x: The Sharp Spiral was the cherished personal starfighter of Jedi Master Saesee Tiin during the waning days of the Galactic Republic.
The Slave II was a starship owned by Boba Fett, which he used circa 10 ABY. It cost him 225,000 credits.

The Yuuzhan Vong—"Children of Yun-Yuuzhan", also called the Chosen Race, known to the Chiss and Ferroans as the Far Outsiders, and sometimes incorrectly abbreviated to Vong (which implied that one was disowned by their family and their gods)—were a nomadic extra-galactic senti…

x: The Seventh Battle of Ruusan was the final major engagement of the conflict known as the New Sith Wars.
Guri was a Human replica droid, designed to be an almost perfect replica of a Human female, and the only one of her kind engineered as an assassin.

Aquatic assault stormtroopers, also known as seatroopers or aquatic troopers, were a specialized branch of the Imperial stormtroopers. They were used by the Galactic Empire to maintain a presence on the many aquatic worlds under its rule.

Radiation zone assault troopers, also known as radiation zone assault stormtroopers, radiation troopers, radiation-shielded stormtroopers, or simply radtroopers, were a specialized variant of stormtroopers that were equipped to operate in heavy radiation zones.

The Zero-G assault stormtroopers, commonly known as spacetroopers, were members of a specialized branch of the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps equipped and trained to capture enemy vessels intact. They also operated within the Imperial Navy.
Dark Troopers were experimental soldiers created as part of the dark trooper program for the Galactic Republic and later Galactic Empire. Dark trooper models were body suits worn by a human pilot.
Hazard stormtroopers, also known as Hazard troopers were a specialized type of stormtroopers used by the Disciples of Ragnos.

Cold assault stormtroopers, also known as Snowtroopers, were Imperial stormtroopers trained to operate in arctic climates. Some snowtroopers were deployed under Death Squadron's Blizzard Force, as well as other arctic forces.

T3-M4 (also called Teethree for short) was a T3-series utility droid built as a master slicer for crime lord Davik Kang. His life of crime was short-lived, however, after Taris was bombarded by the Sith and Davik was killed.
Telos IV, often called simply Telos, was the fourth world within the Telos system, located in the Outer Rim's Kwymar sector.
Canyon was a planet of arid mountains and plains in the Expansion Region, near Moorja.
Sarcophagus was a moon that orbited the planet of Sacorria, and served as a massive graveyard for the planet's deceased inhabitants.
Malachor V, or simply Malachor, was an Outer Rim planet located in the Malachor system. Prior to the final battle of the Mandalorian Wars, the planet was fertile and hospitable.
Abregado-rae, also known simply as Abregado and sometimes spelled Abregado-Rae, was a trade world located in the galaxy's Core Worlds. It was situated at the beginning of the Rimma Trade Route.

An almost untouched world in the Koornacht Cluster, J't'p'tan (known to most simply as Doornik-628E) was settled by the Galandan (from Galand), a population of whom were followers of a religious movement known as H'kig and were fleeing a conflict on Rishi.

affiliation: Jedi Order (owned by Anakin and Obi-Wan)
x: The Jabitha was a starship of Sekotan design that was built for and used briefly by Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.
Hapans were the near-Human natives of the Hapes Cluster, a closely packed star cluster located in the Inner Rim of the galaxy.
The Lorell Raiders were a pirate group in the Hapes Cluster, a closely packed star cluster located in the Inner Rim of the galaxy, some time before 4000 BBY.
A-3DO, known colloquially as ThreeDee, was a Duwani Mechanical Products 3DO protocol/service droid, specializing in the maintenance of starships as well as performing myriad domestic functions.
The Ebon Hawk was a Dynamic-class freighter and a smuggler ship that rose to fame due to its use around the time of the Jedi Civil War.

result: Death of Chief of State Borsk Fey'lya
x: The Battle of Coruscant, also known as the Fall of Coruscant or as the First Battle of Coruscant, was a titanic battle which resulted in Coruscant, the capital of the New Republic, falling into the hands of the invading extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong.

result: Destruction of the Imperial fleet of World Devastators
Considerable damage inflicted upon the Calamarian population
x: The Battle of Calamari, also known as the Battle of Mon Calamari or the Second Battle of Calamari, occurred in 10 ABY, when the reborn Emperor Palpatine's forces attacked the temporary New Republic capital Dac.
Eclipse II was the second Eclipse-class dreadnought. It was also the second flagship of Palpatine.

objective: Discover and colonize worlds in the Unknown Regions
x: Outbound Flight Project was a colonizing and expeditionary initiative by the Galactic Republic into the Unknown Regions, led mainly by Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth.
Skywalker was the name given to an Acclamator-class assault ship after its capture by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The Enforcer One was a modified Core Galaxy Systems Dreadnaught that served as the flagship of Stenness Node–based crime lord Bogga the Hutt in the years leading up to the Great Sith War.

Sibwarra, formerly the Shriwirr, was a heavily customized Ssi-ruuvi Shree-class battle cruiser, and was the flagship of the attack fleet on the remote Imperial world Bakura shortly after the Battle of Endor.

The Nebulon Ranger was a modified Coruscant-class Heavy Courier starship that belonged to Jedi Knight Cay Qel-Droma. Originally an ordinary space transport, the Ranger was modified extensively by Qel-Droma, who transformed it into what he considered a very trustworthy vessel.
The Roche asteroid field, sometimes known simply as Roche, was a series of asteroids colonized by the Verpine, including Nickel One (the capital), Slayn, Korpil, Roche G42, and Shantipole.
The Chazrach (also known as "reptoids") were a short, stocky, reptilian extra-galactic sentient species from a distant galaxy with snubbed snouts who served the Yuuzhan Vong as slaves and soldiers.

The Coway were a primitive race of humanoids that were native to the planet Mimban. Because of their intense dislike of outsiders, they spent most of their lives in the caves beneath the planet's fog-shrouded swamps.
The Ssi-ruuk , Ssi-ruu in singular form, were a saurian species that invaded from the Unknown Regions of the galaxy and initiated the Invasion of Bakura in 4 ABY, shortly after the Battle of Endor.

The P'w'ecks were a warm-blooded, saurian species similar in appearance to the Ssi-ruuk from the tropical planet of Lwhekk in the Ssi-ruuk Star Cluster deep in the Unknown Regions. They were regarded as inferior by the larger Ssi-ruuk who utilized them as slaves.

The Corellian Security Force, commonly abbreviated CorSec, was the primary law enforcement agency of the Corellian system. CorSec was famous for its impressive success rate that relied on the great efficiency of its personnel.

Adari was a mountainous, volcanic planet located in the Inner Rim's Adari sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Adarians, although archaeologists believed evidence pointed to the species not being native to the planet.
Almas was a terraformed planet in the Cularin system. Its moon, Dorumaa, was a captured satellite, which underwent its own terraforming.
Axum was a temperate world located in the Axum system. It had two moons.
Bpfassh was an arid double planet in the Sluis sector orbited by a complicated system of moons, located near Praesitlyn and Sluis Van. It was the homeworld of the Bpfasshi.
Drall was a pleasant, temperate planet in the Corellian system, being one of the Five Brothers. It was the homeworld of the Drall, and was famous for its great food and the Boiling Sea.

Myrkr was a forested world, located fairly close to the galaxy's major population centers in the outskirts of the Inner Rim Territories. It was close to the borders with the Expansion Region and relatively near to the planet of Wayland.
N'zoth was the fifth planet in the N'zoth system, located in the Farlax sector in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of the Yevetha.

Peragus II was a planet in the Peragus system of the Outer Rim Territories' Xappyh sector. A major source of low-grade engine fuel, Peragus II was originally a terrestrial world, but it was nearly destroyed hundreds of years before 3959 BBY by the early attempts of miners to s…
Recopia was a planet in the Recopi system in the Core Worlds, between the Corellian Run and the Hydian Way. It was the site of the annual Bandercamp Auctions in the Hinder Market.
Sacorria was an agriworld in the Sacorrian system, located on the fringe of the Corellian sector.

Saheelindeel was an agricultural world that was located in the Tion Hegemony, within the Outer Rim of the galaxy. It was a backwater world inhabited by the Saheelindeeli, a species of intelligent, green-furred primates.

Sarahwiee was the third planet orbiting the white dwarf Bseto in the Mid Rim. A frozen planet, with a local day of 28 standard hours long, and a year of 389 local days. The planet was discovered shortly after the declaration of the New Order.

Skor II was a planet in the Squab system and the homeworld of the Squibs. It was located in the Outer Rim Territories just west of the Rimma Trade Route. The world was small, with a varied terrain and climate that provided it with vast natural resources.
Solaest was a planet located in the Solaest system, a part of the Belsmuth sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Talravin was a Core Worlds celestial body located on the Hydian Way hyperlane. It was the homeworld of the Human Jedi Knight Bastila Shan. More than three centuries later, it was the site of a casino.
The Fire Breather was a huge leviathan with tough hide and natural chemicals that was manipulated by the Yuuzhan Vong for use as a heavy support organism.
The grutchin was a bioengineered weapon used by the Yuuzhan Vong that resembled a half-meter long, black, winged, locust-like insect.

The Battle of Dantooine took place during the Clone Wars in 22 BBY. One phase was fought on the grassy plains of Dantooine, pitting a small unit of the Grand Army of the Republic against a massive number of battle droids, while a later phase was fought at the same time as the …
The Conquest of Raxus Prime was a battle initiated by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, shortly after the First Battle of Geonosis.
Voxyn were a genetic cross between a fero xyn and a vornskr—both deadly predators—shaped into being by the sentient Yuuzhan Vong species.

Yammosks, also known as war coordinators, were Yuuzhan Vong creatures mainly used as coordinators during battles to send orders to other spacecraft, such as the many coralskippers, to optimize their actions.
Halm was an arid desert world in the Mid Rim, famous for its extensive mines. These mines contained rare Adegan crystals, which were used in the construction of lightsabers.
Nibiru was a forest world, which also boasted at least one large lake. It was located in the Outer Rim's Kakani sector.
Varn was a water planet in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Tiss'shar were a species of predatory sentient therapod reptiles from the planet Tiss'sharl. They were comparatively strong, dexterous, and intelligent, possessing slender frames with long necks and short tails.
Tiss'sharl was a planet in the Xappyh sector, located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the Tiss'shar, a species of intelligent therapods.
The Brentaal was a starship used by the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. It shared its name with the Core world Brentaal IV.
The Marauder Starjacker was a modified E-2 Asteroid Miner captained by pirate Finhead Stonebone in the years leading up to the Great Sith War.

The world of Nim Drovis was located in the Drovian system in the Meridian sector, and was a rainy planet which boasted a Sector Medical Facility and Medical Research Facility attended to by the Ho'Din physician Doctor Ism Oolos, along with a small New Republic base.

The Peace Brigade was a political faction and paramilitary group that opposed the New Republic. It collaborated with the Yuuzhan Vong during their invasion. Their symbol was the image of a Human hand and a Yuuzhan Vong hand clasped, as equals.
Black 2 was a TIE fighter assigned to Black Squadron. The starfighter was flown by TIE pilot "Mauler" Mithel, and the craft was stationed aboard the first Death Star.
The Liberator was a Liberator-class Troopship from the time of the Galactic Republic, during which it bore the name Guardian of the Republic.
The Chistori were a saurian sentient species. They were known to be fierce warriors whose independence had kept them secret from the archives of the Jedi.
The Croke were a species of sentient, multi-legged beings from the planet Crakull in the Unknown Regions who were extremely long lived; one individual enjoyed a lifespan of more than 20,000 years.
The Yevetha were a lithe, skeletal species indigenous to N'zoth in the Koornacht Cluster in the Core Worlds, known for their xenophobia and death-centered culture.
The Allegiance was an Imperial Allegiance-class battlecruiser that participated in the Battle of Calamari in 10 ABY.
The Evocii were a primitive humanoid race from Evocar, which later became the capital Hutt world Nal Hutta.
The Oswaft were sentient, transparent, manta-like creatures that lived inside the ThonBoka nebula in the Centrality.

The Psadan were one of the indigenous races of the planet Wayland. They were covered with lumpy plates that made them resemble walking, talking rocks, Scientists believe they were evolved from hard-shelled mammals.

The Saffa were a sentient species that were responsible for the development of an important form of art, the Saffa paintings, after making contact with the Thennqora. The Saffa painting reached its height approximately 2219-1569 BBY.

The Shi'ido were a sentient species of shapeshifters from the planet of Lao-mon. Senior Anthropologist Mammon Hoole was a Shi'ido, and used his abilities to infiltrate and monitor other alien species.

The Thennqora were a sentient species from the Thennqor system that influenced Saffa paintings after their initial contact, several millennia before the Galactic Civil War. Tamish was a member of this species.
Tsil, also known as Spook-Crystals or Smokies, were mineral-based life forms that resided on the planet of Nam Chorios.

The Vaathkree people evolved on the planet of Vaathkree. They were covered by armored plates, making them appear to be made from stone and metal. Vaathkree were well-known for their devotion to trade and bartering.

The vornskr was a canine beast that could hunt using the Force. Vornskrs were native to the forest planet Myrkr and hunted the native ysalamiri. Over time, the ysalamiri developed abilities to suppress the Force as a defensive adaptation against vornskrs.

The X'Ting were an insectoid species, native to the planet Ord Cestus. The X'Ting were also called Cestians, although the term also came to embody anyone of any species native to the world. They were governed by the Hive Council.
The Ensaiav was a DP20 gunship in the service of the Alliance Fleet.
The Telsor was a DP20 gunship in the service of the Alliance Fleet.
Flurry was a Quasar Fire-class bulk cruiser that was converted into a starfighter carrier.

The Battle of Brentaal IV, also known as the Battle of Brentaal, occurred in 22 BBY. The Galactic Republic had received information that a Separatist stronghold would be lying dormant for a few weeks opening a window of opportunity, as well that the planet was seceding to the …
Hyllyard City was a small frontier town and the capital city of Myrkr, which also served as the commercial hub and largest urban settlement on the planet.
The Walerv was a DP20 gunship in the service of the Alliance Fleet.
Eos was a dark mineral-rich volcanic planet in the Outer Rim Territories that hosted a large droid foundry belonging to the Trade Federation.

The Chu'unthor (the Cerean word for "academy") was a praxeum ship designed by Cerean Jedi Fin-So-Rowan and Human Jedi Ivixa Delbaeth. The ship was built in orbit around the planet Abhean by Republic Fleet Systems in 400 BBY.

The Yuzzem were large, heavy, furred humanoids with long snouts and large black eyes. Their homeworld was the forested planet Ragna III. They were quite strong and temperamental. They fought fiercely, and their large size made them hard to subdue.
The Dominator was an Imperial Interdictor-class Star Destroyer.
The t'landa Til were a massive, quadrupedal, sentient species distantly related to the Hutts.
The Yahk-Tosh were a slug-like sentient species from the planet Xolu in Hutt Space and were believed to be distantly related to the Hutts.
Vontor was a planet located in the Si'Klaata Cluster within the boundaries of Hutt Space. Vontor was a huge source of kiirium.

Shadowtroopers were stormtrooper-Dark Jedi hybrid soldiers created by the Dark Jedi Desann and Imperial Admiral Galak Fyyar on behalf of Lord Hethrir's Empire Reborn. Similar to the Reborn soldiers, Desann used the Valley of the Jedi to imbue stormtroopers with Force powers.

The Kurtzen were a pale, hairless, humanoid species from the planet Bakura. They were the only sentients native to the world; few in number, they became a minority when Human settlers arrived in 150 BBY.

Kalkals were a sentient species. They had wide, flat nostrils and wide mouths. They possessed excellent vision, even during the night, and were famous for their ability to digest almost any substance and regurgitate the rest. Kalkals were somewhat inarticulate.
The Lucky Despot was a large cargo ship which became a notable hotel/casino in Mos Eisley owned and operated by Lady Valarian.

Ahto City was the capital city of Manaan. As the entire surface of Manaan was covered with water, Ahto City was the only above-surface city on the entire planet. The city was mainly inhabited by the Selkath, Manaan's native species.
Calius saj Leeloo, also known as the City of Glowing Crystal, was a major tourist attraction on Berchest during the days of the Galactic Republic and the planet's most populous city.

Kaadara was a small oceanside city on Naboo. Founded thousands of years before the Battle of Yavin as a lavish retreat for Naboo royalty, the city was unique among Naboo cities because the local populace welcomed interactions with the native Gungans.
Helska IV, also called Helska 4, Helska Four, or simply Helska, was the fourth planet in the Helska system, located in Dalonbian sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

CoCo Town, also known as the Collective Commerce District or more simply as the Coco District, was a dilapidated industrial area of the planet Coruscant. It was also the site of Dex's Diner, a local eatery owned by Dexter Jettster during the Republic Era.

Blackmoon was the sole moon of Borleias. As a result, "Blackmoon" was the New Republic code word for the planet. It was so called because it had a black surface, covered in canyons and volcanic craters, and circled Borleias in a 32-hour orbit. It also had a thin atmosphere.
Eredenn Prime, also known as Eredenn IV, was a frozen planet in the Tion Hegemony.

Krant was a wilderness planet in the Bothan Space in the Mid Rim. It saw action from the Clone Wars and the Galactic Civil War, and the Jedi Master Echuu Shen-Jon hid on Krant during decades until Princess Leia Organa appeared on the planet, searching for the Bothan agent Utri…
Doornik-319 (also Morning Bell, Morning's Bell and Preza) was a planet in the Doornik-319 system. The planet was known to the Kubaz as Morning's Bell and to the Yevetha as Preza.
Lao-mon was the tropical homeworld of the shape-shifting Shi'ido species, it was known in their language as Sh'shuun. Their world remained isolated, its exact location unknown to any outlanders.

Brubbs were reptilian bipeds from the planet of Baros in the Baros system. To adapt to life on an arid world with frequent sandstorms, the ancestors of the Brubbs evolved thick skins and tough, transparent membranes over their eyes for protection.
The Lurrians were a peace-loving species that were native to the planet Lur in the Outer Rim Territories.

Aquilaris was an aquatic planet located in the Sanbra sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Once a flourishing resort world, the planet's economy largely revolved around podracing events by the time of the end of the Golden Age of the Galactic Republic.
Reytha was one of the most productive agriworlds of the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire. At the time of the Battle of Yavin, Reytha was governed by Governor Antes Belladar.
The Battle of ILC-905 was fought during the Black Fleet Crisis in 17 ABY.

Blenjeel was a desert planet between Ando and Kothlis, located far from the major hyperlanes. It was inhabited by enormous sand burrowers, which emerged quickly from the ground to devour unsuspecting prey.
Gavryn was a planet with a powerful magnetic pole. Ensign Gilad Pellaeon first distinguished himself while commanding an escort for a convoy to Gavryn. As the convoy entered orbit, pirates attacked.
Orinackra was a prison planet located within the Wild Space of the galaxy.

Bnach was a hot, desolate prison planet that housed an global Imperial penal camp, and was renowned for its deadly rock quarries. Prisoners forced to labor in these quarries were said to survive no more than a year.
Homeworld Security Command, or simply Homeworld Security, was a branch of the Galactic Republic charged with ensuring the security of the capital planet Coruscant.

result: Destruction of the True Mandalorians and Galidraanian rebels
x: The Battle of Galidraan was a conflict that led to the crippling of the True Mandalorians by the Jedi.
The Mrlssi or Mrlssti of Mrlsst in the Tapani sector were a species renowned throughout the sector as scholars and scientists.
Batorine was the forested homeworld of the Blood Carver species. It joined the Galactic Republic in 110 BBY.
The Leviathan was an Interdictor-class cruiser that served the Republic Navy during the Mandalorian Wars.
Mimbanites were one of the native races of the planet Mimban.

Arzid was a planet in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was inhabited by forests of giant macaab mushrooms, tentacle-bushes, and by the dangerous arachnor that feasted on the mushrooms as part of their diet.

Galantos was the second planet in the Utos system in the Core Worlds. It was located on the Widek Bypass, near the Koornacht Cluster. Its first contact with the galactic community was quite ancient, as at least one Fian served as a Jedi 500 years before the First Great Schism.

The Dantari were a primitive species of Near-Humans that hailed from the planet of Dantooine, in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim. They lived a simple nomadic life, wandering about the plains of Dantooine in tribes.

Garban was the homeworld of the Jenet species and the fourth planet in the Tau Sakar system. It was located in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in the region between the Perlemian Trade Route and Corellian Run known as the Slice.
Hakassi was a planet located in the Deep Core.
The Council on Security and Intelligence (CSI) was a committee that provided strategic management of intelligence policy and advising on threats to the New Republic.
The Bakura task force was a small fleet of Rebel Alliance starships dispatched from the Endor fleet to assist the Imperial world of Bakura in repelling the Ssi-ruuvi invasion force of 4 ABY.
Cambrielle was the capital of Ralltiir. The city included the famed Cambriele Exploration Auditorium, and was home to Cambriele SolidState and the popular Dusky Sky Café.
The Wild Karrde was a heavily modified Corellian Engineering Corporation Action VI bulk transport used by Talon Karrde for smuggling and as a mobile base of operations.
Grallia was a city on the planet Ralltiir. It was well-known for its enormous spaceport.
Aaghra was the first planet orbiting the star Zug in the Zug system, which was located in the Arrowhead, the intersection of the Core Worlds and the Slice. It was a moonless world of molten rock.

Zaur was the second planet in orbit around the star Zug in the Zug system, which was located in the Arrowhead region, where the Core Worlds intersected the Slice. The planet had no moons and was completely covered in a methane ocean.

Azameen was the fourth planet from the star Zug in the Zug system. It was an arid terrestrial world that had two natural satellites and was the last planet before the asteroid belt of its star system.

Zauhu was a planet in the Zug system. It was the first planet beyond the asteroid belt and one of the four gas giants in the system, along with Urazuun, Faargau, and Laazrau. Zauhu had the largest number of natural satellites in the star system – forty-seven.
Urazuun was a sixth planet orbiting the star Zug in the Zug system. It was one of four gas giants in that system, along with Zauhu, Faargau, and Laazrau.
Faargau was a planet in the Zug system of the Core Worlds. A planet with fourteen moons, Faargau was one of four gas giants in the star system along with Zauhu, Urazuun, and Laazrau.

Laazrau was a planet in the Zug system. It was one of four gas giants in that star system, along with Zauhu, Urazuun, and Faargau. It was the outermost of them and had the fewest natural satellites – thirteen in total.
Uluu was a planet in the Zug system. It was the farthest planet away from the system's star, Zug, and because of this, it was extremely cold. Uluu possessed a single natural satellite.
Gromas 16, nicknamed the Blood Moon, was the sixteenth moon of the gas-giant Gromas in the Gromas system of the Mid Rim's Perkell sector.
The Vagh Rodiek (Yuuzhan Vong for "Rodian Slaves") were the offspring of the dreadful Yuuzhan Vong bioengineering and the result of genetic manipulation, vivisection, and brutal selective breeding.

Naatan was a beautiful city on the planet Mawan. At one time, it was an enormous city thriving with people, complete with an extensive underground network of tunnels which allowed for the preservation of the city's above ground beauty.

Abregado-dai was the innermost planet from the sun Anza of the Abregado system within the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds region. Located at the head of the Rimma Trade Route like the rest of the system, it was a volcanic planet without any moons.

Abregado-san was the second planet from the star Anza in the Abregado system within the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. It was a barren world, having a desert for a surface, and had no moons.
Abregado-fus was the fourth planet from the star Anza in the Abregado system, within the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. It was a gas giant orbited by nine moons.

Abregado-taki was a planet in the Abregado system within the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. It was the fifth and farthest planet away from the star, Anza, and because of this, it was very cold and icy. In addition to being icy, the planet's surface was also rocky.

Koensayr was a planet in the Colonies region. It was the headquarters of Koensayr Manufacturing. A Gran colony, in addition to industrializing most of the planet, the lower latitudes contain a small, seaside tourism industry, with vibrant colorful sunsets being a standout feat…

The Scimitar, also known as the Sith Infiltrator, was a heavily modified Star Courier and the personal starship of Darth Maul. After his defeat during the Battle of Naboo, the experimental starfighter was appropriated by Maul's master, Darth Sidious.

Kerilt was the innermost planet of the Algaran system, covered by large rainforests. Many surviving Caamasi fled to Kerilt after the bombardment of Caamas by the Galactic Empire, founding the planet's first city, Morymento.

language: Yuuzhan Vong; formerly: Galactic Basic Standard
x: Selvaris was a backwater planet of little significance during the Galactic Civil War. It was the closest inhabited planet to the Bilbringi system.

Ryyk was a Neti colony. It was wrongly considered by some to be the original Neti homeworld, which was Myrkr. Some time prior to the Great Sith War, Ryyk was destroyed when its star went supernova. The remnants formed the Ryyk Nebula.
Pydyr, a moon of Almania, was the homeworld of the Pydyrian species.

Suubatars were majestic riding beasts native to the rolling plains of Ansion. They were six meters tall, with protruding lavender eyes speckled with silver. The suubatar's smooth, tapered skull hinted that it was a creature of impressive speed.
The Endar Spire was a Hammerhead-class cruiser that served with the Galactic Republic Navy during the Jedi Civil War.
Aduba-1 was the first planet from the star Aduba in the Aduba system.
Aduba-2 was the second planet from the star Aduba in the Aduba system.
Aduba-4 was a terrestrial planet in the Aduba system, located in the Outer Rim's Bheriz sector. The fourth planet in its system, Aduba-4 had a pair of moons.
Aduba-5 was a gas giant planet in the Aduba system.
Aduba-6 was the sixth and outermost planet in the Aduba system, on the Outer Rim of the galaxy. It was a frozen, lifeless world.
Enkep was the first planet in the Katorrs system. A molten ball of rock, it had no moons, life, or water and was therefore all but ignored by cartographers of the Galactic Empire.

The Ravager was a Centurion-class battlecruiser used by the Republic Navy during the Mandalorian Wars. In the final battle of the war, it was all but destroyed by the activation of the Mass Shadow Generator and lay in orbit until Darth Nihilus took control of it.

Coyn was a planet in the Coyn system and the homeworld of the Coynites. It was located in Elrood sector, where the Coyn Route met the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route. The capital was the city of En'Tra'Tal, or "King-City".
Grassers were six-legged, three-eyed herbivorous ungulates native to Haruun Kal. They were the main transportation of the Korunnai in the jungle, and were protected by akk dogs.

result: Disarmament and fragmentation of the Mandalorian clans
Utter devastation of Malachor V's surface and the creation of a wound
x: The Battle of Malachor V, also called Ani'la Akaan—the "Great Last Battle"—in Mando'a, was the final cataclysmic battle of the Mandalorian Wars.
Bakarr was a frozen planet in the Katorrs system. It was the third planet from its sun.
Katorr was a gas giant world, the fourth and last planet in the Katorrs system. The star system, which also contained Adumar, was located within the region of the galaxy known as Wild Space.

result: Mothma, Organa, Iblis and Kota are captured
Galen Marek is saved by and escapes with Juno Eclipse
x: The treaty, having been suggested by Darth Vader to Marek, was actually a ploy by Emperor Palpatine to lure all of his enemies into a single place to capture them. Just as Bail Organa declared the treaty finalized, Imperial forces suddenly swarmed the building.

Tu-Scart was a serpentine bio-engineered beast created by the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong during their invasion of the galaxy. His name literally translated as 'slithering smasher', although he was also known as 'Beater'.

Sgauru was a bio-engineered beast created by the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong during their invasion of the galaxy. She was part of a symbiotic pair of bio-engineered beasts known as the Biter and Beater with the other being Tu-Scart.
Tibannopolis was the second largest city on Bespin, after Cloud City. It was one of Bespin's several tibanna gas mining operations.
Raisa was the first planet from the star Alderaan in the Alderaan system.
Avirandel was a barren, rocky planet in the Alderaan system. It had one moon.
Avishan was a frigid planet in the Alderaan system.
Selgon was the first planet from the star Solis Axum in the Axum system.
Grastes was the second planet from the star Solis Axum in the Axum system.
Gorsh was the third planet of the Gorsh system, located in Wild Space 100,000 light years away from the Core. The watery planet had a population of 100,000.

The Diversity Alliance was a radical alien-supremacist terrorist group led by the Twi'lek Nolaa Tarkona from the planet Ryloth and spread across the galaxy, rallying support from non-humans as a result of the injustices inflicted on them by the Galactic Empire.
HK-47 was a Hunter-Killer series assassin droid and Jedi hunter constructed by the Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Revan, shortly after the end of the Mandalorian Wars in 3960 BBY.
Essowyn was the only planet in the Saurton system. The planet was located in the Trax sector, situated between the Kanawyn and Greawyn asteroid belts.

The Anzati (singular: Anzat) were a dangerous and feared Force-sensitive near-Human species with two tentacle-like proboscises that curled out and extended from their cheeks, with which the Anzati were able to feed upon the brains of their prey.
Urfon was the fifth planet from the star Solis Axum in the Axum system.
Phlors Rex was a gas giant in the Axum system. It was orbited by 18 moons.

Phlors Regina was a gas giant planet located within the Azure sector of the galaxy's Core Worlds. Phlors Regina held the seventh position in the Axum system, orbiting the star Solis Axum. It itself was host to fifteen moons.
Ichium was a barren planet in the Axum system.
The Admonitor was an upgraded Imperial-class Star Destroyer under the Empire of the Hand and served as the command vessel, and personal flagship of Grand Admiral Thrawn in the Unknown Regions.
Bak was the airless, rocky first planet in the Bakura system. It was covered with rivers of lava and nearly molten rock.
Arden was the fourth planet and the only gas giant in the Bakura system. It was named after Deredith Arden, the founder of Bakura. Arden was orbited by seven moons.

Hssiss, also called dark side dragons, were a lizard species with the ability to influence Force-sensitive beings around them. If bitten by a Hssiss, one would succumb to the effects of a dark side venom.
Bakura-5, also known simply as Planet 5, was a barren planet in the Bakura system.
Khar Shian was the only moon of Khar Delba, a planet located in the Sith Worlds area of the Outer Rim Territories.

L8-L9 was a prototype battle droid built by TaggeCo during the Clone Wars. The droid was created in the utmost secrecy, and was part of a ploy by Baron Orman Tagge to gain favor in the sight of Palpatine.

Despayre, originally known as Horuz, was a planet in the Horuz system in the Outer Rim Territories, that served as a massive penal and slave world for the Galactic Empire and as a location where the first Death Star was constructed and completed, after being relocated many tim…

Erilnar was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories's Centrality. Serving as the capital of the Centrality, Erilnar had three hundred thousand lakes on its surface, which forced the planet's transportation to go underwater.
Hosrel XI was a planet in the Hosrel system of the Centrality, located in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was an almost barren rock.
Paulking XIV was a planet in the Paulking system of the Centrality. It was renowned for its unusual water life, which included fur-bearing trout, flying crabs, and talking algae.
The Starbreaker 12 was a starship owned by the Daragon family in the years leading up to the Great Hyperspace War.

objective: Locate Count Dooku's hidden base on Bakura

x: Less than a month after the Battle of Geonosis, the Confederacy of Independent Systems invaded the planet Excarga after discovering the valuable ore.
The Ambassadorial Sector was a location in Coruscant's Galactic City. The Ambassadorial Sector was considered a part of the Senate District, and 500 Republica was its premier landmark.

The Battle of Mygeeto was one of the longest battles of the Clone Wars, lasting for two years and beginning in 21 BBY. In 19 BBY, it became part of the Galactic Republic's Outer Rim Sieges to secure the planets of the Outer Rim Territories.

result: Barriss Offee and Luminara Unduli are successfully rescued
The Jedi learn that Count Dooku revealed the location of the Ilum Jedi
x: The Ambush on Ilum was a small-scale battle occurred during the Clone Wars a few months after the Battle of Geonosis.

t: Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)
place: Brentaal IV, Brentaal system, Bormea sector, Core Worlds
x: The Battle of Brentaal IV, also known as the Battle of Brentaal, the siege of Brentaal, and the Battle for Brentaal, was one of the first major engagements between the New Republic and the Galactic Empire, approximately nine months after the Battle of Endor.
The Second Battle of Ord Biniir, also simply known as the Battle of Ord Biniir, took place in 0 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War.
The First Battle of Kamino, also known as the Defense of Kamino, the Assault on Kamino, or simply as the Battle of Kamino, took place in 22 BBY.
Sith Troopers, also known as Sith Legionnaires or Sith Soldiers, were infantry units in the armed forces of the Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War.
TIE pilots served in the Starfighter Corps of the Imperial Navy by piloting the various TIE Series starfighters.
Imperial Navy Troopers, also known as Naval Troopers, Imperial fleet troopers, were the naval soldiers of the Imperial Navy, the space branch of the Galactic Empire's military.

The Evacuation of Rhen Var took place in the first month of the Clone Wars. It was a crushing defeat for the Galactic Republic, despite the fact that the planet was believed unimportant to Republic forces at the time.

A battle took place on Rhen Var early in the Clone Wars. Although still a minor planet in terms of overall strategic importance to the Republic, Rhen Var held the ruins of the temple which held the tomb of fallen Jedi Ulic Qel-Droma and contained information that was vital to …
Euceron was a planet located in the Eucer sector of the Mid Rim. It was located near Anzat.
Kejim was the planet where the Kejim Outpost, an Empire Reborn base believed to be abandoned after the destruction of the first Death Star, was located.

The Knight Hammer, originally named the Night Hammer, was a black Executor-class Star Dreadnought constructed in secret by Superior General Sander Delvardus and appropriated by Admiral Natasi Daala after Delvardus's death at her hands.

region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
sector: Zuma sector; Moddell sector; Outer Moddell systems
x: Eloggi was the second planet in the Endor system, on the Outer Rim of the galaxy. It was a frozen, barren rock that possessed no moons. The Galactic Empire established a mining colony on the planet.

region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
sector: Zuma sector; Moddell sector; Outer Moddell systems
x: Megiddo was the third planet of the Endor system. It was a barren rock with no moons.

The Arc Hammer was an Imperial spacefaring production facility used to supplement the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps with dark troopers, a new generation of battle droid stormtroopers to be used in the Galactic Civil War against the Rebel Alliance.

Aurea was a planet, located in the Aurea system, well known for its expert artisans, gathered in the Aurean Glassworkers Guild. The skilled glass workers of the planet were known to make objects of outstanding beauty; luxury vessels that were considered nearly priceless.

Avogwi were a sentient species of predatory birds native to Altor 14, which was also home to the Nuiwit. Except for their muscular, scale-covered legs, their bodies were covered in orange feathers, which camouflaged them against Altor's orange skies.
Nuiwit were a lizard-like sentient species from Altor 14. In contrast to Altor 14's other natives, the predatory Avogwi, the Nuiwit were strictly herbivorous.

The Reborn were a deadly force of Dark Jedi of the Empire Reborn faction. An accomplishment of the dream of artificial infusion of the Force into individuals, the Reborn warriors were the instrument of Lord Hethrir's master plan, bringing back the ideals of Emperor Palpatine, …
Kroyies were a large birdlike species native to the planet Kashyyyk.
Dalron Five was a planet that was devastated during the long Siege of Dalron Five, in which the Galactic Empire used strategies first devised by Jan Dodonna.
The Doomgiver was an Imperial military carrier vessel used by elements of the Imperial Remnant.
Clone lancer troopers were clone troopers who specialized in speeder bike combat.
Alpha Red was a clandestine experimental research unit primarily within the New Republic Intelligence Service but also later within its successor agency, the Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service.
Taspir III was a mountainous planet located in the Outer Rim Territories.
Clan Fett was an ancient Mandalorian clan that could trace its lineage back as far as the Mandalorian Wars.

G0-T0, also known as "Goto," was a G0-T0 infrastructure planning system operational circa 3955 – 3951 BBY. He later became head of the Exchange criminal organization on Nar Shaddaa and traveled with the Jedi Exile, Meetra Surik.

The Slave IV was an AIAT/i gunship produced by Kuat Drive Yards that was used by Boba Fett to replace the Slave III. Coincidentally, it was of the same ship class as Jaster's Legacy, the original vessel of Boba's father, Jango Fett.

result: Destruction of Gungan colony from swamp gas
x: The Battle of Ohma-D'un or Defense of Naboo was a small-scale battle that took place roughly ten weeks after the Battle of Geonosis.
The Vengeance II, or simply Vengeance, was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served in Death Squadron and under command of Inquisitor Jerec.
The Quaestor was a Republic Praetor-class battlecruiser that served during the Clone Wars.

Rakghouls were a type of Sith-spawned mutants, engineered by the Sith Lord Karness Muur. Desiring an army to rule over and seeking a way to cheat death as so many other Sith before and after him did, Muur had a talisman forged that he poured his spirit and power into, one that…
Danuta was a dull, barren brown planet in the Colavas system, thinly populated mostly by miners and hardscrabble farmers. Trid was the planet's de facto capital.

Artus Prime was a terrestrial planet located in the Artus system of the Kwymar sector in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet primarily served as a mining colony, which was known for its Artusian crystals which could also be used in the construction of lightsabers.

The Bladeborn were a Sith splinter faction that originated as elite Sith assassins of Darth Revan's Sith Empire. They believed edged weapons were better than lightsabers for focusing the dark side of the Force and, as a result, trained in combat with steel swords.

The Imperial Board of Culture, or IBC for short, was the governmental body within the Galactic Empire that was charged with reviewing and censoring popular culture media, such as music and holofilms, that was to be distributed within the Empire.
Mos Osnoe was a small city located on the desert planet of Tatooine.
The Siege of Trasemene was an Imperial victory, won by Grand Admiral Miltin Takel. Takel's use of glitterstim spice proved invaluable in obtaining that victory.

Colicoid Swarm was a modified Trade Federation Providence-class carrier/destroyer in the Confederate Navy. The vessel was colored a bluish grey, with subtle red bow stripes and dark-toned keel, nose, and structure.
The Bolotaur was a large, long-necked reptilian creature native to Kashyyyk.

The bol was a species of mammal native to the planet of Dantooine. It was used primarily to produce milk, but also was a popular mount even outside of Dantooine. They were often hunted for their hide; however, due to over-hunting the population of bols was in steady decline.

Wetland assault stormtroopers, nicknamed swamptroopers, were specialized stormtroopers trained and equipped to operate in forested wetlands and other semi-aquatic environments, such as lakes, rivers, and settlements built on or near waterways.

The Diamala (singular Diamal) were a species from the planet Diamal, in the Core Worlds, who, along with their rivals the Ishori, became prominent during the crises over the Caamas Document and the apparent return of Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Povanarians were a frog-like sentient species native to the planet Povanaria. They were one of the member species of the New Republic in 19 ABY, serving alongside Bagmims and Humans in the New Republic Defense Fleet.

The Ishori, a species indigenous to the planet Isht, were long-time rivals of the Diamala. Their disputes over commerce and resource-sharing were a common source of tension in their part of the Core Worlds.
The Leresai (adj. Leresen) of the Mid Rim were a species which sided against the Bothans during the Caamas Document crisis in 19 ABY.

Kashi was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Phelleem sector. At one point home to the ancient, isolationist Kashi Mer civilization, it was governed by the Kashi Mer Dynasty, whose influence also extended outside the Kashi system.
The Battle of Basilisk was fought before the Great Sith War.
The Bagmims were a sentient species from the planet Xochtl, located in the Gordian Reach.
The Garoos (adj. Garoosh) were a member species of the New Republic. They could be found in all levels of Republic society.

The Morish were a short, furry species from the planet Morishim in the Outer Rim. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, a secret communications center was established in a cave on Morishim; after the Empire pulled out, a Morish known as the Old Recluse found the abandoned c…
Morishim was a planet in the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim and the homeworld of the Morish species.

Calibops were an avian sentient species known during the times of the New Republic. The species had manes and prehensile wingtips. They also had a reputation of being better with words than with acts, something that not even the Calibops themselves argued.

Eres III was a Mid Rim world located in the Esuain sector. During the Mandalorian Wars, the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders attacked it, causing decade-long fires on the world's surface when they ignited its Xoxin plains region.
Di'tai'ni was the home of the Tai'ni, as well as many non-Tai'ni resident workers. It was two systems away from the Both system.

The Froffli species were a New Republic member race easily recognized by their prominent hair-spurs. While many Humans found their appearance ridiculous, others (such as Talon Karrde's associate Chin) arranged their own hair in a similar fashion.

The Laerdocians were a species who spoke Basic with an unusual accent (pronouncing "nothing" as "nothjing", for example.) A Laerdocian named Bodwae served under the smuggler Booster Terrik as a technician on the Errant Venture circa 19 ABY.
Adamantine was a New Republic escort cruiser used at Nam Chorios. All hands were lost and the ship destroyed when the Death Seed plague was released. Its crew included Koth Barak and Gallie Wover.

The Aggregator was an Imperial Immobilizer 418 cruiser owned by High Admiral Treuten Teradoc. Prior to finding herself in Teradoc's service, it was used in campaigns against the Rebel Alliance during the days of the Galactic Civil War.
Another Chance was an Alderaanian War Frigate of the Alderaanian fleet during the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Basilisk was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that was placed under the command of Captain Mullinore, who served as part of Admiral Natasi Daala's squadron of four Star Destroyers.
The Graveyard was the leftover remnants of the planet of Alderaan after its destruction by the first Death Star.
The Gerb were a sentient lagomorph species native to the moon Yavin 13.

The Slith were a sentient serpentine species native to the moon Yavin 13. Nomadic creatures, they lived in patriarchal tribes of up to fifteen individuals and had little civilization and no permanent structures.
Fiddanl, originally known as 96NK3F2, was a barren planet in the Yavin system.
Stroiketcy was a comet captured in the orbit of the star Yavin. The name "Stroiketcy" came from a Corellian word meaning "tailed one."

Yavin 22 was an uninhabitable moon of the gas giant Yavin Prime, originally an asteroid captured by the planet's gravity. The wreck of the space station Yavin Station could be found there. Suz Tanwa found Yavin Station where her ancestor, Suvam Tan, worked and lived there.
Huip was the innermost celestial body orbiting the star Beheboth in the Beheboth system, a star system located in the Sanbra sector, one of the Trailing Sectors in the Outer Rim Territories.

Brenu was the second celestial body in orbit around the star Beheboth in the Beheboth system, which was situated in the Sanbra sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Classified as a sungrazer planetoid, Brenu did not have any moons.

Hebeth was a moonless planet that occupied the third orbit around the star Beheboth in the Beheboth system, which was located in the Sanbra sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Hebeth's surface consisted of molten rock.
The Hebine Ring was an asteroid belt between the planets Hebeth and Beheboth in the Beheboth system. An ancient observatory was built by the Sith in one of the larger asteroids.

Behenui was a planet in the fifth orbit around the star Beheboth. It was the only gas giant in the Beheboth system, which was located in the Sanbra sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Behenui itself was circled by nine moons.

Derenath was a barren, icy planet that occupied the sixth orbit around the star Beheboth in the Beheboth system, a star system located in the Sanbra sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors in the Outer Rim Territories. Derenath had no moons.

Omdrid was a planet that occupied the seventh orbit around the star Beheboth. It was the outermost celestial body in the Beheboth system, a star system that was located in the Sanbra sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Corusca Rainbow was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser under the command of Captain Uwlla Iillor. The ship was originally called the Black Asp and served in the Imperial Navy.
The Adamant was a New Republic bulk cruiser under the command of Admiral Gial Ackbar.
The Adamant was a Victory-class Star Destroyer that served within the armada of Grand Admiral Thrawn.
Revisse was the first planet from its star, Coruscant Prime, in the Coruscant system. The planet had a molten surface.
Platoril was a barren planet in the Coruscant system, the second planet from Coruscant Prime.
Vandor-1 was a rocky, barren planet in the Coruscant system. It was the third planet from the sun Coruscant Prime.
Vandor-2 was a rocky, barren planet in the Coruscant system. It was the fourth planet from the sun Coruscant Prime.
Muscave was one of two gas giants in the Coruscant system. During the Battle of Yuuzhan'tar, the Galactic Alliance's Second Fleet engaged elements of the Yuuzhan Vong armada above Muscave.
Pernicar was the first planet orbiting the star Hoth's Brand in the Ruusan system. Located in the Teraab sector of the Mid Rim, it was a scorching rock.
Stentat was one of two gas giants in the Coruscant system.
Improcco was an icy planet in the Coruscant system. It was the ninth planet from the star Coruscant Prime. Improcco had one moon, known as the Frozen Moon of Improcco.
The Covey was an asteroid belt between the planets Improcco and Nabatu in the Coruscant system.
Nabatu was a barren planet in the Coruscant system. It was the tenth planet from the star Coruscant Prime.
Ulabos was a frozen, rocky planet in the Coruscant system. It was surrounded by immense rings of ice and rock, known as the Ulabos ice bands.
Pas'sic was a planet in the Oricho sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Sif'kric was a planet in the Mezeg sector of the Mid Rim. This planet was attacked during the Caamas Document Crisis.

The Corsair was a Derriphan-class battleship that played a major role in two galactic wars a millennium apart. A Sith vessel, the Corsair contained Force-enhancing Sith magic crystals of immense power that were able to tear out the core of a star.
Ennth was a planet that, every eight years, was wreaked by enormous groundquakes, tidal waves, and volcanic eruptions.
Charny was the second planet orbiting the star Hoth's Brand in the Ruusan system. Located in the Teraab sector of the Mid Rim, it was a terrestrial world.
Turpimir was the fourth planet orbiting the star Hoth's Brand in the Ruusan system. Located in the Teraab sector of the Mid Rim, it was a barren world.

Dromund Ixin was a barren planet with no moons occupying the first orbital position around the star Dromund within the Dromund system. The star system was located within the Outer Rim Territories' Esstran sector, within a region known as the Sith Worlds.
Dromund Kalakar was a gas giant in the Dromund system. Its shipyards produced the VX-9 Mailoc gunship and F-T2 Quell, FT-3C Imperium and F-T6 Rycer strike fighters for the Sith Empire.
Dromund Fels was an arid planet that occupied the fourth orbit around the star Dromund in the Dromund system, a star system in the Sith Worlds within the Outer Rim Territories's Esstran sector.

Dromund Tyne was a barren planet with no moons occupying the fifth orbital position around the star Dromund within the Dromund system. The star system was located within the Outer Rim Territories' Esstran sector, within a region known as the Sith Worlds.
Starstorm One was the personal starship of Jedi Knight and later Dark Lord of the Sith Exar Kun during the period of the Great Sith War.

Farfalla's Diamonds was an asteroid belt located in the Ruusan system. It held the fifth orbital position around the star Hoth's Brand in the system. Located in the Teraab sector of the Mid Rim, it divided space between the planets Turpimir and Zor Vlahu.
Zor Vlahu was a gas giant located in the Ruusan system. It was named for the Jedi Zor Vlahu who fought in the Ruusan campaign during the New Sith Wars. It was the fifth planet in the system.
Saleeh was a gas giant planet in the Ruusan system. The seventh planet orbiting the star Hoth's Brand, it was named for Jedi Lord Saleeh who fought in the Ruusan campaign.

Gale was an icy world that was located within the Hoth's Brand system on the Mid Rim of the galaxy. Situated in the star system's ninth orbit and the eight planet, it was named for Lord Gale, who fought in the Ruusan campaign. Gale was orbited by two moons.

Othone was a planet in the Hoth's Brand system. An ice ball, it was the ninth planet orbiting the star Hoth's Brand. It was named after Johun Othone, who was killed by Darth Zannah during the Duel on Tython.

Myl Vlahu was a gas giant planet in the Ruusan system. It was the sixth planet orbiting the star Hoth's Brand. It was named after Jedi Myl Vlahu who fought in the Ruusan campaign during the New Sith Wars.

The Exchange was a criminal organization active from around 4000 BBY to at least 3627 BBY, and possibly the most powerful of its time, that dealt in spice refinement and smuggling, extortion, weapon trafficking, slave trading, and bounty hunting.

Bouncers were the native sentient species of Ruusan. Globe-like green-furred creatures, they received their name from their method of locomotion: propelled by the wind, they bounced themselves off obstacles to reach great heights.

Gallinore was a planet in the Interior Region of the Hapes Cluster that was famed for its rainbow gems. Gallinore was also home to a number of high-tech labs, including a lockdown facility where imprisoned researchers, including a former Jedi, were allowed to continue some work.

Veloc was a planet in the fourth orbit around the star Velm. The first of two gas giants in the Velm system, it was located in the Halori sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim. Veloc was orbited by thirty-three moons, 281 asteroid moonlets, and a planetary ring.

Sorjus was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Meridian sector. It was the homeworld of the Paaerduag species. The spacer Ja'Gatcha and merchant Mic'tunan'jus Orgu were two Paaerduag who had left their home planet by 3956 BBY.

End of the Jedi Civil War
x: The Battle of Rakata Prime was the final battle of the Jedi Civil War. Taking place around the primary star of the Lehon system, it was fought between the navies of the Galactic Republic and Darth Malak's Sith Empire, with each side bolstered by their own Force-users.
Iron Fist was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought, under the command of Imperial Admiral Zsinj. Originally named Brawl, it was renamed by Zsinj after his first command.
Iron Fist was a Victory-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Starfleet during the Galactic Civil War.

The Myrkr strike team was a group of young Jedi led by Apprentice Anakin Solo, with the support of two YVH droids and various personnel, who went to infiltrate the Yuuzhan Vong worldship Baanu Rass in Myrkr's orbit in order to destroy the voxyn queen during the Yuuzhan Vong Wa…
The Death's Head was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy.
Nemesis was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer.
Kohlma, also known as the Moon of the Dead, was a moon of the planet Bogden.
Stormhawk was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer.
The Inexorable was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Bogg 4 was one of the many moons of Bogden. Bogg 4 was a haven for petty thieves, bounty hunters, and cheating dock managers who took anyone's ships who were gullible enough to trust them.
D'vouran was a living free-floating planet in the galaxy that devoured anything it came in contact with.

Right to Rule was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that served as Grand Admiral Gilad Pellaeon's flagship during the Imperial Remnant's actions in the war with the Yuuzhan Vong from 28 ABY to 29 ABY.
Ramsees Hed was a docking port located on the planet of Cal-Seti.

Ychna were massive, bioengineered, space slug-like creatures that had mouths over eighty meters wide. Long enough to coil around an orbital city, ychna were used during the Yuuzhan Vong War by the sentient Yuuzhan Vong species to mainly assault space stations and other orbital…
The Dashta eels were a species of eels native to Ord Cestus and unknown to the outside galaxy. Immature ones were the size of a clenched Human fist when coiled, and had blind eyes.

Quantill City was the capital city on the planet Ando. The city was divided into Aquala and Quara quarters. It was the location of the Raquish Thoroughfare, where great celebrations took place after Ando's secession from the Galactic Republic in 23 BBY.
Imperial Sovereign Protectors, also known as Royal Guard Champions, were the most elite cadre of guardsmen in the Dark Empire of the Deep Core.

This Battle of Kirrek took place in 5000 BBY, during the Unification Wars of the Koros system. Having unified six of the seven planets in the Koros system, the political leader Empress Teta ordered a conquest of the only remaining independent world, Kirrek.

The Shadow Runner was the personal starship of husband-and-wife pilots Hok and Timar Daragon. In the year 5000 BBY, the Unification Wars of the Koros system broke out, and the forces of Empress Teta were encircled and besieged by rebels on Kirrek.
The Battle of Coruscant was one of several simultaneous engagements that constituted the Sith Empire's invasion of the Galactic Republic.

t: Battle of Koros Major (Great Hyperspace War)
side1: Unified forces of the Koros system
x: During the Great Hyperspace War, this clash was fought between the army of the unified Koros system and the forces of the Sith Empire. In 5000 BBY, Dark Lord of the Sith Naga Sadow gathered an invasion force and launched an attack on the Galactic Republic.

Kirrek was a planet in the Empress Teta system. It was the site of two important battles: a first during the Unification Wars and a later one the Great Hyperspace War. In the former, it was the last world to fall to Empress Teta.

The Battle of Kirrek was a battle fought during the Great Hyperspace War in 5000 BBY. During Dark Lord of the Sith Naga Sadow's invasion of the Galactic Republic, part of his fleet was brought to the Koros system, in an effort to conquer the system.

Brelor was a moon of the planet Commenor. It was given by the Galactic Empire to Jan Dodonna as a retirement home, even as the Empire's COMPNOR intelligence organization tried to assassinate him. Jan was alerted ahead of time by Mon Mothma. He escaped the attempt on his life.
Almania was a cold and windy planet located in the Almanian system in the Outer Rim Territories. It had three moons, Pydyr, Auyemesh, and Drewwa.
Daminia was a desert world located in the Daminia system, a part of the Perkell sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim. The damind lightsaber crystals could be found there.
Virago was a prototype StarViper-class attack platform and the personal starship of Prince Xizor.

A qworlth skaal, also known as dread weapon, was a biologically engineered worm-like organism that extended from the bow of a Yuuzhan Vong warship or worldship. The creature could penetrate the surface of an enemy ship or space station and suck out all beings aboard.
The Havoc was a modification of the experimental Scurrg H-6 prototype bomber/starfighter and was owned by the Feeorin pirate Nym.
The Jade Shadow was a heavily modified SoroSuub Horizon-class Star Yacht owned by Jedi Master Mara Jade Skywalker, which replaced her previous ship, Jade Sabre.
The Dominant was a Carrack-class light cruiser of the Imperial Navy.
The New Republic War College was an educational institution responsible for the preservation of and education on topics of warfare.

Vehicle Command Crewers, also known as Imperial Army pilots, were the Galactic Empire's support personnel responsible for the operation and maintenance of a variety of vehicles, such as the AT-AT and AT-ST, within the Imperial Army.
Ebaq 9 was a natural satellite of the Deep Core planet Ebaq located in the Treskov system. The moon was a barren planetoid.

conflict: New Sith Wars (Light and Darkness War)
x: A battle on Hoth was one of the major battles waged between the Army of Light and the Brotherhood of Darkness during the New Sith Wars. Lord Hoth commanded the forces of the Jedi during this battle.

Khar Delba was an icy, snowy planet in the Sith Worlds, which was part of the Sith Empire as of 5000 BBY. Khar Delba had one moon, Khar Shian, and was located at the edge of Sith Space. It was the home to the Sith war behemoth.

The Cha'a were a small, orange-scaled, reptilian species, known for their cunning natures. They were part of galactic society for many thousands of years. One of the most famous Cha'a was the Merchant Lord, Ssk Kahorr, who lived during the Great Hyperspace War.
Keres I was a searing rock planet with no moons that was located in the Empress Teta system.
Gillad was a planet in the Empress Teta system with one moon.
Mozos was a planet in the Empress Teta system with two moons.
Tryast was a planet that was located within the Empress Teta system, in the Deep Core region of the galaxy. It was orbited by one moon.
Phiris was a planet located in the Empress Teta system. It had two moons.
Phoros was a planet in the Empress Teta system with one moon.

Keres II, alternatively known as Keres Two, was a frozen rock planet. The planet was located in the Empress Teta system of the Deep Core's Koros sector. By 3643 BBY, a mining outpost was set up to harvest carbonite deposits, though it was abruptly abandoned.

The Jade's Fire was a highly modified Personal Luxury Yacht 3000. Originally owned by the industrialist Ja Bardrin and named The Winning Gamble, the ship later belonged to Mara Jade, who named it Jade's Fire.
Barhu was the first planet from the single star of the Churba system. It was a high-temperature, rocky world that was considered to have no civilized purpose.

Ord Ibanna was a gas giant in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet once housed a Tibanna mining colony, which was abandoned sometime prior to the Invasion of Naboo as well as being the site of an intense naval engagement between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire during th…

result: New Republic occupation of Bilbringi Shipyards
x: The Battle of Bilbringi, was the final battle of the Thrawn campaign in 9 ABY between the forces under Grand Admiral Thrawn and the combined forces of the New Republic military and the Smugglers' Alliance.
Bravo Flight, otherwise known as Ferry Flight, was an escort squadron of at least nine T-65BR X-wing reconnaissance starfighters attached to the New Republic Fifth Battle Group.
The Lost City of the Jedi was a secret city and terraforming station, located deep below the surface of the fourth moon of Yavin Prime.

The Battle of Thule, also known as the Assault on Thule, was the final battle of the Dark Reaper crisis during the Clone Wars, in which the Republic managed to locate and destroy the Separatist superweapon.
Otoh Jahai was a Gungan city on Naboo in 3000 BBY. It was the site of an ancient Gungan Temple.
Otoh Urs was a Gungan city on Naboo some 3000 years before the Battle of Naboo.
Otoh Raban was a Gungan city on Naboo in 3000 BBY.
Razor's Kiss was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought built at Kuat Drive Yards for the Empire.

The Prosecutor was a slightly modified Acclamator-class assault ship in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. The ship became infamous in 21 BBY when it was boarded by a hostile crew of Trandoshan slavers and mercenaries.

Republic City was a megalopolis and the capital of Hosnian Prime. It was the seat of power of the New Republic, as the planet served as the duly-elected capital of the New Republic Senate during the conflict between the First Order and the Resistance.

owners: Minister of State Leia Organa Solo
x: The Rebel Dream was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer of the New Republic Navy. It began its career in the Imperial Navy as the Tyrant.

Gal'fian'deprisi was the capital city of the planet Galantos. As the city was half-sunk into the Gar'glum Sea, there were no landing pads for starships. The city was accessible only by Vert'bo airships from the Chirk'pn Wastes.
The Gejalli were enemies of the Shell Hutts, who bought A-series assassin droids for use against them. In turn, the Gejalli were rumored to have kept a number of Nimbus commandos on retainer.

Vosadii was a Hutt kajidic. Soergg Vosadii Bezhin, a Bossban on Ansion, was a member of this clan. The Vosadiis were among the few clans that could trace their lineage back to Varl, the home of the ancient Hutt Empire from before the Galactic Republic; thus, they were known to…
Anjiliac was a Hutt clan. It was very influential and powerful during, and after, the Galactic Civil War. They controlled the shadowport Point Nadir.
Ferroans were pale-blue skinned humanoids with gold eyes. Most females had white hair but some had traditional black hair. They were from Ferro and had colonized the Inner Ferro systems.

conflict: None (isolated conflict; preceding the Great Hyperspace War)
x: A battle on the planet Khar Delba took place in the year 5000 BBY, and served to consolidate the Dark Lord of the Sith Naga Sadow's power before he brought the Sith Empire into the Great Hyperspace War against the Galactic Republic.

The Battle at Primus Goluud was waged high above the star Primus Goluud during the Great Hyperspace War in 5000 BBY, between Empress Teta's forces and the Sith Empire of Dark Lord of the Sith Naga Sadow.
The Ralroost was a Bothan Assault Cruiser commissioned at the end of the Galactic Civil War for the defense of Bothawui.

This skirmish was fought in 5000 BBY between the respective war fleets of Naga Sadow and Ludo Kressh—former rivals for the title of Dark Lord of the Sith—high above the Sith graveyard world of Korriban.

A battle was fought over Korriban during the Great Hyperspace War between the battered and diminished forces of Dark Lord of the Sith Naga Sadow and the forces of Koros system leader Empress Teta, who had followed her adversaries to the worlds of the Sith Empire.
A battle, fought in the year 4000 BBY, was the culmination of a centuries-long planetary conflict known as the Beast Wars of Onderon.
The Beast Riders were those banished from Iziz into the wilderness of Onderon by its rulers who had been corrupted by their former king, the Sith Lord Freedon Nadd.

Deralia was a planet that was located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. After the Jedi captured the Sith Lord Darth Revan, the Jedi Council of Dantooine used the Force to heal the severe damage to Revan's mind, which he sustained after being betrayed by his apprentic…

Onderon is cleansed of the dark side
x: The Freedon Nadd Uprising, also called the Naddist Revolt or the Naddist Uprising, was a series of battles fought during the Old Sith Wars, that occurred on the planet Onderon in 3998 BBY.
Inexorable was a Victory-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Starfleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Inexorable was a Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser that served in the Imperial Navy.
