The sarcophagi of Queen Amanoa and Freedon Nadd are recovered
x: The Funeral of Amanoa was an event that took place during the Freedon Nadd Uprising, in the year 3998 BBY, which saw the dark side-empowered army commanded by King Ommin of Iziz attack the combined forces of the Jedi Order and the Beast Riders of Onderon during the funeral pro…

The Battle of Praesitlyn was fought between Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic forces over Praesitlyn and the Intergalactic Communications Center in c. 22 BBY during the Clone Wars. Its CIS codename was Operation Case White.
Seatroopers were a specialized variant of stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps trained and equipped for aquatic operations.
The Geroon were a sentient species hailed from the epynomous Unknown Regions planet. They were captured and enslaved by the Vagaari species in 27 BBY.

Nomad City was a mobile mining facility owned by Lando Calrissian. It was located on the small, mineral-rich world of Nkllon. Nomad City was built from an old Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser, which was mounted on top of forty captured AT-AT walkers.

The Chevs were one of the two native sentient species of the planet Vinsoth. These humanoids were slaves of the Chevin, Vinsoth's other indigenous people, for most of their recorded history, a fact which shaped their culture and their interactions with the rest of the galaxy.

The capture beast was a Yuuzhan Vong bio-engineered war beast deployed on battlefields to capture refugees and enemy forces during the Yuuzhan Vong War. They resembled gigantic cylindrical, bristled worms and sported a pair of bioluminescent eyespots and antennae.

Rindao was a drab training station in the days of the Galactic Empire, close to the Outer Rim Territories. When the Empire arrived to take over the planet, the local populace had not resisted outright, and so avoided any significant persecution by the new regime.
The Mathayus was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer commanded by Admiral Coy, and later Admiral Dezsetes. Its First Officer was Atali.
Thanta Zilbra was a barren and sparsely populated planet located within the Thanta Zilbra system of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Battle of Ord Mantell was an attack launched by Grand Admiral Thrawn to ensure that the New Republic failed to anticipate that he was planning an assault on Coruscant.
Tarkin's Fang was a planet located in the Deep Core, near the Treskov system. It was the location of a secret Galactic Empire base.
Vandos was a planet located in the Vandos system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was controlled by the Separatists during the Clone Wars.

Omega Squad was an elite clone commando unit, and was part of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. The members of this unit were brought together after each of their respective squads were killed during action at Geonosis.
Theta Squad was an elite clone commando unit, and was part of the Grand Army of the Republic during the beginning of the Clone Wars.

Jrade Plaza was located in the Jrade District in Galactic City on the planet Coruscant. It was capable of holding thousands of spectators and, during the time of the Galactic Republic, contained the Chancellery Walkway, which was lined with monuments and memorials to the most …
The Battle of Telos IV was a battle that started the downfall of the dark trinity of Darth Nihilus, Darth Sion, and Darth Traya in 3951 BBY.

The Eye of Palpatine was a dreadnaught constructed by Galactic Empire at the behest of Emperor Palpatine during the Imperial Era. It was designed by Ohran Keldor as the Empire's first functional superweapon while resembling an asteroid as a means of camouflage.
Amma was the capital city of the planet Bacrana. After a civilian insurrection on the planet, the city was placed under martial law by Moff Lesan Ramier.
The Navigators' Guild, also known as the Brotherhood of Navigators, was an organization responsible for the discovery and establishment of new hyperspace routes for safe travel around the galaxy.
The Second Battle of Onderon occurred during the Freedon Nadd Uprising in the year 3998 BBY, resultant of Galactic Republic Military intervention solicited by the Tchuukthai Jedi Master Thon.

The Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit (R-EAU), known commonly as the Republic rocket-jumpers, was an elite soldier equipped with a rocket pack, used by the Galactic Republic millennia before the rise of the Empire. They were organized as a part of the Republic Army.
The Myneyrshi (singular, Myneyrsh) were a sentient species native to the arboreal planet Wayland located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy.
The choreamnos was a type of lazy, arboreal animal. They hardly moved except to get leaves on other branches.
The Hanadaks were predatory primates indigenous to the forest moon of Endor. Ewoks have claimed that they were controlled by the Gorax, but none of them were able to prove this legend.

Moufs were medium-sized, solitary creatures that often got together to feed or mate. They were very touchy creatures with extremely slow metabolisms who survived on minimal food resources, including the bark of dying trees.

Wallugas were large creatures that lived on Kashyyyk and were generally found on the Rryatt Trail and in the Etyyy hunting grounds. Among the most deadly creatures on Kashyyyk, the Walluga used their powerful limbs to stomp and smash their enemies.

Fynocks were avian creatures that could be domesticated. They appeared as exotic birds with snake tails. Fynocks lived on the planet of Talus and were the atmospheric cousins of the vacuum-traversing mynock.

The grazer was a docile, four legged, slow-moving herbivore native to the planet Alderaan. Bred for their rich source of nutritious and tasty meat and agricultural purposes, grazers were easy to manage and grew to tremendous sizes.
Tortons were red and green testudines with long legs. They originated on Naboo's moon of Rori.

Vesps were poisonous lizards that lived on the planet Lok. They typically fought in pairs and attempted to encircle their prey, attacking it with their spiked tail. Several races existed on Lok, including Desert Vesps, Gorge Vesps and Mountain Vesps.

Thosa, known to the rest of the galaxy as Draethos, was the home planet of the Draethos species, located in the Wyl sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It had jagged, windswept mountains and deep caves. It was an isolated world of xenophobic people.
The Slave III was the third starship piloted by the infamous bounty hunter Boba Fett.
The Shell Hutts were the smallest of the Hutt clans and had a tortoise insignia.

The Jin'ha were a enigmatical warriors known for their work with the lightsaber-resistant cortosis ore. The Jin'ha also sold some of their cortosis ore to the Trade Federation, which utilized it for their experimental assassin droids.
Vuultin was a large city of the planet Brentaal IV. It had no strategic value. It was built to the east of Oradin.
The Starlite Flats was the first piece of terrain through which the contestants of the Boonta Eve Classic raced.
The Metta Drop was a sudden drop in the Boonta Eve Classic terrain used by Podracers on the planet Tatooine.

Ch'hodos was a rocky desert planet that orbited a red sun within the Outer Rim Territories' Sith Worlds region. Ch'hodos was considered a lesser world of the Sith Empire and served as the central base of the Sith Lord Shar Dakhan by the year 5000 BBY.
Odik II was a planet that was located on the Byss Run hyperlane in the Deep Core. It housed political detention wards used by the Galactic Empire to secretly imprison many dissidents.
Odos was a planet located in the Odos system, one of the Odos systems situated within the Meridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Off Chance was an old blockade runner that had been won by Lando Calrissian in a sabacc game.

Ohann was the second planet orbiting the stars Tatoo I and Tatoo II in the Tatoo system. Located in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant. It was the largest out of the three planets in the Tatoo system.
Spuma was a medium sized planet in the Seswenna sector of the Outer Rim. It had a number of prairies, mountains, and jungles located along its surface.

Kesiak, also known as Kesiak City, was the old capital city of the planet Thule. It was the stronghold of the Sith armies during the time of the Sith War, as well as the location of an ancient weapon, the Dark Reaper.
The Sarpazian Rose was a ship used by the female Human smuggler Bera Kazan during the Clone Wars. It was somewhat dented and scarred, a trait owing to the extreme conditions in which Kazan operated.
Sivvi, also known as the Thule Moon, was an asteroid that was captured by the gravity of Thule, becoming the planet's moon.

Giat Nor was the capital of N'zoth, with a population of one million Yevetha. Outsiders were forbidden to enter, though some aliens were known to use disguise kits to gain entrance, despite the penalty of death if discovered.

Hariz was a city on N'zoth, located 150 kilometers southeast of Giat Nor. The city included the starport called Hariz Downside, and outdoor markets. It was connected to Giat Nor by a hovertrain. It was within Hariz that Nil Spaar reappeared after fleeing Coruscant.

Bagsho was the largest free port in, and the capital city of, Nim Drovis. It was split into a New Town and an Old Town, with a canal running between the two. Most of the port was made of stone structures, topped with rickety wooden platforms, balconies, and bridges.
Hweg Shul was the capital of and primary city on the planet Nam Chorios. Hweg Shul spanned only a few kilometers in length following subterranean water seams.
Capital Codru was the capital city of Munto Codru. The city was home to a spaceport and the Forbidden Castle.
Heurkea Floating City was a floating city on Mon Calamari's southern territorial zone.

Reef Home City was a floating city on Mon Calamari.The Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Reef Home was named after the city. The city was webbed by pink coral and housed a generator for Dac's planetary shield.
N'croth was the capital city on the planet of M'haeli. On the outskirts was the H'drachi Ghetto. An Imperial garrison was transformed from the governmental palace by Governor Grigor.

Kuat City was the capital city of the planet of Kuat. It contained the Nebula Orchid diner, and at least part of the city consisted of elegant towers and spires that echoed Kuat's famous orbital shipyards, as well as rows of shops.
Tal'cara was the capital city of the planet Kothlis. It was an industrial center where most of the colony's population was concentrated.
Heh'l City was one of the boxlike cities of Khomm. It contained a cloning facility.
Kalarba City was the primary city on the planet of Kalarba. On the other side of a mountain chain were the Great Sea and the Three Peaks of Tharen.

Tafanda Bay was the name of a floating herdship city above the planet of Ithor. Momaw Nadon was high priest of this city during Imperial intervention. Later, during the Yuuzhan Vong War, Relal Tawron served as high priest.
Cloud-Mother was the name of a floating herd city above the planet of Ithor.
Tree of Tarintha was the name of a floating herd city above the planet of Ithor.
New Nystao was the capital city on Wayland for the Noghri after their world, Honoghr, was devastated. It was named after their capital city of Nystao.

Nystao was the ruling city on Honoghr spread on the northern face of the planet. It was located at the center of a region known as the Clean Lands, as the remaining surface of the planet was contaminated with hybrid kholm-grass seeded by the Galactic Empire.

Ariana was the capital city of Garos IV. It boasted the University of Garos, The Violet Viska, and Chado's Pub. To the south lay the Tahika Cliffs and a mining base at the foot of Mount Usca, to which it was connected by the Currahen Crossroad. To the west was the Locura Ocean.

Meccha was a mid-sized town on the planet of Drall located near the Boiling Sea. It was made up of domed buildings connected by skywalks. The dome's temperature was kept at 17° Celsius which was chilly to most species, but comfortable to the Drall.
Lake Sah'ot was a small lake on the planet of Chandrila, near Hanna City.
Chofin, or Chofin Settlement, was a city on the planet Carratos.
Gryle City was a city on Lamuir IV. It hosted the annual Priole Danna Festival.

The Qom Qae and the Qom Jha were sentient avians native to the planet Nirauan. As adults, they averaged 60 to 100 centimeters from head to their taloned feet, and were covered in smooth, brown-gray skin. They had skin-covered wings, and bore a slight resemblance to bats.
Drev'starn was the capital city of Bothawui.
Gasha was a settlement that floated upon the ocean surface of Bestine IV.
Bin Prime was the capital city of Balmorra, after the capital was moved from the city of Sobrik. It was attacked during Operation Shadow Hand, a couple years after the fall of the Galactic Empire.
Talos was a major spaceport on the planet of Atzerri.
The Raven's Claw was a fast light courier that replaced Kyle Katarn's old ship, the Moldy Crow.
Lake Natth was a lake on the planet Ambria.
Calna Muun was a spaceport and the capital city of the planet Agamar. It was the location of the Agamar Resistance against the Galactic Empire and contained the Council Center. Tondatha was a suburb.

Tondatha was a suburb of the city Calna Muun on Agamar. It was the hometown of Keyan Farlander. When an Imperial assault craft bombarded the town, Keyan raced back to find that his parents living there had been killed.
Corocus was the capital city of the Almanian moon of Pydyr.
Nime was a port city on the Roon Sea of Roon. Governor Koong had an Imperial outpost in this city and watched over the planet from there.

Piringiisi, which meant "healing lava", was a subterranean resort city on the planet of Sullust, famous for its hot springs and mud baths. Vacationers from across the galaxy would visit the resort, to relax and bathe themselves in the hot springs and therapeutic green mud.

Pyre Folas was a major city on the planet of Teyr, on the south face of the Teyr Rift. The Rift Skyrail ran between the city and Turos Noth to the west. Pyre Folas was considered the welcome center to the planet. It hosted the Mobquet Presents: Fastest Land Beings race.
Turos Noth was a city on the planet of Teyr, on the south face of the Teyr Rift. The Rift Skyrail ran between the city and Pyre Folas to the east.
The Teyr Rift was a 4,000 kilometer-long canyon on Teyr. The Rift was a famous tourist attraction with said tourism having been the driving force behind many Rift cities' economies.
Griann was an agricultural town on the planet of Teyr, located in the Greenbelt. It was laid out in a perfect checkerboard grid pattern and catered to the working-class.
Sodonna was a city located at the mouth of the Noga River on Teyr. Its placement made it prime for shipping trade via the waterways, and it controlled all traffic.

Xucphra City was the site of Thyferra's primary starport and served as the planet's capital. Established as Zalxuc City at the height of the New Order to house the Human population of the planet, the residents were responsible almost solely for the production of bacta even tho…
Umgul City was the capital city of Umgul. Outside the city was the Fondine Blob Raceways, accessible by commutube.

affiliation: Cult of The One and The All
x: Colony Two was a colony city on Ylesia. It was located on the shore of the oceanic Zoma Gawanga, north of Colony One and Colony Three.

affiliation: Cult of The One and The All
x: Colony Three was a colony city on Ylesia. It was located on the shore of the oceanic Zoma Gawanga, south of Colony One and Colony Two. It was attacked by the Corellian Resistance in 4 BBY.
The Battle of Khoonda was a local conflict that followed the catastrophic Jedi Civil War in 3951 BBY and was a major event during the First Jedi Purge.

The Lightside Explorer was the personal Vaya-class scout ship of Jedi Knight Andur Sunrider in the years leading up to the Great Sith War. Having bought the ship from a Vultan starship dealer sometime before 3999 BBY, Sunrider used the ship for Jedi business across the galaxy.

H'ratth was a lush planet with a Jedi Academy where Jedi Master Chamma taught Andur Sunrider the Jedi ways in 4001 BBY. It was the homeworld of Vima Sunrider. The academy was known for its training of Jedi healers.
Kroctar was the homeworld of the Kroctari, and the capital and merchant center of the Shataum sector.

Ord Mirit was originally one of the Republic's Ordnance/Regional Depots. After the Battle of Endor, the planet's Imperial garrison relocated to Corellia. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the planet was a strategic world of the New Republic. It was the homeworld of Habeer Zignean.

Moochers were small, semisentient, fur-covered lizards of Abregado-rae. They were believed to be somehow related to the Atzerrian Meek. They lived in dens with populations in the thousands, all birthed by a single queen.
Orooturoo was the home of a race of titanic purple-colored sluglike beings, most notably Princess Nampi. It was an endpoint of both the Metellos Trade Route and the Widek Bypass.
Mugruebe were a non-sentient species of frog-like mammals native to the planet Agamar.

Orron III was an agricultural world located in the Orron system, in the Corporate Sector. An Authority Data Center was located there. Incoming traffic was restricted to drone barges for transporting crops and Authority fleet vessels. Orron III had three moons.
Oseon 2795 was a mining asteroid located in the Oseon system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Centrality sector.
The thernbee was a large, white-haired, semi-sentient creature with psychic powers. Thernbees communicated in psychic visions. They lived in the mountains of Almania.
Snow slugs were creatures native to Alzoc III. They would burrow a tunnel to the surface of the snow and open their cave-like mouths, waiting for unsuspecting prey to enter.
Neeks were reptilian herbivores, averaging at about thirty centimeters in height, indigenous to the planet Ambria.

place: Tomb of Freedon Nadd on Dxun and Iziz on Onderon
conflict: Onderon Civil War; First Jedi Purge (Old Sith Wars)
x: The Onderon Civil War concluded with a final battle in 3951 BBY on the planet Onderon and its moon, Dxun, and was one of the last major events of the First Jedi Purge.
Pterosaurs, also called Soarers, were flying reptiles native to the planet Ammuud. They were carnivorous, feeding on other small reptiles and land mammals.
Oseon 5792, also known as Asteroid 5792, was a fifteen-kilometer-wide asteroid located in the Oseon system of the Outer Rim Territories' Centrality sector.
Oseon 6845 was the largest asteroid in the Oseon system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Centrality.

Ossel II was the swampy, high-gravity homeworld of the Ossans, in Western Reaches and the Outer Rim Territories. Its main export was syp wood, though traders trying to purchase syp wood from Ossans were often required to take Ossans on as part of their crew.

Lola Curich was a city on Lianna. It contained the Allied Tion Historical Society, Thorip Norr, Fronde's Airspeeders, the Astromech Heaven outlet, and PetVac. The Lona Cranith River separated Lola Curich from Lianna City.
Tecave City was the capital city of Cerea. Notable for its ornamented, architecturally distinctive buildings, Tecave City shared its name with the Tecave plant.
Byrne City was the capital city of Demophon. Located on the continent Junno, Byrne City was domed to protect its denizens from Demophon's fierce atmosphere.

Munn City was a city on the planet of Muunilinst. It was the origin of a 22 BBY HoloNet News article on profits the InterGalactic Banking Clan garnered from their simplification of the process of establishing independent currencies.
Shoribus was the capital of the planet Kabal.
Domitree was the capital city of the world Ord Thoden. In 23 BBY it was devastated by a groundquake.
Rordis City was a major city on the planet Nubia. The city was the site of a Industrial Automaton factory.
Taboon was a gas giant in the Aweris system. It shared its name with the Taboon hardwood. Bogga the Hutt's palace was on Vo Dasha, a moon orbiting Taboon.

Bomas were ravenous beasts native to Onderon and its moon Dxun. Although most bomas were generally small, there were some that were extremely large in size, as experienced by the Jedi Exile and her companions while exploring the moon.
The Krath Enchanter was the personal Tetan Royal Space Yacht of Satal and Aleema Keto, the heirs to the throne of the Empress Teta system, in the years leading up to the Great Sith War.

designation: Semi-sentient and sentient, depending on number in group mind
x: The Bafforr trees, or simply Bafforrs, were crystalline plants native to Ithor. They had blue, glassy bark—which quickly blackened upon death—and black leaves.

The Human League was a neo-Imperial Corellia-based group active during the decades after the Battle of Endor. Its members were from the Human population, primarily that of the Corellian sector, of whom most were young and male. Female members were not unheard of, however.
The Vippits were gastropods from Alee, an agricultural world in Hutt Space.

Paaerduags, whose actual name was unpronounceable in Galactic Basic Standard, were symbionts that consisted of a large, yellowish, hunchbacked, two-legged creature with a small green, four-eyed creature sprouting out of its back.

Goluud Minor was a mining world located within the Goluud Minor system of the Core Worlds. By 5000 BBY, a new mining colony had been established on the planet, and merchant lord Ssk Kahorr sent the drone ship Zeta Five to deliver much-needed mining technology and equipment to …

conflict: Clone Wars (Serenno theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: The Battle of New Bornalex took place in 19.42 BBY, during the last months of the Clone Wars, as part of the Outer Rim Sieges.

Biker Advanced Recon Commandos, also referred to as BARC troopers, were special forces clone troopers of the Grand Army of the Republic that were trained to ride BARC speeders across difficult terrain or dangerous battlegrounds.

Harnaidan was the capital of and one of the largest cities on Muunilinst, and served as the headquarters of the InterGalactic Banking Clan. Its towers anchored a skyhook to the orbital city of High Port. Harnaidan was invaded by Republic forces during the Clone Wars in 21.66 BBY.

The Battle of Duro during the Yuuzhan Vong War was a loss for the New Republic. Duro was the first Core world to be conquered by the Yuuzhan Vong. The New Republic had planned to make the polluted world habitable again in order to house millions of displaced refugees.

The Battle of Ebaq, also known as the Battle of Ebaq 9, was a major battle between the scattered New Republic, aided by the Jedi Order, Smugglers' Alliance, and Lumiya's Sith cult against the Yuuzhan Vong, considered the turning point of the war in favor of the New Republic.
The Bakuran Senate was a democratic institution that governed Bakura and the surrounding system, located in Wild Space.

AT-RT drivers, also known as AT-RT clone pilots, were elite clone trooper pilots of the Grand Army of the Republic that specialized in ground reconnaissance and operating the bipedal All Terrain Recon Transport, which they were named after.
The SunGem was the personal Delaya-class courier starship of the Arkanian Jedi Master Arca Jeth, who was active during the era of the Great Sith War.
In 9 ABY, Imperial scout ships, directed by Grand Admiral Thrawn, conducted an information raid on Obroa-skai's extensive library, in order to uncover the location of the planet Wayland.

t: Battle of Yaga Minor (Galactic Civil War)
result: End of the Galactic Civil War
x: A battle at Yaga Minor was fought in 19 ABY between New Republic forces under General Garm Bel Iblis and the forces of the Imperial Remnant under Grand Moff Disra.

The Battle of Sluis Van, also known as the Battle at Sluis Van Shipyards, was the first major military conflict of the Thrawn campaign, orchestrated by Grand Admiral Thrawn to steal a flotilla of New Republic ships.
a: Battle of the Sluis Van Shipyards
Battle of the Sluis Van shipyards

x: Cophrigin V was the fifth planet of the Cophrigin system, an uninhabited star system among the Ash Worlds sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Chiron was a planet located in the Chiron system, in the large sector known as the Ash Worlds. It was the homeworld of a sentient species, the Chironians.

Grey Squadron was a military unit within the Rebel Alliance which was formed during the Galactic Civil War and were led by former Clone trooper X2. The squadron was named after X2's genetic father, the Jedi Knight Falon Grey.
Anoat City was a city on the planet of Anoat. It was the planet's only settlement.

Fftssfft, also known by the Ewoks as "dandelion warriors," were a semi-sapient botanical species characterized by their thicket of sharp yellow quills. They grew in a meadow on the surface of the Forest Moon of Endor, east of the moon's Great Forest.

The Senate Chamber, also referred to as the Great Rotunda, Senate Rotunda, or Convocation Chamber and later known as the Grand Convocation Chamber under the New Republic, was the central chamber of the Senate Building in the Senate District on planet Coruscant.

Red 10 was a T-65 X-wing starfighter in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. It was assigned to Red Squadron and stationed at the Rebel base on Yavin 4. Red 10 was piloted by Theron Nett with R2-X2 as the craft's astromech droid.

The Gados were a species of sentient humanoids with slender, fur-covered bodies. They had elongated necks and lanky limbs, and their heads featured only two large eyes and a pair of protruding incisors. Gados internal organs ran like ribbons throughout their bodies.

The Central Committee of Grand Moffs was a collective body of Grand Moffs within the Galactic Empire. In 5 ABY, the majority of the Grand Moffs attempted to subvert Ysanne Isard's claim to rule the Empire.
Dobido was the smaller of Sernpidal's two moons. It measured twenty kilometers in diameter and was covered with large cities all over the surface.

x: The Battle of Dromund Kaas was one of the opening battles of the Light and Darkness War, in 1004 BBY. In a similar way to the Battle of Malrev IV that took place around the same time, the Sith landed an army to occupy the planet but they were repelled by a violent Republic cou…
The Massacre on Ruusan was a battle of the New Sith Wars.
The Shelltooth was a modified CorelliSpace Gymsnor-3 light freighter owned by the Quor'sav trader Kal'Falnl C'ndros. It possessed a Class 1 hyperdrive.

The High Council, or Special Council, was the ruling council of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances. The High Council was unique in its form, containing a distinct balance of six Jedi and six Galactic Alliance leaders.
The Battle of Dreighton was a disastrous battle during the start of the third year of the Clone Wars.
The Revenant was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that was part of the fleet of Lumiya shortly after the Battle of Saijo. It was capable of carrying 24 TIE/LN starfighters.
The Spectre was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that was part of the fleet commanded by Lumiya shortly after the Battle of Saijo. It was capable of carrying twenty-four TIE Fighters.

The Behemoth was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer commanded by Admiral Bethrogg before the Battle of Endor. At some point during the Galactic Civil War, the Behemoth, under Bethrogg's command, was commissioned to hunt down the Rebel Pegasus Strike Force.
The Fury was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that was a part of Lumiya's fleet shortly after the Battle of Endor. It could carry 72 TIE Fighters.
The Rampage was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer commanded by Lumiya shortly after the Battle of Endor. It was capable of carrying 72 TIE Fighters.
The Firestorm was a CR90 corvette that was part of the fleet of Lumiya shortly after the Battle of Endor. It was modified to carry 4 TIE Fighters.
The Scorpion IV was a CR90 corvette that was part of the fleet of Lumiya shortly after the Battle of Endor. It carried a missile launcher turret in its tail section.
The Borealis was a CR90 corvette that was part of the fleet of Lumiya shortly after the Battle of Endor.
The Wolf-Pack was a CR90 corvette that was part of the fleet of Lumiya shortly after the Battle of Endor.

The Caridan were a mammalian species of Carida. Average Caridans stood over two meters tall and possessed dense musculatures due to Carida's high gravity level. They spoke Caridan and most also spoke Basic.
The Vengeance was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought that served with the Imperial Navy, under the command of Admiral Wooyou Senn. It was thought to have perished as a result of the Battle of Nocto.
The Battle of Bothawui in 19 ABY was, along with the Battle of Yaga Minor, the final clash between the New Republic and the Imperial Remnant.

The Vengeance was a slender, black Kuat Drive Yards Super Star Destroyer that served as the flagship of the Dark Jedi Jerec in the years before and after the Battle of Endor. It was commanded by Captain Sysco.
Bortras was a tranquil world of lush valleys and fertile landscapes in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was known as the home planet of Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth.

place: Observation Post W-16, Cadinth, Allied Tion sector, Outer Rim Territor
x: The Battle of Cadinth was a battle fought in 6 ABY between the New Republic and the Galactic Empire. A Republic task force, returning from the galactic frontier, had decided to take on supplies at the planet of Cadinth in the Allied Tion sector of the Outer Rim Territories, bu…

Clone assassins were a specialized class of clone troopers created by the Kaminoan cloners on the planet of Kamino. These troopers were commissioned by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, through a special order during the Clone Wars.

The Order of the Canted Circle was a fraternity on the planet Coruscant, which was one of the oldest and most exclusive social orders in the galaxy, whose members included the most powerful, influential and wealthy beings.

The Office of the Chancellor, also known as the office of the Supreme Chancellor, consisted of the immediate staff of the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic. The second highest-ranking official in the office was the Vice Chair.

The Galactic Alliance Senate, also known as the Galactic Senate, was the governing body of the Galactic Alliance. It consisted of dozens of senators who represented the many worlds of the galaxy, and was led by a Chief of State that was elected by the members of the Senate.

EV-9D9.2 was a feminine MerenData EV-series supervisor droid and the successor to EV-9D9. She was said to be twice as ruthless as EV-9D9, her predecessor. She was head of cyborg operations within the droid factories of Telti.
Cadinth was one of the original worlds in the Kingdom of Cron, and later Xim's empire. At the time of the Galactic Empire, Cadinth was a wealthy port and desert world in the Allied Tion sector.

Saskapeg was the capital city of the Mid Rim world Cadinth and its government, the Cadinth Oligarchy. In 22 BBY, when the Galactic Republic was clashing with a militant separatist faction, the Oligarchy took the Republic's side.

The New Republic Intelligence Service, or simply New Republic Intelligence (NRI), was the primary New Republic intelligence-gathering agency, responsible for obtaining and analysing information about foreign governments, corporations, organizations and individuals, and reporti…

OLR-4 was an OOM command battle droid stationed aboard the Trade Federation Lucrehulk-class freighter Revenue. In 32 BBY, over the Outer Rim planet of Dorvalla, he was tasked with patrolling the hangar of the freighter for any suspicious activity.

leader: Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader
x: The Inquisitorius, also known as the Inquisitorius Program, the Order of Inquisitors, the Inquisitor corps, the Imperial Inquisition, or simply Inquisition, was an organization of Force-sensitive operatives under the Galactic Empire.
T'olan was an astronomical object in the Wuun system. Early in the Clone Wars, a terrible battle was fought at T'olan.
The Silken Asteroids was a field of asteroids in a system in Wild Space.

The Epicanthix were a warrior species of Near-Humans native to the Outer Rim world of Panatha, within the Pacanth Reach.
Panatha, also known as Epicanthix was a jungle planet in the Pacanth Reach in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Epicanthix. It was close to the Unknown Regions.

x: The New Republic Advisory Council was a body that advised the Chief of State of the New Republic and was comprised of senators from the New Republic Senate.

x: The Revenue was a Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter commanded by Daultay Dofine.

x: Z-N0 was a J9 worker drone assigned to the Jedi investigator Ambaln by the Jedi Council. When Ambaln turned to the dark side, Z-N0 remained loyal to the Jedi Council. Although Ambaln's behavior made Z-N0 suspicious, Z-N0 did not realize Ambaln had betrayed the Council.

Lobaoc was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Mieru'kar sector. Its surface featured lakes and marshes, which were home to the tentacled and omnivorous dianogas. Human and Near-Human farmers maintained several settlements on Lobaoc.

headquarters: Secret Order of the Emperor HQ
x: The Prophets of the Dark Side, also called the Secret Order of the Emperor, was an ancient dark-side cult that arose on the planet Dromund Kaas in the Dromund system of the Outer Rim, a world that once served as the capital of the reconstituted Sith Empire.
a: False Prophets of the Dark Side

x: Protector was a Victory I-class Star Destroyer that served as the flagship of Imperial Admiral Harkov.

The Mandalorian Protectors—or the Mando Cabure when translated in the Mandalorian language of Mando'a—were an organization of Mandalorian supercommandos founded during the galaxy-spanning Clone Wars by the ARC trooper turned "Mandalore the Resurrector," Spar.
Shogun was a planet conquered by and aligned with the Mandalorians.
Norval II was a planet in the Calaron sector abounding with organic life.

The Sojourn was a Hammerhead-class cruiser that served as Admiral Carth Onasi's flagship in the years following the Jedi Civil War. Following the events that saw the destruction of the Peragus Mining Facility, the Sojourn was deployed to investigate what happened.

Aurilia was a mysterious village on the planet Dathomir, founded by a small group of like-minded Force-sensitive refugees. In about 1 ABY, it fell under attack from the Dark Jedi Mellichae and his Sith Shadows.
The Galactic Empire launched the Ison Corridor ambush against Rebel convoys in the Ison Corridor en route to Hoth after the fall of the Yavin 4 base.

result: Destruction of the Galactic Empire's prototype Super Star Destroyer
x: Shortly before the Battle of Endor, the Rebel Alliance launched the Fondor shipyard assault against the Imperial Fondor Shipyards.
A battle at Kothlis occurred after secret Imperial construction data was secured during a raid on the freighter Suprosa.

result: Decisive Hutt victory, collapse of Xim's empire
x: The Third Battle of Vontor (circa 25,100 BBY) was the battle where the Hutts and their allies finally defeated the Empire of Xim the Despot.
The Binayre Pirates were a band of pirates and smugglers that operated within the Corellian sector during the Galactic Civil War.

Brodo Asogi, also known as the Green Planet, was a planet that was the homeworld of the Asogian species. It was located near the border of the Outer Rim Territories and Wild Space, nearby Kalee and Huk.
The Battle of Bespin was a battle during the Clone Wars. Led by Jedi Master Glynn-Beti, it was initially a loss for the Galactic Republic.
The Red Guard, nicknamed Redrobes, was an elite organization of bodyguards trained to protect the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic.

Kulless were a sentient species from the planet Gerres Gule. Members of the species were bipedal, with a round torso and a thick tail. In 24 BBY, the Kulless Shrivel Braittrand competed on the professional Podracing circuit, piloting a Podracer of his own design.

The Neelabi were a shy, fish-like species from Neelabi who could only breathe in water. They could be easily identified by their beady eyes and short stature. The podracer Occo Ninebar was forced to race in a podracer with a water filled bubble.

The Geddawai was a YT-1300 light freighter owned by the Rebel Alliance. Stationed on Rebel outpost DS 5 in 3 ABY, the Geddawai was used as an escape vehicle by the rogue Imperial Admiral Harkov when Imperial authorities caught up with him.

The Church of the Dark Side was a religious organization devoted to the worship of the Dark Side of the Force that came into prominence during the Imperial Era and was sanctioned by the Galactic Empire.

The M'onnok was a dangerous, semi-sentient desert predator from the world of Socorro. Intelligent enough to create spears, clubs, and some simplistic tools, the m'onnok were respected by Socorran nomads for their hunting ability.

The Rings of Coruscant referred to an artificially created planetary ring that encircled the planet Coruscant. The Yuuzhan Vong formed the ring, which they called the Bridge or the rainbow bridge, in 27 ABY after capturing Coruscant and renaming it Yuuzhan'tar.

Kessendra was a small military town located on the planet Kessel. The world's largest prisoner encampment, the Galactic Empire established an administrative center in Kessendra, making it Kessel's impromptu capital. Kessendra Stadium was located on the city's very edge.

The Stark Veteran Assembly (SVA) was an organization composed of, and aimed to support and speak for, Republic Outland Regions Security Force veterans of the Stark Hyperspace War. Headquartered on the Eriadu city of Phelar, its spokesperson as of 23 BBY was Laslo Dorits.

The Thranta-class War Cruiser Valiant was the sister ship of Courage and Fidelity. When Alderaan disarmed after the Clone Wars, Valiant and its sister ships were assigned to escort the Alderaanian War Frigate Another Chance, which had been turned into an armory ship, carrying …
Kushibans were sentient lagomorphs, with two big ears and mood fur covering their bodies. This mood fur was white when the Kushiban were at peace, and changed colors according to their mood.
The clawbird or stana (as natives called it) was a black-feathered avian from Wayland that ate the flesh of dead animals and aliens.
Cracian thumpers were bipedal herbivores used as pack and riding animals. Originally from the planet Craci in the Corporate Sector, they possessed clawed forelimbs and hindlimbs, and a powerful tail.

Fern bickers were bipedal simian creatures that lived on Kashyyyk. For the most part, the fern bickers were solitary creatures. They had gray skin, green hair and four teats. They also featured three long, sickle shaped claws on each hand and foot.
The Greysor was a four legged, carnivorous primate from the planet of Naboo. It was long used during hunts and birding parties by the Nabooian aristocracy.

Gullipuds were bulky, loose-skinned, self-inflating amphibians native to the swamps of Naboo. As they were small and easy prey for other animals, like pikobis, gullipuds would extend their spine to make themselves harder to catch and swallow.

Wandrella were giant worms native to the plains and swamps of the planet Mimban, also known as Circarpous V, located in the Circarpous system. Mimban was a sparsely populated, largely unexplored world, allowing the Wandrella to have free roam over much of the planet.
The Umgullian blob was a small, gelatinous creature native to Umgul.

The uller was a horned creature that lived on Kashyyyk. These clever hunters are superbly equipped for life on planet Kashyyyk. They possess a unique skeletal structure that allows them to absorb significant kinetic damage.

Spice spiders were members of a species of spider that could be found on Aaloth, Taul, and allegedly on Kessel. Their webs were pure glitterstim. At some point prior to the Battle of Takodana, a group of droids stranded on Taul were ambushed by a swarm of spice spiders.
Antares Six was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate.

The Rebel Star was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and then utilized by the New Republic till 10 ABY. Captain Huoba Neva was given command for it due to her actions in the Illoud system.

Jyykle vultures were solitary flightless avian creatures that lived on Kashyyyk. Their feathers were normally ruffled and their hide was very leathery. They were not aggressive at all and normally ran away when provoked.
The Kashyyyk greyclimber was a subspecies of bantha native to Kashyyyk. They were larger than the banthas on Tatooine, and generally more territorial and predatory.
Kkryytch were avian creatures that were native to Kashyyyk. Their primary diet was based on hard-shelled seeds, which the bird was able to crack with its large, powerful beak.
Minstyngar were animals that lived in packs on Kashyyyk. A massive simian creature, the minstyngar haunted the lower levels of the Rryatt Trail. The minstyngar had a rudimentary social structure.

Mogos were creatures with hooves and ten legs found on Roon, though like most of the planet's fauna, they were not believed to be indigenous. Their shaggy fur was used to keep a wild mogo warm in the mountains.
Pug jumpers were non-aggressive creatures with hard, spiked skin. They lived on Kashyyyk and their tongues were appreciated by local traders.

The Bumani Exchange Corporation was the front for the Exchange on Citadel Station during the Telosian Restoration Project. It had dealings with the Czerka Corporation representative office on the station.
The Empire Forever was an Imperial CR90 corvette that served as Imperial Advisor Coh Veshiv's flagship under the command of Captain Annance.

The Dark Side Elite, also known as the Dark Side Warriors and unofficially as the Emperor's Dark Jedi, was a body of seven Dark Jedi established by Emperor Palpatine during his resurrection in several clone bodies.

Originally named the Accuser, this warship was one of two Imperial I-class Star Destroyers captured by the Rebel Alliance after the Battle of Endor, when it was boarded by Rebel forces under the command of Han Solo and Judder Page.
The Starlight Intruder was a large ship built by Salla Zend and Shug Ninx, two smugglers in Ninx's Spacebarn on Nar Shaddaa. They began work on it in 4 ABY.
Ecliptic was a Judicial Department Consular-class cruiser. It was part of a mission dispatched to Asmeru in 33 BBY by Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum to apprehend the leaders of the Nebula Front.
Prominence was a Judicial Forces Consular-class cruiser.
The Famulus was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruise in the service of House Vandron around the time of the Battle of Naboo.

The Ossan were a mammalian species used—and sold—as slaves by the Ancient Houses of the Senex sector. Their homeworld was Ossel II, and they had sizable populations on Asmeru and Karfeddion, the latter being used by House Vandron as an Ossan breeding planet.
Yalara was a planet located within the Yalara system of the Wild Space of the galaxy.

Dosuun was a planet located in the Dosuun system in Wild Space of the galaxy. From space, the planet could be seen to possess varied terrain and several seas. It also had at least one area of hilly temperate grassland.
Assemblers were huge enigmatic arachnids who lived in a large tube-like web floating in space. Their vacuum-resistant exoskeleton essentially allowed them to survive in such an environment.

3C-FD was a 3C-series utility droid that operated during the Dark Wars. The droid was on the light freighter Ebon Hawk when it was coming back from the Unknown Regions carrying Meetra Surik—an ex–Jedi Knight also known as the Jedi Exile—returning to the Galactic Republic after…

Arda II, also spelled Arda-2, and also known simply as Arda, was an industrial world located in the Arda system, a part of the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Raquish Thoroughfare was a busy roadway featuring several streets in Quantill City, the largest city and capital of Ando, the Mid Rim homeworld of the sentient Aqualish species.
Taung Heights was a region of the Galactic City on the planet Coruscant. The region shared its name with the Taung, an ancient sentient species from Coruscant.
Ragna III was a forest planet in the Mid Rim, and the homeworld of the Yuzzem race.

Argai was a planet located in the Cronese Mandate of the Outer Rim. It was best known for having been the homeworld of the ancient pre-Republic conqueror Xim the Despot, and the first capital of his empire.
Ygziir was a planet in the Yuuzhan Vong galaxy that was home to a domain allied to Warmaster Steng, possibly his own. It was destroyed in the Cremlevian War, together with its moon.
Z'trop was a planet located in the Tamarin sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Katraasii Spaceport was a spaceport, located on the the planet Katraasii.

Vultans were a Near-Human species native to the planet Vulta. They were physically similar to Humans except for their pale olive skin, and a mass of fleshy cartilage folds, ridges, and strands covering the top and back of their heads.
Kolermigon was a Rebel Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport captured during the Galactic Civil War.

affiliation: Office of the Chief of State
headquarters: High Council Chamber, New Jedi Temple
x: The Jedi High Council, formerly known as the Masters' Council, was the leading body of the New Jedi Order founded by Luke Skywalker. As of 35 ABY, the Masters' Council had formed as an informal body responsible for the leadership of the Order.
Swamp wampas were humanoid, semi-sentient predators, similar to the wampas of Hoth.
The Lahsbee were a sentient species native to the forested planet Lahsbane.
Dorion Discus was an inconspicuous tramp freighter, owned by Neena Garnet and later inherited by her brother, Roark Garnet.

Bryndar was a planet that, during the Clone Wars, was in the middle of an ice age. That, along with its remoteness, made it the perfect spot for individuals such as smugglers to hide, which is what Flynn Kybo, B'dard Tone and Codi Ty did during their hunt for General Grievous.

Sernpidalians were a near-Human species native to the planet Hettitite. They had white hair, pale skin and red eyes, resembling Human albinos. The traditional Sernpidalian dress consisted of red-striped white robes with huge hoods.

Osa-Prime was the capital city of the planet Osarian. During the Osarian-Rhommamool conflict, Nom Anor ordered a missile strike against the city when the orbits of Osarian and Rhommamool were at their closest, destroying the city and causing the political conflict to escalate …
The Adversary was a Star Destroyer in service to the Imperial Navy, operational during the Galactic Civil War.
Free Lance was a modified Nebulon-B frigate owned by the privateer Urias Xhaxin.

Clone sharpshooters, also known as Clone Trooper Marksmen, clone snipers, or Clone Specialists, were a specialized variant of clone troopers who served in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Vorzyd IV was a planet in the Vorzyd system. All the Vorzydiaks on Vorzyd IV were dedicated to manufacturing products and were disdainful of fun and games.
Operation Cobolt, also known as the Cobolt Offensive, was the military codename for a hit-and-run assault against an Imperial facility by the Rebel Alliance.
Vorzyd II was a planet located within the Vorzyd system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Whuffa worms were long worms that inhabited the planet Dathomir. They were intelligent and had hydrostatic skeletons.

The Singing Mountain Clan was a Dathomiri Witch clan based at the Singing Mountain on Dathomir. The clan appeared as a cohesive, hierarchical matriarchy defined by its warrior culture and magical tradition.
The Battle of Gentes was a battle during the Clone Wars that took place two years after the First Battle of Geonosis.

objective: Locate and rescue Anx Ambassador Quiyyen
Arrive before a Confederate invasion fleet
x: The rescue mission to Vandos took place in 20 BBY during the Clone Wars. In an attempt to lure several Jedi into a trap on the planet Vandos, Confederate General Grievous kidnapped Anx Ambassador Quiyyen and confined him within a dug-out cave.
Aar'aa were a reptilian sentient species native to the planet Aar.

The Aaris were one-meter-tall reptilian sentients native to the planet Aaris III in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Thousands of years prior to the Galactic Civil War, the Aaris built an industrial society across their homeworld, raising large cities.
Abinyshi were a sentient species native to the planet of Inysh.
Barons Hed, also spelled Baron's Hed and sometimes called the "Fallen City", was once a great spaceport full of life, with busy market streets, entertainment and cantinas that was located on Sulon.
The Adnerem were a tall, thin, humanoid species of mammal native to the pleasure planet of Adner in the Yataga sector of the Expansion Region.
The Aefans were a sentient species of small, orange-skinned, humanoids who were native to the planet Aefao, in the Outer Rim Territories.
Affytechans were a species of tall, bipedal sentient plants native to Dom-Bradden, in the Outer Rim of the galaxy.
Aganof were non-humanoid sentients native to the underground caves of Kuras III in Elrood sector.
The Agee were a tiny, winged, sentient species that came in two varieties: those capable of flight and those not. In 17 ABY, several Agee resided on Coruscant, the galactic capital.

The Aggoron were a sentient species. Many Aggorons were traders, and—along with Devaronians, Humans, Nalroni, and Squibs—they formed part of the thousands of non-Gree who lived in Satikan, the largest city on Asation, which was the main trading post and access system to the Gr…

The Agorffi were a sentient species. They were known for their strength and brawn, and were often bracketed with other strong species such as Gamorreans and Wookiees; their resilience, however, made them a prime target for the Slaver Syndicate.
The Akwin were an aquatic sentient species of amphibious mammals that resided in the oceans of the planet Lazerian IV.

The Aldereenians were a sentient species of insectoids. They were native to the Aldereen system, located in the Inner Rim Territories. By 8 ABY, they maintained a consulate on the planet Coruscant. The consulate was located almost 200 kilometers from the Alderaanian consulate.

The Alpheridians were a sentient species, native to the planet Alpheridies in the Expansion Region. The species shared their homeworld with the Miraluka species, who immigrated en masse to the planet several thousand years before the Great Sith War after their original homewor…
The Soomans were a sentient species of red insectoids indigenous to the planet Sooma, located in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Amorphiians, or Amorphiian beings, were a sentient species indigenous to the planet Amorphiia in the Mid Rim.

The Andalese were a sentient species of bipedal humanoids known in the wider galaxy by 17 ABY. Largely resembling Humans in appearance, their distinguishing features included small, pointed horns on the head and symbiosis grafts on the body.
Anguilla were oceanic sentients indigenous to Alluuvia in Elrood sector.
Zexx were a gray-skinned species, featuring cone-like heads and long tusks. They were aggressive and unintelligent. It is possible they were related to the Esoomians.
Zelosians were sentient plants native to the planet Zelos II.

Iotra was the fifth planet in the Iotran system and the temperate, industrial homeworld to the militant Iotran species. The planet was ruled by the Joint Council, eight top-ranking leaders of the Iotran Police Force (IPF).
The Jade Sabre was a custom-built and modified shuttle that was constructed by Jedi Master Luke Skywalker as a gift to his wife, Mara Jade Skywalker, shortly after their wedding in 19 ABY.

Abanol was a planet, the second orbiting the star Beshqek of the Beshqek system, within the Deep Core region of the galaxy. It was a toxic rock orbited by a single moon and neighbor to the mythical world of Byss.
Gerrard V was a planet in the Core Worlds and the site of a battle during the Galactic Civil War.
The Lower City was a section of the metropolis that covered the city world Taris approximately 4,000 years before the Battle of Yavin. It was home to Taris' under-privileged classes.

headquarters: Hidden Bek Base, Taris Lower City
x: The Hidden Beks were one of the more reputable and well liked swoop gangs established in the Lower City of the planet Taris led by Gadon Thek.

objective: Find the scientist Ratri Tane
x: The Mission to Corellia was a mission carried out by Jedi Aayla Secura and Ylenic It'kla seven days after the First Battle of Geonosis.
Selab was a planet in the Hapes Cluster famed for its trees of wisdom. The crystal domes on the Star Home came from Selab.
Charubah was a technology-oriented planet located within the Hapes Cluster, and famed for their Guns of Command designed by Royal Armaments Guild of Charubah.
Arabanth was a planet in the Interior Region of the Hapes Cluster.
Ut was a planet located in the Ut system of the Hapes Cluster. It provided a song to Leia Organa Solo when the Hapes Consortium sent a diplomatic envoy to Coruscant in 8 ABY.
The Harbinger was a Hammerhead-class cruiser that served the Galactic Republic shortly after the Jedi Civil War.
The Thalmussen was a transport vessel used by the Wookiee species from the planet Kashyyyk. It had a grey hull with two orange stripes across its center and was equipped with two engines.

New Coronet was a city on the swamp world of Trigalis. A rundown haven for criminal activity, the city was at one time a bustling trading post. During the Clone Wars, it was controlled by Black Sun assassin Xist.
Sulituans were a species with nautilus-like heads and shells with long tentacles that served as arms and legs. They lived on Archae Teuthis. The Podracer Tzidik Wrantojo was a Sulituan.
Ampliquen was a terrestrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. Located in the Meridian sector, it was found in one of the Chorios systems known also as Ampliquen.
Brachnis Chorios was a cold, greenish-lavender planet on the outer edge of the Chorios systems, far from the triple stars and deep within the Meridian sector.
Budpock was a long time supporter of the Rebel Alliance and a New Republic-aligned planet in the Meridian sector. However, the world was also a haven for pirate gangs.

Cybloc, also known as Cybloc Prime, was a greenish planet orbiting the star Erg Es 992 in the Meridian sector. During the Clone Wars there was a space station in orbit over the planet. Darth Maul and his brother Savage Opress broke into the space station and stole some credits.
Damonite Yors-B was a cold, icy planet in the Meridian sector that was a possible location of Princess Leia during her kidnapping nine years after the Battle of Endor.
Trid was a capital city on the planet Danuta.

t: Battle of Alaris Prime (Hunt for the Decimator)
x: The Second Battle of Alaris Prime took place during the Clone Wars.
Durren was a terrestrial planet near the border between the Meridian and Antemeridian sectors that was home to the New Republic's naval base in Meridian sector.

government: Lant Mining Corporation ownership and administration
x: Demar was the fourth planet of the Demar system.
Exodo II was a hot, stormy, and dense world in the Meridian sector, near Durren and Odos. The Millennium Falcon had a brief encounter with the world nine years after the Battle of Endor.

Frego was a wealthy planet controlled by a crime ring led by the Cobral family since 61 BBY. However, after Lena Cobral testified in front of the Galactic Senate in 41 BBY, exposing Cobral's patronage from Frego's Senator Crote, Frego started on the road to a new beginning.
Gala was a beautiful and wealthy world at one point ruled by the Beju-Tallah dynasty. It was fairly close to Phindar.

Aar was a planet in the Aar system of the Nijune sector, part of the Outer Rim Territories. It was homeworld to the Aar'aa species, reptilian sentients often employed as enforcers by the Hutts, a species known for its many crime lords.

The Upper City was one of the metropolises that covered the city world Taris approximately 4000 BBY. It was inhabited by the privileged classes of Taris and featured the towering glittering spire shaped skyscrapers that dominated the planet's landscape.

Ichtor 8 was a planet in the Ichtor system that was the site on an Imperial resort for wealthy Humans. The planet was very icy and also had abundant natural resources. The planet also contained a ski resort on Mount Quavaar.
Ieria was a planet in the Andaran system in the Core Worlds. It rivaled the wealthier planet Andara in production capability, but received nowhere near the income.
Ignacia was a gas giant, and the fifth planet in the Kalinda system.
Prima, the first planet in the Kalinda system, was an uninhabitable globe of molten rock.
Rhiannon, the second planet in the Kalinda system, was an uninhabitable globe of molten rock.

Kirima was the lone habitable planet in the Kalinda system, on the Enarc Run. It was discovered by Jak Kalinda, who named it for his mother, Kirima Kalinda. The planet had plenty of natural resources, and was colonized shortly after its discovery.
Bethany was the barren fourth planet of the Kalinda system.

Farstine was a planet within the Farstine system, situated in the Mid Rim's Ryndellian sector. The planet was located on two major hyperlanes: the Five Veils Route, which connected the Mid Rim to the Svivreni and Skine sectors in the Outer Rim Territories, and the Triellus Tra…

The Sluissi were the indigenous sentient species of the planet Sluis Van, located in the Outer Rim Territories. While their bodies above the waist were humanoid, their lower halves were serpentine, long and heavily muscled.
Crollia was the sixth planet in the Corellian system; it was a barren, rocky world, unable to sustain life, and possessed no moons.
Soronia was the seventh planet in the Corellian system. It was a frozen, rocky world and had no moons.
Vandor-3, also spelled as Vandor-Three, was the fifth planet in the Coruscant system.
The OboRin Comet Cluster, also known as the OboRins, was a comet cluster on the edge of the Coruscant system.

terrain: Inhospitable mountains, with an occasional hill, plain, or valley
x: Belgaroth was a remote planet that was located within the Core Worlds region of the galaxy, situated near the Rimma Trade Route. The planet was used by the Galactic Empire to test new weapons and combat maneuvers.
Belgar was the capital city and only settlement of the planet Belgaroth, which, like the entire planet, was a drealy place devoid of any attractions.
Dreshdae was a settlement on the planet Korriban that existed before the Jedi Civil War.
Formerly the desolate asteroid known as Geddes, the terraformed world of Hanoon was home to several strategic Imperial outposts designed to increase Imperial presence in that system.
Clak'dor IV was a Bith colony world. Most of the Y'bith left Clak'dor VII and resettled here, in the city of New Nozho.
Maslovar was a city on the planet Desevro.
Derem City was the capital city on the aquatic planet Kamino prior to the Great Flood.
Rhire was the capital city of the planet Rhinnal. It contained the Rhire Concourse of Humanity and History and the Circ.
Austogie was a southern village on the planet Rhinnal. It fell within the region controlled by the Kieger clan and was the hometown of Berra Sane.
Dorthus Tal City was the capital of the planet Sacorria. It contained Dorthus Tal Prison and was on Dorthus Tal Island.
Bandor was the capital city of the planet Bandomeer. Located along the northern mid-latitudes shores of the Great Sea of Bandomeer, it was the planet's only city.
Alater-ka was the capital of the planet Barab I. It served as both a residential city and a spaceport.
Tawntoom was the province of the planet Roon and was ruled by Governor Bisad Koong until 15 BBY. Its capital city, Fortress of Tawntoom, was located inside a caldera.
Ruul was a moon of Sriluur which belonged to the Bulq family. A lush world of tropical gardens, it was the birthworld of Sora Bulq and the site of the Bulq estate.

government: Loose network of democratic town councils
x: Beheboth was a desert planet located in the Sanbra sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Beheboth was home to the Tirrith, a unique empathic gaseous culture of hive-minded sentient particles, which thrived even among the planet's inhospitably arid and dry climate.

Dorumaa was the resort moon of Almas. It was once an inner planet of the Cularin system. Its orbit at that time crossed that of Oblis. Dorumaa was at its closest when Oblis was destroyed, and the force of that destruction thrust Dorumaa farther out in the system.

Tilnes was a moon of Cularin with underground crystal mines. Though it had an atmosphere, Tilnes was barely capable of sustaining life due to the fact that for two months a year, its orbit around Cularin took it too close to Morasil, one of the Cularin system's suns.

Genarius was a gas giant in the Cularin system. Much like Bespin, it had floating cities, including a manufacturing city built by SoroSuub Corporation in 32 BBY. The floating cities of Genarius were viewed as relatively lawless by the standards of the rest of the Cularin system.

Uffel was a droid manufacturing moon run, inhabited, and owned entirely by droids. The celestial body occupied the second orbit around the planet Genarius. The moon had a poisonous atmosphere, which was so thick that the planet was kept perpetually in twilight during its day.
Andosha II was an Aqualish colony world located in the Mid Rim's Lambda sector, on the Corellian Run hyperlane.
Javin was the capital and namesake of Javin sector and the subsequent Greater Javin Region, along the Corellian Trade Spine.
Muskree was a backwater planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Its lone settlement was the failed mining colony Hardscrabble.
Kailion was the main port world for the 77 Sectors. It was the location of the Kailion caves.

region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
x: Xal 3 was a planet located within the Xal system of the Ablajeck sector, not far from Endor. It served as the base for the Armorers' Confederacy.
Eiattu 6 was a planet in the Ado sector of the Mid Rim. Commonly called simply Eiattu by its inhabitants, it was ruled by a monarchy.
Oasis was a volcanic moon orbiting an unnamed planet in a star system located within the Maelstrom Nebula. The moon was home to the Oasis mining colony, a thriving settlement where Oxite was mined.
Aradian was the third planet in the Lianna system known for its repulsorlift technology. The planet had an atmosphere mildly poisonous to most aliens, and it was orbited by three moons.
Abraxin was a swampy world in the Tion Cluster. It was an exporter of Abrax cognac.
Lijuter was the Houk homeworld. It was located near Hutt Space.
Antemeridias was the capital of the Antemeridian sector. Located in the Outer Rim Territories, it was located along the Perlemian Trade Route.

Pii III was a planet famous for the luxury greel wood that grew there. It was located in the Pii system inside the Arkanis sector of the galaxy. It was one of "Teeda's Eyes." It averaged 105 centimeters of precipitation annually.
Pii IV, also named Pii 4 or Pii4, was a logging world located in the Pii system in the Arkanis sector of the galaxy. It was one of "Teeda's Eyes."
C-Foroon was a planet in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim.
Atrivis 7 was a planet in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Populated by Humans, it experienced some domestic conflicts known as range wars.

Horuz was a planet located in the Horuz system in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Horuz was what the Partisans considered a "dark planet," meaning it was a seemingly insignificant planet that experienced communication blackouts and much higher protocols than n…

Zeffliffl was a planet in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, located on the Relgim Run. It was home to the Zeffliffl species, which evolved in salt water seas in the planet's southern hemisphere.

Fedje was a planet in the Outer Rim's Atrivis sector. It was home to many exotic creatures, including the rare folded ear boosqueak. The planet was visited by members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Iridium was a planet in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the infamous Pirates of Iridium, who utilized Iridium "power gems" to disable the shields of their victims' starships, raiding Atrivis space lanes for a year.
Nam'ta was a gas giant located in the Nam'ta system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Atrivis sector. Its clouds formed bands of red, orange, and white.

Spefik was a barren, rocky planet in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was home to a Rebel base during the Galactic Civil War; however, the base was destroyed by Imperial forces in the battle of Spefik around 0.5 ABY.

Forscan VI was a colony planet in the Auril sector, on the edge of the Cron Drift. During the Clone Wars it had been neutral, but in 21 BBY elite Confederacy of Independent Systems agents had established a training camp on the world and disturbed the settlers.
Courkrus, also called Khuiumin 4, or simply Khuiumin, was the primary planet of the Khuiumin system in the Khuiumin sector, located in the Outer Rim.

Urkupp was a planet located within the Urkupp system of the Outer Rim Territories. The homeworld of the Dashade race, Urkupp was destroyed in 3996 BBY by the creation of the Cron Drift during the Great Sith War. However the Dashade survived by having offworld colonies.
Sperin was a planet in the Bajic sector of the Outer Rim Territories, near the Vergesso Asteroids.
Talofan was the capital planet in the Bajic sector. It was the headquarters of Grand Moff Kintaro.

Verisin was a world located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Bajic sector. Around the year 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of the Tenloss Coalition, a criminal organization specializing in contract kidnapping.

Yasilor was a world located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Bajic sector. Around the year 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of the Palkandi Brokerage House, a front organization for the criminal Tenloss Syndicate.
Donadus was an astronomical object located in the Donadus system, a part of the Inner Rim's Bamula sector. It shared its name with the sentient species Donadi.
Dakshee was a planet located in the Barma sector of the Colonies. It was the capital of its sector. Dakshee was marked by constant unrest under the rule of the Galactic Empire.

Lirra was an Outer Rim planet with mineral pools and mud flats on its surface. Located within the Baxel sector close to the border with Hutt Space, Lirra was originally colonized by Human settlers, but almost a century prior to 2 ABY, the Humans on Lirra became outnumbered by …
Kulthis was a planet in the Belderone system that was the site of a Rebel Alliance base during the Galactic Civil War.

Keyorin, also known as the Hunter's World, was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, and known as a common destination for retired or semi-retired smugglers seeking second careers as entrepreneurs or bank-rollers of those who still flew.
Merakai was a colony of the Khil species.

Otunia was a planet that was the Galactic Empire sector capital of the Bosph sector, and the home of the Kabul family. It was covered in deserts and had mineral-rich soil, perfect for mining by Kabul Industries.

Aereen was a dusty, mineral-rich moon of Krant where a Trade Federation mining colony run by Plure Barron was destroyed by Echuu Shen-Jon during the Clone Wars. After destroying the mining operation, Echuu moved on to invade Krant with the few soldiers he had left.
Mandell was a Bothan colony world. It was once devastated by drought, requiring grain shipments from Bothawui. Unfortunately, these shipments contained radarks, which infested the planet.

Sennatt was a world located within the Bothan sector, on the Mid Rim of the galaxy. Colonized by the Bothans, it was one of their industrial hubs. Publictechnic's main manufacturing plant was located on Sennatt.

sector: Brak sector, part of the Aramand Cluster
x: Aram was the tropical homeworld of the Aramandi species. Located in the Aramand Cluster in the Brak sector; it was orbited by a lone moon. It possessed a higher than average gravity, which caused the Aramandi to be short and stout.

Genesia was the second planet in the Genesia system of the Brak sector, orbited by a multitude of space stations known as G-Stations. Genesia was located on a popular hyperlane, and received an influx of spacers and other visitors on their way to various destinations.

Lolnar was a planet located in the Lolnar system, in the Slice portion of the Core Worlds that was known as the Arrowhead. It was situated on the Corellian Run super-hyperroute, between the Perma and Rehemsa systems.

Lish V, also known as L-5, was a tectonically active, inhabited moon orbiting the planet Lish in the Demar system of the Brak sector. Of Lish's fifteen moons, L-5 was the only one with a breathable atmosphere.

Kile was a moon of the gas giant Zhar in the Zhar system. Rogue Squadron established a base on the moon, from where they organized the mission to rescue Han Solo from Boba Fett's Slave I. The other moon, Gall, was a populated, terrestrial world home to an Imperial enclave.
Patch-4 was a trash-covered planet in the Outer Rim that was used to store valuable merchandise by Orion Ferret, an infamous weapons dealer and owner of the Bazarre black market space station.
Krinemonen III was an oceanic moon of Krinemonen. It served as a stronghold of the Rebel Alliance.

F'tral was an Outer Rim Territories waterworld located in the Calaron sector. The planet's surface was almost completely covered by freshwater oceans, with dry land being limited to chains of volcanic islands that were home to mostly predatory or parasitic plants.
Fwillsving was a planet near Kessel and Honoghr. It was sometimes used by smugglers as a repair depot and a hideaway from Imperial patrol starships while smuggling spice on the Kessel Run.
Jerijador, located in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories, was a planet teeming with a variety of lifeforms that was hospitable to humanoids.

Morvogodine was a planet crawling with life that was located in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Galactic Empire occupied Morvogodine during the Galactic Civil War and hosted a notoriously vicious stormtrooper training facility on the planet.
Biitu was the Biituian homeworld in the Cassandran Worlds region.
Cassander – originally known as Cassander's Star – was the chief planet of the Cassandran sectors. It was the sector capital of Cassander sector under the New Order, and it was on the Braxant Run.

Eol Sha was a volcanic planet in the Corva sector of the Outer Rim, near the Cauldron Nebula. Despite a rather temperate climate, the majority of the planet's surface was geologically unstable, with geysers and volcanoes dotting the surface and destructive natural phenomena, s…
Douglas III, the third planet of the remote Douglas system, was a member of the Centrality region of the Outer Rim Territories.
Lekua V, also known simply as Lekua, was a planet located in the Centrality, a sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It had several universities.
Rafa IV was a temperate planet in the Rafa system of the Centrality, located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was a colony world of the Sharu species.
Rafa V was the fifth planet of the Rafa system and the homeworld of the Sharu species.
Renatasia III, or simply Renatasia, was an agriworld that was brutally conquered by the Galactic Empire.

The rare and elusive jackelope was a small horned creature native to the planet Douglas III, a part of the galaxy's Centrality region. Famous game hunter Mendel Douglas, after whom Douglas III was named, traversed the planet in a bid to acquire the jackelope's hide.
The third moon of the gas giant–type planet Storm was located in the Naboo system, a part of the Chommell sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim.
The tenth moon of the gas giant planet Storm was home to a Tagge Company mine. The moon was located in the Naboo system, a part of the Chommell sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim.
Churba was the cosmopolitan sector capital of the Churba sector, known for its cutting-edge technology. It was headquarters of Sencil Corporation.
Lelmra was a mountainous planet in the Churba sector of the Mid Rim. At one time, it was the headquarters of Garm Bel Iblis, and also served as a backup base for the smuggler organization of Mazzic.
Ciutric IV, commonly known just as Ciutric, was the capital planet of the Ciutric Hegemony. The planet had at least two moons, and was subject to frequent yet brief periods of torrential downpour.
Corvis Minor III was a semi-arid world in the Corvis Minor system and the Ciutric Hegemony with temperate zones at its poles which produced exotic xenobiological products sold as luxury commodities.
Corvis Minor IV was a water-rich tropical planet in the Ciutric Hegemony. It produced exotic xenobiological products sold as luxury commodities. It was guarded by the Aspiration.
Distna was the hollow moon of Corvis Minor V.

Liinade III was an agriworld in the Ciutric Hegemony. Its development began near the end of the Galactic Republic and continued under the Galactic Empire. It had light industry which produced comlinks and caf synthesizers.
Ord Sedra was originally an Ordnance/Regional Depot located in the Clacis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Plains of Coruscant was an area of Coruscant located near the Jedi Temple. The "plains" description of the area was due to its relative flatness created by millions of flat-topped skyscrapers packed closely together, with various skyscrapers sticking out above this surface.

The Skull Crackers were a smashball team from the planet Karfeddion known for their disregard of the rules of play. In 32 BBY, the Skull Crackers attended The Tipsy Mynock cantina and became inebriated.
G'rho was a planet in Wild Space on the Shiritoku Spur and was where forests of juvica grew. A remote colony, its colonists raised duncows and built Boku Settlement near a rich vein of crimson ore.
Nyasko was a terrestrial planet located in the Nyasko system. It constituted a part of the Colunda sector, a subsector of the Phelleem sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Colunda Prime was an astronomical object located in the Colunda Prime system. It constituted a part of the Colunda sector, a subsector of the Phelleem sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Hraki was a planet in the Vorzyd Cluster of the Outer Rim.
Kilmaulsias was a planet in the Vorzyd Cluster. It was the homeworld of the Kilmaulsi.
Paigu was a planet in the Vorzyd Cluster of the Commonality in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Paigun species.
Seftek was a planet located in the Vorzyd Cluster of the Outer Rim.
Bovo Yagen was a planet near the Corellian Trade Route. It was home to the native Bovorians who were later joined by a family of settlers led by a former Imperial captain named Bovo Yagen.
The West River was one of the two rivers that framed Salis D'aar, capital city of Bakura, the other being the East River.
Froz was the homeworld of the Frozian species. It was on the Corellian Run. It was a pristine low-gravity planet.
Jumus was a planet in the Corellian sector conquered by the Yuuzhan Vong.

The Karsten Moon was the moon of New Plympto. The spaceport Karsten High Port, and the consular offices of the reigning galactic government, were located on it, as well as illegal processing plants of the drug ji rikknit.
Talfaglio was a reddish-orange planet in the Corellian sector.
Altawar was the homeworld of the Corragut species, located in the Altawar system of the Corellian sector.
Corfai was a planet in the Corellian sector of the Core Worlds.
Xyquine II, also known simply as Xyquine, was a planet located within the Xyquine system of the Corellian sector. The world boasted a diverse array of life.
The Katarn Commandos were a New Republic Special Forces unit.

Brosi was the homeworld of the Brosin species, in the Thandon Cluster, a remote place in the Corporate Sector. It was the fourth planet in the Dostra system, and one of the few homeworlds within the Corporate Sector.
Erysthes, located in the Corporate Sector in the Tingel Arm of the galaxy, was the planet to which the chak-root was native.
Galleefryn II was a jungle planet in Corporate Sector.
Jerrist VI was a factory and resource mining world in the Corporate Sector. It was quarantined by the Corporate Sector Authority when a plague broke out.
Kalla VII, also simply known as Kalla, was a planet in the Corporate Sector. It was the location of the University of Kalla, an Imperial base, and the headquarters of Unlimited Horizons Inc.

Ession was a planet in the Corporate Sector, located at the nexus of the Shaltin Tunnels and Lucaya Cross hyperlanes. It has been settled since before 6000 BBY, establishing itself as a thriving manufacturing and trading center of the Corporate Sector.
Saffalore was a planet in the Corporate Sector, at one end of the Lucaya Cross. It was one of the Sector's most recent boomworlds.
Duroon was a planet in Corporate Sector visited by Han Solo in 2 BBY.

Maryo was a resort world in the Corporate Sector. It was well known for its bazaars and was often visited by idle wealthy beings. Those who visited the planet also enjoyed hunting the native peckvas and fishing for colossus fish amongst the world's vast seas.
Simpla-12 was a neglected, underdeveloped planet, strip-mined and criminal-infested. Jenna Zan Arbor had a lab on the planet surface, and performed her twisted experiments on unfortunate Jedi there.
Utrost was a cosmopolitan terrestrial astronomical object situated in the Utrost system. It was located in the Coruscant sector, which in turn was a subsector the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds.
Jandoon was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, in the Corva sector.

Destrillion was a planet in the Dubrillion system of the Outer Rim Territories, in close proximity to Dubrillion and the asteroids of Lando's Folly. It was a barren world with a turbulent atmosphere, and appeared brown and dirty from space.

Ord Janon was an Outer Rim Territories planet located within the Spinward sector. At some point, Ord Janon served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot for the Galactic Republic, and during the Clone Wars, it was occupied by military forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Doldur was the Imperial-controlled sector capital of Doldur sector. Imperial Moff Eisen Kerioth considered it his personal territory and sponsored research of an antiblaster energy shield.
