Monor II, also called Kline Colony, was the Sunesi homeworld. It was ruled by a monarchy of priest-princes. The tenth, Agapos the Tenth, ascended in 24 ABY.

Dolomar was the sector capital of Dolomar sector. The mostly Human population lived underground to avoid the bitter cold. The largest of these underground complexes, Diflu, was located in the northernmost mountains of the planet, the L'tiri Peaks.

Toloran was the Tolo homeworld, located in the Panto system along with Pantolomin. A winter wonderland that attracted tourists, it was also inhabited by ice dragons. It was far enough away from its sun that it had a cold climate.
Kamparas was a planet in the Dolomar sector of the Core Worlds covered with rainforests, grasslands, rolling hills, and deep valleys.
Phorliss was a planet in the Dolomar sector of the Core Worlds that could support almost any kind of life.
Tangrene was a planet in the Morshdine sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Imdaar Alpha was a moon of Imdaar. Grand Admiral Martio Batch had the massive Imdaar Alpha research station there which was fastened on the most part of one of the moon's hemispheres. It developed an advanced cloaking device and the first of the TIE Phantoms.
Filve was the hot, dry homeworld of the Filvians in the Dufilvian sector of the Mid Rim.
Algarian was a planet in the Mid Rim's Dufilvian sector. It was raided by the Galactic Empire, which was attempting to defeat all Alliance support on-planet.

Womrik was a planet located within the Womrik system in the Dufilvian sector of the Mid Rim, near New Cov. The sights of its ice-capped mountain peaks, which were second to none, attracted many tourists and were a source of pride the planet's inhabitants.
Alluuvia was a planet that was located in the Elrood sector. The mining on the planet conducted by Radell Mining Corporation was overseen by an ecologically-mindful Ithorian.
Derilyn was a planet in the Elrood sector on the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route.

Kuras III was the third planet in the Kuras system of the Elrood sector. Kuras III was a dry, volcanic world, and thanks to a mixture of heavy metals, harmful bacteria and airborne poisons, the environment was considered lethal to Humans and many other species.
Torina was a terraformed planet located in the Torina system of the Elrood sector.
Pinett was a moon in the Elrood sector. It was a mining colony.
Worxer, also called Yablon, was a planet in the stellar drift clouds of Elrood sector. It was destroyed when its sun went supernova around 198 BBY.
The planet Danteel was the capital of the Emmo sector.

Argovia was a planet of stormy, misty, marshy wetlands in the Endocray sector, rich in minerals and ores. It was the location of an Imperial sensor network complex that analyzed data from thousands of sensor buoys, ships, and probe droids in the sector.
Doneer'so was the primary planet of the Doneer'so system in the Fakir sector of the Bakchou arm. It was the homeworld of the insectoid Doneer race.
Fakir was the sector capital of Fakir sector in the Bakchou arm.
Halowan was a barren planet in the Fakir sector of the Bakchou arm. It was the location of Holowan Laboratories, the creators of the IG-series droids.
Mycroft was a terrestrial planet in the Fakir sector. The world hosted a variety of climates and terrains, ranging from low mountains covered in forests, arid deserts, and frozen polar icecaps.

Abonshee—literally, Masterhome—was a planet in the Abonshee system of Fakir sector in the Bakchou arm. It was a temperate world with hardy flora and reptilian fauna. It was home to the reptilian Anointed People, and was located in the Northern Dependencies.
New Brigia was a planet in the Koornacht Cluster.
Polneye was a planet in the Farlax sector of the Core Worlds. Polneye was established under the Galactic Empire as a Grannan colony.

Thobek was an obscure terrestrial planet situated in the Thobek system, a part of the Core Worlds' Farlax sector. It was situated along the Widek Bypass, a hyperlane connecting the planets Orooturoo and Widek in the Farlax sector.
Wehttam was a planet located within the Wehttam system of the Core Worlds. Wehttam was the Wehttam homeworld. It was located in the Farlax sector.
Farrfin was the capital of Farrfin sector and the Farghul homeworld. It was a haven for criminals. A shakedown by the Jedi left the Farghul distrustful of Jedi.
Charmath was a planet in the Farrfin sector of the Galactic Core with one of the galaxy's most complete historical archives.
Firro was a planet in the Farrfin sector of the Galactic Core that was brutally subjugated by the Galactic Empire prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Phraetiss was a planet in the Farrfin sector of the Galactic Core with thick and very tall grasslands.
Wistril was a planet in the Wistril system, located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was known for its smugglers.

Findris was a Colonies celestial body that was the site of a Galactic Empire sector command and the offices of Colonial News Nets. The anti-Imperial Justice Action Network terrorist organization was formed on Findris in 15 BBY.
Romar was the sector capital of Galov sector. It was home to Moff Antoll Jellrek's base.
Altarrn was a planet located in the Altarrn system within the Glythe sector. It was the homeworld of the rare spidery nightgliders.
Fef was a moderately large planet orbiting an orange-yellow star in the Fef system. It was one of the Galactic Alliance planets threatened by a possible Killik coup.

Nentan was a terrestrial planet located in the Nentan system of the Glythe sector. Nentan was a barren planet, and the main point of interest was the ancient ruins of a city built by an unknown alien species. During the Galactic Civil War, Nentan briefly hosted an Alliance base.

Valrar was a planet located within the Valrar system of the Mid Rim. Its dense canopy forests blocked most sunlight from reaching the planet's surface. Khabarakh was reassigned here by Thrawn after his failure to capture Leia Organa Solo on Kashyyyk.
Alzar was a planet located in the Thanium sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Alzarian homeworld, the world was devastated during the Stenax Massacres of 4 ABY.
Betshish was a planet located in the Gordian Reach along the Pinooran Spur between Mogoshyn and Kli'aar. It was the homeworld of a sentient species.
Kadril was an inhospitable, irregularly-shaped world colonized by the reptilian Kadrillians in 6 BBY. It was the source of kunda stones. It was here that Darth Vader developed pacifog.

Krylon was a planet in the Gordian Reach. It was the dominant planet of the Pinooran Spur, a polluted, industrial world dominated by Hynese companies, however it was not very important in this region of space.
Sooma was a planet of grassy plains and an oxygen-filled atmosphere. It was homeworld to the Soomans.
Tandankin was a planet located in the Spadja sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Tharkos was a planet located in the Tharkos system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the headquarters of Millennium Astro-Engineering. The planet was attacked by the Stenax during the Stenax Massacres of 5 ABY.

Torque ("Torqua-na" in Huttese) was a planet located within the Torque system of the Outer Rim Territories and the sector capital of the Gordian Reach. A lackluster industrial world, it was the headquarters of Bwahl the Hutt.
Asation was the major port world of the Gree Enclave and was home to the Crafter caste of the Gree.
Haldeen was a terrestrial planet located in the Haldeen system of the Colonies' Haldeen sector. It was one of the sector's primary worlds.
Lorell was a planet located in the Inner Rim of the galaxy. It lay in a system just outside the Hapes Cluster. It was once base of the Lorell Raiders and was later known for its kickboxing.
Olanji was a high-tech planet located in the Hapes Cluster.

Terephon was a planet in the Hapes Cluster, located in the Transitory Mists. The Mists, which blocked all long-range and holocomm transmissions, ensured Terephon's isolation and helped shape its reputation as a backwater in the Consortium.

Thrakia was a planet with large land masses and rich in natural resources located in the Hapes Cluster. It was the homeworld of an unidentified species, described as an intelligent species of insectoids.
Vergill was a planet located within the Vergill system of the Inner Rim. It was an influential member of the Hapes Consortium. In 25 ABY, the planet's archon was Beed Thane.
Reboam was a planet located within the Hapes Cluster which was noted for being a small world with a harsh climate that was relatively uninhabited and was comparable to Tatooine.
Dreena was a nearly uninhabited ocean world visited by Prince Isolder and his father during Isolder's childhood, playing in the pure oceans of the planet.
Da Soocha was a water-covered planet in the uncharted Cyax system in Hutt Space.
Da Soocha V, also known as the Pinnacle Moon, was the fifth moon of the planet Da Soocha. Da Soocha was located in the uncharted Cyax system, within Hutt Space.
Sakiya, also known as Saki, was a planet located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. It was the tropical and heavily industrialized homeworld of the Sakiyan species.

Nar Hekka was a cold planet located barely beyond the edge of the Y'Toub system, where it also orbited a dim red star. It was situated on the Ootmian Pabol hyperlane between the worlds of Nal Hutta and Du Hutta. Nar Hekka also sat on the Sheela Run.
Nar Kreeta was a Hutt colony and major trade world, located at the nexus of the Pabol Kreeta and Pabol Sleheyron.
Runaway Prince, called Lordunkee Wanpolla in Huttese, was an uninhabited planet in Hutt Space which the Hutts gave to the Yuuzhan Vong.
Shawti was an agriworld where the Desilijic kajidic bred Klatooinian slaves, such as Umpass-stay.

Dachat was a planet in the area of the Core Worlds containing the Hyabb-Twith Corridor. The Nelori Marauders had a base on the planet which allowed them to prey upon both the populations on Hyabb and Twith. The base was destroyed by the Jedi in 4050 BBY.
Hyabb was a planet in the Core Worlds' Krenher sector. It lay on the Hyabb-Twith Corridor hyperlane, which connected it to the planet Twith.
Twith was a planet located within the Twith system of the Core Worlds on one end of the Hyabb-Twith Corridor. It was constantly at war with Hyabb.
Illodia was the sector capital of Illodia sector and home to the Illodian culture of Humans. The Illodians colonized 20 planets in Illodia sector.
Endregaad, a world near the Indrexu Spiral, was the oasis mother homeworld.
Isht was the Ishori homeworld. It was directly represented in the New Republic Senate.
Dar'Or, also known as OM973, was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Jospro sector. Its land surface was primarily covered in forests of two-hundred-meter-tall waza trees.

Azbrian was an agricultural world of sweeping plains and grasslands, dotted with farms that raised the eight-legged herd animals known as dray beasts. One such farm was owned by Condren Foreck, a potential suitor to Lando Calrissian.

Engira was an Outer Rim Territories gas giant located in the Jospro sector. The site of a pirate base that was destroyed more than thirty years before the Battle of Yavin, by the time of the Galactic Civil War the planet had become a supply convoy colony of the Galactic Empire.

Juvex was the sector capital of Juvex sector. It was ruled by House Sreethyn which engaged in the slave trade, and thus was denied Galactic Republic membership until shortly before the formation of the New Order. It was later part of the New Republic.
Indobok was the living moon of Kalarba, orbiting near Hosk Station. In actuality, it was a giant B'rknaa. The other B'rknaa that lived on Indobok were Indobok's children.
Keriba VI was the moon on which Aucellis Park was located.

Pakrik Minor was a peaceful agriworld in Kanchen sector with fruit and tallgrain farms, resorts, and undeveloped countryside. The cloned Imperial sleeper cell Jenth-44 was located on Pakrik Minor. It was the twin planet of Pakrik Major.
Smarteel was a desert planet in Wild Space.
Karnst was in the Karstaxon Regions of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the location of a Xizor Transport Systems refueling depot.

Maramere was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the sentient Mere species. The planet fell under the domination of Lord Toat of the Trade Federation, which used it as a repository of stygium crystals from Aeten II.
Nod Kartha was a desolate, rocky world in the Karthakk system.
Kwookrrr was a planet where enslaved Wookiee children were used for labor in factories and farms. It had previously been a Wookiee colony world.
Junction V, or Junction 5, was the homeworld of Lorian Nod.

The Khil were a sentient species native to the planet Belnar. They were among the earliest member species of the Galactic Republic, and had spread to countless worlds throughout the galaxy by the time the Galactic Empire came to power.
The planet Bakura was home to the namana, a species of tall, straight-trunked tree that was pale yellow in color. In addition to copious foliage and colorful blossoms, the tree produced a fruit.
Aaris III was a planet located in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Covered in jungle, it was connected to the worlds of Charis, Kolatill and Brolsam via hyperlanes.

Ehjenla was the small homeworld of the Tuhgri species. It was located within the Kathol Outback, which was part of the Kathol sector. Homeworld of the Tuhgri species, the planet began emerging from an ice age during the last centuries of the Galactic Republic.
Dayark was a temperate moon that orbited the gas giant Nepe in the Episol system. In 8 ABY, it served as the capital of the Kathol Republic.
Exocron was a planet in the Kathol Outback, hidden in a protostar gas cloud near the Kathol Rift in the Outer Rim Territories.
Kathol was a planet in the Kathol system, which gave its name to Kathol sector.

Kolatill was a planet located in the Kolatill system within the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A stopping point for ships plying their business on the Trition Trade Route, the planet was located several days' travel from the sector capital, Kal'Shebbol.
Danoor was a planet in the Nah'Malis system located within the Kathol Outback.

Oon Tien was a planet in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories, and the homeworld of the Jarell species. Discovered by Galactic Republic colonists roughly 300 years before the Galactic Civil War, the planet was settled by Humans.

Gandle Ott was the fourth planet of the Ott system, located in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The terminus of the Trition Trade Route, Gandle Ott was considered to be the farthest major settled world in the sector.

government: Puppet government under the control of the Bombaasa Cartel
x: Pembric II, also referred to as Pembric 2, was a planet in the Pembric system, located in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Sebiris was a planet located in the Sebiris system of the Outer Rim Territories' Kathol sector. A hot jungle world, it was the homeworld of the Sebiri, a primitive species of scaly-hided humanoids.

Echnos, also known as Tinn VI-D, was a moon of Tinn VI with a nitrogen-rich atmosphere. Its sole settlement was an immense domed structure called Echnos City which arose as a way station for numerous ships that lost their magnetic bottle shielding from passing too close to Tin…
Uukaablis was the fourth planet of the Uukaablis system, and home to the Uukaablians.
Pitann was a desert planet in the Kathol Outback, two days travel from Dayark.

Yvara was the homeworld of the Yvarema species. It was located just inside the Kathol Rift. The planet had a varied topography, with ice and snow capped poles, vast desert plains, and fungal-covered fields.

Ebra, also referred to as Ebran, was a planet located in the Mid Rim's Kesh sector. Its surface was mountainous and featured caverns and large canyons such as the Grythsorin. Ebra was the homeworld of the Ebranites, six-armed humanoids who were well adapted for their environment.

The Garrison Moon was the moon of Kessel, and was commonly referred to by the miners of Kessel as the Sky Bogey. It was shattered by the Death Star prototype in 11 ABY, but a large fragment of it was still orbiting Kessel as of 43 ABY.
Manwess III was an astronomical object that occupied the third orbital position in the Manwess system, a part of the Kilbanis sector in the Slice portion of the Colonies.
Kira IV was the fourth planet in the Kira system.
Koboth was the Kobok homeworld. It was located in the Outer Rim Territories, on the fringe of the Tingel Arm. It bordered the Corporate Sector.

Doniphon was a planet in the Outer Rim's Kwymar sector, in the system of the same name. Doniphon was invaded by the Galactic Empire in 17 BBY, during the Empire's suppressions of rebel activity in the sector.
New Agamar was a high-gravity planet in the Galactic Republic. At least one native was enlisted in the Republic military by the time of the late Clone Wars.

Vilosoria was a Mid Rim planet situated in the Lifh sector. It was the homeworld of the Vilosorian species, which cycled between being docile beings and vicious carnivores based on the change of seasons on the planet.
Pirin was a planet in Locris sector. It was the headquarters of Kontag.

The Financial Appropriations Committee of the Galactic Senate supervised, among other things, monetary grants issued by the Galactic Republic to various organizations and charities. It had a reputation for being stiff-necked.
Marasai was a planet in the Marasa Nebula, near the Trellen Trade Route. It was the homeworld of the Marasans, a species of cyborgs.
Virmeude was a planet in the Mayagil sector. It was the headquarters of Issham Mining Corporation, which was actually a cover for a Rebel Alliance base.

Veron Minor, also known as simply Veron, was a planet located within the Mektrun Cluster; it was the second planet in the Veron Minor system. The native Gazaran were ruled by the ancient noble house of Araba. The planet attracted many tourists.
Ragnar VIII was a remote astronomical object located in the Ragnar system, a part of the Merel sector in the Outer Rim Territories.
Meridian, also known as Meridias, was a planet in the Meridian sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

Till Chorios was a celestial body located in the Till Chorios system, one of the Chorios systems situated in the Meridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. By the date 13:4:4, Senator Bufus Ritsomas represented Till Chorios in the Galactic Republic's Senate.
Merkat was a trade world located in the Merren system, in the Chaykin sector of the Expansion Region. It was an endpoint of the Harrin Trade Corridor.
Ropagi II was a planet in Kira sector, on the Enarc Run. It was an endpoint of the Kira Run and was home to two native species.

Gesaril was a planet found in the Gesaril system of the Minos Cluster. During the Galactic Civil War the Empire had chosen to quarantine the world due to it being the site of a series of nine accidents concerning Imperial warships.
Pergitor was a planet in the Minos Cluster settled by Jesa Corporation miners.
Quockra-4 was the fourth planet in the Quockra system, located in the remote Minos Cluster of the southern Outer Rim Territories.
Karideph was a planet in the Karideph system, a star system in the Outer Rim Territories's resource-rich Minos Cluster.
Onadax was a planet in the Minos Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories in the galaxy. It was the location of an ODT compound that was infiltrated by Jaina Solo.
Sarafur was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Moddell sector, outside of which it was also known as Kuna's Tail III due to its location in the Kuna's Tail system.

region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region; Inner Zuma Region
sector: Zuma sector; Moddell sector; Inner Moddell systems
x: Ovise III was a planet that was located in the Moddell sector on the Annaj-Houche Run.
Sanyassa IV was a terrestrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Moddell sector. A forested world, Sanyassa was home to the barbaric Sanyassan species, who were governed by a kleptocracy.

Zorbia II was a terrestrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Moddell sector. Its terrain consisted of deserts, forests, and plains. The world was home to a group of Humans known as the Zorbian space pirates, whose roots seemed to be Corellian.

The fourth planet in the Morobe system, Talasea orbited the yellow primary star in a red/yellow binary group. A cool, moist, forested, and fog-shrouded world, Talasea had a higher gravity than standard and was lashed by severe thunderstorms during the rainy season.
Lotide was a planet in the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Mytaranor was a bleak industrial world located in the Mytaranor system, a part of the Kashyyyk Region's Mytaranor sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. The hyperlane known as the Nightroad linked it to the Tholatin system as well as the Terr'skiar sector's Pizilis system.

Corvanni IV was an astronomical object that occupied the fourth orbital position in the Corvanni system, a part of the Neshig sector in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was located near the Vorsia system, the origin point of the Vorsian crystal.

Emmer, originally known as Umhul while it was part of Xim's empire, was a high-gravity planet in the Nilgaard sector that was covered in glowing grass and urban sprawls. The planet joined the Galactic Republic prior to 45 BBY.
Capza was a lush, tropical planet in the Velcar Free Commerce Zone. It was also home to Commerce Master Commissioner Gregor Raquoran.

Criton's Point was a quarantined planet in the Myto sector. Its Library of Xer was built 26,000 BBY. Not much was known of the planet, but many historians had expressed interest in gaining access to the Imperial-controlled library.
Bextar was one of four gas giants in the Velcar Free Commerce Zone's Bextar system. It was the site of several Amber Sun Mining Corporate gas mines. Amber Sun imported Entymal slaves as miners.

Cantras Gola was a planet in the Perinn sector. It was a corporate planet controlled by PowerOn Conglomerate. During the Thrawn campaign, it decided to leave the Pentastar Alignment and join the New Republic.
Daltarra was a planet in the Pakuuni sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Joiol was a planet located in the Orus sector of the Inner Rim that teemed with life.
Kimanan was a planet in the Orus sector of the the galaxy's Inner Rim. It was where the pets known as furballs came from.

Lafra was a planet in the Wyl sector of the Outer Rim with a variety of terrains. It was the home world of the Lafrarians, gray-skinned, avian humanoids who were once flyers but lost this ability over eons of evolutionary change.
Mantessa was a planet in the Orus sector of the Inner Rim. The world was encased in forests and treacherous jungles.
Poderis was a planet in the Orus sector of the Inner Rim.

Urce was a Mid Rim planet located in the Lesser Plooriod Cluster. A member of the Galactic Republic since at least the Clone Wars, during the Galactic Civil War Urce served the Galactic Empire as a regional seat of power and was the site of the palace of High Inquisitor Mox Sl…
Low'n was a populous world in the Romintine sector of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Lowen.

Kalandis IV was an Inner Rim planet located in the Pallis sector. Once situated on the Itani Run hyperlane, during the Galactic Civil War, the planet was the base of operations for Prefect Ursellis of the Galactic Empire.
Kallistas was a mining colony next to the Revkinn system in the Parmel sector. Its low mountains covered radioactive elements and rare gemstones. Numerous pirate bases were located on the planet.

Pochi was a planet located in the Faarlsun system, a part of Wild Space's Parthovian Cluster. It was an arid yet habitable world, the surface of which featured endless plains, covered in low grasses and small trees, and low mountain ranges.
Novor 23, in the Novor system was the Ry'coz homeworld. It was located on the Salin Corridor, and was a busy world with large Human and alien populations living in thriving cities.
Uvena III was a Shistavanen colony planet located within the Uvena system of the Outer Rim Territories. Expatriates of Uvena III included Mal Biron, Caet Shrovl, and Riv Shiel.

Trancret was a planet in the Trancret system and the sector capital of the Perkell sector. It was home to the Trancretes. The Trancret Stock Exchange Swindle was pulled off by the Red & Black League of Herstell V.

Bridin Anchorage, originally called Gallienis IV, was once a lush, tourist world in the Portmoak sector. It was renamed Quarlo Bridin, a disgraced politician who took over the world shortly after Thrawn's death.
Dagu was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Dagu system, a part of the Instrop sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Issor was the most powerful planet in the Trulalis system, and the homeworld of the Issori and Odenji.

Trulalis was a planet in the Trulalis system, and it was colonized some time around 500 BBY. The planet was known for its theater. The populace was eliminated by the Galactic Empire. It was the homeworld of Adalric Cessius Brandl and his son, Jaalib Brandl.
Quadrant Seven was a planet which was not part of the Galactic Republic. The planet's last war took place in about 612 BBY. It was a rocky world with canyons, caves, and hills.

Drackmar was the Drackmarian homeworld, located in the Drackmar system, in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The atmosphere of Drackmar was composed of methane, requiring native Drackmarians to wear special methane helmets when traveling off-world.
Selaggis VI, or Selaggis Six, commonly known as Selaggis, was a gas giant located in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Selcaron was a moon of Selaggis VI located in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Amorris was a small terrestrial planet located in the Amorris system of the Outer Rim Territories' Quelii sector. It contained the home base of the Cavrilhu Pirates before they abandoned the site in 19 ABY.
Corstris was a heavily-forested planet in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim.
Morseer was a world located in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim Territories with a methane-rich atmosphere.
Ova was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that disappeared from the galaxy after being was sucked by an Infinity Wave in 30 BBY.
Susevfi, also known as Suarbi 7/5, was a moon of Suarbi 7.
Elshandruu Pica was a planet in the Elshandruu system of the Quence sector, in the Outer Rim.

Trevi IV, also known as Trevi, was a dry planet of barren plains and deserts. It was situated along several hyperlanes and lay in the Mid Rim's Quess sector. A Truishii trader starship was forced to land on Trevi IV at some point to make repairs.
Nathas I was a cold and airless rocky planet located in the Core Worlds' Questal sector. It was the homeworld of the silicon-based species of shape-shifters known as Proteans.
Chorax was a planet in the Rachuk sector, which lay between Commenor and Talasea. It was the sole planet of the Chorax system, a haven for pirates and smugglers.

Hensara III, also known simply as Hensara, was a planet in the Colonies. The New Republic's stolen Imperial Customs Frigate Battle of Yavin was sunk in a deep lake on this planet to hide it from an Imperial patrol.

Vladet was a planet in the Colonies. It was the sector capital of Rachuk sector. An Imperial base was located on Grand Isle. Without vaccination, any visitor to the planet would catch Rachuk roseola. When Rogue Squadron attacked the planet, Imperial Admiral Devlia was killed.
Folor was an airless moon of the planet Commenor, and was the larger of the planet's two satellites. It was barren, mountainous, and frost-coated. The Commenorians once mined the moon.

Shusugaunt was a high-gravity planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Raioballo sector. It was the homeworld of the warlike Shusugaunt species. Millennia before the Battle of Yavin, the spacefaring Shusugaunt encountered the sentient Anx of the nearby planet Gravlex Med.
Sinsang was an industrious world located in the Sinsang system, a part of the Raioballo sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Karra was the Karran homeworld. It was briefly colonized by the Mineral Assets Partnership in 500 BBY. Later, the Galactic Empire established varmigio mines on the planet. Both offworld settlements were destroyed by swarms of insects controlled by the Karran hive mind.

Narg was an isolated planet in the Rayter sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its Human inhabitants were known to be xenophobic. During the Galactic Civil War, the planet was controlled by TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated.
Va'art was a planet located within the Va'art system of the Mid Rim. It was orbited by a jungle moon known as the Jungle moon of Va'art.
This moon orbited the planet Va'art, near the Roche asteroid field in the Mid Rim. It was the home of the taozin, one of the few creatures which were invisible to Force-sensitives.

The Frozen Moon of Improcco was a moon that orbited the planet Improcco in the Coruscant system. The frozen moon had many massive underground vaults containing archived holdings of the Galactic Museum.
Sanbra was the location of the University of Sanbra. It also the location of the Shoapy Hostel.
Stend IV was an Outer Rim planet that lay in the Juris sector. Located on the Five Veils Route hyperlane, it was a tropical world with both jungles and oceans on the surface.

Stend VI was an Outer Rim planet located within the Stend system of the Juris sector. Lying on the Five Veils Route hyperlane, it was a terrestrial world with a temperate climate and a terrain dominated by mountains, plains, and urban areas.

Garnib was the primary world of the Garnib system. It was subjugated by the Galactic Empire and many native Balinaka (considered to be the galaxy's most artistic beings) were exported as slaves to the breeding farms on Karfeddion.
Hutlar was a small, chilly world located in the Mid Rim's Senex sector. Orbiting a red dwarf star, it was the homeworld of the sentient Hutlarians.
Walalla was a planet located within the Walalla system of the Inner Rim.
Cattamascar was a planet in the Bakura sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Kalsunor was a planet conquered by the Sith Empire sometime prior to the Golden Age of the Sith. It was close to Begeren and Ashas Ree and was located on the Kamat Aegit.
Queyta was a planet in the Outer Rim's Danjar sector.
Lenthalis was the sector capital of the Spirva sector. Its largest continent was Basin. The capital city was Hreas Port City.

Vo Dasha was the only moon of the Inner Rim planet of Taboon, located in the Aweris system of the Stenness Node region. A barren locale consisting of mountains, canyons, and rocky plains, Vo Dasha's Type II atmosphere forced visitors to the moon's surface to wear breath masks.
Ithull was the gigantic homeworld of the Ithullans and the colossus wasps. The Ithullans were almost wiped out by the Mandalorians in the year 200 BBY.

Alk'Lellish III was a planet in the Alk'Lellish system of the Sumitra sector. It was the homeworld of the Lellish, as well as the dangerous carnivore known as the ketrann. Wilek Nereus hunted the ketrann at one point.

Geedon V was a planet in Sumitra sector of the Expansion Region. It was the site of a former base for pirates operating in the sector. Once, the entire planet was single-handedly taken over by the gunman Gallandro during one of his early exploits.

Flax was a tectonically-active planet in the Ptera system of the Sumitra sector, in the Expansion Region. Most of the surface's land masses were desert due to the high coastal mountain ranges which prevented atmospheric transference of moisture from the seas.
Boordii was a temperate planet in the Sumitra sector. Its central source of income came from smugglers transporting contraband offworld.
Linuri was a planet in the Doldur sector with a diverse ecosystem. Most of the planet's regions could support humanoid life.

New Kisge was the eighth moon of Chaasch in Suolriep sector, with dense underbrush-covered wilderness. It was the Samuac homeworld. General Vanden Willard established Delta Base on the moon prior to the Battle of Yavin. Being remote, the moon escaped the attention of the Empire.

Tantra was a planet in the eponymous Tantra sector on the Outer Rim. It lay on the major hyperlane known as the Rimma Trade Route was located at a hyperspace junction, where the Route joined the subsidiary Coyn Run.
Achillea was a planet that was located within the Cadriaan Province of the Tapani sector. It was a tradeworld on the Shapani Bypass hyperspace route and was one of House Cadriaan's primary worlds.
Aleron was a smog-covered planet in Tapani sector's Freeworlds Territory. It had domed canyon cities and underground cities. Its crust and mantle were rich in valuable minerals and ores.
Barnaba was a warm, mountainous planet in Barnaba Province. It was an important exporter of agricultural produce in the Tapani sector.

Bethal was a planet located in Pelagia Province of the Tapani sector in the Colonies region. It was the primary planet in the Bethal system. It housed the headquarters of Bethal AgriCorp, and its main export was apocia hardwood timber.

Calipsa was a planet located in the Calipsa Province of the Tapani sector. From space, it was a dull, brown, almost lifeless world. Calipsa was a brown world of little vegetation, rich in natural ores.
Nallastia was a terraformed moon of Fondor. It was settled by colonists from Darpa sector. It was ruled by a monarchy, and chose not to join the Galactic Republic.
Lamuir IV was a planet in the Tapani sector's Freeworlds Territory. It was formerly part of the Herglic Trade Empire. The Priole Danna Festival was held there.
Neona was a temperate planet in the Tapani sector's Freeworlds Territory, populated by an indigenous sentient species.

Pelagon was a planet in the Pelagia Province of the Tapani sector and was the capital world of House Pelagia. It was a planet with a long tradition of providing many Jedi, such as Taj Junak. As a result, it was stripped of much of its power during the Great Jedi Purge.
Soterios was a dry planet in Tapani sector's Melantha Province. Most of the world was scoured by windswept canyons and vast expanses of wastelands.
Tallaan was a planet in Tapani sector's Freeworlds Territory at the confluence of the Giju Run, the Procopian Shipping Lane, and the Shapani Bypass. It was best known for its starship production.

Vycinyth was a forested resort planet in the Barnaba Province of the Tapani sector. Its Tapani Arts and Sports Complex accommodated swoop races, shockboxing, and Cracian thumper races. The planet was orbited by four space casinos and the moon Vilhon.
Vilhon was a moon in Tapani sector. It was a game preserve and was a location for the annual Vor-cal safari hunt. Each house maintains a hunting lodge in orbit around the forest moon of Vilhon.
Ophideraan was an arid desert planet in the Colonies that, by the era of the Galactic Civil War, was ruled by a group of bandits known as the Serpent Masters.

Istic II was the irradiated, ore-rich mining planet that was the second world in the Istic system, located within the Teraab sector. With the permission of the local Imperial governor, the native Isticians were hunted by Human settlers as though they were vermin.
Tyne's Horky was an ore-rich mining world in the Teraab sector. Its streets were full of mining and service droids, used to mine Keschel and Nergon-14.
Sestria was a banking world in the Testarr sector. It was considered corrupt and not as trustworthy as Muunilinst.
Thesme was a planet located within the Thesme system of the Outer Rim Territories. An industrial world, it served as the lackluster sector capital of Thesme sector, on the Thesme Trace.
Syndaar was the sector capital of the Thrasybule sector, near Celanon. It was the location of the Syndaar Military Prep School.

affiliation: Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion
x: Tion was a planet located within the Tion Hegemony of the Outer Rim Territories.

Kanaver was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Tion Cluster's Tion Hegemony sector. By around 25,130 BBY, it was one of the leading worlds of the Livien League confederation, which later became a part of the empire of the Tionese conqueror Xim.
Risban was a planet in the Tion Hegemony, and the location of the river town Keremark. The town was ruled by the Neolsse family, who opposed Imperial subjugation from Fortress Keremark.
Tahlboor was a planet in the Thanium sector. It was home to the Tahlbooreans, who were divided into two castes: the Troobs and the Hobors, perpetually at war.
P'Chek (Gorothite for "Mystery") was a moon of the gas giant Denbalen in the Goroth system. It was the only moon of Denbalen that had an atmosphere.
Milarian was the sector capital of the Trans-Nebular sector.
Draenell's Point was an agriworld in the Trax sector in the Mid Rim. The planet supplied food to both sides during the Galactic Civil War.

Bundim was a planet in Trax sector where the Rebel Alliance lost the Battle of Heg. Commander Resner believed that Bundim was base of operations for the Alliance forces that began rebelling in Trax Sector, shortly after the Battle of Yavin.

Entrus was a planet in Trax sector. It was a temperate world scattered with many islands. Gambling resorts were built upon the hundreds of islands on the planet, resulting in underwater cities and repulsorlift platforms filling the oceans and skies.
Fehern was a planet in the Trax sector of the Mid Rim It was the homeworld of the Eddelians. In the time of the Galactic Republic, Eddelian trading ships would be seen in adjoining systems.
During the Galactic Civil War, it was led by Governor Yndis Mylore, who was also Moff of the sector.
Zeta Zero Nine was a planet located in the Wastes of Wild Space in the galaxy.
Widek was a planet located within the Widek system of the Core Worlds. It was also the terminus of the Widek Bypass.
Nieuth Four was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Nieuth system, a part of the Wyloff sector in the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies.

Wynth was an astronomical object located in the Wynth system, a part of the Wyloff sector in the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel Alliance operative and Imperial defector Colonel Vin Northal was stationed at Wynth.
Neelgaimon was a hot, drought-ridden planet in the Xappyh sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Korev VII was an astronomical object that occupied the seventh orbital position in the Korev system, a part of the Zaric sector in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim.

The Battle of Cathar was the second battle of the Mandalorian Wars before the Mandalorians invaded the Galactic Republic, as the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders under the leadership of Mandalore the Ultimate conquered worlds just outside of the Republic space.

The liberation of the planet Taris was one of the last battles of the Mandalorian Wars. Republic forces freed Taris from Mandalorian control, and pushed on towards the main Mandalorian strongholds beyond the Republic in the Outer Rim.

Aida was the sparsely-populated primary planet in the Aida system, near Lomabu III on the Mid Rim. Under the Galactic Empire, the world would be overseen by Imperial Governor Io Desnand during the Galactic Civil War.
Alassa Major was a resort world located along the Enarc Run, known as a major tourist destination for people dwelling in the wealthy core regions.

Antared III was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Antared system, a part of the Esstran sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, it hosted the hideout of Yesgar, the leader of a group of pirates.
Antiquity was a Mid Rim planet located in the Senex sector.
Arapia was the Kadri'Ra adoptive homeworld. It was located in the Arapia system.

Ban-Satir II was a planet located within the Ban-Satir system in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. Through Ban-Satir II ran the Tingel Route hyperspace lane, which connected the planet with the worlds of Issagra and Gaurick.

The second planet of the Calline system was a tide-locked, atmosphere-less planet. The half of the planet facing the sun was intensely hot and uninhabitable, while the part facing away from it was as cold as vacuum. Between these two halves was a thin habitable zone.
Canoliss IV was a planet located within the Canoliss system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Cannolite species.
Dagary Minor was a celestial body located in the Dagary Minor system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Inner Rim.
Deysum III was a planet in the Deysum system of the Trax sector.
Dohu VII was the seventh of eight planets in the Dohu system. It was the homeworld of the mineral-based species called the Silika. Linkaas Corporation had a warehouse near Docking Bay 71 in Skagras.

Dra III was a planet in the Outer Rim's Wyl sector that was known for its dangerous wildlife. Groundquakes and severe storms were commonplace on Dra III, and the weather, combined with high gravity, created strong and powerful fauna.
Drong II was a planet in the Drong system that was home to the llwelkyn predator.

Disim was a planet in the Epidimi system, discovered 5000 BBY by the Republic, which crossbred its native avians with those of Iri, resulting in the Tarongs, whom drove their mother species on both worlds extinct.

Iri was a forested planet in the Epidimi system located in the mid-rim, discovered in 5000 BBY by the Galactic Republic, which crossbred its native avians with the similar avians of Disim, resulting in the Tarongs, who drove their mother species on both worlds extinct.

Evas VI was a planet of the Evas system, located inside the Belshar sector, within the Mid Rim of the galaxy. The world was humid and it could rain for three days in a row. The planet was also very cold and one would freeze to death, if not for the occasional sunlight.

Freda was a terrestrial world within the Freda system, located near Jante on the Mid Rim of the galaxy, and home to the Freda. During the Galactic Civil War, it was under the control of the Galactic Empire.
Gacerian was the fourth planet in the Gacerian system. It was home to many Gacerite mines and was the homeworld of the Gacerite species.

Gadon 3 was a planet in the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories, noted for its Kif mines. Historically it had fallen under the influence of Kismaano, something long resented by the native Gadons.
Gap Nine was a backwater swamp planet home to a reptilian species.

Gargolyn IV was a planet known to be a garden paradise that was lush with animal life and vegetation. It was the homeworld of the Cor species. The land of the Cors was guarded by a huge beast that destroyed any settlement the scouting Karflo Corporation initiated.
Gertafuu VI was a frigid astronomical object that occupied the sixth orbital position within the Gertafuu system of Wild Space. It was the site of Fort Balarad, a well-protected smuggler outpost.

Glova was a semi-tropical planet in the Glova system colonized around 195 BBY. When its precious metals ran dry, its mines were abandoned, and the inhabitants turned to farming, becoming a leading supplier of food for planets in the region.
Gotida was a celestial body located in the Goti system within the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was the site of the settlement known as Jalor City as well as its suburbs.
Rabaan was the fourth planet in the Ishanna system. It was settled by Corellians during the Subterra Period.
The Combat Moon was a moon of Rabaan where a single Rabaanite engaged a single Sk'rrr in combat to settle conflicts between the two peoples.
S'krrr was the third planet in the Ishanna system. It was discovered by the Rabaanites. The average day on S'krrr lasted 22 standard hours, and its year lasted 310 local days.
Jante was a planet in the Jante system, near Freda.
Jerrilek was a tropical vacation world in the Jerrilek system.
Joralla was a jungle planet located in the Mid Rim's Mektrun sector. It orbited the red giant star Jaska and had an unstable climate that displayed considerable weather and seasonal changes.
Julsujod III was a water world located in the Julsujod system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tolonda sector. It was the homeworld of Stribers, a species of telepathic aquatic sentients.

Karvoss II was a terrestrial planet in the Core Worlds' Parmorak sector. After the Great Sith War, a Human female from Karvoss II discovered her Force-sensitivity while practicing a form of martial arts. She eventually went on to create the Matukai sect of Force-users.

Katanos VII was a mining colony located in the Xan sector of the Mid Rim. After its cortosis mines became depleted, its plight was ignored by the Galactic Senate, so the colonists betrayed the Jedi to the Confederacy.

Mutanda was a planet in the Killaniri system. The planet was a rolling land of grasslands, jungles, and natural wonders. In addition to the sentient Horansi, the world had many different species of big game animals, resulting in a booming legalized safari trade.

Korda Six was a planet that ranged from barren rocky plains to small forests in which the natives lived. It was also where Montross betrayed Jaster Mereel to the Death Watch. Jaster was killed by Tor Vizsla, and Jango Fett became the Mandalore.
Krayiss II, also referred to as Krayiss Two, was a planet in the Outer Rim, in the remote Sith Worlds region of the Stygian Caldera nebula.
Kriekaal was a planet in the Kriekaal system, and the homeworld of the Krieks. Its continents were composed of hardened duranium and its shallow oceans of molten duranium.

Mima II, also referred to as Mima, was a tropical planet located in the Mid Rim's D'Aelgoth sector. The gravitational influence of Lar, the planet's star, caused the tectonic plates on Mima II to be constantly moving across its surface in various directions, leading to the act…

Lomabu III was a planet in the Mid Rim's Lomabu system, which was located near the Aida system. It had only one moon and was covered almost completely by oceans interrupted by long archipelagos. These islands many beaches were covered by carnivorous flagellate microorganisms.
Malrev IV was a planet located in the Thrasybule sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its history was strongly associated with the Sith.

Rydonni Prime was the only habitable planet in the Namaryne system and home to Rythani Products, headed by the K'ntarr family. Moff Caerbellak ruled the planet during the Galactic Civil War and the early years of the New Republic.

Nauton IV was a planet located in the Nauton system of the Taldot sector in the Mid Rim. In 20 BBY, Jedi Master Ruati was beheaded by an assassin on Nauton IV, and fellow Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi suspected the Dark Jedi Asajj Ventress to be the murderer.

Neutra Four was a planet in the Neutra system, located in the Expansion Region's Oeiros sector. The Galactic Empire forcibly seized Neutra Four during the Galactic Civil War, leading one native, Human Rad Torlent, to join the Rebel Alliance as a junior officer.
Ninzam VI was a planet in the Ninzam system. The Draag species was native to the planet.
Ogden Minor was the homeworld of the savage terbeasts. It mainly consisted of a jungle-type terrain.
Panna Prime, also known as the Mud Moon of Panna, and as the red-water moon, was a moon located in the Panna system that orbited the planet Panna along with two other moons.
Proxima Dibal was a solitary planet located in a system of the same name. Song serpents and dinkos were native to the planet's deserts.
Qalita Prime was a planet located in the Inner Rim that was represented in the New Republic Senate. The Right Earl was the leader of this planet.
Qretu 5 was a bacta refinement planet in the Inner Rim's Qretu system, loyal to Ysanne Isard during the Bacta War.

Randorn 2 was an Outer Rim Territories astronomical object situated in the Rolion sector. Its surface featured swamps, in which the caustic harrowbane plant grew and which were home to the large mollusk called the ibliton.
Rett I was a planet in the Rettna system. It was a Jante colony.
Rett II was the second planet in the Rettna system, and was the site of a Jante mining colony. It was attacked and captured by the Jante's sector neighbors, the Freda.

Rigel VII was a heavy-gravity planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Its native sentient species, the hulking Rigellians, were almost extinct at the time of the Galactic Civil War. The planet was also the homeworld of the Rigelian Iris.

Rordak was a planet in the Rordak system. It was an Imperial penal colony with an orbital nightcloak. A battle was fought there between 3681 BBY and 3653 BBY between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Rotas V was a terrestrial planet that occupied the fifth orbital position in the Rotas system, a part of the Yminis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to a group of indigenous fighters that was affiliated with the Galactic Republic.
Gormdin was a moon in the Sarrelon system, covered in dense forests, steep plateaus, and rolling plains.
Sayblohn was a planet located in the Mid Rim's Quess sector. It was occupied by the Galactic Empire, and a group of pirates had a hidden base in the planet's badlands.
Seitia Prime was a planet in the Seitia system, near Rhamalai.
Sevarcos II was the only inhabitable planet in the Sevarcos system. Sevarcos was the only source for the spice variants carsunum and andris, which were its only export.
Siluria III was a planet in the Siluria system of the Atravis sector in the Outer Rim Territories.
Tanjay IV was a powerful world located in the Core Worlds. During the Alsakan Conflicts, it was allied with the Galactic Republic's capital world, Coruscant.

Koda's World, sometimes referred to as Krin Koda after the scout of the same name, was a planet located in the Unknown Regions, in the Tarin system. It is devoid of any advanced installations, as it is home to the primitive Tempestro.

Fyodos, also known as Tatrang IV, was an Outer Rim planet that was located within the Tatrang system. The world's surface was devastated during the Great Cleansing, a war of mass destruction that took place in 350 BBY.

Teya IV was a planet located within the Teya system of the Expansion Region and was the homeworld of the Strak. It was where Willm Lywin founded the Teyan Praxeum in 4600 BBY. In 4000 BBY, Mistress Tannis taught Vici Ramunee and Veni Ramunee at the Praxeum.

Truuine was an Inner Rim waterworld planet. It featured an equatorial belt of islands as well as a polar region with mountains and glaciers. By 4000 BBY, the planet was the site of the Truuine Jedi Praxeum, a training facility established by Jedi Master Mroon Jassa.

Ukatis was an Inner Rim celestial body situated in the Ukatis system. During the blockade of the system at some point by 3996 BBY, the Ukatis enforcer Nayama shot down the starship of Jedi Padawan and smuggler Jolee Bindo, forcing it to crash-land on Ukatis.
TY44 was the name of one of a "string" of satellite-moons orbiting the planet Typha-Dor, located in the Uziel system.
Typha-Dor was a planet located within the Uziel system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Vogel 7 was a low-gravity planet in the Vogel system of the Mid Rim.

Zelos II was the second planet of the Zelos system. It was aligned with the Galactic Empire and was an important source of ores for the Imperial war machine. It was also the homeworld of the Zelosians.

Aldraig IV was a Core Worlds planet located on the Hydian Way super-hyperroute. Its surface featured forests and a picturesque countryside. During the Alsakan Conflicts, the planet was affiliated with the Galactic Republic's capital world, Coruscant.
Cinnatar was a planet located in the Sorrus system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was ruled by a Republic governor.

Sorrus was a planet in the Sorrus system located in the Outer Rim Territories. Its terrain consisted of mountain ranges and large deserts. The planet also had many sprawling cities. It had three capitals, one of which was Yinn La Hi.
The Cinnabar Moon was a moon in the Galactic Core. It served as headquarters of Jedi Master Eelysa and the Wild Knights during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Necropolis, originally named Dahrtag, was a planet in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. Located on the Giju Run, it was a tombworld of that served as a mass burial place for beings from all over the Galactic Core. It was also the home of boneworms and cryptberries.
Darada was a planet on the edge of the Core Worlds. Jev Sunrider was a Jedi Watchman of Darada. His grandson, Andur Sunrider, spent the first nineteen years of his life there.

Duneeden was a planet in the Core Worlds. Despite its proximity to Coruscant, few beings ever came to Duneeden. It was home to the Cascardi Mountains, which was the location of a few private retreats.
Eeropha was a planet in the Eeropha system of the Colonies. It was orbited by the moon Nierport VII.
Nierport VII was a small, desolate moon in the Colonies region of the galaxy—one of seven such moons that orbited the planet Eeropha in the Eeropha system.

Hemei IV was a wealthy Core Worlds planet that was the origin point of the Cosmic Balance religion. The Bakur Mining Corporation also originated there, and its Cosmic Balance–practicing executive officers believed that the world's affluence was disruptive.
Iphigin was a planet in the Iphigin system of the Core Worlds and the homeworld of the Iphigini species.

Karnak Alpha was a planet situated beyond the Hapes Cluster and near the Core Worlds. It was the home of the Karnak Alphans. Because the Karnak Alphans were very fond of strange and exotic animals; the planet was home to a number of large alternate environment zoos.
Ragoon VI, or Ragoon-6, was a beautiful planet in the Core Worlds untouched by civilization and therefore pollution. Ragoon gave off a blue glow from space and was surrounded by several stars.

Rakaa IV was a planet occupying the fourth orbital position in the Rakaa system, on the edge of the Core Worlds. It was a warm world of jungle and forests, with surface water also being present. The planet's flora included the nargk root.
The Acquisitor was a Trade Federation Lucrehulk-class battleship, more heavily armed than most battleships of its class at the time.
Ruan was an agriworld in the Core Worlds.

Vannix was a planet located within the Vankalay system of the Core Worlds, in a sector bordering the Kuat sector. It was represented in the New Republic Senate by Addath Gadan until she advocated appeasing the Yuuzhan Vong during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Yulant was an agricultural planet in the Core Worlds owned by the Salliche Agricultural Corporation who sued Dasobo Meats, a meat shipping company based on the planet. It was one of the worlds on the Ag Circuit.
Ifmix VI was a planet in the Colonies. It was known for its terrible windstorms, tornadoes, and Squalris merchants. It was located near the Perlemian Trade Route.
Nevoota was a planet of the Balmorra system, in the Colonies. It was the homeworld of the Nevoota, a species of sentient bees wiped out by the Mandalorians in 4024 BBY.
Shulstine V was a planet located in the Colonies region.

Jagga II was a planet located in the Venjagga system of the Colonies. Even after the Battle of Endor, Jagga II produced missiles for the Imperial Navy. It was later a strategic world of the New Republic during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Vulvarch was a planet located within the Vulvarch system of the Colonies, not far from Atzerri. Luke Skywalker discovered the Star Morning docked at Vulvarch while en route to retrieve the Fallanassi from Farlax sector.
Aphran IV was a warm planet in the Inner Rim's Aphran system. Located along the Namadii Corridor, Aphran IV was situated between Bilbringi and Carratos.
Merson was a planet that was located within the Inner Rim, near the Merson asteroid belt.
Nahsu Minor was a temperate, grassy planet located in the Ktilac Regions, an Allied Region in the Inner Rim.
Carratos was a planet in the Inner Rim, roughly forty parsecs from Coruscant.
Pengalan IV was a planet in the Inner Rim, between Taanab and Obroa-skai. In 22 BBY, the Galactic Republic destroyed a Confederacy of Independent Systems facility on the planet during the Clone Wars.
Tasariq was a planet in the Inner Rim. It was a barren world with atmosphere-filled craters and tasar crystals. Tasariq joined the Republic in 22 BBY. It was later part of the Galactic Empire.
Circarpous IV, often called simply Circarpous, was a planet in the Expansion Region, one of the financial capitals of the region.
Kayri III was a planet in the Expansion Region that was colonized by the Charon.

Stronghold was a cold, stormy, remote planet. It was used by the Rebel Alliance as a safe world. Little life survived on the surface. The Alliance created a series of caves and tunnels, where rebel soldiers could hide their families.

Lazerian IV was a planet in the Kira sector, located in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. It served as the endpoint of the Kira Run hyperlane and also sat along the Harrin Trade Corridor alongside the rest of the Lazerian system.
Muzara was a planet in the Expansion Region. Humans from Brentaal colonized the planet in 4000 BBY, barely avoiding conflict with the native Muzaran people, who were also known as the Muza.

Krann was a planet in the Expansion Region, on the Enarc Run. It was taken over by the Galactic Empire for its nova crystals, and the native Kluuzot were enslaved. Following the Battle of Endor, the sector governor seceded and established a neutral terrority.
Osarian was a planet in the Expansion Region, near the Corellian Run. It was in the same system as Rhommamool, an inhospitable desert world.
Plagen was a planet in the Expansion Region, on the Enarc Run, with high plateaus covered in lakes and grasslands of lush yellow flora; its lowlands were dry plains.

Seltos was a planet in the Mid Rim. Its Sommin City was home to the largest Tarro remnant. Its primary industries included agriculture, lumber production, and mining of valuable ores. Visitors to Seltos' nature preserves provided a small boost to the economy as well.
Vena was a planet located within the Vena system of the Expansion Region and ruled by Baroness Omnino.
Vernet was an agriworld located within the Vernet system of the Expansion Region.
Zirulast was a terrestrial backwater planet located in the Zirulast system, a part of the Belasco sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region.
The Ketrann was a dangerous carnivore native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Alk'Lellish III. Described as "huge and snarling," the Ketrann had four long, white fangs.
The cratsch was a tree-dwelling predator native to Bakura. Wilek Nereus personally killed one once, showcasing its teeth in his office.
Aargonar 3 was a moon in the Mid Rim. It was hotly disputed in 21 BBY during the Clone Wars. Like the planet it orbited, it was also home to a number of sarlaccs.

Algara II, also referred to simply as Algara and Algar, was a planet in the Algaran system of the Lambda sector, located in the Mid Rim with a population of approximately 1 billion. It was also the homeworld of the Xan.
Vulta was a planet located within the Atreyis system of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Vultan species, as well as Greff-Timms Industrial and Oss Wilum.

Balowa was a planet in the Mid Rim's Balowa system whose primary terrain was rainforest. This planet was the location of a duel in which the Sith Lord Kaox Krul and Jedi Knight Crian Maru, along with her Padawan, Dree Vandap, were killed in 1000 BBY, shortly before the start o…
Orellon II was a planet in the Mid Rim, covered in jungles, plains and volcanic mountains. Thirty-five point nine percent of the planet's surface was covered with water.

Bezim was a planet in the Mid Rim. The native Bezim joined with the people of Junction V, Delaluna, and Vicondor to build the Station 88 Spaceport. This coalition of planets chose to remain loyal to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
The Tertiary Moon of Blimph, also known as Blimph 3, was a tradeworld, a moon from which the indigenous Jokhalli drove Quaffug the Hutt.
Oblis was a technologically-advanced planet in the Cularin system. It included large crystal deposits.
Dargul was a planet located within the Darglum system of the Mid Rim with pampered nobility.

government: Imperial Overlord with an advisory council
x: Demophon was a planet in the Core Worlds, the primary planet of the Demophon system. The planet had two continents, Junno and Klis, which were surrounded by a vast ocean. It was named for Alres Demophon, one of the founders of the Republic Scout Service.
Jatee was the third planet of the Demophon system. It was the site of a Galactic Empire mining operation for rutgar-4. It was destroyed when its sun went supernova.

Garos IV was a planet in the Mid Rim, the fourth world in the Garos system. Located near the Nyarikan Nebula, it was somewhat isolated from outside contact and its inhabitants were a tough, self-reliant people.

Sundari was an arid mining world in the Mid Rim colonized around 4000 BBY. It was a longtime rival of Garos IV, although it depended on Garos IV for foodstuffs. It signed a peace treaty with Garos IV 118 BBY, but resumed war 87 BBY.
Granus IV was an uninhabited planet in the Inner Rim. The Rebel spy Tigor Sims was shot down over the world while carrying crucial datafiles.
Jiroch-Reslia was a planet in the Yushan sector of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Tunroth, a relatively primitive species of hunters.
Tyed Kant was an inhabited gas giant in the Core Worlds, near Demophon. It was the only planet in the Kantel system.

Krykas V was an uninhabited planet in the Mid Rim, covered in mud, briers, and thorns. The planet was blanketed a thick, tan fog consisting of clouds of particulate matter with strong electromagnetic charges strong enough to knock out most ship's sensors.

Leria Kerlsil was a planet in the Core Worlds. It allowed Refugee Relief Movement settlement in 22 BBY, shortly before the Clone Wars, but only by wealthy single men. At the time of the New Republic, the planet had a population of 300,000.
Nazzri was a Mid Rim planet that was located in the Lantillian sector and was the homeworld of the sentient Nazzar species.
Tejrivozs was a planet in the trinary star system of Riflorii. It was a colony of the Advozsec and was controlled by a powerful crime family. It was left alone by the Yuuzhan Vong.

Butler's Cove was a previously uninhabited planet in the Stribos system of the Core Worlds. The planet was chosen by Soron Hegerty as a refuge for the Ssither that managed to escape from the Demophon system.

Tantajoc V was a jungle-covered planet in the Tantajo system of the Mid Rim Halori sector. Tantajoc V orbited a binary star and was completely uninhabited by sentients as of 3 ABY, although its harsh and humid forests teemed with dangerous predators.

Thaere Privo was a planet located within the Thaereian system of the Expansion Region. The Galactic Senate tasked Thaere with protecting the Cularin system in a neighboring sector. Thaere joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Uba III was a planet located within the Uba system of the Mid Rim. It was a home to an Ubese colony, which was destroyed by the Jedi in 1800 BBY during the New Sith Wars, an act that aroused massive amounts of contempt for the Order. It became an asteroid belt.
Ubertica was a planet located within the Ubertica system of the Mid Rim. While habitable, it had a relatively low level of atmospheric oxygen.

Tyan was a Mid Rim planet located in the Tyan sector. By 76 BBY, it was represented in the Galactic Republic by Senator Galim Eddawan, whose cruiser was captured by the pirate Lorian Nod, with Eddawan not being seen again afterward.
Akuria II was an ice planet in the Akuria system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Rydar II was the original homeworld of the Ranat species. The local Human Governor had the Ranats exterminated in 200 BBY. Only three individuals escaped, ending up on nearby Aralia.
Arcan IV, sometimes known simply as Arcan, was a planet located within the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories.

Aviles Prime was an astronomical object located in the Aviles Prime system, within the Hythrope sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region. During the Clone Wars, it was the site of a conference attended by Oviedo Engineering director Lorca Oviedo.

Baros was a planet located in the Baros system in the Dominus sector. An Outer Rim world on the farthest reaches of the Slice, the planet was home to the Brubb species. It had a high gravity, was frequented by windstorms, and possessed infertile growing soil.
Cantros 7, or simply Cantros, was a planet located within the Cantros system of the Outer Rim Territories' Saijo sector.
Carosi IV was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories destroyed by the expansion of the star Carosi into a red giant. The indigenous Carosites had fled the planet beforehand to Carosi XII.

Carosi XII was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories colonized by the Carosites in 200 BBY after the destruction of Carosi IV. It was best known as a center of healing and tourism, attracting numerous and diverse visitors due to its location along a prominent trade route.
The Jade Moon was a moon of Loronar in the Colonies.
Clantaano III, also known as Clantaano, was a desert planet located within the Outer Rim Territories' Albanin sector. It was the homeworld of the nomadic and violent Clantaani species.
Dolis 3 was a snowy Imperial Remnant planet in the Outer Rim Territories, in the influence of Yaga Minor.

Drexel II, also called the "water world of Drexel II," lacked a proper name. It was an ocean-covered planet. The sentient Inleshat species were once indigeonous to the planet. C-3PO aided the Rebel Alliance on Drexel II during the period of 0 ABY and 3 ABY.
D'rinba IV was a world located in the Sombure sector of the Mid Rim.
Engebo V was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories with constant winds.

Falang Minor, also known as just Falang, was a Galactic Republic fortress world located in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium Worlds. A cold and rainy world, it was among the speculated origin points of the Jedi Order.
Gravan Seven was a volcanic planet in the Inner Rim. Its volcanoes polluted the skies, making them hard to navigate.

Iskadrell, also known as Iskallon, was a planet in the Iskallon system of the Wild Space. It was the homeworld of the Iskalloni, a species of humanoid cyborgs. It was raided by Mandalorian Crusaders shortly prior to the Great Sith War.
Gamandar was a planet in the Mid Rim's Iskalon system, considered the twin planet of the nearby waterworld of Iskalon.
Telfrey was a planet in the Mid Rim's Trans-Nebular sector that was home to a native sentient species called the Telfreyans, and also supported a population of Humans during the Imperial Period.
Jussafet Four was a planet in the Outer Rim attacked by warlord Zsinj. It was a mining world under the Galactic Empire, and its inhabitants also mined the Jussafet asteroids.

Kauron was a planet that was located in Kauron system within Meram sector in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. The world was home to the Kauronian species and served as a hideout for the Cavrilhu Pirates.

Kharzet III was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Mortex sector that was uncharted as of 3 ABY. The planet's lush forests were home a wide variety of plant life, and also to a unique species of gundark known as the long-necked gundark.

Kidriff 5, or Kidriff Five, was the most coreward world in Zsinj's space. It was a wealthy trade depot along several hyperroutes. It developed heavy alloys used to improve TIE hulls. Its gleaming cityscapes were similar to those of Coruscant.
Tarsa was a forested planet in the Tarsa system, which was located in the Mid Rim.
Boonda's Moon was a moon located in Hutt Space. It was one of at least three moons that orbited the massive gas giant Kleeva.
Lokondo was an icy world in the Braxant sector of the Outer Rim.
Ku'Bakai 11 was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It was colonized by the Kubaz species.
Ku'Bakai 6 was a planet in the Outer Rim. It was a colony planet of the Kubaz species.
Ku'Bakai 8 was a planet in the Ku'Bakai system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was used as a colony for the Kubaz species.
Laboi II was a small planet in the Slice which was home to the Laboi species. Due to its slow, retrograde rotation, its day was 4,040 standard hours long, just ten hours shorter than its year.
Argavat was a planet within the Argavat system, in the Colonies region of the galaxy.
Lapez 3 was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories on which Luke Skywalker confronted the nightmare demon Reist.
Levian Two was an orange, inhospitable world that was located within the Inner Rim of the galaxy, near warlord Zsinj-controlled territory. It was the location of the New Republic's Beta Sector Base.
M2398-3, best known as Blood Nest, was a large but dismal moon in the Mid Rim. It had half-standard gravity. It was covered in brown-and-red desert, high mountains, foothills, and craters.
Mylok IV, or simply Mylok, was the fourth world in the Mylok system, located within the Outer Rim of the galaxy
Imperial Starfighter Pilots, also known as TIE fighter pilots or TIE pilots, were an elite class within the military of the Galactic Empire.

The Katarn Clan was one of the many clans that prospective young Initiates were placed in when they first began to learn the ways of the Jedi Order. Members of this clan were selected based on their proclivity for stealth.

The Hawk-Bat was a jet-black Tempest-class gunship famous for being the personal ship of Arwen Cohl, and recognized as such on sight by many lowlifes throughout the Outer Rim Territories. It led the attack on the Revenue over Dorvalla in 33 BBY.

Nedij was a planet in the Outer Rim on the eastern spiral arm of the galaxy. It had thin air in which its native species evolved. Natural terrain included snowy mountains which the Nediji preferred, and lowlands.
Equanus was a planet located within the Nharl system of the Veragi sector, in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Equani.
Nysza III, also known as Nysza, was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Dalchon sector. At one point, the Galactic Empire began the construction of a communications bunker there.
Obinipor was an unaligned planet in the Outer Rim, near Warlord Zsinj's territory. Its volcanoes spewed out metals used to fabricate power generators.

Hockaleg was a planet in the Patriim system. The Tarkin superweapon was built in orbit of Hockaleg, with the construction crew living in a spaceport town on the world in between work shifts. Citizens of this world worshiped the deity Holy Jaf.

Brath Qella, known as Maltha Obex by the time of the Galactic Empire, was a planet in the Mieru'kar sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld to the Qella and their predecessors, the Ahra Naffi.
Raed-7 was a planet in the Colonies that traded with its neighbor, Bellassa.

Rimma 13 was a hyperspace exit point located within the Eriadu system, a part of Seswenna sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It shared its name with the Rimma Trade Route.
Altor 14 was a planet in the Zoraster sector, and the homeworld of the Avogwi and Nuiwit. It was subjugated by the Galactic Empire.
Senali was the moon of Rutan. It had four moons of its own. The native Senalis were an offshoot of the Rutanians, and the two peoples had a long history of rivalry and conflict.
Sareet was a planet within the Sareet system in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Sareeta species.

Kuan was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It had a war with neighboring Bordal in 20 BBY, in which the Galactic Empire had to intervene by sending an Imperial Navy fleet under Admiral Mordon. An ace TIE pilot, Maarek Stele, was from Kuan.
Thorgeld I, also known as Thorgeld, was a Core Worlds planet. The mansion of Fabritech, Inc. head Kvarn Mandel and his family was located on the planet, in the underground city of Fabrin.

Timora was a planet located in the Timora system of the Outer Rim Territories. Timora was the inner endpoint of the Shiritoku Way and the closest planet to Bakura in Wild Space. Its people exported sunpetals.
Treylon II was a planet located within the Treylon system of the Colonies. It was the headquarters of Zygian Savings and Loan and the homeworld of Tour Aryon.
Viamarr 4 was a planet located within the Viamarr system of the Inner Rim. Its capital city was Velery. Viamarr Blackroot fungus was grown in the planet's subterranean caves.
Werncin 3 was a slaving planet located within the Werncin system of the Outer Rim Territories' Kwymar sector, on the Listehol Run.

Xobome 6 was a planet located within the Xobome system of the Colonies, between Commenor and Doldrums. Its high plains were blasted by freezing winds. Wraith Squadron captured the Night Caller over Xobome 6.

Trinta was a swamp planet located within the Yartiv system of the Outer Rim Territories near Kwenn Space Station. It was home to a dark side nexus that was occupied by an insane Halagad Ventor during the height of the Galactic Empire.

Zhotta 3 was a planet located in the Zhotta system of the Outer Rim Territories' Mayagil sector. After the Battle of Endor, the Rebel Alliance sent Han Solo and Chewbacca to invite the planetary leaders of this world to a congress to determine the fate of the galaxy.

Zonju V was a planet in the Wild Space, rimward of Rutan. Its terrain consisted of shallow, dusty, scrubby, sparsely-foliated canyons and gorges; littered with deserted ruins carved from sandstone rock. The capital city was Zoronhed.

Kip was a planet in the Outer Rim's Chorlian sector and the homeworld of the Kip species. It was a source of ulikuo gemstones. It was a damp mud-ball riddled with caves. Zorba Desilijic Tiure was imprisoned on Kip in 22 BBY, shortly before the Clone Wars.
Edatha was a world represented in the New Republic by Krall Praget.
Granna was the Grannan homeworld, controlled by the Galactic Empire.
Oolidi was a planet that was located in the Expansion Region. Oolidi was also the Oolid homeworld.

Dohlban was a terrestrial planet located in the Dohlban system, a part of the Dohlbani sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. The Kaaga Run hyperlane connected it to the Void Station in the Bothan sector and the Nar Kaaga system in Hutt Space.
Kalidorn was a planet located in Wild Space. It was the homeworld of the Muttani.
Mordagon was a celestial body located in the Mordagon system, a part of the Authala sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Mordageen smuggler Bendix Fust.

Dor Nameth was a distant planet located in the Dor Nameth system, a part of the Bright Jewel sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. The planet was situated on the Celanon Spur hyperlane, which connected it to the Qiilura and Korvaii systems.

Tefau was a location in the Tefau system of the Outer Rim Territories' Suolriep sector. Soth Petikkin, a Tefaun who worked as a recruiter for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, was from Tefau.

Tirac Munda was an astronomical object located in the Tirac Munda system, a part of the Hevvrol sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Human thief Merc Sunlet.
Tocoya was a planet located within the Tocoya system of the Inner Rim and the homeworld of the Tocoyan race. Neb Dulo, a disciple of the religion Davrilat, was from the planet.

Caltinia was a lush planet that was the homeworld of House Elegin, famous for its hundreds of dueling fields surrounded by numerous mausoleums, temples, and museums celebrating and mourning epic duels of the past.

Danalbeth was a water world located in the Danalbeth system, a part of the Teraab sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It was postulated by some scientists that Danalbeth was the homeworld of the Graygl, a species of aquatic sentients.

Eriscot was a Mid Rim water world located in the Haserian sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Nejma species, which was relocated to the planet Iskalon by a group of spacefaring benefactors after a series of cataclysms on several water worlds, including Eriscot, five m…

Mackar was a water world located in the Mackar system, a part of the Hewett sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Frid, a species of telepathic, fish-like aquatic sentients.
Ota was a frozen world in the Kashyyyk Region of the Mid Rim which was the home of the furry sentient species known as the Snogars.
Pursin was a planet home to the Pursian species, that was constantly at war with Yugami and its inhabitants.
Raxxa was a planet represented in the New Republic Senate by Dall Thara Dru.
Seezar's Planet was a planet where the "Chanteuse of the Stars," Shirley, once performed.

Sikurd was a planet located in the Sikurd system within the Tynquay sector in the Outer Rim Territories, and it was the homeworld of the Sikurdian species. It was also where Sikurdian battle-axes were made.
Tyluun was a gloomy planet located in the Tyluun system of the Juvex sector. It was the homeworld of the Night-Soarers.
Vanan was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Atravis sector's Vanan system in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Xeron was a planet located within the Xeron system, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim.
Yugami was a planet located within the Yugami system of the Outer Rim Territories. Its people were in a constant state of conflict with the Pursian species of Pursin.
Fere, sometimes known as Feree, was the Fere homeworld.
A planet in the Gama system was the Gama-Senn homeworld. Its populace was intimidated into swearing loyalty to the clone Emperor Palpatine after witnessing the Galaxy Gun in action.
Arorua was a jungle planet home to fierce monsters spawned from Sith sorcery, such as the squollyhawlk and the silan.

Ceriun was a terrestrial world that was located in the Ceriun system of the Outer Rim Territories. Around 1000 BBY, a tattooed Sith journeyed to the planet to retrieve a Sith holocron that had been taken there by a Jedi.

Dur Sabon was a planet inhabited by an eel-like species of the same name. Above the planet’s ocean level rose cities on large rocky platforms supported by descending pillars. In the sky above the cities, a series of spheres of unknown purpose hovered.
Felacat was the Felacatian homeworld. It was located in the Outer Rim Territories, and its inhabitants were cat people who would transform into tiger-like creatures when in hyperspace for too long.
Kaon was a planet in the Tion Cluster. It was inhabited by scranges.

Old Mankoo was a planet located in the Old Mankoo system, a part of the Quess sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. The planet was impoverished, and by 23 BBY, the royal family of Old Mankoo had been overthrown.
Ootoola was the vastly oceanic homeworld of the Ootoolan race. The world was located in the Morshdine sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
