Qiaxx was a planet in the Cor'ric sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Skeebo, also known as the Jewel of the Five Systems, was a rocky Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Shadola sector. At some point long before 10 ABY, the Skeebos of Skeeb erected pyramidal stone funeral palaces in a region of the planet known as the sacred valley.

Somov Rit was a sparsely populated green world with a native Human population. During the New Sith Wars, Jedi scout Torr Snapit came to the planet seeking Force-sensitive recruits, but his only luck was with three young children: Rain, Tomcat and Bug.
Talas was a dry, rocky, volcanic Outer Rim world located in the Kamdon system in the Calamari sector. It was the headquarters of Tallet and Lekket.

Terra Sool was a planet located within the Terra Sool system of the Expansion Region. It was liberated from the Confederacy of Independent Systems by Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi in 22 BBY, during the Clone Wars.
Vellity was a planet in the Trax sector's Vellity system, located in the Mid Rim. An agrarian world, it was the homeworld of the Near-Human Borneck.
Xo was a planet located within the Xo system in the Spinward sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Zanibar species and the site of their sacrificial rituals.
Xoman III, or Xoman Three, also known as Xoman Free, was a planet located in the Halla sector of the Mid Rim.
Troxar was a planet located within the Troxar system of the Expansion Region and the Troxan homeworld.

Rakrir was the homeworld of the Rakririan species. A highly refined and meticulous species, few left their homeworld, finding the rest of the galaxy to be too unsophisticated. The planet was sometimes known as Ballikite.
Aefao was the Aefan homeworld, located in the Aefao system. A remote planet, it was on the other side of the galaxy from Nar Shaddaa.
Amorphiia was a planet located in the Amorphiia system of the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the Amorphiians.
Haariden was a volcanic world and the lava crab homeworld. It was orbited by a sole moon, which appeared pink from the planet's surface.
Glithnos was a Galactic Republic planet represented in the Galactic Senate by Jannie Ha'Nook.
Althir III, or Althir, was a remote, independent planet in the Althir system that was located outside of the borders of the Galactic Republic. It had a system of rocky planetary rings.
Veccacopia was an astronomical object located within the Veccacopia system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tunka sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Cacop species.
Adin was a planet in the Expansion Region, located on Hydian Way. Few in the galactic community trusted the bureaucrats that the planets put in power.
Kloper was a New Republic member planet, and the homeworld of the Kloperian species.

Glottal was a planet located within the Glottal system in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. It was the Glottalphib homeworld. It was a hot and humid planet, making it a perfect habitat for the Glottalphibs.
Archae Teuthis was the Sulituan homeworld. It was covered in deep oceans and the Sulituans lived in large float-cities built of phrnnoc, a type of coral.
Daimla was a terrestrial world located in the Daimla system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Kallea sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Daimlo species.
Ghishi was a planet located in the Ghishi system and was the homeworld of the Ghishi species.
Neelabi was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Neelabi species. The Neelabi had a social hierarchy built upon competition.
Ferro was the Ferroan homeworld. In 89 BBY, the Ferroans colonized Zonama Sekot.

Langhesa was the Langhesi homeworld situated in the Langhesa system in the Meram sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was conquered in 129 BBY by the Tsinimals, leading to a mass migration of Langhesi offworld.
Norah was a planet where Soara Antana and Darra Thel-Tanis went on a mission.

Eeyyon was the Mid Rim planet saved by the Jedi prior to the Clone Wars. It was inhabited by a species of tall, pale-skinned humanoids. Native of Eeyyon, Teluron Thacker swore to aid the Jedi Order wherever he was, in gratitude for the help given to his homeworld.
Nativum was a planet. During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems changed their plans — instead of attacking Nativum, they changed to Azure.

Noori was a terrestrial planet in the Noori sector's Noori system within the galaxy's southeast quadrant, located in an area of the Expansion Region overlapping with a part of space known as the Slice.
Piton was a terrestrial planet located in the Piton system of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of the sentient Piton species, which lived underground.
Quint was a planet located in the Inner Rim that was the homeworld of the Quint species.

Rondai-2 was a cosmopolitan planet of mild weather and mild landscapes, with rolling hills but no mountains. It was two days travel by hyperspace from Haven and less than a day from Coruscant. It was a planet for top-security, low-profile business meetings in the Ulta Center.
The planet of Sorl was Jedi Master Noor R'aya's homeworld.
Teevan was a planet with silvery seas located within the Teevan system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Teevan species. Jedi Padawan Tru Veld came from this world.

Ventrux was a planet located within the Ventrux system within the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of Jenna Zan Arbor and original headquarters of Arbor Industries, although the laboratories were closed down when Jenna relocated to Simpla-12.

terrain: Rich mineral soil with blue crystals
x: Zekulae was a planet located at the heart of the Zeemacht Cluster within the Zekulae system of the Inner Rim. It was a barren world, noted for its dark, rich mineral soil, which was studded with blue crystals. Its soil was extremely fine and so was everpresent on the planet.

Surron was a world located in the Surron sector of the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Surronians, an insectoid species with a guild-based society. The Surronian were long-respected shipbuilders, renowned for their innovative starship designs.

Sionia was the homeworld of the Skups, located within Hutt Space. Sionian Skups were a near-human species with a vast range of genetic characteristics. Rumor had it that the Skups were genetically altered by another species and sold to the Hutts ages ago.
Emberlene was a planet located in the Authala sector of the Expansion Region.
Masterra, originally known as Ord Masterra, was a planet in the Hertae sector of the Mid Rim.
Adner was a planet located in the Expansion Region's Yataga sector. It had two suns and was a hot world with cold, arid nights. Adner was the homeworld of the sentient Adnerem species.
Baralou was a planet in the Varada sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Krikthasi and the Multopos.
Benja-Rihn was a planet in the Mid Rim. In its Temple of Tet-Ami was the Orb of Passage. At some point, Mace Windu traveled back in time using the Orb and saved Carthas from insectoids.
Corroth was a planet known for its duelists, such as Matta Tremayne.

Escabar was a planet located in the Escabar system, a part of the freestanding subsectors of the Expansion Region. It featured the regions Khrassh and Serhan, the latter of which had deserts in its northeastern areas.
Hjaff was a planet located in the Colonies. It was the homeworld of the Tarc, a isolationist species of sentient crustacean creatures. Hjaff had three continents.
Illarreen was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Herios sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Poss'Nomin species, who originally evolved on the planet's island continent Vhin.

Inysh was a Core Worlds planet that was home to the Abinyshi. A sentient, passive species of reptilians, the natives of Inysh were among the first species to achieve space travel, although their interstellar colonization was limited.
Jankok was a warm terrestrial planet located in the Jankok system, a part of the Bozhnee sector in the Western Reaches portion of Outer Rim Territories.

Jerne was a desert planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Kanz sector. Its native Jerni species had gone extinct by the time the Galactic Empire militarized the world and headquartered themselves in Jerne City H.Q., an event that had occurred recently by 3 ABY.

The Kashoonara were a sentient species native to Kashoon. The savage humanoids were conquered by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War; however, with support from the Alliance to Restore the Republic, they were able to drive the Empire from their homeworld after a …

affiliation: Kinkosa State allied with Galactic Empire at some point during the Gal
x: Kirtania was the homeworld of the spider-like, pacifist Araquia people. The Kubaz crime lord Schnil Hakoon settled on the planet and centered his operations in Kinkosa City.
Rellnas Minor was the moon of Rellnas. While it had a variety of natural environments, the native Rellarin people were concentrated in coastal and island settlements in the frigid polar regions.

Teloc Ol-sen was a desert planet located within the Teloc Ol-sen system of the Mid Rim that was inhabited by the Teloc Hunters. At some point before 2 ABY, the vigilante group known as the Zulirian Swordmasters fought and massacred a Rebel cell on Teloc Ol-sen.
Thandruss was a terrestrial planet located in the Expansion Region's Thand sector. It was the homeworld of the Krytollaks, warm-blooded sentients with hard outer shells.
Trilos was a moon of Atraken, the only one with a breathable atmosphere. An Atrakenite mining colony was established on Trilos several years prior to the Clone Wars.

government: A mix of representative democracy and theocracy
x: V'shar was a Wild Space planet that was the homeworld of the sentient Ka'hren species. A tradition-bound, religious, and isolationist people, the Ka'hren had a system of government in which their many organized faiths had a direct influence.

Wen'he'dinae was a terrestrial planet located in the Wen'he'dinae system, a part of the Eidoloni sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The planet had several seasons and was home to a multitude of carnivorous creatures.
Churruma was a planet with deposits of valuable metals that was located within the Velcar sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Hanofar was a terrestrial world located in the Hanofar system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. During the early years of the Galactic Civil War, a conflict fought between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, Hanofar was held by the Empire.

Lamus was a moon of an Outer Rim Territories planet. It was inhabited by the A'Mar people. Its equator was forested; its poles were deserts with sinkholes. Gundarks inhabited the moon. One of the moon's settlements was the town of Vidge-Ribu, a low-tech agrarian community.
Skalokor was the second moon of the world Yabosta.

Yabosta was a planet located in the Yabosta system of the Expansion Region. It was orbited by at least two moons, the second of which was called Skalokor. Port Kalla was one of the largest cities on the planet, and its primary spaceport.

Halanit was an ichthyoculture moon colonized around 20 BBY. The moon orbited a large gas giant, and was covered with a thick ice crust, but beneath it crust the inner heat of the moon's core created pockets of breathable atmosphere.

affiliation: Cooperative Council of Independent Planetary Governments
x: Chroma Zed was a terrestrial planet located in the Maerdocian sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim. Home to the wormlike humanoid Chromans, who lived in moist mountain burrows near water, the planet featured some of the most magnificent amphitheater facilities, including one with tw…

Gammalin was a planet in the Vish sector of the Mid Rim. Its populace was wiped out by the Emperor's Plague. Unknowingly released by Fonterrat, he had brought it from an Imperial storehouse and booby-trapped by Nolaa Tarkona.
Kaisa was a planet that was once home to the Buro species. However, it was accidentally driven to extinction by the actions of Human geologists.

Ab'Bshingh was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, home to the Farang and Waroot species, who fought each other continuously for centuries. At some point, the Imperial military strategist Crat Dakerno went to the planet to study the two native species.
Absit was a planet located in the Absit system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tunka sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient humanoid species known as the Yatir.
Alliga was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Phelleem sector. It was the homeworld of the Holwuff species.

Arcopola was a world located in the Arcopola system of the Spadja sector, a part of the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the sister world of the terrestrial planet Gambolla and was the site of the location Greccia.

Barundi was the homeworld of the Barundi species. The natives of Barundi were taken from their homeworld thousand of years before the Battle of Yavin and were deposited on an unnamed planet in Wild Space. There, they worshiped the Yavin Vassilika.
Betal was a Wild Space astronomical object located in the Betal system. It was the origin point of the group known as the Poraskors, who reportedly wove neural-web reflex threads by hand.
Bethars was a celestial body located in the Bethars system, a part of the Emmo sector of the Core Worlds.
Borlov was the homeworld of the feudal Borlovian species.

Captivity was a moon located in the Mid Rim's Manoe sector. It was covered in a layer of clouds and had frequent and violent storms, and the moon's surface featured high mountains and jagged rock formations.
Cordes was an Imperial-controlled planet in the Inner Rim.
Corlass was a planet of pirates, both seafaring and spacefaring. Located within the Outer Rim Territories, it was one of the original member-worlds of the Kingdom of Cron.

Cortina was a planet directly represented in the New Republic Senate. Its government attempted to push its application to the New Republic through, thinking itself superior, but eventually calmed down and earned membership.
Dandelo was a planet inhabited by spotted jugadoos and a sentient, primitive avian species known as Fuzzums.
Darlon was a celestial body located in the Darlon system of the Mid Rim's Eucer sector. Senator Jonas Wallen, who represented a sector in the Galactic Republic's Senate, hailed from Darlon.
Daroon was a planet represented in the Imperial Senate by Alku Vordu.
Delderaan was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Delderaan system, a part of the Noonian sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Denevar was a planet. During the Galactic Civil War, the planet was controlled by Imperial Prefect Adar.

Dordolum was a planet located in the Colonies Region of the galaxy. Its population included individuals from a number of sentient species, such as Aqualish, Barabels, Bothans, Duros, Humans and Ishori.

Erigorm was a planet in the Core Worlds. After the Great Galactic War, Erigorm was one of the planets that threatened secession from the Republic, as part of the Rift Alliance. By that time, it had recorded and administrated the Republic's finances for centuries.

Esooma was a planet located in the Esooma system, within the Sprizen sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the sentient Esoomian species, who were considered to be among the best hired muscle in the galaxy.
Fnessal was a planet located in the Inner Rim's Fnessal system. It was the homeworld of the sentient Fnessian species, including the smuggler Kn'ik Th'ronik.
Fremond III was a planet in the Inner Rim.

Gailea was a planet located in the Gailea system of the Core Worlds. It was the site of the location Femon and the Marqua Spas, the latter of which hosted the renowned and exclusive annual Marqua Spas Grand Ball.
Gambolla was a planet in the same star system as Arcopola, in the Spadja sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Gantho was a planet located in the Gantho system. The planet was represented in the New Republic Senate by Senator Arastide. In 13 ABY the New Republic was in the middle of an investigation into Loronar Corporation and their supposed depletion of the world's resources.
Gavens was a human-inhabited planet located in the Expansion Region's Gavens system. It was the birthplace of Akanah Norand Goss Pell. Its capital city was Torlas.

Gobindi was an Outer Rim planet in the Noonian sector, with an Imperial bioweapons lab. Human siblings Zak and Tash Arranda visited the planet seeking medical aid after Zak contracted a stomach virus. Zak was taken to the hospital and treated.
Gosfambling was a planet in the Mid Rim, and was the homeworld of the Gosfamblings. C-Gosf represented the world in the New Republic Senate.
Gulma was a planet located within the Gulma system in Wild Space and was the homeworld of the Gulmarid species. The planet was covered by swampy terrain.
Horob was a planet with an Rebel Alliance research lab discovered by the Galactic Empire. The planet was taken by the Victory-class Star Destroyer Imperial Hazard.
Intuci was a planet in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories under the control of the Galactic Empire.

Iyuta was an underdeveloped planet in the Fakir sector. Controlled by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War, it was the location of several important governmental facilities and was well protected by spy satellites and large cruisers.
Jandur was a planet in the Inner Rim and was represented in the New Republic Senate.
Jendorn was an Expansion Region planet located in the Farstey sector. It was situated in the Borderland Regions, an area over which the confederation led by Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn had control.
Jenenma was a planet with many starshipwrights. The Hutt's Last Laugh cantina was on the planet, as was the headquarters of a syndicate run by Pal-Nada, a Cerean Force adept.

Jiaan was a planet located in the Jiaan system in the Mid Rim's Almak sector. During the early years of the New Order—which was established in 19 BBY—Jiaan was one of many planets that was subjugated and decimated by the forces of the Galactic Empire, targeted after Jedi Knigh…
Kalzeron was a planet with a feudal civilization. It was the homeworld of the Kalzerian people.
Sucharme was a planet affiliated with the Trade Federation prior to the Invasion of Naboo. The Federation's primary garrison, Tallaga Garrison, was located in the city of Tallaga.
Malthor was a Mid Rim planet located in the Tandon sector. It featured the active trade city Fabrillan, which in turn was the site of the busy Fabrillan City Spaceport.
Kerensik was a terrestrial planet located in the Kerensik system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. Kerensik was a part of the Allied Region known as the Botor Enclave.

Ladarra was a desert planet in the Gordian Reach along the Pinooran Spur. It was the location of the Human colony of New Hope Settlement. The planet was colonized during the days of the Old Republic and ended up becoming a failed chromium mine.

Lansono was a celestial body located in the Lansono system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. By the date 13:5:16, Senator Candabrine Bu represented Lansono in the Galactic Republic's Senate.
Meastrinnar was an Inner Rim planet. During the Galactic Civil War, it rebelled against the Galactic Empire, leading to an Imperial pacification campaign in the city Vondrel.
Miztoc was an astronomical object located in the Miztoc system, a part of the Irnaj sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim.
Norne was a world situated in the Core Worlds. It featured several cities that were home to homeless children.
Omman was a planet located in the Tion Hegemony of the Outer Rim.
Pendal was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Pendal system, a part of the Homon sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim.

Pirralor was a planet located in the Pirralor system of the Juvex sector, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It was the homeworld of House Pilor, and its spaceports were thick with outsiders from the Ninth Quadrant and the Agarix sector.

Porus Vida was a planet located in the Inner Rim and famous for its beauty and its culture. Despite its reputation as a peaceful world of museums, Porus Vida saw conflict throughout its history, including several sieges during the Alsakan Conflicts, and was devastated by the U…
Rathalay was a planet in the Mid Rim known for its vast private beaches. The planet exported Rathalayan firestones.
Rhamalai was an agriworld near Seitia Prime, to which the Cherishites fled following persecution by the Galactic Republic.
Rustibar was a Mid Rim planet subjugated by the Galactic Empire.

Sibisime was a planet in the Mid Rim. The slicer Zakarisz Ghent was living there, in Saraban City in 4 ABY when he was approached by a man who offered him a job if he went to Chibias and gave him a spaceliner ticket.
The planet Sinton was located in the Sinton system, a part of the Mid Rim's Rago sector. It lay along the Rago Run hyperlane, which connected it to the Moro and Gilatter systems.

Tralfin was tropical resort world located in the Outer Rim Territories' Xappyh sector. In 28 BBY, the Human Qan Gindoch was born on Tralfin. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Moff Crin Harson of the Galactic Empire was murdered on Tralfin.

Trevura was an Imperial-controlled Inner Rim planet with a prominent droid population. At some point between 0 BBY and 5 ABY, an underground droid resistance group on Trevura hired the assassin droid S-R6 to kill the local governor, Merno Blask.
Yarrv was a tropical Core World planet of dense jungles, warm oceans and wide, sandy beaches.

Keedad was a remote terrestrial planet located in the Keedad system, a part of the Auril sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the lettrani fruit tree as well as the near-Human Keed species.
Kho Nai was an astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the Khotta homeworld.
Loce was a celestial body situated in the Loce system of Wild Space that shared its name with the sentient near-Human Locan species. It was the homeworld of the young Locan Talas Piran.
Majoor was the homeworld of a native sentient species. It was located in the Expansion Region.
Mauk was a planet where Asajj Ventress was worshiped as a goddess of death.
Mephitis was the Mephitisian homeworld. The indigenous people had no sense of smell. Offworlders found the entire planet's atmosphere to have a foul stench.
Nyny was a homeworld of a three-headed sentient species located in the Ash Worlds. Thirteen years after the Battle of Endor, Nyny was represented in the New Republic Senate.
Saclas was a barren Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Corporate Sector. Home to gelatinous pet slimes, it was a colony world of the sentient Ocsin species.

Y'nybeth was a world located within the star system of the same name of the Expansion Region. It was the dark place and homeworld of the Plasmars, transparent amoebic creatures that absorbed any available warmth into their bodies.
Reigalius was the Reigat homeworld. It was located in the Yucrales Sector of the Mid Rim near Leritor.

Rhamsis Callo was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Danjar sector. It was the homeworld of the Force-sensitive and militaristic Schenor species, which allowed the Galactic Empire to construct a base on the planet despite remaining neutral in the Galactic Civil War.
Serat was the Seratian homeworld. The aggressive nocturnal Tymps were native to Serat, and considered pests.
Shaymore was a planet located in the Shaymore system, which was itself located in the Immerian Outback of the Expansion Region and situated in the lee of the Trailing Sectors.

Shador was a Mid Rim planet on the Gamor Run. It was the Shadorian homeworld and had such a foul atmosphere, that it was painful for Humans to breathe. The planet was dominated by swamps, and the various towns were built on pylons rising above the wet terrain.
Trascor was a terrestrial planet located in the Trascor system, a part of the Corva sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It featured the large island continent Klypash.
Sif-Uwana was a planet within the Colonies area of the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the individuals known as Sif-Uwani and was administered by the Sif-Uwana Council.
Solem was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories and the homeworld of a species.

Spee was a celestial body located in the Spee system, a part of the Saijo sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the site of a spaceport and a number of restaurants as well as at least one hotel.
Th'irus was a planet located within the Th'irus system of the Wild Space.

Tsyk was a planet located in the eponymous star system and lay along the hyperlane known as the Hollastin Run, which connected it to the worlds of Hollastin and Circumtore. It was the homeworld of the sentient species, the Tsyklen.
Velabri was a planet located within the Velabri system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was conquered by the Galactic Empire.
Vendara was a planet located within the Vendara system in the Kwymar sector of the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. It was home to the Vendaran species and the predatory mollusks called skeeg.

Yn was a planet located within the Yn system of the Inner Rim. Around 5300 BBY, the Jedi laid siege to an Imperial stronghold at the battle of Yn. Tulak Hord, Ortan Cela, Khem Val, and Veshikk Urk broke the siege with their army of dark side warriors.
Nam Priax was an oceanic planet located within the Nam Priax system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Perilix was an oceanic world inhabited by thinking clams.

Endex was a world of rocky canyons. It was the Entymal homeworld. During the time of the Old Republic, the Entymals were renowned as excellent pilots across the galaxy. For centuries, many pilots were trained in the canyons which left a lot of wreckage behind.
Melinz was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Melinz system of the Core Worlds. It featured foothills situated within the limits of the city Shad.
Wakeelmui was a planet located in the Colonies.

Challon was a planet in the Core Worlds that remained neutral during the Galactic Civil War. While on Challon, Leia Organa tried to convince local Governor Tchai to support the Rebel Alliance. Organa was forced to kill Giles Durane, her "weapons master," in self-defense.
Shawken was a planet in the Core Worlds that boasted one of the most ancient known civilizations in the galaxy, dating back to the Pre-Republic era.

Aaeton was a planet of the Aaeton system, in the Core Worlds region. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, an Imperial bioweapon activated on the planet.
Belazura was a Galactic Republic member world, and one of the most visually stunning planets in the galaxy. Belazura was directly represented in the Galactic Senate.

Mamendin was a world situated in the Core Worlds. It colonized the Mid Rim's Malari system, and, by the time of the Separatist Crisis, the Malarian Alliance bound it to that system as well as, ultimately, around forty others.
Thracior was a Core Worlds planet that was home to a clan-based culture. In 32 BBY, the planet's warlords began arguing over territory, leading to raids between the local tribes.
Yerphonia was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Yerphonia system of the Core Worlds. It was the site of the prestigious All Science Research Academy.
Caprioril was a planet located in the Core Worlds, near Chandrila. It was the site of the infamous Caprioril Massacre.

Berrun was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Berrun system, a part of the Slice portion of the Colonies. By the time of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, the Republic maintained a detention facility on Berrun.
This industrialized world was located along the edge of the Core Worlds, and was a target of Separatist activities during the early stages of the Clone Wars.

Cortella was a Core Worlds planet ruled by a monarchy. In 25 BBY, the Human Jedi Knights Obi-Wan Kenobi and Siri Tachi impersonated the king and queen of Cortella in order to infiltrate the elite Leadership School on the planet Andara.
Rehemsa was a Core Worlds celestial body located on the Corellian Run. Around 3671 BBY, the Human Felix Iresso was born at a refugee camp at Rehemsa to refugees of the Great Galactic War.
Shulxi was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Shulxi system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. Its surface featured beaches.
Thokos was a planet located within the Thokos system of the Core Worlds. Colonists from Thokos settled Ammuud. Thokos has been settled over 25 millennia ago.
Trantor was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Trantor system of the Core Worlds.
Tentator was a planet located within the Tentator system of the Colonies, used as a prison by the Galactic Republic.
Basilisk was a Core world in the Arrowhead of the Slice, near Coruscant.

Galand was a Core world. It was homeworld of the near-Human Galandans, including the religious martyr H'kig. His teachings formed the basis of the H'kig philosophy. To escape persecution, the H'kig fled to distant Rishi.

Kiva was a planet that was located within the Mid Rim. Its indigenous Kivan people were wiped out by Project Starscream, to the utter horror of Shi'ido anthropologist Mammon Hoole. The only remnants of the people were shadowy wraiths.
Dremulae was a terrestrial planet in the Deep Core and was known for the natural beauty of its Sea of Translucency and for its popular wealthy resort.
Nantama was a wealthy resort world, controlled by House Elegin, renowned for the natural beauty of its fields. The Third Nantama Synod was held there.

Cyimarra was a terrestrial planet located in the Mid Rim's Senex sector. The homeworld of the the aristocratic House Araba, its surface featured cities interspersed among woodlands and mountains as well as a sea.

Kidiet Olgo was a celestial body and a shadowport located in the Kidiet Olgo system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Core Worlds. A hyperlane connected it to the Mamendin system of the Farrfin sector.

Bassadro was a mining world with glassy crags on its dormant volcanoes. It was devastated in a battle in which it was taken from the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars by Empatojayos Brand.
Herzob was an agriworld in the Colonies. It exported grains to several worlds in the Galactic Core and Mid Rim. The planet was infested with jevesects, which tore through the planet-spanning farms.

Golkus was a planet between Carratos and Coruscant. Akanah Norand Goss Pell stopped there to get false identification papers from Talon Karrde's organization before she first met Luke Skywalker on Coruscant.
Koba was a planet on the Cerean Reach in the Mid Rim. It was ravaged by Tulak the Advozse warlord, but later protected from his son Kalut by Jedi Knight Yaddle.

Froswythe was a planet in the Colonies. It was a major source of meat and animal-based textiles for the Colonies and Core Worlds. Roaming herds of livestock included banthas and nerfs. Ycaqt were used for transportation.

Cilpar was an agriworld in the Colonies, nearly covered in mountains, jungles, and forests. It was characterized by the near-indestructible ancient temples scattered across the surface. Local flora and fauna included the predatory ronk.
Ord Lithone was an Inner Rim world that served as a Galactic Republic outpost during the Pius Dea Era. Millennia later, it hosted a Baktoid Armor Workshop factory.
Nak Shimor was a planet in the Colonies, on the Perlemian Trade Route near the border with the Inner Rim. Andur Sunrider purchased the Lightside Explorer on Nak Shimor from a Vultan dealer.
Trunska was a planet located within the Trunska system of the Colonies.
Voktunma was a planet in the Voktunma system of the Core Worlds.

Norulac was a planet in the Inner Rim with numerous mountain ranges strewn all over its surface. Its lack of a strong government enabled various groups avoiding authorities elsewhere to take refuge on the planet.
Ord Vaxal was a planet in the Inner Rim of the galaxy.
Alashan was a planet located in Wild Space of the the galaxy.

Berri was a planet in the Inner Rim. It was a hot, smog-shrouded world with high gravity and a dense atmosphere. It was the homeworld of the Berrite species, which evolved to become master foragers due to its few natural food sources.
Djurmo was a blasted volcanic world located in the Djurmo system, a part of the Strabin sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim.
Sermeria was an agriworld in the Expansion Region.

Ord Vaug was a planet in the Expansion Region's Rocantor sector. The site of a major Imperial propaganda victory over Separatist holdouts in 17 BBY, Ord Vaug was the site of an Imperial prison that at one point held the Venerated Ones of Vandelhelm.

Celegia was an Expansion Region world of raging seas. Its atmosphere was rich in the toxic cyanogen gas, and it was the homeworld of the sentient Celegians. Due to oxygen being lethal to the Celegians, they had to use special life support chambers when traveling off-world.

Prazhi was an Expansion Region planet located in the Cyrillian Protectorate. It was the homeworld of the Zexx species. A member of the galactic community since at least 5000 BBY, a millennium later Prazhi was situated on an important hyperspace trade route.
Tarhassan was a planet in the Expansion Region. It was controlled by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

T'surr was a cold and windswept high-gravity planet in the Expansion Region's Nuon e Safyd sector. Most of the planet's lifeforms had excellent low-light vision, and the harsh conditions of the world gave rise to a predatory sentient species also known as the T'surr.
Nessem was a Trade Federation planet in the Expansion Region. It was orbited by the modest Nessem Shipyards.
Montitia was a poverty-stricken planet in the Montitia system of the Montitian Grant sector, located within the Expansion Region of the galaxy.
A trade world lying on the Corellian Run super-hyperroute, Tlactehon was located in the Expansion Region's Kailion sector.

Cliffborer worms were parasitic, almost mindless, burrowing arthropods common throughout the galaxy. They flourished specially on the many planets that featured mainly arid and rocky climates, such as Tatooine.
Wraids were large reptilian creatures found on many desert planets around the galaxy, including Tatooine, Ruhnuk, and Korriban.

Bakura-6, also known simply as Planet 6, was a barren, ice-covered planet in the Bakura system. It was the site of a small Bakuran colony that was destroyed by the Ssi-ruuk during the battle of Bakura.
Gartros were small dragon-like avian creatures that lived on Coruscant. They had spiked tails, and jaws filled with sharp teeth.

The planet originally known as Gelefil was an agricultural world between Ingo and Ko Vari. It was one of seven inhabited planets out of a total of fourteen in the Annoo system of the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Cirrus was a Outer Rim world orbiting two orange suns. It had golden seas and lovely cities, including the capital Ciran near a bay. It was the homeworld of Talesan Fry and his parents.
The Inner Circle was a group of senior members of the Wyrd, a coven of Tarasin dark side Force witches from the planet Cularin. The Inner Circle were directly answerable to Wyrd's leader.

result: Successful defection and rescue of Tycho Celchu
x: The Rebel Alliance's Red Squadron conducted a mission to Dantooine. The squadron skirmished with the Galactic Empire over a defecting officer named Tycho Celchu, who had secretly contacted the Rebel Alliance regarding his planned defection, though this was quickly discovered b…
Viraanntesses were ten-legged crustacean-like aliens from the Viraanntesse system. Jedi Master Jmmaar was a Viraanntesse.

The Eriadu Trade Summit, also known as the Eriadu Conference, or simply Eriadu Summit, was an event proposed by Senator Palpatine in 33 BBY, ostensibly to gather all parties affected by Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum's proposal to allow the Trade Federation an increase in st…

The Rights of Sentience League was an organization affiliated with the Galactic Republic. In 32.5 BBY, the organization participated in the Eriadu Trade Summit, an event held on the planet Eriadu as a forum for the Galactic Republic and the Trade Federation to discuss the taxa…

Genian was a Mid Rim world. The planet remained neutral during the Clone Wars due to its vast corporate holdings, research labs, and secure banks. Many Senators, both Separatists and Republic alike, would store their money here, due to its neutrality.
Haven was a small planetoid located in the Minos Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories.

Quas Killam was a planet on the edge of the Mid Rim. Its people were the Killam. Quas Killam was a world of weapons manufacturing factories and trinium mines, and so was conquered by the Trade Federation early in the Clone Wars.
Romin was a small Mid Rim planet. It was the homeworld of the Romins.

Crytal Nest was a Wild Space planet that was the homeworld of the sentient Shashay species. During the existence of the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire, the Shashay explored and traded with other star systems, but later into the Empire's reign, the species became mor…
Deylerax was a Mid Rim world, the homeworld of the near-Human Enu race.
Goelitz was a rival of nearby Ylix. The planet became embroiled in a war with its neighbor that lasted for a number of years.
Sanza, also known as Krish, was a Mid Rim world dedicated to casinos, race tracks, arenas, agriculture, and manufacturing. It was the home of the Krish species.

Ylix was a backwater Mid Rim planet located in the Ylix system between Anobis and Ithor. It was a long-time rival of nearby Goelitz, which it finally defeated in battle. It was also the home of the mercenary Gallandro.
Burska was a little-known tundra planet located in the Mid Rim's freestanding subsectors. It had frequent, large-diameter hail and was home to a thick-hided, passive offshoot of the gundark species.

Frithia was a terrestrial planet located in the Frithia system, a part of the Glythe sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. It was home to the predator known as poth as well as the gigantic herd creature krag.

Harpori was a planet that was located in the Druess sector near the Balowa system within the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It hosted a Duros colony that was wiped out by Kaox Krul in 1000 BBY, shortly before the Battles of Ruusan.

Lorista was a terrestrial planet located in the Lorista system, a part of the Glythe sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. Its surface featured wastelands in which grew the flith flower, and it was also home to the vicious predatory creature bruth.
Yoribuunt was a beautiful, swirling gas giant in the Yoribuunt system of the Tharin sector near Hutt Space. It was a popular stop for sight-seers on luxury liners.
Anobis was a terrestrial planet located into the Anobis system of the Bright Jewel sector in the Mid Rim Territories.
Gandeal was a Planet in the Core Worlds and partner planet to the world of Fondor, a fortress world situated on the Corellian Trade Spine.
Morado was a planet located in the Hune sector of the Mid Rim.

Nuralee was a Mid Rim world in the Tyus sector. It had an economic breakdown shortly before the Clone Wars. It was represented in the Galactic Senate by Bog Divinian, a wealthy landowner with ties to the Commerce Guild.

Ord Tessebok was a Mid Rim planet situated in the Irishi sector. Serving as a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost during the Pius Dea Era, millennia later it loosened its immigration restrictions for people displaced by the Separatist Crisis.

Ord Varee was a Mid Rim planet situated in the Belshar sector. Serving as a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost during the Pius Dea Era, millennia later it loosened its immigration restrictions for people displaced by the Separatist Crisis.
Sedesia was a high-gravity Mid Rim world with harsh terrain and rough weather.

Tervissis was a planet located within the Tervissis system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of two sentient species, the Tervigs and the Bandies. The two species were at war with one another, with the Tervigs subjugating the Bandies.

Tholatin was a planet located within the Tholatin system of the Mid Rim. It was the location of Esau's Ridge, a thin crevasse in a towering rock wall inhabited by smugglers. The planet's chief of security was Plaan in 25 ABY.

Tammar, originally known as Lelrais, was the Tammarian homeworld. This planet had an unusually thin atmosphere, which caused native Tammarians to evolve a chemical pouch called a chaghizs torm to store oxygen.
The Dorvalla Incident marked a new development in the activities of the Nebula Front group.

Kalkovak was a remote planet populated by various species including a large sector populated by Quarren. It was a port world for travelers going to the Outer Rim Territories. Illyan Webble was left on the planet after he irritated the crew he was traveling with.

Storinal was an Outer Rim world. The Galactic Empire defeated the New Republic at the Battle of Storinal. The planet was artistically landscaped with lush green countryside, rivers, hills, tropical flower gardens, beaches and seas, and graceful cities.
Boztrok was an Outer Rim world on the Hydian Way just outside Corporate Sector.
Kabray was a Mid Rim forest world orbited by the Kabray Station, a neutral meeting place for diplomats from all over the galaxy.

Dweem was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories used as a base of operations for the Galactic Republic until abandoned because of the Order of the Terrible Glare. Around 60 BBY, Aqinos trained the Iron Knights on Dweem, where he hid with them during the later Great Jedi Purge.

Faldos was a dirty backwater Outer Rim Territories world used by smugglers to sell stolen weapons, armor, and technology. It sat on the very edge of the galaxy, making it far more removed than most of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Fifth Battle of Qotile was the last battle of the Stark Hyperspace War.

The Stark Commercial Combine, also called the Stark Collective or Stark Commerce Combine, was a criminal conglomeration of pirates and smugglers in the Outer Rim Territories. It was organized, led by, and named after crime lord Iaco Stark. Its flagship was the Raptor.

Gluss'sa'Nikto, or Pale Nikto, were a Nikto subspecies. They came from the Gluss'elta Islands of Kintan, causing them to be natural sailors. They had white-gray skin, eye-horns like the Kadas'sa'Nikto, and fins similar to those of the Esral'sa'Nikto, but smaller.

M'shento'su'Nikto, or Southern Nikto, were a Nikto subspecies with no horns, a covered nose, and several pairs of breathing tubes. These tubes were larger than those of the Kajain'sa'Nikto, and also acted as primitive ultrasonic sensory organs.
Krake's Planet was a planet in the Outer Rim's Demetras sector that was home to the Imperial Krake Data Vault during the Galactic Civil War.

Naldar was an Outer Rim world in the Phelleem sector. During the Galactic Civil War, Naldar became the target of severe Imperial aggression, withstanding a 2 ABY offensive that killed most of the royal family, and a 4 ABY another Imperial attack subjugated the world.

Spindrift was a planet in the Spindrift system, located in the Outer Rim's Rseik sector. An isolated world, Spindrift was home to an Imperial outpost called Spindrift Station during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
Corbos was an Outer Rim planet near the Yavin system which was rich in ores. It had "Black Rain Seasons" which saw whole sections of the planet become uninhabitable due to massive thunderstorms.

Stoga was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. A dry, desert world of large canyons and craggy rock formations, Stoga was largely overlooked by the galactic governments due to its remote location—making it a haven for smugglers, outlaws and mercenaries to keep a low profile.

Corphelion was an Expansion Region asteroid rimward of Phindar with numerous holiday resorts where honeymooners and tourists went to see the system's beautiful comets. It was the sight of the Battle of Corphelion during the New Sith Wars.

Haverling was a planet in the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim Territories, near the world of Morishim. It joined the New Republic, aiding the government by providing new shipyards to support the New Republic Navy.
Ord Thoden was a tectonically active planet in the Dynali sector. Its capital was Domitree, and it was represented in the Galactic Senate by Boganni Hrul prior to the Clone Wars.
Dagro was a remote planet and a noted agriworld in the years leading up to the Clone Wars.

Msst was a Mid Rim planet, and the homeworld of Brakiss. It was a small planet in the Msst system, which had an Imperial stronghold. The Empire had theoretically abandoned it after the Invasion of Bakura.
Qexis was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was a high-security research planet with only one spaceport. Few knew it existed.
Von-Alai was a planet in the Von-Alai system of the Expansion Region, polluted by Kontag factories.

Asturias was a factory moon in the Expansion Region that had been abandoned by the time of the Clone Wars. The nearby sun had turned into a red giant, and its radiation rose to limits too dangerous for prolonged exposure for both biological and mechanical existence.
Iscera was an Outer Rim planet near Issor and Nysza III. Fable Astin saw Jaalib Brandl perform in a play on this planet. It was a dry planet lacking any legal establishments that sold alcohol.
Korlings was a planet in the Korlings system, located in the Outer Rim, and home to a noble family. It was rumored to be the homeworld of the notorious pirate Faarl the Conqueror.

Redcap was a planet that was located in the Outer Rim Territories, situated near Socorro, Tatooine, and Issor. It was a barren, rainy world of fluid mud lakes, mud plains, canyons, and mountains that hosted a small-scale mining colony.
Haashimut was an Outer Rim planet. It was a Republic fortress world colonized c. 24,000 BBY from which the Jedi kept a watchful eye on the hostile Tion Cluster from their stronghold there.
Heriston was a planet in the Atravis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Aldivy was an Outer Rim Territories backwater agriworld.

Belthu was a unaligned Outer Rim Territories world located near the territory of Warlord Zsinj. A wealthy planet being controlled by a coalition of mining companies led by corporate executives, it had a durasteel foundry that was owned by an alias of Zsinj.
Fenion was an unaligned Outer Rim planet, near warlord Zsinj's territory. It was the only planet on the Night Caller agenda not visited by Wraith Squadron.
Vispil was a planet located within the Vispil system of the Outer Rim Territories. It refused warlord Zsinj's bribes and fought against him.
Xartun was an Outer Rim Territories planet in the Ojoster sector that was involved in manufacturing. A New Republic world, it was near warlord Zsinj's territory.
Varristad was a small mining planet located in the Varristad system within the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Alba-16 was an Outer Rim planet located in the Belsmuth sector. In 44 BBY, the planet was in the midst of a violent civil war. Nuuta, one of the renewed Phindians, was sent to Alba as punishment for fighting against the Syndicat on Phindar.
Baltimn was an Outer Rim planet. It was here that Ephaan Kenzon established the School of Hidden Wisdom, the only dueling academy to survive the Clone Wars and the rise of Emperor Palpatine.
Dorriella was a terrestrial world located in the Dorriella system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Wazta sector.
Elerion was a notorious gambling planet located in the Outer Rim Territories near Phoebus.

Kwevron was an Outer Rim Territories agriworld. It was a lightly populated world, with almost of all of its people engaged in farming to provide food for neighboring sectors. An Imperial Prefect oversaw its starport during the Galactic Civil War.
Mazuma was a planet located in the Mazuma system, within the Nuiri sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, that was site of the Lucre Cosminational Bank.
Dorvalla IV was a world controlled by Dorvalla Mining. It was the planet beyond their main base, Dorvalla. It was apparently inhabitable by humanoids; whether it actually was is unknown.

New Bakstre was a planet located within the Tendrannan subsector of the Outer Rim's New Territories. Part of the loosely affiliated domain known as the Cassandran Worlds, New Bakstre was a planet dominated by industry situated on the important Braxant Run hyperlane that served…
Nolar was a wealthy planet in the Inner Rim, a commercial center plagued by thieves. Mining equipment was manufactured on the planet.

Ord Grovner was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories near Courkrus. Originally an Ordnance/Regional Depot, the planet served as a staging area for the Imperial task force, led by Admiral Freeda, which wiped out the Eyttyrmin Batiiv pirates.
Prishardia was a backwater agriworld that was located on the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy near Chad.

Seregar was an Outer Rim jungle planet with a breathable atmosphere and green and blue vegetation. The planet's flora included a carnivorous plant, while an example of its fauna was the predator known as the ravenbeast.

Sheris was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Belsmuth sector. During the Clone Wars, it was under the control of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, while a few years later, the Galactic Empire defeated a fleet of pirates and Mandalorians there.
Vactooine was a mining colony in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its dense jungles made it a suitable habitat for the Elix.
Yarnil was a planet located within the Yarnil system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a homeworld to farmers and merchants.
Shinbone was a hardscrabble mining world in Wild Space. It was hit by the Hardan plague. Beilert Valance was born on Shinbone.
Houche was a planet in the Zuma sector, which surrounded the Moddell sector. Houche was an endpoint of the Annaj-Houche Run.

Solay was the main planet in the Solay system in the Dominus sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Home to a variety of species, Solay remained in the hands of a despot for half a century, before the Rebel Alliance hero Luke Skywalker assisted the resisters.
Voltare was a spaceport planet in the Voltare system of the Inner Rim.
Xoemefel was a planet in the Xoemefel system of the Mid Rim. It was the site of Ops Post, a New Republic Scout Service base.
Yanibar was a Wild Space planet with a harsh environment that included seasonal climate extremes. At some point by 3951 BBY, it was settled by a group of families and friends of Jedi.
Caarimon was a warm and steamy planet in the Outer Rim Territories.

Crakull was a planet located within the Crakull system of the Unknown Regions. It was home to the sentient Croke species. The Croke were diminutive in size, and had multiple legs as well as a natural ability to disguise themselves behind illusions.
Kariek was a planet located in Wild Space. Its sole indigenous sentient lifeform were the Eickarie people, who were divided into various tribes.
Shalyvane was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories and the homeworld of the Em'liy.
Er'stacia was a planet in Wild Space and the homeworld of the Er'stacians.
DNX-N1 was a planet located within the Wild Space DNX-N1 system. Charted but largely unexplored, it was the homeworld of the sentient gaseous species known as the Filar-Nitzan.

Gastrula was a planet in the Rayter sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The homeworld of the Gastrulan species, it was the terminus of the short-lived Great Bantha Breakfast Biscuit Run during the Galactic Civil War.
Needan was a Wild Space planet. A jungle world featuring massive oceans and numerous species of plants and animals, it was the homeworld of the sentient Geelan.

Godo was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the source of flame gems. The world was saved by Lando Calrissian and Han Solo. The Godoans refused to save Lando from a deadly disease in return until the Alliance of Free Planets threatened to attack Godo.
Carrivar was an astronomical object in the Unknown Regions' Carrivar system. The sentient species Hemes Arbora was native to Carrivar but eventually abandoned the celestial body.
Hurikane was a planet located in Wild Space. It was inhabited by a species of sentient beings made of stone and purple Hurrikaine crystals, who were almost insectoid in appearance.

terrain: Destroyed after the passing of Zonama Sekot
x: Munlali Mafir was a planet in the Unknown Regions.
Kabieroun was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.
Kodai was a remote planet in the Belderone sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Some time prior to 29 BBY, its entire surface had been flooded save for the city of Rena.
Krevas was a swampy planet in the Outer Rim and the homeworld of the Krevaaki.

Kushibah was a planet in the Gordian Reach sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the primitive lagomorph Kushiban species, most notably the Jedi Master Ikrit. The planet had no cities and limited technology.
Lur was an icy planet on the Outer Rim, known for the native Lurrian species, who were masters of genetic engineering.
Janguine was a jungle planet in the Outer Rim. Its natives spoke Janguine and were overrun by the Mooloolians around 275 BBY.

Nishr was a planet in the Outer Rim, home to a near-Human species known as the Nish. It was the scene of a conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Nordra was a cold, tectonically-active planet in the Inner Rim Territories. Though located along the famous Hydian Way trade route, it was often bypassed by travelers following the Itani Run that detoured around the nearby Itani Nebula.
Uru was a planet located within the Uru system of the Outer Rim Territories, and was the homeworld of the sentient Oni species.

Pelgrin was a planet in the Outer Rim. Over two million years before the Battle of Yavin, an indigenous species, the Pelgrin, built the Oracle on the planet, a merging of technology and the Force. The Pelgrin went extinct, leaving many mysterious ruins and artifacts.
Hirsi was a planet on the Cerean Reach in the Mid Rim.

Caaraz was a tide-locked, tectonically active planet in the Outer Rim. Its night-side was frozen with glaciers. Its day-side was scorching. In between was a thin, habitable region in which the Ranth race evolved.
Revyia was a planet in the Veragi sector of the Outer Rim, and the homeworld of the Revwien species.
Rodis was a primitive and war-torn planet located in the Rodis system of the Sugai sector, one of the subsectors making up the Outer Zuma region within the Outer Rim Territories' Zuma sector.
Orax was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, and was the homeworld of the crystalline Shard.
Sluudren was a planet in the Outer Rim. It was the homeworld of the Sludir. It was located in the Chorlian sector of the galaxy.

Stieg was a planet in the Outer Rim. It was populated by the Stieg-Fan, who ran a peaceful government. During the planet Kegan's isolationist period, The Learning taught that Stieg was a dangerous place to visit, surrounded in war and without any governing body.

Tof was a planet located within the Tof system of the Firefist satellite galaxy on the peripheral halo of the galactic disk and was part of the Unknown Regions. It was the homeworld of the near-Human Tofs, a green-skinned race of space pirates.

Trailia was a low-tech planet, located in the Trailia system of the Outer Rim Territories, on the fringes of known space. It was the homeworld of the Trailians. It was a technologically primitive world with thick jungles.

The Umaren'k'sa were a sentient species from the planet Umaren'k in the Unknown Regions. After another species, the Hemes Arbora, migrated to their world, the Umaren'k'sa adopted much of their visitors' culture, a societal shift that was prompted by the appearance of the senti…
Gbu was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, located in the Tion Cluster's Keldrath sector.
Baskarn was a planet in the Outer Rim. The planet was inhabited by the large, green-furred, Force-sensitive Yrashu. The planet was also home to the dangerous Razor trees.
Orleon was a rainy planet in the Mid Rim. The rain was torrential and never stopped, leaving the planet covered in mud.
Tellanroaeg was an Outer Rim Territories astronomical object. It was located on the Corellian Run super-hyperroute in the Gaulus sector.
Doli was a planet in the Outer Rim rumored by 39 BBY to be the location of a Sith holocron.
Wxtm was a planet located in the Wxtm system of the Outer Rim Territories. One of its native creatures was an avian called a ravenscreecher, which had six legs.
Lisal was a planet in the Mid Rim, rumored to be home to a Sith holocron.
Shikitari was a planet located somewhere within the Unknown Regions. In the world's lush jungle lived a rare subsentient species of insectoids that shared their name with their homeworld.

The Borkeen Belt, also known as the Borkeen asteroid belt, was a dangerous asteroid belt situated in the Outer Rim Territories' Belsmuth sector. It was home to an eighty-meter-long exogorth that was discovered by 22 BBY by scientists from the University of Sanbra.
The Obana Belt, also known as Rycar's Run, was a field of asteroids in the Arkanis sector near Tatooine. It was the site of small amounts of mining and pirate activity.

Yirt-4138-Grek-12 was a Colonies asteroid located in the Fakir sector. It was the site of a pressurized compound where slicers were outfitted with cybernetic implants and trained in industrial espionage targeting the Corporate Alliance.
A3 was an asteroid in the Halmad system. It was the location of Tonheld Mining Corporation's abandoned Site A3, which Wraith Squadron took over to use as Hawk-bat Base in 7.5 ABY.
The Vahaba asteroids were in the Quelii sector, near Halmad, along the Outer Rim of the galaxy. They were home to ore miners and skilled metal fabricators, who once had trade ties with Alderaan.

Dantooine's Second Star was a planetoid nestled within the Dantooine system's Ferionic Nebula. Somewhat round in appearance, the iron asteroid was actually designated a planetoid, and was under the control of a little known, small band of thugs called the Velocity Mercenaries.
Slayn was a Verpine colony city located in the Roche system. Along with Korpil, Slayn co-created the A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Korpil was one of the largest and oldest colonies of the Verpine species. Along with Slayn, they created the A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Shantipole was a remote planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim that was renowned for having a violent atmosphere and being a one-way trip for pilots. It was home to the Mon Calamari Quarrie, who designed a prototype for the B-wing starfighter.

Bilbringi was a world located in the Inner Rim Territories. It was home to the Bilbringi shipyards, a facility which dismantled the Separatist dreadnought Lucid Voice within a year after the end of the Clone Wars.

24 Tredway was an asteroid in the Sil'Lume asteroid belt of the Sil'Lume system, owned by Axton Tredway. Axton was slain by Darth Vader during the Great Jedi Purge on this asteroid. Imperial Governor Sebastian Parnell later destroyed the asteroid.
The Miro asteroid field was where the Stellar Damsel ship once hid to escape Imperial pursuit until its crew could be rescued. The field was infested with mynocks.

The Korteen asteroid belt was an asteroid belt located in the Korteen system, within the Kibilini sector of the galaxy's Territories. A ring of planetary wreckage, it was governed by Quarg's father during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Oseon 5631 was an asteroid located in the Centrality's Oseon system. The renowned singer Ema Slake maintained an estate, the most luxurious of the Oseon system asteroid habitats by 27 ABY, on Oseon 5631.
Oseon 8920 was an asteroid located in the Centrality's Oseon system. It was home to a criminal environment that made it resemble a miniature version of the infamous shadowport moon Nar Shaddaa.
Avon was a planet in the same system as Radnor. Its inhabitants were the Avoni. Avon was, for the most part, distrusted by the Radnorans.
Deeb was one of the four moons of Ambria.
Toprel was one of the four moons of Ambria.
Voth was one of the four moons of Ambria.
Mim was one of the two moons of Ossus. It was rocky and airless. Jedi occasionally used it for training in low-gravity environments.
Nerit was one of the two moons of Ossus. It was temperate, with a varied ecosystem and gravity 125 percent of the standard. A clan of expatriate Neti lived there.

result: Decisive Confederacy of Independent Systems victory
x: The Battle of Duro was one of the many battles of Operation Durge's Lance, a Confederacy of Independent Systems campaign to spearhead into the Core, during the Clone Wars. It proved to be a major Confederate victory.
Aquilae was an ancient Duros colony planet located along the Hydian Way in the Colonies region.

Spiners were nearly-extinct bipedal sentient mammals with sharp quills. They were capable of hurling these with great speed and accuracy by flexing their muscles in a certain manner. Their native world, Worxer, was destroyed when its sun went supernova.
The sea-dragons or waterworms of Drexel were gigantic sentient reptiles who dwelt in the never-ending ocean of their world. They communicated with each other using ultrasonic signals.

Hutlarians were a sentient species of humanoids who possessed red eyes and orange skin. Native to the world of Hutlar, a small, dim and chilly planet located within the Mid Rim's Senex sector, Hutlarians had a reputation for being tough.
The Mandallian Giants were a race of large, heavily muscled humanoids who were bigger and bulkier than Wookiees.
The Merson asteroid belt was an asteroid belt, with a lot of minerals and metal veins, it was close to the planet Merson. It was located at the junction of several hyperroutes.
Shiva IV was a planet in Wild Space that was noted for its extremely remote location, far from the auspices of the Galactic Empire.

The Calians were the Human inhabitants of the planet Shiva IV, located in Wild Space. They were muscular beings, and the majority of them were strong and courageous. They were united into the Calian Confederacy and spoke Calian.

The T'Syriél were tall, muscular humanoids native to the planet Shiva IV. United into the Twelve Tribes of T'Syriél, the T'Syriél were ancient rivals of the Human Calian Confederacy, with which they warred for generations en route to building a strong and respected warrior tra…
The Peremptory was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Andrasta was a Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft owned and operated by Emon Azzameen.

The Selu was a YT-1300 light freighter owned by the Azzameen family. Along with its identical sister ship, the Sabra, it was utilized as a transport and freighter for family missions and assignments provided by Twin Suns Transport Services, a shipping company owned by the Azza…

The Siege of Coruscant was a major space battle in 9 ABY during the Thrawn campaign. Since his forces were outnumbered by the New Republic defenses of its capital Coruscant, Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn used cloaking technology to create an effective siege weapon.

Seoul 5 was a planet in Wild Space which was home to an ancient Human civilization in the Pre-Republic era. The Seoularians, as they were called, powered their cities with enormously powerful crystals that were kept in large supplies underground.

Skärtis, or Skartis, was a resort world located in the Senex sector that was maintained by House Araba. Its seven moons were famous for their complicated orbits. Seeing all seven in the sky at once was said to be a lucky omen.

The Maccabree were a sentient extra-galactic non-humanoid species native to a planet in the satellite galaxy Companion Besh. Physiologically, the Maccabree were tentacled cephalopods who were dependent on their planet's unique atmosphere to live.

The Hiromi were a bipedal, sentient, insectoid species. Despite a strong instinct for self-preservation and a large aversion to anything that could bring them harm, the Hiromi saw themselves as a glorious race of mighty warriors.
Yavin 7 was a moon of Yavin. It was one of four moons of the gas giant shown on the Death Star I's tactical map during the Battle of Yavin.

Transel was an obscure, backwater terrestrial planet located in the Transel system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. It was situated on the hyperlane known as the Shipwrights' Trace, which connected it to the Bassadro, Fondor, and Surric systems.
An arachnor was a giant arachnoid that resided on Arzid. Its web was one of the stickiest in the galaxy.
Cirus II was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was a mining world for syntonium. Lex was a mine operator there.
ZZ-4Z, also known as "ZeeZee," was a JV-Z1/D butler droid produced by Serv-O-Droid, Inc. in the centuries prior to the formation of the Galactic Empire.
Silencer-7 was a World Devastator serving the resurgent Galactic Empire of 10 ABY.
Barab II was the second planet in the Barab system. It was little more than a frozen ball of rock and ice.

Barab III was a planet in the Barab system. A gas giant composed of nitrogen, Barab III was the outermost planet in the system, which also contained the Barabel homeworld of Barab I. It was orbited by 34 moons.
Narvath was the Narvath homeworld. Many members of its local underground joined the Rebel Alliance. It was later a member world of the New Republic.
The First Battle of Tatooine was initiated by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Pirol-5 was a factory-farm planet taken over by the Yevetha during the Great Purge. Nil Spaar himself led the assault from the Pride of Yevetha.

Adriana was a gas giant located within the Tatoo system of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was orbited by several rings consisting of ice. That ice was often mined and transported to the nearby desert world Tatooine, for which it was the most important source of water.

Kojash was one of two mining colonies on the perimeter of the Koornacht Cluster, founded by the Morath. Along with the other settlement on Elcorth, it was conquered and depopulated by the Yevetha during the Great Purge.

Elcorth was one of two mining colonies founded by the Morath on the edge of the Koornacht Cluster closest to Coruscant. The other was Kojash. Both were overtaken by the Yevetha during the Great Purge.

XR808g, or the Exxer, was the smuggling vessel owned and operated by Jae Juun, a smuggler, and his Ewok copilot, Tarfang. It was a Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-1000. Its saucer-shaped hull had the cockpit directly on top with four blaster cannons arranged around it.
The Telos Security Force, often referred to as TSF, managed Telos's planetary security before the destruction of the planet's surface during the Jedi Civil War.
Nanna was a nanny droid with a feminine personality.

The Empire Reborn, also known as the Imperial Remnant (not to be confused with the mainline Imperial Remnant led by Gilad Pellaeon), was a remnant of the Galactic Empire led by the Dark Jedi Hethrir, the Imperial Procurator of Justice and a former student of the Sith Lord Dart…
Several Skyhooks could be seen on the planet from orbit. Visitors to the world were obliged to check their weapons during their stay.
Murninkam was a tropical world far from the space lanes. The Kajiin Swamp can be found there.
Nala tree frogs were native to Ylesia. They were instrumental in the death of Aruk the Hutt.

result: Smuggler Fleet/Drea Renthal's Fleet Victory (Imperial Defeat)
x: The Battle of Nar Shaddaa, also referred to as the Incident at Nar Shaddaa, was a conflict between an Imperial task force and a collection of smugglers and pirates attempting to defend their homes on Nar Shaddaa.
The Bria was a heavily modified SoroSuub StarMite light freighter.
Kuar was a Deep Core world of flat, rocky, dusty plains.
The Coruscant-class Heavy Courier was a model of starship manufactured by Corellia StarDrive. It was used by the Galactic Republic some four thousand years before the Battle of Yavin.
Obredaan was a planet in the Irishi sector of the Mid Rim and was known to have large deposits of cortosis ore, which made the mining industry the planet's main income source.
Storthus was a desolate planet in the Churba sector of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the giant stone eels, an indigenous species composed of living rock.

Tamban was an inhabited planet in Core Worlds. From Tamban, the Koornacht Cluster near the Deep Core could be observed through a telescope. It was ruled by Emperor Preedu III before Palpatine rose to power.

Pakrik Major was the sector capital of Kanchen sector. It was a Planet in the Pakrik system and was located in the Core Worlds region. It was more densely populated than its twin world, Pakrik Minor, and hosted the annual Kanchen Sector Conference.
Dorlon II was a barren planet near Carida. It was an extremely volcanic world covered in sulfur, ash, and lava. From space it had the look of a colorful mosaic of black, tan, yellow.
Magagran was an Imperial planet in the Halthor sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Draukyze was a planet in the Draukyze system of the Thanium sector.

Ket was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Ket system, a part of the Hapes Cluster in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was situated on the Lorell Route hyperlane, which linked it to the Daruvvia and Lovola systems.

Isen IV was an airless, rocky planetoid, one of five satellites of the proto–gas giant Isen in the Isen system of the Outer Rim. Its tunnels were inhabited by about 500 Humans and also by non-sapient morvak.
Sileron was the Derkolo homeworld in the Mektrun Cluster; it was the first planet in the Veron Minor system. It was very hostile and tourists were warned not to visit the planet.

Entymals were sentient insectoids from Endex, an Outer Rim world of many canyons. They had a hardened exoskeleton, with chitinous membranes that enabled them to glide. The species functioned as a hive, with one fertile queen, numerous infertile females, and rare male drones.
The Etti were a sentient species of near-Humans who were originally native to the Galactic Core.

Albecus was a planet in the Galactic Core friendly to the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic. It was situated close to the world Ralltiir. The planet saw the establishment of a Rebel Alliance safe-house after the Battle of Yavin.

Belshar Othacuu was a Mid Rim astronomical object located in the Belshar sector. During the Galactic Civil War, a covert installation of the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order was established there, with a convoy of military supplies scheduled t…
Bessimir was a planet in the Galactic Core, 15 parsecs from Coruscant. Two natural satellites orbited Bessimir.
Boden was a planet in the Boden system. Some time before 0 ABY, Leger DeMain once helped Airen Cracken escape capture during an Imperial occupation of the planet.
Clær was an astronomical object located in the Claer system, a part of the Sern sector in the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. It was the site of an exclusive preparatory academy.
Coriallis was a New Republic planet in the Core Worlds near Coruscant.
Gyosha was an Imperial resort world in the Galactic Core. Wilek Nereus had hoped to be appointed Governor of Gyosha, but got stuck on Bakura instead. OrulShai III was a moon of Gyosha.

Halpat was a planet in the Core Worlds, not far from the Koornacht Cluster. It was the New Republic supply depot for the New Republic Fifth Battle Group's blockade of the Cluster. Etahn A'baht did not consider it close enough to the Cluster.
Ord Sabaok was a Core Worlds planet. During the Pius Dea Era, it served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic.

OrulShai III was a moon of Gyosha in the Galactic Core. It supported Humans ruled by the Galactic Empire. Wilek Nereus was a native of the moon. Sena Pakkallo once treated him for a parasitic disorder on the moon.
Phracas was a planet located in sector 151 of the Core Worlds.

Sifuchi was a celestial body located in the Sifuchi system. It was a part of the Expansion Region's Lostar sector, being located both in the Outer Expansion Zone sub-region and the Northern Dependencies portion of that region.

Stassia was a planet located in the Core Worlds. Its inhabitants were very tolerant under any circumstances. During the Galactic Civil War, Stassia was ruled by the Galactic Empire under the governorship of Tren Pergallis.
Rove was a large barren rogue moon situated in the Inner Rim's Bramior system. Eons before the Galactic Civil War, it had been captured by the Bramior star.

Canastra IV was a Core Worlds celestial body with coastal oceans on its surface. It was home to the amphibian herbivore known as the two-headed tortuce. On Canastra IV, several varieties of the creature existed that led different lifestyles.
Harazod was the capital city of the planet Gerrard V. In 0 BBY, it was seized by local rebels commanded by General Camon Udeon.

Kailor V was a planet in the Kailor system of the Galactic Core. It was the location of the Imperial Zoological Gardens, the aquaria of which were maintained by the Sedrian Shahlik family. The Design Team Beta research facility of Hydrospeare Corporation was also on Kailor V.
Anchoron was planet in the Anchoron system of the Mayagil sector. The Human Anchoroni were known for their flowery speech, genteel decorum, and politeness.

Vagran was a planet located in the Corellian sector with different temperate zones all varying in temperature and precipitation. Its climates and its favorable sunlight enabled Vagran to support a great deal of life.
Nanta-Ri was a planet in the Farlax sector of the Core Worlds. The New Republic Fourth Battle Group was sent to blockade it during the Black Fleet Crisis.

Prildaz was the Yevethan name of the third planet in the ILC-905 system in the Farlax sector in the Galactic Core. It was a barren dustball orbited by the Imperial shipyard Black Nine. The New Republic defeated the Yevethan defense of Black Nine.
Utharis was a planet located within the Utharis system of the Core Worlds.
Dandalas was a planet located in the Farlax sector of the Core Worlds.
Kktkt was a planet in the Farlax sector in the Galactic Core.
Woqua was a planet located within the Woqua system of the Core Worlds.
Tizon was a planet located within the Tizon system of the Core Worlds and one of the original 13 planets of the Duskhan League.

Wakiza was a planet located within the Wakiza system of the Core Worlds of the galaxy. One of the original thirteen planets of the Duskhan League, it was located within the Koornacht Cluster. Wakiza was orbited by the Imperial Navy shipyard Black Eight.

Z'fell was a planet in the Z'fell system of the Koornacht Cluster. It was one of the original 13 planets of the Duskhan League. The planet was attacked by the New Republic during the Battle of N'zoth.
Zhina was one of the original 13 planets of the Duskhan League. It was orbited by the Imperial shipyard Black Eleven.

Doornik-207 was a planet located witnin the Koornacht Cluster in the Core Worlds. The planet was colonized by the Corasgh, settled under the Galactic Empire. However, it was wiped out by the Yevetha during the Great Purge, whereupon the Yevetha colonized the world.

Kutag, also known as Doornik-881, was an Imperial factory farm world that was maintained by droids. It was in the Doornik-881 system in the Koornacht Cluster. Its inhabitants were killed in the Great Purge by the Yevetha, who took over the planet.

Aikhibba was a Mid Rim planet located in the Fei Hu sector. Situated on the Gamor Run hyperspace route, it had become a part of the Galactic Republic by 17,000 BBY, and around that time, it was also a part of the Exploitation Region that was controlled by the Core Worlds–based…
Joruna was a planet in the Farlax sector of the Core Worlds.
Venir was a planet located in the Kuat sector of the Core Worlds.
Praxlis was a planet within the area of space that the Galactic Empire assigned to Black Sword Command.

Lenniera was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Lenniera system. It was a part of the Arrowhead, or the Slice portion of the Core Worlds. It was the site of the estate of the centuries-old family of the Lennieran jatz musician Fitz Roi of the Colonies' Tapani sector.
Nopces Prime was a planet in the Nopces system on the edge of the Bormea sector, near the Hydian Way.

Havricus was a world located in the Havricus system of the Colonies. It was situated on the super-hyperroute known as the Corellian Run, which served as the dividing line between the regions known as the Slice and the Southern Core and linked it to the Pencael system as well a…

The Outer Rim Territories celestial body Karavis was a major industrial site for the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Rebel Alliance General Crix Madine identified it as a possible target in the event that the Alliance campaign Operation Ringbreaker was successful.
Kluistar was a planet on the border of the Colonies region, and was considered a comfortable if undistinguished world.

Reopi was a Core Worlds desert world. It featured the vast equatorial area known as the Red Reopi Deserts. There, magus creatures fed on insects and reptiles and was in turn preyed upon by the Reopi sand crushers.
The Versieds were asteroids in the Pyria system.
An astronomical object was the fourth moon of Pyria VI.
Jagga VII was a planet located within the Venjagga system of the Colonies.
Alabash was a planet on the edge of the Fakir sector. Located in the Alabash system, it was a volcanic planet.
Lorimax was a planet in the Fakir sector's Lorimax system. It was noted for growing grain.

Flankers was a remote planet in Fakir sector in the Colonies. Its star went supernova shortly after the Battle of Yavin, destroying the entire system. Just prior to the explosion, the Imperial garrison on the planet was abandoned.

Sinkar was a planet in the Lawreys system in the Fakir sector. It was a cold and inhospitable world with heavy gravity, and the oxygen supply was frozen on the surface. Extremely hostile to life, it was nonetheless the homeworld of the Sinkar.
The Sarnikken Asteroid Belt was a group of asteroids in the Fakir sector. Its asteroids contained a wealth of heavy metals, and mining operations struggled for control of them.
The Mascot Moon of Carida had the Academy seal carved on it around 5000 BBY. In 8 BBY, as a prank, Mako Spince stole a gram of antimatter and tried to use it to blow the seal off of the moon.
