Ord Antalaha was a planet located along the Shwuy Exchange, in the Colonies region of the galaxy, that was colonized and established as an Ordnance/Regional Depot by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
AX-456 was an asteroid in the Barma sector.

Kiribi was a planet located in the Colonies. Its galactic coordinates were 099, 099, 011. Although it was located 5000 light-years away from Coruscant, because Kiribi's coordinates were positive and began with zero, it was part of the Imperial Center Oversector during the Impe…

affiliation: House Calispa, Tapani Empire, Tapani Federation
x: Coorimbus IV was a gas giant in the Coorimbus system in Tapani sector where House Calipsa secretly acquired corusca gems.

Nightsinger's Orb was the moon of Pella in Tapani sector. The moon was owned by the Hejaran family of House Mecetti. Hejaran Castle was located on the moon. The moon was named for the native nightsinger, a large bat-winged predator.

Pella was a planet in the Pella system in the Mecetti Province of the Tapani sector. It was probably named after the Pella Compact. The planet produced vast harvests of grain and vegetables each year and was an important agricultural producer of the sector.
Lammax was a shadowport planet in the Danju system in the Colonies, near a nebula that made travel to the planet dangerous.
Lamuir VII was a planet in the Lamuir system in Tapani sector.
Sheva was a planet in the Sheva system in Tapani sector. It was a backwater in the Freeworlds Territory. It had a liberal government that did little to threaten smugglers and other criminals.

Sorella was a planet in the Sorella system in Tapani sector. Sorella was also one of the Freeworlds Territory. Also, it was a member of the Three Ellas, with a liberal government looser about crime and smuggling than most Tapani worlds.

Dorella was a planet in the Dorella system in the Tapani sector. It was one of the Freeworlds Territory and one of the Three Ellas. It had a liberal government that was looser about crime and smuggling than most Tapani worlds.

Pernella was a planet in the Pernella system in Tapani sector. It was one of the Freeworlds. It was also one of the Three Ellas, with a liberal government looser about crime and smuggling than most Tapani worlds.

Wyloff was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Wyloff system, a part of the Wyloff sector in the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies. The capital city of Wyloff was surrounded by middle class suburbs.
Darepp was a planet located in the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. It was located near the Foless Crossroads.

Ebiwaan was an astronomical object located in the Sarin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the endpoint of the Leisure Corridor, a trade and tourism route that started at the planet Coruscant in the Core Worlds.

Ord Sigatt was an Outer Rim Territories mining planet in the Galactic Republic. The planet was originally settled by the Republic militia as an Ordnance/Regional Depot, but upon the discovery of carvanium by one of the settlers, it quickly evolved into a mining colony.
Rodaj was a planet in the Inner Rim located near Wroona.
Antar 5 was a moon of Antar colonized by the Gotal as a mining operation. Located in the Inner Rim, the moon was situated in the Prindaar system.
Calus was a planet in the Calus system of the Inner Rim, near Bestine IV. Sweet-sand cookies were made on Calus. It was located at the end of Keller's Void, opposite Wroona.
The Kanawyn Belt was the innermost of two asteroid belts in the Saurton system. The Kanawyns lay inside the orbit of Essowyn.
The Graewyn Belt was the outermost of two asteroid belts in the Saurton system. The belt lay outside the orbit of Essowyn.
Kalki's Braid was an asteroid belt in the Garqi system.
Jinathik was an asteroid belt in the Garqi system between the planets of Garqi and Elsho.
Fervse'dra was an asteroid belt in the Both system between the planets Taboth and Bothawui. The word translated to "clan of stones" in Bothan.
The Vandelhelm Cloud was a vast asteroid field that encompassed the Vandelhelm system in the Expansion Region's Epsi Collective.
The Jontan asteroid belt was an asteroid belt located in the Thanta Zilbra system.
The Chronos Belt was an asteroid belt that orbited the sun Velus. It was situated between the Velus system's second and third planets, Velusia and Velumia, respectively.
Godsspire was an asteroid belt in the Muunilinst system.
Lando's Folly, also known as the Dubrillion asteroid belt, was an asteroid belt in the Dubrillion system.
The Sweep was an asteroid belt located in the Utos system.
The Polith Belt was an asteroid belt orbiting the star Polith in the Polith system. Located between the planets Loxizhra and Thyferra, it held the third orbital position.
Clak'dor VI was an asteroid belt in the Colu system, possibly the remains of a destroyed planet.
The Belk was an asteroid field that was located within the Colavas system, in the Halla sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim.
The Arah asteroid belt, also known as the Belt of Arah, was an asteroid belt in the Dreighton Nebula of the Arah system, within the Dantus sector in the Outer Rim.
"Woern's Asteroid" was one of the largest asteroids in the Drup Asteroid Field, a part of the Drup's Star system in the Outer Rim Territories' Saijo sector.
Kamsul was one of seven inhabited worlds in the Stenness System.

Biivren was a planet located in the Expansion Region's Biivren sector. An industrial world controlled by the Galactic Empire, it was the site of a large zone of factories and refineries that gradually contaminated the planet's water supply.
Gruvia was a planet in the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Gruvian species, whom exported Gruvian Tovash. The planet was part of the Empire.
New Canistel was an inconsequential terrestrial planet located in the Demetras sector's New Canistel system, a part of the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Arrgaw was a major trade planet located in the Expansion Region's Kira sector. A world orbited by impressive trade rings and featuring vast expanses on its surface taken up by warehouses and other corporate structures, Arrgaw lay at the intersection of two important hyperlanes…
Brevost was a planet in the Brevost system of the Expansion Region. It was on the Harrin Trade Corridor between the Krann system and the Cerenia system.
Ruten was a planet in the Cerenia system of the Expansion Region. The New Republic liberated the planet from Imperial Governor Bursthed. The planet hosted the Ruten Pet Show.

Mayvitch 7 was a moon of Amador in the Chalenor system of the Expansion Region. It was colonized by Human colonists from Immalia who established a small outpost on it to protect their mining operations from pirate attacks.

Lohopa II was a mining colony in the Lohopa system of the Expansion Region, on the Harrin Trade Corridor. The local mining operations managed to resist Imperial takeover attempts. The planet developed a growing travel business due to its location on the Corridor.
Roldalna was a celestial body located in the Expansion Region's Kira sector. Shortly after the formation of the New Republic, it was the site of a cantina.
Terana was an asteroid belt that was located in the Vernet system, within the Expansion Region of the galaxy.

Yitheeth was an oceanic planet of the Yinchorri system. The Yinchorri built at least one city on its surface. In 33 BBY during the Yinchorri Uprising, it was the site of the Ambush on Yitheeth. Shallow seas covered 93% of its surface.
Emet was actually a captured rogue planetoid but was counted as the first orbiting body in the Genesia system. Its wandering orbit would eventually cause it to fall into the system's sun.

Brugga was an asteroid located in the Latoma system of the Brak sector. It orbited the system's red dwarf star at an extreme distance, making detection of the asteroid almost impossible for anyone who did not known exactly where to look.
Tel IV was a planet located in the Halthor sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Kira Prime was originally the name of the second planet in the Kira system. It was destroyed and became an asteroid belt.
The Tinnell were a felinoid species of sentients from the Mid Rim. While considered naïve, they were master mechanics with the skill to improvise repairs that made things work better than designed.
Angratha was a Mid Rim planet located in the Senex sector.
Ilimardon was a planet located in the Mid Rim's Nicandra sector. It was governed by the Regal Hierarchy, which maintained a wildlife division and a fleet of starships.
Kaliska was a planet in the Mid Rim. The Techno-priests of Kaliska developed the Visualization engine.

Lanthe was a planet in the Mid Rim's Var Hagen sector. It was the original headquarters of Lanthe Artifice, but when the local Imperial Moff nationalized all corporations, Lanthe Artifice relocated to the Tapani sector.
Maphus Tria was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories where the con artist Tord Gamb ran a con that netted him several hundred thousand credits.
Mengjini was a planet in the Bright Jewel sector of the Mid Rim.

Mowgle was a low-tech agriworld in the Core Worlds, one day and three hours from Demophon with a Class 1 hyperdrive. It was responsible for much of the consumables produced for Demophon during the Galactic Civil War.

Nar Bo Sholla was a Hutt Space world that was the homeworld of the poisonous spor crawler insect. It was a part of the Hutt Empire twenty-five millennia before the Battle of Yavin. In 25 BBY, the Human Morteos was born on Nar Bo Sholla.
Ord Klina was a world located in the Ord Klina system, a part of the Klina sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Sappire was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.
Uridia was one of the many lifeless moons which orbited the single gas giant in the Uridia system.

Wilpiet was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Wilpiet system, a part of the Cademimu sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance maintained a depot there.

Zuliria was a Mid Rim celestial body located in the Eucer sector. It featured several cities and was home to the flying creature known as the Ruori, which most Zulirian urban residents used for transportation.
PDC3141-02 was a Mid Rim planetoid located in the Trax sector. For centuries, the Trade Federation used it for dumping radioactive industrial waste.
The Lweilot Asteroid Belt orbited the white dwarf Bseto and stretched 90 million kilometers wide.
Elbara Nine was a Mid Rim world on the Cerean Reach of the galaxy. It was an icy world and home to the Rebel GlitterFall base. The planet was near a little-used Imperial Navy staging area.

Hallrin IV was an Expansion Region world in the Hallrin system. The Stratis Games, including the Multi-Sentient Unarmed Combat Rounds, were held on Hallrin IV. Clyngunn represented the ZeHethbra in these Rounds.

conflict: Clone Wars (Siskeen theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: A battle took place on the astronomical object Tellanroaeg by the final year of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic's clone troopers and the forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Kalinda Asteroid Belt was an Mid Rim asteroid belt in the Kalinda system.
Ksiczzic III was a Mid Rim world in the Ksiczzic system.

Mon Torri was a snowy, mountainous and glacier-covered world that was located within the Mid Rim of the galaxy. Situated between Ord Mantell and Tatooine, it was surrounded by seven rings, each of them a different color and composition.
Zirku was a Mid Rim world in the Riflorii system.

Tomark II, also known as Tomark, was a Mid Rim world located in the Ividal sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it was the site of the Rebel Alliance starfighter base known as Chiron Base, from which attacks on Galactic Empire convoys were carried out.
Tshindral III was a Mid Rim planetoid near the Outer Rim with a scant, toxic atmosphere which could corrode a freighter's hulls in less than a local day. It was orbited by Starlyte Station.

Venaari was a Mid Rim world, and the third planet in the Vellakiya system. It was the headquarters of Venaari Enterprises. The Galactic Empire increased its presence on the planet following the Battle of Endor due to Project Orrad, which was exposed by Shandria L'hnnar.
Rrulinn was a Mid Rim world in the Yushan sector. Its population fell victim to the Reslian Purge, much as did the Tunroth.
Quaensan Prime was a Gendius sector, Mid Rim world on the Cerean Reach, near the Jiroch system. Its inhabitants were wiped out by the Reslian Purge, similar to what happened to the Tunroth.

Orflon was a frozen, uncharted asteroid located near the Demophon system. It was the location of Asteroid Base, the only permanent Alliance to Restore the Republic base near Demophon during the Galactic Civil War. It was so remote that it was not even inhabited by mynocks.
Refgar was a planet located within the Refgar system of the Core Worlds.
Uba V was a planet located within the Uba system of the Mid Rim. It was a home to an Ubese colony, which was destroyed by the Jedi in the Battle of Uba IV during the New Sith Wars.

Hefi was a planet located in the Hefi system of the Abrion sector, within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Covered by landmasses and oceans, Hefi's surface featured varied climates and was capable of supporting various forms of humanoid life.
Hishyim was a planet covered by a vast desert, located in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Ord Segra was a Galactic Republic world in the Mid Rim's Ord Segra system.

Geridard was a Mid Rim world in the Geridard system of Doldur sector. It was known for its retirement and medical facilities, catering to renowned corporate officials. Augusta I'att was to enter the Geridard Convalescent Center, though she was executed before ever attending.
Ank Kit'aar was a celestial body located in the Ank Kit'aar system, a part of the Druess sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim.
F'Dann IX was a celestial body located in the F'Dann system, a part of the Dufilvian sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim.

Keltos IV was a Mid Rim astronomical object situated in the Irnaj sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it was the site of a military shipyard of the Galactic Empire. Additionally, Imperial Intelligence Sector Plexus facilities were located in the celestial body's orbit.
Trieron was a Mid Rim world and the third planet in the Veron Minor system. It was a research planet covered in cool oceans and glacial continents.

Fitca Prime was a terrestrial planet that was the primary world of the Fitca system, a part of Urce Space in the Lesser Plooriod Cluster, which was in turn situated in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim.
The Jin were sapients native to the Zchtek worlds of the Mid Rim. Rebel Alliance officer Dutra Zeneta was a Jin.

Yetoom Na Uun was a planet located within the Yetoom system of the Senex sector. Positioned at the sector's edge, Yetoom was a shadowport controlled by gangs of Senex-Juvex slave species, and was the headquarters of Fargednim P'taan.
Nyrvona was a planet in the Cha Raaba system of the Hutt Space. Like Ylesia, the Besadii kajidic used it as a quasi-religious spice-processing colony.
Hollast VII, or Hollast Seven, also known as Hollastin Seven, was a planet in Hutt Space.
Tas-La was a world in the Si'Klaata Cluster of Hutt Space.
Kuras IV was the fourth and outermost planet in the Kuras system of the Elrood sector. Kuras IV was a frigid, rocky wasteland.

Meris VI was the outermost planet in the Meris system in Elrood sector. It was a frigid planet swept by constant ice storms. Meris VI had a breathable type II atmosphere in warmer seasons; in winter, the air was too cold to be safe without a heating mask filter.

Javis-12 was the only asteroid in the Mestra system with any sort of landing beacon or spaceport. Javis-12 also had the only ship repair and refuel services available in the system (for which the charge was an even 200 percent of list price).
Shesharile 5 was one of the moons orbiting a gas giant in the Shesharile system, located in the Minos Cluster. It was the only populated moon of the system alongside Shesharile 6.
Shesharile 6 was one of the moons orbiting a gas giant in the Shesharile system, located in the Minos Cluster. It was the only populated moon of the system alongside Shesharile 5.
The Ebruchi were a sentient race native to the Unknown Regions. They were humanoids with creamy white skin and mouths that were surrounded by worm-shaped tentacles.
Tchuukthai, also called Wharls, were sapient ceratopsian quadrupeds from the Unknown Regions.
Morcanth was an Unknown Regions planet the galactic neighborhood of which was the subject of a centuries-long war between three spacefaring alien species.
UR41-284 was a planet located within the UR41-284 system of the Unknown Regions.
Tililix was a planet in the Til system of the Unknown Regions which orbited the star Til. It was the Tarro homeworld before it was destroyed when Til went supernova.
Crustai was the second planet of the Crustai system in the Unknown Regions. It was part of the Chiss Ascendancy.

The Barri were semi-sentient beings native to an unnamed planet in Wild Space. They were enigmatic space-faring creatures that could hitch rides on asteroids and derelict spacecraft for thousands of years in space.
Apliria was a Rebel safe world in Wild Space. Lieutenant Deeve conducted much of the preliminary scouting on the planet during the course of the Galactic Civil War.

Tholon was a Wild Space planet located within the star system of the same name. A desolate rock world with rich deposits of various ores, it was the first planet discovered by the Human scout Casti Tholon by 2 ABY.
Valc VII was a planet located in the Perinn sector of the Outer Rim Territories near the Unknown Regions.
The Zossi Belt was an asteroid belt located in the Faarlsun system, a part of the Parthovian Cluster in Wild Space. It occupied the second orbit around its star, the yellow-white Faarlsun.

The Woodoos were an initiate training clan of the New Jedi Order that was usually made up of children between the ages of five and seven depending on species. This clan was named after the Woodoo, a creature native to Tatooine.

The Bartokk were a species of clawed, sentient insectoids hailing from a nameless planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Controlled by a hive-mind, the Bartokk were barely sentient individually but highly intelligent when in groups.
Nalrithians were a very muscular species of sentient insectoids native to the Outer Rim Territories.
The Nami were a group of nomadic warriors who became pirates in the Outer Rim Territories after the Clone Wars.

The "Tripods," as they were dubbed by Luke Skywalker, were a sentient species of three-legged, triocular beings with sac-like bodies. They had long yellow fur around their hips and tentacles, as well as shadings of pink and turquoise.
Anemcoro was a colony world located in the Anemcoro system of the Outer Rim Territories' Albarrio sector.
Ank Ki'Shor was a manufacturing world located in the Ank Ki'Shor system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Indrexu sector.

Beta Olikark was a planet in the Outer Rim, at the tip of a galactic arm on the other side of the galaxy from the Rayter sector. Its natural stones had intricate patterns and were exported to other worlds for flooring.

Biewa was an industrial planet in the Corporate Sector used as the headquarters of the Corporate Sector Authority Picket Fleet. It was a relatively poor world, and the Biewans spent what few credits they had on clothing, shelter and food.
Branteez was a terrestrial world located in the Branteez system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tolonda sector.
Brintooin was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Seswenna sector. The planet's terrain included plains, marshes, and deserts, as well as scrub and woodlands.
Caursito was a planet in the Colonies that Lieutenant Mavron stopped at to pick up a copy of the TriNebulon News on his way back to the Star Destroyer Chimaera during the Caamas Document Crisis.

Coveway was a harsh Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Koradin sector. Colonized by the time of the reign of the Galactic Empire, it eventually became home to the Human Jak Bremen, who eventually became a constable of the village he resided in and started a family.
Di'wor was a planet that was located in Di'wor system, in the Morshdine sector of the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. The planet's singfruit groves' pollination season attracted many tourists.
Duunir was a celestial body located in the Duunir system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Kibilini sector.
Edonaaris was an obscure planet of swampy jungles in the Outer Rim. The Malka'an Eternal crashed on Edonaaris.

affiliation: The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers
x: Epsi Nadir was an Expansion Region planet located in the Epsi Collective sector. It was purchased by the arms dealer group known as the Most Honourable Guild of Armourers, which established an auction house there.

Gonmore was a Mid Rim planet located in the Irishi sector and on the Entralla Route hyperlane. At one point a part of the New Republic, by 22 ABY it hosted a sector clearinghouse for the smuggling organization led by Talon Karrde.
Haffrin was a planet in the Haffrin system of the Esstran sector in the Outer Rim. Built millennia ago, a Shrine of Kooroo was fabricated on the planet using native stone.

Harloen was a planet located in the Harloen system of the Outer Rim Territories' Belsmuth sector. It was situated on the Hydian Way super-hyperroute, which served as the dividing line between the New Territories and the Trans-Hydian region and which connected it to the Botajef…
Heffrin was a planet located in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim. This mountainous world was a small mining colony maintained by the Galactic Empire.

Hijarna was a planet that was located near or in Orus sector, within the Inner Rim of the galaxy. The planet was once part of the Rakatan Infinite Empire, and was discovered by the Fifth Alderaanian Expedition, which also discovered the one thousand-year old remains of an anci…
Horska was a planet in the Colonies. It was location of an Imperial Remnant HoloNet relay station.

Iyred was a world located in the Iyred system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Kibilini sector. At one point, its surface was covered with tropical and temperate forests. That habitat was home to the Black Bha'lir, a species of large feline predators.
The Bloodstar was a massive warship used by Bar-Kooda during his reign of terror as a pirate.
Mindabaal was a planet located in the Inner Rim of the galaxy.
Mirshilan was a planet within the Mirshilan system in the Outer Rim, near to Nishr.
Neary was a celestial body located in the Neary system, a part of the Calaron sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Oorn Tchis was an Outer Rim planet near Agamar. It was a small, Human-inhabited rural world best known for exporting colorful fabrics and a rare ore used in guidance system design.
Ord Namurt was an Outer Rim planet in the Galactic Republic, and the site of an Ordnance/Regional Depot. An'ya Kuro, known as the Dark Woman, had a training ground for Jedi students on the planet.
Pallaxides was a planet of the Ojoster sector in the Outer Rim. It was owned by TaggeCo, who used it as a resort world.

Pesitiin was an Expansion Region gas giant in the Pesitiin system with perpetual atmospheric storms. Several years before 400 BBY its upper atmosphere housed a Bosken & Bosken mining center which attempted to harvest the planet's gases for profit, but it proved to be an unsust…
Phoebus was an Outer Rim planet near Elerion.
Saarn was an isolated and hidden Outer Rim Territories planet with vast, green grasslands.
Sabrix was an Outer Rim planet. A mining operation led by Denedin extracted radioactive elements from the planet to fund the Sabrin Ring.

Shallow March was an Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Mortex sector. It hosted the Shallow March Supply Post of the Galactic Empire, with the facility being under the command of Major Tarn Innis beginning around 4 BBY.
Shiffrin was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Tammuz sector. Constable Kallin Bremen maintained law and order in a small village there.
Sufezz was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It had a Shrine of Kooroo.

Tebru was a rocky planet that was located within the Tebru system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Juris sector. By the year 3 ABY, the droid inventor and historian Toria Tell maintained a large residence with a workshop and a massive library on the planet.

Tramanos was a watery moon located within the Tramanos system of the Spumani sector. Due to the large percentage of cyanogen in the moon's atmosphere, it was the site of a Celegian colony during the Republic Dark Age.
Trassitan was an astronomical object located in the Trassitan system, a part of the Veragi sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Vengler was a planet located within the Vengler system in Wild Space. Imperial scouts discovered it a few years before 7 ABY. It had a very primitive spaceport in which there was Varno Market, the principal point of interest of the planet.

Vorusku was a waterworld located within the Outer Rim Territories' Juris sector. It was the site of a volcano city as well as a floating bar named the Hyperdrive Cantina. The Kaminoan Jedi Kina Ha once lived on Vorusku.

Dakuyl was a planet located within the Verkuyl system of the Outer Rim Territories where alazhi was grown. It was in the same system as Verkuyl and a secondary bacta production was begun on the planet, but halted after the Battle of Endor.
Verkuyl was a planet located within the Verkuyl system of the Outer Rim Territories where alazhi was grown.
Antmuel VI was a world that occupied the sixth orbital position within the Antmuel system, a part of the Chopani sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Besberra was an astronomical object located in the Besberra system in the Cegul sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It hosted a gladiatorial arena where the Houk gladiator Torog fought to the death.

Camden was a terrestrial planet located in the Camden system, a part of the Morshdine sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A hyperlane connected it to the Edusa and Vandyne systems.

Dalastine IV, also known simply as Dalastine, was a gloomy planetoid located in the Dalastine system of the Inner Rim. The Alliance to Restore the Republic maintained a starfighter base on Dalastine IV which operated Skipray blastboats.
Delassin VI was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Calaron sector. It had oceans on its surface, and primitive seagoing vessels plied the waters of the planet's Diniz and Zehr Seas.
Domgrin was a planet that was located within the Domgrin system, a part of the Prefsbelt sector in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was located relatively close to the planet Gonmore.

Soullex was a planet in the Fardon system in Wild Space of the galaxy. After the Battle of Tantive V, it was garrisoned as the headquarters of Fleet Admiral Gaen Drommel. Drommel was betrayed and killed by Colonel Niovi, who surrendered the Guardian to the New Republic.
The Kauron asteroid field was an Outer Rim asteroid belt in the Kauron system. One of the asteroid contained a Cavrilhu Pirates's base.
Kheedar was an Outer Rim Territories planet in the Kheedar system. It had hydrocarbon processing facilities.

The Lenico Belt was an asteroid belt that was located within the Lenico system on the Outer Rim of the galaxy. The field contained the hidden Cairn Installation, which played host to an Imperial Remnant operation that was active during the Empire Reborn campaign.
Lyran IV was an Outer Rim Territories farming planet located in the Quiberon sector. It was home to the parasites known as Lyran bloodslugs.
Mepha'as Prime was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Mepha'as Prime system, a part of the Belsmuth sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Argoon was an Outer Rim planet in the Argoon system, near Pakuuni. It was the site of an Imperial manufacturing facility abandoned after numerous Rebel attacks.

Rimma 18 was a hyperspace exit point located within the Eriadu system, a part of Seswenna sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It shared its name with the Rimma Trade Route.

Serias was a planet located within the Serianan system in the Wild Space region of the galaxy. The lone inhabited world in the star system, Serias was theorized by the New Republic Scout Service captain Korren Starchaser to be the home of a sentient humanoid species.
Bordal was an Outer Rim planet in the Taroon system. It was one of two habitable planets in the system, and its primary inhabitants were Humans.

Kabaira was an Imperial Outer Rim Territories planet in the Teilcam system with damp, foggy weather. Its vast oceans were interrupted by some 2 million volcanic islands, of which only a few in the southern hemisphere were active during the Galactic Civil War.
Vessar Asteroid Field was an asteroid field located within the Telanka system of the Outer Rim Territories that included Buula's Rocky Home.
Cadezia was an Outer Rim planet in the same system as Trulalis and Issor. It was a prosperous technology and business world.
Y'Trella was a planet located within the Y'Trella system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Ongella was an Inner Rim planet of the Galactic Empire.

Hargeeva was an Expansion Region world, the third of five planets in the Pelonat system located near Garen IV. Its local day was 23 standard hours long, while its year was 380 local days long. It was colonized in 2000 BBY, but was neglected.
Vuchelle was an orange-colored astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories' Atrivis sector.

Repea was an Outer Rim planet near the Cron Drift in the Auril sector. The planet was protected by the Crimson Aces until politicians on the planet feared the squadron might turn on them. The politicians sought aid from the Galactic Empire in razing the Aces' planet-side base.
Marquarra was an Outer Rim planet with a weapons cache of the Ubiqtorate. It was allied with the Imperial Remnant.
Ompersan was an Outer Rim planet located within Imperial Remnant space. It was the site of the Imperial Navy fleet records center.
Parshoone was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, controlled by the Imperial Remnant. It was an Ubiqtorate contact station.
Glade was a planet in the Gordian Reach. It was a polluted industrial world plagued by acidic rains that rusted machinery within weeks.

Pinoora was a planet located into the Pinoora system of the Gordian Reach sector between Torque and Selitan. It was located at the junction of the Pinooran Spur and the Junction-Tierell Loop just north of the Denarii Nebula.

Gettiarn was the ninth planet in the Iotran system. The Gettiarn Space Station orbited the planet and was operated by the Iotran Police Force. It served as the hub of space traffic control for the entire system.
The Emmer system contained an asteroid belt. It was extensively mined using Plasma-Jet Mole Miners and ore haulers. Thirty thousand individuals lived and worked in the belt.
Gandrossi VI was a planet in the Gandrossi system in Perinn sector in the Outer Rim. It was under the authority of Imperial Governor Desh.
Novor 33 was an uninhabitable Outer Rim planet in the Novor system that orbited further from the system's star, Novor Major, than any of the other thirty-two planets there.
Torega was the moon of Topa in the Sespe system. It was the location of White Ledge, a hideout for spacers on the run. Torega was infested with wrix.
Topa was a mineral-poor planet in the Sespe system of the Periphery, orbited by Torega. Shadowports on Topa served local pirate groups.

Yen-2 was an asteroid/planetoid in the Verde system of the Periphery. It was an independently-owned Doonium mining colony. It was serviced by Jatayus Outbound for within-region transport and Xizor Transport Systems for out-of-region transport.
The Battlemoon was an airless moon orbiting Varn, which was converted to house a superlaser dish.

Tertiary Kesmere was a cloudy, storm-wracked world located in the Tertiary Kesmere system, a part of the Raioballo sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the winged hornagaunt species, including the wing-clipped pet Grendel.
The Ashes of Korr were a debris belt at the edge of the Horuset system.
Korriba Scar was a debris belt orbiting in front of Korriban in the Horuset system.
Obica was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Grumani sector. The holy world of the Spumani religion, it was the site of regular pilgrimages and even more frequent wars.
Mumunubb was an planet which orbited the star Sullust in the Sullust system. Located in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it shared the fifth orbit with Munumubb.
Munumubb was an planet which orbited the star Sullust in the Sullust system. Located in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it shared the fifth orbit with Mumunubb.

Qetix IV was a moon in the Dresscol system of the Trax sector. The Alliance to Restore the Republic turned it into a major starfighter repair base. Most capital ships were repaired in the nearby Ventil system.

region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
sector: Zuma sector; Moddell sector; Inner Moddell systems
x: Ovise V was a planet in the Ovise system of the Moddell sector. A gas giant and a known source of tibanna gas, Ovise V was orbited by several inhabited moons, including Midakos and Midakinos.
The Vex Asteroid Belt, also known as the Belt, was a part of the Vex system of the Outer Rim Territories' Moddell sector.
Murk was a planetoid located in the Murk system of the Outer Rim Territories' Moddell subsector. It was an airless, barren rock with low gravity.
Roonadan was the fourth planet in the Corporate Sector's Bonadan system. On Roonadan, passengers could board the Lady of Mindor.
Kail was a planet in the Corporate Sector. Torm Dadeferron, an associate of Han Solo, had family on Kail who controlled several large tracts of land known as the Kail Ranges.
Kir was a planet that was located within the Corporate Sector. A mineral found on this planet was used in the production of crystalline vertex.
Knolstee was a near-virgin planet in the Corporate Sector owned by Park Holdings Inc. Park Holdings used the planet as a layover for traveling tourists.
Gaurick was a planet in the Corporate Sector. It was controlled by a religious cult, with leaders known as muftis, with the cult being known as the Renouncers.
Rampa III, commonly known as Rampa, was a heavily industrialized planet in the Corporate Sector, which had a landscape so barren and polluted that drinkable water was an extremely precious resource.

New Ralltiir was a planet on which Han Solo, Leia Organa Solo, and Chewbacca rested after the first defeat of the clone of Palpatine. While there, Voren Na'al interviewed Han about his exploits in the Corporate Sector years before.

R'alla was a planet in the Corporate Sector, located on the Solenbaran Merchant Route between Bonadan and Kir. R'alla was home to many of the Corporate Sector Authority's top media companies, and its lush, green landscape had many farms and bubbling water springs.
Reltooine was a gas giant in the Tingel Arm. It was a part of the Corporate Sector and a member world of the Corporate Sector Authority.

Ulicia was an industrial planet located in the Ulicia system of the Outer Rim Territories' Corporate Sector, which was governed by the Corporate Sector Authority. It was positioned along the hyperlane known as the Shaltin Tunnels.
Abo Dreth was a planet in the Corporate Sector, thriving with lakes and rivers but with a nitrogen-based atmosphere.
Drog II was a Human-inhabited planet in Corporate Sector's Drog system.
Brochiib was a Trianii colony planet in Trianii Space. Trianii Rangers Atuarre and Keeheen stopped thionarx dealers on the planet.
Pypin was one of the Trianii colony worlds within the disputed border of the Corporate Sector.
Ekibo was a Trianii colony planet in Trianii Space, famous for its farms and herdbeasts. Trianii Rangers Atuarre and Keeheen were responsible for overthrowing a herdbeast-rustling ring there.
Fibuli was a planet in Trianii Space annexed by the Corporate Sector Authority.
Tol was a barren, rocky planet, third in the Dostra system in Corporate Sector. It had no moons.
Mos was a planet, first in the Dostra system in Corporate Sector. It was a searing rock with no moons.
Matra VI was a relatively isolated planet located in the Corporate Sector. It was a successful industrial world, and was populated largely by non-Human species.
Colsa was a barren, rocky planet, second in the Dostra system in Corporate Sector. It had one moon.

Mall'ordian was a planet in the Corporate Sector. A popular tourist destination, it was renown for its crystalline forests. The Corporate Sector Authority was interested in the planet for its potential resources.
Beneris was a planet in the Atrig system. It was a barren rock incapable of supporting life.
Altrax was a frozen planet, and the eighth planet in the Atrig system. It was incapable of supporting life.
Lynaria was a planet in the Atrig system. It was a frozen rock incapable of supporting life.
Tollero was the second planet in the Atrig system. It was a searing rock incapable of supporting life.

Abatrang was a planet occupying the seventh orbital position around the star Atrig in the Atrig system, which was part of the Inner Rim. It was an uninhabitable gas giant with eighteen moons and had an ammonia atmosphere.
Torvik was the fourth planet in the Atrig system. A swampy planet, it was orbited by one moon and was capable of sustaining life.
Amrap was a planet in the Atrig system. It was a desert planet but was capable of supporting life.

The innermost world of the Cularin system, Acilaris was barely large enough to be considered a planetoid. Nevertheless, it had enough gravity to hold an atmosphere, albeit one which was laden with sulfur, carbon, and boron.

Alkur was the first planet in the Lazerian system. It was located within the Kira sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. Regarded as useless, the planet was a searing hot and desolate rocky world, and it had no moons.

Kelro was the second planet in the Lazerian system. Located within the Kira sector, in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region, it was found along the trade routes known as the Harrin Trade Corridor and Kira Run.

Acorvus, also known as Lazerian III, was the third planet in the Lazerian system, orbiting the yellow star Lazerian. It was located within the Kira sector, in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region.

Dborian, also known as Lazerian V, was the fifth planet in the Lazerian system, orbiting the yellow star Lazerian. It was located within the Kira sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region.

Lazerian VI was the sixth planet in the Lazerian system, in orbit around the yellow star named Lazerian. The planet was a gas giant and had eight moons. It was located within the Kira sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region.

Lazerian VII was the seventh planet in the Lazerian system. It was located within the Kira sector, in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. The planet was a gas giant with ten moons, and orbited the yellow star known as Lazerian.
Lazerian IX was a planet that occupied the ninth orbital position in the Lazerian system. It was located within the Kira sector, in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region.

The Rokwahl Asteroid Belt was located in the Lazerian system, occupying its eighth orbital position. The asteroid belt was located within the Kira sector, in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region.

Adega was a planet located in the Auril sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the source of the earliest lightsaber crystals, known as Adegan crystals, and was also home to venomous creatures known as Adegan eels.
Devato was the first planet in the Lianna system.
Geminor was the second planet in the Lianna system. Its atmosphere consisted of a hot, dense poisonous gas and the planet was orbited by one single moon.
Indinor, a rocky wasteland, was the fifth planet in the Lianna system. It was orbited by two moons.
Adinai was a gas giant in the Lianna system, surrounded by eight moons.
Niddion was the seventh planet in the Lianna system.
AX-2 was the innermost planet in the AX system. It was moonless and barren. It orbited the system's dwarf star.
AX-3 was the middle planet in the AX system with 8 moons. It orbited the system's dwarf star.
AX-12 was the outermost planet in the AX system. It was a barren planet located in the Barma sector. It had two moons and orbited the system's dwarf star.

Tonder was the third planet in the Algaran system. It was a tectonically, seismically active world with incredible mining potential. It boasted one moon. The Algarian Bureau of Planetary Colonization and Bureau of Volcanoes disputed which bureau had jurisdiction over the planet.
Krizzin was a planet in the Algaran system. Remote probes had discovered the existence of underground mineral deposits on Krizzin.
Algara V was the fifth planet in the Algaran system. It was a gas giant with fourteen moons.
Algara VI was the sixth planet in the Algaran system. It was a frozen ice ball.
Auyemesh was one of three moons orbiting Almania in the Almanian system.

Andando was the innermost planet of the Ando system, a star system located within the Lambda sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim and the Slice region. Ando's sister planet, it orbited the star Ando and had no moons.
Bala, a ball of searing rock, was the innermost planet of the Aramand system. Despite its inhospitable environment, the Aramandi managed to establish a colony on the surface of the planet.

Mirani was the fourth planet in the Aramand system, located within the Expansion Region of the galaxy. It was a gas giant that was orbited by nineteen moons. The Aramandi species colonized some of them.
Polana was the third planet in the Aramand system. It was a gas giant. Its nine moons supported Aramandi colonies.

Namra was the second-largest gas giant of the system. A yellow and orange planet, Namra had ten moons, four of which were asteroids. The remaining moons were relatively the same size and composition, with thin atmospheres and a cratered coating of ice.

Savrant was the outermost planet of the Bacrana system, and the smallest of the system's gas giants. The green-yellow planet had six moons. All six were strip-mined by Lant Mining Corporation and subsequently abandoned.

Sinal was the innermost planet of the Bacrana system. An uninhabitable ball of searing hot rock, Sinal orbited close to the system's star, Bacrana. Starships approaching Sinal had to be heavily shielded, and could only remain for a short amount of time.

Calito was the third moon of Savrant in the Bacrana system. The moon was strip-mined by Lant Mining Corporation and then abandoned. During the Galactic Civil War it boasted a Bacrana System Defense Force surveillance post.
Bakura-7, also simply known as Planet 7, was the seventh planet of the Bakura system.
Bakura-8, also known simply as Planet 8, was the eighth planet of the Bakura system. It was an ice planet.
Ember was the first planet of the Belgaroth system, located in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. Illuminated by binary stars Matanya A and Matanya B, Ember was a searing world with no moons.
Ash was the second planet of the Belgaroth system, located in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. Illuminated by binary stars Matanya A and Matanya B, Ash was a searing world with no moons.

Flotsam was the third planet of the Belgaroth system, located in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. Illuminated by binary stars Matanya A and Matanya B, Flotsam was a barren world with no moons. An asteroid field of the star system lay before Flotsam.
Colossus was the fifth and outermost planet in the Belgaroth system in the Core Worlds. It was the only gas giant in the star system, and it was orbited by twenty-four moons.

Tregan was the first of Belgaroth's two moons in the Belgaroth system in the Core Worlds. Tregan, like the other moon, Tyrel, was used by the Galactic Empire as a testing facility for gunnery and for training maneuvers.

Tyrel was the first of Belgaroth's two moons in the Belgaroth system in the Core Worlds. Tyrel, like the other moon, Tregan, was used by the Galactic Empire as a testing facility for gunnery and for training maneuvers.
Chel was a terrestrial planet in the Deep Core's Beshqek system. It occupied the first orbital position around the star Beshqek, had a barren rock surface and no moons.

Polos was a terrestrial planet in the Deep Core's Beshqek system. It occupied the third orbital position around the star Beshqek and had one moon. Polos featured a rocky surface and a toxic environment.
Relus was the fourth planet of the Beshqek system, located within the Deep Core. It was one of two terrestrial planets in the system and was orbited by a single moon.
Kissarm was a gas giant in the Deep Core's Beshqek system. The planet was orbited by nine moons and occupied the sixth orbital position around the star Beshqek.

Houll was a terrestrial planet located in the Deep Core's Beshqek system before the planet Byss was destroyed. It occupied the seventh orbital position around the star Beshqek and had five moons. Houll featured a frigid climate and a rocky surface.

Pelutt was a terrestrial planet in the Beshqek system of the Deep Core. It occupied the eighth orbital position around the star Beshqek and had two moons. It featured a rocky surface and a frozen environment.
Drudonna was a moon covered in ice with a 2.5-kilometer diameter. It was one of the two largest moons orbiting the planet Bespin.
H'gaard was a moon of Bespin, one of "the Twins." It was covered in green ice.
Yeltha was a planet in the Both system with a surface of molten searing rock. It had no moons.
Taboth was the second planet in the Both system.
Golm, also known as Bothawui Prime, was a planet in the Both system. A purple gas giant, it was the fourth planet in the star system and was orbited by 23 moons, as well as an asteroid belt.
Ganash was a violet gas giant planet was the fifth world in the Both system, and was orbited by fourteen moons. It was named for a character in Bothan mythology.
Hoppawui was a barren planet in the Both system.
Jentawui was a frozen planet in the Both system.
Framesk Yagen was a planet in the Bovo Yagen system.
Heloan Yagen was a gas giant planet in the Bovo Yagen system. It was named after Bovo Yagen's wife.
Marenn Yagen was a planet in the Bovo Yagen system.

Trellar Yagen was a planet in the Bovo Yagen system. It was covered in jungles and had a hot climate. It hosted a wide range of flora and fauna, much of it carnivourous. The most famous predator on the planet was the trell.
Sollace was a planet in the Brentaal system. A searing rock, it was unable to support any life.
Gastol was a planet in the Brentaal system. It was a gas giant with three moons.
Gumbus was the fifth and largest planet in the Brentaal system. It was a gas giant orbited by sixteen moons.
Javaal was the seventh planet in the Brentaal system. It was an ice ball.
Bseto I was the first planet orbiting the white dwarf Bseto of the Mid Rim. It was a rocky, desert planet, and located in the Bseto system.
Indikir was an arid rock, the second planet orbiting the white dwarf Bseto.
Mol Luxu was the first planet orbiting the star Daca in the Calamari system. Located in the Calamari sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a rocky planetoid.

Mon Eron was the fifth planet in the Calamari system. It was settled by members of the Mon Calamari species around 4400 BBY. The colonists eventually terraformed the planet's oceans. It was orbited by two moons. and contained forests.

Sep Elopon held the sixth orbital position in the Calamari system. It was a gas giant with a beautiful system of rings and was also orbited by 32 moons. It was used as a Galactic Alliance staging area during the Defense of Mon Calamari.
Andra was a planet in the Carida system. Like all planets in the Carida system, Andra was destroyed when the Jedi apprentice Kyp Durron launched a missile from the Sun Crusher.
Bedara was a planet in the Carida system. Like all planets in the system, it was destroyed, when Jedi apprentice Kyp Durron unleashed the Sun Crusher there.
Orline was the third planet in the Carida system. It was a world composed of methane seas, and had one moon. Like all the planets in the Carida system, it was destroyed by the Sun Crusher.

Cari was a gas giant that was located within the Carida system in the Colonies region of the galaxy. Like all planets in the Carida system, it was destroyed by the renegade Jedi student Kyp Durron, who used a superweapon known as the Sun Crusher to cause its primary star to go…

Andinri was a gas giant in the Carida system, a star system in the Colonies region of the galaxy. Andinri was the sixth and farthest planet in the system from the star Caridan, and Andinri was orbited by twenty moons.
Carosi V was a planet in the Carosus system. It was considered a prime candidate for colonization, until it was destroyed in the expansion of the star Carosi into a red giant.

Carosi VI was a planet in the Carosus system. Originally the sixth orbit in the system, it became the first following the expansion of the star Carosi into a red giant and the subsequent destruction of system's first five planets.

Carosi VII was a planet in the Carosus system. Following the expansion of Carosi into a red giant, Carosi VII became a hot, swampy planet that was deemed suitable for colonization by the Carosites at a later date. It was orbited by a single moon.
Carosi VIII was a planet in the Carosus system. It was a hot, jungle planet deemed suitable for future Carosite colonization efforts. It had two moons.
Carosi IX was a planet in the Carosus system. It was a gas giant with six moons.
Carosi X was the tenth planet in the Carosus system of the Outer Rim Territories. Carosi X was a gas giant in orbit around the star Carosi. The planet had ten moons.
Carosi XI was a planet in the Carosus system. It was a gas giant with fifteen moons.
Filo was the innermost planet in the Centares system.
Ussuis was the second planet in the Centares system. It was covered in toxic oceans.
Qasqi was the fifth planet in the Centares system. Due to the fact that it was next to Centares, it absorbed most, if not all asteroids that strayed near Centares.

Nizon was the fifth planet in the Centares system. It was the homeworld of the Nazren species. Agents of Bail Organa provoked the local resistance to oust Imperial occupation and Trandoshan slavers some months after the end of the Clone Wars.
Ithoon was the sixth planet in the Centares system.
Far Qasqi was the eighth and outermost planet in the Centares system.

Expora was the first planet of the Chandrila system, located in the Bormea sector of the Ringali Shell in the Core Worlds. The planet orbited the star Chandrila and was composed of searing rock. Expora was the only one of the system's planets to have no moons.

Lorora was the third planet of the Chandrila system, located in the Bormea sector of the Ringali Shell in the Core Worlds. The planet orbited the star Chandrila and was composed of toxic rock. The world was itself orbited by a single moon.

Asimuse was the fifth planet of the Chandrila system, which was located in the Bormea sector of the Ringali Shell in the Core Worlds. One of three gas giants in the system, the planet orbited the star Chandrila and was itself circled by nine moons.

Quenus was the fourth planet of the Chandrila system, located in the Bormea sector of the Ringali Shell in the Core Worlds. A gas giant, the planet orbited the star Chandrila and was itself circled by three moons.

Dolucar was the sixth planet of the Chandrila system, located in the Bormea sector of the Ringali Shell region of the Core Worlds. Dolucar was a gas giant and orbited the star Chandrila. Twelve moons circled the planet, the most of any planet in the system.
Hurcha was the eighth planet from the single star of the Churba system. Because of its cold climate and distance from the sun, it was regarded as having no civilized purpose.
Simus Minor I was the innermost planet in the Simus Minor system.
Simus Minor 2 was the second planet in the Simus Minor system.
Lis was the innermost planet in the Cirius system. A molten, searing rock, it was uninhabitable.
Caamor was the third planet in the Cirius system. It was a frozen ball of rock, and was orbited by a single moon.
Sirilla was the fourth and outermost planet in the Cirius system. It was a gas giant orbited by 17 moons.
Colavas was a gas giant planet with sixteen moons, in the Colavas system.
Colavas Minor was a gas giant planet with eight moons, in the Colavas system.
Colavas Tertiary was a planet in the Colavas system. A gas giant orbited by nine moons, Colavas Tertiary was the fourth planet in the system.
Sajun was a frozen rocky planet with one moon, the outermost planet in the Colavas system.
Clak'dor I was originally the innermost planet in the Colu system of the Mayagil sector until it was consumed by Colu around 8000 BBY.
Clak'dor II was the second-innermost planet within the Colu system, on the Outer Rim of the galaxy. After the destruction of Clak'dor I, the world became the star system's innermost.
Clak'dor III was a planet in the Colu system.
Solag was a planet in the Corulus system.
Biolag was the second planet in the Corulus system. It was a gas giant orbited by seven moons.
Garulag was the third planet in the Corulus system. It was a gas giant orbited by 15 moons.

D'Skar was a planet located within the Coyn system of the Outer Rim Territories and a rocky wasteland. The name of the planet meant "dagger" in the language of the Coynites and lent its name to a weapon.
Sat'Skar was a planet located within the Coyn system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was considered a sister planet to Coyn itself. The name "Sat'Skar" meant "Sword" in the Coynite language.

Tro'Har was a planet located within the Coyn system of the Outer Rim Territories in the Elrood sector. Covered in methane ice, it boasted a navigation beacon to assist inbound traffic. The name "Tro'Har" meant "Farthest Blade" in the Coynite language.

Ba'Har was a planet located within the Coyn system of the Outer Rim Territories. The name "Ba'Har" meant "Battle Blade" in the Coynite language. Ba'Har was a multicolored gas giant with a small band of rings, the remains of a moon torn apart by gravitational stresses.

Rennokk was a moon of Cularin. It was a molten planetoid, its glow visible on Cularin. Reidi Artom's survey of the moon indicated there were minerals of interest in the lava of the planet, but nobody had attempted to reach those minerals by 31 BBY.

Ulbasca was a moon of Genarius. The celestial body occupied the primary orbit around the planet. Its orbit around its primary was such that Ulbasca was always situated in the light of the Cularin system's two suns.

Originally a habitable moon, Eskaron was perforated by long networks of tunnels created by space worms, which fed on a type of metal within the planet. The worms exposed Eskaron's molten core which expanded and destroyed the local atmosphere, killing several of the worms.

Ostfrei was a moon of Genarius. The moon was very dark, with its unique orbit keeping it in the shadow of Genarius most of the time. Its thick atmosphere prevented most of the light that the moon did receive from reaching down to the surface.
The Second Battle of Vontor (circa 25,100 BBY) was the second indecisive battle fought between the expansionist Hutts and the Empire of Xim the Despot.
The First Battle of Vontor (25,100 BBY) was the first of three battles fought between the expansionist Hutts and the Empire of Xim the Despot at the planet Vontor.
Morjakar was a planetoid originally from a system on the opposite side of the galaxy, when its star swelled into a red giant, swallowing all of its planets except Morjakar.

Arro was the first planet of the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A hot world made of molten rock, it had no moons and orbited the star Domir.

Euton was a terrestrial planet in the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the second orbital position around the star Domir, and it featured a searing hot environment and a rocky surface.

Laseel was a hot jungle planet in the Dathomir system, located in the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Laseel had two moons and occupied the third orbital position around the star Domir.

BABYgnon, alternatively known as Babygnon, was a gas giant–type planet that had eight moons and occupied the fifth orbital position around its sun, Domir, in the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Barmasel was a gas giant in the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the sixth orbital position around the star Domir and was orbited by thirteen moons.

Stindaron was a gas giant in the Dathomir system, located in the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was orbited by twenty moons and occupied the seventh orbital position around the star Domir.

Arodoni was a gas giant in the Dathomir system, located in the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the eighth orbital position around the star Domir and was orbited by eighteen moons.

Chirgay was an ice planet located in the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A cold planet, it occupied the ninth orbital position around its star, Domir. It was itself circled by one moon.

Chav was the tenth and last planet of the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A world made of barren rock, it had two moons and orbited the star Domir.
Emra was a gas giant planet in the Demar system. It had eleven moons.
Gart was the second planet in orbit in the Demar system. Over 30 years before the Battle of Yavin it had been reduced to an empty shell of rock by the Lant Mining Corporation.

Latt was the third planet in the Demar system. By the Battle of Yavin, it had been reduced to a nearly barren rock by the Lant Mining Corporation. A few workers had remained on the planet to seal the deep mine shafts and salvage the leftover mining equipment and buildings.
Lish was the sixth planet in the Demar system of the Expansion Region. A large, blue-green gas giant, Lish was orbited by fifteen moons.
Patar was the outermost planet in the Demar system.
Rima was the first planet of the Demar system. Its closeness to the system's sun caused it to be a lifeless, super-hot ball of rock.
Lish XI was a moon of Lish in the Demar system.
Zenobah was the second planet in the Demophon system. It had a hot climate and was covered in plains. It had two moons, and was destroyed when its sun went supernova.
Lors was a planet in the Duro system of the Core Worlds. The closest to the star Duro, Lors was a searing rock with one moon.
Koli was a planet located in the Duro system.
Doornik-628A was the first planet in the Doornik-628 system, located in the Farlax sector. It was a part of the Koornacht Cluster, itself a region of the Negs portion of the Core Worlds.

Doornik-628B was the second planet in the Doornik-628 system, which was located in the Farlax sector, a part of the Negs portion of the Core Worlds. The planet orbited the star Doornik-628 and was itself circled by a single moon.
Doornik-628C was the third planet in the Doornik-628 system. Its core was surrounded by acidic clouds, and it had no natural satellites.
Pehzehvar (Doornik-628D) was a planet in the Doornik-628 system with a single moon.

Doornik-628F was the sixth planet in the Doornik-628 system, located in the Farlax sector, which was in turn a part of the Koornacht Cluster, a region of the Negs portion of the Core Worlds. The system was centered around the star Doornik-628.
Doornik-628G was a gas giant in the Doornik-628 system.
Doornik-628H was a planet in the Doornik-628 system.
Arjus was the first planet in the Desev system. It was a huge gas giant that was orbited by 38 moons.
Gauther was a planet in the Desev system.
Dar was the first planet in the Derilyn system.
Alorthas was the second planet in the Derilyn system. It was a hot, rocky wasteland that was inundated with signs of technological activity around the time of the Galactic War.
Fahul was the sixth planet in the Derilyn system. It was an airless, lifeless world.
Kalis was the third planet in the Derilyn system. It was a harsh and remote world with a thick, boiling atmosphere. There was no life on the world.
Sotipe was the seventh planet in the Derilyn system. It was a gas giant and had 14 moons.
Serrata was the eighth planet in the Derilyn system. It was a gas giant and had 5 moons. Serrata was a near-star, its mass falling just below the necessary level to make the transition.
Takornan was the fourth planet in the Derilyn system. The planet had two moons and a diversity of fauna and minerals.

Belorphyn was the ninth planet in the Derilyn system. It was an inhospitable ice ball without moons with an oblong orbit (due to Serrata's influence). For a portion of its "year", it actually was closer to Deril than Serrata.
Frellor was the first planet in the Fre'ji system.
Fretaria was the third planet in the Fre'ji system.
Frenoris was the fourth planet in the Fre'ji system.
Korfin was a planet in the Feriae system in the Thesme sector.
Moraices was a planet in the Feriae system of the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim.

Calipp was a gas giant–type planet with twelve moons that was located in the Faarlsun system, a part of the Parthovian Cluster in Wild Space. The planet occupied the sixth and outermost orbit around its star, the yellow-white Faarlsun.
Ios was a gas giant and the fourth and outermost planet located in the Feriae system.

Jun was a hot rock planet with no moons that was located within the Parthovian Cluster's Faarlsun system, in the Wild Space region of the galaxy. The planet occupied the closest orbit to its star, the yellow-white Faarlsun.

Koss was a gas giant–type planet with eight moons that was located in the Faarlsun system, a part of the Parthovian Cluster in Wild Space. The planet occupied the fifth orbit around its star, the yellow-white Faarlsun.

Weken was a terrestrial planet with two moons that was located within the Parthovian Cluster's Faarlsun system, in the Wild Space region of the galaxy. The planet occupied the third orbit around its star, the yellow-white Faarlsun, and had a poisonous environment.
Shella was a planet in the Essesia system.
Danzer was a planet in the Essesia system. It was a smaller-than-average gas giant with two moons.
Muntiadu was a terrestrial planet in the Eriadu system, located in the Seswenna sector of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Pocia was a planet in the Essesia system. It was a gas giant with 19 moons.
Ithona was a planet in the Essesia system. It was a gas giant with five moons.
Jaroona was a volcanic rock planet located in the Eriadu system in the Seswenna sector of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Talleles was a planet in the Essesia system. It was a smaller than average gas giant with two moons.

Erinar was a volcanic rock planet in the Eriadu system, located in the Seswenna sector of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Erinar was circled by one moon and itself occupied the third orbital position around the star Eriadu.
Kodasta was a planet in the Essesia system.

Tarastra was a gas giant in the Eriadu system, located in the Seswenna sector of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Tarastra was the fifth planet that orbited the star Eriadu, and it was circled by seven moons.
Permeles was a planet in the Essesia system.
Kelliadu was a terrestrial planet in the Eriadu system, located in the Seswenna sector of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

sector: Zuma sector; Moddell sector; Outer Moddell systems
x: Dor was the fourth planet in the Endor system.
Trinka was the first planet in Elrood's system. A barren planet of high temperatures, it boasted a small research station.
Akana was the dry and barren fourth world within the Elrood system, located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy in the Elrood sector.
Thrang was the fifth planet in the Elrood system. It was a sizable gas giant with 7 moons.
Tufar was the sixth planet in the Elrood system. It was a frigid world of methane ice.

Sharene was one of the two moons of Elrood. Sharene and Lodos, the other moon of Elrood, were named after a prominent husband and wife who were the first colonists of Elrood and were married under the twin moons. Both moons figured prominently in local culture and folklore.

Lodos was one of the two moons of Elrood. Lodos and Sharene, the other moon of Elrood, were named after a prominent husband and wife who were the first colonists of Elrood and were married under the twin moons. Both moons figured prominently in local culture and folklore.

Akanala was the only moon that orbited the world of Akana. The artisans of that planet often drew inspiration for their works from Akanala. The entire surface of the moon glistened due to rich deposits of sparkling quartz.
Shron was a small, volcanic planet that was the innermost planet of the Hoth system.
Biosh was a planet in the Hoth system. The second world in the system, Biosh was a barren ball of rock. It had little to any atmosphere and no life.
Nushk was the third planet in the Hoth system, located within the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was mostly covered with methane oceans and had four moons.
Ordaj was the fifth planet of the Hoth system in the Outer Rim Territories. It was a gas giant, orbited by seventeen moons, including Ordaj Besh.
Kuthul was the outermost planet in the Honoghr system. This frozen giant was devoid of life.
Logru, also known as Loghru was the first planet in the Honoghr system. It was covered in molten lava.
Geriss was a planet that was located within the Geonosis system. It occupied that star system's first orbit.
Conus was the third planet in the Geonosis system.
Mabonte was the fourth planet in the Geonosis system. It was orbited by a pair of moons.
Abyssissa was the sixth and outermost planet in the Geonosis system. It orbited the star Ea.

Amthau was the third planet in the Genesia system. The surface was dominated by rocky canyons, which spoke of the water which used to run across the planet's surface. This made the terraforming project much easier.

Seft was a planet in the Genesia system. The system's largest gas giant, Seft was orbited by six moons which had been stripped of all resources by the Lant Mining Corporation. LMC occasionally used the planet's atmospheric gases for use in Genesia's industrial plants.
Falk was the last planet in the Genesia system. It was a blue-gray gas giant whose nine moons had been stripped-mined by the Lant Mining Corporation.

Gimm was a moon of Genesia, it was colonized along with its sister moon Laut. Facilities were built underground to house colonists, a place where air was constantly filtered, unlike the unbreathable atmosphere on the surface.
Kalki was a planet in the Garqi system which had no moons and was covered by searing rock.
Elsho was a planet in the Garqi system. It was a gas giant orbited by seven moons.
The Gromas Belt was an asteroid belt located in the Gromas system, within the Perkell sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim, in orbit of the star Gromas.
The Fourth Battle of Qotile was a battle of the Stark Hyperspace War, the fourth of five battles fought on the Outer Rim world of Troiken.
The Third Battle of Qotile was a battle of the Stark Hyperspace War, the third of five battles fought on the Outer Rim world of Troiken. It was presumably a draw.
The Second Battle of Qotile was a battle of the Stark Hyperspace War, the second of five battles fought on the Outer Rim world of Troiken.
The First Battle of Qotile was the opening battle of the Stark Hyperspace War.
The Battle of Ithor in 25 ABY was a battle between the joint forces of the New Republic and Imperial Remnant against the Praetorite Vong.

The Declaration of a New Order was a proclamation made by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine in 19 BBY, first as an address to an Extraordinary Session of the Galactic Senate and then to the general galactic populous.
These unidentified green-skinned humanoids were from the planet Solem.

result: Galactic Federation of Free Alliances victory
x: The Battle of Bakura took place between forces of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances and the Ssi-ruuvi Imperium in 28 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Peppel was an Outer Rim Territories planet in the Corva sector. In 17 ABY, the wanted Devaronian former army captain Kardue'sai'Malloc fled to Peppel, where for the following two years he resided in a simple hut that was protected by a sophisticated security system.
Telil Menin was a planet in the Leria Kerlsil system. The first planet in the system consisted of barren rock with no moons.
Lamarebb was a gas giant in the Lamaro system. It was very close to the sun, Lamaro, and orbited close to the second planet, Lamarecc.
Ristel was the first planet in the Kuat system.
Lamarecc was a gas giant in the Lamaro system. It was very close to the sun, Lamaro, and orbited close to the first planet, Lamarebb.
Goravas was the second planet in the Kuat system.
Lamaremm was the fourth planet in the Lamaro system.
Daver Kuat was the third planet in the Kuat system.
Gortis was the fifth planet in the Kuat system.
Rasapan was a gas giant and the sixth planet in the Kuat system.
Karedda was an ice ball and the third planet in the Kessel system.
Kas was a planet that was located within the Kamino system in Wild Space. It occupied the first orbit within that star system.
Yuka Major was the second planet in the Kamino system. It shared part of its name with the thirteenth planet of the system, Yuka.
Jomon was the third planet in the Kamino system.
Liyha was the sixth planet in the Kalinda system. It was an icy wasteland.
Faa was the fourth planet in the Kamino system. It was located in Wild Space.
Saloch² was a moon of the planet Jiroch-Saloch. It supported a Tunroth colony that was freed from the Lortans by forces of the Galactic Empire, led by Captain Lun Tessra and the Abrogator.
Mira was the sixth planet in the Kamino system.
Miyuu was a rocky planet, and the seventh in the Kamino system. It was orbited by five moons.
Donoa was the eighth planet in the Kamino system. It was orbited by 17 moons.
Talita was the twelfth planet in the Kamino system. It was orbited by six moons.
Imoco was a world that was located in the Kamino system, within Wild Space. It was the eleventh planet out from that system's primary star.
Casna Aure was the ninth planet in the Kamino system. It was a gas giant orbited by 28 moons.

Casna Besh was the tenth planet in the Kamino system. It was an enormous gas giant orbited by a staggering 43 moons and captured wandering comets and asteroids at a rate of roughly two every millennium.
Traxal 1 was the first planet orbiting the star Nubus in the Nubus system. Located in the Core Worlds, it was a searing rock.
Traxal 2 was the second planet orbiting the star Nubus in the Nubus system. Located in the Core Worlds, it was a searing rock.
Nimbia was the fourth planet orbiting the star Nubus in the Nubus system. Located in the Core Worlds, it was a gas giant.
Nigel III was a planet in the Expansion Region situated along the Enarc Run hyperspace route. It had an Imperial presence during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Nothar was the fifth planet orbiting the star Nubus in the Nubus system. Located in the Core Worlds, it was a frozen rock.
Ranste was a searing rock planet in the New Plympto system that occupied the closest orbital position around its star, New Plympto.
Sasan was a planet found in the New Plympto system of the Corellian sector in the Core of the Galaxy. The second world in the system, Sasan was a searing rock planet.
Moth was the first planet in the Naboo system.
Bilagen was the fourth planet in the New Plympto system.
Erep was the second planet in the Naboo system. It had one moon.
K'zar was the first planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system. Located in the Core Worlds, it was a searing rock.
Widow was the fourth planet in the Naboo system. It had one moon.
T'grel was the second planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system. Located in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds, it was a searing rock.

Storm was a gas giant, and the fifth planet in the Naboo system, located within the Chommell sector on the galaxy's Mid Rim. Its thirty-two moons included its third moon and its tenth moon, which housed a penal colony and Tagge Company outpost respectively.
V'rof was the third planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system. Located in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds, it was a volcanic rock.
G'hol was the fourth planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system. Located in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds, it was a terrestrial planet.
M'buh was the sixth planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system. Located in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds, it was a barren rock.
Varhus was a planet in the Muunilinst system.
D'pur was the seventh planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system within the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds. It was the only gas giant in the system.

Havath Prime was the fourth planet in the Muunilinst system, a part of the Obtrexta sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a gas giant orbited by thirty-two moons, itself circling the star Muunilinst.
F'tang was the eighth planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system. Located in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds, it was a frozen rock.
Havath Minor was the fifth planet in the Muunilinst system. It was a gas giant inferior in size to Havath Prime and was orbited by 11 moons.
Pa'aal was the primary moon of the planet N'zoth in the N'zoth system.
An asteroid field was an asteroid belt in the N'zoth system. Located in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds, it occupied the seventh orbital position around the star C'rel.
Menias was the first planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was a searing rock with no moons.
Maedano was the second planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was a barren rock with one moon.
Majesticas was the third planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was a toxic rock with no moons.
Maddules was the fourth planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was a gas giant with nine moons.
Glauheim was a gas giant that was orbited by three moons. It was the second planet in the Marcellus system, which resided in the Marcellus Nebula. Glauheim circled the yellow sun Marcellus.
Mores was the sixth planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was a gas giant with seventeen moons.
Dadrus was a gas giant that was orbited by five moons. It was the third planet in the Marcellus system, which resided in the Marcellus Nebula. Dadrus circled the yellow sun Marcellus.
Militar was the seventh planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was a gas giant with five moons.
Makem Pria was a planet in the Makem system. It was a giant ball of searing rock.
Makem Sup was a planet in the Makem system.
Makem Hek was a planet in the Makem system.
Makem Liva was a planet in the Makem system.
Makem Qat was a planet in the Makem system.
Makem Dua was a planet in the Makem system.
Ovise VI was a planet in the Ovise system.
Wego was the innermost planet of the Obas system located within the Expansion Region of the galaxy.
Rela was the seventh planet in the Obas system. It was orbited by 8 moons.
Ohda was a planet holding the fourth orbit in the Obas system, with three satellites.
Fal was the third planet in the Obas system.

Obas was a superheated volcanic planet located in the Expansion Region's Andirma sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Alliance to Restore the Republic operated a base on the planet, the environmental control systems of which at one point malfunctioned.
Mon Bala was the innermost planet orbiting the star Ryloth in the Ryloth system. Located in the Outer Rim Territories, it was a molten rock.
Or Tuma was the outermost planet orbiting the star Ryloth in the Ryloth system. It was a frozen rock located in the Outer Rim Territories.
Elpur was the first planet within the Ropagi system, situated in the Kira sector of the Expansion Region. It was a desolate searing rock.
Kaloo was a planet in the Roon system within the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It had no moons and had a terrain of searing rock.
Iqoon was a planet in the Roon system. It possessed two moons and had a terrain of barren rock.

Risha was the first planet orbiting the star Rish in the Rishi system. Located in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a toxic hothouse. The planet did not support Human-like life, as its surface was covered with molten rivers and steaming lakes of chemicals.

Rishal was the second planet orbiting the star Rish in the Rishi system. Located in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim, it was a barren, lifeless world that couldn't support life, but was rich in metal and ores. Rishal had no moons.

Rishos was the fourth planet orbiting the star Rish in the Rishi system. Located in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant. Promising stores of gases were found on Rishos that stood waiting to be harvested by enterprising mining corporations.
Inner Los was a planet located in the Recopi system.
Hern was the innermost planet in the Rhinnal system. It was a molten rock, uninhabitable for life.
Penovia was a planet in the Recopi system. It was a gas giant with fourteen moons.
Nensil was the second planet in the Rhinnal system. It was a barren rock.
Lacia was a planet in the Recopi system. It was a gas giant with nine moons.
Outer Los was a planet located in the Recopi system.
Basho was the fifth planet in the Rhinnal system. It was a frigid ice planet and the last one before the asteroid field.

Raxus II, or Raxus Two, was a planet located within the Raxus system, a part of the Tion Hegemony's Back Spiral in the Tion Cluster. It was situated within the historical Greater Tion region, in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
