Omeddyl was a planet located in the Rhinnal system. Positioned just beyond the asteroid field, it was a gas giant with 18 moons, and one of two such planets in the star system.
Ockbur was a planet located in the Ralltiir system.
Ruby was the outermost planet in the Rhinnal system. It was a gas giant with 21 moons and one of two such planets in the star system.
Pau'con was a planet in the Ralltiir system.
Clascvoria was a planet in the Ralltiir system. It was controlled by the Esselian Empire up until its collapse following the Clone Wars.
The Rhinnal asteroid field was in the Rhinnal system.
Inwil was the fifth planet of the Darpa sector's Ralltiir system.
Pyr was one of the planets of the Pyrshak system, which contained Manaan, and was located on the Inner Rim of the galaxy.
Rake was a tiny terrestrial planet in the Prakith system of the Deep Core's Sector 5. It occupied the first orbital position around the star Prak and had a barren rock surface.

Mekith was a tiny terrestrial planet in the Prakith system, located in Sector 5 of the Deep Core. It occupied the second orbital position around the star Prak and had a moon. Mekith featured a rocky surface and a toxic environment.
Delanoth was a tiny gas giant in the Prakith system of the Deep Core's Sector 5. The planet occupied the fourth orbital position around the star Prak and had eight moons.

Prakess was a tiny terrestrial planet in the Prakith system, located in the Deep Core's Sector 5. It occupied the fifth orbital position around the star Prak and had two moons. Prakess featured a frozen environment and a rocky surface.
The Pii system's first planet was a fiery ball of rock that orbited the Pii sun. The hot planet was located in the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Atloran was the third planet in the Panto system. It was a barren, lifeless sphere of a world, but nevertheless was known for its zero-gravity campgrounds and amusement parks.

Pii II was a planet in the Pii system. A fiery ball of rock, the planet was the second to orbit the Pii sun. Pii II, along with the rest of the Pii system, was located in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The fifth planet of the Pii system was a barren terrestrial planet of no interest. The planet was located in the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the fifth planet to orbit the Pii sun.
The Pii system's seventh planet was a frozen ball of ice that orbited the Pii sun. The cold planet was located in the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
The sixth planet of the Pii system was the system's only gas giant and it orbited the Pii sun. The planet was located in the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Pii system's first asteroid field was located in the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The asteroid field orbited the Pii sun and lay between Pii II and Pii III, the system's second and third planets, respectively.

The Pii system's second asteroid field was located in the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The asteroid field orbited the Pii sun and lay between the system's fifth and sixth planets, respectively.

Umnub was the smaller of the two moons that orbited the world of Sullust, on the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. It was incapable of supporting life, but the moon was mined for ores and minerals during the height of the Galactic Republic by the Sullustans.
Sululluub was an asteroid field which orbited the star Sullust in the Sullust system. It was located in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Lununmo was the second planet orbiting the star Sullust in the Sullust system. Located in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant with 34 moons.
Sullumun was the first planet orbiting the star Sullust in the Sullust system. Located in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant with eighteen moons.
Slag was the first planet from the sun in the Sacorrian system. It was a searing rocky world with no atmosphere and no moons.
Arcadia was the volcanic second planet in the Sacorrian system. It was orbited by a single moon.
Noleria was the fourth planet in the Sacorrian system.
Titanicus was the fifth planet from the sun in the Sacorrian system. It was a gas giant orbited by 14 moons.

The seventh and outermost planet in its system, Vo was a frozen, moonless, lifeless rock. It was located in the Sacorrian system, one of the Outlier systems of the Corellian sector, in the Arrowhead portion of the Galactic Core.
Leviathan was the sixth planet from the sun in the Sacorrian system. It was a gas giant orbited by 16 moons.

Yibikkoror was a planet of the Yinchorri system. It was a small world with a dense atmosphere and possibly no solid surface. The Yinchorri built at least one balloon city on the planet, and its residents used flutter-packs for transportation.

Uhanayih was a planet in the Yinchorri system. It was a lifeless rock close to the system's primary star. In the Yinchorri language, its name meant "within world," and it was associated with the spirit realm in the Yinchorri religion.

Vulpus was a terrestrial planet located in the Vulpter system of the Deep Core. It occupied the first orbital position around the star Vulpter, and it featured a searing hot environment and a rocky surface.
Vulp Major was a gas giant in the Vulpter system of the Deep Core. The planet had nine moons and occupied the sixth orbital position around the Vulpter star.

Vulp Minor was a terrestrial planet located in the Vulpter system of the Deep Core. The planet featured a frozen environment, and its surface consisted of rock. Vulp Minor occupied the fifth orbital position around its star, Vulpter, and it had three moons.
Nur was a planet in the Vulpter system of the Deep Core. The planet had a barren rock surface and had one moon. Nur occupied the fourth orbital position around the star Vulpter.

Kins was a terrestrial planet located in the Vulpter system of the Deep Core. It occupied the second orbital position around its star, Vulpter. The planet featured a toxic environment and a rocky surface, and it had one moon.
Vorzyd III was a planet located within the Vorzyd system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Vorzyd I was a planet located within the Vorzyd system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Danar was a planet located within the Vernet system of the Expansion Region. It was a planet full of many vast red deserts.

Vex Major, also known as Far Gent, was a swampy Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Moddell sector. Originally settled by a sect of the Order of the Ffib, by the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War decades later Vex Major was inhabited by insular clans of Human fishers.
Welarn was a planet located within the Vernet system of the Expansion Region. This gas giant was orbited by 23 moons.
Sulphor was a planet located within the Velus system of the Core Worlds.

Velumia was the third planet that orbited Velus, the Velus system's sun. The planet, like the rest of its system, was located in the Northern Dependencies portion of the Core Worlds. Velumia was a gas giant with seven moons.

Zelmaadine was a moonless volcanic planet that occupied the first orbital position around the star Velm. It was located in the Velm system, a part of the Halori sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim.

Vilimia was the fourth planet that orbited the sun Velus. The planet was located within the Velus system of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Core Worlds. Vilimia was a gas giant with thirteen moons.

Velmooine was a desert planet with four moons that occupied the second orbital position around the star Velm. It was located in the Velm system, a part of the Halori sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim.
Iychtor was the fifth, outermost planet that orbited the sun Velus. It was located in the Velus system of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Core Worlds. The frozen rock planet had one moon.

Zeloc was a planet in the fifth orbit around the star Velm. It was the second of two gas giants in the Velm system, located in the Halori sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim. Zeloc was orbited by eleven moons, and it was also encircled by a ring system.

Veladine was the sixth planet orbiting the star Velm. It was the outermost planet in the Velm system, which was located in the Halori sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim. Veladine's surface consisted of ice, and it was orbited by three asteroid moonlets.

The Udine asteroid field was an asteroid field located within the Udine system, on the Inner Rim of the galaxy. Pirates were known to occasionally transport these asteroids to Keller's Void in order to drag ships from hyperspace, utilizing their mass shadows.
Ducocon was a terrestrial planet in the Utos system.
Yetoros was the fourth planet in the Utos system. It was a gas giant orbited by eight moons.
Camos was the sixth and most distant planet in the Utos system. It was a gas giant orbited by 31 moons.
Horticar was the fifth planet in the Utos system. It was a gas giant orbited by 11 moons.
Taoska was the fifth planet orbiting the star Tyrius in the Tyrius system. Located in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was an ice ball that was visible from Rodia.

Toosma was the fourth and largest planet orbiting the star Tyrius in the Tyrius system. Located in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a yellow-orange gas giant and had a total of 18 moons.

Pirdia was the third planet orbiting the star Tyrius in the Tyrius system. Located in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a ringed gas giant with green-blue gases striping its surface.
Mikak was the first planet orbiting the star Tyrius in the Tyrius system.
Marjune was the first planet in the Tirahnn system of the Inner Rim Territories. It was a barren, rocky world.
Kirian was the third planet in the Tirahnn system of the Inner Rim.

Ijol was the fourth planet that orbited Tirahnn, the Tirahnn system's sun. The planet, along with the rest of its system, was situated in the Inner Rim's Zeemacht Cluster along the Perlemian Trade Route, which served as the dividing line between the Northern Dependencies and t…
Enenpa was a gas giant located within the Thurra system, a part of the Esstran sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was orbited by forty moons.
Hordon Cal was a hot ball of rock located in the Thanta Zilbra system of the Outer Rim Territories, orbited by a small moon. Both were destroyed during the Starbuster Plot by the Sacorrian Triad.
Flandar was a planet located within the Thanta Zilbra system of the Outer Rim Territories.
T-4 was a moon orbiting the planet Thaere Privo in the Thaereian system of the Expansion Region.
Zham Hlar was the third planet of the Thaereian system of the Expansion Region. The space station Burnout was located in orbit of the planet.
Odae Ripp was the first planet located within the Thaereian system of the Expansion Region.
Kadok III-E was the fifth planet in the Tertiary Kadok system. It was a gas giant with seventy-five moons.
Kadok III-C was the third planet in the Tertiary Kadok system. It was a barren rock with one moon.
Kadok III-B was the second planet in the Tertiary Kadok system. It was a searing rock with fifteen moons.
Kadok III-A was the first planet in the Tertiary Kadok system. It was a searing rock with eight moons.
Trenal was the third planet in the Tasar system. It had 14 satellites.
The Deadbelt was a belt of asteroids that was located in the Tasar system.
Arganu was a planet in the Tasar system. It was close to the star and the heat and radiation made it uninhabitable. Despite have rich mineral deposits, it was impractical to set up mining operations.
Zeloa was a planet located in the Zel system, in the Inner Rim.
Zellone was a gas giant in the Zel system.
Kleeva was a massive gas giant located within Hutt Space. It was orbited by at least three moons, including Boonda's Moon and Vultee-Pietsch.
Sonn Vilmari was a planet in the Colundra sector of the Outer Rim.

leader: Great Leader of the Second Imperium
x: The Second Imperium was a faction that emerged from the Galactic Empire as one of its splinter factions.

Rigel was a Muurian transport that carried bartenders of the Dunari's Rest when the latter was attacked by Imperial forces. It made it to the hyperspace intact thanks to assistance from the Rebel Alliance.
Corvis Minor V in the Corvis Minor system was a planet orbited by six moons, including Distna. It was a gray-orange gas giant located near an asteroid belt.
Dela III, also known as Dela, was a planet located in the Centrality, a sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Farfeld II was an astronomical object in the Farfeld system. It was the site of an Imperial System Patrol Squadron base guarded by the CR90 corvettes Olrac Etnom and Cutlass until it was destroyed by Red Squadron B-wings.
The Habassa was the Habassa system's primary race.

The Mokk were a Dantari tribe that lived on the planet Dantooine. Most of the tribe lived in its village but many Mokk, including their tribal leader, resided in the Mokk Stronghold. Soothsayers and shamen were also part of the tribe.
Oshetti IV was a swampy planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Its inhabitants used dried swamp hemp, which contained bioluminescent bacteria, to create the glowing fabric known as illuminescence.
Orellon I was the moon of Orellon II. When first discovered, it was thought to be a planet, hence its misnomer.
Arnie was the R9 droid that flew in Luke Skywalker's StealthX during the attack on the Gorog nest, due to R2-D2's malfunctioning.
Pyria VI, also called Pyria Six, was the sixth planet in the Pyria system.
The Candaserri was an Acclamator-class assault ship in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.

Squollyhawlks were massive worm-like creatures native to Arorua. One nearly killed Obi-Wan Kenobi during his visit there in 44 BBY. A false face located on top of the squollyhawlk's head was meant to make its prey believe that it was a smaller creature hiding in the foliage.
A silan was a monstrous, tentacled creature from Arorua. They resembled a mass of writhing tendrils and multiple toothy maws, quite similar to a sarlacc.

NT 600 was an astronavigation and general assistance droid that was hardwired into the Inferno, Vilmarh Grahrk's personal starship. Also known as just NT, she could detach from the Inferno and operate as an independent unit.
The Dur Sabon were a species of tall, eel-like sentients native to the planet of the same name.
The Cobra was a ship that belonged to Lando Calrissian. Calrissian had many stories of how he acquired the ship and wasn't sure which one he liked the best.
Elin Roe was a Colonies celestial body in the Elin Roe system, which was patrolled by Hallyn Phlynne during the Galactic Civil War.
Chrellis was a tiny planetoid located in the Chrellis system, a part of the Lahara sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
The asteroid belts of the Cardua system were mined by the people of that system, who had been subjugated by the Galactic Empire.

Hell's Anvil was the customized personal ship of the bounty hunter Montross. It featured two aft-mounted Dyne 427 radial atomizer engines, not to mention two custom Keizar-Volvec KV4T8-i sublight engines on the tip of each wing.
Jaster's Legacy ('JAST07) was the starship of the Mandalorian bounty hunter, Jango Fett, up until shortly after the Invasion of Naboo.
A battle on the moon Alaris Prime was initiated by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, shortly after the First Battle of Geonosis.
The Eickarie were a reptilian alien species from the Unknown Regions that were aligned with the Empire of the Hand. They were native to the planet Kariek.

The Justice Action Network, also known as Justice Action League or simply as JAN, was an Alderaanian terrorist organization founded after the Clone Wars by Earnst Kamiel and the parents of Jan Ors (who chose the organization's name as an homage to their daughter).
Trigon One was a weapons satellite constructed by the Fromm Gang during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
Vohai was a planet located within the Vohai system of the Outer Rim Territories, covered with industrial sites, that were interspersed with residential towers and parkland.

Nightmare demon was the name of a near-mythical species from the planet of Droxine. They were small-sized primates with two tails, suction cup-tipped fingers and a bare head that resembled the Human skull.

The Padawan Pack was an ad-hoc unit of Jedi Padawans whose Masters had been killed in the Battle of Jabiim. It was hoped that a large group of inexperienced Jedi would equal the effectiveness of a smaller number of Knights or Masters.
The Raging Banthas were a swoop gang who raced on the moons of Shesharile 5 and 6. They were led by Westwood.
The Spiders were a swoop gang who raced on the moons of Shesharile 5 and 6. The ran Zone Five.
The Rabid Mynocks were a swoop gang who raced on the moons of Shesharile 5 and 6.
M-TD, short for "miniaturized translator droid" and nicknamed Em Teedee, was a specialized translator droid used by Lowbacca while attending Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum.
Widowmaker was a white wedge shaped frigate of the Imperial Remnant Navy, captained by Arien Yage. Lieutenants Stalgis and Tarl were members of its stormtrooper contingent.
The Terror was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought in service to the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

In 26 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War between the New Republic and the Yuuzhan Vong species, the Yuuzhan Vong conquered the planet Ylesia. It was soon given to the Peace Brigade as their headquarters.

The Invidious was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer. At the time of Emperor Palpatine's death at the Battle of Endor, it was part of a task force commanded by High Admiral Treuten Teradoc, and served as part of his fleet when he became a self-proclaimed warlord.
The Invids were a pirate group led by ex-Moff Leonia Tavira.

T3-H8 was a T3-series utility droid with masculine programming that was located on the Outer Rim city world of Taris during the Jedi Civil War. The droid was owned by the Twi'lek female Janice Nall and put up for sale for fifty credits in her Upper City droid shop.
M4-78 was a legendary planet of droids, supposedly dating back to the Old Republic. I-5YQ once joked about being the deposed ruler of the planet while he was on Drongar.
The Inferno was a custom-built personal starship owned by the Devaronian smuggler Vilmarh Grahrk.

Mer-9 was a protocol droid assigned by the New Republic to observe the actions of the Corporate Sector Authority and the pro-Imperial forces in Verena City. To do this, Mer-9 worked as a translator and assistant to Bren-Aarica Rordan in her shop.

0-1B was a battle droid that worked incognito as a medical droid aboard the barge Dune Princess. It was assigned by slicer "Never Die" to obtain the Shard of Alderaan, a sought-after slicing program, before crime lord Begas Tok auctioned it off thus risking its falling into th…
Tenfour was a droid assigned to Quinlan Vos's starship, the Skorp-Ion, during the Clone Wars around the time of the Battle of Rendili.

11-17 was an 11-17-series mining droid on Hosk Station. He assisted Zed, R2-D2, and other droids in stopping Olag Greck's plan to steal a shipment of ash ore, and to destroy Hosk Station to conceal the evidence.
The Shikitari were a rare, dim-witted insectoid species native to the planet Shikitari in the Unknown Regions.

place: City of Tiems, Tiems, Tiems system, Belderone sector, Outer Rim Territ
result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: The Battle of Tiems was an engagement fought between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War around 0 ABY, in the area surrounding the city of Tiems on the planet of the same name in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Zchtek worlds of the Mid Rim were home to the Jin. Subjugated by the Galactic Empire, they were the site of a genocide perpetrated by that regime.

result: Destruction of skyhook by the Executor
Rebel Alliance retreat out of system
x: The Battle over Coruscant was a major battle during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic in orbit of the planet Coruscant. The battle led to the destabilization of Black Sun under Xizor's rule.
Opari was a planet in the Opari system of the Mid Rim. It provided the Balawai government on Haruun Kal with gunships.

The Pembric asteroid field was located in the Pembric system. The field surrounded Pembric II, and its asteroids constantly bombarded the surface of the planet. The field was rich in hfredium, and was mined during the time Moff Kentor Sarne controlled the Kathol sector.
Nepe was a gas giant in the Episol system. It was orbited by the moon Dayark, a member of the Kathol Republic.
The Helmsman was a Praetor II-class Star Battlecruiser commanded by Mils Giel at some point in the year preceding the Battle of Endor.
The Jussafet asteroids were mined by the inhabitants of Jussafet Four.
The Akk Guards were Kar Vastor's elite Upland Liberation Front warriors during the Summertime War on Haruun Kal.
Squalls were small lagomorphs that inhabited the planets of Endor and Chandrila.
The Jarvashqiine were a group of shaman-like priests who were able to use abilities granted by the Force and adhered to its dark side.
The Relentless was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer which was best known as part of Grand Admiral Thrawn's fleet during his campaign against the New Republic.
The Battle of Gall was a conflict initiated by members of the Rebel Alliance in 3.5 ABY, during the search for Boba Fett and his carbon-frozen prisoner, Han Solo.
The Battle of Thyferra marked the end of the Bacta War between Rogue Squadron and the Thyferran government, which was backed by Ysanne Isard.

The Battle of Dathomir, also known as the Battle of Singing Mountain, was a battle between the Singing Mountain Clan, New Republic and Hapes Consortium alliance and Zsinj's Empire and their allies, the Nightsisters.

result: New Republic victory; end of the Black Fleet Crisis
Military defeat of the Duskhan League
x: The Battle of N'zoth was the final battle of the Black Fleet Crisis, in which the New Republic implemented Operation Strong Hand against the Yevetha. In 16 ABY, the Yevetha had attacked and massacred all non-Yevethan colonies within the Koornacht Cluster during their Great Purge.

The destruction of Sernpidal, also known as the First Battle of Sernpidal, occurred in 25 ABY when the Praetorite Vong—an advance force of the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong invaders—employed the tactic Yo'gand's Core, pulling the moon Dobido to Sernpidal's surface.

The Great Droid Revolution, also known as the Great Droid Revolt, was an uprising of droids on Coruscant which occurred in 4015 BBY. It was during the Revolution where Jedi Master Arca Jeth learned the technique of short-circuiting a droid by using the Force.

The Battle of Jaga's Cluster was one of the final battles of the Mandalorian Wars. Despite the fact that the Mandalorians would soon lose the war and be almost entirely wiped out, they still managed an impressive victory against the Old Republic, destroying an entire enemy fle…
The Twenty-First Battle of Zehava occurred circa 94 BBY. It was one of the many struggles of the Melida/Daan Civil War on the planet of Melida/Daan and centered over control of the city of Zehava.

result: The Decimators are obtained by the CIS
Decimator codes taken to Alaris Prime by the Wookiees
x: The Battle of Eredenn occurred when Separatist General Sev'rance Tann arrived at the planet during the Hunt for the Decimator after learning of the weapon's existence from Boorka the Hutt.
The Second Battle of Tatooine was a battle of the Clone Wars.
The Star-Hoppers of Aduba-3 was a group of spacers and rogues organized by smuggler Han Solo to defend a small farming village on Aduba-3 from a swoop gang.
HK-O1, also known as the HK-01 assassin-droid prototype, was a prototype HK-series assassin droid created by Czerka Corporation.
Krinemonen was a gas giant planet in Calamari sector orbited by the oceanic moon of Krinemonen III.

FE-9Q, known colloquially as "Effie," was a tractor-robot employed in the farming village of Onacra on the planet Aduba-3. After falling into disrepair, FE-9Q was recovered by the Doshun family, and he became an informal servant.
Uba I was a planet located within the Uba system of the Mid Rim. It was a home to an Ubese colony, which was destroyed by the Jedi in the bombardment of the Uba system during the New Sith Wars.
Uba II was a planet located within the Uba system of the Mid Rim. It was a home to an Ubese colony, which was destroyed by the Jedi in the bombardment of the Uba system during the New Sith Wars.
A ship, prior to being renamed Cay's Dream, served as the personal vessel of Sith Lord and former Jedi Knight Ulic Qel-Droma during the Great Sith War.

Melasaton was a low-tech planet devastated by a great plague. It was saved from the plague when Arbor Industries developed an antidote, even though it was Arbor Industries that secretly unleashed the plague in the first place.
The Dominator was a Victory I-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy.

conflict: Onderon Civil War; First Jedi Purge (Old Sith Wars)
x: A blockade of the planet Onderon was the opening skirmish of the Onderon Civil War, and was also a major event of the First Jedi Purge during that time.
The Corrupter was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer, which served as the flagship of Imperial Admiral Garreth Holtz and the Corrupter Task Force during the Galactic Civil War.
The Shusugaunt were a species from the planet of Shusugaunt in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim.

The Anapolla Musical Splash was a musical attraction at Lamuir IV's Priole Danna Festival showcasing several different genres of music from the galaxy's most famous recording artists, as well as new performers.

The Bosphs were a mammalian species from the planet of Bosph in the Outer Rim Territories' Bosph sector. They had six limbs, no neck and a pair of multiple-lensed eyes that also functioned as auditory sense organs.

The Vors were a sentient species inhabiting the Mid Rim world Vortex. They were thin, brittle-boned reptilian mammals who flew on leathery wings. Although they were a flying species, they lived in underground hummocks.

Chandaar was the throneworld of the Kingdom of Cron following the death of Xim the Despot, it had been conquered by Xim's father. Many years later, it became capital of the Cronese Mandate under the Galactic Empire and was the headquarters of numerous Cronese mining companies.

Banvhar Station was the asteroid headquarters of the Banvhar Combine asteroid miners. Due to the fact that they were located near Trade Federation spaceways, their minerals were stolen by the CIS during the Clone Wars, and even some of the residents were used as target practic…
The Intrepid was a Venator-class Star Destroyer of the Republic Navy.

In 22 BBY, during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, a battle took place on the Outer Rim Territories planet Ossus between Republic and Separatist forces.

result: Asajj Ventress is recruited into the CIS
objective: Recruit Asajj Ventress
x: The Mission to Rattatak was an opportunity for Count Dooku to seek a new ally with the power to defeat the Jedi.
The Battle of Pengalan IV took place during the Clone Wars.

place: Barkhesh, Seitia sector, Outer Rim Territories
result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
Supply convoy is successfully escorted to safety
objective: Escort supply convoy to safety
x: The Rendezvous on Barkhesh was a battle fought on the planet Barkhesh between Alliance to Restore the Republic forces under the command of General Carlist Rieekan—allied with native Barkhesh Resistance forces—and the Galactic Empire in 0.5 ABY.
Covert Ops clone troopers were elite clone troopers serving with the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Horn Station was a backwater world in the Lahara sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was neglected by the Galactic Republic until a Jedi Knight, nicknamed "Pinky," liberated the planet from Shoto Eyefire, a Defel crime lord and blastfighter.
The Extragalactic Society (often referred to as simply ExGal) was an institute devoted to the search for life outside the galaxy.

The Kamarians were an insect-like species native to Kamar. During the Imperial era, the most technologically advanced Kamarians had just developed nuclear weapons, and were well on their way to developing clean fusion and spaceflight.

The Mulako Corporation Primordial Water Quarry, also known as Mulako Corporation Quarry, Mulako Corporation comet, MC Quarry, and Mulako quarry, was a comet that orbited its star once every hundred years.
Iceberg Three, or Iceberg III, was a comet captured in the seventh orbit of Daca.
Killaniri was a gas giant world that was located within the Killaniri system. It was the second of two orbital bodies around its star. The planet possessed fifteen known moons.
Yoberra was a celestial body located in the Yoberra system, a part of the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Neshtab was a planet of snowy ice plains located in the Inner Rim region of the galaxy.
Thaldo was a planet located within the Thaldo system of the Mid Rim. The Rebel cell on Thaldo was one of many infiltrated by Nagai spies some time following the Battle of Yavin.
Tozeer was a planet located within the Tozeer system of the Outer Rim Territories. Tozeer was a desert world with Jawas and Tusken Raiders living on it.
Etorasp was a planet located in the Hakartha sector of the Expansion Region.
Bakkah was a desert planet located in the Bakkah system, in the Thrasybule sector of the Outer Rim.
Jarsatt was a planet located in the Hakartha sector of the Expansion Region.

Yoggoy was a planet in the Unknown Regions. It was covered in mounds similar to the Castle Lands, with flowers imported from Alderaan. The Tachyon Flier crashed on Yoggoy in 27 ABY in the location known as the Crash.
Farbog was a planet in the Galactic Empire visited by Leia Organa Solo during the Galactic Civil War.
Gottlegoob was a planet in the New Republic. During the Presidency of Leia Organa Solo, its people suffered from famine.
Qoribu was a ringed gas giant in the Gyuel system with 55 moons, including Jwlio, Eyyl, Zvbo, Ruu, Nrogu, and Kr.
Jwlio was a food world of the Colony and home to the Taat nest. It was a moon of Qoribu.
Eyyl was a food world of The Colony and home to the Mueum nest. It was a moon of Qoribu.
Zvbo was a food world of the Colony and home to the Alaala nest. It was a moon of Qoribu.
Ruu was a food world of the Colony and home to the Saras nest. It was a moon of Qoribu.
Kr was home to the Dark Nest. It was a moon of Qoribu, covered in ethmane ice jungle.

Borao was a world within the Inner Rim that was located between Coruscant and Ramodi. Its surface was covered in yorik coral spires and forests after its Vongforming and abandonment by the Yuuzhan Vong.
Ramodi was a Galactic Alliance planet with a baradium smuggling ring, rimward of Borao.
The Maltorian Mining Belt was an asteroid belt that was located in the Maltorian system, a part of the Lifh sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It was located near Maltoria.
Talu was the planet in Zsinj space where Han Solo executed the Talu insertion mission during the hunt for Zsinj.

The Castle Lands was a region located across the northern steppes of the planet Alderaan. While mostly plains, the Castle Lands also included the Kaamos Territory, north of the Juran Mountains and the Glarus Valley.
Regel Eight was the eighth planet in the Regel system.
Altair 9 was a dark, swampy planet in the Altair system of the Outer Rim Territories.

designation: Non-sentient, semi-sentient, or sentient depending on size of group
x: Bilars were one of the few examples of a true group mind in the galaxy. Evolved from small, vegetarian primates on the tectonically active but highly fertile planet Mima II, each member of the species was a hairless, pink creature with large, dark eyes, a short muzzle, and two…

Harix was a planet in the Colonies that was a strong center of Rebel activity during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, Imperial Major Stafuv Rahz captured a Harix schoolteacher and a number of children to serve as bait for Rebel leaders.
The Agrilat Region, also known as the Agrilat Swamp, the Crystal Swamps or simply Agrilat, was a region located on the northern continent of the planet Corellia.

region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
x: Abbaji was a planet within the Zuma sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was mostly composed of rainforests, including the Irugian Rain Forest, the only place in the galaxy where firethorn trees could be found.

Abraxas was a planet in the Abraxas system situated within the Yushan sector of the Mid Rim Territories. Abraxas was run dry of its rich natural resources by overwhelming mining, and became a base for the Eiattu pirates.
Acatal was a barren, rocky planet, and the second world in the Elrood system. It was owned by Radell Mining Corporation, which extracted raw ores.
Adamastor was a largely aquatic world situated in the Adamastor system of the Core Worlds. Its surface featured a number of oceans.
Adim was a terrestrial planet located in the Adim system, a part of the Inner Rim's Adari sector. It was the site of a town that functioned as a mining colony.

Aesolian was a planet located within the Aesolian system, a part of the galaxy's Wild Space region. It was the homeworld of bulky creatures known as tretons. They had pointed ears and were capable of emitting fierce snarls.
Aguarl 3, or Aguarl III, was a water planet located in the Aguarl system of the Expansion Region.
Ahug was a planet in Wild Space covered in oceans of molten metal. It was the innermost planet in the Kriekaal system.

Azna was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Demetras sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it served as a stopping point in the popular interstellar race known as the Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade, and the event drew many spectators there despite the racing be…
Axtria was a planet located in the Axtria system within the Core Worlds. It had a toxic atmosphere in which Humans required a breath mask.

Averill was a mining world in the Averill system where the Galactic Empire discovered a rich quadrenium lode beneath the crust; quadrenium was refined for starship construction. The native Humans were originally divided into autonomous mine-clans dwelling in inherited mineholds.
Atrakus was a world located in the Atrakus system, a part of the Mikaster sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region.

Atapap I was part of the Atapap system in the Inner Rim. At the dawn of the Old Republic, centuries before the rise of the Galactic Empire, it was, along with Fadden and Aquilae, settled by colonists of the Duros species, which was native to the Core Worlds planet Duro.
Ather was a manufacturing world located in the Ather system, a part of the Atravis sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Asrat was a planet where the Holy Children of Asrat were worshiped. The Children opposed the New Order and were targeted for assassination by the Galactic Empire. Dengar left service as an Imperial assassin rather than kill the Children.

Asmall was an astronomical object in the Inner Rim. By 7 ABY, this important manufacturing center was allied with the New Republic, who had established a defense net around it; the thief Tord Gamb stole information about the net, making him a fugitive wanted by New Republic In…

Asher III was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Asher system, a part of the Sprizen sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance maintained a cell on Asher III.
Ashash was a waterworld located in the Ashash system, a part of the Zarracina sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region.
Arramanx was an urban world located in the Arramanx system. It was a part of the Cronese Mandate sector of the Tion Cluster, within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Arsteni is a planet in the Arsteni system.
Armath was a terrestrial planet located in the Mikaster sector's Armath system, which was situated in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region.

Arkonne III was an Imperial planet in the Arkonne system inhabited by Humans such as business rivals Divina Quri Adner and Phean Tic'Karcta. Phean sabotaged Divina's vehicle, killing her. Wilek Nereus, Divina's beau, put an Imperial bounty on Phean, whom he personally killed.
Arda III was an industrial world located in the Arda system, a part of the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Arda I was a planet located in the Arda system, a part of the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Arcura was an Imperial world in the Arcura system. Reina Gale once sought to pull a con job on the planet, but was hindered by AT-ATs.

Arbran VI was a moonless ice planet that occupied the sixth orbit around the star Arbran. It was the outermost planet in the Arbran system, which was located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Arbran V was the fifth planet in orbit around the star Arbran. It was the second of two gas giants in the Arbran system, located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was orbited by eleven moons.

Arbran IV was the fourth planet orbiting the star Arbran in the Arbran system. A gas giant with eight moons, it was located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Arbran III was the third planet in orbit around the star Arbran. It was located in the Arbran system in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Arbran III's surface consisted of ice, and it was orbited by two moons.

Arbran I was a rocky, moonless planet that orbited the star Arbran. It was the innermost planet in the Arbran system, which was located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Arat Fraca was a planet located in the Arat Fraca system of the Colonies. The Star Morning suddenly reappeared over Arat Fraca a year after leaving Motexx for Gowdawl. Arat Fraca was two sectors away from Motexx.
Motexx was a planet located in the Colonies region on the other side of the Black Nebula from Arat Fraca.

Gowdawl was a planet to which the Koqus liner Star Morning, fully loaded with passengers, was headed from Motexx. The ship never arrived, rather appearing at Arat Fraca empty of passengers 300 days later.
Aquella was a Mid Rim world located in the Senex sector. By 3643 BBY, an aristocrat residing on Aquella offered valuable items as dowry to anyone who would marry his cousin.
Antipose XII was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Centrality sector. It had violet skies, and its native inhabitants used the word "dubesor" as an insult.

Antipose IX was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Centrality sector. The pleasure yacht Arleen made year-long tours from the Oseon system to Antipose IX and the planet Antipose XII.
Anic was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Anic system, a part of the Xan sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim.
Anarak IV was an Outer Rim planet located in the Anarak system of the Wyl sector.

Alc was a jungle planet that was the third world in the Gacerian system. Alc possessed a breathable atmosphere suitable for colonization, but geological surveys reported that the cost of settling the planet would far outweigh any profit to be made from exploiting the planet's …
Ansillivog was a planet in the Ansillivog system of the Expansion Region.
Aris V was a planet in Parmel sector chosen as a possible base of operations for the Laramus Base Irregulars after they left Laramus Base.
Alvor was the fourth planet in the Kidron system. It was a gas giant with thirteen satellites.
Alvorine was a planet located in the Yminis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Amarin was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Tion Cluster's Allied Tion sector. By around 25,130 BBY, it was ruled by the Livien League and was the site of a League victory over the forces of the Kingdom of Cron.
Ansek was a planet in the Mid Rim's Ansek system.

Alurion was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Raioballo sector. The world was covered in vast tar pits. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Raioballo sector lay along the initial invasion path of the Yuuzhan Vong resulting in their conquest of many of the worlds.
Altratonne was a planet in the Altratonne system, orbiting the star Altratonne Prime.

Altora was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Dalonbian sector. It had a warm climate in its southern regions, and plains and savannahs on its surface. Those grasslands were home to the reptilian predators known as altagaks.
Altier was an astronomical object located in the Altier system, a part of the Altier sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region.

Almar was a tropical planet located in the Elrood sector's Almaran system with beaches, oceans, rain forests, and wide plains of orange grasses. The planet was dedicated to the tourist trade and its surface was called Almar Downside.
Alis Point was a planet in the Tamarin sector of the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy and the site of a Rebel base during the Galactic Civil War.

Algor was a planet in the Algor system of the Tion Cluster famous as a homeworld of pirates, smugglers, and lawyers. The Algorian people were known for their disputatiousness, which became the subject of humor throughout the Tion Cluster. It was the homeworld of Shamus Falconi.

Bresan was one of three primary planets in the Pimbrellan League. It was not as hospitable as nearby Dolstan. Its atmosphere could not sustain most humanoid life. Sealed dome cities were built in underground cave systems.

Dolstan was one of the planets of the Pimbrellan League. It was the planet originally settled by the Pinacists, and was dominant in League politics. It was a dry planet, covered in savannas, deserts and land-locked salt lakes.

Swedlan was one of the three primary planets that made up the Pimbrellan League. Located in Kathol sector within the Outer Rim Territories, Its atmosphere could not sustain most forms of humanoid life.
Bront was a planet located within the Bront system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Svivreni sector. At some point by 0 ABY, the Human male Graf Yonna and his family lived on Bront.

Bresallis was a planet located within the Bresallis system, which was located in the Cadma sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was plagued by a criminal underworld run by the Hutts. Ambassador Walads opposed the Hutts, trying to disrupt their businesses.

Buamlon Central was a planet located in the system of the same name, situated in the Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a dangerous world, and was staked by Barosa Warren, a scout serving with the Republic Survey Corps.
Bresnan was a planet in the Wellte-ir system of the Mid Rim, in the Trax sector.
Bresnia was a planet located in the Tandon sector of the Mid Rim.
Breeka was a dry desert world. One of this world's native animals was a distant cousin to the dewbacks of Tatooine.
Bragkis was a gambling planet with a million-credits minimum betting parlor once visited by Han Solo.

Borkyne was location that shared its name with the Borkyne system of the Bes Ber Bikade sector in the Expansion Region. In 2 ABY, Captain Dagon Niriz claimed that Jodo Kast needed an Imperial pardon for a mess made on Borkyne.
Boranall was a temperate world in the Mid Rim. In 3640 BBY, Boranall was attacked by the Sith Empire warship Ascendant Spear in order to suppress rebellion in the Boranall system.

Borcorash was a planet with incredibly beautiful sunsets with an ever-shifting array of colors brought about by atmospheric conditions. It was the blufferavian homeworld. The planet was the location of the high-tech Resinem Entertainment Complex.

Bofa II was a planet that housed an Imperial Cargo Transfer Area during the Galactic Civil War and was the distribution site of Imperial surveillance droids. The BFF-1 bulk freighter Libom was captured there.

Bodrin was a rocky, mountainous planet in Elrood sector's Bodrin system on the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route. Its poor inhabitants worked for the Elrood Quarry Corporation. The bodrite mines operated at full capacity during the summer.
Bnar VII was an astronomical object located in the Bnar system, a part of the Braxant sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Bilios was a planet in the Bilios system of the Tapani sector's Melantha Province. The Justice Action Network once maintained a base on the planet.
Binaros was a planet located in the Kathol Outback.

Bettok was an astronomical object located in the Bettok system, a part of the Velcar sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Human TIE fighter pilot Creb of the Galactic Empire was born at Bettok in 20 BBY.
Beta Rhama was an Outer Rim planet in the Dalchon sector, on the same hyperroute as Nimba Five.
Besn was a celestial body located in the Besn system, a part of the Mayagil sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

The primary planet in the Berea system in the Elrood sector, Berea was a rocky, mountainous world which was owned and operated by Imperial Mining, Ltd.. Berea was often besieged by hail storms and violent winds, and the nighttime temperature often dropped below freezing.
Bendone was the homeworld of the Howler Tree People.
Bengat was an oceanic world where the Aruzan female Manaroo once danced in competitions. She also rafted the planet's stormy waters in between her participation in these events.
Bengely was a seedy world with an underworld that had a dangerous reputation.
Benon was a planet in the Delantine system. It was the closest planet to Delantine itself. The Imperials were supposed to think Trux Zissu fled to Benon after abandoning the Timespan.

Delantine was a planet in the Delantine system. The Alliance sent Granit to Delantine to bolster Rebel sympathy. Trux Zissu was chosen to be the Governor of Delantine by the Alliance after the Battle of Yavin.

Da'nor, also known as Planet X, was a planet in the Delantine system, near Romm. It orbited three stars and thus went through four seasonal changes each day. Stuart Zissu, C-3PO, 4B-X, and R2-D2 crashed on the planet in Escape pod 4. They were rescued from the planet by Granit.
Romm was a planet in the Delantine system with a small Rebel cell. Trux Zissu intended to rally support from Romm, but was captured by the Empire when he entered the system.

Berason was a Mid Rim mining world located in the Eclorar sector. During the Galactic Civil War, Berason—the inhabitants of which politically opposed the Galactic Empire—was subjected to an Imperial blockade that cut off the world's sources of food and medical supplies.

Beltrix III was a factory planet in the Beltrix system, one of the Six Local Systems. It was the site of the Rebel headquarters in the Six Local Systems and also the headquarters of the Holstrum Talent Agency, a front for Rebel recruitment in which Alliance Intelligence Agent …
Tuttin IV was a planet located within the Tuttin system of the Inner Rim, one of the Six Local Systems.
Thabit was a planet located within the Thabit system of the Inner Rim. Local Maiferri Tag was a Rebel spy arrested and executed by the Galactic Empire shortly before the suicide of Keth Beamis.
Belsmuth II was a planet in the Belsmuth system of the Outer Rim. It had an Imperial technical university which warlord Zsinj converted into a pilot training academy.

Bellis IV, also known as Bellis Four, was a planet in the Bellis system of Demetras sector. Prior to the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, Bellis IV was the sight of a conflict but was ultimately freed, in large part due to the actions o…

Begeren was a planet in the Sith Worlds region of the Outer Rim Territories. It was originally part of the Sith Empire, which constructed enormous monuments dedicated to notable Sith on the planet's surface—a project that cost the lives of an estimated hundred thousand slaves.

Beckoning Call Starr 3 was the third planet of the Beckoning Call Starr system, located in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. The planet had a reputation for beautiful women, with which the smuggler Han Solo was familiar.
Bazaar was a trade world located in the Bazaar system, a part of the Halthor sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Barison was a water world along the Feena Run in the Gordian Reach. It supplied fish, seafood, and kelp to worlds in the Back Reach. Its inhabitants were known as the Barisoni. For religious reasons, many of the Barisoni had renounced technology.

Barpine was a planet with shipyards used as the headquarters of the rogue Imperial Lieutenant Lon Donell. Donell engaged in piracy against the New Republic from the bridge of the Immobilizer 418 cruiser Detainer, of which Donell had usurped command.
Barseg was a planet located in the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories, along the Perlemian Trade Route.

Barenth was an Expansion Region world located in the Drannik sector. During the Waymancy Storm of 7811 BBY, its civilian population saw a near complete evacuation by the Galactic Republic as part of the defense of the world against the Signatories of Waymancy, with the Republi…

Baramorra was a temperate, dreary, rainsoaked Galactic Empire planet governed by Admiral Llon Banjeer's nephew, the "Boss". He employed bounty hunters such as Jahnar-Kooda to keep the populace in line; when the planet's elders objected, he had them killed.

Baradas II was the second planet in the Baradas system. The planet was ruled by Baron Rovan Tresario who founded the Tresario Bounty Hunters Guild, an organization of bounty hunters whom hunted down pirates.

Baraboo was a planet in the Core Worlds, along the Hydian Way. This world was the site of the Institute for Sentient Studies, which contained the most comprehensive collection of neurological models in the galaxy.
Bancar was a celestial body located in the Bancar system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Rayter sector.

Bandonia was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Bandonian system. It was a part of the Arrowhead, or the Slice portion of the Core Worlds. Bandonia shared its name with the disease known as the Bandonian Plague.
Balanor was the rainforest planet in the Noonian sector of the Outer Rim Territories in the galaxy. Balnanor was the homeworld of the Force mite.
Baffop was a planet located in the Baffop system, a part of the Tamarin sector in the Outer Rim Territories. In 32 BBY, the Human male Anselm was born at Baffop.

Tanya was a planet located in the Tapani sector's Tanya system. The rebel cell known as Shimper Ale maintained a manor house on Tanya. The planet produced vast harvests of grain and vegetables each year and was an important agricultural producer of the sector.
Tanger was a planet located in the Tapani sector's Tanger system.
Setolio was a planet in Tapani sector's Setolio system.
Rellio was a planet in located the Tapani sector's Rellio system.
Pavia was a planet in the Pavia system. It was located in the Cadriaan Province of the Tapani sector.

Obulette was a planet in the Tapani sector's Obulette system. It was the capital of Mecetti Province and throneworld of House Mecetti. It was in perpetual twilight due to its dim red star. Its orbital shipyards were smaller than those of Tallaan but nonetheless successful.

Nyssa was a planet in the Tapani sector's Nyssa system, in the Mecetti Province. The Sith cult of assassins known as the Mecrosa Order arose on the planet thousands of years before the Battle of Yavin, backed by House Mecetti.
Nista was a planet in the Tapani sector's Nista system. It was located in the Cadriaan Province and was the base of the Rebel Alliance cell, the Pelagia Freedom Force.
Lupani was a planet located in the Tapani sector's Lupani system.
Javis was a planet in located in the Tapani sector's Javis system.
Jappe was a planet located in the Tapani sector's Jappe system. It was a smugglers' haven.
Grella was a planet located in the Tapani sector's Grella system.
Gilliana was a planet in the Tapani sector's Gilliana system in the Cadriaan Province. Settlers from Gilliana colonized Aleron.
Canti was a planet located in the Tapani sector's Canti system. A secret hyperlane ran from Canti out of the sector. The existence of the route was closely guarded by House Reena.
Amador was a planet located in the Chalenor system of the Expansion Region's Immalia sector, and was orbited by at least one moon named Mayvitch 7.

Bevell Three was the third planet in the Bevell system. Jai Raventhorn led a Rebel team to this planet to capture four Imperial agents, but the mission was compromised: only Jai escaped. The four Infiltrators commandos who died included Leong.
Bryx was a planet in the Bryx sector of the Mid Rim.

Brolsam was a planet within the system of the same name in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. An agriworld, it was located on a branch off the Trition Trade Route, between the sector capital Kal'Shebbol and Torize.

Betha II was a barren, dry low-gravity planet covered in yellow-orange rock with very little atmospheric moisture. The planet was located in the Betha system in Corva sector, at the midpoint of the Daranc Run.

Baes Logia was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Baes Logia system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Quence sector. At one point during the Galactic Civil War, the Carosite Rebel Alliance medic Tamo Lan served in a short campaign on Baes Logia.
Babbadod was a colony world of the Inner Rim located on the Hydian Way between the planet Chardaan and the Itani Nebula.
Babali was a tropical planet with an Obroan Institute research base headed by Kroddok Stopa until his death on Brath Qella.

Serroco, the homeworld of the Stereb species, was a planet in the Ploo sector of the Expansion Region. A muddy world, Serroco was constantly buffeted by ferocious storms and tornadoes that often forced the Stereb to retreat to underground shelters and catacombs.
The Eleemosynary was an Imperial Star Destroyer that served as the personal command ship of the cyborg Grand Admiral Osvald Teshik.
Afarathu was a sect of Selonians extremists that terrorized the Corellian system some four centuries before the Battle of Endor.

result: Capture of Barriss Offee and Zonder
x: This mission to the planet of Felucia took place near the end of the Clone Wars.

The Battle of Dubrillion was a battle during the mid-Galactic Civil War in 3 ABY. The battle, in the midst of the Dubrillion Ocean, was an attempt by the Galactic Empire to draw in and destroy a Rebel Alliance task force commanded by General Crix Madine and deal a crippling bl…

The Desrini District was a civic district in the northern hemisphere of the Republic's capital planet of Coruscant, near the CoCo District. In 22 BBY, the entire district was evacuated after a garbage launcher misfired, spreading toxic waste over the area.

R0-4, or R-Zero-Four, was a protocol droid working as secretary of Koth Melan on the Bothan home-world of Bothawui. His metal skin was polished to a gleaming gold. Like all protocol droids, R0-4 could be very literal and inconvenient.
The Professional Greenputt Tour, abbreviated PGT, was one of the many professional greenputt leagues in 22 BBY. It was overseen by the Greenputt Governing Council.

The Female Professional Greenputt Tour, abbreviated FPGT, was one of several major professional leagues for the ball sport greenputt. Founded by the date 13:3:14, the league was overseen by the Greenputt Governing Council.

The Asexual Professional Greenputt Tour, abbreviated APGT, was one of the major professional leagues of greenputt, a ball sport played on a field. The league was overseen by the Greenputt Governing Council.
The Not-Dead-Yet Professional Greenputt Tour, abbreviated NDYPGT, was one of the major professional leagues for greenputt—a ball sport played on a field—overseen by the Greenputt Governing Council.
The Non-Limbed Professional Greenputt Tour, abbreviated NLPGT, was in 22 BBY one of the major professional leagues for greenputt, a ball sport played on a field.
The Non-Sentient Professional Greenputt Tour was one of the major leagues for greenputt, a ball game played on a field.
Nalzin was a captured comet in the Utos system.

Riome was a little, frigid world located in the Dorvalla system of the Outer Rim Territories. The Toom clan set up a hideout here after sabotaging Lommite Limited and InterGalactic Ore's freighters in 33 BBY, but Darth Maul was able to anonymously lead Patch Bruit and other LL…
Narmle was the first of two settlements built on Naboo's moon of Rori. Named for King Narmlé of Naboo, Narmle was the capital city of Rori.

The Trunsks were a species of sentient mammals native to the planet Trunska. Descended from predators, Trunsks were stout, fur-covered bipeds with large ears and nostrils, well adapted to their cold, thin-atmosphere homeworld.
Tolan was a planet located within the Tolan system of the Colonies. It was the location of the Tolan Navy Shipyards, near Dankayo and probably within a few sectors of Ralltiir.
23 Mere was a colony planet situated in the 23 Mere system of the Colonies. The Star Morning stopped at this world on its way to Motexx from Darepp.
Fwiis was a colony world between Darepp and Motexx visited by the Star Morning after it departed Teyr. It was more than 150 light-years away from Atzerri.
New Polokia was a colony world between Darepp and Motexx visited by the Star Morning.
The Iridonians, colloquially called Iridorians, were a warrior people with a particularly bloodthirsty reputation.

The planet Coronar was the site of an Imperial Intelligence base during the Galactic Civil War. After the Empire's destruction of the Alliance to Restore the Republic base on Dankayo, several datapacks were recovered from the ruins.
Bonderium was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by rebel agents to intercept the Imperial transport Elusive on its way from the planetary ruin of Dankayo to the Tolan Navy Yards.

The Elusive was an Imperial Armored Transport ship that salvaged material from the ruins of the Rebel Alliance base on Dankayo. After an attack by Rebel agents in the shuttle Bonderium, the Elusive changed its original course from Coronar to the Tolan Navy Yards.

Timely was an Imperial Armored Transport of the same class as Elusive. Both vessels saw service with the Imperial Navy, participating in a series of intelligence and salvage operations at the former Rebel Alliance base on Dankayo.
The Captain's Pride was an Ugor Black Hole-class Salvage Dreadnought.

Desstious was a world located in the Desstious system, a part of the Lambda sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Human male Par Lankin, who was born in 50 BBY.

result: Galactic Empire victory, destruction of Vergesso Prime
x: The Battle of the Bajic Shipyards was a battle that took place at the Vergesso Asteroids some time after the Battle of Hoth, in which a major Rebel/Smuggler base was destroyed by the Empire.
The Chromans were a species of wormlike humanoids with smooth heads, smooth skin and webbed hands that were native to Chroma Zed. Their eyes were huge and round and their mouths were lipless.
Laramus was the location of Laramus Base, headquarters of the Laramus Base Irregulars, as well as a rapidly-growing Rebel cell. The Visseon II led a Rebel ambush of an Imperial convoy over Laramus.

L9-G8 (Elnine-Geeate) was a cooking droid that was given by the Squib King Ebareebaveebeedee to the crew of the Rebel Alliance shuttle Bonderium during their mission to intercept intelligence datapacks from the Imperial transport Elusive.

De-Purteen was the capital city of Ord Cantrell and hosted many famous resorts. Following the final death of Emperor Palpatine in 11 ABY, De-Purteen served as the capital of the Crimson Empire, which was controlled at that time by the Imperial Ruling Council.

Damualer Triac was a planet located in the Damualer Triac system of the Inner Rim of the galaxy. The Millennium Oak grew on the world. Jedi Master Haaran Balmor retired to Damualer Triac with his second wife, Hannah Balmor.

The Kill Switch was the personal starship of Beilert Valance, a feared cyborg bounty hunter of the Imperial Era. Originally owned by the pirate Alabar Double Ax, the ship was appropriated and renamed after the Sikurdian raider was hunted down by Valance.

The Chorran shipjackers were a criminal band of starship thieves from the Chorra system that operated in Bamula sector in the Inner Rim. They were routed on Donadus by the bounty hunter Beilert Valance.
Fodurant was a New Republic prison world.
Cejansij was the Cejansiji homeworld. It was known for its canyon dwellings.
Smarck was a planet in Outer Rim Territories, Cademimu sector, Smarck system.

result: New Republic victory, Starbuster Plot foiled
x: The Battle of Centerpoint Station, also known as Operation Sidestep, was a battle for the control of Centerpoint Station in the Corellian system and the climax of the Corellian Crisis.
The Moappa were one of the intelligent deep-sea species living in the oceans of Mon Calamari. Telepathic, they formed a sentient group intelligence from the nearly mindless individuals.
The Intruder was a Namana-class light cruiser and the flagship of the Bakuran Defense Fleet.
The Watchkeeper was a Bakura-class destroyer in the Bakuran Defense Fleet.
Sentinel was a Bakura-class destroyer in the Bakuran Defense Fleet.
Defender was a Bakura-class destroyer in the Bakuran Defense Fleet.
The Kwi were the degenerated descendants of the saurian Kwa—Dathomir's first sentient inhabitants.

Dorcin was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, on or near the Rimma Trade Route. It was a Dorcin trader who traded the Squibs starship technology in exchange for mineral rights to a frozen waste on Skor II.
Dorlo was a planet located in the Atravis sector of the Outer Rim Territories and was controlled by the Galactic Empire.
Circarpous XIV was the fourteenth and outermost planet in the Circarpous system. Its fifth moon had extensive volcanic activity which kept it warm and habitable.
Circarpous X was a frozen planet in the Circarpous system with a traffic monitoring station.
Circarpous XII was the twelfth planet in the Circarpous system with a small colony of Rebel Alliance sympathizers.
This battle was one of the final battles of the New Sith Wars.

The Krevaaki were a race of sentients native to Krevas. The Krevaaki people possessed an exoskeleton. The face of a Krevaaki was composed of a series of shifting, chitinous plates with a limited range of expression.

result: Imperial garrison and tibanna gas platforms attacked
x: The Battle of Bespin took place in the time around the Battle of Endor during the Galactic Civil War.

Team Coruscant was a limmie team that played for the planet Coruscant, led by team captain Jipoly Numifolis. In 22 BBY, the inexperienced Team Coruscant competed in the Galactic Cup of Limmie tournament.

Team Fondor was a limmie sport team that played for the Colonies planet Fondor. In 22 BBY, Team Fondor competed in the Galactic Cup of Limmie, where they were matched against the inexperienced team of the planet Coruscant in the opening round.

A limmie team played for the planet Fwillsving in the Galactic Cup of Limmie. On the date 13:3:14, an issue of HoloNet News' CoCo District Edition reported that the team's single-score victory over the planet Kubindi's team inspired a riot that saw that four million limmie ent…

The Daimlos were a sentient humanoid species native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Daimla. They were short, thick, and heavily built, and their large heads were equipped with skullplates and horns.

The Ghishi were a race of warrior-mantids from the planet of the same name. Ghishi were thin and lanky, with long insectile limbs and large orange eyes. Kraid Nemmeso was a Ghishi who became well-known on the podracing circuit during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Blood Carvers were a sentient insect-like race native to the planet Batorine.

The Rhen Var Harbor was an ancient location on the planet Rhen Var in use before the planet was plunged into an ice-age. The harbor served one of many sites where the Battle of Rhen Var took place during the Clone Wars.

Quay was the name of one of Sriluur's moons. As such it became the name for the Moon God and chief deity of the Weequay religion. The word "Weequay" meant "Followers of Quay". The Month of Plenty was a holiday devoted to Quay.
Team Millennium Holos was a professional swoop racing team that competed on the TransGal circuit. Although it once reigned as the top-ranked team in the galaxy, it had lost that status by 22 BBY.

Team SoroSuub was a swoop racing team. It was presumably sponsored by the SoroSuub Corporation. As of 22 BBY, it had become the second-highest-ranking swoop team. During the Clone Wars, the team participated in the Cularin Classic swoop race on the planet Cularin.
Team Kinyen was a team that played the bolo-ball sport—also called limmie—for the Expansion Region planet Kinyen in the Galactic Cup of Limmie tournament.

Team Kothlis was a limmie team that played for the planet of Kothlis in the Galactic Cup of Limmie. In 13:3, during the Separatist Crisis, they defeated the planet of Ord Mantell's team with a single point in the Cup's opening round.

Team Kubindi was a limmie team that played for the planet of Kubindi. According to an issue of the CoCo District Edition of HoloNet News reported on the date 13:3:14, the planet of Fwillsving's team triumphed over the visiting Team Kubindi; the victory inspired a riot wherein …

Team Ord Mantell was a limmie team that played for the planet of Ord Mantell in the Galactic Cup of Limmie. In 13:3, during the Separatist Crisis, the planet of Kothlis's team defeated them with a single point in the Cup's opening round.

Team Ralltiir was a limmie team that played for the planet of Ralltiir in the Galactic Cup of Limmie. In 13:3, during the Separatist Crisis, they defeated the planet of Tralus's team in an upset, with a single score in the Cup's opening round.

Team Tralus was a limmie team that played for the planet of Tralus in the Galactic Cup of Limmie. In 13:3, during the Separatist Crisis, they were defeated in an upset by the planet of Ralltiir's team, with a single score in the Cup's opening round.

Team Yag'Dhul was a limmie team that played for the planet Yag'Dhul in the Galactic Cup of Limmie. On the date 13:3:14, it was reported on an issue of the CoCo District Edition of HoloNet News that they they humiliated the planet Kinyen's team in the tournament's opening round…

The Stassia Classic was a swoop race that was part of the galactic TransGal circuit. Hosted on Stassia, a planet in the Core Worlds known for swoop races, it was preceded by a race on the planet Corulag and took place after a respite period for the circuit, the racsan break.

Goroth Prime, also known as Goroth, was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Goroth system in the Trans-Nebular sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square R-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Denava was a gas giant with six moons. It was the third planet in the Goroth system. It measured 153,050 kilometers in diameter and had strong magnetic and radio fields. The upper atmosphere was home to a beldon-like species of gas-filled creatures.

The Shamed Ones were Yuuzhan Vong who were a caste all of their own. The Shamed Ones were "imperfect" in some way, having failed in another caste, had their bodies reject implants, committed heresy, or were simply physically deformed.
V'Sar was the smallest moon of Goroth Prime. It had a 1,760-kilometer diameter.
Telar was the largest moon of Goroth Prime.
J'Mel was the second largest moon of Goroth Prime.

Fait d'Fait was a Mid Rim celestial body located in the Venaarian sector. Around 3643 BBY, criminal syndicates recruited an off-worlder to help them manipulate a governor of Fait d'Fait, who pursued anti–organized crime policies.

High-hounds (derogatorily called Man-hawks, Stone-faces, or Birdies) were a species of birdlike scavengers native to Aduba-3. They resembled large birds of prey, but had almost Humanlike heads. They had compound eyes, containing many facets which served different purposes.
Terhaari was the moon of Berchest, exhibiting a strong tidal pull on the planet.

Chule was the second planet in the Bissillirus system. It was a cold planet with no geological activity, covered in oceans and barren plains. Its local day lasted 49 standard hours; its year lasted 145 local days.

Dega was a planet in the Dega system of the Elrood sector. Its local day was 19 standard hours long; its year was 295 local days long. The planet was covered in rocky wastelands. It hosted a Radell Mining Corporation mining colony.

Corva was a planet in Corva sector's Galaan system. The Galactic Republic established a colony on the planet which was wiped out by clodhoppers which arrived in a grain shipment from Naboo. The clodhoppers ate all the vegetation on Corva as well as 87% of the colonists.
A half-Bothan, sentient species lived on the planet of Farfalla. It was distinguished by furred, unguligrade lower limbs, long tails, pointed ears and small forehead horns.
Chaasch was the eighth planet in the Suolriep system. Its eighth moon was New Kisge.

Danadine was a world located in the Danadine system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Dail sector. Around 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of Relekin Confidential, a collection agency that constituted a part of the Tenloss Syndicate.

Demonsgate, also known as NCW-86, was a planet in the Outer Rim's Kathol Rift, near Yvara. From space the planet often appeared to be engulfed in flames due to the volcanic activity bleeding ionized particles into the atmosphere that interacted with debris attracted from the R…
Derora was an inhabitable moon in the Birjis system.
Isamu was a moon in the Birjis system. The Mu tree was native to this moon.
Bogg 11 was a moon of Bogden. It often passed close enough to Bogg 4 for the two moons to share atmosphere. Boba Fett, traveling together with Aia, found the stolen Slave I there.
Bogg 2 was a moon of Bogden. It was covered in rocks and dirt. Once per orbit, it passed close enough to Bogg 9 to share atmosphere.
Bogg 9 was a moon of Bogden. It was covered in rocks and dirt. Once per orbit, it passed close enough to Bogg 2 to share atmosphere.

Calabosh-2 was an astronomical object located in the Calabosh system, a part of the Expansion Region's Arc d'Stot sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it was the site of the main headquarters of the weapons manufacturer Caliban.

The Battle of ThonBoka was a battle in 3 BBY between the Oswaft and the Centrality, a client state of the Galactic Empire and the Renatasian Confederation inside the ThonBoka, a sack-shaped nebula that was home to the gigantic spacefaring Oswaft species.
Calfa-5 was a planet that orbited a single star, which baked its desert moons.
Casfield 6 was a planet in the Casfield system. Incoming starship traffic was managed by droids. A six-ship collision resulted in the death of the 6,000 year old Queen of the Offens.
Chateuse VII was a world located in the Tungra sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Cificap VIII was a planet in the Cificap system. After the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel Alliance freed Habassa slaves from the Galactic Empire near that planet, before the slaves could be loaded onto the Mayhem.
Cranan 12, or simply Cranan, was a planet in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim.
Cridark II was a planet in the Cridark system. It was part of the Empire and the homeworld of Denno Yanglan.

Dagelin Minor was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Cadma sector. A shipment of the flying rodents known as Bogan's brown nafen was at one point imported there for the purposes of combating an infestation of dhuru flies.

Dakot Seven was a planet in the Dakot system of the Mortex sector. An academically-minded world, it was the location of Dakot Tech, an Imperial Technical Branch Outpost. It was the site of the Battle on Dakot Seven.

Dalos IV was a hot, humid planet of shallow oceans in the Outer Rim's Nilgaard sector. It had a single rainforest continent, Kavila, and the planet was 7,000 kilometers in diameter. It was originally a penal colony.
Danchian Prime was a planet in the Outer Rim's Dail sector. The bounty hunter Milko claimed to have a family on Danchian Prime, despite being a droid.
Darkon III was a planet of the Darkon system, within the Chaama sector, in the Mid Rim and Northern Dependencies regions of the galaxy.
Dartessex IV was a celestial body located in the Dartessex system, a part of the Slice portion of the Inner Rim.

Delari Prime was a planet in the Delari system of Corva sector, orbiting twin stars. It suffered an asteroid collision thousands of years before the Galactic Civil War, pushing the planet to an orbit closer to the stars, making the planet a desert world.
Delle II was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Colonies' Delle system, which contained massive farm worlds.
Priapulins were a sapient species from the planet Pria, one of the Core Worlds.
Demos Four was a planet with two moons, located in the Mid Rim. It was located on the Dustig Trace, nearby to the Tyus Cluster.
Devon Four was a planet aligned with the Galactic Republic. Several years before the Clone Wars broke out, the government of the planet—members of a religious sect—refused to pay taxes.

Dilonexa XXIII was a large agriworld located in the Outer Rim Territories' Centrality sector. Each year the planet exported billions of tons of agricultural products, and it served as the Centrality's main producer of foodstuffs, with orbital weather-control satellites helping…

Dles IV was a Rebel Alliance penal world in the Dles system of the Periphery. Although the colony was under direct jurisdiction of Alliance High Command, the nearby Sulorine Sector HQ contributed supplies and manpower when needed.
Dlor 3 was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Dlor system, a part of the Mid Rim's Dononter sector. Around 2 ABY, the Secure Passage seminar was scheduled to take place on Dlor 3.

Dononter Minor was a world located in the Dononter Minor system, a part of the Mid Rim's Dononter sector. Dononter Minor had a Type I breathable atmosphere, and it was the homeworld of the plant known as the widowmaker, which could be used as a weapon.
Dragos VI was a planet scouted by Dantaree for the Rebel Alliance.

Dreffon IV was an astronomical object located in the Colonies' Dreffon system. The distance between Dreffon IV and the Outer Rim Territories' Dravian Starport could be traversed in sixteen days using a starship equipped with a Class 1 hyperdrive.

Drup III was a volcanic planet with two moons. It occupied the third orbital position around the binary stars Drup's Star and Drup's Companion in the Drup's Star system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Saijo sector.

Drup II was a gas giant–type planet with five moons. It occupied the second closest orbital position around the binary stars Drup's Star and Drup's Companion in the Drup's Star system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Saijo sector.

Drup I was a searing hot rock planet devoid of moons. It occupied the closest orbital position around the binary stars Drup's Star and Drup's Companion in the Drup's Star system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Saijo sector.

Dzass IV was an astronomical object that occupied the fourth orbital position within the Dzass system. It was a part of the Seswenna sector of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Eislomi III, also known as Eislo, was an astronomical object located in the Eislomi sector of the Inner Rim. It was the site of a HoloNet relay station.
Feenicks VI was a planet in the Outer Rim's Feenicks system.

Ferros VI was a planet that occupied the sixth orbital position in the Ferros system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Ojoster sector. The Galactic Empire maintained a prison camp on the planet during the Galactic Civil War.

Fleyars IV was the fourth planet in its system. It was the location of the Battle of Fleyars IV, in which the Galactic Empire subjugated the planet. The hero of the Battle was Akal Zed, whom took over command of the Seswennan Nightcloak when his captain was killed.
Galvoni III was an Imperial planet in the Core Worlds' Galvoni system with a military communications complex.
Gandrun Two was a desert world that occupied the second orbital position in the Colonies' Gandrun system. Its terrain was dominated by endless sand dunes.
Gedi 4 was a gas giant planet in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim.
Gendius V was a world that occupied the fifth orbital position within the Gendius system, a part of the Mid Rim's Gendius sector.
Gerbaud 2 was a planet located in the Sepan system, a part of the Sepan sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region.

Gerhalt III was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Altier sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Expansion Region. Gerhalt III was situated in the Gerhalt system, which was a part of the Galactic Republic by 17,000 BBY.

Gholondreine-β was a terrestrial planet of the Expansion Region. The native inhabitants of Gholondreine-ẞ were known for their scholars and philosophers, who held that all sentient beings owed their highest loyalty to truth.
Goratak III was a planet in the Goratak system covered in crystalline wilderness known as the Crystal Forests. It was the site of a messy conflict between Rebel and Imperial forces.
Hathrox III was an urban planet in the Hathrox system. Its civilization was destroyed in a biochemical civil war in about 1196 BBY. The planet was quarantined by the New Republic.

Herios IV was a jungle planet located within the Outer Rim Territories' Herios sector. At some point during the Galactic Civil War, a group of slavers brought the Barabel Baraduk to the planet's Imperial colony, but the Barabel escaped into the jungle, stealing several weapons…

Herstell V was a terrestrial astronomical object situated in the Herstell system of the Colonies. It hosted the headquarters of the "Red & Black League," a criminal organization that was active during the Galactic Civil War and was named after the colors of the Herstell system…
High Chunah was a planet on the Corellian Trade Spine in the Javin sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Hintivan II was a cold, heavily forested world that occupied the second orbital position in the Hintivan system, a part of the Corva sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to large trees.
