Hyrol Preen Beta was a planet in the Outer Rim. Its populace was wiped out by Imperial Storm commandos and ZQ infantry droids because of suspected Rebel activity. A spacer, Johin, brought news of the devastation.
Hythrope IV was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Hythrope system, a part of the Hythrope sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region.
Inat Prime was a planet in the Outer Rim's Quiberon sector. Boba Fett had microscopic subdermal trackers placed on Rivo Xarran on Inat Prime.
Insta-7 was a planet in the Insta system where a warrant was issued for the arrest of Glott.
Isen was a young gas giant and the sole planet in the Isen system. Its five planetoid satellites included Isen IV.
Janara III was a planet in the Janara system, covered in rolling hills and green grass, where Matt Turhaya left his daughter in the care of his wife's parents.

Janilis VII was an Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Cronese Mandate sector of the Tion Cluster. It was one of the cradles of the Cronese Human civilization and was part of the Kingdom of Cron.

Jardeen IV was a planet in the Expansion Region's Trans-Jardeen sector. It was the site of the Imperial Army training center, used by the Galactic Empire for teaching the tactics of utilizing walkers in combat.
Jastro III was a Core Worlds planet that was under the administration of a governor of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Jedd Six was a planet that occupied the sixth orbital position in the Jedd system of Wild Space. During the last years of the Galactic Republic, Lexi Fernandin became the first individual to scout the planet.
Jiroch-Saloch, also known as Saloch, was a world in the Mid Rim's Yushan sector. At some point after receiving galactic-level technology, the hunting-oriented Tunroth species colonized the planet.

Jiroch-Kalok, also known as Kalok, was a world situated within the Mid Rim's Yushan sector. The planet was colonized by the hunting-oriented Tunroth species at some point after they had received galactic-level technology.
Jjannex II was a planet in the Jjannex system. The Star Destroyer Stormclaw defeated a pirate attack near Jjannex II.
Jweab VII was a planet in the Jweab system where the pirate Beyla Rus had a hidden lodge.

Kaellin III was a backwater planet in the Malenstorr system in the Mid Rim's Corbett sector, inhabited by primitive Human hunters. The Alliance to Restore the Republic attacked an Imperial supply convoy near Kaellin III.
Kalakar Six was a volcanic moon of Dromund Kalakar in the Outer Rim. It was covered in lava flows, its crust riddled with magma tunnels.
Kalgo 13 was a planet in the Kalgo system. It was the homeworld of Gyla Petro.

Kasiol 3, also known as Kasiol's third planet, was a world located in the Outer Rim Territories' Pelgrin sector. Its surface featured forests and numerous swamps. The local fauna included the herlixx, a species of amphibian omnivore that hunted fish and smaller amphibians.
Kazlin 5 was a planet in the Kazlin system. It was the headquarters of the crime lord Tyu.
Kile II was a terrestrial and geologically unstable planet located in the Jospro sector of the Outer Rim.
Kogan 6 was a planet in the Kogan system of the Outer Rim Territories. Dr. Bromial led an Obroan Institute archeological expedition onboard the Penga Rift to Kogan 6 after the Black Fleet Crisis.

Kol Huro I was the innermost planet of the Kol Huro system. Like other planets in the system, Kol Huro I was harvested for its natural resources during the years leading up to the Battle of Naboo, as the tyrant who controlled the system began mass-producing weapons and battle …

Kol Huro II was the second planet of the Kol Huro system. Like other planets in the system, Kol Huro II was harvested for its natural resources during the years leading up to the Battle of Naboo, as the tyrant who controlled the system began mass-producing weapons and battle d…

Kol Huro III was the third planet of the Kol Huro system. Like other planets in the system, Kol Huro III was harvested for its natural resources during the years leading up to the Battle of Naboo, as the tyrant who controlled the system began mass-producing weapons and battle …

Kol Huro IV was the fourth planet of the Kol Huro system. Like other planets in the system, Kol Huro IV was harvested for its natural resources during the years leading up to the Battle of Naboo, as the tyrant who controlled the system began mass-producing weapons and battle d…

Kol Huro V was the fifth planet of the Kol Huro system. Like other planets in the system, Kol Huro V was harvested for its natural resources during the years leading up to the Battle of Naboo, as the tyrant who controlled the system began mass-producing weapons and battle droi…

Kol Huro VI was the sixth planet of the Kol Huro system. Like other planets in the system, Kol Huro VI was harvested for its natural resources during the years leading up to the Battle of Naboo, as the tyrant who controlled the system began mass-producing weapons and battle dr…
Kol Huro VII was one of seven inhabited worlds in the Kol Huro system.

Korseg IV was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Grohl sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance maintained a base there that was discovered and attacked by a ground force of the Galactic Empire. In the ensuing battle, the Alliance emerged victorious.

Krykis IV was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Krykis system of the Duluur sector, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. At some point, an indoor marketplace became buried on Krykis IV, later being excavated by archaeologists of the Galactic Empire.
K'vath 5 was a planet in the K'vath system, located along the Rimma Trade Route.

Lemmi VI was an Inner Rim planet located in the Hapes Cluster. The rare Millennium blossom grew in jungle there, and immense creatures jumping around the planet's forests caused large numbers of trees to be flattened.

Lockest IV was a planet in the Lockest system. The system was located in the Palamut sector of the Expansion Region. Roark Garnet once claimed to have contracted the Merthian lung infection while on Lockest IV to stop Tax Inspector Mothra from searching his ship.
Lythos Nine was an agriworld in the Lythos system, affiliated with the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Maldra IV was a planet in the Maldra system of the Outer Rim's Shadola sector. Not long after the Battle of Yavin, the Galactic Empire sought to destroy a pirate base on the planet, but discovered the base actually belonged to the Rebels.
Malicar 3 was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, covered in rocky wastes.
Malo VI was a planet in the Malo system where a warrant was issued for the arrest of Tegist Byrg.

Markon IV was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Markon system of the Core Worlds. During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, it hosted an Imperial base.
Marngar III was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Marngar system. It was a part of the Arrowhead, or the Slice portion of the Core Worlds.
Miglar 2 was a planet where Ma'w'shiye lost his facial horns in a speeder bike accident.
Mokk IX was a planet in the Inner Rim Territories. It was an Imperial labor camp covered in work settlements and wastelands.

The Wolvkil was a feral creature that was utilized by the Vagaari in 22 ABY during their attempt to destroy the remains of Outbound Flight. Wolvkils in stasis could be worn over the shoulders of a Vagaari warrior and had a long-snouted head with clawed forepaws.
Big Score was an Action IV transport operated by Antan Azzameen.
Narigus III was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Narigus system of the Outer Rim Territories' Belsmuth sector.

Nimba Five was a planet in the Nimba system in Wild Space with which the hunter Sam Heggs was familiar. According to Heggs, Nimba Five had a time warp, with one time tropical and the other frozen in ice. It was located on the same hyperroute as Beta Rhama.
Nulan VI was a celestial body situated in the Nulan system of the Hook Nebula, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Gorgon was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer and the flagship of Admiral Natasi Daala. Constructed by Kuat Drive Yards over Kuat in 1 BBY along with its sister ships Hydra, Basilisk, and Manticore, these Star Destroyers were part of the Maw fleet, stationed at Maw Install…
The Hydra was one of four Imperial I-class Star Destroyers stationed at the Maw Installation as part of Admiral Natasi Daala's squadron.
Manticore was one of four Imperial I-class Star Destroyer stationed at the Maw Installation under the command of Captain Brusc as part of Admiral Daala's squadron.
Imperial Sentinels were armored-and-cloaked warriors assigned to serve Emperor Palpatine's Dark Side Adepts.
The Scarlet Thranta was a CR90 corvette of the Galactic Republic Judicial Forces.

Oko E was a resort world in the Oko system. It was known for its "wild-water" rafting on rivers of molten sulfur. The cyborg Lobot partook in this activity, likening it to maneuvers he performed on the elusive Teljkon Vagabond ship with Lando Calrissian in 16 ABY.

Omiddelon III was a planet in the Mid Rim whose rotational plane and orbital plane were perpendicular to each other. Its weather consisted of an intensely hot climate, followed by a brief mild season, then an extremely freezing winter, followed by another mild season.

Oor VII was a planet located within the Cronese Mandate, on the Outer Rim of the galaxy. In ancient times, Oor VII was a humming factory world, but millennia of environmental degradation had left it parched and thinly populated.
Oplovis was a world located in the Oplovis system, a part of the Oplovis sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Emperor's Revenge was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer under the command of the former Royal Guardsman Carnor Jax.

The Destiny was an Imperial craft under the command of General Wessel and Imperial Sovereign Protector Carnor Jax. It was used in the hunt for Kir Kanos. Most of the crew were killed on Zaddja by a trap set by Kanos.

The Devaronian Army defended the Devaronian homeworld of Devaron. Kardue'sai'Malloc, later known as the drunkard Labria in Mos Eisley, was a captain in the Devaronian Army, following sixteen generations of family tradition.
The Fefze were an insectoid species who came from the planet Fef. While a single Fefze was non-sentient, swarms of Fefze collectively formed a sentient intelligence.
Oran-µ was the largest planet in the Oranessan system.
Orion IV was a planet in the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories.

Orvax IV was a slave trade planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Slaves were stored in dungeons here before being sold off to slave owners. The slave traders lived in the upper levels of the cities. Members of the T'surr species worked as security staff.
Pencael IV was an Imperial planet in the Pencael system. It was the homeworld of the wealthy Cholus family, including Imperial Commander Senn Cholus and Rebel Scandium Team member Aven Cholus.

Shalm was the planet where Mount Ganton was located, the highest mountain in its range. An Imperial garrison on the western face of Ganton was abandoned after the Battle of Endor, only to become the base of the Pendarran's Revenge, led by Kolor Delan.
Perithal VI was a planet in the Perithal system of the Inner Rim. It was the location of a branch campus of the Institute of Starship Engineers.
Pernam Minor was a planet in the Pernam Minor system.
Plavin 6 was a Colonies jungle world whose native inhabitants preferred to wear loose-fitting clothing. It was the homeworld of the Humans Nashiak Llalik and Saren Llalik.
Prishella III was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Kessel sector. It hosted several garrisons of the Galactic Empire.

Quiberon V was an Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Quiberon sector. The company Gamorrean Interstellar held mining rights there, which it eventually agreed to sell to the bounty hunter Moxin Tark and his expeditor Minas Derel.
Rafa III was a terrestrial planet located in the Rafa system, a part of the Centrality sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Rafa XI was an icy slush planet that occupied the outermost orbit in the Outer Rim Territories' Rafa system. It was the site of a helium refinery and a research installation.

Ralme IV was a planet in Brak sector's Ralme system. Ralme IV was the site of mining operation overseen by Lant Mining Corporation. Two of the miners were the parents of future Brak sector crimelord Qual'om Soach.
Rampa 1, also known as Rampa I, was a planet located in the Rampa Minor system, within the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Regolith Prime was a planet in the Regolith system where Jiliac the Hutt had a listening outpost.
The Senate Select Committee for Refugees (SELCORE) was a committee that administered caring and settlement for refugees in the New Republic.
Renatasia IV was a Human-colonized planet in the Centrality's Renatasia system.
Rend 5 was a planet in the Rend system that suffered famine in approximately 45 BBY. Jenna Zan Arbor created a synthetic source of nutrition which saved the populace.
Resht VII was a planet in the Resht system. It was the headquarters of the Salaktori Hunters Guild, led by Jeslor Salaktori.
Retep III was a planet in the Retep system.
The Order of Shasa was a Force-sensitive cult of Selkath natives of planet Manaan who were duped to serve Darth Sidious during the tenure of his Galactic Empire.
Revkinn V was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories known for its megalopolises.

Rezi-9 was an astronomical object located within the Rezi system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Bajic sector. Wesau T'orrin, an individual participating in the blaster skill event of the Galactic Games on the Mid Rim planet Euceron in 27 BBY, was from Rezi-9.
Ringneldia II, also known simply as Ringneldia, was an industrial planet located in the Centrality, a sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Rol Two was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Rol system, a part of the Noonian sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, it hosted detention facilities used by the Galactic Empire.
Rutal IV was a planet located in the Fferon system. It was the headquarters of Ry-Kooda.

Sapella was a planet located in the Kathol Outback. Remote even by Outback standards, the planet was five days travel from Timbra Ott. Not many merchants plied the route, since more profits were to be had at Jangelle and the Kathol Republic.
Sarko VI was a planet in the Venzeiia sector of the Expansion Region.

Selenius VII, also referred to as Selenius, was an astronomical object that lay in the Mid Rim's D'Aelgoth sector, along the D'Aelgoth Trade Route. A busy spaceport, it was the location of the establishment known as "Arc of Fire" Bar & Grill.
Sepan 8 was a planet located in the Sepan system, a part of the Sepan sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region.
Sestooine was an Imperial world. It was located in the Outer Rim Territories.

Shadren V was a celestial body located in the Shadren system, a part of the Belsmuth sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Salin Corridor hyperspace route linked it to the Belsmuth, Botajef, Katraasii, New Bornalex, Sheris, and Solaest systems.
Shella was a location in the Tapani sector's Shella system.

Sorotarr VI was a planet located in the Sorotarr system, a part of the Yushan sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It was the site of the establishment known as the Game and was a favorite destination for gamblers.

Spinax III was a waterworld in the Spinax system of the Allied Tion sector. It was viewed romantically by many in the Tion Cluster, as it had a famous tradition of leviathan-hunters: for millennia, hunters would take to Spinax's oceans to hunt the planet's immense crustaceans,…

Stalsinek IV was an Inner Rim jungle planet located in the Hapes Cluster. It was the site of the Temple of Stalsinek, which in turn contained a fountain that was the source of legendary healing waters.
Sunaj IV was a planet in the Sunaj system. The Relentless patrolled the vicinity of Sunaj IV prior to the Battle of Hoth.

Tala 9 was located within the Tala system of the Inner Rim. It was the location of a droid-controlled factory. The droids discouraged sentients from visiting by only using droid languages to issue landing codes.

Tantive V was a planet in the Tantive system of Kwymar sector. It was the location of the Battle of Tantive V, after the Battle of Endor. The New Republic won the battle, causing the retreat of Gaen Drommel to Soullex.
Tao-Grant was a gas giant, the sole planet in the Tao-Grant system. It was orbited by at least two moons.
The second moon of Tao-Grant was a moon of Tao-Grant. It was home to a Rebel Alliance base.

Teh'Jar II was a planet that occupied the second orbital position in the Teh'Jar system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Minos Cluster. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire began to use armed patrols to enforce a high technology ban there.
Thebeon 8 was a planet located within the Thebeon system of the Core Worlds with a pro-New Order government. Its ruler was styled "Most High Proctor."

The Covallon were a bestial sentient species rarely seen away from their homeworld. The descendants of swift predatory quadrupeds, the Covallon had a developed capacity for sensing others' emotions, a holdover from hunting in packs.

result: Bespin liberated from the Galactic Empire
Lando Calrissian reinstated as Baron Administrator of Cloud City
x: The liberation of Bespin occurred months after the Rebel Alliance's victory at the Battle of Endor of 4 ABY when the gas giant Bespin was seized from the control of the Galactic Empire by Rebel General Lando Calrissian.
Turak IV was a planet located within the Turak system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Turcan III was a planet located within the Turcan system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the headquarters of the mercenary company known as Churhee's Riflemen.
Usean II was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Tunka sector. It was home to the rocket grass plant and the herbivore lrashtash, which had large incisor-like teeth to frighten predators.
Vastrip IV was a celestial body located in the Vastrip system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Inner Rim.

Vendrak V was an astronomical object that occupied the fifth orbital position in the Vendrak system. The system was located in the Videnda sector of the Outer Rim Territories in the Western Reaches. Vendrak V was the site of a starport that featured at least one large hangar.
Zoraster was a planet located within the Zoraster system. It was situated in the Zoraster sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Human Condi.
Zilior was a planet located within the Uziel system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Zhann was a planet located within the Zhann system of the Colonies and known for its puppet shows.

Zaraksander was an astronomical object in the Expansion Region's Imberlin sector. It was the site of the Fioer desert, and an Eloinie Petro-Munitions munitions factory was located on the celestial body's southern continent.

Zalso was a planet located in the Core Worlds' Zalso system. The Human Kiras Torla, who graduated from the offworld Galactic Outdoor Survival School around 12 BBY and was middle-aged around 2 ABY, was native to Zalso.

Jendar was a planet located in the Nembus sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, it was the site of a campaign between the forces of the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire for the control of the planet.
Mika, also known as Jellyfish Cove, was an Imperial penal planetoid covered with oceans and barren deserts littered with humanoid statues which came to life at sunset.
Jarvanam was a planet located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Astal sector.

The touch-not was a shrub native to Yavin 4. It exuded a caustic resin that blistered the skin upon contact. Mon Calamari were particularly susceptible to the resin. They were amongst the many perils faced by the Rebels of Massassi Station.
The Second Battle of Coruscant was a lengthy conflict in 10 ABY waged between the New Republic and the Imperial Coalition.

habitat: Between underwater mountain ranges on a coral shelf 12 meters deep
x: The Knowledge Bank, also known as Pakoukou, was a sentient native to Mon Calamari that was aware of all events that happened on the ocean world.

Muunilinst was a planet located in the Muunilinst system, in the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim Territories, that was the homeworld of the Muun species. Muunilinst was considered one of the financial centers of the galaxy.

type: Secret society of assassins and poisoners
x: The Mecrosa Order was a dark side coven that served House Mecetti, a powerful noble family on Obulette who swore an oath to protect them with their lives from all who threatened it.
Motesta was a small farming settlement near Arnthout on the planet Tatooine. It was part of the Circle Route.

The trees of wisdom, or Selab trees, were small trees native to Selab, a planet in the isolated Hapes Cluster. Eating the fruit of wisdom trees bestowed increased intelligence on elderly beings; however, some individuals believed the trees to be only a myth.
C-9PO, pronounced as See-Ninepio or Ninepio for short, was a copper-colored protocol droid that was purchased and modified by Brakiss for use on Telti.
The Grand Corridor, also known as the Grand Reception Hall, was the hub of all activity within the Imperial Palace on Coruscant.
The Cuy'val Dar were a group of one hundred individuals summoned by Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett, to come to the watery world of Kamino to train clone troopers for the Galactic Republic.

The Dreaming River Clan was a clan of Dathomiri witches who lived on the planet Dathomir during the time of the New Republic. Around 12 ABY, Dathomir was occupied by the Imperial Remnant, a government opposed to the Republic.
The Misty Falls Clan was a Dathomiri Witch clan village located near the Misty Falls on Dathomir.
Frenzied River was a river on Dathomir. It was the center of the Frenzied River Clan of Dathomiri Witches.

The Delegation of 2000 was the group of senators, many of whom were part of the Loyalist Committee, who created and presented the Petition of 2000 to Supreme Chancellor Palpatine near the end of the Clone Wars.
The Delegation of 2,000 was a group of concerned senators in the Galactic Senate, many of whom were part of the Loyalist Committee.
The Behemoth from the World Below was the name given to a Sithspawn monster that lived on the planet Aduba-3 during the Galactic Civil War.
Helska 1 was the first planet in the Helska system.
Helska 2 was the second planet in the Helska system.
Helska 3 was the third planet in the Helska system.
Helska 5 was the fifth planet in the Helska system. It was a gas giant.
Helska 6 was the sixth planet in the Helska system.
Helska 7 was the seventh planet in the Helska system.
The Battle of Derra IV was an engagement between the Galactic Empire and a Rebel Alliance convoy near the planet Derra IV.
The Flakax were an insectoid sentient species native to Flax.
The Bothan Council, known also as the Combined Bothan Clans, was the legislature of the Bothan species that ruled Bothawui and controlled all the the Bothan sector.
The Gurlanins were a polymorphic species native to the planet Qiilura. At their normal state, they were canines with black fur all over their bodies.
Tun Aduban was the largest city and only spaceport on the Outer Rim world of Aduba-3.

Spacers' Hill, also spelt Spacer's Hill, was a cemetery mound for pilots just outside of Tun Aduban on Aduba-3. It was maintained by the Verpine priest Pera. Any pilot was considered to have the right to be buried on the Hill.

The Whelm was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought in service with the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, it was stationed at the planet Anaxes and led the Azure Hammer Command until shortly before the Thrawn campaign, when it disappeared into the Deep Core to join …
Terrarium City was an architectural marvel located on the planet of Alderaan.

The Armalat species was a giant, green-skinned non-humanoid race that weighed several hundred kilos. Each one of their hands only had three fingers. Some Armalat settled on Ansion, and were represented by Tolut on the Unity of Community's Unity Council.
Jovan III, often called simply Jovan, was a planet located in the Jovan system and was noted for the Jovan Station, built in orbit around the planet.
The Meris were a tall humanoid race with dark blue skin, similar to the Teltiors, with whom they shared the planet Merisee.
The Teltiors were a tall humanoid race. They were closely related to the Meris, who also hailed from the planet Merisee in the Meris system.
Meris I was the first planet in the Meris system of the Elrood sector. It was an uninhabitable ball of searing rock.
Meris II was the second planet in the Meris system of the Elrood sector.
Meris III was the third planet in the Meris system.

Meris V was a chilly, barren wasteland in the Meris system of the Elrood sector. The landscape of Meris V was mostly composed of rocky wastes, and was orbited by a single moon. Meris V remained unexplored, and there remained many undiscovered ore deposits on the rocky world.
The Galacians were humanoids from the planet Gala. Their skin was a distinctive pale bluish tone, which they called "moonlight." They were therefore frequently called "moon people."
M-3PO, also known as Emtreypio or Emtrey, was a masculine M-3PO military protocol droid that served as the quartermaster of Rogue Squadron.

result: Yuuzhan Vong occupied Bastion and cause it near-destruction
Evacuation of the Imperial Remnant from Bastion
x: The Battle of Bastion was the large surprise attack on the Imperial Remnant by the invading extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong. With the support of the New Jedi Order, the Remnant was able to evacuate the Imperial capital of Bastion before its near-destruction by the Yuuzhan Yong.

Ibanjji was a terrestrial world located in the Ibanjji system, a part of the Mieru'kar sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The conditions on Ibanjji were harsh, and it was home to packs of creatures known as varns.
Gna She'starn was a city on the Bothan homeworld of Bothawui.
Sal Vhe'starn was a city on the Bothan homeworld of Bothawui.
Fevye'starn was a city on the Bothan homeworld of Bothawui.

result: Escape of Revan and Bastila Shan
x: Following the destruction of the Endar Spire by the Sith battle fleet in hopes of capturing Jedi Padawan Bastila Shan, the destruction of Taris was an event that took place during the height of the Jedi Civil War.
The Chatos Academy was one of the many ancient and semi-legendary organizations which studied the Force in the time before the Jedi Order.
Had Abbadon was an ancient lost mythic planet, located in the Deep Core. According to some legends, the planet may have been linked to the origin of the Jedi Order or its forerunners.

Ondos was a planet lost long ago. It was located in the Core Worlds. Along with Had Abbadon, it was one of a handful of candidates believed to be the planet of origin for either the Jedi Order or their Force-using predecessors.
The Battle of Iktotch was a minor battle fought during the Clone Wars.
This courier droid was tortured under the supervision of Jabba the Hutt's droid supervisor EV-9D9.
The Hunters were elite members of the Warrior caste of the Yuuzhan Vong, a specially selected elite comprising in total perhaps one tenth of one percent of the caste.
The Nuruodo family, also known as House Nuruodo or the Second Ruling Family, was a Chiss kin-group from Naporar, one of the Ruling Families of the Chiss Ascendancy.
Mariunhus was a vault-spire on Muunilinst, one of the many small cities located out at sea, the foundations of which were built around the cones of active underwater smoker volcanoes.

The Lancer Battalions were units of the Grand Army of the Republic made up of lancer troopers. These Lancer Battalions were used occasionally against the Separatist's IG lancer combat droids and unwieldy columns of battle droids.
Belleau-a-Lir was an island city on the planet of Alderaan, located on Lir Lakir.

Chianar was a pastoral settlement founded on the planet Alderaan for refugees from the Clone Wars in 22 BBY. Years later, during the early Galactic Civil War, several crewmembers of the Alderaanian gunship Aegis hailed from Chianar.
Onacra was a small farming community of about 100 people on Aduba-3. It was not too far from the planet's only starport, Tun Aduban.
Whrr was a librarian droid with masculine programming that worked during 22 BBY in a small library branch on Tipoca City, located on the planet of Kamino.

The Fa-Loh-Sui was the flagship of the Abin-Ral-Xufush. It was a CR90 corvette that originally belonged to an Outer Rim-based Rebel Alliance command before the Shadow Wing seized it. Abin named the ship after his former love interest, Fa-Loh-Sui.
Andoan mineral-fish were a swimming crustacean species native to Ando.
The Anothian living crystals were life-forms from the planet Anoth. They could barely survive on the planet's surface.
The quivry was a four-legged hooved antelope-like creature native to Antar 4 and were hunted by the Gotals to sharpen their senses.

The demonsquid was an eight-armed mollusk native to the planet Aquaris, with large jaws beneath its clump of arms. It was a particularly vicious aquatic predator that attacked anything that came near its den.
The droffi steed was a four-legged reptilian native to Aridus. The steed could store water in its body tissues and it served as reliable transportation for the Chubbits.
The Meeks were a furry species native to Atzerri that stood on two hind legs. They were related to the moochers of Abregado-rae. They foraged through the trash on the Free Trader planet.

The Balmorran metal parasite was a creature native to urban areas of Balmorra. It was a bony creature with two legs attached to its head. It used its sharp teeth to chew through fabrication equipment.
The shenbit bonecrusher was a large carnivorous lizard native to the planet of Barab I. It was covered with bony and thorny plates. It also had two horns and a long tail.
The kretch insect was a scorpion-like insect that could be found in subterranean passages of Belsavis and Aargau.

The crystal barnacle was a species of barnacle that clung to starships in drydocks on Bilbringi VII, a large chunk of ore in the Bilbringi system. The species had a spike-covered body with three pairs of legs.

The tiga loreng was a non-sentient beaked bird native to the planet Bimmisaari from the Mid Rim. The native inhabitants of Bimmisaari banned all weapons of violence and hunting on their homeworld, ensuring that tiga loreng thrived in the wild.

The tortapo was a six-legged tortoise that was one of the last surviving species on Bonadan, which had lost most of its wildlife due to heavily-polluted environments. It was capable of retracting it's head into its shell.
The Borleian imooda was a reptile with a spiked tail that resided in the jungle regions of Borleias.
The krak'jya, also spelled krakjya, was a feline predator native to Bothawui that got its name from the loud bellowing growl it made.
The chrysalide, also known as the chrysalis beast, was a creature altered by Sith alchemy.
The shook was a carnivorous creature native to Carratos. The stealthy, silent predator would jump on its prey from above.
The Atrisian Iron was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.
Prominence was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. It was destroyed by Separatist forces during the Battle of Duro.
Katana was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served in the Judicial Starfleet of the Old Republic. It was the flagship of the fleet that bore its name.
The Peregrine was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served in the Katana fleet of the Old Republic and later as General Bel Iblis's flagship during the Galactic Civil War.
The Anvil was an Acclamator-class assault ship of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. It was destroyed by Separatist forces during the Battle of Duro.
The Coronet was an Acclamator-class assault ship that served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. It was destroyed by Separatist forces during the Battle of Duro.
The Bolide was an Acclamator-class assault ship of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. It was destroyed by Separatist forces during the Battle of Duro.
Dodecapolis was the capital city of the Givin homeworld of Yag'Dhul at least during the Separatist Crisis and the Clone Wars.

The Thrugii Asteroid Belt was a widespread belt of orbiting material in the Socorro system. It was present in three different orbitals, and astrogation reports suggested that they were the remains of three planets, destroyed when the system's primary, Sokor, blossomed into a r…
A battle was a battle fought on the planet of Eres III during the Mandalorian Wars in 3962 BBY as part of Mandalorian Triumph.

The Battle of Serroco, also called the Serroco tragedy, the Onslaught on Serroco, and the devastation of Serroco, was an engagement during the Mandalorian Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders in the year 3963 BBY.

The Battle of Duro was a major battle of the Mandalorian Wars, fought sometime in 3962 BBY. The Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders campaigned across the galaxy from their territory in the Outer Rim to reach Duro in the Core Worlds, a strategy they called Mandalorian Triumph.
The Ghorman's Honor was a DP20 gunship in the service of the Alliance Fleet. It was named after the victims of the Ghorman Massacre.

As one of their three main offensives at the turn of the year 3963 BBY during the Mandalorian Wars, the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders invaded the planet Onderon and its typically Mandalorian-held moon of Dxun.
A battle occurred on the planet Dagary Minor during the Mandalorian Wars, in 3963 BBY. It was one of many early losses for the Galactic Republic as it struggled to fend off the invading Mandalorians.

The attacks on the Zabrak colonies across the Outer Rim by Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders were among the first major battles of the Mandalorian Wars fought during the Mandalorian invasion of the Galactic Republic in 3963 BBY.
Zarsteck was a planet located within the Zarsteck system of the Core Worlds.
Zebitrope IV was a terrestrial planet located in the Zebitrope system, a part of the Centrality sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Zallakesh was a notorious spaceport on Chuzalla.

Xandil VII was an astronomical object located in the Xandil system, a part of the Lambda sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. It shared its name with the Far Xandil sector, which bordered the Lambda sector in 0 ABY.
Xaza IV was a planet located in the Xan sector of the Mid Rim. Around 3.5 ABY, an exquisite oil-burning chandelier owned by Rithgar, the master of the Kothlis Shadowport came from this planet.

Xend was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Inner Rim's Xend system. It was home to insects as well as the winged xendrite, a type of reptavian that typically hanged from tree branches and hunted insects.
Xerton Nine was an astronomical object that occupied the ninth orbital position within the Xerton system of Wild Space. The Braxant Run hyperlane linked the Xerton system to the Qonto system.

Xerxes was a terrestrial planet located in the Xerxes system of the Core Worlds. During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, it had a planetary police force and was the site of a weapons shop.
Xiunsrus was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Xiunsrus system, a part of the Quence sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A small farming village was located there.
Xuaquarres was a planet located within the Xuaquarres system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the location of both the Graveyard of the Dragons and a secret storehouse of Emperor Palpatine.

Yalln was a terrestrial industrial world situated in the Yalln system, a part of the Mortex sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It featured corporate complexes, outside of which stretched vast unsettled territories.

Yaralou was a saturated planet with no moons that occupied the fourth orbital position around the yellow star Baralou, which was located within the Baralou system of the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector.

Yaronn was a Wild Space waterworld whose only significant landmass was a 200–square kilometer–large, forest-covered continent. During the Galactic Civil War, the Claw, a bounty hunter carrying a grudge against a group of smugglers, sent a message inviting them to Yaronn.

Yeshocq was a planet located within the Yeshocq system of the Mid Rim. It was a colonized, forested, temperate planet with a local year that lasted 13 standard months: the local year was divided into 455 local days. Yeshocq was the homeworld qormot species.
Yhifar was a Mid Rim gas giant located in the Juvex sector. It was the site of the Gas Vortex, the eye of an immense, millennia-old storm.
Yityl was a planet located within the Yityl system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was an Imperial planet inhabited by Humans such as Imperial Customs Agent Hewat and her daughter Kora.

Yntrann was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Yntrann system, a part of Wild Space. During the Galactic Civil War, after the Scandium Team of the Rebel Alliance's Special Forces was disbanded, the Ebranite former member of the team Rith Tar'ak was transferred to…
Yorn Skot was a gas giant in the Yorn Skot system near Dargulli. It was a natural source of non-spinsealed tibanna gas.
Yuga 2 was the second planet in the Yuga system. It was covered in rain forests. The world played host to the popular Yuga Planetary Park, a tourist destination visited by Galaxy Tours.
Yurb was an arid planet located within the Yurb system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the razor-tailed tiger of the Dust Pits.
Yutusk was a temperate backwater planet in the Yutusk system subjugated by the Galactic Empire. It was the homeworld of chef Vimran Trell, whom was conscripted in the Imperial Navy.
Yetnis was a planet located within the Yetnis system of the Inner Rim Territories.

The occupation of Bespin was a battle in the Galactic Civil War between the Bespin Wing Guard under Lando Calrissian (who turned to the side of the Rebel Alliance) and the stormtrooper garrison under Darth Vader, which led to the Galactic Empire gaining control of the gas plan…
The Battle of Dantooine was a battle on Dantooine between the New Republic and the Yuuzhan Vong.
Woteba was a planet located in the Utegetu Nebula of Wild Space between Reecee and Adumar.

The attack on Cartao occurred during the early stages of the Clone Wars over the use of a secondary cloning facility owned by Spaarti Creations. Coming across a planet called Cartao, Palpatine "discovered" Spaarti cloning cylinders, and sent a force led by Kinman Doriana there.

The Whipsaw was a Republic Light Cruiser that served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. It was commanded by General Fyefee Tiis and participated in the Battle of Cartao, where it disabled a Separatist Lucrehulk-class Droid Control Ship.
The Redoubt was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that saw service in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. It was commanded by Commander Denn Wessex during the Battle of Boz Pity in 20 BBY.
Radanks were non-sentient predators in existence by the year 27 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War, when the Yuuzhan Vong invaded the galaxy of the New Republic.

Ord Dorlass was a Mid Rim world located in the Iskin sector. Serving as a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost during the Pius Dea Era, around 3643 BBY it was affected by an epidemic of a dangerous disease.
Ord Simres was a planet in the Outer Rim's Brema sector.
The Balti were a species of furry bipeds with prominent tusks. The smuggler Bingo Mehndra was a Balti.

The Lost Jedi were Jedi who lived in the aftermath of the Jedi Civil War. The term commonly referred to members of the Jedi Order who survived under the First Jedi Purge that was waged by Darth Sion and Darth Nihilus' Dark Jedi faction, although the exiled Jedi and former lead…

result: Anakin Skywalker passes the Trial of the Spirit
x: The Battle of Nelvaan took place at the planet Nelvaan in the third year of the Clone Wars. Following the siege of a rain-soaked planet occupied by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, High Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi and Jedi General Anakin Skywalker were contacted by Supr…

The Smugglers' Alliance was a coalition of smugglers that was led by Talon Karrde to represent their interests to the New Republic so they could sell information, move cargo legitimately and liaise with their sponsor.
This battlecruiser was commanded by Captain Mulchive Wermis following the Battle of Yavin.
Ord Torrenze was a planet in the Sertar sector of the Outer Rim.

The Bombing of Telos IV was one of the first battles of the Jedi Civil War. Meant by Darth Revan to be conquered, the civilian target was attacked without warning or provocation by former Republic Admiral Saul Karath under Malak's direct order, marking the beginning of the con…
Ord Traga was a planet, possibly the location of an Imperial base.
The Freeworlds Common Navy was the military body charged with defense of the Freeworlds Territory of the Tapani sector.
Admiral Ackbar was a Victory-class Star Destroyer that served as the flagship of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu of the Galactic Alliance Defense Force following the Yuuzhan Vong War.

The Warder was a Nebulon-B frigate converted to medical duty by the Rebel Alliance. The frigate continued in operation after the transition to the New Republic, and made up part of the fleet assigned to General Han Solo during the hunt for Warlord Zsinj as part of Group Two.
Thrago was a small moon located in the Thrago system of the Unknown Regions with a swirling atmosphere of yellow sulfuric clouds.
Moro Three was a planet in the Moro system where a maintenance engineer serviced the DR919a.

Regulgo was a planet located in the Regulgo system, a part of the Ryndellian sector within the Mid Rim and Trailing Sectors regions. Months after Han Solo departed Kamar in approximately 2 BBY, Kamarians tracked him down on Regulgo.
Ord Wylan was a world located in the Mid Rim's Oktos sector. During the Pius Dea Era, between 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, it served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic.
Ord Zat was a world located in the Ord Zat system, a part of the Jospro sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

result: Most of the planet's population enslaved
x: The planet Jabiim was subjugated during the Galactic Civil War as the climax of a prolonged conflict on Jabiim between the Galactic Empire and the local Jabiimi rebels, taking place in the decades after the Clone Wars ended.
Saras was the name of the Killik hive of weavers and shapers. At one point settled on Ruu, the hive and its Joiners settled on the planet Woteba in the Utegetu Nebula after the Qoribu Truce.

conflict: Plot to begin a war against the Vagaari Empire
x: The Battle of the Redoubt was a battle in 22 ABY between the Chiss Ascendancy, aided by the Empire of the Hand, the New Jedi Order, and survivors of Outbound Flight against the Vagaari Empire.

The Chandrilan Daily Messenger was a daily newsfeed focusing on current Chandrilan news. Morgraine Delefrenquin worked for the Chandrilan Daily Messenger as the Society News Editor, writing the feature section "Your Stars And Mine."
Glorious was a Belarus-class medium cruiser of the New Republic Defense Fleet.
The Counterpunch was a Carrack-class cruiser that operated in Warlord Zsinj's third group.

Nuba City was the capital and the largest city of the planet Nubia. Located on the western side of a mountain range, it was an industrial city. Containing many factories, the city was often shrouded in dense smog.

The fefze beetle were originally a swarm of fefze who were contracted to work on the planet Duro. Fefze were large, beetle-like insects that shared a single group mind; however, due to Duro's pollution, the swarm began to mutate, losing their sentience and becoming aggressive …
Cannibal arachnids were an immense insectoid species native to Duro that were eventually driven to extinction by that planet's pollution.

The Battle of Tusken's Eye was a battle preceding the Swarm War, fought at the gas giant Tusken's Eye between the pirate forces allied with the Dark Nest and the DR919a crewed by Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Jae Juun, Tarfang, C-3PO and R2-D2.

The Bright Lands was the name given to the side of Ryloth that was baked in constant sunlight during the daytime. Traditionally, Twi'lek clan leaders were sent here to die if one of their fellow clan leaders had died, either from natural causes or in some cases, assassination.

Mon Karren was an MC80 Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in the Solo Fleet, the less heavily-armored sister ship to the Mon Remonda. During the hunt for Warlord Zsinj she was assigned to Group One of Solo's Fleet.
A Jawa camp was a type of Jawa settlement on Tatooine. A common misconception among outlanders was that Jawas lived their entire lives aboard their treaded homes.

Morymento was the capital city of the planet Kerilt. It was a Caamasi Remnant community under Trustant Elegos A'Kla, and included a spaceport and a warehouse district. It received shipments of supplies semi-annually, making it a target for pirates.
Melodies were a humanoid water-based species native to Yavin 8. The species lived deep within the purple mountains of their homeworld, most notably Sistra Mountain.

The Wild Knights was an ad hoc starfighter squadron, made up of Force-sensitive pilots, that was founded and trained by the Barabel Jedi Knight Saba Sebatyne. The members of the squadron were all trained in the use of the Force by either Saba or Eelysa.

The Laboi were a species of sentient, fur-covered, serpentine mammals. They ranged from two to ten meters long, but despite their size, a lack of limbs limited them to manipulating only simple technology that depended on grasping basic tools with the tail or mouth.

The Iyra were a species of sentient cephalopods from the watery planet F'tral. Each Iyra had four or more limbs that spread from the radially symmetrical body, an arrangement that made each member of the species one to two meters in diameter.

class: Centauriform: equine lower body and humanoid torso
x: The Chironians were a sentient species distinguished by their centauriform anatomy; while their torso, arms and head resembled those of a humanoid, their lower body was that of a four-legged equine.

x: The Third Battle of Yavin occurred in 23 ABY when the Dark Jedi Master Brakiss led the Shadow Academy and the Second Imperium on an assault against Jedi Master Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum on the jungle moon of Yavin 4 in the Outer Rim.

The Invasion of Yavin 4 took place at the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4 during the Yuuzhan Vong War in 26 ABY. The Yuuzhan Vong and Peace Brigade conquest of the jungle moon was partially due to the fact that the New Republic was unwilling to provide aid for the New Jedi Order.

x: The Mission to the Chaykin Cluster was a two-part conflict in the Clone Wars. The objective of the first part, Operation Ghost Ship, was to retrieve the Prosecutor data cores. This involved the clone commandos of Delta Squad splitting up.

Redcrested cougars were large, non-sentient, carnivorous felines native to the Outer Rim planet Belkadan. Armed with large claws, fangs, and a bone-tipped tail, the cougars dwelt in Belkadan's jungles and occasionally attacked sentient beings.
R5-L4, also called Elfour, was an R5-series astromech droid who frequently served on Kyp Durron's X-wing during his time in the Dozen-and-Two Avengers.

Kyp's Dozen, also known as the Dozen-and-Two Avengers, were a starfighter squadron in the New Republic, founded by Kyp Durron and his apprentice Miko Reglia. The name was derived from the simple fact that the squadron consisted of 14 pilots.
The Jal Shey were an ancient order of users who studied the Force from a purely intellectual perspective, forsaking the more spiritual paths taken by the Jedi and Sith.

The Empire Youth were Force-sensitive members and minions of Lord Hethrir's Empire Reborn faction. Members of the organization were recruited from the top Proctors and were distinguished by their knee-length pale blue coats.
The Reconstruction Authority was the committee created by the Galactic Alliance after the Yuuzhan Vong War to help rebuild the galaxy from the devastation resulting from the war.
