1st death of Palpatine in a clone body
x: The Battle of Pinnacle Base was fought between the New Republic and the forces of the Reborn Emperor Palpatine over the Republic base at the Pinnacle Moon. Some event of the battle was foretold by Bodo Baas's Master.
The Caamasi Remnant was the term given to an association of individual communities of Caamasi refugees who survived the orbital bombardment of Caamas during the Galactic Civil War.
Wyveral was a planet located within the Wyveral system of the Mid Rim where many advances in forensic medicine were made.
Worru'du was a planet located within the Worru'du system of the Core Worlds and known for its grass fields. The grass from Worru'du could be used for basket weaving.
Wodenstam was a world located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Skine sector.
Skynara was an astronomical object located in the Skynara system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Skine sector. It was situated at the endpoint of the hyperlane known as the Five Veils Route.

Lucrenn was a world located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Skine sector. Around the year 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of Galindas Exports, a fencing operation and member of the criminal Tenloss Syndicate.
Wei was the second planet in the Gacerian system. It was a world of arid, rocky wastes with no moons.

Vuffi Raa was a specially designed and constructed droid thought to be an agent of the extra-galactic droid species known as the Silentium, who created him to explore the galaxy and learn about other civilizations for his "parental" droids.
The Battle of Ylesia was started after the New Republic and Chiss Ascendancy raided Ylesia during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

The Superior was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer belonging to the Imperial Remnant's naval fleet. In 28 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Superior participated in the Battle of Bastion, in which the Yuuzhan Vong assaulted the Imperial capital planet of Bastion in the Sart…

The Battle of Esfandia was the final rout of the Yuuzhan Vong fleet under B'shith Vorrik. Vorrik's fleet had been detailed to subdue the Imperial Remnant, and although Vorrik won the initial battle, the Imperial Starfleet under Grand Admiral Gilad Pellaeon had been slowly wear…

Wrack was an interdictor cruiser that served in the Navy of the Imperial Remnant during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Commanded by Captain Mynar Devis, it was equipped with at least three TIE/D Defender starfighters.

DR919a was the ship used by Jae Juun and Tarfang after the destruction of the XR808g. DR919a was a Damorian Ronto-class transport that was sacrificed in order to let the passengers board the Dark Nest hiveship.
Tytun was a gas giant, the fifth planet in the Gacerian system. It had eight moons.
Tun was an arid planet of rocky wastes. It was the first planet in the Gacerian system. It had no moons.
Rue was the sixth planet in the Gacerian system. It was a frigid rock planet with no moons.

Weerden was an Imperial planet located within the Weerden system of the Core Worlds, near Coruscant. It was here that an assassin droid killed Grand Inquisitor Laddinare Torbin by crashing his shuttle, Sark-I into Torbin's palace.

Wann Tsir was a planet located in the Wann Tsir system, a part of the Sepan sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region. During the Galactic Civil War, Wann Tsir was protected by a planetary shield.

Vykos was a planet located within the Vykos system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a stopping point on the Relgim Run of the luxury liner Kuari Princess, a planet of fast-flowing rivers (such as the Tueinami) which attacted white-water rapid rafters and deep canyons (such…
Vundaria was a planet located within the Vundaria system of the Inner Rim Territories which exported fire lamps.

Vulcar was a baleful orange, sulfurous planet located in the Vulcar system, within the Juvex sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim in the Western Reaches. A hyperlane branching off the Senex-Juvex Loop connected it to the worlds of Tinallis and Tyluun.
Freedom was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer that served in the New Republic's starfleet. Prior to its New Republic service, the ship served in the Imperial Navy under the name Avarice.
The Sentinel was an Interdictor cruiser serving the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy during Grand Admiral Thrawn's campaign against the New Republic in 9 ABY.

Black Wing Squadron, was an elite fighter wing serving on board the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Chimaera. It was led by Lieutenant Creb, who based the squadron off of Rogue Squadron, an elite wing of the New Republic. It composed of TIE/LN starfighters.
Tyrant's Bane was an Assault Frigate in the New Republic Defense Fleet.
Liberty Star was an Assault Frigate in the New Republic Defense Fleet.

The Juliupper was a shuttle equipped with ion drives and a titanium-alloy hull. In 25 ABY, it was one of several starships that attempted to evacuate the residents of the Outer Rim Territories planet Sernpidal, which was located in the Julevian system, while the planet was des…
The Nediji were a species of bird-like sentients that were distinguished by a stubby, keratinous beak and skin that was covered in light, azure-colored down.

The Yoggoy hive was a Killik hive on the planet Yoggoy. In 27 ABY, the Tachyon Flier crash-landed on Yoggoy, with Raynar Thul, Lomi Plo, and Welk onboard. The Yoggoy then absorbed Raynar and became the first hive of the Colony.
B-4D4-GE3 was a GE3-series protocol droid working for Czerka Corporation and a secretary of Jana Lorso, the Czerka representative on Citadel Station.

The first planet of the Calline system orbited so close to the primary, it was hazardously hot and uninhabitable. The world had a dense metal core, making it, in theory, suitable for mining with extensive precautions.
The third planet of the Calline system was a gas giant planet. It had no moons. Trace amounts of industrial grade gases were in its atmosphere.
Callonia was a planet in the Fakir sector of the Colonies. The GX1 Short Hauler, Long Shot, originally belonging to an Imperial admiral, was stolen by Reekeene's Roughnecks at Callonia's spaceport.

Calonica was an Expansion Region celestial body located in the Vensensor sector. During the Galactic Civil War it was the site of a Galactic Empire capital that was surrounded by fifty thousand buried LX-2 comlink mines.
The Eleven, or the Bellassan Eleven, was a resistance group against the Galactic Empire formed by Ferus Olin, Roan Lands, Wil Asani and eight others on the planet Bellassa.
Deneter was a planet located in Wild Space that was orbited by twenty uninhabited satellites. It was located in a nebula near the Red Twins.

Carnth was a Mid Rim world located in the M'shinni sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire's prefect on Carnth promised the farmers of a local village substantial rewards for remaining loyal to the Empire, which hampered the Rebel Alliance's efforts to estab…

I-5YQ (pronounced Eye-Fivewhycue), or I-Five, was a modified 5YQ-series protocol droid that had his creative dampeners disabled by information broker Lorn Pavan. Finding a kindred spirit in I-Five, Lorn made him his business partner and treated the droid as an equal.

Carsanza was a minor industrial world located in the Carsanza system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. Hyperlanes connected Carsanza to the Malador, Valorsi, and Zyluria systems.
The Ylesian Senate was the legislative body of the Ylesian Republic, formed out of the sixty former members of the Alliance of Twelve. It was based in the Palace of Peace in Peace City.

Clone engineers, also known as combat engineer clone troopers, were clone troopers of the Grand Army of the Republic that specialized in military engineering, repairs, and demolitions work, filling a supportive role in the Galactic Republic's military during the Clone Wars aga…

The Battle of Borosk was a major battle fought in 28 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War. After the disastrous Imperial rout at the Battle of Bastion, the Imperial Starfleet regrouped at Yaga Minor before it fell back to Borosk, a major Imperial stronghold.
Yractos was a locale on the Expansion Region planet Gyndine. In 22 BBY, a Thalassian slaver was arrested in Yractos, unearthing a slaving ring scandal.
G'ai Solem was one of a number of cities located on the planet Solem, and was known as an Imperial stronghold.
Talon Squadron—also called Talon Squad—was a New Republic X-wing starfighter squadron formed shortly after the Battle of Thyferra.
Acherin was a terrestrial planet located in the Red Twins system in Wild Space.

Eluthan was an ancient walled city on the planet Acherin, built on a plateau. It was known for its strength as well as its beauty. The city was built with gray, blue, and bronze stones that awed many who looked upon it for the first time.

Chabosh was a planet located in the Chabosh system within the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. The planet was the site of the Battle of Chabosh where Sith Lord Tulak Hord, his apprentice Ortan Cela, and their Dashade Shadow Killers Khem Val and Veshikk Urk led Sith Empire to vi…

The Lost Lady was an old dilapidated Dartiss-5 Caravel used to transport illicit cargo and passengers between Nal Hutta and the Smugglers' Moon, Nar Shaddaa. It operated during the early years of the New Order.

t: Battle of Yaga Minor (Yuuzhan Vong War)
x: A minor skirmish was fought at Yaga Minor in 28 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War. After the Imperial Remnant had badly beaten the Yuuzhan Vong fleet under B'shith Vorrik at the Battle of Borosk, Vorrik withdrew his remaining forces to Yaga Minor.

result: Jamaane faction victory, ascension of Shimmra Jamaane as Supreme Overl
x: The Jamaane coup was a coup against Supreme Overlord Quoreal by Domain Jamaane which made Shimrra Jamaane the Supreme Overlord of the Yuuzhan Vong. It occurred in 29 BBY.

The Mandalorian Crusaders were the first documented type of Mandalorians, established by Mandalore the First, sometime after 7000 BBY and under the command of Mandalore the Conqueror, later Mandalore the Indomitable, they eventually became involved in the Great Sith War and fo…

Mon Mothma was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the New Republic Defense Fleet and later the Galactic Alliance, named for Rebel Alliance and New Republic leader Mon Mothma. It played a major role in a number of conflicts in the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The Battle of Ylesia was fought in 0 BBY at the planet Ylesia by the Alliance to Restore the Republic against the t'landa Til and their Cult of The One and The All that was based on that world.

result: Capture of Ord Biniir by the Alliance
x: During the Galactic Civil War, the First Battle of Ord Biniir—also known simply as the Battle of Ord Biniir—took place when a group of Rebel Alliance Y-wing starfighters attacked the Imperial-controlled planet Ord Biniir.

The New Republic Ruling Council was the senior decision making body of the New Republic and was composed of the Chief of State and and the senators that chaired each of the six sub-committees of the New Republic Senate.

Vaenrood was a planet in the Vaenrood system, which was located in the Pakuuni sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Several months before the liberation of Kal'Shebbol, capital of the Kathol sector, the New Republic fought the Galactic Empire on Vaenrood.

Valera was an astronomical object located in the Valera system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. At some point between 19 BBY and 3 ABY, an uprising against the Galactic Empire took place on Valera.

Varlinaar was a planet located within the Varlinaar system of the Outer Rim Territories. Rorworr once smuggled a team of Rebels into the Imperial base on the planet under the pretense of bringing the Imperials rare foods.
Vasch was a planet located within the Vasch system of the Outer Rim Territories. A world of lush, green, rolling hills, it was the source of Vaschean rye, and was possibly the homeworld of Sam Heggs.

Vatleria was a dark and foggy planet located within the Vatleria system of the Outer Rim Territories. Long abandoned by its inhabitants, the world eventually became the site of an Imperial base in its stone ruins.

Vedis IV was a planet located in the Vedis system, which was part of the Mayagil sector in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. Around 3 BBY, the smuggler Toob Ancher was known to have left Soco-Jarel Spaceport with the YT-1300 transport Glory to reach the planet.

Velga Prime, also known as Velga, and sometimes known as the Gamblers' Moon, was a moon located within the Velga system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim.
Vendred was the first planet in the Bissillirus system, a barren globe that was orbited by a single unstable moon. The planet had a local year of fifty-six standard days.
Venzeiia 2 Prime was a planet located within the Venzeiia system of the Expansion Region that was subjugated by the Empire after the Battle of Hoth.

Verdanth was a rainforest planet in the Verdanth system. It was located on a strategic position on the Duros Space Run and the Sanrafsix Corridor and near the intersection of the Grumani, Sanbra, and Bon'nyuw-Luq sectors. Verdanth's indigenous species included rimebats.
Vessitoar was a planet located within the Vessitoar system of the Mid Rim with a New Republic military training facility.
Charenthoth was a celestial body located in the Charenthoth system, a part of the Slice portion of the Colonies.
Charis was a planet in the system of the same name on the Trition Trade Route in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Choi was a world located in the Inner Rim. It was the homeworld of the Choi species.
Chromovon was a planet that contained an Imperial prison.

Chryya was a planet with a thriving spice business. It was located in the Mid Rim, on the Hydian Way near the border of the Outer Rim Territories. Darth Maul was once sent on a mission to this planet by Darth Sidious to convince the miners to sell to the Trade Federation.
Chynoo was a settlement on Jomark. Its inhabitants modified a SoroSuub Corporation speeder bike in honor of Joruus C'baoth when he came there.

Restuss was the second settlement founded on the Naboo moon of Rori. It was in this city that the Battle of Restuss took place between Imperial and Rebel forces during the Galactic Civil War, which left the city in ruins.
The Pulsar Skate was a modified Baudo-class star yacht owned by Booster Terrik and later inherited by his daughter Mirax.

The Republic Army, known as the Republic Armies, was the collective ground forces of the Galactic Republic from its founding in 25,053 BBY until its dissolution during the Ruusan Reformation in 1000 BBY.

Lutris was a locale on the Expansion Region planet Tynna. Shortly before the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems broke out in 22 BBY, the Tynna Central Government Building, which was sited in Lutris near Lutris Lake, collapsed du…

A battle at Tholatin was fought late in the Yuuzhan Vong War. In the battle, the Mandalorian Protectors under the Galactic Alliance led by Boba Fett liberated the planet Tholatin from Yuuzhan Vong control.
The defense of Gyndine was fought late in the Yuuzhan Vong War. In the battle, Mandalorians, under Boba Fett, liberated the planet Gyndine from Yuuzhan Vong control.
Fondor City was the capital city of the planet Fondor. Creed Mitsun lived there. Renowned for its vices, Fondor City was a common recreational destination for off-duty Fondorian workers.

A battle took place over the Expansion Region planet Tynna during the Yuuzhan Vong War in 25 ABY. Launching the offensive as part of a plot to sway the New Republic into believing that the Corellian system was their eventual target, the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong defeated Tynn…
The Battle of Gyndine was an early battle of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Late in the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Mandalorian Protectors under Boba Fett liberated the planet Ord Mantell from Yuuzhan Vong control.

t: Battle of Ord Mantell (Yuuzhan Vong War)
x: The Battle of Ord Mantell was a battle fought during the first year of the Yuuzhan Vong War. It marked the first use of a qworlth skaal during the war.
Ri'Dar were sentient flying primates from the forests of the planet Dar'Or. As adults, they had a wingspan of three meters and were approximately one meter long, counting their furry tails.

The Hapan Royal Navy, also known as Hapan Fleets, Hapan Royal Fleet or the Consortium Navy, was the primary military forces of the Hapes Consortium, a matriarchal monarchy based in the Hapes Cluster of the Inner Rim.

The Song of War was a Hapan Battle Dragon produced by Olanji/Charubah that served as both a flagship in the Hapes Consortium's Royal Navy and Hapan Prince Isolder's cruiser from 8 ABY to at least 25 ABY.

The elix were rare predatory birds that hunted in flocks. During the Imperial era, their homeworld was threatened by a supernova explosion. In order to preserve the species, a population was established on the Imperial Species Preservation Zone planet of Dar'Or.
Sedrians were a people native to the oceans of the planet Sedri.
The Clar was an astronomical object located within the Clar system, a part of Wild Space. It was the site of the Vivab deserts, a zone of ice-swept plains.
Clendor was a planet in the Inner Rim, near Taanab.
Contruum Six was a planet in the Contruum system.
Coomputu was the fourth planet in the Outer Rim Garnib system. It was a frigid and rocky world, orbited by one moon.

The planet Corjain was located within the system of the same name in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories, just off the Trition Trade Route. Barely habitable, the planet supported a large mining industry, with all settlements located deep underground.

The Mission to Prefsbelt IV took place when the Rebel pilot Wedge Antilles, coordinated by General Madine, attempted to reclaim the Imperial shuttle Tydirium. Antilles infiltrated the Academy through the southern mountain pass and avoided detection by the Sensor Outposts.
The Battle of Aargonar took place early in the Galactic Civil War, almost simultaneously with the Battle of Yavin.

Calamar was the capital city of Esseles. The planet's pleasant climate and rich history conspired to make Calamar a center of high culture, and its suburbs were dominated by vast parks, art centers, holo-production companies, and places of higher learning such as the Darpa Cen…
The Boolarg was a YT-1210 light freighter owned by Gaber Rollobad. The Sullustan smuggler used it to run goods across the Core Worlds until it was shot down by Imperial forces over Corellia.

The Battle of Korda Six was a battle of the Mandalorian Civil War. The True Mandalorians led by Mandalore Jaster Mereel were ambushed by the splinter Death Watch group led by Vizsla on the planet Korda Six.
The Battle of Concord Dawn was a battle of the Mandalorian Civil War.
Vengeance was the code name used by a strike team of Imperial Intelligence operatives working for Moff Vilim Disra and the Imperial Remnant during the Caamas Document crisis of 19 ABY.

result: Empire of the Hand and Chiss Ascendancy victory
x: A battle was fought around 4 ABY between the Empire of the Hand and Chiss Ascendancy with the Ssi-ruuvi Imperium at Lwhekk, capital of the Imperium.

A raid was launched on Nomad City by the forces of Grand Admiral Thrawn to prepare for his attack on Sluis Van. In order to capture the New Republic ships stationed in the shipyards at Sluis Van, Thrawn needed mole miners.
The Second Battle of Nomad City was a raid launched by Grand Admiral Thrawn to supply his shipyards in the Bilbringi system with much-needed hfredium and kammris.

The Coruscant Health Office was a health agency active on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Republic. It controlled outbreaks of disease effectively in the world's spaceports, where they were frequent due to the risk of contagion.
The Republic Spacelane Bureau was the branch of the Galactic Republic to process and map the galaxy and its hyperroutes.

The Republic Measures & Standards Bureau (RM&S) was the branch of the Galactic Republic government responsible for maintaining common units of measurement, including time (and presumably weighting, money, and other similar quantities).

Mandroxan was a criminal alliance formed by the Anavill Smuggler's Guild, the Droxian Traders League, and Manliss Enterprise. Artur Manliss, head of Manliss Enterprise, operated as the cartel's de facto leader in its illegal production and transportation of spice.

Teljkon Vagabond was the name given to a 1,500-meter organic starship created by the Qella to house their species' culture and history when their homeworld of Brath Qella plunged into a sudden ice age.
Drackmarians were a methane-breathing reptilian species that hailed from Drackmar. They were recognized as ferocious warriors.
Corri was a gas giant in the Outlier systems of the Corellian sector.

The Third Battle of Ruusan was one of the final battles of the New Sith Wars. Following the previous engagement over the planet of Ruusan, the victorious Sith forces established a surface base and kept their fleet in orbit.

The Second Battle of Ruusan was one of the final battles of the New Sith Wars. Following the previous engagement over Ruusan, the Republic tried to retake the planet. However, their fleet was defeated by the larger Sith fleet orbiting the world.
The First Battle of Ruusan occurred in 1002 BBY as one of the final battles of the New Sith Wars and the first engagement of the last campaign of the war.

Bissops were non-sentient lizard-hounds used by the sentient Yuuzhan Vong species. Bred by the Yuuzhan Vong to track and hunt living creatures, bissops were carnivorous and had snouts that they used to seek prey.

The Battle of T'olan took place early in the Clone Wars, sometime around 22 BBY, when the Galactic Republic fought at T'olan, a location in the Wuun system. During the fierce conflict, a captain in the Republic Military, the mother of a boy named Trever Flume, was killed.

Threfal was a world located in the Threfal system, a part of the Mid Rim's Iska sector. Threfal had a Type I breathable atmosphere and was the homeworld of the plant known as the meatvine, which could be used as food.
Trebela was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Trebela system, a part of the Altier sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region. A city on Trebela served as its capital.
Cujicor was a planet in the Pakuuni sector of the Outer Rim.

Dilbana was a planet in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim. Located along the Triellus Trade Route, the planet was under a de facto rulership overseen by Jiliac Desilijic Tiron. This form of rule ended with the Hutt Lord's death at the hands of Durga Besadii Tai.
Elokas was one of three habitable planets in the Sabrixin system in Samix sector. It was one of three worlds where crime was controlled by the Sabrin Ring.
Fenves was a planet located in the Boeus sector of the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Devaronian bounty hunter Tyrn Jiton.
Ganlihk was a planet in the Dantus sector of the Outer Rim.
Gortamni was the icy sixth planet in the Wild Space's Gorsh system.
The Peragus asteroid field was a formation of fuel-rich asteroids that was created after the first attempt to set up a mining station on Peragus II.
TC-16 was a silver protocol droid owned by Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray in his citadel on Cato Neimoidia in 19 BBY.
Mantarran was a planet where Moranda Savich managed to avoid capture by Hal Horn.
Minntaa was a Human-inhabited planet liberated by the Rebel Alliance when Imperial Colonel Jeph Shannessi was assassinated by the Alliance Special Forces.
Nelfrus was a planet located in the Nelfrus system of the Elrood sector, a part of the Metharian Nebula Territories region of the Outer Rim Territories.
Phemis was a backwater planet in the Core Worlds region of the galaxy, within the Corellian sector. Phemis was the only planet where rubat crystals, a type of kyber crystal, could be found.
Seline was a remote outpost planet—cold, rocky, harsh and barren—with a Jedi starport, located in the Dalonbian sector of the galaxy's Tingel Arm.

Tranthellix was a Mid Rim world situated in the Senex sector. It was the homeworld of the large carnivorous birds known as the Tranthebar mountain rippers. The world was owned by House Petro of the Senex-Juvex region and was the site of sky cities.

Cuirilla was a celestial body located in the Cuirilla system, a part of the Mbandamonte sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. It shared its name with the tug model known as the VR-10 Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-class spacetug.
A small city on the planet Chandrila, Nayli was known as being one of the three main spaceports on-planet.
Old Town Factoryville was a heavily industrialized, urban area on the planet Eriadu.
Matza was a city located on the world of Rodia. It was situated on the southwestern coast of the Encheeko continent.

Nagan was a Strike-class medium cruiser in the Imperial Navy. Nagan, along with Shotel, were sent to reinforce the Immobilizer 418 cruiser Red Claw position and assist Maarek Stele in destroying the Kopsh.

Quednaks, also called riding beasts, were six legged, reptilian herbivores used by the Yuuzhan Vong as beasts of burden. They transported passengers and cargo. Though they were massive, they could reach speeds of forty kilometers per hour.

Courage was a Thranta-class War Cruiser and the sister ship of Valiant and Fidelity. Manned by droid crews, the three ships served as the escort of the Alderaanian War Frigate Another Chance, which was carrying all of Alderaan's leftover weapons after that world disarmed in th…

Fidelity was a Thranta-class War Cruiser and the sister ship of Valiant and Courage. Manned by droid crews, the three ships served as the escort of the Alderaanian War Frigate Another Chance, which was carrying all of Alderaan's leftover weapons after the world disarmed in the…

Grungeon Block was a a twenty-square-kilometer area of The Works on Coruscant. It had once housed production centers for Serv-O-Droid, Inc., Hunvicko, and Nebula Manufacturing. The manufacturers declared bankruptcy and abandoned the Block.
Unets were a sentient insectoid species. They had four arms and spoke a language called Une. During the Clone Wars, their homeworld was conquered by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Daemen was a planet on the Rimma Trade Route in the Expansion Region. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin in 1 BBY, the Camblian Order from the Outer Rim world of Eedoq sent 309 prospective students to be enrolled at the Clarion Scholars Academy on the planet Daemen.
Dahvil was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Rayter sector. A member of the Galactic Republic, it was the homeworld of Jake Sirrom, a Human Wing Guard of the planet Bespin.
Daluba was a world ruled by the tyrant Tonkoss Rathba, until Rathba was thwarted by Leia Organa Solo during the time of the New Republic.
Dancreti was a planet of tropical jungles and swamps. Its year in local days was 333 days. It was famous for its small animals called the sanl'jek.
Darsie was a backwater planet in between Commenor and Phorliss.
Daslkehnt was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.

Davirien was a jungle planet in the Corporate Sector owned by the Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company. Chiewab used the planet for research, and also permitted the Galactic Empire to use the planet for training missions.
DeGerrillion was a planet located in the Tamarin sector of the Outer Rim Territories where criminals Marg Sonat and Pari' Notgoth were almost killed.
Demigue was a planet distant from Gascon, connected to it by the dangerous trade route known as the Demigue Terror.

Deminol was a terrestrial world located in the Deminol system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex-Juvex Loop hyperlane linked it to the Anstares and Ossiathora systems.

Demnadi was a Mid Rim planet located in the Far Xandil sector. During the Galactic Civil War, a planet-wide riot, believed by the Imperial Governor Cathers to have been instigated by local Rebel Alliance factions, erupted at Demnadi.
Denbo was a planet that hosted the Viraxo 54 orbital facility, a cargo transfer and storage station operated by Viraxo Shipping.
Dennaskar was a forest planet located in the Mid Rim.
Derr was a frigid ice planet in the Demophon system with a single moon. It was destroyed when its star went supernova.
Derricon was a Rebel Alliance aligned planet during the Galactic Civil War.
Dithanune was a planet located in the Dithanune system, a part of the Bortele sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim.
Dix'thaar was a planet in the Inner Rim of the galaxy, host to a Rebel Alliance cell during the Galactic Civil War.
Doaskin was a planet located in the Doaskin system, a part of the Bruanii sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Dodz was a small, barren Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Zoraster sector. It featured extensive crystal caverns, and at some point a profitable crystal mining industry developed on the planet, with the local community being governed by the Citizen's Council of Dodz.

Dorajan was a planet in the Mid Rim within Lannik Space, densely covered in jungle. Around 3–4 ABY, the ship of the smuggler Platt Okeefe was shot down by TIE fighters from an Imperial orbital outpost as she attempted to flee with an unlicensed shipment of heavy blasters of Im…
Dorsis was a Core world in the Corellian sector sometimes referred to as "Mini-Coruscant."

Draria was a celestial body located in the Draria system. It was a part of the Expansion Region's Lostar sector, being located both in the Outer Expansion Zone sub-region and the Northern Dependencies portion of that region.

Dravione was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Tion Cluster's Allied Tion sector. At some point between approximately 25,150 BBY and 25,130 BBY, it was seized by the expanding Kingdom of Argai led by the pirate chieftain Xer VIII.
Dark troopers were specially trained stormtroopers empowered with the dark side of the Force used by the Dark Empire during Operation Shadow Hand. They were the best troopers in the Imperial legions.
Dreve was a celestial body located in the Dreve system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Inner Rim.
Droecil was a planet home to a Rebel Alliance cell.
Dronseen was a planet of the Dronseen system.
Durgeon was an astronomical object located in the Durgeon system, a part of the Galov sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Duron was a planet located in the Duron system. Obo Rin first learned of the Charon race there.
Dwi'kar was a gas giant and the third planet of the Kothlis system, located within the Bothan sector on the Mid Rim of the galaxy.
Dwi'lar was a gas giant, the fifth planet of the Kothlis system.
Group One was a unit of the Confederate Navy that fought at the Battle of Coruscant.
Eckless was a planet in Wild Space, considered to be an almost mythical world containing a great wealth of gems and metals.

Eczar was an astronomical object located within the Eczar system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Seswenna sector. The Filar-Nitzan infiltrator Vacander maintained a bank account on Eczar by 2 ABY.

Ediorung was a planet in the Interior Regions of the Hapes Cluster. The planet was known for the dynamic holosculptures it produced; however, these were strictly judged by the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order Art Group.

Eedoq was a world in the Outer Rim's Tantra sector. Eedoq was the homeworld of the Camblian Order, which, shortly before the Battle of Yavin around in 1 BBY, sent 309 prospective students to be enrolled at the Clarion Scholars Academy on the planet Daemen.
The battle on Deneba took place in the year 3997 BBY during the Krath Holy Crusade, and was one of the earliest known Krath offensives to occur during that conflict.
The Battle of Koros Major was one of the first direct major Republic military offensives against the Krath.
Clone Engineers were clone trooper engineers of the Galactic Republic that were active during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Alpha Blue was a clandestine division within the New Republic Intelligence Service. Publicly, the unit did not exist and possessed no name.

The Cha'wen'he people of the planet Wen'he'dinae were among the galaxy's most distinctive looking species. Cha'wen'he had two thin legs, decimeter-long bony spikes on their heels, and scaly ovoid bodies.
The Mediator was a Mon Calamari Mediator-class battle cruiser of the New Republic Defense Fleet. It was commissioned shortly before or during 25 ABY.
The Onslaught was an Imperial Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy.
The Rebirth was the personal worldcraft of Imperial Procurator of Justice Hethrir. Emperor Palpatine presented it to him as a reward for the cleansing of Firrerre.
The Battle of Nam Chorios was a battle in 13 ABY that took place on Nam Chorios.
Coruscul was a world situated in the Core Worlds. It was the site of a hidden stronghold at one point used by the Order of the Silver Jedi sect of the Jedi Order.

Corutarn was a celestial body located in the Corutarn system, which was a part of the Arrowhead, or the Slice portion of the Core Worlds. The Human Major Perrn of the Galactic Empire, who was born around 32 BBY, hailed from Corutarn.
Terig was a moon of Ingo. Terig was purchased by the House of Tagge Mining Company, which established massive drilling operations to harvest rare minerals such as scatrium and fravisite.
Drarn was a moon of Ingo. Terig was purchased by the House of Tagge Mining Company, which established massive drilling operations to harvest rare minerals such as scatrium and fravisite.
Annoo was an Outer Rim planet located in the Tharin sector. The homeworld of the original Annoo-dat species, they were referred to by xenobiologists as Annoo-dat Prime.
Bolad was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Bolad system, a part of the Tharin sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Arami was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Galov sector. A part of the area dominated by the Hutt species as well as controlled by the Galactic Empire, Arami was one of three worlds where the Hutt holiday known as Boonta's Eve was celebrated, with the festivities…
Kerig'En was a celestial body in the Kerig'En system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Brema sector.
Gellefon was a planet in the Korness system of the Outer Rim. It was the location of Kig Dannen Spaceport. It was a planet of cool, rocky crags, mountains, and crevasses.

Gdans were predators native to the planet Qiilura. About thirty centimeters long when fully grown, it took a whole pack of them to bring down even a merlie calf. Despite their small size, they were not against advancing on sentients, at least when in packs.

Greyman's Planet was an industrialized Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Wazta sector. It was controlled by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War, and at one point the Rebel Alliance executed a mission to transport supplies from it to the Alliance's outpo…

Karinda was an arid, dusty Outer Rim Territories planet that lay in the Wazta sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire maintained a small garrison there, while the Rebel Alliance also constructed a hidden listening outpost on the planet.
Suarbi 7 was a gas giant within the Suarbi system in the Quence sector surrounded by an asteroid ring and at least 13 moons, including Susevfi.
Miko was a planet located in the Sorella system.

Bormter was a Wild Space planet that was home to the four-armed reptiloid Bormterran species. Following the Battle of Endor, Moff Delurin broke with the Galactic Empire and declared himself a warlord, conquering Bormter with his warship, the Galaxy Dragon.
Ananuru was a location in the galaxy where the crime lord Hamnet attempted to bid on an Imperial virus formula from Hakon deVille.
Entooine was a tidal locked moon of a gas giant in the Entoo system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the only inhabited celestial body in the system and had an extreme electromagnetic field.
Reginard was the location of a hidden Rebel base called Reginard Base.
Denubba was the location where General Maxine Baytor participated in the battle of Denubba. It was located in the Mid Rim.

The Epsom Asteroid Belt was located in the Epsom system, a part of the Quiberon sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the Saurian crime lord Sithless Leethe owned a summer residence in the asteroid belt.
Zoma V was a jungle planet in the Zoma system, probably near Tatooine. It was inhabited by the primitive Felinians, to whom Imperial weapons were smuggled by Sithless Leethe.

Muugrah was a planet that was closer to the fringe of the galaxy than it was to the Galactic Core. Its capital was Slaibo, which was close to Squarn's Junkyard. It was a planet of open grasslands inhabited by prospectors and ranchers.

Tegrat was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Koradin sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire launched an invasion of Tegrat's star system, causing numerous inhabitants of the planet to rush toward the local spaceport and many starships fleeing T…

Ksift was an Imperial rainforest world in the Outer Rim Territories. Its capital was Rakati. It was also the location of ATC-5/GS and a Rebel security outpost. Nik betrayed the local Rebels, but was brought to justice by Bret Hanson.

Dandrian in the Dandrian system was called the "crossroads of the galaxy". It had a single sun and was orbited by the Dandrian's Ring of asteroids, the remnants of a moon that struck the planet during formation.
Kyrouac was a backwater Inner Rim farming planet held by the Galactic Empire. The planet's fauna included brush bats and a shelled creature residing in the Spiral Sea.

Radra IV was an average-sized planet with various climatic zones in the Radra system, some distance from major routes and close to the Imperial frontier. The planet had two moons. Its atmospheric density and gravity were slightly more than the Human norm.

Branth was an industrial planet of the Galactic Republic that manufactured droids. However, after the rise of the New Order, the Galactic Empire's heavy demand for droids polluted the planet until it had to be abandoned. It was the only planet in the system containing it.

Ahlenn was a planet in the Ahlenn system. During the Galactic Civil War, a prolonged conflict between Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire, the Imperial Admiral Kohrin's second fleet bombarded the planet thinking that it was home to an active Rebel base, in retaliation for Luke …
Phaylenn was an Imperial planet near Bespin and Ahlenn.

In 22 BBY a Jedi task force, composed by Aayla Secura, Kit Fisto, An'ya Kuro, Masters Tholme and T'ra Saa, was assigned to investigate Confederacy raids on Republic's supply ships near the Corellian Trade Spine.

result: Retreat of Zonama Sekot into the Unknown Regions
x: The Second Battle of Zonama Sekot was a battle in 29 BBY which took place at Zonama Sekot, a "living planet" located within the Gardaji Rift of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Azure Angel was a unique customized Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor starfighter that was modified and piloted by the Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker during the early months of the Clone Wars.
Eliad was a planet in the Minos Cluster where many wealthy noble families of the galaxy were exiled after the rise of the Empire .

The Berrites of the planet Berri were considered to be stupid and clumsy by most other species, though they could be deceptively cunning. Berrites were one-meter tall creatures with two arms and four legs. Their skin was green and wrinkled, with patches of coarse black hair.
Embaril was a world located in the Embaril system. It was a part of the Allied Tion sector of the Tion Cluster, situated within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Enaleh was a planet located in the Colonies. At some point between 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, Enaleh became a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost and was known by then as Ord Enaleh.
The Allegiant was an MC80B Star Cruiser in the New Republic Defense Fleet.
The Reaver was a Sabaoth destroyer under the command of Lieutenant Bella, ensign to Captain Cavik Toth. The Reaver saw combat just prior to the Clone Wars.
The Morgukai were one of several secret societies formed in the history of the Nikto people of Kintan.

Captain Cavik Toth's personal starfighter was a small, one man attack fighter launched from the hangar bay of his flagship. It was armed with heavy laser cannons and concussion missile launchers. It also possessed

Endoraan was a planet that was an endpoint of the Relgim Run, opposite Mantooine.
Endovan was a planet in the Sarka sector of the Mid Rim.
Entuur was a planet inhabited by the Human race known as the Entuurans.
Eredin was an ice-bound planet that was located in the Astal sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The nashtah, also known as a Dravian hound, was a six-legged predatory reptile from the mountains of Dra III.

The Nonnah was a Rebel Alliance transport with a central portion and two spars on the side. As part of Alliance operations on marginal worlds, it was carrying troops and stolen Imperial supplies, but was shot down by the Empire around 6 months after the pivotal Battle of Yavin.

conflict: Clone Wars (Praesitlyn theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
result: Wat Tambor escapes with General Grievous
x: The Second Battle of Xagobah was a major battle during the Clone Wars which took place during the Outer Rim Sieges. It occurred concurrently with Boba Fett's assassination attempt on Techno Union Foreman Wat Tambor.
The Battle of Virujansi occurred when the Republic launched a siege against the Separatist-held planet of Virujansi.
The First Battle of Zonama Sekot was a protracted siege against the living planet Zonama Sekot by the Yuuzhan Vong, whom the Ferroan and Langhesi settlers on Zonama termed "Far Outsiders."

The Inner Council was the senior decision-making body of the New Republic during the New Republic Provisional Council, they composed of the Chief of State's closest advisors. After the dissolution of the Provisional Council, the Inner Council itself was disbanded..
Vuoles were small lizards, approximately the size of a Human hand, that could be found throughout the Rafa system, thriving in all kinds of terrain.
Fadden was a world located in the Fadden system, a part of the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was settled by colonists of the Duros species, which was native to the Core Worlds planet Duro.
Fangol was a small frozen planet in the Mortex sector, and was the site of a secret Rebel Alliance base. It had an icy crust.
Farsellah was a terrestrial world located in the Farsellah system, a part of the Farstey sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Expansion Region.
During the Galactic Civil War, it was the battlefield of the Battle of Fendry.

The Battle of Maridun was a localized conflict between the Imperial forces stationed on Maridun and the local Amanin inhabitants. The battle was considered to be a religious takital by the local Amani, since the Imperials had crossed their sacred border.
Plooriod III, the third planet of the Plooriod system, was an agricultural territory of the Expansion Region. Plooriod III had a vast ocean with small spire-like islands dotting the surface.

The Invincible was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. It was the leader of the task force that conducted Operation Strike Fear before the Battle of Yavin.
Bixby was a Corellian Corvette that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Korolev was a CR90 corvette that served as a medical vessel in the Rebel Fleet.
The Battle of Ko Vari took place during the Great Sith War.

place: Kuar, on the Plains of Harkul
result: Ulic Qel-Droma acquires the forces of Mandalore the Indomitable
x: In the year 3996 BBY, a duel took place on the planet Kuar between the Sith Lord Ulic Qel-Droma and Mandalore the Indomitable, leader of the Mandalorian Crusaders.
The titavian, also known as the goffbird or huge goff, was a gigantic, near-legendary, reptavian native to Naboo.

The Galactic Senate Chamber, also known as the Grand Convocation Chamber, the Senate Rotunda, the grand audience chamber, or simply as the Senate Chamber, was a large, open area contained within the Galactic Senate Building on the planet Coruscant.

The Emperor's office, formerly known as the Chancellor's office or the Chancellor's Suite, was a suite of offices and private rooms that belonged to Emperor Palpatine during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
The CoCo District Constabulary was the local police force of the Collective Commerce District, or CoCo District, on the planet Coruscant.
The Aken was an Acclamator-class assault ship active during the early days of the Clone Wars.

The Glimmerfish was a type of fish native to Alderaan. They were small but incredibly fecund swimmers no longer than a finger, covered with reflective metallic scales. Females would lay hundreds of eggs up and down the shores of Alderaan's canals and rivers.
The Intervention was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that served in the Fifth Fleet of the Open Circle Armada, a branch of the Republic Navy during the last stages of the Clone Wars.

Pedducis Chorios was a planet in the Meridian sector in the Pedducis Chorios system. After her initial retirement from the Imperial Starfleet, Admiral Daala led a group of former Imperial settlers on the world.

result: Shut down of the Crimson Nova
objective: Remove bounty postings on Jedi
x: The Mission to the Rig was a mission undertaken by members of the Jedi High Council during the Clone Wars.

The Quizzers were a mammalian species native to Gamorr which were fascinated by shiny objects. They shared Gamorr with the Gamorreans and the Morrts. The Quizzers were hated by the dominant Gamorreans, who tried without success to exterminate the species.
Ithaqua Station was a spaceport town on the icy world of Toola. It was known for its large central market and for being the site of the planet's main spaceport.

Ferrhast was the planet in the Core Worlds and location of the Imperial Institute of Higher Studies. Despite its distance from the Sith Worlds, ruins built by members of the Massassi species were found on the world during the Galactic War.
Ferxani was the fifth planet orbiting the star Polith in the Polith system. Located in the Jaso sector of the Inner Rim Territories, it was a gas giant.

Fether was a farming world located on the Solenbaran Merchant Route hyperlane, in the Outer Rim Territories' Corporate Sector. The planet hosted a population of sentient Ocsin and was the site of a small spaceport town.
Fluwhaka was a misty planet in the Outer Rim Territories noted for its rocky spires and crags.

Fodro was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Clacis sector, on the Braxant Run hyperlane. During the Galactic Civil War, it served as the endpoint of the Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade, a popular interstellar racing route.

Fokask was a planet within the Fokask system in Outer Rim Territories. It was home to one of Han Solo's old smuggling friends. This retired smuggler sent Solo a copy of the Fokask Banner, which had a rather slanderous article written about Chief of State Leia Organa Solo.
Twilight was the code name for a secret large-scale Imperial operation.
Ixlls were a sentient species of flying creatures native to the moon Da Soocha V, also known as the Pinnacle Moon.

Energy spiders or spice spiders were arachnids that inhabited the Spice Mines of Kessel. They lived in complete darkness inside the mine's caves spinning webs made of glitterstim, a rare kind of spice.

A dinko was a small reptilian scavenger that was extremely vicious and tenacious. It was also notorious for emitting an unbearable stench, and for a mildly toxic bite which could paralyze a Human-sized creature with nausea.

The Sons and Daughters of Freedom, also known as Freedom's Sons, was an independent army that vowed to protect the Galactic Republic and considered the Confederacy of Independent Systems as a serious threat to the peace and freedom of the galaxy.

Garbage Compactor 3263827 was a garbage compactor on the first Death Star where Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Chewbacca, and Princess Leia Organa were temporarily stranded after freeing Organa from Detention Block AA-23 in 0 BBY. "3263827" was a hatch number.

result: Signing of a peace treaty between Balmorra and the Dark Empire
Balmorra granted independence from the Dark Empire
x: The Battle of Balmorra was fought in 10 ABY between the forces of Dark Empire commanded by Executor Sedriss QL and the defenders of the factory world of Balmorra.

Kkekkrrg rro, also called Shadow Keepers, were predators that lived on Kashyyyk. They had five limbs, which fascinated xenobiologists. However, none were ever captured alive or dead, and no corpses were ever found.
The Gryyyl asteroid belt was an asteroid field within the Kashyyyk system located between the planets Kashyyyk and Trandosha.
A battle occurred during the Great Sith War in the Al'Har system.

result: Galactic Empire victory; Kalaan City destroyed
x: A battle took place shortly before the Battle of Yavin on the planet Kalaan.

result: Dantooine and Jedi Enclave partially destroyed
x: The Attack on Dantooine was a massive planetary bombardment conducted in 3956 BBY by the Sith fleets of Darth Malak during the Jedi Civil War.

A battle at the planet Foerost occurred in 3996 BBY during the Great Sith War. It began as a raid carried out by the Krath forces of Sith Lord Ulic Qel-Droma and the Crusaders of Mandalore the Indomitable.
Tizowyrms were a species of small worms bioengineered by Yuuzhan Vong alchemists that, when inserted into an ear, translated and allowed the wearer to speak alien languages.

The Battle of Ygziir was the end of the Cremlevian War, a conflict that was waged in the Yuuzhan Vong galaxy millennia before the Battle of Yavin. One faction of Yuuzhan Vong was led by warmaster Steng, the other by warmaster Yo'gand.
The Battle of the Emperor's Citadel, or the Battle of Byss, was a battle between the New Republic and the Dark Empire in 10 ABY at the reborn Emperor Palpatine's throne world of Byss.
A massive battle on Dxun was one of the last battles of the Mandalorian Wars prior to the final confrontation between Republic and Mandalorian forces at Malachor V.
A battle on the planet Onderon was one of the last battles fought during the Mandalorian Wars, near-concurrent with the Republic's second assault upon the Dxun moon during the same period.

t: Battle of New Alderaan (Operation Shadow Hand)
x: A battle occurred on the planet New Alderaan in 10 ABY between the reborn Emperor Palpatine's forces and the New Republic.
The shamunaar was a giant, long-necked saurian creature from Roon. It lived in the mud fields of Roon, and was a constant threat to the wild banthas of the planet.

Mudmen were silicon-based semi-sentient beings found on Roon. A strong spray of condensed air or water could separate mudmen into small forms. Smaller mudmen could be kept as pets and exported throughout the galaxy. They were harmless and loved shiny things.
The Battle of Orinda was fought late in the Galactic Civil War about eight years after the Battle of Endor and seven months after the resignation of Admiral Daala.

The Reaper was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought in service to the Galactic Empire. Once the flagship of Scourge Squadron under Grand Moff Ardus Kaine, the Reaper became the centerpiece of Kaine's effort to continue Imperial rule after the death of Emperor Palpatine at the Ba…

The Reaper was a Nebulon-B frigate that served in the Imperial Starfleet at the height of the Galactic Civil War. The Reaper arrived after frigate Rapier was destroyed as transport group Renhoek picked up a supply of lonsigars from a group of abandoned containers.
The Endurance was an Endurance-class fleet carrier in service to the New Republic Defense Force in 12 ABY.
The Pentastar Talks were a series of meetings held on the Reaper in 4 ABY between Moff Ardus Kaine and various political and business leaders from the Velcar Free Commerce Zone.

The Guardian was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought. Originally under the command of Admiral Gaen Drommel of the Galactic Empire, it was stationed near Coruscant when news of the Battle of Endor arrived.
The Skirmish on Ossus was a battle between Executor Sedriss QL's forces and the Jedi Knights Luke Skywalker, Kam Solusar, and their Ysanna allies.

result: The Eclipse II enters hyperspace on a collision course with the Galaxy
x: The Battle of Onderon was the final battle between the reborn Emperor Palpatine's Dark Empire and the New Republic during the devastating Operation Shadow Hand.

The Zeison Sha were an order of Force adepts known for their survival skills and self-reliance, as well as their abilities in telekinesis and with the discblade on the planet of Yanibar in Wild Space.
The Zhug brothers were a group of Duros bounty hunters led by Azanti and Dezanti Zhug, consisting of hundreds of individuals bound together by their shared cause—taking control the planet Duro.
The Pentastar Patrol was the military force that operated across the Pentastar Alignment, which formed after the Battle of Endor.

Ebranites were the native people of the planet Ebra in the Dousc system. They were adapted to life in Ebra's systems of caves and canyons. Ebranites had six arms, with two opposable thumbs on each six-digit hand.
Dorum was a city on the planet Balamak, it was the site of the testing of an experimental communications-jamming system developed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Battle of Axion was a battle during the Clone Wars which was a loss for the Galactic Republic.
A battle took place on the planet Thustra during the early stages of the Clone Wars, between the armed forces of the Galactic Republic and the rebellious Sephi people.

result: Major Confederacy of Independent Systems victory
x: The Battle of Merson during the Clone Wars consisted of Galactic Republic forces, led by Jedi Master Ronhar Kim, his Padawan Tap-Nar-Pal and Captain Gilad Pellaeon, being sent into battle on the planet Merson.
The battle of Null was fought during the Clone Wars after the planet Null joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The rasp was a small bird whose sub-species inhabited several planets. Most of them were docile and harmless, but a few rasps—like the plumed rasp—were aggressive and could cause wounds to an unarmed being.

Shards were a silicon-based species native to the planet Orax, who took the form of irregularly faceted cylindrical crystals thirty to forty centimeters in length. Faint pulses of light—thought signals propagating through their "brains"—could be seen inside their bodies.

conflict: Clone Wars (Siskeen theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: In 19 BBY during the Clone Wars, just prior to the Battle of Coruscant, The Confederacy of Independent Systems invaded the planet Tythe on the orders of Darth Sidious in order to draw the attention of Republic forces away from the impending strike at Coruscant, leading to a Re…

result: Ulic Qel-Droma captured by the Galactic Republic
x: The Battle of Coruscant was a surprise attack launched in the Great Sith War of 3996 BBY by the Sith Empire against the Galactic Republic's capital planet, Coruscant.

The Basiliskans were an intelligent reptilian species native to the planet Basilisk, who later, after millennia of enslavement to the Mandalorians, degenerated into beasts known as the Lagartoz War Dragons.

The Balinaka (singular, Balinak) were a species of strong, amphibious mammals native to the arctic planet Garnib. They were covered with thick fur, though they also had a dual lung/gill system which enabled them to breathe both air and water.
The Battle of Mizra was an engagement of the millennium-long New Sith Wars that took place in 1466 BBY.

During the New Sith Wars, the Galactic Republic launched a preemptive strike against the Uba system, the home star system of the Ubese species, to show the proud Ubese that the banned weapons they were constructing were inferior to the Republic's own.

Yavin 2 was the second celestial body surrounding the gas giant Yavin Prime in the Yavin system, a star system apart of the Gordian Reach of the Outer Rim Territories. It was classified as a rocky moon, with little known about it.

conflict: Clone Wars (Felucia theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: The Battle of Belderone resulted from intelligence gained via the captured mechno-chair of Nute Gunray.
The siege of Cato Neimoidia was an attempt by the Galactic Republic to capture Nute Gunray, Viceroy of the Trade Federation and a prominent member of the Separatist Council, during the Clone Wars.
In 3996 BBY, Jedi and Sith forces fought an engagement at the Kemplex Nine space station that proved to be one of the major turning-points of the Great Sith War.
Wicko District was an area of Coruscant near the Temple Precinct. Its garbage pit was used as the location for illegal wing-racing.

conflict: Clone Wars (Siskeen theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: The recapture of Tythe took place on the planet Tythe in the third year of the Clone Wars, as part of the Outer Rim Sieges campaign.
Backed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the Mandalorian Protectors initiated a battle on the planet Kamino in 20 BBY during the Clone Wars.

conflict: Clone Wars (Felucia theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: The Battle of Boz Pity was a major battle in the final year of the Clone Wars. Major Separatist activity on Boz Pity was discovered by Obi-Wan Kenobi during his search for Asajj Ventress.
During the Clone Wars, a battle took place on the planet Clak'dor VII.
The Gungan Swamp was the name of all the swamps and marshes that covered most of the surface of the planet Naboo.
The Ruusan Reformations were an event in the history of the Galactic Republic that limited the power of the Supreme Chancellor.

conflict: New Sith Wars; Light and Darkness War
x: The Duel on Balowa was one of the last battles of the New Sith Wars. It was fought on Balowa, between Sith Lord Kaox Krul and Jedi Knight Crian Maru and her Padawan, Dree Vandap. All three were killed in battle.

conflict: New Sith Wars; Light and Darkness War
x: The Battle of Harpori was one of the last battles of the New Sith Wars. It was fought on the planet Harpori, and resulted in the Sith under Kaox Krul destroying the Duros colony on the planet.

result: Ulic Qel-Droma leaves the Sith Order.
x: A battle on Ossus took place in the year 3996 BBY during the Great Sith War, and was one of the last major battles to be fought during that conflict.
The Intrepid was an Endurance-class fleet carrier of the New Republic Defense Fleet's Fifth Battle Group.

Intrepid was a Munifex-class light cruiser of the Imperial Navy. At the time of the Galactic Civil War, it orbited the planet Gesaril under the command of Captain Dulrain serving a dual purpose: to enforce the quarantine on Gesaril, and to guard the prison that was located on …

Intrepid was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that served with the Imperial Starfleet during the early years of the Galactic Civil War. It was the first Star Destroyer to be destroyed in a direct assault by forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Intrepid was a Nebulon-B frigate of the New Republic Defense Fleet.
The Ahazi was a Hajen-class fleet tender of the New Republic Fifth Fleet.
The Legions of Lettow was the name taken by the apprentices and acolytes of the Kashi Mer Dynasty exile and Jedi Renunciate Xendor.

The Battle of Azure Spaceport was a conflict that occurred in the early stages of the Clone Wars in which Separatist forces tracked the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, Siri Tachi, Anakin Skywalker, and Senator Padmé Amidala by means of a tracer device planted in a foolproof codebreaker.

result: Mandalore the Ultimate takes Mandalore the Indomitable's mantle
x: The Battle of Onderon was a last-ditch effort by the Mandalorian Crusaders to secure a victory in the final stages of the Great Sith War on behalf of the Brotherhood of the Sith.

The Stenax were a fierce, ill-tempered, brooding, and violent race from the planet of Stenos. They fanatically followed the dictates of their god, Vol. They were responsible for the Stenax Massacres, which killed countless millions.

result: Bariss Offee becomes a Jedi Knight
x: The Battle of Drongar, also known as the Jasserak Engagement, was fought during the Clone Wars. Drongar was not a strategic military point; instead, both the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems wished to control the planet's main export, bota.
The Battle of Zaadja was a confrontation during the Clone Wars which occurred approximately eighteen months after the First Battle of Geonosis.
The Battle of Parcelus Minor in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars. A Republic force under Jedi Roblio Darté clashed with a Separatist army in orbit and on the surface of Parcelus Minor, a swamp world.
A battle occurred on the planet Metalorn during the Clone Wars.
The Battle of Skor II was a clash between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems on Skor II, the home planet of the Squibs.
The Battle of Ord Canfre took place in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars. The Separatist forces defeated the Galactic Republic and took over the planet of Ord Canfre.
The Battle of Bassadro, also known as the Bassadro Massacre, was a twelve day battle fought during the Clone Wars.
The Rejuvenator was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer that served with the New Republic Defense Force.

The Third Legion of Light was a unit of the Army of Light. At the end of the New Sith Wars, it was commanded by General Newar Forrth, who led it to victory at the cost of his own life during one of the battles of Ruusan.
Vultar was a planet located in the Vultar system, a part of the Arrowhead region in the Slice portion of the Core Worlds.
The Baanu Rass was a Yuuzhan Vong worldship.

The Battle of Nadiem occurred during the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Separatists. In 22 BBY, five months after the Battle of Geonosis, the Separatist Droid Army, commanded by General Grievous, invaded the Republic-controlled planet of Nadiem and was able to to grab…

In the Battle of Terra Sool, the local militia rebelled against the Confederacy of Independent Systems occupation forces, and were aided by a Galactic Republic task force led by Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.
The Memory of Ithor was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser of the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet.

The Battle of Yavin 4 was one of the final conflicts of the Great Sith War in 3996 BBY. It culminated in the death of Sith Lord Exar Kun and the annihilation of much of the Massassi species on Yavin 4.
The Thunderflare was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer in service in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

The Battle of Doornik-319, also known as the blockade of Doornik-319, was a battle between the New Republic and the Duskhan League at the planet Doornik-319, the primary in the system of the same name.
AX/RX was a modified MD-series medical droid owned by Kh'aris Fenn and was active in 30 BBY. Kh'aris used it as a torture droid, utilizing its knowledge of the anatomy to inflict maximum pain.

The terbeast was a three headed canine creature that roamed the forests of Ogden Minor, terrorizing the locals. The two Jedi Aayla Secura and Quinlan Vos were sent to kill the creatures. Terbeast were large three headed canine species that were very aggressive in nature.
The Twi'lek Ruling Council was the ruling council of Ryloth's capital city of Lessu.

Shulell City was the capital of Lan Barell. The only Human-style settlement on the planet, by the time of the Galactic Civil War, it boasted a population of over 100,000 Humans and at least 30,000 Qieg.

result: The Republic finds out the Confederacy plans to attack Kamino

Indona, also known as the Indona forests, was a continent in the northern latitudes of the Outer Rim planet Cholganna. The continent featured jungles and chilly forests that covered it.
Bahk'tor was a territory of the planet Honoghr located in the Clean Lands.
Zhuk'nir was a territory of the planet Honoghr located in the Clean Lands.
Kihm'bar was a territory of the planet Honoghr located in the Clean Lands.
Lohk'nar was a territory of the planet Honoghr located in the Clean Lands.
Hakh'khar was a territory of the planet of Honoghr that was located in the Clean Lands.
Elkh'mir was a territory of the planet Honoghr located in the Clean Lands.

Kolaador was a planet in the Kolaador system of the Outer Rim Territories.
