x: Investigating reports of defecting Jedi, Mace Windu headed on a Mission to Ruul.
Galltine was a Human-inhabited planet in the Galltine system of the Thesme sector.
Laertos was a planet the primary spaceport of which had a Rebel Alliance drop point.

Lorrad was an Outer Rim Territories urban world located in the Tion Cluster's Allied Tion sector. By around 25,130 BBY, it was ruled by the Livien League and was the site of a League victory over the forces of the Kingdom of Cron.

Tallaso was a planet situated in the Tallaso system, a part of the D'Aelgoth sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Human Riggins Delahrg served as the Imperial governor of Tallaso.

Sochi was a vacation planet located in the Sochi system within the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. The Galactic Empire maintained the camp known as Troopers' Rest on Sochi, where Imperial stormtroopers who reached retirement age were eventually sent.

During the Clone Wars, the Mandalorian Protectors undertook a mission to Norval II, with the objective of capturing Galactic Republic Senator Padmé Amidala. However, the operation was a Republic trap, and the Protectors were ambushed and all but wiped out.
The Undercity was a mechanical wilderness on the ground level of Taris, beneath the upper, middle and lower levels and above the sewers and the underground city.
Nightshrikes were an imposing avian predator native to the rainforests of the planet Monastery. Large and bat-like, nightshrikes were nocturnal and mostly preyed on the other beasts of the forests.

Telos was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, along the Hydian Way. During the campaign at Salient, an Imperial battle group was stationed at Telos under the command of Admiral Utu.

During the New Sith Wars, well before the Light and Darkness War that ended the conflict, a battle occurred on the planet Almas. A Jedi force drove the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Rivan from his fortress on Almas—although the fortress was only partially destroyed.
The "Promised Land" was a legendary underground city located in the lowest levels of Taris, beneath the Undercity and its sewers, as well as below the Lower City, Middle City and the Upper City.

13X was the name of a Victory-class Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Starfleet which was under the overall command of the self-styled High Admiral Treuten Teradoc some eight years after the Battle of Endor.

objective: Find swamp gas antidote
x: The Mission to Queyta was a quest undertaken by five Jedi Masters to obtain an antidote for the chemical weapon known as swamp gas, used to wipe out the Gungan colony on Ohma-D'un.
The Kethor was a Mere cruiser commanded by Captain Orsai prior to the Clone Wars.
The Ession Strike, originally named the Night Caller, was a modified CR90 corvette.
The clone blaze trooper was the Grand Army of the Republic's frontline close-combat infantry support unit and a type of advanced jet trooper. It had very heavy armor.

The saber cat, or sabercat, was a huge, feline, carnivorous species native to the planet Monastery. They were predators with a thick horn which protruded from the top of the skull. The saber cat had four huge paws, each with five razor-sharp claws.

result: The Galactic Empire regains control of Kamino
x: The Kamino uprising was a conflict in 12 BBY on the aquatic planet Kamino, the origin world of the Grand Army of the Republic during the waning days of the Old Republic.

result: Katarn and Ors escape with the plans
objective: Acquire part of the Death Star plans
x: The Mission to Danuta was an early operation of the Galactic Civil War and the second phase of Operation Skyhook. Kyle Katarn, a former Imperial-turned Rebel agent, was sent into an Imperial facility to take a supplemental set of the Death Star plans.

result: Duskhan League gain control of the Cluster
x: The Yevethan Purge, also known as the Cleansing or Great Purge, was an act of xenocide carried out by the Duskhan League in 16 ABY.
The Second Great Schism was a divisive split among the ranks of the Jedi Order that occurred in the year 7003 BBY.
An attack on Tak Base was a minor battle of the Galactic Civil War. Its purpose was for the Galactic Empire to demonstrate the power of the new dark trooper project.
The Daedlus was a Strike-class medium cruiser that served with the Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

t: Recapture of the Empress Teta system
x: In 3996 BBY, in the aftermath of Exar Kun's defeat at Yavin 4, the Galactic Republic retook the Empress Teta system.
Bloodsniffers were vicious predators that were among the many dangerous beasts that could be found in the desolate Badlands of Kamar.

The Lizard Warriors were a species of sentient reptilians who lived in a desert region of the Forest Moon of Endor. Members of the species had green scales and yellow underhides with yellow spikes running down the spine. Their bodies were humanoid except for a long tail.
The Battle of Mustafar was an isolated battle on Mustafar that took place between the Galactic Empire and Separatist holdouts in the early years of Imperial rule.

Rakaans were large, sentient, web-spinning predators native to Rakaa IV. They were notable for their five-phase life cycle, where they changed from one sex to another. Rakaans were land-dwellers, but they were also efficient swimmers.
Archai was a YT-1300 light freighter manufactured by the Corellian Engineering Corporation and owned by the Human scout Coli Carinth.

result: Beginning of the Yuuzhan Vong War
x: A skirmish at the planet Helska IV in 25 ABY marked the beginning of the Yuuzhan Vong War. Arriving at the Helska system, unaware of the Yuuzhan Vong presence, Kyp Durron and his Dozen-and-Two Avengers headed into the Battle of Helska.

Kian'thar were humanoid nomadic people from Shaum Hii, most notable for their ability to sense emotions. Though they evolved from land-dwelling reptiles, their culture was based around the seas and oceans of Shaum Hii.
Bentails were large flying beasts native to the planet of Shaum Hii. Kian'thar derlac herders often rode bentails as they followed their herds across Shaum Hii's oceans.

The Codru-Ji were a race of four-armed humanoids that inhabited the planet Munto Codru. Born as six legged canines known as Wyrwulves, they encased themselves in a cocoon at puberty, emerging weeks later as a two meter tall adult humanoid.
Wyrwulves were six-legged canine animals that, while often mistaken by outsiders for pets or working animals, were in fact the children of the Codru-Ji race.

The Second Battle of Bilbringi, known in the planning stages as Operation Trinity, was a military operation fought near the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War, involving the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances and the Imperial Remnant, an associate state.
The Battle of Yag'Dhul occurred prior to the invasion of Coruscant in the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The Grey Damsel was a Mon Calamari Star Cruiser under the command of Rebel Captain Bok.
Iceberg Four was the eighth planet in the Calamari system and also the farthest from its sun. It was used as a Galactic Alliance staging area during the Defense of Mon Calamari.

result: Kylantha installed as Queen of Naboo
x: In 18 BBY, Queen Apailana of the planet Naboo broke off diplomatic ties with the Galactic Empire, leading the Empire to dispatch the 501st Legion to suppress the growing opposition on the world and retake Naboo.
Aiwha Squad was an elite clone commando unit, and was part of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. This unit was named after the native Aiwhas of Kamino.
A squad of clone commandos was part of the Galactic Republic's Grand Army in the year at the opening of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

result: Initial Uprising Victory, Uprising violently struck down
x: An uprising took place on the city planet of Coruscant and occurred shortly after the Battle of Endor.

Krytollaks were a species of sentient, armored mammals indigenous to the planet Thandruss. They were led by an empress and had a rigid social structure, thinking that absolute monarchy was the only sensible form of government, both on a planetary and galactic level.
The Liberator was a Mere troop transport used by the Mere Resistance prior to the Clone Wars.
The Imperial attack on and occupation of Thyferra took place during the Galactic Civil War around 1 ABY.
The ibbot was a colorful avian creature native to the planet Drall. Sixty-eight varieties of ibbots existed, each specialized to fit in a particular niche of Drall ecology.
Returning from their Mission to Sernpidal, Yuuzhan Vong forces followed the Millennium Falcon and the other escaping spaceships, resulting in the Battle of Dubrillion.

The Alopia Rift was a deep submarine trench on Mon Calamari. Sufficiently deep to provide access to valuable mineral deposits and free of the dangerous creatures inhabiting many similar trenches, the submerged valley was the site of several Quarren mining operations.
Crystal Reef was a Mon Calamari city on Dac.
Foamwander City was one of the oldest and largest floating cities on Dac, floating in a pattern around the Knowledge Bank.

result: The Yuuzhan Vong fleet begins mobilizing
x: In 25 ABY, during the initial stages of the Yuuzhan Vong War, forces of the New Republic and the Praetorite Vong fought the Battle of Helska IV on the icy fourth orbital of the Helska system.

The Mistryl Shadow Guards were an elite group of all-female Human mercenaries. They were sent from their home planet of Emberlene to earn money in support of the devastated communities of their world.
Orotoru G'am was a large city on Mon Calamari off the coast of the Grand Reefs. It was kept afloat by a system of ballast tanks.

The Hakawa islands were a chain of islands on Dac, an ocean planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim. The islands were situated just south of the Algae Sward sea and were formed by the peaks of the underwater Seascape Mountains.
Bomb squad stormtroopers, commonly called bombtroopers, were an elite class of Imperial stormtroopers trained in the activation and deactivation of explosive charges.
Terrina Square was a public plaza on the world of Quellor.
Coral Depths City was the oldest part of Coral City, the planet Dac's capital city.
The attack on Mon Calamari was an attack by Admiral Daala launched in the early part of her campaign against the New Republic.
Morjanssik was a city in the water world Mon Calamari's southern hemisphere.
Wildwater City was one of the newer floating cities on Mon Calamari—it was less than one century old by the time of the Galactic Civil War.

The Norulac Freebooters, also known as the Norulac Pirates, were a group of pirates originating on the Inner Rim planet of Norulac, and known to be active in that area beginning a few years prior to the Battle of Yavin, if not earlier.
Bri'ahl was a planet located in the Bri'ahl sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was inhabited by the Bri'ahls.

The Bri'ahls were humanoids indigenous to the forested planet of Bri'ahl. They had pink skin, large eyes that lacked colored irises, squarish noses, large sharp teeth, funnel-shaped ears, and three fingers and a thumb on each hand.

The Battle of Fondor was fought early in the Yuuzhan Vong War. The New Republic fleet, aided by forces from the Hapes Consortium, and covertly by the Hutt Cartel, fought the invaders in order to defend the planet's shipyards.
The Dragon Lords were a group of people on the planet Drexel who lived together with the massive native species of aquatic lizards known as the sea-dragons.

The Battle of Drexel took place just after the Battle of Yavin during the Galactic Civil War. It was fought between the ship-dwellers of the Great Ship and the Dragon Lords, exiles from the city-ship that took command of the sea-dragons of Drexel.
FX9 was a medical droid in service to the Galactic Empire and the Sith Lord Darth Vader shortly following the Battle of Hoth.
Thakwaash were equinoid biped species from Thakwaa.
The Wheel Security Force or more simply Wheel Security were the local police of the space station known as The Wheel.
The Saurtons were a sentient species of reptiles indigenous to the planet Essowyn.
The Anointed People were a species of sentient reptiles native to the planet Abonshee. Their bodies were sturdy and roughly humanoid, standing on two feet with a tail used for balance.
The Aramandi were sentient mammalian bipeds indigenous to the planet Aram.
The Araquia were arachnid sapients indigenous to Kirtania.
Bovorians were a species of sapient mammals indigenous to Bovo Yagen.
The Carosites were a mammalian, sentient species who hailed from the planet Carosi IV in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Chikarri were sapient rodents from Plagen. They were a sentient species with mammalian features. They had two arms and two legs with a long tail which made them very agile on their feet.
The Eklaad were quadrupedal vegetarian sapients indigenous to Sirpar. They were peaceful and primitive, not having advanced technology.
The Ee were a sentient invertebrate species indigenous to Trilos, the moon of Atraken.
The Ergesh were an indigenous sentient species from the planet Ergeshui.
The Gacerites were bipedal sapients indigenous to Gacerian.
The Galidyn were sentient reptilian predators indigenous to Fyodos.
The Gazaran (singular, Gazar) were arboreal sentient species indigenous to Veron.

The Geelan, or Geel, were a species of sentient, bipedal canines with pot bellies, lanky arms, and stubby legs. Thick fur covered most of their bodies except for parts of the face and hands. Each Geelan had two large, yellow eyes, a dark, wet nose, and a muzzle of sharp teeth.
The Gesarils were a furred, six-limbed sentient species indigenous to Gesaril. Gesarils were all born with an affinity for the Force.
The Horansi were sentient felinoids indigenous to Mutanda.

The Jiivahar were a sentient species descended from hairless simians. They were excellent climbers, with a number of physical attributes that facilitated that ability. They had a streamlined body, with hollow bones, giving them a light frame.
The Ka'hren were sentient humanoids indigenous to V'shar.
The Krikthasi were large sentient marine mollusks indigenous to Baralou.
The Multopos were a sentient species indigenous to the planet Baralou.
The Orfites were sapients indigenous to Kidron.
The Orgons were intelligent plants, and the native sapient species of Gorsh.

The Quockrans were a sentient species of slugs native to the planet Quockra-4. The species had a large, fat body that tapered to a tail. Their torso also had two arms, ending in stubby digits. The black-skinned Quockrans had no differentiated internal organs.

The Sludir were reptilian sapients indigenous to Sluudren. They were large, imposing people, with two arms, six legs, and a thick armored carapace. For millennia, they lived without advanced technology in a society ruled by the proud members of a warrior caste.

Svivreni were short, furry, equinoid sentients native to the planet Svivren. Due to the rocky environment of their homeworld, they developed into a stout species and created a civilization of hard-working people with a natural talent for geology.

The Tunroth were bipedal sentients indigenous to the Jiroch system of the Mid Rim. Towering and physically strong, Tunroth had distinctive elongated heads, a vertical nostril at the top of the skull, and three-digit hands and feet.
The Vernols were a race of sentient bipeds. They had a large colony on Garnib.
The Viska (singular, Visk) were winged sentients, indigenous to Rordak.
a: The great bloodsucking fiends of Rordak

x: The ZeHethbra were furry, anthropomorphic sentients with vestigial tail, claws and fangs. They possessed an acute sense of smell that they could use to detect their fellow ZeHethbra's pheromones and thus gather information about them.

Jarells were a humanoid reptiloid species native to the planet Oon Tien in the Kathol sector. They developed a primitive society on their homeworld, organized into matriarchal city-states, before contact with colony ships from the Galactic Republic approximately three centurie…
The Sebiri were a reptilian sentient species native to the planet of Sebiris in the Kathol sector.

Guudrians were a species of sentient beings from the Guudria system. Each Guudrian was distinguished by a warty, wrinkled face, a short snout, and a wild mane of hair. Their eyes sported a pattern of black checks. Although their teeth were blunt, Guudrians had clawed fingers.

The Yvarema were bipedal sapients indigenous to Yvara. The Yvarema were an example of a non-insectoid hive-mind species. Consisted of several different classes, they were ruled by the Majjvara, and each was totally dependent on the other.

The Turazza were sentient, short, mottled reptiles that hatched from eggs. They were able to run faster than a Human and had comparable strength, but they sometimes had trouble trying to use items designed for taller beings.
The Ssither were a species of sapient snakes indigenous to Jatee. They were relocated to Butler's Cove when their homeworld was destroyed by its sun going supernova.

The Srrors'toks were a sentient species of fur-covered, fanged, anthropomorphic felinoids native to the planet Jankok in the Bozhnee sector. They had a mostly non-technological society of hunters, characterized by their stern concept of honor and their life debts.
The Woostoids were sapient humanoids indigenous to Woostri.
The Vorzydiaks were a Near-Human species indigenous to Vorzyd IV and Vorzyd V. They were tall and gaunt with yellowish-green skin, larger than usual eyes, and a pair of antennae.
The Kilmaulsi were sentient avians indigenous to the planet Kilmaulsias. While they possessed no wings, they had colorful ruffs of feathers under their jaws and along their arms.

Black Butcher was the personal starship of Vin Feal. Originally a stock Nova-Drive 3-Z light freighter, Feal modified the vessel by adding a starboard dual laser cannon and a top-mounted laser cannon.
The Glottalphibs were a reptilian sentient species indigenous to the planet Glottal.
The Sljees were nonhumanoid sentients indigenous to the planet Sljee.
The Sauvax were a sentient species native to the planet Leritor. They were amphibious crustaceans with great physical strength, distinguished by big pincers on their arms and six crab-like legs.
The Mlukis were a sentient primate species indigenous to Belsavis. They grew to adolescence at the age of seven and were considered old at the age of thirty. Jevax was a Mluki.

The Menahuun, unofficially known as "little buggers" and sometimes believed to be gremlins, were a furry anthropomorphic lemuroid species from the planet Lamaredd —known as "Great Menahua" in their native Menahu language—.

The Cor were a feline sentient species native to the jungle world Gargolyn IV. The planet was chosen for settlement by the Karflo Corporation, which tried to forcibly relocate a Cor tribe despite legends warning of peril if this occurred.

The Maelibi (singular Maelibus), native to the planet of Iego, were known as Demons by those beings who had visited the planet. They were less well-known than the Diathim, primarily because the Maelibi lived below ground near the core, and rarely left the planet itself.
The Seylott were a sentient bipedal species of mammalians indigenous to the planet Seylott.
The Tarasins were a bipedal, sapient reptilian species indigenous to Cularin. They were remotely related to the gigantic Kilassin.

The T'surr were a sentient species indigenous to the planet of T'surr. T'surr were rarely seen in the galaxy. The species was among the galaxy's most dangerous predators, although their relative scarcity made them less threatening.

The Tirrith was a unique empathic gaseous sentient creature native to the planet Beheboth. A hive-based culture, the Tirrith was composed of individual energy wisps that shared sensations and intelligence, and could feel what the entire hive felt.
M'shinni, also known as mossies, were a sentient species of humanoid mammals who shared a symbiotic relationship with a species of plant.
The Yrashu were technologically primitive sapient beings indigenous to Baskarn. They were large baldheaded primates with green fur covering their bodies, and at first sight appeared intimidating.
The Yagai (singular, Yaga) were sentient insectoids indigenous to Yaga Minor. They were one of the many species enslaved and exploited by the Galactic Empire.
The Tempestro were a Force-sensitive sentient species indigenous to Koda's World.

The Tasari were a species of sentient bipeds that were indigenous to the world of Tasariq. They had brightly colored blue skin and bright orange or red feathers down their head to spine. They also had a bright yellow beak and also had large eyes.
The Tarro were muscular humanoids from Tililix, a planet in the Til system deep in the Unknown Regions. Their skin color varied from light gray to dark green, while their eyes were bright yellow.
The Xa Fel were a Near-Human race that inhabited Xa Fel in the Kanchen sector of the Core Worlds.

The Tarongs were large sentient avians from the twin worlds of Iri and Disim in the Epidimi system. Notably skilled mimics, Tarongs were typically talkative and friendly people. They were fond of space travel, gems, and protocol droids.

The Tarc were a sentient crustacean species, indigenous to the planet Hjaff. Standing at around two meters tall with four arms and a chitinous exoskeleton, they appeared intimidating to most humanoids, a reputation furthered by their ruthless and emotionless behavior.

The Sunesi were a species of sentient amphibian humanoids native to the planet Monor II. Capable of breathing their world's toxic air, the species was noted for their early metamorphosis they underwent during adolescence.
The Shatras were sentient species of reptilian bipeds indigenous to Trascor.

The Shashay were sentient avians indigenous to Crytal Nest planet in Wild Space. They were renowned for their natural skills as singers and astrogators, giving them the common nickname of Space Singers.
The Sekct were a reptilian sentient species indigenous to Marca.
The Ropagu were Near-Humans who lived on Ropagi II.
The Rellarins were sentient bipeds indigenous to Rellnas Minor, a moon orbiting the gas giant Rellnas in the Rell system.

The Ranth were sentient carnivorous mammals indigenous to Caaraz. Even before the Galactic Empire discovered their homeworld and brought the Ranth to the attention of the galactic community, they were a deeply divided people.

The Rakririans were sentient arthropods indigenous to the planet Rakrir. The sentients were distinctive in appearance, with five pairs of limbs and stalk-mounted eyes. They rarely left their homeworld, finding the wider galaxy too unrefined for their sophisticated tastes.
The Qwohog were amphibious humanoid sapients indigenous to Hirsi, a planet mostly covered in freshwater lakes and seas.
The Pulras were sentients indigenous to Kuras III, which they called "Host". They shared their planet with two other species, the Aganof and the Hairy Savages.
The Proteans (also sometimes called Protreans) were sentient beings indigenous to Nathas I which was located within the Questal sector.

The Poss'Nomin were a sentient species indigenous to the planet Illarreen. Thickly built humanoids slightly larger than the average Human, they were easily recognized by their large, shovel-shaped jaws and their three eyes.
The Pho Ph'eahians were a sentient people indigenous to Pho Ph'eah. They were generally humanoid bipeds whose four arms and bright blue fur made them stand out in a crowd.

The Odenji were a sentient species indigenous to the planet Issor, which they shared with their cousin species, the Issori. Originally a nomadic underwater society, the Odenji moved to the land after being discovered by the Issori, with whom they formed a merged society.
The Noehons were sentient arboreal insectoids indigenous to Noe'ha'on. Noehons were well-known throughout the galaxy as a species of slaves and slave-traders.
The Najib were a sentient species indigenous to Najiba in the Faj system.
The Marasans were sentients indigenous to Marasai, a planet deep within the Marasa Nebula. They were notable for their extensive use of cyborg implants.
The Lafrarians were sentient avian humanoids indigenous to the planet Lafra.
The Krieks were a species of sentients that were indigenous to the world of Kriekaal in Wild Space.
The Kluuzot were a species of sentient lemuroids that were indigenous to the world of Krann.
The Kentra were a winged feline sentient species indigenous to Orellon II. They were simple and friendly with a sense of humor and honesty.
The Karrans were a sentient species indigenous to Karra.

The Kari were small sentient insectoids covered with a black exoskeleton. They were the only sentient race indigenous to Karideph. Their language was similar to singing, appearing closer to the whistling and beeping of droids rather than a sentient species' speech.
The Kalduu were sapients indigenous to Ropagi II.
The Kadri'Ra were a large sentient species believed to be related to the Duinuogwuin. The planet of Arapia was their adopted homeworld.
Bornecks were Near-Humans native to the planet Vellity.
The Starhook Ten was a modified space truck owned by Shug Ninx.

The Bespin Bandit was a delta-shaped smuggling freighter with an off-set cockpit. It belonged to Uz Bonearm and it fought for the New Republic in the battle of New Alderaan alongside Starhook Ten and Hyperspace Marauder. It was equipped with ion cannons.
The Hyperspace Marauder was Lo Khan's personal smuggling starship.

The Riilebs were a sentient species of humanoid insectoids that were indigenous to the planet of Riileb. Members of the species were relatively tall, with gray, knobbly skin and two antennae, which could detect changes in the biorhythms of other organisms.
The New Republic General Ministry was a New Republic organization responsible for government policy, planning, information.
Jedi Explorer was a sleek, two-man starship used by Luke Skywalker and Kam Solusar to reach Ossus during the implementation of the reborn Emperor's Operation Shadow Hand in 10 ABY.

The Annoo-dat Prime were the original Annoo-dat species. Four-eyed reptilian warriors, they desolated and abandoned their original homeworld Annoo, and conquered nearby Gelefil, thereafter known as Annoo. They were known to have preternatural strength, reflexes, and speed.

The Ret were sapient reptilians, indigenous to Gelefil. They had heavy-lidded eyes and scales which changed colors with their emotions. They were also long-lived with the average lifespan of hundreds of years.

The Ansionians, the indigenous species of Ansion, were slender humanoids with pale-yellow skin. Shorter than the average Human, they were hairless save for a single brush of dense fur about fifteen centimeters wide and around seven centimeters tall that ran from their forehead…
The Caarites were a sentient porcine species indigenous to the planet Caarimon.

The avril, native to the moon Yavin 8, was a large bird of prey. It was covered with thick black feathers and had beady eyes. Avrils also had a wingspan of about eight meters and sharp twenty-centimeter-long talons.
The Hairy Savages were primitive, violent, semi-sentient, predatory humanoids indigenous to Kuras III. The term was assigned to the species who was known to attack anything on sight.

The Velmoc species were sentient, humanoid insectoids indigenous to the planet Velmor. Their distinctive physiology included powerful limbs, compound eyes, two antennae, and prominent crests that jutted from the arms.

The Chuhkyvi were a water-breathing species indigenous to Aquaris. Due to a natural disaster, a benevolent species relocated them to Iskalon, where they became part of the Iskalonian school. Although they adopted the common Iskalonian tongue, they also kept their own language.

A species of sentient, green-skinned humanoids made up at least part of the population of the planet Majoor in the Expansion Region. Each member of the species had two three-fingered hands, a globular head, and thick lips.
Foonars were horned, scaly pachydermoids found in the grasslands on the forest moon of Endor.

Ice Demons were sentient humanoids with ice-like traits, possessing bodies that appeared similar to white crystal, as well as resistance to frigid temperatures. They had long, curved horns and sharp, icicle-like teeth.

The Bormterrans were four-armed, fearsome, loyal, dragon-like, reptiloid sapients indigenous to Bormter. They were fierce melee combatants, which made them perfect for recruitment into Warlord Delurin's dragon troopers.

The blue banthas were sapient, Force-sensitive banthas found on the planet Entooine. The average height of a young blue bantha was two meters, whereas adults generally grew to an average height of three meters.

The crystal spiders known as the Lucents (a name Daran Tal gave them, as their own language was unpronounceable to humanoids) were sentient arachnids from an unknown world that was thought to be in the Voidfire Nebula.
The Suprosa was a heavily modified Imperial MB-C1 medium transport.
Chenachochan was a riverside city on Kashyyyk.
Chendrrl was a Wookiee camp on Alaris Prime.

Hoorrkhukk was a major manufacturing city on the Mid Rim planet Kashyyyk that produced trade goods for offworld commerce. The city was built in the interwined branches of the planet's native wroshyr trees.
Ittummi was a location on Kashyyyk north of Chenachochan. It was occupied by Wookiee Berserkers which aided Han Solo and Chewbacca destroy Moff Darcc's fortress.
Kamarkiia was a city in the Wartaki continent on Kashyyyk. During the Galactic Civil War it was abandoned by the Wookiees.
Karryntora was a city on the Wookiee homeworld Kashyyyk.
Kroohhuhwoor was a small agricultural community on the planet Kashyyyk located in the galaxy's Mid Rim. The goods produced in Kroohhuhwoor were primarily sold on Kashyyyk rather than being exported.
Llamitcuk was a Wookiee camp on Alaris Prime.
Maarwraawroo was a large city on the planet Kashyyyk. It had been built around a manufacturing facility in the intertwined branches of the world's native wroshyr trees.

Blackfire Flight was a squadron of RZ-1 A-wing interceptors that was assigned to the Fifth Battle Group during the Black Fleet Crisis. Part of the New Republic Fifth Fleet, it fought in Operation Hammerblow.
Northaykk was a city on the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk.
Okikuti was a city on Kashyyyk located on the banks of a large lake. The town was located in a forest clearing and contained farms, housing structures, an animal nursery, and mining facilities.
Orriorr was a small community on the planet Kashyyyk that produced agricultural goods for the planet.
Blessings was the name of a Dreadnaught of Imperial design employed by the Yevetha during the Black Fleet Crisis.
Rarrhkrrorrho was a small agricultural community that produced goods for its planet Kashyyyk, which was located in the galaxy's Mid Rim.
Rwookawarrump was a Wookiee camp on Alaris Prime.
Tayriiwook was a Wookiee camp on Alaris Prime.
Truvvhhurr was a major city on the planet Kashyyyk located in the galaxy's Mid Rim. The city was built around manufacturing facilities that produced goods for offworld trading.
Tunnatutikan was a riverside city on Kashyyyk.
The Brilliant was a Nebula-class Star Destroyer of the New Republic Defense Fleet.
The Cantrosians were sapient felinoids indigenous to Cantros 7. Scratches from their paws would result in Cantrosian-scratch fever.

Catumen were sapient felinoids known for the fierce mercenary warriors of their species. Catuman warriors were raised in the arts of warfare from birth, and were said to be among the deadliest killers in the galaxy.
The S'kytri (meaning the Windborn in their language) were a sentient species of winged humanoids indigenous to the planet of Skye, also known to the Galactic Empire as Marat V.
The Night-Soarers were a sentient species from the planet Tyluun. They were bipedal in form, and large wings extended from their ribcages and arms, making them capable of independent flight.
The Rigellians were hulking green-skinned sentient humanoids from Rigel VII. Due to the high gravity of their home planet, the reptilian Rigellians were very large-framed, dense, and heavily-muscled.

The Serps were sentient, humanoid reptiles indigenous to the planet Serphidi in the Belial system. They were a sexually dimorphic species, with red-scaled and flat-faced males, and orange-scaled and long-snouted females.

The Brizzit were a insectoid sentient species, difficult to identify by name and face. Tzizvvt was a Brizzit. Although he had been treasure hunting on Jandoon, that was not his homeworld; though there was a colony of Brizzit established there.
The Battle of Teyr was a battle fought on Teyr during the early stages of the Clone Wars.
The Battle of Lianna was a battle fought on Lianna during the Clone Wars. Victory on Lianna cost Jedi Master Cei Vookto his life.

objective: Investigate claims of hidden Separatist weapon caches
x: The Mission to Nivek was an assignment to the planet Nivek undertaken by Obi-Wan Kenobi and his Padawan, Anakin Skywalker, during the Clone Wars.

The raid on Polis Massa was a large skirmish between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic on the mining asteroid colony of Polis Massa that was being used by the Rebel Alliance during the early phase of the Galactic Civil War in 0 BBY.
The Alderaan furry moth, also known as the woolly moth, was a large-winged flying insect native to the planet Alderaan that nested amid bushy flowers.

result: Part of the Death Star plans stolen
501st Legion reassigned to track down the plans
x: The Death Star Uprising was a relatively large prison riot, originating in Detention Block 2180 aboard the first Death Star, where Rebel Alliance captives-of-war attempted to escape by fighting their way into two hangars and stealing a Sentinel-class landing craft.
Otoh Mandassa was a city built and inhabited by the amphibian Gungan race in the swamps on the planet Naboo.
Otoh Sancture was a wealthy Gungan settlement on the planet Naboo ruled by Boss Gallo and located west of Lake Paonga.
Umberbool City was a city in the swamps on the planet Naboo, inhabited by the amphibious Gungan species.
Rellias was a city on Naboo ruled by the Gungan Boss Ganne. It was connected to Otoh Gunga through the Rellias channel.

type: Reconstituted debris of an Executor-class Star Dreadnought
x: Second Death was a unique vessel constructed from the remains of the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Razor's Kiss.

Thikkiiana City was a Wookiee city located on their homeworld of Kashyyyk. Acting as the technological hub of the planet, it was of equal standing to Kachirho, the center of all hyperspace mapping. By the time of the Galactic Empire, it featured a spaceport.

The Icarii were a near-Human species native to Vestar who were wiped out in the so-called Icarii campaign by the Galactic Empire's Lightning Battalion under the command of General Nim and Colonel Abal Karda.
The Iskalloni, or Iskallons, were a sentient species of short, blue-skinned, humanoid cyborgs indigenous to the Wild Space planet of Iskadrell.
The Glarsaurs were reptilian sapients indigenous to Gelgelar. Brutes by nature, they had curled tails and sharp claws.
The Jazbinans were humanoid sentients with feline traits indigenous to the planet Jazbina. They were ruled by an aristocratic family, headed by Lord Prepredenko in 0 ABY.
Palpatine's office was an office in the Galactic Senate Building on Coruscant used by Naboo Senator Sheev Palpatine.
The Lizling were a species of sentient reptiles that were known for their diminutive size. One individual was named Boz.

Jokhalli were sapients indigenous to Blimph 3. They had four arms with long snouts and antennas, closely resembling that of a Dug. Their skin tended to have a green look to it, though their leaders tended to have a brighter shade.
The Jeodu were a tall, brown-skinned species. Their heads were topped with a conical white crystal; for this reason, the name "Dequc" (meaning "Whitehead") was common among them.
Filordi (singular, Filordus) were sapients indigenous to Filordis.
Oblee were three-armed sapients indigenous to Oblis, although originally from the Unknown Regions.

The Ootoolans were a species of amphibious sentients indigenous to the beautiful aquatic world of Ootoola. They generally possessed humanoid features, but their skin was a mottled bright green, and their heads were adorned with a fin-like ridge and several finned jowls.

Akurians, known by their nickname, Snow Stompers, and the derogatory Snow Demons, were tall, white-furred sapients similar in height and build to Wookiees, with crests of hair running along their scalps from nose to nape of neck.
The Mere were sentient humanoids that hailed from the aquatic planet of Maramere. They had orange fur covering their bodies, and could breathe underwater. They had both noses and gills.

A species was indigenous to Orooturoo. With small tentacles, four of which ended in a two-prong feature, extended from a large, purple-colored slug-like body, the species had a mating ritual which involved the female devouring the male, similar to some insects.

Nuffins were sapient humanoids, noted for their cleanliness and gentle nature. Princess Nampi's ship was a converted Nuffin freighter, and she kept a Nuffin slave on board in order to fool would-be pirates into boarding, whereupon they would be ambushed by the princess's soldi…

Sloogarians were slimy, slug-like sapients from the Sloogaria system. They were known to enjoy eating bantha droppings and other treats that most species usually found disgusting. They were also known to stretch the truth for profit.
Meeks were a primitive sentient species, with three eyes. A village of Meeks was afraid that a rancor would eat them.

The Yaka were a race of Near-Human cyborgs hailing from the Yaka system. Centuries before the rise of the Galactic Empire, the neighboring Arkanians, known for their genetic experiments, implanted the naturally dim-witted species with cybernetic implants.
Filvians were a species of sentient quadrupedal ungulates indigenous to the desert planet of Filve, notable for their technical aptitude, their hardiness, and their gregarious nature.

The Drovians were a sentient species that was bipedal in form, with corpulent bodies several times heavier than that of Humans. Their four limbs were extremely strong tentacles, which terminated in three pincers. Their bodies were grey or orange, with black or brown hair.

Pydyrians were sapient avians indigenous to the moon Pydyr that orbited the planet Almania. They were tall, thin humanoids that had two-toed feet and three-fingered hands, and their bone structure was very thin.
Biituians were a near-Human sentient race indigenous to Biitu.
Issori were amphibious, carnivorous humanoids indigenous to Issor.
Gutretee were a crystalline sentient species indigenous to Isis. The Gutretee were immune to blaster fire.
A sentient gray rock and crystal species was indigenous to the planet of Hurikane.

The Keed were a near-Human species from the Outer Rim Territories planet Keedad. They shared their homeworld with Human colonists since the early history of the Galactic Republic. Around 26 BBY, the Keed/Human hybrid Ytavarg Aleema was born on Keedad.

Huraloks were sapient reptilians indigenous to Djurmo. They were known to be a vicious species that held long grudges with other beings and even their own. Huraloks were extremely long-lived, living to as old as the mid 300s.
The Murachaun were sentient reptilians indigenous to Nahsu Minor in the Ktilac Regions.

Paiguns were toadlike sapients indigenous to the planet Paigu. The Paigun body shape was similar to that of the Muuns, though they had knobby, scaly skin and were often more technologically apt. Paiguns were famous for their love of mathematics and logical thinking.

Squalrises were a species of sentient, yellow-skinned humanoids indigenous to the planet Ifmix VI in the Colonies region. The Squalris anatomy was characterized by a corpulent frame, bristly hair garnishing the face, and a rounded crest running the length of the skull.

The H'drachi were a species of sentient, humanoid sapients indigenous to the Expansion Region planet M'haeli. Somewhat resembling cameloids, the H'drachi were highly in tune with the Force, with a high number of the species being Force-sensitive.
Gulmarids were a sapient reptilian species indigenous to Gulma.

Gektls—occasionally spelled Gecktls—were a sentient species of bipedal reptilians native to the planet Hoszh Iszhir. They were regarded as tough survivors, and members of the species were capable of sloughing off their skin and even tails as a means of escaping danger.
Felacatians were a species of polymorphic felines native to the planet Felacat.

Er'stacians were a sentient species of humanoids with purple skin and three clawed fingers per hand. They lived on Er'stacia, a planet in Wild Space, where they divided themselves into clans based upon lineages traced back to the tidal pools of their ancestors.
The Ganathans, or Ganathians, were a sentient Near-Human species indigenous to the planet Ganath, located within a largely uncharted cloud of gases within Hutt Space known as the Oktos Nebula.

Diollans were a species of sentient, featherless avians, that originated on the planet Dioll, in the Juvex sector. They were short and stocky, with broad beaks, leathery, mottled brown skin, and small intense eyes.

The Chubbits were a species of bipedal, sentient reptiles indigenous to the desert world of Aridus in the Expansion Region. The average Chubbit stood shorter than a fully grown Human. Their skin was green or yellow, although some featured red or black spots.

Carthasians were green sapients indigenous to Benja-Rihn that also possessed large, orange eyes with black pupils, set-back nostrils on their large upper jaws and they had a collection of small green stubs visually similar to hair.

Snogars were a tall, furry sentient species native to the ice-covered planet Ota in the Mid Rim. The Snogars were descended from a technologically advanced race referred to as the "Old Ones," who built cities within Ota's ice canyons.
The Satellite Liberator was a Bendine XR12 starship in operation at some point prior to the Invasion of Naboo. It was slightly smaller than an average escape pod.
A red-skinned reptilian sentient species was indigenous to the planet of Sarrish.
Temolak were a sentient species indigenous to Zirulast. They were renowned as scavengers throughout the galaxy.
The Shadowmen were humanoids native to the "night planet" of Nivek.

The Zizimaak were a species of sentient insectoid avians that were indigenous to the world of Kathol. They were genetically created by the DarkStryder to serve as scouts. The race eventually escaped and formed their own society.
The Seikoshans were sapients indigenous to Seikosha. They were very tall humanoids with pale green skin and unblinking red eyes.

The Yimi were a species of sentient, diminutive humanoids with large skulls that were indigenous to the world of Kathol. They were created by the DarkStryder and contained large brains which were flash-printed with necessary skills.
The Yapi were sapient canoids indigenous to Kathol which were created by the DarkStryder which considered them a successful warrior guardian servant race.

The Pan-preneur were amphibious sentients indigenous to Sonn Vilmari. They resembled many other aquatic races, and were believed to be distantly related genetically to the Mon Calamari, though many aquatic species shared similar genetics.

The Saheelindeeli were sapient primates indigenous to Saheelindeel. The ape-like aliens were green-furred humanoids. They had limited technology, and were just starting to move ahead toward automation by 0 ABY. They had a matriarchal society.

The Maoi were amorphous sapients indigenous to Kathol and were created by the ancient Kathol race. The DarkStryder considered them amoral and self-centered, and attempted to discard them in the Segmi tunnels after the Rift Disaster.

The Charr Ontee were sentient arachnids with two pairs of legs and two pairs of arms indigenous to Kathol. They were genetically created by the ancient Kathol species. They also were capable of exuding a sticky webbing.
The Krakai were an insectoid species indigenous to Kathol. They were created by the DarkStryder.

Fiery Ones were mysterious sentient photonic beings indigenous to Kathol. Unlike most of the planet's inhabitants, they were apparently not creations of the DarkStryder. In appearance, they looked like balls of light.
The Vashans were sentient insectoids indigenous to Vasha.
Mykes were Near-Humans under the rule of the Galactic Empire. Norym Kim, a member of the Imperial Interim Ruling Council, was a Myke.
Mos Gamos was a remote settlement on Tatooine. It was a known haven for criminals.
Eidolon Base was the name used by Marl Semtin to indicate the location of the starship Eidolon and its weapons cache on Tatooine.
The Galandans were Near-Humans from Galand. A number of them emigrated to Rishi.

Rodisar was a sapient reptilian species from the planet Rodis in the Outer Rim Territories. Rodisars were a primitive inhabitants and waged seasonal wars with one another. General Nilo was a member of this species that was kidnapped from his homeplanet by a Zygerrian slavers.
The Glory was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer best known as the flagship of former Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin.
The Hemes Arbora were a sentient species from the Unknown Regions. They hailed from the planet Carrivar, but their migrations brought them to the planets Umaren'k and, eventually, Osseriton.
The Court of Justice, also known as the High Court or Supreme Court, was the highest judiciary of the New Republic and Galactic Alliance.

The Swimming People of Dellalt, also known as Swimmers or Dellaltians, were sentient, lake-dwelling sauropteroids indigenous to Dellalt. They were large, with small heads on top of long, muscular necks, four flippers for movement in water, and heavy, short tails.

The Ord Cestus Squad consisted of an Alpha ARC trooper and four clone commandos, which included a communications expert (Seefor), a pilot (Xutoo), a logistics expert (Sirty), a physical training expert (Forry), and their leader, (Jangotat).

Nebula Chaser was a modified thousand-meter long Corellian Engineering Corporation cruiser under the command of Captain Pollux, customized with Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc. sublight drives. It had a hammerhead-shaped front.
The Grave Tuskens were a mercenary swoop gang comprising of Tusken Raiders. The Dark Jedi Maw used the Grave Tuskens as a personal strike force.
Corellian grass snakes were reptilian creatures native to Corellia that resembled ysalamiri, except that they had neither fur nor claws.

The Visionary was the elegant cloaked transport of G0-T0, one of the most successful Exchange bosses operating in both the Y'Toub system and Republic space. It was probably one of a kind, in that its actual owner was a droid, as was its entire crew.

The Tocoyans were a sentient species indigenous to the desert world of Tocoya, in the Ktilac Regions of the Inner Rim. Each member of the species had a hairless, domed head, a humanoid torso, two arms, and wrinkled skin.

The B'rknaa were a mineral-based sentient species native to Indobok, a moon orbiting the planet Kalarba in the Mid Rim region of the galaxy. In actuality, the moon was itself an enormous member of the species.

The Kabierouns were a sentient species indigenous to the planet Kabieroun in the Outer Rim Territories. Their physiology was roughly humanoid, with a long, wrinkled snout that featured two dark eyes and a triangular mouth.

Calocour Heights was a marketing district in the Senate District of Coruscant's Galactic City. It was located between the Palace of the Republic, which was to the south, and the Senate Building. It was near Column Commons.
Saki was a CR90 corvette in the Alliance Fleet. Saki was part of the the Independence task force at Sullust, it was also present during the Battle of Endor.

D-89 was a New Republic Intelligence Ferret-class reconnaissance vessel. Assigned to Colonel Pakkpekkat's Teljkon Vagabond task force, D-89 was used to trail the Vagabond while an interdiction line was established.
Zebitrope VIII was a terrestrial planet located in the Zebitrope system, a part of the Centrality sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Zandor Rockers were a species of sentient beings who looked like rocks with legs and faces. By hiding on the ground, legs retracted, eyes and mouth closed, they could pass for mundane stones. The Rockers could run quickly on their legs or burrow rapidly through the ground.
The Fuzzums were a species of sentient avians indigenous to the planet Dandelo. Members of the species were roughly humanoid, standing shorter than the average Human on spindly legs.
BL-17 was a BL-series Battle Legionnaire, created to serve the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

2X-7KPR ("Tooex") was a green domed KPR security droid operational during the Galactic Civil War. It was capable of monitoring floodlights and perimeter sensors as well as maintaining security devices.
The Brrbrlpp were the indigenous species of the planet Esfandia. They were often referred to by offworlders as the Cold Ones since it was easier to say than Brrbrlpp.

t: Battle of Zonama Sekot (Yuuzhan Vong War)
x: A battle was fought between the living world of Zonama Sekot and the Yuuzhan Vong in 28 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Globblins were carnivores creatures with green skin and four-clawed limbs. They had sharp, white teeth and a jutting lower jaw. Their eyes, located on the sides of their head, glowed blue. They appeared to be capable of mimicking speech, as one was witnessed saying, "Feed me".

The Avengeance was a Bothan cruiser employed by Reh'mwa and other Bothan radicals to locate the hidden world Zonama Sekot. These radicals intended to use the ship to continue the policy of ar'krai and wipe out the relocated Yuuzhan Vong species.
Peripleen were long-living, simian sentients with strong jaws and arms. Wim Smoot, an inmate on Oovo IV, was a Peripleen.
Task Force Blackvine was one of the original five task forces of the New Republic Fifth Fleet, and was created some time before 16 ABY.

The Clantaani or Clantaanis were a species of sentient, long-eared humanoids from the arid world of Clantaano III. The Clantaani lived in marauding, nomadic tribes that fought endlessly over the limited resources of their homeworld.
Draags were a species of stocky, reptilian humanoids from the planet Ninzam VI. Due to their cold-blooded nature, they often wore temperature-regulating suits while away from their homeworld.

Muttani were a species from the planet Kalidorn in Wild Space. The Muttani had a sickly appearance and peculiar body odor. Their bodies were generally hairless, and their mouths were filled with sharp teeth.
The Guineo were a bipedal, sentient species indigenous to the planet of Dohlban, where they were often used for manual labor. Typically, members of the species were tall and powerfully built.

The Mordageen were a sentient species from the planet Mordagon. The species was bipedal in form with pink skin and pointed ears. One notorious Mordageen was the smuggler Bendix Fust, who worked for the Dug crime lord Sebolto.
2-124 was an Uulshos justice droid programmed as an Imperial assassin.
The Eidolon was a redesigned Strike-class cruiser.
The Second Battle of Endor was the first major battle in the Nagai invasion of 4 ABY. It took place nearly one month after the destruction of the second Death Star.

The Palpatine Gardens were a large set of gardens on the grounds of the Imperial Palace on Coruscant. They were among the locations visited by Galaxy Tours' Grand Galactic Tour, with their being among the rare events to allow for a public tour of the gardens.
The Warhog was a VGK-3 Shooting Star class starfighter prototype that was stolen by Alliance Infiltrator Bryce Agoris and freelance operative Myrgaanti Shi-Iki.
The Gruvians were the native sentients of the planet Gruvia in the Expansion Region.

The Arrestor was an Acclamator-class assault ship that served the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars and participated in the Mission to the Chaykin Cluster. It survived the Clone Wars to serve the Imperial Navy in the Galactic Civil War.
The Arrestor was a Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser in the Imperial Starfleet, under the command of Admiral Winstel Greelanx.

The Enforcer was a Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser in the Imperial Starfleet under the command of Admiral Winstel Greelanx that participated in the Battle of Nar Shaddaa. Enforcer, along with Inexorable, formed the rear of the assault force's wedge formation.

Enforce was a Victory I-class Star Destroyer in the Corporate Sector Authority under the command of Baruche Sloane. Commanded by Commander Baruche Sloane, it was assigned to customs duty in the Kalinda system.
The Liquidator was a Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser in the Imperial Navy, commanded by Admiral Winstel Greelanx.
The Aboukir was a New Republic warship that was destroyed during the Battle of N'zoth.
Abrogator was an Imperial Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that acted as the flagship of the fleet sent to Saloch 2 to quell a group of Lortans during the Reslian Purge.
Abubaka II was a starship that saw service with the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It was used by Lieutenant Commander Zhir-Khan.
Accuser was a modified 720 light freighter owned by the Tiss'shar bounty hunter and assassin Kal-tan-shi. He acquired it from one of his targets in the Lesser Plooriod Cluster.
Achilles was a Victory-class Star Destroyer under the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The Ackyuna was a Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy.
Adarga was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer used to defend the TIE Defender development plant in the Parmel system.

The droidbreaker, formerly known as the swamphulk, was a creature native to Belgaroth. Its native planet consumed by pollution and scrapyards, the droidbreaker evolved in a single generation to survive and fit its new surroundings.
Slashrats were rodent-like predators native to Bimmiel.
The Sith warbird was a species of flightless bird from the planet Khar Delba that was commonly used as an artillery mount by the Sith, a Force-sensitive species from the world Korriban.
Native to the planet of Cerea, the crown of silk was both a beautiful and a dangerous creature. Although serene looking and graceful, the crown of silk was a vicious predator.

A creature from the forest world of Mantessa, the Mantessan panthac was one of its most dangerous predators. The fierce pack animal was so deadly that several attempts to breed it offworld caused severe destruction to the native fauna of planets where it was raised.
The Liberator, known as the Adjudicator during its Imperial service, was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer originally used by the Imperial Navy and later by the New Republic.

The Geonosian hydras were huge carnivorous insectoid creatures with three heads, though some hydras could have more than three—which would not be considered a mutation. Hydras were amphibious and lived beneath the few seas on Geonosis, like the Ebon Sea.
Admiral Korvin was an ex-Trade Federation Captor-class heavy munitions cruiser, assigned by Wilhuff Tarkin as the command ship of Raith Sienar's small fleet for his mission to Zonama Sekot in 29 BBY.
Blubreen were amphibious near-Humans from a planet in the Ploo sector.
They were one of many species that could be found in the avenues of Nar Shaddaa at the tail end of the Clone Wars.

The living quarters of Senior High Council member and former Master of the Order Mace Windu served him from his appointment to the High Council until the dissolution of the Order during the Great Jedi Purge.
The living quarters of High Council member Shaak Ti served her from her appointment to the High Council until the dissolution of the Order during the Great Jedi Purge.
The Yavin Runner II was one of a number of shuttles that served the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4.
The clone heavy assault troopers, also known as clone heavy troopers and anti-air clone troopers were heavy weapons specialists in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
The No Luck Required was a Corellian YZ-775 medium transport owned by Uldir Lochett during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The Zorba Express, also known as Zorba's Express, was an ancient starship that belonged to Zorba the Hutt, shady businessman and father of the famous crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

result: The onset of monstrous experiments on the planet’s population by the i
x: During their own conquest crusade against all worlds of the Galaxy, the extra-galactic race of invaders, the Yuuzhan Vong, attacked Rodia, Druckenwell, Falleen, and Kalarba in an attempt to cut off the Corellian Run.
The Zanibar were a cannibalistic sentient species native to the planet Xo.

Silika were sapients indigenous to Dohu VII. They had a very rigid code of honor. Despite having three arms, they were not more dexterous due to their short, stubby fingers, additionally they had stumpy legs.

The Sareeta were a humanoid, sentient species. They had dark, lidless eyes and pink skin. The species, native to the Outer Rim planet Sareet, reached atomic-age technology before encountering the galactic community.
Mind-witches were a humanoid vampire-like species who used Force illusions to fool their victims. They had intense psychic abilities that they could augment with unique stone columns.

Stohls were furred, serpentine luxury pets from the planet of Ichtor 8. The rich wrapped themselves with live stohl, and they could be trained to bite their masters' assailants. They were naturally poisonous, but domesticated stohls had their poison removed.
Adars were pack-hunting reptilian creatures with sail-like wings, which hailed from the blistering hot planet of Omiddelon III.
The Vindicator was a New Republic carrier vessel that was stationed in the space beyond Ammuud.

Peche was a settlement on Krant. It was situated to the west across a large chasm from the city of Theenes, with the two cities connected by three sturdy bridges. Peche included a Command center, a Research Center, prefab shelters, and farms inside its walls.
Kuras I was the first planet in the Kuras system of the Elrood sector. It was a hot, rocky wasteland.
Kuras II was the second planet in the Kuras system of the Elrood sector. Kuras II was a dry, desert world orbited by two moons.

The Kuras Asteroid Belt was an asteroid belt in the Kuras system of the Elrood sector. It orbited the primary star Kuras, between the worlds of Kuras III and Kuras IV. The presence of an asteroid belt made travel to and from the Kuras system difficult.

The Shyrack cave resided on the desolate planet of Korriban. Large groups of shyracks lived in this cave. The cave consisted of three separate tunnels and an abyss which was spanned by a small bridge.
The Qella were a quadruped species from the planet Brath Qella.

The Qonto were a sentient species from the Qonto system, which was located in Wild Space. Although generally not known for their perception, some exceptional Qonto had senses considerably sharper than the Human standard.

This species were a race of thin humanoid aliens with red skin and white facial stripes indigenous to Adin. Other distinctive features were their two-fingered hands and pale pink teeth. Senator Meido was a member of this species.
The Aplocaph were a sentient species preoccupied with finding love. Members of the species treated exotic locations and leisure time as an opportunity to find someone special.
Arpor-Lan was the name of a sentient species of Humanoids with horned chins. Coming from Arporatal-Lanin, Arpor-Lans were famous through the galaxy as scouts and trackers.
The Askhew were a race of short, furry humanoids native to the planet Entooine. They were known to have tamed the native quohrs, and used them to pull their sleds.
The Babbs were a sentient species that were small in stature. Consequently, they were occasionally thought of in contrast to Wookiees.
The arqet was a species of mountain carnivores and predatory ungulates native to the planet Pellastrallas.

A-Cee was a protocol droid belonging to Candice Ondi before her death at the G-Tap on Sulon. He was chrome plated, had one of his photoreceptors replaced with a zoom lens, was equipped to record a thousand hours of audio and video, but could only speak "dozens" of languages.
The arrak snake was an avian reptile native to the planet Ithor. They fed on shamarok flitters.
Artery worms were tiny, vicious worms native to Dathomir.

The Bogan's brown nafen, colloquially referred to as the butterbat, was one of the largest of the many species of nafen found throughout the galaxy. Bogan's brown nafen was widespread on many of the galaxy's warmer habitable planets.

Cannoks were small, aggressive predators native to Onderon and its moon Dxun. They were relatively harmless to Humans, but they had a habit of eating anything that could fit in their mouths. They were known as pests, due to a high reproduction rate and notable curiosity.

The Cherfer was an incredibly vicious herd predator that lived in the deserts on the planet Elom. Cherfers were aggressive from birth, becoming even more so as they matured, which they did very rapidly.

The climbing tauntaun was a subspecies of tauntaun which originated on the planet of Hoth. Known as the smallest of its species, it had the two upward curving horns that met just above the top its head and used its wide paws studded with heavy claws to climb glaciers and caves.
Croator were flightless birds from Wyndigal 2's swamps and marshlands. They were spindly avians, with long double-jointed legs and small arms in place of wings.
The Danchaf, also called tree goblins by the Jenets, were predatory pack animals which originated on the planet Garban.
The Draagax, sometimes called "drag" for short, was a large omnivorous rodent-like creature that inhabited the planet of Relkass.
Dray beasts were skeletal, eight-legged herd creatures used to pull carts on farms, a common sight on Dellalt and Azbrian.
Drebin were large herbivores found on the planet Kuat. They created a natural form of compost, which was used in gardening.

Fenner's Rock was a rock-like creature named after Rivoc Fenner, a xenobiologist. They crawled using two appendages to drag themselves on top of stones and areas which had moss and lichen, with which they ate using their cartilaginous teeth.

The tripion was a crustaceous species with three venomous tail stingers and over 600 different subspecies. They were best suited to live in the deserts of hot worlds, including the moons Gall and Yavin 13, with the species' diet consisting of small lizards and insects.
Ganjukos were large creatures from Fenn with beaks and thick coats of hair. They were known to stampede at a moment's notice.
The glim worm was a burrowing predator covered with knife-like scales, present on many planets.

The Grakkt was a native of marshes and deep swamps on the planet of Naboo. It could grow to about three meters long. The Grakkt roamed the damp grounds of the planet, with a body like a lion with armor, a crocodile-like head and a tail with spikes.
The Helas were a race of amphibious, nonsentient creatures native to the damp world of Enaleh.

The hitcher crab was a crustacean native to the deserts of Sevarcos II. They moved around the desert, and ate plants and smaller animals. A slow-acting poison coated their claws and shell, used both to disable prey and to discourage predators.

The humbaba was a bovine animal native to a number of forest worlds, such as Corellia, Talus and Kashoon. Aarwynn was a notable mythological humbaba. Covered in dense fur, they were natural burrowers, making the soft swamp lands of their homeworlds an ideal habitat.
Iriaz were docile creatures from the grassland planet Dantooine. While not normally aggressive, they could attack if provoked, charging with their horns.
Ludos were tree-dwelling creatures found living near swamps and rivers on the forested planet Ganlihk.

The miner's horror was a ancient large, space-borne creature of mysterious origins found only in space. Often over twenty meters in size, they were vaguely fish-shaped, with large dorsal spines and a set of large, saw-like teeth.
The mishalope was species of striped, furry mammal indigenous to Firrerre.
Myntors were quadrupedal reptilian carnivores native to Kothlis. Myntors resided in Arblis Forest and (along with other predators) contributed to the extinction of a native bird species.

Nyantolo were aquatic mammals native to the swamps of Wyndigal 2. Up to three meters long, they had two front flippers, two small pelvic fins, and upright flukes on their tail. Their large mouths had shovel-shaped jaws and bony beaks which could deliver a powerful bite.
Onahks were semi-amphibious creatures from the temperate wetlands of Osirrag.
The great oopik, also known simply as the oopik, was a species native to Paramatan.

Oskan blood eaters were bipedal carnivores found on a variety of planets, often used as guards for penal colonies. They had two large hooves on each foot and four arms, each ending in a blade-like claw.

Preying makthiers were flying predators which lived in the crystal caves of Makthierse. These creatures looked like insect larvae with leathery, bat-like wings. Their mouths had two long, thin mandibles, while their tails had a paralyzing stinger.
Qormots were omnivorous forest creatures from the planet Yeshocq's southern hemisphere. They were stocky quadrupeds with sharp claws and teeth.

Quamin (plural quamilla) were flying predators from the Kidron jungles. They had leathery skin, membranous wings, and a long tail. Their tails had razor-sharp fins, which quamilla used as their primary weapons.

The Raen sovra, or electrocution worm, sometimes shortened to sovra, was an exotic species of worm first discovered by Dr. Safford Raen on Tenek, in the Mis-Tenek system. These segmented worms had a flexible metallic exoskeleton, and fed off electricity and metal.
Ralltiir tigers were fierce carnivores native to the planet of Ralltiir. Although they appeared innocent when young, they quickly turned into savage and unpredictable creatures.

Reels were large snakes native to Yavin 8. They killed their prey by crushing their bodies. These were among the predators native to the moon that preyed on the Melodies, the moon's sole sentient species.
The Sacorrian grain fly was an insect that fed on the grain of Sacorrian farms. Its bite injected a mild venom, painful enough to make farmers reluctant to fight the pest closely.
Sanl'jek were a species of small quadrupeds that were native to the world of Dancreti. The species was named after zoologist who discovered them.
Selligore were large creatures native to the planet Corsin. Despite their intimidating size (4 meters tall and 20 meters long), they were quite harmless, feeding on aquatic plankton and small fish.

Sensor stars were an aquatic species native to the planet F'tral. The five-armed mollusks lived in groups of 20-30, and communicated with each other via subsonic tones, relaying warnings and advisories such as "food," "emergency," and "storm" to others in the pack.
Shamarok flitters were flying creatures with leathery wings that was native to planet Ithor.
Shredder bat was the common name for a number of related bat species of various worlds. They were originally native to the Core Worlds planet Atrisia.

The sink-crab was a crustacean native to Bestine IV. It used bladders that filled with air to propel itself. While living on Bestine IV, future Rebel pilot Jek Tono Porkins hunted these creatures in his T-16 skyhopper.

The siringana were vicious, reptilian predators native to the planet N'zoth. These beasts had four three-taloned legs, a pair of scythelike arms, a straight, spiked tail, a mouth full of razor-sharp teeth and a face similar to that of a Yevetha.
Skeeg was a mollusk native to the planet Vendara.
The sliideptra was a species of large annelidians from Tel IV.

The storm beasts were large reptilian creatures twisted by the dark side of the Force, that lived on the world of Malachor V. They had several abilities, including being able to emit a wave of destructive sonic energy and enhanced strength.

The Arch was one of the major skyways found within the city of Efavan, capital of the planet Vorzyd V. It circled the Old Bronzan district of the city, and carried passengers from the Farain Skyway to other parts of the city.

DV-9, also known as Deevee, was a research droid built by the anthropologist Mammon Hoole as an assistant. After the destruction of Alderaan, he spent most of his time as a personal tutor for Hoole's niece and nephew, Tash and Zak Arranda much to his dismay.

C8-42-GE3 was a GE3-series protocol droid on Dantooine during the time of the Jedi Civil War. He belonged to the husband of Elise Montagne; after his death, he was left to Elise, who began to treat the droid as if he were her late husband.
The Foresight was a MC30c frigate used by the Rebel Alliance and the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War as a surveyor starship.
Constancians were short, telepathic mammalian humanoids indigenous to Constancia.

Berchestians were a sentient species of humanoids or near-Humans that hailed from the planet of Berchest. A sizable population of them lived on Mrlsst as well. Berchestians had various characters either tattooed or otherwise imprinted on their bald heads.

Enzeen were rarely-encountered blue-skinned humanoids who inhabited D'vouran, though they were not indigenous to the planet. They had needle-like spikes in place of hair on their heads, and were slightly chubby in form.

Gastrulans were sentient gastropods native to the planet Gastrula in the Outer Rim Territories. Standing just taller than Sullustans—who averaged a height of 1.5 meters—Gastrulans sported four short arms and spotted, bulbous heads.
The Mephout was a sentient species originating in the Wild Space Mephout system. In the Mephout society, all diplomatic duties were handled by the females of the species.

The S'krrr were native to a planet of the same name. They were tall mantis-like insectoids with sharp body segments and small transparent, vestigial wings on their backs. S'krrr could not fly, because their small wings were unable to carry their weight.
Venans were pale-skinned Humans from Vena.

The Polydroxol were a species of sentient, denantium-based shapeshifters that were native to the world of Sevetta. They resembled two hundred kilogram masses of mercury while in their liquid state. Their native environment was the toxic volcanic pools of their homeworld.

Arachnoids were a species of sentient arachnids with a legspan of approximately 2.5 meters. They were covered in dense black and gray fur, and possessed four eyes and powerful hind legs. Ptak-Sok, copilot of the Black Widow, was an Arachnoid.
Poldts were lanky sapient bipeds that superficially bore some resemblance to Gungans and the Geonosians.
The Imperator was an Imperator-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy.

The Knytix was a non-sentient mantid from Thyferra that the Vratix employed in a number of capacities. They were said to make excellent pets and soup, and their saliva was used in the construction of Vratix buildings.
Kalaides were diminutive mollusks native to Cols. They were large and covered in spines, helpful to drive away the many predators of Cols.
The Aggressor was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire.

Phemiss was the capital city of New Plympto, homeworld to the Nosaurians. Phemiss was once a major center of rikknit egg exporting, but demand from the citizens of the Galactic Republic dried up, leaving Phemiss a shadow of its former self.

The Imzig species was a sentient Humanoid race native to the planet Couronne. The species differed from base Humans through bony ridges surrounding the formers' eyes, raised eyebrows, and wider nostrils.

Tefauns were a blue-skinned, sentient humanoid species with ridged heads and bulging eyes. The Tefaun banker Kelek purchased the Wheel, a space station gambling resort, launching a brutal gladiatorial competition called the Big Game.

Mimphs were small, semi-sentient creatures native to the Forest Moon of Endor. Although not fully sentient, mimphs were intelligent, and they were able to comprehend and use language to communicate with fully sentient beings like Ewoks.

Iceheads were a species of sentient humanoids with lean, black bodies that held spiked, rectangular heads that resembled blocks of ice. Their large mouths brimmed with jagged teeth, and their three-fingered hands sported sharp claws.

The Kagles were a trio of sentient, brown-furred brothers who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. They were distinguished by their differently colored shirts: one in blue, one in green, and one in yellow. They lived near Bright Tree Village and the home of Larry the Shriek.

Tromes were small humanoid beings found on the Forest Moon of Endor. They were characterized by their small size, high voices, and large beards. Despite their small size, their favorite sport was wrestling; they had wrestling tournaments annually.
A Frost Sprite was a type of sentient humanoid. One Frost Sprite, Odra, the "Duchess of Sleet," lived on the Forest Moon of Endor.

Eriaduan rats were six-legged vermin indigenous to Eriadu, but also found on Koros Major. The rat was one of the few native species to escape extinction during Eriadu's industrialization, outliving most of the species that preyed upon it.
A scorpion species was native to Ziost and was preyed upon by a rodent species.
Sith pincerbugs were arthropods indigenous to the planet Ziost. Their burning venom was used during the initiation of a new Dark Lord of the Sith to burn the Dark Lord's mark on his forehead.
This vessel was a starship used by Empress Teta for travel to Coruscant.

The Hopskip was a modified YT-1300 light freighter operated by smugglers Haber Trell and Maranne Darmic, who mainly smuggled weapons for the Rebel Alliance on Derra IV. It was destroyed by the 181st Imperial Fighter Group above Derra IV.
The Star of Empire was a luxury liner owned by Haj Shipping Lines.

The city of Ta'a Chume'Dan was the administrative capital of the Hapes Consortium. Despite being a small, neat city of only a few hundred thousand inhabitants, it still was the hub of governmental, commercial and legal activity for the entire Hapes Cluster, due to laws requiri…
Noquivzor was a planet located in the Colonies.

The Resolution was a Venator-class Star Destroyer in service of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. In 20 BBY, the Resolution was dispatched to the planet Drongar to evacuate the Republic troops on the world.
The Gladean State Parks were a group of parks on the planet Chandrila known for their beautiful gardens, which were beloved throughout the galaxy.
The Sith war behemoths were beasts of war used by the Sith Empire.
Sith war rhinos were war mounts used by the Sith.
Sith war worms were creatures that were used as war beasts by the Sith Empire during the Battle of Coruscant of the Great Hyperspace War in 5000 BBY.
