End of the Dark Wars and the First Jedi Purge
x: The Battle of Malachor was one of the last known events of the Old Sith Wars. It occurred in 3951 BBY and was the final major event of the Dark Wars and the First Jedi Purge.

Eirraucs were a sentient species from Eirrauus. They were easily recognizable from their six limbs and long, four-eyed faces. Eirraucs moved with a "leaping run," using their rear and middle pairs of limbs to swiftly travel the plains of their homeworld.
Drexls, also known as warbeasts, were reptavian winged creatures indigenous to Dxun.

Tun Wala was a manufacturing center located on the planet Arda II. The T-6 diodem was manufactured here during the Galactic Civil War. Its massive trade shows were visited by S'kytri who performed dramatizations of Initiation Hunts and sold trinkets from Skye.

The city of Bidamount was the site of the great auction house known as Eport. It was located on an unnamed planet. Everything a being could need or desire was to be found here, provided that one had the right collateral to bid with.
Zaloriis City was the capital city of the planet Zaloriis. The Rebel Alliance constructed a base there, but it was destroyed by forces led by Darth Vader.

Zehava was the capital city of the planet Melida/Daan, founded a millennium before Emperor Palpatine's rise to power. Its borders were continually being redefined during the civil war between the Melida and the Daan.
Zoronhed was one of the largest settlements established on the planet Zonju V.
Yedagon City was the capital of the Yedagon nation, on the planet Adumar, and the seat of the Yedagon Confederacy.

Yeere was the largest city found on the planet Reytha and the planet's capital. There was an Imperial base there. By 0 ABY, the base was abandoned. During the Reytha campaign of that year, Darth Vader led an attack force against Rebel Alliance forces from Yeere.
Yellow District was the term used by the Falleen to describe the section of their capital city, Falleen Throne, that was the most polluted, during the years leading up to the Clone Wars.
Xakrea was a major city located on the planet Darkknell. It was the capital of the Daimanate during the Republic Dark Age and contained the Sith Lord Daiman's Sanctum Celestial, his palace.

Domain Kraal was a warrior caste Domain of the Yuuzhan Vong that was in existence during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Around 27 ABY, Domain Kraal was tasked with holding the captured planet of Borleias as a colony and protecting it from the forces of the New Republic.
Xanas City was located in the Mid Rim's Xanas system. After the Battle of Endor, the Xanas City–based arms dealer Magresh had medical supplies stolen from the Galactic Empire's 656th regiment.
Xenvaer was a city found on the planet Alsakan. The Xenvaer Civic Auditorium was located there.

The Robida Colossus was a Ganathan starship that intercepted and rescued the Millennium Falcon after it was chased into a dangerous nebula into Ganathan space. Like most of Ganathan technology, the ship was powered mainly through the power of steam.

The Lore Seeker was a reddish-orange Jemlaat-class yacht owned by the Jedi historian Tionne Solusar. She acquired the ship sometime before 11 ABY from a Randoni trader on one of her frequent research trips to Borgo Prime, literally for the price of a song.
The graiveh was a pre-sentient, humanoid creature from the planet Ealor.
The Erased were a group of people who did not want to be executed by the Galactic Empire for treason, so they erased all memory of their existence.

Agridorn was a planet in the Agridorn system of the Colonies region. During the latter days of the Galactic Republic, Agridorn was represented in the Senate by Rhya Taloon, who pledge her world's support to the Republic at the start of the Clone Wars.
The Battle of Almania was a battle between the New Republic and Kueller's warfleet at the Almanian system.
The Pinnacles of Felth were a collection of rocky foothills located on the planet Roon. It was a favored breeding ground of the native Mogo.
The Port Line was one of the major passenger conveyor tubes located in the city of Efavan, capital of Vorzyd V. It connected Efavan Port to the casinos in the Westrex district.

An FX-9 surgical assistant, also known as the FX-9 , was a FX-series medical droid manufactured by Medtech Industries. During Darth Vader's reconstruction after his duel with Obi-Wan Kenobi, a FX-9 supplied the wounded Sith Lord with a blood transfusion.
The astromech droid UV-002 (or Uvee) was attached to the rescue starship No Luck Required during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The Pride of Thela was a Space Rescue Corps ship, flown by Uldir Lochett until his partner, the Peace Brigade agent Dacholder, tried to betray him to the Yuuzhan Vong.
The Magellan was a Galactic Empire Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that its captain, Julias Narn, used to ensure security at the Imperial Lunar Station on the moon of the planet Danton VI.

Danton VI was a transitional planet under the control of the Galactic Empire, and a leading weapons manufacturer for the Imperial cause. Weapons were shipped off-planet daily from its numerous manufacturing plants.
The Titterbugs were a species of sentient insectoids who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. They were small beings with four legs, two arms, and—at least in some members—an orange carapace.
Strutters were a species of sentient avians. Members of the species had svelte bodies with blue legs and beaks, and long arms with dexterous hands.
The Totem slaves were a group of sapient beings on the forest moon of Endor whom the Totem Master had enslaved through the power of a magical ring.
The Mudgubs were a species of sentient bipeds who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. They had large eyes and long, blunt snouts, as well as hairy, ear-like projections on the sides of the head.

Ghostlings were a species of ethereal humanoids indigenous to the planet Datar. While mostly Human-like in anatomy, Ghostlings had key differences from that species. The Ghostlings' shiny, tan-colored skin radiated an aura of light.
Galdar was the home planet of the Galderians. It was a small, rocky planet which held very little natural resources, or food.
Tantive IV was the fourth planet in the Tantive system of Kwymar sector.
Endorian swamp beasts lived in the Valley of the Lizard Warriors on the forest moon of Endor. They preyed on Ewoks, and other small creatures that lived on Endor.
Kreegons were extinct predators once indigenous to the forest moon of Endor. Morag once reanimated a kreegon skeleton.
Vrooms were creatures used as mounts by Pugs on the Forest Moon of Endor.
Gaios was a planet in the Core Worlds within the grid coordinates K-9. Its philosophers' statement "a seed does not know the flower that produced it," was well known.
Gnisnal was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Starfleet.
The Grannan were a Near-Human species from Granna.
Harridan was a Victory-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Starfleet during the Galactic Civil War.
WeeGee, nicknamed Weeg, was the Katarns' multi-purpose droid, hand-built by Morgan Katarn.
The Mercy was a Imperial frigate, appropriated by the Rebel Alliance while still under construction, and put in service by them as a hospital ship prior to the Battle of Endor.

The New Hope was an antique Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that was used by the Galactic Empire as a museum. In an act of psychological warfare, it was acquired by the Rebel Alliance and served as their flagship, being the command ship of Mon Mothma.

Renor was an Inner Rim planet, and location of a Republic supply depot, where Mon Mothma attempted to meet with a contact, to gain transport to the Outer Rim, prior to being abducted by Senator Pel Talon.

The Gubbur was a frog like creature native to Corellia. It had a long boney ridge coming from its nose and two antennae coming out of its mouth. Gubburs had three long whiskers, useful for sensing tectonic motion and could possibly predict earthquakes.
The carrion spat was an flightless avian creature native to the planet Corellia.
The Corellian butterfly was a butterfly that lived in the swamps of Corellia. It had a long tail containing a stinger, and very large wings.
The durni was an eyeless rabbit-like species that used a sonic radar to navigate the wilderness they live in. This small creature lived underground in the old Selonian tunnels of Corellia.
Dalyrakes were a large arachnoid species from Talus.
The gronda was an elephant-like animal that lived on Corellia's plains.
The Corellian slice hound, also known as the razor hound, was a canine creature form Corellia
The krahbu was a herbivore herd animal with bristly, red-white hide native to Corellia.
The swirl prong was a herd creature from the Forest Moon of Endor. Swirl prongs were related to the similar looking paralopes.
The sharnaff was a large herd animal found on Corellia. It appeared similar to a ronto from Tatooine, as well as the piket from Dantooine and was a favorite prey of scouts and hunters.
The tusk cat was a fawn-colored feline predator found on the world of Naboo and its moon Rori.
Truly Sorry was a Rebel Alliance spacecraft assigned to Jan Ors' Rebel cell.

The langlatch was an animal with grayish skin native to Lok. The langlatch was a very aggressive and voracious predator that ate indiscriminately warm or cold-blooded creatures and were known to attack prey much larger than themselves.
Alak Schou was a Yuuzhan Vong Koros-Strohna, part of the vast convoy of similar vessels that was used to transport the invasion force into the galaxy.
Baanu Ghezh was a Yuuzhan Vong worldship. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Vong male Zhul Yim was stationed aboard the Baanu Ghezh as a shaper adept.

Tumble Bunnies were three-eared rabbits. On the Forest Moon of Endor, Tumble Bunnies were taught by a trainer to do tricks at a carnival to the delight of young Ewoks; as punishment for scaring those woklings, the Ewok Wicket Warrick had to perform several Tumble Bunny shows.
The Tambles were a group of diminutive sentient beings who lived on the forest moon of Endor. They bounced along the surface of rivers; without water, they would die.
Skibs were creatures that built dams and moved along the surface of water on their elongated feet, which resembled natural water-skis. They were found on the Forest Moon of Endor.

Eodons were a species of sentient pachydermoids found on the Forest Moon of Endor. They were large beings with blue-gray skin and prehensile trunks, but—at least to most other inhabitants of Endor—they were most noted for their long, ornate tusks.
The Tulgah witch Morag had a beast that was a furry, demonic beast she used as a tracker.
Ogres were a species of large sentient humanoids with stocky, well-muscled physiques. One specimen, named Gantu, had pale, warty skin, pointed ears, and unkempt black hair on his small head.

Lanthrym was a planet in the Elrood sector. It was on this planet that Cermack Rustill boarded the Shining Comet which was en route to Bodrin. It was considered a good port for pirates. There was a sizable Gamorrean population living there.
A gas giant in the Elrood sector was orbited by Vicerv 3.
Darstell 4 was a relatively peaceful planet in the Elrood sector, which was situated on a minor shipping lane. The primary continental mass consisted mainly of softly rolling hills.

Vicerv 3, also known as Vicerv, was a small planetoid hidden deep within a nearly-destroyed system in the Elrood sector. It received its atmosphere thanks to the nearby gas giant. This provided it with a barren, but survivable atmosphere.
A species sapient of talking trees were found on the forest moon of Endor.
Red Bush Grove was an Ewok village several days' travel south of Bright Tree Village on the Forest Moon of Endor.

The Yarlubb river was on the forest moon of Endor, flowing somewhere between Bright Tree Village and Red Bush Grove. Leektar once followed this river during his search for another village after his own was destroyed.
The Ante-Endor Association, or AEA for short, was a pro-Imperial organization based on Mrlsst that claimed that the Battle of Endor never occurred and was a piece of Rebel Alliance propaganda.
Ion Team was a unit of clone commandos attached to the 22nd Air Combat Wing.
Gallant was a Victory I-class Star Destroyer that saw service with the Republic Navy and later in the Imperial Navy.
The Battle of Fort Nowhere took place one year after the Battle of Endor.

Bonestar Pirates were a group of Corellian rogues, once led by Loka Hask. During this time, they were pursued by the Corellian Security Forces for several crimes. An interstellar chase resulted in the pirates landing on Gus Treta Inner-System Market Station to create a diversion.
Mount Scich'tl was a mountain on Barab I, adjacent to Alater-ka, the planet's capital.

Lightning Battalion was a special forces team of the Imperial Army fighting against the Icarii on Vestar. They wore nonstandard blue uniforms with a lightning bolt insignia. The battalion was responsible for the capture of Icarii sorceress Selestrine.

Tumnors were a species of large flying predators that lived on the fifth moon of the planet Da Soocha, which was located in the Cyax system of Hutt Space. With a five meter wing span the creatures could fly and were able to attack prey with both their teeth and claws.

The Sith Council was a group of ten Sith Lords within the Sith Empire who served as advisors to the reigning Dark Lord of the Sith. This Council convened in a great citadel on Ziost. The Sith Council managed the affairs of the Empire.
The Port-Esta Queen was a smuggling and trading ship that operated out of Port-Esta on Vestar. Her captain spoke with Boba Fett about Abal Karda. Boog served aboard the Port-Esta Queen.

Ubuugan fleshborers were parasitic winged worms native to the swamps of Ubuuga The fleshborers spent the majority of their life cycle within the original host body, emerging only to find another host.
The Demolisher was a Gladiator-class Star Destroyer used by the Galactic Empire around 15 BBY.

The Blockade on Chandrila was an event during the Galactic Civil War. After the Rebel Alliance's raid on Fest, Moff Kohl Seerdon retaliated by attacking the Chandrila, a major part of the Alliance—coincidentally his homeworld, and also the homeworld of Mon Mothma.
The morrts were a furry species of parasitic bloodsuckers native to Gamorr.
The Sulphur Pits of Vulcar were sulfur pits located on the planet Vulcar that were mined for oridium deposits. The world's acrid atmosphere made employing humanoid workers barely cost-effective.

result: Mandalore's population reduced by one third; significant damage incurr
x: In the year 29 ABY, a battle was fought on the planet Mandalore, between an attacking force of Yuuzhan Vong warriors and the Mandalorian inhabitants of the world.

The Mikoans were a sentient species native to Miko. They were humanoid, and appeared Human, bar their green skin pigmentation. The Mikoans resisted the Galactic Empire until their homeworld was bombarded by Moff Delurin from aboard the prototype Dragon-class heavy cruiser.

T-12 was a service droid used by the Jedi to catalog Naddist artifacts being shipped to Ossus following the Freedon Nadd Uprising. During the Conclave at Deneba, T-12 was present, assisting Cay Qel-Droma and the other Jedi.
The Reliance I was a Republic command ship used by the Galactic Republic around 4000 BBY. It served as the flagship of Ulic Qel-Droma during the opening stages of the Great Sith War.
Phosfleas were bioluminescent insects from Kashyyyk. Wookiees would use scented compounds to lure them into mesh lanterns and use them for light.
The netcaster was a highly dangerous arachnid native to the homeworld of the Wookiee people, Kashyyyk. The average length of the netcaster would often be 75 centimeters.
The Kestrel Nova was a Crescent-X9 captured from pirates at Taanab by the Jedi c. 4000 BBY.

The ikov was a species of rodent that was native to the wroshyr tree forests of Kashyyyk. One of the planet's smaller predators, it inhabited one of the upper levels of the Kashyyyk ecosystem, right beneath the tree-top level.

Gorryl slugs, also called protoplasmic slugs, were large, carnivorous slugs indigenous to the forests of the planet Kashyyyk. They were usually 1.5 meters long and could grow to a length of 2.5 meter and had brown skin and purple eyes on stalks.
Devourers were carnivores twisted by the dark side of the Force and were indigenous to Dxun. Exar Kun was attacked by a devourer while trying to enter the tomb of Freedon Nadd, but killed the beast.
Bolstyngars were carnivores indigenous to Kashyyyk.
Vodo-Siosk Baas's courier was the vessel Vodo-Siosk Baas traveled from Dantooine to Deneba in with Sylvar and Crado. Vodo-Siosk later used this to travel to Coruscant to face Exar Kun.
Adegan eels were snake-like creatures indigenous to Adega.
The Galactic Empire launched a scouting raid on Yavin 4 just prior to the Battle of Yavin.

result: Survivors successfully extracted by Rogue Squadron
objective: Locate the Nonnah and rescue the survivors
x: The Search for the Nonnah was an operation in approximately 1 ABY. During a battle with Imperial forces over Chorax, the Rebel Alliance starship named Nonnah was damaged and forced to crash-land on the surface of the planet.
The brush bat was a chiropteroid species from the planet Kyrouac. When startled, it would produce a horrible screech.
The Freefall was a Freefall-class bomber and the personal starfighter of Jinkins.
BLX-5, more commonly known by the alias "Bollux," was a BLX labor droid that served for a time as a member of famed Corellian smuggler Han Solo's crew aboard the Millennium Falcon.
YVH 1-1A was the first YVH 1 combat droid developed by Tendrando Arms. It was also the personal bodyguard of Lando Calrissian, and spoke in a deeper version of his voice.
Blue Max was the name given to a modified B2-X Computer Interface Unit that served for a time as a crewmember of the smuggling freighter Millennium Falcon during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

The Dead Ringer was the transport of smuggler captain Bioto. Cash Garrulan smuggled two refugees fleeing Murkhana aboard the Dead Ringer, simultaneously using the "stow-aways" as stand-ins for Olee Starstone and Roan Shryne and also setting up his rival Bioto for the fall.

Rocket-jumpers were infantry units equipped with Jump Packs and Smart Rockets of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire and then decades later as part of the Resistance during its conflict with the First Order.

Moon Falls was a very popular vacation spot on the sanctuary moon of Endor. An upper lake fell toward the lower lake, but the upper lake was so high up that by the time the water got to the lower lake it was already mist.

Red 2, later re-designated as Red Squadron 1, was an Incom Corporation T-65 X-wing starfighter in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. It was assigned to Red Squadron and stationed at the Rebel base on Yavin 4.

Red 5 was a T-65B X-wing starfighter in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The fighter was assigned to Luke Skywalker to fly during the Battle of Yavin, with R2-D2 serving as the craft's astromech droid.

Grandfather's Shoulder was a white-tipped active volcano on the Korunnal Highland of the planet Haruun Kal, near the capital city of Pelek Baw. Its snowmelt fed the Grandmother's Tears river. The tallest mountain on the Highland, it had dozens of active calderas.
Vine cats were felinoid reptomammals found in the outlying portions of Haruun Kal and the forests of Ziost. They came in half a dozen species, and their skin was used to make leather.
Blimph was a Mid Rim gas giant in the Blimph system. One of its moons was Blimph 3, which was strategically important to the Rebel Alliance due to trading with the Jokhalli.
The Qel-Droma was a frigate once captained by Tash Scrambas during the Alderaan Ascendancy Contention.

objective: Discover the whereabouts of General Grievous
x: The Mission to Utapau occurred prior to the Battle of Utapau, following the Battle of Coruscant.
The Longshot was a modified Tri-Mark VII Interceptor and Meeko Ghintee's personal starship.
The Battle of Iskalon was the second major battle in the Nagai invasion of 4 ABY.
The Valley of the Spirits was home to the Tusken Raider village that was slaughtered by Anakin Skywalker in 22 BBY.
Bantha Burrows was a deep-desert canyon maze located on Tatooine. It consisted of thousands of huge caves, possibly used by banthas retreating from dangerous sandstorms.
The Blockade of Kashyyyk was an event in 1 ABY, in which the Galactic Empire established a blockade over the planet Kashyyyk.
The Zanazi were an order of priest-prophets of the Religion of the Cosmic Balance. The order was established by Dif Istuvi.

Destruction of Desann's Shadowtrooper Project and the Doomgiver
Desann is killed by Kyle Katarn

x: The Battle of Yavin 4, also known as the Attack on the Jedi Academy, was the battle during the Galactic Civil War in 12 ABY that saw Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum defeat Admiral Galak Fyyar and Desann's assault force.
Mount Yoda, originally called Mount Dagger, was an enormous shield volcano on Dagobah that dated from the early years of that planet's formation, billions of years in the past.
The Destroyer was the feared killer droid of Governor Kugg on the planet Dodz.
The planet Sarapin was attacked by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the first year of the Clone Wars.
The Galactic Republic's forces recaptured the planet Sarapin from Separatist control during the Clone Wars.
The Battle of Corbos, also called the Rout of Corbos, was a battle fought between the Jedi Order and Dark Jedi. It was the last battle of the Hundred-Year Darkness.

The Leviathans were an ancient species of bioengineered serpentine creatures created by fallen Dark Jedi during the Hundred-Year Darkness. Some sources speculated that they may have been created by Karness Muur; however, Sorzus Syn took credit for their creation in her chronicle.
The tappratine was a four-winged creature from Munto Codru.
The besiioth was a red-eyed, quadruped creature from Tedel. The most common subspecies was the plains besiioth. Various subspecies were hybridized to create the stalker besiioth breed.
The Battle of Trenwyth was a battle during the Nagai–Tof conflict of 4 ABY between the Tof Kingdom and the Nagai expeditionary force.
Blue lizards were reptilian quadrupeds that lived on the forest moon of Endor. A line of spikes ran along their back, from the top of their head to the end of their tail.

BX-00 served as Baron Gavern Starlock's driver, guard, aide, and assassin. It tried to run over C-3PO and R2-D2 in Baron Starlock's hovercraft. It later tried to assassinate Prince Jagoda on Starlock's orders, but was stopped by C-3PO.

The Annoo-dat gangster Tig Fromm, one of the leaders of the Fromm Gang criminal organization, used a starship as his personal space transport. The triangular-shaped starship was heavily armed and saw use during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
The Blood Brother, formerly known as the Dura-Khan III, was a heavily modified Consular III-class cruiser used by Reddjak, and the main command vessel for the Red Fury Brotherhood.
Mole creatures, as C-3PO called them, were sapient moles who lived underground on Tatooine.

Dorande were a species of pointed-eared humanoids indigenous to the planet of Dorande. At the start of the Dark Times, they attempted to seize the world of R-Duba, conspiring with the planet's royal advisors to murder Prince Jagoda.

Acid lizards were gigantic reptiles who dwelt underground on the planet Tatooine. They possessed a scaled purple hide, mottled with green spots. They are known as acid lizards due to the strong acid inside their large mouths. Gotar was an acid lizard.

The Telkadis hiding tree spider was a mostly static predator from Telkadis. Spider's eggs hatched inside a taku tree and hatchlings burrowed deeper inside the trunk while they grew. They hunted small rodents like voletes, preying by the presence of heat in the surroundings.
The tentacle bird of Pelemax was an unusual flightless avian with tentacles that originated in the Pelemax system.
The Battle of Krant was a major battle that took place in the Clone Wars.

The Cirra was one of the four akias of Aramandi soceity that shared the planet Aram. They colonized the Cirra system, which was named after them. They were the second of the akia to settle their system.
The Expeditionary Library, also known as the Chiss data library, was a massive underground library located under the ice of the Chiss Ascendancy's capital planet of Csilla.
The assault on Doniphon was part of the Kwymar Suppressions in 17 BBY. Rebel forces on Doniphon were defeated by the Galactic Empire.
A firefight on the planet Kestos Minor was a battle of the Kwymar Suppressions, in 17 BBY. The Rebel forces on Doniphon were defeated by the Galactic Empire.
The Raid on Picutorion was part of the Kwymar Suppressions. When Picutorion aligned itself with Rebels in 17 BBY, the Empire responded by attacking the world.
The Assault on Protazk took place on the planet Protazk as part of the Kwymar Suppressions, in 17 BBY. The Rebel forces were defeated by the Galactic Empire.
A battle on Telos IV was part of the Kwymar Suppressions, in 17 BBY. The Rebel forces on Telos IV were defeated by the Galactic Empire.
a: Battle of Telos IV (Galactic Civil War)

result: Tofs repelled, Nagai, Maccabree and Hiromi ally with the Alliance
x: The Twelfth Battle of Zeltros was a decisive battle in the Nagai–Tof invasion of 4 ABY. It was the twelfth time that Zeltros was invaded.
The Battle of Saijo was the final battle of the Nagai–Tof War of 4 ABY.

The Battle of Kashyyyk, also known as the subjugation of Kashyyyk, was the first Imperial invasion of the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk in the year 19 BBY as part of the Empire's Enslavement of Kashyyyk campaign.
Clan Ordo was a famed clan of Mandalorians who presided over the planet Ordo in the Mandalore sector for their Lord Mandalore, the ultimate official over the Mandalorians.
Solanus was a planet in the Solanus system. It was situated within the Dominus sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

R2-B4 was an astromech droid who was dispatched by Amber Comark to assist an Alliance Special Operations team during their mission to expose her father's Death Hunter project on Zeta Zero Nine. A battered droid, R2-B4 was nonetheless feisty and loyal.

R2-C3 was an astromech droid who was owned by the Rebel Alliance. It was infiltrated into the Imperial Sector Plexus station near Keltos IV. Its duties as an Imperial droid were to monitor the Plexus' computer networks for illegal intrusion.
R2-C9 was a modified astromech droid who was owned by Marka Durn.

The Klytonians were a sentient species originating in the Klytonia system of the Outer Rim Territories' Bheriz sector. Their bodies were covered with leathery scales, which produced electric field vibrations that allowed them to communicate with each other.
R2-D0 (Artoo-Deo), or Deo, was Tiree's R2-model astromech utility droid. Deo escaped from the various scrapes Tiree was caught in, and assisted several groups of Rebel agents in rescuing Tiree.
The Erhynradd Mutiny was a conflict that took place in 5 BBY in the vicinity of the Inner Rim's Erhynradd system. It saw the death of Brigadier Gideon Tarkin of the Galactic Empire.

The Battle of Cerea was a month-long battle that took place on the Galactic Republic world of Cerea. The paradise world was ravaged by Commerce Guild forces until defeated by the Republic. The battle ended when Bo-Ro-Tara was assassinated by Gossam Commandos.
The Crynyd was the name given to an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer after its capture by the New Republic at a battle in the Milagro system.

The Jenuwaa Sea was a small body of water located on Kalee, which was the site of a battle between the Kaleesh and Yam'rii during the Huk War. When Ronderu lij Kummar was killed battling the Yam'rii on the beaches of Kalee, her body was lost to the waters of the Jenuwaa Sea.

t: Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon
place: Great Pit of Carkoon, Dune Sea, Tatooine
objective: Liberate Han Solo from Jabba the Hutt
x: The Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon, also known as the battle over the Great Pit of Carkoon, or the Battle of Carkoon, took place in 4 ABY as part of a campaign by Luke Skywalker to rescue his captive friend, Han Solo, from the gangster Jabba the Hutt.
a: Battle over the Great Pit of Carkoon

x: Voss was a terrestrial planet in the Voss system located in Allied Tion sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Battle of Altyr V was a brutal skirmish fought between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars between 22 BBY and 19 BBY.
Equani were a sentient equinoid species native to Equanus in the Nharl system. They were tall bipeds who were covered in fur. All Equani possessed empathic abilities.
Shar'Ack was a planet located in the Shar'Ack system, a part of the Atrivis sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
During the Tionese War between the Galactic Republic and the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, the Union's forces bombarded the Republic capital of Coruscant with waves of pressure bombs.

result: Surrender of the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion and the end of the
Jedi become watchmen of the Galactic Republic
x: The fall of the world Desevro occurred around 23,900 BBY, at the end of the century-long Tionese War between the Galactic Republic and the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion.
The Advisory Council was a seven-being body that advised the Chief of State in the operations of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
T1-N1 was a T1-series utility droid that was owned by Czerka executive Jana Lorso of the Citadel Station branch of the Czerka Corporation in 3951 BBY.
The oorg was a small animal native to Cerea. It was domesticated by the Cereans. It was small, pink, and had a long snout.
K-M2 or Kay-Emtoo was an Industrial Automaton K-Series spaceport control droid. Painted bright red, he was a 2 meter tall, awkward looking droid with a dome shaped cranium.
Shesharile was a gas giant world that was located within the Shesharile system, in the Minos Cluster.

Ghost Base was a Rebel Alliance base operated by Rebel spy Utric Sandov on the planet Krant. It was captured by Moff Yittreas and Strike force Alpha around 1 BBY, but the Rebel staff escaped to the nearby Le'Roche island.

An orbalisk was a parasitic creature found on Dxun that lived in groups. They lay inactive in caves or other dark places, until they found a suitable host creature on whose skin they would attach themselves to in order to feed.
Drog VI was a trade world in the Corporate Sector's Drog system. Etti ran several hunting lodges on the planet.

Rills were reptiles native to Tatooine that looked like scyks. They were not aggressive unless attacked. They had spines along their backs and very sharp teeth, and lived in Tatooine's deserts alongside womp rats.

The Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion, also known as the Royal Guard, was a Separatist military unit utilized by the Separatist Council of the Confederacy of Independent Systems to provide important officials with sentient guards when it was too risky to use droids that were vulner…

t: Space Battle in the Kessel Asteroid Field
x: The Space Battle in the Kessel Asteroid Field was a rescue operation during the Galactic Civil War.

The Galactic Alliance Advisory Council was the successor of the New Republic Advisory Council. Initially, Chief of State Cal Omas believed that the High Council could efficiently govern the galaxy during wartime, and the advisory council did not exist for some time.

headquarters: Defense Research and Planetary Assistance Center
x: The Senate Planetary Intelligence Network, also known as the Senate Interplanetary Intelligence Network, or SPIN, was a intelligence service for the New Republic and was tasked with providing the New Republic Senate intelligence and analysis.
The Eminence was an Imperial Star Destroyer.

Renegade Flight was a Rebel Alliance X-wing starfighter unit under the leadership of Commander Arhul Narra. It was assigned to the Alliance High Command Headquarters before its destruction in 3 ABY at the Battle of Derra IV.

The Proliferans were a species of sentient non-humanoids who resembled large red ants. They were excellent at digging, often using their skills to dig under enemy forces and waylay them when they got close.

The Homanans were a mysterious race of shape-changing sentients from the Homana system. They could change their size from anything the size of a Wookiee to that of an Ewok and were also slightly telepathic, as well as altering the pigment of cells within their flesh.

The Noolan were a sentient species native to the Outer Rim Territories' Noola system. During the Galactic Civil War, the Noolan Otolia Ratiuv, a technician, found her body occupied by the essence of Nana, a Rebel-affiliated member of the Homanan species, following an explosion…

The Shaliz'Na were a sentient species native to the planet Shar'Ack. The species had large wings, some with wingspans of 12 foot, and their bodies were covered in a fine down. Shaliz'na placed a premium on art of all forms, from music to sculptures to paintings.

objective: Destroy Imperial Tibanna gas platform
x: During this mission to the planet Destrillion in the year 3 ABY, Wedge Antilles was assigned to pinpoint critical targets in an Imperial Tibanna Gas facility for a squad of Y-wings to bomb.

x: The Second Mission to Ord Mantell was an operation conducted by Dash Rendar, who was sent by the Rebel Alliance to seek out IG-88D, one of four IG-88 assassin droids.

Known as the "sandbar dweller" in the Devaronian language, the bandara was a beetle-like creature that inhabited the rivers of Devaron. Drift-feeders, they gathered in huge swarms resting on sandbars while feeding on the detritus that floated by.

result: Quinlan Vos is believed by many, to be a Jedi fugitive.

Quinlan Vos's Mission to Nar Shaddaa

x: The Lady Starstorm was a YV-100 light freighter owned by the New Jedi Order.
Kaump III was a Mid Rim planet located in the Bruanii sector. Its high gravity led to its native species being short-statured and with a dense body structure.
The Lightning Rod was a small, beat-up freighter owned by Peckhum, who used it to deliver shipments to various clients, the most notable being Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4.
The Brotherhood of the Sith or Sith Brotherhood was a group of Jedi Knights led by Dark Lord of the Sith Exar Kun who broke away from the Jedi Order to study Sith techniques.

Beck-tori were aquatic parasites from Nam Priax's warm seas that grew to extreme sizes. Because the movement of a potential host through the water attracted Beck-tori, they sometimes would mistakenly attack boats and submersible craft.

The Imperial Hazard was a Victory-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Its captain was Sergus Lanox, and the ship participated in attacking the Alliance base on Horob.
The Agao Ranges were a chain of dormant volcanoes on Bassadro. The mountainsides and nearby foothills were formed of obsidian from the long dormant volcanoes' previous eruptions.
The Starcrossed was a SoroSuub Luxury Cruiser 200 operated by Captain Heedon during the Galactic Civil War.

The Tralus and Talus Liberation Party, colloquially referred to as the TraTaLibbers, or the TTLP, was a political movement active in the Corellian system during the Galactic Civil War and the First Corellian Insurrection.

The Home Planet Party was a political party that was founded by the year 45 BBY on the planet Bandomeer. Its goals were to replant fields on the planet and gain control of Bandomeer's resources from the off-world corporations that controlled them.

The Centerpoint Party was a political faction formed in the Corellian sector during the early stages of the Yuuzhan Vong War by an alliance of New Republic archaeologists forcibly removed from Centerpoint Station and also by independent-minded Corellians.
Eirrauus was a desert world populated by the Eirraucs. It was located in the Quence sector of the galaxy.

A ycaqt was a large reptilian herd animal native to the planet Velmor. Strong, stubborn and fast for their size, ycaqt mainly survived on a diet of plankton, using their massive maws to gather and filter up to 20 kilograms of water at a time.

t: Defense of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)
x: The Defense of Mon Calamari took place in 29 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
a: Battle of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)

x: The Eastern Dune Sea was a vast, empty expanse of sand on Tatooine, east of the Anchorhead settlement, east of the Dune Sea. It was home to a dangerous and fiercely protective tribe of Sand People, as well as wild banthas and dewbacks.

Stribers were an aquatic species originally native to Julsujod III. The Stribers relocated to the water-covered planet Iskalon to escape a cataclysm that struck their homeworld around five millennia before the Galactic Civil War, and became a part of the Iskalonian School, a c…

The Frid were an aquatic sentient species native to the planet Mackar. The Frid relocated to the water-covered planet Iskalon to escape a cataclysm that struck Mackar around five millennia before the Galactic Civil War, and became a part of the Iskalonian School, a cultural gr…

The Nejma were an aquatic species originally native to Eriscot. The Nejma relocated to the water-covered planet Iskalon to escape a cataclysm that struck Eriscot around five millennia before the Galactic Civil War, and became a part of the Iskalonian School, a cultural group o…

The Graygl were an aquatic species originally native to Danalbeth. The Graygl relocated to the water-covered planet Iskalon to escape a cataclysm that struck Danalbeth around five millennia before the Galactic Civil War, and became a part of the Iskalonian School, a cultural g…

Swifts were large, green, reptilian quadrupeds indigenous to the swamps of Naboo. Their running speed was comparable to a speeder bike, and they were capable of jumping great distances to traverse rough terrain.

The lerraa was a large reptilian quadruped indigenous to the swamps of Naboo. It had a long neck, a large nasal horn, and padded feet which, when planted firmly on the ground, made it nearly immovable.

Aquanna were huge, floating creatures indigenous to Naboo with air-filled, blimp-like bodies. They had cephalic lobes, giving them an artificial resemblance to rays and skates. Gungans mounted heavy weaponry on these beasts, making them into living air cruisers.
Glurrgs were a species of non-sentient, bipedal creatures that were employed as workers for the Gungan civilization of the planet Naboo.
The howling plumed rasp was a small, dangerous bird native to the planet Talus.

The OX9 was a model of labor droid used by the Trade Federation. It was essentially humanoid in shape, short, stocky, with large plate-like hand appendages to facilitate carrying large loads. They were also capable of constructing various buildings.

affiliation: Cult of The One and The All
x: Colony One was the capital city of Ylesia. It was located on the shore of the oceanic Zoma Gawanga, between Colony Two and Colony Three. The Altar of Promises and the Mountains of the Exalted were nearby.
C-3PX was a Cybot Galactica 3PX-series protocol droid reprogrammed to be an assassin droid.
The Nishr Suppression was an operation by Imperial forces to put down an uprising by the native Nish on the planet Nishr in 0 ABY.
The jimvu was an agile, six-legged, ungulate-like reptile whose only defense was its swiftness. Their main predators were the veermok and narglatch. They lived in the Gungan swamps of Naboo.
Kashoon was a planet that was conquered by the Galactic Empire, and later freed with the help of the Rebel Alliance. The Kashoonara were left to their own devices afterwards.

objective: Investigate the Imperial remnant base on Alzoc III
x: The Mission at Alzoc III took place during the Galactic Civil War. After hearing a rumor of an Imperial installation on Alzoc III, Mon Mothma sent Kyle Katarn and Jan Ors on a mission to confirm the Imperial presence.
This raid on Imperial territory on Balmorra by Rogue Squadron took place during the Galactic Civil War. The attack was aimed towards two factories manufacturing walkers.

result: Capture of Wedge Antilles by Imperial forces
x: The Assault on Kile II was a battle during the Galactic Civil War, in 1 ABY. The battle, an attack on the Imperial Enclave on Kile II by Rogue Squadron, was another operation engineered by Kasan Moor, a former Imperial pilot who defected to the Rebellion during the Liberation …
A species of pink-furred primate lived on the planet of Roon.

A battle at the Jade Moon took place during the Galactic Civil War, immediately after the liberation of Gerrard V. The battle was a raid led by former Imperial starfighter pilot Kasan Moor following her defection to the Rebel Alliance.
The Escape from Fest, also known as the raid on Fest, was a ground battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire that took place during the Galactic Civil War.

x: The battle above Taloraan took place during the Galactic Civil War. Following the rescue of Wedge Antilles, which brought the elite Rebel starfighter squadron Rogue Squadron to its full potential, the Rebellion began to target Imperial property under the command of Moff Kohl S…

result: Imperial forces destroy the Rebel-held listening outpost
x: The Sabotage at Rhen Var occurred on the ice planet of Rhen Var in 0 BBY during the Galactic Civil War. The battle followed a Rebel Alliance attack that captured an Imperial listening outpost on Rhen Var.
12-4C-41 or Wuntoo Forcee Forwun was one of the 12-4C-41 traffic control droids which worked in Cloud City as part of Lando Calrissian's automated support structure.

1B-8D-GE3 was a GE3-series protocol droid owned by Tolas on Onderon during the years following the Jedi Civil War and used as an auxiliary when conducting sales of droid parts and other related equipment.

68-RKO was a droid in the service of Bail Organa during the Clone Wars. He happened to be traveling on the same pleasure cruiser as Obi-Wan Kenobi and followed him in order not to be considered luggage.

The dunsenn was a species of fish-like animal of vast size, indigenous to Naboo. With troop containers strapped to their undersides, such creatures were used as aerial troop transports called FlopCarriers by Gungans.
Dragon troopers were Wookiee cavalry troopers who rode Katarns and wielded flamethrowers. These troopers were effective at attacking walls and buildings.

X was a battle droid active during the Galactic Civil War. He was found in his manufacturer Kyrotech Corporate Combine's warehouse by a spaceport worker. Via the black market, the latter sold the droid to the pirate leader Zhen Mirat.
TC-3 was a TC-series protocol droid belonging to Senator Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn.
The Battle of Byss occurred some time after the end of the Clone Wars, when the Alderaanian Resistance launched its final attack on the forces of the Sarlacc Project.
The Revenge was a Galactic Empire Imperial-class Star Destroyer in service at some point between 0 ABY and 3 ABY. It once accompanied five Imperial Customs Frigates traveling through hyperspace.
Bomis Koori IV was a planet in the Mid Rim, and was the main gathering point of Corporate Alliance defensive forces on the surrounding worlds during the Clone Wars.

conflict: Clone Wars (Yag'Dhul theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
result: Oro Dassyne's fort infiltrated; protective shield deactivated
Dassyne killed following the Republic's attack on his fort
x: In the final year of the Clone Wars, a battle took place on the planet Bomis Koori IV. As a Corporate Alliance–controlled world, Bomis Koori IV was overseen by Alliance member and Confederate General Oro Dassyne, who maintained a ray shielded fort on the planet.

Gellbeasts, or Wardogs as they were also known were semi-intelligent creatures native to Gellefon which could grow to roughly 2.4 meters tall. They could be extremely vicious when hunting or when pushed into it.

The Telosian Restoration Project was an initiative of Supreme Chancellor Tol Cressa to restore the ecosystem of Telos IV after the planet was rendered lifeless by orbital bombardment during the Jedi Civil War.

The Star Home was the flagship of the Hapan Queen Mothers, one of the most unique and luxurious spaceships in the galaxy—literally a castle set among the stars, equipped with the military capabilities of a fleet carrier.
The Iron Knights were Force-sensitive Shards that trained under the Sunesi Jedi Master Aqinos. Like all Shards, the Iron Knights required droid bodies to interact with the world, hence their name.
a: Iron Knights of the Old Republic

result: The United Warlord Fleets is defeated
x: The Assault on Yavin 4 during the Galactic Civil War in 12 ABY saw Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum defeat the united Imperial assault force, led by Admiral Daala, who handed command over to Vice Admiral Gilad Pellaeon.
