result: New Republic victory with the dissolution of the Diversity Alliance
x: The Battle of the Emperor's Plague Storehouse was a battle between the New Republic and the fanatical anti-Human Diversity Alliance, which sought to exterminate all Humans for the crimes of the Humanocentric Galactic Empire.
The Harmzuay was a modified Kaloth-style battlecruiser that saw extensive service with the Thalassian Slavers.
A battle took place on Ryloth in 24 ABY between the New Republic and the Diversity Alliance.

result: Anakin Skywalker passes the Trial of Skill
x: This Duel on Yavin 4 was a lightsaber battle between Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker and Dark Jedi Asajj Ventress that took place in 22 BBY on the jungle moon of Yavin 4, during the Clone Wars.
The Yakez was a Star Destroyer of the New Republic Fourth Battle Group and the New Republic Fifth Fleet.
The grantaloupe was a four-legged creature that lived on Kashyyyk and was often hunted and eaten by the local Wookiees.
R2-T0 was an R2-series astromech droid owned by the Toydarian junk dealer Watto, who made it available for sale from his junk shop in the spaceport of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine.
The siege of Deko Neimoidia was fought during the Clone Wars in 19 BBY, prior to the fall of Cato Neimoidia and around the time of the Outer Rim Sieges.

The Gellefon Freedom Fighters were a group of Human settlers from the planet Gellefon who had joined Aran Starfire's bid to drive off the Imperial presence from their planet. They were extremely dedicated and had trained well.

result: Fall of Coronet City to Imperial forces
Crix Madine defects to Rebel Alliance
objective: Protect Corellia from destruction as Crix Madine escapes
x: This battle took place on Corellia in 1 ABY. It occurred when the Imperial officer Crix Madine, who was interested in joining the Alliance to Restore the Republic, requested a proper meeting with the Alliance general Carlist Rieekan to discuss the terms of his defection.
Korasa was the smallest of three moons that orbited the ocean world of Kamino.

The octucor was a forest-dwelling land squid from the Outer Rim Territories moon Endor. Sporting an eight-meter-long body with striped skin and eight three-meter-long tentacles, it was a fierce nocturnal predator that reached into the branches of Endor's trees in search of pre…

The Battle of Kalarba was a engagement between the New Republic and Empire of the Hand against the Praetorite Vong that saw the destruction of Kalarba and its moon Hosk Station through the use of the Yo'gand's Core tactic employed earlier at Sernpidal.

3B3-888, also known as 7276, was a Trade Federation B1-series battle droid who served in the Droid Army of Viceroy Nute Gunray. When Gunray's forces invaded and occupied the planet Naboo in 32 BBY, the native Gungans responded by massing their own army to combat the invaders.

3B3-10 was a B1-series battle droid in the service of the Trade Federation. He was part of the Federation occupation force during the Invasion of Naboo, and fought a team of Royal Naboo Security Forces members during the Battle of Naboo.
Baldavian pocket hare was a species of skittish creatures. Due to its skittish nature, cowardly individuals and acts were sometimes compared to them.
DFS-1308 was one of the Vulture-class starfighters assigned to Saak'ak during the Blockade of Naboo. It analyzed but was unable to calculate the "Human element" inside the N-1 starfighter.
DFS-1015 was one of the Vulture-class starfighter assigned to Saak'ak during the Blockade of Naboo.
DFS-327 was a Vulture-class starfighter assigned to the Lucrehulk-class battleship Saak'ak.

Unit Commander P-59, and its underling, P-60, were the two droidekas summoned by Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray to keep Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi from entering the bridge of the Saak'ak. Their combined firepower forced the two Jedi Knights to escape into a vent.
P-60, and its superior, P-59, were the two droidekas summoned by Trade Federation Nute Gunray to keep Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi from penetrating the bridge of the Saak'ak.
SSA-1015 was one of the OOM security battle droids serving the Trade Federation aboard the Lucrehulk-class battleship Saak'ak during the Federation's blockade of the planet Naboo in 32 BBY.

SSA-306 was a Baktoid Combat Automata OOM security battle droid serving the Trade Federation during the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY. He was one of the battle droids sent to escort Queen Padmé Amidala of the Naboo to the Camp Four prison for processing.
SSA-719 was a Baktoid Combat Automata OOM security battle droid serving the Trade Federation during its Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY.

WED-15-I662, also known as Eye-Six-Six-Too, was a WED-15 Treadwell repair droid produced by the Cybot Galactica company. In 0 BBY, during the Galactic Civil War, I662 was aboard a Jawa sandcrawler, the owners of which later captured the Rebel droids C-3PO and R2-D2.

ASP-704 was a masculine ASP-7 labor droid imported by Eugene Talmont, the Imperial prefect of Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine, shortly before the Battle of Yavin in the year 0 BBY. It was tasked with loading cargo aboard a GR-45 medium transport.
Korriz was an industrial planet in the Korriz system in the Sith Worlds, a region of space within the Stygian Caldera nebula in the Outer Rim's Esstran sector.
The Domed City of Aquarius was the underwater center of civilization on Dac.

The giant squid was a species of squid that lived in the oceans of Mon Calamari, a planet that was home to the Mon Calamari species. Giant squids had two eyes and ten tentacles. These manipulators sported numerous suction cups and flared out into sagittiform tips.
The Kashyyyk Trade Rebellion took place sometime during the Separatist Crisis, when a variety of planets and corporations began to withdraw from the Galactic Republic.

TC-9D0 was a TC-series protocol droid from the planet Coruscant with gray plating and yellow photoreceptors. He was manufactured by Cybot Galactica and was affiliated with linguists and other protocol droids.

The Granse Confederacy was a well-structured coalition of bounty hunters and trackers that appeared on the galactic scene shortly after the Battle of Yavin. They were known for their tendency to perform other's dirty work, which they called "discreet problem solving."

t: Mark VII experimental prototype assassin droid
x: The Mark VII experimental prototype assassin droid, also referred to as the rogue assassin droid, or simply nicknamed Mark VII, was a droid that had been created to be the prototype for a series of assassin droid to be manufactured by the Sith Empire based on the graveyard wor…
The Trenchant was a Sacheen-class light escort of the inaugural New Republic Fifth Fleet, of Task Force Copperleaf. Trenchant was the first casualty of the Battle of Doornik-319.

The YT-1300 light freighter Century Hawk was the personal ship of Danielle Kieran. She bought the ship by taking a loan from Talon Karrde, wanting to fly the same ship as her supposed father Han Solo.

Pleasant Meadow was a marshland region of liquefied gases located at the core of the planet, Bespin near the Ugnorgrad Swampway. The only inhabitants of this region were the colonies of Ugnaughts that fled from Cloud City during the Imperial occupation and Ugnaught rebellion.
The Coruscani ogre was a large semi-sentient humanoid beast that lived in Coruscant sublevels, sewers, and dumps.
The Vasudra was a Gallofree Yards GR-75 medium transport owned and operated by the Azzameen family.

The Venix was a starship that made regular deliveries for Viraxo Industries. Sometime after the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, Viraxo Industries attempted to sabotage their rivals, the Azzameen-owned shipping company Twin Suns Transport Services.
The Sabra was one of two YT-1300 transports owned and operated by the Azzameen family, the other being the Selu.

The Splendour was a Kom'rk-class fighter/transport owned by the Besalisk criminal Galus Vez. Vez used the starship to race opponents on his private racing track, the Fool's Run, where he could activate asteroid thrusters remotely from his ship to drive asteroids into opponents.
The Ugnaught rebellion was an uprising that took place in Cloud City on the planet of Bespin shortly after the Battle of Hoth.

The deadly laigrek was a subspecies of laigrek that was native to the grassy world of Dantooine. They were similar in appearance to their insect brethren, however they possessed tougher armor that could endure high temperatures, as well as the ability to breathe short streams …
Maalraas or Nighthunters were a non-sentient species of predatory quadrupeds. Nighthunters hunted in packs, using long claws and powerful fanged jaws to disable their victims.
The brith were a species of large, flying creatures that were indigenous to the grassy Outer Rim world of Dantooine. Their fin-like wings gave them the appearance of swimming through the air.

Laigreks were a non-sentient species of predatory insect native to the grassy Outer Rim world of Dantooine, where they infested the dark and damp subterranean areas of the planet. Possessing six legs, they bore blue or black exoskeletons with red and white undersides.

3B3-1204, also known as 7169, was a Trade Federation B1-series battle droid in the service of Viceroy Nute Gunray's Droid Army. In 32 BBY, 3B3-1204 was a part of the force that invaded and later occupied the world of Naboo, at Gunray's behest.
Kyren were relatively small but lethal flying creatures native to the planet Ansion.
The Intimidator was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought used by the Imperial Navy's Black Sword Command during the Galactic Civil War.
We Fix Anything was a starship repair bay on the Crystal Web Station run by New Republic officer Taver Soren.

DFS-1138 was a Vulture-class starfighter assigned to the Saak'ak. When Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi arrived onboard, DFS-1138 was present in the hangar. Later, when the Jedi's ship was destroyed, DFS-1138 was seen fleeing the hangar with his fellow droid fighters.
DFS-1104 was a Vulture-class starfighter assigned to the Saak'ak.
A Bogey was a kind of creature that lived in the Spice Mines of the planet Kessel.

The cu-pa was a bipedal, theropod-like species of reptomammal native to the Outer Rim worlds of Nam Chorios and Tatooine. They were distant cousins of the tauntaun, another species of omnivorous reptomammals indigenous to the icy planet of Hoth.
The Aggressor was a Victory-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Kur was the second planet in the Bakura system.
Envos was the first planet of the Bandomeer system.
Fitee was the third and last planet in the Bandomeer system.

An iron asteroid field in the Naboo system, Arrissa's Field was named after the pirate Arrissa n'Osnyi. Pirates often used the field to launch strikes on passing freighters, hidden within the asteroid field and covered by the nearby Obligon Nebula.
Penumbra Omen was the code-name of a mysterious and hostile force of starships present in the Naboo system during the Galactic Civil War.
Illyriaqüm was the capital city of the Human Calian Confederacy on the remote planet Shiva IV, containing the seat of Warlord Aron Peacebringer's power during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Yavin 1 was the innermost celestial body orbiting the gas giant Yavin Prime in the Yavin system, a star system located in the Gordian Reach of the Outer Rim Territories. Alongside its outer neighbor Yavin 2, it was classified as a moon, with little known about it.
Yavin 3 was a rocky moon that surrounded the gas giant Yavin Prime in the Yavin system, a star system apart of the Gordian Reach of the Outer Rim Territories.

Yavin 6 was a moon located in the Yavin system of the Gordian Reach sector, within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was one of the twenty-six moons that orbited the gas giant Yavin Prime.

The Scylla was an Imperial frigate and Admiral Natasi Daala's flagship shortly after the Black Fleet Crisis. This ship was almost captured during a battle against General Garm Bel Iblis, who used a pair of CC-7700 frigates to keep it from escaping into hyperspace.
Umaren'k was a planet located in the Umaren'k system of the Unknown Regions.
The Discord was a Star Destroyer in service to the Galactic Empire during the reign of the New Republic.

The Aggressor was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought in the service of the Galactic Empire. Commanded by Admiral Roek, the Aggressor and a force of five Imperial-class Star Destroyers were part of the fleet that patrolled the Inner Rim.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: The Allegiance was a New Republic Imperial I-class Star Destroyer of the New Republic Defense Force.
Hanging Moss Village was inhabited by cruel and vicious Ewoks on the forest moon of Endor. It was an isolated location and its inhabitants were known to torture the creatures they caught.
Charm's Way was a large Naboo freighter captained by Reeve Dallows prior to his disappearance.
B'Knos was an asteroid mining colony located within the Abran asteroid belt in the Abran system. The system was sometimes called the B'Knos system after this colony.

The slivilith were a species of large, green, non-sentient creatures originally created by the Yuuzhan Vong as a long-range intelligence gathering device thousands of years before their eventual invasion of the galaxy.

The Kadal Asteroid Field was located in the Bestal system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector. The asteroid field lay close to the planet Bestal Three and contained asteroids with significant deposits of aluminite and corax ores.
Varada Five was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Varada system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector.
The Stereb were the tall, primitive natives of Serroco. They built the Stereb cities and had low technology.
Bestal Three was a jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector. Its flora included the vortal tree, the seeds of which had medicinal properties.

Kiltik were giant beetle-like omnivores that lived on Cathar. They lived in hives consisting of hundreds of guards, along with a single, even-larger queen. Kiltik rested during the day, coming out of their nests en masse at night to feed.
FLTCH R-1 was a FLTCH-series battle droid created by the Trade Federation.
The Battle of Tandankin or the mission on Tandankin took place a few weeks after the Battle of Endor and moments after Grand Moff Nivers had claimed Tandankin as Imperial territory.
Vreni Island was a small island in a southern sea on Corellia. A small settlement on the island also bore the name of Vreni Island.
The Temple Security Force was the security police of the Jedi Temple and the Temple Precinct surrounding it on Coruscant.
Webweavers were a large species of spiders indigenous to the planet Kashyyyk. They were capable of devouring humans. Wookiees hunted and ate the spiders.

The third moon of Erai was a terrestrial moon located in the Erai system, a part of the Hangshan sector in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region. At some point long before 3956 BBY, Eralam lightsaber crystals were mined on the moon.

Bred for pit fighting, borheks were usually genetically modified creatures measuring two meters in height, and their capacity to endure as well as absorb damage made them common in competitions, such as those seen on the Outland Station.
The Moffship was a Strike-class medium cruiser used by the Central Committee of Grand Moffs. During the Galactic Civil War.

CB-99 was a droid Jabba Desilijic Tiure used to keep his will. After his death shortly before the Battle of Endor, Zorba Desilijic Tiure, Jabba's father, reclaimed Jabba's will and everything he owned through the droid.

A stathas was a sleek, venomous reptile native to the Mandalore system, located in the region of the galaxy known as the Outer Rim. The stathas was known to use its seemingly harmless appearance to hide its deadly capabilities.
The Booty Full was a pirate ship under the command of Phan Riizolo, who worked with the Invids. The Invids were a pirate organization led by Leonia Tavira and in opposition to the New Republic.
The Orthavan was a Mon Calamari Star Cruiser of the New Republic Defense Fleet and a sister ship of the Liberty.

ES-PSA, also known as Espasa, was a RIC-920 rickshaw droid manufactured by Serv-O-Droid, Inc.. He operated as a rickshaw driver in the spaceport of Mos Espa on Tatooine, during the time of the Separatist Crisis and the Clone Wars.
The Public Safety Service, or PSS, was the Corellian law enforcement agency that succeeded the CorSec during the Galactic Civil War.
Whistler, also called Xeno, was the astromech droid of Corran Horn. He was the same R-series model as the legendary R2-D2.
GoldFruit, or goldfruit, was a sweet fruit with a yellow rind. It could be used to enhance flavors in a dessert.
Chinshassa was a city on the planet Shalyvane, which was destroyed by an Imperial bombardment during the Galactic Civil War.

The Star Chamber Café was the central reception area at the Lucky Despot Hotel & Casino in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. A Whiphid crime lord named Lady Valarian owned the Lucky Despot. It was here that she celebrated her wedding to the Whiphid hunter D'Wopp.
Ejolus was a planet located in the Inner Rim.

conflict: Clone Wars (Praesitlyn theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: The Battle of Orto, fought primarily in the last week of the Clone Wars, was a Republic effort to remove Orto's illegal new Confederacy-aligned government.
The battle on Solem was a battle during the Galactic Civil War.

The Imperials were a rival grav-crosier team to Jothan Tiaan Jerjerrod's Ripper-Raptors.Whilst being transported to Starkiller Base aboard a First Order Upsilon-class command shuttle, Jerjerrod noted the co-pilot reminded him of the Imperials sweeper.
The Cyclops, often abbreviated to simply "Clops", was a smuggling vessel that was active during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Corsair Squadron was a starfighter squadron, equipped with T-65 X-wing starfighters, that was formed by Wes Janson and Derek Klivian three years after the Battle of Endor.

The Kiffu Guardians or Guardians of Kiffu, were a group formed by the Kiffar to patrol the prison world of Kiffex and provide law enforcement on Kiffu and its sector. The Guardians were led by the Sheyf, and their ranks included that of general.

The Exodeenians were a species of sentient beings native to the planet Exodeen. They had six arms and six legs, as well as six sets of teeth. They joined the Galactic Republic during the Expansion Era, circa 22,000 BBY.

Excargans were a Near-Human sentient species native to Excarga. During childhood, they were genderless; at around thirteen years old, their bodies would change and their gender would be determined. Many inhabitants of their planet worked for ore-processing corporations.
Oolids were native to Oolidi and were affiliated with the New Republic. Tolik Yar was their senator.
Ord Zeuol was a planet in the Ord Zeuol system, a part of the Vilonis sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: The Ambush at Mos Eisley was conducted by the Galactic Empire against the Rebel Alliance over the Tatooine spaceport Mos Eisley.

The Pazaak Den was a private club in the Entertainment Promenade of the Refugee Sector of Nar Shaddaa for hard-core gamblers looking for a match at the most common card game of the galaxy around 3951 BBY, pazaak.

Oogliths were Yuuzhan Vong-bred fungi. When immature, the feeder filaments of an ooglith could transmit germs into the pores of an individual that could kill them. Mature oogliths developed antibacterial enzymes to prevent such an occurrence.
The Screaming Wookiee Squadron was a New Republic starfighter unit.
Tree-ticks were parasites that lived in the trees of Yavin 4. Woolamanders were one of the animals that they preyed on.

Giant tauntauns, also referred to as common tauntauns due to their abundance, were the largest of the tauntaun subspecies on Hoth. They could measure 15 feet long and nearly 8 1/2 feet tall. A healthy adult had only one known predator, the dreaded wampa.
Shocker Squadron was one of two starfighter squadrons that was formed at the Jedi base on Eclipse to assist the Wild Knights and Kyp's Dozen during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The First Battle of Borleias was an unsuccessful attempt by the New Republic to capture an Imperial base on Borleias, a planet in the Pyria system, during the Galactic Civil War in 6.5 ABY.

The Second Battle of Borleias took place between the Imperial forces on Borleias and Rebel forces, including the remnants of Rogue Squadron, several weeks after the disastrous first attempt by the New Republic to take the world.
The GS-138 was a gunship in the service of the Alliance Fleet.
The Mastala was a DP20 gunship in the service of the Rebel Alliance Fleet. It was named after the planet of Mastala.
Mastala was the third planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Garnib system. It was frigid and rocky. The Alliance to Restore the Republic named a ship after it.

Hole balls were wild creatures that lived on Sulon. They were small animals whose fur were always covered in debris to provide camouflage. They dug many holes, which they hid in when they were frightened. Hole balls made squeaking sounds.
Gra were herd mammals raised by farmers on a number of planets.
Barons Knoll was a hill on Sulon. It gave its name to the city of Barons Hed that was built around it.
The Katarn estate was the farmland on Sulon owned by the Katarn family.
The Sulon Star was a large freighter that was owned by the Dark Jedi Jerec.
The Snutib were a sentient species of mantid-like hunters that allied with the Killiks during the Swarm War.

The coup on Thyferra occurred in 36 ABY during the Swarm War, when a group of Killiks and black membrosia-addicted Vratix took control of the planet Thyferra, seizing control of the the galaxy's supply of bacta along with it.
Tenupe was a mountainous and tropical planet located within the Tenupe system that was located in the Utegetu Nebula of Wild Space and was on the Sparkle Run. It was orbited by the Shattered Moon.

result: Alliance/Chiss victory, end of the Swarm War
x: The Battle of Tenupe was the final battle fought during the Swarm War.

Iesei was a Killik hive that once lived on the planet Tatooine. They were encountered by Vector Hyllus and Cipher Nine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. During the Swarm War, the Iesei lived on a desert planet that came under Chiss attack.

The Blockade of the Utegetu Nebula was a conflict preceding the true start of the Swarm War. The Galactic Alliance, under the lead of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu, originally attempted to prevent the Killiks of the Colony to further expand towards Chiss space.

The Battle of Turak IV, also known as the Turak IV Campaign, was the site of the worst defeat that the Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit (Hell's Hammers) ever suffered at the hands of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Hitak Harriers was one of many Rebel Alliance units that participated in the battles to control Kwymar sector during the Galactic Civil War.
The Hitak mountains were located on Turak IV. The volcanic mountains were used as strategic hiding places by the Rebel Alliance soldiers who fought during the Battle of Turak IV.
A Pappfak was the name of an alien species known for possessing long, blue-colored tentacles. Pappfaks could regularly be found inhabiting the marketplaces at Mos Eisley on the planet, Tatooine.
Katarn's Hill was a hill on Ruusan located near Fort Nowhere.

At some point between 2 BBY and 4 ABY, a battle of the Galactic Civil War took place in the Sagma system of the Outer Rim Territories' Illisurevimurasi sector. The engagement pitted the Galactic Empire against the Rebel Alliance, with the former emerging victorious.

Huurtons were large, slender, canine creatures native to the planet Dantooine. They were characterized by armored backs and long claws, and were highly aggressive. The females were the hunters. A separate species of huurtons was known as huurton howlers.
The Battle of Ton-Falk was an early battle in the Galactic Civil War fought at Ton-Falk.
The assault of U'Dray took place during the Galactic Civil War.
The subjugation of the Yatir on the planet Absit was a battle that took place during the Galactic Civil War, on the Yatir homeworld.
The snow falcons were avian creatures native to the frigid planet Rhinnal, where they built eyries within glaciers.
G-5PO was a protocol droid and translator for Jabba the Hutt.
The Chaf Envoy was a diplomatic vessel used by Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano of the Fifth Ruling Family in 22 ABY during the rediscovery of Outbound Flight.
The Zehr Sea was a sea on the planet Delassin Six. The Vodran Xenon Nnaksta worked as a longshoreman at docks for vessels that traveled on the sea.
The Crimson Casino was a casino and a bar located on The Wheel.
The Big Game was a popular gladiatorial competition held on the Wheel, a massive casino resort space station in the Mid Rim.
The Second Battle of Milagro occurred in 5 ABY.
Spirit of Solaris, originally named Pride of Aridus, was an infiltration ship of the Alliance Special Forces under the command of Captain Nord.
The quenker was a small armored hopping rodent which lived on Dantooine. Its jaws secreted an acidic bile used for eating and digesting its victims' flesh.

The thune was a large herbivorous creature with gray, wrinkled, and hard hides. Living in small herds on the grasslands of Dantooine, they were typically not aggressive; only when angered did they became dangerous opponents.

The Forbidden City was a city on the Mid Rim planet Lahsbane. It was the home of the mature Huhks, known for their tendency towards violence, and as such, off-limits to offworlders for their own protection.
Defiance was a Mon Calamari Star Cruiser that served with the New Republic Defense Fleet during Operation Shadow Hand. It was the first warship of the new MC90 Star Cruiser class of vessel.

The Nova Viper was a sleek battle cruiser owned by the bounty hunter Spurch "Warhog" Goa. In 1 BBY he piloted Nova Viper from Level 88 in the Corellian Sector on Nar Shaddaa to Docking Bay 86 in Mos Eisley on Tatooine.

The Manka Hunter was the name of an Incom corsair starship owned by the outlaw tech Shug Ninx. He kept it in his Spacebarn on Nar Shaddaa's Corellian Sector. Greedo, a young Rodian who was an aspiring bounty hunter, wanted to buy the ship from Ninx for 14,000 credits.
Level 88 was a worker's district and housing community located in the Corellian Sector of the Smugglers' Moon, Nar Shaddaa.

objective: Elimination of the voxyn queen
x: The Mission to Myrkr, also known as the Mission, was an operation conducted by the New Jedi Order in 27 ABY with the purpose of destroying the Jedi-hunting voxyn creatures.

The Radion was the name of a Rodian transport vessel. In 17 BBY, a member of the Rodian Tetsu Clan, named Nok, used the Radion to shuttle his family off of war-torn Rodia. He landed on a jungle planet and hid the ship within a large mountain cave.

type: Six Dreadnaught-class heavy cruisers around a central core
x: Outbound Flight was the main ship of the Outbound Flight Project. It consisted of a central fuselage surrounded by six Dreadnaught-class heavy cruisers designated D-One through D-Six; together, the massive ship was known as Outbound Flight.

The Almas Council was a satellite Jedi Council made up of the six head instructors at the Almas Academy, and led by the Academy's Headmaster. While a separate entity, the Almas Council was subject to the orders of the Jedi High Council on Coruscant.
The Shrike was a modified Incom Corporation Alpha-52 starfighter prototype owned by Talon Karrde that was never developed for the open market.

The Mission to Vjun was Yoda's attempt to bring back Count Dooku into the fold of the Jedi and the Galactic Republic. However, it was actually a trap set by Dooku to ensnare Yoda and to deliver a deadly blow to the Republic's forces.
Quanton was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Quanton system, a part of the Obtrexta sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

R-Duba was a desert and ocean planet located in the R-Duba system, within the Quiberon sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. A minor trade world, it was located in a backwater province of the Galactic Empire.
A starfighter was flown by Oss Wilum when the Jedi raided Cinnagar in an attempt to redeem Ulic Qel-Droma.
The Blue Mountains was the collective name for a range on Devaron, just outside the city of Montellian Serat.

Mon Calamari Regiments were employed by the Rebel Alliance. These Mon Calamari troops were especially trained for planetary defense, thus they were among the best of the Alliance military units when it came to defense against planetary bombardment.
The Ithullans were a humanoid species that hailed from the planet Ithull. As natives of the Stenness Node, they were one of the 25 species collectively called "Nessies".
The Kauronians were a sentient species native to the world Kauron in the Meram sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 0 BBY, a number of Kauronian bounty hunters were present on the planet Tatooine.
The Bomodons were a sentient species native to the planet Bomodon in the Churba sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim.
Fneebs were a sentient species. In 0 BBY, a number of Fneeb bounty hunters were present on the planet Tatooine within Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the Mos Eisley spaceport.
Altyr V was the fifth planet in the Altyr system.
K-8LR was a polished, silver protocol droid that once belonged to Jabba Desilijic Tiure and Jiliac Desilijic Tiron prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Tott Doneeta's starfighter was a one-man starfighter that Tott Doneeta flew it at Cinnagar during the Great Sith War in an attempt to redeem Ulic Qel-Droma.

Oxon City, also known as Oxon, was a city on the planet Naboo in which Gungans and Humans lived. During the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY, the city was surrounded and advanced upon by the forces of the Trade Federation.
The Jawa Canyon was one of many locations on Tatooine. It was here that in 0 BBY Dathcha shot R2-D2.
Saber 2, which was also designated Saber Two, was an Imperial Navy TIE/IN interceptor manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems serving in the 181st Imperial Fighter Wing's Saber Squadron by 4 ABY.
Attack Droid AD-43 was a Viper probe droid employed by Jerec on Ruusan in 5 ABY.
Gartana was the fourth planet of the Gorsh system, with twelve moons in its orbit. Its oceans were composed of water that was toxic.
Garsala was a planet ravaged by volcanoes, and was the fifth orbit of the Gorsh system. It had two moons.
N-K Necrosis was a highly advanced combat droid created during the Galactic Civil War from the body of the late General Grievous of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Abran asteroid belt, or simply the Abran Belt, was an asteroid field located in the Abran system of the Wild Space. It contained the mining colony B'Knos.

Slici Canyon was one of the many surface features of the planet Kamino that were covered with water during the Great Flood. Located on the planet's southern hemisphere, Slici Canyon plunged some 10,000 meters beneath the surface of the water.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: The Insiders was an unofficial military unit within the Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic dedicated to stopping the spread of the Yuuzhan Vong during their invasion of the galaxy and after the decline of the New Republic.
The Red Eclipse was a starship and enslaver organization that was operated by a crew of Trandoshan and Weequay enslavers affiliated with the Exchange that was based out of Nar Shaddaa.

The Refugee Sector was an area on the Outer Rim ecumenopolis moon of Nar Shaddaa delegated to millions of refugees from the Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War. It was mostly a construct of cargo containers and prefabricated structures.
Crast, also called food-kin, were a race of crustaceans from Pria. They had a symbiotic relationship with the Priapulins. Crast eggs began to be incubated after being digested by a Priapulin.
Archais was a celestial body located in the Archais system. It was situated in the Interior Region, an area of the Hapes Cluster in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim.
AT-TE Tank Gunners were elite clone troopers and received ARC training. They operated AT-TE walkers and other armored vehicles. They wore a black shoulder pauldron and helmet pads.

S4-C8-GE3 was a GE3-series protocol droid with feminine programming in 3951 BBY. She had what appeared to be a personality quirk: an obsession for pazaak. She was a regular at the Pazaak Den next to the Nar Shaddaa Refugee Sector cantina.
IT-31 was a utility droid that belonged to Tien Tubb on Nar Shaddaa, but ended up in the possession of Kodin when he took it from Tien's junk pile.

B-5D8-GE3 was a GE3-series protocol droid who worked for Vogga the Hutt as a clerk for his droid-run warehouse on Nar Shaddaa. He unwittingly allowed the warehouse to be infiltrated by T3-M4, who was looking for a way to save Meetra Surik.
The Fere were a sentient species of humanoids native to the world of Feree. They were considered to be master shipbuilders of their time.
Courageous was a flagship in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.
Courageous was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy.
The Gopso'o were a tribe of Drovians from Nim Drovis. Though virtually identical to their rival tribe, the Drovians, the two were at war for longer than either side could remember.

318 was a medical droid who worked at a medical tent in Tyne's Horky, a mining town located on the planet of the same name. In the year 15 BBY, it was requested over the tent's public address system that it report to the emergency sick bay.

Gascon was a wealthy and powerful planet located in the Mid Rim's Trans-Gascon sector. Ruled by a king and Queen Marilla, following the formation of the New Republic, Gascon remained neutral yet strategically important during the Galactic Civil War between the New Republic and…
Ishanna I was the first planet in the Ishanna system. It was a barren, searing rock, with two moons.

Glussa Island was the largest island of the Gluss'elta Archipelago on the Outer Rim planet Kintan. The barren rock-stewn island was situated on the western coast of the Gluss'elta Sea near the volcanic Burning Moon Range.

Ishanna II was the second planet in the Ishanna system. A barren world with no natural atmosphere, Ishanna II was important for its mineral deposits, which were mined by various independent companies. The planet had three moons.

The Bantha Graveyard on Roon was the site of countless bantha skeletons. It was here that "Old Ogger" Baobab lived for sixty years, hoarding Roonstones until his great nephew, Mungo Baobab arrived in the company of C-3PO and R2-D2.

Vortex Wind was a Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Galactic Alliance. This powerful warship was part of a task force commanded by Wedge Antilles during the latter part of the Yuuzhan Vong War, in conjunction with Operation Trinity.
A durkii was a large purple bipedal reptilian monster known for fits of rage when effected with kleex.
MU-12 was a housekeeping droid owned by Jango Fett who took care of his son Boba while Jango was away working.
Wranag was a planet located within the Wranag system of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Order of the Silver Jedi was a sect of the Jedi Order devoted solely to combat the dark side of the Force wherever it manifested, as well as to "Serve and Protect" the Galactic Republic.

The Megador was a Star Dreadnought in the service of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances during the Swarm War, when it served as the flagship of Supreme Commander Gilad Pellaeon and then later at the Battle of Uroro Station during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Corellia Star was a YT-1300 light freighter.
Force Wraiths were non-sentient shadowy creatures created from the dark side by the Force power Create Force Wraith. They would obey their creators every command.
C9-T9-GE3 was a GE3-series protocol droid that was modified to become a swoop racing droid. Due to the installed protocols, it was unbeatable by any other racer.
R7-T1 was an R7-series astromech droid that was produced by Industrial Automaton some time after the Battle of Endor.

The Jedi Temple detention center, also known as the Temple Detention Center or Sith containment cells, was a series of secure chambers located in the southwest quarter of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
The Sybrial brain slug was a type of slug that shared its name with the Sybrial system of the Vodilux sector.
Kromus was the fourth planet in the Kro'eval system. It had a rich biosphere, and by the time of the Clone Wars, it had a sentient population of 1.3 billion.
The Star Sea Flower was the personal YT-1150 cargo transport of the aquatic Priapulin, Charza Kwinn. Using it, Kwinn was able to transport Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to Zonama Sekot.

The Serroco gang on Nar Shaddaa was a loose congregation of displaced veterans of the Mandalorian Wars, in which the planet Serroco was devastated by the Mandalorians. The gang established itself as a menace to the Refugee Sector and even irked the Exchange.

The Brigians were a humanoid species native to the planet of Brigia, in the Tion Hegemony. They were thin and tall with purple skin and red eyes. The planet also had a sensitive ecosystem, requiring all incoming ships to undergo a phase-one decontamination before landing.
The Scatter was a shallow valley on Iego where Angels crashed all starships. It was filled with the wreckage of spacecrafts, and even some workable parts.
The Boneyard was the largest of the many piles of bones on Iego. Lying north of The Scatter, the Boneyard held gigantic skeletons of unknown creatures.

The Battle of Renatasia was an Imperial/Centrality "victory" in 12 BBY that saw the conquest of the Renatasia system, one of the many lost Human colonies founded by Grizmallt under the Galactic Republic.
Arf was the nickname given to a K-9 series droid owned by Havet Storm. Little more than a toy Arf was given to Havet by his grandfather Morvet Storm.
Harbinger was a heavily armed Mon Calamari Star Cruiser that served as General Garm Bel Iblis' flagship in the later part of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Tritus was a Mere cruiser of the Mere Resistance, commanded by Captain Juno, one of Nym's pirate forces. Tritus was deployed at the Battle of Nod Kartha.
Mon Adapyne was an MC80B Star Cruiser that saw service with the New Republic Defense Fleet and later the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

The Mere Resistance was a small resistance movement led by former pirate Sol Sixxa, in opposition to the Trade Federation operations in the Karthakk system. They fought at many battles including the Nod Kartha, the Geonosis, and the Second Battle of Lok.
The Galactic Voyager was a Mon Calamari MC90 Star Cruiser that served as the flagship of Admiral Gial Ackbar.
The Battle of Foerost was the opening battle of the Jedi Civil War.
The Invincible was an Imperial Star Destroyer.

The Balmorran defense force was the local militia of the planet Balmorra. During the reign of the reborn Emperor Palpatine, the Balmorran militia was made up of SD-series battle droids, X-1 Viper Automadon droid walkers, and sentient soldiers serving as commanders for advancin…
The Battle for the Darksaber was fought in the asteroid field of the Hoth system. New Republic forces, fearing another Alderaan incident, ambushed and sabotaged the Darksaber weapon.
The stava was a quadruped carnivore on Honoghr that had good endurance. It was rendered extinct after the contamination of the planet during the Battle of Honoghr in the Clone Wars.

This droid, on a quick inspection, looked very similar to an R2-series astromech droid but was in fact of an earlier model which was slightly larger, being 1.1 meters, rather than 1.0. It also did not seem to have the retractable legs of the R2's.

The Porporites were a cetacean species from the Porpor system. After making first contact with the Galactic Republic shortly after the Great Hyperspace War, they became addicted to ryll spice, which had recently been discovered.
Korphir was an Imperial planet during the Galactic Civil War.
MD-5, also called Emdee Five, was an MD-5 medical droid serving the self-appointed Galactic Emperor Trioculus in 5 ABY.
The Kalaanites were native to the planet of Kalaan. Red-skinned humanoids with large red eyes and squarish snouts, they spoke the Kalaanite language.
Toola Spaceport was the main spaceport on Toola. Jedi Noirah Na and Kai Hudorra escaped Toola after Order 66 by boarding a ship at the spaceport that was destined for Coruscant.

conflict: Clone Wars (Felucia theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: A battle on Murkhana took place during the final days of the Clone Wars. The Grand Army of the Republic staged an assault of Murkhana, headquarters of the Corporate Alliance and residence of Magistrate Passel Argente.
The One was, by the time of the Imperial Era, one of the leaders of the droid civilization known as the Silentium.
The New Republic Security Force (NRSF) or New Republic Security, was the primary law enforcement and counter-intelligence agency for the New Republic government.
4th Squad was a squad of Wilderness Fighters in the Alliance Military.

The Battle of Khuiumin was a suppression operation conducted by the Galactic Empire onto the Eyttyrmin Batiiv pirates, resulting in the pirates' destruction. The survivors formed the Khuiumin Survivors and vowed revenge against the Imperial commanders of that battle.
The Western Forest was a forest on Kashyyyk, located near Royal City.
Crusader was a Victory-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The Bombard was a Victory-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

A Mofference was a secret conference held by the Imperial Central Committee of Grand Moffs in the secluded Mofference room of their Moffship. In 5 ABY, a Mofference was in session while the Moffship orbited the planet Tatooine.

The Enforcer was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought and the flagship of Admiral Kohrin and his second fleet. One of the grandest starships in the Galactic Empire, it was damaged in a Rebel ambush led by Commander Luke Skywalker near Bespin.
The Viscount was the lead ship of the Viscount-class Star Defender line produced for the New Republic and later the Galactic Alliance.
Dire-cats were carnivorous feline creatures that lived on the planet Corellia. They had spines coming out of their backs and shoulder blades, and would attack animals that had the scent of blood.

Vertigo Squad or Vertigo Company was a division of the True Mandalorians during the Mandalorian Civil War. They were composed of Mandalorians with flight experience, and formed an air-attack unit. In the Battle of Korda Six, they were led by Montross.

The True Mandalorians were a Mandalorian group of supercommandos who remained loyal to Jaster Mereel, their leader and the reigning Mand'alor, when Mereel's reformist ideals for the Mandalorians were met with opposition from Tor Vizsla's radical splinter group known as the Dea…
Kordans were a sentient species, native to Korda Six.
Black Nebula was a short-lived offshoot of Black Sun, formed after Xizor's death. It was headed by Dequc, a low-level Jeodu operative of Black Sun who styled himself "Prince" after Xizor's death.
Nezmi was a location on Qiaxx known for its Bubble Cliffs. Black Nebula owned a casino in Nezmi and was headquartered out of a secret base within the cliffs.
K3, otherwise known as Kaythree, was the personal protocol droid of Mara Jade when she served as an Emperor's Hand.

The miridon sea monster was a large, green reptilian beast native to the oceans of Tarnoonga. It would frequently nest and swim about the various undersea mountain tops that broke the ocean's surface.
The Dianoga was a modified attack ship operated by the space pirate Gir Kybo Ren-Cha, several years before the Battle of Yavin.
The attack on Coruscant was an offensive by the Duinuogwuins during the Duinuogwuin Contention that ravaged the planet.
Hope was an MC80 Liberty type Star Cruiser of the New Republic Fleet.
Asyyyriaks were vicious arboreal creatures native to Kashyyyk. They spent most of their time high above the forest floor, using branches to travel among the trees.

Blastails were predatory felines that could be found on most levels of Kashyyyk's multilayered forests. Pollen would stick to the fuzzy bulb on their tail, and as they moved about the forest, they would cross-pollinate the flora of their world.
The Azure Angel II was a modified Jedi Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor piloted by Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars.
Divtos were dangerous three-headed serpents native to the forest moon of Endor.

Gharzr, also known as the Dxunian stalker, were one of the thousands of varied predators that inhabited the forested moon of Dxun. They were notable for their twin stinging tails and stealthy hunting tactics.
Loretto was the homeworld of the famed artist, Duos'tine.
Heliosts were avian creatures native to the planet of Bespin. They fed on the naturally-occurring Tibanna gas.

Implanters were Yuuzhan Vong creatures that "implanted" surge-coral into sentient beings to make them into slaves. Also known as "creepers", these creatures carried dozens of surge-coral seeds on their backs.
Native to the planet of Ithor, the Ithorian dragons were reptilian predators as old as the Ithorians.
The Kilassin were a species native to the jungles of Cularin. They resembled great lizards and dinosaurs from other planets in the galaxy.
Native to the planet Rutan, the Kudana were herd animals.
The Battle of Antar 4 was a defining moment in the Separatist Crisis.
Quosits were a species of twenty-five centimeter insects native to Rhommamool. The hermaphroditic beings inhabited the underground.

Native to the homeworld of the Bothans and found on many of their colonies, including Mandell and Kothlis, the Radarks were subterrenean serpents that burrowed and tunnel underneath many Bothan structures.

Found on most planets with hot and dry conditions, sand ticks were creatures that fed on larger animals' fluids. As big as a Human's fist, the pests were usually found on banthas, but were repelled by reptilian creatures like the dewback.
Insectoid creatures that inhabited the Vergesso Asteroids, the Scree were a non-sentient species of spacefaring insects that attacked anything that ventured near their asteroid field.
The Skreev, also known as the Dxunian Raptor and as the Dxunian Devourer, was a reptavian that was native to Onderon's moon of Dxun.

The rearing spider, also known as the giant cave spider, was a large arachnid native to Endor that got its name from its way of intimidation and attacking, standing on its rear and encompassing its prey with all of its legs.

Watch-beasts were native to forests of Gamorr, the homeworld of the stout Gamorreans, and were domesticated to be guards. As cubs, Gamorreans took Watch-beasts from their mother to bond them with someone, which made them only follow that person's commands.
Native to the planet of Naboo, woolly veermoks were dangerous predators that lived on the frozen swamps of Naboo's northern hemisphere.
Lobel were slow-moving quadrupeds that naturally produced powerful magnetic fields that impeded the operation of nearby navigation devices and (reportedly) gave pilots headaches.
The Startide was a partially constructed MC90 Star Cruiser that was destroyed during the attack on Mon Calamari.
Parrlay was a city on the planet Naboo inhabited by the Human Parrlayans. It was located south of the cities New Centrif and Vis, all of which contained transmitters used for offworld communications.

New Centrif was a city on the planet Naboo inhabited by Humans. It contained a transmitter for off-world communications as well as residential and military buildings and processing centers for natural resources such as food, nova crystals, and ore.

Harte Secur was a Human city on the planet Naboo that lay on a peninsula south of Lake Vis. Its layout consisted of a central courtyard with a command center, with a paved outer area containing various civilian and military buildings.
This former Imperial battlecruiser was in operation as a pirate vessel during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.

The Battle of Ession was a conflict between the New Republic and the forces of Warlord Zsinj. Zsinj planned the battle as a trap, using the Pakkerd Light Transport facility on Ession as bait, in order to destroy several squadrons of New Republic starfighters, including Rogue S…
Arf was an astromech droid serving under Captain Grov Bricker of the pirate ship Mourning Glory.
Implacable was the name given to an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate used by the Imperial Navy in a TIE/IN interceptor simulator mission.

The Republic Security Organization (RSO), also called the Republican Security Organization, was a security agency of the Galactic Republic that was responsible for the overall safety and security of the institution of the Galactic Senate.

The Special Acquisitions Branch of the Library of the Republic was a premiere data-location service of the Galactic Republic during its later years, and one of the Republic's four major intelligence agencies.

The Interstellar Consortium on Technology was a service of the Galactic Republic during its later years. After the Declaration of a New Order, it was assimilated into Imperial Intelligence under the direction of former SBI director Armand Isard.
Weytta was a planet located within the Weytta system of the Outer Rim Territories, near Murkhana. It was the homeworld of the Jedi Master Roan Shryne and his parents, Jula and Jen.
Hammer was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in service with the Imperial Navy.
The Fogger was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that served with the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Dubravans were a species of green-skinned humanoids native to the world of Dubrava. They possessed yellow blood, black eyes, and webbed hands and feet with four digits apiece.

A tikulini or "mining worm" was a large, carnivorous worm native to Jazbina that inhabited the sun crystal mining tunnels. They had green blood. "Tikulini" meant "the death of a myriad knives." Their skin was strong enough to withstand a lightsaber strike.

3DVO was a cam droid owned by Lord Prepredenko of Jazbina. Unusually independent for a droid, he had a distinct personality and considered himself a journalist. He was capable of lying, something most droids were not.
Fordee was a droid built by Mala Mala as a friend, protector, and personal transport. Fordee was armed with several blasters and would defend Mala to the death.

B6, nicknamed Beesix, was a droid built by Mala Mala as a friend and assistant. Mala left him behind in a spaceport on Centares when she, Fordee, and a group of other bounty hunters (including Brazzo and Selle) gathered to see if Ban Papeega could discover the name of the pilo…
Quarras were vicious predators native to the world of Devaron. They were large, four-legged reptilian creatures that possessed massive horned snouts filled with immense teeth.

Desolation Alley was a Galactic Republic maximum security prison on the moon Oovo IV. Notable prisoners included Aurra Sing, Fud Sang, and Bendix Fust. During the last years of the Galactic Republic, Fenn Booda served as the prison warden.
The VCD987 was an Acclamator-class assault ship serving in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.
The Imperial Destiny was Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser of the Imperial Navy.

The Bantha Clan was an initiate training clan of the New Jedi Order named after the bantha, a creature found throughout the galaxy. In 35 ABY, it consisted mostly of students who were the between the ages of ten to twelve.

Ronto Clan was an initiate training clan of the New Jedi Order, named after the ronto, a creature native to Tatooine. In 35 ABY, it consisted mostly of students who were the between the ages of eight-to-ten.
The Starry Ice was one of the starships in Talon Karrde's smuggling operation. It was a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation Action V transport.
The sandjigger was a small arthropod native to Tatooine. Its diet consisted mainly of razor moss that could be found in the desert.
The rollerfish was a meter-long, elusive fish that was native to the upper ocean layers of the planet Kamino.

Detention Camp Six was a temporary camp of the Trade Federation, established near Harte Secur on Naboo during the Federation's occupation in 32 BBY. The base consisted of a Command center and two troop centers, and was protected by four laser turrets.
The Bongomeken Collective was a Gungan manufacturing group located near Spearhead that possibly included the original inventors of the Bongos.
Lors was a Gungan village which helped Boss Rugor Nass during his attempt to free Spinnaker from the occupation of the Trade Federation.

Ettam was a city on Ralltiir that contained several farms. Just before the Battle of Yavin, Imperial forces under Commander Akobi assaulted the town, resulting in many unintentional deaths when the Empire thought a medical center was a Rebel outpost.

The Etherway was one of Talon Karrde's starships. It was a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation Action V transport. It sometimes operated under the alias Garret's Gold. The Etherway was present at the Smugglers' Alliance meeting on Hijarna.

The Uwana Buyer was a SoroSuub Corporation Luxury 5000 space yacht owned and operated by the Human smuggler chief Talon Karrde. Heavily modified by Karrde to suit his needs, the Uwana Buyer was the most extravagant and luxurious vessel in Karrde's fleet.
The Freelies were a youth gang on Vorzyd IV that specialized in industrial sabotage of production facilities on their home planet.
Urrdorf City was the smallest of the twenty orbital cities that orbited Duro. Disc-shaped, it was the lone survivor of the Battle of Duro during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Kee-Piru was a floating city on Mon Calamari, located near the Mester Reef in the southern territorial zone.
Hikahi was a city on Mon Calamari that served as a major spaceport.
Verena City was a major city on the planet Kirima, and was the site of one the planet's largest starports.

S-0D3-GE3 was the designation of a GE3-series protocol droid that was active during the time known as the Dark Wars. The droid was owned by a Bith male named Bahima—the bartender of the cantina in the city of Iziz on the planet Onderon—and was used as a waiter for the cantina.

C7-E3-GE3 was a GE3-series protocol droid working in the droid warehouse of Vogga the Hutt. At one time C6-E3-GE3 had been in charge of directing the other droids in the warehouse, until he was replaced with by C7-E3.
C6-E3-GE3 was a GE3-series protocol droid that worked in Vogga the Hutt's droid warehouse during the age of the Jedi Civil War.
B-4R5-GE3 was a GE3-series protocol droid working for Vogga the Hutt on Nar Shaddaa in 3951 BBY.
TT-32-GE3 was the thirty-second GE3-series protocol droid to find itself in the employ of Tien Tubb, its predecessors all having been destroyed in accidents (including explosions).
The Obi-Wan was the first Nebula-class Star Destroyer commissioned by the New Republic. It was named in honor of Jedi Master and General Obi-Wan Kenobi.

The Vultar Cataclysm was the destruction of the Vultar system in 4250 BBY. During the Third Great Schism that year, a group of Dark Jedi took up residence in the star system and discovered Celestial machines there, including the gravity-manipulation device known as the Cosmic …
The Azgoghk was an Imperial dungeon ship created for the extermination of alien species in the farthest reaches of the galaxy, in accordance with Human High Culture.

Tinn VI was a gas giant in the Tinn system. It had six moons, including Tinn VI-B and the inhabited Echnos. Located at the limit of the Mid Rim, it was a common stopover point for spacers en route to the Outer Rim Territories.
Ivatch was a planet within the Kathol sector's Ivatch system, located within the Outer Rim Territories.

Mairne, situated within the system of the same name, was a planet in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Connected to the neighboring planets of Charis and Gandle Ott by hyperlanes, Mairne was located just off the Trition Trade Route that ran through the sector.

Peirs was a planet within the Peirs system of the Outer Rim Territories' Kathol sector. Connected to the neighboring planets of Gandle Ott, Shintel and Ivatch by hyperlanes, Peirs supported a small colony whose economy was based around supplying ore and natural resources to Ga…

House Benelex, or Benelex Bounty Hunters Guild, based on Paqualis III, was a major house of bounty hunters within the Bounty Hunters' Guild founded by Corvastan Benelex. It was specializing in kidnapping retrieval and LAACDocs. They were also rivals of House Tresario.
The Crimlin clan was a Skakoan clan of which Wat Tambor was a member.

headquarters: Power Mounds of the Elders, Skako
x: The Elders were the holy men of the Skakoan religion. They resided on the Power Mounds of the Elders on Skako and read from the Book of the Boolmide. During the Clone Wars, the chief Elder was Clongor.

N'ildwab was a rocky planet in the Outer Rim with many canyons. The inhabitants of N'ildwab lived very simple lives. Because of this, in an effort to control the people, Nobam Nol terrorized the inhabitants and claimed to be a Sith.

Glass Mountain was a mountain on Tatooine wherein Jabba Desilijic Tiure hid a starship containing priceless treasures. It was guarded by Onoh but was discovered by Milmit and Gorga. Big Gizz and Spiker hijacked the ship, only to encounter the Jabba Tape.
The Spirit of Jabba was a starship hidden by Jabba Desilijic Tiure inside Glass Mountain and watched over by Onoh. It contained many treasures, including eight Mendacian funeral urns.
The Nemphas was a freighter owned by Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo that shot down the Spirit of Jabba near Mos Eisley on Tatooine.
Dragon slugs were large, fire-breathing creatures who ate lumni-spice, living on both Hoth and Corulag.

The Skorp-Ion was the personal ship of Quinlan Vos during his time as a Separatist double-agent. Tol Skorr, jealous of Vos, always desired it. Following the Siege of Saleucami, Khaleen Hentz flew it to Nar Shaddaa to await the end of the Clone Wars.
Umrachs were large reptilian bipeds, introduced to Coruscant when the Yuuzhan Vong Vongformed the planet into Yuuzhan'tar. These creatures inhabited the lower levels, and often fed upon Coruscanti.

manufacturer: New Republic Department of Research and Development
x: The Foreign Intruder Defense Organism or FIDO was a massive battle droid used by the New Republic in 11 ABY.
The Battle of Anoth was a battle that took place on the remote, mountain world of Anoth in 11 ABY between the New Republic and a remnant of the Galactic Empire led by Furgan of Carida.
Titan was a Victory-class Star Destroyer which once orbited the planet Harridan.

Harridan was a planet located on the fringe of Imperial space, and was originally used as a prison colony in the past. Even after it was fully colonized, it still continued to draw in the rogue elements as well as the Rebels of the galaxy.

Kala'din was a ancient city on the planet Ryloth whose demise became the basis of a moral tale. The story, known as «The Fall of Kala'din», was often retold by Twi'lek mothers to their children as a reminder of the importance of keeping secrets.
Crullov City was a city on Corulag. A mostly abandoned industrial city, it was ruled by criminal syndicates, and was the sole source of underworld culture on Corulag.

Tasjon was a location on the planet of Corulag that hosted an important annual swoop race in the years before the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, this race was won by Ignar Ominaz and Tasjon was the origin of a HoloNet News article that broadcast his victory.
Hreas Port City was the capital city of Lenthalis. It was the location of the showroom of Galladinium Galactic Exports.
Jack-a-dales were birds native to Utharis that lived in abandoned buildings.
Arginall City was the capital city of the planet Hargeeva.
The Mayjeln was a transport ship used in times of the Galactic Empire.

The wrix was a mountain-dwelling large carnivorous creature. It was mentioned in a popular, yet unsettling, Corellian fable about two reckless boys who disobeyed their parents. Wrixes were also ideally suited for pit-fight competitions.

The zucca boar or zucca pig was a large pig species native to the planet Tatooine. A muscular beast, it was slightly larger than the average womp rat, but not nearly as dexterous. Although the creature was herbivorous, it had thick skin and dangerous tusks.
The purella was a large predator native to the moon Yavin 8.
The Siege of Wann Tsir was a battle of the Galactic Civil War.
Millinar was an elusive planet believed to be only a myth by the galaxy at large. The myth of Millinar was often compared to those of the Lost City of the Jedi and the Valley of the Jedi.

The Battle of Bogo Rai was a famous battle fought by the Chiss at some point prior to the Swarm War. The Chiss forces deployed during the battle were noted for utilizing a space fleet to perform close ground support.

region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
sector: Zuma sector; Moddell sector; Inner Moddell systems
x: Midakos was a moon in orbit around the gas giant Ovise V, in the Ovise system of the Moddell sector.

region: Outer Rim Territories; Inner Zuma Region
sector: Zuma sector; Moddell sector; Inner Moddell systems
x: Midakinos was a moon in orbit around the gas giant Ovise V, in the Ovise system of the Moddell sector.

The Nuns of G'aav'aar'oon were originally a group of Force-sensitive female Gamorreans who set up a convent in the ruins of an old Jedi fortress on the asteroid of G'aav'aar'oon shortly after the Clone Wars.
Sistra was one of the many purple granite mountains on the moon Yavin 8 and was home to a city of Melodies. This mountain was dominated by pools, caves and caverns.

Borgle bats were large, nocturnal creatures native to the caves of Rori, one of the moons of Naboo. Being carnivorous creatures, they were known for capturing living prey and bringing them back to their warrens, where they would slowly drain the bodies of blood.
Buzzbirds were avians indigenous to Tenupe. They were known for the buzzing noise they made.
Goldies were domestic fish, sometimes used to create a peaceful atmosphere in a room. Some were kept at the Jedi Academy on Ossus.

side1: Order of the Sith Lords/Galactic Empire
x: The Skirmish in the Senate was a confrontation that took place in 19 BBY between the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious and the Jedi Grand Master Yoda. The two veterans of the Force engaged in a ferocious lightsaber duel, with each making liberal use of their powers.
