Order 66 is issued and the Great Jedi Purge begins
x: The showdown on Coruscant was a confrontation that took place in the Supreme Chancellor's Suite of the Galactic Senate on the afternoon of 16:5:22 GrS in 19 BBY.

result: Darth Vader ambushes the conclave, all Jedi are killed
x: The Conclave on Kessel was a meeting of Jedi survivors of Order 66 within an abandoned mine on Kessel. After the execution of Order 66 and the beginning of the Great Jedi Purge, a number of Jedi secretly established contact with each other.
The Wennis was a Galactic Republic and later Imperial cruiser.
The Conclave at Katarr was an event of the Old Sith Wars, occurring in 3952 BBY, and was the first major event of the First Jedi Purge that took place during that time period.
The Conclave on Ossus was the first full Jedi Convocation of the New Jedi Order, taking place on Ossus.

The Conclave on Exis Station, also known as the Exis Convocations or Exis Convocation, was held by the members of the Jedi Order in 3986 BBY on Exis Station, an ion mining station in the Teedio system.

objective: Retrieve missing Agamarian xenoarchaeology research team
x: A reconnaissance mission was conducted by Jedi Knights Corran Horn and Ganner Rhysode in the year 25 ABY to locate and then investigate a missing xenoarchaeology research team from the planet Agamar which had lost contact with the university that had dispatched it to the plane…
Deadend was a town on Kiffex that contained the popular cantina Black Hole.
Bathwas were flying creatures native to Kiffex. Aayla Secura and the feral Anzati used them as mounts.

conflict: Galactic Civil War (Hunt for Zsinj/Imperial Civil War)
x: The Battle of Kuat was an offensive by Warlord Zsinj against Kuat Drive Yards, in an attempt to steal the Star Dreadnought Razor's Kiss, which was under construction, from the Galactic Empire.

The Drunk Dancer was a freighter manufactured by the Corellian Engineering Corporation in 39 BBY. She was approximately 150 meters long, and was similar in appearance to a CR70 corvette, but with a circular bridge module.

The Conclave at Deneba, also known as the Grand Assembly, Jedi Assembly, or the Great Council of Deneba, was a Jedi Convocation that took place during the Krath Holy Crusade, held on the planet Deneba in 3997 BBY.

The Jedi Council Chamber, also known as Jedi High Council Chamber or the Council Chambers, was the meeting place of the Jedi High Council. It was located in the High Council Tower—one of the four Council Towers—of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

The Great Plague was the greatest of all offworld afflictions that the X'Ting race experienced some 100 years before the Clone Wars. Many of the X'Ting survivors believed that the plague was unleashed by the executives of Cestus Cybernetics.

In 1 BBY, a group of local rebels led by General Camon Udeon staged an uprising on the planet Gerrard V, seizing the capital city of Harazod and deploying a small naval fleet in orbit. A week later, Imperial forces under the command of Admiral Jion Trynn arrived at Gerrard V.
The Gorvan Horansi were a Horansi subspecies, native to Mutanda, and were the rulers of the Horansi tribes.
The Kasa Horansi were a subspecies of the Horansi species native to Mutanda.
The Mashi Horansi, nicknamed the "Night Stalkers", were a subspecies of the Horansi native to Mutanda.
The Treka Horansi were a subspecies of the Horansi species native to Mutanda.
The Starduster was Nera Dantels' personal starship, which assisted the Rebel Alliance on numerous missions.
The Sullustan Resistance was a guerrilla movement by the native population of Sullust against the Galactic Empire between approximately 2 BBY and 4 ABY.
The Sublight Queen was Nien Nunb's stock light freighter.
The Shark was Commander Merai's personal heavy starfighter during the Clone Wars. It was of Mon Calamari design.

The Uukaablians were a species native to the planet Uukaablis in the Kathol Outback. They had pale green skins. Originally a race of aggressive, warring factions, the Uukaablians reinvented themselves after the biological near-destruction of their world.
Grabworms were giant predatory worms native to Toydaria in Hutt Space. Swamps were grabworms' natural habitat. The Toydarians evolved with wings, allowing them to escape the grabworm's lunges.

Lancer Squadron was a starfighter squadron that served with the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Equipped with B-wing starfighters, the squadron participated in the Liberation of Coruscant.

The Krayt Graveyard was a valley on Tatooine. It was where many krayt dragons went to die. The bones of hundreds of these creatures littered the valley floor. When an aged krayt sensed death approaching, it instinctively began the arduous journey to this resting place.
Reticul was a city on the Galactic Empire's terraformed asteroid of Hanoon, which had been constructed in 6 ABY. The city's inhabitants held a shard of an ancient Jedi artifact, the Vor'Na'Tu.

Reeche city was on the Galactic Empire-controlled terraformed asteroid Hanoon. By 6 ABY, the city had been constructed next to one of the world's canals. Inside the city was a Command center, animal nursery, and prefab shelters.

Libreck was a city on the Galactic Empire-dominated terraformed asteroid named Hanoon. The city was constructed by 6 ABY and consisted of a Command center and prefab shelters, it was the site of an Imperial prison and two troop centers.

OOL-2 was a B1-series battle droid who served in the Trade Federation Droid Army. Sometime between 39 and 36 BBY, OOL-2 was deployed to the moon Alaris Prime, which the Trade Federation was trying to colonize.
The nano-star was a strange type of droid inhabiting the seas of Mon Calamari.

A sussimi was a nearly-transparent crustacean from the planet Mon Calamari. The creature were only clearly seen after feeding, because its stomach quickly transformed the food into a transparent intestinal goo.
Seatrees were a vegetable species from planet Dac.
The Raid on Sullust was an operation carried out by Rogue Squadron, engineered by Imperial defector Kasan Moor to disable an Imperial station situated inside an active volcano known as the Capacitor.
The Tahika Cliffs were a set of cliffs located south of Ariana, the capital of Garos IV.
Squeaky was a protocol droid with a patchwork appearance, consisting of silver and gold plating.

A skirmish on Eriadu occurred after the Battle of New Plympto. After Bultar Swan and Tsui Choi survived Order 66, they retreated to Eriadu. Clone stormtroopers were on the alert and searched the planet for any signs of the hiding Jedi.

A Yootak was a dangerous predator on Endor and Ewok hunting prey. It had green fur and two long arms. On its hands were three long fingers with long and sharp claws. Its mouth was full of razor-sharp teeth.
Balis-Baurgh was a planet in the Mid Rim's Balis-Baurgh system and the only planet in the system that could sustain life.

Koratas was the fourth moon of Dathomir. It had red soil that hid several deposits of neutronium, lommite and zersium. The Galactic Empire mined the minerals for use in making durasteel. Following the Battle Of Endor in 4ABY, the moon was excavated to build Rancor Base within.

The Panshee, also known as Tribe Panshee, or the Panshee Tribe, were a tribe of Ewoks on the forest moon of Endor who followed the Way of the Tree Spirits. Rebel Alliance and later New Republic agent Grael the Ewok was one the tribe's most respected members.
Thousand Thousand was the capital city of Makem Te.
The Berserkers and Advanced Berserkers were a caste of vicious Wookiee warriors armed with two Ryyk blades or bowcasters.
Cretacian was Leia Organa's Gallofree transport ship in the early days of the Galactic Civil War.
The Imperial Military Oversight Commission was a department of the Imperial Military.
The Crystal Cave was located on the southeast end of the Khoonda plains in the Sandral fields on the world of Dantooine.
The Drunken Thranta was a bar located in the Spacer Quarter of Aldera.
The Bail Organa was a New Republic Star Destroyer.
R4-P22 was the designation of the astromech droid attached to Anakin Skywalker's modified Delta-7 Aethersprite-class starfighter, Azure Angel, during the Clone Wars.
Temba Port was the capital city of Antar 4. It was not, however, the most populated city on that moon, being less inhabited than Baal Commune.
Baal Commune was one of the largest cities on Antar 4, being more populated than the planetary capital of Temba Port.
The Lifeline was a Corellian YT-1300 light freighter owned by smuggler Dannen Lifehold.

Niian was a tropical planet of the Niian system, located within the Thaere sector, in the Expansion Region of the galaxy. In 0 BBY, the smuggler Dannen Lifehold was on the planet doing an errand for his mentor, another smuggler named Twolz.

The Pliith were a sentient species of plants. Lacking independent locomotion, the species was dependent on other species for movement. Their plant-like physiology required substantial amounts of sunshine, together with rain and fertilizer.

result: Imperials capture the passengers on a transport
x: The Raid at Bakura, also known as the First Battle of Bakura, occurred in 3 ABY when the Rebel Alliance discovered that a number of scientists captured from Hoth were being held aboard an Imperial detention center orbiting Bakura.
Genon was a planet not far from Imperial commercial centers but it was nearly devoid of settlement because of its most infamous inhabitant: Grappa the Hutt.
Thani was the capital city of Telos IV. The Chodo Habat Parkway and Thani Terminal were located in it.

RZ-0031 was a Restoration Zone established on Telos IV during the Telosian Restoration Project. It was contained by massive generators that projected protective force-fields, preventing the corrosive atmsophere from further damaging the grasslands and beaches within RZ-0031.
Lay Pa-Sidian was a city on the planet G'wenee, an Imperial trade world. Kenix Kil captured customs officer Tarrant Snil for Grappa the Hutt in Lay Pa-Sidian.
4/NG or Four-Slashing was a service droid owned by Grappa the Hutt as part of his operations on Genon. A valet and majordomo, 4/NG was repeatedly the target of droid-hating Gamorrean Tront.

result: Jango Fett is chosen as clone template
objective: Destroy Komari Vosa
x: The Mission to Kohlma was the final event of The Hunt. After Rozatta's death at the Outland Station, Jango Fett moved on to kill Komari Vosa, end the Bando Gora cult, and collect his 5,000,000 republic credits.
The kreetle was a parasitic, burrowing insect often found in homes and around cities. They could be found on a variety of worlds, including Tatooine, Naboo, Kashyyyk and Geonosis.

The Ibian is a small amphibious creature native to Tatooine, the ibian fed on microscopic dust mites and insects. It was in turn preyed upon by the worrt. These small lifeforms could be recognized by their elongated orange and blue bodies, as well as their distinctive eye stalks.
The glacier tauntaun was a rangy subspecies that inhabited Hoth's valleys and ice caves. It was largely unstudied by science.
Daywings were a species of insect found on the Mid Rim planet Qiilura. Notable for their extremely short lifespan, daywings hatched in the morning and died by the evening.
The Battle of Raquish was the final engagement of the Andoan Wars, fought between the two groups of planets known as the Spiverelda and the Andoan Free Colonies.

Arreis was a BFF-1 bulk freighter that transferred robo haulers to the Dellalt system, preparing for Operation Strike Fear. It was destroyed by Keyan Farlander and Hamo Blastwell during the defection of Bixby.

Nigiro was a BFF-1 bulk freighter that transferred munitions to the Dellalt system, preparing the Operation Strike Fear. It was destroyed by Keyan Farlander and Hamo Blastwell during the defection of Bixby.

Murtceps was a BFF-1 bulk freighter that transferred TIE ships to the Dellalt system, preparing the Operation Strike Fear. It was destroyed by Keyan Farlander and Hamo Blastwell during the defection of Bixby.

Esorp was a BFF-1 bulk freighter that transferred mines to the Dellalt system, preparing the Operation Strike Fear. It was destroyed by Keyan Farlander and Hamo Blastwell during the defection of Bixby.
Mount Usca was a mountain situated on the cape on Garos IV, where the Locura and Cabalia oceans met.
Adni's Hill was a hill that was situated near Currahen Crossroad, on the world of Garos IV.

Luudrian Star was a modified Ghtroc 720 light freighter owned by Tru'eb Cholakk, Rebel gunrunner. Tru'eb was able to buy the ship with the reward he got from Platt Okeefe after freeing her from the slaver Big Quince.
The Battle of Tammuz-an was a stand-alone conflict in the early years of the Galactic Empire.
At some point before the end of the Great Hyperspace War, the planet Ambria was devastated due to the machinations of a female Sith disciple.
The Crusaders were a group of droids within the Second Revelation, a group of sentient droids, that were sent out to find more droids like them.

The Cleansing of Onderon was one of the first skirmishes of the Great Hunt. In it, Jedi led by Guun Han Saresh, Shaela Nuur, and Duron Qel-Droma cleansed the planet Onderon of terentateks left there by the Brotherhood of the Sith during the Great Sith War's Krath Holy Crusade.

The Cleansing of Yavin 4 was one of the first skirmishes of the Great Hunt. In it, Jedi led by Guun Han Saresh, Shaela Nuur, and Duron Qel-Droma cleansed the moon Yavin 4 of terentateks left there by the Brotherhood of the Sith during the Great Sith War's Krath Holy Crusade.
The rescue on Yavin 4 was one of the Battles of Yavin 4 immediately after the beginning of the Yavin blockade.

The Cleansing of Tython was a skirmish of the Great Hunt. In it, Jedi led by Guun Han Saresh, Shaela Nuur, and Duron Qel-Droma cleansed the planet Tython of terentateks left there by the Brotherhood of the Sith during the Great Sith War's Krath Holy Crusade.

In 3993 BBY, in the midst of the Jedi Order's Great Hunt, a Jedi team including Knights Duron Qel-Droma, Shaela Nuur, Guun Han Saresh, and Cale Berkona ventured to Tatooine to hunt terentatek beasts left over from the earlier Great Sith War.
In 3993 BBY, Jedi Knights Duron Qel-Droma, Shaela Nuur, and Guun Han Saresh were sent on a secret mission to hunt terentateks on the Sith homeworld of Korriban.
In 3993 BBY, Jedi Knight Guun Han Saresh ventured to the Wookiee world of Kashyyyk to hunt a "great beast" that was rumored to reside in the planet's Shadowlands.
1729 was a supply craft for the Desolation Alley prison facility on the Oovo IV asteroid in 32 BBY. Bounty hunters Zam Wesell and Jango Fett both made use of the ship to infiltrate Desolation Alley.
The Vengeance was a Galactic Republic Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser active during the Clone Wars.
Selton was a city located on the Mid Rim world of Naboo. Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps pilot Dren Melne was born in this city.
Jiramma was a Hutt clan that operated from Nar Shaddaa. Darga Jiramma Mionne was a member of it.

The Nasirii kajidic was a Hutt kajidic located on Tatooine which controlled most pleasure dens and entertainment on the planet. Like four other Hutt kajidics, the Nasirii controlled nearly one fifth of Tatooine's criminal activities before Jabba's rise to power.

The South Apartments was a residential complex located in the Upper City of the planet Taris. Galactic Republic soldiers Carth Onasi and Revan used one of the apartments as a temporary hideout during the rescue of Bastila Shan.

Praven Prime was an Outer Rim Territories world in the Quelii sector that was home to the L'Xing species. By 3951 BBY, it was a part of the Galactic Republic as well as situated in space controlled by the Gu-vandi species.
The L'Xing were a sentient species that lived on the Outer Rim Territories world Praven Prime, which was a part of Gu-vandi-held space.

The Gu-vandi Collective was a country on the planet Praven Prime. It was incited into a world war with its neighbor, the L'Xing, when an HK-50 series assassin droid suggested the mate of the leader of an L'Xing delegation had been impregnated by their Gu-vandi host.
The Vengeance was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer belonging to the High Inquisitor Jerec.

A battle at the planet Commenor occurred during the Yuuzhan Vong War. As the Yuuzhan Vong continued to expand their control of the Core Worlds, Commenor suffered severe orbital bombardment by Yuuzhan Vong forces.
Asteroid 7785 was an asteroid in the Graveyard, the asteroid belt that formed from what remained of Alderaan after its destruction by the Death Star's superlaser.

Dragon-birds or dragon birds were avian predators indigenous to Onderon and Endor. Those of Endor were considered a bad omen by Ewoks. Those of Onderon inspired the appearance of dragon-bird robot drones.
The Dantooinian creeper was a species of green arthropod indigenous to Dantooine.

Qrrrl Toq's starship was the Jedi ship given to Qrrrl Toq at Ossus which he used to pursue Aleema Keto and Crado into the Cron Cluster. When Aleema detonated the Cluster, Qrrrl was killed in his vessel.

Shoaneb Culu's starship was the starship given to Shoaneb Culu at Ossus which she used to pursue Aleema Keto and Crado into the Cron Cluster. When Aleema detonated the Cluster, Shoaneb's vessel was destroyed in a following supernova in The Cron Drift, Shoaneb got killed with it.

Kedriss One was an evacuation ship used by several Jedi in an attempt to flee Ossus before its destruction. The ship was destroyed by Mandalorian Crusaders on Basilisk war droids before it could leave the system.
Odan-Urr's courier was the transport Odan-Urr used to travel from Ossus to Koros Major in 5000 BBY.

Hoggon's starship was an ungainly looking transport owned by spacer Hoggon. He used it to transport Ulic Qel-Droma to first Yavin 4 and then Rhen Var. Hoggon then flew in it to Exis Station, where Vima Sunrider stowed away on the ship.
The Giant horned hopper was a species of bipedal, hopping, herbivorous mammal indigenous to the Vast Veldt of Cathar. They were often killed by the Cathar in blood hunts.

Polus was an ice world orbiting the binary star Avindia of the Avindia system in the Outer Rim Territories. A frigid, mountainous planet, it had a massive frozen ocean and blizzards as well as ice storms that would frequently scour the planet's surface.
The Rhen Varites were a species indigenous to Rhen Var, where they built beautiful cathedral-like buildings. They went extinct when their homeworld entered an ice age.
The Cyborreans were the native sentient species of the planet Cyborrea in Hutt Space region of the galaxy. They were almost always at war with each other, and were a client species of the Hutts.
Mount Corvast was a volcanic mountain, and capital of the planet Sarapin. Situated amidst a series of islands, it was a mineral-rich location filled with abundant natural resources.
Denunciator was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer which was present at the Battle of Endor.
Indictor was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer which was present at the Battle of Endor.
Imputator was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer which was present at the Battle of Endor.

Pulsar was a Star Destroyer which was present at the Battle of Endor. Commander Dor Reder served aboard the ship as a junior officer, and Lieutenant Niclara Varnillian was a member of the ships's gunnery crew.
Redoubtable was an early-model Imperial I-class Star Destroyer. It was later renamed the Destiny of Yevetha.
The Retaliator was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer which was present at the Battle of Endor. By 4 ABY, the Retaliator was assigned to the planet Venaari.
Direption was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer that served under the Warlord Admiral Krennel's fleet in 9 ABY. It was later surrendered to the New Republic.
The Poesy was a Mon Calamari light cruiser.
Champion, also referred to as Champ, was a New Republic Bothan Assault Cruiser that operated during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

The Nine Ruling Families, formerly the First Ruling Family when the Stybla family ruled the Chiss Ascendancy, the Three Ruling Families, the Ten Ruling Families, and at one point having as much as twelve Ruling Families, were an elite group of Chiss families that led the Chiss…

The Fairwind was a large gunship of a design reminiscent of large sailing ships. The vessel was built with a rounded hull, twin masts, wings, and a large figurehead. When the ship flew in atmosphere, its upper surface operated as an open-air deck.
The Battle of Gravlex Med was a battle during the late Galactic Civil War.

In 5 ABY, the Galactic Empire launched an attack on the planet Ciutric IV, forcing a New Republic evacuation. The New Republic failed in rescuing the former leader of the Galactic Empire Sate Pestage.
The Syndicat was a criminal organization that controlled the planet Phindar during the days of the Galactic Republic.
The Battle of Nickel One was an early conflict of the Swarm War.
The Battle of Daluuj was a minor skirmish preceding the Evacuation of Yavin in 0 ABY. It occurred between a small Rebel Alliance team and Imperial forces under Commander Orlok.
Tola, along with Meriso, was one of the two moons of Merisee.
The Harbinger was a large experimental landing ship designed to conquer and hold planets for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Red 6 was a T-65 X-wing starfighter in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. It was assigned to Red Squadron and stationed at the Rebel base on Yavin 4. Red 6 was piloted by Jek Porkins with R5-D8 as the craft's astromech droid.

Thranta Riders, also known as wing riders, were humanoid sapients who tamed flying thrantas and rode them, performing aerial circus-like shows around the world of Bespin. They liked to paint or tattoo themselves with complex patterns.
The Krozurbians were a green-skinned sentient species native to the Krozurbia system, near the Centrality. At one point in time, they engaged in a war amongst themselves for two hundred years.

The Sunrunner was a fast, but unarmed, sea cutter provided for Nym by Loreli Ro. It was equipped with a Corellian navicomputer, Mitgard repulsorlift engines, and clean-burning ion drives. The ship was used by Nym to seek pirate forces lead by Sol Sixxa.

The Revenant was the pirate ship of Sol Sixxa. It was equipped with a prototype cloaking device by Raith Sienar similar to that used on the Scimitar. Nym rammed the ship with the Sunrunner, sinking both vessels and destroying many B1-series battle droids.
A native race to the planet Pantolomin, the Lomins were an amphibious race which shared the administrative duties within the Panto system with their neighbors, the Tolos.
Caraboose were furred ungulates native to Toola. They were hunted by the native Whiphid for food.
Immalia was an Expansion Region celestial body located in the Immalia sector, home to the Humans known as Immalians.
Warspite was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The Guardian Mantis was Vana Sage's trademark ship. It was a unique starfighter of Xi Char design.
R2-0, known as Artoo-Oh or ArOh, was the original prototype of the R2-series astromech droid. It was an ancient astromech droid with a brass casing, probably built well before 32 BBY.

PL-37 was a protocol droid in the service of Lord Toat of the Trade Federation. It was destroyed when Sol Sixxa sunk the Syren. Nym later recovered its head, and Jinkins was able to discover valuable information from the droid's "brain" about the cloaking device Sixxa had stolen.
Relix were huge predatory fish indigenous to Maramere. It closely resembled the opee sea killer. One attacked Nym while he was searching the ruins of the sunken Syren.

The Syren was a Trade Federation pleasure liner. It was the primary vessel used by Lord Toat on Maramere. After killing Toat and stealing a prototype cloaking device from the vessel, Sol Sixxa sunk the ship.

CB-3D was Flynn Kybo's astromech droid during the Clone Wars. Attempting to assassinate General Grievous on Belsus, CB-3D came along in case the Trade Federation codes they were planning to use should fail.
The Cohasset Rover was a transport that was owned and operated by the miner Stellskard.
The Haroot was an avian species indigenous to the planet of Seylott. Golden orange in coloration, they made a distinctive "haroot" call.
Living on the planet Haruun Kal, the Balawai, or Downfolk, were a social group of indeterminate species who fought with the Korunnai, the natives of the planet, during the Summertime War.
The Harasser battle group consisted of two EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates—designated Harasser 1 and Harasser 2—that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Eichler was a BFF-1 bulk freighter that supported the task force, led by the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Invincible, during Operation Strike Fear.
The Council of Elders was a religious institution of the Elders of the Path faith. Members of the council, such as Tromak, held the title of Elder.
The Tapani Great Council or Grand Council and its associated sub-councils was the ruling political body of the Tapani Federation.
WED00-88 was a WED Treadwell repair droid.
Dindoo's Glory was the personal starship of the Rodian entrepreneur Kelko.
Gam Tim'nisi asteroid belt was an asteroid belt in the Tungra sector of the Outer Rim Territories of The galaxy, not far from the Bespin system.
The Otoh Gunga Zoological Research Facility, also known as Otoh Gunga Municipal Zoo or Otoh Gunga Zoo, was a zoo and laboratory structure located in the Gungan city of Otoh Gunga.

headquarters: Cavrilhu's Kauron base, Kauron asteroid field
x: The Cavrilhu Pirates were a group of pirates based in the Outer Rim.

During the Yuuzhan Vong War, in 26 ABY, the planet Falleen was attacked by the Yuuzhan Vong. During their campaign to cut off the Corellian Run, Falleen was among those worlds conquered with others being Kalarba, Druckenwell and Rodia.

A battle was fought during the Yuuzhan Vong War in 26 ABY on Druckenwell. During their campaign to cut off the Corellian Run, Druckenwell was among the conquered worlds including Kalarba, Falleen and Rodia.

The Grand Reception Hall, or Grand Hall, was an enormous building on Coruscant. It was located in an ancient part of the the city world near the Petrax Historic Quarter where the planetwide city had not been built over the top of older buildings.
The Republican Army was a ground force of the Galactic Republic that took part in the Battle of Mandalore that occurred before the Grand Army of the Republic came into existence.

Knights of the Force Squad were a squad of five minor Jedi who were present at the Battle of Mandalore and fought on the side of the Republican Army. It is unknown if this squad survived for the final victory or not.

result: Capture of Governor Vrox by the Republican Army
x: The Battle of Mandalore took place some time between 52 BBY and 32 BBY. Governor Vrox of the planet Mandalore had sent his Mandalorian Armed Forces to raid star systems neighboring Mandalore, and was suspected of constructing illegal war droids which caused the Galactic Republ…
Darkknell was an astronomical object located in the Darkknell system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, situated along the Hydian Way at grid coordinates M-17.

The Myrkos was a Galactic Republic dreadnaught cruiser in service during the Clone Wars. It was stationed in orbit around Tembora, a mobile rogue moon that housed the Republic's Tembora Research Station.

The Lost Ones was a street gang that lived and operated in the undercity of Coruscant. It was composed of juvenile delinquents who had run away or been abandoned by their parents because of their bad behavior.

The Felinians were a species of sentient felinoids originating from the Felin system. During the Galactic Civil War, the Felinians had developed technology considered primitive in the galaxy at large, but a group of them residing in jungles of the planet Zoma V desired advance…
Eridicon IV was a planet which an old "Squid-face" retired to after owning the Limping Lady.

The Karnak Alphans, alternately Karnak, were the indigenous sapient species of the planet Karnak Alpha. Other than their hair, none of their bodies could be seen. The hair of young females was knotted into ribbons while young males had bells tied to strands of their hair.
AT-ST drivers, also called AT-ST pilots, were Imperial Army combat drivers specialized in operating the All Terrain Scout Transport.
The Borlovians were a feathered race native to the planet Borlov that communicated with multi-layered whistles and trills.
Reef Home was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser serving in the Rebel Alliance fleet during the Battle of Endor and in mopping up operations after the battle.

Dreighton was a desert planet littered with rocks. There was an Imperial facility located on the planet. Below it, the Galactic Empire built a huge network of pipe lines and mining tunnels spanning kilometers beneath the surface.
The Battle of Mayvitch 7 was one of the first battles of the Yinchorri Uprising of 33 BBY. Mayvitch 7 was settled by Human colonists from Immalia to defend their mining operations from pirates.
LE-914, or Ellie, was an LE manifest droid that served as the trusted companion of Rebel spy Tay Vanis throughout the Galactic Civil War.
A teezl, also referred to as a screamer, was a non-sentient, bluish, luminous, swirling creature that could be used as a natural hyperspace communications amplifier.

Molator, originally known as Savrip, was the first Vindicator-class vessel that was not converted into an Interdictor cruiser. It served in the Imperial Starfleet, and patrolled the Mid Rim during the height of the Empire.
The Battle of the Murgo Choke was a battle that occurred during the Dark Nest Crisis, and a conflict which led into the beginning of the Swarm War.

The Ambition was a Carrack-class light cruiser in service to the Imperial Navy. In 4 ABY, the ship became part of Moff Kentor Sarne's military forces when he removed the Kathol sector from the authority of the Galactic Empire, setting himself up as an independent warlord.
The Mission to Bast Castle was a mission by a team of Jedi under Tionne sent to the former Imperial fortress of Bast Castle on Vjun in 22 ABY.
The Mission to Exis Station was a mission by a team of Jedi under Tionne Solusar and Ikrit to Exis Station in 22 ABY.

Molavarans were a sentient species indigenous to Molavar. They had caramel colored skin and a long face. Their scalps had multiple tendrils on the sides and back of their head. They bore pointed teeth and large cheek bones.
Pathfinder III was an exploration ship of the Galactic Republic.

The Duuvhals were a non-sentient reptilian species native to Yashuvhu. They were warm-blooded reptiles covered by green feathers. Their anatomy offered them significant ability to disguise and be unseen in the rainforests of their homeworld.

Blast bugs were projectile biots used by the Yuuzhan Vong. A relative of the thud bug, the blast bug was also shaped from a sparkbee. But unlike the thud and razor bugs, the blast bug was the Yuuzhan Vong analog of a guided missile.
The Yashuvhi were descendants of Humans who had attempted to settle the planet Yashuvhu in the millennia past.
The Coruscani Pilot Institute, abbreviated as CPI, was an academy located on the planet Coruscant, specializing in the training of space pilots.

result: New Republic victory, introduction of the Reborn
x: The Battle of Bespin in 12 ABY was part of the Empire Reborn campaign.
In 3964 BBY, the Jedi Masters of the planet Taris' Jedi Tower killed their Padawans at a false Knighting ceremony that became known as the Padawan Massacre.

The raid Coruscant in 23 ABY, capital of New Republic, was one of the many raids conducted by the Second Imperium during the Second Imperium Crisis. It resulted in the theft of the Bulk Cruiser Adamant and its cargo of turbolasers and hyperdrive cores.
The tandem X-wing starfighter was a modified two-seat version of Incom's more common T-65 X-wing.
The Battle of New Plympto was a conflict that took place towards the end of the Clone Wars.

During the Yuuzhan Vong War, R2-B3 was an astromech droid in Jaina Solo's X-wing when she was in command of the Twin Suns Squadron on Borleias, sometime after the Battle of Coruscant. The droid was nicknamed Cappie to honor deceased wingmate Anni Capstan.

Fiver was Anakin Solo's modified R7 astromech droid a year into the war with the Yuuzhan Vong. When the Peace Brigade attacked the Jedi praxeum at Yavin 4 a little over a year into the invasion, Fiver flew Anakin's X-Wing to distract the Brigade.
Sparky was Jaina Solo's R5-series astromech droid during her early tenure with Rogue Squadron in the war with the Yuuzhan Vong.

t: Second mission to the Yinchorri system
x: The second mission to the Yinchorri system in 33 BBY was a Jedi mission sent to the Yinchorri system following the deaths of the Jedi Naeshahn and her Padawan Ebor Taulk, who had been sent to investigate Yinchorri aggression against the neighboring systems.
The Freedom resistance movement was an anti-New Republic organization on Bakura, established by Malinza Thanas.

t: Raid on the Jedi Temple (Yinchorri Uprising)
x: In 33 BBY, the Yinchorri raided the Jedi Temple on Coruscant under the influence of Darth Sidious.
The Ambush on Yitheeth was a skirmish between the Jedi and the Yinchorri on the oceanic moon of Yitheeth.
The Mission to Yibikkoror took place on the gaseous planet of Yibikkoror, in the Yinchorri system in 33 BBY.
Shannador's Revenge was an Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser in the CSA Picket Fleet used by the Corporate Sector Authority to defend Orron III.
The Crucible was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served as home to Nas Ghent and his elite Black Eight Squadron during the Galactic Civil War. The flight officer was Commander Dorin Millavec.

The Rhodi's Silence was Nas Ghent's personal freighter which he used for high risk smuggling missions. The Silence was "silenced" when Darth Vader personally took down Ghent to recruit him to train a personal squadron for Vader's use.
A battle was the beginning of the Osarian-Rhommamool conflict between Osarian and its neighbor Rhommamool.
A battle at the planet Nal Hutta occurred during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The Battle of Yinchorr took place on Yinchorr in 33 BBY during the Yinchorri Uprising.

result: Luke Skywalker resigns from the New Republic Army
x: The Battle of Mindor was fought between the New Republic and the Legions of Shadow, as part of the warlord Cronal campaign for the control of the Inner Rim.
a: Princess Leia and the Shadow Trap
Princess Leia and the Blackholes of Mindor

x: L-23 was a protocol droid who belonged to Byrom and Ensa, two farmers living on the planet of Molavar. During one of the farmers' routine repair runs on their antiquated moisture vaporators, L-23 was sliced in half by Dark Jedi Lycan's lightsaber, as he approached them.
The Battle of Uhanayih concluded the Yinchorri Uprising of 33 BBY.
The Hethas were a species of humanoids with long faces and large craniums. The gangster Gornt Seron was a member of this species.

The Great Spirit Tree, also called the Great Tree or Spirit Tree, was an ancient tree on the forest moon of Endor that was sacred to the local Ewoks. The species believed that they were all descended from the Great Tree, and that all life eventually returned to it.
The Tyrannic was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Starfleet, as part of the Braxant Sector Fleet.

The Arhan were a sentient near-Human species most of which had thin, frail bodies with long features. One Arhan had light-colored skin, hair, and eyes. Arhans identified as belonging to at least one—female—gender.

Real Deal was a Mon Calamari Sailfish originally provided by Lando Calrissian to Jae Juun and Tarfang. Juun sold the vessel to the Squib war profiteers Emala, Grees, and Sligh who used it to supply material to the Killiks during their border conflict with the Chiss.

result: Inconclusive, Chancellor Palpatine stops the fight
x: During the Clone Wars, a duel took place in the Senate Building on Coruscant between the bounty hunter Boba Fett and the Jedi Master Mace Windu.
Q4P3 was a protocol droid who was once sent to Mustafar to retrieve the "Codex" for his master, Pann. While there, he spoke with several of the droids hoping to discern the location of the "Codex".
The Stellar Web was an Imperial Immobilizer 418 cruiser commanded by Captain Barr Moutil.
The Dazouri were a species of polymorphs that were genetic cousins of the Lahsbees in a manner analogous to the relationship between Human and Near-Human species. They had two forms, rest and rage.
The Dead Forest was a region of the Kkowir Forest which had fallen to the darkness of the Sayormi's power. It was near Kachirho and inhabited by webweavers.
The First Battle of Obroa-skai during the Yuuzhan Vong War was a major victory for the Yuuzhan Vong forces.
The Second Battle of Obroa-skai was a battle between the New Republic and the Yuuzhan Vong, occurring in 28 ABY.

The Great Tree, also known as the Spirit of Nyenthi'Oris, was located in the Mysess Glade, a sub-region of the Kkowir Forest. The tree was sacred to the Wookiees on Kashyyyk, and was tended to by the people of the Kerritamba Village.
Kerritamba Village was one of the ground-level Wookiee settlements on the planet Kashyyyk.

Kkorrwrot were creatures native to Kashyyyk and distant cousins to the walluga. They were often seen in the Etyyy hunting grounds. Intelligent, but reclusive, they had a mouthful of tusks and sharp teeth.

The kahmurra blanca was a subtype of kahmurra, a race of murra bioengineered in the Kahmurra Biogenetic Research Station on Talus. A mutated variant, this creature was larger, stronger and more resistant to average kahmurra. It also had large horns and tusks.

The Bane Back spider was a subtype of gaping spider, an arachnid creature native to the planet Dathomir. A mutated variant, this creature was larger, stronger and more resistant to average gaping spider.
Nym's Stronghold was the largest city and sole planetary spaceport on the planet Lok. It was built prior to the Galactic Civil War around the base used by Nym and his pirates during the Clone Wars.
Zeetsa were a small spherical species with short arms and legs native to the planet Ord Cestus. Zeetsas had leathery skin. They came in at least blue and gray, but possibly other colors.
Q9-X2 was a Q9-series astromech droid. Made as an experimental model by Industrial Automaton, Q9-X2 had a very strong personality, much like R2-D2.
The painted spat was a subtype of carrion spat, an avian creature native to the Corellian system. A mutated variant, this creature was larger, stronger and more resistant to average carrion spat.
Vir Vur were four-legged creatures often found roaming around Rori. They were known to be trained by creature handlers to do many tricks.
The Plains of Harkul, or simply Harkul, was a desert plain located on the planet Kuar. Mandalore the Indomitable and Ulic Qel-Droma dueled there during the Great Sith War.

The Ipharian-Da'Lor were a species of reptilian beings with truncated snake-like bodies from the planet Iphar. They had spiny ridges which extended down from the back of the head to the tip of the prehensile tail, from which a spike could be extended.
Fell Defender was the Chiss Star Destroyer that Commander Jagged Fel was in command of during the Dark Nest Crisis and later, the Swarm War. It captured the Millennium Falcon above Tenupe.

The Kloperians were a sentient species native to the Inner Rim planet Kloper. They were a short, gray species, with fish-like eyes and mouths and extensible necks. Lines of tentacles, several of which were capped with hands, ran down both sides of their bodies.
Thirteen was one of the medical droids who served in Fyzen Gor's Original Dozen. Two years after being repaired by Gor, the droid required replacement limbs.
The Hortek were a species of predatory humanoids that were covered with bony plates and had long necks and large unblinking eyes. They were among the few predatory races to join the New Republic.
Take That! was a YT-1210 Corellian light freighter that was owned and captained by Falan Iniro. It was destroyed in the Battle of Nar Shaddaa by the Carrack-class light cruiser Renthal's Vigilance.

The Minestra was a captured Imperial Customs Corvette that was part of Drea Renthal's pirate fleet. It was upgraded with ion cannons and concussion missiles in addition to its standard turbolaser armament.
The Badlands were among the most remote areas of desert on Ord Cestus. Some outcast X'Ting and other Cestians were known to be exiled to the Badlands.
The Lukhur Badlands was a desert on Nishr, on the continent Feldt. It contained the abandoned mine that was used for Nishr Base Seven.
Umboo was a province on the planet Roon. It was home to the Yomm family.

The Spider People were a sentient species native to the planet of Ord Cestus. They were most likely related to the Cave spiders that were still extant in more modern times. This species was quick to jump to conclusions.
The Syndicate was a criminal organization that was ran on Cularin by Alina Impeveri, during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. It was based in the Ishkik caverns.
Nashal was one of three major cities on Corellia's Twin World of Talus.

x: The Battle of Korriban was a large-scale conflict in 14 ABY, during the Disciples of Ragnos crisis. On Korriban, the Disciples had gathered to resurrect a dead Sith Lord, Marka Ragnos, while the New Republic sent Jedi to intercept the cultists, resulting in a huge battle prima…

Too Late Now was a captured and modified Imperial Customs Frigate that was part of Drea Renthal's pirate fleet that was present at the Battle of Nar Shaddaa. One of its laser cannon turrets was replaced with an ion cannon, allowing it to disable ships for capture.

Bnef Nlle was the small modified light freighter owned by Niev Jaub. It was part of the First Strike Element in the Battle of Nar Shaddaa and lay hidden in the debris field as the Carrack-class light cruiser Vigilance approached the moon.

The Howler Tree People were a sapient species native to Bendone. They spoke a strange and difficult language which they spoke with ultrasonic voices. A team of translators were required to act as an intermediary between them and a speaker of Basic.

The Zarian were a species of short amphibious humanoids from the planet Zaria in the Zaria system. Although they remained free on Zaria, they were still under the control of the aristocratic Ancient Houses.
The Guild of Zygerrian Slavers was one of the larger slaver guilds in operation during the reign of Emperor Palpatine. It was based on the slave trade world of Zygerria.

The Pui-ui species was native to Kyryll's World. The sentients' small bodies were formed by two spheres separated by a short neck. The lower of the two spheres had a number of cilia projecting from it, facilitating movement.
The Razor Runners were a group of mercenaries and bandits commanded by Hal Razor found on the planet Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War.

Ngdins were vampiric creatures used by the Yuuzhan Vong. A sluglike scavenger which moved about on a thousand tiny cilia, ngdins were tongue-shaped which absorbed nutrients from substances such as blood.
Sathogs were creatures native to the planet Kashyyyk.
The Sith Shadows were a group of thugs who were known to attack Force-sensitives during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

ChikatLik was the capital city of Ord Cestus. The name was a X'Tingian word meaning "the center." The city contained thousands of roads, but little aerial traffic, and was designed to blend its artificial structures perfectly with the volcanic terrain.
The Mynock was a starship commanded by Cade Skywalker, named after the parasitic mynock. Aside from Cade, his crew included co-pilot Jariah Syn, mechanic Deliah Blue and later astromech droid R2-D2.
Havoc Squadron was one of a number of the starfighter squadrons that served with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Peacekeeper was one of three Dreadnaught-class heavy cruisers present at the Battle of Nar Shaddaa. It was commanded by Captain Reldo Dovlis.
Mosgoths were large flying reptiles native to Togoria, the Togorian homeworld. They were used as mounts by the Togorian people who befriended them.

Liphons were non-sentient predatory flying reptiles native to the planet Togoria. Togorians, before they developed civilization, were often preyed upon by liphons. Liphons also raided the nests of another species of flying reptile, the mosgoths, in order to steal eggs.

Caross was the capital city of Togoria. As with other Togorian cities and towns, its permanent inhabitants were all female Togorians and their children, due to the division in Togorian society between the nomadic males and the settled females.

WED-15-I7 was a WSB-15 sabotage droid, a fourth-degree military sabotage droid model physically identical to the WED Treadwell repair droid. WED-15-I7 was individually physically identical to the WED-15 Septoid Treadwell.
The Battle of Anx Minor was one of the last major battles of the Galactic Civil War between the Imperial Remnant and the New Republic, occurring during final campaign of the Remnant in 17 ABY.

The Second Battle of Champala, also known as the Battle of Champala, was a battle during the Imperial Skirmishes of 17 ABY that saw Admiral Gial Ackbar, at the helm of the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Guardian, lead the New Republic's Third, Fourth, and Fifth Fleets to reta…

The Agonizer was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer and the flagship of Admiral Teren Rogriss's Anti-Zsinj Task Force. It housed the 181st Imperial Fighter Group and was sent to Adumar to open negotiations with the Adumari.
The Allecto was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Assassin was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Starfleet.
The Conqueror was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in service during the Galactic Civil War.

The Outcasts were citizens of Taris that had been banished to the Undercity of the planet. They and their descendants were forced to live in dirt and filth, while having to beg for and steal food and clothes.

Sab Rufo was an Inner Rim astronomical object that was the site of the Academy at Sab Rufo. At one point during the reign of the Galactic Empire, Major Herrit of Imperial Intelligence sent a communique, addressed to Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader, in which they erroneously …
Emperor's Will was a Victory-class Star Destroyer that was assigned to the Imperial Center defense fleet after the Battle of Endor.
The Engager was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer under the command of Captain Dalton. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin she was disaptched to Rafft to eliminate Rebel activity on the planet.
The Firestorm was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer which became the flagship of Supreme Warlord Harrsk's fleet after the destruction of the Shockwave.
Gauntlet was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that had been assigned to the Tapani sector fleet of the Imperial Navy.
The Kalla's Stanchion was a starfighter carrier in the Alliance Military during the early Galactic Civil War.

The Coruscant mercenaries were a band of Human, Ishi Tib, Nikto, and Rodian assassins active on the planet of Coruscant, capital of the Galactic Republic, during the decade leading up to the Clone Wars.
Bravo Squadron was a Galactic Republic military unit during the Clone Wars. They were led by Anakin Skywalker into the Battle of Sivvi.
An amorphous, translucent, and phosphorescent creature, the Lake-spirit inhabited the subterranean waterways of the planet Mimban. It sent out tentacle-like psuedopods to grasp prey.
Teguta Lusat was a city on Rafa IV that served as the colonial capital of the Rafa system during the Imperial Era.

The Rokak'k Baran was an immense, ancient starship that was the product of Gree technology. Disk-shaped and measuring five kilometers in diameter, the vessel was the only means of travel between the worlds of the Gree Enclave, a small region of space in the Outer Rim Territori…
QT-QC was a CLL-8 binary load lifter droid found in the village of Aurilia on the planet Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War.
The Kon'me were a sentient reptilian species native to the ocean planet Bal'demnic in the Outer Rim's Auril sector.

conflict: Clone Wars (Felucia theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
result: Kon'me victory, expulsion of both Republic and CIS forces
x: The Battle of Bal'demnic was a conflict that occurred during the third and final year of the Clone Wars, instigated by the Confederacy of Independent Systems' attempt to mine cortosis from Bal'demnic's crust.
Kusurrun was a Yuuzhan Vong ro'ik chuun m'arh frigate that took part in the invasion of a galaxy that was, for the most part, controlled by the New Republic.
Viper Alpha was a Mandalorian Crusaders squad armed with Basilisk war droids that fought at the Battle of Ossus during the Great Sith War.
The Nuna's Twins was a captured Imperial transport used by the Rebel Alliance to infiltrate the Imperial base on Kalist VI.

The Onyx Star was the codename for the prototype of the Z-95 Headhunter developed at the Bahalian Shipyards in the Bajic sector. The Onyx Star was stolen by Icaris Tool and Drive but later returned to Sublight Products Corporation for refinement and mass production.

The Far Thunder was one of the Republic-class cruisers that were introduced during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Republic-class vessels were cheap to produce, allowing large numbers to be brought into service.
Whip Hand was a Lancer-class frigate that was initially operated by the Galactic Empire before it was captured.
The Elegos A'Kla was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the New Republic Defense Fleet and later the Galactic Alliance Navy; the vessel was named for Caamasi Senator and martyr Elegos A'Kla.

x: The Rescue on Kessel was an operation that took place around 1 ABY. During the Rebellion's assault on Kile II, Wedge Antilles's Y-wing starfighter had been disabled by Imperial forces. Antilles was smuggled into an evacuation shuttle and shipped to the prisons of Kessel.
In 9 ABY, in the final days of the Thrawn campaign, a battle occurred at the planet Xa Fel.
The ice worms were large predatory creatures from Akuria II. Their burrows honeycombed Akuria II's icy surface, making it highly dangerous to walk on.

The Anti-Alien League was a Humanocentrist group formed before 3956 BBY. Founded by Gorton Colu, a resident of the Outer Rim ecumenopolis of Taris, the group lobbied for the massacre of all non-Humans, especially those like Bith or Rodians without any Human characteristics, an…
The Rellias Straits were a channel that connected Rellias with other underwater Gungan cities and Otoh Gunga.
The Chancellor's Podium was a podium located in the center of the Galactic Senate Building's Galactic Senate Chamber that extended from the Chancellor's working office directly below.
The Other was a prominent member of an extragalactic droid society named Silentium, alongside the One.
Thrass was a city located on the moon of Lupal. After the collapse of the civilization on Lupal and the abandonment of the moon by the few survivors, Thrass fell into ruin.

The Exex was the ruling class on Bespin's Cloud City. It was comprised mostly of business leaders who maintained their headquarters on Cloud City. They were offset by the Baron Administrator and the Parliament of Guilds.
The Parliament of Guilds was the third ruling branch on Cloud City, Bespin. They were offset by the Baron Administrator and the Exex.
The Sunrider was a small starship found by the Jedi Tionne Solusar, Ikrit, Anakin Solo, Tahiri Veila and Uldir Lochett during their trip to Bast Castle on Vjun in 22 ABY.
ER-1C was an ER-1 probe droid built by Graf Zapalo and a team of Naboo engineers. ER-1C was put to work on Ohma-D'un, aiding in the Gungan colonization of the moon.

The Razor was a CR90 corvette in the Alliance Fleet. The corvette was captured by the Motivator while it was trying to escape with the Death Star II construction data onboard, resulting inside the Motivator's hangar bay crashing on the surface of planet Kothlis.
The Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service (GAIS), also known as GA Intelligence or the Intelligence Service, was the main intelligence organization of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances.
The Executive Directorship Board, otherwise known as the Direx Board or the Board of Directors, was the executive body of the Corporate Sector Authority.
The Sunulok was the flagship of Warmaster Tsavong Lah during the early stage of the Yuuzhan Vong War. It command area was the Glory Room and its mess was the High Chew.

N'Zoth was a planet located in the N'zoth system of the Koornacht Cluster in the galaxy's Core Worlds. On the periphery of the Deep Core, it was connected via hyperspace route to Jedha and Coruscant, and situated in square K-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Desargorr was a mountainous world located in the Desargorr system. It was a part of the Allied Tion sector of the Tion Cluster, situated within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Raid on Fara's Belt was a textbook example of a total defeat caused by compromised intelligence.

result: Galactic Empire made aware of Rebel presence near Sullust
x: The Battle of Sullust was a confrontation between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire, fought during the Galactic Civil War in 4 ABY.

The Stinger was a Surronian assault ship given to Prince Xizor of the Black Sun crime syndicate in exchange for his assistance to the hive craft guild that created it. Although basically a Conqueror-class assault ship, the vessel was uniquely customized by its creators.
K-X12a was a battle droid that was owned by the hunter Tanis Venn in 3956 BBY. It had been reprogrammed by Venn to help during his hunts for desert wraid.
K-X12b was a battle droid that was owned by the hunter Tanis Venn in 3956 BBY. It had been reprogrammed by Venn to help during his hunts for desert wraid.
K-X12c was a battle droid that was owned by the hunter Tanis Venn in 3956 BBY. It had been reprogrammed by Venn to help during his hunts for desert wraid.
K-X12d was a battle droid that was owned by the hunter Tanis Venn in 3956 BBY. It had been reprogrammed by Venn to help during his hunts for desert wraid.
Lonnaw was a Mid Rim planet located on the Entralla Route. It served as the first scheduled stop on the shakedown cruise of the Galactic Republic exploratory vessel Outbound Flight in 27 BBY.
Pride of Selonia was a modified Lancer-class frigate under the command of Captain Todra Mayn that served in the Galactic Alliance Defense Force during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The Roxuli asteroids were planetoids in the Roxuli system.

Crustai asteroid base was the asteroid headquarters of Picket Force Two of the Chiss Expansionary Fleet, on the borders of the Chiss Ascendancy. The base was actually hidden inside the asteroid. Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo was in charge of the base for some time.
The Reprisal was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
A battle took place in 5.5 ABY, when a desperate Sander Delvardus, leader of the Eriadu Authority, tried to capture the planet Sullust to stop the New Republic expansion in the galaxy.
R4-T8 was an orange, black and white-colored R4 astromech droid located on Coruscant in 22 BBY.

R5-D2, often referred to simply as R5, was a masculine R5-series astromech droid who served part of Star Tours' technical pool until he burnt out in a tour accident and had to have parts replaced by the maintenance droid G2-9T.

x: The Battle of Artus Prime occurred in 12 ABY between the Empire Reborn and New Republic forces on the Artus Prime mining facility.
The Yald was a heavy cruiser in the service of the New Republic and the Galactic Alliance. It was the flagship of Commodore Brand during the Battle of Fondor.
The Ministry Council was the collective governmental decision-making body that bought together the principal ministers of the New Republic.

Nharpiras were small, mostly aquatic, carnivorous amphibian species that lived on Dagobah. These carnivorous creatures relied on their speed and rapid jaw movement to decimate prey before they even realized what was happening.
Morp was a carnivorous amphibian species native to the planet Dagobah.
The Pom-hopper was an animal from Naboo. An amphibious mammal, it was much more comfortable in the water than on land.
Crab-harps were bioengineered non-sentient creatures created by the Yuuzhan Vong species. Crab-harps had long legs with tendons that linked the tips of each of their legs to their bodies.

leader: New Republic Defense Force Army Command
x: The New Republic Army was a segment of the New Republic Defense Force that served as the ground military of the New Republic. It was formed from the ground forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic after the New Republic was established.

The Valley of Golg was one of many burial valleys constructed on Korriban by the ancient Sith species at some point long before around 200,000 BBY. The valley was particularly notable for containing the tomb of Sith King Dathka Graush.

The Foerost Siege was a two-year blockade that the Galactic Republic imposed on the Techno Union's Foerost Shipyards. It was finally broken in the Battle of Foerost when Admiral Dua Ningo breached the blockade with the Confederate Navy's new Bulwark Fleet.

BIX was a masculine service droid who competed with the Umboo Racing Team in the planet Roon's annual Roon Colonial Games. When BIX was disabled shortly before the Drainsweeper race of 15 BBY, C-3PO helped the team win the event in his place.

Kendamar was a terrestrial planet located in the Kendamar system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Lol sector. Around 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of Kendamari Casinos, a chain of casinos that constituted a part of the Tenloss Syndicate.

Majilop was a world located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Lol sector. Around the year 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of the Lucin Syndicate, a major producer and distributor of illegal holoporn.
Mount Avos was a mountain on the planet Troiken which once housed a spice mine. It was part of the Hormick Range and was located near the Lycinder Plain and straddled the planet's equator.

The Centrans were a sentient humanoid Near-Human species that hailed from Erilnar, capital of their home territory, the Centrality. Their civilization were descended from human setters, and partitioned into a separate race due to Erilnar unusual geography and harsh environment.
The 37th Imperial Fighter Wing was a starfighter fighter wing that served with the Imperial Starfleet.
Tyshapahl was a planet located within the Tyshapahl system of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Queen of Empire was a luxury liner that belonged to Haj Shipping Lines.

The Outrunner was a freighter purchased by Dash Rendar with the profits from his career as a freelance pilot, smuggler, and mercenary. The black ship was heavily armed with both laser turrets and proton torpedo launchers, and could be powered up quickly to enable a rapid escape.

The battle of Orion IV was an engagement between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic that took place on the planet Orion IV in the Tion Cluster in 1 BBY, as part of Operation Strike Fear.
The Battle of Brigia took place during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: The Battle of Denab was an engagement fought early during the Galactic Civil War, prior to the Battle of Yavin, between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire's Imperial Fourth Attack Squadron at Denab.

Brolfi, singular Brolf, were a species of furry sentients who inhabited the planet of Barlok. Their skin, referred to as hornskin, was colored between different shades of green and yellow, and quivered when the Brolf was feeling emotional. They also had stumpy legs.

The Bargain Hunter was a light freighter owned by Dubrak Qennto and crewed by Maris Ferasi and Jorj Car'das. It was able to go for between 600 and 650 hours at sublight before needing to refuel, and it was equipped with lasers and missiles.
The Battle of Selaggis was the continuation of the military engagement begun at the Battle of Vahaba, and the last major engagement with Zsinj before the Battle of Dathomir.
The Nimbus commandos were the elite guards of the Jabiimi Separatist leader Alto Stratus.

DJ-88, or Dee-Jay, was a class three droid affiliated with the old Jedi Order. A white, humanoid droid with red photoreceptors, DJ-88 was designed by its Jedi creator to protect the Lost City of the Jedi, a secret library and terraforming station located deep below the surface…

HC-100 was the droid companion and homework checker of Ken in the Lost City of the Jedi. HC-100 had a humanoid body with silver plating and blue photoreceptor eyes. HC-100 was built by DJ-88. He was made to resemble C-3PO, and he walked and talked like a drill sergeant.

Chip, also known as Microchip, was a droid the size and shape of a twelve-year-old boy. Microchip belonged to the Jedi Prince Ken. He was Ken's caretaker, since Ken was the only Human in the Lost City of the Jedi.
IG-109 was an IG-100 MagnaGuard that helped train General Grievous.
The Battle of Vahaba was an engagement between the temporarily allied forces of the New Republic and Admiral Teren Rogriss forces against the forces of warlord Zsinj.

IM4-099, nicknamed "Face", was a Mark IV sentry droid assigned to the Mos Eisley Militia. Working for the Galactic Empire, IM4-099 gave the Imperials information about criminal activity. The droid took its job seriously.
Termagant was a Strike-class medium cruiser in Warlord Zsinj's fleet.
Langoona was a remote world located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. Centuries ago, it was the homeworld of a once-favored slave species of the Hutts.

x: A battle occurred at Kalist VI during the aftermath of the subjugation of Jabiim. It was a Rebel attempt to rescue mathematician Jorin Sol.
The Frunchettan-sai, referred to as the Frunchies by the Human trader Dubrak Qennto, were a species that originated in Wild Space and controlled several colony worlds in the Outer Rim Territories.
Red Moons was a mercenary organization led by a former Colonel of the New Republic. It was a group dedicated to liberating worlds from the remnants of the Empire.
The Priam was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate which served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. The ship was stationed near Kalla VII in the months leading up to the Battle of Yavin.

Qulok's Fist was a criminal gang active during the early years of the New Republic. Comprising four individuals—Thanis Gul-Rah, Kolig, Padak, and Sufar—Qulok's Fist engaged in various criminal activities, including slave trafficking, mercenary work, smuggling, and bounty-hunting.
Thota were a savage species of predatory creature native to the planet of Varl. They were considered the primary predators of the sentient t'landa Til species who also dwelt on their homeworld.
The Rock Dragon was a Hapan ship that belonged to Tenel Ka Djo. Her parents and grandmother, Ta'a Chume, sent it to her as a gift in 24 ABY when she was training at the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4.
The Raid at Coronet took place two weeks after the Battle of Endor.

x: The Ambush at Thila was an event during the Galactic Civil War. During the Infiltration of Kalist VI, Rebel agents provided false information regarding a Rebel base on Thila to the Empire.
Grillis was an asteroid belt located between Korbin and Abatrang in the Atrig system. It was mined by Cross-Galactic Mining.
Kaer was a gas giant in the Siskeen system of the Hunnoverrs sector.
The Lortans were a sentient humanoid species native to Lorta. They were known to be violent and expansionist.
The Emancipator was a CR90 corvette used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the early months of the Galactic Civil War.
The Retribution was a Marauder-class corvette that served the fledgling Corellian Resistance during the early days of the Galactic Civil War.
The Renthal's Fist was a CR90 corvette that served as the flagship of the pirate Drea Renthal.
The Nautical Star was a 30-meter-long Mon Calamari light freighter.
Renthal's Vigilance was a Carrack-class light cruiser in Drea Renthal's pirate fleet. Originally it had been an Imperial ship named Vigilance under Captain Darv Eldon.

Saber 4 was an Imperial Navy TIE/IN interceptor which was manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems. The interceptor was part of the Imperial 181st Imperial Fighter Wing's Saber Squadron by 4 ABY, and piloted by DS-181-4, who served as the wingman of Major Turr Phennir, also from S…

The Retreat at Katraasii was a battle during the Clone Wars that took place on the planet of Katraasii. Clone Commander Jai'galaar embarrassed himself during the retreat from Katraasii, and was demoted to Captain for his actions.

The Starkiller was a freighter used by the bounty hunter Leshy Drobo prior to 20,000 BBY. Drobo and his partner, the assassin droid XT-8, captured the Jedi Knight Roni von Wasaki, on whom a bounty had been placed.
The Mantan Wanderer was a cruiser of Mon Calamari origin, operated by the Rebel Alliance during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.
The Naritus was an aging MC80a Star Cruiser in the New Republic Defense Fleet that served in the Outer Rim Territories as a pirate hunter.
The Mon Delindo was a MC80 Star Cruiser of the New Republic Defense Fleet.
The Maria was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser, and a sister ship of the Liberty, in service to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Sullute was a MC40a Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War. The cruiser was one of several Rebel warships that met in the Delfii system prior to the Battle of Endor. The cruiser's cargo was warheads.
An early battle in the Galactic Civil War led to the destruction of a Rebel monitoring outpost on Ryloth.

The assault on Kashyyyk took place early in the Galactic Civil War on the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk. The forces of the Galactic Empire assaulted the Rebel Alliance monitoring outpost that had been established in secret on the planet.

The Attentive was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The Diadem was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

The Vindictive was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

The FarStar was a CR90 corvette originally known as the Freedom's Messenger that served as a diplomatic ship for the Galactic Republic. After being lost in the Battle of Ord Torrenze, it was recovered by the Imperial Navy and renamed Renegade.

The Habeen were one of two sentient species that were native to the Mylok system. Along with the other species that shared their star system, the Nharwaak, the Habeen jointly designed and produced a new form of hyperdrive technology.
32-19K was an asteroid in the Peragus asteroid field. It almost certainly blew up with the rest of the asteroid field, due to a poorly-aimed shot from the Harbinger.
R2-D6, or Deesix as he was referred to, was an R2-series astromech droid owned by the Rebel Alliance prior to and during the Galactic Civil War.
The Wildebeest was a creature presumably native to the planet Yelsain. They were known to reach heights of 1.5 meters and were generally as wide as they were tall.
IG-153 was an IG-100 MagnaGuard that survived the Clone Wars. During the Galactic Civil War, it fell into the service of Grand Moff 4-8C as a bodyguard.
IG-182 was an IG-100 MagnaGuard that survived the Clone Wars. During the Galactic Civil War, it fell into the service of Grand Moff 4-8C as a bodyguard.

IG-179 was an IG-100 MagnaGuard in the service of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. After the fall of the Galactic Republic, IG-179 would later reappear as chief lieutenant to Iron Knight Luxum.
IG-138 was an IG-100 MagnaGuard who helped General Grievous
The Battle of Tralus was a battle of the Imperial Civil War.

The Martyr was a shuttle used by the Kaleesh warlord Grievous. The gray shuttle had multiple laser cannons and also functioned as a troop carrier, able to accommodate Grievous and all eight members of his elite Izvoshra.

The Battle of Hapes, also known as the defense of the Hapes Cluster, was a battle fought above Hapes during the Yuuzhan Vong War in 27 ABY between the Hapes Consortium, Empire of the Hand and New Jedi Order against the Yuuzhan Vong Empire.
Acheron was a Broadside-class cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

Bel'reen was an Acclamator-class assault ship serving as a frigate in the navy of the Galactic Empire, in service during the Galactic Civil War around the time of the Battle of Yavin.

Enforcer One was an Acclamator-class assault ship serving as a frigate in the navy of the Galactic Empire, in service during the Galactic Civil War around the time of the Battle of Yavin.

The Techrats was a youth swoop gang on the planet Cerea, circa 33 BBY. The group was made up of pro-tech teenagers who favored joining the Republic and abandoning the old, low-tech ways favored by the Elders. They painted their faces to hide their identities.
Fire's Path was an Acclamator-class assault ship serving as a frigate in the navy of the Galactic Empire, in service during the Galactic Civil War around the time of the Battle of Yavin.
The Galactic Guardian was an Acclamator-class assault ship used by the Republic during the Clone Wars, and later by the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Grey Shadow was an Acclamator-class assault ship serving as a frigate in the navy of the Galactic Empire, in service during the Galactic Civil War around the time of the Battle of Yavin.
Harilin was an Acclamator-class assault ship serving as a frigate in the navy of the Galactic Empire, in service during the Galactic Civil War around the time of the Battle of Yavin.

The Majestic was an Acclamator-class assault ship used by the Republic during the Clone Wars and later by the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. It was refitted with heavy armor plating to enhance its defensive capabilities.
Marauder was an Acclamator-class assault ship serving as a frigate in the navy of the Galactic Empire, in service during the Galactic Civil War around the time of the Battle of Yavin.
Odaeon was an Acclamator-class assault ship that served as a frigate in the navy of the Galactic Empire, in service during the Galactic Civil War around the time of the Battle of Yavin.
NK-3 was the designation given to two IG-100 MagnaGuards that operated as the personal bodyguards of the N-K Necrosis droid on Kashyyyk.
The Claw was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser in service with the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The Fireclaw was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser that saw service with the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

The Harpax was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. It was part of the task force that was dispatched to destroy the forces formerly under the command of the defector Admiral Harkov.

The Imperator was a Victory-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy. During the New Republic push to take Coruscant in 6 ABY, intelligence indicated that a Star Destroyer named Imperator was part of the defensive fleet guarding the Galactic capital.
The Red Claw was an Interdictor cruiser in the Imperial Navy.
Divviks were small, gray, and dangerous creatures with multiple eyes and sharp claws that were indigenous to a world in the Outer Rim Territories.
The ranphyx (plural and singular) was a large, feline predator native to the A'driannamieq Mountains of the planet Elom.
An operation was carried out by the Alliance Fleet to prevent the discovery of their base on Hoth.

J1M, pronounced Jaywun-Emm, was a small, prototype roller-treaded maintenance droid.
B3NK was a the navigator/tactical droid onboard Ki-Adi-Mundi's personal starship. He was also known to be very protective of the ship's computer, as well as his fellow crewdroids, especially J1M.

2-ROB was the medical droid aboard Ki-Adi-Mundi's personal starship. Her databanks contained data on over 12 million species. She accompanied Ki-Adi-Mundi when he attempted to rescue his daughter, Sylvn, from the criminal Ephant Mon.
Ananuru City was a city located on the planet Ananuru. It consisted of a spaceport as well as support facilities for the Ananuru Express and was protected from the dangerous planet by a force-dome.
