x: The Battle for the Katana fleet, also known as the Battle of the Katana Fleet, was a significant event in the Thrawn campaign.

Paarin Minor was a planet located in the Cademimu sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A stronghold of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, the planet was the target of an unsuccessful attack by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Knave Squadron was a starfighter squadron that was equipped with E-wing escort starfighters.

The Blue Flame was Jagged Fel's first ship, a Nssis-class Clawcraft that he constantly crashed when he was a cadet at a Chiss military academy in the Rata Nebula. This starfighter was supposedly painted blue to hide its many dents.
Pellastrallas was a planet located in the Pellastrallas system, a part of the Agarix sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim.
A crystal snake was a venomous reptile native to the moon Yavin 4.
The Home was an old Tsukkian water freighter owned by the founding members of Reekeene's Roughnecks. It was later converted into a Rebel base during the Galactic Civil War.

EEK-176 was a B1-series battle droid manufactured to serve in the Trade Federation Droid Army. In 32 BBY, the Trade Federation invaded the planet Naboo, and EEK-176 participated in the initial landing on the world by leading a group of droids to assist command battle droid OOM…
Sovereign was the lead ship of the Sovereign-class Super Star Destroyer line. It was still under construction during the time of the Dark Empire.

Saber 3 was an Imperial Navy TIE/IN interceptor which was manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems. Part of the 181st Imperial Fighter Wing's Saber Squadron by 4 ABY, Saber 3 was piloted by DS-181-3, who flew as the wingman of Saber Squadron's Baron Soontir Fel, watching Fel's back.

YIN-762 was a B1 battle droid who served as a commander in the Droid Army of the Trade Federation. In 32 BBY, YIN-762 was in command of a base outside the city Spinnaker on Naboo during the Trade Federation's invasion of the planet.
Novatroopers, also known as Nova-class Stormtroopers, were a specialized variant of stormtroopers who were assigned to significant locations such as Emperor Palpatine's birthworld of Naboo.

result: Death Star plans obtained by Rebels
x: The Battle of Toprawa was an early battle in the Galactic Civil War in which the Alliance to Restore the Republic captured a large portion of the Death Star plans from the Galactic Empire.

The Battle on Wayland was an early battle in the Galactic Civil War that was part of a greater Alliance operation to obtain four Incom T-65 X-wing starfighter prototypes guarded by Imperial forces stationed on the planet Fresia.

result: Decisive Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
T-65 X-wing starfighters become the Alliance's primary starfighter.
x: The Battle of Fresia was a decisive engagement early in the Galactic Civil War in 1 BBY on the planet Fresia.
The General's Quarters was a large observation chamber situated at the aft section of General Grievous's flagship, Invisible Hand, atop a fin-like spire.
The gumfish was indigenous to the swamps of Naboo, and a favorite meal of the Gungans. While loved by these amphibious peoples, most other species can't abide the bitter-tasting flesh of this fish.
The Quenfis was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that served with the New Republic Defense Fleet.
Pelagia was a New Republic troopship under the command of Captain Tekba during Operation Shadow Hand.
4-8C, or For-Atesee, was an IG-series assassin droid who served as an Imperial Grand Moff and a member of the Imperial Redesign Team during the Galactic Civil War.
The Arkanian jellyfish was a type of aquatic jellyfish native to the frozen planet Arkania.
The Gama-Senn were a sentient, humanoid species from the Gama system. Gama-Senn had two thumbs per hand and flat facial features.
The Outer Rim planet Paarin Minor, a Republic stronghold, was attacked by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars at some point between 22 and 19 BBY.
Agon Nine, originally known as Turallon, was a planet in the Agon system of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Old Guard was a term used within the Jedi Order to describe certain Jedi in the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Members of the Old Guard had been or were considered as members of the Jedi Council.

The Battle of Manari was fought in 19.5 BBY as part of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and an anti-Republic force on the Expansion Region planet Manari. Jedi General Roan Shryne was one of the combatants present, and his second Padawan died during the fighting.
R5-C7 was an R5-series astromech droid. In 22 BBY, the droid was present on the streets of Coruscant as Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker hunted down Zam Wesell.
Enisca was a planet that, along with Sern Prime and Kashyyyk, were considered prime candidates for anti-Imperial rebellion by Mon Mothma.
The Dalliance was a modified Corellian YT-1210 light freighter owned by the New Jedi Order. It was housed at the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4.

Mossak was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium sector, located at the end of the Perlemian Trade Route and at the start of the Tingel Arm. It was located near Felucia and Galidraan. It was part of Xim's Empire.
Jaguada's moon was the sole moon of Jaguada, which was the only inhabited planet in the Jaguada system. The moon possessed a Type I atmosphere, which was breathable by Humans.

The Wodes were an octopedal sentient species native to a planet with a gravitational pull twice that of the galactic standard. When traveling to worlds with lesser gravities, the Wodes took very heavy steps, unaccustomed to their lighter weight.
The Dodonna was an Assault Frigate Mark I in service to the Rebel Alliance and later the New Republic. The vessel was commissioned following the supposed death of Rebel general Jan Dodonna.
Alliance was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
The Autonomy was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
The Endeavor was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Ossus Day was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Its name came from the term Ossus Day, a time of remembrance. The vessel was named in honor of those lost in the Rebellion.
The siege of Koru Neimoidia took place in 19 BBY during the Clone Wars.
The Arbo Maze was a collection of caverns on the Endor forest moon that were so dense and complex that most beings who wandered into it were never seen again.
Dreadnaught-One, called D-One for short, was the first of six Dreadnaught-class heavy cruisers used on Outbound Flight.
Dreadnaught-Two, known as D-Two for short, was the second of six Dreadnaught-class heavy cruisers used on Outbound Flight.
Dreadnaught-Three, known as D-Three for short, was the third of six Dreadnaught-class heavy cruisers used on Outbound Flight.
Dreadnaught-Four, D-Four for short, was the fourth of six Dreadnaught-class heavy cruisers used on Outbound Flight.
Dreadnaught-Five, called D-Five for short, was the fifth of six Dreadnaught-class heavy cruisers used on Outbound Flight.
Dreadnaught-Six, abbreviated to D-Six, was the sixth of six Dreadnaught-class heavy cruisers utilized in the construction of Outbound Flight.
The Majestic Gundark was a YT-1300 light freighter with only slight modifications, including an upper and a lower turret. It was used by the eco-terrorist group Army of Life.

Clodhoppers were omnivorous and dim-witted flightless avians from Naboo. A clodhopper was rarely more than three feet tall, but they fed in swarms, becoming a real menace. They were protected by tough, durable skin.
The Pashvi were a sentient species whose bodies, while largely humanoid, featured a wider torso and/or longer arms than a Human.

The Preparation Center was a Galactic Republic facility on Yaga Minor where the crew of the Outbound Flight trained for two years prior to the launch of the Project in 27 BBY. It was located several kilometers from the Yavvitiri Spaceport.
42-RST, or Rusti, was a translator droid "owned" by Bungo Bung, captain of the SoroSuub freighter Chubby Gundark.
The squill was a large carnivorous creature native to the planet of Tatooine.
The Darkvenge was a Trade Federation Lucrehulk-class battleship under the command of Vicelord Siv Kav.
Ars Opus was a BFF-1 bulk freighter that was carrying R2-series astromech droids to the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Invincible when it apparently broke down in the Rudrig system.
The Maximus was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Along with the Darkvenge, the Keeper was one of the two Lucrehulk-class battleships in the Trade Federation Special Task Force One.
Lightning was a Delta-class DX-9 transport used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Freedom I was a Rebel Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that carried the Alliance ambassador and docked with the Sullustan ambassador's shuttle Sar X at the diplomatic meeting between Sullust and the Alliance to Restore the Republic during Operation Strike Fear.
Tonin ("Little Atton" in an Aldivian dialect) was an R2-series astromech droid owned by Gara Petothel.

Contruum's Pride was a medium-sized transport that saw service with the fleet of Warlord Zsinj. In response to Zsinj's probe of the Pyria system, the New Republic sent Rogue Squadron to attack Vengeance Derra IV, the starship which attempted to breach Borleias' defenses.
Vengeance Derra IV was a Dwarf Star-class freighter modified to serve as a warship under Warlord Zsinj.
The Tyranny was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer stationed at Fresia.
The Khuiumin Survivors were a pirate band associated with Leonia Tavira's Invids.

The Council of Families was the primary legislative body of the Chiss Ascendancy formed from represenatives of the Ruling Families. The Council ensured that each Ruling Family remained on equal footing.

The Senate Support Services, abbreviated to SSS, was a organization that provided technical assistance to the Galactic Senate. As of 27 BBY, Dean Jinzler and Brooks worked for the Senate Support Services.

Gafra was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. During Operation Strike Fear the Gafra collected a new experimental warhead from Celanon and transported it to a deep space transfer zone.

Genue was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Genue was due to travel from the prison planet Mytus VII, aka Stars' End, to Kashyyyk when it was boarded by some escaped Rebel pilots, including Sam Raider and Toalagar.
Toral was an Imperial BFF-1 bulk freighter that bore Wookiee slaves from Kashyyyk to work on the Death Star I. It was guarded by the newly produced Assault Gunboats.

Uhuru was an Imperial BFF-1 bulk freighter bearing supplies as part of a larger convoy that gathered near Orron III en route to the soon-to-be-finished Death Star I. The convoy was due to rendezvous with the freighter Toral, which was attacked on the way by Rebel forces.
Ojai was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Phoenix was a BFF-1 bulk freighter that bore a load of communications satellites, stolen from the Imperial base on Orron III.

Jeffrey was a CR90 corvette in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. It was supplied in the Cron Drift by the Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport Magnus in order to man the AX-235 outpost, and was also delivered some stolen Imperial communications satellites by…
The Xamaural was the Imperial-class Star Destroyer that picked up Darth Vader following the Battle of Yavin.
The battle of Denubba was a battle fought at Denubba during the time of the Galactic Republic. General Maxine Baytor led the Republic forces and thought it was a spectacle later in her life.
The Tulrus Nesting Grounds, also known as the Tulrus Isle, was a landmass on the volcanic planet of Mustafar.
The Infinity was a fast smuggling ship that the Human smuggler BoShek piloted to Tatooine in 0 BBY in order to deliver it to the Mos Eisley "monastery" to change its transponder codes.
The Great Heep was a large, masculine-programmed droid who operated an enormous fuel ore processing plant on the planet Biitu in the early days of the Galactic Empire.
The Dorr Farm was a moisture farm located on the planet Tatooine and owned by Sholh Dorr.
Poe was a protocol droid owned by Grand Duke Gror Pernon. He acted as the Rogue Squadron's diplomatic liaison to the people of Eiattu 6.
Thuvasaurs were carnivorous predators imported to the planet Eiattu 6. The thuvasaur was not a native creature, but was transported to Eiattu specifically for sport.
Thaks were a creature used as traditional transport on Eiattu 6. Plourr Ilo was an excellent Thak rider, having been trained in her childhood.
Hunter was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Sidral II was an Imperial BFF-1 bulk freighter that carried the latest military equipment, timers and fusion cells, originating from a facility near Coruscant.
Falcon was a CR90 corvette in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. The Falcon was involved in the Death Star construction project.
Godar was a CR90 corvette in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The ball creatures of Duroon were spherical, nocturnal herbivores.
The Intergalactic Musicians' Guild was an association of the galaxy's musicians. The Bith Figrin D'an and his band Modal Nodes were members of the Guild.
The River of Light was located on the homeworld of Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn. While there, a thirteen-year-old Jinn obtained a Force-sensitive stone that he kept as a memento for over three decades.
The Starwayman was a freighter stolen by Booster Terrik. Terrik used the starship in his smuggling operations around the time of the Clone Wars.

The capture of Duro occurred in 11 ABY, during Operation Shadow Hand in the Galactic Civil War, when Vice Admiral Gilad Pellaeon led an Imperial fleet to capture the planet Duro from New Republic forces.
The Mugaari were a long lived species of humanoids native to Mugaar in the Bruanii sector. They were heavy-browed and lantern-jawed, with slate-colored skin.
Gymelo was an astronomical object located within the Gymelo system, a part of the Bakura sector within the Outer Rim Territories and Wild Space.
Kammia was a planet in the extremely remote Drynn system, among the sparsely populated Shiritoku Spur of Wild Space. Kammia was a Human colony world of the Galactic Empire, notable for its rich soil.

K'avor was a city located in the Outlands of the remote planet Shiva IV, situated far from the capital of Illyriaqüm. One of the few Human settlements found in that region of the planet, K'avor was destroyed by a Imperial anti-matter bomb in 3 ABY.
Red Wind was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in service with the Imperial Navy.

The Yarin were a sentient species whose appearance resembled that of trees; their limbs were reminiscent of branches, while their skin had a wooden texture. The species was mobile but slow moving. In 24 ABY, a Yarin served as Harbormaster on the Dac resort known as Crystal Reef.
The Dragon Pearl was Jiliac the Hutt's personal starship.

The stalking bird was a species of flightless reptavian predator with long neck and legs native to the planet Alderaan. They were known to flush out their prey by walking together in formation, spearing animals as they fled the grass before them.
Mistress Mnemos was a BRT supercomputer hidden deep within a secret Rebel Alliance stronghold on Fusai.
Ironhand was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer serving in the Starfleet of the Imperial Remnant at least fifteen years after the Battle of Endor.
The Obliterator was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer serving in the starfleet of the Imperial Remnant at least fifteen years after the Battle of Endor.

Oovo was a gas giant located in the Oovo system of the Outer Rim's Tharin sector. It was orbited by an asteroid belt which contained the asteroid Oovo IV, which housed the maximum security prison named Desolation Alley.

result: New Republic victory with the capture of Czethros
x: The Battle of Kessel during the Black Sun insurgency of 24 ABY was part of their plot for galactic domination.
Gibbela was a remote Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Atrivis sector. It was the homeworld of the shapeshifting Dazouri species, members of which engaged in simple farming on Gibbela.
Nihil was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Starfleet.
Tsukkia was a planet located within the Tsukkia system of the Colonies and housed the manufacturer of Tsukkian water freighters.
Firelance was an Imperial EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate.

The Anvil was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The warship collected the evacuees from the destroyed Mon Calamari cruiser Maximus.
Lauhu was a CR90 corvette which served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Op Mus was a BFF-1 bulk freighter that had been assigned to carried food during and after the evacuation of Yavin 4.

Described as a tangle of flesh, the Naplousean walked on three legs and possessed many glittering eyes. It is theorized that when they also relied on pheromones to communicate, evidenced as a dull smell would accompany their anger.
The Gahenna was a modified Confederacy of Independent Systems core ship, which had been outfitted as a science vessel.
Annihilator was the mobile command base of Atha Prime. It resembled two Star Destroyers joined together and was used to launch his Clone Warriors.
Majestic was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that served as Emperor Palpatine's private flagship in the months following the Battle of Hoth.

The Grey Wolf was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer best known as being the temporary flagship of then-Admiral Thrawn during Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's attempted coup against Emperor Palpatine approximately one year before the Battle of Endor.

Resolution was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that served under the overall command of then-Admiral Thrawn during Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's attempted coup against Emperor Palpatine shortly before the Battle of Endor.
Stalwart was a Victory I-class Star Destroyer commanded by Commander Maloc and used by then-Vice Admiral Thrawn as his flagship approximately one year before the Battle of Endor.
R2-D1 was an R2-series astromech droid. Queen Amidala's royal starship held a complement of droids, one of which was R2-D1.
R2-D609, also known as Thirteen, was Kell Tainer's R2-series astromech droid during Wraith Squadron's initial training until the battle with Admiral Apwar Trigit's Implacable over Ession.

Gadget was the astromech droid assigned to Ton Phanan during his service with Wraith Squadron. Gadget remained with Phanan until his X-Wing was destroyed, leaving both pilot and droid without a vehicle.
A voritor lizard was an aggressive, venomous reptilian creature commonly found on Dantooine.
The Juvaini was an Imperial EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate.

LN-26 was Adar Tallon's droid majordomo at his home on Tatooine. She served Tallon with his wife Kay, working alongside the two servants Morr and Cala Wenn. LN-26 had been programmed with a feminine personality and mannerisms.
Nunurra was the only large city on the planet Roon. It also held the Roon Colonial Games.
Shockwave was a Imperial-class Star Destroyer built at Warlord Blitzer Harrsk's secret Deep Core shipyards.
The Alabak's Gold was a modified Mon Calamari Wander-class jump freighter used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Plawal Rift was a valley on the planet Belsavis.
Olovin was a Galactic Alliance Immobilizer 418 cruiser, produced by Sienar Fleet Systems, that accompanied General Wedge Antilles on a feint in the Duro system during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The Fearless was an Acclamator-class assault ship commanded by Commander Gett during the Clone Wars. Jedi General Etain Tur-Mukan served aboard the Fearless briefly in 21 BBY.
Gamma Squad was a clone commando squad of the Grand Army of the Republic. The commandos of Gamma Squad suffered heavy losses at the Battle of Geonosis, with only Stoker surviving.
Bravo Squad was a squad of clone commandos trained by the Mandalorian sergeant Kal Skirata on the planet Kamino to serve in the Special Operations Brigade of the Grand Army of the Republic.
Whirlwind was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer from which Imperial Admiral Blitzer Harrsk led Arrowhead Command until the Battle of Endor.
The Star Morning was a Koqus liner owned by the mysterious Fallanassi sect. It was used to ferry that sect's members from world to world to escape persecution.
Scythe 3 was a modified TIE/ln starfighter that was stationed aboard the second Death Star in 4 ABY as part of Scythe Squadron.
The raid on the Suprosa was a battle in the Galactic Civil War in which the Death Star II plans were secured.
This battle took place at around 3 ABY on and in orbit of the planet Geonosis. The battle occurred in the wake of the abduction of a number of Rebel Alliance scientists from a prison over Bakura.

Raider was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport captured by the Rebel Alliance. During the Rebel food shortage following the evacuation of Yavin 4, Raider participated in a raid on an Imperial grain supply depot based in an asteroid field, as a part of Operation Grain Sna…

Trips was a Rebel BFF-1 bulk freighter that reclaimed D3RM3, the cargo of the stranded freighter Op Mus containing grain vital to the Alliance due to the food shortage following the evacuation of Yavin.

Drugons were fierce underwater predators found on many worlds, including Sulon and Ruusan. Despite their large bulk, drugons were surprisingly fast swimmers, and their powerful jaws could deliver a devastating bite.
Mailocs were flying predators found on a variety of planets, including Sulon, Endor, Ruusan, and Dromund Kaas.

Water cycs were large jellyfish-like predators that floated in the rivers of Sulon, though a similar creature was also found on Dromund Kaas. Never giving pursuit, they lay in wait for their prey, snatching it with their tentacles.
Dinlo was a forest planet in the Dinlo system. It was the site of a rescue mission undertaken by Jedi Knight Etain Tur-Mukan to rescue a thousand clone troopers during the Clone Wars.
The Grand Audience Chamber, also known as the Ceremonial Hall or the Temple throne room, was part of the Great Temple on the jungle moon of Yavin 4.
The Imac was a BFF-1 bulk freighter that spread navigation buoys around an Imperial listening post above Saheelindeel.
Sentinel was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Sarsuma was a Rebel BFF-1 bulk freighter which attempted to steal Imperial supplies from a depot, during the food shortage following the evacuation from Yavin 4.
Taureg was an Imperial BFF-1 bulk freighter that carried water and left the container Psi 1 carrying grain in an Imperial supplies depot.
The Badi Dea was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer active during the Galactic Civil War.

result: Discovery of lab to test Artusian crystals
objective: Investigate Empire Reborn transmissions on Kejim
x: During the Galactic Civil War, Kyle Katarn and Jan Ors went on a mission to the planet Kejim at the behest of the New Republic.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic strategic victory and retreat
x: The Space Battle at Kuat was an operation performed in 1 BBY by Rebel Alliance Captain Raymus Antilles to lure the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Tyranny away from the planet Fresia, where four prototype T-65 X-wing starfighters were being stored.

result: Escape of R2-D2 with the Death Star plans
x: The Battle of Tatooine in the Galactic Civil War was a series of battles and skirmishes in the Tatoo system, primarily on the planet Tatooine, within a few days before the climactic Battle of Yavin. It resulted in the capture of Princess Leia Organa by Darth Vader.
The Dusty Duck was a light freighter designed and utilized by Neeamesh Dym, a Pa'lowick smuggler residing on Nar Shaddaa

The Battle of Kattada, also identified as a firefight on Kattada, took place in 1 BBY, during the time of the Galactic Civil War, and was fought between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic in the planet Kattada's main spaceport of Haleoda.
A mission took place on the planet of Dorlo during the Galactic Civil War.
At some point between 19 BBY and 3 ABY, Savax, War-Master of the Southern Wastes of Uba IV, led a force of so-called True Ubese in a strike against the yrak pootzck Ubese of Ubertica.
3T-RNE was a droid that worked for the Star Tours travel agency. A broken droid, he could be found waiting for R3-D3 and another droid to be repaired.
DL-X2 was a Veril Line Systems DL-series security droid that worked for the Star Tours travel agency. It was stationed in Sector 2 of the Tomorrowland Starport.
G2-4T was a G2 repair droid that worked for the Star Tours travel agency. He claimed G2-4T was short for G2-4TT45579982DWP-40PST, which was just his first name.

G3-5LE was a droid that worked aboard the Star Tours travel agency's Tomorrowland Starport. It was seen near the MSE droid track plugging and unplugging a fuel tube, using a broken MSE unit as a table to rest it on.

ROX-N was a droid owned by the Star Tours travel agency. At the time of the Raid at Spaceport THX1138, the droid was being stored in a shipping crate. Years later, she staffed an information kiosk for the Astroport Interstellar Services section of a starport owned by Star Tours.

SK-Z38 was a Bird Droid found at the Star Tours travel agency. Two of them were befriended by Star Tours droid G2-4T a few months after the Battle of Endor. They usually were located on the droid lifts and other high places, so they could make their nests.
WEG-1618 was a copper-plated droid with yellow photoreceptors. It had the number "1618" printed on either side of its torso, along with a warning label reading "IRRITANT" in High Galactic.
Advanced Jedi Training Droid 6 was a training droid used to referee sparring matches between Jedi younglings. It was in use around 45 BBY.
Moloskians were a species originating within the Moloskia system. They had eyes in the backs of their heads.

Tsyklen were a sentient species native to the planet Tsyk in Hutt Space. The species had exceptional vision and nimble hands of nine digits each. The Tsyklen were considered wily, and the Hutt species saw them as a prized client species.
Colossus was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Starfleet.

Skuumaa was a planet contested during the Clone Wars. Delta Squad traveled there ahead of the main Republic assault in order to sabotage strategic targets and "prepare the battlefield", shortly after their involvement in an anti-terror operation on Coruscant.
Kelarea was a planet located in the Tynna sector of the Expansion Region.

C2-R4 was a multi-purpose droid built by Squibs as a failed project. The barman Wuher found one such droid in a Mos Eisley alley. The droid was previously owned by some Jawas who intended to use him for spare parts, but he was able to escape due to a faulty restraining bolt.

objective: Patrol and safeguard perimeters
x: The mission to the Corellian-Perlemian Hyperspace Intersection took place in 21 BBY, 367 standard days after the First Battle of Geonosis.

result: Sarlacc Battalions A and B rescued
x: A skirmish occurred between the Republic forces and Separatist forces on the planet Dinlo in 22 BBY.
Elite was an Imperial EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate. While in Droma sector, she received the shipment of tainted grain from Overlord Ghorin.

The Leafar were a group involved in merchant shipping based out of the Leafar system. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, they began to challenge the Galactic Empire. The Empire responded by sending the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Badi Dea to attack their shipping convoys.
The Cathleen was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

The blackfish was a relatively common species of fish notable for their small size, black skin, and colored stripes. They could be found on multiple worlds throughout the galaxy, including lush worlds like Naboo and Yavin 4, or even more arid planets like Lok and Tatooine.

Blowfish were a relatively common species of fish notable for their puffiness. They could be found on multiple worlds throughout the galaxy, including lush worlds like Issor and Naboo, or even more arid planet's like Lok and Tatooine.

Bluefish were a relatively common species of fish notable for their small size, and blue colored skin. They could be found on multiple worlds throughout the galaxy, including lush worlds like Naboo and Yavin 4, or even more arid planets like Lok and Tatooine.
Sowsquatch was huge, barely tamed four-legged animal with sharp teeth. Kulltu Kutta rode a sowsquatch during battles in the Cauldron on Rattatak.
Mantoid was a combat droid gladiator in the Cauldron on Rattatak. During the final years of the Old Republic, Mantoid was destroyed by gladiator Grunda Dolma in close combat.

The Masanya was a CR90 corvette manufactured by the Corellian Engineering Corporation that was used by the fleet of the Rebel Alliance as a light escort vessel. It was modified with a hangar for small vessels and equipped with missile-jamming target-disruption scanners.
Niven was a Rebel BFF-1 bulk freighter that supplied the makeshift B-wing assembly area before its destruction by Imperial forces.
Relentless was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Rian was the capital city of Frego. Its buildings used a higher frequency of turbolifts than most worlds in the galaxy.
King's Galquek, sometimes referred to as Kay-Gee or K-G, was a planet located in the Meridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Drach'nam were a sentient reptilian alien race from La'drach that was known more for size and strength than intelligence. They had three fingers on each hand and three toes on each foot. Drach'nam had pale, pinkish blood.
Radnorans were the native inhabitants of the planet Radnor. Although they were fairly short in stature and sturdy in appearance, they were an intimidating humanoid species.
The Subjugation of Geonosis was an early battle in the Galactic Civil War.
Borga was a terrestrial astronomical object that featured swamps and was located in the Borga system, a part of the Yminis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Battle of Althir was a naval battle that occurred at the planet Althir III, the first battle of the Mandalorian Wars before the invasion of the Galactic Republic, as the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders under the leadership of Mandalore the Ultimate conquered worlds just outside …
The Battle of Althir—the second battle to bear that name—was one of the last battles of the Mandalorian Wars.
Plett's Well, also called Plettwell or Plawal, was a community on the planet Belsavis.

Fury was a Nebulon-B frigate of the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. The frigate attempted to stop Yali and Maria on their way to Hoth. She was destroyed in that attempt by combined efforts of fleets and Red Squadron's B-wings.

After the destruction of Relentless, Operation Blunt Stick was a brief operation led by Keyan Farlander to destroy an Imperial listening probe in a minefield, in order to allow the Rebel fleet to migrate to Hoth unnoticed.
Yali was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

The blockade of Zolan occurred during the Imperial Era. After the rise of the Galactic Empire, the Imperial Military blockaded the planet Zolan, homeworld of the Zolanders and the shape-shifting Clawdites.
Operation: Elrood was an Imperial military action designed at taking control of the entire Elrood sector, in addition to the interdicted space that lay between planets Derilyn and Berea.

Dotermin was an Imperial BFF-1 bulk freighter that was destroyed by Rebel forces while resupplying the Relentless Star Destroyer with TIE fighters. This occurred during the Empire's attempt to destroy Rebel B-wing production in the lead-up to the Battle of Hoth.

Operation: Shadowstrike was a mission put together by the Rebel Alliance to retrieve the Y-wing pilot Kala Kevv (codenamed Prodigal-One) and his datacard (codenamed Prodigal-Two) on the unexplored planet NCW-781.
Ironwall was one of seven major Kentran cities on Orellon II. Lord Grumman Mogotah was the city's ruler.
The Jedi Temple Apprentice Tournament was a competition held annually at the Coruscant Jedi Temple during the reign of the Galactic Republic.
The Bloodboilers of Kragis was an organization from the Expansion Region's Kragis system. At some point by 20 BBY, it attempted to kill the Gen'Dai bounty hunter Durge.
The saw-toothed grank was a carnivore native to the Gungan Swamps of Naboo.

Suurja was an agrarian planet with a breathable atmosphere that was located within the Suurja system of the Outer Rim Territories and harbored both a native species called Suurjans and a colonist population of 16 million.
The Junavex Hotel was a hotel in the Middle City of Taris that had opened by the time of the Great Sith War.
The Stockade was a Trade Federation Lucrehulk-class battleship.
The Cuis clones were six prototype clone stormtroopers, bred from the genome of Sa Cuis, a Dark Jedi who served as one of Emperor Palpatine's personal assassins.
Bright Flight was a Sprint-class rescue craft used by the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Several bacta tanks were installed aboard.
The Battle of the Llon Nebulae was a battle in the Clone Wars.

result: Escape of Independence, Liberty and Defiance
x: The Subjugation of Mon Calamari was one of the first battles fought by the new Galactic Empire. It resulted in the enslavement of the Mon Calamari and Quarren for nearly two decades, until both races united to throw the Empire offworld.
Ruhe was a planet that was allied with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Dooku maintained a citadel on Ruhe, situated on the edge of a massive volcanic or meteoric crater.

The Calamarian Revolt, also known as the Great Revolt, was the uprising in 1 BBY which saw the Mon Calamari species rise up against the Galactic Empire who had been occupying their homeworld for nearly two decades and drove the Empire offworld.

The Conference of Uncommitted Worlds (0 ABY), held on Kabal just after the Battle of Yavin, was a gathering where Princess Leia Organa secured a commitment by Silver Fyre to aid the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The Raptors were the elite soldiers formed by Warlord Zsinj to serve his empire.
The Battle of Thila was a conflict in 0 ABY during the Galactic Civil War, during which the Rebel base on Thila was destroyed.
Highroller was a SoroSuub Corporation Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 owned by K'Armyn Viraxo.
Scherkil Hlas were squat birds used by the Yuuzhan Vong. Flightless, they were a source of protein.
The Battle of Kashyyyk was a large raid by the forces of the Second Imperium on Thikkiiana City on Kashyyyk in 23 ABY during the Second Imperium Crisis.

After a destructive groundquake destroyed the planet Ord Thoden's capital city of Domitree in 23 BBY, a crew of Jedi rescue workers found an infant Force-sensitive girl named Ludi Billane alive in the wreckage and assuming she was an orphan, took her to Coruscant for training.
The People's Inquest was a grassroots populist Jedi-accountability watch-group active before and during the Clone Wars.
Rage was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Starfleet.
Anti-troopers were clone troopers from the last production line based solely on the genetic template of Jango Fett. Their armor and weapons dated back to the time of the Grand Army of the Republic.

The Compellor was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser in the Imperial Navy under the command of Captain Rigell. It was stolen by members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, who removed its gravity well projectors and then scuttled the ship.
The Qektoth Confederation was an organization whose members had decided to abandon inanimate technology in favor of biological technology.

Cutlass was an Imperial CR90 corvette. It was destroyed while stationed in the System Patrol Squadron above Farfeld II by a Rebel attack force consisting of three B-wing starfighters, one of them piloted by Keyan Farlander.
Libom was an Imperial BFF-1 bulk freighter that carried surveillance probes in the cargo transfer area above the planet Bofa II.
Manufactured by the craftsman of Lovolan, the R-10 household droid was the perfect waiter and beverage-server, but it was expensive and normally only bought by the rich.
Bardictol was a Habassan Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport that carried the Habassan envoy to the Independence in order to attain a diplomatic meeting with the Rebel Alliance
Riptide was an Imperial Nebulon-B frigate. Riptide, along with her sister ship Havok attempted to destroy the Rebel Alliance cruiser Independence during negotiations with the Habassa delegates.

result: Route of the next smuggler ship learned
objective: Locate ISO building and interpret nava card
x: The Mission to Coruscant was a mission in the Galactic Civil War. When Kyle Katarn obtained a nava card from the Star Jewel, Jan Ors told him that only the Imperial Security Operations building in the Imperial City hosted a reader that could interpret it.

conflict: Clone Wars (Rise of the Cortosis Battle Droids)
result: Dooku recovers at least one Sith holocron
x: The Coruscant Insurrection, sometimes referred to as the Invasion of Coruscant, was a battle in the Clone Wars that took place in 20 BBY.
Akaga was an Imperial EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate under command of Admiral Harkov during the Galactic Civil War.
Kiilimaar was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.

Cielo was a BFF-1 bulk freighter escorted by the CR90 corvette Wasp. It was part of an Alliance to Restore the Republic convoy after Operation Grain Snatch still looking for a site for a new base, but was endangered by Red Wind.
The Namu was a BFF-1 bulk freighter of the Rebel Alliance fleet escorted by the Corellian Corvettes Orca.
The Crystal was a heavily modified Z-95 Headhunter owned and piloted by Jaina Solo.
The Hurrim were an Outer Rim based pirating group, led by Golov Nakhym, which had a mutual agreement with Dunari and the Rebellion in 3 ABY until an incident in the Nezni system.
The Trickster, originally the Ksstarr, was a Yuuzhan Vong frigate analog renamed in the latter half of the Yuuzhan Vong War. It held three scourges of warriors.
The Otta was a small, mammalian predator native to the Gungan swamps of Naboo.

The nyork was a small, hard-shelled, carnivorous clam native to the swamps of Naboo. They "nipped" with their mouths located inside their shells, and would jump out of the water at whatever seemed to be prey to them.
Destreg II was a planet in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector of the Outer Rim.
The Excalibur was Emperor Palpatine's personal C-3 passenger liner, which he used during the Galactic Civil War.
The Peregrine was originally a Strike-class medium cruiser in the Rebel Alliance fleet sent to the Airam sector.
The muudabok was a swamp herbivore native to the Gungan swamps of Naboo.
Kouerd 1 was a IPV-1 System Patrol Craft employed to protect Harlequin Station.

Members of a species of flying flower creatures lived on the Floating Mountain on the Forest Moon of Endor. While at first they could be mistaken for simple plants, the creatures were actually capable of communicating with other beings.
The Ravenno was a Mesens Corporation SCT Scout Craft in the possession of the Loose Cannon pirate gang.
Kobbahn was an Outer Rim planet near the border of the Unknown Regions. It was the location of one of the earliest Rebel cells in the days following the declaration of the New Order.
Hive rats, also known as mutant hive rats, coruscani rats or simply mutant rats, were enormous, nearly hairless, rapacious rodents who inhabited the sewers and lowest levels of Coruscant.
The Battle of AX-456 was a battle during the Galactic Civil War.

conflict: Hunt for Zsinj, Galactic Civil War
x: A battle at Jussafet Four was an engagement between the New Republic fleet under the command of Han Solo and Warlord Zsinj's planetary invasion force, the Raptors.

Serpent's Smile was a Victory-class Star Destroyer in the service of Warlord Zsinj, a former Imperial admiral who forged his own empire following the Battle of Endor and the disintegration of the Imperial Starfleet.
The Millennium Falsehood was a modified YT-1300 light freighter.
Nebula Queen was a cruise liner owned by Event Vistas.

Milko was a droid bounty hunter that tried to capture Luke Skywalker on Dagobah. The droid originally threatened to kill Luke, but eventually put down his weapons and begged for mercy after Luke turned the tide with his lightsaber.
A-3PO was a silver protocol droid that was owned by Retter Lewis aboard the Cal Ambre and was an assistant and translator at Callia's.
Four-Onebee was the medical droid that Captain Ixsthmus used aboard the starship Long Shot.
The Black Eight Squadron was an elite Imperial military unit composed of pilots who were highly trained in flying TIE/LN starfighters and TIE/sa bombers for the Imperial Navy.
The Harpago was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser in the use of Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin during his betrayal and attempted capture of Emperor Palpatine.
The Vorknkx was a CR90 corvette in the service of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Worrites were a sentient species of crustacean–insectoid hybrids from an unknown part of the galaxy. As tall as Wookiees, their anatomy was dominated by a knobby, protective carapace.
Bruise-leech crawlers, alternatively known as Nelvaan bruise-leech crawlers, were leech-like creatures native to the Outer Rim planet of Nelvaan.

climate: Cold and icy (during Techno Union invasion)
Warm (before and after Techno Union invasion)
x: Rokrul was a village on the planet Nelvaan in the Outer Rim Territories' Koobi system. It was built within an indentation on the side of a cliff and was populated by the local Nelvaanians.
The Twirrl was a carnivorous, mammalian falconoid species, native to Naboo.

The Battle of Pesitiin was a skirmish during the Caamas Document Crisis, orchestrated by Moff Vilim Disra to thwart Admiral Gilad Pellaeon's planned peace negotiations with the New Republic, fought between Pellaeon's flagship Chimaera and several ships of the Cavrilhu Pirates,…

Challat eaters were vicious, swarming predators found on Troiken. They preyed upon the native Xexto population; they were carnivorous and devoured the flesh of anything they came into contact with. Challat eaters were small in size and glowed bright blue.
The Buzzzer was the Series IV picket ship flagship of the Bonestar Pirate Loka Hask, named after an insect from Eiattu 6.

result: Rebel Alliance entire Bothan High Command killed
x: During the Yavin blockade in 0 ABY, the 501st Legion retaliated for the destruction of the first Death Star.
Shaupauts, also spelled shaupats, were carnivorous marsupials that were native to the Gungan swamps of Naboo. A large variety was the greater shaupaut.

result: Galactic Republic victory; package recovered and Trandoshan bounty hun
Both clone commando squads killed, save for Sarge
objective: Recover stolen package from Trandoshan bounty hunters
x: The mission to Ord Mantell was a mission undertaken by two squads of the Grand Army of the Republic's clone commandos to the Mid Rim world of Ord Mantell, during the first year of the Clone Wars.

A squad of clone commandos was an elite special forces unit within the Grand Army of the Republic that operated during the Clone Wars. Comprised of four clones of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett, the squad was led by Sarge.

conflict: Clone Wars (Mygeeto theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: The Battle of Garqi took place near the end of the Clone Wars.
A squad of clone commandos was an elite special forces unit within the Grand Army of the Republic that operated during the Clone Wars.
Sorrusians were a Near-Human species from the planet Sorrus. They differed from baseline Humans in that their skeletal system could compress, allowing them to squeeze through tight places.

The Mersel Kebir was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served as the flagship of the Rendili Home Defense Fleet. At the time of the Clone Wars, it was under the command of Captain Jace Dallin. Other officers included Lieutenant Mellor Yago, and Gallan.
The Raptor was the flagship of the Stark Commercial Combine.
Gilgam was a MandalMotors Pursuer-class enforcement ship employed by K'Armyn Viraxo in a mercenary role to intimidate business rivals and defend Viraxo interests against pirates.
Iritsa was the capital city of the planet Chazwa.
The Mission to Bothawui was a skirmish during the Galactic Civil War.
The sand bat was an animal native to the desert planet of Tatooine. The Tusken Raiders used its venom as a weapon to kill Krayt dragons during rites of passage.
The Abolisher was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

The Siege of Ank Ki'Shor occurred early in the Galactic Civil War. The industrial planet Ank Ki'Shor was targeted by the Galactic Empire because it was a key supplier to the Alliance to Restore the Republic in its formative years.
The Battle of Vnas was a battle in the early Galactic Civil War which was waged at the planet Duro. Having tried to free the planet from Imperial rule, the Rebel Alliance was defeated.

Blackmoon Squadron was a starfighter unit in service to the New Republic and later the Galactic Alliance during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Blackmoon Squadron was made up of E-wing escort starfighters, and crewmembers reshuffled from Green Squadron.
The assault on Dalron IV took place during the Imperial Period. The battle was fought between the Galactic Empire and the planet's civilians.

The Siege of Dalron Five took place during the Imperial Era. The Galactic Empire laid siege to Dalron Five using techniques that had been developed by Jan Dodonna. The Empire managed to conquer the world after a devastating siege, forcing its people to flee and live as refugees.
The Battle of Skorrupon was a battle fought against the Galactic Empire on Skorrupon.
The pacification of Praadost II was a battle of the Nembus Sector campaign, early in the Imperial Period. Rebel forces on Praadost II were defeated by the Galactic Empire.
Arrow was a group of three CR90 corvettes in the Alliance Fleet. They were the third group of a three-wave corvette attack on the Imperial EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Red Wind.
Agility was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The Formidable was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser in the service of the Galactic Empire.

The Geonosis droid foundries boardroom was a room located in the Geonosis droid foundries. It was there where Count Dooku urged the Commerce Guild and Corporate Alliance to sign a treaty with the Confederacy of Independent Systems and to pledge their droid armies to them.
3B6-RA-7, nicknamed "Threebee," was a personal-assistant droid that worked as a spy, care-giver, and farmhand, serving masters as diverse as Moff Dunhausen and the moisture farmer Sholh Dorr.

The Spoilt Sport was the personal yacht of Simon Greyshade, the administrator of the casino space station known as the Wheel. Flashy and expensive, the Spoilt Sport was kept aboard the station and was linked into the Wheel's communications array.
The duracrete worm was a large silica parasite which was found on the planet Coruscant.
The shadow barnacle was a silica parasite living on the planet Coruscant.

The Quicksilver was a private starship owned by Iaco Stark at the time of the Stark Hyperspace War. During the war, it was hijacked by Jedi Master Adi Gallia, who used it to transport Minister Nute Gunray and Senator Finis Valorum back to Coruscant from Troiken.
The Invincible was a Republic light assault cruiser, the command ship of Ranulph Tarkin and the flagship of his fleet. Besides Tarkin, its crew included Antidar Williams and Jace Dallin.

Armx was a modified MerenData RM-2020 espionage droid turned bounty hunter known for his poetry, who often wrote epitaphs for his acquisitions. On one occasion he wrote such an epitaph about his capture of the target Gavron Noff.
The Vendetta was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser serving in the forces of the Galactic Empire.
The Tropsobor was an Ton-Falk-class escort carrier that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The Warhawk was a Mon Calamari MC40a light cruiser owned and operated by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Dimeans were a tall sentient species from the Dimea system, known for their nasty disposition. Many years before the Mandalorian Wars, they were ruled by an overlord named Kraat.

Mine crabs were small but dangerous scavengers who lived within the subterranean levels of Artus Prime. They did not resemble crabs in the traditional sense, though they scuttled about on three crablike legs.

Howlers were predators which lived on the moon Yavin 4. They got their name from their method of attack, which was a howl loud enough to stun their prey. Howlers were somewhat reptilian in appearance.

The Eyttyrmin Batiiv, also known as the Eyttyrmin Pirates, was a pirate group that emerged shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire. They were fairly successful for some time, until the Empire crushed them at the Battle of Khuiumin.
This pleasure cruiser was a civilian luxury craft piloted by Captain Quasar.
The Foxcatch was a heavily modified Lambda-class T-4a shuttle owned by Jodo Kast. Its tail was emblazoned with Kast's personal emblem.
Treadwell was a WED 15 "Septoid 2" Treadwell droid who served the Millennium Falcon. Treadwell was acquired by Han Solo three years before the Battle of Hoth.

objective: Destroy the terrorist network
x: The Mission to Coruscant was a Galactic Republic sting operation to root out a terrorist cell that had been plaguing the GAR.

Farboon was a planet that appeared green-blue from space. It was the site where Maarek Stele, a TIE/LN starfighter pilot, rescued Imperial Admiral Mordon's shuttle from a Rebel attack of X-wing and Y-wing fighters.

Fwatna was a planet in the Subterrel sector near the site where Lando Calrissian found the abandoned freighter Spicy Lady. The ship belonged to his smuggling associate Jarril. This also led to the discovery of Dolph.

Glakka was an ice-covered moon in the Outer Rim Territories where Jabba the Hutt had a gun-running operation along with Chevin criminal Ephant Mon. The two tried to steal an Imperial weapons cache, but were ambushed by an Imperial squad.

Grakouine was a world on which an Alliance to Restore the Republic storage depot was located. It was here that Boba Fett's ship Slave I was impounded by the New Republic after he was presumed killed by the Sarlacc on Tatooine.
Hast was a planet in Wild Space of the galaxy. It was the site of a secret New Republic shipyard that came under Imperial attack.
This scout ship was a craft used by the Rebel Alliance for reconnaissance missions.

This small space cruiser was used by the Rebel Alliance for general transportation. Princess Leia Organa used this cruiser to leave Yavin 4 in search of Luke Skywalker, who had gone missing while searching for a new location for the Rebel base and was eventually captured by Cr…

Proctors was a youth movement used by the Empire Reborn between 13 to 14 ABY. They were mainly composed of Force-sensitive male adolescents recruited by the Imperial Procurator of Justice Hethrir at his base of operations on his private Worldcraft.
Veubgri (Veubg for singular form) were an insectoid species native to the high-gravity world of Gbu in the Outer Rim. They were tall six-legged beings, with tendrils for arms.
Palpatine's transport was the starship in which Supreme Chancellor Palpatine came to Nar Shaddaa to transport Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker home to Coruscant after Anakin killed Krayn.
Ihopek was a planet evacuated by Imperials after the Battle of Endor, along with Narth. While they were being evacuated, the Star Destroyer Gnisnal was demolished by internal explosions.
Janodral Mizar was a planet in Outer Rim Territories in the Indrexu sector.
A two-seater Rho-1 Limulus-class courier took Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to Ilum, and was a design commonly used by the Jedi.

Shiner was an R2-series astromech droid assigned to New Republic pilot Myn Donos. Shiner served with Donos in Talon Squadron until the unit's destruction at Gravan Seven, and then went with him to the newly formed Wraith Squadron.
Klaymor 4-2 was the moon where an Imperial reconnaissance mission discovered a Rebel Alliance spy probe. A single TIE/LN starfighter was dispatched to destroy the probe.
Liok was a planet in Ciutric sector in Outer Rim Territories, where archaeologists discovered the Shadow Traproom, one of the greatest finds of the modern era.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: The Ord Mantell Fighter Wing was a New Republic fighter wing assigned to protect Ord Mantell during the Thrawn campaign. Consisting of X-wing starfighters, the wing was based in a space defense base on the world's southern hemisphere.

Narth was a planet evacuated along with Ihopek after the Battle of Endor by the Galactic Empire. The Star Destroyer Gnisnal was crippled by internal explosions and had to be scuttled. The wreckage later gave the New Republic the complete copy of the Imperial Order of battle.
Nichen was a planet found in the Outer Rim Territories. Kettemoor jumped to this location after its encounter with the Teljkon Vagabond.
Notak was an Imperial stronghold throughout the Galactic Civil War. The planet fell eight months after the Battle of Endor.
Omar was a planet located in the system of the same name.
Sand burrowers were carnivorous worms native to the planet Blenjeel.

The Kashyyyk slash-spider was a species of arachnid native to the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk. The scissors-like mandibles of the spider provided the name for the slip-jaws, a maneuver that was utilized in starfighter combat.

Hettsk was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Belsmuth sector. In 9 ABY, the confederation of the Galactic Empire's forces led by Grand Admiral Thrawn was victorious over the New Republic in a large-scale battle fought on Hettsk.

result: Galactic Federation of Free Alliances victory
x: A battle at the planet Corulag occurred in 29 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War. It was a major victory for the Galactic Alliance and provided the new government with control of a key hyperspace route to Yuuzhan Vong-occupied Coruscant.
Otranto was the base of the Church of the First Frequency. It was ordered to be closed by Imperial Grand Inquisitor Laddinare Torbin.
The Resolve was a capital ship of the New Republic Fifth Fleet, variously described as a Star Destroyer, or as a star cruiser.

Peridon's Folly was a weapons depot that was operated by traders who sold obsolete arms to crime lords. Sectors were controlled by gunrunners and were separated by wastelands where the weapons were tested. IG-88B collected his first bounty there.
The RavinsBlud Crime Syndicate was a deadly criminal organization known to have been on Malastare or Hok. It consisted mainly of Gran members, such as Byhdee Kees and Jaw-knee Rise.

objective: Locate information on Chief scientist Ko Sai
x: The Mission to Kamino was an unofficial operation, ordered by Kal Skirata and carried out by Null ARC lieutenant Mereel to locate the missing Kaminoan Chief scientist Ko Sai.

The Galactic Republic General Ministry was the permanent bureaucracy of the Galactic Republic. It had several responsibilities including supervising and providing financing for the General Ministry Institutes, managing the General Ministry Communications Agency, and, during th…

Mod-3 was an R2-series astromech droid owned by Vana Sage during her time working for the Trade Federation prior to the Battle of Naboo. He served as Sage's co-pilot and in-flight astromech aboard her starship, the Guardian Mantis.
1138 was a CR90 corvette, serving in the Imperial Navy as part of Task Force Vengeance.

Shadow Chaser was a unique shuttle produced by the Second Imperium, for use by the Shadow Academy. Though she was a unique prototype, the Shadow Chaser was of a recognizably Imperial design, probably standing in the same lineage as the Theta-class and Lambda-class shuttles.

Vape was the personal R2 unit of New Republic pilot/commando Garik 'Face' Loran. Early into Loran's tenure in Wraith Squadron he persuaded Cubber Daine, the squadron mechanic, to make some modifications to the droid.
The Kedorzhans were a rotund, rodent-like species—native to Kedorzha in Senex-Juvex—who operated mines in SoroSuub Landing on the planet Taris in the years prior to its devastation by Darth Malak.

The Deluvian fatworm was a type of worm that hailed from the Deluvia system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Klina sector that was situated close to Hutt Space. It led a parasitic lifestyle, attaching itself to the back of members of the sentient Hutt species.
Petrakis was the site of the first engagement between Rebel Alliance B-wing starfighters and Imperial forces.
Plah was a lifeless moon that orbited the planet Tibrin.
Praidaw was the planet where the Fallanassi parents of Akanah first met.

The Dawn Beat was one of the many starships that worked for and participated in Talon Karrde's vast and varied smuggling operations. The ship was a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YZ-775 light freighter.

The Amanda Fallow was one of the many starships that worked for and participated in Talon Karrde's vast and varied smuggling operations. The ship was a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YZ-775 medium transport.

Ryloon was Outer Rim Territories planet in Velcar sector, Ryloon systemand the site of several Imperial Remnant controlled orbital factories where captured prisoners were sent to work. The world remained part of the Remnant following its peace agreement with the New Republic.
Ryvellia was a planet located in the Avhn-Bendara system. Its capital city, V'eldalv, was the site of a brutal uprising that was crushed by the Galactic Empire via orbital bombardment.

Shalam was an Inner Rim planet that was home to the Shalamite cultural group. It was subjected to a bombardment by the Galactic Empire Star Destroyer Emperor's Disciple and had become a part of the New Republic by 12 ABY.

Triton Squad was originally a Republic military unit that consisted of nine clone troopers, including a clone commander. The squad survived the galactic conflict known as the Clone Wars and became an Imperial unit under the Republic's successor state, the Galactic Empire.
Shimmer was a planet located in the Rayter sector.

The Goshyn Queen, a modified Kuat Drive Yards Space Master medium transport, was the flagship of the smuggler Billey. It was named for the Goshyn Detention Center, where Billey had served time prior to buying the ship.
Old Town was a town on the planet Centares.
The Lulsla was a Rebel Alliance MC40a Light Calamari Cruiser.
The Starsider was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser in service to the New Republic and later the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances.
A Core Worlds astronomical object, Thomork was the site of an Imperial Military shipyard. Shortly before the Battle of Endor, the facility produced Imperial-class Star Destroyers.
Thrugii was a planet located within the Thrugii system of the Outer Rim Territories. A desolate, rocky planet near an asteroid field, it has been the home of many failed miners.
Tiragga was a planet of the Tiragga system, in the Mieru'kar sector, located within the Outer Rim of the galaxy. The planet was orbited by at least two moons.
Tirsa was an industrial planet located within the Tirsa system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the Tirsa Wargear armaments company that manufactured the Leviathan submersible carrier.

Trosh was a planet located within the Trosh system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was one of many planets where the Galactic Empire enslaved the native people, claiming that it was protecting the rights of the inhabitants.
Tuulab was the second planet in the Triitus system of the Corva sector.
Vinzen Neela 5 was an astronomical object located within the Vinzen Neela system of the Outer Rim Territories' Parmic sector.

Vizcarra was a Galactic Empire prison planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Cegul sector. The Wookiee Syychi, who went on to be enslaved by the Empire, was born there, and at one point she and the smuggler Memcha-Badawzi—who was sentenced to imprisonment on Vizcarra—bot…

Vob was a gas giant–type planet located in the Vob system, a part of the Ktilac Regions sector in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim. It was famous for its perpetual atmospheric storms, which constituted a natural wonder.

Sungwas were massive, doglike pack scavengers native to the bog moon of Bogden. Resembling a nightmarish cross of wolf and weasel, they were quadrupedal creatures with yellow skin covered in golden fur and a pair of red eyes.
The Langhesi were a race of red-skinned humanoids indigenous to the planet Langhesa, presumably in the Langhesa system. The Langhesi could mold and shape life into new forms. They spoke Langhesan.

The Lastri's Ort was one of the starships in Talon Karrde's smuggling operation. It was a 300 meter long Kuat Drive Yards Star Galleon-class frigate, and as such was the largest and best-armed ship in Karrde's fleet.

The Raptor was one of the two SoroSuub Preybird-class starfighters owned by the smuggler Mazzic. The Raptor was painted with distinctive red bird of prey designs, while its companion Skyclaw had a similar blue scheme.

The Skyclaw was one of the two SoroSuub Preybird-class starfighters owned by the smuggler Mazzic. The Skyclaw was painted with distinctive blue bird of prey designs, while its companion Raptor had a similar, red scheme.
The Kern's Pride, a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation CR90 corvette, was the flagship of the smuggler Samuel Tomas Gillespee.

The Lady Sunfire, a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation Barloz-class freighter, was the personal ship of of the smuggler Clyngunn the ZeHethbra. It was armed with three quad turbolaser cannons and four aft-firing concussion missile launchers.
The Moonshadow was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer operated by the New Republic Defense Force during the Galactic Civil War.

The Distant Rainbow, a modified Kuat Drive Yards Starwind-class pleasure yacht, was the flagship of of the smuggler chief Mazzic. Mazzic bought the ship at a bargain price from a retired Rodian smuggler.
Viper wasps were indigenous to Yavin 4. These stinging insects lived inside of vines and would swarm if disturbed.
Pulga were a type of creature native to the forest moon Endor. The sentient Ewoks also native to the moon would sometimes ride pulga.
Gaupa were a type of creature native to the forest moon Endor. The sentient Ewoks also native to the moon would sometimes ride gaupa.
Palme du Tigre was a planet with a wide variety of terrain, which included jungles, deserts, plains, mountains, and seas.

The Palmiens du Tigre, or simply Palmiens, were humanoids indigenous to the planet Palme du Tigre. The Palmiens had a pre-spatial technology level. They were apparently wiped out as the last test of a stormtrooper training program.

Karlatt was the homeworld of the Morses, a species with a spatial level of technology. It was the first planet in the Karlatt system. It had a temperate climate and moderate precipitation. Its local days lasted 19 hours, and 520 local days made a local year.
Yasla was one of two planets in the Karlatt system terraformed by the Machinist Theocracy that served as home to ultra-wealthy Morses. It was in the Karlatt system of the Galactic Core.
Ymura was one of two planets in the Karlatt system terraformed by the Machinist Theocracy that served as home to ultra-wealthy Morses. It was in the Karlatt system of the Galactic Core.

The Healing Star was a hospital ship in the Galactic Alliance Defense Force during the Swarm War. Accompanying the Megador to Tenupe at the end of the war, it was staffed by only droids, all part of a ruse by Grand Master Luke Skywalker to eliminate Lomi Plo.
