The Five Families of Cestus Cybernetics successfully eliminated
objective: Halt production of JK-13 security droids
x: The Mission to Ord Cestus was an operation by the Galactic Republic to cease the production of JK-13 "Jedi Killer" droids that were to be sold to the CIS and represented a threat to the survival of the Jedi Order.
The Sungrass was a Xiytiar-class heavy transport used by Wraith Squadron during their time posing as the Hawk-bat Independent Space Force in the Halmad system.

objective: Escape from Castle Ventress
x: The Escape from Rattatak was the escape of Obi-Wan Kenobi and the ARC clone trooper Alpha-17 from Asajj Ventress's citadel of Rattatak. Ventress tormented Obi-Wan with muscle maggots and a Sith torture mask.

Provocateur was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in the service of Warlord Zsinj, commanded by Captain Joshi. In 7 ABY it was part of a task force lured into a trap by New Republic forces in the Morobe system.

The Upland Liberation Front (or the ULF) was a name created by Depa Billaba during the Clone Wars. She did this to represent the groups of Korunnai raiding the Balawai on Haruun Kal during the Summertime War.
The Hig were a slender, blue-colored sentient species. The Hig Ginbotham served aboard the Yavin under Wedge Antilles' command, and saw action against the forces of the terrorist Kueller at Almania.

Hrasskis were a sentient race from the planet of Hrasskis. They were distinguished by large, veined air sacs on their backs; they were represented in the New Republic Senate by the belligerent Senator Cian Marook.
The Letaki were a species of sentient beings distinguished by eight tentacles, an egg-shaped head, four eyes, and a sharp beak. Two sets of gills allowed them to breathe in both air and water.

The Nartians were a sentient species of short, four-armed beings. Native to the planet Nars in the Senex sector, they were frequently employed as household servants for the nobles of the region, sometimes serving the same noble family for generations.
Oodocs were a sentient species known for their great size and strength but not their intelligence. They had spiked arms and backs and massive torsos.

objective: Disable Separatist Phrik factory
x: The Galactic Republic undertook a raid on Fest against Confederacy of Independent Systems' phrik refining factory on the Outer Rim Territories planet Fest.
The Crystal Valley was an area on the planet Monastery where large crystal spires would grow from the ground at dangerous speeds.

The Vesuvague tree, also known as the Vesuvague Hanging Tree, was a carnivorous, semi-sentient, red-barked tree from the planet of Ithor. It was one of a number of intelligent plants from the world, a category of which included the Bafforr tree.
Swift Liberty was a New Republic Victory II-class Star Destroyer commanded by Admiral Areta Bell and was often paired with the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Moonshadow.
Selonian Fire was a New Republic Victory I-class Star Destroyer that participated in the Battle of Ciutric, which occurred in 9 ABY, under the command of General Garm Bel Iblis.
Gauntlet, later renamed Corusca Fire, was a Victory I-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Imperial Navy and the New Republic.
The Siege of Otoh Gunga was a raid attempted by the Trade Federation on the underwater Gungan cities of Naboo in the Invasion of Naboo.
The Kalmec was a criminal organization formed by members of the Wookiee species that operated on the planet of Ralltiir during the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Draigons were an avian species native to an unknown watery planet between Bandomeer and Coruscant. They ate fish from the oceans of their world, although this did not make up their diet entirely.

conflict: Hunt for Zsinj, Galactic Civil War
x: The Battle of Levian Two was a trap set by Warlord Zsinj for Mon Remonda following the loss of Razor's Kiss to General Han Solo's forces. Zsinj planted evidence of Raptor activity on the planet as a lure for his opponent.
Smoke Demons were a dark side manifestation that could be summoned through Sith sorcery. They could metamorphose into their targets' worst fears and sought to vaporize their bodies.
Tirahnn was a city on the planet of Tirahnn. Larger than some countries, it hosted the Great Fair and was the trading nexus of the entire Zeemacht Cluster.

t: Supreme Council of the Highland Clans
x: The Supreme Council of the Highland Clans was the governing body of the Highland Clans of the Highlands region on the planet Skye.

result: Fett is introduced to The Hunt
objective: Capture Meeko Ghintee
x: The Mission to Outland Station was the event that introduced Jango Fett to The Hunt.
Sullustan regiments were primarily used by the Rebel Alliance as garrison units.

The Pride of the Senate was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser, commanded by Captain Soontir Fel during his third tour of duty in the Imperial Navy. It was one of three Dreadnaught-class cruisers present at the Battle of Nar Shaddaa.

The bog moon of Bogden was a moon of the Inner Rim planet Bogden. It was used as a hideout by the pirate Gir Kybo Ren-Cha after he made his escape from Tammuz-an, bringing along Princess Gerin Toda as a hostage.

The mallakin was an avian native to the planet Kashyyyk. The creature's natural habitat was within the leaves of the world's giant wroshyr trees, where it would hide and await its prey, commonly small insects.

The eopi was a quadruped mammal native to Nadiem similar in appearance to the eopie of Tatooine. The eopi had mottled green skin and a long, trunk-like snout below two bulging eyes. Some eopi were known to have been domesticated, and made loyal pets.
The Quoorian marshsucker was a type of creature native to the Expansion Region celestial body Quooria. It was similar to mosquitos but was much more deadlier.
End Run was a Xiytiar-class heavy transport operated by the Loose Cannon pirates.

Zolo was the name of a squadron of CloakShape starfighters that were operated by the Loose Cannon pirates. Zolo 10 and Zolo 11 were involved in a skirmish between the Loose Cannons and the Azzameen family shortly after the Battle of Hoth.

The Pixelito Grand Council was a group of government leaders in the city of Pixelito on Malastare. It is known that they often dealt with the posting of bounties on the planet's treacherous criminals.
The Loose Cannon was a DP20 gunship operated by a group of privateers known only by the name of this vessel.

Reks were a sentient species characterized by slender, whip-like bodies. They had thin skin with the texture and temperature of lukewarm rubber. All Reks had brightly-colored eyes; purple was a common iris color for the females of the species.

Skandits were a species of small, sentient bipeds with furred bodies, gangly limbs, and squat, compact torsos. Although the black fur around their eyes looked like a mask, the rest of the body was a bluish gray.
The Ychthytonians were a sentient species of four-armed beings native to the Ychthyton system. They were part of the galactic community by 0 ABY and were part of the New Republic by 14 ABY.

The borer beetle was a type of insect native to Kashyyyk. Wookiee shields were often stylized with the telltale eyespots found on the backs of these creatures. In 1 ABY a spacer found a specimen of this species on the premises of the Dathomir Imperial Prison.

Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, Black 4 was a TIE/ln starfighter within the Imperial Navy. Armed with a pair of L-s1 laser cannons, The TIE/LN starfighter served in the Galactic Empire's Black Squadron by 0 BBY.

Dontamo was a planet in the Radiant One system, near Alba-16. It was a jungle world in 19 BBY and it was where Ferus Olin and Clive Flax were held in captivity at Dontamo Prison for crimes against the Galactic Empire.
The Chaf Exalted was a large Chiss ship in service as a flaghip of the Chiss Ascendancy's Chaf family, serving as part of a fleet led by Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano, core name "Formbi."
Residing most often in forested areas, the trompa was a shaggy, powerful monster with foot-long claws. The creature's physiology links it to the wampa, to which it appeared to be a distant cousin.

result: Jango Fett heads for Oovo IV
objective: To locate the whereabouts of the Bando Gora
x: The Mission to Coruscant was the first step in Jango Fett's participation in The Hunt, to locate the Bando Gora and its mysterious leader Komari Vosa. Tyranus had selected Jango among the few to take on the deadly cult with a reward of five million Republic credits.
Raptor was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that served under Moff Kentor Sarne in the Battle of Kathol System.
The Backstab, also known as the Captain's Ladder, was a CR90 corvette that saw service with a group of pirates and mercenaries.

The Eclipse was the first Eclipse-class dreadnought ever constructed and the lead ship and prototype of its class. It was built as a flagship for Emperor Palpatine, who used it after being reborn into one of his clone bodies.

Flirt was Chenlambec's personal handheld translator. Externally, she looked like a small decorative silver cube, but she was actually a positronic processor, too small to actually be considered a droid.
The Imperial Sanctum of the Imperial Palace on Coruscant served as the seat of the Galactic Emperor following the death of Palpatine aboard the Death Star at the battle over Endor in 4 ABY.

Oradin was a city on Brentaal IV, located to the west of the city of Vuultin. Oradin contained a large spaceport, Imperial-class. Parts of the city were destroyed during the Battle of Brentaal IV between the New Republic and the Galactic Empire.

In 3964 BBY, the Mandalorian warrior clans attacked Flashpoint Stellar Research Station, a lightly-defended Galactic Republic scientific installation in the Outer Rim, as part of the initial campaigns of the Mandalorian Wars.
In the early days of the Mandalorian Wars, a battle occurred between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders over the agrarian world of Suurja.
In 3964 BBY, during the Mandalorian Wars, a battle occurred at the Outer Rim world of Suurja between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders.
During the Mandalorian Wars in 3964 BBY, a battle occurred at the Outer Rim world of Suurja between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders.
Catch, originally known as Jawaswag, was an R2-series astromech droid produced by Industrial Automaton and used by Rogue Squadron pilot Gavin Darklighter to aid in the use of his X-wing starfighter.

KT-10 was an astromech droid with a programmed female personality. She was captured by the giant droid known as the Great Heep on Biitu, and she and fellow astromech R2-D2 became romantically interested in each other while the two were being held captive in the Heep's droid ha…
During the Mandalorian Wars in 3964 BBY, a battle occurred at the Outer Rim world of Suurja between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders.

Choco was an R2 unit with a rounded body and only one center leg who was a prisoner of the Great Heep on the planet Biitu. The clumsy droid was the first to encounter R2-D2 after he had been thrown, deactivated, into the Heep's Droid harem.
Grozbok was a reprogrammed GRZ-6B wrecker droid and worked under the command of Olag Greck. Wreaking havoc on Hosk Station, it was destroyed by Unit Zed's security droids.

objective: To locate Sebolto for information on the Bando Gora.
x: The Mission to Malastare was the third event in Jango Fett's participation in The Hunt, to locate the Bando Gora and its mysterious leader Komari Vosa.
Kiidan was the capital city of the planet Cilpar.
Aphids were small plant-eating insects. They were seen as pests.
The Battle of Ciutric occurred in 9 ABY. It was the final battle in a New Republic campaign against rogue Imperial warlord Delak Krennel.
The Mantooine, named for the planet of the same name, was a Corellian Engineering Corporation CR90 corvette serving the New Republic Defense Fleet.
The Dantooine was a CR90 corvette in service to the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. It was part of a task force commanded by Admiral Ackbar during the Battle of Ciutric.
The Ryloth was a Corellian Corvette in service to the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. It was part of the New Republic fleet during the Seizure of Coruscant.
Kavil's Corsairs were a group of Imperial privateers operating in the months after the Battle of Endor.
Tharen was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in the service of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. One of its gunnery mates was Kesin Ommis.
The Reckoning was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer that saw service with the Imperial Navy, under the command of Admiral Delak Krennel. It held a wing of TIE fighters.

Mantan was a terrestrial world located in the Mantan system, a part of the Calamari sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Prously's Rim Run hyperlane linked it to the New Heurkea and Pammant systems.
Ruisto was a planet located in the Calamari sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Ruisto was the first world settled by the Mon Calamari and the site of their initial meeting with the Republic scouts.
The Thyferran Home Defense Corps was a defense force founded by the warlord Ysanne Isard during her rule of the planet Thyferra.

Rainbow qaana were a species of insects that were bred and used by the Yuuzhan Vong. They were kept for the ethereal music that they produced when clicking their mandibles together and were only used in special ceremonies, or in the presence of the Supreme Overlord.
A battle took place on Togoria during the Clone Wars.
The Galacian Gubernatorial election of 44 BBY was the first time a Governor of Gala was chosen democratically. Prior to 44 BBY, the Beju-Tallah dynasty ruled Gala.

Pols Anaxes was the capital city of Anaxes. Home to the Anaxes Citadel, it was the planet's primary civilian spaceport. The city and surrounding terraced Sirpar Hills were places of utmost grace and nearly all motorized vehicles were banned.

Mon Casima was a Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. It was part of a hastily assembled force of New Republic warships dispatched to Adumar in 13 ABY.
The Detainer was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser in the Imperial Navy.

Bolt Squadron was a Clutch starfighter squadron in the Khuiumin Survivors pirate organization. It was considered the most elite of the Survivors' squadrons, and no new member of the Survivors, regardless of their skill, could start out in Bolt.
The Young was a group of children and adolescents from the planet of Melida/Daan that were against the civil war on their planet.
The Equity was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

The Coromon Islands were a crescent-shaped island chain located on Fresia and were the most heavily populated and developed landmasses on the planet. Most of the land was taken up by the various manufacturing plants and office complexes of the Incom Corporation.

Shadow was a TIE Defender squadron associated with Imperial Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's TIE Experimental Project. Fighters from Shadow Squadron participated in both the defense of Bretie Facility and research station Obsidian.
Commando Team One was a SpecForce team for the Rebel Alliance and New Republic. Its leader held the title Commando One. It operated behind enemy lines and was commanded by Kapp Dendo.
Binder was an Imperial Interdictor-class Star Destroyer given to the command of Admiral Delak Krennel by Ysanne Isard for use in the evacuation of Ciutric. Its captain was Phulik.
Fastblast was a pirate cruiser affiliated with the Invids ran by the renegade Admiral Leonia Tavira. The ship's crew referred to themselves as the Fastblasters.

The Blackstar Pirates were a pirate gang affiliated with the Invids. When they were based on Courkrus in 11 ABY, they tended to gather in a cantina called the Mynock Hole, which included a secure and luxurious hideout that other Invids could not access.

Bao-Dur's remote was a droid remote that was built by the Zabrak when he was a youngling, resembling the standard line of remotes that existed at the time. It was programmed to follow Bao-Dur wherever he went.

The City of Dreams was a utopian dreamscape entirely created through psychic energy manifested by Cody Sunn-Childe, a former Alliance to Restore the Republic hero who had awakened mystic powers during the Galactic Civil War.

The Black Sun gladiator droid was a gargatuan droid model used by Xizor as a sentry droid in his palace. The droid was divided into three parts: lower body, torso, and head. It could not be destroyed easily, as all the sections were capable of operating independently.

Machineville was a district in the planet Taris' Lower City. Set aside for the city's droid population as a place to recharge and repair, Machineville was known as the "birthplace of the swoop-bike" among Taris' racing community.

Junk Junction, sometimes referred to as just the Junction, was a large junkyard in the Lower City of the planet Taris. Established on the site of a group of high-rise buildings that were demolished and never replaced, Junk Junction was a vast expanse of rubble, trash, and refuse.
The Last Resort was a 578-R space transport owned and operated by the reclusive Arkanian Offshoot scientist Gorman "Camper" Vandrayk during the era of the Mandalorian Wars.
Elcor Station was a hovertrain station operating in the lower sectors of the planet Coruscant in 32 BBY.

The Black Heth were a common Coruscant street gang that the Jin'ha used as a front in 32 BBY. According to Mace Windu, the Black Heth were considered petty criminals, and were known to terrorize innocent civilians around Elcor Station.
The Jahibakti kajidic was a Hutt kajidic located on Tatooine, which shared the arms dealing business with Gardulla and controlled nearly fifty percent of the planet's water supply.
The Faljozic kajidic was a Hutt kajidic located on Tatooine, which controlled most exports from Tatooine before Jabba's rise to power.

The Vlassy Nature Preserve was a secluded wildlife preserve, located along the Vlassy River on Garqi. Located eight hundred kilometers southeast of Pesktda, the Preserve was a popular destination for Garqians and off-world tourists alike.
Korriban zombies, also known as Korriban Sith zombies, were semi-sentient, undead humanoid predators native to the Sith tombworld Korriban.

The Corellian Way was a frigate operated by the Galactic Alliance during the Yuuzhan Vong War. The frigate was dispatched to the key communication facility located on Esfandia. The ship and all hands were lost when it was destroyed by a Yuuzhan Vong fleet.
Coriolis was a Duros-crewed starship of Galactic Alliance during the latter stages of the Yuuzhan Vong War. It was operated by Commander Yurf Col.
The Ballarat was an Endurance-class fleet carrier assigned to the New Republic Fifth Fleet.
The droid Viscount Tardi was designed to replace the Human Tardi who had died more than a month before the Rebel Alliance had intended to have him conduct a financial transaction for them.
New Escrow was the capital city of the banking world of Aargau. It contained the beautiful Garden of Butterflies and the planet's oldest spaceport.
The Unification Gala was one of the most popular festivals of the Capital Season. It was hosted by one of the noble houses of Tapani and held on Crispos Isle in the equatorial ocean of Procopia.

The Spritespray was a medium cruiser in service to the Galactic Alliance during the latter half of the Yuuzhan Vong War. It was part of a task force commanded by General Wedge Antilles during the Battle of Bilbringi. It was one of the six warships that survived the engagement.
Axion was a Human colony planet purchased by the Colicoids prior to the Clone Wars. It was then that it became a research and development center for the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Troska was a forested planet located within the Troska system of the Outer Rim Territories.
In the aftermath of the Battle of Endor, the planet Tatooine was embroiled in a revolt against the Imperial forces stationed there.

objective: Protect Crix Madine's Y-wing starfighters as they disable ships trying
x: The Liberation of Gerrard V was an event in 1 ABY during the Galactic Civil War in which the planet Gerrard V gained its independence from the Galactic Empire.

Fidelis was a Tac-Spec FIII Footman droid owned by House Malreaux. He was painted in crimson and ivory: his chassis and head were decorated in the checkerboard pattern that was the livery of House Malreaux, while his extremities bore an ivory base coat with crimson piping.

Solis was a Tac-Spec FIII Footman droid and counterpart to Fidelis. He was functional, but unlike his painted counterpart, he had bare, scratched metal showing, and was not programmed with extreme loyalty.
Cartann City was the capital city of Cartann, the most powerful of the planet Adumar's nation states. It was also the largest city on the planet.

Blue Hawk was an Imperial Lancer-class frigate that, along with its sister ship Cascade, participated in the attack on a Rebel Hospital treating casualties shortly after the Battle of Hoth. They assisted the Imperial Star Destroyer Corrupter in the assault.

The Cascade was an Imperial Lancer-class frigate that, along with its sister ship Blue Hawk, participated in the Imperial Star Destroyer Corrupters attack on a Rebel Hospital treating casualties shortly after the Battle of Hoth.
The cliff wampa was a brown-furred, rock-climbing subspecies bioengineered from the wampa ice creature native to the frozen Outer Rim Territories planet Hoth.
Teks was a city on the agricultural planet Reytha.

The town of Breeda was located west of Yeere, the capital of Reytha. In 0 ABY, it and its food storage facilities were taken by the Rebel Alliance. It was subsequently was retaken by an Imperial strike force led by Darth Vader.
Reytha Minor was a city on the agricultural planet of Reytha. In 0 ABY, it was captured by the Rebel Alliance, which established a stronghold inside the city walls.
The Montrosa Islands were a long chain of islands located in the middle of Montrosa Ocean on the planet Reytha.

result: Rebel Alliance presence on Reytha eliminated
x: A campaign consisting of a series of battles took place on the Imperial agricultural world of Reytha, one of the Empire's major "breadbasket" planets, during the Galactic Civil War.
Last Call was a modified Ginivex-class starfighter given to Asajj Ventress by Count Dooku following the theft of her previous such starfighter by Obi-Wan Kenobi on Rattatak.
Luuq Two was a planet in the Luuq system in the Mid Rim's Luuq sector that was known for its beautiful, deep canyons.
The Battle of Cyphar began when the Storm Fleet arrived at Cyphar, attempting to destroy the port.

The Staraker was an experimental, cutting-edge starship designed by the Galactic Empire and created on the planet Foundry. It was stolen by Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa and Mici Shabandar of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Bandit Squadron was a squadron of Z-95 Headhunters that was deployed by the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Liberty.
Lish IV was a moon orbiting the planet Lish in the Demar system of the Brak sector.
Lish VI was a moon orbiting the planet Lish in the Demar system of the Brak sector.
Tati was a planet located in the Bellassa system of the Core Worlds. Ferus Olin and Roan Lands once vacationed on the planet, where they found a tranquil waterfall-fed pool deep in the forest.

Jabor was a planet where Ferus Olin worked for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Ferus sent double agent Clive Flax undercover into the local Separatist base, thus disrupting a spy ring that had taken root throughout the Mid Rim.
Vibroblade was a Skipray Blastboat that operated as part of the Khuiumin Survivors' pirate forces. It was used to board luxury liners and other larger vessels that had been targeted for plunder.
The Raw Deal was a SoroSuub Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 belonging to Outer Rim entrepreneur and casino owner Dunari.

Vulture was a Republic Sienar Systems Marauder-class corvette in use by an Outer Rim pirate group. Accompanied by an escort of Y-wings and Toscan fighters, named Pirate and Fury respectively, Vulture led an attack on noted entrepreneur Dunari aboard his pleasure yacht, the Raw…
Merchant Row was an area located aboard Outland Transit Station, a large space station in the Baxel sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim.
Belligerent was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

Grez Squadron was a squadron of Rebel Alliance Y-wing starfighters. They launched from the Nebulon-B2 frigate Colada during an attack by Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Rage on the Airam-owned supply platform in the Goff system.

Azul Squadron was a starfighter squadron that served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The unit, equipped with Z-95 Headhunters, was based on the Nebulon-B2 frigate Colada.

Eriadu Customs and Immigration was an Eriaduan governmental agency in charge of customs and immigration in 32 BBY during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. The agency deployed picket ships bearing its emblem.
Eror Zeen was the capital city of planet Danoor. The city was composed of squat buildings no taller than four stories, and blue-white glowlamps lit the streets.

The Borealis was a New Republic cruiser captained by Ioa, it served as the flagship for Chief of State Leia Organa Solo during her secret diplomatic mission to Nam Chorios in 13 ABY. It, along with its escort, the Adamantine, was infected by the Death Seed plague in 13 ABY.

The Corbantis was a New Republic cruiser stationed at Durren Orbital in the Meridian sector in 9 ABY. It was one of two New Republic warships dispatched to deal with pirate attacks on nearby Ampliquen.

The Fireater was a DP20 gunship in service to the New Republic in 9 ABY and stationed at Durren. It was part of a small fleet of warships hastily assembled by Han Solo and Lando Calrissian to defend the Meridian sector from invasion, along with the Courane.

Cruiser 8 was the designation number for an Acclamator-class assault ship during the Battle of Muunilinst. It was used as a blind spot as Anakin Skywalker lured a wing of Nantex-class starfighters into a volley of missiles fired by Red Squadron.
R2-AG4 was an R2-AG agromech droid produced by Industrial Automaton.

objective: Eliminate Longo Two-Guns
Confront Gardulla the Hutt
x: The Mission to Tatooine was one of the final events of The Hunt.

Ubese Thorn-Back War Dragons were huge, violent beasts that were introduced to the populated worlds of the galaxy by Nomad-Damon during the Clone Wars. The reptilian beasts were utilized as mounts by some individuals.
Lyco Pibex were diminutive, passive creatures found throughout the galaxy. They were able to run at rapid paces, and were kept as pets by spacers.

The Zybahhod Yenyoni was a sentient species originating in the Outer Rim Territories' Zybahhod system. They were well-adapted for life in deserts, having special salt glands that removed sodium from the brackish water they drank.

Sandswimmers were spider-like creatures that dwelled on Tatooine. They were among the planet's most deadly predators, as they would "swim" underneath the arid sands of the desert before moving up to the surface to drain all fluids from their prey.

The Amphi-Hydrus were an amphibian sentient species from the Outer Rim Territories planet Dac. They were proficient in using telepathy fueled by the dark side of the Force to manipulate the minds of others.
The Remplish were a clan native to the planet Sullust. After a long holy war on Sullust, they were cast off the planet. Many members of this clan ended up on Ord Mantell and Gamorr.
Celanon City was a sprawling metropolitan complex covering nearly two hundred square kilometers. It was the capital city of the planet Celanon and a major hub of commerce in the Outer Rim.

The Pitrillistians were a sentient species of large, imposing beings hailing from the planet Pitrillistia, in the Mieru'kar sector. They were a peaceful people who communicated through a series of musical buzzes.

Pitrillistia was a remote terrestrial planet situated on the galactic periphery. It was a part of the Pitrillistia system, located in the Mieru'kar sector within the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

result: The Jedi discover that the bacta shortage was a corporate contrivance
x: A mission to Thyferra was carried out during the Stark Hyperspace War by Jedi Master Tholme and his Padawan, Quinlan Vos.
Critokians were a species of two-meter-tall, arachnoid sentients from the Critoki system, although many dwelt in tribes on the moon Yavin 4.
Kattadan Guards were the planet Kattada's primary defense force. They wore blue body armor and were armed with blasters. They were lightly armed since Kattada was a peaceful planet.
The Galactic Republic had guards who protected the Senate Hall on the planet Coruscant during the Great Sith War. They wore brown helmets and green robes, and were armed with force pikes.

The Stellan were a sentient species native to the Outer Rim planet Stellan. A fiercely isolationist but peaceful race, the Stellan maintained that tranquility by abandoning children that they identified as too aggressive.
Tibannucks were intelligent creatures native to the planet Bespin. There, they fed on the tibanna gas, which was then processed by their four lungs.
Quaripeds were an alien species. They boasted four limbs, and green wing-like appendages. The "bodies" of the Quaripeds were ringed by three red hoops.
The Jeby were a species that dwelled on the world of Rainboh, a planet of the Hapes Cluster. They were jovial creatures, shedding their pink or red spots whenever they laughed.

Rainboh was a terrestrial planet located in the Rainboh system of the Inner Rim's Hapes Cluster. Positioned among the Hapan Rim Worlds, Rainboh could be reached from the Great Rim Route or the Rynmar Trail hyperlanes via the planet Rynmar itself.

Scalts were creatures apparently hailing from Tatooine. They evolved into scavengers, and could be found across the galaxy on starships. They featured large air sacks, clubbed tails, and emitted a high-pitched noise for which they were named.
Gryphon was a mountainous planet located in the Inner Rim, where war among its clans had long been a way of life.
Tusken Canyon was a rocky canyon located in the Jundland Wastes, on the planet Tatooine

Hepsalum Tash, known collectively as "the Tash" were a sentient species native to the Dagobah system. Worm-like in appearance, they were a simple folk, valuing peace, stories, and musical entertainment.
U Wanna Wanna was Mos Eisley's biggest outdoor market, where food and craft could be purchased. Barring when Tatooine's gravel storms reached magnitudes of four or above, it was always open.

Bargoon Tatooni was a privately owned trading post in Mos Eisley on Tatooine. It was often the site of an annual Jawa rendezvous and swap meet, and it had the best prices on spacecraft parts and cookware.
Spiz's gang were a gang of young miscreants who terrorized the slums of Coruscant prior to the Clone Wars. They were lead by Spiz and included a H'nemthe, a Kubaz and a number of other aliens.
The Benevolent III was the personal transport of Baroness Omnino as of 37 BBY. It was of the same type as the shuttle used by Senator Palpatine during the years prior to the Invasion of Naboo.
The Aurorient Express was a luxury cruise liner on the gas giant Yorn Skot owned by Clode Rhoden and captained by a Neimoidian.

The Kathol, also known as the Precursors, the Old Ones, or Cthol, were an ancient race who lived on the planet Kathol in the Kathol sector. They possessed organic technology and were a highly advanced civilization, proven when they created the Codex.
The Constrictor was a CR90 corvette in the service of Warlord Zsinj. Like the Night Caller, its enlarged forward hold was modified to carry four TIE/LN starfighters.

A species of small animals lived on the grassy plains of the planet Cerea. Members of the species had two hind limbs and two much smaller for-limbs and on their head a pair of eyes and a mouth with lips large relative to the creatures face.
The Jedi High Council financed a starship for Ki-Adi-Mundi to use in his mission to Tatooine.
Cerean pack animals were domesticated animals indigenous to Cerea. They were used to pull Cerean carts.

The Expeditious was a Carrack-class light cruiser that served in the Imperial Navy under the command of Captain Rojahn. Intelligence Agent Kirtan Loor was aboard the cruiser when it intercepted the freighter Starwind, carrying former Corellian Security officer Gil Bastra.
The Storm Unit was the name of a squad of Rebel Alliance boarding troopers during the Galactic Civil War.

Storm Unit was a Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport used by the Rebel Alliance to transport boarding commandos during the Galactic Civil War. Additionally, Storm Unit was used in the capture of certain vessels, such as the Lambda-class shuttle AA-23.

Agora was a planet in the Agora system that was located within Sluis sector of the Outer Rim of the galaxy. Remaining loyal to the Republic for centuries, the Sluis sector quickly allied with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Bador was one of the two moons of Kuat and were the headquarters of gang bosses Cherit and L. Fraig. It was home to weapons and facilities for testing drives. It was initially not terraformed, though this had evidently changed by 40 ABY. Boba Fett and Mirta Gev visited this moon.
Darth Revan's flagship was the flagship of Darth Revan, who commanded the military forces of the Sith Empire from this vessel during the Jedi Civil War as of 3957 BBY.

The Pelagia Freedom Force or PFF was a small Rebel Alliance cell that operated in the Tapani sector and was lead by a native of Pelagon, Zanthe Nadia. The PFF was not based in the Pelagia Province but on Nista in the Cadriaan Province where it had two safehouses.
Tar Mass was a rough neighborhood in Mos Eisley on Tatooine. It was where the Mo' Moolee Rah market was located. Walking the streets here would require adequate protection.

Grappa's yacht was the personal starship of Grappa the Hutt, a crime lord allied with Black Sun. When Grappa killed Macus Kayniph, a high-ranking member of Black Sun, in a fit of rage in 11 ABY, he reluctantly arranged the destruction of his yacht in order to cover up the murder.

Fragmentation and Dissolution of the Crimson Empire
End of the Imperial Civil War
x: The Battle of Ord Cantrell was a large-scale military engagement during Imperial Civil War between the Crimson Empire led by self-proclaimed Emperor Xandel Carivus and Baron Ragez D'Asta private fleet with the support of the New Republic.
Eridain was a CR90 corvette that fought in the Battle of Endor. It worked with Rogue Squadron shortly after the reformation at 6.5 ABY. It was commanded by Captain Afyon.

The Strike-class medium cruiser Havoc was part of Admiral Devlia's command on Vladet, in the Rachuk system. It intercepted the Customs Frigate Battle of Yavin in the nearby Hensara system, causing the New Republic ship to land on the surface of Hensara III to avoid engagement.

The Reprieve was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate modified as a medical frigate with the New Republic. It was called on to rendezvous with and recover Rogue Squadron after evacuating their base on Talasea, which was attacked by a small Imperial force.
Mount Meru was a mountain on Deneba. The Jedi held the Conclave at Deneba there in 3997 BBY during the Krath Holy Crusade.

Bouncer was a system patrol craft employed by Dunari. It was hired to protect his casino Dunari's Rest. It was on patrol when Ace Azzameen and his brother Emon went to the casino for a drink, only to be turned back after engaging with Viraxo ships within casino airspace.

Garqi vert-mites were a type of mite that partially shared its name with Garqi, an agriworld in the Cassandran Worlds. In 19 ABY, Imperial commandos Chik Apla and Chala Venan prepared to sabotage the Wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade on the planet Coruscant.

The Floating Rock Gardens of Ryloth were a tourist attraction on the Twi'lek homeworld of Ryloth, well known throughout the Outer Rim Territories. However, because of their proximity to the Bright Lands, very few people usually saw them. There was a small entry fee.
The Goliath was a monstrous battle droid owned by the Yahk-Tosh Lord Gar-Oth. The droid was remotely controlled by telepathic commands from Gar-Oth only.
Superlaser Fire Control, or the Fire Control Room, was a chamber in the Theta Sector of both Death Stars where the superlaser controls were situated. It was manned by gunners and Death Star troopers.
The Umboo Racing Team was a team for the Roon Colonial Games lead by Auren Yomm. It was consisted of Yomm, her friend Gee Long, and the droid BIX. They specialized in the Drainsweeper event.

R4-C9 was an R4-series agromech droid, with an R2-series dome, used by Jedi Master Saesee Tiin, when piloting his Jedi interceptor during the Battle of Coruscant in the late stages of the Clone Wars. It was colored yellow and gray, unlike the starfighter's hue.

objective: Sabotage droid production
x: The Sabotage of Olanet Droid Factory was a sabotage mission undertaken by Atin, Prudii, and a clone pilot 460 days after the First Battle of Geonosis.

Kreesis was the largest continent located on the planet Algara II. The cities of Algarine, Benis, and Tivin were all located on the land mass. The popular Club Prosperine, the planet's main tourist attraction, was also located there.

Algarine was the capital city of the planet of Algara II. It was located on the continent of Kreesis. Several corporations had branches in Algarine, including Algar Mining, Feduch Importers, Prosperine Entertainment and Distilleries, and Kexeerian Blasters Technology.
Benis was a major city on the planet Algara II located on the continent of Kreesis.
Tivin was a major city on the planet Algara II located on the continent of Kreesis. A number of Imperial Resistance cells operated in the city.

Dreeka were a kind of fish native to Ithor. They were often fried and eaten. Zovius Mendu once hid from Jedi Master Feln in a crate of dried dreeka fish. They were known for their distinct chirping sound.

Goyoikin was the capital city of Ventooine, located on the only inhabited continent of the planet. A large golden statue of Han Solo stood in the ruins of what was once the temple of the ruling Satab, erected by the grateful population in thanks for his efforts in overthrowing…

The Riders of the Maelstrom was a band of pirates that operated near the Maelstrom. The band was led by the notorious pirate Big Jak Targrim. The pirates used the natural features of the Maelstrom to make a profitable business plundering passing ships.
Meirm City was the capital city of the planet Sriluur, and was described as the heart of Weequay culture. Meirm was located on the Copper Coast of the acidic Meirm Sea.
Glastro was a major city on the planet of Bimmisaari. The city was noted for its production of Glastroan wine, and was home to the Tower of Law.

Bay One was the name of the main hangar bay located onboard the modified Providence-class carrier/destroyer Invisible Hand. Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker crash-landed in Bay One during the Battle of Coruscant, in their attempt to rescue Supreme Chancellor Palpatine.
Elesa was a small mining town on Ando Prime.
Stonia was the capital city of Almania. It contained the Great Dome of the Je'har.
The Cerebus was a bulk cruiser that formed part of the Imperial Corrupter Task Force. It was commanded by Captain Tains.
Vigiliance was an Imperial Dreadnaught that formed part of the Corrupter Task Force. She was commanded by Captain Nemlix.
Badlands was an Imperial CR90 corvette during the Galactic Civil War. Commanded by Commander Kraven, Badlands served under Garreth Holtz's Corrupter Task Force.
The Kraken was an Assassin-class corvette that formed part of the Corrupter Task Force under Imperial Admiral Garreth Holtz. The ship was commanded by Captain Ollender.
622 was the designation of a Venator-class Star Destroyer in the Open Circle Fleet of the Galactic Republic.

Romin were a humanoid species with a somewhat smaller stature than that of Humans. Romin had golden skin and eyes. Their noses were flat, barely raised on their faces, and their mouths were wide and expressive.
A small battle occurred in the Morobe system above the planet Talasea in 7 ABY between Wraith Squadron and elements of Warlord Zsinj's fleet.
The Sandstorm Shipping Concern was a shipping and transport agency based in Mos Eisley on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

Dathomiri boars were non-sentient pig-rodents native to the planet Dathomir, in the Outer Rim Territories. A brown and tusked creature, they were 3 meters tall and lived in the forests and jungles of the planet.

Reptilian fliers (or flyers), also known as saurian fliers, and saurians, were a large species of carnivorous, winged reptavians native to the Outer Rim world of Dathomir. Beast masters were able to domesticate saurians as personal companions or mountable beasts of burden.
Monhudle was a mining planet in the Cassandran sectors region. During the Outer Rim Sieges of the Clone Wars, Jedi General Traavis led clone forces to war against the Separatists on this planet.
PD-28 was a pilot droid who was forced to serve the Galactic Empire's Doctor Raygar. In 3 ABY, Raygar tried to steal the artifact known as the Sunstar from the Ewoks of the Forest Moon of Endor.
Barrens was a settlement on Ord Cestus. It was located south of the Kibo Plateau.

Clandes was a settlement on Ord Cestus. It was an industrial city, beneath which there was a communications landline junction. It was also surrounded by mines. It was located 300 kilometers south of ChikatLik and 75 kilometers southeast of the Dashta Mountains.
Jantos was a large city on Ord Cestus. During the Clone Wars, a trading post was located in the city.
A stalking onsonker was (allegedly) a species of ambulatory, plantlike carnivore. Vilmarh Grahrk had a pet of the species, named "Fluffy."

The Coruscant Planetary Defense Force (PDF) was a detachment of the New Republic Defense Force. It was charged with the duty of defending the capital Coruscant, a task which included manning the orbital defense platforms above the planet and setting up ground defenses.
The Vrakolian were a species with thick skin from the planet Vrakolia. They used the spinblade for harmless games of skill. Other species adopted them as weapons.

The Devils tower was a mountain on the planet Naboo shaped akin to a giant volcano. There was a runway nearby, suggesting the location for a small starfighter corps base or an emergency landing strip.

Frosch were a species of lizard on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, a family of Ewoks on Endor needed to acquire frosch eggs for a potion to save their father, Deej Warrick, from rokna tree fungus.

Rwooks were the most common Wookiee subspecies, native to the planet Kashyyyk. They largely inhabited the tree-city Rwookrrorro. Rwooks were distinguished by their fur, which commonly had more earth-like tones than albino Wookiees, such as red, brown, or chestnut.

place: Well of the World Brain, Coruscant
result: Yuuzhan Vong forces almost completely eliminated
x: The Battle of the World-Well took place in 27 ABY at the Well of the World Brain on Yuuzhan Vong-occupied Coruscant.

x: The Braxant Bonecrusher—originally the Braxant Brave—was an Old Republic-era Dreadnaught-class cruiser.

The Reigats were a species of large humanoids with grayish, mottled skin and dark blue hair, eyelids, and lips. They were generally a species of loners whose yearly "breeding drive" was probably all that kept them from becoming extinct.

The Lowen were a species of Near-Humans from the planet of Low'n. They were distinguishable from baseline Humans by the fleshy tendrils that hung from their heads, their flat noses, and their loose, thick fleshy skin that bundled and folded up around their neck, shoulders, bac…

Zolanders were the native species of Zolan. They were adapted to the extreme cold of the planet. As their sun's radioactive emissions increased, the Zolanders created a skin-altering gene, inadvertently creating a genetic offshoot of the Zolanders, the Clawdite.
Denuhi-Eight was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Denuhi system, a part of the Greater Plooriod sector in the Northern Dependencies portion of the Expansion Region.

Greel screamers were a non-sentient avian predator native to the forests of the planet Pii IV. They were capable of flight and had a carnivorous diet. Greel screamers resided in greel trees, often in groups of four to eight.
The timber render inhabited the lower forests of the planet Pii IV. They were predatory omnivorous creatures who marked their territory by slashing greel trees.

The First Conference of Free Peoples was a meeting of delegates hosted by the Alliance to Restore the Republic in 4 ABY following the Battle of Endor. The Rebel Alliance established a interim goverment as part of its formal transition into the New Republic.

objective: To prevent the Yuuzhan Vong discovering any Jedi weaknesses
x: The Mission to Ossus was an event during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Amidst rumors of a Yuuzhan Vong presence on Ossus, a team composed of Jedi Knights and the New Republic Archaeological Corps was dispatched to prevent the invaders from uncovering any secrets that could reveal any …

The Krayt Draggers was a swoop gang led by Kav Lepkin, with about 15 members. The gang was located in Anchorhead on the planet Tatooine. Their name and gang symbol were based on the Krayt dragon and the binary suns.
The Wuorl were a frog-like species that lived in the branches of the Greenstalk trees on the planet Mrlsst in the Freeworlds Territory of the Tapani sector.
Hunter's Luck was one of the myriad of ships owned and operated by Mara Jade when she was a smuggler. It had originally been a rich kid's private yacht, but was then captured by pirates.
Illafian Point was the capital city of the planet Rathalay.
Stranglethorn was a species of vine found on the forest moon of Endor. When it first sprouted, stranglethorn was of little note.
Yumfla was the capital city of Susevfi. It was a large seaport and contained a fortress built by an Imperial Governor and later used by Leonia Tavira. It also was close to a secret Jensaarai refuge.
Äslajä was a location on the planet Bunduki that hosted the Palawa Band Teräs Käsi tournament in 22 BBY.

result: Rebel Alliance victory, shuttle Tydirium captured
x: The Mission to Zhar was a mission on the part of the Rebel Alliance to retrieve Imperial shuttle Tydirium in 4 ABY.

Krnay was a location in the Krnay system of the Mid Rim's Vilonis sector. The young Rith Murisson, who at one point underwent a Umgullian blob massage therapy session on the planet Umgul, hailed from Krnay.

Forard was a town on Almas, and the only large settlement on the planet. It was built around the Almas Academy, and had very little besides for basic services and entertainment facilities. The town was built directly upon a patch of kaluthin.
Draeo-Kax was a city of the planet Albrae-Don. The Pica Rim Pipeline came near the city.
Daekun was the capital city of the planet Aleron.
Kevron was the smallest of the four moons of the planet Algara II. It was the location of an astronomical research station under the management of the Algarian Bureaucracy.
Omakaton was a moon of the planet Algara II. The moon was mined for its ore under the auspices of the Algarian Bureaucracy.
Radeon was a moon of the planet Algara II. The moon was controlled by the Algarian Bureaucracy, and was mined for its ore.
Tallakron was the largest of the four moons of the planet Algara II. It was controlled by the Algarian Bureaucracy and held a military outpost.
Karren was the capital city of the planet Antiquity. It was the location of the Karren spaceport.

Port Tarkin was the main starport and capital city of the Outer Rim planet Phelarion. It was named by Lady Thalassa Tarkin after her beloved husband, Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, after his death at Yavin.
Greccia was a city of the planet Arcopola. The Arcopola Baas Music Festival was held in the city.
The Action-Keynne XII transport was a bulk transport built by the Corellian Engineering Corporation.

The Cartao Expeditionary Army was the military task force sent by the Confederacy of Independent Systems to subdue Cartao. Led by Tok Ashel, it was charged with taking Spaarti Creations without damaging the facility.

Manikons were primitive beings of a tribe that came to Coruscant following a brutal civil war that led to the destruction of their homeworld. Only a small band of survivors managed to flee to Coruscant.
Satikan was the largest city of the planet Asation.

The Calamari Council, also known as the Mon Calamari government council, was a representative council on the planet Mon Cala. Prior to serving as a captain in the Mon Calamari Guard, Gial Ackbar was the representative of Coral City in the Calamari Council.

The Terra Sool militia was the local military forces of the planet Terra Sool. They operated their own fighters. When Terra Sool was occupied by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, the militia rose up against the Confederacy.

Threadneedle Canyon was a canyon leading to a town on the planet Nadiem. A stream flowed through the canyon into a river on the outskirts of the nearby town. Also, part of the Battle of Nadiem was fought in Threadneedle Canyon.
Fighter Wing Zero-Zero was a Confederate Navy starfighter squadron. It fought at the Battle of Nadiem where its access to the planet's surface was blocked by Saesee Tiin's orbital blockade.
The Pyn'gani were a Near-Human sentient species from the Outer Rim planet Polus. To protect them from the extreme cold of their homeworld, their cities were shielded by heat generators.
The Lonely Five Range, best known simply as the Lonely Five, was a mountain range on the planet Ryloth. The subterranean city of Kala'uun was located within a basaltic peak of the Lonely Five.
The Larkhess was an escort frigate in the New Republic fleet.
The Golden Yoke was a customized Tarrvin-on-Kallik Blade-28 fighter belonging to Pekaelic ke Teldan, the Perator of Cartann.
The Ciasi were a rodent-like sentient species with tall, pointed ears and thin, trunk-like noses. Ciasi could be found with gray-colored skin and could grow prominent tusks.

Prosperity was the largest town on the desert planet Beheboth. Once a hardscrabble settlement mostly populated by moisture farm workers, the town was originally named Garrotine, but was renamed after an economic revival brought about by a rare downpour of rain caused by the Ti…
Carthas was the capital city of the planet Benja-Rihn, and contained many archaeological marvels.
Lumchugger's Hub was one of the most popular entertainment regions on the planet Bescane. The swoop gang Cooper's Swoopers operated here.
Dora Prefecture was a city on the planet Bethal.

Olanet was a planet in the Outer Rim's Siskeen system that sided with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. It was said to be home to the second largest droid factory since Geonosis.
The Hyallp were a sentient race of insectoid beings. They were multi-legged arthropods. Little was known of their planet of origin or culture. Noy Waglla was a Hyallp.
Miner's Town was a town on the planet of Mon Gazza. The settlement was founded to support the miners who worked in the planet's spice mines.
The Battle of Rendili was a battle of the Clone Wars that occurred in 22 BBY.
The Reflection Gardens were a public garden on Coruscant. In 19 ABY, Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade were publicly married there.
The Battle of Adumar was a conflict between the New Republic and the Imperial Remnant, fought in defense of the New Republic's ally, the newly formed Adumari Union.
The Master Stroke was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Starfleet.
Reithcas, also spelled Reithcass, was the capital city of Bortras, a bountiful planet located in the Outer Rim of the galaxy.
The Titavian IV was an exploration ship used by the Intergalactic Zoological Society. It was named after the titavian species of Naboo.

The Kuat Explorer was a Human colony ship. The Explorer was the vessel that colonized the planet of Alsakan in 26,000 BBY. Members of the Hirken family were aboard, making them among the oldest families on Alsakan.
Bridis City was the capital city of the planet Bridin Anchorage.
Heg was the capital city of the planet Bundim. It was destroyed during the Battle of Heg.

result: Darth Revan captured by the Jedi.
Darth Malak betrays Darth Revan and becomes Dark Lord of the Sith.
Force bond forged between Revan and Bastila Shan.
x: The Capture of Darth Revan was a vital mission carried out by the Galactic Republic and the Jedi during the Jedi Civil War.
Brella was the capital city of the planet Cadomai Prime.
Cambar was the capital city of the planet Calipsa.

The Brommstaad Mercenaries, also referred to as the Bromstaad boys [sic], were a mercenary outfit hired by Black Sun for work on Corellia. There, they worked for Zekka Thyne before he was sent to Kessel.
The Bergruutfa Clan was one of the many clans that prospective young Initiates were placed in when they first began to learn the ways of the Jedi Order.

The Happy Dagger was a SoroSuub Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 owned by Roa, an old smuggler friend of Han Solo. The ship was modified to be even more luxurious while also having more firepower then a standard PLY-3000.

The Lightning Forest was a dangerous location on the Forest Moon of Endor. The Ewok shaman Logray owned a globe of Endor that depicted the Lightning Forest as a cluster of trees that crackled with electricity.

The Iskalon Effect was a giant tidal wave on Iskalon in 3 ABY that destroyed the city of Pavillion. It was caused by the Galactic Empire who were trying to kill Luke Skywalker. It is reported that a Merman was killed by this event.
The Domain Hul worldship was the Yuuzhan Vong worldship possessed by Domain Hul.

A Jedi Initiate Clan was slaughtered by Darth Vader during his Raid on the Jedi Temple in 19 BBY. As the clone troopers of the 501st Legion stormed the Jedi Temple, they took refuge in the High Council Tower.

The Bay of Tears was a deep water harbor on Vjun guarded by sudden shoals. The shores of the bay had a network of caves and tunnels that had been carved by the River Weeping. Some of these caves exited into the cellars of Château Malreaux.

x: Muracie was the capital city of the planet Centares.
The Bo Charmian Racing School was a podracing school located inside one of the concession concourses of the Mos Espa Grand Arena on Tatooine.

The Nharwaak were a sentient species that, along with the Habeen, populated the Outer Rim world of Mylok IV in the Mylok system.

x: The Shamus was a Nebulon-B2 frigate that served under the command of Imperial Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin.

Glazer was a CR90 corvette that the Nharwaak used to ferry weapons technology to the Rebel Alliance Nebulon-B frigate Xerxes. The Glazer was escorted in this mission by two other corvettes, the Coffey and the Janson.
Janson was a CR90 corvette that the Nharwaak used to escort the corvette Glazer as it made a technology delivery to the Rebel Alliance Nebulon-B frigate Xerxes.
Clawmouse was a species of rodent found in the deserts of the planet Dreighton.
Rusty Eagle was a transport vessel used by the Rebel Alliance to carry infantry and light vehicles into battle.
The Selander was a Corellian Engineering Corporation Assassin-class corvette operated by the Ripoblus.
Mirage was one of two starfighters attached to the Mistryl Shadow Guard team led by Manda D'ulin, and flown by the Mistryl warrior-woman named Cai and the astromech droid D4.

The RS Revenge was a cruiser in the Rebel Alliance's fleet during their civil war against the Galactic Empire. At some point between 0 BBY and 1 ABY, it was captained by Kazan and stationed at an Alliance base that was hidden in an asteroid field.

The Anaxsi were the Human residents of Anaxes. They were fervently loyal to the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire, and the planet was one large Imperial Navy training and staging ground.
Daplona was the capital city of the planet Ciutric IV. It contained the Shine Astara, and the Daplona River flowed nearby.
Lettow was a Core Worlds planet. After leaving the Jedi Order in 24,500 BBY, the Jedi Knight Xendor founded the Legionnaire Academy on Lettow for studying alternative Force-user traditions.
Jolly Man was a freighter used by the New Jedi Order as part of the Wild Knights. It was used to transport their non-hyperdrive equipped ships (2 I-7 Howlrunners and 3 A-9 Vigilances).

Big Eye was a GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat converted into a sensor platform that was used by the New Jedi Order. Flown by Tenel Ka, it was used in a mission to capture a voxyn in space around the planet Froz.
T1-LB, nicknamed "Elbee" by Jedi Padawan Zayne Carrick, was an LB-series bulk-loading droid in service to the Jedi Academy on the planet Taris in the year 3964 BBY.

The "Rogue Moon" was the nickname of an anomalous unnamed planetoid in the Taris system. The planetoid sat in the middle of an asteroid field, but had a retrograde orbit, traveling in the opposite direction of the asteroids around it.
The Monitor III was a Consular-class cruiser dispatched in 22 BBY to destroy the Pirates of Iridium.

Red Gauntlet was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer under the command of Warlord Zsinj. It participated in the Battle of Vahaba, attacking Admiral Teren Rogriss's Stellar Web along with Zsinj's Victory-class Star Destroyer Serpent's Smile.

124 group was a pair of Imperial Corellian Engineering Corporation Assassin-class corvettes involved in supplying Admiral Wooyou Senn's Task Force Vengeance in the Outer Rim Airam sector during the Galactic Civil War.

337 was a pair of Imperial Corellian Engineering Corporation Assassin-class corvettes involved in supplying Admiral Wooyou Senn's Task Force Vengeance in the Outer Rim Airam sector during the Galactic Civil War.

result: Pirates capture an Orbital Defense Cannon.
x: The battle of Nod Kartha was a lengthy sortie which took place just prior to the Jedi assault on Geonosis in 22 BBY.
The Tal'cara was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser owned and operated by the Bothan Spynet.
D4, also called Deefour, was the astromech droid used by the Mistryl Shadow Guard warrior-woman Cai aboard the starfighter Mirage.

Lucre was a small transport that was used by Corran Horn during the Yuuzhan Vong War. It was destroyed when Corran, Anakin Solo and Tahiri Veila set it on a preprogrammed evasion course in a Yuuzhan Vong fleet and escaped to a nearby asteroid in vacsuits.

The Halleck was an Acclamator-class assault ship in service with the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. It was assigned to Jedi Master Mace Windu during a mission to rescue his Padawan learner Depa Billaba on Haruun Kal.

A Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser owned and operated by an unknown independent party, Mercury at one point aided the Alliance by exiting hyperspace near to where the CR90 corvette Razor was captured by Avenger.
Longshot was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser owned and operated by casino-owner and Rebel ally Dunari.
Sodrab was an Imperial Carrack-class light cruiser that was featured in an Alliance flight training simulation.
Ban Belos was the capital city of the planet of Rabaan.
Quori City was the capital city of the Outer Rim planet Corlass.
Zorb was a planet located in the Zorb system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Cryon was a celestial body located in the Cryon system, a part of the Meram sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Argo-6 was a terrestrial astronomical object, the climate of which featured several seasons. All members of a family residing on the celestial body maintained miniature farms in their mouths, which helped provide them with sustenance.
The Rimrider was an Imperial scout ship stolen by Halagad Ventor in order to escape Darth Vader. He flew the ship to Trinta, and there it stayed permanently in the swamps.
Dragonets were reptile creatures native to the planet Tatooine. Sometimes compared to young krayt dragons, they were often found in lairs made of bones.
Outpost was a Carrack-class light cruiser of the Imperial Navy.
Ishanna V was the fifth planet in the Ishanna system. It housed five moons. The aforementioned stellar objects followed their set individual orbital course, all similarly elliptical.

The Barderia was a Corellian freighter owned by Captain Rhanken. It was roughly 100 meters long and boxy. The captain worked a route of several systems in the Quelii sector, which included the Halmad system.
The primary office of the New Republic's Chief of State was located within the old Imperial Palace on Coruscant.

The Plavonian starfish was an aquatic creature native to the Plavonia system. Plavonian starfish could be stuffed and eaten as part of a meal, and were served aboard the luxury repulsortrain Gem of Alderaan and at the annual Vor-cal Feast held aboard the House Melantha Orbital…
327-A was a Corellian Engineering Corporation Assassin-class corvette operated by the Galactic Empire. It was part of Admiral Wooyou Senn's Task Force Vengeance.

The Fury was a freighter operated by the Mistryl Shadow Guard. In 8 ABY it was commanded by Shada D'ukal, with her young partner Dunc T'racen acting as co-pilot/gunner, when it was contracted by Fenig Nabon and Ghitsa Dogder to transport a troupe of Twi'lek dancing-girls from …

The Indenture was a yellow and white Firespray-31-class patrol and attack ship that was piloted by Krassis Trelix as part of the Karazak Slavers Cooperative. The ship was notorious for traveling under multiple phony aliases and transponder IDs, including the Salvation.

The Eleven Elders of the People, known as the Eleven Elders of Emberlene, the Eleven of the Mistryl, or simply the Eleven Elders) were the ruling council of the planet Emberlene and the leaders of the Mistryl Shadow Guard.
Alderaan was a space yacht owned by Chief of State Leia Organa Solo as of 14 ABY.

The sack of Ko Vari was a battle which saw the forces of Xim the Despot lay waste to the once pristine Hutt colony of Ko Vari. However, the Hutts would soon have revenge after they decimated Xim's fleet at the First Battle of Vontor.
The Jedi Praxeum protocol droid was a golden protocol droid deployed in Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum.
Freckers were a species of small sentient rodents. Though wild and brutal, they were capable of intelligent speech. Freckers also wore clothes, denoting some manner of culture.
Miramba was a synthskin-covered droid that infiltrated Jabba's Palace, with Jabba Desilijic Tiure's former friend, Gru'um Ropple. She was transporting many freckers inside her synthetic skin.
Nivek, also know as Night Planet, was a planet in the Expansion Region, known as a "night planet" due to the perpetual darkness which shrouded its surface.
81 was the designation of an OG-9 homing spider droid produced by Baktoid Armor Workshop for the Commerce Guild. Unit 81 fought in the Battle of Geonosis that marked the beginning of the Clone Wars.

Jaren's planet was a habitable world in the Outer Rim Territories near Molavar. It was home to hoars and was sparsely populated with such Human settlers as Ament and Jaren, but had at least one spaceport. The local police force rode swoop bikes.

Le'Roche was an island on the planet Krant. Between 0.5 ABY and 2 ABY, the Bothan spy Utric Sandov and Krantian Resistance members retreated to the island after Imperial Strike Force Alpha seized the Rebel Alliance's Ghost Base.

The sistermoon was a pale moon which was one of nine of the planet Endor in the Outer Moddell systems' Endor system, located in the Moddell subsector of the Inner Zuma Region, which was in turn part of the Outer Rim Territories' Zuma sector.
The Leocald Opera House was a large, multi-storied opera house located within the Historical District of Estalle, an island city on the planet Procopia.

Kalaan City was a major city on the planet of Kalaan and home to a major Rebel Alliance base before 0 BBY. A bustling city of domed houses and rounded architecture, it boasted a starport and was flanked by large statues of Kalaanites.

Lando Calrissian's R5 unit was an old astromech droid into which Lando Calrissian had encoded all access codes to all doors in Cloud City. Kyle Katarn used it to get access to the upper levels of Cloud City during the Battle of Bespin.

A battle at Folor was an engagement between Admiral Apwar Trigit and the still-in-training Wraith Squadron and Blue Squadron. While the base was eventually lost, the New Republic managed to evacuate the base with minimal losses thanks to unorthodox tactics.
The Battle of Anaxes of 20.1 BBY was the final confrontation between the Confederacy of Independent Systems' Bulwark Fleet and the Galactic Republic's Victory Fleet during the Clone Wars.

The Sirpar Hills were the terraced hillsides surrounding the Anaxes Citadel in Pols Anaxes, on the planet Anaxes. As with the capital, most vehicles were banned in the Sirpar Hills, so residents would switch out their vehicles for Keffis at the nearby Sirpar Station.
The 1-138 was an automated hauler transporting cortosis from Cloud City to the Imperial Cairn Installation during the brief period that the city was occupied by the Empire Reborn.

Anstares VI, also known as Anstares, was a Mid Rim gas giant located in the Juvex sector. It was orbited by three planetary rings and eight moons, the latter of which were a popular destination for visitors from both the Senex-Juvex region and the wider galaxy.
Durollia was a celestial body located in the Durollia system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Kalamith sector. It had at least one spaceport.

Pegg was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Pegg system, a part of the Tynquay sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It hosted multiple spaceports, with the concourse of the main one being the site of the store named Merrk's Weapons Shop.
The Morgukai Shadow Army was an alleged Separatist cloning project that was researched in the secret labs of the planets Saleucami during the Clone Wars.
Andowyne was a Force-imbued planet located in the Kathol Rift. It was the home planet of the Brownie, Daikini, Nelwyn and possibly midi-chlorian life forms.

Sigma Squadron was a starfighter squadron of the Imperial Navy that was equipped with TIE Phantoms. To demonstrate the new starfighters' effectiveness to Darth Vader, Admiral Sarn deployed Sigma Squadron against a Rebel Alliance patrol in the Dreighton Triangle.
Skyhook was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer under the command of General Han Solo during the hunt for Warlord Zsinj as part of Group Two.
Bravo One was a UT-60D transport/gunship that served the Extraction Team Bravo of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Modbreks were a species of pale-skinned humanoids (or possibly Near-Humans). They had small noses and mouths, sharp facial features and large eyes. They were hairless, save for a mane of blue hair.
The Battle of Yavin was an Imperial Customs Frigate which was captured by the New Republic. It was assigned to the Black Curs, a band of smugglers and outlaws led by Dirk Harkness.

A battle occurred in the Chorax system in 6 ABY when Captain Uwlla Iillor of the Galactic Empire ambushed the New Republic starfighter unit Rogue Squadron, using the Immobilizer 418 cruiser Black Asp to pull the squadron out of hyperspace.
The Rout of Hensara was a battle fought by a small New Republic force to recover the Battle of Yavin from Hensara III.

Chains of Justice was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer, part of Warlord Zsinj's fleet. It often paired with the Victory-class Star Destroyer Venom.

Draklor was a Star Galleon-class frigate serving in the Imperial Navy under Grand Admiral Thrawn. The ship was dispatched by the Grand Admiral as part of the Death's Head to ferry Joruus C'baoth and General Freja Covell from his flagship, the Star Destroyer Chimaera to the Mou…
The Forbidden was a modified Lambda-class T-4a shuttle, which was assigned to Rogue Squadron in 6 ABY. It had been modified by the New Republic for training purposes.

A-77 was a CIS assassin droid under the command of Asajj Ventress, while trying to hunt down Grand Master Yoda.

The Rodian Karstag was a predator, native to Rodia, that inhabited swampy and damp forests. An adult was about 1.5 meters in height at the shoulder and between 4 and 5 meters long. Despite the animals' bulky appearance, they were deceptively fast creatures.
Dark Novatroopers were a variant of the dark troopers, deadly next-generation battle droids used by the Galactic Empire.

Decoy Squad Five was an eight-member detachment of clone troopers from the 501st Legion, led by a sergeant.
The Ukian Torbull originated from the agricultural world of Ukio. The Torbull was an experiment by the Ukians to breed a hardy pack animal that could survive any environment.

Vanquo was a mining world in the Outer Rim's Meerian sector that became the site of one of the early battles of the Mandalorian Wars.
The Battle of Vanquo took place in 3964 BBY, when the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders attacked the Outer Rim mining world of Vanquo at the beginning of their war with the Galactic Republic.
The Kuratcha was the mothership of the Hiromi Empire.

The Yinchorri High Command was the leadership of the Yinchorri warrior caste, and the instigators of the Yinchorri Uprising against the Galactic Republic. They were headquartered in a command center located within the planet Uhanayih.

Forscan IV was a planet located in the Forscan system within the Auril sector.

Lurark was the capital city of the planet Saffalore, located in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planetary government was based in Lurark. The Galactic Empire established a garrison known as Argenhald Base outside the city's perimeter.

Clink was the nickname given to the R2-series astromech droid assigned to Myn Donos during his time with Wraith Squadron after the destruction of his first astromech unit and fellow survivor of Talon Squadron, Shiner.
Erinnic was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Starfleet.

x: Muttamoks were small Force-sensitive mammals who were fond of stealing small, bright objects.

Taloraan City, also known as Cloud City, was the capital city of Taloraan and one of the sites of the battle above Taloraan. It featured several tall, spire-like buildings atop a massive repulsorlift generator, similar to technologies used on Bespin.
The Python was an Assassin-class corvette warship. It was used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic in the defection of the Imperial officer Commander Zaletta.

The Evacuation of Yavin was a battle between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire that took place six months after the Battle of Yavin in 0 ABY. It was to be the final clash of the long siege of the moon before the Alliance base was evacuated.
The Bothan High Command was a military command of Bothan commanding officers based on Yavin 4 during the Galactic Civil War.

Lennax was an Imperial planet in the Carpurnal system, coreward of Celanon. It was a hot, arid planet covered in grass plains and near desert. The Human Lennaxians lived in a simple, nomadic society. There were numerous trade settlements on the planet, primarily Port Lennax.

Duors were highly sentient, Force-sensitive delphinoids indigenous to the planet Arrakan. They believed the Leviathan Kithnarrock to be their creator. They created the Battrach by using bio-engineering techniques.
Hanchin was a planet in the Outer Rim's Moddell sector. It was orbited by Qina.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: The New Republic Honor Guard was a military force appointed by the Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic to perform ceremonial duties to high ranking New Republic officials and dignitaries.
The ambush at Alderaan in 7 ABY saw the forces of Warlord Zsinj destroy a New Republic bacta convoy in the Graveyard.

Gouka dragons were immense creatures that lived underground on Aargonar. They used high body temperatures to create tunnels of fused rock in which they lived. They preyed on sarlaccs, but were uninterested in smaller creatures. They could be attracted by engine noise.

The Raid on GemDiver Station was an operation launched by the Second Imperium against Luke Skywalker's Jedi Praxeum in 23 ABY in order to secure more recruits for the Second Imperium's Shadow Academy. It marked the beginning of the Second Imperium's campaign against the Jedi.
Rugjha were non-humanoid sentients with fifteen flexible limbs, glossy mauve skin, and multiple eyes. To Humans, they appeared to be a tangle of limbs with the occasional eye peeping out.

The Leviathans were a tentacled sentient species residing on the waterworld Arrakan. The thousand-year-old Force-sensitive Leviathan Kithnarrock was worshipped as a god by the planet's Battrach species, and during the Galactic Civil War, he helped a group of Jedi and their com…
Blue-spotted preaky were types of birds that were considered beautiful by some.
Edan tigers, also known as snowcats, were large predatory felines native to the colder regions of Edan II.
Tir Asleen was considered the greatest of all kingdoms on the planet of Andowyne.
The Brownies were a diminutive, long-lived species from Andowyne that defied most scientifc classifications.
Torm was one of four continents on the planet of Lazerian IV.

Dura-Kahn was a planet in the Expansion Region. It was part of the Galactic Empire and inhabited by Humans who maintained a tradition of big game hunting. One young native hunter was Moradmin Bast, who became an Imperial officer.

Mount Thunderstone was an active volcano on the Forest Moon of Endor. A dark and forbidding place, Thunderstone was home to Morag, the Tulgah witch, who lived in a castle on the mountain until her death in 3 ABY.

The Naboo whale was an aquatic creature native to the southernmost oceans of Naboo. They were hunted by the Gungan company Binks & Son Whaling Company for hundreds of years before Jar Jar Binks was born. On a whaling trip when Jar Jar was hunting with his father, George R.

The lava worm was a hardy, serpentine creature native to the lava pools of Nkllon. Another kind of lava worm was said to inhabit the molten moon Rennokk. A Tarasin named Kum'Jushkin reported his expedition being attacked by one.
The skirmish on Spindrift was a brief battle that was part of Operation Earplug.

Flashpoint Stellar Research Station was a Galactic Republic scientific research station on the Outer Rim planet of Flashpoint that was captured by the Mandalorian warrior clans in 3964 BBY.
CBX-9 was a protocol droid that worked for T'nun Bdu.

Yuuzhan'tar was an extra-galactic, living, sentient planet in a distant galaxy, far from the main galaxy. It was the homeworld of the Yuuzhan Vong species, and had a large asteroid belt ring around its equator.

In 7 ABY, the New Republic starfighter unit Rogue Squadron flew a mission above Imperial City to eliminate remaining elements of the Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front in the wake of the Krytos virus incident on the planet Coruscant.
The Liberation of Kessel was a battle conducted in 4 ABY. A Wookiee army landed on Kessel to re-power the atmosphere factories and rescue the slaves.

Sinded was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Sinded system of the D'Aelgoth sector, a part of the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. By 7 ABY, New Republic General Crix Masst was present on Sinded.
Garnants were small purple insects that lived in underground hives on Yavin 4, and communicated via vibrations and scent. They had stinging bites.

Echo Lake was a lake on the Inner Rim world of Tasariq. It was located in the center of the mining boom-town Roaring Crater. Echo Lake provided oxygen for the crater, and was stocked with fish by the owner of the nearby Lakefresh Restaurant.

The Ammuud Swooper was a skyblue light Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-2400 light freighter which helped at the Battle of Borleias to evacuate the planet. It was heavily damaged and was repaired in the jungle of Borleias, while the Battle was going on.
Bellatrig was one of the four moons that orbited Zelos II.

Yunkor IX was an astronomical object in the Yunkor system, a part of the Jjannex sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, a TIE staging area was located near the astronomical object.

Vornax was a barren planet located within the Vornax system of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet itself was covered in abandoned droid factories and piles of rusted scrap and garbage. The factories had been left disused for centuries.
The Boonta Speeder Race was an annual speeder race that took place on the planet Boonta two days after the Boonta Eve Classic podrace on Tatooine.

The Children were the lost, cannibalistic Human descendants of an Old Republic survey team who crash-landed on Dagobah in 40 BBY. The survey team slowly died of numerous causes, most particularly fever. However, the Children had developed an immunity to the fever and so survived.

objective: Board smuggler ship

DFS-4CT was the designation of a Vulture-class starfighter in the service of the navy of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
DFS-1VR was the designation of a Trade Federation Vulture-class starfighter in the service of the Trade Federation navy during the Invasion of Naboo.

Ganza Park was a park located in the Historical District of Estalle, a city found on Estalle Island on the planet Procopia. The park consisted of a large preserve made up of rock and flower gardens, rolling hills and isolated groups of trees.

The Greenhouse was a large tea house located within Ganza Park in the island city of Estalle on the planet Procopia. The building had a picturesque view of the ocean from where it was built, and was named for the fact its walls were made of heavy crystal glass.

The Fond Memory was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle in the service of the New Republic around 25 ABY. Several months after the Battle of Helska IV it ferried Leia Organa Solo and Elegos A'Kla from Coruscant to Agamar and Dubrillion.
The Merciless was a Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy.

Aspiration was a Victory-class Star Destroyer that came into the Imperial Fleet right after the Battle of Endor and joined Delak Krennel when he installed himself as the Prince-Admiral of the Ciutric Hegemony. It was on station around the fourth planet of the Corvis Minor system.
