x: After Kyle Katarn rescued Crix Madine from Orinackra, the newly defected officer provided the Alliance with information: Rom Mohc was behind the Dark Trooper Project, and the Alliance should destroy two targets in order to disable it.

Skels were a sentient species that dwelled on Hoth. Hunting in packs, they were a primitive people, attacking whatever they could find without warning. They could burrow under the snow, and survive in extremely cold conditions.

The Seyugi Dervishes were a dark side coven that originated on the sulfuric planet of Recopia, located in the Core Worlds. They were founded several centuries before the Battle of Yavin by a Force-sensitive leader of the Seyugi culture named Karrh.

The Wyrd were a dark side coven of Tarasin witches from the planet Cularin who adhered to the dark side of the Force. The Wyrd opposed the presence of off-world settlers on Cularin and believed that Cularin should be inhabited by the Tarasin people only.
The Believers were a Sith cult that practiced the dark side of the Force on the planet Cularin, and was initially dismissed as a rumor by the Jedi Knights.
The Handmaiden Sisters were the six daughters of the Echani General Yusanis. After the Jedi Civil War, they served as handmaidens to Jedi Master Atris in a secret Jedi Academy on Telos IV.

Tough Squadron was one of the two starfighter squadrons made up of smugglers from Dubrillion piloting Lando Calrissian's uglies, the other being Savage Squadron. They fought in the evacuation of Dubrillion and the Battle of Dantooine during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Savage Squadron was one of the two starfighter squadrons made up of smugglers from Dubrillion piloting Lando Calrissian's uglies, the other being Tough Squadron. They fought in the evacuation of Dubrillion and the Battle of Dantooine during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

A Covenant Shadow, or Covenant Shadow agent, was a Jedi agent under the Jedi Covenant who had every last bit of information about their existence erased from all official documentation. They were known to only a few members of the Jedi Covenant.

Gosfamblings were a delicately-furred sentient species native to Gosfambling who were soft spoken and had whiskers. C-Gosf was a Gosfambling senator in the New Republic. They were wary of losers, thus if one lost any type of election, they could not run again.

TDL-3.5 was a TDL nanny droid that was purchased by Anakin Solo. It tried to replace C-3PO as caretaker of the Solo children under a code invented by Anakin, "Bantha four five six." Winter Celchu, who was taking care of the children with C-3PO, recognized that "Bantha four fiv…

The Spicy Lady was a ship designed after the blue prints of the freighter Millennium Falcon, crossed with an A-wing. The A-wing part of the ship was able to detach and distract a fighter while the Falcon part, which carried the cargo, could escape.
Imerria was a world located in the Expansion Region that was known for its windstorms.

The Wingriders were a part of police force of the Drall. They rode on ibbots to patrol the skies of their world. Though they served a security-type role, they also facilitated trade and communication between cities.
The Sayormi were a mysterious species that lived in the Dead Forest, a dark, rotten part of the Kkowir Forest on Kashyyyk.

The Laramus Base Irregulars, or Irregulars for short, were a small company of soldiers that were led by Tagg Pierce. Pierce formed the Irregulars after he was rejected from the Rebel Alliance for insubordination.
The First Sun Mobile Regiment was a mercenary outfit that worked with the Galactic Empire during the height of the Galactic Civil War.
The Black Curs were a band of mercenaries formed months after the Battle of Endor during the Galactic Civil War.
The Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front (PCF) was a terrorist organization of former officers of the Galactic Empire under the command of Kirtan Loor.

The Trade Federation Occupation Council, also known as just the Occupation Council, was a committee of the Trade Federation installed by the megacorporation to oversee the planet Naboo during its invasion.

conflict: Clone Wars (Siskeen theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: The Mission to Ruhe was a mission near the end of the Clone Wars to lay siege to Dooku's citadel on the planet Ruhe.
Harrier was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser under command of the New Republic.
The Fleebogs were a species of tiny, sentient beings characterized by blue skin, red eyes, and a yellow shell.

The Frost Giants were a race of sentients apparently made out of ice, as they could be melted if exposed to fire. They were eight times as large as Ewoks. Their breath could freeze other beings to death.
The Bloodguard was a unit of elite soldiers within the radical Mandalorian splinter group known as the Death Watch.
The Dead Guard was the name given to a group of Wookiees that defended Kkowir Forest on their home world of Kashyyyk, also known as the Dead Forest. Dead Guards wore gray robes.

The Freedom Warriors were an elite group of specially trained soldiers who aided the Jedi Knights of the Old Republic during resource-intensive operations and dealt with responsibilities too politically inconvenient for the Republic's government to directly address.

The Pendarran Warriors were a military group led by Gendal Delan, who worked closely with the Jedi Knights and Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. The Pendarran Warriors fought at the Battle of Dreighton.
The Eternal Pyre was a vast pyre constructed within a natural depression just east of the Valley of the Dark Lords on Korriban.

The Council of Sisters was the key decision-making body of the Singing Mountain Clan. When times of trial and decisions regarding the clan's stance on specific issues arose, members of the clan would look to the guidance of the council, which was composed of the twelve leading…

x: Death Star Troopers were elite Imperial Navy Troopers stationed aboard both the first and second Death Star. They piloted the battle stations to their destinations, guarded prisoners, and also fired the superlaser aboard each, along with Imperial weapons technicians.
The Anya Karu was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer serving the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy during or prior to 3 BBY, shortly before the Galactic Civil War.
The Blood Gutter was a Carrack-class cruiser of the Imperial Navy. By 7.5 ABY, the Blood Gutter was a part of Warlord Zsinj's fleet.
M-HYD 6804, nicknamed Dowser, was a Mini-Huvicko/Yuzabi Dowser binary hydromech droid brought to Tatooine in the Lucky Despot.
The Praesitlyn Defense Force was the unit of the Republic Army stationed on Praesitlyn during the Clone Wars to defend the Intergalactic Communications Center.
LIN-V8M was an armored LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer in service to the Galactic Empire. Originally created to set charges inside ore and spice mines, it had been converted for military use.

WED-15 "Septoid 2" was a treadwell droid on Tatooine. He belonged to Fixer, who used him at his job at Tosche Station. Luke Skywalker was envious of the droid, due to his own treadwell, WED-15-77's limited capabilities.

The Security and Intelligence Council, also known as Palpatine's War Council, or the Military Advisory Council, was a committee of the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars. It consisted of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's most trusted advisers, though membership changed often.
The By'ynium was a heavy cruiser in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. It was commanded by Captain Lench and destroyed at the Battle of Praesitlyn.
Aurek Company was the designation of a company in the Empire of the Hand's 501st Stormtrooper Legion.

The slaatik hagworm was an enormous non-sentient predatory myriapod which lived in the Lianorm Swamp, on Naboo. It was protected by a hard, chitinous exoskeleton, and was vulnerable primarily on its underside. It also had pincers on its tail, and had green and white skin tones.

The Durastar was a starship owned by the New Jedi Order, and used by Daeshara'cor in the early months of the Yuuzhan Vong War. It suffered a hyperdrive failure near Corellia, forcing Daeshara'cor to abandon it.
"Yeoman Scrapheap" was the name the crew of the Mandian gave their protocol droid. It got the name due to the fact that a crewman had stenciled yeoman's stripes onto its forehead.

The Moulee-rah Patogga was a freighter. Its captain was Barada Rakul, and it held a crew of five. Prior to the breakout of the Clone Wars, the vessel was seized after it was discovered to be carrying one hundred metric tons of ryll.
Lucky Star II was a freighter that Daeshara'cor took from Docking Bay 9372 to Vortex in 25 ABY.

Naotebe winglings were invented by Nom Anor and were engineered by Master Shapers to dissolve and eat synthplas and other plastic derivatives. They were fairly large, with white patterns on their wings that resembled eyes.
Humming peepers were hummingbird-like creatures that lived on the forest moon of Endor. The peepers had white feathers and pink bellies. The planet Kegan also had humming peepers.

objective: Rescue Crix Madine
x: After General Rom Mohc captured the defector Crix Madine, Madine was imprisoned on Orinackra, leading Kyle Katarn and Jan Ors to rescue him.

The Corragut were a sentient species hailing from Altawar, a planet in the Core Worlds' Corellian sector. After the species was discovered by Corellians, the Corragut were offered opportunities upon introduction to the wider galaxy.
Chilastra was a MOD-17 container freighter converted to transport refugees from Druckenwell while it was under Yuuzhan Vong occupation.
Gorath was a cruiser that served in the Grand Imperial Navy of Warlord Foga Brill, the Governor of Prakith.
Kauri was an Agave-class picket ship assigned by the New Republic to assist in the capture of the Teljkon Vagabond. It was attacked and badly damaged.
Kettemoor was a Sacheen-class light escort of the New Republic Defense Fleet.
The New Ambition, originally known as the Shadowfire, was a Suwantek TL-1200 transport under the ownership of the Corellian explorer Derrend Montis.

The Nova Prince was a bulk freighter operated by a group of exiles from the Red Nebula during the era of the Galactic Civil War.

Imperial Reunification was a summit that occurred in 12 ABY during the Galactic Civil War on Tsoss Beacon in the Deep Core by Admiral Natasi Daala, with the hope of convincing the warlords to cease their petty rivalries for the good of the fallen Galactic Empire but would retu…
Kilo Squad was a clone commando squad in the Grand Army of the Republic.

The attack at Datar occurred in 1 BBY, during the Galactic Civil War. While the Rebel forces were completely wiped out, the Galactic Empire's forces failure to capture any prisoners meant the battle was also a failure from the Imperial perspective.
Inquisitor was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer used by Grand General Malcor Brashin as his personal starship.
Etherhawk was a Marauder-class corvette of the New Republic Defense Force.
Per Lupelo was a cosmopolitan planet in the Per Lupelo system. It was dotted by a number of clean cities and bodies of water, and it was also dotted with a number of mountain ranges.
This probe ship was used by Princess Leia Organa to scout for possible new locations, including Kharzet III, for the Rebel base after the Battle of Hoth.
Long-necked gundarks were large, quadruped animals with long necks and long tongues which they would use to catch their prey.
Cudgel was the name Darth Maul gave to a Duelist Elite droid he used to train himself in lightsaber combat. As its name suggested, it was armed with a cudgel.
Rapier was the name Darth Maul gave to a Duelist Elite droid he used to train himself in lightsaber combat. As its name suggested, it was armed with a steel rapier.
Chain was the name that Darth Maul gave to a Duelist Elite droid that he used to train himself in lightsaber combat. As its name suggested, it was armed with a metal chain.
Hachete was the name Darth Maul gave to a Duelist Elite droid he used to train himself in lightsaber combat.
Dodonna was a Galactic-class battle carrier in the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet.

Groola's Place was a large underground establishment on Corellia owned by Groola the Hutt. It was located in the city of Tyrena near the city spaceport and contained various levels including a bar, restaurant, casino, games and amusements, private halls, and Groola's Den.
The Raptors were a gang in the undercity of Coruscant. Their main territory was in the Crimson Corridor, and they were feared by many who lived in or around their range of operation.

Sneaky was Jaina Solo's R9 unit assigned to her new StealthX starfighter at the time of the Swarm War. Sneaky was destroyed when Jagged Fel shot down Jaina during the Battle of Tenupe. He was later replaced by Jaina's new R9 unit, Sneaker.

The Coruscant Customs Bureau was the customs enforcement service of the planet Coruscant during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. The Customs Bureau would inspect arriving and departing ships for irregularities in manifests and cargo.
Fondorians were a hairless Near-Humans species from Fondor.

t: Battle of Nar Shaddaa (Galactic Civil War)
x: The Battle of Nar Shaddaa was one of the earliest battles in the Galactic Civil War. At the time, an Imperial task force under Darth Vader's command was searching for Rebel bases in an effort to uncover their supply lines.
Sarconia was the homeworld of green fleas.

The garbage worm was a genetically-manufactured creature, and one of Coruscant's most primitive and essential organisms to the garbage handling system. Any trash not packaged for orbital export was mixed with oils to be processed by the garbage worms.
The Uscru Entertainment District, also simply known as the Entertainment District, was the entertainment area located in the lower levels of the Uscru District on the planet Coruscant.
The Lost Hope was an old, barely-functioning freighter with two sublight engines.

Mordis VI was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Mordis system, a part of the Lambda sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. Acid storms were a weather phenomenon that occurred on Mordis VI's surface.
The Battle of Gormen occurred during the Galactic Civil War. During the engagement, Rebel Alliance forces, including the field commander Major Bren Derlin, were initially victorious.

Pesktda was the capital city of Garqi, a graceful city of broad avenues lined with bimiza trees and dotted with open-air plazas. It was the only consolidated population center on the planet and contained one-quarter of the world population.

The Pesktda Xenobotanical Garden was a garden located in the city of Pesktda on the planet Garqi. A set of bafforr trees was located at the gardens. When the Yuuzhan Vong attacked Garqi, the local defenders and the Jedi made a stand at the gardens.
Obroa-held was a gas giant world located within the Obroa-skai system on the Inner Rim of the galaxy.
Giza was a droid who fought alongside General Lando Calrissian and Tiatkin on the world of Radix during their campaign against the Eiattu pirates. He and Tiatkin flew one of the transports to Radix.

side1: Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification
x: The Battle of Garos occurred during the Galactic Civil War shortly after the end of the Thrawn campaign. The planet Garos IV was freed by the New Republic after years of intense local resistance against the Galactic Empire.
Wlesc was a neighborhood in the city of Pesktda on Garqi, located just east of the Pesktda Xenobotanical Garden. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Yuuzhan Vong used it as a Thrall training area.

The Taanab Sunrise was a Victory-class Star Destroyer that was part of the New Republic's Defense Fleet as of 25 ABY. That year, as part of the Yuuzhan Vong War, it fought Yuuzhan Vong forces over the Outer Rim planet Garqi.
Red Harvest was a Victory-class Star Destroyer in the Starfleet of the Galactic Empire and Imperial Remnant.

result: Jedi Master Yoda is named Defender of the Home Tree
x: The Wookiees of the planet Kashyyyk defended their homeworld from Confederacy of Independent Systems-aligned raiders in 19 BBY during the Clone Wars between the CIS and Galactic Republic.
Agony's Child was a Yuuzhan Vong warship. It was destroyed during the Battle of Ithor due to fire from a Star Destroyer.

result: Orbital bombardment of the planet's surface
x: A lengthy campaign occurred over the course of three months in 5 ABY on the planet Milagro. Milagro was a planet located at an important hyperroute junction and contained large-scale manufacturing facilities.
Penga Rift was a Dobrutz DB-4 starliner converted to research use by the Obroan Institute.

The Rryatt Trail was a long and winding trail that eventually led its travelers to the shadowy surface of Kashyyyk. It started from Rwookrrorro and snaked all the way down to the Well of the Dead in the Shadowlands.
The Battle of Mygeeto was a battle during the Galactic Civil War.
The Liquidator was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer.

Tammarians were a species from Tammar. Because of the relatively small atmosphere on Tammar, Tammarians possessed air sacks which would allow them to survive in vacuum for short periods. They also had intense fear of water, as Tammar was completely lacking in surface water.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: New Republic Fleet Intelligence, also known as New Republic Naval Intelligence or New Republic Military Intelligence, was the intelligence department of the New Republic Defense Fleet.
Home Fleet's Battle Assessment Division was the strategic planning and analysis division of the New Republic Defense Fleet. In 25 ABY it was headed by Colonel Ixidro Legorburu.
New Town was a neighborhood of Bagsho on Nim Drovis.
Old Town was a neighborhood of Bagsho on Nim Drovis. It was crisscrossed by canals and was near the Thousand Stinking Ditches.
The Thousand Stinking Ditches was an area of the city of Bagsho on Nim Drovis. It was located near Old Town.

result: Destruction of Trade Federation convoy and acquisition of munitions
x: A skirmish over Naboo occurred when Bravo Flight pilot Rhys Dallows, mercenary Vana Sage, Toydarian Reti, and Feeorin pirate Nym raided a convoy carrying supplies for the Trade Federation's blockade of Naboo.

Ninn was a small planet located in the Ninn system of the Outer Rim Territories. The world was despoiled and depopulated in an ancient conflict, but was later resettled by a group that became known as the Priests of Ninn.
The Khoonda Militia was an ad hoc militia led by Militia Captain Zherron and his lieutenant, Berun Modrul.

The N-K Project, also known as the N-K series, was a project by Doctor Nycolai Kinesworthy, whom the Galactic Empire hired to enhance combat droid technologies, and established in the Myyydril Caverns of Kashyyyk under the careful eye of the dark side Prophetess Merili.

Armadid was a large, Force-using predator that stalked the mountains of planet Nubia. The creature measured about 3 meters in length and had bony, armored plates on its domed back. It had a short, stocky tail with a crablike pincer at the end.

Schinga shikou were large, predatory, serpents native to Makem Te, and the most prized of the schinga species. A pureblood schinga shikou was roughly eight meters long, with smooth scales along the length of its body and dozens of large white fangs.

Durgolosks were a non-sentient, six-legged species of fearsome predators native to the swamps of the planet Barab I. Members of the species were huge and white and brown in color. They also possessed tentacles that were tipped with venom.

The Ten Mile Plateau was a plateau located to the north of Worlport, deep within the Scraplands on the planet Ord Mantell. A stellar-energy station was established on the top of the plateau, but had been abandoned as of the Galactic Civil War.
The Thurse was a SoroSuub Corporation Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier used in the New Republic's Defense Fleet in 25 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

The Star of Iskin was a Botajef Shipyards AA-9 freighter operational during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, sixteen months after the beginning of the war, it was scheduled to depart the galactic capital of Coruscant with passengers and cargo bound for the Outer Rim.
The Tinta Rainbow was a spaceliner operated by Tinta Lines.
The Tolmea Mountains were a range of sawtoothed peaks that were one of the most spectacular regions on Ord Cestus. The tallest peak was snowcapped Mt. Tolmeatek (height: about 32.000 m).

Beggar's Solace was a Starlight-class light freighter owned by the smuggler Jin-Jin, who stole it from the hangar bay at the academy on Carida where he served as a TIE pilot. His original plan was to steal an advanced TIE fighter, but he was caught in the process.

The Amerce was a New Republic Star Destroyer under construction at the shipyards of the planet Fondor during the beginning of the Yuuzhan Vong War. In 25 ABY, as the Star Destroyer was a month away from completion, Yuuzhan Vong forces attacked the shipyards.
A skirmish occurred at the planet Atzerri during the Galactic Civil War in which a pirate contact of the Rebel Alliance attempted to sell important Rebel military information to the Galactic Empire.
The Raid above Corellia was a minor skirmish during the Galactic Civil War. Han Solo was rescued by the Alliance to Restore the Republic over Corellia.
SCr-114 or "Skar" was originally a maintenance droid aboard the pleasure cruiser Malka'an Eternal, who turned into an assassin droid.

Unmaskers were non-sentient creatures used by the Yuuzhan Vong to scare ooglith masquers and cause them to reveal the identities of their wearers. Unmaskers were ill-tempered, had sharp teeth, and resembled a cross between a ng'ok and a quillarat.

conflict: Clone Wars (Mygeeto theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: The Battle of Acherin was a conflict in the final days of the Clone Wars.

GX-99 was Cragus 12's security droid and was totally loyal to his owner. He had the basic skills and programming of his line of droids, but had gone through numerous modifications and upgrades to enhance his abilities.
The Talorons were a species of sentient, blue-skinned humanoids native to the Wild Space Taloron system. For much of their existence, the Talorons were peaceful farmers and merchants.
The Claw was a modified Kazellis-class light freighter owned by the bounty hunter Cragus 12. It was fast and deadly, armed with a quad laser cannon and shield generators.

As part of Admiral Ackbar's plan to season the New Republic Defense Force's new recruits and wear down the Yuuzhan Vong, Admiral Traest Kre'fey launched a raid on the world of Duro, captured nearly two years earlier.

conflict: Imperial Period conflicts, Great Jedi Purge
x: The Battle of Acherin took place in the months following the end of the Clone Wars.
The Herd Mother was a ship belonging to the Pacithhip prospector, Ketwol. It was an aged vessel, given little care.

The Star Lady was a modified YT-2400 light freighter and the ship of the con-artist duo Fenig Nabon and Ghitsa Dogder. It was in the drydocks of Nal Hutta when Fen and Ghits teamed with Shada D'ukal to deliver Clan Shak females to Durga the Hutt.

conflict: Clone Wars (Felucia theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: A battle took place between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic as part of the Outer Rim Sieges, which were in turn a part of the galaxy spanning conflict called the Clone Wars.
The Middle City was a level of the Tarisian world-city, between the Upper City and the Lower City. It was constructed a couple of centuries before the planet had become a major hub.

The Highport Stevedore Guild was an organization of dock workers in the major spaceport known as Highport in the Upper City of the planet Taris. Active during the era of the Mandalorian Wars, the Guild had clandestine business ties with local hood Marn Hierogryph.
Eastgate was one of the largest commercial and warehouse districts of in the Upper City of the planet Taris.
Torpris was a planet located within the Torpris system of the Core Worlds.

Kvabja was a planet which was ruled over by a monarch called a Mrahash. Presumably, the Mrahash and the planet itself had little military power during the time of the New Republic, and was controlled by a Drach'nam named Chay Praysh and his slaver consortium.
Carnovian eel was a species of gigantic eels that inhabited the deep waters of the planet Carnovia. The pups of these eels were eaten by Hutts as a snack and were raised in pens by Hutt slaves.
Sevarcos was a planet in the Sevarcos system of the Outer Rim Territories that was the site of a battle in 4 ABY in the months after the Battle of Endor.
Altair 3 was a planet in the Altair system.

Spice eels were giant sand and rock burrowing worms native to Sevarcos II. Their average length was 15 meters, but some old specimens were known to grow beyond 30 meters in length and 5 meters in height.

Minetroopers, also known as tunneling underminers, were specialized stormtroopers specifically trained for operating in mining environments. Minetroopers were deployed as security to the spice mines of Sevarcos II and Kessel's mines.

The Southern Deserts were the deserts of the southern hemisphere of Sevarcos II. During the Galactic Civil War, the Southern Deserts were governed by Spice Lord Xerxes Quintas, who allowed the Empire to mine spice in his territories, much to the dismay of many nomadic Sevari c…
Belly-birds were creatures that were native to Yavin 4.

The Carsunum Chariot was a wind catamaran—a special type of wind rider—owned by Spice Lord Lady Trevael. It was sleek black and named after the carsunum spice that was found deep within her mountain lands.
Andris Moon was a slave galley wind rider owned by Spice Lord Cassius Nolath Rha.

The Sevari Cabal was a colony ship sent of on an expedition in the very early days of the Galactic Republic. The ship was lost, but it was later believed that its crew had in reality discovered Sevarcos II and settled the planet, their descendants being the Sevari.
The A'driannamieq Mountains were mountains on the planet Elom. The native Elom and Ranphyx lived in the A'driannamieq Mountains.
The Naboo Royal crusaders were the elite members of the Royal Naboo Security Forces. In battle, they rode large, powerful guarlara steeds and charged into the heart of enemy infantry.

Noob Hill was located in Ruan's Refugee Facility 17 in 25 ABY. It was an area where, after paying Salliche Ag, refugees fleeing the Yuuzhan Vong invasion could attain marginally better accommodations than those available in the main facility.

The crawl-carrier was an espionage and infiltration droid that was used during the Clone Wars and developed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. They were squat and rectangular in shape, with eight legs.
The Integrity was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that had been assigned to the Open Circle Fleet as part of the Galactic Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.
Ground beetles were a species of beetles native to the planet Dagobah.
The Assault on Thyferra was a battle in the Galactic Civil War and the first effort to rout and destroy Moff Kalast, an Imperial traitor.

L'pwacc Den was one of Selonia's underground cities. It contained a spaceport. During the early Yuuzhan Vong War it was the site of large-scale rioting after the New Republic Advisory Council voted to redirect a fleet from Corellia to Bothawui.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: Core Command oversaw the deployment of New Republic military units in the Galactic Core.

side2: Alliance to Restore the Republic and local supporters
x: The Invasion of Fondor was a battle which began as a riot during the Galactic Civil War.

t: Raid on an Imperial cargo convoy
x: Nine months after the Battle of Yavin, the Alliance to Restore the Republic raided an Imperial cargo convoy near the planet Per Lupelo.
Craw-maws were birds that were genetically engineered by food corporations to be silent and wingless. They were raised on Ruan.
Wingles were birds that were genetically engineered by food corporations to be silent and wingless. They were raised on Ruan.
Nightseers were birds that were genetically engineered by food corporations to be silent and wingless. They were raised on Ruan.
Ronay was one of the two moons of Kuat. The moon was home to facilities for testing drives, and was armed. It was not, however, terraformed.

The iceworm, also spelled ice worm, was a burrowing species of annelid native to the ice planet Hoth. The tidal pull of Hoth's three nameless moons caused fissures in the ice-layers of the massive frozen ocean in Hoth's southern hemisphere, sending jets of ocean water into the…
Evanrue was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in the New Republic Defense Fleet. In 9 ABY, it was part of the fleet assigned to defend Coruscant, and participated in the Siege of Coruscant.

result: Black Sun pirate leader captured and interrogated
x: During the Galactic Civil War, a battle between the Galactic Empire and the Black Sun pirates in the Ilum system in an effort to discover the identity of an Imperial traitor who attempted to jeopardize the Empire's operations on Thyferra.

The Mikans were a sentient species native to the asteroid Mika, also known as Jellyfish Cove. They took the form of beautiful near-Human women; however, once they had attracted someone to them, they turned into huge jellyfish-like creatures and consumed their targets.

"Millie" was the name given to a MILL-247-EE emergency service droid on Tem Chesko's freighter. She had a female personality, and was built to resemble a green-skinned humanoid female. She had blue sensors.

Grumphs were large lizards that were native Nimba Five. Their bodies covered with spines, and each hand was capped with sharp claws. No Human before the lucky Sam Heggs had ever survived to see one. Their eggs were purple and were found in shallow pits of snow.
The Rintonne's Flame was an obsolete Bayonet-class light cruiser serving in the Elrood sector. It was commanded by Captain Dongal Tezrin.

Point Modie was the capital city of the planet of Maramere. In it was the cantina The Silver Cloud. The people of this city were also the victims of Captain Cavik Toth's (Sabaoth Squadron) Trihexalon test.
The altagak was a reptilian creature from the planet Altora. Known for its cunning, stealth, and speed, the altagak was thought to be the apex predator of its homeworld.
The Lark was a private transport from the planet Eedoq which was destroyed by Imperial forces just prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Tauve was a major city on the planet Algara II located on the continent of Dysis. A number of Imperial Resistance cells operated in the city.
Kel was a major city on the planet Algara II located on the continent of Dysis.
Kren was a major city on the planet Algara II located on the continent of Tronis.
Melaana was one of the two capitals of Soterios. The other capital was New Melaana.
New Melaana was one of the two capitals of Soterios. The other capital was Melaana.
Kryndyn was the capital and most populous city of Zelos II. Like the planet's other cities, it was surrounded by a 10-meter high wall with six gates. It had a garrison of 50,000 troops.

The Anti-Terrorism Unit, also known as the Anti-Terrorist Unit or simply ATU, was a specialized police division of the Coruscant Security Force designed to perform counter-intelligence work and combat terrorist activities on the planet Coruscant.
The Third General Survey was an exploration of spiral arms of the the galaxy launched on 145 BBY by the Galactic Republic. It was responsible for finding the planet Brath Qella.

Mount Yeroc was a tall mesa that was located on the planet Tahlboor, in the Tion Hegemony. Located within the mountain was the Sky cannon, an ancient device that had been constructed by an extinct Tahlboorean civilization.

Hobors were one of the two divisions of the Tahlboorean species, the other being the Troobs. The two were often at war. Hobors had purple skin and lived a tribal life, many of them refusing to learn Basic. They were led by Chief Nimondro.

Troobs were one of the two variants of the Tahlbooreans, the others being the Hobors. The two races were constantly at war. The Troobs had blue skin, and embraced technology and Galactic society. Around 5.5 BBY their leader was General Krax.
The Thunderbolt was a large, state-of-the-art freighter owned by Peckhum.
The starship Kai Mir was the freighter of the Duro smuggler Ellor.
Sky City was a city and spaceport located on the northernmost end of the continent of Landra on Lianna. Of the two cities located on Landra—the other being Northwest—it was the oldest of the two.
Landra was the smaller of the two continents on the planet Lianna. It was the location of the cities of Northwest and Sky City.

The Monarch was an Imperial Star Destroyer, commanded by Captain Averen and serving under Director of Imperial Intelligence Ysanne Isard. It was one of two ships left to defend Imperial Center against the impending New Republic invasion.

The Ravager was a Lancer-class frigate serving the Imperial Navy after the Battle of Endor. It was part of the Rachuk sector fleet under Admiral Devlia and was sometimes paired with the Carrack Cruiser Expeditious.
81-X was a OG-9 homing spider droid of the Commerce Guild. It participated in the First Battle of Geonosis
The Blue Diver was a Mon Calamari heavy carrier operated by the Galactic Alliance out of the Second Fleet in the years following the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Gorts were small creatures with blue feathers. They had a flat beak, three toes, a thin tail, and three eye stalks with one eye on top. They were kept as pets, and their eggs (whose shells were a translucent pinkish-pearl) were considered valuable in many cultures.

The Imperial Information Center was a facility located deep within the bedrock of Coruscant, part of the Imperial Palace complex. It serviced the Palace of the Republic before it was inherited by the Galactic Empire, and later the New Republic.
The Great Hall was a large auditorium built by the Rebel Alliance in their hidden base on Arbra. It was used for ceremonies where a large number of Alliance personnel would attend.
The Seven Dark Jedi referred to Jerec and his six Dark Jedi companions, who were intent on locating the Valley of the Jedi and exploiting it for their own dark purposes.
Four Oh Vee Niner was the designation assigned to a TIE/IN interceptor of the Imperial Navy.
The Battle of Harrsk's fortress was a skirmish in the Imperial Civil War.

An isolated planet in the Outer Rim Noonian sector, Odryn was the chief colony world of the warlike Feeorin species. Known as a world of climatic extremes, Odryn was covered in jungles and mountains, into the sides of which the Feeorin built their settlements.
The Oroko was a transport ship that served as a mobile base for the pirate Valius Ying's gang during the Mandalorian Wars.

Friijillis was a planet in the Dail sector. The Hutt-sponsored news network, the Friij News Services—the clearing house of illegal information and data replication, controlled by the Tenloss Criminal Syndicate—was based on this planet.

Corlax 4, or simply Corlax, was a planet located within the Allied Tion sector of the Outer Rim Territories. An unremarkable industrial world, during the Clone Wars almost 300 million Humans inhabited the planet, working mostly as laborers.

Cuthbern was a desolate wasted moon in the Wazta sector of the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. It was known for its factories that produced extremely high quality weapons, including the Star Anvil blaster rifle. It was annexed by the Empire and its population was enslaved.
Doulos was a barren moon of the planet Atraken in the Kattellyn system.

Droxine was a planet located in the Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the carchar and nightmare demon species, although the latter—intelligent, telepathic killers—were believed to have been eradicated by the time of the Clone Wars.
Droxu was a ringed moon in the Cignet system on the Outer Rim of the galaxy.
Dwor was a celestial body situated in the Dwor system, a part of the Steniplis sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Enarc was a planet of the Demophon system. It was a frigid ball of rock. It was destroyed when the star Demophon exploded as a supernova during the Galactic Civil War.
Chunky was an R5 unit assigned to Tyria Sarkin Tainer of Wraith Squadron.

Peekoine was a planet. There were four Landslashers located on the planet. Landslashers 1, 2, and 3 maintained the canals of the planet. Landslasher-4 carved new canals. It was orbited by the space diner Mother's. Peekoine was home to to The Gutterwipes, a swoop gang.
The Yavaris was an escort frigate in the Alliance Fleet and New Republic Navy. When the New Republic attacked Maw Installation, it served as the command ship for General Wedge Antilles.

Mount Merakan was the tallest mountain on the planet Maramere, on the world's largest island. Prior to the First Battle of Geonosis, the Trade Federation established a base of operations within the mountain.

The Jedi Covenant was a secret organization of Jedi headquartered on Coruscant in the time of the Old Sith Wars. It was established after the Great Sith War by Krynda Draay, who felt that not sensing the fall of Exar Kun to the dark side was her failing.
Nosken was a gas giant planet. Several years before 400 BBY the TriGas Corporation attempted to set up a dirigible mining operation on this world, which ultimately failed.
A marsh haunt was a Force-using red-eyed creature.
The Churhee's Riflemen were a specialized low profile mercenary group located on the fringes of the Outer Rim Territories.

Grain maggots were a species of insect which members of the sentient Hutt species would roast and eat. After roasting, most maggots would lie in crispy husks although some would continue to squirm in an attempt to survive, although all would be eaten, dead or alive.
The Sith wyrm was a massive creature that lived on the fourth moon of Yavin in large subterranean lairs.

The Battle of the Chaardan Shipyards was a battle that took place during the Galactic Civil War, the first such engagement since Admiral Daala had unified various warlord-controlled territories into the United Warlord Fleets.
Govia was a planet in the Govia system, a star system in the Corellian sector of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of the Govian species.

The Battle of Baskarn was a minor battle in the Galactic Civil War, in which an Imperial commander in charge of a long range recon mission discovered the secret Rebel Advance Base Baskarn and decided to attack on the spot.
AB-4 was a protocol droid that served at the Advance Base Baskarn on Baskarn. It was programmed for bureaucracy and was in charge of base logistics and equipment.

The mmhmm butterfly was an insect native to the jungles of the planet Baskarn. They sometimes covered every tree and bush in sight in the jungle. The mmhmm butterflies served as a food source for the native Yrashu people and could be picked like ripe fruit.
The Hrosma tiger was a large feline predator with a horn on its forehead. It was native to Baskarn. It was Force-sensitive and thus a very dangerous and ferocious hunter.

Tusk-cats, also spelled as Tusk Cats, were non-sentient carnivorous felines found on the grasslands of the planet Naboo. They used the grass as cover when hunting herbivores. They had a long muscular tail and pair of tusks growing from their lower jaws.

Saber 1, also designated as Saber Leader, was an Imperial Navy TIE/IN interceptor manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems. Saber 1 had the serial number 000004, and also bore a bloodstripe, representing a minimum of ten kills.

Scythe 1 was a TIE/LN starfighter of Scythe Squadron during the Battle of Endor. Flown by Major Mianda, Scythe 1 featured the same upgraded Sienar Fleet Systems P-w702 maneuvering jets as the other fighters in its unit, which increased performance in tight quarters.
Hardpoint Squadron was a starfighter squadron that was entirely composed of Jedi pilots flying XJ6 X-wings. The unit was in existence as of 40 ABY.

Malklocs were large creatures native to Dathomir, where they were near the top of the food chain despite them being herbivorous herd beasts. Because they were so big, only rancors could take them down.

objective: Kidnap the Solo children
x: The kidnapping on Munto Codru was an Empire Reborn mission.

The Elegant Wake was a Sy Myrthian liner that was scuttled by Merson pirates in 22 BBY. It left Coruscant for Sy Myrth on 13:3:3, with 456 passengers onbaord, all Sy Myrthian. The ship skirted the Merson asteroid belt, where five Merson ships attacked the unarmed liner.

result: Kyle Katarn finds an Imperial repeater rifle
objective: Find evidence of super warriors
Find Moff Rebus
x: After discovering the initials M.R. on a weapon at the destroyed Tak Base, Kyle Katarn sought out the weapons designer Rebus on Anoat.

The Malkite Poisoners, also known as the Poisoners of Malkii, were adept assassins who trained in and perfected their poisoning arts on the planet Malkii, where they got the ingredients for many of their deadly poisons.

The Muza were a sentient species native to the planet Muzara, in the Expansion Region. The Muza were large, strong beings with massive overbites and scoop-like teeth. Their forearms were highly muscular.
The Kimogila was a huge reptilian creature, quite similar to the krayt dragon of Tatooine, that was native to the planet Lok.

Gurrcats were wild carnivorous creatures native to the planet Corellia. They roamed the Corellian plains in packs, and if one of their group members were attacked, the whole pack would savagely defend it.
A kusak was a partially armored predatory canine from the planet of Lok. Kusaks usually roamed the rocky terrain hunting in packs. If one tamed a kusak, it was loyal until death.

Spined snakes, also called spined vipers, were snakes native to Lok. They lived hiding among the rocks and sand of the deserts of their homeworld. These predator snakes had venomous spikes along the top ridge of its body and only hunted at daytime.

Snorbals were grazing herd animals from the planet Lok. They were found among the arid wastelands of their homeworlds. Snorbal were highly intelligent and docile creatures, rarely attacking other than to defend their herd.
Perleks were flying creatures that lived on Lok. They usually followed predators to scavenge off the carcasses left behind.

Gurks were hairy humanoids native to the planet Lok. Despite their large size and their worrisome appearance, they were very peaceful animals. They ate primarily nuts, berries, and fruit. These creatures were known for their loud yell.

The gurnaset was a species of peaceful quadruped herd animal that was native to the world of Lok. It would lay eggs and eat insects and shrubs as well as small animals like frogs or lizards. Its meat was tough and gamy.
A battle occurred in 36 ABY during the Swarm War, when Luke Skywalker hunted down Lomi Plo to Sarm, though she escaped to Tenupe.
Licha In was a world of the Gree Enclave and the first to suffer from the degeneration of Gree society.
Lonatro was a world located within the Gree Enclave and served as the primary provider of foodstuffs to the Gree.
Malanose was a planet in the Gree Enclave, on the Outer Rim of the galaxy, which served as the primary world containing the Crafter and Researcher castes of the Gree civilization.
YVH 1-507A was a YVH 1 droid protecting the Solos during the Battle of Coruscant.

Urjani was a Rebel Alliance Neutron Star-class Bulk Cruiser that was destroyed by the Death Star II during the Battle of Endor. It was a part of the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence task force at Sullust prior to its destruction.
The Greenputt Governing Council was a committee headquartered in Tecave City on the planet Cerea. The group oversaw the major leagues of greenputt, a ball game played on a field.
Anakin Sal-Solo was the self-given name of a droid that controlled Centerpoint Station in 40 ABY and believed itself to be the resurrected Anakin Solo.

The Great InQuestors of Judgment also known as Great InQuestors of Justice was a secret division of Judgment in the Pentastar Alignment. A known rank in the Great InQuestors of Judgement was the Zenithal InQuestor of Judgement.

The Bothan Spynet was a well-organized intelligence network that was active during the time of the Galactic Civil War. A Kupohan named Sakhet occasionally did contract work for the Bothan spynet, running a small noodle hut as a front of her intelligence services.

Carnivorous mold in the rainforests of Nim Drovis were producers of acid, capable of eating through flesh on contact. The Drovians and Gopso'o exterminated the mold with flamethrowers and acidthrowers.

objective: Save Anakin from being sacrificed to Waru
x: The Confrontation on Crseih Station was the final conflict between the Empire Reborn and the New Republic forces on Crseih Research Station.
Garollian ghost vipers were creatures native to a location within the Garollia system of the Expansion Region's Baroli sector. The ghost vipers had tongues that they could move rapidly.
The Bestine Imperial garrison, also known as the Imperial fort, was an Imperial garrison located on top of a small mountain overlooking the capital city of Bestine on the planet Tatooine.

The Aalagar were a subspecies of the Bith, a sentient species from Clak'dor VII. The Aalagar lived on remote islands, isolated from other Bith communities. The Aalagar developed a form of communication that involved tying knots of string to convey elaborate symbology.
The Vratixan blood eagle was a species of bird native to the rainforests of the Inner Rim planet Thyferra. The birds had a wingspan of over four meters and were covered in waxy red feathers.
Proto One, also known as Proto Number 1, was a rickety Proto Droid who rebuilt himself using assorted replacement parts after he was discarded by his original organic masters.
Echnos City was the capital of the moon Echnos. It was a technology-rich city encased in a giant atmosphere providing dome.
Squad Eight was a droideka squad stationed on Invisible Hand during the Battle of Coruscant.
Squad Sixteen was a super battle droid squad stationed on Invisible Hand during the Battle of Coruscant.
A group of silicon-based sentient invertebrates, related to mynocks, evolved on a lone asteroid in the MZX32905 system near Bimmiel.

result: Fragmentation of the New Jedi Order
Start of the Third Jedi Purge
x: The Massacre at Ossus, also known as the Fall of Ossus, Massacre on Ossus, Attack on Ossus, Assault on Ossus or the Ossus massacre, was a conflict that occurred in 130 ABY, two days after the fall of Coruscant.

Sith Intelligence and Assassination was an agency of the One Sith of Darth Krayt. It was in charge of espionage, political assassination, interrogation and torture. Around 130 ABY, it was headed by Darth Maladi. Jor Torlin was one of its ranking agents.
The Grinning Liar was a YX-1980 space transport vessel employed by smugglers Chak and Kee.

The Imperial Mission was a missionary society that was in service to the Emperor of the Fel Empire. It was established by Jagged Fel whose missionaries devoted themselves to service so to peacefully spread influence by providing aid to people and planets, and to help those gen…
The Assault on Ruul occurred early in the Galactic Civil War.
Market Street was a location in the Upper City of the Outer Rim world of Taris in the era of the Mandalorian Wars. It was the site of the Market Street Outdoor Exchange, a well-known outdoor market.
The Market Street Outdoor Exchange was a well-known outdoor market on Market Street, located in the Upper City of the Outer Rim world Taris during the time of the Mandalorian Wars.

Jebble was a frozen world located in the Ojoster sector of the Outer Rim. A target for ice miners, Jebble served as a resource world for the nearby ecumenopolis of Taris, and fell under threat when the Mandalorian Neo-Crusader hordes began encroaching upon Taris in the early w…

Tarnith was an Outer Rim Territories world situated in the Ojoster sector. It was a resource world for the planet Taris, and in 3966 BBY, it began to be threatened by the Mandalorian Neo-Crusader warriors.
Black 3 was a TIE fighter assigned to Black Squadron. The starfighter was flown by TIE pilot DS-61-3, nicknamed "Backstabber," and the craft was stationed aboard the first Death Star.
Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, Obsidian 10 was a TIE/ln starfighter serving the Imperial Navy's Obsidian Squadron, which was piloted by OS-72-10.
Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, Obsidian 7 was the designation of a TIE/ln starfighter serving the Imperial Navy's Obsidian Squadron by 3 ABY.
Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, Obsidian 1 was the lead TIE/ln starfighter of the Galactic Empire's Obsidian Squadron.
The Cantham House Meetings, also known as the Cantham talks, were a series of meetings between Senators Bail Organa, Mon Mothma, and occasionally Garm Bel Iblis at Cantham House on Coruscant.

Scimitar Squadron was a New Republic fighter group consisting of RZ-1 A-wings. During the time of the Yuuzhan Vong invasion the unit was led by Colonel Ijix Harona. After the victory at Obroa-skai, the Scimitars were stationed at the Republic's forward base on Kashyyyk.

Scimitar 2 was a TIE/sa bomber manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems that served in the Imperial Navy's Scimitar Squadron. At one point, the bomber was struck by an asteroid in the Anoat system and underwent repairs.
The Ossus Project was a major project between the New Jedi Order and the Yuuzhan Vong. It coordinated from the planet Ossus, and overseen by Kol Skywalker and Nei Rin of the Shaper caste.
The Moonshadow was a Corellian starship used by smuggler and con artist Rik Duel.

sector: Abrion sector; The Cloak of the Sith
x: The rainbow comets of the Cloak of the Sith nebula were for centuries the only method for finding safe passage to the planet Roon. Annually, the comet would find its path through the hazardous spaceway on its way to briefly orbit the system's sun.

The Grand Concourse was a large, canyon-like hallway that ringed the Grand Convocation Chamber in the Senate Building on Coruscant. Leading from the Atrium of the Senate, it allowed access to the lower tier of the Senate Building, and ascended up and around the Senate Chamber.
Caballa City was the capital city of Exocron.
The Avoni were the indigenous species of Avon. In 27 BBY, the Avoni attempted to conquer Radnor after a bioplague struck the planet, which resulted in death followed by evacuation.
Primor was one of the four moons of Kidron.
Segual was one of the four moons of Kidron.

An Ethrani ourobouros was a creature from the Ethrani system of the Valahari sector, a part of the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories. Ethrani ourobouroi were known for devouring their own tails.

The Nord were a dwarf-like, three-foot-tall humanoid species native to Nordra. They were a hardy race that had learned to live under constant threat of danger from the harsh environment of their homeworld.

The Piton were a species from the planet Piton with pale skin. They were known for being tall and thin, with high foreheads. They also had near-white eyes. Most Pitons lived underground, causing them to have translucent skin and no hair.
Jangelle was a planet in the Kathol sector. A temperate world of sandy lowlands, it was crossed with many interlinking rivers, streams and deltas, although it had few large bodies of water.

A battle occurred on the planet Ord Sedra during the Yuuzhan Vong War, the defeat of a slave-raiding group by Jedi Master Kyle Katarn, New Republic Intelligence agent Jan Ors, and Lieutenant Pallin of the Imperial Army.

x: During the conflict with the Disciples of Ragnos–a Sith cult dedicated to the resurrection of the Sith Lord Marka Ragnos, Jedi Master Luke Skywalker of the New Jedi Order sent Jedi Master Kyle Katarn and his apprentice Jaden Korr on a mission to Vjun to stop the Disciples of R…

The Nezriti Organization was a criminal group that operated during the Galactic Civil War. In 3.5 ABY, shortly after the Battle of Hoth, the Nezriti Organization sent a petition of alliance to Prince Xizor, Underlord of the powerful Black Sun crime syndicate.
Raptor-wasps were flying insects from Corellia that lived in colonies.
The Civilian Protection Guild was a small group of sentients on Kashyyyk who dedicated their time to the protection of the citizens of that planet.

The Ghrag Mercenaries were one of the many enemies of the Civilian Protection Guild, particularly of Eyma, one of its members, on the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk. They had a base in the Tyyyn Nebula. In 1 ABY, the Ghrag stole a CR90 corvette from the Civilian Protection Agency.

Kumru was a thriving industrial world positioned along the Corellian Trade Spine in the Javin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was originally governed by the Mugaari species, who surrendered their territorial holdings to the Galactic Republic following hostilities.

Graith was the capital of Goroth Prime. It was the largest and most populous of the planet's o'bekis. It was also the seat of the P'Dar'Ken and the Colonial Government, as well as the location of the corporate headquarters for the various rights holders allowed to operate on G…
Marter An was the capital of Sheris. This city had a spaceport.

Halbara One was the capital of Halbara. All operations of the Halbara's mines were run from Halbara One. Its facilities included a spaceport, an ore loading facility, a small Radell Mining Corporation office building, and an apartment complex for the miners.
Tolea Biqua, sometimes known as TB, was a floating city on Genarius, considered the twin city of Varna Biqua, and built at the direction of crime lord Riboga the Hutt.
The Sureshot was a CEC YT-1300 light freighter.
Jacelle was the capital city of Sirpar. An Imperial starport, it was located on an island on the equator of the planet and had a pleasant climate.

Protazk was a terrestrial world located in the Protazk system, a part of the Kwymar sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the site of Spuma Flats, a region that shared its name with the Seswenna sector planet Spuma.
Sorontill was one of the four continents on the planet Essowyn. It was located in the north-western hemisphere. The other three continents were Baslar, Steltout, and Macor.
Baslar was one of the four continents of the planet Essowyn. It was located in the south-western hemisphere. The other three continents were Sorontill, Steltout, and Macor.
Steltout was one of the four continents of Essowyn. It was located in the north-eastern hemisphere. The other three continents were Baslar, Sorontill, and Macor.
Macor was one of the four continents of the planet Essowyn. It was located in the south-eastern hemisphere. The other three continents were Baslar, Steltout, and Sorontill.
Hilissa was a city of the planet Essowyn, the Saurton homeworld. It was located in the north-western hemisphere, on the continent of Sorontill. It contained the planet's main spaceport.

Lis'an was a city located on the Mid Rim planet Antiquity. It was a quiet spaceport town on the edge of the South Mudflats. It mainly consisted of plasticrete structures. It had one tavern that smelled like garbage.
The Dolandu were a white-furred humanoid species native to the moon Skalokor. They worked as trappers and mountaineers, forming small settlements for trading purposes.

Vondrel was a city located on the planet Meastrinnar and a sister city to the similarly-named Vondrol. An insurgency against the Galactic Empire took root on Meastrinnar at the time of the Galactic Civil War.

The Jante were a species native to the planet of Jante. They were locked in an arms race against the nearby Freda, who eventually attacked Jante industrial plants on Rett II. The Galactic Empire, led by Moff Haveland, ordered a ceasefire, from which the Freda eventually withdrew.

The Aquar were a water-breathing near-Human species inhabiting the planet Velusia. The Aquar were an offshoot of Humans who colonized Velusia thousands of years ago and evolved into their present form.
Belvarian firegnats were glowing insects from the Belvaria system that flew in swarms. They blinked red and green.

The swamp-planet Betshish was home to a sentient species. Their homeworld, which was located on the Pinooran Spur hyperlane of the Gordian Reach sector, between the Mogoshyn and Kli'aar systems, was scouted by colonists from Setor looking for possible sites for a colony.

The Yatir were a humanoid, sentient species. They were native to the planet Absit, located in the south-western portion of the Outer Rim. During the Galactic Civil War, the Yatir were sympathetic to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Main Avenue was a part of Beggar's Canyon. It led to Dead Man's Turn.
Hullis was the capital city of the planet Halmad.
The Plains panther was a type of predator native to the planet Froswythe.
Fellon was a major port city on Halmad. A small Imperial base was located here before being destroyed during Operation Groundquake.

Takari was a small city on the planet Iyuta in the Fakir sector. It was considered to be a resort town, where outrageous prices were charged for lodgings and food. Takari was served by the Iyuta spaceport where docking fees for mediocre facilities was expensive.

Rellidir was the capital of Tralus. It contained the Navos Center for the Performing Arts and the Terkury Housing Complex. In 40 ABY, it had a population of 1 million, the largest center on the world.

result: Reformation of the Fel Empire into the Sith Empire
Beginning of the Second Imperial Civil War
x: This attack was the last battle of the Sith–Imperial War. In 127 ABY, following the failure of the Ossus Project—an effort to restore planets damaged during the earlier Yuuzhan Vong War—the Fel Empire declared war on the Galactic Alliance.
Gallisport was the capital city of Shesharile 5, a large moon in the Shesharile system. It was a crowded, run-down city, filled with huge industrial installations.

The Alderaan Ascendancy Contention (also known as the Alderaanian Ascendancy Contention) was a political conflict taking place in 32 BBY between the noble families of the Core world Alderaan, the houses of Antilles and Organa in particular, over which of them was entitled to t…
Averists were the natives of the planet Averam.
The Sith Triumvirate was a loose alliance of three Sith Lords that controlled what remained of Darth Revan's Sith Empire after the end of the Jedi Civil War.
The Assassin's Guild, also known as the Assassins Guild, the Assassin Guild, or as the league, was an organization active during the Imperial Era, the members of which were freelance assassins.

The Defense Hierarchy, also known as the Chiss military command or Chiss command, was a military command of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force that consisted of its senior officers, including Admiral Ar'alani.
The trantor pigeon was a type of gray bird that lived on Coruscant and Trantor.

The Caravel was the personal starship of Mungo Baobab. Following Mungo's capture in The Cloak of the Sith, Caravel was briefly captured by Roon's Governor Koong before eventually being returned to its owner.

The Battle of Foerost took place in 20.1 BBY, the second year of the Clone Wars. Since the war's outset, the Galactic Republic had blockaded the Techno Union's Foerost Shipyards, hoping to prevent them from supplying starships to the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Imperial Navy Intelligence, also called Fleet Intelligence or Naval Intelligence, was the military intelligence branch of the Imperial Starfleet. Spurch Goa once worked as an investigator for it.

Destabilization, also known as Destab, was a branch of Imperial Intelligence's Bureau of Operations. Their operations were kept quiet, as details of their activities—which ranged from legitimate Intelligence operations to full scale atrocities—were enough to make most agents s…
Slitherettes were a species of snake that hailed from a distant Outer Rim planet. The limbless reptiles could be thirty centimeters long and bright orange in color. They possessed small fangs.
The Kothlis asteroid field orbited Kothlis in a parabolic orbit. It was possibly the remains of a fourth moon or large single asteroid that was destroyed.

A battle at Ixtlar was one of several taking place between the Republic's Victory Fleet and the Separatist's Bulwark Fleet. The battle was inconclusive as the Bulwark Fleet remained a threat, forcing the Victory Fleet to pursue it further.

A battle at Alsakan was one of several taking place between the Republic's Victory Fleet and the Separatist's Bulwark Fleet. The battle was inconclusive as the Bulwark Fleet remained a threat, forcing the Victory Fleet to pursue it further.

A battle at Basilisk was one of several taking place between the Republic's Victory Fleet and the Separatist's Bulwark Fleet. The battle was inconclusive as the Bulwark Fleet remained a threat, forcing the Victory Fleet to pursue it further.
The Home was a large iron asteroid in a star system designated MZX32905, near Bimmiel. The name was a translation of what the sapient mynock-like indigenous species called it.

Blue 5, also known as Blue Squadron 5, was an A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The fighter was part of Blue Squadron during the Battle of Endor, and was flown by Sullustan pilot Ten Numb.
The Storm was a modified Hapan Miy'til starfighter used by Prince Isolder.

The Roon Sea was the main body of water on the planet Roon. Explorer Mungo Baobab, along with his droids R2-D2 and C-3PO, traversed this sea in their search for the roonstones. After evading the maniacal Governor Koong's slave galley, the trio was sucked towards a whirlpool.
Death, formerly known as Dying Slowly, was a town on the planet Jubilar. It contained a spaceport and was a noted center for smuggling.
R2-X9 was an astromech droid that worked in the the Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards during the Galactic Civil War.
The Fel Swoop was a cantina located in Treasure Ship Row in Coronet City on Corellia.

The Serpent Masters were a group of scavengers led by Supreme Serpent Master Tyrann on Ophideraan during the Galactic Civil War. These scavengers were based in the Great Well, and commonly wore salvaged stormtrooper armor. They carried power lances that fired disrupter rays.

The Great Well was a large sinkhole on the planet Ophideraan that contained the main source of water on the arid world, and contained the breeding ground for the distinctive flying serpent species that dominated Ophideraan's skies.

079 was the designation of the Z-95 Headhunter starfighter that was used by Mara Jade in the years following her service as an Emperor's Hand and during her time as a part of Talon Karrde's organization.

The Zulirian Swordmasters were a group of blade wielding sword collectors who were founded on the planet Zuliria by Ther-das. As time went on, the group members discovered that they were gifted 'swordsmen' and combatants.
The Asteroid Dancer was a CEC YT-1500 freighter that came to Nova Station in 27 ABY.
Corellian Customs was the customs agency for the planet Corellia.
Corellian Immigration was the immigration agency for the planet Corellia.
The Gentleman Caller was an Corellian runabout owned by Tendra Risant Calrissian.
The Wicked Pleasure was Senator Viqi Shesh's KDY yacht. It had a roof-mounted turret and was based at Eastport's Docking Bay 3732.
Imthitill was an atoll-city on the planet Ando that possessed cylindrical white towers and was home to members of the Aqualish species.

The Kierra was the ship of the Corellian smuggler Thaddeus Ross. She was a YT-1300 transport whose computer systems were inhabited by a droid consciousness of the same name with a feminine voice and personality.
Khoehng Heights was a mountain named after the play, Uhl Eharl Khoehng, performed beneath it. It was located on the planet Trulalis.
A 3D-4 administrative droid was a 3D-4 administrative droid from the planet Ando.

Vlarnya was the largest city on Courkrus. It contained several cantinas, including The Warren, the Mynock Hole, Margath's on Elshandruu Pica, and The Crash, and casinos. The Aviary was a section of town.
Rock Squadron was the lowest-ranked of the five Khuiumin Survivors starfighter squadrons.
True Invids were the members of the Invids who directly crewed the Invidious. Their starfighter squadrons included Blade Squadron, Saber Squadron, and Pike Squadron.
The Brigands were a gang of outlaws headed by Gideon Longspar who raided the moisture farms in and around the town of Garrotine on the planet Beheboth.

The Diathim, also known as the Angels as a result of spacers mistaking them for such beings, were a mysterious species of winged sentients who inhabited the moons of the planet Iego, specifically living on the largest moon, Millius Prime.
The Fastblasters were the pirate crew of the Fastblast, and were affiliated with the Invids. Their membership included Humans and Kubaz.
Hawk Squadron was one of the five clutch squadrons that formed the backbone of the Khuiumin Survivors.
Slash Squadron was a clutch squadron of the Invids. It was commanded by Captain Wallon.
Kira II was the second planet in the Kira system, originally named Kira Prime by explorers from the Old Republic.

Sand Worms or sandworms were rare creatures that lived deep in their burrowed holes in the desert sands of Tatooine. They traveled very fast underground and were hard to catch in a fight, and were a favorite food of the Krayt dragon.
The goa lawah were a native species of bird on the planet Vortex. Their saliva contained toxic bacteria. The birds constructed nests in the grassy plains of Vortex, where they laid their eggs.
The Herlixx were omnivorous swamp creatures native to the planet Kasiol 3 who were comfortable on both land and in the water. They were 45 centimeters tall and stood on their rear stubby legs.

Magus were a peaceful non-sentient species found in the deserts of the planet Reopi. They were hunted for their hide, which they used along with noxious secretions to defend themselves from predators. They hunted reptiles and insects by burrowing.
R2-S4 was an R2-series astromech droid given to Pike Angeles to help him conduct tests on the modifications he was applying to the Rebel Alliance's first fleet of Y-wings on the planet Dantooine.

Blade Squadron was a starfighter squadron that served with the True Invids under renegade Admiral Leonia Tavira. It was one of the three clutch squadrons stationed aboard the Invidious, and participated in the Battle of Xa Fel alongside a similar unit from the Khuiumin Survivors.

Saber Squadron was a starfighter squadron that served with the True Invids under renegade Admiral Leonia Tavira. It was one of the three clutch squadrons stationed aboard the Invidious, and participated in the Battle of Xa Fel alongside a similar unit from the Khuiumin Survivors.

Pike Squadron was a starfighter squadron that served with the True Invids under renegade Admiral Leonia Tavira. It was one of the three clutch squadrons stationed aboard the Invidious, and participated in the Battle of Xa Fel alongside a similar unit from the Khuiumin Survivors.
Tuskettes were a non-sentient species of tusked mammals that lived feral on the planet Courkrus. Members of the Hutt species ate tuskettes raw as palate cleansers.

Kivans were the people native to the planet Kiva. They were a peaceful people, known by many as artists and architects. When life on Kiva was wiped out by an experiment, they remained as disembodied wraiths. They appeared as shadows with red eyes.

The Hinthra was Elis Helrot's starship of choice. It was a highly modified freighter. He usually smuggled slaves or spice to and from Kala'uun. It was armed with a pair of double blaster cannons. The crew consisted of two other Givins and a male Human.
The battle of Xa Fel was fought at Xa Fel in 11 ABY between the Imperial pirates Invids and the New Republic.
The Farghul were felinoid sapients indigenous to Farrfin. They had claws, incredible strength and speed, and were covered with tawny fur and possessed prehensile tails.
The Battle of Kabray was a skirmish in the Nagai invasion of 4 ABY.

x: The Mission to Ruusan was a mission undertaken by New Republic mercenary Jan Ors and Jedi Knight Kyle Katarn, who sought to stop Dark Jedi and former Imperial Inquisitor Jerec from taking the enormous power of the Valley of the Jedi, an ancient burial ground located on Ruusan,…

result: Alliance operatives recover vital information regarding the Nagai war
x: Several skirmishes on the planet Kinooine stemmed from a series of events that began when a scouting party sent there by Alliance of Free Planets Commander Luke Skywalker was abducted and murdered by Lumiya, Dark Lady of the Sith.

The Sand Sloth was a Corellian Engineering Corporation Starrunner-class starship which served as the personal ship of Kea Moll during the early years of the Galactic Empire. The ship formerly belonged to her father and the young Kea often worked on it alongside him.
Deltooine was a world in the Corporate Sector. It was home to a Corporate Sector Authority military base used to monitor Farana and Wild Space. It was part of the Tertiary Solenbaran hyperlane.
Kismaano was a world in the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories.
Realm of Death was a Yuuzhan Vong warship that was part of the armada set to be dispatched to the Calamari system in 29 ABY to battle the forces of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances.
The Serpent's Kiss was a Yuuzhan Vong warship. It fought at the Defense of Mon Calamari.
The Battle of Caluula lasted for a month in 29 ABY near the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War between a joint Galactic Alliance/Mandalorian force and the Yuuzhan Vong.

The Merriweather was a bulk cruiser and flagship of the Tof invasion fleet. It was a large boat-shaped cruiser, commanded by Tof forces in the Battle of Saijo in 4 ABY. The design was reminiscent of earlier styles, such as the Fairwind.

The Gobindi were the native people of the planet Gobindi. They were master architects, responsible for the huge ziggurats found in the deep jungles of the planet. These ziggurats were built to contain a deadly virus the Gobindi had discovered in the jungle.
The Battle of Mandalore was fought in 4 ABY as part of the Nagai invasion.
Truuzdann was a planet in the Corellian sector. It was primarily visited for its small spaceport.
Sand sloths were large, fur-covered animals native to Annoo. Demma Moll used them as beasts of burden on her farm complex.
Tuskers were creatures native to Haruun Kal. They had snouts, and could grow up to a hundred kilos in mass.

Jacunas were Haruun Kal scavengers, although they would eat living creatures as well. They were birds the size of Kowakian monkey-lizards that traveled in packs of up to several dozen. They were able to fly, run, climb, and swing from tree branches.
Bottle bug was a species of insect native to the world of Haruun Kal. They were the favored prey of snapfish.
Snapfish was a species of fish that was native to the world of Haruun Kal. They typically preyed upon bottle bugs, leaping out of the water in which they lived to catch them.

x: During the year 5 ABY, the Human mercenary Kyle Katarn was given permission by the New Republic to track down and eliminate the Dark Jedi Jerec and his Imperial faction, and stop his plans to uncover the mythical power of the Valley of the Jedi.

Flying Bantha Squadron was a Rebel Alliance unit formed in 3 ABY to prevent the Galactic Empire from utilizing a natural hyperspace communications amplifier called the teezl to turn the tide of the Galactic Civil War.
The ongun-nur were large bird creatures native to the planet of Ansion. Despite their great, intimidating size, the ongun-nur were generally timid creatures. They usually traveled in large flocks.

Mos Espa Open was a podracing track on Tatooine. It was a short track that was overlooked by Jabba's Palace. First the track would split with two caves. The left one would bring you to an open dune sea.
The Fourth Great Schism was a pivotal split among the ranks of the Jedi Order in 2000 BBY.

Screw maggots were a species of scavengers who lived in the jungles on the planet of Haruun Kal. In 22 BBY, the Jedi Master Mace Windu came to the planet to investigate a hologram depicting a slaughtered group of jungle prospectors and a recording that connected his former Pad…
Kassa was the first planet orbiting the binary stars Adega Prime and Adega Besh in the Adega system. Located in the Auril sector of the Outer Rim, it was a searing rock.
Tarassi was the second planet orbiting the binary stars Adega Prime and Adega Besh in the Adega system. Located in the Auril sector of the Outer Rim, it was a barren rock.

Colsassa was the fourth planet orbiting the binary stars Adega Prime and Adega Besh in the Adega system. Located in the Auril sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a gas giant orbited by eleven moons collectively known as the Colsassan moons.
Missarassa was the fifth planet orbiting the binary stars Adega Prime and Adega Besh in the Adega system. Located in the Auril sector of the Outer Rim, it was an ice ball.
Akk wolves were larger versions of the akk dogs that lived on the planet Haruun Kal. Akk wolves were also present on Nal Hutta.
The Wayfarer was a large boat-shaped star cruiser, commanded by Tof forces led by a Supreme in the Battle of Zeltros in 4 ABY.

The Academy of Jedi Archaeology was an academy that studied the history of the Jedi and Sith. Made up of Jedi Researchers, the Academy sponsored studies on Ossus and Onderon during the Great Sith War.
