x: The Attack on the Endar Spire was an event that took place during the Jedi Civil War, in 3956 BBY. Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Malak set up an ambush for the young Jedi Padawan Bastila Shan, whose talents with battle meditation had been crucial to the Galactic Republic's effor…

A battle at Jabiim during the Galactic Civil War was one of the last battles of the hunt for Moff Kalast, the Imperial traitor that supplied the Rebel Alliance with datacodes for the Galactic Empire's superweapon, the Death Star I.
The Sun Guard was a Thyrsian mercenary company and one of the most feared in the galaxy, centered on the planet Thyrsus in the Thyrsus system.

AK-1A "Hammer" was a battle droid used by HK-47 in his attempts to take over the planet of Mustafar. It was armed with two laser cannons and an arsenal of missiles. It was destroyed by a group of spacers who went on to defeat HK-47.
AK-3 "Reaper" was a battle droid used by HK-47 in his attempts to take over the planet Mustafar. It was destroyed by a group of spacers who went on to defeat HK-47.
The Imperial Center People's Militia was a militia and security force created to police the underworld of the planet Coruscant after its capture by the New Republic.
The Slag Pit was a cantina located on the Outer Rim Territories moon Nar Shaddaa. By the reign of the Galactic Empire, it had gained a reputation as one of the roughest bars in the galaxy.
Mirshaf was a planet with an ancient culture that was venerated in the galaxy. Captain Dorja, who served under Grand Admiral Thrawn, used the culture's victory gestures in battle.
Feldt was a continent on the outer rim planet of Nishr. It contained the Lukhur Badlands.

Paramatan was a primitive terrestrial world located in the Mid Rim's Senex sector. Its surface featured forests and jungles as well as plains and oceans. The world's fauna included birds, reptiles, and great oopiks, a species having both avian and reptilian traits.
Operation Roundabout was a military assault on Corellia launched by the Galactic Alliance, which triggered the Second Galactic Civil War.
Syboonas were a species of blue-skinned humanoid sentient beings from the eponymous world of Syboona. They had thin physiques and long limbs, and their heads featured long curved muzzles.
The Thyrsus Sun Guard was a mercenary unit, formed thousands of years before the Clone Wars, fought from 22 BBY to 19 BBY between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Scrumma Jawbone was a shallow arm of Lake Paonga on the planet Naboo. General Tobler Ceel of the Gungan Grand Army established a training center for his militiagungs in it, where they could practice using projectile weapons such as the arbalest, atlatl, and booma.
The Yinchorri Council of Elders was the ruling body of Yinchorri in Tol-Kachorn on the planet of Yinchorr and were made up of the Yinchorri intelligentsia caste.

VibroSword Squadron was a starfighter squadron that was composed of Eta-5 interceptors. Syal Antilles, under the alias of Lysa Dunter, was part of the squadron, and was known as "V-Sword Seven." A Mon Calamari, serving as V-Sword Ten, flew as her wingmate.

Wedge Antilles Boulevard was a street in Coronet City, the capital of the planet Corellia. It was once known as CCC-39, but had been renamed by 40 ABY in honor of Wedge Antilles, one of the most well-known Corellian heroes at the time, although some maps still displayed the fo…
92Z was a YVH 1 droid assigned to protect Thrackan Sal-Solo on Centerpoint Station during Operation Roundabout.
Coruscant Space Traffic Control, also called Coruscant Space Control, was the New Republic government agency charged with controlling all space traffic that traveled to and from the planet Coruscant.
Nebula Flight was a squadron of Corellian attack fighters that participated in the Battle of Tralus in 40 ABY. One of the unit's pilots was Gorvan Peel.

Ax Squadron was a starfighter squadron that served with the Galactic Alliance Defense Force. Equipped with E-wing escort starfighters, the unit fought at the Battle of Tralus during the Second Galactic Civil War in 40 ABY.
TRAGOF1103 or Tralus Ground Occupation Forces Number 1103, was Jaina Solo's XJ6 X-wing starfighter in Hardpoint Squadron.

The Ministry of War was the civilian ministry that controlled the armed forces of the Five Worlds. Its jurisdiction included the Corellian Defense Force, Corellian Security Force, and a secret starfleet being produced at the Kiris shipyards.
Panther Flight was the designation for a flight of YT-5100 bombers that fought in the Battle of Tralus. The unit included Wedge Antilles, flying as Panther One, and Han Solo, flying as Panther Two.
The Zoomer was an overhauled light freighter belonging to the salvage pilot and mercenary Reti.
The Battle of Aereen was between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Chandrila Skies was a space-capable light assault vehicle produced by Uulshos Manufacturing that was part of the Galactic Alliance Second Fleet by 40 ABY.
Toryaz Station Security was the security organization of Toryaz Station. Its officers included Captain Siron Tawaler and Lieutenant Yorvin.

The Kissai were a subspecies of the Sith species who were enslaved by exiled Dark Jedi on Korriban. The Kissai were the priest class in the Sith caste system, where the Kissai would study the nature of the dark side of the Force and practice ancient Sith sorcery and alchemy.

Hogusses were sentient beings with heavy bodies. During the Mission to Ansion, sanctioned by the Jedi High Council and conducted by Jedi Master Luminara Unduli, Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Padawans Barriss Offee and Anakin Skywalker, a Hoguss wielding a killing ax attacked…
The Wetakk were a sentient species of serpentine build with six arms. In 22 BBY, a Wetakk was present in Cuipernam, a city on the planet Ansion.

The Brogune were a sentient species with four eyes. In 22 BBY, a Brogune served as a concubine for the Hutt Soergg Vosadii Bezhin, who was a Bossban—a criminal leader—based on the Mid Rim planet Ansion.

Vorian Four was a terrestrial astronomical object located within the Vorian system of the Expansion Region. It was polluted with niobarium by the Commerce Guild, but the incident was covered up by Shu Mai.
The Black Knights, also known as the Black Knights of Malrev IV, were an alliance of Sith cultists forged together by the Dark Underlord on Malrev IV.
Songoquin Street was a road in Cuipernam on Ansion. It was lined with vendors.
The Pangay Ous were an Alwari clan on Ansion. They were a part of the Northern Bands, and could be identified by their lightweight, waterproof robes.
The Battle of Malrev IV was a battle in 1750 BBY during the New Sith Wars that saw the Jedi Order and Mandalorian mercenaries defeat the forces of the Dark Underlord at Malrev IV.

The Zirfan Glacier was a large glacier on the planet of Rhinnal. It was located just north of the capital, Rhire, and halted at the foot of the Sennes Mountains. Wild gabals subsisted on the surface of the glacier and were hunted by native Rhinnalians for their wool.

Gairks were aquatic predators that lived on Ansion. The gilled creatures had warty green skin and huge sucking mouths that were large enough to swallow a Human. Gairks could combine their mouths to create even larger amounts of suction.
Hootles were herd animals found on Ansion.

A membibi was a non-sentient four-legged insectivore native to the rocky outcroppings on the planet of Ansion. Membibis had a low-slung snout protruding from the face with a splotchy pale white body, which ended in a long whip-like tail.
The Exiles, or Jen'jidai in the Sith language, were the twelve Dark Jedi leaders banished by the Jedi Order into the Unknown Regions after the Hundred-Year Darkness.

The Nulls were a species of tall Near-Humans who inhabited the eponymous planet of Null in the Mid Rim. A fierce and individualistic people, they had a culture of hunters and stonemasons, and they based their planetary economy on hunting tourism.
Birrus were lacy-winged flying creatures, vulnerable to windstorms, that were native to the planet Ansion.

The steep were a species of non-sentient amphibians native to the planet Metellos. Possessing ten-centimeter-thick skin, they dwelt in the sewage-filled seas of the planet, bobbing on the surface of the waters.

x: The Mission to Empress Teta was a Jedi operation conducted in the year 3997 BBY, several months after the Battle of Deneba.
Gogomars were creatures of Ansion. They were used as sacrifices by the shamans of the Alwari. They would read the entrails of the dead gogomar in order to resolve important affairs.
The Vrot were a small race. A Vrot mercenary who worked for Soergg the Hutt was a member of this species.
BD-8, nicknamed Beady, was a Yuuzhan Vong Hunter-series battle droid that was owned by the Solo family until it was destroyed by Killiks under Raynar Thul.
The Kendall was a Hapan Battle Dragon owned by House AlGray that was serving with the Hapan Royal Navy as of 35 ABY.
The Night Lady was a starship belonging to the Yaka pirate known as Redstar. Six years after the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War, Jaina Solo, Lowbacca, and Tesar Sebatyne boarded the Night Lady.
The Roaming Ronto was a Gallofree Yards, Inc., GR-75 medium transport owned by Bornaryn Trading which was used to transport at least a dozen turbolaser batteries to the Killiks.

The Swiff was a Dray-class transport that Han Solo and his wife, Leia Organa Solo, borrowed from their old friend Lando Calrissian. They used it in their disguises as Lord Rysto and Syrule at the Lizil Killik nest during the Swarm War.
The Tobay was an Adz-class patrol destroyer, part of the Grand Imperial Navy, the nominally Imperial force which guarded the fortress world of Prakith in the Deep Core under Warlord Foga Brill.

Tresidiss was a planet located in the Tresidiss system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was owned by Herglic criminals who ran massive gambling establishments and usurious banking operations on the planet.

DD-11A, or DeDe, was a Tendrando Arms Defender Droid owned by Queen Mother Tenel Ka to protect her daughter, Allana. A modified YVH 1 combat droid, DeDe was made to be a nanny and bodyguard droid for Allana. She had weapon arms, a synthskin torso, and a "cherubic" face.
Snevu was a planet in the Unknown Regions where the Battle of Snevu was fought between the Killiks and the Chiss.

The Gloom Walkers were a Sith trooper unit in the Brotherhood of Darkness' army during the New Sith Wars, active in the years leading up to the Seventh Battle of Ruusan. The Gloom Walkers were commanded by Lieutenant Ulabore.
The Sith battlelords, also known as Battlelords, were a class of warrior who served the Sith Lord Darth Rivan during the New Sith Wars.
Tusk-pigs were were a type of pig species that were native to the jungle planet Haruun Kal.
The Irrukiine were four-armed sentients indigenous to Malrev IV. They were sometimes referred to as Irks.
The Black Bha'lir was a society of smugglers who lived by a strict code of ethics. Their name was derived from the large, pack-hunting cats of Iyred known as the bha'lir.
Nuswatta was a planet in the Tion Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories.
Natinati was a planet in the Natinanti system in Wild Space region of the galaxy. The sacred temple Poborandurannum was located on the planet.
Spunchina was a planet in Wild Space known for its wild orgies. Jabba Desilijic Tiure once participated in one of these orgies and survived.

The Battle of Lorshan Pass was the first large-scale battle of the Summertime War, and one of the last confrontations of the conflict. It resulted in a humiliating defeat for the Balawai militia at Lorshan Pass, although at a high cost of the Korunnai Upland Liberation Front.

Phaseera was a manufacturing planet that was the location of a battle near the end of the New Sith Wars. It had been occupied by the Galactic Republic before the conflict, but after the Republic defeat, it became Sith occupied.
The Battle of Phaseera was fought during the New Sith Wars between the Brotherhood of Darkness and the Galactic Republic.

The Outland Regions Security Force, or Republic Outland Security Force, abbreviated ORSF, was a paramilitary force established by the planet Eriadu and the Greater Seswenna for the protection of the Seswenna sector.

DFS Squadron was a squadron of Trade Federation droid starfighters assigned to command ships. They were assigned to the flagship Saak'ak and to the Vuutun Palaa during the blockade of Naboo in 32 BBY.
The Spear was a DP20 gunship that saw service with the Rebel Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War. It was usually seen escorting the Defiance Task Force, and carried a cargo of tauntauns.

GSAD-43 was an Arakyd Industries AD armorer droid originally in the employ of House Salaktori after Arakyd failed to sell the design to the Galactic Empire. Assigned to help bounty hunter Janna Relasi, GSAD-43 personally bonded with her mistress.

The Kobola Spice Mine, also known as the Kobola Bunker, was a cave located on Naboo's moon of Rori. During the Galactic Civil War, the cave belonged to the Kobola Miners and was illegally mined for spice.

x: The Battle of Restuss was a major battle of the Galactic Civil War primarily fought in the city of Restuss on the swamp moon of Rori between forces of the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The Radiant IX was a Consular-class space cruiser.

The Battle of Pelek Baw was a conflict between the Balawai militia of the Haruun Kal government, under the command of Colonel Lorz Geptun, and the Korunnai Upland Liberation Front, led by Jedi Generals Mace Windu and Depa Billaba, and Korun lor pelek Kar Vastor.
The Orange Panthacs were a privately-owned platoon of B2 super battle droids used during the Yuuzhan Vong War with the intention of slowing down the Yuuzhan Vong's frequent occupation of planets.

The Balawai militia was the Korunnai name for the law-enforcement and military forces of Haruun Kal's Representative Council government. It was a part of the Ministry of Justice, and was headquartered in the Ministry of Justice Building in Pelek Baw.

Leia Organa II was a Human replica droid made of the Human Leia Organa by Project Decoy, headed by designers Fandar and Fugo. She was programmed as an agent of SPIN to pose as Leia during dangerous missions.
Tra'cors were the amphibious cousins of the rancor native to Socorro. Though smaller and almost completely waterbound, tra'cor shared most of the rancor's traits, including its hostile temperament.
Kneebs were small, rodentlike creatures with yellow fur. The Hutts considered them a delicacy and used the cured hides to cover luxury items. They were apparently named for the cries they made.

R2-K7 was an R2-series astromech droid. During the Rebellion era, R2-K7 was seen as a member of the Mytaranor Slaving Council, sheepherding prisoners from their cells to auction blocks, and sharing maintenance tasks with Verpine technicians.
Renforra was the site of an Alliance to Restore the Republic base during the height of the Galactic Civil War. Jon Vander led the BTL Y-wing starfighters of Specter Squadron from this headquarters.
2JTJ, usually referred to as TooJay, was a navigation droid provided by the Jedi Order to Master Tahl after she was blinded on Melida/Daan.

The Buzchub were a species of stocky beings covered in dark blue fur. The sentients were believed to be native to Harrandarr, a remote planet in the Bosph sector. The Buzchub enjoyed traveling the galaxy, using mechanical translators to communicate with other species.
Bha'lir were jungle predators from the planet of Iyred. Though gentle when treated with caution, the bha'lir were quite territorial and would respond violently if threatened.

The Huxlings were a group smugglers who worked for Jerf Huxley as of 22 ABY. By that year the group had worked exclusively with Talon Karrde for the last decade, but Karrde ended his working relationship with them when he chose to become a more legitimate businessman.
DS-73-5 was an Imperial Navy TIE/ln starfighter which was manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems. The TIE fighter was active around 0 BBY.

EX-1-2 was an Imperial TIE/sa bomber manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems. As a TIE/sa bomber, EX-1-2 boasted incredibly precise computers that allowed its pilot to destroy specific buildings or vehicles.

EX-1-8 was an Imperial Navy TIE/sa bomber that was manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems. As a TIE/sa bomber, EX-1-8 carried a destructive payload consisting of proton torpedoes, guided concussion missiles, space mines, and free-falling thermal detonators.
Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, EX-4-9 was a TIE/ln starfighter within the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, Onyx 2 was an Imperial Navy TIE/D Defender which was part of a limited production run of its class.
By 4 ABY, shortly before the Battle of Endor, Sienar Fleet Systems began manufacturing TIE/D Defenders for the Galactic Empire.

type: Military force posing as the legitimacy government
x: The Geroon Remnant was a Vagaari military unit posing as the legitimacy Geroon

Doom Bringer was a unique battle droid found in the Neimoidian droid factory on Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War. It was destroyed along with its hands of doom by a group of spacers who went on to shut down the factory that provided battle droids for HK-47.
HK-58 Aurek was a HK-series assassin droid used by HK-47 in his attempts to take over the planet Mustafar. It was destroyed by a group of spacers who went on to defeat HK-47.
HK-58 Besh was a HK-series assassin droid used by HK-47 in his attempts to take over the planet Mustafar. It was destroyed by a group of spacers who went on to defeat HK-47.
8-LOM was a LOM-series protocol droid found in Jabba's Palace during the Galactic Civil War.
The Citadel garrison was the contingent of Yuuzhan Vong Warriors who were tasked with defending the Supreme Overlord Shimrra's Citadel.

AK-Prime was a battle droid found in the crater of a volcano on the planet Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War. It was there that he defended HK-47 from a group of spacers, though he eventually failed and was destroyed.
OR-5 was a B1-series battle droid Colonel in the droid factory on the planet Mustafar. OR-5 was destroyed when HK-47 tricked a group of spacers into reactivating the factory.

Rascal Squadron was a starfighter squadron, likely temporary, which was formed in 3 ABY in order to destroy an Imperial mining facility in the Belt of Arah, but was destroyed by Phantom TIEs soon after completing their task. The sole survivor was Rookie One.
Jostrans were a sentient species native to the planet Munlali Mafir. They were a type of arthropod that could grow up to as large as a Human arm, and resembled slow-moving centipedes.
Imbats were a sentient species, known for their size and relative lack of intelligence.

The Ry'coz were a sentient species native to Novor 23, the sole habitable planet in the Novor system. It was located on the Sisar Run hyperlane, at the northern edge of the Periphery—a small region of space captured by the Galactic Empire that was formerly part of Hutt Space.
A species of rabbit lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. The Warrick family kept a brown one in their hut.
Liberty Gambler was a frigate that bore the flag of Captain Longmar of the Pegasus Strike Force during the Galactic Civil War.
The Pegasus was a cruiser that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Pegasus Strike Force, under the command of Captain Longmar, during the Galactic Civil War.
Aralanni was a cruiser in Captain Longmar's Pegasus Strike Force during the Galactic Civil War.

The jungle folk were a Kentra subspecies with black fur. They were a respected minority who dwelled deep in the Orellan jungles. The jungle folk were hunters, relying on their great physical strength and cunning to outwit both game and enemies.
The spotted folk were a Kentra subspecies with spotted fur. They inhabited the Orellan plains and relied on speed as a means of hunting and survival as they had to virtually race their prey.

The striped folk were a subspecies of the Kentra of Orellon II with striped fur who inhabited the grasslands adjacent to rivers and streams. They were physically very strong and at the same time extremely patient. They were experts in camouflage.

The brown folk, or tan folk, were a Kentra subspecies with brown fur who lived in the lowland hills on the borders between the mountain ranges and plains of Orellon II. They were primarily farmers and constituted the second largest farming community of the Kentra.
Kariish was a Kentra city on Orellon II where King Jerius resided.

conflict: Clone Wars (Yag'Dhul theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: The Battle of Tar Morden took place on the planet Tar Morden towards the end of the Clone Wars.
The Twelfth Squadron was a Nagai squadron that took part in the Nagai–Tof War of 4 ABY. The squadron, led by Wing Leader Taikotelai Akikoma, was destroyed in the Battle of Trenwyth.
F-3PO was a protocol droid in Cloud City on Bespin. When X0-X1 took control of the city, F-3PO was forced to kill Doctor Issan Len, despite its regrets.

FE-3PO was a 3PO-series protocol droid active during the Galactic Civil War. Programmed for Human-Cyborg relations, FE-3PO was also an expert on the other prominent individual droids and droid models in the galaxy at the time.
G-3PO was a protocol droid that was owned by Xalto Sneerzick's parents.
The hornbeak was a predator native to Orellon II. Being in an intermediate state between and avian and a reptilian, it had the body of a dinosaur and the head and feet of a bird.

The crier was a type of avian predator native to Orellon II. It had a wingspan of 10 meters, short feathers, and sharp talons. Criers hunted in groups on the open plain, using their pointy beaks to impale their prey.

Gliders were lizard-like carnivores native to Orellon II They had a cape of skin between their limbs which allowed them to silently glide through the air from the trees that they resided in and onto their prey.

ET-4B was a protocol droid fluent in over five million forms of communication. It assisted a group of Rebels on their mission to Orellon II to find a safeworld for the remains of the recently disbanded Pegasus Strike Force.

The Sarrish Defense Force was the primary military body on the planet Sarrish as of the time of the Clone Wars. Veedaaz Awmetth was a member of the Defense Force before representing his planet in the Galactic Senate of the Republic.

The Krabbex was a species of crustacean that was native to the oceanic world of Dac. It was characterized by its ten legs, dual mandibles in its mouth, two rows of spines running along its back, eighteen black eyes with four on its front, and grasping claws.

language: Primitive dialect of Galactic Basic Standard
x: Squidge was the insulting name given by the Vindar to the race of beings they oppressed. They were diminutive blue creatures with elongated skulls and wavy black patterns on their skin. They spoke a primitive form of Basic and were organized under "den mothers".

The Vindar were a species of white insectoids with four arms and a tough [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carapace carapace]. They possessed large black beady eyes, and they were able to fire powerful purple energy blasts from their hand.

H-3POA was a jade-colored protocol droid that belonged to a group of protocol droids that was owned by Popara the Hutt. H-3POA was given to Vago, Popara's main assistant, to operate in negotiations and meetings.

H-3POB was a green protocol droid who served aboard the Imru Ootmian and belonged to a group of other droids owned by Popara the Hutt. After he rescued Mika the Hutt from Endregaad, Vago, Popara's chief aide, returned to Nar Shaddaa with H-3POB.
H-3POC belonged to the group of jade-colored protocol droids operated by Vago the Hutt, as assistants used in his services to Popara the Hutt.

Baraboo biomold was a microscopic aquatic organism native to Baraboo. Flecks of Baraboo biomold were among the millions of aquatic creatures living in the Royal Icqui Aquaria on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.

The Lurrian rimebat was a sluggish aquatic species of bat that dwelt in cold environments on Lur. The population of Lurrian rimebats were among the millions of aquatic creatures living in the Royal Icqui Aquaria on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.
The Vendetta was the personal flagship of the Falleen Prince Xizor.
Mupples were small furry creatures that were imprisoned at the new Umboo Lightstation when Mungo Baobab, C-3PO and R2-D2 rescued them. Some considered Mupples a delicacy.

conflict: Clone Wars (Felucia theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: A battle, one of the opening engagements of the Outer Rim Sieges, was fought in 20 BBY during the Clone Wars on the planet Ossus. Jedi Master Tholme sent an elite contingent of ARC Troopers to infiltrate the Separatist base.

M-3PO, also known as Treedee, was a Cybot Galactica Human-cyborg relations droid that served at the Farrimmer Cafe as the maitre'd. Before becoming a maitre'd, Treedee monitored communications for the crew of the Mynock 7 Space Station.

M-3PO was a 3PO-series protocol droid who was the property of an individual named Jarstein. At one point in his operational history, M-3PO aided an imprisoned smuggler named Roark Garnet in an escape attempt.

The Battle of Bryx took place on Bryx between Governor Carigan and the Galactic Empire. Carigan had purchased several Leviathan Submersible Carriers and owned hundreds of hidden grounded anti-aircraft guns as well as many other types of high-tech weapons.
The Battle of Gorbah was an Imperial attack on Rebel forces on Gorbah lead by Michael Unther.

Galub slugs were giant, grub-white sea parasites native to Spira. They adhered to large sea animals to suck their blood. Generally very unintelligent, they would sometimes mistake passing boats for potential hosts, making them somewhat of a hazard to yachting tourists.

Camray eels were large snake-like predators native to Spira, which hunted primarily in the Shinkai Abyss. They had huge mouths with rows of sharp teeth. They used their long bodies to seize and crush prey.
Ataria Island was one of the larger islands of Spira. The famous Aspre Plunge was located on this island, as was Ataria City.

Ataria City was located on Ataria Island on the planet Spira. Settled along the beaches of the island's eastern coast, it was a thriving tourist location. The city's marina was the start and end point of the Spira Regatta Open, a famous yacht race.
The Point was the southernmost cape of the largest island on the planet Spira. It was extremely dangerous waters to navigate, as two major ocean currents met there.
The Shinkai Abyss was a large trench at the bottom of one of the oceans of Spira. It was approximately 150 meters deep and 3,000 miles long, and was the primary habit for the fearsome camray eels.

Zed was a 501-Z model Level-One security droid on Hosk. Following the evacuation of the spaceport, he met C-3PO and his counterpart, R2-D2. Quickly he gained their support and that of dozens of leftover and broken droids.
Renegg was a planet located in the Kuat sector of the Core Worlds.
A battle occurred between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic on a planet during the Clone Wars.

Army Command, also known as Imperial Army Central Command, was the council or staff of senior army generals led by the Army Chief of Staff—senior commanding officer of the Imperial Army—that commanded all of the Imperial Army forces from Imperial Headquarters on Coruscant.

R2-4B, pronounced Artoo-Forbee or simply Forbee, was an astromech droid used during the Galactic Civil War. Originally owned by Lorn Moonrunner, the droid was eventually confiscated by the Empire when it was found that its owner was in fact a former Imperial major.

t: Battle of unidentified planet (Kenobi and Skywalker)
x: A battle between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic took place on a planet during the early months of the Clone Wars.
A battle took place in 22 BBY between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic on a rainy planet.
The Battle of Mantessa was fought during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The Emperor's Shadow was the Emperor Palpatine's private shuttle and personal yacht.

Onece 3 was one of five BFF-1 bulk freighters in the Onece flight group. Along with the other ships in the flight group, attempted to pass Imperial Outpost D-34 in the Anoat sector. It claimed it was carrying foodstuffs just as the other ships were.
Alpha Squadron, or Alpha Squad, was an Imperial TIE/LN starfighter unit that was employed in various duties and battles throughout the Galactic Civil War.
Gallon was a cargo ferry used by Mugaari pirates. The Cargo ferry was part of an illicit weapons deal between the pirates and the Rebel Alliance.
Romold was a cargo ferry used by Mugaari pirates. The Cargo ferry was part of an illicit weapons deal between the pirates and the Rebel Alliance.

Dawn was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by the Rebel Alliance. It was part of an arms deal between the Alliance and the pirates in a cargo loading area located in the Tungra sector. The Imperials learned of this deal and attacked.

Tar Morden was a planet located in the Tar Morden system, within the Vensensor sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region, along the Corellian Trade Spine. It was the site of a Confederacy of Independent System facility that manufactured LM-432 crab droids.

The Outbound Flight Colony was a settlement on a remote planetoid in the Redoubt, located in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy. It was established from survivors of the Outbound Flight after it was destroyed by the Chiss Ascendancy.
Snow demons were predatory creatures native to the planet Toola. They hunted mastmots and were in turn hunted by Whiphids. They had white claws, large teeth, hairy wings, and long purple tongues.
This insectoid species were native to the planet Thrakia which was located in the Hapes Cluster.

The Managing Council, was the legislature of the Outbound Flight Colony. The Council, by the requirement of its founding mandate, consisted of member-representatives from its two factions: the Survivors and the Colonists.
The Drup Asteroid Field was located in the Drup's Star system, outside the orbits of the system's three planets. It was the location of "Woern's Asteroid".
Gravel-maggots were worms found in the badlands of the planet Tatooine. They were known to feed on rotting flesh of other creatures.

The Ketes were a large insectoid species that resided on the forest moon of Endor. A group of Ketes lived inside a hive on the Endor moon, although they usually lived in spiral mounds made out of a sticky substance.

The BioCruiser was a massive, nomadic ship owned by Offworld Mining Corporation (UniFy) and commandeered by the philosophical leader called Uni (the former Kad Chun, brother of corrupted Jedi Bruck Chun).
M-3PO-C was a 3PO-series protocol droid who was stationed at the hyperbaride plant on Marca by Dynamic Synergetics, Inc. when the factory had first opened.

N2-3P0 was a gold and blue protocol droid who served the Friends of Paran resistance group on Derilyn during the Galactic Civil War. N2-3PO had a feminine programming and was known to add Gamorrese curses in her speech.

Carnor Jax make a bid to become the Galactic Emperor
x: An attack on the Emperor's Royal Guard took place on Yinchorr during the Imperial Civil War. The incident occurred in the wake of the destruction of Byss, the Sith throneworld, and the final death of Emperor Palpatine.
Wullerton was the capital city of Draenell's Point, located on the continent of Mee'r. It was the location of the Planetary Communications Commission.
Unillian was the only moon of Draenell's Point.

Senali were the native species of the Rutan moon of Senali. They were an offshoot of Rutanians from Rutan, and the rivalry between the two species was provoked by the Yuuzhan Vong into war, leaving both Rutan and Senali weak and vulnerable to invasion.
Rutanians were the native species of the planet Rutan. Their species had an offshoot called the Senali who inhabited Rutan's own moon Senali.
The Phaeda's Hope was a GR-75 medium transport used by the New Republic cell on Phaeda in 11 ABY.
The Battle of Kr was a battle which took place on Kr during the Dark Nest Crisis in 35 ABY between the New Jedi Order and the Dark Nest.
The Battle of Qoribu was a battle which took place on Qoribu during the Dark Nest Crisis in 35 ABY with the Chiss Ascendancy against the Killik Colony and their Hapes Consortium reinforcement.
QT-3PO was a protocol droid. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, in 0 BBY, QT-3PO and its master set down in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine in their freighter.

T-3PO was a silver protocol droid with insectile plating and a feminine personality who served aboard the Subjugator. T-3PO was a harsh droid with feminine programming, and her many years servitude to her masters onboard the Victory-class Star Destroyer made her hate them.

T-3PO was a blue-colored protocol droid who served on Trevura, during the Galactic Civil War. T-3PO served under S-R6, an assassin droid who moved about Voma, a city on Trevura, in order to buy illegal and experimental versions of Imperial blasters that were imported by Merno …

Q-3PO was a protocol droid that worked as a species relations droid for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Later he was given to Doctor Deena Kinnet, after she became a spy for the Galactic Empire.
Mount Skar'lak was a volcano on the Ssi-ruu homeworld of Lwhekk.
The Caves of Ss'laath were a series of underground caves located on Lwhekk, the capital of the Ssi-ruuvi Imperium.

The fft were a species of small, multi-legged lizards which were the main food source of both the Ssi-ruuk and P'w'eck species on Lwhekk. They were often cut open using a ceremonial knife called a fft knife.
Trade City was a city located on the planet Aridus.

Edusa was an industrial planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Morshdine sector. During the Great Galactic War, the reconstituted Sith Empire enslaved the Twi'lek girl Leontyne Saresh there, and she eventually incited a revolt of enslaved beings on the planet before depa…

Vandyne was an industrialized planet located within the Vandyne system of the Outer Rim Territories. As Vandyne was within the region of the Ciutric Hegemony and was located in the same "corridor" of space as Axxila, it was a target for the space pirates known as Kavil's Corsa…
The Duros Sector was a district of Nar Shaddaa. It was inhabited throughout its existence primarily by Duros, hence its name. It was one of the moon's poorest regions.
The liberation of Clak'dor VII was fought at Clak'dor VII between the New Republic and the forces of Warlord Sander Delvardus in 5.5 ABY.
The Forbidden Fortress of the Gorax was a gigantic rock fortress located in the middle of the Desert of Salma on the forest moon of Endor. It was filled with deep crevices and giant spiders.

Kayven whistlers were vicious carnivorous flying creatures, resembling a cross between a monkey and a bat. The magician Xaverri created illusions of them in her act, flying over and swooping down at the audience.
Kushal Vogh was the capital of Elerion. It contained the Lucky Star.

Hermos was an android Human replica droid created by an unknown manufacturer. However, it can be assumed that he was created separately of the Rebel's Project Decoy and the replica droid project headed by Massad Thrumble and Simonelle the Ingoian.

The Quetzal Sisters were a squad of Rebel Alliance femmes fatales used for covert missions. Under the command of General Orma Hundeen, they were composed of Zeela Nall, Nuri Pravada, and Sheyne Tyndos. Leia Organa once worked with them on Elerion.
The Draisini was a Mining Guild Xiytiar-class heavy transport under the command of Captain Forma. It was hit by pirates under Sol Mon in 11 ABY.

The Mutant Acklay was a variety of the amphibious acklay that had been mutated by the toxins of Golbah's Pit on Geonosis. Many lived under the waters of the Ebon Sea, where they hunted creatures within the sea and surfaced to attack prey on land.

Saber Squadron was a starfighter squadron founded by Jedi Master Luke Skywalker for the Eclipse Station in 27 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War. It consisted of Jedi and non-Jedi, and was the personal elite squadron of Luke Skywalker.
The Yavin's Caprice was a New Republic Gymsnor-3 light freighter.
Mober snakes were deadly reptiles with poisonous heads at both ends of its body.

The Huntbird was an explorer-cruiser lent to Luke Skywalker on behalf of the New Jedi Order by Umwaw Moolis in 12 ABY. Skywalker flew the ship from Ithor to the Moonflower Nebula to search for the Eye of Palpatine.

Sometime in 3964 BBY during the Mandalorian Wars, a Kedorzhan pub in the Lower City of the planet Taris was visited by Zayne Carrick and Marn Hierogryph when they were on the run from the First WatchCircle led by Zayne's Jedi Master, Lucien Draay.

The Battle of Smarck was a New Republic raid against Black Sun forces in 11 ABY. In retaliation for the joint Black Sun-Grappa the Hutt funded pirate raids on New Republic hyperspace routes during the crisis against the Interim Ruling Council, Red Leader commander Mirith Sinn …

X10-D, also known as Exten-dee and X-10-D, was a red and bronze colored X10-D draft droid. The Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk used X10-D to control a variety of systems on his starship, Hound's Tooth.

The Navigators' Guild was a guild located in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy that sent navigators to those who hired them. Void Guides, Pathfinders, and Vector One were groups employed by the Guild.

Zeta Five was a Cha'a drone ship owned by Cha'a merchant lord Ssk Kahorr, who used the ship as a freighter. In 5000 BBY, the Zeta Five was sent on a run to deliver supplies and components to a mining colony on Goluud Minor, in the Goluud system.

F4-MF was an IG-series assassin droid who led the Rebel Four, operatives for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War, the team travelled to the planet Vatleria, where they uncovered a new Imperial base.

Pasmin was a planet located within the Outer Rim Territories. One of the original member-worlds of the Kingdom of Cron, it was absorbed into Xim's Empire. After the fall of the empire in 25,100 BBY, it would eventually join the Galactic Republic.
Talon was a CR90 corvette that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

objective: Steal money
x: The Firefight on Bogden's moons was a skirmish between Boba Fett and a fake security trooper.

objective: Contact Dooku
x: This firefight on Coruscant was a skirmish between Aurra Sing and two other bounty hunters.
The Meru Spaceport was a spaceport on Deneba.
Pad 9 was a landing pad on the Outer Rim Territories planet Lok located within an hour of travel from the establishment Brogar's Safe House and Cantina.

Tsaelke were a type of long-necked, graceful cetaceans from Chad. They were used as mounts by farmers on the planet to tend their herds. The creatures had barrel shaped bodies, long necks and small heads. They could carry up to 75 kilograms.
Peepers were birds found on Belsavis. The planet Kegan had humming peepers.
Pellata birds were a type of yellow bird introduced to Belsavis from Ithor.
Wystoh were seven-meter predatory creatures native to Chad. They were frantically territorial and tended to hunt in the deep oceans of that world.
Cy'een were fish-lizards native to Chad with bronze scales and long, thick necks. These creatures were considered beautiful and were known to sing.
Mussubir Three, or simply Mussubir, was a planet located in the Mussubir system of the Senex sector, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It was an important industrial world controlled by House Araba.
The feathered lizards inhabited the forests of the planet Pzob. They would emerge to beg for food from the sentient population.

The Sun-lizard or Tralusian sun-lizard was a reptile that inhabited the planet Tralus in the Corellian system. They had the ability to regenerate both their limbs and their tail. They could be domesticated as pets and live in cages.
The Liberator was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that saw service with the Rebel Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

Dagger was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport in use by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. It was used to transfer an Alliance team to secure the Imperial CR90 corvette Bixby during the ship's defection to the Rebellion.
Flitter was the codename for a Rebel Alliance safe world in the Tierfon system during the Galactic Civil War.
The Towani family star cruiser was a starship used by the Towani family. It crash landed on the forest moon of Endor and was later repaired by Jeremitt Towani in 3 ABY.
Noa Briqualon's starship was a vessel piloted by Noa Briqualon and Salak Weet on a mission to chart the Modell sector.

Nova Whisper was a modified Lantillian ShipWrights GX1 Short Hauler with a checkered history and long list of owners. The original owner was a Corellian commodities shipper by the name of Tev Driscull.
The Northern Hills were located on Corellia, near Coronet City. Ilir Post's estate was there.

result: Anakin Skywalker destroys tri-fighter droids attacking Saesee Tiin
x: In 20 BBY, during the Clone Wars, Jedi General Saesee Tiin participated in a space battle alongside a Republic fleet that consisted of Venator-class Star Destroyers and ARC-170 starfighters.

x: In 19 BBY during the Clone Wars, a battle was fought on an unidentified planet between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems as part of the war's Outer Rim Sieges campaign.

The Firerider was a lightly modified Kuat Drive Yards Starwind-class pleasure yacht owned by the Twi'lek Serdo that operated in the Mid Rim. The yacht was mostly stock except for upgraded deflector shields and an added ion cannon that had been taken from a BTL Y-wing starfighter.

Redshift Runner was a modified Starfeld Industries Z-10 Seeker owned by a Corellian named Elga Arbo. The Runner was one of the fastest commercial ships in the Bureau of Ships and Services's registries. Arbo specialized in legal high-speed delivery of cargo.

The Q'nithian mimbrane, also known as the mimbrane organism, was an unusual creature as it was essentially a living organic recording device. They appeared as thin pasty white sheets that were no longer than a Human finger.

t: Battle of unidentified planet (Confederacy of Independent Systems)
x: A battle was fought on a planet during the Clone Wars, resulting in the natives' enslavement by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
A battle was fought on a planet between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Sath was the capital city on the desert planet of Samaria. The seat of government was the Hall of Ministers.

Samarians were a sentient species native to the desert world of Samaria. The Samarians were engaged in the process of setting up a trade agreement between their neighbors the Roshans, however the Galactic Empire intervened.
The Murra Orders was a relatively young brotherhood of weapon-masters formed during the early years of the New Order. This group created the Kartranin method of sword-fighting.
The Falls of Dessiar were a group of waterfalls on Ithor renowned for their beauty and peace. Much like all things on Ithor, they were destroyed when the Yuuzhan Vong laid waste to the planet.
Dead Reckoning was a modified Consular-class space cruiser. The smuggler Rif Taranu aided the Rebel Alliance by using it to transport goods for them.

Fire creepers were carnivorous cave-dwelling insects of the planet Nirauan. They migrated through their caves in massive swarms. They would devour anything living, including the Qom Qae and Qom Jha, which were their basic food source.
The Oovo IV Uprising occurred when the prisoners on the prison asteroid of Oovo IV rose up against the prison guards and rioted.
Sector 63 was an area of the Coruscant underlevels, possibly near the Wicko District. It contained a Judicial Department jail.
During the Clone Wars, a battle was fought on a planet between the Jedi Master Yoda and the forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, led by a cyborg commander.
A battle between the forces of the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems took place approximately six months after the outbreak of the Clone Wars.
Tybis were a beast of burden native to the planet of J't'p'tan. They were known for having a gentle nature.
The buzzfish was a predatory fish species found on Endor.
The Battle of the Cliffs was a battle fought on the planet of Cilpar during the Galactic Civil War.
Port Kalla was one of the largest cities on the planet Yabosta, and served as the world's primary spaceport.

R4-M6 was an R4-P astromech droid socketed into Mace Windu's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor. The droid was destroyed during the Battle of Coruscant, after Mace Windu collided with a fleet of vulture droids and droid tri-fighters.

Ylesian white worms were a species of worm that lived in mud and were native to the planet Ylesia. They were white in color and relatively lengthy in size. Members of the Hutt species enjoyed eating them.

The Swaze were a technologically advanced people from the Jidlor system. Though they had an advanced culture, with access to starship technology, they revered the wisdom of the comparatively primitive Rellarin people of Rellnas Minor.
R4-K5 was an R-series astromech droid that accompanied Sith Lord Darth Vader, formerly Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, on missions for the Galactic Empire early during the Imperial Era.
This mission to Omphalos was a mission undertaken five months after the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

Gorgon was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate which served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Gorgon was dispatched to prevent the defection of the CR90 corvette Bixby during a Rebel attack on an Imperial convoy near Dellalt system.
The Librarian's Assembly, also known as the Librarians' Assembly, the Librarians Assembly, or the Librarian Assembly, was an organization of Jedi Lore Keepers based in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
The gas giant Rellnas was the sixth planet in the Rell system. Its sole moon, Rellnas Minor, was the homeworld of the Rellarin people.
The Snow Hawks were an elite Snowtrooper unit in the Stormtrooper Corps. They were renowned for their effectiveness during the winter campaign on Selsor's primary continent.
The Gilded Claw was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy. By 8 ABY, it was assigned to defend Kuat Drive Yards.

Condular was a celestial body located in the Condular system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. It was situated between the Chasin and Gandeal systems on the Corellian Trade Spine super-hyperroute.
VTR-LX was an Imperial Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served as a prisoner transport during the Galactic Civil War.

Zylurians were a sentient humanoid species with blueish skin, long hanging nostrils and three fingers. The crew of the ZZ-class freighter Mingula consisted of four Zylurians who were all killed by a swarm of Ubuugan fleshborers.
A female Human replica droid (HRD), Frija Torlock was one of two droids made to mimic the real Frija and her father Governor Torlock.

leader: Chief Librarian of the Jedi Archives
headquarters: Jedi Archives and Library, Jedi Temple
x: The Educational Corps, also known as the EduCorps, was a branch of the Jedi Service Corps that was made up of teachers, scholars, and archivists.
A male Human replica droid, Lexhannen was one of two droids created to mimic the real Imperial Governor Lexhannen Torlock and his daughter, Frija.

Dreambeasts were strange creations made through the dark side of the Force. The appearance of such beasts was never the same, as they took on the shape of what the opponent feared most in their mind. This allowed it to take on a wide variety of appearances.

leader: Head of the School of Torturers
x: The School of Torturers was a facility set up by Emperor Palpatine during the years of the New Order. It served as the focal point in specialized training of individuals in the fine art of torture.

The vapors were native creatures to the planet Togoria, more specifically to the Swamp of Vapors. They were sometimes also known as a mist creature. They resembled wraith-like masses of smoke that appeared almost semi-solid and would be mistaken for fog.
Dersonn III was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Dersonn system, a part of the Tammuz sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
R2-L1, also known as simply Ell-one, was an R2-series astromech droid with the Royal Naboo Security Forces Starfighter Corps.
Velumina was a Hornet-class carrier under the command of Captain Sorran.
Blue Sky Boulevard was a road on Corellia. It led from downtown Coronet City into the Blue Sector, and gave the sector its name. Card's Tapcaf was located on this road.

Spukami were a common breed of Corellian housecats that hunted vermin. The Fed-Dub Protective Services Spukami pocket blaster, manufactured on the nearby Corellia system worlds of Talus and Tralus, was named after the species.
Dellalt canoids were dog-like wild animals that lived on Dellalt. They had a prehensile tail and needle-like teeth.
Skree-skaters were nonsentient creatures native to Galantos that glided across the gelatinous pools of their homeworld, hunting small prey.
Rock Suckers were a type of gastropod native to Mytus VII that drew trace minerals from the stony crust.

x: The Mission to Trenchant space station was a skirmish fought between Asajj Ventress, Durge, and General Grievous in the Clone Wars.
Spor crawlers were small eight-centimeter-long poisonous insects native to the planet Nar Bo Sholla.
Cargo-Go was a Leafar BFF-1 bulk freighter once protected by the Rebel Alliance to gain its support.

The Epsilon Four was a Lambda-class shuttle used for resupplying the Star Dreadnought Terror. In 3 ABY, it was hijacked by Rebel operatives Rookie One and Ru Murleen while receiving cargo on Imdaar to gain access to the Terror.
A male Human replica droid, Altin Wuho was assigned to a task force led by Captain Dirk Balor.
CZ-54 was a CZ-series secretary/comm droid that was manufactured by Serv-O-Droid, Inc.. He was employed by the Bureau of Ships and Services, and once dealt with Duke Sparbo.
UR-1 was a droid similar to C-3PO in voice and vocabulary.

The Northern Lakes was a region that was located in the northern latitudes on the world of Dathomir. Situated north of the territories of Frenzied River and Singing Mountain, it was home to several small lakes.
The Rivers of Stone was actually a cavern located on Dathomir where Barukka lived. Its name came from the fact that the stones took on a flowing rivers like appearance.
Shear mites were a large insect form of life native to the planet Dathomir.

The Verne were herd animals native to the planet of Dathomir. They were hunted mainly for their leathery hides. On the bulls, six horns protruded from the back of the head. They somewhat resembled the ikopi.
The purbole was a simian creature native to the planet of Dathomir.

Moogs were a small non-sentient species of creatures indigenous to the planet Dathomir that were the favored food of the reptomammalian rancors. They were known to be quite difficult to catch as they were both swift and fast-moving animals.
The gaping spider was an arachnid creature native to the planet Dathomir.
The Asaari Wind was a modified SoroSuub Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 owned by the Bimm crime lord Ritinki around 0 ABY.
The airsquid was a type of floating squid that lived in the atmosphere of the Outer Rim Territories gas giant Bespin.
Lunar Shadow was a ship stuck on Nar Shaddaa during the Meetra Surik's visit to the planet. It was crewed by Nikto, and the captain was a Weequay who frequented the Jekk'Jekk Tarr.
H.O.P.E. (High Orbit Precision Entry) Squad was a four man squad of specialized clone commandos used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
A-5DS was a 5DS Ebranite Relations Droid. The model was stout and had extra arms, because the 5DS series had been made to interact with multi-limbed Ebranite species.
The hag'thyyr was a species of predatory reptile that was native to the world of Ebra. The Rull thildas used a flaming hag'thyyr holding a spear as the symbol of their clan.
Scandium Team was a military unit founded by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during its first days.
The Umber Banks were located near some plains of planet Bresnan, on Wellte-ir system.
The Wellte-ir Massacre was a battle fought on Bresnan, in the Wellte-ir system early in the Galactic Civil War.
The Battle of Gendrah-Narvin was a battle including the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. During this battle, the Alliance lost important agents.
The Battle of Fendry was a small conflict fought during the Galactic Civil War. The battle included chases throughout the clouds of the gas giant world of Fendry.

The Loac Campaign was the collective name for a series of related battles fought in the Loac system during the Galactic Civil War by the Rebel Alliance and an unknown enemy that may have been related to the Galactic Empire.

The Vidicx Campaign was the collective name for a series of related battles fought in the Vidicx system during the Galactic Civil War by the Rebel Alliance and an unknown enemy that may have been related to the Galactic Empire.

The Tynquay Skirmishes was the collective name given to a series of related battles that were fought early during the Galactic Civil War by the Rebel Alliance. During the battle, Scandium Team rescued Major Airen Cracken. Rebel agent Opit-Wenbruh was a veteran of this conflict.

result: Enough Imperial ships diverted to allow Rebel fleet to enter Hyperspac
x: The battle of the Vallusk Cluster was initiated by fleet-elements of the Rebel Alliance navy, six months after the Battle of Yavin in 0 ABY, in order to aid the main fleet at Yavin.

conflict: Tycho Celchu is accused of the murder of Corran Horn and treason again
x: The trial of Tycho Celchu was a widely publicized trial held in 7 ABY, in which Captain Tycho Celchu of Rogue Squadron was accused of treason against the New Republic and the murder of his Rogue Squadron comrade Corran Horn.

The Acherin were a sentient humanoid species native to the planet Acherin. During the Galactic Empire's subjugation of the planet, the term was also used to describe anyone who supported the freedom of the planet.

Aga were large, semi-sentient beings with six legs hailing from the planet Zelos II. Aga were pack creatures, and they would attack other creatures not only for food but also for the sheer enjoyment of the fight.
Shroud Team was a military unit of the Rebel Alliance which acted mainly as spies and infiltrators.

Corint City was the planetary capital of Pirik, possibly named after the Corintium ore mined on the planet. It was the base of the Rebel infiltrator Shroud Team, and they spread chaos throughout the galaxy from there.
Pirik was a temperate planet that was located in the Pirik system, in the Divis Arm of the galaxy.
The Agent was one of the last Anxarta-class Freighters produced by Sienar Fleet Systems, in approximately 10 BBY.
Anai was the larger of the two main continents of Lianna. It included the capital, Lianna City, and the cities of Lola Curich, Anxarta, and Melford.

Anxarta was a city on the northern coast of Anai, on the planet Lianna. It was the location of Anxarta Spaceport, which was mainly used by transport and private starships supplying foodstuffs to the local tourist resorts.

The Battle of Thovinack was a conflict during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel Alliance was defeated by Imperial forces on Thovinack. During this battle, Rebel agent Tisha Rostek was killed.
Reynon was a planet. Rebel agent Harovan Toth was a native of Reynon.
The Trailians were a sentient, humanoid species of great beauty. Native to the Outer Rim planet Trailia, they had developed a low technology society by the time of the New Republic.
The Alain were native to Von-Alai. Due to the heavy pollution of their homeworld, they built their residential buildings on giant platforms above the toxic sludge.
A small coastal town on Kabal, Palisade was unaffected by the Imperial bombardment around 0 ABY. The town was the location of eccentric businessman and big-game hunter Tyro Viveca's estate.
The Destruction of the Pelagia was a brief battle between the New Republic troopship Pelagia and a missile, shot from the superweapon Galaxy Gun.

The destruction of Da Soocha V was a brief battle which saw the destruction of the New Republic base on Pinnacle Moon, also known as Da Soocha V, by a missile, shot from the Imperial superweapon Galaxy Gun.

t: Destruction of the Nespis VIII spaceport
x: The Destruction of Nespis VIII spaceport was a battle between the New Republic high command, stationed at Nespis VIII's spaceport, and two missiles, shot from the superweapon Galaxy Gun.
The Borlorians were a sentient species originating from the Borloria system in the Expansion Region's Dentari sector. Members of the species were able to sneer.
B'trillans were a squeaky-voiced, vaguely felinoid species native to B'trilla in the Gordian Reach sector.

The Cacops were a sentient species native to the celestial body Veccacopia in the Outer Rim Territories' Tunka sector. They had eyes with retinae, and the visual appearance of individual Cacops tended to be difficult to distinguish for members of other species.
The Cannolites were a sentient species native to the planet Canoliss IV. Their culture was based on three-dimensional mathematics, which caused problems for offworlders visiting their planet.
The Cemas were a species of sentient beings that had feet. At least one member of the species had entered the galactic community by 17 ABY.
The Bezim were a sentient race from the planet Bezim. They were humanoids with dome-shaped skulls.

Bloxians were a sentient species native to the Bloxia system in Wild Space. The species was characterized by their large size and red-hued skin. Members of this species included Bakk and Chokk, enforcers for the Pliith loan shark Linkaas.
The Chestrashi were a sentient species originating from Wild Space's Chestrashus system. They were ruthless and made extensive use of biological warfare.
The Choi were aliens from the planet Choi. A Choi named Susejo was eaten by the Sarlacc on Tatooine and talked with Boba Fett when he was trapped there. This Choi unintentionally helped Fett escape.

The cidwen were black, predatory, winged insects native to the planet Keros with dangerous beaks and claws. They were introduced to Atraken when a free-trader left a pair of them behind. By the time of 6 ABY, there were a dozen living on the planet.

Corthenians were a sentient alien species from the Corthenia system in the Mid Rim. In 21 BBY, a Corthenian attended a hive ball with a Human and a Wookiee that was being held in honor of a pair of Galactic Republic diplomats, Barrister Doolb Snoil and Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Orryxians were an intelligent, sentient feline species from the Orryxia system in the Outer Rim Territories.
Referred to as the Battle against Liquidator, this series of operations involved the Star Destroyer Liquidator and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The cerrabore was a hulking creature indigenous to the swamps of Naboo. Cerrabores were captured and partially domesticated by the Gungans to serve as living battering rams to smash enemy fortifications and military installations.

habitat: In the sky above the jungle
x: The Floating jellyfish were native to the terrestrial planet Baskarn. They were great jellyfish-like creatures, nearly a hundred meters across, that used lighter-than-air gases to float across the skies above the planet’s extremely thick and deadly jungles.
The Restrainer was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

In 4 ABY, eight months after the Battle of Endor, a battle occurred at the planet Notak. The battle was a rear-guard action by the Galactic Empire; the Victory-class Star Destroyer Harridan was reassigned from its normal duties in the N'zoth system to support Notak and the def…

x: The Mission to Kashyyyk was a rescue operation carried out by the commandos of the Republic's elite Delta Squad which led directly to the Battle of Kashyyyk.
Dan Android was a masculine PR droid with blue photoreceptors. By the year 4.3 ABY, he was in charge of public relations for the Star Tours travel agency, introducing other tours on Tourscan.

objective: Obtain samples of metal testing
x: During his investigation on the Dark troopers, then-mercenary Kyle Katarn visited a Weapons Research Facility on Fest in order to collect more clues on their production.

objective: Place a sequencer charge in the reactor

x: R2-D7 was a conical-headed R4 astromech droid who worked at the Star Tours travel agency's Tomorrowland Starport, tending to StarSpeeder 3000s and operating the Inventory Droid Assistant.
The siege of Nulan VI was a battle that took place some time after the introduction of TIE bombers into the Imperial Navy and the formation of the Scimitar assault wing.
The assault of the Aturi Cluster was a battle fought during the Galactic Civil War resulting in a defeat for the Rebel forces by the Scimitar assault wing.
Retribution was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer.
Morvaks were unusual creatures that resembled large crustaceans that were meters across. They were considered an unusual example of life as they gained sustenance from rocks and stones.
The Blood Razors were a swoop gang from Biivren during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Their activities also included smuggling and piracy, in particular in the Karthakk system.
The Balana thranta was one of the many species of thranta that were native to the planet Alderaan and became virtually extinct upon the planet's destruction.

The great thranta was the largest of the thranta species native to the planet Alderaan and became extinct when the world was destroyed. Its size was estimated at being fifteen times longer then the pilotta thranta.

The pilotta thranta was one of the several species of thranta that were native to the planet Alderaan, which was destroyed by the Galactic Empire, and thus became extinct. They were considered the second largest of the thranta species, smaller only than the great thranta.

Talon Squadron was an elite heavy strike/starfighter support squadron of the Imperial Navy, consisting of Assault Gunboats and TIE Avengers. It was stationed aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Rage.

x: The Battle of Nocto marked the final engagement between the Rebel Alliance and the Empire's Task Force Vengeance. It was the last-ditch attempt of Admiral Wooyou Senn to destroy the Alliance shipyard in the system with the meager remainders of his task force.

place: Unknown, presumably Almaran or nearby system
result: Imperial forces pursue Rebel cruiser Liberty to the Goff system
x: The skirmish near Almaran was a short engagement intended to draw ships away from the Imperial Task Force Vengeance.
The Third Battle of Goff was an ambush set up by the Mon Calamari Cruiser Liberty and the Rebel forces of the Airam sector.

Kormoran was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was a site of an Imperial attack. During the blitz, TIE Fighters were sent in to clear the roads of over 90,000 refugees.
max-W 100, nicknamed "Max, the Janitor Droid", was a cleaning droid that worked in the Droidnostics Center at the Star Tours travel agency.

result: Alliance formed between Boss Gallo and Captain Marsune
x: During a war between the Gungan tribes on the planet Naboo in 3000 BBY, a battle was fought on the ruins of the city Otoh Sancture between the Militiagungs under the command of Boss Gallo and bursas under the influence of Boss Rogoe.
Corweillians were the inhabitants of the Corweillia system in the Mid Rim. Von Taub was a Corweillian.

Courataines were a sentient species of humanoids from a homeworld with lower than standard gravity. Their bodies were wobbly-fleshed, resulting in them wearing exoskeletal travel suits when they traveled.
The Cranscoc were an insectoid species from the planet Cartao who controlled Spaarti Creations. They reproduced slowly, and communicated by changing colors.

objective: Find and rescue Jedi Master Treetower
Free Ugnaught slaves
x: A mission to York Skot was carried out by the elite commando team, H.O.P.E. Squad, to extract Jedi Master Treetower when he was jeopardized while he was attempting to intercept goods being smuggled by the Trade Federation.
