Destruction of cargo ships carrying warheads
x: The Mission to Almaran was a Rebel strike-reconnaissance mission during the Galactic Civil War in order to gauge the strength of the Imperial Task Force Vengeance and eliminate Imperial warhead supplies.

result: Rebel retreat from the Elrood sector
x: The evacuation of Gelgelar saw the evacuation of the local Rebel base and subsequent retreat of the Alliance forces of Elrood sector to the Airam sector. It also marked Task Force Vengeance's first steps towards pacifying the Airam sector and driving any Rebel presence from it.

A sentient cephalopod species existed that had one eye mounted on a single eyestalk and a mouth with appendages on both sides at the base of their eyestalk. The species had anterior flipper-like appendages and a long, flexible tail.
The Battle of the Forest Cities was a major battle in which the unified Gungan tribes attacked and destroyed Boss Rogoe's heavily fortified prisoner camp.
The kheilwar was the name given by the Defel species to a small poisonous insect native to their homeworld of Af'El. It was also known to other races as a homunculus-wasp.

objective: Rescue Rosh Penin from Taspir III
x: During the conflict with the Disciples of Ragnos, a mission was carried out by Jedi Knight Jaden Korr and Jedi Master Kyle Katarn in 14 ABY.
Kurets were a species of small, brown-colored insects, approximately one centimeter long, found on the world of Kubindi. They possessed a hive-based mentality and were often found in swarms.

Sun beetles were large insects that were the size of banthas that lived on the world of Kubindi and raised by the native Kubaz. They were considered beasts of burden in the past until such duties were taken over by droids and other forms of machines.

Ghost spiders, also spelled ghost spydrs, were a shelled, clawed spydr species found in the Silver Forest of Dreams on the planet Kubindi. With some growing to the size of houses, the poisonous arachnids spun webs whose strands were stronger than steel.

The Silver Forest of Dreams was a forest located on the planet Kubindi that was made up of kilometer-tall silver trees that had 20-meter-wide leaves. During the fall, the leaves would fall to the ground and looked like giant rafts.

The Giant Fungi Forest, also known as the Great Fungi Forest, was a titanic patch of huge, trumpet-shaped fungi located on the planet Little Kessel. They were large and strong enough for the world's inhabitants to build homes and offices inside of them.
The Rodian Hunting Grounds, known as Etyyy in Shyriiwook, was a place southeast to Kachirho on Kashyyyk.
Rylle'vak, also known as the Quiet Ocean in Basic, was a body of water that was present on the Bothan homeworld of Bothawui. Velhom'starn was located in this ocean.

Palesia was a territory on the planet Lannik. During the conflict between the Red Iaro terrorist organization and the Lannik government, the terrorists captured the region from loyalist forces, but offered to cede the territory in Jedi-mediated peace talks on the Mid Rim plane…
F-22-RGKx, also known simply as F-22, was a masculine F series repair droid with green photoreceptors and silver plating, with a gold trim.
Rals, also known as stone rays, were a species of cold-blooded reptavian native to Bothawui.

Devil beasts were large flying creatures that lived on Endor. The purple and blue reptavian creatures had four limbs and a tail; their large wings connected from their shoulders to their hips and covered their arms all the way to the wrist.
The Zorbian space pirates were a disorganized group of Human pirates from Zorbia II. They were believed to be of Corellian descent, and had proven to be nuisance in the Moddell sector for centuries.
Crintlians were an alien species native to the Crintlia system. They were known to aggressively defend their territory, even against foes with a significant numerical or technological advantage.
The Battle of Orron III took place early in the Galactic Civil War, near the completion of the battlestation Death Star I.

Following the destruction of the first Death Star battle station at the Battle of Yavin, the Galactic Empire invaded the Rebel Alliance base on Yavin 4 in an attempt to capture the Rebel leaders as an act of retribution.
Stendaff was a Sacheen-class light escort vessel that served in the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Black Fleet Crisis.

Giant algae-beds were a species of sentience Algae from the Cygnus B system, a star system located in the Esaga sector of the Mid Rim. The algae-beds were extremely intelligent, with a highly complex brain.
The Doneers were a sentient insectoid species from the planet Doneer'so, located in the Fakir sector. Their renown for building excellent starships gave them a reputation across the sector.
Jar'Kai was a city on the planet Atrisia.

Groogrun, also known as Clan Groogrun, was a clan of Gamorreans. Nine of their members, led by Ortugg, guarded Jabba Desilijic Tiure at his palace on the planet Tatooine. Snogrutt, a master weapons maker and builder of the Clan Groogrun vibro-ax, was a member of this clan.
The Rogak clan was a clan of Gamorreans. They were the rivals of Ortugg's clan. When Ortugg wrote a letter home to Venorra, he signed off the message by asking her to kill some Rogak clanners.
The Vigilant was a Carrack-class light cruiser of the Imperial Navy.

The kundril was a species of huge, flying insect that was indigenous to the world of Brentaal IV, one of the few lifeforms that wasn't displaced by colonization and terraforming. Kundrils grew to be at least twenty meters and often much larger.
Cairnmogs were large spiked lizards indigenous to Chandrila. No longer able to survive in the wild, they were confined to the rocky hills in the Hanna Wild Game Reserve.

habitat: Waters beneath the polar ice sheets
x: Tenticulons were natural predators of the firehead fish, who lurks in the half-light waters beneath the polar ice sheets on the planet Rhinnal. Their enormous body is an amorphous blob towing dozens of ribbon-like arms, each with a specialized function.

Chiss Intelligence was the name of the intelligence gathering organization within the Chiss Ascendancy. During the Dark Nest Crisis, the Chiss Intelligence dispatched Chiss intelligence officer Daer'ey'ath to gather information on the Killik Colony.

result: Decisive Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: The Battle of Swellen was a Rebel Alliance attempt to capture the Imperial interdictor Compellor while it was undergoing repairs and refits at the KDY-77 repair yard.
The Second Battle of Mobetta was a space battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
The Gotal was a group of two CR90 corvettes assigned to Imperial Task Force Vengeance. They were equipped with additional space survey sensors.
The Gotal 2 was a CR90 corvette assigned to Imperial Task Force Vengeance. It was equipped with additional space survey sensors.

result: Decisive Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: The Third Battle of Mobetta was a space battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. It saw the conclusion of the refit of the Strike-class medium cruiser Peregrine with the Compellers gravity well projectors.

result: Decisive Alliance to Restore Republic victory
x: The First Battle of Derilyn was a major battle in the Derilyn system between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. It began with a Rebel Alliance ambush that resulted in a devastating defeat for the fleet sent to reinforce Task Force Vengeance.

result: Consolidation of the Airam joining Rebel Alliance
x: The Fourth Battle of Mobetta was a space battle surrounding the Rebel Alliance-aided Airam retreat from X7 factory Gallofree under fire from an Galactic Empire strike force.
The Juggernaut was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer active in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The Titan was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer active in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
Resupply of rebel forces in the Airam sector
x: The Mission to Kuras Drift was a joint operation by the Rebel Alliance to resupply the its sector fleet with a new shipment of warheads.

result: Tactical Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: The Battle of Aiqin 4 was a Rebel effort to capture Airam clan leader Ilay during a meeting with the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Rage.

The Compassion was a Lambda-class shuttle that saw service with the Rebel Alliance Fleet around 3 ABY. During a mission to treat the wounded of Gelgelar, the vessel was used to ferry medical supplies to the Medical Frigate Redemption.

place: Deep space, probably near the Gelgelar system
x: The Skirmish near Gelgelar was a space battle between Rebel Alliance forces and elements of the Imperial Navy that took place shortly after the Empire seized control of the Gelgelar system.
The Battle of Halbara was an Imperial strike against a Rebel convoy carrying B-wing starfighters and supplies headed for the Airam sector.

result: Recovery of supplies abandoned to Imperial forces at the First Battle
x: The Second Battle of Gelgelar saw the reclamation of supplies from the captured Rebel base in the Gelgelar system from the Imperial Navy by the Rebel Alliance.
"Bug One" was the designation Alliance Admiral Nek Bwua'tu gave to the nest ship which belonged to the Dark Nest during the Battle of the Murgo Choke in 36 ABY.
During the the Yuuzhan Vong War, at some point between 25 ABY and 26 ABY, Uffel was attacked by the Red Knights of Life.
During the the Yuuzhan Vong War, at some point between 25 ABY and 26 ABY, Kligson's Moon was attacked by the Yuuzhan Vong.

SoroSuub Landing was an area of the Lower City of the planet Taris that was home to a sizable Sullustan and Kedorzhan population—the Kedorzhans often worked in nearby mines. SoroSuub Landing had at least one bar tailored for Kedorzhan miners.

Gray Squadron was an experimental unit of six Aleph-class starfighters based on Blue Diver in 40 ABY. Syal Antilles, Zueb Zan and their astromech were in the squadron. They fought at the Battle of Tralus.

Tromonids were creatures, native to the planet Rywin, imbued with a fatal bite. Months after their discovery, they infested five planets due to their high reproduction rate. At one time, Jabba Desilijic Tiure dealt with Gaar Suppoon where one of these creatures was a trade item.
The Eucerons were a species native to the planet Euceron. They were tall humanoids with large, domed heads and delicate limbs.

The siege of Caprioril was conducted by the Imperial Coalition in 10 ABY, during the offensive prior to Operation Shadow Hand. Arhul Hextrophon was injured during the assault. The siege led the New Republic Provisional Council to release Why Do We Fight the Empire?.

The Fairfolk were a very small race that resembled ethereal, floating Jawas. They were strong in the Force and a number of them working for Darth Vader on Dantooine attempted to sway an oblivious Luke Skywalker to the dark side by setting up a psychic link between Skywalker an…

The sentient Farangs evolved on the planet Ab'Bshingh alongside another intelligent species, the Waroot. The two species were at war for centuries, resulting in the development of unique tactics and customs.

Freda were a species from Freda. They were locked in an arms race against the nearby Jante until the Freda attacked Jante industrial plants on Rett II. The Galactic Empire, led by Moff Haveland ordered a ceasefire, which the Freda eventually withdrew from.

The Fw'Sen were a species that mated only once, prior to being sexually mature, and retained the resulting fertilized eggs within their bodies until a later stage in their reproductive cycle. The reptilian Ssi-ruuk designed and produced a Fw'Sen-class picket ship.
The Fyyrsprus were a small species of humanoid reptilians. Members of the species were harmless but clumsy.

Ov Taraba was a university in the city Iziz on the planet Onderon during the Beast Wars era of the planet. It was an expensive school, where the Minister of State Novar studied the art of diplomacy when he was young. This part of the city was controlled by the Galactic Republic.
The Thunder was an Airam CR90 corvette active during the Galactic Civil War.

The Warrior was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer set to rendezvous with an Imperial convoy carrying supplies and slaves by Mon Calamari at about 2 BBY. The Warrior arrived early only to discover a Rebel force attempting to liberate the slaves.
The Rescue at Mon Calamari was a Rebel Alliance mission to free Mon Calamari slaves being transported to an Imperial Star Destroyer during the Galactic Civil War.
Genians were a species native to the planet also known as Genian. They had violet or lavender skin and were known as skilled diplomats.

The Gorms were a reptilian species from the moon Gormdin. Though they survived by hunting, they were known to be a peaceful race. The Galactic Empire legalized hunting Gorms for sport. When the New Republic came to power, Gorm hunting was made illegal.

The Gorum were a species of humanoids with prehensile tails. They used these tails to hang from trees when they went to sleep. They had large red eyes and forked tongues which could suck fluids from food. Tormey was a member of this species.

The Gotiards were a sentient species that grew up to three meters in height. They were simian in physique, with heads that resembled goats. A traditional greeting among Gotiard males involved rubbing and slapping each other's chests.

Govians were a sentient species from the Govia system. A female member of this species was a receptionist at one of Dr. Cornelius Evazan's "clinics" who was stunned unconscious by Jodo Kast as he pursued the bounty on Evazan's head.

The Hardex were a sentient species native to the Hardex system in the Jubilar sector of the Outer Rim Territories. At some point by 5.5 BBY, the Hardex sent an ambassador to the Targonnian leader Craw. Craw told a joke involving three Hardex and a bantha to the ambassador.

The Harf were a sentient species with an elongated snout and massive arms. They had goggle-like eyes that shined red. In 4 ABY, a drunken Harf was present in the Mos Eisley cantina when the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk and the Mandalorian Boba Fett had a face-off.
The Rak'qua were a bellicose tribe of Nautolans who lived before and during the Galactic Civil War.
The Cloud City Sabacc Tournament was a sabacc competition held in Cloud City, Bespin.
Daggerblade was an Imperial system patrol craft. The Rebel Alliance tentatively identified it as the ship that engaged the CR90 corvette Old Republic shortly after the Battle of Endor.
Old Republic was a CR90 corvette in the Rebel Alliance fleet that fought in the Battle of Endor.
The Unrepentant was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy.
Junk beetles were insects native to the planet of Dagobah. It was included in many dishes and was served with Dagobah mud cake for example.

The Celador Sash was a twin-hulled freighter donated to the New Jedi Order. The parents of its original owner were once saved by Obi-Wan Kenobi and in gratitude the ship was gifted to the Academy some time before 12 ABY.
I-7 was a protocol droid belonging to the human Sevox, who had spliced into the droid in order to see after he lost his eyes.

Vermilic was a Hutt kajidic and one of the younger clans among the other Hutt kajidics. Unlike more traditional Hutt families, Vermilic’s operations centered on the production and distribution of exotic foodstuffs and intoxicants considered unusual within Hutt society.
The Zicreex was a Subla Ransom cargo hauler.

Corbos Mining City was an experimental mine established in a crater on on Corbos in 12 ABY. It generated electricity by using a heat exchanger in a volcanic crater, and it housed 793 miners and their families. All were killed by a Leviathan attack.

M2398 was a gas giant, in the M2398 system, near warlord Zsinj's territory. It was orbited by the Blood Nest moon which was controlled by pirates. Furthermore, it was the place where Wraith Squadron suffered its first loss, Jesmin Ackbar.
The Hewett were a non-humanoid, sentient species from the Hewett system. At one point, an official banquet was held for Hewett senators, at which Konkeel pie was served on the menu.

The Ilwizzt were a sentient species with mahogany skin and a prominent trunk. That trunk flared and vibrated when they spoke. Brco was an Ilwizzt who attained the rank of major in the G'rho Defense Force.

The Inchichtok were a xenophobic sentient species. Around 200 BBY, the Inchichtok had their first contact with the Galactic Republic, meeting the scout expedition commander Arnoth Draenell and his crew in an unscouted star system that later became known as the Bissillirus syst…

The Jastaal were an avian sentient species that spoke in a trilling language. They had wings that partially extended when they walked, lifting their bodies so that they appeared to be half-gliding along, bouncing on the wind.

The sentient Jerni were the original inhabitants of the ancient Outer Rim desert planet Jerne, where they once ruled over a glorious empire before suffering extinction many eons before the Galactic Civil War.

The Jumerians were a sentient species native to the Jumeria system of the Core Worlds. Some Jumerians later became members of the New Republic. In 8 ABY, a number of Jumerians presented Princess Leia Organa Solo with a singing lamp as a gift for her wedding.
The Kalai were a species who, during the Galactic Civil War, suddenly appeared at Zirtran's Anchor aboard the starship Destiny.
The Kalzerians were near-Humans from the planet Kalzeron with gray, leather-like skin. They also had black teeth, and yellow eyes.

The Khoan were a species who, though shorter than Humans, weighed twice the average Wookiee. They had yellow skin, a dorsal fin, and spikes on their faces. These spikes fanned around the face, forming a spiked collar around their faces.
The sentient species known as Kler'terrians were native to the Kler'terria system, a Core Worlds star system. The Kler'terrians had four arms, which they could move independently of each other.
The Kloodavians were small, yellow-skinned reptilians. They had the ability to regenerate lost limbs and were immune to mind tricks.

The Lellish were the native sentient species of the planet Alk'Lellish III in the Expansion Region. Many Lellish became advertising professionals, a business in which they earned a sizable profit by promoting the hunting of a native predator known as the ketrann to offworld pu…

The Lexlars were a species of sentient, hair-covered hominid. Odeon Farnish was a three-feet-tall, Basic-speaking Lexlar who worked as a customs inspector during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.
The Lisst'n were a sentient species that continually shed their skin. They were active in the galaxy dating from the time of Xim the Despot, circa 25,000 BBY.

The Locans were a sentient species of near-Humans that shared its name with the Wild Space celestial body Loce. They had pointed ears, prominent incisor teeth, and distinctive light purplish-blue skin.
The Lomabuans were a sentient species that were native to the ocean planet Lomabu III. The species constructed cities of steel and stone on the coastlines of the planet's archipelagoes.
The Lontars were a sentient species native to the Lontar system of the north-western portion of the Colonies Region.

The Lyunesi were a fragile species of humanoids, one of six that were native to the planet Ryoone. Their faculty in translating languages and capturing every nuance of body language ensured their survival on their homeworld, which was dominated by intense competition among its…

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: The Battle of Dega was a strike by the Rebel Alliance against a resupply operation of Task Force Vengeance, in which Imperial forces under Admiral Wooyou Senn were to receive cargo and conscripts from their Airam allies loyal to detained clan leader Ilay.

The Defiant was an Acclamator-class assault ship. The Defiant first saw service in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars, where it was adorned with lateral red markings port and starboard of the centerline and wore the symbol of the Open Circle Fleet.
Defiant was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Remnant's navy in 28 ABY, at the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The Yanthans were beings from the Yantha system who expertly excised venom sacs from windsnakes, creatures native to the planet Ploo II.

The Zeffliffl were intelligent, seaweed-like aliens native to the planet of Zeffliffl, in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Living in tight-knit groups, the species had a subconscious connection with its group members, which rejected any outsiders.
World was the indigenous name for the home world of the Tripod species. Its exact location was unknown, but it was believed to be situated on the Outer Rim, somewhere between Pzob and Belsavis.

t: Mission to Nar Shaddaa (First Jedi Purge)
place: Refugee Sector on Nar Shaddaa, and the Visionary above the moon
result: End of G0-T0's operations on Nar Shaddaa
Destruction of the Visionary and its crew
Meetra Surik and her allies escape
x: A mission to the moon Nar Shaddaa was conducted by a Human female Meetra Surik in 3951 BBY, and set off a series of conflicts between the local Exchange crime organization, the Hutt Vogga, and the Lost Jedi.

The Saadul were a sentient species. In 25 ABY, a number of Saadul were displaced by the Yuuzhan Vong invasion of the galaxy, and ended up with numerous other refugees on the planet Ruan. The Ruan authorities created a central database keeping track of all refugees.

The Samuac were a near-Human species from the Outer Rim Territories moon New Kisge. Around 12 BBY, the male Samuac Sisquoc graduated from the Galactic Outdoor Survival School, where he was a record-setting student.

The Schenor were a species of tall felines native to the planet Rhamsis Callo. They upheld a code of honor and a respect for the martial arts, and lived in a stratified society with noble, middle, and peasant classes. All Schenor were Force-sensitive.
The Sessehshellah, or Sesseh, were a fierce aboriginal race of mustalids native to the planet Shaymore.

The Stieg-Fan were the tribes living on the planet Stieg, which was located in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories. They were known of in the wider galaxy by 43 BBY, and were generally considered to be an irenic and sociable group with a stable government.

result: Saleucami suspected of being a Separatist ally
objective: Investigation of Dark Jedi Sora Bulq's plans
x: A mission to Anzat occurred when Jedi Master Quinlan Vos brought back information that Sora Bulq had made several trips to Anzat and the Jedi thought he was up to something out there.

result: Galactic Republic's discovery of the Morgukai Shadow Army
objective: Investigate a lead on Sora Bulq
x: A mission to Saleucami occurred when Jedi Master Tholme arrived on Saleucami, and located Master Zao whom he attempted to convince to join him in his mission. However, Zao stated that he served the Force and not the Republic, whose principles diverged.

The Surronians were a race whose society was based on groups called guilds. Within each guild, there was a hive mind which governed each individual Surronian. They were known for their starship designs, unique creations almost never seen offworld.
The Sumrias were a sentient species hailing from the Lol system, a part of the Lol sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Telfreyans were a sentient species native to Telfrey, a planet they shared with Humans. They were green-skinned humanoids with small patches of green hair at the top of their heads.

The Th'iruckai were a primitive, reptilian, sentient species from the planet Th'irus. They were a warlike species who had a vast knowledge of poisons. Their society was organized into tribes led by kings called Teruks.
The Tolanese were a sentient species from Tolan. Var'Rotha Fin'Rotha was a Tolanese.

The Tolos were one of two sentient species native to the Core Worlds' Panto system. Having evolved on the planet Toloran, they worked together with the amphibious Lomins of the system's first planet, Pantolomin, to create a system-wide tourist resort.

The Tren were a species of sentient humanoids with tough, hairless, blue-purple skin and simple facial features. Members of the species sought order in their society, a pursuit that sometimes impeded their judgment of right and wrong.
The T'rinn were a sentient species with bright plumage and claws, and a body plan which allowed them to wield a shoulder-mounted missile launcher.

The Tritonites were an insectoid species from the moons of Triton. They were followers of Gactimus, and as acolytes they were a common sight in spaceports around the galaxy, offering tracts to individuals for their personal enlightenment.

Radix was a Mid Rim planet with a harsh climate. The surface consisted of a large desert with some smaller mountains. The surrounding space were full of ship-debris and other things that were pulled between the central worlds in the system.
The Troxans were a sentient species native to the planet Troxar in the Expansion Region. They had gills on their necks that fluttered and vibrated to convey emotion.
The Tuhgri were a sentient species native to the planet Ehjenla in the Kathol Outback.

Ubasameir were a sentient species with an inborn tenderness for younglings. During the Galactic Civil War, some Ubasameir worked in the Sub-Adult Center on the Bazaar Deck of the Kuari Princess, a giant luxury liner.
Uogo were a race of Humanoids native to the planet Uogo'cor, a Mid Rim world overrun by pirates.

The Urnsor'is were a species of non-sentient parasitic spiders first documented in the Myyydril Caverns on Kashyyyk, though it was unknown if they were native to the planet. The Mother Queen was known to be the source of the infestation within the caverns.
The Uroths were a species of large, sentient bipedal cephalopods. They inhabited the planet of Wizar II, where they followed a primitive way of life in isolation from much of the galaxy at large.

The Velabri were a humanoid race from the planet also known as Velabri. They were generally known as a warlike race with a strict code of honor, despising crime. The Velabri Bloodvow was practiced among the Velabri, similar to the Life debt used by Wookiees and Gungans.
The Vestaari were native to the planet Vestar. There were known to be Vestaari nomads, one of which Abal Karda attempted to disguise himself as when fleeing Vestar.

The Vicon were a sentient species that grew to a height of only one meter. They had long noses, which twitched. Hran Beling was a male Vicon who was training at the Coruscant Jedi Temple as a youngling in 89 BBY.
The Vilosorians were a sentient species native to the Mid Rim planet Vilosoria. Their bodies followed a seasonal cycle, metamorphosizing into powerful carnivores with the onset of the warm seasons.
The Vray were a gentle sentient species that was one of many forced to flee from the invading Yuuzhan Vong during the pangalactic Yuuzhan Vong War, started when they invaded the galaxy from another.
The Waroot were a sentient species native to the planet Ab'Bshingh. They warred with another indigenous species, the Farang, for centuries, developing unique tactics and customs.
The Eiattu pirates, also known as TIE Pirates, were a pirate group of Imperial starfighter pilots who were hiding out on the planet of Radix in the Abraxas system in the wake of the Battle of Endor.
House Salaktori, or Salaktori Hunters Guild, was the preeminent member house of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. Many of the most elite bounty hunters belonged to this house.
House Renliss, or House Renliss Bounty Hunters Guild, was a chapter of the Bounty Hunters' Guild specialized in hunting male fugitives.
House Neuvalis, or House Neuvalis Bounty Hunters Guild, was a chapter of the Bounty Hunters' Guild that matched bounty hunters with the bounties posted by its customers, either corporate or Imperial.
House Paramexor, Paramexor Guild of Hunters or Paramexor hunting guild was one of the main houses forming the Bounty Hunters' Guild during the Galactic Civil War.
House Tresario was an organization of bounty hunters founded in 8 BBY by former officers of the Imperial Navy to track down pirates.
The Mantis Syndicate, or Mantis Bounty Hunter Syndicate, was a corporation of bounty hunters and one of the houses belonging to the Bounty Hunters' Guild.

The Ragnar Syndicate was a member house of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. It was specializing in unorthodox techniques and skills. During the Galactic Civil War, Moff Tregar often employed the Ragnar Syndicate to take out suspected cells of Rebel Alliance supporters in his sector.
Skine Bounty Hunter College was a member house of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. It employed specialists who were considered to be at the top of their trade in a variety of fields.
Slaver Syndicate was a member house of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. Their bounties were sometimes turned over to the slavers.

The Wasilsi were a sentient humanoid species that lived on the planet Joralla. They constructed temples and villages, worked metal, and had a written language. Joralla was inhabited by another sentient species, the avian Tikiarri, with whom the Wasilsi warred for many years.
The W'iiri were a six-legged sentient species with horn plating and pincers. A number of W'iiri worked for J'uoch, the leader of a criminal mining operation, on the planet Dellalt.

The Majan were a humanoid species from the planet of Baroonda. The majority of Majans lived in Baroo, a large city that encircled the Nazwa ruins. The Majans looked very much like baseline Humans, only with a few, subtle differences such as having three lobes per ear.
The Markul were a species of sentient aliens. In Melvosh Bloor's opinion, they did not resemble Kowakian monkey-lizards.

The Mawan were a species of humanoids from the planet Mawan. They had pale skin, two hearts, and blue blood vessels close to the surface of the skin. It was considered a mark of refinement for a Mawan's veins to show through the skin.

The Mephitisians were a four-armed sentient species from the planet Mephitis. Their homeworld had a noxious atmosphere, and as a consequence, the species had evolved adaptations to limit exposure to these gases, such as lids over their eyes and the lack of a nose.
The Meshakians were a group that originated in the Meshakia system of the Mid Rim's Likasha sector.
The Mizx was a species of sentient humanoids that was indigenous to the swamp world of Randorn Two. Mizx were occasionally preyed upon by a native predator, the ibliton.

The Morellians were a species of sentient near-Humans native to the planet Morellia in Wild Space. They dominated the Morellian Commonwealth, a region patrolled by a law enforcement body known as the Morellian Enforcers.

The Mostlaa were a humanoid, sentient species. Individuals of the species had heavy brows, sunken eyes, and large, pointed ears. The Mostlaa named Jimmer had a receding hairline and a beard, creating an overall weasel-like impression.
The Nduuati were a reptilian sentient species. Feyyaz Ferdusi was a Nduuati bounty hunter and swoop racer.
The Battle of Kalla VII took place early in the Galactic Civil War, as part of Operation Skyhook.
The Ramoans were a sentient species whose homeworld was ruined by the Yuuzhan Vong. Six years after the Yuuzhan Vong War, they were still being relocated to new worlds.
Rindians were an alien race from the Rindia system. They were small in stature, had pointed ears, and possessed eight digits on each hand. Their speech was melodious to the hearer.
The Rseikharhl were a sentient species from Rseik, which was located in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Pada were a species of round-faced, mammalian bipeds. They had yellow fur, short horns, and large claws that made them excellent at climbing. They also had superb night vision.

The Paqwe were aliens native to the planet Paqwepor Major. They loved good bargains, tall tales, and had big ambitions. Most hated politics and any law that could limit their expressive freedom, basically any law.
The Pascwa were a sentient species that lived on Pii IV, a planet in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Pelemaxians were a social group that originated in the Colonies' Pelemax system. Generations before the Galactic Civil War, the Pelemaxians tamed the jungle creatures known as the tentacle birds of Pelemax as war mounts, capitalizing on their savage call, which could scare…
The Plasmars were transparent, amoeba-like creatures native to dark world Y'nybeth. Living in an unlit environment, they absorbed any available warmth into their bodies.
The Polosich were a sentient species with velvety skin of yellow pigmentation. Tyew Fordrod was a Polosich living during the Galactic Civil War.
The Nish were a near-Human species from the planet of Nishr.
The Okfili were a sentient species. During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, they were allied with the Alliance.
The Oku were a white-furred species of primitive alien sentients native to the frigid, mineral-rich planet Tokmia in the Outer Rim Territories.

The Oni were a sentient species native to the planet Uru. They were a militant species who were often known to work off-planet as mercenaries. Female Oni were electrophoretic and could store static electricity in a unique capacitor gland within their bodies.

The Aeropteryx were a race of avians from a planet in the Q'nithian system. Their wings were too small to power them for flight, so they used them for pulling themselves across the ground instead. Their wings were tipped with talons to help them do this.
Tamarack was a town on the planet Cilpar that was attacked and destroyed by Moff Boren Tascl in 4 ABY.

Imperial Noghri Commando Team 22 was an Imperial military unit active during the Galactic Civil War. In 9 ABY, led by Khabarakh clan Kihm'bar, the team was sent to Kashyyyk by Grand Admiral Thrawn in order to capture Princess Leia Organa Solo.
Widget was Mora's droid assistant on the planet M'haeli in 0 ABY.
D-4R5 was a protocol droid assigned to the Imperial garrison on M'haeli in 0 ABY.
The Ravagor was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer operating in 0.5 ABY.

result: Death of Governor Grigor and dissolution of his faction
Defection of Ranulf Trommer to the Rebel Alliance
x: The Battle of Red Rock took place on the planet M'haeli in 0 ABY, when Rebel Alliance forces under the command of Princess Leia Organa ambushed and defeated a rogue Imperial faction loyal to Governor Grigor, before being repulsed by legitimate Imperial reinforcements.
Condor was an MC40a light cruiser used by the Rebel Alliance. It accompanied the cruiser Liberty on a number of occasions, at times when Liberty was not operating alone.

result: Despayre and countless prisoners are destroyed, and the Death Star's p
x: The Destruction of Despayre was a cataclysmic event that occurred in 0 BBY, following the attack on the first Death Star. The prison planet Despayre was the final construction site of the first Death Star, where assembly of the space station's superlaser took place.
Ter Abbes was a grim industrialized planet located within the Ter Abbes system of the Expansion Region, just off the Perlemian Trade Route.
Birgis was a terrestrial world in the Dalonbian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It lay in the path of the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong species during their invasion of the galaxy.
New Holgha was a terrestrial planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Ciutric sector, known for its Five Holy Cities.

Pedd Four was an astronomical object located in the D'Astan sector of the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the fourth orbital position within the Pedd system, and the Celanon Spur hyperlane connected it to the Ord Cestus and Celanon systems.

Republic soldiers were enlisted in the Republic Army from 25,053 BBY until its dissolution in 1000 BBY. The Republic soldiers were the troops directly under Galactic Republic control, although in times of war it seems they were reinforced by levies from Republic planets.
WED15-D3 was a WED-15 Treadwell for sale at Jawa Traders in Mos Eisley. Maltreatment by previous owners have left it very suspicious.
Durkii Squadron was an Imperial TIE/LN starfighter squadron stationed at the base on Kalist VI in 0 ABY.
Crimson Squadron was an Imperial TIE/LN starfighter unit stationed at Kiidan on Cilpar in 4 ABY.

The Vunakians were Humans who showed a typical apparel: a ritual scar pattern in their forehead and their cheeks, with a completely clean-shaven head. They had numerous castes, which could be determined by the geometric symbols that were seen in the scars.

objective: To evacuate surviving Radnorans
x: The Mission to Radnor took place in 27 BBY.
The Record Time was an armed troop transport that served with distinction in the New Republic Defense Force during the fall of Coruscant and later the Battle of Borleias during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

result: Moff Kalast is tortured for information by Emperor Palpatine
x: The final battle in a long search for the Imperial traitor Kalast saw the Empire capture the traitorous Moff.

Jaboon were large, slow, four-legged herbivores with tusks native to Naboo. They were domesticated by the Gungans, for their prized hide, from which various armors and clothing could be produced. They would also give young Gungans rides on their backs at parties.

The Kresch was a semi-sentient mollusk native to Naboo. It contained information about nearly every aspect of Gungan civilization, and when opened, its blood would form pictures and words on its skin. Because of this, the Gungans used the Kresch as an encyclopedia of sorts.
The Zeer were a species of giraffe-like, non-sentient creatures.

The Shiro-trap, native to Naboo, was not a separate creature, but a symbiotic pairing of a Tooke trap plant and a Shiro. The plant disguised the animal, while the Shiro provided the plant a form of locomotion. They were known for their appetite for Tooke.
Igitz were a species of small amphibians hailing from the planet Naboo. Those blue-skinned, omnivorous critters dwelled in the planet's many dense swamps.
The Battle of Kashyyyk was a major engagement during the New Sith Wars between the Brotherhood of Darkness and the Galactic Republic.

The Battle of Hsskhor was a battle fought during the New Sith Wars between the Brotherhood of Darkness and the Galactic Republic. In 1003 BBY, the Brotherhood, seeking to gain a foothold in the Mid Rim, captured the planet of Kashyyyk.
The Great Sea of Bandomeer was the sole ocean on the planet of Bandomeer. It divided the entire planet's landmass nearly in half.
The Crimson Axe was the starship of Rav that later served as his permanent headquarters.
The Lost Sultans of Lust were a group hailing from the Lust system who dined with the Human scholar Ebenn Q3 Baobab at some point prior to the year 6 ABY.

The Aerial Plankton Uprising was a conflict in which Captain Gordun and the Human scholar Ebenn Q3 Baobab fought together against the Kinkees. The uprising was mentioned in the "About the Author" section of Ebenn's book, Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide.

The Rodrigo Andrera was a minesweeper craft tasked with dismantling the Palpatine Mine Network sometime after the Battle of Endor. After an accident, only two crew members were found alive aboard the vessel, one of whom was Ebenn Q3 Baobab.

t: Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain
x: The Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain was the Ewok name for an immense, cave-dwelling, predatory arachnid with six eyes, six legs, and a number of tentacular appendages protruding from its face.
a: The Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain

x: An unusually sarcastic B1 battle droid was part of a Confederacy of Independent Systems force based on the Forest Moon of Endor in 19 BBY.
The Wasteland was a massive junkyard that covered a large section of the planet Metalorn during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.
Viidaav was a planet located in the Bryx sector of the Mid Rim. It was inhabited by the Viidaav species.

The Viidaav, or Viidaavs, were a species of sentient humanoids with green or orange skin and angular projections growing from their heads. They were thin beings with large, expressive eyes and three-fingered hands.
A battle took place during the Clone Wars over a mining world of the Viidaav species.
a: Battle of the Viidaav mining colony

x: Ragmar V was a barren, desert-coated world in the Outer Rim Territories. Its population center was an outpost of outcasts of various species, who were opposed to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
The True Justice was an Imperial prison ship, which was used to hold trials for political prisoners in space, rather than on a planet which might potentially support the prisoners.
The Dashta Mountains were a mountain range on Ord Cestus, 180 kilometers west of the Zantay Hills and 75 kilometers northwest of Clandes.
Nexu was a Acclamator-class assault ship that served as a troop transport in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.

Bracca was an inhospitable junkyard planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim. Located close to various hyperspace routes, Bracca's strategic importance made it the site of a campaign during the Clone Wars.
Rijel-12 was a planet where Doolb Snoil had once engaged in sensitive negotiations preventing the planet seceding from the Galactic Republic.
The fire-kraken were a non-sentient species of marine predator that dwelt in the deepest oceanic trenches of the planet Nal Hutta within the Y'Toub system of Hutt Space.

Ore Boulevard was a alley disguised as a minor lava tube in ChikatLik on the planet Ord Cestus. The walls of the alley were adorned with both flat and holographic advertisements for various attractions, exhibits and vendors.
The Spindragon was Sheeka Tull's dilapidated YT-1200 medium freighter.
Kibo Sands was a desert on Ord Cestus. Skot OnSon and his family lived on a farm nearby and lost it when the Five Families cut off the water supply.
The Battle of Altair 9 was a battle fought in the Clone Wars sometime between the First Battle of Geonosis and the Mission to Ord Cestus. Alpha-98 was wounded in the battle.

Tolmeatek was the highest mountain in the Tolmea mountain range on Ord Cestus. "Tolmeatek" meant "untravelable" in X'Tingian. Its peak was covered in snow and it was around 32 kilometers tall. The first people to reach the summit without oxygen supplies did so around 120 BBY.
The Galactic Alliance Guard (GAG) was the secret police of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances during the Second Galactic Civil War.

The Zantay Hills were a stretch of hills on Ord Cestus. They were east of the Kibo Geothermal Station and Kibo Lake, 180 kilometers east of the Dashta Mountains, and to the south of Yal-Noy. They were near the Zantay Caves.
Kibo Lake was a lake on Ord Cestus. It was near the Kibo Geothermal Station and west of the Zantay Hills. It was located on Kibo Plateau.
The Singularity was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer under the command of Imperial Intelligence Director and Emperor's Hand Cronal, better known as Blackhole, during the Galactic Civil War.
Scutz was an Imperial Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that was stolen by Rebel Officers.
Chitliks were burrowing marsupials found on Ord Cestus. They lived in caves and had orange stripes. The females produced a salubrious milk called kista.
Yal-Noy was a mountain on Ord Cestus that was located to the north of the Zantay Hills. A river fed by the mountain's snowmelt ran through the hills.

The Zantay Caves were on Ord Cestus, near the Zantay Hills. They were the home of the Dashta eels, and retreated to the cave after the X'Ting began spreading across Cestus. The Caves were mapped by Kilaphor Dashta around 422 BBY.

The Zaloriis Separatists were an organization of humans from the planet Zaloriis who wanted to secede from the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War, a conflict which it fought the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The Kibo Plateau was an area of the planet of Ord Cestus in the Outer Rim Territories. It was north of the settlement Barrens and south of ChikatLik, and the plateau contained Kibo Lake.
Voor Viper was a modified Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that was owned and operated by Tig Fromm approximately 15 BBY. The vessel was not in prime condition and was prone to malfunctioning.
On the planet of Rivvidu, Boba Fett once chased a female Iotran mark. After the capture, Fett acquired his Silver Speeder. Its Imperial governor employed a Kubaz spy.
The Jawenko lava beasts were a creature native to Mustafar. It naturally produced Nkllonian lava extract from liquid xonolite.

The Ionic Ring was a weather-control starship created by Professor Renn Volz during his time at the Maw Installation, and used by the Galactic Empire as a superweapon. It was named after its Ion Ring or Climatizer, the weapon built into it.

Clone stormtroopers were stormtroopers cloned from various templates, including the Mandalorian Jango Fett, whose genetic material was used in the creation of clone troopers during the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Middle Distance was the valley on Zonama Sekot where the Ferroans first settled in 89 BBY.
R2-RC was an R2-series astromech droid that served Cryle Cavv aboard the starship G Cat.

The Galactic Banking Network, also known as the Imperial Banking Commission, was established by Emperor Palpatine shortly after the Declaration of a New Order as a successor to the Galactic Republic's clearinghouse.
Serpine was a planet known for gambling palaces. It was ruled by an "emperor-governor."
Myrmins were small creatures that lived in colonies and bustled.It had six legs and a set of feelers. Pittins chased them.
The Ocean was a Destroyer employed by the Galactic Alliance during the Second Galactic Civil War.

The Ansta was a warship employed by the Galactic Alliance during the Second Galactic Civil War. The Ansta was part of the blockade of Corellia by the Alliance's Third and Fifth Fleets. It was assigned to the Fifth Fleet, under the command of Admiral Cheb.
Revival was a warship of the Galactic Alliance during the Second Galactic Civil War.
The Thunderhead was a New Republic warship commanded by Captain Ssiew.
The Mandjur was a Majestic-class heavy cruiser in the New Republic Fifth Fleet.

Outpost was a small frozen planet located in the Bissillirus system. It was the outermost planet and covered in frozen ammonia. Unilliten Industries once established a large research facility on the world, the purpose of which was kept secret.

Coin-crabs were a species of small crustaceans, native to the coastlines of Taris, a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Known to be tasty when eaten, deep-fried coin-crabs were served at the Horizon Hotel in Taris' Upper City.

Syned was an ice-covered planet in the Syned system, in Grumani sector. During the Republic Dark Age, Syned was under the control of Sith Lord Chagras, but after his death, it fell into the hands of his daughter Arkadia Calimondra.
The Rim Merchant Einem was a Trade Federation cargo hauler in the Trade Defense Force.

Feragriffs were wild predators native to Batorine. They were ritually hunted by Blood Carvers during rite of passage ceremonies. As Blood Carvers moved to Coruscant, they brought with them the Feragriffs so as to preserve their customs.

Forre Musa was waiter droid in Zerria's Bar on Drall in 40 ABY. Although he was only programmed to serve as a waiter, Musa offered patrons what he called "intelligent entertainment", ranging from political satire to poetry.

The Dabi were a sentient species that had four arms that they could operate independently. A member of the species could speak Galactic Basic Standard. In 40 ABY, a Dabi worked as a bartender in Zerria's Bar on the planet Drall.
The Eminence was an aging Carrack-class cruiser that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

The Braha'tok was a Braha'tok-class gunship under the command of Kiles L'toth in the Dornean Navy. In 4 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, the planet Dornea loaned the Braha'tok—along with its sister ship, the Torktarak—to th…
The Torktarak was a Braha'tok-class gunship under the command of the Dornean Etahn A'baht in the planet Dornea's navy.

Dark trooper team two was a unit of dark troopers, specially trained stormtroopers empowered with the dark side of the Force. They were under the command of Zasm Katth, on the planet Nar Shaddaa. The troopers wore black stormtrooper armor, which was standard for dark troopers.
The Imperial Maintenance Corps was a group of technicians who had exclusive rights to all repairs required at the Imperial Freight Complex on the planet Byss during Operation Shadow Hand.
Scourge One was an Imperial hunter, a model of long-range intercept starship developed for use by the Dark Empire. It was piloted by the Dark Jedi Vill Goir, a member of the Dark Side Elite.
YVH 2-4S, also known as Two-Four-S, was an advanced YVH S-series battle droid with masculine programming produced by Tendrando Arms during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
YVH 2-1S was a YVH S-series war droid developed by Tendrando Arms. 2-1S was part of the Myrkr strike team in the Mission to Myrkr during the Yuuzhan Vong War in 27 ABY.

Harrod's Planet was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Oplovis sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the base of the Oplovis Sector Fleet of the Galactic Empire was located on the planet's surface.

place: Peragus Mining Facility on the Peragus asteroid field from the Harbing
result: Meetra Surik and her allies escape
x: The Skirmish at Peragus II occurred during the Old Sith Wars as the Jedi Exile, Meetra Surik was pursued by Sith forces to a major mining colony in the Peragus II asteroid field. The colony was destroyed by Darth Sion as Meetra attempted to flee the facility.
The Tridius was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that was the personal shuttle of the Reborn Emperor Palpatine. It was distinguished a gray stripe that ran from the nose of its cockpit to its stern.

CE-3K was a protocol droid serving the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. In 10 ABY, CE-3K was assigned to Jedi Master Luke Skywalker's quarters on the planet New Alderaan, shortly before the world was attacked by the Galactic Empire.
The G Cat was a modified Arakyd Helix-class light interceptor owned by Cryle Cavv. With the help of R2-RC, he claimed it was a simple transport, although it had a military background.

The Tedevium was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic that later served as a training ship for starfighter recruits, and was home to the Screaming Wookiee Squadron, a starfighter training squadron that fought as Gold Squadron.
The Backbreaker was an Imperial Lancer-class frigate in service to Warlord Zsinj and part of his third group.

side2: The Warlord and his mercenary army of Lakrans
x: The capture of the Warlord was an engagement between The Warlord's army of Lakran mercenaries against the stormtroopers of the 501st Aurek Company and their Eickarie allies in 22 ABY.

The Valley of the Lizard Warriors was a location on Endor. The valley was home to the Lizard Warrior Joddar, and was also the location where the Ewok, Graak, was sent after his banishment from Bright Tree Village.
Ewok Handlers were soldiers used by the Zann Consortium. They were armed with Gaffi Sticks and used Ewoks as bombs.
Ladro was a planet in the Colonies that supported the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Deephopper was the name of Marka Durn's battered Ghtroc Industries freighter. He was always upgrading it with his droid, R2-C9.
NCW-781 was an unexplored Wild Space planet. A terrestrial world, its surface featured mountains, canyons, and woods.
Manufactured by Alliance to Restore the Republic tactician Adar Tallon, Tala 1 was a Z-95t Headhunter produced during the Galactic Civil War fought by the Alliance against the Galactic Empire.

Tala 2 was a Z-95t Headhunter which was developed by Alliance to Restore the Republic tactician Adar Tallon. As with all Z-95t Headhunters, Tala 2 had a class 3 hyperdrive, which individually allowed Tala 2 long-range reconnaissance.

The manollium or manullian was a species of avian that was native to the planet Ithor. Specimens were characterized by their yellow-feathered bodies. The birds were also found on Belsavis, having been brought there by the Brathflen Corporation.

The lepusa were a species of herbivorous creatures that originated on the planet Freliq. During the colonization of the planet, the lepusa were viewed as vermin, because they ate most of the crops the colonists had planted. For this reason, many of the creatures were killed.
A kdak was an ancient creature of Arda II that had a huge slug-like body, a mouth surrounded by cilia-like feelers that could grab objects, a beak, nine eyes, and a strange-smelling slime trail.

The ibliton was a swamp creature of Randorn 2. A mollusk by nature, its shell was about two meters long with three meter long tentacles. Like many mollusks, its shell was chambered and coiled with its fleshy body protruding out.
Dica was a toxic planet where Qymaen jai Sheelal, better known as General Grievous, was believed to have murdered a Dark Jedi who carried Bane's Heart.

The Chattza clan was a Rodian clan on the planet Rodia. The clan was based on the continent opposite to that of Betu; the Chattza clan had little influence or presence in Betu. They were known to outfit interstellar starships.
An engagement occurred in the Yuvern system during the Galactic Civil War.
The Fleet Support Branch was one of the four organizational arms of the Imperial Navy, consisting of those officers responsible for maintenance and engineering duties.
The General Ministry Institutes were various centers of learning and research that were funded by the Galactic Republic General Ministry and then decades later by the New Republic General Ministry.
Tower 78 was one of many spires erupting out of the massive pyramid known as the Imperial Palace on Coruscant.
Walk worms were a giant species of worm. They had brown exoskeletons with tan undersides, multiple sets of legs and large mandibles.
Fislan was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Fislan system, a part of the Mortex sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
MD-1 was an MD-1 medical droid assigned to the Imperial Navy EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate. Its service carried over once the ship's crew mutined and took over control of the vessel.
Defilers were soldiers of the Zann Consortium employed as "undercover agents" of Tyber Zann whom he dispatched to various systems to promote piracy and sabotage, moreover known as "corruption".
The Imperial Core was a term used by the New Republic to designate the remnants of the Galactic Empire active in the Core during the second half of the Galactic Civil War.

result: Moff Kalast and his star destroyer Avenger escape the battle, retreati
x: The Arrest over Atzerri began when Imperial forces under the command of Darth Vader attacked a Rebel Alliance enclave on the planet of Jabiim.
As a mercenary, Darca Nyl was involved in a number of battles and conflicts years before 32 BBY.
Wildernerfs were a species of herd beast that lived on the planet of Noquivzor. They were frequently hunted by taopari.
Gizz's Gang, commonly referred to as Jabba's swoop gang was a motley swoop gang of mercenaries in the employ of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the Galactic Civil War.

JoKo's Alley was a riotous business strip located in the Underlevels of Coruscant, near Dometown. One of the businesses in JoKo's Alley was the Leafy Green tapcaf. The strip was newly constructed by 26 ABY.
The Planetary Pioneers were a group of pilots who transported colonists to uninhabited planets to settle them.
The Zabin Hive was one of the poorer Kubaz hives on Kubindi. The hive resided in the Silver Forest of Dreams.
The Subjugator was a Victory-class Star Destroyer under the command of Captain Kolaff. Juren was the ship's Chief Engineer.

The Vengeance was a YV-260 light freighter owned by the Rodian Bomu Clan. It was commanded by Heedron Bomu and his brother Ormann who both worked for Zonnos the Hutt. It was armed with twin pairs of ion cannons, a pair of blaster cannons and a turret-mounted tractor beam.
During the Yuuzhan Vong War, in 26 ABY, the planet Kubindi was attacked by the Yuuzhan Vong. The invaders were drawn to Kubindi because of the Kubaz history of genetically engineered insects.

Red Squadron was the designation of a starfighter squadron that adorned their T-65 X-wing starfighters with crimson paint. The unit was stationed aboard the New Republic Fifth Fleet's Majestic-class heavy cruiser Mandjur.
Slip 18-L was a docking area of Port Duggan of Bburru Station.
Elite Squadron was an Imperial squadron of TIE/IN interceptors stationed on Thyferra during the Bacta War as part of the Thyferran Home Defense Corps.

D-A02 was a repair and protocol droid that belonged to a freighter crew of which Matton Dasol was a member, during the time of the Jedi Civil War. A few months prior to the end of the war, D-A02's ill-fated masters made a stop over on the planet Kashyyyk to resupply.

Human League Heritage Squads were groups tasked by the Human-Supremacist organization Human League with uncovering Corellia's Planetary repulsor to use as part of their insurrection to overthrow the Corellian government, under the guise of wanting to learn more about human his…
The Zeuols were a species of sentient, pale-faced beings recognizable for their large, solid-black eyes and coarse, off-white hair.
The Battle of Tantive V was a battle between forces of the New Republic and a Imperial force commanded by Admiral Gaen Drommel.
Wolf's Claw was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer. It was one of the three Imperial-class Star Destroyers assigned as support for Admiral Gaen Drommel's flagship, Guardian.

result: New Republic Fifth Fleet passes operational readiness exercise
x: Operation Hammerblow was the New Republic Fifth Fleet's live-fire operational readiness exercise. The construction of the Fifth Fleet had been authorized by the New Republic Senate on Supreme Commander Admiral Gial Ackbar's assurances that it was needed to continue the war aga…

The Steadfast was a fleet hauler of the Rebel Alliance and later the New Republic Defense Force. It participated in the Battle of Endor and in the Battle of Coruscant against Grand Admiral Thrawn, and after the resolution of the Thrawn campaign, was modified to become a "junke…

The Trianii Rangers was a Trianii paramilitary group renowned for the protection of Trianii Colonies. Adept combatants in space, with training also in practical warfare, something the Corporate Sector Authority took note of when they encountered unnaturally stiff resistance fr…
The Polaron was a warship of the New Republic Fifth Fleet which was comprised entirely of New Class starships.

Graal'diin was a planet under the control of the Galactic Empire. Brenn and Dellis Tantor were told that their father died in a Rebel attack while delivering grain to the planet, but that was in fact a lie designed to cover the fact that the Empire had had him executed for los…
Cattena Squadron was a stormtrooper unit based at the Academy of Carida on the planet Ord Carida.
Collo Fauale Pass was an area of the Collo Fauale mountain range on Phaeda.
The capture of the Tampion was a short-lived engagement between the forces of the New Republic and those of the Yevethan Duskhan League.

F8GN or Eight-Gee-Enn, was a droid owned by Garris Shrike. the Captain of the Trader's Luck. Eight-Gee-Enn was tall and spindly. Originally, he was made from coppery-reddish metal, but had patches everywhere due to so many repairs.
Invincible was a Star Destroyer serving in the Imperial Navy. It was one of four ships that formed the core forces of Moff anti-piracy task force.

The Government Mound was a hill in the center of Abridon's capital city. On the hill's peak sat the Abridon Government Center, which served as the capitol of Abridon. Government Mound was an extremely picturesque site with a commanding view of the city.

Xandel Carivus's Private Guard were a group of soldiers established as an elite bodyguard unit by Xandel Carivus sometime prior to him becoming head of the Interim Ruling Council, presumably on the advice of Nom Anor.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: The Tampion was a fleet shuttle in the Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic.

SH∑1-B was a basic MD5 general-practitioner model medical droid, the taller of two droids that assisted Dengar in the recuperation of Boba Fett after he escaped from the sarlacc pit on Tatooine. His name was unpronounceable to most sentient creatures.

1e-XE was a white-banded MD3 pharmaceutical model medical droid, the shorter of two droids that assisted Dengar in the recuperation of Boba Fett when he escaped the Sarlacc. Its speech protocols were severely limited in comparison with its counterpart, SH∑1-B.
M-Three was one of the seventeen moons of the gas giant Mobus.

place: Jedi Temple, and surrounding areas, Coruscant
result: Beginning of the Republic's transition into the Galactic Empire
x: Operation: Knightfall, also known as the siege of the Jedi Temple and the attack on the Jedi Temple, was one of the first military engagements in the Great Jedi Purge that took place in the year 19 BBY, around the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, the home of the Jedi Order.
The Warrior was the first Warrior-class gunship to be produced under the New Republic's New Class Modernization Program for starships. It was then assigned to the inaugural New Republic Fifth Fleet.
The EX-F was an Imperial warship used as a testbed for new gunnery and engine technologies. It was part of the Black Fleet, which was captured by the alien Yevetha towards the end of 4 ABY.
The Courageous was an Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship that served in the Republic Navy during the Mandalorian Wars.
R6-S1 was the astromech unit of elite Bothan pilot Eelo Begraas. Nicknamed "Shootfirst", the droid helped him fly his customized Z-95 Headhunter Dicer.

Shorty was a nickname given to a astromech droid on Cloud City during the height of the Galactic Civil War. He was secretly a Rebel Alliance agent. The unit helped refugees on Cloud City to reach Rebel safeworlds.

R5-M1 was a slow-moving and noisy astromech droid that was employed by Fiz Cor'gril as a starship mechanic. The unit had the annoying habit of beeping and chirping to itself, while its malfunctioning acoustic signaler sometimes raised the sound level to unbearable levels.
Bot-Un was a domed city on Belsavis. It was located in one of the planet's rifts. Inhabitants of Bot-Un recalled interaction with Plett.

RD-RR was an astromech droid that resembled an R-5 series unit and was red in color. The droid's batteries ran down before it was able to complete a mission, while its builder put the droid in a training exercise.
The Paonga Strait was a channel in Lake Paonga on Naboo that connected Otoh Gunga to the Gungan sacred place in the Lianorm Swamp.
R1-T4 was an R1-series astromech droid produced by Industrial Automaton. R1-T4 was programmed with coded information pertaining to the location of Emperor Palpatine's hidden weapon stores.
P2-D19 was a P2-series astromech droid produced by Industrial Automaton. The droid was considered outdated as of the Galactic Civil War.
R5-R5 was an R5-series astromech droid produced by Industrial Automaton. Owned by the Gungan trader Toba, R5-R5 helped fly the Gungan's freighter, Sea Killer.

Garhai were a species of armor-plated fish native to the planet Neimoidia. The planet's native Neimoidians saw the garhai as a symbol of obedience and "dedication to enlightened leadership." Along with its twin symbol, the Spherical Flame, this was considered one of the two mo…
BXET-R2, nicknamed Box, was an astromech droid assigned to a Y-wing fighter piloted by Rebel flight leader Wilkins during the Galactic Civil War.
The Bestine Chamber of Commerce, together with the Tatooine Moisture Farm Collective, once employed hunters on Tatooine to kill wild creatures known to damage the planet's moisture vaporators.

The Imperial Department for Epidemic Prevention hired hunters on Tatooine to kill wild creatures that were suspected to be carrying droch eggs in order to prevent an outbreak of Death Seed there in 1 ABY.
C-5MO was a silver protocol droid that served as a clerk in a droid shop on the Imperial Remnant capital of Bastion.

Rintatta City was a major city of the planet Exocron. Talon Karrde and his group of smugglers landed at Circle 15 in the Rintatta City military landing fields when going to Exocron to visit Jorj Car'das.
The Fairfax was a Rebel bulk cruiser that was present and destroyed at the Battle of the Bajic Shipyards.

Ratter thists, also known as Kordulian Krisses or simply Krisses, were small and agile furry creatures with striped tan fur and retractable claws. They were sometimes kept as pets, and were used to guard livestock in mountain valleys.
The Analysis Bureau was a bureau of Imperial Intelligence responsible for handling large amounts of data from tens of millions of sources.

Eliior was the capital city of Romin, a world governed by an oppressive dictatorship. The capital was surrounded by the Cloudflower Wall, manned by guard droids and security devices, including surveillance droids, effectively trapping the workers of Romin out of the main city.
Dancer was the nickname given by Mara Jade Skywalker to her own astromech droid. This droid was used aboard the XJ3 X-wing she flew as part of Saber Squadron.
"Nine" was the designated name given to Mara Jade Skywalker's R9-series astromech droid. The droid was used aboard her StealthX starfighter during the height of the Swarm War.
Neufie was the nickname given by Jacen Solo for his R9-series astromech droid. The droid was used in his StealthX starfighter during the height of the Swarm War.

Tikiarri (sing. Tikiar) were sleek, dark, sapient predatory birds from Joralla in the Mektrun sector. The Tikiar starfighter was named after them. They were known to use the six-limbed Oslets as mounts.
During the the Yuuzhan Vong War, at some point between 25 ABY and 26 ABY, Osarian was attacked by the Red Knights of Life.
LEGO City was a gated city in the Known Universe. Despite not being located in the galaxy, the conflict of the Skywalker family was felt there through a Disturbance in the Force.

Beach Troopers were a specialized branch of stormtroopers who wore a stripped down variant of the usual stormtrooper armor, which included the regular helmet and a swimsuit. Beach troopers were often found lounging in baths and spas, seemingly off-duty.
Mutriok were four-legged non-sentient creatures native to Socorro. They were often preyed on by tra'cors, the amphibious cousins of the rancor.
The Cloudland Peaks were a series of towering mountain ranges on the planet Selonia.
R2-D9, also known as "Deenine," was an R2-series astromech droid owned by a freighter pilot named Verzon Tennd, who was a native of Naboo.
Part of a family-run repair business, R2-PU was an R2-series astromech droid operating on the Galactic Rim for generations before the Battle of Endor.
The companion of Rebel agent Shaparo, R2-Q8's Intellex IV droid brain was modified by his owner to access the prison records of the Dnalvec garrison on Sriluur.
R2-QU was an R2-series astromech droid owned by Aloren Breesa, a wealthy businesswoman.
The forces of Warlord Zsinj executed a hit-and-fade strike against the New Republic forward base on the world of Noquivzor.
2-E was a green Model E nanny droid who ran a nursery on Kalarba along with his companions Q-E and U-E.
Q-E was a red Model E, a nanny droid who ran a nursery on Kalarba along with his companions 2-E and U-E.

U-E was a yellow Model E, a nanny droid who ran a nursery on Kalarba along with his companions Q-E and 2-E. He and his companions served on Kalarba for many years, babysitting many clients. By 5 BBY, they were antiques, but they still continued to serve.
R4-M17 was a hardworking, but stubborn astromech droid. Her Arc welder had an intermittent short, and her third leg could no longer retract, but otherwise she was a skilled worker.
R2-RD was an Alliance astromech droid paired with C-D20, a Human-cyborg relations droid. They were assigned to Commander Dauntarist aboard a newly-manufactured HT-2200 medium freighter.
R2-V6 was an R2-series astromech droid produced by Industrial Automaton.
Owned by a Krish mechanic known as Maniac, this modified astromech droid was nicknamed Patchwork. The droid had additional armor plating and was installed with a variety of tools.
Phosphor bugs, also known as firebugs, were flying insects that flashed light. They were native to Belsavis.

3B3 was a B1 battle droid that served in the Trade Federation Droid Army. During the invasion of the planet Naboo in 32 BBY, 3B3 discovered the Jedi Knights Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi and the Gungan Jar Jar Binks sneaking into the capital city Theed.

Purchased by an Outer Rim scavenger decades before the Battle of Yavin, R4-J1 scoured junkyards for parts after developing a scavenging routine of its own. During this time, the droid developed an unusual trait that caused it to jury-rig devices it was supposed to repair.

R4-J9 was an R4 astromech droid, one of three droids assigned to a droid pool that included R4-S2, which managed to survive the Twi'leki scout ship crash and repair itself in 90 BBY. The unit and R4-S2 went on to work for the administrative droid, QS-2D.
R2-V0 was a R2-series astromech droid with purple adornments. R2-V0 was owned by the Ithorian Ixsthmus, a captain of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
R2-Z1, pronounced Artoo-ZeeOne, was an astromech droid owned by a Bothan diplomat by the name of Tereb Ab'Lon. The droid was nicknamed Fweep.
R2-Z13 was an astromech droid owned by a pilot named Koril Bekam. The droid also went by the nickname Plug.

objective: Capture an Imperial I2-CG droid
x: The Mission to Goratak III was fought early in the Galactic Civil War between forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
R4-B11 was an R4 astromech droid owned by Slythor the Squib sometime after the Battle of Yavin. He was known to be cranky and destructive.

R3-K8 was an R3 astromech droid assigned to the New Republic corvette FarStar. Assigned to the hangar control room on the ship, the droid was fitted with an astromech voice box to facilitate communication between itself and the living controller on duty.
R2z-DL, nicknamed Toozy, was the only maintenance droid to ever earn the Rebel Alliance's Rohal Cross for valor. The unit was owned by a deep-cover Alliance operative at one time.

Skorr's starship was a starship used by the bounty hunter Skorr while pursuing the Millennium Falcon from Ord Mantell. The vessel was seized by an Imperial Star Destroyer and Skorr was sent to the Spice Mines of Kessel.
Bay 3 was the designation of the hangar bay where Dash Rendar's Outrider was kept at Echo Base around the time of the Battle of Hoth.

Research Station Shantipole was an asteroid in the Roche system. It was primarily staffed by Verpine. After the Battle of Yavin, the asteroid was the site of the Shantipole Project, in which Slayn & Korpil worked with Commander Gial Ackbar to develop the A/SF-01 B-wing starfig…
Z-58-0 security droid, or Zeeo, was a floating security droid manufactured by Arakyd Industries that once worked for Black Sun.

Luptoom was an Outer Rim Territories planet situated in the Seswenna sector. The planet's Human population, known as Luptoomians, was known for its unusual style of clothing. During the Separatist Crisis, the Luptoomian Nar Hida opened a fashion store on the planet Coruscant.
The Hamadryas were a simian humanoid species with green skin and ape-like snouts. They seemed to not possess the need to blink, and the species lacked a true carotid artery.

New Nozho was a city on Clak'dor IV that was founded by the Y'bith. It was named for the city of Nozho, which was destroyed by a biological attack around 300 BBY during a civil war on the Clak'dor VII. New Nozho eventually became a notable trade port.

The Wide-Eyed was an Imperial survey vessel that claimed to have received a text-based distress signal from the Tantive IV. Though the Rebel ship had, in actuality, been captured by the Imperial Star Destroyer Devastator, the BoSS report filed by Wide-Eyed stated otherwise.

The Merciless was Tyber Zann's personal Aggressor-class destroyer, which served as his and the Zann Consortium's flagship. The basis of the Aggressor-class destroyer, it's design plans were found in the ruins of the destroyed first Death Star by the Zann Consortium.
Garbage rats were a tiny yet sleek scavenger race that tended to set up warrens within the rubbish wastes that had accumlated in dirtier, less frequented byways.
This converted drone barge was Admiral Mordur's base of operations following the Battle of Endor.

result: All lab personnel killed, all assassin droids escape.
x: The Holowan Massacre or Holowan Disaster took place sometime before 15 BBY on the planet of Halowan. It involved the death of dozens of scientists and guards at the Holowan Laboratories at the hands of the assassin droid IG-88.

result: All organic life on-planet dead, droids and IG-88 in complete control
x: The Mechis III Uprising was an incident following the Holowan Massacre which saw the IG-88s take over the droid foundry world of Mechis III from its Human managers.

x: The Risp were small dog-like amphibians native to Ord Vaxal, often trained as guard animals.
Qaestar Town was the largest city on the planet Talus and the Twin Worlds. It was dominated by its enormous spaceport, located on the Qaestar Ridge two kilometers above the city proper.
The Free Mandalore was a modified Kubrai-class S4 transport produced by Kubrai Transportation. In addition it served as Fenn Shysa's personal starship, which he used during the race for the Tessent.
Protector was a Victory-class Star Destroyer in the New Republic Navy during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

x: The Battle of To-phalion Base was an attack launched by Grand Admiral Zaarin against Grand Admiral Thrawn to steal the Vorknkx Project.
Nightfall was a Sith Destroyer in the fleet of the New Sith Empire, which served as Lord Kaan's flagship in the final years of the New Sith Wars.

conflict: New Sith Wars (Light and Darkness War)
