The Camblian Order was a scientific organization that, shortly before the Battle of Yavin in 1 BBY, sent 309 prospective students from the Outer Rim world of Eedoq to be enrolled at the Clarion Scholars Academy on the Expansion Region planet Daemen.
Mauler was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that was part of Kuat's planetary defenses. It was present at the Battle of Kuat.

The Beauty of Yevetha was the name given to a corvette captured by the Duskhan League from the Galactic Empire's Black Sword Command circa 4 ABY. The vessel was subsequently used by Nil Spaar to scout the Koornacht Cluster, and then formed part of Yevethan fleet.
Clan Skirata was a Mandalorian clan. Its members included Munin Skirata and his adopted son Kal Skirata.
This starship was owned by the New Jedi Order in 12 ABY. It was used by Streen and Kirana Ti to travel to the planet Corbos in response to Dorsk 82's signal for help.

LU-L-N was an 8D smelter droid who served as a reporter for The Emperor's Court. After a trial for the murder of Greedo, LU-L-N interviewed the defendant, Han Solo, who lost the case and was sentenced to life frozen in carbonite.
Column Commons was a district of Coruscant located between the Imperial Palace and the Calocour Heights area. The architecture of the region was unique when seen from the surface.

The bulfus (plural: bulfusi) was a large flying mammal native to the Core Worlds planet of Corulag. Roughly bat-shaped but with otter-like features, bulfusi were skilled hunters with a powerful aerial attack.
The attack on Toryaz Station occurred during the Second Galactic Civil War, orchestrated by Sith Lady Lumiya and Thrackan Sal-Solo. It saw the death of Aidel Saxan, the Five World Prime Minister.
The fanback was a cold-blooded amphibian from Naboo. Each fanback had a big dorsal spine along with a sensitive snout.

The Meduza were a non-sentient, apparently exotic species. Although they were not sentient, they were able to be trained, to some extent, as guardians. They could heed simple commands and recognize their name, but not too much more than that.
During the Stenax Massacres of 4 ABY, the Stenax species invaded the planet Kadril, wresting control of the world from the Galactic Empire as they did to many worlds throughout the Gordian Reach.
During the Stenax Massacres of 4 ABY, the Stenax species invaded the planet Alzar, wresting control of the world from the Galactic Empire as they did to many worlds throughout the Gordian Reach.
During the Stenax Massacres of 4 ABY, the Stenax species invaded the planet Arda II, wresting control of the world from the Galactic Empire as they did to many worlds throughout the Gordian Reach.
During the Stenax Massacres of 4 ABY, the Stenax species invaded the planet Sooma, wresting control of the world from the Galactic Empire as they did to many worlds throughout the Gordian Reach.
During the Stenax Massacres of 4 ABY, the Stenax species invaded the planet Tandankin, wresting control of the world from the Galactic Empire as they did to many worlds throughout the Gordian Reach.
During the Stenax Massacres of 4 ABY, the Stenax species invaded the planet Tharkos, wresting control of the world from the Galactic Empire as they did to many worlds throughout the Gordian Reach.
The Security and Intelligence Council (SIC) also known as the Security Council was a Senate council of the Galactic Alliance.

Tinallis was a planet located within the Tinallis system of the Mid Rim. Though it was an industrialized planet, it was noted for the wildlife in its oceans, seashores, and rainforests. One of its native creatures, the tresher, was a lucrative but illegal trade item.

Red 3 was a T-65 X-wing starfighter in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The fighter was flown by Biggs Darklighter, and had previously been stationed near Sullust as part of the Ecliptic Evaders squadron.
Red 7 was a T-65 X-wing starfighter in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Red 8 was a T-65 X-wing starfighter in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. It was assigned to Red Squadron and stationed at the Rebel base on Yavin 4.

Red 9 was a T-65 X-wing starfighter in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Flown by Lieutenant Nozzo Naytaan, the starfighter was outfitted with extra cargo room and led the relief fleet to Clak'dor VII.
Gold 2 was the designation of a BTL-A4 Y-wing in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It was flown by Tiree.

Gold 3 was the designation of a BTL-A4 Y-wing in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Flown by Ryle Torsyn, the fighter was originally stationed at Dantooine base where it was part of the squadron under Davish Krail's command.
Gold 4 was the designation of a BTL-A4 Y-wing in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The craft had several scars across its hull caused by small asteroid impacts.

Gold 5 was the designation of a BTL-A4 Y-wing in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It was flown by Davish "Pops" Krail, and he personally supervised all repairs and maintenance conducted on the starfighter.
Gold 6 was the designation of a BTL-A4 Y-wing in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Piloted by Hol Okand, the fighter led an attack against an Imperial outpost at Kashyyyk.

t: Tatooine Bureau of Ethnicity and Socialization
x: The Tatooine Bureau of Ethnicity and Socialization was an adjunct of the mining colony that was operating on Tatooine in the sixth century BBY.
Q-7N was a Malagarrian mining droid. He left his home planet of Malagarr when its populace wiped itself out by making the planet a giant reactor, causing huge levels of radioactivity.
Treshers were large seabirds which nested on the coastal cliffs of the planet Tinallis. They fed on fish and other aquatic animals, especially the blue-ringed sea crab.
Zio Snaffkin, also known as Zio Snaffkin Spaceport was a major city on Dennogra. It was the home of Ithorian trader Sprool, who was known to frequent the Zio Snaffkin Cantina.
The Indus (singular, Indu) were a Human race from the planet Indu San.
A vartlett was a creature that could be kept as a pet. It was often leashed or tethered and hummed along behind its master.
Indellian was a low-gravity planetoid that served as a trade world, manufacturing hub, and government center for the Yarith sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

The Cracken Flight Group, also known as Cracken's Flight Group, was the name given to the pilots in Pash Cracken's wing of TIE Fighters whom he led in a defection from the Galactic Empire to the Rebel Alliance.

x: The mission to Endor took place during the Clone Wars.

Blathar III was a moon. At one time it was visited by the exotics dealer Rufus Trammel, who harvested a number of the planet's native specimens. After Trammel's departure from the moon, non-native viruses wiped out most of the moon's plant life.

The Convocation of the Force, also known more simply as the Convocation or the Force Convocation, was an advisory body and council designed to promote understanding between the various Force religions based on the desert moon Jedha during the High Republic Era.
The Bail Organa was a CR90 corvette. The ship was used to transport refugees from the destroyed planet of Alderaan.
A massacre took place in Ettam, a small town on the planet Ralltiir, during the Galactic Empire rule of the world.

conflict: Light and Darkness War, New Sith Wars
x: In the Light and Darkness War during the New Sith Wars, a battle occurred on the planet Ambria that saw the Army of Light defeat the Brotherhood of Darkness.

The Lucky Star was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in the Rebel Alliance's fleet. It was frequently used to support Generals Tyr Taskeen and Brenn Tantor's ground operations during the Galactic Civil War.
Ninebeedee was the personal droid of Krynda Draay. It was destroyed by Q'Anilia in 3963 BBY.
Dewback's Burden was a GR-75 medium transport that served with the New Republic Defense Force. It was named after the dewback, a common beast of burden.
The Metron Burner was a Corellian YT-1300 light freighter transport owned by Bama Vook prior to the Invasion of Naboo
Sayan was a prominent industrial city on the planet of Abridon. It was the home of the Abridon Shipyard. In 3 ABY, the Abridon Nationalists took control of Abridon.
Mondder was the capital city of Etti IV. It contained the Mondder Spaceport and the Imperial Embassy.
The First WatchCircle was a group composed of Jedi Seers within the Jedi Covenant. It consisted of five Jedi Masters, all of whom were dedicated to prevent the return of the Sith.

The Onderon Royalists were people and factions on the Inner rim planet of Onderon that supported Queen Talia over her cousin, General Vaklu, during the Onderon Civil War. The exact nature of Royalist sentiment varied.

Twilight Squadron was the name of the TIE/LN starfighter squadron based aboard Rand Ecliptic in the time prior to the Battle of Yavin. Its members included Delund, Peate Kurin, Tars Nandy and was commanded by First Mate Biggs Darklighter and Second Mate Derek Klivian.
The Emperor's Disciple was a Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy that served as the personal flagship of the Imperial Grand Admiral Ishin-Il-Raz.

The Kliknik was a dangerous insectoid species native to the jungles of Yavin 4. These voracious carnivores lived in large underground hives and reported only to their queen, who oversaw every last Kliknik.

Quadducks were six-limbed avians that could be found on the planet Naboo, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. They were related to the ducks and the pelikki, two other waterfowl species that also lived on Naboo. In addition to their wings, they had not two but four legs.

Fire wasps were small, stinging insects with 6 clawed legs. They were able to fly with the use of 4 wings. Their antennae ended in sharp pointed stinger. The abdomen stinger had an embedded egg pod as well as poison, which would hatch inside the stung victim.
Capital Square was a location in Iridonia's capital city of Malidris.

The Toten was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that served as the personal transportation of Admiral Harkov during the Galactic Civil War. It was first spotted during the raid on Science Station Youst just about to enter hyperspace.

Eusebus, also called Euceron City, was the capital city of the planet Euceron. The city was normally not full of traffic, but when the Galactic Games took place on the planet in 26 BBY, it became considerably more crowded.
The capital city of Abridon was a pleasant city that served as the seat of government for the planet.
Bennie was a medical droid that worked at the medcenter of the Moonbender Colony, assisting Doctor Korvik, who felt that the droid needed some reprogramming.

Rakata Prime, also known as Rakata and Lehon, was the homeworld of the long-extinct Rakata species, who were rumored to be the first to develop hyperspace travel, and was one of the few navigable worlds located in the Unknown Regions.

result: The 908th was wiped out to the last man
x: The Battle of Borosk was fought between stormtrooper forces loyal to Roan Fel and those loyal to the New Empire under Darth Krayt.

The Alderaanian Resistance was an early resistance movement against the Galactic Empire, led by Bail Organa on Alderaan during the early years of the New Order. It later became one of the founding members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

A resistance on Chandrila was an anti-Imperial resistance movement led by Mon Mothma on Chandrila during the early years of the New Order. It later became one of the founding members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The Battle of Science Station Youst was one of the preliminary battles of the Sepan Civil War, in which the Ripoblus forces launched an attack on the Dimok Science Station Youst.

The Dromon was a Ripoblus frigate that attempted to aid its forces at the Battle of Science Station Youst during the Sepan campaign. It was destroyed while attacking the Victory-class Star Destroyer Protector.
The Galliot was a Corellian Engineering Corporation CR92a Assassin-class corvette operated by the Ripoblus.

The Sabre was a Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport used by the Ripoblus to attack the Dimok Science Station Youst. It was destroyed at the Battle of Science Station Youst by imperial pilot Maarek Stele, who fired two heavy rockets to the transport.
Pike was a Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport used by the Ripoblus to attack the Dimok Science Station Youst. It was destroyed at the Battle of Science Station Youst.
Musket was a Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport that was used by the Ripoblus for their attack upon the Dimok-controlled Science Station Youst. It was destroyed during the battle that resulted.
The Halberd was a Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport used by the Ripoblus to attack the Dimok Science Station Youst. It was destroyed at the Battle of Science Station Youst.
The Galactic Empire successfully defended their Outpost D-34 from a Rebel attack shortly after the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.

The Hungry Ghost was a extremely modified Carrack-class cruiser owned by the pirate salvager Redkihl Rokk. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, the freighter attempted to salvage scrap from the destroyed Death Star. The cruiser, along with Rokk, were destroyed by Han Solo in 0 ABY.

objective: Capture Gibbela for the Empire
x: The Mission to Gibbela was an embarrassing loss for the Galactic Empire. Gibbela was a remote world, left mostly alone by the wider galaxy. When an entire Imperial stormtrooper squad landed on the planet, they discovered why.
U'Dray was a planet situated in the U'Dray system of the Hook Nebula, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Santarine was a planet that was located within the Hook Nebula, along the Outer Rim of the galaxy.
Jofoger was a planet located in the Jofoger system of the Periphery, a region in the Tharin sector of the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the Sisar Run hyperlane.
Tragrud was the only planet in the Tragrud system, a star system located in the Periphery, a sector in the Outer Rim Territories.
Pyesmev was a Rendili StarDrive–designed Imperial Customs Corvette.
The skar'kla, skar-kla, or glitterclaw, was a semiaquatic, carnivorous reptile, lethal predator native to Bothawui.

conflict: End of the Yuuzhan Vong War
x: A conclave was called by Jedi Master Luke Skywalker at the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War. Held on Zonama Sekot in 29 ABY, it gathered together virtually all the Jedi, including the students onboard the Errant Venture and those stationed at the Shelter in the Maw.

The Undercity sewers was a waste-management complex in among the lowest levels of planet Taris, which was sandwiched between the Undercity surface and the underground city, known as the Promised Land.
The Intrepid was a Galactic Republic luxury cruiser that belonged to the High Council of the Jedi Order in the final decades of the Republic.
The Bloodfin were dark red, semi-aquatic predators native to the oceans of Bastion. They were adorned with a scarlet crest on their head and four-legged with cloven hoofs like daggers.
The Battle of the Tungra sector was a minor battle shortly after the Battle of Hoth.
A second battle occurred at Outpost D-34 shortly after the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.
A battle in the Bruanii sector concluded the Mugaari Campaign shortly after the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.
The Raid on Spearhead was the last major battle in which the unified Gungan tribes attacked and destroyed Boss Rogoe's city of Spearhead.
The Liberation of Spinnaker was a retaliatory strike to recapture Spinnaker from the Trade Federation during the Invasion of Naboo.

result: Trade Federation forces in Harte Secur destroyed
x: The Liberation of Harte Secur was a retaliatory battle where forces led by Boss Rugor Nass attacked Camp Six and the occupied city of Harte Secur to rescue their Fambaa beasts of burden.
In 1 BBY, during the Galactic Civil War, Imperial forces under the command of High Inquisitor Jerec subjugated the moon of Sulon.
In 3 ABY, the Abridon Nationalists attempted to force the Galactic Empire off the planet Abridon.

result: Partial Galactic Empire victory; Alliance to Restore the Republic defe
x: The Massacre on Abridon took place in 3 ABY when the Galactic Empire attempted to take back Abridon from the Abridon Nationalists, who were supported by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

result: Decisive Alliance victory, Abridon becomes member of the Alliance to R
x: The Third Battle of Abridon took place in 4 ABY, right before the Battle of Endor. The Alliance to Restore the Republic supported the Abridon Nationalists in their effort to drive the Galactic Empire off Abridon.
A droid worked at Star Tours' Tomorrowland Starport. The droid ran on tracks, much like the model of MSE-series droids also at the starport.
The Subjugation of Sriluur occurred in 0 ABY, in which the Galactic Empire invaded and conquered the planet Sriluur.
The Pulsar was a DP20 gunship that was a part of the New Republic Defense Force attached to General Keyan Farlander's fleet towards the end of 27 ABY.

Nampi's guards was a loose term used to refer to the security personnel on board Princess Nampi's ship, a converted Nuffin freighter. They were humanoid bipeds with purple skin, two eyes on the top of their heads, and no noses.

The 37th Detachment was a unit of the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. The stormtrooper unit was stationed in the city of Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine by 0 BBY. In that year, another stormtrooper unit, Zeta Squadron, relieved the 37th Detachment at Mos Eisley.
A skirmish occurred on the planet Kashyyyk at the beginning of the Nagai invasion of 4 ABY.
The Battle of Herdessa was a preliminary battle in the Nagai invasion of 4 ABY.
Blurrg's Isle was a geographical location of Endor. This location was said to be the birth place of the blurrg.
The Rancor's Tooth was a Corellian Engineering Corporation CR90 corvette that operated as a privateer ship for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Aa'kuans were a group of anarchists present in the Corellian system during the Galactic Civil War. The overall conviction of the Aa'kuans was anarchistic.
The Alkhara Bandits, also referred to as the Alkharans, were a band of criminals based on Tatooine.
Beldonna's League, also known as Beldonna's Legion, were a group of mercenaries that had formed under the leadership of Liiria Beldonna, to whom they were fiercely loyal.
The Canyon Corsairs, also known as the Corsair Raiders or simply as the Corsairs, were a group of pirates active on the planet Lok and in the Karthakk system during the Galactic Civil War.
The Chunkers were a gang of junk pirates active on the Twin World of Talus during the Galactic Civil War. They primarily stole items that other people had trashed or "chunked away"—hence their name.
The Donkuwah were a tribe of Duloks on Endor.
The Garyn Raiders was a criminal organization based on Rori before and during the Galactic Civil War.
The Greck were a gang of thugs run by the corrupt and criminal businessman Olag Greck, after whom the gang took its name. They were active on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
The Tiger was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

G2-3B was a spindly G2 repair droid who supervised the work being done by G2-9T and G2-4T for Star Tours in the aftermath of the Galactic Civil War. He did not have a conventional head for his droid model.

F-23-DKMx, also known simply as F-23, was a masculine F series repair droid with blue photoreceptors and silver plating, with a blue trim. By the year 4.3 ABY, he was employed by the Star Tours travel agency at their Tomorrowland Starport.

Perilious was a planet that was located within the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. It was home to a large criminal element, which including a large slaving ring that dealt in Twi'leks. The world was continually covered by storms.
Risso was a planet located in the Risso system, situated in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim region, in grid square N-14 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Neo-Cobral, or Cobral for short, was a criminal organization active on Rori during the Galactic Civil War.

The Janta were a Dantari tribe living on the planet Dantooine. Most of the Janta lived in their village and the tribe also established a stronghold in a cave. The Janta were in conflict with the Kunga and the Mokk, another Dantari tribes.

The Kobola Miners were a dreaded crime organization based on Naboo and its moon Rori during the Galactic Civil War. They mined for spice which they sold to various Hutt organizations. They controlled a spice mine on Rori which they used as a bunker.

The Kunga were a Dantari tribe from Dantooine. Most of the Kunga lived in their village and the tribe also established a stronghold in a cave. The Kunga were in conflict with the Janta and the Mokk, another Dantari tribes.
The Lost Aqualish Regiment, best known as the Lost Aqualish, were a group of Aqualish who had settled secretly on Talus where they lived in isolation since centuries.
The Maulers were a group of criminals active on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.
The Meatlumps, also known as the Meatlump Gang, were a band of fanatical technology-hating ruffians, criminals, and terrorists active on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.
The Mummers were a criminal and terrorist organization active on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.

The Rori Spice Mining Collective, also known simply as the Spice Collective, was a conglomeration of law-abiding miners who were the only group legally allowed to mine spice on Naboo's moon of Rori during the Galactic Civil War.
The Sennex or Sennex Pirates were slave traders from the Sennex system. They were considered among the most despicable pirates in the galaxy during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The Skaak Tippers were a gang of renegade computer slicers active on Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.

Hampton was a BFF-1 bulk freighter during the Galactic Civil War. With the assistance of Alliance Intelligence, two captured Rebel pilots were able to escape from Stars' End prison by stowing away on the Hampton.
Courage was a GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat owned by the New Jedi Order.
The Tinmolok was a Marl-class heavy freighter manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards. Captained by Swori Mdimu and his Etti crew, it was part of the Peace Brigade fleet during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The Star Roamer was a medium freighter manufactured by Damorian Manufacturing Corporation. It was owned by CorDuro Shipping and in 26 ABY was used to deliver a shipment of bacta to the Yuuzhan Vong.
The Darkwalkers were one of the many criminal gangs that infested Naboo during the Galactic Civil War.
The Genesis Red was a criminal organization led by a crime lord by the name of Genesis Red during the Galactic Civil War.

The Mos Eisley Police Authority was the local law enforcement agency in Mos Eisley, Tatooine. Their force was armed with blasters and had a station in the spaceport to enable the questioning of suspects. The officers patrolled the city and also operated in space above Tatooine.

F-24-AMTx, also known simply as F-24, was a masculine F series repair droid with green photoreceptors and silver plating, with a red trim. By the year 4.3 ABY, he was employed by the Star Tours travel agency at their Tomorrowland Starport.
The Ashanda Ray was a MC-18 light freighter, and the personal freighter and starship of the gambler Kinnin Vo-Shay. It was a one of a kind vessel of Mon Calamari make.

The dogfight over Naboo was a minor space battle that took place over Naboo some time after 0 ABY.

result: Destruction of Byss, the Eclipse II and the Galaxy Gun
x: The Destruction of Byss was a cataclysmic event that marked the end of Operation Shadow Hand, along with the final death of Emperor Palpatine.
The Skirmish over Vuchelle was a battle of the late Separatist Crisis. In it, a Jedi-led Judicial Forces task force dealt a severe blow to the Pirates of Iridium.

The Chiaki was a large snake-like predator native to the oceans of Iskalon. While their diet consisted primarily of other aquatic creatures, the chiaki were not at all opposed to capturing the unwary Iskalonian for their next meal.

The kirithin was an amphibious predator found throughout planets in the Outer Rim Territories. Encased in heavy, protective scales, the creature's long front fins were used both for locomotion on land and for hunting prey.

R2-C4, frequently referred to as "C4," served the New Republic during 34 ABY as an R-series astromech droid. R2-C4 flew with Kazuda Xiono's squadron on their mission to deliver intelligence about the First Order to the Resistance.
Green glie was a plant which grew in deep swamps. It spread very quickly and was eaten by ollopom. It choked out other swamp molds and was related to red glie.

Red glie was a plant related to green glie, and possessed similar properties despite its red coloration. It was used by Gungans to create a tasty salad dressing, and sold in markets by the Humans of that world as a delicacy.

Najoons were a species of nocturnal avians that were native to the Forest Moon of Endor. They varied in size from a quarter to half a meter long, with wingspans ranging from forty-five to seventy centimeters.

result: The Galactic Empire obtains a Sith holocron
x: The Space Battle at Carida took place during the Galactic Civil War, above the planet Carida, circa 3 ABY–4 ABY.

result: Tyber Zann escapes, resurrection of Zann Consortium
x: The Ground Battle on Kessel occurred early during the Galactic Civil War, when Urai Fen instigated an insurrection on the prison world of Kessel to free the crime lord Tyber Zann.
The Vehemence was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that served as part of the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Malice was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Hovan 99 was a moon in the Hovan system of the Senex sector, and was the site of a deep-space supply depot during the New Republic era.
Binks's Woe was an island in the southernmost seas of Naboo. George R. Binks, his wife and their son Jar Jar spent at least a month shipwrecked there.
Dura Mater Settlement was a settlement on Tatooine that was filled with gullible buyers of droids. Stan and Fred Jawa often hit it.
The Khonin Mountain Range was on Tatooine, east of the Cage. Obi-Wan Kenobi may have lived in a cave there.

Flek was a droid bought cheap by a young Lando Calrissian, who used him for his (scant) knowledge. Flek couldn't swim, and accompanied Lando on a scam operation to the Meeks. Flek advised Lando that he would never become a scoundrel.

result: Energy collectors and drilling platform recovered
x: In 0 ABY, the Battle of Sarapin was fought between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic for control of Sarapin's vital energy collection capacity.
Star's Delight was a Gymsnor-3 light freighter owned by the Duros weapon trader Lai Nootka. In addition to Nootka, the crew comprised the Devaronian Saricia and a Sullustan pilot.

The Shadda-Bi-Boran were a race of green-skinned humanoids indigenous to the planet Shadda-Bi-Boran. A peaceful sun-worshipping civilization, the Shadda-Bi-Boran faced extinction in 43 BBY when their system's star began to die, depriving them of radiation without which they co…
A mission to Endor was undertaken immediately after the Battle of Hoth in order to find a suitable site for the Second Death Star's shield generator.
The Battle of Storinal was fought between Galactic Empire and New Republic forces for the control of the planet of Storinal.
Kashyyyk Bantha was a subspecies of bantha native to Kashyyyk. They were much larger than the banthas on Tatooine, and had slightly shorter fur.

QS-2D was a heavily-modified protocol droid-turned-entrepreneur. Its left hand had been turned into a weapon mount for a blaster pistol, it had been fitted with deep black armor plating, and it had been reprogrammed to serve as an administrative droid.

Pelko bugs were small creatures that were covered in millions of microscopic barbs that delivered a paralytic, blistering toxin which could penetrate armor. They lived only beneath sands of the Valley of the Dark Lords on Korriban, and were attracted to Force-sensitives.

This gang operated on the planet Diado under the leadership of Birok, during the Clone Wars. It consisted of five members: Birok, a Devaronian, and three Humanoid males. One was choked to death and the others were shot by Saesee Tiin.
