x: The Mission to Ruul was Brenn Tantor's first mission after defecting to the Rebel Alliance.
The Pluthan asteroid belt was an asteroid belt located in Wild Space of the galaxy.
Cloud City Control was the primary law enforcement agency stationed in Cloud City on the planet of Bespin.
The CIS-Advanced starfighter was designed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, during the Clone Wars. The prototype never saw any action except for a few trials.
The Orkellian cave slug, also known as the Orkellian space slug, was a type of blind slug native to the Orkellia system of the Mid Rim.
The giant dianoga was a colossal dianoga creature dwelling in the sewers of the galactic capital, Coruscant, around 4 ABY.

Halurian ice-boars were large, porcine creatures native to a location in the Haluria system of the Mid Rim. The creatures had thick hide plates that covered and protected their bodies. The plates were considered to be nearly impervious to such bladed tools as knives.

L8O-RC was an L8O protocol droid that belonged to Riboga the Hutt. The droid was one of many that helped Riboga run his business and was destroyed sometime after Riboga was removed from control of the Cularin system's crime.
Inspector 11 was an Analysis droid on Mechis III. He oversaw the production of the Viper probe droid line.

Team Tauntaun was one of the five Jedi strike-teams sent to Corellia as part of Operation Roundabout. Consisting of Tahiri Veila, Doran Sarkin-Tainer, and Tiu Zax, their mission was to detain Thrackan Sal-Solo.

Team Purella was one of the five Jedi strike-teams sent to Corellia as part of Operation Roundabout. Consisting of Jaina Solo, Zekk, the Falleen Jedi Thann Mithric and Bothan Kolir Hu'lya, their mission was to arrest Five World Prime Minister Aidel Saxan.
Team Slashrat was one of the five Jedi strike-teams sent to Corellia as part of the Galactic Alliance mission code-named Operation Roundabout.

Team Mynock was one of the five Jedi strike-teams sent to Corellia as part of the Galactic Alliance mission code-named Operation Roundabout. Consisting of Jacen Solo and Ben Skywalker, their mission was to destroy Centerpoint Station.
Team Womp Rat was one of the five Jedi strike teams sent to Corellia as part of the Galactic Alliance mission code-named Operation Roundabout.
The Night Raider was a Ghtroc Industries 720 light freighter captained and presumably owned by a Barabel smuggler named Yarrku. It was destroyed in space battle by Kinnin Vo-Shay.

Located on the top floors of the Senate Apartment Complex on Coruscant, the Naboo Embassy allotted this space as an apartment for the current Senator of the Chommell sector and Naboo. It was later converted into a restaurant known as the Naboo Queen.

The Tatooine Howler, also known as a "desert wampa" due to its resemblance to the ice wampa of Hoth, was a creature native to Tatooine. They were large, shaggy creatures with bulky builds and curling horns.
Not long before the Battle of Endor, Brenn Tantor undertook a mission to Trasse. Tantor's goal was to steal an All Terrain Armored Transport from the Trasse Proving Grounds.

Rebel Commandos, also known as SpecForce soldiers, were an elite variant of rebel troopers of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. They composed the multiple units of the Rebel Alliance Special Forces including the Marine Corps, the Special Forces Trackers Unit, and more.
Mon Ubris was a floating city located on the planet of Mon Cala. The city was poor and had a reputation for its criminal activity and a large homeless population.
The Aelena was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Criterios was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

A red pachydermoid species of sentients lived on a planet in the Outer Rim, near the border of Galactic Republic space. They had short trunks which ended in white tendrils, and had a large tusk on each side of this trunk. The species also had large ears and three-fingered hands.

The Battle of Mokk IX was a battle of the Galactic Civil War, sometime before 11 ABY. In it, the forces of the New Republic liberated the Imperial labor world of Mokk IX. Mirith Sinn was a soldier in the New Republic forces of the battle.
The treppok was a red-scaled fish native to the oceans of Baralou. They were known as peaceful creatures, and attacked only when cornered.

MREM-02, or Moreemohtwo was a kitchen droid owned by Corpo the Hutt. When Corpo enslaved famous chef Slabba Drewl, Jedi Masters Micah Giiett and Plo Koon came to his rescue. Corpo then bet Drewl in a cooking contest with MREM-02.
A blister gnat was a type of gnat that had a low level of intelligence and a short life expectancy.
The Great Maze of Lok, also know as the Labyrinth, was a mysterious square maze upon the barren surface of the planet of Lok.
The Immobilizer was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. It was used to prevent enemy ships from entering to hyperspace.
The Grappler was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser in service to the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Captain Cautious's freighter was a transport which was destroyed by the Infinity Gate.
Tiatkin's starship was a small craft used in Lando Calrissian's operation against the TIE Pirates.

Mount Dagger was a mostly-eroded shield volcano on the planet Dagobah. It was the only prominent natural formation on the planet. It stood at 10 km tall and was created during the birth of Dagobah, before 30,000 BBY.

Swift Dreams was one of the six hundred captured refugee ships that the Yuuzhan Vong war fleet used as shields against the defending New Republic forces and as ramships against the capital's planetary shields during the opening stages of the Battle of Coruscant.

result: Selkath victory, Darth Vader gains dark side minions.
x: The Battle of Ahto was a battle that took place shortly before the Battle of Endor.

Blue 9 was the callsign of one of the starfighters in the forces of Iaco Stark, whose fleet included many fighters of the same class. Blue 9 was responsible for destroying Nute Gunray's Trade Federation shuttle.
Forger was a Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy. In the later stages of the Galactic Civil War, she served under the command of Grand Moff Dureya, with Lieutenant Davith Sconn as her first officer.
The Harramin was an Imperial capital ship.
Dragon's Spine was a large chain of snow-capped mountains on the forest moon of Endor at the edge of the Dragon's Pelt. Condor dragons lived in caves inside the high peaks.
Tzarina was a passenger transport starship operated by the space travel agency Star Tours during the early stages of the Galactic Civil War.

The Rampart was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. By the time of the Thrawn campaign, the Rampart was assigned to the Chazwa system to reduce smuggling in the area.
The Requital was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Commander Voldt served aboard the Requital in 10 ABY when it interdicted the Messenger.
Kashir was an Expansion Region planet situated in the Vardoss sector. It was home to the Kashirim cultural group, which acquired galactic infamy due to their socially-accepted practice of thievery.

The Valorous was a Victory-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy assigned to Black Sword Command. It was later captured by the Yevetha following an uprising led by them, and the ship was renamed the Devotion of Yevetha or simply the Devotion.
The Aspirant was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Battler was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Encounter was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Executioner was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Fantome was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Inveterate was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Invincible was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Retribution was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Turmoil was a Tartan-class patrol cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The Liberty was one of the capital ships used by the Yevetha of the Duskhan League during the genocidal Great Purge in 16-17 ABY.
Plooriod IV, the fourth planet of the Plooriod system, was an agricultural territory of the Expansion Region of the galaxy.
Mar'ta II was the seventh planet of the Kothlis system.
Kira III was the third planet in the Kira system.

The Uhumele was a L4000 transport captained by the smuggler Schurk-Heren. After a failed hijacking attempt by Dass Jennir and Bomo Greenbark, Schurk-Heren took the two on as passengers, following their escape from the Battle of Half-Axe Pass.

objective: Rescue Karl Eckener
x: The Rescue of Karl Eckener was the final stage of a series of attempts by agents of the Royal Naboo Security Forces to rescue Karl Eckener, the son of Hugo Eckener.

Kira I was a planet in the Kira system, a part of the Expansion Region's Kira sector. It was an uninhabitable world with no apparent resources of value. Kira I was surveyed by Galactic Republic scouts visiting the Kira system years before 70 BBY.
The Stellar Damsel was a CR90 corvette in the Alliance Fleet.
Shortly before the Battle of Endor, this ship led a mercenary force to disrupt a meeting between the Rebel cruiser Liberty and members of the Bothan Spynet.

Drago was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. After some Rebel pilots, including Samuel Raider and Toalagar, escaped from Stars' End prison aboard the BFF-1 bulk freighter Genue, the Drago was sent to retrieve them near Kashyyyk.

t: Battle of New Alderaan (Hunt for Zsinj)
x: Not long after the end of the Bacta War in 7 ABY, a battle occurred during the Hunt for Zsinj of the Galactic Civil War when the forces of Warlord Zsinj discovered the location of the planet New Alderaan.
In 22 BBY, during the Separatist Crisis, the Corporate Alliance conducted a raid against a group of slicers on an asteroid named Yirt-4138-Grek-12.
Pemblehov District was an area of Talos, one of the major cities and starports on the planet of Atzerri. Inside Talos, it was located in the second-tier outer districts.
Bravado III was a Republic Sienar Systems Marauder-class corvette in Kathol Republic Navy.
The Juno II was a Republic Sienar Systems Marauder-class corvette in the Kathol Republic Navy.
The Mirandine was a Republic Sienar Systems Marauder-class corvette in the Kathol Republic Navy.
Plague was a standard Marauder-class corvette.
Pure Sabacc was a Marauder-class corvette in private service.
The Quillion was a Republic Sienar Systems Marauder-class corvette in the Kathol Republic Navy.
The Siroma was a Republic Sienar Systems Marauder-class corvette in the Kathol Republic Navy.
The Solidarity was a Republic Sienar Systems Marauder-class corvette in the Kathol Republic Navy.
The Triumph was a Republic Sienar Systems Marauder-class corvette in the Kathol Republic Navy. The ship was commanded by Hendric Faile, and carried a complement of marines onboard.
Devaron was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Indefatigable was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Venerable was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Undaunted was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Nexus City was the capital of the planet Entralla.
Mercatan was a Naboo freighter in use before and during the time of the Invasion of Naboo. Before the invasion, it was in the same fleet as Charm's Way during a pirate attack.
Venturer was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Tribune was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

Dragon's Spine was an asteroid belt near the planet Tatooine. Although it served as a center point of navigation for local explorers, stories of starships colliding with asteroids were not unheard of.

The Elite Circle was the leading group of assassins in the Assassin's Guild. To get into this elite group, a sentient had to be voted in by their peers. Members of the Circle were assigned special, large-scale missions, killing targets at the request of "big customers."

result: Ewok victory, Terak and Marauders defeated
x: The Battle of Endor was a contained conflict in 3 ABY between the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village and the Sanyassan Marauders of Terak's Keep.
Wilsey was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that saw service with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Southern Jedi Ruins were the ruins of a Jedi Enclave located on the planet Mustafar within the region known as the Smoking Forest.

The Sable III, originally known as the Anto's Star, was a modified Corellian CR90 corvette used by the flamboyant pirate Drek Drednar and his crew. The ship was stolen by a group of starship thieves working for Drednar who was planning a mutiny against Captain Karn Granzor.
Taraloon was an uncharted planet that served as base of operations of the pirate, Drek Drednar and his crew, who had built a base there. Native to the planet were the reptilian Gornalak.

The gornalak was a carnivorous reptilian species native to Taraloon. They inhabited the caves and tunnels of the planet. Being at the top of the native food chain, they had no natural predators—maybe with the exception of the pirate Chillo Sanpona who hunted Gornalak for sports.

The Idiot's Array was a modified corvette and part of smuggler Talon Karrde's fleet. During the Invasion of Yavin 4 of the Yuuzhan Vong War, it was used to ferry the younglings of the Jedi Praxeum of Yavin 4 to Coruscant where they would be out of danger.
The Sudden Demise, also known as the Demise, was a starship owned by the smuggler chief and information broker, Talon Karrde. The vessel was fast, but it was not heavily armed or defended.

The Jedi Schism was an event that split the Jedi Order three months after the start of the Clone Wars. Hundreds of Jedi refused the Jedi High Council's orders for them to follow Palpatine's appointment of them to positions within the Grand Army of the Republic.
The Corellia Times, or Corellian Times, was a NewsNet and newspaper based in Coronet on Corellia before and during the Galactic Civil War.
The sleft-chuff were large airborne herbivores native to Taloraan. They inhabited the upper atmosphere of the planet, filling their hollow bodies with gas to keep them afloat.
The island-beasts were colossal floating grazers native to Taloraan where they inhabited the upper atmosphere. Island beasts kept themselves afloat by storing gas inside their huge hollow bodies.

Late in the Clone Wars, a battle took place on the Colicoid spawnworld of Colla IV when the Galactic Republic launched a strike on the Colicoid Creation Nest, a corporation that manufactured battle droids for the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

conflict: Clone Wars (Felucia theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: The Battle of Dellalt was one of the last battles of the Clone Wars Outer Rim Sieges. After Order 66, a number of Jedi managed to escape here, but were pursued by Imperial forces. Six of the surviving Jedi stole an SX troop shuttle, disguising it as the Vagabond Trader.
Magnus was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The zuxu was a creature native to the planet Ganlihk, along with the ludos and the ryless.
The Hoth asteroid field, also known as the Hoth asteroid belt or Anoat Asteroid Belt, was an asteroid field overlapping the boundaries of the Hoth and Anoat systems near the planet Hoth.

The Battle of Sullust took place during the Clone Wars, at which Sullust seceded to the Confederacy of Independent Systems. A traitor amidst the Republic allowed the Separatists to defeat their forces.

The kargul was a type of worm that lived on Trindello, a cool, forested moon located in the Trindello system of the Outer Rim Territories' Moddell sector. Reaching eighty meters in length, kargul could burrow underground and did not rely on sight.

result: Consortium and Cartel call a truce.
x: During the Galactic Civil War, a battle between the forces of Tyber Zann and criminal empire of Jabba the Hutt took place on Hypori.

The Battle of Oovo IV took place during the Galactic Civil War. Imperial forces were led by Admiral Hurkk. The Rebel Alliance forces included new Nebulon-B frigates, ironically designed for use by the Imperial Navy to protect convoys from Rebel starfighter actions.

The Star Dream was a transport ship that was owned and operated by Hoban, around the time of the Galactic Civil War. The Jizz band, Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers used this vessel to travel to Tatooine.

Song serpents were desert-dwelling snakes from Proxima Dibal. They were covered in iridescent feathers and had sets of vocal membranes which vibrated as they breathed. When viewed up close, they appeared to be singing.
Diado was a snow-covered world in the Mid Rim.

EG-9 was an ancient labor droid who was mainstay of Mos Espa spaceport on the desert planet Tatooine. It was working on a moisture vaporator shortly before the annual Boonta Eve Classic podrace of the year 32 BBY.

Cairn was an asteroid in the Lenico Belt where the Imperial Remnant's Cairn Installation was located in 12 ABY. Galak Fyyar's ship the Doomgiver was docked there when Kyle Katarn's partner Jan Ors was being held prisoner aboard.

The ra-lugg was a small, red, six-legged arachnid or crustacean native to Endor. The ra-lugg possessed yellow or black eyes, two grasping pincers, and a web-shooting tail to catch its prey, such as the tiny Fleebogs.
Fire beetles were tiny red bioluminescent insects native to Endor. They could be found illuminating the tunnels of the Fleebogs.

The Naboo Underground was a group of loosely organized resistance cells filled primarily by students from the Royal House of Learning in the city of Theed. It opposed the Trade Federation during their occupation of Naboo.

ATK 253 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. When Biggs Darklighter's X-wing, carrying schematics for the Death Star, broke down, ATK 253 was one of three shuttles sent, under Assault Gunboat escort, to capture the fighter.

ATK 592 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. When Biggs Darklighter's X-wing, carrying schematics for the Death Star, broke down, ATK 592 was one of three shuttles sent, under Assault Gunboat escort, to capture the fighter.

ATK 664 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. When Biggs Darklighter's X-wing, carrying schematics for the first Death Star, broke down, ATK 664 was one of three shuttles sent, under Assault Gunboat escort, to capture the fighter.
The Tantive I was a CR90 corvette used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Tantive II was a CR90 corvette used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. When Biggs Darklighter's X-wing broke down while carrying the recently intercepted schematics for the Death Star, the Tantive II, along with the Tantive I and the Tantive III, was sent to …

Tantive III was a CR90 corvette used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. When Biggs Darklighter's X-wing broke down while carrying the recently intercepted schematics for the Death Star, the Tantive III, along with the Tantive I and the Tantive II, was sent to…
A new Crusader-class corvette was illegally acquired by the Zann Consortium shortly after 0 ABY.

Moll was a hot rock planet with no moons. It was located in the Rannon system, a part of the Instrop sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the closest orbit to its star, the yellow-white Rannon.

Kich was a hot terrestrial planet with no moons. It was located in the Rannon system, a part of the Instrop sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the second closest orbit to its star, the yellow-white Rannon.

Onuf was a gas giant–type planet with five moons. It was located in the Rannon system, a part of the Instrop sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the fourth and outermost orbit around its star, the yellow-white Rannon.

Rannon was a forested planet that was located in the Outer Rim Territories' Instrop sector. It was settled centuries before the reign of the New Republic and was inhabited by a population of ten million Humans and Rodians, who governed their settlements via cooperative council.
Timbra Ott was a planet located in the Kathol Outback, at the end of the Galtea Run.

result: Quaestor lost with all hands onboard, Pammant rendered uninhabitable,
x: The Destruction of Pammant was a cataclysmic event that took place shortly before the Battle of Coruscant during the Clone Wars.
Nos monsters were large aquatic creatures that dwelled in the freshwater lakes, underground rivers, and sinkholes of the planet Utapau.
Shibric was an Inner Rim planet situated on the Hydian Way. The crew of the Hopskip claimed that Shibric was their destination when they were captured by the Galactic Empire.
The Falcariae was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

The Anakin Solo, also known as the Anakin for short or Black Annie to its crew, was a modified Imperial II-class Star Destroyer that served as the command ship of the Galactic Alliance Guard during the Second Galactic Civil War—a pan-galactic conflict between the Galactic Fede…
Solibus IV was a planet visited by Aayla Secura during her apprenticeship to Quinlan Vos. It was there that the two Jedi would open the Shu-Wang Prism and solve the Mystery of the Lodi.
Rosha was a planet in the Leemurtoo system. It was a neighbor of Samaria.

Comet Squadron, also known as Comet Group, was a starfighter squadron that served the New Republic Defense Force during the early years of the New Republic. The squadron was equipped with A-wing interceptors and was under the command of Colonel Edor Crespin.
The Thrackan Sal-Solo was a Corellian Dreadnaught built around Kiris 6 that would later serve as the flagship of the Confederation fleet.

t: Battle of Hapes (Second Galactic Civil War)
result: Galactic Federation of Free Alliances victory
x: The Battle of Hapes was an engagement between Hapan loyalists and usurpers wishing to replace Queen Mother Tenel Ka Djo with a pro-Corellian ruler.

conflict: Great Jedi Purge/Imperial Period conflicts (Cleansing of New Plympto)
x: The Battle of Half-Axe Pass was a battle that took place on the planet of New Plympto as part of the Galactic Empire's campaign to kill the planet's Nosaurian population.
Half-Axe Pass was an area of New Plympto located close to Cadgel Meadows.

Flashpoint was an airless planet that orbited very close to its star, with a day lasting just one standard hour. Being so close to its star meant that the planet was bathed in stellar radiation and thus devoid of life.

Strike Force Altagak was a small Rebel force that operated on the jungle world of Mentanar Vosk during the Galactic Civil War. Their mission on Mentanar was to harass the Imperial garrison and thereby distract them from other Alliance activities in the area.
The Solonar Rangers were a mercenary group active during the Galactic Civil War. They used a blue and yellow color scheme on their uniforms and vehicles.
Spike-finned sounders were fish found in the shallow seas of Kamino. Predators and scavengers, they could leap out of the water five meters and glide at least two dozen meters.
YVH 1-24A was a YVH 1 combat droid developed by Tendrando Arms. It accompanied YVH 1-1A onto the vessel Byrt during the evacuation of Coruscant to rescue C-3PO and Ben Skywalker.
The Stomper Brigade was a brigade of YVH 5-S battle droids. The droids were under the command of Grand Master Luke Skywalker, and were tasked to retake Admiral Ackbar during the Battle of Tenupe.
Gelatinous pet slimes were creatures native to the planet Saclas. They were popular among young Gamorreans as pets during the early days of the New Order.
Aris Brace was an independently owned bulk freighter. The ship held the Corellian Merchants' Guild record for continuous cargo runs over five parsecs.

The blue primates of Kashyyyk were arboreal monkeys. Each of their hands and feet had five digits, one of which was opposable. They had long tails and wide, flat faces. Their fur and skin were blue, but their eyes were yellow. They could be found in the vicinity of Palsaang.
Floaters was an umbrella term describing many species of animals found in the atmospheres of Bespin and Yavin Prime.
The Battle of Uba IV occurred during the Clone Wars. Clone Commander Gree of the Grand Army of the Republic and his clone troopers fought against virus-filled octuptarra droids during the battle.

Jugsmuk was a settlement on Gamorr. It was ruled by the Jugsmuk clan, and during the Galactic Civil War its Matron had at that point invested heavily in constructing a landing field for the new spaceport outside of their fortress that'd come to be known as Jugsmuk Station.
The New Osler Flejj Beasts were a professional Pugil team on the planet Lannik. In 22 BBY, its members included Rolsat Noviee and Kova Naan.
The Battle of Gligger was a confrontation during the Clone Wars of 22 BBY–19 BBY that occurred in the vicinity of the Gligger system of the Outer Rim Territories' Ash Worlds sector.

Century flowers were a rare vegetal species from a planet on the far side of the galaxy from Thustra. Specimens were nurtured by King Alaric in his garden on Thustra for a century. Those flowers were sensitive and delicate, and he carefully protected them from weeds.

The Battle of Byblos was a battle that occurred on Byblos during the Clone Wars. During the battle, a squad of Republic ARC troopers hijacked an SRT droid to ride to get behind Confederacy lines before the battle actually occurred.
Swamp rats were small predators native to the swamps of Trigalis.

Durge's pilot droid flew Durge's ship during the Gen'Dai's final year of life. The droid somewhat resembled Durge in appearance and temperament. The droid was decapitated by Obi-Wan Kenobi, although its head remained functional.

Drama Korr's space yacht was a sizable silver-and-gray luxury vessel owned by Corellian merchant Drama Korr. Korr was killed aboard the yacht in the Karthakk system by Durge, who later engaged Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker in combat aboard the ship.
Sandflies were a species of fly found on Tatooine. Moisture farm WED 15 Septoid 2 Treadwell repair droids would often chase sandflies, mistaking their whine for malfunctioning moisture vaporators.
A battle was fought at Commenor between the CIS and the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Ord Mynock Freeport was the only spaceport on Ord Mynock. It was originally part of the protective fortress built by the planet's early settlers, which became a bustling modern spaceport.
Hpaq was a city located on the planet Vulpter that was home to Viper Tower, headquarters of Viper Sensor Intelligence Systems.

The Yawari Cliffs were a geographical feature on the Forest Moon of Endor. The cliffs resembled a plateau, separating the lower more lush and forested Jiberah Plains and Mertuen Forest to the south, and the higher more barren Desert of Salma to the north.

result: Imperial containment of the Rebels for six months
Rebels forced to flee during the Evacuation of Yavin
x: The Yavin blockade, also known as the blockade of Yavin or the Blockade of Yavin 4, was a military action conducted by the Galactic Empire after the destruction of the Death Star in 0 ABY.
Sneaker was an R9 unit belonging to Jaina Solo during the Second Galactic Civil War.
The Solar Grazer was the personal ship of the smuggler Rooty. The craft was a heavily modified VR-10 Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-class space tug and was used for short range runs through Hutt Space.

Crevasse City was the capital of the planet Kalkovak and served as a port city for spacers traveling to the Outer Rim Territories. Han Solo and Lando Calrissian once searched the city for Illyan Webble, who knew the location of the Yavin Vassilika.
The Steadfast was a Ghtroc Industries light freighter that belonged to Drake Paulsen.
The Glory was a YT-1300 light freighter that belonged to Toob Ancher. He left Soco-Jarel Spaceport with the Glory around 3 BBY.

conflict: Clone Wars (Serenno theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: A battle took place at Ord Radama during the Clone Wars. It was one of the first engagements of the Outer Rim Sieges.

conflict: Clone Wars (Mygeeto theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: A battle occurred in the Ywllandr system in 19 BBY, during the final days of the Clone Wars, as part of the Outer Rim Sieges.

The aquatic gundark was an aquatic preator that lived on Yavin 4. It had multiple eyes, making it capable of seeing below and above water simultaneously. They were medium-sized creatures that stalked the shallows of streams and lakes for prey, such as runyips and whisper birds.

The Burskan gundark was a subspecies of gundark. Their temperament was polar from a gundark's, though, as the Burskan variant was very docile. They were known to lay around, even more in warmer weather, but when provoked, had the same ferocity of their cousins.

The Karakan were a group known for their isolationist policy during the early years of the Galactic Republic. They produced Karakan gauntlets, sophisticated medical devices that monitored and adjusted biological indicators such as nervous impulses, blood pressure, and tension.

The loonee bird was a creature that lived on the forest moon of Endor. The bird laughed incessantly, and any other creature it touched would fall under its spell of uncontrollable laughter, a spell that could plague its victim forever and would temporarily affect any who go ne…

The Kiris Asteroid Cluster was a belt of asteroids that was nestled within the outer edges of the Corellian system. The asteroids within the belt were designated by number, with Kiris 3, Kiris 6, and Kiris 17, which marked the "upper" part of the asteroid cluster.

A song sparrow was a type of colorful sparrow endemic to the planet Coruscant. Ky Narec, a Jedi Knight, enjoyed feeding and watching song sparrows and crown finches fly around the Great Tree, located in the Jedi Temple training ground in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

The Verpine Pera in Tun Aduban used a bobtail bantha to pull the bantha travois bearing the corpse of a borg to Spacer's Hill. This bantha appeared different from the common bantha in that it had much shorter fur, leaving its facial features and limbs distinctly visible.
Rock hornets were swarming insects native to Tatooine. The ire of a disturbed rock hornet was proverbial.
The Nelvaan squirrel was a squirrel-like rodent that lived on the planet of Nelvaan.
The Anglebay Station droid was a silver droid serving on the staff of Anglebay Station medical facility on Telos IV during the Galactic Civil War.
The True Victory Party was a political party of Bothans who tried to continue the ar'krai against the Yuuzhan Vong.
SD-XX, or Double-Ex, was a fourth-degree SD-X-series personal security droid built by Tendrando Arms. Jacen Solo had him onboard his personal Star Destroyer in 40 ABY.
The Dragon Queen was Queen Mother Tenel Ka's personal Hapan Battle Dragon.
Beetle Nebula was a Freebooter-class transport that arrived on Coruscant in 40 ABY delivering troops home from the Battle of Hapes.
The Duracrud was a YV-666 given to Uran Lavint after her capture by Jacen Solo, in recompense for the appropriation of her usual ship, Breathe My Jets.
The Dark Nebula was a Star Destroyer that served with the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Imru Ootmian was an Ubrikkian space yacht that had been modified for Popara Anjiliac Diresto's personal use.
Kobarian swamp dogs, sometimes known simply as swamp dogs, were a non-sentient species of domestic canine originating from the planet Kobaria.

Ersheg was a continent on the planet Ergeshui, and was the location of the cities of Erglush and Outworlder City, which were connected by the Living Monorail. A TIE fighter from the Dark Nebula crashed there.

The Army of Terror was the culmination of Project Starscream. It was a group of biologically-created weapons that would never die, could change form at will, could read the minds of its victims and use their deepest fears against them, grew stronger with each feeding, and was …
Vanguard was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer commanded by Commander Ritton in the years following the Battle of Hoth.
Scavenger hawks were winged creatures native to the planet Corellia.

Ruweln was a Bothan colony world located in Bothan space. Ruweln was among the roughly 150 settled systems in Bothan Space dominated by Bothan colonists, and was ruled by the Bothan Council, which was made up of representatives from hundreds of Bothan clans.
The Voidraker was the personal freighter of the notorious Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the Imperial Era.
A sentient humanoid species indigenous to a seven-ringed world that had green skin, large ears, and a horn on their faces. One member of this race once swore by their planet's rings.
Platform 429 was a landing platform on Cloud City. Tag Greenley and Bink Otauna landed the Tydirium there after the Battle of Yavin.
HR 51 was the room in Cloud City where Bink Otauna, dressed as a stormtrooper, blasted C-3PO.
Platform 215 was a landing platform on Cloud City.
A detention cell was located on Level 139 of Cloud City. It was used to imprison Han Solo, Princess Leia Organa, and Chewbacca.

Clam Clan was a Jedi youngling clan in the Jedi Temple in the time prior to the Invasion of Naboo. It was named for the clam. Producing many students over the centuries, the clan was dissolved along with the rest of the Order in 19 BBY during the Great Jedi Purge.

Oo-Ta Goo-Ta was a modified YT-1300 light freighter owned and operated by the Rodian Chordak. Known as one of the fastest ships in the Minos Cluster, Chordak hoped to catch the attention of the Galactic Empire with his ship and receive more valuable Imperial assignments like t…
3D-4X was a silver-plated 3D-4X administrative droid.
A cavern spider was subterranean race of gaping spider, a giant, aggressive arachnid from the planet Dathomir. Most members of the Spiderclan emulated those quiet, efficient and deadly predators.
The Solar Flare was a modified YT-1300 light freighter owned and operated by the Devaronian Trynic. The Solar Flare could often be found prowling the space lanes in the Minos Cluster.

The Blaze of Glory was a modified YT-1930 light freighter owned and operated by the Bimm smuggler Rycar Ryjerd. The Blaze of Glory was at one time docked in Rycar's hidden asteroid base in the Obana Belt.
Beek-monkeys were a type of semi-sentient primate. They were noted for flailing when confined. Han Solo sometimes swore an oath, indicating a possible religious connotation.

The freighter Luke Skywalker took on his return to Tatooine seeking blockade runners for the Rebellion was a round ship capable of transporting a X-34 landspeeder. Unfortunately, despite putting a camouflage cover over the freighter, it ended up salvaged by Jawas.
The Great Hall was the reception hall of the Emperor's Citadel on Byss.
The Nal Raka Criminal Empire was Borvo the Hutt's criminal organization.
White Team was an E-wing squadron that fought at the Battle of Calamari.
ZQ Infantry Support Units were a model of battle droid developed and manufactured by Sienar Intelligence Systems. The droids were used by the Imperial military.
Kiris 6 was an asteroid in the Kiris Asteroid Cluster. It was around Kiris 6 that the Thrackan Sal-Solo was built.

GG-36 or Gigi was a GG-series hospitality droid on Telerath around 3963 BBY. The droid greeted the disguised Jarael and Camper upon their arrival and explained the banking planet and its resemblance to a vacation resort.
Patrol XLS was a Guardian-class patrol ship guarding the Emperor's Citadel on Byss in 10 ABY.
Byss Security was an military unit that oversaw the security of the planet Byss during Operation Shadow Hand.
A species of blue-gray-skinned humanoids with pointed ears. One such being on Tirahnn, recognized Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa and reported them to Kharys.

The mecho-organic droid was a drone created by Ship to wield a lightsaber in combat against Luke Skywalker. At first, Ship thought Luke was merely another simulated opponent, part of the games he played with the ship's computer.
Judgement 12-X7 was a Hunter-Killer probot assigned to Byss Security in 10 ABY. It tried to apprehend the Millennium Falcon when it was inside the Hyperspace Marauder.

Domina Tagge's starship was the vessel three envoys from Monastery took to Yavin 4. The craft was shot-up by TIE fighters and forced to land on the jungle moon after Luke Skywalker destroyed the TIEs.
When Leia Organa first visited Cloud City on Bespin, at least two members of a species of green reptiloids were present there.
13-K was an Infiltrator probe droid produced in a collaboration between Arakyd Industries and Imperial technicians under Admiral Damon Krell following the Battle of Hoth.

side2: Armies of Gardulla and Jabba the Hutt

x: Camp Sagol was an Imperial military camp situated on the planet Krant and constructed after the Battle of Yavin in 0 ABY.

Camp Kaxol was an Imperial military camp situated on the planet Krant and constructed after the Battle of Yavin in 0 ABY. During the Battle of Krant between the Imperials and the Rebels, its forces threatened the Krantian cities of Peche and Theenes.
Ord Segra spaceport was a spaceport on the planet Ord Segra. Pilots and smugglers often met there and gambled.
The bunny was a diminutive rabbit-like lagomorph species of unknown origins.
9575 was a mining vessel that was piloted by "Pinky." He landed it on Horn Station after he needed a new stabilizer.
Sub Pen Nine was a location in Otoh Gunga.

The Ecclessis Figg Room was a gambling chamber in the elaborate complex of the Trest casino in Cloud City, the floating settlement above the gas giant Bespin. It was named after Ecclessis Figg, founder of the city.

Camp Culroon was an Imperial research base on the planet of Zaloriis. Colonel Maximilian Veers was assigned there and developed the All Terrain Armored Transport Blizzard 1 prior to the Battle of Zaloriis.
The Drall Patriots were a group of Drall extremists fighting for the independence of Drall from the unified government of the Corellian system during the Galactic Civil War.
Valiant was a light Calamari cruiser in the service of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Valiance was a Nebulon-B escort frigate in the service of the Rebel Alliance during and immediately prior to the Battle of Endor, as a member of the reformed Defiance Task Force.

The Tuima was a GR-75 medium transport that saw service with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. During and immediately prior to the Battle of Endor, it was a part of the reformed Defiance Task Force, centered around the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Defiance.
The Valiant was an Imperial starship under the command of Captain Oweg. Pit Lieutenant Hast also served aboard the vessel.
The Visage was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer in service with the Imperial Navy.
Inad was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in the Rebel Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Modrols were large predatory creatures native to the jungle world of Port Haven.
Marsh Wyrm were large serpentine creatures from the planet Gelgelar. They were also referred to as the "Great Gelgelar Monsters".
A sentient alien species lived during the Imperial Era. They had dark gray or dark blue skin and possessed an elongated head. One such being was once at the Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy.
Granicus was the name of an Imperial throneworld, in the Granicus system, a gas giant with gray cirrus methane clouds. The galactic capital was a floating city.

The Celestial was a Rebel prison ship. Imperial prisoners Grand Moff Ravik and Bane Nothos revolted and captured the ship from its captain, Alain Gryphon, but Gryphon desperately sent the ship to lightspeed before Imperial reinforcements could arrive.
Kelada starport was a spaceport on the planet Kelada. It was comprised of a myriad of warehouses and docking bays, and was the location of Lorana's Labyrinth.
Vakeyya was the capital city of Socorro. It had a population of 74,000.

Fulluusub was the largest settlement on Sullust that could be considered independent of the SoroSuub Corporation, with less than 30 percent of its population (approximately half a million) employed by them.
Gorovod was the largest continent on the planet Desevro. The city of Maslovar sprawled for hundreds of kilometers along its coastline, with the islands of the Swamplands trailing away to the south.
The Battle of Moorja was a battle of the Clone Wars that took place on the planet Moorja.
Tahlbooreans were sapient humanoids indigenous to Tahlboor. There were two variants of the species: the blue Troobs and the purple Hobors, who were at constant war with one another.
The cave creature was a web-spinning, cave-dwelling arachnid that lived on the planet Tahlboor.
Harthan's shuttle was used by the Harthan family during diplomatic discussions with the Hobors and the Troobs on Tahlboor.
Rebel One was a heavily modified Providence-class carrier/destroyer that was used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic in 0 ABY.
The Disaster at Deepspace Besh occurred nine months after the Battle of Yavin .
Crawlfish were edible aquatic creatures native to Yavin 4's many spring-fed pools.

The Unnh River was located on Yavin 4 and was likely named for the Sullustan explorer Dr'uun Unnh. The river wound its way through the Wayward Jungle, the Isle of Kun, the Val'Arnos Jungle and the Ersham Ridge, passing close to the Palace of the Woolamander and the Great Temple.
Citadel 1 was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Rebel Alliance. Its mission was to rescue Mon Calamari slaves scheduled for transport to the Imperial Star Destroyer Warrior.

Citadel 2 was a BFF-1 bulk freighter that served with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. It was sent to rescue Mon Calamari slaves scheduled for transport to the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Warrior.

Hart was a CR90 corvette that served with the Rebel Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War. The warship's most notable mission came when it was tasked with helping to evacuate the Alliance EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Anvil.
The Steel Fist was a heavily-modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-1300 light freighter owned and operated by the bounty hunter Kolig during the early years of the New Republic.

Alpha Squad was a scout squad for the Zann Consortium. Their final mission was to scout the area of Felucia while Tyber Zann attempted to steal a Sith holocron from Jabba the Hutt. They wandered through several Felucian spore plants and died several seconds later.

An Imperial base belonging to Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire was located on the planet Yinchorr. During the Second Imperial Civil War, it was the headquarters of many Imperial military units, including the 407th Stormtrooper Division.
The Agr was a red-colored predatory bird native to Kashyyyk. It was the namesake of the Wookiee Agr starfighter.

Dragon was a CR90 corvette in the service of the Rebel Alliance. It was presumably trying to destroy the Imperial heavy tugs under the command of Vice Admiral Thrawn in order to stop a salvage attempt. It was destroyed by attacking TIE/sa bombers.

The Battle of Eos was a battle during the Imperial Era. During the battle, Imperial airspeeders were grounded because of the electromagnetic fields on Eos. Imperial officer Brenn Tantor deplored the fact that AT-PTs were not used instead.
The Ardent was a MC40a light cruiser in service to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Song of the Clouds was an Ithorian Manollium-class herdship.
Fondor II was an Imperial military base in the desert of the desolate planet Zaloriis during the Galactic Civil War.
The Kingdom of Dreams was a starship capable of interdimensional travel. Cody Sunn-Childe and his followers retreated to an extra-dimensional realm in the Kingdom.
An asteroid field in the Corellian system, the Pirate's Shadow was named for the cover and shelter it provided to pirates and thugs lurking within it, preying on freighters that ventured too close.

result: Gungan Grand Army and Royal Naboo Security Forces victory
x: A battle took place on Naboo in the Gungan Sacred Place following the evacuation of Otoh Gunga in 32 BBY.

The Wall of Dantooine was a vast obsidian asteroid field in the Dantooine system. No mining operation had claimed the entire field, as it was too large to manage effectively. Stretching as far as the eye could see, it was a useful landmark for travelers.
Chedaki's blockade runner was one of many vessels in the Alliance Fleet. A small, fast craft, it was disabled in orbit of Shiva IV. Princess Leia managed to evacuate the craft in a shuttle.

The Great Hall was a magnificent and gargantuan room within Peacebringer's palace on Shiva IV used for assemblies and celebrations. It was here that a celebration occurred when the Galactic Empire was defeated on Shiva IV.
DUM-9 was a DUM-series pit droid assigned to Anakin Skywalker's podracer, during the famed Boonta Eve Classic race won by Skywalker.

The Zalorian rock-lion, also known as the rock-lion, was a species native to the planet Zaloriis. The rock-lions' habitat was in the mountain range known as the Fantain Mountains, among the boulders which provided shelter from the planet's strong winds.
5TE was a B2-series super battle droid who fought for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the battle between the Confederacy and the Jedi Order on the planet Geonosis in 22 BBY.

7EX was one of the many B2-series super battle droids deployed by the CIS during the Outer Rim Sieges. It was destroyed by Obi-Wan Kenobi on the Invisible Hand in 19 BBY, during the Battle of Coruscant, while acting as a security droid for Count Dooku.
8EX was one of the first B2-series super battle droid to be produced by the Geonosians, during the years leading up to the Clone Wars.

The Dukedoom was a Rebel Alliance ship that was present in the Battle of Endor. One of twenty-two ships provided to the Alliance Fleet by the Virgillian Free Alignment, it appeared to suffer some troubles to its hyperdrive upon arriving at Sullust.
The Chandi was a DP20 gunship in the Rebel Alliance Fleet. It was present during the Battle of Endor. It was a part of the Defiance task force at Sullust before the battle.
Limnate was a GR-75 medium transport in service with the Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War. The ship was present at the Battle of Endor.
Rain was one of the four android creations of the Keeper. She had the ability to manipulate water.

Sunfruit was a wild and sweet tropical fruit that was found on the planet Corellia. It was used to garnish or enhance dessert dishes, such as Corellian Fried Ice Cream, and could also be converted into a liqueur or marinade.

Fecklen were stumpy, squat, horned, gracile-necked creatures that lived in herds on their homeworld Chandrila. They were the primary ranching animal on the planet and were raised for their meat and milk.

The Second Battle of Sernpidal took place in 26 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Kyp Durron had scouted out a worldship being built in the shipwomb of Sernpidal, and decided to destroy it, despite the fact that the worldship was to be used for non-military purposes.

Betar was a BFF-1 bulk freighter in service to the Galactic Empire. It was scheduled to rendezvous with the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Warrior, carrying a cargo of war matériel. Two Y-wings, however, disabled it.

Wiggins was a BFF-1 bulk freighter in service with the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. It was scheduled to rendezvous with the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Warrior bearing a cargo of Mon Calamari slaves.

Century 1 was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. It was part of a convoy en route an Imperial base under construction in the Ghorman system carrying construction equipment.

Century 2 was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. It was part of a convoy en route an Imperial base under construction in the Ghorman system carrying power generators.

Century 3 was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. It was part of a convoy en route an Imperial base under construction in the Ghorman system carrying power generators.
Relephon was a gas giant in the Hapes Cluster orbited by the Relephon Moons, of which several were populated.

The Jaamn was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport that was apparently captured by the Rebel Alliance at some point. The ship was sent to repair the BFF-1 bulk freighter Op Mus which had been stranded in space after an equipment malfunction.
Glacier worms were a species native to Hoth.
Walker was a BFF-1 bulk freighter under the service of the Empire. She was to deliver Habassa slaves to the Nebulon-B2 frigate Mayhem.
Sebolto's Palace was an underworld palace located on Malastare. It was home to the crime lord Sebolto.
Theenes was a walled settlement on the planet Krant. It was situated to the east across a large chasm from its neighboring city of Peche, with the cities connected by three sturdy bridges.
Tanlassa was one of the continents located in the southern hemisphere of the planet Drongar. It saw intense fighting during the early years of the Clone Wars, as large quantities of Bota grew there.
The Resolute was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer.
The Kotiate was an Imperial Star Destroyer during the Galactic Civil War.

Leach was a CR90 corvette belonging to the Pakuuni Pirates. It was defending a pirate outpost along with Clavier and Grapler. Leach was destroyed by Imperial ace Maarek Stele along with the other corvettes and the entire outpost.

The Clavier was a CR90 corvette belonging to the Pakuuni Pirates. She was defending a pirate outpost along with Leach and Grapler. Clavier was destroyed by Imperial ace Maarek Stele along with the other corvettes and the entire outpost.

Grapler was a CR90 corvette belonging to the Pakuuni Pirates. It was defending a pirate outpost along with Clavier and Leach. Grapler was destroyed by Imperial ace Maarek Stele along with the other corvettes and the entire outpost.
Ludwick was a Nebulon-B2 frigate under the command of Commander Buckeye and a part of a task force led by Vice Admiral Thrawn.

The Huntress was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate under the service of the Rebel Alliance. The Huntress had tried unsuccessfully, to destroy the Nebulon-B2 frigate Ludwick, despite assistance with the Pakuuni Pirates, and with some starfighters armed with proton rockets rather…

Pesmenben IV was an Imperial planet in the Mid Rim's Teraab sector that had ore deposits and dunes. At one point by 0 BBY, the businessman Lando Calrissian duped the planet's Imperial governor into leasing it by pulling a scam involving lithium.

Bandigos (also called Bandingos) were a species of vicious omnivore commonly found within Sriluur's Temptation Canyon. They resembled large, dog-like creatures with four clawed-legs and wrinkled skin.
Moori was the designation of a group of two Assassin-class corvettes under the service of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Laantis was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that saw service with the Imperial Navy.

Ranger was the group designation of two IPV-1 Patrol Craft sent by the then Vice Admiral Thrawn to guard NL-1, a space station constructed by the Galactic Empire in the Pakuuni system nearby the planet Argoon.

PK7 was a PK-series worker droid stationed on the planet Gavos and was part of the New Droids' Rights Movement, a group of droids that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against organic life forms throughout the galaxy.
The Knight Errant was a YT-1300 light freighter that was owned by and saw service with the Rebel Alliance Fleet.

The Battle for the Eclipse was a three-way battle between the Zann Consortium, the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire over the planet Kuat, a headquarters for many shipbuilding yards.
The Corvus was an Interdictor Cruiser that was involved with the Battle of To-phalion Base. The cruiser arrived late to the battle.
Ebolo was a Strike-class medium cruiser involved in the Battle of To-phalion Base. It was also a member of the task force that arrived late to the battle and rescued Grand Admiral Thrawn.
Daring was a Strike-class medium cruiser involved in the Battle of To-phalion Base. It was also a member of task force that arrived late to the battle and rescued Grand Admiral Thrawn.
Shadow was an MC40a light cruiser in the service to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

a: Wedding of Mara Jade and Luke Skywalker

x: Shumari was a planet in the Parmel sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Tusken Raider KkH'Oar'Rrhr was rumored to have traveled to this planet to confront the Demon Outlander who wiped out his village, otherwise known as Darth Vader.
The Golden Song was a starship owned by the Jedi General Crian Maru. The ship was used by Maru and her Padawan, Dree Vandap, during their quest to hunt down the Sith Lord Kaox Krul.

The Taking of Kuat was a battle fought between Imperial and New Republic forces during the Galactic Civil War for control of the planet Kuat and its vital shipyards, owned by the Imperial-aligned company Kuat Drive Yards, in 8.5 ABY.
Subjugator was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Galactic Empire.
The Scylla was an IPV-1 System Patrol Craft in the service of Viraxo Industries. It was guarding Industrial Complex VXO-33274, and was destroyed by Rebel pilot Ace Azzameen in the YT-2000 Otana.

A species of non-sentient birds was present on the forest moon of Endor. Logray kept one in his hut around 3 ABY, as he showed the Towani children the whereabouts of their parents using a crystal image spinner.

The Charybdis was a Marauder-class corvette in service to Viraxo Industries. The ship was escorting a convoy to Industrial complex VXO-33274 when it came under attack by Ace Azzameen, who was raiding supplies for a Rebel outpost in the Vergesso Asteroids.
The Butter Newt was a primitive species that did not react to slow stimuli.

x: The Skirmish on Vendaxa was an engagement between Sith of Darth Krayt's order and a group of Jedi, Imperial Knights, Missionaries and bounty hunters, taking place during Roan Fel's insurgency in 137 ABY.

Design Team Beta was a team of four hand-picked specialists who worked for Hydrospeare Corporation during the times of the Galactic Empire. Led by Tolum Harous, the other members included Diran Miciluz, Mosara Thiirn and Sere Lure. Before 1 ABY, the team was led by Dr.

Newoongalls were multi-legged arachnoid creatures native to Rodia. The creatures were often spotted with dripping pincers. Able to climb and jump, they clung to cavern ceilings and dropped down on unsuspecting prey in surprise attacks.

The Tantive V was a CR90 corvette in the service of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Just prior to the Battle of Yavin, the Tantive V acted as a decoy for the identical Rebel corvette Tantive IV, the consular vessel of Princess Leia Organa of Alderaan, which w…

The Eradicator was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 ABY, it was in the process of impounding a starship near the world of Mon Torri when the Millennium Falcon came out of hyperspace.
The Margaret was an MC40a light cruiser that saw service with the Rebel Alliance fleet.

x: The Battle of Solay was a series of battles originating in the Solay Civil War, which bled over into the Galactic Civil War as the despot King Blackart of Solay became affiliated with the Galactic Empire.
IX3244-B was an Imperial Military Survey Team under the command of Captain Toss, with planetologist Lieutenant Kiviett as second-in-command.

The Hininbirg was a Ton-Falk-class escort carrier in the Imperial Navy. Following the Battle of Hoth, the Hininbirg was set to receive TIE/D Defender prototypes from the cargo ferry group Sela near Vinzen Neela 5 but came under fire from Rebel Alliance forces when it entered t…
The Blackstar was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer held in reserve during the hyperdrive upgrade operation for the Nebulon-B frigate Laantis months after the Battle of Hoth.

conflict: Clone Wars (Siskeen theater of the Outer Rim Sieges)
x: The battle of Ragmar V occurred when mercenaries destroyed a Republic gunship there.

Garm Bel Iblis's movement was comprised of the remnants of the Corellian Resistance that remained loyal to Garm Bel Iblis following his rift with Mon Mothma and subsequent split from the Rebel Alliance, shortly after the destruction of Alderaan.
Olinor was a Nebulon-B escort frigate in the service to the Rebel Alliance. She arrived at space station DS 5, presumably to stop Admiral Harkov's capture during the Battle for Honor.
Planka was a Rebel Alliance MC40a Light Calamari Cruiser.
The Anterab was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Galactic Empire during the "Arms Race". The Anterab and the Degathem were delivering supplies critical for
The Degathem was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Galactic Empire during the "Arms Race". The Degathem and the Anterab were delivering supplies critical for

New Republic Intelligence Operations Command, also known as the Operations Ministry or simply Operations, was a New Republic intelligence organization, possibly the command staff of the New Republic Intelligence Service.
The Harken was a Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry (LAAT/i) gunship that saw service with the Grand Army of the Republic during the early stages of the Clone Wars.

Tomrik was the largest gas giant in the Bacrana system. The planet consisted of swirling bands of gasses, colored bright orange and red. Sixteen satellites orbited the planet, most of them originating as asteroids captured from the Carba Asteroid Belt.
The Carba Asteroid Belt was a particularly dense, large and dangerous to navigate asteroid field in the Bacrana system. It occupied the third orbit between the planets of Bacrana and Tomik.
The Jaunty Cavalier was a YT-series freighter owned by the Wookiee Rufarr, who operated it alongside a crew of six beings.
Rafe's Gambit was an independent transport that became grounded on the planet New Plympto around 19 BBY, following the Clone Wars. While it was grounded, Imperial stormtroopers boarded the starship.
The Valance was a small freighter that was docked at the spaceport near Cadgel Meadows on the planet New Plympto in 19 BBY.
Gliders were avians found on Corellia; they lived in large flocks.

Janos was the capital city of Demar and the administrative headquarters of the Lant Mining Corporation. The city was laid out in a circular pattern around a central point when Demar was originally settled.
Tamen was a small town on Demar with a population of around 5,000 inhabitants. It was located near the capital city of Janos.
Megos was the third moon of the planet Hapes.
The Helping Hand was a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-1300 light freighter owned by the starship mechanic and Rebel sympathizer Plu Makor.
Goliath was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer used by the Galactic Empire to protect a Golan platform Golan I. Goliath oversaw a convoy of fifteen Sentinel-class landing craft, the KDT Group.
The Ben Het was a MC40a light cruiser used by the Dimoks.

The Boonta Training Course was a podracing circuit on Tatooine. Like the Boonta Eve Classic podrace, it began at the Mos Espa Grand Arena and took a route through the desert, albeit a drastically less arduous one than Boonta Eve.
CPD 1-13 was a medical droid that was assigned to the Imperial medical center on Coruscant where Irek Ismaren was transformed into a cyborg Dark Jedi.

The missile launcher troopers, also known as anti-air troopers, were troopers deployed by the Galactic Empire to defend against aerial ships. They were trained to have incredible accuracy and stamina, as they were required to carry a missile launcher over long distances.

Cavalcade was an HT-2200 medium freighter used by the BloodScar pirates in 0.5 ABY. Shakko was its captain and Tannis was its pilot. Vickers and Bisc were other crew members. Mara Jade infiltrated the ship and was forced to kill Shakko.

x: The Battle of the Maw in 11 ABY was between the New Republic and Admiral Daala's remaining forces including her flagship Gorgon and Tol Sivron's Death Star prototype.
Nanja flies were a species of carnivorous fly native to the underground caverns of the planet Csilla. The creatures ate carrion.

The Collaborator, originally the Hrosha-Gul (Price of Pain in the Yuuzhan Vong) was a Yuuzhan Vong Yorik-stronha picket ship analog. It was rechristened the Collaborator by Jaina Solo when it was captured for the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances.
The Wasp was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer serving in the Imperial Navy.

Triumph was a group of two CR90 corvettes belonging to the Rebel Alliance. They were sent to try and destroy the Immobilizer 418 cruiser Harpax along with three B-wing starfighters and two Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttles.

The common thranta was the most common and well-known of the thranta species native to the planet Alderaan. The species was able to escape extinction even after the loss of their home, as some of the animals had been shipped to other locales such as Bespin.
The Mingula was a ZZ-class freighter whose complete crew was killed by Ubuugan fleshborers during its journey from Ubuuga to Coruscant.
The Osprey was a Nebulon-B2 frigate used by the Empire, more specifically the Prophets of the Dark Side. It was first used when Maarek Stele was set up by Admiral Harkov and had called for backup.
Ubuuga was a planet located in the Ubuuga system and the homeworld of the Ubuugans and the Ubuugan fleshborers. Ubuuga was well-known for its caviar.

Arditi was a group of three Assassin-class corvettes used by Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's splinter government fleet. Along with Falcon group and BaKaar group, it was sent to destroy Lord Vader's flagship, the Garrett.

BaKaar was a group of three Assassin-class corvettes used by Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's splinter government fleet. Along with Falcon group and Arditi group, it was sent to destroy Lord Vader's flagship, the Garrett.

Falcon was a group of two Assassin-class corvettes used by Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's splinter government fleet. Along with BaKaar group and Arditi group, it was sent to destroy Lord Vader's flagship, the Garrett.

Ubuugans were a sentient species from the planet Ubuuga. They had grayish skin, three eyes, and a long snout. The Ubuugans developed a toxic secretion that protected them from the deadly Ubuugan fleshborers. Some of them even considered the fleshborers as a delicacy.
Excelsior was an MC80 Star Cruiser used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Seti was a fictional GV/3-series guardian droid who belonged to the young girl, Revella. He was one of the main characters of Revella's Journey: A Story of a Girl and Her Droid.

A71 was the designation of an A-series assassin droid used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Battle of Jabiim. It was specially modified for service on Jabiim, presumably adapted to the planet's perpetual rainstorms.
The Botor Income Ministry was a ministry of the Botor Enclave. Kane Griggs worked there between the Battle of Yavin and the Battle of Endor.
Nomad Squadron was a starfighter unit formed by the Alliance to Restore the Republic following the Battle of Yavin in 0 ABY.
The Siege of Kyrska was an intense three-month-long siege on the planet Kyrska during the Galactic Civil War. The fighting was dragged out due to the high number of house-to-house campaigns.
The Cheenee Rift was a valley located within the Jundland Wastes, on Tatooine. It was the location of a Czerka mining complex that was abandoned by the time of the Cold War.

The Spiral was a Corellian Engineering Corporation CR90 corvette that operated as a privateer vessel for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War fought by the Alliance against the Galactic Empire.
Shadowmoths were a type of moth. The resurrection of once-dead Nightsister Zombies from the pods in which the Nightsisters kept their bodies was comparable to the stirring of shadowmoths.

4-LB was a large, square labor droid who ran the Power Station at Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine, where locals came to power their speeders and equipment. It cared little about its customers and their whereabouts and was unenthusiastic about its role.
