x: The siege of Jabba's Palace was conducted in 4 ABY by key members of the Rebel Alliance, including Leia Organa disguised as Boushh, Luke Skywalker, Chewbacca, Lando Calrissian, and Han Solo.
The Gilagimar was a large cruiser-classed capital ship that was one of the most famous warships of the Expansion Period of around 25,000 BBY to 20,000 BBY.

The Attack on Dantooine, also known as the Dantooine Massacre, was an act of terror perpetrated by the Imperial warlord Admiral Daala during the Galactic Civil War against a newly-established colony on the planet Dantooine.

The Dantooine Jedi Enclave Council was the Council in charge of the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine. The governance of the training facility was conferred to this body sometime after the Great Sith War, when the first overseer and the founder of the Jedi academy, Jedi Master Vodo-Si…
Renik was a branch of Imperial Intelligence's Bureau of Operations. It was tasked with counter-intelligence operations.
The Imperial Ministry of Propaganda was an organization responsible for the creation and dissemination of various Imperial propaganda intended to glorify the Empire or cover up its atrocities.

The Technical Services Division, also known simply as Technical Services, was a subdivision of the Imperial Navy's Fleet Support Branch. It was charged with all matters relating to power distribution, environment, and other services not covered by the Engineering Division.
The Engineering Division was a subdivision of the Imperial Navy's Fleet Support Branch. They were in charge of all matters relating to structural and drive engine-related issues.
Najarka was a planet located in the Outer Rim's Rayter sector.

Pako Ramoon was an Outer Rim Territories astronomical object located in the Rayter sector. During the Galactic Civil War, TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated corporate headquarters were situated there.
Salteract was a celestial body located in the Salteract system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Rayter sector.

Tintel was an Expansion Region celestial body located in the Belasco sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it served as one of the mid-race stopping points of the Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade, a popular interstellar racing route.
Delrakkin City was the capital of Delrakkin. As of 0 ABY, it was occupied by the Galactic Empire.
The Underwater Kingdom was a kingdom on the Forest Moon of Endor which was ruled by King Orcon, a member of a finned amphibious species.

The Queen's Honor Guard was the name given to the group of pilots who escorted the Queen of Naboo offworld. The Honor Guard consisted of members of the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps division of the Royal Naboo Security Forces.
The Pure Sabacc was starship that belonged to Captain Bortrek when he, for a short time, had stolen C-3PO and R2-D2.

A cairoka was a type of creature capable of flight and found on the planet Alderaan. They had wings as white as snow. By 1 BBY, the Alderaanian youngling Rel watched cairoka fly over some trees on Alderaan.
Ruby Gulch was a small settlement on Nam Chorios near Hweg Shul populated by Newcomers. It housed a pub called the Flowering Bott Pub.
The Sundance was a light exploration vessel piloted by Kyp Durron at Nam Chorios.

The Ongoing Investigation Division was a subdivision of the New Republic Intelligence Service. The Division would conduct various investigations and keep track of information such as background files on various planets.
Bantha Squad was a training squadron of TIE/LN starfighter pilot cadets at the Academy of Carida around 0.5 ABY.
Tarkin's Teeth was an area of Carida three hundred kilometers from the Academy of Carida. Mountainous and desolate, by 0.5 ABY it had been used as a military training ground for several centuries.
These Endorian snails were tiny creatures with orange and white coiled shells that lived in grassy hill areas on the Forest Moon of Endor.

The suuri was a crab-like species of crustacean native to the Expansion Region planet Tynna. The suuri lived beneath kelp-covered rocks, and was one of the main sources of food for the native Tynnans, who preferred to catch it live when it tasted best.
Corellian canoids, best known simply as canoids, were animals that lived on Corellia.

The boetay was a species of canine-like predator native to Garos IV. It hunted small, furry animals called hojvok. They where also sometimes used as pack animals, or for riding, by the inhabitants of Garos IV.
The heart-tailed tube larva was the immature form of an insect species native to Selonia. It was a favored food of the Selonians.
The mesa groat was a sure-footed, golden-horned herbivore native to the highlands of Teyr.
Carnivorous seaweed was an aquatic carnivorous species of plant that grew in the oceans of the planet Hapes and used its tentacles to suffocate its victims.
The Grizmallt nerf was a rare subspecies of nerf—a nonsentient species—that lived on the Core Worlds planet Grizmallt.
San-pilots were small fish which lived in parasitical symbiosis on the skin of sando aqua monsters.
San-lampris were skin parasites which lived on sando aqua monsters. They appeared similar to miniature colo claw fish.

The giant thranta—not to be confused with the great thranta—was an oversized breed of common thranta, otherwise identical in appearance to the smaller variety. It survived the destruction of Alderaan, its homeworld, on planets such as Bespin.
A flat-bodied creature was native to the swamps of Dagobah. Its body had a brown and yellow coloration, and it had four eyes.
Kiris 17 was an asteroid in the Kiris Asteroid Cluster, which marked the "upper" part of the cluster.
Trigha were a non-sentient species of large reptilian predators that were native to the jungles of Ord Vaxal. Trigha possessed green scaly hides that were often mottled with dark stripes and spots.
Star Bantha was one of the Imperial bulk freighters assigned to Imperial Replenishment Fleet DK-209.

The 43rd Salagori Lancers was a unit of the military of the Galactic Empire that was active during the Galactic Civil War and shared its name with the Inner Rim's Salagor system. The notable unit repeatedly distinguished itself while carrying out special operations.
Victorious was a capital ship that served as flagship of the Qeimet fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Battle of Ghorman, also known as the Pacification of Ghorman, was a battle that took place on the planet Ghorman during the Galactic Civil War.

Irith was a terrestrial planet located in the Irith system, a part of the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. It was a motley stop on the Ootmian Pabol hyperlane between the Du Hutta and Nar Bo Sholla systems.
The gamwidge was an edible creature found on the planet Kinyen. Porcellus sometimes prepared goatgrass-stuffed gamwidge for Jabba the Hutt.
The sandmaggot was an insect native to Tatooine. Its kidneys could be prepared as a dish, as Porcellus was fond of doing for Jabba the Hutt, and its eggs fermented into a silvery-green delicacy.
Around 1 BBY, the Zann Consortium attacked the planet Felucia in order to steal a Sith holocron that Jabba the Hutt had acquired.

Clan Beviin was clan of Mandalorians in existence by the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War. Following the marriage of Goran Beviin and Medrit Vasur, the two male Mandalorians lived together at the Beviin-Vasur farm on Mandalore, ten kilometers outside of the Outer Rim world's capit…
2-1b-58, best known as Billingsly, was a 2-1B surgical droid that worked on Tansarii Point Station during the Galactic Civil War.
The ethersquid was a type of squid that was one of the things for which Gyndine, a planet of the Expansion Region's Circarpous sector with forests and lakes on its surface, was known for.
The winged xendrite was an insectivore native to Xend. It was exported to various planets throughout the galaxy in attempts to control insect infestations.
Yeomets were small, disease-carrying omnivores which infested numerous urban worlds, space stations, and spaceships.
The yo'uqiol (translated from Rodese as "hand of death") was a carnivorous plant native to Ooo-sek.
Tymps were omnivores native to Serat. Originating in the world's forests, they were opportunistic, and adapted to life in Seratian cities, raiding storehouses for roti grain.

Wilds were ungulates native to Kuras III that grazed on the plains in herds. While males and females spawned, a third, separate gender, the carrier, was impregnated with the resulting young during gestation.

Voroos were a non-sentient, reptilian species of stationary predator that were found throughout the galaxy. Due to a lack of limbs, they could not chase prey, instead relying on camouflage and the use of their strong tongues to capture prey and pull it into their large mouths.

Armored crebiks were predatory arthropods native to Troos's subarctic forests. Their thick shells were heavy, and they hunted other arthropods by hanging from trees and falling on and crushing prey passing below.
Two-headed tortuce were a diverse species that were found in many parts of the world of Canastra IV.

Thunder lizards were massive creatures native to Marca. Twelve meters long and three meters high, they were primarily aquatic herbivores, eating seaweeds in the shallows and coming on land only to mate.
Tantlas were cyclopian scavengers native to Ealor.

Thanu were silicavores native to the volcanoes of Kamur. They ate rocks, digesting organic materials trapped therein and expelling the crushed leftovers. The ability to eat rocks was only gained at maturity, and young survived by eating plants.
Kamur was an agricultural world owned by House Petro, and the homeworld of the Thanu species, which inhabited the planet's volcanic regions.
Thevaxan Marauders were green, black, and brown predatory reptiles that grew up to twenty meters long and eight meters at their shoulder.
The tranthebar mountain ripper was a species of bird of prey that possessed a wingspan of over five meters, and was native to the Mid Rim planet of Tranthellix.

Slorks were solitary, omnivorous ungulates native to the swamps of Kidron, but also found on Corellia. They vaguely resembled swine, and were fiercely territorial. While they seldom engaged in predation, they scavenged on the remains of quamin kills.
Stiltwalkers were quadrupedal amphibious insectivores that inhabited the swamps of a large number of the galaxy's planets.

Tailrings, or sand dragons, were desert creatures native to Socorro. They dwelt in small flocks near oases. They had wings, black scales, and short patches of fur. They shed their skin annually, and their age could be determined by the number of knobs on their tail rattles.

Najarkan wilderbeasts were large snakes native to the rain forests of Najarka. They could grow to over thirty meters long, with mouths over two meters in diameter with which they could swallow Humans whole.

The oasis mother was a species of sentient, predatory plant that was native to the desert-covered world of Endregaad. Oasis mothers lived atop small pools of water. Their bodies consisted of a series of intertwined vines that formed a trunk with over-hanging branches.

Photon spiders were bioluminescent crystalline predators native to Varl. They survived on the planet despite the desolation which caused its abandonment by the Hutts and t'landa Til. They required no air to survive, and lived on veins of aurodium.

Razorts were aquatic creatures native to the planet Sedri. Otter-like, razorts had a fearsome look and a vicious nature. It was a fast predator, possessing long fangs and a razor-tail, along with armored joints. The Sedrian Karak managed to tame one, naming it Tooch.

Rolk-mangir (translated from Yinchorri as "horned death"), were an apex predator native to the planet Yinchorr. Four meters tall with an extremely tough hide, rolk-mangir were also quite fast and cunning, and lived in social groups centered around a strength-based pecking order.
An inhabitant of lakes and swamps, the slimy nonakara or whirling snakes was a species that somehow had spread to numerous planets.

Mole serpents were burrowing predators native to the Kathol sector. They dwelt almost entirely underground and ranged from 10-28 meters long. One such creature escaped into the deserts of Tatooine. The creatures are the natural predators of the Tirginni beasts.

Marmaw were reptilian marine predators native to a tropical world in the Almar system. The marmaw was a huge-mouthed shore dweller, with teeth that formed in 20 to 30 bud rows throughout its mouth and throat and developed as they migrated toward the edge of its mouth.
Sid'han, or mud crawlers, were mud-burrowing, crocodilian predators native to Seikosha.
Slars were predators native to Port Evokk that would not hesitate to attack humanoids.
Kichicolia were sociable, herbivorous primates native to Najarka discovered by the Imperial Zoological Agency. Their call was a loud trilling squawk.
Kilits were winged predators native to Zelos II.

Kril were unintelligent, harmless arboreal herbivores native to Kidron. They were easy prey and also raised by the Orfites as the mainstay of their diet. A local company, Attakril Meats, exported their flesh throughout the Elrood sector.
Kououra were predators native to Kashyyyk. Despite its disarming appearance, it had a toxic bite. It was carnivorous with pale tender flesh.
Llwelkyn were predators native to Drong II which were remarkable for their sense of smell.
Mariqar snow q'lk were herbivores which resembled scaled-down banthas with white fur. They were native to the Jhunia Snow Plains on Neftali.
Hoskas were large, lumbering herd creatures native to the plains of Essowyn, where they were hunted by Saurtons. They were also raised for food on Agamar.
A battle occurred at the Silken Asteroids between the Galactic Empire led by Moff Derliff who moved against a Rebel Alliance base led by Jan Dodonna. Dodonna managed to destroy Derliff's forces.
The Binarian sabercat was a predator native to the planet Binaros in the Kathol Outback. A huge feline animal, the sabercat had eight powerful legs tipped with large paws ending in razor-sharp claws.
Sabercats were dangerous felines found on the planet Lothal that preyed on Loth-cat kittens. They used the grass of Lothal's grasslands as cover while hunting herbivores.

Chiru or sand wasps were insects native to Socorro. They were named the Socorran word for "deadly." Their hives could number over two hundred thousand. They were known to attack whole groups of nomads on the planet.
Coohas were flightless, predatory avians native to Gandeid IV, a temperate, low-gravity planet in the Gandeid system. They were up to a meter and a half tall and covered in feathers.
Crimson slugs were predators that lived in the vacuum of realspace. They could be found in the Tapani sector. The crimson slugs were variants of the exogorth space slugs.

Crynoids, or snow spiders, were arachnids native to the ice planet Neftali. Skilled at climbing and jumping, the tiny, three-centimeter-long species had ten segmented legs and was colored gray and white.
The d'oemir bears were a species of bear that were native to the Jhunia snow plains of the world of Neftali. They topped the food chain prior to the planet's colonization.

Druyza were herd animals native to Socorro. They were the primary prey of monnoks, and the Ibhaan'I nomads raised them as beasts of burden and mounts, as well as for their hide, meat, and dung. The dung was used to make bricks.
Diehards were burrowing, predatory insects native to Atraken.
Jexxels were tundra-dwelling, white-furred, red-eyed felines. They had serrated front claws and a mouthful of razor-sharp fangs. Their eyes glowed in the dark and gave them excellent night-vision.
Grotseth were four-meter-long fish from the planet Baralou. They were pack predators.
Prized by trophy fishermen, guda fish were the largest fish found in the icy oceans of Neftali. They could grow three meters long, but were very thin, providing little (but succulent) meat.
Gweld were saltwater amphibians from Sedri. Sedrians made spears from their jaws.

The Iagoin were a race of semi-intelligent creatures that floated among the gaseous clouds of the gas giant Tyed Kant. All Iagoin were gelatinous and ovoid, with a single eye that could move around the surface of the creature.
The floater squid was one of two predatory species of floater creatures that lived in the atmosphere of the Outer Rim Territories gas giant Yavin Prime.

The floater shark was one of the predatory subspecies of floaters found on the atmosphere of Yavin Prime. It attacked anything it perceived as food, and was invulnerable to weapons smaller than a turbolaser.
Ice Cats were predatory felines native to Hoth. Like Spiners, they could attack their prey by shooting quills from their fur. They were also found on Dagobah.
The Dargon was an Imperial Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served the Empire as a prison ship.
The Columbia was a MC80a Star Cruiser that participated in the rescue operation against the Imperial prison ship Dargon.
The Skids was a neighborhood in the city of Tyrena on the planet of Corellia that was known for its somewhat rough appearance and even rougher residents.
The Eleusis was an Ton-Falk-class escort carrier used by the Rebel Alliance.
The Quickwit was a Galactic Republic courier ship. It had a crew of six, including Captain Kendra Tissido.
A skirmish took place on Honoghr early during the Galactic Civil War, shortly after the jailbreak on Kessel.

The Nelwyn were a species of Near-Humans from Andowyne. They were shorter than the Daikini and had different proportions. Given their similarities to the Human and Brownie races of Andowyne, it is likely that the three groups shared a common ancestry.
The Lonsigar 1 was a Rebel Alliance Strike-class medium cruiser destroyed by the Grey Wolf around 3 ABY.
The Lonsigar 2 was a Rebel Alliance Strike-class medium cruiser destroyed by the Grey Wolf around 3 ABY.

The Battle of Kaal was a battle of the Imperial Civil War in 6 ABY. Following the Battle of Endor, the New Republic, Galactic Empire represented by Admiral Uther Kermen, and warlord Utoxx Prentioch clashed over control of the food-rich world Kaal.

The Royale Macheteros were the elite guard of the Kashi Mer monarchy. They practiced a sword fighting style similar to Jar'Kai. The parang was reminiscent of the weapons carried by the Royale Macheteros.

The Yovshin Swordsmen of the Atrisian Empire developed a sword fighting style in which they wielded a dueling sword in each hand. They dubbed the weapons "Jar'Kai" after the Atrisian city where they were first crafted.

The Acceptance was a Judicial Forces Consular-class cruiser piloted by Lieutenant Antidar Williams. It was one of the transports at the Battle of Galidraan, and Jedi Master Dooku's flagship. It was destroyed at the Battle of Uhanayih, though Williams and Maoi Madakor escaped.

Ensolica was a planet of ice and tundra located in the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of the near-Human Enso species, members of which were experts in hydroponics. The Enso offworld merchant Teyora Rekab hailed from Ensolica.
Ice Bats were flying creatures native to Hoth.
Piranhas were carnivorous fish with green scales. They were found on Endor and Dagobah. Another variety existed on Hoth.
Hoth jellyfish were a species of jellyfish that were native to the frozen world of Hoth.
The Snow Bear was a white-furred predatory beast found on the ice planet Hoth.
Helios were floating creatures native to Dagobah that eerily resembled Human brains.
The caterpillars of Dagobah were carnivorous arthropods.
Dagopillers were a species of carnivorous arthropods native to Dagobah.
Dagbats, also known as Dagles, were a species of winged creatures native to Dagobah.
Stargerms were aquatic animals native to Dagobah. These creatures jumped out of the water to grab prey, and then returned to the water to consume them.
Acid Plants were a type of plant found on Hoth and Dagobah that were dangerous to Humans. Acid Plants shot out a gland-like acid onto anyone who wandered under it.
Swamp Gators, also known as Igua-Jaws, were predators of Dagobah with crocodilian-like traits.
Porcuspines were venomous arthropods native to Dagobah.
The Swamp Creature Habogad, also known as the Habogad, was a massive predator native to planet Dagobah.
The Formidable was an Imperial Victory-class Star Destroyer that was sent to a vital Rebel Alliance transit point in the Delalt system during Operation: Clean Sweep.
The Valorous was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

The Mon Calamari Fish Market was a market on the planet Coruscant during the times of the Galactic Republic. A young Darth Maul visited the market briefly upon escaping from the Happy Nerf Herder home for young boys.
The Robber Baron was a Star Galleon-class frigate owned by the infamous Poss'Nomin pirate, Reginald Barkbone.
The Rabaanites were Human inhabitants of the planet Rabaan.
Coercion was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy.
The Ion eel was a species of eel found on the ice planet Hoth.
The Ice Piranha was a type of piranha found on the ice planet Hoth.

The Jumimi was a Carrack-class light cruiser used by Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin. The Jumimi was part of an attempt to destroy the Deep Space Manufacturing Facility ZA-13. However, the cruiser was destroyed by Tan Maarek Stele.
Brenn was the capital city of Genesia. Brenn is primarily under the control of local crime lord Eelien Kirat, although Soach, a smuggling and black market kingpin, is challenging this rule.
Theen Ocean was one of the three oceans on Genesia.
Wold Ocean was one of the three oceans on Genesia.
Zirac Ocean was one of the three oceans on Genesia, the other two being the Theen Ocean and the Wold Ocean.

The Sceltor was a Victory I-class Star Destroyer commanded by Admiral Thrawn. Sceltor participated in the capture of space station RS-32. It also fell into an ambush at the space station's location, but Tan Maarek Stele helped it escape.
The Skirmish on Saleucami was a mission to corrupt Saleucami into supporting the Zann Consortium.

The Eibon Scimitar was a capital ship that served as the flagship of Xim the Despot during the Xim Wars. Its keel was laid down in the Barancar shipyards, and it was destroyed during the First Battle of Vontor.
Spirador was the capital planet of the Tandon sector and the site of Moff Harlov Jarnek's palace.

place: Taul, Gunthar system, Kriz sector, Outer Rim Territories
x: The First Battle of Taul took place between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance on the misty swamp world of Taul.
The Imperial control sector, also known as the Emperor's ruling city, was the capital city of the planet Byss during Emperor Palpatine's second reign.

The Clone Labs, also known as Clone Lab complex were the area of the Emperor's Citadel on Byss that contained Palpatine's clone vats. They were overseen by the Clone Keeper, the Constable of Homunculi.
Ilic was the capital city of New Cov. It was built under a dome to protect the inhabitants from carnivorous plants.
The Nelori Marauders were a well-organized group of pirates who operated during the time of the Galactic Republic, approximately four millennia before the Battle of Yavin.
Cloak Force was a a group of TIE/LN starfighters and stolen mole miners that served the Galactic Empire.
Nellac Kram was planet in Outer Rim Territories in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector. The New Republic freighter Nartissteu was based out of Nellac Kram.
Ialtra was a Fallanassi village on Lucazec. Akanah Norand Goss Pell grew up there. The neighboring villages' inhabitants destroyed Ialtra in fear of the Fallanassi and their powers.
Nackhawns were a kind of bird native to Lucazec. They were carrion eaters and apparently quite ugly.
The Mother's Valkyrie was a Paqwe diplomatic ship sent to Coruscant and was allowed to be damaged by the Yevetha by Belezaboth Ourn.
K-3PX was a black 3PX-series protocol droid that belonged to the Sith Lord Darth Vader during the height of the Galactic Civil War, stationed at the Imperial citadel on Gamandar.
The Second Battle of Taul was a three-way skirmish that took place on Taul the day after the battle of Taul.
The Imperial conquest of the planet Kaikielius was the first battle of the Coruscant-bound arm of the pre-Shadow Hand Imperial offensive in 10 ABY.

The Huntsman was an Imperial Strike-class medium cruiser during the Galactic Civil War. It was to arrive as reinforcements along with Assault Gunboats should the Tortali Platform be unable to handle the Rebel strike force.
Atterol was a celestial body in the Atterol system. It was near Atterol that the Battle of Atterol took place during the Galactic Civil War.

The Tegret was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate used by the Galactic Empire. The frigate was to escort a convoy of 3 Modular Conveyor across the Atterol system. However the Rebels sent a strike force to steal at least one of the convoy craft.
Tue was the first planet in the Kidron system.
Spoi was the fifth planet in the Kidron system.
Kuantar was the third planet in the Kidron system. It was a ringed gas giant.
Kimogila Town was an abandoned city on the planet Lok.
Striker was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that attempted to reinforce the Elliirad Platform against the Rebel Alliance.

owners: Baron Karoll Cilarnus (failed to finalize purchase)
x: The Moomo Williwaw was a Pelagia Duplex Command Assault Gunship owned and operated by the Moomo Brothers.
The Lambarian Crab was a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-2400 light freighter.
The Iotran Police Force, or IPF, was the leading military and police force on Iotra. The top eight members of IPF made up the Joint Council, the lead ruling body of Iotran.
Grasp was the personal starship of the pirate Teehl.

The wuppa was a species of plant that grew on Moltok, a rainforest-covered planet that was located in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. When in full bloom, the wuppa had bright flowers of red and violet.

Cammy was a Holocam E-series droid who helped a Rebel agent to find and infiltrate an assassin droid factory on Tatooine. She also helped test the droids that the agent built, following them around as they went about their objectives.
The droid rebellion occurred when protocol droid C-3PO led a droid rebellion against Boonda the Hutt.

The Crisis Branch was a division of SBI, formed during emergencies. In 22 BBY, Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence Armand Isard formed a Crisis Branch, the first time in over sixty years it had been called into being.

The Intrepid was a CR90 corvette that saw service with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. It was the consular ship of a Rebel ambassador that had been sent on a mission to win the support of the Airam at an Airam Platform.
Dlarnic grazers were herbivores common to the Triumvirate worlds: Kalok, Jiroch-Saloch and Jiroch-Reslia. They were hunted by the Tunroth and formed part of their staple diet.

The Assemblage of Three was the governing body of the Tunroth. Made up of the three Tunroth Hunters of highest rank, it dealt with issues that concerned all Tunroth, such as the need to deal with an external threat, alleviate overcrowding or colonize new worlds.
Kamarian Badlanders were natives of the planet of Kamar who lived in equatorial desert regions called the Kamar Badlands.

The makant were a species of large and playful insectoids native to the forest moon of Endor who had the appearance of a cross between a cricket and a mantis. They were the domestic beast of the Gupins.
Varic was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Varic system, a part of the Chorlian sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Galactic Alliance Fleet Intelligence, also known as Galactic Alliance Military Intelligence or Defense Force Intelligence, was the intelligence service of the Galactic Alliance Defense Force.
Stovax was a planet located in the Core Worlds that the Obroan Institute and Kroddok Stopa intended to excavate.

Basarais was a planet in the Expansion Region. During the Black Fleet Crisis, outside Basarais, a children’s counting rhyme was known that went, «If I had a fat toe, a short toe, a black toe, a new toe, I would know where to go».

Skoth was a dried-up riverbed and settlement on the planet Prakith, and was the source for a number of valuable ores. Prall, a mining company controlled by Imperial Warlord Foga Brill, oversaw much of the riverbed excavation.
Bloodprice was an Imperial Patrol Frigate of the Grand Imperial Navy.

Palpatine's apartment was a suite of rooms maintained by Sheev Palpatine during his time as the senator of Naboo. It was was located in the upper levels of 500 Republica in the Senate District of Galactic City on the planet Coruscant.

Amanda's Toy II was a ship owned by Unlimited Horizons Inc.. It was registered on Kalla VII with registration number RN18-950319. In 16 ABY, Luke Skywalker tracked this ship as it passed the inner flight control buoys of the planet Teyr.
Yisgga was a colony planet located within the Yisgga system of the Inner Rim Territories which the Star Morning had visited.
The Spaar clan was a Yevethan family to which Nil Spaar belonged.
The Northstar was a Hajen-class fleet tender that served with the New Republic Defense Force's Fifth Battle Group during the Black Fleet Crisis.
Drannik was a planet in the Expansion Region. It was a member world of the New Republic and was represented in the New Republic Senate.
Toko birds were a kind of bird eaten by the Paqwepori.
The Liberty was a Majestic-class heavy cruiser in the New Republic's Fifth Battle Group. It was named in honor of the MC80 Star Cruiser lost at the Battle of Endor
Trif was a planet located within the Trif system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was under the control of the Imperial Remnant during the Black Fleet Crisis.

The Cularin system was surrounded by a dense comet cloud, remnants from the system's formation. Most of the comets followed erratic courses around the system, some of which had dense cores similar to the system's heavier planets.
The Battle of Kathol System, also known as the Battle of Kathol, was the final battle between Imperial Moff Kentor Sarne's forces and the crew of the FarStar.
Titania was a Imperial I-class Star Destroyer which served under Moff Kentor Sarne in the Battle of Kathol System.
Bastion was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer, commanded by Captain Brannij, which served under Moff Kentor Sarne in the Battle of Kathol System.
The Tsilor Sea was a body of water on the edge of the city Phemiss, which was the capital of the planet New Plympto. The Pharine River flowed into the Tsilor Sea.

Boash'ua was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate captained by the Bothan Kursk Mal'ia during the Galactic Civil War. It most famously took place in the Battle of Kathol System, in which it assisted in the defeat of Moff Kentor Sarne and the liberation of Kathol.
The Pharine River was a river on New Plympto that formed a rough border for the sprawling capital city of Phemiss. The river flowed into the Tsilor Sea.
The Battle of Troska was between the Galactic Empire and the forces of the Kyber Royal Family.
The Carbonite Sith Army was an army of Sith troopers that had been frozen in carbonite and put into storage on a rocky planet.
The Battle of the Hast Shipyards was a battle of the Galactic Civil War. The Empire's attack devastated the New Republic Hast Shipyards.
The Reliance was a Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Under the command of Captain Iolan Gendarr, it guarded the planet Jardeen IV.
Salibury was a city on the planet Ralltiir.
Falaricae was a MC40a light cruiser used by the Dimoks.

The Onderonian separatists were a group of Onderonians before and during the Onderon Civil War who supported the overthrow of Queen Talia and her subsequent replacement with her cousin, General Vaklu, who allied himself with Darth Nihilus.

The Shemsher was a Nebulon-B escort frigate used by the Ripoblus. It was present at a meeting between the leaders of both factions that was raided by Imperials who intended to capture the leaders of both factions only to kidnap their children instead.

Manus Ferre was a Nebulon-B2 frigate used by the Dimoks. She was present at a meeting between the leaders of both factions that was raided by Imperials who intended to capture the leaders of both factions only to kidnap their children instead.
A mission to Cilpar resulted in a conflict in which the Cilpari Resistance and Rogue Squadron defeated the forces of the Galactic Empire on Cilpar.
The Skirmish on Korriban took place between the redeemed Jedi Apprentice Revan and the entire Sith Academy.

The Jabiimi Nationalists were the faction of Jabiimi under Alto Stratus who took control of Jabiim at the start of the Clone Wars. They joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems and were opposed by the Jabiimi Loyalists.

The Jabiimi Loyalists were the faction of Jabiimis under Orliss Gillmunn who opposed Alto Stratus's Nationalist faction during the Clone Wars. After Gillmunn was killed in 20 BBY, leadership passed to his son, Nolan.
D6-L5, sometimes known as Deesix, was a protocol droid which served Mon Mothma during the Galactic Civil War.

Red Fang was a modified A-24 Sleuth-class scout ship owned by the smuggler Tarquin Zian. Red Fang was armed with two laser cannons. The crew was simply Zian himself, although the ship allowed two more passengers.

Galas was a city in Kallistas during the time of the Galactic Civil War. A gem mine settlement, it was eventually abandoned and taken over by sand bears and, later, by Rebel agent Pallas Quintell for a base. Quintell's Z-95 Headhunter fighter was hidden there.

Trevalis was a city on Kallistas during the time of the Galactic Empire. It was the headquarters of Prefect Dengless Rinn, with 220 inhabitants including some 24 militia. It was also the only official spaceport of the planet.

Mindori was a city on Kallistas during the time of the Empire. A mining town centered around some pits, it was the second oldest settlement on the world, once with over 4,000 inhabitants, but reduced to some 70 of them during the rule of Prefect Dengless Rinn.

Vexen was a city on the mining colony Kallistas, during the time of the Galactic Empire. It was the center of the extraction of radioactive elements, with more than one hundred workers working on it, although the harshness of the place made most of them leave.
Sand bears were a species of bear that were native to the world of Kallistas. They typically attacked settlers, though this would never occur near the planet's cities.

The Black Vulkar Base was the headquarters for a swoop gang on the planet Taris known as the Black Vulkars, located in the Lower City. The Sith orbital bombardment destroyed much of Taris and the base in 3956 BBY during the Jedi Civil War.
Kiris 3 was one of the asteroids of the Kiris Asteroid Cluster.

The Vagabond Registration Office was a branch of the Mon Calamari government. From it's name it can be assumed that its purpose was to register immigrants from other planets that did not have a permanent residence.

The Far Orbit was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that served in the Galactic Empire's navy until, after a mutiny among its crew, it became one of the first privateering vessels for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
This Low Altitude Assault Transport was used by The Muunilinst 10 during their mission to Hypori. It was heavily modified and sported a unique paint job.
The Daubird was a bird native to Kashyyyk's Shadow Forest and were hunted by netcasters.
The Royal Intelligence Service was the primary intelligence agency of the Hapes Consortium.
2-20 was a YVH-series battle droid assigned to Ducha Galney and kept at Villa Solis.
Hapan Security was the primary law enforcement of the Hapes Consortium. Taryn Zel and Trista Zel worked for it.
A forested moon orbited the Unknown Regions planet Rhigar—which was part of the Chiss Ascendancy—in the Rhigar system, within the Rata Nebula.
Rhigar 3 was the outermost of the three moons orbiting the planet Rhigar in the Rata Nebula. Rhigar was home to the Chiss military academy which Jag Fel once attended.
Asdroni was the largest of the three moons of the planet Rhigar in the Rata Nebula which housed the Chiss military academy attended by Jagged Fel.

The Hapan Royal Guard (Chume'doro in Hapan) was the elite security force of the Hapes Consortium. Its duties were to protect both the Queen Mother and the Hapan Royal House. Members of the Chume'doro included Major Moreem Espara.

The Battle of Choal was a skirmish in the Battle of Jabiim in the Clone Wars. In it, a clone trooper force under Jedi General Norcuna was wiped out by the Jabiimi Nationalists while trying to capture the city of Choal.

The Battle of Shelter Base was a skirmish in the Battle of Jabiim in the Clone Wars. It marked the beginning of a disastrous campaign for the Republic's forces, and sees the capturing of both Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando Alpha-17 and Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi.

result: Capture of Nationalist command center by the Republic
x: The Battle of Razor Coast was a skirmish in the Battle of Jabiim in the Clone Wars. In it, Jedi General Leska managed to capture the Jabiimi Nationalist command center, but at a high amount of clone trooper casualties.

The battle of Hyber Canyon was a skirmish between the Jabiimi Nationalists and the Jabiimi Loyalists in 21 BBY. The Loyalists, under Orliss Gillmunn, tried to capture the Nationalist headquarters, but failed. Dunaub led a platoon in the battle.
The massacre at High Rock Canyon was a skirmish between the Jabiimi Nationalists and the Jabiimi Loyalists on the High Rock Canyon. The Loyalists faced a huge defeat in the battle.

A battle took place on Dagu during the Clone Wars. It was between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during which High General Shaak Ti battled a Dark Acolyte named Artel Darc.

The Tunroth Hunters were an elite organization within the Tunroth culture. Only the most capable hunters ever became Hunters, a process that involved a three month initiation rite, and acceptance by three other Hunters.
The Empire, was a prototype Imperial II-class Star Destroyer that served within the Imperial Navy. It was modified with superior shielding, and was commanded by Admiral Kiez.
Trallan was a planet located within the Trallan system of the Colonies and the homeworld of Captain Theb Tobbra.
The Vanguard was a Warrior-class gunship serving in the navy of the New Republic, which fought in the Black Fleet Crisis in 17 ABY.
Barbary birds were a kind of small, swift bird. Males of the species were easily visible with their black and yellow plumage.
The Flarion was an easily-startled bird native to Kashyyyk.
Tholaz was a planet located within the Tholaz system of the Core Worlds.
The Banshee was a New Republic warship that was destroyed during the Battle of N'zoth.
The Werra was a New Republic warship that was destroyed during the Battle of N'zoth.
The Garland was a New Republic warship that was destroyed during the Battle of N'zoth.

Diplomatic Services was a branch of Imperial Intelligence's Bureau of Operations. A catch-all branch, it provided personnel for trade and diplomatic missions assigned to Imperial garrisons, and advisory and political experts for governments and Moffs.

Shador was a Strike-class medium cruiser during the Galactic Civil War. Alongside a fleet including the Valiant under the command of Moff Vensell, Shador was part of an operation against the Alliance to Restore the Republic that was launched from Jerijador.

Usta was a terrestrial world located in the Usta system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Feena Run linked it to the Barison and the Cometwash systems.

The Buick was a unique vehicle called a car or, more specifically, a convertible, that was capable of ground, atmospheric, and space combat. It was a unique design in the galaxy, coming from outside known space.
Cadmus was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Adventure was a DP20 gunship in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Tano was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
The Active was a DP20 gunship in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Pervail was a DP20 gunship in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Bruizer was a DP20 gunship in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Canopus was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Persistence was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate which saw service in the Rebel Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Angelus was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that saw service with the Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Vindictor was a DP20 gunship used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Borgo asteroid belt was the location of a false berubian mine once owned by Lando Calrissian.
In 10 ABY, during the offensive that preceded Operation Shadow Hand, the Galactic Empire conquered the planet Metellos before moving on to Coruscant.
A fake Millennium Falcon was used by a team of Noghri Death Commandos on Bpfassh in 9 ABY in an attempt to capture Leia Organa Solo and her unborn twins for the Dark Jedi Joruus C'baoth.

Stensen's Colony was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Stensen's Colony system, a part of the Stensen sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Ghothian slime pools, which originated in the sector's Ghothia system, could be found there.

The Ancient Grove was a site on Dantooine where the Jedi often came to meditate. Located near the Jedi Enclave, the Ancient Grove was ancient even when the Enclave was built, and its structures bore a strong resemblance to those of a site of Rakatan ruins located nearby.
Shuttle 37 was an Imperial shuttle originally designed to supply the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Chimaera in the Wistril system.

The Salvation was a Nebulon-B frigate that served under the banner of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, one of the first of many starships added to the growing Alliance Fleet.

Trammen was a heavily populated Expansion Region world located in the Harron sector. Situated on the Ootmian Pabol hyperspace route, around the time of the beginning of the Alsakan Conflicts, it was a part of the Galactic Republic as well as the Exploitation Region that was co…

The Grand Dukha was the largest dukha of the Noghri and the meeting place of the Dynasts. Located in Nystao, the Grand Dukha looked the same in shape as the standard dukha of each clan. The differences lay in both its far grander scale and the materials with which it was built.
The Lucky Find was a salvage ship owned by Captain Sreethyn. During the Galactic Civil War, it was operating around Jerijador, and its newest crewmember was Kanda Farral.

The Deretta Destroyers was a mixed Alliance to Restore the Republic starfighter squadron named for heavy assaults on Imperial depots. Among the members of the Destroyers was Tenk Lenso, a talented gunner, who would later go on to serve with the elite Rogue Group.

result: Confederacy of Independent Systems new army built
Beginning of the Hunt for the Decimator
x: The Battle of Kaer Orbital Platform took place early on in the Clone Wars.

Koseyet Mining Camp was a mining camp on Mustafar. It was attacked in 1.5 ABY by HK-47's droid forces as the first part of HK-47's plan to wipe out all "meatbags" on Mustafar. It was stopped by a group of spacers, however, and Koseyet Mining Camp was saved from destruction.

The Battle of Koseyet occurred on Mustafar during the Galactic Civil War. HK-47 and his droid army attempted to wipe out the Koseyet Mining Camp, as part of HK-47's personal mission to seek revenge on all organic "meatbags" for their part in the events that caused him to lose …
The Entertainment Promenade, which was located in the Refugee Sector of Nar Shaddaa, had two major rooms: a cantina and a Pazaak Den.

The Leefari Sea was located on the planet Berchest, adjacent to the city of Calius saj Leeloo (City of Glowing Crystal). Saltile spray from its dark red-orange waters built up over eons to create the gigantic crystal that artisans sculpted into that City of Glowing Crystal.

Mavrille Street was one of the few streets in the Calius saj Leeloo that had been carved wide enough for vehicular travel. It was also a direct route from the Tower in which Grand Admiral Thrawn's clone army was housed to the Calius landing field.

The Ministry of Defense, also referred to as the Defense Committee, was the agency responsible for oversight of the Republic Military and was headed by the Minister of Defense. It was dissolved during the Ruusan Reformation, along with its Minister.

The President's Guest Floor was a floor of the Presidential Palace (later the Imperial Palace) for special guests of the President of the Senate, Galactic Emperor, Chief of State and various other government officials who used the Palace.
Harrandarr was a planet located in the Harrandarr system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Bosph sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Buzchub species.

Nigel VI was a planet in the Nigel system of the Expansion Region, and was the site of a little-known Human colony. The planet was somewhat cold, with glaciers, plains, and large polar ice caps among the dominant topographical features.
Nargo was the capital city of Nigel VI. The Buzchub, Und'l, hired some spacers to transport crates of lexonite from Nargo to the planet Lohopa II, describing the goods as "spice."
A planet was the site of a major battle between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Pa'hir'al City was a settlement located in the Pa'hir'al system, a part of Urce Space of the Mid Rim. Around 1 BBY, the Wookiee operative Tirranna of the Rebel Alliance was captured by the Galactic Empire in Pa'hir'al City, which led to her interrogation by Imperial High Inqui…
Floating City was the capital of the ocean world Aquilaris. The Republic governor ruled the planet from this city. It was a large hovering city-ship that floated above the oceans of Aquilaris.

S-4 was a droid in service to the Star Tours travel agency as a quarantine inspector. He cleaned the baggage claim area with his associate, P-6. He was equipped with radar, a flyswatter, and a loupe. Both were supervised by a blue R2 unit. He required locomotive pads to move.

P-6 was a treaded droid in service to the Star Tours travel agency as a quarantine inspector. He cleaned the baggage claim area and also inspected any incoming astrocultural freights with his associate, S-4.
Roshans were humanoid beings who lived on the planet of Rosha in the Leemurtoo system. They were a tall species with strong, flexible bodies and light blue or green eyes.

The battle of the Celestial Wake was a difficult battle that occurred during the Clone Wars. The clone commando sergeant Sarge participated in this battle. He would later complain about surviving it only to end up doing a ridiculous mission on Garqi.
Bruallki was a herd animal used for food, which could braised and eaten formally at dinner, or cold as a light snack.

The Raid on Bilbringi was a raid by the newly established Smugglers' Alliance on the part of smugglers Mazzic and Ellor against the Galactic Empire at the Bilbringi Shipyards in retaliation of the Ambush on Trogan.

The Lagulla ice cave was an underwater passage in the core of the Mid Rim planet Naboo. In 32 BBY, Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan, Obi-Wan Kenobi, along with their navigator, Jar Jar Binks, traveled through this ice cave in a tribubble bongo on their journey from Oto…
Keskin was a planet which was the site of a battle during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The battle on Keskin took place about nine months after the Battle of Yavin in the Galactic Civil War. In it, the Rebel Alliance raided the Imperial planet of Keskin. Malis, Reydon, and Ohvan fought in the battle.

Krintrino was a planet. During the early stages of the Galactic Civil War, Imperial forces were responsible for the destruction of an Rebel Alliance resistance cell that was based there, about five years prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Shelkonwa was a planet in the Shelsha sector of the Colonies.

Republic Redux was the smallest of the three Rebel Alliance member groups in Shelsha sector, under Yeeru Chivkyrie. Chivkyrie, being a second-tier Adarian, kept his recruitment almost exclusively to other second-tiers.
Teardrop was a planet located in Shelsha sector. It contained Por'ste Island and was near Briston.

Makrin City was the capital city of Shelkonwa. It billed itself as the Second City of Spires, a reference to ancient Coruscant. It contained the Nightowk Repository and a governor's palace. Farfarn District was an area of the city.
The Hand of Judgment was a vigilante group of five stormtrooper deserters who performed multiple operations across the Galactic Empire in the months following the Battle of Yavin.
The Little Bivoli was a Quartermaster-class supply carrier that served as a fringer provisioning ship for the Republic Navy until its destruction in 3963 BBY.

The Veltraa was a Republic Hammerhead-class cruiser under the command of Dallan Morvis in service during the Mandalorian Wars. It was named to honor the service of Admiral Jimas Veltraa to the Galactic Republic.
The Reliance was a Galactic Republic warship that served as the flagship for Admiral Jimas Veltraa during the Mandalorian Wars.

Admiralty Plaza was a plaza on the planet Coruscant that housed the Admiralty of the Republic Navy during the time of the Mandalorian Wars. Each admiral in the Republic Navy had their own office at Admiralty Plaza, and orders were issued out to the Navy from there.
This enclave of a tribe of Sand People was located within the Dune Sea of Tatooine, near the Anchorhead settlement established by Czerka Corporation some time prior to the Jedi Civil War.
The Green Palace was the name of Brasck's smuggling ship, a modified Lantillian GX1 short hauler that always looked as if it had seen better days.

The Hugo was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by Overlord Ghorin to be part of a convoy to deliver grain to the Imperials. Unfortunately the freighter, along with the Grotius, were disabled along with the rest of the convoy by Rebel Y-wings.
Grotius was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by Overlord Ghorin to be part of a convoy to deliver grain to the Imperials.
The Ashanti was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Rebel Alliance. It was part of the operation to steal TIE Avengers from a secret Imperial base.
The Asilyr tribe was a nomadic clan of Humans on Socorro known for being friendlier than the planet's other tribes.
The Bharhulai were one of several nomadic tribes that inhabited the planet Socorro. The Bharhulai roamed the northern polar regions of Socorro, and used crude weaponry and simple clothing.
The Elder Rakatan Settlement was the enclave of the Rakatan Elders on Lehon. Keeper Orsaa was one of the leading members of the settlement.

Bpfassh 3 was the third moon in the complicated system which orbited the planet Bpfassh. It contained a starfighter base, which was presumably destroyed by the Imperial Star Destroyer Inexorable in 9 ABY.

Cavern Monsters were non-sentient beasts from the planet Ventooine. They were very aggressive creatures and were prone to attack any other creature in range. During the reign of the Satabs, Cavern Monsters were used as tools of execution and punishment for their enemies.

Ramit was a BFF-1 bulk freighter that delivered munitions and repairs to the Imperial Nebulon-B frigate Red Wind. However her arrival was timed to a rebel attack consisting of 9 CR90s and two A-wings, one of them piloted by Keyan Farlander. She was destroyed by the Rebel ace.

The Tharen Wayfarer was a starship owned and operated by Kalarba Safari, a Pitareeze family company. The family used the ship to take guests on the "Journey of the Spirit" tour, traveling over the Great Sea and past the Three Peaks of Tharen, Kalarba's symbol of the spirit.
The Indobok Pirates, headed by Captain Huba, were a gang of pirates that operated in the Kalarba system. The group was named after the living moon of Kalarba, Indobok.
Zoma Gawanga, literally "Western Ocean" in Huttese, was an ocean on Ylesia. Colony One, Colony Two, and Colony Three were built on its shore.
Striker was a group of three CR90 corvettes in the Rebel Alliance Fleet. They were the first group of a three-wave corvette attack on the Imperial EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Red Wind.
Hammer was a group of three CR90 corvettes in the Rebel Alliance Fleet. They were the second group of a three-wave corvette attack on the Imperial EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Red Wind.
The giant forest beast was a creature found on the Forest Moon of Endor. It was capable of producing a flagrant projection.
Redkihl Rokk's Pirates were pirates dedicated to serving with Redkihl Rokk on the Hungry Ghost. Many of them almost killed Luke Skywalker when he crash-landed his X-Wing into the hangar.

affiliation: The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania
manufacturer: The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania
x: The Arkanian Legacy was a massive capital ship that served as the mobile headquarters of The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania, also known as Adascorp, in the era of the Mandalorian Wars.
The Startled Circuit was a freighter owned by the Jabba the Hutt-employed spacer duo Garron and Vareth.
Minkring was a planet in the Shelsha sector. By 0.5 ABY it was home to one of the only two remaining Imperial army garrisons in the sector (the other being located on Chaastern 4).
Chaastern 4 was a planet in the Shelsha sector. By 0.5 ABY it was home to one of the only two remaining Imperial army garrisons in the sector, the other being located on Minkring.
Llorkan was a planet and home to an Imperial army garrison. Llorkan was the original destination of Captain Norello's ship, Happer's Way, during his interrupted delivery of fifty AT-ST walkers.
Lessuris was a backwater planet located within the Lessuris system of the Outer Rim Territories. Luskin Exovar was born on Lessuris.
Briston was a planet near Teardrop, in the Shelsha sector.
Por'ste Island was an island located on the planet Teardrop. In 0 ABY, it was hit by a groundquake.

MS-133 was an Imperial science team commissioned by Moff Kentor Sarne, warlord of the Outer Rim Territories' Kathol sector. The team was led by Doctor Lancer Brunou, a respected archaeologist, and was comprised of scientists, technicians, and soldiers.

Copperline was a world of poor farmers that was plagued by pirates for decades. In 18 BBY, the Imperial Navy and Army, including at least one unit of stormtroopers, cleaned out the pirates in a five-month-long operation.

Some time between 2 BBY and 0 BBY, the Galactic Empire sent stormtroopers including Daric LaRone to Elriss. While on it, the stormtroopers triple-checked the identities of the population of a village, and made all its inhabitants wait for six hours in the rain while doing so.
Bompreil was located within the Demetras sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in the Bompreil system.
Sometime before the Destruction of Alderaan, a stormtrooper unit attempted to root out a Rebel cell on the planet Bompreil.

Crovna was a planet in Senex sector that was home to the Peven Auction House; and Birtraub Brothers Storage and Reclamation Center, located near the main spaceport on the planet, which was a front for the Birtraub Brothers' criminal activities.

Drunost was a planet located within the Shelsha sector of the galaxy. A Consolidated Shipping hub and outlet were located near the planet's largest town, Conso City, making Drunost a good stop for fuel and supplies.
Ranklinge was a planet in the Shelsha sector of the Colonies.

Ranklinge City was the capital of the planet Ranklinge. It was located in the northern continent and had a population of around 100,000. The city had an Incom Corporation plant on its outskirts that produced I-7 Howlrunners.

The BloodScars were a pirate organization active in Shelsha sector, headed by a Human called "The Commodore" based on Gepparin. Governor Barshnis Choard secretly funded the group in hopes that the sector might secede from the Empire; though his plot was foiled by Mara Jade.
The Bargleg swoop gang was a swoop gang that was part of the BloodScar, and was used to try to hijack Rebel Alliance weapons on Drunost in 0.5 ABY.

Gepparin was a planet in the Gepparin system of the Shelsha sector. It was the headquarters of the BloodScar pirate gang, who had taken control of the large mining outpost on planet's surface during the Galactic Civil War, while the smaller farming outposts remained free.

Melnor Spear was a heavily-modified Suwantek Systems TL-1800 freighter used by the Imperial Security Bureau. In 0.5 ABY, the ship was moved to the Imperial Star Destroyer Reprisal as part of the ISB force being transported by Captain Kendal Ozzel to points unknown.
Ashkas-kov was a planet in Shelsha sector. It was situated along a minor trade hyperroute.
Chekria was a planet that was the target of attacks by pirates.
Purnham was a planet that was the target of attacks by BloodScar. It was located in the Purnham system and along the Purnham Run.
Shining Hope was one of the three Rebel Alliance cells operating in Shelsha sector around 0.5 ABY. Thillis Slanni was its director of planning.
The Teardrop massacre occurred in 0.5 ABY. An entire town was devastated by Imperial stormtroopers.

Telkadis was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Telkadis system, a part of the Greater Plooriod sector in the Northern Dependencies portion of the Expansion Region. Its surface featured forests of taku trees.
A raraza was an extinct bird of prey from Duro.

A violent herbivorous species known as krusk was native to the Mid Rim planet Bothawui. The species name was used by the Bothans, a sentient species native to the planet, as a first name given to some members of the male sex.

A species known as ursi was domesticated at some point and the creatures were frequently kept as house pets by the Bothans, a sentient species native to the Mid Rim planet Bothawui. The Bothans viewed the creatures to be cuddly.
An ak was a bird of prey from Bothawui, a Mid Rim planet that was the homeworld of the sentient Bothan species. Among the Bothans, "Ak" was also a family name.

A bok was a draft animal from Bothawui, a Mid Rim planet that was the homeworld of the sentient Bothan species. The term was specifically used to refer to the animals' male bulls. Among the Bothans, "Bok" was also a family name.
A fish species known as sez was native to the oceans of the Mid Rim planet Bothawui. The species' name was used as a family name by the Bothans, a sentient species native to Bothawui.
