The access codes for the Eclipse are stolen by the Zann Consortium
x: The Raid on the Imperial Archive was a heist led by Tyber Zann to steal the access codes for the Eclipse at the Imperial Archives on the planet Coruscant, capital of the Galactic Empire.
Silver Claw was a ship piloted by the female Wookiee Gchalla.
New Republic Council Research was an organization that undertook research for the New Republic Provisional Council. Voren Na'al was its director during the Thrawn campaign.
a: Council Research for the New Republic

x: The N'ge'u Valley was a broad formation within the Badlands of N'g'zi, located on the world of Geonosis. Dooku's hangar was located within this valley.
The Shifty Prince was a light freighter in use during the Galactic Civil War.
The Bez'ox Mentzz was a YT-1300 light freighter in use during the Galactic Civil War.
The Lord's Mistress was a YKL-37R Nova Courier owned by Hap Daniel during the Galactic Civil War.
The Dwarf Varactyl was a small subspecies of varactyl that made its way to Tatooine.
The Emperor's Shadow Guard were elite black-armored soldiers within the Royal Guards selected by Emperor Palpatine for their sensitivity to the Force to eliminate suspected Jedi.

The EVO Troopers (Environmental) were a specialized variant of stormtroopers that acted as support units, or working in hazardous environments. The very heart of this variant consisted of stormtroopers that expressed hatred towards Non-Humans.

Heavy Weapons Stormtroopers, also called Heavy Stormtroopers, Heavy Assault Troopers, Imperial Heavy Gunners, or just simply Heavies were specially trained stormtroopers armed with large rapid-fire blasters or DLT-19 heavy blaster rifles, which could level anything in their path.
Targonnians were a green flightless avian species native to the planet Targonn.
B-9D7 was the personal assistant of Movo Brattakin.
The Messenger was a Ghtroc 720 freighter owned by the Core Courier Service. It routinely delivered mail to Coruscant, Coriallis, and other Core Worlds.
Medpac Squadron was a New Republic makeshift starfighter squadron organized specifically to participate in the battle in the Milagro system, which occurred in 5 ABY.
The Keeper was a machine with an artificial intelligence located on Keeper's World. It was accompanied by four android children.

The Chiss Senate, also known as the Chiss parliament or simply the Parliament, was a ruling legislative body of the Chiss Ascendancy formed from at least twenty-eight colony worlds of the Ascendancy and presided by senators—House leaders who were democratically elected by a co…
The 2391st Battle Squadron was a task force in the Imperial Navy serving during the Galactic Civil War.

The training center of the Emperor's Hands was a series of training chambers within the bowels of the Imperial Palace on Coruscant. A clandestine facility, the training center was known to exist only by Galactic Emperor Palpatine.

result: Formation of the Galactic Alliance Remnant
x: The Battle of Caamas was the last major battle between the Fel Empire and the Galactic Alliance in the Sith–Imperial War.

Plesstil was an astronomical object located in the Plesstil system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Veragi sector. A hyperlane linked Plesstil to the Veragi system as well as the northern reaches of the galaxy.
The Sleemo Gang, also known simply as the Sleemos, was a group of low-life thugs and pirates that lived in the outskirts of several cities on Talus during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The Pirates of Tarnoonga was a pirate group based on Tarnoonga, and led by Gir Kybo Ren-Cha.
The Nomad Mountains, also known as the Thaos Mountains, were a forested mountain range on the planet Corellia.

A species of boneless sentients with crystalline eyes existed during the time after the Imperial Period. They spoke through their prehensile trunks. These trunks had fine tendrils at the ends, and members of the species had at least five trunks.

The Triumvirate was the ruling body formed by three prominent figures of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances to serve as a constitutional replacement for the newly defunct Office of the Chief of State.
Glom Tho was a planet in Hevvrol sector, and the location of the Battle of Glom Tho.
The Chu'unthor, the second ship to bear that name, was the wandering praxeum starship of the Jedi Djinn Altis during the Clone Wars.
The Ram's Head was a Rebel Alliance CR90 corvette, the first and only ship to be outfitted with the experimental Shield X deflector shield.
Shaker was an R2-series Drewwa spaceport maintenance astromech droid that accompanied Ben Skywalker on his mission to find the Amulet of Kalara on Ziost.
The Drall Patriot's Cave was a cave located on Corellia and inhabited by a gang of anti-government Drall known as the Drall Patriots during the Galactic Civil War.
The Rogue CorSecs, also known as RogueSecs, were a criminal splinter group of the Corellian Security Forces on the Core world of Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The Afarathu Cave was a cave on the planet Corellia, located near the city of Doaba Guerfel. It was inhabited by the Afarathu extremists.

The Slams, also known as the Slam gang, were a gang of young thugs from Mamendin, in the Galactic Core, starting out there with con jobs and ID thefts. They then roamed the galaxy, mostly in the Core, pulling scams.
The Rogue Shadow was a unique starship that served as the personal transport of Starkiller, the secret apprentice of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
The Imperial Space Force was the space warfare extensive branch of the Galactic Empire, as well as its primary military arm.
The Battle of Condawn was a conflict in the Clone Wars where Luke Starkiller's father Annikin died by the hands of the treacherous Sith Lords of the galactic capital of Alderaan.

Roan Fel's private quarters were located on Coruscant. In 130 ABY, Roan Fel encountered Nyna Calixte spying on them, but she saved his life by alerting him of the Sith's betrayal. He and his escort escaped to Sublevel 12 while Darth Krayt and his Sith went after his decoy.
Foulahn City was a metropolis on the planet Cartao, the home of Spaarti Creations. Lord Pilester Binalie, owner of Spaarti Creations, owned a mansion near Foulahn City.

Knaars were, fast-moving, nocturnal, reptilian, predators, with yellow eyes, purplish-blue scales, and a silver frill of razor-sharp spines along their backs. These predators possessed powerful jaws for tearing apart prey as well as a slashing tail armed with barbs for defense.

Kuk'tar was the second planet in the Kothlis system. It was a chaotic inhospitable world. Kuk'tar was a tiny planetoid with irregular orbit that teared the planet's surface to shreds. The proximity of the planet to its sun caused seering temperatures.

Tulvarees were a species of semi-sentient avian hunters native to the planet of Pochi. Each of their wings was tipped with three razor-sharp talons, and their small mouths were filled with sharp teeth.
A-OIC (a.k.a. Doc) was one-of-a-kind medical/surgical droid. He was custom built by Massad Thrumble before his retirement as the admiral in charge of the Imperial droid research facility.

Lintu was Kar Yang's personal droid, who accompanied and assisted him on his bounty hunting missions. Lintu's body was humanoid, but his head was cone-shaped, narrowing to a rounded tip at the face, with red bands of optical sensors placed at the midpoint of the cone.
Haroon was the sole moon of the Imperial penal world Despayre, located in the Horuz system of the Outer Rim's Atrivis sector.

Mother Vima was a colony ship that, along with Constant, served as one of two support starships of the Beneficent Tasia. The three vessels departed the planet Grizmallt on an expedition to the dangerous southern quadrant of the galaxy in approximately 3900 BBY.
Mar'ta I was the sixth planet in the Kothlis system.
The VTG-2305 Transport was one of a series of transport ships built by Kuat Drive Yards.

The Architects were an ancient group that saved the planet Livno III through the construction of Breeze, Rain, and Solstice Globes. Together, the globes powered a machine which regulated the planet's environment.

Korad was a planet in Elrood sector on the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route. It was covered with starship and vehicle wrecks and was, in essence, a massive salvage yard operated during the Old Republic era by a corporation called Renew which eventually went bankrupt.
Miv'rah Firestorm was a highly modified Nestt-class light freighter owned and operated by the Sullustan smuggler Gaor Tembon.
Dactyl storks were marsh-dwelling birds with long, bent-back legs.

result: Zann Consortium manages to steal tibanna gas
x: The Ground Battle on Bespin occurred when Prince Xizor contracted fellow crime lord Tyber Zann to steal tibanna gas on Bespin from the Galactic Empire.
Weldii III was a mining planet located in the Core Worlds. It was the site of a brutal mining colony led by the Bith administrator Lenc.
The Department of Cost Accounting was a government organization within the Galactic Republic, most likely part of the Ministry of Finance.

In the later stages of the Clone Wars, the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious, publicly known as Supreme Chancellor Palpatine of the Galactic Republic, maintained a meditation chamber inside the Grand Republic Medical Facility on Coruscant.
The Force Web, a network of filaments that connected galaxies, was the largest known structure in the universe by 32 BBY.
Niran was a world located within the Niran system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tunka sector. It was the homeworld of the Human Viran Qol.

The Xenvaer Civic Auditorium was located in Xenvaer on Alsakan. In 22 BBY, it hosted a large Refugee Relief Movement fundraiser attended by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and members of his Loyalist Committee.
Bun-Dingo was an assassin droid that was hired by Governor Bisad Koong to sabotage the Umboo Racing Team and win the Drainsweeper race.
In 26 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Yuuzhan Vong invaders invaded the planet Sriluur.

The Twenty-Second Battle of Zehava occurred circa 91 BBY, three years after the Battle of Bin. It was one of the many struggles of the Melida/Daan Civil War on the planet of Melida/Daan. During the battle, Renei and Wunana were killed.
An Owriss was a large blob-like creature from the forest moon of Endor. They were considered harmless.

The Bivalva contemplativa was a species of clam native to the planet Perilix. They exhibited multigenerational narrative semaphores, which caused dispute among the xeno-ethnologists from the planet Coruscant as to whether the Bivalva contemplativa possessed true sentience.

The m'Yalfor'ac Order was a military order of the Bitthævrian that ruled over parts of Guiteica, which used the Guiteica Militia to dominate their control across the planet. The Order were anti-Force-sensitive and Bothan, being dedicated to eradicating the two.

Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7, also known as RMSU-7 (pronounced Rimsoo Seven), was a Republic Mobile Surgical Unit stationed on the jungle planet Drongar during the Clone Wars in 20 BBY. The Sea of Sponges was in between RMSU-3 and RMSU-7.
The Sabrin Ring was a territorial gang founded by Lady Miletta Sabrin after the Battle of Endor. Their operations were limited to three planets in the Sabrixin system - Sabrix, Elokas and Helisk.

A Taras-chi was an insect native to Kessel. It had six legs under a hard round carapace about three centimeters in diameter. Kyp Durron explained that they offered nutrition to the slaves in the spice mines who could catch them to eat.
The Love Commander was a Luxury 2400 yacht. Its original owner lost the ship in a sabacc game to Lando Calrissian.

Endorian blobs were primitive jelly-like creatures found in the forests of Endor. They were green and had multiple small red eyes, as well as a bigger central one, which they could spit out at a victim to attack it.

The Silaban was a CEC corvette and part of the Corellian Defense Force. It attempted to keep the Love Commander and the Pulsar Skate, along with their two-X-Wing escort from making orbit above Corellia, but was disabled by the combined flying skills and firepower of Wedge Anti…

The Boneyard Rendezvous, also known by the false ID High Tide, was a pirate vessel captained by Byalfin Dyur. The pirates were contacted at some point before or during 40 ABY, and were instructed by Lumiya to track Ben Skywalker during his quest for the Amulet of Kalara.
The Shamunaar was a frigate operated by the Galactic Alliance in the years following the Yuuzhan Vong War. It was captained by a Devaronian named Biurk.
The Blacktooth was a CEC YT-2400 light freighter owned by Faskus Olvidan. It was destroyed by the pirates of the Boneyard Rendezvous.
Gilatter VIII or Gilatter Eight was a gas giant with red, yellow and orange gases and was close to Ansion.

result: Draw (Both Alliance and Confederation claim victory)
x: The Battle of Gilatter VIII resulted from a trap laid by the Confederation Fleet under their new commander, Turr Phennir.
a: Duel on the Resort of Gilatter VIII

x: The New Republic Military Police was a branch of the New Republic's armed forces which were charged with ensuring that members of the military acted within the laws established by the Republic.

The Ministry of Internal Security was an organization established by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine during the height of the Clone Wars to protect the lives of senators as well as other government officials.
The Blue Queen was a Corsair-class cruiser that was used by the pirate group Dharus' Buccaneers during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Misnor was a frigid moon with frozen oceans and glacial regions. Chiilaks were native to Misnor, and were hunted for their fur.
The Skirmish at the Snow Palace was an altercation that ended the Odra crisis. During the course of the fight, the Snow King's heart was melted, and he was restored to his natural state.
The Avatar was the personal Star Destroyer of Grand Admiral Rufaan Tigellinus.

Meniscus was the personal Imperial-class Star Destroyer of Grand Admiral Martio Batch. The executive officer of the Meniscus betrayed and executed Batch following the Battle of Endor, and joined Admiral Blitzer Harrsk in the Deep Core.
Recondite was the personal Imperial-class Star Destroyer of Grand Admiral Nial Declann. It was presumably with him at the Battle of Endor.
Oriflamme was the personal Imperial-class Star Destroyer of Grand Admiral Octavian Grant. He presumably handed it over to the New Republic when he defected in 6 ABY.
The Impenetrable was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that was a part of the navy of the Galactic Empire.
Magic Dragon was the personal Imperial-class Star Destroyer of Grand Admiral Miltin Takel.
The Silooth was the personal Imperial-class Star Destroyer of Grand Admiral Peccati Syn. He named it after the Silooth, a Sith animal.
The Apocahk was an Imperial extermination ship.
The Angrix was an Imperial extermination ship used by the Galactic Empire.
The Taris Chamber of Commerce was an institution located on the Outer Rim world of Taris at the time of the Mandalorian Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders.

Camp Three was a Republic Navy military camp that was established on the planet Serroco when the Mandalorian warrior clans threatened the world in 3963 BBY, during the Mandalorian Wars between the Republic and the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders.

The Duel on Roqoo Depot took place on a refueling and supply station in the Hapes Cluster during the Second Galactic Civil War. It came about following a complex manipulation on the part of Jacen Solo, who had fallen under the sway of the dark side.

A blossoming gulper was an aquatic predator from Mon Calamari. It would bury itself in the sand at the bottom of the sea and leave its petal arms, which resembled the seatree, to wave naturally with the current.
Syn's Shadow was a starfighter-sized black space yacht that belonged to the ruthless bounty hunter known as Andov Syn.

The rinacat was a solitary hunting mammal native to Carosi XII. It preyed mainly upon herd animals but would occasionally descend from the mountains to attack Carosites. Rinacats were known for their unflinching tenacity, and would sometimes cross a continent in pursuit of prey.
CorSec Intelligence was the intelligence branch of CorSec.

A battle occurred in 22 BBY between the combined forces of the Lok Revenants and the Mere Resistance led by Nym, and the Trade Federation allied with Sabaoth Squadron in an attempt to retake Nym's pirate base on the planet Lok.
The Battle of Baltizaar was an attack on the planet Baltizaar by the Bando Gora, a coven of Force-worshiping criminals.
The Royal Gardens of Theed were located within the Royal Palace of Naboo.

A battle took place in 26 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War, near a white dwarf between Corellia and Commenor. A Peace Brigade operation to transfer bacta to the Yuuzhan Vong via CorDuro Shipping was foiled by an ambush of the Wild Knights.
The Crusader's Shield was a Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy under the command of Captain Osted Alater. It was stationed in the Albanin sector.

The Sea Legacy was an Acclamator-class assault ship that deployed the clone forces in the Battle of Pengalan IV. When the battle turned out to be an ambush, the Sea Legacy recovered her troops, and retreated immediately.

A diplomatic mission to the Mid Rim planet Bimmisaari was undertaken by Han and Leia Organa Solo in 9 ABY. However, the mission was never carried out as a Bimm traitor used the Solos' presence on Bimmisaari to attempt to hand them over to Thrawn's confederation.
Darth Maladi's laboratory was a room inside the former Jedi Temple. After the Sith confiscated the structure, Darth Maladi took up residence in the area formerly used as the Jedi's infirmary.

Huf duns were large herd animals native to Talus, a planet located within the Corellian system. These herbivorous creatures were relatively peaceful, often ignoring smaller creatures that roamed around them.
Justa was a moon of the planet Mutanda. Cold and rocky, it served as a shipping port for most of the galaxy's prothium.
Mortav was a moon that orbited the world of Mutanda. It was the innermost of the planet's four satellites.
Seldibia was the third moon of the planet Mutanda.
Mutar-Horan was a moon of the planet Mutanda. It was the outermost of the four satellites.
Ohratuu was a terrestrial planet located within the Ohratuu system of the Expansion Region's Piryn Shar sector. It was home to a species of docile land-based herd creatures known as deripors.
The Battle of H'ken asteroid belt was a skirmish that occurred in 9 ABY, within the H'ken system asteroid belt which was located on the Outer Rim of the galaxy.

The A'Mar were a cultural group of human who called the moon Lamus home. The initial settlers on the Outer Rim moon encountered an astronomical oddity on their third night on the world; while camping near the Wellspring—the source of all surface water on the moon—the settlers …
Novania was a major spaceport city on the planet Arkania.
A minor engagement between the Yuuzhan Vong and New Republic took place near Vortex in 27 ABY, shortly before the Battle of Coruscant.
Draik 4 was a planet located in the Mid Rim. The Imperial-run Damorian Repair Yard was nearby.

Many members of the Elom race were named after this city. Tor'Oront, a mining colony on the planet Nyriaan, was named based on Oront after a con artist from Corporate Sector tricked a group of Elomin to settle there and forced them to mine for madilon without notifying the pla…
ST0-48, or Esteeoh-Four Eight, was an Imperial medical droid later repurposed to be a mixicologist at Chabak's casino in the Zirtran's Anchor space station.

The Death Mark was a frigate that used to belong to an Imperial bounty hunter known as Vygar. Wanting to offer his colleagues a place of their own where they could rest, make repairs and socialize with their colleagues, Vygar decided to integrate his ship into the Zirtran's An…
Destiny was an oddly shaped starship attached to Zirtran's Anchor, a space station located in the Phosphura Belt Nebula.
The 32-18 asteroid shelf was a group of asteroids in the Peragus asteroid field.
The Crimson Aces were an independent mercenary strike force that operated during the Galactic Civil War.
Victor Flight was a starfighter squadron of the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps that served Naboo during the Clone Wars.

Outpost Cinder was an Alliance Special Forces outpost base located on the planet Bid'jerma. It was established on a ridge overlooking the Empire's Bid'jerma Detention Block, in an effort to liberate the high concentration of Alliance prisoners at the facility.
Omicron 023 was a Mesens SCT Scout Craft that arrived at the meeting site between Rebels and Dunari to investigate the craft present in the system.
The Peacebringer was, in 40 ABY, the new flagship for the Galactic Alliance Fourth Fleet and the seat of Admiral Ratobo's command.

headquarters: Imperial Citadel, Kaas City, Dromund Kaas
x: Sith Intelligence was the successor of the Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire.
Unparala was the capital city of Virujansi. It was the site of the Battle of Virujansi during the Clone Wars.
Addolis was the capital city of the planet Sermeria. Johun Othone was born there 1019 BBY.
The Figg & Associates Art Museum was a museum in Cloud City. For a brief time, a carbonite block containing the frozen body of Trioculus was displayed there under the orders of Zorba Desilijic Tiure.

The Rethin Sea was the name of the liquid rethin (also known as "rethen") metal core of the gas giant Bespin. During the Trioculus affair, the Empire constructed a factory barge above the sea to harvest metals and tibanna and produce material.
The Chie was a MC80 Star Cruiser used by the Rebel Alliance.

Ghaz Kul IV was a mining town on the planet Pitann. It was connected to one of Pitann's limited-service starports via repulsorlift barge. The town was grimy and populated with industrial buildings. It was surrounded by slag heaps and open pit mines.
Balderdash was a city on the planet Adarlon that was connected to the world's spaceport by a whisper-transit transportation line.
Kanti was a city on the planet Arkania during the reign of the Galactic Republic.

The Vaj Desert was one of several deserts located on the planet Ingo. When the smuggler Zevel Hortine dropped his cargo to avoid prosecution by the authorities, much of it landed in the Vaj Desert, including the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO.
Off-Canau was a planet. It was one of the favorite tourist destinations of the galaxy.

The Tlönians were a species of sentient arachnoids from the planet of Tlön in the Tlönia system. They were known for their poison-sacs and habit of preying on starships imprudent enough to cross their frontier.

The Fenelar were a species native to the Outer Rim Territories world Fenel. Notable for their starshipwrights and technologists, the Fenelar designed warships such as the Kandosii-type dreadnaught, as well as the legendary Fenelar armor suits.

The Wayward Girl was owned by Jadonna Veloz. Han Solo piloted it from Alderaan to Bespin so that he could attend the Cloud City Sabacc Tournament. It carried nerf tenderloins in stasis for the Yarith Bespin kitchens.
Orvax was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Orvax system in the Dalchon sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Orvax had damp ground and dark forests, which made it hard to see.
Stokoryce was the capital city of the planet Leria Kerlsil.

The Frieste River was a prominent river of liquid water in the southern hemisphere of the frigid world of Rhinnal. The city of Rhire was built along the Frieste. A Jedi chapter house was constructed on its gray banks.

Gabals were a large mammals native to the Zirfan glacier on the planet Rhinnal. Native Rhinnalians hunted wild gabals in the frigid borderland of the Zirfan glacier for their thick fur and as a source of food.

Emdee was an MD-series medical droid who served the First Order. While loading crates aboard the shuttle Two-Seven-Oh-Five on a First Order space station, Emdee was approached by Finn and Poe Dameron, members of the Resistance who were attempting to escape the station disguise…
Hajibar was a city on the planet Foerost.
The Ion Storm was a Strike-class medium cruiser.
The Airam was a clan-based culture of indeterminate species that lived in space within the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Intran was an uninhabited planet in the Intran system of the Brak sector. An Alliance to Restore the Republic military base was established on the planet shortly before the Battle of Yavin. The base housed a squadron of BTL Y-wing starfighters.

Jinet was an uninhabited planet in the Jinet system of the Brak sector in the Expansion Region. The Alliance to Restore the Republic established a starfighter base on the planet shortly before the Battle of Yavin. The base was home to a squadron of BTL Y-wing starfighters.
Garia was a planet in the Garia system of the Brak sector. It was the site of a battle during the Clone Wars.

Latoma was a planet in the Latoma system in the Brak sector of the Expansion Region. It was a small rocky planetoid and covered in impact craters. The planet was used by Byro Ti'mere to distract visitors and bounty hunters searching for his secret base on Brugga.
Rehn VII was a planet located within the Rehn system of Brak sector, situated in the Expansion Region. The world was capable of foodstuff production and had manufacturing capabilities.

Orma was a junk planet in the Aramand Cluster of the Brak sector. Junkers had covered the world in scrapyards which contained many cultural artifacts including some toys and tech. Further within the planet were items of amazing value.
The original capital of Balmorra, Sobrik was a city and industrial region located on the planet Balmorra.

Sea eels were long, slimy, fish-like creatures that were native to Kamino. They had narrow eyes and huge mouths. Household sea eels were often fed sea-mice. They were one of several species of eel in the galaxy.
The battle for the Razor's Kiss was a battle in 7 ABY between General Han Solo's New Republic fleet and the forces of Warlord Zsinj, for the possession of the Super Star Destroyer Razor's Kiss.

The Buro were a species of sentient insects that were considered ethereally beautiful by some other species. They were native to Kaisa, a planet located in the Corva sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Night Havok was a modified YT-1300 light freighter owned and operated by Kara Saffch and her brother Willi Saffch. The ship was often used by them in their scavenging operations and in making cargo hauls in the area of Korbin.

The Moondrake was a salvaged YT-1300 light freighter owned and operated by the Sareetan smuggler Sassan Sareeta. The Moondrake was a heavily armored craft that Sassan constructed from the hulks of three different YT-1300s that he had acquired.
Masalou was a barren rock planet with no moons that occupied the third orbital position around the yellow star Baralou within the Baralou system of the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector.

Tanalou was a frozen rock planet with no moons that occupied the fifth and outermost orbital position around the yellow star Baralou within the Baralou system of the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector.
The Alou Belt was an asteroid belt that occupied the second orbital position around the yellow star Baralou within the Baralou system of the Outer Rim Territories' Varada sector.

Tothis was a lackluster industrial world located in the Tothis system of the Outer Rim Territories' Corporate Sector. The Authority Guardian Corridor hyperlane connected Tothis to the Atchorb and Kir systems.

Greater Marianas was a small dust-swept planet in the Outer Rim Territories subjugated by the Galactic Empire some time before the Battle of Yavin. It contained at least one settlement of Humans and was also home to the yaggie, a creature hunted for its skin and meat.
A yaggie was a small, green, winged creature hunted for both its hide and meat on Greater Marianas. They were considered to have little intelligence.
The Talons were a swoop gang. During the Clone Wars, they participated in the Cularin Classic swoop race on the planet Cularin.
The spire falcon was a bird native to the planet Coruscant. It was at the top of the food chain of animals such as gully rats, grate toads, ferro-worms, and trantor pigeons.
The First Edition was a Surronian L19 heavy freighter bought by Moff Aricos Dreleene under the erroneous assumption that it was an exclusive model that he could show off in parties.

t: Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services
x: The Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services, more commonly called the New Republic Scout Service—which itself was shortened to NRSS—was the official exploration arm of the New Republic.
Vornez was a small village on Yavin 4 that was established after the Galactic Empire fell. It was located near the Central Clinic
Raven Base was a Rebel base located on Yavin 4. It was destroyed by Darth Vader and his forces during the Evacuation of Yavin in 0 ABY. It was located close to Falcon Base.
Falcon Base was a large Rebel base located on Yavin 4, consisting of prefab shelters, a mech factory and three Troop centers.
The Kaminoan resistance was a rebellion movement on the planet Kamino in 12 BBY.
The Longest Winter was Zutton's modified Ghtroc Industries freighter.
The Desert of Simoom was a desert on the forest moon of Endor. It once contained a small forest which was the home of the Ewoks.
The Ghosts were a unit of elite soldiers within the radical Mandalorian splinter group known as the Death Watch.

The Wraiths were a unit of elite soldiers within the radical Mandalorian splinter group known as the Death Watch. Clad in silver-white Mandalorian armor, the Wraiths were based out of the Death Watch's hidden bunker on the forest moon of Endor.

The Three Peaks of Tharen was a mountain range on the planet Kalarba near the immense equatorial zone. The local Kalarbans believed that their great spirit of strength was embodied within the mountains.
The Great Sea on Kalarba was a large body of water around the planetary capital Kalarba City and the Three Peaks of Tharen.

t: Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification
x: The Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification was an underground insurgency to resist the Galactic Empire control of Garos IV during the Galactic Civil War. Garos IV was not liberated by the New Republic until 9 ABY when remnant Imperial forces were driven off.

The Cabinet was a ruling body of the Chiss Ascendancy. Its primary function was to serve as the executive counter to the Chiss Senate. The Cabinet was headquartered in the House Palace in the city of Csaplar on the Ascendancy's capital world of Csilla.
Tol Ado was a planet located within the Tol Ado system of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Caamas Firestorm, also known as the destruction of Caamas, was a vicious attack on the planet Caamas perpetrated by the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY.
Ferro-worms were sightless snakes that made their nests inside of buildings. These worms could be found on the planet Coruscant and were often preyed upon by spire falcons.

The Naboo Moon Mining Union was a union of forty ships and crews that mined kassoti on Rori prior to the Clone Wars. They opposed RRM ships from clogging ports on Naboo. In 22 BBY, the union's chairperson was Kalzutan Opreka.
Blufferavians were birds native to Borcorash. They laid speckled eggs, and sometimes nested in rocky walls.
The husk lizard was a diminutive reptilian creature native to Herego, frequently kept as pets by wealthy humanoids in the Outer Rim Territories.
Meldazar was a planet that was visited by Siri Tachi and her Padawan, Ferus Olin, sometime before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

result: House Pelagia is purged of its Jedi
House Pelagia looses 70% of its seats in the Great Council
House Calipsa annexes eight of Pelagia's star systems
The Mecrosa Order recovers the Holocron of King Adas
x: The Mecetti Purge, also known as the Pelagia Purge, was a period in Tapani sector history that occurred in 19 BBY. During this time, House Mecetti, with the support of the Galactic Empire, virtually eliminated their rival, House Pelagia.

The Stormhawk was a Victory-class Star Destroyer that served as part of Task Force Vengeance. It took part in the Evacuation of Gelgelar and stayed there to guard the station. Later the Rebel Alliance destroyed it in the attack on the Gelgelar system.
The Lanigiro was YT-1300 transport used by the Rebel Alliance. She was carrying medical supplies to the Redemption while the Nemesis attacked the frigate.

Python was a pair of CR90 corvettes that were part of a Rebel convoy that contained B-wing starfighters. The corvettes were attacked, but thanks to the X-wings the entire convoy managed to escape into hyperspace.

The privy council was a group of advisors to the High Lord or High Lady who ruled over the various Tapani sector Noble Houses. The council was typically drawn from the highest status nobles within each house.
An underground city on the planet Alashan was the home of the ancient Alashan civilization. The city was buried five kilometers under the ground of Alashan.
Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 5 was a Republic Mobile Surgical Unit stationed on the jungle planet Drongar during the Clone Wars in 20 BBY.
Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 12 was a Republic Mobile Surgical Unit stationed on the jungle planet Drongar during the Clone Wars in 20 BBY.

An unidentified culture was the ancient civilization native to the planet Alashan in Wild Space. The culture had reached technological sophistication at a time well before the Galactic Republic was founded.

The Pakuuni Pirates was the proper name for the criminal organizations formed from both pirates and smugglers from the Pakuuni system, around the same time of the Battle of Hoth which caused intergalactic trade there and nearby systems like Argoon to be difficult, some would s…
A battle occurred at the planet Liinade III in 9 ABY. It was the first battle in a New Republic campaign against rogue Imperial warlord Delak Krennel.
Leviticus was a town located on the planet Tharkos, nearby the Millennium Astro-Engineering plant.
The Battle of M2934738 occurred in 9 ABY. It was the result of an ambush staged by Imperial warlord Delak Krennel against a New Republic's supply convoy en route to Liinade III.
Fingertip Express was Moranda Savich's personal Sydon Vehicle Works MRX-BR Pacifier.
The Garfin was a New Republic warship sent to aid General Garm Bel Iblis, Booster Terrik, and the Errant Venture at Yaga Minor in an attempt to steal a copy of the Caamas Document.
Kordu was a planet located in the Mid Rim's Kordu sector. The Kriss were native to the planet.

result: Kathol Republic victory, destruction of the Rei'Kas' fleet
x: The Battle of Exocron was a battle fought between Rei'Kas and his pirate fleet against the Exocron Combined Air-Space Fleet, the Aing-Tii and the Wild Karrde.
The Battle Dog was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier in the New Republic Defense Fleet.
T-2H4 was a silver protocol droid who wore an orange kerchief emblazoned with Raze's sigil across one shoulder while in Wyl Tarson's service on Per Lupelo.
The Battle of Qat Chrystac was an Imperial offensive led by Grand Admiral Thrawn.

The Ministry of Defense succeeded the Ministry of War as the civilian management of the Corellian Defense Force during the latter of the Second Galactic Civil War and was headed by the Minister of Defense.

The Ministry of Intelligence was responsible for civilian management of all intelligence in the Five Worlds, which presumably gave it at least partial oversight of CorSec Intelligence. It was headed by the Minister of Intelligence, who was a member of the High Cabinet.

A green-skinned species lived in The galaxy. A group of the species, who served as woodsmen, landed on Endor to harvest the moon's trees. They also enslaved a number of Ewoks and foonars in order to further their efforts, including Dooni's mother.

objective: Recover Edbit Teeks
x: The Mission to Tarhassan occurred three months into the Clone Wars, in 22 BBY.
The battle of Dennaskar was a skirmish that took place on the lightly inhabited world of Dennaskar during the Galactic Civil War between Rebel operatives and Imperial and Santhe Security forces.
Decisive was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer which served in the fleet of the Ciutric Hegemony, when the self-proclaimed "Prince-Admiral" Delak Krennel took control of the region.
The Dancers' Pit was a room where the dancers living in Jabba's Palace would go to prepare to perform for Jabba the Hutt.
The Mission to Maramere was a quest undertaken by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and his newly Knighted former apprentice, Anakin Skywalker, to learn whether Asajj Ventress was still alive.
Kaachtari was an active volcano on the planet Haariden. In 26 BBY, it experienced a massive eruption, in the midst of a world-wide civil war.

The Adminidome was a location on Hologram Fun World where the planet's central operations were located; from here workers could oversee and hold control over the worldwide amusement park's many facilities.

The planet Torize was located in the system of the same name on the Trition Trade Route in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A major trade and industrial hub, the planet was orbited by numerous space stations, and spaceports littered the surface.
Shintel was a planet located in the Shintel system of the Kathol sector, which was part of the Outer Rim Territories.

Shatuun was a planet in the Kathol Outback region of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was covered in towering mountains and plagued by fierce electrical storms. It was an isolated planet, seldom visited by travelers en route to Danoor.

Q'Maere was a planet located within the Kathol Rift. The planet had a deadly, poisonous atmosphere, full of chlorine, and the sky was a sickly green. The majority of the surface was a caustic ammonia ocean interspersed with volcanic salt-caked islands.

result: Silri freed, Imperial Governor killed, prisons destroyed
x: The Ground Battle on Dathomir occurred when Tyber Zann, obsessed with opening a Sith holocron, traveled with his lieutenant Urai Fen to Dathomir in order to find a Force-sensitive to unlock it.

Benoga was an abandoned city on the planet Vulpter in the Deep Core. At one time, it was a large, heavily populated city with significant industrial complexes, but after the intervention of the Trade Federation, Benoga became deserted.
Basin was the largest continent of the planet Lenthalis. It contained Hreas Port City.

The Raider was a Gladius-class light freighter owned by Sith Acolyte Jor Torlin, an agent of Sith Intelligence and Assassination. He took it to the Wheel in 137 ABY as part of his mission to capture Cade Skywalker.
The Thor was a Strike-class medium cruiser in the service of the Rebel Alliance. The ship was part of a convoy along with the Zeus and the Odysseus.
The Zeus was a MC40a light cruiser used by the Rebel Alliance.
The Odysseus was an MC80 Star Cruiser belonging to the Rebel Alliance.
The Sicorro was a Nebulon-B2 frigate under the service of the Galactic Empire. She arrived at Depot XLS for repairs but was also attacked by B-wing starfighters from the Rebel Alliance.
Earth was one of the four android creations of the Keeper. He had the ability to manipulate earth.
Wind was one of the four android creations of the Keeper. She had the ability to manipulate wind.
Fire was one of the four android creations of the Keeper. He had the ability to manipulate fire.
Ice Mountain was a mountain on the forest moon of Endor. It was described as being fairly far away and in an isolated location.

result: Shaman victory, Stagorr imprisoned in Ice Mountain
x: The skirmish on Endor was a conflict on the forest moon of Endor between the Ewok shaman Logray and the Ice Demon Stagorr. The duel took place on the slopes of Ice Mountain and pitted the Force powers of the two warriors against each other.
The Straasa was an Ton-Falk-class escort carrier used by the Galactic Empire.

The Manticore was a Strike-class medium cruiser belonging to the Empire. It was scheduled to be repaired at Depot XLS, but was attacked by Rebel B-wing starfighters intending to destroy all the capital ships while they were at their weakest condition.
The Lion was a Nebulon-B2 frigate belonging to the Rebel Alliance. Along with the Lance and the Ornik, the Lion was to commence an attack on the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Conqueror.

The Lance was a Nebulon-B2 frigate belonging to the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She, along with the Lion and the Ornik, were to commence an attack on the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Conqueror.

Around 1 BBY, Zann Consortium forces, led by Tyber Zann, decided to kidnap the Supreme Strategist from above Mandalore in an act of piracy. Hiding in an asteroid field above the planet, the Consortium fighters destroyed the Mandalorian V-wings waiting there.
Jarnollen was a planet in close proximity to Ord Mantell in the Mid Rim. It was covered in tropical jungle, and its trees possessed overgrown vines.
The Bright Tree Fête was a large festival held at Bright Tree Village. The Tumble bunny Brainer had a popular show there.

Sunshine Lake was a body of water on the forest moon of Endor. Devil serpents were known to occupy its waters. At the bottom of the lake was an Underwater Kingdom inhabited by a species of underwater dwellers.

9-A9, also known as Nynie, was a droid owned by the nobles of Eiattu 6. It looked after Princess Isplourrdacartha Estillo when she was a child. Seven months after the Battle of Endor, 9-A9 accompanied Grand Duke Gror Pernon and Poe to meet with Rogue Squadron.
New Republic Intelligence was the primary Intelligence agency of the New Republic.

A skirmish on Nal Hutta occurred when Zann Consortium forces decided to kidnap the Hutt spaceport director Tanda to corrupt Nal Hutta to further Tyber Zann's plans. Urai Fen and some Defilers landed on the planet and fought their way past various Hutt forces.
The Triumphant-class dark trooper was a variant of the dark trooper, a deadly next-generation stormtrooper battle droid used by the Galactic Empire.
A skirmish over Mandalore occurred when Tyber Zann decided to perform an act of piracy to extort ships from Mandal Hypernautics.
Vintrus was a planet located in the Manda Sector in the Mid Rim.

The Strident was a Nebulon-B2 frigate under the command of Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin during his attempted coup d'état. It was disabled and destroyed by the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Courageous. Maarek Stele was involved in the operation.

The Thunderer was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer which served under rogue Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin. She helped destroy the Star Destroyer Courageous. Her fate following Zaarin's defeat is unknown.
Gilded Lily was a yacht owned by Rollo Morsai. She converted the space yacht into a freighter to earn credits after she was blacklisted from the acting profession.
The Riff-Raff was a modified Gymsnor-3 light freighter owned and operated by Korkeal Hai. The Riff-Raff could often be found hauling freight in the Minos Cluster.

Adascopolis was the ancient capital of the Colonies planet Arkania and the ancestral seat of the House of Adasca, a rich and powerful family that ran The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania, or Adascorp.

objective: Fight Rebel activity
x: Operation Molecular Clamp was one of the firsts of the small operations that were led by Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader against the increasing activity of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, in 1 ABY.

x: Operation Sieve was one of the small operations that were led by Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader against the increasing activity of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, in 1 ABY.

objective: Eliminate Alliance Special Forces agents
x: Operation Green Light was one of the firsts of the small operations that were led by Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader against the increasing activity of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, in 1 ABY.

objective: Eliminate Alliance Special Forces agents
x: Operation Take Down was one of the small operations that were led by Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader against the increasing activity of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, in 1 ABY.

t: Wedding of Wicket Wystri Warrick and Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka
x: The Wedding of Wicket Wystri Warrick and Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka took place sometime after the Battle of Endor, shortly after the death of Chief Chirpa.

The "technology-deficient planet" was a technologically primitive planet inhabited by Humans, or Near-Humans. Their technology had not developed beyond the use of horses, slugthrowers, and metal swords. They had no advanced technology whatsoever.

Quarfs were shapeshifting creatures that had the ability to fly and send signals through a horn on the middle of their foreheads. The only known quarf was seen on the forest moon of Endor, nicknamed "Silky" by young Ewoks from Bright Tree Village.
The Firrereo genocide was initiated by the Galactic Empire through the Procurator of Justice Hethrir to wipe out all life forms on the planet Firrerre, particularly the sentient Firrerreo.
Vryssa was a planet located within the Vryssa system of the Outer Rim Territories that hosted an Imperial garrison base. Buldobeasts were commonly found on this planet.
Brine-eels were a large non-sentient species of eel that lived in salt water.
The Revanchists, also known as the Jedi Crusaders, were a renegade faction of the Jedi Order who assisted the Galactic Republic during the Mandalorian Wars.

Zandor was a barren desert land on the forest moon of Endor that was home to Ogres as well as the sentient rock-like creatures known as Zandor Rockers. Zandor was separated from Ewok lands by the Gorge of Fire, which could only be traversed via the legendary Rainbow Bridge.
Belshain was a northern island-continent on the planet Kabaira, located in the Teilcam system.
Madieri was a northern island-continent on the planet Kabaira, in the Teilcam system.
Eponte Spaceport was the capital city and main spaceport of Kabaira in the Teilcam system in the Outer Rim Territories. Drayhar's Cantina was located in the spaceport.

The New Plympto resistance was the Nosaurian resistance against the forces of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars and, following the Battle of New Plympto, the forces of the Galactic Empire took control of New Plympto.
A minor skirmish took place in the Froz system in 27 ABY, when a Jedi squadron was seeking to acquire voxyn for study.

The assault on Arkania was a battle of the Yuuzhan Vong War in 27 ABY, when the Wild Knights attempted to capture a Yuuzhan Vong yammosk for study while simultaneously disrupting the Yuuzhan Vong plan to invade Arkania.
The Stardream was a passenger liner that was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Pendarran's Revenge was an armed organization formed by Kolor Delan that fought against the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
The Obvious Nirvana was a starship which was destroyed.
Acid rats were a species of rodent that inhabited craters.
Dorande was the homeworld of the Dorande race, who tried to conquer the planet R-Duba. This plan was foiled by C-3PO and R2-D2, however.

Wizards of the Night Spirit were followers of the Night Spirit who were formerly from the Forest Moon of Endor. They came into conflict with the Ewoks, who banished the wizards from Endor to another world.
An Alderaanian swan was a creature from Alderaan.
The Gorge of Fire was a long, broad and deep canyon on the forest moon of Endor that separated the forests of the Ewoks from the land of Zandor.
Quork City was the village of the Quorks on Endor. It consisted of many caves dug out of large rocks. The city was ruled by King Marlox.
Thrantin, or OM813, was the planet headquarters of Barosa Warren and the Galactic Outdoor Survival School. It was located in the Ollonir Boundaries of the Colonies.

A venom rat was a type of venomous rat that could be found in swamps. In 3 ABY, the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick fled from the alien woodsmen Rok and Zol after discovering the alien's plot of cutting down the Ewok's forest on the moon of Endor for processing.

Jerne City H.Q was an Imperial military base located on Jerne. It was under the command of Captain Ryko Vant during the Galactic Civil War, and once hosted the Sith Lord Darth Vader when he visited Jerne trying to hunt down Rebel leaders Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa.
The glop pits was a large swamp on the forest moon of Endor in between Bright Tree Village and the thorn forest. It was the home of the glok monsters and apparently gave off a foul odor.
The Thorn Forest was a large forest on the forest moon of Endor and location of the Stone Circle, a ritual location of the Wizards of the Night Spirit.
Infiltrators were a special unit of soldiers trained by Beri Tulon to cut their way into Imperial armored vehicles, especially walkers, and take control.
A capsule carried the Stranger to the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, two moons near Endor aligned, and a rift in space opened, through which the capsule traveled.

The Hapan Royal Court was the extended royal household in the Hapes Consortium that advised the Queen Mother on issues that were important. Membership included representatives from each planet in the Hapan Consortium.
Kaastoag were scavenging creatures with stingers and tentacles used by the Yuuzhan Vong to clean food waste from the floors of their mess halls.

Harpy was a Nebulon-B2 frigate serving the Galactic Empire. The frigate was present at the attack on the Gelgelar system where it attempted to attack the Liberty. Harpy was destroyed by Rebel B-wing starfighters.
The Stormclaw was a Star Destroyer in service to the Galactic Empire.

conflict: Battle Plan Coruscant, Yuuzhan Vong War
x: The Battle of Reecee was a battle of 27 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Part of Tsavong Lah's Battle Plan Coruscant, the Yuuzhan Vong force took Reecee to use as a staging area for the attack on Coruscant, enabling them to bypass the Bilbringi Shipyards.

t: Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; First)
conflict: Battle Plan Coruscant, Yuuzhan Vong War
x: The Battle of Borleias was a battle of 27 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War. As part of Tsavong Lah's Battle Plan Coruscant, Yuuzhan Vong forces took Borleias to use as a staging area for the attack on Coruscant, enabling them to bypass the Bilbringi Shipyards.
Gatags were shelled creatures used by the Yuuzhan Vong to make ceremonial platters.
Shockapedes were a species of insect used by the Yuuzhan Vong that resembled worms with legs. They resided in hives and were known to be dangerous.
Trout were a kind of fish on the forest moon of Endor. The native Ewoks would sometimes go fishing to catch trout to eat. A fur-bearing variety existed on Paulking XIV.

conflict: Battle Plan Coruscant, Yuuzhan Vong War
x: A battle took place in 27 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Following the Yuuzhan Vong capture of Reecee, a small number of surviving New Republic ships accompanied the Errant Venture to the secret Eclipse Station, a Jedi base in the Deep Core.

The anti-Sith conspiracy was a plot carried out by several high-ranking members of the Galactic Empire in 1 BBY. Led by Grand Moff Trachta, the conspiracy attempted to overthrow the Sith leaders of the Empire—Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader.

The wizards of the Night Spirit were banished to an extra-dimensional world by the Ewoks from the Forest Moon of Endor. The world was a devastated wasteland filled with bones of dead animals and no vegetation.

The Yagaran aleudrupe plant was a species of plant with pink shoots and that grew edible berries which were considered a delicacy on many planets. Gamgalon used them and two other legal chemicals in order to make a gas that could be used much like Tibanna gas.

The rdava-bird was a species of brightly colored bird native to the planet Garqi. They were small, no larger than the hand of a Human, and had orange and red plumage. Rdava-birds were commonly found in Vlassy Nature Preserve, where they were admired by visiting tourists.
The Gallant was a Ton-Falk-class escort carrier.
The Lightning was a Nebulon-B2 frigate that was part of Task Force Vengeance. It was involved in the failed attempt to destroy a rebel convoy intending to deliver B-wing starfighters to the Liberty.
The Damocles was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that was part of Task Force Vengeance. It was involved in the failed attempt to destroy a Rebel convoy intending to deliver B-wings to the Liberty.

t: Battle of Bright Tree Village (Stranger War)
x: The Battle of Bright Tree Village was the initial battle of the Stranger War between the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village and the Duloks.
The Battle of Thorn Forest was the final battle of the Stranger War resulting in the permanent banishment of the Wizards of the Night Spirit from the forest moon of Endor.

The Dulok Swamp was the home of the Dulok tribe under King Gorneesh. It contained several hollowed out trees which served as the homes for the Duloks as well as a main plaza centered that served as a meeting area and fire pit on cold nights.

The Scourge was an Imperial Victory I-class Star Destroyer that was active and well known in the Darpa sector of the Core Worlds by 0 ABY. Manufactured by Rendili StarDrive, the Scourge was 900 meters in length.
The Forgofshar Desert was a location on Carida. When the Imperial military established a base on the planet, they used the desert for survival training.
Ressl River was a river located on the planet Carida.

result: Nagai operative Durne uncovered and captured/
x: The skirmish in the Cantros system was a preliminary skirmish of the Nagai–Tof invasion of 4 ABY.

The Treespirit was a Ghtroc Class 720 freighter owned by the Wookiee pirate Grakkata. Painted a forest green in remembrance of the Wookiee homeworld, the craft appeared battered, but was extensively modified and heavily-armed with four retractable laser cannons.
The planet of Binquaros was located in the Ciutric sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

conflict: Battle Plan Coruscant, Yuuzhan Vong War
x: A battle at the Black Bantha Nebula took place in 27 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Following the Yuuzhan Vong capture of Reecee, Han and Leia Organa Solo scouted the Black Bantha, a dangerous nebula that was immune to sensors and located on the hyperroute between Reecee and…
a: Battle of the Black Bantha Nebula

x: Diptera maggots were used by Yuuzhan Vong shapers to eat away decaying flesh following Escalation ceremonies.

The Meteor Racer was one of the 600 refugee starships that were trapped on Coruscant when the Yuuzhan Vong invaded. The Yuuzhan Vong used these ships and their passengers as Human shields in the Battle of Coruscant.
YVH 1-302A was a YVH 1 droid stationed at Orbital Defense Headquarters during the Battle of Coruscant.
The Thirteenth Imperial Diplomatic Conclave was a meeting of the leaders of pro-Imperial worlds in 0 ABY hosted by Thalassa Tarkin on the world of Phelarion in Port Tarkin.

x: The Battle of Altyr V was one of the first conflicts between the New Republic and the Dark Empire. It was a part of the Operation Shadow Hand campaign.
Gate 3700 was the area of Eastport, Coruscant, that contained Docking Bay 3732 and Docking Bay 3733.

Kastin, also known as OM811, was a barren rock planet with no moons. It occupied the closest orbital position around the red giant star Thrantin Major in the Thrantin OM81-A system, a part of the Ollonir Boundaries in the Negs portion of the Colonies.

Rantorin, also known as OM812, was a barren rock planet with two moons. It occupied the second closest orbital position around the red giant star Thrantin Major in the Thrantin OM81-A system, a part of the Ollonir Boundaries in the Negs portion of the Colonies.

Hirin, also known as OM814, was a barren rock planet with two moons. It occupied the fourth and outermost orbit around the red giant star Thrantin Major in the Thrantin OM81-A system, a part of the Ollonir Boundaries in the Negs portion of the Colonies.

Frewwil was a planet located in the Frewwil system, a part of the freestanding subsectors portion of the Expansion Region. An inhospitable world, Frewwil was explored by the Republic Survey Corps scout Barosa Warren.

Theal was a planet situated in the Theal system, a part of the freestanding subsectors portion of the Mid Rim. It was an inhospitable world that was explored by the Republic Survey Corps scout Barosa Warren.

The Kath subjugation was the conquest of the ocean-covered world Kath II by the Galactic Empire. It used a number of the then-new Aquadon CAVa 400 aquatic attack vehicles to make underwater attacks against the forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, who had taken up po…

Golh was a planet located within the Golh system of the Outer Rim Territories. An aquatic planet, it was owned by Hydrospeare Corporation, who used Golh as a test site for its aquatic projects, commonly aquatic weapons and military vehicles.

result: Rebel officer Mosara Thiirn deserted the Rebel Alliance
x: The Battle of Archais was a conflict between three Rebel SpecForce units and an alliance between Imperial forces and the Assassin's Guild.
The staplarint was an arboreal omnivore. Staplarints were introduced to the planet Brosi by Republic settlers.

The Bay of Sypon was a body of water on the planet Brosi. The West Reyno River emptied into the Bay, and locations along the coastline included the city of Rann, the Shoengen Coast, and the Shoengen Delta.
Nightcast was a Stalwart-class freighter originally owned by Karu Nelbin.
Tory's Catcher was an Imperial Immobilizer 418 cruiser.
Luj City was located on the planet Novor 23 of the Outer Rim Territories' Tharin sector. It was an important financial center of the sector and also included the seedy East Side district.
The Waterspire was a Mon Calamari Simiyiar-class light freighter.
The Mapuzo break-in was an event that occurred on the world Mapuzo by or in 2 ABY.
Mist Laden was bounty hunter Lu'daal-ud's personal ship, in use by his associates of the Granse Confederacy. Lu'daal-ud captured the original owner, an independent trader, in the Imberlin system.
YVH 1-32A was one of the YVH 1 droids that helped Ba'tra clean out the Byrt while looking for Ben Skywalker.

YVH 1-25A was a YVH 1 combat droid developed by Tendrando Arms. It accompanied YVH 1-1A onto the vessel Byrt during the evacuation of Coruscant to rescue C-3PO and Ben Skywalker and was destroyed in the attempt by a singularity mine.
The Natalon Core Bandits were a ruthless group of alien pirates active during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
Ni'Shaw-Dak Ministry was a religious body within the Jydan religion of the indigenous Ka'hren on V'shar.
The Ruori was a flying animal native to the planet Zuliria. It was used as a personal transport in the planet's cities.
The Ocsin, also known as the Ocsinin, were a near-Human species with white skin and black, pupilless eyes that hailed from the Wild Space celestial body Farana.
The Venithon Twins were two Ithorian pirates operating in the Rebellion era.
The Venithon Bandit was the Ghtroc Industries 580 freighter used by the pirate organization Venithon Twins.

The Kliap Pirates was a pirate organization that was active during the Galactic Civil War. They were infamous for the flashy raids they carried out in the Kliap sector. The Venithon Twins worked for this organization for a time.

The Bandits of Ggy-ynt were a pirate organization that originated in the Ggy-ynt system of the Mid Rim's Esuain sector. At some point by 2 ABY, the Ithorian pirate twins Denuab and Dorin—known as the Venithon Twins—had been members of the Bandits of Ggy-ynt.
The Yarnak Gang was a pirate organization during the Rebellion era.
The Fivaran Organization was a pirate organization during the Rebellion era.

The Hy'thor Group was a pirate organization operating in Mieru'kar sector during the Rebellion era, led by the Nalroni criminal Ompiach. Under Ompiach's command, a leadership council managed the group's affairs.
The most common race, Y'tras, composed the 87% of the Shatras population. They were technologically advanced and commonly traveled through spacelanes, having colonies in different worlds.
The second most common race after Y'tras, Hy'tras, composed the 10% of the Shatras population.
The Mytaranor Slaving Council was a slaving group operating in the Mytaranor sector during the Galactic Civil War.
The Vanquisher was a modified Kiltirin-class dungeon ship used as a mobile headquarters for the Mytaranor Slaving Council.
Ploovo's Protocol Team was a criminal group that worked for crime lord Ploovo Two-For-One.
HN-TR1 was an HN-TR assassin/combat droid prototype of unknown design and mysterious background.
EV-4D9 was a MerenData EV-series supervisor droid that was part of Ploovo's Protocol Team.

The Ironhand was High Inquisitor Mox Slosin's personal ship. A modified Merkuni Drives Trenchant-class cruiser, it was used by Slosin personally to patrol the Lesser Plooriod Cluster looking for Rebel activity.

Hewl was an astronomical object located within the Hewl system, a part of the Mid Rim's Eidoloni sector. Karap Valley was located on Hewl, and it featured fog banks that were considered to be infamous by the Rebel Alliance Lieutenant Colonel Palpatine Essex Yerac.
Rya was a celestial body situated in the Rya system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Kwymar sector. It was the homeworld of the Human Cinto Alaras.
Tauber was an Inner Rim world that lay on the Rimma Trade Route super-hyperroute. In 214 BBY, an antidote to the disease known as the Bordal Contagion was created on Tauber.
Zol-Uvena was one of the ships used by Shistavanen scout Yurdak Fav. It had been modifed to be more maneuverable and had a different weapon system than normally installed on the model.

Arporatal-Lanin was a rugged world located in the Arporatal-Lanin system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane connected it to the Thull's Vault system.
Nul was a city on the planet Zelos II. It was the second largest city on the planet after Kryndyn, and was named in honor of Mandated Commander of the People of Zelos Galleros Nul.
The Valley of the Winds was located near Jabba's Palace on Tatooine. A canyon located between two deserts, one high and cool, the other low and hot.
The Hidden Daggers were a pirate organization active in the Corellian system at the time of the Galactic Civil War.

The Galactic Vacant Building Demolishing Movement, or G.V.B.D.M. for short, was a civil movement conceived by Colonel Braedic Ekirk. They would spot abandoned buildings and report their location to the Galactic Empire so they could be demolished. The G.V.B.D.M.
M'Bardi was a water planet located in the Kalamith sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was also the site of the M'Bardi Prison.

Lankashiir was a planet of the Lankashiir system, which was located along the Quellor Run hyperlane within the Colonies and the Slice regions of the galaxy. During the Imperial Era, Lankashiir was under the control of the Galactic Empire.
The Penetrator was a Star Destroyer under construction at Kuat Drive Yards for the Imperial Navy in 3 ABY.
The Inflexible was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer.
The Indomitable was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer.
The Exterminator was a Star Destroyer being manufactured in 3 ABY for the Imperial Navy by Kuat Drive Yards.

The Long Run was a Rebel Alliance barge piloted by Boo Rawl. In 3 ABY, it was used to steal a Colony Class 23669 power generator from the Galactic Empire on Kuat while disguised as an Imperial barge, 36DD.
Bhillen was a type of animal that could be eaten by Humans. It could be stewed,, roasted, or used to a prepare a sandwich.

Atron's Mistress was a custom Zuraco Cargo Hauler owned by the Karazak Slavers Cooperative and used to transport slaves around the galaxy. The ship was commandeered by the Red Moons while on Gabredor III after destroying the Karazak base there and freeing the slaves.
The Ironhand was an Imperial Strike-class medium cruiser that served as part of Task Force Vengeance during the Galactic Civil War. It was escorting part of the Task Force's convoy.
The Tyrant was an Ton-Falk-class escort carrier serving with the Imperial Navy.
The Pincer was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that was part of Task Force Vengeance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Fang was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that was part of Task Force Vengeance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Abolisher was an Imperial Ton-Falk-class escort carrier that was part of Task Force Vengeance.
The Hyperion was a Ton-Falk-class escort carrier that was part of Task Force Vengeance during the Galactic Civil War.

The Talon was an Strike-class medium cruiser that was part of Task Force Vengeance. It was part of the group of reinforcements that were pulled out of hyperspace by the Rebel Alliance Modified Strike Cruiser Peregrine and was destroyed along with the rest of the group by the R…

The Subjugator was a Nebulon-B2 frigate that was part of Task Force Vengeance. She was part of the group of reinforcements that were pulled out of Hyperspace by the Rebel Modified Strike Cruiser Peregrine and was destroyed along with the rest of the group by the Rebels.

Grenadiers were members of the Royal Naboo Security Forces who used ion grenades as their primary weapon and wore red uniforms similar to the Queen's Palace Guard. Other grenade troopers were the thermal detonator troopers who used mortar to shoot thermal detonators.
The Iopene Princess was a Mining Guild cutter. She was outfitted with a state-of-the-art hyperdrive as well as various scanners and probes.

Black Epsilon was an Imperial squadron that performed covert tasks that were too sensitive, or too small for the Imperial Navy to handle. Black Epsilon answered directly to the Emperor. It was one of the few Imperial units that made use of a large number of non-Humans.

Constant was a colony ship that, along with Mother Vima, served as a support starship for the colony ship Beneficent Tasia. In approximately 3900 BBY, the three ships departed the planet Grizmallt in an expedition to the dangerous southern quadrant of the galaxy.

Beneficent Tasia was a colony ship that departed the planet Grizmallt in approximately 3900 BBY in an expedition to seek fortune and glory. Beneficent Tasia was accompanied by its support ships, Constant and Mother Vima.

The Borleias was a New Republic troop transport based on Folor. When Admiral Apwar Trigit attacked the base, the transport was delayed in evacuating by an engine malfunction. Luckily for the crew, the newly-formed Wraith Squadron was able to buy time for them to escape.

80-Vag was the starship of Mugaari pirate Icanis Tsur. The ship, manned by a crew of thirty in addition to the captain, was destroyed in the Hoth asteroid field sometime after the Galactic Empire's rise to power.
Nippers were carnivorous creatures native to Lutrillia, a planet which was located in the Yarith sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Hapes Transit Authority was the traffic control agency that monitored as well as directed the vast amount of starship traffic around Hapes. It handled roughly 2,000 starships per day.
Katraasii was a planet in Outer Rim Territories.
The toccat was a species native to the jungle planet Darlyn Boda. The creatures had four hooves, long pink snouts, and black-furred bodies.

The Kondrus Sea was an algae-covered sea on the planet Drongar. The Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7 was located near the sea before the unit moved to the Jasserak Highlands near the Qarohan Steppes around eighty kilometers southeast.

U-THR, also known as Uthre, was a protocol droid owned by a free-trader named Crimson. A 3PO Human-cyborg relations protocol droid, U-THR was of a slightly more bulky build than the standard 3PO model. It had the prissy character traits that were typical of 3PO droids.

The Sudden Restoration was a Carosite-built and operated hospital ship that saw service throughout the Galactic Civil War, offering free health care to all beings, regardless of political affiliation.
Storm was a CR90 corvette used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Its mission was to capture Ilay, who was on her Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser Kala'din.

Ignat was a CR90 corvette used by the Airam. It was part of the joint-operation that was attacked by rival Airam clan leader Ilay and the Imperial-class Star Destroyer, Wasp. Fortunately, the operation was a success and Ignat escaped into hyperspace.
The Libra was a Rebel CR90 corvette active during the Galactic Civil War. It carried the technicians who outfitted the CR90 corvette Ram's Head with the experimental Shield X.
The Imperial Engineers Academy, also known as the Imperial Engineering Academy, was a prestigious Imperial engineering school.
The Tremendous was an Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship that served the Republic Navy during the Mandalorian Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian warrior clans.
The Laser Flits or Laserflits were a gang which operated out of a bunker on the edge of Mos Espa, a city located on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Echo Flight was a squadron in the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps paired with Delta Flight.
CX-03 was a cargolift vessel in the Republic Navy during the Mandalorian Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian warrior clans.
CX-09 was a cargolift vessel in the Republic Navy during the Mandalorian Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian warrior clans.
CX-14 was a cargolift vessel in the Republic Navy during the Mandalorian Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian warrior clans.
Perspicacity was a cruiser in the Republic Navy during the Mandalorian Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian warrior clans.
Grubstake was a civilian supply vessel that was active during the era of the Mandalorian Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian warrior clans.
Queen of Taris was a civilian spaceliner that was active during the era of the Mandalorian Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian warrior clans.
Mount Berin was a mountain on the planet Garos IV. It was located on the outskirts of Zila.
Cloud Mountain was the highest mountain on the planet Cularin, located generally to the north of Gadrin and Hedrett. Its peak was always covered with clouds, which inspired its name.

The Icarii Campaign was the Galactic Empire's effort to subdue the native Icarii on Vestar. It was led by the Lightning Battalion under the command of General Nim and Colonel Abal Karda.

The Crystal Canyons of Chandrila were an enormous gallery of natural formations made out of rock and crystals, which formed a tight trench, with an abyss below it. The caverns were the site of the burial of the third Barsen'thor of the Jedi Order.
Mount Moggar was a mountain on the planet of Naalol.

Mount Ganton was a mountain in the northern continent of the planet Shalm. A steep cliff on its western side was the site of an Imperial garrison that was later abandoned and used as a base of operations by Pendarran's Revenge.

Mount Meru was a mountain on the planet Drogheda. It was the location of the Mount Meru Mine and was the temporary headquarters of a revolutionary group that waged war with the reigning monarchy in 4 ABY.

objective: Investigate death of Urlor Sette
x: A mission to the planet Commenor took place in 9 ABY, shortly after the death of Grand Admiral Thrawn.
Vrosynri 8 was a minor world in the Ciutric Hegemony.

t: Wedding of Nrin Vakil and Koyi Komad
x: The Wedding of Nrin Vakil and Koyi Komad took place sometime between the end of the Thrawn campaign and the start of the Yuuzhan Vong War. Anki Pace and Corran Horn were among the attendees, as presumably were other members of Rogue Squadron.
The Xulropic Badlands were on Tatooine. They separated the Audessian Expanse from the Western Dune Sea.
The Audessian Expanse was a region on Tatooine. On the opposite side of the Xulropic Badlands from the Western Dune Sea, they were on the border of the planet's habitable zone.
The Lijarak Mines Incident occurred on the celestial body Anic. Alliance operative Larq Thur was killed during the incident.
Sardoran, at one point known as Ord Sardoran, was a world located in the Sardoran system, a part of the Arrowhead, or the Slice portion of the Core Worlds.

Kinun Depot was a location where the Rodian slaver Malak made a stop sometime before 0 ABY, to refuel her ship. During this time her captured prey, Myo, escaped from his custody. Myo then met the musician Lirin Car'n, and the two became associates.
The attack on the Pirik system was an Imperial attack during the Galactic Civil War.
Tartaglia was a planet located in the Tartaglia system, a part of the Hollan sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim.
The Cannibal was Barosa Warren's personal starship while he was the manager of the Galactic Outdoor Survival School.
The j'kuutak was a riding animal used as a mount on Guiteica. Major-Guardian Aul Tarrus Vishav was skilled at riding a j'kuutak.
Noble was a Invincible-class Dreadnaught of the Republic Navy. This vessel was significant in that its Human crew all had natural green hair. Noble was lost centuries before the time of the Empire.
The Battle of Palanhi was a battle in the Clone Wars in which the Confederacy of Independent Systems deployed their Scorpenek annihilator droids to ensure a victory.
The Battle of Formos was a battle in the Clone Wars the CIS won with their Colicoid Annihilator Droids.

The Tarisian Season Opener, also referred to as the Great Swoop Race, was a swoop race held annually in the Lower City of the planet Taris, and was implied to be funded by Czerka Corporation and, later, Lhosan Industries before Czerka Corporation re-established themselves as t…
Red Squadron was the training unit formed by members of Rogue Squadron in 9 ABY, to learn how to use TIE Defenders.

conflict: Galactic Civil War (Hegemony theater/Imperial Civil War)
x: The Battle of Distna was a battle in the campaign against Delak Krennel's Ciutric Hegemony. Rogue Squadron, along with a snoopscoot, were scouting the moon Distna, believing it to be where the Pulsar Station was being made.

The Battle of Shaylin 18 was a crucial battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire that took place at Shaylin 18 after the Battle of Yavin. The victorious rebel forces were commanded by Captain Vanden Willard.

Intentions was a section of Alliance Intelligence. It interpreted and analyzed all information gathered by Alliance Intelligence and attempted to predict the intentions and moves of the Galactic Empire.
Liaq was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Core Worlds' Liaq system. At some point by 2 ABY, the Rebel Alliance officer Beryl Chiffonage encountered a group of mercenaries on Liaq.
KT-18 (or "Kate") was a housekeeping droid that was purchased by Luke Skywalker at the Droidfest on Tatooine, intending to give it as a housewarming gift to his friend Han Solo.
Swivven was one of the four continents located on the jungle moon of Yavin 4. It was named by scout Lile Gorsek.
Koos was one of the four continents located on the jungle moon of Yavin 4. It was named by scout Lile Gorsek.

Sarlacc's Peak was a location in the Carbon Score Wastes on Socorro, surrounded by the city of Killee-Kor. During the timeframe of the Second Imperial Civil War, the pirate Rav docked his ship, the Crimson Axe, within the peak.

Swift was a freighter in service to the Galactic Empire. It was this ship that took Ysanne Isard and her team of commandos to the Bilbringi Shipyards in 9 ABY in her attempt to recapture the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Lusankya. The ship was commanded by Captain Wintle.
