Zabba II was a planet located within the Zabba system of the Outer Rim Territories and
CZ-12-R was the old protocol droid that belonged to Cal Omas during his time as a senator.
YVH-M-1 was a YVH-M droid that worked with Mara Jade Skywalker in clearing out a cell of Yuuzhan Vong infiltrators from Mon Calamari in 28 ABY.
Mester Reef was a gigantic coral reef located near Heurkea Floating City on Mon Calamari.
The Gu-vandi were a sentient species. They were governed by the Gu-vandi Collective, and their area of space included the world Praven Prime, home to the L'Xing species.

The New Republic conducted a raid on Yuuzhan Vong-occupied Wayland in 28 ABY. The goal was to train new recruits in combat that the New Republic was sure to win, in preparation for a decisive major battle later on.

The New Republic raided on Yuuzhan Vong-occupied Gyndine in 28 ABY. The goal was to train new recruits in combat that the New Republic was sure to win, in preparation for a decisive major battle later on.

The New Republic raided on Yuuzhan Vong–occupied Bimmisaari in 28 ABY. The goal was to train new recruits in combat that the New Republic was sure to win, in preparation for a decisive major battle later on.

The New Republic raided on Yuuzhan Vong-occupied Nal Hutta in 28 ABY. The goal was to train new recruits in combat that the New Republic was sure to win, in preparation for a decisive major battle later on. It is unknown if the Hutt underground also participated in the battle.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: Ebaq Control was the military control established by the New Republic at Ebaq 9 in preparation for the Battle of Ebaq 9.

After the Second Battle of Obroa-skai, the damaged New Republic ship Far Thunder was allowed to limp back to the staging area at Kashyyyk with minimal assistance. En route, it was intercepted by Yuuzhan Vong fighters and attacked.

The Starlite Cloud was a Sullustan cruise liner that visited Brentaal in 6 BBY. During its stopover there, the twelve-year-old Platt Okeefe joined the crew as a cabin steward. She worked on the ship for two years before leaving for another job.
The Ravelev was a tramp freighter captained by Kassler, that plied the Anarid Cluster.

Pok's Demise was a freighter owned by the smuggler Platt Okeefe. Her Twi'lek friend, Tru'eb Cholakk, helped secure the finances for the ship, which Okeefe named after her former boss at the Klatooinian Trade Guild, Pok Nar-Ten.

Voorlach was a planet located within the Voorlach system of the Colonies with a Klatooinian Trade Guild presence. It was here that Platt Okeefe became impressed with the workings of the Trade Guild and resolved to join them in order to earn her first freighter.
Colada was a Nebulon-B2 frigate used by the Rebel Alliance. It attempted to evacuate the Goff Platform.
The Dauntless was a Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy of the Fel Empire; though following the coup orchestrated by the One Sith it became part of the Sith Empire's fleet.
Ghazakl worms were non-sentient annelids native to the planet Yuuzhan'tar, the homeworld of the sentient Yuuzhan Vong species.

conflict: Galactic Civil War (Imperial Task Force Vengeance)
result: Imperial victory; Rebel data acquired by Imperial forces
x: The Attack on Soren was a space battle between elements of the Galactic Empire's Task Force Vengeance and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The Imperial forces' mission was to uncover valuable information at a Rebel starship component facility before destroying it.
Re was a MC40a light cruiser belonging to the Rebel Alliance.
Ta was a MC40a light cruiser belonging to the Rebel Alliance.
Mount Ste'vshuulsz was a jagged mountain located on the dark, murky planet Barab I in the Outer Rim Territories. Sheer slopes of shale rock, the mountain was home to the wild skotcarps.

Skotcarps were a species of non-sentient reptiles native to the planet Barab I. Making their home on the shale slopes of Mount Ste'vshuulsz, the skotcarps were small and fast, hiding below ground during daylight hours.
The Fest Resistance Group was a rebel organization which fought against the Imperial forces in the Atrivis sector.

The Listian Hills were a range of low mountains located on the dark, murky planet Barab I in the Outer Rim Territories. Barabel Jedi Master Saba Sebatyne and a native of Barab I often traveled to the hills in her youth.

The motor pool was a hangar in Jabba Desilijic Tiure's desert palace where his vehicles were stored. It included dozens of cargo skiffs, landspeeders, speeder bikes and the large sail barge Khetanna. Jabba's chief mechanic Barada worked and slept there.
The Moon Lady was the primary moon of the planet Askaj. However, the Askajians held the moon in such reverence that the Moon Lady was also counted as a deity.

The Saloon was a Muurian transport used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It was part of the delegation meeting between the Rebels and Dunari who arrived at the meeting in the Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 Raw Deal.
Cerebus was a Nebulon-B2 frigate belonging to the Galactic Empire. It was under the command of Captain Monfre and had TIE Avengers from Avenger squadron carried aboard.
Lament was a Strike-class medium cruiser belonging the Galactic Empire. The Lament along with Corrupter was part of the attack on Dunari's Casino and was destroyed by Rebel B-wing starfighters.
IM4-821 was a Mark IV sentry droid. A holorecording made by IM4-821 was used at the murder trial of Cornelius Evazan.
IM4-822 was a Mark IV sentry droid. A holorecording made by IM4-822 was used at the murder trial of Doctor Cornelius Evazan.
IM4-823 was a Mark IV sentry droid. A holorecording made by IM4-823 was used at the murder trial of Cornelius Evazan.
The feral bantha was a subspecies of the bantha from the planet of Talasea.
A battle in the Duro system took place in 29 ABY, near the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War. It was a failed attempt by the Galactic Alliance to reclaim the planet Duro from the Yuuzhan Vong.

D'larah was a city on the planet Demophon. During the height of the Galactic Empire, the city became very wealthy. Near the end of the Galactic Civil War, the Demophon star went supernova, devastating the Demophon system.
A battle at Fondor took place in 28 ABY, near the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War. It saw the Galactic Alliance retake the vital Fondor Shipyards that had fallen into Yuuzhan Vong hands.

The Solo-Niathal coup was a coup in 40 ABY, during the Second Galactic Civil War, against Chief of State Cal Omas by Jacen Solo which made Jacen Solo and Cha Niathal the joint Chiefs of State of the Galactic Alliance.
Kavan was a planet in the Hapes Cluster. The planet featured a maze of tunnels, which the local Kavani used as emergency homes during harsh winters.
AA-23 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle in the service of the Galactic Empire.
The Duel in The Squall occurred in 11 ABY on the planet of Yinchorr.
The Wanderhome was a Gallofree medium transport that evacuated Ranat and Ryn refugees from Gyndine after the planet was attacked by the Yuuzhan Vong.

Hornagaunts were furred, multi-stomached creatures with wings that were often clipped when domesticated. They were native to Tertiary Kesmere. Their personalities were marked by an inherent aggressiveness which made them dangerous but useful as pets.

The Daya was the name for the central grand plaza of the large Elrood Bazaar on the planet Elrood. The location served as a place where customers could mingle and move through the shops. The area was surrounded by a ring of permanent buildings known as the Perma.

P'hiili were a species of aquatic creatures that were native to the world of Yuuzhan'tar. When the sentient Yuuzhan Vong, also native to Yuuzhan'tar, invaded another galaxy, they took knowledge of the genetic makeup of the p'hiili with them.
Sea Sprite 1 was a C-3 passenger liner that carried tourists to and from various locations across the galaxy.

Refnar was a celestial body located in the Refnar system, a part of the Pakuuni sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. During the early Galactic Civil War, it was the site of a Rebel Alliance base.

Korsks were creatures used by the sentient Yuuzhan Vong species to scrub. When the Yuuzhan Vong shaper Nen Yim was younger, sometime before the Yuuzhan Vong War, in which the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong invaded a galaxy other than their own, she and a pair of crèche-mates, P'lo…

Scythis was a Strike-class medium cruiser belonging to the Galactic Empire. It was stationed at a customs station when Ace Azzameen in the YT-1300 Sabra had to pass through customs to reach Outpost 327.
Hurricane was a Strike-class medium cruiser used by the Galactic Empire. It was sent to investigate a communication array that had been attacked twice.

The sludge panther was a dangerous carnivorous predator native to the planet of Talus. The sludge panthers lived in swamps and dank jungles of Talus. They often rolled around in mud to mask its scent when hunting.
Borus was a modified Imperial Nebulon-B2 frigate that was in the service of the rogue Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin.

The Red Qurang was a yorik coral transport vessel used by the Yuuzhan Vong species during their invasion of the galaxy. Commanded by Ushk Choka, the Red Qurang traveled to the living world of Zonama Sekot to extract former Executor Nom Anor in 29 ABY.

A battle was fought at the planet Gyndine late in the Yuuzhan Vong War, two months before the Battle of Selvaris. The Galactic Alliance tried, and failed, to liberate the world. The Yuuzhan Vong took the captured Alliance soldiers to their prison camp on Selvaris.

The Zeplin was a Victory-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Galactic Empire. It was commanded by Namuura Din, an Imperial captain who followed Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's defection from the Empire shortly before the Battle of Endor.
In 9 ABY, an attack was launched on the planet Bpfassh, along with two other nearby star systems in the Sluis sector, by Grand Admiral Thrawn to lure the New Republic Defense Fleet to Bpfassh.
The Battle of Belderone occurred after Darth Vader's Star Destroyer came in orbit of Belderone to investigate Rebel unrest in the neighboring system of Kulthis.
Mamiens were large simian creatures native to Yavin 4. They were solitary creatures, shy and skittish, and difficult to approach. They also possessed a curious and casual demeanor.
Shell-bats were dangerous and deadly flying reptiles native to Geran.
AZ 380 was a Gallofree Yards, Inc. GR-75 medium transport docked to the space station Azzameen Home Base.

A battle at Selvaris took place in 29 ABY, near the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War. The Yuuzhan Vong were preparing to move a number of ranking Galactic Alliance prisoners from Selvaris to Coruscant in preparation for a major sacrifice.
AZ 556 was a Modular conveyor docked with the space station Azzameen Home Base during the Azzameen family raid on the Viraxo Industries base Viraxo 54.
AZ 7-62 was a BFF-1 bulk freighter present at the space station Azzameen Home Base the day Aeron Azzameen and Ace Azzameen inspected three compromised family cargo areas.

AZ 7-81 was a BFF-1 bulk freighter present at the Azzameen family's Home Base alongside AZ 7-62 as Ace Azzameen and Aeron Azzameen left the space station to inspect three compromised family cargo areas.
The Imperial District was an area of Coruscant.

The skirmish at Ithor was a brief battle between Han Solo in the Millennium Falcon and the Galactic Empire. Solo was able to save some Ithorians from the Empire, evade TIE Fighters, dodge asteroids, escape space slugs, and put them on the planet Bimmisaari for safety.
Resolute was an Invincible-class Dreadnaught used by the Corporate Sector Authority early on in the reign of the Galactic Empire. Its commander was Angela Krin.
The Battle of Kal'Shebbol was fought between forces loyal to Moff Kentor Sarne and the New Republic in 8 ABY.
Cyrillians were a species of tall, sentient reptiles native to the industrialized planet Cyrillia in the Expansion Region.
This unidentified planet was the site of a battle between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
The Gotal hostage standoff, one of the conflicts in the Separatist Crisis, took place on Atzerri in 22 BBY.
The Secession of Ando was one of the defining events of the Separatist Crisis, occurring on the eve of the Clone Wars in 23 BBY.
Mharsup was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Galactic Empire.
Nomlis III was a planet in the Kurdin system where the Bretie Facility, a production center for the TIE Experimental Project, orbited.

Skreegs were small mammalian humanoid creatures native to the jungle moon Yavin 4. They had short and flat ape-like heads with big eyes and a short snout. They had long limbs, and their claws served as their only natural defense.

manufacturer: Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for T

t: Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)
objective: Destroy Racto's factory
x: The Mission to Nar Shaddaa was a military operation conducted by the New Republic Intelligence Service in 14 ABY. Its primary task was to shut down an illegal assassin droid factory commissioned by Lannik Racto.
YVH 1-2r4A was a YVH 1 combat droid developed by Tendrando Arms.
Dorthus Tal Island was on Sacorria, and contained Dorthus Tal City. It was home to the prison Thrackan Sal-Solo was incarcerated in for his part in the Starbuster plot.

Kavaavik was a small flightless avian on the Yuuzhan Vong homeworld, an extra-galactic world destroyed in a devastating ancient conflict. Millennia before this event, the eyes of the kavaavik had adapted to burrowing through dark subterranean tunnels.
Tanc mites were insects native to the jungle moon Yavin 4.

Koaan was a planet near Nar Shaddaa. It was temperate and had many green hills. It was home to the Galactic Research Academy. Whenever an exploration party discovered a new planet, they sent information to this facility for processing.

The Inglenook was an annex of the Palace of the Republic on Coruscant. A spot for Mon Calamari and other aquatic species serving in the Galactic Republic to relax, the Inglenook was located directly on the Glitannai Esplanade.
Bacta Squad was a unit of the Katarn Commandos that fought near Shimrra's Citadel alongside Jeedai Heretics in the Battle of Yuuzhan'tar.
Room 212 was the housekeeping room for Jabba's palace, and was located on level three.
Level three was one of the many levels that made up Jabba's Palace. Room 212 was located on this level.

Intombe was a Strike-class medium cruiser used by the Rneekii. The Rneekii attempted to capture the Assassin-class corvette Hashim group, but thanks to Tan Maarek Stele that attempt failed. Although they did capture scientists from the shuttle G'nabgib.
The Bounty was a warship operated by the Galactic Alliance in the years following the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The Daring was a frigate operated by the Galactic Alliance in the years following the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Bronzium Squadron was a starfighter squadron consisting of X-wings that was assigned to the Galactic Alliance warship Bounty during the Second Galactic Civil War. It participated in Alliance operations monitoring Bothan fleet movements in the Bothawui system.
The Rneekii were a group of pirates from the Outer Rim Territories. Their capital ships consisted of the MC40a light cruiser Sumpntodo and the Strike-class medium cruisers Ayenzii and Intombe.
Sumpntodo was a MC40a light cruiser belonging to the Rneekii pirates.

Ayenzii was Strike-class medium cruiser used by Rneekii pirates. The strike cruiser attempted to negotiate a deal into selling a kidnapped scientist to the Galactic Empire as they were the highest bidder. But they underestimated the Empire.
HM-3 was a Legal analyst droid active in the halls of the Galactic Alliance Senate during the Second Galactic Civil War.
The Imperial Taxation Bureau was the government body under Emperor Palpatine that was responsible for collecting taxes from Imperial citizens, as well as setting tax rates.

t: Battle of Bothawui (Second Galactic Civil War)
result: Galactic Federation of Free Alliances victory
x: The Battle of Bothawui occurred as a result of intelligence provided by Colonel Jacen Solo and the Galactic Alliance Guard to the Galactic Alliance Defense Force that the Bothan military had recently purchased a new class of frigate from the Tallaani Shipyards.
Las Lagon was a minor planet in the Inner Rim seceded from the Galactic Alliance during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Beris was a minor planet in the Mid Rim seceded from the Galactic Alliance during the Second Galactic Civil War.
The Sikan (singular: Sika) were a race of sentient beings that were native to the planet of Sika. Their planet was invaded by opportunistic Chekut forces during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Kem Stor Ai was a planet located in the Tennuutta sector of the Mid Rim.
Kopsh was a Strike-class medium cruiser belonging to Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin.

This Assassin-class corvette belonged to Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin. It arrived at Red Claw location posing as the first of corvette group Chemeti, saying the second had been "delayed", as part of a ruse to pick up pirate prisoners and a TIE Defender scientist.
The Ulzepdi was a Modular conveyor belonging to the Galactic Empire.
Jester was a Carrack-class light cruiser belonging to the Rebel Alliance.

Prism was a Carrack-class light cruiser belonging to the Rebel Alliance. It was part of an operation to receive stolen TIE Defenders from Strike-class medium cruiser Nuance. While the Nuance was captured, the Prism was destroyed by Maarek Stele in a Missile Boat.
Nuance was a Strike-class medium cruiser once belonging to a Nami arms merchant before being captured by Imperial forces.

The Fantain Mountains were a location on the sandy planet Zaloriis. Due to the presence of boulders that blocked the planet's high winds, the mountains were home to small forms of animal life, along with Zalorian rock-lions.

Chollas were herd animals that grazed the plains on the planet Kal'Shebbol in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Around 392 BBY, Twi'lek settlers, escaping from slavery, domesticated the herds that roamed their adopted homeworld.
The Kathol Protector was an Ton-Falk-class escort carrier in service to Imperial warlord Moff Kentor Sarne as part of his military forces in the Kathol sector.

affiliation: Office of the Chief of State
x: The Galactic Alliance Department of Justice, also referred to as the Ministry of Justice, was a branch of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances. It was formed as a organization of the Galactic Alliance to replace its predecessor, the New Republic Ministry of Justice.
The volice worm, also known simply as the volice, was a type of unusual massive worm that at one point lived on the volcanically active, jungle-covered Unknown Regions world Lwhekk.
During the Clone Wars, a battle took place on the planet Qalydon.
The Morgath 5 was a Container transport used for backup convoy services by Imperial defector Admiral Harkov's Victory-class Star Destroyer, the Protector stationed at XQ1 Platform DS 5.
Domaz was the capital city of Kolatill, a planet on the Trition Trade Route in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Battle of Kolatill was a small engagement fought in 8 ABY at the planet Kolatill in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Nat'xikta were a small, wealthy Fefze swarm that lived on Brolsam, a planet in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Pro-Imperial, the Nat'xikta supported the world's government by spying for them, which resulted in the swarm gaining influence.
The Chekut were a race of sentient beings that were native to the Cheku system.

Enceri was a remote town on the Outer Rim world of Mandalore. A small and relatively unimportant town compared to the likes of Mandalore's capital, Keldabe, Enceri was mainly a trading post and served as the nearest supply settlement to Kyrimorut, a refuge for clone deserters …
Battle Group Serroco, also known as the Courageous battle group, was a unit within the Republic Navy that saw service during the Mandalorian Wars under the command of Admiral Saul Karath.

The Bavakar were a sentient species, members of which specialized in biological enhancements and related technologies. The species shared its name with the Bavakar Medical Research Labs company that was in business by 3956 BBY.

The Zuborte Ma asteroid field was located between the planets of Mygeeto and Itzeho, in the Mygeeto system of the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was considered an easy asteroid field to navigate since the InterGalactic Banking Clan took control of the system.
The Fxz'Et was a Ghtroc Industries 720 light freighter that had been abandoned on the planet Kal'Shebbol in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories prior to 8 ABY.
Rock beetles were six-legged insects that lived in the deserts of Tatooine. A large population of rock beetles was known to live in an area known as Rock Beetle Refuge.
The Rock Beetle Refuge was an area in the Dune Sea of Tatooine where a large population of rock beetles lived.
Cave beetles were six-legged insects that lived in the caves of Tatooine. The cook Porcellus used rock beetle and cave beetle carcasses to make beetle broth for his master, Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

The Farrow bird was indigenous to Aruza. A flying predator, the avian would use its unique bioluminescent chest to blind or stun small airborne mammals long enough to make an easy catch over the planet's valleys.
A Bomat was a carnivorous creature native to Aruza. Considered a pest, they were attracted to gobbets of flesh.

The Cularin asteroid belt was a thin asteroid belt in the Cularin system. Its asteroids were the remnants of Oblis, the jungle homeworld of the Oblee. The asteroid belt laid between the orbits of Almas and Genarius.
Triumph was a Strike-class medium cruiser belonging to the Galactic Empire.

Formidable was a Strike-class medium cruiser used by the Galactic Empire. Along with Strike cruisers Triumph, Indomitable and the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Grey Wolf it was to ambush a strike force, sent by Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin, that was supposed to ambush a conv…
Indomitable was a Strike-class cruiser used by the Galactic Empire.

Whirlwind was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser used by the Galactic Empire. It was the lead ship of Task Force Whirlwind that was supposed to arrive at a convoy that was being ambushed by Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's forces to trap them.
The Maelstrom was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser under the command of Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin.
Iron Duke was a Strike-class medium cruiser that was an escort ship for Task Force Whirlwind.
G'neeznow was a Strike-class medium cruiser that was an escort ship for Task Force Whirlwind.
Jitte was an Ton-Falk-class escort carrier under the command of Grand Admiral Zaarin.
Hoopaju was a Rebel Alliance GR-75 medium transport. In 3 ABY, while carrying weapons, it was caught by the Rage in the Airam sector.
Kala'din was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser operated by Airam clan leader Ilay during the Galactic Civil War.
Magua was a CR90 corvette operated by Airam clan leader Ilay during the Galactic Civil War.

Asp was a Strike-class medium cruiser used by the Galactic Empire. Asp and Eel were to go up against MC40a light cruisers Ta and Re. Both ships had TIE Avengers from Avenger Squadron and Assault Gunboats from Talon Squadron.

Eel was a Strike-class medium cruiser used by the Galactic Empire. Eel and Asp were to go up against MC40a light cruisers Ta and Re. Both ships had TIE Avengers from Avenger Squadron and Assault Gunboats from Talon Squadron.

Relkass was an Outer Rim Territories planet that featured an equatorial region of grasslands. The grasslands were home to the cactus known as the Relkass sentinel plant, which contained a powerful narcotic compound in its juice.
Sarne's Stormtroopers were Moff Kentor Sarne's personal stormtroopers, and operated throughout the Kathol sector during his reign.
The Des'maric Pirates operated in the Kathol sector during the early years of the New Republic.
The Asagov Raider, formerly known as the Cekbar Servant, was a Corellian Engineering Corporation Action IV transport operating during the early years of the New Republic.
The Des'maric Blastboats were a group of three GAT-12h Skipray Blastboats that were operated by the Des'maric Pirates around 8 ABY.

Lightflash Squadron was a starfighter squadron that served with the New Republic Defense Fleet. Equipped with RZ-1 A-wing interceptors, they participated in the Battle of Adumar that pitted a combination of Adumari and New Republic forces against those of the Imperial Remnant.
Zeta Hangar was a hangar onboard the Anakin Solo that Ben Skywalker docked at.
Sika was a planet in the Expansion Region that was invaded by opportunistic Chekut forces during the Second Galactic Civil War. It was home to the Sikan.

Yorn Skot mining station was a mining colony located on the planet Yorn Skot. Founded by wealthy tibanna gas magnate Clode Rhoden, it was the gas giant's main colony and had a population numbering in the thousands.

Green Forge was a group of environmental terrorists who were active in the years preceding the Battle of Naboo. The group was known for their tactics of destroying headquarters or refineries of companies that they felt had committed environmental crime.
The Pestoriv Conferences were a series of at least four conferences held during the reign of Galactic Emperor Palpatine before his death in 4 ABY.
The Fourth Pestoriv Conference was a conference that took place at some point during the reign of Galactic Emperor Palpatine before his death in 4 ABY.

The Joint Chiefs of Staff were the leaders of the various branches of the Galactic Alliance's military forces. They included the Chief of Army Operations, the Chief of Naval Operations, and the Chief of Starfighter Command.

Charbi City Spaceport was a spaceport on Vulpter. It was the location of the meeting between Cal Omas and Dur Gejjen. Gejjen was later assassinated by Ben Skywalker on behalf of the Galactic Alliance Guard.
The Galactic Alliance Treasury was the treasury department of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances. It was led by the Finance Secretary.

Karei was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. It was attacked by Strike-class medium cruiser Ull, which had TIE Avengers from Avenger Squadron as well as Assault Gunboats as backup.

Ull was a Strike-class medium cruiser that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. The warship attempted to destroy the Rebel Alliance Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser Karei, sending out its complement of TIE Avengers, from Avenger Squadron and Talon Squadron…
High Tatmana was one of the Tatmana Mountains on Morishim. The Old Recluse lived there.

Fabrillan was the capital city of the planet Malthor. It was a hotbed of activity during the Galactic Civil War. Fabrillan also had a large population of Reigats. It had a slum area, known as "Downside", where the Reigat Bakku lived.

Trailblazer was the name of Reidi Artom's scout ship. She came to own it after having stowed away on it. It was attacked, and the owner killed. Artom repaired it, flew it to a starport, and registered it under her own name.

manufacturer: Kuat Drive Yards (aided with the merged design)
x: The Deathraven was the personal starship of a mercenary pilot named Erron Kell, who constructed the ship sometime after the formation of the New Republic from two Slayn & Korpil B-wing/E2 starfighters with the help of engineers at Kuat Drive Yards.
Drel were a species of aquatic creatures that gasped when out of water.
The Blind Luck was a freighter that was owned by Desric Fol during the Galactic Civil War. The aging freighter's computer systems rarely calculated accurate hyperspace routes.
Elrooden was the capital city of Elrood, a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. The Elrood Bazaar was held here.
Paledors were Corellian animals that became extinct.

The Devaronian Fur-Spider was a kind of venomous arachnid native to Devaron. They were known to hunt only prey they considered a challenge. These spiders wove red webs, and were also known to be found in the Undercity of Coruscant.

Blue Ruin was a Nebulon-B2 frigate belonging to the Galactic Empire. It responded to a distress call from an Imperial troop convoy that was under attack by Rebel B-wing starfighters, RZ-1 A-wing interceptors, T-65 X-wing starfighters and BTL Y-wing starfighters in the Mylok sy…

Diorda was a planet in the Mid Rim that contained a secret Separatist weapons factory. During the Clone Wars, Luminara Unduli was assigned to investigate the secret factory, and after a duel in Mondo-Mod the Hutt's Arena of Doom, Luminara received the coordinates of the weapon…

The Lumini pirates were a pirate organization. By 35 ABY, the organization had become defunct, having been attacked by the First Order. Kuimi Enissa, a young lieutenant in the organization, was the sole survivor of the attack.

The Twin Hills was a location on the forest moon of Endor which consisted of two large mountain peaks. The Twin Hills were known as the home of the Two-headed Gonster, a knowledgeable being that specialized in the capture and neutralization of monsters.

A Zakool was a cat-like creature native to the forest moon of Endor. They appeared to be carnivorous but were not known to attack the Ewoks who lived on the moon. Zakools had dark fur and sharp claws which allowed them to scale trees to an extent.

A zomba was a forest creature on the moon of Endor. It was apparently carnivorous and would eat anything that wandered into its territory. Zombas appeared to run and chase prey using only their hind legs.
Inamo was a Rebel Alliance EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in service after the Battle of Hoth.
Gadrin was a city located on Cularin. Gadrin and its twin city, Hedrett, were the only major non-Tarasin settlements on the planet. The city's industrial sector was nicknamed Ged.
Hedrett was a city on Cularin and along with its twin city Gadrin was the only major non-Tarasin settlement on the planet.
The Starfaring was a spaceliner that was crewed by Bothans. It went missing in the Malrev system, and was later found by members of Rogue Squadron.
The Sith fleet was the spacegoing arm of the Sith military which fought for the Brotherhood of Darkness in the closing stages of the New Sith Wars.
The Phantasm was Xaverri's personal ship.
Thermon was a planet located within the Thermon system of the Mid Rim with many moons that spewed methane gas from geysers.

Razor Eaters were a type of bipedal assassin droid designed by criminal droid engineer Hurlo Holowan. Among the fiercest killing machines ever invented, they stood 2.25 meters tall and their two claw-tipped durasteel arms were capable of punching holes through armored hulls.

Bollin was the oldest platform city on Cularin, and its age showed in its aging technology, low population, and dilapidated buildings. Most of its business revolved around exporting Cularin's exotic woods.
The Vrassh Slaughter was a large-scale slaughter of the Vrassh by the Pas'sic. By 19 ABY, neither the New Republic nor the Pas'sic government had compensated the survivors.
The Blockade of Sif'kric was one of the first armed inter-species conflicts that plagued the New Republic during the Caamas Document Crisis.
The Battle of Mengjini was one of the crises that faced the New Republic during the Caamas Document Crisis.

Soboll was a platform city on Cularin that served as a base for the Thaereian military, constructed shortly after Thaere Privo accepted responsibility for protecting the Cularin system. It was built in a remote part of Cularin, far from other platform cities.

IMP-22 was a masculine Imperial military protocol droid that was programmed in warfare and politics, making him a valuable advisor to the commander he served with the assistance of SD-7 messenger droids.

SD-7 was an Imperial Communications droid, serving as assistant to IMP-22. SD-7's main function was to relay messages from Imperial agents around the galaxy to a high ranking Imperial commander that IMP-22 and SD-7 served. SD-7 communicated in droidspeak.

S-4QD was the only droid left on Tilnes by 31 BBY. At that time, he had been shut down by moon's electromagnetic pulses ninety-three times. Nineteen of those times his memory had been wiped, and twice his photoreceptors had popped out of his head.
New Geddes was a city on the terraformed asteroid Hanoon, and the site of the Terraform Processor.

Capital City, also known as Lothal City, was the main population center and capital of Lothal, a planet in economic disrepair that had invited the Galactic Empire in return for prosperity and security.

A freighter was used by Ephant Mon during a smuggling job on Cerea prior to the Invasion of Naboo. The ship was infested with deadly divviks, and Mon, along with the Techrats and Sylvn were trapped in an escape pod.

IT-O9 was a black and silver spherical interrogation droid owned by Riboga the Hutt. The crime lord would often have the droid hovering nearby when he entertained guests. When Riboga left the Cularin system, he sold off many of his possessions, IT-O9 included.
The Chubby Gundark was a SoroSuub Transport Systems Nyubba-class cargo barge driver owned and operated by SoroSuub Corporation during the Galactic Civil War.
G'rinn Go city was located on the planet Sullust. The city was noted for its great markets, and Bungo Bung sold boaboo juice cultivated from his father's farm there.
Norge was a Virella Systems cargo freighter that approached Azzameen Station shortly after the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.

Qusyte was a planet in the Quyste system within the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim Territories on which Talon Karrde had a training center. The smuggler sent H'sishi there before 18 ABY to study starship operations.

HG-211 was a military droid with a masculine persona who served as the head of security for a droid community that dwelled on the moon Uffel in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Makksre was the planet located in the Uoti sector of the Core Worlds in the galaxy. Sansia Bardrin and her ship were captured by pirates some time prior to 18 ABY.
Kwannot was a Mid Rim planet where Aurra Sing killed Mana Veridi sometime prior to 32 BBY.

The corvaj was a predator that inhabited the Wilds, an area of overgrown jungle and swampy lowlands that was known as the location of insect swarms and vicious beasts. The corvaj was known to be deadly; they ambushed their prey, and were noted for ripping out a victim's liver.

result: Death of Darth Kruhl and entire crew of the Dauntless
x: The Duel on Bastion was a short confrontation between the Emperor Roan Fel of the Fel Empire and the Sith Lord Darth Kruhl, who had been dispatched by Darth Maladi to assassinate Fel.

The Pembric Security Legion was the law enforcement agency on Pembric II. When they were founded, they were an honest organization, but over the years, they were influenced by the growing criminal element present on the planet.

S2P-O3O was a droid working at the Forard research station. Generally called OhThreeOh, the droid was basically a rolling computer with arms. He had a boxlike body with two arms, equipped with tool mounts, extending from the front of it.

Nus Whales were creatures native to Dorumaa. When food was plentiful, a Nus Whale could grow up to twenty meters in a single year. As of 31 BBY, there was one herd of Nus Whales swimming Dorumaa's oceans, consisting of twelve cows and ten bulls.
The Dead Forest was a vast expanse of trees located on the Forest Moon of Endor. It was the home of the Raich's cave. The carnivorous Raich was attacked twice within the Dead Forest.

The Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Annihilator, was stationed on the borders of Hutt Space, near the Periphery, with the Ruthless around 4 ABY. Governor Newen Streeg of the Periphery had the option of calling on the Annihilator when necessary.
The Viper Wing was Nirama's personal space yacht.
The City of Kastays was a major city on the planet Aaris III in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories several thousand years before the Galactic Civil War.

The Navy of Thaere, also referred to as the Thaereian Navy or the Thaereian military, was the military force of the Expansion Region's Thaereian system during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

The Raich's cave was a cavern located within the Dead Forest on the Forest Moon of Endor. The location served as the base of operations for the Raich, who housed a number of animals there. The animals were tied in place and fed food until the Raich decided to devour them.
Terrup was an Imperial Ton-Falk-class escort carrier during the Galactic Civil War. It was part of the fleet that patrolled the Killaniri system.
Disorver was an Imperial Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser during the Galactic Civil War. It was part of the fleet that patrolled the Killaniri system.
E1-6RA, also known as Era (only by her master Lanius Qel-Bertuk), E1-6 and Ee-One (by everybody else), was the administrator droid of the Almas Academy. E1-6RA had a feminine programming.
O2-C4 was a droid chef that had worked at the Almas Academy. A group of Jedi students accidentally destroyed him, after which Mother Missira took over his duties.
Gulginaws were flying creatures native to the planet Corellia. They were also known to live on nearby planet Talus.
Merasy was a Nova-Drive 3-Z light freighter that had a number of owners during the Galactic Civil War.
The Muvon was a Loronar Corporation B-7 light freighter owned by Brophar Tofarain.
The Blood Raptors were a gang operating on Tolea Biqua and Varna Biqua. They wore black synth-hide jackets which had a blood-red claw depicted on the back.

The LQ Flagship Havelon was a capital ship that served as Wilhuff Tarkin's flagship above the planet Despayre, while the first Death Star was undergoing completion. It was aboard Havelon that Tarkin received Darth Vader for his inspection of the station's progress.

The Neeva-Beelo was a YT-1210 light freighter owned by the Rodian Teeloo. It was given to him in 32 BBY by an uncle to annoy Teeloo's cousins, who intended to inherit it. At that point, it was already several decades old with numerous mechanical problems when he got it.

The Cavern of Teeth was a large cavern in Eskaron which at least one race course went through. The cavern was over three kilometers long and around 200 meters high. The cavern got its name from the enormous stalactites and stalagmites littered throughout.

Skinning the Mynock was an area in Eskaron which at least one race course went through. The tunnel there split into a figure 8, which could potentially cause racers to cross each other's paths. A short distance after the first figure 8, the tunnel split again in another figure 8.
The Spiral was a cavern section in Eskaron which at least one race course went through. As it name implied, it was a long spiral-like section of tunnel about forty meters in diameter much of the way.
Platt's Dream was one of the names of Platt Okeefe's first ship.

Dead Bantha Gulch was the name of a ravine on the desert world of Tatooine. The smugglers Platt Okeefe and Tru'eb Cholakk hid out within the crevasse after their escape from the slave lord Quintik Kahr.
SeeVee or C-V was an ASP-7 labor droid owned by the smuggler Platt Okeefe. The droid served her onboard the Last Chance.
Sorfina was a planet. Occasionally, gaudy artworks were requested by buyers on Sorfina.
Bee-Zerobee was a WED Treadwell repair droid. He was owned by the Klatooinian Trade Guild on Boztrok, and was given to Platt Okeefe along with her first ship the Brentaal Princess.

The Brentaal Princess was a Ghtroc 720 freighter that was owned by the Boztrok branch of the Klatooinian Trade Guild. The ship had received numerous modifications from the Guild mechanic, Nazrita Villache.
Stalwart was a Star Destroyer in the service of the Imperial Remnant Starfleet during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

R2-E7 was a R2-series astromech droid. A droid merchant in Mos Espa once tried to sell this droid to Anakin Skywalker when the young Jedi visited the planet Tatooine in 21 BBY to investigate rumors of a new kind of battle droid.

headquarters: Cincey's working hut, Path compound, Dalna
x: The Children of the Open Hand, also known as the Children of the Path, or as simply as the Children, were a group within the Path of the Open Hand cult founded by the Mother and led by Yana Ro. The other members of the group were Cincey, Treze, and Kor Plouth.
Mereks were strange half-arachnid, half-monkey creatures native to the Forest Moon of Endor. They were loners and not particularly aggressive in the wild.
Lando's Commandos was an elite unit assembled in 3 ABY by Lando Calrissian on Cloud City. It was later reformed to rescue several New Republic starships captured by the TIE Pirates.
Jango Fett's starfighter was a starfighter used by Jango Fett during his attempt to kill Tor Vizsla and the Death Watch in 42 BBY.
The Sentinel was an Imperial Victory-class Star Destroyer. It was stationed at Wroona, where it conducted training exercises.
Thira was the innermost planet in the Vaxal system. It was a searing rock with one moon.
Caprol was the second planet in the Vaxal system. It was a moonless, barren rock.
Irfan was the third planet in the Vaxal system. It was a gas giant orbited by seven moons.
Pheon was the outermost planet in the Vaxal system. It was a barren rock with two moons.
Koved City was one of the main cities on Siluria III. Located half an hour from the planet's main spaceport, Koved City was home to Imperial Governor Quannith's mansion.
NeHimmep was a Starfeld Industries ZH-25 Questor-class freighter, named for a famous Duros explorer. Her owner, Captain Mirchidi NeMall, used it for non-smuggling trading purposes.
Jungle worrts were amphibious creatures found on Kashyyyk. Jungle worrts used their long green tongues to catch smaller prey.
The Hunter was a Victory I-class Star Destroyer belonging to the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Backshin were wild herd animals hunted by the Chevin on Vinsoth.

Black Hawk was an Imperial Lancer-class frigate that, along with its sister ship Furious escorted a convoy through the Eidoloni system which, belonging to Xizor Transport Systems, transported a wide range of heavy materials used for the construction of the Death Star II.

Furious was an Imperial Lancer-class frigate. Along with its sister ship, the Black Hawk, it escorted a convoy through the Eidoloni system which, belonging to Xizor Transport Systems, transported a wide range of heavy materials used for the construction of the Death Star II.

Nexus was a Carrack-class light cruiser belonging to the Empire. Along with its sister ship Xerxes and the Victory-class Star Destroyer Vagrant, it attempted to stop the Defiance Task Force from rendezvousing with the Alliance Fleet at Sullust, but were held back by A-wings, t…

Xerxes was a Carrack-class light cruiser that saw service with the Imperial Navy. Along with its sister ship Nexus and the Victory-class Star Destroyer Vagrant, the Xerxes attempted to stop the Defiance Task Force from rendezvousing with the Alliance Fleet at Sullust.

Vagrant was a Victory I-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Starfleet. Along with two Carrack-class light cruisers, the Nexus and the Xerxes, the Vagrant attempted to stop the Defiance Task Force from rendezvousing with the Rebel fleet at Sullust.
Whitecap was, essentially, the head of a ruined 3PO unit modified by the holojournalist Hallis Saper to serve as a recording device.

Coen was a CR90 corvette belonging to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Coen was assigned to the Rebel hospital as protection for the Rebels who were wounded during the evacuation of Hoth.

Farrelly was a CR90 corvette belonging to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Farrelly was assigned to the Rebel hospital as protection for the Rebels who were wounded during the evacuation of Hoth.

Walo was a BFF-1 bulk freighter belonging to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Walo was assigned to the Rebel hospital with cargo for the Rebels who were wounded during the evacuation of Hoth.

Mara was a BFF-1 bulk freighter belonging to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Mara was assigned to the Rebel hospital with cargo for the Rebels who were wounded during the evacuation of Hoth.
Furious was a Victory II-class Star Destroyer that, along with several Viraxo ships, including the CR90 corvette Blast Radius took part in the capture of Twin Sun Station.
Blast Radius was a CR90 corvette belonging to the Viraxo. Blast Radius, along with the Victory II-class Star Destroyer Furious, arrived at the Twin Sun Station to capture it.
The Bank parliament was the central legislature of Gandle Ott of the Ott system, located in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
CUTH-BRT-92-X3, or Cuthbert, as he was known, was a BRT supercomputer mainframe that was installed in Montrol City on Gandle Ott.
RX5-TLN was an assassin droid stationed on the planet Gandle Ott in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories by Moff Kentor Sarne, the Imperial warlord of the region.
The Vengeance was the personal Star Destroyer of Imperial Advisor Bregius Golthan.

Gorkin's Rest was a cantina on Wroona. In 7 ABY, the cantina was a meeting place for Platt Okeefe, Tru'eb Cholakk, Starter, Dirk Harkness and Jai Raventhorn before they launched their sabotage mission against the Star Destroyer Vengeance.

XTS-673 was a Bulk cruiser operated by Xizor Transport Systems. It interrupted an attempt by the Azzameen family to assault the Viraxo munitions cache near 1 by launching its squadrons of Supa Fighters. Ace Azzameen was successful in destroying all of the Supa Fighters.
The Imperial Surgical Corps was a medical branch of the Imperial Military during the Galactic Civil War.

The Neimoidian Royal Guard, whose members were known as Neimoidian guards, Neimoidian soldiers, or Neimoidian gunners, was a military branch of the government of the Neimoidian Purse World Cato Neimoidia.
Kromol was the fifth planet in the Kro'eval system. It was largely uninhabited, with no sentient species.

The Darkknell Defense Agency was the security force of the planet Darkknell. They were in charge of keeping the peace on that world as well as providing emergency services. Colonel Nyroska was a ranking officer in the agency.
The vaults of the Galactic Empire subterranean structure buried deep beneath the Coruscant Imperial Palace and served as the storehouses of Emperor Palpatine's many treasures.
Endor was the alias used for a 500-X shuttle stolen by Han Solo, Chewbacca, and Kyp Durron.

The Impounder was an Imperial Customs Corvette under the command of Captain Mandus Fouc. It was part of the fleet that attempted to take control of the Kalinda system in the years following the Battle of Endor.

The Midnight Star was a modified YV-545 light freighter, captained by Cala Worner, and co-piloted by Thul Kariss. It was registered to the Outer Rim Trade Consortium, and was affiliated with the Rebel Alliance.
The Helmet Squad was a squad of prison guards that stood guard in Desolation Alley.
Manari was a planet in the Manari system of the Brevost sector, one of the Trailing Sectors in the Expansion Region.
Manforgon was a planet located in the Mid Rim's Senex sector. It was used for centuries as a penal colony of the Senex-Juvex region.

Qlothos was an Inner Rim planet with a cloudy atmosphere. By 3 ABY, the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Interrogator detected unusual transmissions from the nearby Qlothos that resembled those made by the Rebel Alliance.
GX-8 was a sewing assistant droid that was employed by Arta Kleidun, owner of Black Spire Outfitters, to help keep up with demand at her store.
A Bliz was a plump species of bird that was native to the world of Hapes. It produced pink-shelled eggs that were considered to be a Hapan delicacy. Blizes made their homes in blizcots.
Monsails were large predatory fish native to the swamps of Trinta. They had long eel-like bodies and large sails on their backs.
Dathomir lizards had green skin that was used for leather garments. Tenel Ka wore Dathomir lizard skin leather. They would begin to fade and wear thin within one to two years.
The Squill Cave was a cavern located somewhere in the deserts of Tatooine and was home to many squill beasts.
The Treasure Trove was one of thirty Gallofree Yards GR-75 medium transports stationed at the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Echo Base on the ice planet Hoth by 3 ABY.

The Bombaasa Cartel was a criminal organization based on Pembric II during the early years of the New Republic. Run by Crev Bombaasa, the Cartel had an uneasy alliance with Moff Kentor Sarne during his time as ruler of the Kathol sector.
WatchCircle Vodo was a group of Jedi Seers during the Mandalorian Wars, aligned with the Jedi Covenant. They were named after Jedi Master Vodo-Siosk Baas.

Krieger was an Imperial Star Destroyer that was part of the forces of Admiral Gaen Drommel. After the Battle of Endor, Krieger was placed under the command of Captain Dor Reder. Its last known location was the Hanod system.

Firedrakes were large flying proboscised insects native to Gallinore that lit up in colored light, heat, and energy. They came out of their habitat, usually caves, at dusk. The insects communicated to each other via their blinks, with short blinks indicating a summon.
Pil Diller was a forested planet in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim. According to records, this planet was once home to the extinct singing fig trees.

Shandor Squadron was a Rebel Alliance starfighter squadron that carried out the attack on the Imperial supply center Jyrenne Base on the planet Onderon. Shandor Squadron suffered minimal losses during the engagement.
The Killing House was a location in the clone military education complex on Kamino, used for the training of clone commandos in anti-terrorist operations.
Tuana was a Gallofree Yards GR-75 medium transport which carried Bothans who had acquired valuable information concerning the Second Death Star.

Q9-01, also known as Zero-One, was a Q9-series astromech droid equipped with a vocoder. Zero-One was Kyp Durron's personal astromech during the Yuuzhan Vong War that he received from a Mon Calamari philosopher who was fascinated with ancient cultures and technologies.

t: The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers
headquarters: The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers' Guildhouse
x: The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers, or Armorer's Guild, was an association that gathered together the best weapons specialists in the galaxy. Procuring and selling a vast array of weaponry, the Guild became unparalleled in its field during the Imperial Period.
a: The Most Honorable Guild of Armorers

x: The Change Zone was an area on the planet of Bespin characterized by powerful storms and vortexes.
A prototype Imperial Executor-class Star Dreadnought was fitted with multiple cloaking devices and underwent construction over Fondor in 3 ABY.
The Traffic Control Center was a multi-story data center located in the upper levels of the Imperial Palace on Coruscant.

PROXY was a prototype holodroid who served as a companion and long time friend of Galen Marek and traveled with him on the Rogue Shadow. Despite their friendship, PROXY would routinely try to kill Marek during training, as this was his primary directive provided by Darth Vader.

The Gray Pilgrim was the mobile Jedi academy upon which the Padawan Maris Brood was taught the ways of the Jedi by her master. Brood was aboard this ship with her master in the Outer Rim during the Clone Wars at the time of the issuance of Order 66.

Ghost was a CR90 corvette belonging to the Galactic Empire. The ship responded to a Rebel Alliance attack on the Nebulon-B frigate Juvaini. Despite her assistance, she was destroyed along with Juvaini.

Igaka was a BFF-1 bulk freighter belonging to the Galactic Empire. The freighter was delivering supplies and repairs to the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Juvaini just as Rebel Alliance RZ-1 A-wing interceptors and B-wing starfighters arrived to destroy the frigate.
DD-19 was a masculine DD-19 "Overseer" labor pool droid assigned to the New Republic CR90 corvette FarStar. It was nicknamed "the slavemaster" due to its harsh treatment of other droids.
