x: J9-R1 was a J9 worker drone assigned to the New Republic CR90 corvette FarStar. Assigned to the hydroponics bay, the unit - along with its two companions (J9-B4 and J9-K6-24) - was considered a "busybody." A self styled "efficiency expert" with endless suggestions to improve c…
SE-4-TQ5 was an SE4 servant droid assigned to the New Republic CR90 corvette FarStar. It had a "smashing way" with fruit, and was assigned on a semi-permanent basis to the ship's mess hall.
SE-4-17 was an SE4 servant droid assigned to the New Republic CR90 corvette FarStar. It had a matte black finish, and was the assistant to DD-19 in the ship's droid repair bay.

R-97 was the quartermaster droid assigned to the New Republic CR90 corvette FarStar. He had the responsibility for overseeing all storage and supply bins, and maintaining the ship's inventory of items.

The Silent Blades were a pirate band that was active during 0 BBY. That year, they were pursued for weeks by the Imperial frigate Far Orbit, led by Captain Vocis Kenit, before the pirates were forced to fight the Imperials in an asteroid field in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Bombing of Callos, also known as the Battle of Callos, occurred early during the reign of the Galactic Empire in 3 BBY.

Vorshaks, informally nicknamed "bark-eaters," were a type of furry, quadrupedal creature that lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. They had powerful front teeth that allowed them to consume the trees of the forest.
The Miss Chance was a modified YT-1300 light freighter that belonged to Kaine Paulsen.

Noonar was a planet located in the Noonian system of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, Noonar was host to the pacifist Noonar Confederacy, which controlled a key stretch of territory between the two galactic powers.

place: Near the edge of the Mid Rim
objective: Locate and eliminate Pegasus Strike Force
x: Operation Venom was a military operation spearheaded by Admiral Bethrogg of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Behemoth.
Resti Kel was a planet located in the Resti Kel system of the Juvex sector, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy.

The Triumph was an Imperial Star Destroyer serving under Director of Imperial Intelligence Ysanne Isard. It was one of two ships left to defend Imperial Center against the impending New Republic invasion. It was captured by the Mon Remonda after having received heavy damage.
Dead Eye was a large area of still air and dense gases and fog on the planet of Bespin. It existed in Bespin's atmosphere at least since the planet’s discovery.

The Endorian Grasslands was an area on the Forest Moon of Endor that was dominated by tall grass. It was inhabited by many species, such as the Grass Trekkers, and it was bordered by the Grass Trekkers' shrine and Gupin stronghold.
The G'nabgib was an Imperial Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used to evacuate the leading TIE/D Defender scientist and other remaining personnel from a research facility.

The Marduk was an Imperial Carrack-class light cruiser that was assigned to the Celanon system under the command of Systems Sub-Commander Jared Brojtal. Following the attack on the Syndaar Military Prep School, the warship led the search for the Ho'Din terrorist Ort Hoogra-D'En.
The Chalcedony was a YT-1300 light freighter modified for passenger transport. It was outbound from Pallaxides when it was forced to crash-land on Celanon.

Widow Maker was a modified Incom Corporation "Explorer" Scout Ship used by brother and sister bounty hunters Alic and Vika Surn. In exchange for their transport, the Surns paid a five percent gap to the Neuvalis syndicate, the ship's true owner.

result: Imperial forces allied to Moff Kentor Sarne force the FarStar to retre
x: The Battle of Galtea was an engagement between the New Republic corvette FarStar, and a roving Imperial fleet allied to Moff Kentor Sarne.
Quian was a terrestrial planet located in the Quian system of the Core Worlds. It was home to a Human population known as the Quians.

36DD (nicknamed the Deedee) was an Imperial barge. In 3 ABY, 36DD was to pick up a Colony Class 23669 power generator at Kuat Drive Yards, but a Rebel Alliance team led by Deen Voorson and Boo Rawl disguised the Rebel ship Long Run as 36DD, took the barge carrying the generato…

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: The Joint Defense Operations Staff were members of the advisory board that advised the New Republic Senate on all defense-related matters.

Last Hope was a CR90 corvette which served with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. The corvette attempted to break through the Imperial blockade on Edan II, but was crippled, crashing onto the planet's surface with the loss of all hands.
The Starlady was a Starfeld Z-10 Seeker owned by the courier Debret Nightmoon.
The Vorpal Demise was a Starfeld ZH-25 Questor in service to the Rebel Alliance.
Hrasskis was a planet located in the Hrasskis system of the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Hrasskis species.
The 28th Flight was a flight group of Confederate Navy Vulture-class droid starfighters in the service of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
The 72nd Flight was a flight group of Confederate Navy Vulture-class droid starfighters in the service of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Graleca was one of the largest cities on Jerrilek. It was situated on an island in the planet's equatorial archipelago and was primarily an agriculture industrial city with few tourist attractions. Many of the buildings in the city were airy and made of white stone.

objective: Assist defecting Imperial admiral
x: The mission to Graleca took place during the Galactic Civil War partially aboard the Devastator and in the Jerrilekkan city of Graleca, as a group of Rebel operatives assisted Chel Dorat in defecting from the Galactic Empire to the Rebel Alliance.
The Special Threats Division was a department of the New Republic Intelligence Service. It was tasked with gathering intelligence on and dealing with unusual threats to the New Republic.
The Tragic Flaw was the personal ship of Bho Vendoll.
The Analysis Bureau, was a branch of New Republic Intelligence responsible for analyzing data and compiling reports for senior personnel and government representatives.
The Cularin resistance was a group organized to resist the perceived threat of the Metatheran Cartel on Cularin.
The dua-wurm was a species of creature that could be found living underground on the world of Cularin. They were two-headed purple worm-like creatures that reached over two meters in length.

The Tactical Analysis Bureau was a branch of New Republic Intelligence Service responsible for analyzing data and compiling reports for senior personnel and government representatives regarding the tactical capabilities of pro-Imperial, neutral, or friendly forces.

4B-X (Forbee-X) was a feminine science research droid affiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic. In 0 ABY, she accompanied Governor Trux Zissu, Stuart Zissu, R2-D2, and C-3PO on a mission from Yavin 4 to the planet Delantine on board the Timespan.
The Timespan was a transport ship used by Trux Zissu, Stuart Zissu, R2-D2, C-3PO and 4B-X to travel from Yavin 4 to Delantine. Trux Zissu was to be the governor of Delantine.
Signal was a branch of Imperial Intelligence's Analysis Bureau. Signal monitored the communications channel through which messages were transmitted.
Escape pod 4 was an escape pod aboard the starship Timespan.
Altoona Prefecture, or simply Altoona, was a city on the planet of Bethal.

result: Ral Shawgrim awarded the Usor Cluster
x: The Jendar Campaign was a series of battles fought between the forces of the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire for the control of the planet Jendar. Ral Shawgrim was a veteran of the Jendar Campaign.

Isiring was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Cassander sector. An ore-rich mining world, Isiring became a part of the domain known as the Cassandran Worlds, founded by the former businessman Cassander Tadrin during the reign of the Galactic Republic.
Forsen was a lush agriworld in the Outer Rim. It was part of the Cassandran Worlds.
The Kobothi S-Corps was an elite unit of security forces charged with the protection of Kobothi Space and interests. It was formed sometime after the Mavvan Conflict.

A skitter was a small animal known to infest buildings. The Imperial Governor's Hall on Verkuyl had a skitter problem late in the Galactic Civil War. Skitters could be recognized by the sounds of their squeaks and scurrying claws.
V-3P5 was a protocol droid owned by New Republic Senator Drextar Pym. 'Vee-Three' was responsible for watching over Pym's two sons, Kyle and Dirv Pym.

The Storrd Township was a city on the world of Seregar. It was the closest thing to a starport that could be found on the entire planet, and visitors could stay in the Callamvor Hotel. The township had once been a prosperous mining town until the mines ran dry.
Cather was one of three moons that orbited the planet of Saleucami, in the Suolriep sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. It owed its greenish hue to the crystalline dust in its atmosphere.
Sreina was a city on Janara III with suspected ties to the Rebel Alliance.
The Star Quest was a Suwantek Systems TL-1800 transport that was owned and operated by the Riileb Tere Metallo.

affiliation: Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services
x: Daxis Outpost was a New Republic research installation that was located in the Jandolhoon system in the Outer Rim of the galaxy. The outpost was used by the Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services as a staging ground for expeditions into the Galactic Rim.

t: Siege of an Imperial Galactic Rim shipyard
x: The siege of an Imperial Galactic Rim shipyard took place during the Operation Shadow Hand in 10 ABY
The Courage of Sullust was a modified GR-75 medium transport which was used to carry ten X-wings of the Rogue Squadron during a diplomatic mission to Ryloth.
Kragg's Fury was the flagship of the Dread Buccaneer Hez Kragg.

Thinin was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate operating in the Imperial Navy under Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin. When the Grand Admiral turned rogue, in 3 ABY, and led a coup d'etat against the Empire, the Thinin remained under Zaarin's command.
Yaai was a Carrack-class light cruiser belonging to the Rogue Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin.
Wunt was an Imperial BFF-1 bulk freighter that operated during the Galactic Civil War. It was carrying mines when it was destroyed during Operation Blunt Stick.
Kan was an Imperial BFF-1 bulk freighter operative during the Galactic Civil War. The ship was carrying mines when it was destroyed during Operation Blunt Stick.
Kant was an Imperial BFF-1 bulk freighter operative during the Galactic Civil War. The ship was carrying mines when it was destroyed during Operation Blunt Stick.
Karatha was a planet in the Expansion Region that was the location of the Rebel Alliance base Eyrie Base. The Eyrie was located in a natural sinkhole on the surface of Karatha.

A bruwose was a large lizard native to Moorja. The lizards were effectively blind, using sound, heat and smell to navigate. They had large fore-paw talons, which they used to sift through soft rock while hunting small prey.
The Harrier Infiltration Team was a Rebel Alliance Special Forces unit. It was composed of Fable Astin, Deke Holman, and Arecelis Acosta. All three members were stationed aboard the Prodigal.

Poytta was a planet in Hutt Space along a small hyperspace route situated alongside the Shag Pabol; as such, it was used as a refueling stop by many slavers and smugglers who travelled along the bigger hyperlane. It also served as Tuga SalPivo's base of operations.
The Assessor was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser.

Scourge Squadron was an naval squadron of the Pentastar Patrol under the Pentastar Alignment. It previously was part of the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire, where it was similar in composition and role to that of Death Squadron.
The planet Da'nor was home to a semi-sentient species of flying lizard. These lizards were ectothermic, and they were distinguished by a set of wings and iridescent skin.

The Rainbow Bridge was a magical phenomenon witnessed on Endor, a forest moon orbiting the planet of Tana. It was created when the artifact known as the Bridge crystal was held toward Ibleam, Endor's sun.

The Jodakan needler crab came from the seas of Jodaka. It was mainly known for its ability to create a needle made out of a paralyzing poison it produced and use the projectile to shoot down prey, including birds such as gulls.
Fey'lya's Pride was the name of Borsk Fey'lya's personal Lambda-class shuttle, which he used during the Galactic Civil War.
The Jedi Dreamer was the custom-built starship of Korren Starchaser, a veteran NRSS scout.
The Chaser was a modified YT-1300 light freighter that was owned and operated by Baydo Chasdy. He utilized the starship to transport stranded Rebel Alliance agents out of Dac.
Rako's Rift was a deep sea trench on Dac near Wildwater City. The large deep-sea predator known as the krakana lived in the rift.

The Eclipse Rider was a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-1300 light freighter that pilot Wedge Antilles rented in 7 ABY during the preparations for the Bacta War, a conflict between Antilles' independent starfighter unit Rogue Squadron and the pro-Imperial governm…
A Nar Shaddaa agri-utility crop sprayer, also referred to as a "Narsh dirt-crate" by clone commando RC-1309, was operated by clone commandos of the Galactic Republic in 22 BBY.
The Fnessian were a sentient species indigenous to the Inner Rim planet Fnessal. They had two eyestalks on their head, from the back of which grew thick, fleshy tendrils.
Morgannier was a freighter owned by the SoroSuub Corporation during the Galactic Civil War.
Shando was a city on the planet of Lirra once controlled by the Jhank Shel Hutt clan until the subjugation of the planet by the Galactic Empire.
The Trustworthy was a Corporate Sector Authority Etti-class light transport that was owned and piloted by Drolen Antig.
Sar Galva was a small mining outpost in the Murul Trench on Dac.
The Trade City was one of the largest cities on the planet Arkania in the Perave system of the Colonies region of the galaxy.

In 7 ABY, the rogue starfighter squadron Rogue Squadron raided Thyferran Convoy Delta-Two-Niner in the Chorax system, kicking off the Bacta War between Rogue Squadron and the Xucphra Corporation of the planet Thyferra.
Ren'bl Ettes was one of the largest cities on the planet Almania in the Almanian Sector.
Mem'Kabarr was a forest on the planet Almania.
Algarra II was a planet in Algarra system the Outer Rim Territories on which Tord Gamb engaged in confidence schemes, contributing to a 25,000-credit bounty placed on him by the New Republic.
Moratrig was one of the four moons that orbited Zelos II.
Nekotrig was one of the four moons that orbited Zelos II.
The Panna dragons were large reptilian creatures that lived on Panna Prime.
Paar's ichthyodonts were large saurian creatures that lived on Panna Prime.

place: A star system with a red dwarf
x: In 7 ABY, during the Bacta War, Rogue Squadron ambushed a Xucphra Corporation bacta convoy under Captain Ait Convarion in a star system with a red dwarf and a dust disk.

Krayn's pirate ship was a massive starship that the T'surr slave-pirate and crime-lord Krayn used to capture other space vessels and to acquire slaves for his illegal spice-processing operations on Nar Shaddaa.

The bounty hunter Aurra Sing had a starfighter. It was carried by the bounty hunter aboard her cruiser. Sing would leave her cruiser drifting and seemingly helpless to distract her pursuers, then surprise-attack them in her fighter. The craft had four powerful laser cannons.
After the rogue starfighter unit Rogue Squadron conducted a number of raids against Xucphra Corporation bacta convoys, Ysanne Isard retaliated by destroying a colony on the planet Halanit.
Natori Association was one of companies that were part of the Tenloss Syndicate and operated as a training and supply company. It was based on the planet Sperin in the Palaquin system.

Eyeshine was a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation Barloz-class freighter that was owned by the Shistavanen smuggler Mal Biron. The vessel had been upgraded with the addition of an X10-D droid brain, which helped Biron to operate and maintain the ship effectively.

type: Modified Kuat Drive Yards D9 Runner light freighter
x: The Starknife was a modified Kuat Drive Yards D9 Runner light freighter owned by the Duros smuggler Kalend Thora. She received the Starknife after the ship's original owner, a fellow member of Black Sun, was ambushed and killed by an unknown party.
The Antar Band was a crime ring active on the Sisar Run. It was led by the Gotal Ujin Voli, who named the group after the planet his homeworld circled.
A battle at the planet Qretu 5 was the result of a punitive strike conduced by Rogue Squadron against one of the off-world bacta-producing colonies of Thyferra.
A battle in the Graveyard was the result of an ambush mounted by Ysanne Isard against Rogue Squadron during the Bacta War.

Safonne's Sword was the flagship of the pirate Safonne Pendon's modest, but effective fleet. It was a CR90 corvette, which was modified to include six turret-mounted double-turbolaser cannons. The ship's drive systems and shields were also upgraded by the Rodian pirate.

Zelosian's Chine was an underwater mountain ridge situated amidst the Great Zelosi Sea on Zelos II. During the Day of the Sepulchral Night, when the tides in the sea were at their lowest, the ridge would be exposed to the surface.
Bay Point was a Nebulon-B2 frigate belonging to the Rebel Alliance. It was part of a second attempt to rescue Rebel and Bothan prisoners, the attempt was foiled by Tan Maarek Stele.
Knights was an MC80 Star Cruiser belonging to the Rebel Alliance.
The Doomer was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served with the Bothan defense fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

Empress' Diadem was one of the starships in Talon Karrde's smuggling operation. It was a modified YT-1210 light freighter and during the Bacta War it was captained by Melina Carniss. A disk-shaped ship, it was armed with a blaster cannon and concussion missile launch tubes.

Kracken was a Nebulon-B2 frigate belonging to the Rebel Alliance. The frigate, along with several other ships, was mobilizing at the Delfii system prior to the Battle of Endor. The frigate's cargo was troops.
A merdoc was a subterranean predatory lizard that lived on Ahakista. It was smaller than a telcar.

The planet of Loken III was the headquarters of TransTech Droidworks. It was the location of Power Station TD-332, which Separatist Geonosians failed to protect from a Republic assault during the Clone Wars.
Glich was a Rebel transport encountered by Maarek Stele on his first sortie at Outpost D-34.

The white-furred bantha was a large animal native to the planet Nelvaan. These creatures were used as riding mounts for the native Nelvaanian population and carried Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi to a Nelvaanian village.

The barber birds were a species of birdlike creature that was native to the forest moon of Endor. The blue-and-white colored birds were roughly two meters tall and had an affinity for ganga root, which they would retrieve from the ground.

The Glas was an IPV-1 System Patrol Craft that was used by the Ripoblus government during the Imperial era. In 3 ABY, it was hijacked by a group of Ripoblus scientists who were growing disenchanted with the Sepan Civil War, and wished to seek asylum with the Galactic Empire.

Ring Lake, also referred to as Rim Lake, was a lake on Jomark. High Castle was located on an island formed by an extinct cinder cone in the middle of the Ring Lake. It was formed by water filling a collapsed caldera of a volcano.
A minor battle between the Rebel Alliance and the Empire took place on Talus during the Galactic Civil War. The battle costed the Imperials an AT-AT, an AT-ST, and one TIE bomber.
Wrigglers were an amphibious species native to Drongar. The average size was about five meters long and half a meter thick, making them the largest of all known land-based lifeforms on that world.
Luxiar 7 was a planet located within the Luxiar system of the Outer Rim Territories. There, R'Ytha Myr dated a person called "Ace", most probably Ace Azzameen himself.
Lakota was an Action VI bulk transport stationed on Saruwen Station when Vasudra had a meeting with Ravenno.
Poptree Forest was a forest on the jungle planet Drongar. During the Clone Wars, a battle occurred there that went badly for the Grand Army of the Republic.

Wingstingers were a species of small insects found on Drongar. They were considered pesky by the Rimsoo personnel there, who used osmotic fields to keep them out of their operating theaters. Wingstingers possessed eight legs and were bi-winged.

The Misanthrope was a cargo ship that crash-landed on D'vouran, a planet that devoured anything it came in contact with. The Misanthrope was captained by Bebo, who was, with Lonni and eighteen other people, a survivor of the encounter.
Sevorrts were reptilian creatures with a leathery hide, native to the desert planet Tatooine. They were related to worrts, but far more aggressive.

result: Success, but clone troopers were abandoned
objective: Destroy enemy bunker
x: On the mission to Kashyyyk, a clone commando team was deployed in the jungles of Kashyyyk by Republic commander Morkov.
Red Dog was a Strike-class medium cruiser belonging to the Rebel Alliance. The cruiser was attempting to rendezvous with the Rebel Fleet at Sullust when it was destroyed by Tan Maarek Stele.
Barker was a Nebulon-B2 frigate belonging to the Rebel Alliance. It was supposed to rendezvous with the Rebel Fleet at Sullust, but was destroyed by Maarek Stele.
Shmus was a Nebulon-B2 frigate belonging to the Rebel Alliance. It was supposed to rendezvous with the Rebel Fleet at Sullust, but was destroyed by Maarek Stele.
The Sickener was a training facility used by the Galactic Republic's Grand Army on the extra-galactic planet Kamino that was used in clone commando training by 22 BBY.
Pelican was a Muurian transport owned by scavengers.

The Zephry Asteroid field was a location in the Zephry system where Ace Azzameen on the Otana rendezvoused with Aeron in order to deliver to her a captured Imperial Viper probe droid from the Saila Na system.
Calico was an Xiytiar-class heavy transport.

The flying serpents were giant flying reptiles—essentially winged snakes—native to the planet Ophideraan. The serpents were hatched from eggs in a breeding ground within the caverns under the planet's surface.

This R5 unit was owned by a Jawa clan who had presumably salvaged it. The droid was defective, and despite hours of long work clan's mechanic failed to completely repair it. The frustrated Jawa angrily kicked the droid causing it to topple over.
C-Ratt was a droid located on Nar Shaddaa around the time of the Battle of Calamari during Operation Shadow Hand.
Talon was an CR90 corvette used by the Rebel Alliance. It accompanied the cruiser Liberty on a number of occasions, at times when Liberty was not operating alone.

result: Jacen Solo falls to the dark side of the force and becomes Darth Caedu
x: The Skirmish on Kavan was a final—as well as decisive and defining—conflict that Jacen Solo faced; he would have to choose whether to remain a Jedi Knight, or become the next Dark Lord of the Sith.

The Planet of the Red Nebula was the sole inhabited planet in the Red Nebula, located in Wild Space. It was bombarded with comets when the nebula was severed from the rest of the galaxy by an unknown cataclysm.

A sentient species inhabited a planet in the Red Nebula in Wild Space, that was slowly drifting away from the galaxy due to a cosmic cataclysm. They were humanoid beings who resembled Humans with pink or pale skin and large, pointed ears.

The Red Nebula comet field was a dangerous barrier that ringed the Red Nebula. It was formed when the Nebula was separated from the rest of the galaxy. Its presence lead to the devastation of the Planet of the Red Nebula.

place: Morning Court, New Jedi Temple, Coruscant
x: The Funeral of Mara Jade Skywalker was a Jedi Funeral to mark the passing of Mara Jade Skywalker. This ceremony took place in 40 ABY, approximately one week after Mara's death on Kavan. The funeral was held in the Morning Court—a large atrium in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
The Untouched Valley was a valley on the Planet of the Red Nebula. It remained untouched by the cataclysm that destroyed the rest of the planet.
Link was an MC80 Star Cruiser belonging to the Rebel Alliance.
The Bew'a was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser belonging to the Galactic Empire.
Confal was a Muurian transport belonging to the Rebel Alliance. The Confal attempted to repair the MC80 Star Cruiser Link, but instead was destroyed by Tan Maarek Stele.

t: Duel in the Temple of the Sith
conflict: Second Imperial Civil War/Third Jedi Purge
x: The Duel in the Temple of the Sith occurred after Cade Skywalker arrived on Coruscant and Darth Krayt, Dark Lord of the Sith detected the Jedi's presence. Full of confidence, Cade infiltrated the Temple from below, releasing the Bothan Jedi healer Hosk Trey'lis.
The Mist was an Ton-Falk-class escort carrier in service to the Galactic Empire.
Qork was a Nebulon-B2 frigate belonging to the Galactic Empire. Along with the Mist, it delivered supplies to the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Garrett.
The Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Garrett operated in the Outer Rim during the Galactic Civil War.
Wyndigal 2, originally known as Huronom, was a swampy planet located within the Wyndigal system in the Ash Worlds in the Outer Rim Territories.
Osirrag was the home planet of the Onahk species. It was a small planet, boasting a pleasant climate of light breezes, perfumed air, and moderate temperatures.

Haven was the codename of the Rebel Alliance's predetermined rendezvous point in the Outer Rim Territories far above the galactic plane, where the Alliance Fleet regrouped after the Rebellion's defeat at the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.

The thermal detonator trooper, also known as a grenade trooper, was an artillery unit used by the Galactic Empire. The trooper used a mortar device to lob thermal detonators into the desired attack area.

Blue Squadron, also known as Blue Squad, was a squadron of 24 inexperienced Bothan starfighter pilots and gunners who flew BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighters in support of the Bothan Spynet's efforts to aid the Rebel Alliance.

t: Battle of Ossus (Second Galactic Civil War)
x: The Battle of Ossus, also known as the Massacre on Ossus, took place in 40 ABY during the Second Galactic Civil War. The battle was between the Jedi of the academy and Galactic Alliance Guard (GAG) Troopers sent by Jacen Solo to threaten the New Jedi Order.

t: Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)
x: The Battle of Kashyyyk took place in 40 ABY during the Second Galactic Civil War and, on the orders of Sith Lord and Chief of State Darth Caedus, saw the attempted subjugation and punishment of a Galactic Alliance member-world.
a: First Duel on the Anakin Solo

x: The Rampaging Ranat was a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-2400 light freighter owned by the smuggler Az-Iban, and later the Disac pirate Morturr Heth.

The Disac pirates was a band of pirates, which operated in the area around the Sisar Run. They became such a problem for both illegal and legal shipping that Black Sun intervened to have the group eliminated.
Cornwall was a planet embroiled in a civil war between two rival clans. Qell Tepine, a member of the Star's Nova mercenary force, was implicated in the war.
The Lightning Tech Squadron was an elite unit of the New Republic's Eclipse Team.
In the Vaykaaris Uprising of 41 BBY, terrorists based in the Vaykaaris system, in the Colonies, threatened over one hundred planets in the region.
The Yanov was an Imperial Customs Frigate stolen by agents of the Black Sun Vigo Sprax. It was later used in an operation by the Rebel Alliance Sandwind Team.
The Hornclaw was a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-1300 light freighter which was stolen from Abek's Station by the Kerestian Limna Yith.
Arc Razor was a starship owned by the bounty hunter Gyran.
The Cones of Silence was a starship owned by the Gotal crime lord Ujin Voli.

manufacturer: Custom built by Salem Victory and Dapp Solus
x: Starcat was a customized light freighter used by the Happy Blasters. It was custom designed and built by Salem Victory and Dapp Solus.

t: Battle of Kuat (Second Galactic Civil War)
result: Eventual Galactic Federation of Free Alliances victory
New Jedi Order withdraws support from Galactic Alliance
x: The Battle of Kuat was fought in 40 ABY between members of the Galactic Alliance Fifth Fleet commanded by Jacen Solo and the Confederation.

Bartyn's Landing, sometimes abbreviated as The Landing, was a coastal town on the planet Lamaredd, to which it served as unofficial capital and only spaceport. It received its official name for its founder Hugo Bartyn.
Render was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Starfleet. The Render arrived at the factory ZA-13 to relieve Maarek Stele.

Shotel was a Strike-class medium cruiser in the Imperial Navy. Shotel, along with Nagan, were sent to reinforce the Immobilizer 418 cruiser Red Claw position and assist Maarek Stele in destroying the Kopsh.

R5-F7 was an astromech droid serving onboard Gold Four Lieutenant Lepira's BTL Y-wing starfighter, flying point for Gold Squadron during the assault on the first Death Star at the Battle of Yavin and fending off Imperial fighters to clear a path for the Rebels to reach the Dea…
The Fall of Bastion was an event that took place in 137 ABY in which former Emperor Roan Fel and his followers retook Bastion back from Galactic Emperor Darth Krayt and his Galactic Empire.
The Second Battle of Balmorra, also known simply as the Battle of Balmorra, occurred in 40 ABY as part of the Confederation's push toward the Core during the Second Galactic Civil War.

The Muskegs were a fanatical and violent religious group of Gungans, situated on Naboo. They were in conflict with the Naboo people as they believed that Gungans should be the only sentient species allowed to inhabit Naboo.
The Ultragungan Militia, also known as the Ultra-Gungan Militia, was a Gungan paramilitary group based on Naboo. Its members were known as the Ultragungans.
Freedon was a container transport stationed next to DX-11a when the outpost was attacked by Rebel forces to rescue Zaletta.

The Kimik was a Nebulon-B2 frigate used by Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's forces to assault Emperor Palpatine's C-3 Passenger Liner Excalibur. With the aid of Maarek Stele and his Missile Boat, the Excalibur escaped into hyperspace, thwarting Zaarin's plans yet again.
The Zoli was a Galactic Alliance frigate assigned to the Fourth Fleet. It was destroyed during the Second Battle of Balmorra.

The Arleen was a pleasure yacht that was in service by 3 BBY. It shared its name with the Arleen system and the Arleen Loop hyperlane. The Arleen made year-long tours from the Oseon system to the Antipose system celestial body Antipose IX as well as the planet Antipose XII.
The Morning Court was a circular, transparisteel atrium on the first level of the new Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
Trucemaker was a ship in the Galactic Alliance Fourth Fleet as of 40 ABY.
Reasonable Doubt was a starship owned by Kut-Rate Kruise Lines.
Zack 1 was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by the Galactic Empire during the Aftermath of Hoth.

Soryi was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by the Galactic Empire during the Battle on the Frontier campaign. During Grand Admiral Thrawn's campaign to expand Imperial presence in the Pakuuni system, Platform NL-1 came under attack by Rebel forces.

Shakker was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by the Rebel Alliance during a raid against Outpost NL-1. The Rebel attack failed due to efforts by Imperial forces defending the station, thus forcing Rebel leaders to flee.

The Blacklight Pirates were a group of dangerous space pirates. Their bases of operations were the Blacklight Territory in the Dantooine system and the Onyx Beacon in the Endor system. They were also actibe in the Declorian Territory of the Endor system.

JTR-47 was a training droid used in the Jedi Temple to help young Jedi hone their skills. Prior to the Battle of Naboo, JTR-47 had a hand in helping Obi-Wan Kenobi through the course, instructing him on how to use the Force to jump, Force push, and throw and fight with his lig…

A battle at the planet Birgis occurred one week into the Yuuzhan Vong War in 25 ABY. During the battle, the Yuuzhan Vong used the Mandalorian Protector mercenaries under Boba Fett to neutralize the spaceport on Birgis while the Yuuzhan Vong dealt with the New Republic forces.
A battle took place on the world of New Holgha three months into the extragalactic Yuuzhan Vong's attempt to overthrow the galaxy in 25 ABY.

Joreikna was a large city on Ryloth. Some of its business came from local mining of ryll, but the city was not dependent on mining for income. Joreikna's clan leaders, the Ku'rys, came into conflict with the leaders of the nearby mining town of Lohema, the Rooshan clan.

Wampa Clan was an initiate training clan of the New Jedi Order that was usually made up of children who were fifteen years old. This clan was named after the Wampa, a vicious creature that was native to Hoth.

Veermok Clan was an initiate training clan of the New Jedi Order that was usually made up of children between the ages of 13 to 14 years old. This clan was named after the Veermok, a creature native to Naboo.
The 42nd Republican Guard Assault Division was a New Republic military unit. It was under the overall command of General Rogar Garret.
The 32nd Cruiser Squadron was a New Republic fleet under the command of Captain S'lixike. It was part of the forces commanded by General Rogar Garret and Admiral Anton Standish.
The Battle of Shumari was a large-scale battle between Jedi survivors of Order 66 and the Galactic Empire, which took place on Shumari.

Mule was a flight group of 5 Heavy Lifters used by the Galactic Empire during the Battle on the Frontier. Heavy Lifters Mule retrieved Cargo containers holding useful parts for Grand Admiral Thrawn's new space station NL-1 in the Pakuuni system.

Viper was a CR90 corvette in the service of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. It was presumably attempting to destroy the Imperial Navy starships under the command of Vice Admiral Thrawn to stop a salvage attempt during the Battle on the Frontier.
Horvus was a group of three Assassin-class corvettes used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Del was a group of 3 Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports in the service of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Transports Del were a part of an assault on XQ1 Platform NL-1 during the Battle on the Frontier.
During the Galactic Civil War, two Rebel Alliance Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transports from flight group Thunder attacked Station NL-1 during the Battle on the Frontier.

Electra was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that saw service with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Electra entered the Pakuuni system near XQ1 Platform NL-1 in the final Rebel engagement against the Galactic Empire during the Battle on the Frontier.
Rover was a group of three Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports in service of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Shark was an Imperial Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport stationed aboard Nebulon-B2 frigate Ludwick during the Galactic Civil War. Transport Shark captured Shuttle Electra and its Rebel Advisor occupants during the final engagement of the Battle on the Frontier.
The Tiger was a Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport used by the Galactic Empire.

The Vulnerator was a Victory-class Star Destroyer assigned to the Galactic Alliance Fifth Fleet. Jedi Knight Jaina Solo commented that it had been in service as long as her parents. The Vulnerator and its two escorting frigates participated in the Battle of Kashyyyk.
Petor was a CR90 corvette that the Nharwaak forces used to protect their base of operations at the Mylok IV Conflict during the Galactic Civil War.
Sunbird was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by Nharwaak forces to protect their base of operations at the Mylok IV Conflict during the Galactic Civil War.
The Galactic Empire used Assassin-class corvette Phoenix at the Mylok IV Conflict during the Galactic Civil War.
Doyle was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by Habeen researchers at the Mylok IV Conflict during the Galactic Civil War.

Fairfax was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that Habeen researchers used at the Mylok IV Conflict during the Galactic Civil War. Shuttle Nexus docked with Fairfax to finalize arrangements for completed hyperdrives and citizenship of the Habeen.
The EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Xerxes served in the Rebel Alliance Navy at the Battle of Mylok IV during the Galactic Civil War.

Tela was a Rebel Alliance Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport, it served aboard Nebulon-B frigate Xerxes at the Mylok IV Conflict during the Galactic Civil War. Tela fled Frigate Xerxes, carrying Rebel Officers, as Imperial starfighter pilots dealt the final death blows.
AL-BRT-34-X3 or Albert was a BRT supercomputer that was part of the Esseles University of Calamar.
AGWS-03 was a Rebel Loronar Corporation Strike-class medium cruiser.
AGWS-04 was a Loronar Corporation Strike-class medium cruiser serving the Alliance to Restore the Republic during her attempt to wrest power from the Galactic Empire in the Airam sector.

The Hall of Peace was a large open hall located in the new Jedi Temple on Coruscant. It was most likely on the first floor as was the Morning Court. The chamber was used to hold great banquets at the Temple for Jedi, and sometimes politicians.

Ship was the name of the Sith Meditation Sphere found by Ben Skywalker in 40 ABY. He was an ancient being whose purpose was to train Sith; to that end, he reached out to the Lost Tribe of Sith on Kesh and imparted knowledge of the galaxy at large to the isolated Tribe, bringin…
Red Star Squadron was an Imperial starfighter squadron formed and led by the Countess Iran Ryad some time after the Battle of Endor.
The Bezil was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by Ripoblus forces during the Sepan Civil War. Imperial forces encountered the Bezil as Dimok starships staged a raid on the Ripolus supply convoy Asbo.
Bredis was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle owned and operated by Ripoblus forces during the Sepan Civil War.
The Falx was a Corellian Engineering Corporation Assassin-class corvette that was owned and operated by Dimoks during the Sepan Civil War.
Delphine was a cargo ferry used by Dimok forces during the Sepan Civil War. Delphine aided other Dimok starships in raiding a Ripoblus supply convoy in the beginning of the Imperial Sepan campaign.
Phantele was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle beloging to Ripoblus forces during the Sepan Civil War.

Keydon was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by Dimok forces during the Sepan Civil War. In an attempt to end the war by capturing the leaders of both the Dimoks and the Ripoblus, Imperial forces, under the command of Admiral Harkov boarded shuttle Keydon, along with shuttle Ph…
Glaive was a cargo ferry Dimok forces used during the Sepan Civil War. It was present at the Battle of Sepan 8.
Godendag was a cargo ferry Dimok forces used during the Sepan Civil War. It was present at the Battle of Sepan 8.

The Red Terror was an automated police force that consisted of five hundred Warden 10-24 security droids. When Brakiss took over the droid factory world of Telti, he requested five hundred Warden 10-24s from Ulban Arms to provide security for the moon.

Maramus were herbivorous furred creatures on the forest moon of Endor. They stood upright on powerful hoofed hindlegs and moved by hopping and jumping. They had forearms which also ended in hooves, prominent horns jutting from the sides of their heads, manes, and long tails.
The Galactic Institute of Anthropology was an institution that at some point published the works Mandalorians: Identity and Its Influence on Genome and Mandalorians: Identity and Language.

Gal Milnor was a planet that housed the main supply base used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic to store food, munitions and fuel. The base, along with a sizeable fleet of Alliance freighters, was destroyed by the Galactic Empire shortly before the Battle of Endor.
The Executive Board was an organization consisting of the highest-ranked officials in the Tagge Corporation, a wealthy and powerful company owned by the Tagge family.
Redhawk was a mercenary bulk cruiser affiliated to the mercenary base Falcon's Nest.
Tolig IV was a planet located within the Tolig system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Stardust was a Muurian transport that carried musicians of the Dunari's Rest when the latter was attacked by Imperial forces. The ship and its crew escaped to hyperspace intact thanks to assistance from the Rebel Alliance.

Lendros was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle on which Golov Nakhym attempted to escape the Hurrim Base during the combined assault by Rebel Alliance forces and Dunari's Longshot. The shuttle was disabled and Nakhym was captured by a Storm Unit.

Omicron 5 was an Imperial Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle which escorted BFF-1 bulk freighters Degathem and Anterab to deliver research supplies to Grand Admiral Zaarin's XQ6 Platform Research during the Galactic Civil War.
Denus was a city on Foundry. It was home to one of Wat Tambor's many residences.

Lucky Day was a YT-1300 captured by Imperial forces during the Galactic Civil War. Following information from Imperial Intelligence to the Galactic Electronics Corporation XQ2 Platform Pondut, Imperial forces stripped the facility of all technology, to include the Mag-pulse To…

The Rebel Alliance employed the cargo ferry Bujiboi during the Galactic Civil War. Bujiboi arrived near XQ3 Platform Pondut during the "Arms Race" after Imperial assault forces had successfully disabled all Galactic Electronics craft in the system.

Fastooni was a C-3 passenger liner which contained passengers. The liner, along with a group of other civilian vessels, some of which contained Bothans who made a reconnaissance mission on the Second Death Star, was held up by the Accuser, which also bought the Immobilizer 418…

place: Deep space, near the Blair Cluster
conflict: Galactic Civil War (Imperial Task Force Vengeance)
x: The battle near the Blair Cluster was a battle of Task Force Vengeance during its operation in the Airam sector.

The Welmo Darb was a Galactic Alliance Star Destroyer assigned to the First Fleet. It served as the flagship of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu, the joint commander of the First and Sixth fleets, replacing his older flagship the Admiral Ackbar.

The Night Blades were a starfighter squadron made up of Jedi pilots flying StealthX fighters, led by Jedi Master Saba Sebatyne. This was one of the six squadrons which comprised the StealthX wing led by Grand Master Luke Skywalker.

Shadow Saber squadron was a starfighter squadron made up of Jedi pilots flying StealthX fighters, led by Jedi Master Kyp Durron. It was one of the six squadrons which compromised the StealthX wing led by Grand Master Luke Skywalker during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Dark Sword was the name of a starfighter squadron made up of Jedi pilots flying StealthX attack fighters and led by Jedi Master Kenth Hamner.
Spidery nightgliders were rare animals native to the planet Altarrn. Considered premium pets, they were sold at Sabodor's pet shop on the planet Etti IV.

9T-LOM was a LOM-series protocol droid owned by a Rodian accountant named Soolehad. At the time of the early stages of the Yuuzhan Vong invasion, Soolehad went by the pseudonym Falloon so as to avoid capture.

Ellichon was an Airam Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle. During the operations of Task Force Vengeance, it was unfortunate enough to cross paths with the Star Destroyer Rage and the Interdictor Cruiser Compellor near the Blair Cluster where the two Imperial vessels were watching…

Redeye was an Airam starship. During the operations of Task Force Vengeance it was misfortunate enough to cross paths with Star Destroyer Rage and Interdictor Cruiser Compellor near the Blair Cluster where the two Imperial vessels were hunting illegal activity.
Anat was an Airam Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser.

The Gilder was a Rebel Alliance GR-75 medium transport during the Galactic Civil War. During the operations of Task Force Vengeance, it was misfortunate enough to fall prey to Star Destroyer Rage and Interdictor Compellor during the two Imperial vessels' hunt for illicit activ…

government: Alliance to Restore the Republic Sector Command
x: Tel III was the third planet of the Tel Minor system, located in the Expansion Region.

Gokobs were a species of friendly, hairless rodents found in the canopies of the forests of Ossus. When frightened, they sprayed a stinking mist. Gokobs spent much of their time scavenging off food scraps and potams from the Jedi academy kitchens.
TC-11 was a TC-series protocol droid owned by the Trade Federation. TC-11 accompanied Gode Takrab to the surface of Naboo during the Trade Federation's invasion of the planet.
A-3TO was a green-plated protocol droid who welcomed any mercenary or smuggler visiting The Yard on the world of Valgauth. He helped them get in touch with Syndicate One.
The Grand Master's offices were a series of chambers located within the High Council Tower of the rebuilt Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
Skone II was a planet in the Skone system of Brak sector, located in the Expansion Region. The planet was capable of foodstuff production and had manufacturing capabilities.
Mallet Squadron was an Airam starfighter squadron made up of R-41 Starchasers. It was attached to the Airam dreadnaught Anat.

The Goya was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by Imperial forces during the Galactic Civil War. Transport Goya reloaded warheads for essential TIE starfighters attacking Nebulon-B frigate Akaga at the Treachery at Ottega.

conflict: Galactic Civil War (Imperial Task Force Vengeance)
x: A battle involving the XQ5 Platform Goff taking place during Imperial Task Force Vengeance's operations in the Airam sector.

A Hoosha was a large flying creature that was able to generate electricity within its body to use as a weapon against fleeing prey. The Hoosha was able to sneak up on its airborne enemies and shock them with a powerful blast of electricity.
Flan was an Airam Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that was present at Goff Platform during the Imperial attack there. it was destroyed along with the rest of the defense force.
C-7NO was an protocol droid assigned to the Alliance Special Forces, Team 19. The droid worked under the direction of Sergeant Whumparrin.
C-D20 was an Alliance translator droid paired with R2-RD on assignment to Commander Dauntarist aboard a new HT-2200 medium freighter.
Qualtrough was a terrestrial planet located in the Qualtrough system of the Outer Rim Territories' Belsmuth sector. Its native population was at one point engaged in an intense worldwide civil war.
The Lakra were a species that originated in Wild Space's Lakra system. Lakra settled the planet Kariek, home to the Eickarie species, and entered a centuries-long civil war with them.
CZ-22 was a battered CZ-series secretary/comm droid that served as the controller of the spaceport on Engebo V. The droid's work involved welcoming committee and customs inspections.
The United Tribes Command was the military force of the United Tribes of Kariek, the government of the planet Kariek in 22 ABY.

conflict: Galactic Civil War (Imperial Task Force Vengeance)
x: The Battle of Rocrin was a bloody conflict that occurred during the operations of Task Force Vengeance in the Airam sector.

x: The InterTribal Council was the governing body of the United Tribes of Kariek and was composed of several leaders from different tribes.
Nobu 1 was a Rebel Alliance Cargo ferry which served in the Airam sector during the operations of Task Force Vengeance.
Nobu 2 was a Rebel Alliance Cargo ferry which served in the Airam sector during the operations of Task Force Vengeance.
Nobu 3 was a Rebel Alliance Cargo ferry which served in the Airam sector during the operations of Task Force Vengeance.
Nobu 4 was a Rebel Alliance Cargo ferry which served in the Airam sector during the operations of Task Force Vengeance.
Ulan Squadron was a Rebel Alliance starfighter squadron composed of T-65 X-wing starfighters. It saw service in the Airam sector where, in the end, it was destroyed.
The Anuti was a GR-75 medium transport that was part of the Rebel Alliance. It saw service in the Airam sector.
The Anuto was a GR-75 medium transport used by the Rebel Alliance. It saw service in the Airam sector.
Deadman's Hand was Dunari's personal Muurian transport.
Gilder was a Rebel Lambda-class T-4a shuttle. It was used once to transfer Rebel officials to Dunari's Rest presumably for some shipping negotiations.
Wind Runner was a Ferryboat liner seen near Dunari's Rest. It was also seen near Camen Spaceport when shuttle Merte escaped the station.
Dusk Trader was a MB-C1 medium transport seen near the Imperial customs station to Zhar during the Mission to Zhar.
Fiery Dawn was a YT-2400 light freighter seen in Outpost 327 during the Mission to Zhar.
Deuterium was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle of the same group as Tydirium. It was found departing Outpost 327 by the Sabra when the latter docked the station in the Mission to Zhar.

EG-67 was an EG-6 power droid for sale at Jawa Traders in Mos Eisley during the Galactic Civil War. His memory had been wiped haphazardly many times, resulting in fragments of memory of former owners and previous events.

EV-2-E was an EV-series supervisor droid manufactured by MerenData. Sometime between the years 2 BBY and 4 ABY, it served in the Alliance Fleet's 14th Roving Line as a droid overseer onboard the line's flagship, the Mantan Wanderer, during the Galactic Civil War.

conflict: Galactic Civil War (Imperial Task Force Vengeance)
result: Decisive Imperial victory; capture of Rebel pilots by Imperial forces
x: During the Galactic Civil War, Imperial forces turned back a Rebel starfighter hit-and-fade against the interdictor Compellor.

The derkolo were quick and aggressive pack hunters that dwelled on the planet Sileron, in the Veron Minor system of the Mid Rim. They were one of the more common predators on Sileron. They were aggressive and individual creatures seemed to have no fear of death.
Viper Squadron was a starfighter squadron in the Alliance to Restore the Republic consisting of RZ-1 A-wing interceptors.
Rampa II, also known as Rampa, was an astronomical object in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim Territories, connected to Panna in the Cronese Mandate by the smugglers' hyperlane Bubble Wink.
The Uplands was a pastoral region on Alderaan, located on the continent of Thon.

The emerald shark was a huge species of shark. Multiple emerald sharks were part of the rainbow-colored school of fish that dwelt within a central column of water in an aquarium located on the Outer Rim Territories planet Dubrillion in 25 ABY.

The Red Hand was a criminal organization on Coruscant that undertook a series of political assassinations during the Clone Wars. They made their way around the world-city using the underground sewer network and followed the Code of the Streets.

During the Clone Wars, a lone battle droid deserted the Separatist Droid Army after being disconnected from the droid collective. A B1-series battle droid forged by the Trade Federation, the droid had no independent thought, as its thinking was done by a Central Control Computer.

A battle occurred near Esseles between the Galactic Empire and the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Endor, Imperial Navy forces were retreating from Esseles when the battle erupted in the outer Essesia system.

The planet Ralltiir was invaded by the Galactic Empire in 10 ABY. As part of the Imperial offensive prior to Operation Shadow Hand, the reborn Emperor Palpatine sent out vast forces to conquer strategic worlds in the Core.

Ardent IV was a cruiser in the service of the Galactic Republic's Judicial Forces, in which participated in the Stark Hyperspace War. Jan Dodonna, still a member of the Navy at the time, served as lieutenant on the craft during the conflict.

Gestrex III was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Gestrex system, a part of the Calaron sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was connected to the Kegan and Norval systems via the hyperlane known as the Triellus Trade Route.

headquarters: Citadel Station Ithorian Compound, Telos IV
x: Chodo Habat's herd was a herd of Ithorians working on the Telosian Restoration Project. They were led by Chodo Habat and his primary representative Moza.
Aramadia was an Imperial Super Star Destroyer used by the Duskhan League.
Furballs were creatures native to the planet Kimanan. Described as tiny, tubby, clown-ish marsupials, they were commonly kept as pets. Sabodor and Eeksa both sold them.

Red Star 1 was a modified TIE/D Defender owned by Countess Iran Ryad. The countess had her fighter painted in a red color scheme. The fighter destroyed in 5 ABY when she was charged with treason and defeated by Baron Soontir Fel.
The Knights' Billet was a set of dormitories located in the accommodation sector of the Temple of the New Jedi Order.

The Galactic Alliance Special Forces were the military special operations unit of the Galactic Alliance Defense Force, specifically part of the Galactic Alliance Army. They were formed from the New Republic Special Forces.
H-9PO was a Duorq 79 Human-Cyborg Relations Droid adopted by H'nib Statermast when the previous owner was killed outside of Farrimmer Cafe.
The stalk-eyed species was a sentient species that lived throughout the galaxy.
Bonaka Nueno was a major city on the Outer Rim planet Intuci. It was the site of a massacre led by the war criminal Gaar Suppoon while using the alias Sonopo Bomoor.

The Scupper Bantoo was a CorelliSpace Gymsnor-2 light freighter operated by the Bith Maddie Macatten in the Kathol Outback. Battered and considered to be an obsolete design by 12 BBY, the vessel formerly belonged to Macatten's enslaver.
Kann was a cargo ferry used by Rebel Alliance. The cargo ferry was part of an illicit weapons deal between the Mugaari pirates and the Rebels.
Wess was a cargo ferry used by Rebel Alliance. The Cargo ferry was part of an illicit weapons deal between the Mugaari pirates and the Rebels.

Destion was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by Mugaari pirates. It was part of an arms deal between the Rebel Alliance and the pirates in a cargo loading area located in the Tungra sector. The Imperials learned of this deal and attacked.

Prince was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by Mugaari pirates. It was part of an arms deal between the Rebel Alliance and the pirates in a cargo loading area located in the Tungra sector. The Imperials learned of this deal and attacked.

Gavial Squadron was a starfighter squadron that saw service with the Rebel Alliance Fleet. Composed of X-wing starfighters, the unit was stationed in the Airam sector during the Rebellion's operations there.

Blood Squadron was a starfighter squadron that served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Composed of BTL Y-wing starfighters, it saw combat in the Airam sector where it was assigned to the Mon Calamari MC80 cruiser Crucible.
Sundancer Squadron was a Rebel Alliance starfighter squadron composed of Z-95 Headhunters. It saw service in the Airam sector where it was assigned to the MC80 cruiser Crucible.
The Goldhawk was a YT-1300 light freighter in service of the Rebel Alliance. It served in the Airam sector during the Rebellion's operations there.

Garang was a city located on the Outer Rim world of Dantooine during the Old Sith Wars. It was the capital city and main trading hub on Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War. The city evidently did not host a large population, as Dantooine was considered to have no urban center.
Gosho IV was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.

SilverWing Squadron was a squadron of TIE/In starfighters that served the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Stationed aboard Station 2LC/Blue along with GoldWing Squadron, it formed part of that station's Imperial garrison based on Esseles.
The largest moon of the planet of Tifnyl had a thin atmosphere and primitive ecosystem. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire had placed a listening post on the moon.
Leven was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Modd was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

The Emperor's Sword was a squadron in the Imperial Military during the Galactic Civil War. Made up of elite pilots sworn to defend Emperor Palpatine, the Emperor's Sword was stationed at Coruscant but always traveled with the Emperor and were therefore present at the Death Sta…
Leeper was Bama Vook's LE-PR34 navigator droid.
The Strutters' Village was the home of the Strutters on the forest moon of Endor.
This Mon Calamari vessel was used during the Clone Wars by Mon Calamari allied with the Galactic Republic.

The StealthX wing was a starfighter force formed by the New Jedi Order, during the Second Galactic Civil War in 40 ABY. It consisted entirely of Jedi pilots, flying almost-undetectable StealthX fighters.
LIN-D2D was a LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer droid for sale at Jawa Traders in Mos Eisley. Like many LIN droids, she was reprogrammed to serve beyond her original purpose as a minelayer.

A species were the near-Human inhabitants of the planet Ventooine. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, their civilization was considered primitive by the galaxy's more progressive inhabitants, and they did not use blasters and other complicated technology despite the fact t…

M-4D0, also known as Fourdee, was a golden protocol droid that served as a porter droid aboard the luxury liner Star of Empire. In 0 ABY, the Systems Infiltration Manager took over the liner and as a result many of the on-board droids attacked the passengers and crew.
Z2-1B was a 2-1B surgical droid that went rogue and adopted an independent agenda to create the ultimate droid. Also known as The Doctor by its creations, the droid was once a regular medical droid.
N'dian was a planet located in the N'dian system, a part of the Spadja sector within the Outer Rim Territories and Trans-Hydian regions.
The Nalmar Family was once the largest criminal organization on Genesia, and controlled much of the illicit activities in Brak sector.
Doolis Podrace Arena was a Podracing course within the capital city of Doolis on the planet Caprioril.
Stimsenj'kat was an MC80 Star Cruiser in the Alliance Fleet.

Ground-eels were a species of animal found on the planet Qiilura that made fluting courtship calls when attempting to find a mate. In 22 BBY, the Jedi Padawan Etain Tur-Mukan heard the mating calls of several ground-eels while she was hiding in a field of barq on Qiilura.

The Kirmay clan was a group of individuals who owned a farm near the city of Imbraani on the Mid Rim planet Qiilura by 22 BBY. The clan lost the property when Ghez Hokan, a Mandalorian serving in the Confederacy of Independent Systems, sold the group to Trandoshan enslavers.
Weed-eels were a type of silver-colored eel found in the Braan River on the temperate Mid Rim planet Qiilura in the year 22 BBY.

Raider was a mercenary cargo ferry. It attempted to steal from the Azzameens in 3 ABY, but it was destroyed by Ace Azzameen.

Vembri was a Muurian transport owned by bounty hunters working for Viraxo Industries. It was destroyed near Destreg II in 3 ABY by Ace Azzameen and his brother Emon after their failed assassination attempt on K'Armyn Viraxo's life.
Tolarus was a Muurian transport owned by Viraxo Industries. It was destroyed near Destreg II in 3 ABY by Ace Azzameen and Emon Azzameen after they tried to assassinate K'Armyn Viraxo.
Halberd was an Imperial Navy Ton-Falk-class escort carrier.

Omicron was an Imperial Gamma-class assault shuttle that was stationed near Comm Center. It attempted to stop the Azzameen family from hacking into one of the station's satellites by deploying spacetroopers. It was either driven off or destroyed.
Vanguard was an Imperial Victory II-class Star Destroyer. The ship protected a convoy passing the Eidoloni system, which carried material for the Second Death Star.
Victory 1 was an Imperial Victory II-class Star Destroyer. It was the vessel responsible for the destruction of the two Rebel Nebulon-B Frigates Cruuz and Fox in the Battle of the Bajic Shipyards.
Victory 2 was an Imperial Victory II-class Star Destroyer. It destroyed the Rebel Bulk cruiser Fairfax in the Battle of the Bajic Shipyards.
Broadside was a Hurrim Marauder-class corvette. It was destroyed by Rebel forces in 4 ABY when they destroyed the Hurrim Base.
Plank was a Hurrim Marauder-class corvette. It was destroyed by Rebel forces in 4 ABY while defending the besieged Hurrim Base.
The Bettel asteroid drift was located near the Hoth system. It was used as a stopover point for Imperial fleets in 3 ABY.
The Battle of Hospital was a skirmish that erupted between forces of the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic some time in 3 ABY in the aftermath of the Battle of Hoth.
The Destruction of the Scythe convoy was a hit and fade attack that was conducted on an Imperial convoy by the Alliance to Restore the Republic that took place in 3 ABY.

The Battle of Bettel was a conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic that took place in 3 ABY in the Bettel asteroid drift and in the Mev system. The Corrupter repair convoy headed for the Star Destroyer Corrupter was destroyed in the battle.

t: Battle of the Anoat Main Sensor Array
x: The Battle of Anoat Main Sensor Array was a conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic that took place in 3 ABY. It resulted in the destruction of the Array.
The Battle of Nomlis III was a conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic that took place in 3 ABY. It resulted in the destruction of the Bretie Facility.

The Defense of the Liberty was a battle fought between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic that took place in 3 ABY. Experimental TIEs attacked the Liberty, but it was successfully defended by the ship's fighters.
The Battle of Eidoloni was a conflict in the Eidoloni system between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic that took place in 3 ABY.

x: The Battle of Dunari's Rest was a battle that took place between the Imperial Navy and the Alliance to Restore the Republic that occurred in 3 ABY.

result: Rebel Alliance victory; Azzameen Station recaptured
x: A battle between mercenaries and the Alliance to Restore the Republic that took place in 3 ABY. It resulted in the recapture of the Azzameen Station.
Scavenger Squadron was a starfighter squadron that flew for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Motivator was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy. The vessel was destroyed by Rogue Squadron while it was trying the capture CR90 corvette Razor to obtain the Death Star II construction data onboard, resulting in it crashing on the surface of planet Kothlis.

The Cracians were a people native to the Craci system. Long before the Galactic Civil War, they domesticated the Cracian thumper as a workbeast. They eventually marketed the animals to the galaxy at large, to whom they became indispensable pack and riding animals.
Tran Mariel was a planet located within the Tran Mariel system of the Core Worlds and the homeworld of the Runyip.

The beetul was an insectoid creature, native to the forest planet Kubindi. They were found in the Silver Forest of Dreams. Some species were large enough for Kubaz to ride on, while others were quite small. One species was iridescent blue.

The spydr was an insectoid creature, native to the forest planet Kubindi. They were found in the Silver Forest of Dreams. The meat of the spydr was thought to be a delicacy in some cultures. The ghost spider was one spydr species.

The flii was an insectoid creature, native to the forest planet Kubindi. They grew up to two meters in length and were found in the Silver Forest of Dreams. One species had green and yellow stripes. Other species included the Fyreflii, the Mayflii, and the Wingflii.
The wingflii was a giant insectoid creature, native to the forest planet Kubindi. They were found in the Silver Forest of Dreams. It was similar to the flii.
Msqitos were a species of large flying insects native to the planet Kubindi. While the species laid their eggs near water, as adults they lived in forests, such as the Silver Forest of Dreams.
The mayflii was a two-meter long, green insectoid creature, native to the forest planet Kubindi. They were found in the Silver Forest of Dreams. They laid eggs in the swamp.

Fyrefliis were a large insect species of bioluminescent flii native to the planet Kubindi. On their homeworld, which was frequently subject to solar flares, the species could be found within the Silver Forest of Dreams.

The aquabeast was an aquatic creature, native to the forest planet Kubindi. They were found in the Silver Forest of Dreams, and would often travel in packs. They also were very powerful swimmers, clocking in at 60 miles per hour.

The Reliant was a battle cruiser in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. Along with the Devout, it was sent to the Cularin system to enforce the Emergency Powers Act after the Almas Academy engaged the Right of Denial.

The Devout was a battle cruiser in the Republic Navy during the years of the Clone Wars. Along with the Reliant, it was sent to the Cularin system to enforce the Emergency Powers Act after the Almas Academy engaged the Right of Denial.

result: Severe damage to Outbound Flight and Vagaari fleet
x: The battle for Outbound Flight was a three way battle between Outbound Flight, Picket Force Two, and the Vagaari fleet. It culminated in the deaths of nearly all aboard Outbound Flight and most of the Vagaari fleet.
The Slader's Raider II was a DP20 gunship that was owned and operated by the pirate and smuggler Roark Slader during the early years of the New Republic.
The Handree was a DP20 gunship that was in operation with the Rebel Alliance sometime during the Galactic Civil War.

objective: Rescue Senator Meena Tills and other hostages
