The Senate Security Committee was a branch of the Galactic Republic Senate concerned with security for Senators and the Republic as a whole.
Indiko was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Galactic Empire during 4 ABY.
Darkk was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Galactic Empire during the year 4 ABY.
Shadow hunters were creatures native to the planet of Ithor. They were extremely deadly to all things, including themselves.

conflict: Galactic Civil War (Hunt for Han Solo)
x: The Battle of Ithor was fought on the Tafanda Bay in 0 ABY. Momaw Nadon led an uprising against the Imperial garrison there, ending Imperial rule of Ithor for a short time.
The Valiant was a Victory-class Star Destroyer. It was captured by the Alliance to Restore the Republic prior to 0 ABY.
The Swamp of Vapors was a treacherous locale on Togoria. It was home to the vapors and the shapers.
Mindnight Fire clan was a hunting clan on Togoria. It was led by Fassool.

habitat: Muddy banks of the Mud Worg River
x: The mud worgs were creatures native to Togoria.
Tyrannosaurs were a type of dinosaur native to Togoria. The eaters native to the planet Abonshee were similar to tyrannosaurs.
The shapers were shape-shifting creatures native to Togoria. One breed was the toothsome image.
The Bastion was a transport ship used by Jedi Master Chamma and his team of Jedi during their mission to the world of Athiss.
This red-skied planet was the site of a battle during the Clone Wars.

The Thyferran Aerospace Defense Force was formed from the Thyferran Home Defense Corps in the aftermath of the Bacta War to guard Thyferra. It was commanded by former Rogue Squadron pilot Bror Jace and trained by the Rogues.
BP-A1 was one of Boonda the Hutt's personal attendants. He revolted against his master in 0 ABY.
BP-A2 was one of Boonda the Hutt's personal attendants. He revolted against his master in 0 ABY.
K-2PQ was Boonda the Hutt's personal chef. He revolted against his master in 0 ABY.
12-4C-41's droid revolt was an event that happened in 0 ABY. In it, 12-4C-41's Droid Army rose up against its oppressors in the hope of gaining galactic domination.

The Bright Nebula was a GR-75 medium transport in service to the New Republic Defense Fleet. It was one of three GR-75 medium transports stationed at Folor Base in 7.5 ABY, and was the second transport to evacuate the moon base during the Battle of Folor.

result: Enslavement of the Geroon species and theft of a Vagaari gravity well
x: The Vagaari attempted to enslave and plunder the Geroons by attacking their homeworld of Geroon. Force Commander Thrawn used possibly one of his favorite tactics, the Thrawn Pincer here.
Amidala's Beach was a private beach island located in Naboo's Lake Country, located in close proximity to Varykino, the ancestral home owned by House Naberrie.
Kattellyn City was a city on the planet Atraken.
The Battle of Vactooine was an engagement between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and 12-4C-41's Droid Army that took place on the planet Vactooine in 0 ABY.
This celestial body was the largest of Vactooine's orbiting moons.

B-1D4, otherwise known as Beewondeefor, or her codename, The Heart of Steel, was an Imperial droid purchased by Leia Organa in 0 ABY. Unbeknownst to them at first, Wondeefor was actually an extremely powerful Imperial weapon devised by Grand Moff 4-8C.
The M'hendosat was a Predator-class warship under the command of the pirate Captain Kassihm. It was destroyed by Rebel agents in 0 ABY.

The Imperial Department of Redesign, also known as the Imperial Redesign Team, was an elite, highly secretive corps of the Galactic Empire, tasked with subduing or liquidating troublesome non-Human species, which was to be achieved through the secret project "The Heart of Stee…
Kassihm's Pirates were a group of space pirates under the command of Captain Kassihm. A large portion of them were killed in 0 ABY.

Bronsoon was a trading port on the original Gordian Reach founded by Human colonists from the Core in ancient times. Bronsoonians had strict rules about gender relations, with laws governing everything from marriage between casts to making eye contact and who could walk where.
Therenor Prime was a planet located in the Doldur sector of the Mid Rim. At some point, the protocol droid C-3PO visited Therenor Prime.
Cheeyoom Matee was a planet home to a Rebel base. It was located in the Core Worlds.

t: Battle of Bright Tree Village (Stranglethorn crisis)
x: The Battle of Bright Tree Village was the defining battle of the Stranglethorn crisis between the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village and an out of control stranglethorn.
The Skirmish at the Kete hive was a minor conflict involved in the Stranglethorn crisis. The event was the result of the intrusion of two young Ewoks into the Kete hive.
Wharzogs were large creatures native to Kintan.

The Bolt was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport in the service of the Rebel Alliance. During the year 3 ABY, it was stationed at the Rebel Hospital only weeks after the disastrous Battle of Hoth.

Contel was an Imperial Container transport. The transport was part of convoy Rope 17, which was supposed to upgrade the Deep Space Manufacturing Facility ZA-13. Contel carried medical supplies for the personnel of the factory.
Vendor was an Imperial Modular conveyor. The ship was part of convoy Rope 17 which was supposed to upgrade the Deep Space Manufacturing Facility ZA-13. Vendor carried equipment for the factory.
Thunderer was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate used by the Galactic Empire. It was part of back-up at Zaarin's XQ6 Platform Research platform should the need for reinforcements be required.

Manta was a C-3 passenger liner located at an Imperial scrap yard at Tolig IV. It had Dejarik boards as its cargo. It was present there when Ace and Emon Azzameen went there to investigate the various containers to search for the data core, and when the raid took place.

Torven was a Container transport located at an Imperial scrap yard in Tolig IV. Its cargo was Motivators. It was present there when Ace and Emon Azzameen went there to investigate the various containers to search for the Data Core, and when the raid took place.

Gabi was a Container Transport located at an Imperial scrap yard in Tolig IV. Its cargo was electronics. It was present there when Ace and Emon Azzameen went there to investigate the various containers to search for their family's Comm Datacore.

Tendo was a MB-C1 medium transport in the service of the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. The vessel was part of the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Corrupters resupply convoy, which was lead by the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Monitor to where the Corrupter lay …

Sormus was a MB-C1 medium transport belonging to the Imperials. Sormus was part of the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Corrupter's vital resupply convoy lead by the Nebulon-B Frigate Monitor to the Corrupter in the Mev system. Sormus' cargo was 'Probe Droids'.

Togri was a MB-C1 medium transport belonging to the Imperials. Togri was part of the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Corrupters vital resupply convoy lead by the Nebulon-B Frigate Monitor to the Corrupter in the Mev system. Togri's cargo was 'machinery'.

Polis was a BFF-1 bulk freighter the served in the Imperial Navy. It was part of the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Corrupters resupply convoy which was lead by the Nebulon-B Frigate Monitor to the Corrupter in the Mev system.

Hilo was a BFF-1 bulk freighter belonging to the Galactic Empire. Hilo was part of the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Corrupter's vital resupply convoy lead by the Nebulon-B Frigate Monitor. The ship's cargo was durasteel. Hilo was attacked by Rebel raiders and was destroyed.

Vo was a Container transport belonging to the Imperials. Vo was part of the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Corrupters vital resupply convoy lead by the Nebulon-B Frigate Monitor in the Mev system. Vo was ferrying a fresh supply of Imperial Probe droids.
The Emerald Twilight was the starship of Sheel Odala. She used it on her trip to Void Station where she fell in with an old acquaintance.

Archon was a Nebulon-B2 frigate belonging to the Imperials. The frigate responded to the prison station Bundil II, which requested aid when the Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser VTR-LX was disabled and its prisoners were rescued as part of a Rebel operation.

The Dantooine Squadron was a starfighter squadron in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic early in the Galactic Civil War prior to the Battle of Yavin. The squadron was assigned to the Rebel headquarters on Dantooine before the base was abandoned.
Suili was a C-3 passenger liner which was used for tourism. It was present in the Nezni system where an incident between the Rebel Alliance and the Hurrim took place.
Amberhawk was Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 which contained artwork. The Amberhawk was present in the Nezni system, where the incident between the Rebel Alliance and the Hurrim took place.
Riley was an Action VI transport. The Riley was present in the Nezni system, going into the hangar of the Corvalis, where the incident between the Rebel Alliance and the Hurrim took place.
Bentor was a Muurian transport. Bentor was just about to enter the hangar of Corvalis when the incident between the Rebel Alliance and the Hurrim took place.
The Soaring Hawkbat Clan, also simply known as the Hawkbats, was one of the many clans in which prospective young Initiates were placed when they first began to learn the ways of the Jedi Order.
Virgillia 7, or Virgillia VII, was a planet located within the Virgillia system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Malagarrians were sentients native to Malagarr. Their society was highly advanced, causing them to plumb the depths of their planet's natural resources. Eventually, they turned the entire planet into a giant reactor, which backfired and quickly eradicated their race.
Stellar Manx was an Action VI bulk transport captained by Kar Lamoran. In 0 ABY, it was commandeered by the Galactic Empire for a top-secret experiment.
The Cavern of Broken Dreams was a point of interest on the Forest Moon of Endor.
The Molten Mountains was a point of interest on the Forest Moon of Endor.
The Adventurer was a Hyrotii Corporation Crescent-class transport, Mark II. It had only limited use and almost no customizations even twenty years after being bought.
The Super Star Destroyer prototype was a massive warship developed by the Galactic Empire some time after the end of the Clone Wars as part of the Sarlacc Project.

The Lost Reef was a DeepWater-class light freighter produced by Mon Calamari Shipyards for the use of Mon Calamari Commercial Expeditionary Service. During its rule, the Galactic Empire dissolved that organization, and the Lost Reef was sold in auction.

manufacturer: Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps
x: Bravo 6, or Bravo Six, was an N-1 starfighter manufactured by Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps that flew as part of the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps' Bravo Squadron. The R2-series astromech droid R2-C4 was often assigned to the starfighter's astromech socket.

The Nazren were an alien race native to the planet Nizon in Maldrood sector. They were occupied by the Galactic Empire and enslaved by Trandoshan slavers after the end of the Clone Wars, but an anti-Imperial group helped the local resistance free their world.

The Battle of M2398-3 was a small battle between Wraith Squadron and a band of pirates which used the moon Blood Nest and a local asteroid belt as their headquarters. The battle was won by Wraith Squadron, but Jesmin Ackbar was killed in a dogfight over the moon.
Argus was a Human-inhabited planet in the Argus system. When the New Order was instituted, Argus's Celestial School of Spaceflight Engineering was closed down.

The Ruby-throated kete was a species of avians that were native to the world of Bellassa. They possessed pale faces and red throats, as did Kestrel when he grew angry, a similarity observed by Trever Flume.
A Super Star Destroyer affiliated with the Imperial Remnant was present at the Imperial capital planet of Bastion in 28 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The lrashtash was a creature native to the planet Usean II. It was a herbivore feeding primarily on rocket grass.

Ooo-sek was one of the first Rodian colony worlds. Its swamps were home to a carnivorous species of plant known as yo'uqiol, Rodese for "Hand of Death." Ooo-sek also boasted vast jungles rife with flora and fauna, making it an ideal hunting ground for adventurous Rodians to tr…

The Tyberious Institute of Xenobiology was an institute from which a group of researchers at one point visited the celestial body Randorn 2. There, the xenobiologists discovered in swamps millennia-old shells of the local ibliton mollusk.

type: Group of Wookiees allied with Czerka
x: Wookiee collaborators were those Wookiees who had aligned themselves with Chuundar, the Chieftain of Rwookrrorro Village before and during the Jedi Civil War and the opening skirmish of the Rebellion on Kashyyyk.
The Valley of Blizzards was a geographic feature on the planet Alzoc III. Located near a Talz village and its Imperial mines, blizzards swept through the valley.
The Resurgence was a Nebulon-B escort frigate used by the Alderaanian Resistance following the end of the Clone Wars. It was in the service of Bail Organa and captained by Adrian Verana.

The Battle of Bespin occurred some time after the end of the Clone Wars, when a group of freedom fighters under the Alderaanian Resistance attempted to prevent a shipment of Nazren slaves to the Galactic Empire for use in the Sarlacc Project.

The Battle of Nizon occurred some time after the end of the Clone Wars. The Alderaanian Resistance assisted the Nizon resistance in driving the Galactic Empire, and their Trandoshan slaver allies, off Nizon.
The Battle of the Resurgence occurred some time after the end of the Clone Wars, when a group of the Alderaanian Resistance were escaping from a mission on Coruscant.

E-10 was a protocol droid owned by the wealthy Human heir Dezono Qua, with whom the droid lived on the planet Esseles. Under orders from Qua, E-10 prepared and cooked a number of young slaves that its master had purchased and wished to eat.

Bocatts were predatory creatures native to the desert planet Tatooine. They had brown, leathery hide and two tusks. In 1 ABY, a cargo containing bocatts in cages was shipped to Tansarii Point Station, a space station in the Bright Jewel system.
The Battle of Antar 4 was a skirmish between the Antarian Rangers and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Sarm was a yellow planet in Wild Space which had been inhabited by an unknown species which built a vast irrigation canal network across the planet. When the Utegetu Nebula erupted, however, it scoured the planet clean of its population, leaving only the canal network behind.
The Battle of Ando was a skirmish between the Separatist government of Ando and the Republic members of the Andoan Free Colonies during the Clone Wars. As such, it was an Aqualish civil conflict.

The Battle of Esseles took place five months after the First Battle of Geonosis. When a Separatist-funded government faction declared that the planet had joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems, a Republic loyalist resistance movement was formed.
H2 was a pilot droid for Dezono Qua, an Esseles native and sadistic cannibal. After Jedi Master Dass Jennir killed Qua, he took the droid for himself.

t: Mission to Mos Eisley (Galactic Civil War)
objective: Free enslaved Rebel Alliance members held prisoner
x: Around 0.5 ABY, the Mandalorian bounty hunter Boba Fett captured a group of Rebel Alliance members that included Admiral Gial Ackbar.
Brint-wo was a large ringed planet that was orbitted by the Brint-wo Colony.

result: Defeat and exile of A'Sharad Hett, Tusken Raiders retreat
x: A duel occurred on the planet Tatooine in the year 17 BBY between two Jedi who had escaped the Jedi Order's extinction in Order 66—A'Sharad Hett and Obi-Wan Kenobi.
3-S was a chrome-colored droid owned by the Chiss pirate Captain Swagg, prior to the Invasion of Naboo.

Greater Galam was a gas giant and the third planet orbiting the star Lan in the Outer Rim's Lan system. It had sixteen moons and was situated within the Hook Nebula. Greater Galam and its star system were discovered by the Galactic Republic around 1300 BBY.
Lesser Galam was a moonless planet, the first from the star Lan of the Lan system. By the time of the Galactic Empire, underground mining colonies had been constructed on the planet.
4-S was a chrome-colored droid owned by the Chiss pirate Captain Swagg, prior to the Invasion of Naboo.
5-S was a chrome-colored droid owned by the Chiss pirate Captain Swagg, prior to the Invasion of Naboo.
The Battle of Tibrin of 22 BBY was a failed Galactic Republic attempt to oust the Confederacy of Independent Systems' military presence from the planet Tibrin during the Clone Wars.
A skirmish took place in 0.5 ABY during the Galactic Civil War on the planet Ord Mantell between the Rebel Alliance and Empire.
The Fortressa was a modified Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc. Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter commissioned by the Trade Federation megacorp.

The Stenness Raider was one of the two ore-raiding ships used by the pirate captain Finhead Stonebone in 3999 BBY to raid Ithullan ore haulers. It was a modified Byblos Drive Yards E-2 asteroid mining vehicle.
3B-IR was a black-colored protocol droid owned by the Metatheran Cartel.

result: Sith revealed after a millennium of alleged extinction
x: The Duel on Tatooine was fought between the Sith Lord Darth Maul and Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn during the Invasion of Naboo.
Operation Shadowplay was a psychological-warfare operation staged by the Rebel Alliance during the Nishr Campaign.

A space battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire occurred in the Graveyard, the remains of Alderaan after it was destroyed by the Death Star around 0.5 ABY during the Galactic Civil War.

C-4ME-O, or Fourmio, was a secretary droid stationed on MedStar Four during its deployment to Despayre in 0 BBY. It stood on a single gyroscopically balanced wheel. It was later assigned to aid Dr. Kornell Divini during his stint aboard Death Star I.
A battle occurred between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic on the planet Kolaador during the Galactic Civil War.
The Leveler was a modified Acclamator-class assault ship that served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars, captained by Gilad Pellaeon.
Ragithian Humans were Near-Humans who inhabited the high-gravity world of Ragith III.

The Geyser Sea was a body of water located on the planet of Akuria II. The sea was kept warm through a system of hot geysers beneath it that also seemed to have the effect of changing the color of the water to an orange hue.

Sim-First was the capital city of Simpla-12. The city was heavily criminal-infested. The buildings didn't have strong foundations, so they would sink into the mud. It is unknown how many lived there but it was said the population was dense due to the criminal activity.
Wrench was an R2-series astromech droid that belonged to Rhys Dallows, and was his most loyal companion. Wrench's serial number was unknown.
The greelor was a quadrupedal carnivore. It had seven-toed feet, pale scales, a long tail, and a long, toothsome snout.
The raid on Golrath Station was a battle between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance in 3 ABY for control of a former Rebel base, Golrath Station.
The MEC trooper was a heavily armed and armored specialized class of clone trooper variants deployed during the Clone Wars.
Warlord was a Victory II-class Star Destroyer in service in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

Unit 416 was a B1-series battle droid member of MT-7's unit while it was deployed to Akiva, a jungle planet in the Outer Rim, during the Clone Wars. During the war, at the onset of the monsoon season the unit was split and deployed to the field.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: The Skirmish at Chinshassa was a brief battle between Rebel pilots under the command of Red Leader Luke Skywalker and the nomad warriors known as Em'liy in the supposed home city of Lieutenant Shira Brie on Shalyvane.
Evil Supreme was a battle/gladiator droid that worked at Mondo-Mod the Hutt's Arena of Doom. By the time of the Clone Wars, the droid had become the champion of the Arena.

Aridka was a rocky planet that served as a battleground between Galactic Republic and Separatist forces during the Clone Wars. The planet was covered in abandoned cities, which were surrounded by cliffs and the ruins of temples and obelisks.
Khons was a moon of the planet Lok. Nym staged an assault on the planet from this moon.

A battle occurred in 32 BBY on Lok between the Trade Federation and the Lok Revenants following a space piracy operation. The battle consisted of three primary engagements between the two organizations. In the end, the pirates were forced to abandon their base.
Y4-E was a silver-colored protocol droid owned by the Metatheran Cartel.
LS-121 was a golden protocol droid owned by the Metatheran Cartel.
The gackle bat was a nocturnal flying predator native to Yavin 4. Their primary food source were stintarils which they killed by injecting a muscle relaxant with their fangs.

A swap meet was a means of bartering between Jawas. One, the Great Swap Meet, also known as Dune Sea Haggleday, was held in the Dune Sea. At these meets, Jawas would arrange marriages for clan members and trade between each other.

Virevols were a non-sentient species of saber-toothed rat found only on Despayre, a prison world in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The virevol could grow to the size of wolves, and were considered formidable creatures by the prisoners on Despayre.
Dungeontown was a makeshift prisoner shantytown on the Imperial prison planet Despayre.
Pizkoss was a planet in the Core Worlds. Two months after Order 66, the Uhumele stopped there to get a new transponder, and Janks was taken into custody by stormtroopers.
A duel between two Force users occurred on the planet Terephon in the year 40 ABY, being the fifth and final confrontation between Jedi Grand Master Luke Skywalker and Lumiya, Dark Lady of the Sith.
Bogden 3, or Bogden Three, was one of the twenty moons of Bogden, a planet located in the Inner Rim.
The Thorn monster was a giant walking vegetable beast made by Morag. The creature was able to persecute the young Ewoks Wicket Wystri Warrick and Princess Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka.

result: Camper takes the exogorths to the Unknown Regions
x: The First Battle of Omonoth, also known as the Adasca affair or Project: Black Harvest, was fought during the Mandalorian Wars in the year 3963 BBY. It was a three-way skirmish between the Galactic Republic, the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, and the security forces of Adascorp.

Scorpion slugs were a non-sentient species native to Despayre, an Outer Rim Territories planet. They were named for the stinger on the end of their tail, which could cause weeks of agony for many humanoid species until the victim either recovered or perished due to the potent …
Slashtown was a prisoner colony on the Imperial prison planet Despayre.

Ton-Falk was a celestial body located in the Ton-Falk system, a part of the Pakuuni sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the Overic Griplink hyperspace route, which linked it to the Florn and Pakuuni systems.

The Skirmish in the Ruby Nebula was an attempt by the Trade Federation to capture Reti, a member of the Lok Revenants who attempted to meet Jedi Master Adi Gallia. When Reti met Gallia, the Jedi realized that Reti had been followed, much to his surprise.
The Skirmish over Saleucami occurred when the bounty hunter Boba Fett, set out to collect the bounty on captured Alliance to Restore the Republic scout party led by Admiral Ackbar over Saleucami.

This monkey was a small creature from the Outer Rim world of Cophrigin V. One of these creatures was in the company of an exiled Jedi, An'ya Kuro, when Darth Vader arrived on the planet to eliminate her in 1 BBY.

The Battle Lance was a 1,600 meter–long Imperial II-class Star Destroyer manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards that served in the Imperial Navy. Sometime before the Battle of Yavin, the warship was selected to test an improved prototype hypermatter reactor.

The Undauntable was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer. Commanded by Admiral Jaim Helaw, it was the oldest ship on the line in its quadrant, but was maintained in excellent condition under Helaw's command.

The Lillibanca was a cruiser that served in the Confederation Fleet in the aftermath of the Battle of Kashyyyk in 40 ABY during the Second Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Alliance and the Confederation.

t: Battle of Commenor (Second Galactic Civil War)
result: Galactic Alliance victory; Commenorians retaliate with biological warf
x: The Battle of Commenor took place during the Second Galactic Civil War.

YVH-908 was a YVH droid assigned by Jacen Solo to guard Allana. 908 went everywhere Allana went, and accompanied her several times on the Anakin Solo where 908 would be destroyed by Han and Leia Organa Solo during their rescue of Allana.
The Vacant Valley was a point of interest on the Forest Moon of Endor.
Light Brigade Division was a brigade of starfighter corps in the Grand Army of the Republic during the last year of the Clone Wars. The brigade included HOB-147, who flew a V-19 Torrent starfighter.
The Gar'glum Sea was a large body of organic gelatin on Galantos. The city of Gal'fian'deprisi was built half above, half sunk into the Gar'glum Sea.
The Indefatigable was one of six Inexpugnable-class tactical command ships to serve the Galactic Republic during the Mandalorian Wars.
The Swiftsure was one of six Inexpugnable-class tactical command ships to serve the Galactic Republic during the Mandalorian Wars.
This horned goat was a herbivorous quadruped from the Outer Rim world of Cophrigin V.

Gaftikar was a planet in the Outer Rim. Some time before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, the mercenaries known as the Brig Stompers wiped out the planet's entire defense force during a coup.
Eyat was a city on Gaftikar with population of 500,000. It was destroyed by the third and fifth battalion of the 35th infantry with help from Omega Squad and Marit militia.
Salt mynocks were a subspecies of the parasitic Mynock that lived on the barren Mid Rim planet Lok.
Napdu was the fourth moon of the planet Da Soocha. Azzim Anjiliac Atirue had a high-end spa called Maya Armus there.

Marits were a species of sentient beings brought by Human colonists to the world of Gaftikar, a forested planet with vast grassy plains. They were meter-tall reptilian humanoids. The Marits had light beige scales that were slightly iridescent.

x: The Duel on Byss was a lightsaber duel between Luke Skywalker and Palpatine in the latter's Clone Labs on Byss.

Grayfeather Squadron was a BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter squadron in the Commenorian defense force, comprising at least five of the heavy fighters. It was commanded by Caregg Oldathan during the battle of Commenor.

place: Near New Cov, in the Churba sector
x: A short but violent battle occurred near the planet New Cov between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. A month after General Garm Bel Iblis forces' raid on Tangrene, Iblis met the Bothan Alliance member Borsk Fey'lya.
The Mawgax was a large bipedal herbivore that lived in the forests of Yavin 4. It used its sharp beak to defend itself.

Located in the planet Taris's orbit, the South Orbital Area was a staging area used around 3963 BBY by the Mandalorian Neo-Crusader warriors during their siege of the world as part of the galaxy-wide Mandalorian Wars.
The Parjai (Mando'a for "Victory") was a Kandosii-type dreadnaught that fought at the Siege of Taris.
The Lupus Maroo was a medium freighter used by the Black Sun organization. In 1 ABY the ship was used to transport salvage of the destroyed Death Star from the moon Yavin 4.

Senta was the capital city of the planet Belasco. It was constructed centuries before the Clone Wars. The city was home to the palace were the royal family that ruled Belasco lived. It sat on top the golden hills that overlooked the Great Sea.
Hawkbat was a supply ship in the fleet of Warlord Zsinj.
Ill Wind was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer assigned at the time of the Battle of Endor under the command of Warlord Zsinj. It later participated in the Battle of Kuat.
The Emperor's Net was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser that joined Warlord Zsinj. It later participated in the Battle of Kuat.
A space battle was fought over the planet Kessel between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Snowmice were small, rarely-seen, land-scavenging rodents native to the icy wilderness of the planet of Hoth.

Stennes were a Near-Human sentient species from the planet Stennaros. A Force-sensitive offshoot of their species, the Stennes Shifters, were subject to millennia of persecution that led to many Stennes also being killed.

Ulda Frav was a tropical Expansion Region planet located in the Hangshan sector. Located in widely explored space by 5000 BBY, by 3998 BBY the world was visited by both a group of Jedi who arbitrated a treaty there and the Nazzar Crown Prince Qrrrl Toq.
Droid Caller was the personal transport of the droid researcher Osaji Uhares. The starship shared its name with droid callers, a device used to control droids.
The Pestage was a Victory-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy during the height of the Galactic Civil War.

The Pilum was a Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport in the service of the Ripoblus government. It served in the Sepan Civil War during the year 3 ABY. It was destroyed by Maarek Stele of the Galactic Empire during the Battle of Science Station Youst.

The Sword was a Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport operated by the Ripoblus in the Sepan Civil War in 3 ABY. It fled from Science Station Youst just as Imperial forces came to defend the Dimoks in the concurrent battle.
The Battle of Gaftikar was a Clone Wars battle that resulted in a Republic victory.

Flits were non-sentient flying reptiles native to the planet Lok. They had thick hides and extremely sharp beaks as well as a number of poisonous barbs, making them a dangerous predator. Flits were also found on Ord Mantell's Tansarii Point Station and the prison world Despayre.
The A-23 Treeduster was a type of shuttle made by Incom Corporation. The ship had a substantial cargo capacity.
R2-BDE, better known as Beedibeedi, was Boonda the Hutt's R2-unit.
Lorda Doma Toma was Quaffug the Hutt's personal staryacht.
The Prosperous Secret was Borvo the Hutt's personal spaceyacht.
The Jade was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle owned and operated by the Bothan Spynet. It was active during the year 4 ABY.
The Reprisal was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser of the Imperial Navy.
R-55 was a police droid on Vorzyd V. In 1 ABY, R-55 responded when C-3PO called out for help after Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa had been captured by Blackhole troopers.

Dokma were small, timid gastropods native to Atollon. Often preyed upon by the spider-like krykna, they had protective shells and two eyestalks. Garazeb Orrelios nicknamed them "bogans." According to Volt Vescuso, the amount of milk a dokma drank was not to be underestimated.

The Alliance Veteran's Victory Association, or AVVA, was a retiree's club for Alliance to Restore the Republic veterans with the ambition to be something more. Its members considered themselves for a reserve role in the the New Republic Defense Fleet.

Lankor VI was the sixth planet in its system, and was orbited by three moons. It had a temperate climate and was home to the Lankorians, an intelligent species of skinny bipeds, with long arms and a sugar-loaf shaped head.
Yuka was the thirteenth and outermost planet in the Kamino system. It partly shared its name with the second planet of the system, Yuka Major.

6Y-2KPR was a green-domed KPR security droid manufactured by Lerrimore Droids. In 0 BBY, this droid was in the possession of Nebit's Jawa tribe and it was stored on the same sandcrawler that held R2-D2 and C-3PO captive after they escaped from the Tantive IV.
Crystan V was an object located in the Deep Core. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, it was inhabited by a little green beings.
Vrobals were a type of carnivorous pig species that were native to the moon Rori. They had a large snout, long ears, a tail and light-colored leathery hide.
The Flash Fire was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser of the Imperial Navy.
A shatual was a species of animal native to the planet Mandalore in the Outer Rim. Shatuals were large creatures that made their homes in Mandalore's veshok forests.
The Sargesso asteroids were situated in the Sargesso system, a part of the Tharin sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Venom was a Victory-class Star Destroyer. It was part of Warlord Zsinj's fleet and was lost at the Battle of Selaggis.

Deck 69 was the 69th level of the first Death Star. It contained the Hard Heart Cantina and a female clothes shop within the Sector N-One area. It was destroyed along with the rest of the Death Star during the Battle of Yavin.

District 3054 was an urban district on Vorzyd V. Luke Skywalker went through it on his way to rendezvous with Natala Vanden in 1 ABY. Skywalker had been surveyed by Imperial agent O-625 until losing track of him in 3054.
Guf drolgs were large hostile reptilian creatures native to the planet Talus.

Fubarium was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle belonging to the Imperials. It was part of Deep Space Manufacturing Facility Drekker's procedure that, should the station's hull be critically damaged, the shuttle would launch, carrying officers.
Guba birds were a species of birds. They made their nests on the mountains of the Forest Moon of Endor.
Perkles were a mammalian species from the Forest Moon of Endor.
Battlefield Subjugation Floatie was an Imperial vehicle used by Dr. Raygar to steal the Sunstar from the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village.

Posi was an Imperial Modular conveyor that was to pick up munitions at the Elliirad Platform while the platform was under attack by a Rebel Alliance strike force consisting of Y-wings what were targeting the freighters, A-wings attempting to provide starfighter support for the…
Tretons were vicious beasts native to the planet of Aesolian.
A duel took place in the year 22 BBY, between renowned Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and the Dark Acolyte Asajj Ventress, in the Underlevels of the galactic capital, Coruscant.
The Imperial Ballet Company was a renowned ballet company based on Coruscant. Attending a performance by the Company was part of the Kuari Princess Grand Galactic Tour.

Rakehell Squadron was a Jedi-aligned starfighter squadron created in 40 ABY to aid in the uprising against Galactic Alliance co-Chief of State Jacen Solo, whom the Jedi Order under Luke Skywalker believed was promulgating further hostilities between the separatist Confederatio…
A species of furry, long-necked mammals lived on the forest moon of Endor.

The Reeko was a starship with a silver-green hull owned by Rodian treasure hunter Suz Tanwa. She flew the ship to the Yavin system where she made her first big break, discovering treasure left by her ancestor Suvam Tan.

Black 11, also known as Black-11, was the designation of a TIE/ln starfighter in the Imperial Black Squadron which was assigned to the Imperial Star Destroyer Steel Talon above the prison planet Despayre prior to the Battle of Yavin.
The Punisher was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy. It was once commanded by Captain Hugo Treece.

Vevut Squad was a clone commando unit that was part of the Special Operations Brigade in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
P-RC3, also known as Persee, was a librarian droid assigned to the library aboard the first Death Star.
Sunspot Squadron was a Imperial TIE starfighter squadron that was stationed in the Corellian system under the command of General Weir.
Galboron was a celestial body situated in the Galboron system, a part of the Hertae sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim.

Rehz'nor was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate belonging to the Rebel Alliance. The frigate played a supporting role during the Battle of Gaerboud IV, during which the Alliance attempted to interdict a shipment of TIE Avengers being ferried from the Sentinel manufacturing facil…
Maungurs were predatory beasts that were only known from Rishii legends.
The Bubkis was an IPV-1 System Patrol Craft used by the Airam. It was present at the Asteroid base Attila, during which time the Rebel Alliance and Airam Clan leader Tamaron were exchanging warheads.

The Mawrunner was a frigate assigned to the Second Fleet. It was active during the Second Galactic Civil War. The frigate, along with fleet admiral Tarla Limpan and a portion of the Second fleet, were destroyed by a blast from the Centerpoint Station.

Reveille was the personal Lambda-class T-4a shuttle of General Tycho Celchu during the Second Galactic Civil War. Selecting Syal Antilles as his personal pilot, he used it to travel to Endor in an attempt to negotiate with the New Jedi Order.

result: Jedi Temple saved from destruction; stolen items recovered
objective: Arrest intruder/thief within the Temple
x: During the Xanatos crisis, various robberies took place at the Jedi Temple which led to the Jedi High Council ordering Jedi Masters Qui-Gon Jinn and Tahl to uncover the thief and present him before the council for judgment.

Kar'a'katok was a Core Worlds planet that was home to the sentient Shimholt species. More than four millennia before the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Nelori Marauders launched a devastating invasion of Kar'a'katok that the Shimholt were able to eventually fight off.

Shimholt were a tall, purple-skinned sentient species native to the planet Kar'a'katok. A very long-lived race, the Shimholt were known as a friendly, agrarian species until around 4000 BBY, when Kar'a'katok was devastated by invading Nelori Marauders.
Sood was one of the three cities that were located on the planet Acherin. Considered the planet's cosmopolitan center, Sood was larger than Eluthan, and served as the planet's capital city.

The lake level was a five story facility located within the walls of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Used as a meditative retreat, the lake and beach area was a place of quiet contemplation and reflection.

The tech center of the Jedi Temple was a chamber deep in the Coruscanti structure. Staffed by members of the Jedi Order's Technical division, the machinery in this chamber controlled electrical, water, and air circulation throughout the Temple.
The Treasury room was a chamber within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant used to hold the Jedi Order's assets and those of other worlds loyal to the Order.

A species of nearly-extinct Gnithian insect was responsible for transmission of ix dbukrii in the wild. They sucked blood, and apparently fed on Gnithian oeps, which were the primary host of the ix dbukrii.

t: Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)
result: Destruction of Centerpoint Station, Victory for Jedi Coalition
x: The Battle of Centerpoint Station was a pivotal conflict during the Second Galactic Civil War, fought between the Galactic Alliance, the Confederation, and the Jedi Coalition.

result: Leadership of the Legions of Lettow falls to Arden Lyn
x: The Battle of Columus was a confrontation of the First Great Schism, a conflict fought in 24,500 BBY between the Jedi Order and the faction of dark side-adherents known as the Legions of Lettow.

The Golden Jewel was the starship assigned to Rebel Alliance Lieutenant Talnar during the Galactic Civil War. Talnar was shot down in the Golden Jewel by an Imperial Guardian-class light cruiser and forced to crash-land on the world of Naalol.
The Banshee was the modified Baudo-class star yacht used by Sirona Okeefe after the Clone Wars, in missions for the Alderaanian Resistance.
R2-R7 was a green astromech droid that served aboard the Consular-class cruiser Radiant VII with Maoi Madakor and Antidar Williams when it was destroyed by the Trade Federation.

The pink blobs were possibly semi-sentient creatures that could join together to form other objects, including various technologies, such as an OG-9 homing spider droid. Each blob had six claws, along with a metal device on its back.
Ragith III was a minor world in the Expansion Region, that had been settled by Humans for several generations by the time of the Dissolution of the Imperial Senate.
The Courageous was a highly modified YT-1300 light freighter.

The Mystic Burn was a YT-1200 medium freighter owned by Captain Harkan Resch, a small-time merchant bankrupted by the Trade Federation blockade of Naboo. Due to the blockade, he was forced to sell the ship to Deel Surool on Ohma-D'un.
Hermit spiders were dangerous arachnoid creatures living on the planet Naboo and its moon Rori.

This bird was an avian that lived on the Mud Moon of Panna. The animal had blue feathers, a long, thin beak, large and pale bulbous eyes, and long, thin legs nearly equal in length to its body, from beak to tail tip.

The Poison Moon was an Interceptor-class frigate and mercenary ship who worked with members of the One Sith. During a mission to capture or kill Alema Rar, the Poison Moon was commanded by Dician, a member of One Sith.

The Vinsor was a Galactic Alliance cruiser that saw use during the early stages of the Second Galactic Civil War. The Vinsor was deployed to support the Anakin Solo during the battle of Centerpoint Station.
The Chinnith was a Galactic Alliance troop carrier shuttle that docked to the superweapon Centerpoint Station during a battle there in 40 ABY, amidst the Second Galactic Civil War.
Lurr was a planet in the Outer Rim's Rayter sector. One of the stormtroopers that accompanied the Sith Lord Darth Vader to Cheelit killed a young woman while on the planet.

Hoszh Iszhir was a desert planet in the Core Worlds and was the homeworld of the reptilian Gektl species. Half of Hoszh Iszhir was covered in waterless deserts, while the other half was shrouded in a poisonous atmosphere.
The Talhu Slotted Peaks were a natural formation located nearby the Shaelo Cliff on the planet Harix. The Empire based a squad of TIE/LN starfighters behind the peaks.
Canaitith Mountain was the location of Kharys's fortress on Skye. The fortress was built high atop the mountain peak.
The Reciprocity was a Axehead frigate in the Republic Navy following the Great Sith War.
Spy bugs were Yuuzhan Vong creatures related to the thud bug, and used to covertly relay spy images from a distance.

The 39th Recon was an Imperial Army ground assault unit that participated in the Battle of Endor. Scout troopers in the 39th Recon were equipped with 74-Z speeder bikes that were used for reconnaissance purposes, as well as rapid transportation in combat zones.
The 27th Elite Recon was a unit in the Imperial Army.

Bull's Eye Squadron was a Galactic Republic clone starfighter squadron that was active during the Clone Wars, and typically flew customized Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighters on special ops missions.
The 31st Flight was a flight group of Confederate Navy Vulture-class droid starfighters in the service of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

L-9, or Ell-Nine, was a serving droid that worked at the Soft Heart Cantina. It was a "trash-can-sized" droid that was propelled on wheels and equipped with extendable arms and a magnetic plate atop of its head with which to anchor drinks.

The Organized Crime Unit—abbreviated as the OCU—was a division of the Coruscant Security Force and countered complex criminal organizations that proved to be far more of a threat than small-time crime.
The Taris Resistance was the name given to the armed group of Tarisians that fought against Mandalorian occupation during the Taris Siege in 3963 BBY.
Gold Squadron was a starfighter squadron that fought for the New Republic.
The Raff Syndicate was a pirate group around the time of the Mandalorian Wars. The Raff Syndicate included the Chevin Nunk Plaarvin and his many Chev slaves including Cipiter.
The Vessel was a transport starship piloted by Leox Gyasi of the Byne Guild. It was crewed by the co-pilot Affie Hollow and the navigator Geode.
The Cularin system's criminal organization, called simply the Organization by those within it, was put together by Riboga the Hutt when he arrived in the system.
The Armored Krakkiss was a giant, beige-colored armadillo-like creature native to Tatooine. It had thick plating covering its body, and its only vulnerable part was its head.
Jodaka was a planet of the Jodaka system, within the Corsair Outback area in the Hapes Cluster, a remote region in the Inner Rim and the Slice regions of the galaxy.
J'Lan was a city on Goroth Prime. 100 years prior to the Battle of Yavin, J'Lan was hit by a massive groundquake.
Kips were a sentient species native to the planet Kip. They were considered to be noticeably small in stature. Zorba Desilijic Tiure was imprisoned on their world for illegal ulikuo gemstone mining

result: Crew escapes due to sacrifice of Bastila Shan
objective: Escape from the Leviathan
x: The skirmish that took place aboard the Interdictor-class cruiser Leviathan was one of the key events of the Jedi Civil War. Occurring not long before the end of that conflict, it saw the crew of the Ebon Hawk captured by the Sith Empire's flagship.

The Blackguard was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer, that was captured by the rogue Imperial Captain—and self-proclaimed Grand Admiral—Andal Sait, with intention of selling it to the criminal organization Black Sun.
SU-B713, or Essyou, was a serving droid that was employed by the Hard Heart Cantina aboard the first Death Star. It was programmed with a feminine vocabulator.

Ratbats were a non-sentient species that lived on Despayre, a prison world in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The ratbats were caught by the prisoners working on the surface of Despayre and roasted, contributing to their meager diet.
The Tydia Rish was a small personal transport ship used by Fiolla in 0 ABY. It was hyperspace capable and boasted a sensor system capable of detecting life forms from orbit.
Tarhassan Planetary Security, or PlanSec, as it was more commonly known, was a security organization based on the world of Tarhassan during the last years of the Galactic Republic.
The Ministry of Licenses and Permits was a Galactic Republic ministry. Cherek Tuhm worked for it and was its hand-to-hand combat champion for eight consecutive years.
The Department of Health was a department within the Galactic Republic. Tinian Hanther worked for it.
The Ministry of Public Information was a Galactic Republic ministry. Livintius Sazet worked for it.
The Ministry of Education was a Galactic Republic ministry that Livintius Sazet worked for.
Mong'tar City was a city that was located on Bogg V, one of the moons of the planet Bogden.

Nirama's public asteroid was the largest asteroid within the Cularin asteroid belt, being over 400 kilometers in diameter. Nirama had a large base on the asteroid, which he had inherited from Riboga the Hutt.
KJB-87 was a cargo transport used to transfer cargo from orbital warehouses to the first Death Star during its construction over Despayre.
Hikil was a tropical planet from which lulari trees were exported.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
headquarters: Near the Grand Hall, Imperial Palace, Imperial City, Coruscant
x: The Admiralty was a ranking branch of the New Republic Navy, with Hiram Drayson in its staff during the Caamas Document Crisis. It was possibly related to Fleet Command. The Admiralty center was in the Imperial Palace, near the Grand Hall.

Naval Command, also known as Supreme Naval Command, High Command, and the Imperial Star Fleet Command, was the command structure of the Imperial Navy. It was reformed from the Naval Command of the Republic Navy and may have been related to the Admiralty.
A battle near Dantooine resulting in a Rebel victory occurred in approximately 1 BBY.
The Overt was a Republic Navy training vessel in service between 40 BBY to 35 BBY. Lieutenant Kan Pojo was the range officer and small-arms instructor onboard.
Suliana was an Agriworld in the Senex sector where fields of cotton grew.

The Omega Gaila was a cargo transport ship. The ship was used by the Galactic Empire to transport containers of ammunition from the Regional Naval Supply Area near Gall, to the Death Star I while it was under construction at Despayre.

t: Attack on the first Death Star
x: In 0 BBY, the Rebel Alliance launched an attack to preemptively destroy or significantly damage the first Death Star while it was nearing completion in orbit above the planet Despayre.
Nighthawk was a B-7 light freighter bought by Jedi Grand Master Yoda in a junkyard on Jovan Station following Asajj Ventress's, a Dark Jedi, attack on Phindar Spaceport.
Limit of Vision was a Hoersch-Kessel Seltaya-class fast courier flown by Jedi Master Jai Maruk while performing recon missions along the Hydian Way in the late stages of the Clone Wars.
The Floating Mountain was a point of interest on the forest moon of Endor. It was over the lava on the top of a volcano.
Da Soocha III was the third moon of Da Soocha.
Jygat was a major city on Mygeeto and was home to the Dressian Kiolsh Merchant Bank.

The Imperial Irmenu Navy was the seagoing military force of the Imperius, the priesthood of the ocean planet Irmenu. It patrolled the world's seas, rescuing sailors in distress, battling pirates, and preventing conflicts between Irmenu's feudal fiefs from getting out of control.
Urun Five was a planet located within the Urun system of the Expansion Region where the natives would sometimes stick non-natives on top of their trees as decorations.
Kebolar was a planet that was used for the removal of colonists from Qiilura. The Republic had already established farms for the colonists.
The Imperial Institute of Military Medicine was a medical organisation of the Imperial Military that studied the advanced aging of clone troopers in 8 BBY in the Galactic Empire.

Bogg 5, or Bogg V, was one of the moons of Bogden, a planet located on the Inner Rim of the galaxy. In 22 BBY, bounty hunter Cad Bane transported Jedi Master Ring-Sol Ambase to Bogg 5, where he surrendered the captive Jedi to Asajj Ventress.
TK-0 was a droid who assisted and was taken care of by Gaib.
Geris VI was a planet that occupied the sixth orbital position in the Geris system, a part of the Trans-Vulta sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Mid Rim.

Surcaris was a planet in the Mid Rim's Trans-Vulta sector where a group of Mandalorian mercenaries, possibly under Munin Skirata, fought. It was also the location where Munin found a young Kal Skirata.
The Republic Institute of Peace Studies was an institution of the Galactic Republic.

Folende was an agriworld located in the Folende system of the Tion Hegemony, within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Desevran Trace hyperlane linked Folende to the worlds of Desevro and Omman.

The tau serpent was a non-sentient species of serpent that lived by 20 BBY, Around that year, when Ko Sai, the Chief Scientist in charge of producing the Grand Army of the Republic, was captured by clone trooper trainer Kal Skirata and his adopted children, they clothed her in…
Liul was a planet where RC-5108/8843 blew up a gas storage facility in 21 BBY.
The Raid on Spacestation 1138 was an attempt made by Nym, leader of the Lok Revenants, to rescue prisoners, Captain Orsai in particular, on board the infamous prison called Spacestation 1138.
Star-Wake was an Envoy-class shuttle that was used during rescue operations after the Seventh Battle of Ruusan by the Army of Light.
The Anti-Republic Liberation Front, also known as the ARLF by its members, was a small group of revolutionary separatists who were dedicated to overthrowing the Galactic Republic.

The New Dawn was an Emissary-class shuttle owned by the former Supreme Chancellor Tarsus Valorum. He preferred the ship over others as he believed he did not need a luxurious ship nor much protection.

result: Attempt to abduct former Supreme Chancellor Tarsus Valorum failed
x: In 990 BBY, the Anti-Republic Liberation Front terrorist organization attempted to kidnap former Supreme Chancellor Tarsus Valorum while he was on a diplomatic mission to the planet Serenno.

The Mystic was the personal Infiltrator-series long-range fighter of Darth Bane. He acquired it through one of his various contacts. The ship was a medium-sized starfighter. It had light weapons and minimal plating, to focus on speed and maneuverability.
A lightsaber duel took place in 990 BBY between the surviving Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Bane and his apprentice Darth Zannah, against a group of five Jedi led by Lord Valenthyne Farfalla.

The Baz nitch was a species of short, bipedal creatures that lived on the remote world of Dathomir that gathered in packs. Though usually docile, they could become temperamental and aggressive when agitated.

Bolmas were reptiles that lived on Dathomir. They grazed in herds. Generally they were docile beasts, but elder males could be aggressive. Their physiology was almost exactly like a dewback, save two short shoulder spikes, and stubby eye stalks.

Brackaset were docile mount beasts that lived on Dathomir. They had an almost identical appearance to the falumpaset of Naboo. However, they are distinctly separated as a species for their skin folds that resembled armored plating.

Rhoa Kwi were a species of large, fearsome predators from Dathomir that often traveled in packs. They were bipedal reptiles with bulky square heads. Beady eyes were set in the sides of their head, and sharp biting teeth jutted from their lower jaw.

The kamurith was a species of quadrupedal, reptilian carnivore that was native to the world of Dathomir. They were characterized by their brown skin, white bellies, and impressive, long orange-back sails.

The Beast Warrior Commandos were a faction of the Beast Riders, warriors from the wilderness of the planet Onderon. During the Beast Wars, they were tasked by Modon Kira with the abduction of Princess Galia in the Iziz Royal Palace.

Reprise was a Guardian-class light cruiser owned by the Tapani Noble House Pelagia. During the Galactic Civil War period it came to the rescue of the Bright Seeker that was being attacked by the Knife's Edge when attempting to recover the hibernating brother and sister of the …

objective: Destroy the Jedi Tower and subsequently kill Cassus Fett
x: In 3963 BBY, a mission was undertaken by the Taris Resistance to destroy the Jedi Tower on Taris.
Karran beetles were a non-sentient insectoid species that were native to the planet of Karra. They used their large mandibles as weapons, and could do great damage to living flesh.

Swarmers were a non-sentient species of insects that were native to the world of Karra. When gathered in large groups, these insects could temporarily blind or deafen anything caught in the swarm by flying into open orifices in the face.
The Karran mantis was a non-sentient insect species that was native to the world of Karra.

The Bhishana Bhaga was a guardian corvette used as mobile base of operations by Arakyd Industries for Min Erethen, one of its key researchers. At its center was Sanctum Sanctorum, a modified A4 Juggernaut used by Erethen as a research lab.

The Duel on Onderon took place in 1000 BBY. After Darth Bane finished his serious business at Freedon Nadd's tomb, he used a giant Drexl to take a trip straight from Dxun to Onderon, using the dark side of the Force.
Paig was a planet located in the Expansion Region

Orryxia was a planet in the Orryxia system, in the Outer Rim Territories near Eriadu. It was home to the Orryxians, a sentient species sometimes given the derogatory nickname "Cats." It was also home to the orycat, a small woodland predator.

Deretta was a moon located in the Tarabba sector of the Outer Rim Territories, the staging point of the Deretta Destroyers, a mixed starfighter squadron of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, until their destruction prior to the Battle of Hoth.
The Battle of Polneye was the only mission of the Yevethan Purge to see local resistance result in a Yevethan casualty.
A battle was fought between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders at the planet Myrkr in 3963 BBY, during the Mandalorian Wars.
The Daynora was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Echelon One was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Echelon Two was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Gallant Haven was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Illian was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Ina'angs Star was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Neladeen was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Paragon was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Pe'aty was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Shayan was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Storm Wind was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Theed's Reach was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Thunderflame was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Titanius was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Vindicator was an Assault Frigate Mark II in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

This species of bipedal sentients lived on a planet in the Outer Rim, near the border of Galactic Republic space. Their face was split down the middle, flaring out in two flaps over a mouth full of sharp white teeth. They wore goggles over their two eyes.

Bulwark was a planet located in the Bulwark system of Wild Space. During the Galactic Civil War, Bulwark served as a Alliance to Restore the Republic safe world—a designated planet where people connected with the Alliance could live free of oppression from the Galactic Empire.
The kahmurra, also known as khmurra, was a herbivorous herd animal with bristley hide and tusks that lived on Talus.

The kima (plural: kimas) was a small species of herbivorous canines found in the wilds of Talus, one of the Twin Worlds which orbited Centerpoint Station in the Corellian system. Unique to the world, kimas were a fast and agile quadruped which hunted alone in remote rural areas.
The decay mites were insects native to Talus, found also on Corellia.
The tortur were large quadrupedal beasts native to Talus.
Paralope were grazing herd animals native to Talus.
Tabage were quadrupedal creature native to Corellia and Talus. Their eyes were covered by narrow slits, and they had small, pointy teeth. They were the prey of the dalyrake.

The mind spider was a behemothan beast of extraordinary proportions. They were known to support themselves, standing upright on their abdomens, by anchoring eight crystalline appendages into earthen canyon walls around them.

Choku were Reptavians native to Yavin 4. These quadrupeds are known for their bright fur. The males were brown and white and the females were black and white. Living and hunting in packs, they were powerfully muscled carnivores and deadly hunters.
Pral was a planet in the Jahilid Drift that was conquered by the Imperial forces under the command of General Bentilais san Sk'ar.
Koltine was a Wild Space world located within the star system of the same name as part of the Jahilid Drift region.

The Funeral of Yarael Poof took place after Master Poof sacrificed himself in order to protect Coruscant from Ashaar Khorda; an Annoo-dat radical. Poof's body was recovered after he had been stabbed by Khorda, who also died from his injuries.
The North Quadrant Intergalactic Automaton Show was an event that took place on Aargau.

The Funeral of Oppo Rancisis took place after Master Rancisis died at the hands of his one-time friend, Sora Bulq. After Bulq was slain by Quinlan Vos, Vos used his Kiffar abilities to read memories from Rancisis' body to learn his battle plan.
The Wayfarer was the ship that Roa used during his smuggling days. It was speedy and meticulously maintained. Once, Roa allowed Han Solo to pilot her through the Kessel Run.
Sith Knight was the title given to a former Sith apprentice who had completed his or her training with a Sith Master or another Sith Knight.

conflict: Imperial Period conflicts (Subjugation of the Jahilid Drift)

The Battle of Glee Anselm was a battle fought at Glee Anselm during the Clone Wars. Nautolan Commander Rin Mako fought in this battle.
Tenek was a forested planet with an electrically charged atmosphere that was located in the Mid Rim's Manda sector.
Zinn's Revenge was a modified CorelliSpace Gymsnor-3 light freighter.
Yukka was a planet under the control of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The Atomic Punk night club was located on the planet.
Carrion birds were a species of carrion birds native to the planet Saleucami. They were known to be scavengers, and were seen feasting on clone trooper bodies after the Siege of Saleucami.
The Last Thing was a modified Guardian 334-class light cruiser owned by Dorok Zalaster.
Emerald Lance was a modified YV-330 light freighter.

Port Evokk was the homeworld of con artist and gambler Tord Gamb. The locals of this planet would use ansmul-hide to make boots and jackets. The bounty hunter Sirenas Firil worked with a small guild out of Port Evokk.

Dractu was a peaceful, undeveloped planet in the Mid Rim, within the borders of Lannik Space, but far from any hyperlanes. It was the homeworld of the Dractuvian people. According to Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi, the planet had the worst food in the galaxy.
Dractuvians were a species of sentient, red-skinned humanoids from the planet Dractu. They built paved streets and resided in homes made of stone.

Dractuvian cave slugs were small, tubular creatures that lived in the caves of the planet Dractu. Although not particularly tasty, they could be eaten and were occasionally served at Dex's Diner on the planet Coruscant.
Chennis was a planet in the Expansion Region that had lost its bacta manufacturing capability.
The Battle of Skye, also known as the Battle of Marat V, was a conflict during the Clone Wars on the planet Skye.
The scaly tauntaun was a small sub-species of tauntaun native to the ice planet Hoth.
Issagra was a planet in the Issagra system. It was located approximately twelve hours hyperspace travel from Fether. Its most notable location was a large space station.

Heroc's Slayer was a modified YT-1300 light freighter used by a group of bounty hunters. They used it in pursuit of a smuggler, who was in over one hundred thousand credits in debt to the loan shark who had hired the hunters, on the agricultural world of Fether.

Alpha-2 Squad was a squad of clone troopers in the Grand Army of the Republic. Clones of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett, the soldiers of Alpha-2 Squad were sent to an unknown planet where they were killed by the energy vampire, Countess Rajine, only to later be used …

Z-18 was under the rule of the energy vampire Rajine during the Clone Wars. He previously belonged to the Jedi Knight Samuro, and led Jedi Master Mace Windu to a holocron Samuro had left when Windu was imprisoned by Rajine.

Energy Vampires were a humanoid sentient species, who drained the life forces of others by way of biting their enemies in order to feed. They had retractable serrated claws, elongated teeth, accelerated senses, and enhanced strength and speed.
Dac's moon was the single moon of Dac, also known as Mon Calamari.
Hitaka was a farming planet located in the Cademimu sector of the Outer Rim Territories, with a lush landscape of forests and mountains.
GT-9R, nicknamed Niner by his masters, was a protocol droid who served two different bounty hunters—Tirog and Thannik—around the time of the Galactic Civil War.

The Yalarans were a sentient, yet primitive, species native to the Wild Space planet Yalara. Unprepared for integration into the galaxy, their homeworld was hidden by a cloaking device created by the Jedi Master Broden Kel Verdox.
EV-7G7 was a modified masculine EV-series supervisor droid who served drinks to the patrons of the 7-Gee Lounge at Mos Espa Arena in 32 BBY.
D'aarmont was a natural quartz outcropping on Bakura, located at the confluence of the East River and West River, on top of which sat the capital of Bakura, Salis D'aar.

Prytis was the northern continent on the planet Bakura, known for massive forests and Bakuran nobles' estates. Most Bakurans lived on Prytis and the capital city of Salis D'aar was located on the continent as well.

result: The Black Curs escape with their recon report intact
x: The Battle of Moorja was a three-way battle between forces loyal to the Imperial Advisors, the rogue Moff Utoxx Prentioch, and a small force affiliated with the New Republic.

The Coruscant Classic was a swoop race that was held on the world of Coruscant, capital of the Galactic Republic, at some point prior to the year 3956 BBY. The Ithorian swoop racer Yuka Rill participated in the event.

result: Ord Vaug liberated from Imperial control
x: The Imperial prison planet of Ord Vaug was liberated by the Alliance of Free Planets shortly after the Battle of Endor.
a: Battle of Ord Vaug (Galactic Civil War)

x: Hyder was a planet. The New Republic agent Trask Lucan was born there
The Prentioch was the personal Imperial-class Star Destroyer of Moff Utoxx Prentioch.
The Burning Moon Range was a group of seven active volcanic mountains that was located on the planet of Kintan, and formed the western coastline of the Gluss'elta Sea.

The Daggersand Ridges was a location above the Skulljaw Grottoes on the Outer Rim planet Kintan. By 30 BBY, the Kajain'sa'Nikto Ma'kis'shaalas had left the Morgukai, a secret society based on Kintan, to join the Jedi Order.
The Vibre-class assault cruiser was a starship specifically designed for commerce raiding by the Galactic Empire, used both by elements of the Imperial military and by pro-Imperial privateer crews.

The Battle at Ukio was a brief battle in the Thrawn campaign of 9 ABY where Imperial forces under Grand Admiral Thrawn tricked Ukio into surrendering by using cloaked cruisers to bombard the planet from under the surface of the planetary shield in coordination with an orbital …

The Engagement at Jestan was a successful mission carried out by the Alliance to Restore the Republic on Jestan. The success of the Alliance was due in large part to the tactical ability of Lieutenant Colonel Beryl Chiffonage.

Jestan was a terrestrial planet located in the Jestan system. It was a part of the Expansion Region's Corpheli sector, being located both in the Outer Expansion Zone sub-region and the Northern Dependencies portion of that region.

Shaylin 18 was a celestial body located in the Shaylin system, a part of the Pakuuni sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Overic Griplink linked it to the Pakuuni and Turkana systems.

The Burning Vengeance was one of two Star Destroyers that were fitted with an experimental weapons system designed by House Andrim. It was fitted with the weapons system at the Kuat Drive Yards and was sent along with the Legacy to the planet Belgaroth for testing.

The Legacy was one of two Star Destroyers that were fitted with an experimental weapons system designed by House Andrim. It was fitted with the weapons system at the Kuat Drive Yards and was sent along with the Burning Vengeance to the planet Belgaroth for testing.

The Shrike was a Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Like other ships of its class, the Shrike was 1,600 meters in length and manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards.

Fighter Red, otherwise known as Red E Squadron or simply Red Squadron, was a squadron of E-wing escort starfighters assigned to the Endurance-class fleet carrier Intrepid of the New Republic Defense Fleet Fifth Battle Group.
Coruscant Space Traffic Coordination was the government office under the Galactic Empire that was charged with monitoring and clearing all spacecraft entering or leaving the planet Coruscant.
Jandoonian salamanders were a type of salamander found on the Outer Rim Territories planet Jandoon. They could be domesticated and kept as pets.

Tujiamoor was an Inner Rim astronomical object. It was the site of the Talecalle volcano chain. Around 11 ABY, Doctor Ils Ee visited Tujiamoor after stealing the Gree artifact known as the Sharka'k Noor.

The Out Runner was an Alliance to Restore the Republic-affiliated YL-2200 light freighter. Following the Battle of Hoth, the crew of the Out Runner was dispatched by General Carlist Rieekan to locate the Treasure Trove, a GR-75 medium transport that failed to rendezvous with t…
The Diligence was a DP20 gunship in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Incomparable was a DP20 gunship in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
The Mediator was a DP20 gunship in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

place: Shyrack caves within Korriban's Valley of the Dark Lords
x: The funeral of Marka Ragnos was a Sith funeral that occurred in 5000 BBY on the planet Korriban, to mark the passing of revered Dark Lord of the Sith Marka Ragnos.

The Cell was a secret organization in the Cularin system during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. A faction in Nirama's criminal Organization, The Cell wanted to oust, replace, and execute the current crime lord.

A memorial service was held for Raana Tey after she died in the destruction of the Jedi Tower of Taris. Although her body was not recovered, a statue was erected in a rooftop garden of the Draay Estate on Coruscant.

result: Rosh Penin is kidnapped by the Disciples of Ragnos and turned to the D

x: The First Mission to Byss was carried out by Jedi Rosh Penin in 14 ABY, for the New Jedi Order. Luke Skywalker assigned Rosh to investigate the remains of Byss, and determine whether the Disciples of Ragnos had been there.

objective: Investigate Force residue
x: The Mission to Wayland was carried out by Corran Horn during the Disciples of Ragnos crisis in 14 ABY.

conflict: Galactic Civil War (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)
objective: Investigate Force residue.
x: The mission to the Valley of the Jedi on Ruusan was carried out by Jedi Master Kyle Katarn during the Disciples of Ragnos crisis in 14 ABY.
Iceberg One was an icy planetoid in the Calamari system. It had one moon and was the third planet in the system.
Velery was the capital of Viamarr 4. It had a population of about one hundred thousand and was located in a heavily forested region of the planet's largest continent in the southern hemisphere.

Headquarters was the company town established by Verkuylian BactaCo when the planet Verkuyl was settled. Located on the Dalos Peninsula, the majority of the planet's population lived in the settlement. The Verkuylian Imperial Governor's Hall was located in Headquarters.
The Battle of Filve took place during Thrawn campaign and was a diversion to distract the New Republic away from the Battle at Ukio.

Kikorie Port was a city on the planet Ast Kikorie. It was the largest city on the planet, containing half a million people. It was also the location of an astrocartographic research station that was connected to the city by a skyhook.
The Bloodfin was a Turbulent-class Star Destroyer that began its service in the naval forces of the Imperial Remnant in 41 ABY. It was built to serve as the flagship of Grand Admiral Gilad Pellaeon.
The Battle of Roche took place in 41 ABY, as part of the Second Galactic Civil War.

result: Alliance-in-exile formed and joins Jedi Coalition
Maw Irregular Fleet and Mandalorians join Jedi Coalition
Imperial Remnant allies with Darth Caedus
2/3 of remaining GA forces join Darth Caedus
Tahiri Veila is named Darth Caedus's Sith apprentice
x: The Second Battle of Fondor took place in 41 ABY, as part of the Second Galactic Civil War. Fondor had earlier left the Galactic Alliance for the Confederation, and to shore up his prestige, Chief of State Jacen Solo decided to retake the world, along with its orbital shipyards.

Net'lseb Toli Park was a park located on the Gar'glum Sea, on the outskirts of Gal'fian'deprisi City on Galantos. It was a kilometer-wide garden of toli trees, fragrant blossoms, and wildlife enclosed in an energy perimeter.
Voma was the capital city of the planet of Trevura.

The Relentless was a Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer which served as the flagship of Darth Krayt's Outer Rim Third Fleet seven years after the Dark Lord of the Sith deposed Galactic Emperor Roan Fel at the end of the Empire's war with the Galactic Alliance.

t: Office of the Chief of State
headquarters: Chief of State's office, Senate Building
x: The Office of the Chief of State or Chief of State's Office, consisted of various aides, staff, and government organizations directly subordinate to the Chief of State of the Galactic Alliance. In this capacity, the Office served as the executive branch of the Galactic Alliance.

Shafr Center was an academic institution that shared its name with the Outer Rim Territories' Shafr system. It was affiliated with The Shafr Center Press, which in 38 ABY published the work The Shafr Anthology of Galactic Language, Second Edition.
Guards of Aldera were guardians of the city of Aldera. It was rumored that one of their number stole the Alsakan Tessent and brought it to Ast Kikorie Station.
Lake Varum was a body of water that bordered the city of Keren on the Mid Rim planet of Naboo.
Troos was a planet located within the Gordian Reach of the Outer Rim Territories.
Hethar was a forested planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Atrivis sector. It was the homeworld of the omnivores known as gornts, whose meat was a staple in the diet of the local colonists.
The Battle of Giju was a brief conflict fought on Giju shortly after the establishment of the Galactic Empire.

The Imperial Oasis was a small body of water on the planet Tatooine, near the Mospic High Range and the Jawa Mountain Fortress. It was considered one of Tatooine's greatest vistas by spacers across the galaxy.

t: Battle of unidentified planet (Unduli and Offee)
x: A battle on a planet was fought between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

The Lialic II was a Corellian Engineering Corporation CR90 corvette in service to the Galactic Empire. Assigned to the Kathol Sector Imperial Fleet, the Lialic II was commanded by Captain Rolf Treidum.

A lupine species of bipedal sentients lived on a planet in the Outer Rim Territories, near the border of Galactic Republic space. They had lupine lower legs, with high ankle joints and three-clawed feet. The species had pointed ears and gray skin, with red eyes.

The Mission to Akuria II was a mission by the Alliance to Restore the Republic to the ice world of Akuria II a short time after the Battle of Yavin. Its intention was to bring the Akuria Rebel Base into the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
A battle was fought on a planet between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

objective: Obtain Doel Scherp's code cylinder
x: The mission to Sernpidal occurred during the Jedi Civil War, when a team of Galactic Republic agents were sent to the planet Sernpidal.

The Loyal Defender was a Galactic Alliance warship that took part in the Second Battle of Fondor. The vessel was so heavily damaged during the fight that an order to abandon ship was issued. The Compass Star was sent to keep the ship safe from attack as this was going on.

The Compass Star was a Galactic Alliance warship that took part in the Second Battle of Fondor. During the course of the battle it was sent to the aid of the Loyal Defender, which had been so heavily damaged that an evacuation order had been issued.
The Ripclaw was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer. It was apparently named after an Alderaanian predator.
Mazhar was a jungle planet in the Spadja sector. Embra the Hutt based his operations there.
The Cauldron was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer. During the blockade of Chabosh, it was commanded by Captain Harsh.
The Indomitable was a MC140 Scythe-class battle cruiser serving the Galactic Alliance from at least 130 ABY.

The Pride of Corellia was a Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet YZ-2500 heavy transport that served during the Sith–Imperial War against the Fel Empire. In 130 ABY, Admiral Nict commanded the transport during the Battle of Caamas, which saw the Alliance's surrender.

result: Exar Kun is anointed the new Dark Lord of the Sith
