a: Second Duel in the Iron Citadel

x: The Battle of Chabosh was fought between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War around 2 BBY.

Lesu was a world located in the Lesu system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Dail sector. Around 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of Malakin Enterprises, a criminal organization that constituted a part of the Tenloss Syndicate.
This duel was fought between the Sith Lord Darth Vader and the Jedi Apprentice Luke Skywalker with Princess Leia Organa in the Temple of Pomojema on the planet Mimban in 2 ABY.
A flewt was a species of predatory butterfly that was found on Naboo.
The Folna was a Agave-class picket ship in the New Republic Navy, commanded by Colonel Foag, and captained by Captain Madis.

A species of mammals were small, predatory creatures native to the Forest Moon Endor. While considered cute and cuddly, the animals could become agitated when restless. When restless, they would bite or claw the perpetrator.

result: The New Jedi Order are forced to withdraw to Ossus
Azlyn Rae joins the Imperial Knights
x: The Battle of Coruscant was one of the final battles in the Fel Empire's war against the Galactic Alliance.
The Black Hole dark trooper was a variant of the stormtrooper battle droid dark troopers.
The Exogen-class dark trooper was a model of the dark trooper battle droid used by the Galactic Empire.
Ravelin was the capital city on the Imperial Remnant capital world Bastion. It contained Disra's palace, the Imperial Library, and the Moff Assembly Hall.
Gallshebbis Prime was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Gallshebbis Prime system, a part of Nilgaard sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the site of a warehouse.
The Battle of Jandoon was a small skirmish between the Galactic Empire and the New Republic forces in the Corva sector.
The Three Sisters were the three moonlets of Ruusan, including Ruusan 2. The smugglers of the planet, including Jerg's crew, called them "The Triplets".

The Dominion was a Star Dreadnought and Super Star Destroyer active by 12 ABY. Originally part of the forces of Imperial warlord Blitzer Harrsk, the Dominion was recovered by Imperial officer Gilad Pellaeon and used to strengthen the navy of the Imperial Remnant.
Vaklin was a planet located in the Vaklin system of the Inner Rim Territories and the homeworld of Shula Shevu.
Yoda's Acclamator-class transport was an assault ship used by Jedi Master Yoda during the Clone Wars.

a: Skirmish on the Temple of the Sith

x: The Battle of Mon Calamari was a major battle between Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire and the Galactic Alliance Remnant, which took place during the Second Imperial Civil War in 137 ABY.

The Alliance, originally known as the Imperious, was a large, powerful warship built by the Galactic Empire ruled by Darth Krayt. It was the prototype of the Imperious-class Star Destroyer, a Star Destroyer design larger and more powerful than the Pellaeon-class.
Shedu Maad was a world in the Hapes Cluster, located within its Transitory Mists region.
The Assiduous was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer used by Inquisitor Valin Draco.
The Gungan Swamp Town was a Rorgungan town and military camp on Rori during the Galactic Civil War.

x: The skirmish at Qoribu was an early battle fought between the Killiks and the Chiss Ascendancy, concerning the border dispute that took place just prior to the conflict.

owners: No set owner, assigned as needed
x: The Scarlet Star was a YT-2400 light freighter in the service of the Galactic Alliance Remnant around 137 ABY. It had no set crew or owners and was instead assigned to various crews and mission team as necessary.
Ryntail was the personal yacht of Tan Dicium, a princeling from the celestial body Sifuchi. It partially shared its name with the Ryn, a sentient species with tails.

language: Dialect of The Thelvin Order of Barundi
x: The Barundi were a humanoid species native to the planet Barundi and encountered on an unnamed planet in Wild Space. A primitive society, the Barundi fashioned their lives around the promotion of perpetual happiness.
Spear Squadron was a starfighter squadron that flew TIE/LN starfighters in the service of the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire.
Awors were large gray animals that were used by the Travelling Jindas. During the Jindas' early days with the Rock Wizard, the animals were used to till the soil, helping the Jindas farm the area.

The Rock Fortress was a mammoth structure on the forest moon of Endor. It was the home of the Rock Wizard. There was a window near the top of the fortress, which allowed the Rock Wizard to look out on the Jinda tribe, who farmed the soil beneath the building.
The Chirq Council, labeled by the CorSec as the Red Circle Gang until their true identity was learned, was a powerful criminal organization active on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.

t: Invasion of the New Jedi Temple
result: Jedi abandon the Temple and destroy all valuable records
x: The Invasion of the New Jedi Temple on Coruscant took place in 40 ABY during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Medth was a planet. The privateer Urias Xhaxin once raided the planet's region in his ship, the Free Lance.
Mrykos was a barren moon of the planet Atraken in the Kattellyn system.

The sallap was a species of tree native to Generis, a planet in the Atrivis sector. Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn once related a parable to his Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi of a particularly dense growth of sallap trees growing near a lake on Generis.
The Broken 'Spanner was a modified TL-1800 freighter that was owned for over three decades by the smuggler Tiv "Poke" Pocarno and then by Torel Vorne.
Freliq was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Calaron sector. It was home to the lepusa, a type of semi-sentient burrowing rodents who were able to manufacture crude tools.

Frisal was a terrestrial planet located in the Frisal system, a part of the Atrisian Commonwealth in the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of loirbniggs, a species of eight-legged reptilian creatures.
The Keeper's makers were humanoids hailing from Keeper's World. They were a strictly non-violent people, and feared war. When a galactic war entered their system they chose to flee their planet.
Keeper's World, located in the Outer Rim Territories, was the homeworld of The Keeper. It used to be inhabited by the Keeper's makers until they fled the planet during an ancient war.
Juntrack River was located on the Inquiesse continent of the agriworld Draenell's Point. The large city of Juntrack was situated around this river.
Juntrack was the largest city of the Inquiesse continent, on the agriworld of Draenell's Point. Juntrack was one of the planet's leading manufacturing centers, and was home to Draenell Industries.

Inquiesse was the smallest continent on the agriworld of Draenell's Point. Inquiesse was home to fifteen million inhabitants, including the three million living in the continent's largest city, Juntrack, and in various other cities throughout the Juntrack River valley.
The Rorian Gungans, best known as the Rorgungans, were an extremist faction of Gungans active on Rori before and during the Galactic Civil War.

The Velusian fursnake, or simply fursnake, was a reptilian snake native to the volcanic islands of the Core Worlds planet Velusia. The snake had a large triangular head with many teeth and a bony stinger on its tail, measuring two meters long.

result: Bannistar Station heavily damaged, Alliance retreat
x: The Attack on Bannistar Station was a conflict during the Galactic Civil War that took place when the Rebel One accidentally ended up at Bannistar Station.

DC-GNK was a originally a GNK-series power droid, later heavily modified to serve as a translator by Jawa Empideera Kkek. DC-GNK was outfitted with a number of salvaged protocol droid parts, allowing him to help Kkek in trade negotiations.
R7-Z0 was an R7-series astromech droid. The droid was primarily colored white, with a black dome and yellow-green access panels.

Prak City was the capital of the planet Prakith. The many skyscrapers of Prak City were said to look like the pointed fangs of some animal when seen from a distance. Cloud cars and airspeeders were common forms of transportation, as the land terrain was difficult to navigate.

Redilos was the single moon of the planet Korbin. It had a barren and heavily cratered landscape, and orbited very close to the planet, making it appear large in the sky. Redilos was known as Redeye to the Korbin natives, because of its bright, dark-red glow at night.

Pleasant City was the capital and largest city of Korbin, and was home to the planet's largest spaceport. It was located near the planet's equator. Like the planet itself, there was no government or law system in place.

Happy was a city on the planet of Korbin. Like the planet itself, Happy had no government or law system. Happy, along with the other cities of Korbin, was given an upbeat name by its criminal inhabitants.
Estalle was a city on the island of the same name on the planet Procopia. Since the formation of the Tapani Empire the city was the seat of power within the Tapani sector.

Rockfish was a species of fish. Rockfish could be served raw and eaten as part of a meal, and was served aboard the luxury repulsortrain Gem of Alderaan and at the annual Vor-cal Feast held aboard the House Melantha Orbital Hunting Lodge over the planet Vycinyth.

A vhe'viin was a species of small rodent native to the Outer Rim world of Mandalore. While the quick-moving vhe'viin was a burrowing creature most often seen covered in coats of tan fur, vhe'viine were known to change the color of their fur to white when living amidst a snow-c…
The Tapani Defense Force was one of three roving Imperial fleets that patrolled the Tapani sector during the Galactic Civil War. The other fleets were the Ground Pounders and Swift Wing.

t: Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa
x: The Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa was a conflict fought between the citizens of Mos Espa, a city on the planet Tatooine, and an army of Tusken Raiders led by the Tusken King in 1 ABY.
The Raid on Kiffu occurred after a failed meeting between Count Dooku, leader of the Dark Acolytes, and Tinté Vos, Sheyf of the Kiffu Guardians.

result: Escape of Obi-Wan Kenobi and Quinlan Vos
x: The Duel on the Titavian IV happened when Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi received a Jedi distress call from the Titavian IV, an exploration ship from the Intergalactic Zoological Society.
The Mining Outpost was a settlement on the moon Yavin IV.

The Ground Pounders or "Gee-Pees" were one of three roving Imperial fleets that patrolled the Tapani sector during the Galactic Civil War. The other fleets were the Tapani Defense Force and Swift Wing.
Swift Wing was one of three roving Imperial fleets that patrolled the Tapani sector during the Galactic Civil War. The other fleets were the Tapani Defense Force and Ground Pounders.

The Leonides was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer assigned to the Tapani sector. It was assigned to the planet Achillea. The ships assigned to the planets Achillea and Mrlsst, protected by the Reyna, were strategically located to control the only routes in and out sector.

The Reyna was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer assigned to the Tapani sector. It was assigned to the planet Mrlsst. The ships assigned to the planets Mrlsst and Achillea, protected by the Leonides, were strategically located to control the only routes in and out sector.
Lyran bloodslugs were omnivorous parasites native to Lyran IV. Prior to the Clone Wars, bloodslugs were exported to Agamar, causing the death of over 100 individuals.

Thulpin City was the agricultural center of the agriworld Draenell's Point. It was located on the grasslands of the Mee'r continent and was home to Thulpin Agriculture. It was home to one million inhabitants.

Mee'r was the most populated of the three continents on the agriworld Draenell's Point. The West Unillian Mountains was located on the continent, as well as five major cities; the capital, Wullerton; the civilian spaceport, Starpoint; Jhepar, Thulpin City, and Uniqer.

MSE-X-PR6 was a modified Rebaxan Columni MSE-6 droid assigned to the research station on Binaros. The little droid used to be a standard MSE-6 droid, but, due to his assignment as a messenger between the station personnel, his skill matrix was removed, and a vocabulator unit w…

The Pulsar was a Lancer-class frigate in Moff Kentor Sarne's forces around 8 ABY. Along with three Skipray Blastboats, it engaged the FarStar shortly after the New Republic corvette had left the planet Binaros.
A Mining Outpost was a settlement on Dantooine. It was established by the Galactic Empire, when they began occupation of the planet.
A team of clone commandos was dispatched to protect director Lorca Oviedo, and was trapped on Asturias when Separatist forces attacked their ship. The only survivor of the mission was Zag.
The Battle of Nym's Factory Compound occurred in Nym's Factory Compound on Lok in 1 ABY.
Davla was the only true land mass on the planet Procopia. Located in the southern polar regions, Davla was a frigid land of constant volcanic activity.
Sep Elopor was a ringed gas giant in the Calamari system of the Outer Rim. At least 32 moons were known to orbit the planet.
The Ironstar was an Imperial Ardent-class fast frigate that fought at the Battle of Mon Calamari in 137 ABY.
The Verpine was an Imperial Ardent-class fast frigate that fought at the Battle of Mon Calamari in 137 ABY.
The nightspider was a species of large, predatory spider that could be found on Naboo.
Merikon was a planet located in the Fath sector of the Outer Rim Territories in the galaxy. During the Imperial Era, the Galactic Empire operated a training facility on the planet.

Belgar Spaceport was the only spaceport in the city of Belgar on the planet Belgaroth. From the time of its opening, Belgaroth remained a minor waystation with a spaceport that was barely suitable for use.
The Dantooine Enclave starship was a small Jedi starship.

The Riesa was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer assigned to the Tapani sector. It was assigned to the planet Tallaan and the Tallaani Shipyards. The shipyard was also defended by Golan Arms defense platforms and various other cruisers.
The Nitsa was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer assigned to the Tapani sector. It was assigned to the sector capital planet Procopia.
The Imperial Outpost on Dantooine was a military outpost established by the Galactic Empire shortly after the Battle of Yavin, when a permanent garrison was established on the planet.
The Imperial Outpost on Lok was a massive stronghold established by the Galactic Empire as part of their plan to extend their control over less developed worlds.
HK-Taskmaster was a battle droid in HK-47's droid army on Mustafar in 1 ABY. It was destroyed by a group of spacers.
The Arrandle Mountains were a low range of weathered peaks located on the desert world of Sevarcos. They stretched across the far north side of the Desert of Kariste.
The Blan Mountains were a mountain range on the remote world Brosi, situated along the length of the Shoengen Coast. The Brosin Underground held its base of operations deep within the mountains.

The Cascardi Mountains were a snow-covered mountain range on the planet Duneeden. Didi Oddo, a business owner, held a private retreat in this mountain range. After the events of Stadum 5 where Didi Oddo fled from Obi-Wan Kenobi, he retreated to his home on the Cascardi Mountains.

Mount Deldarca was an active volcano on an unknown planet. It was the site of a Rebel Alliance base known as Dalgeer's Rim. The base of the volcano was riddled with tunnels that were formed by flowing lava.
The Ghentiw Northern Mountains were a range of rocky, ragged peaks located on the planet of Bundim. The mountains were located just outside the city of Heg.
A Blembie was a carnivorous fish native to Naboo and were traditionally used in games of Theed quoits on Naboo. In the wild, they were known to swim in shoals and had bad tempers.

Bralsin was a small settlement on the Outer Rim world of Mandalore. Located near the Mandalorian capital city of Keldabe, Bralsin sat atop a hill at the edge of the broad and shallow Kelita valley, filled with farmland, woods, and a number of homesteads.

A memorial to Fenn Shysa was erected by the bounty hunter Boba Fett in the settlement of Bralsin on the planet Mandalore. Built in honor of the deceased Mand'alor, Fenn Shysa, it existed as one of only a few memorials ever erected on the Outer Rim world.
Derapha was one of the largest cities on Phaeda.
Korrokrrayyo was the tallest and most massive mountain on all of Kashyyyk.

t: Galactic Alliance Defense Force Fleet Command
x: The Galactic Alliance Defense Force Fleet Command or Galactic Alliance Fleet Command was the command staff of the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet.
Orane Mountain was a mountain that was located on the ice planet of Neftali. It was the tallest peak on Beija, an isthmus which connected the Jhunia snow plains to the Yiulimar Ice Fjords.
The Glory-class dark trooper was a dark trooper variant used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
The Triplehorn mountains was a mountain range located on the planet of Alderaan. Its snow-capped peaks bordered the Royal Palace of Aldera, the planet's capital city.
The West Unillian Mountains were a rugged chain of peaks that cut across the heavily-populated continent of Mee'r, on the agriworld Draenell's Point.

x: The Destruction of the Deretta Destroyers was a battle during the Galactic Civil War between Alliance to Restore the Republic and Imperial forces in which the Deretta Destroyers, a Rebel starfighter squadron, was destroyed.
Thanut was a celestial body in the same system as Fondor.

The Dewback was a warship in the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances that participated in the Second Battle of Fondor. Kral Nevil, captain of the Anakin Solo wanted to bring the Dewback in to aid the Anakin Solo attack on Fondor.
Oridin City was a major city on Fondor that was bombarded with concussion missiles from the Anakin Solo during the Second Battle of Fondor.

t: Wedding of Ghes Orade and Mirta Gev
x: The Wedding of Ghes Orade and Mirta Gev was the private Mandalorian wedding of Ghes Orade and Mirta Gev in Keldabe on Mandalore. While no one attended the wedding but Ghes and Mirta, several Mandalorians and non-Mandalorians attended the celebratory party afterwards.

Revery was a planet known for being inhabited by rich beings, as well as its beaches, mountains, and privacy. It appeared blue from space, and on the planet, there were aquamarine seas, green and gold land, and pink clouds could be seen in the sky.
The Glorious Chariot was a Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 designed by the SoroSuub Corporation. This particular vessel was customized for the Hutt Darga Jiramma Mionne.
Niro was a planet that was owned by the InterGalactic Banking Clan before the end of the Clone Wars.

Niro 11 was a moon orbiting the planet Niro. It was owned by the InterGalactic Banking Clan before the end of the Clone Wars. It then fell into the rule of the Galactic Empire. Clive Flax and Astri Oddo visited this moon when searching for information about Eve Yarrow.

Tikath was a planet located in the Tikath system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a fortress world with a notoriously strong defense. A group of rebel operatives traveled to the planet in pursuit of Imperial scientist Etha Naru.

Grrtok's Band was a mercenary group who operated in the Tapani sector during the Galactic Civil War. It was made up of over 400 expatriated Gamorreans commanded by Grrtok. The group was contracted to House Barnaba.
Alvorine City was the capital city of the world of Alvorine.

Ixzinian rock rams were beasts native to the planet Pellastrallas and the Ixzinia system. They were grazing animals with an armored frill around their head and long, thick coat. They had black eyes and brown coat with white stripes along their backs.
Fiyarro was one of the three largest cities on the Outer Rim planet of Serenno.
Q'mara, located in the Q'mara system of the Juvex sector, was a desert planet with a number of shabby spaceports, where all manner of smugglers and thugs sought illicit employment.

The Jedi Archives of Ossus was a smaller collection of materials than its larger counterpart in the Jedi Temple of Coruscant. Located in the Ossus Academy, the Archives, like its equivalent, were open at all hours and were accessible to all Jedi in need of information.

Elite Flight Alpha was an elite starfighter unit of the Separatist Navy that fought in the Clone Wars. It fielded elite Vulture droid fighters that were often used to supplement other squadrons in combat.
Elite Flight Beta was an elite starfighter unit of the Separatist Navy that fought in the Clone Wars. It fielded Vulture droid fighters that were often used to supplement other squadrons in combat.
The 3rd Group was a unit of starfighters that served in the CIS Navy during the Clone Wars. The unit fielded standard Nantex-class territorial defense starfighters in combat.
The 8th Group was a group of starfighters that served in the CIS Navy during the Clone Wars. The unit fielded standard Nantex-class territorial defense starfighters in combat.
The 5th Group was a flight group of starfighters that served in the CIS Navy during the Clone Wars. The unit fielded Nantex-class starfighters in battle.
Picador Group was an elite starfighter unit in the CIS Navy during the Clone Wars that fielded Nantex-class starfighters armed with turbolaser cannons for use in combat against capital ships.
Confessor Group was an elite starfighter squadron often tasked with leading other squadrons in combat for the CIS Navy during the Clone Wars.
The 2nd Group was a flight group of starfighters that served in the CIS Navy during the Clone Wars. The unit fielded Nantex-class starfighters in battle.
L-7230 was a C-9979 landing craft in the CIS Navy.
L-1131 was a C-9979 landing craft in the CIS Navy.
L-2384 was a C-9979 landing craft in the CIS Navy.
Brindibarr was a large spaceport and capital city of the jungle world Torina.

Capital City was the capital of the Kari homeworld Karideph. The city was home to the planet's only spaceport and, like the rest of Karideph, was heavily populated. The major industry driving the Karideph economy was food production.

Hiit was an Outer Rim Territories moon located in the Corporate Sector. It was the homeworld of the Hiitians, who made first contact with the off-world Trianii Rangers at some point by around 1500 BBY. In 5 BBY, the Hiit was annexed by the Corporate Sector Authority.

The 96th Regiment was a unit in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. The regiment utilized AT-AP walkers and TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank marked with blue stripes to designate their regiment affiliation.
The Garden Level was a gigantic greenhouse located within the Jedi Academy on Ossus. It contained waterfalls and huge amounts of Yuuzhan Vong flora and was used as a place of meditation and study.
The evacuation of Dubrillion occurred early in the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Grathus was a terrestrial planet located in the Grathus system, a part of the Jospro sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet featured several large mud basin settlements, including one which contained a tavern owned by Xig Rollem.

t: Wedding of Corran Horn and Mirax Terrik
x: The wedding of Corran Horn and Mirax Terrik was a secret ceremony that took place in 7 ABY, aboard the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Lusankya. It was officiated by Wedge Antilles who was acting as de facto captain of the recently captured ship.

Zeethreeone was an Imperial probe droid that, under the control of Major Stipling, was assigned the task of finding a source of the metal alloy doonium on Yen-2. The droid was destroyed by Limna Yith, during Black Sun's attempt to overrun the Yen-2 mining operation.
The Aay'han was a DeepWater-class light freighter often used for joyriding. In 21 BBY, Kal Skirata purchased it second-hand from a Rodian in Calna Muun on Agamar for the price of 80,000 credits.
E-5KL was a protocol droid owned by the explorer Frelka during the Galactic Civil War.

The Funeral of Kol Skywalker took place after Jedi Master Kol Skywalker died during the Massacre at Ossus, while buying time for his former apprentice Wolf Sazen to escape with his son Cade, Shado Vao and a number of Jedi younglings.
Holageus was a planet in the Expansion Region.

Oligtaz was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Oligtaz system, in the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. It was the site of the Esraza Temple, which was known to the wider galaxy by 10,000 BBY.

t: Political uprising of the Empress Teta system
x: The political uprising of the Empress Teta system was a military and political coup that happened in the year 3997 BBY, staged against Lord Keto and Lady Magda Keto, the rulers of the Deep Core planet Empress Teta.
a: Political Uprising of Empress Teta system
Political uprising of Empress Teta system

x: The Kathol Republic Senatorial Council was the legislative assembly of the Kathol Republic.
The Battle of Episol was a minor engagement between Imperial forces loyal to Moff Kentor Sarne and the Kathol Republic Navy in the Episol system in 8 ABY.

result: Jedi Temple sustains damage; Lord Nyax allegedly dies
x: The Attack on the Sacred Spire occurred in the ruins of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. On a mission to set up resistance cells on the broken capital city, the Jedi and their strike team were interrupted by the insane Lord Nyax, a bizarre cyborg capable of using the Force.
The Hawkbat Gang was a swoop racing group formed by Drako in the Coruscant underworld during the years following the Invasion of Naboo. Drako was the leader of the Hawkbats until his untimely death.
The Skulls was an infamous swoop gang known for its brutal and violent reputation. They menaced the Hook Nebula. Founded by Jeng Seth, they were particularly noted for their brutality and cruelty.

The SoroSuub skyhook was located above the the world Coruscant. The skyhook was offered to the former members of Rogue Squadron after they resigned their commissions from the New Republic to liberate the planet Thyferra from former Director of Imperial Intelligence Ysanne Isard.
The Kilian Bantha was a subspecies of bantha native to the planet Kilia IV.

terrain: Island archipelagos covered with sand, forests, and meadowlands

x: 6-5C was a medical droid that served aboard the Imperial Star Destroyer Ravagor in 0.5 ABY. It treated Ranulf Trommer after he was injured in an attack over Aguarl 3.
6FT-DP was a rust-colored security droid that was manufactured to serve Bioniip Laboratories on Cloud City. Its model was a 6FT-D2. It served primarily as guard of the Bioniip labs.
LXC-3TF was as assassin droid that served alongside Jasta Finn during the early years of the New Republic. It was heavily armed with a proton torpedo launcher and a blaster cannon.

Thall was a planet that was inhabited by a civilization who followed a religion of the Force. By the High Republic Era, its original civilization was long extinct, though new settlements had been established on the planet.

The Adumari Planetary Defense Forces was formed in the aftermath of the Battle of Adumar. Imperial Admiral Teren Rogriss, who relinquished his command of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Agonizer, was appointed Defense Minister by Balass ke Teldan, the new perator of Cartann.

Sirdar was a planet in a remote region of the galaxy. At some point, a small population of the insectivorous winged xendrites was placed on Sirdar to help with insect control. The xendrites reproduced at an astounding rate and soon overran the planet.
El-434 was a ruthless assassin droid and Imperial agent, that developed a reputation as a brutal killer who enjoyed his work. He was in operation throughout the Galactic Civil War.
The Oasis – or simply "Oasis" – was a Dim-U religious community in the middle of the desert of Tatooine, far from any larger cities.
The Defiant was a cruiser in the Republic Navy.
The Nebula II was a warship in the Republic Navy.
The Trade Outpost was a settlement on Dathomir.
Wing 3 was the callsign of one of the Republic warships that participated in the Second Battle of Onderon in 3998 BBY.
The Battalion was an Imperial Praetor-class battlecruiser that operated shortly after the rise of the New Order.
Pinurquians were a species of horned humanoids active in the galaxy. One well known member was Tinketh Fo, the leader of the planet Keyorin.

Spanner was an LE-series repair droid involved in EV-9D9's revolt on Cloud City during the Imperial era. As he fled from the revolt, Spanner came across the long forgotten BesGas Three, which many presumed had been destroyed.

The Jedi Trials chamber was a large room that was located within the Coruscant Jedi Temple. Serving the Jedi Order as a place for potential Jedi to be administered the Jedi Trials, a specialized program could project simulacrums of various Jedi and Sith to challenge the skills…
The Raid on Kabal was a Imperial raid commanded by then Captain Firmus Piett and Colonel Maximilian Veers from the bridge of an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that was possibly the Accuser.
The fall of Generis occurred in 9 ABY as part of the campaign of Grand Admiral Thrawn to recapture the galaxy for the Galactic Empire.

Bashka was a village on Ryloth that, like most Twi'lek settlements, was carved into a cavern of a mountain. It was located along the thin line that separated the planet between the blistering heat of the Bright Lands and the deadly cold of night side.
The Scourge was a Qektoth attack cruiser that was in use by the Qektoth Confederation as of 8 ABY. It fought against the New Republic corvette FarStar while in the Qu'mock system.

Tott Doneeta's courier was the elegant transport Tott Doneeta used to travel from Ryloth to Exis Station. It had a grappling line, which Tott used to grab onto Vima Sunrider's escape pod, keeping Vima from being destroyed by the star Teedio.

Vodo-Siosk Baas's heavy courier was used by Jedi Master Vodo-Siosk Baas to travel to Coruscant along with Tott Doneeta, Nomi Sunrider, Cay Qel-Droma, Dace Diath, Shoaneb Culu, Qrrrl Toq, and Sylvar, shortly before the Krath assault on the planet.
Oordo III was a celestial body in the Oordo system, a part of the Strabin sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim.

A battle was fought between forces of the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic for control of the desolate and barren planet Spefik. During the Galactic Civil War the Rebel Alliance established a base there, defended by anti-orbital ion cannons.

Antipose was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Centrality sector. It had a single city where the former pirate Raskar set up a system of gladiatorial contests that had a power gem, a rare artifact that Raskar had in his possession, as their ultimate prize.
Picavil was the capital city of the planet Elshandruu Pica.

conflict: Galactic Civil War (Subjugation of the Iskalon system)
result: Mass extermination of the entire planet
x: In 3 ABY, the Galactic Empire decimated the planet Telfrey. Responding to the rebellious sentiments stirred up by Tay Vanis, Darth Vader had the planet's populace wiped out, and the world itself bombed into a dead, lifeless husk.
Gralleenya was the capital city of Questal. It was Moff Bandor's seat of power.

An Enrichment Zone was a protected piece of land on Bandomeer. Since mining was the main industry of Bandomeer, there were many strip mines which left the planet's resources limited. The government set up Enrichment Zones to re-cultivate the dead soil.
The Azure Cabal was a mercenary organization.
Port Fyrin was a major city on the planet Qalydon.
Tangaks were carnivorous predators native to the planet Coyn. They were considered to be a highly unintelligent yet very dangerous species. They had a shaggy coat of fur and moved about on two legs.
The Battle of Gal Milnor was fought both on and above Gal Milnor in 3 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War.
A Pugoriss was a type of creature that could be found on Rori.
A Nudfuh was a type of herbivore that could be found on Rori.
The Bolle bol was a type of creature that could be found on Naboo and Endor.

This unidentified Gamma-class assault shuttle was part of Moff Kentor Sarne's forces, and was presumably part of the Kathol Sector Imperial Fleet before Sarne took control of it after the Battle of Endor.
The Gaaltura V was a CR90 corvette that was used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. It was captured in the Kashyyyk system by the Galactic Empire in 1 ABY.

result: Presumed victory for the New Republic
x: The Battle of Qu'mock was a small engagement fought between the New Republic corvette FarStar, and the forces of the Qektoth Confederation in the Qu'mock system.
Bantha Rock was a large rock formation, located in the deserts of Tatooine. It was named for its resemblance to the native bantha when viewed from nearby Mos Espa.
The Destruction of Carida occurred in 11 ABY, when Kyp Durron used the Sun Crusher to destroy Carida.
The blood beetle was a species of scavenging insect. The beetles had the ability to locate a corpse and devour it down to the bone.
A battle was fought sometime before the Seventh Battle of Ruusan where Valenthyne Farfalla defeated Sith forces.

The Light of Truth was a cruiser that was conscripted into the Republic Navy following the dissolution of the Army of Light after the Ruusan Reformations. In 990 BBY, a message drone was sent to the Jedi informing them of a grievously injured Sith Lord on the planet Ambria.

The scintil vine was a flowering vine native to the planet of Ruusan, and one of the few to survive the damage done to the planet during the battle there between the Jedi of the Army of Light and the Sith of the Brotherhood of Darkness.

Tass root, also known simply as tass, was a kind of plant native to the planet Ruusan. When powdered, mixed with the flowers from the scintil vine, and dampened with water, it formed a highly corrosive paste that could eat through rock and metal.
Belit was a Freighter Type C belonging to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Duel on Corulag was a duel between former Jedi Master Jook-jook H'broozin and his Padawan Danzigorro Potts on Corulag.

The Jowa was a GR-75 medium transport belonging to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Jowa was assigned to the Rebel hospital with cargo for the rebels who were wounded during the evacuation of Hoth.

t: First battle between Jedi and Sith
x: A battle between Jedi and Sith took place sometime after the Exiles' discovery of Korriban and the Sith species.

Kucedre was a GR-75 medium transport belonging to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Kucedre was assigned to the Rebel hospital with cargo for the rebels who were wounded during the evacuation of Hoth.

Raimi was a Freighter Type C belonging to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Raimi was assigned to the Rebel hospital with cargo for the rebels who were wounded during the evacuation of Hoth.
Tsore was a Freighter Type C belonging to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
This recon mission was intended to find out the strength of the Imperial task force assigned to locate the Defiance and her force.
The Rescue at Bundil II was a successful Rebel mission to rescue POWs captured during the Battle of Hoth.
The Mandalorian forest encampment was the headquarters of the Mandalorian resistance to the Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

result: Ship intervenes before victor was decided
x: The Duel on Hesperidium was a vicious fight that occurred in the year 40 ABY, between Jedi Master Mara Jade Skywalker, and Lumiya, Dark Lady of the Sith.
The Queen Anig was a civilian C-3 passenger liner that was present at Calast, a Golan Space Colony 2 space station during the Rescue at Bundil II. The ship contained tourists.
Gazle's Tours was a civilian Ferryboat liner that was present at Calast, a Golan Space Colony 2 space station, during the Rescue at Bundil II. The ship contained tourists.
Pulsar Lines was a civilian Ferryboat liner that was present at Calast, a Golan Space Colony 2 space station, during a battle in 3 ABY. There was a dinner party taking place inside the ship.

Aratech was Star Galleon-class frigate of uncertain relation to the company. The ship was present at Calast, a Golan Space Colony 2 space station during the Rescue at Bundil II, where it bore a shipment of firearms.
Prax Inc was a Xiytiar-class heavy transport that was present at Calast, a Golan Space Colony 2 space station during the Rescue at Bundil II. The ship contained Holodramas.
Blue Star Lake was a picturesque lake located on the forest moon of Endor.
The Bay of Fflus was a coastal bay bordering the Beija Minor Sea on the planet Neftali.

During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance ambushed the Imperial Oplovis Sector Fleet in a battle in the Generis system. The Oplovis Fleet was task force that was en route to the Mantooine system to attack the Rebel presence in the system.

The Atrivis Day group was four BFF-1 bulk freighters used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic to ferry supplies. They were part of a convoy traveling to the Organarms Deep Space Manufacturing Facility that encountered an Imperial Missile Boat.

The Atrivis Advancer was a starship owned by Alliance to Restore the Republic scout Flinor Tekkirl. A Pathfinder model manufactured by Vangaard Industries, the starship remained unmodified by the scout.
The Cult of Exar Kun was a Sith cult that was devoted to the worship of the Dark Lord of the Sith Exar Kun.
New Aldera was the capital city of the planet New Alderaan. It was made to look identical to the city Aldera that was located on Alderaan prior to Alderaan’s destruction.
4-B4 was a droid. It accompanied Jedi Master Dajjun, his Padawan Karii, and a number of other Jedi on a mission to the planet Kailion. It was caught with the Jedi when they were trapped in a cave-in.

The Axxilan antipirate fleet was a peacekeeping patrol fleet situated in the Ciutric Hegemony. Under the leadership of Firmus Piett, it helped the Hegemony become the safest regions of space in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Science Outpost, also known as the Research Outpost, was a spaceport on Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War.
The Smuggler Outpost was a smuggling outpost on the Forest Moon of Endor that was in use during the Galactic Civil War. The outpost was mainly used as a spaceport by spacers visiting the planet.

Tomlas Ore was a Virella Systems Cargo freighter that was present at Camen Spaceport where the Hurrim Lambda-class T-4a shuttle Merte, stolen by two members of Dunari's coalition escaped the Hurrim's asteroid base under heavy pursuit of Preybird starfighters.

The Bulton Cruises was a Ferryboat liner that was present at Camen Spaceport when the Hurrim Lambda-class T-4a shuttle Merte, stolen by two members of Dunari's coalition, escaped the Hurrim's asteroid base under heavy pursuit of Preybird-class starfighters.

The Olleppac was a C-3 passenger liner that was present at Camen Spaceport where the Hurrim Lambda-class T-4a shuttle Merte, stolen by two members of Dunari's coalition escaped the Hurrim's asteroid base under heavy pursuit of Preybird starfighters.

The Agrilat Swamp Circuit was the most popular, if not the most dangerous, swoop racing track in the Agrilat region of Corellia. The course weaved through jagged, crystalline plants, hot springs, and other swamp dangers.
Fitsay was the principal city of the planet Sedri. The city had a inn for pilgrims, houses for the citizens and farmers and marketplaces where the local Sedrians sold goods and wares.

The Animiasma was the personal starship and mobile headquarters of slaver Phylus Mon during the Clone Wars. Phylus Mon used it to dock his other ships, including his personal shuttle and at least two drone fighters that were used as the ships's first line of defense.

t: Battle of the City of Bone
x: During the Galactic Civil War, in the year 3 ABY, the Galactic Empire and the local Mandalorians of the planet Mandalore fought a decisive battle in the Mandalorian City of Bone, headquarters of the local Imperial leader, the Suprema.
Nurrale was a tropical city located on the planet Esseles. It was home to the famous Togatto Speedway.
The Tantrellius Theatre Groupe was a team of players who performed Jediboh Opera at the Jediboh Theatre on Peekoine. It was headed by Damien Tantrellius.
The Gutterwipes were a swoop gang on Peekoine during the Imperial Period. They were lead by Gamusha.
Landslasher-4 was one of the floating city Landslashers on Peekoine during the Imperial Period. It carved new canals into the planet's surface while the other three maintained the canals.
Jediboh Theatre was a theatre in Landslasher-4. It was home to the Tantrellius Theatre Groupe.

Yar was a Star Galleon-class frigate present at Destreg Spaceport that was present when K'Armyn Viraxo's personal yacht, the Highroller, was destroyed by Ace and Emon Azzameen. However, K'Armyn had got wind of this and used the yacht as a trap against the Azzameens.

Bebel Gas was a container transport, presumably belonging to the company that was present at Tinoon Station when a pirate raid took place. The raid consisted of Y-wings, Heavy Lifters and Marauder-class corvettes called Wraith.
The Tinoon Sec was a DP20 gunship that was part of Tinoon Station's security forces. It was destroyed during a pirate raid, that was successfully driven off by Ace Azzameen.
Around the end of the year 28 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War between the Yuuzhan Vong species and the Galactic Alliance, the Yuuzhan Vong attacked the planet Generis.
Thrust-Thru Flights was a large transport company based on the planet Edan II in the city of Fortuna City. Thrust-Thru was secondary to the primary transportation company Edan Spaceways.
Syward was the capital city of the planet Lavisar. In 7 ABY, a military base was stationed there.

The Sord Montok was a transport in use by the transport company Sord Montok for the conveyance of slaves. After picking up the Wookiee slave Reerookachuck on the planet Kessel, he caused a riot enabling him to escape.
The Stiegan Jungle was an area located south of Delrakkin City, Delrakkin.
The Republic was a cruiser in the New Republic.
The Rook was a 720 light freighter owned by the Desilijic kajidic. Ghitsa Dogder was taken there to be interrogated to learn of Durga Besadii Tai's dealings with the Orko Consortium.
Vee-Six was Doune's personal droid. He was always at his master's side, and always attempted to curb his master's obsessive gambling. He was abused verbally by his boss when the Herglic got angry.
The Capper spineflap was a type of creature that could be found on the planet Naboo and its moon Rori.

Camba-Fruit was a type of fruit used in the cosmetic product Distilled Water of Moltokian Camba-Fruit, a wrinkle prevention substance that partially shared its name with Moltok, a rainforest-covered Outer Rim planet.

Eefive-Tootoo was an E522 assassin droid. Originally in the service of Jabba the Hutt, Eefive was fed to the rancor. Two Jawas salvaged the remains, stripped the droid of its assassin droid programming and sold the unit to Lady Valarian.
The Imperious was a Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Fel Empire during the years leading up to the Empire's war with the Galactic Alliance, fought from 127 to 130 ABY.

x: A massacre in the planet Dac's New Coral City occurred in 137 ABY in the aftermath of the battle between the Imperial Outer Rim Third Fleet and the Galactic Alliance Remnant. It was the first event of the Genocide on Dac.

A battle of the Yuuzhan Vong War took place in space over the planet Galantos in the year 28 ABY. After Galantos' inhabitants, the Fia, made a deal with the Peace Brigade and informed them of the threat of the Yevetha, the Peace Brigade relayed the information to the Yuuzhan V…
Braggan's Fist was a group of thugs that operated in and around the city of Tyrena on the core world Corellia.
The Drogheda Royal Guard were the armed forces on the planet Drogheda, who served the planet's monarchy.

The Drogheda Revolutionaries were a fighting force on the planet Drogheda who opposed the monarchy led by Queen Sarna. They were formed at some point following the Battle of Endor, having been inspired by the Rebellion's victory.

Atrivis was a planet in the Generis system located in the Outer Rim sector of the same name. Homack, a starfighter pilot for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, was shot down over the planet and pursued by Imperial Storm commandos.

The Skirmish in the Mandalorian forest was a minor engagement in the Galactic Civil War on the planet Mandalore between the Mandalorians led by Fenn Shysa, and a group of Imperial slavers led by an Imperial commander.
The Shadowblade, code-named the Starkiller, was a Separatist superweapon crafted during the Clone Wars.
Zlarbv IV was a planet in the Zlarbv system and the home to a green, tentacled alien. Kelko once encountered this alien on this planet.

The Boys of Corus were a mercenary band from the Corus system. Among their membership was the Lepi Jaxxon, who learned his marksmanship while doing jobs with the group. However, on a mission to the Corporate Sector, they were double-crossed, and the band was scattered.
Vrelnid was an area on the planet Thyferra with vast fields of alazhi plants at the base of a small mountain range. A processing plant and a small Vratix village were also located nearby.

The Naddist army was the name given to the military force that Queen Amanoa commanded against the Beast-Lords Modon and Oron Kira and his Beast Riders, during Onderon's Beast War conflict of 4000 BBY.
The Expedition to Korriban was an exploratory mission to the Sith world of Korriban that was mounted by a force of Republic warships and soldiers.
Rynmar was a world located in the Rynmar system. It was situated in the Hapan Rim Worlds, an area of the Hapes Cluster in the Slice portion of the Inner Rim.
Gorak was a species of bird that was native to the world of Alderaan. Roast gorak bird was sometimes cooked in malla petals.
The Valorous was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The Battle of Shindra's Veil was the climactic naval engagement of the Unification War, Shey Tapani's campaign to unite the Twelve Kingdoms of the Expanse under one banner.
The crab spider was a non-sentient species of spider native to the planet Despayre, located in the Atrivis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Neka was a planet in the Outer Rim. During the Jedi Civil War, it was subject to a Sith blockade which stopped incoming and outgoing space traffic. The Sith then virus-bombed the world, killing all of its intelligent life.
Ordaj Besh was one of the seventeen moons of Ordaj. It had no known settlements, but may have been home to a pirate base at one time.
Hiroth Besh was a moon located in the Hoth system. Its surface was littered with skeleton ships and plagued by turbulent storms.

result: Battle stopped by Leia Organa Solo
x: Bleak Point Invasion was a battle fought in 13 ABY at Bleak Point Station on the planet Nam Chorios. It was fought between the Therans and the Newcomers.
The D'olop Mountain Range was a mountain range on M'haeli which housed a secret dragite crystal mine in 0 ABY.
Selon Mountain was a mountain located in the D'olop Mountain Range on M'haeli. It housed a secret dragite crystal mine in 0 ABY.
Hali was a temperate planet in the Expansion Region with three suns and at least two moons. It was the homeworld of Marit Dice.
The k'kayeh dragon was a gigantic, serpentine beast that was created by the Sith Lord Darth Rivan to defend his fortress on the planet Almas.

A humanoid species of blue-skinned and short-legged beings with conical heads existed, one of which was the notable Podracer pilot Toy Dampner. The species could exhibit red hair on their heads, and featured short legs in conjunction with long, skinny arms.

Davnar II, also known as Davnar, was a planet located in the Davnar system, within the Kanchen sector in the Core Worlds and the Interior regions, in grid square K-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid. The planet occupied the second orbital position in its star system.
A raid took place on the planet of Kar'a'katok during the height of the Galactic Empire. Imperial forces, led by Major Stafuv Rahz invaded the long secluded planet and attacked the local Shimholt.

The Exalted Torgaigne was a crime syndicate that operated out of Attahox in the Expansion Region. Much of the organization's revenue was generated from the sale of phosovane salts, which were used as a base for painkillers on some Outer Rim worlds.
The Five was an obscure evil-worshipping cult that existed on a warship residing deep within the region of space called the Hellhoop within the Expansion Region.
Meriso, along with Tola, was one of the two moons of Merisee.
Tedel was a planet. It was home to the besiioth.
The homeworld of the Charon species was located in otherspace. It was located near a massive black hole.

The Assassination on Munto Codru, was an event during the Second Imperial Civil War. Darth Kruhl, a Sith Lord of Darth Krayt's Order and assassin under the command of Darth Maladi, was dispatched to Munto Codru in order to ensure the loyalty of the native Codru-Ji to the Sith …
Shackles of Nizon was a GR-75 medium transport that was used as a slave ship by the Galactic Empire, to transport Nazren slaves from Nizon to the construction site of the Sarlacc Project at Byss.

result: Jedi victory; Bogga's thugs are defeated, Nomi Sunrider is made a Jedi
x: A skirmish took place in the year 3999 BBY on the planet Ambria. Under the direct orders of Great Bogga the Hutt, a gang of pirates and thugs were dispatched to Ambria to retrieve both the Tchuukthai Jedi Master Thon and the precious Adegan crystals in his possession.

In 40 ABY, a meeting between Dark Lady of the Sith Lumiya and her apprentice Jacen Solo was interrupted when the Twi'lek Dark Jedi Alema Rar caught Jedi Master Tresina Lobi spying on the conversation.

The Star of the Tion was a modified YT-1300 freighter assigned to members of the Alliance tasked with delivering updates for Alliance cell networks during the oppressive rule of the Galactic Empire. The ship was white with green striped markings.

Bogga's enforcer gang was a group of pirates, thugs, and gangsters led by Great Bogga, a notorious Hutt crime lord. Bogga's enforcers included many species one would usually find under the payroll of Hutts: Weequays, Niktos, Chadra-Fans, and Ishi Tibs were a few.
Finhead Stonebone's pirate gang was a loose-knit organization of thieves, smugglers, and gangsters led by pirate Finhead Stonebone.

result: Death of all Black Sun members
x: The Skirmish on Iego was a confrontation between members of Black Sun and "Bantha" Rawk's family which happened a short time after Cade Skywalker's escape from the Sith.
New Apsolon was the capital city of the planet New Apsolon. The city stretched several kilometers and consisted of two sectors, the Worker sector and the Civilized sector.
Ebon Squadron was a starfighter squadron that flew TIE/LN starfighters in service to the Galactic Empire.
Quenin was a spaceport city on the northern continent of the planet Daltarra.
