The Dicer was the name given to Eelo Begraas' Z-95 Headhunter. The elite Bothan pilot customized his ship, making it incredibly maneuverable. It was also rumored to contain some prototype technology obtained by the Bothan from a job for the Hutts.
Hunter Squadron was a starfighter squadron of BTL-B Y-wing starfighters in the service of Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
The Neebray Manta was a starship that was used by the Pacithhip smuggler Kozzel Qwok and his gang, during the time of the Clone Wars.
The Agricultural research vessel was a starship used for research of agriculture. In 0 BBY one such vessel was hijacked on Alderaan by a Black Sun vigo Slak Sagar.

The Communication center was a location on the first Death Star. After the Destruction of Despayre, Rianna Saren used the comm center to contact Princess Leia Organa and inform her about the battle station's firepower and the Imperial research facility on Danuta.
The bloatfish was a type of fish known to expand its body by taking in water or air as a defense mechanism, giving itself the appearance of a much larger creature.

Champion of Iridonia was a Hammerhead-class cruiser that was the flagship of a Galactic Republic fleet sent to Iridonia early on in the Jedi Civil War. Acaadi attempted to sabotage it during the Battle of Iridonia.

The Battle of Iridonia was a battle fought above Iridonia during the Jedi Civil War. During the battle, Acaadi attempted to sabotage the Republic flagship Champion of Iridonia and a number of Republic ships defected to the Sith Empire.
Speco was a planet aligned with the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War, located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

t: Battle of the Circarpous system (Galactic Civil War)
x: The Battle of the Circarpous system was a series of raids conducted by Rebel forces from the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence that resulted in the destruction of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Intrepid.
The Aurodia was a Galactic Republic warship that fought in the Clone Wars. Lieutenant Commander Ussin Fajinak was its first officer. Its first engagement was the Battle of Kashyyyk.

Haurgab was a planet in the Mid Rim that allied itself with the Separatists during the Clone Wars. The Galactic Republic sent Omega Squad to the planet, who battled the local forces in the Battle of Haurgab.

MI-726 was an MI-series security droid belonging to a board member of the Sienar Fleet Systems company. During an attack on the board member's house, the security droid went rogue and vanished, eventually resurfacing to begin attacking Imperial targets.

objective: Assassinate Dur Gejjen and leave no evidence of GAG involvement.
x: The Mission to Vulpter was a mission planned by Colonel Jacen Solo to have Ben Skywalker assassinate the Five World Prime Minister and leader of the Confederation, Dur Gejjen.

objective: Destroy a Separatist reactor
x: The Mission to Birix was a mission that occurred during the Clone Wars at the same time as the Battle of Coruscant and during it, the Null-class Advanced Recon Commando Prudii attempted to destroy a reactor on the Separatist controlled world of Birix.

result: Mission failed, Wyl Tarson becomes the agent of Darth Vader
objective: To destroy the Hub
x: The Mission to Ahakista was planned by a crime lord Raze and his associate Sardoth - the owner of Daystar Casino.

Made up of the Jedi Knights Jaina Solo, Zekk, and the former Human Chiss pilot, Jagged Fel, the Alema Rar Task Force was charged to defeat the Dark Jedi Alema Rar, who had become a serious adversary for the New Jedi Order in 40 ABY.
Aquila Squad was a clone commando unit that was part of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Manka Squad was a squad of clone commandos who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Republic Livestock and Agriculture Administration was a Galactic Republic department that specialized in genetic engineering. Their data was stolen by the Null Arcs in order to gather enough information to stop their accelerated aging.

Oriolanis was a terrestrial planet located in the Oriolanis system, a part of the Mid Rim's Oriolan sector. The minor technology company Oriolanis Defense Systems, which existed by 27 BBY, was based on Oriolanis.
Orar Squad was an elite clone commando unit, and was part of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Naast Squad was an elite clone commando unit, and was part of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Veshok Squad was an elite clone commando unit, and was part of the Special Operations Brigade of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

result: Republic withdraws its troops from Haurgab
x: The Battle of Haurgab was a battle that was fought on Haurgab during the Clone Wars. The local Maujasi Clans rebelled against the local government and allied themselves with the Confederacy of Independent Systems, conducting several successful raids on GAR supply convoys.
Redeemer was a Republic Fleet Auxiliary Support Vessel that served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.

t: Raid on the Imperial Academy of Carida
x: The Alliance to Restore the Republic conducted a raid on the Imperial Academy of Carida prior to the Battle of Endor. Of the Rebel pilots who carried out the attack, only four survived, including Lieutenant Telsij.
a: Attack on the Imperial Academy of Carida

x: The attack on the Kashyyyk outpost was a battle which occurred on Kashyyyk prior to the Battle of Yavin. The Y-wings of Gold Squadron attacked an Imperial outpost on the planet.
A raid on Corellia took place prior to the Battle of Yavin. Rebel pilot Tiree participated in the raid, saving some engineers who proved invaluable to the Rebellion.

During the Galactic Civil War, the Alliance to Restore the Republic were forced to evacuate their base on Alis Point. During the evacuation, Alliance pilot Zev Senesca held off three TIE/LN starfighters while an unarmed transport carrying the base personnel fled into hyperspace.
The sorties against Fondor Shipyards were twelve attacks on the shipyards at Fondor conducted by the Rebel Alliance prior to the Battle of Endor. Rebel pilot Keir Santage participated in the raids.

result: Majority of population of Pydyr are killed
A major disturbance in the Force occurs
x: The Bombing of Pydyr occurred in 17 ABY, when the Dark Jedi Kueller devastated the moon of Pydyr.
The bombing of the Senate Hall was a terrorist attack that occurred in the Senate Hall on Coruscant in 17 ABY.

result: Kueller demonstrates his power to the New Republic
x: The Bombing of Auyemesh occurred in 17 ABY, when the Dark Jedi Kueller had the moon of Auyemesh bombed as a demonstration of his power.

The Bombing of the Smuggler's Run occurred in 17 ABY when Kueller detonated the bombs hidden in droids bound for Coruscant. As all the droids there had been deactivated, the only ones that blew up were the ones on Smuggler's Run, that were going to be smuggled there.
Khemerion was a planet in the Expansion Region, on which the Separatist Ruusaan Skirata was detained by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Birix was a world that Prudii Skirata went on a mission to during the Clone Wars, to destroy a Separatist reactor.

The Funeral of Etain Tur-Mukan was a Jedi funeral held to mark the passing of Jedi Knight Etain Tur-Mukan. The ceremony was held in 19 BBY, two days after Etain's death on Coruscant the night Order 66 was issued.

The Mission to Prakith was a mission carried out by the Alderaanian Resistance to rescue Jedi Master Denia from the Citadel Inquisitorius on Prakith. A team of spacers infiltrated the citadel and killed a number of Inquisitors along the way.
Junktown, more informally known as the junk town, and later as the Tusken Village, was a small village just outside of Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine.
The Shi'kar were a group whose homeworld—located in the Nembus sector of the Outer Rim Territories—was destroyed by a comet impact some time prior to the Clone Wars of 22–19 BBY.
Garrthinius was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Steniplis sector that was under the control of the Galactic Empire by the time of the Battle of Endor.

The Skirmish on Shinarcan Bridge Extension occurred a few hours after Order 66, when the 501st Legion attacked a number of Jedi, who were trying to sneak out of the security check on the Shinarcan Bridge Extension.

result: Galactic Republic forced into the Treaty of Coruscant
The Jedi Order retreats to Tython
Much of Coruscant left in ruin
End of the Great Galactic War; beginning of the Cold War
x: The Sacking of Coruscant, also known as the Battle of Coruscant, occurred at the end of the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

headquarters: Dark Council chamber on Dromund Kaas
Dark Council chambers on Vaiken Spacedock
x: The Dark Council was the supreme governing body of the Sith Empire. A twelve-member council that served as the ruling body throughout much of the Empire's history.

t: Battle of Sluis Van (Great Galactic War)
x: Shortly after the Sith Empire's return to known space in 3681 BBY, Imperial forces launched an attack on the Galactic Republic's holdings at the planet Sluis Van in the Sluis sector in one of the earliest battles of the Great Galactic War.

result: The Sith Empire destroys the surface cities of Manaan
x: The Devastation of Manaan was an act carried out by the Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War against the planet Manaan, sometime between 3681 BBY and 3653 BBY.
During the Great Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, the remote planet of Ilum was the site of a battle between the two galactic powers.
Sometime between 3681 and 3653 BBY during the Great Galactic War,. the Old Republic and the Sith Empire fought a battle on the planet Dathomir.
The Battle of Utapau was a battle of the Sith Empire's second main offensive against the Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War.

A battle occurred on the planet Agamar during the second main offensive of the Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. The battle resulted in a victory for the forces of the Imperial Military.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: This skirmish took place in the Feswe Corridor, immediately following an initial attack at Skorrupon by the Alliance to Restore the Republic that failed to stop the advance of the newly-completed Star Dreadnought Executor as it neared the Rebel base on Yavin 4.
The Battle of Kiros was fought between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Wanderer was a Far*Reach IV PQR survey vessel in the service of the Imperial Survey Corps during the Galactic Civil War. It was piloted by Brektate at the time of its crash on the crystalline world of Isis.

result: Republic victory, shipyards destroyed, slaves freed
x: The Battle of Gwori was a battle during the Clone Wars in which Anakin Skywalker had to pinpoint the location of a Confederate shipyard on Gwori. Once there he had to call on a bomber strike to destroy it.

This skirmish at the Shi'kar Straits took place in 20 BBY, during the Clone Wars. After the aftermath of the battle on the planet of Kiros, Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker were continuing their search for the lost population of Togrutas.
T'ra Saa's ship was a ship Jedi Master T'ra Saa used to fly to the Azurbani system on a mission given her by the Jedi High Council to meet with Quinlan Vos and inform him of Volfe Karkko's history.
Tholme's commandeered fighter was a starfighter stationed aboard the Raptor. Jedi Master Tholme and his Padawan Quinlan Vos stole it to escape the doomed starship as it was exploding.
Crimson Phoenix Squadron was a Rebel Alliance starfighter squadron that was active during the Galactic Civil War. They operated out of Mos Espa on Tatooine.

The Invisible Shell was a criminal organization that was formed by Lorimar Lebauer who was later imprisoned at the instigation of his nephew Ludlo Lebauer. After Lorimar's imprisonment, Ludlo became acting chairman.
61st Flight was a flight of Trade Federation Vulture droid starfighters in the service of the navy of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

result: No clear result for either side.
objective: Convince the Order of the Sacred Circle to join the Rebel Alliance
x: In 0 ABY, a mission was carried out by Luke Skywalker in an effort to convince the isolationist Order of the Sacred Circle to join the Rebel Alliance.
The Rishi moon, also known simply as Rishi, was a natural satellite of the planet Rishi.
Holador was a remote planet. It had a crashed colony of Squibs living on it.

affiliation: Grand Army of the Republic broadcast
x: One particular droid of the LeisureMech Enterprises BD-3000 luxury droid line, the Bettie-Bot VJ, was responsible for a music program on the Grand Army of the Republic broadcast system of the HoloNet during the Clone Wars.
Alderaanian flare-wings were colorful flying insects native to the planet of Alderaan.
Alderaanian walking barnacles were a species of aquatic crustaceans found on the planet Alderaan in the Core Worlds.
Zronta grazers were non-sentient herbivores that were native to the planet Pii III. The species had a mild temperament.
Dhislugs were predatory gastropods native to Algara II that relied on externally-excreted acid to digest prey, as they lacked teeth. They had two antennae and grew over three meters long.
Metarshi were herbivorous herd animals from Alk'Lellish III. They were hunted by the four-fanged predator known as the ketrann.

Grazers were antlered herbivores who were native to the plains and mountains of the Corporate Sector planet Ammuud. Grazers lived together in massive herds, migrating at a ponderous pace across Ammuud, eating grass, scrub and lichen.
Rujos were silver-furred, herd-dwelling quadrupeds from Annaj spread to Qina and other Moddell sector worlds as domestic animals for carrying cargo or riders.
Hka'ka were a nocturnal species of non-sentient creatures native to the planet Barab I. Preying upon the vsst species, hka'ka were the staple of the shenbit bonecrushers which roamed the world.
Snow storks were white-feathered avians from Berea.
Triggerbirds were native to Bespin, where they lived in symbiosis with beldons. The birds lived in the gas creatures' tentacles for shelter and ate small creatures.

Bestine sea anemones were likely marine cnidarians indigenous of the planet Bestine IV. The flabby, pale, fingerlike growths of Xabar fungus were dark purple in color with crimson tips. According to Boba Fett, they writhed like the tendrils of a Bestine sea anemone.

The Biituian fen-hare was a species that originated from Biitu, a lush agriworld in the Cassandran Worlds. It was a timid creature, and by 4 ABY, it had been incorporated into a Galactic Basic Standard simile for a frightened person.

The Rescue of Domina Tagge was a small engagement on the edge of the Yavin system. While on the routine patrol, the Blue Flight under the command of Luke Skywalker noticed a civilian vessel under the attack of several TIE/LN starfighters.

The Shadow EVO troopers were a specialized variant of the Shadow Trooper, but were also based off of the EVO Troopers. They were equipped with cloaking devices and used FA-3 flechette launchers. They were called to the battlefield by stormtrooper commanders.
A battle was fought in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The dartfish was a type of fish that lived in the sea among sea anemones. The relationship between dartfish and sea anemones was comparable to the one between tiga loreng, a creature native to the planet Bimmisaari, and the asaari trees they nested in.
Harpercod were a type of fish indigenous to Dac. They were banded with speckles.
Ice-lobsters were crustaceans indigenous to the planet Dac's polar seas.
Khasva were a species of fish indigenous to Dac. They could be eaten fried.
Lungfish were a species of fish indigenous to Dac.

The octowhale was a type of creature with claws. While on a jungle planet, in 30 BBY, the Quarren Senator Tikkes mentioned the great creature's brazen claws after witnessing a meteor shower bombard the planet's surface sooner than he expected.
Pointer fish were a species of fish native to Dac. They were eaten raw, rolled in pieces of lampfish tongue.

This sail barge was a Ubrikkian Industries Luxury sail barge that was owned the Gamorrean crime lord, Centa Sonhan. It was attacked by the Rebel Alliance after Sonhan captured the Ithorian Momaw Nadon.
Flutteries were insects native to Cartao. They were flying, swarming pollinators.

t: Attack on Centa Sonhan's sail barge
x: The Attack on Centa Sonhan's sail barge was a battle that occurred on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

Bildogs were oceanic, edible herd beast of Chadra. The animals were large sea slugs that would gather in groups of five to fifty. They could grow over 150 meters long and 15 meters in diameter. The species was considered graceful and gentle, but extremely dumb.
Eloags were a type of white bird native to Chad, eaten by cy'een.
The lactil was a smelly, hoofed, herd-dwelling mammal found on the Jospro sector planet Chad that was raised for its milk.
Growing twelve to fifteen meters in length, methnaps were used as mounts by the seagoing ranchers of Chad. They were akin to tsaelke and cy'een. They could carry up to 125 kilograms.
A popular pet on the Chadra-Fan homeworld of Chad, the pleeky, also named the chak-chak, was a species of rodent which was miniscule in stature.

Proop were edible slugs native to the oceans of Chad, where they traveled in herds. They were tentacled creatures that grew to about fifteen meters long. They were semi-domesticated and tended to stay in the warmer upper levels of the ocean.
The blackback was an elusive forest-dwelling bird of prey that lived in the Hanna Wild Game Reserve and other protected regions on the planet Chandrila.
Hootbats were bats native to Clak'dor VII, named for its hooting noise.

Puffer turtles were a reptilian species of turtles found in the swamps of Clak'dor VII, a planet ravaged by biochemical warfare. Some of these turtles were violet. The species possessed bladders which they could swell to a point that stretched the flexibility of their shells.
The urgonox was a creature native to Clak'dor VII. It was the mutated descendant of the urgrinox.
The urgrinox was an extinct animal native to Clak'dor VII. It was an ancestor of the mutant urgonox.
Corellian scavenge rats, also known as scavenger rats, were rodents native to Corellia.
Corellian wine-bees were insects native to Corellia.
Dragon Slugs were fire-breathing creatures who lived on Hoth.
Slader's Raider I was a Vee-Kir 4 Bulk Transport owned and operated by Roark Slader. It was modified to allow the DP20 frigate Slader's Raider II to be concealed in the bow.
Coruscant game fowl were farm-bred birds eaten on Coruscant.
Gaberworms were half-meter worms found in the garbage of Coruscant. Their hair was harvested to make gaberwool.
Grate toads were a type of toad that thrived on heat and waste produced by sentient life. They could be found on the planet Coruscant in 19 BBY.
Gully rats were a type of rat that thrived on heat and waste, byproducts of sentient life. It could be found on the planet Coruscant.
The Tempest was a Victory-class Star Destroyer in service in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Sea shrikes were birds introduced to the artificial seas of Coruscant.
Shreebirds were an endangered species. Jar Jar Binks accidentally let loose numerous shreebirds from the Endangered Shreebird Aviary on Coruscant at one point.
Yellow-tailed summerbirds were found on Coruscant, including near the Senate Rotunda.
Akcinor were blue-beaked birds from Cularin whose call was mimicked as a hunting signal by the Tarasin.

Gibbit birds were avian creatures native to Dathomir. Gibbit birds were symbiotic to the rancor. The rancor allowed the gibbit bird to roam freely in its mouth, where the bird cleaned its teeth by picking out stuck pieces of bones and flesh.
Kiin'Dray were a variant of gaping spider.
Finned blaggarts were serpents native to Yavin 4.
Remmers were a scavenger species from Endor. Variants included the highland remmer.
Mine rats were subterranean creatures from the Forest Moon of Endor. During the Galactic Civil War, a pack of mine rats lived in the underground tunnels of the Death Watch bunker.
Garalalesh in the Ergesh language, or swamp skimmers in Basic, were three-meter swimming predators that ate prey on the surface of Ergeshui's swamps using wide mouths.
Muckworms were a type of worm. Muckworm could also be used as an insult, as exampled when Dek-Nil referred to Doctor Aphra and Lopset Yas as muckworms.
Nemats were flying insectoid sanguivores from the swamps of Ergeshui. They stunned victims with sonic attacks. Nemats preyed in swarms on Garalalesh or any warm-blooded creature.
Terecons were eight-meter-long reptilian predators of Essowyn, one meter at the shoulder. They burrowed into pits from which they ambushed hoskas.
Bark mites were insects on Rori and Endor. They ate bark, and made large hives in trees and caves.
The dawndaddy was a species that lived on the Forest Moon of Endor and made a noise at the rise of the moon's sun, Ibleam, signaling dawn.
Gunlabirds were avians of Endor eaten by yootaks.

The Quexius was a species of green-and-red birds native to the moon Endor. The bird was aggressive and would often peck at nearby beings for no reason. It was also an incredibly stupid bird that would antagonize predators. For this reason, the Quexius was an endangered species.

Tip-yips, also known as Endorian chickens, were a species that lived on the forest moon of Endor. They were similar to hens, and were raised for their eggs by the sentient Ewoks who also lived on Endor.

Mears were six-legged hooved mammals native to Gacerian. They had sizable horns and a body length of about 2.5 meters. Their multiple limbs allowed them to climb well in the mountains, where they ate what few plants they could find.

Flapdragons were animals from Gamorr's swamps. Beasts that varied in size, with four wings and flaps next to their jaws that dripped with extremely toxic acid. They had the ability to spray fire when intimidated, although seldom used it.
Noli were flightless birds from Gandeid IV eaten by cooha. Adult noli had powerful beaks and claws.
Crupa, sometimes called cloud crupa, were nocturnal songbirds from Garos IV.
Reeho were colorful birds from Gelgelar. They were hunted for food by the native Glarsaur. The Sullustan T'laerean Larn used the Force to merge his mind with the reeho who was named "Sunshine."
Si-hens were birds native to Gelgelar. They ate grain, which they would peck off the ground.
Leaf-leapers were creatures from the planet Geonosis.
Garbage-snipes were edible birds from Glottal.
Parfue gnats were parasitic sanguivores which fed on the blood of watumba bats. Glottalphibs ate parfue gnats.
Highglides were carrion-eating avians from Goroth Prime with emerald feathers. Gorothite mythology considered them a symbol of nobility.
M'Ven, translated "swoopers," were black-feathered avians that ate one specific species of moss on the planet Goroth Prime.
Forntarch were edible, arboreal, carnivorous swamp rodents from Gorsh.
Swarm bugs were methane-filled bugs of Gorsh which exploded when swatted.

The boolon was a type of bird found on Ithor, a planet that was the homeworld of the Ithorian species. A boolon was large in size and had a loud call. Some Ithorian males had "Boolon" as a given name.
A cellwan was a graceful herd animal found on Ithor, a planet that was the homeworld of the Ithorian species. Some Ithorian females had "Cellwan" as a given name.
Eye-snatchers were predatory red-feathered birds native to the Ottega system. Their nests were raided for their edible eggs, which resembled eyeballs.
A flen was a particularly strong beast of burden found on Ithor, a planet that was the homeworld of the Ithorian species. Some Ithorian males had "Flen" as a given name.

The gillom was a type of bird found on Ithor, the homeworld of the Ithorian species. A bird of prey, the gillom's diet primarily consisted of fish. Ithorian males sometimes had "Gillom" as their given name.
The Haali was a species of songbird native to the planet Ithor, the homeworld of the Ithorian species. Ithorian females sometimes had "Haali" as their given name.

The Ivuur was a species of bird found on Ithor, a planet that was the homeworld of the Ithorian species. An Ivuur could sing two different songs simultaneously, and some female Ithorians had "Ivuur" as a given name. The name could have negative connotations.
The marsune was a species of long-extinct behemoth that lived underwater on the Mid Rim planet Naboo. Marsune was also used as a surname among the Gungan species on Naboo.
The Murr species was a tough and slow-witted race of beasts of burden native to Ithor, the homeworld of the Ithorian species. Murr was also a given name for Ithorian males.

A neelig was a venomous serpent that invaded homes on Ithor, the homeworld of the Ithorian species. At some point after the creature had gone extinct, "Neelig" had become an Ithorian male given name, being associated with quickness.

The oovei was a type of bird found on Ithor, a planet that was the homeworld of the Ithorian species. The oovei birds were colorful and would only appear in the morning. Some Ithorian females had "Oovei" as a given name.
Ithorian razor sharks were a predatory fish that lived in the oceans of the planet Ithor. The sharks had dagger-like teeth that lined their large mouths.
A roogak was a hearty but obstinate herd animal found on Ithor, a planet that was the homeworld of the Ithorian species. Some Ithorians had "Roogak" as a surname.
The vonnuvi was a type of waterfowl found on Ithor, a planet that was the homeworld of the Ithorian species. Some Ithorian females had "Vonnuvi" as a given name.
Oslets were six-limbed, arboreal, three-meter-tall herbivores from Joralla. They were used as mounts by the Tikiarri. An oslet's neck was flexible enough that it could rotate its head 360 degrees.

Wulkarsks were six-limbed, four-eyed pack predators from the jungles of Joralla. They were easily capable of eating humanoid-sized prey. Wulkarsks were trained to hunt for the Tikiarri. They were part of a family of animals known as wulkensos.
A waawat was a fierce jungle predator found on Ithor, a planet that was the homeworld of the Ithorian species. Ithorian males sometimes had "Waawat" as their given name.
Grove harriers were predatory birds from Kashyyyk. They ate mallakins.
Tirginni beasts were a non-sentient mammalian species native to an unsettled desert planet of the Kathol sector. Roaming the deserts, the tirginni were preyed upon by mole serpents.
Trogwhales were a non-sentient species of horned animals from the planet Kintan in the Kintan system of the Si'Klaata Cluster in Hutt Space.
Tuskbeasts were a non-sentient species native to the planet Kintan. They were considered dangerous and so were driven to extinction by the Nikto species.
Jungle slinkers were animals from Kirtania which, as camouflage, looked like woody vines known as lianas.

A predator lizard was a carnivorous frill-neck predator native to the rain forests of the planet Kirtania. They were between one-point-nine to two and half meters in length, and lived in the branches of the trees in the rain forest.

A river serpent was a carnivorous predator native to the rain forests of the planet Kirtania. They were between two to three meters in length, and basked on river banks waiting for larger prey such as rodents or wild pigs.
A rodus was a type of rodent eaten by felinxes.

Wampa Valley was a valley on Hoth that was home to a large number of wampas, including the giant wampa, Unkajo. It was linked to Echo Base via a tunnel, which was blocked off by the Rebel Alliance, but was reopened during the Battle of Hoth.

Millipods were a species of giant insect native to the planet Kubindi. The insects' shells were fire-red in color and they dwelt in the swamps of their homeworld, where they were raised as a food source by the indigenous sentient Kubaz species.
The Sith familiar was a type of Sith-developed creature that resembled a small scavenger bird. Familiars were created by the Sith—an order of dark-side adherents—and were produced via Sith alchemy.
Quickers were aerial predators native to Kuras III that were two meters long and had a four and-a-half-meter wingspan.

KyLessian fruit bats were carnivorous, nocturnal bats native to the planet KyLessia. Their name referred to their nesting in wulfruit trees; they did not eat fruit. The creatures were small, measuring 15-30 centimeters long, and were extremely lightweight.

KyLessia was located within the KyLessia system. It was the homeworld of wulfruit trees, KyLessian fruit bats, and KyLessian feather mites. Its exports included KyLessian Fruit Distillate, a popular Outer Rim alcohol.
A Cavehopper was an amphibian predator from Lamaredd.
The Gulletbeast was a non-sentient aquatic predator living in the seas of the planet Lamaredd.

Pharples were small, flightless birds with long beaks native to the desert world of Lok. These cowardly insectivores caused little trouble to sentient beings. Breeds of pharple included giant pharples and runty pharples.

Sulfur mynocks were a subspecies of the parasitic mynock that lived on the arid Outer Rim planet Lok. Contrary to regular mynocks, the sulfur mynocks lived in an atmosphere and had two horns on their head. Variants included the Riverside sulfur mynock and Sulfur pool mynock.

Asgnats were creatures genetically engineered by the Lurrians of the planet Lur. Swarms of asgnats bored through the world's snowy ravines and glaciers to create the warrenlike cities that the Lur inhabited.
Makthierse was a colony world noted for ranches, farms, crystal caves, and Quantrax Creek. Native creatures included lacas and preying makthiers.
Flutterers were thumb-sized fish which traveled in large schools on the planet Marca.
Swamp serpents were brown, predatory serpents native to Marca. Though air-breathers, they were excellent swimmers. They hunted in schools consisting of ten to fifteen individuals.
Swamp sharks were meter-long predatory fish on Marca. They did not hunt in groups.
Water gliders were red, ten-legged insectoids that skimmed quickly on the water's surface on Marca. They possessed sharp mandibles, but would flee from sudden movements.
Tanrays, also known as lava lizards, were predatory reptiles from Mustafar. Tanray heart crystals were named after this creature, due to the crystal's resemblance to a tanray's heart.

Hokami were predators from Mutanda's plains. They had great skill at sneaking through Mutanda's grasses unseen. They were very aggressive and would attack virtually any creature. They were also known to attack repulsorlift vehicles with their sharp claws and their teeth.

Kalan were furry, quadrupedal, tusked herbivores of Mutanda that grew over three meters tall. They moved in large herds and were hunted for food by Horansi and tourists. They had four limbs, with elongated bodies, short necks and broad heads.
Copeks were predators that lived in the core of the planet Naboo.
Fanned rawls, also known simply as rawls, were reptilian snakes from the Mid Rim world of Naboo.
Gallo were fish native to Naboo. Many Gungan families were named after this species.
Kreetch eels were large predators from Naboo capable of feeding on and conducting electricity, which they used to stun prey.
Gerzob was an astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories' Gerzob system. It was the homeworld of the creature known as the Yellow-Bellied Green-Proboscis Marsupial.
Recycloppers were a species of nonsentient fishes that dwelled in the freshwaters of planet Naboo.
A skipper squid was a creature that the Human Royal Naboo Security Forces Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes was familiar with.

The wollod was a species of mollusk that lived in the waterways of Naboo, a planet in the Mid Rim's Chommell sector that featured seas and swamps on its surface as well as an extensive system of water-filled tunnels beneath it.
Ven-Kavi Starport was a starport located on the planet Venaari.
The Aremin was a Star Galleon-class frigate in the Imperial Navy. It was attacked by the smuggler Toob Ancher while suffering from the last stages of Bitter Winter.
Stassia City was located on the planet Stassia.
Marmoth was a planet located in the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim Territories, and was a part of the Relgim Run. It was one of the ports of call of the luxury liner Kuari Princess.
Argona was the capital city of the planet of Rhamalai.
These Endorian goats were a species of goat found on the Forest Moon of Endor. The native Ewoks were known to have domesticated Endorian goats.

Tree vipers were venomous serpents from the jungles of Najarka. Their bite caused paralysis; individuals paralyzed by the venom had to receive a general anti-toxin within eight minutes to avoid irreversible brain damage.
Carrion deathbirds were scavengers; seeing one was considered an ill omen.
Dexus-12 was a world in a trinary Colonies system.
Jocorros were animals from Bespin with delicate wings.

The kasaq mollusk was a type of mollusk that was covered by a shell. In 22 BBY, as part of a Clone Wars battle in the Crystal City on the planet Christophsis in the Outer Rim Territories' Savareen sector, the Human Jedi Anakin Skywalker and his Togruta Padawan learner Ahsoka T…

Rockrenders were large creatures who lived within the caves of the volcanic planet Sullust. They were attracted to the taste of dense minerals—including those found in stormtrooper armor. They had two extremely long claws on each front leg and a long tail.

Siltcrawlers were creatures from the Outer Rim planet Nelvaan. They dug burrows for homes, were capable of hibernation, and lived in colonies. The massive and carnivorous horaxes often split open these burrows with their snout horns in order to eat entire colonies whole.
The gulpers were creatures native to Nim Drovis, a planet located in the Meridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. They occupied the swamps and marshes of Nim Drovis.
Larkin nerfs were a non-sentient subspecies of nerf native to the planet Pii III. They had a mild temperament and a herbivorous diet.
Wooly-nerfs were a subspecies of the nerf.
Fur-bearing trout were a native fish to Paulking XIV.

Irids were flighted birds native to the planet Ragoon VI. With yellow feathers on their wings, they were noted for plumage that was pleasing to the eye. Nevertheless, they were notorious for their violent behavior toward others of their species.
Casting hawks were predatory birds from Ralltiir.

Rodian kelp gnats were a species of non-sentient insect from the planet Rodia. Naturally they lived for only twenty-four hours, however the Kubaz chef Zubindi Ebsuk could keep a member of the species alive for up to five years using growth enzymes, which caused many changes to…
Stinkfish were sea creatures native to the planet Sedri. The stinkfish exuded a poison as a form of defence that could render individuals unconscious.
Jarts were birds of prey native to Ryloth. They hunted at night.
Flensors were a species of carrion bird capable of flight and native to the planet Sakiya within the Saki system in the region of the galaxy known as Hutt Space.

Rass were a species of predators native to the planet of Sakiya in the Saki system of Hutt Space. They possessed hard bones that were a pebbled black in color and used by the sentient Sakiyan species, who were also native to the rass' homeworld, to make the handles for bladed …

Saber-fangs were a species of animal whose physiology included blood. Fully grown saber-fangs would sometimes fight one another, with the result usually being that both participants left the conflict bloodied and a victor being difficult to identify.

Stinger fish were aquatic creatures native to the planet Sedri. They were jellyfish-like creatures with suction cups that stung upon contact. The sting was not life-threatening, but was irritating and annoying.

Mellcrawlers were native to Sullust, a volcanic planet in the Outer Rim Territories. They gave off a noxious smell, which worsened when one of the creatures died By the year 20 BBY, the Sullustan reporter Den Dhur was familiar with the smell of a mellcrawler that had been dead…
Noors were graceful, subterranean animals from the planet Sullust which were only rarely spotted. Many Sullustan females were named for the species.
The tunnel worm was a type of four-meter-long segmented worm that lived on the Inner Rim planet Tasariq. They were carnivorous, could bite, and burrowed tunnels in the earth.
The spidercat was a fur-covered insect that lived on the Inner Rim planet Tasariq. It had characteristics of both spiders and cats and had a venomous bite.
Sting-snakes were guard animals on Tasariq.
Bone gnashers were a breed of subterranean arachne native to the planet Endor. Bone gnashers were so called because they were able to rapidly strip the flesh off corpses.
Faybos were rodent-like scavenger creatures of Tatooine found near Tusken Raider camps. They had large ears, long fangs and striped coat.
Mound mites were garbage-dwelling creatures of Tatooine. A mutated one was known to have terrorized residents of Mos Taike in 1 ABY.
Water bugs were a swimming species that inhabited the subterranean waterways on the planet Mimban. These vermin also lived on Tatooine, Naboo, and Rori. They swam with an anxious, darting motion.
Woolly pigs were a type a pig species that were native to the planet Togoria.
Arabores were a species of aquatic rodents native to the harsh ice-covered planet Toola in the Outer Rim Territories.
Ice tigers were feline predators from Toola.
Enyaks were native to the planet Ukio and were hunted by other carnivores for their food.
Resputi-seals, also referred to as simply resputi, were a type of large and fierce creature that lived in the deep sinkhole caves of the Outer Rim planet Utapau.
Armored vrblthers were a variety of vrblther found on Varl. Like other vrblthers, they were bipeds but would drop to all fours in order to run albeit with a loping gait.
Pollinators were swarming, territorial, pollinating insects from Vaynai.

Black behemoths were territorial predators from Veron, four meters long and two meters at the shoulder. Each behemoth claimed a personal territory and memorized the location of every tree, pool of water and vine.

Swamp worms were four-meter long ambush predators from Veron's swamps. Swamp worms were experts at moving through the thick mud of Veron's surface. They would often bury themselves in a few centimeters of mud and wait for a creature to walk by.

Spinefish were a species of animal from the planet Vodran in the Vodran system of the Si'Klaata Cluster in Hutt Space. They lived in the stagnant rivers of their homeworld alongside the predatory dianoga and were caught by the native sentient species, the Vodran.
Spined pucs were an amphibian frog-like creature. Spined pucs and giant spined pucs were native to Yavin 4. Another race known as pug jumpers were native to Kashyyyk.

The crawlers were 134 species of nearly two-dimensional life-forms that lived under high atmospheric pressures in the boundary between the atmosphere and core of the Outer Rim Territories gas giant Yavin Prime.
Insect-birds were red animals from Yavin 4.
Lopers were the largest species of burrower found on Yavin 8. They were carnivorous pack hunters, armed with teeth and claws, and a bone-plated barbed tail.

Ropedancers were water serpents found on Yavin 8. With an average diameter of 1 meter and a maximum length of 48 meters, these fanged predators had a very elastic digestive system and were capable of expanding it up to twice its normal size.

Ursods were quadrupedal, polar predators of Yavin 8 that preyed upon songbuks. The fur of the Ursod could change color from white to mottled colors in order to blend in with its changing surroundings.
Herabes were creatures of Zolan that could change the texture of their skin to blend in with rocks.
The dingory was a hairless canine predator native to Lan Barell. They were raised on ranches and their meat was eaten by Humans and Qieg. Dingories themselves would eat Qieg if they had the chance.
Tuaregs were two-meter tall equine quadrupeds used as mounts by the Nocivs of Kadril.

Sea monsters were a type of aquatic creatures that lived in the oceans of the planet Selonia. There were no sea monsters on the neighboring world of Corellia because its oceans were much smaller than Selonia's.
Farlus hawks were carnivorous hawks native to Alsakan.
Ghaswars were fossorial creatures of Exodo II. They often burrowed into the lava of the planet.
Birsingrial was a Core Worlds planet known for its jewel-caves. Besany Wennen's family once went there on a vacation when she was about ten years old.
The Mission to Had Abbadon was a skirmish that took place on the planet Had Abbadon, a mythical world located in the Deep Core.
The Independent Company of Settlers was a corporation formed out of loyalists of the former Galactic Empire who wanted to live in peace from the New Republic.

The Bedlam Spirits were an omnipotent group of entities that inhabited the planet Bedlam near the Bedlam Pulsar. They consisted of Tilotny, Horliss-Horliss, Cold Danda Sine and Splendid Ap. The spirits were very powerful beings, capable of manipulating time and mass.

The D'olop mountain range was a mountain range located on the agriworld M'haeli in the Expansion Region. Fragile dragite gems were mined in the mountain range, and used in lightsabers, where they could produce shockwaves when the blade struck an object.
CT-642 was the designation of a carbon-freezing plant located on Coruscant.
VX-391 was a freighter that carried the bodies of Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Ahsoka Tano and other clone troopers encased in carbonite.

The Battle of the North occurred at some point before 94 BBY. It was one of the many struggles of the Melida/Daan Civil War. Over a century later, the Daan took revenge on the Melida for it in the Battle of the Plains.

The Battle of the Plains occurred at some point of the Melida/Daan Civil War. Micae's father, Terandi, died in that battle. The Daan had waged it to take revenge on the Melida for the Battle of the North, which occurred over a century before.

The Battle of Bin occurred at some point between the Twenty-First Battle of Zehava circa 94 BBY and the Twenty-Second Battle of Zehava three years later. It was one of the many struggles of the Melida/Daan Civil War.
Sebolto's drug cartel was the Dug King Sebolto's illegal death stick smuggling enterprise operating in various star systems.
Navroc City was a metropolis on the planet of Cartao, located up by the Quatreen River in relation to the Foulahn City.

Garth was a city of Daan in the North Country on the planet Melida/Daan. At one point during the Melida/Daan Civil War, it was invaded by the Melida, who forced Garth's people into concentration camps, where many died.
Jeco were creatures capable of making swift attacks. Dezix of the Imperial Security Bureau was described as being capable of striking as swiftly as a jeco.

The Frontier Hawk was a heavily-armed, modified YT-1300 light freighter owned and operated by smuggler Roget Jiriss as of 10 ABY.
The Ur-Yuuzhan Vong were a extra-galactic sentient, species from Yuuzhan'tar in a distant galaxy. Ur-Yuuzhan Yong lived as symbiotes with their homeworld and the species as a whole.

The Fall of Falleen took place in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars when a Confederate fleet under the command of General Grievous attacked the planet Falleen.

OT-3PO was a 3PO-series protocol droid who worked in a flophouse located in Gnawer's Roost in the sub-levels of Coruscant. On one occasion, members of the Alderaanian Resistance came by in search of the technician Pavel Trenol, who was staying in a room there.

The Sea Leviathan was a semi-sentient form of Sithspawn, alchemically engineered by the Givin Vul Isen, a scientist in Darth Krayt's One Sith Order.

The Sanctuary III was a modified Pelta-class frigate in the service of the Galactic Republic. Its role as an armed and armored hospital ship was instrumental in the effort to curb losses during the Clone Wars.
The Coruscant Wildlife Management Department was a Galactic Republic organization on Coruscant that was responsible for the control of Coruscani ogres.

The Subjugation of Sinton was an event that occurred during the reign of the Galactic Empire, specifically at some point by 3 ABY. During the event, the Humanocentric Empire subjugated the Mid Rim planet Sinton, which was populated by non-Humans.

The destruction of Otoh Sancture was an attack on the Gungan city of Otoh Sancture on the planet Naboo during the war that had broken out between the various tribes of the amphibious Gungan race that took place in 3000 BBY.
The Calabar Queen was a luxury liner owned by Imperial Corusca Lines.
South Jedi Lane was a street in the Lost City of the Jedi on Yavin 4. Ken's residence, dome-house 12, was on this street.
Whicci were carrion birds native to Vaced.
Hijado was a planet on the Hydian Way, halfway to Bonadan. The Human natives of Hijado were called Hijadoans. It was located in the Hijado system of the Thesme sector.

Passel Argente's starship was the personal starship of the Corporate Alliance Magistrate. During the Clone Wars, Passel Argente used this ship to travel to a rendezvous with the Trandoshan scavenger, Gha Nachkt, aboard his freighter, the Vulture's Claw.
The Devastation was a Separatist Subjugator-class heavy cruiser and the sister ship of the Malevolence.

IT-904 was an Imperial Interrogation droid who was purchased by the bounty hunter Dej Vennor in an auction. Vennor modified the droid, which included giving it new programming and additional armaments, allowing him to use it to help him in collecting bounties.
Dorumaa City was a city on Dorumaa. The Cantina Oceana was located there.
Quadrant A-89 was a section of the planet Coruscant.

The Battle of Aguarl 3 was a brief engagement of the Galactic Civil War approximately six months after the Battle of Yavin, in which a wing of TIE bombers struck at a sub-aquatic Rebel base on Aguarl 3.

The Detention Level was an area on the Death Star that held numerous detention blocks located on descending sub-levels. Sub-level 0 was the first sub-level, with other sub-levels extending downwards towards the battle station's southern pole.
The Cal Ambre was a heavily modified Cal-class battleship.
The Beheboth civil war was fought between moisture farmers and Gideon Longspar in 3 ABY.
The skirmish aboard the Nanda's Luck took place when the pirates aboard the Majestic attacked the fishing vessel Nanda's Luck.

An ice-river vaban was a type of creature that, judging by its name, inhabited cold water currents. According to Goran Beviin, the scarlet and blue color barbels of the ice-river vaban resembled the growths of the Yuuzhan Vong vessel miid ro'ik.

The Five Holy Cities were cities founded by religious crusaders on the planet New Holgha, which was best known for them. The Yuuzhan Vong attacked the planet three months after they launched their galactic invasion.

Collypods were a species of small non-sentient creature used in cooking. They were regularly served flambeed and then smothered in a thick broth.
Hino-111 was a planet and a member of the Galactic Republic.
Mindemir was the primary planet of the Mindemir system. Jenna Zan Arbor wanted to use the planet's water supplies in her experiments, but was blocked from doing so by the Galactic Senate.

The Eastern Enrichment Zone was one of several Agricultural Corps Enrichment Zones located on the planet Bandomeer. The Eastern Enrichment Zone contained the Enrichment Dome and an administration building, where the Meerian RonTha was employed.

An annex was a secret storage site of the Offworld Mining Corporation hidden inside the wall of the Enrichment Dome located on the planet Bandomeer. The dome was used by the Agricultural Corps, a branch of the Jedi Service Corps, to grow plants for their agricultural research.
The Enrichment Dome was a Jedi Agricultural Corps facility located in the Eastern Enrichment Zone of the planet Bandomeer.

An administration building was located within the Eastern Enrichment Zone on the planet of Bandomeer. It was used by the Agricultural Corps, a branch of the Jedi Service Corps tasked with managing the Order's agricultural research. The Meerian RonTha worked there in 44 BBY.
This office was temporarily used by VeerTa and was located within the Home Planet Mine.

The Syngia moon was a moon located in the Syngia system of the Sertar sector, in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It lay on the hyperlane known as the Shaltin Tunnels, which connected it to the Lianna and Zygerria systems.

Computer Support, also known as Computer Central, was an area of Massassi Station adjacent to the War Room.
Vertex was a street located on Coruscant.
The True Covenant was a Jedi organization formed by Lucien Draay after the collapse of his mother Krynda Draay's Jedi Covenant in 3963 BBY.
Ord Adinorr was a snow-covered planet in the Meridian sector.
Corellian Intelligence was the primary military intelligence agency for the worlds in the Corellian system and was vital to the Confederation.

The Crest of Dawn was a space yacht that was owned by Cularin Star Tours. During the Clone Wars, Syub Kyak and his family hired it for their vacation. However, his children rewired the navigational controls, causing it to get stuck in a radiation storm on Genarius.

Twilight's Kiss was a space yacht that was owned by Cularin Star Tours. During the Clone Wars it was hired by Lord Sargo VenHalgon and he along with Lady VenHalgon, his minister Cannison, Mrs. Cannison, Professor Worrita, Mrs.
Keeara Major was a world that Sargo VenHalgon had once encountered some trouble.
The Ugnaught Mechanics Union, or Ugnaught Union for short, was a negotiating body formed by three Ugnaught tribes—the Irden, Botrut, and Isced—to negotiate with the other guilds of Cloud City.
Fivelines was a droid that inhabited the planet Ronyards, which was a major dumping ground for damaged, obsolete and inoperative droids during the era of the Galactic Civil War.
"Brother" Kranch was a droid that inhabited Ronyards.

The Third Battalion was a unit of the Calamari Defense Force. It fought in the Battle of Calamari in the Galactic Civil War.
The Mining Quarter was an area of Cloud City that had a large number of homes for Ugnaughts, with a population somewhere between approximately 500,000 to 1,000,000 Ugnaughts.

Grukk's Jungle was located on the Ugnaught Surface, surrounded by the Irden tribal warrens, the former Northeast Refineries, and Zavlabar's Gentes Grill. A portion of the Ugnorgrad Swampway ran through the jungle.
Phizbin Marsh was located on the Ugnaught Surface, partly surrounding the city of Ugnorgrad. A significant portion of the Ugnorgrad Swampway course ran through the marsh.

The Mountain nerf was a subspecies of nerf that was brought to the planet Fennesa. They were descended from nerfs which had been introduced there thousands of years ago and had adapted to the mountainous conditions there.
Docking Bay 31 was one of many docking bays and gantries aboard the Wheel.

In 0 BBY, a duel was fought on the moon Kalakar Six between the Sith Lords Darth Vader and Darth Maul. Maul was previously defeated decades prior to the duel by the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, who then took Anakin Skywalker, the boy who would become Vader, as his Padawan.
The city of Netassa was the capital of the planet Salliche and the site of an Imperial outpost during years before and during the Galactic Civil War.

Phase Zero dark troopers were a variant of stormtroopers in exoskeletons as a result of the Galactic Empire Dark Trooper Project and were the predecessors of the Dark troopers experimental combat droids.
Oricon was a moon in the Outer Rim Territories just outside the Seat of The Empire.
Rentean was a planet in the Jjannex sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Battle of Rentean occurred during the Galactic Civil War on the Outer Rim planet of Rentean. Forces of the Galactic Empire were dispatched to the planet to destroy its shipbuilding facility.
Breehara was the main continent on the planet Dressel.

The Vigilance was a light cruiser that served with the Cularin Militia during the Clone Wars. It was commanded by Captain Suubrin and in circa 19 BBY was sent on a mission to investigate an abandoned Separatist base.
The destruction of the Almas Academy was a battle that occurred during the Clone Wars when Garth Ezzar was sent to destroy the Almas Academy.

The Jendirian Valley III was a freighter leaving Nar Shaddaa in 19 BBY when it collided with the Stellar Envoy. While the Jenridian Valley III took minimal damage, the Envoy was wrecked and its co-pilot Reeze Duurmun died in the impact.
The Battle of G'rho was the invasion of the remote colony world of G'rho on the edge of Wild Space by the Ssi-ruuvi Imperium in 2 BBY; marking one of its first incursions of the known galaxy.

The Tunnel Rats were a group of cutpurses and con artists who lived in the sewers in the floating city of Tolea Biqua on Genarius. They were lead by a Sullustan called Cheese and in 19 BBY, they captured Rydna, a member of the Believers in the tunnel.

The Invasion of Tynna was the failed attempt by the Galactic Empire to take control of Tynna.
"Heroes of the Republic" was a campaign run by Biscuit Baron in order to promote certain historical figures in Galactic Republic history in the form of commemorative holocubes.

Nilash III, also called simply Nilash, was the third planet in the Nilash system, located close to the baradium-rich planet Chelloa. It was home to a tree-dwelling, telepathic native species and a known source of anthracite.
Altikar IV was a planet in the Altikar system.
The Skirmish on Altikar IV occurred when Imperials tracked the elderly Jedi Jhor-Kai to Altikar IV. There, a number of stormtroopers attacked Jhor-Kai, who engaged them with his lightsaber.
Mourning Glory was a pirate ship captained by Grov Bricker. It was captured by the Hapans during a trip through the Transitory Mists.
Simoom was a planet located in the Simoom system, within the Senex sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim, that was homeworld of the Simoomian sensory hound.

Free Enterprise was a colony ship full of Jindas and Tulgahs which left Eriadu for Kuna's Eye in 130 BBY, but crashed on Endor, thus introducing the two species to the Forest Moon, where both thrived.

This Yinchorri shuttle was used by the Yinchorri during the Galactic Civil War. It was piloted by a Yinchorri pilot, who flew the craft to the Alliance Fleet to pick up Princess Leia Organa for a meeting with the Yinchorri Council of Elders.

Tazan City was a city on the planet Tazan. A group of agents from the Alliance to Restore the Republic landed in the city before infiltrating and attacking the Imperial Data Processing Facility located to the west of the city.
Tazan was a planet in the Expansion Region.

The Emerald Splendor Estates were a set of large luxury houses located on Byss.
The Skirmish in AB-343 was a minor skirmish that occurred during the Jedi Civil War.

Ranadaast was the former capital city of the planet Duro. It was named after Queen Rana Mas Trehalt but came to be known as the City of Ashes or Royal City by offworld Duros. Once a beautiful city, it grew filthy with the industrialization on Duro.
Operation Third Law was the military codename for Princess Leia Organa's mission to secure a loan that would help replenish the Rebel fleet from the banking world of Aargau.

The natives of Yorgraxx were a sentient species on the Outer Rim Territories planet Yorgraxx. They had developed a level on civilization on their planet prior to 1000 BBY, before the Sith Quorlac Fornayh arrived on the planet.
Nadir spiders were large, carnivourous arthropods native to the comet Resh 9376; similar species could be found within other comets and asteroids.

Yorgraxx was a planet located in the Prefsbelt sector of the Outer Rim.
Kruskan was a planet located on the far fringes of the Colundra sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

x: The Battle of Omwat was fought on the planet Omwat during the Clone Wars. Footage from the battle was sent via holo-transmitter to the Separatist leader Count Dooku on Vjun.

K1-1R was a military droid with a masculine persona who operated during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. While at one point he served a master, he later became independent and forged a career as a successful bounty hunter.
A rainy planet was the site of a battle during the Clone Wars.
Jualya Village was a Caamasi village located on the planet Caamas. It was where the renowned light sculptor Ves Volette grew up.

A songfish was a type of fish that was found in the streams of the planet Caamas. It was capable of producing an audible piping noise. Around 18 BBY, the Caamasi artist, Ves Volette, experienced a memnis while on the planet Coruscant.
Scent of Fear was a starship used by Crutag and his crew. During the Galactic Civil War, the Scent of Fear chased a Rebel ship to the swamp planet Trinta, where both ships landed.
Onyx Four was an Imperial Navy TIE/sa bomber manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems that served in the Galactic Empire's Onyx Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
The Ardent was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

The orycat was a small woodland predator native to Orryxia that could be found in packs of 12-24. Imperial official Wilek Nereus obtained a dental specimen of an orycat but was unable to complete a survey of its environment due to inclement conditions.
Guild Sector Three was a location on the planet Herdessa. The area contained the slums of the planet, and many poor and hungry individuals made their homes of the rundown buildings in the area.
The Emza was a civilian C-3 passenger liner that was present at Calast, a Golan Space Colony 2 space station during the Rescue at Bundil II. The ship contained debutantes.
The Fleen was a Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-1300 light freighter. Jer Blankuna arranged for the ship to bring a group of adventurers to his mansion orbiting Alderaan in 27 BBY.
Evac 1 or Rescue 1 was a transport used by the Lok Revenants at the First Battle of Lok.
Shortly before the Blockade of Naboo, mercenaries attempted to kidnap Queen Amidala, leader of the Naboo. The mercenaries were secretly hired by the Trade Federation.

Operation Katabatic was a series of Republic strikes on critical Separatist bases during the Battle of Atraken. This push led to the defeat of the Separatist forces; however, the battle left the world a desolate wasteland.
The Friends of the Republic were a group of individuals dedicated to the preservation of the ideals of the Galactic Republic, which many believed had begun to crumble in the wake of the Clone Wars.
The Spirit of Corellia was a SoroSuub Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 in use by the Jedi from the Talus base during the Galactic Civil War.
The Dire Hound was a nickname of a Z-95 Headhunter that became a stuff of legend in the Corellian system during the Galactic Civil War.
The Ambush on Dargulli was an attack on Darth Vader which happened at the same time of the Anti-Sith conspiracy of Grand Moff Trachta on Coruscant.

Manticore was an Imperial Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle in operation during the Galactic Civil War. Along with its sister ship, Griphon, the Manticore was assigned to escort the POW-carrying Dreadnaught VTR-LX to penal station Bundil II.

Griphon was an Imperial Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle in operation during the Galactic Civil War. Along with its sister ship, Manticore, the Griphon was assigned to escort the POW-carrying Dreadnaught VTR-LX to penal station Bundil II.
The Crimson Sword was a CEC YT-2400 light freighter in operation during the Galactic Civil War. Like many such freighters, it was more than a simple transport craft.
Revelator was a Lictor-class dungeon ship that was used by the Galactic Empire.
The Clarity Gate was a trapezoidal gate that was the entrance to the Ossus Academy grounds, beyond which was a tranquil courtyard which featured a small fountain.

The Academy Administration building at the Ossus Academy was a building that was located down a path leading from the courtyard at the entrance to the academy grounds. It was established to house the administrators that oversaw the work of the non-Jedi employed at the academy.
LEP-96M3 was the personal LEP servant droid of General Whorm Loathsom during the Clone Wars. It had a high voice and spoke in an odd language, consisting of changing high and lower pitch.
The Squeeze Zone was an area on the planet Bespin that was characterized by seething darkness.
Skann was a terrestrial planet located in the Skann system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Astal sector. It was inhabited by farmers who grew crops such as Dust-Corn and Dry Gene Wheat.
The Bespin Dancer was a starship that shared part of its name with the planet Bespin, and served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.
The Dauntless was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that was built in a shipyard on Allanteen Six during the Clone Wars.
The Pioneer was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that was built in a shipyard on Allanteen Six during the Clone Wars.

The Wild Menagerie was a Corellian Engineering Corporation YT-1930 light freighter that was owned by the bounty hunter Zan Ransom. Ransom heavily modified the freighter, improving its hyperdrive, life-support, weaponry, and security systems.

Penumbra was a modified shieldship that was owned by the Sullustan crimelord, Neen Niuv. He used it to escort guests and captured guests to his secret base inside a deserted mining facility in Hutt Space.

The Gen'Dai were a species of large, sentient beings. Their bodies were made up of a mass of regenerative tentacles, which allowed them to regenerate wounds quickly and, notoriously, be almost impossible to kill.

O.S.S. Telira was a CR90 corvette owned and captained by Osman Shrier, who operated it as a passenger liner. It traveled along a ten-day route that included Elshandruu Pica, the capital of Parmel sector and the Quence sector in general. Although the O.S.S.
Calgon was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Calgon system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Meridian sector.

x: The Battle of Cattamscar was a skirmish which saw the conquest of the Outer Rim world of Cattamascar by a Ssi-ruuvi expeditionary fleet at some point between 1 BBY and 4 ABY.

Tashtor Seneca was a location in the Tashtor Seneca system, a part of the Mid Rim's Tashtor sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the forces of the Galactic Empire destroyed the Croc of Gold, the freighter of the Rebel Alliance operative Devon Fuller, over Tashtor Seneca.

The Croc of Gold was a small freighter purchased by the smuggler Devon Fuller. Despite his shady past, Fuller used the Croc of Gold to deal in legal goods, although he was not very successful until he met Owen Sareth, an operative for the Alliance to Restore the Republic who p…
The Freebooter was the second starship owned by smuggler Devon Fuller during his allegiance to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The Solar Flair was a heavily modified Ghtroc Industries 720 light freighter belonging to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The lecture hall in the Jedi Academy on Ossus was used to instruct the students at the academy, and was located behind a hedge of bambwood at the end of the Crooked Way.
This Imperial Star Destroyer was an early Superlaser Star Destroyer, fitted with a prototype superlaser.
Oquan was a bounty hunter group that was based on the planet Naalol during the Galactic Civil War. Its leader was Rel Acoi.
G0-T0-Telerath was a G0-T0 Infrastructure-Planning droid developed by Aratech Repulsor Company assigned to serve as a central organizational hub for the planet Telerath.

A structure within the enclosure was the dwelling of Maris Brood, a Zabrak former Padawan who fell to the Dark side of the Force and took up residence there following the death of her former Jedi master, Shaak Ti.

Lanos was a member world of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Around 22 BBY, it was attacked by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and became the subject of propaganda on the Republic's HoloNet News, which claimed that the Separatists were liberating it from a "…
The Renadala Estate was a wealthy Mos Espa estate on the planet Tatooine. By 8 ABY, the estate had foreclosed.

The Coloi, also known as the Coloi Rancor, was a type of mutant Rancor created by the Sith Lord Quorlac Fornayh. Over a thousand years before the Galactic Civil War, Fornayh planned to use the creature to overthrow the Sith Empire of his time.

The Aaroun were a sentient species of carnivores. The powerful beings were covered in golden fur. The species were bred as slaves and gladiators by the Viis Empire, a significant polity in the Unknown Regions until it was decimated by the shape shifting, malevolent entity know…
The Takara was a starship used by the Jedi Order in 700 BBY.

Tharados was a small, cold planet that was located within the Tharados system of the Mid Rim. The Zabrak Haast Aath ran a slave compound there for Riboga the Hutt. Twelve clone troopers were also sent there during the Clone Wars, due to an administrative error.

Kemix was a barren planet of the Kemix system in the Outer Rim Territories. It had some minor glitterstim deposits located on it and Riboga the Hutt established a spice mine there to mine these. However, the mines were destroyed during the Clone Wars, by the Heroes of Cularin.

The Wolf Clan was a Jedi clan, one of several that Padawans were placed in when they commenced their training on how to be a successful member of the Jedi Order. The clan's members included an orphan named Ezak and his peers Kiri, Lartan, Lina Lascol, and Mox Freedan.
The Battle of Kabal was a conflict that took place during the Clone Wars. The Republic walkers stormed the planet.

The Blockade of the Cularin system was a blockade by the Thaereian military which prevented medical supplies and foodstuffs from reaching the Cularin system. Veneziano Haas was recruited by Nirama to have mercenaries outrun the blockade and deliver supplies.
The Undertow was a seedy bar owned by a Whiphid on Nar Shaddaa. During the time of the Galactic Empire, criminals and thugs went to the Undertow to avoid Imperial attention.
Metellos 3 was an airless moon orbiting Metellos.
L-2832 was a C-9979 military landing craft that served in the Navy of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Kinkosa City was a city in the state of Kinkosa on the planet Kirtania. The Kubaz crime lord Schnil Hakoon had his center of power in this city.

The Ebon Coursers were a group of seven bounty hunters who worked for Schnil Hakoon as his own personal mercenary unit on the planet Kirtania during the Galactic Civil War. They were charged with recovering the Amber Eye from the thief Pierce Mantrell.

Zigoola was a planet and a potent dark side vergence in The Force located in Wild Space, near the Calamari sector. A Sith Temple was located on the barren world, and was used by the Order of the Sith Lords for hoarding Sith artifacts.

The Rodian Salvager's Cartel was a criminal group of Rodian scavengers on Raxus Prime led by Drexl Roosh during the Imperial Era, who had set up an impressive salvage operation on the junk-covered planet by using his minions to produce scrap and other goods that could be sold …
Dreizan was the homeworld of Imperial commander Rezi Soresh.
The Institute of Government Service was located on New Apsolon in the Civilized sector. It contained Roan's office and the Secret meeting room where Balog kidnapped Tahl.
The Pantolomin halfback was a creature native to Pantolomin and used in the gambling game Halfback's Bluff.
The Justice was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser used by the New Republic.
The Remember Alderaan was a Mon Calamari Star Cruiser used by the New Republic.
The Council of Seers was a Jedi Council of the Jedi Order in operation prior to the rule of Galactic Emperor and Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt and his Galactic Empire.

The Felucian ripper, or Flying ripper was a dangerous creature native to the jungle world of Felucia. The ripper was a large predator that hunted in the jungle canopy, although it dwelt in shallow rivers and creeks.
The Relentless was a Sith Imperial ship used as a transport by Darth Krayt.

This Jedi clan was one of the many clans that prospective young Jedi were placed in when they first began to learn the ways of the Jedi Order. Its members were just beginning their training; with the ages averaging around three standard years old.

Meditation Garden Orenth was a meditation garden located within the Hidden Temple on Taivas. Attached to the side of one of the massive ships that made up the Temple's structure, the garden was suspended on a large platform extending out into the great open air of the canyon i…
Hot Prospect was a Calipsan 560 mining ship, which was used by Zayne Carrick and his crew after the Vindication.
FeeJee-13 was a FEG-series pilot droid owned by the pirate Rav that operated the helm of his starship. He acted as backup whenever they landed on a planet. FeeJee was present at the Duel on Roon.

The skirmish on Roon occurred when Rav and Zareb Syn traveled to the planet to "trade" for some flame gems and roonstones. Unbeknownst to the pirates was that Zareb's son Jariah Syn had stowed away on the ship.
The Corellian Queen, owned by the Nebula Line corporation was supposedly the greatest luxury liner in the galaxy.
R4-G7 was an astromech droid assigned to Derek Klivian's X-wing in 5.5 ABY, around the time of the Battle of Mindor. Klivian called him "Arfour."

Kindlabethia was a planet in the Braxant sector of the Outer Rim.

The Battle of Dorumaa was a battle that was fought during the Clone Wars on Dorumaa.

x: The Battle of Cularin was a battle fought during the Clone Wars that drove the Thaereian military out of the Cularin system.
Taspan II was a planet in the Taspan system, in the Inner Rim. The Galactic Empire had a weapons facility on the planet, where gravity well projectors were tested by Imperial scientists.
The supply shed was a hut used to store supplies in Bright Tree Village.
Halkra, also known as "strangle vines," was an arboreal predator from the planet Bothawui.
The Hall of Judgment was a chamber within the Great Temple on Yavin 4. Constructed by the Alliance to Restore the Republic, it was a part of the Massassi Base complex.
R3-G0, also known as Argo, was Bant Eerin's Padawan's R3-series astromech droid during the Clone Wars.
The Battle of Akoshissss took place during the Clone Wars on the Trandoshan moon of Akoshissss. The main point of the battle was to destroy Bitt Panith's secret base that was located on the moon.

Akoshissss was the barren moon of Trandosha. It played a minor part in the Clone Wars by playing host to Bitt Panith's secret base, where Krossen was created. The lab was later destroyed during the Battle of Akoshissss.

The Muurshantre Extinction was an event that saw the destruction of the document known as the Taurannik Codex, which the death cult Knell of Muspilli from the Unknown Regions location Gunninga Gap transcribed in order to summon apocalyptic deities.

The Kanzer Exiles were an ancient and fanatical flock of reptilians led by the Lord Ravager Korman Lao. These exiles spread their faith through mental enslavement and constructed a world-sized temple near the Valtaullu Rift.

language: Communicated via thoughts that relied on computer translation
x: Cephalons were a long-lived sentient alien species that had ganglionic intelligence, with multiple sub-brains that sent information to a central brain.

The Sorcerers of Rhand were a group of beings who believed in a power greater than the Force which they called the Dark. The Sorcerers of Rhand ruled a collection of stellar clusters known as the Nihil Retreat, which was associated with the Perann Nebula in the Unknown Regions.

Ferton was an astronomical object located in the Ferton system of the Al'Nasrl sector, a part of the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. At some point by the time of the Galactic Civil War, Harbon, a sergeant with a mercenary company, visited Ferton.

The raid on the Dlarit estate, during the Bacta War, was an infiltration operation launched by the Ashern commandos and their allies against the Thyferran Home Defense Corps in 7 ABY on the planet Thyferra.
Solenoid was a droid who served the Techno Union, a leading technology concern that was allied with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
The Cool Shot was a YT-1300 light freighter.

Relentless was a cruiser that was part of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.
Aurora was a CR90 corvette that was used by the Cularin Militia during the Clone Wars. It participated in the Battle of Cularin.

The Funeral of Anakin Solo took place on the planet Hapes, once the survivors of the Myrkr strike team returned the body of their fallen leader, Anakin Solo, to his parents Han and Leia Organa Solo. The ceremony took place at night, in a secluded clearing in a mountain forest.

Cularin 1 was a capital ship that was used during the Clone Wars. It was originally called the Nimbus and used by the Thaereian military, but it was captured by the Cularin Militia and they renamed it and put it into service with their fleet.
R3-G6 was an R3 astromech droid. During the Clone Wars, R3-G6 assisted Ahsoka Tano on her mission to Ryloth. It later died on this mission.
Vindalia was a planet located within the Vindalia system of the Colonies and the homeworld of the Vindalian species.

Flavin Hold was a location on the planet Vindalia. The Vindalian Baron Vlaçan Umber was from Flavin Hold. The baron mentioned Flavin Hold when introducing himself to Jedi Knight Jax Pavan around 18 BBY.

The Indefatigable was a CR90 corvette that was used by the Thaereian military during the Clone Wars. It was the flagship of the Thaereian fleet during the Blockade of the Cularin system and Colonel Jir Tramsig, the fleet commander was stationed aboard it.
The Shaull were a sentient species that hailed from an unidentified planet. They possessed light-colored skin with patches of darker color on the wrist, forearm, and elbows.

The Halls of Healing were an expansive wing of the Coruscant Jedi Temple. Located within the southwest quarter of the complex, the Halls were the center of healing and renewal of life for wounded members of the Jedi Order.

The Bilbringi asteroid fields that surrounded the Bilbringi Shipyards made the shipyards there almost unassailable. The only way to mount an attack was to jump to hyperspace and then revert to realspace inside the perimeter.
A small planetoid was located in the Ando system. It had a pale blue-colored breathable atmosphere and the only forms of life that lived there were some plants and fungi.

Presteen was a trade world located in the Presteen system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex-Juvex Loop hyperlane linked it to the Caltinia and Veron systems.
A Perthrillian nightwasp was a winged insect from the Perthrillia system. Nick Rostu claimed he could clip the wings of this insect with a gun at a thousand meters and not wake it up.
The Infernal was a Keldabe-class cruiser.
Nurse was a droid who served Jabba the Hutt and was programmed to care for Rotta in 22 BBY.
The Brownstar was a luxury freighter owned by Malta the Hutt.
D-P4M was a protocol droid owned by T'Chttrk.

The liberation of Ralltiir occurred in 4 ABY, several days before the Battle of Brentaal IV. A resistance group, including Bettle and Jerell managed to knock out the planetary shields, allowing a fleet of six Mon Calamari Star Cruisers to attack the planet.
R2-W3 an R2-series astromech droid owned by the company Renna's Transport Service during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

In 3 ABY, the Galactic Empire bombed the city of K'avor on Shiva IV. In the aftermath of the Destruction of K'avor, Aron Peacebringer and Leia Organa witnessed the burning city before turning back as Organa recognized the Cherenkov effect there.

5537 was the designation given to an E-2T medical shuttle stationed on the Death Star. It was marked as a non-combat vessel, which ensured that neither the Rebel Alliance or Galactic Empire would attack it.

The Sky Battle of Quell took place in the first year of the Clone Wars in the skies over the contested world of Quell when Jedi General Aayla Secura and her Republic fleet were ambushed by a Confederate Navy flotilla.

The Thunder Wraith was a Hapan Express-class ambassadorial shuttle which contained spacious, elegant, and well-equipped passenger quarters with several massive viewscreens.
A2-B4 was an accounting and business droid owned by Lord Anstaal. A2-B4 later came under the possession of Sybegh Abya.

The Scientific and Medical laboratory on Ossus was a smaller infirmary than its larger counterpart in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Located in the Ossus Academy, the laboratory, like its equivalent, were open at all hours and were accessible to all Jedi in need of healing.

The Solay Royal Guard were the armed forces on the planet Solay, who supported the despotic Solay Royal Court led by King Blackart. The guards were heavily armored including a distinct helmet that covered the majority of the head.

The monar serpent was a type of serpent that shed its scales. The serpent's scale shedding was similar to the Separatist flagship Invisible Hand losing pieces of its hull as it descended through the planet Coruscant's atmosphere during the Battle of Coruscant in 19 BBY.

Tiems was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Belderone sector. It was the site of the city of Tiems, which hosted a Galactic Empire outpost during the Galactic Civil War, with an Imperial base being situated in its vicinity.
This shuttle was a craft used by the Rebel Alliance for diplomatic missions.
Tandun III, also known as Tandun Three, was a youthful planet that occupied a young star system in the Outer Rim Territories.

The Rebel Base was an installation on the planet Barkhesh during the Galactic Civil War operated by the Barkhesh Resistance. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, the Barkhesh Resistance offered supplies to the Rebel Alliance.
Thaere Runner was a CR90 corvette that served in the Thaereian military during the Clone Wars.
This starship, used by a group of Lurmen refugees, was referred to as an "ol' boat."
