Rampant was a Victory-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. It was damaged during a campaign against the Rebel Alliance in the Boeus sector, around 2 ABY.
Wachtor was a Victory-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The Chancellor was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in the fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The Holocron Chamber was a sealed room located in the Tower of First Knowledge, one of the five spires of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
R5-B8 was an R5 unit who was present on Sel Zonn Station during the early years of the Galactic Empire.

The Lucan's Nightmare was a modified starship owned by the New Republic agent, Trask Lucan.
The Sandhawk was an avian creature native to Tatooine. It was often hunted for its savory meat.

Cliff hawks were avian predators native to Prakith. Their plumage was speckled with browns and grays, allowing them to naturally blend into the mountainous regions in which they hunted. Common prey included small mammals, reptiles, and their fellow brethren.

The Atrivis Day 1 was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic to ferry supplies. It was part of the freighter group Atrivis Day.

The Battle of Organarms was a conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The Imperial Missile Boat Mu 1 destroyed the X7 Factory Organarms.

R2-P3 was an R2-series astromech droid working in an Ugnaught-run cantina, called the Vapor Room, in Cloud City on Bespin. It was equipped with a serving tray, for serving drinks to customers along with the astromech droid R2-Q5.
Maldinian City was the capital city of the Expansion Region planet Kerkoidia, homeworld of the Kerkoiden species.
T-37 was a GR-75 medium transport used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Dalicron-4, also referred to as simply Dalicron, was a remote, little-noticed planet far in the Outer Rim Territories.
TC-663, or Six Six, as he preferred to be called, was a protocol droid who worked as a translator for Darga Jiramma Mionne.

Dark Lizards, Dark Devils or Dark Tongues were large, reptilian creatures found on the planet Almas. They were a non-sentient species derived from hssiss stock, but the dark side of the Force so permeated the beasts that their scales were black, their eyes glowed red-orange, a…

The Death Rattle was the personal starship of Tor Vizsla, leader of the Mandalorian Death Watch. It was destroyed in orbit over Corellia when Jango Fett slammed a ship in the engines, therefore decapitating the Death Rattle, where it plunged to its "death" on the planet below.
Kaleela was the capital city of the Outer Rim Territories planet Kalee, homeworld of the Kaleesh species.
Arjun was a Strike-class medium cruiser used by the Galactic Empire. It was present at the Battle of Organarms.
Chanosant was a world in the Expansion Region's Chanosant system. During the Clone Wars, it was the site of a Separatist convention which was attended by Count Dooku and held during the Clone Wars.

Intrepid was an Imperial craft that served the Fel Empire. At some point prior to the Sith–Imperial War, the craft departed on a mission to the Unknown Regions. The Sluissi technician, Chief Bor Alsek and Imperial Knight Treis Sinde served aboard the Intrepid on this mission.
Alpha Squadron was an Imperial seatrooper unit that fought in the Genocide on Dac. Loyal to Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, they were all killed by Imperial Knight Treis Sinde.

The Sea Lion was an Acklay Battle Fortress that fought in the Genocide of Mon Calamari. It was commanded by Commander Sturves, who used the craft to track down Mon Calamari refugees and exterminate them.
Shark Squadron was an Imperial Army unit made up of Shark subfighters. Loyal to Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, they participated in the Genocide on Dac.

x: The Massacre on Soheras Trench was part of the Genocide of Mon Calamari ordered by Darth Krayt to punish the Mon Calamari people for their aid to the Galactic Alliance Remnant.

objective: Arrest Xanatos
x: The Second Mission to Telos was a mission undertaken by Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi to confront Xanatos.
The Mercenary enclave was where Khoonda, the government of Dantooine, allowed the mercenaries on the planet to operate from after the bombardment of Dantooine.
The Salvager camp was the headquarters of a loose association of salvagers came to Dantooine in order to explore the what was left of the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine after Darth Malak bombed it.

result: O-Lana taken to the Jedi Temple
Adi Gallia gains reputation as one of the Jedi Order's top pilots
objective: Test O-Lana for Force-sensitivity

x: The Starworm was a Trade Federation Lucrehulk-class battleship.
The Battle of Rodia was a battle fought sometime during the Jedi Civil War.

The Cloud City Miner's Guild, also known as the Cloud City Mining Guild, was an organization that controlled aspects of the tibanna gas mining operations in Cloud City on the gas giant planet of Bespin.
A menagerie was maintained within the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant where Yoda, Grand Master of the Jedi Order, kept his kybuck, which had been given to him by the Wookiees of Kashyyyk.
A battle on the planet Farquar III was an engagement between Republic and Separatist forces.
Division Cloud Force was a unit formed by the Cularin Militia during the Clone Wars, to operate in zero-gravity conditions and on the planet Genarius.

t: Duel at Rainbow Parkway and Gallery Row
x: This duel was a short encounter that took place at the corner of Rainbow Parkway and Gallery Row in 18 BBY.

result: Kajin Savaros discovered by Jax Pavan and Laranth Tarak
x: This duel was a battle of Force powers that took place between Force-sensitive Kajin Savaros and Inquisitor Probus Tesla in a malfunctioning repulsor field near Ploughtekal Market.

The Ralltiir Corps was a military unit in service of the Galactic Republic's army around the time of the Mandalorian Wars. It contained the brigade-sized Telerath 2nd and Serroco Colonial, as well as the smaller Graayson's Company which reported directly to Corps Command.
Training Sergeant Kal Skirata once spent some time there with the Mandalorians fifty years before the first battle of Geonosis.
Curbaq Plaza was a plaza in Galactic City on the planet Coruscant.
Laranth, also known as Corsair, was a Helix-class light interceptor that was used by the Jedi Knight Jax Pavan during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
The Behebothans were the inhabitants of the planet Beheboth.

Black Sun Squadron was a starfighter military group serving Black Sun that fielded Z-95 Headhunters, the predecessor to the X-wing. The fighter craft of the unit were painted white and marked with Black Sun's logo on the wing panels.

Elite Black Sun was an exclusive starfighter military group serving Black Sun that fielded Z-95 Headhunters, predecessors to the X-wing. The fighter craft of the unit were painted white and marked with Black Sun's logo on the wing panels.
The Battle of the Phindar Spaceport was a battle that took place during the Clone Wars when Dark Acolyte Asajj Ventress attacked the Phindar Spaceport to try and kill Grand Master Yoda.

The Trade Federation resistance were a breakaway group of dissatisfied employees of the Trade Federation led by Customs Vizier Marath Vooro that refused to acknowledge the conglomerate new arrangement with the newly-formed Galactic Empire that gave it control over the company …

Unit 2953 was a B1-series battle droid who served in the Separatist Droid Army. A droid with an exceptionally complaining personality, he was disliked by his fellow battle droids, and was sent to execute military duties while the other droids used their time by playing cards.
Zarracina III was a planet located in the Expansion Region's Zarracina sector. It was the homeworld of the Zarracine species.

Tandis Four was a planet in the Galactic Republic. It was the location of the Museum of Light, which on Count Dooku's orders was destroyed by the Separatists during the Clone Wars, prior to the conclusion of the struggle for control of Drongar.

A sentient species, the Zarracines hailed from the planet Zarracina III. In 11,660 BBY, the Pius Dea–controlled Galactic Republic attempted to gain control of the planet, with the Zarracines resisting the efforts.

The Lesser Houdoggin was a species from Klatooine, a desert planet in the region of the galaxy known as the Outer Rim Territories. The creature had self-sealing earflaps that could block out sound in a similar manner to how many humanoid species closed their eyes.
Hillindor game fowl, also known as Hillindor fowl, was a type of edible bird from the Hillindor system. It could be used to make Hillindor fowl soup.
Artorias was a peace-loving Outer Rim planet with few defenses. In 25 ABY, during the onset of the Yuuzhan Vong War, the world was invaded and conquered by the eponymous extragalactic race.
Farquar III was a planet in the Mid Rim's Kurost sector.

1138 was the designation of a B1-series battle droid in the service of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the height of the Clone Wars. It was known to continually malfunction at which point it began repeating, "Roger, roger," over and over again.
A2 was the designation for one of two Arakyd probots deployed to protect and defend Warlord Zsinj's fortress on Xartun.
A3 was the designation for one of two Arakyd probots deployed to protect and defend Warlord Zsinj's fortress on Xartun.
The Ministry of Energy was a ministry within the Galactic Empire. One of its divisions was the Imperial Energy Systems subministry.

place: The galaxy, particularly the Mid Rim and Core
x: The rawmat shortage of 1–2 ABY was a galaxy-wide scarcity of raw materials (or "rawmats") vital in capital ship construction, which was particularly acute in the Core Worlds and Mid Rim.
During the Clone Wars, Hangar 8122 was located on the Gran-affiliated testing facility orbiting Bormus—a blue, luminescent planet in the Bormus system of the Mid Rim's Dustig sector.

conflict: Hunt for Zsinj, Galactic Civil War
result: Wraith Squadron infects the crew of Hawkbat with Bunkurd Sewer Disorde
objective: Protect the identities of Wraith Squadron for the Night Caller rendezv
x: The Mission to Storinal was a Wraith Squadron covert operation with a goal of protecting their assumed collective identity as the crew of the Night Caller.

Abaarian was a planet in the Abaarian system in the Mid Rim. The world joined the Galactic Alliance in the wake of the Yuuzhan Vong War, shipping bottled water to needy planets. Several of these water shipments were hijacked during the Dark Nest Crisis.
Ac'siel was a city on the planet Csilla in the Chiss Ascendancy. It was one of the largest cities found under the ice on Csilla.
ADO-8 was a B1-series battle droid serving the Trade Federation as a commander in the Invasion of Naboo.
A Welatak was a species of aquatic creature that lived on Dorumaa. The research student Solwyn Tamm once observed some of them near Trammel's island.
The Aic was an intelligence and assassination network that worked with the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Qarohan Steppes were a region on the tropical planet of Drongar located in the Jasserak Highlands around eighty kilometers southeast of the previous location of the Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7 near the Kondrus Sea in the Jasserak Lowlands.

t: Battle of the Gem of Alderaan
x: The Battle of the Gem of Alderaan was a battle that occurred on Alderaan, some time after the end of the Clone Wars.
Smelting Core D was the smelting area where Anakin Skywalker's lightsaber was deposited after being lost by Luke Skywalker on Cloud City, at the gas giant Bespin.
Bayonard was a large platform city on Cularin that stood hundreds of meters above the jungle there.
The Pantoran Guard was a group of Pantoran soldiers that were assigned to protect the Pantoran Assembly.

A Black Sun stronghold was established by the criminal organization Black Sun on the remote Forest Moon of Endor as of 1 ABY. It was a small base in a remote mountain region of the moon. Most of the base was built underground, with only a small building visible from above.
The fin-headed species was a sentient species in the galaxy.

t: Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Aayla Secura's ambush)
x: This T-series tactical droid served in the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, he led his droid forces to capture a Galactic Republic information bunker, hoping to gain valuable information about the Grand Army of the Republic.
The Seeker was a YT-1300 light freighter that was owned by the Jedi of the Almas Academy during the Clone Wars.
The Rancor Riders was a gang that was based in Tolea Biqua, on Genarius, during the time of the Clone Wars.
The Argo Moon was a merchant starship in the Baobab Merchant Fleet, commanded by Captain Cag during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
The Grandmaster Council was the ruling political body of the Gree Enclave. Based on the planet Gree, all planetary councils answered to this body.
The All Planets Market was an open-air market held in a large plaza located in the shadow of the Senate Building on Coruscant.
The spider crab was a species of crustacean found on many worlds. They superficially resembled Jodakan needler crabs.
The Explorer was a modified Multi-environment Space Boat refitted by the Alliance to Restore the Republic for a mission to Sedri.
The archivist droid administered the Baobab Archives during the early years of the Galactic Empire. It communicated in a form of Droidspeak.
The new Umboo Lightstation was a starship operated by Governor Koong of Roon's Tawntoom province.
Antamont was a nonindustrial, mountainous planet in the Antamont system of the Meridian sector.

Melters was the name given to the energy based beings that lived in the meltmassif of the Taspan system. They were given this name because they "melted" out of the meltmassif at will, they used the meltmassif for their physical form.

Okyaab 6 was a supposed Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Ojoster sector. According to a 3963 BBY Galactic Republic propaganda broadcast by the "Captain Goodvalor" persona, Okyaab 6 had been conquered by the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders but, after less than a week of Ma…
Zongorlu was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Noonian sector. It was home to the sentient, plant-like Zongorlu species.
The Zongorlu were a sentient species from the Outer Rim Territories planet Zongorlu. They were large, slow-moving plants.
Holess was a planet in the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances and the Holessian homeworld. It had more laws than any other world. Its capital city was the location of the Mount of Justice.

The Holessians were portly humanoids native to Holess, believed to be related to the Lannik. They were obsessed with law and regarded legal cases like a sport, although betting on outcomes was considered sacrilege.
Glassferrans were a sentient species. They had three expressionless eyes, each of which could focus on a different object. Kartill was a Glassferran.

The T'kkrpk were a species of sentient, long-lived insectoids. They did not begin to calculate time according to the Galactic Standard Calendar until their homeworld's Great Reconciliation circa 95 BBY; as a result, many of them did not know how old they were.
An arachnoid species was brought into the New Republic in 5 ABY through the negotiations of Leia Organa, just prior to the Battle of Mindor. The arachnoids were native to a minor star cluster.
Oluna Biqua was a floating city on the gas planet Genarius. It was well known as a place to go for luxury holidays.

The Marauder's Stronghold was a fortified camp on the Forest moon of Endor. It was used as the headquarters and stronghold of the Sanyassan Marauders during the Galactic Civil War. The camp was mostly made of salvaged parts of crashed starships.
This defective R2 unit was an astromech droid in service with the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
The Purge was an Imperial prison barge used during the Galactic Civil War.

The homeworld of Rahm Kota, this planet was a war-torn place. The population of the planet were engaged in trench warfare for years, and Kota saw combat from the age of ten. Eventually, the Jedi Mace Windu arrived on the planet to negotiate a peaceful end to the fighting.

The Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade was an illegal starship race that was part of the Star Rally and was held in the Rayter sector during the Galactic Civil War. Racers began on the planet Dahvil and then traveled to Ord Dorlass, Tintel and Azna, before finishing on Fodro.
Headliner was a YT-1220, that was owned by the Tourism Council of Oluna Biqua during the Clone Wars. It was used as an in-system shuttle in the Cularin system and was piloted by Dellko, a Rodian.
Axe was a modified GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat. It was owned by the Human starship racer Siro Simito.
The Oluna Biqua Elite Guard was a security force that was based in the city of Oluna Biqua, on Genarius, during the Clone Wars.

The city was home to both the planet's grand council, and the Grandmaster council. Visitors to the city reported that the oddities of Gree technology were extremely visible; devices that were more advanced than standard Imperial technology were present, but they were used alon…

The Raid on Supply Depot Thrago was a ploy by Jacen Solo to start a war between The Colony and the Chiss. The six Jedi launched a preemptive strike to push the Chiss to war to stop Jacen's vision from coming to pass.
The Zeolosians were a sentient species from the Zeolosia system in the Mid Rim.

K-OB7, also called Kayo, was a droid who entered into the service of the Bimm Sith adept Toki Tollivar shortly after the end of the Great Sith War. Kayo "helped" Tollivar by hiding the dead bodies of his strangle victims.

Hammer was an Imperial Strike-class medium cruiser created by Loronar Corporation. It was assigned to a small fleet under the command of Captain Vocis Kenit during his search for the vessel Far Orbit, which had committed mutiny against him.
The Hand Pot was a casino on Vorzyd V. As with other casinos in the Westrex District of Efavan, it was located on the Casino Line; although, it was comparatively smaller in size.

The Chancellor Fillorean was a luxury yacht that was commissioned out of Coruscant, and flown as a cruise ship through the Core Worlds. Featuring multiple decks, a silver, swept hull design, it catered to the galaxy's significantly wealthy.

objective: Rescue Princess Leia Organa from Black Sun
x: The Destruction of Xizor's Palace entailed a mission by Luke Skywalker to rescue the imprisoned Princess Leia Organa from the clutches of Dark Prince Xizor and the Black Sun crime syndicate on the planet Coruscant in 3.5 ABY.

t: Battle in the Imperial Security Bureau
x: This battle was a rescue mission that dissolved into an utterly chaotic encounter.
Fostin Nine was a moon located in the Outer Rim.

The Hanna Wild Game Reserve, also known as the Hanna Wild Game Preserve, or as Gladean Park, was located just outside Hanna City, the capital city of Chandrila. It was funded by taxes earmarked for the Gladean State Parks.

The Farns was a swoop gang on Tatooine. Geordi Hans, Jeff Pill, Franklin Scott, and AB-6 were members of the gang. To call them a swoop gang was a bit of a misnomer, since during the Galactic Civil War only Franklin Scott owned a vehicle, and it was a speeder bike, not a swoop.

place: Space, on board the Chancellor Fillorean
result: Sith victory; Tollivar killed by Rohlan Dyre
x: The duel on the Chancellor Fillorean took place in 3963 BBY, between Jedi Knight Zayne Carrick and the Sith warrior Toki Tollivar. It took place on board the luxury yacht Chancellor Fillorean.
The Unification Summit of 43 ABY was a series of negotiations held on Coruscant in an attempt to reincorporate the Imperial Remnant and the Confederation back into the Galactic Alliance.
Lexus Primal was freighter owned by cargo hauler smuggler Raquid Krev during the early years of the New Republic.

place: Charis, Kathol sector, Outer Rim Territories
objective: Quell uprising of native population
x: The subjugation of Charis occurred in 4 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War. The planet Charis, located in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories, was under Imperial rule during the conflict between the Empire and the Rebel Alliance.
Argul was a planet located in the Mid Rim along the Corellian Trade Spine, near to Cerea and Belsavis.

Queel was a swamp-covered Mid Rim planet. The planet was one of the many worlds to see action in the early months of the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY it was the site of a battle between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
KL-6TLF7V/T, also called KL-6T-LF7V/T, Sixtee-El, or 6T-L for short, was a Cybot Galactica F7V Valet/Translator Droid.

The Reclaimer was a customized salvage ship of Belinda Vog. It carried two crew, four passengers, 75 metric tons of cargo, and 1 month's consumables. It had a class 1 hyperdrive and a class 15 backup. It could fly 750 kmh in atmosphere and had a nav computer.

The Best Cargo was a modified light freighter assigned to the some Rebels for a mission to the Graveyard. It was 35 meters long. It could be operated by a single person in a pinch but typically had five crew including one gunner.

Eaters were dinosaur-like predators native to Masterhome, similar to tyrannosaurs. They stood three meters tall at the shoulder, with thick, muscular torsos, thick skin, long legs, and immense teeth. Eaters were warm blooded and covered in fur. Their favorite prey were griffs.
Griffs were deer-like creatures native to Masterhome. The smell of griff-meat drove eaters into a feeding frenzy.

Likkas were long-legged crocodilians native to Masterhome. They were greenish-brown and had brilliant yellow eyes. They stood 1.5 meters tall at the shoulder and grew 3 meters long. They were ill-tempered and had powerful bites.
Luxurious-class space yachts were 31-meter long starships manufactured by Ghtroc Industries.
Keons were curious, rodent-like marsupials, that had an ability to mimic sounds. This ability allowed the creature to repeat words uttered in the vicinity, though at a higher pitch.

conflict: Aftermath of the New Sith Wars
result: Hijacking of the Star-Wake, death of the crew.
x: The Massacre on the Star-Wake was a skirmish between Darth Zannah and the crew of the Star-Wake. Zannah had to find passage to Onderon to meet her master, Darth Bane. After the Star-Wake took off, Zannah was pulling a blaster out of a trunk when she was confronted by Tallo.
The Tourism Council of Oluna Biqua was an organization that controlled tourism in the city of Oluna Biqua during the time of the Clone Wars.
A thin creature was used as a pet during the time of the New Republic. It was a four-legged creature with a thin waist, protruding ribs, dainty feet with only one toe, and a long nose.
The Silbilaari were a sentient species that evolved on a planet near to Senex-Juvex.

Devilsquid were a species of cephalopod that dwelt within the deepest regions of the oceans of the planet Dac, such as Devil's Crevasse. They were far larger than an adult Human and known for being aggressive predators.
ZXK-100346.6a was a planet located in the ZXK-100346 system, in the Outer Rim. It was the sixth planet in the star system and had a very cold climate that resulted in it being covered in ice.

Squinquargesimus was a village on the planet of Quelii. It was the birthplace of the Old Republic Jedi Knight Alek, who fought in the Mandalorian Wars, and later became a Dark Lord of the Sith by the name of Darth Malak—one of the instigators of the Jedi Civil War.

The Althiri were the inhabitants of the Outer Rim planet Althir III. During the Mandalorian Wars, their homeworld was assaulted by the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders. Despite holding off the invaders for five days, the Althiri were eventually defeated.

Dractuvian caveworms were six-legged tubular creatures with sharp teeth. They lived in the caves of the planet Dractu. One of them attached itself to Dexter Jettster, who could not remove it without the assistance of a native Dractuvian.
A tramp freighter was captained by a male human merchant in the Minos Cluster. His crew included a human female and a Wookiee.

The Explorer Mk. V was a model of exploration droid created by Smitroo Industries. 1.8 meters tall, loyal, and very resilient, only 500 of the droids were produced. Smitroo sent the droids out with its scouts to find worlds the company could exploit.
The Borgle Bat Cave was a deep cavern system in the swamp lands of the Nabooian moon Rori. It was home to a high number of dangerous borgle bats.
This unidentified volcanic planet was where Astaroth located Soul Edge.

conflict: Second Imperial Civil War, Genocide on Dac
result: More safety given to Mon Calamari population
x: The Battle of Devil's Crevasse was a battle of the Second Imperial Civil War that took place in 137 ABY in Devil's Crevasse on Dac.
Fortune's Favor was a Wayfarer-class medium freighter that was owned by the Oblee crime lord Nirama during the time of the Clone Wars.

The Thaere Interceptor was a DP20 gunship that saw service with the Navy of Thaere during the Clone Wars. Lieutenant Toric Bisilt was assigned to serve on it for a time and it participated in the Blockade of the Cularin system.
Aggressive Negotiation was a Barloz-class freighter that was used by Legal Arms Ltd. during the Clone Wars.
The Tessellated Arboreal binjinphant was a very rare and furry tree-dwelling creatures.
La'drach was the Drach'nam homeworld, where the species lived in dark cave-cities.
Ghost Squadron was a Galactic Republic V-19 Torrent starfighter squadron that participated in the Battle of Nexus Ortai.
C1-EZ8, also known as Eazy, was an espionage droid and assassin of the Empire.
Pieralos was a city located on the Mid Rim planet Glee Anselm that served as the capital of the Nautolans, one of the two sentient species native to the planet.
Inner Teth was the capital city of the Outer Rim Territories planet Teth during the Clone Wars. The Galactic Empire eventually replaced Inner Teth with a newly built capital, Peroon.
Anselom was a city located on the Mid Rim planet Glee Anselm that served as the capital of the terrestrial Anselmi sentient species, one of the two native to the planet.

The Internal Security Branch, known as IntSec, was a branch within Imperial Intelligence's Internal Organization Bureau. IntSec was charged with the physical security of Imperial Intelligence's facilities and personnel.
Rasterous was a planet with a shipyard belonging to Kuat Drive Yards.
The Ottega Dawn was an Ithorian Herdship. It shared a portion of its name with the primary star of the Ithorian homeworld.
C-3TC was a protocol droid that was under the ownership of Valance Serth during the Galactic Civil War.

objective: Destruction of Republic communications center on Iridonia.
x: During the first few months of the Jedi Civil War, a mission was undertaken by a group of Mandalorian mercenaries, to destroy the Republic communications center on Iridonia.

Carbos Thirteen was a planet around which a space battle between Admiral Nek Bwua'tu and the Corellian and Bothan fleets of the Confederation was conducted during the weeks that followed the Second Battle of Fondor.

The Central Posting Service was a branch of the Galactic Senate that was responsible for maintaining records of all the various criminals and criminal organizations that were wanted for questioning at any given point in time.
Koozebane was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Gilad Pellaeon was an Imperial Remnant Star Destroyer named after the deceased Supreme Commander and Head of State, Gilad Pellaeon. It was Head of State Jagged Fel's flagship.

Darkmeld was a covert Jedi organization created and led by Jedi Knight Jaina Solo. The creation of Darkmeld was informally sanctioned by acting Grand Master Kenth Hamner in 43 ABY amidst tensions between the New Jedi Order and the anti-Jedi policies of Galactic Alliance Chief …
AB-US3 was a training droid used by various individuals during the Galactic Civil War.
The Battle of Argul was a battle fought during the early years of the Clone Wars.
The Battle of Antamont occurred on the planet of Antamont during the Clone Wars, and was fought between the Grand Army of the Republic and the Separatist Droid Army.
Vondrol was a city located on the planet Meastrinnar and a sister city to the similarly-named Vondrel.
Argullians were a sentient, near-Human species from the Mid Rim planet Argul, located in the D'Aelgoth Sector.
Lumica was the capital city of the planet Argul. After the planet was attacked during the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic began an evacuation of the city.
Rena was a planet home to the predatory Renan bloodwolves and known for its wine. Imperial Governor Wilek Nereus once visited Rena during his career collecting dental specimens.

Gandeid IV was the primary planet of the Gandeid system, a part of the Expansion Region's Trailing Grant sector. The planet occupied the fourth orbital position in its star system, and the Gandeidan gravity was low and the climate temperate.
Renan bloodwolves were a predatory species native to the planet Rena. Imperial Governor Wilek Nereus once captured a bloodwolf as part of his collection of dental specimens.
Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 1 was a Republic Mobile Surgical Unit stationed on the jungle planet Drongar during the Clone Wars in 20 BBY.

The Imperial Plaza was a broad ground-level circle made of ferroconcrete located on the planet Coruscant. It was where crowds of spectators gathered to witness the arrival of Rogue Squadron after their successful liberation of the planet Thyferra.

Cularin 1 was a Carrack-class light cruiser that was used by the Cularin Militia in the Cularin system during the Clone Wars. The Heroes of Cularin once met Major Xirossk on it and he sent them on a mission to Uffel.

A color-crawler was a small creature that exuded a colored slime as it slid. Color-crawlers were sold for use in many cosmetic applications and came in a variety of colors, including black, silver, and various shades of brown and green.
The Valiant was a Galactic Republic starship during the First Jedi Purge. In 3951 BBY it was captained by Opelle.

An Imperial-class Star Destroyer served with Sith Lord Darth Vader's Imperial Death Squadron—a task force assembled specifically for finding the headquarters of the Rebel Alliance—during the aftermath of the Hoth campaign of 3 ABY. The Star Destroyer was commanded by a captain.
Pamorjal was a planet located in the Pamorjal system in the Expansion Region.
Tarasin Dream was a merchant ship that was registered on Cularin and operated during the Clone Wars.
The dunecat was a species living in the deserts of Tatooine.
A battle occurred around 22 BBY on the planet Queel during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Confiscation Authority was the governmental body that was in control of the impounds on various Republic prison worlds and directed by the Overseer of Prison Worlds.

conflict: Hunt for Zsinj, Galactic Civil War
objective: Pursue lone TIE/IN interceptor in New Republic controlled planet
x: The Ambush at Gravan Seven was an event during the Galactic Civil War; where forces of Warlord Zsinj ambushed and nearly wiped out Talon Squadron, a New Republic X-wing starfighter squadron.

result: Imperial victory, evacuation of Gamma Base
x: A battle occurred in 0 BBY, shortly before the Battle of Yavin, when Imperial forces located the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Gamma Base on Hoth. The Rebels were forced to evacuate Hoth and flee to Yavin 4.
The Coral Fin was the personal freighter of the Priapulin Charza Kwinn. It was used during the evacuation of Montitia during the Extorin Minor skirmishes.

result: Wraith Squadron successfully detonated their planted charges on the fa
objective: Destroy the manufacturing capabilities of Xartun's transparisteel fact
x: The Mission to Xartun was a Wraith Squadron covert operation with the goal of destroying Xartun's transparisteel product factory owned by Warlord Zsinj. The Wraiths infiltrated the factory at night and planted demolition charges.

This T-series tactical droid, along with three B1-Series battle droids, scouted the Naboo Grassy plains before being destroyed by the Royal Naboo Security Forces. It was later reactivated to garner more information about the Separatists' activities on Naboo.
This World Devastator was a former Imperial starship used by the New Republic.

conflict: Hunt for Zsinj, Galactic Civil War
side2: Planetary defense loyal to Warlord Zsinj
x: The raid on Todirium was an operation carried out by Wraith Squadron during the New Republic's campaign against Warlord Zsinj. The Wraiths destroyed the planet's factories giving matériel to Zsinj, all the while pretending to be Rogue Squadron to entice the Warlord.
Uwari beetles were six-legged beetles that lived in the Myyydril Caverns on the planet Kashyyyk. The local Myyydril tribe used domesticated Uwari beetles as a food source.

place: Naboo training canyon, Naboo Resistance outpost
result: Attacking Trade Federation Droid Army force destroyed.
objective: Deliver supplies to the Naboo Underground
x: This mission was a nighttime mission led by Rhys Dallows, a member of Bravo Flight during the Trade Federation's invasion of Naboo. He and his allies had just attacked a Trade Federation convoy in orbit and captured supplies for the Naboo resistance.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Bin Essada was a member of this species.
The 908th's HQ was the military headquarters of the 908th Stormtrooper Division of the Galactic Empire on the planet Borosk.

conflict: Hunt for Zsinj, Galactic Civil War
objective: Infiltrate Imperial ship and send a rescue message to the New Republic
x: The Ambush at Xobome 6 was an event during the Galactic Civil War; where the modified Corellian corvette Night Caller, a ship that belonged to Warlord Zsinj's forces, was ambushed and captured by Wraith Squadron in the Xobome system.
The Redclaw was a Sabertooth-class assault/rescue vessel that served the Galactic Alliance Remnant. It carried several Venom assault squads, including Redclaw Venom One.
The Nyenthi'Oris Graveyard was a sacred Wookiee burial place in the Kkowir Forest. The graveyard lay
K2-3Z3 was a 3Z3 medical droid in the service of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire. In 137 ABY, after the Battle of Borosk, K2-3Z3 saw to the medical treatment of Sergeant Ran Harkas of Joker Squad.

The Vahla were a nomadic, near-Human species who roamed the galaxy in search of their homeworld. They were tall and slender, and possessed cartilaginous skeletons, which gave them exceptional flexibility.
Croyden was the submoon of the planet of Gipper, located in the Inner Rim. It was known to have a very inefficient postal system.
Gipper was a planet, located in the Inner Rim. It had a submoon named Croyden which was known to have a very inefficient postal system.

The Hall of Champions was located on Jervo's World, a large network of swoop-dueling arenas above Pantolomin owned by Lhosan Industries. It was the biggest swoop-bike course of its time and a subject of extreme interest of swoop bike fans.
Corellian Port Control was the security unit assigned to the Smugglers' Moon of Nar Shaddaa. They attempted to keep crime down on the planet and in it's atmosphere.

The Disciples of Twilight were a Force-sensitive order based on Dyspeth, a moon that was located in the shadows of an Outer Rim planet.
The Hollow Moon was a gambling world located in the Khorya system in Hutt Space.

The Ephin Sarreti was a Star Destroyer in service to the Fel Empire. Part of the Second Outer Rim Fleet, Rulf Yage served aboard the vessel, coordinating starfighter tactics for the entire fleet.
The Second Outer Rim Fleet was a military formation of the Imperial Navy of the Fel Empire. The Star Destroyer Ephin Sarreti, where Rulf Yage served, was part of the fleet.

Galactic Alliance Security, also referred to as GA Security or simply GAS, was a police and paramilitary force of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances. Operating primarily on the planet Coruscant, the GAS was formed in the aftermath of the Second Galactic Civil War.

The Daughters of the Empath Princess were a group of psychics who plied their talents on Atzerri, in the city of Talos.
Munks were creatures that were once native to the planet Ruusan. The creatures were so disliked that the word "munk" become known an insult.

The Knights swoop gang were a group of swoop racers that were adamantly opposed to the Galactic Empire and lead by Finegan Flint. The organization was also enemies of the much more destructive Skulls.

7-A39, also known as SevenAy, was a protocol droid who served the Jedi Order at the Almas Academy, a Jedi academy that was located on the planet Almas. Following the destruction of the academy in 19 BBY, 7-A39 suffered some damage, and his legs were destroyed.
Koong Island was an island in the Roon Sea on Roon which was used as a base by Governor Koong's faction of the Imperial Navy of Tawntoom province during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
The Desert Demons were a criminal gang which operated on the Outer Rim desert planet of Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. They were rivals of several swoop gangs.
Nym's Envoy was a droid that served the pirate warlord Nym.

The Droid Abolitionist Movement was a fanatical group of individuals that promoted droid rights. Led by Xalto Sneerzick, the group petitioned that droids be freed from servitude and be granted the rights of all sentients.
Gold One was a BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber under the command of Gold Leader Captain Jon Vander during the Galactic Civil War.

The Battle of the Silent Blades was the end of a anti-piracy campaign fought by the Galactic Empire in the Outer Rim. It marked the end of the Silent Blades and was also the spark to ignite the mutiny onboard the Far Orbit.

Fireblue Squadron was an I4 Ionizer starfighter squadron in the service of the Galactic Alliance's Core Fleet. An elite unit, Fireblue Squadron was created to complete missions that focused on subduing and capturing enemy vessels.

Twisted Star Squadron was an elite starfighter squadron that served in the Galactic Alliance's Core Fleet. Composed of Jumpstar HPF starfighters, the squadron made use of the Jumpstar's advanced systems to pursue fleeing enemy ships through hyperspace.

The Outcasts of Kkowir Forest were a group of sentients who had been exiled from Kerritamba Village within the Kkowir Forest on Kashyyyk. As a result, they were in constant conflict with the village. They resided in a webweaver cave north of the Great Tree.

Starchaser IV was a Wayfarer-class medium freighter that was owned by Cularin Star Tours during the Clone Wars.
The Hracca Glade was a sub-region of the Etyyy Hunting Grounds on Kashyyyk. It was home to the ferocious Kkorrwrot.
Bocctyyy was a sub-region of the Etyyy Hunting Grounds on Kashyyyk. It was used as the personal hunting grounds of the Rodian hunter Sordaan Xris. It was only accessible by shuttle.

Mosrk'tecks were carnivorous amphibians which looked like large, flattened lizards. They were typically two meters long, not including the tail. They were highly-effective predators and were considered at the top of the food chain on Marca.

D-3P-O2 was a specially-programmed 3PO-series protocol droid responsible for managing Managing Director Vost Tyne's schedule while he was assigned to the hyperbaride plant on Marca. It had a thick accent as it had been programmed by Imperials from the Core Worlds.

Selsor was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Selsor system, a part of the Zarracina sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. It featured several continents.

The Sil'Lume asteroid belt was an asteroid belt located in the Seitia sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
40,005 Milton was an asteroid in the Sil'Lume asteroid belt of the Sil'Lume system.
76,095 Poe was an asteroid in the Sil'Lume asteroid belt of the Sil'Lume system.
The Flail was a terrorist organization active on Coruscant during the years immediately before the Battle of Naboo.

Mount Antas was a mountain on the planet Nizon. Shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire, Imperial forces began to construct a turbolaser battery named Point Gold on the mountain.
Arjun Jr. was a combat utility vehicle launched by the Strike-class medium cruiser Arjun at the Battle of Organarms to resupply Missile Boat Mu 1.

When forming a government on the planet Melida/Daan in 44 BBY, the Young—the ruling faction—created an advisory council as a legislative body. The council consisted of ten members, led by Cerasi, in addition to the governor, Nield.
The Battle of Bandomeer occurred between Imperial forces and the Ionite miners of Bandomeer in 19 BBY.
Noua was an archipelago located on the Inner Rim planet Telerath. Noua was home to the Ember's Fire club, and had a large population of slavers and spice runners.
Loj was a planet located in the Colonies' Loj system. It was the site of the Moss Caverns, near which the expensive intoxicating beverage known as T'iil-T'iil was manufactured.
Silver Bull was a container transport operated by the Galactic Empire.

Aluma was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle operated by the Galactic Empire. Shortly before the Battle of Hoth, it was assigned to rendezvous with container transport Silver Bull to transfer a VIP scientist at the SpecWar Fab Deep Space Manufacturing Facility.
Drop Canyon was a small farming village on Ceriun, a primitive agrarian world.
Dagger 1 was an Assassin-class corvette used by the Galactic Empire.

The Ugor homeworld was a planet in the Paradise system—known as J21-Z65 on most star charts—in the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories, at galactic coordinates M-20. The Ugor species evolved on the world.
The Rock Palace was a location on the planet Tatooine. At some stage, Watto and Shmi Skywalker toured there.

SE4-T25 was the designation of a courteous servant droid who operated a turbolift in the Radell Mining Corporation's Corporate Headquarters building on the planet Elrood during the Galactic Civil War.
The Eye of Shiblizar was an old Ulig Abaha Ltd. Dimel-class assault ship that was modified by the slavers Zlarb and Magg.
5-A was the personal StealthX starfighter of Mara Jade Skywalker held within the Master's Hangar of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
Ven Karya Spaceport was a spaceport located on the planet Kiffex, at the edge of the Trostlos Waste.
This gang was a group of thugs led by partners Lemo and Sanda on Arcan IV.
A four-eyed species existed in the galaxy. An individual of the species was a member of the Pendarran's Revenge.

A small skirmish occurred on the Imperial world of Carida shortly before the completion of the Death Star in 1 BBY, the result of a small Rebel force attempting to interfere with the demonstration of Colonel Maximilian Veers' demonstration of a new model of AT-AT walker.
The Uggli Brothers gang was a group of pirates, centered on Kiffex. Most of their members did, in fact, have deformities or were otherwise unattractive examples of their species.
Skine was a planet located in the Skine sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the location of the Skine Bounty Hunter College.
The Luxury, also known as The Luxury, was a luxurious liner that was used during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

W2-7AY was a brown-colored protocol droid, that was owned by Thaedius Creed during the time of the Clone Wars. After some of Creed's emlpoyees went missing on Cularin, he sent W2-7AY to find the Heroes of Cularin in Hedrett.

Point Nadir was a shadowport located on the comet Resh 9376 in the Outer Rim. It was formally established by the Anjiliac clan built on the remains of a base constructed by the pirate captain Salovan Fische.
Draay 2 was a moon purchased by Lucien Draay should he have had to reconstitute a True Covenant from his mother Krynda Draay's Jedi Covenant. Many Jedi lived on the moon by 3963 BBY.
The Yevethan Uprising, also known as the Day of Retribution, was a brief conflict eight months after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.

The Wilderness Fighters were a military specialty of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Special Forces. Trained to fight and survival in a variety of wilderness environments, individual Wilderness Fighters were specialists in a single terrain type.
The Shirshir Desert was located on the planet of Nishr in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the location of the Nishr Taskforce's Base Three.
Kaythree was a R4 astromech droid that served as Jessika Pava's astromech in the Resistance, after her previous droid, O-R10N, was destroyed during the mission to Megalox Beta.
Salovan's Souk, or simply the Souk, was the marketplace on Point Nadir, a shadowport in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Nest, sometimes known as the K'lor' Nest, was the district of Point Nadir that housed the rougher elements of the Outer Rim shadowport.
The Trostlos Waste was a region on Kiffex. The Ven Karya Spaceport was located at the edge of the Trostlos Waste.
This New Republic base was located on the planet Altyr V. During the Galactic Civil War, it came under attack by two artificial Imperial asteroids.
The Crucible was a massive millenary slave-trading organization, founded by the Sith Lord Ieldis.
Imperial soldiers, or Imperial Heavy Infantry Soldiers, also called Sith troopers, Imperial troopers or Sith Empire Troopers, were the infantry soldiers of the reconstituted Sith Empire's army.
The dying ceremony, also called a farewell ceremony, was a brief ritual in which a Sage of the Baran Do—a Force-based organization located on Dorin—pretended to die.
Republic troopers were the soldiers of the old Galactic Republic created to deal with various threats from the reconstituted Sith Empire following the Great Galactic War.

The Inner Moon was a moon located in the Prakith system. It was one of two moons that orbited the planet Prakith and was closer to it than the other moon. It had no atmosphere and low gravity. In about 19 BBY, the ship Good Feeling crashed there, after being attacked by mynocks.

The Outer Moon was one of the two moons of the planet Prakith. During the early years of the Galactic Empire, it was the site of the Imperial Testing Grounds, a facility that was used develop new starship designs.
Chola Mavra was a floating city, located in the upper atmosphere of the gas planet Genarius.
The Battle of Thaldo was a battle that occurred on Thaldo during the Galactic Civil War.

The Imperial Military Police was a branch of the Galactic Empire's armed forces which were charged with ensuring that members of the military acted within the laws established by the Empire.

The Sabre Club was the most lavish and exclusive casino in the Ace of Sabres. It was limited to 999 members who had to pay 25,000 credits for a two-year membership. Each member got a holocard that contained a genetic sample, voice print and retinal scan.
The Fireclaw Horde was a mercenary gang led by Mebara Jos, operating out of the Cularin system during the last decade of the Galactic Republic.
Fireheads, also known as Rhinnalian fireheads, were one of the strangest lifeforms on the planet Rhinnal.
The Distant Sunrise was a heavily-modified YT-2000 light freighter owned by Karrison Lee.

The Wookiee Liberation Front or WOLF, was an organization founded on the planet Cularin during the Clone Wars. Led by the Five Masters, and seemingly made up of children, all members dressed in flowing, colored cloak and moved about with the help of glow poles.
The Five Masters was the name given to the leadership of the Wookiee Liberation Front and led by the Master in White.
