New Otoh Gunga was the main and first Gungan city built on Ohma-D'un during the moon's colonization in 32 BBY.
The Mission to Dagro was a battle during the Clone Wars on the planet Dagro. Vale City was spared destruction due to Kenobi's efforts.

Project Lasercutter was an Imperial operation led by the Inquisitorius. It aimed to capture Alliance smugglers in order to disrupt Rebel supply lines. Their operation on Tatooine made use of a spy within the Alliance who fed them information on the whereabouts of top smugglers.
The Flare was a modified Kuat Leisure 121-B pleasure craft used by Jedi Knights Aayla Secura and Ylenic It'kla during their mission to rescue Ratri Tane, in the first months of the Clone Wars.
The Flare was the name of bounty hunter Anniha Nega's modified Z-95 Headhunter.
The Department of Defense, or Defense Department, was the branch of the Galactic Republic government that was created during the Clone Wars to oversee all aspects of the Republic Military.
The Venom assault squads were elite military units used by the Galactic Alliance during the Second Imperial Civil War.

Beta Company was a military unit that was part of the Cularin Militia. During the Clone Wars, Beta Company fought in the Thaereian system. The survivors later participated in a Militia parade on Cularin.
Joker Squadron was a Cularin Militia military unit. During the Clone Wars, it participated in a Militia parade, on Cularin.
Recruitment was a section of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's Sub-Adult Group that was responsible for recruiting new members into the organization's ranks.

objective: Destroy Imperial recruiting base
x: The Mission to Tatooine occurred in 12 ABY when independent operative Kyle Katarn raided an Empire Reborn facility on Tatooine for the New Republic.
Model 3-NIi was a B1-series battle droid created by and in the service of the scientist Treun Lorn.
Jevelet was a planet located in the Core of the galaxy that housed a prison/mental facility.

The Fliggerian firebeast was a creature named for its digestive system, which used a form of combustion to break down its food. The name of this creature was also used as an oath between bounty hunters.

The Shapers of Kro Var were an order of Force users indigenous to the planet Kro Var. They originated circa 1000 BBY when a damaged cruiser fleeing the devastation of the New Sith Wars crashed on Kro Var. The survivors of the crash eked out an existence on the inhospitable world.
Daimar was a planet located in the Mid Rim.

objective: Destroy CIS base
x: The Mission to Forscan VI was a Jedi mission undertaken during the Clone Wars.
Korvaii was a small agriworld located in the Kordu sector of the Mid Rim.
Kro Var was a barren planet that was located in the Unknown Regions.
The Wardens of the Sky were a Force-using organization that operated throughout the galaxy, keeping the spacelanes safe.

The Founder was one of the three Acclamator-class assault ships dispatched by the Galactic Senate to defend the planet Duro during the Battle of Duro. The ship and its companions were all destroyed, demonstrating General Grievous' prowess as a master tactician.
An asteroid belt surrounded the Mid Rim planet of Golm, also known as Bothawui Prime.

result: The Zarracines rendered a near-extinct, nomadic species
The Zarracina system annexed by the Galactic Republic
x: In 11,660 BBY, the Galactic Republic carried out a bombardment of the planet Zarracina III. At the time, the Republic was under the control of the Humanocentric Pius Dea cult, and it attempted to gain control of the planet after a strategically important hyperspace jump point …

t: Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)
x: The Battle of Ralltiir was a battle of the Second Imperial Civil War that took place in 137 ABY in orbit of the planet Ralltiir.

The Omen, later known by the Lost Tribe of Sith as the Ship of Destiny, was a Sith dreadnaught serving in Naga Sadow's Sith Empire. In 5000 BBY, Sadow tasked the Omen, captained by Yaru Korsin, to mine Lignan ore for use in the upcoming Sith invasion of the Galactic Republic.
The Harbinger was a Sith dreadnaught active in 5000 BBY, during the Great Hyperspace War. It was commanded by Saes Rrogon, a Jedi-turned-Sith Lord.
The Fulminant was a New Republic warship that was destroyed during the Battle of N'zoth.

The Southern Ewok Lake Village, also simply known as the Ewok Lake Village, was a small Ewok stilt village located on the forest moon of Endor during the Galactic Civil War. It was inhabited by the Ewoks of the Gondula tribe.

The Marauder Mountain was a mountain on the Forest Moon of Endor. It was bordered by the Mertuen Forest to the north and east. The mountain was named after the moon's Sanyassan Marauders who had their stronghold in the area.

The Jiberah Plains were a forested and geographically flat area of land on the Forest Moon of Endor. It was located south of the Yawari Cliffs, which separated the region from the northern Desert of Salma.
The Southern Reach was a mountainous region on the planet Tatooine. The planet's southern oasis was located near this region.
The Lasay Swamp was a swamp region on the planet Naboo.

The Paitnnu Wetlands were a region on the planet Naboo. The city of Moenia was located here. After the Battle of Yavin, the Paitnnu Wetlands was the location of a battle between Gungans and Imperial forces.
The Eastern Great Grass Plains was a region on the planet Naboo. It was located east of the Great Grass Plains.
The Western Great Grass Plains was a region on the planet Naboo. It was located west of the Great Grass Plains.
The Isle of Kun was a jungle region on the moon Yavin 4. It was separated from the Wayward Jungle, the Val'Arnos Jungle and from the Swamp of Fallen Stars by the Unnh River.
The Swamp of Fallen Stars was a swamp region on the moon Yavin 4. It was located between the Val'Arnos Jungle and the Nicolo Peak.
The Wayward Jungle was a jungle region on the moon Yavin IV. It was located between the Yunteh Mountains and the Unnh River.
The Yunteh Mountains were a mountain range on the moon Yavin IV. It was home to at least one inactive volcano. The Yunteh Mountains was surrounded by the Wayward Jungle.

The Ersham Ridge was a mountainous jungle region on Yavin 4. It was separated from the Wayward Jungle and the Taurin Delta by the Unnh River. The Great Massassi Temple and the Labor Outpost were located in this region.
The Taurin Delta was a river delta formed by the Unnh River where it entered an ocean on the moon Yavin 4. The Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster was located on the landmass.

The Val'Arnos Jungle was a jungle region on Yavin IV. It was located between the Unnh River, the Isle of Kun, the Swamp of Fallen Stars and the Nicolo Peak. The Palace of the Woolamander was located in this jungle.
The Nicolo Peak was a mountain on the moon Yavin 4. It bordered the Val'Arnos Jungle and was close to another lone mountain peak, the Borundi Peak.

The Borundi Peak was an inactive volcano on the moon Yavin 4. It was close to another lone mountain peak, the Nicolo Peak. During the Galactic Civil War, the Imperial Fortress was built near the foot of the Borundi Peak.

G0-16 was a fan-tan dealer droid that worked at the Fifteen Moons Casino on the planet Ord Mantell. The droid lacked sympathy for the players, and would routinely skip over players who didn't meet its eye during gameplay.

Uvak were a large, membranous-winged reptavian species with sharp beaks. They were native to the planet of Kesh, where they were used by both the indigenous Keshiri and the Human Lost Tribe of Sith for transportation.

Tahv, also known as the City of Glass, was the capital settlement of the Wild Space world of Kesh. It was built around 5000 BBY on the continent of Keshtah Minor by the planet's native sentient species, the Keshiri; Tahv's walls originally served the purpose of keeping the Kes…

The Steadfast was an Ardent-class fast frigate in the service of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War, seven years after the Dark Lord overthrew Galactic Emperor Roan Fel at the end of the Fel Empire's war with the Galactic Alliance.
The Lazy Katarn was a YT-1300 light freighter that was used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The sclarin were a reptilian species of creature that could be found on the planet of Cularin. They were a dangerous, raptor-like species of kilassin.
Spanner was the loyal companion of Luskin Exovar. He was extensively modified and helped Exovar run Exovar's Emporium.
Avenger was a Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire.

Resolute was a starship in the service of the Fel Empire in 130 ABY. Under the command of Admiral Edouard Fenel it participated in the Battle of Caamas, the final battle of the Sith–Imperial War, where it destroyed a number of cruisers too heavily damaged to properly defend th…
The planet Phaegon III was in the Phaegon system in the Grumani sector. Its largest moon was the main source of Lignan ore.
The G-79 was the designation of the drone barge dispatched by Darth Vader to transport Wrenga Jixton to Corulag, on his mission to assassinate Governor Torlock.
Gactimus was a moon orbiting the planet Triton. Several religious retreats were established there by the insectoid Tritonites.

327-B was a CR90 corvette dispatched along with 327-A and 327-C to attack the Rebel-allied X7 factory in the Mobetta sector. The corvette was produced by Corellian Engineering Corporation. It was part of Admiral Wooyou Senn's Task Force Vengeance.
The Order of Sanctuary was a secret society of female warriors based in the remote areas of Naboo. The Order were patriots, pledging their support to protect the Queen of Naboo.
The Galactic Horizon was an Ithorian Manollium-class herdship.
The Battle of Spirana was an engagement in the New Republic liberation campaign after the Battle of Endor.
Galloa II was the homeworld of the nonhuman Wind Dancers.
Gamma Intelligence Group was a branch of the Imperial Security Bureau, operating out of Gall.
Gamma Squad was a stormtrooper unit that occupied Cloud City.

t: Battle of unidentified planet (Skywalker and Tano)
x: A battle took place in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars, wherein Jedi General Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan, Jedi Commander Ahsoka Tano, engaged enemy forces on a planet with Clone Captain CT-7567, a squad of clone troopers, and several AV-7 Antivehicle Cannons.

A battle took place on the planet Anoth seven standard weeks after the outbreak of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY. Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker defended Anoth from Separatist forces led by the cyborg General Grievous.
A battle took place on the planet Bakura around seven standard weeks after the outbreak of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.

objective: Rescue Leia Organa, recover Imperial battle plans
x: The mission to Nibiru was a search-and-rescue mission undertaken by Luke Skywalker during the Galactic Civil War.

Qatamer was a city on Lorrd, a capital of the province of Kinyov. It had brightly painted buildings that stood out in the desert plains, with the few remaining Argazdan structures, made of sinister looking black stone.
Daermor was a planet from the Daermor system. In 0 ABY, Auditor-General Fiolla conducted an audit there.
Gasnits were large, bat-like carnivores native to an unscouted Outer Rim planet. They would inject their prey with massive amounts of venom before consuming them.
The Ku'Amo was a modified Z-95 Headhunter that was owned by the Shistavanen Blik.
SP-99 was a protocol droid working for the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War.

The Pythea was an exploratory ship owned by Panha, a female Chiss, and Sarkkin, a male Wookiee. In 25 ABY, the ship intercepted a fleet crewed by the Yuuzhan Vong—a species of extragalactic invaders—bound for the planet Artorias.

result: Leffingites subdued by the Galactic Empire
x: The Battle of Almak was fought on the Mid Rim planet Almak sometime between 19 BBY and 1 BBY, during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

result: Obi-Wan Kenobi and Bail Organa injured and rescued
x: The Mission to Zigoola was an operation that took place in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars. Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious set a trap for Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Senator Bail Prestor Organa on the remote Wild Space planet Zigoola, home to a Sith temple.
General Marshoo's Eatery was a restaurant located in Otoh Gunga on the planet Naboo. It was owned and operated by the Gungan Brass Marshoo.
The Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization, or A.C.L.O. for short, was a pro-Rebel Alliance medical supply organization active on the planet Talus during the Galactic Civil War.

result: Failure to end riots; death of all Jedi dispatched
objective: Quell the riots on Kabal
x: The Mission to Kabal was a Jedi assignment authorized by the Jedi High Council and the Galactic Senate in 22 BBY.

The Jinwa Raiders were a group of alien pirates that operated during the Galactic Civil War. A band of Jinwa Raiders was defeated when C-3PO and R2-D2 were forced to pilot a Rebel Alliance transport to Ladro.

Oasis East, also nicknamed the abandoned Oasis, was the designation given to a small body of water located south of the Krayt Graveyard on the planet Tatooine. This oasis was often mistaken for a mirage, given its near-perfect circular shape.
Oasis South was a small body of water located south of Anchorhead on the desert world of Tatooine.
Oasis Northeast was a small body of water located near the Krayt Graveyard on the desert world of Tatooine.

Little Capella was a planet in the Little Capella system in the Gordian Reach, a region in the Outer Rim Territories. In 2 ABY, the company Rapora Mining operated the Rapora Mining Center on Little Capella as one of many new facilities throughout the Outer Rim.
Otonon Tracks, officially designated as A5 S5, was a tending droid who worked for The Ice Cream Man.

The Gilded Thranta was an FX-77 Star Yacht owned by the Rodian Falloon, the former Black Sun account Soolehad, during the Yuuzhan Vong War. It was armed with two turreted, top and bottom mounted dual laser cannons and a concussion missile launcher with twelve missiles.
Atorians were natives of the planet Artorias.
The GK Oppressor was a battle droid that was produced on Mustafar during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
JanFathal was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories and was once part of the Republic. The city of Athar was its capital.
Wookiee Gunner was a Vernal-class freighter owned and operated by the Altisian Jedi faction during the Clone Wars. It was used for humanitarian missions to war-torn planets.
Yarille was a planet located within the Yarille system of the Outer Rim Territories.

Athar was the capital city of JanFathal. Its inhabitants were known as the Athari. During the Clone Wars, the city was at the center of the Battle of JanFathal as control over it was disputed between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Glet-mites were small pests native to Nam Chorios. A group of mites were hormonally modified by a Kubaz chef, under the employ of Beldorion, to grow to huge proportions for the Hutt to eat.

The Global Organization of Interstellar Shippers was a group made up of representatives of the largest transportation corporations based on the planet Gandle Ott in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Hulgren were a species of snake-like creatures that could grow up to 40 meters in length. They were gray in coloration and had numerous eyes. They were found in the lower levels of the space station, Hosk Station.

Sollima's gambling network was a gambling network owned and ruled by an Aleena crime lord Sollima. It has casinos on multiple planets, such as Simbarc, but its jewel was the Hollow Moon, a gambling world located in the the Hutt-controlled Khorya system in the Outer Rim Territo…

Sollima's accounting droid was a 3D-4X administrative droid that performed multiple duties for an Aleena crime lord Sollima. It contained valuable information about Sollima's operation, both legal and illegal, which could be used against him.

This Imperial Garrison was located on Moog Mot VI, a banking planet under Imperial control. In 1 BBY, Han Solo and Billal Batross infiltrated it to retrieve the accounting droid of the crime lord Sollima, but were detained by a squad of stormtroopers.

result: Mission failed, Han Solo and Billal Batross detained by Galactic Empir
objective: Retrieve Sollima's accounting droid
x: Mission to Moog Mot VI was organized by an Aleena crime lord Sollima in order to return his accounting droid from the hands of Galactic Empire before it could use the information inside its data core against him.

Epica was a naturally beautiful world with forested hills, mountain valleys, and cold water seas. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Hydians Auction House was relocated to Epica. At the time it was believed that Epica was too remote to attract the attention of the Yuuzhan Vong.

93D was a silver bipedal droid of unknown manufacture. He ran 93D's, one of the best known chop shops in Point Nadir. His services were costly, but considered worth the money. He had two extra arms and a scathing sense of humor.

Glok monsters were snake-like creatures on the forest moon of Endor. They were native to the glop pits and attacked intruders into their area. Glok monsters took to sleeping under the ground and would "erupt" out of the dirt when attacking.
Ice puppies were creatures that were native to the frigid planet of Toola. The creatures were weak, and so the term developed into a Whiphid insult.
This unidentified moon was a world described as being in the "middle of nowhere."

A battle took place on the planet Florrum in 20 BBY during the Clone Wars. After aiding in the liberation of the Hutt prisoner Ziro Desilijic Tiure from Republic custody, the bounty hunter Shahan Alama attempted to go into hiding from the Republic.
A Flarestar-class attack shuttle was used by the Weequay bounty hunter Shahan Alama around 21 BBY, during the Clone Wars.

Feather Green Village was an Ewok village on the Forest Moon of Endor. It was destroyed in less than an hour by an angry Phlog, who believed that the Ewoks in the village had stolen his luck hanadak skull.

The Starhunter Dhelba was a Starhunter menagerie ark that operated during the time of the Galactic Republic. In about 800 BBY, it crashed on the forest moon of Endor, in the Outer Rim. It had been carrying various creatures, including teeks, gupins and tree goats.

t: Unidentified OOM command battle droid lieutenant
x: An OOM command battle droid served as a lieutenant in the Confederate Navy, aboard a Munificent-class star frigate under the command of a Neimoidian Captain.

The Battle of Corulag was fought between the Fel Empire and the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances during the Sith–Imperial War. Oron Jaeger, an Imperial Army General of the 501st Legion received a head injury during the battle, requiring him to undergo cyborg augmentation.

The G'mi Moa was a Liannan bulk freighter, which traveled a regular shipping route along the Perlemian Trade Route. At one point along its usual routine, the ship was boarded and hijacked by the pirate Gunda Mabin.
The Sipsk'ud were a sentient species native to the Sipsk system in the Kanz sector. They were broadly avian in appearance, with a yellow duck-like beak and white feathers.
Hiffis was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Hiffis system, a part of the Jjannex sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Coruscant Zoo was an zoological institution located on the planet Coruscant. Following an attempt by bounty hunter Zam Wesell to assassinate Senator Padmé Amidala in 7955 C.R.C., the bisected remains of the two arthropods that had been used by Wesell in the attempt were se…
Outpost GRF-7493 was a small Imperial garrison on Yavin 4.
The Jaraana irstat was a Tarasin tribe that lived on the planet Cularin during the time of the Clone Wars.

The flatworm was a type of nonsentient worm. The primitive nervous system of the Swokes Swokes—a sentient humanoid species from the planet Makem Te of the Outer Rim Territories' Nilgaard sector who lacked receptors for the sense of touch and as a result were nearly impervious …
The Obsta Desert was a desert that surrounded the capital city of Thousand Thousand on Makem Te.
Lorrd II was the largest moon of the planet Lorrd, which was located in the Kanz sector, in the Outer Rim Territories.

S-R6, also known as Essar, was an assassin droid active during the Galactic Civil War. For each of his missions, he had his central programming and circuits transferred to a different droid shell for the purposes of disguise.
The Gold Devil was a specialized group of Y-wings completing missions during the Galactic Civil War.

Testament was the Republic Hammerhead-class cruiser in the Republic Navy around 3963 BBY. Commanded by Captain Telettoh, the ship made a stop on the planet Wor Tandell, where Telettoh and Jedi General Malak were looking for Zayne Carrick and his band of renegades, before depar…

The Walkway Collective was a resistance group of around one hundred Coruscanti, established after the Battle of Coruscant. It was centered around the Catier Walkway and led by Tenga Javik. Yassat was a scout for the group.
Tandreeds were a type of non-sentient species native to the planet Wor Tandell. Jarael rode one of those creatures in 3963 BBY.

Gantra Lea was a provincial capital town on the planet Wor Tandell. In 3963 BBY a Republic Hammerhead-class cruiser Testament made a stop on the planet, while it's commander Captain Telettoh and Jedi General Malak were looking for Zayne Carrick and his band of renegades.
Gondagali was the first planet attacked with the MS-19 shield buster, during the time of the New Republic.

The Grendin River was a river on the planet Lok. Nym's Stronghold was built next to the river, a bridge connected it with the starport on the other side. Some legs of the Lok Marathon swoop racing track followed the bed of this river.
Gorfan was a pair of Modular conveyors used by the Imperial Navy. The conveyors were used to deliver supplies to help contruct a space station that would be called NL-1 in the Pakuuni system.

A gorgy-bird was a creature after which the Rogue Squadron tactic, Wobbly as a mother Gorgybird, was named. Female gorgy birds wobbled in flight after giving birth. However, this wobbling was only a ruse to lure predators away from the nest.

Red Squadron was a Predator-class fighter squadron in the Navy of the Sith Empire. It was part of the Coruscant Third Fleet and participated in the Battle of Ralltiir during the Second Imperial Civil War.
Mandalore City was a settlement on the Mandalorian homeworld of Mandalore. It was in existence during the time of the Galactic Republic before the year 1000 BBY.

Gorno was a planet in the Outer Rim, along the Corellian Run near Tatooine. The Galactic Empire had a secret research facility used to design the superlaser for the second Death Star, codenamed Hammertong.
The Bofa Treat Gang was a criminal group on the planet Corellia at the time of the Galactic Civil War. Their leader was Lucien Bender.
The Detritus Satellites were one of several groups of Vulture droid scavengers active at the time of the Galactic Civil War.

X10-700 "Destroyer" was the designation of a droid starfighter that used a Z-95 Headhunter chassis. It was a member of the Detritus Satellites, a group of scavenger droids, mostly Vulture-class droid starfighters, operating in the Dantooine system during the time of the Galact…

The Gundark gang was a criminal organization on the Nabooian moon Rori at the time of the Galactic Civil War. The gang was named after the gundark, one of the most fearsome species in the galaxy. They maintained a base near the city of Narmle.

headquarters: Circle Chambers, Kesh capitol building, Tahv
x: The Circle of Lords was the unicameral legislative body of the Lost Tribe of Sith. The Circle governed the planet Kesh from the Circle Chambers, a room located near the top of the capitol building of the planet's capital city of Tahv.

The Takara Mountains, known originally by the native Keshiri species as the Cetajan Mountains, were a mountain range on the remote Wild Space planet of Kesh. In 5000 BBY, during the Great Hyperspace War, a Sith starship, the Omen, crash-landed in these mountains.
The Indigo Tower was a restaurant on the planet Coruscant which was modeled after the famous Skysitter Restaurant.

The Eternal Crusader was a frigate in the fleet of the Lost Tribe of Sith. It was captured by the Tribe and placed under the command of Lady Olaris Rhea. Rhea's Sith apprentice, Vestara Khai, also served aboard the starship.

objective: Disable the Elders' starfighters and win the war
x: The war on the planet Melida/Daan between the Young—a group of children—and the Elders, the world's oldest residents, of 44 BBY reached its climax when the Young attacked the spaceport where the Elders refueled their starfighters.

6-POC was a LOM-series protocol droid who served for a project manager of GeneTech Syndicate during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, 6-POC operated out of the GeneTech Syndicate Lab near the city of Dearic on the Double World of Talus.

Alpha moon was the designation given to Bessimir's primary moon by the New Republic. When Operation Hammerblow, the operational readiness exercise for the New Republic Fifth Fleet, was initiated against the planet, the alpha moon housed the defenses primary antiship batteries,…
This grapple droid was present in the Battle of Antamont. It detected a deserter B1 battle droid and tried to convince it to return to the droid army.

result: Failure, the entire team save the leader was killed
objective: Kidnap Leia Organa Solo and her twin children
x: The Raid on Coruscant was Grand Admiral Thrawn's operation to kidnap Leia Organa Solo and her twins in order to appease the Dark Jedi Joruus C'baoth. It involved fourteen members of Imperial Intelligence, led by Major Molo Himron.
Woostroids were a black-eyed sentient species. The assistant for the Troig Reezingrom Abbayav, Morna, was a Woostroid.
Bylluran Athletic was a Sullustan bolo-ball team that was active during the waning days of the Galactic Republic. Around 21 BBY, Bylluran Athletic made it to a bolo-ball final.

This moon was located in the Kathol Rift. In 43.5 ABY Jedi Grand Master Luke Skywalker and his son, Jedi Knight Ben Skywalker, traveled to the Rift to find the Aing-Tii species, in hopes of learning more about Jedi Knight-turned-Sith Lord Jacen Solo's fall to the dark side of …
The Graveyard of Lost Ships was a collection of starships which were drawn into orbit around a collapsed dwarf star by Doctor Arakkus.
The Great Northern Forest was a large forest on Myrkr inhabited by vornskrs and ysalamiri. It was also the site of Talon Karrde's base of operations. Hyllyard City was located near the forest.

This spaceport town was located on the planet Hockaleg, in the Patriim system. The spaceport was home to the sizable construction crew of the Imperial Tarkin superweapon, constructed in Hockaleg's orbit, in between work shifts.

The Destruction of Aeten II took place in 3 ABY, shortly following the Battle of Hoth. Imperial Grand Admiral Martio Batch used the superlaser of the Empire's still-under-construction Tarkin superweapon to shatter the planet of Aeten II, releasing million's of the planet's sty…

Red Watch was the codename for the unit formed by clone commandos Sev of Delta Squad and Fi of Omega Squad. The pairing was decided by Kal Skirata during an unauthorized mission on Coruscant to destroy a Separatist terrorist ring.
In 22 BBY during the Clone Wars, Jedi Commander Barriss Offee oversaw an operation on Geonosis.
Oldranai was the capital city of the Outer Rim Territories planet Daluuj.
Veneron was the capital city of the Klatooinian homeworld of Klatooine during the era of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire. During the earlier Imperial Period, the planet's capital was Treema.
Kotokai was the capital city of the Unknown Regions planet Nagi.
Zeltros was the capital city of the Inner Rim planet Zeltros.
Growler was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate which served in the Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

objective: Capture Naboo queen Padmé Amidala
Assassination of Obi-Wan Kenobi, Qui-Gon Jinn, and Anakin Skywalker
x: The Skirmish at Coruscant was a small battle fought on Coruscant in 32 BBY. It began when Padmé Amidala, the Queen of Naboo, was captured by the Sun Guard, the Coruscant mercenaries, and a group of thugs from the Restricted Area.

The Discord was a light cruiser that served in the Confederate Navy during the Clone Wars. During the conflict, Captain Gilad Pellaeon of the Republic ship Leveler mistakenly identified the Confederate destroyer Reaper as being the Discord, while in the Fath system, due to fla…
The Reaper was a destroyer, that served in the Confederate Navy, during the Clone Wars. It was armed with forty turbolasers.
This planet was the location of a battle during the Clone Wars. Jedi Master Yoda defeated an entire Separatist army using only a giant chaingun.

Prowl was a Prowler 1000 seeker droid that belonged to Finn Galfridian as of 25 ABY. After the Battle of Artorias—an invasion of the planet Artorias, Galfridian's homeworld—the droid relocated to the Jedi Praxeum on Yavin 4 with Galfridian.

Feldrona was a planet located in the Feldrona system, a part of the Glythe sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. At some point, it was colonized by members of the Zabrak species from the Glythe sector planet Iridonia.

The Guardstar was an Imperial Patrol Frigate in the Imperial Navy by the time of the Galactic Civil War fought between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. In 3 ABY, the Guardstar was orbiting Tatooine, a planet in the Tatoo system.
Guild was a pair of Lambda-class T-4a shuttles in service to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
C9-RX0, or simply C9, was a protocol droid that resided in the Taloraan City on the planet of Taloraan during the Clone Wars.

The Artorias resistance was a resistance cell established on Artorias. They resisted the Yuuzhan Vong occupation during and after the Battle of Artorias. It was led by the Artorian king, Caled Galfridian, from a hidden base at the bottom of the Great Sea of Artorias.
A battle occurred early in the Yuuzhan Vong War and involved the invasion of the planet Artorias.

Rychel was a remote planet located within the Rychel system of the Dalonbian sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Rychel was invaded by the Yuuzhan Vong early in the Yuuzhan Vong War, shortly after the Battle of Artorias.

Kinyov was a sparsely populated and largely desert province on the Lorrdian homeworld of Lorrd. During the opening stages of the Kanz Disorders, Lorrdian refugees fleeing from other more populated parts of the planet fled to Kinyov.

result: Bothans declare neutrality in the war
x: A battle was fought in 21 BBY over the Bothan colony world of Kothlis during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

objective: To ensure that Taloraan remains loyal to the Republic
x: The Mission to Taloraan was undertaken by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, and Skywalker's Padawan, Ahsoka Tano.
The Republic Service Organization, known also as RSO, was the military support unit within the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
The Worrite homeworld was an astronomical object unknown to the galaxy at large. The crustacean–insectoid Worrite species hailed from this location.
The Metalsmiths Guild was a major trade union on the ore-rich planet of Vandelhelm, whose roots dated back to the original settling of the world.
During the Clone Wars, a barren rocky planet was the site of the battle between Jedi Knights Aayla Secura, Voolvif Monn, Agen Kolar, Anakin Skywalker and several LM-432 crab droids.
The Happy Blasters were a mercenary group of smugglers active during the Galactic Civil War. The group was named for their tendency to blast anything that moved.

Har Binande was the primary planet in the Har system. Invaded by the Lahag Erli during the early years of the Galactic Republic, their forces occupied the planet for many years until they were finally deposed.
The Harbinger was an assault ship owned and piloted by Bel Att while he worked for the Nalroni crimelord Sprax. Limna Yith stole the ship and used it as a ship for her mercenary work.

Harbin-re was a planet located in the Harbin-re system of the Inner Rim. It was famous for productions of operas from the Neoclassical period, including several compositions favored by the Galactic Emperor Palpatine.
Rachuk was a small planet in the Rachuk system, located in the Colonies region.

t: Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)
x: The Battle of Bothawui was a major military engagement in 3671 BBY, during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. The battle was a turning point in the decade-old war, and a major boost to a crippled Republic on the verge of collapse.

The Hard Shell was an Imperial Class-7 Repair Vessel produced by Kuat Drive Yards. Deployed to the planet Jatee, the Hard Shell was hijacked by agents of the Rebel Alliance in an attempt to take Dr. Soron Hegerty offworld.
Yen Bachask was a regional capital city on the planet Yarille.
Echo-97 was a V-19 Torrent starfighter. During the Clone Wars, the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker flew it from Coruscant to the planet JanFathal to rendezvous with the warship Leveler.
The Senate Investigative Committee, or Senate Investigatory Committee, was a Galactic Senate committee, presumably overseeing Senate investigations.

A canary was a creature known for its delicate physiology. The avian Quor'sav species had a similarly frail constitution, which led the gambler Lando Calrissian to compare their physiology to a canary sometime between 3 BBY and 2 BBY.
Hargm's Hill was a low bluff located on a coast of Garos IV. Overlooking the governor's mansion, it was just south of the Tahika Cliffs.
Hargon's Hill was a low peak located on Garos IV. Just south of Ariana, a hibridium vein was found in the hill and exhausted by the Galactic Empire.
Harks were a species of avian beasts native to the planet of Vorzyd IV.

The Harthusa's Pride was a modified space yacht owned by the Devaronian slaver, Harthusa. Confiscated by agents of the Alliance to Restore the Republic in the Bissillirus system shortly after the liberation of Kentara, they kept the ship as they continued to investigate the Bi…
Fallowan was an agricultural planet located within the Sujimis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Twi'lek Dancer was a CEC Barloz-class freighter that had a number of owners through the years.

The Harvest Moon was a 100-ton grain freighter operating during the Galactic Civil War. Working in the Sarrahban system, it was used to smuggle Rebel Alliance refugees and ytterbium out of the system.

HASH-19 was an assassin droid who was operating in the years of the Galactic Civil War. Appearing similar to a surveillance spy-eye, HASH-19 was a gold-chrome metallic ball. However, when provoked, six extensible arms were revealed, each armed with vibroblades.

result: Battle droid generator destroyed, Robonino defeated and arrested
x: A skirmish took place on the planet Rodia in 20 BBY during the Clone Wars. After aiding in the escape of the Hutt prisoner Ziro Desilijic Tiure from Republic custody on Coruscant, the bounty hunter Robonino went into hiding from the Republic and established headquarters on Rodia.

place: Snow fields near the Sun King's palace, Forest Moon of Endor
x: The skirmish near the Sun Palace was an altercation that occurred during the Odra crisis on the Forest Moon of Endor in 3 ABY. The fight pitted four Ewoks from Bright Tree Village against a small number of Iceheads from the Snow Palace.
126 was a Confederate BX-series droid commando who held the rank of sergeant in the Separatist Droid Army and participated in the Battle of Khorm during the Clone Wars.

Hatch was a civilian YT-1300. During the Galactic Civil War it was part of heavy freighter traffic between Navigation buoys B-52 and B-53. The transport was inspected by a single TIE Defender to find equipment inside its cargo. The transport soon jumped to Hyperspace.

Hauler 10 was a cargo hauler owned by the Lant Mining Corporation. Built to transport refined ores, it was assigned to gather its cargo from the Lormar 23 station in the Mangez system. The captain of the Hauler 10 had a tendency for recklessly darting through traffic lanes.

The Resilient was a Venator-class Star Destroyer in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, it was a part of a task force led by Jedi Generals Plo Koon, Kit Fisto, and Tauht that was dispatched to the planet Khorm to secure the valuable agrocite mineral.
The Gladiator was a vessel that belonged to a slaver organization The Crucible. Commanded by the captain Dace Golliard, in 3963 BBY it intercepted a mining ship Hot Prospect in the Koornacht Cluster.

result: Data disk destroyed, retrieved by Anakin Skywalker
objective: Retrieve Separatist data disk from Confederate spies
x: This mission to Mon Gazza took place around 22 BBY, during the Clone Wars—the conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Apatros was the only colony on the Outer Rim mining world of the same name. The colony was controlled by the Outer Rim Oreworks Company, which mined cortosis on the planet, and was used to house miners.
The Fate's Hand was a Freighter-class vessel in service to the Zygerrian Captain Onyx.

objective: Destruction of the Tarkin
x: In 3 ABY, a crack team of Rebel Alliance commandos infiltrated the Tarkin, an Imperial superweapon, in an attempt to destroy the battle station from within before its construction could be completed.
The Cularin Classic was a swoop race, that was held on the planet Cularin.
At least one moon orbited the planet Vaal.

A species of creatures lived on the planet of Vaal. They were large, brown land-living quadrupeds with several horns, a partial exoskeleton, large fangs and spiked tails. It is unknown if they were carnivorous or herbivorous. They were hunted by the predatory hyenax.

The Shi'kar Straits was an asteroid belt formed after a comet hit the homeworld of the Shi'kar species, obliterating it into many pieces. It was located in the Nembus sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Vaal asteroid field consisted of several asteroid fields located in the Vaal system, intersecting the planet Vaal's orbit. In the year 0 BBY, Darth Vader's TIE Advanced x1 sustained damaged upon entering the Vaal asteroid field, causing it to crash-land on Vaal.
The Queel water dragon was an aquatic creature that inhabited in the swamps of the planet Queel. Jedi Commander Ahsoka Tano rode one such dragon during the assault on the Separatist positions.

Havoc was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer under the command of Captain Tulimus, during the Galactic Civil War. A participant in the siege of Edan II, it was destroyed by Rebel Alliance forces led by Colonel Pertarn, when they launched a frontal assault on the ship.

The Havocs were a Bothan swoop gang active in the city of Tal'cara during the Galactic Civil War. They were responsible for sacking the city on their Skybird swoops, specifically considering the area around warehouse district their territory.

Epsis was a criminal organization based in Point Nadir. It was headed by Liash Keane, a female Ubese. It specialized in crimes such as dealing in illegal technology, slicing, forgery, and "reallocations of ownership".
A Refuge Stinger was a species of creature that could be found in the Darkside sector of the planet Coruscant.

Tower Ridge was a sandy ridge on the outskirts of Mos Eisley, overlooking the nearby desert. Tower Ridge was the location of the first subspace transmission antenna set up on Tatooine, as well as one of the planet's first water storage silo.

The Battle of Montellian Serat was a battle fought at the city of Montellian Serat, on Devaron. Devaronian supporters of the anti-Imperial uprising were hunted by the Devaronian Army, led by Kardue'sai'Malloc, in the northlands of the planet.
This V-series droid supervisor was stationed at Imperial Relay Outpost V-798 on the planet Vaal, in the Gordian Reach.
Hazzard was a planet located within the Lahara sector of the Outer Rim that was the homeworld of Boo Rawl.
The Alderaan peace conference was a meeting between representatives from the Galactic Republic and reconstituted Sith Empire to discuss an end to the Great Galactic War.

A head clan was a group of Twi'leks who led their community on the planet Ryloth. Leadership was defined by the member with the shortest lifespan; when one member of the head clan died, the others were cast into the Bright Lands, thus eliminating corruption and assassinations.
The Paradise Towers' Residents Social Association was an organization that operated in the city Hedrett on the planet Cularin, during the time of the Galactic Republic.
Nuth was a city on the Outer Rim planet JanFathal. The local Regent had razed the city to the ground for supporting local rebellious activists several years prior to the Clone Wars.
Tangar was a site of CIS activity during the Clone Wars. A flotila of starships dropped out of hyperspace off Tangar, then jumped again.

The Heavy Defenders was a military unit and part of the Rodian Salvager's Cartel during the early years of the Galactic Empire. They were founded by Drexl Roosh prior to 3 BBY and operated on Raxus Prime.

The Sessal Spire was an active volcano on Keshtah Minor, a continent on the planet Kesh. During the Great Calamity following the Hundred-Year Darkness, the Dark Jedi Baron Remulus Dreypa hid several Leviathan larvae within the crater of the volcano.
A YT-2400 light freighter was used by the Rebel Alliance at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Helisk was one of three habitable worlds in the Sabrixin system.

The Hell's Axe was a modified Incom Corporation "Explorer" Scout Ship owned by Kin Laron. The Hell's Axe was extensively modified by Kin to have drastically superior sublight speed, maneuverability, hyperdrive, shields, and weapon systems from the ships stock model.
The lowest rank in Hethrir's Empire Youth school, the Helpers served as attendants and servers. They wore rust-colored robes.

The Battle of Dromund Kaas occurred on the Outer Rim planet Dromund Kaas, once the capital of the Sith Empire, during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, which lasted between 22 BBY and 19 BBY.
Kemla was a planet in the Dantus sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Nantuker was a planet in the Corsair Outback region of the Hapes Cluster. It was the source of premium Nantuker dates.
Sivoria was a planet located in the Hapes Cluster of the Inner Rim.

Killee-Kor was a small city on the planet of Socorro. It was built throughout rocky cliffs and mesas in the Killee Wasteland such as Sarlacc's Peak, where the Crimson Axe was located. It was a place of impressive underworld activity.

Heptalia was a planet located in the Heptalia system, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim. Heptalia's artisans produced furniture coverings and embroidered rugs that were considered to be exquisite and lent renown to the planet.

Graador was a Mid Rim planet that featured caverns large enough to fit entire fleets of starships in them. The caverns were home to both immense exogorths and mynocks that could survive in the planet's atmosphere.
The Graadorians were a sentient species who developed an agrarian society on their homeworld, Graador. Located in the Mid Rim, the Graadorians' planet came to share its name with the Graador sector.
Ord Dycoll was a planet located within the Ord Dycoll system of the Mid Rim that was destroyed by an ancient drill ship at some point during the Imperial Era.
The Drill ship was an ancient mining vessel that became a planet killer during the Imperial Period.
Zissh was a planet located within the Zissh system of the Expansion Region. It was a frozen world where Jedi Knight Aven Rolk planned to establish a new Jedi Temple and rebuild the Jedi Order.
Zircon was a planet located within the Zircon system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Zuggit was a planet located within the Zuggit system of the Inner Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of a twelve-foot tall, twin-headed, and magenta-skinned alien.

The Herd was a small band of Ithorian smugglers founded and led by Kikow in the years following the Battle of Naboo. Based on the planet Ralltiir, the Herd was based on the Wookiee organization, the Kalmec.
The Galactic Scout Corps was an organization affiliated with the Galactic Republic. It was one of the most respected scouting guilds in service of the Republic.
The Heritage Squad was a branch of the Human League based on Corellia. The Squad was charged with creating propaganda proving that the Human species should be the rulers of the Corellian sector.
Hermes was a Strike-class medium cruiser serving on the frontline of the Imperial Fleet.
Aelids were a race of furry ice worms native to the planet Khorm. They were known for the ability to burrow under the snow and ice. They rarely ate live prey.
The Fricasseed Nerf was a YT-1300 light freighter that was used during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
K1l-R was a personal bodyguard droid and a friend of the Geonosian named Tookra. The droid could operate in both humanoid and crab-like forms.
Cataalda was a planet in a seldom-traveled part of the Mid Rim.

The Kishpaugh spaceport was located on the planet Kishpaugh deep inside the Mid Rim Nelvana Gas Cluster. A hub of smuggling, it attracted criminals of all stripes. In 2 ABY Han Solo visited the spaceport to deliver a shipment of parts to Tookra.
Orocco was a planet located within the Orocco system of the Mid Rim.
Raltac III was a planet located within the Raltac system of the Inner Rim Territories. A band of criminals under the leadership of Grintlok had a safe house located in on the planet.
Dhoro's Sorrow was the personal starship of the criminal named
The Shattered Moon was a moniker given to the lone moon of the planet Tenupe. Red-hued, the moon had broken up into over fifty large fragments at a juncture in its history.
The Rinajaa irstat was a Tarasin tribe that lived in a village deep in the jungles of the planet Cularin.
The Zhadorii irstat was a Tarasin tribe that was governed by the Wyrd sisters. The tribe lived in a village deep in the jungles of the planet Cularin.
The Greethka was a large species of creature that lived on the planet Prakith.

Wizar II was a planet located within the Wizar system of the Wild Space. It was the homeworld of a species of squid-like sentients known as Uroths. It was a terrestrial planet, largely unknown to the outside galaxy.

The Heart of Artorias, originally Tsam P'ah, was a Yuuzhan Vong slaveship used to house captured sentients from Artorias and other planets. Nina and Kaye Galfridian, as well as Jenny and Arbeloa, were held on board.
The Battle of Quell was a conflict between the Imperial Remnant and New Republic in 13 ABY in the Quell system.

The hill people were humanoids from the planet Gala, one of three races of Galacians. Becoming a distinct race over a century before the Invasion of Naboo, the hill people were persecuted for having darker eyes than the so-called typical Galacian.
The evacuation of Rychel was a military offensive against the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong species undertaken by a joint New Republic and Jedi Order task force.

place: Busy hyperspace transit area, near the Leafar system
x: The Ambush of the Leafar occurred in 0 ABY when forces of the Galactic Empire ambushed a Leafar merchant convoy at an important transfer point near the Leafar system.
A B1 battle droid sergeant commanded three B1-series battle droids aboard the Devastation. The droid was destroyed by Ahsoka Tano and Plo Koon.
A B1 battle droid sergeant was onboard the Devastation during the attacking of the Devastation. The droid was destroyed by Mace Windu and Anakin Skywalker.
The Kessel revolts were a series of revolts that took place on Kessel during the Imperial Period.
The Invasion of Lorrd was a conflict during the early stages of the Kanz Disorders which pitted the Myrialites of the Argazdan Redoubt against the Lorrdians.
The battle on the Devastation was a battle between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Terk Street was a street in Mos Eisley's Sector 8D. In the time before the Battle of Yavin, the criminal Nok Derrick was the owner of a hovel on Terk Street.
Sector 8D was a sector in the city of Mos Eisley on Tatooine. Terk Street was located in this sector.
The Hitakans were a blue-skinned race of Humanoids found on the farming planet of Hitaka.
Hitaka fish were a species native to the planet Hitaka. These pink-scaled creatures were often served by the Hitakan people for dinner.
Parada was a Mid Rim agriworld located in the Hadar sector. It was home to the giant herbivorous herd creatures known as wombacks.
Nepoy was a Mid Rim planet in the Nepoy system, Senex sector known for its legendary fruit fields. Nectarwine and other sugary alcoholic beverages were the planets' chief exports.
Corlaasi was an astronomical object located in the Minos Cluster of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated along the Rimma Trade Route and served as a gateway to the Dravin Cut.
Swarquen was a planet in the Swarquen system. It was the homeworld of Mol Hedron.
The Wellspring was located on the moon Lamus. It was the sole place on the moon where water came to the surface; the water that emerged was warm and frothy, having passed through the moon's core.
Amar, also known as Amara, was the homeworld of the Amaran species in the Amar system.
H'ken was the primary planet in the H'ken system. Located within the H'ken asteroid belt, a 20 kilometer wide navigational nightmare, the planet was difficult to access.

result: Confederacy of Independent Systems razes an entire township
x: A battle took place on the planet Ord Mantell in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars, an inter-galactic conflict. Jedi General Ki-Adi-Mundi led Republic troops against the Confederate cyborg General Grievous and his battle droids.
The Kafiri Mountains were a mountain range on the planet Khorm, known for its treacherous passages and difficult terrain.
The Retribution was a Discril-class attack cruiser.
Seyugi were the native inhabitants of the planet of Seyugi and Recopia. A nomadic people, they traveled in the sky of the planet on huge repulsorlift barges and kept to themselves.
A battle on the planet Vonak occurred between the Cilare and the Yuuzhan Vong took place around 25 ABY, prior to the Battle of Artorias.

Vonak was a planet home to the Cilare species which subscribed to martial values and savored combat around 25 ABY. It had wide open grassy plains and was home to canine and a reptilian species which were hunted by the warriors.

The Cilare were a species of humanoids that subscribed to martial values. Around 25 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong War, their homeworld was invaded by the Yuuzhan Vong who exterminated the entire species except for Arbeloa during a one-sided engagement.
A planet was located near Void Station, and owned by the Bothan Jib Kopatha. Several asteroids orbited around it.

The Sweet Time was a modified Kuat Drive Yards space yacht used by a Jedi Coalition strike team—composed of Jedi Ben Skywalker, Leia Organa Solo, Han Solo and Jaina Solo—as their base of operations during a mission to Coruscant.
The storage floor of the Jedi Temple was located below the Temple proper and considered below "ground level" on Coruscant as it was lower than the rooftops of nearby buildings.

Stormtrooper snipers, also known as sniper troops, were specialized stormtroopers equipped with sniper rifles. Some of the troopers were specialists pulled from the ranks of scout troopers and known as Imperial sharpshooters.

The Galaxy Droid was a mysterious droid that had incredible knowledge of the galaxy. It was found by Revan after escaping the Leviathan, the droid was able to find the planet Lehon and even the Star Forge itself.

Murgoob's lair was the home of the reclusive Dulok oracle, Murgoob. The abode was constructed from a hollowed out tree stump. It had several windows and a door at its entrance. The lair was located in a swampy region near the Dulok Swamp on the Forest Moon of Endor.
Kostra was a Mid Rim astronomical object situated in the Romintine sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire attacked it, emerging victorious over Rebel Alliance forces there.

In 3964 BBY, a group of Revanchists—crusading Jedi who defied the orders of the Jedi High Council and left to join the Galactic Republic's war with the invading Mandalorian warrior clans—were ambushed on the Outer Rim planet Suurja while on a scouting mission.
Heptooine was a planet located in the south quadrant of the galaxy. During the Kymoodon Era, areas of space grew around Heptooine, as well as Aplooine, Mantooine and Sestooine.

Aplooine was an ash-covered world in the Outer Rim Territories' Grumani sector. Its surface only featured a limited number of stable landing points on mountaintops; nevertheless, the world served as one of the origin points of the spread of exploration of surrounding space dur…

Rucapar was a city on the planet Alsakan built among five equidistant mountains. From its central square, five lanes of mosaics stretched to the mountains. During the Cleansing of Rucapar during the Third Alsakan Conflict, however, the city and the mosaics were largely destroyed.

The Ark of Baron Auletphant was an interstellar barge. It was golden and was inlaid with rose and azure mytag crystals. Commissioned more than ten thousand years prior to 520 BBY, the Ark of Baron Auletphant traveled for a century between far-flung worlds.
Tomo-Reth was an astronomical object located in the Tomo-Reth system, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim.
The Caliginous Automaton of Tomo-Reth was a tall droid that, during the Kymoodon Era, sat upon a brick throne at the celestial body Tomo-Reth and breathed fire at visitors.
The Tract of Makem Te was a large graveyard located on Makem Te.
Ramoa was a planet, and the homeworld of the Ramoan species, including Bazel Warv, a Jedi Knight.
Lant was the planet in the Lant system, a star system in the Periphery, a sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Lant was a trade world with extensive Hutt holdings.
Tal Nami was a planet located in Hutt Space and was the homeworld of the Tal Nami species.
Nimia was a planet located in the Hutt Space between Klatooine and Yoribuunt. It was located near the Si'Klaata Cluster.

Dirha was a gritty industrial planet that was located within the Dirha system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlane called the Sisar Run, which connected it to the world of Cyborrea and the Sespe system.

Kafane was a poor agricultural planet that was located within the Kafane system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region. Kafane was connected to the worlds of Nimia and Ulmatra by the hyperlane called the Dead Road.

Alee was a primarily agricultural world located in the Alee system, a part of Hutt Space in the Slice. It was situated on the Ilosian Spur hyperlane, which connected it to the Tal Nami system as well as the Boz Pity system in the Mid Rim.

Mulatan was a world located in the Mulatan system, a part of the Bootana Hutta area in the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. It was connected to the Gos Hutta and Sleheyron systems by the hyperlane known as the Pabol Hutta.

Zisia was a rich planet that was located within the Zisia system in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. The planet lay on the hyperlane called the Dead Road, which connected it to the worlds of Elgit and Ulmatra.

Moralan was a Hutt Space planet that was home to the Moralans, a slave species of the Hutt Empire. During the conflict between the Hutts and the Tionese conqueror Xim twenty-five millennia before the Battle of Yavin, the forces of the latter entered the Moralan system.

Usk was a planet that was located within the Usk system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region, near The Cairns part of that region, and lay on the hyperlane called the Dead Road, which connected it to the worlds of Elgit and Saqqar.

Elgit was a minor trade world that was located within the Elgit system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlane called the Dead Road, which connected it to the planets of Zisia and Usk.

Saqqar was an icy planet that was located within the Saqqar system in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. The planet lay on the hyperlane called the Dead Road, which connected it to the worlds of Tisht and Usk.
M'Hanna was a desolate planet that was located within the M'Hanna system in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species.
Sakifwanna was a planet that was located within the Sakifwanna system in Hutt Space. The planet lay on the Elgit–M'Hanna Corridor hyperlane that connected it to the worlds of Elgit and M'Hanna.
Hosko was a verdant agricultural world located in Hutt Space on the Pabol Hutta hyperspace route, not far from Nal Hutta. It was orbited by a space station frequented by traders and smugglers.
Du Hutta was a terrestrial world located in the Du Hutta system, a part of the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. It was connected by the Ootmian Pabol hyperlane to the Irith and Y'Toub systems.

Tisht was a planet that was located within the Tisht system in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. The planet lay on the hyperlane called the Dead Road, which connected it to the worlds of M'Hanna and Saqqar.
Jilrua was a desert planet that orbited a blue giant star within the Jilrua system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region, in the immediate vicinity of the Oktos Nebula.

Diyu was a planet that was located within the Diyu system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlane called the Shag Pabol, which connected it to the Rorak system and the world of Ylesia.

Affavan was a smoggy Hutt Space gambling world that lay on the Hollastin Run hyperlane. During the Kymoodon Era, it was the site of a retaliatory attack by the Belasco Free Volunteers militia on the Utoradii clan of the Hutt species after the latter's forces attempted a raid o…

Xolu was a planet that was located within the Xolu system in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. It was connected to the worlds of Hollastin and Far Pando by the hyperlane called the Pando Spur.

Far Pando was a peaceful agrarian planet in the Far Pando system of Hutt Space. It was situated along the Pando Spur hyperlane, an offshoot of the larger Hollastin Run. The planet was under the control of the sentient Yahk-Tosh species.

Near Pando was an emerging trade world that was located within the Near Pando system in Hutt Space, a region of the galaxy controlled by the Hutt species. The planet lay on the hyperlane called the Pando Spur that connected it to the world of Far Pando.

Carnovia was a humid waterworld located in the Carnovia system, a part of the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. The Kaaga Run hyperlane linked it to the Circumtore and Nar Kaaga systems. The depths of Carnovia were inhabited by gigantic creatures known as the Carnovian eels.

Ooo-temiuk was a forested world located in the Ooo-temiuk system, a part of the Arkanis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the Triellus Trade Route hyperlane, which linked it to the C-Foroon and Tatoo systems.
Gannaria was a terrestrial planet located in the Gannaria system of the Trilon sector, a part of the Outer Rim Territories.
Paqwepor was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Mid Rim.

Rorak 4 was an industrial planet that was located within the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlanes called the Gamor Run and the Shag Pabol. Rorak 4 was orbited by the Rorak 5 space station and was the site of the largest slave market in the Hutt Space.

Ness was a terrestrial planet in the Dagobah system of the Sluis sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Along with the rest of the star system, the planet lay on the hyperlane known as the Rimma Trade Route, and it occupied the first orbital position around the star Darlo.

Auren was a moon of Ingo, located within the Ingo system of the Mid Rim. It was home to a facility operated by the Fromm Gang, a crime family headquartered on the planet Annoo. The multi-level facility was involved in mining, research, and other activities.

Listehol was an astronomical object located in the Listehol system in the Kwymar sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Located on the Hydian Way, it was the head of the Listehol Run hyperspace route which linked it to Mirial.
Loedorvia was a celestial body located in the Core Worlds' Weemell sector. During the Clone Wars, it was the site of a battle between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Steelious was a Core Worlds planet that was located near the world Yarrv. The Hervack Spaceport on Steelious served as an important port for Rebel Alliance smuggling.

Eamus 6 was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Eamus system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. It had at least one sun, and occupied the sixth orbital position within the system.
Lujo was a planet in the Core. It had a temperate climate, and was home to magnificent oceans and landscapes.
Shumogi was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Shumogi system. It was a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds.
Goorla was a planet in the Goorla system of the Corellian sector in the Core Worlds. It was the source of the Goorlish light source.
Xorth was a agriworld located within the Xorth system of the Core Worlds.
Palawa was a planet in the Core Worlds. It was the planet of origin of two mystic Force traditions, the Followers of Palawa and the Chatos Academy.

The Guild of Non-Human Skilled Laborers was a labor guild that was formed by the Herglic Kijo Mnuue, to oppose the way that the Galactic Empire tried to marginalize non-Human workers at the Tallaani Shipyards. Mnuue was appointed to be the President of the guild.

The Corellian Shipbuilders Union operated during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Jadam Questrel was the Union's official representative in Doaba Guerfel on Corellia, and the head of the Guild of Non-Human Skilled Laborers, the Herglic Kijo Mnuue, had some contacts within t…
MdZ-BLK, nicknamed Blockhead, was a MdZ series droid.
The Seville Family, also known as the Seville pirate clan, was a pirate clan that operated during the Galactic Civil War.
The Wanderer was a modified Action VI bulk transport, that was owned by the Devaronian Lavek Talstin.
Candoria was a depopulated planet located in the Colonies region of the galaxy.
Faro was a planet in the Faro system within the Colonies region of the galaxy.

result: Whereabouts of new CIS weapon stolen by Cad Bane discovered
x: The battle of Juma 9 took place around 22 BBY during the Clone Wars on the space station Juma 9. The Skakoan scientist Kul Teska led CIS battles droids on an attack on the station.

Rietta was a gas giant and the fifth planet in the Mustafar system.

Wetyin's Colony was a planet located within the Wetyin's Colony system of the Gordian Reach in the Outer Rim Territories region of the galaxy. A dry agriworld, it was settled by colonists from Setor around 10 BBY and was later largely abandoned.
Voorsbain was a Mid Rim industrial planet situated in the Tangles area of the Senex sector. It was under the control of the aristocratic House Picutorion.
Volgax was a planet located within the Volgax system of the Core Worlds.
The Scourge was a gang of pirates who operated in the outlying unpoliced areas of the Mid Rim and the Elrood sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Zero Command was a splinter faction of the Galactic Empire in the Deep Core that was formed by Admiral Blitzer Harrsk.

Usnia was a forested planet located in the Usnia system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It was also situated close to the Tangles, an area of intersecting hyperlanes.

The Greater Maldrood was a splinter faction of the Galactic Empire, led by Admiral Treuten Teradoc, which controlled a part of the Mid Rim after breaking away from the Empire following the battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
The Eriadu Authority was a remnant of the Galactic Empire that was centered on the planet Eriadu and the Seswenna sector in the galaxy's Outer Rim.
During the Clone Wars, an Amani tribe was located on the planet Maridun. The Amani were hostile toward the Lurmen settlers led by Tee Watt Kaa.
Prentioch's Dominion was an Imperial Warlord faction that was established by Moff Utoxx Prentioch shortly after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
During the Clone Wars, this skirmish took place on planet Maridun between a local tribe of Amanin and a group of Lurmen refugees from the planet Mygeeto.
Velanaria was a planet located within the Velanaria system of the Outer Rim Territories.

result: Multiple vessels stolen from Alliance shipyards during the battle as A
x: The Battle of Death Star III was a space battle fought a few months after the Battle of Endor. During the battle, the Alliance of Free Planets' Red Squadron attacked a Death Star-like space station near Endor.

Imperial Intelligence was the primary intelligence organization that served the Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War. The largest organization under the Ministry of Intelligence, Imperial Intelligence answered directly to the Minister of Intelligence.
Valorsi was a planet located within the Valorsi system of the Juvex sector in the Mid Rim. Its native inhabitants, who came from many species, were known as Valorsians.

Uhltenden was a planet located within the Thrasybule sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Surrounded by a debris ring from many wrecked starships, the planet had an atmosphere toxic to life, and no natural life resided on the planet.
Tuerto was a planet located within the Tuerto system of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Fast Death was a Nargi-class pursuit frigate used by the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances in 43 ABY.
The Quick End was a Nargi-class pursuit frigate used by the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances in 43 ABY.

result: Mace Windu received several Hurrikaine crystals
objective: For Mace Windu to obtain a lightsaber crystal
x: In approximately 58 BBY, Jedi Padawan Mace Windu embarked on a mission to the Wild Space planet Hurikane. The Padawan had been assigned the mission by the Jedi Council so that he could obtain the unique crystals he desired to build his lightsaber.

Hope was the name of a scoutship used by Freia Kallea in her search for a route that would span the entire galaxy, which later became the Hydian Way. In 3701 BBY, the Hope was disabled and crash-landed on the remote world of Nuvar, where Kallea remained for six years.

Nuvar was a jungle planet in the Mid Rim near the modern Hydian Way. In 3701 BBY, Freia Kallea's scoutship Hope crash-landed on uncharted Nuvar after it was crippled by the Neimoidians Thoax and Farge Osaax, leaving her stranded for six standard years.
Trinovat was a sunny, verdant world located in the Trinovat system. It was situated in the Loop Worlds area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Tregillis was a planet located within the Tregillis system of the Expansion Region.
Amber Star was a Corellian corvette that was the former flagship for Zan Dane's pirate fleet.
The Sweet Victory was a Marauder-class corvette that was captured by Zan Dane. He used it as the flagship for his pirate fleet.

place: Sixteen planets in the Gordian Reach
x: The secession of 400100500260026 that occurred in 3946 BBY was the successful attempt of several G0-T0 droids to become the dictators of 16 planets in the Gordian Reach, creating the region known as 400100500260026.
The Ambush on Tatooine was a confrontation that took place between the former Dark Lord of the Sith and redeemed Jedi Padawan Revan and the bounty hunter Calo Nord.

Trasemene was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Phelleem sector. A part of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, in 19 BBY it saw a battle where the navy of the Galactic Empire defeated that of the Separatist holdout led by Toonbuck…

Agomar was a planet in the Agomar system of the Seswenna sector. During the Battle of Agomar, the Confederacy of Independent Systems pitted its Droid Army against the Grand Army of the Republic, with the world eventually falling back onto Republic control.
Tierell was a planet located in the Tierell system within the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Toskhowwl VI was a planet located within the Toskhowwl system of the Mid Rim. Around 5 ABY, the Jaltiri tribals lived on Toskhowwl VI and were known beyond their world for their custom of building stacks of severed heads.
The Rock Rogues was a pirate group that operated during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

The Kilandran Royal Forces was a military order that operated during the time of the Galactic Republic. In about 700 BBY, it merged with a number of other military orders, to form the Iotran Police Force, a military force that was based on Iotra.

The Lurathi Guard was a military order that operated during the time of the Galactic Republic. In about 700 BBY, it merged with a number of other military orders, to form the Iotran Police Force, a military force that was based on Iotra.

The Jengardin Millennial Warriors were a military order that operated during the time of the Galactic Republic. They were the developers of the Jengardin double-bladed vibroblade, and never waged war on their homeworld.
The Red Lancer was a Corsair-class cruiser that was used by the pirate organization Dharus' Buccaneers during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The Dark Revenge was a DP20 gunship that served as the command vessel for the privateer Dharus during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Breakout Squad was a clone trooper unit and part of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Initially, most of its members were shinies brought together under the command of the veteran Clone Captain Lock.
Gree Baaker was a planet in the Gree Baaker system of the Outer Rim's Atrivis sector. Under the Galactic Empire, it was home to the Gree Baaker Labor Camp.
This featureless ovoid craft was used by the cyborg bounty hunter D'harhan. No bigger than a TIE fighter, it looked similar to an egg and trailed a metallic seine behind it.
The Thicket was the debris field surrounding the planet Iego that contained the LaserWeb Defense Station left by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
