Kynachi was a remote Wild Space planet and the base of KynachTech Industries. In 32 BBY, the world was seized by the Trade Federation, and the Skakoan Overseer Umbrag took over the KynachTech factory, also imposing a frequency jammer on the world.

"Cleaver" was a rebuilt 2JTJ personal navigation droid serving the Galactic Republic unit "Breakout Squad." Originally known as "Teejay," the droid was destroyed during the Mission to Kynachi and was rebuilt with parts from BX-series droid commandos by Breaker (CT-8863), a clo…
Outer Zznza was a location in the Zznza system, a part of the Yminis sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

A mission to the Thicket took place in 20 BBY during the Clone Wars. After helping to liberate the Hutt prisoner Ziro Desilijic Tiure from Republic custody on Coruscant, the sentinel droid-turned-bounty hunter HELIOS-3D became based in the Thicket, a patch of space over Iego t…
H2-1B4, also known as Aitchtoo-Onebeefore, was a domodroid belonging to Scarlet Bloodhawk.
The Gargantelles were a species of six-armed giants that inhabited Boz Pity until their extermination at the beginning of the Ductavis Era.

Coccia was a terrestrial planet, located in the Felucia system of the Thanium sector, part of the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Coccia occupied the first orbital position around the star Felix and had one moon.

Brembo was a terrestrial planet whose surface consisted of volcanic rock. It was located in the Thanium sector's Felucia system, found in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Brembo occupied the second orbital position around the star Felix and had no moons.
Albata Ing was a terrestrial world located in the third position of the Felucia system, a star system located in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium sector.

Farasu was a gas giant located in the Felucia system, which in turn was found in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium sector. During the Clone Wars, this area of space was contested over by the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Yamime was a gas giant located in the Felucia system, which in turn was found in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium sector. During the Clone Wars, this area of space was contested over by the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Tsutai was a gas giant located in the Felucia system in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium sector. During the Clone Wars, this area of space was contested over by the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Imei was an ice world, located in the Felucia system, which in turn was found in the Outer Rim Territories' Thanium sector. During the Clone Wars, this area of space was contested over by the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Hasty Harpy was a YT-1760 starship owned by Lalo Gunn during the Clone Wars. It was grounded on Kynachi in 22 BBY by the Trade Federation along with all other ships on the planet, causing Gunn to be stranded there.
Byrsym was a planet that was located in the Mid Rim Territories.
The Faruun were an extra-galactic sentient species of ship-builders from Firefist, a satellite galaxy of the galaxy.
Vinza was a hothouse world located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It had no moons and was located in Separatist space during the Clone Wars.
Fahariyn was a gas giant occupying the first orbital position in the Ansion system, which was located in the Churnis sector in the Mid Rim. It had three moons.

Gaulix was a planet in the Ansion system, which was located in the Mid Rim's Churnis sector. Gaulix occupied the second position in orbit of the star Ansion, and had one moon. Its atmosphere was a broiling toxic soup, rendering it uninhabitable.

Soltan was a planet in the Ansion system, which was located in the Mid Rim's Churnis sector. A ball of barren rock, it was in an area of space aligned with the Galactic Republic, and later the Galactic Empire.
Trauchta was a gas giant in the fifth position of the Ansion system, which was located in the Mid Rim's Churnis sector. It had six moons.
Sulomu was an ice planet in the Ansion system, which was located in the Mid Rim's Churnis sector. Its atmosphere was freezing, rendering it uninhabitable.
Cono was the innermost planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. Cono had no moons, and its surface was covered with scorched rocks.
Fala was the second planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. Fala had one moon, and its surface was covered with volcanic rocks.
Halco was the third planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. It had two moons and, along with Bestine IV, was one of the two terrestrial worlds in the star system.
Burcana was the fifth planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. It had four moons and its surface was frozen.
Spussion was the sixth planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. Spussion was one of the three gas giants in the star system and had twenty-one moons.
Hyomare was the seventh planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. Hyomare was one of the three gas giants in the star system and had ten moons.
Rubler was the eighth and outermost planet of the Bestine system located in the Inner Rim Territories. Rubler was one of the three gas giants in the star system and had twenty-nine moons.
Erodsis was a gas giant located in the Outer Rim's Savareen sector in the Christoph system.
The Barren was an asteroid belt that ringed the star Christoph in the Savareen sector in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Hammers was an asteroid belt located in the Savareen sector between Christophsis and Erodsis.
The Halo was an asteroid belt located in the Savareen sector beyond the gas giant Erodsis.

Cessed was the planet closest to the sun in the Csilla system, which was located within Chiss Space in the Unknown Regions. It was uninhabited due to the searing hot temperatures emanating from the sun.

Repplic was a gas giant that orbited the star Csilla in the Csilla system. Repplic occupied the third orbital position and had twenty-two moons. The gas giant was located in Chiss Space, a sector of the Unknown Regions controlled by the Chiss Ascendancy.
Csorb was a planet in the Csilla system, which was located in Chiss Space in the Unknown Regions.
Formac was a planet in the Csilla system, which was located in Chiss Space in the Unknown Regions.

result: Initial Imperial conquest; eventual Rebel victory
x: The Battle of Kashoon occurred during the Galactic Civil War. It began with the Galactic Empire invading the planet Kashoon.
Undar was an airless terrestrial planet in the Dagobah system, located in the Outer Rim Territories' Sluis sector. It occupied the third orbital position around the star Darlo and had two moons.

Sty was a gas giant in the Dagobah system of the Outer Rim Territories' Sluis sector. Along with the rest of the star system, it lay on the hyperlane known as the Rimma Trade Route. The planet occupied the fifth orbital position around the star Darlo and had fifty-five moons.
Bubbok was a terrestrial planet in the Dagobah system, located in the Outer Rim Territories' Sluis sector. It had three moons and occupied the fourth orbital position around the star Darlo.
Doma was a scorched planet in the Dantooine system, located in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim.
Camillo was a hothouse planet with a toxic atmosphere, located in the Dantooine system, which in turn was found within the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim.

Camooine was a terrestrial planet with three moons that occupied the third orbital position around the star Dina. It was located in the Dantooine system, a part of the Raioballo sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Bannakon was a gas giant in the Dantooine system, located in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim.
Tamarena was a gas giant in the Dantooine system, located in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim.
Dulbris was a gas giant in the Dantooine system, located in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim.
Purnell was a gas giant in the Dantooine system, located in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim.

In the early years of the New Sith Wars, this battle was held between the Jedi Order and the Brotherhood of Darkness. One of the combatants was Jedi Master Pernicar, who during the heat of battle spotted his former Padawan, Wud Mortull, fighting for the opposite side.
A canakal bird was a species of bird that lived on the remote planet of Kesh.

Hynah was an industrial world located in the Kalamith sector of the Outer Rim Territories, on the Hydian Way hyperlane. It was home to the Hynese, a cosmopolitan population of various different species.
Perma was a planet in the galaxy's Core Worlds.

The Imperial Correction Service, also known as the Imperial Correctional Facilities Ministry, was an organization that served the Galactic Empire to supervise and correct imperfections in certain Imperial regions.
The ice dragons of Toloran were noted for their ferocity and size.
Ice Storm was an Imperial snowtrooper unit, an elite formation within the Stormtrooper Corps specializing in cold-weather operations.
Little Kessel was a planet located in the Kessel sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Hinakuu was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Hinakuu system, a part of the Calamari sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Tidal Circuit connected it to the Krinemonen and Sanctuary systems.

t: Duel between Marka Ragnos and Simus
result: Marka Ragnos takes control of the Sith Empire
x: In approximately 5100 BBY, a duel was fought between the Sith Lords Marka Ragnos and Simus, who had been competing in a power struggle for the title of Dark Lord of the Sith Empire since 5200 BBY. Simus challenged Ragnos but was beheaded by his opponent during the duel.
Zyluria was a world located in the Zyluria system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane linked it to the Carsanza system.
The Fourth Nantama Synod was a meeting that was held on the world of Nantama during the time of the Galactic Republic.

Dioll was a rocky planet located in the Dioll system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Kassido Bypass hyperlane linked it to the Kardura and Thermon systems.

Alessia was the moon of the planet Tarsa, that was located in the Mid Rim. During the time of the Galactic Empire, it was the site of a large Imperial base. It was presumably the homeworld of the Alessian terror moth, a species of creature that lived on Tarsa.

A conflict, occurring in 3 ABY on the Forest Moon of Endor, was between the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village and the Phlogs of the surrounding area. It was the second time the the Phlogs had attacked Bright Tree Village.

The Rodian Junk Cartel was a criminal group of Rodians that operated in the galaxy. Following the destruction of the Death Star, the Galactic Empire levied mandatory tithing against the Rodian Junk Cartel.
Faliar was a terrestrial planet in the Fondor system, located in the Freeworlds Territory portion of the Tapani sector, within the Southern Core portion of the Colonies.

Fondor Belt I was the first asteroid belt located in the Fondor system in the Freeworlds Territory portion of the Tapani sector, within the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. It occupied the second orbital position around the star Fondor.
Fondor Belt II was an asteroid belt in the Fondor system, located in the Freeworlds Territory portion of the Tapani sector, within the Southern Core portion of the Colonies.

Fondor Belt III was an asteroid belt located in the Fondor system in the Freeworlds Territory portion of the Tapani sector, within the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. The asteroid belt occupied the fifth orbital position around the star Fondor.

Mzeh was a gas giant located in the Fondor system in the Freeworlds Territory portion of the Tapani sector, within the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. The planet occupied the sixth orbital position around the star Fondor and had eleven moons.
Fondor Belt IV was an asteroid belt in the Fondor system, located in the Freeworlds Territory portion of the Tapani sector within the Southern Core portion of the Colonies.

Ulklub was a hot rock planet with no moons that occupied the closest orbital position to the star Opoku. It was located within the Opoku system, a part of the Galov sector within the galactic regions known as the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice.

Ag'gor was a hothouse planet with no moons that occupied the second closest orbital position to the star Opoku. It was located within the Opoku system, a part of the Galov sector within the galactic regions known as the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice.

Opyol was a terrestrial planet located in the Opoku system, located in the Galov sector as part of the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the fourth orbital position around the star Opoku and had a single moon.

Lok Trul was a gas giant planet located in the Opoku system, a part of the Galov sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the fifth orbital position around the star Opoku and had thirteen moons.
Tunyok was a frozen planet located in the Opoku system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Olaris, also known as Olaris Reclamation Base, was a city on the ruined planet of Taris during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

objective: Uncover pirate activities
x: The Mission to Tatooine was an operation assigned by Morrigan Corde to her daughter, Gunn Yage, with a task to uncover pirate activities in the Arkanis sector. After arriving on Tatooine, Yage reported to local authorities, represented by Moff Nieve Gromia.

The Battle of Centares was a conflict during the Clone Wars. Early during the conflict, the Republic Twelfth Army moved its forces from Lantillies to Centares. Jedi Master Shaak Ti was later commended by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine for her actions on the planet.
Partainu was the fifth planet orbiting the star of Deel in the Neimoidia system. Located in the Colonies, it was a gas giant.
Moonan was the second planet orbiting the star of Nen in the Neimoidia system. Located in the Colonies, it was a toxic rock.

Saak Sooin was the single asteroid belt of the Neimoidia system. Located in the Colonies, it was set into the fourth orbital position around the star Nen. It had valuable minerals under its surface found by miners in 13 BBY.

Bright Sun was a SoroSuub StarTripper space yacht. In 43.5 ABY, Sith apprentice Vestara Khai used this ship, then named She's a Chancer, to escape from Luke and Ben Skywalker after her duel with Luke on Sinkhole Station.
The Envoy was a transport ship serving the Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Chafflock was a location on the planet Rhamsis Callo that was the site of the Rhamsis Callo Spaceport.
The Kynachi were the native species of the planet Kynachi in the Wild Space. The Kynachi were generally distinguished by their golden hair.
Tekurr'k was a planet located within the Tekurr'k system of the Mid Rim's Senex sector.

The homeworld of the Sibilaari species was located in the Sibilaar system of the Bozhnee sector in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was destroyed by a cataclysm, and the native Sibilaari survived by creating hardened shelters on the most stable parts of the planet's crust.
Hultomo was the second planet of the Garnib system. It was an ice world, orbited by two moons.

The attack on Belsavis was a small assault on the Plawal Rift region of the planet Belsavis in 18 BBY. The Plawal Rift was the location of a small enclave of Jedi refugees, mainly children, looked after by the Ho'Din Jedi Master Plett in the wake of Order 66.

Monnoks were a biped species that was feared by many, including the desert nomads of Socorro. Considered to be sentient yet semi-intelligent, these creatures looked primitive, used spears, and were excellent hunters on their homeworld of Socorro, where they lived on the black …

The Imperial Diplomatic Service was an organization that served the Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War. The Imperial Diplomatic Service answered directly to the head of the Sphere of Expansion and Diplomacy.

8th Division was a military unit within the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War elements of the 8th division were stationed on Corellia to defend the Jedi enclave on the planet.
The 419th Infantry was a military unit within the Galactic Empire, stationed on Talus during the Galactic Civil War.

x: Jike was a hot rock planet with no moons that occupied the closest orbital position to the star Asar. It was located within the Ilum system, a part of the 7G sector that was situated within the galaxy's Unknown Regions.
Bory was an airless rock planet with no moons that occupied the second closest orbital position to the star Asar. It was located within the Ilum system, a part of the Unknown Regions' 7G sector.
Cala was an airless rock planet with no moons that occupied the third closest orbital position to the star Asar. It was located within the Ilum system, a part of the Unknown Regions' 7G sector.
Kess Bela was an asteroid belt located between the planets Cala and Ilum in the Ilum system in the Unknown Regions.
Trop was a gas giant–type planet with eleven moons that occupied the sixth orbital position around the star Asar. It was located within the Ilum system, a part of the Unknown Regions' 7G sector.
Eton was a gas giant–type planet with forty-one moons that occupied the seventh orbital position around the star Asar. It was located within the Ilum system, a part of the Unknown Regions' 7G sector.
Fern was a gas giant–type planet with twenty moons that occupied the eighth orbital position around the star Asar. It was located within the Ilum system, a part of the Unknown Regions' 7G sector.
Imrooso was a volcanic rock in the Ottega system in the Mid Rim.
Torgazi was a toxic hothouse in the Ottega system in the Mid Rim.
Shihor was a gas giant in the Ottega system in the Mid Rim.
Gyo was a gas giant in the Ottega system in the Mid Rim.
Harugi Spill was an asteroid belt in the Ottega system in the Mid Rim.
Remsh was the sixth planet orbiting the star Iminec in the Kalee system. It was a gas giant, located in Wild Space.
Elke was the seventh planet orbiting the star Iminec in the Kalee system. Located in Wild Space, it was a frozen rock.
Tovarskl was a terrestrial planet in Wild Space and a colony world of the Yam'rii.
This B2-HA super battle droid was part of Nashtah Team under the command of the bounty hunter Aurra Sing during Cad Bane's attack on the Temple of Eedit on Devaron.
During the Mandalorian Wars, sometime before 3964 BBY, the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders attacked the planet Quelii and inflicted heavy casualties on the civilian population.
Jurzan was a planet in the Expansion Region, on the Harrin Trade Corridor.
Mek va Uil was a planet in the Expansion Region. The Regent of Mek va Uil was from this world.

HELIOS-3D's droid army was a short-lived rogue battle droid army established by HELIOS-3D during the Clone Wars. Consisting of various battle droids and droid starfighters, the army battled a Galactic Republic task force in the Thicket of Iego, where it was mostly exterminated.
The Black Talon was a Gage-class transport in service with the Sith Empire during the Cold War. It was captained by Revinal Orzik.
Anzat One was a transport vessel, employed by the Anzati couple Sint and Nakia Yoru, both assassins working for the Houk Lun Rask, a Vigo of the criminal organization Black Sun.

A battle was fought during the Mandalorian Wars on Nouane, capital world of the eponymous mini-empire Nouane. In 3963 BBY, the Mandalorians launched a Coreward assault from Mandalorian space into the Galactic Republic.
A battle took place on the planet Selonia in the year 22 BBY during the Clone Wars. The Confederacy of Independent Systems was able to defeat the forces of the Galactic Republic and win the battle.
A battle took place on the planet Carida in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars. The Confederacy of Independent Systems won a victory over the Galactic Republic in the battle.
A battle took place on the planet Garos IV in the first year of the Clone Wars. The Confederacy of Independent Systems was victorious over the forces of the Galactic Republic in the fight.

objective: Investigate a rumor of trouble
x: A mission was undertaken by Jedi General Ki-Adi-Mundi of the Jedi Order in 22 BBY during the time of the Clone Wars to investigate a rumor of trouble near the planet Barab I, at the edge of the civilized galaxy.

A battle took place during the first year of the Clone Wars on the planet Korriban. Jedi Master Eeth Koth led a detachment of clone troopers to defend the besieged people of Korriban, but his troops suffered numerous casualties against their enemy.

A battle took place during the first year of the Clone Wars when the Confederacy of Independent Systems mounted an effort to capture the planet Lanos from the Galactic Republic, sending battle droid detachments to fight there.
Waste was a 2-1B surgical droid stationed onboard the Imperial prison barge Purge during the year 1 BBY.
The Vector was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy in service prior to the Battle of Yavin.

A peacekeeping mission on Ryloth was carried out by the Galactic Empire to the planet Ryloth in approximately 1 BBY. A group of Rebel Alliance forces ambushed a squad of Imperial stormtroopers, including TK329.
Sarlucif was a planet in Wild Space and home to the outlaw tech base run by Klaus Vandangante and his daughter, Jessa.

Resdin was a city located on the planet of Ryloth. During the Clone Wars it was ravaged by Separatist forces to make a point to the planet's capital, Lessu, which then surrendered without firing a shot.
The Sleight of Hand was a modified Telgorn dropship used by Cad Bane during the Clone Wars as a go-to craft for delivering precious cargo, both living and otherwise.
The Battle of Behpour took place during the Clone Wars on the planet Behpour in the Mid Rim Naboo system.

The Mission to Alzoc III was a mission to the planet Alzoc III given to Luminara Unduli and Aayla Secura during the Clone Wars. The Separatist leader Count Dooku had set up a trap for the Republic forces with his assassin Asajj Ventress.
The Resistance was a guerrilla group which battled the Yuuzhan Vong after they invaded Garqi. Rade Dromath was the group's leader.
The Font of Power was a nexus of dark side Force energy located on Abeloth's planet inside Abeloth's cave.

Feena was a world located in the Feena system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector, within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Iggy was a IG-97 assassin droid who rose to prominence on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. Working with Big Gizz, Spiker, Onoh, and Klepti B'ay, the group was able to destroy a rogue dark trooper.

Transport 22 was the designation for a StarSpeeder 3000 craft owned by the Star Tours travel agency. C-3PO and R2-D2 performed maintenance and repairs on this vessel while working at the travel agency months after the Battle of Endor.
Livien was a planet located within the Outer Rim Territories and the founding world of the Livien League.

result: X2 is granted the title of Jedi Master
x: A battle occurred on Mustafar between the forces of the New Republic and the X1 faction. The clone trooper-turned Jedi Knight X2 led soldiers against his brother, the Sith Lord X1 to destroy his laboratory of insane clones.
Ranroon was a planet located within the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was particularly known for its legendary Queen Indrexu.
Thanium was a planet located within the Thanium system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was absorbed into Xim's Empire as he expanded his borders from the Kingdom of Cron.

Ilos was a bland agricultural world dotted with cities. It was located within the Ilos system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlane called the Pabol Sleheyron, which connected it to the planets of Chalacta and Ilos Minor.
Xantar was a planet located within the Xantar system of the Outer Rim Territories' Corva sector.
These inhabitants were a gray-skinned sentient species native to the planet Xantar. Luke Skywalker visited Xantar as a guest of a "Bug-Eyes," a pilot from this species.

The unidentified Xantar starship was a saucer-like starship operated by a "Bug-Eyes" who brought Luke Skywalker to his home planet of Xantar. Some time earlier, the pilot brought the starship to the homeworld of Indiana Jones, then brought Jones back to Xantar.
The Sundering of Slession was a conflict that occurred in the vicinity of the Inner Rim's Slession system and was fought at some point between 19 BBY and 0 BBY.
The Battle of Tirahnn was a battle that was fought on the planet Tirahnn during the Clone Wars.

The Imperial Commando Special Unit was a special forces division of elite operatives of the Galactic Empire. First formed from the Republic Grand Army's Special Operations Brigade during the Clone Wars.
Aurek Squad was a clone commando squad that participated in the Clone Wars.
The Solidarity was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that was used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
The Dissection droid was a droid in the service of the extra-galactic Abominor known as the Great Heep.

The Aximia River was a river on the planet Talus. It flowed through Lake Thorn and met with other rivers at the Deep Run confluence. Notable portions of the Aximia River included the the Overlook and the Kima Way.
A duel occurred in 5000 BBY, in the wreckage of the Omen, a Sith dreadnaught that crash-landed on the uncharted planet of Kesh during the Great Hyperspace War.
The Battle of Vjun was an operation carried out by the New Republic against the forces of X1 during the Galactic Civil War.

result: Most members of Grey Squadron are killed
The New Republic learns X1's new HQ is on Mustafar
objective: To find X1
x: The Mission to Dathomir was an operation carried out during the Galactic Civil War.

conflict: Imperial Period conflicts / Great Jedi Purge
x: The Battle of Dantooine occurred during the Imperial Period when an Imperial strike force attempted to find and kill Falon Grey, who was hiding on the planet. The clone X1 spearheaded the assault, but X2 joined the rebels inside, taking a different path from his brother.
This battle occurred on the planet Giju during the Clone Wars. Separatist forces invaded the planet and a regiment of clone troopers led by the Jedi Knight Sha Koon were sent to take back the planet.

place: Tatooine training grounds and space over Tatooine
x: The Invasion of Tatooine was a battle that took place on the planet Tatooine in 19 BBY during the Clone Wars. Before attacking the planet, the Confederacy of Independent Systems used a drone ship to deploy a reconnaissance patrol consisting of probe droids on the surface.

objective: To rescue Rebels
x: The Mission to Geonosis was a mission suggested by Rahm Kota to rescue a squad of rebels.

result: Sajar turned to the light side
x: During the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, Jedi Master Tol Braga corresponded regularly with various Sith Lords as he sought a way to bring the conflict to a peaceful close.
The Majestic was a Venator-class Star Destroyer in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.

affiliation: Office of the Chief of State
x: The Alliance Marshals were law enforcement officers serving the Galactic Alliance in the years following the Second Galactic Civil War. Marshals carried circular shields along with an identification folder and were given a great deal of authority.
The Hiitite Ravagers were a group of pirates that once threatened Trianii Space, but were beaten back by the efforts of the Trianii Rangers.
The Ryoone campaign was a month-long string of engagements fought on Ryoone during the Galactic Civil War.

A battle occurred on the planet Herdessa in 22 BBY six days after the First Battle of Geonosis, the first battle of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Battle of Daalang was a battle of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Jabiimi Military was the military force of the Jabiimi people. It originally consisted of a ground army and small stellar navy to protect Jabiim from a group of Trandoshan raiders seeking to steal ore.

t: Duel in the Jedi Temple Underlevels
x: In 19 BBY, a duel took place between Sith Lord Darth Vader and Jedi Knight Sha Koon, in the Coruscant Underlevels beneath the Jedi Temple.

objective: To find out what was causing all of the disappearances on Alashan
x: A second mission to Alashan was assigned to Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa, Mici Shabandar and the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

A diplomatic mission to Dathomir was undertaken by the Jedi Knight Rachi Sitra sometime after the battle of Talus. However, the mission was foiled, because when Sitra's shuttle jumped into Dathomir space, it was ambushed by Boba Fett's Slave I.
Needle beasts were creatures native to Dithanune.

Ilos Minor was a planet that was located within the Ilos Minor system of the galaxy's Hutt Space region and lay on the hyperlane called the Pabol Sleheyron, which connected it to the planets of Ilos and Nar Kreeta.
Delta Flight was a squadron in the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps paired with Echo Flight. Essara Till was once the flight instructor for the unit.
DX-2K2 was an ancient war droid used by ISB agent Govin Thane in his attempt to stop a group of Rebel agents on Cloud City.

UP-S2, also known as Yupee-Estoo, was a hyperspace-capable courier droid used by Reekeene's Roughnecks. UP-S2 had a supercilious personality, and was assigned to assist Green squad in monitoring communications from the Imperial Communications Center on the planet Iyuta.
The Imperial Resource Procurement Bureau, or ReProBu, was a department of the Galactic Empire. The bureau was tasked with discovering and overseeing the production of of raw materials for the Empire.

An Imperial Agent was an occupation held by operatives of the Sith Empire during the time of the Great Galactic War and the following Cold War. Some of the Agents were actually Chiss members of the Empire's ally, the Chiss Ascendancy.

Fradian was an ore terminal planet located in the Mid Rim. It was an industrial place that looked like it was designed by an architect who wanted to lose his job. Former Jedi Bardan Jusik thought the place was ugly.
The human replica droid known as Stanton Rendar was a recreation of a deceased Human male of the same name.
A nest-guild was a social grouping among the felinoid Schenor species. Each nest-guild was led by a nest-guildmaster, and included nest-warriors.

Meglumine, originally known as Ord Meglumine, was a planet in the Meglumine system of the Inner Rim. An Ordnance/Regional Depot, Ord Meglumine was used by the Pius Dea-controlled Galactic Republic as a staging point for their assault on Iridonia during the Great Northern Crusa…
Osadia was a planet located within the Core Worlds. Its location was kept secret and removed off the star-charts so that the mysterious school that was located there could not be disturbed.

objective: Capture Antarian Ranger Jilam Kester
x: The Mission to Celen was an Galactic Empire operation during the Great Jedi Purge to capture the Antarian Ranger Jilam Kester, who was charged with aiding refugee Jedi escape capture by the Empire, three weeks after the formation of the Galactic Empire.

Neree was a celestial body located in the Neree system, a part of the Suolriep sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Human Rebel Alliance intelligence agent Lesle Andreya was born at Neree around 21 BBY.
New Cylimba was a planet within a star system in the D'Aelgoth sector of the Mid Rim region of the galaxy. It was situated on the Veron Route, which connected it to Veron.
Namore was a planet located in the Namore system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Colonies. Gerom was an official on the planet who held the title of Prefect.
As a test of his recently completed training, Sith Lord Darth Maul was sent by his Master, Darth Sidious, on a mission to Ralltiir to exterminate the leadership of the Black Sun criminal syndicate.

The gaunt was a bovine creature native to the planet Byss. The meat, hides, milk, and bones of the gaunt were used to provide many of the needs of the various Abyssin tribes who kept flocks of the creatures and herded them from oasis to oasis across the deserts of their homewo…

Nopsin was a planet located in the Nopsin system, a part of the freestanding subsectors portion of the Mid Rim. At one point by approximately 3642 BBY, the reconstituted Sith Empire carried out the operation known as the Cleansing of Nopsin there.
Norclune was located in the Norclune system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies.
Distant Wind was a modified XS-800 light freighter from Corellian Engineering Corporation. It was owned by Sullustan gamester Cunbus Locb.

Nurstin was rocky and gas-covered. It was the third planet of the Bissillirus system which was located in the Trax sector. A number of mining colonies were established by Messert Mines Corporation around the planet during the last century of the Galactic Republic.

t: Third battle of the Seswenna sector
x: In 3671 BBY, during the Great Galactic War between the Old Republic and reconstituted Sith Empire, the Seswenna sector in the Outer Rim Territories was attacked and seized by Sith forces.
Rulaar was a celestial body in the Mid Rim's Senex sector. The Rulaarian pleasure yacht existed in the galaxy by the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The Cynestra Space Craft Show was a space craft show held on an artificial satellite orbiting the blue planet of Cynestra during the Galactic Civil War.
The duels in the Jentares system were a series of two battles between the Sith Lord Darth Maul and the reclusive Jedi Master, Siolo Ur Manka.
Leafar was a planet located within the Leafar system of the Expansion Region. It was home to the Leafar.
Chuzalla was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Tammuz sector. It had a significant population of dangerous criminals and was the site of the spaceport city Zallakesh.
In 19 BBY, it was used as a hiding place by Jedi Master Djinn Altis and his group shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire.

The trial of Demagol was an event in 3963 BBY, when the Mandalorian renegade Rohlan Dyre, who was mistaken for the doctor and scientist Demagol, was put on trial for a myriad of crimes Demagol committed against the citizens of the Galactic Republic, while the real Demagol was …

affiliation: Office of the Chief of State
x: A special-missions force of bounty hunters was hired by Galactic Alliance Chief of State Natasi Daala in 43.5 ABY. They answered directly to the Office of the Chief of State, and served officially as part of Daala's security detail.

t: Attack on the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet
result: First Coruscant Task Force ultimately chased off
x: An attack on the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet began when the Sith Imperial navy's First Coruscant Task Force jumped out of hyperspace and surprise-ambushed the Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet, causing their forces to scatter between multiple hyperspace jumps of their own.
Clone gunners were clone troopers that manned vehicle-mounted weapons or artillery, wearing specialized clone trooper armor throughout their service.

The First Coruscant Task Force was a detachment of the Imperial Navy loyal to the Sith Empire. Under the command of Admiral Krion Grail, the Task Force ambushed Galactic Alliance Admiral Gar Stazi's defense fleet in the Arkanis sector.

The Marauder was an Ardent-class fast frigate serving as the flagship of the First Coruscant Task Force, a detachment of the Imperial Navy loyal to the Sith Empire. It was commanded by the Human Admiral Krion Grail and his second-in-command, Captain Shantillen.
The Incident on Dac was a brief skirmish between the Imperial Knights Sigel Dare and Treis Sinde, which Jedi Master Asaak Dan intervened in to stop.
Chortav Meshurkaane was a street on the Outer Rim world of Mandalore, located within Keldabe, the planet's capital city.

Screamer was the personal Nagai starfighter so named after the teezl and used by Dark Lady of the Sith Lumiya against the Alliance of Free Planets' Rogue Squadron and the Mandalorian Resurrector Squadron during the Second Battle of Endor.

The Tenth War, also known as the Tenth Battle of Zehava, was a battle of the Melida/Daan Civil War on the planet of Melida/Daan that occurred at some point before 94 BBY. It resulted in underground burial vaults being constructed in the city of Zehava.

The Kintan Gunrunners were a group of primarily Nikto weapons smugglers. They had a reputation for cruelty and murderous folly, and were known throughout Hutt Space and the Corporate Sector in the Outer Rim Territories.
Cheravh was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Mandalore sector, located within the Cheravh system.
Figg Plaza was part of Cloud City. The Holiday Towers hotel and casino was located on the west edge of Figg Plaza.

Gradient Seven was a detainment moon that was used by the Galactic Empire during the time of the Galactic Civil War, to house prisoners. In 1 BBY, the Imperial prison barge Purge was sent to transport prisoners to Gradient Seven, although it never arrived there.

Cimarosa was the homeworld of the Human Von Longo and his two sons, Kale Longo and Trig Longo. They lived on the world until sometime in 1 BBY, when they were arrested by the Galactic Empire, and placed on the prison barge Purge.
The Battle of the Carosi system occurred after the Disaster at Deepspace Besh between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire. The Alliance made a significant strike against the Empire.

Resurrector Squadron was a squadron of starfighters piloted by Mandalorian Protectors that fought the Nagai during the Second Battle of Endor. The squadron consisted of twelve Cabur-class starfighters led by Fenn Shysa and his copilot.
The Syalann was a capital ship that was used by the Nagai during the Nagai–Tof War.
Khonji Seven was a world that was located just outside the Brunet system.

result: Mandalorian victory; Nagai driven off the planet
x: A battle was fought at Mandallia between the Nagai and the Mandalorian Protectors during the early stages of the Nagai–Tof War. The Nagai had already established a number of bases in the Mandalore sector when the Mandalorians staged an assault on Mandallia.

The Battle of Sullust was a battle fought between the Alliance of Free Planets and the Nagai. Following the Second Battle of Endor, a portion of the Alliance fleet including the Millennium Falcon arrived at Sullust and was ambushed by Nagai ships.
The Battle of Fondor was a battle fought in 4 ABY during the Nagai–Tof War. A combined New Republic/Nagai fleet repelled an attack on Fondor by the Tofs, with high casualties on both sides.

The Battle of the Thesme sector was a battle fought in 4 ABY during the Nagai–Tof War. Tof forces eventually retreated from the Thesme sector after inflicting thirty percent casualties on a Mandalorian Protector task force.

The capturing of Taris was an event during the later years of the Jedi Civil War where the loosely defended planet of Taris was conquered by the Sith Empire. The Sith installed a government on the planet, deposing the Galactic Republic-aligned government.
The liberation of the planet Vilosoria occurred during the Galactic Civil War. The native Vilosorians were able to drive the local Imperial garrison off the planet.

Hypotria was a Mid Rim planet situated in the Bortele sector. During the Galactic Civil War, a deep-cover Rebel Alliance operative and their astromech droid, R2z-DL, were posted on Hypotria, where the latter, posing as a maintenance droid, was stealing valuable data off starsh…
Sigil was a planet in the Sigil system. The Sith Terrak Morrhage trained there.

Daz's Tavern was located in the town of Dalia on Dalicron-4, the planet's largest settlement. It was the social center of the small village, a wooden structure that served both food and drinks. By 3 ABY, Daz, a Human male, owned and operated the tavern.
Gigauns were enormous, yet harmless, creatures native to the planet Ukio. They were also known as hatchet heads by the local workers.
Raze's Organization was a information brokering organization, led by Raze himself.

t: Keelyvine Reus's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor

result: Defeat of the Sith forces on Manaan
x: The Ahto Uprising was a battle that took place in Ahto City on the planet Manaan after the Jedi Order and Galactic Republic defeated the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Malak's Sith Empire at the end of the Jedi Civil War.

The terrorist attack of 14:9:19 occurred on Coruscant around 22 BBY. Palpatine secretly orchestrated the attack under the guise of Darth Sidious. The attack was later publicly attributed to the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
a: Destruction of the Star of Iskin

x: Pleida was a planet located in the Tovosh system of the Outer Rim Territories.
Tureen VI was an astronomical object in the Tureen system of the Outer Rim Territories' Kriz sector. It was the origin of the Soup People, a group known for making high-quality soup.
Blue Squadron was an Alderaanian Resistance squadron that participated in the Battle of Byss.
This duel took place in 980 BBY between Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Bane and his apprentice, Darth Zannah, in the Stone Prison on the planet Doan.

Fenel was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Demetras sector. It was the homeworld of the Fenelar species. A powerful world possessing starshipwrights and technologists, it was eventually raided by the Mandalorian Crusaders, resulting in the Fenelar's extinction.

result: Darth Zannah defeats Darth Bane and becomes Dark Lord of the Sith
x: A duel between the Sith Master Darth Bane and his apprentice, Darth Zannah, took place on the planet Ambria in 980 BBY.
Geska Prime was a planet in the Lifh sector of the Mid Rim.

Kolanda Station was located on Latharra in the Yminis sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it was the site of a massacre of Rebel soldiers by Imperial forces acting on intelligence supplied by Krova the Hutt.
A4-G2 was a G2 repair droid that fixed astromech droids.

The Celestine was a droid legend—a starship-droid hybrid. It was a large warship designed to be operated only by droids. It was equipped with one of the largest and most highly advanced droid brains of its era.
Rangorah was a planet in the Outer Rim's Calaron sector and the location of the Event Horizon cantina.
Ankori-7 was a planet located within the Ankori system of the Expansion Region.

Begali was a celestial body located in the Begali system of the Inner Rim. By 1154 BBY, Begali was affiliated with the Six Sisters, a group of worlds governed by the confederation known as the Echani Command.
Brachi was a planet located within the Brachi system of the Outer Rim Territories and the home to the Brachian Beastlord.

Taronda was a remote mining world. During the Clone Wars, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and his padawan, Ahsoka Tano were sent by the Jedi Council to negotiate a trading agreement with the miners of the planet for raw materials for the Republic.
The Tatooine training grounds were training grounds conducted by Jedi Master Ferroda. Two clones there were X1 and X2.
During the Galactic Civil War, a battle occurred on the planet Vaenrood, located in the system of the same name in the Pakuuni sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

An alien race with huge, muscular bodies and heads that resembled the tips of stalks on their necks. No eyes or noses were visible on their heads, and a small opening revealed their mouths. Plattahr was a member of the species.
Kishpaugh was a planet located within the Kishpaugh system of the Mid Rim.

t: Mission to Coth Fuuras space station
objective: Capture Jedi Knight Borik Yelgo
x: The Mission to Coth Fuuras space station was an Imperial operation to capture the Jedi Knight Borik Yelgo, four weeks after the formation of the Galactic Empire.

Maill was a planet located within the Maill system of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was well-known for having produced one of the rarest coins in the galaxy; the world's King had commissioned the coin in honor of his wife.
Hrill was a planet reputed to be peaceful, quiet, and dull. In 15 BBY, the merchant Mungo Baobab was assigned a mission to Hrill by the Merchant Council of his homeworld, Manda.
Skavers were bandits in Skeebo City. Their base was hidden in a mountain. One of their accomplices was Captain Voor.

XT was the astromech droid of the Valahari royalty and CIS Hero Tofen Vane. XT assisted Vane in piloting his Tempest Zero during the Battle of the Hexus system, as well as other engagements against the Galactic Republic.

A duel occurred on Valahari after Obi-Wan Kenobi discovered that Asajj Ventress was responsible for the sabotage of Viscount Harko Vane. This sabotage lead to his death. Obi-Wan Kenobi tried to inform the viscount's widow, Elodore Vane, of the event.

A battle occurred in the Hexus system between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems around 22 BBY. A squad of Tempest Zero starfighters, led by Tofen Vane, attacked the Republic blockade of the system by Admiral Aldanna.

Doan was a small planet in the Outer Rim Territories whose sole economy was focused on mining. It was ruled by a group of nobles, the Doan Royal House, while most of its population were miners who lived in poverty.

This alien race were tall, muscular beings with orange skin, three-fingered hands, five green eyes, and a large, triangular head with snakelike tendrils in place of hair. Their homeworld was razed by the Empire. Stauz Czycz was a member of this species.
The Duinarbulon Star Lancers were elite mounted warriors recruited from the planet Duinarbulon who served the Kingdom of Cron and the Empire of Xim the Despot.

Valiant was the transport of the Valahari Viscount Harko Vane. In it, he tried to breach the Republic blockade of his planet, but the ship was set to explode by Asajj Ventress, who made it to look destroyed by Republic forces in order to pull the Valahari into war.
Mother Ithor was an Ithorian Herdship named for the Ithorian homeworld, Ithor.
The battle of Ukio was a conflict between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems on Ukio.

t: Battle of the Makem system (Mandalorian Wars)
x: A battle was fought between the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders and the Galactic Republic in the Makem system sometime between 3973 BBY and 3965 BBY, during the early years of the conflict known as the Mandalorian Wars.
Vurrha's Blood was a criminal organization lead by the Quarren crime lord Vurrha Chur. Its base of operation was in Mos Eisley on Tatooine.

A battle between New Republic and Galactic Empire forces at the world of Emmer took place in 4 ABY. After the fledgling Alliance of Free Planets/New Republic repelled the Nagai and Ssi-ruuvi invasions of the galaxy, Mon Calamari led Republic forces that had been kept pent in b…
The living quarters of Council of First Knowledge member Obba served him from his appointment to the Council until he stepped down or passed away.

The Qadel were a sentient species in the galaxy. According to the play Evocar, which was written by the Hutt playwright Direus'pei between 920 BBY and 671 BBY, the Qadel were driven to extinction by the Tionese warlord Xim during his conquests of the Tion Cluster that occurred…
The Ermi were a sentient species. According to the play Evocar, written by the Hutt playwright Direus'pei around 671 BBY, the Ermi were driven to extinction by the Tionese warlord Xim.

The Veeza were a sentient species. According to the play Evocar, which was written by the Hutt playwright Direus'pei between 920 BBY and 671 BBY, the Veeza were exterminated by the Tionese warlord Xim during his conquests of the Tion Cluster that occurred between 25,130 and 25…

The Zoa'mon were a sentient species. According to the play Evocar, which was written by the Hutt playwright Direus'pei between 920 BBY and 671 BBY, the Zoa'mon were driven to extinction by the Tionese warlord Xim during his conquests of the Tion Cluster that occurred between 2…
Malano III was a planet formerly ruled by the A'mari clan.

This battle took place over the planet Yag'Dhul in 5 BBY between the Galactic Empire and a group of Yag'Dhul insurgents. The Imperial forces, led by the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Desolator, ambushed the insurgents at their base over Yag'Dhul.

These insurgents were from the planet Yag'Dhul. In 5 BBY, they attracted the attention of the Galactic Empire, which sent forces with the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Desolator to attack the insurgents.
Latharra was located in the Yminis sector of the Outer Rim Territories and was the location of Kolanda Station.
A battle was fought around 22 BBY on the moon of Gall during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Scrap-Yard City was a city on an unidentified planet. It was quite literally a scrapyard.

objective: Find Darth Andeddu's holocron
x: This mission was undertaken by Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Bane in 980 BBY in order to obtain Darth Andeddu's holocron, which Bane hoped would hold the secret to extending one's life.

The Gorog was a gargantuan beast used in the Tarko-se Arena on Cato Neimoidia. The immense, bipedal creature possessed a hunched stance, two human-like hands with opposable thumbs, two hearts, and four tusks protruding from its lower jaw.

This skirmish took place in Darth Bane's mansion on Ciutric IV in 980 BBY. Princess Serra, the daughter of Caleb, discovered that her father had been killed ten years earlier after he had healed Darth Bane for a second time.
Sintheti was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Sintheti system, a part of the Noonian sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Its surface featured crags.
Sumarin was a planet located within the Sumarin system of the Outer Rim Territories.

This sector defense outpost was a New Republic military installation on the planet Ord Pardron. Located under the surface of the planet, the outpost was originally a mining installation for the Galactic Empire, before being converted into a starfighter base used by the Allianc…
Cadannia was a planet in the Mid Rim region of the galaxy presumably completely, or mostly covered in dense jungles or forests that produced some of the galaxy's strongest toxins.

A skirmish took place in 1002 BBY during the New Sith Wars. In that year, Sergeant Dessel of the Gloom Walkers, a unit in the Sith Brotherhood of Darkness, was arrested by Lieutenant Ulabore for mutiny during the Battle of Phaseera, despite the fact that Dessel had gone on to …
Invisible Lizards were predatory, hard bodied reptiles found on the desert planet of Tatooine. They had the ability to turn invisible when threatened.
Needle Rats were predatory mammals found on the desert planet of Tatooine, as well as Endor. They had the ability to turn into a ball and charge at enemies using its needled fur.
Purple mantis was a species of predatory invertebrates found on the desert planet of Tatooine, and in the forests of Endor.

result: Gelba, Medd Tandar, and several other miners killed
objective: Assassination of Gelba
x: A massacre took place in 980 BBY on the planet Doan. Tensions between the planet's Royal Family and mining caste rose when the miners accidentally killed Prince Gerran while attempting to capture him.

The Stalker was the personal shuttle of the Iktotchi assassin and Sith apprentice Darth Cognus, also known as the Huntress. She flew in this ship to the Stone Prison on Doan after capturing Darth Bane from his mansion on Ciutric IV at the orders of Princess Serra.

The planet Usk, in the Usk system, was home to a native sentient species. At some point, the planet's indigenous inhabitants were enslaved by the Hutt species, and their homeworld was considered part of the region of the galaxy known as Hutt Space, controlled by their masters,…

The Moralan were a sentient species who lived on the planet Moralan in Hutt Space. They were enslaved by the Hutt species but freed themselves and formed a republic with encouragement from the Tionese.

A sentient species, the Ilosians hailed from the agricultural world Ilos. Millennia before the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Ilosians settled many nearby worlds before becoming engulfed in Hutt Space and enslaved by the Hutts.
The Langoonans were a sentient species native to the planet Langoona, located within Hutt Space. The species was enslaved by the Hutts, who favored them until the Langoonans unsuccessfully rebelled.
The Lofquarian gooney bird was a type of bird from the Lofquar system.
The Pervian blood crow was a type of bird that often swarmed on wonderhawks.
The wonderhawk was a type of bird. Pervian blood crows often swarmed on them.
The Gamorrean thunder wasp was a winged insect from the planet Gamorr.
The Socorran granite-hawk was a type of bird from the planet Socorro.

Rhandites, also known as Rhandite nihilists, were a group who exclusively dwelt in the Nihil Retreat as acolytes of the faith established by the Sorcerers of Rhand. The Sorcerers presided over the Rhandites from their sanctum on Rhand in the Perann Nebula.

The Jaltiri tribes were a cultural or/and planetary community that inhabited the world of Toskhowwl VI in the Mid Rim. Around 5 ABY, the Jaltiri tribals were known beyond their homeworld for their custom of constructing stacks made from severed heads.
TerraAsta was a planet located within the TerraAsta system of the Colonies.

Udnil II was a planet located within the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A space battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire took place near the planet during the Galactic Civil War.

The Triumph was a Cygnus Spaceworks Theta-class T-1 vessel owned by Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Bane. Bane flew in the shuttle on a mission to the Deep Core planet Prakith in 980 BBY to acquire the holocron of Sith Lord Darth Andeddu.
The Victory was a Theta-class T-1 vessel used by Sith apprentice Darth Zannah. She flew in the shuttle on multiple occasions, including on her first mission to the planet Doan.

A prison asteroid was located in the Belderone sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Gang leaders Lemo and Sanda were incarcerated there after being captured by bounty hunters in the Keyorin system.

The Oppressor-7 class dark trooper was a dark trooper variant used by the Galactic Empire. Typically stationed as city guards along with the Glory-class dark trooper, the Oppressor-7 class saw a wide range of use on planets such as Corellia and Tatooine as law enforcement agents.
The victory class dark trooper was a dark trooper variant used by the Galactic Empire.
The Flying Color Guard was a group based on Naboo. Their members were generally members of the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps.
Cademimu V, also simply referred to as Cademimu, was a planet in the Cademimu sector along the Celanon Spur.

The Buried Treasure was a bulk freighter owned by the New Republic. Most of its available space was dedicated to cargo storage, and some of the space was not oxygenated or temperature controlled and therefore unfit for human habitation.

The Tetso Shopping Worlds were a group of planets located within the Tetso system, in the Slice portion of the Core Worlds that was known as the Arrowhead. In 2 ABY, Princess Mi expressed interest in visiting the Tetso Shopping Worlds.
Tentrix was a vast, beautiful blue planet located within the Tentrix system of the Expansion Region.
Telepan was a planet located within the Telepan system of the Core Worlds.
The Snow Mynock was a variant of the mynock, a silicon-based parasitical species often found within asteroid belts, that had found its way to the ice planet Hoth.
The Fire Bat was a creature found on Hoth by early 3 ABY.
Caillte was the seventh planet of the Luire system, in the Mid Rim.

A protocol droid worked aboard the Coronet in the ship's cargo bay during the Clone Wars. During Duchess Satine's trip to Coruscant, it authorized the cargo brought by Senator Tal Merrik containing assassin probes.

Flotsam was a Starhawk shuttle owned by Khedryn Faal and Marr Idi-Shael. The primary ship owned by Faal, Junker, was modified so that Flotsam was attached on the side, rather than the standard escape pod.

Palpatine's Spaarti cloning facility, also known as Emperor Palpatine's personal cloning facility was a clandestine laboratory constructed upon the orders of Emperor Palpatine deep within the Imperial Palace on Coruscant.

A Mandalorian Militiaman was a type of soldier native to the planet Mandalore. Mandalorian Militiamen fought against invading forces on Mandalore during the Galactic Civil War. They were stationed in various Mandalorian barracks around the planet.
The Dying Sun was an Interdictor-class cruiser that was used by the Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War.

place: Near a frozen moon in the Unknown Regions
result: Deaths of Relin Druur and Saes Rrogon
x: This mission took place on the Sith dreadnaught Harbinger in 41.5 ABY. Following a skirmish over Phaegon III in 5000 BBY a the outbreak of the Great Hyperspace War, the Harbinger entered an unstable hyperlane and traveled through time to 41.5 ABY.
Mt. Hugo, named after Hugo Bartyn, was the highest peak in the range known as Krakana's Maw in Lamaredd. The Bartyn mansion was located in Mt. Hugo.

affiliation: Sovereign state of Little Mon Cal
x: Little Mon Cal, previously known as Jotsen's Island, was the second-biggest land of mass in the planet Lamaredd and, from c. 517 BBY onward, a sovereign state inhabited mostly by aliens. From its capital city of Farsands, it was also the seat of the main HQ of the Sailor's Union.
The Senate Mining Bureau was a body active five centuries before the Battle of Yavin.

The Reef, also known as The Reef asteroid cloud, was a natural belt of asteroids and dust that resulted from the collision of the two outmost planets in the Lamaro system. The natives of the system gave the belt its name.
MD-0C6, commonly known as Doc, was a self-customized Industrial Automaton MD-series medical droid and the local physician in Bartyn's Landing, a coastal town on Lamaredd.

The Sailor's Union was a syndicate of fishermen in the planet Lamaredd. Founded c. 517 BBY, it helped the original settlers to improve their slave-like conditions; in further years, the community was free and the Union helped them improve their conditions — however, there were…
MMV-608 was a tracked security droid from the MMV security droid series. MMV-608 was active and protecting the mines of Outer Rim Oreworks Company in Lamaredd as of 29 BBY.
The Ragnos Lakes were a location on the remote planet Kesh, named by the Sith castaway group known as the Lost Tribe after the former Dark Lord of the Sith Marka Ragnos.
The Nyriaanans, also known as Nyriaanan natives, were the near-Human inhabitants of the planet of Nyriaan.
The Koban Gorge was an expansive canyon on the planet Koba. The valley was set between two cliffs and filled with abundant forest land, with a bridge that connected one side to the other.

Unit 4416 was a B1-series battle droid in service of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Stationed aboard Tambor Deep Space Centre, it assisted Gorgol the Handy in defense against the Republic siege.

Unit 4432 was a B1-series battle droid in service of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Stationed aboard Tambor Deep Space Centre, it assisted Gorgol the Handy in defense against Republic siege.

t: Siege of Tambor Deep Space Centre
x: The Siege of Tambor Deep Space Centre was an attempt by the Galactic Republic to shut down a Geonosian workshop used to repair CIS starships.

side2: Members of the Sith species on Kesh
result: All but one non-Human member of the Lost Tribe of Sith killed
x: In 4985 BBY, Yaru Korsin, leader of the Lost Tribe of Sith on Kesh, launched a full-fledged purge of the forty-five pureblood Sith on the planet.
Rabolow was a village near the Ragnos Lakes of the continent Keshtah Minor on the remote planet Kesh. It was one of eight towns in the region, including Tetsubal.

Tetsubal was a city located in the area of the Ragnos Lakes, on the continent Keshtah Minor of the remote planet Kesh. Located to the south of the planet's capital, Tahv, by 4985 BBY Tetsubal had a population of 18,000 Keshiri natives.

This battle took place in 31 BBY, when the Jedi Knight Yoshi Raph-Elan and the Princess Lourdes fought against the dictator Gar-Oth, who had taken control of Lourdes' home planet. Gar-Oth was killed during the battle, and his Goliath droid was destroyed, liberating the planet.

During the Imperial Period, the Galactic Empire enslaved the population of the forested world of Shar'Ack. The natives of Shar'Ack, the Shaliz'Na, were a sentient species of artisans addicted to alcohol.
The Skirmish on Aduba-3 was a small incident between spacers and Han Solo and Chewbacca in the town of Tun Aduban on Aduba-3.
The Battle of Nyriaan was a battle that was fought during the Jedi Civil War, near to the planet Nyriaan.
The massacre at the galleon took place when Saadoon-Kauldi killed a crew of slavers who were mistreating their slaves. Saadoon-Kauldi then released the prisoners.

t: Rescue at the Imperial garbage scow
result: Hundreds of slaves released, including Guzald
x: The rescue at the Imperial garbage scow took place when Saadoon-Kauldi released hundreds of slaves from this ship, during his anti-slaver campaign.
a: Rescue at the Imperial garbage pontoon

x: The Kadri'Ra Saadoon-Kauldi created his own criminal empire after being released from slavery. He based his power in alliance with other crime lords such as Abdi-Badawzi and in a big number of former slaves who swore loyalty to Saadoon-Kauldi after being released.

Shadevale stalkers were serpentine creatures native to the planet Kashyyyk. They were known to make their homes in the pools and streams of the Kkowir Forest. They were similar in appearance to, and related to the crystal snakes of Yavin 4.
Bio-Lab 177 was a laboratory onboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Vector.
The Naboo Betterment Society was an organization based on the planet Naboo.

The Valley of Floating Trees was a clouded valley on the forest moon of Endor. It was filled with trees floating on small islands. Wicket, Kneesaa, Latara and Teebo had to cross the valley to reach the Tree of Light in 3 ABY.

result: Other Force-sensitive clones escape the moon
x: A mission was undertaken by Jedi Knight Jaden Korr in 41 ABY, when he traveled to a frozen moon with a cloning laboratory.
The Starfire was a starship owned by Captain Stellet around 41.5 ABY.

The battle of the Koban Gorge was an isolated incident that resulted from Jedi Master Polvin Kut's intervention on behalf of the citizens of the planet Koba, who were suffering under the oppression of Tulak, an Advozse warlord.
MandalMotors Hall was a charcoal-gray building made of granite, located on Mandalore, in the capital city of Keldabe.
PDA-2 was an OOM command battle droid that was responsible for guarding Theed until the Battle of Grassy Plains was over.
PDA6 was a PD Lurrian protocol droid, a series of protocol droid designed by Cybot Galactica. PDA6 was stationed aboard the Ithorian Herdship of an Ithorian botanist named Master Zorneth.
Diamal was a planet located in the Diamal system of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of the Diamal. The planet was frequently in conflict with its neighbor, Isht.

result: Jysella Horn captured by Galactic Alliance Security
x: This skirmish took place on the Processional Way on Coruscant in 43.5 ABY. When Jedi Knight Jysella Horn was stricken with a mysterious psychosis that made her believe that everyone she knew had been replaced by impostors, she began to attack civilians, tossing them across the…
R4-C7 was a red-domed, blue-bodied modified R-series astromech droid assigned to Razor Squadron during the Clone Wars.

t: Second raid on the Sith Citadel
conflict: None (isolated conflict; preceding the Great Hyperspace War)
x: In 5000 BBY, Dark Lord of the Sith Naga Sadow launched a raid on the Sith Citadel on Ziost, intending to capture the starship Starbreaker 12. He succeeded, bringing the ship to his citadel on Khar Delba.

The G'rho Defense Force was the militia on the planet of G'rho. Its members included the Ilwizzt Major Brco, Lieutenant Jerriman, military historian Ydra Sibwarra, and pilots Trig and Seni. The militia included a number of Conjo fighters.

x: The Wayland trap was orchestrated by Darth Maladi in order to capture Cade Skywalker and use him as a test subject for a new creation of hers. Maladi would in turn use her new weapon to help Darth Krayt regain domination over the One Sith.

The Invasion of Dearic was an invasion by the Alliance to Restore the Republic to retake the Talusian city of Dearic in the year 1 ABY, in an attempt to free the Talusian people from an Imperial presence in the region.
The Crucible was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

The Indomitable was a cruiser in the service of the Galactic Republic in the Clone Wars under the command of Admiral Wullf Yularen. The ship participated in the battle of Kothlis, where it was heavily damaged.
The Mission to Duroon was a smuggling run made by the crew of the Millennium Falcon to the planet Duroon for loan shark Ploovo Two-For-One.

The Duroon Rebels were a group of offworld contract-slaves working in a forced-labor camp on the planet Duroon. They started a rebellion against their Corporate Sector Authority oppressors when they were not given the rewards they were promised.

Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, Obsidian 8 was a modified TIE/ln starfighter serving the Galactic Empire's Obsidian Squadron by the year 3 ABY. Obsidian 8 was operated by OS-72-8, a TIE pilot who was previously stationed aboard the Star Destroyer Devastator.
Best Chance was a SoroSuub Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 owned by the Lutrillian gangster Sawthawne.

Dathomir Spaceport was the preeminent spaceport on the planet Dathomir. It consisted primarily of a grassy and muddy field that housed several dull gray prefabricated permacrete domes, among them an administrative building, a communications center, a hostel, several small hang…

The Kodashi viper was an ophidian indigenous to the rainforests of the Outer Rim world of Dathomir. Kodashi vipers were the most poisonous serpents in Dathomir's jungles, and those who failed to heed the multicolored aposematic patterns of their hides often fell victim to the …

A city was located on a remote planet. The Jedi Knight Samuro took the Jedi and energy vampire Rajine and her victims to the city and raised a Force barrier over the planet to ensure that Rajine could not escape.

Rajine's planet was a rocky planet used by the Jedi Knight Samuro to imprison the Jedi and energy vampire Rajine and her victims. He imprisoned them in a city and raised a Force barrier over the planet to ensure that Rajine could not escape.
This blue gas giant was a planet located in the UR-2212-GR system in the Unknown Regions. The gas giant had an icy moon orbiting it that was home to an Imperial research facility.
The Unitive was a Consular-class cruiser of the Galactic Republic that was captained by Pietrangelo during the time of the Clone Wars.
8K6 was a science droid in the service of the Sith Empire. He was aboard the Harbinger when Phaegon III's moon was stripped, and perished when the bridge on the Harbinger was destroyed.
The Red Mud Potters Clan was a clan of Dathomiri witches on the planet Dathomir. One of their members, Hacina, was a Nightsister.
The Battle of Garia was fought on the planet Garia in the Brak sector during the latter stages of the Clone Wars.

Hestria was a Mid Rim agriworld located in the Senex sector. It was known for the wines produced there. Around 3643 BBY, the government of Hestria shut down its secret police force that had been attempting to influence the governments of all the planets of the Hestria system.
The Black Wave was a Corporate Sector Authority-produced ChaseMaster frigate. It was a part of the Lost Tribe of Sith's Sith armada, and was commanded by High Lord Sarasu Taalon.
Gandalla was a planet located in the Boeus sector of the Expansion Region.

Sleeper Cell V-16 was a group of Rebel Alliance agents in the spaceport city of Fabrillan on the planet Malthor. They were regarded by General Cracken as a typical example of a group of "civilian operatives" who covertly aided the Alliance during their day-to-day activities.

result: Sothais Saar captured by the Jedi Order
x: A duel took place in the Senate Plaza on the galactic capital of Coruscant in 43.5 ABY. In that year, several Jedi Knights had begun to contract a Force psychosis that caused them to believe that everyone they knew had been replaced by impostors.
The Raining Leaves Clan was a clan of Dathomirian Witches living on the planet Dathomir. In 43 ABY, the Raining Leaves merged with the men of the Broken Columns Clan to form the Bright Sun Clan.

The Cygnante was a highly modified Mark I Bulk Transport, and was used by members of the Shield organization. The ship had been reinforced to be battle worthy, and to serve as a home base for extended periods without resupply.

t: Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow
result: Nearly 24 Nightsisters captured by the Lost Tribe of Sith
x: A skirmish took place in a landing meadow on Dathomir in 43.5 ABY. Sith apprentice Vestara Khai, the sole survivor of a Sith strike team that had ambushed the Jedi Luke and Ben Skywalker, fled to Dathomir and sent a hypercomm message to her Sith Tribe to retrieve her.

t: Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow
x: A duel took place in a landing meadow on Dathomir in 43.5 ABY. After a Sith strike team's failed attack on Jedi Grand Master Luke Skywalker and his son, Ben, the two Jedi tracked the strike team's sole survivor, Sith apprentice Vestara Khai, to Dathomir.

place: Procession from the Mon Calamari Embassy to the Plaza of the Founders
x: The funeral of Cha Niathal took place after Admiral Cha Niathal's death in 43.5 ABY. Niathal decided to commit suicide rather than face the charges of dereliction of duty raised against her by Galactic Alliance Chief of State Natasi Daala.

The Galactic Alliance Navy Drum Corps was a drum corps for the Galactic Alliance Navy. The Drum Corps took part in Admiral Cha Niathal's funeral in 43.5 ABY; their large barges followed Niathal's casket.
Point Down was an influential base for the Confederacy of Independent Systems on the planet Jabiim. Galactic Republic forces later managed to capture Camp Aurek, Point Down, and Outpost Shear.
Esseles's spynet was an intelligence organization secretely gathering information in the military and economic spheres. It was operating from the Esprix Estate.
Redgill Lake was a lake on the planet of Dathomir. The Raining Leaves Clan and Broken Columns Clan held their annual meeting near this lake.
Rocantor was a planet located in the Expansion Region of the galaxy.
