x: The Raining Leaves Clan massacre occurred sometime in 33 ABY, when a large number of the male slaves of the Raining Leaves Clan, a traditionalist and matriarchal Dathomiri Witch clan, revolted against their masters.

affiliation: Primarily various planetary and sector governments
x: The Planetary Security Forces (PSF), also known as the Planetary Defense Forces (PDF), were the loosely affiliated military forces of the various planetary and sector governments of the galaxy.
Sellasas was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Jjannex sector. During the Galactic Civil War, it hosted an Imperial army garrison of the Galactic Empire.

This battleship was under the control of Sith Lord Ludo Kressh in the years leading up to the Great Hyperspace War. It was one of the few ships in Kressh's control which survived the Battle of Khar Delba, but was later destroyed when Kressh decided to fake his death.

In 17 ABY, during the Imperial Skirmishes, Fleet Admiral Gilad Pellaeon led the forces of the Imperial Remnant in attacking the planet Adumar at the same time as Admiral Natasi Daala attacked Rydonni Prime.

conflict: Hunt for Zsinj, Galactic Civil War
x: A raid on the planet Taris was carried out during the New Republic/Imperial collaboration against Warlord Zsinj, targeting Zsinj's business assets.
A battle at the planet Columus occurred during the Imperial Skirmishes, a desperate attempt by the Moff Council and the replacement warlords to turn the tide in the Galactic Civil War.
A battle occurred at the planet Tangrene in the Imperial Skirmishes, a desperate attempt by the Moff Council and the replacement warlords to turn the tide in the Galactic Civil War.
A battle occurred at the planet Ketaris in the Imperial Skirmishes, a desperate attempt by the Moff Council and the replacement warlords to turn the tide in the Galactic Civil War.

Krendel was a large lizard-like creature. The reptile's skin was glossy yellow with vibrant blue and green mottled spots running down its back. It had large, bulbous black eyes and rubbery, sticky pads on its feet that allowed it to climb surfaces of sheer rock.
The Tuldok clan was a band of pirates from Recopia who periodically raided the Colonies.
The Conqueror was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer armed with a superlaser that was in operation during the Galactic Civil War.

Tay'ah'loo was a planet in Imperial Space. In 1 ABY, an unscheduled capsule carrying Bledsoe's disease landed on the planet. The plague was released and decimated the population of Tay'ah'loo within days. Stormtroopers soon arrived to cart away the dead and disinfect the planet.

Kholes was a planet in Imperial space and the home of a Rebel outpost. In 1 ABY, soon after an outbreak of Bledsoe's disease on the nearby planet Tay'ah'loo, the Rebel outpost was wiped out by Imperial forces.
Thorsgild was a celestial body located in the Thorsgild system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Meerian sector.
Tallek was a planet once plagued by thorn fever. The Galactic Empire rounded up anyone who caught the disease and let them die in isolation camps.
The terrain of the Covallon homeworld included plains. The Covallon themselves evolved from a predator species that roamed the plains, and they retained certain characteristics due to this origin.

Bright Sun Hill, originally named the Jedi Hill Camp, was a hill on Dathomir near Redgill Lake. In 43.5 ABY, the conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan was moved to the hill due to Nightsister attacks on the conclave.
The carchar was native to Droxine. It was a poriferal creature with a distinctive water-vascular system similar to that of the aiwha of Kamino.
The Sotak city-clan was a clan composed of members of the Doneer species. The city-clan lived in Sotak'vik on the planet Doneer'so.

Sotak'vik was a clan-city on Doneer'so. It was home to the Doneer Sotak city-clan, and it was selected by the Galactic Empire as the location of its sector governmental headquarters for the Fakir sector.
Tokks'vik was a clan-city on Doneer'so. It was the major shipyard on the planet and was supportive of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The Sinkars were a species of helium-based slugs native to the planet Sinkar. They survived on solar energy and impurities extracted from the planet's surface.
In 0 ABY, the High Command of the Alliance to Restore the Republic tasked one of its sub-groups, Reekeene's Roughnecks, to send diplomats to the planet Abonshee.

result: Victory for Moff Kentor Sarne's forces
x: In 8 ABY, Domaz, the capital city of the planet Kolatill, was bombed by Imperial forces allied to the Warlord Moff Kentor Sarne.
Sithspawn was the personal starfighter of Namman Cha. It was an elite model of Belbullab-22 starfighter painted dark red.

Lonely Five was the personal starfighter of the Jedi Knight and archaeologist Rachi Sitra. It was a blue and white Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor named after the Lonely Five Range of mountains on her home planet of Ryloth.
This dedicated hacker droid was stationed aboard the GR-75 medium transport Bright Hope during the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.

result: Death of Joruus C'baoth and Luuke Skywalker
x: The Assault on Mount Tantiss, also known as the battle of Mount Tantiss, was carried out by agents of the New Republic to shut down Grand Admiral Thrawn's cloning facility at Mount Tantiss on the planet Wayland.
Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command was a military unit within the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances. It was commanded by the Chief of Starfighter Command.

The Skandits' home was a forest clearing on Endor where a large band of Skandits lived. They brought prisoners there, keeping them in cells dug out from the roots of trees and secured with wooden doors. In 3 ABY, the Skandits captured several Ewoks and brought them to their home.

This trial began in 43.5 ABY when the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances arrested former Jedi Knight Tahiri Veila for her assassination of Gilad Pellaeon at the Second Battle of Fondor during the Second Galactic Civil War.
Shadow Squadron was an Imperial starfighter squadron assigned to defend the Galactic Empire and enforce Emperor Palpatine orders.

t: Kidnap attempt in the Galactic Empire Embassy Complex
x: This kidnap attempt was orchestrated by Kuati Senator Haydnat Treen in 43.5 ABY. She organized several stormtroopers, under the command of Lieutenant Oln Pressig, one of Imperial Remnant Head of State Jagged Fel's Security Chiefs, to attack Fel in his quarters of the Galactic …

The Security Services Shooting Range was a shooting range for the Senate Building's Security services on Coruscant. In 43.5 ABY, Galactic Alliance Chief of State Natasi Daala met with the Chief of Starfighter Command, General Merratt Jaxton, at the Shooting Range.
The Brentaal Star was a Thranta-class corvette in service with the Republic Navy during the Cold War.
Jiguuna was the name of a prominent industrial town built by Bakuush on the Hutts' adopted homeworld of Nal Hutta.
The Battle of Ord Ibanna was a naval conflict between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War.
A battle took place on the planet Kothlis during the Clone Wars, and marked the Galactic Republic's second return to the planet during the war.

In 11 ABY, there was a duel on Courkrus between Corran Horn and members of the Jensaarai. Part-way through the duel, Horn received support from Luke Skywalker. The Jensaarai were quickly defeated by the two Jedi.
The Crimson Fleece was the personal starship of Mirialan smuggler Hylo Visz. Visz purchased it after several years of saving, and made extensive modifications to the ship thereafter.

Hylo Visz's smuggling contingent was a criminal organization founded and led by the Mirialan smuggler Hylo Visz. Visz had previously worked for the Hutt Cartel, but after a botched smuggling run, she left the Cartel's service and struck out on her own.

result: Ashaar Khorda is killed by Jango Fett after Yarael Poof dies
x: This skirmish took place in 27 BBY when the bounty hunters Jango Fett and Zam Wesell, along with the Jedi Master Yarael Poof, attempted to stop General Ashaar Khorda and his followers from using the Infant of Shaa to destroy Coruscant.
EG-7 was a power droid that lived on Tatooine and helped a Rebel agent complete a training mission to reprogram an Imperial droid factory.

The Imperial Entertainers' Guild was a corporation that employed professional holofilm showmen and women entertainers. For an agent's fee, the Guild would book acts in all parts of the galaxy. Their emblem was the mask-and-sunburst.

Zorneth's Herdship belonged to the Ithorian scientist Zorneth. It was crewed by Ithorians and assorted other species, along with numerous droids, including C-3PO, PDA6, and R2-D2. A passenger aboard the Ithorian Herdship was the Human botanist Klorr Vilia.

Krozurbia was a planet located in the Outer Rim's Shadola sector. It was the homeworld of the Krozurbian species. They were engaged in two hundred years of war until peace was brought about due to the intervention of the Ithorian Zorneth.

The Krozurbian War Council was composed of Krozurbians. The Krozurbians had been at war for two hundred years until the War Council embraced peace while under the influence of savorium, consumed through thookah steaks fed to them by the Ithorian Zorneth.

The thookah were a species of animal that had shaggy fur. The Ithorian Zorneth fed thookah the savorium herb. Thookah steaks then had the same properties as the drug itself. The first batch of thookah meat was fed to the Krozurbian War Council.
The Mako operated during the Galactic Civil War as an Imperial assault transport ship.

The Malachor Depths were a series of underground passageways and caverns located beneath the surface of Malachor V. Meetra Surik walked through the Malachor Depths on her way to the Trayus Academy during the Battle of Malachor.

The Duel on the Executor was a lightsaber duel on Darth Vader's flagship, Executor. The conflict took place after Vader brought the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 aboard the ship. The Dark Lord attempted to turn R2 to the dark side, but the droid refused, drawing a lightsaber.

The Junior Palace Guard was a division of the Royal Naboo Security Forces based on the planet of Naboo. Not dissimilar to its parent division, the Palace Guard, the Junior Palace Guard recruits Naboo's youth into its ranks.

Manalin was a rocky planet located in the Joralla system, a part of the Mektrun sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. Manalin occupied the closest orbital position around its sun, the red giant–type star Jaska, and had no moons.

The Shi'kar homeworld was inhabited by the Shi'kar species. It was destroyed by a comet prior to the Clone Wars, and became an asteroid belt known as the Shi'kar Straits. It was located in the Nembus sector.
Predator was the Anzati assassin Kell Douro's personal ship. He used it to pursue Jaden Korr to the frozen moon in the Unknown Regions.
Nar Shaddaa's Undercity, also known as the lower levels of Nar Shaddaa or simply Lower Nar Shaddaa, was the lower levels of the Vertical city of Nal Hutta's moon, Nar Shaddaa.

The Star Cluster Casino job was a heist carried out by professional thieves during the Great Galactic War. The thieves uploaded a program into the computers of the Star Cluster Casino on Nar Shaddaa which allowed for them to win massive payouts at seemingly random intervals.

R6, affectionately called Arsix by those who knew him, was a R6-series astromech droid owned by Jaden Korr in the time following the Second Galactic Civil War. He served as astromech droid to Korr's Z-95 Headhunter on his mission to Fhost in 41 ABY.
Defender One was an Imperial shuttle that ferried Emperor Roan Fel and his Imperial Knights to the surface of the planet of Agamar to formalise an alliance between themselves and the Jedi Order.

Port Landien was a beach town on Naboo and the location of the Port Landien Perfumery. A sando aqua monster was found beached on one of its shores. Quarsh Panaka, while still a lieutenant, apprehended a Gungan criminal at the Perfumery.
Sarlacc Enforcer was the title taken by Sarlacc agents throughout the galaxy during the Great Galactic War and the Cold War.

The Battle of Celanon was a conflict between the Imperial Remnant and New Republic in 13 ABY at Celanon. Under the command of Admiral Gilad Pellaeon, the Imperial forces had been pushed back in an attempt to contain an invasion of Imperial space.

A battle droid commander was a member of the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, the battle droid served under the command of Confederate General Grievous during the Battle of Dorin.
The uncharted Mytus asteroid belt was a thick concentration of asteroids in the Mytus system. The belt was situated halfway between the system's primary star and Mytus VII, the outermost planet.

Mytus V was the fifth planet in the Mytus system. It was unoccupied, being barren and inhospitable to humanoid life. Mytus V was the planet assigned to Pakka during Han Solo's scheme to determine Rekkon's assassin.

Mytus VI was the sixth planet in the Mytus system. It was unoccupied, being barren and inhospitable to humanoid life. Mytus VI was the planet assigned to Torm Dadeferron during Han Solo's scheme to determine Rekkon's assassin.

The Kail Ranges were large ranges found on the planet Kail. In 2 BBY, the ranges were controlled by Dixon Dadeferron and his family. Dixon and his two sons, Trevim and Torm, were independent landowners under the Corporate Sector Authority.

t: First raid on the Sith Citadel
result: Naga Sadow convinces the Sith Council to strike at the Galactic Republ
x: In 5000 BBY, Sith Lord Naga Sadow launched a raid on the Sith Citadel on Ziost, in an attempt to free prisoners Gav and Jori Daragon. Disguising the assault to appear as a Galactic Republic operation, Sadow freed the Daragons, killing venerable Sith Lord Simus in the process.
The skirmish above the planet Fondor took place during the Second Galactic Civil War, executed as a test from Darth Caedus to Tahiri Veila to see if she was worthy of becoming his Sith apprentice.
Bomodon was a terrestrial planet located in the Bomodon system, a part of the Churba sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the sentient Bomodon species.

Deefourfive was a silver protocol droid employed by the One Sith on Korriban in 41 ABY to receive agents of the One Sith into their presence. Deefourfive met the Anzat Kell Douro on the planet of Korriban and took him to see Krayt.

The Trinovates were a sentient species with three eyes. They were native to Trinovat, a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Gordian Reach sector, located on the Junction-Tierell Loop. Their homeworld was verdant, with numerous farms and mines.
The largest moon of the planet Phaegon III contained rich deposits of Lignan ore beneath its outer crust, where it was home to several species of animals.

objective: Liberate political prisoners
x: The Liberation of Stars' End, referred to as the Mytus VII disaster in Corporate Sector Authority correspondence, was the mission to liberate the political prisoners of Stars' End.

This T-series tactical droid served in the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, he was the commander for the CIS army on Malastare, in which he led his droid forces on the verge of conquering the planet.
Vandangante outlaw techs were a roving band of well-equipped and well-trained outlaw technicians, led by Klaus 'Doc' Vandangante and his daughter Jessa.
Nalrith was a terrestrial planet located in the Nalrith system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Rseik sector. It was the homeworld of the Nalrithians, a species of sentient insectoids.
Barcaria was a planet located in the Barcaria system, a part of the Sombure sector of the Mid Rim. It was the origin point of the commodity known as Barcarian claw salt.
Otavon XII, also written Otavon 12 and sometimes called simply "Otavon", was a forested planet inhabited by the Ovoni.
The Ovoni were a humanoid species native to Otavon XII.

Ghaina, a Core World, was one of the earliest settled colony worlds in the Galactic Republic. Remotely situated, it was not considered important to galactic society and produced only one Jedi: Taria Damsin.

Sugatis were large creatures native to the planet Otavon XII with characteristics similar to a rancor or balyeg. Their skin was resistant to lightsaber attack, but they were just barely smart enough to be influenced by Jedi mind tricks.

t: Battle of the Outlaw Tech Base
x: The Battle of the Outlaw Tech Base was the dogfight between the Vandangante outlaw techs and the Corporate Sector Authority, over Sarlucif, in 2 BBY.

The Voss were a sentient, humanoid species native to the planet of the same name, in the Voss system of the Allied Tion sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Their capital city was Voss-Ka, a fortified settlement atop a mountain.
The Voss Mystics were the prophetic rulers of the Voss species. They were talented healers and seers native to the planet of the same name, which was highly attuned to the Force.

result: The Sith Emperor acquires a member of the Voss species
x: The Imperial Attack on Voss was an event that occurred in approximately 3645 BBY, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

result: Freedon Nadd falls to the dark side of the Force
x: In 4400 BBY, Jedi apprentice Freedon Nadd engaged his Master Matta Tremayne in a lightsaber duel on the planet Ossus.

This mission was executed by Jedi Knight Quinlan Vos to investigate the disappearance of the entire planet of Ova. His investigations led him to Dathomir, where he managed to stop the Nightsister clans from destroying Coruscant with the Infinity Gate.
Unit 8826 was a B1-series battle droid present on Ukio during the battle of Ukio. A battle droid once mistook the Jedi Sanya for 8826.
The Coryx Moth was a Republic Venator-class star destroyer which fought during the Clone Wars.
The Coruscant Sky was a Republic Venator-class star destroyer which fought during the Clone Wars with the Indomitable battle group.
The Nightmare Lands were a forested region of the planet of Voss.

Voss-Ka was the mountaintop capital city of the Voss, a species native to the planet of the same name. The city was fortified and defended by commandos and Voss Mystics against the attacks of the Gormak, who viewed the Voss as an abomination.
Fest Otur Island was an island in the Pelath-Ri Marches near the Err-Ka Dam on Voss. The Gormak established a fishing village and mining camp around and on the island.

The Voss commandos were soldiers of the Voss, natives of the planet of the same name. The Commandos were said to have undergone disciplined training that allowed them to survive the attacks of another native species, a tech-savvy pre-flight species named the Gormak.

result: Death of Hylon and his Padawan Dendro
x: The Battle of Otavon XII was a skirmish which took place in 19 BBY and involved the Sith Lord Darth Vader. During the battle, Lord Vader supervised the construction of AT-AT's on Tremor Base, located on the planet of Otavon XII.
The Security Division, also known as Corporate Security, was the military arm of the Corporate Sector Authority, created within the framework laid down by the Corporate Sector Charter.
Bukesek referred to a black-skinned subspecies of Rakata who lived in the volcanic sands of Lehon.
Ikalik referred to a crimson-striped subspecies of Rakata that lived in the black glades of Lehon.
Droot referred to a pale blue subspecies of Rakata that lived in the equatorial tidal coves of Lehon.

Fitomp was an unaligned planet situated in the Unknown Regions' Fitomp system. It was a part of the Rakatan Archipelago, a fragmented group of planets settled by tribes of the Rakata species after the collapse of the Rakatan Infinite Empire around 25,200 BBY.
Hilak was a planet within the Rakatan Archipelago of the Unknown Regions of the galaxy. Following the collapse of the Infinite Empire, it was mostly inhabited by barbarous tribes of Rakata.
Makatak was a planet within the Rakatan Archipelago. Following the collapse of the Infinite Empire, it was inhabited by an enlightened tribe of Rakata called the Makatak tribe.
Tulpaa was an Unknown Regions planet. It was located in the Rakatan Archipelago, a group of worlds settled by remnants of the collapsed Infinite Empire of the Rakata species.

Malata was a planet located in the Malata system of the Unknown Regions. It was a part of the Rakatan Archipelago, a fragmented group of unaligned planets settled by tribes of the Rakata species after the collapse of the Rakatan Infinite Empire around 25,200 BBY.

Persappa was a terrestrial planet located in the Persappa system of the Unknown Regions. It was a part of the Rakatan Archipelago, a fragmented group of unaligned planets settled by tribes of the Rakata species after the collapse of the Rakatan Infinite Empire around 25,200 BBY.

Griwstrick was an unaligned terrestrial planet featuring patches of bamboos. It was situated in the Unknown Regions' Griwstrick system and constituted a part of the Rakatan Archipelago, a fragmented group of planets colonized by tribes of the Rakata species after the collapse …

The Gengh-Noghri were a subspecies of the Noghri native to the planet Tulpaa in the Unknown Regions, distinguishable by their crocodilian heads filled with flesh-tearing teeth and were over two meters in height, and were the descendents of Noghri slaves taken by ancient Rakata…

The Sith infiltrators were a group of Sith assassins that were led by the Sith Lord Darth Ekkage. The Jedi Nomen Karr defeated Ekkage and her assassins, who were then imprisoned in the depths of the Belsavis prison.
Fegorosk IV was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Fegorosk system, a part of the Obtrexta sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

BanthaQuik! was a dining establishment located in Lumchugger's Hub on the planet Bescane. They emphasized quick service and used an electronic menu system to place orders. To deliver their meals, they employed couriers which delivered their dishes on hover-scoots.

Cooper's Swoopers were a swoop gang operating on Bescane in the town of Lumchugger's Hub. They were led by the Rebel sympathizer, Cooper Dray. During Operation Death-Hunter, they became involved with a Rebel SpecOps group that was investigating a secret Imperial project.
The Duel in the Almas Academy was a lightsaber duel that was fought inside the ruins of the Almas Academy.
The Chlovi cat was a species of amphibian predator, that was native to the planet Nyriaan. They were named after the chlovi, a species of large fungus.
The mantys was a species of flying insectoid native to Kubindi.
The Shadow Wing, also known as the Dark Wing, was a pirate group that operated during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Dark Wing was a group active in Port Borgo, a lawless asteroid spaceport, during the reign of the Galactic Empire. A woman tried to join the group there, but later told a sibling in the Rokana Raiders pirate group that it was basically impossible.

The Ay'Nat were a band of pirates that operated in the Naboo system during the time of the Galactic Civil War. They were also present at some point in the Tatooine system where they conflicted with Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire.

A battle was fought between forces loyal to the Galactic Empire, under Admiral Teren Rogriss, and Warlord Treuten Teradoc's Greater Maldrood at Feriae Junction in 8.5 ABY during the Imperial Civil War.
A battle at the planet Maridun was fought between the forces of the New Republic under Admiral Gial Ackbar and Warlord Treuten Teradoc's Greater Maldrood at Maridun in 8.5 ABY.
A battle was fought between the forces of the New Republic, under Admiral Ackbar, and Warlord Treuten Teradoc's Greater Maldrood at the planet Thanos in 8.5 ABY.
Bio-Lab 242 was a laboratory onboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Vector.

This spiny creature lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. It had a long, tapered snout, pointy ears, and climbed on all fours. The creature had black fur with a white stripe down the center. It had a large, gray shell with white spines on it.
A mammalian species was one of the many sentient species of the galaxy.

An arachnid inhabited the forest moon of Endor. It was a segmented creature with blue fur, four clawed legs, and yellow markings on its back. The creature also possessed two yellow eyes, four sharp teeth, and could launch gobs of webbing from its mouth.
The Kalist base commissary was the eating establishment located in Kalist Base on Kalist VI. The crew of the tanker Nuna's Twins was offered a warm meal here after a rebel attack on the base.
This ship was an Ithullan ore hauler active in the Stenness Node in the years leading up to the Great Sith War. It was under the control of Captain Gruna.
Lluma were a species of grazing amphibians that were native to the planet Nyriaan and used as a staple food. Scientists were interested in how lluma herds apparently followed the paths of tempests.
Starveil was a starship that was used as an exploration vessel by the Galactic Republic.
Pherin were a species of omnivorous creature that were native to the planet Nyriaan.
The Invasion of Begeren was a major engagement between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War.

objective: Forcing Jagged Fel to step down as Imperial Remnant Head of State and
x: Operation Duusha was organized by Imperial Remnant Moff Drikl Lecersen in an attempt to advance his conspiracy with Kuat Senator Haydnat Treen to take over control of the galaxy.

Zsinj's Empire was a splinter faction of the Galactic Empire that ruled a vast region of space led by the warlord Zsinj between 4 and 8 ABY. It was established in the Quelii Oversector, where Zsinj was Grand Moff, before expanding outward from there.

conflict: None; Sith preparation for their invasion of the Galactic Republic
result: Barel Ovair is victorious and destroys the spirit of Naga Sadow
x: Around seventy-five years before the Great Galactic War, a lightsaber duel occurred on the Galactic Republic's capital world of Coruscant. The duel was fought between Jedi Master Barel Ovair and his former apprentice, the Nautolan Eison Gynt.
The Primal was a gunship that served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.
The Ultima was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer.
The Lugubraa were a sentient species native to the Stratos Distribution in the Unknown Regions.

t: Attack on the Trade Federation Research Station
result: B2 super battle droid plans stolen
x: This attack was launched by the Royal Naboo Security Forces after receiving intelligence about a Trade Federation Research Station. The Research Station was working on creating a new type of battle droid.

result: Barel Ovair fails to destroy Sadow's spirit
Eison Gynt is abandoned in the tomb
objective: Ostensibly to investigate the resting place of Naga Sadow, but in real
x: In 3756 BBY, the Human Jedi Master Barel Ovair and his Nautolan Padawan, Eison Gynt, set out on a mission to the fourth moon of the planet Yavin.
The Board of Tourism oversaw the tourism activities in the Panto system. Representation on the board was shared by the Tolos and the Lomin.

This landing meadow was located just outside the forest on the planet Dathomir. In 43.5 ABY, the Lost Tribe of Sith sent a team of Sith to retrieve Sith apprentice Vestara Khai from Dathomir, as well as a group of Nightsisters, whom they intended to convert into Sith.

Kampe was a Deep Core planet with a Type II atmosphere and an arid climate. By 12 ABY, Superior General Sander Delvardus, a warlord of the Galactic Empire, maintained a fortress in one of Kampe's labyrinthine canyons.

The Cupric Islands was a region on the planet Sriluur that was home to large portions of that world's agricultural sector. It was believed that the Islands' fertility was derived from the pheromones of the aro'ruul, which could aid plant growth.

result: Jolee Bindo defeats Nayama, but refuses to kill her and she escapes
x: This duel took place circa 3997 BBY, just before the Great Sith War. Jedi Padawans Jolee Bindo and Nayama, husband and wife as well as teacher and apprentice, were divided when Nayama wanted to abandon the Jedi Order and join Exar Kun's Brotherhood of the Sith.

result: Jedi strike team slays Tyris and his followers
x: This Duel on Susevfi occurred near the end of the Clone Wars, when a Jedi strike team traveled to Susevfi and attempted to turn a band of Sith cultists back to the light side of the Force. The cultists rebuffed and attacked them.

The Confrontation on Caprioril was a lightsaber duel that took place on the planet Caprioril between rogue Emperor's Hand-turned Swoop gang come-up flector Mara Jade and Lumiya, Dark Lady of the Sith, some time after the Battle of Endor.
In 4 ABY, former Emperor's Hand Lumiya confronted the Dark Jedi Flint in the one-time residence of the recently deceased Sith Lord Darth Vader for the right to Sith Mastery.
This criminal empire was run by crime lord Bogga the Hutt, and was based in the Stenness Node. At its height, around 3999 BBY, the empire stretched out six parsecs in any direction.

The Internal Safeguards Division (ISD), also known as the Imperial Safeguards Division, was a branch of the Imperial Military charged with ensuring that the galaxy was safe for Emperor Palpatine to travel.
Nal Kenuun's apartment was the home of the Muun gambler Nal Kenuun located on one of the tallest buildings in the city of Pilaan on the planet Muunilinst.
The Internal Security Police force was established to provide law enforcement duties for the New Regime on the planet of Brigia, prior to 1 BBY.
This attack on Bright Sun Hill took place in 43.5 ABY. In that year, the Raining Leaves and the Broken Columns Clans came together in a conclave to unite the clans into one clan.
Explume Minor, also referred to as simply Explume, was an astronomical object located in the star system of the same name, a part of the Unknown Regions' Croke Reach.
Hev was a continent, located in the south-western hemisphere of the planet Garnib, the Balinaka homeworld.

The Dellaltian Bank and Currency Exchange was the planetary banking institution for the planet Dellalt. The immense, empty structure of Xim the Despot's treasure chambers housed the main branch, located on the southernmost of the planet's three continents.

result: Twenty percent of Dac inhabitants are saved
End of the Genocide of Dac
x: The Evacuation of Dac was the action taken by the Galactic Alliance Remnant, the Fel Empire, the New Jedi Order and their allies in response to the Final Protocol administered by Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire to culminate the Genocide of Mon Calamari.
This cruiser was attacked by a Mandalorian saboteur. The Mandalorian was captured and later committed suicide to escape interrogation.

Laser Company was a clone trooper company of the Grand Army of the Republic that served under Jedi General Kit Fisto during the Clone Wars. By 21 BBY, the unit was severely depleted in an encounter on the planet Kessel, with trooper Checkers being the only clone survivor.
Desolation Peak was an outcropping of rock located in the middle of a lake outside the Emperor's ruling city on the planet Byss.

t: Unidentified planet (Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory)
x: A terrestrial planet of the Core Worlds, located near the Coruscant system, was the site of the Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory.

objective: Recover Xim the Despot's treasure
x: The Mission to Dellalt was the search for the missing log-recorder of the fabled Queen of Ranroon by the crew of the Millennium Falcon and her passengers.
The Nebalites were a species of starfighter-sized sentient cephalopod. Nebalites had starships constructed that enveloped their bodies like suits of clothing.

result: Death of a male Jedi; Kardem escapes
x: This duel took place in 22 BBY on the planet Perilious between a male Jedi and the former Jedi Knight Vydel Dir'Nul, who, unknowingly, was also the serial murderer Kardem.
The Jedi Temple medical bay, also known as the Temple infirmary, was a medical center located in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. The bay and its infirmary were staffed by the Medical Corps.
The Chokehold was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser that was used by the Galactic Empire during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The Auditor was an Imperial Customs Corvette that was used by the Galactic Empire during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Phinel's Folly was a small moon located in the Auril sector, in the Outer Rim Territories.

The Medepiest Uprising occurred at some point between 19 BBY and approximately 0 ABY and involved the Galactic Empire. During the uprising, Reginna Bel Typolla smuggled weapons before eventually returning to her homeworld, Malthor.

result: Rogue Squadron learns of the poisoning of Dac
x: A brief dogfight, fought between the Galactic Alliance Remnant's CF9 Crossfire starfighter unit Rogue Squadron and six Predator-class fighters of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, occurred above the planet Dac in 137 ABY.
The Blackstalker was a genetically-engineered offshoot of the Garral created by Imperial scientists expanding on the work of Luthos Garral.
Neo-Bespinians were a gaseous species native to the planet Bespin. They were an advanced civilization which lived in the low atmosphere of the planet.
Harte Secur Airbase was a military installation used by the Naboo Airforce, located southwest of the city Harte Secur. It harbored some of the planet Naboo's best pilots.

government: Nominally led by the Chief Administrator
x: 244Core, formerly Sraato, was an arid planet in the Unknown Regions known for its abundant and seemingly limitless resources.
Durace was a toxic, barren planet in a hostile region of space in the Unknown Regions. Although the atmosphere was breathable, Durace's hostile weather made colonization difficult.

Giaca was a lush, wild, world in the Unknown Regions, which was largely unspoiled by civilization. Although it was not a homeworld or colony for any particular species, it was not without intelligent inhabitants.

Bowcaster troopers, also referred to as bowcaster trooper recruits in their early training stages and heavy bowcaster recruits with even more training, were the basic infantry soldiers in armies of the Wookiee species.

The airship was a starship used by the Jedi. This ship belonged to the Agricultural Corps based on Dantooine. After the separatist attack on Dantooine, it was used by the Jedi to escape the planet and head for Coruscant.

IK-48 was Darth Vader's personal probe droid on the planet Otavon XII. During the early years of the New Order, IK-48 accompanied Vader into the planet's forest when the latter learned that the Ovoni rebels, who were disrupting the All Terrain Armored Transport factory with th…

Mugg Fallow was the presumed homeworld of Mnggal-Mnggal, deep in the Unknown Regions. The grey sludge that formed the being's body (or brain) covered almost the entire planet, with only lifeless continents and the remains of fossilized trees visible.

The stillsail was a type of membranous creature that lived in the Stratos Distribution, a vast Unknown Regions corridor of dust, asteroids made up of ice and mineral-rich rock, and forests of crystalline comet fronds.
The Voxen Tass was a modified Brayl-class bulk freighter that was operational during the Galactic Civil War. Captained by Leona Makk, the Voxen Tass was a ship from Shang Lines.

The Planetarium was a long chamber located at the base of the Tower of First Knowledge of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Situated next to the Tower's main entrance on the first level, it contained large bronzium replicas of several planetary bodies.

This attack on Khomm was a unilateral bombing of the Deep Core world of Khomm in 12 ABY by the United Warlord Fleets' Colonel Ivan Cronus, who commandeered the 13X and his fleet of Victory-class Star Destroyers under the orders of Admiral Natasi Daala.
An unnamed "super-weapon" was commissioned by the Galactic Empire, sometime around the Battle of Yavin, for development on Kamino.
Iope was the third moon of the planet Rinn, in the Baxel sector. It was here that the assassin X-7 hired a team of mercenary pilots to hunt down and kill Luke Skywalker.

objective: Place demolition charges in the Jedi Tower
x: In 3963 BBY, members of the Taris Resistance undertook a raid on the Jedi Tower on Taris as part of the battle against the planet's Mandalorian invaders.
Mount Dijandi was a mountain on the planet Otavon XII.
The Foundry Uprising was an event that took place in the galaxy by 3678 BBY. A Human combatant who fought in the uprising later served as a Republic guard for the governor of the planet Begeren.
Leilana's Dagger was a modified CloakShape fighter piloted by the male Phindian pilot and mercenary Jayn during the Galactic Civil War. The Dagger was named after Jayn's long-lost love.

The Commerce was a scouting vessel that was used by the Corporate Sector Authority. In 403 BBY, the vessel disappeared while attempting to make an orbital scan of the planet Nyriaan, in the Luire system.

side1: Lost Tribe of Sith (Yaru Korsin's faction)
side2: Lost Tribe of Sith (Seelah Korsin's faction)
result: Deaths of Yaru Korsin, Jariad Korsin and Gloyd
Seelah Korsin lost the use of her legs and was abandoned on the mounta
Nida Korsin became the new Grand Lord of the Lost Tribe of Sith
x: A duel took place near the Kesh Sith Temple in 4975 BBY when Seelah Korsin and her son, Jariad Korsin, attempted to avenge the death of Seelah's husband and Jariad's father, Devore, by killing Grand Lord Yaru Korsin, who had dueled and killed Devore twenty five years previously.
Temperance was a town located on the planet Nyriaan.

More than a thousand years before the Invasion of Naboo, the Jedi Council engaged the Anzat Dark Jedi Master Volfe Karkko in a lightsaber duel on the planet Kiffex. After a fierce duel, the Jedi were able to subdue Karkko.

objective: Locate and eliminate Dark Jedi Volfe Karkko
x: In 30 BBY, several Jedi Masters embarked on a mission to the planet Kiffex to prevent the Anzati Dark Jedi Volfe Karkko from escaping the planet. Masters Tholme, T'ra Saa, Quinlan Vos, and Zao successfully completed their mission with the death of Karkko at Vos' hand.

t: Assault on the DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant
x: This assault was led by a group of Rebel Alliance operatives and a band of Sekct on an Imperial hyperbaride synthesis plant on the planet Marca.
The Xaxax were an extinct sentient species, native to the Unknown Regions.

t: Raid on the New Jedi Temple
result: Galactic Alliance forces blockade the Temple
x: A Galactic Alliance-sanctioned raid on the Jedi Temple took place in 43.5 ABY. Several Jedi Knights had begun to fall prey to a Force psychosis, and the Alliance wanted the Jedi Order to turn over its affected Knights to government custody.
A venrap was a large purple snake native to the jungle-moon of Nallastia. Its venom was poisonous, and the powerful creature could crush to death a much larger being.

The Sun Runner was a 400-meter-long Corellia StarDrive Alpha-class heavy transport that went missing around 4000 BBY, when the Margrave Octan of the Darpa sector transported his family and 867 colonists to the Fondor moon of Nallastia, in the Tapani sector.
The Blazing Chain were nomadic raiders in the Unknown Regions in search of poorly defended settlements.

Coruscant Control was a space traffic central control for the Coruscant Security Force. It was in charge of monitoring the space traffic coming and leaving the Galactic Republic capital planet of Coruscant during the Great Galactic War and Cold War eras.
X-17-D was a protocol droid agent of the trader Grazdoc. He was unable to speak, but communicated through gestures.

Endelaan was a lost planet in the Unknown Regions that the Nebula organization believed would bring about the destruction of the galaxy if discovered. The crew of the starship Spiral Dancer was sent to find it.

This large scale execution happened after an attempt on Emperor Roan Fel's life by Darth Kruhl. The Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer Dauntless (which falsely surrendered to deliver the Sith and was to serve as his escape craft) was required to land and the personal ordered to exi…

result: Several Sith and Imperial stormtroopers killed
Crew of the Mynock learns that Isen is no longer on Daluuj
objective: Find and kill Vul Isen
x: In 138 ABY, during the Second Imperial Civil War, the crew of the pirate ship Mynock undertook a mission to the planet Daluuj, where they hoped to find and kill the Sith scientist Vul Isen.
RK-7 was a B1-series battle droid serving the Trade Federation during the Second Battle of Theed. He was the commander of ten other battle droids.

The Naboo Resistance were a group of loosely organized resistance cells created primarily by members of the Royal Naboo Security Forces. Acting largely independent from each other, the groups opposed the Trade Federation during their occupation of Naboo.
The Runner 309 was the starship of legendary scout Captain Nova, although both the ship and the captain were often dismissed as urban legend.

The Burning Gear was a starship that served in the Burning Gear flotilla, a part of the Ebruchi, the fleet of the eponymous species of pirates. The ship was the flagship of the Ebruchi Captain Ness and was equipped with engines and a hyperdrive.

Vagar Praxut was a remote planet located within the Vagar Praxut system. It lay in the Kharmort's Miasma nebula, a part of the galaxy's Unknown Regions. Vagar Praxut was the homeworld of the sentient Vagaari species.

headquarters: Gunninga Gap, deep in the Unknown Regions
x: The Knell of Muspilli was a death cult that dwelt among the moon-trees of the Gunninga Gap within the Unknown Regions. The Knell claimed to possess the ability to summon apocalyptic deities from the realm beyond shadows.

Rhand was a planet located deep within the Perann Nebula, in the Unknown Regions. Rhand was once inhabited by a species that disappeared before some members of the Knell of Muspilli, Kanzer Exiles, and Warriors of Shadow arrived on the planet.
Systino was a criminal syndicate operating in the Unknown Regions. In 4009 BBY, the syndicate discovered the planet 244Core, a world rich in valuable natural resources that they planned to exploit.
Relaali Zone One was the traditional capital of the planet 244Core.
Altiria/Anarris was a planet located within the Altiria/Anarris system in the Unknown Regions.

The Anarrians were a Near-Human species that evolved on the Unknown Regions planet Altiria/Anarris. They were a militaristic species, placing great importance on the strength of one's body and on the physical aspects of life.

Cerdana was the capital city of the Altiri species on the planet Altiria/Anarris. Cerdana, considered the pinnacle of Altiri society and culture, was strategically located along the shores of the planet's longest river. Cerdana was considered by some to be strikingly beautiful.

C-069 was a protocol droid seen in the Senate along with senator Mee Deechi. He was later serving drinks to Deechi and Senator Burtoni when Padmé Amidala and Bail Prestor Organa came to talk to them about Onaconda Farr's death.
The Bombing of the Senate Tower was an act of terrorism that occurred on the Galactic Republic's capital world of Coruscant in 3653 BBY—just days after the end of the Great Galactic War.

R4-D5 was an R-series astromech droid. R4 served in both the Clone Wars aboard an Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter, then later in the Galactic Civil War aboard a BTL Y-wing starfighter. R4 was present for the Battle of Yavin.

The Haserians were a sentient species, native to the Haseria system in the Mid Rim. Around 18 BBY, a group of young Coruscanti Haserians played a game of shockball against a group of similar aged Rodians.
In 23 BBY, one year before the start of the Clone Wars, Groodo the Hutt created a copy of the ancient starship the Sun Runner in a scheme to destroy the Fondor Shipyards.

place: Fondor system, including the planet Fondor and its jungle-moon Nallast
result: Groodo the Hutt's scheme to destroy the Fondor Shipyards, Fondor Space
x: The Mission to Fondor was undertaken in 23 BBY by the Jedi Knights Obi-Wan Kenobi and Bultar Swan, as well as Kenobi's Padawan Anakin Skywalker.
The Resurgence was a Sienar Fleet Systems Curich-class shuttle owned by Lord Dixton, recently-named Governor General of the Fakir sector as of 0 ABY.
The capital of Orto was located on Orto. It was occupied by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, and played host to the undercover operations of Jedi Knight Nem Bees.

Volik was a temperate planet with rocky terrain that was located within the Unknown Regions' Volik system. The planet's surface was dominated by expansive grasslands and small mountain ranges, as well as numerous canyons and waterfalls.

place: Hoth system and several other star systems
x: The Battle of Hoth was a major naval battle that occurred in 3665 BBY, during the second decade of the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.
The 535th Assault Wing was a walker unit in the Imperial military. The Star Destroyer Avenger was the home base of this unit.

Kurdavvia was a planet in the Core Worlds of the galaxy known for its bright sunrises. Princess Kalieva K'ntarr's face lit up like one when Sienn Sconn agreed to help her gain passage off of Rydonni Prime.

The Pirate Confederation was an organization that existed during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. During that time, they sought candidates who were willing to test a proposed smuggling route through the Deep Core.

Colonial Station Chaf was a terrestrial planet within the territory of the Chiss Ascendancy in the Unknown Regions. It shared its name with the Chaf family, one of the Nine Ruling Families of the Chiss Ascendancy.
Mount Vorena was a mountain that was located on the planet Volik.

Ord Dalet was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Sertar sector. It was a Galactic Republic Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost established no earlier than the time of the Old Sith Wars and was named after the letter "dalet" from the Common Sith writing system.

Iron Cesta Flight was a squadron of the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps and was piloted exclusively by Gungans. The squadron patrolled the Naboo system for pirates preying upon the traffic between Naboo and the Ohma-D'un colony.
The Insanity Claws was a Z-95 Headhunter, that was owned by the Zabrak slaver Haast Aath.

objective: Put droids produced by the factory under covert Republic control
x: The Mission to Cularin was a mission that took place during the Clone Wars.

The Liberation was an uprising that took place on Klatooine in 44 ABY. Millennia earlier, a treaty was made between the Klatooinians and the Hutts—the Klatooinians submitted themselves to eternal servitude to the Hutts, so long as the Hutts protected the Fountain of Ancients, …

Puloorn was a snow-covered planet located in the Outer Rim Territories's Spinward sector. It was the site of an ancient, ruined Sith temple that was inhabited both by creatures twisted by the dark side of the Force and by a group of cultists.

T7-O1, known affectionately as Teeseven or T7, was a T7-series astromech droid active during the Great Galactic War, the Cold War, and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Penguins were a sentient species flightless bird.
The Rockhound was a BramDorc Corporation Colossus I Beta Series asteroid tug owned by Lando Calrissian.
New Brampis was the site of the New Brampis Starship Museum.
Freedom Flight was an organization secretly created by Moff Drikl Lecersen in 38 ABY with the false objective of the elimination of slavery throughout the galaxy.
The Starstalker was a Corporate Sector Authority ChaseMaster frigate in use in the Lost Tribe of Sith's armada by 44 ABY.

The Winged Dagger was a Corporate Sector Authority ChaseMaster frigate serving under Captain Syndor in the Lost Tribe of Sith's armada around 44 ABY. That year, command of the Winged Dagger was given to Leeha Faal, with Syndor as second-in-command.
RN8, or Ornate, was a Cybot Galactica protocol droid crewmember of Lando Calrissian's ship Rockhound.
The Battle of Duinarbulon was fought between the pirates of Xer and the Kingdom of Cron in the Pre-Republic era, at the planet Duinarbulon.

Barancar was a planet located within the Tion Cluster. It was a part of the Kingdom of Cron, and was eventually conquered by Xer VIII. It was the site of numerous shipyards under Xim's Empire, which were used construct starships.

result: Nek Bwua'tu hospitalized in a comatose state
x: The attempted assassination of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu took place on Coruscant in 44 ABY. Galactic Alliance Admiral Nek Bwua'tu was attacked by two assassins, sent by General Merratt Jaxton, pretending to be psychotic Jedi.

A base established by the Trade Federation was disabled and attacked by the Royal Naboo Security Forces early in the Invasion of Naboo. The base had extensive defenses and was controlled by the Trade Federation comm web through Comm 4, an orbital satellite.

N-4PO was a protocol droid, that operated during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Syned One was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Syned system of the Grumani sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It shared its name with the planet Syned, which was also in the Syned star system.
C4K0 was a protocol droid that operated during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Roccus was a planet in the Roccus system that was home to one of Twin Suns Transport Services' service platforms.
A planet existed during the New Sith Wars. The Sith Master Finn and his apprentice traveled there and destroyed a building after concluding business with an individual.

The Devastation of Da Soocha occurred during the Second Imperial Civil War in 137 ABY when the Sith Empire's First Sith Imperial Strikeforce unleashed deadly toxins on the watery world of Da Soocha and bombarded the Hutt Temple Maya Armus on its moon Napdu.
The mining safety committee was an organization that was responsible for a shortage of Nolarian 6000 drills in 39 BBY. On the planet Nolar, Quermian Dr.

RC-1Z was a protocol droid who belonged to the Ithorian swooper Draknus during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, RC-1Z, along with RC-2X and RC-3T, helped Draknus to manage the Mos Entha race track on the planet Tatooine.

RC-2X was a protocol droid who belonged to the Ithorian swooper Draknus during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, RC-1Z, along with RC-1Z and RC-3T, helped Draknus to manage the Mos Entha race track on the planet Tatooine.

RC-3T was a protocol droid who belonged to the Ithorian swooper Draknus during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, RC-1Z, along with RC-1Z and RC-2X, helped Draknus to manage the Mos Entha race track on the planet Tatooine.

A moon orbited the planet of Otavon XII, the homeworld of the Ovoni species situated in the Otavon system of the Hollan sector, which was located in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. The moon orbited alongside another natural satellite.
A moon orbited the planet of Otavon XII, the homeworld of the Ovoni species situated in the Otavon system of the Hollan sector, which was located in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim.

The skirmish on Eriadu took place in 33 BBY shortly before the Eriadu Trade Summit. During a meeting with Havac, the leader of the Nebula Front, the pirate Arwen Cohl stated that he would not allow Havac to use his men simply to distract the Jedi, knowing it would mean their d…
The Sernpidal Enforcers were security personnel who operated on the planet Sernpidal during the time of the Jedi Civil War, when the world was under the jurisdiction of Darth Revan's Sith Empire.

Coruscant Fire and Rescue was the organization that provided fire fighting and rescue services to the population of Galactic City on Coruscant during the time of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances.

Zevanth Street was a street that was located on the planet Coruscant. When the Besalisk chef Dexter Jettster first arrived on the planet Coruscant, he opened the stand Dex's Donuts on the corner of Zevanth Street and Avenue Peth.

Avenue Peth was a street on the planet Coruscant. When the Besalisk chef Dexter Jettster first arrived on the planet, he opened a small donut shop called Dex's Donuts on the corner of Zevanth Street and Avenue Peth.

Lenico IV was a planet in the Lenico system of the Outer Rim Territories. Its barren surface presented ruins and others desolated places, like the Ash Plains. Numerous space station colonies such as Lenico Colony Blue remained in its orbit.
The Grace of Chapalan Tides was a Thranta-class warship in service to the Navy of the Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War.

x: The Battle of Yag'Dhul occurred in 5 ABY and was the first engagement between the New Republic and Warlord Sander Delvardus.

The Orbital Advertisement Ring was a conglomeration of a vast number of revolving billboards that had gathered around the planet Vulpter. This massive ring of debris, primarily made up of old advertising materials, choked out natural sunlight.
The Tammuz-an capital city was the center of administration of the planet Tammuz-an.

This mission was carried out by the elite New Republic commando unit Lando's Commandos shortly after the Battle of Endor in an attempt to halt operations by a pirate group consisting of former TIE/IN interceptor pilots.
The Protectorate was a group of sixteen stormtroopers and bodyguards of Imperial governor Wilek Nereus.
Air Avab was a floating city that was located on the gas planet Genarius, in the Cularin system. The cantina CANTINA was located inside the city.

The Sand Splitters were a group of criminals who operated on the planet Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. The Human Saul Rouse and the Trandoshan Erib Kurrugh were both members of the organization.

Elso Magua was a settlement that was located on the planet Genarius, in the Cularin system. In c. 31 BBY, the Believers Sith cult had elements of their organization operating in Elso Magua, and the Jedi Order was aware of the cult's presence there.
Consisting of at least three Sith–Imperial attack ships, Quad Victor was a bomber squadron that served in the Navy of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War.
In 21 BBY, pirate forces attacked Alderaanian Senator Bail Prestor Organa while he was en route to the Galactic Republic's capital world, Coruscant.
Z-Ram was an Assassin-class corvette that attacked Emperor Palpatine's personal C-3 passenger liner Excalibur during the Galactic Civil War.
Rowdy was Jaina Solo's R9-series astromech droid and co-pilot of her StealthX starfighter when she left Coruscant to assist Luke Skywalker and Ben Skywalker in their assault against Abeloth.
The first contact between the Duinuogwuin and the Galactic Republic was made in 15,000 BBY, during the Indecta Era.

BD-34 was a B1-series battle droid that operated during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, BD-34 served Jabba the Hutt's criminal empire on Tatooine under Jabba's sadistic EV-series supervisor droid EV-9D9.

RA-316 was an RA-7 protocol droid that operated during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, RA-316 served Jabba the Hutt's criminal empire on Tatooine under Jabba's sadistic EV-series supervisor droid EV-9D9.

R3-B57 was an R3-series astromech droid that operated during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, R3-B57 served Jabba the Hutt's criminal empire on Tatooine under Jabba's sadistic EV-series supervisor droid EV-9D9.
Kahmurra Biogenetic Research Station was a bio-engineering laboratory located on Talus where scientists created the kahmurra species.

Void was a silver protocol droid owned by the smuggler Roa. Void had escaped the Red Knights of Life on Rhommamool, but the event was so traumatizing he needed a memory wipe to function again. The wipe cost Roa 500 credits, more than Void cost.

t: Confrontation on the Stenness Hyperspace Terminal
x: This confrontation occurred on the Stenness Hyperspace Terminal in 3999 BBY, when crime lord Bogga the Hutt sent a group of his enforcers to steal a package of Adegan crystals from Jedi Knight Andur Sunrider and his family.
Durbin was a village located on the Twin World of Talus. After being overrun by wild creatures, it was known as the Lost Village of Durbin.
Jalarren was a planet in the Senex sector of the Mid Rim.
G12-4J was a 2-1B surgical droid that operated in the Death Watch bunker during the Galactic Civil War.
WED15-I643 was a WED Treadwell workshop droid that operated out of the Death Watch bunker on Endor during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Boro-borosa III was a planet in the Boro-borosa system with three suns. The system was a minor Garonnin possession with mining operations in three asteroid belts and the planetary ring.

A sentient species of humanoids stood over 4 meters tall and had shaggy blue-black fur. They had black skin with black, gleaming eyes and flat noses. Their mouths featured sharp canine teeth. The species had two sexes, male and female.

Varadan was a Mid Rim world of the Senex sector. It orbited two stars and was very hot. Controlled by the aristocratic Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex region, it served as a mining world and employed enslaved labor.
O'reen was an Unknown Regions planet with a surface featuring thick fog and tall mesas and plateaus. It was inhabited by the near-Human O'reenians.
Iol was a lifeless planet in the Unknown Regions.

Little Talhovi was a world located in the Little Talhovi system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane connected it to the Talhovi system.
Veroleem was a planet in the Unknown Regions.

The Corellian Trade Summit was a major summit held in Coronet City, Corellia in 18 ABY. Attended by New Republic Chief of State Leia Organa Solo, it was disrupted by the Sacorrian Triad's Starbuster Plot.
Novar was a planet in the Expansion Region. On the 1,000th year since the world was settled, a large tract of land was turned over to House Korden.
The avka was a large avian predator native to the planet Durace in the Unknown Regions.

Shard Test Site was a Galactic Republic military facility on the remote planet Eredenn Prime. It was located near Eredenn Station and was used, along with the Facet Test Site, to test the secret Decimator weapon.

The Facet Test Site was a Galactic Republic military facility on the remote planet Eredenn Prime. It was located near Eredenn Station and was used, along with the Shard Test Site, to test the secret Decimator weapon.

objective: To capture or kill Lando Calrissian
x: An ambush was set up by the bounty hunter Bossk in 1 ABY in order to capture Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian, who had come into possession of Cloud City by winning it from Dominic Raynor in a game of sabacc.
Fixer One was a droid that operated during the Galactic Civil War.
The hands of doom were battle droids produced in the Neimoidian droid factory on Mustafar. They defended the droid known as the Doom Bringer that was the main guardian of the factory.
Buchich was a planet located in the Buchich system, a part of the Calamari sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was linked by a hyperlane to the Krinemonen system.
The Price of Liberty was a Rebel assault gunboat that operated during the Galactic Civil War.

The garbage hunters were non-sentient creatures native to the Deep Core planet Vulpter. The species evolved in response to the planet's extremely polluted environment and serves as a striking example of how scale and surroundings can shape evolution.
The seizure of Moorja occurred in 4 ABY when the New Republic wrested control of the Inner Rim planet Moorja from the control of Warlord Sander Delvardus.
The Twilight Sun was a Rebel assault gunboat that operated during the Galactic Civil War.

According to Kaminoan legend, the kikla were a sentient species of tiny water dwellers on the planet Kamino. They swarmed together to challenge the significantly larger god-beast Protas for rule over the oceans of Kamino.

According to the Kaminoan legend "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod," the Ancient Trench was an underwater trench located on the planet Kamino and was the site of a battle between the monster-god Protas and the sentient kikla.

Thalina was an underwater ridge on the planet Kamino, according to the Kaminoan legend "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod." In the tale, Thalina was the location where the god-beast Protas and the sentient titan Melkorr battled.

x: The monster-god Protas was destroyed by an aiwha pod after he defeated an army of sentient kikla. According to "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod," it took place on the planet of Kamino.
FA-2PO was a protocol droid that operated during the Galactic Civil War. He was part of the crew of the Jawa Sand Crawler 345.

The BBQ droid was a B1-series battle droid of the Trade Federation of Planets that acted as a cooking droid and had begun operation by 32 BBY. He was deployed whenever members of the Neimoidian species who were affiliated with the Trade Federation became hungry.
A skirmish in the Horuz system occurred in 0 BBY shortly after the Death Star destroyed the planet Despayre and left the Horuz system.
X3D-IO was an administrative protocol droid. It was roughly humanoid in appearance with a covering of highly polished silver chromite.
The East River was one of the two rivers that framed Salis D'aar, capital city of Bakura, the other being the West River.
The Silver Cratsch was a modified YT-2400 light freighter owned by Bix Arden-Govia.
During the Galactic Civil War, a battle over the mines took place on the planet Begeren.
A slopewing was a creature that was used in the herding of such creatures as nerfs and naugas. The slopewing could be found on Corellia, where Wedge Antilles rode one in farm school.

A nauga was a type of livestock that could be found on Corellia. Slopewings or thaks could be used to herd naugas, as Wedge Antilles did in farm school. Ranches raising the animals could also be found in Hollowtown on Centerpoint Station.
Hanod was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Hanod system, a part of the Corva sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Old Quarter was a location within the capital of the Core Worlds planet Grizmallt. Street signs in the Old Quarter were written in the Royal Script of Grizmallt, an oval-based writing system.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic evacuation without losses
x: The Battle of Xyquine II was fought during the Galactic Civil War, when Cracken's Flight Group under Pash Cracken covered the evacuation of the Rebel base on Xyquine II without taking a single loss. During the battle, Cracken invented the Cracken Twist.
Impending Doom was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Starfleet.
Priva was the smaller of Altiria/Anarris' two moons and was the brightest natural satellite in the planet's night sky.
Secava was the larger of Altiria/Anarris' two moons.
Shalla was a colony of Altiri, on the moon of Priva, named after a goddess of peace worshipped early in Altiri history.
In the early days of the Great Galactic War, the Galactic Republic suffered several successive losses to the newly-discovered reconstituted Sith Empire in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Barpotomous Drebble's headquarters was the home of Captain Barpotomous Drebble in the capital city of the planet Stenos. As the leader of a substantial portion of the capital, Drebble ran his business out of the building, and his supporters guarded the building inside and out.
Stellan was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Hunnoverrs sector. It was the homeworld of the Stellan species, whose society was governed by a theocracy.

The Tocan system disaster was a battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. The Empire's Tierfon Sector Fleet was victorious, although a number of Alliance starfighters survived and retreated to Ghorman to recuperate.
A species of sentients native to Yavin 8 were targeted by Galactic Emperor Palpatine for extermination. Tarron Neb was the sole survivor.
V3-FX was a protocol droid who operated during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he operated out of the city of Moenia on the planet Naboo.

C-2V9 was a one-meter tall 2V9 cargo lifter droid produced by Industrial Automaton. It was cylindrical and hovered on repulsorlifts. The droid was equipped with a computer jack, high pitch acoustic signaller, broad-band antenna receiver, and a durasteel lifting arm.
This species of walking plants were grown in soil and used as laborers by the corrupt miner Torkil Mux.

Udrin Cara was a secret Imperial military design center in the Mid Rim. Jeres Moridon was stationed there as a researcher, where he was exposed to Maladeria II, a toxic gas that was being researched at the facility for possible military applications.

Vo Tunbren was a planet in the Tadra sector a subsector of the Cegul sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the location of an Imperial communications research facility where Jeres Moridon was stationed.

Adras was a Galactic Empire–held world located in the Outer Rim Territories' Seswenna sector. Shortly before the Battle of Endor, a team of Sullustan Alliance Intelligence officers was tasked with meeting another group of Rebel Alliance agents in order to lead a group of comba…
The Crecsent was an Alderaanian passenger freighter owned by Nuun Pargen.

x: Effcee was a female-programming droid working along with Deeve and Jarsa, two scouts of the Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services, and traveling with them in the bureau's NRSS Founder in a mission to scout several planets in search of useful resources.

x: REM-02, or AreeEm-OhToo was a hovering droid developed by Industrial Automaton to perform analysis of soil and atmosphere. It was small enough to be carried in a backpack, and it was designed to self-protect itself, avoiding dangers while it performed scout duties.

C4-ZX was a protocol droid active during the Galactic Civil War sometime after 0 BBY. The droid was owned by the Jawa trader Ji'Ni Sil. The droid stood with its master at the Jawa Mountain Fortress on the planet of Tatooine.

Antares Draco's quarters were located on the Empire-in-exile's fortress world of Bastion and were the personal quarters of Antares Draco, the leader of the Imperial Knights. They included a bed, as well as a table surrounded on three sides by a bench.
During the Great Galactic War, a duel between Teneb Kel and Exal Kressh occurred on Lenico Colony Blue, a hospital space station orbiting the dead world of Lenico IV.
Derellium was a planet located within the Cronese Mandate of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Chambers of Persuasion, also known as the Inquisition Chambers, were chambers within the Temple of the One Sith on Korriban.
A battle was fought at Heterkus during the Galactic Civil War.

Heterkus was a planet in the Heterkus system, located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Around 0 BBY, the Galactic Empire's Commander Westen of the Relentless clashed with Adar Tallon and the Rebel Alliance at Heterkus.
Julio was a planet in the Julio system within the Marcol sector. It was known for its mountainous environment.
Fornow was a planet within the Fornow system in the Pacanth Reach of the Outer Rim Territories.
Ravaath was a planet within the Ravaath system in the Pacanth Reach of the Outer Rim Territories.
Sorimow was a planet within the Sorimow system in the Pacanth Reach of the Outer Rim Territories.
The tangler tree was a species of tree that grew on the planet Naboo. Considered to be a docile species, the tangler tree had tentacle-like vines and branches that intermingled with other plants.

The capital city of Haxim's province on Falleen was the location of an Imperial bacteriological research outpost. After a flesh-eating bacterium was accidentally released, the city was destroyed by the Empire in an attempt to contain the spread of the bacterium.

During the early years of the New Republic, an Imperial-backed insurgency in the Illoud system threatened the stability of the region. A New Republic force, commanded by Huoba Neva, succeeded in eliminating the insurgency.
This unidentified Imperial service droid was in the possession of an Imperial scout. When the scout was forced to make an emergency landing on Seoul 5, the service droid repaired his ship.
The battle of Agora was a conflict during the Clone Wars fought between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Freedom's Sons, a pro-Republic vigilante group.
During the Clone Wars, Jedi and pirate forces engaged one another near the Outer Rim world of Varonat.

In 470 BBY, the Core World of Corellia attempted to secede from the Galactic Republic to become an independent system. The leaders of the independence movement went as far as invoking Contemplanys Hermi, which withdrew its membership from the Galactic Senate.
The Widows of Alderaan Educational Consortium was an educational organization from the planet Alderaan that was active during the reign of the New Republic.

result: Destruction of the Sixela system and the death of Rezi Soresh
x: A battle in 0 ABY took place in the Sixela system as a result of the machinations of Imperial Commander Rezi Soresh. Soresh had fled the Empire and searched for 27 days for a safe haven. Arriving in the Sixela system, he used his data to regain his power.
During the Galactic Civil War, the smuggler Roark Garnet fought an Imperial for control of a bathysphere in the atmosphere of a Jovian gas giant.

A large training dojo was built during the Clone Wars by the Jedi Order on sublevel nineteen of the Jedi Temple. It was built to replicate the many different terrains Jedi might find themselves in during the war.

objective: To steal Darth Vader's helmet
x: At some point following the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, a group of Rebels led by Han Solo infiltrated the Super Star Destroyer Executor and stole Darth Vader's helmet.
A flying life form lived in the atmosphere of a Jovian gas giant.

A humanoid species was little-known throughout the galaxy. Members of the species lacked visible ears and had a flat nose and a ridge on the brow. At least some of them had red eyes and orange-brown skin. They also had hair that could be brown.
Chaitun was the first planet orbiting the star Sriluur in the Sriluur system. Located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim, it was a searing rock.
Weitun was the second planet orbiting the star Sriluur in the Sriluur system. Located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a searing rock.
Alcrue was the third planet orbiting the star Sriluur in the Sriluur system. Located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim, it was a searing rock.
Lyntra was the fourth planet orbiting the star of Sriluur in the Sriluur system. Located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim, it was a barren rock.
Quay Lyn was an asteroid belt between the planets Alcrue and Lyntra in the Sriluur system.

Verig was a primitive planet home to a group of native nomadic hunters. During the Galactic Civil War, Rebel Alliance tactician Beryl Chiffonage traveled to Verig and drew inspiration from the planet's nomads, who used a bola-like weapon to trip the large Pryss-creatures, to d…
The planet Verig was home to a group of primitive native nomadic hunters. They used a bola-like weapon, a long rope with stones tied to each end, to trip the large, elephantine Pryss-creatures.

Lubang Minor was a jungle planet widely considered nameless located in the Illisurevimurasi sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Lubang Minor was the site of a Clone Wars battle that stranded clone trooper BL-1707, known as Able.

The Mission to Jazbina was a mission undertaken by Luke Skywalker on the planet Jazbina to rescue Princess Syayna. The mission was in fact a trap organized by Lord Prepredenko to capture local Rebels.
The Worthless Fool was a VR-10 Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-class spacetug belonging to the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It was captained by Maytoc Kollene.
Dibrook was an uninhabitable planet in the Albarrio sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
An Imperial-class Star Destroyer captained by Dirk Balor was patrolling the Lapez system in 3 ABY. The Human replica droid Altin Wuho and his nightmare demon Reist were stationed aboard the ship.
A battle took place during the first year of the Yuuzhan Vong War over the planet Dibrook. The Yuuzhan Vong attacked the Dibrook Space Station, but were fought off when the Heart of Artorias arrived.

This dead red moon lay in the Sixela system, in the Outer Rim Territories. Orbiting the third planet in the system, the moon's terrain consisted entirely of barren red rock, without any flora or fauna to break up the terrain, although the atmosphere could support life.

Nyemari was a planet. By 1 ABY, the planet's capital city Anem had the most modern, sophisticated spaceport in the Meridian sector. The planet was also host to Galactic Empire military installation. The indigenous species was the Nyemarians.

After the destruction of the Death Star, Darth Vader had begun developing a new secret weapon for the Galactic Empire. Meanwhile, in the Rebel Alliance, some rumors have grown concerning "ghost ships" attacking Rebel patrols.
The chubafly was a species of flying creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of chuba.
Kenosha was a planet in the Expansion Region, known for its cliffs.
The mission to Mrlsst occurred when Imperial forces attacked Mrlsst in 4 ABY to recover the Phantom Project and were repulsed by Rogue Squadron.
The Tatooine Campaign occurred in 4 ABY. Rogue Squadron faced off against Imperial Captain Marl Semtin and crime lord Firith Olan for the control of the secret Eidolon Base.

A battle took place on the planet Abonshee in 0 ABY during the Galactic Civil War. While the Reekeene's Roughnecks of the Rebel Alliance were discussing an alliance with the leader of the Anointed People of Abonshee, Godking Trisstan, a damaged Imperial shuttle transporting th…
The Eiattu Campaign occurred when the forces of the People's Liberation Battalion attacked the Galactic Empire's citadel on Eiattu 6.

The Malrev incident occurred when Rogue Squadron was sent to search for the missing ship Starfaring. They were attacked by the native Irrukiine under the mental control of Cartariun, user of Sith magic.

x: The Rescue Mission to Dibrook took place shortly after the Battle of Dibrook. Its goal was to free refugees captured by the Yuuzhan Vong during the battle.
Magresh was one of the two moons orbiting the planet Ergeshui. Along with Sagresh, Magresh caused huge variations in the tide on Ergeshui.
Sagresh was one of the two moons orbiting the planet Ergeshui. Along with Magresh, Sagresh caused huge variations in the tide on Ergeshui.
Queesh was one of the two continents on the planet Ergeshui. It was the location of the Communal Pool, the political center of the Ergesh species.
During the Imperial Era, a group of farmers on Dantooine helped a hidding Falon Grey from being discovered by the Galactic Empire. These rebels opposed the Imperial forces in a short battle there.

This clone army was created by X1, a former clone trooper who had become a Sith Lord, in order to conquer the galaxy. The clones were created in X1's laboratory on Mustafar, and X1 captured Luke Skywalker in order to clone an army of Dark Jedi.

Prior to the onset of the Great Sith War, a lightsaber duel occurred on the planet Vigil, between the Sith apprentices Xash and Sindra, and the Dark Jedi Lian Dray. Dray won the duel, after he slew the Sith siblings while defending his charge, a young girl named Nova.

Sebaddon was a small world in the Mid Rim of the the galaxy.

Clunker was a strong and resilient J8O soldier droid owned by smuggler Jet Nebula during the Cold War. The first time Jet saw him, he tried to fix his vocoder, but Clunker then broke it again. Clunker communicated with his master using military hand signals.

The mission to Sevarcos II was a diplomatic mission to the planet Sevarcos II assigned to the Jedi Knight Jang Li-Li. It was her first diplomatic mission as a Jedi and prior to leaving, she asked Count Dooku, a senior Jedi, for advice.
Gorta was the first planet of Gorsh system in Wild Space. It was a desolate searing rock.
Gorlan was the second planet of Gorsh system in Wild Space. It was a searing desert with one moon.
Widow's Valley was a valley located near the capital city of Theed on the planet Naboo. Several pinnacles could be found there, and a canyon was at one end.
In 22 BBY, when the Galactic Republic was chafing with a militant secessionist faction, the Mid Rim world of Cadinth took the Republic's side.

Grall was a planet located in the Joralla system, a part of the Mektrun sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. Grall occupied the second orbital position around its sun, the red giant–type star Jaska, and had no moons.
Masposhani was a planet in the Mid Rim. According to Beldorion the Hutt, the Jedi Order had once maintained a training facility in its caves.

A cruiser was used by Jedi General Rii'ke En during the Battle of Honoghr in the Clone Wars.
Assessor was an Imperial Customs Frigate patrolling the Thorgeld system. It attempted to stop the Dorion Discus light freighter, but it escaped.

The Stelaciter was an Iskallon Light Frigate in service of the Iskalloni after the Battle of Endor.

After the cyborg Iskalloni enslaved Imperial ambassodors, the Empire retaliated by launching an attack on the planet Iskadrell. The planet was half-destroyed, but the attack was repelled by the Iskalloni.

The bimiza tree was a species of tall, fragrant tree that grew on Garqi, a lush agriworld in the Cassandran Worlds. The trees grew prolifically, forming large rainforests, leading the native Garqians to practice slash-and-burn techniques to clear areas of land.
This gang of outlaws was led by Byrch Dyshkava. They had a hideout.

A Duros family lived on the planet Duro during the time of the Dark Wars. These Duros were a politically connected family, unlike their rivals—a bounty hunter group known as the Zhug brothers—who were cast out from Duro after their violent, failed attempt to take out this family.
The Mining Corps was a branch of the Galactic Empire that was formed in response to the need for raw materials and natural resources for the Empire's vast manufacturing ventures.
The senoti was a species of tree native to the Outer Rim world New Canistel. The deep-rooted trees required an alkaline soil in which to grow, and produced a sap that was used for medicinal purposes.

A species of green reptile lived on Garqi, an agriworld located in the Cassandran Worlds. The reptile had four limbs, which each terminated in three digits, and a long, dexterous tail that it could wrap around tree branches.

During the Clone Wars, Jedi Master Toluz Cheq possessed an R3-series astromech droid. The droid was destroyed along with its owner during a battle against Confederate Vulture droids in the Rial Kroon system around 21 BBY.
