A small, flying species was native to Garqi, an agriworld in the Cassander sector. The species was small; less than the size of a young Human's hand. It had a segmented body of a pinkish coloration and four jointed legs.
The tall trees growing on the Outer Rim agriworld Biitu had light-colored bark and green leaves. They produced orange fruit consumable by both the native Biituians and reptiles.
MK221, also known as Emmy-Kaye, was an attendant and nanny droid who served five generations of the N'Vaari family. MK221 was owned by Brinaloy N'Vaari during the New Order.

The planet Biitu was home to a species of crop-producing plant. Nestled among green leaves, the plant grew a cylindrical crop, yellow in color. The native Biituians cultivated these plants in large fields and harvested their crops.

A species of bird was native to Biitu, an agriworld in the Cassander sector. It had a plump body and a tapering tail, which was about the same length as its body. On each side of this body, it sported a wing, with which it was capable of flight.

This B1-series battle droid participated in the Battle of Saleucami. After being ordered by General Grievous, he opened fire on a Republic light cruiser before telling his troops to board a landing craft.

A species of fowl lived on Garqi, an agriworld located in the Cassander sector. The fowl had a small body, with a tail several times its length. This was divided into three, circular-tipped, central tail feathers.
The Ulorins were the native species of the planet Dela III, in the Centrality.

During the Clone Wars, after the people of the planet Valahari refused to stop supplying the Confederacy of Independent Systems with advanced engines for their starfighters, the Galactic Republic established a blockade of the world.

The Barabi Run was originally a legitimate Mobquet medium transport named the Moonlight Cruise until Mika the Hutt had her renamed.
Moonstruck Pass was the mountain pass outside of the city Galu on the planet Gala where Elan and the Hill people drove off the Beju-Tallah dynasty forces led by Lonnag Giba.

The balyeg was a large reptilian creature that preyed on the pardlam. Bounty hunter Jango Fett considered it one of the scariest creatures in the galaxy. Hoping to teach his son Boba not to fear, Fett took him to the balyeg's planet and ordered him to get the creature's tooth.

Sludgegulpers were flying droids that came in a variety of designs. The droids were popular with pirates due to their sinister-looking appearance and ability to commandeer starships by attaching themselves to the outside and eating through the hull.
The Battle of Oseon was a minor skirmish between the Millennium Falcon and the Renatasian Confederation, in the year 3 BBY.
The Centrality Navy was the naval branch of the Centrality Council, in a remote and independent sector in the Outer Rim of the galaxy.
A winged creature with reptavian characteristics had a long neck, horned head, red wings and a long tail.
This planet was the home to the balyeg creature. It was also inhabited by the pardlam.
Breshig was an Outer Rim Territories world situated in the Mandalore sector. Home to the trill beast creatures, it became a part of space controlled by the Mandalorian warrior culture.

The Vigor was a Corellian gunship that was used by the Peace Brigade during the Yuuzhan Vong War. At some point, the Vigor and the Peace Brigade YV-929 armed freighter Blunt Force approached the refugee ship Wanderhome and Bunurrut, the captain of the Vigor contacted the Wande…
Kajidier was the name of a Hutt clan from Nal Hutta.
Reykos was the most common beast on the planet Volik. It was a docile herd animal similar to a bantha.

J9-6 was a Roche J9 worker drone that was for sale at Jawa Traders in Mos Eisley during the Galactic Civil War.

The Jackhack Slough was an ancient dried-up riverbed located in the Jasserak Lowlands on Drongar.
Zephyr Base, best known as the Rebel Outpost, was a Rebel military outpost on Rori.

Bay of Conquest, formerly known as the Ja-Phelar Bay, was a sea located between the city of Phelar and the Ja highlands on the planet Eriadu. The Phelar Floe river flows into the Bay of Conquest from the south.
The Stormwind was a Victory-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy and was commanded by Captain Jarroth during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
The Webweaver caverns was an underground cavern found beneath the Nawataa Waterfall in the Kkowir Forest on the planet Kashyyyk. The cavern was infested by spiders.

The Jasserak Highlands was a plateau located on Tanlassa continent of the planet Drongar near the Qarohan Steppes that formed the border of the Jasserak Lowlands. The plateau was filled with a strange type of fungus-like tree that produced avedame fruit.
The bombardment of Falleen was undertaken by the Galactic Empire to stop the spread of a flesh-eating bacterium.

Jaxus was a planet that supported life despite orbiting closely to its sun.
Jedi Jewels was the name given to a pair of young Jedi Knights alive during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

The battle of Chandrila was a conflict during the First Great Schism fought between the Jedi, and thus, the Republic, and the Legions of Lettow, under General Xendor. Most historians assumed the Jedi were the victors.

The jemians were petite birds that had been domesticated and raised for their delicious eggs.

Thyferra's largest moon was the largest of two moons orbiting the planet Thyferra. Erisi Dlarit, an Imperial pilot serving Director of Imperial Intelligence Ysanne Isard, crashed into the moon and was killed during a dogfight with Rogue Squadron pilot Corran Horn during the Ba…

The siege of Bomis Koori took place in 6 ABY during the New Republic liberation campaign after the Battle of Endor. It saw the defeat of warlord Utoxx Prentioch at the hands of Admiral Firmus Nantz and the New Republic's First Fleet.
Dragon beasts, also known as Muunilinst lizards, were six-legged, four-eyed scavenging lizards dwelling in the impoverished sections of the cities of Muunilinst.
Jhensrus was a jungle frontier world in the Trax sector. The inhabitants of the planet were often confronted by the native creatures, hence a population of fighters and survivors was shaped.
Jhepar was a city located on the continent Mee'r, on the planet Draenell's Point. It had a population of one million inhabitants.
Jhonterius Park was a beautiful park in the city D'larah, on the planet Demophon. It stretched over four and a half hectares and contained walking paths, benches and tables, and sports fields.
The Fluwhaka revolt occurred in the vicinity of the Outer Rim's Fluwhaka system during the last millennium of the Galactic Republic, at some point after 896 BBY.

Project Second Chance was a New Republic operation that employed smugglers to covertly transport a modular command circuit to the government of the Kalinda system to allow them to activate their defense network.
Liann was the name given to the inhabitants of the planet Lianna, which was populated predominantly by Humans.
During the Clone Wars, a battle was fought over the planet Wayland between the Galactic Republic and the CIS. One Jedi was killed in the battle when its starfighter was shot down.
Impalers were a swirl prong subspecies that used their horns to impale attackers.

Wavelength Gale was a smuggling group active around the time of the First Jedi Purge. They had a base located on the planet Volik, in the Unknown Regions, and it was rumoured that the smugglers had acquired Sith Lord Darth Nihilus's mask.
The Valsedian asteroid belt was an ore-rich asteroid belt located deep within Hutt Space.
Sando's Boys was the name of the group of individuals—more or less permanent members—that followed the pirate and smuggler Sando.
Sando's Hired Blasters was a large squad of Humans that assisted the pirate and smuggler Sando in her activities. They were versed in both melee and ranged combat.
The Nashuaga was a Dynamic-class freighter that had crash-landed on the planet Volik around the time of the First Jedi Purge.
Vortex Squadron was one of many starfighter squadrons that served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Their missions revolved around Alliance attempts to revive the Jedi.

The Endorian Researchers Guild was a scientific organizations active in the Endor system during the Galactic Civil War. The Linear Miasma Scientists, a group of scientists who studied the Linear Miasma nebula, were part of the guild.
Figg Avenue was a street located in Cloud City just off the Administrative Levels. It was named after Ecclessis Figg. The street had K'cri's Cafe located there.
The pardlam were creatures native to a planet. The balyeg preyed on the pardlam.

Arrow Squadron was a V-19 Torrent starfighter squadron formed by the Galactic Republic. The pilots consisted of clones of Jango Fett. The squadron participated in the Mission to Lanteeb, where it took casualties against the opposing droid starfighters.

The Jedi Knight Jaina Solo infiltrated the headquarters of Onadax Droid Technologies in 28 ABY. The company has manufactured a Human replica droid that betrayed the citizens of Bakura, and Solo hopes to bring them to justice for the crimes that their clients commit.

The Wild Star was a modified Deep-X "Explorer", manufactured by Uulshos Manufacturing and modified by the techs of Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships.

The Battle of Circumtore took place between a team of mercenaries hired by Gheeta the Hutt and a team of unarmed bounty hunters led by Boba Fett around 1 ABY. This battle sparked many changes in the Bounty Hunters' Guild that would still reverberate years later.

This battle was fought between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. The result was a victory for the Alliance, who managed to take the strongpoint, securing prisoners and equipment before retreating.

Matarri was a planet noted for its sudden, monsoon rainstorms that contained pounding raindrops that could kill small animals.

The Rkok clan was a clan of Jawas, a species native to the planet Tatooine. At one point prior to the death of their homeworld's crime lord Jabba the Hutt in 4 ABY's Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon, the Rkok clan unloaded a cargo of questionable merchandise, which they sold…

Talesia was a planet known for manufacturing some of the galaxy's deadliest thermal detonators.
Tanatrig was one of the four moons that orbited Zelos II.
Taria II was a planet that was known for its swamps and ravines.
Beshka was a planet in the Outer Rim's Aparo sector.

FM-6B was a medical droid that served the Empire at the Arginall City garrison during the New Order. This droid injected Ketrian Altronel with a slow-release poison to prevent her from defecting to the Alliance.
The marsh-gunnies were small creatures native to Nim Drovis, a planet located in the Meridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. They occupied the bayous, swamps, and marshes of Nim Drovis.

Wadie-platts were creatures native to Nim Drovis, a planet located in the Meridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. They had luminscent green eyes that glowed in the dark. Wadie-platts occupied the swamps and marshes of Nim Drovis.

A planet was located in the Outer Rim Territories, far from the galactic capital, Coruscant. It hosted a gladiatorial ring, in which fighters competed to the death, with the winner collecting credits. Spectators gambled over the outcome.

Locus was a settlement on the planet of Nyriaan, that served as the world's capital.
The Jedi Starfighter Corps was a starfighter unit within the Jedi Order that was staffed by Jedi aces.

The New Generation Project was a scientific research endeavor funded by the Mandalorian warrior clans. The project's aim was to create Force-sensitive Mandalorian knights to rival the warriors of the Jedi Order.

Timira City was a city located on the planet Kamino and site of a clandestine cloning facility for the Galactic Empire. Although the Empire vastly expanded its cloning program beyond Kamino, it still retained as a site for cloning operations.
The Keshiri resistance was a Keshiri movement led by Adari Vaal, dedicated to the removal of the Lost Tribe of Sith and their control from Kesh and restoring the authority of the Neshtovar.

Salin was an Outer Rim Territories world situated in the Sprizen sector. It served as the endpoint of the Salin Corridor and Veragi Trade Route hyperlanes.

Imperial Sith Acolytes were elite Force sensitive soldiers deployed by the Galactic Empire in 1 BBY, founded by Dark Lord of the Sith and Galactic Emperor Darth Sidious.
Braad was a continent of the planet Bakura. It was the location of the Kishh district, which was inhabited largely by members of the Kurtzen species. Braad also had many namana plantations.
LF-R3D was a valet droid who served Lord Sargo VenHalgon.

The 22nd infantry division was a military unit of Rebel soldiers that was formed in 1 BBY. Trained at a hidden base in the Outer Rim Territories, they had not seen combat.

This squad of commandos served with General Rahm Kota during the early years of the Galactic Civil War. Based on the Rogue Shadow, they accompanied the general on his unsanctioned assaults against the Galactic Empire.
The Terror Walker was a massive droid attack walker developed by the Galactic Empire. It was designed to plow through large obstructions and annihilate anything in its path.

The Galactic Breeze was a cruise ship. A number of XLT-014 labor droids were used aboard the ship and when one of the droids programmed the ship's computer with an incorrect destination, the ship was brought off-course and captured by pirates near the planet of Bestine IV.

This skirmish occurred in 3 ABY, within the labyrinthine bowels of the Arbo Maze, a copse of trees so thick that the woods formed cavernous tunnels.
Mud limpets were a non-sentient species regarded by Jedi Master Sabla-Mandibu as capable of perceiving its environment but incapable of interacting with it.

The o'cerry was a non-sentient herbivore species native to the Expansion Region moon of Alchenaut. Discovered and named by Jedi biologist Bowspritz at some point prior to 990 BBY, the species was noted for its habit of acting as a predator alarm for other herbivores in the eco…

The Troiken indictidile was a predatory, non-sentient insect species native to the jungle planet Troiken. They curled into a ball and rolled through undergrowth in order to impale prey on the irregularly shaped spikes that covered their long, thin bodies.

The apple slug was a type of slug that shared its name with the apple fruit. When the Besalisk Dexter Jettster was working as a miner on the Outer Rim Territories planet Subterrel, he would sometimes use ripe apple slugs as an ingredient in preparing the dish known as apple sl…
The Bakuran military police was a law enforcement organization that operated on the planet of Bakura. The Human Anya Foravis served with the police for a short time.
The Kubaza beetle cavern was a cavernous complex dug out by the Confederacy of Independent Systems into the side of the central volcano on the planet Mustafar.
The Bravedawn was a large troop transport mentioned in a short story that was posted on one the planet Cularin's HoloNet nodes during the time of the Clone Wars.

This ship was a Heraklon-class transport utilized by the Zhug brothers, a bounty hunter group active during the years of the Dark Wars. In 3951 BBY, they took a job to collect the bounty on a former Jedi Knight, Meetra Surik, set by the Exchange crime organization.

Oseon VII was a planet located in the Oseon system that was a major tourist attraction and a center of exploration for the whole Centrality. Trouvee family owned a gambling complex on this planet. At one time, Han Solo and Leia visited the planet.
The Honor Detail was a unit in the radical xenophobic group known as the Human League during the First Corellian Insurrection. The Detail was led by Falco.
The Onderian Raptor was a Ghtroc Industries 720 light freighter in service to the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Alphoresis was a planet located within the Grumani sector in the Outer Rim region of the galaxy.
Byllura was a forested world located within the Grumani sector in the Outer Rim region of the galaxy.
Hestobyll was the capital city of the world Byllura. It was located on a series of terraces that were crafted from a large river delta by a team of Galactic Republic engineers.

Greeve was a farm world with heavy gravity that was located in the Grumani sector. The population of Greeve were often considered to be "yokels", and over the years they provided manpower for many different armies.
The Thunder Guard was a military unit that served the Sith Lord Odion during the New Sith Wars. The unit was known for being almost suicidal in the manner in which it attacked its enemies.
A TC-series protocol droid was part of the droid pool aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor by 3 ABY.
Oranessan was a planet that was located in the Grumani sector.
Tergamenion was a planet located in the Grumani sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A darkworld, it served as a base for the Daimanite military industrial complex during the Republic’s Dark Age.
A WED-15 Treadwell repair droid, produced by the Cybot Galactica company, worked for moisture farmer Owen Lars on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

The Chiggnash were a sentient species that resembled scorpions. The species had the ability to control the minds of other beings, and sometimes used that faculty to rapidly accumulate an expendable force of "warrior drones." At least some Chiggnash formed criminal extortion ri…
Jutrand was a city-planet that was located in the Grumani sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. Hundreds of corporations had their headquarters on the world.

Qi Lozar was a desert world that was located in the Grumani sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. It served as a haven for hermits, refugees and other individuals who were trying to escape their pasts.
Vellas Pavo was a planet that was located in the Grumani sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. Before and during the Republic Dark Age the world was a known source of gadolinium.

The Sedesia task force was an Imperial detachment composed of various Imperial branches sent to the planet Sedesia to deal with an outbreak of the "Gray Death," a highly deadly plague. It was part of the Pathogen-Based Loyalty Enhancement Program, led by Dr. Fesjo Negleem.

The Battle of Slotern was a short skirmish at the world Slotern sometime by the year 1 BBY. The engagement was fought between Imperial TIE fighters and resistance fighter craft and ground forces that resulted in a victory for the Galactic Empire.

Ratamesh was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Ratamesh system, a part of the Farstey sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Expansion Region. It was the site of the Thisspias alcazar, a structure which shared its name with the Farstey sector planet Thisspias.

The flow-mollusk was native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Eriadu. The shelled mollusk at one point lived in the planet's shallow oceans, and for centuries, Eriadu was known for its delicate shellwork jewelry.

This droid was an aspiring actress who went to talent school to achieve this. She was a girlfriend of F-29-PSKx, who called her multiple times from a Star*Link booth from the Star Tours spaceport while traveling.
F-25-OJSx, also known simply as F-25, was a masculine F series repair droid with red photoreceptors and silver plating, with a red trim.
Sword Squadron was a starfighter squadron composed of members of the New Jedi Order during the Second Imperial Civil War. They flew X-83 TwinTails.
A city was the capital of Raxus Secundus.
This OOM command battle droid was stationed on the planet Raxus Secundus, guarding a spaceport around 21 BBY during the events of the Clone Wars.

Kamasto was a frigid world that was located in the Grumani sector, along the Hydian Way hyperlane, where it orbited an orange dwarf. The world was the site of a number of monasteries that were operated by the Children of Mani, before the religion was divided by a schism.

Nix Card's office was located in the Republic Executive Building. It contained a couch, several chairs of the same design, Nix Card's desk, and the Muun's chair. It had windows in its back, offering views of Coruscant.

Gallion was a planet that was located in the Grumani sector. Gallion was one of the largest rocky planets in the sector and had low gravity, allowing lifeforms on the world to develop to titanic sizes.
Whinndor was a world that was located in the Grumani sector. It had a sulphuric atmosphere and seas that were abundant with organic molecules.
Ventruun was a Grumani world in the Grumani sector that was located on the Hydian Way and was noted for canny merchants and frenzied deal-making.
Fostin was a black-colored world that was located in the Grumani sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. It was orbited by at least nine moons, including Fostin Nine.
Fiviune was a world that was located in the Grumani sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. It was considered to be a dead world and its surface consisted of rocky plates and spiky crags.

The Reassignment Council Chamber was a circular room at the summit of the Reassignment Council Tower of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. It hosted meetings of the Council of Reassignment during the rule of the Galactic Republic.

The Reconciliation Council Chamber was a circular room at the summit of the Tower of Reconciliation of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. It hosted meetings of the Council of Reconciliation during the rule of the Galactic Republic.

The First Knowledge Council Chamber was a circular room at the summit of the Tower of First Knowledge of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. It hosted meetings of the Council of First Knowledge during the rule of the Galactic Republic.

The planet Coruscant was attacked at one point over 1000 years before 20 BBY. That year, during which the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems raged, the attack was recalled by Republic Senator Lott Dod of the Trade Federation in …

The Breath Stealing was an event that took place on the planet Alphoresis eleven centuries before Operation Influx, when a plague resulted in the death of every child on the world under the age of eight.

Gazzari was a planet that was located in the Grumani sector. Gazzari had a breathable atmosphere, but the planetary surface was inhospitable, due to the presence of volcanoes, tectonic activity and acid rain.
Falleen Throne was the capital city of the planet Falleen. The Yellow District was located here.
A vast asteroid field lay at some point along the Corellian Trade Spine. At the center of the asteroid field lay the planetoid Annamar.

The Naboo airbase was utilized by the Royal Naboo Security Forces during the Trade Federation's invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY. It was placed near the south ridge of the capital city of Theed and consisted of a security hangar and several buildings.

During the Battle of Mindor in 5 ABY, an aged, modified Bulwark-class battleship served with the New Republic's Rapid Response Task Force. This Bulwark Mark I dated from before the Clone Wars and was manufactured originally by the Techno Union.
The Raelli Ball was an annual event hosted by House Melantha during Capital Season.
Aberrant clones were genetically flawed clones of Galen Marek, a Human male Force user who served as the secret apprentice to the Sith Lord Darth Vader until his redemption and death in 2 BBY.

B3-T4 was an R2-series astromech droid with blue and white plating. Active during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, it was built by Industrial Automaton like all R-series astromech droids. B3-T4 stood at 0.96 meters tall.
Samhar was a forest-covered world that was located in the Grumani sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. It was inhabited by the Samhari, a Near-Human species.
The Samhari were a sentient species of Near-Humans who inhabited Samhar, a planet in the Grumani sector.
Scelepas was a world that was located in the Tanta Aurek system, in the Grumani sector. Between 3701 BBY and 3699 BBY the Hydian Way was charted through the planet as part of the Seswenna Expansion.

The Coruscant Security Force Senior Command or CSF Senior Command were the senior officers in charge of the Coruscant Security Force during the waning days of the Galactic Republic. They were located at the CSF Headquarters in Galactic City on the planet Coruscant.
Quirt's prison ship was an Imperial prisoner transport commanded by Colonel Quirt.
The plague wasp was a creature from Delphon.
Formos Spaceport was a space port on the planet Formos.
Apru Del was a floating city that was located in the clouds of the planet Genarius.

J1-P0 was a protocol droid who was owned by Kulton Woodle, a retired Mon Calamari freighter captain, sometime after the Battle of Yavin. During that period, the droid spent time standing with Woodle outside of the Theed Spaceport on the planet Naboo.

The Squall Clan was one of the many clans that prospective young Initiates were placed in when they first began to learn the ways of the Jedi Order. Members of this clan were chosen based on their agility and swiftness of foot.

The Dragon Clan was one of the many clans that prospective young Initiates were placed in when they first began to learn the ways of the Jedi Order. Members of this clan were selected based on their perceived tenacity.
The Forensics Unit, also known as the Forensics Service, was the criminal evidence unit operated by the Coruscant Security Force.
The Burnout Cafetorium was a dining establishment which was located on the Zham Hlar space station, the Burnout.
Thaereian Intelligence was the intelligence division of the Thaereian military.
The planet Shotem was the mining site for specialized lightsaber crystals which pulsed and caused the lightsaber to be more powerful.
Cilare was an ice planet where the crime lord Tayand lived.
A stormtrooper squad was a unit of the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps during the Galactic Civil War. Comprised of clones of the Mandalorian Jango Fett, the squad included at least five stormtroopers.
The loirbnigg was a non-sentient, reptilian species native to Frisal, a reserve planet for wealthy Imperial families. There, the eight-legged creature was bred and trained as a riding animal.
The Grand Theater of Vreni Island was an outdoor theater on Vreni Island on the planet of Corellia. It was the pride of the citizens of Vreni Island.

t: Duel at the Pool of Knowledge
x: In 44 ABY, a duel took place at the Pool of Knowledge, a Force nexus on Abeloth's planet. After they fought and apparently killed the dark side entity Abeloth, the Sith Sarasu Taalon, Gavar Khai, and Vestara Khai, along with their Jedi allies Luke and Ben Skywalker, discovered…

place: Operations Hangar, New Jedi Temple; Coruscant
result: Saba Sebatyne becomes Jedi Grand Master
x: A skirmish took place in 44 ABY in the Operations Hangar of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. After being relieved of his duty by the Jedi Council, former acting Grand Master Kenth Hamner attempted to prevent a wing of StealthXs from launching to assist Luke Skywalker in dealing w…
Caulus Tertius was a planet located in the Inner Rim. No life existed on the planet, although there was evidence to suggest it once supported life.

Arari was the capital city of the planet Blaudu Sextus. In 44 ABY, a revolt of the Octusi—semi-sentient natives of nearby Blaudu Octus—against their masters was provoked by the anti-slavery organization Freedom Flight.

Blaudu Octus was a planet in the Regulan system, near Blaudu Sextus. It was home to the Octusi species, a semi-sentient species who lived as willing servants to the people of Blaudu Sextus until Freedom Flight stirred a revolt amongst the Octusi in 44 ABY.
The Emiax was the personal shuttle of High Lord Sarasu Taalon of the Lost Tribe of Sith. He took the shuttle with his fleet of ChaseMaster frigates during his mission to capture Abeloth in 44 ABY.
In 44 ABY, a skirmish took place near Ashteri's Cloud. The Rockhound, carrying Jaina Solo and Lando Calrissian, was sabotaged by Sith pirates.
The Star Ravager was an Imperial Corellian corvette that patrolled the Kessel system during the Galactic Civil War.
This starship was owned by Muun cyberneticist Bitt Panith as a personal ship of his until 21 BBY.

Drivoks were a sentient species native to Faket in Wild Space. They had mauve-colored skin, no hair, and to all outward appearances, no distinct gender either. Drivoks could speak Basic, but seemed to have limited grasp of the syntax, often omitting articles from their speech.

Count Dooku escapes with the Death Star plans

x: The First Battle of Geonosis, also referred to as the Battle of Geonosis or the Battle on Geonosis, was the first major battle fought in 22 BBY between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic on Geonosis, marking the beginning of the three-year Clone W…

t: Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge
x: The Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge was hosted in 44 ABY by Booster Terrik on the Errant Venture.
The Fariso was a civilian YT-1300 light freighter that operated during the Galactic Civil War.
The Dac anchovy was a species of edible fish native to the planet Dac where they were cooked and eaten by the native sentient Mon Calamari species.
Muntro VI was a world in the Outer Rim Territories. The world was known for its famous Otherworld Arts Festival, an arts festival held every ten years by the Deftoi of Muntro VI.

A battle took place in a Fallanassi village on Pydyr, a moon of the planet Almania, in 44 ABY, between the exiled Jedi Luke and Ben Skywalker, the Lost Tribe of Sith, and the dark side entity Abeloth.

The Sword of Ieldis was the flagship of the Sith Lord Odion during his campaign against his brother Daiman. The vessel shared its name a Sith artifact of the same name—the Sword of Ieldis—the Sith sword of the Sith Lord Ieldis, of the first Sith Empire.

The Obuuri was a Kondo-class assault shuttle in use in the galaxy by 44 ABY. By that time, it had been pirated by the Lost Tribe of Sith for use in the Tribe's war fleet. In 44 ABY, Sith apprentice Vestara Khai called for reinforcements on Pydyr.
A revolt took place on Blaudu Sextus in 44 ABY when the Octusi were convinced by Freedom Flight to rise up against their masters.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: The Battle of the Corridor was a conflict in the Feswe Corridor between the Rebel Alliance and Imperial forces under the House of Tagge in 0 ABY.

A Fallanassi village was located on Pydyr by 44 ABY. The village was located on an island on the moon, and the village, island, and surrounding area were all protected by illusions in the White Current, hiding their visibility to all beings who did not know how to access the W…
Daimar Intelligence was an intelligence organization that operated on the planet Daimar during the early years of the Galactic Empire.

result: Rahm Kota is freed from captivity
objective: Rescue General Rahm Kota
x: A rescue mission to free the Rebel Alliance Jedi General Rahm Kota from the Galactic Empire was performed in 1 BBY, during the early stages of the Galactic Civil War.

This apartment was used by Baron Notluwiski Papanoida and his family during their stay on Coruscant in 21 BBY. It was here that Papanoida's two daughters, Che Amanwe and Chi Eekway, were kidnapped by Greedo and a Gotal bounty hunter.

The Jostaar Express was a starship owned by the expert pilot Raan Calrissian. It was equipped with an upper gun turret and rear deflector shields. The ship shared its name with the Jostaar system of the Outer Rim Territories' Kibilini sector.
This campaign was the last one overseen by Grand Moff Odile Vaiken of the Sith Empire against an unidentified alien civilization. He was killed on the bridge of a Star Destroyer during the conflict.

result: The Imperial Military destroys enough wilderness to allow for their ne
x: Shortly after their arrival on Dromund Kaas, the people of the reborn Sith Empire launched a campaign to clear a wilderness region on the planet. The effort was conceived and organized by the founder and first leader of the Imperial Military, Odile Vaiken.

The Jedi Archives, located within the Jedi Temple of Tython was founded during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire following the Jedi Order's relocation to their ancestral homeworld.
The Rindoon Dart was a Sandonian 4XA Prensile Cruiser owned by the enslaver Pwi'lin. Its design featured at least one wing, and it was equipped with twin blasters.

The Rust Gardens were a location on the junkyard planet Ronyards. It was most likely another site of god-worshiping droids who praised Ronyards itself, believing that the whole planet was a droid god.

The Rebels' Trade Conference was a meeting of Rebel officials and companies or organizations that were dealing with the Alliance to Restore the Republic. They would negotiate prices, quantities, and rendezvous points to stay out of Darth Vader's clutches.

t: Assault on the Temple of the Sith
result: Darth Wyyrlok is killed by Darth Krayt.
Darth Krayt reclaims the throne of the Galactic Empire and control of
x: The Assault on the Temple of the Sith was an attack orchestrated by Darth Krayt in revenge for the betrayal of Darth Wyyrlok, Voice and Regent of the One Sith.

Clariv was a world located in the Clariv system. It was a part of the Back Spiral area of the Tion Hegemony sector, which was situated in the Tion Cluster within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Stalimur was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Tion Hegemony sector. The stormy world featured moors inhabited by a population of farmers known as the Stalimurans, who observed a Tionese winter holiday known as the Devouring.

Mullan was a terrestrial world located in the Mullan system. It was a part of the Keldrath sector in the Greater Tion historical region, which in turn was situated within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

This unidentified planet was the location of a downed Imperial Star Destroyer, the Anya Karu. Aron Harcourt, the captain of the ship, once sent the bounty hunter Boba Fett to the planet to retrieve a holo-recording of Harcourt's wife, Janelle, from the wreckage.

result: Part of the Death Star schematics acquired
x: The Ambush in the Cron Drift took place during the Operation Skyhook in the Galactic Civil War.
The Scanning in the Vergesso Asteroids was a minor skirmish during the Galactic Civil War in the Vergesso Asteroids.

In the first year of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the newly-formed Alliance to Restore the Republic, the Alliance attempted to capture Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin in the Eriadu system.
The Kaikielius campaign took place in the Clone Wars, the battle was part of Operation Durge's Lance lead by Confederate General Grievous.

The Darkness was a battlecruiser that served as the flagship of the Sith Lord Darth Angral. It saw action in the Sacking of Coruscant. It would later be replaced by the Oppressor as Angral's flagship.
Champion was a Mon Calamari–designed cruiser used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during 3 ABY. Evacuees from the Battle of Hoth boarded Champion to reach the Rebel rendezvous point.

The Boma Clan was one of the many clans that prospective young Initiates were placed in when they first began to learn the ways of the Jedi Order. Once a member of the clan, the students would travel together through the academy at the Jedi Temple until the time they graduated.
The Tra'cor Clan was one of the many clans that prospective young Initiates were placed in when they first began to learn the ways of the Jedi Order.

The Epsilon 5 was an Imperial Lambda shuttle used in 0 BBY to transport Grand Moff Tarkin and Bevel Lemelisk. This shuttle was part of a group of five Lambda shuttles attacked in the Eriadu system by rebel forces in order to capture Tarkin and Lemelisk.
The Linear Miasma Scientists were a group of scientists who studied the Linear Miasma nebula in the Endor system. They belonged to the Endorian Researchers Guild.
The Defense of Orto Plutonia took place around 21 BBY during the Clone Wars.
The Folding Dancer was a Rebel Nova Courier that operated during the Galactic Civil War.
The Madersim was an RSF YT-1300 light freighter that operated during the Galactic Civil War.

The Blank Look Gang or blankers were a mid-level criminal organization that worked from the lower levels of the planet Coruscant during the Rise of the Empire era. They specialized in petty theft but had the means for a number of larger heists just rarely the opportunity.
Forthought was one of the two main continents on the planet of Ropagi II, located on the eastern hemisphere.
Afterthought was one of the two main continents on the planet of Ropagi II, located in the western hemisphere.
Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, Shadow Two was a TIE/ln starfighter affiliated with the Imperial Navy's Shadow wing during the Galactic Civil War.

A sentient species of jungle barbarians inhabited Janguine, a planet located in the Halthor sector of the Outer Rim Territories. They shared the planet with the Mooloolian tribes, which occupied the mountainous regions of the planet.
The Senate Security Force, also known as the Senate Security Services, were security and bodyguard forces of the Galactic Alliance in charge of protecting Senators of the Galactic Alliance Senate.

Unit 6 was the designation of at least one of Galactic Empire's stormtroopers stationed at Timira City on the planet Kamino. The designation was in use by the Imperial Military as part of the Stormtrooper Corps.
Twilight Jumper was a Ghtroc Industries 720 light freighter which was for sale by the Bith used space transport salesman Fiz Cor'gril.
P3-NUT was a R2-series astromech droid in the service of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Second Floor Security was a security unit stationed Tarko-se's Casino on Cato Neimoidia. They were all wiped out when the clone of Galen Marek stormed the city.
Storm Killer was a heavily modified CEC YT-1300 light freighter which was optimized for combat and put on sale by the Bith used space transport salesman Fiz Cor'gril.
F1-V3L was a mouse droid used during the Clone Wars.
J-4CK was a R4 astromech droid in the service of the Galactic Republic during The Clone Wars. It was boasted as to having a "Droid-o-lantern" smile.
K-3RNL was a R4 astromech droid in the service of the Galactic Republic during The Clone Wars. The droid was considered to be corny, yet sweet.
1M-AU5 was the designation of a golden MSE-6 series repair droid that was active during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Endeavor was a colony vessel operated by the Arkanians. In 1 ABY, it was carrying 100 individuals to a new world. It was waylaid and captured by the Imperial Commander Rezi Soresh, who had fled the Empire and established an outpost in the Outer Rim of the galaxy.

result: Mission ambushed by the One Sith
objective: Negotiation of an Alliance between the Empire-in-exile and the New Jed
x: In 137 ABY, Emperor Roan Fel of the Empire-in-exile left the Imperial fortress world of Bastion to meet with representatives of the Jedi Order on Agamar.

Fatman was a heavily modified starship owned and piloted by Zeerid Korr. It was most commonly used for smuggling or delivering illegal goods but was destroyed during atmospheric entry over Coruscant in 3653 BBY while delivering Engspice.

place: Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81, Coruscant
objective: Freedom of Valin and Jysella Horn from carbonite
x: This raid took place in 44 ABY in the Galactic Alliance's Detention Center 81, a prison where Valin and Jysella Horn were being held in carbonite by Chief of State Natasi Daala. The raid was led by Han, Leia, and Jaina Solo, as well as Zekk and Taryn Zel.

The Chirk'pn Wastes were a rocky wasteland on the planet Galantos, located north of the city Gal'fian'deprisi and near the Gar'glum Sea. The Black Hammer pirate base was located within them, but there were few other spaceports.
Lake worms, also known as sea worms or water-worms, were giant worm creatures living on the rainswept Outer Rim Territories planet Daluuj.

t: Bombing of Syndaar Military Prep School
x: The Bombing of Syndaar Military Prep School was a terrorist act by Ort Hoogra-D'En. He detonated a spore bomb that killed 45 people, including Jared Brojtal's son. This caused a 50,000 credit bounty to be issued for Ort's capture.
M1-4X, also known as an M1-4X Advanced War Droid or colloquially as Forex, was a unique assault droid built by Doctor Boab Deduun of the Galactic Republic.
At some point after 3522 BBY, an army of Pau'an warriors was assembled by Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Desolous, who had been expelled from the Jedi Order for studying Sith teachings.

t: Battle of Yaga Minor (Darth Desolous conflict)
x: This battle was the culmination of the fight between the Jedi Order and Sith Lord Darth Desolous. The Jedi lured Desolous into a trap on the planet Yaga Minor and killed him and his army of Pau'ans.
The Nightsister fortress on Dathomir was the settlement of the Nightsisters, led by Mother Talzin, during the Clone Wars. It was the home to Dathomirian assassin Asajj Ventress.

The Rail-class Advanced Recon Commando was a post-Galactic Republic generation of ARC troopers that was secretly bred by the Kaminoan scientists in a plot to liberate Kamino from the rule of the Galactic Empire.
Odacer-Faustin was a planet with a cold harsh terrain. Heavy snow and high winds constantly buffeted the world.
The Salvation was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate used as a medical frigate by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

A raccoon was a type of creature with a black mask across their eyes. In 3.5 ABY, when the Wookiee Chewbacca disguised himself as the bounty hunter Snoova as part of a plan to infiltrate Black Sun leader Prince Xizor's fortress, his disguise gave him a raccoonlike mark across …

The Surgeon was a droid that resided in the former Galactic Empire outpost of DN-949A on the planet Netalych. The droid occupied a workshop within a secure bunker, where it kept itself mostly hidden behind a curtain of wires.
The Nyemarians were a species hailing from the planet Nyemari.

Anem was the capital city of the planet Nyemari. The Nyemari Royal Palace was located there, as was the Nyemari Imperial Military Installation. In 1 ABY, a team of Rebel Alliance members infiltrated the Duchess' Royal Palace to steal her access codes.

Ludo Kressh's faction was a collection of several Sith Council members, Sith Lords, and their respective systems that broke off from the Sith Empire to oppose its newest Dark Lord, Naga Sadow, around the time of the Great Hyperspace War.

After she was betrayed and nearly killed by her Sith brethren, the Theelin Sith Lord Darth Phobos organized a fanatical cult devoted to her. She employed the cultists to assassinate Jedi and Sith leaders, which led those two rival factions to join forces and kill Phobos.
The Dominator was an BSX-5 Harrower-class dreadnought used by the reconstituted Sith Empire. It functioned as Darth Jadus' flagship until its disappearance and Jadus' supposed death.
The South Anem Spaceport was a docking facility for starships located on the edge of Anem, the capital of the planet of Nyemari.

objective: Recover supply of astromech droids
x: A mission to the planet Commenor was undertaken by Red Squadron to collect a cargo of astromech droids for the Alliance to Restore the Republic on Commenor.
Audacious was a Lianna-class corvette in service to the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
Reliant was a Lianna-class corvette in service to the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

Novar's Bluff was a Lianna-class corvette in service to the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. It was outfitted with an experimental cloaking device constructed by Santhe/Sienar Technologies.
Ballista was a cruiser in service to the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
A village was located in a marsh on the planet Naboo. In 32 BBY, during the Invasion of Naboo by the Trade Federation, the Human Naboo student Teckla Minnau escaped the besieged capital city Theed.
Cavamina Minor was a small, cold moon in the Mid Rim. Aayla Secura traveled there during the Clone Wars.

t: Skirmish in the Cavamina Minor cantina
x: A skirmish occurred in a cantina on Cavamina Minor around 22 BBY. The Jedi Knight Aayla Secura arrived at the cantina with an escort of clone troopers in search of the pirate Attuma Duum, but they were attacked by several operatives in Duum's employ.
The Garden of Equality was an open area that was positioned on the western side of the Coruscant Senate Building's Great Door.

Taggon was a city that was located on the planet Druckenwell, and was home to the Tagge Company and House D'Vails during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. It was the site of a number of factories and warehouses.

Thull's Vault was a planet located in the Thull's Vault system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It was connected via hyperlane to the Arporatal-Lanin and Talhovi systems.
Queshː (pronounciation: /'kwɛʃ/) was a world riddled with toxic waste within Hutt Space, due to a period of geological instability beginning around 53,600 BBY dubbed the Quake.

objective: Find evidence of Separatist activity in the Valsedian asteroid belt
x: During the Clone Wars, a mission took place in the ore-rich Valsedian asteroid belt.
Catlia was a planet that was located within the Catlia system, in the Chiss Space area of the galaxy's Unknown Regions. It was connected by the Phalanx Route hyperlane to the planet Cormit.

result: Rezi Soresh's plan to kill the Alliance leaders fails.
x: This battle on the planet Belazura occurred as a result of the machinations of the Galactic Empire Commander Rezi Soresh. His previous attempts to kill the Rebel Alliance pilot who destroyed the Death Star failed, so Soresh recalled his personal assassin, X-7.
A reconnaissance mission to the planet Kamino was flown by the pilots of the Rebel Alliance Red Squadron starfighter unit Luke Skywalker, Wedge Antilles, Zev Senesca, Han Solo, and Chewbacca.
Malidris was the city that served as capital of Iridonia.

The Initiate Trials, also known as the Jedi Initiate Trial, the Jedi Tournament, or the Padawan Trials, were a series of tests that Jedi younglings of the Jedi Order were given as prerequisite in order to progress to the level of Padawan.
This scout ship was kept aboard the Bloodstar and used by the pirate Bar-Kooda.
Lazeria City, also known simply as Lazeria, was the largest city on the planet of Lazerian IV. Lazeria City was located on the continent of Laz and was the capital of the Kingdom of Devit.
Elgar was one of four continents on the planet of Lazerian IV.
Laz was one of four continents on the planet of Lazerian IV.

The Battle of Carbos Thirteen was fought during the Second Galactic Civil War. During the battle, Galactic Alliance forces commanded by Admiral Nek Bwua'tu trapped Confederation forces near Carbos Thirteen.
Vagabond was a starship in the service of the Galactic Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, the ship was destroyed during the Battle of Cavamina Minor by a fleet of the Separatist Navy.
The rormaroo was a native species of Pallaxides that was frequently used as riding beasts.

result: Talon Karrde and the Millennium Falcon rescued
x: The rescue on the Chimaera refers to the successful rescue of the smuggler Talon Karrde, who was imprisoned aboard the Imperial Star Destroyer Chimaera in 9 ABY by Grand Admiral Thrawn and his forces.
The mission to Kashyyyk referred to a failed attempt in 9 ABY by the Noghri Commando Team 22 to capture Princess Leia Organa Solo on the Wookiee planet of Kashyyyk.
In 17 ABY, in the time of the Imperial Skirmishes, Admiral Natasi Daala's forces attacked the New Republic at the planet Rydonni Prime.
A battle occurred at the planet Taris in the Imperial Skirmishes, a desperate attempt by the Council of Moffs and the replacement warlords to turn the tide in the Galactic Civil War.

The Battle of Champala was a battle during the Imperial Skirmishes of 17 ABY that saw Fleet Admiral Gilad Pellaeon and the Imperial Remnant attack Champala. The battle was followed by the more famous Second Battle of Champala, which was also known as the Battle of Champala.
Doxet was one of four continents on the planet of Lazerian IV.

Convergence was a Convergence Tactical Assault Vehicle during the Sith civil war of the Republic Dark Age. It was built by mechanics and engineers of Daiman, whose constant indecision led to countless redesigns.
The Darklight was an Imperious-class Star Destroyer that served Darth Krayt's Sith Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War.

result: Slaves of the Sungrazer cooperative are freed
x: In 3963 BBY, Zayne Carrick, a dropout from the Jedi Order, began a campaign against The Crucible, a massive and shadowy slaver organization. One of the first actions in this campaign resulted in a short but brutal skirmish in the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds.

result: Elliah Fel slain, Eshkar Niin believed dead.
x: Before 137 ABY, the Imperial Knight Eshkar Niin abandoned his vows to the Empire and attacked the Empress Elliah Fel on a rooftop in a city filled with skyscrapers.

The Battle of Borosk was an engagement caused by the resurrected Darth Krayt's military push across the galaxy. Following Borosk's capture by the Sith Empire in a previous battle, the planet's control had gone back and forth between Fel and Krayt.

result: Vinsoth is claimed by Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire
x: In 138 ABY, the planet Vinsoth fell to the forces of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire. Lord Krayt had recently begun a renewed military push against his enemies after reclaiming his usurped Imperial throne, and Vinsoth—within the borders of Emperor Roan Fel's Empire-in-exile but …

The Bombing of Falleen occurred when the people of Falleen refused to align themselves with Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire. The Imperious-class Star Destroyer Darklight was deployed to bombard the planet into submission.

Taral V was a planet controlled by the Sith Empire during the Cold War. During the Cold War, a Galactic Republic strike team was sent to Taral V to retrieve information on a missing Jedi. The planet was home to many dangerous species.

The Unifiers, also called Scarlet Riders and Scarlet Runners by Kerra Holt, were red-uniformed Sith adepts that served the Dyarchy, a Sith state that existed in the Grumani sector during the Republic Dark Age.
J3-3V3 was a protocol droid manufactured some time around the Clone Wars.

The Javelin was an Harrower-class dreadnought active during the Galactic War. The reconstituted Sith Empire used it during the Battle of Corellia in an attempt to destroy the Rift Alliance Coalition Forces by setting a trap.
Rim 3 was a planet in the Outer Rim's Kibilini sector. In 3 BBY, the bounty hunter Boba Fett visited Rim 3 while searching for the rogue Imperial colonel Abal Karda.

Lake Yinta was the largest freshwater lake on the Mid Rim world of Vulta. The lake was ringed by the city of Yinta Lake, and emitted a scent of decay that permeated the metropolis.

Yinta Lake was a city on the Mid Rim world of Vulta. It began as a small, unnamed winter retreat for the planet's wealthy arms manufacturers, who built extensive mansions along the banks of Lake Yinta, Vulta's largest freshwater lake.

T6 was an astromech droid owned by Aryn Leneer. It had an orange, domed head and communicated in the beeps and whistles of droidspeak. He assisted in piloting her PT-7 starfighter.

This vessel of unknown class was used by the Human scavenger Hurd Coyle.

A pond was located on the Forest Moon of Endor. Its native flora and fauna included frogs, butterflies, umbrella-like creatures, and victorias. In 3 ABY, the Ewoks Wicket Wystri Warrick, Teebo, Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka, and Latara visited the pond.
The Wind Dancers were a sentient species native to the planet Galloa II, a planet in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Search for the Star Maps was an operation executed by Revan and his student Malak in their search of the Star Maps, which could lead them to the Rakatan Star Forge.

6R-0WL was an R2-series astromech droid that was active during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Like all R-series astromech droids, 6R-0WL built by Industrial Automaton and stood 0.96 meters tall.
5T-U85 was a GNK power droid that was built by Industrial Automaton around the time of the Clone Wars.
BO-LT5 was an R5-series astromech droid that was active during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A crystal forest was created in 3 ABY on the Forest Moon of Endor when the sentient creature called Gracca used the magical powers of his Crystal Cloak to plant several crystal seeds on the Floating Mountain.

The lost city of the Ghorfas was an ancient city built around the Desolation Canyons on Tatooine millennia before the rise of the Galactic Empire. The city was abandoned around 4200 BBY, when human colonists deprived the native Ghorfas of their water supplies.
A snow monster species lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. Its body, several times larger than that of an Ewok, was covered in yellow-green fur, and the monster bore several large claws and teeth.

The Starrunner was an MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser in service to the Galactic Alliance Core Fleet during the Second Imperial Civil War. In 138 ABY it participated during the space battle above Taivas when the forces of the Sith Empire attacked the Jedi Temple.

The Intruder was an Ardent-class fast frigate that served in the Imperial Navy during the Second Imperial Civil War. By 138 ABY, the ship was commanded by Captain Vaclen Tor and participated in the attack against the Hidden Temple of the Jedi on Taivas.
Docking bay 11 was a docking bay onboard Elwis Bontraar's Luxury yacht, the Masquerade.

The Noghri Overclan was the unified clans of planet of Honoghr in the Outer Rim Territories. The Noghri were a clan-based species that lived in hierarchically-structured tribes, and the Noghri Overclan was the overall clan that they served.
The Masquerade was a Luxury yacht owned by the Bothan businessman Elwis Bontraar. He annually held the Galactic Costume Extravaganza onboard it.
Lexi Dio was an assault bomber used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The vessel shared its name with Senator Lexi Dio.
A space battle which took place at a deep-space rendezvous point late in 40 ABY was an important battle of the Second Galactic Civil War.

In 25 ABY, Anakin Solo flew the Calrissian Runner—a modified racing TIE Advanced x1—at the Lando's Folly asteroid belt obstacle course. Like other "Belt-Runner" TIE Advanced x1s, the Calrissian Runner was customized for speed and the rigors of the course.

A tree-dwelling creature lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. It had green eyes with black pupils, and numerous white teeth. In 3 ABY, two Duloks from King Gorneesh's tribe encountered one of the creatures in a tree after failing to kidnap the Ewok Latara.
In 3 ABY, the Ewoks Weechee Warrick, Widdle Warrick, Paploo, and Teebo passed through a cave on their way to the Tree of Light.

A non-sentient species of flying serpent lived on the Forest Moon of Endor, and at least one specimen lived in a cave. The creature had two small wings slightly forward of the midpoint of its body, and black eyebrows situated above yellow eyes with black pupils.
The Razor was a modified Dragonfly-class Imperial drop ship used by the bounty hunter Vrath Xizor during the Great Galactic War. It was later stolen by smuggler Zeerid Korr.

The Dromo was an Imperial supply superfreighter used by the Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War. The ship was part of a convoy that traveled from the Kravos system to the occupied planet of Coruscant.

The Travelling Jindas, a troupe of entertainers on Endor, traveled with a menagerie of creatures, including a purple creature. In 3 ABY, two Duloks—one with an X on his chest and another with an O—encountered the creature after failing to kidnap the Ewok Latara.

This estate was the residence of Hetton's family located in a region directly outside capital city of Carannia on the planet of Serenno. It comprised an enormous mansion and lavish rose gardens that stretched for acres.

During a battle in the Manpha system, the Nagai defeated the forces of the Alliance of Free Planets. The battle was part of the larger Nagai–Tof War.

An army of volunteer soldiers served under Captain Merumeru during the Battle of Kashyyyk in 19 BBY. When word spread across Kashyyyk that a Separatist Droid Army would soon be invading Kachirho, Wookiees from all across the planet rushed to the coastal city's defense.

A leatherwing was an avian creature found on the planet Ord Mantell. Leatherwings had dull, black eyes and huge, membranous wings. Leatherwings would on occasion fly to the southern part of Ord Mantell for warmer air, and were too small to cause a sensor blip on a starship.

This mimph village was located on Endor. In 3 ABY, when the mimphs captured the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick, they took him back to their village to put him on display. Later, when the Snow King froze the moon, the mimphs used shovels to rid their village of snow.

Ryloth Clan was a small, ancient clan of primitive Twi'leks. At the time of the Galactic Civil War, the clan consisted of only eight hundred people.

A greenbeak was a type of non-sentient animal found on the planet Vulta. Greenbeaks made a quacking noise and at times swam in bodies of water. In the year 3653 BBY, smuggler Zeerid Korr went to Karson's Park on Vulta to deliver a hoverchair to his crippled daughter, Arra Yooms.

Located on Mid Rim planet Kashyyyk, a village was the home of Sunchoo, a female Wookiee. Sometime in 22 BBY, Sunchoo was kidnapped from this village by Crovan Dane, a bounty hunter, and was sold into slavery.
In 3 ABY, a robbery occurred at the Sun King's palace on Endor when several Iceheads stole the season scepter, a magical device used to control the weather on the moon.

F-29-PSKx, also known simply as F-29, was a masculine F series repair droid with blue photoreceptors and silver plating, with a blue trim. By the year 4.3 ABY, he worked for the Star Tours travel agency.
During the Galactic Civil War, a mission was carried out to the Selnesh Imperial Detention Center on the planet Selnesh, where the Rebel leader Gebnerret Vibrion was being held.

A tribe of Tusken Raiders lived on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. Its members included Ur and his younger brother, Urur, with the latter having duties restricted to defending the tribe. If Ur was killed, however, Urur would take his older brother's place.

Second Level Security was an Imperial security unit of stormtroopers and riot stormtroopers that were stationed in a casino in Tarko-se on Cato Neimoidia.

Vaced Spaceport was a spaceport on the planet Vaced during the Clone Wars.

The Analysis Bureau was a department of Republic Intelligence.

The Duros Allied Army was a military unit during the Galactic Civil War. At her debutante cotillion, Rivoche Tarkin learned from a CompForce cadet of a planned CompForce attack against insurgents within the Duros Allied Army.

In the weeks leading up to the Battle of Yavin, a group of starfighters belonging to the Rebel Alliance raided a convoy of the Galactic Empire. A EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that was protecting the convoy launched twenty-four TIE/LN starfighters at the Rebels.

After the people of the moon Sulon held an anti-Imperial demonstration, the Empire retaliated by massacring three families who participated in the demonstration.
Hill 461 was a location on the planet Ruusan. It was about 50 klicks away south from Fort Nowhere, and southwest from the home of Grif and Carole Grawley.
A dreamvenom snake was a type of snake. Han Solo shipped cargoes of dreamvenom snakes during his career as a smuggler.

The Cavern of the Serpents was a cavern located deep within the Great Well of Ophideraan that served as the breeding ground and birthplace of the flying serpent species that dominated Ophideraan's skies.
This starship belonged to the bounty hunter Crovan Dane in 21 BBY and was used to transport creatures to the Trandoshan moon Akoshissss for use in Muun cyberneticist Bitt Panith's experiments.

The Slave level was the lowest level of the Great Well on the planet Ophideraan. It was the level where the slaves were confined by the Serpent Masters. It comprised an island on which slaves drilled to keep water flowing in the caverns.

The Bail Jumper was a modified Incom T-65B X-wing starfighter, painted black and bronze. The cybernetic pilot, whose implants negated the need for an astromech droid, replaced the standard astromech socket with a fifth fire-linked laser cannon.
In 1032 BBY, the joint forces of the Sith Lords Daiman, Odion, Lioko, and Malakite spearheaded an invasion into the holdings of the Bactranate, the territory of the Sith Lord Ayanos Bactra.
In 3645 BBY, a duel occurred on the snow-covered world of Odacer-Faustin, between Jedi Knight Rojo Trace, and Shak'Weth, Blademaster of the planet's Sith academy.

Hoylin was a world located in the Hoylin system, a part of the Fei Hu sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It was situated on the Gamor Run hyperlane, which connected it to the Aikhibba and Beris systems.

N4 was a droid that was owned by the near-Human Gern Zott during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. It consisted of a hollow military droid shell that Zott had attempted to make look intimidating, by fitting it with servomotors and a small power supply.

In 32 BBY, a group of Tusken Raiders led by Sharad Hett attacked the trading site of Mochot Steep on Tatooine, which was full of civilians buying weapons with which to protect themselves from the increasingly violent Tuskens.
In 32 BBY, Sharad Hett led a group of Tusken Raiders in an attack on the Tatooine city of Anchorhead. One Tusken war clan rode into the town on Banthas shooting and trampling things.
During a skirmish, the mercenary group the Aurodium Sword defended their client, a Sullustan executive, from a squad of industrial assassins.

In a skirmish at the settlement of Dee'ja Peak on the planet Naboo, the Wookiee bounty hunter Snoova lay in wait for a group of spacers who he had been told were looking for him. Snoova had backup in the form of mercenaries from the Black Sun criminal syndicate.

During the series of harassment raids launched by Grand Admiral Thrawn against New Republic convoys, Thrawn's forces attacked one at Sarka.
The Taanab operation was a hit-and-fade attack carried out in 9 ABY, during the Thrawn campaign, by the forces of Grand Admiral Thrawn against the planet Taanab.

In 44 ABY, a Jedi funeral took place to honor the recently deceased acting Grand Master, Kenth Hamner. It was attended by all the members of the Triumvirate, which consisted of Jedi Master Saba Sebatyne, Senator Haydnat Treen and General Merratt Jaxton.

Naysay was a masculine-programmed, manumitted 3PO-series protocol droid who, in 44 ABY, represented Clan Vacweld of the Manumission Mandate Militia.
The Hweg Shul Municipal Police were a police/paramilitary force in charge of maintaining law and order in the city of Hweg Shul.
Ushmin was a small world just on the borders of the Imperial Remnant.

A Pursuer-class enforcement ship belonged to the Mandalorian Death Watch member Hudu Shiv. He used the vessel during an assassination in 22 BBY.
Shramar was a planet that was controlled by the Imperial Remnant during the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The Ringali Shell Security Force or RSSF was a civilian security force that patrolled the Ringali Shell during the Galactic Civil War.

The Dorsal Killer was a modified YT-1930 freighter that was used as a bounty hunter ship. After the Hutt Sonnos placed a bounty on the Human Deggar Feps, Feps attempted to flee to the moon Nar Shaddaa aboard the Dartiss-5 Caravel Lost Lady.
Knores was a Mid Rim world located in the Senex sector that was famous for its red seas. The world also featured a deep equatorial trench, appealing cities, and violent weather.

Ossiathora was an agriworld located in the Ossiathora system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex-Juvex Loop hyperlane linked it to the Deminol and Kassido systems.
The Darellian fire crab was a species of crustacean hailing from the Darellia system in the Core Worlds.
The Caarimon Ministry of Conservation, also known as the Caarimon Conservation Ministry, was an organization that operated on the planet Caarimon during the time of the Clone Wars.
Manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems, Shadow Three was a TIE/ln starfighter affiliated with the Imperial Navy's Shadow wing during the Galactic Civil War.

The Galactic Alliance Department of Education was an organization within the Galactic Alliance. One of their responsibilities was recommending lesson plans taught to students.
In the last weeks of 8 ABY, Grand Admiral Thrawn raided the Draukyze system in a hit-and-fade attack with a single Star Destroyer in order to test his forces.

The Reverie was a massive luxury liner that catered to the richest beings in the galaxy.
The Caridan district was a section of the planet Carida. Located just outside the Imperial Academy of Carida, the district was well-known for its booming nightlife.

A protoplanetary disk surrounded the blue giant star Kuna's Eye in the Kuna's Eye system, within the Inner Zuma Region of the Moddell subsector of the Outer Rim. Its parent system was less than 1,000 light-years above the galactic plane, located inside the thin disk.

The breathers were a rare Gand subspecies. Scientists were unsure if this race was of an older evolutionary stock, destined to either die out or further evolve; or if they were another coexisting race.

A diversionary battle was fought between the New Republic and the forces of Grand Admiral Thrawn during his military campaign. The assault on Crondre was used as a feint to draw New Republic forces away from Ord Pardron, which in turn left the planet Ukio vulnerable.
A raid on Tangrene took place during the Galactic Civil War and was Garm Bel Iblis's movement's most prestigious military victory.
Late in 8 ABY, the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Stormhawk executed a hit-and-fade attack on the planet Saarn, wiping out New Republic personnel.

A settlement on the moon Gus Talon was home to Rallo's workshop, among other locations. The entire city was destroyed by Imperial orbital bombardment in 2 BBY.

The Promenade was a glitzy and extravagant commercial district of Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. The area was run by the Hutts of the Hutt Cartel and boasted casinos, boutiques, and a massive golden statue of Karagga in the center of the Promenade square.
The Blastfield Shipyards was a massive complex located on Corellia during the Cold War. The complex was dedicated to the construction of capital ships for the Galactic Republic.

A spitapillar was a creature native to Tatooine. Luke Skywalker encountered one inside a Jawa sandcrawler.
This planet was a colony world that was located in the Rim Worlds region of the galaxy. During the waning years of the Galactic Republic, the Human Garth Ezzar was born and raised on the planet.

Blackie's was the name given by Blackie and Cravel, two thieves, to a junkyard in Vorrnti City that they took over shortly before 9 ABY. They used the yard as a front to fix up a derelict AT-AT walker and use it to steal some spice.

Vorrnti City was a city on the planet Vorrnti. It contained a junkyard. The entrepreneur Lando Calrissian visited shortly before 9 ABY and acquired a derelict AT-AT walker with the help of the Katarn Commandos from the New Republic.

Kalab was a planet located within the Sluis sector in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was known to be frequented by smugglers.

By the time of the Jedi Civil War fought between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, a smuggling ring had been run by a smuggler named Galduran Calrissian in the region of the galaxy known as Hutt Space.

The Pit was a location used by the Taris Resistance in 3963 BBY as a place for the Resistance to fall back to after the occupying Mandalorian forces attacked the main Resistance base.
The Sisters of Seelah was an all-female political faction of the Lost Tribe of Sith on Kesh during the Time of the Rot around the 3000 BBY.
The Korsinite League was a political faction of the Lost Tribe of Sith on Kesh which existed during the period of turmoil known as the Time of the Rot.
The Force 57 was a political faction of the Lost Tribe of Sith on Kesh in the period of turmoil around 3000 BBY. They were inspired from the tales of the original Red Sith living on Kesh.
The Golden Destiny was a political faction of the Lost Tribe of Sith on the Wild Space planet of Kesh which had emerged during the Time of the Rot which ended in 3000 BBY.
The Mission to Rescue Doctor Bledsoe was a mission tasked by Colonel Darkstone to rescue Doctor Bledsoe from the Rebel Alliance.
The Agarrees Shipyard Township was a settlement with a docking bay that was infested with mynocks, creatures capable of flight that fed on the energy from power cabling.

During the Galactic Civil War, a battle occurred in space outside the luxury liner Destination: Adventure!. When a group of smugglers emerged from hyperspace outside of the vessel, some pirates were right behind them.

At the end of the Great Sith War, a battle occurred on the planet Thule. With the help of former Sith Lord Ulic Qel-Droma, the Galactic Republic forces disabled the Dark Reaper, a deadly Sith superweapon, during the battle.
The Ultaarian Greenback was a sentient, four-armed, bipedal species. Members of the species had green eyes, a pink horn growing from the nose, large fangs, and pink skin.
Poln Major was a planet located in the Poln system, of the Outer Rim Candoras sector. Poln Major was the seat of government in the area.

Poln Minor was a planet in the Poln system, of the Outer Rim Candoras sector. Although once a center of mining and manufacturing, by 0 ABY its roles had diminished in both capacities. Poln Minor was rich in natural resources, and had a deep network of underground caverns.

Hapor was a terrestrial planet that was located in the Inner Rim's Hapor system and featured the Griren Province. In 0 ABY, the Hand of Judgment, a group of five Galactic Empire stormtrooper deserters, participated in a minor water dispute in the province.

The Griren Province was located on the Inner Rim planet Hapor. In 0 ABY, the Hand of Judgment, a team of five stormtrooper deserters of the Galactic Empire, participated in a lesser water dispute in the province.

Elegasso was a minor planet under the control of the Galactic Empire. In 0 ABY, a local election was blatantly rigged, drawing the attention of the Hand of Judgment stormtrooper team and Imperial agent Mara Jade.

Pickerin was a planet under the control of the Galactic Empire. In 0 ABY, Pickerin was visited by the Hand of Judgment stormtrooper team after hearing word that the government there had enslaved local artisans.

A mission was launched by the Jedi Order to infiltrate and destroy the Starcrusher, a powerful Separatist warship capable of destroying multiple Republic Star Destroyers.

The Rasi Tuum family was a family of Cathar that, during the time of the Second Imperial Civil War, consisting of the littermates Ahn, Zho, and a brother known only as Rasi Tuum. All three were members of the New Jedi Order. Ahn was killed by the One Sith in 137 ABY.

The Brentaal Spacefarers League was a spacer organization based on Brentaal IV circa 3700 BBY. Freia Kallea took an apprenticeship in the league despite the disapproval of her parents Olun and Henne Kallea.
The Human male Matt Talon was born on an agricultural planet. His family was impoverished.

During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire hired the First Sun Mobile Regiment mercenary organization to attack an outpost somewhere in the galaxy. The outpost had been accused of harboring Rebel Alliance sympathizers.
Flexible antennae distinguished members of a tall, spindly sentient species. The species also had feet, bright-yellow eyes, and shrill voices when concerned.
The Tuash'aa was a giant bird native to the planet Kesh. There was said to be Two, a light one and A Dark One.
The Jessar were a sentient species native to the planet of Qaras. In 44 ABY, the Jessar led by Rokari Kem revolted against their enslavers, the Minyavish species.

Qaras was the homeworld of the Jessar species as well as the Minyavish. In 44 ABY, the Minyavish were revolted against by the Jessar, led by Rokari Kem. The Minyavish were then forced to leave the planet.

The Minyavish were a sentient species native to the planet Qaras. For seven thousand years they saw themselves as managers of the planet with native Jessar species as their servants. In 44 ABY, the Minyavish were revolted against by the enslaved Jessar.
Xilxash was an agricultural planet that applied for and was granted Galactic Alliance membership in 44 ABY. It was a small backwater world, known for its delicious brul fruit.
G'haris was a planet from which the rare saass worm originated.
The B'nishi were a sentient species native to the planet B'nish.
Following the Battle of Lianna in 22 BBY, a funeral was held for Jedi Master Cei Vookto, who had sacrificed himself in the battle. Jedi Master Mace Windu presided over the ceremony.

Upekzar was a small terrestrial planet counted among the Sith Worlds of the Esstran sector that was unique among the mostly barren worlds of the Stygian Caldera for its diversity of verdant biomes.
Rhak-skuri, which translated from the ancient Sith as "Dream Singer", were a dark side twisted sub-species of Diplura native to the planet Upekzar.
The Circle of Visions was a circular chain of volcanic islands and coastline locations on the Sith World of Upekzar that ran from the planet's equatorial regions down to its south pole.
In 44 ABY, a duel occurred in the courtyard of the Dark Force Temple on the planet Dromund Kaas between Sith Sabers affiliated with the dark side entity Abeloth and representatives of the Jedi Order.

Club Bwuat'u was a clandestine organization within the Galactic Alliance government and other well-placed and informed beings who were determined to uncover the various conspiracies that seemed to be bent on total galactic anarchy.

HK-57 was a HK-series assassin droid produced in an old Separatist droid factory on Mustafar under the control of rogue assassin droid HK-47. After flaws in the HK-57 and subsequent HK-67 models were discovered, HK-47 initiated the creation of a new model, the HK-77 droid.

Rebel Assault Commandos were elite troops of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. They wore Rebel battle armor and were armed with blaster weapons.

In 1 ABY, Trandoshan slavers of the Blackscale Clan under the command of slaver master Klesk had set up a camp in the southern part of the Etyyy region on Kashyyyk. It consisted of three large tents and was guarded by well-armed Blackscale guards.

Thuruht was a Killik hive that imprisoned the powerful Force entity Abeloth on a planet in the Maw. When Abeloth broke free from her confinement in 44 ABY, the Thuruht prepared for the end of the galaxy.

The M'dweshuui Stronghold was a cave located on the Mid Rim world of Naboo. Located southeast of the Lake Retreat in the foothills of the Gallo Mountains, the cave was used as a compound by the Cult of M'dweshuu during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The Empire Maker was a Imperial II-class Star Destroyer built by the Imperial Remnant that served as Moff Drikl Lecersen's flagship at the Battle over Exodo II.
The Kagcatcher was an Imperial Immobilizer 418 cruiser present at the Battle over Exodo II.

In 44 ABY, a second duel occurred in Kesla Vein on Nam Chorios, immediately after the first. When the Jedi arrived near Kandra Nilitz's landspeeder, they were again ambushed by several Sith Sabers of the Lost Tribe of Sith, which were again commanded by Tola Annax.

A revolt undertaken by enslaved individuals took place on Qaras in 44 ABY, inspired by revolts of Octusi and Klatooinians. The Jessar population, enslaved by the Minyavish, were aided by Freedom Flight. Guided by their leader, Rokari Kem, they overthrew the Minyavish.

H0-U53 was a vendor droid found in the Jedi Temple during the Clone Wars. The droid sold furniture.

80-T5 was a vendor droid found in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during the Clone Wars. The droid sold droids.
