N-30H was a protocol droid that was often used to assist Jedi in the Jedi Temple during the Clone Wars.
B3-3P5 was a R4 astromech droid that was often used to assist Jedi in the Jedi Temple during the Clone Wars.
NO-8OT was a Protocol droid that was often used to assist Jedi in the Jedi Temple during the Clone Wars.
7L-VN was a R2-series astromech droid that was often used to assist Jedi in the Jedi Temple during the Clone Wars.
The Battle of Corrdair was a battle fought between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire at Corrdair during the Galactic Civil War at some point before or in 1 BBY.
The Agitator was a CR90 corvette of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. In 1 ABY, the ship was seen in the Bright Jewel system.
The Valor Prevails was a Harrower-class dreadnought used by the resurgent Sith Empire. It was under the command of Captain Eisek and patrolled the Vesla system.

Cobal was a planet where a small group of Jedi had settled. These Jedi wore unique robes, appearing like casual clothing that was patterned brown and turquoise with one sleeve being larger than the other.
Mestare was a planet where unique lightsaber crystals were mined. It was said that lightsabers which utilized these crystals could cut through cortosis, a lightsaber-resistant metal.

Dahgee was a planet where unique lightsaber crystals were mined. A small group of Jedi with unique robes also lived there. The lightsaber crystals on Dahgee gave their lightsabers a strange, zigzagging blade with a black core, almost like a tree branch.
The Dark Dancer was a starship that served under the portion of the Lost Tribe of Sith's armada commanded by Sith Saber Gavar Khai.

The Annihilation Droid XRR-3, named Silentior by its creator Soa, was originally used to destroy civilizations during the period of the Infinite Empire but was re-programmed to protect the Eternity Vault prison on Belsavis during the Cold War from anything getting in or out.
The Ragtags were a group of thugs who formed the Ragtag gang. They operated on the planet Corellia at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The Council of Agricultural Corps Masters was a Jedi Council that oversaw the internal affairs of the Agricultural Corps.
Ferrazid hounds were animals native to the planet Taris. They lived in the planet's jungles and swamps millennia ago, before it became an urban environment.
Grace Command was a relief organization from the planet Alderaan that officially carried out missions into Sith-controlled regions of space during the time of the New Sith Wars.
The Cadaman Royal Highway was a road in JanFathal's capital city of Athar. It suffered damage during a Separatist uprising on the world.

Dagger was a starship in the service of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, it was sent with a complement of clone troopers under the command of High Jedi General Mace Windu to safeguard Kothlis in the wake of a Separatist invasion there, before being sent to p…
Torbel was a small village on the planet Lanteeb. During the Clone Wars around 21 BBY, there was a mine located in the town that delivered raw damotite for Lok Durd's damotite bioweapon.

objective: Recover a crashed escape pod containing the stolen location of the Sep
x: In 21 BBY during the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic launched a mission to the planet Asuin, sending Jedi Generals Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi to retrieve a task force that had uncovered the coordinates of the Confederacy of Independent Systems' strategic hypermatter…

J-3PO was a Galactic Republic protocol droid that stored the coordinates for the hypermatter generators once they were uncovered from the Confederacy of Independent Systems. However, the droid was destroyed by the Dark Acolyte Asajj Ventress.

objective: Kill Anakin Skywalker
x: In 22 BBY during the Clone Wars, Jedi General Anakin Skywalker, Jedi Commander Ahsoka Tano, and Clone Captain Rex launched a mission to the starship Deyvus to save the apparently endangered civilian starship.
The Krayt Cult Cave was a cave in the desert near Mos Eisley on Tatooine. During the Galactic Civil War, it was the home of the Krayt Cult that worshiped krayt dragons.
The Beetle Cave was a cave located on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine. During the time of the Galactic Civil War, the cave was used as a base of operations for a group of pirates known as the Sennex.
The Hutt Hideout was a cave on the planet Tatooine. It was used by thugs working for Jabba the Hutt. The cave was located east of the Mesric Plateau, and some distance southeast of Mos Taike.
The Tusken Bunker was the name given to an Imperial bunker on Tatooine after it was invaded by the Tusken Raiders during the Galactic Civil War.
The Tusken Village, simply known as the village by its denizens, was a small village on the desert world of Tatooine.
The Rebel Military Base was a base used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic on the desert world of Tatooine.

The Giant Bark Mite Cave was a natural cave on the Nabooian moon of Rori. It was populated by giant bark mites. The creatures had discovered that the cave was damp and warm, making it a perfect nursery for their brood.
The Pygmy Torton Cave was a cave southeast of the city of Narmle on the Nabooian moon Rori. It was populated by pygmy tortons.
Corrdair was a planet located in the Corrdair system of the Hevvrol sector in the Mid Rim. The Battle of Corrdair took place there.

The Giant Decay Mite Cave was a cave west of the city of Dearic on Talus. It was populated by giant decay mites. Scientists believed that something in the rock of the cave had triggered these impressive changes within the insects.
The Giant Fynock Cave was a cave northeast of the city of Dearic on Talus. It was populated by giant fynocks.
The Lost Aqualish War Party's Cave was a cave located northwest of the city of Dearic on the planet Talus. It was used by the Lost Aqualish.
The Death Star Salvage Site was a salvage site in the jungles of Yavin 4. When the Rebel Alliance destroyed the Imperial Death Star near the moon, its debris rained down onto the jungle world.
The Canyon Corsair's Stronghold was located on the planet Lok. It was the base of operations of the Canyon Corsairs, a band of space pirates who plagued the Karthakk system.

The Downed Blood Razor's Transport was a camp built around a transport ship of the Blood Razors that had crash-landed on the planet of Lok. Since that time, it had been used as a base of operations for the Blood Razors.

Harswee was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Mandalore sector. The Mandalorian ruler known as Mandalore the Binder hailed from Harswee, and carpets from its looms were used to decorate the Mandalorian starship Coronet.
The Squill Sanctuary was an area in the desert of Tatooine where a large population of mountain squills lived.
The Darklighter cache, also known as the Darklighter cave, was a cave located on the planet Tatooine. Located near the Darklighter estate, it was used by the Darklighter family as a cache.
The Darkwalker Cave was a cave located a very short distance south of the city of Dee'ja Peak on the Mid Rim world of Naboo.

The Darkwalker Cave was a cave located on the Mid Rim world of Naboo. Located a relatively short distance east of the city of Theed, the cave was under the control of a criminal organization known as the Darkwalkers.
The Skaak Tipper Cave was a cave a relatively short distance northwest of the city of Dee'ja Peak on Naboo. It was used by the Skaak Tippers as a base of operations.

The Mauler Stronghold was the base of operations for the Maulers on the planet Naboo during the Galactic Civil War. It consisted of a small Nabooian villa and a bunker facility, located near the city of Keren.
The Korga Cave was a cave on the Forest moon of Endor. Duloks of the Korga tribe at one point built a hunting outpost within the cavern.
The Orphaned Marauder's Cave was a cave on the Forest moon of Endor.
The Jinda Ritualist's Cave was a cave on the Forest moon of Endor. It was used by the Jinda Ewoks for hunting expeditions in the neighboring forests.
A Smuggler Camp on Yavin 4 was used by the Twi'lek smuggler Ewrosa Soci. It was a secret landing site for transport ships that smuggled spice to the jungle moon that Soci sold to local workers.
The Rancor Cave was a cave on the remote planet Dathomir, located right next to the Nightsister Stronghold. It was populated by many rancors.
The Tao-Ni Security Compound was a bunker located on the forest moon of Endor. Situated in the Salma Desert, it was used as a base of operations for the Tao-Ni Security organization.

Syngia was a celestial body located in the Syngia system of the Sertar sector, in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It lay on the hyperlane known as the Shaltin Tunnels, which connected it to the Lianna and Zygerria systems.

The Cruthauses was a group of Force-sensitive individuals. At some point between 82 BBY and 72 BBY, in an annotation made in a section of his copy of the Jedi trainee guidebook The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force devoted to non–dark side Force-using organizations…
The Boughtine was an organization made up of individuals who were sensitive to the Force. By 72 BBY, the Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn had made contact with the group.

The third moon of Kothlis was a satellite of the planet Kothlis. Around 4 ABY, the Squib named Maja crash-landed on the moon in a Tech 4 PDV. A group of adventurers soon approached him to recover information on the vessel. Maja negotiated with the strangers and sold the vessel.
The Judicator was a CR90 corvette of the Galactic Empire. In 1 ABY the ship operated in the Bright Jewel system.

Feldwes was a planet located in the Feldwes system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Ardan Cross connected it to the Arda and Pygorix systems.
The "Starcrusher" was a large Separatist starship made to look like the battleship Starcrusher during the Clone Wars. It served as a trap for a team of Jedi Knights.
The planet Daltarri was a terrestrial world located in the galaxy. It was covered in plant life which was the home of the plant-based Daltarri species.
The Daltarri were a plant-based species that lived on the planet Daltarri.
A C-9979 landing craft was used by the Trade Federation to invade the planet Naboo in 32 BBY. The Jedi Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi escaped from the Trade Federation battleship Saak'ak aboard this craft.

The Battle of Rhigar occurred in 19 ABY. It was a surprise attack on Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy in the Rata Nebula following the destruction of the Hand of Thrawn, capital of the Empire of the Hand.

objective: Capture the Blackguard
x: The retaking of the Blackguard was a mission undertaken by a group of spacers during the Galactic Civil War, sometime after the Battle of Yavin, to retake the Imperial Star Destroyer known as the Blackguard from the traitorous Imperial Captain and self-proclaimed Grand Admiral…
The Zel'iphian Slave Traders Guild was a sect of slavers that operated in the Dantooine system at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The Joben Crate Company was a Corellian manufacturing company near Coronet that produced crates. It was owned by Talan Joben.
The Valor was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy.

Imperial stormrifles, also known as stormtrooper riflemen, were specialized members of the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps. They fulfilled a similar role to stormsnipers and scout troopers, engaging with the enemy at considerable ranges.

A Research Camp located in the wilderness of the planet Kashyyyk was used by a group of researchers during the Galactic Civil War. The camp was eventually destroyed by the Canopy bandits and the scientists were assassinated.
Stormsurgeons were a variant of standard stormtroopers that were field medics who were responsible for providing emergency medical treatment at a point of wounding in a combat.
Boreleo was the moon of the planet Exodo II. By 44 ABY it was a abandoned mining colony and at the same year destroyed during an Imperial Remnant mutiny.
The 3rd Imperial Heavy Armor was an armored division of the Imperial Army that fought against the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Uizani was a breed of avian creature endemic to the world of Radnor.
Lux was a modified Seeker droid who was used for security in the Glow Dome a nightclub located on the planet Adarlon. He was heavily armed and modified by Dr. Lytos Urtell.

The arool was a species of cactus that was native to Ithor, a planet in the Ottega sector. The arool was one of several semi-sentient plant species on the planet; others included the bafforr and the vesuvague trees. The arool was poisonous to Humans.

The Death Merchant was a GR-75 medium transport owned by the scavenger Arns Grimraker. Grimraker ran a large salvage operation out of the Death Merchant, which allowed him to move quickly and quietly between battlefields to claim the choicest finds before the competition.

t: Battle of the Dernatine system (Mandalorian Wars)
x: Sometime between 3973 BBY and 3965 BBY, during the early years of the conflict known as the Mandalorian Wars, the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders raided the Dernatine system, a star system in Hutt Space.

In 3962 BBY, the Galactic Republic was engaged by Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders in the Vena system located in the Expansion Region's Nojic sector as part of the Mandalorian Wars, an ongoing conflict between the two groups.
Orimanther was a world in the Quelii sector that was visited by the Chevin slaver Phylus Mon during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

The battlebird was a type of bird that lived on the world Orimanther, in the Outer Rim Territories. During the waning years of the Galactic Republic, the Chevin slaver Phylus Mon traveled to Orimanther and attempted to capture a flock of battlebirds.
A group of slicers operated on the planet Lok at the time of the Galactic Civil War. They were based in a building near Nym's Stronghold.
The Last Stand at Refnar was a military engagement between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The Alliance were forced to evacuate their base on the planet Refnar.
The Ni'lyahin Smugglers were a group of of thieves and assassins that was active at the time of the Galactic Civil War.

The Dragonsnake was a Defender-class Star Destroyer in the New Republic Defense Fleet. It was one of the ships that answered the call to aid the Heart of Artorias when Commander Bylsma sent out a request for support to defend Shramar.

The Reptavian was a Republic-class Star Destroyer in the New Republic Defense Fleet. It was one of the ships that answered the call to aid the Heart of Artorias when Commander Bylsma sent out a request for support to defend Shramar.
The Porthoy was a Kuat Systems Transport II freighter that was used by the Metatheran Cartel during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
The Veermok Cave was a cave nestled within the Gallo Mountains near Dee'ja Peak on Naboo. During the last decades of the Old Republic, the cave was an ore mine operated by the Jandosan Mines.

A redbeast was a omnivorous scavenger and hunter that lived in the lower levels of Vandalar City. They lived in packs of two to twelve creatures. They were about one meter at the shoulder, with a length of two meters. They also had a one-and-a-half-meter bushy tail.
The Crystal Runner was a CEC YT-1300 light freighter. It operated in the Dathomir system in the year 1 ABY, transporting lightly glowing crystals.

t: Battle of the Nazzri system (Mandalorian Wars)
x: In 3962 BBY, while the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders were invading Galactic Republic territory during the conflict known as the Mandalorian Wars, the two clashed in the Nazzri system located in the Mid Rim's Lantillian sector.

t: Battle of the Gizer system (Mandalorian Wars)
x: During the Mandalorian Wars, in the year 3962 BBY, a battle took place in the Gizer system located in the Mid Rim's Lantillian sector. The conflict erupted when Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders invaded Galactic Republic space.
During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the planet Cathar was attacked and conquered by the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong.
The Salvage bandits were a group of Mustafarian criminals and salvagers that operated on the planet Mustafar at the time of the Galactic Civil War. They were led by Boss Uruli.
The Mountain Poachers were a criminal group of poachers that was active on the planet Naboo at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The Offworld Special Events was an organization charged to organize concerts and spectacles in the galaxy during the Galactic Civil War era. Litassa Colay was its director.

A resistance group fought in the Battle of Slotern against the Galactic Empire before or during the year 1 BBY. Part of the resistance group on the world Slotern used starfighters to battle against the Imperial TIE fighters, while another part of the group was on the ground.

The Rryatt Ceremonial Guard was a ceremonial Wookiee guard that guarded the giant gate to the Rryatt Trail, a long and dangerous trail that eventually led its travelers to the shadowy surface of Kashyyyk.
The Voracious was a starfighter carrier used by Zodoh the Hutt during his expansionary campaign into the Sith-dominated Grumani sector in 1032 BBY.

The Troukree were a reptilian sentient species, native to their homeworld in the Unknown Regions. Some of them served Thrawn in his fight against Nuso Esva on Poln Major, using their prowess with blades in close-quarters combat. They had a strong belief in an honor system.
When the Velmoc named Jedidiah was discovered by members of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War, a 2-1B medical droid examined the Velmoc to assess his incoherent mental state.

A battle on the planet of Contruum took place as part of the Mandalorian Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders, in 3962 BBY. It occurred during a Mandalorian campaign to capture of the Core World of Duro.

While the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders were invading Galactic Republic territory during the Mandalorian Wars conflict, in 3962 BBY, the two did battle on the planet of Azure, which the Mandalorians had also raided earlier.
In 19 BBY, a space battle took place in the Atoan system in the Ghost Nebula between forces of the Galactic Empire led by Darth Vader, and Atoan defenders.
A ravenscreecher was a large multi-clawed bird native to the Outer Rim planet Wxtm. They had a large wing span and six legs with claws half a meter long.

During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, the B-wing starfighter was first used to destroy a frigate when the Rebels attacked the Nebulon-B frigate Shrike.

Vader's training chambers were located in Darth Vader's castle. It consisted of a combat arena in which he could practice his lightsaber combat skills against modified ASP-19 battle droids. In 3 ABY, Darth Vader met with Imperial spy Jix and his Noghri bodyguard Kohvrekhar here.

The Battle in the Turkana system was a Rebel attack against the Imperial corvette Talon near Turkana. It was Keyan Farlander's first mission. The Rebels captured the corvette and a copy of a top secret Imperial document.

The Battle in the Dellalt system was a Rebel attack against an Imperial convoy in the Dellalt system. During this mission, the Rebels discovered that the Emperor had ordered a new campaign to crush the Alliance: the Operation Strike Fear.

A camp was built by a Gotal hunting party in the dangerous Shadowlands, the dark ground level of the kilometers-high forests of Kashyyyk. It consisted of several rather primitive tents and huts made of wood and hides.
In 1 ABY, Trandoshan slavers of the Blackscale Clan had set up a hunting camp on a high-rising rock formation on the Webweaver Path level of the Rryatt Trail on the planet Kashyyyk.

A group of feral Wookiees had set up a camp on a high-rising rock formation that was accessible via large branches of the high-rising trees of the Webweaver Path level of the Rryatt Trail on the planet Kashyyyk. It consisted of several primitive huts.

result: Successful identification of all Imperial ships
x: The Mission in the Dellalt system was a Rebel reconnaissance mission flown by Keyan Farlander in the Dellalt system. He revealed the outbreak of Operation Strike Fear.

The Ascendant Spear was a Terminus-class destroyer that had been modified into a long-range battle cruiser with a Class 0.5 hyperdrive. This made it incredibly fast in hyperspace compared to the other capital ships of its time.
The Undying was a large capital ship with unknown capabilities. It was larger than the other superweapons created with the Sun Razer.
The Skirmish near Brigia was an Imperial attack during the the transfer of wounded following the evacuation of Brigia.

A group of Rodian hunters ventured onto the Rryatt Trail — a long and winding trail through the dense Kashyyykian forests during the Galactic Civil War. They set up a small camp on the Wroshyr Canopy level of the trail when they got lost and couldn't find their way back.
During the Galactic Civil War, a group of escaped Wookiee slaves went into hiding on the dangerous Rryatt Trail — a long and winding trail through the enormous forests of Kashyyyk.

K4-06B, also known as "Kay," was a masculine secretary droid who was partnered with Uurk, a Gamorrean lawkeeper of the Emmer police. He was specialized in translating Uurk's Gamorrese, defusing bombs, dealing with kidnappers and terrorists, and doing paperwork.

The Dark Eclipse was a Warlord Heavy Cruiser used by the Black Sun during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, it operated in the Dathomir system and later in the Bright Jewel system where it was spotted together with a group of Black Sun starfighters.
The Mephyt River, also known as the Krisa River, was a river located on the planet of Talus. The city of Nashal was built along its banks.
This Aqua droid participated in the Battle of Mon Cala around 21 BBY under the command of Separatist commander Riff Tamson.

The Krask Pirates were a band of space pirates that operated in the Bright Jewel system during the Galactic Civil War. Krask pilots flew Ixiyen-class fast attack crafts, Kihraxz assault fighters and Rihkxyrk assault fighters.
During the Cold War era that followed the Great Galactic War, the Galactic Republic undertook the Taris Resettlement Initiative, an effort to restore the ruined world of Taris.

x: The Battle of Ilum, also known as Operation Dark Ice, was a conflict in the early years of the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, Republic forces undertook a mission to the Hutt homeworld of Hutta.
The Gladiators' Open was a open-ended gladiatorial challenge that was held on The Wheel.

result: Secrets of Ithorian technology surrendered to the Empire
x: The subjugation of Ithor occurred in the early years of the Galactic Empire. The advent of smuggling activity around Ithorian space brought the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Conquest into orbit over the forest planet.

A species of flowering cactus was found on the planet of Lok. After the Battle of Yavin, during the Galactic Civil War, Nym, the leader of the Lok Revenants, ordered Ran Machado to oversee the removal of unintended foliage from Nym's Stronghold.

A species of paddle cactus was found on the planet of Lok. After the Battle of Yavin, during the Galactic Civil War, Nym, the leader of the Lok Revenants, ordered Ran Machado to oversee the removal of unintended foliage from Nym's Stronghold.

A species of yellow pod weeds were found on the planet of Lok. After the Battle of Yavin, during the Galactic Civil War, Nym, the leader of the Lok Revenants, ordered Ran Machado to oversee the removal of unintended foliage from Nym's Stronghold.

A species of low growing weed was found on the planet of Lok. After the Battle of Yavin, during the Galactic Civil War, Nym, the leader of the Lok Revenants, ordered Ran Machado to oversee the removal of unintended foliage from Nym's Stronghold.

A species of tall weed was found on the planet of Lok. After the Battle of Yavin, during the Galactic Civil War, Nym, the leader of the Lok Revenants, ordered Ran Machado to oversee the removal of unintended foliage from Nym's Stronghold.
A planet had seven rings orbiting it and was the homeworld to a humanoid species. The natives would swear by their planet's rings.

A planet was located in the Outer Rim, near the border of the Galactic Republic's territory. The world was conquered by Mandalorian forces under control of Rohlan Dyre, a Mandalorian Crusader who was trying to escape the army so he could discover the true motivations behind Ma…

Battle droid squad 8313 was a B1-series battle droid squad carried aboard a C-9979 landing craft. The squad was deployed during the Invasion of Naboo in the year 32 BBY. The young Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi sneaked onboard the landing craft after escaping the Saak'ak.

result: General Grievous's collection of Sith lightsabers destroyed
x: A duel took place on the acidic planet Dica between the Confederate General Grievous and Dark Jedi twins Kaa and Lii. When one of the twins stole Grievous's Sith lightsaber collection, the General followed her and confronted her and the other sister on Dica.

government: Feudal crime lord clans (up to 25,805 BBY)
x: Shikaakwa was a planet that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region. The planet had a breathable atmosphere and was covered by landmasses and expanses of ocean.

x: The Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi undertook a rescue mission in the city of Theed on Naboo after escorting the Queen home from her mission to speak to the Galactic Senate.
A Stormdriver was a type of capital ship used during the Republic Dark Age by the Hutt crime lord Zodoh.

The Battle of Capital Cay was a three-way battle during the Aquilaris campaign in the Republic Dark Age. In 1032 BBY, the port city of Capital Cay in Aquilaris was occupied by Daimanate forces, the latest in a chain of conquering Sith fiefdoms.

400,324 Henryson was a small, crater-ridden planetoid that was located in the Sil'Lume asteroid belt, in the Sil'Lume system. The planetoid was about a kilometer in length and about half a kilometer in both width and thickness.

A blue-hued planet was located near the Hydian Way, not far from the planet Bandomeer. A stormy world, the planet appeared to be blue in color from space, while its atmosphere had white and gray clouds. It had five moons and was the homeworld of the silver-scaled draigon.
The Legacy was a starship that was owned by Jedi Master Darrus Jeht during the Clone Wars.

The Seeker was a starship that was used by the spacers Khedryn Faal and Marr Idi-Shael. At some point, the pair flew the ship from the planet Fhost to a star system in the Unknown Regions, where they planned to salvage a derelict ship.
This mission was an attack by a group of Rebels on an Imperial prison near Bestine, Tatooine, with the objective of freeing several valuable Rebel prisoners held inside. It was successful.

result: Rebel Alliance prevents the Galactic Empire from beginning a civil war
x: The Calamari Project was a project that was initiated by the Destabilization branch of Imperial Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War, aiming to cause a war between the Mon Calamari and Quarren species, to prevent the planet Mon Calamari from supplying starships to the Re…

This mission occurred during the Galactic Civil War when Rebel pilot Wedge Antilles and a Rebel agent were sent to the asteroid Skip 52, located in the Smuggler's Run asteroid field, to recover a lost shipment of ryll spice.
A mission was carried out by the Rebel Alliance near the city of Bela Vistal on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.

objective: Rescue Rebel Alliance prisoners
x: A rescue was performed by a Rebel strike force to free several Rebellion members from a prison bunker on the moon of Yavin 4. They succeeded freeing the captives.

result: Rebel Alliance secures significant war materiel
x: A large-scale battle took place in the remote Poln system, primarily above the double planets Poln Major and Poln Minor between elements of the Galactic Empire and the forces of alien warlord Nuso Esva, eight months after the Battle of Yavin in 0 ABY.

A debris field in the Taspan system was created by a gravity well projector accident known as the Big Crush that caused the destruction of the planet Taspan II. As of the Battle of Mindor, the debris had not yet had time to settle into stable orbits.

An R2 unit was used by Wes Janson during a battle over Gall. It was programmed by the traitorous Viera Cheran, Chief Technician for Rogue Squadron, to take over control of Janson's X-wing fighter and shoot down Luke Skywalker.

The Seacroppers' Guild was an organization of farmers that cultivated algae on the big oceans of Aquilaris Minor during the New Sith Wars. They were also fishermen who hunted for eels and members of the Guild wore a uniform consisting of grey overalls and boots.

In 704 BBY, the Expansionist Oligarchy exploited its administrative authority over the newly-created Outer Expansion Zone to abuse the region's resources and peoples. The resulting civil unrest and political scandal forced the Galactic Senate of the Republic to intervene.

A skirmish took place at the Riverview Café in the city of Varlo on the planet Roonadan in 44 ABY. The Imperial Moff Tol Getelles had been performing experiments with drochs on three Squibs, Sligh, Emala, and Grees, and began planning with recently-ousted Chief of State Natasi…

Mhatma 5 was a cold terrestrial world that occupied the fifth orbital position in the Mhatma system, a part of the freestanding subsectors portion of the Mid Rim. During the Galactic Civil War, Mhatma 5 was situated on the galactic frontier.
Voniss was an astronomical object located in the Voniss system, a part of the freestanding subsectors portion of the Mid Rim. The meteorological phenomena of the celestial body included dust storms.

Slotern was a world where a battle was fought between the Galactic Empire and a resistance group sometime between the years 19 BBY and 1 BBY. The world was located in the Slotern system of the Wazta sector, which was located in the Outer Rim Territories.
Renhoek was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Lulsla was a MC80 Liberty type Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

This Imperial-class Star Destroyer was commanded by Captain Wankle during the Galactic Civil War. It patrolled near the planet Sullust, and conducted cargo inspections of ships entering and exiting the system.

Oristrom was an Unknown Regions planet located in the eponymous system. The homeworld of the strong–willed Stromma species, the world was controlled by the Stromma council, an organization that led all Stromma planets.
The Voidstar was a prototype battleship belonging to the Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War. It went missing during the conflict and was rediscovered during the following Cold War.

The Jedi Guardian Iunist and the Trandoshan tyrant Gusepp once engaged in battle. Iunist severed the tyrant's forearm, and the encounter subsequently became legendary. Gusepp's Hand became a valuable artifact.
Protector was a Victory II-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War and later the Yuuzhan Vong War.

The plant was from the planet Gibbela, a primitive agricultural planet in the Outer Rim's Atrivis sector. It had had a single stalk that grew a cylindrical, spiraling, yellow crop, with white tufts at the top. The crop was supported by overlapping, dark green, pointed leaves.

x: In 4 ABY, shortly after the Battle of Endor, the Alliance of Free Planets undertook a relief mission to the planet Godo, where the native Godoans had fallen victim to a disease.

The Umbaran militia was the local defense force of Umbara, a shadowy world in the Ghost Nebula. The militia was comprised of the planet's native Umbaran people, who utilized their advanced technology that had been developed on their world to defend their holdings and attack en…

The Tusken Relic Cave was a cave complex on the desert planet of Tatooine that was inhabited by Tusken Raiders. The cave was located in the Tusken March region of Tatooine, near Fort Tusken. The cave was where a tribe of Tusken Raiders kept their most sacred relics.

result: Most of Qawohl's comrades are murdered
x: The skirmish on Cholganna was a conflict fought sometime before 3678 BBY. The skirmish was waged by agents of the Sith Empire, and resulted in the deaths of many of the Abyssin Qawohl's comrades.
Bogoa was a planet covered in spires of durable coral, which could be used as ship-building materials. During the Clone Wars, the planet was under the protection of the Galactic Republic.
In 20 BBY, during the Clone Wars, a battle took place on the coral world Bogoa.
Coppertop was the name assumed by a B1-series battle droid who served in the Droid Army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Gungan Scout Camp was located on the Western Great Grass Plains of Naboo, near the planet's capital city Theed. Composed of several tents, the small camp was used by Gungan scouts around 1 ABY.
The Hoverdale bandits were a group of bandits on the planet Tatooine led by the conman Andro Hoverdale. Their base of operations was a cave in the Tatooinian desert.

Hoverdale's Hideout was the base of operations of the conman Andro Hoverdale and his bandits in the Tatooinian desert. It was a deep cave, filled with all kinds of machinery, stolen droids and crates.

The Poisoned Miner's Camp was a mining camp in the Crystal Flats region of the volcanic planet of Mustafar. A Mustafarian mining crew used it as their base camp for their mining operation during the Galactic Civil War.
A mining camp was one of many similar mining camps run by the Mensix Mining Company on the planet Mustafar.
A Hammerhead-class cruiser was in service during the times of the Old Republic. Its wreck was found thousands of years later on the planet Mustafar.

The Fear and Futility was a Warlord Heavy Cruiser used by the Void Wings pirates during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, it operated in the Bright Jewel and Kashyyyk systems where it was spotted together with a group of Void Wings starfighters.
The Monumenters were a group of criminals on the planet Corellia at the time of the Galactic Civil War. They were mostly bandits and smugglers.

The First Brigade, also called the Restuss Brigade, was an organization that patrolled and defended the city Restuss on the Nabooian moon Rori, prior to its destruction in the Battle of Restuss in 1 ABY.

The Braggan's Fist Camp was the main camp of the Braggan's Fist, a group of criminals on Corellia at the time of the Galactic Civil War. The thugs had established their camp half a kilometer outside of the city of Tyrena.

The isolated agriworld Gibbela was home to a species of tree that produced red, spherical fruit. The plant was cultivated by the Dazouri, Gibbela's native sentient species, who supported it with tripods built from available materials.

x: During the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, a battle was waged aboard the Harrower-class dreadnought Voidstar.

During the Cold War, agents of the reconstituted Sith Empire launched an attack on the Galactic Republic's damaged Thranta-class corvette, the Brentaal Star, with the intention of intercepting and taking prisoner or killing one of the passengers on board the vessel, a Republic…
Raven Squadron was a group of mercenary starfighter pilots, flying Z-95 Headhunters, that attempted to kill Emon and Ace Azzameen in 3 ABY over Destreg II.
The battle of RS-32 was a battle fought during the Zaarin insurrection for the control of RS-32.

Guids were large, hair-covered primates native to the Deep Core planet of Tython. The guid's massive frame was supported by their muscular arms and smaller hind legs, supporting their weight on their knuckles as they walked.
The Forward Commander Mk II was a droid produced on the planet Mustafar by the rogue assassin droid HK-47 as part of his droid army. Its design was based on that of HK-47.
This swoop race was held annually in Tasjon, a city on the planet of Corulag, in the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In 22 BBY, it was won by Ignar Ominaz.

The Tyrena Starport was a spaceport located in the city of Tyrena on the Core World Corellia. Amarent Loren, a member of the Corellian Port Authority, worked at the Tyrena Starport during the Galactic Civil War.

The Daggers Point was a Warlord Heavy Cruiser used by the Hidden Daggers pirates during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, it operated in the Bright Jewel and Kashyyyk systems where it was spotted together with a group of Hidden Daggers starfighters.

The Sher Kar cave was the lair of a group of Sher Kar on Mustafar. To reach the cave, one had to travel across a long valley of the Tulrus Nesting Grounds full of dangerous tulrus. Mustafarian legends claimed that no one who entered a Sher Kar's lair returned alive.
The Quesoth were a sentient insectoid species native to the Unknown Regions planet Quethold and spoke the Quesoth Common Speak language.
The Stromma were a strong-willed sentient species from the planet Oristrom in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy.

Quethold was a terrestrial planet located in the Quethold system of the Unknown Regions. The planet, which contained several mines, was the homeworld of the insectoid Quesoth species, which spoke the Quesoth Common Speak and Soldier Speak languages.

conflict: Nuso Esva–Empire of the Hand conflict
x: An attack on the planet Quethold's Red City was carried out by Empire of the Hand forces under the command of Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo "Thrawn" in 8 ABY.
The Chosen were a group of Storm-hair elite warriors that served their master, Storm-hair Warlord Nuso Esva, with fanatical zeal since they emerged from an unidentified Unknown Regions world.
The Red City was city on the planet Quethold that was located to the south of the Dreaming Waters and was the seat of power of the Quesoth Queen of the Red.
Located on the Unknown Regions planet Quethold, the Black City was one of the three cities inhabited intermittently by the Quesoth species.
The White City was a city on the planet Quethold that was the seat of power of the Quesoth Queen of the White.

The Soldiers were a caste of the Quesoth, an insectoid species from the planet Quethold. The Soldiers had little intelligence and were fiercely loyal to the Quesoth Queen, who communicated with the Soldiers via the language Quesoth Soldier Speak, although the Soldiers lacked t…

The Lake Thorn, also known as Lake Bondoma, was a lake southwest of the city of Nashal on the planet Talus. It was connected to several rivers, including the Aximia River. The Nashal River Race swoop racing circuit crossed this lake.

The Jeassa River was a river on the planet Talus. A curved portion of the river was known as Kyuu's Twist. One of the legs of the Nashal River Race swoop racing circuit led along a part of this river.

The Dreaming Waters was a body of water located to the north of the planet Quethold's Red City. In 8 ABY, the Quesoth bowlcarrier Trevik, who carried a bowl of nectar for the ruler of the city, the Queen of the Red, believed the sky looked odd one morning.

Setting Sun Avenue was a street that was located in the Red City on the planet Quethold. In 8 ABY, Quethold was attacked by the Empire of the Hand and during the battle, Imperial forces entered the Red City and engaged a large group of Quesoth Soldiers in Setting Sun Avenue.
The Rebel Forward Base Camp was a small staging ground for the Special Forces of the Rebel Alliance near the contested Weapons Depot on the planet Talus during the Galactic Civil War.
The Imperial Forward Base Camp was a small staging ground for the Special Forces of the Galactic Empire near the contested Weapons Depot on the planet Talus during the Galactic Civil War.
The Midlis were a caste of the Quesoth, an insectoid sentient species that resided on the planet Quethold.

A mission to the planet of Gobindi was undertaken by four members of the Rebel Alliance in 0 ABY. Pilot Wedge Antilles and three others were sent to Gobindi to investigate the Mah Dala Infirmary for Imperial activity.

A blockade of the planet Gobindi by the Galactic Empire occurred in 0 ABY under the pretense of heavy pirate activity. In reality, the Empire was after the four Rebels who had arrived to spy on the Mah Dala Infirmary a few days prior.

The Madman's Fortune was a museum exhibit ship that flew as part of a traveling freak show. The ship was owned by the Snivvian Goontirk and at some point during galactic history, Goontirk purchased the mummified remains of Vardovin IV, the "Lost King of Duro" from a Ryn mercha…

Kavila was the capital city of Dalos IV. It was cut into the jungle of the planet. The city was comprised of paved plazas and roads, square or pyramidal building built out of stone and formex, well maintained parks, and statues based on Gamorrean myths.

Deathspine varactyls were a type of varactyl that lived on the planet Kashyyyk. They could be found in the jungles near the city of Kachirho, where the planet wasn't completely covered with kilometer-high wroshyr trees.
The Rodian Hunters' Camp was a hunting camp established by Rodian hunters on the planet Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.
A second battle was fought in the Parmel system during the Zaarin insurrection.

The Jon-Tow Economic Development Group was an economic faction that operated on the moon Pinett, in the Elrood sector. The organization was a constortium that included smugglers amongst its membership, and it was led by the Trandoshan Captain-in-Chief Kurakk.
The Chiss Hunter Settlement was a temporary settlement established by Chiss poachers in the Etyyy region on the Mid Rim world Kashyyyk.
The Arcona Compound was a camp for salt-addicted Arcona in the Etyyy region of the Wookiee homeworld Kashyyyk. Arcona addicted to salt were brought here to recuperate and get clean.
Bareesh, alternatively known as the Bareesh Cartel or the Bareesh Clan, was a Hutt kajidic led by Tassaa Bareesh during the Cold War.

During the Clone Wars, Republic Navy Captain Pharl McQuarrie commanded a refitted Consular-class cruiser. McQuarrie and the cruiser served in the Republic defense of the planet Ukio in the early years of the war.

A Lucrehulk-class battleship was used during the Clone Wars by Magistrate Passel Argente of the Corporate Alliance to carry out the operation known as Project Instinction on behalf of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Quarantine section was where the Outbound Flight Colony kept its Force-sensitive children under surveillance because of their Anti-Jedi sentiment. Peacekeepers Perry and Quinze were assigned here in 22 ABY.

Beliarr was a spaceport that was located on the moon Pinett, in the Elrood sector. During the time of the Galactic Civil War, the rival trading concerns the Corsignis Property Alliance and the Jon-Tow Economic Development Group became engaged in a trade dispute and they both b…

Oscum was a spaceport that was located on the moon Pinett, in the Elrood sector. During the time of the Galactic Civil War, the rival trading of the Corsignis Property Alliance and the Jon-Tow Economic Development Group became engaged in a trade dispute and they both blockaded…

The Pinett Freedom Force was an organization that was formed by some of the inhabitants of the moon Pinett during the time of the Galactic Civil War, to peacefully protest against the actions of the Corsignis Property Alliance and the Jon-Tow Economic Development Group, two ri…
The Nosh vu'Ta was a freighter that was used by the Corsignis Property Alliance, and the ship's name translated as "We profit," in Huttese.

The planet of Kidriff 5 had a primary moon. During a battle fought there in 7 ABY between the New Republic and Zsinj's Empire, most of Rogue and Wraith Squadrons orbited the moon while waiting to escort the Millennium Falsehood out of the system.
A raid was carried out on the planet Comkin V during the New Republic/Imperial collaboration against Warlord Zsinj. Comkin V returned under Imperial control after the battle.

A colony affiliated with the New Republic existed on Selcaron, one of the moons of the gas giant Selaggis VI. In 7 ABY, Selcaron was attacked by Warlord Zsinj, who used his Super Star Destroyer, the Iron Fist, to obliterate the colony.
RZ7-6113-23 was a rocky, volcanic class-6 planetoid that was devoid of life. It was located in the Chopani sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Cryptic Warning was one of the two EE-104 Fisheyes that were stolen by the Lost Tribe of Sith for use for their armada. It was commanded by Sith Saber Querdan Dei and was used during the Jedi Queen project.

x: Sahl-Evin was a port city that was located on the planet Jenenma. At some point during galactic history, the Cerean Force adept Pal-Nada used his Force powers to gain control of the Blinders district of Sahl-Evin, an industrial region of the city.
The Blinders district was an industrial region of the port city Sahl-Evin on the planet Jenenma, which was the site of Sahl-Evin's starship-building industry.
An R5-series astromech droid was used by Wedge Antilles during the Battle of Geonosis of the Galactic Civil War.
Denebia was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Denebia system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim.

1B-7, pronounced One-Bee-Seven, was a medical droid owned by the Dark Lord of the One Sith, Darth Krayt. 1B-7 was assigned by Darth Wyyrlok to help the One Sith agent, Nyss Nenn, bring the Iteration of Jedi Knight Jaden Korr out of its slumber in a Spaarti cloning cylinder.
The Skinchanger was a transport that was captained by Prit Kessek, a female Clawdite who worked for the Zygerrian slavers as a courier, while the Gran Kloofus acted as the ship's second-in-command.
Docking Bay 117 was a docking bay that was located on the space station Bazarre, in the Mosu system. The bay was oval-shapped and included a small office and a set of fusion generators.

The Force Crystal Hunter's Cave was a cave on the planet Dantooine containing a large quantity of force crystals. The crystals were discovered in the cave during the Galactic Civil War. Then, Force-sensitive crystal hunters roamed the cave in search for such force crystals.
The Janta Stronghold was a fortified system of caves settled by the the Dantari of the Janta tribe on the planet Dantooine during the Galactic Civil War.
The Nightsister Forced Labor Camp was a labor camp of the Nightsisters on the planet Dathomir. They sent slaves to this camp to work in their mines. These slaves were only males.

In 4 ABY, New Republic pilots Tycho Celchu, Soontir Fel, and Han Solo undertook a mission to the planet Eiattu 6 to escort Winter, who was posing as Leia Organa while the real Organa was on a covert mission to Axxila to negotiate interim Galactic Emperor Sate Pestage's defecti…
The Tibanna mynock was a highly adaptable species of mynock that could be found on the gas giant Bespin and other planets where Tibanna gas was present.

A customized blue-and-white Z-95 Headhunter was owned by Count Rial Pernon of Eiattu 6. He customized the engines, as well as painted the starfighter with a blue flame paint scheme. He flew it to assist Rogue Squadron on their mission on the planet after the Battle of Endor.
The Meatlump Cave was a large cave near the city of Tyrena on the Core World of Corellia. It was used as a base of operations of the technology-hating Meatlump gang.

During the early years of the Galactic Empire, the droid information broker Switch led a criminal organization that was based in Deep Storage Bay V14 on Sel Zonn Station, an XQ2 Platform that orbited the planet Brentaal IV.
During the early years of the Galactic Empire, the Chevin Ganga Lor operated a criminal organization that was based on Sel Zonn Station, a space station that orbited the planet Brentaal IV.
The trill beast was a small, dangerous species of animal from the planet Breshig, located in the Mandalore sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
The Phantoms Bandits were a group of criminals that operated on the planet Mustafar.

The Massassi Isle was an island on the jungle moon Yavin 4. It was located in an ocean off the Taurin Delta. After the Rebel Alliance had evacuated the moon following the Battle of Yavin, several skirmishes took place on this island between Alliance and Imperial Special Forces.

The Old Galactic Market, known in the year 3954 BBY simply as the Galactic Market, was a district on Coruscant. Before the Great Galactic War, the Market was a bustling commercial district on Coruscant.
In 19 BBY, the Sith Lord Palpatine reformed the Galactic Republic into the Galactic Empire and King Mitar, the ruler of the planet Daimar, refused to submit to the new regime.
A T-series tactical droid was a droid created to serve the Navy of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. It was destroyed during the Battle of Umbara.
RX-7246 was a custom-made battle droid that was acquired by the Rodian gladiator Zayda for use as his personal combat assistant.
The Iron Ring were a slaver group that operated during the years following the end of the Clone Wars, primarily on worlds that had formerly been part of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Nathema, originally known as Medriaas, was a fertile agriworld located in the Nathema system of the Outer Rim Territories' Chorlian sector.
Dominator was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in service in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

The Mummer Cave was a cave located on the Mid Rim world of Naboo. Nestled deep within the Gallo Mountains, a short distance west of the city of Dee'ja Peak, the cave was used as a base of operations for the criminal organization known as the Mummers during the time of the Gala…
This species of lichen grew on the planet of Dromund Kaas in the Dromund system. It thrived in gloomy conditions, growing on stone and it gave off a faint purple glow.

Taratos IV was a planet located in the Taratos system, in the Inner Rim. During the Clone Wars, the scientist Bant'ena Fhernan traveled to Niriktavi Bay on Taratos IV to study the world's Niriktavi coral, which Fhernan suspected had some antibacterial properties.

Drezzi was a planet in the Drezzi system of the Outer Rim's Esstran sector that was ruled by a monarchy. At some point before 3954 BBY, the Sith Empire conquered Drezzi, and the husband of Drezzi's Queen Ressa was killed by the Dark Councilor Darth Nyriss.
The Fowler was a Lancer-class frigate that was used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Around 3643 BBY, during the Cold War, a battle occurred aboard the battle station known as Hammer Station.
The Outer Rim Alliance was an association of refugees in the Outer Rim formed due to the inability of the New Republic to defend the Outer Rim from the threat of the Yuuzhan Vong.

Clan Jendri was a Mandalorian clan in existence following the Mandalorian Wars. After the defeat of the Mandalorian leader, Mandalore the Ultimate, at Malachor V by the Jedi Knight Revan, and Revan's subsequent theft of Mandalore's Mask, numerous Mandalorian clans set out in s…

x: Following the Jedi Civil War, legendary Jedi Knights Revan and Bastila Shan were married. The groom had a hangover the following morning as a result of alcohol consumption.

x: The Battle of Shramar was an engagement fought between a joint New Republic and Imperial Remnant force and the Praetorite Vong during the Yuuzhan Vong War in 25 ABY.

The Ritual of Nathema was the name given by historians of the reconstituted Sith Empire to the event in 4999 BBY, in which the Sith Lord Vitiate performed a dark ritual that stripped the Force itself from the entire planet of Nathema.
A chalarax was a creature that had spots. It could not change them, and, based on that fact, sometime before 3954 BBY a proverb had been formulated.

x: Prior to 5000 BBY, Tenebrae overthrew his biological father Dramath and became the new ruler of Medriaas, which he renamed Nathema.

Rekkiad was a planet in the remote Rekkiad system, located in the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. A desolate world covered in ice and snow, it was where the Jedi Knights Revan and Malak hid Mandalore's Mask following the Mandalorian Wars.
Pyros, originally known as Ord Pyros, was a planet located in the Colonies.
Port Jerrell was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories.

x: The assassination attempt on the Sith Emperor was a mission carried out by the Jedi Masters Revan and Meetra Surik, with help from Sith Lord Scourge and droid T3-M4 to eliminate the Sith Emperor, the Dark Lord of the Sith and Emperor of the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The Dilonexicans were the inhabitants of Dilonexa XXIII, an agriworld, and the only habitable planet in the Dilonexa system.
Longwind was a planet located in the Trax sector of the Mid Rim.
Lorardia, or Lorardian, was a planet located in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Lo'Uran was a planet located in the Aparo sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its governor was Blithane.
Maccent was a planet located in the Phelleem sector of the Outer Rim Territories, along the Sisar Run.
Marotan was a planet located in the Inner Rim.
Moer was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Dalon system, a part of the Hewett sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim.
Moseum was a planet located in the Moseum system within the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Movris was a planet located in the Noonian sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Orroman was an astronomical object that was located within the Wild Space Orroman system. At some point, a group of mercenaries caused a water crisis there, with information about the disaster eventually becoming general knowledge across the galaxy.

R'terleD'er was a world located in the Kriz sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, hunters on R'terleD'er were known to pay Baragwins handsomely to track large game.
Roost was a planet located in the Bitrose sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Rhilithan was a lifeless planet located within the Indrexu sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Raamen was a planet located in the Expansion Region.
Somavva was a planet located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim.
Sarrelon I was the first planet in the Sarrelon system of the Expansion Region. The planet had two moons.
Sarrelon II was the second planet in the Sarrelon system of the Expansion Region. A desolate, searing ball of rock, Sarrelon II was orbited by three moons.
Sarrelon VI was the sixth planet in the Sarrelon system of the Expansion Region. It was a frozen ball of rock with two moons.
Sarrelon III was the third planet in the Sarrelon system of the Expansion Region. It was a gas giant with five moons.
Sarrelon IV was the fourth planet in the Sarrelon system of the Expansion Region. It was a gas giant with eight moons.
Sarrelon V was the fifth planet in the Sarrelon system of the Expansion Region. It as a gas giant with twelve moons.
Sarranket was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Sarranket system, a part of the Brevost sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region.
Tamboon was a planet located in the Tungra sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Once, a cooking droid named L9-G8 prepared a crock of Tauntaun chowder for the Prince of Tamboon.
Tanthior was a planet located in the Corellian sector of the Core Worlds.
Tasrin was a planet located in the Colonies.

Tifnyl was the fourth planet of the Tifnyl system. It was a gas giant located in the Elrood sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its moon was the location of an Imperial listening post during the Galactic Civil War.
Velx-Shel was a planet located within the Corellian sector of the Core Worlds.

Vatta Four was a terrestrial celestial body located in Wild Space's Vatta system. During the Galactic Civil War, the local inhabitants of Vatta Four manufactured the type of slugthrower rifle known as the Baed Sharpshooter.

x: Around the year 3966 BBY, the resurgent Sith Empire faced a potential uprising in a space sector under the rule of the warlord Ugroth.
Uriek was a planet located in the Ash Worlds sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Tel II was the second planet of the Tel Minor system, located in the Expansion Region. It was a small ball of rock.
Tel I was the innermost planet of the Tel Minor system, located in the Expansion Region. It was a small ball of rock.
Tzarib was a planet located in the Inner Rim. Quaghens could be caught there.
Krenhner was a planet located in the Krenhner sector of the Inner Rim.

Hadlress was an astronomical object located in the Hadlress system, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Inner Rim. Jasis Temm, the owner and Chief Executive Officer of the company Hadlress Defense Systems, Limited, was based on Hadlress.

The Dark Vendetta was a HT-2200 medium freighter in operation around the time of the Galactic Civil War. Used by the Silent Blades, the ship fought in and survived the Battle of the Silent Blades, along with two Preybird-class starfighters.
The Leviathan was a famous Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served the Galactic Republic as an anti-pirate ship.
The Windsinger was one of the most famous Carrack-class light cruisers that operated during the time of the Galactic Republic.
The Krakana's Claw was a modified GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat that was flown by the Mon Calamari bounty hunter Irackant around the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
The Imperial Elite Guard was an elite stormtrooper unit assigned by the Galactic Empire to protect important government officials during the Galactic Civil War.
The Birthright was a modified Barloz-class freighter that was purchased by the Duros Thes Cilgris during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
The Dawn Raider was a modified CloakShape fighter that was flown by the Jedi ace Jaizen Suel during the latter years of the Galactic Republic.

Under the aegis of the Galactic Empire, several members of a sentient species were executed by stormtroopers. The species was humanoid, had red eyes, two short antennae, and was distinguished by a nasal structure composed of three pairs of breathing holes.
Old Recluse's cave was a cave on the planet Morishim known to be inhabited by the Old Recluse. The cave was in fact a secret Imperial communications center.
The Aii`tkian Anthropologists were a group of scientists active during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
The Mission to Morishim was organized by Admiral Gilad Pellaeon in 19 ABY. Imperial Colonel Meizh Vermel was sent to Morishim to seek out New Republic General Bel Iblis to ask for peace negotiations.
Carz was a moon in the Svivreni sector of the Outer Rim.
Chaila was the second planet in the Garos system. It was located in the Msst sector of the Mid Rim.
The Witchblood Clan, also spelled Witch Blood Clan, was a clan of Witches from the planet Dathomir.
