x: The Mission to the Kauron asteroid field was a mission carried on by Luke Skywalker at the beginning of the Caamas Document Crisis, during his search for the clones used by the Cavrilhu Pirates.

The Gray Griffins were a scouting team that served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War, which consisted on the Humans Dunston Karell and Valera, the Sullustan Oro Otel and the alien Parek.
A battle at Reytha was an engagement during the New Republic liberation campaign after the Battle of Endor.

A battle occurred at the planet Uviuy Exen in 10 ABY, during the offensive prior to Operation Shadow Hand. This battle took part of the offensive planned by reborn Emperor Palpatine against the New Republic to reconquer the Core Worlds.
A battle at Uviuy Exen was a engagement during the New Republic liberation campaign after the Battle of Endor.

A battle at Drearia was a engagement during the New Republic liberation campaign after the Battle of Endor. The New Republic sent a fleet from Brentaal IV, liberated two years ago, to the Hydian Way in order to access the Core Worlds.

The Restored Empire, also known as the Kaarenth Dissension, was a splinter faction of the Galactic Empire in the Outer Rim Territories created by Ennix Devian after the Battle of Endor that became prominent after the Imperial Reunification, refusing the authority of the Imperi…
The Duel on Bosthirda end the threat of Bosthirda separatists for the Reformed Sith Empire with the loyal Sith Lord Scourge killing Darth Xedrix, Dark Councilor segret allied with the separatist.

A battle at Paqualis III was a engagement during the New Republic liberation campaign after the Battle of Endor. The New Republic sent a fleet from Brentaal IV, liberated two years ago, to the Hydian Way in order to access the Core Worlds.
Nyara was a planet containing a class-3 toxic weapons dump. In 13 ABY a team of thieves hired by Nom Anor raided the dump to retrieve a chunk of zinethium.
Altunna was a planet that was the source of nectar enjoyed by both Gilad Pellaeon and Feena D'Asta.
A third moon orbited the Mid Rim planet Naboo alongside Ohma-D'un and Rori. It did not have a name and was in fact little more than an overgrown asteroid.
Rirsack was a planet located in the Belsmuth sector of the Outer Rim. Lieutenant Lar Ndigo of the New Republic bravely fought there sometime during or prior to 13 ABY.
Meenka was the city in which Kir Kanos briefly resided in 13 ABY, during the time he hunted down Lem Krarr. Before he could leave, Boba Fett captured Kanos and brought him to the Restored Empire.

Artesia was a planet located within the Artesia system, a part of the Hangshan sector in the galactic regions known as the Slice and the Expansion Region. The Artesian space collage art form originated on the planet.
The Whisper was a 3-Z light freighter that was used by the Rebel Alliance scout team the Gray Griffins during the Galactic Civil War.

The Toranni was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that was used by the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, the Toranni transported an Imperial exploration team to the newly-discovered planet Alluuvia, in the Elrood sector.
A space mite was a type of silicon-based arachnid that could reside in the vacuum of space. Space mites spent their youth living on mynocks as parasites.
The Personal Profit was a modified YT-1300 light freighter that was owned by the Human Chalmer Trillili.
The SoroSuub Personal Luxury Yacht 3500 Nova's Heart was the private yacht of holostar Javul Charn. It was named after the holo-album of the same name.
The Oldskep was a bulk freighter that was used by the company Imperial Mining, Ltd. during the Galactic Civil War, which was named after an IML executive.
The Raid at Iphigin was an attack of the Cavrilhu Pirates against the New Republic freighters in orbit of Iphigin.
Berea-3 was a "combination ship" that consisted of a stripped-down Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier that had been coupled to a mining rig. The vessel was used by the company Imperial Mining, Ltd.
The Raid over Corulag was a Rebel attack on one of Grand Moff Tarkin's research stations orbiting the planet Corulag.
The Sandy Jaws was located in Beggar's Canyon on the planet Tatooine. It preceded the Stone Needle rock formation.
Zadd was a moon located in the Zaddja system of the Outer Rim Territories.
An anti-Republic force fought against Jedi Master Eeth Koth and the Republic clone troopers in battle on the planet Korriban in 21 BBY.
Thurmik was a settlement that was located on the planet Nam Chorios.
Salvation Point was a settlement that was located on the planet Nam Chorios.

The Ambush at Mon Calamari, also known as the Attack on Mon Calamari, was a battle that occurred in 1 BBY. During the early Galactic Civil War, Palpatine believed that the Mon Calamari would likely try to join the growing Rebel Alliance.

The Timira City Cloning Facility was a highly classified cloning facility operated by Galactic Empire inside Timira City on the planet Kamino. During the Galactic Civil War, it was destroyed by the Rebel Alliance in 1 BBY.
This raid on the planet of Carida was conducted by Han Solo in 1 BBY.

t: Defense of Mon Calamari (Galactic Civil War)
place: Hyperspace routes leading to Mon Calamari
x: During the early years of the Galactic Civil War, the shipyards over Dac began production of new ships for use in the Alliance Fleet.
The Trade and Traffic Ministry was an organization led by the individual Blissa Vlix that operated on the planet Wroona.

S-Ipsus was a small sub-city located on the planet Genarius, which orbited the floating city Ipsus. The sub-city was operated by the company Naescorcom as a research station, and it contained a thermal detonator production line.

Kamino Station X was a facility on the planet Kamino. After the Assault on Kamino in the year before the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel Alliance found the notes of the Galactic Empire's Lead Cloning Technician in a garbage processing facility at the station.

t: Anakin Skywalker's red Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor

x: A siege of Sellasas took place shortly after the Battle of Yavin.
E3E3EEK, nicknamed Mousie by LE-BO2D9, was an MSE-6 series repair droid stationed at the Equator City Flight Control Authority in Equator City on the planet Rodia.
The Cold Front was a customized bulk transport that was owned by the Mugaari criminal Quetemoor the Sub-Elder.
The Balmorran resistance was formed by Balmorran citizens and Galactic Republic soldiers during the Cold War in order to force the Sith Empire from their world.

The Dread Masters were six powerful Human Sith Lords who served the Sith Emperor for centuries as prophets, generals, and advisers. Their names were earned when they studied the power of the Phobis devices, artifacts that had driven even the most depraved Sith mad with terror.

A small and ingrate planet, Alzaris had a very low population, concentrated around a very small open field which served as a spaceport and some massive greenhouses. The planet is constantly bathed in the reddish light of its dying star.
The Silver Fulgur was a tavern located on the planet of Alzaris, in the Rama system. The bartender was Roxard, a former member of the Imperial Army.
The Senate Dispensation Committee was a Galactic Senate committee that was chaired by Canny Mandary Bertar, the senator for the Tapani sector.
Peckva were a non-sentient species of ungulates native to Maryo, a resort planet in the Corporate Sector. They were known for their speed and were hunted by the rich who visited the world.
The Fullor was a vicious predator native to the planet Dra III. Fullors were hunted by off-planet big-game hunters.
The Cal-serpent was a non-sentient species of predatory snakes native to Dra III, a planet in the Wyl sector. Cal-serpents were sometimes hunted on safaris by off-planet, big-game hunters.

The STC003 Starcrasher was an Imperial Heavy Fighter, developed by Incom Corporation, then manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems and Yoyodine Propulsion Systems after the defection of Incom Corporation's engineers.

8557 was a masculine-programmed B1-series battle droid sentry assigned to a Trade Federation C-9979 landing craft. 8557, like all B1 battle droids, had black sensors. 8557 carried a E-5 blaster rifle.

The Tythonian Gnarls, simply known as the Gnarls, was an area of Tython, located just north of the valley which was the home to the heart of the Jedi Order; the Jedi Temple, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Kalikori village was a Twi'lek settlement located on the Deep Core world Tython during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Gage-class transport was a transport design used by the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War.
Schizodes were an insectoid sentient species. Though they were considered to be good combatants and crafters, they were not very individualized.
The Togruta Uprising was an event that took place sometime around the Great Galactic War. Rycus Kilran of the Sith Empire was known to be a pacifier of the event.
Imperial Shuttle 9604 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by Diplomatic Service branch of Imperial Intelligence of the Galactic Empire.
The Tythos Ridge was a mountain range on Talss, the largest of the Tython's continents.

The Department of Health was a part of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances. It was organized first under the New Republic and was influential in dealing with a Death Seed pandemic on Nam Chorios in 13 ABY.
Tastini was a planet in the Chamberlam system.
The Sawal were a humanoid sentient species originating from the planet Tastini.

The Department of Health was an organization of the New Republic. It was influential in dealing with a Death Seed pandemic on Nam Chorios in 13 ABY. It was reorganized in 28 ABY as the Galactic Alliance Department of Health.

The High Council Chamber, located within the Jedi Temple of Tython was built during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire following the Jedi Order's relocation to their ancestral homeworld.

The siblipede was a non-sentient species of small insect native to Ithor, a planet in the Ottega sector of the Mid Rim. They often fed in groups upon the decaying leaves on the forest floor. Siblipedes were preyed on by manollium birds.
An R5 astromech droid was located in the city of Theed on Naboo. An R-series product of Industrial Automaton, the droid was colored white with red trim.
The Chamber of Speech was a computer system located in a cave accessible from upper Kaleth, a fortress city on Tython.
The Slugh were a gastropod sentient species.
The Arakhyn were a sentient species of ruthless hunters.
Sylphes were a botanical, humanoid sentient species, native to Sylvia IV.
Sainte-Evanëflore was a planet and the Sylphe Homeworld. It was governed by the Lord of the Foliage.

Bravo 5 was the personal N-1 starfighter of Dineé Ellberger during the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY. The starfighter was equipped with excellent evasion capabilities. Ellberger used the fighter during the Battle of Naboo.
Kazarak was a planet in the Mahrusha sector of the Outer Rim.
Dwitzel's Rats were a mercenary unit based on Tatooine.

The Nepherides were students and members of a dark side school based on Byss. They were trained, Force-sensitive assassins of the Galactic Empire. They would often wear a plait, and their teeth were carved to look like fangs.
A duel took place on the planet Felucia around 21 BBY during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Overhang was a seedy industrial zone in Nexus City, on the planet of Entralla.

Capella was a mining world located in the Capella system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Capella was linked via hyperlane to the Arda and Little Capella systems.

Group 2 was a squad of three Flash speeders led by Palmer. Group 2 was a diversionary force formed by the Royal Naboo Security Forces in 32 BBY to assist in the recapture of the planet Naboo's capital, Theed from the Trade Federation.

Elamposnia was a monastery world located in the Elamposnia system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector, within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A hyperlane linked it to the Chenowei system.
Chenowei was a terrestrial world located in the Chenowei system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector, within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

The garbage proccessing facility was a facility for processing garbage at Kamino Station X on the planet Kamino; in 1 BBY the Rebel Alliance discovered a document made by the Lead Cloning Technician in the garbage processing facility.

Group 3 was a squad of one Gian speeder and was formed as diversionary force by the Royal Naboo Security Forces in 32 BBY to assist in the recapture of the planet Naboo's capital, Theed from the Trade Federation. Group 3 was responsible for escorting a commando transport.
The medical wing of the Imperial Palace on Coruscant was a fully stocked and state of the art medcenter which serviced the Palace during the regimes of the Galactic Empire and the New Republic.
A 2-1B surgical droid was present while a medic assisted Mara Jade in the medical wing of the Imperial Palace.

B'trilla was a foggy world located in the B'trilla system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Ardan Cross connected it to the Chenowei and Feena systems.

Atorra was a planet located in the Atorra system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector, within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was connected by the Ardan Cross hyperlane to the Troos and the Chenowei systems.
The Migrant Merchants' Guild was a supposedly legitimate trade consortium that advocated for refugee rights and supported the Coruscant reconstruction effort.
Oto was a Veril Line Systems Otoga-222 maintenance droid which served aboard Javul Charn's private yacht, the Nova's Heart.

During the Cold War, a skirmish between the forces of the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire occurred above the planet of Javaal. The skirmish was the result of imperial ships ambushing a Republic patrol group.
The Wing Guard Elite cloud car squadron was a highly streamlined airborne security force composed of veteran and commando pilots pulled from the 1st Wing Guard and the 2nd Wing Guard squadrons.
The 4th Wing Guard was a cloud car squadron assigned to the Bespin Wing Guard—a security force working to protect Cloud City from the Imperial Remnant.
The 3rd Wing Guard was a cloud car squadron assigned to the Bespin Wing Guard—a security force working to protect the Imperial garrisoned Cloud City.

The 2nd Wing Guard was a cloud car squadron assigned to the Bespin Wing Guard—a highly streamlined security force composed of commando pilots hired by Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian to help protect Cloud City.

The 1st Wing Guard was a cloud car squadron assigned to the Bespin Wing Guard—a highly disorganized and corrupt security force run by thieves and bureaucrats—during the administrative barony of Dominic Raynor, before he lost the office to Lando Calrissian in a game of Sabacc.
The Star of Coruscant was a superdreadnaught serving in the Republic Navy during the Great Galactic War.

The Nebula Front squadron was a starfighter unit of the militant wing serving Nebula Front that fielded Z-95 Headhunters, the predecessor to the X-wing. The fighter craft of the unit were painted white and marked with Nebula Front's blue logo on the wing panels.

The Nebula Elite was an exclusive squadron of top-ranking starfighter pilots serving the Nebula Front's militant wing. The squadron fielded Z-95 Headhunters, the predecessor to the X-wing, and were painted white and marked with Nebula Front's blue logo on the wing panels.
Gendoraan was a planet in the Core Worlds. Imperial Security Bureau Agent Dal Rogos claimed to be a languages teacher from Gendoraan as part of his cover identity.
Cirtappa was a planet in the Alui sector of the Mid Rim.
Teagan was a planet in the Kwymar sector of the Outer Rim.

The Wound was a deep chasm located in the middle of the Jundland Wastes of Tatooine. The bottom of the site was impossible to see from the upper ridge, while the rim of the location was filled with camps of Sand People.
Plunder Moon was a moon in the Unknown Regions, located in the Plunder Moon system within the Black Hole sector. A Star Temple was located on the moon.

The Migrant Merchants' Guild headquarters was an area in the Old Galactic Market on Coruscant. It was the site of the headquarters of the Migrant Merchants' Guild, a criminal organization that was involved in bribes, corruption, money laundering, and smuggling, as well as deal…

The Savareen Dancer was a relatively well-known luxury liner that shared its name with the Savareen system of the Outer Rim Territories' Savareen sector and was active in the Outer Rim during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.

The Y'Dar Princess was a relatively well-known luxury liner that shared its name with the Y'Dar system of the Outer Rim Territories' Astal sector and was active in the Outer Rim during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.

The Lady Akiko was the personal yacht of Marshal Levnis, a planetary baron. For a long time, the Lady Akiko lacked a Kalld'n-class stardrive, forcing Levnis to turn to The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers to acquire the exceedingly rare device.

King's Pass was a ravine located on the planet of Alderaan that was the site of a decisive battle between the warring families thousands of years prior to the noble houses creation of the Alderaanian parliament.

The Glarus Valley was a location on the planet Alderaan and was the ancestral home of the royal House Panteer. It was also the site of both Castle Panteer and the Elysium along with it being noted as being the seat of culture as well as democracy on the planet.

The Kaamos Territory was a region on the planet Alderaan that was part of the Castle Lands. It was home to the Lerantha Dam located at the edge of the Lerantha Lake. In addition, it served as the ancestral home of House of Thul.
The Apalis Coast was a rich green flatland on Alderaan located south of the Juran Mountains. It was separated from the sea by a sheer cliff face.
Sylvia IV was a planet and the Sylphe Homeworld, located in the Sylenia V system. It was discovered some decades before the Ruusan Reformation by the Galactic Republic.
Justicar territory, also known as the Justicars' Sector or sector 439, was an area of Coruscant's lower levels that was ruled by the Justicars during the Cold War.
Prine was a mostly-uninhabited desert-covered planet situated on the way between Telerath and Vondarc. It also possessed grasslands where agriculture was possible.
This sleek crimson colored yacht served as the personal starship of House Palpatine. The family's crest was emblazoned upon the side of the vessel.

The Outlaw was a YT-1300 light freighter that may have participated in the effort to rescue Bothan spies shortly before the Battle of Endor. Just after the battle, the freighter was seen jumping out of the area. Scans would reveal that the ship was carrying spice.
The Maker was a YT-1300 light freighter that was stolen from Sythluss Leethe by T'Charek Haathi and her crew on Zelos II. It was used by Haathi on missions for the Rebel Alliance.

The Children of the Emperor were a group of individuals who unknowingly served the Sith Emperor of the reconstituted Sith Empire as puppets and extensions of his will throughout the later years of the Great Galactic War and subsequent Cold War with the Republic.

Refrax was a planet in the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet contained an Imperial-controlled spaceport that served as a stop-over point for ships traveling through Mortex sector during the Galactic Civil War.
Seltaya Minor, also known as Ropagi III, was a planet in the Kira sector of the Expansion Region.
Seltaya Major was a planet in the Mieru'kar sector of the Outer Rim.

Gorm was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Meerian sector. Located on the Galactic Frontier by 4000 BBY, it was the homeworld of the venomous reptiles known as gorm-worms, which were exported across the galaxy.

Abbaji was the third planet from the star Iminec in the Kalee system, located within the Wild Space of the galaxy. Situated in the same system as Kalee, the Kaleesh species' homeworld, Abbaji had two moons and a habitable surface.
Garr'lst was a planet in the Inner Rim. Members of the planet's native sentient feline species were massacred at some point before or during the Republic Dark Age.
The Order of Revan, also known as the Revanites, was a secret society within the reconstituted Sith Empire that adhered to the teaching of the powerful Force-user Revan.

Nekghouls were a more evolved and intelligent strain of rakghouls that had evolved in the ruins of Taris after driving the Outcasts to extinction by the time of the Cold War, three centuries following the planet's destruction in 3956 BBY, where for a while they were the planet…
The Galactic Empire had a prison installation on a planetoid near the Maw. The detention center was placed under complete secrecy, although rumors relating to its existence persisted.
Povanaria was a world located in the Povanaria system. It was situated in the Loop Worlds area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Gulvitch was a mining world located in the Gulvitch system. It was situated in the Loop Worlds area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

A township existed on the planet Ord Mantell during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, Confederacy of Independent Systems troops under General Grievous attacked the planet and engaged the Galactic Republic forces there.

The Sith mineralogical corps was an organization within the Sith Empire during the Great Hyperspace War that focused on finding and mining crystals and other rare stones. Devore Korsin was a member of the corps.
Near Indosa was a world located in the Near Indosa system. It was situated in the Loop Worlds area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

objective: To rescue Oolth
x: In 32 BBY, Jedi Padawan Darsha Assant undertook a mission in the Crimson Corridor, a district in the Third Quadrant of Coruscant's Zi-Kree Sector to extract a Black Sun defector known as Oolth.

A resistance force fought against the reconstituted Sith Empire on the planet Drezzi sometime prior to the year 3954 BBY. The Sith eventually conquered the world, and the husband of Queen Ressa of Drezzi was executed.
The Star Cabal was a secret society of influential conspirators that were formed in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace War.
The Sadow'een were a secret order of assassins who served the Sith Lord Naga Sadow.
A starship with a crew of at least one was owned by a Human male scoundrel. The scoundrel lost the starship to an Ithorian and a Baragwin in a game of holochess.
Hammer Squadron was a V-19 Torrent starfighter squadron that fought in the Battle of Lanteeb during the Clone Wars. Hammer Squadron took many hits and casualties and the clone pilots died.
The Adamant Mass, often nicknamed Naboo's Third Planet, was a particularly large asteroid in the Naboo system.

The Surgical Nursing Services was a medical organization within the Galactic Republic. One of their primary functions was to make sure Republic nurses are up to date on their medical knowledge, requiring them to under go training courses like the Continuing Medical Education.

QM-35 was a droid on the planet of Taris. He served as the guardian of the Tarisian Archive after the ruling members of the Taris governement froze themselves in carbonite during the orbital bombardment of the planet by Darth Malak.
Avilatan was an island on the planet Ord Mantell. It was volcanic and had several lava pools.
Fort Garnik was a Galactic Republic military base located on the island Avilatan on the planet Ord Mantell during the time of the Cold War.
Cascade Company was a company of clone troopers that fought against the Separatists during the Clone Wars.
Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 3 was a Republic Mobile Surgical Unit stationed on the jungle planet Drongar during the Clone Wars in 20 BBY. The Sea of Sponges was in between RMSU-3 and RMSU-7.
The Morlings were the native sentient species of the planet Morda.

A Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer was among the fleet of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy in 137 ABY. Commanded by the Sith Lord Darth Stryfe and Captain Meeshal, it was dispatched to Ossus in that year to search for wayward Jedi.
Oradam village was a small settlement on Ord Mantell located on the Oradam Peninsula.
Drelliad Village was a small settlement on the northern coast of the island of Avilatan on Ord Mantell during the Cold War.
Talloran Village was a small settlement on the planet Ord Mantell. It was located near to the stronghold of Fort Garnik.
Savrip Island was a landmass on Ord Mantell. While largely devoid of most sentient life, it was home to many Mantellian Savrips.
Morda was a planet and the homeworld of the Morling species.
The Doogs were creatures from the planet of Morda and shared the planet with the Morlings. The Morlings used their leather to produce clothes.
The Mutilator was a YZ-775 medium transport that was owned by Gilflyn, a Dark Jedi who was based on the planet Corellia during the reign of the New Republic.
Resoria was one of three smallish continents that were located in the southern hemisphere of the Core Worlds planet Corulag, all of which had the same cycle of seasons.
North Kallis was one of three smallish continents that shared a seasonal cycle and were located in the southern hemisphere of the Core Worlds planet Corulag.
South Kallis was a small continent that was located in the southern hemisphere of the planet Corulag. The continent was covered in impenetrable forests of Corulag bamboo.

The Orbital Transports Union was a union that operated on the planet Corulag. After a set of new berthing taxes were implemented on Corulag, the union's members went on strike, which caused the world's economy to stall, and in an attempt to bring the protest to an end, the pla…
Mastigophorous was a city that was located on the planet Drall, on the northwest coast of the Boiling Sea.
Malachor III was an Outer Rim planet located in the Malachor system.

Horranths were reptilian carnivores native to the Deep Core planet Tython. Quadrupeds with short, stubby legs and an array of horns across their back, horranths were typically seen in few numbers on the grassy mountainsides of their homeworld.

result: Death of the Jedi strike team
x: Near the end of the Great Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, the Sith Lord Darth Azamin—a member of the Empire's ruling Dark Council—was assassinated by a strike team of Jedi.

The Eight-Hour Invasion of Dubrillion was a battle of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and reconstituted Sith Empire. It was a surprise attack from Imperial Army against the relatively unprotected planet of Dubrillion.
Sometime during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Empire invaded the planet Lan Barell.
The Garden of Justice, was an open area that was positioned on the eastern side of the Coruscant Senate Building's Great Door.
Shadow Town was a location on the planet Nar Shaddaa that had been constructed by the time of the Cold War. It resembled an ordinary slum at a glance, though its inhabitants were quite unique.
Gorma-Koss, which literally meant the Gormak Kingdom in the old Voss language, was a settlement on the planet Voss created deep within the lands of the Gormak.
The Resolve was a cruiser that was used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. The ship served as the flagship of the veteran Alliance Admiral Cov.

The Fondor Five was a criminal organization part of the Migrant Merchants' Guild and was active in the Galactic Core during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The Annual Jatzday Race was an annual event that took place in the Togatto Speedway, a podracing arena that was located on the planet Esseles.
ViGureni was a continent located on the Core Worlds planet Fresia. The Coromon Islands, which were located in the cold north of the planet, were to the west of ViGureni.
Prime Coromon was an island that formed part of the Coromon Islands, an island chain located on the planet Fresia.
The Lower Coromon Chain was a group of windswept crags that formed part of the Coromon Islands, an island chain located on the planet Fresia.
A species of blue-skinned eel could be found in the waters of the planet Telerath. They had eight eyes, sharp teeth, and at least three fins, one of which was a dorsal fin.

An avian species with white feathers and a blue beak could be found wild on the planet Esseles. The species possessed long, thin tails and had blue skin around their yellow eyes. The species also had a multicolored crest above their beak.
The Dark Council Chambers, located inside the Sith Academy on the planet Korriban, was the place where the Dark Council discussed anything related to the Sith Empire, their enemies and their plans.

The Republic Strategic High Command, also known as the Republic High Command, was the highest level of command within the Republic Military during the Great Galactic War, Cold War, and Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Mannett Point was an island on Ord Mantell near the island of Avilatan. The two islands were connected by a bridge, but the waterway between them could be crossed easily by foot.
A raid occurred during the Battle of Haurgab amid the Clone Wars and was a face off between Republic troops and the Maujasi who had allied themselves with the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Divac 7 was a location in the Outer Rim Territories and the place where the Imperial trooper Lonkin had distinguished himself in service, earning the title of hero.
Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 6 was a Republic Mobile Surgical Unit stationed on the jungle planet Drongar during the Clone Wars in 20 BBY.
Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 9 was a Republic Mobile Surgical Unit stationed on the jungle planet Drongar during the Clone Wars in 20 BBY.
Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 14 was a Republic Mobile Surgical Unit stationed on the jungle planet Drongar during the Clone Wars in 20 BBY.

result: Destruction of the Endor and its crew
x: In 13 ABY the New Republic vessel Endor was ambushed by the Restored Empire, an Imperial faction of hardliners under the leadership of the Warlord Devian that refused the Imperial Remnant authority, while patrolling the space around the planetoid RZ7-6113-23.

A Naboo Resistance base was established in the Naboo training canyon during the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY. The base had a number of tents for its personnel, two hospitals, and laser turrets for defense. Rhys Dallows agreed to deliver supplies to the base.

The Restoration was an MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser in the service of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. It was tentatively ready for service in the lead up to the Battle of Endor.

This group was founded around the year 19 BBY on the planet Haurgab. It was composed of Humans sympathetic to the cause of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, and helped them fight the Galactic Republic. This group was closely aligned with the Maujasi
The Republic Military Benefit Association was an organization within the Galactic Republic that took charge of providing entertainment to all Republic troops during the Clone Wars.
The Republic Expeditionary Medical Force was an organization within the Galactic Republic that took charge of providing medical care to all Republic troops during the Clone Wars.
The Royal Museum of Alderaan was a museum located on the planet Alderaan that belonged to House Alde and served as the custodians of their homeworld's history.

type: Secret agents of the Emperor's will
x: The Emperor's Hand was a dark side organization that served the will of the Sith Emperor, Darth Vitiate, directly, autonomous of the reconstituted Sith Empire's rule.
The Esh-kha were an ancient alien species that inhabited the galaxy before being imprisoned by the Rakata on the planet Belsavis thousands of years before the Cold War.
The Imperial Cabinet was an organization on the planet Gandle Ott that supported Acting-Governor Marja Lang following the departure of the world's previous Imperial governor.

The Death Star command center, also known as the Death Star control room and the command station, was located on the second Death Star battle station. It was able to remotely operate the station's functions, including the deflector shield and superlaser.

The Crisis Response Unit was a military unit of the Galactic Republic that operated in the years of the Cold War. These elite soldiers of the Republic Military were stationed on the prison world of Belsavis where they were charged with combating any uprising from the prisoners.

A terrestrial planet was the homeworld of Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn. Though he left the world as an infant to become a Jedi, he returned to visit it later in life. The planet had liquid surface water and an atmosphere that was suitable for Humans.

TD-D9 was a droid with multiple red photoreceptors and six spider-like legs who essentially raised a young Maul and aided him in his early training and education in a facility on the volcanic world of Mustafar.

Orsis was a planet that had jungles, oceans and at least one volcano. It was home to the Orsis Academy, which was famous for training trackers, spys and assassins; among its most famous graduates was a young Darth Maul.
Blackguard's Gorge was a location on Orsis and beyond a mountain range from the Orsis Academy. It was reputed to be the former residence of a space-pirate.
Chargrecks were heavily armored, spiked quadrupeds native to the planet of Orsis.

Kaabores were creatures native to Orsis that could be hunted relatively easily. Trezza, headmaster of the Orsis Academy, would often invite favored students to hunt these beasts, only to have them run afoul of the much more dangerous chargrecks.

The Bone Pits was a wampa-infested cave system in the Tromper Crags on the planet Hoth, accessible via a tunnel that opened onto Icefinger Rise. By the Cold War, the White Maw pirates established a base which connected to the tunnels.

Sojourn, also known as "the Hunters' Moon," was a satellite moon of an unknown planet in the Carrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was also the ancient-fortress home and personal retreat of the Sith Lord Darth Plagueis.
H-6P0 was a protocol droid who operated on various CR90 corvettes during the Galactic Civil War.
Docking Bay 155 was a docking bay located on the planet Bastion.
Therpsis was a small mining planet and the homeworld of Pete Vandhaar.

The Queensguard were a military unit of bodyguards that were charged with the protection of the Queen of the Royal House of Alderaan. By the time of the Great Galactic War, the royal family was House Panteer and the Queensguard were charged with the protection of their Queen.

The Mandalorian enclave was located on the planet Dromund Kaas in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. The most recent addition to the Sith's Citadel by the time of the Cold War, the Mandalorian enclave was constructed to house the Sith Empire's allies among the Mandalorian war…

result: Rebel Alliance and Krantian Resistance victory
Leia Organa meets with Utric Sandov
x: The Battle of Krant was the first battle of the Krantian Civil War, during the Galactic Civil War.
A town was located on the planet of Carlac and was home to the Ming Po. Several of its buildings were burnt by the flamethrowers of the Death Watch led by Pre Vizsla.
The Battle of Geddes was a battle of the Krantian Civil War, during the Galactic Civil War.
The Dark Council chamber on Dromund Kaas was much smaller than the Chamber on Korriban. However, during the Great Galactic War it was the headquarters of the Dark Council.
Aquilaris Minor, or simply Aquilaris, was a planet in the Grumani sector of the Outer Rim.
Tel IV was the fourth and outermost planet of the Tel Minor system, located in the Brak sector of the Expansion Region. It was a ball of rock.
A battle that occurred during the Cold War between the forces of the Sith Empire, the Jedi Order, Galactic Republic, and the rogue Mandalorian Clan Varad.
Clan Varad was a Mandalorian clan in existence around the time of the Cold War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Fount of Rajivari was the first incarnation of the Archives of the Jedi Order, originating on the planet Tython in the Deep Core.

affiliation: Sphere of Defense of the Empire
x: The Ministry of Logistics was a division of the Sith Empire, one that fell under the Sphere of Production and Logistics.

The Three Families was a grouping of Hutts that was formed on the planet Quesh and existed by the time of the Cold War. These families consisted of groups led by Broga Masrii, Jeelta Urdosh and Portho Kaltemmic following the discovery of venenit queshaaga.
The Smokeswimmer was a Corellian corvette that was used by the Black Hammer pirates, a band of pirates that operated from the planet Galantos in the Core Worlds.
The Ancient Prison Caverns was an underground level of chambers located on the planet Belsavis that existed by the time of the Cold War and predated the Galactic Republic prison facilities.
The Sons of Palawa were a warrior tribal group that resided on Tatooine in the time of the Cold War. This group had resided in settlements that were located in a cave system in the Jundland Wastes.

This battle droid was stationed onboard General Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer at the time of the Battle of Patitite Pattuna. Some time after the battle, while the ship was traveling through space, he notified Grievous that an unknown pirate ship had been detected.
This battle droid was stationed on General Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer at the time of the Battle of Patitite Pattuna.
This battle droid was stationed on General Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer at the time of the Battle of Patitite Pattuna.

Marrovia was an agriworld located in the Marrovia system, a part of the Gordian Reach sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The Pinooran Spur hyperlane connected the world to the Kli'aar and Ladarra systems.

Woebegone was a starship captained by Ellin Lah often traded goods on Carlix's Folly, Bal'demnic, Sikkem IV, and Vestral. It was stolen by Darth Plagueis in 67 BBY to escape Bal'demnic after an illegal cortosis mining operation resulted in the death of Darth Tenebrous.

House Baliss was a relatively minor Alderaanian noble family that existed by the Cold War. Its success came largely from the fact that it had amassed much of its influence by currying favor with the larger houses.

House Girard was a relatively minor Alderaanian noble house that existed by the time of the Cold War. They remained largely independent in the grand scheme of politics that was common place on Alderaan though this changed when the Alderaan Civil War broke out.

The floating archidia was a species of flower that was native the planet Nubia. The flowers were typically purple, blue or crimson in color, and they had a unique method of seed dispersal, whereby tiny, hydrogen-filled sacs inside the flowers allowed them to float and travel i…
The Valley of Rejection was a valley that was located on the planet N'zoth, about 300 kilometers to the west of the city Giat Nor.

The Battle of Eliad was a significant engagement of the Minos Cluster Campaign during the Great Galactic War. Beginning in 3680 BBY, the battle was waged between the forces of the Sith Empire and those of the Jedi Order in alliance with the Galactic Republic.
Alchenaut was a terrestrial moon that was located in the Alchenaut system of the Alchenaut sector, within the Expansion Region portion of the Western Reaches.

x: The Attack on the Hutt Cartel listening post was a space battle engaged by the reconstituted Sith Empire to destroy a Republic listening post, that was built within Hutt Space near Nar Shaddaa with the Cartels permission to intercept dispatches from nearby Imperial operations.

The sand demon was a species of semi-sentient, six-legged insectoid that was native to the planet Tatooine. Feared by all other life on the desert world, sand demons preyed on a wide variety of creatures, including the legendary krayt dragon.

The High Ontis was a mountain chain that was located in the equatorial region of the planet Ralltiir. The remote canyons of the High Ontis contained a number of marble quarries that were known as the "jumper quarries," due to the fact that their ownership status was contested …

The Tas Sea was a turbulent sea that was located on the planet Ralltiir. The fortress of Alexi Garyn, the leader of the criminal organization Black Sun, was built on top of a granite outcropping located within the Tas Sea.
A battle occurred at the planet Taris in the Imperial Skirmishes, a desperate attempt by the Council of Moffs and the replacement warlords to turn the tide in the Galactic Civil War.
A battle droid was stationed in the hangar of a Separatist supply ship stationed over the planet of Umbara during the Battle of Umbara.
The Surveillance and Security Corps was the first offshoot branch of the Imperial Security Bureau. It was created a year after the end of the Clone Wars as a Planetary Security Forces.
The Black Vault was a Sith weapon storage space in the armory of the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant, the Galactic Republic's capital.
The Zuguruk were a caste of the Sith, a sentient species that originated on the planet Korriban within the Stygian Caldera.

A city surveillance droid was present on the planet Taris during the Siege of Taris in 3963 BBY. During the siege, the droid's brain was not able to determine how to go about its duties in light of the battle, and it attempted to issue a parking ticket to what was in fact a li…
The Defeat of the Starweird Queen was a battle between the Starweird and the Jedi during the Great Galactic War.
In 25 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War between the New Republic and the Yuuzhan Vong species, the Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Taris system.
In 25 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War between the New Republic and the Yuuzhan Vong species, the Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Skorrupon system.
In 25 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War between the New Republic and the Yuuzhan Vong species, the Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Vanquo system.
In 25 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War between the New Republic and the Yuuzhan Vong species, the Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Corsin system.

The Nar Shaddaa Labor Alliance was a criminal organization of slavers that existed in the years of the Cold War.

The DX annihilator network was a droid criminal organization that operated on Nar Shaddaa in the years of the Cold War. DX-TX served as the primary hub of this group who later joined forces with Godoba the Hutt and the Nar Shaddaa Labor Alliance to form the Shadow Syndicate.
The Founder was a Valor-class cruiser in the Republic Navy under the service of the Supreme Chancellor. It served as the personal transport of the Supreme Chancellor and their entourage..

Livien Magnus was the capital city of the planet Ord Radama. During the Great Galactic War, the Sith Empire attacked Ord Radama and besieged Livien Magnus, which was held by the forces of the Galactic Republic.

New Raido was a city that was located on the planet Ord Radama. During the Great Galactic War, Livien Magnus, the capital city of Ord Radama, was destroyed during a battle between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, and in the aftermath of the battle, New Raido became t…

Grotthu was a term referring to all slaves of the Red Sith, a species from the Stygian Caldera. They represented the lowliest caste of the Sith society. Originally, the Grotthu were of mixed species, although many of them were full-blooded Red Sith by 5000 BBY.
A 2-1B surgical droid was stationed inside the Jedi Temple on the planet of Coruscant around 21 BBY during the time of the Clone Wars.

NR-02 was an advanced protocol droid owned by Grand Moff Rycus Kilran. In addition to his standard translation and protocol capabilities, he claimed "manslaughter" and "calumniation" among his functions.
This battle droid was stationed on Asajj Ventress's Trident-class assault ship during the Battle of Kamino along with a fellow droid.
This aqua droid was part of a detachment of droids under command of Asajj Ventress and took part in the Battle of Kamino.

The Lindworm was a dreadnaught that was used by the Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War. At some point during the conflict, the Lindworm and two Sith Harrower-class dreadnoughts assisted with a Sith invasion of the planet Ord Radama that was led by the Sith Lord Darth Ma…
Ardru was a planet located in the Iseno sector of the Inner Rim.

Saccorata was a large city that was located on the main continent of the planet Sacorria, about five hundred kilometers from Dorthus Tal Island. The Sacorria Central Spaceport was located on the outskirts of the city.

Yozusks were creatures native to Dromund Kaas. They were territorial beasts with rocky protrusions on their back. When the first Sith arrived on Dromund Kaas, they referred to the yozusks as "rock wardens". They were still predominant by the time of the Cold War.

climate: Arid, high temperature and low humidity
x: Paloma was the sole planet in the Paloma system, near the Kathol sector. It didn't have any important resources nor strategic value.

objective: Find Sando
x: On Ord Mantell the Jedi learned that Sando's ship went to the Bold moisture plant, run by Orin Bold and his daughter Nella Bold. However, the Bolds knew nothing of Sando, and told the Jedi of their own problem with the crime lord Taxer Sundown.

Predator was a modified scout ship owned by Khlor, a Human bounty hunter active during the Imperial Era. The bounty hunter's hideout resided on a volcanic island on the planet Velusia. Khlor's prefabricated barracks featured a vehicle bay.

The darkfly was a species of fly. A large number of darkflies lived inside the head of the decaying Sorcerer of Rhand Blessed Toxmalb and at Toxmalb's command, swarms of the flies would fly from his head and attempt to choke or suffocate his enemies.

The Rift Alliance was a political faction and militant group in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic formed of Republic or Republic-aligned planets united by their shared protests at the Republic "incompetence", they threatened to secede from the Republic.
Network Access was a vital hub of the HoloNet located on the moon Nar Shaddaa by the Cold War, which itself was considered the technological heart of the galaxy.
The Lightspring was a natural site of incredible beauty and serenity that was located deep within the most desolate reaches of Tatooine, within the Dune Sea.
The Imperial Science Bureau, also known as the Imperial Science Corps, was an organization of the reconstituted Sith Empire dedicated to research and development of new technology.
K'aargs were large, bipedal reptilian humanoids from the planet Shira. They were described as being not very accommodating, and were feared for their mouth full of sharp teeth.
Shira was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.
Around 3665 BBY, during the Great Galactic War, the Sith Lord Ferrid undertook a mission to steal a Galactic Republic superweapon for the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Cult of the Screaming Blade was formed by the renegade Sith Lord Paladius during the reconstituted Sith Empire. Based on Nar Shaddaa, it was usurped by the Sith Inquisitor, Kallig, during the Cold War.

result: Darth Plagueis secretly watches the duel
x: The duel on Abraxin occurred during year 67 BBY on the planet Abraxin.
Essien was a world in the Halthor sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Vjun were a mysterious species recorded in the library records of Darth Plagueis, possibly contemporaries of the Rakata.
Axial Park was a major point of interest at Coronet City on Corellia that showcased Corellian's appreciation for nature.

The Incorporation Islands was a district of Coronet City which was series of islands occupied by the largest and most prosperous business entities. Most of this sector was wholly owned and controlled by different galaxy-spanning enterprises.
The Coruscant Spaceport Authority was the agency in charge of the Coruscant Spaceport on Coruscant during the Cold War. It monitored traffic around the spaceport.
The Corellia Corporate Council was a political policy making coalition with representatives to every government committee on Corellia.
The Jafan III was a Naboo passenger starship servicing Legislative Youth Program members during the final years of the Great Peace of the Republic period.

AR-G0 was a class three droid owned by the smuggler Beryl Thorne operating out of Taris during the Cold War. Thorne named AR-G0 the second in command of her operation on Taris after suffering the losses of many contacts to rakghouls.

A rocky planet was the location of the Carbonite Sith Tomb, which housed a Carbonite Sith Army along with a Carbonite Sith Master. It was found by the Nightsister Silri after she studied a holocron acquired by Tyber Zann.
Nam-aK was a droid sent by the Gree to repair Coruscant during the Cold War.

Tyne's Horky was a rough, rowdy, and lawless frontier mining town on a planet of the same name. The crime lord Kleb Zellock owned a piece of everything in town, and ran his criminal empire out of Doodnik's Café.

headquarters: Doodnik's Café, Tyne's Horky, Tyne's Horky
x: The crime lord Kleb Zellock operated a criminal organization in 15 BBY. He operated out of Doodnik's Café in the frontier mining town of Tyne's Horky on a planet of the same name. His organization dealt in bounty hunting, smuggling, claim-jumping and gun-running.
The Outreach Bureau or Imperial Outreach Division was an agency of the reformed Sith Empire that was responsible for the distribution of information and news.
Waypoint Station Aurek was a Galactic Republic military station built on Taris during the Cold War. It served as a secure base for soldiers and medical personnel during the reconstruction of Taris.
The bomber command post, a military installation of the reconstituted Sith Empire on Taris, was originally the Galactic Republic's Waypoint Station Draay or Draay Outpost during the Cold War.
The Gungan Security Force was a law enforcement agency on the planet Naboo that was used by the Gungan race to police their society.

The Otoh Gunga Transit Authority was an organization created by the Gungans of the underwater city of Otoh Gunga on Naboo. Lob Dizz was noted for being a respected engineer who had worked for both the Otoh Gunga Transit Authority and the Gungan Grand Army.
Bravo 4 was the personal N-1 starfighter of Rya Kirsch during the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY. Kirsch used the fighter during the space battle and was killed when the ship was destroyed.

The special tactical unit was a police special forces team of the Coruscant Security Force (CSF) that operated during the era of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Rana Squadron was a Republic Starfighter Corps squadron active during the Cold War. Rana Squadron consisted entirely of Duros pilots.
"The Specter" was a bipedal, humanoid assassin droid who operated out of Providence during the Galactic Civil War.
Labor Valley was a sector on the planet Corellia that was home to dozens of interconnected industrial factories that produced everything from raw durasteel to hyperdrives to thermal detonators.

The Nikto Sector was an area on Nar Shaddaa that had been formed by the time of the Cold War. Nar Shaddaa was seen as an attractive site for employment by Nikto enforcers seeking masters amongst the Hutt Cartel.
The Rust Yards was an industrial area located on the planet Nal Hutta, near the River Lands and the Eastern Grime.
Perstas were a bipedal species with large hind limbs upon which they hopped. Norky was a Persta.
Elite royal crusaders were upgraded variants of the Naboo Royal crusader and were members of the Royal Naboo Security Forces. They were outfitted at Security Force Fortresses.

terrain: Rings of molten rock and glassy stone
x: Shoon was a terrestrial world located in the Shoon system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim.

Doreen was a waterworld located in the Doreen system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. Situated near the Tangles area of the sector, the planet was linked via hyperlanes to the Kalgo and Usnia systems.

Firebase Alpha was an illegal energy-mining station on an asteroid located 1.5 terameters from a black hole inside the Rishi Maze satellite dwarf galaxy operated by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Sikkem IV was one of the many planetary haunts of Captain Ellin Lah and her crew from the Woebegone.
Carlix's Folly was one of the many planetary haunts of Captain Ellin Lah and her crew from Woebegone frequented.
Vestral was one of the many planetary haunts that Captain Ellin Lah and the crew of the Woebegone frequented.
Quantum Collosus was a passenger starship that traveled between Coruscant and Eriadu, reverting out of hyperspace along several worlds on the Hydian Way.
Clan Carid was a Mandalorian clan living on the planet Mandalore during the time of the Second Galactic Civil War.

Sunspot was a minor planet that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region. The small world experienced violent storms when it passed the planet Malterra in its orbit, and it had an extremely hot climate.

Malterra was a minor planet that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region. The small world experienced violent storms when it passed the planet Sunspot in its orbit, and it had an extremely hot climate.

Nox was a manufacturing planet that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region. The planet was colonized by the non–Force-sensitive settlers of the planet of Tython more than thirty-four thousand years before the Battle of Yavin.
Krev Coeur was a planet that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region. The planet's climate was so hot and arid that no life-forms could survive on it without protection.

Ska Gora was a verdant forest planet that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region. More than thirty-six thousand years before the Battle of Yavin, the non–Force-sensitive settlers of the planet Tython colonized Ska Gora.

Furies Gate was the outermost planet of the Tython system that was located within the galaxy's Deep Core region. The cold and barren world was colonized more than thirty-six thousand years before the Battle of Yavin by the non–Force-sensitive settlers of the planet Tython.
Obri was a gas giant planet with three moons that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region.
Mawr was a gas giant planet with seven moons that was located within the Tython system of the galaxy's Deep Core region.
The Rift, and the surrounding Riftlands, was a massive, jagged tear in the ground, many kilometers wide and deep on the planet Tython.
Bendii was a planet located in the Seitia sector of the Outer Rim. From space, Bendii appeared as a blue orb.
The Abyss of Ruh was a natural feature located in the Rift of the planet Tython in the Deep Core of the galaxy.

The Old City was an ancient and abandoned city of ziggurats and pyramids located in the Red Desert, on Talss, a continent of Tython. When the Je'daii Order discovered the site after their arrival on the world in 36,453 BBY, the city was already ancient and of unknown origin.
The Silent Desert was a natural feature of the planet Tython in the Deep Core of the galaxy, so named because of its unique ability to nullify all sound transmitted in its environment.
The Deep Ocean was a sea on the planet Tython that was home to Mahara Kesh, the Temple of Healing for the Je'daii Order.

Pylat birds were a species of non-sentient avians native to the planet Neimoidia that were prized as status symbols. Some wealthy Neimoidians kept such birds in special cages. During 3 ABY the casino cruiser Morenia was offering a Pylat bird as a prize.
Blue Desert City was a city on Dathomir. It was there that Darth Sidious met Kycina, and was given the infant Maul.

x: The contest on Sojourn occurred in 67 BBY on the planet of Sojourn, where Hego Damask, the Muun Sith Lord Darth Plagueis resided after he hosted the Gathering there. After he hosted his event, his Sun Guards brought news that an intruder penetrated the building's defenses.
The Kintan Kings was a criminal gang of Nikto that operated in the Old Republic era and resided on Nar Shaddaa. Originally, they were led by Bareesh the Hutt and operated from the Nikto Sector.
The trap at Fluwhaka was a battle fought between the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic against the Dark Jedi during the Hundred-Year Darkness.

Bog People, also known as Bogmen, were groups of outcasts that lived in the swamps of Nal Hutta. Their numbers consisted of those that crossed the line even in a criminal society, lost everything and had no place to go, or those that outraged their Hutt employers.

The Ashtan Tor was a freighter that operated during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In about 31 BBY, the freighter was raided by pirates while hauling a cargo of the narcotic ryll from the planet Ryloth.
The Wyvard was a starship of the Imperial Remnant that served under Moff Porrak Vansyn at the Battle over Exodo II.
Muuts were a type of creature from the planet Kesh that could be tamed as pets.

The border assault post, originally the Galactic Republic's Waypoint Station Morne—officially Republic Outpost Four—during the Cold War, was a reconstituted Sith Empire military station built on Taris.
The Science Service was a branch of Corulag Academy that focused upon scientific research. It was housed its own tower and was lead by Chief Scientist Frexton.

Forward Outpost Alpha, originally known as the Galactic Republic's Kanner Outpost, was a military station built on Taris during the Cold War. It served as a secure base for military and research personnel during the reconstruction of Taris.
The Carto Asteroid Belt was an asteroid belt in the Expansion Region.
An ancient Sith battlecruiser laid adrift in a gravitational pocket of the satellite galaxy Rishi Maze.
Swimming creatures existed within virtual reality, and preceded the appearance of Mermeia during an erotic mind evaporator experience of the Wookiee Attichitcuk in 1.5 ABY.

Bogan was one of the two moons of the planet of Tython. Observing both Bogan and Ashla, the other natural satellite, the first settlers of Tython recognized the light and the dark aspects of the Force.
The White Nova was a luxurious star liner that was used to transport passengers during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Galsol was a planet in the Belderone sector of the Outer Rim.
This unidentified red pit droid worked on Ratts Tyerell's podracer during the Boonta Eve Classic on Tatooine in 32 BBY.

Army C was part of the Trade Federation Droid Army, consisting of Armored Assault Tanks and Multi-Troop Transports. In 32 BBY, during the Invasion of Naboo, it was sent to flank the Gungan Grand Army during the Battle of Grassy Plains.

conflict: Blockade of the Rimma Trade Route
x: In 3680 BBY, during the early days of the Great Galactic War, a battle between the Sith Empire and Galactic Republic occurred in the Seswenna sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Maladians were a cult of highly-skilled humanoid assassins from the Maladi system known to honor all their contracts, as well as being able to wound or kill Jedi Knights.
Pygorix was a world located in the Pygorix system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Coruscant equatorial belt was an area of the planet of Coruscant in the Core Worlds region. In the year 20 BBY the area was considered prestigious by the Sakiyan Republic navy Admiral Tarnese Bleyd who planned to purchase an apartment at the top of a monad in the equatoria…

The Corporate Committee was a power-sharing body that was established on the planet 244Core in about 100 BBY. The committee was made up of representatives of every company that operated on 244Core, and it was responsible for electing the world's Chief Administrator.
Zone 210 was a region of the planet 244Core. The city Eeookko was situated in the middle of a large crater that was located within Zone 210.

Army B was a unit of the Trade Federation Droid Army. In 32 BBY, during the Invasion of Naboo, it was sent to flank the Gungan Grand Army during the Battle of Grassy Plains. Army B was destroyed while attacking a Naboo Resistance base.

C-06X was a battle droid unit created by the Colicoid Creation Nest during the Cold War. It was acquired by the Sith Empire during the Cold War to serve as a courier for Darth Malgus and inform Imperial heroes of the upcoming Colicoid war games.
The Supreme Guard was an elite security force of the Republic Military that was assigned to personally protect the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic.

The Rim Faction was one of two split political factions that was active within the Galactic Republic's Senate prior to the inception of the Separatist Crisis, which was organized by the Separatist Alliance.
Mezzileen Spaceport was a spaceport on Coruscant. It shared its name with Supreme Chancellor Signet Mezzileen.
Mok's Cheap Eats was a restaurant in The Works on Coruscant, catering to factory workers.
The Republic Reserve Administration was a financial agency of the Galactic Republic. Its development was overseen by Hego Damask who was, in reality, a Sith Lord.

The Black Legions was an elite military unit of the Dark Jedi renegades of the Hundred-Year Darkness. Their leader was the Marchioness XoXaan. The Black Legions participated in the Battle of Corbos in 6900 BBY. Sorzus Syn mentioned the legions in her titular chronicle.
Kinzor was a planet where Professor Schardak studied in the local archaeological museum.
Dagmar II was a planet in the Dagmar system and the seat of the Imperial Governor of Dagmar where his palace was located.

This Archeological museum was located on the planet Kinzor. During his studies, the archeologist Schardak unwittingly freed an ancient abomination, found in a tumulus on Tatooine. The mummy killed several beings before fleeing the planet.

Iraidas or Lraidas were a species of predatory reptomammals that were native to the planet Alderaan. They were characterized by their long ears which permitted them to develop an advanced hearing which they used to hear and hunt their prey.

Bolraidas were an animal species native to the planet Alderaan, distant relatives to the Iraida. They were considered one of the most aggressive animals in the galaxy that was a sharp contrast to the tranquility of their homeworld.

The Republic Customs Office was the organizations charged with preventing illegal trade of spices and other illicit goods within the Galactic Republic by the time of the Cold War with the Sith Empire.

Uphrades was a planet located in the Uphrades system of the Inner Rim. Originally a green and fertile agriworld during the years leading up to the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, Uphrades supplied the Republic capital planet Corusc…
The planet of Oblis was destroyed thousands of years before the Clone Wars.

x: A skirmish occurred in a star system in the Unknown Regions in 27 BBY. Progga the Hutt had been attacking the Bargain Hunter and following them even when they made hyperspace jumps.
a: Skirmish between the Chiss and Progga

x: Black Sun territory, also known as the Black Sun district, was a sector of Coruscant ruled by the Black Sun criminal syndicate in the aftermath of the Sacking of Coruscant.
The Chasm was a large canyon located high in the mountains of the continent Talss on the planet Tython.
The Sullustan Constable Brigade was a law enforcement agency that operated on the planet Sullust.
Trendivar was a planet in the Hunnoverrs sector of the Outer Rim. A skirmish occurred here between the forces of the Vanderijar kajidic and the bounty hunters of Grim Destiny.
The Massacre at Kolanda Station was a battle of the Galactic Civil War. All Rebel soldiers were massacred by Imperial forces acting on intelligence supplied by Krova the Hutt.

This species was native to UR41-284. They attempted to resist Grand Admiral Thrawn. Thrawn ordered Captain Ferob of the Victory-class Star Destroyer Iron Fist to destroy everything within 70km of the coordinates of the planet's museum district.
The Customs Enforcement Division was a branch of the Coruscant Security Force charged with customs enforcement on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War era.

Huro was a planet in the Huro system within the Ciutric sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Trever Flume stopped at an exclusive florist on Coruscant who sold exotic blooms and bought a small plant with vibrant yellow leaves native to the planet Huro.

Jhantoria was a celestial body located in the Jhantoria system. It was a part of the Allied Tion sector of the Tion Cluster, situated within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Jhantoria was the origin point of Jhantorian wine.

The Doombringer was a Harrower-class dreadnought equipped with the Silencer, a superlaser capable of destroying an entire fleet. During the Cold War it was Moff Valion Pyron's flagship and became part of Darth Nox's fleet.

The Tosh Residence was a tent that housed the young miner Jann Tosh and his gruff uncle Gundy. Near the home was a cave that allowed Gundy and Jann to search for Keshels, the currency of the planet of Tyne's Horky.
The Battle of Pallaxides took place on Pallaxides during the Galactic Civil War. It was a victory for the New Republic.
Wings was a modified space transport that was used as a scouting ship by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Battle of RZ7-6113-23 took place in orbit of RZ7-6113-23 during the Galactic Civil War.
Endor was a Dauntless-class heavy cruiser in the New Republic Defense Fleet. It was destroyed sometime in 13 ABY when it was led into a trap near the planet RZ7-6113-23.
The Ceyan Range Raceway was an icy podracing course located near the Ceyan Range mountains on Hoth. It stretched for 10.5 miles. Ben Quadinaros was the track favorite.
Malachor II was an Outer Rim planet located in the Malachor system.
The Great Migration was a period that impacted the Killiks of Alderaan during distant times. This event was marked as a deeply buried primal memory of the hive mind.

terrain: Rocky desert , putrid swamps , polluted lakes and ponds
x: Mandalah III was a planet in the Mandalah system.
Shrobs were saurian humanoids from the planet Mandalah III. They were tall and lean, with scaly brownish skin.
Phase One was an assassination attempt on Chief of State Leia Organa Solo and her family during the Galactic Civil War.
A raid was organized by Nom Anor to steal a chunk of zinethium in a class-3 toxic weapons dump on Nyara.

The Reign of the Ax was an era of time in the history of the Sith species. It corresponded to the reign of King Adas, which lasted three hundred years (circa 28,000 BBY to 27,700 BBY). It ended with the King's death, while he was trying to drive off the Rakata.
The Ninûshwodzakut (which meant "Knotters of Entrails" in Sith) were a group of Kissai whose role was to create Sithspawns through alchemy and manipulated breeding.
In about 20 BBY, a skirmish took place in the Cularin system, aboard the starship Animiasma.
Bravo Fighter was the an N-1 starfighter attached to Bravo Flight during the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY. Anakin Skywalker used the fighter during the Battle of Naboo.
In about 19 BBY, a conference was scheduled to take place in the Cularin system, which was to be attended by various local dignitaries from throughout the system.
B-2A was an experimental battle droid produced for the Galactic Empire in Imperial Research Station 61 on the planet Wayland.

B-2B was an experimental battle droid based on the B2 super battle droid. It was created at Imperial Research Station 61 under the direction of Milosh Muhrlein. He hid the droid in a secret chamber in his office.
Shortly before the Life Day of 1 ABY, the Rebel Alliance set up a base in an asteroid field.

x: Between 0 BBY and 1 ABY, members of the Rebel Alliance undertook a mission to recover the Talisman, an artifact created by the Galactic Empire to bait the Alliance with false rumors of its invisibility-granting qualities.
CT-Tertium was a barracks built by the Galactic Republic in the military base Ground Base Seven on the planet Drongar during or prior to 30 BBY.
The southeast quadrant was an area of Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7 built on the planet Drongar for use in the Clone Wars during or prior to 30 BBY.
The Gran Youth Council was an organization on the planet of Malastare with members in the capital city of Pixelito.

Carbonite Prisoner Storage was a section of the Minimum Security Section on Belsavis that included a bunker, an open yard, and Republic Prison Block South, where a number of prisoners were kept in carbonite. These included both violent killers and anarchists.
Aurum, later known as the lost city of Aurum, was a city on the planet Tython that was built by the Tythans, the settlers brought to Tython by the Tho Yor ships in 36,453 BBY.

x: In about 21 BBY, a skirmish took place on a small asteroid in the Cularin asteroid belt.

x: In about 19 BBY, shortly after the conclusion of the Clone Wars, the Sith student Len Markus traveled to the Heart Tree on the planet Cularin to search for the Eye of the Sun, an ancient Jedi artifact.

Feris was a celestial body located in the Feris system, a part of the Agarix sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It featured polar ice caps and was home to a civilization millennia prior to 3637 BBY.
Feris City was a city on the planet Feris. The city was known for its large number of bounty hunters.

The Duel on Darth Revan's Flagship was a confrontation during the Jedi Civil War between the Dark Lord of the Sith Revan, and Sith apprentice Darth Malak. It took place in Revan's flagship. The lightsaber duel resulted in Malak's defeat and the loss of his jaw.

The Conquest of Tatooine was an event in which Tatooine—then a lush world—was subjugated by the Predor Tul'kar and the forces of the Infinite Empire. A city was burned, and many Force-sensitive Kumumgah were purged or taken prisoner after the battle.
Pieldi was a celestial body located in the Pieldi system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim.
Dramassia was a densely-populated urban planet located in the Dramassia system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim.
Umthyg was a lackluster industrial world located in the Umthyg system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim.
Bugtown, formerly known as the Farnel Research Facility or Lab 352, was a genetic research facility located in the Broken Valley on the planet Balmorra, next to Lake Farnell.

A battle took place near the planet of Chommell Minor between the newly formed Bravo Squadron and a group of pirates. Ric Olié took part in the battle in his new N-1 starfighter, Bravo 1. Sate Pestage quipped that several of the pirates collided with one another.

The Lower Industrial Sector was a region on Nar Shaddaa that housed some of the oldest industrial facilities and warehouses that were still in use on the moon. Some of these dated back to hundreds of years and were constructed by the Evocii that had built the city.

The Council Chamber was a room located within the Imperial Palace on Coruscant during the New Republic's control of the complex. Located off of the Grand Corridor, the chamber was used by the New Republic Provisional Council and later the Ruling Council.

The Grand Meeting Hall was a massive section of the Imperial Palace on Coruscant. Serving both the Galactic Empire and the New Republic, the enormity of the Grand Meeting Hall was diminished in relation with the Grand Corridor.
The Assemblage auditorium was a chamber within the Imperial Palace on Coruscant during the New Republic's control of the complex.
High Port Immigration was an organization that operated from the High Port Space Center around the planet of Muunilinst that handled the arrival of individuals to the world.
Hego Damask's residence was the home of the Muun Sith Lord Darth Plagueis, also known as Hego Damask, located on the island of Aborah on the planet Muunilinst.

Aborah was an island in the Western Sea on Muunilinst. The island was a dormant smoker, underneath which lay a number of interconnected lava tubes, remnants of its violent, volcanic past. For generations Aborah was the province of the Damask clan.
A massacre occurred in 67 BBY aboard the freighter Woebegone, when Darth Plagueis killed the ship's crew. It started when Plagueis was a stowaway on board the ship.
The Predator's Beak was a YT-2400 light freighter that was used by the Galactic Empire as a scout ship.

The Geonosian Hive Army was part of the military forces of the planet Geonosis that consisted of the insectoid aliens' warrior caste. While lacking a formal military, the warriors were usually sufficient in dealing with both criminal or security issues.

Clan Jeban was a Mandalorian clan in existence around the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War. Members of Clan Jeban could be identified by a shared red color-scheme on their Mandalorian armor, and a clan sigil designed around a black saber etched on the wearer's chest plate.
The Imperial Throne Room of the Imperial Palace on Coruscant served as the seat of the Galactic Emperor Palpatine, ruler of the Galactic Empire.
Simento-Threk was a celestial body located in the Simento-Threk system, a part of the Meram sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Lusaanda was a celestial body located in the Lusaanda system, a part of the Meram sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Mistar-5 was a terrestrial astronomical object. The attorney known as The Wavering Oeklass once appropriated a boat on Mistar-5.
Devil's Asteroid was an Outer Rim Territories asteroid located within the star system of the same name.
The Battle of Arda was a conflict between the Imperial Remnant and New Republic in 13 ABY in the Arda system.

t: Imperial throne room (Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center)
x: The throne room of the Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center on Coruscant served as the public seat of the Galactic Emperor from the foundation of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY at the end of the Clone Wars.
The Mid Rim Lending Network was an organization. At some point during galactic history, the Network signed a contract with the company Kalibac Industries to purchase a number of librarian droids.
The Battle of Barison was a conflict between the Imperial Remnant and New Republic in 13 ABY in the Barison system.
The Battle of Lucazec was a conflict between the Imperial Remnant and New Republic in 13 ABY in the Lucazec system.

x: Around the first year of the Clone Wars, Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi was sent on a mission to the planet Kamino to stop a Confederate plan that involved taking the bounty hunter Jango Fett's cloning DNA template.
The Crucible was an arena on Dathomir that housed the Selection of the Nightsisters.

Savrip Clan was one of the many many clans that prospective young Initiates were placed in when they first began to learn the ways of the Jedi Order. Named after the Savrip of Ord Mantell, the clan was stationed at the Jedi Temple on the Galactic Republic capital of Coruscant .
Clan Spar was a Mandalorian clan that operated by the time of the Great Galactic War.
