x: The Battle of Tython, also known as the Battle of Kaleth, was the final battle of the Despot War which was waged by Despot Queen Hadiya against the Je'daii Order in 25,805 BBY.
The First Light was a freighter that was used by the Cularin-based company Renna's Transport Service during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
The Second Breath was a modified YT-1300 light freighter that was used by the Cularin-based company Renna's Transport Service.

Dessin's Dagger was a modified YT-1300 light freighter that was active during the Clone Wars. In about 21 BBY, the freighter traveled to the Druckenwell system and there, the vessel's crew attempted to fit a device to a luxury liner.

The Forest of Broken Glass was a region of the planet Durace, in the Unknown Regions. The forest did not contain any trees and it's name was derived from numerous silicate rock formations of various shapes and colors that were situated in the region.
During the Galactic Civil War, a cruiser conducted a raid on an Alliance base on Refnar.

The Pictograph Caverns were a set of caverns that were located on the planet Durace, in the mountains near to the world's equator. The caverns were inhabited at some point prior to Durace's devastation and they contained a number of primitive carvings.

An asteroid was located in the Crustai system on the edges of the Chiss Ascendancy. The Crustai asteroid base used by the Picket Force Two of the Chiss Expansionary Fleet was hidden inside the asteroid.

GB-3P0 was a protocol droid that was owned by the family House Bolleon. Lord Bolleon was a collector of artifacts and primitive art and at some point during galactic history, GB-3P0 accompanied Bolleon on an expedition to the planet Durace, to translate the ancient pictographs…
The Alkaline Sea was a sea that was located on the planet Durace. A small island was situated in the middle of the sea, on which rare alparas flowers grew.
The alpharas flower was a rare variety of flower that bloomed only once every one hundred years, and they could be found only on a small island in the middle of the Alkaline Sea on the planet Durace.
Karthrexia was a world in the Kriz sector of the Outer Rim. Around 5 ABY, a thick survival tent was necessary to withstand the harsh conditions on the Karthrexian glaciers.

Shor was a planet in the Unknown Regions that was inhabited by the Near-Human Shorak species. Shor was located near to the world Giaca and about one hundred years before the Jedi Civil War, scouts from Shor discovered Giaca.
Peroenia was a planet in the Unknown Regions. It was the homeworld of the Peroenians.

Seven Flames was a planet located in the Rayter sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the Alliance to Restore the Republic established a support base on the planet, which the Rebels used to launch a diplomatic operation to the planet Karra in an a…

Levet's farm was a farm located on the planet Mandalore, and owned by the Mandalorian known as Levet. Located approximately ten kilometers outside of Mandalore's capital city, Keldabe, Levet's farm was only a short distance down a simple dirt road from the Beviin-Vasur farm.

x: The Shorak were a Near-Human sentient species that originated on the planet Shor, in the Unknown Regions. They were more muscular than baseline Humans, and they often dyed their hair deep colors and decorated their arms with tattoos.

The Peroenians were a Near-Human species that originated on the planet of Peroenia, in the Unknown Regions. They had six digits on each of their hands and feet, and they also had long, yellow-and-gray-colored hair.

Tallpeak was a small settlement located on the planet Giaca, which served as the primary outpost of the Peroenian species on the world. It usually housed a population of just a few hundred individuals.
Station 300 was an outpost that was established by the Shorak species on the planet Giaca, during their attempts to colonize the world.

Maruuk's Nook was a concealed bolthole that was located on the planet Giaca. The hideout was located sixty meters above the surface of a canyon and it consisted of a network of caves, the largest of which was just big enough to land a small freighter in.

Glasspoint was a large, basaltic column on the planet of Giaca, which served as a neutral meeting point for criminals and other factions. The column had a black, glass-like appearance, and it was one kilometer in width and half a kilometer in height.

The Street Performers And Panhandlers' Guild was an organization on the Outer Rim Territories planet Tatooine. In 32 BBY, the information broker Televan Koreyy served as leader of the guild and kept tight control over the other guild members.

Farstone was a world located in the Farstone system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. A hyperlane connected Farstone to the Umthyg system.

Kimm Aurek was a dingy industrial world located in the Kimm Aurek system, one of the Kimm systems of the Juvex sector, which was itself a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim.
Kimm Cresh was a planet located in the Kimm Cresh system of the Juvex sector, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It was one of a trio of dingy industrial worlds belonging to House Sreethyn.
Kimm Besh was a planet located in the Kimm Besh system of the Juvex sector, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It was one of a trio of dingy industrial worlds belonging to House Sreethyn.

Zaria was a terrestrial world located in the Zaria system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex-Juvex Loop hyperlane linked it to the Anstares and Malador systems.
Anturus was a planet located in the Anturus system of the Senex sector, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. It was the homeworld of House Picutorion.
The Miners' Union was a trade union that operated on Iol, a planet in the Unknown Regions that was controlled by the company Tangan Industries.

Haven was the capital city of Iol, a planet in the Unknown Regions that was controlled by the company Tangan Industries. Iol was oldest and largest settlement on Iol, and it consisted of five large, separate domes that were each at least 1 kilometer in diameter.
Menelath was a city on Iol, a planet in the Unknown Regions that was controlled by the company Tangan Industries.
Relak Canyon was a canyon that was located on the planet of Iol. The canyon was a byproduct of centuries of mining on Iol, and was seven kilometers in width and up to one kilometer deep in places.
Shirkel was a city on Iol, a planet in the Unknown Regions that was controlled by the company Tangan Industries.
The Merchant's Consortium was a business association that operated on Iol, a planet in the Unknown Regions that was controlled by the company Tangan Industries.
The Cult of Veroleem was a cult that ruled the planet Veroleem in the Unknown Regions.
Desperation's Refuge was a small encampment on the planet Veroleem, which was operated by former slaves of the Cult of Veroleem that had escaped from their masters and formed a resistance movement.
The Coreesh Mountains was a mountain range that was located on the planet Veroleem, several dozen kilometers to the east of the city New Promise.

The Council Chamber of the New Jedi Order's Hidden Temple was where the Jedi Council convened. Surrounded by starships, it was grounded on Taivas. During the Attack on the Hidden Temple, it remained on the ground when the rest of the temple rose into the air.

Talhovi was a Mid Rim world located in the Juvex sector. It was the homeworld of the Mekuun family, with whom the Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex region had prohibited trade. Talhovi nevertheless remained economically powerful and exported goods such as Talhovian ale.

x: The Battle of Teradoc's fortress was a skirmish in the Deep Core between the forces of Imperial warlords Harrsk and Teradoc. Ending with the intervention of Admiral Daala, the battle concluded the Imperial Civil War and directly led to the Imperial Reunification.

In 3680 BBY, the second year of the Great Galactic War, a series of public demonstrations broke out on Coruscant, the capital world of the Galactic Republic, in response to political infighting in the Galactic Senate and the Sith Empire's invasion of the Outer Rim Territories.
A B1 battle droid participated in the Battle of Dathomir around 21 BBY under command of Separatist Supreme Commander General Grievous.

An unidentified OOM security battle droid was stationed inside Separatist Supreme Commander General Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer. Around 21 BBY, during the Battle of Dathomir, he reported to Grievous that the fleet was approaching the planet of Dathomir.

New Promise was the capital city of the planet Veroleem, in the Unknown Regions. New Promise was located to the west of the Coreesh Mountains and it was the only major settlement on the Veroleem, containing the majority of the world's population.
The Council of Enlightened Elders was a ruling council that acted as the governing body of the Cult of Veroleem, a religious sect that ruled the planet Veroleem.
The Crimson Stars were a band of pirates that operated on the planet Volik, in the Unknown Regions.
The Ebon Strikers were a band of pirates that were based on the planet Volik, in the Unknown Regions.
Lunaara Square was a public meeting place that was located in the city Rastar on the planet Altiria/Anarris.
The racsan break was a period of reprieve observed by the TransGal circuit, a galactic professional swoop racing division, that followed a race on the planet of Corulag.
The Deep Charting Expedition was an expedition made by the Republic scout ship Spotrunner, leading into the depths of the Unknown Regions. At some point a Mnggal-Mnggal outbreak occurred on the ship.
Jennie Pickalho was a Human replica droid, designed to be an almost perfect replica of a Human female. She worked at the Chandrilan Embassy on Coruscant at the time of the destruction of Alderaan.

The Republic Embassy Security Service was a law enforcement force for the Galactic Republic. It worked with the Republic Diplomatic Corps and provided protection for embassies on various planets outside the Republic.

The Second Bureau was a branch of the Chandrilan Embassy on Coruscant, dedicated to collect secrets and informations. In 0 BBY, it was directed by Major Jonas Davan.

The Battle of Alakatha was a skirmish between Rogue Squadron and the Invid pirates.
R3-D5 was an R3 series astromech droid that saw operation during the Clone Wars. The droid was assigned to Saesee Tiin's starfighter and saw combat over Lola Sayu during a dangerous mission.
A vindinax was a type of dangerous predator that originated on a world in the Unknown Regions, on which it was at the top of the food chain.
TT4 was a protocol droid that was used by the company Tor-Ro-Bo Industries as an irregular transport specialist.

Tor 7863 was a bulk freighter that was used by the company Tor-Ro-Bo Industries. At some point, Tor-Ro-Bo hired a group of spacers to smuggle some semi-processed TOL-type ore off of the planet 244Core and transport it to Tor 7863, in breach of a profit-sharing agreement that T…

5T4 was a small, orange-colored, wheeled droid that served the company Tor-Ro-Bo Industries. 5T4 was based in Tor-Ro-Bo Processing Center 879 on the planet 244Core and at some point, 5T4 greeted a group of spacers that had been sent to the facility to smuggle some cargo for To…
Zone 54g was a region of the Unknown Regions planet 244Core. The company Tor-Ro-Bo Industries operated an ore processing facility on an island that was situated in Zone54g.
In 27 BBY, a skirmish occurred between the Springhawk, a vessel of the Chiss Expansionary Fleet's Picket Force Two, and a Vagaari plunder ship, along with its two fighter escorts.

x: The Red Light Sector was an area of Nar Shaddaa known for its illicit entertainment.
The womp weasel was a creature. The musician Swanny Mull once referred to himself as a womp weasel after he denied knowing Obi-Wan Kenobi in order to avoid getting into trouble.

A small asteroid field was located in the Crustai system in the Unknown Regions. The Chiss traversed it to reach their Crustai base of Picket Force Two that was inside a large, wobbly asteroid in the asteroid field.
The Vivab deserts were ice-swept plains located on the Clar. By the year 2 ABY, they had been explored and charted by Barosa Warren and Casti Tholon.

The Battle of Ord Radama, later known as the Harrower Disaster, was a major engagement of the Great Galactic War between the belligerent powers of the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Geroon was the homeworld of the Geroon species. It was located in the Unknown Regions Geroon system. Around 27 BBY, it was attacked by the Vagaari species.

The Second Migration referred to a time in Tython's early history when non-Forceful Tythans were forced to leave their homeworld by the Je'daii Order for their own safety. It followed the First Migration, or the arrival of the Tho Yor in the Tython system.

The Despot Army was the military force loyal to the Shikaakwan Kral Hadiya. Consisting of conscripts and volunteers from across the Settled Worlds of the Tython system, the army was fueled by their fear and hatred of the Je'daii Order on Tython.
In 3660 BBY, the forces of the Galactic Republic's Navy attacked the Sith holy planet of Korriban—the third conflict of the Great Galactic War to be focused on the ancient burial world.
The Battle of Ziost was a conflict of the Great Galactic War fought between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

The Battle of Ashas Ree was a conflict of the Great Galactic War, waged around 3660 BBY. After failed attacks on the Sith planets of Korriban and Ziost, the forces of the Galactic Republic, under the command of Jedi Master Ven Zallow, launched an attack on the Ashas Ree—a worl…
Around 3660 BBY, during the Great Galactic War, a battle occurred on and in orbit of the planet Serenno.
The Reconquest of Ord Radama was a major battle of the Rim Campaign—one of the large military campaigns near the final years of the Great Galactic War.

Assault Team One, along with Assault Team Two, was ordered, by Force Commander Thrawn of the Chiss Expansionary Fleet, to perform an out-hull operation on a Vagaari gravity projector's starboard side during the Battle of the Geroon homeworld.

Assault Team Two, along with Assault Team One, was ordered, by Force Commander Thrawn of the Chiss Expansionary Fleet, to preform an out-hull operation on a Vagaari gravity projector's port side during the Battle of the Geroon homeworld.

During the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire that lasted between 3681 BBY and 3653 BBY, a battle occurred on Velmor, a resource-rich planet in the Mid Rim.

During the Great Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, a twenty-eight-year conflict spanning from 3681 BBY to 3653 BBY, the Empire attacked the planet Loronar with a significant military force.

result: The Imperial Seventh Fleet is removed from service
x: During the Great Galactic War, the Free Spacers Fleet, allied with the Galactic Republic, engaged and defeated the Imperial Seventh Fleet of the Sith Empire's Imperial Navy.

During the Great Galactic War, at some point prior to 3664 BBY, the Jedi Padawan Xerender engaged the Sith Lord Darth Baras in a duel. Xerender was joined in his fight by his Jedi Master Wyellett, who attempted to sway Baras to the light side of the Force.
During the Great Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, a twenty-eight-year conflict spanning from 3681 BBY to 3653 BBY, a battle occurred on the moon Yavin 4.

objective: Attack on Imperial civilians
x: During the Great Galactic War, the Galactic Republic's legendary Dagger Wing undertook an unauthorized mission to bomb Sith–Imperial citizens on the planet Fest.

The Outward Bound was a modified Vangaard Industries Pathfinder scout vessel that was owned by the Cyrs family. Over the years, the starship was handed down through generations of the family and it underwent numerous overhauls and upgrades.

Madra was desert city that was located in the Rym Mountains on the planet Socorro, near to a dormant volcano. The city contained a number of underground water pools that were renowned for their medicinal benefits.

The Alliance was the name given to the combined forces of the Empire-in-exile, the New Jedi Order, and the Galactic Alliance Remnant, who allied in 137 ABY in order to bring down Darth Krayt's Sith Empire.

Dorn Base was an Imperial base on the planet Hoth during the Cold War and successive Galactic War. The base included a command center, an Imperial market, and a cantina. Colonel Vannis was the base's commander before being killed in action around 3642 BBY.
The Jagged Plains Imperial Garrison was an outpost in the Clabburn Tundra on the planet of Hoth operated by the Sith Empire during the Cold War.
The Fortitude was a Valor-class cruiser in the Republic Navy. It was involved in the breaking of the Hydian Way blockade in 3660 BBY.

The Ice Behemoth Cave was a giant cave on the planet Hoth, where, during the Cold War, Talz members of the Galactic Republic set up a weapons and supply cache. The cave was inhabited by many wampas as well.
The Battle of Algara was a battle between two pirate factions, the Imperial Invids and the Thalassian slavers, in 11 ABY for the control of planet Kerilt's supplies.

Matacorn was a terrestrial world located in the Matacorn system, a part of the Mid Rim's Lambda sector. A nondescript trade world, it was the homeworld of the Human Hurst Romodi. Matacorn also shared its name with the Matacorn campaign, a part of the Galactic Civil War.
The Skirmish near Kessel occurred when a small New Republic fleet tried to prevent the Imperial pirates Invids from stealing a spice shipment in the Kessel system in 11 ABY.
Outpost Varath was an outpost operated by the Sith Empire in the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War.
Mos Anek was an outpost of the Sith Empire in the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War.

Outpost Rennar was a small Mandalorian settlement located west of Breezefield Farms in the Jundland Wastes of the planet Tatooine where the small clan would constantly engage against the local Tusken Raider tribes.
The White Maw was a pirate organization that operated during the Cold War to the Third Galactic War. The White Maw were known for their salvage operations on the planet Hoth.
Highmount Ridge was a geological feature on the planet Hoth. Within the ridge was located Shai Tenna's pleasure den and a wampa cave.
The Attack on the Galaxy Chance was a raid of the Khuiumin Survivors to capture former Imperial officer Zlece Oonaar.
The Attack on Tinta Lines was a raid by the Invids pirate group, who attacked two Tinta Lines passenger liners in 11 ABY.
The Bharhulai Tribal Lands were a series of territories located in the northern regions of the planet Socorro, extending to the world's polar icecap.
The Telos was a Valor-class cruiser serving in the Republic fleet during the Cold War as the flagship of the First Expeditionary Fleet of the Galactic Republic.
The Eriadu News Service, also known as ENS, was a news service that operated on the planet Eriadu during the Imperial Era.

The Clabburn Tundra was a stretch of frozen wasteland on the ice planet of Hoth. The area became a battleground between the Galactic Republic, Sith Empire, and scavenging pirate groups during the Cold War.
The Battle of Susevfi was a battle during the Galactic Civil War by the New Republic against both the Invids and Jensaarai on Susevfi in 11 ABY in order to rescue Mirax Terrik Horn.
The Mission to Courkrus was the first mission intiated by Corran Horn as a Jedi. In 11 ABY, he intended to terrify the Imperial pirates, the Invids who were on Courkrus to drive them off the planet.
During a battle in the Faldos system, the Nagai defeated the forces of the Alliance of Free Planets. The battle was part of the larger Nagai–Tof War.

During the Nagai–Tof War, the Nagai launched an attack on the Mephout system. The Nagai raiders targeted the government of the Mephout Dominion, an isolated Wild Space sector, which at that point had not yet officially aligned itself with the Alliance of Free Planets.
During an attack on Virgillia 7, the Nagai defeated the forces of the Virgillian Council. The battle was part of the larger Nagai–Tof War.
During a battle at the Koda Space Station, the Nagai defeated the forces of the Alliance of Free Planets. The battle was part of the larger Nagai–Tof War.

The 77th Air Wing was an Imperial starfighter wing that operated during the early years of the Galactic Empire. The wing was commanded by Captain Shea Hublin and was made up of at least one squadron: Sword Squadron.

The Tularan Marsh was a swamp on Taris that formed at the site of several abandoned swoop tracks. By 3643 BBY, the region had become a swamp, and the area was home to k'lor'slugs, nexu, ferrazid hounds, and bogwings.

In 10 ABY, during the Imperial offensive prior to Operation Shadow Hand, after driving the New Republic from the galactic capital of Coruscant, Imperial forces pursued the retreating New Republic along the Perlemian Trade Route and attacked Anaxes.
D-3P8 was an independent droid who ran a store on Ord Mynock. He was very persistent and would follow customers around his store until they purchased something.
The Glacier Breaker Wampa Den was a wampa cavern on the planet Hoth during the Cold War.
The Ice Claw Wampa Den was a wampa cavern on the planet Hoth during the Cold War.

The Spirit of Vengeance was a large, Mandalorian dreadnaught under the command of Mandalore the Vindicated.

The Freeport Security Force was a private law enforcement group chartered with the Ord Mynock Freeport to enforce local laws and protect the citizenry. It consisted of approximately 150 police officers.
The Terror Brigade was a group of illicit thrill-seekers composed of former Mandalorians, who settled on the planet Hoth during the Cold War.

The fourth battle of Orinda occurred during the Galactic Civil War between the Imperial Remnant and a dissident Imperial faction of hardliners, the Restored Empire, for the control of the Imperial capital Orinda and thus gain control over the Remnant.

Buoyant was an Inner Rim planet that was terraformed by a sentient species millennia before 54 BBY. The alterations made to Buoyant by the terraformers included an increased rotation rate as well as lush vegetation and imported animals, among them a long-necked herd quadruped.

Kursid was a planet in Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. It was inhabited by a species of primitive humanoids whose sole contact with the greater galaxy was through training missions conducted to the planet by the Order of the Sith Lords.
Pisquatch's Place was a cantina located a few blocks down from Chalmun's on Outer Kerner Way, Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine.
The Glacial Fissure was the name applied to the region surrounding a volcanic rift on the planet Hoth whose proper name was White Maw Pass.

The Mongrel Altar was an altar constructed within a natural depression which held the Eternal Pyre and was located just east of the Valley of the Dark Lords on Korriban.

The Force Assassins were a band of Force-sensitive assassins that operated in the Dantooine system during the Galactic Civil War.

A-4P0 was a librarian droid who served the Jedi Order as an analyst in the Archives of the Jedi Temple on the planet Tython during the Galactic Republic's Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The Heroes of Bothawui were the men and women of the Republic Military and Jedi Order who participated in the second battle at Bothawui in 3671 BBY, during the Great Galactic War.
A traveling air rodeo that featured thrantas was owned at one point by a female owner. An animal rights group kidnapped the woman who owned the rodeo, planning to starve her for a week.
A group of activists for animal rights had a goal of stopping the use of thrantas—a species of large, winged creatures—in air rodeos.

Pat-aK was a droid sent by the Gree to repair Coruscant during the Cold War.

CB-08-4 was a medical droid operating on Taris during the Galactic War. Its primary field of research and treatment was the rakghoul plague, and it ran the primary medcenter of Waypoint Station Draay.
Vhork Squadron was a starfighter squadron of the Hapan Royal Navy. Named after the vhork, a giant Daruvvian hawk, it was considered the best squadron in the Hapan Navy.
A Vhork was a type of giant hawk from the Daruvvia system. One of its known traits was to be very territorial.

G4-0M was an astromech droid active during the Cold War. G4 served the Galactic Republic as a courier on Carrick Station, delivering messages and mission briefings from the Emergency Response Corps to Republic personnel aboard.

The Great Crisis was a two-week period of riots and killings which broke out on the planet Kesh immediately after Testament Day in 3000 BBY. During that Testament Day, the Lost Tribe of Sith rediscovered the fact that Humans had once been servants to another species.
The Aurora was a heavily modified Valor-class cruiser that was in the service of the Republic Navy during the Great Galactic War and Cold War respectively.
An overclan was an Alwari clan of great importance on Ansion. The Borokii and the Januul, both notable overclans, were long-term rivals.
This Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 was purchased by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, disguised as Rako Hardeen, from a Bith starship dealer on Nal Hutta around 21 BBY during the time of the Clone Wars.
The Citizens' Militia was the security force and militia of several cities and outposts on the planet Tatooine. It was led by a sheriff and included soldiers and constables.

The Senate Commercial District or Commerce Hall was a commercial complex built underneath the Senate Plaza on Coruscant.

The Inner Rim Caucus was a political faction in the Galactic Alliance Senate. The faction held anti-Jedi sentiment views.
DU-3 was a pit droid that existed during the Clone Wars. He served as a loyal companion to a spacer.
Amelie was a Millicreep droid that served the Umbaran militia during the Clone Wars. It was captured during the Battle of Umbara and re-programmed to be the companion of a Jedi Knight.

Melan's office was the personal office from which Bothan Spynet member Koth Melan conducted his business. The office was located in the Intergalactic Trade Mission in Drev'starn, capital city of the Bothan homeworld of Bothawui.
The Rude Awakening was an assault pinnace infiltrator manufactured for the GA Marines Void Jumper units.

The Redstar was a Galactic Alliance frigate.
This battle droid was a B1-series battle droid that participated in the Sky Battle of Quell against Jedi Master Aayla Secura's fleet and served under TF-1726's command.

This incident was an attempt at Jedi Master Yoda's life by Asajj Ventress that took place on the planet Ithor sometime during the Clone Wars, between 22 BBY and 19 BBY. It was thought that the Grand Master had perished in this event for a short time before the truth came out.

This duel occurred on the planet Gala in 44 BBY, when Jedi apprentice Obi-Wan Kenobi and Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn were dispatched to Gala, to deal with the upcoming elections, and the mystery of the poisoning of Queen Veda.

The Imperial News Network was the public service news agency that operated under the Imperial Remnant sometime in 44 ABY.
Landru City was the capital of Danteel, the sector capital of the Emmo sector in the Core Worlds.
Govialty Gate was a westward facing, high-arching gate connected to the city wall around Cuipernam on Ansion.

The Dorin's Sky was a Thranta-class corvette that was in the service of the Republic Navy during the Cold War.
This town was located on the planet Bogden's moon Bogg 4. Among the bustling streets of the town that were filled with various species from all over the galaxy was a tavern called The Bonny Bounty.

Thermodraft, as it was called by Ozurist, was a stationary machine that was part of Coruscant's infrastructure. Located in The Works, Thermodraft was attacked during the Cold War by a group of "mobiles", rogue droids whose programming was corrupted in the Sacking of Coruscant.

P-2XN was a droid that served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. P-2XN was stationed as a courier aboard the Republic's Carrick Station, delivering messages and mission briefings to the Republic personnel aboard.

The aquatic Rebel Navy was the aquatic naval component of the Rebel Alliance Military. They committed operations on aquatic worlds; with their most common enemy being the Imperial Maritime Division.

The Imperial Maritime Division, also referred to as the Imperial Navy (not to be confused with the Imperial Starfleet), was part of the Galactic Empire's Military that carried out operations on bodies of water of different planets.

The Kaas City military police was a law enforcement agency under the Sphere of Laws and Justice that was responsible for maintaining order in Kaas City, the government center of the Sith Empire's capital planet, Dromund Kaas.

Operation: Red Cell was a clandestine operation conducted by the Republic Strategic Information Service, the Galactic Republic's intelligence agency, during the Great Galactic War with the Sith Empire between 3681–3653 BBY.

The Overlord was a warship in service of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.
PR-0B07 was a Separatist probe droid during the Clone Wars that served as a companion to a spacer.
A GR-75 Medium transport was used by the Rebel Alliance to take a small army from Krant to its asteroid field in 0 ABY. In transit, rumors that Darth Vader was on his way spread among the crews.

The Plain Lady was a starliner in use in 44 ABY. In that year, the Jedi Valin Horn and Jysella Horn went undercover aboard the EconoClass starliner to the Galactic Center Spaceport to infiltrate the planet Coruscant in order to liberate the world from the Lost Tribe of Sith.
A Hapan vessel, Sharmok 718 was a transport utilized by the New Jedi Order during the evacuation from the Jedi Academy on the planet Ossus.

Volgh Squadron served in the Hapan Royal Navy in 44 ABY. The squadron consisted of Hapan Miy'til starfighters, and they assisted the New Jedi Order during the evacuation from the Jedi Academy on the planet Ossus after the academy came under attack by the Lost Tribe of Sith.

Hagamoor 3 was a moon of planet Antemeridias located inside the Imperial Remnant's territories by 44 ABY. In that year, it served as the home for the scientists who had created the nanovirus strand that targeted the family of bounty hunter Boba Fett.
The Avenger was a corvette in the Imperial Navy. Commander Zarin served aboard the Avenger in 2 BBY.

Tech was a branch of Imperial Intelligence's Analysis Bureau. Their mandate had two main objectives; to analyze enemy technology and determine how it functioned, and to supply Intelligence with hardware to counter it.
The Experi-Tech was a branch of the Tech Section of the Imperial Intelligence.

This race of blue-skinned humanoids were native to a planet. Their homeworld was the location of the battle during the Clone Wars. Jedi Master Yoda defeated an entire Separatist army using only a giant chaingun. A cantina patron was a member of this species.

Rancor-dragons were mutated rancors with wings, created through alchemy at Anil Kesh. Rancor-dragons could fly. Butch was a rancor-dragon. They were slightly smaller than true rancors, and were used as mounts by the Je'daii.
The Je'daii Council, also known as the Masters' Council, was the governing body of the Je'daii Order.

The Shepherd was a Pursuit-class light cruiser that served in the Imperial Navy as of 0 ABY. That year, it traveled to the Inner Rim's Hapes Cluster under the command of Grand Admiral Osvald Teshik, accompanied by eight gunships.

E-3PO was a protocol droid that was owned by the Human Korlana Toryn. During the Clone Wars, Toryn was sent into hiding on the moon Nar Shaddaa by her father, Senator Jasso Toryn, and E-3PO accompanied her to the world.
Dirconites were a sentient species of rotund humanoids with light skin and small, sharpened teeth that had the ability to produce hypersonic shrieks capable of stunning other humanoids.
Prexiar was a planet located in the Steniplis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet had great freshwater seas and vast jungles. The Pirates of Prexiar operated an outpost there.
The Esus Mesa was a stone mesa located in the Jundland Chasm on the planet Tatooine that was connected to nearby cliffs by a stone bridge.

Keshtah Minor, known for millennia amongst the Keshiri and Lost Tribe of Sith as simply Keshtah, was a small continent on the southern hemisphere of the planet Kesh.
Alanciar, also known as Keshtah Major, was a large continent located on the planet Kesh's southern hemisphere. It was home to a Keshiri civilization who called themselves the Alanciari.
A tiperoo was a diminutive creature with blue skin, two green eyes, a prominent lower jaw, and a glowing antenna.

Beray was a location on the Keshtah Minor continent on the planet Kesh during the Time of the Rot. It housed a political faction of the Lost Tribe of Sith, to which the father of Sith Caretaker Varner Hilts belonged.
A political faction from Beray was a party in the Lost Tribe of Sith before 3000 BBY, during the Time of the Rot. The father of Sith Caretaker Varner Hilts was a member of the faction.

In 32 BBY, Darth Maul was ambushed by Tusken Raiders on the planet Tatooine. Maul, a Dathomirian Sith Lord, had been tasked by his Master, Darth Sidious, to eliminate Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi, the two Jedi who protected Queen Padmé Amidala, ruler of Naboo.

The Panthac was a Imperial Mandator III-class dreadnought. In 10 ABY, the Panthac and the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Whelm destroyed each other above the Core Worlds planet Alsakan during a battle part of the Imperial Civil War.

x: The Senate Subcommittee to Investigate Jedi Activity was a subcommittee set up within the Galactic Alliance Senate in 44 ABY.

x: The Parting Gift was a small, heavily armored, twelve-passenger Sandalso LuxiCruiser yacht in use in 44 ABY. In that year, the new Imperial Remnant Head of State Vitor Reige gave it to the previous Head of State, Jagged Fel as a gift.
The Fantasy in the Sky fireworks pageant was a regular celebration which took place on Cloud City, Bespin and revolved around the use of pyrotechnic displays.
a: Galaxy in the Skies Fireworks Pageant

x: JS-25 was a protocol droid that dwelled in the droid-run settlement X2-4 on the moon Uffel during the latter years of the Galactic Republic.
Y-2D0 was a protocol droid with computer-programming specialties that was part of a community of droids that resided on the moon Uffel during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

A planet was in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy. Its inhabitants were at war for centuries with the Niordi from the Niorde system, and eventually defeated the Niordi with help from hired merceneries from the Leech Legions.
IT-R9 was an IT-series droid that was based on the droid-operated moon Uffel during the latter years of the Galactic Republic.

A laboratory was located on the fringes of the Niorde system in Unknown Regions during the Clone Wars. It was here that the Niordi created their living weapons to defend their home planet of Niorde from the advances of the Leech Legions.
In-iK was a droid sent by the Gree to repair Coruscant during the Cold War.
A city was located on the planet Bal'demnic, containing Kon'meas Spaceport. In 67 BBY, the Muun Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Plagueis visited the city after killing his Bith master, Darth Tenebrous.

The Contispex dynasty was a ideological discourse of Supreme Chancellors who were adherers of the Pius Dea humanocentrism religious sect and presided over a theocratic authoritarian Galactic Republic for a millennium.

Imperial Depot was a supply depot used by the Galactic Empire on the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk. The Depot had two prefab shelters and a mech factory inside the walled enclosure, and was located south of the city of Tunnatutikan.

This humanoid species tended to be light blue in appearance. They had hairless heads except for sideburns across their cheeks. Their eyes tended to be mostly white, and they had relatively flat noses. They had a large stature, approximately twice that of the average Human.
This alien race were a species of insectoids to which Mzerc and his wife belonged.

The Flame of Sinthara was a cathedral ship in service to the Republic Navy during the Pius Dea Era. In 10,966 BBY, the Flame of Sinthara participated in the Battle of Uquine against the Jedi–Renunciate alliance.
The Mission to Kessel was a mission undertaken by R2-D2 and C-3PO on Kessel at the beginning of the Trioculus affair.

A six-eyed aquatic species dwelled in bodies of freshwater on the planet Naboo, in the Chommell sector of the Mid Rim. Such creatures were found in Lake Paonga, in the swamps near the city of Otoh Gunga.

N0-HX was an astromech droid that worked for Agent Fauler of the Republic Strategic Information Service. N0 worked as a messenger for Fauler during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, when the agent was stationed on Tatooine.
The Battle of Panna was fought between the pirates of Xer and the Kingdom of Cron in the Pre-Republic era, at the planet Panna.
The Battle of Chandaar was fought between the pirates of Xer and the Kingdom of Cron in the Pre-Republic era, at the planet Chandaar.
The Battle of Jhantoria was fought between the forces of the Xer's Empire, led by Xim, and the Livien League, at the planet Jhantoria. The battle ended in a decisive victory for Xim.
This battle was fought between Xim's empire and the Hutt Empire in the Xim Wars, at the Hutt-controlled world of Sleheyron.
The duel on Maryx Minor was a duel that occurred between Darth Vader and bounty hunter Boba Fett on Maryx Minor in 3 BBY.
This battle was an early confrontation in the Tionese War between the young Galactic Republic and the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion.

This battle was fought in the Tionese War between the young Galactic Republic and the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, over control of Roche. Coming off of their victory at Abhean, the Tionese were successful in conquering Roche as well.

This battle was contested in the Tionese War, between the young Galactic Republic and the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion. Coming off of victories at Abhean and Roche, the Tionese were successful in conquering Lantillies.

This battle was contested in the Tionese War between the young Galactic Republic and the Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion, over control of the Republic trade world of Tirahnn. Coming off of victories at Abhean, Roche and Lantillies, the Tionese succeeded in conquering Tirahnn.

Uthtara was a Mid Rim astronomical object located in the Eucer sector. During the Tionese War, it was the site of a Galactic Republic hyperspace jump-beacon that facilitated commercial interstellar travel to the celestial body Okator VIII.
Peshara was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Peshara system. It was situated in the Arrowhead region, a part of the Slice portion of the Core Worlds.

This battle was the concluding battle of the First Great Schism. With the Legions of Lettow crippled after the death of their leader, Xendor, and a crushing defeat on Columus, the Jedi, led by Jedi Master Awdrysta Pina, attacked Lettow in an attempt to finish their opponents off.

Irkalla was an astronomical object beyond the planet Kitel Phard where, at the end of the First Great Schism, Jedi Master Awdrysta Pina and Legions of Lettow leader Arden Lyn faced off. Pina suffered a mortal wound, but before dying, used morichro to stop Lyn's heart.
The Republic assault on Virujansi was a confrontation that took place in 17,018 BBY on the Inner Rim planet Virujansi.

result: Alsakan victory and liberation of the planet
x: The Alsakani liberation of Virujansi of the First Alsakan Conflict took place in 17,012 BBY. After the Galactic Republic assault on Virujansi six years earlier, the Alsakanis liberated the planet in this battle.

The Battle of Kes was a confrontation that took place in 16,921 BBY in the Core Worlds' Kes system. The system was situated on the hyperlane known as the Axis, between the Coruscant and Alsakan systems.
The First Siege of Porus Vida was a battle of the First Alsakan Conflict that took place in 16,820 BBY.
The Siege of Belasco was a confrontation that took place around 16,800 BBY at the Expansion Region world Belasco.
The Second Siege of Porus Vida was a battle of the Second Alsakan Conflict, fought between the Galactic Republic worlds Coruscant and Alsakan and their respective allies.

The Strontium Raid was a confrontation that took place in 15,480 BBY at the Mid Rim planet Abhean. The planet was situated along the portion of the super-hyperroute known as the Perlemian Trade Route that was under the control of Coruscant, the capital world of the Galactic Re…

result: The centerpiece of the Alsakan Mosaics destroyed
x: The Cleansing of Rucapar was a confrontation that took place in 14,450 BBY in the city of Rucapar on the Core Worlds planet Alsakan. The event saw the destruction of the centerpiece of the artwork known as the Alsakan Mosaics.

The Defence of Drogheda was a military engagement at the Wild Space planet Drogheda in 13,649 BBY, as part of the fourth of the Alsakan Conflicts between the planets Coruscant, Alsakan and their respective allies.
The Conquest of Manaan was a confrontation that took place in 13,220 BBY at the Inner Rim oceanic planet Manaan.
The Taï were the native sentient species of the planet Taypho.
The Sliiskiis was a sentient, insectoid species found in the galaxy. They had retractable pincers.
The Assorhians were the native sentient species of Assorhan.
Drez was an astronomical object in the Drez system of the Corva sector, which was part of both the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories.

The Organa Vinerium was a farm on the Core World of Alderaan. Located on the Apalis Coast, it served as the farm facilities for House Organa where they made their wine, and was served by the nearby Apalis Fields.

A military exploration ship affiliated with the Galactic Republic left on a mission to the Unknown Regions to search for Confederacy of Independent Systems supply planets during the Clone Wars. The ship stumbled upon the O'reen system and its main planet, O'reen.

result: O'reen isolates itself from the galaxy
x: The Jedi Knight Morningfire led the clone trooper Vornskr Company in a rescue on the planet O'reen in the Unknown Regions after the native species, the O'reenians, took the crew of a Galactic Republic military exploration ship as slaves; the starship had been combing the Unkno…
Pa Tho was an astronomical object located in the Inner Rim's Pa Tho system. It shared its name with the alien culture known as the Pa Tho, which had vanished at some point by 16 ABY.
Camp Karnori, also known as Espelar, was a settlement on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Outpost Largona, also known as Largona Outpost, was a settlement on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Largona
The Coruscant Merchants' Guild was a merchant group active by 11,987 BBY that shared its name with the galactic capital, the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.

ML-T2 was a droid that worked as a vendor on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. It maintained a shop in the Anchorhead market, where it constructed and sold armor.

RM-T2 was an astromech droid that worked on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. RM had a shop in the Anchorhead market, where it sold equipment commendations.
The Dustig Sector Forces were the Planetary Security Forces of the Galactic Republic's Dustig sector. By the year 34 BBY, they had been mired by corruption and neglect.

The Twin Suns was an interstellar pirate group active on the Outer Rim planet of Tatooine. Named after the system's twin suns Tatoo I and Tatoo II, it was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Arlionne was a Galactic Republic Victory I-class Star Destroyer that was a part of the Victory Fleet during the Clone Wars.

The Unrepentant was a Bulwark Mark I battlecruiser that served the Confederacy of Independent Systems as Admiral Dua Ningo's flagship in the Bulwark Fleet. The ship was destroyed during the Battle of Anaxes in 20 BBY.
The Biskaran Pirates originated in the Inner Rim's Biskar system. At some point by 35 BBY, they launched the siege of Niele.
The Safecrackers were an elite Republic Special Forces Division squad of troopers in the army of the Galactic Republic, who fought against the Sith Empire during the Cold War.
Hagamoor City was a city on Hagamoor 3. In 44 ABY, former Jedi Knight Tahiri Veila and bounty hunter Boba Fett visited this city.
The Kanduh were an ancient sentient species from the planet Kaldahan.
The Bah'r Kilido were a species pink-skinned humanoids with long faces and thin limbs. Their noses and chins were studded with a pair of short tusks. Suppoon was a member of this species.

The Stellar Halo was a battlecruiser that served as part of the Imperial-aligned Kuati Sector Forces during the Galactic Civil War, in which the Galactic Empire fought the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later its successor state, the New Republic.
The Aurora was a Star Dreadnought helmed by Admiral Teren Rogriss, serving in the Imperial-aligned Kuati Sector Forces.
Detention Center A was a Galactic Empire prison on the planet Kessel. The camp also consisted of five Imperial fortresses and other military buildings.

Detention Center C was a Galactic Empire prison on the planet Kessel. A Fortress was present in the base. After the Empire lost the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, it was decided to abandon Kessel and the atmosphere factories were shut down.
Detention Center B was a Galactic Empire prison on the planet Kessel. After the Empire lost the Battle of Endor in 4ABY, it was decided to abandon Kessel and the atmosphere factories were shut down.
The Oppressor was a Harrower-class dreadnought that served as the flagship of Darth Angral during the Cold War.
The Mission to Graador involved several operatives of the Alliance to Restore the Republic investigating Graador as a potential base for the Alliance Fleet following the Battle of Yavin.
A group of mynocks mutated and achieved sentience. On the planet Graador, these mynocks controlled exogorths.

The Attack on Porus Vida was a one-sided bombing of the Inner Rim world of Porus Vida by Colonel Ivan Cronus of the Imperial Remnant in the 13X and his fleet of Victory-class Star Destroyers, taking place in 12 ABY.
The Manarai Heights Spaceport was a spaceport located in the Manarai Heights district of Coruscant.

This species had chalk white skin, sunken black eye sockets, and fingers with one more joint than a Human finger. Their long fingers were used for drawing blood. The lifespan of this species was much longer than that of a human. Aurra Sing's father was a member of this species.
Mid Rim Operations Group was a subdivision of the Republic Strategic Information Service. It was placed under the command of Ardun Kothe around 3647 BBY.

A strike team of Republic Strategic Information Service personnel was active during the Galactic War. It was sanctioned by the Galactic Senate to operate autonomously to avert a second war and was placed under the command of Ardun Kothe.
Adjesk was a city on the planet of Corulag.
This felinoid race were native to the planet Garr'lst. They were massacred by the Human mercenary brigader Jarrow Rusher.

A non-sentient tusked creature lived on Endor, a forested moon orbiting the planet of the same name. This animal had a strong odor and was sometimes used as a bait by the native Ewoks, a species of bear-like furry bipeds.

The Event Horizon was a battlecruiser which was part of the Imperial-aligned Kuati Sector Forces in 8.5 ABY during the Galactic Civil War, a conflict fought between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later its successor state, the New Republic.

The Luminous was a battlecruiser and part of the Imperial affiliated Kuati Sector Forces in 8.5 ABY, at the time of the Galactic Civil War, in which the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later its successor state—the New Republic—fought against the Galactic Empire.
The Battle of Kelrodo-Ai was a battle of the Western Reaches Operation.
RE-M0, also referred to as Remo, was a droid created by Doctor Nasan Godera during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Ebenmal was a planetoid located in the Ebenmal system of the Mid Rim's Irnaj sector. It was on Ebenmal that a battle between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance was fought sometime between the years 2 and 1 BBY.
A battle was fought on the planetoid Ebenmal at some point between the years 2 BBY and 1 BBY. A group of Imperials, consisting of eighty-five jumptroopers, attacked the Citadel of Ebenmal.
The Ilthmar's Fist was a battlecruiser in the navy of the Galactic Empire. A part of Death Squadron, it participated in the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
The Yalor were the native sentient species of the planet Yaloris.
The Globlours were a sentient species native to a planet in the Outer Rim.
The Swonks were a reptilian sentient species.
The Glothians were a sentient species in the galaxy.
The Dargas were a Near-Human sentient species native to the red desert planet Zender.

Surprise Squadron was a New Republic starfighter squadron composed of RZ-1 A-wing interceptors. In 8.5 ABY, it participated in the Taking of Kuat by using ion torpedoes to disable four enemy starships in helping to capture Kuat Drive Yards.

The Damask Holdings superspire was the headquarters of Damask Holdings, the clandestine financial group founded by Hego Damask, a Muun who was secretly the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Plagueis, and who used the group to advance his political influence in galactic politics with…
The Third Battle of Aefao was fought at the world Aefao between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Darth Thanaton's meditation chamber was the personal chambers of Darth Thanaton. The chambers consisted of many rooms, however, its greatest detail was the large room in the middle, with a platform and many large Sith statues around it.

The First Battle of Plagen took place on the planet of Plagen between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic as the two sides clashed during the Clone Wars, which occurred from 22 BBY and 19 BBY.
A T-series tactical droid served the Confederacy of Independent Systems at the time of the Clone Wars, a galaxy-wide conflict between the Confederates and the Galactic Republic.

place: Initially Tatooine, later throughout the galaxy
x: The rakghoul pandemic was a massive outbreak of the rakghoul plague that occurred around a decade after the Treaty of Coruscant ended the Great Galactic War.

Aegel Squadron served in the Hapan Royal Navy in 44 ABY. The squadron consisted of Hapan Miy'til starfighters, and they assisted the New Jedi Order during the evacuation from the Jedi Academy on the planet Ossus after the academy came under attack by the Lost Tribe of Sith.
The Daphoros was one of the Hapan Battle Dragons belonging to the Hapan Royal Navy in 44 ABY under command of a female Hapan commander.

Denova was a planet in the Ojoster sector that consisted mostly of woods and high peaked mountains. Ancient ruins were noted to be present on the surface though details on them were largely undocumented.

The Subjugator was the first Subjugator-class heavy cruiser produced. Uniquely this vessel was armed with a Trihexalon launcher. During the Trihexalon attack on Coruscant, Mavra Zane and Chewbacca infiltrated the warship and sabotaged the main reactor, destroying the vessel.

4-SEN, or Foursen, was a droid who served Gorry and the Mantellian Separatist Movement on Ord Mantell during the Separatist War. He was stationed in the Separatist base's warehouse at Mannett Point when the smuggler known as Ace broke in and killed a number of soldiers there.
B2-T1 was a droid that could be found in Mos Ila on Tatooine.
B5-2T was an astromech droid residing on Tatooine during the Cold War that relayed to the Republic strike team a message from Satele Shan regarding the Republic Starship Allusis.

t: Duel in the Dark Council Chambers (Kaggath)
n: Duel in the Dark Council Chambers
result: Kallig anointed Darth Nox, elevated to the Dark Council
x: This duel took place during the Galactic War. It was the final confrontation between the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Thanaton and the Sith Lord Kallig.

The Glimmer of Hope was a starship that served in the navy of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Between 2 BBY and 4 ABY, Grand-engineer Lony Coleema was kidnapped by the IG-88 assassin droid IG-88 after providing information about the Galactic Empire to the Rebel Alliance.
The baspoor glider, also called the "sky swimmer" for its fish-like appearance, was an omnivorous flying amphibian found usually on temperate worlds, in particular on Belsavis.
A patrol cruiser belonged to the Malarian Alliance.

n: Duel in the Dark Council Chambers
result: The Emperor's Wrath is acknowledged by the Dark Council
x: A lightsaber duel took place during the Galactic War being the final confrontation between Darth Baras and the new Emperor's Wrath.

This four-armed alien race were blue-skinned humanoids with large heads and their V-shaped mouths gave them the appearance of a perpetual smile. Their homeworld's gravity was much less than standard, so they were confined to anti-grav chairs. Ellam was a member of this species.
Little Mochot was a location on the planet Tatooine. Tirs Maladane hailed from this place.
The Archer was a Tector-class Star Destroyer that was used by the navy of the Galactic Republic near the end of the Clone Wars. It was produced by Kuat Drive Yards and measured one mile in length.
The Aculeus was a Mandator III-class dreadnought that was part of the navy of the Galactic Empire and its short-lived successor, the Dark Empire.
The Javelin was a Vengeance-class dreadnought that served in the navy of the Galactic Empire and its short-lived successor, the Dark Empire.
In the aftermath of the Sacking of Coruscant in 3653 BBY, riots broke out across the Galactic Republic's capital planet Coruscant.
This city was the capital of the Mid Rim planet Eiattu 6. The city sat on one of the planet's oceans and contained the citadel of Eiattu's Imperial governor, Moff Leonia Tavira.
The Old Galactic Market Taxi Station was an air taxi station located in the Old Galactic Market on Coruscant.

This yacht belonged to Grand Vizier of the Galactic Empire Sate Pestage. Following the death of Emperor Palpatine at the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, Pestage used it to flee Coruscant when Director of Imperial Intelligence Ysanne Isard accused him of treason.

The Old Galactic Market Shipping and Receiving Docks was an area in the Old Galactic Market on Coruscant. In 3643 BBY it was the site of the Migrant Merchants' Guild armed insurrection against the Coruscant Security Force.

The Old Galactic Market Concourse was a major area of the Old Galactic Market on Coruscant that remained under Galactic Republic control in the aftermath of the Coruscant riots in 3653 BBY and the take over by the Migrant Merchants' Guild.

The Old Galactic Market Concourse Lounges were an area of the Old Galactic Market on Coruscant connecting the Taxi Station and Concourse Bazaar with the Shipping and Receiving Docks. The Dealer's Den Cantina was also located here.
The Old Galactic Market Concourse Bazaar was located in Concourse section of the Old Galactic Market on Coruscant.
The Old Galactic Market Concourse Staging Point was located in the Old Galactic Market on Coruscant between the Shipping and Receiving Docks and the Concourse section.
This humanoid race had six-fingered hands, a lanky build and severe-looking faces. Archyr Beil and Skeck Draggle were members of this species.
A Consular-class cruiser was owned by Noggox the Hutt during the Clone Wars. It was captured by the pirate Dool Pundar in 22 BBY.
Defiance's Banner was a starship that served as the flagship of the Sy Myrthian ex-senator Toonbuck Toora's Confederacy of Independent Systems holdout forces in the aftermath of the Clone Wars.
The Schiav were a sentient species. Standing at over two meters tall, they were distinguished by their tan-colored skin, long brown hair and two fangs projecting upward from their bottom jaws.

Grim Destiny was a bounty hunting team operating during the Galactic Civil War. It consisted of eight bounty hunters led by Garm Trodask. Grim Destiny was the team that pursued the Hutt gangster, Mennac, on the planet of Trendivar.
The Sith Sanctum was the Sith headquarters located on Dromund Kaas. The Sith Sanctum had many points of interests, including Darth Thanaton's private library and meditation chamber.

The Kabalian Cross was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that was a part of the navy of the Galactic Empire. Manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards and measuring 1,600 meters in length, it shared its name with the Mayagil sector planet Kabal and was in service around 13 BBY.
The Imperial News Network was a state news broadcasting organization under the Ministry of Intelligence operated by the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.
The Xyrass were a small, skeleton-like humanoid species from Tabor V.

The Krakana was a Viscount-class Star Defender that was used by the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Yuuzhan Vong War. In 27 ABY, the Krakana was ordered to travel to the planet Kuat, where the New Republic intended to use it as an orbital artillery battery.
The Sith Lord Count Dooku had headquarters on the planet Raxus Prime. It was destroyed during the Conquest of Raxus Prime in 22 BBY.

Ristal was a planet in the Kubilaï system. The colonel Ershack commanded a Rebel base on the planet sometime after the Battle of Yavin. After the disappearance of an Ytterbium cargo which was destined to the Rebel garrison on Hoth, he sent Rebel operatives to investigate.
The Snake's Guild was a pirate confederation which governed the planet Tabor V. Officially, the Guild reproved murders and crimes, but the local law enforcement was very soft in its action.
Aldorus IV was a mining planet in the Aldorus system.

The Shattered Ridge was a chain of mountains located on the planet Dathomir. The Nightsisters thought the melting of the snow on the slopes of the Shattered Ridge foreshadowed a mythical event known as the Wild Hunt.
Kaldahan (formerly known as Kanduh) was the home planet of the ancient Kanduh civilization.

An Orthar was a lizard-like creature, sporting a very thick fur and extreme resilience. It was used by the local populations as a mount in the frozen mountains of the planet of Shingra. One Orthar would cost 200 credits.
A Krodyur was a flat creature, sporting a white fur and a dreadful jaw. Extremely dangerous and hard to see in the mountain of Shingra—especially during the night—it would often attack the voyagers.
A Snow Siren was a creature living in the mountain of the planet Shingra. Similar to crabs, they hid under the snow and produced plaintive moans to attract voyagers in crevices.
Aldorus VI was a green gas giant in the Aldorus system.
The Doom Slayer was an experimental assassin droid built by Sythluss Leethe.

Glory of Kamgeddon was a cathedral ship that was used by the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a time of anti-alien crusades that were instigated by the Pius Dea faith that controlled the Republic. It shared its name with the Kamgeddon system.

Foless Spaceport Authority was an organization on the planet Foless. In 21 BBY, two of its officers investigated the arrival of the Jedi Nuru Kungurama, who had unknowingly traveled in the company of a slaver.

The Thyrsians were a subspecies of the Near-Human Echani originating from the Inner Rim world of Thyrsus, defined by their differing culture and almost polar-opposite appearance to the Echani. Thyrsians were also known for their role in the development of the Force pike.

The Shining Pathway was a cathedral ship that was used by the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era of anti-alien crusades by the Republic, which was under the sway of the Pius Dea religion at the time.

The Illorbion's Hammer was a cathedral ship that was used by the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a time of anti-alien crusades that were instigated by the Pius Dea faith that controlled the Republic.
Eerm was a serpentine predator from Dorin.
An erd was a domesticated predator often used as a sentry animal found on Ithor, a planet that was the homeworld of the Ithorian species. Some Ithorian males had "Erd" as a given name.
Isnr was a class of birds with vivid colors native to Cerea. It was a common name among Cerean females.
The battle of Obredaan was the penultimate engagement fought between the forces of the New Republic and Imperial Remnant during the Orinda campaign. The New Republic won the battle.

The Bloodshield was a legendary capital ship that was ancient by the time of the adoption of the starship classification scheme known as the Anaxes War College System during the Clone Wars of 22 BBY–19 BBY.
The Flanchard was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy.
The Hertae Home Brigade was a famous security force of the Hertae sector.
The Iseno Rangers were a famous security force of Iseno. They had a longstanding military tradition, though they were a largely ceremonial force.
The Greater Plooriod Wardens were a famous security force of the Greater Plooriod Cluster.
The Lantillian Planetary Security Forces was a famous security force of the planet Lantillies.
The Garde d'Azure was the security force of the Azure sector during the Old Republic. Their military prowess was such that it was known by the wider galaxy.
EV-6T6 was an EV-series supervisor droid who served as a droid supervisor.

The Pradeux was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that was a part of the navy of the Galactic Empire. Manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards and measuring 1,600 meters in length, it had a bridge that was outfitted with a communications tower and at least one ISD-72x deflector shield …

Orkana, also known as the Poisoned Land, was a heavily polluted territory on the planet Tatooine. It was the domain of Orko, a Hutt trader of the lower H'uun caste, and was the location of his palace.

A sentient species were predatory beings with red-colored carapace-like skin and a tooth-filled maw. Two members of the species at one point attacked the team of the Galactic Empire scientist Devlor Samt on a world that the former were not native to, being eventually killed th…

A XLT-014 labor droid was working on the cruise ship Galactic Breeze during the last years of the Galactic Republic. The droid was reprogrammed to enter information into the ship's computer in order for the ship to go to the wrong location.

A group of pirates were active during the last years of the Galactic Republic. Near the planet Bestine IV in the Inner Rim, the pirates captured the cruise ship Galactic Breeze with the help of an XLT-014 labor droid who was reprogrammed to cause the ship's computer to bring t…
The Utor Shock was a conflict that occurred in the vicinity of the Inner Rim's Utor system in which the Galactic Republic's Judicial Forces had a key role that took place in 602 BBY.

The Recusal was the Jedi Order's response to the Pius Dea Crusades. In 11,933 BBY, the Order decided that they could no longer associate themselves with the Pius Dea-controlled Galactic Republic, and that their actions against alien species were immoral.
This city was located on Sullust. At one point during its history, the city was saved by a local named Jubieck, who later became famous among Sullustans for this act.
A wonat was a kind of creature that moved silently due to its furred toe-pads. Around 10 BBY, while sneaking in the Trader's Luck starship, the young Human male Han Solo moved as silently as a wonat.
A large, hazardous asteroid field was located in the Krykas system, a part of the Mid Rim's Spirva sector. The terrestrial planet Krykas V was situated in the middle of the asteroid field.
The Grand Conclave was a ritual that was held by the Tarasin species on the planet of Cularin during the Clone Wars.
The Nakat Incursions was a border conflict that occurred in the 5130s BBY, in which the Mandalorian Crusaders harried a number of Galactic Republic settlements.
In 3962 BBY, Dorjander Kace and his Mandalorian Knights raided the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine during the Mandalorian Wars when the Mandalorians made an effort to kidnap young Jedi Padawans.

The Zambarti were lavender-hued humanoids with wide bodies and huge heads. Their eyes were shaped like saucers, and their hair resembled a slate-colored bird's nest. Their large ears were pink in coloration, and looked like wings. Members of this species had more than one heart.

x: The Dromund Kaas operation was a covert mission carried out by the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order in 3640 BBY, during the Galactic War against the Sith Empire, that saw the Republic Navy attack the Imperial capital planet of Dromund Kaas.
The Raid on Janara III was an Imperial attack on Janara III during the Great Jedi Purge.

The Great Zhell, later known as the city of Zhell, was an ancient settlement on the planet Notron, homeworld of the Taung and the Zhell species.

Vanahame was a moon in the Grumani sector in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Republic Dark Age, Vanahame was part of the Odionate, a Sith rump state ruled by the Sith Lord Odion.

Marrovian pigs were a type of pigs species that were native to the planet Marrovia. They were fed in giant farms before being processed in planet's rendering stations.

The secret underground tunnels beneath the planet Coruscant's underworld, were a well kept secret for thousands of years. During the Cold War, their existence was discovered.
During the Galactic Civil War, the Kubaz crime lord Schnil Hakoon maintained a headquarters on the planet Kirtania. The thief Pierce Mantrell broke into the building and stole the Amber Eye.

During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire established a work camp on the planet Kirtania for the purposes of harvesting valuable hardwoods from the rain forest. It was destroyed by Araquian tribesmen.

Thrawn's secret fortress was a secret fortress that Thrawn owned. When he started replacing people before they died with clones, he kidnapped the original person forcing them to live in this fortress.

Pineath were a species of sentient beings originating from the Unknown Regions. They had burgundy colored feathers. Their culture included a habit that if one of them was harmed by an outsider, they demanded another life in return.

Nagem Dr'Lar's salvage team was a salvage team led by the Selonian Nagem Dr'Lar during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, the team was on Yavin 4 collecting debris from the Death Star when they were attacked by Osae Meilea, a Sullustan in the service of the Hutt Cartel.
The Deference was a Pythar-class Imperial shuttlecraft that belonged to a scientist of the Sith Empire during the Great Galactic War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.
The 301st Infantry was a unit in the Republic Army's Infantry Division during the Cold War and the subsequent Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
In 29 BBY, Tarkin hosted a meeting with Sienar Fleet Systems' Chief Executive Officer Raith Sienar and assassin Ke Daiv in his apartment.

This sentient species was once native to Hijarna. They were the builders of the Fortress of Hijarna, which was their last point of defense against alien invaders. They were made extinct around that time.
The ghost cell was an organization of expert assassins and saboteurs that operated during the years of the Cold War.

The Aurodium Spoon was a place located in the city of Lola Curich on the planet Lianna. In existence by the year 67 BBY, the Aurodium Spoon was placed in a public square full of boutique shops and restaurants, with a pedestrian tunnel opening onto one side of the square.

A battle involving the Imperial Remnant took place near a world in 9 ABY as a part of the Thrawn campaign, with seven of the Imperial Remnant's Dreadnaught-class heavy cruisers commanded by Grand Admiral Thrawn attacking the planet's defenses.

Clan Farr was a Mandalorian clan that fought against the Jedi Knight Revan when the Mandalorians invaded the Galactic Republic during the Mandalorian Wars. During the Cold War they resided on the Sith Empire's capital of Dromund Kaas.

The Revanite compound was the headquarters of the Order of Revan, located on Dromund Kaas, capital of the Sith Empire, during the Cold War. The camp was set far off the beaten path along the Riverfall Wilds to prevent strangers from locating it or trespassing inside.

The Endar Rebirth was a Republic survey vessel in service during the Cold War. It was the first ship to investigate Taris, devastated by orbital bombardment three centuries previous, as a candidate for resettlement by the Republic.

The isolation chambers were hidden rooms housed in the subterranean galleries beneath the temples on Yavin 4 built by Naga Sadow. Their purpose was to host the Massassi warrior Kalgrath, who was put in hibernation in 3996 BBY.
T9-N9 was a astromech droid during the Cold War. It was owned by the Revanite Torrun, who resided in the Revanite compound in the planet of Dromund Kaas.
The ancient city established by the Je'daii Order to support Vur Tepe was located on the planet Tython. It was in ruins by the time of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Gnarls Outpost was a Jedi base located in the Tythonian Gnarls on the planet Tython during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
A cave tunnel connected the Tythos Ridge of mountains and the region known as the Tythonian Gnarls to the north on the planet Tython.

Sometime after the Morodins established a colony on the planet of Varonat, an ecological disaster struck their homeworld. The event resulted in the Morodins being unable to grow their organic space vessels, which led to the colony on Varonat being cut off from the homeworld.

A village loyal to the Royal House of Naboo was located on the planet Naboo near the city of Spinnaker. The village was bordered by a river from its western to its southern side and contained natural resources such as trees, nova crystals, and ore deposits.

Joy was a city on Korbin. Like other cities on the planet, such as Pleasant City, Happy, and Peace, it was controlled by criminals who gave it its name, though conditions were not as severe as in Pleasant City. Because of this and its small size, Joy was known as a Small-Timer.

Peace was a city on Korbin. Like other cities on the planet, such as Pleasant City, Happy, and Joy, it was lawless and controlled by criminals who cynically gave it its upbeat name, though conditions were not as severe as in Pleasant City.

A green-skinned, yellow-eyed, quadripedal species of creatures with long snouts lived on the planet Bri'ahl. In 19 BBY, one such creature considered eating the discarded head of the protocol droid C-3PO, but ultimately decided against it and tossed the head down a hill.

The 2,367th annual Priole Danna Festival was held in 0 ABY in Gryle City on the planet Lamuir IV. The 2,367th incarnation of the Priole Danna Festival, it was celebrated by beings drawn from all over the galaxy.
Dustbin was an R5-series astromech droid used as a navigator by Voort saBinring during Wraith Squadron's mission to apprehend corrupt Galactic Alliance General Stavin Thaal on Kuratooine in 44 ABY.

Fuzzy was an R2-series astromech droid who served as Myri Antilles's navigator during Wraith Squadron's mission to the planet Kuratooine to apprehend corrupt Galactic Alliance General Stavin Thaal for his involvement with the Lecersen Conspiracy.

Vacuum was the name given to the protocol droid owned by Zehrinne Thaal by 44 ABY. He was given this name because Thaal had the droid's vocal synthesizers removed when she bought him so that she wouldn't have to listen to him whenever he served her.
The Pius Dea Spaceport was a spaceport located on the galactic capital world of Coruscant during the Galactic Republic's reign.

The Gerrard V military was the local defense force of Gerrard V. In 0 BBY, segments of the military, including General Camon Udeon, staged an uprising on the planet, seizing the capital city of Harazod.

The Gerrard V Rebels was partly formed by segments of the Gerrard V military, and comprised both ground troops and starships. In 0 BBY, they staged an uprising on Gerrard V, seizing the planetary capital of Harazod.
During the Galactic Civil War, Nada Synnt controlled an organization of smugglers. One of his operatives was Danken.
The Bethal Commerce Council was responsible for Bethal's economic wellbeing. Rall Teedra headed the council during the Galactic Civil War.

Alabar was a city on the planet Esseles. Esselian New Order Party leader Jamson Freller held a press conference in the city urging incumbent president Cambira Ralle to step down due to his failing health.

The Zethusian plains were located on the planet Kamori. The cities of Hyra, Jandal and Kimora City were situated on the Zethusian plains. In 1 ABY, a series of groundquakes damaged the cities and caused thousands of deaths.
Hyra was a city on the planet Kamori. It was damaged by groundquakes in 1 ABY.
Jandal was a city on the planet Kamori. It was damaged by groundquakes in 1 ABY.
Grovner was a principal city on the planet Ord Grovner.

The Ord Grovner Naval Base was an Imperial naval facility located at Ord Grovner. The Victory-class Star Destroyers Bombard and Crusader returned to the base after dealing with the Eyttyrmin Batiiv pirates.

Diab was a planet located within the Diab system of the Wild Space. Its sixth moon was orbited by the secret Jedi prison known as the Prism. Diab's electrical storms wreaked havoc with sensors and no transmissions were allowed in or out of the prison.

The Imperial Palace Guard was a division of the Imperial Military tasked with guarding the Imperial Palace. During the first New Year Fete Week after the Battle of Yavin, the Imperial Palace Guard was the first display unit in the traditional parade.
The Brella Temior crisis was an incident that occurred during the Imperial Era. It shared its name with the Brella Temior system, a star system located in the Barma sector of the Colonies.

Central Sector was a district in the city of Amma on the planet Bacrana. In 1 ABY, a large riot against Imperial forces occurred in the area, mainly around Central Sector Square.
Central Sector Square was located within Central Sector in the city of Amma on Bacrana. It was the site of a fierce clash between demonstrators and Imperial forces in 1 BBY.

The Shaldania Parade was the traditional opening to the New Year Fete Week, featuring floats, bands and a procession of military regiments from all over the Galactic Empire. The Imperial Palace Guard took part in the parade as the first unit to march.

Elshandruu City was located on Elshandruu Pica, a planet situated in the Outer Rim Territories. The city contained the resort hotel Margath's on Elshandruu Pica, which was robbed in 1 ABY by the intergalactic jewel thief Tombat.
A battle occurred after negotiations about disrupted mining rights in the Rettna system between Freda and Jante collapsed.
The Sundari Flatlands was a region on the planet Balmorra. During the Great Galactic War and the Cold War, it was a hotly contested area because of the Balmorran Arms Factory's location there.
The Surgeons was a Republic Special Forces black ops squad that operated during the Great Galactic War against the Sith Empire.
A colony of the Chagrian species existed on the planet Mindor during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Territory Administration was one of the divisions headed by a Viceprex in the Corporate Sector Authority. The division worked with the other divisions to shape the Authority's general policies into a business plan administered by territory.
During his time as a Galactic Republic statesman, the Alderaanian noble Eckhorn Baliss owned a personal ship that could carry at least one person.
The Skirmish on Carlac occurred around 21 BBY during the Clone Wars

A starship was owned by the Muun Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Plagueis in the years before his death in 32 BBY. He flew it with his personal droid 11-4D and used it for missions to places such as Abraxin and Naboo on missions to find Naat Lare and to kill Ars Veruna respectively.

The Farlek was a species of four-legged, predatory creature. They stood at a height of about 2 meters and were 4 meters in length, and they were covered in green, scaly plates. They also had wide, armored heads and long, sticky-tipped tongues, which they used to catch their prey.
The Ma'alkerrite ape-men were an ape-like sentient species hailing from the Ma'alkerr system of the Mid Rim. They had contact with the galaxy by the time of the Galactic Civil War.

This near-human race was native to Pitann. They were short and barrel-chested, with large, muscular arms and legs, and dark, leathery skin. Since their homeworld had a higher gravity than Dayark, they seemed to bounce when they walked. Sho'ban Do was a member of this species.
In 25 ABY, a lightsaber duel was fought on the planet Belkadan between Jedi Master Mara Jade Skywalker and Yuuzhan Vong agent/warrior Yomin Carr.

During the Galactic Civil War, a village on the planet Karra was visited by Doctor Elth Nardah and a team of Alliance to Restore the Republic agents. They hoped to broker a treaty with the native Karrans, led by Tist.
The Alliance Diplomatic Corps was the branch of the Alliance to Restore the Republic tasked with dealing with friendly states and potential allies. It was under the control of the Ministry of State.
The Sith Empire maintained a small outpost, where they held prisoners of war during the Great Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
Momansi Belt was an asteroid belt in the Expansion Region.

Timas were a species middle-sized, two-legged critters found on the world of Naboo, a terrestrial planet located within the Chommell sector. Their had reptavian traits and somewhat resembled the kaadu, another creature also native to Naboo.
The Javelin Dreadnaught was a warship conceived by the Imperial Science Bureau during the Cold War for Darth Mekhis, the head of the Sphere of Technology at the time.
Yellowblade's Landing was a settlement on the ice world Orto Norwe which was controlled by the criminal gang known as the Scourge.
