A battle took place in the Gamor system during the Great Sith War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, in 3996 BBY. The Republic ultimately emerged victorious.

A battle in Yablari system occurred in the Great Sith War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, in 3996 BBY. At Yablari, the two sides fought with the Sith emerging as the victors.

Moorjhone was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, within the Jospro sector and was the homeworld of felinoid Moorjhoni. It was in a trinary star system. It was normally lit and heated by two of the three suns at a given time.
Crescent Canyon was a massive canyon located in the northern Clabburn Tundra on the planet Hoth, separating the Whiterock Wastes and Highmount Ridge.
The Valiant was a Valor-class cruiser that served as the flagship of Admiral Dabrin of the Republic Navy during the Galactic War with the reconstitited Sith Empire.
The Starship Graveyard was a region on the planet Hoth that was home to the remains of dozens of ships that had been shot down during the Battle of Hoth in 3665 BBY.

Kuratooine was a planet in Wild Space. Though it was home to several Galactic Alliance Army bases and a Galactic Alliance embassy, it was not officially part of the Alliance and continued to maintain its own system of laws and its own government. Its capital was Kura City.

Xesh Squad was a unit in the Special Forces Division of the Republic Military during the Cold War with the Sith Empire.

objective: Isolated event

The Redshifter was a XS stock light freighter owned by the smuggler Nico Okarr during the years before the Great Galactic War. He claimed it was the "fastest ship in the sector".

Clan Lok was a Mandalorian clan in existence prior to the start of the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Yaga drone was a subspecies of the Yaga, created through genetic engineering following the rise of the Galactic Empire.
The Nociv were a subspecies of the Kadrillian species.

x: The Battle of Vanahame was a battle during the New Sith Wars which occurred on the planet Vanahame in 1032 BBY. Earlier, Sith Lord Odion had acquired the Helm of Ieldis, an ancient Sith artifact from the planet Skarpos.
The Hot Streak was a Z-95 Headhunter that was owned by the Duros gambler Kelna Toodo during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Akmalla was a port town on a planet that was situated close to Hutt Space. During the waning years of the Galactic Republic, the run-down cantina The White Door operated in the town.
The Radiant Splendor was a SoroSuub Barzo cargo freighter that was flown during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
The Sith Emperor's power base was a group of individuals and organizations that existed to serve the will of the Emperor of the reconstituted Sith Empire in whatever fashion he desired.

Attichitcuk's camp was a settlement built by the Wookiee Attichitcuk on the moon Alaris Prime at some point between 39 BBY and 36 BBY, during his group's colonization attempt of the moon. The camp was built in a small forest clearing and only had four buildings.

When the Jedi Knight Tasiele Shan was exiled by the Jedi Order for challenging their views on marriage and attachment, she was sent to an unnamed planet in the Outer Rim Territories in order to meditate on her controversial views.
This sentient reptilian species had blue skin. Jedi Master Judd was a member of this species.

The Coruscant Security Special Investigation Panel was a panel of officials in the Coruscant Security Force, which operated on the planet Coruscant during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Bosthirda separatists were a Human-based organization that tried to secede their homeworld of Bosthirda from the reconstituted Sith Empire; in truth they were only thralls of the Dark Councilor Darth Xedrix, who used them in his machinations.
Citlik IV was a planet in the Citlik sector of the Expansion Region.
Core World Operations Group was a subdivision of the Republic Strategic Information Service in the Core Worlds.
The Sphere of Biotic Science, also known as the Ministry of Biotic Science and the Pyramid of Biotic Science, was one of the twelve Spheres of Influence within the reconstituted Sith Empire.

x: The Sphere of Defense of the Empire, also known as the Ministry of Defense and the Pyramid of Defense, was one of the twelve Spheres of Influence within the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Anthus was a planet in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim.
Zelaba was a planet in the Outer Jalor sector of the Mid Rim.

Katalla was a planet in the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim. It was a casino world considered to be a respite from conflict. During the Clone Wars, the Besadii clan had a money funneling scheme with the Separatists.
J'Pel was one of the many mining settlements established on the planet Goroth Prime.
The Jran were small Non-sentient predators which preyed on the tiny Wenton creatures, if they could catch one.

A group of marauding Dark Jedi were known to roam the Elrood sector a few years before the Invasion of Naboo. Their raids were brought to an end when the Jedi Knight Jorus C'baoth intervened, leading a strike team of fellow Knights in the sector.
The Sarissa was a dreadnought that served the Galactic Empire by guarding the Candoras sector's Poln system as part of the sector's fleet.

The Indupar Nova was a corvette that saw service during the reign of the Galactic Empire. At some point during the Galactic Civil War, the Indupar Nova was attacked by the Rebel privateer vessel Free Lance in the Ec Pand system while it was carrying the noblewoman Lady Kalena …
Melldia was a planet located in the Melldia system of the Outer Rim Territories's Esstran sector. In 3950 BBY, the Sith Lord Darth Nyriss claimed to be "the destroyer of Melldia."

Hallion was a planet located in the Sith Worlds of the Outer Rim. The planet featured lava fields that produced obsidian, and decorative spheres made of polished obsidian from the lava fields were prized for their dark luster.
Hidden Tegoor was a planet located in the Albanin sector of the Outer Rim.

Vardoss IV, also known simply as Vardoss, was a celestial body located in the Vardoss system, a part of the Expansion Region's Vardoss sector. A hyperlane linked it to the Horob system as well as the Neshei system of the neighboring Neshei sector.

The Brell Sediment was a region on the planet Taris, named after Lake Brell. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Taris Resettlement Initiative and the Republic Military maintained Waypoint Station Draay near Lake Brell, and a colony was b…

The 501st Legion was a stormtrooper unit in the Empire of the Hand military. The original 501st Legion, an elite unit composed primarily of clone soldiers from the Jango Fett template, was indirectly involved in the creation of the unit that shared the same designation.

During the Cold War, between Sith Empire and Galactic Republic, a battle occurred above the planet Kovor when an Imperial fleet, led by the starfighter ace Tervor "Riptide" Jheran, ambushed a Republic patrol.

The Conraddas Vindicator was a white-hulled starfighter carrier with orange markings that served in the Republic Navy during the Great Galactic War against the Sith Empire.

Kovor was a planet where a battle occurred during the Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and Galactic Republic, which the latter won thanks to the intervention of the Coruscant Aegis squadron.
Hilo was a planet located in the Hilo sector of the Expansion Region.
Llewebum was a planet located in the galaxy. It was home to a species of the same name. It was a member of the New Republic.
Daronak was a terrestrial planet located in the Daronak system, a part of the Phelleem sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the site of Channoga Boulevard.
C2-N2, also known as Seetoo Enntoo, was a Hollis-series steward droid produced by Automata Galactica and owned by the Jedi Knight known as the Hero of Tython.

t: Hero of Tython's Defender-class light corvette
x: The Jedi Knight known as the Hero of Tython owned a Defender-class light corvette during the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

In 137 ABY, a meeting of Codru-Ji clan leaders was called by clan chief Rikkar-Du. The Sith of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire was attempting to annex the Codru-Ji homeworld of Munto Codru and had approached Rikkar-Du to unite the clans under his rule.

A tribe of shamanistic Ortolans lived on the Ash Plains of Lenico IV during the Great Galactic War. Around 3678 BBY, the Ortolan's village was visited by the Sith apprentice Exal Kressh, who learned their Force techniques and then proceeded to massacre the members of the tribe.
The Jedi Restoration Concord was an organization founded by the Jedi Master Syo Bakarn around 3653 BBY, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Imperial Military attacked a base of the Republic-aligned mercenary group known as the Fist of Justice on Droxine.

The Naos Asteroid Belt was situated in the Naos system, in the Slice portion of Wild Space. At some point, a fortress in the asteroid belt was inhabited by Dathka Graush, a Sith King who ruled on the distant planet Korriban around 7000 BBY.

The Coruscant Court of Appeals were the appeals court of the planet Coruscant. They were located at the Coruscant Court of Appeals building in the Administrative Sector. Many of the judges were killed during a terrorist attack in 22 BBY.

The Coruscant Central Court were the central court of the planet Coruscant. They were located at the Coruscant Central Court building in the Administrative Sector. Many of the judges were killed during a terrorist attack in 22 BBY.
Chelleya was an astronomical object located within the Chelleya system of the Outer Rim Territories' Seswenna sector.
A skirmish occurred on Christophsis around 22 BBY. Yoda fought B1-series battle droids by leaping from one STAP to another.
The Northern Jundland Plateau was a region in the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine, located on the western edge of the area known as the Deathly Heat.
Outpost Thorazan was a Galactic Republic outpost in the Dune Sea region of Tatooine during the Cold War with the Sith Empire.
The Ur'kossags were a criminal gang on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Marsune's base was a base located in the Gungan Swamp on the planet Naboo that belonged to the rogue male Gungan Captain Marsune. Sometime prior to 3000 BBY, Boss Gallo of Otoh Sancture visited the base and traded Marsune five nerfs for four glurrg workers.
The Zabrak Army was the local Planetary Security Forces of the planet Iridonia.
The Fallon was a shuttle used by Boba Fett during his hunt of the squad hired by Governor Purton to kill him in 1 BBY.

The Gungan Sling Brigade was a quartet of Gungan performance artists who practiced sling painting. Each of them wore an outfit and a mask the hue of which matched one of the four primary colors and were nicknamed accordingly: Red, Yellow, Blue and Green.
Arbular was an astronomical object located in the Arbular system, a part of the Lambda sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim.
Horos was a celestial body that was located in the Horos system, a part of the Lambda sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It shared its name with the hyperlane known as the Horos Spine.

The kittle (plural: kittles) was a small species of felines kept as personal companions or house pets. They were regarded as cute, and had a cat-like growl. Through the process of bioengineering, beast masters were able to incubate kittles by using their DNA.

A mining settlement was located on the planet Taronda. During the Clone Wars, it was attacked by Asajj Ventress and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, who hoped to divert the Galactic Republic's attention from claiming Taronda's raw materials.
Caulbon was an astronomical object located in the Caulbon system, a part of the Western Reaches portion of the Inner Rim.
Esaga was an astronomical object located in the Esaga system, a part of the Esaga sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim.
The Alsakan Lowlands was a region of the planet Alderaan that lay east of the Apalis Coast and west of the Juran Mountains and King's Pass.
Mikaster III was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Mikaster system, a part of the Mikaster sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region.
The Battle of Mikaster III was a battle of the Clone Wars on the planet Mikaster III. During the battle, Octuptarra combat tri-droids released deadly bioweapon against the clone troopers.

The Secure Vaults was the term applied to the northern region of the High Security Section on Belsavis. It contained several Rakata vaults, including Vault S-31.

The High Security Section was a district of the Republic prison complex on the planet Belsavis during the Cold War. It was primarily used to contain criminals of alien species, and Project Noble Focus performed most of its research on the High Security Section's inmates.

Varactyl Vale was a valley in the Minimum Security Section on the planet Belsavis. Named after the varactyls who made their home in the trees there, the Vale contained a Rakata vault designated Vault K-23, as well as the caverns of the Condemned and Guardposts Alpha and Beta.
The Minimum Security Section was one of the main districts of the Republic prison complex on the planet of Belsavis.
The Maximum Security Section was one of the main districts of the Belsavis prison, a Galactic Republic prison on the planet of Belsavis.
The Ancient Prison Approach was a volcanic rift spanned by a bridge located in the Maximum Security Section on Belsavis.

MaxSec Operations Access was an access road from the High Security Section on the planet Belsavis to the Maximum Security Section, linking the Secure Vaults region with the Maximum Security Ops Center.

The Outer Depths was one of the three main caves in the Ancient Prison Caverns on the planet Belsavis, and the Outer Depths linked the eastern end of the Maximum Security thoroughfare to the Power Center cavern.
The Gorinth Canyon was a large system of ravines on the planet Balmorra, located near the city of Sobrik.

Pulassas Minor was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Pulassas Minor system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Koradin sector. At some point prior to the Battle of Yavin, a Galactic Empire TIE fighter squadron was ordered to bombard civilian targets on Pulassas Minor.
Capitol Square was a region in the western part of the Government District in Coronet City, the capital of the planet of Corellia.
Serenity Valley was a valley in the Old Paths region of Voss. The Shrine of Healing was located at the northern end of the valley.

The Old Paths was a region on the planet Voss that lay to the west of the mountaintop city of Voss-Ka. The Shrine of Healing was located in the Old Paths, as well as several Voss outposts and ancient ruins dating from before the Voss and the Gormak split into separate species.
The Condemned were the individuals who were descendants of prisoners on the Republic prison planet Belsavis.
The Sphere of Expansion and Diplomacy, also known as the Ministry of Expansion and Diplomacy and the Pyramid of Expansion and Diplomacy, was one of twelve Spheres of Influence of the Sith Empire.
The Sphere of Laws and Justice, also known as the Ministry of Laws and Justice and the Pyramid of Laws and Justice, was one of twelve Spheres of Influence of the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Sphere of Production and Logistics, also known as the Pyramid of Production and Logistics, was one of twelve Spheres of Influence of the Sith Empire. Headed by a Dark Councilor, the Sphere oversaw the Ministry of Logistics.

After the defeat of the Sith Emperor during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Jedi Knight known as the Hero of Tython was awarded the Cross of Glory along with the other members of the Jedi's crew by Grand Master Satele Shan and Admiral Da…
The Galactic Princess was a freighter captained by the Gran Oobolo in 44 ABY. Oobolo ran a gambling operation on board the ship as a cover for his criminal activity.

The mind healer's grove, also known as the Spirit Healers' grove, was a cave on the Russet Slopes of the Old Paths on the planet Voss. The cave was home to ancient ruins, and was used by the spirit healers and dream-walkers of the Voss.
The Sith Emperor of the resurgent Empire owned a shuttle among the private craft reserved for his use.

The Biochemical Industrial District was a district in the Labor Valley region on the planet Corellia. It was the location of several companies, including Ardus Industries, the Corellian Chemical Corporation, the Beharen Droid Factory, and the Saxan Chemical Refinery.
Entertainment Plaza was a district in Red Light Sector of Coronet City's Blastfield Shipyards. The Rusty Freighter Cantina and the Gilded Descent Casino were both located in the area.

A mission was undertaken by Galactic Alliance Security agent Myri Antilles in 44 ABY to the freighter Galactic Princess to investigate whether the ship's captain, the Gran Oobolo, was engaging in criminal activity.

The Markaran Plains were a region on the planet Balmorra. The Jacent Valley was located in the plains, and both the Sith Empire and the Balmorran resistance maintained several outposts in the area at various points during the battle for control of the planet.

The Jacent Valley was a canyon located on the Markaran Plains on the planet Balmorra. During the occupation of Balmorra by the Sith Empire, the Imperial Military maintained an outpost called Camp Jacent in the valley.
Shad-Ka Outpost was a Voss commando outpost on the southern edge of the Nightmare Lands on the planet Voss.

Ken-La Outpost was an outpost of the Voss commandos in the Old Paths region of the planet Voss. The Republic Military also maintained a significant presence there, basing most of its operations in the region at the outpost.
The Russet Slopes was a wooded area in the Old Paths region of the planet Voss. The hills were home to many nexu, and the Voss commandos maintained Ken-La Outpost on the northern slopes.

A vorantikus was a large bipedal non-sentient species native to the planet Voss. The Gormak experimented on vorantiki to create monstrous cybernetic war beasts, and the dark side entity Sel-Makor corrupted a vorantikus into the servant known as the Gormak Guardian.
The Flamewood was a wooded area in the Old Paths region of the planet Voss, notable for its populations of nexu and mawvorr.

The Volcanic Trench was a section of the Glacial Fissure on the planet Hoth notable for the geothermal vents that lined its floor. The White Maw pirates controlled the Trench as they did much of the region.

Mawvorr, also known as crysfangs, were a hostile, non-sentient species native to the planet Voss. The four-legged, multicolored creatures were primarily found in the Old Paths and the Nightmare Lands, where they were especially abundant in the Flamewood and Crysfang Glade area…

The Belsavis Prison Administration Center was the main headquarters for the Galactic Republic's prison complex on the planet Belsavis. Warden Playt's offices were located there, and the only official shuttles off of Belsavis departed from the Administration Center.
The Tromper Crags was the mountain ridge that formed the eastern side of Highmount Ridge on the planet Hoth, bordering the Glacial Fissure on its eastern side.
Orinda's moon was the natural satellite of the planet Orinda.

During the last years of the Cold War, a Republic Valor-class cruiser and a large complement of Liberator-class starfighters was sighted over the Imperial-aligned agricultural world of Nez Peron, challenging the Sith Empire's authority.

Prospera Jang was a celestial body located in the Prospera Jang system, a part of the Kurost sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim.

The Assault on Vardoss IV was a famous battle won by the Galactic Empire on Vardoss IV. It was the final battle of the Ciutric Offensive, a campaign of the Reconquest of the Rim that took place in 19 BBY.
Bid'jerma was a planet located in the Prefsbelt sector of the Outer Rim.

A battle between the New Republic and an enemy force took place on the planet Rirsack during or before 13 ABY. Due to the bravery and brilliant tactics of Lieutenant Lar Ndigo, the New Republic emerged victorious.
The Ministry of Intelligence was one of three main divisions of the reconstituted Sith Empire. The Ministry of Intelligence answered to the Sphere of Imperial Intelligence.

During the Cold War between the forces of the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, a battle occurred in the Llanic system. In this remote region of space the Empire constructed a secret space station, where were studied biological weapons.

The city on the hills was a city on the planet Teardrop. Around 0.5 ABY the Rebel Alliance had a base there, but it was evacuated only moments before Imperial-class Star Destroyer Reprisal arrived to punish the Rebels.
The squad under the command of the Chagrian sergeant Fideltin Rusk was a unit within the Republic Military's 301st Infantry during the Cold War with the Sith Empire.

A silver protocol droid served as a translator for Spearmaster Ch'Unkk, a Whiphid who sat on the Imperial Interim Ruling Council in 11 ABY. The protocol droid witnessed Ch'Unkk get gunned down by Council head Xandel Carivus's Private Guard.
The Intercessor was a Valor-class cruiser in the service of the Republic Navy that participated in multiple battles during the Great Galactic War against the Sith Empire.
The Deliverance was a Republic cruiser that served in the Republic Navy during the Great Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The chambers of Burr Nolyds, head of the Imperial Interim Ruling Council, were located in a villa in the city of De-Purteen on the planet of Ord Cantrell. They were destroyed in 11 ABY along with Nolyds when a message disk left by Yuuzhan Vong Executor Nom Anor self-destructed.
The Starbreeze was the personal Mu-type shuttle of Colonel Laren Omas of the Republic Army's Special Forces Division during the Great Galactic War.
A unit under the command of the Duros Sergeant Bedd was a squad in the Republic Military during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Padawan birthday ritual was a Jedi tradition in the last years of the Galactic Republic. Taking place on a Padawan's thirteenth birthday, the apprentice would reflect on the past and receive a special gift from their Master.
C-6RR, also known as Sixer, was Class-six protocol droid in the possession of the Balmorran resistance fighter Numen Brock around 3642 BBY during the time of the Galactic War.
Socco was a planet in the Outlier systems of the Corellian sector.
Kraten was a planet in the Outlier systems of the Corellian sector.

Vorn tigers were a non-sentient feline species native to the planet Alderaan. They were one of the numerous species of predators of Alderaan, distinguished by their distinctive horns and covered by a blue, sleek fur.

Diab 6 was the sixth moon orbiting the planet Diab within the Diab system of the Wild Space. It was orbited by the secret Jedi prison known as The Prism. Diab's electrical storms wreaked havoc with sensors and no transmissions were allowed in or out of the prison.
Delphon IV was a planet located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim.
Delphon 7 was a planet located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim.
Regosh was a moon of Delphon IV, located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim.

Zosha was an uninhabited planet that orbited a bluish star in the Unknown Regions' Zosha system. A white-colored celestial body loomed large in Zosha's sky, and the planet itself appeared gray, blue, and white from space.

During the later years of the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, a squad of troopers from the Republic Military attacked an Imperial outpost in order to rescue prisoners of war.

Pleem's Nexus was a planet located in the Mezeg sector of the Mid Rim.
The Battle of Ranroon was fought between the forces of Xim the Despot and Queen Hylei Indrexu Cortess for the control of the planet Ranroon. The battle ended by a victory for Xim.

The Moisture Farmers of Tatooine organization was formed by moisture farmers by 4 ABY. In that year, one moisture farmer, Ardon Crell, represented the others in paying the desert planet Tatooine's Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure for protection from the planet's Tusken Ra…
Local 253 was a sector of the Moisture Farmers of Tatooine, an organization of moisture farmers that was formed by 4 ABY.
Holstrum Talent Agency was a recruitment front for the Alliance Intelligence that operated on Beltrix III during the Galactic Civil War. Keth Beamis worked as a scout for the Holstrum Talent Agency.

The Zed'hoffa Orbital Diving Competition was an extreme sport competition hosted over the Living Pits on Boonta during the Imperial Period to attract more Human colonists to the planet that could not podrace.

The Office of the Auditor-General was a department of the Corporate Sector Authority led by the Auditor-General and Assistant Auditor-Generals. Dagmar Vozda and Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla were both members of the Office of the Auditor-General.
A celestial body located in the Inner Rim, Brightday was the site of the Second Battle of Brightday during the 7811 BBY conflict known as the Waymancy Storm.

Hettitite was a planet that was located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Dalonbian sector in the Outer Rim Territories region of the galaxy. It was the homeworld of a sentient Near-Human species that had pale skin, white hair, and red eyes.
The Republic superweapon initiative was a weapons research and development program started by the brilliant Galactic Republic scientist Doctor Nasan Godera during the Great Galactic War.
During the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, a battle was fought on the planet Kalandis Seven.

Ord Hout was a world located in the Ord Hout system. It was situated in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Ord Celbus was a world located in the Ord Celbus system, a part of the Karthakk sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Ord Ivarn was a world located in the Ord Ivarn system, a part of the Hakartha sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Expansion Region.
Ord Gallapraxis was an Ordnance/Regional Depot in the Expansion Region. It was colonized by the Galactic Republic sometime before the Pius Dea Era.
Ord Carpagia was a world located in the Carpagia system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies.
Ord Marsax was an Outer Rim Territories world located in the Belderone sector. During the Pius Dea Era, it served as a Galactic Republic outpost.
Ord Lonesome was a world located in the Ord Lonesome system, a part of the Albanin sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Ord Fanthal was a world located in the Ord Fanthal system, a part of the Ojoster sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Ord Pentala was a world located in the Ord Pentala system of the Inner Rim's Western Reaches portion. Ord Pentala served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY, des…
Ord Zynthar was a world located in the Ord Zynthar system. It was situated in the Lambda sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim.

Operations Division was the primary branch of Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire. Headed by Keeper, the division oversaw the actions of Cipher Agents and all other active Intelligence operations.

The Fifty-third Armored Platoon was a unit within the Republic Army that served in the Battle of Corellia against the Sith Empire.
The Eighty-first Infantry was a division in the Republic Infantry during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Advanced Product Research Sector was a district in the Labor Valley region of Corellia's capital Coronet City. Corellian Industries maintained a factory and a laboratory in the region, though both were captured by the Sith Empire during the Battle of Corellia.
A funeral was held in 20 BBY at the Jedi Temple for Jedi Master Halsey, who had been killed on Devaron by the Nightbrother Savage Opress during a battle at the Temple of Eedit.

In 3017 BBY, Corellian privateers launched an attack on the planet Alsakan during the Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict. The battle saw the destruction of squadrons of Alsakan battleships by Corellia's frigates.

Possums were bipedal, reptilian creatures hailing from the fourth moon of Yavin Prime. They possessed devices resembling goggles over their eyes.

Tatrang I was a hot rock planet with no moons that was located within the Tatrang system, a part of the Tammuz sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet occupied the closest orbit to its star, the red giant Tatrang.

Tatrang II was a searing rock planet with no moons that was located within the Tatrang system, a part of the Tammuz sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the second closest orbit around the system's star, the red giant Tatrang.

Tatrang III was a poisonous jungle planet with three moons that was located within the Tatrang system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Tammuz sector. It occupied the third closest orbit around the system's star, the red giant Tatrang.
Tatrang V was the fifth planet of the Tatrang system, located in the Tammuz sector of the Outer Rim. It was a desolate mountainous world with two moons.
Tatrang VI was a ringed gas giant–type planet with twenty-three moons that was located within the Tatrang system, a part of the Tammuz sector in the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Tatrang VIII was an asteroid belt in the eighth orbital position of the Tatrang system, located in the Tammuz sector of the Outer Rim.
Tuvvet was the moon orbiting the planet Gorsh, located in Wild Space.

Around 22 BBY during the Clone Wars, an Acclamator-class assault ship was used to transport Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker and their clone troopers to Kamino's Tipoca City, just prior to the Battle of Kamino.

The Battle of Abelard was a battle between the Rebel forces and the Galactic Empire on the planet of Abelard some time after the Battle of Yavin. During the conflict, the Rebels managed to steal a stabilized ytterbium cargo.

The Solemnis was a Rebel Alliance starship. After the Battle of Abelard, the Solemnis was tasked with conveying the stabilized Ytterbium cargo that the Rebels had stolen from the Imperial forces to the Rebel base on Hoth but it disappeared before reaching Ristal.

Shingra was the only inhabitable planet in the Ordali system. It is covered in snowy mountains, with an average temperature of -15°C. Rarely, gems renowned for their size and purity can be found by mining the rock here.

Kaon City was the capital city of the planet Kaon in the Tion Hegemony. During the outbreak of the rakghoul virus during the renewed war between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, Kaon City was infected thanks to the unknowing actions of the smuggler Melarra.
The Nehutyc was a Shaadlar-type troopship.

The Battle for Black Ice took place during the Galactic Civil War above the planet of Refrax between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
Resilon was a mining world located in the Bortele sector of the Mid Rim.

A campaign near the city of Gell Mattar took place in 3666 BBY during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

The Vehemence was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, the Vehemence was attacked by Rebel Alliance forces, sustaining ion cannon fire to its bridge shields.

In the year 3650 BBY, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, the latter attacked a colony of Chagrian pacifists on the planet Mindor.

Pamina Prime was a planet in the Inner Rim. It was home to shellfish that were responsible of a deadly disease when eaten, the Borotavi syndrome. Jedi Master Taria Damsin was diagnosed with this disease after eating a local blue-shelled mollusk with a green stripe.

A group of gray-colored, heavily-cratered asteroids was located within the galaxy by the year 25,793 BBY. That year, the Devourer—a starship under the command of the Rakatan Predor Tul'kar of the Infinite Empire—vanished from Rakatan sensors at that location.

The atomic blast on Raspar-6 was a large-scale nuclear explosion on the moon Raspar-6, located in the Tragan Cluster, within the Outer Rim Territories. The blast impacted the atmosphere of a nearby planet during the month of Stolivea in that world's calendar.

The Qulun camp was a camp used by the Qulun, a non-traditional trading clan of the Alwari tribes native to the planet Ansion. The Qulun constantly moved around Ansion, setting up camp when they traded.

Gapillian grazers were a non-sentient herbivorous species native to the planet Ord Mantell. They were gentle-tempered beasts that wandered the grassy meadows of the planet, although their massive curved tusks and their hides, that looked like an armor, could give them a fearso…
Razoronns were non-sentient predators native to the planet Ord Mantell. They were one of the few carnivore species that could take down a Gapillian grazer by itself.

Trinthan prowlers were a non-sentient feline species native to the Trinith system. After their discovery, these deadly cat-like creatures were sold across the galaxy for use as trained hunters and trackers.

Bogstalkers were ancient creatures from the planet Taris. Before the Jedi Civil War, no one was able to see these creatures, but after Darth Malak's bombardment, bogstalkers appeared again on the planet's devastated surface.

The Core Tunnel was a brightly illuminated tunnel adjoining the carbon-freezing chamber on Cloud City. Luke Skywalker traversed the tunnel in his pursuit of Darth Vader following their initial duel within the carbon feezing chamber.

The West Gallery was a gently curving windowed corridor that overlooked the upper levels of Cloud City. Tian Chyler, along with two other Cloud City patrons, was present in the gallery when Lando Calrissian ordered the evacuation of the city following the Empire's invasion.

Downtown Plaza was an expansive outdoor area of the most upper levels of Cloud City. The Millennium Falcon flew above this area upon being granted permission to land on Platform 327. Revelers could be seen rejoicing in the plaza following news of the Emperor's death.

The North Corridor was an area of Cloud City. It was through here that Boba Fett escorted the recently carbon-froze Han Solo to his ship, Slave I. Fett also took a couple of pot-shots with his blaster at Luke Skywalker, after hearing an impatient R2-D2.
Port Town District was an area located on the upper concourse of Cloud City. The area was not to be confused with the notorious mid-level, Port Town.

The Level 4 Military Corridor was located on the Death Star and destroyed in the Battle of Yavin.

Tarsarian devourers were non-sentient predators that spawned on Taris's destroyed surface during the Cold War. They were the product of a rakghoul virus mutation that spread to the tarsarian stomper.

A species of primitive mammalian scavenger/hunters evolved on the Expansion Region planet of Adner. Members of the species were semi-social and lived in tribes ranging in size from five to twenty individuals.

The Alderaanian tourist board was an organization based on Alderaan, the task of which was to attract tourists to that planet.

A vast lake lay on the site of Aldera, the capital of the planet Alderaan. The Royal Palace overlooked the lake which was in fact a geologically recent meteor crater. It had formed around 30,500 BBY and had subsequently filled with water from the local subterranean aquifers.
The Elespads were a pachydermoid, sentient species. They had brown or orange skin color, two large and floppy ears, a trunk and a pair of tusks.

This holoprojection chamber was located on board the Executor adjacent to Darth Vader's meditation chamber. The chamber contained a HoloNet transceiver projection pod with which Darth Vader communicated with The Emperor via a secret frequency.
Cell block 121811 was a cell block in the east wing of the Republic military base's prison on Coruscant. The cell block was primarily controlled by Clone Commander Fox of the Coruscant Guard.
The Rebel Alliance Missile Trooper was a specialized soldier who carried a low-impact missile launcher. The soldiers could also become Armored Missile Troopers and carry two launchers.

A Separatist terrorist network was in operation on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The terrorists were responsible for attacks against the Republic such as the attack on Depot Bravo Five.

Clan Rodarch was a Mandalorian clan in existence during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Members of the Rodarch clan were known for keeping asharl panthers, training them to fight in battle alongside them.

The duneclaw, also known as a guuria, was a non-sentient beast native to the planet Tatooine. It was rarely seen on the planet's deserts, this because it preferred to hunt near Tatooine's cliffside caves and other dark, enclosed spaces, thanks to its ability to navigate in dim…
The Refugee Relief Movement fundraiser was a fundraising reception for the benefit of the Refugee Relief Movement—or RRM—that was organized on the planet of Alsakan in 22 BBY.
A species of primitive sea-dwelling creatures evolved on the planet of Hjaff with in the Colonies. Originally living in the planets oceans the species was eventually forced to move onto land.
A skirmish occurred on Dagobah during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

The Sith Lord Vodal Kressh gathered an army of followers in order to use against the reconstituted Sith Empire led by Vitiate, though he died before putting any of his plans into action. His followers remained on the planet Athiss over the following centuries, however.

The makrin creeper was a creature that was native to the planet of Makeb. The insect-like creatures appeared to be made up of earth and wood, but in reality, these were parts of their natural camouflage made of cords of muscle and nerve-rich tissue.

The InterStellar Regulators were a mercenary organization during the time of the Cold War and Galactic War, second only to prominent Mandalorian clans as one of the most successful and well-equipped mercenary outfits of its era, with a string of successful military campaigns o…
Early during the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire destroyed the town of Tondatha on the planet Agamar in the Lahara sector in retaliation for the alleged sedition of its residents.

The Coruscant Underworld Police were police officers of the Coruscant Security Force assigned specifically to patrol the underworld of the planet Coruscant.

An office suite was a room on the first Death Star for architects that were in the stages of designing the uncompleted Death Star. In 0 BBY, at the close of the Battle of Yavin, it was destroyed when the entire space station was destroyed by Luke Skywalker.

The army was disbanded when Jinn impaled Crion and Xanatos, who had fallen to the dark side of the Force, fled the planet for parts unknown only to resurface as the head of the Offworld Mining Corporation.

The Trade Federation Recruitment Center was a organization within the Trade Federation which existed in the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

A secret meeting room was located within the Institute of Government Service on the planet of New Apsolon in 41 BBY. A meeting was to be held between the Absolutes, Workers and the Civilized with Jedi Master Tahl acting as a mediator.
An office was located in the Institute of Government Service on the world of New Apsolon. It belonged to the planetary governor, Roan.

Absolutes supposedly disbanded, but not entirely

To introduce democracy and to assist the fragile government
x: A mission was undertaken to the fragile world of New Apsolon in 47 BBY by Jedi Masters Qui-Gon Jinn and Tahl to act as mediators to ensure peace whilst forming a government.

The Emperor's library was a large library located in the Imperial Palace on Coruscant. It belonged to Emperor Palpatine and only his top people were allowed to use it—among these people were his Sith apprentice Darth Vader and Emperor's Hand Mara Jade.
After her death on Mawan in 26 BBY, Jedi Master Yaddle was given a traditional Jedi funeral in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

A Consular-class cruiser belonged to Grand Master Yoda. This transport was used to take him, Jedi Master Yaddle, Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and his Padawan Anakin Skywalker to the planet of Mawan in 26 BBY.

objective: Remove criminal factions, restore provisional government
x: In 25 BBY, four members of the Jedi Order embarked on a mission to the planet of Mawan, to put down an insurgency of lawless criminals and to establish a provisional government committee.
A blue EG-6 power droid roamed the courtyard of the Lars homestead. It was several hundred years old.

This marketplace was a location in Cuipernam, the capital city of Ansion. In 22 BBY, Jedi Master Luminara Unduli, Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi, and their Padawans Barriss Offee and Anakin Skywalker explored this marketplace during the Mission to Ansion.

The Lokani Dawn was a sleeper ship that carried its passengers in suspended animation. It was constructed and launched by the people of the planet Coruscant around 25,200 BBY, not long after the fall of the Rakatan Infinite Empire.

R5-K3 was an R5-series astromech droid who was owned by Vorn Tel-Ovis, the owner of a junk shop that was situated in the settlement Mos Shuuta on the planet Tatooine. Like most other R5 units, R5-K3 had a sullen demeanor, and it hated Tel-Ovis.

The Opee Fleer was a decommissioned military bongo that had been rebuilt to participate in the Otoh Gunga Challenge. Many racers considered the Opee Fleer too cumbersome, but what it lacked in maneuverability it made up for in size.

The Whiplash Council was the governing body of the Whiplash resistance movement after the Whiplash leader, Thi Xon Yimmon was captured. Formed by Tuden Sal, the Council's members included Sheel Mafeen, Acer Ash, Fars Sil-at, and Dyat Agni.

In 18 BBY, an attack occurred on Emperor Palpatine's villa by Whiplash fighters. The goal was to kill Palpatine, but the attack had been expected, and while Whiplash managed to cause minor damage, the fighters were all killed.
The Jedi complex known as the Masters' Retreat was constructed over a lake on the planet Tython. The lake was also filled with several ruins of the ancient Je'daii.

result: Kyakhta and Bulgan, cured of mental disabilities, join the Jedi as gui
x: During a mission to the planet Ansion in 22 BBY, Jedi Padawan Barriss Offee was kidnapped by Kyakhta and Bulgan, two clanless Ansionian males (Alwari outcasts, formerly of the Tasbir clan). She was kidnapped on the order of Soergg the Hutt.
In 22 BBY, during a Jedi Order diplomatic mission to the planet Ansion, a skirmish took place in Cuipernam, Ansion's capital city.
A clan of bursas, a semi-sentient race of carnivores native to the planet Naboo, were under the influence of Boss Rogoe, a Gungan warlord on Naboo during a war between the Gungan tribes.

A clan of bursas lived near the city Spearhead on Naboo in 3000 BBY. As Boss Gallo's Grand army prepared to attack attack on Spearhead, his ally Marsune encountered the clan and its wounded leader. In exchanged for healing the leader the bursas joined Gallo in his attack.
During the Second Galactic Civil War in 40 ABY, Jacen Solo owned and maintained an apartment in the Senate District on Coruscant.

In the Second Galactic Civil War around 40 ABY, Colonel Jacen Solo maintained a private task force that answered directly to him. This task force was part of the Galactic Alliance Guard of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances.

result: Irek Ismaren defeated, resistance cells set up
x: In 27 ABY, a mission to Coruscant was undertaken by a team of Jedi and members of Wraith Squadron.

The Future Glory Committee was a Galactic Republic initiative begun by General Var Suthra of the Republic Military by the time of the Cold War of 3653–3641 BBY between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Mon Calamari Jedi Cilghal maintained her own private lab in the Jedi Academy on the planet of Ossus at the time of the Swarm War around 36 ABY. It was presumably built at the time of the academy's construction in 30 ABY.

An apartment was owned and maintained by Jedi Master Luke Skywalker and his wife, Mara Jade Skywalker at the time of the Yuuzhan Vong War from 25 ABY to 29 ABY. Their son, Ben, was possibly raised here.

During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Empire's Fury squadron was dispatched to the Sullust system in order to hunt down the Ash Angels squadron, and the Empire's Fury destroyed the Ash Angels within the Sululluub asteroid field.

Early on in the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, Republic agents aboard the space station Kilran's Lance above Aeten II disabled the station's defenses and a Republic fleet attacked the station.

During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire the now-rogue Dread Masters, after their failure on Denova, resurrected their proxy Kephess and sent him and a composited army to occupy the Gree world of Asation and in particular the Gran…

During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the First Son, leader of the Children of the Emperor, ordered the Empire to attack the planet Sarkhai in a bid to distract the Barsen'thor.
The Battle of Duro occurred above the planet Duro in 3640 BBY, during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Shifalas were a species of sentient simians coming from Carreras Major in the Outer Rim Territories. They were the dominant species of the Carreras system and had furry humanoid features.
Around 3640 BBY, the newly appointed Emperor's Wrath battled the Emperor's Voice when it was under the control of the entity known as Sel-Makor in the Ancient Halls of the Dark Heart.
A city was located on the planet Ord Mantell. Two clone commando squads undertook a mission to recover a stolen diplomatic package intended for Supreme Chancellor Palpatine.
Shattered Rock canyon was located on Vaced. It was filled with sharp rocks. During the Clone Wars, the Jedi Nuru Kungurama fought the Death Watch sniper Hudu Shiv in the canyon.

An asteroid field was located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. It was here that the Far Orbit starfighter complement squared off with the Silent Blades.

objective: Escort Commissioner Langu Sommilor to Coruscant
x: A mission was conducted on Vaced by the Galactic Republic's Breakout Squad.

The Near Wash was a location on the planet Desevro.

The Swamplands was an area on the planet Desevro. The Thoi and Lajune lived in the Swamplands. Jigani Port, the primary spaceport on Desevro, was also located in the Swamplands

The Defenestrator was the nickname of a bounty hunter assassin droid during the Cold War. He was one of the winners of the Great Hunt, along with Bloodworthy, Jewl'a Nightbringer, and Mandalore's Chosen.
Jerunga was a city on the planet of Bosthirda.

A supply depot was opened on the outermost moon of Bosph in the Bosph system by the retired Bosph bounty hunter Morga Bunna. The supply depot took up much of the small moon and much of it was buried beneath the it's surface in areas Morga had had drilled though himself.

The outermost moon of the planet Bosph was a large chunk of rock which orbited the planet at a great distance. The moon had been partially destroyed during a conflict prior to 19 ABY and by this time retired Bosph bounty hunter Morga Bunna opened up a supply depot on the moon.

A species of primitive mammalian omnivores evolved on the Outer Rim planet of Bosph. Members of the species had six limbs and were hunted by predators called Luprisi which they had to out smart to avoid.

Eridani was a major Galactic Republic establishment on the planet Sylvia IV. In 1125 BBY, the Disaster of Arrakad led to the massacre of the Human population of Eridani, forcing the Republic to launch a massive evacuation of Jedar and Lorik before quarantining the planet.

Jedar was a major Galactic Republic establishment on the planet Sylvia IV. In 1125 BBY, the Disaster of Arrakad led to the massacre of the Human population of Eridani, forcing the Republic to launch a massive evacuation of Jedar and Lorik before quarantining the planet.

Lorik was a major Galactic Republic establishment on the planet Sylvia IV. In 1125 BBY, the Disaster of Arrakad led to the massacre of the Human population of Eridani, forcing the Republic to launch a massive evacuation of Jedar and Lorik before quarantining the planet.

The Gamefinders were a Force-sensitive government faction of the Bosph species on their homeworld Bosph. The faction was part of a hierarchy of Force-sensitive factions that made up all of Bosph government and ruled over the planet.

The Sickhealers were a Force-sensitive government faction of the Bosph species on their homeworld Bosph. The faction was part of a hierarchy of Force-sensitive factions that made up all of Bosph government and ruled over the planet.

The Farseers were a Force-sensitive government faction of the Bosph species on their homeworld Bosph. The faction was part of a hierarchy of Force-sensitive factions that made up all of Bosph government and ruled over the planet.

Teldanus was the second-tallest mountain peak located on Goroth Prime, rising some 7,350 meters tall. It was located on the planet's western hemisphere and its name translated into Basic as the "Overlook."
M'Nis was the tallest mountain peak located on Goroth Prime, rising some 8,100 meters tall. Its name translated into Basic as "Skyfang".
Touch of Gold was a starship that was operated by the Zeltron Black Sun agent Donari Caron during the early years of the Galactic Empire.

A skirmish took place in 18 BBY aboard the Imperial Lambda-class T-4a shuttle ST 321. While aboard the shuttle headed back from Yinchorr to Coruscant, Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader were attacked by traitorous Emperor's Hand Sheyvan and six clones of Dark Jedi Sa Cuis.
The Chevin gangster Adamar Kirb established his own cartel on the moon Nar Shaddaa sometime before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, a Jedi Consular later known as the Barsen'thor owned a Defender-class light corvette.

The Jantsk mercenaries was a mercenary group based on the planet Endor. It was named after its leader, Vurrha Jantsk. During the Galactic Civil War, Jantsk and his mercenaries went to the Mid Rim planet of Naboo in order to attack Queen Kylantha's chambers.
Gon Tiek was a world located within the Gon Tiek system, a part of the Atravis sector in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Maun Digitalis was a world located in the Maun Digitalis system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies. At some point after the establishment of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY, the elite Imperial stormtrooper unit 501st Legion fought on Maun Digitalis.
Venestria was an astronomical object located in the Venestria system, a part of the Clacis sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Battle of Ord Trasi was a battle that took place during the Clone Wars in between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems on the planet Ord Trasi.
A battle was fought by the Galactic Republic at Venestria during the Clone Wars.

The Desiccation of Gholondreine-β, also known as the Gholondreine Desiccation, occurred in 10 BBY. During the first years of the Imperial Period, the Gholondreine scholars and philosophers published quietly urgent critiques of the Galactic Empire.

The Devastation of Gibad occurred in 19 BBY. When the government of the planet Gibad refused to cooperate after the Galactic Empire's given deadline, Emperor Palpatine ordered that the FG36 virus—created by Separatist scientist Ovolot Qail Uthan, a native of the planet—be unle…
Carreras Major was a backwater planet in the Outer Rim Territories.
Melody Lake was a deep body of water located on the slopes of Sistra Mountain on Yavin 8 and was the ancestral home of the Melodie race.

Lake Krul was a body of water located on the uninhabited jungle world of Balowa. It was named after the Sith Lord Kaox Krul, who perished there in a titanic struggle against the Jedi Crian Maru and Dree Vandap.
Isttu Village was a small settlement located on the Ithorian Herdship Bazaar.
Isttu Lake was a large branch of the Great Mother River that flowed through Isttu Village on the Ithorian herdship Bazaar.
Telega Lake was a body of water located on an Outer Rim planet which had several spectacular waterfalls. Hidden behind the waterfalls was a series of caves used by the Rodian gunrunner Nain Lup.

Sapphire Lake was an artificial body of water formed in Hollowtown, on Centerpoint Station, as a kind of nature preserve. Within the lake was a forested island that contained Eben Kinahay's heavily defended estate.

objective: Liberate Mesa and Resa Greenbark
x: A mission was undertook on Orvax IV in 19 BBY by Jedi Master Dass Jennir and the crew of the Uhumele in order to rescue the wife and the daughter of Bomo Greenbark.

An assault on Dezono Qua villa, on the planet Esseles, occurred in 19 BBY. The raid was carried by Jedi Master Dass Jennir and the crew of the Uhumele in order to rescue the daughter of Bomo Greenbark.
Juranno was a city of Alderaan, situated in the Juran Mountains valley. The city had been deliberately built in this spot, so it looked like it had been carved from the mountains surrounding it.
An skirmish occurred in 19 BBY on the planet Mimban between the crew of the Uhumele and crime lord Haka Hai for the control of Dreypa's Oubliette.

P8-47 was a droid active on the planet Nal Hutta during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The droid was owned by the Hutt crime lord Suudaa Nem'ro, who controlled the town of Jiguuna.
An skirmish occurred in 19 BBY on a jungle moon between Jedi survivors of Order 66 and Lumbra's group of pirates.

The Summit Farm Blossom Winery was a farm situated near the foothill of the Gallo Mountains on the Mid Rim planet of Naboo. The house of the farm was a building made of wood and stone, with a quaint-peaked roof.

The A-wing starfighter unit Comet Squadron was involved in a mission that took place in the early years of the New Republic. One of the squadron's pilots, former Imperial holovid star Garik "Face" Loran, was forced to eject during the operation to avoid a proton torpedo.

Naboo Senatorial Delegation was the political body that represented the planet Naboo and the 35 other worlds of the backwater Chommell sector during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. It consisted of a senator and their entourage.
Boruga was a planet located in the Core Worlds.

Candy was a hybrid astromech droid that was put together by the Rodian mech-tech Geri. The Rodian built the droid by combining the head of an RX-Series pilot droid with the body of a P2-series astromech droid, and he named it Candy because he considered the droid to be a "swee…
Sometime between 3667 and 3653 BBY, during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Chagrian Fideltin Rusk fought in a battle on the planet Amador.
Honest Yarg's Droid Emporium was a shop located in Ploughtekal Market on Coruscant in the early years of the Galactic Empire, run by Honest Yarg.
Hotel Sunspire was a hotel located on the Great Western Sea of Coruscant in the early years of the Galactic Empire.
The Mossy Glen Inn was an inn on the planet of Toprawa in the early years of the Galactic Empire.
The Solo family owned and maintained an apartment on the world of Corellia, the home planet of Han Solo. They owned this place during the Second Galactic Civil War in 40 ABY.
A funeral was held for the esteemed Jedi Master Omo Bouri after the latter died on an ill-fated mission on behalf of the Jedi Order.

This Ambush in the Surd Nebula was a short battle between the Galactic Federation Triumvirate and a pair of Sith, which took place on the floating world of Mala few months after the Second Imperial Civil War.

A small island was located off the northern coast of the island Avilatan on the planet of Ord Mantell. During the Separatist War, the reconstituted Sith Empire maintained a listening post underneath the island.

The Dread Host, also known as the Dread Guard, were a group of brainwashed Imperials and Sith who were under the control of the Dread Masters; the six powerful Sith Lords who served the Sith Emperor for centuries as prophets, generals and advisors.

The Toron Voq was a Galactic Republic patrol frigate that was sent to investigate a distress signal from the Jedi enclave on Rhinnal. The Toron Voq discovered the Red Reaper, but the Sith warship destroyed the frigate before it could escape.
An unidentified city was a small settlement on the Outer Rim planet of Carreras Major around 138 ABY.
The Red Ronto was a cantina which could be located onboard Brink Station around 45 ABY. In that year, Han Solo and Leia Organa Solo ventured here to meet with Lando Calrissian.

In 10,967 BBY, during the Seventh Alsakan Conflict, Alsakani forces attacked the Pius Dea fortress world of Fondor with aid from the Jedi Order and a number of alien species, including the Duros, Herglics, and Hutts.

In 10,967 BBY, during the Seventh Alsakan Conflict, Alsakani forces attacked the Pius Dea fortress world of Ord Mirit with aid from the Jedi Order and a number of alien species, including the Duros, Herglics, and Hutts.

In 10,967 BBY, during the Seventh Alsakan Conflict, Alsakani forces attacked the Pius Dea fortress world of Ixtlar with aid from the Jedi Order and a number of alien species, including the Duros, Herglics, and Hutts.

In 10,967 BBY, during the Seventh Alsakan Conflict, Alsakani forces attacked the Pius Dea fortress world of Ord Carida with aid from the Jedi Order and a number of alien species, including the Duros, Herglics, and Hutts.
Carreras Minor was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. In 138 ABY, an ice mining platform was operational on the planet's ring.

During the Republic Dark Age an arxeum, a type of mobile university dedicated to the advancement of military sciences, was constructed by the company Industrial Heuristics and pressed into the service of the Bactranate Sith state, in the Gazzari system.

Ducky was a DUM-series pit droid that served the Human podracer Sacha Swiftbird. As a result of podracer crash, Swiftbird became injured and Ducky's neural net was scrambled, rendering the droid inoperable.

A Torture Chamber was a cell, at least ten meters across, that could be located onboard the Anakin Solo in the Second Galactic Civil War in 40 ABY. It was filled with organic Yuuzhan Vong torture devices, including an Embrace of Pain.
A chamber served as the meeting place for the Agamarian Council during the New Jedi Order era.

Arkinnea was a planet that was located in the Axion sector in the Expansion Region of space. The planet suffered at the hands of the Separatists and at the end of the Clone Wars, it was overrun with refugees.
In 26 ABY, the Khommite Jedi Knight Dorsk 82 utilized a starship in an effort to rescue a number of droids from the planet Ando during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
Clone counselors were individuals who assisted the clone troopers of the Galactic Republic's Grand Army.

This species were a species of near-Human humanoid sentients possessing gray skin and ridged craniums. Male members of this species were hairless, with wrinkled skin, while females possessed light blue hair and much smoother features.
This sentient species were tall, wide-bodied beings with triangular heads. Feleen Bantillian, Gavron Sil, and Drex were members of this species.
The Infinity Plain was a plain located on the planet Dathomir on which was situated a Kwa Star Temple that contained an Infinity Gate.
In 25 ABY there was a droid uprising on Ruan.

The Gungan thief Marsune led a gang that operated on the planet Naboo in the year 3000 BBY.

Questor was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that was used by the Galactic Empire. In about 18 BBY, the Sith Lord Darth Vader traveled to the planet Mandalore aboard Questor in the aftermath of his capture of the Whiplash resistance leader Thi Xon Yimmon, to pick up equipment on th…
Raptor was a starship that was used by the criminal organization Black Sun during the early years of the Galactic Empire.
Darvannis was a desert planet in the galaxy where the Hutt Cartel ostensibly built up its military forces during the Galactic War.

Clan Kelborn was a Mandalorian clan in existence following the time of the Mandalorian Wars. When Jicoln Cadera rebelled against the Sith-favoring reign of Mandalore the Vindicated, Clan Kelborn was one of several clans that rallied to Cadera's side.

Clan Itera was a Mandalorian clan in existence following the time of the Mandalorian Wars. When Jicoln Cadera rebelled against the Sith-favoring reign of Mandalore the Vindicated, Clan Itera was one of several clans that rallied to Cadera's side.
Starliner was a street in Coronet City. In 18 ABY, during the First Corellian Insurrection, Han Solo and Belindi Kalenda met where Starliner crossed Volbick in an attempt to steal a spaceship.
Volbick was a street in Coronet City. In 18 ABY, during the First Corellian Insurrection, Han Solo and Belindi Kalenda met where Volbick crossed Starliner in order to attempt to steal a spaceship.
The Sith Tenebrae was born in a village on the agriworld of Medriaas in 5113 BBY. The village was located on the planet's remote northern continent, far from his father, the Sith Lord Dramath.

Several centuries after the founding of the reconstituted Sith Empire in 4980 BBY, the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Lokess proposed a plot to overthrow the Sith Emperor to her fellow members of the Empire's ruling Dark Council.
