objective: Defeat the Sith Emperor
x: In 3960 BBY, the Jedi Knights Revan and Malak followed the trail of the Sith Emperor from Nathema to Dromund Kaas, the capital of the True Sith Empire, and embarked on a months-long mission in order to assassinate the Emperor.

In 3954 BBY, the Sith Lord Darth Nyriss arranged for a series of assassination attempts against herself in order to draw suspicion away from the conspiracy against the Sith Emperor. There were, in total a set of two assassination attempts she constructed against herself.

The Financial Division was a branch of the Corporate Sector Authority. It dealt with finance and banking. After leaving the Bank of Aargau, Riga Lanchenzoor joined the Financial Division and became its Executive Viceprex.
IX-2A, also known as Ajax Twoay, was a modified BDG bodyguard droid manufactured by Lanthe Artifice.

Mirocaw was a rugged starship that was operated by the Whiphid bounty hunter Tulkh during the Cold War. The vessel contained various trophies from across Tulkh's career, including the remains of creatures that he had killed.

Sarls were a species of amored bugs that lived on the moon of Draay 2 in the Outer Rim Territories. A swarm of those creatures dwelled in the secret temple built by the Jedi Master Lucien Draay to hide a Sith artifact known as the "Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger." They had for…
An unidentified 3PO-series protocol droid was owned by the smuggler Torbin. The droid was modified to have a secret compartment in its torso which was used to smuggle weaponry and illegal substances.
An unidentified R5-series astromech droid was owned by the spacer Brayl. The droid was known to get grumpy if it didn't get a regular oil bath.

The Coruscant Security Force (CSF) operated a detective division to serve as its criminal investigative arm. It was led by a Chief of Detectives and based out of the Coruscant Security Force Headquarters in Galactic City on the planet Coruscant.
An unidentified R2-series astromech droid was owned by the spacer Nikambree, who performed extensive modifications to it to the point that the droid did not resemble its original form.
The Duros hyperspace trailblazer Gan Basso owned a starship in the early centuries after the founding of the Galactic Republic in 25,053 BBY.
The Sarapin Wanderer was a starship in the service of the Republic Navy during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Sometime after 4980 BBY, the enslaved individual Dakar Sol led a rebellion against the reconstituted Sith Empire on the planet Malachor V.
The compound of Darth Vengean was a huge complex within the Sith Sanctum, where the strongest warriors trained and followed the orders of their master.
The Celanon–Sprizen Negotiation was a trade dispute between the Celanon and Sprizen systems, two star systems that lay along the Celanon Spur hyperlane.

result: Most Bosphs unable to leave their planet
x: During the reign of the Galactic Empire the planet of Bosph in the Outer Rim Territories was blockaded and quarantined by the Imperial Navy.

The Trandoshani Hunters Alliance was an organization of Trandoshan hunters that was active in the centuries after the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire under the Sith Lord Darth Revan.

The Muunilinst Podrace was a podrace event held in 0 ABY at the planet Muunilinst, at the outskirts of its capital Pilaan. It had six participants all funded by Muun gamblers who made bets on the race's outcome.

t: Battle between the Kumauri Empire and the Republic
x: The battle between the Kumauri Empire and the Republic was a confrontation that constituted a part of the war fought between the Kumauri Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Boneyard was a factory city that was situated on the planet Nox, in the Tython system. The city was situated within a large factory dome and the air in the city was barely breathable as a result of discharges of industrial fumes.

Mook fruit was a type of fruit that was enjoyed by tauntauns. In 3645 BBY, the Whiphid bounty hunter Tulkh encountered a tauntaun in the stables of the Sith academy on the planet Odacer-Faustin, and he suggested that the creature would like some mook fruit.
KD-77 was a T-series tactical droid that served under Lok Durd on Lanteeb.

t: Supreme Court inquiry against Finis Valorum
place: Coruscant, in the Galactic Courts of Justice Building
x: A Supreme Court inquiry was launched in 33 BBY into allegations of embezzlement by Finis Valorum, then Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic.

The Januul camp was a native tribal camp, extensive and mobile, pitched by the Januul, an Alwari overclan of the planet Ansion. Like many other Alwari clans, the Januul nomads could efficiently disassemble their camp, as needed, and move around Ansion.
The Theed Palace Banquet Hall was a vaulted room for the purpose of hosting an official reception in the Royal Palace of the people of Naboo, in the city of Theed.

Tarlam was a small city on the planet Makeb. City Hall was located in the center of the city, which was situated atop one of Makeb's seven-kilometer-high stone mesas, and Tarlam Estates Marketplace dominated the southern half of the city.
The Merchant Quarter was a sector in the city of Iziz on the planet Onderon where merchants conducted business with the citizens of the city and offworlders.
House Alde was the estate of the noble House Alde on the planet Alderaan. Located in the Juran Mountains, it was just north of Fort Alde, and contained the Royal Museum of Alderaan.
The Royal guard of Gala was the security forces for the royals of Gala, specifically, Queen Veda.

place: Jedi Research Facility, Timira City, Kamino
result: Boba Fett and his team steal the fake Mandalorian relics
Dengar and Latts Razzi are arrested
objective: Steal the Blade of Beginnings
x: The Korasa job was the theft of two fake Mandalorian relics that took place on the planet Kamino during the Clone Wars.

result: Death of Toborro and Szajin, Hutts negotiate settlement with Republic
Sith Empire secures supply of isotope-5
x: The Conquest of Makeb was a battle during the Galactic War that pitted the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire against the ambitions of the Hutt Cartel on the border world of Makeb.
BT-9 was a protocol droid owned by Fez Burba during the Cold War. It could be found on Tatooine.

t: Skirmish outside of Darth Nyriss's stronghold
x: In 3954 BBY a skirmish took place outside of Darth Nyriss' stronghold on the planet Dromund Kaas. After the Sith Lord Scourge arrived at Nyriss' stronghold he was attacked by two mercenaries. During the brief battle both mercenaries were killed.

result: Sechel discovers who purchased the droid.
objective: Discover who purchased the droid that almost killed Darth Nyriss
x: In 3954 BBY, a mission was undertaken by the Sith Lord Scourge and Dark Councilor Darth Nyriss' advisor Sechel to discover who purchased the droid that had attempted to kill her during the second attempt on her life.

The King's Road was a roadway that linked the King's Pass canyon and House Alde, the estate of the noble House Alde on the planet of Alderaan. Both the road and the canyon were named in honor of Darrus Alde, the first king of Alderaan.

A tribe of Tusken Raiders lived on the planet Tatooine sometime after the Battle of Yavin during the Galactic Civil War. During this time, the tribe attacked the city of Mos Espa on the planet in retribution for the theft of several artifacts from a relic cave on the planet.

The Dark Temple pass was a valley west of Kaas City on the planet Dromund Kaas. The edifice known as the Dark Temple stood at the western end of the valley, and the Sith Empire's Outpost Warden blocked the eastern end of the valley and the road to Kaas City.
Gunship One was an LAAT/i gunship used by the Galactic Republic during the Battle of Kothlis.

C6-N8 was a protocol droid active during the Cold War. It could be found on Alderaan. In 3643 BBY, the droid tasked a traveling Republic affiliated individual with helping its master, Selia Antares, defuse a House Ulgo bomb on a transport ship.

place: A cave outside of Kaas City, Dromund Kaas
x: Operation supernova was Jedi Knight Meetra Surik's term for the skirmish that took place in a cave outside of Kaas City on the planet Dromund Kaas during the year 3950 BBY.

In 3954 BBY, following orders from Dark Councilor Darth Nyriss, Sith Lord Scourge, along with Nyriss' advisor Sechel and her security chief Murtog, embarked on a mission to the Bosthirda separatist compound in order to eliminate a group of separatists.
a: Raid on the Bosthirda separatist compound

x: The Bendu Village was a settlement occupied by the Order of Dai Bendu who dwelled in the Andobi Mountains of Ando Prime around 32 BBY. That modest village consisted of a few tents clustered around a central stone colossus.
In 4 ABY, the Naboo people orchestrated a rescue of Queen Padmé Amidala after she was somehow captured by a group of Tusken Raiders stationed at Jundland Station.

Jundland Station was a settlement on Tatooine located near Mos Osnoe, Boorka's Palace, and the Confederacy way station. It was either located at the Jundland Wastes on Tatooine, or was otherwise named after it.

Explorer's Crag was a steep peak located in the vicinity of the Happy Grove on the forested moon of Endor. At some point in history, a traveling explorer visited the skies of Endor in a hot air balloon, but crashed on top of the Explorer's Crag.

t: Attack on the Nar Haaska system
x: In 26 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War between the New Republic and the Yuuzhan Vong species, the Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Nar Haaska system.

Verdson was a location. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Imperial Sub-Prefect Matagorn was murdered by the Srrors'tok bounty hunter Tyionsis Cex, and a piece of Matagorn's body was subsequently found in Verdson.
In 25 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War between the New Republic and the Yuuzhan Vong species, the Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Alee system.

The Icehang Loop was an area in the Highmount Ridge region of the planet Hoth. A looping pathway located underneath a fractured ice overhang, it was home to numerous wampas, and Shai Tenna's pleasure den was located in the loop.
In 26 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War between the New Republic and the Yuuzhan Vong species, the Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Rorak system.
The Tho Yor Arrival at Tython marked the zero year for the Standard Time dating system using TYA notation.

result: Langoonans driven to brink of extinction
x: During their enslavement by the Hutt species, the Langoonan species native to the planet Langoona, in a system of the same name deep in Hutt Space, unsuccessfully rebelled against their masters.

The Personal Transport Assembly Shop was an assembly shop on Darkknell during the Old Republic era. It was known to assemble and paint Speeder bikes. It was once considered by Narsk Ka'hane to be too toxic even for the Sith Lord Odion's workers to work at.

Dwarf opee sea killers were a downsized subspecies of the opee, a carnivorous non-sentient creature with reddish orange skin and yellow eyes that lived in the sweet waters of the planets Naboo and Aquilaris.
G'nooks were a species of non-sentient, ape-like humanoids. They were known for their lack of intelligence, which some postulated was due to their very small brain.
Alderaan night birds were a species of non-sentient avian creatures that hailed from the planet of Alderaan. Those nocturnal birds emitted cooing sounds.

The Necropolitans were a cultural group of Humans who lived on the planet of Necropolis, in the Core Worlds. Although they were genetically identical to baseline Humans, the Necropolitan had a unique culture that set them apart from other humans.
The Corellian Thunder was a DP20 gunship in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
The Dream Runner was a DP20 gunship serving the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
The Defector was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
The Drammel was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in service to the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Egoa trees were a non-sentient species of tree that grew on the planet Tal Nami within Hutt Space. The trees were capable of growing fruit, roots and branches and grew at a rate of one meter per day.
Thosa was a planet of barren rock orbiting Dostra Major in the Dostra system. It was the fifth planet in the system, and was orbited by two moons.

The New Thinking Division was a branch of the Imperial Science Bureau of the reconstituted Sith Empire. Nadrin Tro was a scientist from this division of the Bureau who was selected to aid the Sith's mission on Makeb in acquiring isotope-5.

Illip was a Hutt clan, or kajidic. One of its members was Juvard Illip Oggurobb, a Hutt who held the title of Doctor at some point before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
A large asteroid belt orbited the Algunnis binary star in the Algunnis system.
The Mission to Ryvester was a covert operation conducted by Wraith Squadron, a New Republic commando unit, on the planet Ryvester in 13 ABY.
A clan of Mandalorian warriors was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Simoomian sensory hound was a non-sentient species of six-legged canid native to the planet Simoom.

During the conflict between the Hutt species and the self-declared Tionese Daritha Xim, the Hutts reconquered the planet Moralan during the invasion of Moralan after the Moralan species who lived there freed themselves from Hutt slavery.

The planet Nathema's northern continent was the site of at least one farming village. The Sith pureblood Tenebrae, the son of Medriaas's ruling Sith Lord Dramath, conquered the northern continent during his rise to power.

During the Yuuzhan Vong War, in which the empire of the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong species invaded the galaxy between the years 25 ABY and 29 ABY, the Vong attacked the Tsyk system within Hutt Space.

Between 25 ABY and 29 ABY during the invasion of the galaxy by the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong species, which became known as the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Vong attacked the Hollastin system within Hutt Space.
During the invasion of the galaxy by the intergalactic Yuuzhan Vong species between 25 ABY and 29 ABY, the Vong attacked the Circumtore system within Hutt Space.
The Fioer desert was a region of the planet Zaraksander. During the Galactic Civil War, the Neo-Fundamentalist Phlangites operated from the desert.
The Neo-Fundamentalist Phlangites, also known as the NFP, were a group led by the individual Zaglis that operated in the Fioer desert on the planet Zaraksander.
The Peaceful Dawn Rally was a protest that was held on the planet Zaraksander during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The cloudsnake was a variety of snake that had a smooth carapace.

SD was a droid at Ania Solo's junk yard that served as Ania's security and enforcer, throwing out any unruly customers and protecting the property. It was destroyed by Darth Wredd, who was impersonating Yalta Val, when the imposter attempted to kill Ania and Sauk.

The Dark Warbirds were a pirate organization operating in the Trax sector. They settled on the planet Uogo'cor, enslaving the native Uogo until the Galactic Empire destroyed all the pirate forces in the Uogo'cor system.
The Battle of Heg was fought between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire in the city of Heg during the Imperial subjugation of the planet Bundim.
Starpoint was a city on the planet Draenell's Point. Located on the continent of Mee'r, It was home to a population of three million. It was also the home of the Farmer's Folly cantina.

Agricultural loading platform XT-21s was located seventeen kilometers outside Thulpin City on Draenell's Point. During the Battle of Bissillirus, Alliance to Restore the Republic forces raided the platform for its food supplies.
Uniqer was a city on Draenell's Point, located on the continent of Mee'r. It was home to just over one million inhabitants.
New Calince was a city on Draenell's Point, located on the continent of Rett. It was home to just around two million inhabitants.
Rett was a continent on the planet Draenell's Point. While it was the largest, it was also the least populated, with six million inhabitants. Two million of them lived in the city of New Calince.
Dragnoor was a city on Deysum III. It served as the planet's capital.
Klerint was a city on Deysum III. It was the site of the Imperial Resources Base.

Sometime between 3647–3642 BBY, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, a clan of Mandalorian warriors attacked the palace of a Hutt whom they believed had signed a death mark against them.
Jurio was a planet in the Jurio system, a part of the Corva sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the winged creature known as the Juriod fang-flier.

The Endor Splendor Inn was an inn located on the forest moon of Endor. Guest rooms were in 400 bungalows, and amenities included the Thatch Club Cabaret, the Golden Magic Tavern, the Village Drums Boutique, and native Ewok guides.

Around 25,200 BBY, the planet Tatooine was bombarded by the Infinite Empire of the Rakata species, which was suffering a plague that was reducing their numbers and stripping them of their ability to use the Force.

result: Foiling of the Sinister Triumvirate's plot
Galactic Civil War brought to an end
objective: Find Jorj Car'das
Retrieve a complete copy of the Caamas Document
x: In 19 ABY, the crew of the smuggling starship Wild Karrde embarked on a hunt for Jorj Car'das, whom they believed possessed a complete copy of the elusive Caamas Document.
Zerist was a moon that orbited the planet Obri.
The Outer Rim Concourse was a concourse located aboard Tomorrowland Starport that supplied registration for flights to planets located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, including Bespin.

objective: Assassination of Ta'a Chume
x: In 23 ABY, a squad of Bartokk assassins hired by Ambassador Yfra raided Reef Fortress in an attempt to assassinate the matriarch of Hapes, Ta'a Chume.

Aucfans were small rodent-like creatures considered to be vermin. They had green skin, two large sharp ears and two red eyes. These creatures sometimes entered into cargo containers of spaceports or warehouses and had troubled the employees.

The Kintan crushers, also known as Kintan enforcers and a host of other names, were a species of powerfully-built creatures from the planet Kintan in Hutt Space. They were related to the semi-sentient Kintan striders, a species they surpassed in intelligence.

The Herald of Karagga was a masculine-programmed protocol droid who worked for Karagga the Unyielding, leader of the Hutt Cartel shortly after the end of the Cold War. The droid stood by his Hutt master's side and delivered messages on behalf of his master.

The Eastern Grime was a region of the planet Nal Hutta, surrounded by the Evocii swamp, the Bog, the Rust Yards and the palace of Hutt crime lord Fa'athra. At the time of the Cold War, the Eastern Grime was home to various Evocii tribes.
The Caves of the Primeval Wardens was a region of the Tomb on the planet Belsavis. It contained the entrances to numerous vaults and facilities in the Tomb.
Talaos City was the capital of the planet Makeb.
This R2 unit worked in the quarantine inspection area of the Tomorrowland Starport Baggage Claim. He supervised the work of freight and baggage inspection droids P-6 and S-4.
Tarlam Central Square was a plaza in the settlement of Tarlam on the planet Makeb that served as a courtyard to the settlement's City Hall.
Praya was an ocean planet located in the Praya system, within the Clacis sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. By the year 4.3 ABY, it was home to the luxurious Sea Castle Resort Hotel.
Bar Neth (also spelled Bar-Neth) was a former desert planet located in the Bar Neth system, a quinary star system positioned in the Albarrio sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Sea Castle Resort Hotel was a deluxe hotel suite on the water planet Praya, during the time of the Galactic Civil War. The hotel was given the rating of five stars by the Milky Way Guide, and as such was among the highest ranking hotels in the galaxy.
The Carl Hodgesville Dude Ranch was a popular tourist spot on the terraformed desert planet of Bar Neth.
Dessain Mining was a mining company that was created by the Dessain family.

t: Unidentified Interdictor-class Star Destroyer (ambush of Gray Flight)
x: An Imperial Interdictor-class Star Destroyer took part in an operation to ambush Gray Flight. The ship deployed its interdiction field, trapping the flight. The Rebel fighters then destroyed eleven TIE/IN interceptors and turned their attention to the Interdictor.
Sea Base 2000 was a popular tourist attraction on the water planet of Praya. It supplied visitors with marine-speeders to either race with each other or to spelunk for treasure in sunken ships.

Hook hawks were a carnivorous bird species native to the Stark Forests on Tython during the time before the Old Republic. Packs of hook hawks used their mesmerizing songs to seduce prey into a somnolent trance before killing and devouring them.
Silik lizards were rare reptiles native to the Silent Desert on Tython. They were silicon-based life forms that were able to absorb energy from the sand.
The Great Journey was a trip undertaken by all members of the Je'daii Order as Je'daii Journeyers.

t: Galactic Alliance Department of Public Protection
x: The Galactic Alliance Department of Public Protection was the department of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances that supervised domestic security on the planet Coruscant. The department received information from the Coruscant Security Force.

The Mon Gazza Spice Mines were a spice-mining facility located on the planet of Mon Gazza. In terms of productivity, that facility was only bested by the famous mines of Kessel, where the telepathy-inducing glitterstim spice was collected.
Heklu were a non-sentient, amphibious species native to the planet Riileb in the Riileb system of Hutt Space.
The MotherClan was group of Riileb believed to be descended from the First Riileb and from whom the ruler of the species was selected.

Imperial Security was a law enforcement of the Imperial Remnant. They served as police officers on Remnant worlds. They also served as bodyguards for the Imperial Head of State. In 44 ABY Imperial Security was led by Kthira'shi'ktarloo.

The Athallian Messenger was a courier starship that crash-landed on the planet Tatooine with a cargo of gemstones at some point by 36 BBY. Many treasure hunters subsequently searched for the vessel without success.
A moon with a stormy atmosphere and seas on its surface was one of the eighteen natural satellites that orbited the gas giant–type planet of Kiskua.

result: Lord Tagriss steals several Sith relics
objective: To steal Sith artifacts from the Arcanum
x: Around 3638 BBY, the Sith Lord Tagriss staged a raid on the Arcanum, a facility maintained by the Sith Empire to contain dangerous Sith artifacts, in order to steal some relics on behalf of the Dread Masters.

Communication Intelligence, abbreviated as ComInt, was a division of Imperial Intelligence during the time of the Imperial Remnant. Its officers were assigned to the Imperial Navy to intercept enemy communications and deceiver them.
Bloodfin Security, commonly abbreviated as FinSec, was the designation for the forces responsible for security operations aboard the Imperial Remnant Star Destroyer Bloodfin.

The Coruscant Building Authority was an agency operating on the planet Coruscant during the Galactic Alliance. It ensured that buildings in Galactic City were built with the proper permits and that blueprints of all buildings were filed with the agency.

The Planetary Fire Suppression Office was an agency operating on the planet Coruscant during the Galactic Alliance. It ensured that buildings in Galactic City were built with the proper specifications to prevent fires.

A base with a fortress was built by the Trade Federation on the moon Alaris Prime. It was constructed between 39 BBY and 36 BBY during the Trade Federation's illegal colonization of the moon. The base was maintained by OX9 labor droids and commanded by SRAM-13.
Rhol Yan was a capital city and a spaceport on the planet of Kalimahr. Rhol Yan had been built on an archipelago stretching out into the Southern Ocean.

The Khar Peninsula was a one-kilometer and half wide and nineteen-kilometer long peninsula that jutted from a large island in the Southern Ocean on the planet of Kalimahr. The city Khar was situated on the peninsula during the height of the Je'daii Order's power.

A species of insects native to the planet Riileb in Hutt Space eventually evolved into the sentient Riileb species, who could grow to between 2 and 2.75 meters tall. The precursor species were social in nature and possessed antennae.

The Tigon mining colony was a mining settlement on the Mid Rim planet of Makeb. When the Hutt Cartel invaded Makeb in 3638 BBY, they began massive mining operations on the planet, which triggered severe groundquakes.
Civic Square was a public square on the west side of Talaos City, the capital of the planet of Makeb. It hosted the Talaos Police Station.

The abandoned mining mesa was the site of a mine on the planet of Makeb. It was here that isotope-5 was first discovered by Solida Hesk's mining corporation, but the mesa was abandoned due to safety concerns and was overrun by native wildlife.
The Westwater Settlements was a settlement on the planet Makeb that occupied one of the planet's mesas. It included the Farend Cantina and the Kinlo Plantation, and Tyvar's family lived in the area.
Aboro Mesa was a location on the planet of Makeb that hosted several installations.
The Aboro Steppe was a plains region on the Aboro Mesa, which itself was on the planet of Makeb.
The volcanic mesa was a mesa on the planet Makeb that was known for its significant magma chamber that was the site of Stronghold One, a secure facility that contained the planet's treasury.
Telemur mesa was a mesa on the planet of Makeb, which was the site of Telemur Falls.
Telemur Falls was a waterfall on the Telemur Mesa, located on the planet of Makeb.
The planet Farstine was occupied by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. The parents of a child were killed by Imperial soldiers during the occupation, leaving the boy an orphan.

Members of the Galactic Republic Army's elite rocket-jumper unit were sent on a mission to the planet of Cyborrea at some point before the conflict known as the Freedon Nadd Uprising that happened in the year 3998 BBY.
In 26 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War between the New Republic and the Yuuzhan Vong species, the Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Cyborrea system.

Ironholgs was nickname given to an upgraded version of a Holgorian IM-220 maintenance droid associated with Je'daii Ranger Lanoree Brock. Ironholgs was responsible for basic onboard maintenance and security of Brock's ship; though it did not have arms.

The Heinsnake Cult was an ancient religious group which wielded a dark and powerful magic capable of rivaling the Dark Lords of the Sith and clouding their vision. Its symbol was a green headless snake, which the cultists painted or tattooed on their torso.
A planetoid was an irradiated world located within The Redoubt in the galaxy's Unknown Regions. In the year 27 BBY, the Outbound Flight crash-landed on the planetoid.

In 23 ABY, the dining hall of Fountain Palace, the personal residence of the Hapan Queen Mother on the planet Hapes, was bombed. The bomb was meant to kill Ta'a Chume, the matriarch of Hapes, and her granddaughter Tenel Ka, the Hapan princess.

The Senate Security Officers, known simply known as SSOs and referred to at times as Senate Security, were soldiers of the Galactic Republic military that shared jurisdiction of protecting the Galactic Senate with the Coruscant Security Force during the Great Galactic War and …
New Tayana was a floating city that was located on the planet Duro. At one time, the Duros Cad Bane lived in the city, but he later left to forge a career as a successful bounty hunter.
The Descent Ghetto was a crime-ridden district of New Tayana, a space city that orbited the planet Duro.
Port Town was a region within Equator City on the planet Rodia. In 0 BBY, the holostar Javul Charn ventured into Port Town to visit the cantina Every Delight.
The Nautolan moon-snail was a species of snail that had a glowing shell.

t: Attack on a Tetan carbonite smelter
x: In the year 3996 BBY, the Mandalorian Crusaders attacked and destroyed a Tetan carbonite smelter in the Empress Teta system.

The Spice Mines of Kemix was a spice-mining operation that was established on the planet Kemix by the Hutt crime lord Riboga during the Clone Wars, after he discovered naturally-occurring deposits of glitterstim on the world.

t: Wedding of Varner Hilts and Iliana Merko
place: Kesh Sith Temple, Takara Mountains, Kesh
x: The wedding of Varner Hilts and Iliano Merko allowed Iliana Merko, leader of the Sisters of Seelah, to share Hilts' power over the Tribe.
In 10 ABY, Boba Fett undertook a mission to the planet Skeebo to rescue Anachro. However, Fett was forced to fight Ry-Kooda after the Herglic tracked him down.
In 10 ABY, Boba Fett and Ry-Kooda fought each other in a showdown in Orkana, a heavily polluted territory on the planet Tatooine.
In existence by 10 ABY, a bar once resided on the surface of Rutal IV. Ry-Kooda and Boz once went there.

objective: Sabotage Riboga's spice mining operation
Rescue the Tarasin Force Adepts Krizta and Trik
x: During the time of the Clone Wars, the Heroes of Cularin—a group of freelance agents from the Cularin system—ventured to the planet Kemix on a mission to cripple a spice mining venture established by the Hutt crime lord Riboga on the world and to rescue the enslaved Tarasin Fo…

Uhrar was a city on the planet Kesh, located on the continent of Alanciar. Wardmaster Quarra Thayn served as the chief military advisor of the city, where she lived with her husband, Brue, and their three children.

The Imperial Center Sanitation Department, also called Coruscant Sanitation, was a department on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire that was responsible for processing the massive amounts of waste. Waste was removed from the planet via mega-barges.

Ganzik was a world located in the Ganzik system, a part of the Mid Rim's Maldrood sector. It was situated near the hyperlane known as the Perlemian Trade Route. The primary shipyards of the starship manufacturing company Mesens Corporation were located in orbit around Ganzik.
Kerebba was a city on the planet Kesh, located on the continent of Alanciar.

The protection division was the arm of the Coruscant Security Force that was responsible for protecting the Chief of State and high profile government leaders of the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances.

t: Standoff in the Republic Central Medcenter
place: Republic Central Medcenter, Galactic City, Coruscant
x: A standoff occurred in 20 BBY at the Republic Central Medcenter when Republic Treasury Agent Besany Wennen discovered that the medical droids intended to euthanize Fi Skirata since they had declared him brain-dead.
Mala was a remote planet in the Surd Nebula in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. It was home to an unidentified near-Human species with white hair.
HHG-RX was an RX-series pilot droid that existed during the early stages of the Galactic Civil War. It could frequently be found hitch-hiking at Spaceport THX1138.

Jedi Mickey's Starfighter was the personal customized Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor of the Jedi Master Mickey Mouse and his astromech droid partner, R2-MK. Mickey and R2-MK used Jedi Mickey's Starfighter to battle droid starfighters and Imperial TIE Fighter squadrons.

The mice (singular form, mouse) were a species of diminutive, rodent-like sentient beings with large ears who hailed from the world of Hyperion. The renowned Jedi Master named Mickey Mouse, who fought during the Clone Wars and survived the Great Jedi Purge, was one of them.

result: Jedi appear to be terrorists on Corellia
objective: Kill Wedge Antilles
x: The Five Worlds leadership decided to assassinate Wedge Antilles after replacing him with Admiral Genna Delpin.

MK-RU was a droid that was part of Imperial Intelligence on Dromund Kaas in Kaas City. An unidentified Imperial delivered a package to this droid while it was in Kaas City. They worked with Manda and Minder Twenty.
The Valiant class was an Imperial cruiser that saw service within the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.
The Corellian Guard was a military unit within the Rebel Alliance that the Rebel operative Commander Yanus Melikan served in during the early stages of the Galactic Civil War.

IM-2M was an IM series security droid manufactured by Droid Security Systems and stationed in the Star Tours terminal of Spaceport THX1138 by about the year 1 BBY. It had multiple black, red, and white sensors, as well as blue and silver plating.

Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, Imperial forces annexed the Cassandran Worlds, a loosely-allied region of space in the New Territories of the Outer Rim. The split the region into three subsectors named Cassander, Tadrin, and Tendrannan.

R3-T3 was a astromech droid serving the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. He was tasked with infiltrating the Separatist base during the Third battle of Felucia. His cover was blown, so he escaped into the wilderness, leaving a oil trail behind him.

conflict: Onderon Civil War, First Jedi Purge (Old Sith Wars)
objective: Find Kavar
x: A mission to the Planet Onderon was conducted by Human female Meetra Surik in 3951 BBY, which set off a series of conflicts between the Onderon Royalists, Onderon separatists and the Lost Jedi in an effort to find Jedi Master Kavar.

The Del Andue were a strange-looking sentient species. In 3 ABY, the Jedi Luke Skywalker spent some time living in a hovel on the planet Tatooine with two Del Andues while he made preparations to rescue his friend Han Solo from the clutches of the crime lord Jabba the Hutt.

The Grand Melee was an event that took place on Dromund Kaas in 3643 BBY for qualification into the Great Hunt. An unidentified bounty hunter won the Melee by killing all of the participants. This individual would eventually go on to win the Great Hunt.

The Republic Medical Service was the healthcare system of the Galactic Republic around the time of the Cold War. It provided mobile medical tents, medical droids, bacta tanks, stimpaks and other medical services to citizens of the Republic as well as military personnel.
This planetary command ship was a starship that was part of the resurgent Sith Empire. In 3640 BBY this command ship took part in and was destroyed during the battle of Kalandis Seven.

The Vaathkree was an Imperial star cruiser commandeered by Grand Admiral Thrawn as of 6 ABY. That year, Thrawn traveled to Sluis Van aboard the Vaathkree in order to acquire a Star Destroyer under construction in the Sluissi construction yards, and to gather intelligence in an…

During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Republic Strategic Information Service agent Theron Shan and the Jedi Master Gnost-Dural undertook a mission to the Imperial Military's Reaver Station.

During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, a battle occurred along the Hydian Way when Mandalorians attempted to blockade the hyperlane having laid an extensive minefield. So the Republic sent the Coruscant Aegis to destroy them.

t: Kath Scarlet's Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft
x: This Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft was flown by Kath Scarlet, the Captain of the Binayre Pirates during the Galactic Civil War. Scarlet used the ship to ambush and capture the cargo of unarmed starships passing through Corellian space.

Raxus Secundus, also known simply as Raxus, was a lush world in the Outer Rim Territories' Tion Hegemony that served as the capital planet of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Marvasa's Marauders was a mercenary group based in the Cyrillian Protectorate around the time of the Clone Wars. The bounty hunter Rako Hardeen was once a member, receiving his distinctive facial tattoos from the group.

x: During the Clone Wars, the bounty hunter Cad Bane raided the Descent Shopping Mall.
The Arkinnea Militia was the local military forces of the planet Arkinnea during the Clone Wars and the Imperial Period.

objective: Assassinate Allana Solo
x: In 36 ABY, the Gorog were hired to kill the daughter of Tenel Ka Djo, the Queen Mother of Hapes. With the intervention of her father, Jacen Solo, the Chume'da was saved.
A Capuchin was present at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on Tatooine around the time Luke Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi were there. The Capuchin wore a red vest and was fond of dates.
OB-CPO was the aircraft of Jock Lindsey. At some point it was kept in Mos Eisley on Tatooine.
The Tenacious was a Venator-class Star Destroyer in operation during the early stages of the Galactic Empire. It was helmed by Captain Denimoor.
The Tempestuous was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that was used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

During the Great Galactic War, the Military of the Galactic Republic maintained a stronghold on the planet of Ord Radama. The stronghold was located atop a mountain not far from the world's capital city of Livien Magnus.

M-1991 was a Bugnaught bounty hunter who operated during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Circa 21 BBY, M-1991 was captured by the Galactic Republic and imprisoned alongside other wanted bounty hunters aboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Tempestuous for transport…

R5-Q3 was an astromech droid who was owned by the bounty hunter Arlain Zee. During the Clone Wars, Zee was imprisoned by the Galactic Republic alongside various other captured bounty hunters aboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Tempestuous.

The inside-outside room was part of the House of Organa's private quarters in the Aldera Royal Palace. One entire wall of that room was made of transparisteel doors that provided a full view of the family's private gardens.

Kessel was the nickname of an unidentified species of bird found in the Aeneid system. Lando Calrissian, Marshak, Fonker Dahk, and others once tricked Han Solo into buying 17,000 credits worth of the worthless and pestilent birds.
The Kaas City expansion district was a construction site and extension of Kaas City on the planet of Dromund Kaas. It was located just outside the walls of Kaas City.
Quarren City was a major population center for the Quarren people of the water planet Dac.
This sentient species were diminutive humanoids with a lavender spot on top of their bald heads.

t: Republic economic depression of the Great Wars
x: During the Great Galactic War of 3681 BBY–3653 BBY, the Galactic Republic slid into a severe economic depression that confounded the government's efforts to fight in the conflict against the invading Sith Empire.

t: Jedi strike team (Assassination of Darth Azamin)
x: Around 3653 BBY, near the end of the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, a strike team of Jedi infiltrated the stronghold of the Sith Lord Darth Azamin.
The Hidaci Ridge was a mountain formation located on the planet Ereesus.
A moon orbited Ereesus, a planet in the Kanz sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

result: The destruction of the manufacturing domes
x: The Bombing of Nox was an event which occurred during the Despot War on Nox.

Sometime before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Jedi Master Yuon Par led an expedition to the planet of Koros, known more commonly as Empress Teta, for the purpose of conducting archaeological excavations.
The Dyclops were a sentient species who, despite their mostly humanoid body, were distinguished by their two heads, both of which featured a mouth, a single eye, and an ear.
The raid on Belthu occurred in 7 ABY when New Republic Intelligence destroyed a durasteel foundry that was being used by Warlord Zsinj based on information supplied to them by Wraith Squadron.

Wielu was a planet in the galaxy with two suns, and was well known for its famous beaches and thriving black market. During the Clone Wars, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano briefly vacationed here.

Umax was a planet located somewhere in the galaxy, on which a detention center had been established. Sonko Fromm, a male of the Annoo-dat Blue species, was briefly imprisoned on Umax before he was freed by his boss Sise Fromm.

The Coruscant Criminal Records Office was an office of the planet Coruscant that maintained records of criminals. Jedi Master Luke Skywalker once issued a request to the office for any information on several names.
DX-TX was a droid leader of the DX annihilator network located on the moon of Nar Shaddaa. This group allied with Godoba the Hutt and the Nar Shaddaa Labor Alliance to form the Shadow Syndicate.
This sentient species were distinguished by their yellow skin, including the cluster of tentacles they used for locomotion, as well as a lumpy patch on the front of their face.
Elvarnos was a city on the continent of Keshtah Minor on the planet of Kesh. It survived through the Great Crisis, and held archives of information on the Lost Tribe of Sith, including
Minrath was a village on the continent of Alanciar on the planet of Kesh. Edell Vrai and Quarra Thayn passed through it on their way to the city of Sus'mintri during the Invasion of Alanciar.
Prefsbelt IV, also known simply as Prefsbelt, was a planet in the Prefsbelt system and Prefsbelt sector of the Outer Rim Territories that housed a naval academy.

Helleguth was a planet located in the Helleguth system of the Inner Rim. Obi-Wan Kenobi intended to bring the criminal T'mott Zoat there, to stand trial for his crimes. One of those crimes was the murder of a woman named Jesef in 41 BBY, who Obi-Wan Kenobi failed to protect.
The Bognog was a Strike-class medium cruiser that was owned and operated by the Nami during the Galactic Civil War.
After the formation of the Galactic Empire from the Galactic Republic in the year 19 BBY, a planet was represented in the Imperial Senate by the Pho Ph'eahian senator Braxis.

Some time during the Galactic Civil War, the interstellar travel agency Galaxy Tours commenced a four-week Grand Galactic Tour holiday package to four planets, with the Kuari Princess acting as the luxury vessel ferrying its patrons across the galaxy.
The Changing of the Imperial Guard was a formal ceremony conducted by the Imperial Military at the Imperial Palace on Coruscant, which entailed changing shifts amongst several members of the guard.

The Coruscant underworld police (CUP) or Coruscant underground police, also simply underworld cops, was a special forces law enforcement section of the Coruscant Security Force patrolling the lower levels of the Galactic Republic capital planet Coruscant.
Atron was a planet located within the Atron system of the Mid Rim's Senex sector.

Judges of the Dead was a landmark located on the planet of Socorro, between Vakeyya and the Rym Mountains. At fifty meters tall each, its four rock formations were seen by the locals as resembling hooded women with faces hidden in sorrowful contemplation.
Cjaalysce'I was a city on the planet of Socorro. It had walls to prevent the winds of Jyalma, the Socorran windy season, from destroying the city.

Undrarian was a Krikthasi junieuw on the planet Baralou. The territory covered thousands of square kilometers and contained over 20 individual tribes. Undrarian was also the location of the Magl'Ikkan Temple.
Quadrant L-42 was a region in the undercity of the planet Coruscant. During the Galactic Civil War, the Besalisk Cho'pa'ailor operated a speeder repair shop in Quadrant L-42.

Trust Me was a starship that formed a part of a pirate gang that operated out of Darknon Station. At one point by the time of the Galactic Civil War, it and two other vessels of the gang laid an ambush on the Helix-class light interceptor Kizbon's Box; however, the latter inst…
Profit was a starship which was owned by the male individual named Druug and used as a pirate vessel during an ambush near the Space station, Darknon Station.

A male-patterned Human replica droid infiltrated the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. During its mission, the replica droid had its face damaged and killed a member of the Alliance. The droid's Human guise possessed light skin and brown hair.
The Justice was a Harrower-class dreadnought in the service of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.

This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their long snouts and buck teeth. In 4 ABY, at least one member of this species could be found in the city Wrils on the planet Svivren, and another in a casino on the planet Qiaxx.
The Black Talon Gang was a criminal gang led by the Human Shorran Dak that operated during the Clone Wars.
Talon's Wing was a starship that was operated by the Black Talon Gang, a criminal gang led by the Human Shorran Dak.

Cannus solix were a species of animal kept as pets during the reign of the New Republic. At least one cannus solix may have been entered into Sok Brok's Fiftieth Annual Pet Show, a pet show held on the planet Taris in 43 ABY.

A pre-planned ambush took place close to the space station Darknon Station on the Itani Run Hyperlane in the Inner Rim. The conflict involved three pirate vessels aiming to capture a Helix-class light interceptor.

t: Unidentified GR-75 medium transport (Invasion of Yavin 4)
x: During the late stages of the Galactic Empire's Attack on Yavin 4, a GR-75 medium transport aided in evacuating the Rebel leader, General Jan Dodonna, as well as Red Squadron members, Commanders Luke Skywalker and Wedge Antilles.

The Deddite was one of two BFF-1 bulk freighters sent to pick up a supply commerce consisting of several cargo containers being readied for shipment by CT-11 space tugs and deliver them to the Imperial fleet.

The Banthar was one of two BFF-1 bulk freighters sent to pick up a supply commerce consisting of several cargo containers being readied for shipment by CT-11 space tugs and deliver them to the Imperial fleet.
Void striders were a species that lived on the planet Abafar.
The Battle of Kalinda took place in the Kalinda system during the Galactic Civil War, in the times following the Battle of Endor.

CZ-198 was an exotic moon in the Unknown Regions that acted as a testing ground and laboratory for the Czerka Corporation during the time of the Galactic War. It was one of the most advanced product development facilities created by the corporation.
The Network Security District was an area on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
At some point before 32 BBY, a starship belonging to an extra-galactic spacer was forced to land on Tatooine after colliding with an asteroid of the Dragon's Spine belt.

t: Unidentified OOM command battle droid (discharge report)
x: During the Clone Wars, an OOM command battle droid led at least two B1-series battle droids on a desert planet resembling Tatooine.
During the Clone Wars, a B1 battle droid, alongside another B1-series battle droid, was led by an OOM command battle droid on a desert planet resembling Tatooine.
During the Clone Wars, a B1 battle droid, alongside another B1-series battle droid, was led by an OOM command battle droid on a desert planet resembling Tatooine.
IG-1000 was a TIE variant starfighter piloted by the assassin droid IG-88.
Sand rats were a type of rat, known for living in hiding. The Mandalorian Paz Vizsla compared his tribe residing in a hidden covert after the Great Purge of Mandalore to sand rats.
The Jedi Knight Jomar Chul flew a ship that he used to scout the Dromund system before he was chased out of the star system and shot down over the planet Tatooine.
The Pilgrim Retreat was a small camp in the Old Paths region of the planet Voss, located south of the Shrine of Healing.

The Republic Space Rangers were a body of armed beings affiliated with the Galactic Republic. They were notably trained in hand-to-hand combat. Zell, who became the ambassador of Majoor under the Galactic Empire, was a former elite Space Ranger.
Ramook was an agriworld located just beyond the far end of the Chiloon Rift.
The King's Ransom was a Tammuz-an transport captained by Jessica Meade.

Sechel's secret apartment was the secret apartment of Sechel, Darth Nyriss' advisor. In 3950 BBY Sechel was ambushed in his secret apartment by the Sith Lord Scourge and tortured for the files he had on the Nathema conspiracy.
Sarina was a desert planet where members of the Rebel Alliance operated. Rebels patrolled the planet on creatures called Sand hoppers.

XR was the personal droid assistant of Dr. Akary Smith. However, it ended up reprogrammed and armed by General Koong, and was tasked with capturing Smith, Jann Tosh, C-3PO, and R2-D2. However, R2 managed to outsmart the droid.
Squad Four was a unit of Imperial stormtroopers assigned to the M-Class Imperial Attack Transport Regina Cayli during the Galactic Civil War.
Squad Five, assigned to the M-Class Imperial Attack Transport Regina Cayli during the Galactic Civil War, was a unit of stormtroopers serving the Galactic Empire.

One of several throne rooms located in the Imperial Palace which served as one of the seats of power for Emperor Palpatine, this throne room was the setting for the final acts of the Anti-Sith conspiracy masterminded by Grand Moff Trachta.
An asteroid belt was located in the the Kalla system. It contained a number of luxurious homes built under pressure domes during an Authority fad.

Brejik's Run was an area in the Tularan Marsh on the planet Taris. Before the Destruction of Taris, the Tarisian Season Opener took place on a track in the area, and the section of the Marsh known as Brejik's Run was littered with the wreckage of swoop bikes that had been used…

The Archenar asteroid field was an asteroid field located in the Mid Rim. During the Cold War between Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, the Archenar asteroid field was the theater of a battle concluded with a Republic victory.
One of the throne rooms of the Imperial Palace on Coruscant served as the public seat of the Galactic Emperor from the foundation of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY at the end of the Clone Wars.

The Krayt Fang was a YT-1300 light freighter that belonged to Trex, a Trandoshan bounty hunter in the employ of Hutt Cartel crime lord Teemo. The Krayt Fang was docked at Landing Bay Aurek, in Mos Shuuta spaceport on Tatooine, with a broken hypermatter reactor igniter.

manufacturer: Local license, original design by General Spacetronics
x: During the Galactic Civil War, the smuggler Roark Garnet encountered a Janako model MaKing-class transport. A General Spacetronics design which was built under a local license, the Janako featured the rear flanges unique to that model of ship.
The gesaw rat was a small quadrupedal rodent from the moon of Carreras Minor. Gesaw rats had thick blue hides, and fed on power.
Ordnance disposal was a unit of the Coruscant Security Force. It was composed of bomb disposal experts who were responsible for detecting, securing, and disposing of explosives.

The Carreras Incident was a fleet action that took place in the Carreras system in the year 138 ABY. A blockade of Carreras starfighters was set up on the orders of Darth Wredd, who was posing as the Imperial Knight Yalta Val and was attempting to prevent any departure or arri…

The Nighthawks were a squad of boarding troopers that were commanded by Lieutenant Paling, and were a subdivision out of the Alliance Fleet "Storm Unit." The Nighthawks participated in Rebel assaults, such as at the Nomlis III Imperial Bretie Facility.
During the Raid at Bakura, this GR-75 medium transport, alongside two others, was involved in rescuing prisoners from Bakura.
During the Raid at Bakura, this GR-75 medium transport, alongside two others, was involved in rescuing prisoners from Bakura.
During the Raid at Bakura, this GR-75 medium transport, alongside two others, was involved in rescuing prisoners from Bakura. It was ambushed and destroyed late into the raid by Sarkli.
During the Galactic Civil War, a pirate group operated throughout the Sayblohn system. Their base was located in the Badlands of the planet Sayblohn.
A species of sentient grasshopper-like beings produced sound and speech by rubbing together their legs. Members of the species shared several bodies via single hive mind.

headquarters: NW Coromon Island 102, Northwest Coromons, Fresia
x: INCOM Corp. Customer Service Bureau was a part of the starship manufacturing Incom Corporation. It was located at NW Coromon Island 102, in the Northwest Coromons island chain on Fresia. Incom facilities were spread throughout the larger Coromon Islands group.
Sarrahban was a planet in the Sarrahban system, located within the Cyrillian Protectorate of the Expansion Region.
During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire invaded the planet Sarrahban as they refused to take sides in the war and attempted to remain neutral.

During the Galactic Civil War, a cell of Alliance to Restore the Republic partisans operated on the planet Sarrahban despite its neutrality. When the Galactic Empire invaded the planet, the cell evacuated aboard the freighter Harvest Moon.
This sentient species were dragon-like and had red skin. A member of this species was the associate of a reclusive assassin.

The Silver Star was a luxury liner operating during the Galactic Civil War. The vessel was the site of a meeting between an ambassador representing the provision government of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and the Gaddrian ambassador.
The Coruscant Benevolent Society was an organization which operated on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Republic.

The Space Slug was a Tallaan Clipper transport in use during the early days of the Galactic Empire. Both the Kedorzhan Senator Dewell Bronk and the Human Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi booked passage on the ship while trying to escape the planet Coruscant in 19 BBY.

The Death's Claw was a pirate organization that was active on the planets Taris and Rishi during the Cold War. Known for robbing anything that talked and shooting anything that didn't. While exploring Taris, they acquired relics that once belonged to the Jedi Covenant.

conflict: Early Imperial Period conflicts / Great Jedi Purge
x: The Ambush at Kestavel was an event that took place several months after the creation of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY, which nearly resulted in the assassination of the Empire's primary enforcer, Darth Vader.
Talss was the largest continent on the planet Tython. Also known as the Dark Continent, it was sparsely populated and wild.

Chukba was a Damotite mining village situated on the planet Lanteeb. The inhabitants of Chukba were at a disadvantage to those of the rival mining village Torbel, because they did not have knowledge of how to avoid suffering from the effects of Damotite poisoning.

Deebin was a Damotite mining settlement that was located on the Outer Rim planet Lanteeb. During the Separatist occupation of Lanteeb during the Clone Wars, the inhabitants of Deebin were at a disadvantage to the rival mining village Torbel, because they did not have knowledge…

Endvo was a mining village that was situated on the planet Lanteeb during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Endvo was one of various settlements on the world that mined Damotite, an ore that could be used to fuel plasma-refining plants.

Trahn was a Damotite mining village located on the planet Lanteeb. During the Clone Wars, Lanteeb was occupied by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Trahn and the rest of Lanteeb's Damotite mining industry was forced to supply the Separatists with large quantities of t…

Voteb was a remote settlement that was located on the Outer Rim planet Lanteeb. During the Clone Wars, the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker ventured to Lanteeb on a mission to counter the development of a Separatist bioweapon, and while on the world the pair disguised …
Faket was a world located in the Wild Space region of the galaxy. Faket was inhabited by the Drivoks, a species of psychic, sentient Humanoids.
The Chandrilan Security Bureau was an intelligence agency that operated on the planet Chandrila during the Clone Wars.

Coldstone Canyon was a canyon on the planet Hoth that was located southeast of the Starship Graveyard. The leaders of the White Maw pirate group gathered there for convocations to discuss serious matters affecting their entire organization.
Kestavel was a planet located in the Colonies, near Borleias. It was the location of The Lucky Twi'lek. The crew of the Uhumele ambushed Darth Vader there in 19 BBY.

The Dominator was a warship that was deployed by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, the Dominator was assigned to patrol near to the planet Kalarba, in order to dissuade the Confederacy of Independent Systems from attacking the world.
Nineball was the nickname given to the astromech droid associated with Jedi Knight Ohali Soroc in her search for the Mortis monolith.

The Yunu were a large, furred, sentient species native to Arkinnea. They lived in the planet's forests, and allied with the Jedi refugees led by Jedi Master K'Kruhk, helping them establish a secret temple there.
A Munificent-class star frigate served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Battle of Coruscant in 19 BBY.

The Unknown Regions warlike species known to the insectoid Quesoth as the Storm-hairs emerged from an Unknown Regions planet, led by the brutal Storm-hair Warlord Nuso Esva, and ravaged Unknown Regions and Wild Space.
Nilrebmah I was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. No life had ever evolved on the world; its terrain was largely desert plains. There were no moons in Nilrebmah I's orbit.

Nilrebmah II was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. The atmosphere of the world was fluorine-based. It's desert-covered surface was cratered, due to the fact that its atmosphere was filled with asteroids which made frequent impact on the surface.
Nilrebmah III was an uninhabited low-gravity planet of rocky plains in the Nilrebmah system.
Nilrebmah IV was a frozen planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet's atmosphere was methane-based, and no life had ever evolved on its frigid surface.

Nilrebmah V was a terrestrial world planet in the Nilrebmah system. Covered in seas filled with fish and crustaceans, the planet's atmosphere was oxygen-rich and breathable by the majority of species; though the planet never evolved sentient life.

Nilrebmah VI was once a planet in the Nilrebmah system. After some cataclysm in the galaxy's ancient past, the planet was reduced to rubble, forming a debris cloud where the planet once was. An exogorth was recorded as making its abode deep within the asteroid cloud.
Nilrebmah VII was a desert planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet's atmosphere was a mix of oxygen-nitrogen, and no life had ever evolved on its dry surface.
Nilrebmah VIII was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet's surface was tectonically unstable, with great storms of ash and fire worsening the erosion and blackening of the surface.

Nilrebmah IX was once a planet in the Nilrebmah system. After some cataclysm in the galaxy's ancient past, the planet was reduced to rubble, falling into its old orbit as an asteroid belt. Flocks of mynocks flitted about the belt.

Nilrebmah X was a rocky planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet's atmosphere of sulfur dioxide. Lacking any surface water, the planet was home to a silica-based life form that were capable of touching the Force.
Nilrebmah XI was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. A world with a chlorine-based atmosphere, Nilrebmah XI never developed any lifeforms.

Nilrebmah XII was a volcanic planet in the Nilrebmah system. The planet was in an unnatural state of tectonic activity, brought about by the machinations and experiments of Ku'ar Danar in the time of the Hundred-Year Darkness.

terrain: Shell formed 5,000 meters above the actual surface
x: Nilrebmah XIII was a planet in the Nilrebmah system. Following the experiments of Ku'ar Danar, Nilrebmah XIII had been moved into a lunar orbit over its neighbor, Nilrebmah XII.

Malastare's western continent was the western continent of the planet Malastare. After the Gran Protectorate was established around 1000 BBY, all unemployed Dugs on Malastare were forced to relocate to the western continent.

The Polar Wastes were a region on the ice planet of Akuria II. At some point, the Galactic Empire created a base here, and as did the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The natural Geyser Sea was also located in the Wastes.
