The Ghost was a modified VCX-100 light freighter owned by the Twi'lek Hera Syndulla that was used by the Spectres rebel cell during the Age of the Empire.
The siege of Niele was a conflict that was caused by the Biskaran Pirates in the vicinity of the Colonies' Niele system.

Base Prime was a research installation erected by Marvid and Craitheus Qreph on a monolith of unknown origin inside the Bubble of the Lost in the Chiloon Rift of the Wild Space. It housed the laboratories where the brothers conducted their experiments.
P-3B2 was a droid that worked in the cantina in the Sith Academy on the Sith homeworld of Korriban during the Cold War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Ocuvox were a species of winged animal found in the forests of the planet Wielu during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Carnage was a Harrower-class dreadnought and flagship of the Sith Lord Darth Achelon. During the Galactic War, the Carnage fought a Republic fleet over Corellia.

An unidentified starship was used as a scout ship by Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia Organa in 0 ABY to make contact with the Akuria Rebel Base. It was destroyed in the Akuria system by robotic TIE/LN starfighters and forced to crash-land on Akuria II.
TIE Squadron Four was a squadron of TIE/LN starfighters in the Imperial Navy of Grand Admiral Thrawn.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
objective: Acquire part of the Death Star plans
x: The Mission to Darkknell was an event occurring during the Galactic Civil War. It was during this mission that Senator Garm Bel Iblis uncovered evidence of the construction and existence of the Death Star.
During the Galactic Civil War, Raal Yorta utilized a starship that was owned by his father. It was destroyed by the Star Destroyer Aggressor over Bothawui.
The Ukunuku Killik Nest was the central nesting location of the Killiks of the Ukunuku hive. It was located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan.
H-8 was a droid present on Dromund Kaas around 3643 BBY, when it was destroyed by an Empire-affiliated individual.
X39-R32 was the designation of a battle droid which was around 3642 BBY located on Hoth inside Tromper Crags mineral mine, where it was destroyed.
R4-GL was the designation of a battle droid located inside the Network Security District on Nar Shaddaa, where it was destroyed around 3643 BBY.
The B0-2S Battle Droid was a Hutt battle droid which went berserk on Nar Shaddaa around 3642 BBY, when it was destroyed.
The Prototype Dx-2 Pyrodroid was the designation of a battle droid located on Corellia around 3640 BBY, when it was destroyed.
The Prototype Rk-4 Sentinel was the designation of a prototype battle droid of the Galactic Republic located on Corellia in 3640 BBY, when it was destroyed.
DS-224 Colossus was the designation of a battle droid located on Quesh around 3642 BBY, when it was destroyed.
OT-15 Eradicator Droid was the designation of a battle droid located on Balmorra around 3642 BBY, when it was destroyed.
OT-17 Eliminator Droid was the designation of a battle droid located on Balmorra around 3642 BBY, when it was destroyed.
CC-121 was the designation of a battle droid located on Makeb around 3638 BBY, when it was destroyed.
RG-L8R was the designation of a battle droid located on Makeb in 3638 BBY, when it was destroyed.
SD-0 was the designation of a battle droid located on Coruscant around 3643 BBY, when it was destroyed.
EV 3D3 was the designation of a battle droid located on Coruscant around 3643 BBY, when it was destroyed.
The B3-4T Disposal Droid was the designation of a battle droid located on Nal Hutta around 3643 BBY, when it was destroyed.
M-78 The Harvester was the designation of a battle droid located on Nal Hutta around 3643 BBY, when it was destroyed.

The Ryloth Senatorial Delegation was a body of diplomats who represented Ryloth and the other planets of the Gaulus sector in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic. The delegation consisted of a senator and their aides, although sometimes it was led by two co-senators.

t: Massacre at the Schenor research station
x: During the Galactic Civil War, mercenary forces, backed by the Galactic Empire, massacred the Schenor population on a research station.

The Senate chamber was an enormous chamber in the New Republic senatorial complex where the New Republic's Senate met. It was in this chamber where the fact that Darth Vader was senator Leia Organa's father was revealed.
The Raid on the Juno convoy was a Rebel ambush that occurred on the Imperial freighter group Juno after the events on Brigia.
The Destruction of the Invincible was the deciding event of Operation Strike Fear during the Galactic Civil War in the year 1 BBY.
The Floater Vehicles Department was a government agency on a planet that had been occupied by Imperial stormtroopers. The department was staffed by bureaucrats.

The House of Demesne was a noble house active during the Galactic Civil War. They ruled over a planet with wisdom and benevolence, and were loved by the people. The head of the House carried the title "Lord."
The Internal Counterintelligence Branch, known as IntCon, was a branch within Imperial Intelligence's Internal Organization Bureau.
The Analysis section was one of three units within the Imperial Intelligence's Internal Organization Bureau's Internal Counterintelligence Branch.
The Operations section was one of three units within the Imperial Intelligence's Internal Organization Bureau's Internal Counterintelligence Branch.
The Intelligence section was one of three units within the Imperial Intelligence's Internal Organization Bureau's Internal Counterintelligence Branch.
Interrogation was a branch of Imperial Intelligence's Analysis Bureau. Interrogation was the destination of all enemy agents captured by Imperial Intelligence.

Sedition was a division of Imperial Intelligence. It specialized in knowledge and predictions on organized resistance to the Galactic Empire and the New Order. As resentment to the Empire grew during the Galactic Civil War, so did the size of Sedition.

A sector branch was the basic division of Imperial Intelligence. Each sector within the Galactic Empire had a branch, and each branch had a pool of experts from which the Sedition and Crisis branches drew operatives from in times of need depending on the situation.

External Communications, known also as ExComm, was a division of Imperial Intelligence. It was used to manage the equipment that relayed emergency or high priority messages between the various bureaus of Imperial Intelligence, the Ubiqtorate, and the Imperial Military that req…

Surveillance was a branch of Imperial Intelligence's Bureau of Operations. Unlike their Commission for the Preservation of the New Order counterpart, Surveillance was a relatively small operation, with one agent for every seventy employed by COMPNOR.

Infiltration was a branch of Imperial Intelligence's Bureau of Operations. After their initial training and indoctrination—which included the use of Mnemiotic drugs—Infiltration agents were assigned to serve with Intelligence, sector branches, or Sedition.

Assassination was a branch of Imperial Intelligence's Bureau of Operations. As assassination was seen as a legitimate means of removing key members of the opposition, Assassination personnel were embraced with the rest of Imperial Intelligence.
Al'Moab III was the third world in the Al'Moab system. A relatively imposing planet, Al'Moab III was mostly covered in deserts. However, that had not prevented the colonization of the land.

The Awards Auditorium of the Imperial Palace on Coruscant served as a place for the Galactic Emperor to present awards to various personnel from the Imperial Military's various branches for tremendous service to the Galactic Empire from its construction circa 18 BBY until the …

Storm Squad was a squad in service of the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. It was stationed on the Dorin's Sky when it was attacked by an Imperial boarding party and most of its members were killed in action.
Annihilator 6K-A2 was the designation of a Colicoid battle droid that organized war games on the behalf of the Colicoid Creation Nest. It was destroyed around 3642 BBY.
Operator IX was the designation of a battle droid that was destroyed on Asation around 3639 BBY.
X1-02 was the designation of a astromech droid of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. It relayed to Imperial forces a transmission from Darth Malgus.
VT-N9 was the designation of a astromech droid used by the Sith Empire during the Cold War. It relayed to Imperial forces an urgent transmission from Darth Malgus.
TM-09 was the designation of a security droid tasked as a warden team leader on the Belsavis by the Rakata.
TC-93 was an astromech droid belonging to Republic Strategic Information Service agent Carina during the Cold War. She formed an attachment to him and refused to perform memory wipes on him.
T6-B9 was the designation of a astromech droid located on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
R6-D0 was the designation of a astromech droid residing on the Vaiken Spacedock during the Cold War. It relayed to Imperial forces a transmission from Darth Malgus regarding the situation on Athiss.

PO-12 was the designation of a protocol droid, located within the weapons lab of Lord Grathan's estate on Dromund Kaas, during the Cold War. He boasted that he was fluent in over 100 forms of communications and dialects.
PD-44 was the designation of a battle droid of the reconstituted Sith Empire stationed on Taral V during the Cold War. It was destroyed around 3642 BBY.
N4-71 was the designation of an Imperial astromech droid stationed on Belsavis during the Cold War.

I-M3 was the designation of a battle droid of the reconstituted Sith Empire deployed on Balmorra during the Galactic War. The droid was destroyed in combat, but its remains were scavenged by Galactic Republic technicians.
IK-4C was the designation of a combat battle droid serving the reconstituted Sith Empire deployed to Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic.

E5-D5 was the designation of a utility droid of the Balmorran resistance working on Balmorra during the Galactic War. It was a sole survivor of a disaster mission and was begging Sheed to mount an effort to recover the supplies that were lost to enemy during the ambush.
DX-AX was battle a droid residing on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. It was part of DX annihilator network.
Xenoanalyst II was the designation of a Gree battle droid that was present in 3638 BBY aboard the Gray Secant. It was programmed to challenge visitors to combat for ability evaluation.
Titan 6 was the designation of a battle droid that was destroyed on Darvannis around 3638 BBY.

Mentor was the self-given name of a droid consciousness that became self-aware around 3640 BBY and started planning a droid revolution. As one of the founders of the Directive 7 movement, he set up a base on the moon Zadd in the Unknown Regions.

t: State of the Galactic Civil War
place: Imperial Palace Audience Chamber, Imperial Palace, Coruscant
x: In 3 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Emperor, Palpatine made a speech regarding the state of the war.
During the Zaarin insurgency and the finalizations of his trap on Endor, the Emperor used this throne room of the Imperial Palace on Coruscant to meet with various officers for pressing matters.
The mission at Argoon was the first battle of the Battle on the Frontier campaign of the Galactic Civil War.
The Destruction of the Pakuuni Pirates was a conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Pakuuni Pirates group during the Battle on the Frontier campaign of the Galactic Civil War.
a: First Battle of the Pakuuni system

x: The Rebel Alliance launched a series of attacks on Imperial forces in 3 ABY as they attempted to construct the space station Platform NL-1 in the Pakuuni system.
a: Second Battle of the Pakuuni system
Third Battle of the Pakuuni system

x: The Battle of the minefield was a conflict during the Battle for Honor campaign during the Galactic Civil War.
The First Battle for DS 5 was an engagement during the Battle for Honor campaign during the Galactic Civil War.
The second battle of DS 5 was a conflict during the Battle for Honor campaign in the Galactic Civil War.
The third battle of DS 5 was a conflict during the Battle for Honor campaign during the Galactic Civil War.
The fourth battle of DS 5 was the final engagement in the Battle for Honor campaign during the Galactic Civil War.

The battle of Yn was a conflict between the Sith Empire and armies of Jedi and rebels, who faced the Sith Lord Tulak Hord. During Hord's campaigns on the planet Yn and the Jedi-held world of Chabosh, he rejected the Sith Lord Aloysius Kallig's offer to battle beside him.

The MC80 Home One type Star Cruiser Independence contained an awards auditorium, for awarding its personnel various medals for their service to the Rebel Alliance. Mon Mothma frequently presented the medals to the members of the awarded personnel in person.
The capture of the Zeplin was a battle fought during the Zaarin insurrection.

Zaarin's fleet was a fleet of former Imperial Navy warships that acted as rogue Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's government military. Originally, it was a unit of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Military, but joined Zaarin after his betrayal and fought in his insurrection.
The Capture of the Link was a battle fought during the Zaarin insurrection.
The Recovery of the Sealion was a battle fought during the Zaarin insurrection.
The Emperor's special reserve guard was a starfighter squadron that served as a reserve guard for Emperor Palpatine.

Eta Squadron was an Imperial Navy squadron of TIE/sa bombers in the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, they fought rogue Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's forces in his insurrection. They also engaged Nharwaak forces at Mylok IV.

Alpha Squadron was an Imperial Navy squadron of TIE/D Defenders serving the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, they engaged rogue Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's forces in his insurrection.

Pi Squadron was an Imperial Navy unit serving the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. They fought rogue Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's splinter government forces during the Zaarin insurrection.

Tau Squadron was a starfighter squadron of TIE pilots serving the Galactic Empire's navy during the Galactic Civil War. They fought rogue Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's coup forces during an insurrection.

Zeta Squadron was an Imperial Navy unit that flew TIE/sa bombers for the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, they fought rogue Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's splinter government fleet in his insurrection.
Z-Alpha Squadron was a TIE/sa bomber unit originally in the Imperial Navy that defected to rogue Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's government fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

Z-Alpha Squadron was a TIE/ad starfighter unit in the Imperial Navy that defected to rogue Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's splinter government fleet during the Galactic Civil War. In the Zaarin insurrection, they fought the Galactic Empire but were ultimately defeated.

Z-Theta Squadron was an Imperial Navy starfighter squadron that defected to Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin's rogue government forces during the Galactic Civil War. In the Zaarin insurrection, they fought against the Galactic Empire but were ultimately defeated.
The Stardogs were a group of Galactic Republic military veterans who came out of retirement to fight against the Sith Empire during the Cold War.
The Grand Ballroom was the main ballroom aboard the luxury liner Kuari Princess. The ship's orchestra played soothing subharmonic music to allow passengers to dance.
The Royal Suite was a deluxe stateroom aboard the luxury liner Kuari Princess.

A centennial feast celebrating the Hutt Bakuush was held in Bakuush's palace on the planet Nal Hutta sometime before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, and orpali dragons were among the delicacies on the menu.

Orpali dragons were a rare species of lizard that was considered a delicacy by the Hutts. Orpali dragons were bred and grown in captivity, killed in infancy, and then traditionally served on a bed of glazed chuba eyes.

A Sessehshellah village was located on the Expansion Region planet Shaymore. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Empire's forces razed the village in retaliation for Rebel Alliance–backed activity carried out against an Imperial patrol by the native Sessehshellah.

During the Galactic Civil War, Fandar headed a organization of pirates. They attempted to raid an Imperial treasury ship with the Alliance to Restore the Republic, but Fandar's right-hand man betrayed them and they were led into a trap.
A corvette served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. While being chased by a Star Destroyer, both ships were captured by an extra-galactic species.

t: Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Rebel Alliance corvette)
x: During the Galactic Civil War, an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire at one point pursued a Rebel Alliance corvette. During the pursuit, which took both starships into unknown space, a fathership of an extragalactic species appeared and captured the two vessels.
The Galactic Empire employed a treasure ship to collect and transport the revenues of a sector to the capital.
During the Battle of Hoth, the Galactic Empire deployed a transport to the far side of a ridge overlooking Echo Base in an attempt to flank the Alliance to Restore the Republic forces.

The Infernal Council was the name of a group of Sith Purebloods who had been slaves of Soa during his reign thousands of years before the Galactic Republic was formed. They were imprisoned in stasis with him in the Eternity Vault on Belsavis.
G4-B3 Heavy Fabricator was a labor droid guardian of the Karagga's Palace on Nal Hutta. It was destroyed around 3639 BBY.
T-CR8 was a droid which resided on Tatooine, where it sold armor, as well as armor upgrades and materials, in a small shop.

Galactic Alliance Infantry Scouts were light infantry soldiers in the Galactic Alliance Army. They wore light blue uniforms, black boots, orange pauldrons, and helmets. Unlike the Galactic Alliance Infantry Troopers, the scouts had virtually no armor.

The Lumrunner was the personal PB-950 patrol boat of the space pirate Shamus Falconi. He inherited the ship from his grandmother. The Lumrunner was over 300 years old when his grandmother captured it at the beginning of her pirate career.

The ISS-7 Guardian Battledroid was a battle droid model in service of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY it was stationed aboard the Emperor's Glory guarding the tractor beam control console.
A type of troop transport that was used by the Mere Resistance prior to the Clone Wars.
The Kimogila's Claw was a YT-1300 light freighter that operated during the Galactic Civil War.

H2-A0 was an astromech droid that resided on Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. There, it managed a small shop, where it also provided the knowledge of cybernetics construction to others.

R-R09 was a droid that resided on the planet of Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. There, it managed a small shop, where it also provided the knowledge of cybernetics construction to others.
Sedratis City was situated in the Sedratis system of the Core Worlds. It contained the Sedratis Coliseum, and Demelza's Destructors were the city's premier gladiator walker combat team.
Anyat-en was a location on the planet Poln Minor.
Lisath-re was a location on the planet Poln Minor.

During the first year of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Alliance forces under General Rahm Kota conducted a mission to the planet Kuat, where they were aided by Captain Juno Eclipse.

During the first year of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Alliance forces under General Rahm Kota conducted a mission to the planet Selonia, where they were aided by Captain Juno Eclipse.

During the first year of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Alliance forces under General Rahm Kota conducted a mission to the planet Druckenwell, where they were aided by Captain Juno Eclipse.
The jungle bantha was a subspecies of bantha.
JT-02 was a protocol droid owned by Jordel Tlan on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
CN-94 was an astromech droid in service of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War, found on Nar Shaddaa around 3643 BBY.
GH-5B2 was a GH Maintenance Droid which worked in the sewers below Eyar City and was owned by Eyar Treatment Systems.

The Spotrunner was a Galactic Republic scout ship. During an expedition into the depths of the Unknown Regions, a Mnggal-Mnggal outbreak occurred on Spotrunner which lead to the death of the entire crew.
At one point around 3643 BBY, an ancient frigate emerged, well-preserved by the vacuum of space but adrift and unresponsive, in the Outer Rim Territories' Kalki Nebula.

A nameless moon was located in the Unknown Regions. At some point by approximately 3643 BBY, a terrible naval battle was fought above the moon between forces of two cults—the Knell of Muspilli, a death cult from the Unknown Regions location known as the Gunninga Gap, and the W…
The Warriors of Shadow were an all-female cult that was an offshoot of the Taung civilization, also known as the Warriors of the Shadow.

place: Unknown Regions, above a unnamed moon
x: Sometime after 200,000 BBY, two cults—the female Taung sisterhood known as the Warriors of Shadow and the death cult Knell of Muspilli—battled each other in a terrible naval battle above a unnamed moon in the Unknown Regions.
Nudskutch was a settlement on Gamorr. During the Galactic Civil War, it and the surrounding region was controlled by the warlord Rog and his wife, the Matron Gundruk.

Bolgoink was a settlement located on the Wugguh continent of Gamorr. The village was controlled by the Bolgoink clan, who maintained a clan hold in the settlement ruled by Matron Kufbrug during the Galactic Civil War.

PL-40112-CE-021105 was a planet located in the Salfrem system, within the forbidden Wild Space sector known as the Wastes. The planet was the home of Bertroff Hissa, a Human-Sephi hybrid who ended up becoming Grand Moff of the Galactic Empire.

The Rozzum were a species of sentient aliens who came from another dimension than that of the known universe. They had ties to the Order of the Terrible Glare, a group of dissident Jedi Knights formed during the Pius Dea Crusades.

Off-Worlders' Quarter was a city on the planet Ropagi II. Technically not a quarter, but a city on its own, it was located in a large natural bay on the continent of Forethought. All off-worlders had to report here before being cleared to the rest of the planet.
Balarik was a major city on the planet Ropagi II.
Kaloder was a major city on the planet Ropagi II.
Ropagis was a major city on the planet Ropagi II.
Tev was a major city on the planet Ropagi II.
Torvane was a major city on the planet Ropagi II.
Yaloris was a planet. The Yalor were the native sentient species of the planet.

t: Attack on a Sienar Fleet Systems board member's home
place: Home of a Sienar Fleet Systems board member
x: An attack was made on the home of one of the board members of the Sienar Fleet Systems starship design company by rebel terrorists during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
The Radnoran research labs were research laboratories located on the planet of Radnor.

The colony creature was a sentient species that resided in the oceans of the planet Mon Calamari. The creature was made up of billions of independent cells that shared a collective consciousness, and it could also exert a weak form of mind control that enabled it to control th…

During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the rogue MI-series security droid, MI-726, attacked an Imperial factory. During the attack, the droid verbally assaulted a security guard working at the facility, before setting off an explosion that destroyed the factory.
Moap's office was a small office maintained by the Kitonak crime broker Moap in the mid-levels of Nar Shaddaa's cityscape.

The siege of Kaleth happened during Rajivari's purges after the fallen Jedi Master Rajivari was killed in his attempt to murder his fellow Masters and reshape the Jedi Order which he had co-founded, and his followers barricaded in Rajivari's fortress of Kaleth, where they put …

The Reckoning was a YT-1300 light freighter owned by the Wookiee bounty hunter Granakk. Its hull was stronger than a stock YT-1300, and it was upgraded with heavy deflector shields and an assault laser cannon, which replaced the laser cannon on the standard freighter model.
JT-05 was an astromech droid owned by Jordel Tlan on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
JT-10 was a bodyguard droid bodyguard owned by Jordel Tlan on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
JT-11 was a bodyguard droid bodyguard owned by Jordel Tlan on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
The Miniad was the modified FA-504s transport used by Nir Rinit during his tenure on the planet Naalol.

objective: Rescue three Ysanna chieftains
x: The Mission to Vjun was carried out in 11 ABY by Jedi Master Luke Skywalker and three fellow Jedi in order to rescue three Ysanna chieftains captured by the Dark Empire. Luke used Force lightning to ensure the victory of the Jedi.

The Frostflower Path was a roadway that ran along the coastline in the Alsakan Lowlands on the planet Alderaan, continuing from the Wooded Valley in the Apalis Coast to the west. The area was inhabited by creatures such as nerfs, manka cats, bolraidas and flutterplumes.

The Serene Meadow was a meadow in the Alsakan Lowlands, a region on the planet Alderaan. It was home to a number of nerfs, vorn tigers, and iraidas, and both Wardpost Duvaal and the estate of House Teraan were located on the meadow.

The Apalis Fields was a series of farm fields along the Apalis Coast, just north of the Seaside Windfarms. The fields were west of the Organa Vinerium, which used the harvest from the Apalis Fields to produce wine for House Organa.
The Deforested Slopes was the name given to the northern part of the Wooded Valley in the Apalis Coast on the planet Alderaan after the forces of House Thul cut down the area's trees.

The Foothill Paths was an area of grassland and foothills on the planet Alderaan. It was considered part of the Apalis Coast and troops loyal to the House of Organa, whose estate was built nearby, were stationed in the area throughout the Cold War.
The Seaside Windfarms was an area of the Apalis Coast on Alderaan. It was inhabited by such creatures as nerfs, bolraidas and flutterplumes.

The Wooded Valley was located south of Castle Organa on the Apalis Coast of the planet Alderaan, and was the site of the main roadway between the House Organa estate and the Alsakan Lowlands to the east.

The Frostlined Trail was a path that ran along the southeastern side of the Glarus Valley, on the south side of the Fornaak River. It spanned most of the valley, from the Juran Mountains to past the Elysium.
The Frostrock Promontory was an area of the Glarus Valley on Alderaan. It was inhabited by such creatures as nerfs, manka cats, and flutterplumes.
Mount Sendoth was a mountain located in the Glarus Valley on Alderaan.
The Salvation was a CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle manufactured by the Corellian Engineering Corporation.
Aath's slave compound was a slave compound run by Haast Aath for Riboga the Hutt on the planet Tharados.

Drop Point: Condor was the codename of a Rebel Alliance drop point located in System M132L4. It was operational for the duration of Operation Nighthook, and specific communications channels were monitored from 0200 to 0600 each standard day.

Eagle's network was a terrorist group led by Eagle during the Cold War, that was secretly backed by Darth Jadus. Later known as the Eradicator network, it included cells on a number of planets, such as Tholatin, Molavar, Balmorra, Alderaan, Tatooine, and Nar Shaddaa.

During the Cold War the Ghost cell made their base of operations in a Tatooine Village. Its location was secret, all new recruits brought in had no idea of is exact location. The supplies were delivered to the village by smuggler called Dragon Eyes operating in Mos Ila.
The Regulator Command Center was a major base of the InterStellar Regulators on Aboro Mesa on the planet Makeb.
The Republic Medical Corps was a specialist corps in the Republic Military which provided medical services. One notable unit was the Second Battalion.

The Second Battalion of the Republic Medical Corps, more commonly known as the Protectors, was a humanitarian division that served alongside the Republic Military on battlefields across the galaxy, conducting rescue, reconnaissance, and evacuation operations to help civilians …
This RA-7 protocol droid worked at the Sundari shipping docks on Mandalore in 20 BBY. As it inspected the shipping crates at the docks, it detected a presence inside of a crate.
By 3643 BBY, a survey team discovered an ancient Sith oubliette in catacombs on the planet Dromund Fels.
House Organa was the estate of the House of Organa on the Apalis Coast of the planet Alderaan. Castle Organa served as the heart of the estate.
Northern Cliffs was a name given to a range of cliffs located in the Glarus Valley on Alderaan.
Southern Cliffs was a name given to a range of cliffs located in the Glarus Valley on Alderaan.
Riparian Bluffs was a name given to an area of bluffs located in the Glarus Valley on Alderaan. The Panteer Refuge of House Panteer was located near that area.
Silvan Hills was a range of hills located in the Glarus Valley on Alderaan.
The Thul Command Bunker was a military outpost of the Sith Empire located in the Glarus Valley on Alderaan.

Alsakan Crossing was the name given to a pair of bridges that linked the northeastern corner of the Alsakan Lowlands to the Juran Mountains on the planet Alderaan. The bridge spanned the Fornaak River, and was located at the western base of Mount Tessef.
The contested valley was a valley in the Juran Mountains on the planet Alderaan that saw significant fighting during the planet's civil war.
The Evergreen Crags was a region in the northwestern Juran Mountains on the planet Alderaan, situated north of the Glarus Bridges.
The Glarus Bridges was a name of bridges over a ravine located in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan.

The Highland Trail was a roadway that ran through the Juran Mountains on the planet Alderaan, starting at the Juran Crossroads at the southwestern corner of the House Alde estate and running north up the Juran Pass.
Juran Crossroads was the name of a road intersection area located in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan.
Juran Pass was the name of a mountain pass located in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan.
The Kingsroad Dale was an area located in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan, near King's Pass.

The Audacity was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that saw action during the Clone Wars. As of 0 ABY, it was still active (albeit badly damaged) by Tag Rogaren, who encountered Leia Organa in the ruined remains of Alderaan and gave her permission to board.

There were peace negociations that took place at Hsskhor, capital of the planet Trandosha, between representatives of the Trandoshans and the Wookiees from the neighboring Kashyyyk in an effort to end their ancestral conflict.

The Whispering River was a waterway on the forest moon of the planet Endor. When the Dulok King Vulgarr planned to kidnap the woklings of the Ewok settlement known as Bright Tree Village, he created a distraction for the village's warriors by directing them to follow the route…
Kitinitik Killik Slopes was the name of a Kitinitik Killik nest habitat located in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan.
Lowlands Road was a road located in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan that led toward the Alsakan Lowlands.
Mount Tessef was the name of a mountain located in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan.
Mount Ulgo was the name given to a mountain in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan. The Ulgo Fortress was built on the mountain and its slopes, and a tunnel was built through the mountain.
Mount Tessef Ruins was the name given to ruins located in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan. Around 3963 BBY the ruins were occupied by House Rist forces led by Commander Rak.

The overrun mining path was a road in Alderaan's Juran Mountains that led to a nearby lanthanide mine, but was overrun by Killiks. Captain Ascercia and Sergeant Virne were stationed in the area at one point around 3643 BBY.
Rugged Headland was the name of an area located in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan.
Snowdrift Path was the name of a mountain path located in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan. The entrance to House Rist Bunker was located in this area.
Sunny Vale was the name of an area located in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan.
The Twisted Paths was the name given to an area in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan that was affected by a buried Seed of Rage.
The Woodland Path was a small path that ran through the Juran Mountains of the planet Alderaan to the northeast of Mount Anzaada.

Drovis Cave or Drovis Cavern was a cave located in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan. Around 3643 BBY the cave was used by assassins affiliated with House Rist as their base of operations. The cave was infiltrated by an Imperial individual, who confronted Vessex Ulgo.

The Lanthanide Mine was a mine located in the Juran Mountains on Alderaan that at one point was used for lanthanide production. It was eventually abandoned and by c. 3643 BBY was inhabited by the Killiks of Ukunuku nets, led by a Night Herald.
The Alsiri Lowlands was an area located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan.
The Alsiri Pass was the name of a mountain pass located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan.
The Infested Vale was the name of an area located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan. Oroboro Killik Caverns could be found in this area.
Juran Ascent was the name of a road located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan that lead towards Juran Mountains.
Mount Anzaada was the name of a mountain located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan.
Fornaak River was the name of a river flowing through the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan.
Fornaak Falls was the name of a waterfall on the Fornaak River located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan. Nearby was the entrance to the Fornaak Falls Cavern.

Laria was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Rseik sector. By 3643 BBY, dozens of star-charts, accompanied by notes in a forgotten language, had been stored in computer banks inside ancient ruins on Laria.
The Alderaan Peace Summit was a peace summit held by Jedi Master Sidonie Garen in an attempt to bring an end to the Alderaan Civil War amongst the Great Houses of Alderaan.

Hoogon Two was an astronomical object located in the Dantus sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the site of a supposed monument built by the founder of the Sacred Way, a religious organization.
The Tyrant was the flagship of Darth Tormen in the beginning of the Galactic War. It was captained by a Human named Evlen.
The Northern Trail was the name of an area located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan.

The Organa dig site was the name of a cave located in Kaamos Territory on Alderaan. Around 3643 BBY, a science team of House of Organa residing in the cave held an old holocron retrieved by Jedi, with incriminating evidence against House Thul.
Organa Surveillance Camp was a military installation of House Organa located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan around 3643 BBY.
The Pestilence Pond was the name of a body of water located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan.
The Resistance Ridge was the name of an area located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan.
The Riverside Graze was the name of an area located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan.
Sabas Killik Hives was the name of an area located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan that was inhabited by the Killiks of Sabas hive.
The Southern Trail was the name of an area located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan.
Tranquil Glen was the name of an area located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan.
Lanar Resupply Camp was the name of an area located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan.
The Thul research camp was a House Thul installation located in the Kaamos Territory on Alderaan. Among the personnel stationed there were Lieutenant Sorchka, Miles, Rehmar Thul and Yudin Thul.
The Ruur Killik Burrows was a cave network in the mountains of King's Pass on the planet Alderaan that was inhabited by the Ruur Killik hive.
The Aesea Killik Hives was a series of Killik nests and a cave system in the Glarus Valley on Alderaan that was inhabited by Killiks of the Aesea hive.

The Anzaada Cavern was a cavern within Mount Anzaada, a mountain on the border of the Juran Mountains and Kaamos Territory on the planet Alderaan. The cavern was filled with ancient ruins, and was the only way of reaching the summit of the mountain.
Duwan Pass was the name of an area located within the King's Pass on Alderaan.
Dassel Pass was the name of an area located within the Glarus Valley on Alderaan.

The Sendoth Ruins was a series of ancient structures that lay in ruins by the time of the Cold War. Located atop Mount Sendoth in the Glarus Valley of the planet Alderaan, the ruins were the site of the Alderaan Peace Summit between the Great Houses of Alderaan.
The Moraine Gulch was the name given to the northwestern part of the Gorinth Canyon on the planet Balmorra, the part of the canyon that bordered on the Moraine Territory.
The Sobrikarill Valley was a valley located in the Gorinth Canyon on Balmorra, just outside the city of Sobrik.

Sometime after the start of 0 ABY, the Far Orbit attempted to raid a Santhe/Sienar Technologies shipment, which was guarded by a TIE Advanced x1. The crew of the Far Orbit aimed to capture the TIE with their ion weaponry, and add it to their starfighter complement.
An Imperial Base was located on Naboo's moon of Rori during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

t: 25th anniversary of the settling of the Alderaan Ascendancy Contention
x: The 25th anniversary of the settling of the Alderaan Ascendancy Contention took place in 3 BBY during the Imperial Era.
Visseon II was an Alliance to Restore the Republic cruiser operating during the Galactic Civil War. It participated in an ambush of an Imperial convoy in the Laramus system.
Lefken's Dreams was a light freighter captained by Rars Lefken during the Galactic Civil War.
The fire-control chamber was located aboard Centerpoint Station. It was from here that the station would be fired.

The Transtom was an Imperial fuel container active during the Galactic Civil War. It was destroyed while en route to the main fleet. Its loss was reported in the Imperial Commission on the Conduct of the War.

EV-8D3 was an EV-series supervisor droid who was figurehead of the New Droids' Rights Movement, a group of droids that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against organic life forms throughout the galaxy.
R2-B7 was a droid that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against organic life forms throughout the galaxy.

Gavos was a small planet located in the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim. It was the location of a poorly productive oridium mining operation that was won in a game of sabacc sometime during the Galactic Civil War by Bargos the Hutt—a gambling, middle-ranked Hutt Cartel crime lo…
The Narrows was an area located in the Gorinth Canyon on Balmorra.
The Gorinth Plateau, also known as the Gorinth Wilds or the Windswept Plateau, was a plateau that bordered the southern side of the Gorinth Canyon on Balmorra.
Talon's Reach was a training outpost located in a canyon off Outpost Victory in the Gorinth Canyon on the planet Balmorra.
Workshop A6 was a location within the Troida Military Workshop in Gorinth Canyon on Balmorra used as a base by the Balmorran resistance during the reconstituted Sith Empire's occupation of Balmorra.
The Kag'areth Queen's Nest was an abandoned facility located in a canyon branching off of Outpost Victory, a military outpost of the Balmorran resistance in the Gorinth Canyon on the planet Balmorra.
Karill River was a river flowing through the Gorinth Canyon on Balmorra.
Overgrown Trail was the name of an area located in the Gorinth Canyon on Balmorra.
Karill Village was a village located on the Karill River in the Gorinth Canyon on Balmorra.
The Grassy Fields was the name of an area located in the Markaran Plains on Balmorra.
The Balmorran resistance listening post was located in the Markaran Plains on Balmorra and managed by techinicians Jalba and Prand.

The Markaran Wastes, also known as Spire Swamp, was an area in the northern Markaran Plains on the planet Balmorra that became a toxic swamp after the Traken-4 ChemWorks plant on the area's northern edge was damaged during the Battle of Balmorra.
The Stillwater Bend was the name of an area located in the Markaran Plains on Balmorra.
The Stillwater Estuary was the name of an area located in the Markaran Plains on Balmorra.

Lower Markaran Outpost, originally Markaran Imperial Outpost, was an outpost of the Sith Empire located in the Markaran Plains on Balmorra. Lieutenant Thorpe, Fixer 66, Science Officer Garboza, and Toybox were stationed at the outpost.

Upper Markaran Outpost, originally Remote Markaran Outpost, was an outpost of the Sith Empire located in the Markaran Plains on Balmorra. Colonels Proshen and Teeg, Commander Moriden, Captain Jaggard, and Intelligence Officer Kytoma were stationed at the outpost.

Box Canyon was a small canyon located on the southeastern edge of the Sundari Flatlands on Balmorra. The Galactic Republic established the Upper Sundari Outpost in the canyon, which was relatively hidden from the rest of the war-torn area.
The Barasin Refuse Yards was an area located in the Sundari Flatlands on Balmorra.
Lower Sundari Outpost, originally known as Sundari Imperial Outpost, was an outpost located on the south edge of the Sundari Flatlands on the planet Balmorra.
The Resistance Village was a name given to a village of the Balmorran resistance located in the Sundari Flatlands on Balmorra.
The Rakata Transport Center was the modern designation for the Rakata transporter that was located in a cave off of the Outer Wastes in the Ancient Prison Caverns on the planet Belsavis.
The Outer Wastes was an area located in the Ancient Prison Caverns on Belsavis.
The Passage to the Scar was a passageway that linked the Ancient Prison Caverns to the Scar, a canyon that was spanned by a volcanic rift.
The Power Center cavern was one of the ice caverns known collectively as the Ancient Prison Caverns on Belsavis.
The Maximum Security Power Center was an area located in the Ancient Prison Caverns on Belsavis. It contained an emergency reset to one of Belsavis prison's shield generators.

The Esh-kha vault was one of many Rakatan vaults constructed on the planet Belsavis to contain the Esh-kha. This particular vault was located in the Outer Wastes of the Ancient Prison Caverns, and Captain Black led his unit on an ill-fated mission into the vault.
The Key Keeper's Lair was an area located in the Ancient Prison Caverns on Belsavis.
Stasis vault 109 was a security storage area located in the Ancient Prison Caverns on Belsavis. Cathar Prince Shange and others were kept in stasis there for over 20 years.

Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT was a unit of sixty Zero-G assault stormtroopers commanded by Sergeant Clayton Balrog. The unit was stationed aboard a Star Destroyer during the Galactic Civil War, and was split into Strike Force One and Strike Force Two during missions.

Strike Force One was a combat element of Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT. Strike Force One, alongside Strike Force Two, were deployed to assault the pirate Victory-class Star Destroyer GrimDeath I during the Galactic Civil War.

Strike Force Two was a combat element of Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT. During the Galactic Civil War, Strike Force Two, alongside Strike Force One, were employed to assault the pirate Victory-class Star Destroyer GrimDeath I.

The GrimDeath I was a converted Victory-class Star Destroyer, used as a pirate vessel during the Galactic Civil War. It staged raids in the Woldona system before heading to Galpos II, and was suspected to be linked with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Duel on Rattatak was a brief skirmish between Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker and the Dark Jedi Asajj Ventress in the Rattatak arena known as The Cauldron. After a fierce lightsaber duel, Anakin eventually defeated the Dathomirian assailant.
Alien Gangland was an area located in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
A Rakata vault was located in the Alien Gangland, a region of the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison. It was partially excavated by Republic forces.
The Southern Rakata Transporter was a Rakata teleporter located in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Gran Confinement was an area for Gran prisoners located in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Gran Exile was an area located in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Hunter's Blind was a region of the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison. It was used to incarcerate Trandoshan prisoners, and was the site of a Rakatan vault.
The Trandoshan vault was a security vault overtaken by Trandoshan prisoners located in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
Kovsky River was a river flowing through the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
MaxSec Main Access was the main roadway that linked the High Security Section of the planet Belsavis to the Maximum Security Section. The Tertiary Monitoring Station was located along the roadway.
The Prison Maintenance Facilities were the main industrial and maintenance facilities of the Galactic Republic's detention complex located in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Rattataki Battlewoods was a wooded area in the northern side of the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison.

Rattataki Block Alpha was a prison block for Rattataki prisoners located in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison. It was located beneath the Republic watchtower on the eastern side of the High Security Section.
Rodian Internment was a part of the Republic's detention complex located in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison.

The Tusker Glade was an area located in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison on the planet Belsavis. The Imperial Command Post utilized by Special Operations Group Four during the Invasion of Belsavis was located in this area.
The Prison Geothermal Collectors were a part of the Republic's detention complex located in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Sith Lord Raxxus was incarcerated in a personal cell block in the High Security Section of Belsavis prison, a Republic prison complex located on the planet Belsavis.

The Republic watchtower was a part of the Republic's detention complex located in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison. Following the prison break, it housed an outpost of Republic forces, including Colonel Hauer, Major Camren, Officer Serik and Senator Tudos.

The Imperial Domination Outpost was a military installation of the Sith Empire located atop Vixxon's Shear, an outcropping in the Alien Gangland region of the High Security Section on the planet Belsavis

The Imperial Command Post was a military installation of the reconstituted Sith Empire located in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison following the prison break. It was a damaged prison complex that the Empire took over in the Tusker Glade.
The Acklay Wilds was an area located in the Maximum Security Section of the Belsavis prison and inhabited by Acklays.
The Antediluvian Jungle was an area located in the Maximum Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Convict's Wild was the name of an area located in the Maximum Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Iceshadow Thicket was a small thicket located in the northwestern corner of the Maximum Security Section of the Belsavis prison.

The Isolation Area was a region located south of Main Prisoner Transfer roadway in the Maximum Security Section of the Belsavis prison. It was the site of the Quarantine Zone, a converted Rakata vault.

The Main Prisoner Transfer was the main roadway that ran along the southern side of the Maximum Security Section of the planet Belsavis. The Isolation Area and the Imperial frontline camp were both located off of the road.
The Maximum Security Thoroughfare was a Rakatan complex that served as a roadway, linking several of the Ancient Prison Caverns to the Maximum Security Section of the planet Belsavis
Meltwater Pond was a small pond located on the eastern edge of the Maximum Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Operations Access Road was a roadway located in the Maximum Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Special Restraint Cells was a section of the Maximum Security Section, a sector of the Galactic Republic's Belsavis prison facility on the planet Belsavis.
The Ultraviolent Offenders Containment was a part of the Galactic Republic detention complex located in the Maximum Security Section of the Belsavis prison on the planet Belsavis.
The Aphor Grove was an area full of Aphor trees located in the Minimum Security Section of the Belsavis prison.

Bogwing Brake was the name given to the region of the Minimum Security Section on the planet Belsavis that was located just north of Prisoner Intake but south of the Prison Administration Center. It was named for the numerous bogwings that made their home there.

The Cliffside Generators was the name given to the cliff on the western edge of the Minimum Security Section of the planet Belsavis, which featured a large generator and the South Power Generator Facility.
HiSec Facilities Access was a roadway on the southern side of the Minimum Security Section on the planet Belsavis that led to the industrial facilities in the High Security Section's southern area.
HiSec Prison Access was a roadway located in the Minimum Security Section of the Belsavis prison that allowed passage into the High Security Section.

The Inmate Recreation Zone was an area located in the Minimum Security Section of the Belsavis prison, just south of the Prison Administration Center. It was used for prisoner recreation, and also for prisoners to grow food for the complex.
The Larcenous Prisoner Holding was a part of the Republic detention facility located in the Minimum Security Section of the Belsavis prison.

A cell block in the Minimum Security Section of Belsavis prison, a Republic prison complex on the planet Belsavis, was one of the cell blocks that the Republic regained control of following the Sith Empire's initial attack on the world.

The Mercenary Containment Cells were a part of the Republic detention complex located in the Minimum Security Section of the Belsavis prison. Located south of the Inmate Recreation Zone and north of the Prisoner Intake roadway, it was used to incarcerate dangerous mercenaries.
The Perimeter Patrol Command Post was located in the Minimum Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Primary Thoroughfare was the main road in the Minimum Security Section of Belsavis prison, a Republic prison complex on the planet Belsavis.
Prisoner Intake was the eastern roadway in the Minimum Security Section of the Belsavis prison that led from Prison Transfer and Processing to the Primary Thoroughfare.
The Terrorist Detention Sector was a part of the Republic detention complex located in the Minimum Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Condemned Caverns was a cavern complex in the Minimum Security Section of the Belsavis prison that was overtaken by the Condemned during the prison break.
Vault K-66 was a security vault located in the Minimum Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
Republic Guardpost Alpha was a Galactic Republic guardpost located in Varactyl Vale in the Minimum Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Prison Command Center was a part of the Republic detention complex located in the Minimum Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Detainee Processing Center was part of the Galactic Republic detention complex located in the Minimum Security Section of the Belsavis prison.
The Bounty Brokers Association or BBA was an organization active during the years of the Cold War and Galactic War that handled the bounty contracts for bounty hunters.

BH-7X was a renowned assassin droid bounty hunter and a member of the Bounty Brokers Association. During the Cold War and Galactic War BH-7X visited both the Carrick Station and Vaiken Spacedock and guided the potential bounty hunters through the process of either capturing or…
D-3X was an assassin droid henchman of a crime lord living during the Cold War and Galactic War.
House Frayus was a minor Alderaanian noble house that was led by its matriarch Dariana Frayus at the time of the Cold War and Galactic War.
A Silurian rodent was a creature that lived in nests. The protocol droid QT-3PO compared the inside of a Jawa sandcrawler to the inside of Silurian rodent nest.

The Elite Senate Guard were a chosen few selected of the Senate Guard whose responsibilities included protection of important senators. They often accompanied the senators to their home planet and back to Coruscant, ensuring their safe passage.
The Great Desert was a desert bordered with gashed canyons and cliffs located on the planet Fhost.

Portug was a planet located in the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. The Tusken Raider KkH'Oar'Rrhr and his followers once visited this planet in search of his revered leader A'sharad Hett, after his exile from Tatooine.

result: The peace mission to Armath can continue
x: Circa 15 BBY, Zell, an ambassador from the planet Majoor, led a peace mission to the planet Armath.

41-VEX was a medical droid initially stationed at a clinic in Mos Eisley on Tatooine that, in an attempt to purchase its freedom, unwittingly indentured itself to Teemo the Hutt, who upgraded it to serve as a medical and maintenance droid in his palace.
The Regnant was a Harrower-class dreadnought in the service of the Sith Empire during the Cold War and the Galactic War.

South Talbus was a location on the planet Kesh. In 3959 BBY, the Human former-Jedi Jelph Marrian visited a bar in the city Tahv, and on his arrival, a Keshiri bartender commented that Marrian looked as if he had just came to the bar straight from South Talbus.
The Salin Mariner was a "C-One" luxury liner that was operating by Salin Excursions around the time of the Clone Wars. Around 22 BBY, the Mariner undertook a cruise from Lianna to Botajef.

The Ao Var was a Ghtroc Industries Class 720 light freighter with a crew capacity of at least one. It was piloted by a smuggler named Pash, but technically was the property of cartel gangster Teemo the Hutt.
The Jedi Ruins was a name of a Jedi outpost located in the Glarus Valley on Alderaan.
The Xenoform Marshes was the swamp lands east of the "Green Ellipse" and south of the Equation Enclave on the planet Asation. The Grand Hypergate was built in the marshes.
The Harmonious Habitat was the name given to the cave that linked the northern side of the Quadrilateral Forum to the Xenoform Marshes.
The Greeting Plane was the name given to the swamp north of the Equation Enclave of Satikan, a Gree trading outpost on the planet Asation.
The Quadrilateral Forum was a section of the "Green Ellipse," a ruined city on the planet Asation. The Forum was located west of the Xenoform Marshes
The Black Sun docks were located in the heart of Black Sun territory on Coruscant.
The Black Sun Market was an area located in the Black Sun territory on Coruscant.
Leisure Garden was a public garden in the Axial Park district of Coronet City, the capital of the planet Corellia.
Cutie was the astromech droid assigned to the V-wing starfighter of Imperial pilot Shea Hublin during the Battle of Kelrodo-Ai in 17 BBY.
The Fartrader Lounge was an area located within the Migrant Merchants' Guild headquarters, in the the Old Galactic Market, on Coruscant.
The Dockside Slums was an area located in the Black Sun territory on Coruscant.
Circa 2 ABY, the Rebel Alliance was forced to evacuate its research base on the planet Horob after it was uncovered by the Empire.

result: Rebel Alliance takes over an Imperial listening post.
x: In 0 BBY, during the Galactic Civil War, an attack was launched against the Galactic Empire's listening outpost at the Citadel on the Outer Rim planet Rhen Var. The Rebel Alliance sent a team of soldiers which overran the facility's garrison.
A Mining Guild cutter was a state-of-the-art starship with advanced hyperdrive and sensor systems. The Iopene Princess was one of such starships.
The Migrant Merchants' Guild Computer Lab was a computer lab in the Old Galactic Market of the planet Coruscant where the slicer Kixiaralu was forced to work for the Migrant Merchants' Guild.
The Veshok Terrace Apartments was a section of living quarter apartments located in the the Justicar territory on the planet Coruscant, named for the veshok trees of Mandalore.
The Wind Riders were a snowtrooper unit operating within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps.
The Cartel Mining Mesa was a region of the planet Makeb. It housed the Drilling Platform Fwanna during the Hutt Cartel's takeover of the planet.
The Wayland Herd was an Ithorian herd, whose Ithorian Herdship was based the planet Ithor. Iggjel and his friend were members of the herd.

result: The House of Thul captures Fort Orrus
x: The assault on Fort Orrus was an attack made on the Great House of Organa stronghold of Fort Orrus by the Great House of Thul during the civil war on the planet Alderaan.
The Sandstorm Dunes was an area located on Darvannis, guarded by TITAN 6 and Dash'Roode.
Oasis City was a city located on Darvannis.
The Plateau Bazaar was an arms bazaar located on the edge of Oasis City on the planet Darvannis.
The Novare Coast was an area located on the planet Denova. It was a major battlefield in the fighting on the planet during the Galactic War.
The Baradium Mine was a baradium mining location on the planet of Denova.
The Seaside Woods was an area located on the planet Denova.

The Lair of the Ghost was a cave located in the Malignant Bog on the planet Dromund Kaas in the Outer Rim Territories. A terentatek nest, it was named for the monstrous Sithspawn that made its home in the cave's depths—Akure, the Ghost in the Darkness.
The leaders of the slave rebellion on the planet Dromund Kaas had their headquarters in a bunker near the unfinished colossus of Darth Vowrawn. It was assaulted by Cipher Nine around 3643 BBY.
The Spaceport Expanse was the name of an area located outside Kaas City spaceport on Dromund Kaas.

The Crescent Canyon Mesa was a massive ice mesa located at the southeastern edge of the Whiterock Wastes on the planet Hoth. It was named for Crescent Canyon, which separated the mesa from the Wastes and Highmount Ridge to the west.
The Organa Air Cavalry were a military unit loyal to the House of Organa, one of the Great Houses of Alderaan, during the Alderaan Civil War.
An R5-series astromech droid accompanied the elite Rebel Alliance fighting force Renegade Squadron on a mission to rescue enslaved Rebel prisoners on the planet Tatooine around 0.5 ABY.
A species of winged avians were native to the planet Kilmaulsias in the Vorzyd Cluster, where they eventually evolved into the sentient Kilmaulsi species.

Ceitia Five was a planet located within the Mid Rim. In 138 ABY, Darth Wredd attacked and killed a One Sith member who had infiltrated the legislature of the Galactic Federation Triumvirate on the planet.
Blade's Edge was a heavily modified Z-95-AF4 Headhunter starfighter that was operated by the Kadas'sa'Nikto bounty hunter Kaa'to Leeachos during the early years of the Galactic Empire.

The Ukian Defense Service was a defense organization on the planet Ukio. One of its divisions operated Ukio's planetary shields. The service was active when Ukio was attacked by forces under Grand Admiral Thrawn during his campaign against the New Republic.

The Caprioril Massacre was the name given to the incident where an assassin droid, targeting Governor Amel Bakli, reasoned that the most effective way to eliminate its quarry was to kill all 20,000 attendees at a swoop race on the Core World of Caprioril.

Garcornia was a celestial body located in the Garcornia system, a part of the Mid Rim's Ado sector. It was the origin point of Garcornian spice. By 3638 BBY, multiple manufacturing plants were situated on Garcornia.

The Walker was an Imperial treasury ship. During the Galactic Civil War, it was transiting through the Fakir sector with a corvette escort when it was attacked by six Alliance to Restore the Republic T-65 X-wing starfighters.

This ship was the personal starship of the bounty hunter Dranok and his Nelvaanian partner Skarl. Mechanic Pergus Frode took shelter on this ship during an outbreak at the Sith academy on the planet Odacer-Faustin.

CR-97 was a personal droid of the Sith Lord Darth Zhorrid during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY it contacted an Imperial Agent Cipher Nine through a hologram, after which his master sent the agent to find Vyord Yanol on Nar Shaddaa.
T-12N was an astromech droid found in Mos Ila on Tatooine during the Cold War, where it managed the requisition of specialty goods.

N4-01 was the designation of a astromech droid in the service of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. It relayed to Imperial forces an urgent transmission from Darth Malgus, asking them to come to Vaiken Spacedock for a mission regarding the Advozse Hegemony.

conflict: Hunt for Xesh and Daegen Lok
x: In the year 25,793 BBY, a battle occurred in the Ryo Fortress on the planet Shikaakwa between the mad warrior Daegen Lok and his ally Xesh, and a team of Je'daii sent to capture the two.

Occurring at some point prior to or during the year 3643 BBY, the Duros uprising on Zilior was a rebellion comprising members of the Duros species, who were revolting against the Sith Empire on the planet Zilior.

G6-M2 was a shopkeeper droid served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War with the Galactic Republic. It was stationed aboard the Black Talon, a transport in service to the Imperial Navy, when it attacked the Republic warship Brentaal Star.

A smuggling ring delivered CryoBan weapons to the House of Thul on the planet Alderaan while they were backed by the Sith Empire during the Cold War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic. The ring was shut down by Republic forces in 3643 BBY.
The planet Alderaan was the capital of the New Galactic Empire.
Aquilae was a Planet in the Aquilaean system that was a target of conquest by the New Galactic Empire.
Imperial Transport was an organization within the Galactic Empire responsible for movement of Imperial Military equipment and personnel.

CH-1 was a droid bounty hunter that was active during the early years of the Galactic Empire. CH-1 was granted unique self-improvement programming by its creator and, seeking to continually modify and upgrade itself, the droid turned to bounty hunting in order to raise funds.

This torture droid used by Ban Papeega to torture Thurlow Harris to extract the name of the pilot who destroyed the Death Star. It was destroyed when Vader flew into a rage and killed all the bounty hunters, except for Mala Mala.
Sector 1459 was a region of the undercity of the planet Coruscant. During the early years of the Galactic Empire, the Umbra Club, seedy, underworld death stick den, was operated within Sector 1459.

The Meridian Grace was a NX-1200 freighter that belonged to the Mirialan smuggler Giana Kayl. Around 3643 BBY it was transporting goods from Tai Cordan for the Balmorran resistance, but was shot down and crashed on Balmorra.

The royal garden of Alaric, King of Thustra, was located in his palace. It notably hosted a rare species of flowers which came from the other side of the galaxy. Alaric was very fond of his garden, and he insisted on preserving the fragile harmony of its eco-system.

The Stark Forests was a forest region on the continent of Thyr on the planet Tython. The trees of the Stark Forests sucked moisture from the air and stored water in leathery sacks that hung like pendulums from their skeletal branches, and the sacs were useful to travelers who …

Rukabi Major was an asteroid located within the Vaal asteroid field. Around the time of the Cold War, the Hutt Glorzo issued a contest there where the winner would acquire a hologram program named Holiday.
The Theoretika was a mobile research laboratory owned by Czerka Corporation that was active over a century before the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

The Hound was a Venator-class Star Destroyer in operation during the early formation of the Galactic Empire, and operated under Darth Vader's authority, and was directly commanded by Captain Gillehspy.

Section X was the original site of the Belsavis prison colony on the planet Belsavis. Around 3668 BBY, a ship containing dozens of HK-51 series assassin droids and piloted by one of Dread Masters's apprentices, crashed there.

The Valarian Syndicate was a criminal organization created by Lady Valarian. During the Galactic Civil War, it strongly rivaled Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire for the control of the planet Tatooine. Members of the organization were known simply as Valarians.
Stobar Spaceport was a spaceport located on Stobar, where the diner Plop Dribble's was located.

A group of enslaved individuals utilized by Lord Qet to construct a statue of Dark Council member Darth Vowrawn grouped together and rebelled against their Imperial masters during the Cold War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.

The Cross of Glory Walk was a path in the Leisure Garden part of Axial Park on Corellia, along which a number of holostatues were situated to celebrate the heroes of the Jedi Civil War who had won the Cross of Glory: Revan, Juhani, Canderous Ordo, Carth Onasi, Mission Vao, Zaa…
Maarka was a planet located in the Perkell sector of the Mid Rim. During the Clone Wars, it was the site of a Republic base.

The Watchful was a DP20 gunship in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Aeolus was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Albion was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Bonaventure was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Maidstone was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Speedwell was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
Swiftsure was a Marauder-class missile cruiser in the service of the Rebel Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

This R4 unit made repairs aboard the Millanti, a Capital YV-class freighter owned by Ohwun and Chachi De Maal.

The Imperial Environmental Preservation & Refocusing Authority, also known generally as the Imperial Preservation & Refocusing Authority, or the IEPRA for short, was a government department of the Galactic Empire staffed by a Deputy Associate Operations Director, Lieutenant Ri…
In 20 BBY, the Confederacy of Independent Systems initiated a month-long siege of the planet Felacat.
