x: During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems sent a number of agents on a mission to infiltrate a leisure satellite that was visiting in orbit of Coruscant.

place: A leisure satellite in orbit of Coruscant
x: The Spiral Double Cup was a podracing tournament held aboard a leisure satellite in orbit of Coruscant during the Clone Wars.
The moon of Themis contained an explosive ore that was capable of acting as a power source.

objective: Gain the allegiance of Themis
x: During the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems both undertook a mission to Themis for the same reason: to gain the planet's allegiance in the midst of the intergalactic conflict.
CLI-ON 87 was an IG-86 sentinel droid who was convicted by the Galactic Republic of oil misuse and assassination during the Clone Wars.
The Spring Equinox ceremony was a group of events practiced by all the monks of the B'omarr Order.
The Comet Run was a racing event that took place in the city of Mos Espa on Tatooine. The event was often attended by the citizens of Pika Oasis.
The Sulfur Lake Pirates were a gang of pirates active during the height of the Galactic Civil War. On the desert planet of Lok, they were the main competitors of Nym's Lok Revenants.
The Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout was the secret base of the Sulfur Lake Pirates, located on the planet of Lok.
An Imperial Mine had been established on the planet Lok by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
The Imperial Research Facility was a weapon research center established by the Galactic Empire on the planet of Lok during the Galactic Civil War.
The Thirty-eighth Infantry was a unit in the Republic Military that was active during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Jashwa was a planet located somewhere in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the Jashwik, a Sullustan cousin-species.
Around 1 ABY, Princess Leia Organa of Alderaan had her own office in her capacity of member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
In 20 BBY during the Clone Wars, a battle broke out on a moon of the planet Gyndine.
During the Clone Wars, a skirmish took place on the planet Hoth.

During the Clone Wars, a group of Zygerrian deserters aboard the Wayferer led by Colonel M'rch raided the Galactic Republic Pelta-class frigate Medica. They posed as a damaged vessel and sent out a distress call.
The Wayfarer was a transport used by Colonel M'rch and his group of Zygerrian deserters during the Clone Wars.
The Balmorran maweater was a creature native to an island chain on the planet Balmorra in the centuries before the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Aur X was a planet located in the Aur system near the Colonies planet Phu. The planet occupied the tenth orbital position within its star system and consisted of a giant diamond the size of a terrestrial world.
A cloud of tumbling diamond fragments occupied the eleventh orbital position in the Colonies' Aur system.

The Ciratu Spheres were a group of six spherical objects which orbited the star Ciratu in the Ciratu system, which was a part of the Immerian Outback sector in the Expansion Region and Trailing Sectors, far from any trade routes.

Ianane III was a Wild Space planet whose surface was completely covered by a deep layer of sand. The planet had violent storms in its atmosphere, and the brightness of its surface for a long time caused it to be misidentified as a star.

The Penegelen Shards were a spherical cloud of tumbling fragments which orbited the star Penegelenin the Inner Rim, within the star system of the same name. They consisted of substances such as scorched alloys or flash-frozen hunks of dirt and rock.

A settlement existed on the Outer Rim planet Ragmar V during the Clone Wars around 19 BBY. Its population consisted of outcasts of various species, including Humans, Klatooinians, Bith, Rodians, Ithorians, Gamorreans, Jawas, Nuknogs, and Devaronians.
The Imperial Treasury Department, also referred to simply as the Imperial treasury, was a governmental organization that oversaw the treasury of the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The Taris Reconstruction Authority was the organization that oversaw the reconstruction of the planet Taris during the Cold War.
Internal Security was the internal security and counterintelligence division of the New Republic Intelligence Service.
The Ministry of Finance was the ministry of the Galactic Empire that dealt with monetary issues. It was led by the Finance Minister. In 19 BBY the position was held by Minister Gahg.
The Ministry of Finance was a department of the New Republic government under the General Ministry that was charged with financial matters.
The Ministry of Finance was the civilian monetary and financial ministry of the Galactic Republic. Its head was the Minister of Finance.

The Ministry of Commerce was a part of the New Republic General Ministry responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of commerce within the New Republic and kept track of important inter-system shipping.
A planet was located on the edges of the Torch Nebula, a nebula in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy.
The Ministry of Science was a department of the New Republic General Ministry that was responsible for scientific advancement.
The Ministry of Security was a department of the New Republic General Ministry that was responsible for public security.
The General Ministry Cabinet was the governing council of the New Republic General Ministry. It consisted of the heads of the various ministries that were a part of the General Ministry.
A gladiatorial tournament was held annually on the planet Nal Hutta by an eccentric member of the Hutt species.
Sandtuskers were reptilian scavengers native to the planet Tatooine that were known for their large tusks, the ridges of bone that protected them, and their toothy maw.

t: Raid on Imperial Pay Station RMH-1973
x: A few years prior to 3643 BBY, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, the criminals Risha Drayen and Beryl Thorne raided Imperial Pay Station RMH-1973, a pay station of the Imperial Treasury Department.
A platoon in the Thirty-eighth Infantry of the Republic Army served in the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

The greater crested gundark was a particularly fierce variety of the non-sentient gundark species that was believed to have been extinct centuries before the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

The gundarks, a non-sentient predatory species, had a nest on the moon Alaris Prime. Between the years 39 BBY and 36 BBY, the nest was attacked by the forces of the Trade Federation Droid Army and a group of Wookiee warriors, who were both attempting to colonize the moon.
The Warhammer was a dreadnaught of the Sith Empire that was active during the Great Galactic War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.

An oasis on the edge of the Western Dune Sea of the planet Tatooine was a Force nexus strong with the light side of the Force. After the Battle of Yavin, the Jedi Nos'lyn led an aspiring Jedi to the oasis in order to instruct him in the ways of the Force.
During the invasion of the galaxy by the intergalactic Yuuzhan Vong species between 25 ABY and 29 ABY, the Vong attacked the Cyrillia system within The Slice.
Hansor's Hooligans was a gladiator walker combat team during the Galactic Civil War led by Madrix Hansor. The team had a grudge against Demelza's Destructors, another team led by Demelza Mintori.

Demelza's Destructors was a gladiator walker combat team during the Galactic Civil War led by Demelza Mintori. The unit and its leader held a grudge against Madrix Hansor and his team, Hansor's Hooligans that seemed unending.
The SV-45 was a StarSpeeder 3000 used by Corellian Translines as a transport during the early New Republic era. It was captained by Duran Har at this time.

Councils of the Wise were the councils within M'shinn culture which controlled M'shinn colony planets and their homeworld Genassa. The council consisted of the eldest member of each Rootline–family units within M'shinn society–that were on the planet.

A species of plant was part of a symbiotic relationship with the sentient M'shinn species. The moss like plant grew on the species skin and covered their entire bodies apart from the soles of their feet and the palms of their hands.
The Eradicator was a ship that was a part of the fleet of Moff Kentor Sarne during his campaign. Its commanding officer was Captain Thulian Merast and its first officer was Lieutenant Jav Remlyn.

Kal'Shebbol's Fury was a special missions platoon serving with the forces of Moff Kentor Sarne during his campaign as a warlord. The unit was led by Lieutenant Gerrin Nikals. The platoon consisted of two sharpshooter squads, one engineering squad, and one heavy weapons squad.
During the Yuuzhan Vong War, an invasion of the galaxy by the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong species between 25 ABY and 29 ABY, the invaders attacked the Edusa system.
During the intergalactic Yuuzhan Vong's invasion of the galaxy between 25 and 29 ABY, which was known as the Yuuzhan Vong War, they attacked the Tangrene system.
Furious was the Lambda-class T-4a shuttle serving the droid information broker 8t88. Its crew included a pilot and at least one Stormtrooper.

A drag course used for Podracing existed on the Outer rim planet of Tatooine. The track featured an array of twists and turns, and offered obstacles such as rough terrain where Podracers would lose traction and slow down considerably.

A drag course used for Podracing existed on the Outer rim desert planet of Tatooine. More difficult than the other drag courses on the planet, it featured sharp turns and tight squeezes in between rocks and cliff-sides.
A drag course used for Podracing existed on the Outer rim planet of Baroonda. The race began within a city and headed out of the city, over a bridge, and into a set of ruins.

A drag course used for Podracing existed on the Mid Rim spice-mining planet of Mon Gazza. The course opened in a large set of grandstands and remained that way until the course broke off into the mining fields.
The Deathly Heat was a region in the northern Jundland Wastes of the planet Tatooine. During the Cold War, it was inhabited by a Geonosian militia.
A drag course used for Podracing existed on the Mid Rim planet of Malastare. The Fluggrian pilot Elan Mak was favored here, and would challenge other racers to one-on-one matches.
A drag course used for Podracing existed on the Mid Rim planet of Malastare. The pilot Bozzie Baranta was favored here, and would challenge other racers to one-on-one matches.

A Venator-class Star Destroyer was attacked by forces from the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. The Separatists landed a super tank on the Star Destroyer, prompting Clone Commander Jet to send a Jedi Knight to destroy the invasive tank.
A drag course used for Podracing existed on the Outer rim planet of Ando Prime. The Ciasi Slide Paramita, was favored on this course, and he would challenge other pilots to race against him here.
The D-1Z prototype bomber was a prototype variant of the B28 Extinction-class bomber developed by the Sith Empire which was taken for a test flight during the Battle above Lorta.
The Dread War was a conflict during the Galactic War that pitted the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire against the renegade Sith Lords known as the Dread Masters on the volcanic moon of Oricon.

Kishh'daar was a continent of the planet Bakura. After the world was colonized by Humans from the Bakur Mining Corporation, Kishh'daar was set aside for settlement by Bakura's native Kurtzen species for such time as their population grew large enough to warrant it.

The whorrwaarr were a giant variety of bantha found on the arboreal planet of Kashyyyk, in the Mytaranor sector. The Wookiees, the sentient inhabitants of Kashyyyk had domesticated the whorrwaarr and made them carry loads.

Eriadu Spaceport Control was a security organization located in Eriadu City on the planet of Eriadu circa 32 BBY. Spaceport Control was involved in the safety of the Eriadu Trade Summit and aftermath, specifically around the area of the spaceport.
The Voam was a tribe of Evocii led by Odeph in the year 3643 BBY, when tensions between the Hutts and the Evocii on Nal Hutta were high.

Lothal was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During the early years of the Galactic Empire, Lothal was in a state of economic disrepair and invited the Empire to take over the planet's industries, with the promise of prosperity and security.

The Intergalactic Law Agency, abbreviated as ILA, was a law enforcement agency formed during the last century of the Galactic Republic to provide a galactic wide policing. However the agency was disbanded in favor of the Sector Rangers.

Camp Forty was a military camp established by Lightning Battalion in 3 ABY during a vital stage of the Icarii Campaign. It was there that Colonel Abal Karda held the Icarii leader Selestrine captive before decapitating her.

The Syboona smuggler Knire Dark owned a storehouse that she used for storing her illegal merchandise. It was raided by Galactic Republic authorities around 22 BBY, ending Dark's career. The raid was chronicled in HoloNet News Vol.
K-2G1 was a droid that sold various goods in the Thul Palace cantina on Alderaan during the Cold War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
The Overlook stage was a raised terrace located in the back of the Royal Palace in Theed, capital of Naboo. It was overlooked by King Ars Veruna's library tower and the palace's rear watchtower.

terrain: Enormous rock pinnacles with shallow wetlands at the base
x: Nalyd was an Outer Rim planet and the homeworld of the Nalydians, a species of sentient, stocky humanoids.

result: Han and Leia Solo escape with Omad Kaeg.
x: The Skirmish at Red Ronto was an event that took place in 45 ABY.
The Liberation was a Venator-class Star Destroyer in service of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.
A species with large wide eyes existed in the galaxy. They were covered in brown fur, and possessed short beaks, a single antennae, and a tail. They had short legs with two toes on each foot.
In 22 BBY during the Clone Wars, a battle took place in the Inner Rim Vanik system when the Malevolence carried out a strike there.
In 22 BBY during the Clone Wars, a battle took place in the Mid Rim Ichtor system when the Malevolence carried out a strike there.
In 22 BBY during the Clone Wars, a battle took place in the Mid Rim Vondarc system when the Malevolence carried out a strike there.

A skirmish occurred along the Hydian Way during the Yuuzhan Vong War, in the year 28 ABY. The Millennium Falcon, traveling through Yuuzhan Vong territory on a diplomatic mission to the Imperial Remnant, was decanted from hyperspace by a Yuuzhan Vong dovin basal.

A flame tygah was a feline-like beast with six paws and an oily hide of variegated scales native to the Strafe Plains of the planet Tython. Its body blazed with such heat that its tail swished white fire, and its teeth and eyes glowed with intensity.

AG-37 was an IG-series assassin droid in operation in the aftermath of the Second Imperial Civil War. A regular visitor to Ania Solo's junkyard on Carreras Minor's moon, AG-37 was in operation long before and had seen empires rise and fall.
The Outer Rim planet Vanquo had a moon that could be seen in the sky on clear nights. The moon had a green color, and appeared large in the night sky when visible.

The Mystral Minstrels were a musical group whose work was considered melodious. Their music was available in the galaxy during the period that the droid Master-Com was administrator of the space station known as The Wheel.
The Republic Resettlement Zone was a region around the city of Olaris that was under Galactic Republic control during the Taris Resettlement Initiative.

The Duel on Kestavel was an event that took place in the The Lucky Twi'lek several months after the creation of the Galactic Empire. Dass Jennir and Kai Hudorra defeated the Dark Jedi Beyghor Sahdett.

An Ewok village existed around 19 BBY, located on the forest moon of Endor. The village was lead by a chieftain and consisted of various other Ewoks. At some point the village came to be terrorized by a beast known as the Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain.
The Skirmish on Telerath took place several months after the creation of the Galactic Empire. Dass Jennir defeated the criminals who ruled the planet Telerath single-handed.

The Mission to Imperial Prison ISO-L8 took place several months after the creation of the Galactic Empire. Assassin Falco Sang infiltrated Imperial Prison ISO-L8 in order to find Janks and informations about Dass Jennir.

The Skirmish on Prine took place several months after the creation of the Galactic Empire. Dass Jennir journeyed through the desert of Prine in order to rescue Ember Chankeli who was captured by a enslaver caravan.

The Mission to Vondarc took place several months after the creation of the Galactic Empire. During their search for Dass Jennir, the crew of the Uhumele raided the Imperial guard station to hack into the Imperial databanks for clues on Jennir.
During the Imperial Era, the Galactic Empire fought a battle on an Outer Rim world.

x: The Rescue on Arkinnea took place several months after the creation of the Galactic Empire. The Whiphid Jedi Master K'Kruhk, after crash landing on Arkinnea from an attack on a jungle moon, protected his students from the Galactic Empire, more specifically the Arkinnea Militia…

t: Capture of the Death Star test unit
x: The Capture of the Death Star test unit was a mission undertaken by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the early stages of the Galactic Civil War.

The Griagh was a monstrous, four-headed creature that dwelled in a large cave system on Endor. Although it was long considered to be legendary, the Griagh was real indeed, and it was awakened late in the Galactic Civil War, when the Galactic Empire established a bunker on the …

place: Desert of Salma/Forbidden Fortress of the Gorax
result: Ewok victory, Gorax slain, Towani family reunited.
x: A battle took place on Endor that was a contained conflict in 3 ABY between the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village and a Gorax, in an attempt to reunite two human children, Mace and Cindel Towani, with their parents, Jeremitt and Catarine Towani, who had been imprisoned by the Gorax.

t: Skirmish at the Endor shield bunker
place: Bright Tree Village/a cave/Endor shield generator bunker
x: The skirmish at the Endor shield bunker was a battle in 3 ABY between the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village, the Galactic Empire, and a legendary creature known as the Griagh as part of the Imperial-Ewok War, which led to the Battle of Endor eight months later.
CZ-13, also known as Cees, was a friendly and efficient receptionist droid active during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Blasted Asteroid was a commercial chain of cantinas that operated after the Battle of Yavin during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

In the year 25 ABY, a skirmish took place in deep space in the Outer Rim Territories. A group of unreconstructed Imperials on their way to join the Imperial Remnant were attacked by a group of Yuuzhan Vong coralskippers, and their yachts were completely annihilated.

t: Second skirmish in the Outer Rim
x: A star system in the Outer Rim played host to a brief skirmish in the year 25 ABY. The Bothan Assault Cruiser Ralroost arrived in the system after receiving reports of mysterious alien starfighters, and dispatched the T-65A3 X-wing starfighters of Rogue Squadron to investigate…

t: Third skirmish in the Outer Rim
x: A skirmish occurred in deep space in the Outer Rim in the year 25 ABY. The New Republic's Rogue Squadron had earlier captured the privateer Urias Xhaxin, who himself had tangled with the coralskippers of the Yuuzhan Vong, a mysterious alien threat lurking in the Outer Rim.
The Metalorn prison known as Unreal City employed a number of guards.

The Officers' Club was a restricted lounge in which the officers of the Grand Army of the Republic could enjoy moments of relaxation during the Clone Wars. It was located in the Jedi Temple of Coruscant, headquarters of the Jedi Order.

An inventory droid, CZ-332 worked at Farlander's Outfitting and Supply, an equipment store and pawn shop on the Wheel space station, which was open around the year 1 BBY during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

t: Unidentified Imperial Security Bureau WED Treadwell repair droid
x: A WED Treadwell repair droid which worked on the Wheel space station was commandeered by the Imperial Security Bureau during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Sermerian First House was the noble body that ruled Sermeria from its capital city of Addolis during the time of the Galactic Republic. Ister Paddie was a noble of the House before going to Coruscant to represent his people in the Galactic Senate.
The Sermerian Bio-League was an organization in existence on the planet Sermeria around the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

The Siege of Ramsir was an engagement that was fought in the vicinity of the Outer Rim Territories' Ramsir system at some point between 19 BBY and 2 ABY. It saw the participation of the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire.
In the year 3 ABY, several members of the Rebel Alliance set up an ambush on an uninhabited planetoid.

The Trulalis Stage Company was a troupe of actors who performed tragic plays on Trulalis. Otias Atori was one of their number, and the young Jaalib Brandl started his acting career with the company prior to 5 BBY.
Zone N7 was one of the areas that made up the northern hemisphere of the first Death Star. It contained several sprawls, including one referred to as City Sprawl North 7: A68.

In 3963 BBY, during the Mandalorian Wars, the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders captured the ice planet of Jebble after securing the planet Taris. The Mandalorians then moved on to the planet Serroco, and used Jebble as a staging ground for a planned assault on Alderaan.
The Second Battle of Omonoth was a battle fought between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders in 3963 BBY, during the Mandalorian Wars.

t: Skirmish between the Pythea and a Yuuzhan Vong fleet
x: In 25 ABY, the exploratory ship Pythea was exploring the edge of the galaxy when it came across the fleet of the Yuuzhan Vong, resulting in a skirmish. The captain of the ship, Panha, recognized the invaders and attempted to warn Artorias of the impending danger.
34 Besh was an escape pod on board the Munificent-class star frigate Sa Nalaor which served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, where they fought the Galactic Republic.
A species of green insects inhabited the jungle planet Cholganna in the Outer Rim Territories. About the size of a Human thumb, the insects were capable of flight and buzzed as they did so.
R5-J1 was an R5-series astromech droid who worked in the droid maintenance shop in the Retreat during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The Starblue Ranger was a ILH-KK Citadel-class civilian cruiser owned by the Wookiee hunter known as Captain Shorwarr.

The Gampassa was a species of turtle native to the planet Glee Anselm's oceans. Their skin was wrinkled and gray, while their bodies were round and elongated. A ponderous head and tiny tail grew from the creature's front and backside, respectively.

Be'ekk was a planet in the Cholganna system of the Outer Rim Territories. It orbited the star Chol, with three smaller planets orbiting more closely than it, Ryien, Cholganna and Chol. It was brown in color and had a ring.

Ryien was a planet in the Cholganna system of the Outer Rim Territories. It orbited the star Chol, with a smaller planet, Chol, and a larger planet, Cholganna orbiting more closely than it and one larger planet, Be'ekk, orbiting further away. It was grey in color.

Chol was a planet in the Cholganna system of the Outer Rim Territories. It orbited the star Chol, with three larger planets orbiting further away than it, Cholganna, Ryien and Be'ekk. It was brown in color.
Hyperdrive Station A-226 was a technical sector of the Imperial battle station known as the Death Star. The stations' powerful hyperdrive system was housed in that sector and monitored from there.
Anchorhead was a spaceport town on the planet Aquilae.
The Battle of the Space Fortress was a battle that was fought between the Aquilaean Starforce and the Galactic Empire.

result: King S'Shah is killed and deposed
Elglih becomes new king and creates a strong bond with the Rebel Allia
objective: Establish friendly relationship with the Serps
x: In 3 ABY, three members of the Rebel Alliance were dispatched on a mission to the planet Serphidi. Their goal was to establish good relations with the native Serps, but chaos ensued, and one Rebel pilot was killed. All was well again after Luke Skywalker jousted with the king.

A raid was conducted in the waning years of the Galactic Republic by the Coruscant Police Force on the planet Coruscant. The raid target the Hutt Cartel in the Entertainment District. During the raid, Officer Raim Tibekk killed a Cartel operative.
The Aquilaean Council was the official ruling council in the Palace of Lite, Aquilae lead by King Kayos, and eventually his daughter Queen Leia.
The CZ-8X Eradicator Droid was a battle droid used by the Czerka Sentient Resources Department during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Sicemon (also spelled Siceman) was a planet located in the Sice system that was covered in vast grasslands and mounds. Inhabited by giant flying whales, it was home to a city that was used as a base by the Rebel Alliance.

result: Jax Pavan escaped and presumed death
x: The Battle in the Factory District occurred during the Great Jedi Purge, in 19 BBY. During their search for 10-4TO, Jedi Knight Jax Pavan and his companions fought against Black Sun Vigo Prince Xizor in the Coruscant Factory District, inhabited by hostile feral droids.
These undead warriors were created through the use of alchemical techniques, devised by the Sith Lord Darth Drear.

A blue protocol droid worked as a Podrace commentator around 22 BBY. The droid operated out of the circuits on the Mid Rim planet of Mon Gazza, and commentated on the Mon Gazza Maze event on its qualifier races.

The Doom Pipes were a series of pipes that made up part of the Mon Gazza Maze course and its qualifiers. Many of the pipes ended in dead ends. At least one pilot failed to even enter the pipes during a race that took place in 22 BBY.
The blobstacle course was a course for blob racing on the planet Umgul which was involved in gambling.

result: Sith lose all three airships but manage to capture two hostages
Sith survivors return to Keshtah Minor in trawler Mischance with Jogan
Edell Vrai and Quarra Thayn embark on overland reconnaissance mission
objective: To spy on Alanciar and return to Keshtah Minor
x: The Mission to Alanciar was an airborne exploratory flight launched by the Lost Tribe of Sith in 2975 BBY to explore the continent of Alanciar, a large continent lying to the west of Keshtah Minor.

Traal was a remote planet. At some point by approximately 180 BBY, the Twi'lek Jedi Master Skia Ro famously survived on Traal for two years while equipped with nothing but a towel, a fact that was known to her apprentice Christina Starspeeder.

Bator Bai was an ice world located in the Bator Bai system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It was linked by a hyperlane to the Kalgo and Suliana systems.
Osmani was a planet located in the Western Reaches of the Mid Rim. Part of the Senex sector's Osmani system, is a minor trade world owing to its location in the Tangles.

During the Infinite Empire of the Rakata species invaded the Tython system, the Infinite Empire captured the gas giant Mawr and its numerous moons, which were some of the Settled Worlds of the system.
During the invasion of the Tython system by the Rakata species, the Rakatan Infinite Empire captured the gas giant Obri, one of the Settled Worlds of the system, and its moons.
When the Infinite Empire of the Rakata species invaded the Tython system in 25,793 BBY, their first strike was an attack on the space station Fury Station.

During the Infinite Empire's invasion of the Tython system, the Je'daii Order foresaw that the forces of the Rakata species would strike at the planet Shikaakwa, and therefore countered Sub-Predor Ceh'let's attack with one of their own.
During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, the Hutt crime lord Suudaa Nem'ro controlled a gang that operated on the planet Nal Hutta.

Sometime between 25,793 and 25,792 BBY, after capturing the gas giants Obri and Mawr during their invasion of the Tython system, the Infinite Empire of the Rakata species attacked the planet Tython, as Predor Skal'nas hoped to secure the Infinity Gate rumored to exist there.
Masrii was Hutt clan that was led and represented on the Three Families by Broga Masrii.
Kaltemmic was a Hutt clan that was led and represented on the Three Families by Portho Kaltemmic on Quesh.
Urdosh was a Hutt clan that was led and represented on the Three Families by Jeelta Urdosh on Quesh.

The Fa'athra clan was a Hutt clan, or kajidic, of the Hutt Cartel. One of its members was the Hutt Voontara, a crime lord on Nal Hutta. The Fa'athra clan had members that had quarrels with those of the Nem'ro clan.
A skirmish occurred in 3 ABY when Logray, the shaman of the Ewoks of Bright Tree Village, and his assistant Paploo met the Dathomiri witch named Charal in her lair.

The fall of Ska Gora was a battle that saw the Infinite Empire of the Rakata species capture the forest world of Ska Gora, one of the Settled Worlds, during their invasion of the Tython system that began in 25,793 BBY.
The Rockcan was the personal ship of the miner Gideon Smith. The craft was a small mining vessel that had been outfitted with turbolasers.

The shaclaws were massive, armored insects native to Voss that possessed powerful foreclaws able to tear through the flesh and armor of their foes. Shaclaws also used these foreclaws to burrow into the earth to find roots and subterranean mammals to feed upon.
The Nem'ro clan was a Hutt clan, or kajidic, of the Hutt Cartel. One of its members was the Hutt Suudaa, a crime lord on Nal Hutta.

The Marshall Awe was a starship which served in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire. At one point in its use it was controlled by Captain Strayit, and had Zertik Strom serving on board as a Lieutenant.

The Peacehawk was a starship that served in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire. After saving the life of Captain Strayit of the Marshall Awe, Lieutenant Zertik Strom was promoted to First Officer of the Peacehawk, serving under General Ulric Tagge.
The Enforcement was a Pursuit-class light cruiser which served in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire in their Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Knife's Edge was a Mansk-class escort frigate used by House Melantha during the Galactic Civil War. The vessel posed as a privateer in service to both the Rebel Alliance and House Mecetti to hide its true affiliations.
The Fa'athra gang was a criminal gang during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire that was run by the Hutt Voontara Fa'athra on Nal Hutta.
Voam was a village of the Evocii species near Jiguuna on Nal Hutta. The Hutt Suudaa Nem'ro operated a work camp out of the village.
J-45 was a gray 2-1B surgical droid employed by Jabba the Hutt on Tatooine. The droid offered Luke Skywalker medical treatment during his attempts to free a carbonite-frozen Han Solo from Jabba.

Baratatta was an Evocii village on the planet Nal Hutta and the location of much resistance against Hutt rule during the Cold War. Huttsbane was a prominent member of the village. It also had a Spirit-Leader, whose wisdom was respected even by Huttsbane.
Inijic was a Hutt clan, or kajidic. Kossak Inijic Ar'durv was a notable member of this clan.
The Poporov merchants were a group of merchants from Armstiss who at one point rebelled against the Galactic Empire.
The Dust Gaps were the final stretch of the Podracing course known as the Mon Gazza Maze, located on the planet of Mon Gazza.

Splinter Pass was the opening stretch of a Podracing course located on the planet of Mon Gazza, known as the Mon Gazza Maze. Splinter Pass was a large, flat expanse of land dotted with spiked durasteel pillars and totems that were difficult to navigate.
Skeleton Straits was a portion of a Podracing course known as the Mon Gazza Maze, located on the planet of Mon Gazza.
Red Squadron was a squadron of Hunter-class starfighters piloted by members of the Je'daii Order during the Infinite Empire's invasion of the Tython system.

An Imperial communications droid, sometimes called "comm droid" by his companions, played a significant role in the life of Ania Solo and her hunt for the Sith Darth Wredd in the aftermath of the second Imperial Civil War.
PT01 was the designation of a DUM-series pit droid that served as a mechanic for various Podracer pilots.

PT02 was the designation of a DUM-series pit droid. PT02 was one of several pit droids owned by the Toydarian junk dealer Watto, who offered the droid for sale along with its counterparts, PT03 and PT04, around 32 BBY. Most of the potential buyers were Podracer pilots.

PT03 was the designation of a DUM-series pit droid. PT03 was one of several pit droids owned by the Toydarian junk dealer Watto, who offered the droid for sale along with its counterparts, PT02 and PT04, around 32 BBY. Most of the potential buyers were Podracer pilots.

PT04 was the designation of a DUM-series pit droid. PT04 was one of several pit droids owned by the Toydarian junk dealer Watto, who offered the droid for sale along with its counterparts, PT02 and PT03, around 32 BBY. Most of the potential buyers were Podracer pilots.

A monster species inhabited the jungle moon Yavin 4. It was large, with shaggy hair and tusks, and hunted in the jungle. In 23 ABY, one creature attacked the spacer Peckhum outside the Jedi Praxeum but was sent back into the jungle by Jedi Master Luke Skywalker.
The Salmagodro Grand Academy was a higher-education facility that shared its name with the Inner Rim's Salmagodro system. Its staff included the military history scholar Hu Jibwe.
A Fifth Battle of Ruusan was fought on Ruusan around 1000 BBY.
A Sixth Battle of Ruusan was fought on Ruusan around 1000 BBY.

The Fourth Battle of Ruusan was fought at the height of the Ruusan campaign in the final phase of the New Sith Wars. Thanks to intelligence provided by the defecting padawan Githany, the Sith forces routed the Jedi Army of Light and temporarily drove them from the planet Ruusan.

Syrox, also known as the Wolf Worms of Monsolar, were an alpha species of ectomorphic worm native to the planet Monsolar. They lacked a brain, yet were highly efficient predators which fed on blood using their large circular mouth of sharp teeth.
The Ishi Tib Crime lord Haka Hai controlled a Criminal gang by the year 19 BBY. The group operated out of a compound among st the swamps of the planet Mimban.

The Cleansing of Nopsin was a military operation carried out by the Imperial Military commanded by the General Greist and Lieutenants Pierce and Phenter on the planet Nopsin sometime during the Great Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

A quadripedal species of creature with purple skin, a hunched back, plenty of sharp teeth, and at least one tusk existed in the galaxy. In the year 138 ABY, one of them was transported to the planet Iego by the delivery crew of AG-37 and Sauk, aboard AG-37's freighter.
During the Vaklin insurgency on the planet Vaklin, insurgent forces ambushed a patrol being carried out by the Galactic Empire.

Arachnokillers were biotically created creatures formed by the Columi brothers, Craitheus and Marvid Qreph. They were spider-like animals that could be kept inside glass tubes. They were designed to explode under stress and could be used in assassination attempts.
Sarnus was a planet in the Chiloon Rift in Wild Space. In 45 ABY, Lando Calrissian had established a refinery on the world to mine the plentiful asteroids present in the rift.

t: Attack on the Imperial command center
x: In the year 19 BBY insurgents attacked an Imperial command center on the planet Vaklin as part of the Vaklin insurgency. The insurgents attacked the center in the hope of rescuing a Jedi Knight who was imprisoned there.
The Aurel Moon was a Marcadian luxury cruiser used by the Columi brothers, Craitheus and Marvid Qreph to travel through the Chiloon Rift and oversee their financial takeover of the nebula.
The Blue Star was a casino located on the planet Valnoos.

result: Capture of Han Solo, destruction of the Blue Star

x: The Assault on Base Prime was an attack by the New Jedi Order against the Columi brothers, Craitheus and Marvid Qreph to rescue Han Solo and prevent the brothers from gaining access to a monolith on which Base Prime had been built.
The Nargons were a biotically created species of humanoids with prehensile tails and lizard-like features. They fought for the Columi brothers, Craitheus and Marvid Qreph, who had created them.

The Defense of the Anvil was a series of skirmishes following the Evacuation of Yavin. The Rebel Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Maximus was fatally damaged during an ambush from the Imperial Star Destroyer Nihil.

result: Darth Wredd kills a member of the One Sith
x: The Duel on Cadomai Prime was a brief skirmish that occurred in 138 ABY between the rogue Sith Darth Wredd and a Snivvian member of the One Sith order. Following the Carreras Incident, Darth Wredd had embarked on an insurgency against the One Sith.

Group 5 was a squad operating during the Second Battle of Theed in 32 BBY. Once the battle ended, Security Chief Quarsh Panaka contacted group 5 via comlink and requested the squad's location if they needed medical attention.
Kato Zakar was a continent to the south of Thyr on the planet Tython.
Thyr was a continent north of Kato Zakar on the planet Tython, separated by the vast Thyrian Ocean.
Manam was a Killik hive in the Colony around the time of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Bezha Two was a Core Worlds planet. It was inhabited by several nations and became one of the founding members of the Galactic Republic upon that government's establishment in 25,053 BBY.

During the reign of the Galactic Empire, an embezzler worked for Ribba, a Hutt who owned a supposedly legitimate textile business. This individual began to embezzle funds from the Hutt, however, and once Ribba found out, the embezzler was forced to flee.

result: Death of Bpfasshi Dark Jedi leader
x: A duel, took place in 700 BBY between Minch, a male Jedi, and a Bpfasshi Dark Jedi on the planet Dagobah. Minch won the duel, but the dark energy of the Bpfasshi remained there.

t: Duel at the Temple of Imperfect Repose
x: During the insurgency against the Galactic Empire on the planet Vaklin, the Jedi Knight Cho'na Bene dueled the Sith Lord Darth Vader in the caverns after the Temple of Imperfect Repose.

x: A group of insurgents rebelled against the Galactic Empire in the year 19 BBY, shortly after Order 66 and the end of the Clone Wars.
2R-CH, also known as Torch, was a battle droid equipped with a flamethrower who worked with the Advozse Hegemony during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
3-SN4 was an astromech droid that worked as a merchant in the city of Anchorhead on the desert planet of Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

4-4TM was a droid musician that served as a member of the Leisurenauts, an all-droid musical band that performed in Kaas City's Nexus Room cantina on Dromund Kaas during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
AD-304 was a droid that served the Imperial Reclamation Service of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. AD-304 delivered messages for officers such as Colonel Jadick.
44-ND was a probe droid in the service of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
AG-16 was a droid used by Doctor Larek on Belsavis during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

AG-15 was a droid used by Doctor Larek on Belsavis during the Galactic War. AG-16, AG-15, and a number of additional droids were sent out to locate ancient Rakata security droids and extract their memory cores, but the droids were destroyed before they could do so.
The Retaliation was a Venator-class Star Destroyer commanded by Maarisa Zsinj.

The Barbed Ginx was a relatively harmless, curious amphibian that frequented Makeb's marshes. They were first discovered by scientist Dep Aila on Makeb when he found the creatures surrounding his speeder having pulled the exterior casing off in search of food.
The Exoboar was a vicious burrowing creature native to the planet Makeb.

The vrake was a species native to Makeb. The vrake came very near to extinction until an enterprising scientist named Kaylah Taprish took a liking to the creatures. After five years of study and crossbreeding, Taprish released a dozen colonies of the vrake into the wild.
R2 was an astromech droid that worked with Rebel pilot Keyan Farlander during his time serving on the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence.

The Kelita valley was a verdant river valley on the Outer Rim world of Mandalore. Located in Mandalore's northern hemisphere, the Kelita valley was broad and shallow, with dense woodlands and spreads of cultivated farmland, punctuated by circular, fortified Mandalorian homeste…
This EG-6 power droid, owned by the Rebel Alliance, worked on the flight deck of the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence.

Arrochar was a planet on the edges of Hutt Space, located near Mon Calamari and ruled by a traditional monarchy. For long time it remained away from the central politics in the Galaxy, being a recluse planet, as the inhabitants would say, private.

In 3964 BBY, during the Mandalorian Wars, the planet Vanquo had an aid station that served refugees in need. The station was located on the other side of the planet from a mining outpost visited that year by fugitive Jedi Padawan Zayne Carrick.

n: Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa
place: Grand Audience Chamber, Great Temple, Massassi Site, Yavin 4
x: The wedding of the Corellian smuggler Han Solo and Leia Organa was to take place on Yavin 4 in the year 5 ABY.

The Kessendra Coronation was held in 5 ABY in the open-air Kessendra Stadium on Kessel. It was organized by the Central Committee of Grand Moffs to reveal the existence of their champion Trioculus, the Supreme Slavelord of Kessel.

headquarters: Defense Research and Planetary Assistance Center
x: The Rapid Response Team was a unit of the New Republic Senate Planetary Intelligence Network (SPIN). Composed of Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa Solo, Han Solo, and Lando Calrissian, the unit was to be used for secret operations.

The waterfall cave was a cavern located on the Jedi homeworld of Tython. In 3643 BBY, Qyzen Fess went to search for Nalen Raloch in order to help Yuon Par and her Jedi padawan in the cave, but was captured by an overwhelming amount of enemies.
Craci was a planet located in the Craci system in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was the home of the Cracian thumpers, a species used frequently as mounts by scouts.

Etti V was a planet in the Etti system in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim Territories. By the time of the Battle of Yavin, the Corporate Sector Authority moved the Etti species off Etti IV to the planet and did not allow anyone else access to Etti V.
B-3G9, also known as Threegee, was a combat analysis droid manufactured by Czerka Corporation around the time of the Great Galactic War.
During the Great Galactic War, Darth Immern commanded his personal cruiser as part of the Imperial Navy of the Sith Empire. Both Immern and his cruiser were destroyed in the First Battle of Bothawui.
It was mentioned that Oruba used his quick wits and self-preservation to manage and making his criminal empire going.

result: Rakatan victory. Many surviving Je'daii taken prisoner by the Rakata
x: The Attack on Ska Gora was a battle between the Je'daii defenders and the Infinite Empire under the command of Predor Skal'nas.

Artus Five was a lifeless gas giant in the Artus system of the Kwymar sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Following the destruction of Dominator, Darth Jadus faked his death and choose the orbit of Artus Five as a place to hide his secret dreadnought.
Nova was a cruiser in the Republic Navy that participated in the Battle of the Maelstrom, the mission of which was to free Revan from the Maelstrom Prison.
Farstar was a cruiser in the Republic Navy that participated in the Battle of the Maelstrom, the mission of which was to free Revan from the Maelstrom Prison.
A Trandoshan/Confederacy of Independent Systems alliance launched an attack against Kashyyyk around 20 BBY, destroying a Jedi outpost.

A Consular-class cruiser was used by Jedi Master Mavra Zane to transport a group of younglings to the Jedi outpost on Kashyyyk around 22 BBY. She tested them during the trip by using training remotes. The cruiser also carried Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptors aboard.

A Lucrehulk-class battleship was part of a Confederacy of Independent Systems fleet led by the Nihilist over Felucia. During the rebellion there around 22 BBY, a Jedi-led task force intervened. Master Yoda ordered them to concentrate all fire on the Droid Control ship.

The Federated Teradoc Union was a remnant of the Galactic Empire located in the galaxy's Deep Core. The Federated Teradoc Union was formed by two warlords Kosh and Treuten Teradoc, after their own splinter factions united due to Greater Maldrood being targeted by the various o…
The Mandalorian Patrol was an organization of Mandalorian space forces responsible for protecting the Mandalore sector in the years prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars.
The Revolutionary Edge Brigade was a cell of Brentaal anarchists operating during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Palaks were an insect species of near-microscopic beetle which were believed to share large portions of their genome with the predatory voroos species.
This B1 battle droid was used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, serving Poggle the Lesser and saw combat during the Second Battle of Geonosis.
A B1 battle droid was used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars, serving Poggle the Lesser and saw combat during the Second Battle of Geonosis.

2T-DS was a successful droid bounty hunter who was a member of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. At one point, he retired from bounty hunting and became the personal assistant to the Guild's Associate Managing Director of Accounts.
A battle cruiser was commanded by General Khypes of the Sith Empire when he was sent to conquer the recently-discovered Voss system around 3645 BBY.

Mount Avilatan was a volcano located on the island of Avilatan on the planet Ord Mantell. A Separatist stronghold used by the Mantellian Separatist Movement was situated in the very heart of the volcano.

objective: Capture of The Eagle
x: The Raid on Tholatin was undertaken by the Imperial Intelligence in an attempt to capture the terrorist known as The Eagle for the destruction of the Dominator.
Alien Control was an organization within the Sith Empire dealing with the genocidal task of population control within various alien species. Doctor Korvus was a member of the organization.

An unknown Venator-class Star Destroyer was a ship in the Imperial Navy. While in Imperial service during the early months of the Empire, she was critically damaged by a beam fired by the Heinsnake Cult thanks to a tracer planted onto the ship by a cultist.
MZ-12 was an astromech droid that once served under Darth Immern. Despite not being programmed for it, MZ-12 was used by Immern as a navigator.
The Vahitian bat was a variety of bat. Vahitian bats were winged creatures, and they would swoop and dive through the sky as they vied against each other for territory.
The Quake was a massive geological event that occurred on the planet Quesh, beginning around 53,600 BBY.

Experimental Weapons Division was a branch in the Imperial Intelligence of the Sith Empire. One of its members, Geris Paelid, was tasked with testing an experimental weapon on unsuspecting locals on Tatooine.

The Dread Executioners camp was an Imperial outpost of the Dread Executioners located on Oricon. The personnel stationed there included Lord Hargrev, Maiya Vix, Barleos Choid, Dae'o Soset, Halsia Banso, Seibahn Vabakson and Traxalis Deagua.
The Raid in the Rudrig system was a Rebel raid on a broken freighter, Ars Opus, for R2 Units that the Rebel Alliance desperately needed. This was later discovered to be Imperial bait.
Masara was a large island continent northwest of Thyr on the planet Tython.
A species of lizard inhabited Gwori. One lizard killed a clone trooper during the Clone Wars.

A Munificent-class star frigate was created at the Gwori shipyards during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Ahsoka Tano stole the frigate to help them transport the slave workers in the shipyards off-world during a battle on Gwori.
Research Corps Eight was a division in the Imperial Science Bureau of the Sith Empire. The Neimoidian twin brothers Jeek and Teek were both tier-six inventors in the Research Corps.
The Elder Council was the ruling body among the Red or Elder Rakata. Prior and during the Old Sith Wars, the members of the council allied with Revan, the Dark Lord of the Sith.
A battle was fought at Gala in 8 ABY, during the New Republic's campaign against Zsinj's Empire following his death during the Galactic Civil War.
A battle was fought at Andara in 10 ABY during the Galactic Civil War, during the Dark Empire's early campaign against the New Republic prior to Operation Shadow Hand.
A battle was fought at Alsakan in 10 ABY during the Galactic Civil War, when the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Whelm and the Mandator III-class dreadnought Panthac destroyed each other in battle.

Gold Squadron was a unit of three B-wing starfighters in the fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, an Imperial Navy group attacked the cruiser Lulsla, an MC80 cruiser that the unit was stationed at.
Red Squadron was a BTL Y-wing starfighter squadron in the Alliance to Restore the Republic that fought at the Second Battle of the Pakuuni system in 3 ABY. It was destroyed by the Imperial Navy.

Gold Squadron was a Z-95 Headhunter squadron that served in the navy of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. It took part in the Second Battle of the Pakuuni system, where it was destroyed by Imperial Navy forces.
The Starhawk was the prototype of the Starhawk-class battleship line and the product of the New Republic's Project Starhawk during the Galactic Civil War.
Palace Security was the security detail of the Imperial Palace under the New Republic government. It was led by Colonel Jak Bremen.

The Marauders was a gang within the larger White Maw group of pirates active on Hoth during the Galactic War. Admiral Layek Davos who planned to defect from the Sith Empire hired the services of several Marauders to accompany him and his men to the Starship Graveyard.
Wheel was a droid that served as a Republic Strategic Information Service agent active during the Cold War.

Sometime prior to the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, Admiral Jefand Ange led an extermination campaign against the homeworld of the Gen'Dai species. Billions died, and most of the few who survived were enslaved by the Empire.
Satele Shan Boulevard was a street on the planet Coruscant that was situated within Pyochayarit, in the Azda Cluster region of the planet.

Around 3638 BBY, during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Republic breached the Stygian Caldera and attacked the Kalsunor system, a star system in the nebula near the Empire's capital of Dromund Kaas.

Gohai were a non-sentient quadruped species that could be found throughout the Expansion Region. With a well-muscled body comparable in size to large predators like the gundark or nexu, they had a long, thick tail.

The Blocks were a series of massive granite barriers which blocked the path leading up to the Lost Tribe of Sith's mountainside temple on the planet Kesh. Each of these cubes were ten meters tall and gave the impression of a giant staircase for the gods.
Following the Raid in the Rudrig system, three X-wings were hijacked by their R2 units. The Rebels mounted an effort to recover the X-Wings and their pilots.

Following the war led by a Jedi-Republic Coalition against the Mandalorians, and the decline of the Mandalorian ways following the Mandalorian Excision, Aka'liit (or the Mandalorian Faithful in Galactic Basic Standard) was formed by those within the Mandalorians whom desired t…

The Grand Acquisitions Race was a galactic scavenger hunt hosted by the Chevin Conglomerate in hopes of acquiring a series of unique and rare items that they believed would appease the Gree species, which was returning to the known galaxy.

The thunderhead hawk was a type of hawk native to the planet Makeb. A ground-based creature known as the vrake, also native to Makeb, featured a head crest that greatly resembled the head of a thunderhead hawk, and vrakes used the crest to startle their prey—typically small ro…

The Life Day Revelers were a group of Life Day celebrants active during the Galactic War. Around 3638 BBY, they tried to promote their holiday in the Sith Empire, the authorities of which regarded them as subversive nonconformists.

A battle was fought during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems on Malsuum. During the battle, a Twi'lek Jedi led a clone trooper charge but was killed by an explosion.
a: Battle of the unidentified desert planet

x: Blisterbugs were small, non-sentient, venomous creatures. Care had to be taken when poisoned with blisterbug venom, as an allergic reaction could cause swelling and possibly death.

The Semblan eel was a species of eel native to the planet Sembla, which featured enormous coral reefs in its oceans. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Semblan eel was discovered among the reefs for the first time by explorers.

The desert planet Malsuum was the site of a battle during the Clone Wars. Clone trooper Hock Malsuum was marooned on the planet and was taken in by farmers. More than two years later, he left to seek out Darth Vader.

Clan Deshra was a Mandalorian clan that was active during the Galactic War. Members of the clan reverse-engineered alien technology to develop their own retribution feedback shields almost a standard century before the conflict between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent S…
Clan Jennis was a Mandalorian clan active during the Cold War. A number of Mandalorian warriors from Clan Jennis tracked down a shipment of stolen goods.

A planetary defense force existed on the planet Gall during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. They fought the Separatist Droid Army during the battle fought on Gall during the war, but needed aid from the Jedi to defeat them.
The Department of Adjudication, also called the The Adjudicators, was a law enforcement agency in charge of intervening in economic crime and corruption during the days of the Galactic Republic.

t: The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization
x: The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralizaton (also known as THORN) was a philanthropic agency that sought to eradicate the rakghoul pandemic.
A trihexalon-based attack was launched against the capital planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars in 20 BBY.

The Ark was a massive starship created by the Hutt Cartel. Commissioned by Toborro the Hutt as a way to escape the volatile atmosphere of the planet Makeb while carrying a huge supply of the recently discovered power source called Isotope-5.

During its mining operations on the planet Aridus, the Galactic Empire established an outpost. The outpost was destroyed in 1 ABY during a raid carried out by the Chubbit resistance and led by an actor pretending to be the Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi.
OWO-3 was a battle droid who served in the Trade Federation Droid Army, working as a gunner aboard the Trade Federation flagship Saak'ak, a modified Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter.

The smuggler more commonly known as Ace owned an XS stock light freighter during the Cold War and the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Having owned it for a while already, the smuggler had the freighter stolen by the criminal Skavak.

x: In 0 ABY, Imperial stormtroopers made an attack on a small Chubbit encampment being used by a Rebel gunrunner to sell arms to the Chubbit resistance.

x: During their larger resistance to the Imperial occupation of their homeworld, Aridus, the Chubbit resistance fought a battle at the Empire's Iron Tower to permit their Human allies to infiltrate the structure.
The Giant's Spear Mesa was a region of the planet Makeb. It housed a secret facility that housed and constructed the The Ark during the Hutt Cartel's takeover of the planet.

Solida Hesk's resort was a tourist resort located on a mesa of the planet Makeb. During the Hutt Cartel's takeover of the planet, it was the site of a summit between three Hutt clan leaders hosted by the resort's owner, Solida Hesk.

The Fingers was the name given to a mesa on the planet Makeb located between the Avesta Plantation and the Aboro Mesa. The top of the mesa was dotted by smaller mesas that resembled fingers reaching skyward, thus giving rise to the name of the mesa.
The Sanctuary research complex was a region on the planet Makeb. It was known to have housed the lab of famous Hutt scientist Juvard Illip Oggurobb and the cage of a huge rancor, called Grim Tooth.
BB-6G was an astromech droid in service of the Galactic Republic at the time of the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

M3-8Z was an astromech droid in service of the Galactic Republic at the time of the Galactic War. During the Conquest of Makeb, it was sent as a courier by Republic Strategic Information Service Officer Deena Riss to help her enlist the services of the Republic strike force re…

T6-D4 was an astromech droid at the time of the Galactic War. After the Conquest of Makeb, it was sent to Keylander Station as a courier by Supreme Commander Jace Malcom to help him enlist the services of the Republic strike force regarding the mysteries surrounding the surviv…

ZAN-3LO was a protocol droid that was stationed on Keylander Station. The droid assisted Supreme Chancellor Leontyne Saresh in enlisting the help of the Republic strike force during the time of the Conquest of Makeb.

Moraine Territory was the name given to the western end of the Gorinth Canyon on the planet Balmorra. Mostly villages and factories, it was the starting place of the Balmorran resistance, and the Sith Empire invaded the area during their retreat from Balmorra.
The Pterathki were a bird-like species native to Makeb, they were also found in the wilds of Onderon.
Gravity Hook Seven was a gravity hook facility on the planet Makeb. Used in secret to house an Imperial strike team during the events of the Conquest of Makeb.
The Frinn Mesa was a region on the planet of Makeb.
The Yaras were a species who lived on the planet Makeb.
A rebellion was launched against Presidente Shu Mai on the planet Felucia during the Clone Wars around 20 BBY.
The Underwalkers were a species native to Makeb. There was a female Underwalker on the planet Oricon named Nefra, who guarded the Dread Fortress there during the Dread War.
The subteroth was a bipedal non-sentient species native to Makeb.

T4-M7 was an astromech droid serving the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. During the Conquest of Makeb, it was sent to the Drill Site Control Center as a courier by Darth Mortis to help him enlist the services of the Imperial strike team regarding the Shroud.

Z1-3C was an astromech droid serving the reconstituted Sith Empire at the time of the Galactic War. During the Conquest of Makeb, it was sent to the Drill Site Control Center as a courier by Darth Acina to help her enlist the services of the Imperial strike team regarding the …

R-C92 was a model of protocol droid that was stationed on the Imperial Orbital Station orbiting the planet Makeb. The droid assisted Darth Marr in enlisting the help of the Imperial strike team during the time of the Conquest of Makeb.

M5-RT was an astromech droid at the time of the Galactic War. After the Conquest of Makeb, it was sent to the Imperial Orbital Station as a courier by Under-Moff Bensen to help him enlist the services of the Imperial strike team regarding the containment and destruction of evi…

K4-E2 was a model of protocol droid during the Galactic War. It was sent to the orbital station on Makeb as a courier by Moff Varnus Olec to help him enlist the services of the Imperial strike team regarding the build up of mercenary forces on the planet of Darvannis.
D3-X9 was of protocol droid used by the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. It was dispatched to Makeb as part of Katha Niar's forces, where it was stationed at the Drill Site Control Center.
Corvana was a junker ship used by the Balmorran resistance during the Galactic War. It was named by its pilot Ari Skyff in honor of his previous ship, the Corvani.
Magravia was a world located in the Magravia system, a part of the Karthakk sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Jermac was a world located in the Portmoak sector of the Outer Rim. Located along the Llanic Spice Run, Jermac was a notable spice producer.
The Rescue of Sullustan Tech Staff took place during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.

SE-2-4, also known as Twofour, was an SE-2-4 servant droid in the service of Lord Vaskel Savill. Savill treated the droid poorly, and continuously insulted the droid. SE-2-4 was ashamed of being treated that way.
Project Threshold was a program run by the Sith Empire on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War that dealt with creative innovative torture machinery.

Team Sebulba was the name of a Podracing team that was formed by the famed Dug pilot Sebulba during the year 22 BBY. Sebulba, a Podracer pilot himself, had since retired from the sport to lead the team.

SV-3 Eradicator was a prototype battle droid that participated in the Battle of the Red Reaper. Used to defend the bridge of the Red Reaper against capture, the prototype droid's weapons were augmented by six mysterious Sith power sources.

The crime lord Ken-Kiba maintained a base on the second moon of the planet Telerath for his spice-running operations. His spice refineries there were staffed by enslaved Chubbits and Nosaurians, overseen by T'surri gang members.
Golden Fury, also known as Toborro's Glittering Fury Mark II, was a isotope-5 droid built by the Hutt Cartel and powered by the rare substance called Isotope-5.

The Bothrium Beast was a non-sentient creature created by the Dread Master Brontes, found in the Rooted Depths of the planet Oricon. During the Dread War in 3638 BBY this creature was responsible for spreading corruption across Oricon in the form of Tendrils.

The Black Seraphs, or Seraphs for short, were a Corellian swoop gang formed and led by Sunny Bounder and her second-in-command Grinder. Bounder formed the gang from the remains of another swoop gang that she had helped destroy.

The tonitran was a large non-sentient lizard native to the planet Makeb. Tonitran lizards stood on two legs and had yellow skin with green markings on their back. Juvenile tonitran lizards were known as coppi lizards.
Project EK-8 were mutated Flesh Raiders and personal experiments of Rasmus Blys and Czerka Arms on the moon CZ-198 during the Galactic War.

Project TG-5 were mutated Flesh Raiders and personal experiments of Rasmus Blys and Czerka Arms on the moon CZ-198 during the Galactic War. Contained within tanks of unknown content, the subjects, when released, would discharge a pheromone that attracted Project EK-8.

Project DS-5 was an experiment of Czerka Corporation on the moon CZ-198 during the Galactic War. Located in a sewer of the Czerka research facility on the moon, the mysterious subject attacked and was defeated by forces who recovered a vital anti-toxin trashed by employees of …

result: Construction begins on Endor shield generator bunker
x: Around 4 ABY, the Dulok Swamp on the moon of Endor was invaded and destroyed by forces of the Galactic Empire. The Imperials were looking for a site to build a shield generator bunker to protect their Death Star II battle station in orbit of the moon.
The Dragonbane Circuit was located in the crystal swamps of the Agrilat region on Corellia. Unlike the Agrilat Swamp Circuit, the Dragonbane circuit was truly dangerous, for more than one reason.
The Long Run was the starting leg of the Dragonbane circuit. It was a smooth straightway over marsh grass. Because it was clear of obstacles, it was easy for swoop racers to accelerate to high speed.

Pillars of the Sky was the second leg of the Dragonbane circuit. While the previous leg, The Long Run, was clear and smooth, enabling high speeds, this leg took the swoop racers through a dangerous swamp.
The Razor Blades was the third leg of the Dragonbane circuit, following Pillars of the Sky and preceding In a Pinch.

In a Pinch was the fourth leg of the dangerous Dragonbane circuit. This leg took swoop racers through a narrow crevasse, winding its way up to a ridge which was steep. Halfway through the leg, the crevasse narrowed to the point that only one swoop could pass through it at a time.
The Reentry was the sixth and final leg of the Dragonbane circuit. Like the first leg, The Long Run, this leg was clear and almost straight, which allowed for high-speed racing.

place: Dannar's Claim and Hanter's Gorge, Tatooine
x: The Comet Run Day Battle was a battle between the Tusken Raiders and the farmer Orrin Gault's Settlers' Call Fund group.

Dannar's Claim was a combined general goods store, living quarters and cantina located in the Pika Oasis on the planet Tatooine. Originally built by Dannar Calwell, following his death the Claim was run by his wife, the widowed Annileen Calwell.

The Spyder was a sabacc parlor on Coruscant. It was run by the reserved Bothan Korsin Fenn. It was frequented by Black Sun operatives. At some point, the criminal Kaa'to Leeachos owed The Spyder 20,000 credits and ended up banned from the place.
Sector 1265 was a sector on Coruscant. It was home to the Zelcomm Tower.

Capital Security was the law enforcement agency of the Imperial Remnant capital planet of Bastion. In 19 ABY, Capital Security was alerted by Major Grodin Tierce that New Republic operatives were in the city.

result: Destruction of the Vigilant security system
x: The Seizure of CZ-198 was a skirmish between rebellious entities within Czerka Corporation's facility on the moon of CZ-198, the forces of the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

Palpatine's Statue Garden was an open air location in the Republic Executive Building where Supreme Chancellor Palpatine kept a number of stone statues. The garden occupied space on a large balcony on one of the upper levels of the executive building.

The Senate War Rally was an event that occurred during the Clone Wars, which was done to promote the war effort. It was held by the Galactic Senate of the Republic, led by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine.
An isolated chain of islands existed on the planet Balmorra that was home to two unique species—the wingmaw and its primary predator, the Balmorran maweater.
The Nikto Horoth Gendi formed his own gang upon being given control of the Nikto Sector, a region of the moon of Nar Shaddaa, by his Hutt master.
The "Green Ellipse" was the name given to a ruined city on the planet Asation that was completely abandoned by the time of the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The attack on Bandomeer was a battle of the Clone Wars that took place on the planet Bandomeer.

t: Raid on the Republic hypermatter refinery
x: During the Clone Wars, the bounty hunter Volan Das led a Separatist raid on a Republic hypermatter refinery.
The bounty hunter Volan Das owned a starship during the Clone Wars.
The Coruscant Energy Commission was a regulatory body that was responsible for oversight of energy recharge prices on the planet Coruscant.

objective: Destroy a Separatist base
x: A mission to Felucia took place in 20 BBY during the Clone Wars, when Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker set out to destroy a Separatist base on the planet.

The rakghoul tunnels were series of cave and underground tunnels located beneath the surface of various worlds, such as Alderaan, Tatooine, and Corellia, where rakghoul infestations developed. Existence of the tunnels remained unknown until the plague broke out on those worlds.

Green quadrupeds were creatures who inhabited a swampy planet that was visited by the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker sometime during the Clone Wars, an intergalactic war that started during 22 BBY.

A non-sentient crab species existed on a planet filled with swamps. During the intergalactic conflict known as the Clone Wars, which began during 22 BBY, the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker scouted the planet.
Zeta Squadron was an Imperial Navy starfighter squadron that flew TIE/IN interceptors during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, they took part in a battle against Nharwaak at Mylok IV.
Iota Squadron was a starfighter squadron in the Imperial Navy that flew TIE/IN interceptors during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, they fought the Nharwaak at Mylok IV.
6E-O3 was a droid that sold gear to the forces of the reconstituted Sith Empire forces while stationed on CZ-198, during the time of the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and Galactic Republic.

A planet existed in the galaxy that was home to be populated with many dangerous creatures. During the Clone Wars which had begun by 22 BBY, the Confederacy of Independent Systems had set up a base on this planet. The surrounding area was made up of oceans and swamps.

C9-4O was a shopkeeper droid who was active during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the war the droid worked on Carrick Station, where it sold targeting devices and blue sparkle powder.

The Eyeless were massive subspecies of Rakghouls found mainly in rakghoul tunnels. The hulking creatures were known to have inhabited the heart of the plague-ridden tunnels, a single beast for each tunnel network.

The Lair of the Eyeless was the heart of the rakghoul tunnels that were located on Alderaan, Tatooine, and Corellia; all of which were inhabited by huge creatures called the Eyeless and an army of rakghouls.
Angry Ranat was Ponda Baba's personal starship.

C1-10P, commonly known as "Chopper," or simply "Chop," was a masculine C1-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton that was active during the Clone Wars and the early years of the Galactic Empire.
O6-D5 was an astromech droid that operated during the time of the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

C-E29 was a protocol droid that operated during the time of the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The droid was present on CZ-198 as a mission courier for Republic forces fighting during the Seizure of CZ-198.
B5-R8 was a shopkeeper droid that operated during the time of the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire.

GR-18 was a droid that operated during the time of the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. The droid was present on Gravity Hook Seven during the Conquest of Makeb.
Imperial Starship 2423T6H3L5 was the official designation of a starship used by the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
The Marines, also known as SpaceOps, were a division of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Special Forces operating during the Galactic Civil War.

Sluis Control Communications was a group active on the planet Sluis Van during the reign of the New Republic. In the year 9 ABY, Sluis Control Communications forwarded a call from Princess Leia Organa Solo on the planet Coruscant to her husband Han Solo on Sluis Van.

Clan Gedyc was a Mandalorian clan. Following the rise of the peaceful New Mandalorian faction in the aftermath of the Mandalorian Excision, members of Clan Gedyc were divided in their support of the pacifist sect and the traditional warrior clans.

Kol Atorn was an astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories' Kanz sector. It was settled by Mandalorian emigrants and exiles. An individual grew up in the alleys of Kol Atorn and learned an accented version of the Mando'a language from the celestial body's settlers.
Impound stations were areas to which starships were sent if they violated the flight procedures of Galactic City Air Traffic Control on the planet Coruscant.

D-2B8 was an astromech droid in service of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. A counterpart of AG-11 who was fond of him, D-2B8 was stationed aboard the frigate Toron Voq when the ship was attacked by the Sith warship Red Reaper in the Rhinnal system and was destro…
During a mission to Bpfassh, an attempt was made to capture Leia Organa Solo and her unborn twins for the Dark Jedi Joruus C'baoth.

Clan Priest was a Mandalorian clan. Following the rise of the peaceful New Mandalorian faction in the aftermath of the Mandalorian Excision, members of Clan Priest were divided in their support of the pacifist sect and the traditional warrior clans.
