place: Bright Tree temple, Bright Tree Village, Endor
x: The wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa, also known as the wedding of Han Solo and Princess Leia, took place on Endor in 4 ABY following the Rebel Alliance's victory over the Galactic Empire during the Battle of Endor.
a: Wedding of Han Solo and Princess Leia

x: The Phantom was a modified VCX-series auxiliary starfighter manufactured by the Corellian Engineering Corporation that was used by the Spectres during the Imperial Era and the early conflicts of the Galactic Civil War. The Phantom could dock with its mothership, the Ghost.
The Niax was a bulk freighter captained by Hathox Greb during the Galactic Civil War.

Ops was the name used to describe the center of operations for the New Republic base located on the planet of Altyr V. During 10 ABY, Imperial troops arrived on the planet during Operation Shadow Hand.
The Rath Cartel was a criminal organization active at the time of the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Vandelhelm Combine was a criminal organization active at the time of the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Mandellia was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that served as a haven for pirates in the early years of the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Sacorrian grey bears were a mammalian species of bear native to the planet Sacorria. They had grey fur and stood from 2.5 to 3 meters tall with especially long arms.

Korraks were a non-sentient species of large, serpent-like reptiles native to the planet Sacorria. They possessed eight short and stubby but powerful legs, ending in clawed feet and allowing them to move incredibly quickly both and lands and when climbing trees.

Aurean vultures were a large non-sentient, avian species of vulture native to the planet Aurea. Possessing wings of over 4 meters in length, they lived in the planet's deserts where they stayed adrift on warm updrafts until, using their brilliant eye sight, they spotted prey.
Redjellies were a non-sentient species of aquatic creature which inhabited the Boiling Sea on the planet Drall. The creatures traveled in swarms and were light, translucent and delicate in nature.

Ixxis and Su's floating game was the name given to a semi-regularly series of sabacc games run by the scoundrels Brali Ixxis and Prahman Su during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Peace negotiations took place in 15 BBY between Mon Julpa, king of the planet Tammuz-an, and Malameu Toda, overlord of the planet's independent Outer Territories.

A gladiatorial arena was built on the planet Soruus. Many gladiators died fighting in the arena, which included a huge statue of the Tionese Despot Xim holding a heatbeam which towered over the fighting area.

The Palace of Memnii was a structure built on the planet Caamas by the native Caamasi, which housed millions of first-person accounts made by beings from across the galaxy who had confronted violence during their lives.

place: An Ewok village in Sector 5-7 on Endor
x: This Skirmish on Endor took place shortly after the Battle of Endor, as a small group of scout troopers and stormtroopers, under the command of an Imperial commander known only by the designation 347.609/D5, assaulted a treetop Ewok village.
The Republic base camp was the primary staging point used by the Galactic Republic during the Battle of Ilum fought between the Republic and the Sith Empire.

affiliation: Ewoks and Alliance to Restore the Republic
x: This Ewok village was located in Sector 5-7 on Endor. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, it housed the Rebel commando group Recon-A who had been assigned to the village to help the Ewoks recover from the battle.

Otoh-D'in was a paradise located in a swampland according to the mythology of the Gungan species of the planet Naboo. It was created by Balam, the first Gungan warrior, after he was turned into one of the guds by Oma-Oma, the chief deity.
A mining outpost was built on the frozen planet of Keres II in the Empress Teta system. The outpost mined several carbonite deposits and other ores found on the planet.
A tomb was built by the Sith Lord Darth Perash of the Sith Empire. The tomb's construction lasted decades, as Perash continually ordered the workers to tear their progress down and start again.

The Red Light Sector was a section of the Coronet City on Corellia. During the Battle of Corellia the Galactic Republic forces established an Imperial-free Red Light Sector as their base of operations.
The Green Jedi Council was the governing body of the Green Jedi, a sect of Jedi native to the planet Corellia.
The Battle of Kuat was a battle that occurred in 3637 BBY during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

During the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Empire's Bane Brigade attacked the ocean planet of Iskalon. Under the command of Sith, the Brigade set fire to the oceans, leading the Republic to label them butchers and war criminals.
During the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Empire's Bane Brigade wiped out the Jedi Order's Enclave on the planet Genarius.
Ghoral birds were found on the planet Makeb as well as a number of other worlds in the surrounding region.

Romossobar was a planet in the galaxy that was the site of the Place of Enlightenment Through Knowledge. During the Cold War, the Jedi Master Tarben Jenoquan was studying on Romossobar when he was briefly infected with the Dark Plague.
Aderalis was the moon of the planet Deralia.

Battle droid squad 8252 was a B1-series battle droid squad carried aboard a C-9979 landing craft. The squad was deployed during the Invasion of Naboo in the year 32 BBY. The young Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi sneaked onboard the landing craft after escaping the Saak'ak.

B9-D7 was an astromech droid who served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. The droid was stationed on the planet Nar Shaddaa where it acted as a messenger, projecting holograms of Colonel Siturn so he could communicate with Imperials.
B-6NX was a battle droid who served the reconstituted Sith Empire on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War.
The Chem-Basin Mine was a mine on the poisonous planet of Quesh that was important in the planet's supply of Quesh venom. Opened in 3647 BBY, the mine had been opened for four years by 3643 BBY.
The Three Families war camp was a war camp that could be found on the poisonous world of Quesh operated by the Three Families during the year of 3643 BBY in the time era known as the Cold War.

Solu Five was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories along several profitable hyperlanes. During the Galactic War, the planet was represented in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic by Senator Grom Zian.

The raid on Colony Three took place in 5 BBY on the planet Ylesia. Six years after her escape from the Besadii Hutt slaving world Ylesia, Bria Tharen, now a Corellian Resistance member, led a commando mission to free those slaves.

result: One of the biggest military disasters for the Galactic Empire
x: The Shrouded Offensive was an event that took place a few months after the Declaration of a New Order.
The AZ-322 Peacemaker was a battle droid used by House Organa during the Cold War. It was stationed at Wardpost Luurdes in King's Pass on the planet Alderaan.

A government archive was built on the planet Belasco during the Kymoodon Era of galactic history. A report prepared in an effort to reduce colonization in the Outer Rim Territories was stored in archive and detailed five Hutt backed attacks on worlds beyond the frontier at the…

In the year 6 ABY a Conference on Popular Entertainment was held on the planet Obroa-skai. The Academician of Popular Studies Thunys Albegron spoke at the conference concerning the Holodrama True Tales of the Ancient Republic, in particular Episode XXIV: Death on the Rim, whic…
During the Kymoodon Era, forces backed by the Hutt Utoradii kajidic assaulted the planet Parcovey Minor in the hope of enslaving a group of colonists settled there.

result: Slaves successfully taken by Hutt forces

result: Slaves successfully taken by Hutt forces
x: During the Kymoodon Era an assault was made on the planet Lexrul in the Trax sector by raiders backed by Hutts. The raiders successfully captured slaves although some colonists on the planet escaped.
During the Kymoodon Era, a clan battle took place on the planet Lexrul in the Trax sector. The battle was fought by cybernetically enhanced slave berserkers belonging to two rival Hutt kajidics.

Ostor was an arid terrestrial planet located in the Ostor system, at the fringe of the Outer Rim Territories in the Koradin sector. It was a barren planet composed of red soil, deep canyons, and various wind-sculpted rock formations.

objective: Deliver important information to Rebel leaders
x: This mission took place during the Galactic Civil War, as an Imperial diplomat had two Rebel couriers deliver an important message to the leaders of the Alliance.
In 19 ABY, agents of the Imperial Remnant fomented a riot in the area of Merchant's Square in the Bothawui city of Drev'starn, playing off civil unrest caused by the Caamas Document Crisis.

Attis Station was a research facility located on the poisonous planet of Quesh. During the Cold War in the year of 3642 BBY, the research lab was attacked by Imperial forces, and the scientists and personnel were captured and held hostage.
Adrenal Valley was the name given to the valley located north of Broga's Palace and the Malignant Meadow and south of the Chem-Basin Ditchlands. The Adrenal Research Base was located in the area.

objective: Sabotage Imperial Ore Facility
Defend ancient temple
x: This mission took place during the Galactic Civil War, as a group of Rebel operatives were dispatched to Gap Nine to sabotage an Ore facility.

objective: To find the planet of Mortis
x: The hunt for Mortis was a mission led by ten Jedi Knights of the New Jedi Order to find the Mortis monolith at the behest of Grand Master Luke Skywalker in 44 ABY, following the defeat of Abeloth.
In 39 BBY, Darth Maul massacred everyone in the Orsis Academy, following orders from his master, Darth Sidious. The decimation of all within the academy signaled its end.
A penal colony belonging to the Galactic Empire was located on the planet Garen IV during the Galactic Civil War.

Operation Blue Harvest was an Imperial operation during the Galactic Civil War. A Rebel spy once heard several Imperial technicians discussing the project, wondering what it entailed that required large amounts of money and manpower.
Emdee-five was the medical droid assigned to Reekeene's Roughnecks, and stationed aboard the Tsukkian water freighter Home.
The Equatorial trench was the wide trench than ran around the equator of the Galactic Empire's first and second Death Stars, separating their northern and southern hemispheres.
The brother of the Director of Imperial Intelligence Armand Isard served aboard a Galactic Republic starship during the Stark Hyperspace War in 44 BBY.
Utoradii was a Hutt kajidic that led an assault on Parcovey Minor during the Kymoodon Era.

Control was a Terreene Brainiac model of control droid tasked with running the Imperial mobile mining operation on the planet Alabash. It was well-programmed to carry out its task, finding and extracting ores from the surface of a planet.

G2-5T was a masculine G2 repair droid that screened luggage in Spaceport THX1138's Star Tours terminal. Shortly before the Galactic Empire's raid on the space station around the year 1 BBY, G2-9T wondered what had happened to G2-5T, who he expected to relieve him.
Astroport Interstellar Services was a section at a spaceport owned by the travel agency Star Tours by 4.3 ABY. ROX-N acted as the information kiosk staffer to the entrance to the area.

Vark Street was located in the city of Takari on the planet Iyuta. It was the location of The Strip, a section of the street that contained seven bars that commonly catered to Imperial Marines stationed on the planet.

The Strip was a section of Vark Street in the city of Takari on the planet Iyuta. It contained seven bars, including The Giant Step, which were known to be frequented by the Imperial Marines station on the planet.
Fog creatures or mist creatures were a predatory cephalopod species native to Kestavel. They lived in the kilometer-deep, fog-covered ravine surrounding The Lucky Twi'lek casino.

t: Occupation of the Kesh capitol building
x: In 3000 BBY, the Sisters of Seelah, a faction of the Lost Tribe of Sith, occupied the Kesh capitol building.
The Ravager was the flagship of Predor Skal'nas during the invasion of the Tython system in 25,792 BBY.

In 25,792 BBY, during the invasion of the Tython system by the Rakata species' Infinite Empire, the Rakatan forces under Predor Skal'nas invaded the planet Tython in hopes of securing the Prime Infinity Gate in Tython's Chasm.
A security vault overtaken by Gand prisoners was located in the High Security Section of the Belsavis prison.

Athallia was an astronomical object located in the Athallia system. It was a part of the Athallia sector, within the Trailing Sectors portion of the Expansion Region. Kalarcha served as Athallia's capital. Athallia shared its name with the courier starship Athallian Messenger.
Kalarcha was the capital city of the planet Athallia. Fin Mak'lath was native to Kalarcha but moved to Bespin after his wife was killed there in food riots.

The High King's Guard was a monarchical institution on the Imzig homeworld of Couronne. Utris M'Toc, a former member of the High King's Guard, forcibly fled the planet after a bloody coup, eventually transitioning to a security position with the Bespin Wing Guard.

During the Galactic Civil War, an Imperial cruiser served in the Imperial Navy's Fakir sector fleet. It was in orbit of the planet Iyuta and received a priority message from a probe droid that an Imperial scout vessel had captured General Lens Reekeene of the Rebel Alliance.
M8T-V was an astromech droid of the Galactic Republic posted on the Carrick Station during the Cold War.
In 40 ABY, an assassination was carried out on Thrackan Sal-Solo on Corellia.

x: The Assault on Tython, also known as the Invasion of Tython, was a battle that occurred in 3637 BBY during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The Coldest Grave was the name given to the region of the Starship Graveyard on the planet Hoth that lay between the Frostwake Hills and the wreck of the Vehement Sword, and south of the Grim Path.
The Southern Whitelands was a tundra located on the eastern edge of the Glacial Fissure, south of Graveyard Road and east of White Maw Pass. Graveyard Road separated it from the Northern Whitelands
The Great Czerka Datacrash was a famous event involving Czerka Corporation that was perpetrated by the freelance spy known as the Shroud sometime prior to the conquest of Makeb in 3638 BBY.
The six Sith Lords known as the Dread Masters traveled in a dreadnaught during the Great Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Republic Stellar Cartography Service was a branch of the Galactic Republic that dealt with the mapping of galactic space. It frequently bought starships build by the shipwrights of the planet Corellia.
Lank's farm was a farm owned by Bels Lank on the planet Tatooine. He lived there with his daughter, Reen, until the farm was razed by the bounty hunter IG-72 during the Hunt for Adar Tallon.
The Barrier was a formation of solid rock located in the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine. It lay at the entrance to Tusken Canyon.

x: A mission to Coruscant was carried out by a member of the Jedi Praxeum during the Disciples of Ragnos crisis in 14 ABY.

Motivation was a section of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's Sub-Adult Group that dealt with members who failed to live up to tenets of the New Order. Motivations goal was to modify their behavior and turn them into citizens useful to the Galactic Empire.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: SAGroup headquarters was a section of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's Sub-Adult Group that was responsible for co-ordinating the various divisions of the organization.
The Department of Redesign or Redesign Bureau was under the control of the Coalition for Improvements' Sector Development agencies.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
headquarters: ISB Central Office, Imperial City, Coruscant
x: The Commission of Operations was the governing body of the Imperial Security Bureau. Based out of the ISB Central Office in Imperial City, the Commission would transmit assignments to the Sector Officer in charge of the relevant operational branch.

Media was a branch of Imperial Intelligence's Analysis Bureau. It was responsible for monitoring public scandocs, newsdocs, comlinks, beamcasts, and other media to look for hidden messages and patterns that might have been planted by enemy agents.
Crisis was a division of Imperial Intelligence. Formed when needed, Crisis branches were created in response to hot spots that arose across the Galactic Empire.
Tatooine/3 was a system cell serving Imperial Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War. Based on Tatooine, Murtan Andes led the cell.

The Outlaw's Den, known by the reconstituted Sith Empire as Region 92-2987, was an area located in the Jundland Wastes on Tatooine.

A base was built by Wookiee colonists on the moon Alaris Prime close in proximity to a Trade Federation outpost. The base had access to several vital resources, including food, carbon, nova crystals, and ore.

Chewbacca's camp was built on the moon Alaris Prime between 39 and 36 BBY by Wookiee colonists. It was run from a central command center and initially contained buildings used for collecting resources, along with two power cores and a troop center.

A base was built by Wookiee colonists on the moon Alaris Prime between 39 and 36 BBY. It was constructed south of a base belonging to the Trade Federation, an organization the Wookiees were at war with.
The Mendacious Oasis was an oasis located in the Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine. During the Cold War, it was inhabited by a Geonosian militia led by Nekra the Warlord.
The Kalarath Imperial Encampment was an outpost operated by the Sith Empire located in the Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine.

The Northern Jundland Wastes was the region of the Jundland Wastes that lay north of the Wound. The Dreviad Wastes, the Deathly Heat, Manister Base, and Camp Karnori were location in the area, and the Suns' Rise Ridge bordered the southern edge of the Wastes.
A battle occurred in the Pindra system between the forces of the New Republic's Admiral Willham Burke and the Galactic Empire's Admiral Ledre Okins.

x: The Halmad campaign was a lengthy undercover operation perpetrated by Wraith Squadron as they worked to establish their cover as the pirate group known as the Hawk-bat Independent Space Force.
The Visara was a starship which served as a transport escort in the fleet of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire.

The Gamble was a converted freighter used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Princess Leia Organa and General Vanden Willard traveled aboard the Gamble on a mission to negotiate the purchase of materials to be used in the construction of Echo Base.

result: Convicts take control of the planet
x: The Jailbreak was an event that occurred on the penal colony of Ord Vaxal in 20 BBY. It began when a chain gang in a medium-security facility subdued their guards and took over. News of their success spread quickly throughout the planet, sparking mutinies in the other prisons.

Mentor Assassin Zeta was one of three assassin droids that were controlled by the droid consciousness Mentor. Alongside Beta and Theta it confronted the strike team sent to Zadd to halt Mentor's plans for droid revolution.

Mentor Assassin Beta was one of three assassin droids that were controlled by the droid consciousness Mentor. Alongside Zeta and Theta it confronted the strike team sent to Zadd to halt Mentor's plans for droid revolution.

Mentor Assassin Theta was one of three assassin droids that were controlled by the droid consciousness Mentor. Alongside Beta and Zeta it confronted the strike team sent to Zadd to halt Mentor's plans for droid revolution.
A gas giant was located in the Sartinaynian system, and creatures similar to beldons lived in its atmosphere. The gas giant also had numerous moons.

Specters of "Sith Warriors" existed on the Sith homeworld of Moraband. These wraith-like apparitions were conjured by Force Priestesses as well as by the power of the dark side of the Force, in order to test if Jedi Master Yoda was ready to begin training to preserve his ident…
R2-M3 was an R2-series astromech droid used to compensate for the One Liner lack of a navigation computer.

L3-V5 was an astromech droid in the service of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. It was stationed aboard the Gav Daragon where it contacted a Republic spacer regarding the threat posed by Directive 7.

L2-PN was an astromech droid in the service of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. It was stationed aboard the Telos where it contacted a Republic strike team prior to the beginning of their mission to Taral V.

After gaining the upper hand in the campaigns after the death of Warlord Zsinj, Admiral Gial Ackbar invaded the remaining territory of the Galactic Empire, taking the planet Agamar in heart of Imperial Space.

During the campaigns after the death of Warlord Zsinj, the New Republic retook the planet Emmer and the Emmer system, which Zsinj had absorbed into his empire sometime after an earlier New Republic victory there.

The Imperial Diplomatic Corps, or Diplomatic Service, was an organization in the Galactic Empire's military bureaucracy that used diplomats throughout the galaxy for negotiations and talks between governments and large corporations.
The Administration Division was a subdivision of the Imperial Navy's Line Branch.
The Deck Division was a subdivision of the Imperial Navy's Line Branch.
The Flight Division was a subdivision of the Imperial Navy's Flight Branch.

In 18 BBY an ambush occurred on the Twins when the starship Far Ranger, boarded by Jax Pavan, Laranth Tarak, Den Dhur and I-5YQ transport Thi Xon Yimmon, Cerean leader of the Whiplash resistance movement.
Around 18 BBY, the Jedi Knight-in-hiding Jax Pavan came to the Oyu'baat seeking information from a Black Sun lieutenant by the name of Tyno Fabris, who was living in Keldabe at the time.

In 18 BBY after the ambush near the Twins, Thi Xon Yimmon, Cerean leader of the Whiplash resistance, was captured by the Galactic Empire; Vader later jailed Yimmon in the Kantaros Station guarded by a Inquisitorius contingent commanded by Probus Tesla.
Stygeon Prime, also known simply as Stygeon, was a mountainous, snowy planet located in the Stygeon system of the Outer Rim Territories' Nuiri sector.

The Tone was an Imperial BFF-1 bulk freighter bearing supplies as part of a larger convoy that gathered near Orron III en route to the soon-to-be-finished Death Star I. The convoy was due to rendezvous with the freighter Toral, which was attacked on the way by Rebel forces.
The Nullifier was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy. In 0 ABY, the Nullifier was present above Corulag soon before the events of the skirmish on Corulag.
The Pillage was a starship owned by Larken. The vessel was used alongside fellow pirate ships Trust Me and Profit during an attempt to capture the Helix-class light interceptor Kizbon's Box.
The Firewing was an unmarked starship originally owned by a Wookiee Smuggler and some of his human co-pilots.

The Bloodshot Rancor was a starship owned by the technician Carl Norn during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Norn made his friend Andronikos Revel first mate on the ship, though Norn eventually lost the ship due to gambling problems.
Mynock Fodder 62009 was a freighter that visited the planet Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Vusl was one of the continents of Veron. Trelbio spaceport and the city of Hengin Ki-Tapp Wett Gon-far were both located on Vusl.
Ganzka was one of the continents of Veron. Burll-ikem-Tiz-Sah and Gazzt So-Terr Aggul Meztim-Si were both located on Ganzka.
Ablor was one of the continents of Veron. The city of Dish-dok was located on Ablor.
Norol was one of the continents of Veron.
Distt Dok was a city on the planet Veron.
Gazzt So-Terr Aggul Meztim-Si was a city on the continent of Ganzka on Veron. It had a population of 50,000 Gazaran.
Burll-ikem-Tiz-Sah was a city on the continent of Ganzka on Veron. It was the largest city on Veron, with a population of 350,000 Gazaran.
Iutuga was a large island on the planet of Rodia. It was located in the Iuliu Sea, east of the continent of Encheeko.
Camp Kote was owned by the Death Watch on Carlac and was commanded by Lieutenant Vherr. A Jedi Knight infiltrated the camp during the Skirmish on Carlac and defeated Vherr.

During the campaigns to reconquer the Core Worlds in 10 ABY and the resulting Imperial Civil War, a battle occurred at the planet Chasin. The Vengeance-class dreadnought Javelin rammed into the Torpedo Sphere guarding Chasin, destroying both.

Kra was a city located on the smallest continent of the planet Coyn. The spaceport Kra'Tais or "Craftersland" was located in this city as well.
The internal affairs department of the Senate Guard of the Galactic Republic's Senate was responsible for investigating and rooting out corruption within the Senate Guard service.
A city existed somewhere in the galaxy that was home to a Podracing course. The Podracer pilots Wan Sandage Jr., Kraid Nemmeso, and Aldar Beedo raced on it during 24 BBY.
During the Clone Wars, a battle took place for control of a strategic city.
The Conclave of Chanosant was held on the planet Chanosant in an effort to recruit support for the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

During the Galactic Civil War, a Torpedo Sphere was deployed to the planet Fangol after a distress signal was received from the Field Secured Container Vessel Black Ice after it had been captured by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
During the Galactic Civil War, a Torpedo Sphere was undergoing refit and upgrade at the Tallaani Shipyards.
Grand Admiral Pitta's torpedo sphere was a nineteen-hundred-meter vessel that Grand Admiral Danetta Pitta took command of when he became a warlord independent from the Galactic Empire.

During the Imperial Civil War, a Torpedo Sphere was present at Chasin. During a battle fought between two Imperial factions, the Torpedo Sphere was destroyed when it was rammed by the Vengeance-class dreadnought Javelin.

Tuskcat Troopers were Royal Naboo Security Forces riding on tusk cat mounts. They used flamethrowers instead of blasters and had heavier armor than regular troopers. They were also faster due to the tusk cat mounts. They were very effective against mechanized units.

result: Han Solo and Chewbacca escape the blockade
x: During the Galactic Civil War, a skirmish took place in a warehouse located on a deserted moon. It involved a squad of stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire and the smuggler Han Solo, as well as his co-pilot Chewbacca.

At some point during the Imperial Era, Han Solo and Chewbacca were ambushed by the Galactic Empire on an unidentified green planet. However, the Imperials' plans turned against them when a group of Wookiee warriors emerged from the woods and engaged battle.
A warship of the Sith Empire participated in the Battle of Corellia in 3640 BBY, during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic, and was heavily damaged during the battle.
Long before the Great Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, a rebellion carried out by enslaved individuals broke out on the planet Ziost.
During a war on the moon Alaris Prime, the Wookiee Attichitcuk was ambushed by Battle Droid Beta Versions of the Trade Federation.

x: A complex of treasure vaults was built on the planet Dellalt by the empire of the Tionese despot, Xim.
Moraband, known in antiquity as Korriban, was an Outer Rim planet that was home to the ancient Sith Order. The desolate and mountainous world was abandoned after many ancient wars.

The Nimbanels were a sentient reptilian species native to Nimban. They could be found throughout the galaxy demonstrating their talents, particularly in the areas of business, politics, and general problem-solving. Jay Igno was a Nimbanel air taxi driver on Coruscant.
Bardotta was a remote planet located in the Bardotta system of the Shasos sector of the galaxy's Colonies region.
The Parade Grounds were an area on the planet Duinarbulon which were supposedly used by the Duinarbulon Star Lancers and other members of the empire of the Tionese despot Xim.

Alderaan, located in the Core Worlds, was a terrestrial planet covered with mountains. During the waning decades of the Galactic Republic, it was ruled by Queen Breha Organa and represented in the Galactic Senate by her husband, Senator Bail Prestor Organa.

Parcovey Minor was a Mid Rim world situated in the Hune sector. During the Kymoodon Era, it was settled by Galactic Republic colonists from Belasco; however, the Hutts viewed the world as a part of their territories.
The Guiding Hand was an emerging criminal organization during the Cold War on Nar Shaddaa. The Guiding Hand's members were fanatically loyal to their leader, the crazy Jedi Master Duras Fain.

The Red Light Lancers were an organization of tech specialists on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. They were a sub-organization of the bigger Guiding Hand. They were composed of many Nikto and were based in the Red Light Sector.

Dogs, also known as hounds, were a classification of non-sentient, omnivorous quadrupedal or sometimes hexapedal species of canines in the galaxy. One type was the akk dog, which was found on Anoat. The Begamor two-headed dog was found on the planet Begamor.

The Rift Alliance Coalition Forces was the combined military forces of the planet members of the Rift Alliance during the Cold War. They answered first to the Rift Alliance's leaders and performed many missions for them.

headquarters: Senate Building, Federal District, Galactic City, Coruscant
x: The Galactic Senate, also referred to as the Galactic Congress, the Congress of the Republic, or the Republic Senate, was the legislative assembly of the Galactic Republic.

Humans were a species of sentient, bipedal mammals with bilateral symmetry. Throughout the galaxy, they constituted the culturally dominant species and were commonly encountered on most settled planets, from the bountiful planet of Naboo to the desert world of Tatooine.

A family retreat on the planet Z'trop was owned by the Kett family, owners of Kett Shipping. Firmus Kett, a captain in the Trade Defense Force of the Trade Federation, mentioned the retreat in his memoirs, where he claimed the family never spent as much time in the retreat as …

The Coruscant Security Force (CSF), also referred to as Coruscant Security or Coruscant Police and later as the Imperial police, was the law enforcement service in charge of maintaining order on the galactic capital planet of Coruscant.

A planet existed in the galaxy. During an intergalactic event known as the Clone Wars, which had begun by 22 BBY, the planet had aligned itself with the Confederacy of Independent Systems, a major player in the war.

A battle occurred on a planet sometime during the Clone Wars. It occurred when the clone armies of the Galactic Republic stormed the planet, controlled by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, in order to raid its banks of Separatist treasure.

Mon Cala, also known as Mon Calamari or Dac, was an oceanic planet located in the Mon Calamari system, a binary star system positioned in the Calamari sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories and The Slice.
Triumphant was a Star Destroyer serving in the Imperial Navy. It was one of four Star Destroyers that composed Moff Vanko's Vanko's anti-piracy task force.

Naboo was a bountiful planet in the Chommell sector of the Mid Rim, in the Trailing Sectors and close to the border of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the indigenous Gungan species and to a population of humans known as the Naboo.

Dee'ja Peak was a farming community located in the Gallo Mountains on Naboo. It was founded by a nomadic tribe of humans from Grizmallt who came to colonize the planet many centuries before the Clone Wars.

terrain: Frozen ice plains, glaciers, oceans mountains
x: Hoth was a remote, icy planet that was the sixth planet in the star system of the same name, located in the Anoat sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld to the primitive wampa species.
Malachor was a rocky, hellish wasteland planet located in the Chorlian sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories region.
Wampas, or wampa ice creatures, were a carnivorous, semi-sentient white-furred primitive species of mammal which dwelled on the snow-clad planet Hoth.

A Rebel base was on Cardooine early in the Galactic Civil War. The starfighter unit Soaring Dactillions was assigned there at one time to test the A-wing prototype. It was assaulted by the Galactic Empire but the action was stymied by the actions of the tech expert Tendaar Bel.

Cryptology was a department within the Intentions branch of Alliance Intelligence and later the New Republic Intelligence Service. Cryptology had the responsibility for attempting to decipher Imperial codes.

Interrogation was a department within the Intentions branch of Alliance Intelligence. Charged with the questioning of captured prisoners, Interrogation maintained a fully equipped laboratory with both the Alliance Fleet and the Alliance Headquarters.

x: Kessel was a planet within the Akkadese Maelstrom that hosted spice mines. The planet also exported coaxium and Kesselstone. While Kessel's northern hemisphere was devoted to mining, the planet's southern hemisphere was home to lush sanctuaries.

The Executor was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought and personal flagship of the Sith Lord Darth Vader and was the most powerful vessel ever created by the Galactic Empire.

Coordinate was an office within the Operations department of Alliance Intelligence. The office was responsible for handling operations considered too important to delegate to the operatives of Systems Operations.
Passive Operations was an office within the Operations department of Alliance Intelligence. Despite its name, Passive Operations was anything but.

Systems Operations was an office within the Operations department of Alliance Intelligence. Headed by a case officer stationed at Sector Headquarters, they were immobile intelligence networks based in a star system.

During the Galactic Civil War between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire, the Rebel X-wing squadron Soaring Dactillions conducted a raid on the Fondor Shipyards, a key starship construction facility in orbit of the planet Fondor.

The Galactic Empire launched an assault against the Cardooine Rebel base during the Galactic Civil War. The strike force was stymied when the technician Tendaar Bel scrambled the Imperial IFF codes, allowing the Soaring Dactillions, flying prototype A-wings, to route the force.
Counter-Intelligence was a section of Alliance Intelligence devoted solely with monitoring the Alliance to Restore the Republic and guarding against Imperial infiltration.

Security, also known as Alliance Security, was a branch of Alliance Intelligence's Counter-Intelligence department. Security was tasked with recruiting agents and deploying them within other sections of the Alliance.

Retrieval was a branch of Alliance Intelligence's Counter-Intelligence department. Working closely with Security, Retrieval was responsible for taking individuals targeted by Security as suspected infiltrators and proving their innocence or guilt.

Dantooine was a planet in the Dantooine system, in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim Territories' northern New Territories region. Dantooine was affiliated with both the Galactic Republic and later, the Galactic Empire.
The Jedi High Council, more commonly known as the Jedi Council, was a body of twelve Jedi Masters that governed the Jedi Order.

Ewoks were a diminutive primitive species of furry bipeds native to the forest moon of Endor. They were most notable for helping the Rebel Alliance defeat the forces of the Galactic Empire at the Battle of Endor, allowing the shield generator there to be destroyed, and in turn…
Dathomir, nicknamed the "rancor planet," was a remote, neutral, and obscure planet in the Dathomir system of the Quelii sector in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy.
Womp rats were creatures native to Tatooine, and were considered pests by local moisture farmers who hunted them for sport.
Zabraks were a near-human carnivorous species native to the planets Iridonia and Dathomir. Most members of the species had distinctive horns atop their heads, as well as two hearts.
Coruscant , also known as Jewel of the Core Worlds, or Imperial Center during the rule of the Galactic Empire, was an ecumenopolis—a city-covered planet, in the Coruscant system of the Core Worlds.

Onderon was a jungle world located within the Inner Rim. During the Clone Wars, the planetary government seceded to the Confederacy of Independent Systems; in the Separatist Senate, Onderon was represented by Senator Mina Bonteri and later by her son, Lux Bonteri.

government: Clans under the authority of the Mand'alor
x: Mandalore, also known as Mand'alor, was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Mandalorians, a fearsome warrior clan-based people, and the indigenous Alamite species.
The Nightbrothers were a small colony of Dathomirian Zabrak male warriors who lived in a village on the far side of the planet Dathomir under the rule of the Nightsister clan of witches.

Tatooine was a sparsely inhabited circumbinary desert planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Part of a binary star system, the planet orbited two scorching suns, resulting in the world lacking the necessary surface water to sustain large populations.
The Rengali Imperial Naval Academy was one of the Academies used by the Galactic Empire to train its Naval officers. Imperial Captain Ralchio Nervi attended the Academy after marrying Lila Nervi.

The Republic Ministry of Intelligence was a ministry dedicated to the Galactic Republic's intelligence activities. During the Clone Wars, one of the Ministry's workers was a human, Davu Golec from the planet Mandalore.

Lotho Minor, also known as the Junk World, was a ruined planet in the Lotho Minor system in the Outer Rim Territories' Wazta sector that was the homeworld of the mysterious society known as the Junkers. It was discovered early in the history of the Galactic Republic.

The High Board Room was a hydrostatic bubble-chamber in Otoh Gungan, from which the Gungan High Council ruled the city. During the Invasion of Naboo, the two Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi were escorted to the High Board Room to explain their presence in Otoh Gunga.
Chagrians were an amphibious sentient species of tall and horned humanoids with blue skin that were native to the planet Champala.

The Naboo Royal Advisory Council, also known as the Royal Consultative Council, was a body of ministers who served as advisors to the elected monarch of the pastoral planet Naboo. The planet's governor was also the chairperson of that council.
Theed was the capital city of the Naboo, a society of humans who lived on the planet of the same name. It was home to the Royal House of Naboo's palace, which was situated on the Palace Plaza.

Midi-chlorians were microscopic, intelligent life forms that originated from the foundation of life in the center of the galaxy and ultimately resided within the cells of all living organisms, thereby forming a symbiotic relationship with their hosts.

R2-D2, pronounced Artoo-Deetoo and often referred to as R2 (Artoo), was an R2-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton with masculine programming.

Team Alderaan was a Limmie Cup team. Formed from Alderaanians, it counted among its players as of 0 BBY one of the galaxy's fastest athletes, Cael Hanarist. That year, the Galactic Empire annihilated Alderaan as the team was playing in the Cup on the planet Fondor.

Coral Collegium was a school on Dac, a world where education was highly valued. The technician Tendaar Bel was enrolled in astrophysics classes there, although he never actually attended the curriculum.

The Lagoon was a community of renegade undersea computer technicians on the planet of Dac. Formed around 19 BBY in opposition to mainstream Mon Calamari society, the group's members delightfully solved problems in an unorthodox manner and challenged social conventions they vie…
Raydonia was a temperate, forested planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
C-3PO (See-Threepio) was a 3PO-series protocol droid designed to interact with organics, programmed primarily for etiquette and protocol.

Dagobah was a remote, unexplored planet in the Dagobah system, and one of the purest places in the galaxy within the Force. A remote world of swamps and forests, it served as a refuge for Jedi Grand Master Yoda during his exile after the destruction of the Jedi Order.
The Red Desert was a desert located in the southern region of Talss, a continent of the planet Tython.
The Strafe Plains was a region prone to localized Force storms located on the continent of Kato Zakar on the planet Tython.

The Moon Channel was a sea located on the planet Tython that ran between the continents of Kato Zakar and Talss. The city of Ban Landing was located on the coast of Kato Zakar, and the seven Moon Islands were located in the Channel.
The Edge Forest was a forest on the southern coast of the continent Masara on the planet Tython. The Je'daii temple of Bodhi was near the forest.

The Moon Islands were a series of seven islands that were located in the Moon Channel on the planet Tython. The Islands were spread across one hundred kilometers between the continents of Kato Zakar and Talss.
Bothans were a group known for operating a spy network. Bothans were known to communicate with each other in a series of growls.
Nal Hutta, also known simply as Hutta, was a hot, swampy planet located deep within Hutt Space of the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Hutt species and headquarters of the Grand Hutt Council.
Assorhan was the homeworld of the Assorhian species.

Ossapohans were one of the two variants of the Assorhians, the others being the Assopohans. The race of each Assorhian determined their position in society: the black-skinned Osoppohans were the ruling caste, while the white-skinned Assopohans were the slave caste.

Assopohans were one of the two variants of the Assorhians, the others being the Ossapohans. The race of each Assorhian determined their position in society: the black-skinned Ossapohans were the ruling caste, while the white-skinned Asoppohans were the slave caste.
B4-T9 was a vendor droid at the ancient Gree Hypergate on Seline, as well as the Voidstar, which were contested between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
R-5TM was a battle droid who served the reconstituted Sith Empire on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War.

C86 was a battle droid in service of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. On Alderaan, C86 was part of a detachment sent to disable the defenses of a House Ulgo fortress, but the unit met heavy resistance and all except C86 were destroyed.

The Millennium Falcon, originally designated YT 492727ZED and formerly known as the Stellar Envoy, and registered or known under various aliases and pseudonyms including Broken Bell, Corell's Pride, Close Shave, Fickle Flyer, Foul Matter, Graphite Skipper, Jin-Den Smoke, Longs…
Corellia was a planet located in the galaxy's Core Worlds known for its ace pilots and large starships.
The Selkath were a species of aquatic beings native to the planet Manaan. The species was most comfortable underwater and preferred to be immersed in liquid.

S0-M1 was an astromech droid in service to the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. Stationed at the Vaiken Spacedock, S0-M1 relayed to Imperial forces an urgent transmission from Darth Malgus regarding the situation on Cademimu V.

Sarlaccs were dangerous, carnivorous creatures located on Tatooine and several other planets throughout the galaxy. It shared common ancestry with other species, including the rathtar, blixus, and vixus.
ISD-12 was an interrogation droid used by the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War.
N5-R3 was an astromech droid in service to the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Cold War it was stationed at the Outpost Talarn on Alderaan.

Zero was a renegade espionage droid and slicer. During the Cold War he reprogrammed several other droids to serve and defend himself and set up a lair on Nar Shaddaa near the Central Hub Prime, though which passed all Imperial communications.
C0-R1 was an shopkeeper droid in service to the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Naboo (singular "Naboo"), also known as Naboolians or Nabooians, were a cultural group of humans from the planet Naboo. Contrary to the native Gungans, with whom they shared their world, the Naboo originated offworld as human colonists from Grizmallt.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Level 5127 was a level on the metropolitan world of Coruscant, so named because it was located five thousand, one hundred, and twenty-seven levels from the planet's ground. Galactic City comprised the entirety of Level 5127.
Mustafar was a young, small planet located in the Mustafar system, within the Atravis sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

The Devastator was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy, famous for its tenure as the flagship of the Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Vader. Under Vader's command, the Devastator participated in the Battle of Scarif and the capture of the Tantive IV.

headquarters: Senate Building, Senate District, Imperial City, Coruscant
x: The Imperial Senate, also referred to as the Galactic Senate or the Imperial Congress, was the legislative assembly of the Galactic Empire that constituted one of the last remnants of the Old Republic.
RK-C3 was a Czerka Corporation protocol droid stationed at the remote moon CZ-198. During the Seizure of CZ-198 in 3638 BBY, the droid was expropriated and reprogrammed by the Galactic Republic.
D-03A was a Galactic Republic protocol droid banker posted in Anchorhead during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
VZ-19 was an astromech droid of the Galactic Republic posted as a merchant in Anchorhead on Tatooine during the Cold War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

AR-X9 Prototype Droid was a prototype battle droid used by the Galactic Republic to guard the Olaris Spaceport in the Republic Resettlement Zone on Taris. The droid was armed with a flamethrower and a blaster cannon.
C-20 was a Galactic Republic protocol droid banker posted at the Castle Organa on Alderaan during the Cold War.
P-7B7 was a shopkeeper droid of the Galactic Republic managing the cantina at the Castle Organa on Alderaan during the Cold War. Amongst other things he sold deviled Zeldrate eggs.
S-4S0 was a protocol droid stationed on Carrick Station during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Tantive IV was a CR90 corvette in the service of the House of Organa. The ship was a central player in the events at the beginning of the Galactic Civil War, serving as Princess Leia Organa's personal starship in the leadup to the Battle of Yavin.
Sullust was a planet located in the Sullust system of the Outer Rim Territories that was home to the Sullustan species.

T9-M6 was an astromech droid in service of the Sith Empire during the Cold War. Stationed at the Vaiken Spacedock in the after of the Battle of Corellia, T9-M6 relayed to Imperial heroes a transmission from Moff Ilyan Regus urging them to join Imperial offensive on Ilum.

K-4NV was a battle droid of the reconstituted Sith Empire. Stationed by Labor Valley Tram Station on Corellia during the Battle of Corellia of the Galactic War, K-4NV relayed to Imperial forces a transmission from Moff Jiak regarding the renegade droids of the movement Directi…
S-1A0 was a protocol droid which served the reconstituted Sith Empire. It was present at the Vaiken Spacedock during the Cold War.

M9-08 was an astromech droid used by the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. Posted at the Vaiken Spacedock, M9-08 relayed to Imperial forces an urgent transmission from Darth Malgus regarding the reemergence of the Red Reaper, the flagship of Darth Ikoral.

Yavin Prime, also known simply as Yavin, was an orange gas giant, nearly 200,000 kilometers in diameter, located in the Outer Rim Territories. Its clouds provided cover in battle, but death awaited any pilot who dove too far.

B2-44 was an astromech droid used by the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. Stationed at the Thesh Outpost on Hoth, B2-44 suggested to an Imperial hero that the White Maw pirates could be more easily dealt with, if one were to take out their source of income - a rare variant…
The Heavy Resource Recovery Machine 5 or HRRM-5 was a powerful battle droid used by the White Maw pirates on Hoth to guard their valuables stoled at the ice caves of Loramarr during the Galactic War.
Yavin 4, also known as Yavin, was the jungle-covered fourth moon in orbit around the red gas giant Yavin Prime.

Central City was a small country town on the planet of Lothal. When the Galactic Empire occupied Lothal, elite stormtroopers were charged with patrolling the streets of Central City, despite its minor importance.
R-N05 was a shopkeeper droid in service to the reconstituted Sith Empire stationed on Belsavis during the Galactic War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Drash-So was a planet located in the Selvatas system of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Second Imperial Civil War, the One Sith ran a prison labor camp on the planet. Ania Solo and Ramid were two of the inmates there.

Dathomiri clan, also known as coven or witch clan was the name given to a group or assembly of Force-users on the planet Dathomir. By the Clone Wars, dark side-wielding Nightsisters had been united into a single clan under Clan Mother Talzin.
The Saak'ak was a modified Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter that was part of the private fleet of the Trade Federation and served as the Federation's flagship during the Invasion of Naboo.

The Radiant VII was a Consular-class space cruiser of the Galactic Republic. It transported Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi to the planet Naboo, where they were to negotiate with Viceroy Nute Gunray of the Trade Federation.

Level 1 was the lowest megastructure level constructed on the planet Coruscant and was deemed uninhabitable. Level 1 was one of the very first levels of Coruscant constructed in 100,000 BBY that eventually rose from the soil into a world-spanning city.
Wookiees, known in their own language of Shyriiwook as "the People of the Trees," were a species of tall, hairy humanoids that were native to the planet Kashyyyk.
The Coruscant Underworld, also called the Lower Coruscant, lower levels or undercity, were the levels underneath the surface structures of the planet Coruscant.

The Valley of the Dark Lords was an area of Moraband that contained numerous monuments serving as crypts for deceased Dark Lords of the Sith. The largest monument in the valley housed the tomb of Darth Bane, the founder of the Rule of Two.

leader: Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader
x: Clone troopers, also known as Clone soldiers, Republic troopers, Republic troops, Republic soldiers, Regs, and nicknamed the "Boys in White," were highly trained soldiers in the Grand Army of the Republic.
The Cereans were a species of sentient mammals hailing from the planet Cerea. They were distinguished by their enlarged conical cranium that contained a binary brain.

x: The Battle of Bothawui was an engagement that took place near the planet Bothawui in 22 BBY. Remembered as a key battle of the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic's victory in the battle put a stop to a Separatist advance.

The Battle of Quell was a battle that took place in 21 BBY—also dated to 2 BFE—during the Clone Wars in orbit and later the upper atmosphere of the planet Quell, where the Galactic Republic fleet of Jedi General Aayla Secura was assaulted by a squadron of Confederacy of Indepe…

result: Death of Queen Karina the Great
Destruction of the primary Geonosian droid factory and other factories
Capture of Archduke Poggle the Lesser
x: The Second Battle of Geonosis, also known as the invasion of Geonosis or second invasion of Geonosis, took place in 21 BBY during the Clone Wars on the planet Geonosis, which had also served as the site of the conflict's opening battle.

The Dynasty was a modified YT-1210 light freighter that was owned and operated by Axtor Bridgeman. It boasted a faster hyperdrive, both main and backup, as well as two concussion missile launchers. The Dynasty was also 7 meters longer than a stock YT-1210.

The Battle of Malastare Narrows took place at Malastare Narrows in 34 BBY. The Corporate Alliance Admiral Trench blockaded the planet Malastare, and a Galactic Republic fleet, in which the human Wullf Yularen served as one of the leading officers, attacked Trench's forces.

The Logrus was an ExcelStar Lone Scout-A used by Dhar Bullwin in an attempt to recover a power that he hoped to use to rule the galaxy. The Logrus was destroyed by a group of New Republic scouts over Koda's World.

Stewjon was a planet in the Deep Core that was the homeworld of Obi-Wan Kenobi, a male human Jedi Master. Between 32 and 29 BBY, Kenobi told his Padawan, Anakin Skywalker, that he did not remember leaving his homeworld.
A shark was a carnivorous type of fish prevalent on many worlds throughout the galaxy.
Kindalo were a species of tall, bioluminescent, tree-like sentients who could be found in the subterranean caverns of the planet Aleen.
Bespin was a gas giant in the star system of the same name in the Anoat sector, its riches manifested in the form of rare tibanna gas.
The Shadow Collective was a large criminal alliance and rival Sith Order founded during the Clone Wars by the rogue Sith Lord Maul.

The Death Watch, known as Kyr'tsad in Mando'a, was a Mandalorian terrorist splinter group of warriors that opposed the pacifist government of Mandalore (led by Duchess Satine Kryze) during the Clone Wars.

Polis Massa was a planetoid in a dense asteroid field located in the Subterrel sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, far from any major hyperspace lanes. At some point, Polis Massa was a planet located within the system of the same name.
Dathomirians, also known as Dathomirian Zabraks and culturally as Dathomiri or Dathmiri, were a subspecies of Zabrak native to the planet Peridea in a distant galaxy.

NT-X2 or Entax and his counterpart BT-X2 were designed as a top-of-the-line Imperial assassin droids, however they were stolen mid-transport and ended up working for Luskin Exovar as security guards at Exovar's Emporium.

BT-X2 or Botax and his counterpart NT-X2 were designed as a top-of-the-line Imperial assassin droids, however they were stolen mid-transport and ended up working for Luskin Exovar as a security guards at Exovar's Emporium.

Tauntauns were a species of semi-sentient reptomammals native to the snowy plains of Hoth. They were used by members of the Rebel Alliance after they domesticated some of them when they built their new headquarters on Hoth, as the extreme conditions made airspeeders unreliable.

Black Sun was a criminal syndicate that came into prominence during the Clone Wars as the Jedi Order focused more on military affairs and less on law enforcement. Black Sun was allied with the Shadow Collective and its leader, the renegade Sith Lord Maul.

Kamino was an aquatic planet located in a remote star system in Wild Space of the galaxy. It was sometimes considered extragalactic due to being in close proximity to the Rishi Maze dwarf satellite galaxy.

headquarters: High fortress of the Pyke Syndicate, Oba Diah
x: The Pyke Syndicate, also known as the Syndicate, Pyke Family, or simply as the Pykes, were spice traffickers of the eponymous species within the Spice Cartel that operated in the criminal underground from their homeworld of Oba Diah, where they almost completely controlled the…

result: Rebel Alliance defeats Moff Dardano and maintains control of Whisper B
x: Around 0 ABY, the Imperial forces of Moff Lasre Dardano attacked Whisper Base, which had recently been captured by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Zanbar was a temperate swamp moon in the Outer Rim Territories covered with massive rocky plateaus. During the Clone Wars, the Mandalorian splinter group Death Watch established a temporary camp on its surface, which continued to be used after Death Watch allied with Maul to f…

place: Theed and the Great Grass Plains, Naboo

x: The Battle of Naboo, also known as the Battle for Naboo or Liberation of Naboo, was the final conflict of the Trade Federation's invasion of the planet Naboo.
a: Battle of the Great Grass Plains

x: Ugnaughts were a species of porcine, sentient humanoids, native to the planet Gentes. They were considered by many to be among the (if not the) hardest-working species in the galaxy.

Tipoca City was the capital city of the watery planet Kamino, and home to several million Kaminoans and housed the Ruling Council. The city was a network of domed structures built atop stilts over 150 kilometers tall at Kamino's equator.

result: Zonama Sekot makes a blind jump to hyperspace
x: In 29 ABY, Yuuzhan Vong former-Executor Nom Anor, disguised as the Prophet Yu'shaa, traveled to the living world of Zonama Sekot along with Jedi Knights Tahiri Veila and Corran Horn, as well as the Yuuzhan Vong priest Harrar and the shaper Nen Yim.
The Force Priestesses were five beings that resided on the Wellspring of Life, the home of the midi-chlorians.

Members of the Wookiee species built a medical droid on the moon Alaris Prime between 39 BBY and 36 BBY for the purpose of saving Attichitcuk, a Wookiee Chieftain who had been shot and gravely injured by B1-series battle droids of the Trade Federation.
The Malastarian Art Union was an organization dedicated to art, operating on Malastare as of 32 BBY. The Art Union posted a bounty for Guanolta, a member of Sebolto's drug cartel.

The Malastare Special Service was an organization on Malastare around 32 BBY. The Special Service posted a bounty on Jenatahza for being a participant in a plot to murder Representative Ainlee Teem. Jango Fett claimed the bounty alive for the Special Service.
A clan of Wookiees existed on Kashyyyk some time before the rise of the Galactic Empire. One day, a member of that clan was involved in a duel with another Wookiee, the father of Attichitcuk.

The Galactic Wildlife Liberation Front was an organization operating around 32 BBY that sought freedom and safety for non-sentient wildlife. They posted a bounty on Mawshunba Zee, a member of Sebolto's drug cartel, for the illegal breeding of wild nexu.
Cloud City, originally known as Floating Home Mining Colony, was a tibanna gas mining colony floating in the clouds of the planet Bespin, located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Loyalist Committee was a political committee created by Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine as an advisory body to himself to handle the Separatist Crisis and promote loyalty to the Galactic Republic.

No-Holds-Barred was an underground organization aligned to the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It was a collective of directors and actors that had been blacklisted by the Galactic Empire, and early funding was almost entirely provided by freedom-fighter and former Jedi Init…

The Starbound Misfit was a heavily modified Corellian YT-1930 light freighter that was owned by the Near-Human tramp freighter captain Lynnori during the Galactic Civil War, after the Battle of Yavin.
The Rodian slaver owned a starship that he used in the years before the Great Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, an incident occurred at the abandoned lidium mine Mesa 291 on the planet Bothawui.
Soovada, translating from Huttese as Spoils of War, was an annual event held on the moon of Nar Shaddaa by the Hutt species.

D4-N7 was a droid who lived on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. On Tatooine he worked in the Stillsand Waves area of the Dune Sea.
Lola Sayu was a volcanic and sulfurous planet located within the Lola Sayu system of the Outer Rim Territories' Belderone sector.
The University of Zo-Ro was a college on the planet Colstev. It was the site of a massacre conducted by the Imperial Military against the students, who were often dissidents.

result: Assassination of Elan thwarted and her cover as a defector to the New
x: The raid on Wayland was a 25 ABY operation by the Yuuzhan Vong in order to secure the spy Elan's cover as a defector during their war with the New Republic. An assassin trained under Domain Shai was dispatched to the planet Wayland to attempt the assassination of Elan.
In 25 ABY, during the Yuuzhan Vong War, a battle occurred near Exodo II that saw a Yuuzhan Vong ship destroyed, and the spy Elan "defect" to the New Republic.

The ARC program, also known simply as ARC training, and alternatively known as the Clone Commander training program, was a training program that certain clone troopers of the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic underwent in order to turn them into leaders by developing their i…
The Judicial Quarter was a district in the city of Voss-Ka on the planet Voss. The Voss Bas-Ton and his family ran a teahouse in the Judicial Quarter.
Du Mai was a desert world located in the Du Mai system, a part of the Bryx sector in the Slice portion of the Mid Rim. It featured a mountain cave.

Hutts were a large slug-like sentient species who were native to the planet Varl, but considered their homeworld to be Nal Hutta after abandoning Varl due to the Kayfoundo Kapa. They were well known as galactic gangsters who controlled the Hutt Clan crime syndicate.

Count Dooku and General Grievous are captured
x: The Battle on Ord Mantell, also known as the Battle of Ord Mantell, was fought between the Shadow Collective of Maul and the Confederacy of Independent Systems on and in orbit of Ord Mantell during the Clone Wars.
Ord Mantell was a planet of the galaxy's Mid Rim that served as the capital of the Bright Jewel system. It was the homeworld of the Mantellian Savrip species.

Stormtroopers (STs)—also known as Imperial stormtroopers and often derogatorally referred to as "bucketheads"—were the elite shock troops of the Galactic Empire, and were part of the Stormtrooper Corps, an independent military branch operating under the Imperial Army.

The cold weather assault troopers, or snowtroopers and referred to as "snowies" by the troopers themselves, were a specialized stormtrooper variant used by the Galactic Empire equipped to operate in frigid environments.

Kashyyyk, also known as Planet Wookiee C to some humans in the Core Worlds, was a wroshyr tree-covered forest planet located in the southwestern quadrant of the galaxy and the homeworld of the Wookiee species.

The Peacekeepers were a Jedi faction that split from the Jedi Order centuries before 3643 BBY, dedicating themselves to nonviolence and contemplation. They produced many writings, the last of which were their greatest.
Seluket was a planet that featured numerous stone monuments that were centuries old by the time of the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The Kaleesh, also known as the Kaleeshi, were a reptilian sentient species from the Wild Space world of Kalee.
Kri-Ta Outpost was an outpost of the Voss commandos in the Pelath-Ri Marches, a region of the planet Voss that was largely under the control of the warlike Gormak species.

Vondoru was a planet in the Unknown Regions. During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, an Imperial fleet ambushed the Valor-class cruiser Intercessor over Vondoru and destroyed it.

Heavy Weapons Specialists were a branch of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Special Forces. A combat heavy role, Heavy Weapons Specialists were trained to operate and maintain a wide variety of heavy weapons, including repeating blasters, missile weapons, and artillery.
Utapau was a remote, subterranean planet located deep in the Utapau system of the Tarabba sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

Living Fires were entities summoned by the prophet of the Sith alchemist Vodal Kressh within his tomb. The prophet summoned the entities to aid him when a strike team was sent to gather Sith artifacts from the tomb and attacked him.

The Tomb of Vodal Kressh was a Sith tomb built on the planet Athiss for the Sith alchemist Vodal Kressh. Those who had served Kressh during his life remained on Athiss in the tomb and their descendants became known as the Tomb Dwellers.

The Ruins of Kressh were a set of Sith ruins located on the planet Athiss outside of the tomb of the Sith alchemist Vodal Kressh. Those who had served Kressh during his life remained on Athiss in the tomb and ruins and their descendants became known as the Tomb Dwellers.

The excavated tomb was a Sith tomb built on the planet Athiss near the tomb of the Sith alchemist Vodal Kressh. Those who had served Kressh during his life remained on Athiss in his tomb and their descendants became known as the Tomb Dwellers.

M-5Q5 was a shopkeeper droid who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the war it was stationed in the Republic's secret prison on the planet Belsavis.

result: The region of Dathomir, once inhabited by the Nightsisters, has become
x: The Battle of Dathomir, also known as the Massacre of the Nightsisters and Massacre of Dathomir, was a genocidal battle that took place in 20 BBY, during the Clone Wars, on the planet of Dathomir.
The Pykes were a species of sentient humanoids native to the planet Oba Diah. The species had two distinct physiological groups.
Falleen were a repto-mammalian sentient species native to the planet of the same name. They were capable of projecting powerful pheromones.
C-5D1, also known as fifty one was a protocol droid who worked in the Galactic Republic's prison on the planet Belsavis during the Galactic War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Gungans were an amphibious sentient species and the indigenous inhabitants of the planet Naboo. The various different Gungan races could live on both water and land, but often made their home in underwater cities such as Otoh Gunga.

result: The Rift Alliance rescued by the Barsen'thor
x: Around 3642 BBY, during the Cold War, the reconstituted Sith Empire orchestrated an attack on the Valor-class cruiser Fortitude, a diplomatic vessel which served as the meeting place for the members of the Rift Alliance separatist group.

x: Around 3642 BBY, during the Cold War, the Sith Empire orchestrated an attack on the Rift Alliance's Attis Station on the planet Quesh. The attack was repelled by the Barsen'thor of the Jedi Order, assisted by Nadia Grell of the Rift Alliance.

result: Forces of Captain Valon defeated by the Barsen'thor
x: Around 3642 BBY, during the Cold War, the Barsen'thor of the Jedi Order helped the Rift Alliance Coalition Forces defeat the forces of White Maw Captain Valon.

Around 3640 BBY, during the Galactic War, the Rift Alliance Senator Tobas Grell was kidnapped by Stark, a servant of the First Son of the Emperor.

Around 3640 BBY, during the Galactic War, the Barsen'thor of the Jedi Order undertook a mission to the planet Voss, where he helped the young prodigy Gaden-Ko complete his journey as a Voss Mystic, despite the interference of the Sith Empire.

During the Cold War and the following Galactic War, the Rift Alliance organization possessed a fleet, which participated in the Battle of Corellia, among other battles.
A cave was located on the Jedi homeworld of Tython, deep in the Flesh Raider territory. In 3643 BBY, the Twi'lek Nalen Raloch established a camp inside the cave.

A cave on the planet Tython served as the first meeting place between the very first Jedi High Council of the Jedi Order, consisting of Jedi Masters Cala Brin, Garon Jard, Ters Sendon and Rajivari, before Rajivari fell to the dark side of the Force and rose against his fellow …
A cave was located in the Jundland Chasm on the planet of Tatooine. Jedi Master Eriz Vossan often meditated inside it.
After the Battle of Corellia and the defeat of the First Son, the Barsen'thor of the Jedi Order and their allies were celebrated during a ceremony on Coruscant.

terrain: Floating mountains, lush forests, molten caverns
x: Mortis was an ethereal realm within the Force that resembled a planet. Its existence was whispered over in legends and stories passed down through the millennia by Jedi, Sith, and the average spacer alike.
C2-N2, also known as Seetoo Enntoo, was a Hollis-series steward droid owned by the Jedi Master known as the Barsen'thor.
Scrud was an Espionage droid that worked for GalactiCore.
Endor, designated IX3244-A, also known as the Forest Moon of Endor or the Sanctuary Moon, was a small forested moon that was the ninth moon that orbited the Outer Rim planet of the same name.
The Central Lowlands were a particularly arid region of Tatooine, a desert planet located in the Outer Rim Territories.
Ran Dan's Folly was a mining colony at the South Pole on the planet Sunspot in the Tython system. The outpost mined petonium and marionium, two elements used for energy.

The Step of Harmony was an outcropping on the mountain city of Voss-Ka that was used for capital punishment. Individuals who disrupted society were made to step off of the Step of Harmony and plunge to their deaths. Many Voss chose to jump off.

A Tythonian War Droid guarded the grave of the Weapon Master on the planet Tython. It directed the Padawan of Jedi Master Yuon Par to a set of challenges in order to be granted access to the hilt of the First Blade.
Republic Expeditionary Forces was the name of a Republic organization that participated in the Taris Resettlement Initiative.

T8-C3 was an astromech droid belonging to Cin Tykan's expedition on Taris. It survived the attack on the expedition by the Death's Claw pirates and helped a Jedi Knight track Tykan before returning to the Republic base.

The Gormak Lands was a region on the planet Voss that was dominated by the hostile Gormak species. Located to the south of the mountain city of Voss-Ka, the Gormak Lands were home to the Gormak city Gorma-Koss, and was the main staging ground for Gormak attacks on the Voss.
Terentateks were a species of hulking bipeds found on the arboreal planet of Kashyyyk that craved the blood of Force-sensitives.

Sometime during the Great Galactic War and the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, the notorious pirate Harridax Kirill captured a vessel belonging to the Jedi Order that was carrying Force-sensitive children.
While working for House Ulgo and besieging House Teral, the mercenary general Astar Vox operated from a camp near House Teral's residence on Alderaan.

The Carida was a Galactic Republic starship active during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, it was the target of an attack by Sith forces. Jedi Knight Laranna Fain defended the ship but was wounded in the process.

In 3643 BBY, the starship Carida was attacked by Sith forces. Jedi Knight Laranna Fain defended the ship but was wounded in the process. The surviving Republic soldiers led by Lieutenant Bela Whinn called for assistance.

In 3643 BBY, the future Barsen'thor responded to a call for help from the starship Carida, which had been attacked by Sith forces. Jedi Knight Laranna Fain had defended the ship but was wounded in the process.
The Drainage Isle was an island located on the planet Nal Hutta, near the River Lands and the Old Muckworks. A huge putrid chemilizard lived there during the Cold War.

The River Lands were an area located on the planet Nal Hutta, surrounded by the Old Muckworks, the Drainage Isle, the bog and the Rust Yards. The river itself was inhabited by infected and mutant chemilizards.

headquarters: Gardulla the Hutt's Palace, Nal Hutta
x: The Grand Hutt Council, also known as the Hutt Grand Council and the Hutt Council, was the ruling body of the Hutt homeworld of Nal Hutta, which included a number of high profile and influential clan-families, who led the powerful crime family known as the Hutt Clan from the h…

Florrum was a sulfurous desert planet located in the Florrum system, within the Sertar sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, it was the location of a pirate gang led by Hondo Ohnaka.
