x: The Duel on Mustafar, also known as the Battle on Mustafar, was a lightsaber duel where Anakin Skywalker, now the recently apprenticed Sith Lord, Darth Vader, fought his former Jedi Master and best friend, Obi-Wan Kenobi, on the planet Mustafar in the Outer Rim.
The Zillo Beast, sometimes referred to simply as "the Zillo," was a non-sentient, reptilian species endemic to the planet Malastare.
Malcolm's Dunes was the name of a farming settlement in the Dune Sea on Tatooine during the Cold War. It was led by a farmer named Hale Malcolm.
Toborro's Glittering Fury was a golden isotope-5 droid built for the personal use of Supreme Mogul Toborro. It was ultimately destroyed in Toborro's Palace shortly before Toborro's own death.

Soon after the start of the Galactic War, the Barsen'thor undertook a mission to Hoth to investigate rumors of an ancient army imprisoned by the Rakata. There, they found a Rakata monument and fought Rakata guardian droids.
Cell block 923-A was located in the Minimum Security Section of Belsavis.
A Rakata named Lhunu hid in a vault in the Maximum Security Section on Belsavis. There, they met the Barsen'thor.
The TZ-27 annihilator droid was a security droid that was used to guard cell block 923-A on Belsavis.

A zombie, also referred to as an undead, was a corpse revived through supernatural means such as Dathomirian witchcraft. Completely will-less and speechless, zombies were controlled by those who had summoned them in the first place.
The Tomb of Hallow Voice was located in the Tomb on Belsavis and held the leader of the peaceful faction of Esh-kha, Hallow Voice.
Belsavis Orbital security was an organization responsible for monitoring arrivals to to the planet-prison Belsavis and maintaining the Macula Station. Sulle was a Captain in the orbital security.

Koiogra was a world which had been visited by the New Republic pilot Chass na Chadic. While on Koiogra, she discovered a recording of Jyn Erso's speech prior to the Battle of Scarif, realizing she had previously met the rebel on Uchinao a year earlier.

Clawdites were a sentient reptilian species whose members could change shape to impersonate any humanoid close to their shape. Chromatophores allowed Clawdites to replicate the appearance of another person, but could not change their body size or mass.
During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, a custodian droid oversaw a psychiatric unit called Maximum Security Pod J-P8 on Belsavis.
The Trandoshan Veneb Drassk led a clan of Trandoshans during the Cold War, teaching them to abandon the teachings of the Scorekeeper and pursue self-interest.

Around 3641 BBY, the Trandoshan Qyzen Fess issued a ghrajath to the traitorous Trandoshan Veneb Drassk. Accompanied by the Barsen'thor, Fess confronted Drassk and his clanmates on Taris and killed the traitor.
The Holy Path of Mir was a cave sacred to the Voss located in the Old Paths region.
The Halls of the Righteous was a sacred place to the Voss located in the Gormak Lands, in the heart of Gorma-Koss.
The Tela Mining Operations was a Gormak mining camp located in the heart of Gorma-Koss.

A frigate was owned by the Yuuzhan Vong Malik Carr during the Yuuzhan Vong War. It saw action in the Bilbringi system, where it engaged the carrier-cruiser Thurse before its commanders allowed it to appear to be driven off by the New Republic vessel.
LI-45 was a protocol droid stationed aboard the Imperial prototype Harrower-class dreadnought Javelin.
During the Battle of Corellia, after being forced to retreat from Guardian Hold Six, Jedi Jari Orez set up a temporary refuge camp as his new base of operations.
The Enkindle was a Valor-class cruiser in service to the Republic Navy during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Onasi was a warship in the Republic Navy that was under Jedi Master Oteg's command at the Battle of the Maelstrom in the early days of the Galactic War.

result: Death of Jedi High Council member Adi Gallia
x: During the Clone Wars, a skirmish took place on the Outer Rim world of Florrum between the pirate forces of Hondo Ohnaka, aided by the Jedi Order, and renegade pirate forces under the command of the renegade Sith Maul and Savage Opress.
There was a city present on the desert moon Zardossa Stix during the Clone Wars.

The Ruined City was an old remnant of Voss civilization. Located on the planet Voss in the Old Paths, the site was home to many Republic troops and excavation teams. The entrance to the Halls of Enlightenment was also located in the area.

Sundari was the domed capital city of the planet Mandalore. The city was situated in the deserts of Mandalore and was enclosed by a bio-dome that allowed the city to exist on the harsh planet, which had been rendered a desert after years of Mandalorian wars.

In the aftermath of the battle to end the Trade Federation's invasion of the planet Naboo, the funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn was held in Theed for Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn, who was impaled by the Sith Lord Darth Maul during the battle.

In the aftermath of the Galactic Empire's defeat against the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Battle of Endor, the Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker held a funeral for his father, Anakin Skywalker, on the Forest Moon of Endor.

The Ut'ttailri Jawa Camp was a mobile settlement of Jawas on Tatooine during the Cold War, centered around a sandcrawler. However, the sandcrawler was damaged in the Northern Jundland Wastes, stranding the tribe there. Tteek Tlek was one of the Jawas living at the camp.

Twi'leks, sometimes referred to xenophobically as tail-heads or Twi, occasionally referred to as Rylothians, were a tall near-human species whose most striking feature was a pair of long appendages protruding from their skulls, called lekku.
The Kaminoans were a tall, thin amphibian sentient species that hailed from the aquatic planet of Kamino in Wild Space.

Lantibba City was the capital city of Lanteeb during the Clone Wars.

Tusken Raiders, less formally referred to as Sand People or simply as Tuskens, were a nomadic sentient species indigenous to the desert planet Tatooine, where they were often hostile to local settlers. Tusken children were called Uli-ah.
Jawas were a nomadic sentient species of meter-tall furry humanoids native to the Outer Rim desert world of Tatooine. Jawas who migrated from Tatooine were referred to as Offworld Jawas.

Cutter's Way was a GX1 short hauler that was part of the stock of Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships during the Galactic Civil War. A previous owner had started the conversion of this yacht into a light freighter and could be outfitted to serve as either one, or both.

The Rogue Runner was a Gymsnor-3 light freighter that was part of the stock of Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships during the Galactic Civil War. The previous owner had modified the ship by adding weapons and shields however the Ion drive was old and needed to be replaced.

RA-7-D was a RA-7 protocol droid which acted as an engineer and saboteur for the Rebel Alliance. He believed that he was in love with a medical droid, although it was unknown if this is due to a programming glitch or a form of emergent behavior.
Gorse was a tidally-locked planet located on the Inner Rim. It had one moon called Cynda, which was rich in thorilide crystals.

The Cutlass was an Imperial Patrol Craft that served the Galactic Empire after 4 ABY. It was deployed to the Sev Tok system under the command of Captain Untirrka where it planned to board the freighter Argent Lady under suspicion of smuggling.

x: The Imperial Security Bureau (ISB), also referred to as the Imperial Security Office or the Imperial Secret Service, was an internal security and intelligence agency of the Galactic Empire that was charged with defending it against security threats from within and ensuring the…

Pau'ans were gaunt, long-limbed humanoids from Utapau. They dwelled in their planet's sinkholes, and tamed the local varactyl for riding. Due to their long life-span, they were also known as the Ancients.
Rancors were very large, semi-sentient reptilian carnivores native to the planet Dathomir, although they were also introduced to and present on Felucia, Tatooine, Ottethan and Koboh.

The Cave of Evil, also known as the dark-side cave, was a large and living dark side vergence located under a gnarltree on the swamp planet of Dagobah. Entering the cave subjected entrants to the vergence's control, projecting their worst fears as apparitions and illusions.
Lake Paonga was a lake located on the planet of Naboo. The underwater capital of the Gungans, Otoh Gunga, was located in the lake.

P-T48 was a protocol droid who worked as a merchant during the Galactic War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. During the war it ran a stall within the Republic controlled Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport on the planet Corellia.
S-4V5 was a shopkeeper droid who worked as a starship components merchant during Great Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Toydarians were a sentient, winged species from the planet Toydaria in Hutt Space. In addition to their ability to fly, Toydarians were physically defined by their long snouts and webbed feet, and could resist mental manipulation from the Force.

The "Peacemaker's Day" speech was a famous speech issued by General Bouris Ulgo during the Cold War that saw him declare himself King of the planet Alderaan. He issued the speech before a group of his soldiers, but broadcast the speech across the planet.
The Great Pit of Carkoon, also known as the Sarlacc Pit, was a large sand basin located within the Dune Sea, on the desert planet of Tatooine.

Slave I, also spelled Slave One and also known as Boba Fett's starship and Jango Fett's starship, was a modified Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft used by the infamous Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett before the Clone Wars and later his unaltered cloned son, Boba …
Lasats were a humanoid sentient species native to the Wild Space planet Lira San, though the species had settled the Outer Rim world of Lasan.

The Destruction of Alderaan, known to the Alderaanians as the Disaster, saw the planet Alderaan in the Coruscant Core destroyed at the hands of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

x: The Duel on Cloud City was a lightsaber duel that took place on Cloud City in the planet Bespin. After failing to capture Luke Skywalker during the Battle of Hoth, Darth Vader—Skywalker's father—set a trap for Skywalker on the Cloud City of Bespin.

Geonosis, referred to as Geonosia by some natives, was the desert home planet of the Geonosians. It hosted the Confederacy of Independent Systems major battle droid foundries and was the site of the First Battle of Geonosis, the opening conflict of the Clone Wars, as well as t…

The Herglics were a species of sentient, hulking aliens with black skin, a wide mouth, oily eyes, and a blowhole. Due to mistreatment by the Galactic Empire, many took refuge on Level 1782, on Coruscant, where one rescued Anandra Milon from a stormtrooper.

Rats were creatures that could be found in the lower levels of the city-planet of Coruscant. Those that roamed the junkyard of Level 1782 were particularly large. Tatoo-rats dwelled in the palace of Jabba the Hutt on Tatooine.

Mos Espa was a spaceport settlement located on the desert world of Tatooine. The settlement included a number of commercial and workspace settings, as well as entertainment establishments such as the Mos Espa Grand Arena.
Bright Tree Village was home to an eponymous tribe of Ewoks on Endor during the Galactic Civil War.

Coronation Day was an event celebrated on the planet Alderaan. It was also celebrated by the Alderaanian residents of Level 3204 on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire, despite the fact many of them rarely visited their homeworld.
During the Separatist War on Ord Mantell, the Galactic Republic military storage outpost Mannett Point was taken by the Mantellian Separatist Movement.

A starship was manned by droid historians, led by a droid named NL0-A, who were devoted to recording galactic events. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the ship returned from unknown space.

x: The Western Ice Shelf was a region on the planet Ilum.

MD-0 was an MD-0 medical droid assigned to the Imperial Navy EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate. Its service carried over once the ship's crew mutined and took over control of the vessel. MD-0 was responsible for seeing crew members reporting illness so that they could be diagnosed.
MD-2 was an MD-2 medical droid assigned to the Imperial Navy EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate. Its service carried over once the ship's crew mutined and took over control of the vessel.

MD-3 was an MD-3 medical droid assigned to the Imperial Navy EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate. Its service carried over once the ship's crew mutined and took over control of the vessel. MD-3 was responsible for operating the medical bay's bacta tanks, and operated the pharmacy.

MD-4 was an MD-4 medical droid assigned to the Imperial Navy EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate. Its service carried over once the ship's crew mutined and took over control of the vessel. MD-4 oversaw the ship's surgery unit with assistance from MD-2.

The Twilight was a Corellian G9 Rigger-class light freighter owned and operated by the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars. Skywalker and his Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, used the ship to escape from a battle on Teth.

Level 2142 was a level of the city-planet of Coruscant. Following the destruction of the planet Alderaan by the Galactic Empire, two Alderaanian survivors; Anandra Milon and her younger brother Santigo, spent a night in an alley on the level while trying to escape capture by I…

Hangra's Meat Shack was a food vendor stall set up on Level 2142 of the city-planet Coruscant. Shortly after the destruction of the planet Alderaan by the Galactic Empire, the stall's grill was operated by an old man who was approached by Anandra Milon, an Alderaanian survivor.

The Zygerrians were a humanoid feline species from Zygerria. Having evolved from a horned sentient canine species, they built a powerful empire by capturing and selling slaves until the Jedi of the Galactic Republic went to war with them and outlawed it.

Ord Mantell City was the capital city of the planet Ord Mantell. The Black Sun criminal syndicate operated a base in Ord Mantell City, which was the location of a battle between the Shadow Collective and Confederacy of Independent Systems, resulting in significant damage to th…

x: During the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic and Jedi Order carried out an assault on Vizsla Keep 09 in an effort to capture Maul and Count Dooku.
Zygerria was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Zygerrian species.

Lasan was a planet located in the Lasan system of Wild Space that was long ago colonized by a group of Lasat that left their original homeworld of Lira San. The planet was protected by the Lasan High Honor Guard.

x: The Battle of Ringo Vinda, also known as the Ringo Vinda campaign or the Battle for Ringo Vinda, was fought at Ringo Vinda during the Clone Wars. Separatist Admiral Trench captured the planet's orbital graving docks, prompting a Republic effort to retake the world.

The Annaj House of Detention was a detention center built on the planet Annaj. The treasure hunter Barzur Antilles was at one point in his career incarcerated there, and while imprisoned questioned about the treasure known as the Tessent.
The Ultimatum was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer under the command of Captain Rae Sloane during the reign of the first Galactic Empire.
Cynda Dreaming was a freighter that operated between the planet Gorse and its moon Cynda during the Age of the Empire. It was destroyed by the Imperial Star Destroyer Ultimatum in 11 BBY.
The Desert Jewel was a luxury yacht owned by Fayet Kelen, the owner of Kelen Biolabs. It was mainly used by his daughter, Nakari Kelen, for scouting planets for her father.

Ringo Vinda was a planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim, along the Perlemian Trade Route. It was encircled by a massive civilian graving dock. The Ringo Vindans, a human cultural group, spoke Galactic Basic Standard with a distinctive accent.
Votrad Independent Downport was a spaceport located in the city of Votrad on the planet Brentaal IV.
High Security Lockdown was a district on the moon Nar Shaddaa. A hidden annex of the prison district of Shadow Town, it was also home to a number of refugees.

The Boonta Eve Classic, also known as the Boonta Eve Podrace, the Boonta Eve Classic Podrace or simply Boonta Eve, was the largest annual podrace in the galaxy and cultural event on the planet Tatooine.
The Void was the title of the featureless seemingly endless desert covering the entire surface of the planet Abafar. It was broken up by small bodies of water and several outposts such as Pons Ora.
Mos Eisley, also known as Mos Eisley Spaceport, was a large spaceport settlement located southeast of the Jundland Wastes on the backwater Outer Rim Territories planet Tatooine.

Anoobas were a species of vicious and carnivorous canine-like desert mammals. The species had a varying tones of gray fur covering its body. Additionally, anoobas also had a distinct lower jaw that was complemented with chin tusks.

x: The Commission for the Preservation of the New Order (COMPNOR) was a government agency responsible for the promotion of the Galactic Empire's New Order ideology.
Colstev was a small, rocky planet in the Stewjon system. It was the homeworld of Jin-Rio Akabi.

An R2-series astromech droid astromech droid served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. In 4 ABY, the R2 unit participated in the climactic Battle of Endor, assigned to one of the Rebel X-wings.

Clone commandos, also known as Republic commandos while serving under the Galactic Republic and Imperial Commandos under the Galactic Empire, were elite clone troopers that served in the Grand Army of the Republic's Special Operations Brigade during the Clone Wars.
Devaron was a terrestrial jungle planet located in the Devaron system of the galaxy's Colonies that was the homeworld of the Devaronian species.

Ryloth was a planet in the Ryloth system of the Outer Rim Territories, and the homeworld of the Twi'lek species. Its terrain varied, filled with jungles, mesas, valleys, and volcanoes, and had an atmosphere breathable for Twi'leks and humans alike.

Level 3204 was a level of the city-planet Coruscant. It was mostly occupied by residents originally from the planet Alderaan, but after the planet's destruction by the Galactic Empire, most of the occupants rioted before being arrested by Imperial stormtroopers.

Level 1996 was a level of the city-planet Coruscant. The level was a maze of pipes, sluices and catwalks located underneath the compactors of the shady Level 1997 and above the open abyss of Level 1995.
Starlight Towers was an apartment complex on the planet Coruscant that was located in the territory of the paramilitary Justicars' Brigade.

The Old Market Sector was an area of the planet Coruscant. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, a series of riots took place there, which led to the members of the Mon Calamari species being "relocated." A droid mechanic who lived next door to the human child Anandra Milon…

Level 1997 was a shady level of the city-planet Coruscant. Anandra Milon and her brother Santigo Milon met a pair of criminals there to discuss employment, but ended up having to flee the encounter when Imperials arrived at the cantina where the meeting was taking place.
Shady Glen Estates was an apartment complex on the planet Coruscant that was located in the territory of the paramilitary law enforcement group known as the Justicars' Brigade.

Level 1782 was a level of the planet Coruscant which consisted of one gigantic junk yard. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, a camp was set up among the scrap by fugitives hiding from the Empire.
The Shipping Docks was a shipping and docking complex located in Justicar territory on the planet Coruscant.

Corridor G147, also known as sector G147, was an area of space within the Roche asteroid field in the Roche system. During the blockade of the Roche system, corridor G147 was guarded by a single Imperial EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate.
The Evociii swamp was a swamp located east of the town of Jiguuna on the planet Nal Hutta. The Evocii village of Voam was located in the swamp.

Level 1995 was a level of the city-planet Coruscant located below Level 1996. One area of the Level produced humming noises and strange lights, both of which could be perceived from a catwalk on the level above.

Nalis Quarry was a mining quarry that was located southeast of Kaas City on the planet Dromund Kaas. Using slave labor and stone from the quarry, the Sith Lord Qet attempted to construct a colossal statue of his master Darth Vowrawn, but the construction site and Nalis Quarry …

E-B0W was a droid and a member of the Leisurenauts, an all-droid musical band that performed in Kaas City's Nexus Room cantina on Dromund Kaas during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Emperor's Gates was the name given to the gateway on the south side of the Wall on the planet Dromund Kaas.
The Cave of Shadows was an ancient Sith tomb on the planet Dromund Kaas that was located in the Malignant Bog. A powerful Sithspawn could be summoned using a ritual and Sith runes in the cave.
Der' behag was a protocol droid employed as a banker in Kaas City on Dromund Kaas, during the Cold War between Sith Empire and Galactic Republic.
The Expansion Outpost was a small medical and military outpost located in the Kaas City expansion district on the planet Dromund Kaas.
The Jungle Valley was a valley located near the Dromund Kaas spaceport that lay between the Spaceport Expanse and Outpost Tempest.
The Jurgoran Maw was a cave located at the base of a waterfall sinkhole in the Riverfall Wilds on the planet Dromund Kaas.

The Malignant Bog was a swamp located south of the Wall on the planet Dromund Kaas. It was the site of several Sith tombs, and was home to a large number of hostile yozusks, gundarks, sleens, and vine cats.

The Riverfall Wilds was part of the expansive jungle that lay to the south of Kaas City on the planet Dromund Kaas. Located south of the eastern part of the city, the Wilds were so named for the waterfall and rivers located in the region.

The Tythos River Valley was a valley on the planet Tython. The Tythos River ran through the valley, starting at the Forbidden Falls on the mountainside to the north, and ran south through the mountains past the Jedi Temple and out to the Tythonian Gnarls and the Tythos River D…

The Lower Wilds was the name given to the eastern end of the Valley of the Dark Lords, which by the time of the Cold War had sunk far lower than the western end of the valley. The Tomb of Marka Ragnos and the empty tomb of Naga Sadow were located in the Lower Wilds.

Falks Reach was the name given to the sandbar connecting Mannett Point to the larger island of Avilatan on Ord Mantell. The two islands were also linked by a bridge that spanned the sandbar, but it was destroyed in the Separatist War.
The Mirrian Peninsula was a peninsula on the north side of the island of Avilatan on Ord Mantell. It was located north of Talloran village.

The Oradam Peninsula was a peninsula on the north side of the island of Avilatan on Ord Mantell. It was located east of Oradam village, and the Imperial Listening Post was located on a small island off the tip of the peninsula.

Level 3108 was a level on the city-planet Coruscant. Shortly after the destruction of the planet Alderaan, the fugitives Anandra Milon and Santigo Milon fled from the Galactic Empire to Level 3108 from their home on Level 3204.

Mandalorian super commandos, also known as the Mandalorian Supercommandos, the Mandalorian traditionalists or Maul loyalists, were Mandalorian warriors who served the rogue Sith Lord Maul and his criminal syndicate, the Shadow Collective, during the Clone Wars.
The Mon Calamari (also known as Mon Calamarians) were a humanoid, aquatic species native to the planet of Mon Cala. They shared their home planet with the Quarren.

The Mannett Shore was a region of beach on the coast of Avilatan, an island on the planet Ord Mantell. The Mannett Shore was the western beach of Avilatan, and the island of Mannett Point was off the coast there.
The Savrip Shore was a region of beach on the northern coast of Avilatan, an island on the planet Ord Mantell; Savrip Island was off the coast of Savrip Shore.
The Lava Flow Overlook was a series of lava rifts dotted by power generators on Avilatan, an island on the planet Ord Mantell.
Carreras Minor's moon was the moon of planet Carreras Minor in the Outer Rim Territories. There was a junkyard run by Ania Solo located on the moon.
The Old Muckworks, originally known as the Jiguuna Muckworks, was a chemical processing facility located on the planet Nal Hutta, near the city of Jiguuna.
The Bog was a region of the planet Nal Hutta, located between Jiguuna, the Evocii swamp and the Eastern Grime.
W3 was an astromech droid, that accompanied Jao Assam in a starfighter on his mission to the Carreras system in 138 ABY.
Ro-tuK was a droid of the Gree who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
DK-9 was a droid that was tasked with delivering a shipment of spice from Kessel to Gizmel Gam on the planet Ord Mantell.
A gas-emitting creature was native to the water planet Ashash. Its emanations were similar to the stinkfish of Sedri.
The Initiate's Path was a winding path that ran through the southern Riverfall Wilds to the Wall on the planet Dromund Kaas.
The Dugs were a sentient species from the planet Malastare. They were easily identified by their long snouts and the fact that they walked using their arms.

Karranto Mesa was a mesa on the planet Makeb. When the planet was in danger of destruction in 3638 BBY, Karranto Mesa was one of many mesas destroyed in the chaos, exploding shortly before the planet stabilized.
A7-M1 was an astromech droid that served the Sith Lord Lana Beniko as a messenger on Vaiken Spacedock during the Galactic War between the reconsituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Birabosola-K was a Gree research droid dispatched by the starship Gray Secant to study the planet Alderaan. It was accompanied by a squad of more heavily-armed Gree droids.
Takobanulu-K was a Gree research droid dispatched by the Gray Secant to study the planet Dromund Kaas. It was accompanied by a squad of more heavily-armed Gree droids.

Lerantha Lake was a lake located in the Kaamos Territory of the planet Alderaan. Held back by Lerantha Dam, Lerantha Lake was one of the two origin points of the Fornaak River along with the Fornaak Falls, and House Thul had a droid factory built on the north side of the lake …
A series of riots took place in the Old Market Sector on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Justicar Maintenance was an area in the territory of the Justicars' Brigade on the planet Coruscant. Located near the entrance to the Works industrial sector, the area was home to most of Justicar territory's maintenance systems and controls.

The Jedi Embassy was the diplomatic mission of the Jedi Order to the Galactic Republic, which was located in a section of the Senate Building during the Cold War after the Order moved off Coruscant to Tython.

Around 3708 BBY, a Great Hunt was held by the Mandalorians, and a young bounty hunter named Hedarr Soongh competed. Soongh emerged victorious in the Great Hunt, becoming the youngest competitor to ever win the title of Grand Champion of the Great Hunt.
A Great Hunt was held by Mandalore the Vindicated during the Cold War, and the Zabrak bounty hunter Jewl'a Nightbringer emerged victorious in the competition.
A Great Hunt was held by the Mandalorians prior to the Cold War, and the bounty hunter known as Bloodworthy emerged victorious in the competition.

A Great Hunt was held by the Mandalorians sometime between 3678 BBY and 3668 BBY, and the droid bounty hunter known as the Defenestrator emerged victorious in the competition, despite protests from some competitors.
G-4T was a probe droid of the Sith Empire who lived during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
During the Galactic Civil War, the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Task Force Starfall attacked the Imperial Victory-class Star Destroyer Subjugator shortly after it left Kwenn Space Station.

Detention block 241 was a detention area aboard the Victory-class Star Destroyer Subjugator. Walex Blissex and his Alliance to Restore the Republic escorts were imprisoned in detention block 241, and escaped when the ship was attacked by Task Force Starfall.
The Broken Valley was the name given to the lake-filled valley north of the city of Sobrik on the planet Balmorra that was the site of Bugtown, formerly known as the Farnel Research Facility.

The Gorinth Agricultural Sector was a farming region located on the southern edge of the Markaran Plains on the planet Balmorra. The Stillwater Farms were located there, as was the toxic Glowwater Swamp.
Stillwater Farms was a farming complex located in the Gorinth Agricultural Sector, a region in the southern edge of the Markaran Plains on the planet Balmorra.
Zilkins were a diminutive humanoid sentient species whose members had spotted green skin and stood at an average of roughly 0.33 meters in height.
Centax-3, or Centax 3, and nicknamed "The Aunt," was the third of four moons orbiting the planet Coruscant. The Aloo family had a residence there.

Glowwater Swamp was a toxic swamp located in the Markaran Plains on the planet Balmorra, between the clean waters of Stillwater Bend and the purified river that ran through the adjacent Stillwater Farms.

Camp Kono Nolan was a small camp located in the Markaran Plains on the planet Balmorra that was used by the Balmorran resistance. The scientist Iannos Tyrek set up shop there after defecting to the resistance.
Lake Farnell was a lake located in the Broken Valley, north of the city of Sobrik on the planet Balmorra.

N6-BC was a astromech droid who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the Sith Empire. In 3640 BBY, the droid was stationed on the planet Ilum, during the battle that took place there.

N-7F5 was a shopkeeper droid who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the Sith Empire. In 3640 BBY, the droid was stationed on the planet Ilum during the Battle of Ilum. On Ilum the droid manned a small cantina within the Republic base camp.

DG-93 was a protocol droid who served the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War against the Sith Empire. In 3640 BBY, the droid greeted a group of Republic aligned individuals on the planet Ilum, who then traveled to take part in the Battle of Ilum.
L4-B5 was an astromech droid that belonged to Sergeant Pell of Republic Army's Fifth Squadron during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Works was an industrial zone located in the Industrial District of Imperial City on the planet Coruscant. It was a vast, burned out district that was mostly abandoned.

R5-D4, also referred to as R5 (Arfive) and called "Red" by Luke Skywalker, was a red and white-striped R5 astromech droid owned by a group of Jawas on Tatooine in the early days of the Galactic Civil War.
The Chemical Refinement District was a region of the Corellian Sector on the planet Nar Shaddaa.
Coronet Boulevard was a main street in the Corellian Sector on the moon Nar Shaddaa.
The Network Infrastructure District was a region of the Network Access region on the moon Nar Shaddaa.
The Northern Wastes was a region in the Jundland Wastes, on Tatooine.

A 2-1B surgical droid was a staff member of a nursery located in the Jedi Temple on the planet of Coruscant. The droid was attending to the infants in the nursery when the bounty hunter Vianna D'Pow infiltrated the nursery, looking for a Sullustan infant.

Saponza's homestead was a large house on the desert world of Tatooine. After the owner, Saponza, and his companion killed six of Jabba's scouts, Bib Fortuna contacted them, warning them that Jabba would have his revenge.
The Banthan Drifts was an area that was located on the eastern edge oof the Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine.
The Cool Respite was a region of the Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine that was located south of Outpost Zaroshe. It was an area often frequented by the Exchange to stockpile spice.
The Bantha Drifts Tunnel was a tunnel that linked the Jundland Chasm to the Banthan Drifts in the Dune Sea, on the other side of the rock formations that bordered the Chasm.

The Krayt Dragon Graveyard was a region of the Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine that was the site of several krayt dragon skeletons during the Cold War. The Lightspring and an mining complex were located underneath the graveyard.

The Infinite Dessication was a region of the Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine that extended westward from Outpost Zaroshe. The Rakatan complex where the Imprisoned One was kept was located in the area.
The Shifting Path was a roadway that led from Outpost Thorazan in the Dune Sea to the Jundland Chasm on the planet Tatooine.
The Stillsand Waves was a region in the Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine. The Motesta Oasis was located there.
The Ten Thousand Grains was a region in the Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine. The Kalarath Imperial Encampment was located there.
The Unslaked Thirst was a region in the Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine. The Great Pit of Carkoon and the Mendacious Oasis were both located in the area.
The Desert of the Real was a region of the Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine that was located west of Outpost Thorazan. At the time of the Cold War, the area was roamed by Rills and Womp rats.
The Drydust Crescent was the region of the desert planet Tatooine that lay north of the city of Mos Ila. The Ugarra Dunes were located in the middle of the Crescent.

The pontite crystal mines were located in Starlit Pass on the planet Ilum's Eastern Ice Shelf. During the Battle of Ilum, Republic and Imperial forces fought over the pontite crystals within the mines.
The Ugarra Dunes was an area in the Drydust Crescent, the region of the desert planet Tatooine that lay north of the city of Mos Ila.

Camp Can'ali was a Jawa trading camp on the planet Tatooine. At one point during the Cold War, the camp was located southeast of Mos Ila, though the Jawa tribe who lived in the camp soon moved their sandcrawler.

The Shattered Basin was a sinkhole on the edge of the Southern Jundland Wastes that was reachable via a tunnel. The Sevarin Mesa formed the eastern border of the Basin, and the mesa was lined with windmills.
Suns' Rise Ridge was the name given to the ridge that formed the northern edge of the Wound in the Jundland Wastes, on the planet Tatooine. It was named for the twin suns of the planet.

Suns' Set Ridge was the name given to the ridge that formed the southern edge of the Wound on the planet Tatooine. It was named for the twin suns of the planet, and the Ridgeside Sentry Post was built atop the upper ridge.
The contested crossroads was the name given to a crossroads in the Eastern Ice Shelf on the planet Ilum that became hotly contested during the Battle of Ilum.
The Imperial waystation was a base of the reconstituted Sith Empire in the contested crossroads of Eastern Ice Shelf on the planet Ilum.
The Wellspring of Life, also known simply as the Force planet, was the homeworld of the midi-chlorians, microscopic organisms that made life possible by residing in all living things.

Breezefield Farms was a windfarming complex on the eastern side of the Southern Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine. The Latarl and Ma'alin farmsteads were part of the Breezefield Farms. The Mandalorian Outpost Rennar was located nearby.

The Zarazan Farmstead was a moisture farm operated by the Exchange, located east of Mos Ila on the planet Tatooine. During the Cold War, Casey Rix lived on the farmstead. Izzeebowe Jeef lived in a hut a short walk from the rest of the farmstead.
The Imperial base camp was a Imperial base in the Barren Frost region on the Eastern Ice Shelf of the planet Ilum.

LE-4DO was an LE-series repair droid constructed by Anakin Skywalker during his training at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. LE-4DO was built in memory of C-3PO, Anakin's droid on Tatooine, and was programmed to assist the Padawan with his chores.
The Western Jedi Ruins was a region in the Eastern Ice Shelf, on the planet Ilum.

The Sevarin Mesa was a stone mesa on the eastern edge of the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine that was the western wall of the Shattered Basin. A windfarming complex was built in the basin, with windfarms located along the top of the mesa.

The Sevarin Mesa Windfarms was a windfarming complex built in the Shattered Basin in the Jundland Wastes of the planet Tatooine. It was named after the Sevarin Mesa, which formed the western wall of the Basin, and the facility's windmills were built atop the mesa.
The Krayt's Jaw was a mountain range located west of the Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine. Rowan Delk had planned to hike the mountains since he was seventeen.
The Baba Voza cavern was a cave near the city of Mos Ila on the planet Tatooine. It was home to a tribe of Jawas led by the Force-sensitive Jawa Lelek.

The Southern Jundland Wastes was the region of the Jundland Wastes that lay south of the Wound. Outpost Rennar, Outpost Varath, the Breezefield Farms, and the Shattered Basin were located in the area, and the Suns' Set Ridge bordered the northern edge of the Wastes.

The Joroshe's Spirit Cave was a cave located in the Shattered Basin on the planet Tatooine. A holy site to the Tusken Raiders, the cave was visited by Darth Silthar, who was killed in his search for answers about what the Czerka Corporation had discovered in the Dune Sea.

Delrian was a world in the Inner Rim Territories which hosted an Imperial penal work camp. Prisoners incarcerated there during the Imperial Era were tasked with installing electronics on the durasteel restraints used on the Oovo 4 prison.

The Togruta were a tall near-human species, characterized by their colorful skin tones, large montrals, head tails, and white facial pigments. They hailed from the planet Shili, in the Expansion Region.
Twin Suns Station was the name given to the main building complex in the mining compound run by the Twin Suns pirates in the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine.
Twin Suns Mine was a mine in the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine. Part of a mining compound, it was controlled by the Twin Suns pirate gang.
The Ma'alin Farmstead was a windfarm, part of the Breezefield Farms complex located in the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine. It was overrun by Sand People during the Cold War.

The Latarl Farmstead was a windfarm, part of the Breezefield Farms complex located in the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine. It was occupied by Gamorreans during the Cold War until the Sith Empire drove them out to occupy their nearby base.
The Dreviad Wastes was a region of the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine. Dreviad Outpost was located in the area, as was the Chuaro Farmstead.

The Red Cliff was a stone cliff located in the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine. Separated from the Scrap Ridge by a rock formation, the Red Cliff was located south of the Wound, and a Reclamation Service base was located atop the cliff.

The Scrap Ridge was a stone cliff located in the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine. Separated from the nearby Red Cliff by a rock formation, the Scrap Ridge was located south of the Wound, and an Reclamation Service base was located atop the ridge.

A battle occurred sometime on the planet Hosko during the Hutt Cataclysms, a civil war that ravaged the Hutt Empire. During the Cold War, farmers on Hosko discovered buried weapons and droids from the battle.
A moon in the Outer Rim Territories was the site of a palace built by the Kumauri Empire.

XN-D1 was a droid active during the Cold War who was obsessed with dissecting biological life. He maintained a number of laboratories where he conducted experiments, and one of those laboratories was discovered and raided for research data.

Vall Kumauri's flagship was a starship used by the warlord Vall Kumauri. When Kumauri's conquests of approximately 10,000 BBY led to a conflict between his empire and the Galactic Republic, the flagship participated in a battle between the two factions.
The Inquisitor's TIE Advanced was the personal TIE/ad v1 prototype TIE fighter entrusted to the Grand Inquisitor in his mission to hunt down Jedi for the Galactic Empire.

Gelemeade was a planet in the galaxy with at least four moons. During the Cold War, a routine scan of Gelemeade's fourth moon detected signs of simple organic life beneath its uninhabitable surface, and further investigation found a variety of exotic life underground.

The fourth moon of the planet Gelemeade was an inhospitable environment. However, during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, a routine scan of the moon detected signs of simple organic life beneath its uninhabitable surface, and furthe…
The Broken Horn was a modified C-ROC Gozanti-class light cruiser and the personal transport of Devaronian criminal Cikatro Vizago, leader of the Broken Horn Syndicate.
The Broken Horn Syndicate was a criminal organization that ruled the planet Lothal's underworld. The Devaronian Cikatro Vizago was the syndicate's leader.

Detention Block AA-23 was a detention area located within Detention Block AA on the Detention Level of the Death Star. It was reserved for political prisoners. The detention cells for this sector were located 400 meters below Docking Bay 327.

The Lawbringer was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer commanded by Captain Hiram Zataire. In 5 BBY, it was requisitioned by Agent Kallus of the Imperial Security Bureau, who would use it in his mission to snuff out the rebel uprising on the planet Lothal.
Imperial combat drivers, also known as tank troopers, were the elite ground-vehicle pilots of the Galactic Empire's Army.

The Aleena were a species of short, sentient reptiles from the planet of Aleen. The Aleena lived on the surface of their homeworld, while the Kindalo lived in the underground, as was outlined in the Aleena–Kindalo treaty that ended their war.

Exigar was a polluted planet in the galaxy. During the Cold War, surveys of Exigar detected unusual mutations in the planet's flora, and further investigation revealed that the pollution was causing abnormal variations in native lifeforms.
Useria was a planet whose moon was home to the legendary Lunar Gardens, which were in ruins by the time of the Cold War.

The moon of the planet Useria was the site of the Lunar Gardens, a legendary garden that was in ruins by the time of the Cold War. Excavation of the Gardens during the Cold War discovered a cache of valuable specimens.
Mechis II was an industrial planet located in the Mechis system of the Inner Rim. By the time of the Cold War, the world's plant life had adapted to grow inside droids and other machinery.
Loposi Three's moon was a natural satellite of the world Loposi Three. It was situated in the Loposi system, a part of the Dustig sector in the Trailing Sectors portion of the Mid Rim.
Giddea was a planet in the galaxy whose sun died during the Cold War. Bioanalysts managed to harvest specimens from the world before it became permanently shrouded in darkness.

The Sith Lord Balionn-Gur conquered a planet during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic and set out to rule it through law and order rather than fear. Thus, he hired diplomats to convince the populace of his intentions.

During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, a fleet battle occurred above the planet Kamar, leaving dozens of valuable starship hulks behind that were stripped of parts and valuables by scavengers.

Bengely Four was a world in the galaxy that was settled by a group of Kitonaks. During the Cold War, the Kitonak colonists began to rapidly undergo a series of benign genetic mutations, the source of which was traced to a viral infection augmented by a rare chemical in the col…
Bhargebba Six was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Bhargebba system, a part of the Esstran sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Slum district G17 was a district on the planet Coruscant located in the underworld. It contained, among other things, the Spider Arms Hostel, several cabarets, at least two Noodle Bar diners, Chezdeze, Galaxy Noodles, a massage parlor, a gangster hangout, a gun market, and a b…
Besalisks were a humanoid sentient species with four arms and an inflatable wattle that were native to the planet Ojom.
Imperial shock troopers, formerly clone guards under the Galactic Republic, were elite stormtroopers who served in the Coruscant Guard of the Galactic Empire.
Riot clone troopers, also known as clone riot troopers or riot control clone trooper, were specialized clone shock troopers of the Coruscant Guard who were trained in riot control.

Loth-cats were a non-sentient member of the feline tooka species native to Lothal, often found in the grassy plains of that Outer Rim planet. They were small, temperamental creatures, and while at times friendly, were still able hunters with sharp teeth and claws.

Loth-rats were creatures that lived among the grasslands of the Outer Rim Territories planet Lothal. They served as prey for Loth-cats. On the planet, the term was also often used as an insult. The species made its home in the grass of Lothal's grasslands.

Ochotl was an Outer Rim Territories agriworld located in the Airam sector. The company Ochotl Ag harvested the chak-root plant on the planet, which was also the homeworld of the galaxy-renowned shockball player Kob Mondray.
The SkySlayer was a model of light assault starship manufactured by Aratech Repulsor Company. The Grasp, owned by the bounty hunter Teehl, was an Aratech SkySlayer.
The Battle of Shumavar was a battle during the Clone Wars. Former shockball star Kob Mondray fought for the Confederacy in this battle.

The Hutt Clan, also known as the Hutt Families, the Hutt Cartel, the Hutt empire, or just the Hutt clans, was a Hutt crime family that made its riches through smuggling and myriad illegal businesses on worlds across a region of space homonymous with the species name.

Xexto were a sentient species of slight, spindly, six-limbed aliens who were native to the planet Troiken. Xexto were highly dexterous, enabling them to participate in the highly dangerous sport of podracing.
The Er'Kit were a species of humanoids with large, elongated craniums and long, skinny legs. One Er'Kit was Ody Mandrell, a famous podracer who took part in the Boonta Eve Classic.

The Jedi Archives, also known as the Jedi Temple Library, was the Jedi Order's repository of knowledge on Coruscant, rumored to hold the sum total of all galactic knowledge. They were overseen by the Council of First Knowledge.
The Well of the Dark Side was a deep, magma-filled chasm located in the realm of Mortis where the dark side of the Force was channeled.

x: In 41 ABY, the Umbaran Nyss Nenn utilized a scout flyer to travel around the galaxy on missions for the One Sith.

A planet was located in the Unknown Regions. It was orbited by the Rakatan entity Mother who lived inside an abandoned space station, connected to it by an organic tether. The planet was in tidal lock with another planet of the system.
A planet was located in the Unknown Regions. The planet was in tidal lock with another planet of the system.

An asteroid belt was located in the Unknown Regions. Jaden Korr believed the belt to be the remains of a structure, possibly a superweapon, destroyed when the Rakatan Infinite Empire turned the system's star into a pulsar.
The Stormblade Bloodfest was a gladiatorial competition. By the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign, the Houk gladiator Borbig Drob had claimed victory at the Bloodfest on nine occasions.

During the Disciples of Ragnos crisis, a group of Disciples of Ragnos saboteurs infiltrated a power plant on Bakura. A team was sent to investigate by Bakuran authorities, but the infiltrators killed the team. Jedi trainee Jaden Korr then arrived and defeated the invaders.

During the Disciples of Ragnos crisis, an Disciples of Ragnos Immobilizer 418 cruiser attacked a merchant ship near Blenjeel, forcing it to crash-land on the planet. Jedi trainee Jaden Korr later arrived to find any survivors.

In 14 ABY, the criminal Lannik Racto had an office at the upper levels of a large building on Coruscant. There, he was captured by Jedi Jaden Korr. Once Jaden got to the top, Racto taunted the Jedi and opened a door with a room full of assassin droids.
Arena Day was a festival of illegal gladiatorial matches on the Outer Rim planet Lothal.
Houks were a sentient species of hulking humanoids that had massive forearms and were capable of building heavy musculature.

Skahtul's coalition was a gathering of small bands of bounty hunters and mercenaries under the leadership of the Barabel hunter Skahtul and the Kajain'sa'Nikto Calliose, who allied in order to collect a huge prize on Luke Skywalker's head.
MP-77 was a protocol droid who served the Galactic Republic during the Great Galactic War against the Sith Empire. MP-77 had a yellow sensor and grey plating.
The Alderaan consular gardens were gardens attached to the Alderaan consulate on the planet Coruscant.
A drag course used for Podracing existed on the Outer rim planet of Tatooine. The Xexto pilot Gasgano was favored on this course, and he would challenge other pilots to race against him here.
A drag course used for Podracing existed on the Outer Rim planet of Ando Prime. The pilot Fud Sang was favored on this course and he would challenge other pilots to race against him here.
A drag course used for Podracing existed on the Outer rim planet of Baroonda. The pilot Toy Dampner was favored on this course, and he would challenge other racers to compete against him.
A drag course used for Podracing existed on the Mid Rim spice-mining planet of Mon Gazza. The Phuii pilot Mars Guo favored this course, and would challenge opponents on it.
A drag course used for Podracing existed on the Mid Rim spice-mining planet of Mon Gazza. The Aleena pilot Ratts Tyerell favored this course, and would challenge opponents on it.
A methane lake was a body of liquid methane which could be found on the high-gravity planet of Malastare. The Malastare 100 Podracing circuit was built around a methane lake.

Sketto Leap was part of the Malastare 100 podracing course on the planet of Malastare. The section was notoriously difficult, involving a long jump off a ramp, above a deep chasm. The name of the section came from a large Sketto hovering above the chasm.

The Hoodu Geyser Fields were a number of sulfur geysers on the planet of Baroonda. The fields were part of the Grabvine Gateway podracing course. The end of the fields was marked by a gigantic statue.

Table Rock was part of the podracing course know as Sebulba's Legacy on the planet of Malastare. The rock formation split the main road into two distinct parts, a twisting higher path on the left and a lower straight path on the right.
A butler droid was owned by the family of Governor Dol Donar II. The protocol droid was tasked with allowing guests to meet with he governor.
The Golden Ravine was the last part of the Baroo Coast podracing course on the planet of Baroonda. The rock formation featured curving mesa roads and winding turns.

The Baroo Heads were large statues found on the coastline near the city of Baroo and near a volcanic mountain on the planet Baroonda. The Baroo Coast Podracing course traversed the coastline and the Baroo Heads.

The Sketto Canyon Bend was the last part of the podracing course known as Sebulba's Legacy on the planet of Malastare. The canyon featured two distinct parts, a straight left path and a lower, harder to navigate right path.
The Swallow Mud Marsh was a swamp surrounded by a dense, overgrown jungle on the planet of Baroonda. The swamp was part of the Grabvine Gateway podracing course.
NB4 was a porter droid with masculine programming who was employed by the Rodian bounty hunter Slyder while on the starship Star of Empire.
The Bold Ascent was the name given to the eastern side of the Tromper Crags, the side bordering the Glacial Fissure on the planet Hoth.

The Crystal Wastes was a crystalline field located south of the Glacial Fissure on the planet Hoth. The Brig Stompers mercenary unit made their base in the Wastes, and the massive Pantran whitefang Snowblind lived among the crystals.
The Molten Rift was a volcanic rift deep within the Crystal Wastes of the planet Hoth. It was home to a nest of territorial tauntauns that were capable of taking down a fully-grown wampa in teams.

The Eruption Impasse was the name given to a branch of the White Maw Pass, the volcanic fissure that lent its name to the Glacial Fissure region of the planet Hoth. The Impasse was named for the numerous volcanic vents that dotted the rift.
The Big Sink was the name given to the fractured ice sheets in the Northern Snowdrift Hills in the planet Hoth's Clabburn Tundra.

Bitewind Plain was a icy plain located in the western reaches of the Icefall Plains of the planet Hoth. The power station that supplied the nearby Dorn Base was located in a ravine on the Bitewind Plain.

Brightmirror Road was a roadway that spanned the Whiterock Wastes, linking Aurek Base with Outpost Cresh and marking the border between the Icetromper Wastes from the Desolation Plains. The Whiterock Wastes Monitoring Station was located just off of the roadway.

Rodia was a remote and swampy jungle planet. It was the homeworld of the Rodian species. Cities on Rodia were encased with domed environmental shields that allowed entry and exit for vehicles and vessels.
Betu was a continent on the planet Rodia. Shortly after the destruction of the first Death Star, Luke Skywalker took a luxury yacht, named the Desert Jewel, to Betu for a secret mission.
Geonosians were a winged, semi-insectoid species native to the planet Geonosis that created nests in large, spire-like colonies on their homeworld.
The Buried Field was the name given to the snowfield on the planet Hoth that lay north of the Jagged Plains in the Clabburn Tundra and south of Crescent Canyon.

The Frostwake Hills were located at the western edge of the Starship Graveyard on the planet Hoth. The Sith Empire's Frostwake Outpost was built into the hills, with the base's entrance overlooking the Glacial Fissure's Eruption Impasse, and the Grim Path ran through the hills.

The Buried Dead was the name given to the region of the Starship Graveyard that lay to the north of the Grim Path and west of the wreck of the Vehement Sword. Outpost Zerek, a Republic Military base, was located at the western end of the area.

Cell Block D was a detention area aboard the Desolation Alley, a Galactic Republic maximum security federal prison on the asteroid Oovo IV. The Podracing course known as The Gauntlet ran through the cell block.
Crescent Canyon Overlook was a ridge located at the northern edge of the Icefall Plains of the planet Hoth, just west of Dorn Base.
Dour Mountain was a mountain peak that was located at the southeastern edge of the Whiterock Wastes on the planet Hoth, overlooking the Clabburn Tundra.
The Desolation Plains was the name given icy plains that lay north of Brightmirror Road in the Whiterock Wastes of the planet Hoth. Icequake Ridge was located on the southern edge of the plains.
Drossrock Mountain was a mountain peak located at the northern edge of the Glacial Fissure on the planet Hoth, on the eastern edge of the Northern Whitelands.
Borolol's Claw was a mountain on the prison moon Captivity. It was the only place on the moon where the constant storms could be breached by a starship.

x: The Second Battle of Dathomir was a battle fought during the Clone Wars on Dathomir between the combined forces of the Sith and the Confederacy of Independent Systems; and the renegade Sith Lord Maul and Mother Talzin.

The Frigid Plain was an icy plain located in the northernwestern part of the Icefall Plains region on the planet Hoth. The Sith Empire's Drift Hills Imperial Outpost was located underground at the northern edge of the plain, where it bordered the Clabburn Tundra.

Frostclaw's Den was a cave system used by the Skel Frostclaw that was located underneath the Big Sink on Hoth's Clabburn Tundra. The entrance to the den was a volcanic sinkhole spanned by a bridge, and a tunnel connected the bridge to the Buried Field.
Frostbite Lake was a frozen lake located on the eastern Icefall Plains of the planet Hoth. During the Galactic War, Talz commandos established camps along the western edge of the lake.
The planet Kothlis' second of three moons, located in the Kothlis system, was a barren planetoid of rocky canyons and scrubs.

x: The Battle of Coruscant, also known as the first Battle of Coruscant, the Siege of Coruscant, or the strike at Coruscant, was a crucial battle that took place in 19 BBY on the surface and in orbit of the planet Coruscant, the capital world of the Galactic Republic, during the …
The Baliss staging grounds was an area in King's Pass on the planet Alderaan that was used by the military forces of House Baliss as a staging ground during the Alderaan Civil War.
The guerrilla research camp was a research camp used by House Organa's guerrilla military forces in Kaamos Territory on the planet Alderaan. It was built atop the Resistance Ridge.

House Thul was the estate of the noble family of the same name in Kaamos Territory of the planet Alderaan. Thul Palace, Rhu Caenus Spaceport, and the estate of the vassal house House Girard was located on the grounds of the estate.

House Syrush was the estate of the noble family of the same name in King's Pass of the planet Alderaan. However, the Ruur Killik Burrows were located in the mountains behind the estate, and the Ruur hive overran the estate when the tunnels were broken open.
Hijo was an astronomical object located in the Hijoian system, a part of the Expansion Region's Hijoian Space. By 12 ABY, it fell within the territory controlled by the New Republic.
RA-30 was the protocol droid on Carrick Station who handled Treek's contract.
J-0S4 was a shopkeeper droid who sold items made by Binary Star Realty on Carrick Station.
R-NT1 was a shopkeeper droid of the reconstituted Sith Empire stationed at the Imperial Lodgement on Belsavis, during the Galactic War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.
The Lamplit Path was a path marked by lamps that led from the Jagged Plains Imperial Garrison to the eastern end of the Crescent Canyon in the Clabburn Tundra of the planet Hoth.

t: ASP-19, Lightsaber Training Configuration, Mark IX
x: The ASP-19, Lightsaber Training Configuration, Mark IX was a training droid modified after the standard Industrial Automaton ASP-19 battle droid for lightsaber training purposes. The Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader personally designed the modified units for his personal use.
Seeker's Hill was the hill that the Tower of Prophecy was atop on Voss.
The Ambassador Commons were an area of Voss-Ka, within the Alien Enclave, where all offworld visitors were required to stay during the Cold War.
The Republic District was a district in the city of Voss-Ka reserved for the Galactic Republic.
The Imperial District was the area of the city of Voss-Ka reserved for the Sith Empire, consisting of the northernmost plateau in the city.
Fort Kodentha was a fort owned by the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
The Alien Enclave Market was a market located in the Ambassador Commons, one of the Alien Enclaves in the city of Voss-Ka on Voss.

The Administrative Levels were a collection of levels in Cloud City, on the planet Bespin. The Exex was located in the Administrative Levels, as was the Parliament of Guilds. Cloud City's main hospital, Cloud City Central, was located on the Administrative Levels.
Loading bay 372 was a docking bay in Cloud City's Port Town. Odea Aurora usually sold her wares to tourists at the back of loading bay 372.

Mirialans were a long-lived, near-human species native to the planet Mirial. They had skin tones ranging from green to yellow or pink to purple. Most had traditional geometric tattoos on their faces which symbolized personal achievements.
The Protector was an armed frigate in service to the Damarind Corporation. It ferried the Corusca Stones acquired by the Damarind Fishing Station in the Yavin system back to the corporation.
Bountiful Hunter was a light freighter operated by the Lenushaa gang.
Iviitz was a light freighter operated by the Lenushaa gang.

N1-FEX, also known as Fex, was a droid who worked as a mercenary with the Weequay Kasso Trelek and the Human Tera. On one occasion the group traveled to a cantina within the territory of the crime lord Gorgen, which the droid entered by kicking the door off its hinges.

The Galactic Trade Center, also known as the Kaas City Craft and Trade Market, was a major trade market in Kaas City on the planet Dromund Kaas. The name "Galactic Trade Center" also applied to the main building in the market, which featured computer terminals and bankers.
The Ulgo Footpaths were a series of paths that led through the mountains of King's Pass on the planet Alderaan. The footpaths were largely under control of House Ulgo during the Cold War.
6U-N5 was a vendor droid that served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. He sold gear in the Republic outpost on Felucia.

Vonogarusa-K was a Gree research droid dispatched by the starship Gray Secant to study the planet Coruscant. It was accompanied by a squad of more heavily-armed Gree droids, and during the Cold War it stopped transmitting to avoid detection by new Gree droids nearby.
Gamrokodavi-K was a Gree research droid dispatched by the starship Gray Secant to study the planet Hoth.
Dendotaloga-K was a Gree research droid dispatched by the starship Gray Secant to study the planet Quesh.

Pobarazotu-K was a Gree research droid dispatched by the starship Gray Secant to study the planet Tatooine. Accompanied by a squad of Gree battle droids, it investigated Rakata technology left on the world, but the planet's shifting sands slowed its excavations.

Lomasigaro-K was a Gree research droid dispatched by the starship Gray Secant to study the planet Voss. Accompanied by a squad of Gree battle droids, it refrained from transmitting in order to not interfere with the native Voss and Gormak's technological advancement.

Jamona was the name of a location in the Juran Mountains of the planet Alderaan that was in ruins by the time of the Cold War. The ruins were located in a cave along the Fornaak River, just east of the waterfall that took the river into the Glarus Valley.

The Lerantha Footpath was a road that led through the eastern mountains of Kaamos Territory on the planet Alderaan, leading from the Fornaak River to Lerantha Lake. The Thul research camp was located along the trail, as was the bridge to the underground part of the Lerantha Dam.
The Soros Guardpath was a trail that led through the Kaamos Territory on the planet Alderaan, linking the Soros Killik Burrows to the Northern Trail.
Commerce Way was a roadway in King's Pass on the planet Alderaan that led to the House Traders' Circle.
The Circle Maintenance Corridor was a roadway near the House Trader's Circle in King's Pass on the planet Alderaan.
The Ulgo war camp was a military staging camp atop the Riparian Bluffs in the Glarus Valley on the planet Alderaan that was used by House Ulgo during the Alderaan Civil War.
The Ulgo Technical Works camp was a military staging camp atop the Frostrock Promontory in the Glarus Valley on the planet Alderaan that was used by House Ulgo during the Alderaan Civil War.

The Ruur Killik Hivewoods was a region in the southern end of King's Pass on the planet Alderaan that was named after the Ruur Killik nest, which during the Alderaan Civil War emerged from hibernation and established large hives throughout the area.
The Thul training camp was a military training camp for the forces of House Thul in King's Pass on the planet Alderaan. It was located across a small lake from the staging grounds of House Baliss.
T6H-5R was a protocol droid that served Lord Jorad Thul, a noble of House Thul on the planet Alderaan, during the Alderaan Civil War.

The Fen of the First was the name given to a small lake on the eastern edge of the Malignant Bog on the planet Dromund Kaas. It was named for the First, an enormous yozusk that inhabited the wetland during the Cold War.

L1V-IN was an IN-4 information droid. Circa 3 ABY, Rebel Alliance operatives used L1V-IN as a blind drop for passing along confidential messages at the Kuat Passenger Port, but their cover was blown when Do'naal, an Imperial spy, discovered their system.
H0-M3 was a vendor droid that served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. He sold gear in the Republic outpost on Felucia.
M3-45 was a vendor droid that served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. He sold gear in the Republic outpost on Felucia.

F8-N0, or simply En-oh, was a droid that served as an assistant to Keikana Herot, the Science Commander of House Organa's forces at Wardpost Duvaal on the planet Alderaan. F8-N0 assisted Herot in her research into the Killiks.
Camp Beskar was owned by the Death Watch on Carlac and was commanded by Lieutenant Ralnar. A Jedi Knight infiltrated the camp during the Skirmish on Carlac and defeated Ralnar.
Camp Ara'nov was owned by the Death Watch on Carlac and was commanded by Lieutenant Melkket. A Jedi Knight infiltrated the camp during the Skirmish on Carlac and defeated Melkket.
The Destroyed Village was a village on Carlac that was destroyed by the Death Watch during the Skirmish on Carlac. A Jedi Knight once fought Death Watch Sergeant Kellov in the ruins of this village.
The Rancor Colony on Felucia was a colony mothered by Scratch. The colony saw battle during the Third battle of Felucia.
Scratch's Cave on Felucia was the cave of the rancor, Scratch. She mothered the rancor colony around this cave.

The Sarlacc Pit on Felucia existed during the Clone Wars. During the Third battle of Felucia, the Galactic Republic requested that a Jedi Knight collect samples of green slime dripping off the sarlaccs spines for medical technology.
Banthas were a species of large, hairy mammals with sharp, spiraling horns. They inhabited the desert planet Tatooine, though they were bred on many worlds throughout the galaxy.

Sullustans were a species of humanoids that hailed from the planet of Sullust, and were experts at manufacturing, scientific and technological development, and economics, having founded the prosperous SoroSuub Corporation.
The mission to Kashyyyk was one step in the Rebellion's plan to keep the Empire away from Echo Base.

Dandoran was a lush and watery planet located in the Doran system, within Hutt Space. Throughout history, it was often used to hide cartel smuggling operations. It was covered in crystal clear lakes and pristine forests.
The B2 Assault was an enhanced B2-HA super battle droid that the Confederacy of Independent Systems deployed during the Third battle of Felucia to patrol the Separatist base.

The Esh-kha stasis vault was a Rakatan statis vault, one of many on the planet Belsavis used to contain the Esh-kha. This particular vault was located in the Caves of the Primeval Wardens in the Tomb, and imprisoned the followers of the Esh-kha revolutionary Hallow Voice.

This Nysillin farm was a nysillin farm located on Felucia. It was captured by the Nuro Pirates, who were supplying the Confederacy of Independent Systems with nysillin during the Third battle of Felucia.
MT-4T was an astromech droid during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Fujari were a group of pirates that committed various acts of piracy in the Rseik sector around the time of the Bordal Contagion. They raided a Galactic Republic convoy attempting to bring the antidote to the Bordali, which caused the cure for the contagion to be ruined.
The Jedi Temple Guard was a security force maintained by the Jedi Order and tasked with the protection of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, the capital planet of the Galactic Republic.

T6-44 was an astromech droid that served the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Cold War. It was tasked with delivering supplies to the Thul research camp on the planet Alderaan, but Killiks attacked and stole the supplies.

The Kuat Drive Yards Governor Quarters were the residences on board the Kuat Drive Yards for the governor of the Drive Yards. Asset K-33 took up residence in these quarters while undercover for the Sith Empire.
The Wok-Wok was a monkey-like scavenger that was native to the planet Aris. They were friendly, and often roamed the platforms strung between the trees on which the population lived.
White Maw Pass was the proper name for the icy rift that the Glacial Fissure region on the planet Hoth was named after.
A camp was built within the junkyards of Level 1782 of the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Alderaanians were a cultural group of humans native to the planet Alderaan. Known for their pacifistic values and devotion to the arts, prominent individuals included Viceroy Bail Prestor Organa and his wife, Queen Breha Organa, who were the adoptive parents of Princess Leia O…
RC-42 was a protocol droid that was stationed on the planet Tatooine during the Rakghoul pandemic during the Cold War.

The Bala D'ur was a Gen'Dai faction of the White Maw pirate gang during the Cold War and the Galactic War. The Gen'Dai held several Ortolans colonists hostage until they were rescued by forces affiliated with the Galactic Republic.
Beggar's Canyon was a dry river bed that cut through Ben's Mesa, on the desert world of Tatooine. Its landmarks included the so-called Dead Man's Turn, the Diablo Cut, and the Stone Needle.
Vergesso I was one of five valueless asteroid rings orbiting the yellow star Lybeya in the Outer Rim Territories' Lybeya system.
Vergesso II was one of five valueless asteroid rings orbiting the yellow star Lybeya in the Outer Rim Territories' Lybeya system.
Vergesso III, also Vergesso Belt III and Vergesso Field III, was one of five valueless asteroid rings orbiting the yellow star Lybeya in the Outer Rim Territories' Lybeya system.
Vergesso IV was one of five valueless asteroid rings orbiting the yellow star Lybeya in the Outer Rim Territories' Lybeya system.
Vergesso V was one of five valueless asteroid rings orbiting the yellow star Lybeya in the Outer Rim Territories' Lybeya system.
Vanguard Outpost was a military outpost of the reconstituted Sith Empire that was situated on the Markaran Plains on the planet Balmorra, along the southern ridge of the Jacent Valley.
The Voss commando outpost, also known as Camp Isah-No or Camp Talen-Ki, was an outpost built by the Voss commandos atop Koss Overlook in the Gormak Lands of the planet Voss.

Clone Intelligence was the military intelligence branch of the Grand Army of the Republic. During the Clone Wars, clone espionage units were tasked with tracking General Grievous, a Separatist commander and high-value target of the Galactic Republic.
The Unearthed was a Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft used by the treasure hunter Aach Een.

Garel was a planet located in the Garel system of the Outer Rim Territories' Lothal sector that was controlled by the Galactic Empire. It was the homeworld of Imperial Supply Master Yogar Lyste. Garel was several minutes away from the planet Lothal via hyperspace travel.

Cynda was the thorilide-rich moon of the planet Gorse, located in the Inner Rim of the galaxy. The moon was vital to the production of turbolasers in the Galactic Republic and, later, the Galactic Empire.
Moonglow-72, tagged Imperial Provisional 72 and Renegade One by the Galactic Empire, and the Expedient by the human Kanan Jarrus, was a mining transport ship owned by Moonglow Polychemical.
The One in a Million was a Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 owned by the collector Oolak Goyl.
The Emerald Empress was a Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 owned by the politician Zethe Raskin.
The Umbaran airbase was a base used by the Umbaran militia and their Confederacy of Independent Systems allies during the Battle of Umbara.

x: Confederacy of Independent Systems landing zone Aurek was a landing zone used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Battle of Umbara.

t: Confederacy of Independent Systems landing zone Besk
x: Confederacy of Independent Systems landing zone Besk was a landing zone used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Battle of Umbara.

The term "krayt dragon" referred to a number of large, carnivorous reptilian species that hailed from Tatooine, a desert planet in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Krayt dragons, despite their fierceness, were hunted for the precious pearls found in their bodies.

Neimoidians were a humanoid species native to the planet of Neimoidia, while also settling wealthy colonies they named Purse Worlds, such as Cato Neimoidia. They had smooth noseless faces, mottled green-gray skin, and large red-gold eyes.

The Trandoshan Pirates were lead by Dheeb and Krussk during the Clone Wars on Umbara. During the Battle of Umbara, Krussk lead a group of these pirates to Bunker Krill, owned by the Umbaran militia and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Trandoshan Pirate's outpost was the base of operations for the Trandoshan Pirates during the Battle of Umbara. During the battle, a Jedi Knight infiltrated the outpost and defeated Dheeb, the pirate's leader.
CC-9G was a protocol droid who served Supreme Chancellor Leontyne Saresh of the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Troigs were a sentient species that was native to the planet Pollillus. They had two heads, each head having its own personality and temperament. Both heads shared the same awareness, therefore they were very alert and observant.
The Markess Narn was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates.
The Childerly was one of two EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates, along with the Markess Narn, that protected Vergesso Base, one of the largest shadowports in the galaxy.
The operation on Manaan was undertaken to Manaan by allies of Theron Shan and Lana Beniko following the attacks on Tython and Korriban.
