x: The Assault on Cymoon, also referred to as the Raid on Cymoon 1 or as the attack on Cymoon 1, took place during the Galactic Civil War, and shortly after the Battle of Yavin when the Rebel Alliance carried out an attack on the Imperial Weapons Factory Alpha on Cymoon 1.
The Corellian Industrial Cluster was an area in the the galaxy's Expansion Region that contained the moon Cymoon 1. The Cluster was controlled by the Galactic Empire.
This Jawa tribe was led by Iziz during the Jedi Civil War. Several members of the tribe were enslaved by the Sand People, and Iziz asked Czerka Corporation for help but they refused.

A species of sentient beings with pink flesh and yellow eyes inhabited the junkyards of the moon Cymoon 1 in the Corellian Industrial Cluster. Members of the species had tentacles protruding from all parts of their body, some of which they used as limbs.
224 was an OOM command battle droid who served in the Separatist Droid Army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Grizmallt was a war-torn planet in the Grizmallt system of the Core Worlds, and the origin of the humans who crash-landed on and colonized Naboo. Around 3900 BBY, a civil war on Grizmallt caused a group Grizmallti to flee their home in colony ships and settle on Naboo.
Rugosa, also known as the Coral Moon of Rugosa, was a temperate moon located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories close to the planet Toydaria.

A battle was fought on the planet Darvannis during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, when the Dread Master Styrak attempted to assemble an army of mercenaries and other criminals.

During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, an Imperial fleet attacked the Republic's Ardis Outpost in the Unknown Regions. Despite the surprise ambush, Republic reinforcements were able to drive off the Imperial forces and save the station.

t: Battle in the New Cov ice field
x: During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, a battle occurred in the asteroids near the planet New Cov when Imperial starfighters fortified themselves in the system by setting up a prototype minefield using remote satellites.
a: Battle in the New Cov asteroid field

x: During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Republic attacked the Imperial refueling station Regnant Station in the Unknown Regions, destroying the station and depriving the Empire of a foothold in the area.

During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, a Republic fleet attacked the Republic's Kabal Station in the Outer Rim Territories. Despite the surprise ambush, Imperial reinforcements were able to drive off the Republic forces and save the station.

During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, Imperial forces attacked the Far Cradle, a Republic refueling station in the Unknown Regions, after short-range Republic ships were tracked back there.

Russo-ISC was an SP-4 ISC crime scene analysis droid who served the Jedi Order, working at the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Level 1315 was an underworld level on the planet Coruscant. It was so named because it was located one thousand, three hundred, and fifteen levels from the core of the ecumenopolis, which was accessed by the underworld portal.

x: Concurrent to the blockade of Naboo, Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum sent Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas on a secret mission to Oba Diah.

The Eriadu Conference, also called the Eriadu Trade conference, or the Eriadu trade summit, was a diplomatic meeting that took place on the planet Eriadu in 33 BBY, in an attempt to solve the long-running power struggle between the Galactic Republic and the Trade Federation du…
A revolution took place on the planet Phindar in 44 BBY. The citizens of Phindar rose up against the ruling Syndicat and captured the Syndicat's leaders, including its head, Baftu.
Island Four was the name of an island hunting ground located on the moon Wasskah that was used by members of a hunting guild headed by the Trandoshan Garnac.

Razorback Island was an island on the planet Rishi. During the Galactic War, the Order of Revan constructed a large signal jammer on the island in order to block communications during the forthcoming Battle of Rishi; however, a team of independent operatives invaded the island…

Sky Ridge Island was a mountainous island located on the planet Rishi, north of Horizon Island. Home to a village of the native Rishii, the island was the site of a stronghold established by the Order of Revan during the Galactic War.
Toydaria was the homeworld of the Toydarian species, located in Hutt Space.
The Tenloss Syndicate was a criminal group that co-owned a shipyard in the Bajic sector with several lower-level members of the criminal group known as the Crymorah Syndicate.
The Fremond was a spacetug used by the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. The starship shared its name with the Fremond system, located in the Inner Rim Territories.
Aggression Management was a bounty hunter guild that was active during the Cold War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

t: We Feed Your Bounty To Our Rancor
x: We Feed Your Bounty To Our Rancor, also known as Rancorfodder, was a bounty hunter guild that was active during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Sung-Tarr Corporation was a bounty hunter guild that was active during the Cold War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Galactic Retrieval Specialists was a bounty hunter guild that was active during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Retribution was a bounty hunter guild that was active during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Vengeance Factory was a bounty hunter guild that was active during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Blood for Credits was a bounty hunter guild that was active during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Spikefist Runners was a bounty hunter guild that was active during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
The Simple Truth was a bounty hunter guild that was active during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Killsisters' Continuum was a bounty hunter guild that was active during the Cold War between the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

A Czerka mining team used a sandcrawler to cross the Dune Sea led by a mining captain. Sand People attacked the sandcrawler, immobilizing it and sending multiple waves of Sand People to finish the team off. However Revan intervened and defended the mining team.
The Salliche was a frigate in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. The vessel shared its name with the agriworld Salliche, which was located in the Core Worlds.
The Core Envoy was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer used by the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. The Star Destroyer was equipped with engines and measured 1,600 meters long.

The Compliant was a Star Destroyer used by the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. In 14 BBY, the ship was stationed at the planet Pii's Imperial marshaling station, along with another Star Destroyer, the Enforcer.
The Gatherers were a group of non-Jedi Force worshipers whose aim was to spread the teachings of the light side of the Force and the Jedi Order during the reign of the First Order.

An outpost belonging to the Galactic Empire was located on the planet Trogan. Five years after the Empire's creation, the personal starship of Imperial Governor Wilhuff Tarkin was stolen by a rebel cell and used to attack Galidraan Station.

A rumor concerning the pirate Q'anah stated she once became stranded on an isolated moon in the final decades of the Galactic Republic's reign. While on this moon, prior to her rescue, Q'anah was forced to chew her hand off because it had become infected.

An RA-7 protocol droid served the Galactic Empire during the early years of the organization's reign. The droid was stationed on the facility known as Sentinel Base, where on one occasion it acted as the tailor of Governor Wilhuff Tarkin.

The Nautolans were a humanoid species from the planet Glee Anselm. They were amphibious, and adapted to survive in harsh environments. Nautolan society was largely peaceful, but they were at odds with the Anselmi, a related species also native to their home planet.

t: Battle in the Bimmiel asteroid field
x: During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, a battle occurred in the asteroid field in the Bimmiel system when a Republic fleet set up a minefield in order to divide Imperial forces in the Kanz sector.

During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, a battle occurred above the planet Lorta when Republic forces attacked the D-1Z prototype bomber on its maiden voyage. Imperial forces successfully defended the bomber.

During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, a battle occurred above the planet Hypori when Imperial forces attacked the prototype "Gilded Meteor" bomber on its maiden voyage.
Christophsis was a planet located in the Christoph system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories where the Battle of Christophsis was fought during the Clone Wars.

Berch Teller's rebel cell was formed and led by the former Republic Intelligence agent Berch Teller after the Antar Atrocity. Members of this cell came from several species including humans, Koorivar, and Gotals.
Operation Yavin Kill Two was an Imperial operation designed by Darth Vader to capture the Heroes of Yavin in the Alderaan Graveyard.

The Dune Sea, known as the Great Dune, was a vast stretch of desert on the Outer Rim planet of Tatooine. The Great Pit of Carkoon, which contained a creature known as the sarlacc, was located in the Dune Sea. The Western Dune Sea was where the Mos Espa Grand Arena was located.

x: The Escape from Cloud City, also remembered as a skirmish on Cloud City, took place during the Galactic Civil War. As part of a plot to capture Luke Skywalker, Darth Vader led the Imperial Military to Cloud City, a tibanna gas mine in the atmosphere of Bespin.

Merchant One was a C-ROC Gozanti-class light cruiser owned by the crime lord Azmorigan. The ship carried a number of armaments, including laser turrets and laser cannons used in criminal operations. The vessel also held a number of escape pods.
The Ga'hanoraw Tribe was a tribe of Tusken Raiders that preyed on settlers and other offworlders in the Jundland Chasm on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War.
The Wannschok Tenements was a section of the Nikto Sector on the moon Nar Shaddaa that was named after the Wannschok, a famous desert on the planet Kintan.

The Gauntlet gang area was the name given to an area on the moon Nar Shaddaa that was taken over by the Gauntlet street gang. Club Imperato was located in the area, and the region was accessible by a turbolift from the Red Light Sector.
Haven was a luxury dreadnaught built by Garblaque the Hutt during the Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

The Talz Commandos was a group of Talz warriors who allied themselves with the Republic Military and assisted their military efforts on the ice worlds of Ilum and Hoth. Fetzellen and Broonmark were members of the group.
ST 321 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle which served as the personal transport of Darth Vader, a Dark Lord of the Sith, during the latter stages of the Galactic Civil War.

Highmount Road was a roadway that ran through the Highmount Ridge of the planet Hoth, joining the Upper Pass and the Lower Pass. The Geothermal Substation was located at the southern end of the road, at the corner of Highmount Road and the Lower Pass.
The Barrenwoods was the name given to the northwestern region of the Pelath-Ri Marches on the planet Voss. The Gormak constructed a number of monoliths in the area.
The Northern Whitelands was a tundra located on the eastern edge of the Glacial Fissure, north of Graveyard Road. Drossrock Mountain and Lake Algid were located in the Whitelands.
The Malignant Meadow was an area on the planet Quesh. Broga's Palace was located on the meadow, and the Grancha Lakand venom mine was located in a small ravine in the southern part of the meadow.
The Upper Industrial Sector was a district on the moon Nar Shaddaa that featured a large number of industrial facilities and factories.
The Great Mother River was a river that ran through the upper level jungle on the Ithorian Herdship Bazaar. Isttu Village was built around a wide branch of the river known as Isttu Lake.
Graveyard Road was a pathway crossing the northern side of the Glacial Fissure region of the planet Hoth.
The Celestial Crow was a light freighter owned by Feylara Raed during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The jungle wampa was a brown-furred subspecies of wampa that lived in temperate jungle climates, such as the planet Rishi. Rishi's Horizon Island hosted a population of jungle wampas during the era of the Galactic War.

t: Scouting mission to the Massassi Site
objective: Locate and bring back Sith relics
x: A secret scouting mission to the Massassi Site on Yavin 4 was performed at the behest of Palpatine, Supreme Chancellor the Galactic Republic, a little over four months after the onslaught of the Clone Wars.

Special Operations was a division of the Imperial Diplomatic Service of the Sith Empire. Maro Vizhen, the head of Special Operations, was tasked with recruiting allies from the criminal syndicates and gangs on the moon Nar Shaddaa.
Pharmalux Technologies was the company that ran the Pharmalux Waste Processing facility on the moon Nar Shaddaa.

t: Manaan Board of Tourism and Trade
x: The Manaan Board of Tourism and Trade was stationed on Manaan and was run by the Selkath.
The Manaan Port Authority handled the docking of starships on Manaan including trade with off world species.

Gamorreans, derogatorily known as "pigs," were a sentient species of green-skinned pig-like humanoids that hailed from the Outer Rim planet of Gamorr. They grouped themselves in clans, each of which was led by a warlord and a Clan Matron.
The dragonsnake (also spelled dragon snake) was a large, predatory reptile that dwelled in the muddy waters of certain planets, including Dagobah and Nal Hutta.

Kaadu were creatures native and indigenous to the planet Naboo. During a fight on the Great Grass Plains, kaadu were deployed with fambaas to support the Gungan Grand Army to fight off the Trade Federation battle droids.
Fambaas were quadruped amphibians with tough hides that could be found on the planets Naboo and Onderon.

Great Grass Plains was a large area of plains located 40 kilometers from Theed on the planet Naboo. During the Battle of Naboo, the Gungan Grand Army fought against the Trade Federation battle droids on the Great Grass Plains.
The Alderaan Guard, also known as the Alderaanian royal guards, were a security force responsible for the protection of members of the House of Organa, the royal family of the planet Alderaan.

Monument Plaza, also known as Monument Park, was a large plaza on the populous ecumenopolis world of Coruscant. It was also the location of the planet's only uncovered mountain peak, Umate, the highest point of the Manarai range.
08-RD, nicknamed oh-eight, was an astromech droid companion of the hyperspace explorer Ziril during the Galactic War.

The Dauntless was a Valor-class cruiser that was part of the Republic fleet during the Galactic War. In 3637 BBY it served as the flagship of the Jedi Grand Master Satele Shan during the Battle of Rishi.

The Chem-Basin Ditchlands was a region on the planet Quesh that was the site of the Chem-Basin Mine. The Ditchlands were located south of the Republic Operational Headquarters, and west of the complex surrounding Attis Station.
The Unstable Components Development was a subzone of the Labor Valley on the planet Corellia. A magnogravitics plant was located on the northern side of the area.

Glasswater Run was the name given to the southern side of the Icefall Plains on the planet Hoth. A wide tundra, the area was the location of Zero Station, the Talz Training Camp, and the Drift Hills Stronghold.
The attack on Soontir Fel occurred on Csilla in 28 ABY, between a Galactic Alliance team on the hunt for Zonama Sekot, and rogue Chiss elements under the command of Ganet.
The Ravagers was a pirate gang that was headquartered on the planet Rishi. Years before the Galactic War, the Ravagers were involved in the infamous Ravager Raids.
Blood Company was a mercenary unit that was hired by Bouris Ulgo during the Cold War to exterminate the Soros hive of Killiks. The group was led by an alien who participated in the Manaan Atrocities.
Operation: Glass Echo was a covert Imperial Intelligence operation carried out by the agent codenamed Cipher Nine on the planet Nar Shaddaa during the Hunt for the Eagle.
Pelath Point was a hill on the Pel-Ki Ridge in the Pelath-Ri Marches of the planet Voss. Pelath Point was the site of Pir-Tel Outpost, a Voss commando outpost built around an ancient ruin.

Icequake Ridge was a north-facing ridge located in the Desolation Plains on the Whiterock Wastes of the planet Hoth. Brightmirror Road ran along the top of the ridge, and the Crescent Canyon tech depot was accessible via an entrance in the ridge.
G8-R3, also known as R5-A7, was an astromech droid which served onboard the Naboo Royal Starship used by the royalty of the planet Naboo.
The wastes was the name given to the heavily polluted areas outside the cities on the planet Deysum III, a result of the world's uncontrolled industrial growth.
Er'Kit was a desert planet located in the Noonian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Er'Kit species.
The Imperial Power Bureau was a department of the reconstituted Sith Empire that dealt with power generators and other energy matters. This bureau fell under the purview of the Sphere of Technology.

Teth was a jungle planet located in Wild Space of the galaxy. At some point, the world was inhabited by the B'omarr Order. However, by the time of the Clone Wars, their castles were abandoned, though some would be converted by the Hutts into formidable strongholds.

The battle of the Vehemence was fought between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Rebel Flight leader Wilkins started an attack run on the Star Destroyer Vehemences bridge and fired the ion cannons.

Nalydians were a a species of small brown-skinned humanoids from the planet Nalyd. By 138 ABY, they had developed a civilization among the stony pinnacles and mesas of their homeworld, which was covered in a swirling orange fog.

The planet Nalyd was home to a species of giant creatures that anatomically resembled spiders and were domesticated by the indigenous Nalydian species. These giant spiders were larger than an adult-sized Human being and were used as steeds and pack animals.
The planet Nalyd was home to a species of floating jellyfish-like creatures that were capable of flying through the skies.
Cybot was a third-degree protocol droid bounty hunter that was active during the years 5 and 10 ABY. Cybot had gold-colored plating as well as yellow and orange photoreceptors.

result: Revolt put down by the 212th Attack Battalion
x: A Wookiee revolt took place on the planet Kashyyyk during the Galactic Empire's rule. The revolt was put to a halt by Imperial General Kahdah and the 212th Attack Battalion.

x: The Mission to Murkhana was an Imperial mission undertaken by the Sith Lord Darth Vader and Moff Wilhuff Tarkin to the planet Murkhana, where a cache of communications equipment had been discovered.
The Telgordo's Pride was a luxury liner operated by Telgordo Travel during the Galactic Civil War. It was hijacked by a rebel group led by the Mon Calamari Rutralli Optor.

x: In 5 BBY, the rebel crew of the starship Ghost undertook an operation to attack and destroy over two dozen Imperial interrogator droids near an Imperial center on the planet Lothal.
Forage worms were a large type of worm found on various worlds across the galaxy. Their slimy exterior could be many different colors, including shades of brown, grey and purple.

Chalacta was a planet located in the Metatessu sector's Chalacta system within the Mid Rim. that was the homeworld of the Chalactan people. The human Jedi Master Depa Billaba was born on Chalacta. In the C.R.C.
Peace Park was a stylized rooftop garden terrace located in Sundari, the capital city of the planet Mandalore.
AT-AT pilots, also known as AT-AT Drivers, were Imperial combat drivers specialized in operating the Imperial Army's AT-AT walkers.

Sando aqua monsters were enormous, muscular predators that could be found in the oceans and lakes of Naboo. They could grow up to 200 meters, but because there were few of them left on Naboo by 32 BBY, they obtained an almost legendary status.
Vehicle commanders were commanders in the Galactic Empire and later in Imperial Remnant and First Order who oversaw the operation of military vehicles.
The Brig Stompers were a group of non-human mercenaries active during the Galactic War. They have gained notoriety after wiping out Gaftikar's entire defense force during a coup.

objective: To open a secret smuggling line for the Rebel Alliance
x: During the Galactic Civil War, and shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Admiral Gial Ackbar of the Alliance to Restore the Republic sent Luke Skywalker and R2-D2 on a mission to the planet Rodia.

Rattatak was a mountainous planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. After killing the warlords responsible for the death of Jedi Knight Ky Narec, former Jedi Padawan Asajj Ventress ruled Rattatak until she was found and recruited by former Jedi Master Count Dooku,…
Grass kapirs were a species that could be found on Tython.

place: Agricultural loading platform XT-21s, Draenell's Point
x: During the Galactic Civil War, a battle occurred in the Bissillirus system. An Imperial supply fleet was assembled at the Bissillirus Resupply Base, intended to support an Imperial campaign on the planet Lexrul.

The Uogo'cor suppression was a suppression operation executed by the Galactic Empire onto the Dark Warbirds. The concentrated assault on the Mid Rim world of Uogo'cor by the Imperial Navy resulted in the destruction of the pirate gang.
At-la'o was one of the many cities on Cato Neimoidia. It was the location of Lott Dod's palace.
The Pantorans were blue-skinned near-humans native to the moon Pantora. They were part of the Galactic Republic, during the waning years of that government.

Mimban, also known as Circarpous V, was a swamp planet located in the Circarpous sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region. Situated along the Nanth'ri Trade Route, it was the homeworld of several intelligent species, including the Mimbanese.
This unidentified planet was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories.
M8-3R was a astromech droid during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

This unidentified planet had at least one spaceport called Lasgo Port. The planet was surrounded by a minefield which had been left there during the Second Imperial Civil War. In 139 ABY, the assassin droid AG-37 and his companions visited this planet while delivering supplies.
During the Galactic Civil War, a group of outlaws working for Jabba the Hutt attacked a homestead on the planet Tatooine, belonging to the mercenary Saponza.

t: Attack on a Tusken Raider camp
x: A gang of mercenaries led by the human Saponza and his partner aided the Galactic Empire in attacking a Tusken Raider camp on the planet Tatooine.
A group of Tusken Raiders lived in a camp on the planet Tatooine. The settlement consisted of a central building surrounded by three autoturrets on rock plateaus, and a series of walls.

result: Hutt Clan cartel den destroyed and medical supplies recovered
x: The Alliance to Restore the Republic asked a rebel cell to aid them on a mission to recover medical supplies from a Hutt Clan den on the planet Dandoran during the Galactic Civil War.

The Hutt Cartel owned a den on the planet Dandoran where they hoarded medical supplies. The based consisted of two alloy depots and two credit vaults enclosed by a square wall and protected by two autoturrets and a central deflector shield generator.
The V-828 Clearcutter was a four-legged battle droid that was deployed by the forces of House of Thul during their invasion of the Organa Vinerium during the Alderaan Civil War.
N5-D3 was an astromech droid stationed at the Upper Markaran Outpost on Balmorra during the battle to liberate the world from the reconstituted Sith Empire.

x: During the Clone Wars, a trio of Jedi—Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, and Padawan Ahsoka Tano—unintentionally undertook a mission to the realm of Mortis.
At some point after the Battle of Mindor during the Galactic Civil War, a group of technobeasts were created on the planet Trailia by a Dark Side Adept known as Cronal.

Orto Plutonia, also known as Orto, was a frigid planet located in the Pantora system of the Outer Rim Territories' Sujimis sector. It was orbited by the moon Pantora, which was long believed to be the only inhabited world in the system.

The Strix was a starship owned by the mercenary Saponza. The vessel was used in various battles by Saponza's gang during the Galactic Civil War. It was armed with a laser cannon, but the weapon could only provide one strafe's worth of fire before needing to recharge.

x: A gang of mercenaries participated in a mission to reduce the womp rat population on the planet Tatooine in order to stop the vermin attacking locals.
A research lab on the planet Tatooine was used by mercenaries to conduct research on local womp rats.

A base on the planet Tatooine was used by mercenaries to breed womp rats. The compound consisted of a central headquarters and two dome shaped structures protected by a wall, which separated them from a credit vault, two credit markets and a landing pad.
The Isilia was a Ghtroc Industries 440 freighter owned and operated by Captain Adriav Kavos. It was crewed by the Arconan Gezzov-tak, the Ortolan Nabkess, and the Quarren Segken Tels.

A group of mercenaries attempted to carry out a sneak attack on the homestead occupied by the mercenary Saponza and his partner's gang. The gang were informed by their allies of the attack before it commenced, and so were able to defeat the attackers.

Azkulkt was a repulsorlift city populated by the Viska on the planet Rordak.
Deggaruls was a repulsorlift city populated by the Viska on the planet Rordak.
Dreggusom was a repulsorlift city populated by the Viska on the planet Rordak.
Whosk was a repulsorlift city populated by the Viska on the planet Rordak.

The Crymorah Syndicate was a set of crime families—the Baldamiro Family, the Rang Clan, the Wandering Star, the Droid Gotra, and envoys of the Hutt Clan—who operated during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Narglatches were a species of carnivorous mammalian cats native to the frigid world of Orto Plutonia and Naboo. These felines were considered sacred by Orto Plutonia's indigenous Talz, who used them as mounts and a source of food.
Trandosha, also known simply as Dosh, was an arboreal planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim and the homeworld of the Trandoshan species.
The Imperial Agent Cipher Nine was assigned an X-70B Phantom-class prototype to use as a base of operations during the agent's tenure with Imperial Intelligence and beyond.

The Sith Lord later known as Darth Nox was given a Fury-class Imperial interceptor by the Sith's master, Darth Zash, during the search for the artifacts of Tulak Hord. Kallig, as the Sith was first known, continued to use the ship even after leaving Zash's apprenticeship.
The Sith Lord later known as the Emperor's Wrath was given a Fury-class Imperial interceptor by the Sith's master, Darth Baras, during the search for Jaesa Willsaam.
The Battle on Doshan was a battle conducted between Imperial forces and the local Trandoshans. The battle was important enough to necessitate the use of the 501st Legion.

objective: Rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars from the Tusken Raiders who kidnapped her
x: During the Separatist Crisis, Anakin Skywalker traveled to Tatooine in an attempt to rescue his mother, Shmi Skywalker Lars, from a camp of Tusken Raiders. This followed weeks of visions in which Skywalker saw his mother suffering.

Arkanis was a rainy planet in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, and the throneworld of Leeya, the Empress of the Regency Worlds. The Galactic Empire's officers academy was located there.

The Supreme Court was the highest court of law in the Judicial Department of the Galactic Republic. The Supreme Court tried Nute Gunray, the Viceroy of the Trade Federation, on four separate occasions for his actions in launching the Invasion of Naboo, but Gunray avoided impri…

IM-873X was an Imperial Star Galleon used as a freighter. Over a period of six years leading to the Battle of Yavin, the ship made regular trips to the Corva sector. In 0 ABY, a delay of eight days caused Alliance Intelligence to take notice.

The smuggler Rayc Ryjerd purchased a starship sometime before or during the year 4 ABY, putting himself into debt in the process. He worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure in an effort to pay these debts.

x: In the fourth year before the Battle of Yavin the activities of a rebel cell operating on the Outer Rim planet Lothal drew the attention of Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, a high-ranking officer in the Galactic Empire by launching a raid on the communications tower.
Orrays were big creatures native to the planet Geonosis. They were used by the Geonosian picadors as mounts and beasts of burden.
Septoids were segmented, venomous, carnivorous creatures native to the Carrion Plateau on Eriadu.

place: A planet in the Kwymar sector
x: During the Galactic Civil War, a skirmish was fought on a planet in the Kwymar sector between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire over the recovery of a downed Imperial assault shuttle.

During the Galactic Civil War, a battle was fought between the Galactic Empire and Alliance to Restore the Republic on the planet Vendrak V. Imperial Intelligence planted information that a spaceport hangar on Vendrak V contained weapons that would be useful to the Rebellion.

During the Galactic Civil War, a battle occurred in the village of Chakton. Imperial forces under the command of Commander 334.556/G7 clashed with Alliance to Restore the Republic forces led by Commander Thickston Deke.
Murkhana was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Known for its natural beauty, it was a major tourist attraction in the last years of the Republic Era.

result: The Republic is unsuccessful in finding the Togruta colonists
x: A battle took place on the planet Kiros during the Clone Wars between the joint Confederate-Zygerrian occupation and a Galactic Republic intervention force.

Mustafarians were an insectoid sentient species native to the volcanic Outer Rim mining world of Mustafar of which there existed two distinct subspecies: the tall, thin Northern Mustafarians, and the short, stocky Southern Mustafarians.

The Erselu were a species of wild and fierce predators native to the steepara forests of the planet Dressel, where they posed a constant threat to the Dressellese sentient species. They were similar in some way to the Wookiee species of the planet Kashyyyk.

The panagra were a predatory species which stalked their prey. They were native to the planet Dressel, where they lived in steepara forests and posed a constant threat to the sentient Dressellian species who also called the planet home.

The astrigia were a species of fierce swooping predator with large eyes. They lived in the forests of steepara trees that covered the planet Dressel, and posed a constant threat to the sentient Dressellian species who shared the planet with them.

Cuirreal climbers were a species native to the planet Dressel. Their meat featured prominently alongside mushrooms and the seeds and syrup of the steepara tree in the diets of the sentient Dressellian species.

264 was a readapted R4 astromech droid working for the Imperial Press Corps of the Galactic Empire as a communications courier. The droid was taken prisoner by the crew of the Ghost so their own droid, Chopper, could pose as a courier.

This unidentified planet that rained acid as well as glass was the fourth planet of a remote system near an unidentified planet which hosted the spaceport of Lasgo Port. This glass rain planet was home to a species of giant beetles which ate glass.
The Corrupted Fields was a region north of the Sundari Flatlands that was infected by the dark side after one of the Seeds of Rage was buried there.
The Alcove of Ruin was an alcove in the cliffs along the eastern edge of the Dune Sea on Tatooine. It was infected by the dark side after one of the Seeds of Rage was buried there.
The bounty hunter known as the Hunter owned a D5-Mantis Patrol Craft that the hunter's crew used to travel the galaxy during the Great Hunt and beyond.

The Sla Kar were the lowest class of society on the planet Demophon. The term "Sla Kar" was a corruption of the word "slacker". They consisted of the poor and the criminal who had no alternative but to labor for the Empire.
The Byrne City Unified Protectorate, or The Protectorate, was a private law enforcement organization in Byrne City, capital of the planet Demophon.
The Black Obsession was a modified Mon Calamari Shipyards A-Z-Z-3 Light Freighter. It smuggled political prisoners from the city of Selkren off the planet Demophon during the Galactic Civil War.

The Auditor was a Sienar Fleet Systems IPV-1 System Patrol Craft assigned to the planet Demophon during the Galactic Civil War. It attempted to stop the Black Obsession as it smuggled political prisoners off world.
The Dred Imperative was a transport shipping refugees off the planet Demophon prior to its destruction via supernova during the Galactic Civil War.
The Jundland Wastes were a region of Tatooine, a desert planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. The Great Chott salt flat existed in the southeastern extreme of the Jundland Wastes.
The Talon was a Sienar Fleet Systems Immobilizer 418 cruiser. During the Galactic Civil War it patrolled the Demophon system prior to the destruction of that system in a supernova.
Paragon was a massive floating city on the gas giant of Tyed Kant. It housed 90 percent of the population, and the administrative center of the planet.
Sprawl 41 was a floating ranch located in the northwest quadrant of the planet Tyed Kant. It was owned by Nebula Consumables, one of the largest agricultural corporations on the planet.
Sprawl 34 was a floating ranch located in the northwest quadrant of the planet Tyed Kant. It was the headquarters of Premier Provisions, a front company for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The Evening Star was a Corona-class transport. During the Galactic Civil War a group of rebel agents piloted the Evening Star to the Kantel system during the Mynock virus outbreak.
Northwest was a city and spaceport located on the continent of Landra on Lianna. It was a sprawling city and port complex.

LB-K2, or Elbie, was part of the initial test run of a few hundred LB-series courier droids developed by Industrial Automaton. She was shipped to Premier Provisions on the planet of Tyed Kant, but when she arrived on Sprawl 34 it was already devastated by the Mynock virus.

Sprawl 18 was a floating ranch located on the planet Tyed Kant. It housed Gryseium Incorporated, a subsidiary of Corazon Industries. During the Galactic Civil War, Sabel Axis Corazon had the Mynock virus developed here.

The Tyed's Valiant was a CR90 corvette owned by Gryseium Incorporated during the Galactic Civil War. After Alliance to Restore the Republic agents infected Sprawl 18 with the Mynock II virus, Sabel Axis Corazon personally pursued them in the Tyed's Valiant.
Portharton was a city on the planet Lianna. It was located on the Anai continent, and was west of the planet's capital, Lianna City.

the D'larah City Patrol, or DCP, was the primary law enforcement agency in D'larah on the planet Demophon. The DCP also provided security for local corporations, such as Shankti Drive Works and Tumleh Navigation.
The G'uotr Network was a black market that formed on D'larah during the panic surrounding an imminent supernova in the Demophon system during the Galactic Civil War.

Tibrin was an aquatic planet covered in phosphorescent seas with towering coral reefs as tall as the sky. It was located in the Tibrin system, a trinary star system on the edge of the Hadar sector in the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Ishi Tib species.
Kel Dors were a sentient species native to the planet Dorin. In order to survive oxygen-rich environments, they wore specialized breath masks that covered their eyes and nostrils.
Nam Chorios was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that housed both an Imperial mining colony and prison facility by the fifth year of Darth Sidious' reign as Emperor.

Obroa-skai was a planet located in the Obroa-skai system of the galaxy's Inner Rim. The Vaathkree Trade Corridor connected it to Contruum and Ubduria. It was known mostly for its libraries and medcenters.
Dorin was a planet located in the Dorin system in the Deadalis sector of the Expansion Region that was the homeworld of the Kel Dor species.
The Admiralty was the leading department of the Galactic Empire that administered the Imperial Navy, giving counsel and governing policy of the Imperial Navy.

The Four Sages of Dwartii – Sistros Nevet, Braata Danlos, Faya Rodemos, and Yanjon Zelmar – were a group of contentious philosophers and lawgivers from the early days of the modern Galactic Republic, who had great influence on its early constitution.
Curreck was a planet located in Outer Rim Territories. Captain Darren T. Weeb was a native of the planet.

The Kiffar were a near-human species from the planets Kiffu and Kiffex. Although they seemed human in appearance, Kiffar were distinguished by their scarlet blood and facial tattoos, which indicated their clan affiliation on their species' homeworlds.

Gossams were a diminutive blue-skinned species native to the planet Castell located in the Colonies region of the galaxy. Several Gossams, such as Shu Mai and Amita Fonti, allied themselves with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

The audience chamber of the Imperial Palace was located on the penultimate level of the Palace spire. A vast, circular room without partitions, it featured a ten-meter-tall podium upon which Emperor Palpatine sat in a simple chair.
The residence of Galactic Emperor Palpatine was located at the Pinnacle Room of the Imperial Palace's central spire. It was divided into two separate spaces by a curved partition.

Eskrats were a species of rat that ran around a lot. The demolitions expert Skelly compared the pilot Kanan Jarrus and the miners of the Moonglow Polychemical company to eskrats after Jarrus showed no interest in hearing about a potential mining hazard.

Sand monkeys were a species of animal which were good at climbing. When the Twi'lek pilot Hera Syndulla scrambled up a set of scaffolding on the planet Gorse, it was in a fashion similar to a sand monkey.

The Imperial Zoological Agency was a branch of the Imperial Survey Corps, a part of the Navy of the Galactic Empire. The duties of the Imperial Zoological Agency included the cataloging of plants and creatures on worlds newly discovered by the Empire.

The Imperial Zoological Gardens were a facility located on Kailor V, a planet in the Arrowhead portion of the Core Worlds. Established on the authority of Emperor Palpatine of the Galactic Empire, they featured a beautiful display of fauna and flora from across the galaxy.

RT-56/X was a silver-plated protocol droid skilled in bargaining and con artistry. During the Galactic Civil War, he resided on the planet Narg, where he became partners with the local scammer Biull Sangtwo.

x: The action at Mustafar was a naval engagement four years before the Battle of Yavin when the Spectres staged a mission to rescue the Jedi Kanan Jarrus, their co-leader who had been captured during a mission to infiltrate the Imperial Communications Center at Jalath.
The Unstoppable Horde was a vicious Gamorrean gang operating during the Galactic War. In 3642 BBY they were present on Hoth and overran an outpost of Ortolan settlers.

The Battle of Sedratis took place during the Clone Wars, a conflict that pitted the Galactic Republic against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Jedi Generals Anakin Skywalker and Huulik led the forces of the Republic Military to victory in the battle.
The Imperial Species Identification Bureau, or ISIB, made contact with the Ssither species on the planet Jatee during the Galactic Civil War.
The Hard Liner was an Imperial shuttle that was piloted by Erlick Frodar during the Galactic Civil War. It ferried stormtroopers to their destinations.
The One Liner, formerly the Flat Liner, was originally a stock YT-1300 light freighter purchased by Erlick Frodar during the Galactic Civil War.

x: After stealing the corvette Carrion Spike from Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, a rebel cell lead by Berch Teller attacked an Imperial space station orbiting the planet Galidraan III in the Galidraan system.
The Sinking Stone was a stolen Imperial vessel. It was used by Soron Hegerty during the Galactic Civil War as a mobile base for her attempts to help the Ssither of Jatee.

The Nomad was a Loronar Corporation "Out System" Scout Vessel piloted by Imperial scouts during the Galactic Civil War. Prior to the Demophon supernova the Nomad sought new locations for the Empire's Demophon operations.

The Claw was a CR90 corvette crewed by former associates of the pirate Butler during the Galactic Civil War. After Butler's death his crew became convinced that he had left behind a treasure on Butler's Cove.

t: Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala
x: Twenty-two years before the Battle of Yavin, and shortly after the outbreak of the Clone Wars, Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala were married in a secret wedding on Naboo.
The Mandalorian Guard, also known as the Mandalorian police was the security force of the New Mandalorian led Mandalorian Government Council on the planet Mandalore. They served as peacekeepers.

The Demophon Supernova occurred during the Galactic Civil War in the Imperial-controlled Demophon system. The star Demophon was known to be unstable, and the Demophon Stellar Monitor Station was established to monitor it.

The Night Wind was a YT-1300 light freighter crewed by a band of pirates led by Captain Jor Entel during the Galactic Civil War. Prior to the Demophon supernova Jor Entel offered the Night Wind as an inexpensive means of evacuating Demophon.

Grig, also called Grig City, was one of the cities on the planet Narg. It was served by Grig Starport, located on Starport Street, and was the location of the TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated Administration Center, Grig Employee Training School, TGM Hospital, and the Free …

x: The Executive Separatist Council, also known simply as the Separatist Council or Executive Council, was an executive governing body led by Count Dooku within the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

x: Liberty's Misrule, originally known as the Annihilator, was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought that served as the flagship of Grand General Cassio Tagge in the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin.

The Random Mallet was a hammer-shaped frigate owned by the Corellian pirate captain Hethra Mcgrrrr and his men, the Black Hole Gang. During the Clone Wars, the Random Mallet was trapped within the Unknown Regions by the gravitational pull of a black hole.
Tracyn Island was an island on the planet Rishi, located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy.
Gorset were a species native to Rhamalai. They roamed the plains of Rhamalai in herds of five to two hundred, and were easily domesticated. Denel Moonrunner had a gorset, Chaser, as a pet.

The R4-Salvatron was a large salvage droid that worked in the Barasin Refuse Yards on the planet Balmorra during the Cold War. Similar in design to the X2H-8 Overseer Droid, the R4-Salvatron was destroyed by Imperial forces.

The Security Droid GH-11 was a powerful security droid that was stationed in the assembly line of the Okara Droid Factory on the planet Balmorra. During the Cold War, it was destroyed by Imperial forces that invaded the factory.

The Annihilator X-12 was a powerful tripedal battle droid that was stationed in the assembly line of the Okara Droid Factory on the planet Balmorra. During the Cold War, it was destroyed by Imperial forces that invaded the factory.

The B-R6 Prototype Droid was a tripedal prototype battle droid designed in the Research and Development sector of the Okara Droid Factory on the planet Balmorra. It was armed with two powerful blaster cannons on its arms.

The C-13 prototype droid was a four-legged prototype battle droid designed in the Research and Development sector of the Okara Droid Factory on the planet Balmorra. It was armed with two powerful blaster cannons on its arms.

result: Nexus Route information recovered and brought to Republic leadership
x: The Battle of Lola Sayu, also called the mission to the Citadel, was a battle fought during the Clone Wars between the Grand Army of the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems in and around the Citadel, a Separatist prison on Lola Sayu.
Abafar was a remote desert planet located within the Outer Rim Territories, and was host to massive amounts of rhydonium, a scarce and volatile fuel source.
K6P-3, or Kaysixpee, was an astromech droid that Grand Master Satele Shan used as a messenger to recruit allies to combat the dark side threat that arose from the planet Athiss.

The Barasin Crag was the name given to the spur of rock located at the southern end of the canyon that contained Barasin Refuse Yards. The crag overlooked a deeper canyon itself, and a bridge connecting the Gorinth Plateau to the Lower Sundari Outpost ran directly over the crag.

Pasher was a desert planet located in the Pasher system in the Inner Rim region of the galaxy, in square M-14. Although similar to the planet Tatooine in terms of terrain, Pasher lacked the intersecting hyperspace routes that made the other world a popular smugglers' den.
Sandstone scorpions were a species native to the desert planet Pasher. The scorpions possessed poison glands and had armor which was highly effective at deflecting heat.
Spine spiders were a species of spider native to the desert planet Pasher. The spiders possessed poison glands which had medical applications.
The Promise was a frigate in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Fleet. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, the frigate was in hiding in the Sujimis sector near the planet Orto Plutonia.

Project Harvester was the codename for an Inquisitorius operation by the Galactic Empire to capture young Force-sensitives and turn them into Imperial agents skilled in the ways of the dark side of the Force, all while trying to prevent the Jedi Order from recovering.

The rebels TIE fighter, nicknamed "Sabine's masterpiece," and also known as Sabine Wren's TIE Fighter was an Imperial TIE/ln space superiority starfighter, piloted by Baron of the Empire Valen Rudor, that was stolen by Ezra Bridger and Garazeb Orrelios, two members of a rebel …
Glare Peak was a town on the planet Trivar II.

Ghests were a predatory serpentine species native to the jungle swamps of the planet Rodia. With long, green bodies; claws; and sharp teeth, they preferred to ambush prey on swamp shorelines by pouncing on them from the water, rarely if ever hunting on land.

Daxan Beta was a planet situated near a main trade route used by the Galactic Empire. General Jan Dodonna of the Alliance to Restore the Republic briefly studied it as a potential location for a new Rebel base after the evacuation of the Great Temple on Yavin 4, but quickly re…

Insk was a silicon-based planet located in the galaxy's Wild Space. General Jan Dodonna of the Alliance to Restore the Republic briefly studied it as a potential location for a new Rebel base after the evacuation of the Great Temple on Yavin 4, but quickly rejected it due to b…

A-B6, or Ay-BeeSix, was the fourth member of the Farns swoop gang in Mos Eisley, along with Geordi Hans, Jeff Pill, and Franklin Scott. She often asked questions and got in the way, but the gang put up with her.

LBT-16 was a BT-16 perimeter droid for sale at Jawa Traders in Mos Eisley. When it arrived it was a psychological mess, requiring a complete memory wipe to overcome its trauma. It was refurbished and in excellent physical condition as of 0 ABY.
BX-9T was an ill-tempered administrative droid that ran Docking Bay 86 for its absentee owner, Trepler Darklighter.
CG-X2R was the robo-bartender at the Dockside Cafe in Mos Eisley. He was prone to complaining.
ELGaR was a LGR series cooking droid that worked in the kitchens of the Dim-U monastery in Mos Eisley.

result: The Rebel Alliance evacuates Base One
x: The evacuation of Yavin 4, also known as the evacuation of Base One or the evacuation of the Great Temple, by the Alliance to Restore the Republic took place in 0 ABY, in the days that followed the Battle of Yavin.

place: Grand Temple's throne room, Great Temple, Yavin 4
x: The Royal Award Ceremony was a medal ceremony held in the Great Temple on Yavin 4 the morning after the Battle of Yavin.
R02-E was a SE4 servant droid employed by Drayk at the Dim-U monastery in Mos Eisley.
2PO was a protocol droid in the employ of Melnea Arnthout, leader of a group of colonists to Tatooine. He was kidnapped by Jawas after only one season on the planet.
Arnthout Pass was a narrow pass through the Jundland Wastes linking Arnthout and Anchorhead. Motesta was a settlement along the pass.

Market Place was a flea market and bazaar near the center of Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. Originally it was just a sandy lot where farmers would set up their tents, but by 0 ABY it was a thriving market.

WAC-47 was a modified DUM-series pit droid who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. He was a part of D-Squad along with several other droids on an important mission, serving under Colonel Meebur Gascon and piloting his ship.

The Invincible was a Providence-class Dreadnought and capital ship that served in the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars as the flagship of Harch Separatist Admiral Trench.

Momongs, or Trandoshan monkeys, were a species of primates that lived in the trees of forests on Wasskah, the moon of the planet Trandosha. They had six limbs, a long tail, big ears and green eyes. Their fur was mostly orange, with occasional black and white patches.

A Judicial was a member of the Judicial Department. They served as the primary non-Jedi peace officers in the Galactic Republic. Most Judicials attended the Judicial Academy before being assigned to the Judicial Forces.
The Judicial Department, also known as the Judiciary branch, was the executive and judiciary department that oversaw law enforcement and judiciary affairs for the Galactic Republic.

The Deltrons were a sentient species from the planet of the same name. They had a torso, lungs, a heart, a lipped mouth, and iron-based blood. At least one individual, Brisha Shard, had golden skin and eyes the color of bronzium.

Eufornis Minor, sometimes referred to as simply Eufornis, was a planet located in the Shadola sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A remote colony, it was sometimes confused with Eufornis Major, a prestigious city-planet located within the Core Worlds.
Todo 360 was a techno-service droid owned by bounty hunter Cad Bane. During the Clone Wars, Todo served Bane on various missions despite being often overlooked and undervalued by him.
The Lucid Voice was a Providence-class Dreadnought that served within the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
The Nite Owls were an elite Mandalorian unit made up of warriors led by Bo-Katan Kryze as part of the larger Death Watch movement.

Lagos was a Sentinel-class landing craft used by the Galactic Empire. After the destruction of the Imperial Communications Center on Lothal, Lagos was used to ferry R4 courier droids to and from the Tellstar in order to maintain Imperial communications.

Parwans were a sentient species native to Parwa. During the High Republic Era, Parwan Jedi Master Obratuk Glii was a respected diplomat within the Jedi Order. During the Clone Wars, the Parwan Derrown was considered one of the best bounty hunters in the galaxy by Count Dooku.

The Chekkoo clan was a Rodian clan on the planet Rodia. The clan was based in the Chekkoo Enclave on the continent of Betu. Members of the Chekkoo clan were known to be skilled in manufacturing weapons, armor, and other related munitions. Laneet Chekkoo was a member of this clan.

x: The Battle of Teth, also known as the battle on Teth, the assault at the B'omarr Monastery, the battle at the Teth Monastery, or the rescue of Rotta, took place on the Hutt-controlled planet of Teth between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

New Atraken City was a city located half a kilometer below the surface of Trilos. Originally a small community for miners and their families, the evacuation of Atraken and the influx of refugees pushed the population up to around 40,000 by 6 ABY.
DM-7 was a droid whom the Toydarian junk dealer Watto hired to kill the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn following the conclusion of the Boonta Eve Podrace on the planet Tatooine in 32 BBY.

Belugans were an aquatic sentient species native to the planet Quarzite. Largely humanoid, the Belugans sported fleshy sideburns on the sides of their faces and had sectioned jaws that hid their baleen-like teeth.

t: Darth Vader's black Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor
x: Several black Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptors served as the personal starfighter of the Sith Lord Darth Vader in the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign.
Guanomongers were a coprophagous species from the Outer Rim planet of Skye. They lived in the Entyrmion, a vast cavern complex located under the mountain ranges of Skye, and fed on skingle feces.
Mount Krisklar was one of the many mountains of Skye, a planet of the Marat system. In the mythology of Skye's native sentients, the S'kytri, that mountain was considered a goddess.

Clan Vizsla was a Mandalorian clan that was active during the time of the Galactic Republic, and the Galactic Empire. The Mandalorian Jedi Tarre Vizsla served as the Mand'alor of the Mandalorians sometime prior to the fall of the Old Republic.

The Golandras was a MedStar-class frigate under the command of Captain Brisha Shard during the Clone Wars. It was destroyed shortly before the Battle of Skye in 21 BBY, when the Galactic Republic dispatched that medical frigate to the Marat system.

Parwa was a planet which was the homeworld of the Parwan species. It had seasons which were several centuries long, and some Parwans hibernated along with the changing seasons even if they were not on Parwa. The Parwan bounty hunter Derrown was born on Parwa.
Lesynn were birds native to the planet Fyodos.

Corellian sand panthers, also known as just sand-panthers, were a feline species native to the planet Corellia. The engineers of Coronet Arms based the design of the Mark V "Sand Panther" hunting rifle on an ancient rifle used to hunt sand-panthers.

Deathmoon was a moon of the planet Fyodos. It had another name prior to the Great Cleansing, but it was lost to the Fyodoi. When the Deathmoon was full in the skies of Fyodos, the Fyodoi became fearful as the satellite resembled the withered face of a corpse.
Lifemoon was one of the three moons of Fyodos. Fyodoi held parties, marriages, and coming of age rituals when Lifemoon was full.
Warmoon was a moon of the planet Fyodos. Fyodoi believed that when the Warmoon was full, it was a good time to engage in battle, which included hunting the Galidyn.

Galleros was the primary continent of the planet Zelos II. It was renamed in honor of the Mandated Commander of the People of Zelos, Galleros Nul. It was the location of the planet's cities—Drev, Kryndyn, Lyn, Lyrd, Nul, and Tolk—as well as the Valley of Umbra.
Pammant was a planet colonized by members of the Quarren species. By the Republic Era, several Quarren engineers resided there.
The Atraken Range was a mountain range on the moon Trilos.

Gamorr was a lush planet located in the Galov sector of the Outer Rim Territories, along the Triellus Trade Route. It was the homeworld of a porcine sentient species, the Gamorreans, who chopped down forests to clear land for farming.

result: All attendees of the Grand Alderaanian Gathering killed
x: The Okonomo Tragedy was a gruesome incident that took place on the planet of Alderaan around the year 32 BBY, during the annual Grand Alderaanian Gathering.

The Adjudicator was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Under the command of Captain Kronn, it was positioned in orbit over Cymoon 1 along with two other Star Destroyers.
Level 1331 was a level on the planet Coruscant. During the Age of the Empire, Phoca Soot was the prefect of the level.

Carida was a mountainous planet located in the Carida system within the Colonies region of the galaxy. During the Clone Wars, the Valor space station orbited the planet, while the era of the Galactic Empire saw Carida as home to an Imperial academy and a naval docking facility.

The Deep Core Security Zone was an area of the galaxy's Deep Core which was controlled by the Galactic Empire. It was considered a sensitive region and access to the zone was restricted by the 15th Deep Core Reserve Fleet, operating out of nearby Empress Teta.

Calcoraan was a planet located in the Calcoraan system in the Inner Rim. It was entirely covered by an ocean made out of chromyl chloride, which gave the planet its blood red color, mixed with several other acids, making it uninhabitable.

result: Destruction of Mala and all its lifeforms
Darth Wredd begins his Sith apprenticeship
x: Towards the end of the Second Imperial Civil War, the One Sith scientist Vul Isen decided to test his viral spores on the planet Mala, a primitive remote world that was home to an unidentified near-Human species.
The Alderaan Refugee Conference was a diplomatic conference held by members of the Galactic Senate on the planet Alderaan during the Clone Wars.
Gallian cobras were a type of reptile native to the moon Gall. They were noted for darting their tongues in an inquisitive fashion while hatchlings.
Nyriaan was a planet where the human Jenkes managed a gladiator arena during the early days of the Galactic Empire's rule.
The Anx were a tall reptilian sentient species native to Gravlex Med. They were notable for their blade-shaped head which had a crest that changed color according to the individual's mood.

Balosars were a near-human sentient species which possessed two antennapalps on the tops of their heads, but were otherwise similar in appearance to humans. They were native to the ruined world Balosar.
Coratanni Town, formerly known as Ruugaria, was a town on the planet Rishi that served as the main base of the pirates known as the Ravagers.
Grassworms were a species of worm which were similar in appearance to noodles when anemic.

Givins were a sentient species from Yag'Dhul. They had the appearance of an animated skeleton, and were renowned for their mathematical genius. During the Galactic Civil War, the Givin cryptographer Drusil Bephorin was recruited into the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Ahakista was a location in the Ahakista system where the Daystar Casino was built. The Dug gambler Gronson Takkaro, who at one point worked as operations manager of the casino, fell deeply into debt on Ahakista and fled to the planet Lothal.

Section IG-44 was an area of the planet Coruscant. Coruscant Guard riot troopers believed Duchess Satine Kryze fled toward that section after the police identified her as a suspect in the murder of Davu Golec.

The proclamation of the New Order was the event that marked the founding of the Galactic Empire. Following the end of the Clone Wars, during an emergency session of the Galactic Senate, Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine—secretly Darth Sidious, the Dark Lord of the Sith—claime…

Malastare Narrows was a location on the planet Malastare in the Mid Rim Territories. In 34 BBY, prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, a Corporate Alliance fleet commanded by the Harch Admiral Trench had fo…
Imperial Heavy Troopers were a branch of the Imperial Army's Stormtrooper Corps. Heavy Troopers were equipped with special combat armor and electrostaffs in order to deal with highly resilient foes.

Carrandar Secundus was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Carrandar Secundus system of the Outer Rim Territories' Portmoak sector. The Galactic Empire destroyed a nest in the system around five years before the Battle of Yavin.

A nest was located on Carrandar Secundus, where it was destroyed by the Galactic Empire around five years before the Battle of Yavin. The human girl Merei Spanjaf read about the nest's destruction on a newsfeed on her datapad.

Uquine was a placid planet located in the Uquine system in the Colonies region. The agricultural scientist Tepha Leonis gave birth to her second child, Zare Leonis on the planet, although the Leonis family left the world, living in a number of locations including the space sta…

Eufornis Major, sometimes referred to as simply Eufornis, was a prestigious ecumenopolis planet located in the galaxy's Core Worlds. Due to their similar names, Eufornis Major was occasionally confused with Eufornis Minor, a remote Outer Rim colony world.

x: Not long after the Battle of Yavin, an Imperial Lambda-class T-4a shuttle carrying weapons and equipment that were supplied by the crime lord Jabba the Hutt was attacked by a robotic CR90 corvette.

place: A pirate space station, the edge of the Outer Rim

x: During the Galactic Civil War, not long after the Battle of Yavin, a robotic CR90 corvette belonging to pirates—who were funded by the Crymorah Syndicate—attacked an Imperial shuttle carrying Imperial weapons. The Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader, stopped the corvette.

The Skewer was a ship used by the Zorbian space pirates in the Moddell sector. The pirates were rumored to have raided a caravan from Annaj that was transporting treasures to be appraised and sold, as well as an Ayrou antiquities freighter, before the pirates crashed on the Fo…
T8X-4 was an astromech droid that served the Sith Empire aboard Vaiken Spacedock during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
K3-F7 was an astromech droid that served the reconstituted Sith Empire aboard Vaiken Spacedock during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
P6-K4 was an astromech droid that served the Galactic Republic aboard Carrick Station during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.
F3-T2 was an astromech droid that served the Galactic Republic aboard Carrick Station during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.
L5-V2 was an astromech droid that served Admiral Bey'wan Aygo of the Republic Navy aboard Carrick Station during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.
Z2-B3 was an astromech droid that served Admiral Zasha Ranken of the reconstituted Sith Empire's Navy aboard Vaiken Spacedock during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
The Unchained, or "Slave Cult", was a group of slaves among those who rebelled against the reconstituted Sith Empire at the unfinished colossus on Dromund Kaas during the Cold War.
PM-1203, colloquially known as the Fort Anaxes asteroid, was a massive planetoid located in the Azure system's Anaxes asteroid belt, within the Azure sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Keren was the largest city on the planet Naboo. It was the location of Club Deeja, as well as a pocket of Alderaanian citizens. After the destruction of Alderaan, Princess Leia Organa ventured to Keren to save the Alderaanians there from the Galactic Empire.
The Battle of Korseg IV was an engagement fought during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.

LG3-18 was a landing guidance droid with masculine programming that was stationed on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the year 5 ABY. LG3-18 was programmed to lead incoming starships to public landing platforms.

Flare Base was an Alliance to Restore the Republic military base on the planet Korseg IV. It was located high in the mountains. The base was understaffed with only 200 personnel, half a dozen X-wings, and a medium transport.
The Patience was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in the service of the Rebel Alliance's fleet during the Galactic Civil War.
8-13 was a hunter killer droid that, by the year 5 ABY, found its way into the irrigation systems of a homestead located on the moon Sulon.

QT-KT, also known as Qutee-Kaytee and often referred to as Qutee, was an astromech droid and a member of D-Squad, under the command of Colonel Meebur Gascon, during the Clone Wars. She belonged to Jedi Knight Aayla Secura.

M5-BZ, also referred to as simply BZ or Beezee, was an astromech droid who had served the Jedi Master Tera Sinube and subsequently became a member of D-Squad. M5-BZ was lost in hyperspace after opening an airlock while aboard a Venator-class Star Destroyer, the Renown.

Kalist VI, also known simply as Kalist, was a barren rocky planet located in the Kalist system of the Deep Core. It was the homeworld of rebel pilot Dak Ralter, who joined Rogue Squadron of the Rebel Alliance.

An Imperial penal colony was built on Kalist VI. The Alliance to Restore the Republic pilot Dak Ralter was born to a family of political prisoners in the colony, and later escaped with bright ambitions.
Toola was a frigid planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of both the sentient Whiphid species and massive beasts of burden known as mastmots.
Tiisheraan was the homeworld of the Alliance to Restore the Republic Major Bren Derlin. It was located in the Tiisheraan system in the Core Worlds.

Ralltiir was a terrestrial planet located in the Core Worlds' Darpa sector, in the Ralltiir system. During the Clone Wars, Lieutenant Commander Orson Krennic of the Galactic Republic financed a few weeks of vacation on the planet for the smuggler Has Obitt's former crew member…

Axxila was a sparsely-populated terrestrial planet located in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories. An exporter of ores, the once prosperous world eventually fell into obscurity after outside forces like the Galactic Empire engaged in strip mining operations.

The Kupohan were a sentient species from the planet of Kupoh in the system of the same name. Due to the strong winds of their ecosystem, they had evolved their frequency filter organs to screen out all the noise and detect voices, which also helped them hunt.
Kor Bareesh was a planet located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. It was the ruined throneworld of the Bareesh kajidic.
D5-F2 was an astromech droid that served the reconstituted Sith Empire aboard Vaiken Spacedock and, later, Crag Outpost during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
L3-R3 was an astromech droid that served the reconstituted Sith Empire aboard Vaiken Spacedock during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic.
R0-P6 was an astromech droid that served the Galactic Republic aboard Carrick Station during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.

The Rand Ecliptic was a starship in the service of the Galactic Empire shortly before the Battle of Yavin. After attending an Imperial Academy, the pilots Biggs Darklighter and Derek Klivian both received their commissions aboard the vessel.
The Lavaflow Traverse was a tunnel in the Tomb, an ancient prison complex on the planet Belsavis that connected two caves in the Tomb—the Ancient Stasis Zone and the Ancient Rakatan Keep.
The Jiguuna Market was an open-air marketplace in the city of Jiguuna on the planet Nal Hutta during the Cold War. It was located just outside of Nem'ro's Palace.

A settlement was located just south of the Rust Yards, an industrial site on the planet Nal Hutta during the Cold War. The settlement was home to the workers who were employed at the Rust Yards, such as Ezra and her husband Rand.

R3-S6, also known as "Goldie" or "Stubby," and as "Agent R3" to the Separatists, was an R3-series astromech droid assigned to Anakin Skywalker, during the Clone Wars to replace his lost astromech droid R2-D2.

Llanic was a planet located in the Llanic system in the Karthakk sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated at the intersection of the Llanic Spice Route and the Triellus Trade Route.

Pantora was the primary moon in orbit around the planet Orto Plutonia, in the Pantora system, located in the Sujimis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square P-19 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

place: Above the moon Pantora, in the Pantora system
x: The blockade of Pantora, also known as the Pantoran blockade, was established during the Clone Wars by the Trade Federation above the moon Pantora, in the Pantora system.

During the Clone Wars, the daughters of Pantora Supreme Chairman Notluwiski Papanoida, Che Amanwe Papanoida and Chi Eekway Papanoida were kidnapped by the bounty hunters Greedo and his Gotal accomplice.

Omereth was a water-based planet located in the Omereth system within the Outer Rim Territories, past Hutt Space. Practically uninhabited, it possessed a few archipelagos and had little to offer to most species in the galaxy besides fish.
Located on Level 5000, the planet Coruscant's central power distribution grid was comprised of massive generator towers that powered the entire ecumenopolis.
Volpai were a four-armed sentient species found in the galaxy. Notable Volpai included Robbs Ely, Tiggs Leo, and Moregi.
The Magi Sentinels (singular: Magus Sentinel) were an organization of robed individuals who protected the monarch of Onderon around the time of the Freedon Nadd Uprising in 3998 BBY.

In 139 ABY, the junk dealer Ania Solo was kidnapped by her estranged lover Ramid, who was responding to a Galactic Federation Triumvirate bounty on her head for her alleged role in the murder of the Imperial Knight Teemen Alton.

result: Blackouts and widespread fires on Coruscant
The bill to de-regulate banking conglomerates is passed
x: During the Clone Wars, a bombing occurred on the Republic capital Coruscant of the planet's central power distribution grid. The attack was planned by Count Dooku to disrupt the peace initiative occurring between the Republic and the Separatist Alliance.

x: An apartment on the planet Coruscant served as the residence of Senator Christo.

Kouhuns, also known as Indoumodo kouhuns were small, multi-legged arthropods from the jungle planet of Indoumodo that were able to deliver a deadly venom to their victims. As their venom was typically lethal, they were sometimes employed by assassins to kill their targets.

A mandatory blackout was put into place on the planet Coruscant in the aftermath of the bombing of the central power distribution grid. Senator Onaconda Farr was assaulted by bounty hunters Robonino and Chata Hyoki during one of the blackouts.
Padmé's office, located in the Senate Office Building on Coruscant, was used by Senator Padmé Amidala during her time in the Republic Senate.
A funeral for Senator Onaconda Farr was held on the planet Coruscant a few days after his death.

t: Escape from the Republic military base

x: After her arrest for the murder of Letta Turmond, Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano managed to effect an escape from the Republic military base where she was being held.

result: Asajj Ventress's lightsabers are stolen by Barriss Offee
x: While in the underworld, Tano teamed up with bounty hunter Asajj Ventress. Tano contacted Offee, oblivious to the fact she was the one framing Tano. Offee told her to find a clue in an abandoned munitions warehouse.

Asmeru was a planet located in the Asmeru system in the Outer Rim Territories' Senex sector, part of the Senex-Juvex region. On the 234th day of the world's sixteenth month, the natives at one point celebrated a festival known as Q'anah in their language.
The Hound's Tooth was a modified Corellian Engineering Corporation YV-666 light freighter used as the personal starship of Bossk, a Trandoshan bounty hunter.
Balnab was a temperate planet located in the Bright Jewel sector of the Mid Rim, near Patitite Pattuna. During the Clone Wars, it served as a home to a group of alien castaways.

Aleen was a rocky planet located within the Bright Jewel sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim. It was home to the diminutive, terrestrial Aleena species, and the Kindalo, a bioluminescent, tree-like species.
Nexu were predatory felines native to the planet Cholganna. They were also found on Zhanox, Vodran, and Saleucami.

The Core Five, also known as the Council of Five, was the ruling body of the InterGalactic Banking Clan on the planet Scipio. The Council was arrested after being charged with corruption, allowing Senator Rush Clovis to assume total control of the Banking Clan.
"Doctor Ball" was an IT-O Interrogation Unit in service to the Galactic Empire before the start of the Galactic Civil War.

Thalassians were a sentient species, some of whom worked as slavers. During the reign of the Galactic Republic, the Er'Kit Senator Danry Ledwellow accepted bribes from Thalassian slavers and allowed them to operate on his species' homeworld.
Yuzzums were a sentient species native to the Forest Moon of Endor. A Yuzzum named Joh Yowza occasionally sang with the Max Rebo Band, while another known as Wam Lufba worked as an exterminator.

B3-RD was an astromech droid that was tasked by Galactic Republic-allied forces with reprogramming artillery controlled by the Sith Empire in the Axial Park region of Coronet City during the Battle of Corellia.

C-9X was a prototype battle droid designed by the Corellian Engineering Corporation. It was deployed by CEC executive Benton Maas during the Battle of Corellia against the Sith Empire, but Imperial forces destroyed the droid and took its signal emitter that could control other…
Garel City was a city on the Outer Rim planet Garel. It was the location of the Garel City Spaceport.

Pons Ora was one of the few settlements on the surface of Abafar, a remote desert world located in the Outer Rim Territories, and served as the planet's de facto seat of government. During the Clone Wars, it was host to a Separatist rhydonium mining installation.
MF-80 was a protocol droid with feminine programming who was in the service of the Grand Hutt Council and owned by Gardulla.
The Naboo Royal Handmaidens, or simply handmaidens, were a group of young female handmaidens chosen as aides to the Queen of the planet Naboo.
0-0-0, also known simply as Triple-Zero, or just Trip, was a protocol droid that specialized in etiquette, customs, translation and torture.
BT-1, also referred to as "Bee Tee," was a homicidal BT-1 assassin droid created by the Galactic Empire's Tarkin Initiative.
DX-M2 was an advanced battle droid who was part of Strike Team Oricon, a Galactic Republic unit tasked with battling the forces of the Dread Masters on the moon Oricon.

U9-C4, also referred to as Ceefor and nicknamed "Flat Top" by Colonel Meebur Gascon, was a somewhat timid R5 series astromech droid owned by Thongla Jur, a member of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.

A species of bioluminescent microplankton were native to the planet Mon Cala. The microplankton could be used as a hair dye if it was washed into an individuals hair, as it would bond with each hair strand and then emit pulsating glow.

The Vigilance was a warship of the reconstituted Sith Empire that participated in the invasion of Taris during the Galactic War. The Vigilance destroyed a Galactic Republic cruiser, though escape pods from the ship managed to land on Taris's surface.|

result: Death of Jedi Master Depa Billaba
x: The Battle of Kaller was a battle of the Outer Rim Sieges that took place on the planet Kaller during the last days of the Clone Wars.

x: The secret mission to Geonosis was carried out by the Sith Lord Darth Vader not long after the Battle of Yavin.
Tey-Zuka was an ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid that served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.

The Spectres take one of Calrissian's fuel canisters
x: In 4 BBY the rebel crew of the Ghost accompanied smuggler Lando Calrissian on a mission to his farm on Lothal, after aiding him in acquiring a puffer pig from the crime lord Azmorigan.

The Electrum was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that served in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. Originally stationed at the planet Ryloth's deepdock, the Star Destroyer was loaned out to serve in the flotilla of the Imperial installation known as Sentinel Base.

KRONOS-327 was an IG-86 sentinel droid who worked in Ziro the Hutt's criminal organization during the Clone Wars. He was Ziro's favored assassin until he failed an assignment and was ordered for destruction.

TC-70 was a TC-series protocol droid who served as a translator for Jabba the Hutt during the Clone Wars and into the Imperial Era. However, by 2 ABY, Jabba had a different protocol unit serving as his translator droid.
The Mount Tantiss project was a secret cloning project carried out by Grand Admiral Thrawn during his reemergence to the galaxy.
Yoda's fighter was a modified Jedi starfighter at one point during the Clone Wars, stationed in the Jedi Temple hangar.

R9-D9 was an astromech droid who served King Sanjay Rash of Onderon during the Clone Wars. Late in the war, R9 showed Rash and General Kalani holographic images of Steela Gerrera and Lux Bonteri as Akenathen Tandin informed them the rebel leaders also included Steela's brother…
Oaka Prime was a wildlife preserve planet in the far corners of the Inner Rim, near the Unknown Regions.
The crime lieutenant Abron Mar owned an R-41 Starchaser. He used it to fly in between Takara's stronghold and the planet Katraasii.
