objective: Destroy the Vanqor listening station
x: During the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic launched a mission to destroy a Confederate listening post on the planet Vanqor.

result: Destruction of the Christophsis Separatist tower
x: At least two years after the Battle of Christophsis, a second battle took place on the planet Christophsis during the Clone Wars.
Racer A2D-3 was an protocol droid that was used in the droid races on the Nar Shaddaa Promenade during the Grand Acquisitions Race. Sapaaga the Hutt was a frequent better on the Promenade races.

Racer CGK-0 was a droid that was used in droid races on the Promenade of Nar Shaddaa during the Grand Acquisitions Race, a galaxy-wide scavenger hunt organized by the Chevin Conglomerate during the Cold War.

FX-7 was a FX-7 medical assistant droid who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. While on the planet Hoth at Echo Base, FX-7 assisted 2-1B when curing Luke Skywalker with bacta treatment who was injured by a wampa.

t: Battle of unidentified planet (Tholme and Ventress)
x: In 22 BBY, months before the Battle of Christophsis, a battle took place on a planet early in the Clone Wars.
Krayt's Claw was a Tatooine-based syndicate of bounty hunters led by the adolescent bounty hunter Boba Fett that operated during the Clone Wars.

Akiva was a remote jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was once part of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, who created a large droid construction facility under the planet's surface.

Jelucan was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet sided with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. During the Age of the Empire, Jelucan was annexed by the Galactic Empire.
During the Cold War, the Sith Lord Darth Jadus faked the destruction of his Harrower-class dreadnought Dominator, allowing the Eagle's network to claim responsibility for the attack.
The Mellcrawler was the personal starship of the Sullustan smuggler Nien Nunb that he used throughout the Galactic Civil War.

The Codian Moon orbited the planet Codia I in the Mid Rim Territories. It featured forests, and wood-moss grew there. At some point, herds of the creatures known as reeks were transplanted to the Codian Moon from their homeworld, Ylesia.

AR-72 was a droid in the employ of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. AR-72 was designed to interface with the "brain" of the the Tomb, a Rakata prison complex on the planet Belsavis, so that he could bring the prison's communication systems online for the Empire.
The Imperial Mining Institute was a scientific research agency that operated under the authority of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.

B8-M2 was a battle droid in the employ of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. During the invasion of Belsavis, B8-M2 was stationed deep in the Tomb guarding one of the Rakata teleporters, and served as a communications link to Commander Vorel.

K0-29 was a battle droid in the employ of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. During the invasion of Belsavis, K0-29 was tasked with guarding the probe droid TA-350 deep in the Tomb on Belsavis, though TA-350 was of the opinion that K0-29 was unintelligent—i…

SD-9 was a battle droid in the employ of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War. During the invasion of Belsavis, SD-9 was tasked with retrieving the memory cores of disabled Rakata droids in the Warlord's Deep in the Tomb, but the Esh-kha destroyed SD-9's escor…
Starkiller Base, also known as the Starkiller, was a series of First Order military installations and bases built into and on the ice planet of Ilum in the Unknown Regions.
The capital city of the planet Mahranee was obliterated by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars as part of its attack on the planet.

objective: Steal the Imperialis
x: During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Papa Toren, a crime boss operating on the Colonies planet Castell, hired gambler Lando Calrissian and his team to steal the Imperialis from Orbital Shipyard CC-24.
The Imperialis was a luxury pleasure craft owned by Supreme Chancellor and eventually Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine during the Galactic Civil War.
The Dejarik Hologame Galactic League, an organization catering to dejarik competition, flourished during the reign of Emperor Palpatine.

objective: Rescue the scholar Hethan Romund
x: The scholar Hethan Romund was rescued from the Dark Side Adept Malefax by several Force-sensitive allies.

Organic, living whale-ships made up Doctor Cylo's research base, and therefore his fleet. The whale-ships had four long fins and thick tails that allowed them to maneuver through space. They also had massive teeth.

Aargonar was a planet located in the galaxy. During the Clone Wars, the husband of Confederacy of Independent Systems Senator Mina Bonteri went there to set up a base for the Separatists, but was killed when Republic clone troopers attacked.

Sha Qarot was a planet located in the Sha Qarot system in the Deep Core that orbited a red sun. It had a moon named Fex. Due to its poisonous atmosphere and heavy volcanic activity, Nakari Kelen thought nobody would ever want to set foot on the planet.

t: Attack on a Venator-class Star Destroyer
x: During the Clone Wars, a super tank was sent to a Venator-class Star Destroyer. However, once aboard the Star Destroyer, the B1-series battle droids inside the tank began an attack on the cruiser, destroying its cargo bay.

During the Clone Wars, Count Dooku sent his Sith Acolyte to Dathomir to meditate on the dark side of the Force. In order to stop this, Master Yoda sent a Jedi Knight there on a mission to defeat one of Dooku's Acolytes.
Assembler was a droid that joined the Directive 7 movement headed by Mentor during the era of the Galactic War.
Bulwark was a battle droid that joined the Directive 7 movement headed by Mentor during the era of the Galactic War.
Detector was a battle droid that joined the Directive 7 movement headed by Mentor during the era of the Galactic War.

Replicator was the name given to a battle droid created by Mentor, the leader of the Directive 7 movement during the era of the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Interrogator was an interrogation droid that joined the Directive 7 movement headed by Mentor during the era of the Galactic War.
C5-M3, or Healer, was a medical droid that joined the Directive 7 movement headed by Mentor during the era of the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
Z0-B5 was an astromech droid that was used as a messenger by Moff Jiak of the Sith Empire during the Galactic War.
Kanarosiku-K was a Gree research droid stationed aboard by the starship Gray Secant. It recruited outsiders to reestablish communications with various research droids scattered throughout the galaxy.

A hawk-bat (also spelled hawkbat) was a type of bat which had a beak with sharp contours. The nose of Wilhuff Tarkin, a bony human male, looked like a hawk-bat's beak. The Jedi youngling clan which Dooku belonged to was named after the creature.

Loth-bats were a species of giant bat native to the planet Lothal in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. They were known to travel in packs and had the ability to glide over long distances, as well as roost under the eaves of buildings.

The Stellar Vista was a Mon Calamari star cruiser during the Imperial Era. In the standard year 14 BBY, during the star cruiser's service as a luxury liner, it was pulled out of hyperspace by the orders of Imperial Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, who was seeking to recapture the Carrion …
The Mon Cala eel also known as the Mon Calamari eel, or the electric eel, was a species of predatory eel found in the oceans of Mon Cala. They were reputed for being slippery.

Ord Cestus, also referred to as simply Cestus, was a planet in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Located in the vicinity of the Perlemian Trade Route, it was situated a considerable distance away from common routes between Geonosis and Coruscant.

Corruptor Zero was a battle droid that commanded the droid armies of the Dread Masters at the Dread Fortress on Oricon during the Galactic War. During the Dread War, Corruptor Zero was destroyed while trying to repel invading forces.

A jail was located in Gorse City, capital of the planet Gorse. After the industrialist Denetrius Vidian murdered the Besalisk Lal Grallik, her husband Gord Grallik and his cousins attempted to arrest Vidian and the Imperial Captain Rae Sloane and take them to the jail.

The SR-78 Bulwark Defense Droid was a three-legged battle droid used by the Shroud, a freelance spy active during the Galactic War. The deactivated SR-78 was stationed at the Shroud's factory on the moon Nar Shaddaa.

The Gray Syndicate was a small criminal organization located on the planet Lothal. The group was headquartered in the outskirts of Capital City, in a disused tavern down a dirty alley that had at one time been Ake's Tavern.

In the aftermath of the Battle of Endor, citizens of Imperial Center, the Imperial capital world, carried out a riot in Monument Plaza to celebrate the imminent fall of the Galactic Empire, as well as the death of its Emperor, Sheev Palpatine, who had secretly been the persona…

Level 1313 was a level on the metropolitan world of Coruscant, so named because it was located one thousand, three hundred, and thirteen levels from the core of Coruscant, which was accessed by the underworld portal.

The Banshee was a Lancer-class pursuit craft which served as the personal starship of bounty hunter Asajj Ventress during the Clone Wars. The Banshee featured two cabins, a small galley, and a cargo hold, used for holding bounties prisoner.
The veeka was a type of red-plumed bird that was native to the planet Dathomir. The meat of the species was edible by Dathomirians and Kiffar.
Burra fish were a species of fish native to the planet of Dathomir, who's flesh was edible by the Kiffar, Dathomirians, and Latero.
The Academy Screening Office was a department of the Academy for Young Imperials on Lothal that was tasked with ascertaining the qualifications of applicants.
Lightning was an astromech droid with a masculine personality that worked in the Zero Angle, a bar in the Galactic Empire's Flight Base for the Bright Jewel Oversector.

Sarapin Four was a planet in the Sarapin system of the Core Worlds. During the Cold War, the Galactic Republic Valor-class cruiser Enkindle retreated to the upper atmosphere of Sarapin Four, but was destroyed by Imperial forces.

The Bimmiel asteroid field was an asteroid belt in the Bimmiel system in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic War, the Republic Navy attempted to establish a minefield there to disrupt the Sith Empire's activity in the Kanz sector, but were stopped by Imperial forces.

The Gilded Meteor was a prototype bomber that was developed by the Galactic Republic and was sent on its test flight in the Ferra sector during the Galactic War. The reconstituted Sith Empire attacked the bomber above Hypori, but was repelled.
Qunaalac was a Hutt kajidic, or clan. During the Clone Wars, it was led and represented on the Hutt Ruling Council by Marlo.
Clone flametroopers were clone troopers of the flame trooper corps in the Grand Army of the Republic.
Lahn was a planet located in the galaxy. It was covered in beaches, forests, and oceans.

result: Two Jedi Masters killed by Virgillian dissenters
objective: Establish peace talks between the Virgillian Free Alignment and the Ar
x: In 23 BBY, a diplomatic delegation of the Jedi Order was dispatched on a mission to Virgillia 7 to establish peace talks in the Virgillian Civil War between the Virgillian Free Alignment and the Aristocracy.
The falumpaset was a herbivorous species of mammal found on the planets Naboo and Onderon. In the wild, the species lived in swamps, forests, and plains in family groups.
Ortolans were a sentient elephantine species of squat, blue-skinned bipeds with large, floppy ears, beady black eyes, and a trunk-like nose that were native to the cold planet Orto.

Separatist holdouts was a term for the various fractured military and political elements of the Confederacy of Independent Systems which continued to remain active after the end of the Clone Wars after the reintegration of former Separatist worlds into the Empire after splitti…

Orto was a cold planet located in the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Ortolan species. Orto was so cold, the natives had to consume large amounts of food in order to develop a warm layer of blubber.

In the aftermath of the Battle of Hoth during the Galactic Civil War, a GR-75 medium transport supported the main Alliance Fleet at the Rebel Alliance's secret rendezvous point beyond the Galactic Rim.
Shortly following the Battle of Hoth, an Imperial Strike-class medium cruiser happened upon the Rebel Alliance's secret rendezvous point beyond the Galactic Rim.

The Rover was a HH-87 Starhopper belonging to the Devaronian Gev Hessan. After his death, the pilot Wedge Antilles used the ship to explore the Outer Rim Territories. Over Akiva, he was confronted by an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire.

Rayboo were antlered mammals native to the barren ice tundra of the planet Hoth. They gave loud, wailing cries and were hunted by wampas, alpha predators that occupied the top of Hoth's food chain but primarily hunted tauntauns.

The Iotrans were a humanoid species from the Iotra system. When Merei Spanjaf and Jix Hekyl tried to smuggle a pulse-mag into a data center on Lothal, they encountered a hulking, bald example of this species with a blaster who warned them that they'd be "two smoking spots" if …
Alert was a New Republic DP20 gunship that was assigned to Customs duty in the Kalinda system.

Mataou was a hot desert planet located in the Mataou system, in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories, on the edge of the Ivax Nebula. Long before the Galactic Civil War, Mataou was ruled by Hutts, including the Gnuda Kajidic.
The Chadra-Fan was a sentient species of meter-tall, rodent-like humanoids from the Outer Rim world of Chad. They had large ears, and flat noses with four nostrils.
Garbage masher 3263827, also known as trash compactor 32-6-3827, was a garbage compactor for recyclable waste aboard the Galactic Empire's DS-1 platform, better known as the Death Star.

The Far Orbit Resort and Lodge was a place for hunters to go. It was founded around 40 standard years before the Battle of Yavin by an Ithorian and a Rodian. Business boomed during the Clone Wars, but slowed down during the Imperial Period.

Yarkora, also known as Yarkorans and Yak Faces, were a sentient species found in the galaxy. Saelt-Marae and Jedi Master Adampo were Yarkorans. Due to most Yarkora eating constantly throughout the day, they had two stomachs, four kidneys, and three livers.

The Kadas'sa'Nikto, or Green Nikto, were one of the subspecies of the Nikto species from the planet Kintan; another was the Kajain'sa'Nikto. They had scaly green, gray, or red skin, black eyes, and symmetrical horns.

Titan Base was a Rebel Alliance starfighter outpost. It was in a subterranean cavern on an uninhabited planet in the Corva sector. The base consisted of a command center, the hangar, barracks, and a weapons range.

A planet was located in a star system of the Outer Rim Territories' Corva sector. Titan Base was a secret starfighter base the Rebel Alliance had built into a mesa on the planet that was used to launch Rebel operations in adjacent sectors.
Mount Verena was a mountain located outside Verena City on the planet Kirima.
The SaSassis Bar was a bar located on the planet Kirima in Verena City's Verena Starport, in operation around 6 ABY.
Kameria was the only moon of the planet Kirima. It was also the location of the Royal Naval Yards.

The Corporate Sector Authority Security Police, also known as the Corporate Sector Authority police, or as the CSA security police, or Espos, was a law enforcement agency that was part of the Corporate Sector Authority.
Following the Battle of Endor, the inhabitants of the Kalinda system staged a revolt that drove the Galactic Empire off the planet.
The Great Drought was a period of intense drought conditions on Tatooine, a desert world in the Outer Rim Territories, in the years prior to the Battle of Yavin.

The Black Hole was the name given to the worst part of the Off-Worlders' Quarter on the planet Ropagi II. It was the location of the world's black market, and was where criminals, smugglers, pirates, and bounty hunters congregated.

The River was a boulevard located in the Off-Worlders' Quarter on the planet Ropagi II. It was lined on either side by bars and cantinas. Droids were not welcome in the majority of the establishments along the River.
The Scrap Heap was the name given to an area of the Off-Worlders' Quarter on the planet Ropagi II. Droids congregated in the area while their owners drank in the bars and cantinas of the River.

The Karbonni asteroid belt was located in the Pax system. The cargo ship Fool's Gold, loaded with gemstones, was lost in the belt until its cargo was recovered by adventurers in the early years of the New Republic.
TJ-55 was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid who led an infantry detachment from the Separatist Droid Army during the Battle of Christophsis of the Clone Wars.

t: Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor
x: In 20 BBY, it was extensively damaged by Confederacy fire during the Battle of Sullust, the Jedi and droid escaping unscathed only with R2-D2's deployment of his built-in fire extinguisher.
Pastil was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Pastil system in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square S-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Obex was a Nu-class attack/transport shuttle used during the Clone Wars. It was destroyed by BX-series droid commandos during the Defense of Rishi Station, after it had ferried Clone Captain Rex and Clone Commander Cody to the Rishi Station.
Unit 26, also known as Unit 2-6, was a BX-series droid commando who participated in the takeover of Rishi Station during the Clone Wars along with other commando droids, such as Unit 07.
"Sparky" was the nickname given to a commando droid captain by clone trooper Hevy who led a team of BX-series droid commandos to capture Rishi Station during the Clone Wars.
The Fervse'dra asteroid belt was located within Bothan Space of the regions known as the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice.

The Ruten Pet Show was an event held on the planet Ruten during the early years of the New Republic. It was instituted by sycophants attempting to curry favor with Imperial governor Bursthed; Bursthed had a love of exotic creatures and kept several as pets.
A Nu-class attack/transport shuttle delivered Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano to Christophsis during the Battle of Christophsis in the early stages of the Clone Wars.
The Daunted Gypsy was a Jermaguim-class Light Freighter operated by the New Republic. It was used by Republic operatives during the Freedom Strike Seltos operation.
Little Mount was a mountain that bordered Verena City to the north on the planet Kirima.

t: Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor

x: Count Dooku's frigate was a Munificent-class star frigate that served in the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems as the flagship of Separatist leader Count Dooku during the Clone Wars, until it was crippled during a skirmish at Vanqor.

Count Dooku's solar sailer, also known as Count Dooku's Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop, was a Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop owned by Count Dooku after receiving it as a gift from the Geonosians. He used it as a private transport throughout the Clone Wars.

t: Unidentified Sheathipede-class transport shuttle (Count Dooku's frigate)
x: A Sheathipede-class transport shuttle was stolen from Dooku's Munificent-class star frigate by Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker during a skirmish of the Clone Wars.

Quell was a terrestrial planet located in the Quell system of the Outer Rim Territories. In 21 BBY, the planet served as a site of a Clone Wars engagement, where the Galactic Republic task force of Jedi General Aayla Secura was attacked by a Confederacy of Independent Systems …

A Republic frigate was part of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. Jedi General Anakin Skywalker used it to evacuate Jedi General Aayla Secura and some of her troops from her flagship Liberty during the Battle of Quell.
Mastiff phalones were a non-sentient species of avian quadrupeds that were native to the savannas of Maridun. As carnivores, they were dangerous predators.
The Lurmen village was comprised of a group of Lurmen who colonized the remote planet Maridun in order to escape from the Clone Wars.
Kooriva was a planet located in the Kooriva system of the Inner Rim Territories.

Varno Market was a marketplace on the planet Vengler. Around 7 ABY, a group of scouts came across the Eye of Koda in the marketplace, and were attacked by Scitrok Warriors under the command of Dhar Bullwin.
Clone cold assault troopers, also known as cold assault clone troopers or Clone Snowtroopers were a specialized variant of clone troopers within the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
685 was a B1-series battle droid that was stationed at a base on Orto Plutonia during the Clone Wars that was destroyed in a skirmish on Orto Plutonia.
A Talz village was located on the planet Orto Plutonia during the Clone Wars. Its inhabitants included Thi-Sen, the chieftain of the Talz tribe.
The eastern swamps were an area on Naboo that was the only known location of the perlote trees, which housed populations of slug-beetles.
Reeksa was a species of carnivorous plant that grew on the Outer Rim world of Iego. The plant survived in low-light conditions at the bottom of canyons by capturing live prey and digesting them.
A Venator-class Star Destroyer, the Defender served as part of the Galactic Republic's naval branch, in the Open Circle Fleet, during the Clone Wars.
The Venator-class Star Destroyer Redeemer was part of the Galactic Republic's naval forces during the Clone Wars.
The Ubese were a sentient species that spoke Ubese. Originating from the planet Uba IV, the Ubese were notoriously isolationist, rarely conducting trade with off-worlders.

The nek was a non-sentient predatory species found in the galaxy. Characterized by their squat physiques, yellow fur, sharp teeth, and harsh barking, neks could run at great speeds, and they were considered dangerous by humans.
Chad was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the sentient Chadra-Fan species. A blue dressing known as Chadian dressing was from this world.
The Council Hall bubble was a habitation bubble of the Gungan city of Otoh Gunga. It contained the High Tower Boardroom, from which the Gungan High Council governed its people.
The Central Civic area was located in the Gungan city of Otoh Gunga. It connected to the Council Hall bubble, which contained the High Tower Boardroom, the gathering place of the Gungan High Council.
The Gungan Sacred Place, also known simply as the Sacred Place, was in an ancient forest. It became sacred to the Gungans, a sanctuary for troubled times.
Gladiator Night was an illegal sporting event held in Monad Outpost on the planet Lothal.
The Galactic Empire carried out an assault on the headquarters of the Gray Syndicate, located in the building once known Ake's Tavern in the northern market district of Lothal's Capital City.

A massacre occurred at the village of Rhador at some point between the years 2 BBY and 1 BBY. The village, which had existed for a thousand years prior to the Imperial occupation, proceeded to protest and rebel against the Imperials, entering an armed standoff, which resulted …

The Anaxes asteroid belt, also known as the Anaxes asteroid ring, was an asteroid field located in the Azure sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was created when a cataclysmic event destroyed the planet Anaxes after the end of the Clone Wars.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
Defection of Everi Chalis to the Alliance
x: The Attack on Haidoral Prime occurred during the Galactic Civil War in 3 ABY when the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry engaged the Galactic Empire's military forces on the planet Haidoral Prime.
The Administration District was the southern section of the Black Hole, a region of the Labor Valley on the planet Corellia.

The Refinery District was the northern section of the Black Hole, a region of the Labor Valley on the planet Corellia. The Refinery District was north of the Administration District and was where most of the hypermatter refineries in the area were located.
Mos Doba was a town located on the desert planet Tatooine. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, it had been taken over by a group of mercenaries.

Atom Edge was a freighter affiliated with the Rebel Alliance in use after the Battle of Yavin. It was carrying supplies to the Rebels on Tatooine when it was shot down. The Galactic Empire arrived at the crashsite first, and set up a trap for the Rebels.

Luggabeasts were a non-sentient quadruped species that lived in the galaxy. They were found on frontier worlds, their masks were fused permanently onto their faces, and mechanical invasive systems enhanced their durability and working capabilities to well beyond their natural …

Armored sloths were native to the planet Spintir. After Malefax's dark side presence frightened fauna near the Dawn Temple, armored sloths had to be lured back to the temple to allow it to flourish again.
The bloater was a gas-filled floating creature from the planet Spintir that traveled in herds.
Spintiri lynxes roamed the forests of the planet Spintir in packs.

The icewolf was native to the planet Spintir. Icewolves were predatory, hunting with teeth and claws, and inhabited the forested valleys and mountain caves on the planet. After rendering prey unconscious, icewolves would bury it in ice.

Archon Quarry was the name given to the eastern half of the Cartel mining mesa on the planet Makeb. It was the site of Drilling Platforms Duba, Keeta, and K'wanna, which were anchored to the sides of the mesa along the edge of the quarry, as well as Communications Bunker 31 an…

Reles was the only city on the planet Spintir, and its capital. The location had been the site of a Jedi outpost that was abandoned when the Jedi built the Dawn Temple atop Mount Tellec, but over time the outpost became a starport, and later the city of Reles.

The Caves of Light and Shadow were the site of an old disturbance in the Force on the planet Spintir. The caves became a vergence in the Force, where the dark and light side energies in the caves were unbalanced.
This nanny droid, with feminine programming, was employed by the Galactic Empire in service of the Education and Economics Ministries.

The Durasteel Smeltworks was a section of the Labor Valley on the planet Corellia. During the Battle of Corellia in the Galactic War, the region was heavily bombed, destroying most of the factories in the Smeltworks.

The jamels were a yellow-skinned, quadrupedal creature native to the planet Utapau. The creature had tall, spindly legs, a large hump on their backs, and a drawn-out face with a red snout. Jamels were used as beasts of burden by the Utapau Amani.

Phelar was a city located on the Outer Rim world of Eriadu. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Eris Harro, Bureau Chief of the HoloNet News Outer Rim Node, held office in Phelar. The city also housed an Imperial Junior Academy.

Shyloah's Crest was a location found on the remote ice world of Hoth. Sometime after the Battle of Hoth and before the Battle of Endor, a battle between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire occurred here.
Wampa Mountain was a location on the remote ice world of Hoth. Sometime after the Battle of Hoth and before the Battle of Endor, a battle between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire occurred here.
Mynock Grottos was a location on the world of Dandoran. Sometime after the Battle of Hoth and before the Battle of Endor, a battle between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire occurred here.
Smuggler's Basin was a location on the world of Dandoran. Sometime after the Battle of Hoth and before the Battle of Endor, a battle between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire occurred here.
Varsa Meadows was a location on the world of Dandoran. Sometime after the Battle of Hoth and before the Battle of Endor, a battle between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire occurred here.
Massassi Valley was a location on the remote moon of Yavin 4. Sometime after the Battle of Hoth and before the Battle of Endor, a battle between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire occurred here.
Skygazer Hill was a location on the remote moon of Yavin 4. Sometime after the Battle of Hoth and before the Battle of Endor, a battle between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire occurred here.

Anchorhead Pass was a location on the remote desert world of Tatooine. Sometime after the Battle of Hoth and before the Battle of Endor, a battle between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire occurred in the pass.

The Jundland Chasm was a location on the remote desert world of Tatooine. Sometime after the Battle of Hoth and before the Battle of Endor, a battle between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire occurred in the chasm.
Luun Heights was a location on the world of Er'Kit. Sometime after the Battle of Hoth and before the Battle of Endor, a battle between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire occurred here.
Gundark Pass was a location on the world of Er'Kit. Sometime after the Battle of Hoth and before the Battle of Endor, a battle between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire occurred here.
Quolas was a tree-city inhabited by the Sathari species on the planet Arbooine.
The Ardan resistance was formed in opposition to the Galactic Empire several years before the Battle of Yavin. They set up a base in the Gauntlet on Arda I.

Halcyon was an arboreal planet located in the binary Halcyon system in the galaxy's Colonies. The planet notably housed a species of large rodents, and sparkstone could be found there. It also had several moons.
The starship Cruel Mistress was an Allanar N3 light freighter used by the Trade Spine League on the planet Burnin Konn during the Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector by the Galactic Empire.
The Mother of Pearl was an Allanar N3 light freighter used by the Trade Spine League during the Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector.
The Space Manta was an Allanar N3 light freighter used by the Trade Spine League during the Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector by the Galactic Empire.

The ro hypa was a serpentine creature native to the desert planet Mataou in the Anoat sector. They were red and purple in appearance and were highly venomous, capable of spewing potent poison at their prey.
The Pretty Profit was an Allanar N3 light freighter used by the Trade Spine League during the Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector by the Galactic Empire.

Kirtarkin was a planet located in the Kirtarkin system of the Anoat sector, in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. The Galactic Empire had several depots on Kirtarkin that contained large recycling centers, though they were too late to save the world's polluted environment.
Viamarr was a world in the Viamarr system of the Inner Rim Territories that was controlled by the Galactic Empire.
Galidraan III was a planet in the Galidraan system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It had a space station in orbit that was maintained by the Galactic Empire.
The Agrilat District was a district of the Corellian Sector on the moon Nar Shaddaa. The Chemical Refinement District was located in the Agrilat District, as was Coronet Boulevard.
Rothana was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Rothana system. It had arctic regions that were home to the arctic horny whelmer.
Thustra was a planet located in the Thustra system in the Sumitra sector of the Expansion Region. Sephi flyers came from here.
A volcanic planet was located in a nameless star system that was visited by the Carrion Spike, which spent some time in the planet's orbit after leaving the Galidraan system.

R2-D60 was an R2-series astromech droid that was a spy for the Rebel Alliance, but worked on Coruscant serving various members of the Imperial Senate. He was a typical R2 but had an unusual, frosted dome, and included a Burtt acoustic signaller.

Tenara was a planet that was located in the Tenara system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector, within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. A small hyperlane connected Tenara to the planet Korphir.

R4-D23 was an R4 astromech droid operating on Coruscant. He was a typical R4, but also wore a blue cone-shaped hat with star and moon shapes in its design and included black "ears." He was known to frequent the local droid spa for oil baths and recharging.
The Ming Po were a group of humans native to the Outer Rim planet Carlac.

The Shadow Raptor, originally known as the Eccentric Lad, was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate and the flagship of Alliance Intelligence operations in the Borderland Regions. General Airen Cracken and his crew liberated the vessel from the Galactic Empire at Contruum.

LE-LU979 was a female-programmed LE-series repair droid nicknamed Lelu. She was talkative, and the coordinates for the Alliance Intelligence flagship Shadow Raptor were encrypted deep in her memory banks.
Tund was a hidden planet located in the mysterious Tund system, within the Centrality sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in grid square U-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Frostwall Village was a small, low-tech city on the planet Spintir. It had about 300 inhabitants, not all of whom were permanent. In 0 ABY, they encountered a group of Force-sensitive individuals who were trying to restore the nearby Dawn Temple.

Bloom Fruit was a fruit regarded by the Witches of Dathomir for its ability to heighten senses when consumed. Herbalists of the witch clans further enhanced this effect by drying and preparing the fruit.

Milodons were non-sentient, centipede-like insects native to the caves of the planet Quarzite, where they were used as mounts by the indigenous Kage. They could also be found on Hissrich, where one attacked Jedi Masters Kit Fisto and Prosset Dibs during the Clone Wars.
The Ivax Syndicate was a secretive criminal enterprise, led by Voras the Hutt, that originated in the Ivax Nebula, its namesake, and operated within the Anoat sector.

The Blood Bone Order was a pirate gang led by Captain Lassa Rhayme that operated during the Clone Wars and reign of the Galactic Empire, where they became a food and weapons supplier for a subgroup of the mainly extinct Partisans known as the Dreamers.

The Rang Clan, sometimes referred to as the Rangs, was a crime family that was active during the Clone Wars and the Galactic Civil War. The Volpai Moregi embezzled from the group, leading the clan to place a hefty bounty on his head.

Desilijic, also known as the Desilijic Tiure clan, or the Tiure family, was an influential Hutt kajidic. Jabba Desilijic Tiure, head of his crime family, had the Desilijic's tattoo carved on his right arm.

Kachirho was a coastal Wookiee settlement located in the Wawaatt Archipelago of Kashyyyk. According to the Galactic Atlas, it served as the planet's capital. In truth, however, the city of Rwookrrorro held that title.

Sugi's bounty hunters, also known as Sugi's crew, was a cadre of noble bounty hunters and mercenaries led by the Zabrak Sugi during the Clone Wars. Members of the cadre included Embo, Rumi Paramita, and Seripas.

The Lucky Lekku was a Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry that participated in various battles during the Clone Wars. In service of the Galactic Republic, it would be utilized fighting against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Vigilance was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer active after the Battle of Yavin leading a fleet which included Helix Squadron. Under orders from Darth Vader, the fleet participated in the Battle at Fostar Haven to destroy the Alderaanian refugee convoy.
The Escape, previously known as the Farbrooke's Hope, was a small freighter that belonged to former Confederate General Kleeve, who became a smuggler on Lahn after the Clone Wars.
Cosians were a species of long-lived sentient reptilian humanoids from Cosia. Jedi Master Tera Sinube was a Cosian who served the Jedi Order from the High Republic Era to the Clone Wars.

Cavetroopers were a variant of stormtroopers who were trained to operate in various cave-like geographical areas. They used a lighter version of armor, similar to that of scout troopers and carried blaster carbines and long-bladed vibroknives.

PZ-4CO, pronounced "Peazy-Fourseeo" and nicknamed "Peazy," was a PZ protocol droid who was designed to resemble the Tofallid species. PZ-4CO also served in the Resistance during its struggle against the First Order approximately three decades after the Battle of Endor.
Anoat was a planet located in the Anoat system of the Outer Rim Territories. It was once a sprawling city-world that, as seat of the Nothoiin Noble Court, was the capital of the Anoat sector.

The Carbon Score Cantina was a cantina located on the planet Burnin Konn. "Happy" Dapp conducted operations with Riley and her sibling from the cantina. The Data Seeker Dazur Dar maintained a presence in the cantina.
The Konn-Nevos Spaceport was a spaceport located on Burnin Konn.
The Longstar Marketplace was a market located on the planet Burnin Konn.

BX-2R, or Toor, was a renovated BX-series droid commando assigned to janitorial work at Moff Lasre Dardano's Whisper Base. Toor was fitted with a restraining bolt and was responsible for cleaning the garage and filing reports.
The First Order riot control stormtrooper, also called simply the riot control stormtrooper, was a specialized variant of the standard stormtrooper of the First Order.
The Finalizer was a Resurgent-class Star Destroyer of the naval forces of the First Order. It served as the flagship of General Armitage Hux and Kylo Ren.

Resistance troopers, also known as the Resistance infantry and Resistance soldiers, were Resistance personnel trained as army ground troops. In existence approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor, the soldiers relied on hit-and-run tactics.

The First Order heavy trooper, also called the megablaster heavy assault trooper—so named for the FWMB-10 repeating blaster or "megablaster" that they carried—was a variant of the standard stormtrooper used by the First Order.
First Order snowtroopers were a variant of the stormtrooper used by the First Order thirty years after the Battle of Endor. They wore insulated armor and helmets designed for cold weather.
ME-8D9, also known as Emmie, was an ancient protocol droid who resided in Takodana Castle on Takodana for many years. Once known to be an assassin, the droid later served criminals as a translator.
Takodana was a remote, neutral planet located in the Mid Rim, though it fell in the southwestern region of the galaxy known as the Western Reaches.

The Guavian Death Gang, also known as the Guavian gang, was a criminal organization in operation roughly thirty years after the Battle of Endor. The pirate gang was driven out of the Core Worlds due to unrest in the galactic underworld after the collapse of the Galactic Empire.
Kanjiklub, also known as the Kanji Gang, was a notorious criminal organization that operated in the Outer Rim Territories. The gang was active by the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The Council of Three was the leadership of Mandroxan in the Portmoak sector. The triumvirate of crime bosses during the era of the New Republic was Artur Manliss, Sehvorah and Parmella Trillidor.
Oilcan was a droid member of a Bleeder gang located in the Red Light Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.

The Alien Outreach Center was a small enclave in the High Security Lockdown sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa. Inhabited by alien refugees, it also served as a recon outpost for agents of the Republic Strategic Information Service.
Hanna City was the capital of the planet Chandrila. During the New Republic Era, the city was a beacon of the New Republic and briefly served as its capital.

Valentia was the capital city of the planet Jelucan. It was situated atop a mountain. Its buildings, some of which were ten to fifteen stories high, were carved into the pale white stone of cliffs. The buildings stretched along the side of the mountain for some distance.
The Liberty was a MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser of the MC80 Star Cruiser line that served in the Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

objective: Monitoring Galactic Empire activity in the Outer Rim Territories
x: During the Galactic Civil War in 4 ABY, the New Republic pilot Captain Wedge Antilles undertook a mission to the planet Akiva in the Outer Rim Territories to spy on the Galactic Empire that had gathered for an Emergency summit on Akiva where they intended to regroup and launch…
The New Republic Senate, also known as the Galactic Senate, Galactic Congress, High Senate and early on as the Provisional Senate, was the legislative assembly of the New Republic.

Kylo Ren's command shuttle was an Upsilon-class command shuttle utilized by Kylo Ren, who was a leader of the Knights of Ren and a warlord of the First Order around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.

result: General Jylia Shale and Adviser Yupe Tashu are captured
Akiva is liberated from Imperial rule and becomes the first Outer Rim
x: The rebellion on Akiva took place on the planet Akiva during the Galactic Civil War, months after the Battle of Endor. The rebellion was waged on the surface and in space over the Outer Rim planet Akiva, between the New Republic and the Galactic Empire.
The Isatabith rain forest, also known as the Isatabith forest, was located on the Core World of Alderaan and partially shared its name with Isatabith falls.

The Cloudshape Falls were waterfalls located on the planet of Alderaan. Quiggold lived luxuriously at Cloudshape Falls on the planet from his comfy rooms, fooling the innocent and stashing credits until the Empire eventually caught up with him.

The Imperial Coalition, also known as Palpatine's alliance, was an alliance between the Ruling Circle and remaining fleet commanders who remained loyal to the former Galactic Empire which had largely collapsed following the Liberation of Coruscant in 6 ABY.
Anthan Prime, also known as Anthan, was a gas giant located in the Anthan system of the Outer Rim Territories' Braxant sector. It was connected by hyperspace route to the planets Bastion and Bescane.

Sesid, the homeworld of the Draedan species, was an aquatic planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was a popular tourist destination, and many vacationers traveled across the galaxy to visit its tropical islands.

Kothlis was an astronomical object located in the Kothlis system within Bothan Space in the Mid Rim. Luke Skywalker was stationed on Kothlis during the conclusion of Princess Leia Organa's involvement in Operation Yellow Moon.
The Imperial Survey Corps (ISC), also known as the Survey and Exploration Corps, was an branch of the Galactic Empire's military whose duty was the exploration of the galaxy.

Venom-mites were venomous arthropods. While on Draboon at the time of the Mandalorian Civil War, Satine Kryze and Obi-Wan Kenobi were attacked by a swarm of venom-mites, resulting in Kenobi having to carry Kryze to safety.
Miser was the innermost planet of the Bespin system. Cloud City, which floated in the habitable atmosphere of the gas giant Bespin, was constructed from materials mined on Miser.

Ugnorgrad was a city built by the Ugnaughts as one of the floating habitats in the thin band of atmosphere surrounding the gas giant Bespin. Located on the Ugnaught Surface, the colony was ruled by King Ozz around the time of the Battle of Endor.

Gnuda was a Hutt kajidic. Long before the Galactic Civil War, the Gnudas owned a luxurious estate on Mataou, in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Gnuda were among the Hutt patrons of the privateer Sidon Ithano.

The Anklebiter Brigade was a group of youngsters on Coruscant who provided information to the Rebel Alliance and assaulted Imperial positions for control of the CoCo Town area after the Battle of Endor. Their members included Jak, Streaks, and Iggs.

The Perlemian Cartel was a crime syndicate active in the Outer Rim Territories. The Cartel controlled multiple star systems by the time of the Clone Wars fought between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, which marked worlds as neutral during the …

Jogan-bats were a type of bat that shared part of their name with jogan fruit. When the junk dealer Temmin Wexley launched a speeder bike out of the bay doors of the MK-4 freighter Moth during the rebellion on the planet Akiva in 4 ABY, it was comparable to a jogan-bat with it…

Tokmia was a planet located in the Anoat sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Figg Excavations mined the world for crystals, though they eventually abandoned it, leaving behind some crystals guarded by a still-active security system.

Gutretee, also known as Isis, was a planet in the Gutretee system in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Special crystals with sensor- and communication-dampening effects could be found on that world.
First Order stormtroopers, also known simply as stormtroopers or "bucketheads," were the infantry soldiers of the First Order, a fascist neo-Imperialist military junta.
Cratertown was a town located on the planet Jakku. It was the location of Ergel's Bar.

5251977 was a small planet so obscure that it had not been given a name besides its numerical designation. It was located in the Outer Rim Territories in grid square P-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The morning after the Galactic Civil War's Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, a Rebel Alliance strike team—the Pathfinders—carried out an assault on an Imperial outpost on the moon Endor.

The Xanadu Blood was a modified Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter owned by the Duros bounty hunter Cad Bane. The Xanadu Blood was given to Cad Bane by Darth Sidious as payment for his theft of a holocron and the kyber memory crystal as well as his usual rate times three.
Y 4 was the designation of a two-seat model BTL-S3 Y-wing Starfighter that belonged to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Nothoiin was a planet in the Nothoiin system in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It had a moon on which ur-diamonds were mined. During the Iron Blockade, a makeshift medical center on Nothoiin had to resort to smugglers to acquire supplies from Gerrenthum.

Zeitooine was a jungle planet located in the Inner Rim's Zeitooine system that was ruled by a monarchy. At some point by the time of the High Republic Era, several Jedi fell during the Zeitooine Schism.

Flametroopers were a variant of Imperial stormtrooper equipped with incendiary weapons. In the Imperial Era, they were deployed to Kashyyyk and Agaris to defend Imperial facilities against native fauna.
Around 0 ABY the planet of Anoat was gassed by the Galactic Empire. A group of dissidents were known to have been present on Anoat, but the Empire could not find their camp.
The South Sector Sinners, nicknamed Southies, was a criminal organization operating on the planet Burnin Konn. It employed thugs and hoodlums.
B9-DT was a black and red astromech droid owned and used by the Galactic Empire. The droid contained a series of maps and Imperial transmissions.

The Thradians were a species of humanoid sentients from Thrad. They had yellow skin, full black eyes, and annulated appendages that grew from the top of their skulls. Senator Nadea Tural was a female Thradian.

Vrogas Vas was a planet located in Outer Rim Territories. It had no known native life forms and large amounts of gaseous emissions, and it housed the Jedi Temple in which Jedi Master Phin-Law Wo was stationed.
Gentes was a planet located in the Anoat system in the Anoat sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the sentient Ugnaught species, which fed on the native genteslugs.

Millius Prime was one of the thousand moons that orbited the planet Iego and the homeworld of the Diathim. During the Clone Wars, the moon was conquered by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, which installed the primary node of a LaserWeb Defense Station on its surface.

The Imperial Future Council (IFC) was a group of high ranking officials of the Galactic Empire who attended a summit on the planet Akiva in aftermath of the Battle of Endor to decide the future of the Empire.

Aiwhas, also called air whales, were a non-sentient species of winged cetaceans native to the planet Kamino. They were used as mounts by the Kaminoans. Kaminoans were derogatorily referred to as "aiwha-bait" by the clone troopers.
Wraith Squadron was an Imperial squadron that was wiped out by the Rogue Shadow some time before or during 1 BBY.

The Shrikes was an Alliance to Restore the Republic special recon unit named after a bird of prey and led by Lieutenant Caluan Ematt. Their mission was to identify, secure and prepare new locations for the Alliance.

Ottegans were a cousin species to the Ithorians a race of Hammerhead shaped beings from the Ottega system. Praster Ommlen, an devotee of the Sacred Order of Ramulus was a member of the species. As was the criminal Ola Hest who was active during the High Republic Era.

Bodach'i were a species of sentient, pale-skinned reptiles. They had a tail and scaly skin. Following the rise of the Galactic Empire, the Bodach'i showed open defiance towards the regulations established by that new regime.

Endor, also called Tana by the Ewoks native to one of its moons, was a gas giant located in the Endor system, a binary star system positioned in the Moddell sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Tuanul was a settlement on the planet Jakku located in Kelvin Ravine. It was populated by members of the Church of the Force, who eschewed modern technology and instead created their own in order to bring themselves more in touch with nature.

Mordal was a terrestrial world situated in the Illisurevimurasi sector's Mordal system of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories. During the Galactic Civil War in 4 ABY, the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance fought a battle on Mordal.
Maborn was a city on the Outer Rim world Mordal. During the Galactic Civil War, in 4 ABY, a firefight in Maborn took place between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Hutta Town was the capital of the ecumenopolis moon Nar Shaddaa. It consisted of huge tower blocks that thrust up into the brown polluted air of the moon, with every available space between the structures filled with teetering shanty towns known as skyslums.
Approximately a decade before the Clone Wars, a group of usurpers on the planet Halcyon abducted the planetary leadership and held them hostage in a remote location.
Anthan 13 was a moon that orbited the planet Anthan Prime.
Anthan 14 was a moon that orbited the planet Anthan Prime.
The Remembrance was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate active within the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

The Ranolfo was a Rebel Alliance blockade runner active during the Galactic Civil War. Prior to the Battle of Endor, it was part of an Alliance Fleet convoy tasked with protecting Princess Leia Organa, one of the Rebellion's leaders.
Zastiga was a planet in the Zastiga system in the Kallea sector on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories, frequented by traders.
The Anthan Spire, also known simply as the Spire, was a city that hovered within the planet Anthan Prime in the Outer Rim Territories.

The Alliance High Command, also known as Alliance Command, Rebel Command, Rebel Alliance High Command, Rebel Council, Alliance Council, Rebel Alliance's ruling council, Alliance's ruling council, Rebellion Command, or the Rebel Alliance command, was the leadership council of t…

B-U4D, nicknamed "Buford," was a heavy loader droid active approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor, serving as part of the Resistance. B-U4D was a burly loading droid clad in yellow ceramic armor plate.

Garos was a terrestrial planet located in the Garos system in the Msst sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square P-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the location of a university and Imperial facility five years after the Clone Wars.
The Saurin were a species of sentient reptiles from the planet of Durkteel, in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. They had imposing, jagged teeth, knobby skin, and ridges along the length of their heads.

Durkteel was an agricultural planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim that was the homeworld of the reptilian Saurin species. Durkteel was also the homeworld of Mattis Banz, a Force-sensitive human who joined the Resistance.

The Government District was a region of Lonisa City on the planet Valo. During the High Republic Era, when Valo fell under attack from the Nihil, Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram was arrested while attempting to alert the Starlight Beacon about the attack.
The Agrilat was a location that was composed of crystal forests. It was a spot of swoop racing.
The Ruloosian sand-snake was a species from the Ruloosia system.
The Valley of Extinction was a dark valley on the mysterious Wellspring of Life, the world from which midi-chlorians and life itself were born.

The churi was a large avian native to Endor, a forested moon orbiting a planet of the same name. Logray, the shaman of the Ewok Bright Tree Village, wore a headdress made from the skull of a churi and his apprentice Teebo wore churi feathers atop a gurreck skull headdress.
The Tyrant was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy. Under the command of Captain Lennox, it served as part of Darth Vader's personal fleet, Death Squadron.
The Council of Elders, also known as the Treeta Dobra, was the ruling body of each Ewok tribe. In 4 ABY, Chief Chirpa headed the council of the Bright Tree tribe.
The species to which the Jedi Grand Master Yoda belonged was ancient and shrouded in mystery. Members of this species were rarely seen anywhere in the galaxy.

Whip-snakes were a type of snake known for being smart. While on the Outer Rim planet Akiva in 4 ABY, the woman Shirene, the sister-in-law of New Republic pilot Norra Wexley, compared the intelligence of Norra's son Temmin Wexley to that of a whip-snake while the ladies spoke …

Swamp buffalo were a type of swamp creature that were dangerous, but not necessarily effective, when gathered in large numbers. In 4 ABY, the former Imperial Sinjir Rath Velus compared stormtroopers to swamp buffalo during an argument with the bounty hunter Jas Emari.

Rullag was an astronomical object located in the Cadma sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Dark Jedi Nax Cirvan claimed to have killed eight Jedi and their Padawans on the plains of Rullag during the Clone Wars.
Nea Dajanam was an astronomical object in the Nea Dajanam system of the Sern sector in the Colonies and the Interior.

The Subjugator was a Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. In 4 ABY, the ship was part of the Imperial fleet over the moon of Endor, defending the Empire's battle station, the second Death Star.

Assassin-spiders were a species of spider distinguished by the phosphorescent skull pattern located on their thorax. They were capable of spitting venom and creating webbing which they could dangle from.
The Hasamadhi Warehouse District was a vast district on the planet Coruscant. It was in close proximity to the Southern Underground.

BALK1 was the designation of an Imperial Viper probe droid that was captured by the New Republic and repurposed for their use. After the New Republic became suspicious of Imperial activity on the planet Akiva, the probe droid was sent to gather data.
Juntar was the homeworld of New Republic Special Forces sergeant major Jom Barell, located in the Core Worlds.

Brain slugs or brain-slugs, were a species of slugs that hailed from Nusa Sept V. They had mouths and tongues, but lacked eyes. The commonly used phrase "like stealing slime from a brain-slug" meant that something was very easy.

Verkles were tusked, brown-and-white furred rodents that lived on the forest moon of Endor. The sentient inhabitants of Endor, the Ewoks, sometimes hunted verkles for their meat or to be used as bait.
The Galactic Empire carried out a massacre on Kashyyyk, the home planet of the Wookiee species, at some point before the Battle of Endor.

The Emperor's Throne Room was a room reserved for Darth Sidious, the Galactic Emperor of the Galactic Empire aboard the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station. It was located at the pinnacle of the Emperor's Tower in the north pole of the battle station.
The holding room of the second Death Star was a waiting area that was connected to Emperor Palpatine's throne room by an elevator.
Draedans were a species of sentient humanoids native to the aquatic planet of Sesid. They had green skin, red eyes, and sharp teeth, and were known for having large families.
An elephoth was a massive, quadrupedal creature with a pair of tusks, green and thick hide, small red eyes, and two greenish trunks, covered with moss and vines.

Boar-wolves, also known as borras, were non-sentient, bristle-backed creatures that lived on Endor, a forested moon that orbited the planet of the same name. Boar-wolves had thick hair, humped backs, and and two tusks.

result: Rebel Alliance gains intelligence on the Imperial Fleet
Imperial Navy sets a trap for Endor
x: The dogfight in the Hudalla system, also known as the raid on the Hudalla system, occurred around 4 ABY shortly before the Battle of Endor when the Rebel Alliance discovered a meeting of the Imperial Navy.
Kiros birds, also known as just Kiros, were a beautiful, regal, and elegant species of small bird native to the planet Kiros. They were highly intelligent and capable of understanding conversations.

Hesten were large-eared primates that lived on the planet Balnab. They were often trapped in nets by castaways on the planet. Hesten had white and blue fur. They had six limbs in total, four of them being arms with hands that included three long fingers each.

Cyrkon was a toxic planet located in the Outer Rim Territories, on the edge of Hutt Space. In the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin, Lieutenant Caluan Ematt of the Alliance to Restore the Republic went into hiding on Cyrkon after escaping an ambush by the Galactic Empire on Taa…
The Vehement was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in service of the Imperial Navy. Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, it was under the command of Captain Hove.
Motok was the largest city and de facto capital of Cyrkon, a planet located on the edge of Hutt Space.

The Ailon Military Ceremonies was an annual event undertaken by the Ailon Nova Guard. The event was widely covered by galactic news sources and included holofeatures, fireworks, laser displays, flying displays, mock battles, feasts, parades, and festivals.

A battle occurred when the Ansarra Rebel base, an Alliance to Restore the Republic starfighter base, came under attack by a Star Destroyer, a capital ship of the Galactic Empire. The attack occurred prior to the Destruction of the Death Star.

Carrier butterflies were tiny insects native to the planet Maridun. They could also be found on Saleucami and Daro. They were often used as messengers as they were able to listen to their owners' instructions and deliver messages to allies.
Ghomrassen was one of the three moons of Tatooine, along with Guermessa and Chenini.
Guermessa was one of the three moons of the planet Tatooine, along with Ghomrassen and Chenini.

Chenini was one of the three moons of the planet Tatooine, along with Guermessa and Ghomrassen. Chenini and its parent planet were located in the Tatoo system, a binary star system located in the Arkanis sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The findsmen (singular: findsman) were a Force-sensitive mystic tradition of the Gand species that dated back centuries before the Galactic Civil War on their fog-shrouded homeworld of Gand. Findsmen were known for their uncanny tracking skills.
The Sand Splitter Cave was a cave located on the planet Tatooine, west of the Western Dune Sea and south of the Valley of the Winds.
The Akiva Summit was an emergency summit held on the Outer Rim world of Akiva between some of the most powerful figures remaining in the Galactic Empire a few months after the Battle of Endor.

Besadii was a Hutt kajidic, and one of the most powerful families of the Hutt Clan. Some of its members included Gardulla Besadii the Elder and Arok, the latter of whom had the symbol of the kajidic tattooed on his upper left arm.

The Agrelcu Haalta, which could be translated as the Aggressive Defender in Basic, was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served as the flagship of Troonol. It was the command ship of a Qunaalac fleet that patrolled the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space.

775519 was a T-6 shuttle used by Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas around the time of the Invasion of Naboo. It was shot down over the moon of Oba Diah, killing Sifo-Dyas whereas Silman survived to be imprisoned by the Pyke Syndicate, and its remains were later discovered by the clone tro…
HK-51 was an individual HK-51 series assassin droid manufactured by Czerka Corporation shortly before the end of the Great Galactic War.
Darrastead was a village with about 100 inhabitants on Onderon. It was led by elders. The villagers were often used as laborers by the Imperials from Whisper Base.
Lathir was a Rebel Alliance cruiser that acted as a command vessel. It was one of the closest to Onderon, and was used to transfer prisoners captured from Whisper Base.
The Nothoiin cartel was a criminal organization based on Bendeluum, in the Anoat sector. It ran independently from the larger crime organizations of the sector.

The Tarsunt were a species of furry sentients from the planet of the same name. They were represented by Senator Colandrus in the Galactic Republic, and by Lanever Villecham in the New Republic; the latter went on to serve as chancellor in the New Republic Senate until his dea…

CZ-1 was a tutor droid named after its model. It was owned by the Kyrell family, who resided on the planet Jelucan. Its primary function was to tutor Thane Kyrell as a child during the years after the Galactic Empire was formed.

Mister Bones, also simply referred to as Bones, was a heavily modified B1-series battle droid with a murderous personality. He was constructed by Temmin Wexley and built from components the boy scavenged from the catacombs beneath Myrra, the capital city of Akiva.
The Time of Panic was the name given to the months after the Imperial invasion of the planet Derilyn in the Elrood sector.
Andal's Dream was the personal yacht of Moff Villis Andal, governor of the Elrood sector. He used it to travel across the galaxy, engaging in big game hunting with his wealthy friends.

Silverbacks were a subspecies of the sentient Wookiee species on Kashyyyk. Two silverbacks were Wullffwarro and his son Kitwarr, who were taken into slavery by the Galactic Empire before being rescued by the Spectres.
The Military Oversight Committee was a committee of the Galactic Senate that had oversight over the Republic Military during the Clone Wars. Roonan Senator Aang held the deciding vote in the group.
The High City of Refuge was a metropolis on the planet Kidron. It was surrounded by a thirty-meter wall and topped by a reinforced transparisteel dome. It was ruled over by the City High Council.

The Viscount was a Star Destroyer in use by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Participating in the Pacification of Salline sometime in between 2 and 0 BBY, the Viscount released dropships down to the planet, carrying the AT-ATs Hammer six and eight, as well as…
An urda was a beast of burden native to the planet Jaresh.

The Grand Temple's throne room was a ceremonial hall located within the Great Temple, on Yavin 4. On the morning after the Battle of Yavin, the throne room housed the Royal Award Ceremony, during which heroes of the Alliance to Restore the Republic were saluted.
The Insidious was a Gladiator-class Star Destroyer in service to the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Period.
The Admonition was a MC30c frigate used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Eclipse was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought in service of the Galactic Empire. It also served as the flagship of Emperor Sheev Palpatine during the Age of the Empire.
Dressellians were a species of sentient humanoids that were native to Dressel. They lived in peaceful isolation from any conflict until the Galactic Civil War.

Abednedos were a sentient species native to the planet of the same name in the Colonies region of the Galaxy. Abednedo were humanoid and mammalian, and their face featured dangling mouth tendrils and two fleshy nostrils.
The Battle of Ogoth Tiir was fought by the military of the Galactic Empire. In the aftermath of the battle, Imperial General Hurst Romodi took reconstruction initiatives.
The Deep Dark was a Skywatcher-class deep space scout ship that served in the Imperial Scout Corps during the Galactic Civil War.

The Tsevukans were a sentient, if ferocious, species that hailed from the planet of Tsevuka, in the Outer Rim Territories. They rode meters-tall creatures called kivaroa. After the Galactic Empire took possession of their home planet, the Tsevukans attempted to resist.

Sephi were a humanoid sentient species, found on both Isobe and Thustra in the Thustra system, who boasted long life and an affinity with droids and machinery. They had long tapered ears that could twitch, swivel and flatten in accordance with the emotional state of the subject.

The Crimson Kreehawks was a gang of criminals and disenfranchised youth that was based on the city of Jorra on the planet Cato Neimoidia. Their activities ranged from dealing spice to extortion, and they were loyal to the Whitescar Syndicate.
The Whitescar Syndicate was the most powerful criminal mafia on Cato Neimoidia in the wake of the Clone Wars. The cartel unofficially controlled the city of Jorra, as well as across the star system.

Jorra was a city on the planet Cato Neimoidia. It was separated by a massive bridge; the upper portion of the bridge consisted of residences and other skyscrapers, while the lower portion of the bridge contained run-down buildings and was classified as off-limits and uninhabit…

Defiant Core was a base established on Innton II, a planet near the Triton system. It had been built out of a previous Separatist base that had been made using parts salvaged parts from a Recusant-class light destroyer, Nova Defiant, that had crashed on the planet.

Capra was a city located on the planet Kinyen along the Saeduree River. It was home to the planet's spaceport. A speakeasy in the city was located between an electronics repair shop and a fabric shop, and was one of the only places to obtain alcohol on the planet.

Malthee was a city on the planet Kinyen. After the Gran refused to give in to the Empire's demands to increase food production and request for more access to Kinyen, the Empire bombarded the heavily populated city, leaving a crater in its place.

The Battle of Cawa City was fought during the Galactic Civil War when the Alliance to Restore the Republic fought to liberate Sterdic IV from the shattered Galactic Empire. It took place seventeen days after the Battle of Endor and resulted in a Rebel victory.

Bobbie was a WA-7 waitress droid who worked aboard the Miss Fortune, a bar/starship based on Cyrkon. She featured a built-in order transmitter that kept her in touch with the kitchen at all times, and a paired set of repulsor stabilizers helped her maintain balance as she went…

Lanniks were bipedal humanoids with droopy, long ears that were native to the planet Lannik. With a long history of war, the Lannik people revered bravery and courage as personal traits. Jedi Master Even Piell was a member of this species.

result: Beltire liberated by the Rebel Alliance
x: In 4 ABY, the Beltire Liberation was carried out by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War when it liberated the Mid Rim location Beltire. During the event, rebel pilot Lieutenant Shara Bey flew assist for Rampant Squadron.

The Victory at Endor was a New Republic assault frigate during the Galactic Civil War. It served in the Bothan Combat Response Element and fought in the Battle of Kathol System, in which it assisted in the defeat of Moff Kentor Sarne.

The Ast'ria was a New Republic CR90 corvette during the Galactic Civil War. It served in the Bothan Combat Response Element and fought in the Battle of Kathol System, in which it assisted in the defeat of Moff Kentor Sarne.

Hutt's Ambition was a New Republic bulk cruiser during the Galactic Civil War. It served in the Bothan Combat Response Element and fought in the Battle of Kathol System, in which it assisted in the defeat of Moff Kentor Sarne.

The Resistance was a New Republic DP20 gunship during the Galactic Civil War. It served in the Bothan Combat Response Element and fought in the Battle of Kathol System, in which it assisted in the defeat of Moff Kentor Sarne.

Bogwings were a reptavian species native to the planet Naboo. During Gulliball games played by Gungans, bogwings were released into the sky to signal halftime. Bogwings were known to be able to carry nine times their own weight. They were also very territorial.
Xandu were an aerial mammavian species native to the planet Iego. They were one of many predators native to the world. They could hunt and carry prey as large as a human.

Basteel was a frigid and mountainous planet located in the Corva sector. It had almost no flat ground and little vegetation. Its inhabitants lived in subterranean cities, like its capital, Eladro City.

As a result of the Azzameen family's actions against the Galactic Empire and the Imperial-aligned trading company Viraxo Industries, a competitor to the Azzameens' Twin Suns Transport Services trading company, the Galactic Empire issued warrants for the arrest of the members o…

The Azzameen family conducted a mission to recapture the family datacore, which had been discarded and transported to Junkyard Control from their home, the orbital station Azzameen Home Base, following the station's capture by the Galactic Empire.

As part of the Rebel Alliance's efforts to build their forces for an eventual battle against the forces of the Galactic Empire, a meeting between the Alliance and the Bothan Borsk Fey'lya, leader of the Bothan Spynet, was arranged.
After a mercenary group interrupted a meeting between Alliance forces and the Bothan Spynet, the Alliance wished to locate the aggressors responsible for the attack.
The Volt Cobra was the personal starship of the bounty hunter Sana Starros. She used it numerous times to carry goods and assist her friends in the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

An acid spider was a dangerous type of spider that existed on the planet Tython. Lanoree Brock once woke from a dream on Tython and thought of the dangerous wildlife in the foothills of Talss, such as these spiders and flame tygahs, but she knew that she would sense them throu…

Clan Wren, also known as the Wren clan, was a Mandalorian clan that was a vassal of House Vizsla. Clan Wren was led by Countess Ursa Wren and consisted of her husband Alrich Wren, their son Tristan, and their daughter Sabine, and was composed of Mandalorian warriors that donne…

A creature could be found on the planet of Naboo. Members of this non-sentient species of creature lived in the swamps of Naboo and were kept in some of the decorative pools and canals of Theed's gardens.

Tinnel IV, also known as Tinnel, was an ancient, conservative planet located in the Tinnel system in the Quanta sector of Core Worlds, along the Corellian Run. Tinnel IV was the homeworld of Jothan Tiaan Jerjerrod, Jax Jerjerrod, and Tiaan Jerjerrod.
The First Coruscani Migration was an event that took place sometime before the skirmish in the Temple of Eedit.
Shrikes were a species of birds of prey. They gave their name to a special recon unit in the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

objective: Escort Rebel agents
x: Mission to Giju was a mission launched by the Rebel Alliance to rescue underground rebel leaders from the planet Giju before Imperial agents arrived.

Slakari-hound were hounds that fed on rotten carcasses. While in the gas giant Bespin's Cloud City in 4 ABY, the wealthy Onderonian Jintar Oarr tried to convince fellow Onderonian and Imperial loyalist Borgin Kaa to stand down when rebels raided his residence for access to a c…

Whilks were a species of non-sentient, long-legged critters. They were farmed for their milk and their hides, which made for fine leather. Their meat, however, had a ropy consistence. Their babies were referred to as whilk calves.

Far Hiradne was an area on the planet Lothal. It was known in the days before the Galactic Empire for its forests with trees that could be tapped for greel-wood syrup. The elderly poet named Holshef's first job was as a sap collector in Far Hiradne.

Pelamir Gorge was a gorge found on the planet Lothal. It was known for its forests filled with spine trees. Holshef, an elderly poet, wrote poetry about his recollections of the trees. His artistic expressions made him wanted by the Galactic Empire.

t: Skirmish aboard a Rebel ship of the line
x: In 3 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, there was a skirmish aboard a Rebel ship of the line when Admiral Damon Krell sent an Infiltrator probe droid to trap and attack Luke Skywalker.

Veknoids were a sentient species that were distinguishable by their large under-bites, sharp teeth, slender tails, and fleshy ears that were positioned on the tops of their heads. One famous Veknoid was Teemto Pagalies, a flamboyant Podracer pilot from Moonus Mandel.
