During the later years of the Clone Wars, a battle took place on the Outer Rim planet Akiva that saw Galactic Republic forces attack a Separatist droid factory.
R7-A7 was an astromech droid who belonged to Ahsoka Tano. During the Clone Wars, he served in the astromech socket of her various starfighters whenever she flew in combat.
Starwhales (also spelled star-whales) were oceanic creatures that could be found on Uthura. Zev Senesca, a pilot with the Alliance to Restore the Republic, used to hunt starwhales with a harpoon.
Ikopis were a mammalian species of non-sentient, long-legged herbivores that could be found on the grass plains and turf of the planet Naboo. Ikopis were also found on a ocean planet.
The pikobis were a species of small, non-sentient, fast-moving reptavian that were native to Naboo and could also be found on many other planets.

Shistavanen were a species of sentient fur-covered bipeds with wolflike faces, clawed paws, and glowing yellow or red eyes. Their homeworld was the planet Uvena Prime. One Shistavanen was Odabba, who worked for Garello Technologies during the High Republic Era.
Motts were a species of non-sentient, horn-nosed herbivorous mammals found on the planet of Naboo. They fed off swamp vegetation.

Imperial Army troopers, also identified as Imperial Army soldiers and casually known as "army regulars," were infantry soldiers deployed by the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire throughout the galaxy during the Imperial Era.
Joopas, or joopa worms, were a non-sentient species of giant, worm-like creatures that lived below the surface of the dusty planet Seelos and could grow to be 21 meters in length.
Cawa City was a city located on Sterdic IV. Seventeen days after the Battle of Endor, the forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic liberated Cawa City from the Galactic Empire.
Sterdic IV, also known as Sterdic Four, or simply as Sterdic, was a planet located in the Ryndellian sector of the Mid Rim Territories, on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories.
Resolute Base was a Rebel Alliance base located on the humid planet Jagomir. The base was established in 0 BBY after the Alliance forces were driven from their base on Arda I by Imperial forces.
Night-beetles were a species of beetle native to the planet Ganthel. During the Battle of Endor, Admiral Rae Sloane of the Galactic Empire likened the firefight to night-beetles in Ganthel's outback.
Seelos was a remote desert planet in the star system of the same name in the Kwymar sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Andelm IV, also known simply as Andelm, was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, the planet was ruled by Jaum, a crime lord.

DDM-38, also referred to as DDM or DeeDee, was a droid with feminine programming that served General Brendol Hux at the Imperial academy on Arkanis. The droid continued serving Hux after he joined the First Order, a remnant of the Old Empire.
The Andelm beetle caverns were a series of caverns located underground on the planet Andelm IV. Indigenous Andelm beetles inhabited the caverns.
This city was located on the planet Andelm IV.
Q'anah's Marauders were a pirate group that was active during the later years of the Twilight of the Republic.
Z9 was a masculine-programmed R5 series astromech droid who served the Galactic Republic and belonged to Admiral Wilhuff Tarkin during the Clone Wars.

Stepson's Gorge was a narrow, craggy pass on the planet Jelucan. The gorge contained a large number of waterfalls, which flowed even during winter when the pass iced over, although often just as a trickle.
The Sky Loop was a running track located high on the roof of the Royal Imperial Academy on the planet Coruscant.
Shaaks were a bulbous mammalian species of non-sentient herbivores that grazed on the grasslands of Naboo, and were bred on other planets as well.

Nar Hypa was the barren and desolate desert moon of Mataou located in the Mataou system, Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Long before the Galactic Civil War, Nar Hypa served as a trading hub and spaceport for the Hutts.

Harbinger was a Star Destroyer of the Tector-class in service to the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. In 4 ABY, it was the sole Tector-class in the Imperial fleet defending the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station over the Forest Moon of Endor.

The Garrote was an attack cruiser of the Imperial Navy. After the Battle of Jakku, the cruiser was sent to hide in the Queluhan Nebula along with other ships belonging to the remnants of the Galactic Empire. Commander Nash Windrider was promoted as the Garrote's Flight Commander.

JJH2 was an astromech droid model of the same name who was active during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Colored in purple and black, JJH2 was a crew member of the Mighty Oak Apocalypse, a freighter owned by the Wookiee captain Lohgarra.
JJH2 models were series of astromech droids which at least one notable model served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Rebel Marksmen, also known as Rebel Sharpshooters or rebel snipers, were snipers who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. They carried carried E-17d sniper rifles.

Rakazzak beasts were massive eight-limbed creatures that were tamed and ridden by the sentient Yuzzum native to the moon Endor.
The Eternal Flagship was a capital ship that served as the flagship of the Eternal Fleet under the command of Arcann, Prince and later Emperor of the Eternal Empire.

The Gree were a little-known alien species with tentacles who were native to the Gree system of the Gree Enclave in the Outer Rim Territories. They also shared their name with the Outer Rim astronomical object Gree.
The Stalgasin hive was a major hive that controlled all other major hives on the planet Geonosis on the Outer Rim of the galaxy. It was also the planet's capital.

Golbah hive was a major city on the planet Geonosis and a notable hive of the Geonosian species. It wielded huge influence over the world's political system—which included ten prime hives—but was eventually destroyed.

Darth Marr's flagship, also known as Darth Marr's frigate, was a Terminus-class destroyer that was used by the reconstituted Sith Empire's Dark Council member Darth Marr during the Galactic War while campaigning at Ziost and then later within Wild Space before it was destroyed…
The Antarra was a stolen Imperial Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by Commander Luke Skywalker of the Alliance to Restore the Republic to go on a mission to the planet Vetine to recover a Great Tree.

Rattatakian redjackets were creatures from Rattatak who lived in swarms and stung painfully.
Melchior 5 was a terrestrial astronomical object on which laser-pinball machines could be found. It was located in the Melchior system in the Zeemacht Cluster of the Inner Rim Territories.

Alderaanian wolf-cats were feral creatures from the planet of Alderaan. When she was forced to watch Han Solo being frozen into carbonite, Leia Organa figuratively felt like her insides were being torn apart by wolf-cats.

Vetine was a planet located in the Merrick sector within the Inner Rim Territories. It was the location of an Imperial base with a research lab containing the two remaining fragments of the Great Tree that Darth Sidious stole from the Jedi Temple after declaring himself Empero…

x: Operation Yellow Moon, also known as the mission to Yellow Moon, or simply as Yellow Moon, was an operation undertaken by Princess Leia Organa and a crew from the Alliance to Restore the Republic shortly before the Battle of Endor.
The Mellcrawler II was an Inyusu-class Star Yacht in the Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War. It was named after the Mellcrawler, the previous starship owned by Rebel pilot Nien Nunb.

x: In 4 BBY, the Galactic Empire launched an assault against rebel and former clone forces on the planet Seelos.

The Otolla were one of the two major races of the Gungan species. They were characterized by their tall and usually lanky bodies, longer haillus, prominent bills, and inquisitive eyes that sat up on short stalks. The Otolla were a younger race than the bulkier Ankura.

The Ankura were one of the two major races of the Gungan species, denoted by their shorter bill and haillu, hooded eyes, and stockier build. Despite their close cousin Gungans, the thin, lanky Otolla more well known across the galaxy, Ankurans were nonetheless an older race.

EG-4 was a EG-series power droid owned by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. While the Alliance was based in Echo Base on the planet Hoth, EG-4 provided power to the starships and machinery around the base.

K-3PO was a 3PO protocol droid who served as a captain in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was stationed at Echo Base on the ice planet Hoth, where he was charged with organizing the base's droidpool.

R5-M2 was an astromech droid who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. The droid was programmed to calculate optimal evacuation trajectories.
R-3PO, also known as "R-3," was a 3PO-series protocol droid with distinctive deep red plating, bright yellow “eye” sensors, and a moody attitude.
Abednedo was a planet located on the Corellian Run and in the Abednedo system of the galaxy's Colonies region.

Commenor was an ancient, conservative planet located in the Colonies region of the galaxy. It was located in the Commenor system along the Trellen Trade Route, and was an endpoint of the Commenor Run and the Quellor Run hyperspace routes.
RIC-920 was a brown-plated RIC-series general labor droid who worked as a rickshaw driver in the city of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine.

An Imperial outpost was located on the Forest Moon of Endor during the Battle of Endor. After the Galactic Empire was defeated during the battle, Imperial holdouts remained in the outpost in the hopes of launching a counterattack against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Pantoran guard was a group of Pantoran bodyguards that protected important Pantoran political figures, including the Supreme Chairman of the Pantoran Assembly and Pantora's senator that represented the system in the Senate of the Galactic Republic.
Defels were a sentient species whose members had the ability to become almost invisible by bending light around themselves.

R5-P8 was an astromech droid owned by the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. In addition to a unique paint job, the droid was also heavily modified with a Weequay blaster pistol mounted atop his head.
Arch grubs were a type of insect native to the planet Geonosis, where they were eaten by the native Geonosians.
White banthas were a type of large pack animal native to the frozen Outer Rim world of Nelvaan. They had vast amounts of white fur and long black horns.

Blarths were a species of amphibian native to the planet Naboo. They possessed long grabbing tails ending with fine fingers at the tip, which they could use to catch their prey in the swamps they dwelt in.

The Dagobah python was a species of snake native to the planet Dagobah. It lived amongst the gnarltrees that were commonly found in the world's swamps, and was capable of swallowing up to fifteen times its own weight in food.

Banshees were a non-sentient species of airborne predators native to the planet Umbara. During the Battle of Umbara in the Clone Wars, wild banshees attacked the Galactic Republic's clone troopers on several occasions.

The genteslug was a type of slug. Ugnaughts, a porcine sentient species that hailed from the planet Gentes in the Outer Rim Territories' Anoat sector and originated in a desert or wasteland environment, ate genteslugs as well as molds and fungi that they grew.

Bordoks were a species of sure-footed equine herbivores native to the forest moon Endor. Since the bordoks could carry large loads relative to their small size, the sentient Ewoks used them as both pack animals and mounts.

Can-cells were a species of flying insect found of a number of planets across the galaxy, including Batuu, Kashyyyk, Aleen, Ryloth, Rodia, Taul, and Teth. They had quad wings and large eyes, and were capable of growing to over three meters in length.

Ginnthos were large non-sentient carnivorous spiders native to the planet Utapau who lived in the world's dark sinkhole caverns. They had the ability to spin durable silk, which they used to trap their prey before consuming it.
Convorees (singular: convor), also known as Trandoshan birds, were a species of beautiful, regal, and elegant owl.

Gurrecks were a species of predatory carnivores native to the forest moon of Endor. They had sharp fangs and tusks. The Ewok Teebo wore the skull of a Gurreck on his head despite the risks posed by the hat's fangs.
Wetyin's Colony was the main settlement on the moon Yavin 4 that was established when settlers traveled from the planet Setor to become farmers.
a: Shara Bey and Kes Dameron's home

x: Gorgs, also known as chubas, was a general term used for several species of amphibians used as food by many different sentient species.

The houjix were a species of quadrupedal cephalopod native to the planet Kinyen. These predators had toothy mouths and possessed the ability to generate bio-electric shocks, which could send electrical jolts through prey.
The Ghhhk were an insectoid species hailing from the planet Bith. They were apex predators with four limbs and two antennae, and possessed a strong musculature.

Horaxes were a type of giant blue reptile native to the frozen Outer Rim world of Nelvaan. They had saber-sharp fangs and enormous horns. The tails of horaxes were covered in scales that young Nelvaanian villagers were tasked with acquiring as part of an initiation ritual.
Mastmots were a species of massive, furry, and friendly beasts of burden native to the frozen world of Toola. They had tusks which were prized for use in necklaces.

K'lor'slugs were a species whose appearance was used for one of the holographic pieces in the game dejarik. Pink, tubular beasts, they had suction cup-like mouths and sharp teeth, and were clawed, multilimbed creatures considered to be fearsome and nightmarish.

t: Skirmish in the Temple of Eedit
x: A skirmish occurred in the Jedi temple of Eedit on the planet Devaron between Lieutenant and Jedi Padawan Luke Skywalker and the Galactic Empire. It was Skywalker's first actual duel with his lightsaber.
Fanha was an astronomical object within the Fanha system in the Seitia sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Gan Moradir was a colony planet located in the Gan Moradir system in the Xan sector of the Mid Rim, in grid square Q-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid. During the Galactic Civil War, it was occupied by the Galactic Empire.
The Xan were a small-bodied sentient species. Some of them had established a colony on the planet Gan Moradir, in the galaxy's Mid Rim. Geeska Dotalo was a male member of this species.

The Accelerated Transgenic Heuristic Abhorers (A.T.H.A) were savant abominations created by the techno-lords of the Arkanian Dominion as a response to the Assimilators, the self-repairing cyborgs of the Arkanian Renegades.
The Assimilators were powerful cyborg warriors created by the Arkanians.

At some point, the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 were part of a diplomatic mission to Circarpous. C-3PO commented on R2's eccentricities during the mission in a conversation with the Resistance pilot Jessika Pava sometime after the Battle of Endor.
The Attack on the Red Wind was a battle of the Galactic Civil War near Plooriod IV.

Muunyaks were a non-sentient pack animal, native to the planet Jelucan. They were domesticated and used as the primary form of transportation by the planet's valley-dwellers until the introduction of ridgecrawlers by the Galactic Empire.

Ng'oks were a species whose appearance was used for one of the holographic pieces in the game dejarik. Although its origins were unknown, the ng'ok was speculated to be a predator, given its deadly claws.
Lava fleas were a species of six-legged insect native to the volcanic planet Mustafar. They had eyes that distinguish between light and darkness as well as powerful legs for jumping.

Mongworst were a species of vicious and deadly insects found on the Outer Rim planet Geonosis. They were bred for combat by the native Geonosians and made to participate in pit fights for the Geonosians' pleasure.

Rock-vultures were a species of carnivorous bird native to the planet Utapau in the Outer Rim Territories. They were one of the few species that inhabited the planet's wind-torn surface, where they devoured their prey without waiting for it to perish.
Neebray mantas were a flying creature found throughout the galaxy, dwelling on planets like Tatooine, moons like the Rishi Moon, and even in the void of space in the Kaliida Nebula.

Doo were a species of scalefish native to the planet Naboo. They lived alongside six other scalefish species in the waters around the city Otoh Gunga in Lake Paonga, and could also be found in the Abyss, where they were preyed upon indiscriminately by the large Colo claw fish …

Faa, also known as faa fish or big-mouth faa, were a species of scalefish native to the planet Naboo. They lived alongside six other scalefish species in the waters around the city Otoh Gunga in Lake Paonga, and could also be found in the Naboo Abyss where they were preyed upo…
The Laa, also known as the Fantailed Laa fish, were a species of scalefish found on the planet Naboo and the moon Jedha.

The Mee, also called the mee fish, were a species of scalefish native to the planet Naboo. They lived alongside six other scalefish species in the waters around the city Otoh Gunga in Lake Paonga, and could also be found in the Abyss, where they were preyed upon indiscriminate…

The Ray, also known as the Rayfish or blinding rayfish, were a species of predatory scalefish native to the planet Naboo and Koboh. The blinding rayfish had a protruding mandible and a skeletal appearance. They pretended to be long dead, waiting for their prey to approach.

See, also known as see fish, were a species of scalefish native to the planets Naboo and Koboh. They lived alongside six other scalefish species in the waters around the city Otoh Gunga in Lake Paonga, and could also be found in the Abyss, where they were preyed upon indiscrim…

The Tee were a species of scalefish native to the planet Naboo. They lived alongside six other scalefish species in the waters around the city Otoh Gunga in Lake Paonga, and could also be found in Abyss, where they were preyed upon indiscriminately by colo claw fish and opee s…

Yobshrimp were a species of tiny creature native to the planet Naboo. They were eaten by the seven species of scalefish found in Lake Paonga and in the Naboo Abyss. Tiny yobshrimp lived in the gills of tee scalefish, and were then licked out and eaten by laa scalefish.

The skalder were a mammalian desert species of herbivorous quadrupeds native to the plains of the planet Florrum. Primarily inhabiting lands filled with acidic geysers, the beasts had to ability to sense when the geysers would soon erupt in order to get to a safe distance.

habitat: Holes in the ground, hollowed-out logs
x: Sleens were a species of insect-eating lizard native to the planet Dagobah. They lived in holes in the ground and hollowed-out logs. The Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker encountered a sleen in the Cave of Evil while he trained on Dagobah.

The slug-beetle was a species of small blue, winged beetle that lived on the planets Naboo and Tatooine. On Naboo, they lived exclusively amongst the roots of the perlote tree, which grew only in the world's eastern swamps.
Vine snakes were a species of snake native to the swamp planet Dagobah. They were capable of squeezing into relatively confined spaces, including the engine of an X-wing starfighter.
Utapaun flying squid were a species of flying carnivores native to the planet Utapau. They were constantly hungry and not picky in what they devoured, making them a threat to anything else airborne.
Shriek-hawks, known as jai'galaar in Mando'a, were a species native to the planet Mandalore.
Sha'rellian toops were a species of black-colored creatures from Nal Hutta used by the sentient Hutt species as living headpieces that mimicked the hair of other species.
Swamp slugs were a species of creature native to the swamps of the planet Dagobah.

result: Drusil Bephorin extracted from Imperial custody
x: The mission on Denon, also known as the mission to Denon, was conducted by Luke Skywalker and Nakari Kelen. Their goal was to rescue the Givin cryptologist Drusil Bephorin from Imperial custody.
Ploo II was the homeworld of the Glymphid podracer Aldar Beedo. It was located in the Ploo system in the Ploo sector of the Expansion Region.
Ploo IV was the homeworld of the Fluggrian species including the podracer Elan Mak. It was located in the Ploo system in the Ploo sector of the Expansion Region.

The Scions of Zakuul, commonly known simply as the Scions, was a division of the Knights of Zakuul who possessed the ability to see the future through the Force and were infatuated with the idea of destiny.

Sneeve was an astronomical object in the Sneeve system in the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim. It was situated in grid square Q-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid and was the homeworld of the Sneevel species, such as the podracer Boles Roor.

Triffis was a planet that was the homeworld of the Triffian species, including the podracer Ebe E. Endocott. It was located in the Triffis system along a major hyperlane in the Hevvrol sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square O-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Gravestone was a massive alien combat frigate that was able to defeat the Eternal Fleet, a fleet of droid-controlled warships that was systematically destroying all life within Wild Space, with its powerful Omnicannon.
The Ravager was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought of the Imperial Navy. It was also one of the largest and most powerful military warships ever constructed by the Galactic Empire.

Hoovers were a species of small, quadrupedal sentients that had long, blood-sucking trunks. One such hematophagous alien, a male named Attark, was owned as a pet by Jabba the Hutt. Members of the species were often mistaken for pests due to their appearance.
Vjun was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories in grid square Q-6 on the Standard Galactic Grid, situated between Lucazec and Phindar along the Salin Corridor hyperspace route.

An iknayid was a non-sentient arachnid species that was native to the swamps of the planet Zakuul. The Zakuulans sometimes trained iknayids as gladiatorial beasts for their arenas. Several taxidermied iknayids were displayed at the Royal Hunting Lodge of Onderon around 3627 BBY .
The Eternal Alliance, also known as the Galactic Alliance, was a military organization formed by the Outlander.

Stenness was a terrestrial planet in the Airon sector of the Inner Rim Territories. A crime lord operated a massive gambling den on Stenness. The smugglers Han Solo and Sana Starros illegitimately got married on Stenness while robbing the crime lord's gambling den.
The Pride of Tarlandia was an important battlecruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. It shared its name with the Core Worlds Tarlandia system.

The Shieldmaiden was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in service of the Imperial Navy. Shortly before the Battle of Endor, it was under the command of Captain Khione. Following a series of escapades, Khione was killed and the Shieldmaiden was heavily damaged by a Rebel team.

Andelm beetles were a species of beetle native to Andelm IV. Their larvae contained certain rare organics that could be used to power blasters. Andelm beetles traveled in a swarm and were dangerous to sentient beings in large numbers.
Arcis was a central company town on the planet Burnin Konn. During the Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector it was inhabited by miners and their families; however, it became overrun with hostile droids.

Oovo 4, also known as Oovo Four, was a high-security prison moon located near asteroid-strewn space. The Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft was designed for the task of guarding the moon, as a unique craft was needed for the job.
Nelvaan was a frigid Outer Rim planet located in the Savareen sector's Nelvaan system. It was home to the peaceful, sentient Nelvaanian species.
Fralideja was the capital city of the planet Mustafar.

Gehenbar hive was a notable Geonosian hive and a major city on the planet Geonosis. It wielded huge influence over the political system of the world's Geonosian species, which included ten prime hives.
Pair O'Dice was one of the more famous casinos located on the floating Cloud City on the Outer Rim planet Bespin.
Yarith Bespin was one of the more famous casinos located on the floating Cloud City on the planet Bespin. Visitors could play the sabacc variant Corellian Spike at the casino.
Enforcement, or the Enforcement desk, was a branch of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau which contained special operations units that backed up other ISB agents in the field.

Interrogation was a branch of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau which was responsible for the interrogation of suspects. They claimed to have a ninety-five percent success rate of gaining useful data from those questioned.
Re-Education was a branch of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau that was responsible for brainwashing suspects in order to have them support the Empire.

Surveillance, also designated as the Surveillance Branch, was a branch of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau that was responsible for analyzing data to look for potential threats. Emigration officers of the Corellian Security Forces were attached to the branch.

Investigations was a branch of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau responsible for using data to suppress rebel activity. Agent Kallus worked in the Investigations, Internal Affairs, and Enforcement branches of the ISB.
The Allyuen spaceport was a spaceport on Allyuen, a world located in the Anoat sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, that was garrisoned by the Galactic Empire.
Mantellian Savrips were a semi-sentient, but technologically primitive, reptilian species from the planet Ord Mantell whose appearance was used for one of the holographic pieces in the game dejarik.
Gerrenthum was a planet located in the Gerrenthum system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, serving as the Anoat sector's capital after the previous capital, Anoat, was rendered uninhabitable.

Sriluur was a desert planet located in the Sriluur system in the Periphery, a subsector of the Outer Rim Territories' Tharin sector that was the homeworld of the Weequays, a species whose tough, leathery skin helped them endure its harsh conditions, and the Sriluurian butterfly.
Sleheyron was a celestial body located in the Sleheyron system in Hutt Space, in grid square S-10 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

t: Skirmish aboard a Republic medical station
result: The rebels escape from the Seventh Sister and the Fifth Brother
Phoenix Cell acquires the medical supplies needed
x: During the Galactic Civil War, members of the Lothal rebel cell engaged in a skirmish against two Imperial Inquisitors aboard an abandoned Galactic Republic Haven-class medical station.

Bat were a type of creatures whose characteristics included wings, a flat nose, and elongated ears. Known species of bats included the chirodactyl, the jogan-bat, the kinor bat, the Loth-bat, the snow shredder bat, the sandbat, and the Spintiri glowbat.

80-M, also know as Eightyem, was a protocol droid who served as the interpreter of Jabba Desilijic Tiure, a Hutt crime lord who led his own criminal empire, until he angered his master and was disintegrated.

Allyuen was a planet located in Allyuen system in the Anoat sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in grid square K-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was home to the Allyuen spaceport, which was garrisoned by the Galactic Empire.
The Shuxl Brotherhood was a clever and powerful criminal gang of Kadas'sa'Nikto who were active on the planet Burnin Konn during the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector.

result: The Outlander's team escapes with the Gravestone
x: The Battle of Asylum occurred in 3631 BBY after Emperor Arcann of the Eternal Empire, having been notified of the Outlander's presence at the shadowport of Asylum by the Scion leader Heskal, brought the Eternal Fleet to Asylum and opened fire on it.
Lianorm Swamp was a swamp on the planet Naboo close to Lake Paonga. It spread over an area of 85 square kilometers.

Ione was a planet in the Ione system of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector, Imperials seized all crystal shipments landing on Ione, causing an overflow of crystals in Imperial holdings.

Darlyn Boda was a planet in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade, Darlyn Boda had a criminal network which included the Trade Spine League and the Ivax Syndicate.

The Advozsec (singular Advozse) were a humanoid sentient species native to the volcanic planet Riflor, located in the Mid Rim. Thanks to their thick skin and sensitive eyes, they manage to survive in a harsh environment.
The Baragwin were a large sentient species with pink and gray skin and yellow eyes. The thug Hermi Odle was a Baragwin. As a colonial species, they had migrated and adapted to dominate many worlds.
The Glymphid were a sentient species with orange or red colored eyes and beige, blue, gray, green, and yellow colored skin. The podracer Aldar Beedo from Ploo II was a Glymphid.
The Fluggrians were a sentient species with yellow eyes and green, purple, white and pink skin that was native to Ploo IV. Elan Mak was a Fluggrian podracer who was active on Tatooine.
Triffians were a sentient species with yellow eyes and black, blue, yellow, and cream skin native to Triffis. The podracer Ebe E. Endocott was a Triffian.

Sneevels were a fur-covered sentient species. Boles Roor was a Sneevel Podracer pilot from the world of Sneeve who competed in at least three Boonta Eve Classic Podraces, two of which the pilot had won.

result: Dhara Leonis rescued, Zare Leonis escapes a death sentence from the Ga
objective: Rescue Dhara Leonis from Imperial custody
x: The rescue of Dhara Leonis was a mission to rescue the sister of Zare Leonis, Dhara Leonis, from Imperial custody in Area Null of the Arkanis Academy on the planet Arkanis.
The Torment was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer in the naval forces of the Galactic Empire that participated in the Battle of Theed during Operation: Cinder and was helmed by Captain Lerr Duvat.

Delphon was a planet in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade, the criminal Trade Spine League wanted to quietly move a shipment of crystals from the planet Burnin Konn to Delphon, but had to first deal with the Black Hole Gang.
The Black Hole Gang was a crew of pirates that operated out of the Delphon system and terrorized the shipping lanes of the Anoat sector.
Bendeluum was a planet in the Bendeluum system in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories along the Corellian Trade Spine. The independent Nothoiin cartel criminal organization was based there.

Kintan striders were a species of silicon-based lifeforms from the planet Kintan who were intelligent enough to use simple tools. These beasts were burly, massive, and monstrous. Their appearance was used for one of the holographic pieces in the game dejarik.

Nelvaanians were a sentient species native to the frozen Outer Rim world of Nelvaan. They practiced a perilous initiation ritual in which young males had to obtain a scale from the tail of a horax, giant blue-skinned reptiles with saber-sharp fangs and enormous horns, in order…
The Xamsters were a sentient species. The species had exceptional brains capable of thinking quickly and processing sensory data at high speed. The podracer Neva Kee was a Xamster.
The Skrilling were a three-fingered, bipedal sentient species with green skin and brown eyes. The arms dealer Pote Snitkin was a Skrilling, as was the Jedi Knight Ord Enisence.

The Stennes Shifters were a sentient species that had an innate ability to use the Force to pass invisibly through crowds and were typically hyper-wary of strangers. They could have tan skin and brown hair. Known members of the species included Trinto Duaba and Braconnor Bakiska.

The Chevin were a large sentient elephantine species with massive heads that stretched the length of their entire bodies. They could have gray skin, black eyes, and blonde hair. The Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure's head of security Ephant Mon was a Chevin.

The Kitonak were a sentient species with pink skin and small eyes that was native to the planet Kirdo III. Their bodies released a vanilla-like scent. They boasted thick, leathery skin, which allowed them to adapt to harsh climates as their tough skin protected them from the sun.
Frog-dogs were a sentient species of lizard that, at first glance, were usually thought to be non-sentient and were often mistaken for pests.

A communications ship attached to the Rebel Alliance Fleet was stationed in orbit of the planet Sullust during the Battle of Endor. It relayed news of the battle's proceedings to other Rebel Alliance forces not present at Endor.

Pondakree was the homeworld of the Imperial loyalty officer Emarr Ottkreg. It was located in the Pondakree system in the Inner Rim Territories. Bagging lake-divers on Pondakree was a task that was considered considerably easy.

A tour guide droid with masculine programming was welcoming a group of Shadow Collective soldiers to Peace Park, located in the New Mandalorians' capital city of Sundari, during their takeover of the planet Mandalore when one of them blasted him in the face, destroying the hap…

Kivaroa were large, five meter-tall, slick-skinned creatures with eight legs. They were able to be ridden by native Tsevukans on the planet Tsevuka. Around 11 years before the Battle of Yavin, a group of Tsevukans ambushed Grand Moff Tarkin's transport while on a tour.
The Dragonbird Gardens was a garden complex located on the planet Aargau that was well-known for its grandeur.

TN-123 was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid of masculine programming who served within the Separatist Droid Army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems as a commander during the Clone Wars.
The Corporate Security Liaison Office was a division of the Corporate Sector Authority's Office of the Auditor-General.

The Detached Duty Office was a division of the Corporate Sector Authority's Office of the Auditor-General. It was established for two reasons; firstly, as a public relations exercise to give the impression that the Corporate Sector Authority valued civic-mindedness.

A florakeet was a type of feathered creature that could be roasted and plucked. When being questioned by thugs working for the gangster Surat Nuat on the planet Akiva in 4 ABY, the junk dealer Temmin Wexley claimed that a transport belonging to Nuat had been roasted and plucke…

Starklebirds, also known as just starkles, were a type of carnivorous, migratory bird found on the Outer Rim Territories planet Saleucami. Flocks of starklebirds took shelter in greater cake trees, filling their many layers.

A thatch-sparrow was a type of bird that flitted around when scared. In 4 ABY, the bounty hunter Jas Emari thought about how she had tracked the Imperial moneylender Arsin Crassus around the galaxy for the last month, considering his travels comparable to the scared flitting o…
Ivarujar was a volcanic planet in the Ivarujar system in the Vensensor sector of the Expansion Region, situated along the Corellian Trade Spine.
Kerev Doi was a spice-mining planet in the Kerev Doi system in the Circarpous sector of the Expansion Region that was known for its "colorful," lawless path and its corrupt banking system.

ZK-723S was an elite Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of the planet Zakuul, that was designated as the command unit for the shield bunker on the planet Alderaan that supported the Eternal Empire's Star Fortress in orbit.

ZK-094R was an elite Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of the planet Zakuul, that was designated as the command unit for the shield bunker on the planet Belsavis that supported the Eternal Empire's Star Fortress in orbit.

ZK-294A was an elite Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of the planet Zakuul, that was designated as the command unit for the shield bunker on the planet Hoth that supported the Eternal Empire's Star Fortress in orbit.

ZG-841F was an elite Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of the planet Zakuul, that was designated as the command unit for the shield bunker on the moon Nar Shaddaa that supported the Eternal Empire's Star Fortress in orbit.

ZK-163M was an elite Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of the planet Zakuul, that was designated as the command unit for the shield bunker on the planet Tatooine that supported the Eternal Empire's Star Fortress in orbit.

ZK-517P was an elite Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of the planet Zakuul, that was designated as the command unit for the shield bunker on the planet Voss that supported the Eternal Empire's Star Fortress in orbit.

Cerulean skycatchers were a type of blue bird with a plucky nature found on the planet Akiva. In 4 ABY, on a quiet morning after rain, a pair of cerulean skycatchers ducked and dived through the air above the home of the couple Esmelle and Shirene in the Akivan city Myrra whil…

Ring-dogs were a type of dog that had banded tails. In 4 ABY, New Republic pilot Norra Wexley and her son, Temmin Wexley, argued about fleeing from the planet Akiva, with Norra claiming it was her decision to make as Temmin's parent.

A fengla was a type of small, hairless vermin with high haunches, green eyes, and crooked incisors. In 4 ABY, the former Imperial Sinjir Rath Velus encountered a fengala in the subterranean catacombs under the city Myrra on the Outer Rim Territories planet Akiva.
Uthura was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Uthura system of the Inner Rim Territories. It had at least one ocean that was inhabited by starwhales.
Perin was a Trianii colony planet in Trianii Space.

ZEM-19ST was an elite Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of the planet Zakuul, that was among the Skytrooper forces deployed to board Darth Marr's flagship during a battle with the Eternal Fleet in 3636 BBY.

ZEM-24NF was an elite Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of the planet Zakuul, that was among the Skytrooper forces deployed to board Darth Marr's flagship during a battle with the Eternal Fleet in 3636 BBY.

ZEM-63IG was an elite Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of the planet Zakuul, that was among the Skytrooper forces deployed to board Darth Marr's flagship during a battle with the Eternal Fleet in 3636 BBY.

ZEM-88EH was an elite Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of the planet Zakuul, that was among the Skytrooper forces deployed to board Darth Marr's flagship during a battle with the Eternal Fleet in 3636 BBY.

The Sligo Pirate gang was a swoop gang that resided in the underworld of Coruscant prior to the Clone Wars. At some point after 28 BBY, the leader of the gang challenged a Twi'lek to a swoop race through the tunnel of a power plant.
Emerald kofta-grouses were a type of bird that partially shared their name with kofta-buns, a kind of bread.

A dipolopod was an insect-like creature that could be used as a beast of burden. Dipolopods had hard green plates, eyeless heads, clawed legs and wicked-looking stingers. They could be ridden with the use of a saddle, but often needed prodding using an electro-prod.

The Mighty Oak Apocalypse (often referred to as Moa) was an independent cargo YT-2400 light freighter during the Galactic Civil War, captained by the Wookiee Lohgarra. The ship's name was more intimidating in Shyriiwook.

Iloh was a tropical terrestrial planet in the Iloh system of the Inner Rim Territories covered in archipelagos and oceans, offering tourists and locals thousands of beaches. Notably, it was the homeworld of Imperial officer turned Rebel pilot Kendy Idele.
Cuckoo hens were a type of chicken that made clucking sounds. By the time of the Imperial Era, being compared to one of the hens could be considered a symbol of cowardice.

A sail-bird was a type of bird considered to be characteristically savvy. In 4 ABY, the New Republic pilot Norra Wexley and her sister-in-law, Shirene, discussed the challenges of raising Wexley's son, Temmin Wexley, while on the planet Akiva.

Native to the planet Wielu, Sloats were large carnivorous snake-like creatures with long mouths and large feathered wings. They were attracted to the glowdart, another creature on Wielu. A crime lord named Shon Ti'Ja owned a sloat on the planet.

Meetles were arthropods known to inhabit the sewer systems of the Meatlump Hideout beneath the streets of the city Coronet on Corellia. Although they closely resembled kreetles in appearance, Chef Schlump referred to the meetles as rodents.

Worrmps were small creatures known to inhabit the sewer systems of the Meatlump Hideout beneath the streets of the city Coronet on Corellia. Although they closely resembled worrts in appearance, Chef Schlump referred to the worrmps as rodents.

The Commandant's Cadets was a secret student society found within the Galactic Empire's Arkanis Academy on the planet Arkanis. Created by the academy's leader, Commandant Brendol Hux, the organization was made up of cadets handpicked by Hux.

Glowdarts were small insectoids native to the planet Wielu. They had a symbiotic relationship with the indigenous sloat, a snake-like creature. Glowdarts were used to break into Traygura's base by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and smuggler Rook Pryce.
Rinn was a frozen planet located in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim. Inhabitants of Rinn depended on heaters to live in the freezing conditions.
Shadow troopers, also spelled as shadowtroopers, were elite and highly trained stormtroopers that served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War against the Rebel Alliance.
Pujool was the sixth and most distant planet in the Anoat system of the Anoat sector, in close proximity of the planet Anoat. A gas giant, it was orbited by six moons.

Arieli was an Expansion Region planet under the Galactic Empire's rule. After a local insurgency sabotaged the Imperial Arquitens-class light cruiser Peacemaker there, the cruiser began firing on the world's municipal buildings.

Dinwa Prime was a planet in the Inner Rim Territories that was occupied by the Galactic Empire. Imperial atrocities committed on the world by 18 BBY were cited in anti-Imperial broadcasts sent from the planet Lothal that year.

Ivera X was a Core Worlds planet that suffered under the rule of the Galactic Empire, having its cities destroyed as a response to Imperial posters being vandalized. The light freighter Mighty Oak Apocalypse did a supply run there during the Galactic Civil War.
In 4 BBY, members of the Spectres, temporarily allied with the pirate Hondo Ohnaka, engaged in a skirmish with the crime lord Azmorigan and his forces in Nixus Hub 218 on the planet Nixus.

Nixus was a frigid planet in the Nixus system of the Outer Rim Territories' Parmic sector, at the end of the Llanic Spice Run. Despite sporting glacial terrain and low-gravity, the planet was not inhospitable and actually hosted a structure, Nixus Hub 218.
The Mandible was an Imperial starship that was involved in an accident by 3 ABY, when the vessel's captain ferried vaporous cargo aboard the ship while drunk.

A battle was fought on the terrestrial astronomical object Ferrok Pax between the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, nicknamed Twilight Company, and a warrior group that had captured fellow rebel soldiers. Twilight Company lost many troops trekking to the enemy.

The Uthuthma were an alien species native to the planet Jakku. They were described as having a "socket-eyed skull face" with a "toothy maw." They wore chains around their necks as scarves. Gazwin was a member of this species that was present on Jakku during the New Republic Era.

Belsus was the moon of the planet Gentes, in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. At the time of the Iron Blockade, there were rumors that General Grievous of the Confederacy of Independent Systems had once built a laboratory there.
Gross Revenue was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Financial Division. It was responsible for tracking the Authority's assets, resources, expenses, and income.
Revenue was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Financial Division. It was responsible for collecting the tax revenue from the consumers and businesses within the Corporate Sector.
Stock and Investment was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Financial Division. It was tasked with handling the transaction of the Corporate Sector Authority's shares.

Contracting and Licensing was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Financial Division. The division was responsible for organizing contracts from sponsors and non-sponsors, and well as marketing Authority products such as entertainment programs outside the Corpora…
Legal Division was a branch of the Corporate Sector Authority. One of the larger divisions, it worked closely with Media Division.

Inter-Corporate Tribunal was the highest judiciary of the Corporate Sector Authority. It was a independent subdivision of the Legal Division that dealt with legal suits between small companies and individuals.
Sector/Imperial Liaison was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Legal Division. The subdivision was responsible for representing the Authority's interests to the Galactic Empire.
Media Division was a branch of the Corporate Sector Authority. It managed all communications and content for public broadcast throughout the Corporate Sector.

Demographics was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Media Division. It studied the Corporate Sector's consumer base and determined economic trends, including purchasing trends and attitudes. This information was passed to Entertainment and Product Advertising.

Product Relations was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Media Division. It was responsible for molding and controlling the feelings of the Corporate Sector's residents, as well as marketing the Authority to outside interests.

Entertainment was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Media Division. Entertainment produced almost all of the Authority's public entertainment programming, including dramas, comedies, music, and theater.

Recruitment was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Media Division. It was responsible for sourcing new employees for the Corporate Sector. Due to the work done by Public Relations and Entertainment, Recruitment never had problems meeting its quota.
Product Advertising was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Media Division. It designed, tested, and implemented all advertising campaigns for Authority products.

Production Division was a branch of the Corporate Sector Authority. The largest of the divisions, it was responsible for the allocation of factory ships, seeding colonies, and the manufacture of goods.

Scheduling was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Production Division. It was tasked with monitoring the productivity of the Authority's facilities, including mines, hatcheries, refineries, manufacturing plants, and Authority-owned retail businesses.
Resource Development was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Production Division. It was tasked with the development and construction of new facilities throughout the Corporate Sector.
Feasibility was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Production Division. It analyzed the data gathered by Scout Services and suggested potential uses for star systems.
Research Division was a branch of the Corporate Sector Authority. It dealt with new and different products, working in tandem with the design and marketing teams of various sponsor companies.

Resources Division was a branch of the Corporate Sector Authority. It was the second largest division and had two responsibilities; search for new supplies of raw materials, as well as design and procure all equipment for the Authority.

Scout Services was an organization of the Corporate Sector Authority whose duty was the exploration of the galaxy. It was a subdivision of the Resources Division that sent scouts to investigate and scan unexplored star systems within the CSA sphere of influence.
Central Services was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Resources Division. It was responsible for repair and maintenance of all equipment.
Supplies and Allocation was a subdivision of the Corporate Sector Authority's Resources Division. It designed or procured all equipment used by the Authority.

The Main Production Boulevard was a roadway in the Upper Industrial Sector on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. The reconstituted Sith Empire's Imperial Special Ops Center was located along the boulevard.

The Exchange Factory Square was an industrial square controlled by the Exchange in the Upper Industrial Sector on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. The Meridian Hall and Charnax Industries were located in the area.

The Coolant Overflow, so named for the excess coolant dumped in the area, was a sector of Network Access, part of the Network Security District of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

The Secured Systems was an area of the Network Access of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Eidolon Security maintained a datacenter in the area.
The White Wing was an anti Empire terrorist group within the Eagle's network. It operated on Nar Shaddaa behind the front company VerveGen Corporation.

Drazaal Row was a street in the Duros Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa. During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, Imperial Intelligence maintained an outpost along the street that monitored the sector.

The 75th Legion forward camp, originally the Galactic Republic's Lytle Research Outpost, was located in the Shattered Pipeworks area of the Tularan Marsh on Taris and served as a base of operations for the 75th Legion.
The Shattered Pipeworks was the name given to part of the Tularan Marsh on the planet Taris. The name came from the numerous massive broken pipes in the area.

The Imperial Garrison was an industrial complex converted into a military base by the reconstituted Sith Empire on the planet Quesh during the Galactic War. Imperial forces under Moff Dracen established their base there during the Quesh war.
The Unwell Woods was a wooded area on the planet Quesh.

The Poisonwater Mining Operation was a valley on the planet Quesh that was the site of several mining operations during the Galactic War, a conflict fought between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The adrenal synthesis factory was a industrial factory used by the Galactic Republic and the Three Families to synthesize adrenals on the planet Quesh during the Cold War and Galactic War.
The Tainted Valley was a valley on the planet Quesh.
The Highmount Slopes was the name given to the mountain range that formed the eastern edge of the Highmount Ridge on the planet Hoth.

The Tromper Crags mineral mine was a mineral mine located underneath the western mountains of the Highmount Ridge on the planet Hoth. The White Maw pirates controlled the mine, along with the rest of the neighboring Tromper Crags Geothermal Plant.

The Snow Hills Pass, known to the Hailstorm Brotherhood as the White Ridge Hills, was a roadway that ran along the southern edge of the White Maw Pass in the Glacial Fissure, between the fissure itself and the Crystal Wastes to the south, and linked Leth Outpost to the west wi…
The Icefinger Rise was the name given to the plain west of the White Maw Pass in the Glacial Fissure region on the planet Hoth, east of the Bold Ascent and the Highmount Ridge.

Holowan Labs was a facility of Holowan Laboratories located in the Network Security District on Nar Shaddaa. It contained a show room, where Holowan Industries was demonstrating new battle droid models to their Republic clients sometime around the year 3642 BBY.
G-T7 was a protocol droid of the Sith Empire. During the Galactic War, it was stationed at the Voss Orbital Docking Station above Voss.
The Beastmark Hills was the name given to the southern part in the Old Paths region of the planet Voss.

The Houk Syndicate Lair was a cave system in the Beastmark Hills in the Old Paths region on the planet Voss. It was used as a base by the Houk Syndicate during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The tomb of Albathius, known as the "Shining Man," was located in the Old Paths on Voss.

The Road to Renewal, also known as the Path of Pilgrimage, was a roadway that led through the Serenity Valley in the Old Paths region of the planet Voss to the Shrine of Healing. The Pilgrim Retreat was located along the roadway.
The Western Watchwoods was the name given to the western part of the forest located on the northern edge of the Gormak Lands on the planet Voss, at the foot of the mountain where Voss-Ka was located.
The Eastern Watchwoods was the name given to the eastern part of the forest located on the northern edge of the Gormak Lands on the planet Voss, at the foot of the mountain where Voss-Ka was located.
Darkstone Grove was a small grove located on the northern edge of the Nightmare Lands on the planet Voss, east of the Crysfang Glade and west of the Lake of Unseen.

S-1D5 was a shopkeeper droid in the service of the Sith Empire. During the Battle of Corellia in the Galactic War, it was stationed in Coronet Spaceport in the Incorporation Islands region of the planet Corellia, distributing starship upgrades.

J-4K4 was a shopkeeper droid in the service of the Sith Empire. During the Battle of Corellia in the Galactic War, it was stationed in Coronet Spaceport in the Incorporation Islands region of the planet Corellia.
NA-71 was a protocol droid owned by the Star Cabal. During the Galactic War it was welcoming guests to an apocalypse party during the Battle of Corellia at the Coronet Spaceport on Corellia.
ISD-80 was a medical droid of the reconstituted Sith Empire. It oversaw Shara Jenn's neurochemical levels after her recovery from a coma induced by Star Cabal.
IR-77 was an advanced battle droid deployed by the intergalactic spymaster known as the Shroud to protect his interests across the galaxy.
The Crimson Brotherhood was a mercenary organization operating on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
Infotech Plaza was a plaza in the Network Security District of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Republic Mining Camp was a settlement used by the mining workers employed by the Galactic Republic on the planet Quesh during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Ithorian Jho operated an antique freight hauler. A few years before the Battle of Yavin, Jho used it to evacuate the Spanjaf and Leonis families from Lothal ahead of Imperial searchers. Jho described the hauler's hyperdrive motivator as "iffy," but usable for short trips.

Khorm was a terrestrial astronomical object with a notable amount of natural mineral resources, making it of interest to both the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems. It was located in the Khorm system in the Halori sector of the Mid Rim Territories.

Nixus Hub 218 was a station on the black market planet Nixus. It was a base of operations for the smuggler Azmorigan. The Galactic Empire had a presence on the station, and used this to capture two Lasat.

The Detention Task Force was a law enforcement correctional task force active in the Corporate Sector. By 132 BBY, a group of criminals arrested by the Jedi Order were placed aboard the transport Palwick as the convicts were due for processing by the Detention Task Force.

Information Procedures was a branch of Situational Enforcement, part of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division. Working closely with Operational Multisystem Management, their technicians strove to ensure the security of the Authority's transmissions.

Material Procedures was a branch of Situational Enforcement, part of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division. They tracked all reports of property damage to Authority equipment and facilities. Material Procedures had two branches; Embezzlement and Industrial Espionage.

Transit Procedures was a branch of Situational Enforcement, part of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division. They investigated all issues concerning shipping and commerce between Authority-controlled planets. Transit Procedures had two branches; Piracy and Smuggling.
Data Theft was a part of the Information Procedures branch of Situational Enforcement, which was a division of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division.
Extortion was a part of the Information Procedures branch of Situational Enforcement, which was a division of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division.
Industrial Espionage was a part of the Information Procedures branch of Situational Enforcement, which was a division of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division.
Patent Infringement was a part of the Information Procedures branch of Situational Enforcement, which was a division of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division.

Embezzlement was a part of the Material Procedures branch of Situational Enforcement, which was a division of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division. It had the highest efficiency rating of all the Security Division branches.

Industrial Espionage was a part of the Material Procedures branch of Situational Enforcement, which was a division of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division. It was tasked with countering acts of industrial sabotage from companies based outside the Corporate Sector.
Piracy was a part of the Transit Procedures branch of Situational Enforcement, which was a division of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division.
Smuggling was a part of the Transit Procedures branch of Situational Enforcement, which was a division of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division.
An OverPrecinct was an organizational level of Locational Enforcement, which was part of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division. OverPrecincts were assigned to a Territory.
A Precinct was an organizational level of Locational Enforcement, which was part of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division. Precincts were assigned to a Region.
A Sub-Precinct was an organizational level of Locational Enforcement, which was part of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division. Sub-Precincts were assigned to a Zone.

A Station was an organizational level of Locational Enforcement, which was part of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division. Stations were assigned to a Market. If a Market was spread over multiple planets, then several Enforcement Stations were assigned to the area.

An Enforcement Station was an organizational level of Locational Enforcement, which was part of the Corporate Sector Authority's Security Division. Enforcement Stations were present when a Market covered more than one planet, meaning a single Station would not be effective.

The Crystal Cave, also known simply as the Naboo Cave, was a cave located on the Mid Rim world of Naboo. Nestled deep within the Gallo Mountains, the cave was home to a number of creatures known as the narglatch, many of which were sick.

x: The blockade of Ibaar occurred in 4 BBY, during the Galactic Civil War, when forces of the Galactic Empire blockaded the planet Ibaar, cutting the Ibaarian people off from vital supplies to lure rebels to their destruction in any attempt to help the people on the planet.

Ibaar was a mountainous, rocky, and temperate planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that fell under Imperial control in the years prior to the Battle of Yavin. The Empire created a blockade around the planet that cut off vital supplies from the Ibaarian people.

Prototype B6, also known as the Blade Wing, the Bevel Wing and Hera Syndulla's B-wing, was a prototype B-wing heavy assault starfighter designed and built by the Mon Calamari engineer Quarrie on the planet Shantipole as a part of Project Shantipole.
BG-81 was an astromech droid who served the Mon Calamari engineer Quarrie in the years prior to the Battle of Yavin and during the Galactic Civil War.

Odessen was a planet located in the Wild Space, that had a strong connection to the Force. A world with significant oceans and mountainous continents, Odessen had a mild climate and a variety of wildlife among its forested terrain.

327-T, also known by the nickname 327, was a spunky, simpleminded WED-15 Treadwell repair droid who served aboard the Republic Venator-class Star Destroyer Tranquility during the Clone Wars, maintaining many of the ship's systems on board.

An Imperial-class Star Destroyer was commanded by Commodore Idel during his mission to capture the stolen yacht Imperialis. Following his failure to prevent the yacht escaping the Castell system, Idel committed suicide onboard the vessel's bridge.

Plexis was a relatively small planet located in the Plexis system in the Core Worlds region of the galaxy. During the Age of the Empire, it housed a number of spice gangs, all of which were under the authority of the Zenowai Crime Society via an overseer named Shoja Ko.
The Zenowai Crime Society was a criminal organization that originated and operated in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. It notably controlled spice gangs on Plexis.
The Paradise Atrium was an upper class lounge located in Cloud City, a tibanna mining colony floating in the skies of the planet Bespin.

Malachor Company was a band of mercenaries employed by the Galactic Empire on the desert world of Er'Kit. On behalf of the Empire, the mercenaries forcibly removed citizens of Er'Kit from their homes to make way for Project Hidden Eye.

The Klatooine paddy frog, also known as Klatooinian paddy frogs, was a species of frog from Klatooine that made up part of a Hutt's diet. Jabba kept an aquarium of these frogs by his throne at all times, and some in a neon green liquid inside of a green orb.

Balith was an inhabited planet located in the Balith system that was in the midst of a civil war in 21 BBY. That year, at the request of Balith's people, the Galactic Republic dispatched its Third Legion, under the command of Jedi General Anakin Skywalker, to join the conflict.
The artisan colony was a city with 50,000 inhabitants located on the planet Kiros. It was founded by Togruta colonists who created a society without weapons, pursuing art and beauty instead of war.
The Annihilator was a Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. In 4 ABY, it served in the Imperial fleet defending the second Death Star.

The Tecora was a reddish-colored YV-865 Aurore-class freighter that belonged to Darts D'Nar during the Clone Wars. D'Nar used the ship for transporting slaves and treasures to Zygerria, until its capture by Republic forces during the battle on Kiros.
Transport One was the callsign of a CR90 corvette that served with the Phoenix Cell sometime before the Galactic Civil War.

HK-55 was a HK-series assassin droid that served the Sith Lord Lana Beniko during the conquest of the galaxy by the Eternal Empire and afterwards. He was programmed as a bodyguard, but also functioned as an assassin droid when required.

Thrad was a dry desert planet which was represented by Nadea Tural in the Imperial Senate. In 4 BBY, Tural was rescued by the crew of the Ghost after her shuttle crashed.

EG-86 was an EG-series power droid that served the rebellion as a courier of vital information. Rebel Hera Syndulla dispatched fellow rebels Sabine Wren, Ezra Bridger, and the droid C1-10P to find EG-86 and take it to the Havoc Outpost, but their mission was nearly compromised…
An RX-series pilot droid flew a GX1 short hauler several years before the Battle of Yavin. During a routine trip to the planet Garel, his ship was hijacked by members of the Spectres rebel cell.

The Howling Crag Clan Village was a village located in the Susk'kinad region of the Outer Rim world of Dathomir. The village was inhabited by the Howling Crag Clan, including a Dathomirian by the name of Denkra Kymeri.
The Northern Dune Sea was a region of the Dune Sea, a large expanse of desert on the Outer Rim world of Tatooine.

During the Clone Wars, the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure employed a feminine vendor droid as a translator in his palace on the planet Tatooine.
The school bus was a type of vehicle, similar to a shuttle or a starfighter, used by the Jedi Temple School District to transport Jedi Initiates and Padawans from the Jedi Temple to other locations.

A B1-Series battle droid was used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems as Asajj Ventress' bodyguard in her journey to Coruscant. At some point during 22 BBY, Asajj Ventress was sent to Coruscant while the political group Bureaucratosis was giving a speech.

Fortune and Glory was the personal Luxury 3000 space yacht of the pirate Captain Hondo Ohnaka, leader of the Ohnaka Gang. He used the yacht to deliver supplies to a group of rebels on the planet Onderon during the Onderonian Civil War in the Clone Wars.
The Zann Consortium was a crime syndicate that was active during the Galactic Civil War. The consortium was at odds with Black Sun.

Culroon III, also known as Culroon, was a terrestrial astronomical object located the Culroon system of Wild Space, situated in grid square P-20 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was inhabited by Culroonians.

Zaloriis was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Askarian sector's Zaloriis system, which was situated in the Expansion Region and the Slice. It was situated in grid square P-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Zaloriis was inhabited by Zalorians.
The varasquactyl was a mutated creature, the result of mixing the DNA between squills and varactyls.
Scaparus Port was a spaceport on the planet Arkanis. It was about two klicks from the Arkanis Academy, nestled in a gap between two cliffs.

The Thyrian Ocean was a large body of water between the continents of Thyr and Masara on the planet Tython. In the days of the Je'daii Order, Cloud Chasers were used to ferry travelers across the ocean.
Internal Affairs was a branch of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau which was responsible for rooting out traitors amongst the Empire's ranks.

The Nothoiins were a species of gold-skinned humanoids that hailed from the planet of the same name. Long before the Galactic Civil War, the Nothoiin aristocrats founded the Noble Court that ruled the entire Anoat sector.
Armored eels were a species of carnivorous eel native to the swamps of the moon Yavin 4. They preyed upon brightly colored lizard crabs.

D'Qar was a verdant planet located in the Ileenium system of the Outer Rim Territories. By the thirtieth year after the formation of the New Republic, the planet was the location of the headquarters of the Resistance, a private paramilitary force formed by Senator Leia Organa …

Vashkan apidactyls, also called dacs for short, were a species of giant, winged insects that hailed from the warm planet of Vashka. They were the size of a small humanoid, had an armor-like chitinous exoskeleton, two sets of wings, and venomous stingers.
The moons of Gozgo were a group of at least two moons located in the galaxy. The moons were referenced in a curse used by Cikatro Vizago, Kemlin and Orka.

Hosnian Prime was a planet in the Hosnian system of the Core Worlds, located along the Corellian Trade Spine. By 28 ABY, it served as the capital of the New Republic and the headquarters of the New Republic Senate.

Giju was a planet located in Herglic Space within the Colonies. Due to its placement on the Rimma Trade Route and the Herglic Alley hyperspace routes, it received many visitors and had tapcafes and cantinas to serve them.
Whiforla II was a planet located along the galaxy's Shipwrights' Trace trade route. Whiforla-song was a language spoken by the avian inhabitants of the planet.
Tikaroo was a town located on the planet Devaron. The town was composed of a few small stilt houses, most of which were one or two stories tall. Tikaroo was surrounded by jungle.

Sirpar was a planet found within the Galactic Empire. It was known for its extremely high gravity compared to that of other human-inhabited planets in the Empire, as well as a dazzlingly intense sun that was so bright that non-natives needed to wear polarized goggles in order …
A salt hawk was a type of bird that occurred around the home of Ciena Ree in the valleys of Jelucan, and whose cries were familiar to her. They could be heard from indoors before dark.

Anglers were a bulbous, carnivorous species of organism native to the swamps of the moon Yavin 4. They would sit on the buttress roots of trees and pull lizard crabs from the swamps, which they would then absorb and eat.

Lizard crabs were a species of brightly colored creatures native to the swamps of the moon Yavin 4. They were eaten by armored eels and anglers, the later of which grabbed lizard crabs while perched on buttress roots and then absorbed them.

Leviathan grubs were a subterranean, omnivorous species native to the moon Yavin 4. The grubs would feed on the roots of Massassi trees below ground for three hundred years before emerging as one of the largest predators in the moon's forests.
Lizards were a type of reptile. Some varieties of lizard could be found in the swamps of the planet Dagobah, including sleens, while others dwelt on the planets Dathomir and Hissrich.

Spiny bograts were a species of rat that were native to the swamps of the planet Dagobah. While living in exile on Dagobah, Jedi Grand Master Yoda often found spiny bograts and various other swamp life coming through the door of his hut.
Sapphire ice worms were a species of worm native to the ice planet Hoth. They dug winding burrows, which the wind whistled through at night to create haunting melodies.

Butcherbugs were a species of insect that were native to the swamps of the planet Dagobah. While living in exile on Dagobah, Jedi Grand Master Yoda often found butcherbugs and various other swamp life coming through the door of his hut.

Gwerps were a non-sentient species of lean, frog-like creatures with protruding horns and tusks. Bobbajo, a Nu-Cosian nicknamed the "Crittermonger," used to carry small animals around in cages, including some gwerps.

Lonlans were a non-sentient species of mammal whose body resembled a large, semi-inflated, mud-colored balloon. The Nu-Cosian named Bobbajo, also known as the "Crittermonger," used to carry around one such creature in one of his cages.

Zhhee were a non-sentient species of winged lizards. They sported bright colors and had a noisy, mischievous, and obstreperous behavior. Bobbajo, a Nu-Cosian nickamed the "Crittermonger," owned a mated pair of zhhee.

Reestkii was a town located near the equator of the desert planet Jakku. It was also situated over four hundred kilometers away from the only settlement on the planet worth noting, called Niima Outpost.
Gabdorins were a sentient species of large, round-headed amphibians from Gabdor.
Vinsoth was an astronomical object located in the Vinsoth system, a star system in the Quelii sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Nu-Cosian were a genetically-engineered offshoot of the Cosian species. They were created to colonize the planet Cos Secundu. They were long-necked bipeds with muscular tails they used for balance and self-defense. Bobbajo belonged to the species.

The Shadow Caster was a Lancer-class pursuit craft used by the bounty hunter Ketsu Onyo. About four years before the Battle of Yavin, Ketsu used this starship to travel to the planet Garel during an assignment from the Black Sun crime syndicate to obtain the GNK-series power d…
Thwips were a species of non-sentient mouse-like mammals. They were tiny creatures with four eyes and six legs. They had sensitive hearing.
Snees were a species of sentient avians. Those long-beaked creatures were no bigger than a human's fist, including the span of their blue wings.
Ponemah Terminal, also known simply as Ponemah, was a remote desert planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, near the planets Ogem and Jakku in the Mid Rim.

Frigosians were a sentient species that were native to the planet Tansyl 5. Small for the average humanoid, they had sensitive eyes that meant they had to wear goggles to protect them from the light in certain environments.
Sidon Ithano's pirate crew was a crew of pirates led by Captain Sidon Ithano, a pirate who went by the moniker "Crimson Corsair".
The Lost Clusters was a region of the galaxy in Wild Space. Sidon Ithano, known as the Crimson Corsair, was considered the most dangerous pirate to ever sail the Lost Clusters.
The skirmish of Adratharpe 7 was a conflict that took place on Adratharpe 7. Sidon Ithano, known as the Crimson Corsair, was considered the most feared fighter in the battle.
The Narglatch Cave was a cave located in the Paitnnu Wetlands on the Mid Rim world of Naboo, east of the city of Moenia. It was teeming with a colony of narglatches.
The attack on Arda II was a battle of the Galactic Civil War that took place in orbit of the planet Arda II.

Docking Bay 327, also known as Hangar Bay 327 or simply as Bay 327 was a docking bay aboard the Death Star. The docking bay was overseen by a control room, along with a tractor beam projector. It served as a cargo loading assembly area.
B1-CC14 was a B1-series battle droid with masculine programming who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
C5-D9 was a purple and green protocol droid with masculine programming that served as cabin boy in the Weequay pirate Scorza's gang around fifty years after the end of the Clone Wars.
The Imperial vs. Gungan Battle was an ongoing conflict between forces of the Galactic Empire and Gungans loyal to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
The Wheel Races was an event on the planet Jakku that took place north of Ergel's Bar sometime after the Battle of Endor.

Wasp-worms (also spelled as waspworms) were a type of worm that resided in hives on the planet Vrogas Vas, although they were not native to the planet. During a battle on the planet, Han Solo and Doctor Aphra became covered in wasp-worms after shooting a pair of hives.

t: Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)

The Narmle Militia, also known as the Narmle Police Forces, was a militia and police force responsible for defending the city of Narmle on Naboo's moon of Rori.
O-66 was a pilot droid who served on the Scimitar, a Star Courier owned by Darth Sidious.

Hammertown was an area home to a large Ithorian population in Takobo City on the world Takobo. During the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire, two Imperial Inquisitors—the Seventh Sister and the Fifth Brother—captured a Force-sensitive Ithorian there.

Niima Outpost was a junkyard settlement on Jakku, a desert planet in the Western Reaches of the galaxy. The outpost was named for and founded by Niima the Hutt after the Battle of Jakku to capitalize on the new scavenging opportunities the battle created on the planet.
The Mountaintop smugglers were a criminal organization in operation during the time of the Galactic Civil War. The organization primarily consisted of smugglers and spice runners.

Amethia Prime was a planet located in the galaxy's Inner Rim. It had at least one large ocean which was spotted with volcanoes. During the Age of the Empire, crime lord Big String based his operations on an island fortress there.
Aryx were large bipedal birds native to the Mid Rim planet Cerea. The Cerean rebel Kidi Aleri rode the birds at some point in her life prior to Operation Yellow Moon in 4 ABY.

The Dowutin were a species of large humanoids that were native to the frigid planet Dowut, which was located in the Core Worlds. Dowutins were known for their great size and strength, facial horns, and long lifespans.
The Quantum Storm was a GR-75 medium transport in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Scum-squids were a type of carnivorous squid that could eat humans and were found on the Hutt Space and Outer Rim moon Nar Shaddaa.

Lava eels were a type of eel that lived in the dolovite mines on the volcanic world of Mustafar. For years, lava eels were kept out of the mines by Kongo the Disemboweler before he was taken to fight in Grakkus' arena on Nar Shaddaa.

Xandanks were predatory creatures that lived in the dolovite mines on the volcanic world of Mustafar. For years, Xandanks were kept out of the mines by Kongo the Disemboweler before he was taken to fight in Grakkus Arena on Nar Shaddaa.
Celanon was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, situated along the Hydian Way which connected it to Junction and Botajef. It was home to the Astarte line.
Anthan 12 was a moon that orbited the planet Anthan Prime in the Anthan system.
Anthan 1 was a moon that orbited the planet Anthan Prime in the Anthan system of the Outer Rim Territories' Albarrio sector.

The Hassks were a sentient species native to Hasskyn. They were almost completely covered in fur, except for their gray-skinned faces. They had sensitive hearing and keen night vision, all the better for hunting.

The Glacial Remnants was the name given to the remains of a glacier located in the northeastern corner of the Glacial Fissure region on the planet Hoth, adjacent to the Glacial Paths and the Upper Pass from the Highmount Ridge.
