objective: Locate Lor San Tekka and ask him for help locating Luke Skywalker
x: During the Cold War, the mission to Ovanis was undertaken by Commander Poe Dameron and Black Squadron of the Resistance when they traveled to the planet Ovanis to find Lor San Tekka to ask for his help in locating Jedi Master Luke Skywalker.

The Education Ministry was a government department of the Galactic Empire that operated on Lothal during the Age of the Empire. Kinera Tiree was the daughter of Fondana Tiree, the Imperial education minister on Lothal.

A battle took place between Phoenix Cell and the Galactic Empire between 4 BBY and 3 BBY. The Phoenix Squadron was able to retreat relatively unscathed but lost Phoenix Three to a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter.
The Ayalam was an Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle that was used by the Ripoblus during the Sepan Civil War.
The Noerbo was an Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle that was used by the Ripoblus during the Sepan Civil War.
The Yawnor was an Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle that was used by the Ripoblus during the Sepan Civil War.
In the months following the Battle of Endor, New Republic and Galactic Empire forces fought a battle on the planet Naalol.
Moths were small species of insect no bigger than a human hand. They were notoriously good fliers, able to fly in all directions. They came in many colors, such as brown and white.

The Atawar was an Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle that was used during the Sepan Civil War by the Dimoks. The Escort Shuttle was part of a defense force for Science Station Youst, an XQ1 Platform that was officially a science station, but was also secretly a weapons lab.
The Nipasa was an Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle that was used during the Sepan Civil War by the Dimoks.

The Moth was a MK-4 freighter owned by Owerto Naiucho, used for smuggling illegal goods. After the Battle of Endor, he used it to travel to the planet Akiva. Following the death of Owerto, the New Republic starfighter pilot Norra Wexley took ownership of the Moth.
Suoi Tre was a cargo ferry Dimok forces used during the Sepan Civil War.
Can Giouc was a cargo ferry Dimok forces used during the Sepan Civil War.

The Arabu was a group of 2 escort shuttles that was used by the Ripoblus during the Sepan Civil War. At Sepan 8 they were part of the Ripoblus defense force for a transfer between the children's leaders of both the Dimok and Ripoblus factions as part of a new treaty between th…

The Berono was a group of 2 escort shuttles that was used by the Ripoblus during the Sepan Civil War. At Sepan 8 they were part of the Ripoblus defence force for a transfer between the children's leaders of both the Dimok and Ripoblus factions as part of a new treaty between t…

The Degio was a group of 2 escort shuttles that was used by the Ripoblus during the Sepan Civil War. At Sepan 8 they were part of the Ripoblus defence force for a transfer between the children's leaders of both the Dimok and Ripoblus factions as part of a new treaty between th…
The Calitana was a group of 2 escort shuttles that was used by the Ripoblus during the Sepan Civil War.

Scouter was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. The transport participated in the mission at Argoon, attacking an abandoned cargo area near the planet Argoon. The transport was destroyed in the battle.
Splinter was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that saw service with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Zenn-La was a location in the Zenn-La system within the Venzeiia sector of the Expansion Region and the Slice. It was situated in grid sqaure O-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of Jlibbous, a chef who was renowned for greatness by 146 BBY.
Ovanis was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories on which the followers of a religion known as the Crèche dwelled.
In 4 BBY, several dissidents on the planet Garel staged an impromptu protest against the local Imperial authorities' destruction of a controversial statue by the artist Janyor of Bith.

The Fortress was a cave on the planet Jelucan, named such by Ciena Ree and Thane Kyrell. The two friends spent years furnishing it with fur rugs and blankets from Ciena's family, and luxurious castoffs from Thane's.

The Sapphire Rogue was a starship that responded to the hyper-transceiver beacon that Leia Organa and her team placed on Sesid during Operation Yellow Moon. It was the size of a a small freighter but accelerated like an attack ship.

During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire waged a pacification campaign on the planet Meastrinnar. During the campaign, the Imperial Security Bureau intercepted a transmission that placed an Alliance intelligence cell in the city of Vondrel.

During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire stage an attack on the planet Kostra. During the engagement, the Alliance pilot Fulkrehm Protial was forced down in his Y-wing and exposed to near-fatal levels of trosilon nerve toxin.

The battle of Miztoc City was fought on the planet Miztoc. Alliance member Argon Doehn fought in the battle, and vital assistance was offered by Mygo Skinto which led to Miztoc remaining out of Imperial control.
The capture of Alpha Outpost was an Alliance victory used to distract Imperial attention from the Alliance's operations on Ralltiir. The Defel Thar'quan played a vital role in the operation.
The Daisy Mae was a unique customized Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor owned by Admiral Gial Ackbar.
Ubdurians were a species of sentient humanoids native to Nag Ubdur and Ubduria. Their bald heads featured dark eyes seated deep in their sockets, but no visible nose.

PZ-99, nicknamed "Peezee-Ninety-Nine," was a security droid that appeared to have originally have been a PZ protocol droid. He served at the Battle of Jakku and later the Resistance during its struggle against the First Order.
0-MR1, more often referred to as Omri, was an RA-7 protocol droid who served the First Order during the Cold War.

Crul was a planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim that was covered in warm, shallow, and salty seas and lagoons. It was the homeworld of two sentient species: the Crolutes, who were exclusively male, and the Gilliands, who were exclusively female.

The Gilliands were one of the two sentient species that lived on the oceanic planet of Crul. They were exclusively female, while the other species, the Crolutes, were exclusively male. Z'Vk'Thkrkza was a Gilliand who ran a tavern on the Colossus, located on the planet Castilon.
2MED2, spelled Toomedtoo, was a medical droid who served the Resistance during the Cold War.
CO-34, also called "See-Oh Three Four," was a CLL-M2 binary loadlifter who served the Resistance during its conflict against the First Order
VL-44, also called "Vee-El Forty-Four," was a security droid who appeared to have originally been a PK-series worker droid. He served the Resistance during the Cold War.

affiliation: Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research
headquarters: Imperial Center of Military Research, Scarif
x: The Tarkin Initiative, also knows as the Grand Moff Tarkin Initiative or the Tarkin Institute, was a secret think tank within the Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research, an agency that belonged to Imperial Intelligence and the Imperial Security Bureau.

This Tarkin Initiative base was where the BT-1 assassin droid was created. Sometime before the secret mission to Geonosis, the BT-1 prototype, revealed to be homicidal, killed everyone in the base and then set it to self-destruct, as the assassin droid jettisoned into space.

Shuttle S257 was a Sentinel-class landing craft of the Galactic Empire's naval forces. Sometime in 4 BBY, the shuttle was stolen by the rebels of Phoenix Cell, where it was used by Kanan Jarrus and Rex in their mission to an experimental Interdictor-class heavy cruiser in orde…

Glaive Squadron was an elite TIE/D Defender squadron within the Galactic Empire. It was identified by a crimson-red hull, not unlike the Emperor's Royal Guard TIE/IN starfighters. Countess Iran Ryad was a former member of the unit.

Oosalon Mesa was a mesa located on the planet Oosalon, a barren world in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. In 3 BBY, it was the site of a duel in which Kanan Jarrus and Ezra Bridger fought against the Fifth Brother and Seventh Sister.

Intelligence Post Drazaal was an outpost established by Imperial Intelligence in the Duros Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Duros slums, also known as the Duros Residential Zone, was a section of the Duros Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. It was home numerous alien refugees.
Rana Mas Square was a public square in Umbarra Plaza within the Duros Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Umbarra Plaza was a section of the Duros Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The plaza was the site of Rana Mas Square, and the Hutt Cartel maintained a safe house in the area.
The rebel refugee zone was the name given to part of the Duros slums in the Duros Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Rana'Inrull District was a district in the Duros Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The district was home to Duros Plaza and Mutotech Labs.
The Transit Hub was the name given to the westernmost section of the Duros Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The Transit Hub Corridor was a street in the Red Light Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Red Light Slums was a rundown residential section of the Red Light Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The criminal Bleeder gangs controlled the area, as they did most of the Red Light Sector.
The Red Light Sector Concourse was a marketplace and public plaza in the Red Light Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Askajians were a sentient humanoid species that were native to the planet Askaji. On their homeworld, they lived in tribes led by a chief. Jedi Master Klefan Opus and Yarna d'al' Gargan, who was forced to dance for Jabba the Hutt as one of his slaves, were both Askajians.

B33 was an astromech droid that was owned by the Kubaz banker Rikard Lovas. Fitted with a restraining bolt, B33 was a member of Lovas' droid posse and was used in the Kubaz's attempt to fake the robbery of his own starship.

The molsume was a large, multilegged predator native to the jungles of Ithor. It had twin poisonous fangs and a jewel-like, iridescent pelt warning potential predators that its flesh was also toxic. Once it scented food, the molsume could attack with high speed.

District 1 was the first and lowest level of the city known as the Spire on the planet Zakuul. Like all of the other districts or levels of the Spire, District 1 was labyrinthian in design and boasted a variety of museums, restaurants, and other entertainment venues.

District 36 was the thirty-sixth level of the city known as the Spire on the planet Zakuul. Like all of the other districts, or levels, of the Spire, District 36 was labyrinthian in design and boasted a variety of museums, restaurants, and other entertainment venues; all of th…

The Kintan Kingdom was the name given to a region of the Nikto Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The area was named for the Kintan Kings, a criminal gang that controlled the Nikto Sector.
The Swoop Bike Drag was an area of the Nikto Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Alien Arms Bazaar was a weapons market located in the Wannschok Tenements in the Nikto Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The Prison Depths was a sector of Shadow Town, a prison complex operated by the reconstituted Sith Empire on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
The Violent Prisoners Ward was a sector of Shadow Town, a prison complex operated by the reconstituted Sith Empire on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
A factory owned by Damrosch the Hutt was located in the Lower Industrial Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

Ankmeer Plaza was a public plaza located in the Lower Industrial Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. Damrosch the Hutt oversaw his nearby factory from the plaza.
A warehouse was used by the Sith Empire in the Lower Industrial Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. It was heavily patrolled by Imperial droids and soldiers.
The Datacenter District, best known as the Datacenter Back Alley, was a sector of Network Access of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
The Imperial data center was a data center operated by the Sith Empire in Network Access, part of the Network Security District of the moon Nar Shaddaa.
The Imperial explosives lab was a laboratory operated by the Sith Empire in the Network Security District of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.

The Imperial implantation lab was a laboratory operated by the reconstituted Sith Empire in the Network Security District of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Empire and the Galactic Republic.
Data Systems Infrastructure was a sector of the Network Security District of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The Grid Databanks was a sector of the Network Security District of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

The Systech Quarter was a quarter of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. The Network Security District and the High Security Lockdown were located within the quarter.

The transit bridge was an area in the Network Security District of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The Empire occupied the bridge, using it as their forward base in the district.

The Wandering Diva, or simply the Diva, was a starship piloted by the Jedi explorer known as Ley Neetels at least three thousand years before the reign of the Galactic Empire. Equipped with a hyperdrive, the vessel was used by Neetels to traverse the galaxy's Deep Core.
Riosa was a planet located in the Inner Rim region of the galaxy.

affiliation: Committee for transportation of construction materials
x: The Elder Houses, also known as the Great Houses, were the collected hereditary royal houses of the galaxy. They included the House of Organa and Lady Carise Sindian's family.

Draboon was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Mandalore sector. During the Mandalorian Civil War circa 42 BBY, Satine Kryze of the Mandalorian House Kryze came under the protection of Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi.

In 0 ABY, the rebel spy Eneb Ray carried out a prison siege at Sunspot in retaliation for the deaths of pro-rebel senators and Rebel Alliance operatives during the Arrth-Eno Mission. Eneb sought to kill all Imperial prisoners housed in the Alliance's top-secret Sunspot Prison.

Lonerans were a sentient species from the Expansion Region planet Lonera that had long, silky fur the color of gold and four thin, extended limbs that allowed them to walk on two feet or all fours with equal ease.
Ashaftans were a diminutive sentient species that had wooly fur. In 28 ABY, the Ashaftans were represented in the New Republic Galactic Senate.

Birren was a small, quiet Inner Rim planet that was originally settled by both Alderaanian and Arkanisian explorers. After the destruction of Alderaan, it was one of the few places where candlewick flowers still grew naturally.

A rebel cell led by Commander Ryden initially had its headquarters on the planet of Imvur. It was part of early rebel movement, headed in secret by Senator Bail Organa of Alderaan, that would become the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Verpine were an insectoid sentient species that controlled Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines, a droid manufacturer. Effor was a member of the Verpine species.

The Stone Needle was a spindle of rock located in Beggar's Canyon on the desert planet Tatooine. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, when Luke Skywalker successfully operated an X-wing flight simulator, he felt as he had the first time he threaded the Stone Needle in his T-16 …
The dead-enders were a group of elderly men who lived in Carbon Ridge mountain on the desert planet Jakku.
CZ-1G5, referred to as Seezee, was a CZ-series secretary/business communications droid that lived on the planet Jakku.

t: Skirmish at the abandoned Jakku moisture farm
result: Constable Zuvio destroys several droids and arrests Rikard Lovas for t
x: A skirmish took place on the desert planet Jakku in and around an abandoned moisture farm between Constable Zuvio of the Niima Outpost and the droid posse of Rikard Lovas.

Ming Po Town, also known as Ming Po village was a small town that was the home of the Ming Po on the planet Carlac. A number of buildings in the town were burned and destroyed by Death Watch forces commanded by Pre Vizsla.

Imvur was a planet located in the Hasmir system within the Mid Rim Territories. Between 4 BBY and 3 BBY Imvur was controlled by the Galactic Empire, although a rebel cell of the larger rebellion had a base there.
Evac One was an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser originally known as Transport Ship 63378 which was stolen from the Galactic Empire and later used as an evac ship by the Spectres.

Harloff Minor was a planet in the Harloff Minor system of the Core Worlds, near Coruscant. The heavily-traveled world, with its large equatorial cities, was considered a center of commerce and culture in the galaxy.
Takobo City was the capital city of Takobo. During the reign of the Galactic Empire an Ithorian populated area known as Hammertown was located in the city.

Bakkun was a group of three Imperial Navy cargo ferries. They were part of a convoy under escort by the Victory-class Star Destroyer Stalwart that was to deliver supplies and building materials to the Nebulon-B2 frigate Ludwick, with the intentions of establishing a space stat…
R2-Q5 was an R2-series astromech droid. Made by Industrial Automaton, he served the Galactic Empire aboard the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station, performing maintenance and repair as needed.
Vodran was a swampy, murky jungle planet located in the Vodran system in the Si'Klaata Cluster of Hutt Space, in grid square S-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Runeer was the designation of a group of two Assassin-class corvettes under the service of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. They were used by the Alliance as part of their first attack on Space Installation NL-1.

Reload was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by the Galactic Empire during the Battle on the Frontier campaign. During the campaign, then, Vice Admiral Thrawn's wanted to inspect Platform NL-1, which had its construction recently completed.
The Republic Power Generation was a region of the Upper Industrial Sector on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The Large Scale Production Facilities was a industrial area in the Upper Industrial Sector on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Imperial Special Ops Center was a military base established by the reconstituted Sith Empire along the Main Production Boulevard in the Upper Industrial Sector on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
Taxel was the name of a group of two Rebel Alliance Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transports that were used as part of a last ditch attack on Station NL-1 during the Battle on the Frontier.
Clipper was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that saw service with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War at the Battle on the Frontier.

The Trident was a Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport used by Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. The transport participated in the Battle of Mylok IV, in particular at the finalization of a deal between the Habeen and Admiral Zaarin for new hyperdrive technology.

Independent Movement for Self-Determination was an organization led by Count Dooku. It was mentioned in Count Dooku: Words of Truth, a propaganda poster to advertise a series of lectures that Count Dooku was supposed to give at Reena University.

R0-GR, or "Roger," was a B1-series battle droid who served the Freemakers, a human family of scavengers that traveled throughout the galaxy. He was a veteran of the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars. He had a mismatched torso and right arm.
Moragans were a sentient species native to the planet Moraga. Morfizo and his wife Morfizia were members of the species.

Gonk's Infinite Loop was the name given to a yard in the Attis Station complex on the planet Quesh during the Cold War and Galactic War. During the Quesh war, it was patrolled by a battle droid belonging to the Hutt Cartel that had gone rogue and attacked anything in sight.
The Yuna Crosscut was a tunnel carved through the cliff beneath Attis Station on the planet Quesh during the Galactic War.

The Yuna Bore venom mine was a Quesh venom mine operated by the Galactic Republic on the planet Quesh during the Galactic War. The mine was attacked and destroyed by the forces of the reconstituted Sith Empire under Moff Dracen during the Quesh war.
Badger was the designation given to a pair of cargo ferries used by former Galactic Empire Admiral Harkov's fleet following Harkov's defection to the Rebellion.
Whell was a Cargo ferry used by Admiral Harkov's fleet when they defected to the Rebellion.
Moogans were a sentient humanoid species native to the planet Mooga. They had slender builds with long limbs and a long neck as well as bright green blood.

Mooga was a planet located in the Mooga system in the Perkell sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was homeworld of the sentient Moogan species. Controlled by the Commerce Guild during the Clone Wars, the Moogan smuggler Tee Va hailed from this world.
The Kuliquo belt was an airless and lightless asteroid field in the Inner Rim used for mining for the Galactic Empire's war effort during the Galactic Civil War.

Inyusu Tor was a large volcanic mountain on Sullust. At the top of it was the Inyusu Tor mineral processing facility. As well as this, Sullust's capital Pinyumb was located under the south side of the mountain.

The Herald was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer serving under Prelate Verge. Near the end of the Mid Rim Retreat, Verge pulled Captain Tabor Seitaron from his retirement to help him hunt Governor Everi Chalis who defected from her post at Haidoral Prime to the Alliance to Rest…

Fillithar were a snake-like sentient species hailing from the world of the same name. As a serpentine life-form, they lacked hindquarters. Their tail, however, was prehensile. During the High Republic Era, the Fillithar Jedi Master Simmix trained the Padawan Cohmac Vitus.

A species of white-winged birds was native to the planet of Alderaan. They flew in an X-formation, always westward, and they circled the planet once a year so that different regions marked their seasons by the birds' appearance.

Theron was a planet in the Theron system in the Vilonis sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square O-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid, whose surface featured famous spiral stone formations. It had a strong racing culture, including podracing and the Five Sabers tournament.

The Five Sabers was a prestigious piloting championship held on Theron. As its name suggested, the contest was comprised of five stages: the atmospheric dash, the orbital sprints, the lunar relays, the sublight relays, and hyperspace orienteering.

Pamarthens were a cultural group of humans from the planet of Pamarthe. They had their own language and they enjoyed a reputation for courage, skill, and enthusiasm. Most Pamarthens learned how to handle watercraft at a young age and, eventually, how to pilot starships.

The Double-A was a modified RZ-1 A-wing interceptor that was created by Novaldex twenty-four years after the Battle of Endor. It had modded fins, and a metal coating that made its hull shiny and reflective like a mirror.
The Nomme was a Container transport under the service of the Empire, during the Galactic Civil War.
The Libro was a YT-1300 light freighter used by the Galactic Empire.
The Hut was a YT-1300 light freighter used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
The Subcom was an Imperial BFF-1 bulk freighter that was present during the Zaarin insurrection.
Teal was an Imperial BFF-1 bulk freighter that was present during the Zaarin insurrection.
Renegade was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by Imperial forces during the Galactic Civil War. The Renegade took part on the first skirmish on Deep Space Manufacturing Facility ZA-13.
The Ravenous was a Maxima-A-class heavy cruiser of the First Order Navy around 30 years after the Battle of Endor. During the Cold War, Agent Terex commanded the ship during the Mission to Ovanis.
The Elpi was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport that was used part Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin forces

The Khramboans were a diminutive species of blue-skinned, black-eyed sentients. Khramboan eyes were on the sides of horizontal eyestalks at the center of their egg-shaped heads, and their mouth was covered with tentacle-like appendages.
The StarScavenger was a starship owned by the Freemakers, a family of scavengers. They used the ship to collect and transport scrap and travel across the galaxy.
Clone paratroopers, also known as airborne clones or Airborne Troopers, were specialized clone troopers trained for airborne operations in the Grand Army of the Republic.

The Amaxine warriors were a paramilitary organization active during the New Republic Era commanded by Arliz Hadrassian and named after an ancient warrior culture. They first made themselves known by bombing the New Republic Senate building.
Blue was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by the Rebel Alliance.
The Leopard was a Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport used by the Empire.
The Empire employed and retrofitted Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport Resupply to reload starfighters should they run out of warheads in battle.
The Java was a Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport that was used by the Empire.
Nikto beetles were a type of beetle which, when served as kebabs, were considered a delicacy by members of the sentient Nikto species.

Pacho was a group of Heavy Lifters that were employed by the Empire. They were inside the Imperial Star Destroyer Adarga to pick up cargo containers carrying TIE Defender prototypes that rogue Grand Admiral Zaarin was trying to steal.

Gatalenta was a warm, uncommonly tranquil planet located in the Gatalenta system in Core Worlds famed for its tea, lengthy, erudite poetry and meditative retreats. It was situated along the Trellen Trade Route.

Pamarthe was an Outer Rim planet located in the Pamarthe system of the Mayagil sector that was home to the human culture known as the Pamarthens, who were known for being excellent pilots, as well as for their courage and gusto.

Bastatha was a planet in the Bastatha system of the Inner Rim. Independent from the New Republic in the years following the Galactic Civil War, Bastatha became a haven for organized crime, and the Kajain'sa'Nikto crime lord Rinnrivin Di ran his cartel on the planet.

The Mirrorbright was the personal starship of Leia Organa during her years as a New Republic Senator. Usually piloted by Organa's assistant, Greer Sonnel, the Mirrorbright was a glossy white ship with an unconventional W-shape that allowed for the concealment of some custom-mo…
Sibensko was an aquatic planet in the Sibensko system in the Bes Ber Bikade sector of the Expansion Region, situated along the Corellian Trade Spine between Cymoon and Kinyen.

Orinda was a planet on the Entralla Route in the Orinda system in the Irishi sector in the Mid Rim Territories and New Territories. The rebel Cloud-Riders raided a fueling depot there by 10 BBY and were joined by one of the depot's security guards, Batcha Hunaris.

The Ossifrage was an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor that was owned by Greer Sonnel. At some point, the ship had been used to fight the Galactic Empire, and had been slightly damaged. Greer purchased the A-wing, modifying it, and used it during a race known as The Gauntlet.

place: Senatorial conference building, New Republic senatorial complex, Repub
x: The so-called Napkin Bombing occurred when the Amaxine warriors bombed a conference building of the New Republic's Galactic Senate on Hosnian Prime.

place: Pressy's Tumble refinery complex, Pressylla system
x: During the New Republic Era, the miners at a First Order–owned mining colony in Pressy's Tumble, an artificial asteroid field in the Outer Rim Territories, staged a strike to protest the harsh living and working conditions there.

Daxam IV, also referred to simply as Daxam, was a cold, desert planet in the Outer Rim Territories, at the edge of the binary star system of the same name. It was connected by hyperspace route to Rior and Azzameen Station, and was also near the planet Pamarthe.

Noult was a planet that played host to a slaughter during the Galactic Civil War. The planet was later found to have housed a secret Rebel base. The incident on Noult was later remarked by Ransolm Casterfo as an example of the Rebel Alliance's so-called terrorist tactics.

Vivonah was a terrestrial astronomical object that was assaulted by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. It was located in the Vivonah system in the Atravis sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square L-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Glowfish were a type of fish found on the planet Sibensko. They had blue-white fins and traveled in schools.

Lonera was the homeworld of the Loneran species. It was located in the Inner Rim Territories along the Nanth'ri Trade Route between Antar and Gyndine. The fact Lonera was near the galaxy's Expansion Region was met with derision by some.
The Association of Small Craft Manufacturers was a trade group engaged in lobbying activities on the New Republic capital of Hosnian Prime in 28 ABY.
Gad was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Gad system in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square M-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Snowbirds were a species of migratory avian creature that lived on the New Republic capital planet of Hosnian Prime.

Crystal Cairn was a professional starship racing team active in the years following the Galactic Civil War. Greer Sonnel was a member of Crystal Cairn for two years until she retired following a bloodburn diagnosis.
The Western Wastes was a desert region on the planet Daxam IV, inhabited by Arliz Hadrassian and the Amaxine warriors in 28 ABY.

The Rieekan was a transport ship operated by the New Republic in the decades after the Galactic Civil War. The transport shared its namesake with Carlist Rieekan, a general of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The battle of the Eva-T system was a two-stage conflict fought between the Galactic Empire, Nami pirates and the Rebel Alliance after discovering that the Nami had operational TIE Defenders.

result: Abduction of TIE Defender Chief scientist
x: The ambush on Hashim was a battle that concluded the T/D Technology campaign.
Rinnrivin Di's cartel, also known as Rinnrivin Di's criminal empire, was a Nikto cartel created and led by the Kajain'sa'Nikto Rinnrivin Di during the New Republic Era.

Resistance pilots were pilots who served the Resistance under its starfighter corps. They fought in countless battles against the First Order forces during the Cold War and fought in the subsequent war between the First Order and the Resistance.

EGL-21, also known as "AMPS" or "Amps," was a manumitted EGL power droid based in Niima Outpost on the desert planet Jakku. He welded objects for scavengers in exchange for power, spare gas canisters, interesting metals, or a good joke.
The Wreck Belt was a debris field orbiting the planet Lotho Minor.

headquarters: Fortress-Home of the Open, Open's mountain
x: The Open were a faction of near-humans that lived on the planet Carnelion IV. They were at war with the Closed, a rival faction.
The Closed were a faction of near-humans with three vertical slits instead of ears, that lived on the planet Carnelion IV. They were at war with the Open, a rival faction.
The battle of Yrrna was an attack on an Imperial cargo area in the Yrrna system.

result: Galactic Empire victory Ali Tarrak captured
x: The capture of Ali Tarrak was the final battle that put an end to the Renegade proliferation of the TIE Defenders, the capture of the Nami leader Ali Tarrak and the conclusion of the New Threats campaign.
The Sarlaccs were a criminal gang based in Gorse City on the Inner Rim world of Gorse during the Age of the Empire. The gang was named after the sarlacc, a large predatory creature.

place: Senate Square, outside the New Republic senatorial complex, Republic C
x: In 28 ABY, a dedication ceremony was held on Hosnian Prime, in honor of Senator Bail Organa, a founder of the Rebel Alliance. During the ceremony, a seventy-meter-high Jelucani fogstone statue of him, designed by Janyor of Bith, was revealed.

During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance launched an assault on Vivonah. Years later, during the time of peace in the New Republic, Senator Ransolm Casterfo used it as an example of the so-called terrorist tactics used by the Rebels.
The Choora was a YT-1300 light freighter owned and operated by the Nami during the Galactic Civil War.

place: Eternal Throne room, the Spire, Zakuul
