Vitiate's spirit invades the body of the Outlander, who is then frozen
Arcann becomes the new Eternal Emperor and begins the Eternal Empire c
x: In the aftermath of the first skirmish with the Eternal Fleet in 3636 BBY, two prominent figures of the ongoing Galactic War—Darth Marr and the Outlander—were taken prisoner and brought before Emperor Valkorion of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul.
Proto 11 was one of 12 TIE/D Defender prototypes created by Grand Admiral Zaarin.
Proto 12 was one of 12 TIE/D Defender prototypes created by Grand Admiral Zaarin.

CL-5 was a combat utility vehicle launched by the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Grey Wolf during the operation to capture Nami Crime Lord Ali Tarrak. Its role was to refill Imperial Starfighters with warheads during battle

K-2SO was a modified KX-series security droid who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Originally created for the Imperial Army, the droid was deployed in 2 BBY as part of the Galactic Empire's efforts to quell protests on the planet Ghorman.
Death troopers, also known as death soldiers or AWR Troopers, were an elite variant of stormtroopers specializing in stealth, espionage and lethality that served the Galactic Empire.

New Republic soldiers, also known as New Republic Troopers or New Republic troops, were the soldiers of the New Republic's Defense Force. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, Republic soldiers fought on the planet Uyter.

SBT 1 was a Heavy Lifter used by forces loyal to rogue Grand Admiral Zaarin. The Lifter was present at a Supply Base located in the Gwar system. Imperial forces lead by Captain Kuuztin launched an attack on the base and destroyed the base, but fell into a trap.
Nordis Prime was a planet located in the galaxy's Mid Rim. It was on this world that security cameras picked up BeeLee Amdas's ID, leading to her death at the hands of Ryn Biggleston.

Jaresh was a planet in the Corva sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A key member of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era, Jaresh received a sky-island at the Republic Fair on Valo which contained a representation of its bustling markets.
Scorza, a Weequay pirate who once worked with Sidon Ithano, led a gang of pirates after betraying his Delphidian partner.

Dybrinthe were a humanoid sentient species native to the Deep Core moon of Dybrin 12. Due to the moon's poisonous and highly pressurized atmosphere, Dybrinthe out of Dybrin 12 had to wear large helmets and breathing gear when they left their homeworld.
Comra was an astronomical object located in the Prefsbelt sector's Comra system in the Outer Rim Territories that was represented in the New Republic Senate by the Centrist Mortan in 28 ABY.
Thession was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Thession system of the Bortele sector, within an intersecting portion of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice regions.
Tokuut was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Demetras sector's Tokuut system, within an intersecting portion of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories.

result: All patients, droids and medical staff killed
x: In 0 ABY, the notorious bounty hunter Beilert Valance led his crew in a wholesale slaughter of the neutral and unarmed medical center Anglebay Station on Telos IV.
Demiloch was a terrestrial astronomical object located in an eponymous star system in Lannik Space within an intersecting portion of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice regions.

Promencius Four was an Old Tionese colonial backwater located in the Promencius system of the Outer Rim Territories's Thanium sector. Situated at the coordinates S-5 on the Standard Galactic Grid, it was considered rare to see a sanitation station there.
M2-M5 was an engineering droid who served the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, also known as Twilight Company, during the Galactic Civil War.

Yaga Minor was an industrialized planet located in the Outer Rim Territories where shipyards were located. A base of the Ubiqtorate, the Galactic Empire's military intelligence branch, was also located at the planet.

The Laguna Caves were caves on the desert planet of Tatooine. In the last decades of the Galactic Republic, they were part of the Boonta Eve Classic racetrack. Because of a canyon krayt dragon that had taken residence there, rescue teams never dared to enter the caves.

Mos Espa Market was a marketplace located in the city of Mos Espa, a spaceport on the desert planet of Tatooine. At the time of the Invasion of Naboo, it was possible to buy gorgs for seven wupiupi apiece in Mos Espa Market.

The Shawda Ubb (also spelled Shawda-Ubb) were a species of squat, green-skinned, potbellied sentients. They had four thin limbs that ended in three digits apiece, and small heads whose faces sported heavy brow ridges. As an inborn defense mechanism, they were able to spit poison.
IG-102 was one of the two IG-100 MagnaGuards, with IG-101, that served as General Grievous's droid bodyguards aboard the Invisible Hand during the Battle of Coruscant.
Hok was an astronomical object located in the Hok system of the galaxy's Colonies region that was the homeworld of the Gran podracer Mawhonic.

Kowak was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Kowakian monkey-lizards, the kowakian ape-lizards, and mole-fleas. The Zygerrian Prince Sono Molec ruled over the Zygerrian Slave Empire from his palace on the planet Kowak.
Manpha was a wet and swampy planet located in Manpha system of the Seitia sector, a part of the Outer Rim Territories and the Western Reaches.
Uba IV was a terrestrial planet occupying the fourth orbital position in the Uba system, a part of the Barsa sector of the Mid Rim Territories.

This MagnaGuard, alongside a green counterpart, were present alongside a few other Separatist-aligned battle droids in the caves of Utapau. However, several of the droids ended up devoured by Nos monsters.

This MagnaGuard, alongside a gold counterpart, were present alongside a few other Separatist-aligned battle droids in the caves of Utapau. However, several of the droids ended up devoured by Nos monsters.

Council was a planet in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A world of rocky mountains, it was the heart of the Noble Court, the original rulers of the Nothoiin species that once controlled the whole sector.

Askaj, also known as Askaji, was a planet located in the Askaj system in the Cegul sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the Askajian species. On Askaji, the native Askajians lived in tribes led by a chief.

Coastal defender stormtroopers—more commonly known as shoretroopers and also known as the coastal guard, with those stationed on the planet Scarif referred to as Scarif stormtroopers—were a specialized variant of the Galactic Empire's stormtroopers trained and equipped for com…
The Eclipse Fighter was a starship owned by Naare, a female Sith agent who worked for the Galactic Empire. The vessel consisted of a centralized cockpit built around a part of retractable wings.

Fusai was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Fusai system within the Fusai sector, a subsector of the Zuma sector, in the Outer Rim. It was situated in grid square H-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Xelric Draw was a shallow, wide-mouthed canyon that split the Mospic High Range of mountains at the north-western edge of the Northern Dune Sea, a part of the small inhabitable region in the northern hemisphere of the desert planet Tatooine.
The Great Mesra Plateau was a highland area of the desert planet of Tatooine. The city of Mos Eisley was located on the plateau, north of Anchorhead.
The Western Dune Sea was a region of the Dune Sea on Tatooine. During his time as a hermit on Tatooine, Obi-Wan Kenobi lived in a house on the edge of the Western Dune Sea.

The South Ridge, or South Slope, was an area on the Clabburn Range of the frozen planet of Hoth. It was located immediately to the south of Echo Base, a hidden base built by the Rebel Alliance in the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin.

The Wawaatt Archipelago was a group of islands on the planet of Kashyyyk. It notably contained the coastal city of Kachirho. During the Battle of Kashyyyk, Separatist forces occupied the Archipelago, but Kachirho remained under Wookiee and Galactic Republic control.

Slave Quarters Row, also called the Slave Quarter, was an area located on the outskirts of Mos Espa, a spaceport city on Tatooine. It consisted of a series of small hovels stacked atop each other that were originally built by the mining companies who first colonized Tatooine.
Subterrel was a planet located in the Subterrel system in the Subterrel sector of the Outer Rim Territories. At some point before the Clone Wars, Dexter Jettster spent time prospecting on Subterrel.
Horthav was a planet located in the Kuat sector of the Core Worlds.

The Junior Sabers was a piloting competition and the junior version of the Five Sabers championships. Greer Sonnel was one of the competitors who flew for the Crystal Cairn team, and competed from 23 ABY to 25 ABY.

Zone Forty-Two was a blasting zone on the moon Cynda, which orbited the planet Gorse. The dissident miner Skelly tried to convince Moonglow Polychemical and the other mining companies not to conduct blasting past Zone Forty-Two while he conducted a test bombing.

Zone Thirty-Nine was a blasting zone on the mining moon of Cynda. During the Age of the Empire, the mining company Dalborg Mining conducted thorilide mining operations there using Baradium bisulfate to free the diamond crystals.

The Blue Ghosts were a criminal gang that operated in the Anoat sector. By the time of the Iron Blockade, they had nearly been wiped out in a territorial dispute with the powerful Ivax Syndicate. However, the surviving Ghosts worked hard to regain their favor with the Syndicate.

Tei-Untis was a planet inhabited by Zabraks that was located in the Tei-Untis system of the Core Worlds and the Interior. It was situated in grid square K-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid. A kleptocracy, it was governed by thieves.

The Bastatha security forces was the law enforcement organization on the planet Bastatha. The Niktos Tosta and Xun were corrupt magistrates in the security forces, and were in league with Rinnrivin Di's cartel.
Zone Sixty-Six was a mining zone on the moon Cynda. During the Gorse Conflict, Imperial stormtroopers acting under Count Denetrius Vidian's orders ordered an evacuation and conducted a test bombing.
Fetch was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

The Piimi was a Strike-class medium cruiser that was used by the Rebel Alliance to defend the Sealion, a prototype of the Missile Boat that was sent to the XQ4 Platform Enin'sd by the Mon Calamari Cruiser Link.

The Firefox was a Strike-class medium cruiser that was used by the Rebel Alliance to defend the Sealion, a prototype of the Missile Boat that was sent to the XQ4 Platform Enin'sd by the Mon Calamari Cruiser Link.
The Opos was a YT-1300 transport used by the Rebel Alliance. The freighter attempted to dock with the XQ4 Platform Enin'sd, but it was destroyed in the process by Tan Maarek Stele.

t: Destruction of the Missile Boat facilities
result: Zaarin coup forces victory, all available Missile Boats recalled by Em
x: The destruction of the Missile Boat facilities was a series of sneak attacks committed by forces led by Rogue Grand Admiral Zaarin, on the Empire's Missile Boat production facilities that forced a recall on all active Missile Boats.

During the Galactic Civil War, an attack was initiated on the planet Mardona III in 3 ABY by the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry against the Galactic Empire. It resulted in the death of the rebel Charmer.
Several years before the Battle of Yavin, a group of anti-Galactic Empire dissidents established a secret base on the planet of Anoat.
Derdmin was an IPV-1 System Patrol Craft used by the Rebel Alliance to patrol XQ3 Platform AZ 77.
The Neenoc was a YT-1300 transport that was present at XQ3 Platform AZ 77 when the platform was attacked by Imperial forces lead by the frigate, Implacable.

Argus was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by the Rebel Alliance. The shuttle was launched from the MC80 Star Cruiser Ardent, carrying officers. The shuttle was destroyed by TIE Avengers that were attacking the Cruiser.

Shark Squadron was a squadron of 4 Z-95 Headhunters that were one of two groups of fighters in the MC80 Star Cruiser Ardent. The squadron was destroyed by TIE Avengers that engaged the cruiser. The cruiser was badly damaged but managed to escape into Hyperspace.

Tiger Squadron was a squadron of 4 Z-95 Headhunters that was the first of two groups of fighters in the MC80 Star Cruiser Ardent. The squadron was destroyed by TIE Avengers that engaged the cruiser. The cruiser was badly damaged before escaping into Hyperspace.

The Dodger was a Nebulon-B frigate used by the Rebel Alliance. The ship arrived to attack 3 BFF-1 bulk freighters Rugle with multiple Rebel starfighters. The attack was thwarted by two Assault Gunboats.

Clan Chorn was a clan of Mandalorians in existence at the time of the Eternal Empire's invasion of the galaxy. When Mandalore the Avenger rallied the clans in an attack on the Eternal Empire's droid factory on Darvannis, Clan Chorn was one of the clans able to aid her.

The First Order Security Bureau (FOSB) was an enforcement and espionage agency of the First Order lead by Major Chetachi Gohl. Agent Terex was a ranking officer of that agency, as was Lieutenant Weel.
Clone scout troopers, also known as clone scouts, were specialized clone troopers that served in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
Point Rain was the name the Galactic Republic gave to its primary staging area during the Second Battle of Geonosis during the Clone Wars.
Hendrix was a world located in the Iska sector of the Mid Rim. Prior to the Battle of Hoth, Han Solo planned to run weapons from Minoth to Hendrix for the Rebel Alliance.

The Valorous was a Lantillian GX1 short hauler in service to the Galactic Republic that delivered Padmé Amidala, Teckla Minnau, Nix Card, and two Senate Commandos to Scipio during the Clone Wars. The Valorous was then converted into civilian use during the Imperial Era.

result: Telloti Cillmam'n renames himself Malleus, the Hammer of the Dark Side
x: In 19 BBY, at the time of the issuance of Order 66, a lightsaber duel was fought on Nicht Ka between Jedi Master Ekim Ryelli and Telloti Cillmam'n, a member of the Jedi ExplorCorps who had been corrupted by the armor of Warb Null.

Aestilan was a world located in the Demetras sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Following the Battle of Yavin, the world was scouted by Rebel Alliance forces seeking for a new base. Aestilan was known for its rock worms making the planetary mantle very fragile.

Cerroban was a world located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Following the Battle of Yavin, the world was scouted by Rebel Alliance forces seeking for a new base. Cerroban was a waterless and airless rocky world that was pounded by asteroids regularly.

Thedavio VII was a world located in the Expansion Region. Prior to the Battle of Hoth, a fleet of unidentified black starships was spotted near the planet. It was unknown whether they were some kind of new Imperial design.
Vassek 3, also known as the third moon of Vassek, was a moon of the planet Vassek located within the Vassek system of the region known as the Outer Rim Territories.
Reep was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by the Rebel Alliance. The transport was present at a Rebel summit in the Delfii system, carrying advisors.
Channel was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by the Rebel Alliance. The shuttle was present at the Rebel Summit at the Delfii system, carrying "Com Staff".

Supply was an Imperial Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport retrofitted to be a supply ship that would provide starfighters with more warheads should they run out. The ship was present on the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Garrett.
Mos Eisley security was the local law enforcement agency of Mos Eisley and its surrounding area.
Sluis Van was an astronomical object in the southern region of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches, along the Rimma Trade Route, in square M-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Sand worms were gigantic worms that inhabited the Sea of Sand, a region of the desert planet Ponemah Terminal's southern hemisphere.
Desolation Station was an Imperial outpost charged with overseeing the research behind the implementation of the Death Star, a massive weapon capable of destroying entire planets.
Eriadu City was the capital city of Eriadu, a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy.

District five was the fashion district of Eriadu City, the capital of the Outer Rim planet Eriadu. Shortly after his graduation from the Imperial Academy of Eriadu, the stormtrooper TK-462 was assigned to patrol district five, which was plagued with shoplifters.

Veron was a Mid Rim Territories astronomical object where the bounty hunter Brand infiltrated the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry through a recruitment drive by 1 BBY, sneaking her equipment onto the company's CR90 corvette Thunderstrike in hope of assassinating their Ca…
An air scrubber farm was built near the city of Phelar on the planet Eriadu cleaning toxins from the air created by the world's mining industry.
Pii was a planet in the Pii system, located near the Gulf of Tatooine. It was the location of the Galactic Empire's Imperial marshaling station Pii.

The Cosmatanic Steppes was a flat layer of mantle suspended above a gas giant located the Cosmatanic Steppes system, a star system in the Grohl sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. The terrain was mostly grassland.
The Truant was a modified Lux-400 yacht. It and its crew were on the wanted lists in multiple star systems due to their habit of smuggling weapons.

Rywin was a planet in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of the tromonids. Mere months after a scientific expedition to the planet resulted in the discovery of the species, they had infested five other planets due to their high reproduction rate.
The Ambush at Sul-34 was an attack on the Rebel fleet to delay the Rebel Assault on Endor long enough for Palpatine to ready his forces for the Battle of Endor.

result: The location of Admiral Gial Ackbar is transmitted to the Resistance
C-3PO replaces his missing arm with a red one
x: During the Cold War, a mission was sought out by the Resistance on Taul, which was a known home to can-cells and spice spiders.
Vexar was a gas giant of the Vexar system located in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was orbited by at least three moons, including the third moon of Vexar.
The third moon of Vexar was a rocky moon that orbited the gas giant Vexar. The moon could barely support Human life.

Stobar was a planet located in the Stobar system in the Boeus sector of the Expansion Region that was the site of the Stobar Spaceport. Savage Opress would visit Stobar during his search for his long-lost brother, the former Sith Lord Maul.
The Liberation of Syruss was a battle of the Galactic Civil War that took place in the Syruss system.
The Blue Wave was a Mon Calamari cargo hauler that served in the Alliance Fleet early in the Galactic Civil War.
Introsphere was a mining company that was based in the Gorse system during the last years of the Galactic Republic. It was involved in surface mining operations on the planet Gorse.
Highground was a settlement on the planet Gorse which housed a spaceport. Highground was near Shaketown, a settlement which housed the Moonglow Polychemical refinery.
The Cudgel was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle in the complement of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Ultimatum.

Calladan's field was a place on the planet Gorse that was near the settlement of Gorse City. During the Gorse Conflict, the Galactic Empire rerouted all of Moonglow Polychemical's personnel transports to Calladan's field.

The Emperor's Tower was a mooring tower located at the uppermost northern hemisphere of the second Death Star that housed the throne room of Emperor Palpatine. Its design was reminiscent of the High Council spire of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
The Nomannic was a standard Corellian civilian YT-1300 transport passing through a customs checkpoint. It was the first craft of several to be inspected by an Imperial TIE Interceptor.
J'doytzin III was a planet in the galaxy. During the Clone Wars, Chancellor Palpatine negotiated with their Shahmistra.

Ritam was a Corellian corvette that was passing by an Imperial customs platform. The corvette was inspected by a TIE Interceptor to find that it contained repulsors as it had claimed in the manifest and was allowed to leave.
The Elorac was a BFF-1 bulk freighter that was used by a civilian company. The ship was inspected by a TIE Interceptor to find Amber as its manifest had claimed and therefore was free to leave.
Following the events of the Gorse Conflict, Zaluna Myder settled on an agricultural world. By the Age of the Empire, most of the planet's settlers had moved to places like Gorse to look for work.

The Pits was a neighborhood on the south side of Gorse City, an urban settlement in the planet Gorse. It was located in a former thorilide mining quarry. The Pits was home to Okadiah Garson's cantina The Asteroid Belt and Okadiah's flophouse.
Seinar T5D was a civilian Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport that passed an Imperial customs checkpoint. A TIE Interceptor was then launched and inspected to find workers in the cargo.

Seinar T4D was a civilian Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport that passed an Imperial customs checkpoint. A TIE Interceptor was then launched and the transport was the third to be inspected by the fighter to find workers in the cargo.

StarTour 7 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that was used by a tourist company. The shuttle was inspected by a TIE Interceptor pilot at a customs checkpoint who identified the cargo as "Tourists," and the craft was permitted to leave the station.

Ryloth kinetic gliders were winged creatures native to the planet Ryloth. Their flight paths were known to intersect those of aircars. That hazard, together with the planet's strong wind, made air travel on parts of Ryloth dangerous.

The Jedi Temple central security station was a chamber in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant which housed a beacon that was used to summon the Jedi home. It housed several towering banks that was designed for a few Jedi doing maintenance work.

Bogan Boulevard, nicknamed "Broken Boulevard", was a road in the Gorsian settlement of Shaketown. Moonglow Polychemical's refinery was located on the street, as was Besalisk chef Drakka's eponymous diner.

objective: Rescue members of the Uprising who had been taken by Ubrik Adelhard's
x: Several months into the Iron Blockade, the Smuggler undertook a rescue mission to free key members of the Uprising from the Crypt, an Imperial prison where they had been taken following a failed attempt at kidnapping Commander Bragh.

A protocol droid was used by a cloaked being to give Bazine Netal, a bounty hunter, a mission. It was an old droid, with outdated programming that rendered it barely sentient at all. After it informed Netal of the existence of her next mission, it began counting down from ten.
Weet was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport employed by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Control was a CR90 corvette used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War within an Imperial simulation.

Vashka was a planet in the galaxy. It was covered in trees and mountains, with small towns dotting the edge of the planet's seas. In its prehistory, it hosted a variety of megafauna, before they were hunted to extinction for the safety of the sentient inhabitants.

The Sith Lord Darth Sidious used a modified Eta-class shuttle as his personal shuttle in the later stages of the Clone Wars. He used the ship to travel to the planet Mandalore to thwart his former apprentice Maul's rise to power.
The Dragon Void Run, also known simply as the Dragon Void, was an old, dangerous race held in the galaxy. The race traveled between three planets, stopping for mandatory refueling points at each.

A nest of Thalassian slavers operated on Galpos II during the Imperial Era until they were cleared away by the Galactic Empire's 291st Legion. During the engagement with the Thalassian enslavers, the legion used All Terrain Defense Pods.

The Office of Student Outcomes was a department of the Royal Imperial Academy on Coruscant. It was responsible for overseeing student performance and devising methods for instructors to provide maximum improvement for their students.

GEMINI Prime was an advanced droid designed by the species that built the artificial planet Iokath. The Prime was used as the template for the construction of the GEMINI series of droids, which were in turn installed as the captains of the Eternal Fleet's warships.

The Guillotine was a modified Flarestar fighter and the personal starship used by the Kyuzo bounty hunter Embo during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Kiamurr was a world located in the Likasha sector of the Mid Rim.
The Office of the Emperor consisted of the immediate staff of the Galactic Emperor Palpatine of the Galactic Empire who directly subordinate to the Emperor.
Elkkasinn was a world located in the Phelleem sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Many gunrunners of the Sendavé Shared Interest Collective were from Elkkasinn and Sunin.
Sunin was a world located in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Many gunrunners of the Sendavé Shared Interest Collective were from Elkkasinn and Sunin.
Nummunr was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Ash Worlds, within the Slice portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Tyybann was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Inner Rim.
Rentallian cairnhounds were predatory pack hunters native to the planet Rentalles.
The Mid-Hemisphere Trench of the Death Star was one of the secondary trenches that ran parallel to the battle station's main equatorial trench. It separated the southern hemisphere in two.
Chaako City was the largest city on the desert planet Chaaktil. In the city was the orphanage where Bazine Netal was raised, and Delphi Kloda's gym and secret combat school.
Clan Beroya was a Mandalorian clan in existence during the time of the Galactic War, a conflict waged between the forces of the Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Nal Kapok was a jungle planet where the Kyber Saber hilt was hidden by followers of the Jedi Master Baird Kantoo. During the Clone Wars, a battle between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic was fought on Nal Kapok.
G2-9T was one of the supposedly rogue droids that attacked Constable Zuvio during his investigation of a banking ship robbery in Niima Outpost.
The Hunt for Dooku's Treasure was a treasure hunt between two pirates, the Delphidian Sidon Ithano and the Weequay Scorza.
a: Race for the Lost Treasure of Count Dooku

x: The Andelm IV gangster Jaum owned a wheeled battle droid that was used to quell trouble among his slave miners in the Andelm beetle caverns. It was a wheeled red battle droid with two large wheels around a central chassis. The chassis had two sets of laser cannons on each arm.
The Assault on Liintaar was an Imperial attack on the Alliance's Liintaar Station during the Galactic Civil War.
The Battle of Altratonne was an engagement between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Agamar was a barren, rocky planet located in the Agamar system within the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy in grid coordinates M-5.
The Xirl hunting lodge was a hunting lodge built on Xirl, a planet in Wild Space, by the big game huntress Gozetta.
Shortly after escaping from the Empirical, Galen Marek, Darth Vader's secret apprentice, conducted a mission to The Undertow on the planet Nar Shaddaa in 2 BBY.

Scurriers were a species of small rodents that hailed from the desert planet of Tatooine. They were characterized by their long ears, distinctive snout, and skittish temperament. They normally roamed the desert, but were commonly found loitering outside inhabited settlements.
A battle was fought at Drearia in 10 ABY during the Galactic Civil War, as part of the Imperial Mutiny.
Vashka City was a city on the planet Vashka.

result: Bazine Netal successfully retrieves the case
objective: Recover a steel case from Jor Tribulus
x: A mission was undertaken by the bounty hunter Bazine Netal to Vashka to recover a steel case from the retired stormtrooper Jor Tribulus.
The Gauntlet was a very mysterious and extremely dangerous annual race, in which many young pilots were selected from to partake in the Five Sabers championship.

The slaughter on Noult was a slaughter played out by the Alliance to Restore the Republic on the planet Noult during the Galactic Civil War. Soon after the slaughter happened, a secret base was discovered on Noult, proving that it was the Rebels who carried out the slaughter.
Nubia was a world in the Nubia system in the Corellian sector of the Core Worlds that was home to Industrial Automaton droid factories and Nubia Star Drives, Inc. shipyards.

The hanging gardens was a public garden on the outskirts of Republic City on the New Republic's capital planet of Hosnian Prime. The gardens consisted of a staggered sandstone pyramid, with each floor hollow in the center.

During the Separatist Crisis, the Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and his Padawan, Anakin Skywalker, were involved in a very important mission concerning a border dispute on Ansion, which left the galaxy staggered.
Galactic Republic Customs of Coruscant was a Galactic Republic law enforcement agency that enforced customs on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars using customs droids.
The palatial drill was a mining vehicle used for transport through the surface of the planet Shu-Torun by members of the world's royal family.

The Eellayin were a civilization who resided on Polis Massa before their extinction. By the end of the Clone Wars, some Kallidahin archaeologists and exobiologists believed the Eellayin were their species' ancestor, so they began excavating Polis Massa in an attempt to recover…
Iktotchon was a planet located in the Iktotch system in the Narvath sector of the Expansion Region. It had a moon, Iktotch, which was the homeworld of Iktotchi Jedi Master Saesee Tiin.

Megalliforms were a type of giant, tough-skinned bird found in the galaxy. When the chef Strono Tuggs challenged the Nu-Cosian Bobbajo to bring exotic ingredients to cook, Bobbajo returned with a megalliform, which Tuggs had to wrestle into submission.

Fierce battles occurred in the skies above the planet Tatooine in 5000 BBY, during the time of the Great Hyperspace War. The fights scattered the surface of starship wrecks that quickly disappeared under the sands.
The Northern Jungles was a region of the planet Akiva. By the time of the Rebellion on Akiva during the Galactic Civil War, the aristocratic Karyvin clan owned crystal mines in the jungles.

The Southern Archipelago was a chain of islands located on the planet Akiva. By the time of the Rebellion on Akiva during the Galactic Civil War, several of the islands were owned by the aristocratic Karyvin clan.

result: GEMINI Prime captured by the Alliance
x: The raid on Darvannis occurred when the Mandalorians attacked the planet Darvannis as part of the Alliance's war against Zakuul in 3630 BBY.

Krillcrab were a type of crustacean whose meat could be eaten. When the junk dealer Temmin Wexley saw the pale flesh of an Uugteen's limbs through the joints in its armor on the planet Akiva shortly before the Rebellion on Akiva, it reminded him of the flesh of a krillcrab tha…

Musk-hounds were a type of dog. After waking from a medically induced coma in Hanna City on the planet Chandrila following the Rebellion on Akiva, New Republic pilot Norra Wexley felt as tired as an old musk-hound.

Redjacket wasps were a species of insect that lived in nests. When TIE/ln space superiority starfighters descended on the Alliance to Restore the Republic Fleet after the Galactic Empire sprung its trap at the Battle of Endor, it reminded Rebel pilot Norra Wexley of angry redj…

Gorths were a type of creature with a tail that attracted flies. When New Republic pilot Norra Wexley flew through the innards of the second Death Star battle station during the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, she mentally compared the TIE/ln space superiority starfighters that swar…

Canyon adders were a type of venomous snake. While on the Outer Rim planet Akiva in 4 ABY, the woman Esmelle criticized her sister, the New Republic pilot Norra Wexley, for abandoning her son to join the Rebel Alliance.

Ryukyu hares were a type of hare that were prone to sneak away and flee when scared. When Imperial Grand Moff Valco Pandion suggested that the Empire retreat from the planet Akiva during the rebellion on Akiva in 4 ABY, Admiral Rae Sloane compared his suggestion to the behavio…

A pipe-weasel was a type of weasel. In 4 ABY, the human child Jak requested an electromagnetic pulse weapon from the Iktotchi crime lord Talvee Chawin as a reward for saving Chawin's associate Lazula.

The Kerkoiden, known also by the slang term Kerk, were a sentient species from the planet Kerkoidia. The Confederacy of Independent Systems General Whorm Loathsom was a Kerkoiden, as was one of the many guards employed by the crime lord Talvee Chawin on the planet Coruscant so…

During the Galactic Civil War between the New Republic and the Galactic Empire, a group of Imperials attempted to restart several of the Geonosian droid manufacturing factories left on the planet Geonosis as a remnant of the Clone Wars.

The Thrugii asteroid belt was an asteroid belt located in the Thrugii system in the Outer Rim Territories. At some point Nightswan heard from someone who worked at the Thrugii asteroid belt about a nonhuman who teamed up with a Jedi General during the Clone Wars.
R5-L26 was an R-series astromech droid that served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars, a conflict fought between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Balnab were a group of individuals of a unique tentacle-faced species stranded on the planet Balnab after a shipwreck. They were led by the holographic persona Albee Dewaw, who was in reality controlled by a group of DUM-series pit droids.

Order was one of the two factions of the Pentastar Alignment's legislative arm alongside Enforcement. Order took on the responsibilities of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's Select Committee and Imperial Intelligence's Ubiqtorate.
Tirahnn was an Imperial terrestrial astronomical object located in the Tirahnn system in the Zeemacht Cluster in the Inner Rim along the Perlemian Trade Route.

The Eriadu Patriots were a sports team of some sort within the Galactic Empire, based on Eriadu. Merei Spanjaf was once bored by a broadcast describing the Galactic League commissioner's review of a proposed trade between the Patriots and the Shad Furies.
The Chamber of Order was the legislature of the Pentastar Alignment. The membership of the Chamber of Order was comprised of former Imperial and corporate officials allied to the Alignment.

Politorate was an organization with the Pentastar Alignment's Order branch that was tasked with ensuring the preservation and principles of the New Order. Politorate assigned Politorate officers—known as "Pols"—to every office, starship, and garrison within the Alignment.

Insurrection was one of the Order branches within the Pentastar Alignment. Insurrection was born as the result of an investigation conducted by the Chamber of Order into the reasons that star systems threw off Imperial control and joined the New Republic.
Judgment was a part of the Order branch of the Pentastar Alignment. Their principal agents were the Great InQuestors of Judgment who were responsible for maintaining the decrees of the Alignment.

Protectorate was a part of the Order branch of the Pentastar Alignment. Protectorate took on the duties of the Ubiqtorate's Internal Security Branch and the Imperial Guard Corps. Their main concern was the protection of Alignment personnel and equipment.
Enforcement was the military branch of the Pentastar Alignment. Enforcement combined the duties of Justice and Enforcement. The Pentastar Patrol was one of the largest Enforcement units.

Ator was a location in the Ator system of the galaxy's Core Worlds. At some point before the formation of the Galactic Empire, Cliegg Lars brought a Thornen Pyramid Puzzle from Ator back to his homestead on Tatooine.

The Great Chott salt flat was a region in the southern extreme of the Jundland Wastes, on the Outer Rim desert planet of Tatooine. The area was home to dozens of moisture farms, which made up the Great Chott salt flat community.
The Naween Oasis was a rare fertile patch of land located on the otherwise desert planet of Tatooine, north of Mos Eisley spaceport.

Wasco was a backwater world that was rarely visited by anyone. It was located in the Wasco system in the Bri'ahl sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square I-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Great Hall, located in the Naboo capital of Theed, was an annex of the city's main hangar complex. The monarch of Naboo could inspect their troop during ceremonial parades held in the hall, which featured high ceilings and tall windows.

CS-321 was a tan-colored RA-7 protocol droid that was owned by Weequay pirates during the Clone Wars, a war between the Galactic Republic and the breakaway Confederacy of Independent Systems. He was destroyed during a battle between the two parties.

Ben's Mesa was a flat-topped mountain located on the desert planet of Tatooine. It was named in tribute to Ben Neluenf, the first great Tatooinian podracer, who died while attempting to scale the mesa. The dangerous Boonta Eve Classic racetrack mostly turned around Ben's Mesa.
A clan of Mandalorians mercenaries loyal to Ung Kusp was hired to recover a Sith artifact stolen by an Outer Rim cyberneticist many centuries before the Clone Wars.
The Toydarian Guard were soldiers assigned to defend the King of Toydaria.

A clan of Mandalorian mercenaries were active during the Dark Wars on Dantooine, seeking to do work. However, when traveling with the Jedi Exile, Mandalore the Preserver attempted to recruit the clan to his quest in reuniting the clans.

KT-310 was a red-plated, cylindrical KT power droid that lived on the desert planet Jakku. Around thirty years after the Battle of Endor, it was present in the junk dealer Unkar Plutt's shop in Niima Outpost on Jakku shortly on the First Order's attack on the nearby Tuanul vil…
The Zuzabol were a sentient bipedal species shorter in height than humans. The Zuzabol Avga Rosene and another member of the species worked as a fueling crew for the Resistance in the year 34 ABY.

Obrexta III was a cruiser that had been in service to the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Towards the end of the war, it was tasked with carrying the captured clone trooper Kix to Serenno. En route, it was attacked by Republic forces.

Noctu was a blue and massive gas giant in the Noctu system of the Colonies that revolved around one star and had several moons. Centuries before the Imperial Era, one of Noctu's moons was crammed to the core with resources, including gems, minerals, and spice.
Temptors were a type of quadrupedal creature found in the forests of the moon Endor. The long-necked creature had a brown leathery skin and 5 pairs of black eyes.
R2-A6 was an R2-series astromech droid of the R-series produced by Industrial Automaton.

Interrogator was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire that participated in the Battle of Endor under the command of Captain Inalis, as well as the Battle of Jakku, the final battle of the Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the fledgling New Republic.
Mennar-Daye was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Mennar-Daye system in the Thesme sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The commerce center was located on Mennar-Daye, and housed a New Republic presence. The ship Yissira Zyde traveled to the commerce center where it was screened by Republic authorities and gained new cargo.
The skirmish near Farboon was a minor skirmish that paved the way for Maarek Stele to be initiated into the Imperial Navy as a TIE pilot.
This was Maarek Stele's first official duty mission as a TIE pilot.

Marwigo was a red- and white-plated WA-7 waitress droid who was employed by Plop Dribble's on the planet Stobar. She was present in the restaurant in 20 BBY when the former Nightbrother Savage Opress came in and began acting violently with the eatery's staff.

result: Garel is liberated from the Galactic Empire
x: During the Galactic Empire's reign over the galaxy, the people of the Outer Rim planet Garel fought to liberate their world from the Emperor's oppressive regime. One of the resistance fighters, Ushos O. Statura, was only a teenager when he fought for Garel's liberation.
AV-9R was a protocol droid used by the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3639 BBY AV-9R was on the Carrick Station, where he suffered a mobility malfunction.
AX-871 was a battle droid who fought in the Battle of Kuat during the Galactic War, where it was destroyed aboard the Kuat Defensive Station.
B6-31 was an astromech droid used by the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Baradium Processing Facility was a facility on Denova that processed baradium ore. During the Battle of Denova it was overtaken by Kephess and his Warstalkers, who turned the facility for their own use.

Blaster was a jury-rigged battle droid created during Galactic War by BO-55 Astromech droid to join him in the Ravagers pirate gang on Rishi. Possessing both a child-like enthusiasm and advanced weaponry, BO-55 and Blaster plotted their operation to inflict maximum destruction.
BO-55, also known as Master, was an astromech droid of a discontinued model that was picked up by Ravagers pirate Torque, who rebuilt and reprogrammed him into a blood-thirsty killing machine.

Carida Corsairs was a pirate gang active for over two hundred years before the Galactic War. Once a formidable threat to the Perlemian Trade Route, the gang suffered a big loss when their base on Carida was destroyed by a Republic strike force.

The Corellian Run Scoundrels was a smuggling gang operating on the Corellian Run during the Galactic War. A notorious Corellian Run Scoundrels captain Kai Zykken operated from Raider's Cove on Rishi, along with his first mate Tomota.

CZ-5X Eradicator Droid was a battle droid manufactured by the Czerka Corporation. During the Seizure of CZ-198 in 3638 BBY the droid was used to opposed the forces trying to establish control over CZ-198, but was destroyed.

D-7RZ was a protocol droid used by the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3638 BBY D-7RZ was on the Carrick Station, where he relayed to an important figure a priority request from Supreme Chancellor Leontyne Saresh to report to Major Vom Dresid on the Gav Daragon.

D-LZ8 was a protocol droid used by the Hutt Cartel during the Conquest of Makeb. After Doctor Juvard Illip Oggurobb was successfully rescued from Toborro, several other Hutts abandoned Toborro and pleaded the Republic to take them on the Ark to escape Makeb's imminent destruct…
EN-4C was a battle droid that was part of the Cademimu V police force during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, it was destroyed by a strike team seeking to disable the Cademimu missile stockpiles.

EN-C7 was a battle droid of the reconstituted Sith Empire stationed on the Harrower-class dreadnought Ziost Shadow during the Galactic War. During the outbreak of the rakghoul plague in the Tion Hegemony, they transported an Imperial strike team to Kaon.
GE-31 was a protocol droid used by the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3639 BBY it was stationed on the Valor-class cruiser Gav Daragon.

GXR-5 Sabotage Droid was a battle droid of the Galactic Republic active during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY it was aboard the Thranta-class corvette Brentaal Star during the attack by the Gage-class transport Black Talon.

GXR-7 command droid was a battle droid of the Galactic Republic active during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY it was aboard the Thranta-class corvette Brentaal Star during the Attack on the Brentaal Star by the Gage-class transport Black Talon and was destroyed by an Imperial boardi…
H4V-1K was a Astromech droid present on the Vaiken Spacedock during the Cold War and Galactic War.

The ISS-944 Power Droid was a combat-prepared power droid owned by the reconstituted Sith Empire and used aboard the Harrower-class dreadnought Emperor's Glory during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY, it was destroyed by a boarding party from a Republic transport Esseles.

K7-22 was a battle droid of the Sith Empire stationed on the Harrower-class dreadnought Ziost Shadow during the Galactic War. During the outbreak of the rakghoul plague in the Tion Hegemony, they transported an Imperial strike team to Doctor Sannus Lorrick's Lost Island.
The Karsoom was a group of mercenaries operating on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
LD-402 was a protocol droid used by the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3639 BBY it was stationed on the Harrower-class dreadnought Ziost Shadow.

LR-5 sentinel droid was a battle droid used by doctor Sannus Lorrick during the Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. It was destroyed in 3639 BBY, by a strike team that stormed Lorrick's lab on Ord Mantell.

M-2VB was a medical droid used by the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3639 BBY he was stationed on Carrick Station, where he examined Republic General Conlath, who suffered a mental trauma during an encounter with Dread Masters forces on Belsavis.
M-V09 was a protocol droid used by the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3639 BBY it was stationed on the Harrower-class dreadnought Ziost Shadow.

Na-TaK was a protocol droid from the Gree active during the Galactic War. In 3639 BBY Gree forces on Asation were attacked by the creatures coming through the Grand Hypergate that was opened by Kephess, servant of the Dread Masters.
The Nova Guard was a group of mercenaries operating on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.
P-3DB was a protocol droid used by the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War. In 3639 BBY it was stationed on the Valor-class cruiser Gav Daragon.
P-5C3 was a shopkeeper droid present on the Vaiken Spacedock during the Cold War and Galactic War.
QO-77 was a battle droid of unknown origins available for purchase during the war against Zakuul. The unit was similar in appearance to QO-99, a member of Specialists.
RL-4 was a Protocol droid used by the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War as a special envoy in Office of the Supreme Chancellor Leontyne Saresh.

S1-M0 "Doc Simon" was a battle droid of the Galactic Republic active during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY it was aboard the Thranta-class corvette Brentaal Star during the Attack on the Brentaal Star by the Gage-class transport Black Talon.

S4-E Support Droid was a probe droid used by the Order of Revan during the Galactic War. During the Battle of Rishi in 3637 BBY it assisted the Revanites Rarrook and Marko Ka who tried to stop a strike team from reaching the signal jammer on the Razorback Island, but failed an…

The Soaring Duros was a hoverbarge used by the Ravagers pirate gang during the Galactic War. In 3637 BBY a group of individuals hired by exiled Ravagers Captain Ruugar boarded the vessel while it was docked in Coratanni Town.
Stonerays were a species of flying reptavian carnivores native to Yavin 4. Living in swamps and jungles, they used their taloned tails to disembowel their prey.
The Toe-Chop's Tapcaf was a cafe in the Coratanni Town on Rishi, the base of operations of the Ravagers pirate gang.
The Treefall Gorge was a site on Denova that was a point of conflict during the Battle of Denova.
The Vanguard's Blade was a Thranta-class corvette in the Republic Navy that served in the Galactic War with the Sith Empire.

Kephess's Redoubt was a military bunker used by Kephess and his Warstalkers as their main base of operations during the Battle of Denova. When an enemy strike team tried to storm the Redoubt, Kephess opposed them with heavy walkers, Trandoshan Warstalkers and Imperial defectors.

The Patchblight Path was the name given to the road in the Nightmare Lands on the planet Voss. It was inhabited by crysfangs and caused the Gormak who wandered it to fall under the influence of the Dark Heart.
The Northern Jedi ruins were located on the Eastern Ice Shelf of the planet Ilum, remains of ancient Jedi structure fallen into disuse by the time of the Galactic War.
The Cross-Shelf Corridor was carved in the ice of the planet Ilum and connected the Western Ice Shelf and the Western Jedi ruins.
The Barren Frost was an area located on the Eastern Ice Shelf of the planet Ilum, which served as the cite of an Imperial base camp during the time of the Battle of Ilum in the Galactic War.

The Imperial prison camp was established by the Sith Empire on the Eastern Ice Shelf of the planet Ilum. It housed captured Republic prisoners during the time of the Battle of Ilum in the Galactic War.

The Republic crystal refinery was established by the Galactic Republic on the Eastern Ice Shelf of the planet Ilum to process the Adegan crystal. During the Battle of Ilum in the Galactic War it was raided by the forces of the reconstituted Sith Empire.
The relacite crystal mines were used by the Galactic Republic on the Eastern Ice Shelf of the planet Ilum to process the relacite variety of the Adegan crystal.

The mephite crystal mines were used by the Galactic Republic on the Eastern Ice Shelf of the planet Ilum to process the mephite variety of the Adegan crystal. During the time of the Battle of Ilum in the Galactic War, the mines were raided by the Sith Empire forces.

The Jorrn Kresh gang was a criminal organization led by Jorrn Kresh. Originally known as the Kressar gang under Boss Kressar, Kresh wrested control of the organization and renamed it. They attempted to force protection money out of Grison Jarn.
D-Mot was a security droid owned by Captain Raquid Krev.
Scarif was a remote, tropical planet located in the Abrion sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
The Arbitrator was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought in the Imperial Navy and one of thirteen Super Star Destroyers in the Empire's service prior to the Battle of Endor.

A dreadnought served in the Imperial Navy as one of the Galactic Empire's thirteen Super Star Destroyers prior to the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY. However, by 5 ABY, it had been captured over Kuat by the New Republic for use in its fleet.
Trail was a pair of Lambda-class T-4a shuttles used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Boranda was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Boranda system in the Manda sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was a desirable vacation spot, as when Merei Spanjaf made it up as a possible prize for a raffle on the spot, a woman purchased five tickets for the raffle.
The Peacekeeping of Parliock was a conflict that was fought at some point prior to the Clone Wars which involved the Jedi Order.

result: Poe Dameron is awarded the Rieekan Ribbon for Bravery in Battle
objective: Rescue Admiral Gial Ackbar from First Order custody
x: Thirty years after the Battle of Endor, the Resistance staged the rescue of Admiral Ackbar during the Cold War.
Twon Ketee was a toxic swamp planet that was home to rathtars.

t: Office of Imperial Promotion, Galactic Truth, and Fact Correction
x: The Office of Imperial Promotion, Galactic Truth, and Fact Correction (OIP) was a propaganda service of the Galactic Empire formed from the ashes of COMPNOR in an effort to countermand the influence of the New Republic in the months following the Battle of Endor.
The Bravaisians were a short, long-snouted sentient species that were native to Bravais. They had a dexterous tongue that they often used instead of their fingers.

result: Poe Dameron is rescued and FN-2187 betrays the First Order
objective: Escape from the First Order and rescue Poe Dameron
x: The First Order stormtrooper FN-2187 and the Resistance pilot Poe Dameron carried out an escape from the Finalizer during the Cold War in 34 ABY.
Skittermice were nocturnal creatures inhabiting the planet Jakku. Industrious and determined, skittermice crossed the deserts at night in search of food and salvage to make nests and burrows.

The Verity District was a sector of Galactic City on the planet Coruscant. Noted for its towers, it was next to the Federal District and, during the time of the Galactic Empire, housed the Hall of Adjudication, the Hall of Imperial Register, the Institute to Preserve Imperial …

The Galactic Empire operated a fuel depot at the location Beroq 4 during the Imperial Era. By 4 ABY, during the Alliance to Restore the Republic's war against the Empire, the rebel pilot Lieutenant Shara Bey participated in liberating the world Gorma.

Omwati were a sentient species whose members had a crown of feathers atop their heads, spindly fingers, and beaks which clacked during speech. Shi Shu, the second of the pirate captain Eleodie Maracavanya, was an Omwati.

A bar was located aboard the Imperial battle station known as the Death Star, prior to the superweapon's destruction in the Battle of Yavin. According to Sinjir Rath Velus, it was an ugly, austere place with little to select in terms of alcohol.
Vworkka were a species of carnivorous raptor native to the desert planet Jakku that preyed upon skittermice. Vworkka would perch silently and patiently waiting for their prey.

Vorlaggn were a sentient species native to Vorlag, a cavernous planet. They had skin like the cracked char on a piece of fire-cooked meat whose fissures suppurated clear fluid, three hollow-set eyes, and spoke in the third person, which could confuse individuals of other species.

Vorlag was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was the cavernous homeworld of the sentient Vorlaggn species. A palace existed on the planet that was owned by the crime lord Slussen Urla-fir Kal Kethin-wa Canker.

leader: Counselor to the Empire Gallius Rax
x: The Shadow Council was a military advisory council consisting of high-ranking officials of the Galactic Empire.
Forest troopers were Imperial stormtroopers trained to operate in forested environments. To that end, they wore special, camouflaged stormtrooper armor.
The boa was a type of snake in the galaxy. Boas were known to wrap around objects, a habit emulated by the grappling boa, a weapon named after the snake.

affiliation: Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research
x: ST-149, or ST 149 was a Delta-class T-3c shuttle that was used as a transport for Director Orson Krennic and his death trooper unit. Krennic chose the ship due to his appreciation for its unusual geometry, although he held no sentimentality for the craft.

Jedha, also known as the Pilgrim Moon, the Cold Moon, or the Kyber Heart, and formerly known as NiJedha, was a small desert moon which orbited the planet NaJedha. Located in the Jedha system of the galaxy's Mid Rim, the moon had a cold climate due to its lasting winter.
Trabzon Road was a road on the Outer Rim planet Akiva. In 4 ABY, the junk dealer Temmin Wexley stole a crate from a transport belonging to the crime lord Surat Nuat that had crashed on the road.
The Kora Biedies river was located on the Outer Rim planet Akiva and had eddies of water that formed rapids. At some point, the river intersected with Trabzon Road, a street on Akiva.
Hroth-beasts were an avian species native to the cavern strewn planet of Vorlag. They had red leathery skin with long wings. Its beak was covered in small worm-like tentacles that contained stingers.
The Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders were an ancient group of Mandalorian warriors. The Trandoshan big game hunter Garnac owned a Mandalorian Neo-Crusader helmet during the Clone Wars.
Trole was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport the Rebel Alliance employed during the Galactic Civil War.
The Monarchomechs were an organization of cyborgs that existed about 400 years before the Battle of Yavin.

t: Raid on a quadanium steel shipment
x: A raid was executed on an Imperial quadanium steel shipment by a Rebel Alliance X-wing starfighter squadron under the command of Jyn Freila. The raid ended poorly for the Rebel squadron leaving most of them dead and Freila without an eye.
The Tua-Lu, also known as the Stranger's Fortune, was one of the many starships owned by the pirate Maz Kanata at the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Nymeve Lake, or Lake Nymeve, was a freshwater lake on the planet Takodana. On its shoreline rested an ancient castle run by the pirate Maz Kanata, who had a parapet overlooking the lake.

The Special Operations Division was a branch of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau. It established Project Hidden Eye during the Galactic Civil War. The project, however, was thwarted by the Rebel hero Luke Skywalker with the help of another operative.
HELIOS-3E was an IG-86 sentinel droid who operated with the bounty hunter Cad Bane.

Chiller was a CR90 corvette employed by the Rebels. The corvette, along with the Glaser, was part of a Rebel strike force attacking Imperial frigate Laantis while it was receiving a new hyperdrive engine from the freighter Rasvin.
Scythis was a IPV-1 System Patrol Craft used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
HELIOS-3D was an IG-86 sentinel droid who operated with the bounty hunter Cad Bane.
Iakaru were a sentient species native to the planet Iakar. Bistan was a member of this species.

The Blacklip Pirates were a pirate organization whose members arrived in the Anoat sector seeking for plunder exactly as the Galactic Empire decided to blockade the whole sector. The pirates managed to scrap three Imperial cruisers before fleeing toward Ozu.
The Belgaroth asteroid field was an asteroid field located in the Belgaroth system in the galaxy's Core Worlds. The field was known to have ore and to employ DLC-13 mining droids to extract it.

Tognath were a sentient species that were native to the planet Yar Togna. The Tognath had a striking look thanks to their insectoid and mammalian characteristics; another factor was their having both an endo- and exoskeletons.

Yar Togna was an Outer Rim Territories planet that was home to the sentient Tognath species. A high-gravity world with a dense, oxygen-poor atmosphere, it featured a massive volcanic mountain range that ejected large quantities of sulfur and ash into the planet's air.
Special Commando Advanced Recon Troopers, also known as SCAR troopers and the project known as the SCAR program, were elite stormtroopers in the military forces of the Galactic Empire.
Strega were a type of harrier bird with blunt beaks that were roughly the size of dogs. They were capable of being powerful hunters and could be trained when motivated properly.
Fort Ironhand, located near Anchorhead, was one of the two main Galactic Empire army installations on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Nag Ubdur was a planet located in the Ubdur system of the the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was inhabited by Ubdurians. Binjai-Tin was considered to be a large merchant city on the planet.
The Kardavan penitents were a group that originated in the Kardava system of the Mid Rim's Sevastol sector. The group's membership included Humans.
Kaar was a modified Corellian YT-1300 transport used by a Rebel spy during the Galactic Civil War.

Mittoblade was a terrestrial astronomical object known for its razor cliffs that was located in the Mittoblade system in the Inner Rim Territories. It was mentioned in a marching chant sung by Imperial cadets at the Academy for Young Imperials on Lothal.
Old Miner's Highway was a street in Gorse City on the Inner Rim planet of Gorse during the Age of the Empire.
Beggar's Hill was a cemetery on the western edge of Shaketown, a settlement on the Inner Rim planet of Gorse. Despite the name, it was not actually located on a hill.

Wizard's Tower was the communications pod of the Invisible Hand, a Separatist Providence-class Dreadnought present during the Battle of Coruscant. A section of the tower was outfitted by Count Dooku, the leader of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Chaakrabbits were a type of creature that lived on the planet Chaaktil. The bounty hunter Bazine Netal was given the nickname "Chaakrabbit" by her mentor Delphi Kloda.
Taul was an acidic planet in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in grid square J-18 on the Standard Galactic Grid, inhabited by several dangerous creatures, such as the steel-eating spice spiders.

Kerroc was an inhospitable planet allied with the First Order. During the Cold War, the Resistance hired Sidon Ithano and the crew of the Meson Martinet to infiltrate a First Order facility on Kerroc to steal an AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport needed to rescue Gial Ackbar, an imp…

The third moon of Takodana was a rocky moon that had a large sinkhole. This sinkhole was inhabited by several varactyls whose eggs resembled golden orbs. Varactyl eggs were prized on the black market.
Butterflies were flying insects that sported two pairs of large, brilliantly colored wings. The planet Maridun was notably home to the carrier butterflies, who were often used as messengers.
Teklos was a planet. The "Teklos" Mobile Command Base took its name from the planet after it was adapted to combat swoop gangs.

The Satrapy of Myrra was the planetary council of Akiva and composed of several Satraps including Isstra Dirus, who ruled the capital city of Myrra shortly after the Battle of Endor. The Satrapy of Myrra was based in the Satrap's Palace in that city.

Gugverms were a type of vicious creature which lived in the slums of Nar Shaddaa, an Outer Rim moon. In his youth, the human Malakili trained gugverms to stop stealing from food stores. With time, the creatures became his pets, friends, and protectors.
Kill-wings were a type of beast which Malakili trained for Hutt circuses.
Sand dragons were a type of desert-dwelling reptilian creature which Malakili prepared for Hutt circuses.

Orko 9 was an asteroid in the Orko system in the Videnda sector of the Outer Rim Territories. While under the employment of the Galactic Empire, Golas Aram—a Siniteen architect known for designing prisons—oversaw its conversion into a floating prison that he counted among his …
Irudiru was a planet in the galaxy's Irudiru system. Golas Aram, a Siniteen architect specializing in designing prisons, lived in a compound on the planet.
The Blazemaker was a starship owned by Zander Freemaker during the Imperial Era. It was a Z-wing and Zander considered the ship his pride and joy.

The ninth moon of Tilth was a moon that had a presence of water, in the form of the Sea of Carawak. The sea contained a floating depot that was once used by Grand Admiral Rae Sloane to refuel her battleship, the Dreadstar.
The Sea of Carawak was a large sea located on the ninth moon of Tilth. It contained a floating depot once visited by Grand Admiral Rae Sloane to refuel her battleship, the Dreadstar.

objective: Kill New Republic leaders
x: The attack on Chandrila occurred during the festivities of Liberation Day—the day scheduled for peace talks between Mon Mothma of the New Republic and Rae Sloane of the Galactic Empire—on Chandrila, newly-freed prisoners from Ashmead's Lock on Kashyyyk who were under the influ…
The Endor blue butterfly was a species of butterfly native to the forest moon of Endor. It was named for its wings, which were blue in coloration.

Chomong were a sea creature native to Velusia, and were referred to by Leia Organa as diaphanous blobs of glowing flesh. Their fossilized corpses made up an aggregate of crystalline matter off the coast of Kolo-ha, an island on Velusia.

Mandlertoks were a type of lizard that could be eaten by humans when skewered and cooked over a fire. At some point, the human general Leia Organa ate a skewered mandlertok during a culinary ritual as part of her diplomatic duties.

Goliath Mal was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Colonies' Goliath Mal system, situated in grid square N-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid in the Slice, that served the food known as pickled coodler-roe as a culinary tradition.

Kolo-ha was a claw-shaped atoll of islands on the planet Velusia, and was the mouth of an extinct volcano. New Republic leaders, including Chancellor Mon Mothma and Leia Organa, traveled here to negotiate the surrender of Grand Vizier Mas Amedda.
Velusia was a planet located in the Velusia system and the homeworld of the Velusian species, which occupied most of the planet except the volcanic atoll of Kolo-ha.
Velusians were a species from Velusia. They lived on every part of the planet except the atoll of Kolo-ha. Velusians ate raw chomong, a native sea creature.
Belladoon was a world located in the Myto sector's Belladoon system within the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories regions.
Questal was an astronomical object in the Questal system and Questal sector of the Core Worlds that the Imperial Lambda-class shuttle CS-831 was supposed to travel to.
Korrus was a world located in the Clacis sector's Korrus system within the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories regions.
Zhadalene was a world located in the Kanz sector's Zhadalene system within an intersecting portion of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories.
Bilge-bugs were a type of insect in the galaxy. In 19 BBY, the clone trooper Doc joked to Jedi Knight Iskat Akaris that their ration bars were made of bilge-bug protein.
Bladder-bugs were a type of hissing insect that lived in the forests and canyons of the planet Akiva.
Starlegs were a type of aquatic creature caught and processed on the planet Chandrila, along with skor-fin, marmal-fish, and pearlshells.

Ateles were type of hooting bird that could be found in the Outer Rim planet Akiva's Canyon of Akar. While visiting the planet Kashyyyk in 5 ABY, the Akivan native and pilot Norra Wexley considered the relative silence of the world, comparing it to the noises made by Akiva's f…
The marmal-fish was a species of fish native to the oceans of Chandrila.
The Neimoidian tick larva was a parasitic larva native to the planet Neimoidia that induced a craving for blood in its host's brain.

result: The Resistance helps Grakkus the Hutt escape Megalox prison
objective: Help Grakkus the Hutt escape Megalox
x: The mission to Megalox Beta was undertaken during the Cold War by Commander Poe Dameron and Black Squadron of the Resistance to locate Lor San Tekka. They wanted to question the imprisoned Hutt crime lord Grakkus, who had encountered Lor San Tekka a long time ago.
Hoven was an astronomical object located in the Inner Rim.
Seymarti V was the fifth planet of the Seymarti system. Han Solo destroyed the planet in 2 ABY.
Haaridin was a world located in the Kwymar sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Seven months after the Battle of Yavin, Imperial stormtroopers on Zeitooine arrested a local family after the parents persistently violated a ban on independent publications. The stormtroopers forcibly dragged the family out of their home.
Seven months after the Battle of Yavin, the Imperial Star Destroyer Devastator undertook an evacuation of the Imperial garrisons on Ivarujar, a planet that had undergone a massive volcanic eruption.
The New Republic Security Bureau (NRSB) was an intelligence and law enforcement agency of the New Republic. It was founded less than a month before the Liberation Day attacks in 5 ABY.
T-2L0, often called Ello, was an attendant protocol droid owned by Leia Organa of the New Republic in 5 ABY.
The Teeno Village district, also known as the Teeno Village sector, was a district in Coronet City, the capital city of the planet Corellia. A pair of artists resided in the district.
Diadem Square was a square located in Coronet City, the capital city of the planet Corellia. It was the main location of a revolution organized by the Acolytes of the Beyond.
Juni Street Station was a mag-lev station near a group of casinos in Coronet City, the capital city of the planet Corellia. It was once home to a revolution organized by the Acolytes of the Beyond.
Mangan Three was a world located in the Colonies.

Cioran was a planet located in the Saavin system, a part of the Southern Core portion of the Core Worlds. During the Galactic Civil War, the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Ravenous monitored the traffic around Cioran.
Trundalki IV was a world located in the Mid Rim.

Gnats were small creatures that lived on the planet Vorlag, congregated in swarms, and ate rotting meat. There was a large number of them outside Slussen Urla-fir Kal Kethin-wa Canker's palace because of the large amount of flesh stored there to be fed to his hroth-beasts.
Ningoth was a remote ocean planet inhabited by Opee sea killers. The bottom of Ningoth's oceans were covered in rock spires.
The capture of Cygnus Staff was an operation committed by the Rebel Alliance to capture staff from Cygnus Spaceworks.
R0-HK was a B1-series battle droid who fought alongside fellow B1 battle droid R0-GR in the Battle of Naboo. Years later, he was put on display at the Emperor Palpatine Museum.
An EV-series supervisor droid was used by Darth Vader to torture Overseer Aggadeen for his failure to prevent Weapons Factory Alpha's destruction at the hands of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The battle of Keeper's World was a running battle from the space around Keeper's World to its surface. Princess Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, C-3PO, and R2-D2 were spared when they discovered The Keeper, who faked their deaths and drove the Imperial forces into retreat.
An unidentified Imperial fighter craft was used by an Imperial commander and four stormtroopers to pursue a Rebel scout craft to the surface of Keeper's World during the Battle of The Keeper's World.
Unidentified creatures, humanoid in appearance with pink fur, dwelled on Keeper's World and were a threat to any who landed on the planet.

Project Shantipole was a venture devised by the Mon Calamari master engineer Quarrie to develop a blockade buster starfighter. Based on the planet Shantipole, the project's major output was the "Blade Wing" Prototype B6.
The Harbinger was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy famous for being one of the only Star Destroyers to be hijacked by the Rebel Alliance.

The Dissolution of the Imperial Senate was the dissolvement of the legislative body of the Galactic Empire, enacted by the decree of Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine in response to the Galactic Civil War.
Zoh was an unhabited junk planet where Jek-14 settled during the Imperial Era. The Freemakers found Jek-14 in Zoh, and requested him to train Rowan Freemaker in the ways of the Force.
Insectomorphs were a domesticated four-legged species on the planet Malastare which were used as mounts by soldiers of the sentient Dug species.

Cliffhold was a spaceport city that was built directly into the face of a basalt cliff on the planet Iego. By the time of the Clone Wars, Cliffhold was much less busy than in previous times due to the spice convoys no longer running through the area.
Quantxi, also known as the Junk Moon of Ord Mantell, was one of at least three moons that orbited the Mid Rim planet Ord Mantell. It was terrestrial and covered in a junkyard.
Bulabirds were a species of bird native to the planet Chandrila. They had star-tipped beaks and strutted around the pebbles and sand near a bar off Junari Point. They had good hearing.

Falcon was a Lambda-class shuttle used by the Rebel Alliance. When Shantipole Project was compromised by an Imperial spy the project staff, Admiral Ackbar, and the two prototype B-wings had to evacuate. The first prototype was unarmed but the second was and provided support.

The azurdactyl was a two-legged aquamarine and black reptavian found on the Outer Rim planet Jagomir. The flying creatures were somewhat intelligent, a fact that members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic learned while stationed on the planet.
An evarrian was a large insectoid predator native to the swamps of Jagomir.
Ranger was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Trident was the personal Trident-class assault ship of Asajj Ventress during the Clone Wars.
Doshan was an Expansion Region world situated in the Drannik sector. It was the homeworld of Doshan blood worms.
Fixer was an MSE-6 series repair droid who worked for Jek-14 on Zoh.
Klytus V, was a gas giant in the fifth orbital position of the Klytus system located on the edge of Wild Space in grid square H-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Sriluurian butterflies were a type of butterfly from the planet Sriluur.
Danorian wolves were a species of wolf in the galaxy. When Milo Graf encountered the Devaronian Cikatro Vizago, the boy likened Vizago's grin to that of a Danorian wolf.
IG-70 was a masculine IG-series assassin droid who worked for Rask Odai, leader of the Twin Horns Storage crime front.
SD-357 was a police droid that was active during the Clone Wars, serving at the Cybloc Transfer Station belonging to the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

N-3RO was a droid who worked for Jek-14 on Zoh. He and his fellow droids were castaways who respected Jek-14 for looking after their well-being. Due to his past experience, N-3RO had a hatred for sentient beings apart from Jek-14; whom he revered as the Maker of Zoh.
BL-OX was a member of a community of castoff droids who lived on the junkyard world of Zoh. This community was led by the Jek-14, who was known as the Maker of Zoh.
The Resistance spy droid network was a group of droids across the galaxy used as spies for the Resistance during the Cold War. The network was run by C-3PO.
The Ground Logistics Division (GLD) was a branch of the Resistance ground crew. Vober Dand served as a GLD controller monitoring operations.
Wavers' Peak was a mountain on the planet of Jelucan.
"Carly" was a murderous BD-3000 luxury droid who served in the kitchen of Takodana Castle on Takodana alongside fellow BD-3000 droid "J'Nell."
"J'Nell" was a BD-3000 luxury droid who, along with the BD-3000 known as "Carly," worked in the kitchen of Takodana Castle on Takodana.

The Nautilian was an MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser that served in the Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War. It participated in the decisive battle fought at Endor, where it was entirely obliterated by the second Death Star.
The raid above Bonadan was a hit and run attack on an Imperial commerce area in the Bonadan system during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.
a: Commerce Raid in the Bonadan system

x: Krayt was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle under the employ the Galactic Empire.

result: Emperor Arcann dethroned and taken into hiding
x: The Battle of Odessen occurred around 3630 BBY when Emperor Arcann of the Eternal Empire, having learned the location of the Alliance base on the planet Odessen from SCORPIO, who took over his Eternal Throne, led the detachment of the Eternal Fleet still under his control to d…
R4-M1 was an R4 astromech droid who served the Galactic Republic and Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.

Vertseth was a planet in the Vertseth system of the Colonies that was the homeworld of Vertseth Automata, a droid manufacturing company that produced techno-service droids. One such droid was named Todo 360 and operated under the bounty hunter Cad Bane during the Clone Wars.

The Aleen Underworld was the subterranean wilderness of the planet Aleen. The Kindalo species thrived in the unique atmosphere of the Underworld, and also served as the domain of the strange being called Orphne.

Mimbanites were a species of eight-limbed brown-furred creatures native to the planet Mimban. They dwelled in the mixture of jungle and swamp that covered the surface of the planet. Luke Skywalker encountered one in 2 ABY, but it quickly fled.

Imperial combat assault tank pilots, also known as GAV pilots, GAV troopers, tank troopers, were Imperial combat drivers specialized in operating tank vehicles, such as the TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank.
The conference with the Circarpousian underground was an important meeting of local resistance groups in the Circarpous system in 2 ABY.

Coway shafts were underground tunnels used by the Coway to travel beneath the surface of Mimban. They were well-lit with phosphorescent growths. The Coway would often connect these tunnels to existing Thrella wells for surface access.

Aut-O was an ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid who served in the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars with the military rank of commander.

The five mine towns contained the human population of Mimban. They were established and overseen by the Galactic Empire, and consisted primarily of miners operating the energy drill and other mine equipment gathering resources for the Empire.

Several Circarpous resistance groups opposed the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. As of 2 ABY these groups were underground, as the Circarpous system was unwilling to openly support the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
A depot station operated by the Trade Federation was located on the planet Tyne Albamon. The station was created some time after the Bordal Contagion.

Kerkoidia was a blue-gray planet located in the Kerkoidia system in the Kira sector the Expansion Region, in grid square N-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid The Kerkoiden species was native to the world, and the Kerkoiden male Whorm Loathsom served for a long time in its planet…

Nosaurians were a horned sentient species that was native to New Plympto and had red eyes and orange, white, and yellow skin. They were mainly found in forested environments. They were considered ill-tempered, and often refused to communicate in Galactic Basic Standard.
During the Clone Wars, a funeral was held for Jedi Master Even Piell on the planet Lola Sayu after he was killed by an anooba whilst escaping from the Separatist prison known as the Citadel.
