The rebels acquire a Sheathipede-class transport shuttle
objective: Obtain munitions
x: In 2 BBY, Captain Rex and the Spectres undertook a mission to the planet Agamar to obtain proton bombs from a Separatist supply ship.

The Phantom II was a modified Sheathipede-class transport shuttle belonging to the Spectres. It replaced the team's original VCX-series auxiliary starfighter Phantom, which was lost during the mission to Reklam Station.
The derrick major was an area on Coruscant that had cargo docks underneath it.
V2A DAZ was a droid that served as a forensic science commander in the Coruscant Security Force during the Clone Wars.

One year after the Clone Wars, the moon Raada had a settlement where Selda's cantina was located. Former Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano briefly hid out there under the name "Ashla" while hiding from the Galactic Empire.
In 1 BBY, the prototype astromech droid P2 stood within the equipment-filled garage of Tosche Station on the planet Tatooine, dwarfing a nearby R5 droid who was repairing a generator.
Z1-Z0 was a droid pirate crime lord during the Galactic Civil War. He realized that it is better to lead than to serve.

place: Hyborean Moon black-site prison, Hyborean Moon
x: One month before the liberation of Kashyyyk, forces of the New Republic attacked the Imperial-held Hyborean Moon, destroying the ISB's blacksite prison as well as its civilian complexes.
Logron's desert farmstead was the hideout of the crime lord Logron on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

A RA-7 protocol droid was active on the Smuggler's Moon, Nar Shaddaa, shortly before the skirmish in Grakkus the Hutt's arena. The droid was destroyed by Chewbacca after another droid attempted to cut off C-3PO's head.
Bespin Motors facilities were the manufactories of Bespin Motors in Cloud City on Bespin. They were located near Port Town, an infamous area of the city.
An LOM-series protocol droid was one of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's bounty hunters who attempted to capture Luke Skywalker after the boy stole water from their speeder.
Civilian exploratory corps was an organization of the Galactic Republic which commissioned the AT-EST exploration walker to Rothana Heavy Engineering.

The Nallastian movement was an organization founded by a group of Fondorians who left the Fondor Guild of Starshipwrights to protect Nallastia, a moon of Fondor, against intensive exploitation. Mon Calamari and Ithorians senators supported the movement.
Bardotta Capital City was the capital city of Bardotta.
The Ro-ti-Mundi was a Venator-class Star Destroyer of the Open Circle Fleet, a major space fleet of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.

result: Vanqor's invasion plans for Typha-Dor are disrupted, peace is negotiat
objective: Rescue Typha-Dor's TY44 satellite outpost workers
x: The Mission to Typha-Dor took place in 25 BBY.
Moraga was a jungle planet located in the Oricho sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Moragan species.

Lahn-rats were a type of rat native to the planet Lahn. In 4 BBY, when the rebel cell known as the Spectres undertook a mission on Lahn, the Jedi Padawan Ezra Bridger attempted to lure a pair of stormtroopers away from their post as a distraction for his master, Kanan Jarrus, …

The Blue Flare was an old light freighter that belonged to Sona Fey'lya, a female Bothan smuggler. At some point, Logron, a crime lord on Tatooine, took away the Blue Flare as payback. She later was able to steal it with the help of the Pero brothers and an adventurer.
Illmek Island was an island on the planet Lahn. An outpost of the Galactic Empire was located there.

The World That Was were the remains of an advanced civilization destroyed in a war between the Open and the Closed. It was located under the Celadon Sea, a poisonous mist that Grecker claimed the Open poisoned Carnelion IV with.
Fishers, also known as corpses, were a sentient species of carnivores native to Carnelion IV. They were mutated from humans who lived on the planet as a result of the poisonous Celadon Sea.

Carnelian dragons were a type of carnivorous reptilian dragon native to the planet Carnelion IV. They had four legs, eight blue eyes, red and green skin and an aggressive behavior towards other organisms.

New Alderaan was a safeworld that the Alderaanian survivor Janray Tessime spent time on during the Galactic Civil War tending civilian populations. It was located in the Ash Worlds in the Outer Rim Territories. The festival of Winter's Heart was celebrated on New Alderaan.

Signal Intelligence, also referred to as Signals Intelligence, was an intelligence organization within the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Its technicians gathered secret information from Imperial electronic signals such as encrypted communications chatter.

Rendezvous Point: Victim was a location in the Outer Rim Territories where Captain Lerr Duvat aboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Torment rendezvoused with a messenger that was carrying an important message from Emperor Palpatine.
The Great Basin was a wide, water-filled valley on the jungle planet Akiva. It contained the cliff known as the Witch's Finger, and the middle of the basin was taken up by Lake Amari.
The Chenza Hill was a location on the planet Akiva.
The Orchard Hill was a location on the planet Akiva.
The homeworld of the Squamatan species was a planet located in the Squamat system in the Mayagil sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Squamatans were a sentient species of humanoids notable for their blue skin and acidic venom. They were enslaved under the Galactic Empire to assist in acquiring thorilide minerals from their homeworld.
Pheryon was a gas giant located in the galaxy's Inner Rim. Poe Dameron traveled to Pheryon during the Cold War to meet with the journalist Suralinda Javos.
The Galaxy Beacon was a HoloNet channel that the journalist Suralinda Javos worked for around the time of the Cold War.
A skirmish occurred on the Inner Rim planet of Pheryon during the Cold War.
The Cobalt Laborers' Reformation Front, or just Cobalt Front, was an anti-Imperial workers' association on the planet of Sullust, which fought for better safety and factory standards.

Valgauth was the homeworld of the Valgauthians, a group of human who had a reputation as berserkers when boarding starships. As such, a Valgauthian was regarded as a valuable addition to any pirate crew.

The Claatuvac Guild was an ancient organization of Wookiee cartographers and navigators reputed for their knowledge of secret hyperspace routes. The Guild's headquarters were located in the Tree Vikkilynn, in the settlement of Kachirho, Kashyyyk.
Wroshyr lice were insects found in the wroshyr trees of Kashyyyk. The native Wookiees processed them in distilleries to make wroshyr lice syrup.

t: Mission to hijack an Imperial weapons shipment
objective: Hijack an Imperial weapons shipment
x: In 14 BBY, several members of the Free Ryloth Movement led by Pok undertook a mission to hijack an Imperial weapons shipment at the Yaga Minor shipyards.
During the Dragon Void Run, pilots participating in the race stopped on a planet. Whilst on the planet, the pilots were arrested by Imperial forces. However, the racers were later released.

Arthon was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Arthon system within the Ottega sector of the Mid Rim and New Territories. It was situated in grid square L-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid, and was inhabited by members of the sentient Ottegan species.
GL-916 was a green-plated shopkeeper droid with red sensors that owned a kiosk in the lower market districts of the planet Coruscant's underworld in 21 BBY.
K-8PO was a protocol droid on Coruscant during the Clone Wars.

A needlebug was an insect. It was also used as a term to describe someone who was holding someone else back. Princess Leia Organa took pride in being the official needlebug in Emperor Sheev Palpatine's side in the Imperial Senate.

result: The Sith are driven off Coruscant
x: The Liberation of Coruscant was a battle during the Jedi-Sith War, in which the Jedi Order succeeded in driving the Sith off Coruscant. Later, an arcade of stained-glass windows and statues in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant honored the Jedi heroes of this battle.

Q2-B3KO, or Threekayo, was a feminine-programmed articulated holographic color separator. Originally a class five droid, she was mistakenly upgraded to class one status as a result of a requisition error.

objective: Bring back Sith artifacts
x: Sometime before the Battle of Coruscant, an expedition was sent to the planet of Malachor at the behest of Darth Sidious, a Dark Lord of the Sith whose public persona was Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine of the Galactic Republic.

A species of non-sentient arthropods evolved on the volcanic planet of Mustafar, where they lived in mountain caves that protected them from the lava. Eventually, they evolved into the sentient Mustafarian species.

The Umbaran airbase was an airbase located on the planet Umbara. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the Umbaran Militia, an ally of the Separatists, used the airbase as a supply line to the planet's capital city.
The Sundari Warehouse District was a district in the New Mandalorian city of Sundari. During the Clone Wars, Prime Minister Almec used a warehouse to store black market supplies.

The shadow rancor was a subspecies of the reptilian, semi-sentient rancor species notorious for its penchant for destruction. Easily recognized by their black-tinted skin, they attacked anything within arms reach.

The rage rancor was a rare subspecies of the reptilian, semi-sentient rancor species aptly named for having an even nastier temperament than the more common of its kind. It towered over its cousins, with extreme strength and toughness to match.

A relay was the source of all HoloNet communications on the planet Murkhana. During the Clone Wars, it was utilized by the Confederacy of Independent Systems to transmit Shadowfeeds, Separatist propaganda transmissions, to enemy worlds along the Perlemian Trade Route.

The Clabburn Range was a mountain range on the snow planet Hoth. The Alliance to Restore the Republic built their base into the mountains of the Clabburn Range and used a relatively flat ground to the base's immediate south as a staging area for evacuation.
Caamas was an astronomical body located in the Cirius system within the galaxy's Core Worlds. It shared its name with Caamasi light sculpture, and Caamasi cheese pie.
The Upper Ring was a part of the Wheel space station that was restricted to the rich, and the Galactic Empire. Some notable residents included Wick Cooper, Becky Smoochenbacher and Furlac.

The coronation of Queen Amidala as monarch of Naboo took place on the Day of Ascendancy, during the final years of the Galactic Republic. Padmé Amidala was elected to the throne of the Royal House of Naboo, becoming the queen of her people at the age of fourteen.
The Rokarian dirt-fish was a type of fish found in the Rokaria system of the Outer Rim Territories. Members of the galactic populace were known to "gut" dirt-fish.
The Nev Ice Flow was located on Hoth. The Rebel Alliance built Echo Base south of the ice flow, and the Battle of Hoth took place over it.

Sneeps, also known as pishnes, were a species of non-sentient bird that were long-necked, soft-mouthed, feathered creatures that resembled a combination of avian and mollusk. They could be found in the galaxy thirty years after the battle of Endor.

The Senate Guard was an elite security force of the New Republic. Its duties were for the protecting the New Republic Senate. The Senate Guards was the restoration of the original Senate Guard of the Old Republic, resuming their role as defenders of democracy.

result: The Sith capture Coruscant and take control of the Jedi Temple
x: A battle was fought on Coruscant during the Jedi-Sith War that ultimately ended in a Sith victory.
The Toydarian royal delegation was a commission of individuals from the planet Toydaria.

The Middle Ring was a section of the space station called The Wheel in the Abrion system. It was home to the Freemaker Salvage and Repair, a family starship and repair business owned and operated by the Freemakers. It was located between the Lower Ring and the Upper Ring.

Hera's A-wing was an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor used by the rebel pilot Hera Syndulla. Syndulla was the leader of Phoenix Squadron, a squadron of A-wing fighters that was a part of the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
The Epoch Swift was the personal starship of Maz Kanata. It was kept in a private hangar in her castle on the planet Takodana.

Cazne was an area of cratered flatlands located on the planet Ryloth. The site of a major battle during the Battle of Ryloth, it was marked by a number of simple Twi'lek graves, while the underground hideout of the Twi'lek Resistance was hidden beneath the wreckage of a C-9979…

Mos Elrey was a settlement within the small inhabited portion of the desert planet Tatooine's northern hemisphere. It was located on the eastern edge of the Western Dune Sea near the south western edge of the Jundland Wastes.

Codenka Mafurias was the moniker used by the creator of the podracing poster "The Sport's Greatest Rivalry," which depicted the rivalry between podracers Ben Quadinaros and Sebulba in the final decades of the Galactic Republic before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.

Tayron was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Videnda sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Wretch of Tayron housed an Imperial Security Bureau black site during the Galactic Civil War.

Garel Shuttle 63725 was a GX1 short hauler on Garel. In 4 BBY, the Spectres Sabine Wren and Chopper hijacked the shuttle after picking up the GNK-series power droid EG-86. The shuttle was damaged in a skirmish with the bounty hunter Ketsu Onyo's ship Shadow Caster.

Orchis 2 was a terrestrial moon in the Orchis system where the Graf Archive, a depository of records and artifacts, was located. The moon was home to the Graf family and at one point was occupied by the Galactic Empire.

x: In 2 BBY, members of Phoenix Cell undertook a mission to the third moon of Concord Dawn. After the Phoenix Cell lost contact with the Mandalorian Protectors, Fenn Rau, Sabine Wren, Ezra Bridger, and Chopper traveled to the third moon to investigate.

The Avenue of the Core Founders was a large concourse which served as the pathway to the Senate Building's entrance on Coruscant. It was adorned with humanoid statues representing the original founders of the Galactic Republic, all of whom hailed from the Core Worlds.
Bastion was an industrialized planet located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. Also part of the New Territories, it was connected via hyperspace route to Anthan Prime.
Zequardia was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Zequardia system in the Dalchon sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It became the site of a battle during the Clone Wars.

type: Resistance organization of the oppressed Romin people
headquarters: Resistance base at "Teda Estates," Romin capital of Eliior
x: The Citizens' Resistance was a large organization of the desperate, oppressed citizens of the planet Romin, which for many years before the Clone Wars and the rise of the Galactic Empire was ruled by the tyrant-dictator Roy Teda.
New Coral City was a city on the Outer Rim ocean planet Mon Cala, homeworld of the Mon Calamari and Quarren species, that existed by 20 BBY.
The Hidden Cave was located in the Nightsister lair and was the home of Old Daka, who summoned the Army of the Dead to destroy the Separatist Droid Army which had attacked Dathomir.

Soun IV was an astronomical object with royalty in the Soun system of the Expansion Region in grid square J-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. A humanoid princess from Soun IV visited the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant shortly before the Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY.
The Sub-Adult Group (SAGroup) was a youth-based organization consisting of enthusiastic youth members fervently loyal to Emperor Sheev Palpatine, the Galactic Empire, and the tenets of the New Order.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: The capture of the Helot's Shackle was a Alliance to Restore the Republic mission to liberate slaves being transported from the Besadii Hutt planet Ylesia aboard the CR90 corvette Helot's Shackle.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory

x: During the Galactic Civil War as a part of Operation Ringbreaker, 20 soldiers of the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry launched an attack on the Kuliquo belt in 3 ABY, an Imperial mining asteroid field.

The planet Galidraan IV had at least two moons. One of these was considered its outermost moon.
The Battle of Foerost occurred by around 5 BBY, sharing its name with the terrestrial astronomical object Foerost.
Sector Monitors were civilian spy agencies that were part of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's Coalition for Progress.

x: The Commission for a Safe and Secure Republic was a nonprofit think tank based on Level 5121 of the planet Coruscant during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
a: Commision for a Safe and Secure Republic

x: The Shadow Stacks was the subterranean department of the Graf Archive on Orchis 2. The items that could not be immediately identified were stored there awaiting processing.
The Belnar Insurrections were a series of events that took place sometime by the year 3 ABY, taking place in the vicinity of the Colonies' Belnar system.
The battle on Phorsa Gedd took place during the Galactic Civil War between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire as part of the former's Mid Rim offensive of circa 1 ABY–2 ABY.

The Chargona campaign was a battle that involved the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry sometime by the year 3 ABY during the reign of the Galactic Empire. It took place in the vicinity of the Expansion Region's Chargona system.
In 0 ABY, shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Nakari Kelen and fledging Jedi Luke Skywalker undertook a mission to Pasher.
A battle took place on the planet Phindar between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and Galactic Empire.

t: Raid on an Imperial heavy freighter
x: During the Galactic Civil War, in 3 ABY, the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry undertook a raid on an Imperial heavy freighter.
During the Galactic Civil War, the CR90 corvette Thunderstrike was infiltrated at a rendezvous in the Elochar sector in 3 ABY.
Z0-0M, also known as Zeeyo Ohm, previously the Shroud, was a feminine replicator droid who was active during the Cold War.

During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems launched an attack on the planet Phindar. After the rise of the Galactic Empire, Moff Wilhuff Tarkin recalled the attack in a conversation with the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
The Concordian mines were a series of mines constructed on Concordia, the moon of the planet Mandalore.

The taqwa (which translated into "snow-strider" in Galactic Basic Standard) was a multi-headed, non-sentient quadruped hailing from the planet of Vallt. Despite their innate ferocity, the taqwa were used as draft animals by Vallt's native, blue faced sentients, the Valltii.

The Valltii were a sentient species native to the planet of Vallt. They were stout, with large round faces and mouths designed to chew meat, ice-blue skin, and lustrous growth of facial hair. According to Galen Erso, they were skilled stoneworkers.
Kaddak was a lawless planet located in the Kaddak system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, near Rothana. In the years of the New Republic, it was controlled by the Ranc Gang.

Vallt was a planet located in the Juris sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Valltii and Taqwa species, and also the birthplace of Jyn Erso. Vallt was a cold world, with half the planet covered in glacial ice.

In 4 BBY, the inhabitants of Rampa 2 staged an uprising against the Galactic Empire. Several Imperial troops were wounded or killed when the rebels attacked an Imperial facility, before being routed and captured by Imperial forces.
Crimson Squadron was a squadron of R60 T-wing interceptors employed by Airam Clan leader and Imperial collaborator Ilay.
Cobalt Squadron was a squadron of R60 T-wing interceptors employed by Airam Clan leader and Imperial collaborator Ilay.
Tiger Squadron was a squadron of 4 Y-wings employed by Airam Clan leader and Imperial collaborator Ilay.
Tambolor was a city located on the planet Vallt. During the Clone Wars, the scientist Galen Erso was held prisoner in the Tambolor prison.

Dreivus was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Oeiros sector's Dreivus system, within an intersecting portion of the Expansion Region and the Slice.

Vurdon Ka was a planet located in the Vurdon Ka system in the Darlonn sector of the galaxy's Inner Rim that was the homeworld of the Vuvrian species. It was located close to one end of the Perlemian Trade Route, which connected it to the planets Castell and Chazwa.

A spaceport in the Outer Rim Territories was the site of a duel between two Jedi Finn Ertay and a Nikto Jedi and the brothers Darth Maul and Savage Opress around 19 BBY during the Clone Wars. The two Jedi were both killed during the battle.
R3-D3 was an R3-series astromech droid active during the Galactic Civil War.
Talrezan Four was the fourth orbit of the Talrezan system in the Tandon sector within an intersecting portion of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice.

Unroola Dawn was located in the Unroola Dawn system in the Mid Rim Territories' Doldur sector. Situated at the coordinates P-15 on the Standard Galactic Grid, it was affiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Haidoral Administrative Center One was a city located on the Mid Rim planet Haidoral Prime. It was known as Glitter by the locals due to the crystal mountains that were located nearby.

Vanzeist was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Suolriep sector's Vanzeist system, within an intersecting portion of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice regions.

A city was the capital of the planet Ankhural. Sometime before she joined the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, Brand came to the planet and the city had been enclosed by a ray shield that filtered out of the billowing dust of the surrounding silica plains.

A Geonosian empire was ruled by the Queen Karina on the desert planet Geonosis after it was sterilized by the Galactic Empire. Karina, however, was injured by the Empire, and lost the reproductive use of her womb.

The Ryn were a humanoid sentient species with white hair and prehensile tails. They were known to be itinerant and were rarely seen in the Core Worlds. Shortly before the end of the Clone Wars, two Ryn followed Lyra Erso only to offer a scintillating pendant.

A species of tentacled creatures lived on the planet Kelrodo-Ai during the early years of the Galactic Empire. The creatures, which were pink and red in color, lived in tunnels and laid gelatinous black eggs which they violently protected from intruders.

Hypori was a remote planet located in the Hypori system in the Ferra sector of the Outer Rim Territories that had a hydrothermal landscape that was host to a Techno Union droid factory.
Mac-Vee was a nanny and housekeeping droid who served the Erso family. After leaving for Lah'mu, Jyn Erso admitted that she missed Mac-Vee, and wondered what the droid would do without them.
The Galactic Republic's Grand Army of the Republic—assisted by the Jedi Order—and the Confederacy of Independent Systems waged a battle on the planet Hypori in 22 BBY as part of the Clone Wars.
The Salient Campaign, also known as the Battle of Salient or as the campaign at Salient, was a multi-week battle that took place in the Salient system in 17 BBY.
Hangar Six was a hangar bay located onboard the First Order's Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Finalizer.
Bay Two was a launch bay located on the wall of Hangar Six onboard the First Order's Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Finalizer.

Merj was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the methane-breathing Morseerian species. During the Clone Wars, it was a member world of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Alpinn was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories where Lyra Erso searched for kyber crystals. Alpinn reflected light in realspace due to the remnants of ancient mineral seas.
Assis was a TDK-160 research-assistant droid. Sometime before the rescue of Galen Erso, the droid worked with a group of scientists notably including Galen and Lyra Erso on the planet Vallt.
Espinar was a planet located in the Espinar system of the Core Worlds where Lyra Erso led a survey team, discovered and mapped a cave system that promised a bounty of rare crystalline deposits.

Hellenah was an astronomical object in the Hellenah system in the Xan sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square Q-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Sometime before 21 BBY, the Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt delivered munitions to Hellenah, garnering a hefty profit.

Lah'mu was a ringed agrarian planet in the Raioballo sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its small population of settlers included the Erso family, who relocated to Lah'mu after the Clone Wars, and were ultimately tracked down by Director Orson Callan Krennic years later.

The Vagrant was a Corellian Engineering Corporation YV-666 light freighter owned by the Aqualish crime lord and smuggler Bandin Dobah. It served as Dobah's hideout but was badly maintained and its hyperdrive did not work anymore.

The Room of Morning Mists was a room in the Varykino lake retreat on the planet Naboo. The controversial poet Omar Berenko wrote one of his most famous works, the disturbing and visionary epic poem Defense of Naboo, in this room.

Atrisia, also known as Kitel Phard, was a Core Worlds celestial body featuring brush on its surface. Atrisian mythology included the demigod Wapoe, and at some point, the celestial body was ruled over by the Atrisian Emperors.

Bonadan was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories Corporate Sector that marked the start of the Hydian Way. By 10 BBY, the arms dealers Ephant Mon and Masse Goskey had attended an arms exchange on the planet.
R4 was an R-series astromech droid that flew with Scout Two. Along with Scout Two and Scout Three, R4 was destroyed when they discovered the First Death Star.

The Republic Corps of Engineers was an organization of the Galactic Republic. Its purpose was to construct and maintain facilities throughout the galaxy, both onworld and in deep space, for the use of the Republic.
Synistahg was an astronomical object in the Synistahg system in the Lothal sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In the year 2 BBY, the Galactic Empire blockaded Synistahg.

R3-A3 was an R3-series astromech droid and member of a local rebel cell on Mykapo called the Iron Squadron. He was responsible for maintaining the Sato's Hammer systems and customized it to its own specifications.

The Sato's Hammer was a YT-2400 light freighter used by Iron Squadron.
Fire Plants were a species of plant native to the planet Dagobah. They bore a striking similarity to the Ice Plants found on the ice planet Hoth.

The Speeder Bike Assault Force was a group of Imperial snowtroopers and/or Vader's Special Force Troopers equipped with Speeder Bikes. Luke Skywalker encountered Speeder Bikers during the Battle of Hoth as well as the Occupation of Bespin.
Bandin Dobah's asteroid base was an asteroid located in the Pit, an area of stray asteroids scattered throughout the arm of a nebula and located at the end of the Kessel Run.

The Arms Interdiction Task Force was a branch of the New Republic Security Force assigned to handle black market arms dealers. Drev Prilarca was a commander in the task force who was working on obtaining information related to the arms dealer known as "Gundark."

Late in the Clone Wars, the Separatist cruiser Obrexta III was attacked in a sector of the galaxy by Galactic Republic forces en route to deliver clone trooper CT-6116 "Kix", who had been captured on Coruscant by Separatist forces, to Confederate leader Count Dooku's palace on…
Rudy was a green and white R2-series astromech droid known for its "gleeful" enjoyment of taking over systems and turning them against perceived enemies.

Suba was a planet located in the Atravis sector within the Outer Rim Territories. The Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt found the Malicious Moondog, a cantina on Suba, no more nastier than the cantina on Rajtiri, the Wanton Wellspring.

Jibuto was an ancient city located on the arid planet of Rajtiri. It was believed Jibuto prospered as a result of Rajtiri birthing and fostering more smugglers anywhere outside of Hutt Space.

The Roche Asteroid Field was an asteroid field in the Shantipole system, a star system in the Roche sector in the galaxy's Mid Rim, in grid square Q-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid, situated between Lantillies and Abhean on the Perlemian Trade Route.

The Chimaera was a modified Imperial I-class Star Destroyer captained by Imperial officer Thrawn during the Galactic Civil War.
Dressel was an remote astronomical object located in the Dressel system in the Noolian sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Dressellian species, including Has Obitt.

Eadu (pronounced /ˈiːduː/) was a storm-stricken planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It hosted the Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory prior to the outbreak of the Galactic Civil War, where Galen Erso and his team of scientists attempted to unlock the secrets of the kyber crysta…

The Good Tidings was a light freighter owned by the Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt during the Clone Wars. It was agile, making it good at slipping through blockades. Obitt handled the freighter with skill, which had been learned through years of piloting.
The Cupola was a location on the planet Coruscant. At some point before the Campaign at Salient, the lawyer Arsha Lome and Governor Wilhuff Tarkin visited the Cupola.
The Koboks were a sentient species of skeletal insectoids.

The Tynnans were a species of furred and bucktoothed aquatic mammalian sentients from the planet Tynna. The species was adapted to freshwater environments and had sensitive snouts to make up for their poor eyesight.

The Trianii were a species of bipedal felinoid sentients from the Trian system. In an attempt to impress a Trianii debutante, Lando Calrissian once took a swing at the Esoomian brawler Bumblethunk, who beat him down and stole the Smuggler's Guide from him.
Jedha City, also known as the Holy City, NiJedha in the ancient texts, or simply Jedha, was an ancient walled city located on the desert moon of Jedha.

2-1B Delta was a 2-1B surgical droid who initially belonged to the Galactic Empire. While working throughout the military prison system, he developed an aversion to the damage done to organic flesh by Imperial weapons, which eventually prompted him to flee.

"Pinprick" was the nickname the Rebels of the Anoat sector gave to an IT-O interrogator droid they salvaged from an inexplicable wrecked starship. It could not speak, its memories were encoded, and strange things would happen wherever it went.
The Good Tidings V was a starship owned by the Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt that replaced his old light freighter the Good Tidings.

Turlin/Benthic Extraction, also known simply as Turlin/Benthic or T/B, was a mining consortium in the galaxy. They were notably able to gain limited mining concessions on Legacy worlds such as Wadi Raffa.

Merj spaceport control was an organization based in Merj spaceport on the planet Merj. The Dressellian smuggler had a good rapport with agents of Merj spaceport control which convinced Lieutenant Commander Orson Krennic that Obitt could be as trusted as any smuggler.
Hiitians were a species of human-sized sentient avians. They had feathers growing from their backs.

The Central District was a sector of Galactic City on the planet Coruscant that contained the Central District spaceport, the Imperial Energy Division headquarters, the Institute of Applied Science, and the Llanter Plaza.

Reamma was a planet located in the Reamma system in the Corbett sector of the Mid Rim Territories. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, the Alliance to Restore the Republic set up a temporary base, LX-Robynsun V, on Reamma.

R4-W9 was an R4 astromech droid with an exceptional map of hyperlanes and asteroid belts of the region of the planet Formos in the Outer Rim Territories. The Aqualish smuggler Bandin Dobah wanted this map and stole the droid and entrusted him to Daro Blunt.
Aria Prime was a planet in the Aria Prime system of the Inner Rim Territories that was where Lyra Erso was born around 48 BBY. Lyra's mother lived and worked on Aria Prime as an artist.
The Senate Hearing Chamber was a large governmental hearing chamber located within the Galactic Senate Building on the galactic capital world of Coruscant.
Senate Tier 125 was one of the many levels that constituted the main Senate Chamber of the Galactic Senate Building on the galactic capital world of Coruscant.
A museum was a located next to the Peace and Security station in Coronet City on the planet Corellia. The museum shared a basement with the P&S building and used it to store a bunch of artifacts.
Vader's Special Force Troopers, also known simply as Special Force Troopers, were troopers of the Galactic Empire that were visually identical to snowtroopers.
Salient I was a planet located in the Salient system of the Aparo sector in the Outer Rim Territories, along the Hydian Way.

Salient II was a planet located in the autonomous Salient system, on the edge the Corporate Sector. In 18 BBY, the planet, along with the rest of the system, resisted what they perceived as intrusion by the Galactic Empire in a hard-fought, prolonged campaign.

J9-B8 was a protocol droid variant freed by his mistress. He traveled through the Outer Rim Territories with his friend R4-W9. At some point after the Battle of Yavin, Bandin Dobah and his gang attacked the two friends to steal R4-W9 and left J9-B8 dismantled.
Skorii-Lei was an aquatic planet within the galaxy that Princess Leia Organa traveled to sometime after the Battle of Yavin.

A Stormdriver owned by Zodoh the Hutt was destroyed during an attack on the planet Aquilaris Minor. In 1032 BBY, Zodoh launched an invasion of an area of space known as the Daimanate while its ruler, the Sith Lord Daiman, was away.

Darth Vader's Security Force were elite troopers of the Galactic Empire that were visually identical to snowtroopers and the Vader's Special Force Trooper, only having red-colored armor instead of the usual white armor.

In 3 BBY, a remote planetoid was the site of a scrap pile operated by two Xot named Bidvel and Davil. As indicated by the presence of a dome shield over the scrap pile, the planetoid lacked an atmosphere.
Gruthic Winged Beasts were large non-sentient creatures having a pair of wings, two heads perched atop long flexible necks, a long tail, scaly gray-green skin and four limbs ending in sharp claws.

The Llanter Plaza was a plaza located in the Central District on Coruscant. During the Clone Wars, Lyra Erso ducked into a corridor that ended at the southeast of Llanter Plaza whilst working out to find some breathing space.
Wynkahthu was a gas giant in the Mid Rim Territories with turbulent atmospheric storms located near Ord Mantell.
The Lokori were a stalklike insectoid species with green blood native to the planet Lokori.
A sentient species of avians were native to the planet Malpaz. During the Clone Wars the species began integrating with colonists from all over the sector.
The Xidelphiads were a sentient species in the galaxy. Individuals within the species would change sex at several points in their life, and would do so by encasing themselves in a chrysalis.

Lokori was the home planet to the species of the same name. It was near Ryloth and had a pleasant atmosphere. The planet had a rainy season. The capital city was Fucallpa, which was home to Helical HyperCom, a producer of personal comm devices.
Malpaz was a planet that during the Clone Wars suffered invasions from both the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. It was home to an avian species.

Fucallpa was the capital city of the planet Lokori. According to Lyra Erso, it looked like an "enormous flower bed" due to the riotous colors and shapes of the city's basketlike buildings and spiked domes.

Kartoosh was an astronomical object in the Western Reaches and Narrant sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was located along the Cerean Reach hyperspace route. The massive construction and overhaul facility was a shipyard stationed over Kartoosh that saw design work in 23 BBY.

Epiphany was the outermost of three planets that orbited a red dwarf star in the Salient system, in the Aparo sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Its moon was the location of the headquarters of Zerpen Industries.
RB-551 was an older model B1-series battle droid who served within the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

The rocket stormtroopers, also known as rocket launcher stormtroopers or Demolition Troopers were specialized stormtroopers equipped with large, shoulder-fired missile launchers that allowed them to damage vehicles and buildings from a great distance.

The Last Chance was a Sentinel-class shuttle that belonged to the Weequay pirate Hondo Ohnaka, after he stole it from Reklam Station, a secret Imperial reclamation plant located on the planet Yarma.
Kothal market was a marketplace in Kothal on the planet Lothal. The human farmer Morad Sumar sold fruit in the Kothal market.
In 5 ABY as the Imperial Era ended, members of the Acolytes of the Beyond staged a revolution in Coronet City on the planet Corellia.

Sap drinkers were non-sentient insects that could be found on the planet of Devaron. They had a teardrop-shaped, iridescent blue body that featured two pairs of crystal-like wings and a barbed stinger, which they used as a defense against creatures that might attack their nests.
In 11 BBY, the Galactic Empire formally annexed the Outer Rim planet Jelucan in the early years of the Imperial Era.

Skorii-Lei Fish Market was a market located in a city, on the planet Skorii-Lei. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, Pash Davane went to Skorii-Lei Fish Market to get medicine for Princess Leia Organa who she had saved from drowning.
Bruce was a RIC-series general labor droid that was owned by the human female Pash Davane.

The B'ankor Refuge, or B'ankora Refuge, was a small sanctuary on Coruscant given by Supreme Chancellor Chasen Piian of the Galactic Republic in perpetuity to surviving members of the B'ankora species during the waning years of the Republic.
During the Galactic Civil War a battle was fought on the planet Skorii-Lei between the Galactic Empire and Alliance to Restore the Republic that wrecked the whole of Skorii-Lei's primary industry.
Fulan Ro was a town located on the Cosmatanic Steppes, in the Outer Rim region of the galaxy.

Wobani was a temperate planet partially hidden by a swirling dust cloud, located in the Wobani system, in the Bryx sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim. During the Imperial Era, the planet was used by the Galactic Empire as a site for labor and prison camps.

Gate officers were Imperial Navy Troopers stationed onboard Golan M3185 space stations in charge of operating its Shield Gate.

Corellian Academy of Sciences was a Corellian institution. Its members notably studied the rathtars for years, but they only managed to discover very little about them, because of the difficulty to investigate the species closely without being attacked or eaten.

Taleucema was the capital city of the Outer Rim planet Saleucami. Established by Pantoran colonists when the planet was first settled, Taleucema was the planet's primary trading hub and home to the world's primary spaceport.

Blackwind Crater was a large, isolated crater over 250 kilometers northeast of Taleucema. Because of its subterranean hot springs, the crater's interior was a sweltering combination of jungle and marshland.
Thaelos were a race of primates native to the many forested craters of Saleucami.
Nuunos were a race of crustaceans native to the wastes of Saleucami. As the world's apex predator, a nuuno was considered extremely dangerous by the Saleucamians.
Galvas were a species of mammals native to the equatorial deserts of Saleucami.

Thrawn's Offices were the personal offices of Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn. His main office was located aboard his personal Star Destroyer Chimaera. He also had another office in the Imperial Armory Complex.
A planet located in Wild Space was home to the trading and supply base Havoc Outpost. A terrestrial world situated in Standard Galactic Grid square S-19, it appeared bluish from space.

affiliation: Commission for the Protection of the Republic
x: The SAGroup was a sub-branch and youth program of the Commission for the Protection of the Republic (COMPOR). Venthan Chassu, a member of SAGroup and supporter of Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine, created the propaganda poster Do Not Bind His Hands.
Spamels were blue- or purple-skinned, long-legged riding creatures native to the desert moon of Jedha. The beasts featured a thick neck that carried their wedge-shaped head.
Sometime after the Battle of Endor, a battle was fought over the planet Kuat. During the battle, the New Republic captured an Imperial dreadnought whilst it underwent repairs.

During the Galactic Civil War, Imperial forces ambushed soldiers of the New Republic at Govneh Ridge on the planet Nag Ubdur. Despite losing a number of men and women, the New Republic was able to capture Govneh Ridge.

During the Galactic Civil War, the population of the merchant city Binjai-Tin were massacred by the Galactic Empire. During the Battle of Nag Ubdur, the massacre was discovered by members of the New Republic Thirty-First including Private Rorith Khadur.

Malgan Market was a market located in the city of Iziz on the Inner Rim jungle planet Onderon. As a central hub in the city, merchants and traders sold goods, including many types of fruit, in the market.

Sector S-11 was an area on the planet Onderon that was suspected by the occupying Confederacy of Independent Systems to contain a secret base maintained by the Onderon rebels. However, the Onderon Rebels' true base was located in Sector S-29 at the time.
Sector S-29 was an area on the planet Onderon that was home to the Onderon rebels' secret base around 20 BBY. It was also the site of a small battle in the Onderonian Civil War as well.
Pretor Flats was a location on the far side of the planet Lothal from Capital City's Academy for Young Imperials that was home to Pretor Flats Academy, a less prestigious Imperial Academy.

The Archaeological Association was an organized association of archaeologists.

The capital city of the planet Malpaz was destroyed by the Galactic Empire during the early stages of its reign. The city was built below a hill and featured a power grid as well as a primitive nuclear power plant.
The Hweg Shul municipal police was the local law enforcement agency of Hweg Shul, capital city of the planet Nam Chorios.

JR-12 was a fourth degree security droid programmed with a masculine personality. Bipedal and humanoid in structure, JR-12 operated as an independent security contractor on the Mid Rim world Ord Mantell during the Galactic Civil War.

Obus VI was an aquatic planetoid that was located in the Wild Space region of the galaxy that was uncharted before the Eternal Empire conquest. It was picked by the Shroud as the location of his new multi-part base of operations - the Coil - for its proximity to Zakuul.
The Ternion Building was a building located on the moon Nar Shaddaa. Following the Eternal Empire of Zakuul's conquest, it became home to the Nar Shaddaa shield bunker.
The Rusty Reach was a scrap reclamation plant located to the north of Worlport, deep within the Scraplands on the planet Ord Mantell.

Redlake was a farming village located to the north of Worlport, on the border of the Scraplands on the planet Ord Mantell. Aimee Kraeff was born and raised in this village, twenty years before the Galactic Civil War.
Aegis was an Alderaanian gunship commanded by Caline Metara during the Galactic Civil War.

Fifth Wheel was a small settlement located to the north of Worlport within the Scraplands on the planet Ord Mantell. Twenty-five kilometers from the capital city, the village was known as the Jewel of the Scraplands, and was populated by scrap dealers and scavengers.

Yalawua was a squat located to the north of Worlport within the borders of the Scraplands on the planet Ord Mantell. Hivelike, the squat was inhabited by a colony of Jawas rumored to have fled Tatooine after the loss of their village to Tusken Raiders.
The Coral Coast of Ord Mantell was the shorelines that spread out southeast of the capital city of Worlport.
The Breakwater was a maritime district located on the southern edge of Worlport, the capital city of Ord Mantell.
The Government Cirlce was the government district within the walls of Worlport, the capital city of Ord Mantell.

Herglic's Folly was a gambling district located within Worlport, the capital city of Ord Mantell. The most dangerous of Worlport's three gambling districts, Herglic's Folly was named for the Herglic species.
The Industrial District of Worlport was located along the capital city's northern border, separating the city from the expansive Scraplands beyond.
The Invasion of Voss, also known as the Defense of Voss and the liberation of Voss, was a major battle during the war against Zakuul of Zakuul.
A gas giant was located in the Cosmatanic Steppes system within the Grohl sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. It was situated in grid square R-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

A village was located on the planet Dantooine, near the Jedi Enclave. During the Great Jedi Purge, a group of people on Dantooine harbored the fugitive Jedi Falon Grey there. The village was eventually destroyed by the Galactic Empire.

DLC-13 was a DLC-13 mining droid who worked at an ore mine in the Belgaroth asteroid field following the Battle of Hoth. DLC-13 was carrying out his duties in the processing plant when Rowan Freemaker, who was in trance-like state, was carried in the droid's pot.
Merchant's Bridge was one of the biggest thoroughfares in Thune City, the capital of the planet Thune. A large bridge spanning a canal, it was covered with market stalls and merchants.

Aphra's crew was the grouping of various bounty hunters, assassins, and other allies who worked with the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra at any given time.
Mikkia was a planet with a variety of climates located in the galaxy's Expansion Region, and home to the Mikkian species. Mikkia was a member of the Galactic Republic for thousands of years.
K-OHN (or KONE) was a manumitted L-1 tactical droid that provided people with his programmed skills in exchange for energy and credits.

The destruction of Jedha City, also referred to as the destruction of the holy city, or as the massacre at Jedha, occurred during the reign of the Galactic Empire when the Empire, in an effort to test the superlaser of the Death Star, used the battle station to destroy the hol…
In 13 BBY, renowned scientist Dr. Galen Erso was captured by Orson Krennic, Director of the Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research agency, and his personal squad of death troopers.
The Profundity was an MC75 Star Cruiser commanded by Admiral Raddus that served in the Alliance Fleet. It was notably present during the Battle of Scarif.
The Ark Angel II, formerly known as the Ark Angel, was a modified Bellicose-class heavy lifter owned by the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra.

Abersyn symbiotes were a species which fed on the brain stem of sentient species. They had to be fed into a plasma furnace in order to keep them in a quiescent state, though a regular exposure to a plasma vent was proven to have the same effect on them.
SW-0608 was a Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle stolen from the Galactic Empire by the Alliance to Restore the Republic and used by the squad Rogue One during the Battle of Scarif.

Kyber mines were located on the moon Jedha. Rogue Rebel leader Saw Gerrera led several attacks on Jedha's mines and cargo shipments. After that, the Imperial Star Destroyer Dauntless was moved over Jedha City to provide security and serve as a deterrent to further attacks.
Fest was a cold, mountainous planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Atrivis sector. It was the forged homeworld of the adopted boy Kassa, later renamed Cassian Jeron Andor.

Anomids were a sentient species that were native to Yablari. Because they lacked vocal cords, they communicated with one another through a sophisticated and subtle combination of hand and body language.
The Britarro were a mysterious sentient humanoid species that were native to Britaxis Minor. Nik Hepho was a Britarro who worked as a bounty hunter.

leader: Secretary of the Cabinet Bail Organa
x: The Alliance Civil Government was the governmental command council of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, existing alongside the Alliance Military. It was led by Mon Mothma, the Chancellor of the Rebel Alliance.

Milvayne was a planet in the Inner Rim Territories controlled by the Milvayne Authority, a harsh, justice-oriented law enforcement agency. After the establishment of the Galactic Empire, Milvayne fell under its protection, under the terms it kept an invisible presence.

The Milvayne Authority, also known as the Milvayne Judiciary, was a law enforcement agency that operated on Milvayne. Its most celebrated officer was Tam Posla. Posla's final case with them involved reports of kidnapping, forced servitude and surgical alteration.
Queen of the Core Network was a HoloNet news network active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Two of its employees were the human journalist Tracene Kane and the Trandoshan cameraman Lug.
In 4 ABY, in the months following the Battle of Endor, a Battle on Sevarcos occurred in a spice mine on the planet Sevarcos. The New Republic fought with Imperial forces at the mine.
The Decraniated were an order of servants produced by a fugitive surgeon Cornelius Evazan, initially for Dryden Vos. Several Decraniated served aboard Vos's yacht First Light.

leader: Secretary of the Cabinet Bail Organa
x: The Alliance Cabinet, also referred to as the Cabinet, and sometimes informally called the Political High Command, was a branch of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Civil Government.
NaJedha was an oceanic crystalline planet in the galaxy's Mid Rim, orbited by the moon Jedha. The Rebel Alliance were briefly stationed on NaJedha during a mission to contact the Partisans.
Talpini were a sentient species native to Tal Pi. Weeteef Cyu-Bee, a member of the Partisans, was a member of this species.
Pipada was a humid planet in the Pipada system of the Videnda sector, located in the Outer Rim Territories and the Western Reaches. It was home to the amphibious Drabatan species.
Iakar, also known as Iakaru, was a jungle planet and the homeworld of the Iakaru species. It was located in the Iakar system in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Pendarr III was a planet located in the Pendarr system within the Alchenaut sector of the Expansion Region and Trailing Sectors. It was situated in grid square L-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The RA-7 protocol droid 4D6-J-A7 served the Galactic Empire's Imperial Intelligence and Imperial Security Bureau as an administrative assistant during the Age of the Empire.
The Docklands was the maritime district of the capital city of Vossport on the planet Weik.

The Bowl of Glass was an active volcano on the planet Weik. The caldera situated amid the canyons of the Frostfall, the Bowl was harvested for its geothermal power using ancient techniques passed down from the first settlers of the planet.
The Frostfall was a series of canyons and ridges on the planet Weik. The Frostfall was situated between the cities of Vossport and Fume.

The Madlands were a rugged, desert region near the equatorial areas of the planet Weik. A maze of gorges, buttes, canyons, and ridges, the Madlands was not occupied by any signs of civilization as the conditions were too dangerous to sustain permanent residents.

The Highland Lakes was a prosperous region located along the equator of the planet Weik. Connected to the populated regions of Vossport and Fume by a long road that ran through the Madlands, Highland Lakes was geographically close to the Sunrace Citadel.

The Ordan Spine Mountains were a fertile region of the planet Weik beyond the city of Vossport. Between the towering mountains were valleys home to thriving farming villages and hermitages for religious orders, like the Paladins of the Adamite Tower, located in the fortified r…
The Karnik Valley was located in the Ordan Spine Mountains of the planet Weik. A starship crashed at the mouth of the valley and was buried deep within the fertile earth.

The Crysifal Peak was one of the tallest mountains which formed one end of the Ordan Spine Mountains on the planet Weik. Its peak was often shrouded in snow and clouds, and no one had ever survived an attempt to scale its slopes.
Trollbane were a predatory species native to the planet Weik in Wild Space.
The Ring of Kafrene, also referred to simply as Kafrene, was a mining colony and deep-space trading post in the Kafrene asteroid belt of the Thand sector.

Lexrul was a heavily industrialized planet in the Lexrul system in the Trax sector of the Mid Rim Territories. Orson Callan Krennic was born in Sativran City on the planet around 52 BBY.
Jour-un was a major port city and trading hub on the planet Bardotta.
Nan-gau was a major city located on the planet Bardotta.
Shun-go was a city on the planet Bardotta.
Feng-gau was a city on the planet Bardotta.
Wakizan beetles were a type of edible beetles that were considered a delicacy in the Core Worlds. One way to prepare them was to fry them in troogan oil.
Pad Ten was the tenth landing pad at the Citadel Tower on Scarif.
Pad Eight was the eighth landing pad at the Citadel Tower on Scarif.
Pad Twelve was the twelfth landing pad at the Imperial Center of Military Research on Scarif. It was one of the landing pads attacked by the Rebel squad Rogue One during the Battle of Scarif.
Hriin River was a river on the planet Auratera. The lifeblood of the town of Hriin, the river was used to power the town's generators and power the homes located there.
Pad Fourteen was the fourteenth landing pad at the Imperial Center of Military Research on Scarif. It was one of the landing pads attacked by the Rebel squad Rogue One during the Battle of Scarif.

Pad Two was the second landing pad at the Imperial Center of Military Research on Scarif. During the Battle of Scarif, Bodhi Rook created confusion by falsely reporting to the Citadel Tower that he spotted forty Rebels heading west on Pad Two.

Pad Five was the fifth landing pad at the Imperial Center of Military Research on Scarif. During the Battle of Scarif, Bodhi Rook ordered Corporal Stordan Tonc to create confusion by falsely reporting to the Citadel Tower that Pad Five had been overtaken by Rebels.

The Dauntless was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that was in service of the Galactic Empire. The Star Destroyer was stationed above Jedha City in 1 BBY after Imperial Intelligence claimed a single destroyer would shut down any resistance to the Empire's kyber crystal minin…
The day after the Battle of Yavin, Alecia Beck of the Imperial Security Bureau led an ambush on Taanab against the Shrikes, operatives of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Reenee were beasts of burden genetically modified for use in the low gravity environments of Auratera.
Skysnare were large avians native to the planet Auratera.
The Central Isopter was a death-worshipping cult whose members frequented areas of violence, meditating on matters of mortality.
A species of cybernetic spiders that fed on power sources was created by the Imperial scientist Cylo in the early months of Emperor Palpatine's reign.
Landing Platform Nine, also known as landing pad nine or platform 9, was the ninth landing pad at the Imperial Center of Military Research on Scarif.
The Lightmaker, also known by its callsign "Corvette Five," was a Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's fleet.
The Military Police was the law enforcement branch of the Galactic Republic's military during the Clone Wars.
Wetyin was a continent located on Yavin 4, a jungle moon of the gas giant Yavin. It notably housed the Massassi Site, home of the Great Temple.
Starloft was a continent located on Yavin 4, a jungle moon of the gas giant Yavin.
The Massassi Site was a region of Yavin 4, a jungle moon of the gas giant Yavin, that housed a number of ancient monuments built by the vanished Massassi people, including the enormous Great Temple.

Nystullum was an underwater city located beneath the northern ice floes of the planet Mon Cala. Prior to the Galactic Civil War, the starship Profundity was the city's civic governance tower.

Lorrdians were a sentient bipedal species that gave off a distinctive natural scent and had a very expressive body language. Lorrdian members of the Brotherhood of the Beatific Countenance wore concealing robes that acted as a physical vow of silence.
The Vobati were a little-known sentient species that were native to Vobes. Valwid Ined was a member of this species.
Eadu Flight Station was a shuttle depot located at the Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory on the planet Eadu during the Age of the Empire.
The Kafrene asteroid belt was an asteroid belt located in the Thand sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region that contained the Ring of Kafrene.
Sativran City was a city located on the planet Lexrul. Director Orson Krennic was born in Sativran City around 52 BBY.

The Commenor Underground was a rebel cell that fought against the Galactic Empire during its reign. Around 10 BBY, it briefly worked with Saw Gerrera's extremist Partisans. Arhul Nemo was a member of this group.

The Path of Judgments was a location in Jedha City, a large, walled city on the cold, desert moon of Jedha. The Path of Judgments and the rest of NiJedha were destroyed by a single-reactor superlaser blast from the newly-operational Death Star.

The Dome of Deliverance was a location in Jedha City, a large, walled city on the cold, desert moon of Jedha. Before the Galactic Empire had arrived on Jedha, some of the orphans were brought to live there, or at the Temple of the Kyber or Waiting of Night.
SW-1721 was a Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle used by the Galactic Empire to transport turbolaser barrel sleeves to the Imperial security complex on Scarif.
SW-4415 was a Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle used by the Galactic Empire to transport deflector shield matrix circuitry to the Imperial security complex on Scarif.

Patriim was a world in the galaxy. Despite being considered strategically insignificant, shortly before the Battle of Scarif it was the location of a major tactical deployment of Imperial forces, subject to frequent communications blackouts and the source of several encrypted …
During the Clone Wars, an insurrectionist cell, backed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, operated in the wilds of the Outer Rim Territories fighting against the Galactic Republic.

Essie was Jyn Erso's name for an SE-2 worker droid who worked on the farm of Galen Erso, keeping an eye on the horizon for any intruders. Despite being a menial labor droid, Essie had a very pronounced loyalty subroutine.
R3-S1, nicknamed "Threece," was an R3-series astromech droid with feminine programming that served as part of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Agricultural Corps, also known as the AgriCorps, was one of the four branches of the Service Corps of the Jedi Order.

Tonekh was a city located on the planet Kupoh. The city was populated by the Kupohan, a sentient species native to the planet. It was built inside of a mountain valley, which protected it from Kupoh's harsh winds.

Isde Naha was an Outer Rim Territories world situated in the Yarith sector and at the intersection of the Corellian Trade Spine and Lipsec Run hyperspace routes.

Jenoport was a location in the Jenoport system of the Colonies. Sometime before the mission to Eadu, K-2SO found Cassian Andor on Jenoport staring at his blaster with tears on his face after committing an act that even General Davits Draven was not aware of.

Chemvau was a location in the galaxy. After escaping a prison in the Catacombs of Cadera on Jedha, Cassian Andor considered leaving Jyn Erso behind like he had left men behind on Chemvau and Eiloroseint.
Eiloroseint was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Eiloroseint system in the Tokamac sector of the Expansion Region.
The Imperial Ball was a lavish, formal party that was held in the Imperial Palace on Coruscant every year on Empire Day.
