Mount Octan was a volcanic mountain on the jungle-moon of Nallastia that housed the fortress of the ruling Skull Queen, Quenelle (who, as the contemporary Margravine, also served as the Fondorian satellite's political ruler).

The wild grillik was a large reptilian creature native to the jungle-moon of Nallastia. Covered in scales, the reptile had six muscular legs and a long, lean body. Its jaws encased three rows of very sharp teeth.
A killspike was a native bird of the jungle-moon Nallastia.

Trohlu, also known as Alethea, was the only moon orbiting Aleen, a planet in the Bright Jewel sector of the Mid Rim. A yellow, rocky satellite, Trohlu lacked an atmosphere, though it did host an observation post and a listening station established by the Galactic Empire.

The Sabat were a sentient species in the galaxy. The Sabat had blue, pink, or tan colored skin, large foreheads and flattened heads. Leevan Tenza, a member of Saw Gerrera's Partisans, was a Sabat. Gelan Yees was a Sabat member of the Cloud-Riders.

A DH-Omni Support Vessel was in service of the Confederacy of Independent Systems' navy during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic. The supply ship crashed on the planet Agamar in the Outer Rim Territories during a battle between Republic and Separatist forces.
Tythoni Square was a municipal area in the Holy Quarter of Jedha's Holy City that shared its name with the Deep Core planet Tython.

Heavy Shoretroopers were coastal defender stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire who had undergone specialized training in the use of heavy ordnance. They were equipped with large reciprocating quad blaster cannons, DLT-19 heavy blaster rifles, and Z-6 rotary blaster cannons.
Montellian Serat was the capital city of the planet Devaron.

Plaeree was an ancient city on the planet Devaron. The Point of Parting that stood at the gates of the city's spaceport was claimed to be the original plaza that inspired other cities to establish a point of parting at every starport on the planet.

The Wanderer's Path was a road that ran through the thick vine jungles of the planet Devaron. Adolescents would accompany experienced Wanderers on expeditions out into the dense jungles as part of a formal rite of passage established during the planet's history.

Project War-Mantle, also known as simply War-Mantle, War Mantle, the stormtrooper program, and the Stormtrooper initiative, was an initiative of the Galactic Empire enacted soon after its founding that sought to fill out the ranks of the burgeoning Imperial Army with conscript…

Stellar Sphere was one of several Imperial projects developed in secret by the Tarkin Initiative. The technical schematics for Stellar Sphere were kept at the Citadel Tower on Scarif, along with those of Project War-Mantle and the Death Star.

Bamayar IX was a gas giant formed of emerald- and turquoise-colored gas clouds. Between 7 BBY and around 5 BBY, the trainee pilot Bodhi Rook skillfully flew a Nu-class transport through the clouds of Bamayar IX with a number of his classmates in the Galactic Empire's Terrabe S…

The Republic Seal Mountain was a mountain on the moon Iktotch. When the citizens of the moon predicted the arrival of the scouts sent out by the Galactic Republic, the Iktotchi realized that cementing their position in the galactic community would benefit their own position in…
Ankhela was a city on the Iktotchi homeworld Iktotch, the third moon of Iktotchon.
Lonalaka was a city on the Iktotchi homeworld Iktotch, the third moon of Iktotchon.

The Apostate was a starship owned by the bounty hunter Nik Hepho. While Hepho was searching for adherents of the Church of the Force in Jedha City on the moon Jedha in the year 1 BBY, the ship hovered in orbit above, operated by a droid intelligence that waited for the hunter …

ZX-199 was an elite Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. In 3631 BBY, it was destroyed by Lana Beniko and The Commander inside the skytrooper droid factory on Zakuul.
ZT-001D was an elite Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, it was protecting the GEMINI Prime in the factory on Darvannis.

AB-6H Guardian Droid was a battle droid used by the Shroud to guard the asteroid level of The Coil, his base on Obus VI. In 3630 BBY, the droid detected and engaged intruders, though it was destroyed by HK-55 and Z0-0M.
Advanced Combat Unit AZ-03 was a designation of several battle droids used by Arlaia Zayzen, a gladiator in the Arena Grand of Zakuul.
Annihilator T4-1D was a battle droid available during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Arena Grand was the main gladiatorial arena of Zakuul. Located in the Old World, it featured fights between Zakuulans, off-worlders, creatures and droids that were broadcast as entertainment and source for betting across the Eternal Empire.

Battle Droid Atherna was an experimental assault battle droid constructed by the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, it was deployed to protect an outpost of the Knights of Zakuul under attack by Havoc Squad, but was destroyed by Aric Jorgan and The Commander

The Blast Crew was a crime syndicate based on Asylum and led by Tanno Vik. Vik and his rival Oggo of the Starbolts syndicate disagreed over the control of the Free Zone black market, settling their dispute with blasters.
The C2-N Dominator Droid was a battle droid used by the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War.

Cave jurgoran was a subspecies of Jurgoran evolved to live in near-dark environments such as caves. To adapt to the darkness, the species developed bioluminescent scales and a reflective hide, with each creature having a distinct glow pattern, nearly undetectable to most, but …

The DX-2 Dominator Droid was a battle droid used by the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY the droid, along with TZ-3 Dominator Droid and C2-N Dominator Droid was used to defend the approach to the Bastion in the Coronet City on Corellia, but was destroyed during…

EPHEMERIS droids was a series of multi-tasking droids used by the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. Combining the mathematical features of Class one droids, administrative functions of Class three droids and combat capabilities of Class four droids, EPHEMERIS droids were used to run t…

G5-M1 was a protocol droid of the Galactic Republic active during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY it was stationed aboard the Wanderer-class transport Esseles when it was attacked by the Harrower-class dreadnought Emperor's Glory.
The Gilded Star was a treasury ship used by the Eternal Empire of Zakuul to safekeep the valuables obtained in the years it spent pillaging the galaxy following the Eternal Empire's conquest.
KJ-931 was an experimental assault Skytrooper, a type of battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of Zakuul.
The Krayts was a criminal gang operating on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

L3-E7 Colossus was a battle droid model used by the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY four Colossus droids were used to defend the approach to the Bastion in the Coronet City on Corellia, but were destroyed during the assault by the Galactic Republic forces.

The narvaxx was a four-legged non-sentient species living in the galaxy. Several captured narvaxx were used by Doctor Sannus Lorrick in his experiments with the rakghoul plague in his base on Ord Mantell.
P-0A5 was a shopkeeper droid active during the Galactic War, stationed on the Vaiken Spacedock.
Shade stalkers were a predatory species living on the planet Odessen. Bipedal and covered in scales, they were extremely aggressive in nature, often hunting in packs.
Shaft 12 was a mining shaft on the Eastern Ice Shelf of Ilum, established by the miners of the Minos-Mestra Corporation around 3631 BBY.
Shaft 16 was a mining shaft on the Eastern Ice Shelf of Ilum, established by the miners of the Minos-Mestra Corporation around 3631 BBY.

ST-97 "Steel" was a battle droid model used by the Twin Suns of Tatooine during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY the droid was guarding a mine in the Jundland, which was taken over by the pirates, where it was destroyed by a Galactic Republic individual sent by Jundo Martik to reclai…

The Starbolts was a crime syndicate based on Asylum and led by Oggo. Oggo and his rival Tanno Vik of the Blast Crew syndicate disagreed over the control of the Free Zone black market, settling their dispute with blasters.

Swamp rancor was a sub-species of Rancor living in swamps. Their notable difference from common rancors were the two large horns on their head, as well as a darker shade of skin. They could be found in the Endless Swamp on Zakuul, the capital world of the Eternal Empire.

The Veil was a trio of male Human Cyborgs—Veil One, Veil Two and Veil Three—operating on Nar Shaddaa during the Galactic War. Around 3640 BBY the Veil took control over the production of the CN-12 sensor chip from the Cult of the Screaming Blade.

The TZ-3 Dominator Droid was a battle droid used by the Sith Empire during the Galactic War. In 3640 BBY the droid, along with DX-2 Dominator Droid and C2-N Dominator Droid was used to defend the approach to the Bastion in the Coronet City on Corellia, but was destroyed during…

Vandin was a planet with at least one floating tibanna gas platform that housed tibanna gas miners. The planet utilized at least some form of organized security force, consisting of a number of probe droids. The Brekken Gang maintained some presence on the planet.
Z1-V8 was a battle droid active during the war against Zakuul. In 3630 BBY it resided on Zakuul, the capital world of the Eternal Empire.
Z3-V6 was a battle droid active during the war against Zakuul. In 3630 BBY it resided on Zakuul, the capital world of the Eternal Empire.

headquarters: Mind healer's grove, Old Paths, Voss
x: Dream-walkers were a sub-sect of Voss Mystics outcasts, who practiced the ritual of Dream-walking. Not entirely embraced by the Voss society, they had an encampment in the caves beneath Voss-Ka called the Mind healer's grove.

X-TR0 was a battle droid with a feminine programming used by the Shroud to guard the museum on the volcano level of The Coil. In 3630 BBY X-TR0 detected intruders in the museum and attacked them, while politely asking them to leave.

Yelsain was an astronomical object in the galaxy that was covered in dense forests and was home to humans who dwelled in the wilds. Wion Dillems was a member of the Tree Dweller tribes native to the world.

Generis was an Outer Rim astronomical object part of the Atrivis sector. It served as a regional headquarters and operations sector for Senator Mon Mothma's organized rebellion against the Galactic Empire.

Fresia was a terrestrial planet in the Core Worlds' Torranix sector that was home to the Coromon Headhunter. During the Clone Wars, the world's Galactic Republic senator, Seti Ashgad, simply vanished.

Skinflayer was a non-sentient reptilian species. Skinflayers had two legs, large arms with four claws on each hand, a short tail, spikes on their heads and a mouth full of sharp teeth. Skinflayers could be found in jungle environments of Belsavis and Taral V.
Z9-V86 was a battle droid active during the war against Zakuul. In 3630 BBY it resided on Zakuul, the capital world of the Eternal Empire.

Broadberry Meadow was a secluded cliff and riverside garden located in the capital city Theed on the planet Naboo by the year 32 BBY. The garden contained a hexagonal building with beige walls and a domed green roof built amongst the grass and trees of the meadow.

The Ellié Arcadium was a circular building with tan-colored walls and a turquoise dome that matched the style of other buildings in Theed, the capital city of the human Naboo culture on the planet Naboo.
The Road to Glory was a road located on the Eastern Ice Shelf of the planet Ilum during the time of the Battle of Ilum in the Galactic War.
The Chillwater Crag was a canyon located in the northern part of the Eastern Ice Shelf of the planet Ilum during the time of the Battle of Ilum in the Galactic War.
The Watchpoint Hill was one of the Northern Snowdrift Hills located in the Clabburn Tundra of the planet Hoth during the time of the Galactic War.

The Caves of Elshuu was a series of caves located in The Tomb of the planet Belsavis. During the Galactic War, the caves housed the Mind prison of the Rakata named Elshuu, which was tended by his followers.

The Quake Shelter 14-K was a groundquake shelter located on the Frinn Mesa of Makeb. During the Conquest of Makeb it was taken over by the InterStellar Regulators and was used by Kazac to hold their captive Lemda Avesta.
The Clan Sharratt enclave was an enclave of Mandalorian Clan Sharratt located on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
ChemFlex Labs was a laboratory of ChemFlex located in the Republic Research Division of the Ternion Building, on Nar Shaddaa.
The Morgukai temple was located on Nar Shaddaa and used by the Nikto Morgukai cult. During the Cold War it was attacked by ba Republic team send by Tythan Phomm.

The Shadow Syndicate safe house was located on Nar Shaddaa, within Keeling's listening post, and used by the Shadow Syndicate. It served as Maro Vizhen's undercover facility, using the front of the listening post to keep themselves and the Empire's intentions hidden.
The Crysfang Glade was an uncorrupted area of the Nightmare Lands on Voss, named after crysfangs that inhabited it.
The Crossing Woods was a forested area located in the Pelath-Ri Marches on Voss.
The Dreamwalk Path was a road located in the Pelath-Ri Marches on Voss during the Galactic War.

Chamber of Cleansing was the name of a cave located in the Gormak Lands on Voss. It was used as a place to enter the Spirit World by the dream-walkers such as the Gormak Hadrik, one of the few non-Voss dream-walkers.
The Snowstone Turning was an area located in the Icefall Plains of Hoth during the Galactic War.

The Drift Hills Prison Camp was set up by the Galactic Republic in the Clabburn Tundra of Hoth. During the Galactic War the camp was taken over by Advozsec mercenaries, who imprisoned the Republic personnel along with their former prisoners.
The Broken Bow Canyon was a canyon in the Starship Graveyard of Hoth during the Galactic War.
The Snowcap Mountain was a mountain located in the Highmount Ridge of Hoth during the Galactic War.
Charnax Industries was an industrial facility located in the Upper Industrial Sector on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.

The Armageddon Battalion post was a military installation of the Sith Empire on Hoth during the Galactic War. Armageddon Battalion was quartered there until it was persuaded by the Emperor's Wrath to depart and join the Battle of Corellia.
The Forward alien camp was an alien-crewed outpost of the Galactic Republic on the Eastern Ice Shelf of Ilum during the Battle of Ilum in the Galactic War.
The Grim Path was a roadway located in the Starship Graveyard of Hoth during the Galactic War.
The Trader's Causeway was busy mercantile roadway located in the pirate town of Raider's Cove on Rishi during the Galactic War.
The Gorge Hollow River Pass was a canyon located in the Western Jungle Expanse of the Horizon Island on Rishi during the Galactic War.
The Skyline River Pass was a canyon located in the Western Jungle Expanse of the Horizon Island on Rishi during the Galactic War.
The South Ridge Beach was a beach located on the Sky Ridge Island of Rishi during the Galactic War.
The Sky Ridge Loch was a lake located on the Sky Ridge Island of Rishi.
The South Ridge Pass was an area located on Sky Ridge Island on Rishi.
The Sky Ridge Vale was a valley located on the Sky Ridge Island of Rishi during the Galactic War.
The Western Ridge Sea Cliffs was a series of cliffs located on the Sky Ridge Island of Rishi during the Galactic War.
Prowler's Trail was an area located on Yavin 4 near to the Imperial Guard Academy. During the Revanite crisis, the Sith Empire established an Imperial Forward Camp in the area.
Verdant Swamp was a swamp located on Yavin 4 near to the Imperial Guard Academy. During the Revanite crisis the Galactic Republic established an Republic Forward Camp in the area.
The Republic Forward Camp was a military outpost of the Galactic Republic established in the Verdant Swamp of Yavin 4 during the Revanite crisis.
The Imperial Forward Camp was a military outpost of the Sith Empire established in the Prowler's Trail of Yavin 4 during the Revanite crisis.
The Breaking was the name of a large tunnel on Yavin 4 that connected the Prowler's Trail, the Verdant Swamp and the Imperial Guard Academy grounds.

Altar of the Fallen was erected on Yavin 4 near the Imperial Guard Academy grounds. During the Revanite crisis, the Altar was taken over by the Order of Revan and was protected by the Lance Squadron command walker.
Massassi village was a settlement of the Massassi on Yavin 4 in the vicinity of the Temple of Sacrifice.
The Republic Alcove Camp was a military outpost of the Galactic Republic established in the vicinity of the Temple of Sacrifice of Yavin 4 during the Revanite crisis.
The Imperial Alcove Camp was a military outpost of the Sith Empire established in the vicinity of the Temple of Sacrifice of Yavin 4 during the Revanite crisis.
Tram Pump Station 726 was one of many pump stations that supported the hovertram system of the Old World, of the planet Zakuul.
Medical Unit AZ-01 was a medical droid used by Arlaia Zayzen, a gladiator in the Arena Grand of Zakuul.

Combat Unit AZ-02 was a battle droid used by Arlaia Zayzen, a gladiator in the Arena Grand of Zakuul. Along with other droids such as Medical Unit AZ-01, Advanced Combat Unit AZ-03, Assault Unit AZ-A and Assault Unit AZ-B, this droid was designated after Zayzen's own initials …

Doom Droid was an isotope-5 droid designed on Makeb. At some point during the Eternal Empire conquest the droid was obtained by the Eternal Empire and brought to Zakuul. The droid underwent modifications, which allowed it to be piloted by a Human mind instead of a droid brain.
Assault Unit AZ-B was a designation of several battle droids used by Arlaia Zayzen, a gladiator in the Arena Grand of Zakuul.
Assault Unit AZ-A was a designation of several astromech droids used by Arlaia Zayzen, a gladiator in the Arena Grand of Zakuul.
G0-ON Abductor was a battle droid model used by Nocturno and Drake Raven, a pair of gladiators in the Arena Grand of Zakuul. Along with G0-ON Attackers, these droids assisted them during the fights.
G0-ON Attacker was a battle droid model used by Nocturno and Drake Raven, a pair of gladiators in the Arena Grand of Zakuul. Along with G0-ON Abductors, these droids assisted them during the fights.

Platform 6 was a platform in the Old World of Zakuul that was the location of the Platform 6 cantina. In 3631 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Senya Tirall and the Alliance Commander visited the cantina during their search for the Lady of Sorrows.

Twin Rail District was a district in the Old World of Zakuul. In 3631 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Senya Tirall and the Alliance Commander passed the district during their search for the Lady of Sorrows.
Midtown District was a district in the Breaktown on Zakuul. In 3631 BBY Senya Tirall and The Commander passed the district during their search for the Lady of Sorrows.

Midtown Lane was a street in Breaktown on Zakuul. In 3631 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Senya Tirall and the Outlander passed the lane during their search for the Lady of Sorrows, fighting many Heralds of Zildrog to reach the Razor.

Songsteel Heights was an area in Breaktown on Zakuul. In 3631 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Senya Tirall and The Commander passed the Heights during their search for the Lady of Sorrows, fighting many Heralds of Zildrog to reach the Razor.

Undercity Junction 353 was a power junction located in the Undercity of Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Kaliyo Djannis and the Alliance Commander wired an ion grenade into the Junction and later detonated it to disable the Overwatch security.

Undercity Junction 754 was a power junction located in the Undercity of Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Kaliyo Djannis and the Alliance Commander wired an ion grenade into the Junction and later detonated it to disable the Overwatch security.

Power Junction K-H82 was a power junction located in the Breaktown of Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Kaliyo Djannis and the Alliance Commander wired an ion grenade into the Power Junction and later detonated it to disable the Overwatch security.

Security Hub 771 was a security station located at the Power Junction 353 of Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Kaliyo Djannis and the Alliance Commander wired an Ion grenade into the Junction and disabled the Security Hub in preparation for their assault on t…

Security Hub 62-B was a security station located at the abandoned tram station in the Old World on Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Kaliyo Djannis and the Alliance Commander disabled the Security Hub in preparation for their assault on the Overwatch.

Security Hub 1Y-33 was a security station located at the Old World on Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Kaliyo Djannis and the Alliance Commander disabled the Security Hub in preparation for their assault on the Overwatch.

Security Hub S-52U was a security station located at the Residential sector of the Old World on Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Kaliyo Djannis and the Alliance Commander disabled the Security Hub in preparation for their assault on the Overwatch.

Security Hub 4-18 was a security station located at the Power Junction 754 on Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Kaliyo Djannis and the Alliance Commander disabled the Security Hub in preparation for their assault on the Overwatch.

Security Hub 3-31 was a security station located at the Power Junction 754 on Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Kaliyo Djannis and the Alliance Commander disabled the Security Hub in preparation for their assault on the Overwatch.

Security Hub M-02U was a security station located at the Market Station in the Old World of the planet Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Kaliyo Djannis and the Alliance Commander disabled the Security Hub in preparation for their assault on the Overwatch.

Security Hub 002-C was a security station located in Breaktown on Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Kaliyo Djannis and the Alliance Commander disabled the Security Hub in preparation for their assault on the Overwatch.

Security Hub 038-A was a security station located in Breaktown on Zakuul. In 3630 BBY, during the War against Zakuul, Kaliyo Djannis and the Alliance Commander disabled the Security Hub in preparation for their assault on the Overwatch.
The Caves of Eleuabad were a network of water-filled underwaterways within the porous structure of the planet Naboo.

Asterios was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Asterios system in the Narrant sector of the Mid Rim Territories where the Alliance to Restore the Republic had a base prior to moving to a new one on the Outer Rim world Reamma.
D2-0A was a protocol droid active during the Galactic War. In 3637 BBY, it was used by the Minister of Intelligence to send a covert message to Cipher Nine on Rishi.

The Kanawyn Syndicate was a weapons and spice-dealing crime syndicate based on Rishi and led by Avax, and her brothers Chrone and Dastid. Though only a few dozen members strong, the Kanawyn had serious credentials - when an Exchange boss refused to join them, he got skinned.

GS-908 was a battle droid manufactured by Galactic Solutions Industries. In 3637 BBY it was escorting the GSI survey team working on mapping the Emperor's Eye on Ziost. When the Invasion of Ziost happened and Vitiate wiped all life on the planet, the droid malfunctioned.
The Razor was a location in Breaktown on Zakuul. During the Eternal Empire conquest it became a headquarters of the information broker known as The Lady of Sorrows.
The Bala D'ur Slaver Camps was the hideout of Bala D'ur pirates on Hoth during the Galactic War. It doubled as a slaver camp, in which they kept their Ortolan prisoners, working them to death.

The Brekken Gang was a criminal gang of Nikto led by Captain Kenrik Fost. In 3630 BBY they received an order from Gault Rennow for obtaining a functional missile, with the trade-off scheduled at Vandin.

Archaeo-Prime was a structure located on the Cosmatanic Steppes, a mantle of land suspended over a gas giant in the Outer Rim Territories. Archaeo-Prime was maintained by the Archaeological Association.

The Central District was a district in New Adasta, the capital city of Ziost. In 3636 BBY the former Sith Emperor Vitiate came to the world and possessed many of the Imperials on the planet, turning them into his puppets to murder civilians and the Central District become a po…
District 1327, best known as Breaktown, was a district on the planet Zakuul ruled by corruption and torment of weak by the strong.

Drooga's pleasure barge was the luxurious sail barge of Drooga the Hutt, who used it to throw enormous parties of feasts on the moon Nar Shaddaa. It was said a person's ability to amuse Drooga was the only barrier to entry onto his pleasure barge.
The Eternal Fleet reprisal bombardments were a series of bombardments carries out by the Eternal Fleet against five inhabited worlds in 3630 BBY.
The Flamechasers was the name given to themselves by the fans of Firebrand.
The Free Zone was a black market located on the Shadowport of Asylum. In 3631 BBY it was fought over by two rival syndicates, the Blast Crew led by Tanno Vik and the Starbolts led by Oggo.

result: Darvannis occupied by the Eternal Empire
x: The Invasion of Darvannis occurred in the early stage of the Eternal Empire conquest of the known galaxy. Of little interest to both Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, Darvannis was only defended by mercenary forces hired by the Hutt Cartel.

JT-03 was one of many droids owned by Jordel Tlan, who kept him company during his retirement on Nar Shaddaa and were the only beings he could trust. Tlan's worker Netula Pahn was in charge of maintaining the droids and mentioned that JT-03's blasters were malfunctioning.

x: During the Eternal Empire's conquest of the galaxy, the Galactic Republic's navy attempted to defend the Republic planet of Alderaan from the Eternal Fleet. However, the Republic had planned for a standard naval assault and was unprepared for the ferocity of the Eternal Fleet.
Minimech CM-12 was a droid model manufactured and available for purchase in the galaxy at some point before and during the Galactic War.

The planet Denon was occupied during the Eternal Empire's conquest of the known galaxy. After the Eternal Empire defeated the Galactic Republic forces in orbit, non-Skytrooper Human personnel were sent down to the surface.
The Press Corps of the Galactic Republic was responsible for the propaganda efforts during the period of the Galactic War.

Around 3640 BBY a guild on Sarkhai asked the Sarkhai representative in the Galactic Senate Nadia Grell for permission from the Galactic Republic to demolish the Annex of Kespan, the oldest ruin on the planet, and build a new spaceport on its site.
Station Guardian One was a battle droid developed by Kuat Drive Yards during the Galactic War. During the Battle of Kuat in 3637 BBY it was destroyed aboard the Kuat Defensive Station.
The Long-Range Sensor Field was a field located in the Whiterock Wastes on Hoth during the Galactic War.

The Augmentation shop was a black market establishment operating on Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War. It was located within the Coronet Boulevard on the moon, and guarded by a few thugs from the Krayts who had purchased goods from there.

The Ugnaught Clan Warehouse was a warehouse located in the Duros Sector of the moon Nar Shaddaa. In 3643 BBY, three Ugnaught bounty hunters, Gornik, Slatblath, and Ugmir, participants of the Great Hunt attempted to repair their battle droid in the warehouse.

The VerveGen Corporation building was the headquarters of the VerveGen Corporation in the Upper Industrial Sector on Nar Shaddaa. In 3643 BBY the building was infiltrated by Cipher Nine and Kaliyo Djannis, who interrupted a meeting between VerveGen leadership and the Eagle.

affiliation: The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania
x: The Adasca BioMechanical facility was a facility of The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania located on Quesh during the Quesh war.

The Adrenal Processing Factory was a Galactic Republic facility located on Quesh that processed Venenit queshaaga into combat adrenals. During the Quesh war the factory was attacked by the forces of the Hutt Cartel.
The Gates of Olaris was the gate that separated the Taris city of Olaris, the site of the Galactic Republic Taris Resettlement Initiative, from the Rakghoul-infested wilderness beyond.
Black-Saber was a code name for a data tape in the Galactic Empire's data vault on Scarif. Rebel Alliance member Jyn Erso mentioned it while searching for the Death Star's plans.

Lamproids were a carnivorous sentient, serpentine species that were native to Florn. They were well adapted to the dangerous environment of their homeworld, protecting themselves against dangerous lifeforms with their teeth, serpentine coils, and venomous tails.

The Holy Quarter was a location in the Holy City on the moon Jedha. During the Battle on Jedha, Jyn Erso saved the young girl Pendra Siliu from the fighting occurring there between the Galactic Empire and Saw Gerrera's Partisans.

The Eedit Road was a road that ran straight through the thick vine jungles of the planet Devaron. Joining the town of Tikaroo and the Temple of Eedit, the road was built by the Jedi Order and made of red stone.

The kyber crystal research team was a division of the Tarkin Initiative that specialized in the study of Force-attuned kyber crystals. The research team was led by the brilliant scientist Doctor Galen Erso.

Nouane was an astronomical object located within its eponymous star system in the Nouane sector, which was located in the regions known as the Inner Rim Territories and the Interior. It lay within grid square N-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Drearia was a world located in the Drearia system of the Inner Rim and the Interior. It was situated in grid square L-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid, and the super-hyperroute known as the Hydian Way linked Drearia to the Paqualis system as well as the world Champala.

Zeltros was an astronomical object in the Zeltros system in the galaxy's Inner Rim that had oceans and beaches with tropical trees. In 231 BBY, Sylvestri Yarrow referenced a festival that took place on Zeltros.
Ambria was an unpleasant desert planet, in tune with the dark side of the Force, that was located in the galaxy's Inner Rim. At some point, a human female was seen beside a lake on Ambria.

Berchest was an astronomical object located in the Berchest system in the Anthos sector of the Inner Rim Territories. In 4 ABY, General Hera Syndulla led a New Republic strike at Berchest in hopes of capturing Imperial Yachts and securing useful data.

Thyferra was a planet located in the Inner Rim Territories, lying on the Rimma Trade Route. It was the homeworld of the Vratix species, who invented the substance bacta and eventually became addicted to it.

Cona was a desert planet located in the Cona system in the galaxy's Inner Rim that was the homeworld of the Arcona species. Hem Dazon, a male Arcona frequently spent time in the Mos Eisley cantina after becoming stranded on Tatooine.
Marsh spiders were a type of spider that could be found stalking the swamps of the planet Dagobah.
The Promenade of Seven Guilds was a ceremonial avenue and the main thoroughfare in Pau City on the planet Utapau.

Early in the reign of the Galactic Empire, the planet Yar Togna was brutally conquered and then occupied by the Empire. The incursion saw Imperial troops use rifle butts and clubs against civilians and their property.

Mos Taike was a settlement built on the western edge of the Northern Dune Sea on the north side of the Mospic High Range in the small habitable region in the northern hemisphere of the desert planet Tatooine.

The throne room of the Naboo monarchs was located in the heart of the Royal Palace of Theed. On the request of Royal Naboo Security Forces Captain Quarsh Panaka, the handmaiden Eirtaé installed a compartment within the throne, only accessible by the queen that concealed two sm…
The Central Armory was an armory in the military complex of Tipoca City on Kamino.
The University of Rudrig was a university that shared its name with Rudrig. Thanks to loans taken out by her mother, the geological academic Lyra Erso studied at the university in 30 BBY.
Rudrig was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Rudrig system in the Tion Hegemony in the Outer Rim Territories. It was the location of a university that Lyra Erso studied at in 29 BBY.
The desiccated tablelands was a location on the Force-sacred moon of Jedha that consisted of massive, barren mesas.

Samovar was a legacy planet in the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located in grid square I-18 on the Standard Galactic Grid. Samovar had mining interests that legally mined minerals there in accordance with Samovar's status as a Legacy world.

The Ordu Aspectu was a splinter group of the Jedi Order that existed long before the Galactic Civil War, until they met their doom at the hands of a rogue artificial intelligence based on one of their founders.
LC-Zed was an early model of LC "hunting droid", a precursor to the Eliminator 434-series assassin droid.

The Coruscant Ballroom was a location on the planet Coruscant, where an event known as Coruscant Nights took place. During the Clone Wars, posters advertising Coruscant Nights in the Ballroom were put up in the Coruscant Underworld, in order to attract potential customers.
R5-M4 was an R5 series astromech droid that assisted in mining operations on the planet Mustafar. He included a Burtt acoustic signaller.
The Subjugator was a Resurgent-class Star destroyer of the First Order Navy famous for its participation in the capture of Resistance admiral Gial Ackbar during the Cold War.

place: Citadel of Rur and surrounding space
x: The attack on Garn, also known as the doom of the Ordu Aspectu, was a battle that took place many years before the Battle of Yavin when droids controlled by Eternal Rur attacked members of the Jedi Order and a Jedi splinter group known as the Ordu Aspectu.
Coruscant Green Park was a park area located on the planet Coruscant, filled with trees and elegant buildings. By the time of the Clone Wars, the park had become endangered.
Jaatovi was an astronomical object in the Jaatovi system of the Inner Rim Territories. It had at least three moons around it, one of which was inhabited during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

The uprising on Qemia 7 was a tragic revolt that took place on the Mid Rim moon Qemia 7 by 1 BBY. The uprising left the human Stordan Tonc—a native of the moon—with a hatred of the Galactic Empire and led to him leaving Qemia 7 and joining the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Qemia 7 was a terrestrial moon in the Qemia system of the Mid Rim Territories and New Territories' Strabin sector. It fell within grid square M-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid. An uprising had occurred on Qemia 7 by 1 BBY.
The Battle of Balamak was a battle that took place on Balamak sometime before the Battle of Scarif. The red lining on the garb of Senator Vasp Vaspar denoted the battle.

Unidentified Duroonian flyers were spotted by Han Solo after nightfall on the planet Duroon during his adventures there in 2 BBY. They were lacy, thin, and white, which flew through the air with a swimming, rippling motion.

Unidentified Duroonian crawlers were spotted by Han Solo after nightfall on the planet Duroon during his adventures there in 2 BBY. They looked like bundles of straw, and slowly crawled through the fronds of fern-trees.
Byss was an astronomical object that was the homeworld of the Abyssin species.

G2-1B7 was a 2-1B surgical droid that belonged to Saw Gerrera, leader of the rebel Partisans. The droid was modified so that it could dispense drugs to Gerrera at what would normally be considered dangerous intervals and was baffled that he was still alive after inhaling near-…
The Anchorite habit house was a location on the desert planet Jakku.
Cassidode VI was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Cassidode system of the Aparo sector within the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories.
Devlikk was a sentient species. Wan Sandage, a podracer from Ord Radama, who participated in the Boonta Eve Classic race held on the planet Tatooine during 32 BBY was a Devlikk.

The Ranc Gang was a criminal organization based on the Outer Rim planet Kaddak. Sometime following the Battle of Jakku, Terex, a former stormtrooper who had fought in the battle, became crime lord of the Rancs under the title of Lord-General.

Awrathakka was a Wookiee city built around a giant Wroshyr tree and located on the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk. During the Age of the Empire, Imperial forces enslaved the city's inhabitants and relocated them to Camp Sardo.

Warrin Station was a location that was a popular haunt for smugglers following the Battle of Endor. Han Solo and Chewbacca rallied several smugglers and Wookiee exiles there as part of their campaign to liberate the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk.
Syni IV was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Syni system of Wild Space that was the location of an Imperial garrison during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Ursosaurs were a territorial reptilian species native to the planet Auratera in the Outer Rim.

Level 5 was a level on the planet Coruscant. It was the lowest habitable level of the 5127-levelled ecumenopolis, and was deemed by a young Leia Organa to be the lowest accessible level of the Coruscant Underworld, citing common knowledge.

The Vault of Justice was a room within the Chamber of Antiquities, the complex of rooms that made up the base of the Great Jedi Library on Ossus. Located deep within the labyrinth of rooms and halls, the Vault contained the ancient artifact known as the Gauntlet of Neer.
A stunfinn was a deadly blood-red, long-fanged aquatic creature native to the Colonies world of Balmorra.
Dust stalkers were a predatory species native to the Madlands on the planet Weik in Wild Space.
Errops were a domesticated species native to the planet Weik in Wild Space. They were used as draft beasts, and were notable for being furry and walking with a shuffling gait.
Vask-wolves were a predatory species native to the planet Weik in Wild Space. They hissed when hungry and were considered ferocious.

Captivator's crew was a crew of bounty hunters led by the assassin droid Captivator who were hired by Jabba Desilijic Tiure to capture Han Solo.

Well of Shadows was a vertical tunnel that delved deep into a natural cavern system on a planet.

Mucktown was the main settlement of the Mud dwellers of Vagadarr Prime.

Noe'ha'on was a jungle world located in the Noe'ha'on system, a part of the Piryn Shar sector of the Expansion Region.
Molavar was an astronomical object located in the Abrion sector's Molavar system within an intersecting portion of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice regions.
The Gundark Arms Ring was a group of arms dealers led by an individual known as "Gundark." The group was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire and into the reign of the New Republic.

The northern market district was the northern district of Capital City, the aptly-named capital city of the planet Lothal. It contained Ake's Tavern and an express speeder bus ran between the district and Capital City spaceport, with only a single stop in between them.

Pelikki were a species of non-sentient, river-dwelling birds from the planet Naboo. They had an expandable throat pouch in which they held their aquatic prey when hunting.
Keejins were a species that inhabited the galaxy. They were likely to be encountered in caves.

Pion was a planet located in the Pion system within Wild Space.

Lutrillia was a planet in the Yarith sector, a subsector of the Javin sector of the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
Agaris was a planet with a damp, clammy climate located on the very edge of Wild Space and was the adopted homeworld of the Agarian species.

Ya-ya flies, also known as yaya flies, were a type of fly native to the jungle world Akiva. They were purple with a pair of wings, four appendages and a long needle like protrusion sticking out from their head.

The Notch was a narrow opening of Beggar's Canyon on Tatooine.

B'Thazoshe Bridge was a rock formation in the Jundland Wastes on Tatooine. Formed by ancient drainage channels, B'Thazoshe Bridge was the largest natural bridge on the planet, and it was considered sacred by the native Tusken Raiders.

Thrawn's sparring gym was a room designed and equipped for exercise aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Chimaera, the flagship of Grand Admiral Thrawn. In that room, the Grand Admiral used to train in hand-to-hand combat by fighting DT-series sentry droids.

Ysalamiri were four-eyed, lizard-like creatures. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn had two sculptures of ysalamiri made out of green, brown, and yellow material in his office aboard the Chimaera, placed behind his desk.
The Redeemer was an assault frigate that served in the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY.

The Amity was a Starhawk-class Battleship Mark I that served in the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War in 5 ABY. The Amity took part in the Battle of Jakku where it was subsequently destroyed.
The Unity was a Starhawk-class Battleship Mark I that served in the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War in 5 ABY. The Unity took part in the Battle of Jakku.

The ginzy was a thick-bodied, monkey-like creature with a chunky clay-colored and blond plumage and black eyes. It stood on two skinny legs, and its tiny hands ended in hooked talons, which the creature used for defensive purposes.

Bassa hounds were a type of heavy-hoofed dog. During the Imperial Era, a bassa hound belonged to the personal zoo of Harra the Hutt on the planet Vodran. By the New Republic Era, bassa hounds were trained as hunting companions at Kergans Academy.

Blue One was a T-65 X-wing starfighter that was used by Rebel Alliance pilot General Antoc Merrick. Merrick notably used Blue One during the Battle of Scarif, where he was killed when his fighter was shot down.
Fathiers were a species of quadrupeds that resided in the galaxy. They were often used as mounts, and wealthy inhabitants of Kergans and Cantonica rode them in competition.
The Kergans Security Force was the law enforcement agency of the planet Kergans.

The orphan farm of Lund Gourley, Durkteel, was a farm in which orphans under the care of Marn grew and harvested hemmel crops. Marn provided her wards with water and food, and would often send them to the local Phirmist temple by drift shuttle.

The Cirque Glacier was a glacier located on the ice-covered planet Hoth. It was located north of the Clabburn Range of mountains and south of the North Ridge and Lanteel Glacier. The Hanging Valley sat to the west of the Cirque Glacier and the Nev Ice Flow lay to the east.
The E'Y-Akh Desert was located on the planet Geonosis.

Straight Street was a street in Mos Eisley, Tatooine. Kerner Plaza ran off this road, as well as the Mos Eisley prefecture militia base.

The Elom were a mysterious sentient species that were native to Elom who lived in frozen grottos. They were short and stocky, and covered in thick, oily fur. As a result of living in darkness, Eloms had exceptional eyesight, but found natural or bright lights intolerable.
KMD-RA-71 was a silver-plated RA-7 protocol droid that served the Galactic Empire. It was present in Jedha City on the moon Jedha in 1 BBY.
The Orion was a Braha'tok-class gunship that was in service of the Massassi Group, a Rebel cell led by General Jan Dodonna.
Clan Saxon, also known as the Saxon clan, was a Mandalorian clan of House Vizsla.
The Vanguard was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate commanded by General Jan Dodonna that was a part of the Rebel Alliance's fleet.
Ingo was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Ingo system in the Bortele sector of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice, falling within grid square R-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Kassius Konstantine's Interdictor was an Interdictor-class heavy cruiser commanded by Imperial Admiral Kassius Konstantine during the Battle of Atollon.

The Black Forest was a forest on Kashyyyk that had been dead millennia before 5 ABY. The native Wookiees believed that the area had been poisoned by a darkness, and some believed that the Black Forest was cursed and haunted by bad spirits.
Slime crabs were a species of crab that could be found in the swamps of Ques. They were also edible to humans.
Ton-biri was a city on the planet Devaron.
Assarda was a city on the planet Devaron.

The Room of a Thousand Fountains was a massive seven-story greenhouse located in the First Knowledge Quarter behind the arcade depicting Liberation of Coruscant within the ziggurat base of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

Accipipteros were a type of large, birdlike reptavians native to the planet of Dagobah. Flying predators, they were the uncontested rulers of the swamp world's jungle canopies, where they spent their entire lives in the branches of gnarltrees.

Corporations Road was a street in Mos Eisley, Tatooine. It contained the Customs House. It was on this street where a Jawa fell off a startled ronto during Luke Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi's traverse through the city.

The Devil's Doorknob was a part of the hazardous Boonta Eve Classic course, located at the end of The Corkscrew. It was considered a very tough part of the arena, and many individuals had died in the Devil's Doorknob.
The Shadowlands, designated as Sector 7 by the Galactic Empire, were dark forests on the planet Kashyyyk. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Kashyyyk resistance hid in the Shadowlands.

The New Droids' Rights Movement was a droid civil right movement against organic life forms, organized by EV-8D3 on the planet Gavos. Some of it members tried to destroy the storm barrier generator to kill miners on the planet.

result: The Alliance to Restore the Republic are allowed to go free
x: The skirmish in the Hellhoop was a battle of the Galactic Civil War.

Leia Organa's pursuers are sent 8,000 years into the past, allowing he
x: The mission to Bedlam was undertaken by Leia Organa during the Galactic Civil War.
The Viridians were a sentient species native to the Viridia system.
The Skirmish on Mere was a minor battle that would pave the way for Nym to recruit a new ally in his fight against the Trade Federation.

The big game hunter Gozetta owned a sleek blunt-nosed shuttle. It was black and gold, with platinum bearings, had eight ion engines, and a rear hatch. Its design greatly resembled the Botajef SS-54 assault ship.
AT-ACT drivers were Galactic Empire army or navy units who piloted All Terrain Armored Cargo Transports.

Regor-Mada was a terrestrial astronomical object that was the homeworld of J'mi, a young alien who ended up joining the Resistance. It was located in the Regor-Mada system in the Tantra sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square M-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Keredians were a species of humanoids whose members were thinly spread around the galaxy. Little information existed about them, including their homeworld.
The Moveable Feast was a freighter starship that belonged to the bounty hunter Shalla Mondatha, also known as "the Shade."

M-OC was an Imperial hunter droid which was created by Emperor Sheev Palpatine and was tasked with locating and capturing the Force-sensitive Rowan Freemaker. He had a personal starship called the Tracker I.
The Arrowhead was a starship built by Rowan Freemaker, who believed that it could turn the tide of the Galactic Civil War.

result: Freemakers help Princess Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker escape the Whe
x: Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, an Imperial manhunt for Princess Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker took place on The Wheel. With the help of the Freemakers, Princess Leia and Luke evaded Lieutenant Estoc's forces and returned to the Rebel Alliance.

result: The Freemakers rescue Zander Freemaker with Naare's help
Wick Cooper's N-1 starfighter badly damaged
x: In 3 ABY, the Freemakers and Naare undertook a mission to rescue Zander Freemaker from the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vendetta. Zander had been captured by the Galactic Empire after taking Wick Cooper's N-1 starfighter on a joyride.
The Well-Being level, also referred to as Level 10 and written as the Tenth Level, was a location in Pau City on the planet Utapau.
Crait was a small salty mineral planet located in a remote sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in grid square N-17 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
Veruna was one of three moons that orbited the planet of Naboo. It shared its name with King Ars Veruna, who reigned over the Naboo before Padmé Amidala.

Sic-Six were a six-eyed intelligent species who, due to their unusual appearance, were easily mistaken for pests. One Sic-Six resided in the palace of Jabba the Hutt on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

The Naboo delegation was a group of diplomats that represented the planet of Naboo in the Senate of the Galactic Republic. Senator Sheev Palpatine served as head of the delegation during his tenure as the Naboo's representative in the waning years of the Republic.

Imperial Navy High Command, also known as Fleet Command, was one of the command groups of the Imperial Starfleet. By 1 BBY, Admiral Conan Antonio Motti has held the title of Admiral of the Fleet, and was also Chief of the Imperial Navy.
The Alderaanian delegation was a group of diplomats that represented the planet of Alderaan in the Congress of the Galactic Republic, and later in the Senate of the Galactic Empire.
Bargos's mining operation was an oridium mine on the planet Gavos during the Galactic Civil War owned by Bargos the Hutt.
The Bargos's mansion was Bargos' headquarters, a Hutt, during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Rawnde was one of the many moons that orbited Iego. It had a pinkish surface, with a large blue fissure running down one side.
The Gavos Droid Revolution was an uprising of droids on Gavos sometime after the Battle of Yavin, during the Galactic Civil War.

Imperial Riot Control Troopers, also known as riot control stormtroopers, Imperial riot troopers, stormtrooper chargers, and simply riot troopers, were specialized Imperial stormtroopers who acted as a security force tasked with the dispersion and arrest of insurgents taking p…

Winlion was one of the 1,000 moons of Iego, a group of moons that orbited the Outer Rim Territories planet Iego. Each of the moons was as mysterious as the planet itself, which was located at Standard Galactic Grid coordinates T-7.

The Tracker I was a starfighter piloted by the Imperial Hunter droid M-OC, the Emperor Palpatine's secret project. He used this ship to ferry him across the galaxy during the hunt for Rowan Freemaker, who had stolen the Kyber Saber from the Emperor.

Dead Man's Turn was a landmark within the Beggar's Canyon, located on the desert planet Tatooine. The turn held notoriety for the particular danger it posed to people who flew through the canyon, giving it the befitting name.
Mabo was an MA-B0 cargo lifter droid who joined the Church of the Force. He was a believer and a pilgrim who believed in the Force.
T-2LC also known as "Elsie" was a protocol droid that served as a nanny for Han Solo and Leia Organa around the time of the Battle of Jakku.

Kril'Dor was a planet located in the Kril'Dor system in the Outer Jalor sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was a source of tibanna gas. Located close to the Uba system, Kril'Dor was positioned at the coordinates I-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The finance ministry was the government department of the Galactic Empire which dealt with financial issues and headquartered in the Federal District of Coruscant, the Imperial throneworld.

Togorians were a sentient species of large, feline beings with digitigrade feet. Their bodies were covered in short, thick fur that could be brown, white, orange or red with stripes, and their eyes could be yellow or green with a yellow hue.

The Cyphari were a sentient species native to the planet Cyphar. Cyphari were described as resembling large stick insects with snouts similar to that of a Rodian. They were covered in neat rows of short red fur. One group of Cyphari was known as the Afe clan.

Cyphar was a terrestrial planet located in the Spirva sector of the Mid Rim that was the homeworld of the Cyphari species. The planet was mainly covered in grasslands and deserts with canyons, and had ground rich in scarn, a pre-spice compound.

Lysatra was an isolated planet in the Lysatra system in grid square I-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid, a portion of the Expansion Region that was considered Wild Space. By 15 BBY, it was still considered a part of Wild Space.
A throne room was used by Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine during the Galactic Civil War.

R2-H16 was an R2-series astromech droid that was optimized to function in cold weather. The droid's distinctive red-and-green "hat" was an external radiant heating array. He also included a Burtt acoustic signaler.

R2-B00 was an R2-series astromech droid that was a space pirate, and could be found on the planet Takodana. The droid was painted with a phosphorescent colorant, and included a Burtt acoustic signaller.
R5-X3 was a red-and-white plated R5-series astromech droid that worked for the Resistance during the Cold War with the First Order by 34 ABY.

Star Tours officers managed the daily operations and oversaw the personnel and droids of the Star Tours travel agency, as well as the operations of the souvenir trading post at the end of a tour. They wore distinctive blue and orange uniforms.
The Sterdic Star was a Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette commanded by Captain Hoff that was part of the Resistance's naval forces.

objective: Investigate the reports that the Rebel Alliance were gathering near My
x: During the twenty-third celebration of Empire Day, Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine received a report that the Rebel Alliance was gathering near the planet Mygeeto, Palpatine had his apprentice Darth Vader investigate to see if the report were true.
Clepresdan was one of the 1,000 moons that orbited Iego. It had a singular large crater on its surface with large canyons diverging from that crater.
Cobarb was one of the 1,000 moons that orbited the planet Iego, which was located at Standard Galactic Grid coordinates T-7 in the Outer Rim Territories.

Flitrude was a green and brown colored moon that orbited the planet Iego, which was located in the Outer Rim Territories at Standard Galactic Grid coordinates T-7. Like the rest of rest of Iego's 1,000 moons, Flitrude was as mysterious as the planet itself.

Uncovalor was one of the 1,000 moons that orbited the planet Iego, which was located at Standard Galactic Grid coordinates T-7 in the Outer Rim Territories. Like all of Iego's moons, Uncovalor was as mysterious as the world itself, and had a pink and brown surface.
Dinzo was a planet located in the Dinzo system in the Msst sector of the Mid Rim Territories.
The Noghri were a sentient species native to Honoghr. They had gray skin, a row of horns on their head and ran on all fours. Noghri were known for their combat skills and keen sense of smell.

Vardos was a planet located in the Jinata system in the galaxy's Core Worlds, and was home to Iden and Garrick Versio. Vardos was notable for its diversity and loyalty, with even the planet's many alien inhabitants expressing faith in the Empire.
The Ho'Din were a species of yellow-green humanoids in the galaxy. Ho'Dins possessed two large dark eyes, long suction cup-tipped fingers and, on their heads, red-violet fleshy tendrils.

The Galactic Spice Mining Guild was a spice mining organization fronted by the kingpin Groff Zugga, who served as a guild boss on the planet Mon Gazza. Under Zugga's leadership, Mon Gazza was second only to the planet Kessel in spice production.

The Pau Sinkhole was a natural formation stretching beneath the surface of the planet Utapau. It housed the subterranean settlement of Pau City, home to a million inhabitants including Pau'ans and Utai.

Chalcedon was a terrestrial planet located in the Chalcedon system in the Tashtor sector of the Mid Rim, in grid square I-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Located on the Great Gran Run between Cerea and Takodana, it was the center of the galactic slave trade.
Bacrana was an astronomical object located in the Bacrana system in the Brak sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region along the Corellian Run.

Black Spire Outpost (BSO), commonly known as Black Spire, was an outpost settlement on the planet Batuu. Due to Batuu's location on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories, Black Spire Outpost was one of the last stops before Wild Space and the Unknown Regions.

Ord Biniir was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in grid square K-5 on the Standard Galactic Grid. Prior to the Galactic Civil War, the Alliance to Restore the Republic launched a successful assault on Imperial targets there.

result: Terex is taken into First Order custody
Death of L'ulo L'ampar and N1-ZX
x: During the Cold War, a battle broke out in the Fjor system between the Resistance, the First Order, and the Ranc Gang.

The Blood Crow was an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser originally commanded by Captain Rik Virgilio, and later by Captain Filia Rossi. It was the first assignment of Lieutenant Thrawn and Ensign Eli Vanto.

Pad 560 was a landing pad in a spaceport on a green-skied planet. Shortly after the end of the Clone Wars in the year 19 BBY, the Senator Dewell Bronk landed on the planet on a transport that had traveled from Coruscant.
The Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Senator Dewell Bronk had to change transports on a planet with green colored skies while trying to flee Coruscant following the end of the Clone Wars.
The M'shinn species evolved from a humanoid precursor species on their homeworld Genassa.

The Corvus was a Raider II-class corvette used by Inferno Squad during the Galactic Civil War. Originally an Imperial vessel, the Corvus joined the New Republic following Commander Iden Versio and Agent Del Meeko's defection from the Empire.

The Thunder Wasp was an Imperial Arquitens-class light cruiser under the command of Commander Alfren Cheno. Captain Thrawn served as first officer aboard the vessel with his assistant, Ensign Eli Vanto.

result: Four starships and many small arms weapons captured
x: A battle occurred in the years leading up to the Battle of Yavin between the Sammun insurgents and the 96th Task Force of the Galactic Empire. Commander Karyn Faro, acting under Admiral Thrawn's direction, pacified the insurgents.

Kerner Plaza was a roadway within the city of Mos Eisley on the desert world of Tatooine. Flanked by an open-air bazaar, Kerner Plaza connected Straight Street to Inner Curved Street and was home to the Dim-U monastery.
Coruscant food stall was a marketplace located in the Uscru Entertainment District, on the planet of Coruscant, street-side food stalls serve affordable, fast fare to residents of all types.

2D4 was a B1-series battle droid stationed on the planet Gavos and was part of the New Droids' Rights Movement, a group of droids that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against organic life forms throughout the galaxy.

2D5 was a B1-series battle droid stationed on the planet Gavos and was part of the New Droids' Rights Movement, a group of droids that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against organic life forms throughout the galaxy.

3D1 was a B1-series battle droid stationed on the planet Gavos and was part of the New Droids' Rights Movement, a group of droids that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against organic life forms throughout the galaxy.

3D4 was a B1-series battle droid stationed on the planet Gavos and was part of the New Droids' Rights Movement, a group of droids that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against organic life forms throughout the galaxy.

3D7 was a B1-series battle droid stationed on the planet Gavos and was part of the New Droids' Rights Movement, a group of droids that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against organic life forms throughout the galaxy.

9B2 was a B1-series battle droid stationed on the planet Gavos and was part of the New Droids' Rights Movement, a group of droids that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against organic life forms throughout the galaxy.

3D-4K was a 3D-4 administrative droid who worked for Oridelve Incorporated on the planet Gavos. He was deactivated by R2-B7 before the Gavos Droid Revolution, a violent rebellion against organic life forms throughout the galaxy launched by EV-8D3, figurehead of the New Droids'…

BLL1 was a CLL-M2 binary loadlifter who worked for Oridelve Incorporated on the planet Gavos. During the Gavos Droid Revolution, EV-8D3, figurehead of the New Droids' Rights Movement, used protocols to control him.

BLL2 was a CLL-M2 binary loadlifter who worked for Oridelve Incorporated on the planet Gavos. During the Gavos Droid Revolution, EV-8D3, figurehead of the New Droids' Rights Movement, used protocols to control him.
C3-P9 was a protocol droid who worked for Bargos the Hutt during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
Chef was a COO cook droid stationed on the planet Gavos and worked for Oridelve Incorporated during the Gavos Droid Revolution.
Batuu was a remote terrestrial planet on the edge of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in the Batuu system of the Trilon sector.
A desert planet was located in the Fjor system in the Grohl sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 34 ABY, it was the site of a battle between the Resistance, the Ranc Gang, and the First Order.
Rebel sentries were Rebel Alliance personnel who monitored incoming and departing starships from the top of a watchtower near the Great Temple, the Rebellion's headquarters on Yavin 4.

FX-769 was a FX-series medical assistant droid stationed on the planet Gavos and was part of the New Droids' Rights Movement, a group of droids that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against organic life forms throughout the galaxy.

Lookout was a Searcher 2050 exploration droid stationed on the planet Gavos and was part of the New Droids' Rights Movement, a group of droids that was focused on spreading violent rebellion against organic life forms throughout the galaxy.

LIN-V8K was a LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer—a model of black-plated fifth-degree mining droid—that was amongst the droids offered for sale to the Lars homestead on the planet Tatooine by a group of Jawas in the year 1 BBY.
On the planet Wayland, the Guardian of Mount Tantiss established a city near Mount Tantiss and forced the native Myneyrsh, Psadan, and Human populations to build it.
R-3DO was a protocol droid working at the Resistance base on D'Qar. The red-colored droid monitored the Resistance's network of spy droids.
Pik-pok fish were a species of small red fish on Naboo. The Gungan Jar Jar Binks enjoyed eating pik-pok fish. Tooka cats also enjoyed eating such fish.
The Valfin Labor Camps Insurgence was an event that occurred during the Galactic Civil War after the establishment of the New Republic.
During the Cold War, the Resistance held a funeral for L'ulo L'ampar, a Resistance pilot after he perished in a battle over a desert planet.
Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, the Imperial shuttle Resurgence was damaged in a skirmish and forced to land on the planet Abonshee for repairs.

During the Imperial Era, nighttime riots occurred on the planet Ryloth, spurred by the heat of the summer months. The riots resulted in Twi'leks resisting Imperial control, forming crowds in the streets and cantinas of Lessu City, with unrest ensuing.

The Zakuulans were a cultural group of Humans from the Wild Space planet Zakuul. Before the rule of the Eternal Empire and Tenebrae—under the guise of the Zakuulan Warlord Valkorion—the Zakuulans worshipped the Six Gods.
Shimmerbirds were an avian species whose tongues were used by the Koorivar to craft robes.
The Lunnix were a sentient species with white fur and yellow eyes that lived in the galaxy. Zorahda was a member of this species.

The Ociocks were a sentient avian species that lived in the galaxy. A family of Ociocks including a female and her mother were imprisoned at Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817 on the planet Wobani during the time Jyn Erso was there.
The Rayeth were an amphibious sentient species that lived on Inusagi. They had long and slender bodies as well as membranes. Bardbee was a member of the Rayeth species.
The Caldanians were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They had dark brown slimy skin, tendrils, and a flexible cartilage instead of bones. A criminal was a member of this species.
The Cyrans were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. At least one Cyran was living on the planet Skuhl during the Imperial Era.
The Fryiaans were a sentient four-armed species from the Fryiaa system. In the Imperial Era, a female Fryiaan was a dancer and singer of a band.
Winrocs were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. At least a few Winrocs were living on the planet Skuhl during the Imperial Era.

The Jefi (plural form: Jefies) were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. The Jefies were considered to be a species of incredible loyalty, unflinchingly following anyone who presented them self as a competent leader.

The makorr were an aquatic predator species that lived in the galaxy. They fed on mollusk meat. During the Imperial Era, Captain Thrawn was able to track down a group of iridium smugglers by following several boats that had dumped a large quantity of mollusk meat, attracting a…
The Blade was a maze of narrow streets in the city of NiJedha, on the holy moon Jedha.
The Old Shadows was the long outer wall of the Temple of the Kyber in NiJedha, Jedha. Forever shielded from sunlight, it symbolized the necessity of balance between light and darkness.
The Labbo were a long-eared sentient species that lived in the galaxy. The Labbos' ears had flaps that could touch their shoulders when twitching.
The Ma'cella were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. Dwindun was a member of this species.
The Huloons were a sentient species whose anatomy included hands. During the reign of the Galactic Empire a Huloon youngling lived as a beggar on the Five Points space station.
The Kaths were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. A shopkeeper was a member of this species and had scales and at least one scaly hand.

Meftians were a fur-covered sentient humanoid species that had long black and white fur. They were also slightly reminiscent of the Wookiees. Kullbee Sperado, a member of this species, was a gunslinger and a member of the Partisans.

D'janis IV was an astronomical object where the female Dejammy Shallon served as a teacher and priestess. It was located in the D'janis system in the Halla sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square J-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Errimin was a terrestrial astronomical object where the Galactic Empire attempted to assassinate Saw Gerrera by poisoning him with teccitin. The attempt failed but Gerrera was sick for months afterwards.
Ghita was an astronomical object where an attempt to assassinate Saw Gerrera occurred. The attempt failed when the sniper missed Gerrera by centimeters.
Yablari was a world in the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Anomid species. Silvanie Phest led a handful of Anomids from their homeworld to the moon Jedha.

Siriamp was an astronomical object in the Siriamp system of the Mid Rim Territories' Halm sector where the Galactic Empire transformed ore from in what Saw Gerrera believed was a major weapons development due to its increased focus on cargo.
Centori was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Centori system in the Iskin sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square O-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Corlus was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Corlus system in the Woostri sector of the Expansion Region where a growing group of Saw Gerrera's partisans were based.

The Weldsingers of Grace were a religious group dedicated to the veneration of the Force. They were one of many such faiths whose members could be found in Jedha City on the moon Jedha prior to the city's destruction in 1 BBY.
The Tulava Quartet were a group who worked in Jedha City on the moon Jedha and were known to purchase goods stolen from the Galactic Empire.
By 3 BBY, the male human Tonk led a crew of anti-Galactic Empire insurgents. The crew consisted of Tonk himself, Sybl, Osky, and Ten-21, a cyborg human, and a Weequay.
Bakura was a planet in Wild Space considered an attractive destination for a day trip from the planet Batuu by the author Eloc Throno. Its capital city, Salis D'aar, was built in a circular pattern.

conflict: Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire
x: Ezra's broadcast was a message of rebellion delivered shortly after the raid on the communications tower in the year 4 BBY.

Khomm was a planet located in the Khomm system of the galaxy's Deep Core. It had many oceans and was the homeworld of the Khommites and the Khommite striders. Khomm participated in cloning that left behind logo proteins.
Aridus was a planet located in the Aridus system, a star system in the Narvath sector of the Expansion Region along the Gamor Run.

Cularin was an astronomical object situated in the Thaere sector's Cularin system within the regions known as the Expansion Region and the Slice. It was located in grid square P-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Cyrillia was an industrial planet located in the Cyrillia system in the Cyrillian Protectorate, a sector of the Expansion Region in grid square O-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Derra IV, also known simply as Derra, was an astronomical object located in the Derra system in the Mikaster sector of the Expansion Region, in grid square N-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Gizer was an astronomical object located in the Gizer system in the Lantillian sector of the Mid Rim Territories on the Perlemian Trade Route, which connected it to Taanab and Lantillies.

Horox III was an astronomical object located deep in the Outer Rim Territories where the Alliance to Restore the Republic established a temporary outpost. Luke Skywalker traveled to a bar on Horox III sometime after his mission to Vagadarr Prime.

A police probe was flying patrol in Coruscant's Sector GL5 when a shot rang out. The probe spotted Mandalorian Duchess Satine Kryze beside the body of Davu Golec of the Republic Ministry of Intelligence.

Bulbas were a species of tiny rodents from Skuhl that had pale brown fur, a tiny pink twitching nose, big black eyes, and a long, fur-covered tail ending in a tuft. Bulbas' bones were very weak, which set the stage for a symbiotic relationship with an indigenous vine species.
Hirara was a small, inhabitable planet located in the Five Points system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. There were guesses that rebels had set up a base on the planet.
The Judicator was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer in service of the Imperial Navy during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

The Royal Court of Onderon was the monarchal court of Onderon, consisting of the household and entourage of the monarch. At one point in galactic history, Oz Ladnod served as the official poet to the Royal Court.

At some point before the Battle of Endor, the Rebel Alliance's Blue Squadron launched an assault on the Galactic Empire's Strike Station Aurek. Lieutenant Valeria devised a plan to destroy the battle station by dropping a proton bomb into the base's thermal exhaust port.
During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Woan Barso owned a Unar-Con tug which he used to move cargo up to the freighters waiting in orbit above Jedha.
Inusagi was a planet in the Vilonis sector of the Mid Rim region of the galaxy. It was famous for its sakoola blossom festival.

In 4 ABY, a dogfight took place between the Rebel Alliance's Blue Squadron and the Galactic Empire. During that dogfight, Zander Freemaker flew his modified starfighter Blazemaker Mark II, which had been fitted with several blasters.

t: Skirmish with an Imperial Star Destroyer
result: Destruction of an Imperial-class Star Destroyer
x: In 4 ABY, a space battle took place between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. An Imperial Star Destroyer attacked the Rebel Alliance's command ship Home One.
