R0-GR loses one of his legs
x: In 4 ABY, the Freemakers undertook a mission to rescue the Rebel Alliance agents Lando Calrissian and Chewbacca. The Freemakers were initially intercepted by an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser commanded by Durpin and Plumestriker.

t: Mission to obtain a Type A vector coil
result: The Freemakers obtain a Type A vector coil
objective: Obtain a Type A vector coil
x: In 4 ABY, the Freemakers undertook a mission took place to collect a Type A vector coil for the Rebel Alliance starfighter pilot Colvett Valeria's U-wing starfighter.
A growing group of Saw Gerrera's Partisans were based on Corlus.
The Agarians were an extremely long-lived sentient species that evolved from fungi. They were, in a manner of speaking, sentient mushrooms who could alter their size and the number of their limbs.
The Straks were a sentient species native to the Expansion Region planet Teya IV.

Hyropodic aetherbeasts were a type of creature native to only three biomes on the world of Yolthani VI. They possessed a large muscled upper torso, with two arms and a head. Their faces included two white eyes and a mouth of sharp teeth surrounded by red tentacle-like appendages.

Yolthani VI was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Yolthani system of the Nijune sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories, being situated in grid square N-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Essfour, also spelled as Essfor, was an R5 series astromech droid that served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was assigned to Luke Skywalker, following R2-D2's mission to rescue a captured C-3PO.

The Alkenak fields were a sporting venue located in the Core Worlds' Alkenak system. At some point between 0 ABY and 3 ABY, they were mentioned in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology.

The Ezaraa were a species of warmongering carnivorous sentients that were native to the the planet Ezaraa. They intended to overthrow the Galactic Empire, only to replace it with their own dominion and feed on the other species, which they deemed as lesser to them.

Jos was one of three moons that orbited the planet Saleucami, located in the Suolriep sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. The moon had a greenish hue due to crystalline dust in its atmosphere.

Victori was one of three moons that orbited the planet Saleucami, located in the Suolriep sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Crystalline dust in the moon's atmosphere caused it to have a greenish hue.

The Droidnostics Center was an area of Star Tours' Tomorrowland Starport used for droid repair and maintenance, almost entirely staffed by droids themselves. The term "Droidnostics" refers to a droid diagnostics system.
The Romary was a Phelarion-class fuel tanker in service to a crew of Xexto led by Captain Perrili in 34 ABY.

Moltok was an astronomical object located in the Atrivis sector's Moltok system, within the intersection of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories regions. Situated at the coordinates L-5 on the Standard Galactic Grid, it was home to a Ho'Din settlement.
Keitum was a planet located in the Keitum system in the Ariarch sector of the Mid Rim, connected via hyperspace route to Ansion. Cartherston was a city located on the planet.
Cartherston was a city located on the planet Keitum.

Maryx Minor was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Many eruptions, explosions, and spurts of radiation were common on the planet. These conditions made it difficult to maintain shelter for very long, a reason the Galactic Empire passed over it.
The Botajef Defense Force was the planetary defense force of the Outer Rim world of Botajef. It was made up of seven squadrons of V-19 Torrent starfighters as well as two CR90 corvettes.
The P'frorin gotta-worm was a type of worm from the P'frorin system of the Outer Rim Territories' Bheriz sector.
Vulpors were a non-sentient species with long, silky tails that inhabited the grasslands of Skuhl.

M'haeli was an agriworld located in the M'haeli system in the Majoor system of the Expansion Region. The world contained the D'olop mountain range, where dragite gems were mined for use in lightsabers.
Sernpidal was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

The Panaka was a starship of the Galactic Empire's loyalist forces during the Galactic Civil War, serving as a vessel within the Imperial blockade that defended the Imperial capital Coruscant in 5 ABY. It was named after the Imperial Moff Quarsh Panaka, who had perished in 3 BBY.

Huulia was a planet located in the Huulia system of the Colonies. In 32 BBY, the nacelle from a Huulian starfighter was among the junk stored in the scrapyard of the Toydarian Watto's junkshop in the city of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine.
4A-2R was a RA-7 protocol droid droid that was a member of Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang by the Clone Wars. 4A-2R was a valued part of Ohnaka's operation due to the surveillance equipment in his head.

Ktath'atn was a dark forest planet in the Ktath'atn system in the Chopani sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was ruled by the Queen of Ktath'atn, whose hive fed on the human inhabitants. It was the location of the Citadel of Ktath'atn, which stood over a village.
Tharl was a terrestrial astronomical object where the Graf lodge was located. It was located in the Tharl system in the Sugai sector, a subsector of the Zuma sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

The Makurth were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. On Moltok, a Ho'Din settlement came under attack from a local Makurth boss, leading the Ho'Din to request Imperial muscle to avoid it turning into a full-fledged war.
G2-PI (Geetoo-Peeeye) was a talkative G2 repair droid who managed droid maintenance at the Resistance base on D'Qar.
Four hundred vulture droids were launched from the outermost moon of the planet Umbara during the Battle over Umbara.
Chankin was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Chankin system in the Mid Rim's Jidlor Marches sector.

Kal'Shebbol was a planet located in the Kal'Shebbol system in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located close to one end of the Rimma Trade Route, which connected it to Septra. Cal Alder, an Alliance to Restore the Republic lieutenant, hailed from the planet.

The Cyblocians were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. An assassin was a member of this species.

The Coruscant Ministry of Ingress was the organization responsible for processing immigrants arriving on the planet Coruscant. The ministry had subdivision offices located throughout Galactic City. Tannon Praji served as the First Minister of the Coruscant Ministry of Ingress.

The attack on Tharkos was a battle of the Galactic Civil War. It was carried out by the Rebel Alliance after Han Solo tipped off the Rebels about a deal between Millennium Astro-Engineering and the Galactic Empire.
The B'omarr Flats were an expanse of land in the Northern Dune Sea of Tatooine near the Great Mesra Plateau. The Great Pit of Carkoon was located in this area.
Paradise Road was a street in Mos Eisley, branching off from Spacers Row. Masse Goskey's famous Arms Emporium and Jabba Desilijic Tiure's Desilijic Complex were several buildings on this road.

Shadda-Bi-Boran was a planet located within the Toblain sector in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. By 228 BBY, it was located within the Occlusion Zone created by the Nihil marauders. In 39 BBY, the planet's sun was dying.
During the rebellion on Akiva, the New Republic starfighter pilot Norra Wexley formed a team to inspire a popular uprising against Imperial rule on Akiva.

The moons of Ai'ken Prime were a group of at least two moons located within the Inner Rim Territories. Lord Hossferin of the Vandelae star system Hossferins traveled from the moons of Ai'ken Prime to visit the queen of Ktath'atn, but was killed by her lieutenant, Bombinax.

Canto Bight was a coastal city on the desert planet Cantonica. The city was a destination for wealthy individuals, as it was filled with casinos and racetracks. During the war between the Resistance and the First Order, Resistance members Finn and Rose Tico traveled there.
The attempted kidnapping of Senator Amidala, by members of the Burning Rancors, occurred during the Clone Wars on Coruscant.
The Valley of the Eremite was a valley on the planet Jakku that was near the Plaintive Hand plateau. It was located beyond the Yiulong Canyons and Caverns of Bagirlak Garu.

An asteroid field was located near Maarka, in the Perkell sector of the Mid Rim. While on a mission to deliver a data file with important intelligence for the Republic base on Maarka, Ahsoka Tano was ambushed by six Vulture droid starfighters in this asteroid field.

place: An asteroid field in the Maarka system
x: During the Clone Wars, a skirmish took place in an asteroid field near Maarka.

The Ponta One was an SC3000 freighter cargo ship owned by Akshaya Ponta. Akshaya's daughter, Tanith Ponta worked aboard the freighter, causing her to become ill with bloodburn. After Tanith's death, Akhaya banned her son Hadder from piloting, fearing he may get the disease.
During the Separatist Crisis, in the final months before the start of the Clone Wars, the Roshu Sune pursued a terrorist bombing campaign.
The Miraluka were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They had tanned brown skin, gray or white hair, and did not possess eyes.

AD-W4, also referred to as Ay-Dee, was a mercenary droid that General Grievous hired to oversee the Separatists operations on the planet Hissrich during the Clone Wars. AD-W4 was ultimately destroyed after a duel with Jedi Master Mace Windu on Hissrich.
The skirmish in Mos Espa took place in the city of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine during the Clone Wars.

BB-9E was a black-plated BB-series astromech droid in the service of the First Order. A top-of-the-line astromech droid, during the New Republic Era, BB-9E served aboard Supreme Leader Snoke's flagship, the Supremacy, keeping machinery operational and upholding security proced…
The odupiendo were a species of large, flightless avians from Naboo. Although unable to fly, the odupiendo were fast runners.

Radhii was a planet located in the Radhii system of Wild Space that was part of the Galactic Empire by the time of the Battle of Endor. In Tavuu the capital of the planet, the Segenka prison was located there.

This unidentified planet was a planet in the galaxy. During the Clone Wars, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker took a Jedi Initiate Clan on a training mission to this planet. Members of the group included Jedi younglings Ammon, Cryle and Tryla.
The tannors were a venomous species that were indigenous to an unidentified planet.

Tamsye Prime was a planet located in the Tamsye Prime system in the Thanium sector in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, the planet produced shell munitions for the Galactic Republic. In 5 BBY, Saw Gerrera abandoned Jyn Erso on the planet whilst on a mission there.

This abandoned planetoid was a planetoid located in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, Jedi Master Mace Windu went on a mission to this abandoned planetoid to investigate the source of a distress signal.

The Octagon district, also called simply the Octagon, was a multi-level plaza in Lessu City on the planet Ryloth. The capitol building was located in the district. Imperial personnel relied on the Octagon for recreational purposes such as visiting cantinas.

x: During the Clone Wars, a conference was held on the contested moon of Gus Talon to negotiate peace.

The diplomatic complex on the moon of Gus Talon was a huge complex built solely to host diplomatic negotiations. The whole facility was automated and self-sufficient, as droids ensured the building ran efficiently.

The Acidity was a Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. It served as the personal Star Destroyer and flagship of Grand Moff Randd, who commanded the Imperial fleet from the bridge of the Acidity during the Battle of Jakku.

The Guarlara was a Venator-class Star Destroyer that served in the Fifth Fleet of the Galactic Republic naval forces' Open Circle Fleet, and participated in the Battle of Coruscant during the Clone Wars in 19 BBY.

The Glaciate was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser in service of the Imperial Navy. It participated in the Battle of Jakku, where the Galactic Empire was defeated, ending the Galactic Civil War.
The Striking Distance was an MC80 Star Cruiser that was owned by General Carlist Rieekan during the Galactic Civil War. It participated in the climactic Battle of Jakku.
The Profusion was a Lucrehulk-class battleship that served within the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
TF-1726 was a masculine-programmed T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid who served in the Confederacy navy during the Clone Wars.
The Imperialis was a replica of Emperor Palpatine's original luxury yacht of the same name. The replica was stored at the Jakku Observatory.

Clone trooper flight crews were clone troopers in the Grand Army of the Republic who were trained to help maintain the ships and walkers. They served aboard ships such as the Venator-class Star Destroyer.
Clone jetpack troopers or clone jet troopers were a variant of clone trooper trained for aerial combat, most commonly through the use of the JT-12 jetpack.

Stealth clone pilots, also known as stealth ops clone pilots, or simply as stealth pilots, were clone trooper pilots of the Galactic Republic that were trained to pilot stealth vehicles such as the IPV-2C Stealth Corvette.

Chroma-neekas were tiny rodent-like creatures that nested inside computers and other electric devices. The fed off the power lines causing malfunctions. Chroma-neeka's would spread by stowing away aboard tramp freighters.
The Sollux was a humanoid sentient species with frog-like features which the mysterious being Orphne belonged to.
The Kandarra was an Imperial shuttle assigned to Garos IV. It was commanded by Commander Skilis.
Gonky was a GNK-series power droid. It was an unusually enthusiastic member of its series, and had a taste for combat situations.
R7-D4 was an R-series astromech droid that served with the Kel Dor Jedi Master Plo Koon during the Clone Wars.

The Cylo Directive was a subdivision within the Tarkin Initiative, a secret think tank within the Galactic Empire. It was headed by Doctor Cylo, who specialized with cybernetics. Cylo envisioned a society with advanced cyborgs and without the Force.

The inner systems' Imperial remnant was a remnant of the Galactic Empire that existed within the inner systems of the galaxy following the Galactic Empire's dissolution and surrender to the New Republic.

Tibalt was a uninhabited planet that was fully covered in mountains, hills, and plains. At some time before the Battle over Tibalt, another battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire happen on Tibalt's surface.
TC-4 was a red TC-series protocol droid with ties to the Sith Order.

This unidentified planet was a planet in the galaxy. During the Clone Wars, Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi went on a mission to this planet, thinking he would find a Separatist traitor with information to sell.
In 0 ABY Doctor Chelli Aphra assaulted the Naboo villa of the retired mortician Commodex Tahn on behalf of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
The Sunspire was an Alderaanian escort frigate used by the New Republic Starfleet during the last year of the Galactic Civil War.
In 0 ABY, Doctor Chelli Aphra undertook a mission to the Citadel of Ktath'atn with Luke Skywalker in order to seek an audience with the Queen of Ktath'atn.
A hive of abersyn symbiotes were controlled by the Queen of Ktath'atn on the planet Ktath'atn for many standard years.

Vader's starship was a starship given to the newly christened Sith Lord Darth Vader in 19 BBY, along with a droid who fit in an astromech socket. Vader destroyed a Rebel base by blowing up a cargo of coaxium with the starship.

During the early stages of the Great Jedi Purge in 19 BBY, Jedi Padawan Caleb Dume answered the Jedi beacon distress signal and attempted to return to the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant.
Cad Bane's group, also known as Cad Bane's crew, were a group of bounty hunters led by the Duros bounty hunter Cad Bane from before 32 BBY, until at least 20 BBY.

x: Shortly after Order 66, a celebration marking the eradication of the Jedi Order was held on Coruscant. The event was to celebrate the destruction of the Jedi Order.
This species of reptavians originated from a farming moon in orbit of the planet Kashyyyk. These creatures dropped seeds from their beaks over the farmlands of their moon.

This farming moon was one of the three moons in orbit around the planet Kashyyyk.

The Pryce Mine was owned by Pryce Mining on the planet Lothal until it was given to the Galactic Empire by Arihnda Pryce to prevent it being take over by governor Ryder Azadi after he discovered a vein of doonium had been uncovered on the mine.

Clone medical officers, also known as medical officer clones, were Galactic Republic clone troopers specialized in medical treatments. They served aboard Haven-class medical stations and Republic starships during the Clone Wars.
Konkiv was a remote jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories, located within the Konkiv system in the Cadma sector.
Cherridan was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Cherridan system in the Belnar sector of the Colonies where an uprising at an Imperial labor camp was put down.
An uprising was brutally put down at an Imperial labor camp on Cherridan.
A successful assault was launched on an Imperial stormtrooper garrison on Winter's Edge.
Plo's Bros was the name given to Republic LAAT/i gunships used by the 104th Battalion during the Clone Wars.

Ahsoka's Jedi Interceptor was an Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor flown by Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano. The ship color was red similar to her previous Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor. Her droid R7-A7 continued to serve as her copilot.

conflict: Chirrut Îmwe and Baze Malbus' attacks against the Galactic Empire

Delta-T-3 was the designation of a YV-865 Aurore-class freighter that was used by the Zygerrian Slave Empire during the Clone Wars.

In 4 BBY, a skirmish took place on the planet Thrad. Two former Imperial officers, Swain and Cogon, fled to the planet seeking to defect to the rebels. They were met by an agent of Senator Nadea Tural who agreed to aid them in return for intel the brought with them.

Between 4 BBY and 3 BBY, a skirmish took place on the planet Imvur between two Rebel cells and the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. The Imperials targeted the Rebel base on the planet in retaliation for a previous raid on an Imperial base.
The ghoma was a clawed creature native to the Zoess, a large forest on the planet of Radhii.

Tavuu was a major city on Radhii, a planet located in the galaxy. Tavuu was built on high plateau over a jungle named Zoess. In the eastern part of the city, where the Imperial base and the prison Segenka was located, criminals and criminal elements were active.

x: The Lodan job was an event that occurred during the latter years of the Galactic Republic. The bounty hunter Arlain Zee earned notoriety and became a wanted man after he swindled Sli Genchu out of the job.
Prior to the Battle of Jakku, the Counselor to the Empire Gallius Rax recruited two dozen local Jakku orphans as child soldiers.

The Dromedar was a freighter carrying a cargo of static-locked tibanna gas that during the reign of the Galactic Empire was found derelict in space by the Gozanti-class cruiser Blood Crow. Thrawn, Eli Vanto and other crew members were dispatched to investigate it.
Ession's primary moon was the primary satellite of the planet Ession in the Corporate Sector. Its surface was rocky, barren, and dusty.
Team Dosho was a group of three Trandoshan mercenaries in the employ of the Hutt Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo.
Oliu was a forest planet located in the Jubilar sector within the Outer Rim Territories.
Tyegin was a forested planet located in the Tyegin system in the Inner Rim Territories with many railroads on its surface.
The Hossferins were a group based in the Vandelae system. Their members included a Lord Hossferin who traveled to the planet Ktath'atn in 0 ABY in order to gain audience with the world's queen.

Watassay was a small, inhabitable planet located in the Five Points system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. At some point, the Galactic Empire enacted a blockade around it, wanting to claim the resources there.
Rumitaka was a small, dusty planet located in the Five Points system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
Satotai was a small, inhabitable planet located in the Five Points system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
Uchinao was a small, inhabited planet located in the Five Points system of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
Skuhl was a planet located in the Skuhl system in the Spadja sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Virkoi was an aquatic world located in the Virkoi system of the Inner Rim Territories that housed a Imperial training academy known as Viper's Nest. Sinjir Rath Velus uncovered a plot to assassinate Darth Vader whilst on Virkoi.
Uba was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Mid Rim.
Fashinder Prime was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Fashinder Prime system in the Primtara sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square P-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
In an effort to mine quadanium for the construction of the Death Star, the Galactic Empire established a compound on the Wild Space planet of Agaris in the early years of Emperor Palpatine's reign.
Marleyvane was a terrestrial astronomical object that hosted an Imperial Academy and Imperial shipyards.

Toopil was a complex on the planet Rodia that consisted of a cantina, a handful of meeting rooms, a smugglers' den, and dormitories. It also had a private docking bay that was suitable for most light freighters.

Sammun was a planet in the Outer Rim's Batonn sector that was governed by Governor Estorn. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Commander Karyn Faro was tasked with taking the Ninety-Sixth Task Force to Sammun and eliminating local insurgents.
Scrim Island was a location on the planet Batonn.
A species of giant ant lived on the planet Twon Ketee.

The Stinker was a type of creature that was native to the planet Xirl. They started out as small creatures less than a foot long, and could grow to huge sizes larger than ships. They molted their skin when they grew another pair of arms.

Ants were a species of insects that could be found on the planet Salient I. It was felt among the people of Skuhl that they were ants and the Galactic Empire was a giant that would take no notice of an Outer Rim Territories planet like them, though this was proven false as the…
The Marleyvane shipyards also referred to as the Marleyvane yards were shipyards on the planet Marleyvane.

Thissermounts were a type of stump-legged creatures that lived on the Inner Rim desert planet Jakku. They possessed brittle manes of hair and were used as riding beasts by the anchorites that dwelt on the world.

The Orkoon Hub was a location on the planet Jakku. When Grand Admiral Rae Sloane traveled to Jakku to find out information about Gallius Rax she came across Ergel's Bar in Cratertown where the bartender, Corwin Ballast, told Sloane that a Knockback Nectar was ten credits apiec…

Darth Vader's Venator-class Star Destroyer was a Venator-class Star Destroyer owned by Darth Vader during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He murdered several of the ship's crew, including Admiral Mummert, after being interrupted while meditating in his chamber.
During the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic liberated the planet Nothoiin from the Confederacy of Independent Systems after a month-long battle.
The Echani were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They shared their name with a form of martial art.
Ke'dem Ramp was an area of the Agrilat Swamp, on the planet Corellia. It was the sixth piece of terrain that the contestants of the Agrilat Swamp Circuit had to race through.

During the Mission to Megalox Beta, BB-8 and the other Black Squadron astromech droids O-R10N, R2-HA, and R4 encountered a large security droid. The droid destroyed O-R10N but was electrocuted and disabled by BB-8.
A Tree snake was a type of snake that lived in trees.
The Venture was a freighter owned by the big game hunter Gozetta.
Deck Twelve was a chamber inside the Megalox space station that contained the primary security field generator that projected the gravity shield above Megalox prison on the planet Megalox Beta.
Galway farm was a farm located on Jaresh.
A barn owned by Grimshaw was located in the village of Jowloon on the planet Jaresh.
A moon orbited the planet Agaris in Wild Space.

Al'doleem, also known as the river moon of Al'doleem, was a moon located in the galaxy's Mid Rim that the droid Arex spent many years on with many Jedi. During the early stages of the Great Jedi Purge, Jedi Master Kirak Infil'a lived in seclusion on the moon.
Arex was a Jedi training droid who spent many years with Jedi on Al'doleem, a moon in the galaxy's Mid Rim.
A Monga-snake was a type of snake. Lina Graf called disgraced Imperial Navy Captain Visler Aqorian Korda III a monga-snake after he betrayed her on Xala's moon.

Gattering was a desert planet located in the Gattering system in the Noolian sector of the Mid Rim Territories. In 19 BBY, a group of enslavers operated from a base on the planet until they were killed by the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
A base was located on Gattering in the Mid Rim that was maintained by a group of enslavers.

A syndicate operated on the Cosmatanic Steppes during the Age of the Empire. Soo-Tath and his brother were both members of the syndicate. The rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra loaned credits from the syndicate in order to rebuild her starship, the Ark Angel II.

place: Cosmatanic Steppes, Cosmatanic Steppes gas giant
x: The historical art rush was an event championed by archaeologists.
Lahag Erli was a planet located in the Lahag Erli system, a part of the Expansion Region's Cantons of Lahag sector.

The Haddrex Gang, or Haddrex Consortium, was a gang that existed in the galaxy. Prior to the Invasion of Naboo, they were wiped out during an altercation on the city-moon of Nar Shaddaa by a group of bounty hunters led by Cad Bane.
The Zoess was a large forest located on the planet Radhii. It was home to creatures such as deschene and ghoma.

Arthurians were a sentient species. A group of Arthurian delegates were meant to negotiate with Senator Padmé Amidala of the Galactic Republic at some point during the Clone Wars. As noted by the Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano, Arthurians never used eating utensils.

The greddleback termite was a type of termite that lived in hard mounds or nests. Many of these mounds, which could be anywhere from humanoid to building-like in size, could be found in the termite forests of Northern Indoumodo.
The Sunburst was a G9 Rigger-class light freighter used by Ephraim and Mira Bridger.

The Conqueror was a Maxillipede shuttle that was present at the battle of Antolus I. It was equipped with a magnetogravitic shield.
A Pole-snake was a type of snake that lived on the desert planet Jakku. At least one pole-snake took over the nest of a skittermouse prior to the Battle of Jakku.
Antolus I was a planet located in the Sarka sector of the Mid Rim.
During the Clone Wars, a battle took place on the planet Antolus I.

A base was located on the floating Anthan Spire of Anthan Prime and was maintained by the Givin information broker known as "the Ante." The base served as the headquarters for the Ante's operations.
The Phorosians were the inhabitants of the planet Phorose.
A stingfly was a type of insect. According to Thrawn, thousands of stingflies being encouraged to attack a tusklan from all sides would kill the creature.
A Akivan viper was a type of snake that lived on the planet Akiva.
CS-831 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by Grand Admiral Rae Sloane to travel to the planet Coruscant.
The Diligent was a Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy that, in 5 ABY, traveled from the planet Ryloth to join the Imperial forces on the planet Jakku.
K-4D8 was an enhanced, masculine KX-series security droid who served Director Orson Callan Krennic of the Galactic Empire.

The Foremost was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in service to the Galactic Empire's naval forces. The Foremost joined other members of Admiral Carlou Gendling's task force, including the Thunder Wasp and two Raider-class corvettes during the battle over Umbara.

A Grist mollusk was a species of Mollusk with dense meat. In 12 BBY, the crew of the Arquitens-class light cruiser Thunder Wasp captured smugglers who were attempting to smuggle iridium stored inside Grist mollusk shells.

The Anaxes canyon was a canyon located on the planet Anaxes. During the Battle of Anaxes, a Republic gunship was shot down by Separatist DSD1 dwarf spider droids and crashed in the canyon.

Cedonne was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Cedonne system in the Dononter sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was the site of mining yards, and Lina Graf was nearly flattened by a binary loadlifter while on Cedonne.

The Cyban Front was a criminal organization that worked with the Droid Gotra during the Age of the Empire.

Mount Pasvaal was a hollow mountain located on the river moon Al'doleem in the Mid Rim. A Jedi monastery was located on the summit of the mountain, while the interior of the mountain itself was a labyrinth of tunnels, chambers, and temples.
A monastery used by the Jedi Order was located on Mount Pasvaal on the river moon of Al'doleem in the Mid Rim.
The Praetorian Guard, also known as the Imperial Praetorian Guard and later as the Elite Praetorian Guard, were elite crimson-armored soldiers of the First Order.

Kylo Ren's TIE silencer was a prototype TIE/vn space superiority fighter used by Kylo Ren during the First Order's war with the Resistance. Ren's use of the TIE silencer allowed Sienar-Jaemus Fleet Systems to refine its onboard system from his detailed post-flight reports.
Raptorans were a species of large bird native to the river moon Al'doleem in the Mid Rim.

A lava planet was located in the galaxy. Under the rule of the Galactic Empire, a rebel cell known as the Spectres, came in their starship Ghost, and picked up some supplies, destroyed machines and a com array, liberated prisoners of the Empire, and destroyed a TIE fighter.
The Authority was a Star Destroyer in service to the Galactic Empire. It was commanded by Admiral Bethava Rocwyn. In 1 BBY, the Authority captured a group of Partisans in the Five Points system.
This capital city was the capital of the planet Inusagi.

The Dominion of the Ezaraa, or the Ezaraa Dominion, was an organization of war-mongering members of the Ezaraa species. They wished to overthrow the Galactic Empire and take control of the entire galaxy and wider universe.
A CR90 corvette was owned by a group of pirates who were supported by the Crymorah Syndicate.

A Jedi ceremony was held for Padawan Ahsoka Tano at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant in 21 BBY in which she was given new Padawan beads by Grand Master Yoda to signify her growth as a Jedi.
In orbit over the planet Carnelion IV was a field of debris made out of technological wreckage, including space stations and satellites.
This airgun was an airship scavenged and cobbled together by Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker during the mission to Carnelion IV.

A CT-900 freighter was a model of freighter, that has a distinctive hammerhead. One known CT-900 freighter was the StarScavenger, the starship and transport of the Freemakers, a family of scavengers who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

The Duggenhei was a transport vessel. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Arihnda Pryce arranged for her parents, Elainye and Talmoor Pryce, passage to Lothal via Paeragosto City on the Duggenhei from Batonn.
Hammer-headed beasts were creatures found on the diseased planet Carnelion IV. The beasts served as mounts for the planet's native species, the mutated Fishers.

A mountain was located on the poisoned planet Carnelion IV. Located in a cave bored into the mountainside was the Fortress-Home of the Open, the main installation of the Open faction, who warred with the rival Closed.

Mudslide Falls was located on the Mud Fields of a planet in the Vagadarr system.

The Mud Fields were a region on a planet in the Vagadarr system. It was the area of the planet that was not close in proximity to the Blue mountains and was thus dead and lifeless. The Mud dwellers were headquartered in Mucktown there during the Vagadarr system war.
Mudbugs were a type insect native to a planet in the Vagadarr system. The human Mud dwellers of the system consumed the mudbugs as a source of food.

Mud frogs were a type frog native to a planet in the Vagadarr system. During the first mission to the Vagadarr system, diminutive green Jedi Grand Master Yoda was briefly confused for a mud frog by a warrior of the Rockhawkers.
A nightswan was a bird, which only sang after night fell. The rebel Nevil Cygni took the name Nightswan as a code name to undertake covert rebel activities against the Galactic Empire.

Paeragosto City was a city on the main continent of the planet Batonn. When tackling the Batonn sector insurgency during the reign of the Galactic Empire, Arihnda Pryce had a plan to halt the progress of rebel insurgents near the city, involving a bomb.

R5-D23 was an R5 series astromech droid operating in marketplace of Lothal's Capital City. He was a typical R5, but also wore a blue cone-shaped hat with star and moon shapes in its design that served as auxiliary shielding. He included a Burtt acoustic signaller.
The Skyscreamers were a small group within the tribe of Mud dwellers from a planet in the Vagadarr system.
The Blue mountains were a range of mountains located on a planet in the Vagadarr system that were actually dormant giants of living stone.

Paklarn was a planet in the Paklarn system in the Abaar sector of the Mid Rim Territories. During the Imperial Era, the smuggler Nevil Cygni set up an iridium smuggling operation on Paklarn that involved the mineral being hidden in grist mollusk shells.

A series of caves served as the village of the Old Ones, a tribe of mature humans on Vagadarr Prime in the Vagadarr system. The caves were located deep within the Great Mountain, the only mountain remaining of the Blue mountains by the time around 40 BBY.

headquarters: Old Ones' caves, Great Mountain, Blue mountains, Vagadarr Prime
x: The Old Ones were a tribe of mature humans who were the parents of the adolescent tribes of the Mud dwellers and Rockhawkers.

The Ancient Ones were an organization of humans from a planet in the Vagadarr system who were the ancestors of the Old Ones. The Old Ones were the parents of the two tribes known as the Mud dwellers and Rockhawkers.

The Shadow of the mountain was a region of a planet in the Vagadarr system that was the land surrounding the Great Mountain, the last mountain of a range of Blue mountains. The Shadow of the mountain was where the tribe of human adolescents known as the Rockhawkers resided.
Arane's partisans were a anti-Imperial group led by Arane Oreida.

Around 6 BBY, Jyn Erso undertook a solo mission to the planet Horuz with the goal of assassinating Imperial scientist Dorin Bell. Jyn suspected that Saw Gerrera had tasked her with the mission as a way to celebrate her fifteenth birthday.
In 6 BBY, the Partisans undertook a mission to the Mid Rim planet Inusagi. The Partisan leader Saw Gerrera had been hired by Arane Oreida for the mission.

A pirate faction enacted multiple raids upon the Trade Federation prior to the Invasion of Naboo in the Kellux system.

Chaleydonia, also known as the Crystal City, was the capital city of the planet Christophsis. It was a modern city made out of organic crystal construction. Count Dooku and Asajj Ventress had their final confrontation at a tower in the city.

Prior to the Invasion of Naboo, an altercation occurred on the city-moon Nar Shaddaa.

Kay-Tap square was a location on the planet Rodia. During the Clone Wars, Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi traveled to the square to stop the bounty hunter Cad Bane from kidnapping a Force-sensitive Rodian child named Wee Dunn.

The Flensor was an Arquitens-class light cruiser that served in the Imperial Navy and participated in the Batonn insurgency.

The Sempre was a Imperial troop carrier that was attacked by the frigate Castilus and two squadrons of V-19 Torrent starfighters.
The Marauder was a frigate once used by Q'anah's Marauders until Q'anah's demise at the hands of Wilhuff Tarkin.
The Castilus was a frigate that along with two squadrons of V-19 Torrent starfighters attacked the troop carrier Sempre.
A Gozanti-class cruiser was used as a ship by the Haddrex Gang until it was stolen by Cad Bane's group.

The Ahak Maharr were a tusked sentient species. They spoke a guttural, deep-pitched language. They had a traditional toast that, once translated into Galactic Basic Standard, meant "May we rend the flesh of our enemies, and drink their blood as we do this liquid before us."

HM-12 was a legal-analyst droid in service of the Galactic Empire. In 0 ABY, when Captain Iden Versio was court-martialed for treason, the droid was tasked with defending the accused as required by Imperial Navy law. Imperial Admiral Nasha Garvan represented the prosecution.

Vessel 4240-C was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle attached to the Imperial Star Destroyer Implacable. Lieutenant Commander Del Meeko, then chief engineer aboard the Implacable, used it to reach Imperial City upon being summoned by Admiral Garrick Versio of the Imperial Security Bu…
Arvaka Prime was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Arvaka Prime system Inner Rim Territories where Jaccun Pereez owned a mansion. Its people were said to be happy with Pereez's rule.

The Implacable was a Star Destroyer in service to the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. In 0 ABY, the vessel was commanded by Admiral Dayun, with Lieutenant Commander Del Meeko serving as chief engineer.
Level 5120 was one of the highest levels of the city-world of Coruscant. The Diplomat Hotel had one of its floors on that level.
The Voolukarians were a sentient species found in the galaxy. They worshiped a fertility god named Kuk'waibi.
The Keltrians were a sentient species from the Keltria system. A book called Ancient Keltrian Poets: Masters of Alliteration contained poetry that ancient Keltrians wrote.

Denash was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Batonn sector. During the Imperial Era, it was governed by Governor Wistran. The planet was home to an insurgent movement. During the Batonn sector insurgency, the Denash insurgents were defeated by Admiral Kinshara.

The Determination was a Star Destroyer in service to the Galactic Empire during its reign of the galaxy. Soon after the Battle of Yavin, the Star Destroyer was stationed in the Mid Rim, where it engaged and destroyed a small Rebel force.

Jeosyn was a planet in the Weneen sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It had an extremely slow rotation period, about three months, which meant that days and nights were unusually long and that both caused temperature extremes.
The Shadow Side was a location on the planet Jeosyn. The headquarters of the Dreamers was located in a cave system on the Shadow Side of Jeosyn.

Ezaraa was a planet that was the homeworld of the Ezaraa species. The Dominion of the Ezaraa, a group of Ezaraa who wished to overthrow the Galactic Empire and reign across the galaxy, were based on the planet, but the land they possessed was limited to only two continents.
Onderonians were a cultural group of human natives who called the Inner Rim jungle planet Onderon, their homeworld.

The Coruscant Traffic Violation Bureau was a Galactic Republic agency which dealt with traffic violations on the Republic capital planet Coruscant.

The Republic Ministry of Economic Development was a Galactic Republic agency. Eleven Star Marketing launched a campaign on the Ministry's behalf, developing various imagery such as the poster Settle the Outer Rim designed to urge individuals to explore the galaxy.
Svaaha was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Svaaha system within the Core Worlds and the Interior. It was situated on grid square K-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Lothalites, also called Lothalians, were a cultural group of humans native to the Outer Rim planet Lothal. Most had a copper sheen to their skin, as exemplified by Ezra Bridger, Ryder Azadi, and Morad Sumar.

The Royal Nothoiin Constabulary was the local police force on Nothoiin. After the disappearance of the bounty hunter Zatch during the ambush of the Goldskin Parade, the Royal Nothoiin Constabulary believed that Zatch could still be at large, likely armed and dangerous.

The RHA Consonance was a Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette in the Alliance Fleet that participated in the Battle of Scarif. It survived the battle and escaped seconds before the arrival of the Devastator.

Pammur was the southernmost continent of the planet Affadar. It was covered in forests, rivers and mountains. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, the Galactic Empire began to mine Pammur for minerals that it wanted.
Jinata Security, also known as J-Sec, was a law enforcement agency based on the planet Vardos in the Core Worlds during the reign of the Galactic Empire, with which J-Sec was allied.

The Force Builders were an ancient Force-sensitive order who were an offshoot of the Jedi. They were devoted to creating the finest art, architecture, and starships. The Force Builders built the city of Alistan Nor on a remote jungle planet.

Courtsilius was one of the five planets that orbited the sun of the Hosnian system, in the Core region of the galaxy. Large hexagonal and circular city structures covered significant swathes of the planet, and glowed red and blue from orbit.

Cardota, also known as Hosnian Cardota, was one of the five planets that made up the Hosnian system, in the Core region of the galaxy. The system, including Cardota, was destroyed by the First Order in 34 ABY.
Raysho was one of five planets that orbited the same sun, making up the Hosnian system, in the Core region of the galaxy. The system, including Raysho, was destroyed by the First Order in 34 ABY.

The Shad Furies were a sports team that were based on Shad during the Imperial Era. In 4 BBY, a news broadcast reported that the Galactic League commissioner was reviewing a big proposed trade between the Shad Furies and the Eriadu Patriots.

Prairie-fowl were a species of birds that lived on the planet Lothal. They were grown for their meat. Merei Spanjaf once bought prairie-fowl breasts and tubers home for her mother Jessa Spanjaf to prepare for dinner.
Janus Kasmir's crew was a crew led by the smuggler Janus Kasmir during the Clone Wars and Imperial Era that consisted of him and Caleb Dume.
R4-C4 was an R4 astromech droid that served during the Clone Wars.

The Carpastor Comet Swarm was an astronomical phenomenon located in the Carpastor system of the Rolion sector, a part of the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated along the Salin Corridor hyperspace route.
An aquatic species was native to an ocean planet that Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa crashed on after the mission to Ktath'atn.
Am'balaar City was a city located on the river moon of Al'doleem. The city was destroyed when Darth Vader burst the local dam, resulting in the entire city being flooded.

Lund Berlo was a dangerous city on the Mid Rim planet of Durkteel.

This moon was the outermost of the three moons in orbit of the planet Ryloth. The Twi'lek holiday known as Longest Night occurred when this moon and the two other moons of Ryloth were at their lowest phase.
Ryloth's third moon, also known as its Third Moon, was the third moon in orbit of the planet Ryloth. A desolate, rocky moon with a breathable atmosphere, it was the closest of Ryloth's three moons.

The northern continent of the planet Vallt was able to be powered by the planet's fusion plant.

Republic Naval Intelligence was an intelligence service of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. The chief of naval intelligence attended a meeting about the construction of a secret battle station in the Republic Center for Military Operations on the planet Coruscant.

Vakharon was an astronomical object. During the Galactic Civil War, Darth Vader oversaw a mining operation on Vakharon for what were thought to be kyber crystals, which would power the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station.

The Falfa was the personal Rainhawk-class transport of Baron Notluwiski Papanoida of the Pantoran Assembly. During the Clone Wars Papanoida and his son Ion used the ship to rescue his daughter Che Amanwe Papanoida who was being held hostage by the Trade Federation on Tatooine.
The Canto Bight Police Department (CBPD), also known simply as Canto police, was the law enforcement of the casino city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Cantonica was a desert planet in the Cantonica system within the Corporate Sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. The planet was home to the casino city Canto Bight, which was a destination for wealthy tourists, gamblers, and war profiteers.

In 4 ABY, the Freemakers undertook a mission to obtain Kyber crystals from the planet Qalydon. During their mission, they encountered a Lurmen village and befriended the locals. Imperial forces under Durpin and Plumestriker stole the villagers' kyber crystals.

A small moon was located in the galaxy's Mid Rim. An extract from a creature that lived on the moon was used used as a mild anaesthetic by the natives of the moon. The First Order Commander Malarus used it to promote body mass growth and to stimulate intelligence.
The Propaganda Bureau was a department of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Civil Government, which rose in the wake of the Galactic Civil War. It was headed by the artist Janyor of Bith.

An extract from a creature that lived on moon in the galaxy's Mid Rim was used as a mild anaesthetic by the natives of the moon. The First Order Commander Malarus used it to promote body mass growth and to stimulate intelligence.

The Swift Market was a marketplace located in Pinyumb, the capital city of the planet Sullust. In 3 ABY, after the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry captured the Inyusu Tor mineral processing facility near the city, Pinyumb was put on lockdown by the Galactic Empire.

result: Darth Vader takes the Rur crystal
x: A skirmish broke out aboard the Sorca Retreat after Eternal Rur took control of a droid during an auction held by the archaeologist doctor Aphra.
Sarini Island was an island located on the planet Chandrila. It featured a zoo. In 5 ABY, Brentin, Temmin, and Norra Wexley arrived in Sarini Island to visit its zoo.
Lanais were an avian sentient species who lived on Temple Island on the ocean planet of Ahch-To for thousands of years.
A zoo was located in Sarini Island, on the planet Chandrila. It featured pangorins, caw-crabs and uralangs. In 5 ABY, Brentin, Temmin, and Norra Wexley visited the zoo.

objective: Enlist the help of the Master Codebreaker
x: The mission to Canto Bight, also referred to as the mission to Cantonica, was undertaken by the Resistance members Finn, Rose Tico, and BB-8 during the Resistance's war with the First Order.
A wholesale food market was located in Capital City on the planet Lothal.

Caw-crabs were a type of crab that could be found in the Sarini Island zoo on the Core Worlds planet Chandrila. During a visit to the zoo in 5 ABY, Brentin, Temmin, and Norra Wexley saw several caw-crabs scuttling and splashing around in their enclosures.
The Lothal Imperial Spaceport Authority was responsible for the Capital City spaceport on the planet Lothal in 5 BBY.
Shadow Market was a market located in Cloud City on the planet Bespin.

x: In 4 ABY, Rowan Freemaker was captured by Darth Vader. After the Freemakers completed the quest to build the Arrowhead starship, the Rebel Alliance used the ship to inflict damage on Imperial forces.

t: Mission to obtain a Kyber crystal
x: In 4 ABY, the Freemakers undertook a mission to obtain a Kyber crystal from Baird Kantoo's planet.

Charros IV was a planet in the Mid Rim Territories' Numesira sector. It was the site of the Xi Char Cathedral factories, where members of the Xi Charrian species produced the Vulture-class starfighter "vulture droid." During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance was force…
This moon was the third in orbit of Jaatovi. It was the homeworld of Ambassador Oaan.

Genassa was a Mid Rim Territories celestial body. At some point by 3 ABY, a rebel insurgency group planned to attack an envoy of the Galactic Empire in Genassa's name. That year, however, the group was arrested on Genassa, a fact that was reported on by HoloNet News.
Fornax was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Mid Rim, in grid square K-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
Enarc was an astronomical object located in the Enarc system in the Alui sector of the Mid Rim Territories and the Trailing Sectors.
When Gideon Hask was ten years old, a rebel infiltrator instigated a bombing at the planet Kuat's shipyards. The parents of Hask were killed during the blast, leaving him orphaned.
Pamarthen lions were a type of lion that lived on the planet Pamarthe. During the Gauntlet, Greer Sonnel noted that some racers followed behind her like crows trailing Pamarthen lions.

Bay Three was a docking bay in Niima Outpost on the planet Jakku. When the scavenger Rey took BB-8 to Niima Outpost, she told the droid there was a trader in Bay Three named Horvins who may have been willing to give BB-8 a lift offworld.
Lahsbane was a planet located in the Lahsbane system in the Onatos sector in the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice, and was situated in grid square R-15 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
Tynna was a planet in the Expansion Region that was placed along the Shipwrights' Trace hyperspace route and was home to the aquatic, sentient Tynnan species.

objective: Uncover proof that Senator Bezz Drexx took bribes from the Confederacy
x: Suspecting that Senator Bezz Drexx was taking bribes from the Confederacy of Independent Systems
The Absolution was a Resurgent-class Star Destroyer in the Navy of the First Order that Captain Cardinal interrogated a Resistance spy, Vi Moradi, for information about Captain Phasma's past aboard.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
Rowan Freemaker is rescued from the Empire

x: Four years after the Battle of Yavin, the Freemakers staged a mission to rescue Rowan Freemaker. The Imperial hunter droid M-OC and Darth Vader lured Rowan into a trap on the planet Qalydon.

Iskalon was a planet located in the Iskalon system in the Trans-Nebular sector of the Mid Rim. The pirate Queen Maz Kanata hid a portion of the spoils from her reign there in a buried vault equipped with a antitamper sub-space alarm.

Kalarba was a planet located in the Kalarba system in the Hevvrol sector of the Mid Rim. It was orbited by multiple moons, including one that had the Imperial space station Hosk Station built entirely around its surface.
Ord Pardron was an astronomical object located in the Mid Rim Territories that was a safe world for Senator Mon Mothma's organized rebellion against the Galactic Empire by 2 BBY.
Kwenn was a planet located in the Mid Rim and the Slice. The Kwenn Space Station was situated above the planet.

The Silencer was a Resurgent-class Star Destroyer in service to the navy of the First Order that was sent along with Captain Phasma to patrol a hyperspace transit point between the Unknown Regions and the Core Worlds.
A rebel cell was established by Senator Mon Mothma of Chandrila. Mothma worked alongside Luthen Rael to establish an intelligence and rebel network, which she also helped fund.

Thala-sirens were large pinnipeds, found on the planet Ahch-To, among other watery worlds. Characterized by their udders, large flippers, and long snout, they were found basking on the cliffs of the sacred Temple Island, the site of the first Jedi Temple, when Rey traveled to …
Mon Gazza was a Mid Rim Territories planet located on both the Corellian Run and the Llanic Spice Run. It was the site of spice mining and trading.

result: The Sith are driven off Coruscant.
The Jedi destroy the Sith shrine on Coruscant.
x: During a war against the Jedi Order, the Sith took control of the planet Coruscant, capital world of the Galactic Republic. During their occupation the Sith constructed a shrine over a sacred spire, a powerful light side vergence on the planet.

Osk-Trill was an astronomical object whose name was comprised of two letters in the Aurebesh writing system. It was located in the Osk-Trill system within the Core Worlds, and was situated in grid square M-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Appenza Peak was the most famous snow-capped mountain on the planet Alderaan, visible from the capital Aldera. Although it was not Alderaan's highest mountain, its silhouette featured on the flag of the capital region.
The Day of Demand was a day on which the heir to the throne of the planet Alderaan would claim their right to the throne. It was held on the sixteenth anniversary of the individual's Name Day.
The Day of Demand for Leia Organa was a ceremony held on the sixteenth anniversary of her original Name Day, where she demanded her right to the throne of Alderaan.
WA-2V, also known as 2V or TooVee, was the personal attendant droid of Princess Leia Organa. She had bluish fingers, a roll ball for movement and a stiff apron that passed for her hips.

The Gotal Assembly for Separation was a political party on the Gotal homeworld of Antar 4 that advocated joining the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Separatist Crisis. The Roshu Sune was a radical splinter group of the Assembly.
Sometime before or between 25,000 BBY and 22,000 BBY, the Gotals of Antar 4 established a colony on the Dead Moon of Antar.

In 4 ABY, Alliance to Restore the Republic launched an assault near Alzoc III. Reviewing Imperial repair schedules, Kordi Freemaker discovered that an entire Imperial fleet was converging at a repair deport near Alzoc III.

In 4 ABY, a skirmish between the Freemakers, Quarrie and the Imperial hunter droid M-OC took place on Shantipole. With M-OC seeking to destroy the Freemakers, Rowan convinced his family to lure the hunter droid into a trap on the stormy planet of Shantipole.

Wormstew Town was a town on the Smuggler's Moon of Nar Shaddaa. The human Sana Starros grew up in the town. The outfit known as Jega's Squad operated out of Jega's Music Hall and Petting Zoo, which was located in Wormstew Town.
Spalex was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that contained a massive vein of thorilide.
Jaelen was a peaceful planet in the galaxy. In 34 ABY, on the orders of Agent Terex, the First Order was using civilian transports to smuggle arms from the Outer Rim to planets like Jaelen.

Otoh Langua, also known as Langua, was a small Gungan city on the planet Naboo. During the Invasion of Naboo by the Trade Federation in 32 BBY, Otoh Langua was one of several Gungan settlements attacked by the Trade Federation Droid Army.
Silichordates were a type of worm. Dobias Cole-Truten made a living on Jedha by trapping and selling sillichordate worms that other vendors would turn into meals.

The Sliver was a city on the planet Kaddak. It was considered to be a haunt for criminals including pick-pockets and murderers. The Sliver was dominated by the Ranc Gang. It had at least two levels including Level 72 and Level 45. Level 72 was home to a cantina and a spaceport.
The Coruscant mines were mining facilities located on the planet Coruscant.
The Circle Bay mayor's office was located in Circle Bay on Nubia.

Molemen were a species of diminutive, naturally blind humanoids with white skin. In 22 BBY, when the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker confronted Zam Wesell in the Outlander Club on Coruscant, three molemen were being escorted by a tour guide to the club's Digisee gamin…

Finish assembling the Arrowhead.
x: In 4 ABY, The Freemakers went on a mission to save the Alliance Fleet from being destroyed by the Galactic Empire.

In 4 ABY, a skirmish took place on the planet Kashyyyk between the Alliance to Restore the Republic, their Wookiee allies, and the Galactic Empire. The Freemakers helped to change the tide of the battle by using the Arrowhead to destroy their AT-AT and AT-ST walkers.

t: Assault on an Imperial Assault Carrier
x: Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the Rebel Alliance launched an assault on an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser and its escort of TIE fighters. A scavenging family known as the Freemakers picked up wreckage resulting from the skirmish in their starship, the StarScavenger.
Skye was a small terrestrial planet located in the Marat system of the Varada sector, within the Outer Rim and the Western Reaches.
Ziost was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories in grid square R-4 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was one of the noteworthy worlds of the ancient Sith.

Bartanish Four Sector, often shortened to Bash Four, was a sector located on the planet Coruscant. It housed a supplementary citizen assistance office opened by Senator Domus Renking of Lothal. It held many apartments and businesses, including a Dojo.

The Spalexians were a sentient species were native to the planet Spalex. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Empire attempted to mine Spalex for its thorilide but were met with strong resistance from the native species.

Heap Nine was a junker world in the Expansion Region's Boeus sector where scavengers picked at the remnants of a long-dead civilization. In 3 ABY, the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry took a rest stop at the world during its own campaign.

Rotoga was an astronomical object in the Rotoga system in the Alchenaut sector of the Expansion Region, in grid square L-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Aaston Lok was better known as "the Skull Crusher of Rotoga."
Shaak Ridge was a long, narrow row of hills located on the Great Grass Plains on the planet Naboo, south of Theed.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: The Imperial Office of Customs, also known simply as Imperial Customs, was a division of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order that ensured all importers and exporters operated in full compliance with the Galactic Empire's laws and regulations.

Level 72 was a district on the Outer Rim world of Kaddak's settlement, the Sliver. Level 72 hosted a cantina that was frequented by the Ranc Gang. Level 72 also hosted docking facilities for ships such as Agent Terex's flagship Carrion Spike.
Level 45 was a district in the Sliver, a settlement on the planet Kaddak. It was home to a cantina that was frequented by various groups including Kanjiklub and the Guavian Death Gang.
Parnassos was a desolate planet located in the galaxy's Unknown Regions that was the homeworld of Phasma. Formerly lush and green, Parnassos had been colonized by the Con Star Mining Corporation.

objective: Uncover the identity of the traitor and secure the adegan crystals
x: The Crisis on Umbara was an event that took place after the beginning of the War on Iokath. To infiltrate the Order of Zildrog, Theron Shan staged his defection the Eternal Alliance, setting a trap for his friends on Umbara.
Yoda's Jedi interceptor was an Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor used by Jedi Master Yoda during the Clone Wars.

D8-40 was a droid with a male programming who resided in the Anoat sector at the time of the Iron Blockade. A lover of romantic literature and tragic holo stories, he was also one of the best (and most unusual) safecrackers in the galaxy.

Harvest Hissrich's flora for their power
x: The operation on Hissrich was launched by the Confederacy of Independent Systems on Hissrich early in the Clone Wars.

The Scyre territory was the living area of the Scyre clan on the planet Parnassos. The territory consisted of mostly spires of black rock, cliffs, ledges, and caves, bordered on one side by a sea and the other by Claw territory.

Almec's office was an office that was used by Prime Minister Almec in Sundari on the planet Mandalore during the Clone Wars. It was nearly identical to Duchess Satine Kryze's throne room, but with darker lighting.
Ponta Two was a T-16 skyhopper owned by Akshaya Ponta. The planet hopper eventually landed in the care of Jyn Erso.

x: The battle for Jedha occurred on the holy moon after a group of rebels led by Princess Leia Organa participated in a mission to Jedha during the Galactic Civil War. They attempted to make contact with the surviving members of Saw Gerrera's Partisans.
The catacombs of Akiva were located beneath Myrra on the jungle planet Akiva. The Confederacy of Independent Systems utilized a droid factory in the catacombs during the Clone Wars.

The Fast Friend was a starship owned and captained by the Devaronian smuggler, Kurjak. In 0 ABY, Kurjak was hired by Del Meeko and Gideon Hask, members of Inferno Squad who were posing as brothers, to deliver them and a container to Eriadu.

Resistance Intelligence was a branch of the Resistance responsible for obtaining and analyzing information about the First Order and reporting such information to General Leia Organa, head of the Resistance.

A village of Tusken Raiders was located on the desert planet Tatooine. Whilst on the planet negotiating a deal for the Galactic Empire with Jabba the Hutt, Darth Vader slaughtered the members of the village.
Nafens were a species of nocturnal flying insect that frequently carried diseases.
Nectarsects were a species of insect that consumed nectar.
The Naboo Wastelands was a barren area on the planet Naboo.
New Marketplace was a commercial district in Talos on the planet Atzerri. Inside Talos, it was located in the second-tier outer districts.
The North Beach was a region of an island on the Rakatan homeworld that was controlled by The One's forces.
Nova Level was an upper level of the city on Coruscant.
Circle Bay was a location on Nubia. A protest took place at the Circle Bay mayor's office during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

A protest occurred at the Circle Bay mayor's office on Nubia during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Colonel Wullf Yularen and Captain Thrawn investigated the protest and found it particularly unique, deducing that their nemesis Nightswan might be targeting Imperial governmen…

The Deviant was a starship in the Alliance Fleet. In 1 BBY, the Deviant fought in the Battle of Scarif, where it and the Heartbound were ordered by Admiral Raddus to box in the Imperial Star Destroyers.

Dolo-fish were a type of fish. After being informed by Fleet Admiral Gallius Rax that portions of the Imperial Navy had been hidden since the Battle of Endor, Grand Admiral Rae Sloane felt gutted like a dolo-fish.
Firebirds were a type of bird. Several Wookiees had the sigil of a firebird on their arm.
Tik-tak birds were a type of bird that could be found on the planet Naboo.
Wrosha-grubs were fat plump worms whose skin popped when they were bitten. Grand Moff Lozen Tolruck

A canary moth was a type of moth that had wings. While on the Core Worlds planet Chandrila in 5 ABY, the pilot Wedge Antilles walked through a spaceport to meet with his colleague, the pilot Norra Wexley.
Taka-teys were a type of gold feathered bird that could be found on the planet Devaron.
The Westwind was a T-6 shuttle piloted by Rissa Mano to transport a squad of Jedi to the Outer Rim planet Hissrich during the early stages of the Clone Wars.

result: Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi liberated from Imperial custody
x: At some point following the rescue of Luke Skywalker, forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic liberated Grakkus the Hutt from Imperial custody when they intercepted his prison transport vessel.
Targons were a species of giant cats that possessed thick fur, tufted ears, four eyes, and tufted tails. Despite being a predator species, they had low-level empathic abilities.

Thrinaka was an island on the aquatic planet Sesid. Like most of the islands on the planet, Thrinaka was a popular tourist destination. A group of rebels led by Leia Organa met with a Draedan contact called Aurelant on the island during Operation Yellow Moon.
R3-B0017 was an R3-series astromech droid that was programmed to scavenge the planet Dathomir and serve the Dathomirian Zabrak Darth Maul. The droid was equipped with green durasteel plating.

First Order stormtrooper executioners, also known as First Order Judicial Stormtroopers, First Order Executioners, or simply executioner stormtroopers, were First Order stormtroopers randomly selected from existing ranks and assigned to enact the death penalty on enemies and t…

The Supremacy, disparagingly nicknamed "Snoke's Boudoir," was a Mega-class Star Dreadnought that served as the flagship of Supreme Leader Snoke and the mobile capital of the First Order from within the Unknown Regions of the galaxy.

The Raddus, formerly known as the Dawn of Tranquility, was an MC85 Star Cruiser that served as the flagship of General Leia Organa. It was used by the Resistance during its war against the First Order.

Parnassos beetle was a species of golden-colored, poisonous beetle native to the planet Parnassos. Its venom had the capability to liquefy a victim's insides completely. Captain Phasma used one of these beetles to kill Brendol Hux.

2BB-2 was a blue-plated BB-series astromech droid with masculine programming in the service of the Resistance. The droid was present aboard the MC85 Star Cruiser Raddus during the evacuation of the Resistance base on the planet D'Qar in 34 ABY.
Gill-goats were a type of goat. Sinjir Rath Velus once called Jom Barell a gill-goat.
Level Six was located on the First Order's superweapon Starkiller Base. After being dumped into a garbage chute by Han Solo, Finn and Chewbacca, Captain Phasma exited the chute at level six.

BB-4 was a khaki-plated BB-series astromech droid in the service of the Resistance. Similarly to 2BB-2, another BB unit in the service of the Resistance, the droid's sensor was not fully encased in his head. BB-4 also had a Resistance crest on his body.
R4-X2 was a green R4 astromech droid operating during the First Order-Resistance War. It served on board the main cruiser of the Resistance.
Y5-X2 was a green R5 unit operating during the First Order-Resistance War. It served on board the main cruiser of the Resistance.

objective: Rescue Ketsu Onyo
x: In 2 BBY, Hera Syndulla, Garazeb Orrelios and Rex staged a mission to rescue Ketsu Onyo from Tolteck.

The Crystal forest was a forest on the planet Christophsis. During a pilgrimage to return kyber crystals back to where they came from, a group of Church of the Force members passed through the crystal forest.

Derella was an astronomical object located in the Derella system of the Core Worlds, situated in grid square M-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of Senator Cinderon Malpe, who represented it in the Imperial Senate of the Galactic Empire.
In the years between the Battle of Naboo and the Clone Wars, spice miners on the moons of Naboo repeatedly went on strike for larger shares of the profits.
The Strike on Onoam was a bombing orchestrated by Saw Gerrera's Partisans on Onoam to assassinate Imperial Moff Quarsh Panaka in 3 BBY.
The River Wuitho was a river on Alderaan. It could be seen from the south terrace of the Royal Family's palace in Aldera.

Chal Hudda was a marsh-covered planet of the Outer Rim Territories that had a soupy green atmosphere. Because its natural resources held use for almost no life-forms except the native Chalhuddans, that world was of interest to virtually no one else.

The Istabith Falls were waterfalls located on the Core Worlds planet Alderaan that shared their name with the Istabith range, a mountain range on the same world. During her youth, the Alderaanian Princess Leia Organa visited the waterfalls to relax.

Onoam was a moon of the Mid Rim planet Naboo, located in the Chommell sector and the Trailing Sectors. Its grassy plains housed second homes for wealthy citizens of Naboo while miners extracted medicinal spice underneath the surface.

At least one hundred years before 24 ABY during the High Republic Era, the planet Parnassos was devastated by a nuclear calamity. The Con Star Mining Corporation abandoned the planet and its population, who were reduced to a post-apocalyptic existence.
The Claw territory was the living area of the Claw clan on the planet Parnassos. The territory had a plateau which was big enough for their entire clan to sleep on.
A plateau was located in the territory owned by the Claw clan on the planet Parnassos. It was big enough for all the members of the Claw to sleep on.
A cardinal was a type of red bird that Cardinal, formerly designated CD-0922, was named after by Brendol Hux.

U5-GG, also known as Gigi, was a U5 astromech droid who served the Resistance. Gigi was assigned to the spy Vi Moradi. The two were captured in a starhopper by the First Order, and Moradi wiped U5-GG's memory before stormtroopers could access any data.
Crickets were a type of insect that could be found on the planets Jakku and Dalna. First Order Captain Cardinal felt he was lucky if he was able to see a nest of crickets whilst living on Jakku.
Keresia was an astronomical object located within the Keresia system, a part of the Demetras sector within the Outer Rim Territories and Trans-Hydian regions of the galaxy.
The Committee for Imperial Reallocation was an organization within the New Republic. The Ithorian senator Oko-Po was present on the committee.
The Chalhuddan were a sentient species native to the Outer Rim planet Chal Hudda. They had two horn-like protrusions on their heads and five distinct genders.

Skinwolves were the name given to a set of wolves that lived on the planet Parnassos. While helping General Brendol Hux back to his ship, three Scyre warriors led by Phasma and three First Order stormtroopers fought a group of skinwolves in a desert.

F3-ZK, also known as Fez, was a large loading droid with a gentle personality. One day in 34 ABY, he came to Jakku aboard a droid ship set to scout the planet. However, while exploring the desert of Jakku, Fez fell into a trapping pit set by the local scavenger Teedo.

The Polestar was the Royal House of Alderaan's royal yacht. When Princess Leia Organa visited Coruscant for the first time in 5 BBY whilst serving as her father Bail Organa's intern, they flew to Coruscant on the Polestar.
A yacht was once owned by Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine. It was Palpatine's favorite yacht on Naboo and was utilized on Coruscant at least once for a visit to the Jedi Temple.
The Nashtah Bite was a Victory-class Star Destroyer in Warlord Zsinj's third fleet.
The NightRunner was a Ghtroc 720 light freighter used by Bazak's Gang.
The Istabith range was a mountain range on Core Worlds planet Alderaan. The range shared its name with the Istabith Falls, waterfalls located on the same world.
Mines were located in Terpsichore Station on the planet Parnassos.
Fillithar was a planet in the galaxy that was the homeworld of the snake-like Fillithar species. Twenty years into the reign of the New Republic, it was represented in the Galactic Senate.
A mine was located on the moon Onoam. In 3 BBY, Princess Leia Organa of Alderaan
A warehouse was located on the planet Naboo. It was burned by miners during strikes they undertook.
The moon that orbited the planet where Baird Kantoo built the Kyber Saber was accidentally destroyed by the Jedi Master while testing the newly constructed weapon.

A planet was where Baird Kantoo built the Kyber Saber. It was orbited by a moon which Kantoo accidentally destroyed while testing the newly constructed weapon, and was also known to be rich in kyber crystals.

Paucris Major was a planet located in the Paucris system. In 3 BBY, Princess Leia Organa traveled to Paucris Major, discovering a fleet of battleships and transports being refurbished in the planet's orbit.
During his time as a pilot for the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later the Resistance, the Duros L'ulo L'ampar used an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor as his mode of transportation.

The attack on Calderos was carried out in 3 BBY by the rebellion on Calderos Station, an Imperial space station and deep-space waypoint. It was carried out to conceal rebel shipping to an outpost on the planet Crait.
Kath hounds were a fierce canine species of pack hunters found on the planet Dantooine that could be leashed. They were about one meter in height and had cloven hooves, thick fur and strong jaws.

A razorwolf was a type of wolf that resided on the Inner Rim planet Jakku. In 33 ABY, the human Rey was scavenging inside a starship on Jakku. Rey sensed danger when she heard a creak but was unsure if a razorwolf or another scavenger was on the ship with her.
A dune-rat was a type of rat that lived in warrens in deserts.
The Rivoche Ranges were a mountain range on the Outer Rim planet Eriadu. At some point, the planet's native Imperial Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin learned about the range.

Boonta was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in grid square S-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid, that was connected to Bimmisaari, Junkfort Station, Klatooine, Sriluur, and Sy Myrth by hyperspace routes.

objective: Hunt down and kill Lieutenant Sol Rivas
x: The hunt for Rivas was undertaken by Captain Phasma, the First Order TIE fighter pilot TN-3465, and the BB unit BB-K8 to hunt down Lieutenant Sol Rivas for his alleged "treason" against the First Order.
BB-00, nicknamed Boo, was a BB-series astromech droid that belonged to the cartographer Emil Graf. The droid helped keep their scout ship Star Herald operational.

The Urodel were sentient amphibians. Bollie Prindel and Vetch were members of this species, as was an individual present in CoCo Town on the planet Coruscant. Nooa was an Urodel who trained as a Jedi Padawan during the High Republic Era.

Level Two was located on Starkiller Base. After framing Lieutenant Sol Rivas for the lowering of Starkiller Base's shields, Captain Phasma first spotted Rivas on the south platform of Level Two and attempted to detain him but failed to do so due to continuous explosions throug…
Kai Pompos was a town located on the planet Irudiru.
A small uninhabited planet was located in the Sunshi system. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Empire discovered kyber crystals on the planet and mined them out.

The Nautilus was a cave located within the territory owned by the Scyre warrior clan on the planet Parnassos. Before the clan lived in the Nautilus, it was the ancestral home of a family that the human female Phasma and her brother Keldo were part of.
Ten-21 was a CZ-series secretary/business communications droid that was part of Tonk's crew.

The Resistance High Command, also known as Resistance command, was the leadership of the Resistance during its conflict and subsequent war with the First Order. It comprised a mixture of Rebel Alliance veterans, ex-leaders of independent defense forces and New Republic converts.
Sisofish was a type of fish that lived in the galaxy. In a contest held at the castle of Maz Kanata, Damor Gregon served a dish consisting of fried sisofish with citrus salad.
Albeks were a highly aggressive and territorial Force-sensitive species of reptile found on many worlds throughout the galaxy.
