x: The theft of the prototype TIE Defender Elite was carried out during the Galactic Civil War by the Spectres of the Alliance to Restore the Republic on Lothal around 1 BBY.
TB-3 was a protocol droid stationed on the isolated planet Parnassos who worked at Terpsichore Station, a mining facility utilized by the Con Star Mining Corporation.

D473 was a droid who worked at Terpsichore Station, a mining facility on the planet Parnassos that belonged to the Con Star Mining Corporation. His task was to assign adequate tasks to new laborers according to their skills, which were determined in tests.

objective: Obtain supplies for the Rebel Alliance
x: During the Imperial Era, the rebellion sent Captain Cassian Andor and the KX-series security droid K-2SO on a mission to raid an Imperial freighter in the F'tzner system.

objective: Determine if Crait is suitable for a Rebel base
x: During the Galactic Civil War, the Alliance to Restore the Republic sent Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa on a mission to the mineral planet Crait to scout it as a possible rebel base.
R4-M9 was an R4 astromech that was a part of the Galactic Empire. It was aboard the Tantive IV after it was disabled in orbit of the planet Tatooine.

In 3 BBY, Ezra Bridger, Sabine Wren, Kanan Jarrus, Garazeb Orrelios, and Wullffwarro undertook a mission to save Kitwarr in a forest on the planet Oliu. After a hard rain storm, Kitwarr was eventually found by the crew.

Kufs, also known as the ghost moon, was a mysterious moon that orbited the planet Vodran, though it was invisible to most scanners. After escaping the planet Vodran, Dec Hansen and Sari Nadle landed on Kufs. Nykkalt was a type of rare metal that flowed beneath Kufs' surface.
Squeeps were a type of bird which could be found on the desolate planet Parnassos. They were small, pretty birds that fed of the nectar of plants.
The Craygalon Marauders was a group of marauders that came from Snowdn-4.

Snowdn-4 was an astronomical object where the Craygalon Marauders were from. It was located in the Snowdn system in the Centrality, a sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square U-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Cole-Haddon was a terrestrial astronomical object that was known to be inhospitable. It was located in the Cole-Haddon system in the Dalonbian sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Hreeshi was a terrestrial astronomical object known to be pretty and nice. It was located far from Endor, in the Hreeshi system in the Kalamith sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Galgardi Syndicate was a criminal syndicate organization.
Corson Prime was a location in the Tharin sector within the Outer Rim Territories.

This protocol droid was a protocol droid that served at the Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory, a droid factory located on a planet close to the Coruscant system. During the Clone Wars, this protocol droid welcomed Obi-Wan Kenobi upon his arrival on the planet.
A bunker was located on the mysterious moon Kufs.
Teacher's cabin was a school located on the planet Ques.
Command Sector North was an area along the equatorial trench within the second Death Star.

t: Raid on a suspected rebel cell
x: Around 1 BBY, the Imperial Security Bureau had undertook a raid on a suspected rebel cell on the planet Lothal. During the raid, Old Jho, an Ithorian male, attempted to help the cell escape but was caught by the ISB and later executed.
Following the Battle of Endor, Moff Delurin declared himself Warlord of Wild Space and set about creating his own empire in the frontier regions of Wild Space.
A creature that had black eyes, and had gray skin, and was native to the moon Charissia.

Daalang was an astronomical object located in the Daalang system in the Daalang sector of the Mid Rim. It was situated at the nexus of the Gamor Run, the Trax Tube, and a hyperlane extending south to Bothawui.

Herdessa was an astronomical object located in the Mid Rim Territories along the Corellian Run. The Galactic Republic blockaded it during the Clone Wars, and Senator Shea Sadashassa represented the celestial body in the Republic Senate and later the Imperial Senate.

Lorta was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Lorta system in the Gendius sector of the Mid Rim Territories. In 382 BBY, Axel Greylark arrived on Lorta, where he ran into and had to quickly escape a former business partner.

Null was an astronomical object located in the Null system of the Trans-Vulta sector within the Mid Rim and the New Territories in square N-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The whisper bird, a species of bird native to the Outer Rim moon Yavin 4, could also be found on Null.

Radnor was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Radnor system in the Daimar sector of the Mid Rim Territories along the Corellian Run. Colonel Brierly Ronan briefly considered dropping off an Imperial Security Bureau Agent there while Ronan himself ventured on to Scarif.
The Bad was a location in the stronghold owed by Harra the Hutt on the planet Vodran.

Lew'elans were a cultural group of humans native to the aquatic planet Lew'el. They originated from settlers who came to the world a long time ago and named the planet Lew'el, which means "deluge." The people of Lew'el lived by the sea, which provided everything they needed.

Lew'el, which meant deluge, was an aquatic planet located in the Wild Space of the galaxy. Originally settled by humans a long time ago, Lew'el remained a largely forgotten world by those who craved power. Humans native to Lew'el were called Lew'elans.
The Tectozin were a sentient species native to the planet The Deep. They had stalked eyes and retractable talon fingers. U'rum was a member of this species.
The Fold was a location in the stronghold owed by Harra the Hutt on the planet Vodran.
The Garage was a location in the stronghold owed by Harra the Hutt, on the planet Vodran.

Droideka Alpha was a droideka that survived the Clone Wars and was later reprogrammed to serve in IG-88's Droid Army during the Galactic Civil War. It was part of a group of droids led by IG-88 to start a Droid Revolution, which was destroyed in 4 ABY.

The Anlari were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They had fleshy horns on their heads that could curl and twist, and those that belonged to younger individuals were only as long as a human finger. G'kolu was a member of this species.
At some point the astromech droid R2-D2 was rescued by Luke Skywalker from the Deep, a planet in the Unknown Regions.
Agoliba-Ado was a jungle planet located in the Agoliba-Tu system.
Agoliba-Ena was an icy, snowbound planet located in the Agoliba-Tu system.
Kor Vella was a city on the planet Corellia. Cassian Jeron Andor wore a Corellian-cut khaki field jacket that was popular in shops in Kor Vella.
Monastery was a planet located in the Monastery system in the Haserian sector of Mid Rim, in grid square Q-16 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
Paralytic shellfish were a type of shellfish that could be found in the oceans of an ocean planet. Their toxin was dangerous to most living species.
Ulon Ipo-Lito was a location on the planet Lew'el. It was thought to have been the remains of a sunken island.
The Deep was a planet located in the Unknown Regions with a barren and lifeless surface. At some point, Luke Skywalker traveled to the Deep to rescue R2-D2 from a mining complex.
A mining complex was located on the Deep, a planet in the Unknown Regions.

Touksingal was a planet located in the galaxy where the dissertation advisor of a female biologist once traveled. During their time on Touksingal, the advisor lost an arm to a group of bloodthirsty bat-like predators that hunted in swarms.

Cro-Akon was a world located in the Thuldin's Grant sector within the Expansion Region of the galaxy. Prior to being taken to the Deep in the Unknown Regions, a Z7 series construction droid was part of a crew that built a settlement in the tundra of Cro-Akon.

Tanto Winn was an astronomical object whose inhabitants all had green eyes. It was located in the Tanto Winn system in the Alui sector of the Mid Rim Territories, and was the homeworld of Jane, a girl who traveled aboard the Wayward Current on its journey to Canto Bight.
The Wayward Current was a transport barge that at some point undertook a week journey from the Mooshie Cluster to Canto Bight captained by Tuuma the Hutt.
Mole-fleas were a sentient species native to the planet Kowak. Lugubrious Mote was a member of this species.
Myomar was a planet located in the Myomar system in the Deadalis sector of the Expansion Region. Myomar Academy, an Imperial Academy, was located on the planet.

Snoke's Throne Room was an enormous chamber veiled by an opaque red curtain. Located aboard the Supremacy, a Mega-class Star Dreadnought and flagship of the First Order, it was in the throne room where Supreme Leader Snoke broadcasted his holographic image or relayed orders to…
Bars Barka was a planet located in the Bars Barka system, a part of the Barsa sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. It was linked via hyperlane to the Varvva system.

The Red-pointed viper is a venomous serpent found in the jungles and swamps of Belkadan. Although not considered as life-threatening, at least not for trandoshans, a red-pointed viper's venom causes nausea which can be cured with antidote.
Ulon Atur was an island on the planet Lew'el.

Ertrax was a Wild Space planet located within the star system of the same name. Ertrax was home to the Ertraxi, a peaceful species of multiple-eyed humanoids who were eager to make contact with other species and cultures.
Porthomer eels were a type of eel that lived on the planet Lew'el.

result: The Spectres are able to get a message through to Alliance High Comman
x: Around 1 BBY, members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic hijacked Crawler 413-24 in an attempt to use its long-range communications equipment to contact Alliance High Command.

Kyaddaks were massive Force-sensitive insectoid creatures native to the planet Christophsis. They had many saw-blade limbs that made a loud tak-tak-tak sound as they roamed through the Crystal forests, which served as their habitats.
Basher sharks were a type of shark that lived in the galaxy. Aya-Glon owned a spear that was tipped with the tooth of a basher shark.

The Loth-wolf den used by loth-wolves was located on the planet Lothal, deep in the mountains of the planet's northern hemisphere. It was situated underground, and accessible via a passage underneath one of the planet's omnipresent rock spires.

The Lothal cliff dwelling was located in the southern hemisphere of the planet Lothal. It served as a base for the Lothal resistance group and the Spectres during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire in 1 BBY.

result: Hera Syndulla and some other surviving pilots captured
Further Alliance-related assistance in the Lothal campaign withdrawn
x: The Attack on Lothal, also known as the Battle of Lothal, occurred during the Galactic Civil War in the year 1 BBY, when the Alliance to Restore the Republic attacked the planet Lothal in an attempt to destroy the Imperial Armory Complex, where the Galactic Empire was planning…
The demolitions job on Foerost was a mission undertaken by the Drabatan rebel corporal Paodok'Draba'Takat Sap'De'Rekti Nik'Linke'Ti' Ki'Vef'Nik'NeSevef'Li'Kek by 1 BBY.

objective: Steal medical supplies from the Galactic Empire
x: Six months prior to the outbreak of the Galactic Civil War, the Alliance to Restore the Republic sent a Special Forces team to infiltrate the planet Iakar to steal medical supplies from the Galactic Empire.
The Invincible Faith was an MC80 Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic prior to the Battle of Endor.

The Suerton were a sentient reptilian species that lived in the galaxy. An eerily lucky species, the Suertons allegedly had the ability to subconsciously affect probability. The brothers Dodibin, Thodibin, and Wodibin were all Suertons from Chanceuxi.
The Eviscerator was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer under the command of Admiral Garrick Versio.
The Ja-bess Incursion was an event the Galactic Empire's Inferno Squad participated in sometime before the squad's commander, Iden Versio, escaped from the rebel ship Invincible Faith.

Ruoss Minor was a planet located in the Colonies and the Interior's Ruoss Minor system, which was situated in grid square M-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was controlled by the Galactic Empire at some point during the Imperial Era.

Anelsana was a terrestrial world located in the Anelsana system of the Expansion Region's Farstey sector, situated in grid square O-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It had several cities on its surface.

Docking bay 77 was located in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. It was owned and operated by the Sullustan Voos. Rai-Kalei berthed his ship, the Mayjeln there. The docking bay was owned by Voos, who made a few alterations to the docking bay.
Beetoo was an R-series astromech droid who accompanied Jedi Master Jocasta Nu in the days following the proclamation of the New Order.
The Instigator was a RX4 Patrol Ship that served in the New Republic fleet.

result: Imperial forces wiped out, save for Agent Del Meeko
objective: Investigate Pillio
Destroy the Emperor's Observatory
Reclaim the compass
x: In 4 ABY, Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker and Imperial Special Forces Agent Del Meeko simultaneously undertook a Mission to Pillio.

Station Control West was one of the four station control centers of the Galactic Empire's Death Star, overseeing the operations of the space station's western hemisphere. Its commanders included Pamel Poul and Sheard.

t: Destruction of an abandoned weapons depot
objective: Recover weapons from the abandoned weapons depot before the Galactic E
x: The destruction of an abandoned weapons depot was undertaken in 5 ABY by General Lando Calrissian and Shriv Suurgav on the planet Sullust.

Bayora was an astronomical object in the Expansion Region where at some point in time, Lor San Tekka took a map that led to Luke Skywalker. While probing the mind of Del Meeko, Kylo Ren learned that Tekka had taken the map to Bayora.
Athulla was a planet located in the Jinata system in the Core Worlds.

Project Resurrection was a clandestine operation by the First Order to turn child conscripts—thousands of whom were abducted from outlying systems—into a new generation of stormtroopers for the First Order Army.

objective: Capture Gideon Hask and shut down the Imperial operation there
x: In 5 ABY, Iden Versio and Del Meeko undertook a mission to Chinook Station on Bespin. Their objective was to find and capture Gideon Hask after learning from Ralsius Paldora that Admiral Garrick Versio's fleet, being overseen by Hask, had been refueling at Chinook for several …
Chinook Station was a fuel depot affiliated with the Galactic Empire, outfitting their forces with valuable tibanna gas. It was located on the planet Bespin.

A skirmish broke out on the planet Takodana between Imperial forces and General Han Solo of the New Republic as the smuggler, with the help of defector Ralsius Paldora, attempted to find data cubes stored in a forest that contained information crucial to both the Republic and …
The Wilderness Preserve service was a search-and-rescue service on Atrisia. Calum Gram developed precision flying skills during his time serving in the Wilderness Preserve service.

result: Iden Versio and Del Meeko defect from the Galactic Empire
Gleb is recovered by Gideon Hask and returned to Garrick Versio
objective: Recover Protectorate Gleb
x: A skirmish broke out in Kestro on the planet Vardos after Commander Iden Versio and Agent Del Meeko disobeyed their orders to return the Aqualish Gleb alone to Admiral Garrick Versio, instead choosing to save civilians as well.
Landing Bay 2 was a hangar in Kestro on the planet Vardos. When Inferno Squad traveled to collect the Aqualish Gleb from the Archive they landed their ship, the Corvus in Landing Bay 2.
The Tagge Holographic Museum was located on the planet Chandrila. It was filled with holographic exhibits of various lifeforms from throughout the galaxy.
A planet in Wild Space was used by the Chiss Thrawn, following his battle against the Grysk Hegemony, to fake his exile to eventually join the Galactic Empire.
Mount Quavaar was located on Ichtor 8. Shantee Ree claimed to have been approached by the stohls she adopted while turbo-skiing on Mount Quavaar.

Scritters were a type of beetle that lived within nests in the coral canyons of the planet Pillio. During a mission he undertook on Pillio, Luke Skywalker killed many scritters with his lightsaber, resulting in them exploding orange fluids out.
Orowatan fireflies were a type of firefly.
A star squid was a type of squid native to the planet Lew'el. Aya-Glon once pretended to be one to distract a marlin hunter.
A porpoise was a type of creature that lived on the planet Lew'el.
Awalian newts were a type of amphibian from the Awalia system.

result: Sullust is freed from the Galactic Empire
x: The Liberation of Sullust was a battle following the Battle of Endor where the New Republic liberated the planet Sullust from the Galactic Empire after months of fighting.
A marlin was a type of fish that lived on the planet Lew'el.
A razorback whale was a type of whale that lived in coral reefs alongside many other aquatic species, including the angel-pin shrimp.
Angel-pin shrimps were minuscule oceanic creatures that could be found in coral reefs.

The vegicus were a non-sentient species that lived in the bilges and storage nooks of long-haul starships. As such, they were considered a vermin. Dwoogan, who served as a cook aboard the transport barge Wayward Current, occasionally prepared vegicus tails fried in oil.
A sentient species were on the planet Sterdic IV during the battle of Cawa City.

Wermals were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They had one large eye, nose-slits, pink skin, and three hearts. They could live for well over a century. Kedpin Shoklop was a Wermal from Werma Lesser.
Werma Lesser, also known simply as Werma, was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Wermal species.

The Sea of Cantonica, also known as the Cantonican sea, was an artificial ocean located on the planet Cantonica, considered the galaxy's largest. The casino city of Canto Bight was located on its shores. From orbit, the sea's shape belied its artificially created nature.

The Cantonican Dream was a luxurious starship that transported passengers to and from the casino city of Canto Bight, on the planet Cantonica. Kedpin Shoklop traveled on it when he went there on vacation.
Wiyentaah was an underground city on the planet Polis Massa, built by the mysterious Eellayin civilization. It was destroyed when Polis Massa was shattered in a mysterious cataclysm.

The Cantonican Planetary Control was the organization that oversaw planetary security on the planet Cantonica. It ran the customs that all arriving travellers had to pass through. They particularly looked out for potential spies from the First Order or Resistance.
A city was located on the planet Alderaan. The city, along with the rest of the planet, was destroyed by the Galactic Empire in 1 BBY.

Strike Force Xesh was an Alliance Rangers squad that served the Rebellion during the Galactic Civil War. At some point in the war, Strike Force Xesh was dispatched to Ithor to destroy an Imperial communications relay.

Loo-Too was an astromech droid who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the lead-up to the Galactic Civil War. In 1 BBY, Loo-Too was assigned to Red Four of Red Flight who was deployed to assist Extraction Team Bravo in the Wobani system.
A wind-truster was a type of bird native to the planet Lew'el.

result: Kylo Ren learns Tekka took the map to Bayora
objective: Learn what Lor San Tekka did with the map to Skywalker
x: During the New Republic Era, the First Order warlord Kylo Ren undertook a mission to Pillio to learn where Lor San Tekka had taken the map to Jedi Master Luke Skywalker.

Someilk was an astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. Around 1 ABY, the Galactic Empire utilized a settlement there until Chelli Aphra and a crew working for 0-0-0 destroyed it.

The Overseer's Tower was located on Chinook Station on the planet Bespin. During the mission to Chinook Station, Iden Versio and Del Meeko infiltrated the tower in order to capture Gideon Hask but once they reached the tower it was too late as Hask had already departed.

This BX-series droid commando was used by the bounty hunter Cad Bane during the Senate hostage crisis in the Galactic Senate. The droid impersonated a Senate Commando and wore the commando's armor for the rest of the event.
A Maxillipede shuttle was used by D-Squad to carry out a mission to steal an encryption module from a Providence-class Dreadnought commanded by the super tactical droid Aut-O.
This MC80 star cruiser was a MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser that served in the Alliance Fleet and most notably participated in a battle at the Fondor shipyards.
These unidentified predators were a species of carnivorous felines that inhabited the jungle of the planet Zeenada.

A Rho-class transport shuttle was used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems to load rhydonium onto a Venator-class Star Destroyer to destroy the Republic strategy conference taking place on the space station Valor above Carida. It was stolen by D-Squad to escape from Abafar.
Fenn was a planet in the mid rim. The ganjuko originated on Fenn before spreading across the galaxy.
The Iso-One was the wreck of a BFF-1 bulk freighter owned by the Twi'lek Reom, the president of IsoTech, and was his secret headquarters after the loss of his previous base on Raxus Prime.
Precinct 47 was a location on Starkiller Base, that housed the base's thermal oscillator.
Blockade runner 0-9-9 was the designation of a Pelta-class Transport Frigate in the naval forces of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Columi were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. Imperial Flag Lieutenant Edwig warned fleet and garrison commanders to be wary of members of the Columi species in a transmission sent on behalf of Admiral Firmus Piett.
Flurrgs were creatures that lived on the planet Takodana. They made croaking noises.

Junari Point was a seaside location that was located several kilometers away from the Chandrilan capital of Hanna City. It was home to a bar that was frequented by the former Imperial Security Bureau loyalty officer Sinjir Rath Velus during his rest and recreation time.
The Skygarden was a floating botanical garden above Chandrila's Hanna City. It was a popular location for Chandrilans to gather at in order to openly debate political topics.
A campsite on the planet Takodana was used by the pirate Maz Kanata.
A gigantic aquatic fish creature was native to a planet.
Axxila III was a moon in the Axxila system of the D'Astan sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It housed the Bright Jewel Oversector Flight Base, an Imperial military base.
LEP-86C8 was an LEP-series service droid that helped Doctor Nuvo Vindi with the Blue Shadow Virus during the Clone Wars. He was at Vindi's hidden lab on the planet Naboo.
Ai-jed was a settlement on the moon Jedha that was still inhabited by 1 ABY despite the destruction of Jedha City.
A crisis began on Moltok when a Makurth boss shot at a Ho'Din settlement. This lead the Ho'Din to request Imperial support to prevent the crisis from becoming a full-fledged war.
A megacorporation was a corporate entity that was a massive conglomerate, usually with monopolistic qualities. The Trade Federation and Techno Union were powerful megacorporations.

A Providence-class Dreadnought served in the Confederacy of Independent Systems's naval forces and served as the flagship of a Separatist fleet commanded by the ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid Commander Aut-O during the Clone Wars.
The Breha was a diplomatic vessel used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Its design greatly resembled that of a J-type 327 Nubian starship.

result: Ishi Tib join the Rebel Alliance
objective: Rescuing Luke Skywalker
x: Around 1 ABY, Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker went on an undercover diplomatic mission to the planet of Tibrin, on the edge of the Hadar sector.

A CR90 corvette served in the New Republic Defense Fleet and notably participated in the Battle of Jakku ferrying Captain Lindsey and his unit to Carbon Ridge to destroy a Imperial research base before the corvette crashed on the surface.
Yellow-4 was a New Republic T-65B X-wing starfighter that participated in the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY.

Yiyar was a small Rodian clan during the Galactic Civil War. It owned the Yiyar Salvage Corporation, located on the Wheel, in the Mid Rim. Others did not like Yiyar members due to their violent behavior. Yav Yiyar was a member of the clan.
Arratu Station was a city on the planet Parnassos created by the Con Star Mining Corporation.

The mutiny on the Rand Ecliptic was an insurrection that took place on board the Imperial starship Rand Ecliptic. During the course of the mutiny, Derek Klivian, an undercover agent of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, helped First Mate Biggs Darklighter defect.
Culoss was the name of a band of pirates that were originally part of Q'anah's Marauders. They notably hijacked the freighter Dromedar to steal its cargo of tibanna gas and captured its crew.
The Aurorient Express crisis was an event that occurred aboard the Aurorient Express in the year 38 BBY.
Proam Avenue was a location on Coruscant where the Proam Avenue Citizen Assistance office was located.

During Nightswan's campaign, a battle over Umbara erupted above the planet Umbara between the naval forces of the Galactic Empire and forces controlled by the mysterious individual known as Nightswan.
The Ninka was a Free Virgillia-class Bunkerbuster in service of the Resistance during its conflict with the First Order. Its commanding officer was Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdo.

Logra were creatures found on the desert planet of Tatooine. When the Tusken Raider A'Yark became a chieftain, the younglings of her clan were forced to kill logra in the rites of adulthood instead of krayt dragons.
R5-J2 was an Imperial modified R5 series astromech droid stationed on board the Death Star II superweapon while the battle station was under construction in the Endor system.
The Hollenside Enclave was an enclave that was the location of a colony of humans led by Mayor Pord Benchel.
The Cyphar Incident occurred during the Imperial Era when a land dispute took place on the planet Cyphar between the local Cyphari Afe clan and human colonists based on the Hollenside Enclave.
The Afe clan was a clan of Cyphari on the planet of Cyphar that possessed territory near a human colony and a Twi'lek settlement and was led by Chief Joko.

Dek-Nil was a first generation droideka who was reprogrammed by Doctor Aphra. He joined Aphra on a mission to retrieve the memories of Triple-Zero, and was later imprisoned in Accresker Jail along with her, being used as a hubdroid.
Naval Command and Control was an Imperial Navy organization.
This white-skinned species was a sentient species of bipedals that possessed three-fingered hands, webbed toes and glowing blue eyes.

Iris was a communications droid that assisted Captain Cardinal of the First Order. The spherical, hovering, black-colored droid was capable of controlling video cameras and internal sensors on board the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Absolution as well as providing basic vital…
Randon was a planet located in the Randon system in the Mytaranor sector of the Mid Rim Territories, at the confluence of a number of hyperspace routes.
Bunku Nagara (Huttese for "City of Palaces") was a city located on the planet Vodran. The city contained the Vatta Hutta, a temple dedicated to the worship of the Hutts.
Paulef were a non-sentient creature that had delicate hands.

Genhu was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Genhu system in the Periphery, a subsector of the Tharin sector in the Outer Rim Territories. homeworld of Cost Niktur. When Niktur was a child, her mother, her father, and Other found her in a Hendo bush.
This OOM command battle droid was present during a skirmish on Hoth.
A type of green bird lived on the forest moon of Endor.
A pheasant was a type of bird from Naboo. A subpecies of pheasant was the golden pheasant. They had colorful plumage with a yellow head and red chest.
Command center was a location on Starkiller Base.
Vette Lake was a lake located on Xu'hu. A bar called the Dande Donjon was located on the lake's shore.
Mathas was a planet in the Mathas system of the Inner Rim Territories whose inhabitants suffered from the Niffin plague at some time before the Clone Wars.
The Hemmel fields were fields where hemmel grew on the planet Durkteel.
At some point before the mission to Nakadia, the New Republic liberated the planet Nakadia from Imperial rule.
The Order of Zildrog was a militant organization that emerged on Zakuul following the fall of the Eternal Empire.
Tibrina was the capital city of the planet Tibrin was located on a ocean. Following the Battle of Yavin, Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia Organa under took a diplomatic mission to the city.
Section A-four was a location on the space station Lansend Twenty-Six.
Section A-five was a location on the space station Lansend Twenty-Six.
Section B-five was a location on the space station Lansend Twenty-Six.
Section B-eight was a location on the space station Lansend Twenty-Six, a facility the Galactic Empire used to hold slaves.

A nomadic tribe of Tusken Raiders lived in the Jundland Wastes desert of their homeworld Tatooine. In the year 32 BBY, the Tusken Orr'UrRuuR'R was part of the tribe and took part in shooting at podracers participating in the Boonta Eve Classic race as the vehicles passed throu…

6L-CH was an overstressed green-plated BB-series astromech droid in the service of the Resistance. It was stationed on the Raddus above the planet D'Qar shortly after the Battle of Starkiller Base, where it was repaired alongside other BB units.

84-SH was a timid gray-plated BB-series astromech droid in the service of the Resistance. It was stationed on the Raddus above the planet D'Qar shortly after the Battle of Starkiller Base, where it was repaired alongside other BB units.

9RU-MP was a gruff red-plated BB-series astromech droid in the service of the Resistance. At some point 9RU-MP met B1-series battle droid R0-GR at the repair bay aboard the Raddus. R0-GR would later include 9RU-MP in his book Droidography.
R2-R9 was an R2-series astromech droid with masculine programming that served the Royal House of the planet Naboo during the Invasion of Naboo by the Trade Federation in the year 32 BBY.

Mantooine was an astronomical object located in the Atrivis sector where the Jedi Master Yoda once took his Padawan Dooku between 86 BBY and 80 BBY. During the Galactic Empire's reign, an Imperial garrison was based there.
The Nangilima was a starship in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic shortly after the Battle of Yavin, and was called to assist in the evacuation of Yavin 4 by Admiral Gial Ackbar.
The Esperance was a starship used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Snoop 2 was a Patrol X-wing used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic that was assigned to perimeter and reconnaissance sweeps around Base One on Yavin 4.

The Glarus Lagoons, or Glarus lagoon, were located on the Core Worlds planet Alderaan. In 3 BBY, Apprentice Legislator Kier Domadi suggested visiting the Glarus Lagoons to his peer, the Alderaanian Princess Leia Organa.
Level 4120 was a level on the planet Coruscant.
Caskadags were a sentient species with two stomachs that hailed from a desert world. Anglang Lehet, who worked as an assassin, was a member of this species.

Palandags were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They were notable for having an exolung. Dhuz, Hhex, and Jhat were Palandags who worked as musicians. Palandags' language was comprised of sounds that some considered to be naturally musical.
The Scrapheap Point was an area in the southern hemisphere of the planet Raxus Prime. It served as the primary base of IsoTech, a front company owned by the Twi'lek Reom.

Heavy Snowtroopers were Heavy Weapons Stormtrooper variants of Snowtroopers of the Galactic Empire. They that underwent elite cold weather training and specialized in using large rapid-fire blasters to destroy their targets.
Heptooinians were a sentient species that originated from the Heptooine system. Kaljach Sonmi and Haki Zeophrine were members of this species.

Arctic Jumptroopers were Imperial Jumptroopers specialized to operate in cold environments. They wore uniforms identical to those worn by snowtroopers. These troopers could be seen working alongside regular "snowtroopers" in arctic operations.

Forest Jumptroopers were Imperial Jumptroopers that had modifications to their standard jetpacks which produced more efficient power routing, allowing them to move more quickly in densely forested environments. They wore armor similar to that of shoretroopers.

Desert Jumptroopers were Imperial jumptroopers that were equipped with modified jetpacks which allowed them to operate in extremely hot and dry conditions, and allowed them to move more quickly in arid environments.
The sulfur sea was a lava sea on the planet Lola Sayu.
Sand mynocks were a type of mynock. At some point in its history, the planet Cantonica was once a world of sand mynocks and smugglers' hideouts.
Dor Namethians were a sentient species from the Dor Nameth system. Lexo Sooger, who worked as a masseur was a member of this species.
The elephant slug was a creature seen on Dagobah. Orange in color, with a long snout and green eyes, the slug could roll into a ball to attack its enemies.

The holgnot was a long, serpent-like creature seen on Dagobah. Orange and green in color, with a long snout and bulging eyes, the creature could quickly pop out from holes in trees and the ground to attack an enemy.
The praying mantis was a large, green, flying insect seen on Dagobah.
The underslug was a small creature seen on Dagobah. The green and orange creature crawled along the ground and could blend into grass. It would raise up its round head to attack an enemy.
Gigoran Fighters, also commonly known as Gigoran rebels, were Gigoran mercenaries in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Cator was a GC-8 droid who served as guardian-protector of a secret vault in the Jedi Archives of the Jedi Temple. After the fall of the Jedi Order, the droid continued to keep watch and was present when Jocasta Nu returned to collect one of the items in the vault.

Rasta Aliens were a humanoid species that had spines on their calves, a long rippling strain near their neck, and short stubs on their heads. Known as dangerous predators, they were capable of shooting deadly spikes from their abdomen in three-pronged bursts.

The Rock Hound was a four-legged canine species found inside caves in the Tatooine desert. The creatures burrowed into nearby rocks and would burst to the surface to attack an enemy. A number of the canines inhabited a cave known as the Rock Hounds' Lair.
Laser Cave was the name given to a cave in a Tatooine desert. A natural corrosive acid dripped from stalactites in the cave. Luke Skywalker found a blaster while exploring the cave.
The Rock Hounds' Lair was a cave in a Tatooine desert inhabited by a number of the canine Rock Hounds.
Crawler Cavern was a cave in a Tatooine desert inhabited by a number of dangerous Sand Slugs.
Raider's Lair was a cave in a Tatooine desert that was home to a number of violent Tusken Raiders.
Obi-Wan's Cave was the name applied to a cave in a Tatooine desert where Luke Skywalker encountered Obi-Wan Kenobi. The cave was home to many sand flies.

The homeworld of the Caskadag species was a desert world light-years away from the planet Cantonica. When Anglang Lehet tasted Cantonican cactus liqueur served in Canto Bight, he noted it tasted like home.

Beethree, or B-3, was a broken astromech droid owned by Akshaya Ponta. When Ponta met with Jyn Erso the deal they agreed upon was Erso to fix Beethree in return for space traveling to fix the droid. However, Erso was unable to do so.
Prior to the attack on the Sempre, a large espionage operation was conducted by members of the Higher Skies Advocacy Group and Yinchom Dojo on the galactic capital of Coruscant.

During the Imperial Era, the troop carrier Sempre was attacked by two squadrons of stolen V-19 fighters and the frigate Castilus while transporting Wookiee slaves. The attackers damaged and boarded the transport.

result: Several canisters of tibanna gas stolen
x: The Dromedar hijacking occurred in 13 BBY, during the Imperial Era, when the freighter Dromedar was raided and captured by the pirate band Culoss, which was led by the insurgent leader Nevil Cygni. The pirates took the crew prisoner and captured the ship's tibanna cargo.
After an attack on the transport Sempre, insurgents and freed Wookiee slaves attacked the space station Lansend Twenty-Six in an attempt to liberate their companions.
The Vector was an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era that notably featured red markings on its hull.

The Suppressor was an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser that was in service to the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. At one point, it flew over a rocky, tan terrestrial body alongside a TIE fighter.
The Interdictor was an experimental Interdictor-class heavy cruiser that was equipped with four gravity well projectors, allowing it to pull starships out of hyperspace.

Alaspin was a location where a faintly poisonous variety of wine was produced. It was located in the Alaspin system of the Suolriep sector within the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice, falling within grid square S-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Squall was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier in service to the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era.

The Pursuant was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier in service to the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. At some point, the cruiser-carrier flew over a land-and-water-covered terrestrial body alongside TIE/ln space superiority starfighters.

The Stronghold was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier in service to the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. At some point, the cruiser-carrier sustained damage to its hull and lay in a debris field with two TIE/ln space superiority starfighters.
Tethyrr River Valley was a valley in the jungles of the planet Cholganna.
Tethyrr River was a river in the jungles of the planet Cholganna.

IsoTech offices were the headquarters of IsoTech, a front company owned by Reom. They were located on The Wheel during the Galactic Civil War, a conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Reevos were amphibians creatures native to the planet Cholganna. Each had a prominent, lizard-like head on a long, upright neck around 3 meters tall. Reevos also had a water-cannon-like ability to knock down prey.
The Hand of Justice was an Arquitens-class light cruiser which served in the navies of the Galactic Republic and Galactic Empire.
The Centicore was an Arquitens-class command cruiser in service to the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. At some point, the light cruiser fired shots at a target from behind an asteroid.
Garel's Honor was a Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette that served in the naval forces of the Rebel Alliance during the Imperial Era.
V-333 was a droid who owned V-333's Silken Parlor. She was responsible for roping in Kedpin Shoklop into using her bath house.
R2-6N was an astromech droid who worked in the facility's garage in the Retreat during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

result: All Gus Talon citizens declared prisoners
Wedge Antilles joins the Rebel Alliance
x: The Galactic Empire conducted a bombing of the Corellian moon Gus Talon early during the Galactic Civil War in retaliation against a local Rebel Alliance cell.

Cloddograns were a sentient species of which Bargwill Tomder was a member. At some point, two Cloddograns menaced Mahjo Reeloo in Galagolos spaceport on the planet Galagolos V until Hondo Ohnaka saved her.

Kintoni was a planet under the rule of the Galactic Empire and governed by Governor Sanz. It was located in the Kintoni system in the Ash Worlds of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square S-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Askkto-Fen IV was a location in the galaxy. Lexo Sooger was raised in the slave pits of Askkto-Fen IV before becoming a masseuse at Zord's Spa and Bathhouse in Canto Bight.

The slave pits of Askkto-Fen IV were slave pits located on Askkto-Fen IV. Lexo Sooger was raised in the pits before becoming a masseuse at Zord's Spa and Bathhouse in Canto Bight. After leaving the pits, his personal motto became "Hear nothing, see nothing, say nothing".
Dennogra was an astronomical object in the Tharin sector of the Outer Rim Territories, connected via the Triellus Trade Route to Junkfort Station and Taskeed.
The Cularin Syndicate was a criminal organization, with one such member being Anglang Lehet before he paid his way out of it.
A forest was located in Northern Indoumodo on the planet Indoumodo.

The Archive Courtyard was a courtyard in which the Archive was located on the planet Vardos. It contained a monument dedicated to Garrick Versio, an Imperial admiral who was responsible for bringing Vardos into the Empire, earning him the title of the "Hero of Vardos."
Rodian Snipers were Rodian soldiers of the Alliance to Restore the Republic that specialized in the usage of long range weapons. They were also equipped with smoke grenades.
Sullustan Demolition soldiers were Sullustan soldiers of the Alliance to Restore the Republic that specialized in the usage of Smart Rockets and explosives.
Ishi Tib Jetpack Troopers were Ishi Tib soldiers of the Alliance to Restore the Republic equipped with jetpacks, personal energy shields, and blasters.
The Retribution was a First Order Resurgent-class Star Destroyer that was present during the Cold War and the war between the First Order and the Resistance.
The Old City Boys was an underground criminal organization that operated in the city of Canto Bight on Cantonica.

Locate Del Meeko
x: Near the end of the Cold War, a mission was undertaken by Iden Versio, Resistance member Shriv Suurgav, and Versio's daughter, Zay Versio, to investigate the planet Athulla.
A sand slug was a type of giant slug that was native to the moon Jedha.

x: Following the destruction of the Hosnian system, a battle broke out in Kestro City, the capital city of the planet Vardos, in 34 ABY during the early stages of open warfare between the First Order and the Resistance.

The Opportunity was a EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate that served under the banner of Jinata Security during the Cold War. The vessel was eventually disabled above Athulla by Inferno Squad while carrying out Project Resurrection.

Tark Squad was an elite clone commando squad that existed as part of the Special Operations Brigade of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. The four members of the squad were Thyrsian mercenaries trained by Sarsius Torne, a Thyrsus Sun Guard.
DC-10 was a protocol droid who served at the Coruscant City Tours.
An IG-86 sentinel droid participated in the Senate hostage crisis. It was part of Cad Bane's crew when they went to break Ziro Desilijic Tiure out of prison.
D477 was a droid who worked at Terpsichore Station, a mining facility on the planet Parnassos that belonged to the Con Star Mining Corporation. Her task was to give uniforms to the miners.

The saddle was a natural valley at the top of the steps on the Temple Island on the planet Ahch-To. Porgs, a species of bird, could be found on the saddle. It was once a place of meditation for the ancient Jedi.
Dulathia was an astronomical object in the Dulathia system in the Lantillian sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was the homeworld of Kaydel Ko Connix, a human lieutenant of the Resistance.
Pippip 3 was a planet located in grid square Q-4 on the Standard Galactic Grid, in the Pippip system within the Illisurevimurasi sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim and New Territories regions.
The Xi'Dec were an insectoid sentient species from Stic. Ubbla Mollbro, a female opera singer with engorged egg sacs, was a member of this species.

x: The Battle of Oetchi, also known as the retreat to Crait or the attack on the Resistance fleet, took place in 34 ABY when the First Order attacked the Resistance within the Oetchi system, intent on destroying the insurgents that opposed their conquest of the galaxy.
The Anodyne was a modified Nebulon-C escort frigate that served in the New Republic Defense Fleet and later the Resistance navy during its conflict with the First Order.
The Fulminatrix was a Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought in the First Order Navy captained by Moden Canady.

Hays Minor was a planet in the Otomok system that was the homeworld of Rose and Paige Tico. Prior to the pair joining the Resistance, the First Order used the world to test weapons after stripping it of its Haysian smelt and also stole children to become stormtroopers.
Hays Major was a planet in the Otomok system. It, along with its sister planet Hays Minor, spun at the edge of what could be considered habitable in the system.
Jedi Crusaders were a group of Jedi. Luke Skywalker had a pendant from a Jedi Crusader which contained a broken Sith kyber crystal.
The Vigil was a Vakbeor-class cargo frigate manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards. It was captured by Resistance commandos from pirates during a battle off the Chasidron Shoals.

The Solicitude was a 1,600-meter-long Imperial I-class Star Destroyer in service to the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. Moden Canady began his career in the Imperial Navy as the commander of the Star Destroyer, at which point he held the military rank of major.

An Ahch-Tonian grub was a type of creature native the the remote planet of Ahch-To. The Wookiee Chewbacca once attempted to use these grubs as bait for fishing on the planet, only to find that there were no fish to catch because of it being the winter season.
Ow-Chee-2 was a torture droid that Admiral Screed used to put Mungo Baobab into hibernation.
K-4 was a protocol droid used by Brendol Hux and later Armitage Hux aboard the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Absolution.

objective: Deliver supplies to the Atterrans
x: The Atterra campaign, also known as the Atterra crisis, or the mission to the Atterra system, was a mission undertaken by the Resistance to transport supplies to the Atterrans in the Atterra system.
Temple Island was an island on the planet Ahch-To where the Jedi Order was founded over a thousand generations before the fall of the Galactic Republic.

objective: Capture Theron Shan

The fingerlip garpon, also referred to as Finger-Lipped Garpon or simply garpon, was a species of scalefin fish found in the oceans and lakes of the planets Ahch-To, Corellia, and Koboh.

The twinfin hyacander was a species of fish native to the oceans of the planet Ahch-To. The fish had green-scaled bodies with bright red lips and relatively large white teeth. The species possessed a pair of dorsal fins, one long ventral fin and a tail fin.
The Battle of Chyron Belt was a confrontation that took place at some point by the time of the First Order-Resistance War in 34 ABY in the vicinity of the Expansion Region's Chyron system.

The spetan channelfish was a species of fish with two black eyes native to the oceans of the planet Ahch-To. The fish had gray, pink, and white scales covering their bodies and four tendril like appendages protruding from each corner of its mouth.
The Conqueror was a Resurgent-class Star Destroyer that served in the First Order Navy. It was equipped with engines.
The Harbinger was a Resurgent-class Star Destroyer that served in the First Order Navy. It was equipped with engines.
Snoke's escape shuttle, also referred to as Snoke's escape craft, was a shuttle owned by Supreme Leader Snoke.
The Libertine, christened by its first owner as the Steadfast, was a Star Yacht that Finn, Rose Tico, BB-8 and DJ used to escape from Canto Bight.

Atterra Bravo was a planet located in the Atterra system within the Outer Rim Territories. The Firestone Islands were located on Atterra Bravo. It had a sister planet named Atterra Alpha and both were surrounded by a thick asteroid belt.
Refnu was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It served as the departure point for the Atterra campaign as it was not as far from the Atterra system as D'Qar was.
Atterra Primo was a gas giant located in the Atterra system within the Outer Rim Territories.
Atterra Alpha was a planet located in the Atterra system within the Outer Rim Territories that was controlled by the First Order

The Inspectorate was an inspection agency within the Galactic Empire. Inspector Thanoth served in the Inspectorate during the time in which he was adjutant to Darth Vader. Thanoth uncovered Vader's plot to kill and overthrow the Emperor, for which Vader killed him.
Upper Etrega was the homeworld of the Q'Itane Trusk Berinato. It was located in the Upper Etrega system in the Colonies.
The Q'Itane were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. Trusk Berinato, a friend of Bail Organa, was a male Q'Itane from Upper Etrega.

The moon of Ooloponi was a moon in the galaxy that Princess Leia Organa presented to Chancellor Mon Mothma as a potential base of operations for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Mothma however rejected the moon, stating that it was too hot.

Baraan-Fa was a small, beautiful planet in the Grumani sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was known for its trade and farming, inhabited by members of the human species. It was the homeworld of Sari Nadle, a cadet in the Resistance's J-Squadron.
Kinraths, or Netcasters were yellow spider-like creatures found deep within the forests of the planet Kashyyyk, where they weaved sprawling webs amongst the tall woodland trees.
The Spectral was an Interdictor-class heavy cruiser that was in service to the Galactic Empire during its reign of the galaxy. It was commanded by Admiral Ektol Traz.
The Cobalt Hammer was an MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 in the Resistance's Cobalt Squadron.
The sonar swallow was a type of bird from D'Qar.
The Cobalt Hornet was an MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 in the Resistance's Cobalt Squadron.
The Cobalt Belle was an MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 in the Resistance's Cobalt Squadron.
The Crimson Bolide was an MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 in the Resistance's Crimson Squadron.
The Crimson Cutter was an MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 in the Resistance's Crimson Squadron.
The Crimson Dancer was an MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 in the Resistance's Crimson Squadron.
The Cobalt Treasure was an MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 in the Resistance's Cobalt Squadron.
The Cobalt Mare was an MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 in the Resistance's Cobalt Squadron.
The Cobalt Wasp was an MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 in the Resistance's Cobalt Squadron.
The Crimson Hailstorm was an MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 in the Resistance's Crimson Squadron.
The Cobalt Scarab was an MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 in the Resistance's Cobalt Squadron.

Oreenda Fayeet was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Oreenda Fayeet system within the Colonies. The spice addict Jaahn Liddle was imprisoned by the Galactic Empire on Oreenda Fayeet, before being rescued by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Bears were a type of creature that lived in the galaxy. Upon seeing Lieutenant Wulfgar Kath of the First Order, Resistance spy Vi Moradi noted he was built like a bear. A species of bear was the garu-bear, a type of hibernating bear.
Spaceward Ho! was a Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry utilized by the Galactic Republic's military against the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone War.

A golden pheasant was a type of pheasant. They had colorful plumage with a yellow head and red chest. They could be found on the planet Naboo. According to the Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs, Simmered Golden Pheasant was a popular dish on Naboo by the year 34 ABY.
Bad Kitty was an LAAT gunship. It had customized nose art painted on either of its sides, with a nexu riding a large bomb and the ship's name written in Aurebesh on the bomb.
Separatist Nightmare was a LAAT gunship used by the Grand Army of the Republic during the Second Battle of Geonosis, serving in Mundi's squadron.
A type of green flying creature inhabited the planet Kardoa.
Boot Gunray was a LAAT gunship used by the Grand Army of the Republic.
Tuloch-Gorum was a city located on the planet Hays Major.
Skota was a location on the planet Hays Major.
Port Addes, also known as Port Addis, was a city on the planet Hays Major.
Islomat was a city on the planet Hays Major.
Henchbrao was a city located on the planet Hays Major.
Tre-Sebris was a location on the planet Hays Minor.
The Kesselians were a cultural group of humans who called the planets of Kessel and Little Kessel home, located in the Kessel sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The billfish was a species of fish native to the oceans of the planet Ahch-To. The beak of the billfish was used as part of a musical instrument by the Lanai species.
This fish was a species of fish native to the oceans of the planet Ahch-To. Its corpse was used as part of a musical instrument, the opah-bladder bagpipes.
R2-O3 was a R2-series astromech droid with masculine-programming. One of the first R2 units created on Anoat, R2-O3 spent a majority of his existence as a demolitions droid.
Horses were hardy creatures used as mounts by the Ewoks of the Forest Moon of Endor. A horse-like species known as the orbak lived on the Kef Bir, the Ocean Moon of Endor.

Warlentta was a world in the Warlentta system that was the homeworld of Larma D'Acy, a commander in the Resistance. After Warlentta refused to join the New Republic, its independent culture made an impression on Senator Leia Organa.
Isobe was a planet located in the Thustra system in the Sumitra sector of the Expansion Region. It was ruled by a royal family and produced unique Tynzo crystals.

Chickens were a type of domesticated birds that could be found on Takodana, Endor, and Batuu. All Terrain Scout Transports, a type of Imperial walker, were derisively nicknamed "chicken walkers." A female chicken was known as a hen. A cuckoo hen was a type of hen.

The Malevolence was a qaz-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Yavin, it was considered a new vessel, although it was one of the only qaz-class Destroyers to remain active during the war, with the others no longer bei…

Tawds were non-sentient creatures native to the planet Durkteel. They were woolly and long-tailed, and also present on Ottinger 7. Mattis Banz mentioned that one tawd could destroy a dozen farms by eating every living thing and destroying what remained.
Little Vixen was a reconnassance transport used by the Resistance members Paige and Rose Tico, along with Bravo Rising resistance movement member Reeve Panzoro, during the Atterra campaign.

IT-3PO, or Eyetee–Three, was a protocol droid who operated during the Clone Wars and later the Galactic Civil War. He belonged to Rel Harsol, captain of the Sa Nalaor, then to Ropok, Reom's father and owner of IsoTech.
CZ-873 was a droid who operated during the Galactic Civil War. He belonged to IsoTech and was stationned on the planet Raxus Prime.
A jungle planet was located in the galaxy. During the Cold War, FN-2187 and a squad of First Order stormtroopers were deployed to this planet to search for any Resistance activity.

This B1-series battle droid was captured, reprogrammed and used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. It was a member of a group of three battle droids placed under the command of the astromech droid R2-D2 during a mission to the Outer Rim planet Lola Sayu.
Wooriids were an amphibious carnivore native to Glee Anselm, the home planet of Jedi Master Kit Fisto.
Trammis III was a location in the galaxy. In 7971.325.3 C.R.C., the Weequay pirate Hondo Ohnaka sold contraband puffer pig bladders and Sansanna preservatives in the Chreotan Souk on Trammis III.

First Order jet troopers, or simply jet troopers, were a stormtrooper variant in the Stormtrooper Corps of the First Order. Unlike the standard trooper, who was mostly trained in ground operations, these specialists were trained in aerial combat.
ARIES was a self-aware droid that remained as sole ruler of Iokath for millennia following the eradication of his creators in the Iokath Civil War.
The Ongidae were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. Pemmin Brunce was an Ongidae who worked as the head of security in the Canto Bight casino on Cantonica.
Bufopel were a sentient humanoid species that lived in the galaxy. Some of them, known as the Bufopel Protectors, fought with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Baarstal was an astronomical object that was located within the Baarstal system in the Outer Rim Territories. At some point shortly before the fall of the Galactic Republic, a small incident occurred near Baarstal.

Thuna III was an astronomical object located within Wild Space's Thuna system. At some point by 32 BBY, a colony on Thuna III was devastated by a groundquake. In the wake of the disaster, a band of raiders intended to pillage the settlement.
The Attendants were a group of mute alien navigators from an ancient insectoid species that was used by various factions in the Unknown Regions, where they originated.

A bombardment occurred on the Tak-Beam complex on the planet Durkteel on the same day as the Battle of Endor when the Galactic Empire dispatched three Star Destroyers to Durkteel after it received rumors of a Rebel Alliance meeting occurring near the planet's industrial center.
The Asteroid Dreadnought was a rumored Imperial Navy dreadnought that was camouflaged as a space rock during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Kylo's chambers were Kylo Ren's personal quarters on the First Order Mega-class Star Dreadnought Supremacy. The chambers provided Ren with the isolation he needed in order to meditate on the Force.

The Battle of Nal Kapok took place on the planet Nal Kapok during the Clone Wars between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic. R0-GR, a B1-series battle droid veteran of the Clone Wars, considered this battle the worst battle he fought in.

This planet was covered in mountains and seas that had a rainy climate. Rowan Freemaker and R0-GR hid the last Kyber Saber kyber crystal on this planet, until Naare found it.
Copero City was a city on the Unknown Regions planet of Copero.
Dune worms was a type of worm native to the planet Tatooine.
Orwan Port was a city on the planet Hays Minor.
Planum Sebris was a location on the planet Hays Minor.

The Virgillian Free Alignment was a resistance group operating in the Virgillia system against the system's government supported by the Galactic Empire. It was one of the early allies of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
One day after the formation of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY, Imperial Intelligence arrested sixty-three Imperial senators on charges of conspiracy and treason.
A shuttle was used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic to evacuate Chancellor Mon Mothma in the event that the Death Star destroyed Yavin 4, which housed the Alliance's base of operations.
Feenix was located in the D'Aelgoth sector's Feenix system within an intersecting portion of the Mid Rim Territories and the Western Reaches.

ARIES base was the base of operation of ARIES, the only self-aware droid on the artificial world of Iokath, located in its southern hemisphere. It was located near a massive superweapon that could knock out or kill organics over the great distance.
The Attack on Duma's forces was a battle between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire that took place in 3639 BBY during the Galactic War.
A battle in the Baros system between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire took place in 3639 BBY in the Galactic War.

C8-S3C was a battle droid active during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Chromium Garden was a garden located on the artificial world of Iokath, next to Selruvian biome and the Tributary. In 3630 BBY the Alliance leadership, trapped on Iokath by ARIES, passed the Chromium Garden and took shelter inside the Tributary.

Cleaning Probe Z02 was a cleaning droid used in Fa'athra's Palace on Nal Hutta during the Cold War. In 3643 BBY Cy Krolo and his partner who worked for Suudaa Nem'ro got the droid out of the palace and then planted transmitters on the remaining droid to gather information on V…
The Coalition Command Post was a military outpost established on Yavin 4 during the Revanite crisis by the Yavin Coalition forces under Darth Marr and Satele Shan.

Cult of Gethul was formed around an abomination called Gethul by Jedi Master Adelade in 3631 BBY. Following the death of the Eternal Empire Empress Vaylin and the formation of the Eternal Alliance, Adelade received precise coordinates to a location on Makeb from an anonymous s…

Raddan was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories within in the galaxy.

This RA-7 protocol droid was an information specialist which operated undercover as a protocol droid aboard the Sundered Heart.

The Sisterhood of Ta'fan-jirah was an organization that was active on the planet Chandrila during the time of the Clone Wars.

A Venator-class Star Destroyer was used by the Galactic Empire during the early stage of its reign. It was present during the construction of the Death Star in orbit of Geonosis.

Drabatan Saboteurs were amphibious Drabatan soldiers for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. They fought during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire, and were known as fierce commandos that charged into combat yelling full-throated war cries at their enemies.

Iakaru Warriors were Iakaru soldiers in the Rebel Alliance. Due to the jungle environment of Iakar, the Iakaru Warriors have keen eyesight and strong spatial awareness, allowing them to effectively attack enemy defenses.

Ithorian Infiltrators were Ithorian commandos employed by the Alliance to Restore the Republic that specialized in infiltration tactics. They used a personal energy shield and modified ion blaster to get close to deflector shield generators and disable them.

Desert Soldiers were troopers that served in both the Alliance to Restore the Republic and New Republic that were trained to operate in all manner of desert environments.
Rinagom was a planet located in the Corporate Sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Site-145 was a location on the planet Filata.

Sebris Gamma was a village on the planet Hays Minor. It was destroyed by ground-penetrating incendiary bombs dropped by First Order bombers when the residents refused to follow the First Order's orders.

Drone vessel 171 was a drone freighter used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Forest Jetpack Troopers were Rebel Alliance Jetpack Troopers that were equipped with modified jetpacks, allowing to achieve greater agility, speed, and damage needed for combat in dense forest and jungle environments.

The Internal Organization Bureau, abbreviated IntOrg, was a branch in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Intelligence organization. They operated IntSec, the service's internal intelligence department, and IntCon, the service's counterintelligence department.

Candovantans, or Candovants, were a sentient species from the planet Candovant recognized by their bulbous, hairless heads and brown, tan, and red skin. The New Republic senator Zygli Bruss was a member of the species, as was the Resistance pilot Zizi Tlo.

Sector Plexus was a branch of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Intelligence organization. The branch was the core of Imperial Intelligence communications throughout the galaxy. It utilized a vast network of communications droids, the HoloNet, and the Imperial Compulink.

The Crimson Smiter was an MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 in the Resistance's Crimson Squadron. When a First Order TIE fighter crashed into its bomb bay, it set off a chain reaction which resulted in the Cobalt Hammer being the final bomber left.
The Battle of Chasidron Shoals was a battle where Resistance commandos were able to obtain the Vigil, a Vakbeor-class cargo frigate from pirates.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: The Select Committee, or the Select Council, of the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order (COMPNOR) was a secret entity that guided the commission's five major agencies.
The IntSec was the internal intelligence service of the Internal Organization Bureau, a sub-unit of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Intelligence organization.
The IntCon was the counterintelligence branch of the Internal Organization Bureau, a sub-unit of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Intelligence organization.
An argora was a type of bird that lived on Xendek. The Xendekians believed that the argora was the responsible for all the good fortune on the planet.

The General Staff was the leading command organization of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army. It was responsible for making decisions for army operations and was a component of Imperial High Command.
Stormtrooper Command was the leading command organization of the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps, a branch of the Imperial Army, and was part of Imperial High Command.

Battle Station Command (BSC), or Battlestation Command, was the command agency of Battle Station Operations and was responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the construction of the Death Star, and to ensure that operations were effective and efficient.
A clam was a type of mollusk. One such species of clam was a lee romay, found on Mon Cala. A lee romay held the crown presented to Prince Lee-Char when he became King of Mon Cala.
Metellos was a planet in the Metellos system, a star system in the Corusca sector of the Core Worlds. It was connected via a hyperspace route to the distant planet Ilum in the Unknown Regions.

Marking the start of what would be an occupation, the Galactic Empire's takeover of the Outer Rim planet Lothal occured soon after the Clone Wars and the establishment of the Empire when Lothal's government petitioned for aid and support.

conflict: Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire
x: After the takeover of the Outer Rim planet of Lothal by the Galactic Empire, Lothal saw a rise in insurgent activity. Among the earliest revolutionaries were Ephraim and Mira Bridger, who beamed out transmissions of hope and rebellion against the Empire.

Sanctuary Coast was a sprawling city located on the planet Alderaan that was built on enormous stilts on the border of a large inland sea. Throughout the city's history, its leaders were committed to offering assistance to refugees fleeing wars and oppression.

Engineering was one of eight major departments that made up the Galactic Empire's Battle Station Operations on board the planet-killing superweapon, the Death Star. The Death Star was later destroyed during the Battle of Yavin.

Personnel was one of eight major departments that made up the Galactic Empire's Battle Station Operations on board the planet-killing superweapon, the Death Star. The Death Star was subsequently destroyed during the Battle of Yavin.

Maintenance was one of eight major departments that made up the Galactic Empire's Battle Station Operations on board the Death Star, a planet-killing superweapon. The Death Star was subsequently destroyed during the Battle of Yavin.

Logistics was one of eight major departments that composed the Galactic Empire's Battle Station Operations on board the planet-killing superweapon, the Death Star. The Death Star was subsequently destroyed during the Battle of Yavin.

Medical was one of eight major departments that made up the Galactic Empire's Battle Station Operations on board the planet-killing superweapon, the Death Star. The Death Star was subsequently destroyed during the Battle of Yavin.

Security was one of eight major departments that made up the Galactic Empire's Battle Station Operations on board the Death Star, a planet-destroying superweapon. Security teams kept surveillance over the battle station until it was destroyed during the Battle of Yavin.

Technical support was one of eight major departments that made up the Galactic Empire's Battle Station Operations on board the planet-killing superweapon, the Death Star. The Death Star was subsequently destroyed during the Battle of Yavin.

Station defenses was one of eight major departments that made up the Galactic Empire's Battle Station Operations on board the Death Star, a planet-killing superweapon. The Death Star was ultimately destroyed during the Battle of Yavin.

The city of Aldera on the planet of Alderaan maintained highly skilled security forces that served as a law enforcement agency. It was notable for its deployment of non-lethal policing techniques and added to Alderaan's reputation of being a peaceful world.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: The Coalition for Improvements, or the Coalition of Improvements, was a division that was part of the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order organization.

Dendada XVII was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Dendada system in the Seswenna sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the location of the Imperial Internal Affairs Outpost utilized by the Galactic Empire's Internal Affairs.

The Bureau of Operations, or simply known as the Bureau, was a branch of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Intelligence organization that handled important covert operations that were beyond the standard operating scope of local resources.
Geejaws were a species of reptavians which lived on Endor. They could be made into geejaw omelettes.

Administration was an organization within the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire considered to be one of the army's countless less glamorous units, yet vital to the army's objectives. The organization was active during the Imperial Era, which lasted from 19 BBY to 5 ABY.
General maintenance was an organization within the Army of the Galactic Empire that was considered to be one of countless less glamorous units but was thought to be vital to the Army's mission.

Adjustments was a branch of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Intelligence organization. The elite secret agents that were part of Adjustments received critical assignments, and thus were allowed extreme flexibility to implement those missions.

Intelligence was a branch of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Intelligence organization, which was responsible for gathering information from Analysis and used its own experts to uncover trends, reporting them to officials throughout the galaxy.

Analysis was a branch within the Galactic Empire's Imperial Intelligence organization. Analysis was responsible for surveying and interpreting an abundance of surveillance data and information acquired daily.
The Infernum was a Zeta-class shuttle used by the Inquisitorius, an organization tasked with hunting Jedi.

Dac City was a city located above the oceans on the planet Mon Cala, which itself was also sometimes known as Dac. Sometime after the Proclamation of the New Order, King Lee-Char met with Imperial ambassador Telvar to discuss trade proposals between the Empire and Mon Cala here.
During the last decades of the Galactic Republic, an agricultural freighter in the Baobab Merchant Fleet embarked on an expedition to find Roonstones.

Resistance technicians, also known as a ground tech were technicians that were part of the Resistance's support staff. During the evacuation of D'Qar, they attached a temporary accelerator pod to the tail of Commander Poe Dameron's T-70 X-wing starfighter Black One.

conflict: Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire
result: The Mon Calamari destroy Dac City wiping out most of the Imperial grou
x: The Battle of Dac City was a conflict that occurred one year after the rise of the Galactic Empire, when Darth Vader undertook a mission to the planet Mon Cala to determine if a Jedi was hiding there and advising the Mon Calamari king, Lee-Char, in negotiations with the Empire.

The Canyons of Mist were a series of canyons on the forest moon of the planet Endor. Ewok warriors of Bright Tree Village were once directed to a cave there by the Dulok King Vulgarr, who claimed that a monster lived there who had kidnapped one of their young.

Tabu, along with Tebu, was one of the two moons that orbited the planet Cosia, located the Cosia system in Cosian Space, a region of the galaxy's Deep Core. The two moons were exhibited fully in Cosia's nighttime sky.

Tebu, along with Tabu, was one of the two moons that orbited the planet Cosia, located the Cosia system in Cosian Space, a region of the galaxy's Deep Core. The two moons were exhibited fully in Cosia's nighttime sky.

Whenever a clutch of Cosian eggs hatched, a great celebration would take place on the Deep Core planet Cosia. The Cosians would usually celebrate in their villages across Cosia, to honor new life and wisdom brought into the world.
Hiss-wyrmgrubs were a type of creature from the Sullustan homeworld, Sullust, that ate the roots of subterranean trees and chewed up underground gardens.

The First Order stormtrooper gunner was an variant of the standard stormtrooper used by the First Order. Their role was to man a F-Z0 antipersonnel blaster cannon on Atmospheric Assault Landers when landing on enemy territory.

The Stalwart was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in service to the Imperial Navy during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 2 BBY, the Star Destroyer served as the flagship of Admiral Kinshara's One Twenty-Fifth task force.
Bandit 1 was a Z-95 Headhunter in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Bandit Squadron. During the Galactic Civil War it served as Ace Azzameen's personal Z-95.

Valdeer were a type of creature found in the mountains of the planet Naalol. A series of small towns in the mountains were inhabited by valdeer shepherds as well as artisans and miners, although at least one such town was reduced to rubble after fighting on Naalol during the G…
Death Star City was the nickname given to a stretch of personnel housing that was located in the southern hemisphere of the Death Star.
The Northern Polar Command Sector, also known as simply the Northern PCS, was located in the Death Star's apex region, and held the combat leadership for the space station.
The wet-weather gear stormtrooper, also known as the imperial trench trooper and on Mimban called the Mimban Stormtrooper, was a variant of the Galactic Empire's standard stormtrooper.
Marriten was a remote planet located in the Marriten system.
These jellyfish-like creatures lived in the atmosphere of the planet Cantonica. Their tentacles could give an electric shock or disable machinery upon contact.

This droid scout ship was used to scout the planet Jakku, and was scheduled to leave on the afternoon following the attack on Tuanul. The loading droid F3-ZK was scheduled to be picked up at the Starship Graveyard by the droid ship, but fell into a trap set by Teedo.

Meor Ain was a terrestrial planet in the Meor Ain system in the Jubilar sector of the Outer Rim Territories where Dex Acquisitions operated a depot. Tunga Arpagion was rescued from the depot by the Rebel Alliance.

A listening station was located on Trohlu, the lone moon of the planet Aleen. The station, alongside an observation post, were operated by the Galactic Empire, and, despite the two structures, the Empire took a hands-off approach to Aleen.

An observation post was built by the Galactic Empire on the planet Aleen's moon Trohlu, alongside a listening station. The two structures were the only sign of the Empire's presence in the system, as they had taken a hands-off approach to Aleen.

result: The Resistance successfully rescues Lor San Tekka
objective: Rescue Lor San Tekka
x: During the Cold War, the Resistance launched a rescue of the explorer Lor San Tekka from the Great Forveen Nebula after he was dropped into the nebula by former First Order agent Terex.
PM-6986 was a planetoid located in the Outer Rim Territories' Anaxes asteroid belt. It had been formed by 19 BBY from the remains of the destroyed planet Anaxes.

The Imperial Court, also known as the Emperor's court, was the collective body of high ranking Imperial officials with close ties to Emperor Sheev Palpatine. The members of the Imperial Ruling Council and other advisors were all part of that elite.

The Planet Jumper was a Crinya-class freighter that had served the Alliance to Restore the Republic for about a decade. The ship was extensively modified during its lifetime with the Alliance, including additional hull plating and the mounting of triple laser cannons.
Gigor was a frigid planet located in the Tynquay sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, and was the homeworld of the Gigoran species.

result: Iakaru surrender and retreat further into the forests
x: During the Clone Wars, the Iakaru were massacred and forced to surrender after fierce resistance following the discovery of valuable chemical compounds on Iakar by Degan Explorations.

Toprawa was a remote planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Kalamith sector along the Hydian Way. It avoided much attention from the Galactic Republic and its successor, the Galactic Empire, who kept a research station.
During the Huk War, a conflict between the Yam'rii and Kaleesh sentient species, the Yam'rii assaulted Shrupak, considered by the Kaleesh to be the holiest temple on their homeworld Kalee.

After the Battle of Endor, the planet Abednedo was attacked by the Galactic Empire with a climate disruption array as part of Operation: Cinder. The planet was able to barely escape destruction due to local resistance and a New Republic special forces team.
Jexxel cats were a type of feline that lived in the caves that riddled the mountains of the frigid Outer Rim planet Gigor.
Jakobeasts were a brown-furred type of animal that inhabited the valleys between mountains on the snow-covered Outer Rim Territories planet Gigor.
Icetrompers were a type of giant creature that inhabited the valleys found between the mountains of the frigid, snow-covered, Outer Rim world Gigor.

Ambush spiders were a type of giant spider that lived as part of the vertical ecosystem that existed in the continent-spanning rain forests and dense jungles that grew in the equatorial latitudes of the Outer Rim Territories planet Iakar.

After the establishment of the Galactic Empire, an Imperial occupation force along with scientists from the Imperial Corps of Bioengineers were dispatched to occupy and recover medicinal properties found on Iakar.

objective: Recover the memories of 0-0-0
x: Around 1 ABY, the Tarkin Initiative's Hivebase-1 was infiltrated by Doctor Aphra, rebel general Hera Syndulla and a group of mercenaries hired by the Son-tuul Pride to recover the memories of the crime lord 0-0-0.
