The Vensenor was the decommissioned Venator-class Star Destroyer aboard which the Galactic Empire's Vensenor Flight Academy was based. During the Clone Wars, starfighter ace Bythen Forral, then a captain in the Galactic Republic Navy, was deployed aboard the Vensenor.

The Gallant was a Corellian corvette belonging to the Galactic Empire's Vensenor Flight Academy, located in orbit above the planet Arkanis. The commandant of the flight academy, Bythen Forral, commonly used the corvette for his personal business.

result: The Son-tuul Pride learn the memories are stored in Hivebase-1
objective: Learn what Wat Tambor did with the memories of 0-0-0
x: The Mission to Skako Minor was undertaken by members of the Son-tuul Pride to the workshop of Wat Tambor on Skako Minor to learn what the Skakoan had done with the memories of 0-0-0.

Members of the Son-tuul Pride attacked an Imperial settlement on Someilk to recover Clone Wars era data for the criminal organization's leader, 0-0-0. The Pride ultimately succeeded, securing the information and destroying the settlement.
The Internal Security Bureau was a feared agency within the Galactic Empire. Agents of the bureau were present everywhere in order to ensure proper loyalty.

Hive command was a command unit within the Tarkin Initiative that oversaw operations on Hivebase-1, a classified Tarkin Initiative research and development space station that was protected by a scaraphyte swarm.

Hutt clone troopers were cloned Hutt soldiers that were created under the Galactic Empire's Tarkin Initiative. Although they were rejected for wide-scale use, they were frozen in an archive aboard Hivebase-1, a secret Tarkin Initiative facility.

t: Unidentified planet (New Academy for Space Pilots)
x: A terrestrial planet was located in the galaxy, home to the New Academy for Space Pilots.
This unidentified moon was a small moon in the galaxy.
The Cargo Comet was a Wayfarer-class medium freighter that was part of Senator Bail Organa's secret resistance movement.

The Cargo Sky was a Wayfarer-class medium transport that was part of Senator Bail Organa's resistance movement During the blockade of the planet Ibaar, Organa ordered the Cargo Sky and the Cargo Comet to be loaded with supplies and military equipment and to deliver it to the r…

The New Republic Pilots Commission was a organization within the New Republic that the smuggler Han Solo grudgingly accepted the leadership of. In 7 ABY, the Commission was due to have its inaugural meeting which involved a weeks worth of planning and preparation.
Dubrillion was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

The Dark Trooper project, or the dark trooper program was a Republic Special Weapons Group and later Imperial Department of Military Research program whose goal was to create a force of soldiers known as "Dark Troopers" for the Galactic Empire.

The Death Star internal security personnel were security forces stationed onboard the Galactic Empire's Death Star that worked with agents from the Imperial Security Bureau to shut down black market operations in Death Star City, a sprawl of personnel housing and development i…
A commissary was located aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Devastator.

Sector delta was a location near the Umbaran airbase on the dark world of Umbara in the Expansion Region. During the Battle of Umbara, the Galactic Republic's 501st Legion was able to capture the Umbaran airbase from the Umbaran militia.
A planet existed in the galaxy that was home to a scrap eating worm species. In 4 ABY, Nien Nunb and Shriv Suurgav landed on the planet to look for two TIE fighters.

Snow shredder bats were a type of bat found on the Outer Rim Territories planet Gigor. They inhabited the caves that riddled the frigid world's mountains, which they shared with jexxel cats and sentient Gigorans, as well as edible mold and mushrooms that thrived around deep ho…

Zohakka XVII was an astronomical object which contained sea life that was located in the Zohakka system in the Corthenia sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square K-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Y6-T0 was an astromech droid who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Strokill Prime was a waterworld in the Outer Rim Territories where the Galactic Empire operated an underwater base. The Mon Calamari king Lee-Char was kept prisoner in the base on Strokill Prime, but was killed by stormtroopers during a Rebel Alliance rescue attempt.
A sandsnake was a type of snake. The scavenger Rey noted that Unkar Plutt could smell weakness like a sandsnake could smell a rat.

Refuse fields were located on Cymoon 1, a moon in the galaxy's Expansion Region. Whilst Han Solo, Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker infiltrated the weapons factory to destroy it, Chewbacca piloted the Millennium Falcon to the moon undetected and landed in the refuse fields.
During the Battle of Hoth, a funeral was held for the ace pilot Luke Skywalker, hero of the Battle of Yavin, who died one day before following a wampa's attack.

A Venator-class Star Destroyer was used to retrieve Jedi General Yoda, members of the Coruscant Guard, and the Toydarian Royal Delegation from Rugosa after a battle took place against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
08 was a Separatist BX-series droid commando that participated in the defense of Rishi Station, where they were subsequently destroyed.
09 was a Separatist BX-series droid commando that participated in the defense of Rishi Station, where they were subsequently destroyed along with 07 and 08.

The Cloud-Riders, also known as Enfys Nest's marauders, were a pirate gang led by Enfys Nest during the reign of the Galactic Empire that rode swoop bikes. Nest inherited leadership of the Cloud-Riders from her deceased mother.
The Defiance was an MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic by the closing stages of the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
The Independence was an MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic by the ending stages of the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
The Perpetuus was a red-and-white CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle that was used by the Galactic Republic.
The Acushnet was a Corona-class armed frigate that was originally going to be sold to investors and starship collectors following the end of the Separatist-planned production.
The Imperial Corps of Bioengineers was a scientific corps in the Galactic Empire that specialized in bioengineering.
The mission to Rentalles was launched by the Rebel Alliance to recover a Hyperwave signal interceptor.
An OOM command battle droid served under General Grievous, Supreme Commander of the Droid Army, aboard Grievous's frigate during the Battle of Bothawui.

The Paralyngian dire slug was a bloated gastropod credited to be discovered by the Devaronian hyperspace trailblazer Viron Ghartoth. By Ghartoth's standards, the slug was deemed "excellent" when lightly broiled.

Patrol troopers were a specialized variant of the Galactic Empire's stormtroopers, acting as a rapid response policing force within urban environments and serving as the urban equivalent to the scout trooper.

t: Mission to the twelfth moon of Yout
objective: Assassination
x: Some time before the raid on Ziro's Palace, the assassin droid KRONOS-327 was sent on a mission to the twelfth moon of Yout by Ziro the Hutt, to assassinate someone. The mission ended in his failure. KRONOS-327 returned to Ziro's Palace on Coruscant to report his failure.

The Coruscant Rescue Ops was a fire department that existed only to serve the greater good of Galactic City, Coruscant, by providing disaster relief whenever necessary. They notably put out fires using emergency fire suppression speeders.

The crackdown on Pipada was the Galactic Empire's response to protests by the Drabatan species of the Outer Rim planet Pipada following the Empire's establishment, which occurred in 19 BBY. The Imperial forces blockaded the planet and deployed swamptroopers to its surface.

A Drabatan-led movement was formed on the Outer Rim planet Pipada in the name of the young singer Sa'Kalla after she was captured and tortured by the Galactic Empire for speaking out against its rule by 1 BBY.
DD-BD was a WDD adminmech droid that operated within the control hub of mining operations on Kessel. Before being sold into slavery, DD-BD served on a Morseerian pirate ship.
Endee was an R1-series astromech droid that was present on the planet Mon Cala one year into the reign of the Galactic Empire.

place: Mon Calamari Royal Palace, Mon Cala
x: Following the Battle of Mon Cala during the Clone Wars, a coronation was held for Lee-Char as he was crowned king of the planet Mon Cala.

The Fromprath were a sentient, snakelike, six-armed species that lived in the galaxy. Hundreds of years before 3 BBY, the Fromprath lived on an Outer Rim planet but were forced to live in exile away from the planet after being forced out by the Nightsisters, who renamed the wo…
Xifal was a planetoid located in Xifal system, within the Allied Tion sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
2638 was a B1-series battle droid in the Droid Army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems that was active during the Clone Wars.

result: Lar Kantayan recalled and reassigned to Vardos for failing to accompli
objective: Infiltrate the Partisans
x: Sometime prior to Inferno Squad's infiltration of the Dreamers, Agent Lar Kantayan was sent by the Imperial Security Bureau to infiltrate the Partisans, an extremist rebel cell led by Saw Gerrera.

The Imperial Supply Corps, also known as Logistics and Supply,, the Imperial Supply Fleet, or simply Imperial Supply, was a subdivision of the Galactic Empire that dealt with the transportation of supplies.
The Duel on the Imperial Palace was a confrontation that took place on the Imperial Palace of Coruscant, formerly the Jedi Temple of the Jedi Order, in 5 ABY.

An showdown occurred in 19 BBY on a forested planet between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic in an attempt to recover the carbonite block in which the smuggler Han Solo was frozen, which was being delivered to the Empire by the bounty hunter Boba Fett.
Ven-Kav was the capital city of the planet Venaari. It was the location of the local Imperial Command Center, the Binary Bar, and Ven-Kavi Starport

The Vermillion was a clunky, modified ZV-9 freighter that belonged to the pilot Taka Jamoreesa. It was disguised as a basic New Republic transport, trying to bypass the New Republic's efforts to de-militarize.

Ardennians were a sentient, simian-like species that were native to Ardennia. Due to their extra pair of arms and prehensile toes, the species was known for being extremely agile, nimble and quick-thinking under pressure.
The Chevalier was a New Republic shuttle under the command of Captain Krull. After a standoff near Substation Grimdock, the Chevalier was sent by Krull to inspect and board the Vermillion.
Burundang was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Burundang system in the Harron sector of the Expansion Region where Han Solo bought a play blaster for his son Ben Solo.

Kizbon's Box was a Helix-class light interceptor operating during the Galactic Civil War. It was the target of an ambush near Darknon Station by a pirate band led by Larken. However, the three vessels under his command were destroyed by the Crotok pilot.
BX-778, abbreviated BX or Beex, was a Class three culinary septoid droid with masculine programming, that belonged to Han Solo and his wife Leia Organa.

The Campalan mountain range was a mountain range located on the southeastern peninsula of the Forest Moon of Endor. It contained cliffs on which well-compensated, humanely-treated Ewok farmers picked dark-brown Endorian caf beans.

The End of Days was a Keldabe-class cruiser of the Zann Consortium's pirate fleet, that served as the flagship of Admiral Jerid Sykes. The End of Days was staffed by some of the Consortium's best officers and crew, and was often used as Tyber Zann's personal transport.
Sabacc Squadron was an elite starfighter squadron of the Zann Consortium composed of StarViper Mk. II.
The Rabbit's Foot was a WUD-500 star yacht owned by the smuggler Jaxxon.

Aduba-3 was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Aduba system in the Outer Rim Territories' Bheriz sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the smuggler Jaxxon visited Aduba-3 and acquired memory chips for his repair droid, ML-08.
Azmorigan's henchmen were a cadre of mercenaries and bodyguards regularly hired by the Jablogian crime lord Azmorigan.

t: Battle between Ord Mantell and Genassa
place: Deep space between Ord Mantell and Genassa
x: A battle occurred circa 0 ABY between the fleets of the Zann Consortium and the Veiled Sorority. It resulted in the death of Noira, the Pirate Queen of the Sorority, and ended the war between the two pirate groups.

Alzoc III, also known as Alzoc, was a frozen planet located in the Sujimis sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Talz species. The world was taken over by the Galactic Empire due to its exploitable mineral wealth.
Baltro was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Baltro system in the Onatos sector of the Mid Rim Territories.

Teeks were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. At some point, a crashed ark brought Teeks to the moon of Endor. When Han Solo and Lando Calrissian were searching for a pilot on Frander's Bay, Solo pushed his way through a group of Teek before dodging a lumbering Kullp.

The Kullp were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. When Han Solo and Lando Calrissian were searching for a pilot on Frander's Bay, Solo dodged a lumbering Kullp after he pushed his way through a group of Teek.

During the Clone Wars, Jedi Knight Pablo-Jill and Separatist General Grievous had an intense duel in a collapsing satellite city above the planet Duro. Pablo-Jill was injured by Grievous, who stole Pablo-Jill's lightsaber from the floating debris of the city.

The Blue Stars were an organization that around 3 BBY was present along with representatives from the Galactic Empire and Droid Gotra at an auction in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica held by Cli Pastayra of the Wandering Star for a device known as the Phylanx Redux Transmi…
Crimson Dawn was a criminal syndicate once led by the former Sith Lord Maul, who became the leader of the Shadow Collective near the end of the Clone Wars.
Wisties, also known as fire sprites or firefolk, were a small, radiant, sentient species native to the Forest Moon of Endor.

The Lady Luck was a Luxury 3000 space yacht belonging to Lando Calrissian, who bought it shortly after the Battle of Endor from an Orthellin royal mistress. Calrissian, Kaasha Bateen, Florx Biggles and Lobot used the ship to travel to Chandrila.
In 1 ABY, a trade summit was held on the planet Sarka, in the Mid Rim. It took place to establish commercial relations between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Sarkan people.
The Skyjumper was a freighter captained by Drev Jalok and crewed by Sullub Soonin. The ship was attacked by the pirate Drek Drednar while on route to the Altier system.
CD601 was a contruction droid infected with the caretaker virus.
The pacification of Hyrol Preen Beta was an event that resulted in the destruction of the planet Hyrol Preen Beta by the Galactic Empire.

A battle took place on Baltro at some point during the reign of the Galactic Empire. During the battle, Lando Calrissian saw Kaasha Bateen for the last time before she showed up on Cloud City on Bespin with a class of Twi'leks two years after the Battle of Jakku.

Hoopaloo were a sentient species covered head to toe in ruffled feathers, which could be brown with blue highlights. They had a sharply hooked beak, and their feet had three toes forward and one back.

The White Worms were a criminal organization led by Lady Proxima based on Corellia that existed during the Imperial Era. Also known as the White Worm Gang, its members included the human scrumrats Han, Qi'ra, and Rebolt, as well as the Grindalid enforcer Moloch.

First Light was a Nau'ur-class yacht owned by the near-human crime lord Dryden Vos of Crimson Dawn who used it as a personal residence and mobile base of operations for the crime syndicate. It fell into the possession of Qi'ra after Vos's death.
Lammaxian turkeys were an avian species from a jungle planet.
A red droid operated on behalf of the Cyban Front criminal organization during the time of the Galactic Empire.

A droid represented the Cyban Front at the Auction of Rur with another Cyban Front droid. The two questioned the crystal's technopathy abilities and the host, Chelli Aphra, let the crystal possess it until her companion, Krrsantan, destroyed it.
This unidentified moon was one of the five moons that orbited Ryloth, a planet located in the Gaulus sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Krassbrucker was a medium-sized corvette that served in the New Republic Defense Fleet two years after the Battle of Jakku.

The Tribulan Vort was a Star Cruiser that served as the flagship of Captain Krull in the New Republic Defense Fleet two years after the Battle of Jakku. It deployed squadrons of new RZ-2 A-wing interceptors during the blockade of Substation Grimdock.
The Radium Destrobar was a Mon Cal frigate captained by the Cosian Viz Moshara.
This starship was piloted by Luke Skywalker on a mission for the Rebel Alliance to deliver pre-Empire micro-books to the planet Harix in 1 ABY. Accompanying Luke were the droids C-3PO, and R2-D2.
An OOM command battle droid served as a commanding officer during the Battle of Ryloth. The droid was destroyed at the bridge control of Lessu City.

Beckett's gang, also known as Tobias Beckett's gang, Tobias Beckett's crew, Beckett's crew, or Tobias Beckett's group, was a gang led by the criminal Tobias Beckett some time during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

The planet Fondor hosted a research and development division that engineered experimental new technologies for the Galactic Empire such as climate disruption arrays. Imperial R&D scientists stationed over Fondor created Fortune of Fondor, an experimental mask.
Heroes of the Republic Boulevard was a road in Hanna City on the planet Chandrila. The street was commonly very busy with crowds of people.

Revolina Street was a street in Hanna City on the planet Chandrila. After attending a New Republic pilot's union meeting at the Chandrila Senate house in 7 ABY, the smuggler Han Solo began to walk back to his apartment by turning off of Heroes of the Republic Boulevard onto Re…

A campaign occurred on the astronomical object Zaloriis shortly before the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY. The conflict involved the Galactic Empire and the Zalorians, the inhabitants of Zaloriis, and came about in response to a revolt there.

The Frizznoth were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They were short in stature, and at least some members utilized giant mechanized battle armor to compensate for their small size. Mozeen Parapa, head of the Parapa Cartel, was a male Frizznoth.

KR2-M80 was an astromech droid that was forced to work in the control room of the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel. The droid featured a silver dome, and white and yellow plating and it used an Intellex IV droid brain.

R5-232 was an R5 series astromech droid with white, black, grey and blue plating and silver sensors. Like all R5 astromech droids, it was manufactured by Industrial Automaton and stood ninety-seven centimeters tall.
R2-S8 was an R2-series astromech droid with white, black and red plating and a black sensor. Like all R2 astromech droids, it stood 93 centimeters tall and was manufactured by Industrial Automaton.
R5-PHT was a black and silver plated R5 series astromech droid that served the Galactic Empire. It was equipped with a Kerner Optical holographic projector and had black sensors.
Raysol Prime was an astronomical object located in the Colonies and the Interior, within the Duluur sector's Raysol Prime system. It was situated in grid square M-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Grava was a moon located in the Grava system. The Galactic Empire operated an asylum on the moon, but it was later inhabited by the Brotherhood of Wire and Bone.
An aquatic sentient species existed in the galaxy. They had purple or pink skin. Three notable members of this species were Moggee, Sylvestarr, and Ziggee.

The Karee Blockade Clutch was an event that took place in 7 ABY in the vicinity of the Expansion Region's Karee system. During the event, the Vorantis—a ship owned by the pilot Brantis Mo Fresk—beat the starship Brightfox.
The Vorantis was a starship owened by the pilot Brantis Mo Fresk. In 7 ABY, Mo Fresk participated in the Karee Blockade Clutch in his ship where he beat the starship Brightfox.

Pasa Novo was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Pasa Novo system in the Onatos sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was the site of the Pasa Novo campaign during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

The Great Ungeness Trench was an underwater trench on the ocean-world Mon Cala. In 18 BBY, after the destruction of Dac City, Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader sunk to the trench, and faced a large creature.

S1D6-SA-5 was a red-colored SA-5 protocol droid that saw use in a control hub of the Spice mines of Kessel. S1D6-SA-5 and the other droids used by the Pykes were freed in 10 BBY during an slave uprising started by the droid L3-37.

The Trade Federation outpost was constructed on the moon Alaris Prime between 39 BBY and 36 BBY to produce B1-series battle droids for the Trade Federation Droid Army. It contained two buildings, a troop center and a power core, both surrounded by a light wall.
The Frander's Bay Shuttle was a Model Eleven Corellian transport shuttle used by the smugglers Han Solo and Lando Calrissian to travel from Hanna City to Frander's Bay to search for a pilot.

Preevow Sector was a location in Pau City on the planet Utapau. Prior to being kidnapped by members of the Wandering Star, Fyzen Gor and Greesto Ftrak had talked about opening their own offsite surgical center in the sector after their graduation.
During the Imperial Period, the Galactic Empire enacted a bombardment of the politically-influential planet Mindabaal. The planet was left in ruins with only a few survivors.
A filth beetle was a type of beetle that could be found on the planet Utapau.
The Phylanx Redux Transmitter, also known as Number One, was originally a medical droid owned by the Pau'an-led Wandering Star crime syndicate.

ML-08, also referred to as Mel, was a maintenance droid that served aboard the smuggler Jaxxon T. Tumperakki's starship the WUD-500 star yacht Rabbit's Foot. Mel was considered to be "the worst maintenance droid" ever by Jaxxon.

A species of squid-like creatures lived deep within the oceans of the planet Mon Cala. The creatures were believed to be as old as the planet itself, and many avoided delving into the Great Ungeness Trench in which it resided.
The Imperial paratrooper force was a unit of the Imperial Military. General Rom Mohc was a highly decorated member of the Imperial paratrooper force.

Accresker Jail was a wreckage-prison that was operated by the Galactic Empire. The mobile prison was considered to have a low survival rate, as remembered by Chelli Lona Aphra, who was captured by the Empire's Magna Tolvan on Son-tuul.

A remote uninhabited planet was located beyond the Outer Rim Territories. Around the Galactic Civil War, Darth Vader overheard Graballa the Hutt informing Vader that he had captured Rowan Freemaker at the former Freemaker garage.
Nodo's yacht was a yacht that was owned by Rekias Nodo.
Trogodiles were a species from the planet Rattatak.
Control Room 327 was a Death Star control room.
A translucent clam was a type of clam that, along with kiln oysters, provided decorative shells and lustrous pearls in the oceans of the planet Lew'el.
Valorum's shuttle was an Eddicus-class planetary shuttle used by Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum to greet Queen Padmé Amidala when she arrived on Coruscant.
The Renegade's Blood was a Consular-class cruiser that served as the flagship of the Veiled Sorority pirate fleet.
The Savrip was a Marauder-class corvette that served as the first flagship of the Veiled Sorority pirate fleet.
The Rotten Core was a YT-2400 light freighter that served in the Veiled Sorority pirate fleet.
The Eye of Uba was a ILH-KK Citadel-class civilian cruiser that served in the Veiled Sorority pirate fleet.
The Censure was a Action VI bulk transport that served in the Zann Consortium fleet until it was captured by the Veiled Sorority.
The Vanity's Price was a Action VI bulk transport that served in the Zann Consortium fleet until it was captured by the Veiled Sorority.
The Flatline was an Interceptor IV-class frigates that served in the fleet of the Zann Consortium.
The Brilliance was an Interceptor IV-class frigates that served in the fleet of the Zann Consortium.
The Retribution was a Star Galleon-class frigate that served in the fleet of the Zann Consortium.

The Vuutun Palaa was a Lucrehulk-class battleship that served as part of the Trade Federation in the capacity of a droid-controlling vessel during the Invasion of Naboo, where it was at the heart of the Federation blockade.

The Corkscrew was a section of the Boonta Eve Classic podrace course that consisted of several small, weaving turns. Located on the course after the hazardous Jett's Chute, the Corkscrew ended where the narrow Devil's Doorknob passageway opened onto the Hutt Flats.

The Emperor's personal shuttle, or simply the Emperor's shuttle, was a shuttle used by Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine. Heavily modified, the Lambda-class T-4a shuttle featured a cloaking device that rendered it invisible to all known forms of energy.
Sector One was a location on the planet Anaxes, utilized by the Separatist Alliance's droid army during the Clone Wars' Battle of Anaxes in 19 BBY.
Mesula was an ice moon located in the Mid Rim Territories. Many eons before around 11 BBY, Mesula underwent a cataclysmic rupture, causing it to shatter.
Shuttle Six was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by the Galactic Empire to transport Doctor Aphra and the low-riskers from the wreckage of Hivebase-1 to Accresker Jail.
The Hapes Consortium was an organization that ruled the Hapes Cluster, which was a sector of hundreds of stars in the Inner Rim of the galaxy, including Hapes.

A wedding was held for the sister of the HoloNet News reporter Calliope Drouth sometime before Drouth attended the Imperial Ball in the Imperial Palace on Coruscant. Whilst at the wedding, Drouth wore an ivory dress.

A Lurmen village was located on the planet Qalydon during the Imperial Era. Its chief was Biz, father of Maynar and husband of Elan. The settlement was liberated by the Freemakers from the Galactic Empire within a year before the decisive Rebel victory at the Battle of Endor.

Operation Cobalt was an operation undertaken by the Alliance to Restore the Republic at some point before the Battle of Endor. During the operation, Colonel Anna Seertay of the Rebel Alliance's Pathfinders was killed.
Valtos was a rocky planet located in the Valtos system of Wild Space. In 9 BBY, Han Solo was at Valtos space port before being captured by the bounty hunters Zuckuss and 4-LOM.

Zalorians were the inhabitants of the astronomical object Zaloriis. Shortly before the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, the Zalorians fought the reigning Galactic Empire on Zaloriis, who had to put down a revolt there.

result: The Order of Zildrog is defeated and Zildrog is destroyed
The Eternal Alliance loses the Gravestone and the Eternal Fleet
objective: Prevent the Order of Zildrog from activating Zildrog
x: The mission to Nathema was the Eternal Alliance's attempt to stop the Order of Zildrog from awakening Iokathi machine god Zildrog on Nathema.
Mustafarian Soldiers, also known as Mustafar Sentries, were nothern Mustafarians enlisted by the Confederacy of Independent Systems to guard their smelting facilities on the planet Mustafar.

The Taung & Zhell Society was a student society at the University of Coruscant, on the planet of the same name. The society shared its name with the Taung and Zhell, two ancient and historical sentient species from Coruscant.
The excavation on Durkteel occurred in 34 ABY on the planet Durkteel when a construction crew were clearing the ground of the ruins of the Tak-Beam complex for a comm tower.

Crevasse City was a city on the Core World Alderaan that was the first and largest of the canyon cities. It was built into the walls of a massive canyon, which allowed it to conceal everything from dwellings to heavy industry underground.
A scatterbug was a type of insect that could be found on the planet Kashyyyk.
The Whahalla Massacre was an incident that occurred after the Garosians and the Sundars signed a truce in an attempt to end the Garosian civil war.

leader: Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader
x: Purge Troopers, also known as Purge Stormtroopers, were a specialized variant of stormtroopers utilized by the Galactic Empire as expendable death squads.

Bel City was an underwater city on the Outer Rim world of Mon Cala. In 18 BBY, Jedi Padawan Ferren Barr and his group of followers were located in an underwater cave by the Galactic Empire's Inquisitors, led by the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader.
There existed a sentient species of tall bipeds characterized by a horse-like elongated snout. Notable members of that species included Defancio Storsilt and Askroh.
In 18 BBY, Jedi Padawan Ferren Barr and his group of acolytes maintained a cave refuge near Bel City on the Outer Rim planet Mon Cala.

conflict: Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire
x: In the aftermath of the Battle of Dac City in 18 BBY on Mon Cala, Imperial Colonel Bergon's sky-base was attacked in the planet's northern hemisphere by a squad of Mon Calamari aquatic vehicles led by Commander Gial Ackbar.

A creature lived in the oceans of the planet Mon Cala. During the Battle of Dac City, two of these creatures were deployed by King Lee-Char, jumping above the water's surface and crashing back down, creating a large wave that destroyed Dac City.

The Mist Hunter was a modified Byblos Drive Yards G-1A starfighter owned by the bounty hunter Zuckuss, used by him and his companion 4-LOM. Holding cells aboard Mist Hunter were used to hold Beris Ford and Han Solo after his capture on the planet Valtos.
The Spice Cartel was a criminal organization that controlled the spice trade from within the underworld of the planet Coruscant, capital of the Galactic Republic.
Arbra was a planet covered in woodlands that was located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Fort Ypso, also known as Ypsobay Trading Company headquarters, was a snowy mountain village on the planet Vandor. The buildings were built into the side of a mountain and could be reached by wooden bridges.

t: Mission to explore a tomb on Athiss
objective: Discover Force-related knowledge
x: A group of lore seekers went to Athiss to explore a tomb they mistakenly believed was of a Jedi. They arrive at the Far Orbit Resort and Lodge before journeying to the ruins.
The Bearers of the Claatuvac stacks were a small group of Wookiee scouts who swore to protect HoloGrids until the liberation of Kashyyyk.

During the Clone Wars, a Munificent-class star frigate served within the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems and was commanded by the T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid TF-1726.

Citadel Command was a command unit stationed within the Citadel prison on the planet Lola Sayu. Commanded by the Phindian Commander Osi Sobeck, the unit was also operated by several OOM-series security droids and the T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid K2-B4.
Sullust Control was an agency responsible for monitoring space traffic on the planet Sullust.

result: Lando Calrissian loses shipment of All Terrain Defense Turret walkers
x: After the Battle for Tatooine, Tatooine rebel cell of the Rebel Alliance came in possession of Calrissian's holojournals, including Holojournal Entry 1983712, and received chatter from the criminal underworld of the older and heavily-armed AT-DT walkers being utilized.

Grievous's frigate was a Munificent-class star frigate used as the personal flagship of General Grievous in the Confederacy of Independent Systems' naval forces during the Clone Wars between the Confederacy and Galactic Republic.
A pale purple gas giant was located in an unnamed star system within the galaxy.

A skirmish broke out in an unnamed star system between the Rebel Alliance and Galactic Empire when the Empire attacked a convoy of rebel starships protecting Princess Leia Organa as they were traveling through the system.

The Scout Undead Trooper was the name given to Imperial scout troopers that succumbed to "the Sickness," a virus that turned dead beings into mindless, walking corpses known as Undead Troopers with cannibalistic urges.

The Heavy Undead Trooper was the name given to Imperial Heavy Weapons Stormtroopers that had succumbed to "the Sickness," a virus that turned dead beings into mindless, walking corpses known as Undead Troopers with cannibalistic urges.
A small rocky moon orbited a mountainous planet. During 3 ABY the moon was destroyed by Naare while using the Kyber Saber.

t: Grievous's Munificent-class star frigate (suspected Confederate space)
x: During the Clone Wars, a Munificent-class star frigate served in the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, and was used by Kaleesh Separatist General Grievous.
ASN-121 was a modified ASN courier droid used as an assassin droid by the Clawdite bounty hunter Zam Wesell.

The dead lands was the centerpoint of the nuclear accident near Calliope Station that caused the devastation of Parnassos. It was a fenced-off area on the planet Parnassos, where faded signs and the Gand Churkk warned visitors of the dangers of entering.

Jendirian Valley was an AA-9 Freighter-Liner in service during the Separatist Crisis. After a failed plot to assassinate Senator Padmé Amidala of Naboo, she and her Jedi escort secretly traveled back to her homeworld aboard the Jendirian Valley.
The Refugee Relief Movement was an organization that transformed AA-9 Freighter-Liners to serve as refugee transports and help people in need.
The Sunstrider was a quadjumper owned by Mhar'li, a pilot who worked salvage runs out of Jakku.

The rings of Geonosis were a set of planetary rings that orbited the planet Geonosis. They were created when a two kilometer-wide comet collided with one of Geonosis' moonlets. The rings' asteroids were mined for raw materials to construct the first Death Star.
Kiara's Comet Cluster was a comet cluster in the Hartaga system in the Drannik sector of the Expansion Region in grid square K-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Hutt Clan operated a smuggling site on the desert planet of Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War, where goods were smuggled off-world.

Eons before 7 ABY, the ice moon Mesula ruptured, which resulted in its shattering. Sometime later, the smuggler Lando Calrissian and the droid L3-37 visited the Remnants of Mesula after she received a transmission from D9.

Pripraks were creatures that could be found in Chandrilan forests. In 7 ABY, while Han Solo and Lando Calrissian smoked Chandrilan monjavs on Solo's bedroom balcony, gentle hoots of pripraks from the forests and faraway laughter filled the night.

Preepnobs were creatures that could be found in garren trees along the Grand Promenade of the Rebellion in Hanna City on Chandrila. In 7 ABY, as Lando Calrissian and Kaasha Bateen walked along the promenade preepnobs hooted back and forth in the garren trees.
The Moonglow was a light freighter owned and operated by Lorcu Malshae and his Twi'lek co-pilot Par'tha. The ship was destroyed over Ord Mantell.
The Azumels were a sentient six-eyed species native to Azum. Argus Panox was a member of this species.

The Imperial River Base was an Imperial installation near the Wookiee city of Kepitenochan. Imperial forces from the base attacked the Government Tree in Kepitenochan during the Liberation of Kashyyyk.
The Royal Naboo Security Forces Missile Trooper was a specialized soldier who carried a missile launcher. The troopers could also become Armored Missile Troopers and carry two launchers.
Wild crawlers were multi-legged arthropods with biting mandibles. They were found on the planet GH-531.
This recon pod was built by Jessika Pava in 34 ABY for a reconnaissance mission on Starkiller Base following the Hosnian Cataclysm.
The Strus clan operated a compound on Jakku in 34 ABY.

This sewer system was a collection of sewers underneath Gorse City on the planet Gorse. By 11 BBY groundquakes on Gorse had rendered the sewers useless, and only certain beings like Skelly even knew that they existed.

The oevvaor was a large, ferocious marine reptile from the planet Kashyyyk. The Wookiees named a model of jet catamaran after it. The catamaran's prow was also modeled after the axe-like horn found on the head of a male oevvaor.
The Eternal Empire military was the military force of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul.

result: Inhabitants flee to the Gungan Sacred Place

manufacturer: Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps

x: GEMINI 16 was a GEMINI model droid, one of thousands used by the Eternal Empire of Zakuul as captains of the Eternal Fleet.

The Tran Mariel runyip was a subspecies of Runyip from Tran Mariel. Like their cousins found on Yavin 4, the Tran Mariel runyip had possessed hooves and tapered ears but instead of a long snout they possessed a long trunk and a shaggy coat of hair.
Czerialus was a planet in the Czerialus system in the Kailion sector of the Expansion Region that was the homeworld of the Czerialan species.

Ardennia was an Outer Rim Territories planet that was the homeworld of the sentient Ardennian species. The human Juronus Opto and the Wayuning Topi Topi were also native to that world, and the inhabitants of Ardennia held repeated events known as Mynock roasts.
Czerialans were a sentient species native to the planet Czerialus. They resembled humans with high cranial domes with tufts of white hair. Jannitha Xoczuko was a member of this species.
Operation Starbird was an Alliance to Restore the Republic operation to the Imperial-controlled planet Goroth Prime during the Galactic Civil War.

Summa-verminoth were a gigantic, space-faring species of legend that dwelled in the Akkadese Maelstrom around the planet Kessel. With numerous eyes and electrified tentacles that they used to ensnare prey, summa-verminoth were often misunderstood creatures.

result: Imperial Army troopers return to Camp Forward rather than press forwar
Han Solo and Chewbacca escape Mimban with Beckett's gang
x: The battle on Mimban, also known as the battle at Mimban, was one of the bloodiest battles of the Imperial Military's Mimban Campaign. The engagement was also infiltrated by Beckett's gang in order to steal an Y-45 armored transport hauler for their planned heist on Vandor.

result: The Cloud-Riders obtain the coaxium stolen by Beckett's gang
Tobias Beckett and Dryden Vos are killed
x: The showdown on Savareen was a skirmish that broke out in 10 BBY on the planet Savareen between the Crimson Dawn crime syndicate, the gang of Tobias Beckett's and the Cloud-Riders to determine who would take control of the coaxium Beckett and his gang had stolen from Kessel.

A gang dispute was caused on the planet Eshan by the infamous Droid Gotra during the reign of the Galactic Empire, resulting in the loss of many innocents. During the choas of the dispute, Tayshin Maxa learned harsh survival skills which she taught to her sister Moda.

Eshan was a planet in the Eshan system of the Inner Rim Territories where the infamous Droid Gotra caused a gang dispute, resulting in the loss of many innocents. Eshan was also the homeworld of Tayshin Maxa and Moda Maxa.

Corellian Security Forces, also known simply as CorSec, was a local civilian law enforcement agency on the planet Corellia. As Gus Talon, a moon of Corellia, lacked a substantial security force of its own, CorSec were deployed to the moon in cases of civil unrest.

Rwookrrorro was the capital of the planet Kashyyyk, homeworld of the Wookiees. An inland tree city located several hundred kilometers of Kachirho, in an area of exceptionally tall wroshyr trees, Rwookrrorro reached up through the canopies.
The Nephrans were a sentient crustacean species that were native to the water-rich planet Nepotis. Therm Scissorpunch was a member of this species.
The Oktarians were the human inhabitants of the planet Oktaro.

Oktaro was the home planet of a human culture known as the Oktarians. It was located in the Oktaro system in Lannik Space, within the Mid Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, it was invaded by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and liberated by the Galactic Republic.

Octeroids were an amphibious sentient species native to the aquatic world of Octero IV. They were known galaxy-wide for their striking appearance and simple lifestyle. They were thought to be gentle giants with little technology, preferring to stay on their homeworld.

Corellia's nearest moon was the nearest moon to the Core planet Corellia. When traveling into space aboard a shuttle, Han noted that he could see everything from the ship's hull to Qi'ra's face to Corellia's nearest moon in bright relief and perfect detail.

The Mimbanese were one of several sentient species native to the planet Mimban. Experts in guerrilla warfare, the Mimbanese had the unsettling ability to seemingly disappear into the mud and murk of their homeworld.

Danzikans were a swamp-dwelling, two-headed sentient species native to the swamp world of Danzik. Similar to the Troigs, both heads were independent and they used this to their advantage in card games and business deals.

During the later period of the Clone Wars, Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi flew an Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor. Kenobi piloted the interceptor during a mission to rescue Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine during the Battle of Coruscant.

Drashima III was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Drashima system in the Majoor sector of the Expansion Region where a toxic mushroom was found by Jenra and her staff during Jenra's time as a Senior applications engineer in the Galactic Empire.
The tech squad was a branch of the Canto Bight Police Department that protected the coastal city of Canto Bight at the planet Cantonica.

A planet was located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. In order to get away from the service of the Galactic Empire, Jenra had spent two decades sending money in small amounts, so it wouldn't attract attention, to an untraceable account on this planet.
The Ungrila were a sentient species in the galaxy. They had several pairs of horns above their mouths. Yasto Attsmun, Brushaun, and a crime boss were members of this species.

The Silo was a work camp located in the Bottoms of Coronet City on the planet Corellia. The Silo territory was infamous as a place run by some of the nastiest people on Corellia, where the life expectancy of its orphans was less than eighteen standard years old.
Ushruu was a forested planet in the Ushruu system in the Altier sector of the Expansion Region. It was also the homeworld of the Enchantress, a female Force-sensitive human.
Elgamor 5 was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Elgamor system in the Maldrood sector of the Mid Rim Territories. The smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca once visited Elgamor 5.
The chasm was a location on the planet Ushruu. It was considered a nexus in the Force.

t: Raid on the Orinda fuel depot
x: At some point the marauder Enfys Nest raided a fueling depot on Orinda. Following the raid, Batcha Hunaris, who had worked as a security guard at the depot, joined Nest and her gang.

Scrumrat referred to children that were taken in by the White Worms. After she took over control of the Unbroken Clan, Grand Leader Vukorah freed a number of the scrumrats from Lady Proxima to serve her.
Fleek eels were a species of eel with gray skin, a defined dorsal ridge and a pink, fleshy opening to their buccal tunnel. Most species considered it a delicacy.

Coppergrins were a species of copper-colored, black-eyed scalefin fish found in the oceans of the planets Corellia and Ahch-To. The fish were caught by the Lanai on Ahch-To; on Corellia, they were sold in the fishmarkets of Coronet City.

Needlegawps were a species of black-eyed scalefin fish with several varieties, including the silver-colored sleek needlegawp and the green-spotted, yellow-skinned speckled needlegawp. The fish were found in the oceans of the planets Corellia and Ahch-To.
Lancepykes were a type of fish that were a staple of the fishmarkets in the coastal Coronet City on the planet Corellia during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Garsmelt was a type of fish that could be found in the oceans of the planet Corellia. It was one of the staples sold in the fishmarkets of the Syllain District in coastal Coronet City.

Grindalids were a annelid sentient species native to Persis IX, an Expansion Region planet with a dense atmosphere that blocked out the light of its star. As such, they had photosensitive skin that caused them to burn very easily when exposed to sunlight.
Marca was a terrestrial swamp planet in the Marca system of the Meerian sector within the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories. It fell within grid square N-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Imroosians were a sentient species that existed within the galaxy from the volcanic planet Imroosia. Imroosians developed flinty, chalk-like skin, cracked like dried out desert ground, to adapt to their heated climate and were hairless.
The Silver Howl was a modified YT-2400 light freighter piloted by the smuggler Astrid Fenris.

Yir Tangee was a planet in the Yir Tangee system of the Colonies and the Interior. It was situated in grid square L-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The planet was the homeworld of two humans, the smuggler Astrid Fenris and Ace Squadron pilot Freya Fenris.
Oslumpex V was the homeworld of the smuggler Tregga. It was located in the Oslumpex system in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square S-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Numidian Prime was a jungle planet on the edge of the galaxy's Mid Rim, known for being a haven for smugglers and thieves, such as the bounty hunter Shenda Mol, who operated a stronghold on the planet.

The Corellian royalty sponsored exploration and colonization initiatives that helped expand the borders of the Old Republic thousands of years before the reign of the Galactic Empire. Prince-Admiral Jonashe Solo was a member of the Corellian royalty.

The Dark Star Hellions were a rival biker group of the Cloud-Riders led by Enfys Nest during the rule of the Galactic Empire. The Cloud-Rider's colors were boldly displayed on their swoop bikes to distinguish themselves from the Dark Star Hellions and the Nova Demons.

The Nova Demons were a rival biker group of the Cloud-Riders led by Enfys Nest during the rule of the Galactic Empire. The Cloud-Rider's colors were boldly displayed on their swoop bikes to distinguish themselves from Nova Demons and the Dark Star Hellions.

Persis IX was an Expansion Region world that was home to the sentient, worm-like Grindalid species. Its dense atmosphere blocked most of the light, to which the Grindalids' eyes and skin were highly sensitive.

The Frontier Skirmishes were skirmishes on the planet Vandor that occurred sometime during or prior to 10 BBY. Prior to the heist on Vandor, Beckett's gang utilized a trench created during the skirmishes as a camp.
Mount Vastadon was a mountain on the planet Vandor that had an elevation of 1,235 meters.

Mount Redolava, also known as the Big Rock, was a mountain on the planet Vandor that had an elevation of 2,990 meters. One of Tivoche Bilure's jobs involved climbing the Big Rock to help set up a comm repeater.
The Corubalni Pass was a location on the planet Vandor near Mount Vastadon and Mount Redolava. It was named after the Republic Scout Service scout Arhul Corubalni.
The Iridium Mountains was a mountain range on the planet Vandor. Fort Ypso and the Crispin Imperial Depository were both located there.

The Spinnaker Trail was a trail on the planet Vandor near the Corubalni Pass, Mount Vastadon, and Mount Redolava. Markers were used on the trail to guide travelers along safe routes and as memorials to recognize those who perished on making the trails.

The Aerie was a carrier utilized by the Cloud-Riders to transport them and their swoop bikes during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The ship rarely landed, as the swoops could launch from altitudes of 400 kilometers. It served as the nomadic pirate group's home base.

The Kaldana Syndicate was a criminal syndicate that operated in the Corellia system. They were composed solely of humans, believing that all aliens were a problem, especially Rodians, who they considered the scourge of the galaxy.
The Bottoms was a district in Coronet City on the planet Corellia that was home to the Silo. According to Rebolt, it used to be a swamp before shipbuilders drained the land to build more factories.
Qi'ra's safe house was a ship used as a secret safe house by the scrumrat Qi'ra in the freighter boneyard in Coronet City on the planet Corellia.
Barbadelans were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Dobarn Tren and Karamu were members of this species.
Gallusians were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Luleo Primoc, who was a chart-topping singer who also performed on the First Light, was a member of this species.

The disputed wilderness zone was an area on the swamp planet Mimban where combat between the Galactic Empire and the Mimbanese Liberation Army was the fiercest. Imperial Forward Field Operations, the temporary Imperial headquarters, was located deep inside the zone.
Ugors were a sentient blob-like species that existed in the galaxy. During the High Republic Era, Archivist OrbaLin was the first member of the species to ever join the Jedi Order.
Sometime between 19 BBY and 10 BBY, the Galactic Empire seized control of the planet Petrusia. They enslaved several of the native Petrusian species at the Imperial outpost on the planet Kullgroon.

Petrusia was a planet located in the Petrusia system in the Nuon e Safyd sector of the Expansion Region and The Slice. It was situated in grid square P-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid, and was the homeworld of the Petrusian species.
Embassy Row was a street in Hanna City on the planet Chandrila that was home to an apartment owned by Han Solo and Leia Organa.

Gotarites were a mole-like sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They had pink skin, green eyes, a pair of powerful incisors, low-light vision, and an excellent sense of smell. Fugas Fandita, who was present at the Lodge on Vandor, was a member of this species.
TD-H4, nicknamed "Tool" or "Die," was a droid believed to be centuries old. He was part of the Droid Gotra and befriended a young Han Solo on Corellia.

Elnacons were a large peaceful sentient species that hailed from Nacon, a world that had an ammonia-rich atmosphere. When on other worlds, they had to wear special breathing apparatus. They had noseless faces and four-fingered hands.

Nithorns were an avian sentient species that existed in the galaxy with leathery orange-and-green skin, black eyes and beaked faces. Members of the species were both present at the Lodge on Vandor and the First Light. One was also seen shopping on Ghorman in 3 BBY.
New Tobura was the capital city of the planet Oktaro.

The Dwuni were a species of short bipedal sentients. They had large heads with sharp-toothed mouths and eyes on stalks. Two Dwuni brothers, Blawz and Crodit, worked as enslaved miners in the mines of the planet Kessel in 10 BBY.

Dyplotids were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy, possessing four eyes that allowed them to see both the ultraviolet and infrared spectrum. Members of the species had been present at locations such as the Lodge on Vandor and the First Light.
Petrusians were a sentient species that was from the planet Petrusia. Kristiss and her father Rythus were members of this species.
JV-P12 was a blue, box-shaped HVAC droid with two legs that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

HT-IN-4 was a box-shaped information droid that was forced to work in the control room of the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel. In 10 BBY, he was freed when his restraining bolt was removed during a slave revolt in the mines started by the droid L3-37.
MPH-11 was a gray, box-shaped MPH power droid with two legs that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

The Desolator was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that participated in the assault near Alzoc III between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The Desolator was under the command of Commander Estoc during the Galactic Civil War
Following the Battle of Endor and the destruction of the second Death Star, a remnant faction of the Galactic Empire established itself in the Velcar sector.
Valtos space port was a spaceport at Valtos where Han Solo was captured by the bounty hunters Zuckuss and 4-LOM, in 9 BBY.
The Oseon Belt was a part of the Oseon system in the Outer Rim Territories' Centrality. It contained a subtropical moon which the gambler Lando Calrissian won ownership of at one point by 10 BBY.
The Taozin were a type of creature that, as a grub, had a long body with eight limbs. In 10 BBY, the crime lord Dryden Vos kept a Taozin grub on display in his study aboard his ship, the First Light.

result: Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet joins the Rebel Alliance
King Lee-Char and Regent Dors Urtya are killed by the Galactic Empire
x: The Mutiny on Mon Cala was a rebellion in which the Mon Calamari rose up against the Galactic Empire's occupation of their planet.
Kerestians were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The big game hunter Iothene Jacontro was a member of this species.
Pyke sentinels, also known as Kessel Guards, were guards hired by the Pyke Syndicate to protect their operations on the planet Kessel.

The Den of the White Worms, also known as the White Worms' den, the White Worm lair, or Lady Proxima's Lair, was the headquarters of the White Worms criminal gang in Coronet City on the planet Corellia.

result: Black Sun leave the Shadow Collective
x: During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems attacked the Black Sun. The Confederacy navy began to lay siege to the Black Sun's forces, at the same time as the Second Battle of Dathomir and an attack on the Pyke Syndicate.

result: The Pyke Syndicate leaves the Shadow Collective
x: During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems attacked the Pyke Syndicate. The Confederacy navy had been lying in wait and attacked by surprise.

t: Grievous's Providence-class Dreadnought (Campaign against the Shadow Collective)
x: A Providence-class Dreadnought served as the command ship of General Grievous during the Confederacy of Independent Systems's campaign against the Shadow Collective. It was boarded by the Nightbrother during the Battle of Ord Mantell.

In 13 BBY, an Imperial under the moniker "The Engineer" held an auction on Corellia for a data cube that had plans for a shield generator. Though the auction was originally won by the Droid Gotra, the auction was eventually won by the Kaldana Syndicate.
A mysterious shuttle was used by the Nightsister Mother Talzin to travel to the desert moon Zardossa Stix during the Clone Wars.

JBLX-24 was a blue- and white-plated humanoid protocol droid that was repurposed as a labor droid to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

P4T-GM was a red-and-white-plated P4T protocol droid that was overworked as a conflict resolver in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

The Sinkhole was the name given by the scrumrats to the audience chamber of the lair owned by the White Worms gang. The gang's leader, Lady Proxima, lived in a pond within the Sinkhole, and rose from the pond when she wanted to speak with her underlings.

MK5-L1 was a black L-1g general purpose droid that was forced to work as the landing-pad operations droid in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
GOUD-4 was a gray, box-shaped messenger droid with four wheels that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

result: The Galactic Empire destroys the rebel base
x: A battle occurred during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire on Sullust.

The Dorneans were a species native to the planet Dornea. The Dorneans designed the Braha'tok-class gunship, a gunship class manufactured by the Dornean Braha'ket Fleetworks Conglomerate to protect their homeworld from the Galactic Empire.
This planet was a snowy world that was the location of a cloning machine left over from the Clone Wars era. Luke Skywalker went to the planet to find and destroy the device.
Bony hutta toads were a species of toad with an evenly-spaced grid of mismatched horns and bumps on their backs. Cities on the planet Dorin were often compared to the backs of bony hutta toads.

B8G-H0R was a B8G labor droid that was forced to work in the spice mines owned by the criminal Pyke Syndicate on the planet Kessel. In the year 10 BBY, he was involved in a slave uprising on Kessel caused by a group of outlaws trying to steal coaxium fuel from the Pykes.
T1M8-LT2 was an orange- and green-plated A-LT Utility Droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
P6B-LT2 was a red and white plated A-LT Utility Droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

conflict: Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire
x: During the Galactic Empire's invasion of the planet Mon Cala, former Jedi Padawan Ferren Barr and his disciples attempted to flee to Bel City where a skirmish occurred.

Batuv was a planet in the Expansion Region that was occupied and blockaded by the Galactic Empire. Prior to his meeting with Tobias Beckett, Captain Lando Calrissian, and his co-pilot L3-37 took the Millennium Falcon to Batuv where Calrissian picked up a cape from Borkus.

R2-F1P was an R2-series astromech droid with white, silver, yellow, and orange plating and a black sensor. Like all R2 astromech droids, it stood 0.96 meters tall and was manufactured by Industrial Automaton. Its status indicator could be red or blue in color when on.
A tactical droid was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid stationed on Christophsis during the Battle of Christophsis.

CEC Island, best known as the CEC Headquarters, was the headquarters of the Corellian Engineering Corporation. The CEC Island was a vast complex of buildings located in the Incorporation Islands district of Coronet City.

The Melbu were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their respirator horns, which were connected to a breathing mask worn on the mouth and their bright orange eyes. Auromae Iselo, a member of the Cloud-Riders, was a Melbu.
The Revered Masters were spiritual leaders of the Lasat people on Lasan, and often carried around Ashla Staffs—staffs with a special connection to the Force, or as they called it, the Ashla.
Nupayuni salt flats was a location on the planet Crait. It was named after the Nupayuni Mining Consortium.

An OOM-series security droid was stationed on the Saak'ak before the Invasion of Naboo. It held the rank of corporal, and was destroyed when the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn used his Lightsaber to deflect energy blasts at it.
The sparadillo was a creature whose armored skin was used as a material for clothing. The frontman of the Guavian Death Gang, Bala-Tik, wore boots made of sparadillo armor.

During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Partisans led by Saw Gerrera undertook a series of attacks in the Arkanis sector. During the attacks the Partisans scored a number of victories against Imperial storehouses, convoys and inspection stations, leaving no survivors.
4724 was the designation of a droid who served in the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic.

This OOM command battle droid was present on Tatooine with the Head of State of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Count Dooku and his IG-100 MagnaGuards while they were waiting for Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano, who were carrying the son of Jabba Desilijic…
CorSec Plaza was a plaza in Coronet City on Corellia which contained the Peace and Security Headquarters.

This B1-series battle droid was stationed on the planet Hissrich early in the Clone Wars. The droid served as a lookout, and showed an appreciation for the beauty of the planet. It later witnessed Mace Windu's squad take out a droid patrol squad, and reported this to AD-W4.

t: Duel in the Royal Command Bunker
x: During the Galactic Empire's invasion of the planet Mon Cala, a duel occurred in the Royal Command Bunker between Darth Vader and Ferren Barr.
Paqualis III, also known as Paqualis, was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Inner Rim, situated along the Hydian Way and positioned at the coordinates L-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Royal Command Bunker was located on the Outer Rim planet Mon Cala, built for the King of Mon Cala.
Kod'yoks were a peaceful non-sentient species of shaggy, horned quadrupeds that roamed the open plains on the snowy planet of Vandor.

V8-R was a masculine astromech droid who served in the Resistance Starfighter Corps during the Resistance's war against the First Order. Some members of the Resistance were superstitious about V8-R's name, and he was teased for it.

A planet was home to a casino where Han Solo once cheated in a game of sabacc using funds for the Rebel Alliance. Solo's fellow gamblers discovered he was cheating, and chased him and Luke Skywalker off the planet without their money.

Ganimed were a humanoid sentient species distinguished by the single black horn on top of their hairless heads. The species had pointy ears and a ruddy brown and muddy yellow skin tone. The bounty hunter Purong was a member of the species.

The mordon was an endangered species of creature. The Spectres encountered one being transported to the Emperor's personal zoo, aboard a class four container transport while trying to rescue the argora.
Wickridge was a location on the planet Burnin Konn that had a chromium mine nearby.
Some time after 34 ABY, Maz Kanata owned a TUG-b13 spacetug.
C-Deck was a deck on the Providence-class Dreadnought that was super tactical droid Aut-O's flagship. It contained the ship's communications center and the Separatist encryption module.
A planet located in Wild Space was orbited by at least two pink moons. At some point after the Galactic Civil War, Emil Graf, BB-00, and CR-8R discovered the planet.
A non-sentient rock and scrap eating worm species were native to a planet.

P4-99 was an astromech droid in service to the Resistance during its war with the First Order. During the Resistance's attack on Starkiller Base, P4-99 was in the astromech slot of Sara Bel-Sun's T-70 X-wing starfighter. During the battle, Bel-Sun and P4-99 were killed.

XA-LX, nicknamed "Exalex" by Ello Asty, was an astromech droid in service to the Resistance during its war with the First Order. During the Resistance's attack on Starkiller Base, she flew with Asty and was killed.
BR-BA was an astromech droid in service to the Resistance during its war with the First Order. During the Resistance's attack on Starkiller Base, BR-BA flew with Pallaris Ven and was killed.
The New Republic Tribunal, also known as the New Republic War Tribunal was a judicial institution of the New Republic.

type: MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser
x: The Aurora Flare was an MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser that was part of the Mon Cala Imperial Trade Fleet of the Galactic Empire and carried a shipment of coaxium that was meant to be taken to the Redhurne system.

Hallway 328 was a hallway on the Invisible Hand. During the Battle of Coruscant it was where Chancellor Palpatine, Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker were trapped by a ray shield. They were then surrounded by droid forces.
A Venator-class Star Destroyer was in service to the Galactic Republic naval forces' Open Circle Fleet, where it also served as the flagship for Jedi Master Adi Gallia during the Clone Wars.

Lorrd was an astronomical object located in the Kanz sector's Lorrd system, within the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories, situated at the coordinates N-4 on the Standard Galactic Grid. During the rule of the Galactic Empire, it fell within Imperial space.
The 3rd Moon was a terrestrial moon located in the Outer Rim Territories that was inhabited by various species.

Mace Windu's Jedi fighter was a Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor flown by Jedi Master Mace Windu. R8-B7 was Windu's astromech droid copilot, but after R8's destruction, R2-D2 commandeered the starfighter.

conflict: Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire
result: The Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet escapes Mon Cala
x: The defense of the southern polar regions was tasked to Admiral Raddus by King Lee-Char during the Galactic Empire's invasion of the planet Mon Cala.
Zeran Town located on the northern part of the planet Mon Cala under the rule of the Mon Calamari monarchy.

Kullgroon was a planet located in the Expansion Region where droids were repaired at an outpost. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Empire enslaved the Petrusians who worked at the outpost, including Rythus, who was the father of freedom fighter Kristiss.

objective: Smuggle weapons to the Imperial outpost of Kullgroon so the Petrusians
x: The job on Kullgroon was undertaken by the smuggler Lando Calrissian to smuggle weapons to a group of Petrusians who had been enslaved by the Galactic Empire at an outpost on Kullgroon.
During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Separatist General Grievous used a Providence-class Dreadnought.
A Providence-class Dreadnought participated in the Battle of Sullust, in which it served as the command ship of a Separatist fleet commanded by Asajj Ventress, and fought against the Republic forces.
Imroosia was a volcanic planet located in the Imroosia system of the Inner Rim Territories in grid square N-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Febrini sand-prestor was a type of creature that originated in the Febrini system of the Inner Rim's Hapes Cluster. At some point by 3 ABY, the 434-FPC Personal Chef Droid 434-FPC prepared a meal for several people.

GL-0T15 was a black-plated GL vendor droid owned by the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn during the reign of the Galactic Empire. It served as the operator for the principal turbolift onboard the First Light, the personal yacht of Crimson Dawn's leader Dryden Vos.
PA-LT4 was a white and gold plated A-LT Utility Droid that was owned by the criminal Crimson Dawn syndicate during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
The south landing bay was a hangar bay located on the Confederacy of Independent Systems listening post Skytop Station.

t: Attack on an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate
x: During the Galactic Civil War, prisoners within the Galactic Empire's Accresker Penal Legion attacked a rebel EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate.

Kalishik was a forested planet located in the Kalishik system. It was situated in the Back Reach area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Ardan Cross connected it to the Arda and Feena systems.

The T'sarki were a seal-like species native to Kalishik in the Gordian Reach sector. They were generally regarded as a friendly species, but were quick to take offense at what they perceived to be routine dishonesty and swindling at the hands of other species.

A hubdroid led a squad aboard the Galactic Empire prison Accresker Jail. The hubdroid was sabotaged by Chelli Lona Aphra during an attack on an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate, causing it to explode, killing all the members of its squad aside from Aphra and Lopset Yas.
The Wastelands of Kullgroon, also known simply as the Wastelands, were a droid junkyard on Kullgroon.

t: Jocasta Nu's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor
x: In the days following the proclamation of the New Order, Jedi Master Jocasta Nu and astromech droid Beetoo flew a golden-plated Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor from her school to the Coruscant Underworld for Chief Librarian Nu to infiltrate the former Jedi Temple…
B7-N5, nicknamed Bev, was a protocol droid who assisted Fey Zara in running her cantina, where she offered individuals tutorials and quests for holotables.

The Emperor's throne room was a throne room of Emperor Palpatine that was located in a tower on the Death Star. The tower and the throne room were located in the Northern Polar Command Sector, and were both destroyed during the Battle of Yavin.
The Iego council was a guild composed of residents and officials of the spaceport city of Cliffhold on Iego.

The Vex crusade was an alleged organization led by an alien named Sandewar Mandewar. When the notorious doctor and smuggler Cornelius Evazan pretended to demonstrate his shape-shifting abilities to the rogue archaeologist Chelli Aphra while disguised under the alias "Lopset Ya…

Mairan, also referred to as mind flayers, or as Bors, were a sentient multi-tentacled multipod species that were native to Maires. They had the unique ability to read minds, and as a result, they were often used as a form of torture by the Galactic Empire and the Partisans.
The Phydolon were a paired symbiotic sentient species native to the planet Mydasos that existed in the galaxy.

Mydasos was a nearly-undiscovered backwater planet located in the Dalicron sector in the Outer Rim Territories, between the Corellian Trade Spine and the Hydian Way. Mydasos was home to the symbiotic Phydolon species, as well as a variety of flora and fauna.

Narro Sienar Boulevard was a waterway-spanning speeder bridge located in Coronet City, the capital city of the planet Corellia. It was a part of the planet's system to connect island-like architectural units called pills.

The south hall was a hall in the Palace of Grakkus the Hutt on the moon of Nar Shaddaa. During the rescue of Luke Skywalker from Nar Shaddaa, Squad Five, an Imperial TIE fighter pilot unit, were met with resistance from Grakkus' IG-100 MagnaGuards in the south hall.

place: An asteroid field between Coruscant and Albecus
objective: Deliver a message to Albecus
x: Some time preceding the events leading up to the Battle of Geonosis, Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi was sent out on a mission by Jedi Masters Mace Windu and Yoda to safely deliver a message from the Jedi Council to their allies on the Core World of Albecus.

Dooba was a MK 8001 Attendant Droid who looked after a young child. The child's plasticene doll, Branli, ended up with a broken finger after a fall from a grav slide. Dooba fixed the doll's finger for the child.

result: Junior Lieutenant Veers promoted to the rank of major
x: The insurrection on Culroon III occurred on the planet Culroon III when the native Culroon ambushed the forces of the Galactic Empire.

Shortly before the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, a campaign occurred on the astronomical object Culroon III. The conflict involved the Galactic Empire and the Culroonians, the inhabitants of Culroon III, and occurred as a result of a revolt there.

The Culroonians were the inhabitants of the astronomical object Culroon III. Shortly before the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, a campaign between the Culroonians and Imperial forces took place on Culroon III to put down a revolt there.

The wreckage-prison Accresker Jail attacked a pirate station, and Sana Starros stated she believed it was part of the Galactic Empire's bandit purges.

The Yavin Coalition was a joint task force formed by Jedi Grand Master Satele Shan and the Dark Council's leader Darth Marr in effect to deal with the threat posed by Revan and his followers in 3637 BBY.
A dangerous planet was located on the edge of Wild Space. The planet had been overrun by droids, who were later disabled by an immobilizer beam.
The battle of Movris was a battle of the Galactic Civil War.

Annaj was an astronomical object in the Annaj system of the Outer Rim Territories' Moddell sector. It was at the end of the Spar Trade Route, the easiest way to get into the sector, and was patrolled by the Galactic Empire.
Ast Kikorie was a location in the Ast Kikorie system in the Moddell sector, a subsector of the Zuma sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

Assault on the Mako-Ta Space Docks

x: Jassks were an endangered non-sentient species that swallowed its prey whole and digested it for weeks. The Spectres encountered one being transported to the Emperor's personal zoo, aboard a class four container transport while trying to rescue the argora.

Huklas were an endangered non-sentient species that could rip through a man in seconds. The Spectres encountered one being transported to the Emperor's personal zoo, aboard a class four container transport while trying to rescue the argora.
Yavin's Hope was a Mon Calamari cruiser that was commanded by General Vanden Willard during the Galactic Civil War.

t: Republic (MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser)
x: The Republic was an MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War following the mutiny on Mon Cala by General Jan Dodonna.

Chandar's Folly was a planet located in the Saijo sector in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. During or before the time of the High Republic, the Jedi Knight Te'Ami attended a rodeo on Chandar's Folly.
A valath was a huge and deadly creature that was the apex predator of the planet Chandar's Folly. It had a hide that boasted unique chromatophores which allowed it to blend into its background.

result: Darth Vader kills all hunters, except for Wilhuff Tarkin
x: In 14 BBY following the Berch Teller campaign, Governor Wilhuff Tarkin repaid a debt to the Sith Lord Darth Vader by having himself and nineteen other men hunt Vader on the planet Chandar's Folly.
Mount Arakeirkos was a mountain atop which a great clock was built out of stone by the religious order known as the Arakein Monks almost two thousand years prior to the Galactic Civil War.

Livorno was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories' Belderone sector, within the Livorno system. It was situated in grid square R-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Livorno was home to a species of the same name.

Sector six was a location in the Kadavo system. During the Clone Wars, in the Battle of Kadavo, a Zygerrian royal guard informed Keeper Agruss that a fleet of Galactic Republic warships had exited hyperspace in sector six.

Hylobons were a sentient species native to the Hylobi system. Aemon Gremm and his men, including Toht Ra, were all members of this species. They were part of the Hylobon Enforcers, who served Dryden Vos as bodyguards in the criminal organization Crimson Dawn.
The retreat from Gaulus was an operation during the history of the Rebel Alliance. During the action, the U-wing gunship served in a medevac role.
The Tocan system extraction was an operation during the history of the Rebel Alliance. During the action, the U-wing served in a gunship role.
