result: The Rebel Alliance captures four transports
x: The Rebel Alliance captured four loaded transports in the Pyros system in 3 ABY. Minister of Finance Nower Jebel messaged Rebel Alliance Chancellor Mon Mothma following the action, complaining that even that victory would not make up for the loss of the ion cannon at the Battl…

The Possibility was a name given to a Nomad Four, a civilian version of a Seltaya military courier ship, owned by the former handmaiden Duja. It crashed on Mokivj, having been shot down by a Separatist vulture droid during the Clone Wars.

A team of nineteen hunters was put together by Governor Wilhuff Tarkin to hunt the Sith Lord Darth Vader, after Vader requested Tarkin hunt him. The team traveled to the planet Chandar's Folly in the Outer Rim Territories where Vader killed the entire team except for Tarkin.

6G-66, nicknamed "Sixer," was an astromech droid in service to the Resistance during its war with the First Order. 6G-66 flew in the T-70 X-wing starfighter of Jessika Pava during Black Squadron's mission to gather allies and bring new systems into the Resistance.

GM12-L1 was a blue L-1g general purpose droid that was repurposed as a labor droid and forced to work as the landing-pad operations droid in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
P0-03 was a white, red and blue, barrel-shaped P0 adminmech droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Mos Entha was a settlement built across from the Mospic High Range, on the desert planet Tatooine. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure kept slave pens in Mos Entha.

Icefish were a type of fish that were edible to humans and Latero. In 18 BBY, Milo Graf regretted eating the last of a stock of icefish for breakfast while enduring a particularly turbulent ride in space.

Landing Pad 13 was a landing pad at the Imperial Center of Military Research on the planet Scarif. When Governor Wilhuff Tarkin and his guard arrived at the complex for a meeting, his Lambda-class T-4a shuttle landed at Landing Pad 13.
Anakin's flagship was a Venator-class Star Destroyer of the Galactic Republic naval forces' Open Circle Fleet. It served as the flagship of Jedi General Anakin Skywalker.

Trios' ship was a starship owned by Queen Trios of Shu-Torun. After contacting the Sith Lord Darth Vader with the location of the newly put together rebel fleet, Trios returned to her ship, during a ceremony held aboard the Mako-To Base celebrating the Alliance's fleet, in an …

An ST-series super tactical droid was in active service to the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. In the year 19 BBY, he served under Admiral Trench during the Battle of Anaxes as they attacked the Republic's vital shipyards on Anaxes.

result: Black Squadron fails to persuade King Siroc to ally with the Resistanc
x: Following the Battle of Starkiller Base, members of the Resistance's Black Squadron were unintentionally involved in a local battle on the Outer Rim world Pastoria.

Pastoria was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Pastorians. By 232 BBY, a technician from the planet served aboard the High Republic cruiser Castellan before it crashed on the moon Toshara.
A skirmish took place in the Korakanni Mound on the planet Geonosis during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Pastorians were a sentient species with several insectoid features from the Outer Rim planet Pastoria.
Galen Erso's Office was the personal office of the scientist Galen Erso. From his office, Erso studied bug tech and blueprints sent to him from Geonosis.
Krennic's Office was an office used by Commander Orson Krennic during his time as head of the construction of the Death Star on Geonosis.

The Korakanni Mound was a location on the planet Geonosis. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, a group of saboteurs led by a rogue Geonosian queen were based in the Korakanni Mound, and sabotaged the Empire's construction of the Death Star.
A transport was used by the primary rival of King Siroc on the planet Pastoria. The transport was destroyed in an attack initiated by King Siroc.

A transport was owned by King Siroc on the planet Pastoria. When Black Squadron arrived on Pastoria to ask for the king's assistance, he instead tricked them into supporting the transport, which was commanded by Colonel Squill, in a battle against his primary rival.
The raid in the Senex system occurred early in the Galactic Civil War. During a training mission, Rebel pilot Dev accidentally entered in an Imperial training ground in the Senex system.
An office was located in Cantham House on the planet Coruscant. It was used by Senator Bail Prestor Organa during the Clone Wars.

Kudon were a sentient species in the galaxy. A number of Kudon resided on the moon Kudo III. During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems enslaved a village of Kudon, forcing them to work in a foundry to create battle droids.

The Coruscant Port Authority, also written as the Coruscant port authority, was an organization that operated on the Imperial capital, Coruscant.

Imperial Sector Control was an organization within the Galactic Empire active during the Galactic Civil War.
A prison-tug, also referred to as a tug cruiser was a type of modified Arquitens-class command cruiser utilized by the Galactic Empire as a tug for wreckage-prisons.
Risha Synata's ship was a starship owned by and dedicated to the Frenk actress Risha Synata. It had a gold and dark-red color scheme alongside geometric decorations.
Section C-6 was a location in Tipoca City Military Complex on the planet Kamino.

Caterpillars were a type of bug. Fried caterpillars were served as food at a party in Gorag Tower on Reena during the Queen's Bloom Festival. The Kwazel Maw of Rodia resembled a cross between a caterpillar and eel.
Bilgefrogs were a species of frog native to the Core Worlds planet Corellia. Around dawn, they tended to make croaking sounds.
Pnakotic Coast village was a village located on the Pnakotic Coast on the planet Savareen. It was home to a community of Savarian humans.

The Fireball was an old racer that Team Fireball tried to restore in their repair shop on the Colossus, a refueling station on the planet Castilon. It was given its name because of its tendency to burst into flames and/or explode.

Alistan Nor was a remote planet located in the galaxy where the ancient Force Builders' city of Alistan Nor was located. Alistan Nor historically was covered in grassy plains, but over time, it became a lush jungle. Alistan Nor was also surrounded by three asteroid rings.
Cos Secundu was a planet located near Cosia, in the Deep Core region of the galaxy. Cosian bioengineers created an offshoot of their own species, the Nu-Cosians, to colonize that world.

The warrior caste was a caste of Geonosians dedicated to warfare. Members of the caste were known as Geonosian warriors, Geonosian soldier drones, Geonosian drones, or simply Geonosian soldiers. Geonosian soldiers were the only type of Geonosian drone that had functional wings.
A cruiser was owned by the Kudon trader Mek Nu'Tiv.

During the Imperial Era, the female Petrusian Kristiss led a group of resistance fighters against the Galactic Empire. The Petrusians were enslaved on the planet Kullgroon until smuggler Lando Calrissian helped them revolt.

Alaphani were a sentient species. They had plated and grooved gray skin with six light blue eyes between plates on their heads. Several grey teeth jutted outward from their mouth and had holes above them. Their heads were attached to their body by multiple thin connections.
Mess Hall IV was a mess hall on the Rebel Alliance space station Mako-Ta Space Docks.

Dex Acquisitions was an organization that ran the Dex Acquisitions Depot on Meor Ain. The Galactic Empire had an arrangement with Dex Acquisitions, paying them to kidnap Clawdites such as Tunga Arpagion.
X3-299-11 was a planet located beyond the Outer Rim of the galaxy. Several structures were located on its surface, including the entrance to an ancient temple, which was home to the Shadowfang Beast.
Level 1329 was a level on the planet Coruscant.
The Sabetue were a species, genderless members of which were distinguished by a white skin. One Sabetue was a member of a gang of criminals in Coronet City of the planet Corellia in 13 BBY.

The Vulpter data raid was a raid on the planet Vulpter with the purpose of retrieving information on Galen Erso, Project Celestial Power, Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research, and more. The raid, undertaken by an operative, was successful.
Central library was a library located in the city of New Tobura on the planet Oktaro.
During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Empire conducted enslavement operations on the planet Gigor after the native Gigorans were discovered by a Weequay pirate.

The Technical division was a division within the Jedi Order that was responsible for maintaining and repairing all craft of the Order. Jedi Master J'oopi Shé was part of the organization during the Clone Wars.

The Empty Boot was a freighter that once operated near Drall, a planet in the Corellian system to recover a shipment of glitterstim.

The Nek Princess was a freighter that once operated near Selonia, a planet in the Corellian system to recover a shipment of avabush spice.

The Xim's Scion was a pirate cruiser destroyed in a skirmish with the CorSec several centuries before the Battle of Yavin.

The Aurean Glassworkers Guild was a group of expert artisans who lived in the Torragan Mountains, on the planet Aurea, in the Core Worlds. They used the Eternal Furnace, a giant lava pool for their most audacious and important projects.

The Corellian Port Authority was in charge of the traffic around the Orbital Industrial Zone and the Port of Corellia on the planet Corellia. During the Galactic Civil War, the Corellian Port Authority was under the authority of the Imperial Transit Authority.
The AC-Seventy-Five-P yacht liner was type of yacht.
Red Nimbus was an AC-Seventy-Five-P yacht liner.
Derango 4 was a hardscrabble astronomical object in the Khuiumin sector's Derango system, within grid square O-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid and the Outer Rim Territories.

The Ghost Ship of Veragi was the name eventually given to a starship that shared it with the Veragi system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Veragi sector situated on the hyperlane known as the Veragi Trade Route.

ID-83 was the designation of Sentinel-class landing craft, a transport utilized by the Galactic Empire. In 13 BBY, it was in Coronet Spaceport on the planet Corellia scheduled to depart of the Naval Academy on Carida.
The Mila was one of the four akias of Aramandi society. They were based on the planet Aram, as well as the Mila system. The akia colonized the Mila system after the Galactic Empire was established.
The Orma was one of the four akias of Aramandi society. They were based on the planet Aram, and were the first akia to colonize another star system, the Orma system.

result: Insurgents eventually evacuated by Phoenix Cell
x: During the reign of the Galactic Empire, multiple resistance uprisings took place against the Empire. During one of those uprisings, Mart Mattin's father was killed and Iron Squadron, the rebel cell he led, disbanded without his leadership.
Screerats were a species of rat found on the planet Corellia. They infested the Den of the gang known as the White Worms and the gang's scrumrats were expected to capture the vermin.

The Southern Marshlands was a location on the planet Mimban. During the Mimban Campaign in 10 BBY, Lieutenant Alayus Bolandin briefed members of the 224th Imperial Armored Division that in three hours they would move out for the southern marshlands, and as such, wanted an adva…

Scalefin fish were a type of small fish found in the oceans of the planets Ahch-To and Corellia, where they could be purchased in Coronet City's fishmarkets. They were edible to humans and on one occasion, the scrumrat Qi'ra stole of meal of scalefin fish on a dare.
Kaminoan Planetary Defense was the main defense grid for the planet Kamino. The organization had a substation located in the higher levels of Kamino's capital city, Tipoca City.

A tribunal was held against Han Solo while training as one of its cadets. At the tribunal, Solo was charged with disobeying a direct order. Solo was found guilty and was reassigned to the infantry unit on Mimban.
Zerm was an astronomical object in the Zerm system in the Kessel sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, situated along the Pabol Sleheyron.
The Green Ace was a modified G30 ship piloted by Hype Fazon. The racer's wings could shift angles for maximum maneuverability while flying. It was plastered with the logos of Fazon's sponsors.

The Yellow Ace was a ship piloted by Bo Keevil, who performed stunts and tricks while flying it. It was a complex ship to fly, and had wings that could shift into a variety of configurations. Keevil often crashed the ship.

type: Heavily modified TIE/ln space superiority starfighter
x: The Black Ace was a modified TIE/ln space superiority starfighter piloted by Griff Halloran. Halloran used it both as a racer and in the defense of the Colossus.

The Blue Ace was a custom-built state-of-the-art starship piloted by Torra Doza that suited to her personality and racing skills, during the time of the Cold War. It could hold an astromech droid and was able to change the power of its laserblasts.

The Red Ace was a starship piloted by Freya Fenris. Freya Fenris took inspiration from Kuat Systems Engineering's A-wing starfighter line, and incorporated wings with laser cannons for better stability and firepower.
Tilurus was a terrestrial celestial body situated in the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. It lay on the Pabol Sleheyron hyperspace route between the astronomical objects Aeneid and Mandrine.
Mandrine was an astronomical object located in the Kessel sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. During the High Republic Era, the Nihil attacked the Kiapene trading post there.
Injopan was an astronomical object located in the Kessel sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
Coronet Times was the biggest news agency of the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. Its headquarters were located in Coronet City.

The Executive Secretariat, or Exec Sec were the rulers of Centerpoint Station. Its members were assigned by the Federation of the Double Worlds and it was headed by a Chief Executive. Administration and Operations were parts of the Executive Secretariat.
"Greenies" was a nickname the Galactic Empire gave to one of the species native to the planet of Mimban.

Firrerre was a world in the Outer Rim Territories' Sugai sector, a subsector of the Zuma sector. It was the site of a consular office for New Republic Space Ministry that issued the METOSP titled 558 ModSuFi, warning spacers to avoid the planet Jakku.

Aleen Minor was a planet located in the galaxy's Inner Rim that was settled by the Aleena species several thousand years before the rise of the Galactic Empire during one of the species' expansionist periods.

Livno III, also known as Livno, was a largely undiscovered planet located in Wild Space on the edge of the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Lynna species. It was situated in the Livno system in grid square J-21 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Christophsians were a sentient race native to the planet Christophsis. They looked similar to humans in appearance. During the Battle of Christophsis, Christophsian rebels fought against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
R4-D6 was a dark blue R4 astromech droid that served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
R2-X2 was a green and white R2-series astromech droid that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Mangez IV was a shuttle owned by the Lant Mining Corporation.
Hauler 339 was a cargo hauler owned by the Lant Mining Corporation.
Hauler 67 was a cargo hauler owned by the Lant Mining Corporation.
The Pulverizer was an Asteroid Prospector AP-300 owned and operated by Lant Mining Corporation. The vessel was commanded by Captain Niree. Hema and Rikap were part of the vessel's crew.

Ikkrukkians, also known as Ikkrukki, were a sentient species native to the Mid Rim planet Ikkrukk. One member of the species, Porter Engle, served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Their physiology enabled them to be able to live for centuries.
Administration was a branch of the Executive Secretariat, the government of the Centerpoint Station. Its main role was to collect taxes and deliver different licenses.
Operations was a branch of the Executive Secretariat, the government of the Centerpoint Station. It consisted of the security of the station, the construction and the orbital traffic.
Centerpoint Station Security was the law enforcement agency of the Centerpoint Station and was a branch of the Operations.
The Sacorrian Security Police was the law enforcement agency on the planet Sacorria. It was mainly composed of Humans and Selonians.
Cell 3B was an Imperial prison cell located on the planet Corellia.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: The Ambush of Convoy LMC-55c was an Alliance operation to capture a Lant Mining Corporation convoy. Alliance forces ambushed the convoy, which was under Imperial protection. After destroying the Imperial escort, Captain Riane of the Alliance demanded the surrender of the convoy.
The Grand Promenade of the Rebellion was a street in Hanna City on the planet Chandrila.
Rutian referred to one of the many skin tones of the Twi'lek species, generally denoting a shade of blue.

The Executives were the board of directors that oversaw the Lant Mining Corporation. The board consisted of six members, each of which was responsible for one of LMC's six divisions; Mining, Refining, Resource Discovery, Research and Design, Sales, and Security Patrol.

SE4-10 was a modified Industrial Automaton SE4 servant droid. Following Qual'om Soach's attack on the Nalmar crime family, Eelien Kirat decreed that all top personnel required protection. SE4-10, alongside SE4-12, served as camouflaged security droids for Kirat and Elana Nalmar.

SE4-12 was a modified Industrial Automaton SE4 servant droid. In the aftermath of Qual'om Soach's attack on the Nalmar crime family, Eelien Kirat decided that protection was required for his top lieutenants.

Bazak's Gang was a pirate organization that operated in the Brak sector. Led by Lekk Bazak, the group was a collection of Rodians and Humans. They operated a Ghtroc Industries Class 720 freighter, the NightRunner, and two GAT-12j Skipray Blastboats, Slasher and Slicer.
The Slasher was a Sienar Fleet Systems GAT-12j Skipray Blastboat. It was one of two Blastboats used by Bazak's Gang.
The Slicer was a Sienar Fleet Systems GAT-12j Skipray Blastboat. It was one of two Blastboats used by Bazak's Gang.
R5-S5 was an R5-series astromech droid that belonged to Byro Ti'mere, and worked with him at Ti'mere's InfoServices.

AV-6R7 was a V-series droid supervisor who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War, overseeing the work droids constructing the second Death Star superweapon and acting as a liaison to the Executor, flagship of Sith Lord Darth Vader.
The Bay of Eeronon was a small body of water on the planet Aram. The capital city of Talerakia was located on the shores of the bay.

The Resort Sector was a region of Amma, the capital city of the planet Bacrana. It was the city's main tourist area, and its coastal regions were situated on Bacrana Bay. It was bordered to the north by South Sector.
The Sacorrian Meritorious Incentive Program was an organization on the planet Sacorria which controlled the profitability of each agricultural exploitation.

The Silestro Privateers was a band of pirates operating in the Corellian system during the Galactic Civil War. Their leader was captain Jostero and their headquarters were in the Rayless Lantern, an asteroid in the Pirate's Shadow belt.
The Tyrena Dance Company was a group of dancers located in Tyrena, a city on the planet Corellia.
Kethmandi was a planet in the Kethmandi system of the Expansion Region's Hangshan sector. Sometime between 19 BBY and 10 BBY, Chewbacca was an Imperial prisoner on Kethmandi.

The Business and Commerce Quarter was the central district of Janos, capital city of the planet Demar. The Lant Mining Corporation's Administrative Center was located in the Business and Commerce Quarter.
Amthau City was the planet Amthau's only city. It was built into the walls of one of the planet's larger canyons above an underground river.
Brala was a city on the planet Genesia. It was located on a continent in the planet's western hemisphere.
Kila was a city on the planet Genesia. It was located on a continent in the planet's eastern hemisphere.
Brenn Bay was a body of water on the planet Genesia. The city of Brenn was located on its shores.

During his exile on Tatooine, the Ithorian Momaw Nadon cultivated a hidden garden. Nadon was a renowned botanist amongst other Ithorians and the Ithorian species was in general considered to be very skilled in this particular subject.
Hangar eighty-eight was a hangar located in Hanna City on Chandrila. Han Solo and Lando Calrissian boarded the shuttle to Frander's Bay from the hangar.
An akia was one of the four clans of Aramandi society. The four clans were the Cirra, Orma, Mila, and Lota.
A planet was located in the Avery system in the Belderone sector of the Outer Rim Territories where Jaxxon and Amaiza Foxtrain met Queen Prizzi of Livorno.

Icy Moon was a Sienar Fleet Systems Light Patrol Ship owned and operated by the bounty hunter Rafe Finna. During the Galactic Civil War, it was present at Gadde on Lish V to transport Rebel prisoners.
Lish Runner VII was a passenger liner owned and operated by Lant Mining Corporation. The vessel was used to transport LMC workers between Lish's moons.
Space Drifter was a medium freighter owned and operated by Core to Rim Shipping. The vessel was commanded by the Sullustan, Captain Prem Nistt.
Early Riser was a light freighter registered to Neva Transport and captained by Elana Nalmar under the alias of "Reela Marl."
Star Trader was a Ghtroc Industries 720 light freighter owned and operated by Lirisa Casti.

Caged Animal was a Concealer-class Prison Ship. It was charged with the transport of Alliance prisoners of war and was targeted by the Brak Sector Force. However, the Galactic Empire anticipated the Alliance's move and instead filled the ship with Zero-G assault stormtroopers.
Constrictor was a Concealer-class Prison Ship. It was charged with the transport of Alliance prisoners of war.
During the Imperial Period, the Galactic Empire invaded the world of Niran.
ICC-5537 was the designation of a 20-T Railcrawler conveyex transport train stationed on the planet Vandor during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Genesian Customs was an organization that deal with customs inspections in the Genesia system. Due to the highly corrupt nature of bureaucratic organizations in the system, Genesian Customs could often be bribed.

The Amma protest was a civil demonstration by the population of the city of Amma on the planet Bacrana. Protesting against Imperial atrocities, the demonstrators peacefully marched on Central Sector Square.
During Operation: Insignificant, members of the Brak Sector Force staged an impromptu battle over Lish V in an attempt to rescue Rebel prisoners.
Corubalni Spaceport was a spaceport located on Vandor. It was named after the Republic Scout Service scout Arhul Corubalni.
The Rampaea Horizon was a bulk freighter that Tivoche Bilure worked on to get passage off of Corellia. It visited Venustria, Ulness Prime, Great Aglamerti, Kessel, and Vandor.

A planet was located in a distant region of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet's terrain was comprised of mountains as well as plains covered with purple and green grass, and it had a type I atmosphere breathable to humans.
Katarns were dangerous and deadly predators that were native to the planet Kashyyyk, where they prowled the deeper, lightless levels of the world's complex vertical ecosystem.

Vuvrians were a sentient species of humanoids whose oblong, insectile head featured twelve eyes and two long antenna-like appendages. Hailing from Vurdon Ka, they never established any colony world. Thanks to their heightened senses, Vuvrians were exceptionally perceptive.

Lynos IV was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Mortex sector's Lynos system, which was located in the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories. The celestial body was situated in grid square R-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Marquinn was an astronomical object in the Marquinn system in the Inner Rim Territories where Zefin Tuzo ran a resort casino. Han Solo and Chewbacca went to Marquinn to sell several marked sabacc decks, but were pursued by Vullen Candroon, who was working with Tuzo.

The Camp Forward airfield was an airfield that was housed at Camp Forward, the temporary headquarters for the Galactic Empire's forces located deep in the disputed wilderness zone on the swamp planet Mimban, where combat against the Mimbanese Liberation Army was the strongest …
Docking Bay Three was a docking bay located on Substation Grimdock.
The devastation of Rion was a battle of the Galactic Civil War.
During the Galactic Civil War, a skirmish took place on the frozen planet of Rion.
The devastation of Little Kessel was a battle of the Galactic Civil War.

During the war between the First Order and the Resistance, Commander Poe Dameron borrowed a starfighter from Grakkus the Hutt to aid the members of Black Squadron during the Battle of Ikkrukk. The starfighter was equipped with four laser cannons, a hyperdrive and six engines.
The Northern Docking Zone was an immense area composed of 30 hangars, located in the north pole of the Centerpoint Station. It was controlled by the Executive Secretariat.
Null Town was a location in the South Pole of the Centerpoint Station and was controlled by baron Benton Kaldo, a businessman and crime lord during the Galactic Civil War.
The Southern Docking Zone was an immense area composed of 30 hangars, located in the south pole of the Centerpoint Station. Officially, it was unused, but criminals established their bases there.
Admin Sector was a sector within the Technology Sector, the North Pole of Centerpoint Station.
Conical Six was one of the South Conical Mountains in Centerpoint Station. Five Brothers Resort and Casino purchased exclusive rights to the use of it.
The planet Corellia's northern continent was the location of the Agrilat Region and Orik's Spine.
Kribben's Folly was an area of the Agrilat Swamp, on the planet Corellia. It was the third piece of terrain that the contestants of the Agrilat Swamp Circuit had to race through.
Oblivyn Gate was was an area of the Agrilat Swamp on the planet Corellia. It was the first piece of terrain that the contestants of the Agrilat Swamp Circuit had to race through.
The Sulfur Archway was an area of the Agrilat Swamp, on the planet Corellia. It was the tenth piece of terrain that the contestants of the Agrilat Swamp Circuit had to race through.
During the Galactic Civil War, a siege took place on Syni IV.

The H'ken asteroid belt was located in the H'ken system. It was twenty kilometers wide. Shortly after the Battle of Bilbringi, a squadron of New Republic X-wing starfighters were attacked and destroyed in the belt by an Imperial splinter faction.
Dark Star was a bulk freighter owned and operated by the Gotal crime lord Mahk'khar.
Star Streak was a bulk hauler owned and operated by the Corporate Sector Authority.
Striker was an assault shuttle owned and operated by the Twi'lek crime lord Ree Shala.

Accresker command was the leading administration of the Galactic Empire wreckage-prison Accresker Jail. After Magna Tolvan brought a TIE fighter into the prison to rescue Doctor Chelli Aphra, Accresker command detected the craft and ordered it to identify itself.

result: Cornelius Evazan captures Chelli Aphra and 0-0-0
x: After the Galactic Empire decommissioned the wreckage-prison Accresker Jail, a skirmish ensued as the prison was fired on a collision course with the planet Tiferep Major. Doctor Chelli Aphra, who had been a prisoner at Accresker, was a main cause of the events.

The Assault on Galaan took place during the Galactic Civil War. Not long after the end of the Thrawn campaign, the New Republic maintained a vital communications base in the atmosphere of the gas giant Galaan.

class: Finance Retrieval and Net Investigations droid
x: FRN-I, also known as Franni was a Finance Retrieval and Net Investigations droid that worked with the Special Investigations squad on the planet Stassia.
Farhava Beta was a frontier planet in the galaxy with similar characteristics to Vandor. The world was exploited by corporate interests to considerable profit.

Edis VII was a frontier planet with similar characteristics to Vandor that was located in the Edis system in the Farana region of Wild Space. The world was exploited by corporate interests to considerable profit.
Gamerong was a frontier planet in the galaxy with similar characteristics to Vandor. The world was exploited by corporate interests to considerable profit.
The Arbiter was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served as part of the Imperial Navy. Zeck Tambell served aboard the Arbiter for two years as a naval security officer.

The bluevev glider was a species of large blue fish found in the oceans of the planet Corellia, where they could be purchased in Coronet City's fishmarkets. They could also be found in the waters of Nur, an ocean moon in the Mustafar system.
1MSE-KUP24 was a KUP24 messenger droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spices mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

7169 was a B1-series battle droid who served in the Trade Federation's Droid Army. In 32 BBY, they were part of the forces deployed to the city of Theed on the planet Naboo by the Federation during its invasion of the world.
An escape shuttle was brought by the vigilante Tam Posla to the wreckage-prison Accresker Jail, in 3 ABY, as part of a deal with the rogue archaeologist Chelli Aphra.

result: Churhee's Riflemen are nearly wiped out
x: The mission on Y'Trella was an operation undertaken by Churhee's Riflemen, a pro-Imperial mercenary group, on the planet Y'Trella. The mission resulted in a debacle and led to the death of almost all the Riflemen, including their founder and leader, Vlaydm Churhee.

The Battle of Turcan III was a battle of the Galactic Civil War fought on Turcan III. Despite being an Imperial victory, the battle brought Churhee's Riflemen galaxywide fame as heroes of the Rebellion.

The Auric was a Rebel Alliance YT-1760 Small Transport active during the Galactic Civil War. Piloted by Commander Lina Graf, the Auric had a five member crew that included the technician Skritt, Lieutenant Thom Hudd, the former bodyguard droid XM-G3 and Graf's long-time compan…

t: Heist of the Alderaanian data archive
objective: Acquire the data archive
x: After the trader Mek Nu'Tiv obtained an archive that contained what was left of the Royal Library of Alderaan, both the Resistance and the smuggler Han Solo organized their own heist to take it for themselves.

t: Battle between the Zygerrians and Galactic Empire
result: King Atai Molec exiles Sono Molec to Kowak
x: At some point during the Imperial Period, a naval battle occurred between the Zygerrian slavers and a fleet commanded by Imperial Captain Ralchio Nervi. The Zygerrians were soundly defeated, losing their Prince Hordem Molec, the elder son of the Zygerrian King Atai Molec.

Corosi 7 was a terrestrial moon with a rocky surface. It was located in the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories' Corosi sector, within the Corosi system. Corosi 7 was situated in grid square N-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Vixnix was a small terrestrial planet located in the Vixnix system in the Rago sector of the Mid Rim in grid square I-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid, on the edge of Wild Space, The Stinky Jawa Cantina was a cantina located on Vixnix.
Resistance engineers were engineers that served in the Resistance.
XM-G3, also known as Gee-Three, was a bodyguard droid who retired from his duties as a bodyguard and joined the crew of Rebel Alliance commander Lina Graf.

The Hoopaloo Nest was a starship owned by the informant Graysom. While waiting to meet Kanan Jarrus and Hera Syndulla in an asteroid field, the Nest was taken over by an entity, causing it to crash on an asteroid.
J3-55 was a gray loadlifter droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

CC-4M was a white loadlifter droid with fabric dust shroud on its left shoulder that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
The planet Corellia's southern continent was the location of Coronet City, the Gold Beaches and Tyrena.
The Auric was a river that crossed the city of Tyrena.
North-East was a section of Tyrena with a reputation as a dangerous part of town. Despite its reputation, it was not uncommon to see people of the higher classes.
The most prestigious musical conservatory of Corellia was located at Tyrena.
The Tyrena School of art was located on the planet Corellia and formed some of the greatest artists of the galaxy.
The Tyrena theater district, located in the city of Tyrena, was home to some of the most beautiful theaters and opera houses of the Core Worlds.

Bovo's was a cantina near the Treasure Ship Row in Coronet City and owned by Carn Truuvik, a successful criminal. He and several other beings loyal to him, including Catrinna, conned targets out of their credits through rigged sabacc games during the Galactic Civil War.
The Central Business District was the economical section of Coronet City. It was composed of many buildings and Coronet Times had its headquarter in this district.

The Corellian Museum of Space Exploration was a museum located in the Corellian Engineering Corporation Headquarters in Coronet City on the planet Corellia. It retraced the history of the conquest of space travel, from the hyperspace cannon to the hyperdrive.
The Corona House Gardens was a public park that surrounded Corona House on Corellia.
The Coronet Heights was the main entertainment district of Coronet City, especially with the Coronet City Zoological and Botanical Gardens and the Museum of Fine Art.
The Embassy Hill was a fashionable district in the Governmental Sector of Coronet City where ambassadors lived. The Coronet Arms Hotel was also located in this district.
The "24-karat" beaches were located on the Gold Beaches, which stretched along the western coastline of the planet Corellia's southern continent.
The Black Gold beaches were the Northern part of the Gold Beaches, on Corellia. The name was due to the black volcanic silica.
The Port of Corellia was the main spaceport of Corellia and was overseen by the Corellian Port Authority.

t: Mission to rendezvous with the Resistance
result: The Resistance retrieves intelligence stating the First Order is going
objective: Rendezvous with Commander Poe Dameron and give him intelligence on the
x: During the Cold War between the New Republic and the First Order, New Republic pilot Kazuda Xiono and his squadron were given a mission by New Republic Command to deliver top-secret information to Commander Poe Dameron of the Resistance.
A CR90 corvette served in the fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, the Defense Fleet of the New Republic and the naval forces of Resistance during its service.

Balthamus, also known as Number Ten, was a medical droid in service of Fyzen Gor's Brotherhood of Wire and Bone, specifically of the Original Dozen created by Gor himself. He wore a hood and his droid hands had been replaced with two grayish, bloated human hands.
Elrik Vonreg's TIE Interceptor or Vonreg's TIE Baron was piloted by Major Elrik Vonreg during the Cold War.

Zone Five was a district of Gallisport, a city on the planet Shesharile 5. It was a heavy industrial zone with low-cost residential units. During the Galactic Civil War, the Spiders swoop gang ruled Zone Five.

Zone Three was a district of Gallisport, a city on the planet Shesharile 5. It was an abandoned industrial zone with low-cost residential units. It was the location of Ta's Roost and Chop's Shop. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rabid Mynocks swoop gang protected Zone Three.
The Legally Authorized Law Authorities, or LA-LAs, was a private law enforcement agency employed by the government of Gallisport, the capital city of Shesharile 5.

G1-7CH, commonly known as "Glitch," was a hospitality droid that worked at Aunt Z's Tavern. There, he served the clients, and, when necessary, also simulated various odds about the races while Aunt Z managed bets.
Gonda was a terrestrial planet located in the Gonda system, within the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square N-18 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

t: Race between Kazuda Xiono and Torra Doza
x: As part of his cover as a spy for the Resistance, Kazuda Xiono had to participate in a race between himself and Torra Doza, a member of Ace Squadron.
A species of small multi-legged creatures was native to the forest moon of Endor. The Dulok king Gorneesh used one such creature as a sponge while bathing.

A sharvo fish was a type of bioluminescent fish that was native to the planet Castilon. After the Colossus platform was sunk under the surface of the water, schools of these fish could be seen swimming around it.

Lajaie's cruiser was a Mon Calamari cruiser of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It was commanded by Commander Lajaie. The cruiser was then destroyed during the Imperial attack on the Mako-Ta Space Docks.
Hynestia Prime, also known as simply Hynestia, was a cold tundra planet located in the Hynestia system and Hynestian sector of the galaxy's Colonies region that was orbited by a pair of moons.
Scrap crabs were a non-sentient species of crustacean that lived on the junk-planet Trionak. The crabs had massive claws and magnetic shells capable of collecting scrap metal for protection.

Bray was a dark planet home to the Brayan species. It was located in the Piryn Shar sector in the Expansion Region. During the Clone Wars, Count Dooku resided in a citadel along with Ravna, a mutated creature who could convert others into his kind.
The species of Ravna was a sentient species of vampiric creatures that could infect others and transform them into similar creatures.

result: The attack by Kragan Gorr and his pirate gang is successfully repelled
x: During the era of the New Republic, the pirate Kragan Gorr and his gang used a low-visibility storm, which were codenamed "triple darks," to launch an attack on the Colossus refueling station on behalf of their employers, the First Order.
The Vella plains were grassy flatlands on the planet Corellia. The Kor Vella mesa was located at the center of the Vella plains and the city of Kor Vella was built atop the mesa.
Cliffside was a district in Kor Vella, a city on the planet Corellia. It was the location of Draknul Café.
Draknul Café was a tapcafe located in Kor Vella, on Corellia, and owned by Fianna during the Galactic Civil War.
Crollia's Maw was a huge canyon on the planet Crollia and the main location of the former mines of crodium.
The Great Archives was the location in Mastigophorous, a city on the planet Drall, where the Dralls held the archives from the dawn of the Galactic Republic.
The Hall of Clans was the location of the government of Drall.
The Academy of Mastigophorous was one of the most prestigious academy of the galaxy.
Old Town was the oldest district of Mastigophorous, a city on the planet Drall.
Trionak was a junk planet located in the Trionak system, in the Yarith subsector of the Javin sector in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Meccha Wingrider Garrison was a location near Meccha, formerly inhabited by the Rakatas then by a garrison of Wingriders, the police force of the Dralls.
Neral's moon was a moon that had orbited the planet Neral before its destruction and was ruled by Ne'eda Frip.
A village was located on the planet Bray, home to the native Brayans. After Lord Ravna began converting several Brayans to his species, the village's power was sabotaged.

Volcanic environment stormtroopers, also known as lava troopers, were black-armored stormtroopers stationed around Fortress Vader—a castle belonging to the Sith Lord Darth Vader on the planet Mustafar—during the Imperial Era.
CKO-171, also known as Kay-Oh, was an ancient protocol droid who was part of the crew of the Jedi Dreamer.
Brayans were a sentient species from the planet Bray. During the Clone Wars, a village on Bray was terrorized by Lord Ravna, leading to the local Brayan population to ask the Jedi Council for help.
During the Clone Wars, Jedi Masters Obi-Wan Kenobi and Adi Gallia undertook a mission to the planet Bray after the native Brayans asked the Jedi Order for help.
Deepwater Docks were docks used by smugglers to avoid controls by the Selonian authorities.
Kimotte Den was one of Selonia's underground cities.
Scasmirs Den was one of Selonia's underground cities.
Tir'mal Den was one of Selonia's underground cities.
Shove-Off Point was a shantytown in Dearic, a city on Talus. The Drall, a smuggling merchant, lived there.
The Icormek River was located near Dearic, the capital of the planet Talus.
The Port of Qaestar was the biggest and most dangerous spaceport of Talus. It was located at the top of Qaestar Ridge, near Qaestar Town.
Lynna were a felinoid species native to the largely undiscovered planet of Livno III in the galaxy's Wild Space.
Crysallia was the capital city of the planet Aurea.

The Shakamm Crater was the location of an impact that changed forever the Aurea's surface. Later, a group of artisans of the Mardri Soulworks Collective used burning crystals from the mining operations located there to create objects.
The Leviathan was a Continent-class crawler used by the Kingdom of Shu-Torun and their miners for offworld excavations of low gravity moons. Queen Trios claimed it could peel a planet's mantle.
The Warbird gang was a gang of pirates led by Captain Kragan Gorr that was active during the era of the New Republic, and secretly worked under the First Order.
G-LN was a DUM-series pit droid owned by Flix and Orka. G-LN assisted them in the Office of Acquisitions by helping them retrieve items or assist customers.

Neral was a planet located in the Neral system in the Corellian sector of the Core Worlds that was orbited by one moon. Neral had been a rich planet, with many natural resources, but volanic eruptions destabilized the planet's core and caused the planet to explode.
The Colossus marketplace was a marketplace that was busy with merchants, gamblers, and many species on the Colossus fueling station.
Magernon's Amnesty was an event that occurred when former Imperial sergeant Magernon freed many prisoners from Substation Grimdock, including Imperial supporters and terrorists.
Crocins were a reptilian sentient species that were native to Croce. Karjj was a member of this species.
The Mandalorian resistance was a dissident group of Mandalorians formed by Lady Bo-Katan Kryze, leader of Clan Kryze and the former regent of the planet Mandalore, during the Imperial Era.
During the revolt against the Eternal Empire, a GEMINI droid was destroyed on Iokath by Vaylin for feeling fear.

Rendel was a planet located in the Kiva system. It was ruled by Queen Bellan, who was chased from the world by her sister Zalla. Bellan hired smugglers, such as Han Solo and Chewbacca, to go to Rendel under the guise of delivering a statue, so that they could defeat Zalla.
Barbadel was an astronomical object in the Core Worlds where Han Solo and Chewbacca encountered the Barbadelan Karamu.
SV-3, or Ess-Vee-Three, was an L-1g general purpose droid that worked with the Barbadelan Karamu. When Karamu's Cranan star-hopper crashed onto Rendel, Ess-Vee was damaged.

The Kubaza beetles were a vicious hive-dweller species of giant beetles that existed on the volcanic planet of Mustafar. Their diet consisted of the minerals and, as such, they were a common sight near lava flows.

R4-H18 was an R4 astromech droid that had a translucent white body with silver highlights. The droid worked serving drinks to guests at the Canto Casino on Canto Bight. He was equipped with a drink tray as well as a liquid dispenser arm that could fill glasses it carried.

Prior to the Age of the Galactic Empire, Sith Lord Momin led a group of acolytes in his quest to satisfy the dark side of the Force. He utilized them, alongside resources inherited from his Master, Darth Shaa.

t: Darth Momin's destruction of a city
result: Darth Momin is trapped inside of his mask
x: Between c. 1100 BBY and c. 1000 BBY, the Sith Lord Darth Momin was guided by the dark side of the Force to select and destroy a city. Momin created a superweapon, with the help of his acolytes that possessed the power to destroy the city.
A city was destroyed by the Sith Lord Darth Momin when he attempted to hit it with a superweapon and freeze it in time using the Force.
Rada-cats were a variety of cat. The family of Momin owned a pet rada-cat, Flitta, but he mutilated her to make a sculpture.
At some point after their mission to Ushruu, Han Solo and Chewbacca were given a mission to the planet Rendel, hired by Bellan.

Phara's faction was a faction on the planet Vallt led by Marshal Phara that sought to take over the planet. It lacked the necessary military support to do so, until it was supported by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Star Dreadnought Assault Prototype was a prototype Executor-class Star Dreadnought used by the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. It was constructed surrounded by a large dock, running more than half the Star Dreadnought's length, in orbit above a cloudy celestial body.
A racer was piloted by Jace Rucklin. In an effort to save weight and make the ship faster, all systems deemed "extraneous," including the ejection seat parachute, were removed from it.

Rucklin's team was headed by Jace Rucklin, and consisted of himself, Lin Gaava, and Gorrak Wiles. They operated out of the Colossus platform on Castilon. They had a reputation as being lazy pranksters who did not focus on their work.

Jarek Yeager’s racer or Yeager's ship was a racer that belonged to Jarek Yeager. He had used it to compete in races on the Colossus platform, but by 34 ABY Yeager no longer did so, keeping the ship in his private hangar in his repair shop.

Level 3215 was a level of Galactic City on the planet Coruscant. During the reign of the Galactic Republic, the human Tanivos Divo was born there and grew up in the level's Gavas-Eclat neighborhood watching his father being extorted by criminals.
DRX-7 or DRX-752B was a protocol droid who served Lando Calrissian on Cloud City, Bespin. He was reprogrammed by a mysterious man to assassinate Lando. He was defeated by Kaasha Bateen and Lando.
Underworld Logistics was a branch of the Eternal Alliance that worked with the criminal underworld to supply the Alliance's forces and gather intelligence. It was led by Hylo Visz.

R2-M5 was an R2-series astromech droid with red, white, and silver plating and a black sensor. Like all R2 astromech droids, R2-M5 was manufactured by Industrial Automaton and stood ninety-six centimeters tall.
Mount Krana was a mountain on Endor, located beyond the Salma Sands. A Gorax whom the Ewok shaman Makrit called "the Great Devourer" lived there.
Mardri Soulworks Collective was a domed city on the planet Aurea found by Coovo Mardri and a group of artisans near the Shakamm Crater.
The Carmine Peaks were a mountain range on Aurea.

Ifeoma was the third moon of Aurea. It had a cool, humid, and perpetually cloud-covered environment and had a bad reputation due to the uninterested population for the art. Ifeoma was the main city on the moon.
Ifeoma was the main city on Ifeoma, the third moon of Aurea.

The Torragan Mountains were a mountain range located over two thousand kilometers away to the southeast of the Shakamm Crater on the planet Aurea. It was the location of the Dome of Crystal Fire, a protected cave deep below the mountains containing burning crystals.

The Dome of Crystal Fire was a gargantuan cave deep below the Torragan Mountains on the planet Aurea. Burning crystals covered the walls, creating a dazzling display of constantly shifting colored lights.
The Eternal Furnace was a giant lava pool used by the Aurean Glassworkers Guild for their most audacious and important projects.
The Vorheim Gallery was a gallery on the planet Aurea. Bryn Shale, a famous thief, claimed she would steal the sculpture Dawn of Light during its exposition at the gallery.
A pluripleq was a tentacled creature that was created with bioengineering and possessed shapeshifting abilities.
Whippomorns were a sentient species the existed in the galaxy. A gangster named Sturg Ganna was a member of this species.
Bsellis City was a city located on the planet Bestine IV.

Malian was a planet located in the Malian system in the Expansion Region. At one point after the Battle of Yavin, Killaen Chamat had a force vision, leading Chamat, Codo Keburr, and Omi Vass to search a temple on Malian for a holocron.
A protocol droid served in the royal palace on Shu-Torun. While accompanying Darth Vader on a mission to the planet, the assassin droids 0-0-0 and BT-1 encountered the protocol droid.
Science and Research was a division of the Eternal Alliance founded by the Hutt scientist Doctor Juvard Illip Oggurobb to coordinate the research into Zakuulan technology.

D9, known as Deenine, was a protocol droid spy and an associate of the self-made droid L3-37. At L3-37's request, he tracked down the Phylanx Redux Transmitter, a device created by the gangster Fyzen Gor that could control droids, forcing them to kill.

The tach were a species of non-sentient, tree-dwelling primates native to the planet Kashyyyk. A harmless and even friendly creature, the tach could often be found on the ground searching for overripe fruits.
Farrendal was a city on the planet Corfai.
Mount Lorrist was the highest mountain of the planet Corfai and was known for its dangerous ski slopes.
Olvergast Glacier was a glacier located on the planet Corfai and was one of the biggest in the Core Worlds. It was protected by a government law and its ice could not be exported to other planets.
Salvarrn Nature Reserve was a location on the planet Corfai and one of the biggest nature reserve of the Core Worlds.
Winterdome was the first city built on the planet Corfai.
Icecrest was a district in Winterdome, a city on the planet Corfai.
The Winterdome Museum was a museum located in Winterdome, a city on the planet Corfai.

Nepotis was a water-rich planet located in the Nepotis system of the Calaron sector, a part of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. It was situated in grid square T-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Croce was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Croce system, a part of the Yminis sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. It was situated in grid square S-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Tal Pi was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Tal Pi system, a part of the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories.

Vobes was an astronomical object located in the Vobes system of the Core Worlds. It was the homeworld of the less-known species called the Vobati. At some point, an artist mentioned the species and its homeworld in a entry of their journal dedicated to the Vobati.

Britaxis Minor was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Britaxis Minor system of the Inner Rim Territories and the Slice. It was situated in grid square O-11 of the Standard Galactic Grid and was the homeworld of the sentient Britarro species.

TN-5 was an ancient droid in Pau City on Utapau. It was rumored to have served Krynbalt Kyr, the first Grand Zigoth, over an eon before 13 BBY, continuing to remain functional. Fyzen Gor thought of TN-5 when contemplating the longevity of droids compared to organics.
Cadomai Prime, also known as simply Cadomai, was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, situated along the Hydian Way that was the homeworld of the Snivvian species.

Octero IV was a watery Outer Rim Territories astronomical object. It was home to the Octeroid species, members of which needed to use breathing apparatuses when traveling off-world. The smuggler Glaucus hailed from Octero IV.
Danzik was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Danzik system, a part of the Dalonbian sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories.
Craeen was a planet in the Corellian sector colonized by Corellians.
Seelom District was a seedy district in Jyvus Space City, the largest space city in orbit over Duro.
Tarn was an astronomical object that was the homeworld to the Tarnab, a sentient species that was represented by Senator Mot-Not Rab during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Honoghr was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Honoghr system in the Kessel sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Noghri species. During the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic's 327th Star Corps fought a battle on Honoghr.

4D-M1N, nicknamed 4D, was a command bridge droid who assisted Imanuel Doza, the captain of the Colossus platform on the planet Castilon. While often residing in Doza Tower, she occasionally left to perform tasks for the station's captain.

The Desert of Salma, also known as the Salma Sands,, was a vast desert located on the Forest Moon. A dusty, barren, and harsh expanse pockmarked with acrid and acidic pools, it was bordered by tall mountain ranges.

Terminus was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, and was the intersection of the Corellian Trade Spine and the Hydian Way. The corridor was known to be infested with pirates, including the Ohnaka Gang.

Nimban was a terrestrial planet located in the Nimban system, a part of the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. Situated in grid square S-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid, it was linked by the Pabol Sleheyron hyperspace route to the Chalacta and Sleheyron systems.
Fenbolt was a service droid of Cli Pastayra and reprogrammed by Fyzen Gor. Around 3 BBY, Fyzen betrayed the leaders of Wandering Star and killed them with the droids. Fenbolt killed Cli Pastayra.

The Situation Rooms were data and planning centers located in the Council Towers of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. The rooms filled an entire level of a Council Tower and were linked to the Library and Archives.
An attack on an Imperial fort took place in 3 ABY on the planet Coyerti when the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry assaulted a strategic Imperial fortification in the battle for the planet.
A Purifier droid attacked Vaylin on Iokath, and later helped her reestablish control over the GEMINI droids captaining the Eternal Fleet.
A plaza square was located in the city of Raxulon on Raxus Secundus, capital of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
A main port was located in the capital city of Raxulon on Raxus Secundus, an Outer Rim world which served as the Confederacy of Independent Systems' capital.
The Tech Masters were a group of engineers who ruled the planet of Trionak in the Kiax Nebula, keeping it secret for centuries.

The Distillery was an Imperial bioweapon facility located on the planet Coyerti. It was used to create, refine, and test volatile bioweapons and other substances. The Distillery was the main hub of Coyerti's production, making it a strategic location for attack.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: The attack on the Distillery was an assault that took place on the planet Coyerti in 3 ABY. The distillery was a biotoxin and chemical refining facility used by the Galactic Empire and was the hub of the Empire's production on Coyerti, making it a valuable target for the Allia…
Trash Squids were a type of squid of the Dianoga species.

x: During the Coyerti campaign in 3 ABY, the Coyerti Imperial garrison was under attack by the Alliance to Restore the Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry. Late battle, it was destroyed by a large number of Coyerti.

Neijaia was a planet in the Neijaia system of the Expansion Region covered in swamps was home to many wild species, including a native species who spoke the Neijaian language. Poe Dameron and BB-8 visited the planet, but were chased by the natives.

A humanoid species native to a Neijaia that spoke the language Neijaian. Members of the species chased Poe Dameron and BB-8, and later caught them, along with Kori Ong, in a trap. With Ong's help, Dameron and BB-8 escaped the natives, and were able to leave the planet.

Doc was a junk droid, consisting of the head of an OOM command battle droid and the body of a KX-series security droid. Built by Akar Duel on Lotho Minor, Doc and several other droids gained their freedom and were inadvertently liberated by the arrival of the Millennium Falcon.
Saracor was a planet that had massive amounts of rhydonium. Between 10 BBY and 9 BBY, Jabba the Hutt had drilling platforms on Saracor to mine rhydonium.

Teetee was a junk droid created by Akar Duel on Lotho Minor. Despite having a restraining bolt, Teetee was unaffected by Duel's programming, and attempted to convince the other droids on Lotho Minor to rise up against their ruler.
A junk droid with the head of an EV unit was created by Akar Duel on Lotho Minor. The junk droid was fitted with a restraining bolt that caused it to believe Duel was the Maker, following him.
The ystervark was a giant creature with defensive plating and toxic spines. It was viewed as a worthy foe and a revered delicacy by the sentient Thisspiasians of the planet Thisspias.
Skustell was the homeworld of the amphibious Ongree species. The Ongree Jedi Master Coleman Kcaj hailed from Skustell. Around 19 BBY, Skustell had a seat in the Imperial Senate.
Speagulls were birds native to the ocean planet Castilon.
Maires was the homeworld of the Mairan species. It was located in the Maires system, a star system in the Hapes Cluster in the Inner Rim Territories.

Roona was the homeworld of the Roonan species and was located in the Roona system in the Bes Ber Bikade sector of the Expansion Region along the Corellian Trade Spine. Roona was represented in the Galactic Senate by Senator Aang, and in the Imperial Senate by Senator Den Gane.
Florn was an astronomical object with a dangerous environment located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Lamproid species.
Elom was a cold desert planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Elom and Elomin species.
Trillia was an Expansion Region celestial body. It shared its name with the Trillia Massacre, which saw dwarf rathtars kill and eat a large number of beings.

Hasskyn was a terrestrial celestial body located in the Hasskyn system of the Minos Cluster, a part of the Outer Rim Territories and the Western Reaches. It was situated in grid square M-20 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Shukut was the homeworld of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Ketsu Onyo.
Astromandicar was the capital of the planet Froz before its devastation ordered by Naomi Dargon, the Corellian sector's Moff, for supporting the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Fendwellifar Forest was a forest on the planet Froz before its devastation ordered by Naomi Dargon, the Corellian sector's Moff, for supporting the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Halavortigas was a city on the planet Froz before its devastation ordered by Naomi Dargon, the Corellian sector's Moff, for supporting the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Juleenasov was a city on the planet Froz before its devastation ordered by Naomi Dargon, the Corellian sector's Moff, for supporting the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
The Undescanatain Falls were falls on the planet Froz before its devastation ordered by Naomi Dargon, the Corellian sector's Moff, for supporting the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Khomr was an agriworld colonized by Corellians shortly after the invention of the hyperdrive.
The Sleeping Rancor was a cantina in Nuba City on the planet Nubia and owned by Duff Caros, a male Human cyborg, during the Galactic Civil War.

t: Nubian Collective Museum of Engineering and Design
x: The Nubian Collective Museum of Engineering and Design was a museum located on the planet Nubia.

The Shorn Stabilizer was a cantina on the planet Nubia and owned by Aarrom, a male Ithorian, during the Galactic Civil War. It was known as the best neutral drinking-hole in the Corellian sector, a place where opposing factions could safely meet.

Tehar was an obscure terrestrial planet located in the Mid Rim near the Unknown Regions. The world was home to a human population known as the Teharans, and it was the site of a village that featured a temple of the Force.

The Engineering Level was located on the supertanker fuel depot known as the Colossus, and was the area of the station in which the Chelidae resided.

Chelidae were a sentient species indigneous to the planet Castilon. While amphibious, they preferred to live above the water. They were enclosed in a natural protective shell, and the males sported facial hair while the females did not.

Wandering Star, also known as the Wandering Star Gang, was a criminal syndicate led by an individual with the rank of Grand Vygoth. They worked out of Level 1313 on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Republic.
Mileva was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Mileva system of the Maldrood sector, a part of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice.

The Mother Jungle was the vast rain forest ecosystem that covered the surface of the planet Ithor. The native Ithorians considered it most sacred, and forbade to set foot within it. Their reverence, however, left the Mother Jungle vulnerable to exploitation.
Hubin was a moon in the Dene Gois Cluster within the Outer Rim Territories, and the residence of the isolationist Clan Markona and their leader, Thane Markona.
Barnahof was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories, patrolled by stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire.
The Nuxan were a sentient humanoid species from the Nux system in the Mid Rim Territories. They were distinguished by their unpleasant, rotten odor.
Boiyuh was a terrestrial planet in the Boiyuh system within the Colonies and the Interior regions, situated at the coordinates J-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Republic Group was an obscure organization that was allegedly tied to holding companies on Coruscant and Corellia, and was active before and during the Clone Wars. During the war, it operated the Stellar Envoy, which sported its colors, out of Ralltiir.
The Five Crime Syndicates, or Five Families of Crime, was a term given to several crime syndicates located in the galaxy. Over the years, membership of the Five shifted and changed.
Thanrax were creatures that were native to the moon Hubin. One thanrax chased Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, and Han Solo through a forest on Hubin before being scared away by an Thane Markona.
The Outrider was a YT-2400 light freighter owned by Dash Rendar that left the planet Tatooine in 1 BBY.
The Imperial Space Ministry was an agency of the Galactic Empire that was responsible for maintaining starship records.
Dankayo was a location in the Dankayo system of the galaxy's Colonies that was a suspected base of rebel operations.
Picutorion was a location in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy that was a suspected base of rebel operations.
Akuria was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, not far from the planet Dantooine, that was a suspected base of rebel operations.
Laakteen was a location in the Laakteen Depot system of the galaxy's Colonies that was a suspected base of Rebel Alliance operations.
Gargon was a mountainous planet in the Gargon system within the Mandalore sector of the Outer Rim and New Territories, in grid square O-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Transport TY-700 was a Darius G-class freighter used by the First Order to transport fuel. Due to the starship being a model normally used by civilians, its allegiance to the First Order was not immediately apparent.
The Larkrer was a Separatist freighter. Boroklif served as a captain onboard the vessel and used it to ship supplies between Batuu and Mokivj, where the Separatists had a secret droid factory.
The Permondiri Explorer was an old survey craft that, at one point in time, was used by the Jedi Order.

An RA-7 protocol droid served Captain Magna Tolvan of the Galactic Empire. While on the Citadel of Rur, the RA-7 protocol droid was briefly possessed by Eternal Rur, attacking both the crew of Tolvan's shuttle and later Tolvan herself, but returned to normal after the destruct…
Silver-nape beetles were a species of beetle found on the swamp-covered planet of Dagobah. They burrowed inside of gnarltrees.
The scrange was a species found in the swamps of the planet Dagobah. A quick-striking creature, it used its spiked tail to attack and hid amongst the roots of gnarltrees.

The spotlight sloth was a species found on the planet Dagobah. It shared its swampy habitat with such other creatures as the bogwing and the dragonsnake. Yoda's hut contained a rug made of spotlight sloth fur.
The Rimrunner was a Hutt transport ship that crashed in the Jundland Wastes, Tatooine, during or prior to the Galactic Civil War.
The Spice Siren was a Galactic Republic freighter. At some point, it crashed near the Xelric Draw on the desert planet of Tatooine.
In 3630 BBY, at the end of the war against Zakuul, Empress of Zakuul Vaylin was killed during the Assault on Odessen, but this caused the leaderless Eternal Fleet to revert to its primal programming.
In 3630 BBY, at the end of the war against Zakuul, Empress of Zakuul Vaylin was killed during the Assault on Odessen, but this caused the leaderless Eternal Fleet to revert to its primal programming.

In 34 ABY, Resistance members Commander Poe Dameron and Kazuda Xiono, along with astromech droids BB-8 and CB-23, investigated a derelict Darius G-class freighter that was broadcasting a distress signal.

CB-23 was a BB-series astromech droid with feminine programming who was a member of the Resistance in 34 ABY. She was assigned to Commander Poe Dameron while BB-8 was stationed on the Colossus with Kazuda Xiono.
An asteroid field was located in the Castilon system, near the planet Castilon. In 34 ABY, pirates from Kragan Gorr's gang raided a Darius G-class freighter in sector six of this asteroid field.
The Kowakian ape-lizard, also known as the Kowakian ape, was a huge, semi-sentient predatory reptilian creature native to the planet Kowak.
Snarlaps were a non-sentient long-necked feathered species native to the planet Ques.

Panna was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Cronese Mandate sector. Situated at the coordinates S-6 on the Standard Galactic Grid, the world was connected to the celestial body Rampa II by the Bubble Wink, a hyperspace route favored by smugglers.

A planet was the center of the Dene Gois Cluster in the Outer Rim Territories. The gas giant's moons, which made up the cluster, were one of the densest stable moon systems known to exist. Hubin was one of the many moons that orbited the planet.
Imperial Boarding Inspection and Customs was an agency of the Galactic Empire that was responsible for customs enforcements and starship inspections.

The Blazing Claw was a pirate organization led by Pirate Queen Gunda Mabin during the Age of the Galactic Empire. It operated out of the Maelstrom Nebula and contained hundreds of starships, led by the Bloody Bones.
The Imperial Institute for Archaeological Exploitation, abbreviated as IIAE, was an institution of the Galactic Empire that issued certificates to accredited archaeologists.
Milvayne City was a city located on the planet Milvayne.
Gwongdeen was a planet located in the Colonies and the Interior regions, covered by a membranous biological sea that protected the rocky core.

Dhandu 3, often known as simply Dhandu, was the third of three moons that orbited the planet Dhandu in the Dhandu system in the Expansion Region. It was home to the Turlossus, a massive six-legged reptilian species.

The Gahenn Plains, also known as the plains of Gahenn, were a location on the planet Mustafar. At some point during the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Sith Lord Darth Vader had his castle built over the ancient Sith cave located in the Gahenn Plains.
This main road led to the Umbaran capital city on the planet Umbara. During the Battle of Umbara, the Galactic Republic's 501st Legion was attacked by the Umbaran Militia while traveling on the road.

The Kwymar Suppressions were a series of attacks during the reign of the Galactic Empire that took place somewhere in the Kwymar sector. The human mercenary Saponza stated he was involved in the events.
The Star Jewel was a starship manufactured by Ubrikkian Industries that was owned by the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the Imperial Era.
A hideout was the base of operations for the Twi'lek Resistance led by Cham Syndulla during the Battle of Ryloth.

MK-1, or Emkay-One, was a butler droid who served at the mansion of Thane Markona. He helped look after Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker and Han Solo, several members of the Rebel Alliance who became stranded on Hubin.
813A was the sole moon orbiting the planet Thrantin. The Galactic Outdoor Survival School occasionally used the moon for zero-gravity training when Thrantin's grav regulators were not working.
The Kalis Peaks were a series of mountain spires in the Kalis Range on the planet Thrantin.

x: As part of the First Order's attempts to take over the Colossus platform, Kragan Gorr and his pirate gang launched a raid on the platform, some time after a prior attempt.

The Kur forests were located in the Kur Minor system of Wild Space. They featured thorn vines, an infamous poisonous plant. At some point by 2 ABY, the Human scout Casti Tholon made a trek through the Kur forests.

A plaza was located at the entrance of the Sundari Royal Palace on the planet Mandalore. The plaza was overlooked by the Royal Palace's balcony. Mandalorian citizens could gather in the plaza for governmental addresses.

Docking Bay 42 was a docking bay on the Imperial Star Destroyer Vigilance. In 4 ABY, when New Republic pilot Wedge Antilles' HH-87 Starhopper—the Rover—was towed into the bay, he opted to rig it to explode and flee the scene.
First Order fleet gunners, also known as fleet engineers, served the First Order, notably aboard the Supremacy, Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnoughts and aboard Star Destroyers like the Finalizer.
Cabranga Street was a street in the Old Town area of Canto Bight, Cantonica. Café Raduli was a popular destination that ran along it.
The Walin'or cell was a cell of the Alliance to Restore the Republic that originated in the Walin'or system of the Mid Rim's Shiwal sector.
Polanis was an agriworld in the Core Worlds of the galaxy, within the Corellian sector. It was known for the Polanis ale and the Polanis Wine produced on the planet.
The Trade Zone was a location in Dorthus Tal City, the capital of Sacorria.
Truuzdann was the capital of Truuzdann, a corrupted planet in the Corellian sector.
The Estainia Hunting Grounds were a location on the planet Vagran.
The Estainia Resort Islands were a location on the planet Vagran.
Vagran City was the capital of the planet Vagran.
The Vagran Zoological Preservation Habitat was a location on the planet Vagran.
Agadore was a city on the planet Xyquine II.

Desevro was an astronomical object located in the Tion Cluster of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was also located on the Perlemian Trade Route. It was contested territory during the Galactic Civil War.
Chazwa was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Inner Rim, along the Perlemian Trade Route. It was located in the Chazwa system in the Orus sector.
Clan Markona was a clan that referred to the community on Hubin in which Thane Markona and his daughter Tula lived.

The Platform Classic was a major race held on the Colossus platform on the planet Castilon. For the Classic in 34 ABY, Captain Imanuel Doza, the platform's owner, invited famous racer Marcus Speedstar to participate.
The Bloody Bones was the starship of the pirate queen Gunda Mabin, serving as the capital ship for the Blazing Claw during Mabin's leadership.
A listening array belonging to the Trade Federation was built on the moon Alaris Prime between 39 BBY and 36 BBY, during the war there between the corporation and the rightful Wookiee colonists.
