The Capitol Park was a park on the planet Xyquine II.
The Millennial Forum was a location on the planet Xyquine II.
The Mount Vissa was a mount on the planet Xyquine II.
New Coronet was the capital of the planet Xyquine II.
Sirden was a major city located on the Corellian sector planet Xyquine II.
The Strangling Sea was a location on the planet Xyquine II.
The Umber Jungles was a location on the planet Xyquine II.
Valendia was a city on the planet Xyquine II.

Noryokon was an astronomical object in the Noryokon system of the Inner Rim Territories that had a notoriously long rotation period, leading to local days being signficantly longer than a standard day.
Ripper-Raptors were a grav-crosier school sports team that was part of a school on the planet Tinnel IV.

The Imperial Office of Security was a part of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Intelligence and Security Bureau offices, which were used by Imperial Intelligence and the Imperial Security Bureau and were located within the Citadel Tower on the Outer Rim planet Scarif.
The Mandroxan Cartel was a criminal organization that hired freelancing smugglers. Platt Okeefe included them in a list in the Smuggler's Guide on potential clients.
The Lantillian Spacers' Brotherhood was an organization that hired freelancing smugglers for weapons smuggling to anti-Imperial guerrillas such as the Partisans.

The Klatooinian Trade Guild was a trade organization that hired freelance smugglers, and were known to pay half of the fee upfront if it was negotiated. Platt Okeefe included them in a list in the Smuggler's Guide on potential clients.

Glasfir Ring was an organization that was rising in power and was in good terms with the Galactic Empire. They hired freelance smugglers, and Platt Okeefe included them in a list in the Smuggler's Guide on potential clients.
Ororo Transportation was an organization that was a front of the Tenloss Syndicate, a criminal organization that was friendly with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
A village on Hubin was the home of Clan Markona. It was comprised of several farm buildings and other houses. A tavern was also located in the village.
Q32H-3PO-9ST was a 3PO-series protocol droid Protocol droid.
The Devastation of Froz occurred during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Galactic Constitution Conference was the founding conference of the Galactic Republic. Corellians required a clause in the Galactic Constitution: Contemplanys Hermi, allowing the Corellian system to enact temporary autonomy in exchange for withdrawal from the Senate.
The Black Vulkars was a small swoop gang active during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
A droid led the Citadel Separatist holdout during the Imperial Era and was malfunctioning, though sophisticated.
A battle took place on the planet Ord Tellarom. Anakin Skywalker also fought during this battle.
Esral'sa'Nikto, more commonly referred to as the Mountain Nikto, were a sentient subspecies of the Nikto. Oplock, who was a mechanic and friend of Marcus Speedstar, was an Esral'sa'Nikto.
Romar starport was a starport on Romar. On the edge of this starport there was a warehouse where the outlaw tech T'ar Ta'avon lived.

headquarters: Jedi Temple medical bay, Jedi Temple, Coruscant
x: The Medical Corps was an organization within the Jedi Order. Jedi Master Stass Allie led the Medical Corps.
R4-D12 was an R4 astromech droid owned by the professional racer Marcus Speedstar. The droid assisted Speedstar in navigating his ship during races.
Bri'n was an arboreal planet with a breathable atmosphere and various flora and fauna. A horned humanoid species lived on the planet.

t: Department of Agriculture and Non-sapient Creatures
x: The Department of Agriculture and Non-sapient Creatures was subdivision of the Galactic Empire that was concerned with matters regarding agriculture and non-intelligent creatures.
Rib-cats were a species of non-sentient cats found on the moon of Nar Shaddaa.

The flame ibbot was a subspecies of ibbot that lived along the Boiling Sea on the Core Worlds planet Drall. The omnivorous birds were colored copper, brass, or blue-black, and were capable of squirting a jet of scalding water and bile at predators.
Great ibbots were a subspecies of ibbot. They lived on the planet Drall and were used by the division of Drall police called the Wingriders.
Spikefishes were a type of fish on the planet Drall. They lived in the Boiling Sea.
Drallish Mermaid were a type of large, kind mammal that lived in the Boiling Sea on the planet Drall.
Teryx were small reptavians living in the Cloudland Peaks on the planet Selonia.

Salerodrex were the dominant predators in the oceans of Selonia. They had an excellent hearing and could smell blood from many kilometers away. Their sharp teeth could cut in half a human body with ease.
Tunnel worm were a type of worms living in the tunnels of the planet Selonia. They were employed as beast of burden by Selonians and were also considered as a source of food.

Trippa hive was a Geonosian hive on the planet Geonosis where a droid factory was located. Trippa hive was the site of an engagement during the First Battle of Geonosis in which a Republic demolitions crew occupied the factory.

The Metal Clan was a clan on Bri'n that opposed female alien Th'er. They sought to destroy her trees. After negotiations with Th'er failed, the Metal Clan chased her and the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn, surrounding them briefly before they escaped aboard an Eta-class shuttle.

This T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid served in the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic. The T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid had white sensor color and light and dark plating.
The Department of Prisons was a department in the New Republic that was responsible for concerns regarding prisons under its control.

headquarters: New Republic Defense Fleet headquarters, Chandrila
x: The Digital Warfare Department was an organization within the naval branch of the New Republic that was involved in electronic warfare.

Yuvernians were a two-headed sentient species from the Yuvern system, they each had two spot-covered heads sitting atop a long neck. Cane Adiss, a member of Jabba the Hutt's criminal empire, was a male Yuvernian.

The Great Evacuation was the grandiose name given to the escape from Garqi by the Star's Delight. Coined by Dynba Tesc, the Great Evacuation was organized by Corran Horn and Whistler to free the crew of the Star's Delight and several New Republic-sympathetic individuals.

Ord Tellarom was a desert planet located in the galaxy that was home of a Clone Wars battle site. During the Imperial Era, Ord Tellarom was the home of a Zillo Beast, and the location where the B1-series battle droid R0-GR was reactivated by the Freemakers.

The Sublight Star Five Million was a race held at some point by 34 ABY in which starfighter racer pilot Hype Fazon once competed. During the race, Fazon taunted his competing racers before throttling the sublight jets of his craft and crossing the finish line.
A clan of Mustafarians led by Father Kkkt lived on Mustafar. After witnessing the arrival of a burning starship, Kkkt sent four of his clan to investigate where it may have landed.
The Lathien Leth was a Nella 342 light freighter owned by the Sullustan smuggler Rani Quanic.

x: During the mission on the Colossus platform, Kazuda Xiono undertook a second mission into Doza Tower to try and find out how Captain Imanuel Doza might be colluding with the First Order.

OB-1E was a OOM security battle droid owned by Gorn Vorrox during the Galactic Civil War to protect his store, Gorn's Emporium, located in the seedy Seelom District of Jyvus Space City, the largest space city in orbit over Duro.

OB-2B was a OOM security battle droid owned by Gorn Vorrox during the Galactic Civil War to protect his store, Gorn's Emporium, located in the seedy Seelom District of Jyvus Space City, the largest space city in orbit over Duro.

A world was powerful in both the light side and dark side of the Force. It had been discovered and charted in the distant past, but was not considered important enough to be named or given a designation. The world was abundant with life, but had no signs of technology.

By 37 BBY, the conflict on Bri'n had arisen between the Metal Clan and the people of Mistress Th'er, the priestess of wood. The Jedi Order sent Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi to the planet in 37 BBY.
During the Clone Wars, Senator Padmé Amidala received as message from one of her handmaidens, Duja. Duja reported that Separatists were on Mokivj and had a droid factory in place.
Dallenor was a desert planet located in the Aldino sector of the Mid Rim. An excavation led by the archaeologist Clatriffe discovered a Jedi holocron on the planet, notifying the Jedi Order.
A hushstalker was a type of creature that could be kept as pets. Skrrll once had a hushstalker named Brutux and was reminded of it by the rib-cat Warm Face.

A clone medic was a clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic that served as a medic. Kix was a clone medic in the 501st Legion. and wore the symbol of the Republic Medic Corps on his left shoulder.
Level Two was a level on the Octagon on Ryloth.

The mottled hexskip paddler was a species of black-skinned aquatic creature that lived in the oceans of the planet Corellia and was sold by fishmongers on the docks of Coronet City. The paddlers had long, thin bodies with a lateral steering fin on each side and a large flat tail.
The Lessu Dancer was a freighter owned by the smuggler Tryphon Leo. He used it to travel to Pashvi.

objective: Determine what the First Order is using Station Theta Black for
x: During the Cold War, Resistance Commander Poe Dameron and Kazuda Xiono were sent on a mission to the Unknown Regions to investigate what the First Order was using Station Theta Black for.

Eighty-One was a BX-series droid commando hunter who was hired by Wilhuff Tarkin to hunt Darth Vader, on Chandar's Folly. Eighty-One stole Vader's lightsaber after it proved to be deadly against Tarkin's team.

The MGK-300 integrated droid brain was a droid brain installed aboard Imperial TIE/rb starfighters for pilot support. One was on Han Solo's TIE/rb heavy starfighter while serving the Empire in Onyx Squadron under the callsign Onyx Nine.
Artoo was an R2-series astromech droid who belonged to the starship captain Jhensara. Artoo was one of three droids on the ship alongside Arthree and Arfive.
Arthree was an R3-series astromech droid who belonged to the starship captain Jhensara. Arthree was one of three droids on the ship alongside Artoo and Arfive.
Arfive was an R5-series astromech droid who belonged to the starship captain Jhensara. Arfive was one of three droids on the ship alongside Artoo and Arthree.

result: Darth Malgus returns to the public.
The Galactic Republic helps the Jedi Colony on Ossus.
Darth Malora is removed from the Dark Council.
x: The Invasion of Ossus was an operation carried out around 3628 BBY by the reconstituted Sith Empire under the direction of Darth Malora, and later Darth Malgus.

Qaberworms were a species of giant tentacled worms who had an inability to feel pain. They were also known to be protective of their owners. Vulaada Klam and her family owned a qaberworm named Gurtyl, who they brought with them to Milvayne.

South District Seven was a district on Milvayne where the cyberneticist Professor Prexo resided. Seeking out Prexo, Chelli Aphra attempted to take a train to South District Seven, but was forced to follow 0-0-0 when he was thrown down into the city's lower levels.

The Jedi Colony was a settlement established after the Eternal Empire conquest on the planet Ossus. The settlement was established by Jedi Master Gnost-Dural with hopes of gathering Jedi that survived the conflict.
A processing center was located in Milvayne City on the Inner Rim planet Milvayne. New arrivals on Milvayne stayed at the processing center, such as the war refugee Vulaada Klam and her parents.
DV-4D4, or DVD-4D4, was a DV supervisor who worked in the control room in the spice mines of Kessel in 10 BBY. After L3-37 freed him and other droids, DV-4D4 freed every droid and slave in the mine.
WG-22, styled as Gonk Gladiator, was a modified EG-series power droid made by Ralakili to be a gladiator droid to fight in his droid fighting pits inside Fort Ypso on Vandor.
In 0 ABY, the mission to Omereth was undertaken by Nakari Kelen and fledging Jedi Luke Skywalker.

x: In 34 ABY, during the war between the First Order and the Resistance, the First Order launched a mission to the planet Dathomir to obtain a Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor that once belonged to Anakin Skywalker, the grandfather of Kylo Ren.
WED-021 was a grey WED Treadwell repair droid that was forced to work in the control room in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
W1-EG5 was a white repair droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
P1-SZE was an orange P1 adminmech droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
NP-G1 was a yellow mining operations droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

CZ-3 was a CZ-series secretary/business communications droid that was twinned with fellow CZ unit CZ-1 in service to members of the Stacchati species. After a crash in the deserts of Tatooine the two droids became separated and CZ-3 ended up in the spaceport of Mos Eisley.
Forge B3 was a forge in the Main Rendering Plant 908 on Belsus.
The "All Aces Battle Royale," or simply the "All Aces," was a race hosted every ten cycles for ace pilots on the ocean planet Castilon.
GB-BD was an GB adminmech droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

The loading docks on the Colossus were a location where salvagers worked pulling wreckage from the ocean below. They were located on one end of the platform. Synara San got a job there after arriving on the Colossus.
DA1-4XB was a 4XB programming droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
C00-L05C was a rebuilt grey L05 adminmech droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
CM-3XB was a programmer droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
C26-T was a sifter droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
FD3-MN was a modified FD3-MN fighting droid made by Ralakili to be a gladiator droid to fight in his droid fighting pits inside Fort Ypso on Vandor.
Adarians were a sentient species from the Adari system in the Inner Rim that possessed a cranial aperture that enhanced their focus and amplified sound waves.
Faz was an extremely cold terrestrial astronomical object in the Faz system in the Farlax sector of the Core Worlds that Imperial stormtroopers could be stationed to.

The planet Esseles was invaded by the Galactic Empire in 10 ABY. As part of the Imperial offensive prior to Operation Shadow Hand, the reborn Emperor Palpatine sent out vast forces to conquer strategic worlds in the Core.
The Stacchati were a sentient species. The CZ-series secretary droids CZ-1 and CZ-3 once served members of the species and were modified from standard models to more closely resemble their masters.
A tribe of Jawas led by Chief Nebit lived in a sandcrawler on the planet Tatooine where they traveled throughout the Dune Sea scavenging droids and technology to sell.
The Inyusu Tor mineral processing facility, also known as the Inyusu Tor refinery complex, was located at the top of the volcanic mountain Inyusu Tor on the planet Sullust.
Lost Murvey was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Lost Murvey system, a star system in the Wild Space in grid square H-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Pashvi was a planet in Wild Space where the pirate Queen Maz Kanata hid a portion of the spoils from her reign in a buried vault armed with an antitamper sub-space alarm.
Borgo Prime, also known as Starport Borgo or Port Borgo, was an asteroid that served as a shadowport in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Port Haven was a shadowport in the Whendyll system in the Cademimu sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In the aftermath of the attack on Valo during the High Republic Era, Port Haven was one of the locations where the Unified Republic Task Force dealt with Nihil marauders.

Athus Klee was a world in the Athus Klee system in the Kalamith sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Besalisk Dexter Jettster traveled to the world during the reign of the Galactic Empire and discovered an ore hub operated by the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate where worke…

Descopose Farmark was a terrestrial astronomical object in the system of the same name in the Mid Rim Territories. The pirate Queen Maz Kanata hid a portion of the spoils from her reign there in a buried vault equipped with a antitamper sub-space alarm.
Seeratter was an astronomical object in the Seeratter system of Wild Space, falling within grid square G-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Graddus Rex was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Graddus Rex system in the Inner Rim region of the galaxy. The pirate Queen Maz Kanata hid a portion of the spoils from her reign there in a buried vault equipped with a antitamper sub-space alarm.

Zirtan's Anchor was a shadowport located in the Phosphura Belt Nebula in the Outer Rim Territories region of the galaxy. The former pirate Queen Maz Kanata marked it on a map she included in the book that would eventually become known as the Smuggler's Guide.
In the aftermath of the skirmish on the planet of Batuu, Grysk prisoners broke out from their detention cells and had an encounter with Commander Kimmund and his legion, aboard the Chimaera.

Gelgelar was a shadowport with an outlaw garage. The former pirate Queen Maz Kanata marked the direction of Gelgelar off the edge of a map she included in the book that would become known as the Smuggler's Guide.

Tanquilla Beach was a shadowport with an outlaw garage. The former pirate Queen Maz Kanata marked it down as an outlaw garage on a map she included in the book that would later become known as the Smuggler's Guide.
Roxuli was an Expansion Region planet that was the site of a remote mining colony during the existence of the Galactic Republic.

Keldooine was a planet and shadowport in the Keldooine system on the edge of Hutt Space. During the Republic Era, Keldooine was a key world in the region, though by 33 BBY, the piracy rampant in the Slice had taken hold on the planet.

Spirana was an astronomical object in the Spirana system of the Inner Rim Territories situated along the Corellian Run. Following the Galactic Civil War, the veteran Yrica Quell worked as a cargo operator there, eventually joined by one of her old comrades, Chass na Chadic.

Wroona was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Wroona system in the Inner Rim Territories. It lay at grid square L-15 on the Standard Galactic Grid, where it was situated along the Rimma Trade Route.
Bunduki was an astronomical object in the Bunduki system in the Pacanth Reach in the Outer Rim Territories.
Elrood was a planet in the Elrood system in the Elrood sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The location Dinbar and its starport were located on the planet.
Farana was a Wild Space planet where at one point the pirate Hondo Ohnaka acquired the frigate Acushnet and several Flarestar-class attack shuttles from a collector of antiquities.

Garqi was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories. Located on the Braxant Run hyperspace route, it was situated at grid square K-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Gree was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in the grid square L-2 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Halmad was a forested astronomical object in the Halmad system in the Quelii sector of the Outer Rim Territories, situated along the Braxant Run. The droid Y3-99 ran Y3-99's Bounty Services on Halmad.
Ketaris was a terrestrial astronomical object in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
Lok was a world located in the Maramere system in the Karthakk sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.
The Pits of Plooma was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, in the grid square L-3 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Shimia was an Outer Rim celestial body located in the Shimia system of the Dalchon sector. It was represented in the Galactic Republic's Senate, and the agricultural planet Mynos III was under its protectorate. Shimia was the homeworld of the Pacithhip Bok Askol.
Shumavar was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, situated along the Hydian Way.
Triton was an astronomical object in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, situated on the Rimma Trade Route.
Zhar was an astronomical object located in the Gall system, a star system in the Cadavine sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Redoubt was an astronomical object located in Wild Space, in grid square H-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Aeten II, also simply known as Aeten, was a volcanically turbulent planet located in Wild Space in grid square J-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid. A terrestrial planet, Aeten II held the second orbital position in the Aeten system.
Rutan was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy, situated on the Hydian Way.
Foless was an astronomical object located in the Foless system of the galaxy's Colonies region, situated on the Corellian Trade Spine and the Shipwrights' Trace.
Spice Terminus was a location in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy.
Karazak was a world in the Outer Rim's Sujimis sector, within the Karazak system. It was known for its enslavement industry.

Thakwaa was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Thakwaa system within the Tunka sector of the Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches, positioned in grid square I-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Urdur was an astronomical object in the Urdur system in the Outer Rim Territories' Corporate Sector, in grid square S-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Grand Causeway was a causeway on Pashvi that was at least partially covered by a stone roof. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the smuggler Tryphon Leo searched the causeway for the Shrove of the Left-Handed God Typhojem, which contained a buried vault of treasure h…

The Corellian Merchants' Guild was a guild associated with the planet Corellia. The freelance smuggler Tryphon Leo was a member of both the Corellian Merchants' Guild and the Mandroxan Cartel during the reign of the Galactic Empire, a fact that Leo wrote down in the book Smugg…
R4-G77 was an astromech droid owned by Hype Fazon of Ace Squadron, serving as co-pilot of Green Ace.

Zaddja was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Zaddja system of the Outer Rim Territories, situated at the coordinates H-15 on the Standard Galactic Grid. Its surface consisted of oceans broken up by archipelagoes of white sand beaches.

type: Fictitious spice dealership and criminal organization
x: The Kaitis Cartel was a fictitious criminal organization created by Sith Lord Darth Maul. Maul posed as one of the cartel's enforcers and worked with the thief Zek Peiro in intercepting scarn shipments.

objective: Capture Hera Syndulla
x: Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, a crew of mercenaries led by Chelli Aphra traveled to the Lucrehulk Prime to capture the Alliance to Restore the Republic General Hera Syndulla.

Diablo Cut was a treacherous ravine within Beggar's Canyon on Tatooine. By narrowly making it through both this and the Stone Needle in his T-16 skyhopper, Luke Skywalker proved himself to be an excellent pilot.
The Thugs of Thule were a infamous and highly educated mercenary gang that shared its name with Thule, a planet in the Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Imperial Cruiser 07200823 was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier in the navy of the Galactic Empire. While serving in the Carida Academy, Han Solo and his fellow cadets were assigned to take the cruiser and transport several TIE fighter pilots.
The Krypder Riders were a group of pirates led by Hudso Shaku that operated on the planet Dallenor during the later years of the Galactic Republic.

objective: Retrieve a Jedi holocron
x: The mission to Dallenor began after a Jedi holocron was discovered during an excavation on Dallenor. Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker were sent on a mission to the planet to verify the holocron and return it to the Jedi Order.

The Dallenor Excavation was an archaeological excavation on the Mid Rim planet Dallenor. It was led by the archaeologist Clatriffe. The first artifacts uncovered in the excavation included ancient broken droid parts, but eventually an item thought to be a Jedi holocron was found.

Telerath was a planet located in the Nouane sector of the Inner Rim. It was allegedly a resort world but had problems with gang violence. Disputes on Telerath were settled through sword combat, in a convention known as Sword Law.

Parsh was the homeworld of Wanten, a sandtrooper commander in the military of the Galactic Empire. Before joining the stormtroopers, Wanten eked out a living on the harsh world as a member of a clan where he was protected by an Alphon.

x: An attack on the gunrunner Praaelon Di was carried out by a group of bounty hunters and pirates at some point between 1 BBY and 3.5 ABY.
Bakkar Spire was a spire in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu that acted as the location of a spaceport.

Galagolos V, also known simply as Galagalos, was a swampy and stinky planet located in the galaxy's Colonies region, in grid square J-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid, that was the homeworld of the Cloddogran Bargwill Tomder.
The Zygerrian slave market was a slave market on the planet of Zygerria. The market was controlled by the Zygerrian Slave Empire.

Strata Seven was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Strata system in the Inner Rim Territories where a Mandalorian construction worker used to hit on the pilot Taka Jamoreesa.

t: Auction for the Phylanx Redux Transmitter
x: Around 3 BBY, an auction for the Phylanx Redux Transmitter was held in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica by the criminal syndicate Wandering Star for the Phylanx Redux Transmitter.
Xu'hu was a terrestrial object in the Xu'hu system of the Outer Rim Territories' Quiberon sector. The cantina Dande Donjon was located there, on the shore of Vette Lake.
Manala was a high-end island resort on the planet Telerath. It was home to the planet's most infamous judge, Mazzum Onas.

The moisture farmer Cliegg Lars formed a quadrille of dozens of moisture farmers to rescue his wife Shmi Skywalker Lars from a band of Tusken Raiders who kidnapped her when they passed near the Lars moisture farm.
The Sphere of Scientific Advancement was one of the five Spheres of Influence of the reconstituted Sith Empire that was created by Empress Darth Acina after the Eternal Empire conquest.
The Cistern of Discipline was a location on Corellia filled with water. Lady Proxima sent White Worms there after a storm to scavenge for flotsam and catch fleek eels and coppergrins.
G2-X was the droid custodian of of the starship Wayward Current.

Beixander 9 was a small lonely moon located in the Beixander system within the galaxy's Mid Rim in grid square H-15 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was covered in oceans and hills, one of which was home to a settlement.
Dhandu was a planet located in the Dhandu system, within the Interior and the Expansion Region, in grid square I-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Substation Grimdock, also known simply as Grimdock, was a moon inhabited by bastaks, a species of crustaceans. It was located in the Grimdock system in the Axion sector of the Expansion Region, along the Ootmian Pabol hyperspace route.

First Order SCUBA troopers, also known as First Order underwater stormtroopers or simply SCUBA troopers, were stormtroopers of the First Order that were specialized to operate in aquatic environments.

result: Han, Luke and Leia escape Hubin
Clan Markona join the Rebel Alliance
x: During the Galactic Civil War, a skirmish broke out between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire on the moon Hubin.

Motesta Oasis was an oasis located on the desert planet of Tatooine. Situated on the far eastern edge of the Jundland Wastes, the oasis was between Arnthout to the north and the Jawa Heights to the south.

t: Skirmish in the Fort Garnik hangar
x: During the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, the smuggler who would later be known as the Voidhound and their associate Corso Riggs were attacked by bounty hunters in the hangar of Fort Garnik.

Sometime before the plot to assassinate Senator Amidala, Jango Fett, his son Boba Fett, and three other bounty hunters went on a Mission to Ord Mantell to capture a runaway Twi'lek who was trying to join the Black Sun on the planet Ord Mantell.

Savi's Path was the local name for a route to and from Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. Savi, an elder of the outpost, owned the company Savi & Son Salvage and its associated workshop near the middle of the outpost.

The Randolean Ring was a criminal organization active during the Imperial Era. The pirate Hondo Ohnaka regarded the group as scoundrels and scum, but he felt that they were not as villainous as the Mandragonian Mob.
The Obsidian Combine was a criminal organization active during the Imperial Era. The pirate Hondo Ohnaka believed the Obsidian Combine to be bad, but he believed the Mandragonian Mob was even worse.

result: The Mantellian Separatist Movement takes control of Talloran village
Republic forces blockade Talloran to contain the Separatists
Many civilians trapped inside without supplies
x: During the Separatist War on Ord Mantell, forces of the Mantellian Separatist Movement took over and occupied the settlement of Talloran village.

Dryden's study was the office of Dryden Vos, a crime lord and the public leader of Crimson Dawn. Vos kept several artifacts and frozen trophies in his office, which was on the top level of the First Light.

Bardelberan 7, also known simply as Bardelberan, was a planet located in the Bardelberan system, within the Churnis sector in the Mid Rim. It was situated in grid square J-6 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

In 34 ABY, an incident occurred on the Colossus platform on Castilon after Bibo, a juvenile rokkna, was accidentally brought on board inside of a wrecked Z-95 Headhunter salvaged by Synara San. Upon seeing the creature, Neeku Vozo instantly decided to adopt him and name him Bibo.
The Karavian Trench was an underwater trench in the ocean of the planet Castilon. The trench was home to rokknas, gargantuan tentacled creatures native to the world.
Rokkna were a species of massive, tentacled sea creatures native to the planet Castilon.

Verde's Belt, also known as the Verde asteroid field, was an expansive asteroid field in the Verde system. The mineral rich asteroids that formed it made it a hotbed for illegal mining. It contained the planetoid Yen-2.

A mouthless green-skinned alien species lived in the galaxy. The species was humanoid in form. Two black eyes were set in its face, along with a pronounced nose. The species could be fed nutrients through a special suit.
The Corellian Sector was a sector of the moon of Nar Shaddaa.
The Galaxy's Glory was a racing starfighter owned by the famous racer Marcus Speedstar.

Praxat Sil was a terrestrial astronomical object located within the Sava system, a star system in the Jidlor Marches of the Mid Rim Territories, situated in grid square J-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Siren Sea was a sea on Parnassos that was near Terpsichore Station, a Con Star Mining Corporation outpost that was home to a large mine. The Siren Sea was a popular tourist destination before the Devastation of Parnassos and was said to be a tram ride away from Terpsichore.
The tenth-level solarium den was a solarium on Weigh Station Karambola. Lando Calrissian met Prita Sven in the tenth-level solarium den, but was taken off the station by L3-37.
The Battle of Arantara was an engagement fought in 22 BBY on the astronomical object Arantara during the ongoing Clone Wars between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic.
Arantara was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the galaxy. In 22 BBY, Arantara was the site of the Battle of Arantara during the Clone Wars.
Administrative Sector 7-C was a sector of the prison moon Substation Grimdock. Aro N'cookaala was in charge of the security of all entities within the sector.
Administrative Sector 44-B was a sector of the prison moon Substation Grimdock. The desk of the Gungan security guard Aro N'cookaala was located at the main entrance to the sector.

The Grimdock Archive was the archive of information at the prison moon Substation Grimdock. Han Solo and Lando Calrissian recruited a team to slice into the Grimdock Archive and retrieve information on Fyzen Gor.
Subsector Five was a subsector of the prison moon Substation Grimdock, located above Subsector Twelve.
Subsector Twelve was one of the lower subsectors of the prison moon Substation Grimdock in the Expansion Region. Bastaks inhabited the area below the subsector.

The Mesulan Remnants Belt was an asteroid field created from the rupture of the ice moon Mesula. Fyzen Gor hid the Phylanx Redux Transmitter in a chamber within the Remnants, programming it to act as the center of gravity for the asteroids as well as move in a random path thro…
Sef Con was a private prison operator in the New Republic. The security force was made up of former Galactic Empire elite assault stormtroopers.

The Elthree Assault Team was a group of seven battle droids, founded by L3-37 to counter Fyzen Gor's Phylanx Redux Transmitter. Gor planned to use the Phylanx to transmit a virus that would command droids around the Galaxy to rise up and kill organic beings.
The Darkflare was a state-of-the-art S-46I Medium Scout Ship that was manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems for the Galactic Empire.

A droid was constructed by L3-37 in order to form the Elthree Assault Team. Once built, the battle droid manufactured several replicas of itself, waiting until a virus that L3 had placed in the Phylanx Redux Transmitter sent out a distress signal.

Number Five was one of the medical droids who served Fyzen Gor's Brotherhood of Wire and Bone, and one of the Original Dozen. The droid was modified and repaired, partially using body parts taken from Wookiees.
Sector seven forty-six was a location within the Mesulan Remnants Belt. A skirmish between Fyzen Gor and several Imperial TIE fighters occurred in the sector.
An Imperial outpost was located on the planet Allst Prime. The 61st Mobile Infantry were deployed on the planet to take out the outpost.
Pakiphantos were a sentient elephantine species that existed in the galaxy. They had large ears, pillar-like feet, and trunks which they could use to make a trumpeting noise.
Trivar II was a planet in the Nuiri sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was a regular stop for the Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service freighter Stellar Crawler operated by Captain Nel Frel.
The Stellar Crawler was a modified YT-2400 light freighter commanded by Captain Nel Frel, a member of the Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service, during the Galactic Civil War.
Quan-Shui was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Quan-Shui system in the Montitian Grant sector of the Expansion Region. The Z7 series construction droid Zeta worked on a job on Quan-Shui.
Z5-TXT was a droid who worked on building a settlement in Quan-Shui and then worked in Cro-Akon. A group of Tectozin's went to slave droids building a settlement in Cro-Akon.
The Freighter boneyard was a location in the Silo, Bottoms, Coronet City, Corellia filled with broken freighters. Qi'ra kept her safe house there.
Powlo's lair was a lair in Coronet City where Powlo lived.

Valashar was a Mid Rim Territories celestial body situated in the Churnis sector's Valashar system. In 34 ABY, the Office of Acquisitions proprietors Flix and Orka sold a phase connector mining device to a mining colony on Valashar.
Keteerians were a sentient species that inhabited the galaxy. Teroj Kee, an ally of the First Order, was a Keteerian, as was Terrib Igmusk, a hotel employee at Canto Bight.

Bastaks were a species of non-sentient, carnivorous crustaceans that inhabited the lower levels of the prison moon Substation Grimdock. They had a hypnotic call, which only took effect with eye contact.
Forosnags were a non-sentient species with several pairs of arms and six rows of teeth. They were immune to blaster fire due to their ability to swallow it.

Forlyn were creatures that were illegal to hunt. At some point by around 11 BBY, Lando Calrissian persuaded Prita Sven into letting him fly off Pantora with a cargo of illegally poached forlyn carcasses.
Sriflies were a type of fly found on Kashyyyk.

The moons of Bogden were a group of moons that surrounded the planet Bogden. Sometime prior to the Invasion of Naboo, bounty hunter Jango Fett was hired by the Sith Lord Darth Tyranus on one of the moons for access to his genetic template.
Clerion was an uninhabited gas giant located in the Lower Tion. It was situated in the Clerion system in the Palamut sector of the Expansion Region.
KRONOS-841 was a droid who bid by proxy with his cohorts at the Xrexus Cartel's auction of Jedi Padawan Eldra Kaitis in 33 BBY; however, they were outbid by the industrialist Jee Kra.
During the Separatist War, the Galactic Republic imposed a blockade on Talloran village to contain the Separatist forces there.

The Scarlet Vertha was a custom-made Ghtroc Industries 720 light freighter owned by the Morseerian Nabrun Leids. Leids used the starship in his work as a smuggler and a pilot for hire and was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Moldour 14 was a moon that orbited the Outer Rim Territories celestial body Moldour. Its surface featured several islands, on one of which the Pirate Queen Maz Kanata buried treasure in a vault.
Commex's headquarters was the main office of the Commex corporation located on the planet Ulicia in the Corporate Sector.
The Corellian League was a gladiator walker combat league. Teams in the league included Cloud City's Bespin Velkers.
Bespin Velkers was a gladiator walker combat team during the Galactic Civil War. They were based on Cloud City and competed in the Corellian League.
The Imperial Navy Exclusion Zone was an area in the Abrion sector that was restricted by the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire which contained the Imperial stronghold planet Scarif.

The Spacers' District was a location on the world of Athus Klee. During the reign of the Galactic Empire sometime prior to 10 BBY, the Besalisk Dexter Jettster arrived on Athus Klee in a star-streamer.

The Council of Labor Abuses was a body within the Imperial Senate of the Galactic Empire. At some point prior to 10 BBY, the Besalisk Dexter Jettster learned of an ore hub being run by the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate on Athus Klee, and traveled in the world in order to inv…
A starship once served as the personal flagship of the tyrannical warlord known as Xim the Despot long before the reign of the Galactic Empire or the First Order.

The Underworld, also known as the Undercity, was the lower levels of Milvayne City on the planet Milvayne. Individuals who were unwanted in the upper city, or sentenced as criminals by the Milvayne Authority, were thrown down into the Underworld.

Destruction of the Scyre and Claw clans
Destruction of the Scyre territory and Arratu Station.
objective: Recruit warriors for the First Order
x: During the New Republic Era, General Brendol Hux led a mission to the backwater world of Parnassos to recruit warriors for the First Order, a successor of the "Old Empire." Hux's ship was shot down by Parnassos' automated defense system.

Thunder bats were a species of bat that could be found on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, the Endor-residing Ewoks Paploo and Wicket Wystri Warrick were playing drop-the-sack, attempting to drop a sack of mud on their friend Teebo.

The Gozzo were a sentient species that were native to the planet Drahgor III which was located in the Outer Rim of the galaxy. Han Solo negotiated with a group of Gozzo living on Troiken during the Galactic Civil War. Flix, Flanx, and Floog were members of this species.
Level 3321 was one of the 5,127 vertical levels of Galactic City, the ecumenopolis that covered the planet Coruscant.

The Kuari Princess was a luxury liner which operated during the Imperial Era. At some point, the Kuari Princess was targeted by the Droid Gotra for a campaign. The Imperial Security Bureau suspected piracy would occur, but the Princess went untouched.

t: Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Operation Shadow Hand)
result: Heavy Imperial casualties, including the Invincible with all hands
Escape of the Millennium Falcon with Vima-Da-Boda
objective: Imperial: Recruit Boba Fett; kill Vima-Da-Boda; locate and capture the
New Republic: Rescue Vima-Da-Boda
Bounty hunters: Capture or kill Han Solo
x: A mission to the moon Nar Shaddaa was undertaken by the crew of the starship Millennium Falcon during Operation Shadow Hand. Han Solo, his wife Leia Organa Solo and their allies sought to rescue the fugitive Jedi Vima-Da-Boda.
The Booster BX was a custom light freighter owned by the Broken Horn Syndicate that served as a raiding vessel during the Age of the Empire.

result: The First Order betrays Kragan Gorr and the Warbird gang
The First Order leaves a small detail of stormtroopers on the Colossus
objective: Kidnap Torra Doza and coerce Captain Imanuel Doza to relinquish contro
x: Torra Doza's abduction was a mission in 34 ABY that the First Order tasked the pirate Kragan Gorr and his pirate gang with, to kidnap Captain Imanuel Doza's daughter Torra in an effort to coerce him into relinquishing control of the Colossus to the First Order.

Palliduvans were a near-human species From the Wild Space planet Palliduva, characterized by their lanky frames, chalk-white skin, and long, bony fingers used to draw blood. Palliduvans included the bounty hunter Aurra Sing and the pirate Valik.
The Galleon was a sail barge composed of various old Imperial vehicles that served as the headquarters of Kragan Gorr's Warbird gang on Castilon.

result: Kazuda Xiono sinks Teroj Kee's ship, denying the First Order access to
objective: Steal a phase connector for the First Order
x: During the New Republic Era, the First Order operative Teroj Kee undertook a mission to steal a phase connector from Flix and Orka's shop, the Office of Acquisitions, on the Colossus platform on the planet Castilon.
A warehouse on the Expansion Region planet Nakadia was the location of many chemical bioweapons stockpiled by the Galactic Empire during its reign.

The Caves of Thunder were caves located on the Forest Moon of Endor. In 3 ABY, the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick returned to Bright Tree Village from a distant section of the forest, where he encountered a savage, red-furred Ewok.

The Crimson Dawn syndicate owned an ore hub on Athus Klee. Doctor Cornelius Evazan was employed there to cybernetically alter the workers there, which caught the attention of the Besalisk Dexter Jettster.

The Sandral-Matale feud was a conflict between the Sandral and Matale family families on Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War. The feud was ended in 3956 BBY due to the intervention of the Jedi Padawan Revan.

Em-Five was a droid that operated during the Imperial Era. When the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca required a part for their freighter, the Millennium Falcon, they tasked Em-Five with retrieving it on the planet Corellia.
Kudo III was a terrestrial moon of Kudo, located in the Kudo system within the Corvair sector of the Inner Rim Territories. It had a population of the Kudon species.

Kudo was a desert planet located in the Kudo system of the Corvair sector of the Inner Rim Territories, orbited by at least three moons. Kudo III, one of Kudo's moons, was inhabited by the Kudon species.

Pijal was a terrestrial planet located in the Inner Rim Territories' Pijal system that was connected to the hyperspace route known as the Pijal Hyperspace Corridor. The world had a moon nearly as large as itself and was affected by solar flares from its sun roughly every decade.

Moldour was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body. It was orbited by several moons, including Moldour 14, which for centuries were used by various individuals to hide personal valuables. By 3 ABY, the clothing items Moldour thief belt, pants, and vest were all made on Moldour.

Sector 7-E was a location on the Colossus the station's residents were prohibited from entering. Kazuda Xiono and BB-8 encountered several pirates in sector 7-E, and managed to prevent them from stealing several crates of blasters.

t: Obi-Wan Kenobi's blue Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor
x: Following the loss of his previous Eta-2 during the Battle of Coruscant, Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi piloted a blue Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor prior to the Battle of Utapau.

result: Kazuda Xiono and Neeku Vozo help Synara San escape the First Order tro
objective: Help Synara San escape from the Colossus before the First Order captur
x: After the First Order occupied the Colossus platform in 34 ABY, Resistance spy Kazuda Xiono helped Synara San, a spy for the Warbird gang, escape from the station before she could be captured.
Quadrant 3.27 was the section of the Colossus platform that Jarek Yeager's Repair Station was located in.

Novka was an astronomical object in the Mid Rim Territories where the Galactic Empire operated an impound yard. When the smuggler Sana Starros was captured by the Empire after assisting members of the Rebel Alliance, her ship, the Volt Cobra, was taken to Novka to be impounded.

The Black Spire was a petrified tree found in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu. It was considered the heart of the outpost and was located next to Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities and Savi's Workshop.

t: Attack on an Imperial Impound Yard
result: Damage to the Imperial Impound Yard
x: An attack was led by members of the Rebel Alliance at an Imperial Impound Yard on Novka. The objective of the attack, led by Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, Han Solo and Tula Markona of Clan Markona, was to retrieve the Volt Cobra, the starship of Sana Starros.
Innton II was a sparsely populated planet near the Triton system. It was also the location of the Defiant Core.
A YT-2400 light freighter was held by the Galactic Empire at the Imperial Impound Yard on Novka. It was stolen by Tula Markona during an attack on the Imperial Impound Yard, and used by Clan Markona.

A village was located on Kudo III, home to a number of Kudon. During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems gassed the village and enslaved the Kudon, forcing them to run a droid foundry in attempts to trick the Galactic Republic into destroying the factory and…

Rorak was an astronomical object located in the Rorak system in Hutt Space in grid square S-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It sat along the Shag Pabol hyperspace route, and was an endpoint of the Gamor Run route that linked it to Circumtore to the west.

Circumtore was a ring-shaped planet located in the Hutt Space region of the galaxy. It was connected to the Hutt Space worlds Rorak, Nar Kaaga and Hollastin by hyperspace routes as well as Daalang outside of the region. Circumtore was located at galactic coordinates S-12.

Nar Kaaga was a planet located in the Hutt Space region of the galaxy. It was connected to fellow Hutt Space world Circumtore and the Bothan Space planet Bothawui by hyperspace routes. Nar Kaaga was located at galactic coordinates S-13.

Syvris was a small moon in the Syvris system in the Al'Nasrl sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square T-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was part of the Triellus Trade Route, which connected it to the world Dubrava and the Arami system.
The Typhojem Excavation was an archaeological dig that took place on the Grand Causeway on the planet Pashvi during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Qhulosk was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories, home to the Qhuloskian species. During the Imperial Era, the Galactic Empire operated an Imperial Navy Mobile Base on Qhulosk to assist in a battle against the Qhuloskian inhabitants.
The Varcinius Repository was a saucer-shaped satellite that was in geosynchronous orbit in the mesospheric cloud layers of Clerion. It had many hexvaults used to store valuable items.
Pax was a world located in the Pax system of the Kira sector, a part of the Expansion Region and the Trailing Sectors in grid square N-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Corridor G-9 was a corridor on the Colossus refueling station. When the Resistance spy Kazuda Xiono ran from the First Order while wearing the armor of the stormtrooper CS-515, he escaped down Corridor G-9, placing the armor back on the unconscious trooper, who was then tracke…

A snarlfish was a type of fish that was native to the planet Castilon. Because of evolution, the snarlfish was left with moveable eye stalks that helped them detect movement in the oceans murky waters.

A mining colony operated on the Mid Rim celestial body Valashar by 34 ABY. By that year, the colony ordered a phase connector mining device from the Office of Acquisitions on the supertanker fuel depot Colossus, though it was ultimately destroyed before being delivered.
A planet was the site of Takara's stronghold, where Mara Jade was taken as a prisoner in 10 ABY.

result: Dooku makes contact with the Kaldana Syndicate
objective: Investigate the Kaldana Syndicate
Seek out the Kaldana Syndicate
x: In 26 BBY, the Jedi Knight Jak'zin undertook a mission on Sullust on behalf of the Jedi Council and Galactic Republic to investigate the Kaldana Syndicate, a criminal syndicate who had made inroads on Sullust.

Howlan was a city located on Qhulosk. The city was the site of a battle between its inhabitants and the Galactic Empire, who were stationed in the nearby Imperial Navy Mobile Base. During the course of the battle, the city was heavily damaged.

place: Varcinius Repository, in orbit around Clerion
x: The Varcinius Repository job was a heist pulled off by Gallandro and a gang that he had put together. The main goal was to steal the Codeleach for a client.
BJ-64 was a feminine repair droid with a single round eye in the middle of her head. She repaired speeders used for illegal racing.

A starship served as the flagship of the Kaldana Syndicate, a criminal organization that operated in the Corellia system. In 13 BBY, the Kaldana sold the flagship in order to enter an auction for a datacube that contained plans for a shield generator.
Selonia was a planet located in the Corellian sector of the the galaxy's Core Worlds. It was was one of five planets orbiting the sun Corell in the Corellia system.

result: Commander Poe Dameron and Kazuda Xiono discover that the system's sun
objective: Investigate a star system the First Order has been active in
x: In 34 ABY, Commander Poe Dameron and Kazuda Xiono undertook a mission to the Dassal system, a star system Xiono had identified during his mission on the Colossus, which the First Order had apparently been active in.

A moon was located in the Dassal system in the Unknown Regions, orbiting the planetoid Najra-Va, which had been cored out by the First Order. Due to the disappearance of the system's sun, the moon's surface was rocky and cold.

Najra-Va was a rocky planet in the Dassal system of the Unknown Regions, orbited by a once-inhabited moon. Along with the other celestial bodies in the system, Najra-Va was cored out by the First Order as a test for the Starkiller Base superweapon in the year 34 ABY.

This village was located on a moon of the planet Najra-Va in the Dassal system in the Unknown Regions. Its major focal point was a large temple. At some point, its population was massacred, prior to the system's sun vanishing.
DUM-4 was a DUM-series pit droid that was allocated to pit crew of podracer Ody Mandrell during the Boonta Eve Classic podrace at the Mos Espa Grand Arena on the planet Tatooine in 32 BBY.

The Tanner Ranch was located in the Western Dune Sea on the planet Tatooine. It was the home of the Tanner family, Jahn and Lania and their son, Shan. The ranch was also the home of their three farmhands, Wes and Dana Hogaan and their daughter, Minda.
The Coronet Rapier was a YT-1300 light freighter. It was used by a crew of spacers during the Galactic Civil War.

side1: Citizens of Wayfar and surrounding settlements
x: The Battle of Wayfar was an armed conflict between the citizens of the town of Wayfar and a Tusken Raider warband on the planet Tatooine. A roving warband of Tuskens terrorized the Western Dune Sea, destroying settlements and stealing water.
R5-S9 was an R5 unit manufactured by Industrial Automaton that served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.
A Twi'lek militia safehouse was established in an underground district of Nabat, a small city located on the Outer Rim world of Ryloth.
The Enduring Pride was a modified IGV-55 surveillance vessel used by the Coalition for Progress during the Galactic Civil War. It was an Imperial propaganda flagship that served under Captain Okma.
Kivley's Gulley was a dried-up river on the planet Mokivj. LebJau attempted to build a boat in the dry riverbed, hoping that rain would flood the river and allow it to float.
Yovbridge was a settlement on Mokivj. Interstel Systems had an office in Yovbridge.

Interstel Systems was a communications network and message service that operated in the Outer Rim Territories, near the edge of the Unknown Regions. They had a comm triad on Batuu, Mokivj and Plood, and an office in Yovbridge.

The security council was a committee of the New Republic that was in charge of coordinating security. After Fyzen Gor escaped Substation Grimdock during Magernon's Amnesty and the resulting standoff, an emergency meeting of the security council was called, and the New Republic…

conflict: Search for the Phylanx Redux Transmitter
x: The blockade of Substation Grimdock, also known as the Battle of Grimdock, occurred above the prison moon Substation Grimdock after Sergeant Magernon granted amnesty to many of the prisoners.

t: First skirmish in the Mesulan Remnants Belt
x: A skirmish occurred in the Mesulan Remnants Belt between Fyzen Gor and several Imperial TIE fighters. The Millennium Falcon, piloted by Lando Calrissian and L3-37, became involved after arriving in the Mesulan Remnants to follow a distress signal sent by the droid D9.

t: Second skirmish in the Mesulan Remnants Belt
conflict: Search for the Phylanx Redux Transmitter
result: The Phylanx Redux Transmitter is destroyed
x: A skirmish in the Mesulan Remnants Belt occurred after Fyzen Gor's escape from Substation Grimdock. Attempting to prevent Gor from activating the Phylanx Redux Transmitter, Han Solo and Lando Calrissian's team tracked the transmitter to the Mesulan Remnants, but their starship…
The Shrapnel Field was an area on the planet Utapau. After kidnapping Fyzen Gor and Greesto Ftrak, the Wandering Star took them into wastelands past the Shrapnel Field.
Sinkhole Crassnah was a sinkhole on the planet Utapau.

Number Seven was one of the medical droids Fyzen Gor's Original Dozen, who had been repaired using limbs taken from Wookiees. Number Seven was one of the droids who assisted Gor in his activation of the Phylanx Redux Transmitter in the Mesulan Remnants Belt.
The Original Dozen was a group of medical droids, originally taken from the Wandering Star, reprogrammed and upgraded by Fyzen Gor.

The Parapa Cartel was a criminal organization led by the Frizznoth Mozeen Parapa. They tracked the Phylanx Redux Transmitter to Freerago's Satellite Diner and Motel, requesting the assistance of Sana Starros and Han Solo to find it and deliver it to them.

Karvathians were a sentient species from the Karvathia system that could hear high-pitched sounds. They created the music style trusk, which, during the time of the Old Republic, was originally performed in dingy establishments at pitches that only members of the species could…

Sranfrak Creek was a location in Pau City on Utapau, and the home of Fyzen Gor's parents. Cli Pastayra of the Wandering Star instructed his gunners to burn down his family home and kill his parents in the event of his death.

The First Order maintained elite stormtroopers, a specialized variant of the standard stormtrooper, that were part of its special forces. Armed with SE-44C blaster pistols, they also utilized elite speeder bikes that were employed for high-risk missions.

result: Hype Fazon and Aunt Z escape the platform on a stolen transport and he
objective: Rescue Hype Fazon and others from the First Order
x: During the First Order's occupation of the Colossus refueling station, Resistance spy Kazuda Xiono and Torra Doza launched a mission to rescue Hype Fazon, Aunt Z and several others that had been captured by the First Order.
The Pnakotic Coast was an area of coastline on the planet Savareen. Both the Bis Refinery and the Pnakotic Coast village were located on the Pnakotic Coast.
In 8 ABY, Moff Kentor Sarne deployed a Carrack-class light cruiser to Tanquilla Beach. The captain's mission was to strike at the corvette FarStar and then retreat into hyperspace.
The Centennial Peregrine was a starship stolen and crashed by Hondo Ohnaka, a pirate operating throughout the galaxy.

Hype Fazon's hangar bay, designated hangar C2, was a hangar located on the Colossus refueling station and was used by the Ace pilot Hype Fazon as his personal hangar. Fazon stored his racer, the Green Ace, there.

R23-X9 was an astromech droid owned by Torra Doza of Ace Squadron. Though it resembled an R-series astromech, it was a more specialized version custom-built for Doza, and its color scheme was made to match Doza's state-of-the-art racer, the Blue Ace.

R5-G9 was an astromech droid belonging to Griff Halloran of Ace Squadron. Like Halloran's ship, the Black Ace, R5-G9 was cobbled together from old Imperial-issue droids and other assorted parts, including an old R2 unit.

SC-X2 was an astromech droid belonging to Bo Keevil of Ace Squadron. When Keevil flew his ship, Yellow Ace, SC-X2 made calculations to assist whenever the ship reconfigured its wings. SC-X2 was highly reinforced to withstand most crashes and ship malfunctions.
T3-K10 was an astromech droid manufactured by Duwani Mechanical Products and owned by Freya Fenris of Ace Squadron, co-piloting Freya's customized ship Red Ace.
The Sand Pirates were a group of pirates who operated on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War
The West Docks was a docking area on the Colossus platform. The First Order arrested several residents of the station who opposed their occupation, holding them as prisoners at the West Docks.

result: The Resistance establishes a base on Batuu
