The Finalizer is incapacitated over Batuu
objective: Locate members of the Resistance
Locate allies, sanctuary and firepower
x: The mission to Batuu, later known as the Battle of Batuu, was a battle that took place during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.
a: Attack on a Resurgent-class Star Destroyer

x: 8D-J8 was an 8D-series smelter droid manufactured by Roche Hive. At one time, the droid was aboard the sail barge of Jabba Desilijic Tiure on the planet Tatooine.

Gralack was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Gralack system in the Kwymar sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Several structures were located on Gralack, including a theater where the actor Tunga Arpagion performed.
Seylott was a planet located in the Seylott system in the Sarin sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the site of one of Maz Kanata's treasure troves.
Cianap was a terrestrial planet in the galaxy. At some point, an advanced society existed on Cianap, but it was destroyed, leaving ruins of cities behind.
Raz, nicknamed Razzy, was a droid that lived on the planet Cianap. She had witnessed the fall of the planet's civilization, and later became the companion of one of the Cianap native.

headquarters: Savi's Workshop, Black Spire Outpost, Batuu
x: The Savi & Son Salvage company on Batuu salvaged starships in a junkyard outside of Black Spire Outpost, and sold metal and other items within the outpost at Savi's Workshop.

result: Kazuda Xiono successfully makes contact with the Resistance
objective: Deactivate the First Order jammer on top of Doza Tower to make contact
x: During the First Order's occupation of the Colossus refueling station on Castilon, Resistance member and spy Kazuda Xiono launched a mission to deactivate the First Order communication jammer on top of Doza Tower so he and his allies could contact the Resistance.

The invasion of the Antemeridian sector occurred in 13 ABY during the low-intensity phase of the Galactic Civil War. Eight years after the Battle of Endor, Imperial Moff Tol Getelles still ruled the Antemeridian sector, in the Borderland Regions.

LE-12 was an older-model LE-series droid who resided on the Colossus. It moved on two springy legs, and regularly performed tasks for mechanics and salvagers who resided on the platform. It was aided in these tasks by its two clamps and a head capable of rotating 360 degrees.

The Targappians were a species of sentient humanoids characterized by their webbed fingers and iridescent hair. Four years after the Invasion of Naboo, their homeworld of Targappia was represented in the Senate of the Galactic Republic by a female senator.

Clabron was a planet in the Clabron system in the Core Worlds that was the homeworld of the Clabronian species. During the Clone Wars, many Clabronians wished to stay out of the conflict, but Grand Minister Stin planned to side with the Galactic Republic.

The Clabronians were a sentient species from the world of Clabron. During the Clone Wars, they were led by Grand Minister Stin, who considered siding with the Galactic Republic, despite the fact that many Clabronians wished to stay out of the conflict.

result: Grand Minister Tarmin agrees to provide aid
objective: Convince Clabron to join the Galactic Republic
x: During the Clone Wars, Senator Padmé Amidala undertook a mission to Clabron, after Grand Minister Stin summoned her there to ally with the Galactic Republic. However, the Confederacy of Independent Systems learnt of the meeting, sending the assassin Lis Mohles to kill Stin.

Targappia was the homeworld of the humanoid Targappian species. It was represented in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic by a female Targappian, and was located in the Targappia system of the Colonies.
The White Suns or Whitesuns was a liberation movement that freed slaves that was active on the planet Tatooine in 28 BBY.

The main stack was a location on Cianap, situated underneath the ground. When escaping from the Ender, a native of Cianap and his droid Raz attempted to run to the main stack, but the Ender blocked their path.
Sivad was an astronomical object located in the Mid Rim Territories and the Trailing Sectors' Iskin sector, within the Sivad system.
Thiafeña was an astronomical object located in the Thiafeña system within the Mulgard sector of the Mid Rim and Trailing Sectors. It was situated in grid square N-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Joh'Cire was a desert moon located in the Mid Rim Territories' Alui sector, within the Joh'Cire system. It was situated in grid square N-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid. During the time of the Galactic Republic, the moon had a growing population and moisture farming industry.
Dravabi Province was an area on the planet Bromlarch. After seismic activity damaged Bromlarch's planetary aqueduct system, rain in Dravabi Province led to a threat of flooding.
NON-3, nicknamed Nonnie, was a NON unit assigned to Padmé Amidala, senator for Naboo in the Galactic Senate, during her six-week orientation session.

During the Galactic Civil War, a battle took place above Cianap between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. During the battle, Darth Vader was forced to crash-land on Cianap after his TIE Advanced x1 was damaged.
The Inferno was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Imperial Navy shortly before the Battle of Yavin.
The Yam'rii, also known as the Huk, were an insectoid sentient species from the Wild Space planet Huk.

The Quor'sav were a sentient species that moved about on at least two long, stilt-like legs. One such being was present in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine in 1 BBY on the same day Luke Skywalker sold his landspeeder to a Vuvrian named Wioslea.
The Republic Survey Corps was a surveying organization within the Galactic Republic. The Republic Scout Service scout Arhul Corubalni had logged the planet Vandor into its databank.

The Dhanduese were a flightless avian sentient species that inhabited Dhandu 3, a moon of the planet Dhandu. The low gravity of the moon did not affect them, as their clawed feet allowed them to grip onto the ground.
Hakotei was an astronomical object associated with the Presagers of Hakotei, a group that ritually sacrificed individuals to receive visions of the future.

The Qiraash were a near-human sentient species identifiable by their pink skin and large craniums. Leesub Sirln was a Qiraash who was present at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina shortly before the Battle of Yavin.
The Riorians were an insect-like species. One named Loje Nella was present during a performance by the Max Rebo Band at Jabba's Palace in 4 ABY.
A sentient species existed in the galaxy. They had green or tan skin and black eyes. One member of the species was Gatha Elbaphay, who was at Canto Bight in 34 ABY.

Sortuvian brain moths were a type of carnivorous moth that consumed brains. When being pursued by TIE fighters, Han Solo claimed that boarding was unadvised due to escaped Sortuvian brain moths, but the TIE pilots were not fooled.
A settlement was located on a hill on the moon Beixander 9. Due to the native nocturnal species that inhabited the moon, the settlement closed its gates during the night.

The antislavery committee was a committee in the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate. When trying to decide which of the Senate's committees to join, Senator Padmé Amidala was informed by her handmaiden Versé that the antislavery committee was an option, adding that it wasn't …

Gwongdeenian sub-subterranean gastropods were a non-sentient species of large snails native to the planet Gwongdeen. With little to no intelligence, the gastropods simply created tracks through the corridors of Gwongdeen, and then followed their tracks over and over.
The Mandragonian Mob was a criminal organization, who Hondo Ohnaka believed to be the worst in the galaxy.
The turlossus were a colossal species of reptiles home to Dhandu 3. Non-aggressive herbivores, the turlossus walked on the grasslands of Dhandu 3 in herds.
The hyperdrive chamber of the Colossus was located deep in the station. It contained the supertanker fuel depot's hyperdrive, mounted directly above the central control table.

Talivar was a terrestrial astronomical object located within the Talivar system of the Chorlian sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Talivar, along with the rest of the Talivar system, was located within grid square S-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Pyre's ship was an Upsilon-class command shuttle used by Commander Pyre of the First Order during the Cold War to travel to and from Colossus.
MB-13A or MB-13 was a BB-series astromech droid in service to the First Order during the occupation of the Colossus. Following a fight with CB-23, the droid fell down an elevator shaft.

Taurill were a multi-limbed, furry species that shared a hive mind. At one point, Bandit Billie and Ratty-Ratty hired a group of Taurill to help them steal a starship, thinking their hive mind would work to their advantage.

Salline was a location on the planet Chandrila. In 27 BBY, the publication Bormea Today conducted an interview in Salline with local sensation Senator Mon Mothma, who had recently been elected to represent Chandrila in the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate.

A planet was located in the Huru system, and was rich in farium, which was mined by its human inhabitants. It was the homeworld of Kanina Nico, who returned to the planet after learning the Galactic Empire planned to enslave the inhabitants.
Qhuloskians were a sentient species from Qhulosk. During the Imperial Era, they resisted the Galactic Empire, leading to a battle in the city of Howlan.

A B1-series battle droid served with the Separatist Droid Army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. After that army's deactivation in 19 BBY, the droid remained in operation and at some point went rogue, eventually becoming a bounty hunter.

Ledeve was a jungle astronomical object located within the Ledeve system, a star system in the Expansion Region and the Interior. The Jedi Order constructed a Jedi Temple on Ledeve, and later rediscovered it during the Clone Wars.
Ghulars were a sentient species. The Ghulars were enslaved by the Qhuloskians, forced to mine farium on Qhulosk.
The Abyssal Rooms was a building located beneath the surface of the planet Shu-Torun.
The Spires were a collection of tall buildings on the planet Shu-Torun. The ore-dukes of Shu-Torun brought the rare minerals they excavated to the Spires to be exported.

Adamantine shoals were creatures that lived in the magma on the planet Shu-Torun near the area of the Ancestral Retreat of the Shu-Torun royalty. In 0 ABY, during the War on Shu-Torun, Queen Trios had taken refuge inside the Ancestral Retreat.

result: Rogue B1-series battle droid B1-0516 joins the Grand Army of the Repub
x: The Battle of Horain was a battle fought on Horain in the Crantori system during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Horain was a world in the Crantori system of the Inner Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Horian species. During the Clone Wars, a battle was fought on Horain between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.
TR-33NA was an SP-4 analysis unit that worked as an archive droid at the Graf Archive on the moon Orchis 2.

The Hackjackers were a gang of starship thieves led by Tjepo Juibop, who operated from a chop shop on Takodana. After they stole ships from outside of Maz Kanata's castle, she asked Han Solo and Chewbacca to pose as buyers to find out where they operated from.

The Guagenian Star Sea was a location in the Guagenian sector. When Lando Calrissian was made to take the Solstice Globe to the Galactic Empire as a tribute, he had to take it to the Guagenian Star Sea.
The kova was a non-sentient reptile native to Hynestia, living beneath the surface. The Hynestians hunted the kova for food, and also made kova leather from its skin.
Klinnet were aquatic creatures that inhabited the canals of Neral's moon. They were able to flash with neon colors in order to communicate with each other.

headquarters: Mirrin Prime Republic base, Mirrin Prime
x: Mirrin Control was a New Republic organization that monitored space traffic around Mirrin Prime.
The Osia'Kru Brume lowlands were the region of the planet Gand from which the Laromun'rac cult originated.

The second coronation of Réillata as monarch of Naboo took place on the steps of Theed Royal Palace in 28 BBY. Réillata was re-elected to the throne of the Royal House of Naboo to serve a second and final term as Queen following the stepping down of Padmé Amidala.

result: The Colossus is freed from First Order control and leaves Castilon
End of the occupation of the Colossus
Tamara Ryvora joins the First Order
Beginning of the hunt for the Colossus
x: The Battle of Castilon, also known as the attack on Castilon or the battle on Castilon, was one of the earliest battles during the war between the First Order and the Resistance in 34 ABY.
Equipment Requisitions was an area located in the Senate Commercial District, an area of shops located around the Senate Building on the Galactic Republic's capital planet of Coruscant.

The Thunderer was a Resurgent-class Star Destroyer that was used by the First Order. During the occupation of the Colossus, the Thunderer tried to stop the Colossus from jumping to hyperspace and leaving Castilon.
The Kassk were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy around 34 ABY. Two Kassks were the members of the Warbird gang led by Kragan Gorr.

conflict: Hunt for the treasure of Nok Drayen
x: During the Hunt for the treasure of Nok Drayen, Feylara Raed lured a smuggler to her starship, the Celestial Crow, to kill them. She hoped doing this would persuade her former lover, the smuggler's rival Skavak, to get back together with her.

result: Reki gives the future Voidhound information on how to access his house
objective: Meet with Reki to obtain data on his house on Mannet Point
x: During the Separatist War on Ord Mantell, the smuggler who would later be known as the Voidhound traveled to the occupied settlement of Talloran village to meet with Reki.
The Malastare delegation was a group of diplomats that represented the planet of Malastare in the Senate of the Galactic Republic.
The Atterran were a race of pale-skinned humans that inhabit the planet Atterra Bravo. Casca Panzoro was an Atterran.
A committee in the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate dealt with educational reform in the poorer areas of the planets of the Core Worlds. It was headed by Senator Mina Bonteri of Onderon.
The transportation committee was a committee in the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate headed by Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine that focused on the transportation of goods.

t: Committee for transportation of construction materials
x: The committee for transportation of construction materials was a committee in the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate, led by Senator Bail Organa of Alderaan, that dealt with the transportation of construction materials to planets in the Mid Rim.

Foundry was a location in the Foundry system of the Colonies. During the Clone Wars, Foundry had a Geonosian colony, and Geonosian warriors protected Baktoid Armor Workshop factories that operated there. Foundry was later under control of the Galactic Empire.
The Channel was a location within the Akkadese Maelstrom that led to the planet Kessel. It was the main route of the Kessel Run.

The Wells were a location in the Akkadese Maelstrom, a region of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice that consisted of ionized gas, dust clouds, water vapor, ammonia, carbonbergs, and gravity wells.

In 28 BBY. groundquakes severely damaged the planet Bromlarch's aqueducts. As part of the relief effort to help rebuild the aqueduct system, Senator Padmé Amidala of Naboo proposed the Mid Rim Cooperation Motion to the Galactic Senate.

Lake Andrasha was a lake on the Core World planet of Chandrila. In 5 ABY, the Special Senator Council on Galactic De-Escalation Strategies, a subgroup of the legislature of the New Republic, was transported by former Rebel Alliance pilot Norra Wexley to the lake, where a meeti…

A sentient species lived on Cianap. They had blue skin and hair of various colors. Mira was a member of this species. They were a much more advanced society, but the Ender, destroyed their society, forcing them to live underground.

The Anselmi were a species of blue-skinned humanoids. They were one of the two sentient species that called the ocean planet Glee Anselm their home. Long before the Clone Wars, the Anselmi were the dominant species on Glee Anselm.

Melacon was a world located in the Jalor system within the Jalor sector of the Mid Rim and the New Territories at the coordinates J-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was an arid world, and it had no surface water.

Ramitrix was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Jalor system within the Jalor sector of the Mid Rim and the New Territories, at the coordinates J-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid. It was a lifeless rock with no surface water.
The third level was a level on the space station known as the Wheel, which contained the Ashton Stadium.

A terrestrial planetoid was located near The Wheel, a space station in the galaxy's Mid Rim. To avoid being noticed as Jedi, Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker left their shuttle on the planetoid, booking a public hyperbus to the Besh Gorgon system.
The Lepi was a sentient species characterized by their lanky frame, long ears, and buck teeth. One notable Lepi was the smuggler Jaxxon.

The Galactic Globetrotters were a shockball team owned by Jaspara, the owner of the Wheel. During one match held while Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker visited the station, the Globetrotters were beating the visiting team, the Ballistic Banthas.
The Ballistic Banthas were a shockball team. In a match held in Ashton Stadium on the Wheel, the Banthas were losing to the Galactic Globetrotters.
The Nova Crime Syndicate, also simply known as the Nova gang, was a criminal organization led by the Anomid Grynask Sanberge, who operated from the Wheel in the Besh Gorgon system.
Mission 46/N was a survey mission undertaken by MB1711-V of the Imperial Survey Corps in the Alderaan Graveyard. The mission found the ruins of the Aldera Royal Palace still intact on Asteroid 7785.
Lizard-gulls were a species of non-sentient reptavians on the planet Glee Anselm.

A celestial body was the homeworld and point of origin of the Grysk warlike species, which at one point formed the Grysk Hegemony. The Grysks sought to conquer the Unknown Regions and the surroundings of their point of origin, as well as the Chiss Ascendancy nation.

objective: Take down the Spike
x: During the Galactic Civil War, Rebel General Leia Organa led a mission to the planet Shu-Torun to strike a economic blow against the Galactic Empire, as well as seeking revenge against Queen Trios for her betrayal of the Rebel Alliance at Mako-Ta, which resulted in heavy losse…

The Abyssal Approach was a tunnel system underneath the surface of Shu-Torun that led to the Abyssal Rooms. Leia Organa and her team boarded Lord Or-Tar's ship as it flew through the Abyssal Approach, in order to kidnap and impersonate the ore-duke.
The storage level was a level in the Jedi Temple used for storage. It was once "invaded" by battle droids.
Exo was a protocol droid who assisted a spy in the Rebel Alliance. The spy obtained schematics for a key factory of the Galactic Empire, who tracked down and destroyed their base.
The khardax was a creature from the planet Rodia. Fraulda Rynn once tried to kill Cikatro Vizago using one such beast.
Dooma 4 was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Dooma system in the Dentari sector of the Expansion Region that housed an Imperial Metal Factory.

Orra was a planet located in the Orra system in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories. After being relieved of her active duty within Phoenix Squadron, Cadet Kay Karno traveled to Orra with the intent of becoming a bounty hunter.
SV-38P, or Essvee, was a feminine-programmed protocol droid. Sometime before the raid on Kessel, she was involved in an airspeeder crash and badly damaged.

result: Alliance lose a transport to pirates
x: During the Galactic Civil War, a skirmish broke out in the Kiax Nebula between Red Squadron of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Tech Masters.

A receiving area where the Galactic Emperor Palpatine met with local system governors and his close advisors existed aboard the second Death Star. Located in the 100-story isolation tower, it occupied one spoke of the tower's quadripartite summit.

B1-0516, nicknamed Bats, was a B1-series battle droid in the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the Clone Wars, B1-0516 fought in a battle against the Galactic Republic on Horain, where his processor was short-circuited by a stray blaster bolt.

Q5-7070 was a B1-series battle droid in the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. While on Opop Hibbedit, Q5-7070 fell out of his squad's Multi-Troop Transport due to unsecured straps, landing in the jungle below.

Opop Hibbedit was an astronomical object in the Mid Rim Territories covered in forests and jungles. During the second year of the Clone Wars, a squad of B1-series battle droids, including Q5-7070, was sent to survey Opop Hibbedit.

The Shosho Belt was a treacherous asteroid field in the Shosho system in the Graador sector of the Mid Rim Territories that contained the cantina known as Shosho Outpost. The explorer Emil Graf claimed it was a once-in-a-lifetime adventure.

Mantero, also known as the Funeral Moon, was the smallest of two moons that orbited Serenno. The bones of the Serennian ancestors of Dooku were buried in House Serenno's family mausoleum on the moon. House Serenno owned the largest plot on the moon.

Clone trooper officers, also known as Clone Officers, were clone troopers who served as officers in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, a pan-galactic conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
A village on Skako Minor was inhabited by an unidentified species.
A village was on Utapau inhabited by Amani. The village was visited by Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi during their Mission to Utapau.
The Bellicose was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the Galactic Empire that was captained by Commander Tylux. It was destroyed while chasing a spy of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Candorian Scourge, also known as the Candorian Plague, was an outbreak of the Blue Shadow Virus which occurred several decades prior to the Clone Wars. It claimed millions of lives in only forty-eight hours.

A starship was used by the hunters Winloss and Nokk. They used the starship while hunting down Doctor Chelli Aphra and 0-0-0 on Milvayne, but it was destroyed when the Coalition for Progress fired on Milvayne City.

A droid served as the assistant to a scientist in his laboratory. When the scientist inadvertently created the droid personality matrix that would eventually be known as the Triple-Zero protocol personality matrix, he asked his assistant to destroy the creation.
Trallus' Rustbucket was a dilapidated Ghtroc Industries freighter. It was stolen from Kwenn Space Station by spacers attempting to escape the Taloron Hunter Crutag and his crew of bounty hunters.
The gwayo bird was a bird native to the homeworld of Sakiyan bounty hunter Djas Puhr. The bird's eggs were considered a delicacy.
During the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire, Rebel Alliance General Airen Cracken began setting up spy networks in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Necropolis was a junk planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was connected to the worlds of Rattatak and Ponemah Terminal by a hyperspace route.
Demir was an iron planet located in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy. At some point, Captain Phasma of the First Order led an attack on the world.
During the Clone Wars, the Republic Evacuation Point was established on the planet Horain by the Galactic Republic.
The Firestone Islands Guards was a security force on the planet Atterra Bravo that Rendal Panzoro was a pilot for. They policed piracy and smuggling.
The Sith military were the armed forces of the original Sith Empire during the Great Hyperspace War.
A skirmish was fought at Nexator sometime before the Battle of Scarif. Between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.

A skirmish was fought at Carsanza sometime before the Battle of Scarif. The Rebel Alliance's tactics at this skirmish were cobbled together with tactics from a skirmish at Nexator and re-used at the Battle of Scarif.
The Lothal Senate was the governing body of Lothal within the Galactic Senate. It was based in the Lothal City Capitol Building.

Rango Tan was a planet located in the galaxy, home to an indigenous pre-hyperdrive species of bipedal sentients known as the Rangan. It had a population of 45 million, which was made up of three major civilizations.

Rangans were a indigenous pre-hyperdrive species of bipedal sentients native to the planet Rango Tan. They remained neutral in recent galactic conflicts as they had no interplanetary travel of their own.

t: Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe (Jedi Civil War)
x: A tribe of Tusken Raiders lived on the planet Tatooine during the Jedi Civil War. Around 3956 BBY, they were based in an Enclave within the Dune Seas of Tatooine, southwest of Anchorhead.

The Numidian Prime strike team was a strike team assembled by the Jedi Order to capture the bounty hunter Shenda Mol. Around 66 BBY, the team was sent to the Mid Rim planet Numidian Prime, where Mol was operating, to apprehend her and her followers.
Tyrena was a city on the planet Corellia.
The Wandering Hope was a starship owned by the grandmother of Rinetta Gan. It was left in a hangar at the landing yard on Hynestia.

Sector six was a sector within the Castilon system. Prior to the Hosnian Cataclysm, Kragan Gorr's Warbird gang attacked a Darius G-class freighter carrying several kowakian monkey-lizards and a kowakian ape-lizard.
Resistance commandos were dedicated commandos that served in the Resistance. During the Battle of Chasidron Shoals, Resistance commandos captured the Vakbeor-class cargo frigate Vigil from pirates.

t: Destruction of the Ledeve Jedi Temple
x: During the Clone Wars, Separatist General Grievous ordered the destruction of a Jedi Temple on Ledeve. After previously killing a Jedi and their Padawan, Grievous came across the temple and attempted to claim the temple's secrets for himself.

The Anyyon, also called Guardians of An'yettu, were the paramilitary protectors of the An'yettu Islands, on the planet Rodia. The An'yettu clan was at war with the Chattza Clan, the largest Rodian clan. The clan once hired a group of mercenaries to defend the islands.

The Committee for Renewal was a secret organization composed of ten merchants and companies of a city in the Outer Rim Territories. The Stalton Syndicate, a group of criminals, moved in the city and extorted credits from legitimate merchants.

The Hakks was a Gamorrean clan on the planet Gamorr during the Galactic Civil War. They once destroyed the last Shrook outpost on Gamorr, a rival clan led by Grruna Thu. The latter hired Reog's Regiment, a group of mercenaries, to crush the Hakks in retaliation.

The Reog's Regiment was one of the largest independent mercenaries unit in the Outer Rim Territories and the Hutt Space during the Galactic Civil War. It was composed of two dreadnaughts, many frigates and gunships, two starfighters squadrons and 3,000 soldiers.

The Shrook was a Gamorrean clan on the planet Pzob. Grruna Thu, the leader, once hired Reog's Regiment, a group of mercenaries, to crush the Hakks in retaliation of the destruction of their last outpost on Gamorr, but the mercenaries were overwhelmed in the battle.
The Stalton Syndicate was a criminal organization in the Outer Rim Territories during the Galactic Civil War. They once extorting credits from merchants on a planet in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Dantooine Incursion was an engagement between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic during the third Galactic War, occurring around 3627 BBY.
The Blue Cliffs were located on the planet Endoraan. Passengers aboard the Kuari Princess were able to visit the Blue Cliffs and enjoy roasted quialeg.

The Pursuer was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer that was in service to the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire. The Pursuer became the headquarters of the Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, and assisted the fighter wing in a number of operations.
D-O was a custom data storage and retrieval droid that was once owned by the Sith assassin Ochi of Bestoon. The droid was created by a droidsmith, who was killed by Ochi.

ZO-E3, known as Zoe, was a feminine droid, and the co-pilot of the smuggler ship Windfall. She and her captain were captured in the Windfall, pulled out of hyperspace above the planet Mustafar by an Imperial interdictor vessel.

The Scrapper Guild was an organization active on the Mid Rim planet Bracca during the reign of the Galactic Empire and into the First Order-Resistance War that scrapped capital ships and other material from the Clone Wars.
BD-1 was a BD explorer droid that accompanied Jedi Master Eno Cordova during the last years of the Galactic Republic.
Shock troopers, also known as Republican shock troopers, drop troopers, or simply as droppers, were specialized infantry of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and New Republic.
The Razor Crest was an ST-70 M-111 Razor Crest series used by the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin. Prior to the rise of the Galactic Empire, it served as a military patrol craft.

t: Duel between the Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer
x: According to a Sith legend, two Sith known as the Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer engaged each other in a lightsaber duel around 3400 BBY. However, both died due to the effects of the vapors of the Pits of Paxxis at which the duel was taking place.
IG-11, also known as Eyegee-Eleven or simply as IG or Eyegee, was a IG-series assassin droid who was a bounty hunter during the New Republic Era.
Malanose city was located on the planet Malanose in the Gree Enclave. It was home to vaults where protoypes and replicas of thousands of Gree devices were kept.

Pijal varactyls were a subspecies of the reptavians, varactyls. The original varactyls had been imported to Pijal from Utapau by the Iltan clan to have an edge in the Grand Hunt. They were bred into the unique streamlined, swift, crimson-feathered Pijal varactyl.
Shurrupak was a terrestrial world with oceans and beaches that was located in the Shurrupak system in the Vulcusion sector of the Expansion Region.

The T'zaki were a species of sentient insectoids that shared a unified consciousness in the form of a hive mind. By the time of the Republic Era, T'zaki culture more readily accepted slavery compared to many human cultures.

Uro was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories' Wazta sector, within the Uro system. It was situated in grid square I-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Uro was home to an arachnid species who consumed their weakest children.
Pijal's moon was a verdant moon that orbited the planet Pijal, rich with mineral deposits of whirlpool opals and the only known source of kohlen crystals.

The Meryx was a Gozanti-class cruiser owned by the gemstone thief Pax Maripher and co-piloted by Rahara Wick around 40 BBY. Before their partnership, Maripher went through several pilots, none of whom could stand his quirks.

The Facet was a Cieran-made Nivex-class starfighter owned by the thieves Pax Maripher and Rahara Wick, who modified it and stored it in the lower cargo hold aboard their freighter Meryx. It had a coppery surface.

Z-3PO was one of several 3PO-series protocol droids that were aboard a starship attacked by pirates near Wild Space. The only survivor of the attack was the human child Pax Maripher, who was found by Z-3PO, along with fellow protocol droids G-3PO and B-3PO.

G-3PO was a 3PO protocol droid aboard a starship that was attacked by pirates. Along with several other droids, including Z-3PO and B-3PO, G-3PO discovered Pax Maripher, the only survivor of the attack.

B-3PO was a 3PO aboard a starship that had been attacked by pirates, who killed all sentient beings, except for Pax Maripher, who had managed to hide himself. Two of the protocol droids aboard the ship, Z-3PO and G-3PO, discovered Maripher, prompting B-3PO to investigate.
The Great Assembly Room was a large room in the Jedi Order's Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant, located in an area of the building not accessible to Jedi younglings.

There was an arboretum in the Jedi Temple of Coruscant that housed trees, flowers, and ferns of a thousand different worlds. Qui-Gon Jinn visited it for the first time at age twelve, only the morning after Dooku made him his Padawan.
Qui-Gon's quarters were the private quarters of Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

The Advent was a cargo freighter. While carrying foodstuff to a system suffering from famine, it was protected by the Jedi Rael Averross and his Padawan Nim Pianna due to pirate activity in the sector. However, the crew mutinied, which led to the death of Nim Pianna.
The Leverage was a Branch-class cruiser captained by Czerka Corporation Sector Supervisor Meritt Col.

The Pijali were a cultural group of humans from the Inner Rim planet Pijal and its moon. By 40 BBY, a group of Pijali known as the Opposition began to protest the signing of the Governance Treaty, which would form a democratic Assembly that would lack proper representation for…

Drexel was an astronomical object located in the Drexel system of the Lol sector in the Outer Rim Territories and the Trailing Sectors. It was situated in grid square Q-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Republic pilots were pilots that served the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, non-clone Republic pilots served within the Republic Navy, with one, Captain Bythen Forral, becoming an ace.

The Summit was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser carrier which served the Galactic Empire's navy. Around 4 ABY, the vessel was assigned to transport a maintenance crew to the Kudo system on a mission to aid the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Celerity.
The Celerity was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the navy of the Galactic Empire.

Retta was a jungle planet located in the Retta system in Wild Space. During the Clone Wars, Kreeda hid a group of individuals who wished to escape the war on Retta, using her ability to become invisible.
The Segredo were a sentient species with the ability to manipulate the minds of others in order to appear invisible. During the High Republic Era, there were few Segredo left in the galaxy.

objective: Prevent the Celerity from falling into enemy hands.
x: During the Galactic Civil War, the Imperial Squadron Five of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing was tasked by Colonel Shakara Nuress with a mission to keep the disabled Star Destroyer Celerity from falling into enemy hands.

Nacronis was a marshland planet in the Mid Rim and New Territories with a unique meteorology that caused it to be ravaged by siltstorms. The planet's population, which included humans, inhabited ancient citadels.

A mining facility of the Galactic Empire was located on Kudo. When the Star Destroyer Celerity was left disabled in the system and a maintenance crew were sent aboard the Summit to repair it, they were unable to make contact with the mining facility.
During the Galactic Civil War, a skirmish broke out between a Rebel Alliance cell and the Galactic Empire.
Kalarassi Five was an astronomical object in the Kalarassi system of the Inner Rim Territories. During the Imperial Era, a group of prisoners on Kalarassi Five broke out of prison.

Nacronis ground control was a supposed local starship traffic control organization of Nacronis. After participating in the destruction of Nacronis, Imperial defector Yrica Quell claimed in a falsified report to IT-O of the New Republic that she had attempted to contact Nacroni…

t: Skirmish on an unidentified jungle astronomical object
x: At some point during the reign of the Galactic Empire, an Imperial captain hired the droid bounty hunter IG-88 to apprehend a thief who had managed to highjack a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle on a jungle astronomical object.
Irff was a vacation planet with a struggling economy. It was covered in oceans and mountainous islands, and had two suns.
A species of sentient arachnids were native to the planet Uro. The species' arachnid instincts led them to eat their weakest children.

J4-K3, also known as Jake, was an orange and white maintenance droid that moved around on a large rolling base. He was very dedicated to his work and communicated using binary. His standard sensor color was orange, but it would change color based on his emotions.
The Jedi crèche was a location in the Jedi Temple where Jedi younglings lived until they were chosen to become a Padawan.
I'vorcia Prime was a planet in the I'vorcia Prime system of the Outer Rim Territories' Mieru'kar sector that was home to various exotic creatures, including sarlaccs.

result: Destruction of a large portion of the planet's rich ecosystem
x: The Battle of I'vorcia Prime was a battle the Galactic Empire participated in during the Imperial Era on I'vorcia Prime.

The I'vorcia Prime Preserve was an area of the planet I'vorcia Prime kept preserved after the Battle of I'vorcia Prime damaged its ecosystem. The smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca took a baby sarlacc from the preserve for the collector Dok-Ondar.
The Kendoh Gang, also known as the Kendoh Crew, was a notorious gang led by the criminal Kendoh Voss, which included Remex Io and Wooro.

Calumdarian was a volcanic rocky world located in the Calumdarian system in the Immalia sector of the Expansion Region. Its atmosphere was breathable for a short time period, but was filled with smoke that made long-term exposure difficult.

objective: Capture Shenda Mol
x: The Mission to Numidian Prime was an operation undertaken by a Jedi Order strike team on the Mid Rim planet Numidian Prime to capture the bounty hunter Shenda Mol around 66 BBY.
Ohma-D'un was a small moon that orbited the planet Naboo. Bursas could be found there. It was colonized by the Gungans in the aftermath of the Battle of Naboo.

The Gillanium Syndicate was a criminal organization led by a crime lord known as "The Underlord." Around 2 BBY, the assassin droid bounty hunter IG-88B engineered a series of events that resulted in the destruction of the syndicate, allowing the droid to collect a large number…

Minashee was located in the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories, within the Tadrin sector, which was a subsector of the Cassander sector and thus was part of the Cassandran Worlds. It was situated in grid square K-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Hawk-Bat Clan was one of the many clans in which initiates were sorted at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Dooku was a member of that clan, along with Sifo-Dyas, Zang Arraira, and Arath Tarrex. At the time, Jedi Master Tera Sinube was in charge of the clan.

The Jedi Temple refectory or simply the Jedi refectory was the dining room located in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Its tables were equipped with hologram displays which showed rolling schedules and menus.
Carannia was the capital city of the Outer Rim Territories planet Serenno. It shared its name with Carannian fur which was worn by Serennian Senator Izzet Noor during the High Republic.

The Windrunner was an airship that belonged to Dooku, the Count of Serenno. During the invasion of Serenno, Count Ramil was in command of the Windrunner. Dooku allowed the droids to take him to face Ramil aboard the airship, where he killed the Count and disabled his army.
Vollick were a sentient species. Osika Kirske was a Vollick warlord on Rattatak. The Jedi Master-turned-Sith Darth Krall was a Vollick.

The Altiri were a sentient species. They were known to have purple skin and white hair. Some individuals had a gem in the middle of their forehead and above their eyes. Jedi Master Lene Kostana and her family belonged to the species.
The Tirra'Taka was an ancient dragon that lived on the planet Serenno. In ancient history, users of the dark side of the Force captured a Tirra'Taka and corrupted it to use in battle.
A Jedi seeker was a Jedi that searched the galaxy for Force-sensitive younglings to recruit into the Jedi Order. The Jedi Masters Yula Braylon, Cherff Maota, and Yoda were seekers.

A solar storm occurred on Protobranch during the Republic Era. It was a natural disaster that sent the floating cities of the planet falling. Jedi Padawan Sifo-Dyas had a Force vision of the event before it occurred.

In 82 BBY, after her death, a funeral was held for Countess Anya of House Serenno on the funeral moon of Serenno. A protest broke out during Lady Jenza's speech honoring her mother, with rocks being thrown at Count Gora.

During their time at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, Jedi Initiates were placed into clans. Such Clans were the Bear Clan, the Clan Kowak, the Hawk-Bat Clan, the Heliost Clan, the Thranta Clan, and a clan that consisted of the Younglings Petro, Ganodi, Katooni, Byph, Zatt and Gu…
The Battle of Wasted Years occurred by 1032 BBY. The Sith Lord Darth Krall participated in the battle and emerged victorious.
Tuk'ata were a species of creatures classified as a Sith warbeast. Also known as Sith hounds, they could be found on Moraband.
Saffia was a city on the planet Serenno, over one hundred kilometers away from the capital city of Carannia.

Asusto was a small forested planet located within the Tamsis Nebula in the Outer Rim Territories, strong with the dark side of the Force and often visited by smugglers. The last of the Presagers of Hakotei hid on the planet.

result: Zekka Thyne is arrested by CorSec and sent to Kessel
Colonel Veers is recommended for a promotion and reassigned to the Exe
Darth Vader rewards Vice Admiral Thrawn by giving him command of the N

objective: Eliminate Zekka Thyne and destroy Black Sun's operations in the Corell
Create a distraction for Prince Xizor
x: During the Galactic Civil War, Vice Admiral Thrawn devised a scheme that resulted in the capture of Zekka Thyne.
The Second Moon of Thrinittik was a rocky moon. As a child, Chelli Aphra lived in a house in the University Quarter on the moon, along with her mother Lona Aphra and father Korin Aphra.
Red Mist was a Slinani Migration Shrine that was at one point located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. Around 2 ABY, the archaeologist Chelli Aphra visited the shrine with Vulaada Klam.
The University Quarter was a settlement on the Second Moon of Thrinittik. The family of Chelli Lona Aphra resided in a house in the University Quarter.

Carajam was a desert planet in the Carajam system in the Dalonbian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The bounty hunter Boba Fett visited the planet to claim a bounty on a Rebel pilot, taking a job to target Zingo Gabnit.

Starspin was a YT-1210 light freighter owned and operated by the smugglers Cev Malanx and Regec Sloom. During the early years of the New Republic, the Starspin smuggled goods throughout the Corva sector.
T-11 was a JV-Z1/S DataBank Droid who served the Galactic Republic as a military tactics strategist. Following the rise of the Galactic Empire, T-11 was reassigned to controlling a garbage scow.

The Heliost Clan was one of the many clans in which initiates were sorted at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Jedi Master Tera Sinube was their primary teacher for lightsaber combat and at one point consisted of Gretz Droom, Ky Narec, and Qui-Gon Jinn.
The Thranta Clan was one of the many clans in which initiates were sorted at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Jedi Master Dooku was the main lightsaber combat instructor of Thranta Clan.

Palek was an astronomical object inhabited by the Palekians and known for its hyperstorms. It was located in the Palek system, a star system in the Cyrillian Protectorate in the Expansion Region in grid square O-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Plin Minor, also known as Plin, was a terrestrial planet in the Plin Minor system of the Inner Rim Territories that was home to the Plinovian species. The Solodoe wished to terraform the planet, which would damage the Plinovians' natural habitat.
Salliche was an agriworld located in the Core Worlds of the galaxy. It provided crops to other worlds in the region like Coruscant.

Nithorni was an astronomical object in the Nithorni system in the Colonies that was represented by Tanan Vetall at the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally on Coruscant. It shared its name with the Nithorn avian sentient species.

Coachelle Prime, also known simply as Coachelle, was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Terr'skiar sector's Coachelle system within the Mid Rim Territories that was represented by the Lepi racer Thrar in the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally.
LEP-10019 was a droid in service to Count Dooku. LEP-10019 summoned Asajj Ventress while she stayed at his palace on Serenno.
Minfar was a backwater jungle planet in a distant region of space in the Inner Rim Territories in grid square I-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Sakreen was a rocky planet in the Sakreen system in the Ash Worlds of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the hiding place of the pirate Rane Mahal, whose starship had crashed on the planet.
Mitek-Por was a terrestrial astronomical object that contained the Ruins of Mitek-Por. An NP-unit was discovered in the ruins and taken to the droid museum on Nubia.

Valgauthians were the human inhabitants of the planet Valgauth. They had a reputation as berserkers when boarding starships. As such, Valgauthians were regarded as valuable additions to any pirate crew.

The Archive of Forbidden Artifacts was a Bogan Collection, a hidden vault of prohibited objects associated with the dark side of the Force, that lay within the archives of the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant.
The Ruins of Mitek-Por were a set of ruins on Mitek-Por. An NP-unit servo-droid was discovered within the ruins, and taken to to the droid museum on Nubia.
The Kentas Gallery was a gallery in the droid museum on Nubia, holding some of the museum's most valuable droids.
Level Two was a location on an Imperial base. During the Galactic Civil War, a chief named Rusl-Kwin clogged the toilets on Level Two.
Carrion birds were a type of predatory bird. In 28 ABY, Leia Organa compared them with members of Rinnrivin Di's cartel who were in pursuit of her and Ransolm Casterfo.
Arbiflux was a forest planet located in the Outer Rim Territories along the Veragi Trade Route. The future archaeologist Chelli Aphra and her mother Lona moved to the world after leaving her father.
Unox was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories, and the location of an abandoned spice mine.
The Slinani were a religious warrior clan that constructed Migration Shrines that stored their battle trophies. One such shrine was Red Mist, located in the Outer Rim Territories.

Kainnan was a city on Zerist, one of the moons of the gas giant Obri in the Tython system, mostly populated by the workers of Dessain Mining. It was located at the base of Sokar volcano to get heat and energy from it, though it meant a constant threat of occasional eruptions.
Sokar volcano was an active volcano on Zerist, one of the moons of the gas giant Obri in the Tython system. The city of Kainnan was located at its base, to obtain warmth and energy from the volcano.
Barab I, also known simply as Barab, was an irradiated planet in the Barab system in the Albanin sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Nar Haaska was a shadowport on the border of Hutt Space and the Outer Rim Territories. At some point by 10 BBY, Bandit Billie and her crew of shipjackers accosted the space yacht of the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure, the Star Jewel, while it was on a layover on Nar Haaska.

Dellalt was an astronomical object located within the Tion Cluster of the regions known as the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. The astronomical object was positioned within grid square T-6 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Drongar was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy, positioned at the coordinates T-5 on the Standard Galactic Grid. A smuggler grew up on Drongar and, prior to the First Order-Resistance War, used to climb the trees there.

Sy Myrth was a planet located in the Sy Myrth system in the Jospro sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square S-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was linked via hyperspace routes to Belderone, Boonta, Centares, and Jabiim.

Jabiim was a terrestrial planet situated within the regions known as the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. Connected to Sy Myrth and Taskeed by hyperspace routes, it was positioned at the coordinates S-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid. Ore was one of the main exports of Jabiim.
Varl, also known as Varl Prime, was a planet located in the Varl system in Hutt Space that was orbited by 3 moons.
Reuss VIII was a planet in the Reuss system in the Portmoak sector of the Outer Rim Territories, located along the Llanic Spice Run hyperspace route.
Azure was an astronomical object located in the Azure system in the Truum sector of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice. It was positioned in grid square P-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
Kinooine was an astronomical object located in the Kinooine system of Wild Space, in grid square J-21 of the Standard Galactic Grid south of the southern edge of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Valiant Damsel was a light freighter operated by the New Republic. It was used by a group of operatives who helped to rescue the Black Curs on the planet Moorja.

River toads were a type of toads. In 40 BBY, Jedi Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi felt that the Pijali Minister Orth's facial expression during a conversation about the Opposition performance troupe with Pijal's lord regent Rael Averross expressed disgust, as if she would rather lick a…
Dooku's quarters were the private quarters of Jedi Master Dooku at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
Dannamore was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Saijo sector of the Outer Rim Territories where the orgo-harvest facility was located.
The Republic Correctional Authority (RCA) was an organization within the Galactic Republic that was charged with detaining criminals deemed too dangerous for local law enforcement agencies.
The Republic Treasury was an organization in the Galactic Republic that was tasked with overseeing the government's economic system, including the printing of Republic credits.
The Space Rescue Corps, abbreviated to SRC, was a Galactic Republic organization active around the time of the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Senate Intelligence Oversight Committee served within the Galactic Republic as the oversight committee for the Galactic Senate's Bureau of Intelligence.

The Republic Security Council, or the Security Council, was a Galactic Senate committee of the Galactic Republic responsible for protecting the Republic and had a large role in overseeing the war effort during the Clone Wars.
The Finance Committee was a committee in the Galactic Senate that related to the Galactic Republic's budgetary and financial matters.
The Ethics Committee was a Galactic Senate Legislative committee of the Galactic Republic, and was considered a spiritual partner of the Judiciary Committee's Internal Activities Committee.

objective: Protest the link between the Pijali monarchy and Czerka
x: The Opposition on Pijal led a non-violent series of protests led by Halin Azucca to protest the link between the Pijali monarchy and Czerka Corp in 40 BBY.

result: Revolt on the Leverage is started
objective: Facilitate the treaty between the Pijali monarchy and Czerka
x: The Mission to Pijal was a mission undertaken by Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi to mediate the signing of the Governance Treaty between the Pijali monarchy and Czerka Arms on the Inner Rim planet Pijal in 40 BBY.

The Tributum was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer that was under the command of Imperial officer Kanchar. During the Galactic Civil War it fought against Rebel Alliance forces during their mission to Shu-Torun.
Tarsunt was a planet located in the Tarsunt system of the Mid Rim, located in Bothan Space. It was the homeworld of New Republic Chancellor Lanever Villecham.

Danan Karr was a location on the Outer Rim Territories planet Carajam, containing a spaceport. While being pursued by the bounty hunter Boba Fett on Carajam, Zingo Gabnit contacted the Xan sisters, who refused to rescue him unless he met them at Danan Karr.

The Death Plains was an inhospitable stretch of desert on the planet Carajam. During the Imperial Era, Zingo Gabnit and Turfitch were forced to cross the Death Plains whilst escaping from the bounty hunter Boba Fett.

A rocky planet was the location of a mining colony ran by the Fantanines. The planet was strip-mined, destroying its environment. A sentient species native to the planet impeded the mining operation, leading the Fantanines to exploit them for resources.

The Fantanines were a sentient species with insectoid features. They had long lifespans and a small population, which led them to strongly avoid conflict within their species. The Ben Diffle Fantanines were a group of Fantanines who operated a mining colony.

The Dentaal Uprising occurred on the planet Dentaal during the Galactic Civil War when the Dentaal Independence Party overthrew Imperial Governor Taliff. The Empire responded by deploying the Candorian plague to the planet and killing the world's entire population.
The Imperial Orphanage Authority was an organization established by the Galactic Empire to care for orphaned children.
Following the destruction of Accresker Jail, Doctor Chelli Aphra and 0-0-0 were involved in a chase on Milvayne, having been linked together with proximity bombs by Cornelius Evazan.
Spine-wolves were a type of wolf that lived in a forest on the planet Serenno. As an infant, the Serennian Dooku was abandoned in that forest by his father, Gora.
Advance Squad was a squad of clone trooper that served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

The "Ursellin Sun Jammer Race Fixings" were one of the many notable exploits that the criminal organization "Red & Black League" that, led by the con artist Janstren Brell, had carried out by the time of the Galactic Civil War.

The Shadow was a light freighter owned by the Imperial smuggler Lett Minak. A few years after Emperor Palpatine died in 4 ABY, Minak worked for rogue Imperial Moff Feleea, ferrying "special requests," which involved travel to New Republic space or territories controlled by ren…

CZ-94 was a droid that served in the portmaster's office at the Serenno Spaceport. It was destroyed by Asajj Ventress, Sith apprentice to Dooku, who visited the spaceport in search of her master's sister Jenza.

Pendago were a sentient species with multiple tentacled limbs. One Pendago was a member of the Razorclaw Gang on Serenno, and had several of its limbs cut off by Asajj Ventress, who was attempting to learn the location of the Crolute criminal Glute.
Palekians were a group of sentients that inhabited Palek. They used crystals that appeared similar to kyber in order to meditate.

Kijimi was a frigid mountainous planet located in the Bryx sector of the galaxy's Mid Rim, in grid square R-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid. Once famed for its marked spirituality, the planet became known as a haven for criminals and lawlessness.
Pasaana was a desert planet located in the Expansion Region's Ombakond sector that was the homeworld of the Aki-Aki species.

The Aki-Aki were a sentient elephantine species native to the desert planet Pasaana. They were generally peaceful and hospitable, making them welcoming to offworlders when they arrived on their planet. According to Unkar Plutt, they were very literal.
Orbaks were a species of horse-like riding beasts. Found on several worlds, their exact galactic origins were unclear, although the ocean moon Kef Bir was the homeworld of a herd of orbaks.
The Thieves' Quarter, also known as the Thieves' District and formerly known as the Quarter of the Beatific, was an area of Kijimi City on the planet Kijimi.
The Moon of Avedot was a mountainous moon of the planet Avedot in the Colonies region's Avedot system that hosted the New Republic impound facility Base 354-23X.

The Turret Room was a serene chamber within the Theed Royal Palace, in the capital city of Theed on the planet Naboo. It was attached to a small temple used to revere ancient rulers of Naboo and was originally constructed by King Jafan.

Khormai were a sentient species from the Khorm system. One Khormai bothered Asajj Ventress in the Belsallian Cantina on Serenno, and the Sith apprentice knocked him unconscious with a tray from a serving droid.

The Tabor Plains was a grassland on Protobranch, where the majority of the planet's bacta was produced. The Tabor Hospital was suspended above the Tabor Plains on an antigrav platform, along with bacta production plants.
Aitch-Sixteen was an astromech droid that worked with starships of the Jedi Order in the hangars of the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.
Pijal capital city was a city located on the planet Pijal.

K43, referred to as Kakra by the indigeonous population's elders in their native tongue, was a tectonically unstable volcanic planet located in the Kakra system in Wild Space, within the Expansion Region.
Jamiri was an astronomical object where the Alliance to Restore the Republic had an outpost.

The supply moon was a moon located in deep space, controlled by the Galactic Empire. A minister was traveling to the moon when his Lambda-class T-4a shuttle came under attack from Rebel Alliance X-wings.
A crown finch was a type of bird. Jedi Knight Ky Narec fed crown finches and song sparrows, another type of bird, that lived in the training ground of the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant.

Ordo was a Mandalorian world located in the Ordo system in the Mandalore sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was home to the Archaic Arsenal, which housed an ancient Mandalorian rally master lance.

The Windfall was a starship owned by a smuggler and their droid co-pilot ZO-E3. During a smuggling operation, the Windfall was pulled out of hyperspace above Mustafar by an Imperial Interdictor-class, and its captain was taken to be imprisoned in the fortress of Darth Vader.

t: Imperial Bureau of Shipyards and Construction
x: The Imperial Bureau of Shipyards and Construction was an Imperial organization responsible for shipbuilding and construction. They once fought a legal battle with Loronar Corporation over the weapons loadout of the E-9 Explorer.

t: Fact-finding mission to the Outer Rim
x: A fact-finding mission to the Outer Rim was undertaken by members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War waged against the Galactic Empire.

The Squintpipe was a Galactic Republic cannonship in service by 7811 BBY. That year, the starship saw action when the Signatories of Waymancy carried out an orbital bombardment of Immalia as part of the Waymancy Storm.
Plinovians were the native species of the planet Plin Minor. They were gaseous life-forms that were able to self-combust when riled up.

objective: Kidnapping the Givin codebreaker
x: The Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure sent a group of his men led by the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo on a mission to Mygeeto to kidnap a Givin codebreaker from the InterGalactic Banking Clan on the planet Mygeeto.

The Republic Office of Criminal Investigations (or ROCI) was the division of the Galactic Republic's Judicial Department that managed subordinate law enforcement agencies and maintained the Republic Enforcement DataCore.

The Republic Security Force, also known as the Republic Guard, was the primary civil law enforcement agency of the Galactic Republic and was a branch of the Republic Office of Criminal Investigations.

The Core Faction was a split political faction that was active within the legislative assembly of the Galactic Republic prior to the outbreak of the Separatist Crisis, which was organized by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
The Militarists were a political faction active within the Galactic Republic Senate prior to the onset of the Confederacy of Independent Systems' Separatist Crisis.
The Senate Rotunda Preservation Committee was a committee within the Senate of the Galactic Republic whose tasks were to exterminate granite slugs and keep the Senate Rotunda architecturally sound.

The Republic courts were judicial assemblies that were part of the Galactic Republic's Judicial Department. Their jurisdiction was primarily over disputes between planets, such as taxation and trade between star systems or crimes committed outside orbital space.
Shoril was a small Gungan town located under a lake of the same name. Consisting of a dozen hydrostatic bubbles, it was in shallow water, and thus could be seen from the surface.
Dd54639//322T was an Imperial probe droid assigned to Imperial Recon Unit 42B8/S327. Tasked with the elimination of Mennac the Hutt, dd54639//322T was deployed to the planet Trendivar.

Pandem Nai was a terrestrial planet in the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories with a tibanna gas industry. It, along with its tibanna-mining space station, Orbital One, was taken over by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing shortly after the Battle of Endor.
The Lodestar was an Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship that served as the flagship of New Republic General Hera Syndulla's Barma Battle Group during the Galactic Civil War.
XL-5 was a war droid that was used by a scavenger crew to protect their operations during the early years of the New Republic. XL-5 was armed with a blaster rifle and a repeating blaster.
Ollopoms were short, gentle non-sentient herbivores native to the swamps of the planet Naboo. A species of rodent, they were often mistaken for pom petals, a plant that was part of their diet.

Blutopians were a sentient species from the watery planet of Blutopia. Oolin Musters was a female Blutopian who was imprisoned by the Galactic Empire on Wobani. Oga Garra was another female Blutopian who owned Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.

Profoggs (also called Profroggs) were a species of large rodents characterized by a snout, horns, super-sharp incisors, and powerful claws that they used for defense and digging. They built complex underground burrowing systems called "towns." They could be found on Tatooine.

Koovis was a planet in the Inner Rim. During the Galactic Civil War, Alliance operative Klev Natasken was captured by Imperial forces on the world, prompting the Alliance to commit Infiltrator squads to try and rescue him.
The Leviathan was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era.
The Ambush against PLT Depot 5 was a skirmish in the Galactic Civil War that took place in 3 ABY or earlier.
An attack on a Rebel depot took place during the Galactic Civil War that took place in 3 ABY or earlier.
Counter-intelligence at Klaymor 4-2 was a skirmish in the Galactic Civil War that took place in 3 ABY or earlier.

t: Incident at the Imperial Customs Checkpoint
x: The incident at the Imperial Customs Checkpoint was the name given to a skirmish in the Galactic Civil War that took place in 3 ABY or earlier.
C2-B9 was an R5 series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton. It at some point served in the palace of Jabba Desilijic Tiure on the planet Tatooine.

EG-127 was a green-plated GNK-series power droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton. During the Galactic Civil War, it served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and was stationed in Echo Base, the Alliance's headquarters on the planet Hoth.

EG-57 was a green-plated GNK-series power droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton that in 10 BBY witnessed a slave and droid uprising in one of the Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel.
L4-R6 was an R4 astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton who functioned as a repair droid. In 1 BBY, L4-R6 was in the possession of a tribe of Jawas on Tatooine.
MB-12 was a BB-series astromech droid that served the Resistance on board the MC85 Star Cruiser Raddus at some point prior to the starship's destruction in 34 ABY.

V0-RK was a Viper probe droid that served the Galactic Empire and took part in the effort to locate the secret base of the Alliance to Restore the Republic after the Battle of Yavin during the Galactic Civil War.
The Borogove was a bulk freighter resembling a pregnant bantha. It was operated by self-proclaimed master thief Cecil Noone and his gang as of 0 ABY.

t: Heist on a First Order train
result: Two containers of Coaxium are successfully stolen and are given to the
objective: Steal a shipment of Coaxium from the First Order
x: During the war between the First Order and the Resistance, Hondo Ohnaka of Ohnaka Transport Solutions launched a heist on a First Order train to steal containers of coaxium to give to the Resistance.
Skettos or cave skettos, were a species of non-sentient, ferocious flying pests found on the desert planet of Tatooine.
Peko-peko were a type of flying creatures that could be found in the swamps of the planet Naboo.

Felucia birds were a type of bird that lived on the planet Felucia. In 19 BBY, several flew by forces of the 327th Star Corps during the Battle of Felucia, and one of these birds flew near Clone Commander CC-5052 and other clone troopers as they fired on Jedi General Aayla Sec…

Gualaar were a type of quadruped animal indigenous to the mountains and hills of Naboo. They were tall and broad-barrelled with white fur, black eyes, and a single large horn on their head and two on their snout.

Dwarf vinocks were a type of winged creature with cream skin and black eyes. In 10 BBY, the crime lord Dryden Vos kept a dwarf vinock on display in a case in his study on board his yacht, the First Light.

Goaty-chickens were a type of small bipedal creature with brown fur and black eyes. In 10 BBY, the crime lord Dryden Vos kept the remains of a goaty-chicken on display in a case in his study on board his yacht, the First Light.

The droch was a type of cerulean-colored creature from the planet Felucia. In 10 BBY, the crime lord Dryden Vos kept the remains of a cerulean droch on display in a case in his study on board his yacht, the First Light.

Wurrek were a type of tentacled creature with red skin. In 1 BBY, a human inhabitant of Jedha City on the moon Jedha was cooking a wurrek in a pan over a fire in the city's streets as the rebel operatives Jyn Erso and Cassian Andor walked past, shortly before the city's destru…

Sheffi were a type of small, gray-furred creature with black eyes. In 34 ABY, Gatha Elbaphay, a patron of the Canto Casino in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica carried the pet sheffi Awgree while at the casino tables.
Jekoon was a floating non-sentient species that existed in the galaxy. A Xi'Dec kept a Jekoon at the Canto Bight casino.

Versimillipedes were a type of quadrupedal, brown-skinned species on Jedha, Kenari, and Khofar. In 1 BBY, a versimillipede climbed a rock face near to the Catacombs of Cadera, shortly before the area was decimated by the Death Star superweapon.

Sand skitters were a type of small, brown-furred creature that could be found on the desert planet Tatooine. In 4 ABY, a worrt captured a sand skitter with its tongue outside the crime lord Jabba the Hutt's palace and devoured it.
Nudjs were a type of green-skinned lizard found in the swamps of the planet Dagobah. In 3 ABY, a nudj scurried out of the entrance to the Cave of Evil as the Jedi in training Luke Skywalker entered.

The Iltan clan was a clan on the Inner Rim planet Pijal. Decades before 40 BBY, the clan imported varactyls, a species of ridable creatures, from the planet Utapau to gain an advantage in Pijal's ceremonial Grand Hunt racing event.

The Opposition were a theatrical performance troupe on the moon of the Inner Rim planet Pijal, led by Halin Azucca. The Opposition was created to inform the Pijali citizens of the misrepresentation of the moon's population due to influence from the Czerka Corporation.

FR-D 8T-KA, or FR-D, was an RA-7 protocol droid that specialized in cultures of the Outer Rim Territories. FR-D was aboard a New Republic warship that had been stolen by mercenaries hired by Domina Tagge to collect durasteel for retrieval of the Great Life Jewels.

objective: Investigate rumors of Sith artifacts
x: During the Republic Era, Jedi Master Lene Kostana undertook a mission to the planet Asusto in order to track down rumors of Sith artifacts on the black market.

Gafsa was a canyon in the South Jundland Wastes region on Tatooine, a desert planet in the Outer Rim Territories. Gafsa contained at least one water well. Rare wells like that were consider sacred to the Tusken Raiders, and trespassing could lead to swift violence.
Imperial Refining Platform M36 was a Galactic Empire refinery located in an asteroid field in the Outer Rim Territories. It had no organic workers, but was protected by KX-series security droids.
Emergency Services was an organization that operated on the planet Dac. They utilized repulsorcraft ambulances and were deployed to shuttle crashes to rescue the passengers.

49AX3 was a Dreadnought-class heavy cruiser that served the navy of the Galactic Empire. Some time between 3 and 4 ABY, the vessel was captured by the Alliance to Restore the Republic, who used it to raid Imperial Refining Platform M36, a refinery in the Outer Rim Territories.

t: Raid at Imperial Refining Platform M36
result: Rebel Alliance escape with the fuel
objective: Acquire fuel supplies
x: During the Galactic Civil War, a team of rebels undertook a raid at the Galactic Empire's Imperial Refining Platform M36. Assisted by Luke Skywalker, the rebels destroyed the KX-series security droids at the facility, securing its fuel supplies.
During the Clone Wars, a mission was undertaken to Alderaan by Ahsoka Tano, Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala.

Lokud 7 was a jungle world in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, Rebel Alliance spies landed on Lokud 7 with Imperial intelligence. Darth Vader followed the Rebel spies to the planet in search of them.
The Surrogator was an Arquitens-class light cruiser of the Galactic Republic that was used by Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi during the Battle of Saleucami to lure General Grievous.

The Stinger Mantis, commonly known as the Mantis, was an S-161 "Stinger" XL luxury yacht owned and piloted by Greez Dritus. In 14 BBY, Dritus transported the former Jedi Cere Junda and Cal Kestis on the vessel as part of their secret mission to rebuild the Jedi Order.

2296 was the designation of an OOM-series security droid that served in the Trade Federation's Droid Army. In 32 BBY, it was stationed on board the modified Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter Saak'ak while the starship was part of the blockade of the planet Naboo.

2391 was the designation of an OOM-series security droid that served in the Trade Federation's Droid Army. In 32 BBY, it was stationed on board the modified Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter Saak'ak while the starship was part of the blockade of the planet Naboo.

Wyyyschokk were a species of gigantic spider that lived on the planet Kashyyyk. Both highly intelligent and extremely hostile, they could ensnare prey by casting webbing at them from a distance, and would often wait to ambush their prey by attacking them from above or below.

Flame beetles were a species of beetle that lived on the planet Kashyyyk. The creatures consumed local plants and synthesized their remains into a highly flammable derivative, giving them their signature bioluminescent abdomen.

The Senate gardens were located in the Senate Plaza on Coruscant. One section of the garden had a grove of chinar trees which was the favorite of Senator Bail Organa of Alderaan who liked to sit there after a general session and think of home.
Senthrodys was a terrestrial planet located in the Senthrodys system of the Inner Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square O-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Beauchen was a terrestrial astronomical object located in an eponymous star system within the Mid Rim Territories' Vensori sector.

The Entropian Hive was an asteroid in the Entropian Hive system in the Elbaran sector of the Mid Rim Territories, along the Cerean Reach. The asteroid was used as a black market trading post, controlled by the Entropian Hive Trading Council.

Jiruus was a planet in the Rolion sector that was home to the Jiruusi species, orbited by the Grinning Moon of Jiruus. Under the Galactic Empire's rule, its star system, the Jiruus system, was the prize jewel of the Rolion sector's Imperial moff.

The Grinning Moon of Jiruus was a moon that orbited the planet Jiruus, located in the Jiruus system within the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated in the Rolion sector at the coordinates P-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Alakatha was a terrestrial astronomical object known for its beaches that was located in the Alakatha system within the Var Hagen sector of the Mid Rim. It was situated in grid square M-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Mountain troopers were a specialized stormtrooper variant in the Stormtrooper Corps of the First Order. They were equipped with white armor reminiscent of the old Imperial coastal defender stormtroopers.

Skorrupon was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Skorrupon system in the Trans-Vulta sector of the Mid Rim Territories and New Territories, in grid square N-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid, where the New Republic pilots Wyl Lark and Kamala encountered a Twi'lek.

Polyneus, known as Home by its inhabitants, was an isolated, pastoral world in the Inner Rim. The world, largely detached from galactic affairs, was known for its native sur-avkas, semi-tame flying creatures that were ridden by its human population.

Sur-avka were a species of flying creatures native to Polyneus. New Republic pilot Wyl Lark grew up riding sur-avka on Polyneus, giving him the ability to fly starfighters. They had down feathers, leathery skin, and an unpleasant odor.

Trenchenovu was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches that was situated along the Corellian Trade Spine. The Galactic Empire operated the Trenchenovu shipyards there.

The Trenchenovu shipyards were a Galactic Empire shipyard near Trenchenovu. The Rebel Alliance squadron led by Nath Tensent attempted to attack the shipyards, but were all but destroyed by the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.
Thumbsnapper's Bridge was a location where Riot Squadron won a battle against pirates. It was located in the Phelleem sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Mek'tradi was a planet in the Mek'tradi system in the Baroli sector of the Expansion Region that housed a Rebel Alliance cell during the Imperial Era. The Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing bombarded the planet from orbit to draw out the rebel cell and destroy them.

The Hellion's Dare was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate captained by the Chadra-Fan Kreskian in the service of the New Republic. Following the Battle of Endor, it was assigned to scouting missions, embarking Riot Squadron and Hound Squadron.

Dhen-Moh was an Inner Rim Territories astronomical object where the Galactic Empire, including the Sith Lord Darth Vader carried out genocides. Multiple individuals reflected on the atrocity later on, particularly in respect to Vader's involvement.

Mrinzebon was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Mrinzebon system in the Sombure sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was the site of a colony. It was the site of a battle between Republic clone troopers and Separatist droids during the Clone Wars.
Ontotho was a forested planet in the Ontotho system in the Nembus sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Lyran was a world in the Lyran system in the Quiberon sector of the Outer Rim Territories where Chass na Chadic, pilot in the New Republic's Alphabet Squadron, had once visited.

Argai Minor was a terrestrial planet. The Galactic Empire had forces within the Treinhaus Citadel on Argai Minor, and when the New Republic attacked the citadel, the Barma Battle Group sent Meteor Squadron, Hail Squadron, and Vanguard Squadron to support their ground forces.
Hetnagaro was a world located in the Hetnagaro system within the Andirma sector of the Expansion Region and Trailing Sectors. It was situated in grid square L-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Indu San was an astronomical object in the Rolion sector of the Outer Rim Territories where the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing operated at in the weeks after the Battle of Endor 4 ABY, during which some of their members were killed.
Harkrova I was a terrestrial planet located in the Harkrova system in the Inner Rim Territories. The planet was situated at the coordinates N-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
An unnamed moon orbited the barren planet Harkrova I. The moon was covered in forests and mountains, and housed a temple which the Rebel Alliance used as a supply cache.

Vernid was a planet located in an Outer Rim Territories and New Territories' Vernid system with at least two moons. Home to mud plains and bruising rain, its inhabitants, considered barbaric by some, included worm farmers that worked dig-rigs.

Greater Xnapolis was a city located on the world Mrinzebon. The city was somewhat profitable during the reign of the Galactic Empire, however, shortly after the Battle of Endor, the Empire abandoned the city and Mrinzebon. Immediately, riots and looting began.

Induchron was a city located on the planet Pandem Nai. When the New Republic attacked Pandem Nai to take out the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, which had taken hold on the planet, Induchron was endangered by debris from the falling Orbital One station.
The Aerie was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier used by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. It pursued and destroyed the New Republic frigate Hellion's Dare.
The No Harm was a medical frigate in the navy of the New Republic. Yrica Quell was treated aboard the frigate after the battle on Pandem Nai.
D6-L, or Dee-six, was an R-series astromech droid that served the New Republic. Imperial defector Yrica Quell chose the droid for her T-65B X-wing starfighter in Alphabet Squadron.
T5, or Tee-five, was a C1-series astromech droid owned by Nath Tensent. T5 had served Tensent in his Rebel Alliance squadron, and later in the New Republic's Alphabet Squadron.
The Red Isles was a location on Thakwaa. Nath Tensent and his astromech droid T5 were once stranded on the Red Isles for several days.
The Warren was a bunker in Traitor's Remorse, a holding area for Imperial defectors. It was located next to a bunker.

The Huntsman was a starship that served in the navy of the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The vessel lost its entire crew during a number of attacks carried out by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing some time after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
