objective: Find a cure for the Crimson Forever
x: During the Galactic Civil War, a skirmish took place aboard Domina Tagge's Mining Explorer near the Red Nebula.
Phateem was an uninhabited planet in the Phateem system in the Inner Rim Territories. It was located in the Nouane sector near Telerath, and was covered in bamboo forests and mountains.

The Ashlendu Mountains was a mountain range on the planet Phateem. The Halls of Knowledge, a Jedi artifact cache, was located within the mountains, though had fallen into ruin by the time of the Galactic Empire.

The Kemalo Farming Cluster was a farming settlement on Kinyen, inhabited by Gran farmers. When the settlement ran behind on its quota, one farmer, Rake Dee, suggested hiring the slicer Skaak Tippers to run the farm remotely through droids.

The loralora bird was a species of bird hybrid from the moon of Ketz. One loralora bird was for sale in Bina's Creature Stall in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, and was set free when Julen Rakab unlocked the stall's cages to prevent Delta Jeet from finding him and Izal Garsea.
A well-known market district was located in Bsellis City on Bestine IV. Members of the Nova Razors gang occasionally sold their spice in the market.
Garbage tunnel races were a tournament that took place on Coruscant.

t: Mission to retrieve the Great Life Jewels
place: Aboard an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the Unknown Regions
result: The Great Life Jewels are reunited and pulled toward a sun about to go
objective: Retrieve the Great Life Jewels
x: During the Galactic Civil War, Domina Tagge organized a mission to retrieve the Great Life Jewels, which were stored aboard an Imperial-class Star Destroyer set adrift in the Unknown Regions.

Usk Minor was a terrestrial astronomical object with desert terrain that hosted an Imperial Communication Relay. It was located in the Usk system in Hutt Space, in grid square T-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Gallery of Peace was a gallery in the headquarters of the Coalition for Progress, holding artifacts that represented their victories and triumphs.
The Katooni was a modified ZH-40 Tribune-class light freighter owned by the pirate Hondo Ohnaka.

According to legend, a T-series tactical droid served the Confederacy of Independent Systems aboard General Grievous' flagship in 22 BBY. Growing weary of the general's disregard for droids, the tactical droid deliberately altered the orders before the Battle of Alamass.

A main city was located on the Mid Rim planet Toledian. In 34 ABY, the city was destroyed in a mining accident. The news of the destruction of the city reached the planet Batuu, where it was discussed by residents of Black Spire Outpost.

A protocol droid served Admiral Mathieson of the New Republic, recording every conversation the admiral had for five years. The protocol droid's head was stolen from the Brooksdion space station by a small team of Resistance operatives led by Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdo.
The Halcyon was a Corellian passenger MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser operated by Chandrila Star Line.
An avian species lived in the jungles of the planet D'Qar.
The Darkghast was a large creature that lived in the caverns of the planet Mustafar. It was similar to the rancor, though it had extra limbs and mandibles.
The Fereallis was a TL-1200 transport owned by Captain Gideon, a Devaronian pirate and leader of the Suwanee Pirates.
New Republic Hall was a location on the planet Noquivzor. It featured a landing pad and was protected by ion cannons.

t: Attack on the Tembora Research Station
x: An attack on the Tembora Research Station took place sometime during the Clone Wars. The research station was built by the Army Weapons Research Department of the Galactic Republic and was responsible for the design of the KLR series combat droid.

The Wandering P'orp was a freighter used by a team of scavengers led by Captain Thea. Douzler was a member of its crew. In 5 ABY, the Wandering P'orp was present on Centares when its crew salvaged durasteel out of Rubyflame Lake.

Dandoran Eyeteeth was location on Dandoran. During the Battle of Starkiller Base Jess Pava compared the feelings of atmospheric fight in T-70 X-wing starfighter with her Skipfish running Dandoran Eyeteeth.

result: The Galactic Empire conquers and enslaves Kashyyyk
x: The pacification of Kashyyyk occurred on the planet Kashyyyk between 19 BBY and 18 BBY following the end of the Clone Wars when the Galactic Empire conquered the world following a siege.
The Wookiee uprising was an uprising that occurred on the planet Kashyyyk following the pacification of Kashyyyk. The Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk was instrumental in cowing the uprising.

origin: Somewhere in the Outer Rim Territories
x: The Wantu were a sentient species that hailed from the Outer Rim Territories. The members of this species believed in a river that could heal all wounds.
Kral'to was a location in the Outer Rim Territories. The elders of Kral'to told the tale of an ancient traveler who could cure diseases.
Pook was a PK-Ultra worker droid that served the Resistance. He was sent with Vi Moradi and Archex to set up an outpost for the Resistance on Batuu.
The Penumbra was a First Order Star Destroyer that traveled to Batuu in order to capture a Resistance spy codenamed Starling and bring her to the Finalizer.
The Midnight Blade was a starship flown by the smuggler Zade Kalliday and his partner Valoss. The two had begun flying it together in 24 ABY.
A desert moon was located in the galaxy's Unknown Regions. As a boy, Wulfgar Kath lived in slums on the moon until he was found by the First Order, eventually rising to the rank of lieutenant.

place: Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong advance scout ship
result: A'Sharad Hett escapes the Yuuzhan Vong and declares himself Darth Kray
Death of all Yuuzhan Vong present
x: Following capture at the hands of the Yuuzhan Vong, former Old Republic Jedi Master A'Sharad Hett escaped from imprisonment and fled to Korriban, quickly taking the name Darth Krayt and founding the One Sith.

Starmarks were a species of small bird that natively existed on the planet, Batuu. They could be distinguished by the white star shape in the feathers on their chests. Their calls could be heard within Black Spire from the nearby forests during the night.

Gruffins were a species of non-sentient creatures. Gruffins could produce milk and wool, while their fat could be used to create soap and their meat could be eaten as food. Gruffin herds were present in a farming settlement on the outskirts of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.

The Naklor was a mythological creature that was said to have inhabited the planet of Batuu. According to old Batuuan tales, the Naklor terrorized the people of Batuu, stealing gruffins and kidnapping men from Black Spire Outpost.

The Snarlok was a legendary creature among the people of Batuu. It was said to have constructed the Black Spire of Black Spire Outpost out of the corpses of misbehaving children, according to Grana, an elderly woman in a farming community, who told her grandson Dolin that the …
Chaakroaches were a type of creature that lived on the planet Chaaktil. According to the Resistance spy Vi Moradi, they were as big as her feet and could be a source of protein.
Chaakrats were a type of rat that lived on the planet Chaaktil. They were mentioned by the Resistance spy Vi Moradi when she was asked by Salju what creatures lived on Chaaktil.
The Bothan Museum heist was a heist in a Bothan museum that was accredited to the female bounty hunter Kendoh Voss.

Lost Souls was a highly dangerous asteroid field in the Cademimu sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The gases in the field limited sensors and blocked communications, making it difficult to navigate with low visibility.
A starship was used by Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdo of the Resistance when stealing the head of Admiral Mathieson's protocol droid from the New Republic space station Brooksdion.
Hangar bay nine was a hangar bay aboard the New Republic space station Brooksdion. The T-85 X-wings of Rapier Squadron were held in hangar bay nine.
Chaakbats were a type of bat that lived on the planet Chaaktil. The mother of Resistance spy Vi Moradi used to tell her daughter stories of cave witches who shapeshifted into chaakbats.

J1-B2 was an R4 astromech droid, manufactured by Industrial Automaton. In 1 BBY, the droid was present in the Great Temple, headquarters of the Alliance to Restore the Republic on the moon Yavin 4, when the Alliance forces within were scrambled for an attack on the planet Scarif.

The Elders of Kakra were the council of elders of the Kakrans of the planet K43, which they referred to as "Kakra". When the protocol droid C-3PO visited K43 on a mission for the Rebel Alliance, the Elders brought him to speak with them.

Norwoods were creatures that inhabited a forested planet. Bylsma, a former Alderaanian guard who hid from the Galactic Empire on the planet, was able to give orders to the norwoods, using them as bodyguards.

A planet was located in a distant region of the Outer Rim Territories. A terrestrial forested planet, it was home to the creatures known as norwoods. Bylsma, a member of the Alderaan Guard, escaped to the planet after the Galactic Empire destroyed Alderaan.
The Battle of Arbular was a battle fought on the planet Arbular during the rule of the Galactic Republic. It resulted in a Spiverelda victory.
The Battle of Horos was a battle fought on the planet Horos during the rule of the Galactic Republic. It resulted in a Spiverelda victory.

The defense of Murkhana City took place in 19 BBY, during the Outer Rim Sieges of the Clone Wars, in Murkhana City on the planet Murkhana, which had been the site of conflict over the course of the war through a battle nine months into the war in 21 BBY and a prolonged bombard…

Wick 111 was a celestial body located in the Wick system of the Instrop sector, a part of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. It was situated in grid square S-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid and shared its name with the planet Wick that was situated in the same star system.
The Wickwar were a sentient species with face tentacles. Wazellman was a Wickwar from Wick 111.
Lespectus was a Core Worlds planet located in the Lespectus system in grid square M-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid. A hyperspace route connected it to the Fedalle and Kuat systems.

Moldwarp were a scaled sentient species. One Moldwarp, Edmo Ectacle, hailed from Lespectus, and was present in the casino in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in around 34 ABY. Another, Draiven Bosh was a con-man during the High Republic Era.

EG-02 was a GNK-series power droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton with white plating. During the First Order occupation of the planet Batuu in 34 ABY, EG-02 spent time on the world at the Droid Depot in Black Spire Outpost.
S2-M8 was an R-series astromech droid that was manufactured by Industrial Automaton with blue and yellow plating and a black sensor.

M5-R3 was an R5 series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton. It had red, black and white paneling and an R5 dome with a black sensor. In 34 ABY during the occupation of the planet Batuu by the First Order, M5-R3 was present in Black Spire Outpost.

C1-4B was a C1-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton and owned by the Droid Depot in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu. During the First Order occupation of the planet Batuu in 34 ABY, C1-4B was displayed on a shelf of droid parts within the depot.

LM-7B was an R4 astromech droid that was displayed on a shelf of droid parts within the Droid Depot in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu during the First Order's occupation of the planet in 34 ABY.

S3-R9 was an R-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton and owned by the Droid Depot in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu. During the First Order's occupation of Batuu in 34 ABY, S3-R9 was displayed on a shelf of droid parts within the depot.
B5-SL was a BB-series astromech droid with a black sensor and blue and brown paneling. Like all BB-series units manufactured by Industrial Automaton, it stood 0.67 meters tall.
M5-K7 was an R-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton with orange and white paneling and a black sensor.
The Royal District was a district in the city of Myrra, the capital of the planet Akiva. The Satrap's Palace and Withrafisp Road were located here.
Governor Adelhard's chamber was located in the Prime tower of Cloud City on the planet Bespin. It belonged to Governor Ubrik Adelhard.
Myrmidants were little creatures that lived in colonies.
Kabatha were creatures which guts were made into a breakfast and eaten by Wookiees.
Murra were creatures that locked horns when they mated.
Pearlshells were a type of aquatic creature caught and processed on the planet Chandrila, along with skor-fin, marmal-fish, and starlegs.
QC-ME, also known as Q-See, was a droid that worked in the morgue of a Coruscant Security Force facility during the time of the Galactic Republic.
Jenet were a rodent sentient species. One Jenet, Cenevax, was a crime lord who operated an unlicensed gambling ring on Coruscant.
The Sallichen were a sentient species from the Core Worlds planet Salliche. The Sallichen senator Bulgeski represented Salliche in the Galactic Senate.

result: Grand Admiral Balanhai Savit is arrested
x: During the Imperial Era, a skirmish occurred between the Galactic Empire's Third Fleet commanded by Grand Admiral Balanhai Savit and the Chimaera, commanded by Commodore Karyn Faro.
B'aerlaks were legless jungle herd bovines. They were capable of reaching speeds up to 30 kilometers per hour.
The Orleon Belt Grand Slalom Finals was an asteroid slalom race that occurred during the early reign of the Galactic Empire in the vicinity of the Orleon system in the Talcene sector of the Mid Rim.

Bark rats were stoutly built rats native to the planet Cholganna. They made up the bulk of the diet of the predatory nexu, a species that hunted in Cholganna's cool forests using their infrared vision to spot warm-blooded prey.

The Brother Claw Gang was a criminal gang led by the crime lord Brother Claw that had territory on the planet Burnin Konn. he gang consisted primarily of humans, wielding blaster pistols or vibroswords.

This Otoga-222 maintenance droid was built by Anakin Skywalker out of scrap and old parts on the planet Tatooine to assist him while working at Watto's Shop. He often rebuilt the droid to accomplish specific tasks.
Onod I was a celestial body located in the Onod system of the Irnaj sector, a part of the Mid Rim Territories and the Western Reaches.

Sith Jetpack Troopers, also known as Sith jet troopers, were Sith Eternal troopers specialized in aerial combat. The 105th Battalion was a Sith trooper unit that included Sith jet troopers in its ranks. The troopers drew on the dark and ancient legacy of the Sith Order for power.

Revwiens were a sentient species. A Revwien merchant sold Owen Lars a Zephyr-G swoop at an auction in Mos Nytram on the planet Tatooine. The Revwien Comedy Academy Playhouse on the planet Coruscant was named for this species.
Eroudac Citadel was a location in the galaxy. The Garsea family stayed there for a period during Izal Garsea's childhood.
The smuggler Ana Tolla and her crew used a freighter on their operations.

Nameel was a forested world inhabited by a Trandoshan tribe led by Warlord Vurrsk, as well as Dupei monks. The Dupei stole credits from the Trandoshans, and when they retaliated, the Jedi Eno Cordova and Cere Junda were sent to restore the peace.
The Dupei were a sentient species. A group of Dupei monks resided on Nameel, and stole credits from a nearby Trandoshan tribe who tried to buy outlawed weapons from them.
A translator droid served Warlord Vurrsk, the leader of a Trandoshan tribe on Nameel, relaying Vurrsk's words in Galactic Basic Standard when speaking with outsiders.
A tribe of Trandoshans was led by Warlord Vurrsk on Nameel. The tribe attempted to buy outlawed weapons from a group of Dupei monks, who proceeded to steal credits from them.
The Dupei monks were a group of monks made up of the Dupei species. The Dupei monks were a rare sight in the galaxy, but one group existed on Nameel.

The Fylari were the inhabitants of the Fylar region of the planet Ontotho. When the other regions of Ontotho united to form a planetary government in order to enter into the Galactic Republic, the Fylari refused to agree to join.

The Fylar region, also simply known as Fylar, was one of the regions on the planet Ontotho, inhabited by the Fylari. When an Ontothon government was formed so that the planet could join the Galactic Republic, the Fylar region was the only region that refused to unite.
A humanoid, saurian species lived on a Fantanine strip-mining planet. They had red skin and white eyes. While adults were humanoid, younglings were small quadrupeds.
The Red Dwarf Raiders were a criminal group based on the planet Burnin Konn during the Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector by the Galactic Empire.

Woodoos were a species of nesting creature found on the planet Tatooine. The child of two miners living in a homestead near Mos Entha could hear the calls of nesting woodoos during the otherwise silent nights at the homestead.

Hallway 33M was a hallway at the Grand Regent on Lanz Carpo. Leia Organa and Han Solo accessed the hallway while searching for the hotel's communications room as part of a mission for the Rebel Alliance.
The Nexu Claws were a criminal gang of arms dealers led by the criminal Red Adder and operating on the planet Burnin Konn during the Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector by the Galactic Empire.
The Stormhawks was a group of racers sponsored by MandalMotors during the Galactic Civil War. Gerrol Hunn was the pilot and Charra Tull was the co-pilot during the Cloud City Grand Prix.
Aly San San was a droid with feminine programming that R-3X remembered fondly whilst playing music at Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.
The Emerald Sea was an ocean located on the planet Savareen. It was located at the edge of the Pnakotic Coast, on which the Bis Refinery and a Savarian village were located.

Urusida were a non-sentient species. They had a diet that included fish, and were covered in shimmering fur. Urusida pelts reminded the Karkarodon Lee Skillen of her homeworld due to the fish that they consumed.
Actlyon City was a crowded and polluted city located on the planet Actlyon.
The ancients, were, according to legend, a species that had once inhabited the planet Batuu and vanished long before explorers first came there.

t: Capture of the Mon Calamari ship
x: The Capture of the Mon Calamari ship was a battle that took place during the Clone Wars. A Mon Calamari ship carrying Jedi Master Quarmall and a group of Jedi younglings was ambushed by a Separatist fleet.

Batuuan braga bears were a species of bear that lived on the planet Batuu. They were brown and chased after their prey. When the droid SF-R3 visited Batuu, he learned that the growl of a braga bear was a sign to run away.
The tree-goat was a type of goat. Roxi, a resident of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, owned a tree-goat, which often had to be rescued from the roof of her neighbor's house.

The truffleboar was a species of pig-like creature, similar in appearance to a small happabore. Dolin, a farmer who lived on the outskirts of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, owned a pet truffleboar named Waba.

Batlizards were a type of lizard that had the ability to fly, and lived in nests. Several Batlizards lived inside of Savi's Workshop in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, making nests in dark corners of the room.

YS-5755 was an R-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton. The droid featured in the song "Goola Bukee" by Zano, during which YS-5755 had a solo performance. The droid DJ R-3X praised the R-unit's performance, citing it as the reason for the song's success.

The Industrial Levels, also known as the Factory Levels, were levels 221-280 of Cloud City, above the planet Bespin. Tibanna gas mining and processing equipment, such as carbonite freezing facilities composed those levels.

Honest Grek's Speeders was a shop owned by Honest Grek in the Industrial Levels of Cloud City above the planet Bespin during the Galactic Civil War. Speeders, cloud cars and swoops could be found in the shop.
The Industrial Spaceport was a series of docking clamps and airlocks in the Industrial Levels of Cloud City above the planet Bespin for ships too large for the landing bays at Port Town.
Processing Vane 5 was one of many vanes across Cloud City to filter tibanna gas and freeze it in carbonite blocks. It was overseen by Negri, a male Ugnaught.
Plaza district was the top level of Cloud City above the planet Bespin.
Neelanon was a planet located in the Neelanon system in the Senex sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square L-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

R5-B0019 was an R5 series astromech droid that once spent time among the droids carried inside a Jawa sandcrawler on Tatooine. The droid was colored in black and white, and included a Burtt acoustic signaller.
R5-A2 was an R5 series astromech droid with orange and white paneling and black sensors. It stood ninety-seven centimeters tall and, like all R-series units, was manufactured by Industrial Automaton.
R5-K6 was an R5 unit that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Red Squadron during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

R2-A3 was an R2-series astromech droid that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. It was based out of the Rebel headquarters on the moon Yavin 4 and flew alongside Red Two pilot Wedge Antilles.
R2-F2 was an R2-series astromech droid that served as part of Red Squadron in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
R2-L3 was an R2-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton that had red, white and black paneling, a black sensor and stood 0.96 meters (3feet 2inches) tall.

Gideon's Imperial remnant, also referred to as Moff Gideon's Imperial Remnant, was a neo-Imperialist holdout of the Imperial Remnant that continued its loyalty to the ousted Galactic Empire during the New Republic Era despite the Empire's collapse after the Battle of Jakku at …

A rocky planet was located in the Rarlech system of the Unknown Regions. Supreme Leader Snoke and his apprentice, Kylo Ren, traveled to the planet. There, Snoke taught Ren how to weaponize his rage before departing the planet to continue the training elsewhere.
Level 0 was the ground level of the planet Coruscant, located beneath Level 1.

Level 4 was one of the lowest levels on the planet Coruscant's subterranean underworld. The level was supposedly inaccessible, but entering it was possible. A lost museum was on or below the level, and Amilyn Holdo searched for it while on Coruscant with Leia Organa.

The pygmy porlceetin was a type of large, hexapedal, venomous creature native to the Outer Rim planet Geonosis. They had green markings that they used to lay in wait for prey and evade potential predators.

Fengrine was an agri-industrial world that had hydroponic shells around it. It was located in the Fengrine system in the Senex sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square L-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Mos Nytram was a remote town on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine, a desert world of which only a small portion of the northern hemisphere was habitable. By 22 BBY, the moisture farmer Owen Lars bought his Zephyr-G swoop from a Revwien merchant at an auction in Mos Nytram.
The scatalpen was a deadly predator from the planet Aleen. The Aleena podracer Ratts Tyerell named the vehicle he used in the 32 BBY Boonta Eve Classic race after the creature.

Arctic horny whelmers were ten-legged creatures found in the arctic regions of the Outer Rim planet Rothana. Being both bulky and fairly slow, they hunted in packs, wearing their prey out with their persistence.
Leebsie-lurkers were a type of insect found on the desert planet Tatooine. They could be brown in color and had a three-part, segmented body with three pairs of jointed legs, and a pair of antennae.
A blorp was a type of green creature with a transparent, blob-like body. They had two eyes and a mouth and could also have two arms.

1234 was a B1-series battle droid that served in the Trade Federation Droid Army. During the Naboo Crisis, 1234 fought against the Gungan Grand Army at the Great Grass Plains, but the battle droid was destroyed by Bombad General Jar Jar Binks.

R3-M3 was an R3-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton that stood 1.09 meters tall and had blue plating and a transparent dome. It served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

U-3PO was a 3PO-series protocol droid who served the Alderaanian Diplomatic Corps. After Imperial agents altered his programming, the droid became an unwitting spy in the royal court of the planet Alderaan, and was assigned to the CR90 corvette Tantive IV in 1 BBY.
The Central Security Tower was the headquarters of the Bespin Wing Guard during the Galactic Civil War. It was located in Plaza district, a district in Cloud City, above the planet Bespin.

The Podracer's Retirement was a popular cantina among mechanics and crew racing during the Galactic Civil War. It was located in Cloud City above the planet Bespin. Ol' Sav and Honest Grek were regular customers of the establishment.

The Four-and-a-Half was a cantina in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War. Straddling levels 124 and 125 in Port Town, there was no official record that it existed, and it was illegal to enter it.

The Lady Yarith was a squalid hotel owned by Bozzi in Cloud City above the planet Bespin during the Galactic Civil War. It was named after Ecclessis Figg's wife. Elaiza occupied a room there during the auction of the Jewel of Yavin.
The Landing Bay 124A was a landing bay in Port Town, a district in Cloud City. During the Galactic Civil War it was owned by the crime lord Vorse Tabarith and managed by Hressk.
The Revwien Comedy Academy Playhouse was a location on the planet Coruscant. It was located next to the Vos Gesal Hotel.
The Senatorial Accounts Presidium was a location on the planet Coruscant, associated with the protection of senatorial accounts.

Sector H-46 was a sector of Galactic City, the ecumenopolis that covered the Galactic Republic's capital world, Coruscant. In 22 BBY, much of the sector was owned by the wealthy Sah'c family, which had led to sector H-46 becoming known colloquially as "Sah'c Town."

The Bonadan Embassy was the embassy of the Outer Rim planet Bonadan on the planet Coruscant, capital of the Galactic Republic. The embassy was located at the top of a tower in the upscale Federal District of Coruscant's Galactic City.

Following the Battle of Endor, the Galactic Empire targeted Candovant as part of Operation: Cinder. The Imperial defector Yrica Quell heard about the attack, which resulted in the leveling of Candovant's civilization.

Following the Battle of Endor, the Galactic Empire targeted Commenor as part of Operation: Cinder. The Imperial defector Yrica Quell heard about the attack, which resulted in the leveling of Commenor's civlization.
A7-X2 was an astromech droid affiliated with the Sith Empire and stationed near the canyons of Ossus during the Invasion of Ossus.
Q-Z5 was a probe droid affiliated with the Sith Empire and stationed near canyons on Ossus during the Invasion of Ossus.
E9-L4 was an astromech droid affiliated with the Sith Empire and stationed near the canyons of Ossus during the Invasion of Ossus.
Y-G3 was a probe droid affiliated with the Sith Empire that was stationed near the catacombs on Ossus during the Invasion of Ossus.
P-X5G was a Probe droid affiliated with the Galactic Republic and stationed near the catacombs of Ossus during the Invasion of Ossus.
Tourist District was a district in the upper levels of Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War. It was composed of everything for tourists, such as casinos, hotels, museums or theaters.
Cloud City Skyport was a location in the Tourist District of Cloud City.

Beauty of Bespin was an exhibition room of landscapes made with colored gasses in glass containers in the Figg & Associates Art Museum located in the Cloud City above the planet Bespin during the auction of the Jewel of Yavin.
Reflections on Xim was an exhibition room during the auction of the Jewel of Yavin with items from Xim's reign in the Figg & Associates Art Museum located in the Cloud City above the planet Bespin.

Wonders of the Galaxy was an exhibition room during the auction of the Jewel of Yavin with copies of many Wonders of the Galaxy in the Figg & Associates Art Museum located in the Cloud City above the planet Bespin.

t: Destruction of the Toledian main city
x: In 34 ABY, the main city of the Mid Rim planet Toledian was destroyed in a mining accident. News of the cities destruction reached the planet Batuu, where it was discussed by residents of Black Spire Outpost.
T4-B4 was an astromech droid affiliated with the Galactic Republic stationed near the dead forest of Ossus during the Invasion of Ossus.
RC-P9 was a battle droid affiliated with the Galactic Republic that was stationed near the farms of Ossus during the Invasion of Ossus.
Figg Hall was the administrative district, including the offices of the Baron Administrator, in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.
Grand Galaxy Holo-Park was a holographic entertainment in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War. It displayed landscapes from the planets Alderaan, Christophsis, Coruscant and Kashyyyk.
The Hungry Beldon was a cosmopolitan restaurant located near the Figg & Associates Art Museum in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.
The Sunset House was an expensive restaurant at the top of the Kerros Tower in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.
The Landing Pad P4 was a location in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.

The Three Beldons Buffet was one of the finest restaurants in Cloud City. It was located near the Yarith Bespin and the Figg & Associates Art Museum and was owned by Jolen Mandar during the Galactic Civil War.
The Trin Bin was a casino near the Figg & Associates Art Museum in Cloud City where gamblers could play to trin sticks.

The Benathy were a large sentient species that resided on the planet Benath in Wild Space. During the Imperial Era, Darth Vader led a battle against the Benathy, which ultimately failed, though the Benathy were subdued.
The Felucian Ripper was a flying creature that could be found on the planet Felucia.
The Manta was a flying creature that could be found on the planet Felucia.

During the New Republic Era, the First Order blockaded the Otomok system in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. The New Republic objected to the blockade, but the Order told the Republic it was an internal affair, which they accepted.
The Horian were a species that lived on Horain during the Clone Wars.
A substation for the Kaminoan Planetary Defense was located in the higher levels of the planet Kamino's capital city, Tipoca City.
Mother Talzin's clan referred to a particularly large clan of Nightsisters, led by Mother Talzin, on the planet Dathomir.

The Grand Salon, also called the Sundari throne room, was a vast chamber within the Sundari Royal Palace in Sundari, Mandalore. It served many functions, primarily as Duchess Satine Kryze's throne room, but also as a council chamber.
The galaar was a common bird of prey native to the Outer Rim world of Mandalore. The creature lent its name to the GALAAR-15 blaster carbine manufactured by Concordian Crescent Technologies.
Following the Battle of Endor, the planet Rekkana was liberated by the New Republic.
12-4C-41z was a slicer droid. He was in Cloud City shortly before the auction of the Jewel of Yavin.
C3-B8 was a protocol droid working in the Figg & Associates Art Museum in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.
DZ-3PO was a protocol droid working for Kaltho the Hutt, a crime lord during the Galactic Civil War.

Spikewheel was a droid scavenger who captained the starship Salvage-1. A group of scavengers, including the Nikto Gritz, hoped to join her crew, though Spikewheel was only interested in recruiting Gritz as her first mate aboard the Salvage-1.

Salvage-1 was a starship owned by the droid Captain Spikewheel, who led a crew aboard the ship. When a group wanted to join the crew of the ship, Spikewheel took them to Lotho Minor, forcing them to stay one night on the junk planet in order to prove themselves.
The pallaskean was a species of sea serpent that resided in the oceans of the planet Ahch-To.
En-Threelo was a droid who served the Fylari of Ontotho. After the Fylari rescued Jedi Padawan Cere Junda, Neralli had En-Threelo watch over her.
The Fylar Forest was a forest located in the Fylar region of Ontotho. A temple was located deep within the Fylar Forest, and was rediscovered during the Republic Era.
During the Imperial Era, a skirmish broke out on the planet Ontotho between the Galactic Empire and an insurgent cell.
Ontotho City was a city located on the planet Ontotho. At the time of the Ontothon government's entry into the Galactic Republic, the city was patrolled by the security force of the Daa Corporation.
The musk teave was a creature that existed on the planet Ontotho. Children of the Fylari people were able to communicate with the creatures, through an ability that Neralli compared to the Force.

The Daa Security Forces were the security force of the Daa Corporation, made up of both humans and droids. When Dylanto Daa and the Daa Corporation attempted to work with the government of Ontotho, a number of Daa Security Forces patrolled Ontotho City.
Heva was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories that hosted an outpost of the Hidden Hand criminal syndicate, operated by the arms dealer Wef.

result: The Benathy submit themselves to the First Order
x: In 33 ABY, Kylo Ren and his troops fought the Benathy on their homeworld Benath to prevent King Kristoff and their people from expanding their territory.

result: The Benathy are subdued, but Darth Vader is unable to kill their god
x: At some point following the Great Jedi Purge, Darth Vader went to a world in Wild Space where he fought the Benathy after his demands were not fulfilled. Thousands on both sides died, according to Kristoff.
K4-76A was a security droid and the co-pilot of Tarryn Rayzer during the Cloud City Grand Prix with specific programming to avoid destroying other racers.
Chirodactyls, also known as Dathomirian bats, were a species of winged carnivorous creatures native to the planet Dathomir.

Latero, also known as Lateron, were a sentient species from the planet Lateron that possessed four arms. The species had a keen sense of smell. Marino Pomana was a member of the species who worked as a chef on the planet Begamor.
First Order Treadspeeder Drivers, also known as Treadspeeder pilots, were specialized pilots who operated 125-Z treadspeeder bikes. They were active during the First Order's war with the Resistance.
Kylo Ren's TIE whisper was a set of two modified TIE/wi interceptors utilized by the First Order's Supreme Leader, Kylo Ren, during the war against the Resistance.
R3-8C was an astromech droid and a slicer in Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War.
This cleaning crew of stormtroopers was deployed to confront a species of animals on Starkiller Base. It was led by Captain Bray.
E5-PT2 was a unique builder droid in the employ of Saponza and his partner at the time of the Galactic Civil War.

The Ataraxia, known for some time as the Lourna Dee, was a starcruiser in the service of the Jedi Order. First commissioned by 232 BBY, the Ataraxia served under the command of Jedi Master Jora Malli at the Battle of Kur.

The hunanetre, or huna-netre, were a type of creature that could be found on Rentalles. While on display at a celebration of the Outer Rim on Serenno, the Dianectric Menagerie contained a number of hunanetre.

The Trannon District was a district located in Carannia, the capital city of the Outer Rim Territories planet Serenno, near the Carannia Spaceport. In 23 BBY, Sith assassin Asajj Ventress went to the district under the orders of Count Dooku to search for Jenza, Dooku's sister.

The Yacombe were a Force cult once associated with the dark side of the Force and whose members only spoke to outsiders through proxies. In 382 BBY, a delegate of the Yacombe attempted to join the Convocation of the Force, an advisory council, in the Holy City of the moon Jedha.
Velenki was a small settlement located on Rattatak. Its inhabitants led the Jedi Ky Narec and his apprentice Asajj Ventress into a trap under threats from the warlord Osika Kirske.
The Razorclaw Gang was a criminal gang active in the city of Carannia on Serenno. Glute was a former member of the gang but had fallen out of favor with its leader.

The Flame-Wielders were a group who fought against the Jedi Order during the Battle of Nar Shaddaa, which took place by 68 BBY on the moon Nar Shaddaa. After being immolated by the Flame-Wielders, Jedi Master Crucitorn managed to endure the pain and continued to fight back.

The Battle of Nar Shaddaa took place by 68 BBY on the moon Nar Shaddaa, in which Jedi Master Crucitorn of the Jedi Order fought against the Flame-Wielders. Crucitorn became immolated by the Flame-Wielders, but endured the pain and continued to fight back.

Dalna was a small planet located in the Dalnan sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Known for its agriculture, Dalna was inhabited by a settler population known as the Dalnans, who distrusted outsiders and rarely traveled offworld.

The Luster was a cruiser owned by the Solodoe ambassador Ketas. While Ketas was negotiating with the Plinovians on Station Zeta, the Jedi diplomat Arath Tarrex stole Ketas's seal of office, made of solid mythra, from the Luster, using the Force to circumvent the security systems.
Katarr was an astronomical object that was the homeworld of the sentient Reeman species, located in the Katarr system in the Vensori sector of the Mid Rim Territories.

A starship was used by the Duros trader Staaysha Dekkr who worked for the Duro Interstellar Freight and Shipping company. The starship became trapped in a gas cloud nebula after attempting to make a shortcut through it to get to Klytus V Station.
A gang of pirates was led by Captain Gwarm during the Imperial Era.

Valkoths were a species of creature. The holopresenter Divad Masspur approached the Jedi Master Dooku with an idea for a sport that involved Jedi being dropped into a tank of creatures, suggesting valkoths as a possibility.
The Coachelle Burrow Runs was a racing event, in which the Lepi racer Thrar participated using a ground-churner.

The Celanon Circuit was a racing event. Ramil, a racer from Serenno, made himself known on the Celanon Circuit. The race took place in the vicinity of the astronomical object Celanon, located in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Bindai district was a district located on the planet Coruscant. During the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally, both Izal Pre and Ramil crashed into the Bindai district.
The Calocour bend was a portion of the Dragonfire Circuit airspeeder track on Coruscant.
The Hesperidium straight was a section of the Dragonfire Circuit on Coruscant. It shared it's name with Hesperidium, one of the moons of Coruscant.

The Lefex turn was a turn on the Dragonfire Circuit airspeeder racing track on Coruscant. During the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally, Izal Pre of Cona crashed after passing through the Lefex turn.
The Razda straight was a section of the Dragonfire Circuit airspeeder track, located near the start of the race.

The Tyerell Ring was a section of the Dragonfire Circuit on Coruscant. It shared its name with the podracer Ratts Tyerell, who crashed into a stalactite at the Mos Espa podrace circuit's Laguna Caves during the Boonta Eve Classic in 32 BBY.

The Hythan Quarter was an area on the planet Coruscant where there were many production plants and factories with towering chimneys. The lair of the crime lord Cenevax was located in the Hythan Quarter.

The Delgaldon Plains were an area of plains on the Outer Rim Territories planet Serenno. When arriving on Serenno to assist the Serennian people with Abyssin mercenaries who had taken over the planet and the capital city, Jedi Masters Dooku, Sifo-Dyas, Lene Kostana, and the pr…

Anzellans were a diminutive sentient species. Their size was comparable to infant members of other species. The eyes of Anzellans had floating corneal micro-lenses that could see microscopic details and they also had purple blood.

Tah'Nuhna was an ice planet in the Mid Rim, home to the species of the same name. Tah'Nuhna and its people had been neutral in every conflict, welcoming to all, and they allowed the Resistance to briefly stay on their planet shortly after the Battle of Crait, leading the First…
The Tah'Nuhna, also referred to as the Tah'Nuhnan, were an insectoid sentient species which hailed from the Mid Rim ice-planet of the same name.
The Optima was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer commanded by Cremp, an officer of the Galactic Empire's Tarkin Initiative.
PC-265 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used by Governor Wilhuff Tarkin to travel to the Star Destroyer Optima.

Ash Moon 1 was a moon located in the Kartovian Formation. A Central Isopter deathshrine was located on the moon. Korin Aphra was present at an archaeological site on Ash Moon 1 when he was contacted by Boba Fett.

Mount Gethzerion was a mountain affiliated with Mother Talzin of the Dathomirian Nightsisters. While Talzin's son Maul was exiled on the junk world of Lotho Minor, he lured salvager Captain Spikewheel to the planet to hijack their starship and escape to Mount Gethzerion.
C2-N2, also known as Seetoo Enntoo, was a Hollis-series steward droid owned by Meteor, Havoc Squad's commanding officer.
The Panop was a starship owned by Boss Carpo of the Carpo Crime Syndicate. It was located above the planet Lanz Carpo, and used as a fortress for Carpo's guards.

result: Obi-Wan Kenobi is led to a trap near Maramere
Obi-Wan Kenobi borrows Aayla Secura's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor
objective: Find information on Asajj Ventress's whereabouts
x: During the Clone Wars, Obi-Wan Kenobi went on a mission to the planet Trigalis in order to find information on Asajj Ventress's whereabouts.
The destruction of Tah'Nuhna, also known as the sacking of Tah'Nuhna, was an assault launched by the First Order on the neutral world of Tah'Nuhna for assisting the Resistance.

The Formidable was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer used by the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. In 1 BBY, during bounty hunter Beilert Valance's hunt for Darth Vader, the Formidable was under the Sith Lord's command.

Sisk was an astronomical object located in the Sisk system in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square U-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid, that was home to the popular dessert Sic-Six-layer cake.

The Ramesh were a Hutt kajidic active in Hutt Space. The kajidic was a patron of the Delphidian privateer Sidon Ithano, who also held patronages from the Desilijic, Besadii, Gnuda, and Shell kajidics.
Shell was a Hutt kajidic that—along with Desilijic, Besadii, Gnuda and Ramesh—was a patron of the Delphidian privateer Sidon Ithano.

Fermic was a terrestrial factory planet located in the Fermic system within the Wazta sector of the Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches. It was situated in grid square J-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Tevel was a grassland planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was home to the Tevellan species. It was the location of a New Republic bacta production plant. The First Order annexed the planet, and the Tevellans requested assistance from the Resistance.
The Zixon were a sentient species native to the planet Minfar. They were shorter than humans, covered in short and thick green fur, and had long pointed ears, a snout, and long-clawed hands.
The Ladara Vex was a light cruiser in the navy of the First Order. Commander Branwayne Spiftz acquired the Ladara Vex for a mission to the planet Minfar.
Ghikjil was an underground city located on Minfar, inhabited by the Zixon species.

objective: Prevent the First Order from discovering the Echo Horn
Obtain the Echo Horn
x: The mission to Minfar, also known as the Battle of Minfar, was undertaken months after the Hosnian Cataclysm during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

The Tevellans were a sentient species from the planet Tevel. The Tevellans were covered in orange fur with white or dark brown stripes, long tails, and membranes between their arms and torsos which allowed them to glide.

The StarRover, colloquially known as the Rover, was a freighter owned by the pirate queen Maz Kanata. Kanata supplied the StarRover to the Resistance for use in a mission to a bacta production plant on Tevel, undertaken by Finn and Poe Dameron.
Two-Seven-Oh-Five was the designation of a First Order medical shuttle. The Resistance members Finn and Poe Dameron stole the shuttle from a space station during their mission to Tevel.

result: The Tevel Bacta planet is successfully retaken by the Resistance and t
objective: Liberate the Tevel bacta production plant from the First Order
x: During the war between the First Order and the Resistance, Resistance members Poe Dameron and Finn were sent on a mission to the planet Tevel.

Planetoid A.17 was a planetoid located in the Toria-vic Nebula in Wild Space within grid square S-3 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of the human Lieutenant Mytus Adema of the Galactic Empire.

Rine-cathe 111 was the homeworld of human General Sotorus Ramda of the Galactic Empire. It was located in the Rine-cathe system of the Core Worlds and the Interior in grid square L-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Kef Bir, designated IX3244-C and known as the Ocean Moon of Endor, was an ocean moon orbiting the gas giant Endor in the Endor system.
The Spice Runners of Kijimi were a gang of spicerunners that operated from Kijimi during the late Galactic Civil War and the New Republic Era.

A bat-squirrel was a type of creature that was capable of gliding through the air. Members of the sentient Tevellan species, who had thin membranes stretched between their arms and torsos, were able to glide like bat-squirrels.

Peka was an energetic river community on the Outer Rim planet Batuu that lived in a small settlement mostly made up of tents, huts, and cabins made from natural resources. The inhabitants mostly worked in fishing and farming, and some commuted into Black Spire Outpost.

Surabat was a tiny settlement located in the Surabat River Valley on the planet Batuu. Its residents were hardy and reserved folks, many of whom were involved in the dangerous task of harvesting the Golden Lichen that grew on the spires that surrounded the vicinity.

Black One, also known as Poe Dameron's X-wing fighter, or Poe's X-wing, was a Resistance T-70 X-wing starfighter that was utilized by Commander Poe Dameron during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

RZ-7, or Arzee-Seven, was a masculine droid built by Karr Nuq Sin from spare parts he found, including the circuitry of a protocol droid, the hard drive of an astromech, and the casing of a medical droid.

Promencious Four was a planet. Around the time of the rule of the Eternal Empire, the centuries old wreck of the Splendor, a lost Mirialan luxury cruiser, was discovered in the lava fields of Promencious Four.

The Pinnacle Room was a circular chamber with a domed ceiling and walls dominated by massive arched windows located at the highest point of the central spire of the Imperial Palace, formerly the Jedi Temple, on the planet Coruscant.
Alamass was a distant and frigid planet that was covered in icy tundra and turbulent floes of ammonia within the Alamass system, a star system in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Cerosha was a planet home to several cities, including Mock and Solace. For many years, Solace had been peaceful and lively, but some individuals visited Solace for illegal trade.

Cairos was a city located on the planet Cerosha. After the destruction of Solace, another city on Cerosha, the inhabitants of Cairos became fearful of an individual known as the Dark Wraith, who was said to have destroyed Solace.

Mock was a city located on the planet Cerosha, near to the city of Solace. In the time after the destruction of Solace, the inhabitants of Mock came to believe that it had been destroyed by a figure known as the Dark Wraith for its citizens' disobedience.

Solace was a city located on the planet Cerosha, on the edge of the Boralic Sea. At one point, Solace was a bustling city occasionally protected by an individual known to the inhabitants as the Wanderer.

Drahgor III, or Drahgor Three, was a terrestrial planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Drahgor system. It was the homeworld of the sentient Gozzo species, which mined into their planet's ground for fuel resources.
The Boralic Sea was an ocean located on the planet Cerosha. The cities of Mock and Solace were both located close to the edge of the Boralic Sea.
Flintwings were a species of creature that inhabited the planet Batuu. They were known to make howls, which could be heard from the Saka homestead.
The skindle was a creature found on the planet Batuu. The sounds they made could be heard from the Saka homestead outside Black Spire Outpost.

Simoth was a forest world home to a camp of Simothian enslavers. After taking Ry Nymbis as his apprentice, the Sith Lord Darth Caldoth abandoned him in the camp on Simoth. For seven years, Nymbis fought for the slavers, becoming stronger.
Simothians were a group from the forest world Simoth. A number of Simothians worked as enslavers in a camp on Simoth.

A moon was the site of a mountain into the black jade side of which members of the Sith tradition of Force-users at one point carved a sacred temple. Eventually, however, the moon was abandoned, with the temple reduced to a crumbling ruin.

A night world was located in the galaxy, with ashen swamp terrain covered in electric mist. The Sith Lord Darth Caldoth took his apprentice Ry Nymbis to the night world so that he could hunt down and kill a knight and take their lightsaber.
An asteroid was located in the depths of Wild Space. On the asteroid, a Force cult constructed a fortress that overlooked a fissure in the void.
Kaspas was a terrestrial ice world located in the Kaspas system, a part of the Hevvrol sector in the Mid Rim Territories. It was positioned at the coordinates 0-15 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

x: During the war between the First Order and the Resistance, Resistance General Leia Organa led a mission to the ocean planet of Mon Cala.
Endor-la was a "lost city" found on the forest moon of Endor. Though it was a supposedly peaceful place, young Ewoks Wicket and Teebo once got into trouble there after fleeing from some Duloks.

The Firaxa Syndicate was a criminal syndicate that operated on Coruscant's Level 1313, led by Lacezzi Macran. Macran's adopted son Meysor was a member of the syndicate, and was in line to inherit the organization.

Ryarten was an astronomical object that appeared green from space that was located in the Ryarten system within the Corthenia sector of the Mid Rim and New Territories. It was situated in grid square K-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Fuacha was a swamp world home to a family of Gamorreans, including Honnah. During the Imperial Era, stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire killed Honnah's family, leaving her to discover their bodies when she returned home.
Mytar was a cold astronomical object with snowy forest terrain. The human Gita lived on Mytar while she was young, and was taught to use sniper rifles on the native wildlife.
Anoatian pit beasts were massive beasts that resided on the polluted planet of Anoat. The scavenger Rey fought one during her stay at the Resistance Camp there.

The Mourning Shrines was a memorial located underwater on the planet Mon Cala. The shrines consisted of multiple large blue statues of Mon Calamari greats, including Admiral Gial Ackbar. The memorial was surrounded by coral and eels.

JJ-EP9 was a GNK-series power droid that fought in a droid battle in Galma on the Outer Rim planet Batuu sometime during the First Order-Resistance War. The battle was broadcast over the local radio station BSO 401.72 and resulted in a controversial victory for the droid R-3PO.

The Forgotten Terrace was a location in the jungles of Yavin 4. During the Revanite crisis, leading members of the Yavin Coalition, such as Darth Marr and Grand Master Satele Shan traveled to the Forgotten Terrace with a ship that departed from the Coalition Command Post.
A thunder-wasp was a type of creature that buzzed and moved in a swarm. Thunder-wasps shared their name with the Thunder Wasp, an Arquitens-class light cruiser.

Kendoh Gang become fugitives to the First Order
objective: Retrieve a cache of Weapons from Base 354-23X on the moon of Avedot
x: During the war between the First Order and the Resistance, Commander Poe Dameron of the Resistance undertook a mission to the Moon of Avedot to obtain munitions that the New Republic had impounded from pirates in Base 354-23X.

The Vratix were a species of sentient insectoids from the planet Thyferra. They were the inventors of bacta, a gelatinous substance that encouraged the rapid healing of serious injuries. The production of bacta gave Vratix an almost mystical pleasure.

The Engineering Corps was a Resistance subdivision that made the necessary modifications to keep the Resistance's gear operational as well as countering new advancements in technology of the First Order.

The Avadora was a small First Order yacht owned by Vroc Raynshi, the father of Maize Raynshi. When Vroc was reassigned, Maize, along with the Force-sensitive Karr Nuq Sin, and the droid RZ-7, stole the ship for their journey to travel around the galaxy and uncover Jedi artifac…

A strike-vulture was a type of vulture that the Force-sensitive Dathomirian Asajj Ventress believed were the only birds found on the planet Rattatak. They were known to strip bones clean on the planet's dust plains.

Stennaros was a celestial body located in the Stennaros system. It was part of the Stennes sector, a subsector of the Expansion Region's Har Worlds sector, and lay in grid square K-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Terrelia was the homeworld of the Eighth Brother, a Terrelian Jango Jumper Inquisitor and former Jedi, and Cassilyda Cryar, another Terrelian Jango Jumper and criminal who lived in the Coruscant Underworld. It was located in the Terrelia system in the Inner Rim Territories.

The Temple of Malmourral, also called the Zardossa Stix Pyramid, was an ancient pyramid-like temple located on the moon Zardossa Stix which served as a base for the Frangawl Cult, a religious organization from Bardotta who worshipped the demon of war, Malmourral.

Zardossa Stix Port was a major city on the moon Zardossa Stix, located among its moon-spanning deserts. The city featured several market stalls and was home to a variety of species, and also had starship landing areas.

result: Bentilais san Sk'ar joins the Imperial Military
x: During the Imperial Era, Captain Thrawn and his fleet of Galactic Empire Star Destroyers bombarded the Wild Space planet Oben after Thrawn failed to understand its inhabitants, the Kaleesh, by studying their art.
RK-9, or Arkay-Nine, was a rebuilt aqua droid that acted as the personal security droid of Chadkol Gee, advisor to General Nossor Ri on the planet Mon Cala.
Krakanas were carnivorous creatures that existed on Mon Cala. In the culture of the Mon Calamari, the remains of those who lost in ancient rites of challenge were fed to krakanas.

Rentalles was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Rentalles system within the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim and New Territories. It was situated in grid square O-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Zeffo was an electromagnetic wind-swept planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. A water-rich world, its terrain consisted of rocky mountains and cliffs, and its surface was covered in grass.
R6-LE5, also known as "Leefive," was an R6 astromech droid that served voluntarily in the Resistance in its base on the moon Ajan Kloss.
R5-2JE, also known as "Toojay," was an R5 series astromech droid that served as the head of the droid pool for the forest landing area in the Resistance base on the moon Ajan Kloss.

The R2-series astromech droid R2-SHP, also known as "Shep," served the Resistance with his counterpart R6-LE5 during the war against the First Order. The pair performed routine maintenance on the CR90 corvette Tantive IV while it was in the Resistance base on the moon Ajan Kloss.
Phillak were creatures native to the mountains of the planet Zeffo.

Scazz were subterranean, verminous creatures that lived on the planet Zeffo. They could communicate hostile intent from the top of their heads to the end of their tails and had oversized mouths used for surprise attacks.
The Collapsed Ruins were located on the planet Darvannis. The ruins formed a underground tunnel that allowed access to the Plateau Bazaar from the Sandstorm Dunes.
The Scar was an area located on the planet Darvannis.

result: Ana Tolla's crew is stopped from sabotaging Kat Saka's farm
x: A skirmish took place at Kat Saka's farm after Ana Tolla's crew was discovered trying to sabotage the farm.

Imperial Transport Pilots were Imperial combat drivers specialized in operating transport skiffs on the planet Mustafar. They wore white armor with blue markings, resembling that of Imperial stormtrooper body armor with Imperial combat assault tank pilot helmets.
Talus was a planet located in the Corellia system. The world was part of the Galactic Empire and under the governance of Planetary Governor Ili P'tan, who was intensely xenophobic.

The Tarkin's Will, formerly known as the Fortitude, was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the Imperial Navy. It was present near the Death Star at the time of the Battle of Yavin, and was severely damaged by debris from the Death Star.

Celsor 3 was an ice moon located in the Celsor system of the Hook Nebula. Its primary terrain was snow-topped ice pillars and icy ground. It was uninhabited, save for the native jakoosks, who spent most of their time slumbering.
Jakoosks were a species of large creatures capable of flying and burrowing under snow native to the ice moon Celsor 3.

The Land Port was an industrial area of Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu. The Land Port acted as the land-based entryway into the outpost for travelers arriving by foot, on the back of a creature, or in a surface vehicle.
Ephemera was a remote resort planet in the Inner Rim Territories with many spas. During the Imperial Era, Tibanna gas was mined to extinction by the Empire before they abandoned the planet.

The Service Yard was a gritty yard in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu. Located between the Milk Stand on Merchant Row and the Droid Depot within the outpost's Land Port, the Service Yard acted as a back-of-house area for the Droid Depot, supplying an oil bath and a dro…
Leisure and Recreation was a division of the Mekuun Corporation, the existence of which surprised some as Mekuun was primarily known for producing heavy repulsorlift vehicles.
The Rothkahar were a group that existed in the galaxy. According to local stories on the planet Ephemera, the planet's founder was a Rothkahar philosopher.
The Sphere of Military Command was one of the five Spheres of Influence of the reconstituted Sith Empire that was created by Empress Darth Acina after the Eternal Empire conquest.
The Sphere of Sith Doctrine was one of the five Spheres of Influence of the reconstituted Sith Empire that was created by Empress Darth Acina after the Eternal Empire conquest.
The Sphere of Civil Administration was one of the five Spheres of Influence of the reconstituted Sith Empire that was created by Empress Darth Acina after the Eternal Empire conquest.
The Sphere of Galactic Influence was one of the five Spheres of Influence of the reconstituted Sith Empire that was created by Empress Darth Acina after the Eternal Empire conquest.

Destra was one of two moons that orbited the Outer Rim planet Batuu in the Batuu system of the Trilon sector, the other being Valara. It was not visible from Black Spire Outpost, the planet's largest settlement.

The Trandoshan Nokk belonged to a clan during her early life. Nokk's skills as a hunter impressed her clan's elders, gaining the envy of Skikkesk, a hunt leader in the clan. As part of Nokk's coming-of-age ceremonial hunt, Skikkesk forced her to kill and skin a baby Wookiee.
A contingent of vulture droids was built in the Kudo droid foundry. Although the droid starfighters engaged Jedi General Anakin Skywalker and his BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bombers, they were defeated.
Zucca were a type of creature. They could be eaten as food, and were served to Jabba the Hutt to celebrate the return of his cousin Crakka.

Arkonoks were domesticated herd beasts on the planet Onderon. They were infamous for their unpredictable fits of rage which put tamers in serious danger. Their meat was prized as a delicacy on the planet, despite being generally regarded as nothing out of the ordinary.

The Daa Camp was an outpost established by Dylanto Daa and the Daa Corporation on Ontotho, situated on the border of Fylar. While assisting the Fylari, who claimed to have been attacked by the corporation, the Jedi Padawan Cere Junda infiltrated the camp.

The mekle was a predatory flying creature native to the jungle planet Minfar. They had two sets of wings, and were large enough to pick up and carry away a human. Mekle had an aversion to bright light, and as such would not attack an individual wearing a reflective suit.

The grobel were creatures from the planet Minfar. They resided underground, where their scales helped them carve tunnels through the rock. The grobel would attack the native Zixon, who would use xinda flower dust to keep the creatures away.

The Forbidden Lands was the name that the Zixon gave to the area where the Galactic Empire had set up on their homeworld of Minfar. The Empire constructed research facilities on Minfar, where they created the Echo Horn, a device that could control the Zixon.
Dwarf rathtar was a subspecies of rathtar found on Trillia. They were involved in an incident known as the Trillia Massacre.
Originally known as Kijimiko, a spiritual settlement centered around the Dai Bendu Monastery, Kijimi City laid on the frigid Mount Izukika of the planet Kijimi.
Tralus was a planet located in the Corellia system at the coordinates F-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid, along with its twin planet Talus.
Long before the Imperial Era, the planet Mustafar was devastated after Lady Corvax used the Bright Star to activate her Aeon Engine.
A dealer droid served aboard the luxury train Exas Jewell during its maiden voyage on the planet Tyegin.
A mission took place on the planet in 3627 BBY as part of the Third Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and Galactic Republic.

result: Kazuda Xiono and Torra Doza are able to kill the Jakoosk.
objective: Hunt down and kill a jakoosk on Celsor 3
x: A mission was undertaken by the Warbird gang and later Kazuda Xiono and Torra Doza to find food for the Colossus by killing a jakoosk on the ice moon Celsor 3.

Keedees were a type of bird that could be found on Akiva. While living in the city of Myrra on Akiva, Norra Wexley and Wedge Antilles kept keedees, which they collected eggs from. They sported multi-colored tail plumage.

BB-19H was a BB-series astromech droid that had a gold, red, and translucent red body, with a black sensor. The droid spent time at Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana where he quietly observed the smugglers, brigands, scouts, and spies there.

The Battle of the Meridian Complex was a major and decisive battle in the renewed conflict between the Sith Empire and Galactic Republic. The Empire launched a massive fleet at the Republic planet Corellia seeking to destroy the advanced Meridian Complex shipyard.
ARIA was an artificial intelligence in charge of the CI-004 Research Facility, a Czerka Corporation base on the planet Dxun in 3627 BBY.
Ajan Kloss was a jungle moon located in the Cademimu sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square L-5 on the Standard Galactic Grid, orbiting the gas giant Ajara.

Bogano was a grassy planet in the Outer Rim Territories. It was largely unexplored during the time of the Imperial Era and could not be found on any maps. Its surface was covered in mesas and wetlands.

PALLAS-Eleven was an aged assassin droid who worked in a crew led by the Lasat pirate Grox. During the Galactic Civil War, Grox and his crew captured the freighter Millennium Falcon, which the pirates planned to sell to the Tech Masters of Trionak.

The Nema was a transport used by the Rebel Alliance. During the Galactic Civil War, it transported medical supplies through the Kiax Nebula, and Red Squadron were sent to accompany it. The transport was hijacked by pirates who served the Tech Masters and taken to Trionak.

The spitscuttle was a creature known to infest the starships of the Galactic Empire's fleets. They were similar in appearance to the scurrier, a creature from the planet Tatooine, though had no relation.

Around 12 BBY, Fortress Vader was attacked by an army of plague-infected Mustafarians that were mind-controlled by Mother Sssl of Clan Rrrt. Darth Vader handled the situation by taking control of Sssl's thought, ultimately driving her and her horde into a nearby lava river.
Clan Rrrt was a Mustafarian clan whose priestess was Mother Sssl.
The Huttbreaker's Rebellion was a revolt that occurred around the same time as the Conquest of Makeb in 3638 BBY.
The Dire Skulls was a pirate gang operating in Brzo's Wells, within the space station Mek-Sha in 3627 BBY.
Junker Jott's crew was a group of journeymen, technicians, engineers and utility droids based on Mek-Sha. Led by Junker Jott, it was one of the five ruling organizations on Mek-Sha by 3627 BBY.
The Dar'manda was a band of ex-Mandalorian gun runners and one of the five ruling organizations on Mek-Sha after Huttbreaker's Rebellion.
Harido Wald was the largest smuggling ring in the galaxy and one of the five ruling organizations on Mek-Sha by 3627 BBY. The group was led by Veek the Sneak and constituted mostly of Rodians.

The Brothers, or simply Brothers, was a group of slaver zealots and one of the five ruling organizations on Mek-Sha after Huttbreaker's Rebellion. They sold many slaves to the Sith Empire by 3627 BBY.

objective: Galactic Republic: purchase fuel for the Republic ships
Sith Empire: sabotage the Republic fleet
x: A mission took place on the shadowport Mek-Sha around 3627 BBY as part of a larger conflict between the Sith Empire and Galactic Republic.

Nuja was a terrestrial astronomical object that was the homeworld of Pacer Agoyo, the son of a pilot in the New Republic's Phantom Squadron. It was located in the Nuja system in the Axion sector of the Expansion Region.
Megablock 65 was a neighborhood located on the moon of Nar Shaddaa that was home to Lentsch's spice den.

In 12 BBY, shortly after the construction of Fortress Vader on Mustafar, a raid on the castle was conducted by Criakan and a contingent of Southern Mustafarians. They managed to break into the fortress and capture Vaneé, although they were all soon killed by Darth Vader.

objective: Rescue Lieutenant Thom Hudd
x: During the Galactic Civil War, Commander Lina Graf of the Rebel Alliance embarked on a mission to Fortress Vader on Mustafar to rescue Rebel Lieutenant Thom Hudd who was being held prisoner by Vaneé in the fortress.
