objective: Find the Tusken totem and use it to discover the location of salt mine
x: A search for a Tusken totem was undertaken on the planet Tatooine.
A sentry droid worked in a small crew led by the bounty hunter Jeskian Veldar. He had plating colored entirely black, with a singular red sensor.
A protocol droid was owned by the crime lord Ne'eda Frip, leader of Ne'eda's Stalwarts on Neral's moon. The protocol droid translated for Frip, who usually resided within a tank in her tower.

Ne'eda's Stalwarts were a criminal organization that consisted of the henchmen of the crime lord Ne'eda Frip, who resided in Ne'eda's Tower on Neral's moon. They were charged with keeping order on the moon.

The Retreat from Parcelus Minor happened during the Imperial Era. The mercenary Saponza claimed to have participated in the retreat from Parcelus Minor, in addition to the Mytaranor Campaign and the Kwymar Suppressions.

The blue-breasted hover ibbot was a species of ibbot native to the Core Worlds planet Drall. The bird, one of sixty-eight varieties of ibbots found on the planet, had a wingspan of seven centimeters and evolved to hold a particular niche in Drall's ecosystem.
The yellowtail ibbot hawk was one of the sixty-eight species of ibbot bird native to the planet Drall. While most ibbot species fed on algae, the yellowtail ibbot hawk was carnivorous.

The crested arrow ibbot was one of sixty-eight species of ibbot, a class of bird native to the planet Drall in the Corellian sector of the Core Worlds. Unlike most other ibbots, which ate algae, the crested arrow ibbot was predatory.
The common ibbot, also known as the brown ibbot, was one of sixty-eight species of ibbot bird native to the Core Worlds planet Drall.
The Jedi Order established a temple in a moist lowland on the planet Caamas.
Clan Tallmeadow was one of the clans of New Plympto. It was based in a district of the same name in Phemiss, the capital of the planet.
Clan Sunsinger was one of the clans of New Plympto. It was based in a district of the same name in Phemiss, the capital of the planet.
Clan Seawatcher was one of the clans of New Plympto. It was based in a district of the same name in Phemiss, the capital of the planet.
Clan Riverwander was one of the clans of New Plympto. It was based in a district of the same name in Phemiss, the capital of the planet.
Clan Leapfar was one of the clans of the planet New Plympto. It was based in a district of the same name in Phemiss, the capital of the planet.
Clan Holdfast was one of the clans of New Plympto. It was based in a district of the same name in Phemiss, the capital of the planet.
Clan Flashblade was one of the clans of New Plympto. It was based in a region of Phemiss that was also known as Clan Flashblade.
Clan Fishgather was one of the clans of New Plympto. It was based in the Clan Fishgather district.
Clan Farlook was one of the clans of New Plympto. It was based in a district of the same name in Phemiss, the capital of the planet.

A pilot droid was one of many similar droids that served the Scrapper Guild on the shipbreaking planet Bracca, piloting hover barges in the Shipbreaking Yard. In 14 BBY, the pilot droid was situated by a wrecked Venator-class Star Destroyer, collecting waste on his hover barge.
Line Ten-A was the designation of an area on the wing of a wrecked Venator-class Star Destroyer situated within the Scrapper Guild's Shipbreaking Yard on the planet Bracca.
The Hynestian Royal Guard were the security force of the royal family of the planet Hynestia. Captain Twyla was the head of the Hynestian Royal Guard.

t: Battle between Rogue Squadron and Ysanne Isard's forces
x: In the year 5 ABY, Soontir Fel helped the New Republic's Rogue Squadron win a critical battle against the forces of Ysanne Isard's Galactic Empire.
The Uniformed Branch was the most visible division of the Canto Bight Police Department. Its members worked in the city's Old Town and casinos.

The Legacy Run was a Class A modular freight transport that was destroyed in an event known as the Great Hyperspace Disaster. Fragments of its debris were shot through hyperspace and traveled to points across the galaxy.
The Byne Guild was a guild based in in the outer reaches of the galaxy during the High Republic Era. Owning a fleet of starships, the guild was headed by Scover Byne.

Saberfish were a type of enormous fish that lived in the storm seas of the Mid Rim planet Tibrin. During the High Republic Era, a countess from the Core Worlds planet Abregado-rae ordered a saberfish for her private aquarium.
Catadra was a temple world located in the Deep Core's Cerberon system. It was home to a number of religious cults, the most notable of which was the Children of the Empty Sun.
The Yordain Core was an astronomical object in the Yordain Core system in the Inner Rim Territories where an event happened, involving a blessing by a priest-king.

The Allegiance was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier which served in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 4 ABY, it began serving the Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing along with two other cruiser-carriers.

Verzan was an airless planet located in the Deep Core's Cerberon system. It served as a garrison world of the Galactic Empire, but was bombarded by the New Republic during its campaign to capture the system, obliterating much of Verzan's surface.
CB-9 was an astromech droid who served the New Republic's Alphabet Squadron as the droid of Yrica Quell. CB-9 replaced Quell's previous astromech D6-L after it was destroyed in a crash on Pandem Nai.
Jarbanov was a barren planet located in the Slice portion of the Expansion Region, in the Serathrace sector in grid square P-11 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Anx Minor was an astronomical object located in the Anx Minor system in the Outer Rim Territories' Raioballo sector. It lay along the Veragi Trade Route between the Dantooine and Ord Trasi systems. It was the site of a massacre during the Galactic Civil War.
A massacre took place at the location Anx Minor during the Galactic Civil War, prior to the New Republic's campaign in the Cerberon system.

Narthex was the moon of Catadra, a planet in the Deep Core's Cerberon system. Having once been inhabited, Narthex had been unpopulated for nearly a millennium, and the moon was overrun with dirkweed brambles.
The Cerberon debris field was an asteroid field located in the Cerberon system, within the Deep Core.
Asteroid CER952B was an asteroid located in the Cerberon debris field, within the Cerberon system of the Deep Core.

A planetoid was located in the Cerberon system, orbiting the Cerberon singularity black hole. Yrica Quell, Caern Adan, and his unique IT-O crashed onto the planetoid after escaping the destruction of the Lodestar. The planetoid contained a Sith tower located on top of a mesa.

Kol Huro was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Kol Huro system in the Kanz sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The journalist Caern Adan was detained and imprisoned by the Galactic Empire after he published a story about droid production forecasts on Kol Huro.

Koru Neimoidia was a Purse World located in the Colonies region of the galaxy. After being imprisoned by the Galactic Empire, the former journalist Caern Adan hoped that a new warden would be appointed and release him back into the streets of Koru Neimoidia.

Yethra was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector's Yethra system within the Outer Rim Territories. Situated at the coordinates N-17 on the Standard Galactic Grid, it had one sun and a terrain that consisted of ice sheets.
The Warplands was a location on the planet Fedalle, containing the ruins of Navosh-Hul.
The Cataract of Moons was an astronomical object where TIE fighter pilot Soran Keize of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing once encountered an enemy Polynean pilot.
The Cybersynth District was a district of the planet Troithe that contained foundries. During the Troithe operation, Wyl Lark escorted Kairos's U-wing through Cybersynth District foundries.

Quarmendy was a rocky planet in the Mid Rim Territories. The Nexus, a floating city and trading outpost, was situated above Quarmendy. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the latter group controlled the Nexus.
The Nexus was a trading outpost located above the planet Quarmendy. Early on in the Clone Wars, the Nexus was occupied by the Confederacy of Independent Systems under the leadership of Wat Tambor.
New Vertica was a city located on Nar Shaddaa. The Benevolence Tower, home to the Inheritors of the Crystal cult, was located on the outskirts of New Vertica.
The Noral Sea was a sea located on the planet Ord Radama in the Outer Rim Territories.

Deaons were a sentient species native to the astronomical object of Ord Gimmel. Members of the species possessed long fingers and manufactured a variety of makes and models of the short, squat variable holdout blasters, which were shaped to fit their hands.
Chorgad was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Chorgad system within the Fei Hu sector of the Mid Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square Q-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Starskimmer was the starship of the bounty hunter Nakano Lash, who led a crew of other hunters. The ship included a large room with a holoprojector at its center, which Lash would use for briefing before missions.

Receiver Station 356-39 was a communication station located on the mining planet Chorin. The bounty hunter Beilert Valance attempted to contact his former lover Yuralla Vega through Receiver Station 356-39, but cut the transmission just before it went through.
By 3 ABY, a bombing on Chorgad was carried out by a crew of the Mourner's Wail Syndicate against their rival, the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate.

objective: Take control of the Nexus
x: During the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic undertook a mission to the planet Quarmendy to take the floating city Nexus from Confederacy of Independent Systems control.
Galandan was, along with Galactic Basic Standard, one of the two primary languages spoken on the planet J't'p'tan.
A town was located on the planet Merokia. It was the home of the Force-sensitive human Karr Nuq Sin and contained his school.
The Force-sensitive human Karr Nuq Sin lived in a house on the planet Merokia. The house was located in the same town as Nuq Sin's school.
Fire rats were a type of creature native to Mustafar. They were known to gnaw on the lava crystals that could be found on the volcanic world.
This BX-series droid commando served on Anaxes during the battle between the Grand Army of the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
The operation at Jarbanov, also referred to as the Jarbanov attack, was carried out in 5 ABY at the planet Jarbanov by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.
The east passage was a location on the planet Pasaana.

The Alliance to Restore the Republic operated a base on the planet Ketal. Eventually, the Xucphra bacta-harvesting corporation learned of the base's location and shared it with the Galactic Empire, who destroyed the base.
In 32 BBY, recently-elected Queen Padmé Amidala of Naboo held the Chommell sector summit for the leaders of other planets in the Chommell sector.
Hornet was a Rebel CR90 corvette that was destroyed in the Battle of Remitik.
Prowler 2 was an Imperial CR92a Assassin-class corvette that participated in the Battle of Remitik.
Prowler 3 was an Imperial CR92a Assassin-class corvette that participated in the Battle of Remitik.
Prowler 4 was an Imperial CR92a Assassin-class corvette that participated in the Battle of Remitik.
Prowler 1 was an Imperial CR92a Assassin-class corvette that participated in the Battle of Remitik. It was the first of four Imperial corvettes to arrive at the battle.
Warrior was a Rebel CR90 corvette that was destroyed in the Battle of Remitik.
Typhoon was a Rebel CR90 corvette that was destroyed in the Battle of Remitik.

The Broken Wing was a specific location formed on the planet Zeffo when an unidentified Venator-class Star Destroyer crashed there after suffering large amounts of damage from a Separatist dreadnought during the Battle against a Separatist dreadnought.
The gazarant was a species native to the planet Fresia. The Lower Coromon Chain was home to gazarant feeding grounds, which helped to prevent prisoners from escaping.
Aygion Mountain was a major city located on a mountain of the same name on the agriworld Kinyen. It served as the planet's capital and contained the First Temple of Doellin.

Riar was a major city located on the planet Toydaria. It had a population of approximately 100,000, of which about 80 percent were Toydarian, and was divided into several districts. It was built on a series of hills.
Toydar was the largest city on the planet Toydaria. It had a population of approximately half a million.

Arnel was a major agri-industrial city on the planet Toydaria. The city was composed on ten rings of alternating water and land surrounded by swamps. The majority of its buildings were constructed atop large metal poles.
U2-C1 was a U2-C1-series housekeeping droid manufactured by Publictechnic and employed at Jabba's Palace. The blue-colored droid informed the Whiphid J'Quille about a threat to him.
The Low Park was the region between the several hills that made up the Toydarian city of Riar.

The Merchant Mounds were a trio of hills located in the Toydarian city of Riar. Most of Riar's trade takes place in the mounds. One of the hills, called Merchant Mound One, was the first settlement that would become Riar, and so was also known as the Old Town.
The Factory Hill was a hill located in the Toydarian city of Riar. It was used for heavy industry and contained the city's power plants and other utilities

The Transit Hill, also known as the Riar Starport, was a hill located in the Toydarian city of Riar. It was adjacent to the Factory Hill, and all starship traffic entering the city was routed through the hill.
The Tower Hills were a pair of hills located in the Toydarian city of Riar. They contained a number of residential towers, which could be up to fifteen stories tall.
The Royal Highland was a hill located in the Toydarian city of Riar. It contained the royal residence and other government facilites. It was the largest and tallest hill in the city.

Merchant Mound One was one of the three hills that made up the Merchant Mounds, the district of Riar in which most trade took place. The original settlement that became Riar was located on Merchant Mound One, so the hill was also known as the Old Town.
The Bright Vigil was a medical transport that served the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
The southern province was a province of the Mid Rim planet Naboo. By 32 BBY, a girl lived in the province who was famed for her water sculptures.

The battle above Catadra, also referred to as the battle over Catadra, was a battle initiated by the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, led by Colonel Soran Keize, to attack General Hera Syndulla's New Republic forces within the Cerberon system.

The rock garden was a location in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Jedi Padawans were often assigned to rearrange the stones in the garden, and it was one of the tasks Obi-Wan Kenobi wished he were carrying out rather than reading taxation bills presented to the Galactic Senate w…

result: The Galactic Empire destroys the Parozha VII outpost
x: The attack on Parozha VII was carried out in around 5 ABY by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

The zobberan hound was a species of eight-limbed creatures. While not known for their intelligence, they were known to be extremely loyal and obedient once trained. They were native to the Zobbera system.

Salis D'aar was the capital city of the planet Bakura. It was laid out in a circular pattern which, according to historian Eloc Throno in his 34 ABY book Traveler's Guide to Batuu, made it easy for outsiders and visitors to navigate.
The Queen's library was a library in the Theed Royal Palace down the hallway from the royal apartments on the fifth floor, reserved for the use of the Queen of Naboo.

The Theed sewer system was the sewer system of the city of Theed, capital of Naboo. For health purposes, it was the only part of the city's infrastructure completely managed by droids, and as such was normally completely flooded with water.
The sewage treatment plant was a location on the outskirts of the Naboo city of Theed where the city's sewage was processed.
A catfish was a species of fish native to the planet Batuu in the Outer Rim Territories.

The eastern exurbs were a location on the planet Christophsis. In 22 BBY, during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, the exurbs served as the site for the refugee camp of Republic Senator Bail Prestor Organa, as well as the comp…

The Minister of Sustenance's compound was a compound owned by the Minister of Sustenance in the eastern exurbs of the world of Christophsis. Senator Bail Organa and his rebels stayed in the cellar beneath the compound when they were targeted by Separatist General Whorm Loathsom.
The western district was located within the city of Chaleydonia, the capital of the planet Christophsis.

The War Production Board was an organization within the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, Lieutenant Commander Orson Krennic noticed scientists who were associates of the War Production Board during a meeting of the Strategic Advisory Cell.

The western district in Chaleydonia, the capital city of the planet Christophsis, had a town square. During the Battle of Christophsis, the Galactic Republic encountered little resistance when capturing the town square and rest of the district.

LIN-34 was a droid that operated during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, LIN-34 served Jabba the Hutt's criminal empire on Tatooine under Jabba's sadistic EV-series supervisor droid EV-9D9.
The Melilla Sea was a large body of water located on the Core World of Leria Kerlsil.

H-dash-five-one-eight-zero-two was the designation of a Coyote cargo ship owned by Hondo Ohnaka of Ohnaka Transport Solutions on the planet Batuu. The Resistance spy Vi Moradi used the freighter when rescuing Siv and Torbi from the planet Parnassos.

The Shrikarai, also known as the Nameless, as the Shrii Ka Rai or Shrii-ka-rai (Eaters of the Force or Force Eaters), were creatures that preyed on the Living Force, thus making them into natural predators for Force-sensitive individuals when they were forced off of their home…

A moon in the galaxy was once colonized by the Geonosian species. Long after the moon had been abandoned, during the Imperial Era, antiques dealer Antron Bach went into hiding on the moon with a cache of Jedi artifacts he had been entrusted with by Jedi Master Uvell.

Lizard-crows were a type of creature found on the lava fields of the world Mustafar. They were known to be scared off by what the Mustafarian priestess Sssl referred to as "molten men." During her attack on the fortress of the Sith Lord Darth Vader with an army of plagued Must…

An RQ protocol droid served the Czerka Corporation aboard the cruiser Leverage. The RQ protocol droid processed the former Czerka slave Rahara Wick after she had been captured on the moon of the planet Pijal.

t: Skirmish between the Admonitor and Creysis's scout squadron
x: In 2 ABY during the Imperial Era, a skirmish occurred between the Imperial Star Destroyer Admonitor and a scout squadron of Ebruchi clan in the Unknown Regions.

A Geonosian colony was located on a moon in the galaxy. Long after the Geonosians had abandoned the colony, during the Imperial Era, antiques dealer Antron Bach went into hiding there with a cache of Jedi artifacts he had been entrusted with by Jedi Master Uvell.

The Trustworthy was a starship flown by the pilot Reen and her droid partner Kreven. The two were hired by the Guild of Technicians to transport cargo aboard the vessel, but Kreven sabotaged the thrusters, intending to allow pirates to steal the Trustworthy cargo.

Kreven was a six-armed droid that worked with the pilot Reen. The two were hired by the Guild of Technicians to transport cargo aboard the starship Trustworthy, but Kreven betrayed Reen, intending to sabotage the vessel so that pirates could take the cargo.
The Guild of Technicians was a guild that hired the pilot Reen and her droid partner Kreven to transport cargo aboard the starship Trustworthy.
The Uln was a species of bird. It could be served as food. Feyodor of Feyodor's Tavern served stuffed Uln bird glazed in a light mist of Zsajhira berry juice.

An enforcer droid served the Chance Encounters casino on the space station known as Station Zeta. After the Jedi Arath Tarrex, who was sent to Station Zeta as a diplomat, gained debts to the casino by cheating, the droid was sent to collect the money from him.

A tactical droid served Count Dooku of the planet Serenno aboard his airship, the Windrunner. When Dooku, a Sith Lord, sent his apprentice Asajj Ventress to find his sister Jenza at Carannia Spaceport, he insisted Ventress take the airship, where she was accompanied by the tac…

A waitress droid served at the Belsallian Cantina on the planet Serenno. When the Sith apprentice Asajj Ventress entered the cantina to search for the Crolute criminal Glute, she used the waitress droid's tray to knock a Khormai patron that had been harassing her unconscious.
A command security droid served Count Gora of the planet Serenno, leading a unit of other security droids. During the funeral of Gora's wife, Countess Anya, Gora had the droids stationed nearby.

During the Galactic Civil War, New Republic General Hera Syndulla's Barma Battle Group bombarded the Galactic Empire's airless garrison world of Verzan. The world had been a fortress that cracked open under the fire from the Lodestar and proton bombs from Alphabet Squadron.

A security droid served as a commander in the droid army of Count Ramil of the planet Serenno. After Ramil orchestrated the takeover of Serenno by Abyssin mercenaries, numerous Serennians fought back, assisted by the Jedi Master Dooku, brother of Ramil.
The incident on Serenno was an invasion of the planet Serenno orchestrated by its Count, Ramil of House Serenno, in 42 BBY. Ramil intended to turn the people of Serenno against the Galactic Republic.

x: At some point the Knights of Ren were hired to raid the penal world of Osseriton. During the raid, the Knights freed prisoners and liberated the dungeon ship known as the Night Buzzard, which they modified to become their own transport.
Woshrikes were a species of dangerous creatures found on the agrarian planet of Ertegas in the Anoat sector. While growing up on Ertegas, Arro Basteren protected his family's crops from woshrikes.

During the time of the Galactic Republic, a summit was held on Station Zeta between the Plinovian and Solodoe species. The Solodoe wished to terraform the planet Plin Minor, which would lead to the destruction of much of the Plinovians' natural habitat.

x: The Battle of Troithe, also referred to as the attack on Troithe or the battle at Core Nine, was a surprise attack initiated by the New Republic against the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing during the Galactic Civil War.

Clan Farlook was one of the districts of the city of Phemiss, the capital of the planet New Plympto. It contained Hiakk Hall, and was the home of Clan Farlook. It bordered the Clan Flashblade, Clan Tallmeadow, the Clan Sunsinger districts.

The Clan Fishgather was one of the districts of the city of Phemiss, the capital of the planet New Plympto. It was the home of Clan Fishgather, with which the district shared its name, and bordered the Tsilor Sea and four other districts.

Clan Flashblade was one of the districts of the city of Phemiss, the capital of the planet New Plympto. It bordered six other districts, and was the home of Clan Flashblade, with which the district shared its name.
Clan Holdfast was one of the districts of the city of Phemiss, the capital of the planet New Plympto. It was the home of Clan Holdfast.
Clan Leapfar was one of the districts of the city of Phemiss, the capital of the planet New Plympto. It was the home of Clan Leapfar
Clan Riverwander was one of the districts of the city of Phemiss, the capital of the planet New Plympto. It was the home of Clan Riverwander.
Clan Seawatcher was one of the districts of the city of Phemiss, the capital of the planet New Plympto. It was the home of Clan Seawatcher.
Clan Sunsinger was one of the districts of the city of Phemiss, the capital of the planet New Plympto.
Clan Tallmeadow was one of the districts of the city of Phemiss, the capital of the planet New Plympto. It was the home of Clan Tallmeadow and contained Phemiss Bridge.

The drifters' district was one of the districts of the city of Phemiss. It was separated from the rest of the city by the Pharine River and was primarily inhabited by Nosaurians who did not belong to a clan.
The Corteone Ocean was an ocean on Talus. Qaestar Town was built along the ocean.

J-6 was a protocol droid who existed during the High Republic Era, belonging to aspiring inventor Avon Sunvale. A repurposed bodyguard droid, she was given to Avon by her mother Ghirra Starros around three years before the girl was sent to Port Haileap.
The Remel Sea was a body of water located on the Core World of Leria Kerlsil.
The Keri Sea was a body of water located on the Core World of Leria Kerlsil.
The Swampway 200 was a popular biannual skimmer race hosted by Ugnaught King Ozz, which followed a course called the Ugnorgrad Swampway through Grukk's Jungle and Phizbin Marsh.
Gaaten was a planet located in the Garis sector. It was home to an orphanage that became the home of a Force-sensitive girl named Elish in the aftermath of the Clone Wars.
Malloran was an astronomical object in the Malloran system in the Garis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The young girl Elish as well as her mother hailed from Malloran.
A terrestrial planet home to an undeveloped society was the homeworld of the human Everi Chalis, who lived in the ruins of a bombed paper mill prior to the time of the Galactic Empire.
Templemarch was a city on the planet Crucival where the Opaline Creed faction was present in 4 BBY, operating from a cloister outside the city until its fall.

The Cryptanalysis department was a department of the Galactic Republic formed sometime around the Clone Wars. During the war, members of the department traveled to Murkhana along with Wilhuff Tarkin and troops from the 12th Sector Army.

A civilian settlement was located on the planet Vir Aphshire near some hives and orchards. In 0 ABY, after the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry captured the hives and orchards from the Galactic Empire, the rebel Sergeant Fektrin led a scout party to the settlement and det…
Mount Veermok was a mountain on the planet Eriadu located to the north of the Orrineswa River. It was part of the Carrion Spike and was owned by the Tarkin family.
The forty Great Families of the Chiss Ascendancy were a political ruling group of Chiss families within the Aristocra of the Chiss Ascendancy.
The Chiss Syndicure was the supreme ruling body of the Chiss Ascendancy, and was composed of the Aristocra's Nine Ruling Families. Members of the Syndicure were known as Syndics.
The Whirlwind was a Chiss starship part of the Chiss Ascendancy's Expansionary Defense Fleet. It was equipped with engines and could be brought to flight status in half an hour.

Csaplar was the capital city of the planet Csilla and the Chiss Ascendancy. Csilla was the homeworld of the sentient, near-human Chiss species. By the time of the rise of the Galactic Empire, most of the city was located underground, well below Csilla's icy surface.

A mining field was located on the terrestrial astronomical object Thearterra, in the Unknown Regions. In 19 BBY, it had been newly opened. In that year, the Chiss Ascendancy's ruling Mitth and Ufsa families both sought control over the field.

Naporar was a planet in the Chiss Ascendancy and was also the headquarters of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet. Naporar contained a medcenter where Mitth'raw'nuruodo underwent physical therapy after the Vagaari pirate operations.

Dioya was a location in the Dioya system in the Unknown Regions. Shortly after the Vagaari pirate operations, Supreme General Ba'kif planned to travel there with Mitth'raw'nuruodo in order to investigate a derelict ship found in the system.
Thearterra was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Unknown Regions' Thearterra system, within the Chiss Ascendancy nation.

Treen was a remote forest moon. The Jedi Padawan Vosa attempted to meditate in the Forest of Tranquility on the moon, but mistakenly sat on a spikeworm nest. Vosa was warned of the nest by a native ape creature, and managed to avoid being attacked by the worm.

The Forest of Tranquility was a forest on the remote moon of Treen. The Jedi Padawan Vosa visited the forest to meditate, but mistakenly sat on the nest of a spikeworm. An alien ape warned Vosa of the danger, saving him from being attacked by the worm.
Porthor was a major city located on the planet Arbooine.
Liber 1 was a Rebel BFF-1 bulk freighter that was destroyed at the Battle of Remitik.
Liber 2 was a Rebel BFF-1 bulk freighter that was destroyed at the Battle of Remitik.
Liber 4 was a Rebel BFF-1 bulk freighter that was destroyed at the Battle of Remitik.
Liber 3 was a Rebel BFF-1 bulk freighter that was destroyed at the Battle of Remitik.
The Nal Hutta Jewel was a Minstrel-class space yacht manufactured by Ubrikkian Industries. It was the base of operations for Ganis the Hutt.
Trunk rippers were arboreal mammals who tore into trees in search of insects. They could reach lengths of two meters. They had dual foreclaws, a toothed snout, and prehensile tail.
Lava nymphs were winged creatures that dwelled in groups, living in luminescent hives at the Corvax Fortress during the Imperial Era.

The Eucliptan Morae was a BR-23 courier constructed by Republic Sienar Systems. It served the Galactic Republic as a personnel transport and courier before being phased out of military service and refitted to civilian specifications.
Axial Park North, also known as the North Tram Station, was a tram station on the Coronet Junction, the public transport system of Coronet City, located in the northern part of Axial Park.

R2-Q2 was an R2-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton that was attached to the 501st Legion of the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, it was part of the team that boarded the Tantive IV to root out Rebel spies.
The Ord Radama Spaceport Authority was an independent agency that ran the Livien Magnus spaceport. The agency was overseen by the planetary governor and controlled arrivals, depatures, and security.
The Noble District was a district of the city of Livien Magnus that contained the Imperial Palace.
The Commerce District was the part of Livien Magnus that contained the Scarlet Sword cantina.

Reaps were creatures that lived in dead forests on the Forest Moon of Endor. They had a long body, the front end of which featured two eyes and a beak, with which the reap screeched when attacking foes.

The Western Provinces were a region of the Mid Rim planet Naboo. During the Republic Era, the girl Rabene Tonsort hailed from the Western Provinces and spoke in the distinctive accent of those who lived there.

result: Conflict between the Chiss Ascendancy and the Paataatus
x: The attack on Csilla was a battle between the forces of the Chiss Ascendancy and three attacking warships. The attackers were the Paataatus Hiveborn, though they were unidentified at the time of the attack.

The Barrows was the name for the most dilapidated parts of Livien Magnus' Residential District. It was the only part of the city to survive its destruction in 3653 BBY, and was home to the city's poorest residents.
The Residential District was a part of the city of Livien Magnus that contained the Barrows.

A protocol droid served the Alliance to Restore the Republic aboard the cruiser Invincible Faith. In 4 ABY, shortly prior to the Battle of Endor, the protocol droid was in the workshop of a rebel technician for repairs.

The city cemetery of Theed was the main burial area of Naboo's capital city. The Naboo who died in the Battle of Naboo not buried in their family plots were interred there, with the Queen's crest carved on their gravestones.
The Kaasban Sea was a sea located on the planet Sakiya in Hutt Space. The shanty town of Iepatap Harbor was built inside a tiny cove on the sea's northern shore.

Ridgetown was a major city built around the Rotoksa Ridge Grand Lodge on the planet Sakiya. It was inhabited primarily by Sakiyans who sought admittance to the Lodge, and contained dozens of shops and cantinas.

Kæhaxa was the capital city of the planet Sakiya. Like the cities of Ithor, Kæhaxa used repulsorlift technology to hover above the ground. This allowed to city to slowly move across the planet, and it often stopped near small villages.
Iepatap Harbor was a large shantytown located on the planet Sakiya.
The skuir fish was a species of fish native to the planet Sakiya. They were aggressive, and grew to an average of five meters in length.
The Rotoksa Mountain Range was a snowy mountain range located on the Hutt Space planet Sakiya. The mountains contained the city of Ridgetown.

Hunter's Valley was a valley located in the Rotoksa Mountain Range on the planet Sakiya. The owners of the nearby Rotoksa Ridge Grand Lodge transformed the valley into a game preserve by importing Species from around the galaxy trapping them with a particle shield, so that the…
The Financial District was a district of Coronet City, the capital of Corellia. The Mangrove Hotel was located in the Financial District.
Quellor City was a major city located on the planet Quellor.
Arch Canyon was a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit. Most races opted to travel over the Dune Sea instead of through Arch Canyon, though the Boonta Eve Classic did not.
The Whip was a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit.
Bindy Bend was a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit.
The Coil was a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit.
Jett's Chute was a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit. During 32 BBY's Boonta Eve Classic, Anakin Skywalker's podracer's engines overheated in the Jett Chute.

Guildhead's Way was a location on Chandrila. The smuggler Platt Okeefe wrote in the Smuggler's Guide that individuals seeking to smuggle fine oro-weave should ask for Ox-Herder at the Trappist cantina on Guildhead's Way.
Rori was a small moon that orbited the planet Naboo. Before Grizmallti people discovered Naboo, the Elders left behind their statuary on the moon.

Spider-sponges, also written as spider sponges, were a type of flora native to the planet Geonosis. Nests of spider-sponges lived in the air vent tunnel between the power generator hub and the fusion reactor in the Geonosian droid factories in 22 BBY.

The Pharine Delta was a portion of the Pharine River, which flowed through the city of Phemiss on the Core Worlds planet New Plympto. The delta contained several islands and emptied into the Tsilor Sea.
The loro was a species native to the planet Cato Neimoidia.
The treveel was a species native to the planet Cato Neimoidia.

During the Galactic Civil War, Imperial forces staged an attack on Ort Hoogra-D'En's base on the planet Pallaxides. The assault was in retaliation for Hoogra-D'en's bombing of the Syndaar Military Prep School.
The Carrion Spike was a location on the Carrion Plateau on the planet Eriadu. It was owned by the Tarkin family. It sat atop a hill and was made out of black volcanic glass.

A planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories was covered in a shallow sea of crystal clear water that featured coral growth. Conquered by the Galactic Empire, it was the site of Horizon Base, a vital Imperial shipping port and refueling station.

The Aethrorn Mountains, sometimes known as the Aethrorns, were a mountain range located on the planet Jagomir. The ruins of a pirate base were located in the Aethrorn Mountains.
The Shimmering Falls was a massive, 200 meter tall waterfall located on the planet Jagomir. Behind the Falls were caves that served as a burial ground for Sith.
A dream shimmer was a species of large, buzzing insect found on the planet Jagomir. The insect's thorax and abdomen were about the size of a small rodent.
The arzid rodent was a species of rodent found on the planet Arzid.

Oru was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was home to a group of human warriors known as Oruans. The First Order took over the planet and stripped it of its resources, causing Oru to become toxic.
The Oruans, also known as the Oru, were a group of humans native to the planet Oru. A warrior people, the Oruans fought back when their planet was taken over by the First Order.

The Pride of Stars was a starship in the service of the Galactic Empire during its early years. It was commanded by the decorated Imperial Navy captain Ran Niall, who implicitly trusted his bridge crew.
GH-72 was a medical droid who assisted Lorren Morrick at Arda Base.

Hangar Five was a hangar on Horizon Base. During a Resistance mission to Horizon Base, Finn asked Poe Dameron to collect him and Gannis Ducain at Hangar Five.
The candori was a tentacled carnivorous creature. Mezlo, the leader of a resistance group of Oruans on Horizon Base, kept at least two candori to fend off First Order forces.
The Tarinna, also known as Critonian story vampires, were a sentient species that fed on experiences and memories.
The Fury of Alderaan was an Alliance to Restore the Republic cruiser that was used to carry members of the Ardan resistance to Jagomir after the Battle of the Gauntlet.
Rook Minor was a terrestrial astronomical object that hosted the Golden Rocket Bank. The Troig Durl and Dekk worked as security in charge of the bank's vault on Rook Minor.

Magnetic rock chimps were a species of creature that lived in the jungles of the planet Opop Hibbedit. They spoke simplistic Galactic Basic Standard and consumed metal, which they referred to as "popo-nut".
The Ragged Claw was an XS stock light freighter used by the smuggler gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi.
The Greens was a location in Qaestar Town, the largest city on the planet Talus.
"The Loop" was a road that surrounded Qaestar Town, the largest city on the planet Talus.
The Dens were a location in Qaestar Town, largest city on the planet Talus.
Old Town was the oldest area of Qaestar Town, the largest city on the planet Talus.
The Northroad was a road in that ran along the Corteone Ocean and eventually entered Qaestar Town, the largest city on the planet Talus.
Kystes' Tomb was a location in Qaestar Town, the largest city on the planet Talus.
Little Drall was a location in Qaestar Town, the largest city on the planet Talus.
The High Road was a road on Talus that led to the Qaestar Steps.

A B1 battle droid served the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. The battle droid operated under the tactical droid TX-20 during the Battle of Ryloth.
A B1-series battle droid held the rank of sergeant in the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Jafani delegation was a group sent from the planet Jafan to participate in the Chommell sector summit held by Queen Padmé Amidala of Naboo. It was headed by Harli Jafan, the daughter of Jafan's planetary director.
Camp three was a prison camp constructed on the planet Naboo by the Trade Federation during its occupation.
A B1-series battle droid served as a sergeant in the Confederacy of Independent Systems' droid army during the Clone Wars.
Sector 11374265 was the designation of an area of the planet Teth, outside the B'omarr Order Monastery.
An OOM command battle droid of the Confederacy of Independent Systems was stationed on the planet Teth, at the B'omarr Order Monastery.
The Bantha Plains were a location on the planet Tatooine. The Plains were located between the Northern Dune Sea and B'omarr Flats and were a sandy region inhabited by wild banthas.

Bildor's Canyon was located on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine. The north entrance of the canyon connected to Tatooine's Desert Valley region and its south entrance led to the North Jundland Wastes region.
Pika Oasis was a location in the Jundland Wastes on the planet Tatooine. It was near Ben Kenobi's home and the wreckage of the crashed freighter Spice Siren.
Starboard #5 fusion reactor complex was a reactor complex on the starboard wing of the First Order flagship Supremacy. It was located next to Starboard #6 fusion reactor complex.
Starboard #6 fusion reactor complex was a reactor complex located on the starboard wing of the First Order flagship Supremacy. It was next to Starboard #5 fusion reactor complex.

The University of Yabol Opa was a planet-wide university located on the Colonies world Yabol Opa. In 22 BBY, Grand Warden Solokin Sakellar served as the university's absolute ruler and had a lodge on the Galactic Republic capital of Coruscant.

The Wealth Level was one of the eleven levels of Pau City, the capital of Utapau. It contained a number of seawater processing plants that extracted valuable substances from the planet's world-ocean. The level also contained warehouses and factories.
Seameadow was the region directly north of the city of Phemiss. It bordered the Pharine River and Tsilor Sea.
The Drowned Chase was a swamp located across the Pharine River from Phemiss, the capital of New Plympto.

The Hieroprince's Ascension was an event marked by the Opaline Creed, a religious faction based on the Outer Rim world Crucival during the time of the Galactic Empire. The event was based around the Hieroprince, an individual in the Creed's religion.

Zeta was a Z7 series construction droid who was part of a crew tasked to build a settlement on Cro-Akon. When the construction site was raided by slavers, Zeta sacrificed herself to allow fellow droid Z5-TXT to escape with the other droids and organic workers.

The Green Mazes were large mazes located within the Trophill Gardens. The challenge of the mazes required participants to carry comlinks to alert managers for a rescue. Over half the people who entered the mazes required a rescue.
The Joyous Roamer was an asteroid tug under the command of Omad Kaeg that had been built sometime before 45 ABY. It was used in the Chiloon Rift.

The Lok Revenants were a group of pirates that existed during the final decades of the Galactic Republic, led by the Feeorin Nym. The pirates operated along the Corellian Run and the end of the Llanic Spice Run, as well as the Arkanis sector in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Waldo Flats were a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit.
The Waldo Grade was a location on the Mos Espa podrace circuit on the planet Tatooine, near the Waldo Flats.

t: Raid on the Black Sun's clinic
result: Clinic shut down and patient list recovered
objective: Shut down Black Sun's clinic
Recover clinic patient list
x: In around 3643 BBY, Coruscant Security Force officer Stansun tasked an agent of the Galactic Republic with raiding a clinic being operated by the criminal Black Sun on the planet Coruscant.
A sentient species of ancient insectoids were active in the galaxy following the Battle of Jakku. Navigators known as the Attendants were members of the insectoid species.
The Renown was a Venator-class Star Destroyer utilized by the Galactic Republic and its naval branch, as well as the Open Circle Fleet, during the Clone Wars.
The Fifth Moon of Thrinittik was a terrestrial moon located in the Thrinittik system of the Colonies. It hosted a university library, which was, at some point, partially destroyed during an attack.

Sarjenn Prime was a terrestrial astronomical object with a cold climate located on the edge of the Sarjenn system. During her time studying at the University of Bar'leth, Chelli Aphra embarked on an unsanctioned archaeological expedition to a fortress on Sarjenn Prime.
Zeilo was the capital city of the planet Arbooine. It was also the largest city on the planet.

The Silver Star was a G9 Rigger-class light freighter produced by the Corellian Engineering Corporation. During the Galactic Civil War, the Silver Star was captained by Saral Aenet, and was attacked by a Pathfinder-class scout ship carrying bounty hunters hired by Erron Irbian.

An Arquitens-class light cruiser served the navy of the Galactic Empire. After the Empire attacked the Son-tuul Pride crime syndicate and confiscated their fortune, the credits were to be transferred to an Imperial vault aboard the Arquitens-class light cruiser.

t: Workshop of the Architects of Vaale
x: The workshop of the Architects of Vaale was a sanctum located beneath the city of Vaale on the planet Dianth.
The Helshar clan was, along with the Tumris clan, one of the two clans found in the city of Quolas. By the time of the Clone Wars, the two clans were bitter rivals and dominated the city.
The Tumris clan was, along with the Helshar clan, one of the two clans found in the city of Quolas. By the time of the Clone Wars, the two clans were bitter rivals and dominated the city.

The Sathari Pathran Helshar founded a resistance movement against Gel Marcolf, a tyrant who ruled the city of Quolas. Initially, the resistance did not take action for fear of retribution against Helshar's family and other townsfolk.

The Commercial District was one of the four districts of the city of Jorra. It was the primary economic center in the city, though by the Imperial Period, its activity was much reduced and more heavily monitered.
The Residential District was one of the four districts of the city of Jorra. It primarily contained housing for the non-wealthy residents, as well as small businesses that served them.

The Palace District was one of the four districts of the city of Jorra on the planet Cato Neimoidia. The wealthy families of Jorra lived in the Palace District, though many homes fell into disrepair during the Imperial Era because of the Trade Federation's loss of power after …
The Factory District was one of the four districts of the city of Jorra. It produced products such as droids and airspeeders.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the Alliance to Restore the Republic was involved in a battle on the planet Bakura during the time of the Galactic Civil War. The Alliance's Blue Squadron was instrumental in the battle, which ended in a victory for them.
Tish was a mountainous planet with a stormy climate home to a lightning mining platform crewed by Ugnaughts.

Hetzal Prime, also known simply as Hetzal, was a planet located in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet and its system were within the territory of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era, containing a total population of forty billion.

Delriss was a rocky planet located in the Expansion Region. Thousands of years before the Battle of Yavin, the planet was mined for rare ores, though they eventually were exhausted. It was orbited by the aquatic moon of Delriss.
The aquatic moon of Delriss was a moon of the planet Delriss that was covered in oceans. The moon was very isolated, leading the Jedi Order to build a sanctuary on the moon.
The Harrower was a ZH-25 Questor-class that was present in the galaxy during the Galactic Civil War. It was fitted with a dorsal turret-mounted medium laser cannon.
The Jorra Spaceport Authority was an organization that supposedly helped to bankroll the Dropview cantina. In reality, the cantina was backed by the Whitescar Syndicate.

Sesid Traffic Control was an organization that controlled the movements of ships in the planet Sesid's airspace. According to Nien Nunb, the organization would alert the Galactic Empire of suspicious activity immediately.
The didac was a species native to the planet Wielu.
Alekie Island was an island located on the planet Wielu.
Woorta Cent's Estate was an estate located in the eastmost portion of the city of Thousand Thousand, the most powerful city on Makem Te.
Gelfish were a species of tentacled fish found in Tython's Moon Channel, where they once attacked Lanoree and Dalien Brock.
The Leleen River was a river located on the planet Toydaria. Its average width was 100 meters, although it could become even wider during floods.
The Windswept Lakes were more than a dozen bodies of water that formed at the intersection between the Merchant Mounds of the city of Riar and the surrounding swamps.
Churr was a farming world near Quellor. During the Mandalorian Wars, the Republic suffered major losses on Churr.
Gefthaine was a forested world near Mandalore. War droids were supposedly spotted on Gefthaine.
The Starhound was a Simiyiar-class light freighter that was used by the undercover Imperial Security Bureau agent Eren Garai.
The Constant Spirit was a Rebel light freighter that fought at the Mission to Quellor.
The Gatekeeper was an Imperial Customs Corvette that fought and was destroyed at the Mission to Quellor. It was commanded by Captain Task.

The Council of Elders was the governing body of the planet Glee Anselm. It consisted of representatives from each of the planet's settlements. Each representative had the title of "elder," though they were not necessarily of advanced age.

The Trandoshan Slavers Guild was an organization of the Trandoshan species that practiced slavery. During the Imperial Period, the Guild and the Galactic Empire maintained an enslavement processing center on Alaris Prime, a moon of the planet Alaris in the Kashyyyk system.

A species lived in the caves in Basteel's mountains. The species was black and rather small, and lived in large swarms. During Operation Yellow Moon, Leia Organa and her team were attacked by a swarm, which left each of them with multiple bites.

A volcanic island was located on the planet Sesid. It was near the planet's main island chain, and though the volcano was active, by 4 ABY it had not erupted in five to six years. As part of Operation Yellow Moon, Leia Organa and her team planned to put a beacon on the island.
The Lower Flora Cloud was a location in the Inner Rim Territories. While disguised as a hyperspace scout, Luke Skywalker stated that his ship had been attacked by pirates and damaged by meteorites.

A BX-series droid commando was ordered to transport stolen lightsaber crystal to a ship in a ice mountains on the other side of the planet. However Clone Commander Gree had been assigned to retake the Crystals from the droid, who had hidden them in the canyon.

Lupal was a moon located in a system centered around a dying star. Once home to a highly advanced and cultured civilization, Lupal was rendered inhospitable by the solar flares of its star, and the moon was eventually left uninhabited.

HCT-10 was an excavation droid on the crew of the explorer Fionn Tucat during a mission to the uninhabited moon of Lupal. When the red light emitted by Lupal's dying star drove the Shistavanen crewmember Kordus Vrak mad, he began to attack the rest of the crew.
RF-U5 was an excavation droid that served in the crew of the explorer Fionn Tucat during an expedition to the moon of Lupal.

Obsidia was a storm-wracked moon located in the Unknown Regions. The moon orbited a tempestuous gas giant that was slowly being torn apart by gravitational pressure, which caused Obsidia's orbit to slowly decay and fall toward the planet.
According to legend, the Straits of Hibrath were a location deep within the Unknown Regions. The Sith Lord Darth Caldoth traveled through the Straits of Hibrath to reach the moon Obsidia.
Kizan was a world that housed a number of academics, including students who traveled to Kizan's glass towers to study the philosophies of other cultures.
Bathoris was a frozen moon located in the Bathoris system in the Outer Rim Territories, situated in grid square N-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
A continent on the planet Sacorria was known as its main continent. The continent contained the city of Saccorata and the Sacorria Central Spaceport.
Athamar was an astronomical object, that, according to legend, was home to the floating laboratory complex of the Sith Lord Darth Caldoth.

The Royal Academy of Arts was a learning institution on the celestial body Atrisia. At one point, the aristocrat Resinu Santhe-Caltra, who was a member of the Santhe family from the Outer Rim Territories astronomical object Lianna, was enrolled at the academy.
Delphon City was a major city located on the planet Delphon in the Outer Rim Territories.
The Bypass Notch was a location on the planet Ryloth.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: During the Operations on Tatooine, the Imperial base Fort Ironhand was attacked by Rebel Alliance forces, which emerged victorious.

t: Attack on the Empire Shuttle Yard
result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: During the Operations on Tatooine, an Imperial base known as the Empire Shuttle Yard was attacked by Rebel Alliance forces, who emerged victorious.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
x: During the Operations on Tatooine, the Imperial garrison on Tatooine was attacked by Rebel Alliance forces, whom emerged victorious.
CH-33Z was a MSE-6 series repair droid. At one point, the Chadra-Fan Vosa stood atop the MSE series droid at the Day Star Hotel while she spoke to her spy, Faddey.

Coromon Besh was an island located in the Coromon Islands, an island chain on the Core World of Fresia. The Islands contained a number of manufacturing plants. Most of the Human staffers and designers for those factories lived on Coromon Besh.

Pecoppi parrots were a species of barely-sentient birds from the planet Recopia. The parrots were often drugged and sold to pet collectors. These birds were an intelligent species, that were one of the few animals that could speak various languages.
DFS-311 was a Vulture-class starfighter that served in the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars as part of a starfighter squadron.
Ardee was an astromech droid in service to a human man who claimed to be the Rebel Alliance pilot Luke Skywalker during the Galactic Civil War.
A solif-spider was a species native to the planet Pasaana that could produce silk strands. Many of these silk strands were in the modified WTK-85A interstellar transport called the Bestoon Legacy.

The Implacable was an Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship that was part of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars, which lasted from 22 BBY to 19 BBY and was fought by the Galactic Republic and Separatist Alliance.
The Tide of Progress XII was a Munificent-class star frigate active in the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Southview Village was a small settlement on the planet Edan II. Locations within the town included the Settlement Offices, Otis' Livery, and the K-O Bar. Shortly after the Imperial assault on Edan Base, surviving Rebels arrived at the village.

The fall of Yordain Core was an event which took place at the Yordain Core where the individual Zab, who was eventually a Sergeant in the 61st Mobile Infantry, experienced a struggle for survival and was present for a blessing from a priest-king.
The Highgarden District, or simply Highgarden, was a lightly urbanized district on the planet Troithe.

The Scar of Troithe was a continent on the planet Troithe which had been heavily mined. During the Galactic Civil War the continent was flat and riddled with ravines and canyons, with no resident life.

The Core Nine mining megafacility, or simply Core Nine, was a large, dome-topped, cylinder-shaped deep core drilling site used during the heavy excavating of the Scar of Troithe, a continent on the planet Troithe. Around 5 ABY, Core Nine was the only mining facility remaining.
The Taa Complex was a sublevel greenhouse with rooftop gardens which was located in the Raddakkia Plaza on the planet Troithe, which used a climate emulator.

The Raddakkia Plaza was a public area on the planet Troithe which featured the Taa Complex, a greenhouse with rooftop gardens, and drift platforms which allowed individuals to walk about above the plaza.

The Ord Radama Rebel Cell was a small Alliance to Restore the Republic that was active on the planet Ord Radama. The Cell was led by Haril Zense, and much of its activity took place in the Scarlet Sword cantina.
Evarrian hunters were one of the races of the non-sentient Evarrian species. They grew to 4 meters and had hundreds of legs.

Arda Base Control was a group that was was responsible for directing ships that were preparing to land at Arda Base, a process which ordinarily involved slave circuiting. Major Yalor was a member of the organization.
The 84th Stormtrooper Legion was an Imperial stormtrooper legion that contained Talon Company. During the Galactic Civil War, the Legion attacked Arda Base.
The Imperial ace Tam Blackstar flew a TIE Hunter. His Hunter was used at the attack on Arda Base.
After the Clone Wars and Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine's proclamation of the New Order, the Galactic Empire annexed the planet Onderon.

The Thannerhouse District, or simply Thannerhouse, was an urban district on the planet Troithe which bordered with the Thanner Lake, a large reservoir whose presence was clouded by towers, bridges and platforms.

The Gloried Chalice District was a district on the planet Troithe which served as the capital for a thousand years. Following the rise of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY, the capital was relocated to the Troithe Planetary Defense Center.

The Troithe Planetary Defense Center, or TPDC, was a militarized area on the planet Troithe. By the Clone Wars, which began in 22 BBY, its barracks and weaponry was abandoned and the defense of Troithe was undertaken by private military companies.
The Old Skybottom District was a populated sector on the planet Troithe which was eighty kilometers south of the main spaceport.
The Web was a district located on the planet Troithe, so named by the locals. The area had many factories, most of which were decommissioned by the Galactic Civil War.

Kellgar Seven was a terrestrial astronomical object on the fringes of the Outer Rim Territories. A cell of the Spice Runners of Kijimi undertook a heist on Kellgar Seven, escaping to Yavin 4, where they became stranded after they killed their traitorous pilot Beke Mon'z.
Setor was a planet located in the Colonies. A number of colonists from Setor settled on the moon Yavin 4, in a settlement referred to as Wetyin's Colony, where they became farmers.

EV-6B6 (Eevee-Sixbeesix), known as Eevee, was a helpful and talkative EV-class droid who originally served the Pyke Syndicate aboard a Moraysian cruiser. The Moraysian cruiser was stolen by the mercenary Ledesmar, and EV-6B6 was thus forced to serve her.

The Zualjinn Syndicate was a criminal organization of spicerunners during the time of the New Republic. They rivaled the Spice Runners of Kijimi, who sent the operative Tomasso to kill the Zualjinn high commander.

Quintil was a frigid planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. Tomasso, an operative of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, was stranded on Quintil after successfully eliminating the high commander of the Zualjinn Syndicate.

Yungbrii was a cold and rocky planet in the Opalok system of the Far Xandil sector in the Mid Rim. It had a sparse population, including humans, who were mostly unconcerned with galactic affairs. The planet also had a meager defense force.

Garsath were massive and aggressive space-faring creatures. A group of Spice Runners of Kijimi attempting to escape the Zualjinn Syndicate by hyperspace skipping encountered a garsath along the Davezra Way.
Moraysians were a species of tan, stout humanoids from the Moraysi system. They were skilled inventors and builders of starships, and had an ability to actualize their schematics.
A Moraysian cruiser was utilized by the Pyke Syndicate. The Moraysian cruiser, along with its complement of droids, was stolen by Ledesmar, a mercenary formerly enslaved by the Pykes.
Judakann was an inhospitable planet located within the Torch Nebula in the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was home to the amphibious creatures known as lurkers.
Lurkers were a non-sentient amphibious species of carrion eaters native to the planet Judakann, in the Torch Nebula. The Rokana Raiders pirate group made a stew from Lurker meat.
Shownar was a terrestrial planet in the Shownar system in the Parmic sector of the Outer Rim Territories, located near the Torch Nebula. The nebula was visible at night from the surface of Shownar.

Elkeenar was a rocky wasteland planet located in the Penagosis system in Wild Space, in grid square K-21 of the Standard Galactic Grid. While a member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, Poe Dameron visited the Marimkes Mountains on Elkeenar with Tomasso.

The Marimkes Mountains were a mountain range on the planet Elkeenar. They had stairs carved in stone that led up to a rock hut. The mountains were the only notable landmark on the planet, which was otherwise a wasteland.

Guat'a was a barren planet located in the Outer Rim Territories near the Torch Nebula, and a haven for many criminal types. The Spice Runners of Kijimi undertook a heist on Guat'a, stealing from the warlord Smaatku.

Alshuey Town was a town and trading post on the planet Guat'a. The town was small with old and worn down buildings, including a social club called Rugova's, which served as the base of operations for the warlord Smaatku.

Fiumarians were a sentient species from the Fiumar system in the Core Worlds with pale pink skin, pupilless eyes, a sloping forehead, and yellow blood. They were deceptively fast and could remain neutral in heated negotiations, making them adept diplomats or smugglers.

Gordelians were a large, bloated, and slow-moving sentient species hailing from the Nishmar system, on the fringe of the Unknown Regions. They were often considered lazy and rarely seen away from their homeworld.
The "Purple Ones" were an alien species native to a planet. Unable to speak basic or use blasters, many were enslaved by Krastic Tarta, slavemaster of the Arkanian Dawn.
During the Galactic Civil War, a rebellion against the Galactic Empire occurred on the planet Andelm IV, backed by members of the Rebel Alliance.

The Teth resistance was a movement that fought against the Galactic Empire on the planet Teth. It was established before the Alliance to Restore the Republic but joined the Alliance after the Battle of Yavin.
Oedriga was a major city located on the planet Nal Hutta.

Zeva Bliss's Centurion-class battlecruiser served the leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi. Zeva Bliss used the battlecruiser to travel to the planet Judakann and collect her daughter Zorii Bliss and Poe Dameron and take to Kijimi as full members of the Spice Runners.

The Vondel was a G9 Rigger-class light freighter owned by the smuggler and enslaver Alfris Sotin. During a deal where Sotin betrayed the Spice Runners of Kijimi, Spice Runners Zorii Bliss and Poe Dameron stole the Vondel, and their cell of the gang continued to use the freighter.

The Osako pirates were a pirate organization active during the era of the New Republic. After Poe Dameron joined the Spice Runners of Kijimi, Dameron's father Kes Dameron and his friend L'ulo L'ampar made a deal with the Osako pirates to find him.
Krystar was a planet inhabited by a population of Ovissians. During the Clone Wars, the planet was a part of the Galactic Republic, represented by Vishar Koss and led by Regent Queb.

objective: Determine whether clone troopers were being held prisoner
x: The Galactic Republic undertook a mission on Krystar during the early Clone Wars in 22 BBY. The mission saw the 212th Attack Battalion's Ghost Company and at least one member of the 104th Battalion travel to the planet Krystar after Senator Padmé Amidala was given information …
TRK-R was a loader droid who worked in a settlement on the planet Serelia during the time of the Galactic Empire, transporting cargo using a landspeeder.

The Springhawk was a heavy cruiser of the Chiss Ascendancy navy that was commanded by Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo. After the Vagaari pirate operations, command of the ship was temporarily taken away from Thrawn, though he regained control soon after.
The Vigilant was a kilometer long Chiss Nightdragon man-of-war commanded by Admiral Ar'alani of the Chiss Ascendancy.
The Paataatus were a sentient species with a swarm mentality. The Chiss Ascendancy led an attack on numerous Paataatus fighters above the Paataatus homeworld, Nettehi.

Nettehi was a planet located in the Unknown Regions' Nettehi system, which was located within Holy Paataatus space. The planet was the homeworld and hive-home of the Paataatus sentient species, and their government of the Paataatus Hiveborn.
Weltflies were creatures that stung their enemies. Although a weltfly's sting was not dangerous alone, a large number of them could be.

The attack on the Paataatus was a retaliatory strike conducted by the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet on Nettehi, the homeworld of the Paataatus species, shortly after an attack on the Chiss homeworld of Csilla around 19 BBY.

Nikarduns were a sentient species found in the Unknown Regions. General Yiv was a Nikardun. The Nikardun government was the Nikardun Destiny. At the time of the Clone Wars, it began to invade a number of nearby societies. General Yiv was thwarted by Thrawn.

During the Galactic Civil War, Imperial forces assaulted the Alliance's Edan Base on Edan II. Led by the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Havoc, Imperial forces attacked Edan Base in force, overwhelming it and forcing surviving Alliance personnel to scatter into the surrounding a…

Following the Imperial victory over Alliance forces at Edan Base on Edan II, the Rebellion struck back by assaulting the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Havoc. An Alliance team infiltrated the Havoc, planting detonite near the vessel's deflector shield generators.

Arch-E was a navigator droid who worked with the smuggler Jayko, and was also able to play the drums. Arch-E and Jayko were present in a cantina when the smuggler's former crewmate Tan entered, thanking Jayko for writing about him in his book, A Smuggler's Life.

An OOM command battle droid served in the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. The OOM command battle droid was one of many battle droids dispatched during the Separatist siege of Hisseen.
Sector 340-NJ, known informally as Blood Town, was a district of Nar Shaddaa. It was located in the moon's Undercity, below the Corellian Sector.
Dream Street was the central area of Nar Shaddaa's Red Light Sector, and the only part of the district with proper security.

Dead Town was the informal name for one of the districts of Nar Shaddaa, located in the moon's Undercity. It contained a number of mausolea in which numerous dead Nar Shaddaans were interred. The mausolea were run by droids and occasionally raided by grave robbers.
The Hunting Grounds was the informal name for one of the districts of Nar Shaddaa, located in the moon's Undercity.
The Valveworks was the informal name for one of the districts of Nar Shaddaa, located in the moon's Undercity. They contained a large recycling plant that cleared toxins out of the air.

The Dark Lands was the informal name for one of the districts of Nar Shaddaa, located in the moon's Undercity. The Dark Lands were located directly beneath the Red Light Sector, and were notable for having no electricity.
Fang-rats were creatures that were found in Nar Shaddaa's Darklands, where they were hunted by the district's residents.
The Yev'anaha Belt was an asteroid belt that surrounded the planet Varl. It was composed of the remnants of Varl's moons, destroyed starships and more.
The Potala Um Var was a warship commanded by the Hutt Ulal and used to patrol the Ardos system. Its name meant "eternal vigilance."
The Basin of Torturous Flame was a massive crater located on the planet Kintan. The crater was located at the end of the River of Fire, and extended to the planet's core.
The Numol'elrul were a subspecies of Nikto. Long before the Galactic Civil War, the Numol'elrul retreated underwater and isolated themselves, causing the other Nikto to believe them to be a legend.

Voraxx were massive, hairy creatures found in the Hutt Space planet Klatooine's Derelkoos Desert. Tribes of the planet's native Klatooinians that lived in the desert used voraxx as both mounts and food animals.

The Ferelakk Savannah was a massive savannah located in Klatooine's southern hemisphere. It was more heavily populated than the Derelkoos Desert but was of lesser cultural importance. The people of the savannah lived in villages of up to 5,000 and farmed voraxx and bracil.

Bracil were a species that lived in herds in the Hutt Space planet Klatooine's Ferelakk Savannah. The creatures were domesticated by Klatooine's native Klatooinians and served both as mounts and as one of the primary food sources for the savannah's residents.
