Woern's Assault Shuttle was a modified Gamma-class assault shuttle that was used by Laerron Woern as his command ship. He received it after the ship was found abandoned after a battle.
The H'drachi Ghetto was a part of N'croth, the capital of M'haeli.

A leviathan species lived on the coral moon Rugosa sometime before a calamity had boiled its oceans away. A skeleton remained on the moon during the time of the Clone Wars, allowing a school of neebrays to colonize the ribs.

Sídi was a planetoid in the Outer Rim Territories. It was gray and cold, with only humans and ash-beetles thriving. During the Clone Wars, it was the site of an old communications tower and Rank and Leera's inn.
Sluuce Canyon was a canyon on the desert planet Tatooine. It was located between Bestine and Mos Eisley and was often used to travel between Mos Eisley valley and higher ground.
The Mos Eisley valley was a valley on the desert planet Tatooine. It contained the city of Mos Eisley, and was connected to the surrounding higher ground by Sluuce Canyon.
Hubba Heights was a large region on the desert planet Tatooine. It was located to the west of the Jundland Wastes.
The Mayor's Office was a building located on the planet Corellia and served as the official office of the mayor of Kor Vella during the Galactic Civil War.
Coranth was a location at the bottom of the Pau Sinkhole. Its pools and grottoes were a sources of calcium.

The Iskalon uprising was a battle on the planet Iskalon that involved the Galactic Empire. During the uprising, Lindon Javes taught Terisa Kerrill to ignore propaganda. She would follow the advice and mention it to Javes before the battle at Fostar Haven.
The Intrepid Heart was a GX1 short hauler of the Galactic Republic that was used as the personal transport of a Jedi Master on a mission to recover Sith artifacts which was eventually lost.
The Second Elite Council Bunker was a bunker located on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. It served as the headquarters of the Chirq Council.
The First Elite Council Bunker was a bunker located on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. It served as the headquarters of the Chirq Council.
The Ryll Warehouse was a bunker located on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. It was used by Vuul Sarlin and his group to stock the Ryll spice distributed in Kor Vella.

The Ryll Smuggler Base, also known as the Ryll Smuggler Bunker, was a bunker located on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. It was the headquarters of the ryll smuggling ring of the Chirq Council.
The Red Circle Base, also known as the Red Circle Bunker, was a bunker located on the planet Corellia during the Galactic Civil War. It was one of the main bases of the Chirq Council.
Asharl panthers were large, aggressive felines native to the frigid planet Ilum in the Unknown Regions. They lived in Ilum's Northern and Southern hemispheres.
Blismal were a non-sentient rodent species found deep within the caves and caverns of Ilum, an ice planet deep within the Unknown Regions.
The Drall Patriot Warehouse was a bunker located on the planet Corellia. It was used by the Drall Patriots during the Galactic Civil War.
Jzoro's Bunker was a bunker located on the planet Corellia, near the city of Doaba Guerfel. It was used by the Chirq Council during the Galactic Civil War.
The Gorgodon was an aggressive species of reptilian native to the planet Ilum. They were known to be extremely dangerous.
Razhak were a non-sentient worm species found on the frigid planet Ilum in the Unknown Regions.
Snowfeathers were a non-sentient Force-sensitive bird species found on the ice planet Ilum deep within the Unknown Regions.
The Varcinius Agglomeration was a company that held an auction for the Smuggler's Guide, a famous journal used by various prominent criminals and pirates.
The leaf-tail was a species of non-sentient winged rodent found on the planet Dagobah. Leaf-tails were about thirty centimeters in length with a wingspan of roughly the same width.
Clan Awaud was a Mandalorian clan that splintered during the Clone Wars. The splinter faction of Clan Awaud was part of the Old Mandalorians and was based on Vlemoth Port.

The Final, also referred to as Seezelslak's Cantina and Seezelslak's Saloon was a starship and mobile cantina owned by the Azumel bartender Seezelslak. The cantina served drinks, and had a jukebox and a Repulsor Darts board.
ParSec was a local law enforcement agency on Parkella. Varko Grey was a ParSec police officer before becoming Titan Leader for the Galactic Empire.
The Lesser Bogwing was a reptavian native to the planet Dagobah. A type of bogwing, these small creatures lived in the swamps of the planet.
The Millennium Collective, as named by L3-37, was the trio of droid brains that made up the central computer of the YT-1300 light freighter Millennium Falcon.
The Posenaur was a species of lizard native to the planet Dagobah. They only had two legs.
The smooka was a small, winged, non-sentient creature native to the planet Dagobah.
The Dreaming River was a river on the planet Dathomir. During the Republic Era, the Dathomirian witch Falta visited the Dreaming River.
The Misty Falls were a group of waterfalls on the planet Dathomir. During the Republic Era, the Dathomirian witch Falta visited the Misty Falls.
The Great Canyon was a canyon on the planet Dathomir.

Charhounds were a type of hound that could be found on the ore planet of Elphrona in the Outer Rim Territories. One charhound, Ember, was considered a member of the Jedi of Elphrona Outpost during the time of the High Republic.

J-4X was a droid that was active in the year 34 ABY. J-4X was present when Guavian Death Gang pirate Tara Rashin attacked a cargo vessel, and the droid communicated with a droid repair technician aboard the starship.

The cabinet was an organization that operated on the planet Troithe. During the Cerberon system campaign, Acting Governor Fara Yadeez reported to Colonel Soran Keize of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing that the cabinet had been hit hard in the months after the Battle of Endor.

The Otoh Gunga Garden was the primary sports arena in the Gungan city of Otoh Gunga. They were primarily used for racing bongos, but also held concerts and other events. The Gardens were built in their own hydrostatic bubble and could fit tens of thousands of Gungans.

A bipedal species lived in the galaxy during the Imperial Era. A species of tall, thin-necked beings, at least one member resided in a mining village on Mapuzo in 9 BBY, while another was present on the Spur Orbiting Market in 3 ABY.
DIS-347 was a droid tri-fighter that served as part of the Separatist Alliance's naval branch during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
The Mercurial was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in service to the navy of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
The darvro was a beast of burden from the planet Ord Gimmel. The Darvro-class light freighter was named after the creature.
The kulthka fish was a non-sentient species of fish found across the planet Dac. The Knowledge Bank had a connection with the fish that allowed it to record everything that the fish saw or heard.

The Polar Plateau on Telos IV was located in the planet's polar regions. Massive and featureless, the ice plateau was a mesa in which the Telosian Jedi Academy was built by the Jedi Master Atris, the Jedi Order's leading historian.

The General Ministry Agencies were various task-oriented organizations that oversaw and operated the machinery of aspects of the New Republic. The Agencies included Navigation, Communications, Port Operations, Records, Facilities, and Transportation.
Communications was a New Republic Agency. It was under the auspices of the General Ministry.
Facilities was a New Republic Agency. It was under the auspices of the General Ministry.
Navigation was a New Republic Agency. It was under the auspices of the General Ministry.
Port Operations was a New Republic Agency. It was under the auspices of the General Ministry.
Transportation was a New Republic Agency. It was under the auspices of the General Ministry.

affiliation: Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic
x: The Quartermaster Corps, known simply as the Quartermaster, was a section of the Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic.

Operations branch was a section of the New Republic Intelligence Service's Special Threats Division. Following her actions during the Corellian Crisis, Belindi Kalenda was promoted to the rank of Lieutenant Colonel and assigned to head up the Operations branch.

The Technical Analysis division was a branch of the New Republic's Intelligence Service. Following the Corellian Crisis, the Technical Analysis division prepared a report on the hyperwave inertial momentum sustainer for Vice Admiral Kursk Mal'ia.

x: The invasion of Utapau was the Confederacy of Independent Systems's invasion of the Outer Rim world of Utapau.
Salana's Rebels were a cell of the Alliance to Restore the Republic that operated on the planet Ord Gimmel during the Galactic Civil War.

Geharr was a major city located on a city continent on the planet Ord Gimmel. Geharr was originally composed of six separate cities, which over time coalesced into one. The city's name meant "Keeper of the Faithful."
The Royal District was a district of Geharr, a major city on the planet Ord Gimmel. It contained the Geharran Royal Palace. The district was protected by thousands of guards.
GR-75 A was the designation of a GR-75 medium transport of the New Republic Defense Fleet that was active during the Galactic Civil War.
GR-75 B was the designation of a GR-75 medium transport of the New Republic Defense Fleet that was active during the Galactic Civil War.
GR-75 C was the designation of a GR-75 medium transport of the New Republic Defense Fleet that was active during the Galactic Civil War.
The Geharran city continent was a landmass located on the planet Ord Gimmel. The planet's capital city of Geharr was located on the continent.
A battle was fought during the Tionese War near Axum. The Tionese won the battle and used pressure bombs to destroy the planet's shipyards.
A battle was fought during the Tionese War near Alsakan. During the battle, the planet was hit by Tionese pressure bombs.
A battle was fought during the Tionese War near Cadinth. The planet was hit by Galactic Republic pressure bombs.
A battle was fought during the Tionese War near Thanium. The planet was hit by Galactic Republic pressure bombs.
A battle was fought during the Tionese War near Chandaar. The planet was hit by Galactic Republic pressure bombs.
A bombing of Barseg was carried out during the Tionese War. The planet was hit by Galactic Republic pressure bombs.
In 14 ABY, the criminal Lannik Racto owned a hidden droid factory on Nar Shaddaa. There, he mass-produced assassin droids for sale on the black market.
Rugosan King coral was a species of gigantic green coral that grew in the coral forests of the moon Rugosa.

The SoroSuub District was a district in Geharr, Ord Gimmel. The SoroSuub Corporation operated a number of factories in the district, which it used to produce hyperdrive components. The company also operated a headquarters tower in the district.
The Graf Archive conducted a restoration effort of the library's contents at some point in galactic history.
The SoroSuub Corporation used a tower as its headquarters on Ord Gimmel. The tower was located in the SoroSuub District of the city of Geharr.
The Armorer's workshop was a workshop used by the Armorer around 9 ABY within the Mandalorian covert on the Outer Rim planet Nevarro.

The Gaalt Sky Rowing team was an athletic team that included Skreen, the alien technical director for the Manifold Mollusk Matrix and Matrimony Association. Skreen brought an appreciated rhythm and strength to all of his endeavors and was an active member of the team.
The Drengir were a plant-like species of sentient, amorphous carnivores from the Wild Space planet Mulita who threatened to reap harvest across the Galactic Frontier during the High Republic Era.
An astromech droid was assigned to Vanguard Five some time after the Battle of Endor and flew with them whenever they were in an X-wing starfighter or a BTL Y-wing starfighter.
Zibben's Path was was an area of the Agrilat Swamp, on the planet Corellia. It was the fourth piece of terrain that the contestants of the Agrilat Swamp Circuit had to race through.
The Wagyx Pass was was an area of the Agrilat Swamp on the planet Corellia. It was the fifth piece of terrain that the contestants of the Agrilat Swamp Circuit had to race through.
The Turnsturin Turn was was an area of the Agrilat Swamp, on the planet Corellia. It was the twelfth piece of terrain that the contestants of the Agrilat Swamp Circuit had to race through.
The Sink Hole was was an area of the Agrilat Swamp, on the planet Corellia. It was the second piece of terrain that the contestants of the Agrilat Swamp Circuit had to race through.
The Corellian Twister was was an area of the Agrilat Swamp, on the planet Corellia. It was the eleventh piece of terrain that the contestants of the Agrilat Swamp Circuit had to race through.
The Skrag Turn was was an area of the Agrilat Swamp, on the planet Corellia. It was the eighth piece of terrain that the contestants of the Agrilat Swamp Circuit had to race through.
The Rasp Ravine was was an area of the Agrilat Swamp, on the planet Corellia. It was the seventh piece of terrain that the contestants of the Agrilat Swamp Circuit had to race through.
The Drall Hollow was was an area of the Agrilat Swamp on the planet Corellia. It was the ninth piece of terrain that the contestants of the Agrilat Swamp Circuit had to race through.
The battle at Tolea Biqua on Genarius was set shortly after the end of the Clone Wars, between the forces of the Coalition and the Cularin Militia.
A sentient species had yellow skin, gray hair, and orange eyes. Mennis Duren was a member of this species, who was present on the Ring of Kafrene trading outpost in 1 BBY.

x: The warehouse district was a district within a barren city located on an Outer Rim planet. A carnita arena was located in the district. Din Djarin visited Gor Koresh while he was in the town. A group of wild dogs inhabited the abandoned industrial buildings of the town.

A mission to the planet Tatooine occurred at some point after the clash on Nevarro, in which the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin traced down a lead from Gor Koresh alerting him to another Mandalorian on the planet.

An abandoned sarlacc pit on Tatooine was inhabited by a leviathan krayt dragon, which the Mandalorian Din Djarin speculated to have eaten the sarlacc. Members of a tribe of Tusken Raiders regularly visited the pit to feed the dragon, in hopes that it would sleep longer.
Docking Bay D-768 was a docking bay situated within Fleet Support's Air Station on the Mid Rim planet Ord Mantell.

Mek-Sha Home for Lost Children was an orphanage located on the space station of Mek-Sha. Ri'kan and Sa'har Kateen spent their earliest years in the orphanage sometime before the Third Galactic War. In 3626 BBY, Dirlid Bond was the director of the orphanage.

Located on the Mid Rim planet Ord Mantell, barrack block 5 Epsilon was a barracks complex within Fleet Support, an installation built by 22 BBY and utilized by the Galactic Republic's Grand Army in 22 BBY.

Night hounds, also known as feral hounds and wild dogs, were a species of dog that were native to the planet RTK111, living within the streets of a warehouse district at some point during the reign of the New Republic.
The Gladean Arboretum was an arboretum located in the Chandrilan city of Emita.

A slimesnipe was a type of creature that could be found in the jungles of the planet Felucia. In 3 BBY, the Alderaanian Princess Leia Organa visited Felucia on a pathfinding trip and watched her instructor, Chief Pangie, shake off a slimesnipe.
A hippoglace was a creature with an azure hue. In 34 ABY, Resistance spy Vi Moradi used hippoglace yarn to knit a lumpy sweater for her brother, Baako.
The Shadow Syndicate was a criminal syndicate active during the Galactic Civil War. The Syndicate was one of a number of organizations trying to exploit the chaos after the Battle of Endor.

Hangartown was the name given to a hangar aboard the Liberty's Misrule that was home to thousands of residents. Hangartown was the third name given to the hangar, so Eleodie Maracavanya believed that it may be renamed.

See-Seven was an RA-7 protocol droid in the service of the Galactic Empire. According to a story told to the Mustafarian youths Giggek and Tuttel by the elder Lellis, See-Seven assisted Imperial Inspector Vaneé when he was sent to investigate a number of insane stormtroopers s…

Trask was an estuary moon orbiting the gas giant Kol Iben. Din Djarin once ferried the Querm Rybet "Frog Lady" and her spawn to the moon from Tatooine and later encountered Bo-Katan Kryze and her Nite Owls there.

Kol Iben was a gas giant located in a star system in the Outer Rim Territories' Arkanis sector. It had at least one moon, the estuary moon of Trask. The planet was situated in the Outer Rim Territories.

Adelphi was a terrestrial coastal planet in the Adelphi system of the Outer Rim Territories. In the early New Republic Era, Adelphi hosted an outpost of the New Republic where the starfighter squadron Adelphi Rangers, including New Republic pilot Captain Carson Teva, were stat…

The Bothan-5 was a New Republic Correctional Transport that carried prisoners of the New Republic. The mercenary crew of Ranzar Malk were sent to rescue the prisoner Qin from the prison ship, utilizing the Razor Crest, the starship of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin.

The New Republic Correctional Corps (or NRCC for short) was a branch of the New Republic used to deal with prisoners of the New Republic. The New Republic soldier Lieutenant Lant Davan was a member of the organization, which owned New Republic Correctional Transports.
The Querm Rybet, or simply Querm, were one of the many subspecies of Rybet, a sentient amphibian species. Querm Rybet hailed from the planet Quermia.
The knobby white ice spider, also known as the Maldo Kreis ice spider, was a species of spider that lived in ice caves on the planet Maldo Kreis.

A mission to the estuary moon of Trask occurred after the mission to Tatooine, in which Din Djarin was tasked by Peli Motto with delivering "Frog Lady" to her husband on the moon in exchange for the location of a group of Mandalorians.

Spark-roaches were a species that lived in a pit in Vader's castle. When the personal servant of Darth Vader, Vaneé, was imprisoned in the pit by his master, Vaneé relied on spark-roaches as his only companions and sustenance.

t: Gladean Gardens Botanical Park of Chandrila
x: The Gladean Gardens Botanical Park of Chandrila was a park located in the Chandrilan city of Emita. It was one of the Gladean State Parks.

Imperial commandos were Imperial Special Forces soldiers that served the Galactic Empire. Former Imperial officer-turned-Rebel Alliance general Crix Madine led a unit of Imperial commandos before defecting.

The Dac Peace Conference was a meeting between representatives of the Quarren and Mon Calamari peoples. The two groups' long rivalry had become inflamed shortly after the Galactic Empire was driven off of Mon Cala.
1933 was a B1-series battle droid who served in the Droid Army of the Trade Federation during their invasion of the planet Naboo.

The needles were a formation of tall, relatively fragile rock spires on the planet Shuraden. During the High Republic Era, Jedi Master Sskeer brought his Padawan Keeve Trennis to the needles for her Jedi Trials, challenging her with locating a Tythonian pendant he had hidden a…

X0-R3 was a kitchen droid that served the Rebel Alliance at Echo Base on the planet Hoth under Lieutenant Harlize Dana. The droid worked alongside Chase Wilsorr during one shift, dicing peeled tubers.

R5-G8, nicknamed Arfive, was the astromech droid of Rebel Alliance pilot Wedge Antilles. R5-G8 had developed numerous personality quirks, including communicating in a way that Antilles described as "screeching" and the insistence to cite regulations.

S-5V3 was a protocol droid that served the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The droid had blue plating with a gold Alliance starbird adorned on its torso. After the Rebel Alliance fleet split following the Battle of Hoth, S-5V3 was aboard the flagship Home One.

The Enigma was a starship in the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. After receiving prime marks at the Imperial Naval Academy on the planet Carida, the Ilohian Tian Karmiya gave fine service aboard the Enigma.

During the Imperial Era, the Victory at Batonn was a starship that served the Imperial Navy. After she received prime marks at the planet Carida's Imperial Naval Academy, the Ilohian Tian Karmiya finely served on the Enigma—another starship—and the Victory at Batonn.

The Majestic was a starship that served the Galactic Empire during the government's reign. The vessel was commanded by Captain Canonhaus, who strived to learn about the rest of the crew from their files, as taught by Captain Tabor Seitaron at Carida Academy.

The Swoop was a Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier that served the Galactic Empire during government's reign. Lieutenant Canonhaus served aboard the carrier as liaison to the stormtroopers, who called him Footoo. The troopers liked the lieutenant but did not trust him.
Korbatal was a moon of the planet Trymant IV, a world in the Outer Rim and Western Reaches regions of the galaxy.

Suba Tren was a terrestrial astronomical object inhabited by members of the Frizznoth species. A number of Frizznoths were killed in a massacre caused by Vap Tomulus. As a result of the massacre, Frizznoth crime lord Mozeen Parapa hunted down and killed Tomulus.
The Rinetta dining room was a dining salon located on the Tibanna mining colony of Cloud City. It shared its name with the Hynestian princess Rinetta Gan.

t: Destruction of Asher III Rebel cell
x: Shortly before the Battle of Hoth, the Galactic Empire carried out an almost-total destruction of a Rebel Alliance cell operating on the astronomical object Asher III.

Howlrunners were massive, skull-faced canids found in the deserts of Kamar. They were known to prey on humans if given the chance. The TIE pilot Howl of the Galactic Empire's Theta Squadron chose their nickname after learning about howlrunners via a holo.

Erub II was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Erub system of the Inner Rim Territories where, by 3 ABY, the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk had found the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca trawling the sewage seas in search of spare parts.

Gandolo IV was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Gandolo system in the Lahara sector of the Outer Rim Territories. By 3 ABY, the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca had attempted to build a secret Wookiee colony on Gandolo IV.

The Bitemark was a starship that was purchased by the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk by 3 ABY. Shortly after the purchase, the ship was destroyed during an explosive firefight on the Jurzan spaceport between the bounty hunter and the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca.
The Doshian jellyfish was a type of jellyfish from the planet Trandosha. The claws of the sentient Trandoshan species could cut and flay wroshyr wood as easily as a they could a Doshian jellyfish.

The Rooted Moon was one of two inhabited moons of the planet Hetzal Prime, located in the Hetzal system of the Outer Rim Territories. Along with the Fruited Moon, the Rooted Moon focused on agricultural production.

The Fruited Moon was a moon that orbited the planet Hetzal Prime, within the Outer Rim Territories' Hetzal system. Along with Hetzal Prime's other inhabited moon, the Rooted Moon, the Fruited Moon had a focus on agricultural production.
The Kor Vella mesa was a mesa on the planet Corellia. The mesa was located at the center of the Vella plains and the city of Kor Vella was built atop the mesa.
Corvus was a forest planet in the Outer Rim Territories that was home to the fortified city of Calodan.

A clan of Nikto was in servitude to the Hutt Cartel for twelve generations by the time of the Hutts' Conquest of Makeb in 3638 BBY. Members of the clan who served as Khobisho the Hutt's bodyguards were known to keep formidable pets, including exoboar attack hounds.
The Discovery of Korriban was the arrival of the Dark Jedi Exiles on the Sith species's homeworld of Korriban, eventually leading to the creation of the Sith Empire.
Mamacores were a species of non-sentient carnivorous creatures from the water moon of Trask.

Calodan was the walled capital city of the forest planet Corvus. After the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin helped Bo-Katan Kryze seize weapons from an Imperial cruiser, Kryze told him that the former Jedi Ahsoka Tano could be found in the city.

A creature with tentacles was found on the moon Trask. In 9 ABY, a member of this species was found inside the Razor Crest after it was repaired by a local dock worker. Inside the Razor Crest, the creature descended upon Grogu until it was crushed by Din Djarin.
The Third Horizon was an Emissary-class Republic Cruiser of the Galactic Republic.

Ab Dalis was a swampy wasteland world situated in the Ab Dalis system of the Outer Rim Territories, along the Corellian Run. It was home to numerous corporations led by oligarchs and trillionaires and had a corrupt and ineffective government that catered to them.
Aguirre City was the capital city of the planet Hetzal Prime. Zeffren Ecka, the minister of the Hetzal system, resided in the Ministerial Residence within the city.
Sunspot was an astronomical object in the galaxy. During the Galactic Civil War, Sunspot was the location of the Rebel Alliance's space-bound maximum security penitentiary known as Sunspot Prison.
CB-6B was an orange-and-silver–plated BB-series astromech droid with a black sensor. The droid, like all of its model, was manufactured by Industrial Automaton and stood 0.67 meters tall.
During the High Republic Era, a conclave between the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic was held at the newly-constructed space station Starlight Beacon.
A species of squid was found on the estuary moon of Trask. The species was frequently used to make Trask Chowder In 9 ABY, Grogu was served a bowl of chowder containing a live specimen.

x: The Assault on the Imperial Gozanti freighter was a Mandalorian resistance operation in 9 ABY. Four Mandalorians led by Bo-Katan Kryze went on a mission to steal weapons from an Imperial Gozanti-class Assault Carrier which flew for a remnant of the Galactic Empire led by Moff …

t: Attack on an asteroid mining station
x: An attack took place on a pirate base by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The proximity of the base to the Alliance Fleet's rendezvous point following the evacuation of Hoth threatened their safety.
Kamar was a desert astronomical object that was home to a sentient insectoid species. It was located in the Kamar system in Wild Space, in grid square S-3 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Aurora IX was a Galactic Republic Longbeam cruiser, a brand-new design from the Republic shipyards on Hosnian Prime during the High Republic Era.

The "Nova" was the nickname Jedi Padawan Bell Zettifar gave to the Jedi Vector typically flown by him and his Master, Loden Greatstorm. It was distinguishable from other Vectors by carbon scoring acquired when Greatstorm and Zettifar had flown it through an ion storm.
The astronomical object Kamar was home to an insectoid sentient species that were once encountered by Amara Kel.
Perimako Major was a world where the Alliance to Restore the Republic fought against the Galactic Empire between 2 BBY and 3 ABY.

Distilon was a world that was the site of a battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire between 2 BBY and 3 ABY. Rebel pilots Wedge Antilles and Derek Klivian, who had previously defected from the Empire, participated in the fighting at Distilon.

A world was ruled by the family of the human known as "the Contessa." Her family had ruled the world from a palace for several centuries, and the Contessa believed that they had been benevolent rulers.
A Surakkean peacock was a type of peacock originating from the Surakkea system in the Mid Rim Territories. In 3 ABY, when the Lepi businessman Jaxxon T.

R3-L1 was an R3-series astromech droid that had blue and green plating and a transparent dome. It served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Hammerfish were a type of fish from the Mid Rim planet Glee Anselm. At some point, the Nautolan Finial Bright hunted the fish while on Glee Anselm, and later reflected that they visually resembled the shape and aesthetics of a Longbeam cruiser.
The Scargon region was a region of the world of Kalist VI. Dak Ralter hailed from the region.

Koshaga was a Wild Space planet that was home to the Koshagan people. Many Koshagans were part of the Koshagan People's Movement, an armed rebellion that fought against Koshaga's tyrannical ruling class.

The Koshagan People's Movement was an organization on Koshaga that fought against the tyranny of the planet's ruling class. Emon Kref's father served as a general in the organization, which was destroyed by the Galactic Empire prior to the Battle of Hoth.
COO-2310 was one of the supposedly rogue droids that attacked Constable Zuvio during his investigation of a banking ship robbery in Niima Outpost.
During the Clone Wars, a conflict fought between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, the planet Quermia was extensively blockaded by the Separatists.
TL-30 was a medical droid of the Sith Empire who tended to Darth Malgus's injuries following the battle on Corellia in 3627 BBY.
A Gozanti-class Assault Carrier was used by Gideon's Imperial remnant several years after the Battle of Endor.
The Sa Nalaor was a Munificent-class star frigate that served within the Separatist Alliance's naval forces during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.

The Nevoota Bee was an Acclamator-class assault ship of the Republic Navy that participated in the Battle of Muunilinst in 22 BBY during the Clone Wars, where it operated as a fleet carrier, transporting 156 V-19 Torrent starfighters into battle.
M4-Y9 was a astromech droid active around 3627 BBY.
Rombuk were non-sentient creatures in the galaxy used as mounts around 3627 BBY.
The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally was a swoop racing event organized around 3626 BBY. It occurred on several planets, including Dantooine, Tatooine and Onderon.
a: The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally

x: The Polis Massa Asteroid Field, often simply known as Polis Massa, was a collection of asteroids formed from the remnants of the destroyed planet of Polis Massa. The Polis Massans maintained several facilities in the asteroid field.
The Pit Screamers, also known as Screamers, was a swoop gang that participated in the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally around 3626 BBY.
The Blatant Beks were a swoop gang participating in the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally around 3626 BBY.
Horizon's Razor, also known as Razors, was a swoop gang participating in the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally around 3626 BBY.
The Star Hopper was a cruiser used by the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era, where it served as a Padawan Academic Cruiser led by Grand Master Yoda and Jedi Master Torban Buck.
Bralanak City was a city situated on Trymant IV, surrounded by an ocean. It was the most populated area on the planet.
Bantam Dxun Reapers were non-sentient creatures of Dxun used as mounts around 3626 BBY.

R00-8Y, nicknamed Ruby, was a modified DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid owned by Mubo, the proprietor of the Droid Depot in the town of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. Mubo programmed R00-8Y to act as his personal assistant, and the probe droid became his constant companion.
The Koom was a clan of Wookiees. At least one member of the clan was present onboard the Liswarr when Bossk attacked the gunship.
The Gkrur clan was a clan of Wookiees. At least one member of the clan was present onboard the Liswarr when Bossk attacked the gunship.
The Chyakk was a clan of Wookiees. At least one member of the clan was present onboard the Liswarr when Bossk attacked the gunship.

Alun was a planet located in the Mid Rim of the galaxy. Because no useful hyperspace routes connected it to other systems, Alun was relatively isolated, and escaped Imperial rule. The planet was ruled by a royal family.
The Mythrol's speeder was a standard Nevarro speeder used by a Mythrol and was destroyed during a mission to destroy an Imperial base on the planet Nevarro.
CB-3DU was a protocol droid who served as a teacher on the planet Nevarro following its liberation from the forces of the Imperial remnant led by Moff Gideon.

x: In 9 ABY, an attack on an Imperial base was led by Magistrate Greef Karga, who hired the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and Alderaanian mercenary Carasynthia Dune, and also a Mythrol to infiltrate the installation and destroyed it, stealing a Trexler 906 Armored Marauder…

SD-7, nicknamed "Essdee", was a Galactic Republic scout droid with masculine programming who existed during the High Republic Era. He was stored onboard a maintenance shuttle docked aboard the cruiser Steady Wing as part of the onboard tool kit.

B4-N9 served as the announcer of the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally. Built and programmed by swoop riders and enthusiasts for his characteristic volume and energy, the droid operated as the live commentator of the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally.

Thurrb were non-sentient creatures in the galaxy used as mounts around 3626 BBY. They were known to be helpful as beasts of burden. While generally friendly and docile, they had a tendency to slobber all over unsuspecting individuals who got too close to their large mouths.

The CorSec vs. Flail Battle took place on Talus during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, the terrorist organization known as the Flail was active on the planet Talus, in the Corellian system.
Habassa II was an astronomical object in the Habassa system in the Herdessa sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square Q-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Gideon's light cruiser was a Class 546 model of the Arquitens-class command cruiser under the command of Moff Gideon in the years after the Battle of Endor.
The Imperial Senate Guard was an elite unit of guards formed from the elements of the Senate Guard of the Old Republic that were loyal to Sheev Palpatine and the New Order.
Crunchbugs were a species of purple-shelled insect. They were edible by certain species.

Mearalis II was a planet located in the Mearalis system in the Bri'ahl sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet boasted a number of mountain ranges and was the source of varpeline crystals, which could be used as lightsaber crystals.
The Sif were a band of mercenaries assembled by Erran Sif during the Galactic Civil War.

IG-88C was an IG-88 assassin droid who worked as a bounty hunter. IG-88C was one of five identical IG-series assassin droids manufactured by Holowan Laboratories. Upon their activation, the droids slaughtered their constructors and escaped their laboratories into the galaxy.
Skid Lake was a lake formed on the world of Innton II that was created by the crash of the Nova Defiant. Toxins leached out of the ship, poisoning the lake.

result: Jai Maruk defeated and captured by Asajj Ventress
x: During the Clone Wars, there was a duel on Vjun between Jedi Master Jai Maruk and Dark Jedi Asajj Ventress, which the latter won. Ventress took Maruk as prisoner and delivered him to Count Dooku.

Ulterior Vision was a security and investigation service led by Elora Silssusio before she joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The group did illegal work for senators until it was exposed by the Imperial Security Bureau.
A resistance group operated in the Outer Rim Territories during the Galactic Civil War. Elora Silssusio was a member of the group, which eventually merged with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Imperial expansion was an expansion effort carried out by the Galactic Empire at some point during its reign across the galaxy. During this effort, the Empire erected a military base on the volcanic Outer Rim planet of Nevarro.

8t88 was a silver-plated, humanoid-shaped mercenary droid with red, blue, and white sensors. Residing on the moon Nar Shaddaa, the droid was willing to negotiate changing loyalties—at some point, 8t88 double-crossed a human and threatened them with a DL-44 heavy blaster pistol.

objective: Damage the SoroSuub Corporation's operations in G'rinn Go city
x: Operation Thunderbolt was an operation undertaken by the Sullustan Resistance under Gaff Kilvaari during the Galactic Civil War. The goal of the mission was to disrupt the Imperial aligned–SoroSuub Corporation's operations in G'rinn Go city.
AgriSuub was a subsidiary of the SoroSuub Corporation that produced crops that would later be used to colonize new planets. AgriSuub operated a research facility in G'rinn Go city on Sullust.
A port was used by Moff Gideon's faction of the Imperial Remnant to trade with the black market of Trask via transporting cargo with an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser.

headquarters: G'rinn Go city corporate security HQ
x: The SoroSuub Corporation maintained a security force. The force was used to defend SoroSuub facilities in G'rinn Go city during the Galactic Civil War.
SoroSuub corporate intelligence was a branch of the SoroSuub Corporation. Members of the organization were dispatched to G'rinn Go city after Operation Thunderbolt.
An industrial district was located on the outskirts of G'rinn Go city. It contained an uplink station that was targeted by Operation Thunderbolt.

A battle occurred on the planet Ithor during the time of the Old Republic. The Jedi Master Oorrl Morm fought against a vicious band of pirates and sacrificed his own life to create enough time for a Republic Navy warship to arrive and arrest the pirates.
The Acquisitor was the personal starship of Domina Tagge of the powerful House of Tagge and headquarters of the Tagge Corporation.
Philaxia was a planet in the Philaxia system in the Har Worlds sector of the Expansion Region. It was discovered by the Galactic Republic. The phase-knife was invented there.
The Kwilaan Starport was a spaceport in the city of Keren on the Mid Rim planet of Naboo. It was the largest facility of its kind in the Mid Rim and was used by many travelers.
The Comark Orchards were an orchard owned by the Comark family in the city of Nayli. The orchards produced jaquiria and muja fruit.
The Mad Monks of Xo were an organization which was "silenced" by the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk sometime during or before 3 ABY.

A skirmish was fought by Alliance to Restore the Republic attempting to escape an Imperial Star Destroyer. Elora Silssusio sustained serious injuries in the skirmish, causing her to be taken to Polis Massa for treatment.

Gortus 4 was a terrestrial moon located in the Kanz sector's Gortus system, within the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Situated at the coordinates N-4 on the Standard Galactic Grid, it was home to a colony by the time of the Galactic Empire.

The Construction Division was a division of the House of Tagge's Tagge Corporation. In 3 ABY, the colony on the moon Gortus 4 signed over the rights to the moon to Lady Domina Tagge—the leader of Tagge Corporation.
The D'Armin Syndicate was an organization that operated during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, the syndicate attacked a supply ship of the Tagge Corporation.
Scout guards were militia soldiers marshalled by Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth as the majority of her gathered forces.
The Scar was the name for the five kilometer-long path on Innton II created by the crash of the Nova Defiant near the end of the Clone Wars.
The Dead Rivers was the name given to the two rivers on the planet Innton II that were cut off by the crash of the Nova Defiant.
Morgan Elsbeth's forces were the collection of starship and ground forces led by the industrialist Lady Morgan Elsbeth.
a: Shin Hati and Marrok's starfighter fleet

x: Forest walkers were gentle, nocturnal quadrupeds native to the forest world of Corvus. They could be observed feeding on the upper branches of trees, which they were easily able to reach due to their long legs.
The Corrupter was a Victory-class Star Destroyer that, during the Imperial Era, belonged to the Imperial Navy. It was equipped with sublight engines and turbolasers.

x: In 9 ABY, during the New Republic Era, the city of Calodan located on the forest planet of Corvus was liberated from Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth and her army of guards by the former Jedi Ahsoka Tano during her search for Ezra Bridger and Chiss Grand Admiral Thrawn with the help …
The Nightmare Ruins were a group of ruins on the planet Dathomir.
The Brother's Bastion was a location on the planet Dathomir.

The Cliffside Fortress was a fortress on the Strangled Cliffs on the planet Dathomir. It was used by the Nightbrothers and was situated close to their village. It was located near the Swamp of Sacrifice and utilized as a protective outpost.
The Collapsed Settlement was a collapsed settlement on the planet Dathomir.

The Halls of the Nydak were a set of halls and small natural rooms on the planet Dathomir. It was home to mainly nydaks, but bane back spiders also roamed the location. Walls in the halls were decorated by Dathomirian Glyphs.
The Nightbrother Dungeon was a dungeon constructed and used by the Nightbrothers on the planet Dathomir.

The Strangled Cliffs were a cluster of highly-elevated cliffs on the Outer Rim Territories planet Dathomir. The cliffs were home to a wide range of terrain which were home to bane back spiders, nydaks as well as their Nydak Alpha cousins, and the chirodactyl bats.

The Swamp of Sacrifice was a swamp on the planet Dathomir inhabited by nydaks and bane back spiders. It was decorated by various species of flora including: Bleeding Guts, various fungi, Hydraatis, and Mushlings. The swamp was the residence of a ruined nightbrother arena.

The Witches Horn was a peak of the Strangled Cliffs on the planet Dathomir. A face was carved into the cliff, something that was common in structures built by the Nightsister clan of Dathomirian witches.

The Treacherous Approach was a location on the planet Dathomir. When attempting to adventure to the Tomb of Kujet in 14 BBY, Padawan Cal Kestis failed to avoid a boulder that was thrown down on him by a Nightbrother.
The Upper Strangled Cliffs was the uppermost section of a group of cliffs on the planet Dathomir, directly above the Strangled Cliffs. The hydraatis plant grew in the area.

A Nightbrother village was the residence of Viscus' clan of the Dathomirian Zabrak warrior group, the Nightbrothers, on the planet Dathomir. Built into the side of the Upper Strangled Cliffs, the village was also home to the Nightbrothers' domesticated bane back spiders.
The Speakers were a subgroup of the Polis Massan species. Unlike the other members of their species, the Speakers were able to vocalize speech.
The Neo-Tayans were a progressive faction of the Tayan League that took control of the party approximately 1,500 years before the Battle of Yavin and funded the creation of the Great Gran Run.

Kordoku was a mountainous world that housed a Jedi Temple. Covered in snow and trees, and with a cloud-filled atmosphere that contained waves of pink-green lights, the world appeared white and blue when viewed from space.
The Xucphra Corporation controlled a district in the Thyferran city of Zalxuc City.
The Zaltin Corporation controlled a district in the Thyferran city of Zalxuc City.
The contested gangland was an area of Mek-Sha dominated and fought over by gangsters around 3627 BBY.
The Bazaar was a marketplace in Three Points, an area within the space station Mek-Sha in 3627 BBY.
The Grand Master of the Jedi Order, Yoda, who was part of a rarely seen species, kept his homeworld a secret.
The Zalxuc City business district was a district in Zalxuc City on Thyferra. It contained the cantina Morbo's Place.

The Dauntless was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer that was in service of the Galactic Empire. It was commanded by Moff Raythe, and carried experimental satellites crucial to Operation: Cinder following the Battle of Endor.
The Talusian Smugglers were a band of smugglers that operated on Talus during the Galactic Civil War.

An island was located on the planet New Alderaan. It contained an Alliance to Restore the Republic prison codenamed "Cantham Cellar" and was located on the opposite side of the planet from New Aldera.

A bouf rat was a type of rodent that was preyed upon by a lyxine. While waiting to inform the Sith Lord Darth Vader that the crew of the Executor-class Star Dreadnought and flagship of the elite Imperial fleet Death Squadron, the Executor, had located the YT-1300 light freight…
A cave located on the planet Talus was inhabited by the Selonians of the Neetha Den during the Galactic Civil War.

The Kotabi were a humanoid sentient species in the galaxy. Jedi bond-twins Terec and Ceret were members of the species and originated from the planet Sagamore The planet Kotab was also a homeworld of the twins.
Kotab was a planet located in the Kotab system of the Inner Rim Territories and the Slice. It was situated in grid square N-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Night Brokers was a swoop gang around 3626 BBY. By the time of the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally, the swoop gang Horizon's Razor had become indebted to the Night Brokers.

Operation Clean Sweep was an operation undertaken by Alliance to Restore the Republic forces to eliminate three Imperial Intelligence agents in Geharr, the capital of Ord Gimmel. The operation was masterminded by Bleshk Callor.
The tactical theater was a room aboard the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser Independence. It contained tiered seating around a holo-emitter and was used for discussing large operations.

The Beast of Burden was a Hardcell-class interstellar transport used by the CIS Navy of the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars. At one point, the Beast of Burden traveled near a Separatist Munificent-class star frigate.

The Foreman's Labor was a Hardcell-class interstellar transport used by the CIS Navy of the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars. Foreman's Labor was considered legendary for its ability to hold out under the heaviest of enemy firepower.
Port District was an area located on the upper concourse of Cloud City.
Armor Unit 14 was a heavy battle droid of Vulture Squad, an armored military unit of the Sith Empire present in the Battle of the Meridian Complex in 3627 BBY.

The northern cave was a cavern on Onderon near the city Iziz. During the new galactic conflict between Sith Empire and Galactic Republic, the cave was secretly used by Imperial emissaries to make dealings with the Untamed.
Xahn's Crossing was the confluence of several rivers, including the Krisa River, located on the planet of Talus. It was used as a racetrack for the Nashal River Race.

The Narrows was a narrow portion of the Krisa River valley, located on the planet of Talus. The Narrows separated the city of Nashal from the rest of the valley. It was used as a racetrack for the Nashal River Race.
The Overlook was a portion of the Aximia River valley, located on the planet Talus. It was used as a racetrack for the Nashal River Race.
The TH Causeway was a narrow strip of land between the Jeassa River and another river, located on the planet Talus. It was used as a racetrack for the Nashal River Race.
The Deep Run was the confluence of several rivers, including the Aximia River and the Krisa River, located on the planet of Talus. It was used as a racetrack for the Nashal River Race.
The Virrago Bend was a curved portion of the Krisa River located on the planet Talus. It was used as a racetrack for the Nashal River Race.

The Fed-Dub Stretch was a canyon of the Krisa River valley, located on the planet Talus. Named after the Fed-Dub, it directly led to the city of Nashal. The Fed-Dub Stretch was used as a racetrack for the Nashal River Race.
The Kima Way was a portion of the Aximia River valley, located on the planet Talus. It was used as a racetrack for the Nashal River Race.
The Snaykinn Pass was a canyon located on the planet of Talus. It was used as a racetrack for the Nashal River Race, allowing pilot to reach the Jeassa River form the Krisa River.
Kyuu's Twist was a curved portion of the Jeassa River, located on the planet Talus. It was used as a racetrack for the Nashal River Race.

The Quid Embankment was a bank of the Krisa River, located on the planet of Talus. It was used as a racetrack for the Nashal River Race, allowing pilots to land on the ground after running up the river.
Garva's Turn was a curved portion of the Krisa River located on the planet Talus. It was used as a racetrack for the Nashal River Race.

The southern cave was a cavern on Onderon near the city Iziz. During the new galactic conflict between Sith Empire and Galactic Republic, the cave was secretly used by Imperial emissaries to make dealings with the Untamed.

The central cave was a cavern on Onderon near the city Iziz. During the new galactic conflict between Sith Empire and Galactic Republic, the cave was secretly used by Imperial emissaries to make dealings with the Untamed.

The Socorro Sunset Grand Prix was a race that Keo Venzee took part in sometime by 4 ABY. During a race Keo pulled a move that caused Relkin to lose the race and the chance to be admitted in the Imperial Starfighter Corps.
The Scorch was an area of sunbaked plains on the planet Trandosha.
The Oasis was a lake side region within the wilderness of the planet Onderon.
The Karthon Chop Fields was a scrap yard used as a correction facility by the New Republic. Materials from the yard were used to construct the second Death Star, prior to its destruction in 4 ABY.

x: The Battle of Tython, also known as assault on Tython, was a skirmish that took place on the planet Tython between a faction of the Imperial Remnant led by Moff Gideon, and the Mandalorian Din Djarin and his allies, the bounty hunter Boba Fett and elite mercenary Fennec Shand,…

Airlock 8 was a location at the edge of Fortress Inquisitorius' defense perimeter. A spaceous chamber, the airlock contained a body of water upon which laid a balcony housing consoles, by which were stationed stormtroopers.

Garen IV was a terrestrial prison world in the Garen system in the Thuldin's Grant sector of the Expansion Region, in grid square J-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid, that operated during the Imperial and New Republic Eras.
Acablas was a structure located on the planet Auratera. It contained a strong vergence in the Force.
New Venture Plaza was an area of the lower Office Atrium within the Ternion Building on the planet Nar Shaddaa.
In 3626 BBY, the swoop gang Night Brokers owned a garage in the New Venture Plaza, within the Office Atrium on the moon Nar Shaddaa.
The Lake Encampments was a Mandalorian camp outside the city of Iziz on the planet Onderon in 3627 BBY. The camp was controlled by the rogue Mandalorian group Ash'ad.
The Proving Grounds was an old ritual site on the planet Onderon to revere battle.
The iguana was a species of reptile that was found on the moon Endor. The Ewok Chirpa had a pet iguana.
An uprising of enslaved miners on the planet Mygeeto was incited by Alliance to Restore the Republic agents. The uprising lead to a major Imperial counterattack that crushed the uprising.

A breed of coral was found exclusively on the planet Dac. The coral was particularly dense and was therefore used to create coral pikes, a traditional Mon Calamari melee weapon that shared some similarity with Force pikes.
Last Chance Pier was an area of the Red Zone within the space station Mek-Sha in 3627 BBY.
Slugfall Cantina was a cantina at Slugfall Harbor, within the space station Mek-Sha in 3627 BBY.
Harido Wald territory was an area controlled by the smugglers Harido Wald, within the space station Mek-Sha in 3627 BBY.
Three Points was a large area within the space station Mek-Sha in 3627 BBY.
Ash-beetles were a type of beetle native to the planetoid Sídi.
The Chyakk clan was a group based in the region known as Bentora Space.

Arbooine was an Outer Rim Territories celestial body located in the Arboo sector. It was home to the venomous arboreal forest predator known as the bearsloth, which posed a danger to any visitors to Arbooine.
The bulbous was a creature that was used as a dejarik holomonster. They were native to the planet Dorin and could project toxic gasses to kill enemies.

The museum guard were a group of security guards of the Galactic Empire who served during the Galactic Civil War and were tasked with protecting the Imperial Museum. The guards wore armor reminiscent of the Galactic Republic's Senate Guard, and utilized vibro-pikes.

Elessia was an astronomical object in the Mid Rim Territories. After the fleet of the Rebel Alliance scattered following the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, Commander Ellian Zahra of the Galactic Empire attacked the Seventh Division at Elessia.
The Trawaki were a small cave-dwelling sentient species native to the world Rushan IX that spoke the Trawak language. The species evolved on its world independently of all other life.

Rushan IX was a terrestrial world that was home to numerous forms of life, including the Trawaki species. It was located in the Rushan system in the Andirma sector of the Expansion Region. The Trawaki evolved independently of the other life on the world, dwelling in caves.

The Mandalorian Trat'ade was a coalition of Mandalorian clans that emerged in the aftermath of the Eternal Empire's conquest of the galaxy.

Some time before 3626 BBY, Kira Carsen stole a ship to carry Jedi Master Satele Shan and her students when they were infected by Tenebrae's curse. Though Carsen initially wanted to acquire a corvette, Scourge valued the space provided by the carrier's many decks.

The Hidden Chain was an organization created by Heta Kol around 3626 BBY. It was founded on an unswerving belief that Mandalorians should use their skills in war to further their own agenda, rather than acting as mercenaries for hire.
Elite Squad Troopers, or ES troopers, were special forces troopers who served the early Galactic Empire prior to the termination of cloning production on Kamino.
Morak was a jungle planet located in Wild Space on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories inhabited by humans as well as members of the Shydopp species.
N5-Z2T was an N5 sentry droid who operated for the New Republic at the Karthon Chop Fields, a scrapyard where prisoners of the New Republic were sentenced to serve.
The Petrified Mounds of the Killiks was a location on the planet Alderaan.
The capital of Colstev was located on the planet Colstev.

Juggernaut Pilots, also known as tank troopers, Transport Troopers, or as Imperial Juggernaut Drivers, were a class of Imperial combat driver officers of the Galactic Empire that operated various Imperial ground assault vehicles like troop transports to HCVw A9.2 juggernaut tr…
A village was located on the planet Morak. Migs Mayfeld and Din Djarin passed through the village while driving Juggernaut Five.
The destruction of Burnin Konn took place three months after the Battle of Endor, when Operation: Cinder was carried out on the world of Burnin Konn was by the Galactic Empire.

The Morak Imperial remnants were a grouping of Imperial holdouts active on the planet Morak by 9 ABY. They operated a secret refinery dedicated to the refinement of rhydonium, a valuable but volatile fuel source used in starships.

Shydopps were a sentient species from the planet Morak. After the fall of the Empire, Shydopp pirates attacked shipments of rhydonium being delivered to an Imperial remnant, as well as Din Djarin and Migs Mayfeld, who were disguised as members of the remnant.

The Ariwook were a sentient mammalian species of brown, hairy humanoids with black eyes. Around 0 BBY, a member of the species, Rff Huff, visited Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina, located on the planet Tatooine, and engaged in a shootout with the Ganimed bounty hunter Purong.
A species of sentient humanoid with yellow-and-blue skin and a pair of protruding tusks existed in the galaxy by the time of the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Qotile was a desolate astronomical object ruled by a masked monarch that was located in the Qotile system in the Colundra sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square S-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Telosians were the inhabitants of the Outer Rim world of Telos IV.
The second orbital belt in the Roche system was located near the center of the star system and contained the Verpine colony of Korpil.

Sluis Sector Command was an organization affiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic that operated within the Sluis sector. The Command established supply runs to the Defiant Core base on Innton II.
A medical droid was used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic forces at the Defiant Core base on Innton II. By the time the base was established, the droid was old.

Chandrilan Adventure Travel was a corporation that operated on the planet Chandrila. It provided guides for visitors to Crystal Canyons.
The Chandrilan Park Ranger Service was an organization that was responsible for policing the Gladean State Parks on Chandrila.
An Imperial administration center was located on a planet during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It was attacked by Rebels in 0 ABY.
An Imperial communications hub was located on Sunfall Peak during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It was raided by Rebels in 0 ABY.

The Shydopp pirates, also known as the Dopp-fuil clan, was a pirate group comprising of Shydopps armed with spears and thermal detonators and riding skiffs. The pirates operated on the planet Morak during the New Republic's era and targeted an remnant forces rhydonium shipments.

Owls were non-sentient avian creatures. Types of owls included convorees and snow owls, which could be found on the Core Worlds planet Alderaan in the snowy area surrounding the mountain Appenza Peak. The helmet of the Mandalorian Bo-Katan Kryze incorporated the face of an owl.
Several creatures of a quadruped species were present at Tuanul on the desert planet Jakku, shortly before the First Order sacked the village.

Vintians were a sentient species from Vint that had an appearance similar to that of a regular rock. Geode was the nickname of a Vintian who served as the navigator of the transport Vessel during the High Republic Era.

Vint was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories that was home to Vintians, a species that resembled rocks. One Vintian from Vint, nicknamed Geode, became the navigator aboard the transport starship Vessel.

The Fortune's Folly was a pleasure barge owned by the Mandalorian Bask Sunn, a Dar'manda lieutenant and recruitment officer. In 3626 BBY, the starship participated in the assault on the Spirit of Vengeance II.

The Directorate was an organization active during the High Republic Era. Lord Isamer was one of its leaders. Working for the Hutts, the Directorate caused a crisis between the planets Eiram and E'ronoh after kidnapping royals from both worlds.

The Seeker's Vigil was a starship owned by the Mandalorian Ash'ad, serving as a fortified vault and monument to Mandalorian culture. In 3626 BBY, the Seeker's Vigil participated in the assault on the Spirit of Vengeance II.
The Champion's Glory was a warship of the Mandalorian Clan Varad. In 3626 BBY, the starship participated in the assault on the Spirit of Vengeance II.
Eiram was a terrestrial planet located in the Eiram system, alongside its twin planet E'ronoh. It had a vast array of oceans, with a society based on their vast seas.

E'ronoh was a planet in the Eiram system that was the twin world of Eiram. E'ronoh was a dusty and rocky desert world. The world once had rivers, but they dried away, leaving marks of where they once flowed.

Eirie, known as the Timekeeper Moon and the lost moon, was a moon between the twin planets Eiram and E'ronoh, in the Eiram system of the Dalnan sector in the Outer Rim Territories.

Kennerla was a planet where Affie Hollow had traveled during the High Republic Era while serving aboard a starship, at some point before she became the co-pilot of the transport Vessel for the Byne Guild.

The followers of Jedi Master Satele Shan were Jedi students who accompanied her after the end of the war against Zakuul. By 3629 BBY, Shan was said to operate a secret Jedi academy for her students on Coruscant.

A zeftgeist was a creature that ate grain. In 232 BBY, the Dalnan Honesty Weft expressed his frustration about having to accompany a Dalnan delegation to the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon so the Outer Rim planet Dalna could join the Republic.

The Zeitooine mission was a Jedi mission to the Inner Rim planet Zeitooine during the High Republic Era. Jedi Knight Dez Rydan participated in the mission, but eventually the strain led him to privately fear he was in danger of giving in to his anger.

A species of flying beast was found on the Inner Rim planet Onderon. The early settlers of the planet were besieged by the beasts, which eventually caused them to build thick, high walls and deep, wide moats around their cities to key out the beasts.
Fi'Lin were creatures of the galaxy that inhabited wetlands.
Valley of the Machine Gods was the home of the sleeping deities of Iokath.

Hangar 12 was a hangar in the First Order flagship Steadfast. In 35 ABY, during the Mission to Kijimi, Resistance members Finn, Rey and Poe Dameron landed the Bestoon Legacy in the hangar, using a First Order Captain's Medallion to get clearance.
A staging area for Pirin City's mines was located about ten minutes from the city. Speeder trucks owned by the SoroSuub Corporation carried miners to and from the staging area.
The Gran constabulary was a law enforcement agency that operated on the planet Kinyen. The Capra Spaceport was initially managed by the constabulary, though the Galactic Empire eventuallly took over.
The Senol Forest was a forest located on the planet Innton II. The Great Cavern, which contained the Defiant Core base, was located in the forest.
The Icefall Plains were a location on the remote ice planet of Hoth.

A species of small, brown furred creatures were native to the Forest Moon Endor. After her parents were rescued from the Gorax, Cindel Towani held one creature of this species in the Warrick family hut.
Mount Sarrano was a dormant volcano on the planet Sullust. The city of Serres Sarrano was built on the mountain.

Begamor was a planet of the galaxy with an irregular orbit around a binary star. The light of the planet's suns appeared to have a green tint upon the surface. The world was once led by a corrupt president, Jamie Brasson.
Vossport was the capital city of the Wild Space planet Weik.

The Ossus Colonization Initiative was a colonization effort led by Jedi Master Gnost-Dural to seek refuge in the Jedi Order's ancient homeworld Ossus, isolated from the galactic community.
The Begamor two-headed dog was a type of dog found on the planet Begamor during the High Republic Era. In 200 BBY, the Jedi Padawan Sean inspected the estate of President Jamie Brasson on Begamor.
An astronomical object was the site of a Separatist holdout after the collapse of the Republic in 19 BBY.
Lafete was an Outer Rim Territories planet that included factories and the Port of Lafete city on its surface.

Ebrahi's loyalists were a group that supported Ebrahi's claim to the throne of the planet Ord Gimmel. Members of the loyalists attempted to assassinate Meilarra, a candidate for the throne supported by the Galactic Empire.

Shuttle 2743 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that was tasked with transporting the Imperial clone engineer Penn Pershing in 9 ABY. After being disabled by Slave I ion cannons, the shuttle was taken over by Din Djarin and Marshal Cara Dune.
The scrimp was a creature that was used as a dejarik holomonster. Almost nothing was known about the creature as most of its origins were lost in time.
Night fishers were flying creatures. They could be found soaring around the salt marshes and muddy estuaries of Corellia, occasionally diving into the water.

Meihanna Island was an island located on the planet Ord Gimmel near the Geharran city continent. The island was a nature preserve and retreat for the planet's royal family. After the disappearance of Queen Nehanna, her son, Ebrahi, lived on the island until he reached adulthood.
The Arena of Death was a type of arena located upon the moon Nar Shaddaa.

A B1-series battle droid served as a captain in the CIS Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars. The battle droid served within the army of General Whorm Loathsom and participated in the Battle of Christophsis.
Coral Depths City was a suburb of Foamwander City on Dac. Most of the city's population, which contained a number of merchants and financial traders, worked in Foamwander.
An island chain on the planet Sanctuary was settled by the planet's original colonists. The islands' residents fished the Sanctuary's oceans and farmed the islands themselves.
The Wideband Temp Agency was a front company for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. It was based in the city of Dearic, on the planet Talus.
The Imperial Office was a building located in the city of Dearic, on the planet Talus, and used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
A continent of the planet Kinyen contained the city of Capra. Saeduree River Shipping was granted exclusive shipping rights for much of the contient by Kinyen's government.

In 3626 BBY, a hideout of the swoop gang Golden Storm was located within the Ten Thousand Grains on the planet Tatooine. It was used to hold their Jawa slaves.
The Golden Storm was a swoop gang based on Tatooine in 3626 BBY. The Golden Storm started abducting Jawas with demolition talents and enslaving them.
The Great Cavern was a massive cave located in the Senol Forest on Innton II. The cave contained the Defiant Core, a base made from a Separatist Recusant-class light destroyer.
The Begamor shrimp was a creature found on Begamor.

A priesthood based on the planet Dac existed some time before the Galactic Civil War. Its members worshipped the god Pakoukou, who was in fact the Knowledge Bank. The priests communed with the Knowledge Bank regularly and advised the Mon Calamari king.
Chambell's militia was a militia active on the planet Ord Gimmel during the Imperial Period. It supported Geit Chambell's claim to the throne of Ord Gimmel.
An 15-person intelligence unit was based in the Defiant Core Rebel base on Innton II.
Mission Planning was a branch of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It used information gathered by Alliance Intelligence to plan operations.
A pilot training course was established by the Polis Massa Rebel Base. The course ran through the Polis Massa asteroid field.

Quarren Town was a city located on the waterworld planet of Mon Cala. It was home to a large population of Quarren and included the Quarren headquarters, which was used as a staging ground for the Separatist during the Battle of Mon Cala.
The Spirit of Jedha was a transport that served the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War during the Galactic Empire. The transport was present at the rebel outpost on the jungle planet Lowik.
49-J12, or Fournine-Jaytwelve, was a droid that worked for the Hutts at the H'unn Cabaret Pit on Nar Kaaga.
A Venator-class Star Destroyer was used as a transport by Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi and participated in the Battle of Teth in 22 BBY. It was commandeered by Admiral Wullf Yularen.
This OOM command battle droid was serving as a commander for the Separatist Droid Army during the Battle of Teth.
An OOM command battle droid was serving as a commander in the Separatist Droid Army during the Battle of Teth.

Gort's Casino was a location on the moon Nar Shaddaa in Hutt Space.
A lightsaber duel occurred on the planet Woteba in the year 35 ABY, at the heights of the Dark Nest Crisis, between the Jedi Knight-in-training Leia Organa Solo and the Twi'lek Jedi Joiner Alema Rar.

The Scrap Pit was an area of the space station Mek-Sha in 3627 BBY. It was used by the slaver group The Brothers to house some of their slaves.

The Battle of Kur, also known as the battle at Kur, was a battle fought between an alliance of the Galactic Republic, the Jedi Order and forces from the planet Eriadu against Nihil pirates at the Kur Nebula in 232 BBY.
The summer capital police was the law enforcement agency of the capital city Xia capital.
The Xia capital was the capital city of the planet Land.
The martial traditionalists were a Mandalorian group of Mandalorian warrior clans who had a degree of power on the planet Mandalore by 40 BBY.
Green Dawn was the capital city of Begamor. Its overall architectural style was based on that of Coruscant.

Starlight Beacon's Jedi temple was a Jedi temple located onboard the Starlight Beacon space station. The largest temple outside of Coruscant, it was intended to serve as a hub for the Jedi Order's activities in the Outer Rim Territories and beyond.
A crime syndicate was led by Jamie Brasson during the High Republic Era.

J-9A was a female-programmed navigator droid assigned as an aid to Harra the Hutt. When the First Order arrived at Vodran and took over Harra the Hutt's stronghold, Harra and the droid retinue were exiled. J-9A led them to the ghost moon Kufs.

A B1 battle droid served in the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. It was stationed on the bridge of a Munificent-class star frigate during the Ambush on Rugosa.
A B1 battle droid served in the droid army of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. They were stationed on Rugosa during a battle as part of Asajj Ventress' forces.

R8-X4F was a battle droid in service of the Galactic Republic on Ossus at the start of the new conflict with the Sith Empire. During the Invasion of Ossus, it went rogue and was brought down by Imperial or Republic forces.

R8-X8 was a battle droid in service of the Galactic Republic on Ossus at the start of the new conflict with the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Invasion of Ossus, it went rogue and was brought down by Imperial or Republic forces.
The Ancient ruins were an area on the planet Ossus that contained a large amount of pre-Cron Supernova ruined buildings at the time of the invasion of Ossus by the Sith Empire.

2767 was a B1-series battle droid in the Trade Federation Droid Army. In 32 BBY, he was part of the forces deployed to the city of Theed on the planet Naboo by the Federation during its invasion of the world.
Conduit 398-GX14 was a power system conduit on the Starlight Beacon space station, located behind an access hatch near the entrance to the station's Jedi temple.
The Clazca were one of the tribes that composed the Beast Riders of Onderon. They opposed the Galactic Empire.
The Amroth were one of the tribes that composed the Beast Riders of Onderon.
The Rimesea was a large body of water located on the planet Weik. A number of trading wind-ships traveled across it.
Skyholme was a mountaintop city located on the planet Weik.

Sector Twelve was a location on the planet Hoth. During the Battle of Hoth, General Leia Organa ordered Commander Chiffonage to send all troops in the sector to the South Ridge before, at the urging of the smuggler Han Solo, ordering a retreat.

T-P3O was a protocol droid who served at the Jedi academy on Coruscant.
The search for Yiprukk was a search by a mother looking for her Force-sensitive son Yiprukk during the Clone Wars.
An astronomical object of blue color was to be found in the Bith system. It was home to members of the Bith species, who were native to Clak'dor VII despite sharing a name with the system.

V-18 was a droid owned by the Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram on the planet Valo during the High Republic Era. Possessing a boxy appearance, V-18 had been painted purple by Jomaram to avoid him having the appearance of a crate.
Bonbraks, also known as the barat-karabak, were a diminutive hairy sentient species native to the planet Bartokan V. They were classified as a protected species by the Galactic Republic.

A platypus was a sentient species with teal fur, a duck-like bill, a flat, orange tail, and webbed feet. It communicated by making a repetitive clicking noise with its mouth. Their eyes could be brown. The Alliance to Restore the Republic agent Perry was a member of the species.

x: The Mission to Begamor was a mission to the planet Begamor where Jedi Master Mostima and Jedi Padawan Sean were sent to stop President Jamie Brasson in 200 BBY.
No-Space was a remote area of space in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. The region served as a pirate haven for the anarchistic Nihil during the High Republic Era.

The Gaze Electric was a starship used by the Evereni Ro family, whose members were part of the Path of the Open Hand religious cult, and later the Nihil pirate syndicate over the course of many decades of the High Republic Era.
The New Elite was a modified corvette commanded by Kassav Milliko, a Tempest Runner in the Nihil marauder organization. The vessel served as the flagship of Milliko's Tempest.

The Elegencia was a corvette-sized starship owned by Pan Eyta, a Tempest Runner of the Nihil marauder organization. It had a beautiful interior, with surfaces covered in soft leather and lighting that accented Eyta's design choices.
The Lourna Dee was a cruiser commanded by Nihil Tempest Runner Lourna Dee, who named the vessel after herself.

Ban Landing was a city located on the shores of Kato Zakar, a continent of the planet Tython. Situated at the mouth of the Moon Channel, Ban Landing served as a transit hub for Je'daii crossing the channel and visiting the the seven Moon Islands or distant Thyr.

Umate was the highest mountain in the Manarai range on Coruscant, and by the Republic Era, the only uncovered mountain on the ecumenopolis. The mountain's body, below the plaza, was incorporated into the city-planet's fabric, becoming riddled with tunnels.

The Manarai range was a mountain range located on the planet Coruscant. Its highest peak was Umate. Over time, as Coruscant was transformed into an ecumenopolis, the planet-spanning city covered the entire Manarai range except for Umate, the peak of which became the centrepiec…

The Arbitrage was a freighter utilized by the company Garello Technologies on the planet Ab Dalis, captained by the Shistavanen Odabba.

Qualai was a small, low-gravity, terrestrial planet located in the Qualai system within the Kallea sector on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories and in the Western Reaches. It was situated in grid square K-20 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Panacea was a Salvation-class Republic medical frigate and one of the earliest Great Works of Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh during the High Republic Era.
Thull's Shroud was a location in the Mid Rim Territories' Senex sector, situated in grid square L-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was also situated near the Mid Rim astronomical object Belsavis.
