Eriadu's inhabited moon was a moon that orbited the Outer Rim Territories planet Eriadu. During the High Republic Era, the moon had an estimated population of 1.2 billion.

Amfar was a terrestrial astronomical object that possessed beaches. It was located in the Amfar system in the Inner Rim Territories, in grid square O-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid along the hyperspace route known as the Vaathkree Trade Corridor east of Obroa-skai.

The Aurora III, nicknamed "Aurie," was a Galactic Republic Longbeam cruiser in use during the High Republic Era. During a combined Republic and Jedi Order effort to save the Hetzal system from hyperspace debris, it was piloted by Joss and Pikka Adren.

The first Emergence was the first of the Emergences, fallout of the Great Hyperspace Disaster in which fragments of the freighter Legacy Run shot out of hyperspace seemingly at random. Seven pieces of the starship emerged in the Ab Dalis system.
The Yekkabird was a Pacifier-class sector patrol cruiser of the Galactic Republic, owned by the Core Worlds planet Corellia, a member world of the Republic Defense Coalition.
The Marillion was a Pacifier-class sector patrol cruiser of the Galactic Republic's Republic Defense Coalition, owned by the member world of Alderaan.
CV-4T was a protocol droid who served the GeneTech Syndicate on Talus during the Galactic Civil War.

The Imperial Research Division was an organization dedicated to study and research for the Galactic Empire. In addition to its role in scientific research, the Imperial Research Division was also tasked to oversee and control private research throughout the galaxy.

The Kirmay clan owned a farm located on the Mid Rim planet Qiilura. Ghez Hokan, a Mandalorian mercenary hired by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, sold the Kirmay clan to Trandoshan slavers, which was explained to clone commando RC-1136 by a Qiiluran villager in 22 BBY, …
Chromants were a type of ant that lived on the Outer Rim planet Elphrona, residing in nests that could contain up to a hundred individuals.

The Emergences were a series of disasters that occurred in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster, in which the freighter Legacy Run came apart in hyperspace while maneuvering to avoid a Nihil starship, with numerous fragments of its wreckage entering the Hetzal system…

An Emergence of the Great Hyperspace Disaster occurred in the Outer Rim Territories' Ringlite system. Several thousand people were killed as the result of an impact of debris from the freighter Legacy Run, amid the crippling of hyperspace travel across the Outer Rim due to the…

The Ridadi were a species of star-locust who were known to migrate through space. While migrating, they used the specific magnetic pulses of nearby stars to guide them and usually avoided inhabited worlds.
A Rebel cell operated on Gus Talon, one of the moons of the planet Corellia, in 2 BBY during the Galactic Civil War.
A Ximpi city was located on the planet Shuraden around 232 BBY. The city was home to a population of Ximpi.
The Begamor underworld was the underworld of Begamor. It had an abundance of bars.

Clone Comms Technicians were clone trooper technicians of the Galactic Republic that were active during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Clone Comms Technicians were responsible for proper communication, making them essential for any army.

The dedication of the Starlight Beacon was an event that launched the Starlight Beacon, the culmination of Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh's Great Works. Starlight Beacon was part of Soh's efforts to expand the Galactic Republic's presence in the Outer Rim Territories.

TR-01L was a security droid owned by the Guavian Death Gang on Batuu. In 34 ABY, TR-01L was encountered by C-3PO and a droid repair technician, who attempted to negotiate with it in order to rescue R2-D2 from the Guavian Death Gang.

Tempests were the largest divisions of the Nihil marauders. Three Tempests existed, each of which was led by one of the three Tempest Runners. At the time of the Great Disaster, these were Pan Eyta, Lourna Dee, and Kassav Milliko.

Adi Gallia's Jedi Starfighter was a Red Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor flown by Jedi Master Adi Gallia during the Clone Wars.

Ogden's Hope was a sizeable town located on the Outer Rim Territories planet Elphrona, thirty kilometers away from the Elphrona Outpost. It was primarily inhabited by individuals who owned and worked various mining claims.
Juniper bugs were a type of insect that were one of Bina's shipments. Julen Rakab noted that they were not carnivorous but they were itchy.

The Salathera was a Lancer-class pursuit craft used by the Quarren Tara Rashin, a member of the Guavian Death Gang in 34 ABY.

IG-88A was one of five identical IG-88 assassin droids that, according to legend, were created by Holowan Laboratories during a secret Imperial project known as the Project Phlutdroid.

The Keftia district was a district located on the planet Ab Dalis during the time of the High Republic. Garello Technologies was also based in the district.

A spider-like creature was native to the planet Kullgroon. The creatures were arachnids with blue skin, that had the ability to reassemble itself after being blasted. Lando Calrissian was traveling through a cave when he was attacked by hordes of the little spiders.

A swamp planet served as home to an elite assassin and his base around 19 BBY. The base was infiltrated by a mercenary group led by a wealthy industrialist, intending to hire the assassin's services to kill Darth Vader.
An ice planet served as the corporate base of a wealthy industralist around 19 BBY, and was visited by Darth Vader of the Galactic Empire.

A RA-7 protocol droid was on Coruscant with an astromech droid in 21 BBY during the Clone Wars. The RA-7 protocol droid and astromech droid were both in a dark alley in the lower market districts of Coruscant.

The San Tekka compound, also known as the San Tekka manor, was an estate owned by Marlowe and Vellis San Tekka on a private San Tekka clan island in the Lake Country of the Mid Rim planet Naboo during the High Republic Era.

The Path of Coins was the largest of the Ord Mantellian city of Worlport's three gambling districts.

GNK-189 was a GNK-series power droid who served the Resistance. The Droid was part of C-3PO's party whilst stranded on Taul, before being attacked by a spice spider and separated from the group.

Worlport Bay was a body of water located along the Breakwater region of Worlport, the capital city of the planet Ord Mantell.

A Twi'lek city was located on the planet of Ryloth. It was decimated by Hyena-class Droid Fighter/Bombers in 21 BBY, after Separatist leader Wat Tambor ordered the destruction of all Twi'lek settlements in range.

MSE-3-M813M was an MSE-series mouse droid who served the First Order.

The South Stretch Worker's District, also known as the South Stretch District, or as simply the Worker's District, was a district of the city of Canto Bight, located on the planet Cantonica.

Haileap was a terrestrial planet in the Haileap system in the Dalnan sector, a subsector of the Tunka sector in the Outer Rim Territories. Its primary spaceport was the outpost Port Haileap. During the High Republic Era, Port Haileap was watched by a Jedi marshal.
The White Zone was a part of the city of Worlport, the capital of the planet Ord Mantell. Built on the site of a Republic garrison, the White Zone was patrolled by numerous Imperial troops.

The Poisoned Barb was a Nihil starship belonging to the Storm Kara Xoo.
Handsies were a species of primates native to the jungle moon Wevo. The species' name was given to them by aspiring scientist Avon Starros while she was stranded on the moon with several others.
The Lengilese civilization originated in the Expansion Region's Lengil system and, according to the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra, was lost by 3 ABY.

Star-locusts were insects that could live in the vacuum of space. The Ridadi were a species of star-locust that were known to migrate through interstellar space in giant swarms.

The House Ministry of Inquiry, also known as MI, was a centuries-old spynet under the control of House Mecetti. MI had infiltrated most of the other Noble Houses by the time of the Galactic Civil War, as well as agents within the Imperial Security Bureau and the Ubiqtorate.
Iego City Hall was one of many buildings in the city of Cliffhold on Iego. Jaybo Hood led Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker past the building after they had recovered their needed reeksa root.

Tee-Six was an astromech droid who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Tee-Six was aboard the transport Spirit of Jedha when it malfunctioned and fell out of hyperspace, coming under attack from the pirates of the Ohnaka Gang.
Ought-Six was a droid who was the captain of the Droid Crush Pirates of Bestoon, a droid pirate group associated with Bestoon.

The Droid Crush Pirates of Bestoon, known more simply as the Droid Crush and also referred to as the Crush, were droid pirates associated with Bestoon and led by Captain Ought-Six and were known to be recruited by the Jedi hunter Ochi of Bestoon.

A space-faring creature that was a subspecies of the summa-verminoth resided in the Red Honeycomb Zone, a pathway through the Galactic Barrier between the Unknown Regions and the rest of the galaxy. The creature had a singlular eye, a large mouth, and numerous tentacles.

A raid took place between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire in which Captain Cassian Andor was involved in. Originally K-2SO was going to join Cassian, but, while attacking an Imperial freighter, the two located three Wookiees.
Sector GL-44 was a sector located in the Imperial Complex on Lothal.

The Imperial Broadcast was a media organization that produced entertainment programs and communications for the Galactic Empire.

A massacre occurred in the ancient city of Montellian Serat on the planet Devaron by the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. The Devaronians who survived the massacre taught their children how to hunt and become snipers in the aftermath.
An insurgency on the planet Orto Plutonia against the Galactic Empire occurred during the Imperial Era. The Talz resistance maximized their environmental advantages to fight Imperial forces.

Orbital Commerce was a ministry operating on the planet Tallaan during the Galactic Civil War. One of the most powerful ministries, it controlled the civilian shipyards and oversaw the daily financial transactions that took place on any orbital station above the world.

The Journeyman was a passenger starship which existed during the High Republic Era. When hyperspace routes were beginning to be opened up in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster, the Journeyman departed Cerea with a load of mostly Cerean passengers.

The Rushlight Equinox was a starship utilized by the Byne Guild member Vishla's crew during the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, when hyperspace was being reopened after the Great Hyperspace Disaster, the Rushlight Equinox was present on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.

Ogemites were a sentient species in the galaxy that partially shared their name with the celestial body Ogem in the Mid Rim Territories. In 232 BBY, several Ogemites boarded the starship Journeyman on the Mid Rim planet Cerea.

Cluster World Relations was an organization of the Corellian state tasked with promoting good relationships between the Human population and tribal species living on the worlds of the Corellian system.

The Mizi were a sentient species with long limbs, a long nose, and a lower susceptibility to radiation than most other species. As a result, Mizi often transported cargo that other species were unable to.

The Orincans were a porcine sentient species from the Orinca system in the Outer Rim Territories. They appeared similar to Gamorreans, though had paler skin. The Orincans had a dislike for the Mizi, another sentient species from the same region.
Leoxo was, for a period of time during the High Republic Era, the name of an inhabited terrestrial planet in the system of the same name in the Rayter sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Lightseeker was a starship owned by the Jedi Wayseeker Orla Jareni. Roughly pyramidal in structure with three engines, the ship had a pearlescent finish to its hull.

A species of white serpents was found on the lost moon, a moon between the twin planets Eiram and E'ronoh. Several meters long and over a meter wide, the serpents were carnivorous, despite the apparent lack of other life on the moon.

Sedri was a waterworld located in the Sedri system of the Tharin sector, falling specifically into the Periphery area of space.
Sedri Minor was an arable farming planet located in the Sedri system of the Periphery, situated in the Outer Rim Territories.

Frist wolves were a type of wolf native to the Mid Rim planet Trandosha. They were hunted by the native Trandoshan species, whose culture was firmly rooted in hunting, often with the aid of Trandoshan hunting hounds.

Jurgen's bandits was a minor group of bandits active on Naboo's moon of Rori during the Galactic Civil War. The bandits were led by Jurgen Nath, a criminal involved in the kidnapping and murder of Felicia, the daughter of Wernell Covington, years before the Battle of Yavin.

Vladlun's gang was a minor gang of criminals active on Naboo's moon of Rori during the Galactic Civil War. The gang was led by Vladlun Travan, a criminal involved in the kidnapping and murder of Felicia, the daughter of Wernell Covington, years before the Battle of Yavin.
PZ1-3 was a droid with masculine programming who served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era, piloting the Padawan academic cruiser Star Hopper.
Valo was a forested planet in the Valo system on the edge of the Rseik sector. It was where the sentient avian Alcedian species originated.
The Farodin Woods was a forest on the planet Valo. It was located past the outskirts of Lonisa City. Crashpoint Tower was situated in a field deep within the Farodin Woods.
M-227, nicknamed Em-Two, was an ancient security droid owned by the pilot Sylvestri Yarrow during the High Republic Era, serving aboard Yarrow's starship, the cargo hauler Switchback.
The Switchback was a cargo hauler owned by Chancey and Sylvestri Yarrow, the latter of whom inherited it after Chancey's death in a Nihil attack. Other crew members included Neeto Janajana and M-227.

The Trymant IV disaster, also known as the disaster on Trymant IV, was a cataclysm which struck the Outer Rim Territories' Trymant system as the result of an Emergence of the Great Hyperspace Disaster, when delayed hyperspace debris appeared in the system.

The banshee bird was a type of winged avian. A brass banshee bird with its wings outstretched was mounted on the cross section of the Corellian Cross, a medal made to commemorate the contributions of the planet Corellia to the Alliance to Restore the Republic that was awarded …

An occupation was undertaken by the Galactic Empire on the planet Champala during the Imperial Era. The Galactic Empire expanded mining and manufacturing operations tenfold, resulted in the poisoning of the already tainted oceans on Champala by industrial pollution.

A symbiont was a fungoid creature involved in symbiosis. General Yiv the Benevolent owned multiple symbionts, which he wore on his shoulders like epaulets. Yiv's symbionts tested air and liquids for toxins and other harmful substances.

Over a decade before 3 ABY, the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk was part of a posse of Trandoshan hunters. Whilst part of the posse, Bossk collected one of his first bounties for the Galactic Empire, the Wookiee renegade Chewbacca.
The Lake Octir was a lake located on the Nabooian moon of Rori. It was surrounded by a swamp known as the Lake Octir Swamp.
A criminal cartel was in control of the planet Phindar around twenty years before 14 BBY.

Kidron was a planet located in the Kidron system in the Elrood sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, many Y-wing pilots trained on Kidron, soaring through its spectacular orange skies.
Ridlay was a rocky planet in the Ridlay system in the Lambda sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was inhabited by a sentient species.

The Blue Dragon was a pirate organization based in the Aakaash system of the Oplovis sector and were the most powerful crime syndicate in the system, the Blue Dragon had ties to high-ranking officials of the Land & Sky Corporation, the company that ruled the Aakaash system.

The Jade Rats were a gang of thieves active towards the end of the High Republic Era in the Aakaash system of the Oplovis sector. Its membership numbered around twenty, and the group was based on a smuggling ship.

The appearance of Tetarick sea urchin was similar to that of Lu Nan when the latter wore a special armored vest with mutliple straps and metal shackles that held together a dozen rifles, six shotguns, and a modified DF-q91 sniper rifle the height of herself in 200 BBY.

The Order of the Sight Voltaic, also known as Grand-engineers, were an ancient organization of Force-sensitive scholars. They had a unique spiritual connection with technology, and were capable of controlling droids or sending information directly into their memory banks.
The Vermilion Birds were a pirate gang that operated in the Aakaash system towards the end of the High Republic Era under the leadership of the Yellow Hand.

During the Galactic Civil War, shortly before the Battle of Yavin, the Galactic Empire annexed the planet Hethar in order to provide a new source of food for the Imperial Military and sustain the war effort against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
A freighter was in the possession of the New Republic's intelligence service during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

Land was the capital planet of the Aakaash system and the world from which the unique culture of the system originated. In addition to the Xia capital, the planet had 10 major cities of comparable grandeur.

An outpost of the Rebel Alliance was established on Aeos Prime during the Galactic Civil War with the Galactic Empire. Decades after, during the First Order-Resistance War, the First Order destroyed the abandoned outpost to prevent the Resistance from using it.
During the Old Sith Wars, a droid was present on the Outer Rim world of Dantooine. It was used by the local authorities, the Galactic Republic, and the Jedi Order as an information droid.

t: Assault on the Werta system moon
x: During the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire launched a concerted assault on a moon in the Werta system where a Rebel Alliance base had been discovered.

A populated terrestrial moon was located in the Werta system, a part of the Mid Rim's Oriolan sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance established a large base on the moon. Shortly after the base's establishment, it was discovered by the Galactic Empire.

The Republic Transport Bureau was a governmental department of the Galactic Republic active during the High Republic Era. The bureau was responsible for ensuring safe and reliable travel across the Republic, as well as the shipment of cargo.
Purseworld Security was the law enforcement agency of the purseworlds.

The Maree's Diligence was a freighter owned by Garello Technologies during the High Republic Era, named after company head Larence Garello's mother. It was destroyed during a Nihil attack shortly after the Great Hyperspace Disaster, torn apart by several pirate harpoons.

The Sawa was a tribe of Wookiees. When Bossk attacked the gunship Liswarr, he smelled a Wookiee who belonged to either the Sawa or Kaapauku tribes, though he noted that he often confused the two groups.

Thunder was a planet of the Aakaash system, which was ruled by the Land & Sky Corporation. The criminal He Shan of the Vermilion Birds pirates killed Yue Chang, a contact of the Silver Knights, at the Oasis Docks on Thunder.

The Kaapauku tribe was a tribe of Wookiees. When Bossk attacked the gunship Liswarr, he smelled a Wookiee who belonged to either the Kaapauku or Sawa tribes, though he noted that he often confused the two groups.
Level 5216, or Level 5,216, was a level of the ecumenopolis planet Coruscant. During the High Republic Era, Monument Plaza, home to Coruscant's only uncovered mountain peak, was located on the level.
The Shadow trooper gunship was a heavily modified Low Altitude Assault Transport, utilized by Republic Intelligence's clone shadow troopers during the Clone Wars.

The reflecting pond was a pond located at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. At some point before 3 ABY an incident involving the Jedi Tru Veld and fireworks occurred in the pond which cracked Jedi Master Yoda.
In 5 BBY, the Croke Rokur Gepta brought about the destruction of the planet Tund using a biological agent released by an electromagnetic torpedo.

Spikebats were a species of bat that lived in forests on the planet Serenno. They were active during evening. The Sith apprentice Asajj Ventress disliked spikebats along with many other aspects of the planet.
The Andobi Mountains were a mountain range on the ice planet of Ando Prime. By the year 22 BBY, podraces were held in these mountains.

The eighteenth Emergence was one of the Emergences in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster, an incident when the freighter Legacy Run was destroyed in hyperspace and its debris began reverting into realspace in unpredictable locations.

The Port District, also known as the Port Quarter, was a district on the planet Coruscant that contained the planet's two main spaceport zones. People with no connections were aware of the western spaceport, while visitors used the Eastport.
The western spaceport was a spaceport in the Port District of the planet Coruscant. During the Separatist Crisis, it experienced, along with the Eastport, a 6,000% increase in migration traffic.

The Coruscant Eastern Spaceport, also known as Eastport or the Coruscant Spaceport, was one of the two major spaceports on the planet Coruscant and was located in the world's Port District on Level 5127.

A brawl erupted during the Separatist Crisis at the Eastport of the Port District on the planet Coruscant between Weequay and Houk immigrants. The brawl was uncontrollable, and resulted in the deaths of fifteen individuals and another forty-five seriously injured.
The Battle of Mon Calamari was an engagement fought over the planet Mon Calamari during the Clone Wars. The Iktotchi Jedi General Saesee Tiin participated in the battle.
The red apricot was the starship of red apricot squad, an elite squad of the Silver Knights, a prominent civil mercenary group in the Aakaash system.
Lake 9776 was the asteroid that housed the stronghold of the Blue Dragon pirates. It was located within the Lake asteroid field of the Oplovis sector's Aakaash system.

The home of the Silver Knights was a settlement in the abandoned desert wastelands of the Oplovis sector planet Wind in the Aakaash system. It housed a community that was supplied by the Silver Knights, a civil mercenary group, which saw the settlement as its home.

Refuge seven was a part of the home of the Silver Knights settlement on the Aakaash system planet Wind.

Sector 47 was an area of space above the Forest Moon of Endor. During the Battle of Endor in the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire's Star Destroyers were located in Sector 47 and ambushed the Alliance Fleet.

Holding Sector MV-7 was an area of space above the Forest Moon of Endor. During the Battle of Endor in the Galactic Civil War, Rebel Alliance Admiral Gial Ackbar ordered Green Squadron to stay at Holding Sector MV-7 while the rest of the Alliance Fleet forces took evasive acti…
The Defensive Perimeter was located along the perimeter of Fortress Inquisitorius on the ocean moon of Nur in the Mustafar system. Airlock 8 was located within the Defensive Perimeter.
The four great families were a group of families in charge of the Land & Sky Corporation's board of directors. The families included the Nan family, Xia family, Chen family, and Ma family.

The Culture Ministry was a ministry of the Galactic Empire. At one point, it approved the obscure Colonies holiday Feast of Lord-Protector Jarmanidath, allowing it to be celebrated by members of the Imperial Military.
The Minder was a surveillance vessel of the Galactic Empire. The starship served as an escort of the bulk freighter Yadeez, the flagship of the Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Chadawa was an ocean planet located in the Chadawa system of the galaxy's Inner Rim Territories, and was governed by the Chadawan government. An unknown species built the planet eons ago, forming the planet to machine-exact specifications that gave it several unique features.
The attack on Chadawa occurred in 5 ABY during the Galactic Civil War, when Shadow Wing attacked the planet Chadawa as part of Operation: Cinder.

The Brightsaber was a heavy cruiser that served within the fleet of the New Republic. It took part in the New Republic's attack on the Galactic Empire's forces at the planet Jakku in 5 ABY, where it was targeted and destroyed by the Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

The Hunting Hound was a heavy cruiser that served within the New Republic's fleet. During the New Republic's attack on the Galactic Empire's forces at the planet Jakku in 5 ABY, the cruiser was targeted and destroyed by the Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

The Serenade was a heavy cruiser that served among the New Republic's fleet during the Galactic Civil War. Taking part in the New Republic's attack on the Galactic Empire's loyalist forces at the planet Jakku, it was destroyed by the Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

The Canny Bargain was a starship equipped with deflector shield generators that served in the New Republic Defense Fleet. In 5 ABY, the vessel participated in the New Republic's assault on the Galactic Empire's loyalist forces above the planet Jakku.

The Unerring was a starship that served within the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. By 5 ABY, the vessel and its escorts sought to destroy a conspiracy by one of the late Emperor Palpatine's viziers.
Dybbron III, or just Dybbron, was a planet in the Inner Rim Territories' Dybbron system which hosted a breakaway faction of the Galactic Empire during the later Galactic Civil War.

Kortatka was a planet in the Inner Rim Territories' Croynar sector which broke away from the Galactic Empire during the late Galactic Civil War. In response, it was targeted and purged by the loyalist 204th Imperial Fighter Wing in 5 ABY.
The Spire Fly was a fly located on the planet Batuu. Izal Garsea noted that all the pebbles being thrown around her reminded her of the spire flies that would surround people during the summer.

Fikzwaa was an astronomical object in the Fikzwaa system of the Inner Rim Territories and the Trailing Sectors. Situated at the coordinates N-14 on the Standard Galactic Grid, it was home to a diminutive species whose population numbered multiple billion.

Netalych was a cold planet located in the seventh orbit of the Netalych system in the Inner Rim Territories and Trailing Sectors, situated at the coordinates N-14 on the Standard Galactic Grid just off of the Corellian Run super-hyperroute.

The Industrial District, also known as the Industrial Sector or Industrial Zone, was a district of Imperial City on the planet Coruscant. It contained the Coruscant Industrial Zone Detention Center and the Works.

The Blue Sector was a location in Coronet City on the planet Corellia. The ASP-9 "Vrelt" autopistol manufactured by Talus Ironworks saw use within the Blue Sector by inspectors of the Corellian Security Forces at crime scenes.

To'hok Neige was located in an eponymous star system within the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Situated in the Kriz sector, it lay within the grid square J-18 on the Standard Galactic Grid and was featured with luminous amber skies.

A jungle planet situated far from the Core Worlds was the homeworld of a species that saw anything not of their world as being unpure. In order to prevent contamination, the native population would cover themselves in wrapped garments and masks.

A humanoid species with chitinous features was native to a jungle planet. The species perceived there to be two worlds, their own and everything beyond it, and did not wish to come into contact with anything from outside of their planet.

During the Galactic Civil War, eleven months after the Battle of Endor in 5 ABY, an attack led by Colonel Soran Keize of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing was launched on the planet Dybbron III as part of Operation: Cinder.

During the Galactic Civil War in 5 ABY, an attack led by Colonel Soran Keize of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing was launched on the planet Kortatka as part of Operation: Cinder. The attack resulted in the devastation of the planet.

An astronomical object had two stars. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Han Solo and Chewbacca, who successfully completed the Dragon Void Run mission and found the right mole, traveled to the object and met Leia Organa.

During the Galactic Civil War in 5 ABY, the planet Fedovoi End was destroyed by the loyalist Imperial forces of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, led by Colonel Soran Keize, as part of Operation: Cinder.

4E, nicknamed Foree, was a conical astromech droid with the emblem of Alphabet Squadron on its chassis that served the New Republic toward the end of the Galactic Civil War.

During the Galactic Civil War in 5 ABY, New Republic General Hera Syndulla and her forces aboard the Star Destroyer Deliverance, had spent a week smashing Imperial blockades in the Nythlide Array.

Skirl was a small village located on the distant planet Batuu. Surrounded by ancient, misty woodland on three sides that marked one of the most fertile and beautiful part of Batuu, Skirl had a quiet community of farmers who grew grain.
Melchi's Medical Relief was an organization run by the Herglic Melchi in the Tapani sector during the Galactic Civil War.
Mountain was a planet of the Aakaash system, which was ruled by the Land & Sky Corporation. It was noted to be a polluted world with many areas being particularly high in deadly toxins or Radiation.

Water was a planet of the Aakaash system, which was ruled by the Land & Sky Corporation and used for agricultural activity. It exported the Water chickens, which was an ingredient in dishes such as the Water chicken meat pie and Water chicken egg fried rice.
Boohar electric snakes were a species of snake. They were mentioned to hunt prey.
The Lioaoin Orbital Command was a branch of the Lioaoin Regime.

The Cathar were a catlike, felinoid humanoid sentient species. Members of the species possessed fur and manes, slitted eyes and noses, tufted ears, a mouth with teeth, and clawed hands. They were powerful, swift, and fierce fighters.

An ancient grove associated with the Jedi was located on the moon Alaris Prime. It contained several ruined structures and was described in a Jedi holocron. The grove was accessible by a path through a forest, although the entrance to it was covered by a line of trees.
Grunnrurr was an area of the planet Kashyyyk, the homeworld of the Wookiee species located in the Mid Rim's Mytaranor sector.
Kahiyuk was an area of the Wookiee homeworld Kashyyyk, a planet located in the Mytaranor sector of the Mid Rim.
The area of Rowrakruk was located on the planet Kashyyyk, the homeworld of the Wookiee species in the Mid Rim's Mytaranor sector.

The area known as Warralokk was located on the planet Kashyyyk, in the Mid Rim's Mytaranor sector. Volunteers from Warralokk joined an army of Wookiees, Kashyyyk's native sentient species, that formed during the Clone Wars in order to defend the city of Kachirho in the Wawaatt…
The Krakana was a Galactic Republic Valor-class starship, and the flagship of the Twenty-Ninth Fleet. It was under the command of Vice Admiral Dol Narlock.

Sparkflies were a type of bioluminescent fly that could be found on the Outer Rim planets Ab Dalis and E'ronoh. In 382 BBY, Jedi Knight Gella Nattai noticed incandescent sparkflies while in E'ronoh's royal palace.

Chewflies were a type of fly on the Fruited Moon of the Outer Rim planet Hetzal Prime. They flew in seasonal swarms on the moon that destroyed the crops planted there, plaguing the Hetzalians residing there.

Tu'oon was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Tu'oon system in the Juris sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the site of a massacre carried out by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing during the reign of the Empire.
The Jedi quarter was a section of the Starlight Beacon space station that contained its Jedi temple.
The biosphere zone was a section of the Starlight Beacon space station which contained recreations of the natural environments of various worlds of the Outer Rim Territories.
Pipeline Junction West was a region on Geonosis modeled after a pipeline junction.

Sand beetles were creatures encountered on the desert planet of Tatooine. When the Tusken Raider A'Yark became a chieftain, the younglings of her clan were killing sand beetles in the rites of adulthood instead of krayt dragons.
An Imperial-class Star Destroyer served under the command of Admiral Wilhuff Tarkin during the early months of the Galactic Empire.

A non-sentient species of maggot lived on the planet Felucia. Theelin New Republic pilot Chass na Chadic heard stories from her mother about how the maggots spent most of their lives being blown around the planet on storm winds.

Baradas was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Baradas system of the Colonies. During the Galactic Civil War between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire, the rebel pilot and squadron commander Nath Tensent experienced a bad landing on Baradas in his first …

Cliff was a location on the planet Polyneus where New Republic pilot Wyl Lark was born. Over a year after returning to his homeworld following the Battle of Jakku, Lark visited Cliff to speak with a Sun-Lama about treating a sur-avka's mangled claw.
Tor was a village on the planet Polyneus that was the home of the Polynean pilot Stam Groundling, who left Polyneus as part of the Hundred and Twenty.
The Aphelion III was a Galactic Republic ship in operation during the third Galactic War. The ship was the most heavily-secured ship under the command of Vice Admiral Dol Narlock.
The clone barracks was a building within Fort Anaxes, a base of the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic on the planet Anaxes during the Clone Wars.
The Platform TT-3-9-7 was an area of Fort Anaxes, a base of the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic on the planet Anaxes during the Clone Wars.
BB-H20 was a BB-series astromech droid that had a red and white body, with a black sensor. The droid aided the Resistance along with R2-H25 during their time on Crait.

During the Galactic Civil War in 5 ABY, General Hera Syndulla's New Republic forces aboard the Star Destroyer Deliverance, who had continued their hunt for the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, managed to track the fighter wing and the bulk freighter Yadeez, after the 204th had sto…
Gloovans were a sentient species that possessed a bulky figure and lumpy purple skin. Scram was a Gloovan gangster who led the Scram Gang during the time of the Galactic Empire.
The Castilon Run Cup was a sky race hosted on the planet Castilon. The race was made up of several one-on-one rounds that involved racing through sky rings while avoiding obstacles.

The Triple Dark Storm Cup was a race hosted on Castilon in 34 ABY. The race was made up of several rounds, and the pilot Kazuda Xiono would eventually win the race, which allowed him to move on to the more difficult race, the Colossus Master Cup.

The Colossus Master Cup was a race hosted on Castilon in 34 ABY. The race was made up of several rounds, and the pilot Kazuda Xiono would eventually win the race, which allowed him to move on to the more difficult race, the Dameron Xtreme Cup.

The Dameron Xtreme Cup was a race hosted on Castilon in 34 ABY. The race was made up a single round against Poe Dameron, and the pilot Kazuda Xiono would eventually win the race. Upon winning, Kazuda received an X-wing.

The clan of Vylip F'alma was a Mustafarian cavern tribe on the planet Mustafar. The Priestess was also a member of the clan. The clan helped Corvax's descendant to kill the darkghast near the Corvax Fortress and participated in the battle against Fortress Vader.

A mountainous planet was visited by the Spectres rebel cell during the Imperial Era. Rebels Sabine Wren, Hera Syndulla, and Chopper attempted to steal a medical kit from a Lambda-class shuttle on the planet; however, Galactic Empire stormtroopers captured the shuttle while pur…

The crystal mine was an area within the Corvax Fortress on the planet Mustafar. The mine was used by Lady Corvax to extract crystals to power her technology.

Memory moths were moths that lived on New Holstice. By the third year of the Clone Wars, New Holstice was a cylindrical habitat of glowing memory moths that could allegedly be seen from orbit given all the Jedi lost in battle.

The CIS Jammer Prototype was a Confederacy of Independent Systems Lucrehulk-class battleship that served during the Clone Wars. It was outfitted with a modified transmission array that could broadcast jamming signals.
Chardaan was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Inner Rim, in the Chardaan system. It was on the Hydian Way and Shipwrights' Trace hyperspace routes.
A crypt served as Lord Dorwin Corvax's tomb within Corvax Fortress, on the planet Mustafar.
Dol'har Hyde was a forest planet situated in the Outer Rim Territories. During the High Republic Era, a cell of the Nihil marauder organization that was led by Krix Kamerat was based on Dol'har Hyde.

Midarr was a terrestrial planet located in the Midarr system in the Mulgard sector of the Mid Rim Territories. The Burnsi Run hyperspace route led in the direction of Midarr from the planet Dol'har Hyde in the Outer Rim Territories.

The Nilos was a Sienar Fleet Systems Imperial Lambda-class shuttle, shot down near Iziz on the planet Onderon during the Galactic Civil War. Moff Lasre Dardano took the shuttle for its personal use at Whisper Base, before the attack by Alliance Special Operations members.
Military Operations was a division of the Eternal Alliance founded by Admiral Bey'wan Aygo to coordinate the Alliance's military and strategic intelligence assets.
The Paataatus delegation was a delegation that served the Paataatus Hiveborn, the nation of the Paataatus species.
Traffic Control was a branch of the Lioaoin Regime that was responsible for monitoring and controlling starship traffic over the Lioaoin heartworld.
Long before the Imperial Period, forces attacked the planet Mustafar, leading to Lord Dorwin Corvax being killed by the invaders.

Curamelle was a city located on the planet Corulag of the Core Worlds. Eleven months after the Battle of Jakku, in which the New Republic achieved a decisive final victory over the Galactic Empire in 5 ABY, former New Republic pilot Chass na Chadic resided in Curamelle.

Crullov was a location on the planet Corulag, located in the Core Worlds. Eleven months after the Battle of Jakku, where the New Republic won a decisive final battle against the Galactic Empire in 5 ABY, the former New Republic pilot Chass na Chadic resided in the city Curamel…
The Festival of the Eternal Alliance was an event celebrating the Eternal Alliance's victory over the Eternal Empire after the Battle of Zakuul in 3630 BBY.

Krooloks were a species of creatures that supposedly inhabited the forest moon of Endor, a type of troll. At some point, a Kroolok apparently stalked the forest around an Ewok village while its inhabitants sheltered against the cold.

Base 1468 was a research outpost on Kamino during the Clone Wars. It was attacked during the Battle of Kamino by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, with the clone troopers of the Galactic Republic fighting in its defense.
During the High Republic Era, an incident in the Jedi temple on the planet Batuu took place, when the Jedi Order studied a dark relic that turned them all against each other.
Demlins were ferocious animals native to the planet Batuu.
The floating park was a location within the Federal District on the planet Coruscant.
H2-WF was a "hunter-seeker" probe droid from Nathema refurbished for use by Eternal Alliance engineers. The droid utilized technology from Nathema's original inhabitants.
During the Clone Wars, Quinlan Vos and Asajj Ventress landed their starship Banshee on a landing pad in their visit of Raxulon, located on the planet Raxus Secundus.
Boohar pitbulls were dogs found in the galaxy around 200 BBY.
Boohar cats were horned cats which were sometimes kept as domestic pets.
The hangar was located within Fortress Vader on the planet Mustafar during the Imperial Era. The hangar served as the main stage for the battle between the Marching Horde and the Imperial garrison.
The Valau were a tribe of sentients native to Nagoa, a location in the remote corners of the galaxy during the Sith Wars between the Galactic Republic and various Sith factions.
Lake 4399 was an asteroid in the Lake asteroid field. An Ping lead red apricot squad in an attempt to capture Zhang Níngtao and ransom him to the Blue Dragon for the return of the enigmatic tenebrae.
Lake 9527 was an asteroid in the Lake asteroid field and was home to the Nan family.
During the Clone Wars, loading docks on the planet Oba Diah were used by the Martez sisters to steal cargo from the Pyke Syndicate.

Dox Piter was a collection of villages in the south of the planet Onderon. The villages were located at the base of a mountain known as the Dagger. It was at Dox Piter where a legendary conflict took place between Wodnakki and the Royal Guard of Queen Lina.
"The Dagger" was an unscalable rock spire on the planet Onderon's southern point. At the base of the Dagger stood a collection of villages called Dox Piter.
The Ardent Crusade occurred by 3643 BBY. Covered by a gray shell, a cubic relic of the crusade was blue, green, and red in color.
A terrestrial planet at one point orbited a dying star. The red-colored crystals known as the Qixoni crystals were formed on the planet, where they were warmed by the dying sun.
Vvaw was a planet in the Calaron sector's Vvaw system, which was part of both the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. It fell within square U-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The thissp mouse was a rodent native to the planet Thisspias. The sentient Thisspiasians native to the world ate live thissp mice, a practice against galactic social norms.
The Eternal Empire had a network of agents which they used to spy on the outlands, a Zakuulan term for the Core Worlds, years prior to the war against Zakuul.
RW-22 was an astromech droid who served at the Jedi academy on Coruscant.

During the Galactic Civil War, a New Republic Special Forces strike force undertook a mission to the world Zin Taal in order to capture the command base of the mercenary unit known as the First Sun Mobile Regiment.

Zox was an X-0X recording droid owned by Mandora Catabe when she was editor-in-chief of the HoloNet News in Coruscant. After the Imperial military banned the use of relay droids, she upgraded it and gave it to Calliope Drouth upon her dismissal.
Estaria was an astronomical object in the Estaria system in the Indrexu sector of the Outer Rim Territories that featured a number of orbital ports and was known for its dense civilian traffic.
In 232 BBY during the High Republic Era, an Emergence of the Great Hyperspace Disaster occurred in the Eriadu system of the Outer Rim Territories.

D-R3D was a battle droid used by the Dread Masters as a member of their defensive unit but was subsequently repaired and reprogrammed by the Eternal Alliance for offensive, defensive and medical uses.
H1-R1 was a droid used by the Eternal Alliance on the planet Odessen capable of recordkeeping purposes.

Rock Canyon was a canyon located on the planet Tatooine. In 1 BBY, the astromech droid R2-D2 was captured by a group of Jawas lead by Dathcha in Rock Canyon.

t: Mission to the Imperial supply depot
x: During the Galactic Civil War, a group of Rebel Alliance agents undertook a mission to an Imperial supply depot in the Rainos Cluster.

During the Galactic Civil War, a squad of Imperial Army assault troopers attacked a group of Rebel Alliance agents on the planet Obas as the latter was attempting to prevent the destruction of an Alliance base there.
The Hassarians were a species of the galaxy with willowy physiques, lilac hair, and long snouts. As of the High Republic Era, the species had a centuries-long rivalry with the Skembo.
The Screaming Talons was a criminal organization operating during the Galactic Civil War. Far-ji was a Boss within the gang, and waged a feud with rival gangs.

The Azure Sunset was a luxury sail barge owned by the Pantoran noble Kyja Cho. During the Galactic Civil War, Kyja Cho hosted an event aboard the Azure Sunset, summoning Hutt crime lords and Corporate Sector Authority executives to view a rare krayt dragon pearl Cho had in her…
The Zapertine Cup was a podracing course on the planet Korrilan IV. The series of races were only eligible to racers piloting CR-17 Incendia podracers.
Korrilan IV was a planet located in the Mid Rim Territories. The Zalpertine Cup was a Podracing competition held on the world, catering to podracers piloting CR-17 Incendias.

During the Galactic Civil War in 5 ABY, General Hera Syndulla and her New Republic forces aboard the Star Destroyer Deliverance were attacked by several Imperial sabotage droids, which were used to slow the New Republic's pursuit of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

The ancient Sith of Upekzar were known to have conducted their Mysteries' High Rites in an elaborate volcanic cave system, one of five such cave systems that together constituted the Circle of Visions.

The Great Kimogila's Skeleton was the name given by the inhabitants of Lok to the imposing skeleton of a massive kimogila. The final resting place of the creature was known as a notable point of interests of the planet Lok.
Sometime after their discovery of the Circle of Visions, the Sith residents of Upekzar built a city close at hand to the cave system in which they conducted their Mysteries' High Rites.

This Consular-class cruiser was used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Jedi Master Luminara Unduli and Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano used it to transfer arrested Viceroy Nute Gunray to the Tranquility. It was later stolen by Faro Argyus during his escape with Gunray.

A Nu-class attack/transport shuttle was used by a Galactic Republic delegation under Senator Kharrus assigned to deliver a ransom of spice to Hondo Ohnaka's gang of pirates in exchange for Count Dooku.

This Flarestar-class attack shuttle was used by the Weequay pirate Barb Mentir to shoot down the Nu-class shuttle carrying Senator Kharrus. It was stolen by Confederacy of Independent Systems leader Count Dooku during his escape from Florrum in 22 BBY.

Anakin's shuttle was an refitted Eta-class shuttle that used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Jedi Generals Anakin Skywalker and Adi Gallia used it to board General Grievous's Recusant-class light destroyer and rescue Jedi Master Eeth Koth.
This Sheathipede-class transport shuttle was used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. It was assigned to rescue General Grievous during the Battle of Saleucami.
This Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship was used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

This Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship was used by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. When a Zillo Beast was captured after the Battle of Malastare, this ship was used to transport the creature to Coruscant.
The Gauntlet was a Kom'rk-class fighter/transport that was used by the leader of the Death Watch, Pre Vizsla, as his personal ship.
Kirima was a terrestrial planet located in the Mid Rim. Located near another celestial body, Kirima had icy and rocky terrain with blue crystals.
The Spine Snake River was a river located on the planet of Lok. It was used as a racetrack for the Lok Marathon.
Yavin 8 was a moon in orbit around the red gas giant Yavin Prime. It was one of twenty-six moons in its orbit, and one of three which supported life, including Yavin 4 and Yavin 13.
Yavin 13 was a moon in orbit around the red gas giant Yavin Prime. It was one of twenty-six moons in its orbit, and one of three which supported life, including Yavin 4 and Yavin 8.
The Nine Day Island was a small river island located in the Grendin River, on the planet Lok. It was used as a racetrack for the Lok Marathon.
KC-78 was an astromech droid with masculine programming that served Jedi Master Estala Maru during the High Republic Era.

Soikans were a sentient species from the planet Soika. Tall in build and having pointed ears, they were divided into at least two groups, Gagics and Livtaks, both of which had distinctive colorations. White hair, silver skin and lilac eyes were typical for the Livtak.

Boltrunians were a sentient species which existed in the galaxy. Some Boltrunians were present in the medcenter of the Starlight Beacon space station when Administrator Velko Jahen arrived and was escorted through the facility by Okana.

Medosleans were a sentient species from the Medoslea system which resembled large jellyfish. Shortly after arriving on the Starlight Beacon, Administrator Velko Jahen saw one Medoslean, spread over two cots, being administered drugs by Doctor Gino'le, the Chief of Medical Oper…

The Skembo were a sentient species in the galaxy. They had short legs and long, prehensile tongues with which they could seize food. The Skembo had a rivalry with the Hassarians. Ceeril, one member of the species, served as the Ambassador of Rion during the High Republic Era.

The Halaisi were a sentient species in the galaxy. Humanoid in shape with a build similar to that of humans, they had golden skin and eyes, and four limbs with five-fingered hands. Their eyelids and lips could be blue, and they could have black eyebrows.
FB-88 was the designation of a Pelta-class frigate that served within the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Gorobei was a celestial body located in the Gorobei system of the Inner Rim Territories and the Interior. It was situated in grid square M-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid and was the homeworld of the Frenk bounty hunters Rumi Paramita and Twazzi.

Great Zilk was a celestial body located in the Irishi sector's Great Zilk system, which was within the Mid Rim Territories and the New Territories. It was situated in grid square K-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Halais was a celestial body located in the Halais system of the Colonies and the Slice. It was situated in grid square N-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid and was linked to the Alderaan and Commenor systems via the hyperspace route known as the Commenor Run.

Lavisar was the homeworld of the human Jedi Master Cin Drallig. It was located in the Lavisar system in the Strabin sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square M-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Bombardment of Xorrn took place on the Outer Rim Territories planet Xorrn in 19 BBY during the Clone Wars.

Rampa I was a location in the Rampa Minor system of the Outer Rim Territories' Baxel sector. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Rampa I was subjected to an Imperial subjugation carried out by the 9th Engineering Battalion and former combat engineer Lira Hardin, who defec…

Korbori was an astronomical object located in the Korbori system of the Colonies and the Interior. It was situated in grid square N-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid and lay on the Hydian Way hyperspace route, which connected it to the Candovant and Ubardia systems.

The Ssori Fragments were a celestial body located in the Ssori system, a part of the Klina sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. They were situated in grid square S-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid and were the homeworld of the Ssori bounty hunter Seripas.

Cybloc XII was an astronomical object situated in the Cybloc system of the Outer Rim Territories' Meridian sector. It was the homeworld of the Snivvian Morlimur Snugg, a superintendent on the InterGalactic Banking Clan's Cybloc Transfer Station in the same star system.
Vrant Tarnum was a terrestrial moon in the far reaches of the Stygmarn system. The Kharvashark Ruins were located in its southern hemisphere.

The Kharvashark Ruins were a location on the southern hemisphere of the planet Vrant Tarnum, in the Stygmarn system. Long before the High Republic Era, members of the Elders of the Path hid half of an ancient relic in a cave on the ruins' outskirts.
Bogaranths were large, quadrupedal carnivorous creatures. They produced noxious slime when they were hungry, which was frequently.
Apatros was a world in the Apatros system, a star system in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Coynites were a sentient species from the Coyn system. One such being was involved in a gladitorial fight in the city of Sclavos on Zygerria, which ended with the Coynite's death.
The Nova Defiant was a Recusant-class light destroyer that served in the naval forces of the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
The Gilded Aegis was a Recusant-class light destroyer that served within the Confederacy of Independent Systems' naval forces during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
The Patriot Fist was a Recusant-class light destroyer that served within the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
The assault on Starlight Beacon occurred during the High Republic Era when the Starlight Beacon space station came under attack by the Drengir, a species of sentient carnivorous plants.
Parcelus Minor was a location in the Parcelus Minor system in the Parcelus sector of the Expansion Region. The mercenary Saponza once participated in the Retreat from Parcelus Minor.
The Separatist Council Conference Room was a room on the planet Mustafar where members of the Separatist Council conferred. It was located deep in the mining facility of the Techno Union.
Croluthe Zenj was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Croluthe Zenj system in Lannik Space, a sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square R-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Banchii was a planet in the Inugg system of the Outer Rim Territories. During the High Republic Era, it housed a Jedi outpost which Jedi Knight Lily Tora-Asi was stationed at in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster.

Figg's Avenue was an avenue in the gas mining colony Cloud City. The crime lord Askroh ordered a constituent to travel down the avenue in order to cut off Lando Calrissian and Jiandy, who were fleeing on a speeder.
The Razzi warehouse raid was robbery of the Razzi Syndicate that had occurred by 10 BBY. In the aftermath of the raid, stolen cargo was received by the rivial criminal orginization Crimson Dawn.

Dry Gulch was a settlement in the southern hemisphere of the planet Savareen where an independent coaxium refinery was located. By 10 BBY, the Bellwing Gang had been harrasing Dry Gulch over the refinery, and the locals hired the mercenary Gallandro to deal with the gang.
G2-RX was a G2 repair droid who served the Resistance and repaired droids on board the Raddus.
The Onoam spaceport was a spaceport serving Naboo's moon, Onoam. It was located only a few kilometers away from the queen's secondary palace on the moon.
Blarrum was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Blarrum system in the Mayagil sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was inhabited by gundarks and home to Kul Kenada Spaceport.

A summit was held on the planet Mon Cala between 235 BBY and 232 BBY. At the summit, the human female Avon Starros was forced to eat joppa stew for a month straight, as it was the only thing her nanny droid J-6 was programmed to prepare.
Flutterbugs were insects found on Hosnian Prime and Dalna. Avon Starros once followed a flutterbug outside of her family home and was kidnapped as a result.
The fifth Emergence was the fifth of the Emergences, fallout of the Great Hyperspace Disaster in which fragments of the freighter Legacy Run shot out of hyperspace seemingly at random.
The nineteenth Emergence was the nineteenth of the Emergences, fallout of the Great Hyperspace Disaster in which fragments of the freighter Legacy Run shot out of hyperspace seemingly at random.

The Salenga were a sentient species which existed in the galaxy. They had pink skin, yellow eyes with vertical eyelids and triangular pupils, and hands with one thumb, one finger and a single wide appendage where humans and species with similar hand shapes had more fingers.

result: The galaxy is led to the brink of financial ruin
x: The Battle of Muunilinst was a battle during the Clone Wars that took place on the planet Muunilinst. The training of clone trooper pilots in their handling of the V-19 Torrent starfighter postponed their deployment until this battle.

Bormus was a planet in the Bormus system in the Dustig sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was under the jurisdiction of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Malkii was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Malkii system in the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Winds of Ruin, also known as simply Ruin, were a criminal group who captured the musician Tu-Wane Jipps and had him play music for them at their base.

R0-B5U was an astromech droid that served with Yarvok among the Nova Blades pirates. R0-B5U participated in the Dantooine Incursion and was stationed at the entrance of the Dantooine Power Station to accept ransom payments totalling fifteen million credits in exchange for the …
The Human thief Cecil Noone ran with a crew around 0 ABY consisting of the Sluissi Hass Sonax, the Tynnan Dawson, and the Human Kels Turkhorn.
Cioral was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Unknown Regions Chiss Ascendancy nation. In 18 BBY, it was the stronghold of one of the Ascendancy's Great Families, the Xodlak family.
Creepmice were a type of mice. In 382 BBY, Path of the Open Hand member Yana Ro encountered the mice on the moon Jedha.

Soon after the Battle of Yavin that marked the start of 0 ABY, a swoop race was held on the Outer Rim planet Rion to determine the Rion Swoop Champion. The prize for the race was 1000 credits and a trophy.

Jekara was an ice planet located in the Jekara system of the Mid Rim. The Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate, having resurfaced under the control of Lady Qi'ra, stole the carbonite-frozen smuggler Han Solo from the bounty hunter Boba Fett, holding a celebration on Jekara to aucti…

result: The Galactic Empire dispatches the CompForce Demnadi Relief Operation
x: During the Galactic Civil War, a planetary riot erupted on the planet Demnadi.
A pit simply titled, The Pit was a hole in which the Queen of Gorph society would cast people she disapproved of. The pit was located in the Gorphs' grotto.

A wisp spider was a type of spider that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Dalna. According to the Dalnan Honesty Weft, his father—Ambassador Weft—had captured a wisp spider and then set it free outside on at least one occasion.

Mos Espa Way was the main street in the city of Mos Espa on the Outer Rim Territories planet of Tatooine. It was lined with cantinas and stalls intended for tourists. Its side roads led into the entertainment district, and it was overlooked by the shopping district.
The New Quarter was a section of the city of Mos Eisley on the Outer Rim Territories planet of Tatooine.
The Old Quarter was a part of the city of Mos Eisley on the Outer Rim Territories planet of Tatooine.

The Theed market square was the largest market square in Theed. Prior to the Invasion of Naboo, it contained four fountains, a number of statues and benches, power generators, and several entrances to the Theed sewer system.

R0-VR, known as Rover or Ar-Oh, was an astromech droid owned by the former Jedi and saber-for-hire Ty Yorrick during the High Republic Era. Often resembling a puppy, R0-VR had the temperament of a loyal canine.
KL-03, or K-L, was an admin unit and protocol droid owned by the former Jedi Ty Yorrick, who worked as a saber-for-hire during the High Republic Era.

The Tholothian mercenary Ty Yorrick flew a starship during the High Republic Era. Accustomed to rejecting attachment to what she perceived as tools, Yorrick gave the YT-750 freighter no name, only using a variety of registration numbers for the vessel when docked in Galactic R…

Safrifa was a swamp planet located in the Galactic Frontier of the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Safrifan species. The planet was inhabited by swamp farmers as well as clans led by marsh-lords.

Safrifans were a sentient species native to the swamp planet Safrifa. They had skin the color of stagnant water, large oval eyes, and hair like pondweed. Despite their perceived scrawny nature, the Safrifans were industrious, able to raise crops in Safrifa's marsh terrain.

In the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster during the High Republic Era, a task force was created by the Galactic Republic in order to discover the cause of the disaster and subsequent Emergences, and find a way to deal with them.
A village located on the planet Aleena housed a population of Aleena. At one point, the Galactic Empire attacked the village and an Aleena child was orphaned.

During the Imperial Era, the Galactic Empire undertook a mission to the planet Aleen. During the mission the Empire committed an act that caused a stormtrooper and two other to desert from the Empire. An Aleena village was damaged and an Aleena child was orphaned.
The Dor-Drel were one of the tribes that composed the Beast Riders of Onderon during the Galactic Civil War.
The Ezelk were one of the tribes that composed the Beast Riders of Onderon during the Galactic Civil War.
The Iziz Imperial Customs was the local headquarters of the Imperial Office of Customs on Onderon during the Galactic Civil War.

t: Hunting lodge of the Beast Riders
x: The Hunting lodge of the Beast Riders was the gathering point for the Clazca, a Beast Riders clan on Onderon during the Galactic Civil War.

During the Imperial Era, Tase Somer's black market network was a clandestine network operated for the purchase and sale of rare artifacts. The artifacts listed on the network included items from the High Republic Era.
Level 121 was a relatively quiet section of Cloud City on Bespin. The Ugnaught Recnelo Cott preferred to live on the level instead of with her family in a busier part of the city.
Level 142 was a section of Cloud City on Bespin. It contained the Azure Den, an underground gambling site.
A pirate frigate was frigate utilized by a pirate group. During a battle in the Mirrin sector, Rapier Leader Poe Dameron was captured and interrogated on the frigate by the pirates.
During the era of the New Republic a battle took place between Rapier Squadron and a pirate group in the Mirrin sector. Rapier Squadron was lead by Commander Poe Dameron.

Celwis was a planet of the Chiss Ascendancy and a stronghold of the Xodlak family. It was located beyond the eastern edge of Chiss Space in the Celwis system in the Unknown Regions. Though Celwis was economically valuable, the world was politically insignificant.

A starship hailing from the region of the galaxy beyond the Unknown Regions known as "Lesser Space" carried Galactic Republic technology and held human survivors by 19 BBY. The vessel was seized by a task force of the Chiss Ascendancy's Chaf family.

Boropacc was the capital city of the planet Rapacc, homeworld of the Paccosh species. When the Paccosh drove out the Nikardun forces that had invaded their planet, the city underwent damage, both from the Nikardun destroying what they could as they fled and from the Paccosh in…

The Midsummer was a frigate in service to the Chiss Ascendancy's Xodlak family, serving as part of their planetary defense fleet, though it was stationed on the surface and was derelict and abandoned.
The Apogee was a light cruiser in service to the Chiss Ascendancy's Xodlak family, serving as part of their planetary defense fleet, though it was stationed in orbit as a defense platform.

Sunrise, as it was named by the Chiss species, was a planet located in the Unknown Regions Sunrise system. The world was covered by mountains, forests, and rivers, as well as a compound located near a nyix metal mine.

A light freighter was owned by the chief Fardi of the Fardi clan in the year after the formation of the Galactic Empire. It was based in the shipyard of the clan's compound, which was on the planet Thabeska in the Thabeska system, until the former Jedi Ahsoka Tano
Shihon was a planet in the Shihon system in Chiss Space, in grid square E-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid in the Unknown Regions.

Hoxim, often referred to as the "Agbui mining world," was an unclaimed and uninhabited planet in the Unknown Regions. Its terrain consisted of forests and grasslands as well as rugged mountains and small swaths of desert, but it had extremely acidic soil.
Copero was an astronomical object of the Chiss Ascendancy located in the Unknown Regions, situated in the Copero system near the Ascendancy's east and southeast sectors.

leader: Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious
x: The Tankers were a type of guard created as part of a wider cloning effort and located on the Sith planet of Exegol, specifically stationed on the Sith Citadel on the planet's surface.
The Agbui, nicknamed Scratchlings, were a sentient species that resided within the Unknown Regions. Their members possessed a form ability of telepathy, able to read a being's emotions by touch.

A ship was owned by Chardri Tage and his partner and co-pilot, Tamsin, in the year after the formation of the Galactic Empire. Bail Organa sent the pair in their starship to locate a former Jedi, Ahsoka Tano, though he did not tell them whom he sought.
A starship was owned by an agent of the Black Sun criminal syndicate. It was equipped with two engines and armed with powerful cannons. In 18 BBY, the starship was well-maintained and no longer new.

R2-H7 was a green-and-white R2-series astromech droid in the Royal Naboo Security Forces who traveled to the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY in the astromech socket of an N-1 starfighter piloted by Captain Gregar Typho.
A-Foroon was a planet located in the Arkanis sector within Outer Rim Territories. A-Foroon was the homeworld of the Hutt Arok.
The Magys's people were a sentient species that resided within the Unknown Regions and hailed from the planet Sunrise. The Magys was a Force-sensitive member of the species.

Wazta was a location in the galaxy that was the site of the Wazta emergence during the High Republic Era. Two Hassarians were injured in the Emergence and transported to the Starlight Beacon space station to receive medical care.
Soika was a terrestrial planet which was the homeworld of the Soikan species. It was located in the Soika system in the Inner Rim Territories, in grid square M-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The mission to the Malaga Cluster was a diplomatic mission undertaken in 232 BBY by Jedi Master Avar Kriss, Jedi Knight Nib Assek, and Assek's Padawan Burryaga Agaburry, to the Malaga Cluster to negotiate a trade agreement between the Ayelina and Ludmere.

The Wazta emergence was one of the Emergences of the Great Hyperspace Disaster, in which debris from the destroyed freighter Legacy Run were launched out of hyperspace at great speeds in locations across the Outer Rim Territories.
A bodyguard droid with masculine programming was owned by Ambassador Ceeril of Rion during the High Republic Era.

A detention center was located onboard the Starlight Beacon space station. After the Skembo Ambassador Ceeril was discovered to have staged an assassination attempt against himself to try and frame two Hassarian patients in the station medcenter, Marshal Avar Kriss ordered Cee…

The security tower was a section of the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon. Unlike the rest of the station, it lacked elaborate decoration and looked very plain. Evidence room three was located there.

Evidence room three was a room in the security tower of the Starlight Beacon space station. The remains of a bodyguard droid belonging to Ambassador Ceeril were placed in the room after the droid was destroyed during an assassination attempt on the diplomat.

The massacre on Suba Tren was an incident that took place on Suba Tren in which a number of Frizznoths were massacred. Vap Tomulus was involved in the massacre, later claiming that he had not murdered the Frizznoths on purpose.

The Ravenous was a Star Destroyer that served in the navy of the Galactic Empire. The Ravenous once stopped Han Solo and Chewbacca's ship, the Millennium Falcon in the Saavin system, though Solo managed to disguise his identity.

x: During the Imperial Era, sometime after the Duel on Cloud City, the Sith Lord Darth Vader undertook a mission to the planet Exegol in the galaxy's Unknown Regions to confront his Sith Master, the Galactic Emperor and Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious, also known as Sheev Pal…

result: Clone Force 99 escapes Kamino with Omega, but without their former mem
x: Shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire, the members of Clone Force 99 were forced to escape the planet Kamino.

result: Clone Force 99 lets Saw Gerrera and his people leave peacefully
objective: Eliminate Saw Gerrera and his insurgents
x: Shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire, the irregular clone commando unit Clone Force 99 was sent on a mission to Onderon to wipe out a supposed separatist outpost.

An island was located on Glee Anselm. During the reign of an empress, members of the Anselmi species claimed and settled the island. When the Anselmi outgrew the island's natural space, they constructed a series of dams to push back the surrounding oceans.

M4-Y10 was a small astromech droid present on the planet Tatooine in 3626 BBY. The droid had black plating and antenna along with a red photoreceptor and stripes across its three legs and on the left side of its body. The right side had a white stripe.

V1C-0RY was an shopkeeper droid stationed aboard Carrick Station, a Galactic Republic space station, during the Cold War between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The droid functioned as a business vendor on the station and claimed to have an extensive inventory.

t: Battle in the Bright Jewel system
x: During the High Republic Era, a battle was fought in the Bright Jewel system near Ord Mantell between a Galactic Republic-Jedi Order starfighter force and a group of Nihil pirates.

The Resource Reclamation Initiative was an initiative by the Galactic Republic during and after the war against Zakuul. On Carrick Station, announcements were periodically broadcast to incentivize individuals on the station to donate their junk to the initiative.
A prison planet was located in the Grehollo system, a part of the Manoe sector in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim that also contained the prison moon Captivity.

Tulgah Heights was a location on the Forest Moon of Endor that shared its name with the Endorian Tulgah species and was home to witches. The Ewoks of Bright Tree Village told stories about the witches around campfires and considered the witches "malevolent."

Ashla was a moon of the planet Tython. For millennia, it was held as a sacred world to the Jedi Order. Members of the Order would travel to the moon so they could meditate on disturbances and visions they would find troubling.

Wingmaws were a species of carnivorous flying creature that could be found on Ashla, the primary moon of the Deep Core planet Tython. They would feed by picking the flesh from the bones of already-deceased prey.

R2-RN8W was a rainbow-colored astromech droid that enjoyed celebrating with others on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. Its dome had primary photo receptors, radar eyes, a data card reader, and a Herner optical holographic projector.

The Tipoca City Training Facility, also known as the Kamino training room, was a location within the Tipoca City Military Complex on the planet Kamino that was used by the Kaminoan cloners to train clone cadets.
A cafeteria was present within the Tipoca City Military Complex where clones would eat food.

result: Clone Force 99 escapes with their damaged shuttle
The Lawquanes successfully board a passenger shuttle offworld
x: Shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire, a skirmish took place at a spaceport town on Saleucami between the fugitive clone commandos Clone Force 99 and Imperial clone troopers.

A training course was located on the Outer Rim moon Ajan Kloss. Situated in the Klosslands, the course was used by Leia Organa to instruct her Padawan Rey in the ways of the Jedi during the First Order-Resistance War in 35 ABY.

The monzu was a predatory species found on the planet Zolan. As a result of a spike of solar radiation from Zolan's sun, the monzu and various other species on the world developed the ability to alter their skin color and change their body shape as an adaptation.

Rugosa giant beetles were a species of beetle native to the coral forests of Rugosa. The beetles had light-purple skin. Yoda and a group of clone troopers encountered the beetles during a mission to the moon Rugosa.
Unidentified Rugosa snakes were a purple-skinned species of snake native to the coral forests of Rugosa. They lived inside the ground, only with a small stub of their body sticking out.

Saleucami town was a spaceport town that existed on the planet Saleucami at the beginning of the Imperial Era. Controlled by the Galactic Empire, it contained an impound lot used by Imperial forces to hold seized starships.

BU-11 was a BU-series bartender droid who worked in Ziro's Palace during the Clone Wars. It served a Trandoshan a glowing green cup. It reacted as Senator Padmé Amidala entered the room with HELIOS-3D.

R4-H5 was an astromech droid utilized by the Nautolan Jedi Master Kit Fisto at the First Battle of Geonosis in 22 BBY. Since that battle marked the outbreak of the Clone Wars, Fisto was assigned a new droid, R6-H5, by the Jedi Order.

Gonky was a defective GNK-series power droid, who served Clone Force 99 aboard the Marauder. Wrecker frequently used the droid as a weightlifting aid. As a defective unit, Gonky's power unit could not fully charge.
The surtop was a carnivorous creature found on the planet Troiken. By the time of the Galactic Empire, they lived primarily in zoological preserves.
The skizzard was a creature found on the planet Troiken. Skizzards were sometimes featured in the native Xextos' mosaic artwork that were designed to evoke feelings of speed and motion.
Sreeharlo was a location on the planet Dressel that was led by a governor. Orrimaarko served as governor of Sreeharlo before joining the Dressellian resistance.
The Mercenary Guild of Coyn were a group of mercenaries. By the time of the Clone Wars, the guild had operated for decades and centuries, having a host of seasoned warriors at their disposal.
Qibbu's Hut was a hangout on Coruscant. Clone troopers would visit at times.

Jungle Felucians were a primitive sentient species of amphibians native to the Outer Rim Territories planet Felucia. Members of the species were tuned to the ever-changing presence of the Force on their homeworld.
The Ordo Moon Dragon was a species of nocturnal creature native to the Ordo Moon. It fed on raw energy.

The Ordo Moon was a rocky moon that orbited a blue gas giant in the Bortele sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It had a thin atmosphere and was home to the Ordo Moon Dragon, a creature that fed on raw energy.

The Kanji Criminal Enterprise, also known simply as the Kanji, was a criminal group that operated on Nar Kanji with the Kanji Hutts. They were involved in the pit fighting in the Garkata Fighting Arena, and protected the fighter Wyrmen Lictor.

result: All Partisan soldiers and civilians present are killed
Saw Gerrera's location becomes lost to the Empire
objective: Eliminate Saw Gerrera
x: During the Onderon insurgency, a mission to Onderon occurred shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire.
A group of creatures was native to the moon Noaxson. The creature had Pink hair, yellow eyes and a beak. The creature had two large legs and was used to ride on by pirates.
The Talortai were an avian sentient species that possessed feathers and clawed feet. Talortai hailed from Talor, an astronomical object that featured tropics.

The Jade Starunner was a starship in operation during the Galactic Civil War. The vessel was owned by Vendi Kjleno, a war hero of the Rebel Alliance who fought during the Battle of Yavin. By 1 ABY, Kjleno was attacked by Imperial forces in the Endor system.
Talor was a tropical astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories's Varada sector that was home to the Talortai, a species strong in the Force that was once massacred by the Sith.
Rystan was a cold, inhospitable planet located in Wild Space. A freezing world, it maintained a habitable zone that could sustain some life, including creatures like the slarga.

Rystan's habitable band was a section of land on the freezing planet Rystan that was able to support life. Though not as inhospitable as other areas of the planet, the habitable band was still plagued by intense cold and wind.
The Golamaran ice flats was a fielded region of the planet Rystan that was home to a location known as the Shrine.

Slarga were large creatures native to the planet Rystan. Strong animals with thick, shaggy pelts, slarga were capable of traversing through the harsh elements of the freezing world and were used as beasts of burden.
Rust-weevils were a species of insectoid creatures native to the planet Rystan that were known to feed on metal objects.
During the Galactic Civil War, an uprising took place in the Atrivis sector, a sector located in the Outer Rim Territories.

A garrison was associated with a Trandoshan clan, of which Pekt was a member. The garrison contained Wookiee prisoners-of-war who had been captured as part of the longstanding rivalry between the two species.
