The Asteroid Bandits, also known as the Mining Pirates, were a group of pirates active in many different star systems in the galaxy during the Galactic Civil War.

A B1 battle droid in the Geonosian droid army served in the Petranaki Arena during the First Battle of Geonosis. The battle droid had its head accidentally grafted onto the chassis of C-3PO when the protocol droid had gotten trapped in the droid factory's conveyor belt system.

Calior was a planet situated in the Seitia sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Inhabited by humans, Calior was controlled by a regional government.

An ambush occurred in the Valo system against the forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic by the Galactic Empire. Imperial agent Lyle Kullan had infiltrated the Rebel Alliance's Rogue Squadron in an attempt to capture Commander Luke Skywalker.

Vincorba was a rocky planet located in the Vincorba system in the Piryn Shar sector of the Expansion Region. Its inhabitants included humans and members of a bipedal species, while the pontiff of a religious cult was a ruling figure on Vincorba.

A sentient species resided on the Expansion Region planet Vincorba. The species was bipedal, possessing protrusions on either side of their face and tendrils atop their head. On Vincorba, a member of the species held the leading title of pontiff during the Imperial Era.

The Gotal Bandits were a group of pirates present in the Kashyyyk system during the Galactic Civil War. They had a base located near the edge of the star system that provided a string tactical advantage for their raids against civilian traffic.
G-90, or Gee-Ninety, was a Jayosbrand assassin droid who was part of the Assassin's Guild in the Imperial Era. The droid had a large spherical body with a head that protruded from the top.

The Revengers, with its members dubbed "heroes," were a group that operated during the Imperial Era. Led by Ankala Sahm and consisting of S'ira and Tanka, all three of whose homes had been destroyed by the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate, their goal was to pursue operatives of…

The Chiss Poachers were a group of Chiss hunters present in the Kashyyyk system during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, the Chiss were active in the Etyyy region of Kashyyyk where they maintained a settlement.
Hold 6 was a cargo hold on Orca-class freighter, Freighter 2716. It contained a massive Kyber crystal and was guarded by Death trooper, DT-F16 and her squad.

The Portmaster's office was an office located in the Trannon district of Carannia, the capital city of the Outer Rim Territories planet Serenno. The office was far from the Carannia Spaceport and controlled space travel to and from the spaceport.

Gus Talon was a moon of the planet Corellia. During the High Republic Era, the Nihil marauder organization undertook a plan that involved operations on Corellia as well as Gus Talon, which would be overseen by Sabata Krill, a member of the cell led by Krix Kamerat.
Endovar was a terrestrial planet located in the Endovar system within the Terrabe sector of the Mid Rim and the Interior. It was situated in grid square M-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The spine dragon was a type of creature. Tarl Sokoli, a war hero of the Galactic Empire, was known as the "Spine Dragon of Anaxes."

The Kerrakk were an insectoid sentient species whose members were grouped in hives. A hive of Kerrakk enforcers operated during the Imperial Era, but were killed by the bounty hunter crew led by T'onga after they attempted to rob the Carbon Score Cantina on Burnin Konn.
A hive of Kerrakk enforcers operated during the Imperial Era. On Burnin Konn, the Kerrakk enforcers attempted to rob the Carbon Score Cantina after its bartender failed to pay protection.
The Forerunner II was a light cruiser in the service of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. It was commanded by Admiral Tarl Sokoli, an Imperial war hero.
Arashar was an astronomical object in the Arashar system of the Inner Rim Territories situated in grid square J-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It appeared blue-green from space.

The Court Of Justice was the court of the planet Mon Cala. In 34 ABY, Resistance General Leia Skywalker Organa Solo led a mission to Mon Cala to get starships needed for their navy. But Chewbacca, Rose Tico, and Rey were attacked by a Quarren mob but were accused of the crime.

Following the Battle of Endor, Grand Moff Ardus Kaine declared himself a warlord, seeing it as an opportunity and set about creating his own faction in the Outer Rim, where it soon joined with local leaders from the Velcar Free Commerce Zone and established the Pentastar Align…
A gang of pirates led by Eyan McDermitt operated on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

Sometime after the Rakatan invasion of Korriban, an ice age occurred on the planet Ziost, originally a thickly forested world with a warm climate, that leveled the vast woodlands as well as most evidence of civilization.

Bogo Rai was an astronomical object located within the territory of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Ascendancy nation. It was situated in grid square E-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid, within the Bogo Rai system.

Yashuvhu was an astronomical object located within the territory of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Ascendancy government. The celestial body was in the Yashuvhu system, situated in grid square F-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Wordro's organization, run by Wordro the Hutt, suffered hijackings of its shipments during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

The Torton Runner was a heavy freighter owned by the Hidden Daggers pirates during the Galactic Civil War. In 1 ABY, the Hidden Daggers obtained sensitive information about Imperial operations on Corellia and planned to deliver the data to the Rebel Alliance.
The Nerfs Pride was a YT-1300 light freighter owned by the Alderaanian diplomat Darmin Lerspri during the Galactic Civil War.

The amphibious wolf was a type of wolf native to the Expansion Region planet Shaymore. During a joint effort by the native Sessehshellah and the Rebel Alliance to expel a Galactic Empire hydrocarbon extraction operation from Shaymore, a pack of amphibious wolves attacked a Reb…
A Paccian gunboat was piloted by the Chiss Mid Captain Csap'ro'strob "Apros" of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet at the battle in the Sunrise system known as Senior Captain Thrawn's last stand.
Slingshot was a united persona, consisting of a modified droideka piloted by the Ugnaught Dizzy. Slingshot was active following the fall of the Galactic Empire.

This camp was located on the planet Ziost and was used by a group of researchers. Nearly nine years after the Battle of Endor, when the Jedi scholar Tionne Solusar set out to find Kalgrath, the researchers informed her that they noted a dark shadows lurking around their camp a…
The Livorno were a species native to the astronomical object Livorno, which was ruled by Queen Prizzi.

Caramm V was a planet in the Caramm system within the Talcene sector of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice. It was situated in grid square R-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Cargo Bay 17 was a cargo bay on the Orca-class freighter, Freighter 2716. It contained prisoners captured by the Empire to help build the first Death Star.

Ladybright, also known as Bright, was a droid member of the Orphans, a group led by the bounty hunter Chanath Cha. Similar to the other members of the Orphans—who, as the group's name suggested, had lost their parents—Ladybright was the last of their factory line.
In the battle, Dao's flagship had suffered critical damages to its essential systems and was dangerously low on fuel and ammunition.

The Siroto was a starship utilized by the Orphans, a group led by the bounty hunter Chanath Cha, during the time of the Galactic Empire. The members of the Orphans—the droid Ladybright, Sear, and Imara Vex—operated under Cha aboard the vessel.

TA1313 was a T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid who was part of the Confederacy of Independent Systems' navy during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, the tactical droid served in the personal flotilla of Separatist leader Count Dooku.

Tunnel Team Twelve was a unit of the security crew led by Alys Ongwa that was active during the crew's mission to protect Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh while she visited Corellia. Smeemarm reported in for the unit from the underbelly of Coronet City.

Sector two zero nine was a sector of the jungle planet Hissrich.
TK-37059 was an Imperial supply shuttle used by Theron Shan, Jedi Master Gnost-Dural, and the smuggler Teff'ith to travel to Reaver Station.

Gorvich's private hangar was a hangar owned by the smuggler Gorvich. Prior to traveling to Reaver Station, Theron Shan, Jedi Master Gnost-Dural, and the smuggler Teff'ith visited the hangar with Gorvich.

A private hangar was owned by the Kel Dor Jedi Master Gnost-Dural on the planet Coruscant. Gnost-Dural kept the TZ-6 executive shuttle Prosperity at the hangar, which he and Theron Shan used on their mission to Ziost.

During the Galactic War, Theron Shan and Jedi Master Gnost-Dural infiltrated the Sith Empire vessel Ascendant Spear in order to the sabotage it and allow the Galactic Republic to destroy it as part of an ambush at Duro.

The Darkpath was a frigate utilized by the Black Sun criminal syndicate during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Adorned with a yellow Black Sun logo on the front, the ship was owned by the Black Sun boss Lord Gyuti. The ship had a large hangar that could accommodate many ships.
Yeksom was a terrestrial planet in the Yeksom system in the Antemeridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories, along the Perlemian Trade Route.
Japeal was a terrestrial planet with a temperate climate in the Japeal system in the Kanz sector of the Outer Rim Territories, situated along the Veragi Trade Route.

Tais Brabbo was a planet in the Tais Brabbo system in the Shadola sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Crime-ridden, Tais Brabbo's corruption was such that the Hutts were rumored to have decided against moving some of their operations there.

A veranda in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant was decorated with stained glass windows. One of them depicted Jedi Master and Jedi Lord Valenthyne Farfalla who served the Jedi Order during the Ruusan campaign of the New Sith Wars.

JJ-5145, nicknamed Forfive, was a logistics droid that served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
The sand beast, also known as a sand ape, was a species of large, predatory, reptilian creature with six limbs that lived on the planet of Tatooine.

In 3 ABY, the Imperial Admiral Tarl Sokoli was assassinated by the Imperial Dark Squadron leader Beilert Valance outside the Eriadu system.

Choss was a planet located in the Choss system in the Colonies. Rey, Chewbacca, Moebin Faltus, and Finn visited the planet to get repairs for the Millennium Falcon. The planet had forests and a large city.
A city was located on the planet Choss. While vendors and shops lined the streets and markets, there were also skyscrapers located throughout the city.

Needlefish were a species of fish that lived in the underwater seatree forests of the Mkbuto Seatree Preserve on the Outer Rim Territories planet Dac. The Preserve hosted a delicate ecosystem that, in addition to the needlefish, was home to tumblebaskers and blossoming gulpers.

The Training Grounds were an area on the moon Yavin 4. The Imperial Guard Academy was built by the Sith Empire at the center of this area.
A species of green-skinned reptavian flying monstrosities that resembled miniature dragons inhabited the planet Ziost.
Onod was a planet located in the Onod system of the Irnaj sector, a part of the Mid Rim Territories and the Western Reaches.
Laecor was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Laecor system in the Kallea sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to a village whose residents had been sympathetic to the Jedi Order.
A village was situated on Laecor in the Outer Rim. It was home to a group of locals who had long been sympathizers of the Jedi Order.

The Strassi family, also referred to as the Trandoshan family, was a crime family that operated on the planet Tatooine during the New Republic Era, which was known for protecting the Mos Espa city center and its business territories.

The blutfish was a type of fish. Between 1 ABY and 3 ABY, Rebel pilot Ibti Myrak was stationed on the MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser, the Home One after her reckless actions during the attack in the Cilpar system.

The lighting of lanterns was a ceremony on the Mid Rim Territories planet of Kijimi that evolved from an act of basic survival. It was practiced by the Dai Bendu monks during the cold nights, and was held to express gratitude.
The Ardok Ranch was located on the Chiss Ascendancy planet Ool and was owned by Cohbo'rik'ardok, known by the core name "Borika", and her husband Bomarmo.

The Verdigris Hills were located on the mining world Elphrona and contained a deposit of nova crystals. Between 247 BBY and 232 BBY, Jedi Master Porter Engle discovered herbs growing out from the hills' crystal deposits and decided to use them in his cooking.

Grid 24B-30 the designation of a set of land on the planet Elphrona. It contained an aurodium mine that suffered a collapse during the High Republic Era, prompting Jedi Loden Greatstorm and Bell Zettifar to lead a rescue operation from the Elphrona Outpost.

An aurodium mine was located in Grid 24B-30 of the planet Elphrona. During the High Republic Era, Freeno, one of several Er'kit miners searching for the mineral aurodium, discovered a valuable kantak crystal in the mine and attempted to unearth it with his rockspanner.

A quadruped droid was utilized by the bounty hunter Boba Fett while he worked on the Outer Rim Territories planet Carajam between around 2 BBY and 4 ABY. Fett rode the droid while transporting the corpse of a rebel pilot he had captured across a desert.

AL-42 was a train operator droid who operated a train for the Pyke Syndicate. In 5 ABY, the droid operated a train that made its way across the Dune Sea, killing various Tusken Raiders and their banthas along the way.
The Order of the Night Wind, or simply the Night Wind, was an order of assassins that were located in Hutt Space.
Gazian was a living planet in the Mid Rim's Gazian system. It was covered by the Living Sea, a large, deep growth of mushrooms with hallucinatory spores. The area was strong in the Force.

A tribe of Tusken Raiders was active on the Dune Sea of Tatooine following the rescue of Han Solo by his companions from Tatooine Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure. The tribe was led by a chieftain and used black clothing and garments.
The Twins, also known as the Hutt Twins, referred to a Hutt brother and sister who were crime lords during the New Republic Era.
The death pits of Duur were a location in the galaxy.

A Horned gekko was a species of lizard native to the desert planet Tatooine. Capable of crawling inside a host being's body and creating hallucinations, the lizard was used by Tusken Raiders to guide individuals on spiritual journeys.

The Talid were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. A male podracer Gen-Goma was a member of the species. By sometime during or after 5 ABY, a large statue of a Talid could be found on the planet Ando Prime.

Clan Shale was a respected Mandalorian clan active during the third Galactic War. At some point, Clan Shale faced a critical conflict with the newly risen Clan Nerak, leading to a dramatic duel between their leaders, ultimately preserving their clan's honor.

A droid was stationed at the Jedi Order's Elphrona Outpost during the High Republic Era. It alerted the Jedi that inhabited the outpost of any pressing matters, including those that involved the wellbeing of Elphrona's citizens.
A species of bird was native to the Outer Rim planet Dathomir. The birds cleaned the teeth of the rancor when they got dirty.

Chespea was a forest world in the Outer Rim Territories' Rayter sector. During the High Republic Era, it was the location of a Jedi temple.
The Fian were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy that possessed a higher resistance to radiation than that of humans.

Long before 230 BBY, the Umbaran female Jedi youngling Orla Jareni was part of a group of younglings within the Jedi Order at the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.

Beekmonkeys were a type of monkey. While trapped aboard the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon in 230 BBY, the pilot Leox Gyasi mentally compared fellow pilot Koley Linn—who he had a history of unpleasant encounters with—to a beekmonkey.

A carax was a large six-legged insectoid creature species. During the Galactic Civil War, Rrynt'vor, the overlord of the Rak'qua tribe, owned a carax named Ageaughu. After the Battle of Yavin, the beast lived in a cave of Station Gamma, in the Bright Jewel system.

A species of small animals were present on a planet in Wild Space to which the Chiss Mitth'raw'nuruodo was exiled. Thrawn used the animals to sneak explosives past an Imperial encampment's sentry perimeter.

The Enso were a sentient species from the Ensolica system. Around 230 BBY, the defense minister of the planet Eiram was an Enso woman.
The war room was an atrium-like room with high ceilings inside the Dai Bendu Monastery on the Mid Rim Territories planet of Kijimi. Around 19 ABY, it was one of the sites of the Kijimi summit.
The Spectre was a starship in the service of the Nihil pirates during the High Republic Era. It was commanded by a captain who had bad blood with Roborhyan, another member of the marauders.
A raid was conducted against a Pyke Syndicate repulsortrain by a Tusken Raider tribe, led by Boba Fett.

The Aqualish crime family was part of Jabba's criminal empire when it was led by Lord Bib Fortuna following Jabba's death.

J7R-T was an R5 series astromech droid that was active during the New Republic Era, serving in the palace of Daimyo, Boba Fett.

The Carannian hills were a group of hills on the planet Serenno located outside the capital city of Carannia. By 42 BBY, a lookout was established in view of Carannia.
The Meerians were a sentient species. They could have silver skin and gold hair. One Meerian, Yeet, was a member of the Nihil.
Thelj was a planet located four sectors away from the planet Dalna and was home to a population of varied settlers.

The Silver Moon of Acomber was a moon upon which the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk'wassak'Cradossk once collected a bounty.

The Rycep asteroid belt was an asteroid field in the Rycep system in the Jjannex sector of the Outer Rim Territories, situated along the Lipsec Run. It was located just one hyperspace jump away from the Anoat system.

Asteroid X342 was an asteroid located in the Rycep asteroid belt, just one jump away from the Anoat system. While hunting the criminal known as "Chainbreaker" in the belt, the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk'wassak'Cradossk hid his starship, the Hound's Tooth, on Asteroid X342.
Pincer fleas were fleas that could live on members of the Wookiee species. While infiltrating the Wookiee starship Liswarr, a pincer flea landed on the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk'wassak'Cradossk.
Kara Xoo's Tempest was a Tempest of the Nihil pirate organization that was led by the Quarren Kara Xoo during the High Republic Era. The Tempest recruited in part by kidnapping children during raids.
Quaymoon betting parlor was a betting parlor in the Hutt Space.

A battle occurred in the Nefitifi system during the High Republic Era's Nihil conflict. Multiple Jedi onboard a Longbeam cruiser were able to board and capture a Nihil starship, as the pirates swiftly surrendered.

Rampa II Port Authority was an organization operating in the Port Hoshim on Rampa II.

Matton Dasol's crew was a freighter crew that worked with the Human male Matton Dasol during the Jedi Civil War. They visited the planet of Kashyyyk often and acquired a large debt to the merchant Eli Gand.

Rim's Edge was a cantina located in the pit of an abandoned monastery, which became an outpost, on a nameless planet eventually named Freerock.

The Grysk leadership was the leadership of the Grysk warlike species. Generalirius Nakirre, the leader of the Kilji species' government, the Kilji Illumine, wished to enlighten all Grysks to the Kilji beliefs, and thought that becoming a partner of the Grysk leadership would a…
A droid was once owned by the Force-sensitive human female Reva Sevander, though it was later taken from her.

The Rishii were the inhabitants of the planet Rishi. They were an intelligent avian species that lived in high mountains. The Rishii were cordial and uninterested in advanced technology, choosing to remain relatively isolated.
An engagement occurred on the planet Rishi during the Clone Wars when Geonosians of the Confederacy of Independent Systems attempted to conquer Rishi for its resources.
A long-necked creature was native to the planet Irff. At some point, Biggs Darklighter and Jek Tono Porkins rode on this creature during a vacation.

Boosodia was a celestial body located in the Boosodia system of the Inner Rim Territories in grid square N-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the homeworld of the sentient Boosodian species, including the forger Amuncie Tidian.

A lake on the planet Langston was located in its mining district. In 22 BBY, during an aid mission, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and Jedi Initiate Mill Alibeth witnessed younglings playing Blitzball in the lake.
The Jasserak Lowlands was a region located on the Tanlassa continent of the planet Drongar. The Jasserak Highlands formed the border of the region.

The prescreen department was a department of the Galactic Empire staffed by Imperial officers that screened incoming information from the bureaucracy, including productivity reports, messages, and invitations.

Sophros, which translated as "the Balance," also known informally as Planet X, which it was dubbed by the prospector Radicaz "Sunshine" Dobbs, was a planet located in Wild Space that sat on the edge of the Galactic Frontier.
The Mapuzo mining village was a Galactic Empire–controlled mining town located on the planet Mapuzo. The town was home to an Hidden Path safehouse.

A community was located on the Core Worlds planet Chandrila near Lake Sah'ot. It was visited by medical officer Zahara Cody and former prisoner Trig Longo after they escaped from the Imperial prison barge Purge.

An OOM command battle droid was the leader of Patrol 118 in the Separatist Droid Army. During the Onderonian Civil War, the droid led a patrol in the city of Iziz on Onderon when they were ambushed by the Onderon rebels.

A sentient species once lived in the Outer Rim Territories' Arath system. Shara'Tam, a moon in the system, housed a statue that remained as proof of the species' existence millennia after it was created.

Sleek was a species of flightless bird, hunted to near-extinction for their delicious meat centuries before the Galactic War, with only one small colony surviving on a remote Fondor island around 3630 BBY.
A type of flock-dwelling avian creature with quicksilver wings dwelt on the Core Worlds planet Chandrila.

Shara'Tam was an arid moon in the Arath system, located within the Outer Rim Territories and Galactic Frontier. The Jedi Sturm Umbrik led an expedition there that discovered treasure and confirmed that a sentient race had once lived in the moon's star system.
The Republic Pathfinders conducted expeditions in the Outer Rim Territories for the Galactic Republic and often worked alongside the Jedi Order.
Kadrillians were a sentient species from the Kadril system in the Outer Rim Territories. They possessed terrapin half-shells, and had scaled skin which could be orange in hue.

A communications team or comms team was responsible for receiving messages via EX droids from Republic Pathfinders who were far away in the Outer Rim Territories. They would then set up a string of relay buoys to keep the Republic in contact with the frontier worlds.
Devalok was a terrestrial planet known for its gardens and gardeners that was located in the Devalok system in the Altier sector of the Expansion Region.
A city was located on the planet Devalok. The city's northern district contained the Amrit spaceport.
The Pasaana Plains was a location on Pasaana where many travelers had ventured through to get to the Forbidden Valley.
The Kijimi Crooks were a gang on the planet Kijimi. After seeing a bounty poster of Rey Skywalker, they decided to go after her.
Antsy Astromech was a Astromech droid found in Kef Bir Space.
The Company 77 Village was a location on Kef Bir where the Company 77 soldiers and residents lived. The village consisted of a farm and museum, and was surrounded by mountains and lakes.

Daring Droid was an astromech droid found in Exegol space that was aligned with the Resistance. As the First Order was pinning down the Resistance, this droid, along with a protocol droid, went out to rescue soldiers nearby.
The Wookiee Choir was a band of Wookiees consisting of four singers and the Choir Master.

The Rodian rot-worm was a parasitic worm that shared its name with Rodia, a planet of jungle and oceans located in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories, as well as its native Rodian species of sentient reptilians.

A crew of at least four members was headed by the Weequay Jarl on the planet Coruscant. In 22 BBY, they became aware of a valuable EX droid in the possession of the Mirialan Servit. The crew followed him to Dex's Diner, where they held up the customers at blaster point.

Char rat were a type of rat. Sometime between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Tasu Leech—a member of the bounty hunter T'onga's crew—called the bounty hunter Dengar a "double-crossing char rat" after the latter left the crew on the flagship of the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn after he had…

G-1FY or Iffy was an old protocol droid who worked on the Wookiee starship Namrelllew in 22 BBY. Shortly after the beginning of the Clone Wars, he encountered Senator Padmé Amidala when she went undercover on the ship on a mission for the Galactic Senate.

The Starheart was a gunship that served as the command ship of the New Republic's Halo Squadron. The Starheart intercepted a freighter carrying Dathan, Miramir, and Rey as it was chased by forces of the Sith Eternal.

A starship was utilized by a criminal group in 3 ABY. The starship was in space above when Luke Skywalker flew his T-65B X-wing starfighter near the ship. The group's boss wanted a T-65 and the captain ordered the starship to use it's magna-harpoons to fire at the ship.

Desinta was an ice planet in the Morshdine sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Sometime between the years 42 BBY and 32 BBY, Desinta was embroiled in a civil war between the Desintian government, led by the nominally elected Prefect Aminar, and multiple other factions, includ…
Chimeraleons were a species of half-dragon, half-jungle-cat predators. These creatures could change color to blend into their environment. They had razor-sharp jaws and they could breathe fire.

Zerek Besh was a criminal syndicate that came into prominence during the Galactic Civil War and had influence into the farthest reaches of the galaxy.
The Toren crime family, also known as Papa Toren's group, was a crime family led by the crime lord Toren that was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

The Neimoidian faction was the faction of the Trade Federation controlled by members of the Neimoidian species, who leveraged control over the entire Federation. As such, it was not the only faction of the Federation controlled by Neimoidians.

Rylorii Minor was a neutral mining planet located in the Rylorii Minor system in the Rocantor sector of the Expansion Region.

ZZ-10 was a droid who accompanied the Wookiee male Jedi Arkoff during the High Republic Era. He was buried on the planet Banchii with Azlin Rell's journal to protect it until he was discovered by the Nihil pirate organization.
The Dank Graks were a group of criminals whose members were mostly rejects from dark side of the Force cults, active in 382 BBY.

Vernost was a volcanic planet and the only place in the galaxy where the "miracle liquid" Ceela was found. In 2 ABY, the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire battled over the Ceela in the canyons of the planet.

The Aqualish Quarter was a location in the Worker's District in Mos Espa, Tatooine.

Tibidon sand whales, or just sand whales, were a relative of the tibidee that was native to the desert planet Tatooine. Measuring three hundred meters in length, the sand whales used their pectoral fins and a tail fluke to propel themselves through either sand or air.
A nameless rocky barren moon not far from Jabiim was the site of a duel between Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and the Sith Lord Darth Vader in the year 9 BBY.
This moon was one of fifteen moons that orbited the Outer Rim planet Geonosis.
Tessen was a celestial body in the Tessen system of the Phelleem sector in the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice that fell within grid square S-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

A species of beings was found throughout the galaxy that included among its members Armo Malou, a bartender who worked at the Canto Casino and Racetrack on Cantonica. Another member worked as a supply store clerk on Tatooine during the Imperial Era.

A species of white-skinned beings counted among its members Grayla Stindy, an individual who once attended the Canto Casino and Racetrack on the planet Cantonica. Members of the species sported large skin flaps that arced down from their bulbous heads.

A dark side hellscape was located in the galaxy. Its location was known to the former Sith Lord Maul and Lady Qi'ra, the leader of Crimson Dawn, but was unknown to the Sith Lords Darth Sidious and Darth Vader.
The Dan'Gar were a political party on the planet Desinta some time between 42 BBY and 32 BBY. The group were a political opposition to the worlds nominall elected leader, Prefect Aminar.
KP-1 was a masculine K-series astromech droid associated with the Hidden Path. In 9 BBY, the droid was found on the planet Jabiim.

The garu-bear was a type of hibernating bear. When a freighter carrying the child Rey and her parents Dathan and Miramir emerged from hyperspace in Wild Space in 21 ABY, it hung momentarily in space like a garu-bear coming out of a long hibernation and taking stock of its surr…

Hyperkarn was a forested planet in the Outer Rim Territories with a twilight forest where the human female Miramir lived for years with her grandmother before giving up her life there to travel with her husband Dathan, who had also lived on Hyperkarn for a period of days.

A duel took place in 241 BBY atop Mount Bikja on the planet Alaris Prime. After having ascended the mountain and entered the shrine of a dark side cult known as the Yallow Fellowship, the Zeltron Padawan Klias Teradine encountered a vitalicron that corrupted his mind.

Janx II was a gas giant located in the Janx system in the Prackla sector of the Expansion Region near the Inner Rim Territories. In 21 ABY, Boxer Point Station, a space station that functioned as a huge multipurpose port facility, was located in high orbit above Janx II.

The Errant Venture was a starship with a dedicated casino. By 21 ABY, the gambler Lando Calrissian had made one of his best hauls playing in the casino, which he considered to have a good gambling hall.

Mircapala was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Mircapala system of Wild Space. It was situated in grid S-3 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Neftali was a barren cold and frozen planet located in the Socorro system of the Outer Rim Territories. It had crystal seas and ice floes.
The second moon of the Outer Rim and New Territories planet Vernid was located in a Kanz sector's Vernid system near the Veragi Trade Route in grid square M-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Karolia was a densely forested planet located in the Belderone system of the Outer Rim Territories. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Tauntaza, the Imperial governor of the planet Gabredor III developed a piece of technology that drained the power from living things.

Antillion was a backwater world located in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, it was located in a sector governed by an Imperial governor, and was where former University of Bar'leth Sava Madelin Sun worked as a junk seller after h…
Tirn III was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Tirn system in the Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Tsukimitsurin was a jungle moon located in the Tsukimitsurin system, a star system in the Churnis sector of the Mid Rim Territories.

Primus Cabru was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Primus Cabru system within the Allied Tion sector of the Outer Rim and the Slice. It was situated on grid square S-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Primus Cabru was the site of a library.
A market moon was located in the Pirsen system in the Eidoloni sector of the Mid Rim Territories, seven parsecs away from the planet Polaar.

Bothsoliman was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Bothsoliman system within the Hollan sector of the Mid Rim and New Territories. It was situated in grid square M-7 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Jarbanov Orbital Sorting Association was a scrapping organization based at the barren Expansion Region planet Jarbanov, located at the edge of the junker systems.

CSA officers, nicknamed redcaps and Espo officers, were CSA troopers who held a position of authority and responsibility in the Corporate Sector Authority. CSA officers wore red helmets and brown field armor.
Taw Provode was a planet located in the galaxy. An Imperial fuel dump was located on the planet.

Malathon IX was a planet located in the Malathon system within the Ghost Nebula sector as part of the Expansion Region.

Ko-Longava was an astronomical object located in the Ko-Longava system within the Hocatar sector of the Expansion Region and the Slice. It was situated in grid square P-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Muqular was the homeworld of the tibanna gas–breathing Muqularan species. It was located in the Muqular system within the Montitian Grant sector of the Expansion Region and the Interior, situated in grid square J-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
A planet was ruled by the Sith Lord Viceroy Exim Panshard prior to his death. By 21 ABY, the planet had become long forgotten and the viceroy's tyrannical reign of the planet was told in legends.
Etai was a planet located in the Mid Rim Territories within the galaxy. The etaan crystal was a powerful type gemstone found on Etai that was utilized to power lightsabers.
Imperium One was the designation of an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser used by the forces of Imperial Governor Tauntaza.
Aloxl was a hot planet located in the Deep Core within the galaxy. The planet had an unusual ellipse around its gigantic star causing a 125-year hot season, and a 25-year cool season.
"Kiza's world" was the name of a large asteroid located on the edge of the Red Honeycomb Zone in the Unknown Regions.
Temako was a planet in the Temako system in the Antemeridian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was the location of Voltec's manufacturing headquarters during the Galactic Civil War.
A crew was led by the female criminal known as "the Sphox." In 21 ABY, the crew were hired to assist the Jedi hunter Ochi in his search for a young girl sought by the Sith Eternal.
Yoturba was a planet located in the Mid Rim Territories. In 21 ABY, the Lerct Historical Institute conducted an archaeological dig at a site on the planet.
A moon was located in a sector near the Inner Rim Territories. The moon, along with many others in the sector, was almost the size of a planet.
A private security service was set up and run by Nikka Xizen in the years after she left her service as a Bespin Wing Guard during Lando Calrissian's time as baron administrator of Cloud City.

M-1, or Em-One, was a scarlet former Imperial mouse droid owned by the former Acolytes of the Beyond member Komat when she lived in exile on the planet Polaar. She used M-1 as as a danger signal due to Polaar's distronic radiation poisoning.

KB-68, or Kaybee Sixty-Eight, was a Duelist Elite droid with feminine programming who was owned by a male individual on Mircapala. The individual programmed her to defend him from an attacker that never actually came.

Pasaana's moon was the bright white single natural satellite of Pasaana, a planet in the Middian system of the Ombakond sector. The planet was a part of the Expansion Region and the Slice and was situated in grid square O-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
Therezar was a gas giant located in the Therezar system. The station Nightside was located in a fixed orbit of Therezar within the planet's ring system.
Torrenoteer Minor was a desert planet located in the Torrenoteer system. It had three moons, two which were green, and the third being violet.

Polaar was a Mid Rim Territories planet located in the Polaar system within the Aubreeyan Cluster of the galaxy's Eidoloni sector. During the Galactic Civil War, a skirmish was fought near Polaar, where a Mon Calamari battle cruiser was forced to flee.

Torrenoteer Minor's third moon was the third moon of the planet Torrenoteer Minor in the Torrenoteer system. Unlike Torrenoteer Minor's other two moons, which were green, the third moon was bright violet.

Taw Provode's solitary moon was the solitary moon of the planet Taw Provode in the Taw Provode system. The moon's surface was made of thin diamond sheets held aloft by larger crystal bergs that floated in a subterranean ocean.
The Kaywhite was a Corporate Sector Authority capital ship that was the sister ship of the Emchen. The two served as the command ships of the CSA's fleet in 21 ABY.

"RogerRoger" was the online alias of a B1-series battle droid who served in the Clone Wars. At one point, he left a one star review of the All Terrain Reconnaissance Transport, citing the fact that it stomped on big metal legs as a reason for his disdain.
The Trade Federation landing zones were the areas on the Outer Rim planet Geonosis where the Trade Federation kept its core ships.

The Banshee was a Ginivex-class fanblade starfighter used by Separatist Alliance commander and Sith assassin Asajj Ventress during the Clone Wars. Ventress used the Banshee during the Battle of Sullust, and survived thanks to its design.
The Mon Calamari faction was the Mon Calamari and Quarren faction that represented their government in the Senate of the Galactic Republic.

Volta was an astronomical object in the Volta system in the Chaykin sector of the Expansion Region. The human Dathan was stopped traveling aboard a sunscooper at Volta, and instead joined up with the crew of a Twi'lek captain who was traveling to the Outer Rim Territories.

The Death Star Cafeteria was a cafeteria on the second Death Star that fed Imperial stormtroopers. The cafeteria had a menu consisting of Boba Feta Cheese, Lando Calzone, Darth Wafer, Yoda Yogurt, blue milkshake, Han Salad, and more.
The Jedi Master Quinlan Vos made use of a personal Jedi starfighter during the opening weeks of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems in 22 BBY.
The Board of Directors was the governing body of the SoroSuub Corporation, led by Chairman Siin Suub during the height of the Galactic Civil War.

A mudslide disaster occurred in the eastern regions of the secondary continent of the planet Naboo in 22 BBY. Most of a village was destroyed, with only eight children who had been onboard a school transport surviving.

Aldhani was a planet located in the Cademimu sector in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. During the Imperial Era, Cassian Andor joined the Aldhani rebel infiltration team for a mission to rob the Imperial base there.

B2EMO, also known as Bee-two or Bee, was a B2 groundmech salvage assist unit who spent years in the service of the Andor family. An old boxy droid with red plating and a black main sensor, Bee could roll on his wheels over a range of terrains.

The Traffic Division was a division of the New Republic Tribunal that regulated traffic. They were responsible for sending fines to pilots who traveled above speed limits.

The B-wing Owners' Club was a club for pilots that owned B-wings. They issued bumper stickers with a pun that compared a B-wing to a picture of a bee, and one of these stickers was collected by Poe Dameron in a vehicle guidebook.

The Coruscant Skyways Authority or CSA was a group that regulated the skyways of Coruscant. At some point, they sent a Charge Payment Order to Obi-Wan Kenobi, as his Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor did not display identification.

The First Order Family Fun Day was a day for having fun hosted by the First Order. It was intended for families, and hosted events such as visiting Kylo Ren's command shuttle, or face painting to look like Maul. A poster for it was collected by Poe Dameron in a vehicle guidebook.

In 38 BBY, a battle took place in the Unknown Regions Pleknok system between the Chiss Ascendancy government's Boadil family and the Paataatus Hiveborn government initially, and later the Ascendancy's Chiss Defense Force.
Leia's bedroom was the childhood bedroom of Princess Leia Organa of Alderaan, located on Alderaan in a high tower of the royal palace and was considered simple by royal standards.
Rockmites were insects which could supposedly burrow into and nest inside the horns of Iktotchi suffering from horn rot.

During the ongoing Galactic Civil War, the New Republic's Rogue Squadron raided a group of pirates in an area of space. Multiple pirate fighters were shot down before squadron leader Wedge Antilles ordered that the pirates be allowed to escape.
The Chadawan moon was a desolate moon, barely larger than an asteroid, which orbited Chadawa, an inhabited ocean world constructed by an ancient alien species eons before the Galactic Civil War.

Gideon's Imperial Remnant Warehouse was a warehouse located in the galaxy. It sold cruiser parts, and featured Moff Gideon in advertisements. It was affiliated with Gideon's Imperial remnant and offered discounts for founders of the First Order.
The go-zeki were a group of gangsters of the Kyuzo species known for fanatical honor and deadly skill in battle. In 19 BBY, the go-zeki were active on Nar Shaddaa, a moon of the planet Nal Hutta.

The fighter design bureau was a branch of the Incom Corporation. Alliance to Restore the Republic sympathizers within the branch designed the Alliance's T-65B X-wing starfighter.

Spintiri glowbat was a type of bat that was native to the forest planet Spintir.

The Forward Work Team was a team that worked in the crew of Resurgent-class Star Destroyers. They worked in the front of the battlecruiser, as opposed to the Rear Work Team who worked in the back. A poster advertising the team was collected by Poe Dameron in a vehicle guidebook.
The Rear Work Team was a team that worked in the crew of Resurgent-class Star Destroyers. They worked in the back of the battlecruiser, as opposed to the Forward Work Team who worked in the front.

Basta Core was a frigid scrub-covered planet that possessed blue vegetation. In 21 ABY Enric Pryde, Viceprex Coromun and a group of CSA troopers participated in a mission to eliminate a syndicate of insurgents and capture a cache of arms.

The Canopy Bandits were a group of criminals present on Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War.
The Death Star II Restoration Fund was a foundation formed during or after 4 ABY to restore the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station.
G4-G4-G5-XNXX7-G4 was an agridroid working on Hyperkarn. She was managed by Dathan who was tasked with keeping the droid operating.

The Loongren were a species who were persecuted by the Land & Sky Corporation, ostracized by propaganda and kept in poverty. The species did not enjoy the civil rights of other sentients within the Aakaash system.

The great gash was a scar in the landscape of the planet Lenahra. It was created by the crash of a starship long before 41 BBY. The survivors of the starship crash founded a civilization on the planet, and lived peacefully for some time.

Ruhnuk was a planet located in Wild Space surrounded by an ionic storm. Due to the world's dry, arid climate it was prone to duststorms. Heta Kol and the Hidden Chain had established a base of operations there, sometime after their attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II.

The mission to Elom was undertaken by both the Sith Empire and the Jedi Order along with Task Force Nova, both factions sought to travel to the Temple of Nul in order to uncover the intentions of rogue Sith Lord Darth Malgus.

A B1-series battle droid served under the command of General Lok Durd during the Clone Wars. While stationed on the planet Maridun, the battle droid was stationed in a Separatist command center and commanded his fellow units, only to be cut down by Jedi General Anakin Skywalke…
The Core District was a majestic district in the center of Cinnagar, capital of the planet Empress Teta.

A crew was led by the pirate Crimson Jack. In 34 ABY, the crew attempted to claim a bounty from the First Order after learning that a Resistance spy had sent a transmission about a drive of secret codes.

The Unmasked was a Sith cult that was lead by Lord Kanoth and Lady Dominique. They were a cult devoted to attaining the same power that birthed the Dark Lord Darth Nihilus by utilising a Mass Shadow Generator.

R5-D5 was an R5 series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton. In 9 BBY, the R-series astromech droid was operating on the Imperial-controlled planet Mapuzo, where it worked alongside the loader droid NED-B on a landing pad atop a flat mesa.
The Canopy bandit's camp was located on the planet Kashyyyk during the Galactic Civil War. It was the base of the group of criminals known as the Canopy bandits.

A city was located on the Inner Rim Territories planet Zeitooine during the Imperial Era. The location contained a spaceport as well as a city square. It was visited by the freighter Mighty Oak Apocalypse seven months after the Battle of Yavin.

2X-3KPR was a KPR security droid that belonged to the Lars family on the planet Tatooine. In 9 BBY, it stood outside the Lars Homestead on alert conditions when the former Inquisitor Reva Sevander arrived in search of the Lars's adopted son, Luke Skywalker.
R2-B3 was a droid that was part of the Hidden Path. In 9 BBY, R2-B3 was present for a meeting preparing for the Rescue of Princess Leia.
New Town was a gated town in the Known Universe. Despite not being located in the galaxy, the conflict of the Skywalker family was felt there through a Disturbance in the Force.
Madurs was an ice moon in the Lenguin system in the Maldrood sector of the Mid Rim Territories that orbited a gas giant. The inhabitants of the moon built ice palaces and had a great value for art.

Wayunings were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. Topi Topi was a diminutive member of the species from Ardennia who by 34 ABY had a bounty placed on their head for stealing a Kowakian monkey-lizard from the Creature Stall in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu.

Fissure Lake was a lake located on the Chiss Ascendancy planet of Celwis.

Scaraphytes were acidic space-borne creatures. A swarm of them surrounded the Galactic Empire's Tarkin Initiative base Hivebase-1, and a specific flight vector was required to evade the creatures when approaching the base.
Tree-burrowers were a species that lived in the canopies of Kashyyyk's forests.

An office belonging to Viceroy Bail Organa of Alderaan was located at the royal palace. It was destroyed by the Death Star's test firing during the Disaster.

The Enigma Catalyst was a YT-series starship owned by the criminal Khel Tanna and was used by her crew.

Condlurans were a sentient species that existed within the galaxy. The Condluran Briff worked as a smuggler on Jedha during the High Republic Era.

Tristall was an astronomical object located in the Tristall system within the Colonies and the Interior. It was situated in grid square L-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

A manufacturing district was located on the planet Sterdic IV. It contained the city Cawa City and had an Imperial presence. In 4 ABY, after the Battle of Endor, members of the Rebel Alliance debated what would be the best approach to the Imperial presence on Sterdic IV.

A well-popluated city was the capital of the Mid Rim planet Sterdic IV. In 4 ABY, in the aftermath of the Battle of Endor, Princess Leia Organa carried out recon of the planet, which included mention of the capital and the planet's manufacturing district, where the Galactic Em…
Shuttle two was one of three Resistance shuttles utilized by the Resistance to transport recruits off the planet Dantooine in an attempt to escape a First Order blockade around 34 ABY.
An unidentified planet located within the Unknown Regions was the point of origin from which the Storm-hair species emerged.
A float-jelly was a type of massive floating living gasbag that resided on the Outer Rim planet Yar Togna. These gasbags ate ash held in the planet's thick atmosphere from erupting volcanoes.

Forrn was a world located in the Forrn system within the Mid Rim Territories' Xan sector. The world was ruled by Empress Eliaora by 4 ABY. At one point, the Princess Leia Organa visited Forrn and established a connection with Eliaora.

A type of flying creature lived in a cave on the planet Panisia. The leavings from the creature created unrefined tibanna gas.
The Twilight Forest was a region on the planet Dathomir. It was located between the Asou Dankal, Takal Nax and Susk'kinad regions. Its landscape consisted mostly of plateaus and canyons.
Yumaou Risoath was a region on the planet Dathomir. It was located between the Rhoa Yenth, Takal Nax, Rhoa Sammir and Lhon'kinad regions. Its landscape consisted mostly of plateaus and canyons.
"The accident," as many Alderaanians referred to it, was when Princess Breha Organa of Alderaan fell on her way down the Alderaanian mountain Appenza Peak while completing her Challenge of the Body.
A final battle between the Empire of the Hand confederation and a warlord took place. During the battle, Imperial Baron Soontir Fel lost his eye, which prompted him to retire.

Rhoa Yenth was a region of grassy high plains on the planet Dathomir. It was located between the Takal Nax and Yumaou Risoath regions.

An avian species was native to the planet Birukay and was known to Detta Yao, a Shadow University student. By the time between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the species had become extinct.

Bastion Military Control was an organization based on the planet Bastion. In 19 BBY, Gilad Pellaeon demanded that the Star Destroyer Relentless be located by searching records through Bastion Military Control.

Usirine Street was a thoroughfare located in the city of Eusebus on the planet Euceron. It was connected to the city's main boulevard, and turning left onto Usirine Street from the boulevard brought a person to Stadium One.
Grand Eucer Street was a street located in the city of Eusebus, capital of the planet Euceron. The street was home to the Sleek Cruiser Inn, a hotel.

The main boulevard of Eusebus was a thoroughfare in the city of Eusebus on Euceron. The boulevard connected to Usirine Street and Air Transit Green, by which one could reach Stadium One and Stadium Ten, respectively.
"Scrappy" was an astromech droid in service of the Galactic Republic. It was present at the Jedi Colony during the Invasion of Ossus.

In 22 ABY, Jedi Master Luke Skywalker attacked Vagaari Empire Supreme Commander Estosh's Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser Dreadnaught-Four, obtaining the location of a rendezvous point where Estosh was to take Dreadnaught-Four in the process.
"Friendly" was an astromech droid in service of the Sith Empire. It was present at Strike Base XR-484 during the Invasion of Ossus.

The Trandoshan Four were a group of Trandoshan bounty hunters operating in the Corellian sector during the Galactic Civil War. They were the toughest and most dangerous group of bounty hunters in the region.

Kenari was a forested planet located in Mid Rim Territories' Perkell sector. It was devastated by commercial mining operations by the Galactic Republic that left tribes of orphaned children the only survivors.
The Pre-Mor Security Inspection team was a special investigation division of Pre-Mor Enforcement, the overall Preox-Morlana law enforcement arm, which governed the Free Trade sector.

Morlana Four was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories' Morlani system, situated along the Hydian Way. It was under the control of the Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation until 5 BBY, when the Galactic Empire took over jurisdiction of the star system.

The Leisure Zone was an area on the planet Morlana One that included brothels. It was under the jurisdiction of the Preox-Morlana. In 5 BBY, Cassian Andor visited a brothel in the Leisure Zone in search of his sister, whom he had been separated from at a young age.

The Kenari were a group of humans native to the planet Kenari. They spoke the language Kenari. They were described as having dark features and large, dark eyes. After large scale mining devastated Kenari, tribes of orphaned children were the only Kenari to survive on world.

Tac-Corpos, also commonly referred to by nicknames such as "Corpos" or "Blues," were law enforcement troopers employed by the Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation who served as officers in the Pre-Mor Security Inspection team and its main holding organization Pre…
Imperial Regional Command was an organization within the Galactic Empire which local governments and authorities reported to in regards to crime rates.

The Alpha were a group of human children that lived in the forests of Kenari. Tribes of orphaned children like the Alpha were the only survivors of the population of the planet after mining operations poisoned the world.
D3-C0 was an astromech droid in service of the reconstituted Sith Empire. It was present at Strike Base XR-484 during the Invasion of Ossus.
D3-C0 was an astromech droid in service of the Galactic Republic. It was present at the Jedi Colony during the Invasion of Ossus.

Drangea were large aquatic creatures that lived in the deepest, coldest parts of Mon Cala's ocean. Described as being squid-like, it had two brains, one in its crest and one that floated freely around its body.

Raxshir, also referred to as sabertooths, were a type of large, predatory feline with yellow fur with black stripes. One raxshir lived in a pine forest on the planet Shili and attacked the Togruta Pav-ti Tano and Ahsoka Tano there in 35 BBY.
A sentient species of insectoids lived in the galaxy, on worlds such as Ferrix. One member was Euphaus Biro, who lived during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

ROKS was a semi-reputable news organization that operated a news sled on Coruscant in 44 ABY.
R10-X6 was a battle droid in service of the Galactic Republic. It was destroyed by the reconstituted Sith Empire forces during the Battle of the Meridian Complex.

The Stromma species' Stromma diplomatic enclave was located at the border of the Black City on the Unknown Regions planet Quethold, the homeworld of the Quesoth species. At some point, Empire of the Hand stormtrooper Lhagva, a Stromma, stayed at the enclave for two years.

Number Three was one of the the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Admonitor hangar decks. In 8 ABY, after Stromma Council Liaison removed the Stromma stormtrooper contingent from the Empire of the Hand's service, all Stromma aboard the Admonitor were commanded to travel to Numb…

The Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces, alternatively known as Pre-Mor Enforcement, or simply as Corporate Authority and Pre-Mor security service, was the private security force and Corporate Tactical Forces of the Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation conglomerate…
D0-5K was an battle droid in service of the Sith Empire. It was present at Strike Base XR-484 during the Invasion of Ossus.

Level 3 was a location on a Munificent-class star frigate where prisoners were held. In 22 BBY during the Clone Wars, Galactic Republic senators Padmé Amidala and Yarua, along with others were kidnapped by Confederacy of Independent Systems forces led by General Grievous and h…
The Lenahrans were a group of people who lived on the planet Lenahra.

An unidentified sentient species possessed gravity well projectors, which were used to pull starships out of hyperspace. The Vagaari Empire stole the projectors from the species and incorporated them into the Vagaari slaver fleet.
Red One was the T-65B X-wing starfighter used by Garven Dreis in the Battle of Yavin.
ED-G4R was an protocol droid in service of the reconstituted Sith Empire. It was present at Strike Base XR-484 during the Invasion of Ossus.
C0-RA was an battle droid in service of the Galactic Republic. It was present at the Jedi Colony during the Invasion of Ossus.

The Darkseekers were an organization of the Sith that hunted threats to the Sith and wielded red lightsabers. The Darkseekers attempted for a number of years to wipe out the Ascendant and at one point confronted Miril, the leader of the Ascendant.
Sigma Squadron was a starfighter squadron of the Imperial Navy that was made up of TIE/IN interceptors.

Sev Tok was an astronomical object in the Sev Tok system in the Kurost sector of the Mid Rim Territories. In 5 BBY, Imperial Security Bureau Major Partagaz told ISB Dedra Meero that he was impressed by her detention numbers from the location.
The Chandrilan Embassy, also known as the Mothma household, was the permanent representation of Chandrila to the Galactic Empire on the planet Coruscant.
An unidentified creature was a rodent-like species that had two heads. It also had white fur and dark eyes. Jocasta Nu kept one of them as a pet during her days in hiding after Order 66.
RE-G was a purifier droid created on Iokath that was present during the War on Iokath.

The Lowlands was a region on the planet Aldhani. The Enterprise Zone was located in the Lowlands, along with most of the world's native population. The rebel spy Lieutenant Gorn wanted to refocus the Aldhani Garrison's attention to the Lowlands as a distraction.

The Enterprise Zone was a location in the Lowlands region of the planet Aldhani. Displaced Dhanis from the Highlands were forced to live in the Enterprise Zone by the Galactic Empire as factories, new towns, and Imperial housing was built there.

Nobillians were a species of insectoid beings found in the galaxy. Neeva and Neevaan were two Nobillians that lived on Nar Shaddaa and were enemies of the criminal Boggs Triff. Multiple members of the species attended the Canto Casino and Racetrack on Cantonica in 34 ABY.
The Hast Antu Gang was a gang that operated during the Imperial Era. Chelli Lona Aphra backstabbed them and stole their score from them multiple times on Rudun III.

A Day of Days was a Chandrilan custom which involved the giving of a present. In 5 BBY, Imperial Senator Mon Mothma visited the Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest under the guise of buying a gift for her husband, Perrin Fertha, for his Day of Days, but in reality, sh…
A bazaar was located in Nevarro's city, where merchants sold their wares. A Kowakian monkey-lizard was roasted on the grill in the bazaar.

A Tusken Raider camp was located in the Dune Sea of the Outer Rim planet Tatooine in the last days of the Galactic Empire. It was destroyed by the Pyke Syndicate, who put false evidence pointing to the Kintan Striders Gang.
Arvala-6, or Arvala-Six, was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Arvala system in the Sevetta sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
A hot spring was located in Maldo Kreis. The spring formed a haven for a colony of hibernating knobby white ice spider.
The Moraki were the locals of the planet Morak.

An uninhabited refuge world was the location where Chiss Syndic Mitth'ras'safis and a human female wished to crash a starship hailing from Lesser Space, the portion of the galaxy lying beyond the Unknown Regions, at some point around 27 BBY.

The Oba Diah high council was a body that was a part of the Pyke Syndicate. When Daimyo Boba Fett sent a Twi'lek majordomo to negotiate with the Syndicate, the majordomo asked to present the terms of surrender to a spokesperson that was empowered to deliberate an acceptable ou…

objective: Locate Lah Zhima and rescue him from the Sith
x: Following the plot to kidnap the Sabersmith, the Jedi Juro, along with Ethan, Lah Kara and Homen began a search for Lah Kara's father Lah Zhima after Zhima was captured by Jedi hunters that were working for the Sith.

Callonia spaceport was a starport located on Callonia in the Fakir sector. During the Galactic Civil War, Reekeene's Roughnecks stole the GX1 Short Hauler Long Shot from Callonia spaceport. The ship was originally intended to function as a pleasure yacht for an Imperial admiral.
Nasma Klain, the sacred river, was a river in the Akti Amaugh on the planet Aldhani. The Imperial air base at Alkenzi was located 50 klicks from it.

A creature that had a dark coloration and scuttling limbs was native to the planet Thelj. In 382 BBY after Theljan whales breached the ice beneath Path of the Open Hand member Yana Ro and the corpse of her girlfriend Kor Plouth, these creatures emerged from the hole and pulled…
Theljan whales lived in the waters of Thelj. They had the capacity to break the green icy crust that could cover the planet's waters in certain areas.

Grass hens were a type of hen. In 382 BBY, while in the Ferdan town market on the Outer Rim planet Dalna, Jedi Padawan Kevmo Zink passed by a number of grass hens that had been plucked and strung up by their legs to be sold.
The Relik moons were located in the Relik system within the Steniplis sector of the Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches, situated in grid square L-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

A fern chick was a type of bird that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Dalna. They could be kept in a coop. In 382 BBY, while on Dalna, Jedi Padawan Kevmo Zink helped elevate a fern chick coop so it could be repaired after a flood in the town Ferdan.

The Rook was the capital city of the planet E'ronoh. It was located by the Ramshead Gorge.
The Paxion was an Alif-class Longbeam starship that served the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era. It was under the direct supervision of Supreme Chancellor Orlen Mollo.

Ferdan was a town located on the Outer Rim planet of Dalna during the High Republic Era. It had a single small spaceport, with only a droid managing the docking beacon. The town also had only two facilities with rooms to let.
The Scupper was a pleasure yacht owned by the smuggler and prospector Radicaz Dobbs during the High Republic Era.
DZ-23, or Deezee, was a maintenance droid belonging to Radicaz Dobbs whose primary job was to clean Radicaz's ship, the Scupper.
The Valiant was an Alif-class Longbeam in service to the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era.

C-9, or See-Nine, was a green astromech droid who belonged to the Jedi Knight Azlin Rell.

Grass sharks were a species of non-sentient herd animals native to the planet Tiikae. They were large, with six legs, twisted tusks and gold-striped skin. The sharks migrated every five years to their southern mating ground, following the planet's magnetic fields.

Grass frogs were a type of frog that lived in grass on the Outer Rim planet Dalna. In 382 BBY, as the Evereni Path of the Open Hand cult member Marda Ro stepped outside of her cell in the Path compound and saw the nearby meadow, she heard grass frogs singing.
The Boss Meetup was the name given to the gathering of Gungans at their Sacred Place following attacks on Gungan cities by the Trade Federation during the Invasion of Naboo.

A market was located in the town of Ferdan on the planet Dalna during the High Republic Era. Members of the Path of the Open Hand cult would occasionally set up in the market to preach and hand out flowers and other small gifts.

The Ashrow volcano was located on the planet Dalna. In 382 BBY, heavy rainfall threatened to flood the town of Ferdan, located downriver from the volcano, because of a weather occurrence at the mountain's base.
A droid was a mercenary hired by Frax to kill Han Solo during the mission to Odona. The droid was about to flee with Selt, but Frax was against their leaving and gunned the both of them down.

The Harmony was a shuttle used by the Path of the Open Hand cult during the High Republic Era. The Children, a team set up by the Mother, the Path's leader, travlled in the starship on missions to "liberate" Force artifacts.
Balfron was a location in the Balfron system in the Core Worlds' Dolomar sector. Transport to Balfron was available from the Coruscant Eastern Spaceport.
Bhatiqu was the lone city on the ice planet Thelj, situated in a temperate zone created by the planet's original settlers. It was covered by a dome.
Clan Kowak was a Jedi clan that existed during the High Republic Era. The clan contained Force-sensitive Conjeni younglings.

Kessarine were a sentient species. Females, or egg bearers, had one tail, while males had multiple. Members of the species also had cheek frills, double eyelids, and webbed fingers.

Stic was a planet located in the Stic system of the Xappyh sector, a part of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories. It was situated in grid square Q-3 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Stic was the homeworld of the Xi'Dec species of sentient insectoids.

The Ebruchi homeworld was a terrestrial planet that was the homeworld of the sentient Ebruchi species.

During the Clone Wars, a B1-series battle droid served within the naval forces of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, under the command of T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid TM-171.
Level 91 was a level of an apartment building on the metropolitan world of Coruscant.
The Karn Household was a standard apartment located on Level 91 of the metropolitan world Coruscant.
The ocean moon of Amloch was located in the Amloch system of the Rayter sector in the Outer Rim Territories and the Western Reaches, situated in grid square J-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Dhanis, also known as Aldhanis, were a cultural group of humans who called the planet of Aldhani home. Centuries prior to Imperial takeover, the hills of the planet were covered by hundreds of settlements that housed at least 40,000 Dhanis across the highlands.

The Lady of Bestine was a spacious passenger starship. In 19 BBY, Annileen Calwell left Tatooine on the Lady of Bestine with her two children, Kallie and Jabe, after her college application was accepted by the University of Alderaan.

Corridor ghouls were creatures that lived in sewers in the underworld of the planet Coruscant. Around 3 ABY, a family of Imperial defectors encountered a corridor ghoul as they attempted to escape from Coruscant underworld police.

Frezno was an Outer Rim Territories moon with makeshift encampments for villages. Doctor Quadpaw operated in a tent on the moon, and was the activated contingency plan for a rebel infiltration team that did a heist on the nearby planet Aldhani in 5 BBY.

The Iquoonian Peaks were a location on the astronomical object of Roon. The peaks included bands of gemstones.
Blevin's office was the office of Imperial Security Bureau Supervisor Blevin.
Banas was a rugged planet with a cold environment that was located in the Outer Rim Territories and on the frontier of the Galactic Empire's territory during the Galactic Civil War.
A night-lether was a type of flying creature found on the Core Worlds planet Alderaan during the High Republic Era. They flew in flocks and navigated by sensing magnetic fields.
Applied Toxicology was a Division within the Sith Empire. Major Annette Miran was a chief researcher at the Applied Toxicology.
A colony world was part of the Chiss species' Chiss Ascendancy nation. The planet was inhabited by several Chiss families.

The Dark Council chamber on Vaiken Spacedock was used by the Sith Empire during the third Galactic War. The chamber itself was an identical copy of the chamber used on Dromund Kaas during the reign of Empress Acina

Dedra Meero's ISB office was an office used by Imperial Security Bureau Supervisor Dedra Meero and her assistant, attendant Avril Heert, while they investigated the theft of an Imperial N-S9 Starpath Unit.
The Cloud Bridge was a location on Teyr that served as the last spot on the Rift Skyrail monorail system.
Vel Sartha's camp was a temporary settlement used by a rebel team led by Vel Sartha during the preparations for their mission to rob the Imperial base on Aldhani.
The Path compound, also known as Path territory, was the headquarters of the Path of the Open Hand on the planet Dalna.
A sentient species was native to the planet Banas. They had blue, gray, or white colored skin. Halorum and Moular were members of this species.

CI-09 Peacekeeper was a floating turret droid model. It was used by Dread Pirate Karvoy on Mek-Sha.
Country walkers against Imperial walkers were a group who opposed the usage of the All Terrain Armored Transport, a vehicle used by the Galactic Empire.

Niamos was a world in the Vorzyd sector of the Outer Rim Territories dominated by oceans and beaches. Initially a place for those lying low to gravitate to, it soon fell under the occupation of the Galactic Empire, which laid down new laws.

Cliff worms were a type of worm that could be found on the planet Skako Minor. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, pirates affiliated with Jul Tambor, the grandson of former Techno Union Foreman Wat Tambor, crashed their ship into a hive of cliff worms after they boarded a transport from…

H4-W2 was an astromech droid active around the time of the Galactic War. During the Invasion of Ziost it transmitted an emergency signal to field operatives, urging them to respond to the Code Omega event.
Idalowd was a species of sentient beings that were identified by their purple, puncture-proof skin. Countess Alissyndrex delga Cantonica Provincion was a member of the species.

Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, pirates enlisted by the nationalist Jul Tambor blockaded the planet Skako Minor during Tambor's efforts to reclaim the planet from the pro-Imperial regime.

A KX-series security droid model supplemented an Imperial shoretrooper garrison on the planet Niamos. After interacting with two individuals moments prior, it was summoned for assistance by a nearby trooper for the interrogation of Cassian Jeron Andor.

x: The Imperial Bureau of Standards, also simply known as the Bureau of Standards, was a department of the Galactic Empire tasked with the standardization of industrial production around the galaxy.
The Andon Host were a species on the planet Malenko. By the time of the Clone Wars the Andon Host were long extinct. According to legends, they were powerful necromancers.

The Bank of Kolma was a financial institution based on the planet Chandrila. In 5 BBY, Chandrilan senator Mon Mothma approached Kolma banker Tay Kolma for help clandestinely accessing her family accounts without alerting the watchful eyes of the Galactic Empire.

Malenko was a planet located in the Mid Rim Territories. Part of the Malenko system in the Eidoloni sector, the planet appeared to be bathed in green mists and covered in bleak water bodies with crystalline shards sprawling through its surface.

Ajax Sigma was a warrior-priest droid who lived in the High Republic Era and was created on Kligson's Moon, he sought the freedom of droids and became an insurgent out of anger until he was struck down by the Jedi Order.
Gansevor, known as the "planet of knives," was a rocky, mountainous planet located in the Tammuz sector of the Outer Rim Territories, and on the Republic frontier.

Turrak was a planet in the Turrak system within the Outer Rim Territories and Galactic Frontier that was the homeworld of the Scalvi species. During the High Republic Era, it was visited by Jedi Grandmaster Yoda after the Scalvi sent out a call for help.

The ISB conference room, also known as the ISB meeting chamber, was a room in the ISB Central Office on Coruscant. It was used for Investigations branch officer meetings, including the sector supervisors' forum and major policy change announcements.

A massive datavault maintained for the Imperial Security Bureau was located within in the ISB central office on Coruscant. It contained datatapes with data from multiple Imperial sectors under ISB supervision, which officers could use in their investigations.

objective: Determine if Banas is suitable for a Alliance to Restore the Republic
x: A mission was taken by Commander Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia Organa to the planet Banas in the Outer Rim Territories to determine if the planet was suitable for a Alliance to Restore the Republic.

A residence in the suburbs of Lazeria City, the capital of the Expansion Region planet of Lazerian IV, was the place in which the trusted aide to King Alarik X and commander of the King's Own Guard, Alroy Kever, resided.
Tribis were small bipedal reptilian creatures native to Ossus.
Pier Nine was a location at Niamos. The human Cassian Andor was apprehended by a shoretrooper after being suspected of suspicious activity.

Cheldu was an insectoid herbivore species native to Umbara. Though their appearance could be off-putting to some prospective owners, few mounts could match the loyalty and affectionate nature of the Cheldu.

A charitable organization was founded to help individuals find and reunite with their families after being separated during the Clone Wars. Founded by 1 BBY, the organization attracted the attention of the Alderaanian Rel during his time as a student.
A battle took place on the Outer Rim moon of Shard during or after 1 BBY.

The bog slug was a type of slug that lived in bogs on the Outer Rim Territories swamp planet Dagobah. Whenever they were available, the alien Jedi Master Yoda used bog slugs as an ingredient in the Mud and Bug Soup meal—which he admitted did not taste good—during his exile on …
A rodir was a creature found in the galaxy at the time of the Third Galactic War. Rodirs were white and brown creatures with blue or orange eyes and had long tails that split at the end.

A division of the Imperial Security Bureau was led by Colonel Wullf Yularen and tasked with exposing instances of sedition within the Galactic Empire's Imperial Senate. Yularen served in the division after resigning his admiral commission in the navy.

The Arden Ring was the innermost of the three concentric districts of Salis D'aar, capital of the Wild Space planet Bakura. The Salis D'aar central archives and High Court of Bakura were located within the district, which was used for public building.
The Danisai Ring was the middle of the three concentric districts of Salis D'aar, capital of the Wild Space planet Bakura.

The Bakur Ring was the outermost of the three concentric districts of Salis D'aar, capital of the Wild Space planet Bakura. The district was used primarily for service and industrial work, and was also known as the "Red Ring" due to the color of its streetlights.
Dominance was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in the service of the Galactic Empire.
Narkina 5, also known as Narkina, was a small water moon that orbited the gas giant Narkina. The Galactic Empire maintained a prison complex there.

terrain: Rocky expanses, cliffs, mountains, and caverns
x: Segra Milo, or Segra-Milo, was a barren planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Jospro sector. Originally the site of mines, the world became abandoned before the Partisans rebel cell used a mine there as a starfighter launch base.

The Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex, also known as the Narkina 5 detention facility was a complex of seven separate Imperial factory facilities situated in the middle of a lake located on the moon Narkina 5.

A lifeless planet was the site of the Jedi Mitaka's compound, where the human and several of his assistant droids resided. Within the structure, Mitaka and his assistants researched how to bring life to the planet.

Following Jedi Masters Dooku and Mace Windu's mission to Raxus Secundus, a funeral was held for Jedi Master Katri. In addition to Dooku and Windu, the funeral was attended by many other venerable Jedi, including Yoda, Plo Koon, Saesee Tiin, Depa Billaba and Tera Sinube.
Galdi was a planet located in an eponymous star system within the Western Reaches portion of the Outer Rim Territories.

Deris-plata was a planet located in the Eucer sector within the Mid Rim Territories. Incognito Cassian Andor claimed to be from Deris-plata during his time on Niamos. In reality, Andor was from Kenari.
Giermos was the home planet of a prisoner at the Imperial prison on Niamos who was being transferred to another facility.
Spellhaus was an astronomical object that hosted a power station for the Galactic Empire. By 5 BBY, the rebel cell led by Anto Kreegyr was probing the power station and planning an attack.

Narkina was a gas giant located in the Abrion sector's Narkina system within the Outer Rim, specifically at Standard Galactic Grid space S-15. The planet also lay in the section of space known as The Slice.
A village located on the planet Shili was inhabited by members of the Togruta species, including a young Ahsoka Tano and her mother, Pav-ti Tano. It was located at the edge of a forested wilderness.

An interrogation room was located in the basement of the ISB central office on Coruscant. It was used for interrogations of persons of interest to the ISB.
Class IB non-Imperial shipyards, capable of producing cruisers, where located at the planet Mandalore, in the Outer Rim Territories Mandalore system.

Class IB shipyards of the Galactic Empire's military, capable of producing cruisers, where located at the planet Rintonne, in the Mid Rim Rintonne system.
Class IB civilian shipyards, capable of producing cruisers, where located at the planet Lianna, in the Outer Rim Territories Lianna system.
Table Five was a group of prisoners assigned to prison labor in the Imperial Prison Complex on Narkina 5. Its operation was overseen by the manager of Unit Five-Two-D, the inmate Kino Loy.
