x: A mission to Thule was led by Jedi Knights Josk Nivar, Tualon Yaluna and Iskat Akaris to sabotage the droid factory on Thule after slicing information on other Separatist foundries.
A'ranni was a small farming village located in the Badlands of the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh. Iazacal trees grew within the village.
A Tikotiko was a small species of creature. A batch of tikotikos hatched and infested Hap's Sap Tap after accidentally being delivered there.
Tharnakans were sentient species from the planet Tharnaka. When Tharnaka was flooded due to storms, the Tharnakans left the planet, leaving behind the Tharnakan Story Stone.
A crew was led by the human Ace Kallisto. The Tharnakan Ishbul Ekwesh and the Gungan Tooba Jinx joined to retrieve the Tharnakan Story Stone.
Aklyrr Bend was a town on the forest planet Tenoo. The town was named for the blue aklyrr, a creature that could be found nearby. By around 233 BBY, the town was taken over by the biker gang Ganguls.
The Ganguls, also known as the Gangul gang, were a pirate gang who operated in the Outer Rim within the Bri'ahl sector during the High Republic Era.
The starfish was a species of creature that inhabited Lake Paonga on the planet Naboo. Starfishes had light orange skin and five limbs.
Olgothon 3 was a moon that orbited the gas planet Olgothon.
Olgothon was a gas planet orbited by the moon Olgothon 3.

Tharnaka was a planet that housed the artifact Tharnakan Story Stone. It was the native planet of the Tharnakan species. Long before 233 BBY, the climate on Tharnaka changed, causing a flood to descend on the entire planet.
Nash's speeder was a landspeeder built by the pilot Nash Durango and her mothers.

The Corsalys was the freighter originally piloted by Jessica Meade circa 15 BBY. When en route to Tammuz-an carrying Mon Julpa and Jann Tosh along with his droids R2-D2 and C-3PO, it came under attack by the pirate Gir Kybo Ren-Cha and was destroyed.
Havel Prime was a terrestrial astronomical object that was host to a warehouse belonging to the Tagge Corporation that contained a number of prototype battle droids.

Thraxsos were a species of large non-sentient reptilian carnivores native to the moon Olgothon 3. Between 20 BBY and 19 BBY, Jedi Knights Tualon Yaluna and Iskat Akaris were attacked by and slew a pair of thraxsos during a mission to Olgothon 3.
Tiss'ell was a planet that had lava fields.
Lava fields were large fields of lava located on the planet Tiss'ell
The facet spider was a type of spider. It was served in a cantina on the planet Christophsis as a delicacy.
A division within the Tagge Corporation was led by Silas Tagge, who served as the company's Head of Weapons Development.

Mips were minute parasitic creatures found on the arid planet Geonosis in the Outer Rim Territories. They traveled in swarms and formed a symbiotic relationship with the enormous merdeths that dominated Geonosis's barren exterior.

Sand snakes were a type of furry snake found on the arid planet Geonosis in the Outer Rim Territories. Their eyes and mouths were situated at the center of their body, which could grow up to three meters, or ten feet, in length.

Ur-greedles were a type of six-winged creature found on the planet Geonosis in the Outer Rim Territories. Cousins of the sentient insectoid Geonosians who were native to the world, the ur-greedles were shorter and stouter versions of their relatives.
Ace's ship was owned by the human thief Ace Kallisto.

Lump was an IG-series droid owned by the Ortolan shopkeeper Gamodar and used to protect his artifacts. Sometime between 19 BBY and 18 BBY, an acquaintance of Gamodar's, the former Jedi Iskat Akaris, accompanied by the Grand Inquisitor, came to remove Gamodar's collection.
The Veil was the treacherous atmosphere of Sophros. It made landing on the planet remarkably difficult by acting as a sort of defense mechanism and immune system for the world.

Piranha eels were a type of eel that traveled in shoals. In 382 BBY, while traveling through the treacherous atmosphere of Wild Space's Planet X known as the Veil, the Path of the Open Hand Force religion member Marda Ro noticed balls of liquid swarming toward the Scupper, the…

objective: Obtain supplies for Phoenix Squadron
x: During the Galactic Civil War, Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus went on a supply run to obtain supplies for the Phoenix Cell.
Sulon was one of the two moons of the planet Sullust, and was located in the Sullust sector's Sullust system in both the Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches regions.

Horn-toed morglesnaps were a type of creature featuring horned toes. While aboard the Jedi cruiser Star Hopper in 231 BBY, the Padawan Lula Talisola asked her friend, the Mikkian Zeen Mrala, how she was as they traveled to the latter's homeworld, Trymant IV.

A bomber was used by the Nihil marauders during the High Republic Era. It was part of a class of bomber that ran on the fuel zylium 12. In 231 BBY, the bomber was deployed during the Nihil attack on the Republic Fair on the planet Valo.
A battle took place on the planet Ord Tiddell when Galactic Empire forces attacked the Alliance to Restore the Republic as it evacuated its forces from the world at the start of the Mid Rim Retreat.

leader: Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader
x: The droid uprising was a massive gathering of droids assembled by Captain Ought-Six of the Droid Crush Pirates of Bestoon with the aim of killing the Sith Lord Darth Vader, who had destroyed every droid who joined the uprising at some point prior in their mechanical lives.
In 230 BBY, the Maawat Mountains on the planet Dalna were attacked by the Nihil.

This Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser was commanded by Captain Elk and was a part of the Segra-Milo Imperial patrol. In 5 BBY, Luthen Rael was briefly stopped by this Arrestor cruiser while entering the orbit of Segra Milo aboard his Fondor Haulcraft.

K-2PL, abbreviated K-P or K-2 was a droid who served the Moldwarp thief and collector Draiven Bosh alongside the astromech droid R4-13 during the High Republic Era. The droid had yellow sensors and silver-bronze plating.

R4-13 was an astromech droid who served the Moldwarp thief and collector Draiven Bosh alongside fellow droid K-2PL during the High Republic Era. The droid had an orange-colored sensor and maroon-white plating.
The Teevan were a sentient species that originated from the Teevan system. In 382 BBY, a Force-sensitive Teevan man was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult.

6609 was a prison cell located in the Naraka prison on Naraka. In 2 BBY, Ezra Bridger and other members of the Spectres, including Garazeb Orrelios, Sabine Wren, and Chopper rescued their occasional ally Hondo Ohnaka from the cell.
The lower district of of the Outer Rim planet Actlyon's Actlyon City had a cantina operating in it by 34 ABY.

Piasas were a large type of bird indigenous to the planet Koboh. They could be distinguished by their ax-like beak and large stature. The piasa was considered one of Koboh's apex predators, striking fear into any creature it decided to prey upon.

type: Imperial I-class Star Destroyer hyperspace transport ring
x: The Eye of Sion was a large hyperspace transport ring built by forces under the supervision of the witch Morgan Elsbeth, with the intent of reaching and rescuing Grand Admiral Thrawn from exile in another galaxy.
Peridea was an extragalactic planet located in the far galaxy. It was the homeworld of the Noti and once the center of the Witch Kingdom of the Dathmiri, which eventually collapsed.

Arcana was a planet that held a stronghold constructed by the Nightsister witches of Dathomir thousands of years before the Battle of Endor. In 9 ABY, Ahsoka Tano took a map from Arcana which was believed to lead to the Imperial Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Seatos was a planet in the Denab system in the Outer Rim Territories that was inhabited in the past by a species from a different galaxy. They constructed a mechanism on it to locate their galaxy powered by a spherical star map.
The Badlands was a desert region on the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh that was home to the farming village A'ranni. Iazacal trees were cultivated on farms by the E'roni.
The Brushlands was a region on the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh that was home to a mining village that had been abandoned by 382 BBY.
RD-3 was an SK series astromech droid that was with the New Republic Defense Fleet during the New Republic Era on board the Defender-class cruiser Vesper under Captain Hayle.

C1-D1, or See-One for short, was a protocol droid working at the control centre for the Santhe Shipyards in Coronet City, on the planet Corellia during the dismantling of the Imperial fleet for the New Republic. Her function was catalogue inventory on arriving transports.
A New Republic nav droid was a protocol droid who operated on the Vesper and was destroyed by the Force-sensitive mercenary Shin Hati.

The Senate Defense Council was a council within the New Republic. In around 9 ABY, the Council, led by Senator Leia Organa, requested an update from General Hera Syndulla regarding the breakout of prisoner Morgan Elsbeth from New Republic custody.

Cheddatown a city located on the planet Orto. It was a bustling city with many businesses and suburban residences. The streets of Cheddatown were lined with streetlamps and were suitable for civilian speeders, double-decker landspeeder buses, and also pedestrians.

The first night's reception dinner was a formal dinner hosted in the main dining salon of the Chiss diplomatic vessel Chaf Envoy in 22 ABY by Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano, core name "Formbi," of the Fifth Ruling Family.
Fel's Imperial transport was the personal transport of Commander Chak Fel of the Empire of the Hand.
The Valo Security Force (VSF), also known as the Valon Security Force, was a security force that operated on the Outer Rim planet Valo during the High Republic Era.

Kavith III was an icy planet in the Kavith system in the Corva sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The planet was flat, with no mountains to obstruct the sky, and covered with black lakes and rivers. Inhabitants of the planet would shelter underground during blizzards.
Hoth Scout Troopers were scout troopers equipped with heated suits for deployment in cold environments, such as on the ice planet Hoth. They drove speeder bikes like standard scout troopers.

The Violet was a freighter in service of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
A rock mouse was a type of mouse present in the rocky wilderness of the planet Korba. At some point by 19 BBY, the Korban miners Attu and Abat prepared to descend into the mountain Spire 17 mine.
The Armaments Committee was a part of the Trade Federation of Planets that set standards for the Federation's military, which was not subject to regulation by the Galactic Republic.

Miekos was a small marshland planet on the edge of Wild Space. Formerly a San Tekka colony, the planet became a farming community. It had a diverse population that included Togruta, Mirialans, Nautolans, humans, and other species.
The Scion shuttle was the custom starship used by witch Morgan Elsbeth as a transport and private shuttle.

The Primacy, also known as the Sunken Lucrehulk, was a crashed Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter that served as the base of operations for the Bedlam Raiders, a group of marauders on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.
A freighter was commanded by the safari droid SF-R3 to deliver various creatures to the Sil Gohtta's Nature Preserve during the High Republic Era.
A shuttle was owned and operated by the Moldwarp collector Draiven Bosh during the High Republic Era.

Teriona was a small, forested planet located in the Mid Rim Territories. Despite it being along several major trade routes, long history of war and violence kept it from being considered useful by the Galactic Republic.
A botany classroom was located on the planet Langsha-Raang.

A Kavith wolf was a type of wolf from the icy Outer Rim planet Kavith III. They had white fur, brown eyes, two tails, and massive jaws.
By 235 BBY, the girl Avon Starros was kidnapped by a local group after she snuck out of the family's compound on the Core Worlds planet Hosnian Prime.
A forest frog was a type of frog found on the moon Endor. They had a silvery back, which allowed them to blend in with the shadowed forest. In 4 ABY Wicket Warrick caught two plump forest frogs.

The Prime Gate was an Infinity Gate constructed by the Kwa species located at the bottom of the Chasm canyon on the planet Tython. This gate was the most powerful of Kwa Infinity Gates, as it did not require a corresponding access point on the other side.

A capital ship served as a warship during a war waged between the Sith tradition of Force-users and the Jedi Order, their ideological antithesis, at some point by 1032 BBY. At the time, the warship housed the Jedi High Council.

The mechanic Ara and the Jedi Toul underwent a Jedi Order–approved mission to the planet Dolgarak during a war waged between the Jedi and their ideological antithesis, the Sith tradition of Force-users, at some point by 1032 BBY.

Jalucaz was a small, swamp-filled planetoid in the Outer Rim Territories where the Chuul's tavern was ran. It was located in the Jalucaz system in the Subterrel sector.
In 4 ABY, three days before the Battle of Endor, the Galactic Empire unsuccessfully attempted to assassinate the rebel leader Mon Mothma.

Prospector's Folly was a region of the Koboh Mountains on the Outer Rim planet Koboh, located near the Rambler's Reach Valley and Rambler's Reach Outpost. Prospector's Folly was named after the many priorite prospectors that died attempting to climb the peaks of the area.
Hares were a species that roamed around the icy planet Kavith III.

The Baldamiro Family was one of one five crime families—alongside the Rang Clan, the Wandering Star, the Droid Gotra, and envoys of the Hutt Clan—that made up the Crymorah Syndicate during the Imperial Era.

A diplomatic trip to Mon Cala was undertaken by the Galactic Republic senator Ghirra Starros in 238 BBY. For the trip to the planet Mon Cala, Ghirra's six year old daughter Avon accompanied her. During her time on the planet, Avon stole an escape pod and flew it.
Springfield was a small town on the astronomical object Earth.

A battle took place on the planet Celes IV during the Clone Wars. After the Confederacy of Independent Systems established a fortress that shielded enough to prevent an orbital assault, a group of Galactic Republic forces attempted to attack the fortress but ended up pinned down.
Earth was a planet in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of Maggie Simpson.
A bearded jax was a type of yellow-eyed creature found on the moon Endor. In 4 ABY, the Ewok shaman Logray looked at a bearded jax in an attempt to find peace during the Imperial invasion of Endor.
A Star Navigator Droid served onboard the Eye of Sion and calculated the coordinates to get to Peridea.
A Star Navigator droid with red ocular sensor served onboard the Eye of Sion and talked to Morgan Elsbeth.
A polar bear was a type of bear. The alien Sweebotta resembled a polar bear.
Nazzar were a sentient species that lived in relative harmony with other species on the planet Coruscant. Krrl and Akray were members of the species.
In the Galactic Civil War, the Galactic Empire's Field Secured Container Vessel Black Ice was attacked by the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The starship was stolen in the engagement.

The Phon'Qi Caverns, also known as Phon'Qi's Caverns, were a series of caves underlying the Foothill Falls area on the Outer Rim planet Koboh. The caverns were the home of many endemic mysterious and unique organisms, including various fungal species.
During the Galactic Civil War, the New Republic established a planetary outpost on the planet Mon Gazza, which was later destroyed in an attack by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Kilotowans were a sentient species in the galaxy with pink skin and hair, as well as gentle-peaked ears. One member of the species was Leyli Romero.

The Senate Oversight Committee was a legislative committee within the New Republic Senate that was active following the Galactic Civil War. Located on Coruscant by 9 ABY, it was led by New Republic Chancellor Mon Mothma.
A settlement on the planet Dantooine was the world's oldest settlement during the High Republic Era. It had a port for trade and a public house.

TR0-F33 was a trophy droid created by the Mon Calamari Sprocket. He was programed to be the main objective in the game of Trophy Chase, and possessed a mischievous and childlike personality, loving to dance and be part of the action whenever possible.
The sanctuary district was the district located on the planet Exegol. At its heart was the Sith Citadel, an ancient fortress.

The Noti were an extragalactic, sentient, crustacean-like species native to the planet Peridea, a ringed planet located in the far galaxy, far away from the main galaxy.
Thrawn's forces was a large military force under the command of the Chiss Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo "Thrawn" used by the Imperial Remnant during the New Republic Era.

Howlers were extragalactic furred quadrupedal creatures native to the planet Peridea. Howlers could be tamed and ridden, and would respond to commands as demonstrated by Enoch and Sabine Wren, who used the word "tota" to order one such creature to sit.

RX-23 was an RX-series pilot droid who operated during the Galactic Civil War. At one point, the droid flew a GX1 short hauler from Iego, but the ship was hijacked by R2-D2 to fly to Gallios to find and recruit 0-0-0 for D-Squad.

The Great Mothers were three Dathomirian Nightsisters who allied themselves with Grand Admiral Thrawn. Their names were Klothow, Aktropaw, and Lakesis, and they were practitioners of dark magick, claiming to be able to read the threads of fate and destiny.

The Bandits of Peridea, were a group of pirates that roamed the desolate alien wasteland of the extragalactic planet of Peridea in the distant barred spiral far galaxy that spoke the same language as the native Noti.

Symon, designated Ayesspee-Nine at activation, was an ASP-series labor droid who was a member of the Second Revelation.
Deera was a droid who was a member of the Second Revelation. Prior to the outbreak of the Scourge threat, Deera spoke with the Revelation's leader, Ajax Sigma, about his history.
An MSE-6 series repair droid served Moff Gideon on the hidden Imperial base on Mandalore during the New Republic Era.
A extragalactic species of small reptavian was native to the planet Peridea. They lived in the vast wastelands of grass and crags which covered the planet.

The Silver Arrow was, according to General Leia Organa, one of the Rebel Alliance's most reliable supply-run ships during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, something went wrong with the ship's droids, causing a member of the ship's crew to contact out for immediate aid.

The Hawk's End was a starship used by the Rebel Alliance under the command of Captain Magna Tolvan during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Tolvan used the ship to depart from Mareti Base on the Outer Rim astronimical object Hiorin.

A group of mushrooms existed on the forest moon of Endor in 3 ABY. These fungal creatures possessed a brown stem topped by a dark-red cap with orange spots. The stem exhibited facial features, including two white eyes, a nose-like protrusion, and a mouth.
Reena was a planet in the Reena system in the Tapani sector of the Colonies that was home to the eponymous Reena University.

This small, cubical shuttle served as the personal transport of Besalisk cook Dexter Jettster during the Clone Wars. The vessel was painted white and red and sported a tail fin along with landing gear and a boarding ramp. It was capable of both space and atmospheric flight.

An ancient city was built into a cliff-side on Gloam. It was surrounded by abandoned mining equipment. It had rows of carved archways over 30 meters above ground that led inside. It was laid out like a hive, with a large central chamber that lead down to the mines.

The hydrominae was an aquatic species present in the Sublight Lounge within the MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser Halcyon as a part of the process in making the alcoholic cocktail Silver Sea Martini.

Setarans were a sentient species that had domed, ridged heads, pale skin, and gills running from the bottom of the neck to jutting cheekbones, framing two deep-set eyes. Setarans did not possess a mouth, and instead communicated with other sentients via telepathy.

A shipweaver was a creature that wove webs within ships. By 382 BBY, a large amount of webs had been made by a shipweaver in a locker within the Scupper, a yacht owned by the prospector Sunshine Dobbs.
Scuttlers, or scuttling lizards, were creatures that inhabited Okut Dand's ship. The colony nestled in the nooks and crannies of the ship, including the crew's mattresses.

The Casus Belli was a battleship in the fleet of the Tagge Corporation. It served as a research facility for the company, and Lady Domina Tagge—the company's leader—oversaw experimental weapon development for the company aboard the ship.
A crew was led by the rebel Captain Magna Tolvan during the Imperial Era. It consisted of Tolvan, the navigator Kelb, a Caamasi named Pilok, a Devaronian named Sheyo, and an Ikkrukkian named Brissa.

A battle took place in orbit over a red planet during the Galactic Civil War where an Interdictor-class heavy cruiser was cornered between two EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates and a MC75 Star Cruiser with dozens of starfighters swarming about.

Glabos were a type of eel that lived in caves on the planet Ryloth. During the first two years of the Clone Wars, which began in 22 BBY, the Twi'lek Jedi Knight Tualon Yaluna went on a mission to Ryloth, during which he learned how to fish for glabos as he waited for an opport…
Abridon was a planet in the galaxy. It was the homeworld of Amnen Jhoff, her son Harclew, and her grandson Kasva.

The Destruction of Dalna was a volcanic cataclysmic event on the planet Dalna in 230 BBY. It was triggered by the Nihil pirate organization and their scientist Zadina Mkampa using a crystal matrix built into the planet's crust that created groundquakes.

The Viscid Bog was a swamp located near the Rambler's Reach Valley on the Outer Rim planet Koboh. During the High Republic Era, the area served as a fresh water source for Jedi and Republic scientists stationed on Koboh to research the Koboh Abyss and the anomalous Koboh matter.
Bramalish were a species that resided on the planet Karaxis.

objective: Seize control of the planet Karaxis and its people
x: During the New Republic Era, General Armitage Hux and Kylo Ren were sent on a mission to the planet Karaxis by Supreme Leader Snoke, who wanted the planet under the First Order jurisdiction.
Bavana was a planet located in the Sertar sector within the Outer Rim Territories. The traitor Graygon Eckt hid on the planet from Count Dooku.

The viscid lurker, sometimes referred to as simply lurker, was a species of jellyfish-like aquatic invertebrates endemic to the Outer Rim planet Koboh. The species dwelled in dark, underground waters of the planet, intentionally avoiding natural light.
The barbed hookfish was a species of fish endemic to the Outer Rim planet Koboh. The species evolved out of necessity into a brutal predator.

The blue-finned crayfish was a species of crustacean endemic to the Outer Rim planet Koboh. The species was particularly elusive. At one point, priorite prospectors thought to capture the rare creature to sell at a high price. Their failures made many declare the species a myth.
The Ugyir River was a river on Corellia. The bay squid that lived in the river became extinct due to pollution caused by the Galactic Empire's construction of Star Destroyers.

Nena's ship was a ship owned by the Nikto engineer Nenavakasa Nalor. In 34 ABY, Nalor feigned damage to her ship in order to board the supertanker fuel depot Colossus in order to sabotage it for the First Order.

The Reekrider Cartel, or the Reekriders, was a criminal cartel. Following the Battle of Kur in 232 BBY, a Nihil Strike in Tempest Runner Pan Eyta's Tempest group seized a reedug drug shipment from the cartel, which had been destined for the celestial body Athiss.

Praadost II was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Nembus sector's Praadost system. Once hosting an environment friendly to its inhabitants, Praadost II was strip-mined by the Separatists shortly after the Clone Wars began in 22 BBY, leaving its air unbreathable,…

The snakefish was a species of fish endemic to the holy moon Jedha, orbiting the Mid Rim planet NaJedha. The snakefish thrived in the scattered oases of the moon, including in the Narkis Highlands. The frigid waters of the oases provided a natural coolant for the snakefish.

The Narkis Highlands were an area of the Narkis Desert on the Pilgrim Moon Jedha, orbiting the Mid Rim planet NaJedha. The highlands were the namesake of the Narkis Anchorite group, since members of the monastic cult frequently visited the area.
The Phlac-Arphocc Prototype was a sample model of the droid tri-fighter, manufactured by Phlac-Arphocc Automata Industries.
Inleshat were a sentient species. Anst Wozo was an Inleshat who operated during the High Republic Era.
The Jedha Markets, also known as Jedha's primary marketplace, was a location in the Holy City of Jedha. The market covered a large area of the Holy City, hosting many market stalls and vendors.

Hangar D-13 was a hangar aboard the First Order Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Thunderer. In 34 ABY, as the TIE pilot Tamara Ryvora was preparing her TIE fighter for departure from the Star Destroyer in order to desert from the First Order, she was questioned by Agent Tierny a…
The Castilon gorgs were a non-sentient subspecies of the amphibious gorg. Bitey was a member of the species.

A type of arthropod was native to the Wild Space world Mulita. In 231 BBY, the sentient carnivorous plants known as the Drengir weaponized the arthropods to act as guards for them during the joint Jedi Order and Hutt Clan assault on Mulita.

The Moon of Sarkhai was a boxy cruiser used by the Path of the Open Hand. In 382 BBY, it was part of a mission to retrieve Nameless eggs from Planet X, captained by an individual named Hal and carrying Path members Nanda and Tragor.
In 230 BBY, a groundquake occurred in the mining village of Charbana on the planet Mikkia. Jedi Mirro Lox and Amadeo Azzazzo were dispatched to help.

The Jedi Temple armory was located within the Jedi Temple on the Galactic Republic capital planet of Coruscant during the High Republic Era. Within the armory, Jedi such as Kirak Infil'a and Master Govena constructed a range of lightsabers for the order.

The Children of the Storm were a group within the Nihil that were led by scientist Baron Boolan. They were former Force-sensitives whom the baron had experimented on. They were Jedi hunters who captured Force users for Boolan to perform experiments on.

A subjugation of the planet Wayland occured when a Dark Jedi Joruus C'baoth, the insane clone of Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth, forced the native Myneyrsh, Psadan, and Human populations to live together—creating his own kingdom in the city at the base of Mount Tantiss.
3V-NT was an astromech droid that accompanied Kars Kussix and helped him with his work.

The Island was an unidentified island located on an unidentified planet. Many castaways called the island home after they had crashed on the planet.
A planet surrounded by a maelstrom was covered in oceans and contained an island. The inhabitants of The Island, who were stranded on the planet, referred to themselves as Castaways.

A clan which included members of the Hutt species was active at Kintan, a Hutt Space planet that was the homeworld of the Nikto Nenavakasa Nalor. Years before 34 ABY, when she was a little girl, Nalor was enslaved by pirates, who later sold her to the clan.

An HK-87 droid leader was in command of a unit of HK-87 assassin droids serving Witch Morgan Elsbeth. The droid had a dark grey photoreceptor and was painted in dark red. It carried an electrostaff and wore a tattered grey cloak.

A reek-like creature was owned by Yonak's father and caged in the Son-tuul Pride base. Yonak's father would feed the creature severed heads. The creature was eventually killed by Darth Vader.
R8-H23 was an R8 series droid astromech droid whose main task was to spread holiday cheer and treats to all. He was colored in red, white, and green, and wore a festive wreath with a gold bow.
8D-8D, or simply referred as Eights, was a training droid who served the Jedi Order on Starlight Beacon during the High Republic Era.

Serenno Spaceport Security, also known as Serenno Spaceport Control, was the local law enforcement agency operating in the Carannia Spaceport on Serenno.
A shipyard on Corellia produced control boards during the Imperial Era. Around 13 BBY, the White Worms criminal organization attempted to stage a raid at the shipyard and steal its products.

During the Yuuzhan Vong War, at some point between 25 ABY and 29 ABY, the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong invaders subjugated Kintan, the homeworld of the Nikto species.
Doc Nindle's place was a building in Ferdan, on Dalna, that served as Doc Nindle's clinic and surgery center. It featured windows, an examination table, a cupboard with shelves, and storage drawers.
A boarding house or lodging house was owned by Lady Jara in Ferdan, on Dalna. It was known locally as the only place off-worlders stayed when they visited Dalna.

The Mother's cottage was the residence of the leader known as The Mother within the Path of the Open Hand compound on the planet Dalna. It had been built by a Weequay who had died of a wasting illness.

Marda Ro's cell was the personal residence of Marda Ro within the Path of the Open Hand compound on the planet Dalna. It was clustered with other cells near the southern edge of the Path commune.
The honeycomb cells were a tightly grouped cluster of living cells located within the Path of the Open Hand compound on the planet Dalna. One of the cells was occupied by Marda Ro.

Yana Ro's cell was the personal residence of Yana Ro within the Path of the Open Hand compound on the planet Dalna.
Imperial Diplomatic Shuttle 993 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle which served as a personal shuttle of Imperial Intelligence agent Jahan Cross.
Forrians were small, furry mammals that lived on the world Batuu. They harvested dried berries from the forest floor and had claws that they used to grip tree bark.

Skylar-birds were a type of bird that lived on the world Batuu. While meditating in the Batuu Jedi temple around 379 BBY, Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani reached out with the Force, perceiving the life around her as glowing colors and sensing both a flock of skylar-birds and a herd…

Hosnian termite were a type of small termite that shared its name with the Core Worlds' Hosnian system. Around 12 BBY, a team of Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate operatives—led by the woman Qi'ra—visited a Jedi temple on a planet to seek a Force artifact.
Coronet salamanders were fly-eating salamanders that partially shared their name with Coronet City, a city on the Core Worlds planet Corellia.
Vader's throne room was the personal throne room of the Sith Lord Darth Vader within his personal residence, Fortress Vader, on the planet Mustafar.

According to rumors, kill zones, also known as killzones, were locations established inside the Occlusion Zone by the Nihil. It was assumed that Nihil patrols used those kill zones to get rid of starships that managed to break through the Stormwall without beeing destroyed.
The Observatory was an ancient building on The Island.

Marrok's Fiend fighter was a modified RP82 Fiend fighter used by Marrok, a former Jedi hunter of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius, while serving the witch Morgan Elsbeth as a mercenary during the post-Imperial era.
An asteroid field was located in the Outer Rim Territories. Kori Zaran was stranded in the field, and undertook the galaxy mission to return to Hoth.

Sarjenn 3 was a moon in the Sarjenn system, orbiting an astronomical object. Between 0 ABY and 4 ABY, Darth Vader embarked on a mission with Sulaco in order to convert her from a rebel spy to a double agent for the Galactic Empire.
The Sarjenn 3 port was the sole port of the moon Sarjenn 3. At some point, the port was converted into a rebel stronghold.
In 5 ABY, during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the New Republic, the New Republic declared victory over the Empire at Andara.

After the Declaration of a New Order in 19 BBY, the Galactic Empire immediately blockaded the planet Ossus in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. Access to the planet was restricted to only those cleared by the Office of the Emperor.

Ylesian White Worms were a type of worm from the planet Ylesia, where their larval stage could be found in mud.
The Enami were a species of furry humanoids native to the planet Ena. Their fur could range in shades of brown with speckles of color which could lose its hue or turn white with old age.
The Cadamo Sun was a YT-1300 light freighter in service during the Galactic Civil War.

The brikal was a blue-shelled arthropod found on the planet Dalna, which was used by the Path of the Open Hand to make the blue paint that members wore on their faces. The paint was created by crushing the shells and mixing them with chalk and a sweet-smelling binding agent.
An spontaneous resistance movement erupted into being on the planet Ferrix during the Galactic Empire's occupation, which had been upsetting the sons and Daughters of Ferrix, in 5 BBY.
The honey glider was a small non-sentient species found on the planet Dalna. They could jump and glide in the air using wing membranes. A diet of blue brikal larvae tinted the animals bright blue.
Asheris was a terrestrial moon located in Tagge Space. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the droids of the Tagge Corporation ship, the Casus Belli, were infected by the Scourge.

The Sarkhai were a people native to the Mid Rim world of Sarkhai. The Sarkhai people painted their faces to protect themselves from predators that lurked in the forests.

Between 21 BBY and 19 BBY, Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi of the Jedi Order participated in a skirmish against Tofen's Raiders. While fighting the Confederacy of Independent Systems–aligned Tofen's Raiders pilot unit, Kenobi's starfighters experienced technical issues.
8422 was a B1-series battle droid that served the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the Battle of Murkhana, the droid approached Captain Wilhuff Tarkin with a E-5 blaster rifle in hand.

A space battle took place in the Kessel system during the Galactic Civil War. It was the culmination of an attempt of the Rebel Alliance's Fourth Battle Group to take control of Kessel from the Galactic Empire.
The Radiant Anthem was a Rebel Corellian corvette in service during the Galactic Civil War.

A wait staff droid was serving food and drinks in a commissary on the planet Eriadu during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the RDC officer Captain Pikka Adren ordered jogan juice and salted wuli nuts from the droid.
Sector two was a part of the Rebel Alliance Lucrehulk-class battleship Lucrehulk Prime that contained the brig.
The Karthakk Queen was a X4 Gunship that was used by the Lok Revenants during the Galactic Civil War. It was destroyed by Black Epsilon in the Karthakk system in 1 ABY.

The kite was a species of flying creature native to the Core Worlds planet Alderaan. For generations, the Alderaanian inhabitants of the world tamed two species, kites and thrantas, to act as airbourne steeds and convey individuals from one city to another.
Isatabith falls was a point of interest on the planet Alderaan that shared its name with the Isatabith forest. Alderaan was destroyed by the Galactic Empire in 1 BBY.
During their expansion, the Sith Empire attacked the Galactic Republic-controlled planet Draethos.
During their expansion, the Sith Empire raided the planet of Quermia.
During their expansion, the Sith Empire raided the planet of Felucia.

The Squall was a location where those aspiring to be members of the Emperor's Royal Guard sparred against each other. During their final test, trainees fought each other to the death before Emperor Palpatine.

The Vallent IX was a CR90 corvette that was used by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. It was captured in 1 ABY by a traitorous Alliance engineer who planned to deliver it to the Ghrag Mercenaries.

Soola was an astronomical object located in the Soola system of the Outer Rim's Khuiumin sector. In 231 BBY, the Jedi Order staged a skirmish near Soola so it could infiltrate the Nihil pirates and discover its leader's identity.

R0-1N6 was an R0-series astromech droid that played the drums as part of a performance by Maximilian Rebo alongside a Bith musician at Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary on the planet Tatooine. R0-1N6 was destroyed when the Pyke Syndicate bombed Fwip's sanctuary in 9 ABY.

Epikonia was a terrestrial tech-focused planet located in the Ojoster sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was a communications hub that relayed and boosted signals from its sector to other parts of the galaxy.

The Aldera Alps were a chain of snow-capped mountains on the planet Alderaan. The city of Aldera, which notably housed the Royal Palace of Alderaan, was nestled between those mountains and a lake.
The Nihil established their main base on the planet Hetzal Prime after they destroyed Starlight Beacon and established the Occlusion Zone. They established it to control food shipments.
A protocol droid served as a translator for Jabba the Hutt at Jabba's Palace.

Thorum was a minor jungle planet located in the Thorum system of the Vendusii sector in the Mid Rim Territories of the galaxy. It had a substantial Crimson Dawn presence. Calda was the planet's largest city and a business hub. The Hammers syndicate were also located on the world.
The Massassi Reborn was a HC-A1A Medium Cruiser that operated during the Galactic Civil War.
The Rambling Ghost was a freighter that operated during the Galactic Civil War.
The Falling Sunspot was a transport that operated during the Galactic Civil War.

The Gray Cap was a cantina located on the planet Corellia. The cantina was a popular hangout for off-duty Imperial officers. At some point, a group of rebels raided the cantina to gather intel from the off-duty officers.
Hylanth was a moon located in the Hylanth system in the Meram sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Two astronomical objects were able to be seen from the surface of the moon.
R4-6D0 was the personal R4 astromech droid of High Magistrate Greef Karga on Nevarro. When the Pirate Nation attacked Nevarro, the droid sent a message to the New Republic asking for aid.

Between 21 BBY and 19 BBY during the Clone Wars between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic, a Confederate naval force launched an attack against a Republic fleet. The battle saw Republic and Separatist ships clash.
R2-D3 was one of the astromech droids on D'Qar. When R6-D8 malfunctioned right before the Battle of Starkiller Base, R2-D3 took his place as Temmin Wexley's astromech for the battle.
Anto Kreegyr's group was a rebel cell led by Anto Kreegyr, a former militant of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, as part of the neo-Separatist Coalition.
The Lothal County Fair was a county fair hosted on Lothal.

Miv'rah was a world located in the Miv'rah system within the Gaulus sector of the Outer Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square R-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid, and was linked to the Ab Dalis and Wrea systems by the Corellian Run super-hyperroute.

Clan Werda was a Mandalorian clan active during the Third Galactic War and the concurrent Mandalorian civil war.
Galjaero was a planet located in the Tungra sector within the Outer Rim Territories. In 232 BBY, the Abednedo Chigg and other former pirates got their starship stuck in the mud on the planet.
A village was located in the trees of Kashyyyk during the High Republic Era. The Wookiees Johgeshakka and Whitaggikk lived there.

Mardorsh were creatures that were encountered by Lys Solay and SF-R3 on the planet Aludia. At that time, they were considered to be a newly discovered species by the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts.
Ayrou were a sentient species. Kilan T'Dara—who served as chair of the advisory council for Force-related groups known as the Convocation of the Force—was an Ayrou.
Ootoos were a sentient species from Ootoo Prime. Ayva Ackler was an Ootoo miner who lived during the High Republic Era.

Ballum was a planet located within the Mid Rim near the Nihil Occlusion Zone during the High Republic Era. A year after the destruction of Starlight Beacon, Ballum was the base of operations for Skarabda the Wise.
PT-3 was a droid who lived with the Chadra-Fan Marlaa Jinara after being abandoned by his previous owner.

The lesser houses were a group of families on the planet of Serenno. Members of the Great Houses of Serenno—the six major noble families—met in the Great Assembly House to discuss matters of planetary importance with members of the lesser houses performing a purely advisory role.
AG-1 was a droid built by the farmer Roog on the planet Omaka.
AG-2 was a droid built by the farmer Roog on the planet Omaka.
AG-3 was a droid built by the farmer Roog on the planet Omaka.
The Chiffons were avian creatures found on the planet Kondoraan. They used their wings to glide along the wind current of the planet.

Haven was a mountain village on the planet Ison. Haven was led by Lesa Benex, the woman who started Haven to be a place where people could live in peace, away from all the violence brought by the Galactic Empire.

Cols was an astronomical object located in the Cols system within the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square Q-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid. At one point, Cols was under the control of the Galactic Republic.

Ookbat was an astronomical object located in the Ookbat system within the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim and the Slice. It was situated in grid square Q-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The Ootmian Pabol hyperspace route linked Ookbat to the Randon and Ubrikkia systems.

Rorak 5 was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Rorak system in Hutt Space and the Slice. It was situated in grid square S-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Rorak 5 was located at the junction of the Gamor Run and the Shag Pabol hyperspace routes.

The species of sentient reptoids from the depths of the Unknown Regions had long-vanished before the formation of the Galactic Empire. Known members of the extinct reptilian race included the Kanzer Exiles, a fanatical flock led by the Lord Ravager Korman Lao.

During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, there was heavy fighting in the Humbarine sector including the bombardment of the sector's capital, Humbarine, by Separatist forces.

Recon troopers where a type of clone trooper that specialized in reconnaissance missions. A part of the Galactic Republic's Grand Army of the Republic, Recon troopers wore white Phase II clone trooper armor and used a black blaster.
Gonkstar was a Power droid who resided on Kef Bir after the Battle of Endor.

Kondoraan was a planet within the galaxy. The inhabitants used sky skimming boards as their main method of transportation. In 232 BBY, Zia Zaldor Zanna took a group of Jedi younglings to Kondoraan, where they learned how to surf.

Albrae-Don was a world in the Albrae-Don system in the Sern sector of the Colonies, in grid square L-13 of the Standard Galactic Grid. During the Imperial Era, Albrae-Don was a rebellious world along with other worlds in the Sern sector such as Ghorman.

Luzalite was a planet located in the Luzalite system of the Core Worlds and the Interior, situated in grid square L-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid. A hyperspace route connected it to the Pantolomin and Coruscant systems.

Sulorine was an astronomical object in the Sulorine system in the Suolriep sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of the human Vanden Huyck Willard, who was serving with the Alliance to Restore the Republic on the moon Yavin 4 by 1 BBY.
Gorag Tower was a tower in a city on the planet Reena containing a penthouse owned by House Reena. Around 396 BBY, it was the site of a party celebrating the Queen's Bloom Festival.
A city on the planet Reena was home to Reena University.
Rampa 2, also known as Rampa II, was a planet located in the Rampa Minor system, within the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
Aaricetri was a planet located on the very edge of the Imperial Outer Rim. The starport city of Penshakka was located on Aaricetri.
The howler lizard was a type of arboreal lizard that could be found in the jungles around the Massassi Site on the moon Yavin 4 in 1 BBY. The reptile's cries could carry for miles.
During their expansion, the Sith Empire raided the planet of Gand.
During their expansion, the Sith Empire raided the planet of Florn.
Ifron was a planet located in the Thuris sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the Bovris Tapcafe, which notably served Thuris Caf.
Aludia was a forest planet located in the galaxy. During 232 BBY, a starship thief named Sty Trune crash-landed a starship on Aludia's surface after getting into a fight with bounty hunter Rhugo Tar.

Barlok was a terrestrial planet in the Barlok system of the Marcol sector in the Inner Rim Territories and the Interior. It fell within grid square L-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. The world was known for its advanced horticultural techniques.
Torren was a planet within the galaxy. During the Clone Wars, Grand Master Yoda went to Torren, uncovering mysteries that surrounded the red planet and visiting its Temple Ruins.

A battle took place on the planet Balmorra between the Jedi Order and the Dark Jedi during the Hundred-Year Darkness. The Leviathans who were bred by the Jen'jidai Sorzus Syn splintered the Jedi barricades on the planet.

Corellian bloodhounds were slim, agile canids averaging up to a meter in length. Their bodies were covered in a fine coat of quills and possessed enlarged snouts to aid in smelling for prey, while their teeth were shaped like daggers.

Gel was an android and a partner to the human Kako.

MHD-19 was a medical droid doctor and member of the Rebel Alliance. The sick patient Palia was under his care.

The Coyn's Tempest was a Ye-4 gunship that was used as a flagship by a band of Coynite mercenaries active in the Dathomir system during the Galactic Civil War.

The Northern tundra was a location on the northern pole of the planet Lothal, where the Lothal Jedi Temple was located.

Spiridian lizards were a type of lizard that could be eaten as food. By 382 BBY, during the High Republic Era, a meat trader sold seared Spiridian lizards in the Holy City on the Mid Rim moon Jedha.

Firehawks were rare birds native to the planet Tenoo. Nash Durango named her starship, the Crimson Firehawk, after them. They are known for their stubbornness and their beautiful feathers.
The Comet Runners were a pirate group led by the Palliduvan Corr Taldaan during the High Republic Era.
B-333, also known as Bee-Triple-Three or Big Bee, was a droid who worked alongside the black market smuggler Argomon.
Pikpik were a diminutive, sentient rodent species. Some Pikpiks worked as scrappers on the planet Bracca during the High Republic Era.
M1-M1, commonly referred to as "Mimi," was a small droid who assisted the scrapper Eren Kitt on the planet Bracca.

t: Unidentified RA-7 protocol droid (ISB Office of Internal Review)
x: An RA-7 protocol droid worked for the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau at the ISB Office of Internal Review on Coruscant.
The Unbreakable was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that served as the flagship of Admiral Corleque of the Galactic Empire.
The Kessel Massacre was an event that took place in the Spice Mines of Kessel at some point before the Battle of Geonosis.

Eye-Oh-Ninety-Eight-Dee was the designation of a droid processor of the Galactic Empire. The Sith Lord Darth Vader utilized the droid brain and several others to take control of the M.A.R. Corps, a team of cyborg rebels, with Eye-Oh-Ninety-Eight-Dee being implanted into Masakint.
Zuborta Ma was a shattered asteroid field in the Albarrio sector's Mygeeto system.
The Jedha Campus was a Jedi academy on the planet Jedha. The campus had a policy restricting the keeping of wild animals as pets, including those deemed "cute."
Nanta's tree was a tree in Bright Tree Village on the forest moon Endor where Nanta—an Ewok who aspired to become a Storykeeper—recorded his stories by carving them into the tree's bark.

A Jedi Initiate clan included the Jedi younglings Reva Sevander and Faris. In 19 BBY, the clan were present in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant when they were attacked by clone troopers as part of Order 66.
R2-I2 was an astromech droid who was captured by the giant droid known as the Great Heep on Biitu. The droid likely survived it's captivity.

A secondary facility served as a backup for Darth Sidious's secret facility on Mustafar, where the Sith Lord attempted to perform a conditioning procedure to turn Force-sensitive children into his personal army of dark side spies.
The Ikoru was a Nihil cloudship used by Marchion Ro and the She'ar to travel to Planet X to retreive members of the Nameless species.

Lurca hounds were a species of dog on the planet Wayland. They had gray skin, and the sclera of their eyes was red while their pupils were blue. Lurcas had bony frills protruding from their noses—which were snubbed—and were muscular.
K-9X1, or K-9, was a droid in service to the Galactic Empire in the Mount Tantiss facility on the planet Wayland. They had a yellow sensor, and were equipped with a stun baton.

Dryaxes were a type of huge, humanoid-shaped predator found in the jungles of the planet Wayland. They had glowing red eyes and lupine features. During or after 18 BBY, the clones Omega and Crosshair encountered a dryax on Wayland while fleeing from Tantiss Base.

The assault on Exegol, otherwise known as the razing of Exegol, was carried out in 3 ABY, by the Schism Imperial when they attempted to challenge Emperor Palpatine's power by attacking the Sith Citadel on Exegol where he kept his greatest treasures and secrets.

The Tantiss Base communication center was a communication center within Tantiss Base of Mount Tantiss, which provided incoming transports with clearance and instructions on how to approach and land on the facility.
a: Weyland facility air traffic control room

result: Omega, Crosshair, and Batcher escape Mount Tantiss
objective: Escape the Tantiss Base
x: The escape from Tantiss was a skirmish during the early reign of the Galactic Empire in which the rogue clones Omega and Crosshair, along with a lurca hound named "Batcher," escaped from confinement at Mount Tantiss during or after 18 BBY.
The Tantiss Base command center was a location within the Galactic Empire's Tantiss Base on Mount Tantiss.
Shuttle 135 was a Nu-class attack/transport shuttle that operated as part the Galactic Empire's Advanced Science Division.
The central lab was a highly secure laboratory in the Tantiss Base utilized by Kaminoan cloning expert Nala Se to research the integration of m-count into clone trooper blood.

A medical bay was located in the Tantiss Base on Mount Tantiss, where Emerie Karr, assistant to Imperial cloning program chief Royce Hemlock, collected the blood of clone troopers imprisoned in the facility to test for successful m-count integration.
Setron was a jungle planet in the Expansion Region. Doctor Royce Hemlock of the Galactic Empire once had a laboratory stationed on the planet.
Imena was the only inhabited planet in the Tybal system. It had large blue oceans and five moons, one of which had a spaceport.

Conscription trooper pilots were conscripted soldiers that served as Imperial Starfighter Pilots for the Galactic Empire during the early Imperial Era. They acted as a precursor to the TIE fighter pilots that were later used by the Empire.

The Battle of Seswenna was fought between the Nihil pirates against the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. After the battle, the Nihil celebrated their triumph over the Republic and Jedi during a celebration at their compound on Hetzal Prime.

Aricho was a planet located in the Outer Rim behind the Nihil pirates Stormwall in the Occlusion Zone during the High Republic Era. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon in 230 BBY, Jedi Padawan Imri Cantaros hid on the planet.

Flower serpents were a type of serpent found on the Outer Rim planet Haileap. The scientist Avon Starros—who lived for a time on Haileap—considered them to be pretty but deadly, and that they had no care for anything beyond themselves.
Omega's room was a room located in the Galactic Empire's Tantiss Base on the planet Wayland where the young clone Omega lived during her Imperial captivity during or after 18 BBY.

Sarumo was a planet of the Galactic Republic situated within the Galactic Frontier in the Outer Rim Territories. During the High Republic Era, General Abediah Viess chose to live in retirement on Sarumo.
The human Elecia Zeveron led a crew of thieves around 396 BBY. One member of the crew, the Kilotowan Leyli Romero, was attending Reena University as a student to spy for them.
A B1 battle droid was stationed on the Separatist Subjugator-class heavy cruiser Malevolence in 22 BBY.
The Imperial citadel was a secret Galactic Empire fortress on the Deep Core planet Byss, the secret throneworld of Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine.

Janaus was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Janaus system in the Thrasybule sector of the Outer Rim Territories, in grid square P-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid, that was the site of a Jedi outpost established by the Jedi Order during the Republic Era.

Lesser Tontakoh was an astronomical object in the Lesser Tontakoh system in the Klina sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the site of a Jedi outpost of the Jedi Order during the Republic Era.
Barayfe was an astronomical object in the Barayfe system in the Alchenaut sector of the Expansion Region where the Jedi Order maintained a Jedi outpost during the Republic Era.

Tharben was a terrestrial planet in the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice, near the edge of Hutt Space along the Ootmian Pabol. The planet was home to a Jedi outpost of the Jedi Order and had a security patrol subsidized by the Galactic Republic.
Ord Jannak was a terrestrial planet situated along the Ootmian Pabol in the Slice. The Jedi Order had a Jedi outpost on Ord Jannak during the Republic Era.

Yitabo was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Yitabo system in the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim Territories. Situated near the planet Kwenn, Yitabo exported foodstuff to many of the worlds around it.

The Gem Cities of Kwenn were a series of thirteen island archipelagoes situated on the planet Kwenn. The islands were transformed as part of the Grand Renewal, one of the Great Works of the High Republic Era, when Kwenn was rescued from the brink of destruction.

Brazatta Key was one of the islands in the Windward Chain of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. It contained an industrial zone and a spaceport, and was home to a number of manufacturers that exported goods to the rest of Kwenn.

Vorah Key was an island on the planet Kwenn, a part of the Windward Chain of the Gem Cities of Kwenn. It contained a judicial complex as well as Gutson's Pub, and was known for its nightlife. Bridges connected Vorah Key to Brazatta, Capital, and Zyboh Keys.

Zyboh Key was an island of the Gem Cities of Kwenn's Windward Chain on the planet Kwenn. It contained Kwikhaul Livery Corporation and a fathier-racing venue, and also hosted a vintage spacecraft show and auction. Zyboh Key was connected via bridges to Vorah, Gala, and Parva Keys.

Parva Key was an island of the Windward Chain of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. The island contained the Bivall Colony, which provided a home for members of the Bivall species after the Protobranch disaster, as well as other aquatic beings.
Essafa Key was an island of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn, situated in the Middle Chain.

Gala Key was an island of the Middle Chain in the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. The island was known for its entertainment, containing an arena where acts from across the galaxy came to perform.

Capital Key was an island of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn, situated within the Middle Chain. Sanctuary Mount, a mountain that contained an outpost of the Jedi Order, was situated on Capital Key.

Kinnawah Key was one of the islands of the Middle Chain of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. It contained the Lamplighter Boutique, a district famed for its antiquities, as well as a landing for the casino sail barge Pelagic.

Langdam Key was an island of the Gem Cities of Kwenn's Middle Chain on the planet Kwenn. The island was home to the Harbor Market, where luxury shopping was available, including the Tasty Comet dessert and fine clothiers.

Quarney Key was an island in the Middle Chain of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. The island contained a nature preserve and served as the gateway to the exotic chains of the north sports waterfalls and caves that were crafted as part of the Grand Renewal.

Rayley Key was an island of the Leeward Chain of the planet Kwenn's Gem Cities of Kwenn. The island was home to the Paths of Harmony, a park designed to promote reflection and healing that originated from the mind of a Jedi Master, as well as a clinic.

Malbaira Key was an island of the Leeward Chain in the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. The island was protected from development as a nature preserve, and its flora and fauna attracted numerous naturalists. Malbaira Key was also known for its views of the aquatic oroko.

Addoa Key was an island of the Leeward Chain within the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. Rendili Hyperworks operated on the island, which was home to factories connected via spaceport to the Kwenn Space Station above the planet.
The Windward Chain was an island chain that was part of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. The chain consisted of Brazatta, Parva, Vorah, and Zyboh Keys.
The Middle Chain was an island chain within the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. It contained the Capital, Essafa, Gala, Kinnawah, Langdam, and Quarney Keys.
The Leeward Chain was one of the three island chains of the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn. It contained the Addoa, Malbaira, and Rayley Keys.

The teal oroko, commonly known as simply oroko, were aquatic nine-pointed echinoderms that could be found in the sea of the planet Kwenn. The creatures had numerous spawning grounds within the islands of the Gem Cities of Kwenn, including near the Gala, Essafa, and Malbaira Keys.

Sanctuary Mount was a promontory on Capital Key in the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn that served as an outpost of the Jedi Order. Sanctuary Mount was the name of both the promontory and the Jedi outpost that had been carved into it.
Regal Voyager was a travel company that operated luxury liners in the region known as the Slice. The company offered passage to the planet Kwenn and its Gem Cities of Kwenn.

The Pelagic was a casino sail barge that operated within the Gem Cities of Kwenn on the planet Kwenn, traveling between the various islands of the archipelago. The casino's home port was on Brazatta Key, and it also docked on Gala, Capital, Kinnawah, Langdam, and Quarney Keys.

A supply ship served within the fleet of the Tagge Corporation during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, the supply ship was attacked by the D'Armin Syndicate, which led to a drop for the company in the Hadi system.

The Jedi Order established an outpost on the planet Kwenn at some point by the High Republic Era. In 229 BBY, Jedi Master Yarael Poof was present at the outpost while he attended a meeting—via hologram—with the remainder of the Jedi High Council, Jedi Master Elzar Mann, and Su…

x: Around 3 ABY, a battle was fought in Tagge Space between the Tagge Corporation and the Scourge who had infected the company's droids and cyborg employees.
The Gurus of the Assassin Guild were individuals affiliated with the Assassin Guild. At one point they taught the bounty hunter Dengar twelve forms of bladed combat.
During the early reign of the Galactic Empire Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine used a Rho-class transport shuttle as his personal craft.

Lau was a planet in the Meerian sector of the Outer Rim Territories. After Omega and Crosshair fled Imperial facility on Wayland, they ended up on Lau before they managed to steal and ship and leave the planet.
A droid was the bartender at a cantina on the planet Lau during or after 18 BBY.
Lau birds were species of birds with colorful feathers native to the planet Lau.
Gonko was a Power droid who resided on in the Jundland Wastes on Tatooine. He wanted to be escorted and protected from the Tusken Raiders, but fell over on the way to his destination
Ekuda was a celestial body in the Ekuda system. During the Galactic Civil War, Imperial Alpha and Tau Squadrons attacked the MC80 Calamari Cruiser Tano in space near Ekuda.
A town was located in the planet Lau. It included a spaceport, where Star Commuter 2000 shuttles ferried passengers to the planet, as well as a cargo port.

An unidentified species had once inhabited the planet Rhand in the ancient past. After the original inhabitants of Rhand mysteriously disappeared, the structures that they had constructed fell into ruin.

The fatalists of Plootark IX were a mysterious group found on the planet Plootark IX. The fatalists are credited with the invention of absolute disruptor technology that caused Class-D disintegration, also known as transcendental annihilation.
VP-8R was a bodyguard droid who served the pilot Vane Sarpen during the High Republic Era.

The moon of Saltear was a terrestrial moon that was the site of a settlement. After the formation of the Nihil marauder organization's Occlusion Zone in the Outer Rim in 230 BBY, the moon was located at the edge of Nihil territory.

Exu Prime was an Outer Rim astronomical object located in the Tolonda sector's Exu Prime system. In 230 BBY, it became stranded behind the Stormwall hyperspace barrier that defined the Nihil marauder-controlled region of space known as the Occlusion Zone.
The Kinpany Gap mining settlement was a settlement in the mining location Kinpany Gap on the planet Lothal.

An eclectic marketplace was located on an astronomical object. Around 379 BBY, Marda Ro—the Evereni founder of a group of marauders who would eventually become the Nihil—visited the marketplace during her hunt for other members of her species.

result: Omega and Crosshair escape Imperial presence
x: The Cargo Dock Clash was a skirmish that occurred on the planet Lau sometime after the Escape from Tantiss.

Imperial beast tamers were members of the Galactic Empire who weaponized wild creatures for the Empire. They utilized cruel practices to make creatures more violent, allowing them to be used as weapons for the Empire.
The Iron Assembler was a vulture droid of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The droid was identified as a Scintilla Scavenger.

Belin's ship was a transport starship piloted by the Ugnaught Belin during the High Republic Era. After Belin was trapped behind the Stormwall in the Occlusion Zone, a region of space captured by the Nihil marauders, he unwillingly used his ship to transport cargo for the Nihil.

Prandril was a small moon in the Outer Rim, situated in the Prandril system within the Minos Cluster. During the High Republic Era, the moon was home to a colony of the Rodian species, who did not wish to spoil the land upon which they settled.
An asteroid field was located in the Prandril system, situated in the Minos Cluster within the Outer Rim.

An unnamed moon was located in the Farj system where it orbited the second planet in the system. It had no water and was uninhabited. It was covered with an organic network similar to an aboveground silver and gray root system.

The Financial District, also known as the financial zone was a location that spanned 30 square kilometers in the Galactic City of Coruscant. It was adjacent to the Federal District and The Works and housed many banks and financial institutions as well as the Greth Lan-Dwu Corp.
Arli's moon was a moon that orbited the ocean planet Arli in the Outer Rim. During the High Republic Era, the family of Jordanna Sparkburn, a member of the San Tekka clan, resided on the moon.

Arli was a red ocean planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Great Hyperspace Rush, the planet was settled and had a hyperspace route mapped by the San Tekka clan, and a hardy moss was discovered on its islands that could be utilized in various materials.

Uveron was a planet located in the Colonies. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Rebel Alliance leader Mon Mothma undertook a funding mission for the Alliance to the world. During her time on Uveron, Mothma was kidnapped by the Scarabi.
Ice wyrms were a creature found on the planet Barton IV.

A room built from transparisteel was located aboard the Gaze Electric, a ship that belonged to the pirate leader Marda Ro. Although she suspected it was meant to have been used for medical observation, by around 379 BBY she used it to cage a beast known as the Great Leveler.
Shihan was a terrestrial planet in the galaxy mainly inhabited by droids. At some point, Mandalorians Din Djarin and Grogu visited Shihan to deliver cargo to the droids.
The Tempest Breaker was a starship operated by the bounty hunter crew known as the Tempest Breakers during the High Republic Era.
The Wookiee Chalmun maintained a private office behind the main bar of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina, a cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine that Chalmun owned.
Kindosorn was a planet with jungle terrain situated in the Kindosorn system in the Lol sector of the Outer Rim. It was the site of an outpost of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era.
Vuundalla was a planet located in the Bri'ahl sector within the galaxy. The planet was ruled by Pychor Vuundir and Dafne Vuundir.
Seswenna City was the capital city of the Outer Rim planet Seswenna. When Seswenna fell within the Occlusion Zone territory of the Nihil marauders, the city was occupied by the Nihil.
A large gas planet was located in the same system as the ocean planet Arli within the Outer Rim Territories. Situated closest to its sun, the gas planet was also the star system's namesake.

Birage was a small city located on the moon of the planet Arli. The settlement was composed of buildings constructed from sandcrete that were clustered in seven neighborhoods around a central square, also including a spaceport.

The Iliri Spine was a ridge located on the moon of Arli that was blanketed with dark moss and spindly grasses. The ridge was overtaken by a blight that had begun to consume the entire moon, which left the Iliri Spine gray and lifeless.
Neon bats were a type of bat that could produce light that were found on the moon of the planet Arli in the Outer Rim.

The Shrine of Contemplation was one of the ancient Voss temples located near the Interpreter's Retreat on the planet Voss. The shrine's archives contained valuable Force artifacts and records documenting Jedi influence on Voss.

K-5, also known as Kay-Five or five, was one of the K droids constructed by the droid J-6 on Aricho. Along with the other K droids, K-5 was built to assist the local resistance force in liberating Aricho from the Nihil marauders.
The droid designated one was a K droid constructed by the droid J-6 on Aricho. Along with the other K droids, one was built by J-6 to aid the resistance force of Aricho against the Nihil marauders.

Seven was the designation of a K droid built by the droid J-6 on Aricho. The K droids were made to aid the planet's resistance force in liberating its people from the control of the Nihil marauders, although seven was incomplete.

The Hadros Vipers were a sports team active during the High Republic Era that took part in a sport where an individual batted. They originated from the Outer Rim's Hadros system, and shared their name with the planet Hadros in that system.

Interpreter's Retreat was settlement of the planet Voss which was a sacred place for interpreters to work. It was located near the shrines of Judgment, Contemplation and Silence. Most of the Retreat was forbidden for outsiders to visit without special permission.

Ytrecht was the capital city of the planet Aricho. It was located on a side of the planet that suffered from powerful storms that made flight difficult, resulting in the town being accessible for only a few months of the year.
A battle took place near Ekuda in the Ekuda system during the Galactic Civil War. Imperial starfighters destroyed the Rebel MC80 Star Cruiser Tano.
Hunamma was a Hutt kajidic. The world Kor Hunamma, which was located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space, was the throneworld of the Hunamma kajidic.
Nijiladii was a Hutt kajidic. The world Kor Nijiladii, which was located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space, was the throneworld of the Nijiladii kajidic.
Oktanivii was a Hutt kajidic. The world Kor Oktanivii, which was located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space, was the throneworld of the Oktanivii kajidic.
Usilic was a Hutt kajidic. The world Kor Usilic, which was located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space, was the throneworld of the Usilic kajidic.

Atalia was a small agrarian planet that had algae farms. Fel Ix grew up there along with some other Kessarine families.
Remora-one, also known simply as the Leech, was a leech vessel used by the Clone Underground during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

A secret deep undercover program of the Galactic Empire's Advanced Science Division was active during its reign. The program was run by Doctor Royce Hemlock and consisted of a clone division trained and conditioned into being special forces operatives known as Clone X troopers.

x: Slandarvia M-9 was an astronomical object in the Mid Rim that was affiliated with Baron Slandarv of the Galactic Empire. Slandarv operated a factory on Slandarvia M-9 that was surrounded by worker housing. In his factory, Slandarv secretly developed a new model of battle droid.
A restaurant serving wraps was located in an unnamed city on Pantora. It used Aurebesh signage to attract customers, which read "[obscured]ANDO [obscured]ON WRAPS".
Revan's hideout was an abandoned apartment used as a hideout by amnesiac Sith Lord Revan and his companions during the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire in 3956 BBY.

A scrap pile was run by the Xot Bidvel on a remote planetoid. Bidvel collected discarded droids, inventoried them, and then sold the useful parts. Davil worked for him at the site, along with one other employee.
In 3 ABY, the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra was ambushed on the Outer Rim world Burnin Konn.

The ambush on Taris took place in 3 ABY, when the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra was ambushed on the Outer Rim world Taris by bounty hunters hired by Lady Domina Tagge—head of the Tagge Corporation—after Aphra had blown up her nephew Ronen Tagge.

result: Chelli Lona Aphra captured by Kharrek and Just Lucky
x: In 3 ABY, a skirmish took place at Arveesh Station between bounty hunters hired by Tagge Corporation and the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra. Ultimately, Aphra was captured by the hunters Kharrek and Just Lucky.
A restaurant serving gyros was located in the central marketplace of Ro Station, a city on Pantora. Another such restaurant was located in an unnamed city where Riyo Chuchi met up with Avi Singh.

The night market was a market located at Arveesh Station in the Mid Rim. In 3 ABY, while working with the bounty hunter Kharrek to capture the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra, the assassin Just Lucky spotted Aphra south of the night market.
The Way of Clarity was a stealth shuttle of the Path of the Open Hand during the High Republic Era.
An astromech worked for the Path of the Open Hand on the Way of Clarity.

A shop selling snow cones was located in the central marketplace of Ro Station, a city on Pantora. Another such shop was located in an unnamed city where Riyo Chuchi met up with Avi Singh. The shop used yellow and pink signage written in Aurebesh to attract customers.
Bill's Assorted was a business located in the central marketplace of Ro Station, a city on Pantora. Another such business was located in an unnamed city where Riyo Chuchi met up with Avi Singh.
A colony in the galaxy was located above a vein of hollinium. At one point during the Imperial Era, a mining conglomerate discovered the hollinium under the colony.

A restaurant serving meat was located in an unnamed city on Pantora. The eatery used a yellow and green sign written in Aurebesh to attract customers, with the word "meats" running vertically down the right side of the sign.

During the Imperial Era, a mining conglomerate discovered a vein of hollinium below a colony in the galaxy. The conglomerate amassed a group of Neutron Star-class bulk cruisers in orbit over the colony, intending to obliterate them.

x: Riyo Chuchi and Avi Singh's secret meeting was a meeting between two senators, the Pantoran Riyo Chuchi of the moon Pantora, and the human Avi Singh of the planet Raxus, during or after 18 BBY.

WED-15-ST68 was an ancient WED-15 Septoid Treadwell owned by a clan of Jawas on the planet Tatooine. In 1 BBY, the Jawa's stopped their sandcrawler stopped at the Lars Homestead on the planet Tatooine in order to sell droids to the Lars family, but the moisture farmer Owen Lar…

The Verdant Dawn was a freighter captained by the Dug Suhlarla Tug during the Imperial Era. An independent vessel, Tug and her crew were a tight-knit bunch who worked together for decades, with some of them even being second- or third-generation.
The Officer's Quarters was an area of the ISB listening station Nova Garon, that contained the living quarters of ISB officers and Bode Akuna.
The Central Command was an area of the ISB listening station Nova Garon.
Hangar Bay was the hangar of the ISB listening station Nova Garon.
The Hangar Bay Exterior was the exterior of the Hangar Bay on the ISB listening station Nova Garon. The Stinger Mantis crew landed at the Hangar Bay Exterior while searching for Bode Akuna.

A prestigious newsnet operated on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant during the Republic Era. By 28 BBY, the newsnet employed the holojournalist Kooib-s Guvar, though she also worked for a less reputable tabloid on the side to earn extra credits.

A tabloid operated during the Republic Era and employed the holojournalist Kooib-s Guvar by 28 BBY. In addition to her work for the tabloid to earn extra credits, Guvar also worked for a prestigious newsnet on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.

Klaatu was a celestial object located in the Klaatu system, in the Airam sector of the Outer Rim. A space battle between the Airam and the Galactic Empire took place near Klaatu during the Galactic Civil War.
M-2XR was a legless protocol droid that was sent to a droid reprocessing plant.

Itch mites were a type of mite. When the Jedi Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi boarded the Invisible Hand, flagship of Separatist General Grievous, during the Battle of Coruscant in 19 BBY, Grievous refered to the Jedi as itch mites when ordering a group of B1-series battle…
Radiant Expanse was a region on the planet Tanalorr. It contained the cliffside location Haven's Edge.

LE-47 was a LE-series droid who was owned by the Comet Runners. At some point during the High Republic Era, Corr Taldaan and the Comet Runners were present at Yarrum Tower when they came across the pirate Taborr Val Dorn who was showing off Jedi artifacts he stole from the dro…
The Pietr was a MC40a light cruiser used by the Rebel Alliance during the the Galactic Civil War.
Y3-99, or Whythree-Ninenine, was a droid who ran Y3-99's Bounty Services on the Outer Rim astronomical object Halmad. The droid provided bounties to a number of bounty hunters, including Jango Fett.
Jaloria was a terrestrial astronomical object situated in the Jalor sector of the Mid Rim. It was the site of a Regional Republic Headquarters during the era of the Galactic Republic.

Swellen was a world located in the Swellen system, within the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A space battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire took place near Swellen during the Galactic Civil War.

Rocrin was a celestial object located in the Rocrin system, within the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A space battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire took place near Swellen during the Galactic Civil War.

A modified DUM-series pit droid worked at the bar at Tanda's Cantina aboard a space station above the planet Suria. Sometime around 18 BBY, the droid interacted with the rogue Clone Force 99 members Hunter and Wrecker as they searched for bounty hunter Fennec Shand.
Suria was a planet located in the Suria system in the Bajic sector of the Outer Rim Territories and the Trailing Sectors. It was situated in grid square P-17 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Gryzards were gator-like carnivores that lived in the murky waters of the planet Veelo. During or after 18 BBY, a group of gryzards attacked the bounty hunter Fennec Shand and the clones Hunter and Wrecker as they traveled along a river on Veelo in a hydroskiff.
A city was located on the planet Gaaten. The city included an orphanage that worked to adopt children whose parents died during the Clone Wars.
Veelo was a planet in the Veelo system in the Vorzyd sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It had a Type III atmosphere which made it lethal for humans without protective breath masks.

x: At some point, a group of explorers led by Fionn Tucat underwent a mission to the Wild Space Moon Lupal with the goal of uncovering the long lost people's secrets and retrieving their remaining treasures.
