x: Hoping to lure Jedi Master Bran Ath' Morath to his death Darth Caldoth destroyed the city of Pundith on the Planet Kizan. Sure enough Jedi ships soon appeared in orbit as Caldoth awaited in the ruins of Pundith.

Gee-Twelve was a droid who worked at Y3-99's Bounty Services, a business operated by the droid Y3-99 on the Outer Rim Territories celestial body Halmad. The former towered above their employer and had gray-colored plating.

Hinda was a world located in the Hinda system, within the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A space battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire took place near Hinda during the Galactic Civil War.

Goff was a world located in the Goff system, within the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A space battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire took place near Goff during the Galactic Civil War.

WAC-77, or "Wack," was a pit droid created on the planet Ojom. The repair droid had a black photoreceptor and brown and tan plating. It served with the Besalisk pilot Javlin on her freighter, along with the Twi'lek mechanic Chalan Talosi.
The Rooftops was a slum on Level 2046 of Coruscant.
Hangar 2046-C was a hangar located in Level 2046 of the Coruscant underworld.

The Undercity Industry was an industrial district located in Level 2046 of the Coruscant underworld.

The Undercity Meats was a location within the Undercity Industry district on Level 2046 of the metropolitan planet Coruscant.
Desert Ridge was a location on the desert moon Jedha within the Narkis Desert.

Essebra was a celestial object located in the Essebra system, within the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A space battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire took place near Essebra during the Galactic Civil War.

Bes was a world located in the Bes system, within the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A space battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire took place near Bes during the Galactic Civil War.
Sir Kron was Protocol droid who assisted Mila while giving Bakurat readings. By the time of the First Order Sir Kron was just a Bodyless copper colored head with vivid yellow eyes.
Sparth was a world that at the time of the First Order had an undercity with gangs.
The Undercity was located on the planet Sparth. During the time of the First Order it was known to have gangs.

A group of Houk bounty hunters, three brothers, operated on the planet Daiyu by 32 BBY. After the valuable relic the Hope of Glee Anselm was stolen, the brothers drank at the Two Blasters Bar as they prepared to take on the recovery bounty.

A group of Nautolan thieves operated during the time of the Galactic Republic. The thieves wore full body armor that spontaneously combusted when they were killed, hiding their identities, and saw themselves as patriots of the Nautolan people.

Tarlox was an ice moon located in the galaxy.
Quellus was an astronomical object in the galaxy known to have an abandoned monitoring station during the time of the First Order.
The Arid Flats was a location on the desert moon Jedha within the Narkis Desert.
The Narkis Desert was a region on the desert moon Jedha.
The Pilgrim's Path was a region on the desert moon Jedha.

The Ruins of Ranvell was once a city of an ancient Force-worshipping cult on the desert moon Jedha, that was once connected to a vast number of trade routes, but by 9 BBY had fallen into ruin. The Divine Oasis was believed to be the city's only water supply.
Ruins Landing Site was a location on the desert moon Jedha within the Ruins of Ranvell.
Whistling Drop was a location on the desert moon Jedha within Pilgrim's Path. It had a crashed Lambda-class T-4a shuttle.
The Veiled Hangar was the hangar of the the Archive on the desert moon Jedha.

Between 385 BBY and 382 BBY, a job on Klynan was carried out by the Evereni Path of the Open Hand cult member Yana Ro while she was a member of the Path's Children, a group of Path members who obtained Force artifacts on behalf of the group's leader, Elecia Zeveron.
Gripp's Landing was a rocky cliffs located on Tenoo. Many firehawks lived on the cliffs.
Tentac was a group of three Airam Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttles during the Galactic Civil War.
Eriadu droid intelligence squad, also known as 5A-G3's spy network was a spy network founded by the droid 5A-G3 to work against the Nihil marauders during the Nihil conflict.

One of a four-eyed quadruped species was ridden by former Nihil Tempest Runner Lourna Dee on the planet Ballum, in her capacity as enforcer for the Hutt Skarabda. It was covered in white fur that was tipped with blue and pink, and had blue spots on its sides.

Woolamander Troopers, also known as Woolatroopers, were an experimental type of clone soldier created by the Kaminoans. They were created under Project Woolatrooper from the genetic template of a Woolamander that was caught on the moon Yavin 4.

Tremaal was an astronomical object with a volcanic surface that was located in the Brentaal system of the Core Worlds.
Verdant Gardens was a location on the planet Tanalorr that led to Jedi Temple. It bordered Haven's Edge.

The Imperial chain code program was created and managed by Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart to implement the nascent Galactic Empire's version of chain codes, biometric information that was carried by citizens.

The Three Sith-keteers was a hypothetical group of Sith that scientist Heinz Darthenshmirtz proposed to a carbonite-frozen Alliance to Restore the Republic spy Perry the Rebelpus that would have consisted of Darthenshmirtz, a Sith-inator-affected Perry, and moisture farmer Fer…
The Tiamat was a MC40a light cruiser used by the Rebel Alliance during the the Galactic Civil War.
The Pembo was a MC80 Star Cruiser used by the Rebel Alliance during the the Galactic Civil War.
The Ack was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser used by the Airam during the the Galactic Civil War.
The Isitoq was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser used by the Airam during the the Galactic Civil War.
The Okinu was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser used by the Airam during the the Galactic Civil War.
The Virocho was a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser used by the Airam during the the Galactic Civil War.

Jindau Station was a location in the Inner Rim Territories At one point after the Attack on Chandrila, Norra Wexley and her team visited Jindau Station while on a mission in their MK-4 freighter, the Moth.
The Smuggler's Tunnels was a network of tunnels beneath Pyloon's Saloon on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.
The Collapsed Passage was a passage that led to the Chamber of Duality on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.
Summit Ridge was a location within Prospector's Folly on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.
Mountain Ascent was a location within Prospector's Folly on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.
The Winding Ravine was a ravine located within Dredger Gorge on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.
The Moldy Depths was a cavern located beneath Harvest Ridge on the planet Koboh.

The Abandoned Foundry was a location within the Koboh lunar satellite facility on the Shattered Moon of the Koboh system.
The Monastery Walls were the walls of an ancient monastery within the Ruins of Ranvell on the desert moon Jedha.
The Abandoned Tradeway was an ancient trade route within the Ruins of Ranvell on the desert moon Jedha, that had a ruined statue of a Nautolan Jedi wielding a Lightsaber.
The Halls of Ranvell was a loaction within the Ruins of Ranvell on the desert moon Jedha.
The Penitent Chambers was a loaction within the Ruins of Ranvell on the desert moon Jedha.
The Desert Passages was a location within the Archive on the desert moon Jedha.
The Base Antechamber was a location within the Archive on the desert moon Jedha.

Sylar's hideout was a hiding place used by Sylar Saris on the planet Veelo. It consisted of a room built into a tree and had a hatch and tunnel leading to a hydroskiff for an escape route. The hideout was guarded by underwater sensor mines.
3B3-21 was a B1-series battle droid that served in the Droid Army of the Trade Federation. In 32 BBY, they were part of the force that invaded the planet Naboo.
A pirate group was comprised of a variety of species including Bith, Abednedo, Twi'leks, and Humans. It operated near the city of Solace on the planet Cerosha.

The Solace militia was a group of ill-trained citizens from the city Solace that was razed to tackle the thread of a pirate group. However the militia were not prepared and were quickly sent fleeing back to the city.
The Codru-Ji chief Rikkar-Du had a camp on the planet Munto Codru. Rikkar Du's family, including his wife Tassa and their son Jassar, lived in a tent in the camp.

The Temple of Elujoji, or simply the temple Elujoji, was a temple on the planet Sukalan. The Force-sensitive human who would eventually be known as the Ronin once heard about the temple from their teacher, who told their student that "the truth of the galaxy" was there and tha…
Da-Vlunnian were a sentient species that lived in the galaxy. During the High Republic Era, one Da-Vlunnian, Masakene, served as the chief steward for Skarabda the Hutt on the planet Ballum.
Noomis Rigans were Humans native to Noomis Riga. The adviser to Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine, Sim Aloo, was a Noomis Rigan.
A scrapyard owned by the slaver Sampa Grott. It was located deep in the Surabat River Valley on the planet Batuu.

Noomis Riga was an agricultural world and the homeworld of the Noomis Rigans. During the Clone Wars, a battle was fought between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems occurred on Noomis Riga.
Ferrixians were the residents of the Outer Rim planet Ferrix.
Vratheans were a type of huge, tentacled, deep-sea leviathan with a bioluminescent carapace that lived in the oceans of the planet Pabu, rarely surfacing from the depths.
Luminescent green rays were a type of bioluminescent ray that dwelled in the oceans of the planet Pabu. They were green in color with flat, disc-shaped bodies and a thin tail.

The gathering field was a field in the compound owned by the Path of the Open Hand cult on the Outer Rim planet Dalna. By 382 BBY, the older sister of the Mikkian Path member sat in the field for days as she planned to leave the group.

A black market hauler was operated by the pilot Argomon and the droid B-333 during the High Republic Era. The black market hauler made deliveries for the Nihil marauders within their Occlusion Zone territory behind the Stormwall, including to the prison ship Korvix Vorn.

objective: Rescue captive prisoners
x: A raid on the Nihil prison ship Korvix Vorn was undertaken to rescue several prisoners.

Ventress' ship was the personal starfighter of bounty hunter Asajj Ventress. The former Sith apprentice flew the ship during the Imperial Era, using it to travel to the planet Pabu during or after 18 BBY to investigate the former Republic special forces squad Clone Force 99.

Pabu cove was a rocky cove located on the island of Pabu. The cove was below the seawall that delineated Lower and Upper Pabu, but lay in a largely uninhabited part of the island, away from the populous.
Odes Town was, according to legend, a town located on the planet Monta that didn't celebrate Life Day.
Merisee was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Merisee system in the Elrood sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The cult built a temple on a asteroid in Wild Space. The temple was said to overlook a fissure which allowed viewers to stare into the essence of the Living Force itself.

The Eaduan village cluster was located on the Outer Rim planet Eadu during the Imperial Era. Although Eadu had a hostile and rainy climate, the southern hemisphere, where the village cluster was located, had fertile soil and was less inhospitable than the northern hemisphere.
A blast range was located on the planet Eadu. Dynamic kyber field experiments were conducted there as part of the Tarkin Initiative's research to create the Death Star.
The Preelos Consortium was a local criminal organization on the planet Toydaria. The Preelos Consortium was well known in the Riar underworld and an ally of the Desilijic Hutt Kajidic.

A clan of Wookiees produced the dish known as rillrrnnn spears by wrapping spears of the plant rillrrnnn in thin strips of meat and soft dough made from grains from the Wookiee homeworld, Kashyyyk, before seasoning and baking them.
Durand's Council was a council within the Durand crime family. A Devaronian captain was put on trial and executed by the council after he was declared guilty of conspiring against the family.

A ship was owned by a Theelin family during the High Republic Era. Between around 397 BBY and 387 BBY, the family was present on the Expansion Region planet Genetia when the Evereni Ro family was attacked by townspeople.

Khaërn VII was an abandoned mining planet, occupied by natives and colonists. The colonists maintained a hyperspace communications relay. The planet was covered in swampy plains and bayous, with the occasional jungle.

OB1, or "Obiwan" was a protocol droid owned by the old Sullustan, Vendor. He was present when his master was killed by the mercenary Hydra under the guise of a consul, having recorded the ordeal despite being decapitated during the process.

Symbiotes were malleable, jelly-like organisms native to the planet Khaërn VII. Symbiotes were capable of enveloping individuals through symbiosis to act as a strong, lightweight diving suit for said individuals.

A trawler was utilized by the Hutt Clan during the High Republic Era. Between around 397 BBY and 387 BBY, the trawler towed a ship containing members of the Evereni Ro family—the cousins Marda and Yana, as well as the two's mothers—to the Hutt Space moon Nar Shaddaa where the …

C-06N, also know as See-Zerosixen, See-Ohsixen, Sixen, or Six-En, for short, was a protocol droid who was stranded inside the Nihil Occlusion Zone with Republic Defense Coalition Lieutenant Visma Tarko and Corporal Elping Tsoo.
A private landing field was located in the Holy City on the Mid Rim moon Jedha near the Roalj Temple. By 382 BBY, it was owned by a donor of the Path of the Open Hand cult.
A group of pirates that stole treasure from an Imperial Governor. Three of its members, Marath, Kalab and Houliet betrayed the group and took the treasure for themselves.
Underneath the complex was Toopil, a secret complex used by members the Chekkoo clan to do clandestine business of their own.
Toprawa City was a city on the planet Toprawa.

Carrion serpents were a type of serpent that lived on the Galactic Frontier planet Tiikae and fed on carcasses.
A settlement was located on the Galactic Frontier planet Tiikae. It contained a Jedi temple and a boarding house.
Andro Prime was a terrestrial astronomical object where the pirate Phee Genoa at one point repaired the circuits of her power droid, MEL.

Olly was a service droid that worked as an attendant at a refueling depot inside a lunar base. The pirate Phee Genoa used the depot and visited during or after 18 BBY to refuel her starship, the Providence.

Una was a nurse droid at Reena University. Dean Ry Harket monitored the purported "symptoms" her student Axel Greylark was exhibiting of malongo pox, correctly—albeit without proof—assuming that he was faking it.

Hemlock's office was the private office for Royce Hemlock, Chief Scientist of the Advanced Science Division in Tantiss Base on the planet Wayland. The room was spartan with few decorations other than two pillars in the corners, a desk and three chairs.

result: Clone Force 99 fails to plant a homing beacon on an Imperial vessel
objective: To retrieve Omega
x: During or after 18 BBY, the Galactic Empire performed a raid on the island Pabu to retrieve genetically defective clone Omega.

Around 379 BBY, Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani underwent her Jedi Trials on the world Batuu. Her Jedi Master, Silandra Sho, left her shield in Peka village, deliberately allowing it to be taken by a salmaca creature that had been raiding the village for several weeks.
Tarlafars were a short, white-furred sentient species of which Wamoth, Ailish, and Bayrn were members. The Tarlafars' head shared some visual similarity to the species of Senator Nico.

Banfoden Prime was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Banfoden Prime system, which was located in the Alchenaut sector of the Expansion Region. It was situated in grid square L-16 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Scarabi were a group of mercenaries who operated during the Imperial Era. A group of Scarabi, led by Hachi, kidnapped Rebel Alliance leader Mon Mothma while on the world Uveron, intending to hand her over to other parties such as the Galactic Empire unless the Rebellion pa…
Vexos was a planet located in the Vexos system in Wild Space that had large creatures, such as strostodons.
The spixx was a species of fish found on the planet Taypho. There was a sport on Taypho called Spixx leaping, which involved riding a wild spixx fish for as long as possible.

Lava worms were a type of giant, black-scaled worm native to the volcanic planet Brazadann located in the Outer Rim Territories. Growing to be hundreds of meters long, they traversed the lava seas of the planet and were ridden by the locals.

The sublevel containment chamber was an underground containment facility in Tantiss Base on the planet Wayland. It was used to hold cloned Zillo Beasts—referred to by Royce Hemlock as "the assets"—created by the Advanced Science Division.
The Nihil engineer Alfkenda resided in quarters aboard the Gaze Electric, the flagship of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro.
Ro's suite was the personal living quarters of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro aboard his flagship, the Gaze Electric.
Caraad was a planet located in the Interior and Colonies regions of the galaxy.

Gant spiders were large poisonous spiders that lived on the world Batuu. Around 379 BBY, Jedi Padawan Rooper Nitani learned that a salmaca that was raiding Peka village was also protecting the village by preying on a nearby colony of gant spiders.
B.O.B.7 was a Protocol droid and Rebel agent who operated on the planet Ominia.
The Slangs were small, nomadic beings that traveled the galaxy as true space scrappers. They had four arms with long, thin fingers, a stocky thorax, and an elongated face.

Ethark was a tropical planet in the Epsilon 69.02 system. The surface consisted of vast steppes of photosynthetic plants, forests, and mineral reliefs. An estimated two-thirds of the surface was covered in forests.
A2-D6 was a pilot droid that served the Galactic Republic's Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era.

Ranx warriors were genetically engineered warriors created by Imperial scientist Aakhel Vaahn Deehn. The creatures possessed predatory jaws, ashen leather skin and sharp claws. They stood at three meters tall.
CK-38 was a protocol droid who worked for the King and Queen of the planet Vuundalla.

A pitdog was a type of dog. In 382 BBY, the Disciples of the Whills chief archivist Feric Oranalli was intimidated by the Evereni Path of the Open Hand cult member Yana Ro into taking her to see Werth Plouth—the Path's Herald—who had been imprisoned in the Temple of the Kyber …
Scratch-hens were a type of hen. In 382 BBY, the leader of the Path of the Open Hand cult, Elecia Zeveron, suffered a seizure while in the Path compound on the Outer Rim planet Dalna.

Ominia was a glacial planet in the Epsilon 69.02 system. The planet's surface was completely covered in ice and had no indigenous life. A mining station owned by Yohn Stelly was present on the planet.
Lahn was the gas giant moon of the planet Ethark. The moon was mostly composed of sulfur, nickel, and plutonium. It had multiple asteroids orbiting it.

t: Attack over an Imperial supply moon
x: A group of Rebels led an attack against an Imperial convoy, consisting of two Imperial-class Star Destroyers, including the Leviathan. The convoy was transporting the Imperial Imperial war minister to an Imperial supply moon.

The Luminous Knives was a rebel group with the goal to eliminate all Imperial forces. It was founded by Arkiin Smir after the Destruction of Alderaan. The group destroyed and damaged multiple Imperial operations, but also caused considerable numbers of civilian casualties.
Karken was a terrestrial object in the Inner Rim inhabited by mynocks.
The Grim Devourer II was a pirate starship in service during the High Republic Era.

In 229 BBY, Mirialan Jedi Knight Vernestra Rwoh took part in a battle near Genetia against the Nihil pirates, during the Jedi Order's offensive against the Nihil after the formation of the Stormwall barrier that prevented hyperspace travel into the Occlusion Zone, a region of …
Torku was a terrestrial object in the Inner Rim Territories where a group of rebels fought the Galactic Empire.

objective: Release the Daan's leader
x: A diplomatic mission to Melida/Daan took place around 395 BBY, when Galactic Republic Senator Lexxir Greylark, his son Axel Greylark, and a Jedi Knight traveled to the location Melida/Daan to release the leader of the Daan, who had been captured by the opposing Melida.

The Great Western Sea was a sea located on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant, situated far from the world's Jedi Temple. In 33 BBY, Jedi Master Yaddle thought about the sea while working on legal duties within the Temple, reflecting on how she felt she was drowning in details.

Chamble was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Chamble system in the Mytaranor sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square Q-10 of the Standard Galactic Grid. A part of the Galactic Republic, it was represented by a senator.

Yinchorri were a reptilian sentient species. They possessed broad, rounded snouts and unlike other reptilian species such as the Trandoshan and Saurin, had smooth scaleless skin. Jodak, a pilot for the Riftwalkers, was a Yinchorri.

The Riftwalkers were a pirate gang that operated in the Slice during the Republic Era. The gang was named for the Riftwalker sabacc game. The Nautolan Zilastra, leader of the Riftwalkers, plotted against the other pirate gangs in the region.
The Vellus was a GR-75 medium transport belonging to the Rebel Alliance and was destroyed by Darth Vader between 2 BBY and 4 ABY.
IK-111, or Eyekay, was a murderous assassin droid who worked for Zilastra, the leader of the Riftwalkers pirate gang.

Valboraan was a desert planet located in the Valboraan system, in the Kastolar sector of the Mid Rim Territories. It was situated along the Ootmian Pabol near the planets Kwenn and Keldooine. The planet was home to many cave systems, which made it attractive as a hideout.
Galactic City Recovery was a company based on Coruscant that repossessed stolen starships and returned them to their owners for a fee.
The Poisoned Blades was a pirate gang active in the Slice during the Republic Era.

The Filthy Credits, commonly known as the Filthy Creds, was a pirate gang that operated throughout the Slice during the Republic Era. Its leader was known as the Chief Executive, while its members wore suits.
The Vile was a pirate gang that operated in the Slice during the Republic Era. The gang was known for being vicious and depraved.
The Staved Skulls was a pirate gang active in the Slice during the Republic Era. Its members decorated their heads by driving metal spikes into their skulls.

Maldroth was a planet in the Maldroth system in the Grumani sector of the Outer Rim Territories with a vast archipelago surrounded by a glittering sea. According to legend a group of colonists settled on Maldroth after a great war that left the people with a lasting guilt.
A vast group of islands surrounded by a glittering sea.
A sea that surrounded a vast archipelago on the planet Maldroth.
The 4077th Medical Army Spatial Hospital, shortened to the 4077th Mash, was a Rebel medcenter commanded by Colonel Burns. Its headquarters was the hospital ship, the Asclepios.
The main port city of the planet Kennerla had a docking hangar by the High Republic Era.

A docking hangar employing a Besalisk harbormaster was located in the main port city of the Outer Rim planet Kennerla by the time of the High Republic Era. In 229 BBY, the pilot Affie Hollow parked her ship, the Vessel, in the hangar.
2-1B33, nicknamed "Piquouse", was a Rebel medical droid that assisted Doctor Benjamin Pierce.
FX-9-33 was a surgeon droid and a colleague of medical droid 2-1B33. FX-9-33 worked aboard the Rebel medical frigate, the Asclepios, and specialized in cardiovascular operations.

Erebus was a planet located in the Erebus system in the Colonies. A mountainous and muddy world, Erebus had valuable resources that would be extracted by Imperial strip mining, which left the terrain even more barren and potholed.
Em'liy were a sentient species. One Em'liy, Mikilanie, lived on Jedha during the High Republic Era.

Hafernia was a planet in the Inner Rim Territories that had joined the Galactic Republic shortly before 33 BBY. As a showing of good faith, they wished to send pallets of boots to the Republic to be worn by the Jedi Order.
Pendalanorians were gigantic, skeletal humanoids native to the jungle planet Pendalanor. They had translucent skin and slightly fluorescent bones.
The Regal Zephyr was a passenger transport operated by Regal Voyager along the Ootmian Pabol hyperspace route during the Republic Era.

The Morleen was a freighter piloted by its owner during the Republic Era. The freighter was captured by the Riftwalkers pirate gang with its owner still aboard and transported to the Riftwalker Compound on the planet Keldooine.
Musti was a domesticated, intensely loyal creature used as a pet in urban areas. They could be trained to serve a variety of roles. Their young were known as "pups."
Termidotes were a type of tiny creature found on the forest moon Endor. They possessed six limbs, a pair of wings, two antennae, two black eyes, and a pair of long teeth.
Valnoos was an astronomical object in the Valnoos system in the Morshdine sector of the Outer Rim Territories. A variant of sabacc known as riftwalker sabacc originated from Valnoos.
The Invasion of Ison was a battle fought between Imperial General Sorin and a Rebel squad on the planet Ison.
Otto's Grotto was a location on Quarney Key on the planet Kwenn that served fleek eels.
The Paths of Harmony was a park designed to promote thought and healing that was located on Rayley Key on the planet Kwenn.
The Education Ministry was a government location on Capital Key, Kwenn, that contained the office of the deputy minister for academic loan reconsolidation.
The Bivall Colony was a colony on the island Parva Key, Kwenn, founded by the Bivall victims of a solar storm on Protobranch, but has since come to serve other refugees.
Noosa fish were a type of fish that could be found on the world Miekos. During the day, they absorbed sunlight, which they reflected back for the first few hours of night.
Thana were a type of fish that could be found on the world Miekos. Noparo Yar and his wife, Fee-Na, were farmers who raised thana on their homestead.
A ship was owned by the Vukorah during her time as a bounty hunter.
SK-89 (Esskay-Aytnine), known as Esskay, was a droid that operated for Kwikhaul Livery Corporation on the planet Kwenn.
A large space battle took place in the exosphere of the place Denon during the Galactic War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

The Randomizer was a Pelta-class frigate that served as the flagship of Zilastra, leader of the pirate gang known as the Riftwalkers. Zilastra had previously stolen the frigate from the Trade Federation.

Marsh ponies were a type of pony that had a vegetarian diet. In 228 BBY, while unloading supplies on the Republic Defense Coalition mobile launch and repair station, the pilot Jordanna Sparkburn thought about how her girlfriend Sylvestri Yarrow wanted to one day buy land on a …

An antique ARC-8 starfighter was owned by Fraxa, owner of Kwikhaul Livery Corporation on the planet Kwenn. The ARC-8 starfighter was originally from the High Republic Era, during which it had seen extensive use.

Dee-Twelve was a droid owned by the family of Jerlyn, a resident of Peka village on the world Batuu. Around 379 BBY, while working on the family's farm at night, Dee-Twelve was taken by a salmaca that was raiding Peka and brought to its nest.
A city on the ocean world of Mon Cala that was five kilometers from the Great Ungeness Trench.

A Kraalfin was a creature that lived in the oceans of the planet Mon Cala. The child Carus once lied to his parents about encountering one outside of its territory to which his father set out looking for it.
A Mandelfish was a fish that lived in the oceans of the planet Mon Cala and swam in schools. They were thought to populate the planet when the Mon Calamari were only a fledgling species.
The Regal Hopper was a cargo ship operated by Regal Star Freight. On one occasion, the starship transported grains from Yitabo to Keldooine.

Assurance was a CR56 corvette commanded by Captain Pell Baylo during the Republic Era. Under Baylo's command, the corvette had operated in a variety of roles, including in nine planetary defense forces and as commercial security for eight corporations.
Rockworms were, according to legend, creatures that lived on the moon Endor. with the cave-dwelling Ewoks during the time of darkness before the Golden One came and brought light to the moon.

Boolahs were a type of rodent native to the planet Kwenn. They possessed white fur and had a long, slinky body. Pogee Shrag owned a number of boolahs that had been abandoned by residents of Kwenn who had left the planet.
A mission was undertook by the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire during the Cold War to defeat the followers of Vodal Kressh on the planet Athiss.

A ship owned by the Thradian Jonram Dremel was used between the years 14 BBY and 9 BBY. The Mohsenian Kricad would later steal the ship following the death of Dremel onboard the DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station.
Perro Quay was a location on Langdam Key on the planet Kwenn. It contained the Langdam Harbor Market.

The Langdam Harbor Market was a market located at Perro Quay on the planet Kwenn's Langdam Key. The Jedi Master Ki-Adi-Mundi visited the market while on Kwenn, witnessing a relationship disagreement between the Yarkora Aptorr and Varralis.
Hydrosnakes were a type of snake. During or after 18 BBY, the clone Echo called former Imperial Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart a hydrosnake when questioning if he could be trusted.

Black Rock Passage was an area of space located in the Akkadese Maelstrom, a region of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice consisting of ionized gas, dust clouds, water vapor, ammonia, and planet-sized carbonbergs as well as gravity wells.
The Lost Island was an island located on the planet Ord Mantell. During the Galactic War, it was the site of Doctor Sannus Lorrick's secret laboratory.

Level 3921 was a sub-surface city level of Galactic City, the ecumenopolis covering the planet Coruscant.

Temerancé was a forested planet located in the Rekai system. After the Nihil marauders established the Occlusion Zone, Temerancé fell behind its Stormwall barrier.

Abtin was a planet in the Abtin system in the Danjar sector of the Outer Rim Territories. When the Nihil marauders expanded the Stormwall barrier that surrounded their Occlusion Zone territory, Abtin was one of the worlds that fell into the Nihil's new borders.

Alpha-44 was an Imperial Rho-class transport shuttle. During or after 18 BBY, it was stolen by Echo, a member of the Clone Underground and the rogue clone commando unit known as the Bad Batch.

The Rendellians were a species native to the planet Rendel. Rendellians possessed fur that ranged in color from purple, green and orange, as well as wings that matched the color of their hair. Zalla and Bellan were members of this species.
The TIE fighter bay was a hangar located in the Galactic Empire's second Death Star.

A freighter was owned by the smuggler Azita Cruuz. When Cruuz obtained the formula for coaxium ultra on the moon Ro Mira, she and the Jedi Mace Windu traveled to her freighter, which was parked at the Radial Spaceport.

Kay Vess' crew was a crew led by the criminal Kay Vess to carry out a heist. Their ship was a prototype EML 850 light freighter called the Trailblazer designed in the Republic Era and last of its kind from the Clone Wars.

Pilot's End was a navigational hazard in the Akkadese Maelstrom, a region of the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice that consisted of ionized gas, dust clouds, water vapor, ammonia, carbonbergs, and gravity wells.
The Thunderhead was a location within the Corkscrew, a part of the turbulent Outer Rim Territories region known as the Akkadese Maelstrom.

The Mudfields of Bororn were a set of muddy fields on an astronomical object. In 228 BBY, by which point the mudfields' astronomical object had been annexed as part of the Nihil's Occlusion Zone, monster hunters Ty Yorrick and Drewen Qweebjillan were hired to defeat a Trilark …

Leebon's shuttle was a shuttle owned by Jedi Master Leebon of the Jedi Order when she was stationed on the Mid Rim moon Jedha during the High Republic Era. After Leebon's death during the Battle of Jedha in 382 BBY, the shuttle's ownership transferred to Jedi Master Vildar Mac.

A cruiser was owned by the Hoopaloo Strat during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, Jedi Padawan Matthea Cathley and Jedi Knight Oliviah Zeveron traveled aboard the cruiser from the Mid Rim moon Jedha to the Outer Rim planet Dalna to investigate the Path of the Open Hand cult.

A ship was owned by the Tarsunt Okut Dand during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, the Path of the Open Hand cult members Werth Plouth and Yana Ro briefly served aboard the ship as they traveled from Port Mackie to the Outer Rim planet Dalna.
The great hall was a massive hall located in the space station Starlight Beacon.
An art gallery was located in the space station Starlight Beacon. It held many arts donated by the planets of the Galactic Republic.
A storage room was located in the space station Starlight Beacon. In 232 BBY, the dedication plaque was stored in the storage room prior to the dedication of the Starlight Beacon.

Lake Haruuni was a lake located high in the mountains of the planet Haruun Kal. Due to its altitude, the fish that dwelt in the lake practically floated out of its dark waters when the Haruun Kal native Azita Cruuz fished for them alone from Lake Haruuni's rocky shores during …

Pelek Baw was the capital city of the planet Haruun Kal. Azita Cruuz, a human native of the world, grew up alone in the city as an orphan and encountered many other children there who still had parents.

Gate Control was an organization of the Galactic Empire responsible for controlling access through the Shield Gate, the single entry port of the otherwise impenetrable deflector shield around the planet Scarif.
A Rodian colony was based on Prandril during the High Republic Era.
A village housing a Rodian colony was on Prandril during the High Republic Era.

A Cloudship was utilized by the Nihil Cloud Sarn Starbreaker during the High Republic Era. During the First Battle of Cyclor, the ship was destroyed by Jedi Padawan Bell Zettifar.

Engineering was a location within the Galactic Empire's Star Destroyer Implacable. It was worked by a team of engineers including Lieutenant Naylyn Bashan and led by the vessel's chief engineer, Lieutenant Commander Del Meeko.
A T-series tactical droid served under the Chevin Major Hoom Garaf of the Confederacy of Independent Systems at the Third Battle of Aefao during the Clone Wars.
A passenger transport was in operation by the time of the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, the vessel set out for the Outer Rim location Travnin with several individuals on board.

A blum-maggot was a type of maggot. Between 5 ABY and 28 ABY, the Dulok King Gorneesh referred to the Ewok Wicket Wystri Warrick as a "snivelling blum-maggott" when Warrick ran to attack a group of Duloks at their camp on the Outer Rim Forest Moon of Endor.

The Halisite were a sentient species that originated on a planet on the frontier and were considered rare by the time of the High Republic Era. They possessed a bone fin that crested their head and pulsed red and blue as it flushed with blood in time with their heartbeat.
A planet was the origin of the Halisite sentient species. The planet was situated farther out on the frontier of the Outer Rim than the planet Hetzal Prime.
The Happy Grove was a forest on the moon Endor where Bright Tree Village was located.
Hangar Twenty-Two was a hangar on the Cyclor Shipyards which housed the research vessel Innovator.

A world in Hutt Space that had never seen peace or justice was the homeworld of the human girl Kylah Lohmata.

At Attin was a forested planet in the Outer Rim Territories with an orderly population that was isolated from the wider galaxy as part of the Great Work of the Old Republic.

A claim was located on the Outer Rim planet Elphrona in the High Republic Era, situated north of the world's Jedi-operated Elphrona Outpost.

Penumbra was a floating city that orbited a gas giant in the Tollello system. By around 377 BBY, Jedi Knight Rooper Nitani and Jedi Master Silandra Sho infiltrated an illegal weapons deal in Penumbra with the aim of arresting the criminal Ullan Yite.

Hallitron-7 was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the Hallitron system in the Jalor sector of the Mid Rim. During the Republic Era, Renzoh Silliac of the Blood Oath Syndicate operated a salvage yard on Hallitron-7.

Bright Circle was a criminal organization that was lead by Ullan Yite. Around 377 BBY, it put together a deal with a pirate group to sell smuggled weapons. The deal was broken up and Yite was captured by Silandra Sho, Rooper Nitani, and P3-7A.
The Idiot Three were an inept trio of amateur pirates that operated in the Slice during the Republic Era.
The Mission to Sorin's Star Destroyer was an attempt by a squad of Rebels to prevent General Octavion Sorin's Star Destroyer from traveling to the planet Ison.

A salvage yard located on Hallitron-7. It was run by the Chevin known as Renzoh Silliac, who was murdered there by Huijari after a conflict between Jango Fett and various other bounty hunters unfolded on the site.

A salmaca was a type of large lizard-like creature that lived in caves on the world Batuu. They raided homes for valuables to line their nests, and some believed that they only existed in legends. Around 379 BBY, a salmaca began raiding homes in Peka, a village on Batuu.
A sentient species existed in the galaxy. The Force-sensitive being Maz Kanata and an assassin were both members of the species.

An RA-7 protocol droid served the Blood Oath Syndicate member Renzoh Silliac on the planet Hallitron-7. After a brief skirmish, the protocol droid was interrogated by the Palliduvan bounty hunter Aurra Sing and coerced into unlocking Silliac's computer.

An office belonging to an information broker was located on Level 1313 on the planet Coruscant. The bounty hunter Jango Fett encountered a group of Anselmi threatening the broker and dispatched them with a micro-rocket, causing significant damage to the office.
During the Republic Era, a mission to the planet Hallitron-7 occurred.

The Regional Republic Headquarters was a location on the planet Jaloria. After trying to negotiate a peace treaty between the Anselmi and Nautolan species, a heist occurred in the headquarters, which resulted in the theft of the artifact.

The secret gambling den was a location active on the planet Oosalon during the Republic Era. While attempting to capture the bounty on the Koorivar Fissark Tozan, the bounty hunter Jango Fett destroyed the gambling den.
2341 was a B1-series battle droid who once was deployed to a desert environment with a fellow B1 unit.

A grounger was a porcine creature found on Endor. Chirpa jumped onto a grounger's back and wrestled it onto the ground before binding its feet with a lasso, in order to demonstrate to the younger Ewoks how to capture a grounger.
A bipedal species had gray fur and brown horns, skin, and eyes.

Transport One was the designation of a Longbeam cruiser of the Galactic Republic's Republic Defense Coalition that assisted in the Republic and Jedi Order's raid on the Korvix Vorn, a prison ship of the Nihil marauders, intended to serve as a transport to rescue the prisoners.

A planet was the location of a village that the Sith Okinaa lived in. Okinaa lived on the planet for at least ten years, and was one of the last remaining members of the village along with their droid, R5-D56.
A village on a planet was the home of the Sith Okinaa. Eventually, Okinaa and their droid companion, R5-D56, were the last two remaining members of the village.
The Senate Budgetary Committee was a committee made up of senators from the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate, which was based in the Senate Building on the planet Coruscant.
The capital city of the Colonies planet Hynestia Prime contained the Hynestian royal palace.

A world was located in the Almar system of the Sluis sector, within the Outer Rim Territories. This world was often called a tropical paradise, being covered with orange-grass hills and shallow seas. It was the homeworld of the marmaws, a species of amphibious carnivores.

836-VS was a Sentinel-class landing craft that was stolen by the Alliance to Restore the Republic and used for a mission to the moon Killun 71.

Dinutu was a planet located in the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Dinutun species.

A vantage point was located on the world Batuu and offered a view of the surrounding countryside and the village Peka. Three stones on the vantage point marked it as a site of worship for an ancient religion, and it was a favorite location of Jedi Master Silandra Sho.

Omega's ship was a starship used by the clone Omega during the Imperial Era. She kept it docked in a cave next to Pabu cove. Omega eventually left Pabu in the ship to join the Alliance to Restore the Republic, accompanied by the GNK-series power droid Gonky.

SW-0222 was an Eta-class supply barge of the Galactic Empire. The supply ship was utilized by Administrator Sly Moore's Schism Imperial, a covert faction intending to overthrow the Emperor, as part of its plan to assault Exegol and the Sith Eternal.

An airless moon housed a lunar base where the service droid Olly operated a refueling bay. During or after 18 BBY, the pirate Phee Genoa visited the moon in her starship, Providence, to get the vessel refueled.
A criminal gang of aliens led by Kruno operated on the planet Ammon IV during the Imperial Era.
Gee-Bee was a droid who worked in the gardens on the planet Isobe alongside Levier during the Imperial Era.
The Megarian bog-worm was a type of worm that existed in the galaxy. The Chiss Fraulda Rynn owned a pet Megarian bog-worm named Skoogia.
Bay 5 was a hangar within the Galactic Empire's Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Sovereign. It housed multiple TIE fighters, as well as the Grand Inquisitor's TIE Advanced.

Shryke's crew was a crew in the Nihil marauders led by the Storm Melis Shryke within General Abediah Viess's Ministry of Protection. Aboard the Cacophony, Shryke and her crew performed a number of raids outside the Nihil's Occlusion Zone territory.
Sector four was an area of jungle on the planet Wayland. It was located past the perimeter of Tantiss Base, an Imperial facility built in Mount Tantiss on Wayland.
The Foregone Catastrophe was a starship owned by General Abediah Viess, Minister of Protection in the Nihil marauder organization.

Rigellians were a type of sentient species. Kang and Kodos were members of the species.

The diplomatic wing of the Royal Naboo Security Forces was a security group responsible for the protection of Naboo diplomats. Mariek Panaka served as a high-ranking officer in the diplomatic wing before becoming Captain of the Guard.
Wampas were a species of cave-dwelling, winged mammals similar to gigantic bats. They were native to the basalt planet Brazadann, and were ridden by the local Brazanites.
Droofs were a species of calm and peaceful mammals native to the planet Taypho. Taï, the native sentient species, rode droofs.
42X-58939 was a BX-series droid commando that served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
42X-11811 was a Separatist B2-HA super battle droid created by Baktoid Combat Automata that was reprogrammed by the Gen'Dai Rayvis to serve the Bedlam Raiders in 9 BBY.
SC-97 was a BB-series astromech droid with a black sensor and dark red and white paneling. As a member of the BB-series, it was manufactured by Industrial Automaton and stood 0.67 meters tall.

AR-L5 was a BB-series astromech droid with a blue sensor and blue and white paneling, covered in rust. As a member of the BB-series, it was manufactured by Industrial Automaton and stood 0.67 meters tall.
R3-RN8W was a black and rainbow-colored astromech droid of the R3-series with a transparent dome. This astromech called the Coruscant Underground its home and roamed the lower levels of Coruscant.

The Zedrahls were a species of sentient, reptilian Humanoids. Their skin was covered in scales. The species was in a major nuclear conflict amongst themselves caused by Arglos, a fanatical, religious leader who sought to eliminate all life on their planet.
NRX, or "Enarex," was an enigmatic assassin droid and one of the leaders of the Princes of Hell. NRX wore purple robes to hide it's true nature from strangers.

The Great Worms Cemetery was a valley on the planet Brazadann where lava worms went to pass away. The cemetery was considered one of the most mystical places on the planet, and was sacred to the local Brazanites and Salamander Warriors.
T42, also known as "Tea For Two", was an administrator droid who worked in the warehouse of the Rebel prison, Ergün prison.
Kessan's Landing was a small island located on the planet Ord Mantell. During the Third Galactic War, the island was the site of a resurgence of the Mantellian Separatist Movement.

Ophidions were a formidable species of translucent moray eel native to the planet Taypho. They were one of the many dangerous aquatic creatures that resided in the planet's oceans, living among the coral masses.

G-2, also called Xiri's starfighter or just Xiri's fighter, was a Forward ReCon fighter starfighter that Princess Xiri A'lbaran and her husband Phan-tu Zenn discovered in a hangar north of the Path compound on the planet Dalna during the Night of Sorrow in 382 BBY.

The elites of Geonosian society made up a caste within their species hierarchy, much like the drone and warrior castes. Like the various other castes of their species, elite Geonosians could be found in the catacombs of their homeworld, the planet Geonosis.

Isolt was a pastoral planet that fell within the Nihil marauders' Occlusion Zone territory during the High Republic Era. The Nihil, attempting to trigger a volcanic eruption similar to the event that devastated the planet Dalna, bombed Isolt repeatedly.

Vixoseph I, or simply Vixoseph, was a planet that was located within Galactic Republic space during the High Republic Era. The planet's main colony was attacked by the Drengir carnivorous plant species, after which Vixoseph I remained largely uninhabited.

Flyhorn lizards, also simply known as flyhorns, were a type of lizard found on the planet Tatooine, where they lived solitary lives out in the world's deserts.

Ribento was a planet that existed in the galaxy. The planet was located in the Ribento system and had two inhabitable moons, Morlas and Tho. During the High Republic Era, the planet was bombarded by the Nihil.

Morlas was one of two inhabitable moons—the other being Tho—that orbited the planet Ribento in the Ribento system within the Quence sector. It was located in grid square O-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid, in the Outer Rim Territories and Trailing Sectors.

Tho was one of two inhabitable moons—the other being Morlas—orbiting the planet Ribento in the Ribento system within the Quence sector. It was located in grid square O-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid, in the Outer Rim Territories and the Trailing Sectors.

The grand feasting hall was a place located in the Nihil main base on the planet Hetzal Prime. During the High Republic Era, the Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro feasted in the grand hall while flanked by two Nameless.

A repertory theater company existed on the planet Kwenn. During the Grand Renewal in 233 BBY, Jedi Master Yarael Poof helped fund and support the company and its repertory theater, and had become fond of and well-acquainted with them.

Phelarion was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Phelarion system of the Seswenna sector within the Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches. It was located in grid square M-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Deliberator was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer used by the Imperial Navy. The Star Destroyer contained databanks, which included a file titled "Pyke Syndicate" from the "Kessel" section of the Imperial Archives.

J0-8O was an archival droid who worked at the Galactic Museum and Archives on the planet Chandrila. The droid's role related to storing some of the rarest testimonies and records relating to atrocities and genocides committed by the Galactic Empire and making them available.

Bosph was a planet in the Bosph sector of the Outer Rim Territories. In 3 BBY, the Galactic Empire bombarded the world to try and wipe out a sentient species that dwelt there. Surviving members of the species chose to dis-remember the Empire.
FR3-D0M was a battle droid that was part of Mantellian Separatist Movement stationed on Kessan's Landing, a small and forgotten island on Ord Mantell during the third Galactic War.
The Retention was an Interdictor cruiser in service to the remnant of the Imperial Navy's Seventh Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

The New Republic Survey Corps was a part of the New Republic. At some point following the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY, members of the survey corps captured an image of the crashed Imperial-class Star Destroyer Inflictor in the Starship Graveyard on the desert planet Jakku.
The Hunters Elite Club was a VIP group with associated with the Hunters of the Outer Rim, based out of the Grand Arena on the planet Vespaara.

RDC base was a base on the planet Hintis IV used by the Republic Defense Coalition.

The Stranger's cave, also called the Stranger's lair, was a cave located within an island on the planet Bal'demnic. Throughout its walls, the cave had veins of cortosis metal.

The governing council was a body in the New Republic including senators such as Leia Organa. Agent Joris Vegen presented a briefing to them on what she had discovered on the prison planet Wobani after it was abandoned by the Galactic Empire.

The massacre at the Greens was a massacre of Nihil pirate forces that took place at The Greens on the Core Worlds planet Corellia. The event all but wiped out the Nihil presence on the planet, with them being left with only two ships.
The Eternity Enterprises barge was a pleasure barge operated by the tourism company Eternity Enterprises.

A starport was located on the planet Vespaara. A digital map of the location could be found within the Vespaara Tours Loading Zone building at Vespaara Row, a civilian plaza and part-time make-shift battle arena utilized by the Hunters of the Outer Rim.

The Outworld Resort was a tourist destination within the galaxy. Posters advertising the Outworld Resort could be found within the Dune Sea Outpost battlefield of the Grand Arena, utilized by the Hunters of the Outer Rim on the planet Vespaara.
A Garbage Shoot could be found on along the edge of the Death Star Crossfire battlefield of the Grand Arena, utilized by the Hunters of the Outer Rim on the planet Vespaara.

Blue scorpions were a type of scorpion native to Eiram. They were mostly kept out of Erasmus Capital City by the protection dome, although smaller ones could sometimes slip through. These scorpions became poisonous once they reached maturity.

Pendalanor was a jungle planet in the galaxy. It took three days of hyperspace to travel from the planet Hoth to Pendalanor. The planet was the home of the Pendalanorians, which were a species of tall, skeletal humanoids. The Ho'Din Ho-Jon lived on Pendalanor.
Mount Felo was a volcano located on the island of Kessan's Landing, on the planet Ord Mantell.
Balada's Row was a location on Vespaara, listed as one of the destinations offered by the Vespaara Tours transportation service in association with the Hunters of the Outer Rim.

Chakonnis was a major city on the volcanic planet Burnin Konn. It was destroyed by a series of volcano eruptions in 4 ABY when forces of the Galactic Empire led by General Valin Hess detonated the geothermal reactors within the city and other cities on the world.
Dashaad was a planet active during the time of the Galactic Republic.
Q-10 was a droid who lived during the reign of the Galactic Republic in the Old Republic era.
The Moulee-rah Casino was a location on Vespaara, listed as one of the destinations offered by the Vespaara Tours transportation service in association with the Hunters of the Outer Rim.
The Ootmians was a location on Vespaara, listed as one of the destinations offered by the Vespaara Tours transportation service in association with the Hunters of the Outer Rim.

Launchbay 12 was the name of a location associated with the Hunters of the Outer Rim on Vespaara. It is referenced numerous times via graffiti displayed around the Hunters training grounds within the Grand Arena.
The Asclepios was a medical frigate utilized by the Rebel Alliance. It was the headquarters of the 4077th Medical Army Spatial Hospital
A farm was owned by the family of Jerlyn, a resident of Peka village on the Outer Rim world Batuu. Jerlyn and the family's droid, Dee-Twelve, both worked on the farm.

The Coruscant Emeralds were a grav-ball team that played on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant during the Imperial Era. Edi Myrtaan, a keeper for the team, had a significant fan following and appeared in a number of recruitment materials for the Galactic Empire.

Fanbugs were a type of flying bug that could be found on the moon of the Outer Rim planet Arli. When the San Tekka clan member Jordanna Sparkburn lived on the moon years before 228 BBY, she and her brother Harth Sparkburn attended a school in the city Birage.

The Crimson Reach was a hauler used by Qi'ra and her crew to retrieve an item for Dryden Vos. The ship was piloted by Drex and Noyio during the mission. It had a gun turret in the aft section for defense.

Qira's crew was a group of Crimson Dawn personnel that worked together while stationed on Thorum. The crew was originally led by Cerveteri Slane but Qi'ra assumed leadership as her position in Crimson Dawn rose.
Ashlasi was one of the twin moons that orbited the planet Brendok, alongside Bogaro. The ringed moon had a pale gray appearance, with darker areas and circular regions.

An escape craft was attached to Polan GX-8, a Polan-717 Jedi transport used by the Jedi Order. The escape craft was not equipped with a hyperdrive. Above the planet Brendok, Mae-ho Aniseya stole the escape craft and used it to flee from Jedi Master Sol aboard the Polan.
Bunk 23 was a bunk bed on the sub-level of the Trade Federation's WD-2550 Whydah-class yield conveyer Fallon. In 132 BBY, it was used by the meknek Verosha Aniseya.

The Thranta was a starship of the Survivor Fleet, a fleet of Alderaanians who survived the destruction of the planet Alderaan by the Death Star and got rescued by rebels Princess Leia Organa and Lieutenant Evaan Verlaine.
Blackbolt was a droid pirate captain who operated on the starship Terror of Tenoo during the High Republic Era, plundering the planet Tenoo, including Kaliah Kublop's staff.
The Great Forge was an underground magma lake with small basalt islets.

Hrumphs were a type of non-sentient quadrupedal herbivore found in the swamps of the planet Naboo. The had purple spots smattered across their lightly tanned body and four long horns that they used together with their highly sensitive ears to avoid predators.

A city became part of the Nihil pirates' Occlusion Zone region of space at some point after its formation in 230 BBY, stranding the city behind the Nihil's Stormwall hyperspace barrier. A resistance cell working against the Nihil used the city to operate from.

Bantha ticks were parasites that feasted off of the large hairy mammal, the bantha.

Crocodinas were a type of crocodile-like creature with scaley heads that included a pair of eyes and a long, thin snout with a toothy maw.

The B1-SAL Probe Droid was a model of floating cube-shaped probe droid available during the Third Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire.

The J4-SN Chef Droid was a model of floating droid used as a cooking droid by Hutt Cartel members Gaboorga the Abundant and Duuba the Magnanimous during the Feast of Prosperity on Nar Shaddaa in 3626 BBY.

The patented Head Chef Droid was a J4-SN Chef Droid owned by Hutt Cartel members Gaboorga the Abundant and Duuba the Magnanimous, serving as Head Chef of The Sarlacc Pit cantina and Bog's Bounty Banquet Hall during the Feast of Prosperity on Nar Shaddaa in 3626 BBY.

The C1-4W, also known as the C1-4W claw machine gonk droid, was a model of bipedal power droid available during the Third Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. A functional miniature version of this droid known as a "Replica C1-4W" also existed.

A settlement was located on the planet Banchii in the Outer Rim's Inugg system. A Jedi outpost was located near the settlement. In the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster in 232 BBY, refugees were relocated to the settlement.
Besh Gorgon was an astronomical object located in the Besh Gorgon system in the Maldrood sector of the Mid Rim along the Perlemian Trade Route. It was orbited by the space station known as The Wheel.

Valaracs were nomadic birds found on the planet Kijimi. They possessed exceptional vision that allowed them to hunt prey at great distances, while their wing serrations allowed them to fly quietly, making them virtually silent before striking their prey.

R2-Q9 was an astromech droid who served onboard the Death Star II battle station in 4 ABY. The droid regularly made trouble for the stormtrooper TK-423, locking them out of their quarters, running over their feet, and even threatening them with an arc welder.

Sandvipers were serpentine species found in the galaxy. The Hunters of the Outer Rim participant and former bounty hunter Imara Vex named one of her weapon wraps after this creature.
K-A0S was an Imperial KX-series security droid who competed as a Hunter in Hunters of the Outer Rim on the planet Vespaara in 9 ABY.
A clan of Elia-An lived on the planet Oanne by 228 BBY.

Ah Re Won was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Republic Era, between around 40 BBY and 32 BBY, the Sith Lord Darth Sidious sent his Sith apprentice Darth Maul to meditate in stillness and quiet in the Sith temple on Ah Re Won.

A coven of the Presagers of Hakotei was led by a priestess, an insectoid alien dark sider. By around 82 BBY, the Presagers were believed to be extinct, though the coven, in hiding on the planet Asusto, was the last one to survive.

Safe House One was a cave used as a safe house by the Scarabi mercenary group. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the Alliance to Restore the Republic investigated the safe house, trying to locate rebel leader Mon Mothma, who had been kidnapped and held for ransom by the Scarabi.
The Imperial headquarters on the planet Ivera X was looted by the resident Iverians after the Galactic Empire's rule there ended.

A private spacedock was located on the Core Worlds planet Hosnian Prime. It was located near the manor of the Starros Clan, which was on the outskirts of the location Curlnow.
N-4M was an analyst droid who worked for the Rebel Alliance.

The Pit Hangar, also knows as the Podracer Hangars, was a hangar located in the Mos Espa Grand Arena. It was situated next to the Pinnacle, not far from the race track. The distinctive engine bay struts are typical of the famous podrace hangars on Malastare.

The Royal Box was the most opulent viewing box of the Mos Espa Grand Arena. It was reserved for the ruling Hutts, especially for Jabba the Hutt, the grandmaster host of the Boonta Eve Classic. On the backside of the box, darkened windows concealed secret deal-making rooms.

The Viewing Towers of the Mos Espa Grand Arena were towers used to watch podracing events, like the Boonta Eve Classic. Family and friends of some privileged racers watched the race from these towers.

The Commentary box of the Mos Espa Grand Arena was a small area of the grandstands that was used by commentators to comment on podracing events, like the Boonta Eve Classic. The Commentary box featured a data array.

The grandstands also referred to as the grandstand and stands were the main complex of the Mos Espa Grand Arena. They were cradled within a natural canyon amphitheater and consisted of many overcrowded seats. The grandstand could hold more than 100,000 spectators.

Gerrigon was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Gerrigon system in the Masla sector of the Mid Rim Territories that was once a hub of culture and commerce. During the Republic Era, a civil war broke out on Gerrigon.
R5 was an astromech droid and a member of the Rebel Alliance. R5 was the partner of Karie Neth during the battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
Arfive was a droid and a member of the Rebel Alliance who served on the flagship Home One during the battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
Seezee was a CZ-series secretary/business communications droid and the secretary droid of chronical Dora Mar in 4 ABY.
Fennesa was an astronomical object in the Inner Rim.
Endoviara Seven was an astronomical object in the Endoviara system in the Dantus sector of the Outer Rim Territories, near the border of the Rim and Wild Space.

A droid assisted the former handmaiden Sabé during the Imperial Era. The droid accompanied Sabé to collect the thief Warba Calip from Sergia and then to Caranthanax B, where the former handmaiden intended to test whether the Jedi Luke Skywalker had a dark side.

Servo or SR-V0 was a Gonk droid who accompanied the nerf herder Sig Greebling. Servo was upgraded by Sig as a challenge from Jedi Master Bobarian Afol to test Sig's Force Builder abilities. He was given the ability to speak not only Gonkian but also Basic due to this upgrade.

Odux were domesticated quadrupedal horned beasts of burden that were ridden by sentient beings around 3623 BBY. There were a number of Odux variants, including "Mudland," "Firebrand," "Resplendent," and "Snowblind" Odux.
An asteroid was situated within an asteroid field in the Nihil marauders' Occlusion Zone territory. It held a Nihil base that Baron Boolan utilized as a base for his experiments.
Astenban was a moon in the Outer Rim Seswenna sector that was near the planet Eriadu, as well as near the main hyperspace route of the Outer Rim Inugg system planet Banchii.

The karafankata was a creature of the Outer Rim planet Ah Re Won. Carnivorous creatures, karafankata fiercely protected their young. Between around 40 BBY and 32 BBY, a karafankata lived on Ah Re Won with several babies.

Attacks were made on the planet Ivera X during the Imperial Era after Galactic Empire propaganda and recruitment posters on the planet Ivera X saw repeated vandalism, which led to Imperial officials ordering the destruction of its cities.

The Arena Citadel was part of the Mos Espa Grand Arena on Tatooine. It hosted betting floors with giant screens which were used to follow races. These live channels were Hutt-owned and the gambling was controlled by Jabba the Hutt.

The Rathtar's Revenge was a massive starship used as the flagship of the pirate group Ganguls. The starship took part during the Battle of Tenoo where it attempted to destroy the Tenoo Jedi Temple with cables.

Mynos III, or Mynos Three, was an agricultural planet in the Dalchon sector of the Outer Rim Territories, under the protectorate of the Pacithhip of Shimia. The planet was red in color, possessing two planetary rings that crossed at the equatorial lines.

The Lucky Tortle, formerly known as the Sarlacc's Scorn, was a refitted Viperi-class cargo shuttle utilized by Dahara the Hutt. The shuttle was equipped with a Class One hyperdrive, shield technology, and four laser cannons, including one that rotated.
T8-3R was a BB-series astromech droid that resided on The Island of a planet after being stranded there. The droid was one of the many inhabitants known as Castaways who called the island home.

The Brendok four was a team consisting of four Jedi: Masters Kelnacca, Sol, Indara, and her Padawan Torbin. They were stationed on Brendok in 148 BBY, about a century after the Emergences which had seemingly left the planet lifeless.
Variax was a rocky planet in the Variax system in the Aldino sector of the Mid Rim Territories that hosted a shipyard during the High Republic Era.

Variax security was an organization that controlled a shipyard on the planet Variax. When the Ganguls attempted to steal starships from the shipyard, a number of starfighters converged on their flagship, with an officer commanding the vessel to leave.

The zaba wolf was a type of legendary wolf on the world Andraven. The Andraven inhabitants once befriended the zaba wolves with kao reed flutes, also using them as mounts. By 232 BBY, however, none of the wolves had been spotted for a number of years.

The blue aklyrr, commonly known as the aklyrr, was a rare creature found in the forests of the planet Tenoo. They were quadripedal creatures, featuring antlers and four eyes. Aklyrrs made dens on the ground, but were adept at climbing and were fast.

An H-type Nubian yacht was utilized by the former handmaiden Sabé during the Imperial Era. Accompanied by a droid, she took the H-type Nubian yacht to Sergia to collect the grifter Warba Calip before traveling to Caranthanax B in order to meet the Jedi Luke Skywalker and test …
Bay Eighteen was a hangar bay located on the modified MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser, the Home One, the flagship of the fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The Bestoonian were a sentient species. One Bestoonian was the Sith assassin Ochi, who hailed from the planet Bestoon.

During the Imperial Era, an uninhabited planet existed within the Outer Rim Territories. While the Rebel Alliance was stationed on the planet to repair an Imperial fortress for their own purposes, the Sith Lord Darth Vader managed to thwart their efforts and use the fortress o…

The Skilla were a sentient species. Their vital organs, including photosensitive orbs for sight, vibrating cilia for hearing, and smell receptors, lined an uvula-like bulb suspended from the roof of their mouth, behind rows of sharp teeth.

The Frejukes were a sentient species that possessed heat-retaining blubber. Wolentic Dudge, a resident of Kijimi City on the planet Kijimi, was a Frejuke whose blubber made him a good fit for the world's snowy climate.

Myykians were a species of elephantine humanoids that lived in the galaxy. The species possessed blue skin and was elephantine in appearance, including a long trunk-like nose and two eyes. They could also possess a head of hair.

A giant non-sentient serpent lived on a terrestrial planet. When lifting its upper body vertically, it could reach the height of a 1.7-meters-tall 3PO-series protocol droid. The snake was covered in red scales, and it had a row of crests running along the top of its body.

This four-armed creature was encountered by C-3PO and R2-D2 when the droids were stranded on a planet due to their space vessel needing a new supply of space crystals. The creature was covered in red fur, and had a round pink nose, yellow eyes and pointed ears.

The yard was a location found on the Nihil prison ship Korvix Vorn. During the High Republic Era, numerous prisoners were ordered by the Nihil pirates to appear in the yard for "The Warden," an alien who commanded to ship.

Level 3 was a location that was located on the Nihil prison ship Korvix Vorn. After a raid occurred on the ship, a Nihil pirate mentioned to The Warden that the shields to the Korvix Vorn had been breached.

During the High Republic Era, the Nihil alien, The Warden, had quarters located on the Nihil prison ship Korvix Vorn. After yelling at the human Driggit Parse to head towards the Stormwall, the Warden mentioned how he would be in his quarters.

A service droid served the Jedi Order while stationed at the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant. During the High Republic Era, the service droid attempted to assist the human Avon Sunvale after the terminal she was at was malfunctioning due to her own actions.
A bedroom for the human Avon Starros was located at the Nihil main base on the planet Hetzal Prime in the Occlusion Zone during the High Republic Era.

The Hall of the Eye was a location that was found in the Nihil main base on the planet Hetzal Prime in the Occlusion Zone during the High Republic Era. The room consisted of a dais in the center of the space with seating that accumulated in a half circle.

A sentient species had horns, toothed mandibles, and glossy dark eyes. In 0 BBY, six members of the species who were part of the Norclu Order were seeking to undergo a pilgrimage from the planet Tatooine to the world of Norclune.

A Raider-class corvette was utilized by a group of raiders during the Imperial Era. After the former Galactic Empire commander Ellian Zahra joined the raiders, she commanded the Raider-class corvette, with an IG-100 MagnaGuard operating aboard it.

A fire gnat was a type of gnat. In 33 BBY, when Jedi Master Depa Billaba threatened the pirate Zilastra after having been imprisoned by her in brutal conditions, Zilastra was unconvinced, assessing that Billaba could not even swat a fire gnat in her state.

A medical droid was on the Voyager Dawn between 12 BBY and 9 BBY. The medical droid was of the 2-1B surgical droid model and was taking care of its master, Jedi Elan Rast. As the droid examined the Jedi, they were attacked by the Galactic Empire and The Grand Inquisitor.

The Jumurra were a sentient species with tan skin, pointed ears, and brown eyes. They also possessed jowls. During the High Republic Era, the elder Naasa, a member of the species, was in the Brendok coven.
Keldooine's largest city was a megalopolis situated on the planet Keldooine. In 33 BBY, Jedi Master Depa Billaba went undercover in the city in order to investigate piracy within the Slice.

The Mirogana Market was located in the city Mirogana on the moon Toshara.
Sashin was a village in the Karaba Foothills on Akiva, a jungle planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During 3 ABY, the wives Shirene and Esmelle lived in the village.

Kadùa Village, simply known as Kadùa, was a wind fishing settlement in the Mirogana Valley on the moon Toshara near the Mirogana Gate. In 3 ABY, the settlement was made up of several buildings surrounding a center Robuma pen.
The varaki were predatory creatures native to the moon Toshara. They generally fed off smaller animals, also posing a threat to grazing robuma.

Robumas were herbivorous mammals native to the moon Toshara where they roamed the savannas. Herd animals by instinct, they were domesticated by the first arrivals to the moon and became essential to Tosharan culture, with the creatures' milk, leather, and meat all commonly use…
Ronga bugs were small insects of the moon Toshara. They possessed light-emitting organs that they used to locate one another in darkness.

Yubesho rats were a type of rat found on the moon Toshara. Living mostly underground, the rats were mostly blind, but had a heightened sense of smell that could lead them to food at impressive distances, and they were known to chew through wood and even metal to get to it.

Gushiro were small mammals native to the moon Toshara. Possessing densely-furred, slender bodies, they hunted small rodents and insects like the apono moths in the moon's shrublands, which were their primary habitat.

Kama birds were a type of large predatory bird native to the savannas of the moon Toshara. The birds' preferred prey was robuma calves, and they circled around herds of the creatures for some time before striking.

Slygels were a type of soft-bodied invertebrate that resided in the orbit of the moon Toshara. They possessed gelatinous skin and fed on energy, such as that from starships and the energy cells of satellites.

The Castellan was a cruiser operational during the High Republic Era. After falling under attack by a fleet of Nihil starships, the Castellan made an emergency jump to hyperspace, crashing on the moon Toshara.
The Shrine of Judgment was one of the ancient Voss temples located near the Interpreter's Retreat on the planet Voss.
Palagosal was a planet located in the Arkanis sector. After signs of the blight were found on the planet, the Galactic Republic ordered an evacuation of any individuals on the planet.
The Ralltiir Occupation, also known as the occupation of Ralltiir, took place in 1 BBY when the Galactic Empire occupied the world Ralltiir and kept a presence there for an extended period.

Ascaal district was a region of the moon Toshara that included the Ascada River. In 3 ABY, unusually high rainfall occurred during a hurricane, causing authorities to predict flooding in the district a week later.

The Ascada River was a river located in the Ascaal district of the moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, there was unusually high rainfall during a hurricane and, a week later, this led authorities to predict flooding in the district.
Sector 14-D was an area of the city of Mirogana on the moon Toshara. A toxic mainline rupture in the city sector led to its closure to the public while toxicity remediation took place.

Helikoprion was a waterworld in the Helikoprion system in the Nilgaard sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was home to the Heliko species. After the planet was engulfed in a civil war, the Delik family, who resided on Helikoprion, moved off-world.

Centuries before the Great Galactic War, Jedi Master Raniah and her followers found refuge on an uninhabited planet in Wild Space after their were expelled from the Jedi Order.

The kyumo rabbit was a species of mammal native to the planet Kijimi. It had white fur, yellow eyes, a long nose, and large feet. To avoid predators, the rabbit would run or dig into the snow to hide. The kyumo rabbit's sensitive ears were excellent at detecting a threat.

Devil serpents were a type of creature found on the Forest Moon of Endor.

Lower Mirogana was an area of the multi-level city Mirogana on the moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, a fire occurred in Lower Mirogana's central market that destroyed a number of merchant stalls.

The central plain was located on the moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, conditions across the plain remained stable despite persistently strong and steady winds occurring over several days.

Rajatha Ridge was a ridge on the moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, a mild tornado warning was issued for the area and reported on Holonet News Toshara by wind report host Botto Fna, who advised listeners with high sensitivity to wind to remain indoors.

Orbital Security was a security organization that performed cargo checks on citizens of the moon Toshara in the Toshaal system of the Outer Rim Territories.

The Growlers were a pirate gang based near Bogano and active during the reign of the Empire. After the group bought Imperial parts from Greedo, he ran away with both the parts and the money.
Wull was a rocky planet located in the galaxy.
Wyburke was a swamp planet located in the galaxy.
Zodac was a terrestrial forest planet located in the galaxy. In 19 BBY, the Nite Owls set up a camp on the planet where they trained before the attack on Mandalore.
Kyaa was a jungle planet located in the galaxy.

Olcull was a terrestrial planet located in the galaxy.

A DUM-series pit droid was nicknamed "Drip" by Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker.

VX-2411, nicknamed "Ringer" by the youngling Anakin Skywalker, was a droid that functioned as a podracer during the Republic Era. The droid previously served as a conductor unit for trains on the planet Vandor before being modified to work on a podracer.
Toshaal was a planet located in the galaxy's Outer Rim, orbited by the moon Toshara.
Karalle was a swamp planet located in the Outer Rim's Albanin sector. The force-sensitive Quermian Jarea Kaela once hid on Karalle to hide from bounty hunters and the Inquisitorius.

9-EZ was an A-LT Utility Droid who operated on the moon Jedha. In 1 BBY, 9-EZ was rolling through a street in Jedha City, when a passsing Imperial TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank transporting kyber crystals was attacked by Partisan fighters.
Kroop birds were bipedal avian creatures indigenous to the planet Omaka. The birds lived in flocks, building tubular nests into the sides of mountainous paths.
Oppa was a terrestrial planet located in the galaxy. In 3 ABY, while delivering Han Solo to Jabba the Hutt, Boba Fett stopped on the planet to refuel.
Craysol was a rocky planet with constant lightning storms where a hideout of Clan Colbra was located.

The Hidden Chain flagship was a capital ship used by the Mandalorians of the Hidden Chain during the Third Galactic War. The ship transported the Holocron Machine created by the Hidden Chain leader Heta Kol to create an army of Force-sensitive soldiers.
The Overgrown Mining Site was a mining area on the planet Ruhnuk.

A subterranean species was native to the planet Ridlay. The species, referred to as "ghosts" by the local inhabitants, lived underground; only journeying to the planet's surface every fifty years during the total eclipse.
The Stingray was a ship manufactured by the Urukabb Slipways that was owned by the family of the Heliko female Haze Delik. Delik used the ship when she was a part of the Nihil pirates.
The Hollow Chasm was a canyon located on the planet Ruhnuk.

The job on Alzoc III was an incident where the mercenary Xi'an and bounty hunter Din Djarin, both members of a crew alongside the criminal Ranzar Malk and Xi'an's brother Qin, traveled to the Outer Rim planet Alzoc III for a job. The job saw Djarin dive into his darker instincts.

The Glass Abyss was the derisive name of the underground caverns on the planet Metagos that contained its capital city of New Xaxxis. The caverns contained large crystal obelisks, both standing on the ground or hanging from the ceiling, which were the source of the name.
Picadir was a swamp planet located in the Mayagil sector within the Outer Rim Territories.
The Tunnel 2-A, nicknamed Ruined Dig Site, was a mine on the planet Ruhnuk. At the time of the Showdown on Ruhnuk, it was inhabited by the legendary tineback known as Kithrawl.
