Cethis was a terrestrial astronomical object that was home to a settlement known as Haven during the High Republic Era. After the blight emerged on Cethis, the Jedi Order and Republic Defense Coalition evacuated Haven's citizens away to a settlement established on an island.
A type of feathered lizard was found in the forest of the astronomical object Cethis. The lizards possessed bright plumage and large fleshy wings that they could walk on like front legs.
Oisin was a planet inhabited by the Oisinians. During the High Republic Era, the Oisinians traded with the Malorins of the planet Malorin.
Malorin was a planet inhabited by a group of the same name. During the High Republic Era, the world had a trading agreement with the Oisinians of the planet Oisin.

The Arid Wastes were desert plateaus overlooking canyons on the planet Ruhnuk.

Azlin's quarters was a living quarters located in the Jedi Temple Detention Center within the lower levels of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

Meridaus was a terrestrial astronomical object. By 228 BBY, during the High Republic Era, Jedi Knight Pola Sheel encountered a member of the Nihil marauders' Jedi-hunting Children of the Storm group as well as that Nihil's pack of Force-consuming Nameless creatures on Meridaus.

Reath's lab was a laboratory located in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, utilized by the Jedi Knight Reath Silas during the High Republic Era while researching the Nameless creatures and the blight affliction.

The Excavator was a Venture-class cruiser used by the former Jedi Master Cohmac Vitus during the High Republic Era. Vitus utilized the cruiser during his search for the Tolemite civilization.
L-77 (El-Seventy-Seven), nicknamed Sevens, was a combat droid who worked alongside the mercenary Ashton Vol during the High Republic Era.
The Invictus was a Pacifier-class transport ship utilized by the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era.

The design regiment was a sub-unit of the Republic Corps of Engineers. Lieutenant Commander Orson Callan Krennic, a member of the corps that was secretly transferred to the Republic Special Weapons Group, was offered a position within the design regiment.

The Wonto District market was a bazaar in the Wonto District of the spaceport city Mos Eisley on the desert planet Tatooine. The human merchant Simrain Kanda, a streetfood stall selling Sketto Chuga, and the gambling parlor the Dizzy Droid operated in the market during 3 ABY.

The Miyuki Trade League was a merchant and smuggling syndicate that was formed during the Republic Era when groups of smugglers came together to protect shared interests. As the league grew it began employing merchants which offered equipment on a number of worlds.
The Terror of Tenoo was a cruiser operated by the pirate Blackbolt during the High Republic Era.

A series of hidden farms belonging to the Gungan species was located north of the city Rellias on the planet Naboo. The farms were operated by worker glurrgs and guarded by kaadu cavalry.

Ahsoka Tano's quarters were the living quarters used by Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano. Located inside the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant, Tano's quarters were a small and simple space where Tano would meditate.

Angoth was a small planet that featured woods and a ring of scattered asteroids. During the High Republic Era, a settlement existed on Angoth, and the Nihil marauders also established a base in a former detention center for smugglers.
A large rural settlement was located on the planet Angoth during the High Republic Era. It was close to an outpost, once a detention center that was taken over by the Nihil marauders.

The Orchid was a starship utilized by the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. The vessel was used during a Republic and Jedi Order mission to capture a Nameless creature from a base of the Nihil marauders on the planet Angoth.

An island was located on the planet Tolis. After the native Tolemites' civilization was destroyed as a result of the Nameless creatures and the blight, the few survivors retreated to rebuild on the island.

A type of leviathan creature was found on the planet Tolis. Larger than mountains, the leviathans were immensely strong in the Force.

The Tolemites were a sentient species native to the Wild Space planet Tolis. Living around twenty thousand years before the High Republic Era, the Tolemites were steeped in the Force, which they worshiped as the Peace.

Ripurni was a lifeless planet located near the edges of the Anoat sector. Eventual Imperial Grand Moff Ubrik Adelhard was born on this planet. At some point during the Imperial Era, Ripurni was used as a mining planet.

Maya-14 was a Maya-series holodroid who was an acrobatic dancer in the Xaxxis Axis Quartette on the planet Metagos. They were a sister of Maya-8, a fellow dancer, and Maya-12, operating in the bar Vin-Vin's Wheelhouse in the city of New Xaxxis.
The Metagosan were a reptilian sentient species. Possessing dense musculature, they were similar to the Trandoshans. The species had a typical sibilant hiss when speaking.
New Xaxxis was the capital city of the planet Metagos. Located in the underground caverns known as the Glass Abyss, the city was shaped like a wagon wheel and housed nearly a million New Xaxxans.
The Zilka were a sentient buglike species. They possessed four legs and were armored. Two Zilka enforcers encountered the undercover Jedi Master Mace Windu on the planet Metagos.
A Hutta snake was a common type of snake that partially shared its name with the planet Nal Hutta. The Hutt Churo studied the skin-shedding habits of Hutta snakes.

Grozz's hometown was a town on the planet Kashyyyk. By 9 ABY, the town had nearly been converted into a shrine for the Wookiee Hunter Grozz, honoring his exploits as a professional Huttballer and even housing a museum to the then-Hunters of the Outer Rim entertainer.

The Storming of Abartolom was a conflict that took place on Abartolom during the Imperial Era. As part of the engagement, the Galactic Empire deployed TK stormtroopers from at least one V-82 dropship.

The Moraysi rebellion was a conflict that took place during the Imperial Era some time after the Storming of Abartolom and prior to the Battle of Atollon. As part of the rebellion, the Galactic Empire deployed at least forty-two TIE fighters and attacked a starship.
A settlement was located on the planet Oisin during the High Republic Era.

R4-TR3 was an R4 astromech droid whose appearance was akin to a festive evergreen tree, even topped with a sparkling golden star. The droid was known to spend time on the forest moon of Endor.

The Ganzee Gang, also referred to as the Ganzee, was a criminal gang that operated in the undercity on the planet Coruscant during the High Republic Era. The gang was notorious for forcing orphans to work for them.
Thrumfrogs were a type of frog that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Eriadu during the High Republic Era.
Qi Dail was a world located in the galaxy that had unusual rock formations.
A large fire-breathing dragon resided deep within the core of the planet Eriadu, according to claims made by the first members of the Tarkin family who landed there.

The scout expedition commander Arnoth Draenell operated with a crew working for the Galactic Republic that was killed by the Inchichtok.

The Wookiee sanctuary was a Wookiee village deep in the forests of the planet Kashyyyk. Yanna was the elder and leader of the sanctuary. At some point between 19 BBY and 18 BBY, Clone Force 99 rescued the Wookiee Jedi Padawan Gungi, and brought him to the safety of the village.

The Imperial Veterans Association was a veteran's affairs organization dedicated to veterans of the Imperial Military, a force composed of seemingly countless beings who served the Galactic Empire, which reigned from 19 BBY to 4 ABY before falling in 5 ABY.
Petris Major was a planet located in the Outer Rim Territories that had at least one city. During the High Republic Era, Jedi Tar'ak Borran lived on Petris Major, who had an Echo Stone.
Zondula was a world located in the galaxy. During the Great Jedi Purge, the 501st Legion was sent to eliminate five Jedi who were stationed at a temple on Zondula.
A puffball was a type of furry creature that could be found on the Outer Rim planet Dalna during the High Republic Era.
An HK-87 assassin droid accompanied the mercenary Marrok on Corellia to confront the former Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano, where the assassin droid was destroyed.
The Talmadge was a small shuttle used by Jedi Masters Cohmac Vitus and Kantam Sy to fly from Starlight Beacon to Corellia.
Hysalrians were a sentient species from the Hysalria system. N'Kata Del Gormo, rumored to have been an early instructor of future Grand Master Yoda, was said to have been a Hysalrian.
Level seven was one of the levels of the city New Xaxxis on the planet Metagos. It contained Hillia, the village of the Sa'ad clan, situated deep within a vast mushroom forest.

The Farakai were a large anthropoid sentient species from the Outer Rim. They possessing a unique bonding ability in which two individuals would be joined with a bridge of bone and muscle.
WRM-2456, nicknamed Worm, was a protocol droid who served Thane Chulok in the city of New Xaxxis on the planet Metagos. He had a golden inverted pyramid body on treads.

The insectoid Zilka sentient species originated from a planet. When the gangster Chulok analyzed two unconscious Zilka enforcers who had been incapacitated by the incognito Jedi Master Mace Windu, the Rodian Lok—one half of Chulok—noted that Windu had been familiar with Zilka …
The Great Wheel, or level four, was a level of the city New Xaxxis on the planet Metagos. It was circular in shape, with concentric rings and spokes that radiated from the center.
The Syblins was the name given to individuals of the species of Queen Sybil, an insectoid being who resided on the planet Metagos and whose species' name was unknown.
An astromech droid pilot operated a landspeeder on the planet Pagodon. The droid was signaled by the Kubaz ferryman Barlidan to escort Din Djarin and a Mythrol to the Razor Crest, but Djarin refused.
The New Republic commando were an elite variant of New Republic soldiers of the New Republic.
The Thermal district was a district of Kijimi City on the planet Kijimi. The district was home to The Wellspring, an old bathhouse that made use of hot springs.

The Queen's Road was an section of Kijimi City which led from Kijimiko Square to the Monk's Gate on the planet Kijimi. During 3 ABY, the area around the road by the Monk's Gate was part of the Ashiga Clan District.

The Ridge Terrace was an grouping of housing that over looked a ridge on the edge of the Thermal District of Kijimi City on the planet Kijimi. During 3 ABY, the Quarren merchant, Shuma would land her ship there and sell her wares.

The Varl Circuit was a podracing circuit that ran through the pilgrimage tunnels that connected the three Moons of Varl.

Lehanis was a swamp planet located in the Outer Rim Territories where Luke Skywalker and Rynn Zenat fought the Acolytes of the Beyond in search of Ky Narec's compendium.

A remote village was located on the planet Iridonia. Nox hailed from the village before eventually leaving to participate in the Hunters of the Outer Rim.

Hosnian Gravity Parks was a gravity-themed park situated in the Hosnian system. In 3 ABY, an advert for the park that described it as "fun for the whole family in every direction" was played in Huttese over the speakers of the casino cruiser Morenia.

Lions were a species of leonids whose face served as the Mandalorian Clan Eldar's signet. They were known for representing concepts such as bravery, courage, and pride.

An ice troll was a type of troll. Between 1 BBY and 4 ABY, during a particularly bleak winter on the moon Endor, the Ewoks Wicket Wystri Warrick, Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka, and Teebo attempted to trap a Kroolok, another type of troll that supposedly lived on Endor.
The Supply Yard was a supply shipping yard used by the Czerka Corporation in 3638 BBY on CZ-198.

The First Order barracks were located on the Thunderer.

A sentient winged species lived within the galaxy. The species possessed gray and brown feathers and had the ability to fly. The astronomer Kh'ymm was a member of the species.
In 228 BBY, during the High Republic Era, Jedi Master Kantam Sy of the Jedi Order was involved in a hostage negotiation on Ferrix.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.
The Endless Lake was a large lake on the forest moon of Endor. It was once a major settlement named Endless Lake Village until it was attacked and sunk by Orcon, king of the Underwater Kingdom.
Horned eopies, also known as antlered eopies, were a species of quadrupedal mammallians found on the planet At Achrann. They were a variant of the eopies who lived on Tatooine.
Troiks were a clan on the planet At Achrann, who were led by General Strix. Their clan maintained armed forces identified as the Troik Army.

An aquatic invertebrate creature found in the galaxy that had translucent pink skin and a large black eye. When the youngling KB was wandering around Borgo Prime, around 9 ABY, she saw several of the creatures in a jar at a creature shop in the port.

A crustacean found in the galaxy that had black and red shell, one green eye, six legs and a six plated tail. When the younglings Wim and Neel were wandering around Borgo Prime, during 9 ABY, they walked past on such creature.
The Battle on Malenko was battle during the Clone Wars fought between the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems' Droid Army.

Neon woolly caterpillars were a type of caterpillar. During the High Republic Era, the Hutt Churo kept neon woolly caterpillars in his greenhouse laboratory in his family's palace on the planet Nal Hutta.
Didelum rodents were a type of rodent with prehensile tails that played dead when approached by predators.

Bistan's U-wing was a UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft piloted by Laren Joma and Taslet Colb during the Battle of Scarif. The U-wing arrived with the rest of Blue Squadron to reinforce Jyn Erso and the rest of Rogue One in their mission to recover the Death Star plans.

A serving droid worked at Takodana Castle on the planet Takodana during the Imperial Era.

Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa was a location that was situated on top of the Skull Ridge Mountain on the planet Lanupa.

The Everon exodus took place in 500 BBY, when the last members of the Evereni species—known as the Wanderers—remaining after the Great Storm and centuries of conflicts banded together and abandoned their homeworld Everon to escape death under the lead of the Xouri family.

This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

Aruza was a celestial body located in the Aruza system of the Expansion Region and the Interior. It was situated in grid square I-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Aruza was the homeworld of the Aruzan female Manaroo.

Gallowyss was a planet located in the Anoat sector. After Grand Moff Ubrik Adelhard was betrayed by his advisor, Reyna Oskure, he escaped alongside Commander Bragh and several stormtroopers aboard an escape pod that crashed onto Gallowyss.

A safety droid was in the service of At Attin's government in 9 ABY. When Wendle tried to find the barrier access code to try and sneak a message out to find his son Wim, the safety droid noticed a surge coming from the terminal.

An IG droid was guarding a shipment of prototype blaster pistols on a 20-T Railcrawler conveyex transport on Ord Mantell. Boba Fett, sent by Jabba Desilijic Tiure to steal the prototypes, disabled the droid using a reprogrammed MSE-6 series repair droid.

A settlement on the astronomical object Vianax had been ruined by 229 BBY. That year, Jedi Master Kelnacca and his Padawan, Yarzion Vell, made repairs to the settlement after fighting members of the Nihil marauders on Vianax.
The bounty hunter Shenda Mol had a group of followers who operated on the Mid Rim planet Numidian Prime during the Republic Era.
In 40 BBY, Pijali blackguards executed a strike on a soulcraft above the Inner Rim planet Pijal.
Mastor was an acidic planet where a rebel base was located.
A Jadeite neighborhood was located on the planet Coruscant. During the High Republic Era, the eatery Tal-Iree's operated in the area, situated down an alleyway.

During the New Republic Era, the Onyx Cinder undertook a mission to Skull Ridge Mountain on Lanupa.
The Dulok camp was maintained by a group of Duloks led by King Gorneesh on the Outer Rim Forest Moon of Endor.
Tak Rennod's pirates were a crew of pirates led by the pirate Captain Tak Rennod. Among the crew’s members were a first mate, the droid SM-33, and a woman who was the concubine of Rennod.
Docking Bay Two was a docking bay located on Coruscant.
The Dwarf Star was a small-scale replica of the Galactic Empire's Death Star built by Lax Torios for planetary use on The Island of a planet.

The stealth ship was a prototype IPV-2C Stealth Corvette developed for the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars that was used by the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker to break Admiral Trench's blockade of the planet Christophsis.
Hermit crabs were a type of crab species the exist in the galaxy. The trash crab was a hermit crab-like species found on Lanupa.

The Bauble Battlestation was a vehicle built by Lax Torios for planetary use on The Island of a planet. It was a festive, green and red variation of her Dwarf Star planned to be used for a since-scrapped Life Day parade. She sold it at her vehicle shop for three hundred probits.
Stinging blue butterflies were a type of blue butterfly that migrated and could sting. During the High Republic Era, the young Hutt Churo recorded the migration patterns of stinging blue butterflies.
A sentient plant-like species was active in the galaxy. The Pirate King Gorian Shard was a member of this species.

The Beach Ball was a vehicle built by Lax Torios for planetary use on The Island of a planet. It was a blue, red, white, and yellow variation of her Dwarf Star.

R6-D23 was an R6 astromech droid operating in Bespin's Cloud City, maintaining starships. The droid was a typical R6, but also wore a blue cone-shaped hat with star and moon shapes. This astromech droid included a Herner optical holographic projector.
The Bogaranth pen was located on the Gaze Electric to house its Bogaranths.

The Sandstone Quarter was a district in the north of Mos Eisley on the desert planet Tatooine. The Miyuki Trade League established a cache of materials and equipment in the quarter sometime before 3 ABY.

M3-LOD, nicknamed Melody, was an astromech droid that was created by Ca Isiora and Telem prior to the Battle of Endor.

The Green Ring of Nenyezh was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Nenyezh system in the Halori sector of the Mid Rim Territories. The location possessed gardens and was controlled by the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.
Reepayto was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. "Doctor Mandible" was a member of this species.

A droid working for an individual named Koje who resided on the desert planet Tatooine. Around 2 ABY, their employer owed money to the Hutt Clan and, when he wasn't able to pay, he hid out in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.
The Junkyard was a location in the south of Mos Eisley on the desert planet Tatooine. It was just south of the Dowager Queen crash site in Mos Eisley.
The South Quarter was a district in the south of Mos Eisley on the desert planet Tatooine. During 3 ABY, the Galactic Empire operated an a listening post in the district.
The Imperial Listening Post was in the backroom of a house in the South Quarter of Mos Eisley on the desert planet Tatooine that operated during 3 ABY.
The Wonto District was district in the center of the city Mos Eisley on the desert planet Tatooine that included the Ubrikkian Trade Tower, Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina and a bazaar.

The Slonini Cartel was a criminal organization in the galaxy. By 3 ABY, the cartel had collapsed following the assassination of its leader, Slem Slonini, by the bounty hunter Vail Tormin. As a result, Tormin's value increased by almost 350%.

The chef Laizhu Bedenn once owned a moderate diner in the city of Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine. At some point, Jabba the Hutt increased the pay Bedenn had to give him, which ended up resulting in the diner's closing after Bedenn could not pay Jabba what she owed him.

The Kijimiko Caverns were a series of caves that ran from the Thieves' Quarter of Kijimi City to under the Dai Bendu Monastery also located in the city.

The Hutt Cartel District was section of that city of Mos Eisley on the desert planet Tatooine that was controlled by the Hutt Clan during 3 ABY. The Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure had a townhouse in the district.
RX-01 was an RX-series pilot droid who served as a tram-operator on the isolated planet At Attin, where he piloted a school tram bound for At Attin Middle School Gamma.

Seeker's Peril was a rock formation in the South Jundland Wastes region of the desert planet Tatooine. In 3 ABY, the Jawa merchant Pinota Pakinota operated out of an old Tusken camp on a cliff in the rock formation.

Nomad Gulch was an area in the South Jundland Wastes region of the desert planet Tatooine. In 3 ABY, the Galactic Empire considered the Imperial Outpost 74 and the Garrick Ranch to be near Nomad Gulch.

Pillar Forest was an area in the North Jundland Wastes region of the desert planet Tatooine. The location had a number for piller like rock formations. Sometime before 3 ABY a Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier crashed into one of the pillars.

10114 was a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter that was assigned to Fuel Station Visavi while it was orbiting the Outer Rim Territories moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, after it was found to have faulty power line it was shipped from the station to another location.

10291 was a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter that was assigned to Fuel Station Visavi while it was orbiting the Outer Rim Territories moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, after it's Ion engine was replaced it was shipped from the station to another location.

10127 was a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter that was assigned to Fuel Station Visavi while it was orbiting the Outer Rim Territories moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, after it's ion engine was replaced it was shipped from the station to the Fondor Shipyards.

Viper 071-V-8852 was a viper probe droid that served the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. By 3 ABY, it had been sent to the planet Plexis where it undertook an eight week mission to observe the spaceport and recorded any activity of spice or weapons smuggling.

Mine Cart was an abandoned mine in the North Jundland Wastes region of the desert planet Tatooine. The location had a number for piller like rock formations. Sometime before 3 ABY the end of a Tusken Raider's gaderffii stick was lost at the top of an overlook above the mine.
Fern's nanny droid was a nanny droid that belonged to Fara and Fern. Fern was able to override the droids memory to convince it of false events.

Ithorian crawlers were genetically designed organisms capable of surviving in a zero-moisture environment. These beings were seeded on the planet Gholondreine-β by the Galactic Empire after it drained the planet's oceans.
The Mud Pits were located at the Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa on the planet Lanupa during the New Republic Era.
Coruscant rodents were a type of rodent native to the Core Worlds planet Coruscant and liked to eat the flowers within the gardens of the Jedi Order's Jedi Temple.
Bev Kranti clams were a species of clam from the planet Chandel that produced valuable pearls over the course of 150 years.

Myrran Swimmer's Club was an athletic club that existed in Myrra the capital city of the Outer Rim Territories planet Akiva.

The Tosharan Wildlife Society was an organization that concerned itself with wildlife on Toshara a moon in the Outer Rim Territories. Sometime before or during 3 ABY the society wrote a notice regarding gushiro settling in a rocky alcove in the Southern Falls region of the moon.
EV-9T9 was the trusted servant droid of Jedi Knight Kam Solusar.
EY-E9, or EY, was a protocol droid that ran the casino cruiser Morenia during 3 ABY.

Chenley Prime was a gas giant that contained Shingcu Station, the lair of Boolan. Keeve Trennis, Sskeer, Terec, Ceret, OrbaLin, Lourna Dee, and Tey Sirrek ventured to this station to save a Yacombe girl.

A droid flew a ZH-40 Tribune-class light freighter for the casino cruiser Morenia during 3 ABY. He took part in a supply mission to Renpalli Station for the Morenia in 3 ABY where he bought twenty tanks of veron gas and fifteen units of hyperfuel.

Pip-Squeak was a MSE series maintenance droid that was given to an Akivan child who later passed away.

Secluded Backalley was an alley way near the Queen's Road in Kijimi City on Kijimi, a planet in the Mid Rim. The alley led to the Kijimi Spaceport. By 3 ABY, an individual looking to leave the planet had lost their identicard in the alley.
A black, eight-limbed bug species was a delicacy found on the pirate asteroid Borgo Prime. In the New Republic Era, members of this lobster-size species were served in a local noodle bar.

An asteroid was situated in the Outer Rim Territories' Tharin sector. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel Alliance maintained a droid-operated supply dump facility known as the Dump that had been built in the asteroid.

CORT-327 was a freighter used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The ship was piloted by Burin Kassal and copiloted by Calle Tharandon during a mission to Ord Mantell to extract rebel operatives who's location had been compromised.
Old Junkyard was an area off the Back Alley of the Wonto District of Mos Eisley on Tatooine, a planet in the Outer Rim. By 3 ABY, an individual had lost a well–made airspeeder toy.
The Bestine junkyard was a junkyard in the city Bestine on Tatooine, the desert planet in the Outer Rim. During 3 ABY, a scavenger named Otip Ashtep operated out of the junkyard.

The Azerbaz Region was an area of the Desert Valley region on Tatooine, a desert planet in the Outer Rim. It was situated east of the city Bestine and west of Mos Eisley spaceport. By 3 ABY, the Miyuki Trade League had left a cache of materials and equipment.

The Eastern Mesra Plateau was the eastern portion of the Great Mesra Plateau in the Desert Valley on Tatooine, a desert planet in the Outer Rim. It was located west of the city of Mos Eisley. During 3 ABY, the Hutt Clan operated a bunkhouse out of the area..
The Imperial Checkpoint was a checkpoint run by the Galactic Empire in 3 ABY, near the city Bestine in the Desert Valley region on Tatooine, the desert planet in the Outer Rim.
The Tusken March was an area of the Western Dune Sea on Tatooine, a desert planet in the Outer Rim. By 3 ABY, the Miyuki Trade League had established a vault in the area.
The Lowland Basin was an area of the Great Chott salt flat that included the Lars homestead and Tosche Station on Tatooine, a desert planet in the Outer Rim.

The Ja-Mero Ridge was a rock formation in the South Jundland Wastes on Tatooine, a desert planet in the Outer Rim. By 3 ABY, the Miyuki Trade League had placed a cache of materials and equipment near the ridge.
The Ancient lair, or Ancient Creature's Lair was a cave used by a Krayt dragon. By 3 ABY, the dragon had abandoned it leaving behind a large cave system. Which had been taken over by a bandit gang.
The Myrra Outskirts was the area around the capital city of Myrra in the Myrra Valley on the Akiva, a jungle planet in the Outer Rim.
The Stratha Peaks was a rock formation north of Mount Selasa on Akiva, a jungle planet in the Outer Rim.

The eastern falls was a series of waterfalls located in the southeast area of Grazing Fields region on Toshara, a wind-swept moon in the Outer Rim. By 3 ABY, a hideout called Shaska's Hold had been build in a set of rocks near the falls.

The Arobernos were a large, sentient, red-skinned species with pointed ears. They could survive being engulfed in lava. One member of the species was blind and locked in symbiosis with the Eye of Webbish Bog on the planet Mustafar.

The Howling Strip was an area in the northeast of the Boulder Forest region on Toshara, a moon in the Outer Rim. By 3 ABY, a communication outpost for the Galactic Empire had been constructed in the strip along with two ground based turbolasers.
Mombin hill was a hill in Mirogana Valley on Toshara, a moon in the Outer Rim. The rock formation known as Bosan Mound was near the hill.
Spine Mountain was a rock formation that ran through the Mirage region of Toshara, a moon in the Outer Rim.
Phantideans were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They had pink skin and large tusks.

The Heart of Eroudac were a sentient species native to the planet Eroudac. They were white, pink, and green, with hair that imitated thorny plants. They buried themselves underground within a location known as the Oasis, waiting travelers who came searching for mythical flowers.

Krill sharks were a type of shark found on the planet Eiram. During a seasonal ritual, krill sharks broke through the surface of the water. On one occasion, in the city Erasmus on Eiram, the Eirami Jedi Raa-lyn Las was present when locals gathered along piers to watch the ritual.
During the High Republic Era, the Nihil marauders attacked the planet Adelphi. The Nihil struck without warning and the Jedi Order was unable to arrive in time to stop them.

Around 9 ABY, Silvo stood trial aboard a pirate frigate. The former captain faced charges of leading a disastrous raid on a merchant freighter that cost many crew members their lives, as well as escaping from prison.

In 4 ABY, shortly after the Battle of Endor, General Han Solo of the Alliance of Free Planets undertook a diplomatic mission to the planet Vandelhelm in order to escort the Venerated Ones of Vandelhelm, Lillindri Nanimei Filda Vandelhelm XXXII and Endrodanar Tiopuld Shaamador …
Pelagic’s skiff was utilized as complement to the casino sail barge Pelagic on the planet Kwenn in 33 BBY. It was secretly owned by the pirate gang known as the Filthy Credits.
The Sirroning were a six-limbed, sentient, tan-skinned species. One known as the Eye of Webbish Bog was locked in symbiosis with a blind Areobernos on the planet Mustafar.

Vermin's Reach was a district of Dazenma, the capital city of the planet Dekien. Seen as a seedy part of town, tourists who wandered into it were typically escorted away, and the ones who insisted on visiting the district didn't make the way home.

Truvi was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Atravis sector's Truvi system, which was part of the Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches. It was situated in grid square L-20 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Leequa was a location on the planet Ghorman. In 2 BBY, gouge mining equipment sent from an Imperial armada landed at Leequa in order to harvest the planet's kalkite deposits for the emperor's "Energy Initiative".
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.
The Dekien sea was a sea on the Outer Rim planet Dekien.

The pilgrim's ward was a section of Yojou, the capital city of the planet Rei'izu. It contained many religious sites that had been preserved by Imperial edict and was separated from the rest of the city by the Moga River.

A shrine was located in the pilgrims' ward, a section of Yojou, the capital city of the planet Rei'izu. It was one of Rei'izu's oldest and largest shrines, and hundreds of cloud-deer lived on its grounds.
Aaldus 6 was a wealthy planet in the galaxy that joined the Galactic Empire around the time of the Battle of Yavin.

Watoru was a terrestrial astronomical object in a binary star system, where it experienced seasonal variation. It was the site of the home estate of Jedi lord Hanrai, who presided over the training of Jedi apprentices there as part of his Jedi clan.
Hanrai's clan was a Jedi clan led by the Jedi lord Hanrai. Members of the clan included Yuehiro, Numoda, Masamu, Ogara, and Tsuden.

The Valley of Kraau was located on the forest word Ska Gora in the Tython system. During the invasion of the Tython system by the Rakatan Infinite Empire, the Rakata captured Ska Gora and constructed a base in the Valley of Kraau.

A protocol droid reported the results of the bioscan of a family to regent-captain Zargo Anaximander in 21 ABY. This droid along with two others then destroyed each other with blasters as the information and data analysis contained privileged information.

A crystal belt was located in the Aldhani system. Every three years, the planet Aldhani passed through the crystal belt as part of its orbital path, allowing meteors from the crystal belt to harmlessly burn up in the atmosphere, creating a spectacle known to the native people …
Data Center was a sector in the Imperial Bureau of Standards of the Galactic Empire.

Eight Hundred Block was a location on the agricultural world Mina-Rau. By 4 BBY, Kellen gave Brasso an adulterated Emergency Work Order for the Eight Hundred Block so Brasso, Bix Caleen and Wilmon Paak could hide from the Galactic Empire, as they did not possess visas and were…

Stone fleas were a type of flea found in the sea caves of an island on the planet Bal'demnic in the Outer Rim's Auril sector. The skura that nested on the island during the High Republic Era ate stone fleas and formants in the sea caves.

Vermingilua was a classification of avian that the small and tubby skura species belonged to. Standing 0.15 meters tall and eating stone fleas and formants in the sea caves of the planet Bal'demnic in the Outer Rim, the skura had long snouts and slabbed-shaped heads.

Iliabath was an astronomical object located in the Iliabath system within the Mortex sector of the Outer Rim and New Territories. It was situated in grid square R-4 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The South Depot was a location on the planet Ghorman. During the construction of the Galactic Empire's Palmo armory around 3 BBY, the Ghorman Front learned that nightly cargo-carrier shipments for the building of the armory originated from the South Depot.
The Jedha Working Group was an organization within the Galactic Empire that produced classified data pertaining to the construction of the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station and the Mid Rim moon Jedha.

New Alvaros was the capital city of the planet Barajin during the Imperial Era. Between 19 BBY and 4 ABY, when the human female Rynn Zenat—a native of Barajin—was at a very young age, her parents were killed by the Galactic Empire during a raid carried out by the Spice Runners…
Senator Greylark's office was the office of Galactic Republic Senator Zenny Greylark during the High Republic Era. It was located on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.
ISB plaza was a plaza that existed in front of the Imperial Security Bureau Central Office on Coruscant.

The meknek Fillik owned a PIP droid during the High Republic Era. Manufactured by Pui-ui Implement Products, it was eighteen centimeters (seven inches) tall, had black and orange plating, and was equipped with an internal carousel that included custom tools.

The Hidden Mounds was a rock formation on the moon Toshara. In 3 ABY, an advertisement featuring a picture of the mounds along with the phrase "The Hidden Mounds, visit now" written in Aurebesh was displayed at the capital city Mirogana.
Carburo was an Expansion Region celestial body located in grid square K-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Khepi, located in Wild Space, was a planet and the homeworld of the Khepi who existed since the formation of formation of the Galactic Republic and remained independent of it through out most of its existence.

The Poor Crow was a light freighter owned by the pilot Ekiya. It was a long, sharp-nosed ship that had extensible, scarred wings and stenciled writing on its side naming it "the poor crow." On the inside, the Crow was neat and well maintained, though it appeared assembled out …
Vel's home was the home of Vel Sartha on the moon Yavin 4.
A scout ship was stolen by the Sith Kouru to pursue the former Sith known as the Ronin.

Uedar was the only moon of the planet Ueda, which was part of the Ueda system in the unincorporated Bosphian provinces of the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories in square Q-3 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

Quaraxian was a sentient species that aged very slowly and possessed significant intellectual prowess. By the time of the Republic Era, the species were virtually extinct, with the exception of individuals such as the Quaraxian female criminal Phaedra.
The Khepi Tomb, also known as the Great Tomb, was a necropolis built into an asteroid hidden in the Sayma Nebula located in Wild Space.
The mooc was a species of felinoid creature.

Arjee-Entoo was a gold plated droid that worked for Phaedra between the years 40 BBY and 34 BBY. The droid was destroyed after being shot down in Phaedra's shuttle by the bounty hunter Zam Wesell in the Y'Toub system.

The lodging and hospitality quarter was an area of Point Ueda, the planet Ueda's capital city. The city once housed the administrative offices of a lucrative logging operation based on the valuable Ueda conifer and was home to the operation's mill workers.

The Old Loggers' Hill cemetery was a cemetery located in Point Ueda, the capital city of the planet Ueda. The city was built on the slope of a hill on one of Ueda's archipelagos and the cemetery was located around half way up outside the built up areas.
Sil Gohtta was an Outer Rim Territories and Trailing Sectors celestial body located in grid square Q-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Two-Headed Toothvole was a creature from Bogmadada with two heads each with a set of eyes. At least twenty cycles before 3 ABY, the pirate captain Hondo Ohnaka claimed to have killed the fearsome Two-Headed Toothvole of Bogmadada by shooting it between both sets of eyes in…
The destruction of the Wild Space planet Khepi occurred during the High Republic Era when an asteroid impacted the planet causing it to break apart.
Qorvino's island hideout was an island on Lake Amari in the Great Basin region of the jungle planet Akiva.
Qorvino's cave hideout also known as the Crash Site was a cave located on the jungle planet Akiva that was used by the pirate Qorvino to raid the Imperial supply lanes along the Hydian Way.

Bororn was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Bororn system in the Rseik sector of the Outer Rim Territories, located in grid square N-20 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was the site of the location known as the Mudfields of Bororn.

The trade commission of the planet Ueda was housed in an orbital station above the world in the Outer Rim's Ueda system during the High Republic Era. The haulcraft pilot Trowee Astur shuttled passengers and cargo from the space station.

A graphin was a creature with gray fur. The criminal Melo Tolicus wore a makeshift shawl made of graphin hide while being transported aboard the prison ship Palwick in 132 BBY.

A nori-inkal was a rare coral-like creature from Boothi IV, a location in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim. It had four pink appendages with fins and two thinner appendages between them with darker tips.
The borgax was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of borgle bat and mawgax.

The Imperial Archaeological Division was a division of the Galactic Empire. By 3 ABY, Doctor Jessik was member of the division who sent a report on their progress towards finding the Great Tomb of the Khepi in the Sayma Nebula from Hauler's Keep in the Khepi system of Wild Space.
The fanged tiglon was a species of feline creature.
A cantina operated on the planet Eiram shortly after the destruction of Starlight Beacon in the year 230 BBY during the High Republic Era.
The feathered slice hound was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of Corellian slice hound.
The winged quenker was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of quenker.

The Marek Crows was a group of pirates that operated in the Khepi system of Wild Space. in 3 ABY. During that year, the Crows sought to recruited new members.

An unidentified pirate ship was a starship belonging to the Filthy Zephyrs, a gang of pirate Quarren based on the ocean planet of Manaan.

The Eastern Wilderness was an area of the Outer Rim planet Ueda. During the High Republic Era, the Clarodian brothers Tianris Mez and Guanlos Mez supervised an old family deep-mantle mining operation in the Eastern Wilderness.
The Clarodian brothers Guanlos Mez and Tianris Mez jointly supervised an old family deep-mantle mining operation in the Eastern Wilderness of the planet Ueda during the High Republic Era.
BR-0D was a security droid belonging to Vonn the Hutt during the Galactic Civil War.
Em-8-Tee was an environmental droid belonging to Vonn the Hutt during the Galactic Civil War.
Pinedrillers were a type of creature that produced wool and could be found in the coastal forests of the archipelagos on the Outer Rim planet Ueda, home of the Ueda conifer pine.
Mehdo's Parlor was a private sabacc parlor operated by a Melitto named Mehdo in 3 ABY out of the backroom of the Domak Refectory, a popular cantina in Kijimi City on the fridge Mid Rim planet Kijimi.

Nagai were a sentient humanoid species hailing from the astronomical object Nagi. They had black hair, two red eyes, and pale white skin, along with pointy ears and unique face markings. The species was shown to be strong-willed and spoke in Galactic Basic Standard.
Disney Parking Planet was a terrestrial planet with a breathable atmosphere, typically used by visitors to the Disney Playground Planet as parking space.
Disney Playground Planet was a leisure destination planet in the galaxy. Visitors typically went to Disney Parking Planet first.

JO9-4MN was a boxy, primitive model of power droid manufactured by Veril Line Systems that was repurposed by the Trade Federation to act as a repair droid and foreman on the WD-2550 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer Fallon.
The psychotic jax was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of bearded jax.
The boar wolfcale was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of boar-wolf.
The whiskerback widow was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of hermit spider.
The barbed vesp was a species of creature bioengineered from mutated DNA of vesp.
C-9PO was a protocol droid belonging to Captain Brandell Mantracor during the Galactic Civil War.
BL-R4 was an astromech droid affiliated with the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts. A friend of fellow GSCR member Quinn, he had male programming and a shy personality.

Outer Kavorn was a terrestrial world. By 228 BBY, an infection known as the Blight that drained worlds of life, was found on Outer Kavorn during its spread across the galaxy. Around that year, the Blight's spread was stopped.

Levulia was a terrestrial astronomical object. By 228 BBY, during the High Republic Era, the infection known as the Blight that drained worlds of life was found on Levulia during its spread across the galaxy.
The Bad Hurt Time was the name given by the female charhound Ember to an event that occurred when she was a puppy where a spike-sparrow killed all but one member of her charhound pack.

Songbirds were a type of bird. Around 228 BBY, as a drift of Jedi Vectors flew through the sky above the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant, they swooped and dived like a flock of songbirds chiming through the air.

A spike-sparrow was a type of sparrow that could be found on the Outer Rim world Elphrona during the High Republic Era. By 232 BBY, a spike-sparrow killed all but one member of a charhound pack on Elphrona.
A sparrow was a type of bird. Types of sparrow include song sparrows and a spike-sparrow.
The Auberge, formerly known as the Glitterstim Shine, was a war cruiser owned by a spice dealer from Kijimi until it was confiscated by the Nihil after the formation of the Stormwall.
The Majestic Aiwha Clan was a clan of Jedi Initiates in the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. It shared its name with the aiwha, a type of flying amphibian native to the planet Kamino.

Khofeen was the only moon that orbited the planet Khofar, which was located in an intersecting portion of the Outer Rim Territories and New Territories. It was part of the Khofar system in the Lahara sector and lay in grid square M-5 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
2J-4DPR, also known by landing area staffers as Silvertreads, was an astromech droid manufactured by Lerrimore Automata assigned to repair and assess starships visiting the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.

The planet Mon Gazza was the site of relic markets during the time of the Galactic Republic. The markets gained a reputation for forgeries and replicas, and some time after it was claimed that the artifact Architect's Scepter was found there, author Suna Charoo commented on su…

During the Clone Wars, a siege took place on the planet Wrea against a Separatist base. C-B3 cortosis battle droids were deployed to the battle, however because their designs were sabotaged, they were ineffective in combat.

A office in Hauler's Keep was used by Reess Passik while he worked as a contract broker for the Miyuki Trade League in 3 ABY. The office had a viewport that overlooked one of the space station's hangers.
A Yarkora colony on the Outer Rim planet Carlac was settled by members of the Yarkora species by 132 BBY. The colony was located in Carlac's cold blue-sand equatorial deserts.

Godis Ulani's home neighborhood was located in Olega City on the Mid Rim planet Olega. The human Godis Ulani lived in the neighborhood during the High Republic Era, and in 132 BBY, while Ulani was sitting outside the Olega Apothecary, they wore clothing with a tartan pattern t…

The Southern Isles were islands located on the Mid Rim planet Olega. In 132 BBY, the spiritual horticulturalists Thakira Tatara and Kiraya Tatara traveled from the Southern Isles to Olega's capital, Olega City, to sell exotic seeds and sprigs.

An astronomical object located in Wild Space was the homeworld of the Shani species. According to the hyperspace savant Mari San Tekka, it was located beyond the known routes like the Wild Space planet Sophros.
CB was a RA-7 protocol droid, who was always robbed by the young orphans Cad Bane and Niro.
Dendroks were creatures found within the cave walls on the planet Kundu Minor.
The Upper Arts Sector was located on the planet Coruscant, situated three levels above an area near the Duros Blocks.

The Warehouse District was a district located on the planet Coruscant. In 19 BBY, the spy Chemish Runazha began monitoring the "4040s"—a pro-Galactic Empire activist group—and participated in their Separatist Reintegration Day protests.
The Duros Blocks were located on the planet Coruscant.

A city existed on the planet Duro during the later Republic Era. The city was crime ridden. The Duros criminal and bounty hunter Cad Bane grew up as an orphan on the streets of the city together with his friend Niro. The city was governed by a town council and had a police force.
This species was a sentient species that was present on the planet Abtin.
This species was a sentient species found on the planet Bororn.
A starship featuring the Hyperspace Lounge bar was active at one point, equipped with hyperdrive technology, occasionally employed as a means of travel.
The Zantarrk Gang, or known simply as the Zantarrk, was a gang that operated during the New Republic Era that were known for wearing different helmets from the Galactic Empire.
Lepidoptera was a classification of insect that included moths. Lepidoptera were known for their looping and erratic flight pattern.
Shellflowers were a species of flower. They had soft centers full of sticky syrup. Primitive beings would use their forefingers to extract the syrup.
Volkarans were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Elan Rast was a member of this species.
A species that originated from the Heptooine system and eventually evolved into the sentient Heptooinian species.

Sixbee was a droid who served the Colman family on Estarvera during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the droid was destroyed by an autocart while attempting to return to Ryden and Calina Colman.
The lommite processing plants was a location found in Eriadu City on the planet Eriadu that specialized in the processing of lommite, ores that were used to create transparisteel.

The Eriaduan resistance operated against the Nihil invading Eriadu.
A pale-skinned near-Human species found within the galaxy on planets like Tatooine. Tork and Sosio Kakra were a members of this species.

This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Aleksin and Pavol were clones of a member of this species.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy, found at locations such as the moon Quantxi.

An island on Lake Amari on the jungle planet Akiva that in 3 ABY served as a base for a criminal gang run by the Sullustan crime lord Surat Nuat. The island consisted of a series of caves and a single landing pad which could support a Sienar-Chall Utilipede Transport.

A jungle base in the Stormhollow of the planet Akiva that in 3 ABY served as a base for a criminal gang run by the Sullustan crime lord Surat Nuat. The base was built around a number of ruins and included a single landing pad.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Tox and their family were members of this species.

Luminous Magnificence was the throneworld of the Sovereign Latitudes of Maracavanya, a pirate nation ruled by the pirate Eleodie Maracavanya. It was located in Wild Space and situated in grid square H-14 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

A camp located in a clearing in the Myrra Valley region on the jungle planet Akiva was used by members of Typhoon Squadron in 3 ABY, The ruins of a stone arch and other stone structures were also located in the clearing.

This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.
A grayish-brown-skinned humanoid species found within the galaxy on planets like Tatooine. Gormaanda was a member of this species.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Nol Ilen and Jyss Cordam were members of this species.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

Gavin Darklighter's T-65 X-wing was a starfighter purchased for the human pilot, Gavin Darklighter, after he chose to relinquish his commission to the New Republic Navy when the New Republic refused to liberate the planet Thyferra from Ysanne Isard after she became the "legiti…

A resistance group was led by Gebnerret Vibrion, the former senator of the planet Ghorman. He emerged as leader of the group after disappearing from the Imperial Senate around 2 BBY. The group ultimately joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
The sacred tree forest was a forest visited by the Jedi Padawan Nakime, who underwent a series of spiritual trials to overcome temptation to the dark side of the Force after being blinded in battle.
Daedus's moon was the moon of the Outer Rim planet Daedus.
