A pirate group led by Captain Qorvino that raided shipping lanes along the Hydian Way from the jungle planet Akiva during the Imperial Era.

The raka, a species that appeared to be extinct, was a creature renowned for its tree-climbing prowess, using its sharp claws to scale the tallest trees on the planet Tenoo. Raka skeleton fossils were unearthed at an excavation site on the planet.

In 232 BBY, explorer droid 0G-LC had an excavation site on the Outer Rim planet Tenoo to unearth the fossil remains of rakas, ancient creatures on Tenoo which climbed trees using their well-adapted claws.

The Industrial Sector was a location on the Mid Rim planet Malastare. Months prior to their race on Batuu before around 10 BBY, racers Volo Bolus, Pyya Bocc, and Deland Tyerell raced on their speeders through a restricted section on the outskirts of the industrial sector on th…
A famine supposdedly occurred on Adarlon during the New Republic Era.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The humanoid species was distinguished by their green skin.

A group of freedom fighters was active on the Expansion Region planet Aridus during the Clone Wars, fighting against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Republic High Command sent at least one commando squad to Aridus in hopes of coordinating with the group.
Musso was a terrestrial planet where an imperial base was located.

The Back Alley was an alley in the Wonto District of Mos Eisley on the desert planet Tatooine which led from the Wonto District market to an Old Junkyard. By 3 ABY, an individual had lost a well–made airspeeder toy.
The Darksing D-45 was a heavy freighter owned by the Nallera's mining crew in the Tatoo system during the Galactic Civil War.
Sulton was a terrestrial planet where an imperial factory was located. After the Liberation of Lothal, the TIE Defender program was moved to Sulton.
A Hunter's camp was located on the planet Spintir.
A wooden bridge spanned a deep chasm beneath the Dawn Temple on the planet Spintir.
The Skryls were sharp-toothed aquatic mammals native to the planet Spintir. They whelped on the ice during winter and basked on the island's shores in spring and summer.
Pitsy was one of numerous protocol droids owned by a debtor of Watto in the Federal District of Coruscant.

The Pyke market was an area in the city of Mirogana on the Outer Rim moon Toshara. It was located between the Pyke District and the Market District of Mirogana. A merchant named Hen Puon operated a store out of the market in 3 ABY.

The Maintenance Room is a room in the city of Mirogana on the Outer Rim moon Toshara that could be accessed by a vent. By 3 ABY, a non functional sweeper droid had been stashed in a container with in the room.

Gorak’s suite was a private space used by the Pyke underboss Gorak Palas in the city of Mirogana on the Outer Rim moon Toshara that could be accessed by a turbolift from within Makal's Gambling Parlor.

A city was located on the planet Mygeeto. During the Clone Wars, part of the Mygeeto Campaign between Grand Army of the Republic's Galactic Marines, led by Clone Commander Bacara and Jedi Master Ki-Adi-Mundi, and the Confederacy of Independent Systems was fought in the city in…
A Rebel base served as a hideout for the Rebel Alliance on the planet Baroonda.
Q-13 was the personal droid of Jedi Master Skia Ro.
Hemlock's shuttle was a Rho-class transport shuttle that transported Imperial Doctor Royce Hemlock to the Imperial summit on Eriadu during or after 18 BBY.

A raider group attacked a Chorin village at some point prior to 1 BBY. The attack ended with many of the village's inhabitants being killed and buried. After the attack, Beilert Valance returned to the village and was outraged before leaving to attempt finding the raiders.

The Battle of Jabo was an engagement fought at some point by approximately 180 BBY. In the battle, the Twi'lek Jedi Master Skia Ro of the Jedi Order famously defeated the Sith Darth Kozyr, a fact that was known to Ro's apprentice Christina Starspeeder.
Arium Island was a volcanic island located on the tropical planet Eiram. It was known for a secret research facility studying blue scorpions.
Marchion Ro's prison was a prison that existed for the sole purpose of housing the convicted Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro following the Nihil conflict.

The Cularin space slug was a variety of space slug—gigantic silicon-based lifeforms that live in the vacuum of space—found in the Cularin system. Cularin space slugs were more docile than the space slugs found elsewhere in the galaxy and could be trained as guards.
The Chiloon Rift was an astronomical object located in Wild Space. It was located in grid square O-3 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
Keller's Void was an astronomical object located in the Inner Rim Territories. It was located in grid square L-15 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Khadaji Singularity was an astronomical object located in the Corridan sector of the Core Worlds. It was located in grid square J-10 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Kharmort's Miasma was an astronomical object located in the Unknown Regions. It was located in grid square H-9 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Magataran Maelstrom was an astronomical object located in the Inner Rim Territories. It was located in grid square N-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Marcol Void was an astronomical object located in the Kathol Outback in the Outer Rim Territories. It was located in grid square M-21 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Nakrikal Singularity was an astronomical object located in the Grumani sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located in grid square N-17 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Novolek Beacon was an astronomical object located in the Periphery, a region in the Tharin sector in the Outer Rim Territories. It was located in grid square S-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Open Sea was an astronomical object located in the Centrality of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located in grid square U-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Radama Void was a region in the Esstran sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located in grid square Q-5 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Black Delve was an astronomical object located in the Har Worlds sector of the Expansion Region. It was located in grid square J-16 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Drift was an astronomical object located in the Elrood sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located in grid square M-20 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Marais was an astronomical object located in the Hatawa sector of the Core Worlds. It was located in grid square J-10 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Noopiths was an astronomical object located in the Bozhnee sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located in grid square L-18 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Pangarees was an astronomical object located in the Airam sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located in grid square L-20 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Quintarad was a celestial body located in Wild Space in grid square H-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Roil was an astronomical object located in the Gordian Reach of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located in grid square Q-5 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Sundered Veil was an astronomical object located in the Phelleem sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located in grid square S-7 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Veil was an astronomical object located in the Farstey sector of the Expansion Region. It was located in grid square O-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Whirl was an astronomical object located in the Inner Rim Territories. It was located in grid square K-8 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Valtha Divide was an astronomical object located in Wild Space. It was located in grid square S-4 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
The Void of Aogros was an astronomical object located in Wild Space. It was located in grid square H-18 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Lahtee was a distant snow-covered planet located in the Mid Rim Territories of the galaxy. In 34 ABY, Supreme Leader Kylo Ren traveled to Lahtee with Vaneé to hunt down a Theelin Jedi survivor known as Grandea.

A town was located on the Mid Rim Territories snow-covered planet Lahtee that contained several structures, including an eatery. In 34 ABY, Supreme Leader Kylo Ren confronted a Theelin Jedi survivor known as Grandea on the town.

result: Kylo Ren finds out Luke Skywalker has died.
objective: Find and kill Grandea
x: After the conquest of Corellia, a mission was undertaken in 34 ABY by Supreme Leader Kylo Ren and Vaneé to the snow-covered planet Lahtee in the Mid Rim Territories in search of a surviving Jedi, Grandea.

objective: Finding the Echo Stone
x: The mission to Angcord was mission to the world of Angcord carried out by the Jedi Barnabus Vim and his Padawan Vix in search of mysterious Force artifacts, specifically the Echo Stone that had been a object of legend, capable of amplifying connections to the Force.
A village was located on on the planet Deppani.
The Decimator was a Resurgent-class Star Destroyer used by the First Order.
Beltire was a location in the Beltire system of the Mid Rim Territories' Narrant sector.

The Carlac belt was an asteroid field near the planet Carlac in the Carlac system of the Outer Rim Prefsbelt sector. In 132 BBY, the DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship Palwick exited hyperspace in the belt and collided with several asteroids, spinning out of control.

Xivalia was an astronomical object in the Xivalia system in the Bes Ber Bikade sector of the Expansion Region. The Galactic Republic knew the Alvadorjian species as "Xivalians" due to some of them settling there, but their true homeworld was in the Alvadorjia system.

A rebel cell organized on the Outer Rim jungle planet Akiva by a local named Calys during the reign of the Galactic Empire. As the cell grew, Calys's Twi'lek brother Asara Deyn began helping the cell by spying on Imperial patrols.
Omwat was an astronomical object in the Omwat system in the Garis sector of the Outer Rim Territories that was the homeworld of the Omwati species.
The Xenoform Interests Caucus was a political grouping within the Imperial Senate during the Imperial Era.
The Nonmonetary Trading Committee was an Imperial Senate committee pertaining to trade during the Imperial Era.
The Millennial Planning Committee was an Imperial Senate committee during the Imperial Era. In 19 BBY, Millennial Planning Committee members attended the COMPNOR-Alpha summit.

conflict: Investigation into the framing of the Jedi
x: In 19 BBY, a bombing took place on the Holy City of the moon Jedha during a mass mourning procession for the Jedi Order after its destruction by the Galactic Empire.
1649th level was a level of the planet Coruscant.
Argazda was an astronomical object in the Argazda system in the Kanz sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Argazda was the farthest edge of the Zygerrian Slave Empire at its height.
Woostri was an astronomical object that was the homeworld of the Woostroid species. Woostri was also the homeworld of the human male mercenary Migs Mayfeld.
Bimmisaari was an astronomical object in the galaxy's Mid Rim that was located on a hyperspace route between Charros IV and Boonta.
Columex was an astronomical object located in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories along the Perlemian Trade Route and the Salin Corridor.
Suarbi was an astronomical object that was located in the Suarbi system in the Quence sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was located along a major hyperlane that linked it to the Svivren system.
Level 4168 was a level of the planet Coruscant.
Suboreen was a planet located in the galaxy. Around 6 ABY, Beilert Valance met with Han Solo at the planet.

The Palpatine Foundation was a Galactic Empire organization that shared its name with Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine. In 2 BBY, the organization hosted the Third Decennial Imperial Jubilee on the planet Alderaan.

Red was a BDX droid who was active at Savi & Son Salvage in Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu by 34 ABY. The diminutive biped was a charismatic leader who enjoyed supervising his fellow BDX units and developing plans.
A OOM command battle droid served the Confederacy of Independent Systems in the Separatist Droid Army during the Clone Wars.

Grek was a BDX droid who was active at Savi & Son Salvage in Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu by 34 ABY. The diminutive biped was shy, but with a keen attention to detail, which made her effective at cataloguing.
Oskar was a BDX droid who was active at Savi & Son Salvage in Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu by 34 ABY. The biped was highly energetic and enjoyed pranks.

The Third Decennial Imperial Jubilee was a gala organized by the Palpatine Foundation and held on Alderaan in 2 BBY to celebrate the 30th Anniversary of Emperor Sheev Palpatine's election as Chancellor of the Republic.

t: Bombing of the Treitamma Political Center
result: Garm Bel Iblis presumed dead, rest of the Bel Iblis family killed
objective: To assassinate Senator Garm Bel Iblis
x: The bombing of the Treitamma Political Center was committed by the Galactic Empire under the direction of Armand Isard for the purpose of assassinating Corellian Senator Garm Bel Iblis. The senator's family were killed, but Bel Iblis was outside the building at the time.

A webberie co-op was a co-op of nine webberies based in Beldoni Valley, Ghorman. In 3 BBY, a broker for the co-op, Sunif Brecanti, travelled to the Ghorman capital of Palmo to represent the estates in a town hall.
A type of hive-mind beetle lurked in the service corridors of the First Death Star during its construction over the planet Geonosis between 14 BBY and 9 BBY.
The Wild Squadron was a rumored group of ghosts who scoured the stars each Life Day to collect the souls of the damned to join them in their unending hunt.

Typhloractyls were a species of reptavian creatures related to the Varactyls. They were kept as pets during the time of the Third Galactic War and could be found on the planets Coruscant and Dromund Kaas.
K'shar was a moon that existed somewhere outside of the jurisdiction of the Galactic Republic. A city was build in the hollowed inside of the rocky moon.
The Aspirant was a Republic Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship active in 19 BBY during the Clone Wars.
The Auxiliary Bay was a docking bay on the Achra Station, a space station located in the Akiva system. In 3 ABY, the docking clamps in the bay were fried and the whole system needed to be reset.

Nechrim's Wake, also known as Necrim's Wake, was a New Republic CR90 corvette led by Captain Gauvis during the New Republic. On the edge of the Fenril sector, it was attacked by Zantarrk Gang starships and forced to crash on Loradil.
A species of huge forest snakes lived on Endor. They had green scales with red motting.
A species of giant tree frogs lived in the forests of Endor.

Doric Prime was a planet that existed in the the galaxy. It was a mostly oceanic world, with few islands that harbored forests. A type of settlement was located near one of the islands and was supplied by a nearby hydro power plant.

Elkew-Nine was an IG-86 sentinel droid who worked alongside the bounty hunter Aurra Sing. Together with other IG-86 droids, Elkew-Nine was tasked with ensuring her security while she copied a list of Republic agents from Asajj Ventress at the Doric Prime power plant.

Ologage was city on the planet Ylagia. At the end of the Clone Wars, the city changed its allegiance from the Confederacy of Independent Systems to the newly-formed Galactic Empire as the Imperial Army entered the city.
A vortex moon orbited around the planet Ylagia, a world within a trinary star system.
Level fifty-ninety-one air race was an airspeeder race on Coruscant. In 20 BBY, Senator Bail Prestor Organa and Perrin Fertha attended the race in a private box.
Dead Man's Claim was an area of the Sayma Nebula near Hauler's Keep in the Wild Space Khepi system.
Digger's Charm was an area of the Sayma Nebula near Hauler's Keep in the Wild Space Khepi system.
The Scrap was a rocky area of the Sayma Nebula in the Wild Space Khepi system.
Mynock Lair was a rocky area of the Sayma Nebula in the Wild Space Khepi system that was home to a number of Mynocks.

Glassbreaker Way was located on the planet Coruscant. Around 19 BBY, the spy Chemish Runazha began monitoring the "4040s"—a pro-Galactic Empire activist group—and participated in their Separatist Reintegration Day protests.

The Irons was a neighborhood on the planet Coruscant. Around 19 BBY, the spy Chemish Runazha began monitoring the "4040s"—a pro-Galactic Empire activist group—and participated in their Separatist Reintegration Day protests.

Zephlin's Chrome was located on the planet Coruscant. Around 19 BBY, the spy Chemish Runazha began monitoring the "4040s"—a pro-Galactic Empire activist group—and participated in their Separatist Reintegration Day protests.

Rishon Street was located on the planet Coruscant. Around 19 BBY, the spy Chemish Runazha began monitoring the "4040s"—a pro-Galactic Empire activist group—and participated in their Separatist Reintegration Day protests.
The Selonian worker scandal was a political scandal pertaining to laborers of the Selonian species, otter-like sentient bipedals from the planet Selonia in the Core Worlds.

Leyoye Prime was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Leyoye system in the Elochar sector of the Mid Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, Confederacy of Independent Systems operatives were contracted by the CIS to plant a bomb on a city in Leyoye Prime and escape.

objective: Plant a bomb in a city
x: The Mission on Leyoye Prime was an operation during the Clone Wars. Confederacy of Independent Systems operatives were contracted by the CIS to plant a bomb on a city in Leyoye Prime and escape.

The spikeworm was a type of worm native to the remote forest moon Treen. They were large in size with a brown, segmented body from which small spikes protruded. The worms also had a large, beak-like maw with a spiked tongue.
The Rhanipur Belt was an astronomical object in the Rhanipur system in the Hevvrol sector of the Mid Rim Territories.

The Strange Pillar was a pillar-like rock formation in the Pillar Forest area of the North Jundland Wastes region of the Outer Rim, desert planet Tatooine. Sometime before 3 ABY a Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier crashed into one of the Strange Pillar.
The SuperNovas were a criminal gang based in Coronet City, Corellia, during the New Republic Era.
An archivist droid was kept by the Alvadorjian Nahasta clan to record memories of the group and its members. The droid was cylindrical and able to hover three meters above the ground.

The Concentrated Care Unit was a room located on level 9 in Lina Soh Hospital. In 1 BBY, after Luthen Rael stabbed himself using the Nautolan bleeder, he was kept safe in this room with life support for his interrogation the next morning.

objective: Recruit members for the Partisans
x: An attack was carried out by Saw Gerrera's Partisans against Center One, a Galactic Empire reeducation facility in 19 BBY.
Kessel City was a city located on the planet Kessel.
A succession crisis on Chandrila erupted sometime between around 32 BBY and 19 BBY, rocking the Core Worlds planet Chandrila during the Republic Era.

An attack was staged in Hanna City, in Chandrila, by the Confederacy of Independent Systems in the early stages of the Clone Wars. The Separatists caught planetary defenses off guard, and jammed all transmissions as Chandrila attempted to send urgent calls to Coruscant.

The Death Star Summit, as designated in the Imperial Archives, was a high-level assembly of the Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military, convened in a conference chamber aboard the Death Star shortly prior to the obliteration of Alderaan in 1 BBY.
Tibbannopolis was a location of the planet Bespin.

The junction station was a location on Starkiller Base. During the Battle of Starkiller Base, Rey and Finn sabotaged a junction box to allow Han Solo and Chewbacca to infiltrate Starkiller's oscillator structure.
The Assembly Area was a location on Starkiller Base.
The Interrogation Room on Starkiller Base was used by Kylo Ren to interrogate Rey.
In 19 BBY, a massacre took place outside of Cantham House, the official residency of Senator Bail Prestor Organa of Alderaan on Coruscant.

The Emergency Relief Area, also known as the Old Sports Ground was a sports ground in the southern district of the city Tel Bollin on the planet Endregaad which was taken over by the Corporate Sector Authority in 19 ABY following a deadly plague outbreak.
In 19 ABY, the Joxin system planet Endregaad in the Indrexu sector was placed under quarantine by the Corporate Sector Authority.
A task force of the Jedi Order was assembled in 132 BBY to travel to the planet Khofar to aprehend the assassin Mae-ho Aniseya.
The moon of Aster was a terrestrial moon that, according to the Theelin-human Jedi Padawan Jecki Lon, had a vibrant emerald ocean.

Human cultists were a type of cultist active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. When discussing the early rebellion with Axis network leader Luthen Rael, Saw Gerrera considered human cultists, along with the Partisan alliance and Ghorman Front, lost.
Tordus was a planet that was the homeworld of the Tordusian species.
Axiloth City was a city that belonged to the Axiloth civilization on the planet Tordus. By the time of the Galactic Republic, the city had turned into ancient ruins.
Xorfin were a type of giant fish found on the planet Tordus. They were dangerous and aggressive if approached.

The Asutvu Rift was an underwater area located near the Invasion Zone on the planet Manaan. By 3625 BBY, the Rift had become the site for the Syphus Collective, specifically within the Temple of the Progenitor.

The Sand Striker was a vehicle built by Lax Torios for planetary use on The Island of a planet. When Ros Okslad uncovered a crashed TIE striker, he loved the sandy look of it so much that he requested Lax Torios build him his own.
In 22 BBY during the Clone Wars between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic, Jedi General Mayanka Catrine departed from Outpost 716 for a mission.
R2-B0025 was an R2-series astromech droid that was present on the planet Corvus. The droid was painted in orange and black, with green and gold accents.

The Scythe IV was a G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter in service during the Galactic Civil War. It was the personal starship of Hortrix Steelarm, a smuggler working for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Tech Management was a field where staff of the Jedi Order operated in on the planet Coruscant in the Jedi Temple.
LEP-999, or "LEP" for short, was an LEP-series service droid that worked for the Hassarian Separatist general Kazameer.

terrain: Mountains out of stone, crystals and minerals
x: Siline was a planet located in the galaxy and was the homeworld of the Silinese species. The planet held a variety of biomes including forests of blooming pale-blue and green colored trees, grasslands, deserts, oceans, and mountains.

The Silinese were a sentient species hailing from the planet Siline. They had crystalline bones, facial horns and teeth and diverse vibrant skin colors with matching hair and eyes. Because of their physiology, they were stronger and tougher than many species, including humans.

result: Attacking forces repelled from the Kassina Outpost
Alliance to Restore the Republic strategic victory
Alpha Droid reprogrammed to serve the Akivan Rebels
Imperial data within the facility fully wiped
x: The Attack on the Kassina Outpost was an assault performed by the Alliance to Restore the Republic and Kay Vess' crew on the planet of Akiva, within the Galactic Empire's facility of Kassina Outpost.

result: An injured Gayla Reen escapes with all data disks
objective: Retrieve data disks
x: During the Clone Wars between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, the Confederacy of Independent Systems-aligned spy Gayla Reen carried out a mission to the planet Sullust in order to recover a collection of data disks.
Preene was a swamp planet located in the galaxy. During the Galactic Civil War, Luke Skywalker crash-landed on the planet and fought a Dragonsnake.
In 1039 BBY, the Quermian Sith Lord Ayanos Bactra conquered the planet Sarrassia in the Grumani sector and sought to exploit the world's Sarrassian iron resources.
Hadlyn was a rocky planet located in the galaxy.
A type of bird lived on the planet Hadlyn. Its screeches could awake the native rock creatures.
A species of rock-like creatures lived on the planet Hadlyn. When awakened by a screech of a Hadlyn bird, the creatures would assemble from separate rocks into a humanoid shape.

A Crowning Convocation was held on the planet Siline in 134 BBY. The Jedi Padawans Jecki Lon and Yord Fandar participated in the Crowning Convocation and managed to stop a conspiracy during the great hunt.
A translator droid was utilized by the Wookiee criminal Lonkus on the planet Liskan during a trade dispute between the Trade Federation and the Gillanter Corporation.
Around 160 BBY, Jedi Master Vernestra Rwoh carried out an attack on the pirate group known as the Strafes on the planet Cerifisis.
Kryger was a terrestrial planet in the Kryger system in the Ado sector of the Mid Rim Territories where the Jedi Order operated a Jedi temple during the High Republic Era.

Crystal bats were a type of bat found in the Triple Moon Caves on the planet Siline. In 134 BBY, while visiting the caves, the Silinese Rhos Arthyst told Jedi Padawan Yord Fandar to watch out for both crystal bats and endangered dry-rock salamanders.
Dry-rock salamanders were a type of salamander found in the Triple Moon Caves on the planet Siline. During the High Republic Era, they were endangered.
The Moten yacht was the personal SoroSuub 3000 space yacht of the woman Cellia Moten.
A mission occurred to the planet Tryth during the Imperial Era.

Syrinxians were a cultural group of a horned species hailing from the Outer Rim planet Syrinx Prime. Between 40 BBY and 34 BBY, the Syrinxians went to war with the neighboring Vekurans, as the latter invaded Syrinx Prime following centuries of distrust and tension between the …

A sentient species existed on the Outer Rim planets Syrinx Prime and Vekura. The populations of this species hailing from these two planets formed two distinct cultural groups: the Syrinxians and the Vekurans.

R2-F4 was an R2-series astromech droid that operated during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Circa 1 ABY, the droid was under the command of Labsol Renuffi, a technician who worked in the Death Watch bunker on Endor.

result: Jedi Master Mace Windu and Jedi Knight Aayla Secura incapacitated
Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn is stabbed by Corlis Rath and nearly dies fro
x: Between 40 BBY and 34 BBY, the assassin Corlis Rath and Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn engaged each other in a challenging duel on the agriworld of Mina-Rau.

t: Galactic Exploitation Technologies security team five-niner
x: Galactic Exploitation Technologies security team five-niner was a formation of six Mandalorian mercenary Bes'uliik starfighters working for the corporation Galactic Exploitation Technologies in the Chiloon Rift nebula.
Incom reconnaissance craft X396 was a StealthX starfighter operated by Ohali Soroc, a Jedi Knight of the new Jedi Order. The R9-series astromech droid Nineball functioned as the starship's navigator.
The RiftMesh Committee, informally known as the Mesh Committee, oversaw the operation of the RiftMesh, a communications network serving the Chiloon Rift in Wild Space.
A miners' support cooperative operated in the Chiloon Rift nebula during the era of the Galactic Alliance.

Crash Pit Three was a crash pit operated at the Sarnus Refinery, an ore refining complex operated by the businessman Lando Calrissian on the planet Sarnus in the Chiloon Rift during the era of the Galactic Alliance.
Crash Pit One was one of series of crash pits operated at the Sarnus Refinery, an industrial complex on the planet Sarnus owned by the businessman Lando Calrissian.
Crash Pit Six was a crash pit at the Sarnus Refinery industrial complex on the Chiloon Rift planet Sarnus.
A military coup on the planet Thaere Privo in the Thaereian system occurred during the Clone Wars.

An oversight board was active within the Galactic Empire during the construction of the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station. It was composed of six directors who reported directly to Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine's advisory committee.
Monnoc was an astronomical object in the Outer Rim Territories in grid square N-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid. During the Nihil conflict, refugees fled Monnoc in fear of the Nihil raiders.

Pontus was an asteroid city situated in the Pontus system of the Outer Rim Territories' Tolonda sector. The city became part of the Occlusion Zone following its formation in 230 BBY and was sealed behind a barrier preventing hyperspace travel.

Solunus was a settlement on the planet Asternin in the Outer Rim Territories. Nine months after the destruction of Starlight Beacon, Solunus was raided by the Nihil. During their raid, they were successful in capturing the Jedi Grand Master Pra-Tre Veter.
Aggarda was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Aggarda system in the Metatessu sector of the Mid Rim Territories that the pirates Zilastra and Burlug once visited.

Tellion was a densely populated planet in the galaxy that was a well-known manufacturing and recycling world. It was part of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era, and was afflicted by the Blight in the final weeks of the Nihil conflict.

Estarvera was a planet in the galaxy that was home to at least one city. During the final weeks of the Nihil conflict, Estarvera was afflicted by the Blight, and much of its population unsuccessfully attempted to flee the world.
A little-known world was, by the time of the Galactic Empire, a colony of Nothoiin, a planet in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

objective: Find Azlin Rell
x: Around 228 BBY, Jedi Knight Reath Silas underwent a search for Azlin Rell. Azlin Rell, a former Jedi assisting in a mission to the planet Sophros, had escaped in a ship. Following the mission, a memorial service at the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant was held.
Varovians were a sentient species from the planet Varovia. Naarok of the Varovian Order of Seers was a Varovian.
The trial of Marchion Ro was held around 228 BBY in the Galactic Republic's Senate Building on the planet Coruscant.

A shuttle was used by the Luminous Nine during their mission to the planet Sophros in 228 BBY to travel to the planet's surface from the Ataraxia. The shuttle landed safely on Sophros, but suffered immense damage to its systems and was unable to fly.

A type of wriggling creature was found on the planet Sophros. It was long and relatively thin for its length, and it was bright red in color. It had many legs and its underside consisted only of teeth.

t: Memorial service at the Jedi Temple
x: Around 228 BBY, a memorial service for those who had died in the Nihil conflict was held at the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant. The service was joyful, and hundreds of Jedi attended the service to honor the dead and laud their heroes.

A ship that belonged to the Jedi Barnabas Vim was later found on the planet Sophros by the former Jedi Azlin Rell, who used it to leave the planet. Aboard the ship, Rell found Vim's lightsaber and bled its kyber crystal.

A shuttle was used by the Drengir to leave the planet Banchii. The Drengir, who had a truce with the Jedi on Banchii, were given the ship by Jedi Knight Lily Tora-Asi in exchange for agreeing to help protect the planet.
N9 was a navidroid that served hyperspace prospector FalaFala Mo Dap during the High Republic Era.
TT-5T was a droid that served hyperspace prospector Trenwick Mashwick during the High Republic Era.

A terrestrial mining planet was the site of a chemical mine during the High Republic Era. The human Raf Thatchburn grew up on the planet and worked in the mine, which ultimately resulted in his lungs becoming shredded, forcing Thatchburn to wear a breathing apparatus.
Amaltanna was a planet within the Amaltanna system, a star system in the Kanz sector of the Outer Rim Territories.
The Battle of Amaltanna was a battle between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars on the planet Amaltanna.
The Atriik were a sentient species known to exist during the time of the Clone Wars. Members of the species possessed horns on the sides of their heads and mottled skin.

An oclatar was a many-tentacled creature found on the abandoned starship which contained the Tomb of Sarasti Thel, founder of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door. By 32 BBY, a nest of oclatars settled in the dark, depressurized interior of the ship despite the lack of atmosphere.

Kaltrais was a planet located in the Fenril sector of the Inner Rim Territories. By around 6 ABY, Tusvein Shoirin served as the president. Following his death, the Fenril Consortium took control of the planet.

A starship contained the Tomb of Sarasti Thel, founder of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door religious group. In the innumerable years since Thel's death, the ship had wrecked in an asteroid field, remaining there so long that it began to merge with the asteroids themselves.

Casino Yego was a casino ship that was located above Glee Anselm between 12 BBY and 9 BBY. In this time, the Seventh and Ninth Sisters met Eorgus aboard the ship to collect information regarding the whereabouts of Tensu Run.

Crax eels were a type of eel. At one point, the alien crime lord Sabi Sabo Acidy fed his brother to a pack of feral crax eels for a bottle of squig. Eventually the incident became known to the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra and New Republic Director Meteora Gray.
No earlier than 5 ABY, a six-month-long Expedition on Hoth was undertaken by the New Republic's Department of Artifacts and Archival Goods Retrieval on the Outer Rim planet Hoth.
Imynusoph was an astronomical object that was located in the Imynusoph system in the Kallea sector of the Outer Rim Territories in grid square J-21 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The Holo-News buyout was an event between 5 BBY and 3 BBY that saw the HoloNet News bought out. In the past, the station had been independent but was directly taken over by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems, with the Gal…
Around 41.5 ABY, a Damorian S18 light freighter was forced to land on planet after being ambushed by the Sith Meditation Sphere Ship and five Sith from the Lost Tribe of Sith.
The Secession of Sy Myrth was one of the defining events of the Separatist Crisis, occurring on the eve of the Clone Wars in 23 BBY.

Sinsara was a dangerous and minor planet in the Anoat sector within the Outer Rim. It had a mysterious connection with Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn's past. In the years before the Invasion of Naboo, the assassin Corlis Rath attempted to kill Jinn for a reason involving Sinsara.
A species of sentient bipedal species existed in the galaxy. One member of the species was the crime lord Sabi Sabo Acidy.
An Ot'oak, also known as a mole, was a burrowing creature native to Endor.
Tryth was a planet located in the Tryth system covered in mercury. The planet experienced ionic storms and mercurial rain.
The Campi were a sentient three-armed humanoid species that existed in the galaxy. Two members of the species were the emissaries Xiering and Stingxi.
A ship was utilized by the bounty hunter Quin Carree during the High Republic Era.
Broondas was a tropical planet where a separatist base was located.
The Flamsteed was a large utilitarian freighter in operation around the time of the formation of the Alliance to Restore the Republic in 2 BBY.
A BX-series droid commando was a BX-series droid a part of the personal entourage Cellia Moten at her estate. During or after 18 BBY, the droid was destroyed by Omega with a war hatchet.

Heavy Gan's Movers was a local smuggling ring that supplied rare goods and contraband to the wealthy citizens of Spintir. Their leader, Heavy Gan, was a Twi'lek who ruled his operation with cunning and intimidation.

A city was located on the Outer Rim Territories planet Mygeeto. It was a vast metropolis and featured a big spaceport. During the Clone Wars, battles had been fought in the city and heavy artillery strikes had damaged or destroyed many of it's buildings.
Dallow was a planet located in the Dallow system and the home of the Moten estate.

A sentient species was found to the planet Angcord, commonly described as the first Pilgrims of Angcord among the Angcord kingdom, and comprising the majority of the Pilgrim Warriors by 482 BBY. They had elongated heads, with blue skin, black or brown hair, and gray eyes.

Bareen was a terrestrial astronomical object that housed a distillery during the New Republic Era. Between around 31 ABY and 34 ABY, as the human racing team owners Lando Calrissian and Han Solo shared a glass of ale on the Mid Rim planet Malastare, Calrissian praised the qual…
See-Fordeeoh was a droid who served Han Solo during the New Republic Era.
A pirate group was active during the First Order-Resistance War. At one point they took part in a mission to acquire a Jedi text from a ship that was being consumed by a star.
Ravnok was a terrestrial planet where an Imperial base was located. In 9 ABY, Din Djarin and Grogu visited the abandoned base in search of spare parts and were attacked by a Rancor.
Oldo was a terrestrial planet where a rebel base was located.
Mohan was a terrestrial planet where a battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire took place.

result: Kylo Ren abandons the Knights of Ren and officially joins the First Or

The Sharfree Pirates were a band of space pirates that operated in the Bright Jewel system during the Galactic Civil War. They piloted G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighters and M12-L Kimogila heavy fighters.
Sebulba's crew was a crew led by Sebulba to undertake a heist at the Hutt colosseum on Nar Shaddaa.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished their long, blubbery necks with multiple chin folds, as well as stringy hair.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished the fan-like crest that ran from the bridge of their nose and over their head.

This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished their wide, beak-like mouths and fin-like crest that fanned from the sides of their chins to the top of their head where it grew thickest.
The Hydian-Hutta Podracing Circuit, also known as the Hydian-Hutta Circuit, was a podracing championship that happened around 10 BBY.
Garel Shuttle 3765 was a GX1 short hauler on the planet Garel. In 4 BBY, the shuttle landed in Bay 22 of the Garel City Spaceport.
"Energy Coupling Alley" was what Fode called a section of the Moon Curser's Cup podracing track on Nar Shaddaa.
Neidoria was the homeworld of the Neidorian Paghee'Dhe Dahglyn.
Blightmoon was a moon that orbited the planet Malastare.
Zillo was a moon that orbited the planet Malastare.
The Occlusion Zone Occupying Force was an occupying force of the Nihil marauder organization that resided on the planet Eriadu within the Nihil-controlled Occlusion Zone during the High Republic Era.

result: The Castellan flees and crashes on Toshara
x: During the High Republic Era, the cruiser Castellan was attacked by the Nihil. As a result, the Castellan was forced to make a blind emergency jump to hyperspace and ultimately crashed on the moon Toshara.

Thraisai was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Thraisai system within Wild Space. It had a reputation as a vector for the trade of enslaved individuals, and was known as a hideout for bounty hunters.

This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The humanoid species was distinguished by their distinctive masks which possessed an almost beak-like shape, as well as a curved protrusion extending upwards from their cranial area.

This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The humanoid species was distinguished by their tan, almost orangish skin, with two large pointed protrusions extending from the sides of their heads, resembling either conical ears or fleshy horns.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The bulky humanoid species was distinguished by their gray and pointed ears.

Kiranno was a terrestrial astronomical object that was the homeworld of the Force-sensitive female Soona Taj, who was recruited into the Jedi Order during the Republic Era. It orbited three suns and it's terrain included hills and plains with grasses and trees and insects.
The Keeradak was a starship used by the Hutt enforcer Mayze Vice.

A duel between Separatist leader Count Dooku and Jedi Grand Master Yoda took place on the planet Vjun in the Outer Rim Territories. Dooku, before making a tactical withdrawal, was able to accomplish the near impossible by wounding his former master.
The Imperial Navy facility was a building that was situated on the planet Coruscant during the Imperial Era. The building was owned by the Galactic Empire and donated fully by the Imperial Navy.

Liicate City was the capital city of the planet Siline. It was located across a plain and was surrounded by a range of mountains on either side, which were formed in huge stacked pillars, and two river, which later joined into one, cut through the city.

A Felucian flickerbird was a type of sensitive bird that shared its name with the planet Felucia. In 228 BBY, while aboard the Emissary-class megacruiser Third Horizon, Republic Defense Coalition Admiral Pevel Kronara reflected that while a commander needed to externally appea…

Axel was an R-series astromech droid that was purchased by the Twi'lek Pyya Bocc on the planet Malastare while broken. Bocc's friend Volo Bolus was not pleased to see the Twi'lek bring home the droid and suggested he be returned, but Bocc was keen not to hurt Axel's feelings.
The Heart's Dagger was an X4 Gunship that was used by the Velocity Mercenaries during the Galactic Civil War. It was destroyed by Black Epsilon in the Dantooine system in 1 ABY.
C-1D6 was a medical droid in service to the residents of Kessan's Landing on Ord Mantell during the Third Galactic War.
ME-3P, or Emee, was a bartender droid who worked in Ardak Point cantina in Kessan's Landing, on Ord Mantell, during the Third Galactic War.

The Zerek Besh crime syndicate held a summit at its Westhill Palace on the casino planet Cantonica in 3 ABY. The summit was attended by a representative for the Pyke Syndicate, a representative for the Hutt Cartel, and a representative for Crimson Dawn.
A protocol droid was worked on by the Rodian droidsmith Gedeek Obaz in 3 ABY. When Kay Vess approached Obaz to help her with a job, the Rodian took control of the droid to attack her.

The Arch was an underpass formed from centuries of erosion in the Dune Sea region of the desert planet Tatooine. A dirt road ran beneath the arch and made an ideal passage for speeders despite the occasional bandit looking to raid defenseless merchants.

Droideka Gamma was a reprogrammed droideka and part of IG-88's Droid Army during the Galactic Civil War. It was part of a radical group of droids that planned to start a Droid Revolution before they were destroyed in 4 ABY.

A sentient species that possessed a fleshy appearance, with various bulges and folds, including multiple chins and layered jowls, with large ears, and a curved, an almost snake-like head-stalk that ended in a pair of eyes with exposed, vertical nostrils situated between them.
A sentient species that possessed a large cranium, with a head crest, four eyes, an inverted nose, pronounced upper lip, and bony neck.
Track Talk was a radio service that broadcast the Hydian-Hutta Podracing Circuit, around 10 BBY.
Epo was a planet located in the Epo system of the Outer Rim Territories' Ciutric sector. It was the site of Ansett Island.

Celadon was the name given to a terrestrial moon that the starship Oasis crashed on sometime after the Battle of Exegol. The Resistance member Coy Tria named it Celadon after the moon's pale green color.
Myoca was a terrestrial planet in the galaxy. Coy Tria and his family operated a tea farm on the Iensi Plateau in Myoca's Loe Province.

Galgus was a terrestrial astronomical object in the galaxy. In the years before the Clone Wars, three Jedi—Mace Windu, Kit Fisto and Fisto's Padawan Nahdar Vebb—fought a large creature that had been terrorizing a nearby village on Galgus, though the fight ended with Vebb slayi…
Thies IV was a terrestrial astronomical object in the galaxy that was home to giant cicadas with a hundred-year cycle.

Sterna IV was a gas giant in the galaxy that, during the reign of the Galactic Empire, was the site of an Imperial factory facility. The bounty hunter Boba Fett raided the prison to capture a prisoner as part of a bounty.
Taisun was a temperate planet located within the galaxy that was the site of Taisun Isle, which was ruled by the Taisun Isle Royal Court.
Sapper was a desert planet in the galaxy that featured intense sandstorms. During the Clone Wars, Clone Force 99 visited Sapper to investigate a Separatist installation.
Katou was a jungle planet located in Wild Space in the galaxy that became embroiled in the Clone Wars when Count Dooku ordered General Grievous to conquer it.

Pirros was a planet in the Fenril sector of the Inner Rim Territories that was once a member of the Galactic Republic. After the end of the Galactic Civil War, Pirros was among the worlds of the sector that formed the Fenril Consortium in opposition to the New Republic.
Sevetta was a mercury-rich planet located in the Sevetta system within the Sevetta sector of the Outer Rim. It had toxic air and was home to a mercury-based species that could shape-shift.
A type of aquatic sea creature was found on the planet Tolis.

Rabnir was a planet located in Wild Space. During the Galactic Civil War, the Twi'lek female Daesha, a disciple of Hitanaga, the queen of the Nightlands, resided on the planet and lured the Jedi Luke Skywalker to the planet so he could be offered to Hitanaga to house her spirit.

A near-human species existed in the galaxy. Members of the species were almost identical to humans, but had two hearts and had pink to fair-colored skin, white hair, black eyes and narrow, almost non-existent, black eyebrows.
Tamo'Akora was a gray-green terrestrial planet in the Amosu system. The largest of the star system's three worlds, it was the only habitable one, though it was constantly wracked with thunderstorms.
Zonus was a resource development company that extracted rare metals and natural resources from the mining planet Genya. Jin-Sim Canbelon was the company's CEO.
Genya was a mining planet. The company Zonus Corporation extracted metals and natural resources from it.
The Crusaders were a sect of radical Jedi led by The Grand Master.
The smuggler's tunnels, also known as the smuggling tunnels, were a series of smuggler tunnels located on Nar Shaddaa near the Moon Curser's Cup podracing track.

Provina was a terrestrial astronomical object that was visited by the New Republic D.A.A.G.R.s member Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra and the GNK-series power droid Deegee-Aytseven to find Chelli's half-sister Dellen Aphra.

Records was an organization within the New Republic during its reign. At one point no earlier than 5 ABY, astromech droids were being assigned to Records, alongside the New Republic Starfighter Corps, at a rate that left the Republic's droid pool flimsy.

Supply was an organization within the New Republic during its reign in which a tinkerer worked. At one point no earlier than 5 ABY, as astromech droids were being assigned to the Republic's Records and Starfighter Corps at a rate that left the Republic's droid pool flimsy, the…

The Evil Raiders were a group of space pirates active in the Endor system during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, they allied with the Black Sun against the Corellian Security Force.
Parantha was a city on the planet Aricho. It was less than a day's travel on foot from the capital Ytrecht.

3V-2L was a dark side-empowered battle droid created by Lord Umbral from the chassis of an astromech droid as part of his Master's Top Secret Army during the third Galactic War. The droid was defeated by the Alliance Commander at some point on Tatooine.
The Tava Yagen Asteroid Belt was an asteroid field in the Bovo Yagen system in the Kailion sector of the Expansion Region. Quadrillium could be found in the belt's asteroids.
D-29 was a bioanalysis droid who worked on Manaan during the Invasion of Manaan.
Tusk bunnies were a creature living on the planet Siline. They were rather small and were most active at dusk, and lived in the thicket of brambles in forests. They excreted light-brown spoor.
K-63 was a technician droid specialized in cybertech who worked on Manaan during the Invasion of Manaan.

Crowning Convocations were championships held on the planet Siline between the planet's youth every seven to ten planetary years when thermal vents in the continental crust of Siline busted and spewed red metallic vapor into the atmosphere.

headquarters: War Council tower, Capital district, Liicate City, Siline
x: The Silinese War Council was the main governing body of the Silinese government. It was led by the Allvoice. In 134 BBY, the allvoice was Enea Arthyst.
The Iru Clover was a heavy cruiser of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. It was used for stationing for larger missions throughout the galaxy and had a bay with Jedi Vectors.
Sorlapin were a type of clam living in lakes on the planet Siline. They had vibrant pink shells with white striations. Their flesh was oily and they were harvested for food and skin soothing lotions.
Lilacane was a southern region on the planet Siline. Arcol juice was a traditional sharp wine from the region.<
L4-RG was a battle droid and one of three droids created by an eccentric droid engineer on Ord Mantell with the help of a Republic-aligned individual.
QT-33 was an astromech droid and one of three droids created by an eccentric droid engineer on Ord Mantell with the help of a Republic-aligned individual.
ZP-U1 was a probe droid and one of three droids created by an eccentric droid engineer on Ord Mantell with the help of a Republic-aligned individual.
Ericadi were creatures native to Siline. They were considered the planet's most dangerous animal and apex predator, and they held deep cultural significance to the Silinese.

The hunting arena was an enclosed area of forest next to the ocean on the planet Siline in which the great hunt, the third and often last stage of the Crowning Convocation, was held during the later High Republic Era.
The Brightpetal conference room was a room in the upper levels of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. It had a long oval table and a dozen slim chairs and a window looking out on the Coruscant skyline.
A gas giant was the third planet in the star system of Siline. On one of the gas giant's moons, the Silinese had build an outpost.
On one of the moons of the third planet in the star system of Siline, the Silinese built an outpost.

The Silinese government was the government of the planet Siline. Its main governing body was the Silinese War Council, led by the allvoice. The government was formed during the early High Republic Era, when the different warring Silinese nations unified and civilized.
The Silinese Greater Sea was an ocean on the planet Siline. A small northern continent was located in the sea that included the Painted Desert of Indicate.
The Painted Desert of Indicate was a desert located on the smaller northern continent of the Silinese Greater Sea on the planet Siline. It included the gods-chimney.
The gods-chimney was a location located in the Painted Desert of Indicate on the smaller northern continent of the Silinese Greater Sea on the planet Siline.

An obstacle course was located in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. The course was used for Jedi training and was made out of various moving elements including pillars, ropes, bars for climbing, a pool, a balance bar with padded spears and spring pads, with the goal being to reach…
The sheeraptor was a type of avian creature living on the planet Siline. It build nests on top of rock formations.

MSE-6-PR2 was an MSE-6 series repair droid that had somehow wound up on Hoth with a crate of similar droids during the Galactic War. It requested help from an individual in recovering data from the wreck of the Sendant Pride.
MZ-7 was a secretary doid that worked for the individual known as The Curator.
S3T-BNS was a Protocol droid and merchant who sold their wares on Carrick Station.
The navora frog was a carnivorous frog that lived on Nal Hutta. It captured prey by emitting a rotten smell to attract flies and then released a quick burst of chemicals that flash-froze them.
SN-4RK was an astromench droid and merchant who sold cybernetic implants on Carrick Station on behalf of Lonndar Eadwinn.
Lont bugs were a type of insect. Dahara Devirsivik Norri enjoyed eating them fried.

A near-human species lived in the galaxy. The species greatly resembled humans, but they had blue skin and dark blue hair. One member of this species was Zefin Tuzo, the owner of a resort casino on Marquinn. Her security forces were of her own species and were all female.
The Syphus Collective was a Selkath isolationist group present on Manaan during the Third Galactic War.
The Ballian were a small furry species that originated from the Balli system in the Outer Rim Territories. The brother of Maisie was a Ballian on the planet Metagos.
EVE was an artificial intelligence that was secretly created by ARIA as a clone of her own programming which the Sith cult known as the Unmasked could use for experiments.
A bacta hot spring was a type of spring. The former Sith known as the Ronin was brought to a bacta hot spring to recuperate following a duel with the Grand Master.
The nihrotic monstrosity was a type of sithspawn created by the Sith alchemist Lord Kanoth through the use of Kanoth's alchemical creation, nihrot.

Watchdog was a remote combat platform created by the Sith cult known as the Unmasked to guard their research station in Sector R-4. It was created, in part, using the alchemical product known as nihrot and with the assistance of AIRA, an AI.
IP-CPT was a battle droid created by the Sith cult known as the Unmasked to guard their research station in Sector R-4. It was created by Lady Dominique with the assistance of ARIA, an AI.

327-C was a CR90 corvette dispatched along with 327-A and 327-B to attack the Rebel-allied X7 factory in the Mobetta sector. The corvette was produced by Corellian Engineering Corporation. It was part of Admiral Wooyou Senn's Task Force Vengeance.
Tallimar Prime was an astronomical object in the galaxy that was the home of the Ressad Dynasty which included the Tallimarian Centada Ressad.
Meddan was a terrestrial astronomical object in the galaxy that the bounty hunter Boba Fett pursued Samu Mavolak to during the Imperial Era.
Lulu was a droid owned by the Besalisk Joona. It was an old friend of the Jedi F.
Inoli was a terrestrial planet. It was the site of a carbonite mine. After earthquakes triggered a gas leak at the mine, a carbon freeze affected Inoli's population.

result: The shield relay unit is lost
objective: Steal a Imperial shield relay unit
x: After the hunt for Lyco Strata, the Theelin bounty hunter Latts Razzi led a heist at a shipyard on the astronomical object Cassaro to steal a Imperial shield relay unit.

result: Failure, Sebulba detained by Grakkus's criminal empire
objective: Steal credits from the Hutt colosseum
x: Around 10 BBY, Sebulba's crew attempted a heist at the Hutt colosseum on Nar Shaddaa. The heist failed, resulting in Sebulba being captured by Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi.

affiliation: Department of Artifacts and Archival Goods Retrieval
x: Deegee-Aytseven, nicknamed "Stripes" by Chelli Lona Aphra, was a modified GNK-series power droid in service to the Department of Artifacts and Archival Goods Retrieval.
To-Ba was a mobile gambling hall owned by Anzellan gangster Que-Dama and located within a AK-BK on the planet Olcatz. It was frequented by several individuals, including the Tonnika sisters.
Olcatz was a terrestrial planet with features such as mountains and islands.

Snowtrooper Ops, also known as Snowtrooper Operatives or Snowtrooper Scouts, were a group of specialized elite snowtroopers of the Galactic Empire. They specialized in stealth and in reconnaissance and scouting missions.
A starfighter was used by the Grand Master, who used it to travel to the planet Olcatz to find the former Sith known as the Ronin.
The planet Olcatz was put on lockdown by a Jedi known as the Grand Master in order to trap the former Sith known as the Ronin on the planet until the Jedi could find and kill him.

Winger was an assassin group active during the reign of the Galactic Republic. By 19 BBY, the bounty hunter Sevn contacted a Trandoshan about an assassin protocol she had installed in her droid partner IV-A4 that she was trying to remove.

Kaamui was a terrestrial planet that was the homeworld of the master of the droid Teto. At some point, Kaamui was destroyed by a war, and Teto escaped with his master aboard a starship designed to resemble the planet.
Ceezee was an RA-7 protocol droid with masculine programming who worked as a businessman.
A village was located on the snowy planet Joetz. After it was destroyed by the Galactic Empire, the rebel princess Crane rescued a survivor of the attack, the Gigoran child Woopas.

Oppressor was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that pursued the Jedi F. The Star Destroyer was captained by an admiral of the Imperial Navy and served as the flagship of Zero, formerly the Jedi Master known as Shad-Rah.
A Sheathipede-class transport shuttle was owned by the human Ron and was capable of being piloted by the droid Lulu.
This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were humanoid, with white skin, and a singular horn growing out of the left side of their forehead.
Tkoku Island was an artificial island on the planet Olcatz, accessible via the Tkoku Bridge. It was created by the Anzellan Que-Dama.

This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were diminutive humanoids with long arms that nearly reached their feet, as well as wide mouths, upturned noses, and long, curved, fleshy points extending from the sides of their heads.

A gang of Rodians operated during the reign of the Galactic Republic. By 19 BBY, when the Sand Bird, the starship of the bounty hunter Sevn and her droid partner IV-A4, was attacked, Sevn asked if their attackers were agents of the Basham mercenary group, which IV-A4 confirmed.

A duel occurred on the planet Olcatz between the former Sith known as the Ronin and Aneé-san, the bodyguard of the Anzellan Que-Dama, after the Ronin's astromech droid companion R5-D56 caused a disruption in Que-Dama's gambling hall aboard an AK-BK walker.

A battle occurred on Tkoku Island on the planet Olcatz when the Crusaders, a radical Jedi sect led by the Grand Master, were lured there by the former Sith known as the Ronin and the associates of the Anzellan Que-Dama.

Winger's base was a base used by the assassin group Winger during the Republic Era. By 19 BBY, while leaving the planet Genya aboard their starship Sand Bird, the bounty hunter Sevn suggested to her droid partner IV-A4 that they earn some credits.

A skirmish took place on a battlefield sometime after the Ronin's rupture with the Jedi clans. Amidst rain and blasterfire, a Sith known as the Ronin dueled a Jedi who would later call himself the Grand Master, near some crates and a moisture vaporator.

A golden droideka owned by Zonus Corporation was at one point employed by businessman Jin-Sim Canbelon. The large droideka variant could be directly controlled by a human pilot. Canbelon used the droideka in his duel against the bounty hunter Sevn.
The Morenias Sabacc tournament held aboard the casino cruiser Morenia in 3 ABY. The tournament's grand prize was the coordinates to the hidden moon Okala Five.

A rocky moon of the jungle planet Akiva, which was located in the Akiva system within the Meerian sector of the Outer Rim and New Territories. It was situated in grid square O-6 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

A four-breasted species was a sentient humanoid species that existed in the galaxy. Around 9 ABY, a light-skinned, dark-haired female member of the species was present at Starport Borgo, performing solo dances as a door girl to attract customers to a local dance club.

Renforra Base was a military base established by the Alliance to Restore the Republic on Renforra. During the Galactic Civil War, Specter Squadron, led by Jon "Dutch" Vander, was stationed at Renforra Base.

The Explorator was a Dreadnought-class heavy cruiser under the command of Commodore Visler Aqorian Korda III of the Galactic Empire. The Explorator was shot down during the Battle of Jakku, killing Commodore Korda.

Gold 1 was the designation of a BTL-A4 Y-wing in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It was flown by Jon "Dutch" Vander and had previously been designated as Specter 1 when the starfighter had been part of Specter Squadron and stationed at Renforra Base.

The Thrantha was a Star Destroyer of the Galactic Empire that was under the command of Captain Torsal. During or after 18 BBY, the Thrantha intercepted a yacht owned by Cellia Moten after it received damage to its engines.
Between 19 BBY and 0 ABY, a duel occurred aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Oppressor between the Jedi F and her former master, Zero.
The oceanic delegation was a political group that Prince Flot of the Taisun Isle Royal Court had to write a speech as part of his coronation day.

The Crusaders used Low Altitude Assault Transport transport crafts at some point. When the former Sith known as the Ronin was found on the planet Olcatz by the Crusaders, thanks to a report by the Rodian bounty hunter Do N-Yuk, the Crusaders mobilized transport crafts to the p…

A town was built around a coaxium refinery on the moon Ro Mira in the Vergara system. The town was build in a cave underneath Ro Mira's ice sheets. The town had many businesses and, like often with refineries, it attracted lawlessness and corruption.
Yakuza was an organization. The Anzellan gambling hall owner Que-Dama was a Yakuza leader.

A cemetery existed on the planet Olcatz by the time of its lockdown by the radical Jedi sect known as the Crusaders. It contained dozens of tombstones and a large rock with an illustration of the Jedi known as the Grand Master and the Crusaders squaring off against Ewoks.
Adikaria was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Adikaria system of the Core Worlds and the Interior. It fell within grid square K-12 of the Standard Galactic Grid.

The planet Olcatz had snowy mountains on its surface. The Anzellan Que-Dama ran To-Ba, a mobile gambling hall within an AK-BK that was at one point located in the mountains. A river could be found near the mountains.

The Sand Bird was a gunship used by the bounty hunter Sevn and her droid partner IV-A4. After the Sand Bird was damaged in an attack by Basham agents, Sevn and IV-A4 traveled to the planet Genya to make repairs, where they were hired by the businessman Jin-Sim Canbelon.

Basham was a mercenary group active during the Republic Era. An orphaned girl was kidnapped and raised by Basham and given the name Sevn by them. At the age of seventeen, Sevn betrayed Basham, and they sent agents after her on multiple occasions.

The Cave of Mutations was a cave located on the planet Dathomir. During the Galactic Civil War, the Nightsister Kyrisa performed bioengineering experiments on rancors in the cave, creating creatures considered as abominations by other Witches of Dathomir.

A Nihil crew was present in Slendo's during the occupation of Eriadu. The group of six officers were carousing in the back of the bar which annoyed the owner Slendo. After delivering a free round of Eriaduan ale to their table, they were shot dead by Slendo.

A Nihil group was present in Slendo's during the occupation of Eriadu. They entered the bar right after Slendo had killed a group of Nihil officers. They threatened him when the bartender told them his bar was now a no-Nihil zone. The group was killed by the patrons of the bar.

Mita was a terrestrial astronomical object located within the galaxy. The human female Sevn hailed from Mita, though she was orphaned during a war and eventually left the location by 19 BBY, temporarily serving as a mercenary for the criminal group Basham, before becoming a bo…

This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. These humanoids were distinguished by their dark green skin and tiered noses. One member of this species, Abron Mar, served as a lieutenant in Takara's criminal organization by 10 ABY.

The sky-bellied leaf eels were a type of eel living on the planet Siline. It was a long creature similar to a snake. The skin on the eel's upper side was red while on it's underside it was a darker color that was almost royal purple.
The Special Forces Clone Trooper was a type of special forces clone trooper employed by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

The Breeding Cave was a cave located on the planet Dathomir. During the Galactic Civil War, the cave was inhabited by a giant gaping spider domesticated by the Dathomiri Witches of the Spiderclan as their Queen Mother.

result: The Zerek Besh spy is found and killed
Sliro Barsha secretly creates an alliance with Bib Fortuna
objective: Discover the identity of a Zerek Besh spy among Hutt Cartel ranks
x: During 3 ABY, Jabba the Hutt coerced the bounty hunter Vail Tormin and the outlaw Kay Vess to perform a mission in infiltrating Fort Sunfire, a stronghold of the Galactic Empire, in order to identify a Zerek Besh spy planted within the Hutt Cartel.

This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The red-skinned species was diminutive and appeared humanoid, seeming to posses two arms and two legs, with rounded heads featuring only one mouth with elongated, circular lips, as well as two large eyes with smal…

A sentient humanoid species existed in the galaxy. Members of the species had large heads and green or pink skin. They had two small tendrils that danged from their upper lips, large black eyes, and lacked any visible nostrils.

A humanoid sentient species existed in the galaxy. Members of the species had tan skin with a pair of short, flesh-covered horns protruding from the upper fronts of their heads. They also had two pointed ears and could grow gray mustaches and eyebrows.

The Anzellan Que-Dama rode a modified mouse droid. The MSE series droid was equipped with a scrolling display screen and blaster armament, the latter being employed in a battle on Tkoku Island on the planet Olcatz.
The third moon of Filata was a terrestrial moon of the celestial body Filata. "Site-145" was an archaeological site on the moon.
5D6-RA-7 was an RA-7 protocol droid that served the Galactic Empire, and was aboard the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station shortly before its destruction during the Battle of Yavin.
The Rodian bounty hunter Do N-Yuk owned a fighter decades after the Sith rebellion. The starship docked to the AK-BK walker where the gambling hall To-Ba was located, on the planet Olcatz.

result: Sevn betrays Jin-Sim Canbelon and aids the insurgents
objective: Capture members of an insurgent group
x: By 19 BBY, Zonus Corporation CEO Jin-Sim Canbelon hired the bounty hunters Sevn and IV-A4 for a job and tasked them with capturing members of an insurgent group.

result: Alliance to Restore the Republic victory
objective: Investigate the Galactic Empire's movements on Joetz
x: Between 2 BBY and 4 ABY, the Rebel Princess Crane performed reconnaissance on the planet Joetz to investigate the movements of the Galactic Empire after they landed near a rebel base there.
Kay's room was in the attic of The Broken Hoof bar on the planet Cantonica where the thief Kay Vess lived during the Imperial Era.

A tentacled armed alien was seen imprisoned within Jabba's Palace around the time of the Rescue of Han Solo. The alien reached its tentacled arm outside of its prison window and grabbed protocol droid C-3PO but was swatted away by a Gamorrean Guard.

A YT-2400 light freighter was used by the Rebel Princess Crane following the evacuation of a rebel base on the planet Joetz. Crane sat in the YT-2400 light freighter's cockpit with the rescued Gigoran child Woopas and spoke with Admiral Basil Kiucee via hologram.

The Hooded Cloak was a YT-1300 light freighter belonging to a Cloak pirate officer during the Galactic Civil War. The ship was captured by the Corellian Security Force in the Corellian system in 1 ABY.

A ship was used by Jedi Hunters as they pursued Juro's ship. The Jedi ship escaped, but the Jedi Lah Kara was blasted into space and eventually drifted to an abandoned ship. The Jedi Hunter ship arrived at the abandoned ship, where Kara was again able to escape the Jedi Hunters.

Juro's ship was a starship used by the Jedi Juro, Ethan, Lah Kara, and Homen. While being pursued by Jedi Hunters, Kara was blasted into space and left behind when the starship jumped to hyperspace to escape. The Jedi later returned to rescue Kara.

The Suveron was a B-12 Bacta Transport. Sometime before 1 ABY, the ship exploded in the Endor system due to critical reactor failure. The destruction of the Suveron released a half million tons of bacta in space.
Lux's XS stock light freighter was a XS stock light freighter owned by Lux Bonteri during the Clone Wars, it was used to transport the Onderon rebels.

leader: Director of the Office of Extraplanetary Relations
x: The Office of Extraplanetary Relations was a civil diplomatic body on Manaan that dealt with the diplomatic needs of the Manaan government.

leader: Director of the Office of Ethics
x: The Office of Ethics was a civil body on Manaan that dealt with the ethical needs of the Manaan government.
The Department of Selkath Ethnology was a civil body on Manaan that preserved, promoted, and shared Selkath culture with visitors.

Arar-Toozero was a probe droid in service to Itai, a prospect to the Knights of Ren.

JN-47 was a bipedal droid who, between 232 and 230 BBY, damaged his vocabulator beyond repair. JN-47 then went to Dotti's Droid Workshop in Kublop Springs on the planet Tenoo for maintenance.

The Secession of Yag'Dhul was one of the defining events of the Separatist Crisis, occurring on the eve of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.

The shoal unitusk was a species of medium-sized fish present in Blba Groves on the planet Dantooine during the Third Galactic War. It could be recognised by the single horn on its head.
The bog guppy was a species of small fish present in Blba Groves on the planet Dantooine during the Third Galactic War.
The toe mangler was a species of small fish present in Blba Groves on the planet Dantooine during the Third Galactic War.

Bisnus were a type of small, quadrupedal, egg-laying creature that could be found in the junkyards on the planet Bracca. They had purple skin, green eyes, and gray fur.

The Empire of Art was the prospective regime of Perek, formally the Emperor's Hand named Cronal, after he infected the galaxy with his Art virus.

A building in the city of Palmo on the Colonies planet Ghorman existed by the time of the Imperial Era. In 3 BBY, a town hall meeting was convened at the building where many citizens of Ghorman complained to local officials about the Galactic Empire's presence on the world.
A ringed planet was situated in the Derosha system, orbited by the Derosha Six space station of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau.
A creature lived on Galgus. It had attacked a village and ate several villagers. Mace Windu, Kit Fisto, and Nahdar Vebb confronted the creature in an attempt to stop its attacks.
A village was located on Galgus. It was attacked by a creature who ate some of the residents.

Lethan referred to one of the many skin tones of the Twi'lek species, generally denoting a shade of red. The Twi'lek Shakka was a Lethan Twi'lek.
The white wroshyr grove was a location on the planet Kashyyyk that secretly contained the last surviving white wroshyr trees, which were sacred to the planet's native Wookiees.
The Well of Night was a hole in the white wroshyr grove on the planet Kashyyyk. It was a few meters deep and contained a Sith artifact known as a thornseed.

Balada's office was the office of Balada the Hutt, who ran the Hunters of the Outer Rim sports competition on Vespaara. This office was where Balada stored her archive of relics and costumes, sometimes showing them off or lending them to others.
The Axil Research Station laboratory was a section of the Axil Research Station that was used to assess, record and decode artifacts recovered from the Axiloth City ruins.

The Axil Research Station communications center was a section of the Axil Research Station that was used to maintain a station-wide relay and communicate with external clients like surrounding vessels and surface contacts.

Axil Research Station engineering was a section of the Axil Research Station that was used to maintain the water and air filtration systems. It also monitored the station's structural integrity. It was run by Maitland.

Harreld was a gemstone-rich planet in the galaxy. During the construction of the Death Star, Director Orson Callan Krennic negotiated with the planet's leader Harqque in an effort to secure Harreld's kyber crystal deposits for the Galactic Empire, but such negotiations yielded…

An archaeo-team worked on the Axil Research Station in the Axil Research Station laboratory assessing, recording, and decoding artifacts found in the Axiloth City ruins. It consisted of five individuals.

A four-armed alien ape was native to the remote forest moon Treen. The ape had white fur, and along with its four arms, the ape also had four ears.

The Ottegan Star Destroyer was a vehicle built by Lax Torios for planetary use on The Island of a planet. She created the vehicle as a way of honoring the legacy of the prior inhabitants of The Island, the Sacred Order of Ramulus.
A species of large reptilians lived on Endor. They could attack their victims with their strong tails or leap into the air to lunge at them.

A species with red eyes, yellow claws, and a tail could be found on the Forest Moon of Endor and in the deserts of Tatooine. They moved by propelling themselves with their large pincers, using them to jump into the air.
A species of green lizards with long tongues lived in the trees of Endor.

Fett Club was a club organized by Darth Tyrannus when searching for the clone template for the Grand Army of the Republic. It was named for Jango Fett, the assumed last surviving Mandalorian, who also was a member.

The Sweet Treat was a vehicle built by Lax Torios for planetary use on The Island of a planet. A variant of her small-scale snowspeeder replica, Torios made the vehicle as a special gift for Lanur Jad, whom she knew had a sweet tooth.
Tordusians were a sentient species that lived on the planet Tordus.

The Enigma was a research vessel once belonged to Darth Nul at some point before 3622 BBY. The Enigma was a self-sustaining vessel designed to be a mobile research facility capable of traveling to the farthest reaches of the galaxy.

The Red Light Orphanage was an orphanage located within the Red Light Sector on the moon Nar Shaddaa. Mako lived there until she discovered the institution was about to sell her. She crashed the bank account of the orphanage and escaped with the credits.
The Imperial Space Control was a department of the Galactic Empire responsible of issuing official permits for the installation of weaponry on non-military starships.

The Grand Inquisitor, Hydra, used a cruiser when hunting down Clive Flax and Astri Oddo. Clive Flax and Astri Oddo used the cruiser to escape a spaceport.
A Taylander shuttle was operated by a human pilot as part of the Rebel Alliance Navy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Huff Darklighter's personal security force was a private security force created by Huff Darklighter on the planet Tatooine. Some members wore stormtrooper armor which was stained dark blue to match the color of their uniforms.

R7-G8 was an R-series astromech droid that existed during the Clone Wars. It had red, blue, yellow and white plating.

Alaban was a planet that was a source of tibanna gas used by the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, Rogue Squadron attacked and damaged its mining platforms.
Aticar was an ice planet where bounty hunter Jango Fett pursued and shot down a pilot who had stolen data from the cloning facilities on Kamino.

Muglan's crew was a group of pirates operating in the Nihil's Occlusion Zone during the High Republic Era. Led by Captain Muglan Tarantyne, other key members included the Clantanni Renga and the Muun Gabb.

Straan Valgar's mob was a criminal organization operating out of the Port Hunavon space station during the High Republic Era. Led by the Gloovan crime boss Straan Valgar, their operations included organizing cage matches on which patrons bet.

During the Clone Wars, General Grievous was dispatched to capture the planet Katou in Wild Space under Count Dooku, and he invaded the jungle planet. Jedi General Cardiff Baye and his clone forces were sent from their battle on Covenanon by the Jedi Council.

Gray Squadron 1 was a BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The fighter was part of Gray Squadron during the Battle of Endor, piloted by Gray Leader Colonel Horton Salm with Kin Kian serving as his gunner.

Gray Squadron 2 was a BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The fighter was part of Gray Squadron during the Battle of Endor, piloted by Lieutenant Telsij with Karie Neth serving as his gunner.

Green Squadron 1 was an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The fighter was part of Green Squadron during the Battle of Endor, piloted by Green Leader Arvel Crynyd.

Green Squadron 3 was an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The fighter was part of Green Squadron during the Battle of Endor, piloted by Tycho Celchu.

Red Squadron 7 was an Incom Corporation T-65 X-wing starfighter in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The fighter was part of Red Squadron during the Battle of Endor, piloted by Keir Santage.

Red Squadron 4 was a T-65 X-wing starfighter in service to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The fighter was part of Red Squadron during the Battle of Endor, piloted by Derek "Hobbie" Klivian.

A species of shark lived on the planet Doric Prime. It was large and had two bodies joined together at the tail fin.
