The Overtone was a planet hopper captained by the Bivall bounty hunter Quin Carree of the Tempest Breakers, along with her partner Lourna Dee.
G3-R44 was an astromech droid that served the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

A diplomatic mission was conducted by Jedi Knight Bavoc Ansho and his Padawan Tualon Yaluna as representatives of the Jedi Order by 22 BBY during the Republic Era in which they escorted a senator and defended them from bandits.

The Sanyassan Marauders were a group of Sanyassans who inhabited the Dragon's Pelt savanna on the forest moon of Endor around 9 BBY. They forced their blurrgs, members of a local breed, to tow wheeled wagons.

IG-72 was an IG-series assassin droid manufactured by Holowan Laboratories who worked as an assassin and a bounty hunter. By 9 ABY, the droid had self-destructed while taking part in the hunt for the Republic Era fugitive Adar Tallon on the planet Tatooine.

Dwoobs were a type of creature with brown fur. In 9 ABY, a pair of Gamorrean fighters wore traditional leather and dwoob-fur trunks while brawling for sport in the arena at the honky tonk of Abyssin criminal Gor Koresh on the planet RTK111.

Clan Bralor was a Mandalorian clan that existed during the New Republic Era. One member of the clan, Kort Bralor, was a member of the Children of the Watch, a religion of Mandalorian followers of the Way of the Mandalore. Orange was a color associated with the clan.

Crondre was an astronomical object that was part of the Dufilvian sector's Crondre system, which fell within square R-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid as part of the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice.
Farshore was a section of the Great Basin region of Akiva, a jungle planet in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was situated on the shore of the basin's Lake Amari.

Three Human dark side adherents operated on the moon Kalakar Six. They claimed to have uncovered secret knowledge of the dark side of the Force that was otherwise only known to Emperor Palpatine and his Sith Apprentice Darth Vader.

Strills were a type of creature with thick brown fur during winter. The Mandalorian known as the Armorer wore a mantle of thick winter strill fur over her armor while living in a secret covert on the planet Nevarro in 9 ABY.
A thelpian lizard was a type of lizard that could be served as food.
Bull rancors were a type of rancor. As a rancor, it was semi-sentient.
The Entertainment District was an entertainment area located on the planet Janix.
The Mosyk were a sentient reptilian species. They had green skin, a bone-like structure on the back of their heads—similar to Vurk—as well as as three fingers on each hand.

A supervisor droid was in charge of a bank tower owned by the Gran crime lord Nico Deemis. During a raid on a bank tower, the bank droid was kidnapped by the Nightbrother Scorn, one of the Shadow Collective personnel, and brought back to a safehouse.
A police droid accompanied the human officer Pak during a raid on a bank tower on the planet Janix during the Imperial Era. He was destroyed by the former Lord Sith Maul.
Midani was an astronomical object in the Midani system in the Thuris sector of the Outer Rim Territories.

Dom-Bradden was a terrestrial astronomical object in the Dom-Bradden system in the Lol sector of the Outer Rim Territories. The Galactic Empire maintained an outpost on Dom-Bradden, but abandoned the facility after the Empire's collapse.

Vestar was a terrestrial astronomical object located within the intersection of the Outer Rim Territories and the Trailing Sectors. Situated in the Rseik sector's Vestar system, it lay within the coordinates N-20 on the Standard Galactic Grid.

Gorbah was a terrestrial astronomical object located within the intersection of the Outer Rim Territories and the Western Reaches. Situated in the Atravis sector's Gorbah system, it lay at the coordinates L-19 on the Standard Galactic Grid.
Iceni was a rainswept planet in the Iceni system in the Corporate Sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was where the luxury landspeeder company Arlen-Dempler was based.

Maul's safe house was a secret location on the planet Janix utilized by the criminal leader and former Sith Lord Maul and his Shadow Collective. A sizeable group of Mandalorian personnel occupied the area, which included weapons, speeders, and other supplies.

The Nihil Faksir was a member of a sentient species with bright orange blood. The species was slightly more resilient to the poison that Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro used to kill Faksir, as he did not dissolve from the inside-out as Ro had expected.

Janix Civil Defense acted as law enforcement on the planet Janix. Helmed by Chief Klyce, the organization included both humans and Tactical Defense Droids and was proudly independent of the Galactic Empire.

The metal yards was a location found on the planet Janix. During the Imperial Era, the former Sith Lord Maul landed at the yards with a starship obtained from a human he killed, before ordering the Zabrak Icarus and Scorn to destroy the starship.

The Felshi were a sentient species found within the galaxy. They were defined by their bulky builds and large limbs, with blue skin and small eyes. The one-armed boxer Kabb Uppercut was a member of this species.
Gatori's species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy.

A mine was located in a star system and was owned by a lord of the Empire. When the mine was new, the lord desired laborers to work in it and sent his Jedi to find volunteers from a small Outer Rim moon that was neighbored by the mine's star system.
A Fatfish was a type of fish. In 32 BBY, a Gungan stole a spatula from another Gungan on the planet Naboo who used it to cook fried fatfish.
Flutterby was a type of butterfly-like insect that was found in the galaxy. The Brendoki flutterby was one race of flutterby which was native to the forest planet Brendok.
M1-DY was a droid owned by Mill Alibeth during the Imperial Era.
RD-L1 was a green-plated protocol droid who worked for the Barsha Corporation valet Brencoyle.

A shootout occurred on the planet Serolonis located in the Kriz sector by 9 BBY. For decades, Boba Fett, a human male bounty hunter, favored an EE-3 carbine rifle after witnessing the Zabrak bounty hunter Sugi use one effectively during the shootout.

In 10 BBY, the criminals Jaylen Vrax and ND-5 landed their KS-500 light freighter, the Successor, in a spaceport just outside the urban district Kristom on the planet Giju while trying to track down the Imperial Security Bureau agent Madel Nureth.

The shuttle Martyr crashed on the Jenuwaa Sea of the planet Kalee by 29 BBY. It was arranged by Count Dooku, San Hill, and Poggle the Lesser in order to secure the allegiance of the Kaleesh warlord Grievous.
1BAR-0 was first foot droid to High Magistrate Greef Karga of the planet Nevarro, serving alongside his second foot droid, 2MAS-N.
Speckled versimillipedes were a type of versimillipede that was found on the planet Khofar in the Outer Rim. Unlike other versimillipedes, the speckled versmillipede was poisonous.
Ezra Bridger's A-wing was a RZ-1T trainer used by Jedi padawan Ezra Bridger in 2 BBY.
Sector 8-J was an area of Janix city on the Mid Rim planet Janix. It was situated in one of the city's districts near its Banking District.

The Skulljaw Grottoes was a location below the Daggersand Ridges on the Outer Rim planet Kintan. By 30 BBY, the Kajain'sa'Nikto Tsyr fought against the Jedi Knight Ma'kis'shaalas in along the Daggersand Ridges until Tsyr lost his footing and fell into the Skulljaw Grottoes below.
The Republic broadcast tower was a HoloNet broadcast tower operated by the Galactic Republic in the Network Security District of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.
The Hutt data haven was a HoloNet broadcast facility operated by the Hutt Cartel in the Network Security District of the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Cold War.

This species was a sentient humanoid species distinguished by their yellow skin and cone-shaped cranium. In 4 ABY, at least two members of this species were present in a casino on the planet Qiaxx.

The Mon Remonda was a large fleet starship that served within the navy of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. At one point during its service, it served as the posting for Polearm Squadron.
The Terminator was a starship that served within the navy of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. At one point during its service, it served as the posting for Obsidian Squadron.
A gang led by Bedat operated during the New Republic era. Forming his gang at some point no later than 28 ABY, Bedat employed many enforcers who carried out assassinations on his behalf.

An island on the planet Lehon in the Star Forge system was home to the Temple of the Ancients. By the year 3956 BBY, the island was home to two opposing Rakatan tribes, the Elders and the Black Rakata.

objective: Assassinate Noggox
x: During the Clone Wars, Count Dooku sent his Dark Acolyte Savage Opress on a mission to Affa.

A group of monks were active on the cold Mid Rim planet Vandor during the First Order-Resistance War. In 34 ABY, the dark-side practitioners known as the Knights of Ren, led by Tava Ren, went on a mission to raid a vault occupied by the group.
The South Beach was the southernmost beach on an island on the planet Lehon. By the year 3956 BBY, the beach hosted the settlement of the Rakatan tribe known as the Elders.

A small droid with masculine programming was a companion of the human mechanic Salju who lived in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu. He had a round body on two legs and a round head with large, pointy "ears" and a large black sensor.
A pirate crew boarded a derelict starship containing the Tomb of Sarasti Thel before being scared off by something aboard the ship.
The Central Beach was the centrally-located beach on an island on the planet Lehon. By the year 3956 BBY, a Hammerhead-class cruiser had crashed in the shore just off the beach.
Brindals were a sentient species with feet. Young Brindals were capable of wailing and crying, and Brindals identified as belonging to at least one—female—gender.
A moon was located near the planet Coruscant. It had a mine which was owned by a family.
A mine was located on a moon near the planet Coruscant. Long before 382 BBY, it exploded, giving the family that owned the mine a radiation blight.

South Beach was a coastline located on Kachirho on the planet Kashyyyk. It faced the Wartaki Sea. During the end of the Clone Wars, this area became the site of the Battle of Kashyyyk, where Wookiee warriors and the Grand Army of the Republic engaged the Separatist Droid Army …
C-2C was a 2-0A medical droid that served aboard the medical frigate Renascence. Shortly after the Night of Sorrow, she, alongside an FX-2 droid, treated Jedi Master Creighton Sun's injuries.
Trygyn was a terrestrial planet where a Republic base was located during the Clone Wars.

Two weeks after the funeral at the Jedi Temple, a ceremony was held on the moon of Eirie shared between the twin planets Eiram and E'ronoh to conmemorate a new peace treaty that would put an end to the Eiram and E'ronoh War.
Following the Battle of Jakku, Commander Barro's faction of the Imperial Remnant took refuge at a base on a frigid planet in the Outer Rim Territories.
A planet was the site of a battle between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the first year of the Clone Wars.
Red Hell was a modified WED-15 Septoid Treadwell that fought in the Grakkus Arena ran by the Hutt Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi. At some point, Red Hell fought the droid Silicate Uppercut.
At some point, a slave uprsing orchestrated by Wrollanppf happened at Grakkus Arena on the moon Nar Shaddaa.

JK-00P was a prototype Jedi assassin droid created by the Galactic Empire to hunt surviving Jedi after the execution of Order 66. JK-00P was forced to learn the history of the Jedi, and as a result it questioned why they were killed.

Tsutsuuya was a terrestrial planet that was the site of Galactic Empire Advanced Technology Development Bureau Facility No. 74. The prototype Jedi assassin droid JK-00P was activated at the facility and sent to hunt Jedi Knight Nagi Tsukumo.

A zando was a type of large creature with six legs, a pointed head, and a round body. Between 18 BBY and 3 BBY, a droid being chased by a zando was protected by the droid JK-00P when it arrived just outside of Droid Paradise.

A terrestrial planet had a population that the human Jedi Knight Nagi Tsukumo provided aid to at a point between 18 BBY and 3 BBY, during the Great Jedi Purge. However, the planet's people took advantage of a bounty for Tsukumo's capture and betrayed and poisoned him.
A wyrdwyrm was a type of creature found on the planet Metellos.
Hexvault Ring C was a hexvault ring located on the satellite Varcinius Repository.
The Bellwing Gang was a group that at some point muscled a coaxium refinery on the planet Savareen.
A planet was home to the Droid Paradise. Jedi Knight Nagi Tsukumo traveled to the planet with two droids—Dee-Seven and Ee-Ten—in search of the paradise.
A Krastik was a spiky aquatic creature. The individual Loonoo slept in a room under an aquarium that had krastiks.
A Needlebasker was an aquatic creature that would bunch up in schools. On the moon Nar Shaddaa, the individual Loonoo slept in a room under an aquarium that had needlebaskers.

The Bloodfin Hellions were a group present on the moon Nar Shaddaa. While in their room, the individual Loonoo would hear the Bloodfin Hellions race to their garage every night on swoop engines one hour before dawn.
Salvage Station was a location on the moon Nar Shaddaa. It had a bazaar that the individual Loonoo bought an elixir from.
SalSta #42 was a location found in Salvage Station on the moon Nar Shaddaa.
Ogoth Tiir was an astronomical object located within the Ogoth Tiir system in the Atravis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. During the Imperial Era, a battle occurred on the location.
An animal emporium existed on Level 220 on the moon Nar Shaddaa.

The Coruscant Deployment, also known as the push for Coruscant, was a military operation carried out by the First Order during the First Order-Resistance War that saw the Order attempt to capture the former Imperial throneworld of Coruscant.

The smuggler Han Solo was involved in an incident on Brentaal which also involved the Carpo Syndicate. He later believed that the reason the Kajain'sa'Nikto Harkos hunted him in Black Spire Outpost sometime after was due to the incident, though Harkos denied that idea.
The Mourner's Wail incident was an incident that involved the smuggler Han Solo and the Mourner's Wail Syndicate. was involved in an incident on Brentaal which also involved the Carpo Syndicate.
The Advanced Technology Development Bureau was a bureau within the Galactic Empire. An Imperial scientist within the bureau created a prototype Jedi assassin droid designated JK-00P.
An undercrab was a type of crab. The Adarian Twirm was fed to one such crab by Latts Razzi of the Razzi Syndicate.
During the High Republic Era, the Galactic Republic had a frontier office in Black Spire Outpost's spaceport, which acted as the planetary authority.

The New Republic Heritage Division was an organization within the New Republic. After the fall of the Galactic Empire, individuals such as holojournalist Corwi Selgrothe and historian Arhul Hextrophon conducted interviews with Rebel and Imperial veteran pilots, whose interview…
The Athos was a starship captain by Dumas Mar'Ti during the High Republic Era.

A sabacc league was held at the rebel base on Dantooine prior to the Galactic Civil War. Rebel pilots from multiple Alliance starfighter squadrons participated, competing against one another in sabacc.
The Ceremony Room was a room on the Rebel Alliance starship Mon Remonda. At one point, a Twi'lek pilot from Polearm Squadron reported that the noise outside the room was distracting their prayers.

objective: Find Droid Paradise
x: At a point between 18 BBY and 3 BBY, Jedi Knight Nagi Tsukumo and the droids Ee-Ten and Dee-Seven searched for a rumored location known as Droid Paradise.

The gambling district was an area of Mirogana, the capital city on the Outer Rim moon Toshara. It was located near the city's spaceport and contained various gambling establishments including Makal's Gambling Parlor, a number of Sabacc parlors, and a holographic fathier-bettin…

Thorden's personal bunker was an area of Mirogana, the capital city on the Outer Rim moon Toshara. It was build by for Thorden, moon's Imperial governor, in preparation for the fall of the Galactic Empire against the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Kala'unn Port Authority was the port authority of the Kala'uun spaceport on the planet Ryloth.
One of Imena's five moons had a spaceport.

A droid was responsible for rumors about a Droid Paradise on a planet. At some point, the droid powered down within a facility once owned by the company Tomizato where it broadcasted the rumors among droid networks.
Izzic was a terrestrial planet where a First Order base was located.
Walker Three was an All Terrain Armored Transport used by a faction of Neo-Imperials led by the warlord Barro on an ice planet during the New Republic Era.
An Iridium Mountain Gorg was a type of egg-laying gorg present in the Iridium Mountains on the planet Vandor.
An unnamed gas giant was the second planet of the uninhabited Farj system. A small moon orbited it.
The Algo's Progress was a starship owned by the San Tekka clan. Spence Leffbruk participated in the Hyperspace Chase aboard the Algo's Progress.
A terrestrial planet was the homeworld of Jedi Knight Nagi Tsukumo. Following Tsukumo's death, the droids Ee-Ten, Dee-Seven, and JK-00P returned his ashes to his homeland.
The Temple staff were beings employed by the Jedi Order to maintain the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
The Kessarine Fel Ix, alongside a handful of other Kessarine families, grew up in a small algae-farming community on the agrarian planet Atalia.
The Jellani Garden was a meditation garden located on the rooftop of the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant.

A type of insectoid creature had six legs, wings that it used to fly, large pincers, and a long tail. Between 18 BBY and 3 BBY, Jedi Knight Nagi Tsukumo and the droids Dee-Seven and Ee-Ten encountered one of the creatures.

The Starlily was a starship owned by the Graf family member Helis Graf. It was an older solar sailer retrofitted with subsidiary reactors that rendered the sails decorative antiques. It was shining white, with long wings and a bulbous double nose.
Bakh'tor was a territory of the planet Honoghr located in the Clean Lands.
Eikh'mir was a territory of the planet Honoghr located in the Clean Lands.

The Illodians were a sentient species native to the planet Illodia, the capital of the Core Worlds' Illodia sector. They had long lifespans. The Illodians colonized twenty scattered worlds that made up their sector.
Oxen were a horned creature herded on the planet Pkori. Between 19 BBY and 18 BBY, while visiting a town there, the Inquisitor Iskat Akaris saw Pkorian men leading red oxen with painted horns.

Jagoth was an astronomical object located far from the borders of the Galactic Republic, in the Outer Rim Territories. Around 362 BBY, a team of Republic Pathfinders led by Jedi Master Temesh travelled to Jagoth to investigate the death of Jedi Master Atticus Cale.

conflict: Taborr Val Dorn robs Kublop Springs marketplace
x: A skirmish between the Jedi Order and Taborr's gang took place in Kublop Springs marketplace around 233 BBY. The conflict began with Taborr and his pirate associates robbing a Nautolan shopkeeper before being confronted by Jedi Initiates Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay and Nubs.
The Geyser field was a location in the river around the town of Kublop Springs, on the planet Tenoo, filled with geysers. The Kublop Classic's final stage took place in the Geyser field.

A moon was one of two moons that orbited the planet Janix. After Spybot smuggled himself onto a Pyke cruiser, the droid sabotaged the hyperdrive, forcing the Pykes to land their starship and their shipment of credits on the moon.
The Starfarer was a CR90 corvette used as a tour ship by Hyperlight Tours.

objective: Find a Yara plant and heal Nubs
x: A search for Yara plant leaves took place during the High Republic Era on the planet Tenoo when Jedi Initiate Nubs caught the sniffles.

The top of a giant Tenoo tree was the only place where Yara plants grew. Around 233 BBY, when Jedi Initiate Nubs caught the sniffles, his friends Kai Brightstar and Lys Solay climbed to the top of the Tenoo tree, where they faced off a gangul and retrieved a Yara plant leaf.
Hangar eighty-nine was a docking bay located in the Coruscant Eastern Spaceport on the planet Coruscant. The CR90 corvette Starfarer started its 643rd tour there around 33 ABY.
A colossal starship was commanded by the Sith Gennoh and dwarfed any vessels that opposed him.
Kawabe was a terrestrial planet where a First Order base was located.

An R3-series astromech droid served in the First Order base on Kawabe as a spy for the Resistance, hiding in a storage closet and scaring any approaching stormtroopers. After sending out an emergency signal, he was rescued by Rey, Finn, and Poe Dameron.

The alien Krelman was a member of a humanoid species who strongly resembled humans, although they had six fingers on each hand, and they consumed liquids through a hole in their head, instead of through their mouths.

result: Clone Force 99 kills a Separatist creature
objective: Eliminate an unknown weapon on Vikir
x: During the Clone Wars between 21 BBY and 20 BBY, Clone Force 99 was dispatched on a mission to the ice-covered planet Vikir to eliminate a Separatist weapon, which turned out to be a large creature, for the people of the planet.

A creature was present on the ice-covered planet Vikir during the Clone Wars. Between 21 BBY and 20 BBY, Clone Force 99 went on a mission to the planet to eliminate the creature, which was being used as a weapon by the Separatists to coerce the people of the planet into joinin…
